Tu-in Filistiate hong pai-in Refaim kuam sung luh uh hi.
Tua ciangin David in Pasian thu dong a, "Filistiate doin ka kuanto ding hiam? Keima khut sungah amaute nong pia ding hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ciangin Topa in ama kiangah, "Kuanto in, nangma khut sungah amaute kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Baalperazim ah David paito a, amah in tua lai-ah amaute zo hi; tua ciangin David in, "Tuikhang in a phulkhap bangin Pasian in keima khut tawh ka galte phulkham hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua mun a min in Baalperazim kici hi.
Filistiate in tua lai-ah a pasiante uh nusia uh a, David' thupiakna tawh tuate mei sungah kihal hi.
Tua ciangin Filistiate in kuam sung luh kik lai uh hi.
David in Pasian thu a dot kik ciangin Pasian in ama kiangah, "Amaute' nungah na kuanto kei ding hi; kual pai in la lungli kungte gal khat lam panin amaute hih in.
Lungli kungte' dawnah kalsuan huging na zak ciangin galsim dingin pai in; bang hang hiam cih leh Filistia galkapte a vat dingin nangma mai-ah Pasian kuan khin hi," a ci hi.
Pasian in amah a thupiak bangin David gamta a, amaute in Gibeon panin Gezer ciang dong Filistia galkapte vat gawp uh hi.
Tua ciangin David minthan'na in gam khempeuh zel a, Topa in minam khempeuh tungah amah kikihtakna tungsak hi.
David in ama adingin David khuapi sungah innte lam hi; amah in Pasian' thuciamna singkuang' adingin mun khat bawlin puanbuk khat lamsak hi.
Tua ciangin David in, Topa' thuciamna singkuang a pua ding leh ama na a sem tawntung dingin Topa in amaute teel ahih manin Levi mite sim loh kuamah in Pasian' thuciamna singkuang pua thei lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a bawlsa, ama om nading munah Topa' thuciamna singkuang a paipih to dingin David in Jerusalem ah Israel khempeuh khawm hi.
Tua ciangin David in Aaron' suante leh Levi mi a khopte in:
Kohath-te beh sung panin a ukpi Uriel, a behte za leh sawmnih tawh ahi hi;
Merari-te beh sung panin a ukpi Asaiah, a behte zanih leh sawmnih tawh ahi hi;
Gershom-te beh sung panin a ukpi Joel, a behte za leh sawmthum tawh ahi hi;
Elizafan-te beh sung panin a ukpi Shemaiah, a behte zanih tawh ahi hi;
Hebron-te beh sung panin a ukpi Eliel, a behte sawmgiat tawh ahi hi;
Uzziel-te beh sung panin a ukpi Amminadab, a behte za leh sawm-le-nih tawh ahi hi.
Tua ciangin David in siampite Zadok leh Abiathar, leh Levi mite Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, leh Amminadab sam a,
amaute kiangah: Note in Levi mite beh lutangte na hi uh hi; ama adingin ka bawlsakna munah Israel Pasian, Topa thuciamna singkuang na paipih toh theih nadingun note leh na Levi mipihte uh nomau mah kisiansuah tawm un.
A masa lai-in no Levi mite na om kei uh a, a kisehsa bang danin kem lo i hih manin eite tungah Topa i Pasian hong hehin daan hong pia hi, a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel Pasian, Topa' thuciamna singkuang a paipih to dingin siampite leh Levi mite amau mah kisiansuah tawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' kamgenna tawh kizui-in Moses' thupiak bangin Levi mite in a liangko uh tungah zawlte tawh Topa' thuciamna singkuang pua uh hi.
Lungdamna aw gin'sak nadingin, la sakna nate, harp lasakna leh laiza lasaknate leh daltuahte nakpi takin tumin la a sa dingin Levi ukpite in a mipihte uh a seh nading David in thu pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Levi mite in Joel' tapa Heman seh uh hi; tua ciangin a behte sung panin Berekhiah' tapa Asaf; Merari minam sung panin a behte uh Kushaiah' tapa Ethan;
tua ciangin amaute tawh pawl nihna-in a behte uh Zekhariah Ja-aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Banaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Elifelehu, leh Mikneiah, leh kongcingte Obededom leh Jeiel seh uh hi.
Lasate Heman, Asaf, leh Ethan-te in sumngo daltuahte a tum ding ahi uh hi;
Zekhariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Hehiel, Unni, Eliab, Ma-asseiah, leh Benaiah-te in a paisuak-aw-in harp lasaknate a tum ding uh ahi hi;
ahih hangin Mattihiah, Elifelehu, Mikneiah, Obededom, Jeiel, leh Azaziah-te in laiza lasaknate a un-aw-in makai ding ahi uh hi.
Levi mite sungah la makai Khenaniah in la uk ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in thei hi.
Berekhiah leh Elkanah-te in thuciamna singkuang ading kongcingte hi ding uh hi.
Siampite Shebaniah, Joshafat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zekhariah, Benaiah, leh Eliezer-te in Pasian' thuciamna singkuang mai-ah peengkulte tum ding uh hi. Obededom leh Jehiah-te zong thuciamna singkuang' adingin kongcingte hi ding uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David leh Israel upate, leh a tul-a a ukte, Obededom' inn panin lungdamna tawh Topa' thuciamna singkuang a paipih to dingin pai uh hi.
Pasian in Topa' thuciamna singkuang a pua Levi mite huh ahih manin amaute in bawngtal sagih leh tuutal sagih biakna-in pia uh hi.
David in saihadial puan tualpi silh a, tua mah bangin thuciamna singkuang a pua Levi mite khempeuh, leh lasate, leh lasate a uk Khenaniah-te in zong silh uh hi; tua ciangin David in siampi puan khat silh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel khempeuh in sakite leh peengkulte, leh daltuahte' awging tawh kizui-in otna tawh Topa' thuciamna singkuang paipih to uh a, harp lasaknate leh laiza lasaknate tawh nakpi takin la sa uh hi.
Topa' thuciamna singkuang David khuapi hong tun' lai takin Saul' tanu Mikhal in kongvangneu panin na en a, Kumpi David laamin a gualnuam-a om a mu hi; tua ciangin amah in a lungsim sungah David neu-et hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Pasian' thuciamna singkuang hong tumpih uh a, David in ama adingin a lamsak puanbuk sungah koih uh hi; tua ciangin meihal biakna leh thu-nuama biaknate Pasian' mai-ah pia uh hi.
David in meihal biaknate leh thu-nuama biaknate a piak a man khit ciangin amah in Topa' min tawh thupha pia a,
Israel mi numei leh pasal khempeuhte tungah anlum lum khat, sa bak khat, leh leenggahkeu bek khat ciat hawm hi.
Tua tham loin amah in Topa' thuciamna singkuang mai-ah na semin thu ngen ding, lungdamna ko ding, leh Israel Pasian, Topa a phat dingin Levi mite pawlkhat seh hi.
Asaf in a ukpi hi a, amah zomah a nihnate in Zekhariah, Jehiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Banaiah, Obededom, leh Jeiel, harp lasaknate leh laiza lasaknate a tum dingte ahi uh hi; Asaf in daltuahte a tum ding hi a,
siampite Benaiah leh Jahaziel-te in Pasian' thuciamna singkuang mai-ah peengkulte a tum paisuak ding uh ahi hi.
Tua ciangin tua ni-in David in Asaf leh a Levi mipihte in Topa' tungah lungdamkohna la a sak ding seh masa hi.
Topa' tungah lungdamna ko-in, ama min lo un la, ama sepnate mite lakah kitheisak un!
Amah la sak un, phatna la amah sak un la, a lamdang ama septe khempeuh gen un!
Ama min siangtho hangin nuamin diang un la, Topa a zong mite lungdam ta hen!
Topa leh ama hatna zong un la, ama ompihna zong den un!
Ama hihsa a lamdang nasepte phawk un la, ama hih a lamdangte, a genkhiat thukhennate phawk un,
Ama nasem Abraham' suante, Jakob' suante, ama teel tuamte aw!
Amah in Topa eite' Pasian hi a, ama thukhennate leitung khempeuh ah om hi.
Amah in a thuciamna phawk tawntung hi, khang tulkhat adingin a thupiakna kammal,
Abraham tawh a bawl thuciamna, Isaak tungah kiciamin a khapna,
Jakob tungah thukhamin amah in a kipsak, Israel tungah tawntung thuciamna-in a kipsak,
"Nangma tungah Kanaan gam hong pia-in, gamhluah dingin na tanh dingin kong pia ding hi," a cihte phawk tawntung hi.
Amaute a mi-in tawmin, gen taak loin, peemta hi uh a,
minam khat pan nam khatah vak kawikawi-in, kumpigam khat pan gamdang khatah a pai lai-in,
amah in amaute kuamah nengniam sak lo hi; amaute' hangin amah in kumpite tai a,
"Ka sathau nilhte lawng kei un, ka kamsangte tungah siatna hih kei un!" ci hi.
Leitung khempeuh aw, Topa la sak un! A ni ni-in ama hotkhiatna thu gen un.
Minamte lakah ama minthan'na gen khia un la, a lamdang ama septe mi khempeuh lakah gen un!
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa lian a, nakpi takin phat ding ahi hi; pasian khempeuh sangin amah lamdang sak zawk ding ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh minam dangte' pasiante khempeuh milim hi lel a, ahih hangin Topa in vantungte a bawlpa ahi hi.
Pahtawina leh minliatna in amah umcih a, thahatna leh lungdamna in amah kimkot hi.
Leitung mi khempeuh aw, Topa thei tel un la, Topa' minthan'na leh a thahatna thei tel un!
Ama' min in ngah dingin a kilawm zah ciang dong minthan'na Topa tungah pia un; biakna paipih un la, ama mai-ah pai un! Biakna puan silhin Topa bia un;
leitung mi khempeuh aw, ama mai-ah ling un; hi hi, leitung kip a, kilok ngei lo ding hi.
Vantung kipak hen la, leitung lungdam hen, minamte lakah, "Topa maang hi!" amaute in ci ta uh hen.
Tuipi leh a sunga om khempeuh awng hen la, gamlak leh a sunga om khempeuh diang hen!
Tua ciangin gamlak singte in lungdamin Topa mai-ah la sa ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh leitung thukhen dingin amah hong pai hi.
Amah hoih ahih manin Topa tungah lungdamna ko un; bang hang hiam cih leh a itna kip a tawntungin a kho hi!
"Kote hong khahkhia in, ka kihotkhiatna Pasian aw, minamte lak panin hong kaikhawmin hong honkhia in, na min siangtho tungah lungdamna kong koh theih nading uh, leh nangmah phatna ah ka minthan' nadingun,
Israel Pasian, Topa in thupha ngah ta hen, a tawntung pan a tawntung dongin!" zong ci lai un, a ci hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, "Amen!" ci-in Topa phat uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in ni sim-a a kisam bangin thuciamna singkuang mai-ah na a sem tawntung dingin Asaf leh a Levi mipihte Topa' thuciamna singkuang mai-ah nusia a,
Obededom leh a behte sawmguk-le-giatte zong nusia hi; Jeduthun' tapa Obededom leh Hosah-te in kongpi cing dingte ahi uh hi.
Ama itna kip kho tawntung ahih manin, amaute tawh Heman leh Jeduthun, leh Topa tungah lungdamna a ko dingin a kiteel; a minin a kilo khia a om laite om hi.
Heman leh Jeduthun in la aw dingin peengkulte leh daltuahte nei uh a, biakna la sak nadingin lasakna nate nei uh hi. Jeduthun' tapate kulhkongpi cing dingin kiseh hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in a inn ciat uhah ciah uh a, David zong a innkuan thupha pia dingin a innah a ciah hi.
Tu-in David a innah a teen' ciangin amah in kamsang Nathan' kiangah, "En in, keimah in taamtaak inn hoih sungah ka teeng a, ahih hangin Topa thuciamna singkuang in puanbuk nuai-ah om hi,'' a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Nathan in David kiangah, "Pasian in nang tawh om ahih manin na lungsim a, om khempeuh hih in," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin tua zan mahin Nathan' kiangah Topa' thu hong tung a,
"Pai in la, ka nasempa David kiangah gen in. 'Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Nangmah in teen' nadingin kei adingin inn na lam kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Israelte ka paipih toh a, kipan tu ni dongin inn sungah ka teeng kei a, puanbuk khat pan puanbuk khat, omna khat pan omna khatah ka pai kawikawi hi.
Israel khempeuh tawh ka painasa mun khempeuh ah, keima mite tuu bangin a cing dingin ka sawl thukhente khatpeuh peuh tungah, "Bang hangin lamsak lo na hi hiam?" ci-in kam khat beek ka gen hiam?' ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in ka nasempa David kiangah hih bangin na ci ding hi, 'Vanglianpen' Topa in hih bangin ci hi, ka mi Israel tungah ulian a hi dingin lonona, tuu na zuihna panin nang kong la hi;
na paina peuhpeuh ah nang tawh kong om khin a, na mai panin na galte khempeuh ka susia hi; leitung miliante khat min bangin nang adingin min khat kong bawlsak ding hi.
Na nuntakna bei-in na pate kiang na zuat ciangin nangma nungah na tapate khat ka khangsak ding a, ama kumpi gam ka kipsak ding hi.
Amah in kei adingin inn khat hong lamsak ding a, keimah in ama kumpi tokhom ka kipsak paisuak ding hi.
Keimah in ama pa ka hi ding a, amah in Keima tapa hi ding hi; nangma hun ma-a sem Saul tung panin ka lak khiat bangin ama tung panin ka itna kip ka la khia kei ding a,
ka inn sung leh ka kumpi gam sungah amah kipsak paisuakin ama kumpi tokhomkip paisuak ding hi,'ci hi," a ci hi.
Hih kammalte khempeuh tawh kizui, leh hih mangmuhna khempeuh tawh kizui-in Nathan in David kiangah gen hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi David tumin Topa' mai-ah tu a, "Topa Pasian aw, nangmah in hih ciang dong kei nong tun' pih nadingin keimah in kua hi a, ka innkuanpihte in bang hi lel ahi hiam?
Na nasempa nong pahtawina ah David in nang tungah bang gen ding nei nawn ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in na nasempa na thei hi.
Topa aw, na nasempa' hang, leh nangma lungsim bangin hih na liante khempeuh na kitheihsakna ah hih liatna khempeuh na hih hi.
Ka bil-un ka zakna uh tawh kizui-in Topa aw, nangmah tawh a kibang kuamah om lo a, nang simloh Pasian om lo hi.
Izipt panin na hotkhiatna mite mai-ah minamte hawlkhiatna tawh nang adingin a lian a lauhuai min khat na bawlna, Pasian pai-in ama mi dingin a hotkhiatna mi Israelte tawh a kibang leitungah minam dang kua om ahi hiam?
Na mi Israelte a tawntungin nangma mi ahi dingin na bawl hi; tua ciangin Topa aw, nangmah in amaute' Pasian na suak hi.
Tu-in Topa aw, na nasempa leh a suan a khakte tawh kisai-in na gensa thu a tawntungin kip hen la, na gensa bangin hih in;
tua ciangin, 'Israel Pasian, Vanglianpen Topa in Israelte' Pasian hi,' ci-in nangma min a tawntungin kipin kiliansak ding a, na nasempa David' ukna nangma mai-ah kip tawntung ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nang ka Pasian in keima suante kumpi-in nong bawlsak nading na nasempa tungah nong lak khin zo hi; tua ahih ciangin na sempa in na mai-ah thu nget ding han'na lungsim nei hi.
Tu-in Topa aw, nangmah in Pasian na hi a, na nasempa tungah hih na hoih na ciam khin hi;
tua ahih ciangin tu-in nangma mai-ah a kizop tawntung theih nadingin na nasempa' suan leh khakte thupha na piak ding nang hong lungkim ta in; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa aw, nangmah in thupha na piaksate a tawntungin thupha ngah ahi hi," a ci hi.
Hih thu khit ciangin David in Filistiate zoin nuaisiah a, Filistiate' khut sung panin Gath leh a khuaneute la hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Moab mite zo a, Moab mite David' nasem suakin siah hong puak uh hi.
Zobah leh Hamath gam kumpipa Hadadezer-in Eufrates gun kuam gamte ngah kik nuamin kuan ahih manin, David in amah doin zo hi.
Tua ciangin David in ama tung panin leeng galkap tulkhat, sakol tuang galkap tulsagih, leh khe galkap tul sawmnih la hi; tua ciangin David in leengkai sakol galkap khempeuh a zagui atsat sak a, ahih hangin leeng za khat' adingin a kicing siit hi.
Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer huh dingin Damaskas-a Siria mite hong pai ciangin David in Siria mite tul sawmnih leh tulnih that hi.
Tua ciangin David in Siria gam Damakas ah khuacingte koih hi; tua ciang Siria mite David' nasem suak uh a, siah puak uh hi. David a paina peuhpeuh ah Topa in gual zawhna pia hi.
Tua ciangin David in Hadadezer' nasemte in a puak kham kibawl lumte la-in Jerusalem ah ciahpih hi.
Tua ciangin Hadadezer khuapite Tibhath leh Kun panin David in sumngo tampi tak la hi; Solomon in tuate tawh sumngo tuikuangpi leh khuampite leh sumngo um-le-beelte a bawl hi.
David in Zobah kumpipa Hadadezer' galkap buppi a zawhna thu Hamath kumpipa To-u in a zak ciangin,
Hadadezer simin a zawhna hangin a hopih ding leh a lungdampih dingin Kumpi David kiangah a tapa Hadoram sawl hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Hadadezer in To-u tawh kido zel hi. Amah in kham ngun, leh sumngo tawh kibawl na namkim khempeuh puak hi;
Kumpi David in hihte zong, Edom, Moab, Ammon mite, Filistiate, leh Amalek, minam khempeuh kiang panin a puak khiat ngun leh kham tawh Topa' tungah ap khawm hi.
Tua ciangin Zeru-iah' tapa Abishai in Ci Kuamah Edom mite tulsawm leh tulgiat that hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Edom ah khuacingte koih hi; tua ciangin Edom mite khempeuh David' nasem suak uh hi. Topa in David a paina peuhpeuh ah gualzawhna pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in Israel khempeuh tungah uk hi; amah in a mite khempeuh tungah thuman leh thutang zang hi.
Zeru-iah' tapa Joab in galkapte a uk ahi hi; Ahilud' tapa Jehoshafat in thuciamtehpa ahi hi;
Ahitub' tapa Zadok leh Abiathar' tapa Ahimelek in siampite ahi uh hi; Shavsha in lai-atpa ahi hi;
Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah in Khereth mite leh Peleth mite tungah a uk ahi hi; David' tapate in kumpipa' nasepna-ah maang liante ahi uh hi.
Hih thu khit tawl khat ciangin Ammon mite' kumpipa Nahash si a, a tapa in ama tangin uk hi.
Tua ciangin, David in, "Ama pa kei tungah thuman takin hong gamta ahih manin Nahash' tapa Hanun tungah thuman takin ka gamta ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin David in a pa huhau-in amah a hehnem dingin kamtaite sawl hi. Tua ciangin David' nasemte amah a hehnem dingin Ammon mite'gam Hanun' kiangah hong pai uh hi.
Ahih hangin Ammon mite' uliante in Hanun' kiangah, "David in nang kiangah hehnemte hong sawlna hangin na pa a pahtawi hi, ci-in ngaihsun na hi hiam? A phekleh ding leh a lumlet ding leh gam sung ensim dingin ama nasemte na kiangah hong pai hilo ahi hiam? a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Hanun in David' nasemte manin a khamul uh metsak a, a kawngciang uhah a puante at khiatsakna tawh amaute daisakin sawl khia hi; tua ciangin amaute kihem uh hi.
Hih mite tawh kisai thu David kiangah a kigen ciangin amah in amaute a dawntuah dingin mi sawl hi; bang hang hiam cih leh hih mite nakpi takin maizum uh a, ciah ngam lo uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Na khamul uh a khan' kik mateng Jerikho ah om un la, tua ciangin hong ciah un," a ci hi.
Ammon mite in David' muhdahin amau mah a kibawl tawmna uh a muh uh ciangin Hanun leh Ammon mite in Mesopotamia, Aramma-akah, leh Zobah panin leeng galkapte leh sakol galkapte cial nadingin ngun talen tul khat puak uh hi.
Amaute in leeng galkap tul sawmthum leh tulnih leh Ma-akah gam kumpipa a galkap tawh cial uh a, amaute hong pai-in Medeba khua kiangah phual sat uh hi. Tua ciangin a khuapite uh panin Ammon mite kikhawmin galdo dingin hong kuan uh hi.
David in tua thu a zak ciangin Joab leh mi thahat galkap khempeuh sawl hi.
Tua ciangin Ammon mite hong kuan khia-in khuapi lutna ah galdo dingin hong pang uh a, a hong kuan kumpite pen amau teng mah gamlakah om uh hi.
Gal in a nung leh a mai panin a pan'na Joab in a theih ciangin Israel mi kitengkhia mi pawlkhat teel a, Siriate a do dingin pangsak hi;
a om lai a mite amah in a sanggampa Abishai' ukin koih a, Ammon mite a do dingin amaute kipangsak hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Siria mite ka lelh tuak leh nangmah in kei nong huh ding hi; ahih hangin Ammon mite nang na lelh tuak leh keimah in nang kong huh ding hi.
Hang in, i mite ading leh i Pasian' khuapite' ading pasal tat ni; Topa in ama hoihsak bangin hong hih ta hen," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Joab leh amah tawh a om mite in a do dingin Siria mite kiang nai hong naih uh hi; tua ciangin ama mai-ah amaute tai uh hi.
Siria mite a taina Ammon mite in a muh uh ciangin tua mah bangin amaute zong Joab' sanggampa Abishai' mai-ah tai uh a, khuapi sungah lut uh hi. Tua ciangin Jerusalem ah Joab hong ciahkik hi.
Ahih hangin Siria mite in amaute Israel in a zawhna a muh uh ciangin, amaute in kamtaite sawlin Eufrates galkhat a, om Siria galkapte sam uh a, Hadadezer' galkapte a ukpa Shofak a makai-in om hi.
David kiangah hih thu a kigen ciangin, amah in Israel khempeuh khawmin Jordan galkah a, amaute kiangah pai-in amaute a do dingin galkapte khawm hi. David in Siria mite do dingin gal pangsak a, Siria mite tawh kido uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israelte mai-ah Siria mite tai uh hi; tua ciangin David in Siria mite leeng hawl galkap mihing tulsagih, leh khe galkap tul sawmli that a, amau' galkap ukpa Shofak zong that hi.
Tua khit ciangin Hadadezer' nasemte in amaute Israelte in a zawh khitna a muh uh ciangin amaute in David tawh kilemna bawl uh a, ama khut nuai suak uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Siria mite in Ammon mite huh nuam nawn lo uh hi.
Kumpite in khuakhal sungin galsimin kuankhia zel uh hi. Tua hun hoih khuakhal hong tun' ciangin Joab in galkapte pai khiatpihin Ammon mite' gam sugawp a, hong pai-in Rabbah khua umcih hi. Ahih hangin Jerusalem ah David om hi. Tua ciangin Joab in Rabbah khua vatin lumlet hi.
Tua ciangin David in amau' kumpipa' kumpi lukhu ama tung panin lak khiatsak hi; tua lukhu kham talen khat gikin a sungah suangmanpha khat a omna amah in thei hi; tua hi a, David in tua lukhu ama lu tungah khu hi. Tua ciangin amah in tua khuapi panin van kinusiate tampi tak pai khiatpih hi.
Tua ciangin amah in tua sunga om mite pai khiatpihin sing-atnate leh tuzumte leh heite tawh na a sem dingin koih hi; tua bangin Ammon mite' khuapite khempeuh ah David in hih hi. Tua ciangin David leh mi khempeuh Jerusalem ah ciah uh hi.
Hih thu khit ciangin Gezer ah Filistiate tawh kidona hong om hi; tua ciangin Hushah khua mi Sibbekai in mithagolte' suan leh khakte khat ahi Sippi that hi; tua ciangin Fillistiate kinuaisiah hi.
Tua ciangin Filistiate tawh kidona om kik leuleu hi; tua hi a, Jair' tapa Elhanan in a teipi kung siamlawngpi cia a pha, Gath khuami Goliath' sanggampa Lahmi that hi.
Tua ciangin a khut lang tuakah khutme guk a nei, a khe lang tuakah zong kheme guk mah a nei, a vekpi-in sawmnih-le-li a nei, mi thalian khat a omna Gath ah gal om kik hi; amah zong mi thagolte' sung pana hong piang ahi hi.
Amah in Israel a to ciangin David' sanggampa Shimea' tapa Jonathan in amah that hi.
Hihte in Gath a, mithagolte sung pana hong piang ahi uh hi; David leh a nasemte' khutin amaute puk uh hi.
Satan in Israel langpan' a, Israel mi phazah a sim dingin David hanthawn hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in Joab leh galkap a ukte kiangah, "Pai un, Be-ersheba panin Dan ciang dong Israel mi phazah va sim un la, amaute a phazah ka theih nadingin kei kiangah thu hong zasak un," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Joab in, "Topa in a mite a zah za khatin behlap ta hen! Ka to kumpipa aw, amaute khempeuh ka topa' nasemte hilo ahi uh hiam? Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin ka topa in hih kisam sa na hi hiam? Bang hangin Israel tungah mawhna tun' ding na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in Joab thu-zawh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Joab kihem khia-in Israel sung khempeuh ah pai a, tua ciangin Jerusalem ah hong ciahkik hi.
Tua ciangin Joab in David kiangah galkap thei ding mi phazah pia hi. Israelte khempeuh sungah galkap thei ding mihing awn khat leh sang khat om a, Judah sungah galkap thei ding mi tul zali leh tul sawmsagih om hi.
Ahih hangin Joab in kumpipa' thupiakna hoih sa het lo ahih manin a simna ah Levi minam leh Benjamin minamte hel lo hi.
Ahih hangin hih thu ah Pasian lungkim lo a, amah in Israel vat hi.
Tua ciangin David in Pasian kiangah, "Hih na ka sepna ah nakpi takin ka khial hi. Ahih hangin tu-in nang tungah kong thuum hi, na nasempa' mawhna hong maisak in; bang hang hiam cih leh a haihuai mahmahin ka gamta khin hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in David' thu-mupa Gad tungah thu gen a,
"Pai in la, David kiangah, 'Topa in hih bangin ci hi; 'Nangma tungah thu thum kong pia hi; nang tungah kong hih theih nadingin tuate khat teel in,' ci hi, ci in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David kiangah Gad hong pai-in ama tungah, "Topa in hih bangin ci hi, 'Na lak ding khat teel in;
kialpi kum thum sung; ahih kei leh na langte in nang hong simgawp lai takin na galte' mai-ah kha thum sung galtaina; ahih kei leh gam sungah pulnatna leh Topa' vantung mi in Israel sung khempeuh ah suksiatna ni thum sung a piangsak Topa' namsau,' ci hi. Tu-in kei hong sawlpa kiangah ka ciahpih ding dawn' nading khentel in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in Gad kiangah, "Keimah in lungkhamna lianpi khat ka tuak hi; ama hehpihna lian mahmah ahih manin Topa' khut sungah hong puksak in; ahih hangin mihing' khut sungah hong puksak kei in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in Israel tungah pulnatna khat tung sak hi; Israel mi tul sawmsagih puk hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian in a susia dingin Jerusalem ah vantungmi sawl hi; ahih hangin amah in a suksiat ding lai takin Topa in mu a, tua thusia ah amah kisik hi; tua ciangin amah in a susia vantungmi kiangah, "Pha zo hi; tu-in na khut khawlsak in," a ci hi. Jebus mi Ornan' ancilna gei-ah Topa' vantungmi a din' laitak ahi hi.
Tua ciangin David khuadak to a, leitung leh vantung kikalah Topa' vantungmi ding-in a khut sungah a kidoksa namsau khat omin Jerusalem tungah a zan mu hi. Tua ciangin David leh a upate puanhampi silhin mai puk uh hi.
Tua ciangin David in Pasian kiangah, "Mi phazah a sim dingin thu a piapa in keimah hilo ka hi hiam? Khialin a gitloh gamtat mahmahpa in keimah ka hi hi. Ahih hangin hih mite in bang gamta khial ahi uh hiam? Topa ka Pasian aw, kong thuum hi, keimah leh ka innkuan daan hong pia in; ahih hangin na mite tungah gimna tungsak kei in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David paito-in Jebus mi Ornan' ancilna phual tungah Topa adingin biakna tau khat a lam nading a gen dingin Topa' vantungmi in Gad sawl hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa' min tawh a gen Gad' kammal bangin David paito hi.
Amah tawh a om a tapa lite bu uh a, Ornan in mangbuh a cilcil lai takin a khuadak leh Topa' vantungmi mu hi.
Ornan kiangah David hong tun' ciangin, Ornan khuadak a, David mu-in ancilna panin hong paikhia a, a mai lei lam ngatin David tungah zahtakna bawl hi.
Tua ciangin David in Ornan kiangah, "Mite kiang panin gimna a ven' theih nading Topa' ading biakna tau ka lam theih nadingin na ancilna mun hong pia in—a man a cingin piak dingin hong pia in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Ornan in David kiangah, "La in, ka to kumpipa in hoih na sak bangin hih in; thei in, meihal biaknate a, zat dingin bawngtalte, a sing dingin ancilna singte, leh an tawh biak nadingin a mangbuhte kong pia hi. A vekpi-in kong pia hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Kumpi David in Ornan kiangah, "Hi lo hi, a man a cing tawh kong lei ding hi; Topa' adingin nangma' aa ka la kei ding a, keima sum bei loin meihal biaknate zong ka pia kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in Ornan tungah a mun lei nadingin kham shekel zaguk a gik a pia hi.
Tua ciangin David in tua lai-ah Topa' adingin biakna tau khat lamin meihal biaknate leh thu-nuama biaknate bawlin Topa' tungah thu ngen a, tua ciangin amah in a thungetna a piakna-in a meihal biakna a hal dingin vantung panin meikuang pia suk hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' thupiakna tawh vantungmi in a namsau a pai sungah siat kik hi.
Tua hunin, Jebus mi Ornan' ancilna phual ah Topa in ama nget a piakna David in a muh ciangin amah in tua lai-ah a biak piaknate bawl hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Moses in gamlakah a bawl Topa' biakbuk leh meihal biakna tau pen tua hunin Gibeon mualdawn ah om lai hi;
ahih hangin amah in Topa' vantungmi' namsau kihta ahih manin Pasian' tungah thu a dong dingin tua lai-ah David pai ngam lo hi.
Tua ciangin David in, "Hih lai-ah Topa Pasian' inn om ding a, hih lai-ah Israel' ading meihal biakna tau om ding hi," a ci hi.
Israel gam sunga om gamdang mite a kaihkhop nadingun David in thu pia a, tua ciangin amah in Pasian' inn lam nadingin suang seeksate a bawl dingin suang seekte koih hi.
David in kongpi kongkhak a, zat dingin siktukkilh leh gak nadingin sik tampi koihin, teh zawh lohin sumngo tampi tak zong koih a,
taamtaak singte sim zawh hi lo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Sibon khuamite leh Tai-ar khuamite in David kiangah taamtaak tampi tak puak uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh David in, "Ka tapa Solomon khangno-in pumpi tawh sinna om nai lo a, Topa' adingin a kilam ding inn in gam khempeuh ah minthan'na leh pahtawina ah alian mahmah ding ahi hi; tua ahi ciangin keimah in tua inn dingin ka kiging khol ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin David in a sih ma-in na tampi tak koih khol hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a tapa Solomon sam a, Israel Pasian, Topa adingin inn khat a lam ding gen hi.
David in Solomon kiangah, "Ka ta aw, Topa ka Pasian' min dingin inn khat lam ding ka lungsimah om hi.
Ahih hangin kei tungah Topa' thu hong tung a, 'Nangmah in mi tampi thatin gal lianpipi na sim hi; nangmah in keima mai leitungah sisan tua zahta luangsak na hih manin ka min dingin inn na lam kei ding hi.
En in, nangma sung panin tapa khat hong piang ding hi; amah in kilemna mi hi ding hi. Keimah in a kimkot a, a galte khempeuh panin ama tungah kilemna ka pia ding hi; Ama min in Solomon hi ding a, ama hun sungin Isreal tungah kilemna leh daihna ka pia ding hi.
Amah in keima min dingin inn khat lam ding hi. Amah in ka tapa hi-in keimah in ama pa ka hi ding a, Israel sungah ama kumpi tokhom ka kipsak paisuak ding hi,' hong ci hi.
Tu-in ka ta aw, amah in nangma thu a gensa bangin Topa na Pasian' inn na lamna ah na tangtun' theih nadingin Topa in nang hong ompih ta hen.
Amah in Israel tungah nang hong uksak ciangin Topa na Pasian' thukham na zuih theih nadingin Topa in ngaihsut pilna leh thutelna nang tungah hong pia ta hen.
Tua ciangin Israelte' adingin Topa in Moses a piak thukhamte leh biakna ngeina kipte zuih ding na kidop nak leh na maa vang ding hi. Thakhauh in la, hang in. Lau kei in; lungkia kei in.
Gimna lianpi tawh Topa' inn dingin kham talen tul zakhat, ngun talen awn khat, leh teh zawh lohin sumngo leh sik ka koih khin zo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tam mahmah hi; sing leh suang zong ka koih zo hi. Nangmah in hihte na behlap ding hi.
Nangmah in na a sem ding mi tampi na nei hi: suangseekte, lei-le-suang inn lam siamte, khutsiamte, leh sim zawh lohin siamna nam khempeuh a nei,
kham, ngun, sumngo, leh sik sep a siamte na nei hi. Kithawi in la, sem in! Topa in nang hong ompih ta hen!" a ci hi.
David in zong Israel makaite khempeuh in a tapa Solomon a huh nading thu pia a,
"Topa na Pasian uh note tawh om hilo ahi hiam? Amah in na kiim khempeuh uhah kilemna hong pia hilo ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in gam sungah teeng mite keima khut sungah hong pia khin hi; Topa leh ama mite mai-ah gam sung khempeuh kinuai-siah hi.
Tu-in Topa na Pasian uh a zong dingin na ngaihsutna uh leh na lungsim uh kipsak un. Topa' min dingin a kilam inn sungah Topa' thuciamna singkuang leh Pasian' um-le-beel siangthote a kipaipih theih nadingin kithawi un la, Topa Pasian' biakinn lam un," a ci hi.
Tu-in David teekin kum tampi pha a, amah in Israel tungah kumpi-in a tapa Solomon koih hi.
David in Israel makai khempeuh leh siampi leh Levi mite khawm hi.
Levi mite kum sawmthum panin a tungsiah teng kisim a, a vekpi-in pasal tul sawmthum leh tulgiat pha hi.
David in, "Hihte tul sawmnih leh tulli in Topa' inn sungah nasep uk ding a, tulguk in mangte leh thukhente hi ding a,
tulli in kongcingte, leh tulli in phatna ding a, ka bawlsa lasaknate tawh Topa' tungah phatna pia ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in Levi mite a beh behin pawl thum suah a, tuate in: Gershon pawl, Kohath pawl, leh Merari pawl ahi uh hi.
Gershon' tapate in Ladan leh Shimei ahi uh hi.
Ladan' tapate in: A ukpi Jehiel, leh Zetham, leh Joel, thum pha uh hi.
Shimei' tapate in: Shelomoth, Haziel, leh Haran, thum pha uh hi. Hihte in Ladan' beh lutangte ahi uh hi.
Tua ciangin Shimei' tapate in: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, leh Beriah ahi uh hi. Hih lite in Shimei' tapate ahi uh hi.
Jahath a ukpi hi-in, Zina a nihna ahi hi; ahih hangin Jeush leh Beriah-te in tapa tampi nei lo uh ahih manin innkuan khat kisuak sakin sim khatin kisim khawm hi.
Kohath' tapate in: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, leh Uzziel, li pha uh hi.
Amram' tapate in: Aaron leh Moses ahi uh hi. Amah leh a tapate in Topa' mai-ah paknamtui a hal tawntung ding leh ama na semin ama min tawh thupha a piak tawntung theih nadingin a siangtho pen nate a ap dingin Aaron kituam koih hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian' mipa Moses' tapate ahih leh Levi minamte lakah kisim hi.
Moses' tapate in: Gershom leh Eliezer ahi uh hi.
Gershom' tapate lakah Shebuel in a ukpi ahi hi.
Eliezer' tapate lakah Rehabiah in a ukpi ahi hi; Eliezer in tapa dang nei lo a, ahih hangin Rehabiah' tapate tam mahmah hi.
Kohath' tapa nihna Izhar' tapate lakah Shelomoth in a ukpi ahi hi.
Kohath' tapa thumna Hebron' tapate lakah: Jeriah a ukpi, Amariah a nihna, Jahaziel a thumna leh Jekameam a lina ahi hi.
Kohath' tapa lina Uzziel' tapate lakah: Mikah a ukpi, leh Issiah a nihna ahi hi.
Merari' tapate in: Mahli leh Mushi ahi hi. Mahli' tapate in: Eleazar leh Kish ahi hi.
Eleazar in tapa nei loin si a, tanu bek nei hi; amau' tanau, Kish' tapate in amaute ten'pih uh hi.
Mushi' tapate in: Mahli, Eder, leh Jeremoth, thum pha uh hi.
Hihte in Topa' inn nasepna ah na a sem ding, kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah, a mi mi-in a minin a mi phazah zui-in a kiciamtehna bangin beh lutangte, a beh behin Levi' suante ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh David in, "Israel Pasian, Topa in a mite tungah kilemna pia zo hi; tua ciangin amah in Jerusalem ah om tawntung hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Levi mite in puanbuk hita leh tua tawh kisai nasep nading nate khat peuhpeuh hita leh a puak ding uh kisam nawn lo hi," a ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh David' thupiakna a nunung pen tawh a kisim hihte in kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah Levi mi a phazah ahi hi—
"ahih hangin amaute' nasep in Topa' inn nasepna ah Aaron' suante huhin, inntualte leh inndeite kemin, biakna na khempeuh a siangtho sak ding, leh Pasian' inn nasepna ah hih ding khat peuhpeuh a sem ding ahi uh hi;
Ompihna Anlum, an tawh biak nadingin annel, silngo sawh loh anlum moh, a ki-em piakna, sathau tawh a kihel piakna, leh a tam tehna, ahih kei leh a lian tehna nasep khempeuh zong a huh ding ahi uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute zingsang simin ding ding uh a, lungdamna koin Topa phatin, nitakin zong tua mah bangin hih ding uh a,
a mal zah a kisam bangin sabbath nite, khadet nite, leh pawi nite-in Topa tungah meihal biakna a kipiak peuhpeuh ciangin a tawntungin Topa mai-ah om ding uh hi.
Tua bangin Levi mite in kikhopna puanbuk leh biakinn kemin, Topa' inn nasepna ah amau' behte ahi Aaron' suante huh ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Aaron' suante a kisehkhennate in hihte ahi hi. Aaron' tapate in: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, leh Ithamar ahi uh hi.
Ahih hangin a pa uh sih ma-in Nadab leh Abihu si-in ta nei lo uh ahih manin Eleazar leh Ithamar-te siampi suak uh hi.
Eleazar' suan Zadok, leh Ithamar' suan Ahimelek' huhna tawh David in amau' nasepna ah a kiseh bangin Aaron' suante a koih hi.
Ithamar' suante lak sangin Eleazar' suante lakah ukpi tam om zaw ahih manin, amaute in Eleazar' suante pawl sawm-le-guk suahin, Ithamar' suante pawl giat suah hi.
Eleazar' suante leh Ithamar' suante lakah biakinn uliante leh Pasian' uliante om tuak uh ahih manin amaute in a kibangin aisaanna tawh amaute koih uh hi.
Tua ciangin Levi mi Nethanel' tapa ahi lai-atpa Shemaiah in Kumpipa, leh uliante, leh siampi Zadok, leh Abiathar' tapa Ahimelek, leh siampite leh Levi mi beh lutangte' omna ah amaute ciamteh hi; Eleazar' suante' adingin khat kiteelin, tua ciangin Ithamar' suante adingin khat kiteel a, kilaih sak niloh uh hi.
Aisaanna a masa pen Jehoiarib tung, a nihna Jedaiah tung,
a thumna Harim tung, a lina Seorim tung,
a ngana Malkhijah tung, a gukna Mijamin tung,
a sagihna Hakkoz tung, a giatna Abijah tung,
a kuana Jeshua tung, a sawmna Shekaiah tung,
a sawm-le-khatna Eliashib tung, a sawm-le-nihna Jakim tung,
a sawm-le-thumna Huppah tung, a sawm-le-lina Jeshebeab tung,
a sawm-le-ngana Bilgah tung, a sawm-le-gukna Immer tung,
a sawm-le-sagihna Hezir tung, a sawm-le-giatna Happizzez tung,
a sawm-le-kuana Pethahiah tung, a sawmnihna Jehezkel tung,
a sawm-nih-le-khatna Jakhin tung, a sawmnih-le-nihna Gamul tung,
a sawmnih-le-thumna Delaiah tung, a sawmnih-le-lina Ma-aziah tungah tu hi.
Hihte in Israel' Topa Pasian in amah a thupiak bangin a pupi uh Aaron in amaute' adingin a kipsakna ngeina bangin Topa' inn sungah pai dingin amau' nasep uh ahi a kiseh nasep nei uh hi.
Tua ciangin Levi' suante a om laite lakah: Amram' suante sung panin Shubael' suante Jehdeiah ahi hi.
Rehabiah' suante sung panin Isshiah a ukpi ahi hi.
Izhar' suante sung panin Shelomoth' suante Jahath ahi hi.
Hebron' suante lakah: Jeriah a ukpi, Amariah a nihna, Jahaziel a thumna, Jekameam a lina ahi hi.
Uzziel' suante sung panin Mikah' suante Shamir ahi hi.
Mikah' sanggampa in Isshiah ahi hi; Isshiah' suante sung panin Zekhariah ahi hi.
Merari' suante in: Mahli, Mushi, leh Ja-aziah ahi hi.
Merari' suante Ja-aziah' sung panin Beno, Shoham, Zakkur, leh Ibri ahi hi.
Mushi' tapate in: Mahli, Eder, leh Jerimoth ahi uh hi. Hihte in a beh tawh kizui-in Levi' suante ahi uh hi.
Hihte in zong a behte uh ahi Aaron' suante mah bangin kumpi David, Zadok, Ahimelek, leh siampite leh Levi mi beh lutangte' muhna ah beh lutangte leh a nau pasalte ciat in a kibangin ai saanna tawh nasepna tavuan la uh hi.
David leh nasepna ah a ukpite in zong laiza lasaknate, harp lasaknate, leh daltuahte tawh mai lam thu a genkhol dingin Asaf, Heman, leh Jeduthunte' tapate pawlkhat nasepna-a dingin koih tuam uh hi. Na a semte leh amau' nasepte in:
Asaf' tapate sung panin: kumpipa' makaihna nuai-ah mai lam thu a genkhol Asaf' makaihna nuai-ah Asaf tapate Zakhur, Josef, Nethaniah, leh Asharelah ahi hi.
Jeduthun sung panin Jeduthun' tapate in: lungdamkohna leh Topa phatna-in laiza lasakna tawh mai lam thu a gen khol a, a pa uh Jeduthun' makaihna nuai-ah Gedaliah, Zeri, Jershaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, leh Mattibiah, guk pha uh hi.
Heman sung panin Heman' tapate in: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamtiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, leh Mahazioth ahi hi.
Hihte khempeuh in Pasian thuciamna bangin amah a pahtawi dingin kumpipa' thu-mupa Heman' tapate ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in Heman tungah tapa sawm-le-li leh tanu thum pia hi.
Amaute khempeuh Pasian' inn nasep nadingin Topa' inn sungah daltuahte, harp lasaknate, leh laiza lasaknate tawh la lam sangah a pate uh ukna nuai-ah om uh hi. Asaf, Jeduthun, leh Hemante in kumpipa' thupiakna nuai-ah om uh hi.
A Levi mipihte uh tawh Topa' ading lasakna lamah sinna a nei a siam mi a vekpi in zanih leh sawmgiat-le-giat ahi hi.
Tua ciangin a neu a lian, sia leh a sinte a kibangin, amaute in amau' nasep ding uh aisaan uh hi.
Asaf behte adingin ai masa Josef tungah tu hi; a nihna Gedaliah, leh a sanggamte leh a tapate, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a thumna Zakkhur, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a lina Izzri, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a ngana Nethaniah, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a gukna Bukkiah, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a sagihna Jesharelah, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a giatna Jeshaiah, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a kuana Mattaniah, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a sawmna Shimei, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a sawm-le-khatna Azarel, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a sawm-le-nihna Hashabiah, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a sawm-le-thumna Shubael, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a sawm-le-lina Mattithiah, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a sawm-le-ngana Jeremoth, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a sawm-le-gukna Hananiah, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a sawm-le-sagihna Joshbekashah, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a sawm-le-giatna Hanani, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a sawm-le-kuana Mallothi, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a sawmnihna Eliathah, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a sawmnih-le-khatna Hothir, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a sawmnih-le-nihna Giddalti, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a sawmnih-le-thumna Mahazioth, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi;
a sawmnih-le-lina Romamtiezer, leh a tapate leh a sanggamte, sawm-le-nih tung tu hi.
Kongcingte a kiseh khennate in: Korah behte sung panin, Asaf innkuan sung panin Kore' tapa Meshelemiah ahi hi.
Meshelemiah' tapate in: Zekhariah a tacil, Jediael a nihna, Zebadiah a thumna, Jathniel a lina,
Elam a ngana, Jehohanan a gukna, Elieho-enai a sagihna ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Obededom' tapate in: Shemaiah a tacil, Jehozabad a nihna, Joah a thumna, Sakar a lina, Nethanel a ngana,
Ammiel a gukna, Issakhar a sagihna, Peullethai a giatna ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in Obededom thupha pia hi.
Ama tapa upa pen Shemaiah sung panin zong a beh sungah ukte ahi tapate suak hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in siamna lian a nei mite ahi uh hi.
Shemaiah' tapate in: Othni, Refael, Obed, Elzabad leh a sanggamte siamna a nei ahi Elihu, leh Semakhiah ahi hi.
Hihte khempeuh in Obededom' tapate leh amau' tapate leh a sanggamte uh tawh, nasepna dingin siamna a nei mikician ahi uh hi; Obededom sung panin sawmguk-le-nih pha uh hi.
Tua ciangin Meshelemiah in siamna a nei tapate leh sanggamte, sawm-le-giat nei hi.
Tua ciangin Merari' innkuan sung panin Hosah' tapate in: Shimri a ukpi (amah tacil ahih loh hangin a pa in a ukpi-in amah bawl hi),
Hilkiah a nihna, Tebaliah a thumna, Zekhariah a lina ahi hi. Hosah' tapate leh a sanggamte khempeuh sawm-le-thum pha uh hi.
Innkuan pasal lutangte kongcingte ahi uh hi; amaute in a sanggamte uh tawh Topa' inn sungah nasep nei uh hi;
amaute in a neu a lian a kibangin a pate uh innkuan kuanin amau' kongpi ding ai saan uh hi.
Nisuahna lam adingin ai, Shelemiah tungah tu hi. A tapa, a pil thulamlakpa Zekhariah' adingin zong ai saan uh a, leilu lam-a dingin ama ai pha hi.
Obededom adingin leitaw lamah hong suak a, a tapa tungah vankoihna inn kipia hi.
Shuppim leh Hosah adingin lampi a pai tohna, Shallekheth kongpi san, nitumna lamah kia hi. Galvil leh galvil kimaituah hi.
Vankoihna inn kongah nih nih-in a om mah bangin ni simin nisuahna lamah guk omin, ni simin leilu lamah li omin, ni sim mah-in leitaw lamah li om hi;
tua ciangin nitumna lam a, om lampi inn adingin a lampi ah li omin a lampi innah nih om hi.
Hihte in Korah mite leh Merari' tapate lakah kongcingte a kiseh khenna ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Levi mite sung panin Ahijah in Pasian' inn van manpha koihleh a ki-ap letsong koihnate uk hi.
Gershom-te beh sung panin Ladan in innkuan tampi a pian' khiatna mi khat hi a, Jehiel innkuante zong ama sung panin a piang ahi hi.
Jehiel' tapate, Zetham leh a sanggampa Joelte in Topa' inn van manpha koihnate uk uh hi.
Amram mite, Izhar mite, Hebron mite, leh Uzziel mite sung panin—
Moses' tapa Gershom-te beh sung panin Shebuel in van manpha koihna a ukte' lakah a ukpi ahi hi.
Gershom sanggam Eliezer' suan Shelomoth tawh zong beh kinai ahi hi. Eliezer' sung panin a tapa Rehabiah, a tapa Jeshiah, a tapa Joram, a tapa Zikri, a tapa Shelomoth ahi hi.
Hih Shelomoth leh a sanggamte in, kumpi David, leh beh lutangte, leh a tul tul leh a za za-a uk uliante, leh galkap a ukte in a ap uh ahi, a ki-ap letsongte a kikoihna khempeuh uk uh hi.
Gal sungah a ngah vankinusiate sung panin Topa' inn puah nadingin amaute in letsongte ap uh hi.
Thu-mupa Samuel, leh Kish' tapa Saul, Ner' tapa Abner, leh Zeru-iah' tapa Joab in a apsate khempeuh zong, a ki-ap letsong khempeuh Shelomoth leh a sanggamte' kepna sungah om hi.
Izhar mite sung panin Khenaniah leh a tapate pen Israel adingin uliante leh thukhente-in a pualam nasepna ah kiseh hi.
Hebron mite sung panin Hashabiah leh a sanggamte, siamna a nei mihing tulkhat leh zasagih in Jordan nitumna lam Israel tungah Topa' nasepna khempeuh leh kumpipa' nasemna ah uk uh hi.
Hebron mite sung panin Jerijah in a ukpi ahi hi. (David' uk a kum sawmlina kumin kikantelna bawl uh a, Gilead gam sung Jazer ah amaute sung panin siamna lian a nei mihing kimu hi.)
Kumpi David in Jerijah leh a sanggamte, siamna a nei mihing tulnih leh zasagih, a beh sungah lutang ahite, Pasian tawh a kisai na khempeuh leh kumpipa' vaite ah, Reuben mite, Gad mite, leh Manasseh a langte tungah a uk dingin a seh hi.
Tu-in Israel mite, beh lutangte, a tul leh a za-a a ukte, leh khen khatah mi tul sawmnih leh tulli a om, kum tawntung kha khat khit kha khat hong tungin a kuankhia a khente tawh kisai-in na khempeuh ah kumpipa' na a sem a uliante in:
Zabdiel' tapa Jashobeam in a kha masa sungin a khen masa a uk ahi hi; ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tulli om hi.
Amah in Perez' suan leh khak hi a, a kha masa sungin galkap a ukte khempeuh a ukpi ahi hi.
Ahoah-te beh Dodai in a kha nihna sunga a khen a ukpi ahi hi; ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tulli om hi.
A kha thumna adingin a uk a thumna-pa, siampi Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah in a ukpi ahi hi; ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tulli om hi.
Hihpa in mihing sawmthumte sungah a thahat, mihing sawmthumte a uk Benaiah ahi hi; ama tapa Ammizabad in ama khen a ukpa ahi hi.
Joab sanggampa Ashahel in a kha lina adingin a lina hi a, ama nungah amah a liah dingin a tapa Zebadiah om hi; ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tulli om hi.
A kha ngana adingin a uk a ngana-pa in Izrah-te beh Shamhuth ahi hi; ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tulli om hi.
A gukna, a kha gukna adingin Tekoa khua mi Ikkesh' tapa Ira ahi hi; ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tulli om hi.
A sagihna, a kha sagihna adingin Efraim' suante sung panin Pelon khua mi Helez ahi hi; ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tulli om hi.
A giatna, a kha giatna adingin Jerah mi sung panin Hushan khua mi Sibbekai ahi hi; ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tulli om hi.
A kuana, a kha kuana adingin Benjamin mi sung panin Anathoth khuami Abiezer ahi hi; ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tulli om hi.
A sawmna, a kha sawmna adingin Zerah mi sung panin Netofah khua mi Maharai ahi hi; ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tulli om hi.
A sawm-le-khatna, a kha sawm-le-khatna adingin Efraim suante' sung panin Pirathon khuami Benaiah ahi hi; ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tulli om hi.
A sawm-le-nihna, a kha sawm-le-nihna adingin Othniel suante' sung panin Netofah khuami Heldai ahi hi; ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tulli om hi.
Israel minamte tungah a ukpite in: Reuben mite' adingin Zikri' tapa Eliezer ahi hi; Simeon mite' adingin Ma-akah' tapa Shefatiah ahi hi;
Levi adingin Kemuel' tapa Hashabiah ahi hi; Aaron adingin Zadok ahi hi;
Judah' adingin David, sanggamte' sung panin Elihu ahi hi; Issakhar' adingin Mikhael' tapa Omri ahi hi;
Zebulun' adingin Obadiah' tapa Ishmaiah ahi hi; Naftali adingin Azriel' tapa Jeremoth ahi hi;
Efraim mite' adingin Azaziah' tapa Hoshea ahi hi; Manasseh minam a langte' adingin Pedaiah' tapa Joel ahi hi;
Gilead gam sunga Manasseh minam a langte adingin Zekhariah' tapa Iddo ahi hi; Benjamin adingin Abner' tapa Ja-asiel ahi hi;
Dan adingin Jeroham' tapa Azarel ahi hi. Hihte in Israel minamte' makaite ahi uh hi.
Israel mite vantung aksi zahin a tamin a bawl nading Topa in thuciam khin ahih manin David in kum sawmnih nuaisiah a pha mite sim lo hi.
Zeru-iah' tapa Joab in sim ding kipan a, ahih hangin zo man lo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh hih thu hangin Israel tungah Pasian' hehna hong tung a, Kumpi David' khang tangthu sungah tua a kisimte kikhum lo hi.
Kumpipa' van manpha a ukte in: Kumpipa' van manpha koihnate ah Adiel' tapa Azmaveth ahi hi; tua ciangin gam sunga van manpha koihnate, khuapi sungate, khuaneute leh tausangte, sunga omte tungah Uzziah' tapa Jonathan ahi hi;
tua ciangin lo kho dingin lo nasep a sem mite tungah Khelub' tapa Ezri ahi hi;
tua ciangin leenggui lote tungah Ramah khuami Shimei ahi hi; tua ciangin leenggui lo panin a piang leenggahzu koihnate' adingin Shifmoth khuami Zabdi ahi hi.
Shefelab gam sunga om Oliv leh theiba kungte tungah Gederah khuami Baalhanan ahi hi; tua ciangin sathau koihnate tungah Joash ahi hi.
Sharom gam sungah a gamta ganhonte tungah Sharon khuami Shitrai ahi hi; kuam sunga om ganhonte tungah Adlai' tapa Shafat ahi hi;
Kalaohte tungah Ishmael mi Obil ahi hi; tua ciangin la a nute tungah Meronoth khuami Jehdeiah ahi hi.
Tuuhonte tungah Hagri mi Jaziz ahi hi. Hihte khempeuh in Kumpi David' neihsa a kemte ahi uh hi.
David' pano Jonathan in thu thei mi leh lai thei mi ahih manin thu-lam-lakpa ahi hi; amah leh Hakmoni' tapa Jehiel in kumpipa' tapate cing uh hi.
Ahithofel in kumpipa' thu-lamlakpa hi a, Arkhi mi Hushai in kumpipa' lawmpa ahi hi.
Ahithofel a sih ciangin Benaiah' tapa Jehoiada leh Abiathar in laih uh hi. Joab in kumpipa' galkapte a ukpa ahi hi.
David in Jerusalem-a Israelte lakah zaneite, minamte sungah zaneite, kumpipa' na a sem a khente sungah uliante, a tul tul a, a ukte, a za za-a a ukte, neihsa khempeuh leh kumpipa' ganhingte leh a tapate a kemte pen, kumpi inn a, zaneite, a thahat mite, leh gal a hang tawntungte khempeuh tawh khawm hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi David a khe-in ding to in, "Ka sanggam leh ka mite aw, ka thugen hong za un. Topa' thuciamna singkuang ading leh i Pasian' khengak nadingin tawlngakna inn khat lam ding ka lungsim sungah a om hi; tua ciangin a lam nading ka kiging hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian in kei kiangah, 'Nangmah in galhang khat hi-in sisan tampi luangsak na hih manin keima min dingin inn na lam kei ding hi,' hong ci hi.
Ahi zongin Israel Topa' Pasian in Israel tungah kumpi ahi tawntung dingin ka pa' innkuan khempeuh panin kei hong teel hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in makai-in Judah teel a, tua ciangin Judah innkuan panin ka pa innkuan teel a, tua ciangin ka pa' tapate lak panin Israel khempeuh tungah kumpi-in kei hong bawl ding kei tungah amah lungkim hi.
Tua ciangin ka tapate khempeuh lak panin (bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in kei tungah tapa tampi hong pia hi) Israel tungah Topa' kumpi tokhom tungah a tu dingin amah in ka tapa Solomon teel khin hi.
Amah in kei kiangah, 'Ka inn leh ka inntualte a bawl dingpa in na tapa Solomon ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka tapa dingin amah ka teel khin a, keimah in ama pa ka hi ding hi.
Amah in ka thupiaknate leh ka biakna ngeina kipte tu ni-a mah bangin zuih ding a ngaihsut paisuak nak leh ama kumpi gam ka kipsak tawntung ding hi,' hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin tu-in note in hih leitang hoih nei-in note khit na tate uh tungah gamh-in na nusiat tawntung theih nadingun Topa' mai-ah kikhopna ahi Israel khempeuh' muhna, leh i Pasian' zakna ah Topa na Pasian uh' thupiaknate khempeuh zui-in zong un.
"Tu-in nang, ka tapa Solomon aw, na pa' Pasian thei in la, na lungsim khempeuh leh utna lungsim tawh ama na sem in; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in lungsim khempeuh zong a, ngimna leh ngaihsutna khempeuh thei hi. Nangmah in amah na zon' leh nangmah in amah na mu ding hi; ahih hangin amah na nusiat leh amah in nang hong paaikhia paisuak ding hi.
Biakinn dingin inn khat a lam dingin Topa in nang hong teel khin ahih manin tu-in kingaihsun in; thahat in la, sem in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in a tapa Solomon tungah biakinn innlim, leh a innte, a van manpha koihnate, a dawl tungnungte, leh a dei sungnungte, leh hehpihna tokhom' adingin inndei a geelna;
leh Topa' inn a tualte adingin a lungsimah a ngaihsut khempeuh, a kimkot a, inndeite khempeuh, Pasian' inn van manpha koihnate, leh a ki-ap letsongte ading van manpha koihnate;
siampite leh Levi mi a khente, leh Topa' inn sungah nasepna khempeuh ading; Topa' inn sungah nasep nading um-le-beel khempeuh ading,
nasepna ah zat ding kham tawh kibawl um-le-beel khempeuh a gihna, nasepna ah zat dingin ngun tawh kibawl um-le-beelte a gihna,
nasepna ah meivak khuam a kizat ciatna bangin kham meivak khuamte leh a meivakte a gihna, a meivak khuam leh a meivakte a gihna zah ciat, meivakkhuam khat leh a meivakte ngun a gihna,
Ompihna Anlum adingin sabuai kham a gihna ciat, ngun sabuaite adingin ngun a gihna,
leh sikkeukate, kuangte, leh haite ading kham citak a gihna; kham haipite leh a gihna ciat; ngun haipite leh a gihna ciat;
a kisiangsaksa kham tawh kibawl paknamtui biakna tau ding leh a gihna zah ding a geelna; a khate uh zakin Topa' thuciamna singkuang a khuh kherubte' kham leeng ding a geelna zong pia hi.
Nasep ding khempeuh geelsa bangin sep dingin hih thu tawh kizui-in Topa' genna bangin lai-in gelhna tawh amah in hihte khempeuh a siangin hih hi.
Tua ciangin David in a tapa Solomon kiangah, "Thakhauhin hang in la, sem in. Lau kei in, lungkia kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa Pasian, kei' Pasian nangawn nang tawh om hi. Topa' inn sung nasepna khempeuh a nasepna khempeuh a kizawh matengin amah in nang hong tamasak lo, hong nusia lo ding hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian' innah nasep khempeuh a sem dingin siampite leh Levi mi a khenkhente om hi; nasepna khatpeuh peuhah siamna a nei mi, nasepna khempeuhah nang tawh hong om ding hi; uliante leh mi khempeuh zong nangma thupiakna bangbangin gamta ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi David in a kikhawm khempeuhte kiangah, "Pasian in amah bek a teelsa ka tapa Solomon pen khangno-in pumpi tawh sinna om nai lo a, nasep ding pen lian hi; bang hang hiam cih leh hih inn lianpi in mihing ading hilo a, Topa Pasian' ading ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka Pasian' inn dingin ka hih theih zah ciang, phuh dingin onik suang, suangpak, mel tuamtuam a nei suang, suangkang, leh suangmanpha nam khempeuh tampi takte ban-ah kham zat nading nate ah kham, ngun zat nading nate-ah ngun, leh sumngo zat nading nate ah sumngo, sik zat nading nate ah sik, leh sing zat nading nate ah sing ka koih khin zo hi.
Tua tham loin, a siangtho inn adingin ka koihte khempeuh banah, ngun leh kham keima aa mahmah zong om a, ka pa Pasian' inn ka ngaihsutna hangin ka Pasian' innah ka piakte in:
Kawm zut nadingin Ofir gam kham ahi kham talen tulthum, leh a kisiangsaksa ngun talen tulsagih,
leh siamneelte in a hih ding nasepna khempeuh adingin kham zat nading nate ah kham leh ngun zat nading nate ah ngun ahi hi. Kua in utna lungsim tawh Topa tungah tu ni-in amahmah kipia-in ki-ap ding na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin beh lutangte in ut thu-a piakna bawl uh a, minam makaite, a tul tul-a a ukte leh a za za-a a ukte, leh kumpipa' nasepna ah a uk uliante in zong hih uh hi.
Amaute in Pasian' inn nasep nadingin kham talen tulnga leh kham darik tulsawm, ngun talen tulsawm, sumngo talen tulsawm leh tulgiat, leh sik talen tul zakhat pia uh hi.
Suangmanpha a nei peuhmah in Gershon mi Jehiel' kepna sung, Topa' inn van manpha koihna ah pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin hih mite in utna lungsim tawh pia uh ahih manin mite lungdam uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in lungsim khempeuh tawh Topa tungah cingtakin pia uh hi; kumpi David zong nakpi takin lungdam hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a kikhawmte khempeuh' omna ah David in Topa phat hi; tua ciangin David in: "Nang, Topa, ka pu uh Israel Pasian aw, a tawntungin thupha ngah ta in.
Topa aw, liatna, leh vangliatna, leh minthan'na, leh gualzawhna, leh min liatna in nangma' aa ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh vantung leh leitungah a om khempeuh in nangma' aa ahi hi; Topa aw, kumpigam in nangma' aa hi a, tuate khempeuh tungah nang a lutangin hong kisangsak hi.
Hauhna leh minphatna nangma kiang pan hong pai a, nangmah in na khempeuh tungah na uk hi. Na khut sungah vangliatna leh thahatna om hi; liatsak nading leh thakhauhsak nading na khut sungah om hi.
Tu-in nangma tungah ka nuam uh hi, kote' Pasian aw, a minthang na min ka phat uh hi.
"Ahih hangin kote in hih bangin utna tawh ka piak nadingun keimah in kua hi a, ka mite in bang hi lel ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh na khempeuh nang kiang pan hong pai hi a, nangma' aa mah nang tungah kong pia uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka pu ka pate khempeuh uh mah bangin kote in nangma mai-ah mikhualte leh peemtate ka hi uh hi; ka hunte uh leitungah nilim bang hi a, a kip om lo hi.
Topa kote' Pasian aw, na min siangtho pahtawi nadingin nang ading inn lam nadingin ka piaksa uh hih a tampite in nangma khut sung panin hong pai hi a, a vekpi-in nangma aa mah ahi hi.
Nangmah in lungsim entelin thumanna ah na lungkimna ka thei hi, ka Pasian aw; lungsim thumanna tawh hih nate khempeuh citna tawh kong pia khin a, tu-in nang tungah citna leh lungdamna tawh a hong pia, hih lai-ah a om na mite ka mu zo hi.
Ka pute uh Abraham, Isaak, leh Israel Pasian, Topa aw, na mite' lungsim sungah tua bang ngimnate leh ngaihsutnate omsak tawntung in la, amaute' lungsim nangma lamah kai in.
Amah in a lungsim khempeuh tawh na thupiaknate, na tecipannate, leh na thukhamte kemin a vekpi-in sem a, keimah in ka vaihawmsa inn lianpi amah in lam theih nading ka tapa Solomon tungah utna lungsim guan in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in a kikhawmte khempeuh tungah, "Topa na Pasian uh phat un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin a kikhawmte khempeuh in a pute a pate uh Pasian Topa phat in, a lu uh kun uh a, Topa bia-in kumpipa tungah zahtakna bawl uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Topa tungah biakpiakna bawl uh a, a zing ciangin Topa tungah meihal biakna bawngtal tulkhat, tuutal tulkhat, leh tuuno tulkhat, a leenggahzu tawh a biakna teng tawh, leh Israel khempeuh adingin biak piakna tampi pia uh hi;
tua ciangin amaute in tua ni-in lungdamna lianpi tawh Topa mai-ah pawi khamin om uh hi.Tua ciangin amaute in David' tapa Solomon kumpi-in a nihveina bawl uh a, amaute in Topa adingin amah kumpi-in sathau nilhin, siampi dingin Zadok sathau nilh uh hi.
Tua ciangin a pa David tangin Topa' kumpi tokhom tungah kumpi-in Solomon tu hi; tua ciangin amah a dau pai a, Israel khempeuh in ama thu mang uh hi.
Makaite khempeuh leh a thahat mite, leh Kumpi David' tapate khempeuhte in zong Kumpi Solomon tungah a thuman ding uh thu ciam uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Israel khempeuh muhna ah Solomon tungah minthan'na lianpi pia a, Israel sungah ama ma-in kumpi khatpeuh peuh tungah a kipia ngei nai lo kumpi min liatna guan hi.
Tua bangin Jessi' tapa David in Israel khempeuh tungah kumpi ahi hi.
Israel tungah ama uk hun in kum sawmli sung ahi hi; amah in Hebron ah kum sagih sung, Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum-le-thum sung uk hi.
Tua ciangin a khangham, a ni cing, hauhna leh minphatna tawh si hi; tua ciangin a tapa Solomon in ama tangin uk hi.
Tu-in Kumpi David' gamtatnate a patna pan a tawpna dongin, thu-mupa Samuel' Khang Tangthu sung, leh kamsang Nathan' Khang Tangthu sung, leh thu-mupa Gad' Khang Tangthu sungah,
ama ukna leh ama vangliatnate khempeuh leh ama tung leh Israel tung, leh gamsung kumpi gamte khempeuh tungah a tung thute a kiciamtehna tawh kigelh khawm hi.
Pasian' deihna hangin Khazih Zeisu' sawltak za-ah hong koih, keimah Paul leh i sanggampa Sosthenes in
Khazih Zeisu hangin mawhna tawh kipelh, misiangtho dinga hong koih ahi Korin khua ah a om Pasian' pawlpite akipan, mun khempeuh ah eite Topa bek hi lo amau Topa zong ahi, Topa Zeisu Khazih kiangah thu a ngen mi khempeuhte kiangah thu kong zasak uh hi.
Topa Zeisu Khazih leh i Pa Pasian kiang panin hehpihna thupha leh nopna nomau tungah hong tung ta hen.
Khazih' thu tecipan'na nomau lakah a kip ahih ciangin
note in amah hangah thu genna leh lungpilna a kipan, na khempeuh na kicing uh a,
Khazih Zeisu hangah no hong piak thupha hehpihna suangin, note hangin ka Pasian' hehpihna ka phat tawntung hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in i Topa Zeisu Khazih hong kilat ding ngakin na om lai takun hong piakna thupha khat beek na sam kei uh hi.
Tua Topa in eite Topa Zeisu Khazih' Ni-inah mawhsak nading tawh na kipelh nadingun a tawp dongin no hong kipsak ding hi.
I Topa ahi ama Tapa Zeisu Khazih tawh kipawlna sungah hong sam Pasian in ciam pelh mi ahi kei hi.
Ute naute aw, note khempeuh in kam kikhat na gen uh a, kikhenthang loin, lungsim kikhatin, kiciamtehna kikhatin, kicing takin na om nadingun i Topa Zeisu Khazih' min tawh kong thuum hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ka ute ka naute aw, note lakah a kitawng om hi ci-in Khlo-e te innkuanpih kimkhat in hong zasak uh hi.
Note in, "Kei Paul' mi ka hi, kei Apollos' mi ka hi, kei Kefas' mi ka hi, kei Khazih' mi ka hi," na ci tek uh ka cihna ahi hi.
Khazih a kikhen hiam? Paul in note tang dingin singlamteh tungah a si hiam? Ahih kei leh, Paul' min tawh kibaptaiz na hi uh hiam?
Krispas leh Gaias longal note lakah kuamah ka baptaiz kei hi ci-in Pasian' hehpihna ka phat hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, "Paul' min tawh baptaizna ka ngah hi," ci-in kuamah in a gen thei kei ding hi.
Stefanas-te innkuan zong ka baptaiz hi. Midangte ka baptaiz lam ka thei kei hi.
Khazih in baptaiz dingin kei hong sawl lo hi; Lungdamna Thu hilh dingin hong sawl hi. Ahih hangin Khazih' singlamteh a mawkna ahih loh nadingin kam pilna tawh hilh ding hong sawl kei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, siatna a thuakte' ading singlamteh thu in haina thu ahi hi. Gupna a ngah eite ading tua thu in Pasian' vangliatna ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Lai Siangtho sungah: "Pilna a neite a pilna ka sugawp ding hi. Lungpil a neite a lungpilna ka sugawp ding hi, Lungpil a neite a lungpilna ka paaimang ding hi," ci-in a kigelh hi.
Lungpil mi koi-ah a om hiam? Laithei mi koi-ah a om hiam? Hih leitung thu kidong thei mi koi-ah a om hiam? Pasian in leitung pilna a haisak hilo ahi hiam?
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian' vaihawm bangin leitung mite in amau lungpilna hangah Pasian thei lo uh ahih ciangin, Pasian in a umte thuhilhna hai tawh a gup nading lungsim a nei hi.
Judah mite in nalamdang a ngen thei uh hi. Grik mite in lungpilna a zong thei uh hi.
Eite i hih leh, singlamteh tungah a si Khazih' thu i hilh hi. Tua thu in Judah mite ading kipukna ahi hi. Gentailte ading haina ahi hi.
Ahih hangin Judah mi hi taleh, Grik mi hi taleh, a kisamte adingin Pasian' vangliatna leh Pasian' pilna ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian' haina in mite' pilna sangin a pilzaw hi; Pasian' thanemna in mite' thahatna sangin a hatzaw hi.
Ute naute aw, note hong sapna thu na ngaihsun un. A hong sap mite lakah leitung pilna a nei mi tampi a om kei uh hi; minthan'na a nei tampi a om kei uh hi; a nam liante tampi a om kei uh hi.
Pasian in lungpilte zumsak nadingin leitung mihaite a teelkhia hi. A thahatte a zumsak nadingin leitungah a thanemte a teelkhia hi.
A omte a man'than sak nadingin leitungah a gina lote leh a kigina sim lote akipan, a om lote nangawn a teelkhia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian mai-ah kuamah a kisathei ding a om kei hi.
Tua Pasian hangin note in Khazih Zeisu sungah na om uh hi. Tua Khazih Zeisu in eite ading Pasian kiang pan pilna, dikna, sian'thona leh tatkhiatna hong suak zo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin, "A kisatheite in Pasian hangah kisathei ta hen," a ci hi.
Ute naute aw, note' omna-ah kong pai ciangin kamsiamna leh pilna tawh Pasian' teci thu note kiangah gen dingin hong pai ka hi kei hi.

Tua ciangin Adonijah in Solomon kihta hi; amah dingin pai a, biakna tau kite len hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon kiangah, "En in, Adonijah in Kumpi Solomon kihta hi; bang hang hiam cih leh, en in, amah in biakna tau kite lenin, 'Amah in a nasempa namsau tawh a thah loh nading kei tungah Kumpi Solomon hong kiciam masa hen,' ci hi," kici hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in, "Amah in kilawm mi ahihna a lahtel theih leh ama samzang khat zong lei lakah kia lo ding hi; ahih hangin ama sungah gitlohna a kimuh leh, amah si ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kumpi Solomon in sawl a, amaute in biaknatau panin amah paikhiatpih uh hi. Amah hong pai-in Kumpi Solomon in ama kiangah, "Na innah ciah in," a ci hi.
David' sih ding hun a nai ciangin amah in a tapa Solomon thuhilhin,
"Leitung khempeuh ngeina bangin a pai ding ka hi ta hi. Thakhauhin pasal na hihna kilangsak in la,
"Tham loin, Zeru-iah' tapa Joab in kei hong bawlna, gal sunga si mite' phu a lakna-in, gal kilem hun sungin a thah Israel galkap ukte ahi mi nih, Ner' tapa Abner leh Jether' tapa Amasa tungah a bawlna leh, amah in mawhna nei lo mite thatin, tua ama gamtatna hangin ka thuaknate zong na thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin nangma pilna bangin gamta in la, ahih hangin lungnuam takin Leinuai-ah ama lutang paisuksak kei in.
Ahih hangin Gilead mi Barzillai' tapate tungah thuman takin gamta in la, na sabuai-a nete bangin amaute omsak in; bang hang hiam cih leh na sanggampa Absalom' kiangpanin ka tai lai-in amaute in tua bang thumanna tawh kei hong bawl uh hi.
Mahanaim-ah ka pai lai-in a nasia samsiatna tawh kei hong samsia, Bahurim panin hong pai Benjamin mi Gera' tapa Shimei zong nang tawh om hi; ahih hangin Jordan ah keimah dawn dingin hong pai ciangin ama tungah Topa tawh kiciamin, 'Namsau tawh nang kong that kei ding hi,' ka ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in amah a mawh baang loin ngaihsun kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in mi pilna hi hi; ama tungah na bawl dinga kilawm na thei ding a, amah thatin a lutang hanah na paipih suk ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin ama pate tawh David ihmu-in David khuapi sungah kivui hi.
Israelte tungah David in a uk hun in kum sawmli sung ahi hi; amah in Hebron ah kum sagih sung ukin, Jerusalem ah kum sawmthum leh kum thum sung uk hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a pa David' tokhom tungah Solomon tu hi; ama kumpi gam kip takin kiphut hi.
Tua ciangin David leh Haggith' tapa Adonijah Solomon' nu Bathsheba kiangah hong pai hi. Tua nu in, "Thu-nuam-a hong pai na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in, "Thu-nuam hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tuapa in, "Nang tungah gen ding khat ka nei hi," a ci hi. Amah in, "Gen in," a ci hi.
Tuapa in, "Kumpi gam in keima' aa hi-in, Israelte khempeuh in keima uk ding a lamet mahmahna uh na thei hi; ahi zongin kumpi gam kihei-in ka sanggampa' aa suak hi; bang hang hiam cih leh hih thu in Topa kiang pan ahi hi.
Tu-in nangma tung panin kong nget ding khat om hi; kei hong nial kei in," a ci hi. Tua nu in ama kiangah, "Gen in," a ci hi.
Amah in, "Kumpi Solomon kiangah nong ngetsak ding kong thum hi - amah in nang hong nial lo ding hi - Shunem mi Abishag ka zi dingin kei tungah hong piak ding," a ci hi.
Bathsheba in, "Hoih mahmah hi; kumpipa kiangah kong gensak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Adonijah taangin ama tungah thu gen dingin Kumpi Solomon kiangah Bathsheba va pai hi. Tua ciangin tua nu dawn dingin kumpipa dingin tua nu mai-ah kun hi; tua ciangin ama tokhom tungah tu-in kumpipa' nu' adingin tutna khat lasak hi; tua nu ama tak lamah tu hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Nangma tungah na neuno khat nget ding ka nei hi; kei hong nial kei in," a ci hi. Kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Hong ngen in, ka nu aw; bang hang hiam cih leh kong nial kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Amah in, "Na sanggampa Adonijah' zi dingin Shunem mi Abishag ama tungah kipia hen," a ci hi.
Kumpi Solomon in a nu dawngin, "Bang hangin Adonijah adingin Shunem mi Abishag hong ngen na hi hiam? Kumpi gam zong ama adingin ngetsak lai in; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in ka u pasal hi a, ama lamah siampi Abiathar leh Zeru-iah' tapa Joab pang hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Solomon Topa tawh kiciamin, "Hih thu in Adonijah' nuntakna a lei kei taak leh Pasian in kei hong dawm kei ta hen!
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, kei hong phutin ka pa David tokhom tungah hong koih a, ama ciamsa bangin kei adingin innkuan khat hong bawlsak Topa in a nungta ahih mah bangin, tu ni-in Adonijah kithat ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kumpi Solomon in Jehoida' tapa Benaiah sawl hi; amah in tuapa satpuk sukin, tua ciangin amah si hi.
Tua ciangin siampi Abiathar kiangah kumpipa in, "Nangma mun leh gam a omna Anathoth ah ciah in; bang hang hiam cih leh na sih ding a kilawm ahi hi. Ahih hangin nangmah in ka pa David' mai-ah Topa Pasian' thuciamna singkuang na puakna leh ka pa' gimna ah na gim khopna hangin tu tungin nang kong that kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Solomon in Topa' siampi hihna panin Abiathar hawlkhia in, Topa in Shiloh a, Eli innkuan tawh kisai a genna thu tua bangin tungsak hi.
Hih thu Joab kiang a tun' ciangin - bang hang hiam cih leh Joab in Absalom a huh loh hangin Adohijah huh hi - Topa' puanbuk ah Joab tai-in biakna tau kite len hi.
Kumpi Solomon kiangah, "Topa' puanbuk ah Joab tai hi, en in, amah biakna tau gei-ah om hi," ci-in a kigen ciangin Solomon in Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah sawlin, "Pai in, amah satpuk suk in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa puanbuk ah Benaiah pai-in ama kiangah, "Kumpipa in thu hong pia a, 'Hong paikhia in,' a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in, "Hilo hi, hih lai-ah kei ka si ding hi;" a ci hi. Tua ciangin Benaiah in kumpipa kiangah thu puak kikin, "Tua bangin Joab in thu gen a, tua bangin amah in kei hong dawng hi," a ci hi.
Kumpipa in amah dawng kikin, "Ama cihsa bangin hih in, amah satpuk in la, phum in; Joab in thu om lopi-in mi a thahna hangin mawhna pen keima tung leh ka innkuan tung panin tua bangin na siangsak ding hi.
Topa in ama mawhna ama lu tang mah ah tungsak kik ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka pa David' theih lohin amah in Israel galkapte a uk Jether' tapa Amasa, amah sangin thuman zaw-in a hoihzaw ahi mihing nih do-in namsau tawh that hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi thahna hangin dantahna in Joab' lu tung leh ama suan leh khakte' lu tungah a tawntungin hong tungkik ding hi; ahih hangin David tung, leh ama suan leh khakte tung, leh ama innkuan tung, leh ama kumpi tokhom tungah Topa kiang panin a tawntung nopna om ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah paito-in Joab satpuk sukin that hi; gamlak ama inn sungah amah kiphum hi.
Kumpipa in Joab taangin galkapte tungah Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah koih a, kumpipa in Abiathar' taangin siampi Zadok koih hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in mi sawlin Shimei samsak a, ama kiangah, "Jerusalem ah inn khat lamin tua lai-ah teng in la, tua lai mun panin mun khat peuhpeuhah paikhia kei in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nang paikhia-in Kidron lui na kan ni-in na sih ding tel takin thei in; na sih leh nangma khialhna hang hi ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Shimei in kumpipa kiangah, "Na thugen hoih hi; ka to kumpipa' gen bangin na nasempa gamta ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Jerusalem ah sau veipi sung Shimei om hi.
Ahih hangin kum thum a cin' ciangin Gath kumpipa Ma-akah' tapa Akhish kiangah Shimei' silate nih va tai uh hi. Shimei kiangah, "En in, na silate Gath-ah om hi," ci-in a kigen ciangin
Shimei ding-in la khat a van vawhin a silate a zong dingin Gath-a Akhish kiangah pai hi; Shimei pai-in Gath panin a silate ciahpih hi.
Jerusalem panin Gath-ah Shimei pai-in a ciahkikna thu Solomon kiangah a kigen ciangin,
kumpipa in mi sawlin Shimei samsak a, ama kiangah, "Topa tawh hong kiciamsakin, thupi takin nang hong thuhilhin, 'Nang paikhia-in mun khat peuhpeuh ah na pai ni-in na sih ding tel takin thei in,' hong ci hilo ka hi hiam? Tua ciangin nangmah in, 'Na thugen hoih hi; ka mang hi,' na ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin Topa tungah na kiciamna leh nang hong thuhilhin kong thupiakna zui lo na hi hiam? a ci hi.
Kumpipa in Shimei kiangah, "Ka pa David tungah siatna na bawlte khempeuh na lungsimah na thei hi; tua ahih ciangin Topa in nangma siatna nangma lu tung mah ah hong tun' kik ding hi.
Ahih hangin Kumpi Solomon thupha kipia-in a tawntungin Topa mai-ah a tokhom kikipsak ding hi," zong ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah thupia hi; amah paikhia-in Shimei satpuk sukin, tua ciangin amah si hi. Tua ahih ciangin Solomon' khut sungah kumpi gam kikipsak hi.
Solomon in Izipt kumpipa Faro tawh numei-a kizopna bawl hi; amah in Faro' tanu teenpih a, ama inn, Topa' inn leh Jerusalem kimkota kulhpi lam a zawh mateng David khuapi sungah tua nu paipihin omsak hi.
Ahi zongin Topa min adingin inn kilam nai lo ahih manin mite in mual tunga biaknate ah biakna pia uh hi.
Solomon in Topa itin, a pa David' thukhamte zui hi; ahi zongin amah in mual tunga biaknate ah biakna pia-in paknamtui hal hi.
Tua ciangin biakna pia dingin Gibeon ah kumpipa pai hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua in mual tunga biakna mun lianpen ahi hi; Solomon in tua biaknatau tungah meihal biakna tam veipi tak a piaknasa mun ahi hi.
Gibeon ah zanin a mang sungah Solomon tungah Topa kilang hi; Pasian in, "Nang kong piak ding hong ngen in," a ci hi.
Solomon in, "Na nasem ka pa David tungah a lian itna kip na lak hi, bang hang hiam cih leh cihtakna, thumanna tawh nangma mai-ah gamta-in, nangma tungah lungsim thutang hi; nangmah in ama adingin hih a lian itna kip koihsakin, tu ni-in ama tokhom tungah a tu ding tapa khat na pia hi.
Tu-in, Topa ka Pasian aw, keimah in naupang no khat hi napi-in ka pa David' munah kumpi-in na nasempa nong koih hi; bangci pusuah ding cih ahi a, bangci sungtum ding cih ahi zongin bangmah ka thei kei hi.
A lian, a tamna a kisim a kiseh thei lo, nangmah in na teelsa na mite lakah na nasempa om hi.
Tua ahih ciangin keimah in a sia leh a pha ka theih theih nadingin na mite uk nading thu theihtelna lungsim na nasempa hong pia in; bang hang hiam cih leh hih a lian a tam na mite kua in uk zo ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Solomon in hih thu a ngetna in Topa lungkimsak hi.
Pasian in ama kiangah, "Nangmah in hih thu hong ngenin, nangma adingin khan' sauna ahi a, hauhna ahi a, na galte' nuntakna ahi zongin hong ngen loin, a man thu theih nadingin nang adingin thu theihtelna hong ngen na hih manin,
en in, nangma hong ngetna bangin kong pia ding hi. En in, nangma hun ma-in nang tawh a kibang a om loh nading leh nangma khitah zong nang tawh a kibang hong khan' loh nadingin pilna leh theihna lungsim kong pia ding hi.
Nangma hun sung tawntung kumpi dang nang tawh a kiteh theih loh nadingin nangma hong nget loh hauhna leh pahtawina zong nang kong pia ding hi.
Na pa David in a tot bangin nangmah in ka lampite tawnin ka thukhamte leh ka thupiaknate na zuih leh na khan' ka sausak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon khanglo a, en in, hih in a mang ahi hi. Tua ciangin Jerusalem ah amah pai a, Topa thuciamna singkuang mai-ah amah ding-in meihal biaknate leh thunuam-a biaknate pia-in, a nasemte khempeuh adingin pawi khat kham hi.
Tua ciangin numei paktat nih kumpipa kiangah hong pai uh a, ama mai-ah ding uh hi.
A numei khat in, "Aw, ka topa aw, hih numei leh kei, inn khat sungah ka omkhawm uh hi; amah a om sungin keimah in ta khat ka nei hi.
Ka ta neih khit ni thum ni ciangin hih numei in zong ta nei hi; ko bek a om ka hi uh hi; kote tawh inn sungah kuamah dang om lo a, kotegel bek inn sungah ka om uh hi.
Amah in delhphah kha ahih manin zanin hih numei' tapa si hi.
Tua ciangin zan kim lai takin amah tho-in, na nasemnu ka ihmut lai takin ka kiang panin ka tapa la-in ama ang-ah koih a, ama tapa si keima angah hong koih hi.
Zingsangin ka ta nawi pia dingin ka thawh ciangin, en in, na si hi; ahih hangin zingsangin lim takin ka et ciangin, en in, amah in keima sung pan-a suak ta na hi lo hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a numei dang khat in, "Hilo hi, a hing naupang in keima' aa hi a, a si naupangin nangma' aa ahi hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin a masa nu in, "Hilo hi, a si naupang in nangma' aa hi a, a hing naupang in keima' aa ahi hi," a ci hi. Tua bangin kumpipa mai-ah amaute in thugen uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in "Khat in, "A nungta in keima tapa hi a, nangma tapa si hi,' ci hi; tua ciangin a dang khat in, 'Hi lo hi; nangma tapa si a, keima tapa in a hing pen hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Namsau khat hong la un," a ci hi. Tua a hih ciangin kumpipa mai-ah namsau khat hong kipaipih hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "A nungta naupang khen nih suah un la, khat tungah a lang pia-in, a dang khat tungah a lang pia un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a tapa a nungta numei in a lungsimah a tapa khasiat ahih manin kumpipa kiangah, "Aw, ka topa aw, a nungta naupang amah pia in; bang bang hita leh amah that kei in, a ci hi. Ahih hangin a khat in, "Hih in kei ka hi a, nang na hi zongin tang thei lo ding hi; hong hawmsak un a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in dawngin, "A masa numei tungah naupang hing pia un; bangbang hita leh that kei un; amah in a nu ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel khempeuh in kumpipa' piak thukhenna za uh hi; thutang a sem dingin ama tungah Pasian in pilna pia hi, ci-in phawk uh ahih manin amaute in kumpipa lamdangsa-in om uh hi.
Kumpi Solomon in Israel khempeuh tungah kumpi hi a,
hihte in ama nuai-ah za lian a neite ahi hi: Zadok' tapa Azariah in siampi ahi hi;
Shisha' tapa Elihoref leh Ahijah in lai-atte ahi uh hi; Ahilud' tapa Jehoshafat in thuciamtehpa ahi hi;
Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah in galkapte a uk ahi hi; Zadok leh Abiathar in siampite ahi uh hi;
Nathan' tapa Azariah in uliante tungah a uk ahi hi; Nathan' tapa Zabud in siampi leh kumpipa lam a lakpa ahi hi;
Ahishar in kumpipa inn uk ahi hi; Abda' tapa Adoniram in aana tawh na a semte a uk ahi hi.
Solomon in Israel khempeuh tungah ulian sawm-le-nih nei-in tuate in kumpipa leh a innkuan adingin annek tuidawn pia hi; mi khat in kum khatin kha khat sung annek tuidawn pia uh hi.
Hihte in amaute' min ahi hi: Efraim mualtung gam sungah Benhur;
Makaz khua, Shaalbim khua, Bethshenesh khua, leh Elonbethhanan khua sungah Bendeker;
Arubboth khua sungah Benhesed (Soko leh Hefer gam khempeuh ama aa hi);
Nafathdor gamsung khempeuh ah Benabinadab (amah in Solomon' tanu Tafath zi-in nei hi);
Ta-anak khua, Megiddo khua, leh Jezre-el khua nuai Zarethan khua pang-a om Bethshean gam khempeuh, leh Bethshean khua panin Jokmeam khua pang khat dongin Abelmeholah khua sungah Ahilud' tapa Baana;
Ramoth-gilead gam sungah Ben-geber (Amah in Gilead sunga om Manasseh' tapa Jair' khua neute leh Bashan sungah a om Argob gamsung, kulhpite leh sumngo zawlte a nei khuapi lian sawmguk nei hi);
Mahanaim khua sungah Iddo' tapa Ahinadab;
Naftali gam sungah Ahima-az (amah in Solomon' tanu Basemath zi-in la hi);
Asher gam leh Bealoth khua sungah Hushai' tapa Baana;
Issakhar gam sungah Paruah' tapa Jehoshafat;
Benjamin gam sungah Ela' tapa Shimei;
Amor mite kumpi Sihon leh Bashan kumpi Og gam ahi Gilead gam sungah Uri' tapa Geber ahi hi. Tua ciangin hih sawm-le-nihte banah Judah gam sungah ulian khat om lai hi.
Judah leh Israelte tuipi gei-a sehnel bangin tam uh hi; amaute in ne-in dawnin lungdam uh hi.
Solomon in Eufrates panin Filistiate' gam leh Izipt gamgi ciang dong kumpi gam khempeuh uk hi; amaute in siah hong puak uh a, a nuntak sung tawntung Solomon' na sem uh hi.
Solomon' ading ni khatin annek tuidawn in annel lawh sawmthum, leh an lawh sawmguk,
bawngtal a thau sawm, leh lono-a kivak bawng sawmnih tuu za khat hi a, sakhitalte, leh Siria sakhite, sanangte, leh a thau vasate kisim lo lai hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Eufrates nitumna lam gamsung khempeuh Tifsah panin Gaza ciang dong, Eufrates nitumna lam pang kumpi khempeuh tungah ukna nei hi; ama kiim mun khempeuh ah kilemna om hi.
Solomon' hun sung khempeuh Judah leh Israel lungmuang takin omin, Dan panin Be-ersheba ciang dong nangawn mi khempeuh a leenggui leh a theikung nuai uhah om uh hi.
Solomon in a leengte adingin buk a nei ciat sakol tul sawmli leh sakol tung tuang mi tulsawm leh tulnih zong nei hi.
Tua uliante in Kumpi Solomon leh Kumpi Solomon' sabuai-ah hong pai mite khempeuh adingin amau ciat sikh kha sung adingin annek tuidawn pia uh hi; amaute in bangmah kisamsak lo uh hi.
Amau' nasep ciat tawh kizui-in a kisapna munah sakolte leh sakol zaptelte' adingin mangbuhham leh buhtu zong paipih uh hi.
Pasian in Solomon tungah teh zawh lohin a thuk mahmah pilna leh theihna, leh tuipi gei-a sehnel bangin lungsim zaina pia a,
Solomon' pilna in nisuahna lam mi khempeuh leh Izipt pilna khempeuh khuplet hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh mi dang khempeuh sangin amah pil zaw a, Ezrah mi Ethan, leh Mahol, tapa Heman, Kalkol, leh Darda sangin pil zaw hi; ama minthan'na in a kiim-a minam khempeuh lakah kizeel hi.
Amah in paunak tul thum zong genkhia hi; ama late in tul-le-nga a hi hi.
Amah in Lebanon a, om taamtaak-a kipan phungmai a, a po puknahte dongin singkung thu gen hi; amah in khe li nei ganhingte, leh vasate, leh a bokvak ganhingte, leh ngasate thu gen hi.
Mi khempeuh sungpan, leh leitung kumpi khempeuh sung panin Solomon' pilna a za dingin ama pilna a zasate hong pai uh hi.
Amaute in ama pa' munah kumpi-in amah sathau a nilhna thu a zak ciangin Tai-ar kumpi Hiram in a nasemte Solomon kiangah sawl hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Hiram in David it tawntung hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in Hiram kiangah kam khak a,
"Topa in ama khe nuai-ah amaute a koihsak matengin amah a umcih a galte tawh kidona hangin ka pa David in Topa ama Pasian' min dingin inn a lam theih lohna thu na thei hi.
Ahih hangin tu-in Topa ka Pasian in na khempeuh ah tawlngakna kei tungah hong pia hi; hong langpang ahi a, thusia ahi zongin om lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in ka pa David kiangah, 'Nangma taangin na kumpi tokhom tungah ka koih ding na tapa in ka min dingin inn lam ding hi,' a cih mah bangin Topa ka Pasian' min dingin inn khat lam ka sawm hi.
Tua ahi ciangin Lebanon taamtaak singte kei adingin a kiphuk nading thu pia in; ka nasemte in nangma nasemte seppih ding uh a, nangma seh bangin na nasemte' thaman ding nang tungah kong pia ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Sidon mite bangin sing suih zia a thei kote lakah khat zong a om lohna na thei hi," a ci hi.
Hiram in Solomon' kam a zak ciangin nakpi takin a lungdam a, "Hih a lian a tam mite a uk dingin David tungah a pil tapa a pia Topa in tu ni-in thupha ngah ta hen," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Hiram in Solomon kiangah mi sawlin, "Kei kiangah nong thu-khak ka za hi; taamtaak sing leh taaksan sing tawh kisai na deih khempeuh a hih dingin ka kiging hi.
Ka nasemte in Lebanon panin tuipi ah tuate hong puak suk ding uh hi; nangma cihna munah a pai dingin tuipi a tawn dingin keimah in tuate phongin ka bawl dinga, tua lai munah keimah in a singte phelsakin nangmah in na ngah ding hi; nangmah in ka innkuan ading an piakna tawh ka deihnate nong kicingsak ding hi," ci sak hi.
