Saul' nasemte in ama kiangah, "Tu-in en in, Pasian kiang panin kha gilo in nang hong gimsak hi.
Tu-in na mai-a om nasemte in laiza lasakna a tum siam mi khat a zon' nadingin ka topa un na nasemte thu pia in; Pasian kiang panin kha gilo na tungah hong tun' ciangin amah in tua hong tum ding a, tua ciangin na ci hong dam ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Saul in a nasemte kiangah, "Lim takin a tum thei khat kei adingin hong zong un la, ka kiangah amah hong paipih un," a ci hi.
Tangvalte khat in dawngin, "En un, Bethlehem mi Jessi' tapa, a tum siam, a thahat, a gal hang mi, thugen a siam, a mel hoih khat ka mu hi; Topa in amah tawh omkhawm hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Saul in Jessi kiangah kamtaite sawl a, "Na tapa David, tuute tawh a ompa, kei kiangah hong sawl in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jessi in anlum, leh leenggahzu savun thawl khat leh keelno khat a pua la khat la-in, Saul kiangah tuate a tapa David puaksak hi.
Saul kiangah David hong tung a, ama nasepna-ah lut hi. Saul in nakpi takin amah it a, amah in a galhiam pua-pa suak hi.
Saul in Jessi kiangah mi sawlin, "Keima nasepna-ah David hong omsak in; bang hang hiam cih leh keima muhna-ah amah in maipha mu hi," ci sak hi.
Pasian kiang pan-a kha gilo Saul tungah a om peuhmah ciangin David in laiza la-in a khut tawh tum hi; tua ahih ciangin Saul thak suakin a cidam a, ama kiang panin khagilo kihemkhia hi.
Tu-in Filistiate in galdo dingin a galkapte khawm uh hi; Judahte gam Sokoh ah amaute kikhawm uh a, Sokoh leh Azekah kikal Efesdammim ah giahphual sat uh hi.
Tua ciangin Saul leh Israel mite kikhawmin Elah kuam-ah giahphual sat uh a, Filistiate do dingin kikhung uh hi.
Filistiate a gal khat mual tungah ding uh a, Israelte a gal khat mual tungah ding-in, amaute' kikalah guam khat om hi.
Filistiate giahphual panin Gath khuami Goliath a kici a makai, a tun' pi kua val a sang mi khat hong paikhia hi.
Amah in a lu tungah sumngo siklukhu nei-in, sikpuan tawh amah kithawi a, a puan gihna in sumngo shekel tulnga ahi hi.
Amah in a khete tungah sumngo ngaltuam nei a, a liangkote kikalah sumngo teikhawh kikhai hi.
A teibul in siam lawngpi cia bang hi a, a teipak in sik shekel zaguk gik hi; ama mai-ah a lum puapa pai hi.
Amah ding-in Israel uliante otsanin, "Galdo dingin bang hangin hong kuankhia na hi uh hiam? Keimah in Filistia mi hi-in, note in Saul' nasemte hilo na hi uh hiam? Note' adingin mi khat teel un la, tua mipa kei kiangah hong paisuk sak un.
Amah in kei hong doin hong thah zawh leh kote in na nasemte ka hi ding uh hi; ahih hangin keimah in amah zoin ka thah leh note in komau' nasem hi-in ka na uh na sem ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua Fislistia mipa in, "Tu ni-in Israel uliante kong to hi; i kido theih nadingin mi khat hong pia un," ci thuah lai hi.
Saul leh Israelte khempeuh in Filistia mipa' kammalte a zak uh ciangin amaute lungkia-in nakpi takin lau uh hi.
Tu-in David in Judah gam Bethlehem khua-a om Efrathah mi, tapa giat a nei, Jessi min neipa' tapa ahi hi. Saul hun lai-in tua mipa teek zo-in kum tampi pha ta hi.
Jessi' tapa a upen thumte in galdona-ah Saul zui khin uh hi; gal sungah a pai a tapa thumte' min in a ta upa Eliab, leh ama zom-ah Abinadab, leh a thumna in Shammah ahi hi.
David in a nautum pen ahi hi; a upapen thumte in Saul zui uh a,
ahih hangin Bethlehem-a a pa' tuute a vak dingin Saul kiang panin David kileh kawikawi hi.
Ni sawmli sung zing leh nitakin Filistiapa hong pai-in hong ding hi.
Tua ciangin Jessi in a tapa David kiangah, "Hih ankan seu khat leh hih anlum lum sawm na ute puak dingin guang in la, na ute kiang giahphual ah manlangin va puak in;
a tul a ukpa kiangah zong hih sathaukhal sawmte puak in. Na ute' om dan va mu in la, amau omzia a kitheihna lim pawlkhat hong ciahpih in," a ci hi.
Tu-in Filistiate tawh kido-in Saul leh amaute, leh Israel mite khempeuh Elah kuam-ah om uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jessi in amah a thupiak bangin zingsangin David tho baihin, a keem ding mi khat tawh a tuute nusia a, a ante pua-in pai hi; mihonte galphual ah pai-in galdo kikona a ot lai takun amah giahphual va tung hi.
Israelte leh Filistiate, galkap leh galkap a kido dingin kinaih uh hi.
David in van cingpa khut sungah a nate nusia-in galkapte kiangah va tai a, pai-in a ute va hopih hi.
Amaute tawh a kiho lai takin, en in, Gath khuami Filistiate, a makaipi Goliath min nei-pa, Filistia uliante lak panin hong paikhia-in a masa-a mah bangin kam hong pau hi. David in ama kampau za hi.
Israel mite khempeuh in tua mipa a muh uh ciangin ama kiang panin taikhia uh a, lau mahmah uh hi.
Israel mite khat leh khat kiho-in, "Hih hong paikhia mipa na mu ngei hiam? Israelte a to dingin hong paito takpi hi; amah a that mipa tungah kumpipa in hauhna tampi pia-in, ama tanu zong pia ding a, a pa' innkuante Israelte sungah aana nasep leh siah khempeuh maang sak ding hi," a ci uh hi.
David in ama kianga ding mite kiangah, "Hih Filistiapa that-in Israelte tung panin hih mindaina a beisakpa adingin bang kihih ding ahi hiam? Amah in a nungta Pasian' galkapte a to dingin hih dawibia Filistiapa in kua ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Mite in a kibang mahin amah dawng uh a, "Amah a that mipa tungah tua bangin kihih ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Tu-in amah in mite kiangah thu a gen ciangin ama u a upapen Eliab in za hi; David tungah Eliab heh mahmah a, amah in, "Bang hangin hong paisuk na hi hiam? Tua tuu tawm khatte gamlakah kua tawh nusia na hi hiam? Na kihai-muan'na leh na lungsim gitlohna ka thei hi; bang hang hiam cih leh gal kidona mu dingin nong paisuk hi," a ci hi.
David in, "Bang hih ka hi hiam? Kam bek hi lo ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin ama kiang panin midang khat kiangah kihei-in a kibang mahin thu dong hi; mite in a masa-a mah bangin amah dawng kik uh hi.
David' kampaute a kizak ciangin amaute in Saul' kiangah gen kik uh hi; Saul in amah sam sak hi.
Tua ciangin David in Saul kiangah, "Ama hangin kuama lungkia sak kei in; na nasempa pai-in hih Filistiapa tawh ka va kido ding hi," a ci hi.
Saul in David kiangah, "Amah tawh kido dingin hih Filistiapa' lang khatah na kuan zo kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh nang in tangval na hi pan a, amah in a tangval-a kipan galkap mi ahi hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin David in Saul kiangah, "Na nasempa in a pa' tuute a kem zel hi; humpinelkai ahi a, vom ahi zongin hong pai-in tuute lak panin tuuno a mat ciangin,
a nungah delhin vat gawpin a kam sung panin tuuno ka honkhia hi; keimah hih dingin amah hong ding leh keimah in a khamul-in manin vat gawpin ka that hi.
Na nasempa in humpinelkai leh vomte that khin ngei hi; amah in a nungta Pasian' galkapte ninsak ahih manin dawibia hih Filistiapa in tuate khat tawh kibang ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in, "Humpinelkai khecin leh vom khecin panin kei hong honkhia Topa in hih Filistiapa khut sung panin kei hong honkhia ding hi," ci thuah lai hi. Tua ciangin Saul in David kiangah, "Pai in, Topa in nang hong ompih ta hen!" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in a galvante David silhsak hi, amah in a lu tungah sumngo lukhu khusakin, sikpuan silhsak hi.
Tua ciangin David in a galdalnate tungah a namsau khih a, amah kingeinaseh lo ahih manin lam pai dingin a kithawi leh pai thei lo hi. Tua ciangin David in Saul kiangah, "Hihte tawh ka pai thei kei hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka kingeinaseh kei hi," a ci hi. David in tuate suahkhia hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a khut-ah a ciangkhut la-in, lui panin suangmai tang nga tengin a tuucin' thung-ip, a ip sungah tuate koih hi; a khut sungah a suanglotna tawi a, Filistiapa nai-ah amah pai hi.
Tua ciangin a mai-ah a lum puapa tawh Filistiapa hong paisukin David hong naih hi.
Filistiapa khuadakin David a muh ciangin amah in simmawh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah a tangval pan, a cidam tuak, a mel hoih khat hi lel hi.
Tua ciangin Filistiapa in David kiangah, "Ciangkang tawh kei kiangah nong pai nadingin kei in ui ka hi hiam?" a ci hi. Filistiapa in ama pasiante tawh David samsia hi.
Filistiapa in David kiangah, "Ka kiangah hong pai in, huih lak vasate leh gamlak gamsate tungah na sa ka pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in Filistiapa kiangah, "Namsau leh teipi leh teikhawh tawh kei kiangah nang nong kuan hi; ahih hangin kei in Israel galkapte' Pasian, mihonte' Topa, nangmah in na to mipa' min tawh nang kiangah kong kuan hi.
Tu ni-in Topa in ka khut sungah nang hong pia ding a, keimah in nang hong sattukin na lu ka tankhia ding hi; tua ciangin tu ni-in huih lak vasate leh leitung ganhingte tungah Filistia mi a site' luanghawmte ka pia ding hi; Israelte sungah Pasian khat a om lam leitung mi khempeuh in a theih nading,
leh Topa in namsau leh teipi tawh a hotkhiat lohna thu hih a kikhawm khempeuh in a theih nading ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh galdona in Topa aa hi a, amah in kote khut sungah note hong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
David tawh kituah dingin Filistiapa ding-in hong pai a, hong naih ciangin David zong Filistiapa tawh kituah dingin manlangin gal mai-ah delh hi.
Tua ciangin David in a khut-in a thung-ip sawkin suangtang khat la a, lawnin Filistiapa' taltang kha hi; a taltang ah a suang tum a, lei lakah amah maipuk hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in suanglotna khat leh suang khat tawh Filistiapa zo a, Filistiapa kha-in that hi; David khut sungah namsau om lo hi.
Tua ciangin David tai-in Filistiapa tungah ding a, a namsau la-in a paai panin dok a, amah thatin tua tawh a lu tankhia hi. Filistiate in a makaipa uh a sihna a theih uh ciangin amaute tai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israelte leh Judah mite awngin ding uh a, Gath leh Ekron kulh kongpi ciang dong Filistiate delh uh ahih manin Sha-araim panin Gath leh Ekron ciang dong Filistia mi a liamte lampi-ah puk uh hi.
Tua ciangin Filistiate a delhna panun Israelte hong ciahkik uh a, amaute in amau' giahphual luhsak uh hi.
David in Filistiapa' lutang la-in Jerusalem ah paipih hi; ahih hangin amah in a gal kidalna ama puanbuk-ah koih hi.
Filistiapa do-in David a kuan khitna Saul in a muh ciangin galkap mangpa Abner kiangah, "Abner aw, hih tangvalpa kua tapa ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Abner in, "Na nuntakna a hin' mah bangin, Kumpipa aw, ka thei kei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Tangvalpa kua tapa ahi hiam kan in," a ci hi.
Filistiapa a thahna panin David hong ciah ciangin Abner in amah samin a khut sunga Filistiapa' lutang tawh Saul mai-ah amah paipih hi.
Saul in ama kiangah, "Tangval aw, kua tapa na hi hiam?" a ci hi. David in dawng in, "Bethlehem khuami na nasempa Jessi' tapa ka hi hi," a ci hi.
David leh Saul a kiho khit a kipanin Saul' tapa Jonathan in David it mahmah a, Jonathan in ama pumpi zahin it hi.
Saul in tua ni-a kipanin ama kiangah David omsak a, a pa' inn-ah ciah sak lo hi.
Tua ciangin Jonathan in David tawh thuciamna khat bawl hi.
Jonathan in ama tunga om a puantualpi suah-in David pia a, a gal kidalna, leh a namsau nangawn leh a thal leh a kawnggak zong pia hi.
David kuankhia a, Saul in a sawlna mun peuhpeuhah a maa tun' hi; tua ahih ciangin Saul in galkapte a uk dingin amah koih hi. Hih in mite khempeuh' muhna leh Saul' nasemte' muhna-ah zong hoih kisa hi.
Filistiapa a thahna panin David ciahin, amaute in inn lam a zuat uh ciangin, Israel khuapite khempeuh sung panin Kumpi Saul dawn dingin khuangtum leh lungdamna lasakna leh lasaknate tawh lasa leh lam kawmin numeite hong kuankhia uh hi.
Amaute in lungdamna bawlin omin numeite khat leh khat in, "Saul in a tulin that, David in a tulsawmin that," kici uh hi.
Saul heh mahmah a, hih thugenna in amah lungkim losak hi; amah in, "Amaute in David tungah a tulsawmin pia-in, kei tungah a tulin hong lo uh hi; kumpi min puak cih sim loh bang nei nawn ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ni a kipanin Saul in David encik hi.
A zing ciangin Pasian kiang panin khagilo in Saul hong bawhin, ni simin David in a hih ngei bangin laiza lasakna a tum lai takin ama inn sung tengah kamsan'na nei hi. Saul in a khut sungah a teipi tawi hi;
Saul in a teipi-in David nihvei khawh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh, "Kawm tawh David ka khawhcip ding hi," ci-in ngaihsun hi. Ahih hangin David in a nihvei mahin pelh thei hi.
Saul in David kihta hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in amah ompih a, ahih hangin Saul kiang panin amah kihemkhia khin ta hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Saul in ama omna panin amah la khia-in mihing tulkhat a uk-in koih hi; mite makai-in amah kuankhia-in hong ciah hi.
David in a sepna khempeuh ah a maa tun' hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in amah ompih hi.
Amah in matut zawhna lianpi a neih lam Saul in a muh ciangin amah lamdang sa-in om hi.
Ahih hangin Israelte khempeuh leh Judahte khempeuh in David it uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute makaihin amah kuankhia-in hong ciah hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in David kiangah, "Hih lai-ah ka tanu uzaw Merab om hi; nang tungah zi dingin kong pia ding hi; kei adingin hang peuh in la, Topa' gal do in," a ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Saul in, "Keima khut sungah amah si loin, Filistiate khut sungah si hen," ci-in ngaihsun hi.
David in Saul kiangah, "Keimah in kumpipa' makpa ka hih nadingin kei in kua hi a, Israelte sungah ka tanaute, ka pa' innkuante in kua ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Saul' tanu Merab David tungah a kipiak ding lai takin Meholah mi Adriel tungah a zi dingin kipia hi.
Tu-in Saul' tanu Mikhal in David ngai hi; amaute in Saul kiangah gen uh a, tua thu in Saul lungdam sak hi.
Saul in, "Ama adingin amah in thangzak ahih theih nading leh Filistiate khut in amah a langpan' theih nadingin ama tungah amah pia ning," ci-in ngaihsun hi. Tua ahih ciangin Saul in David kiangah a nihveina genin, "Nang in tu-in ka makpa na hi ding hi," a ci hi.
Saul in a nasemte thupia a, "David kiangah thu tuam genpih un la, 'En in, nang tungah kumpipa lungkim a, ama nasemte khempeuh in nang hong it hi; tua ahih ciangin tu-in kumpipa' makpa suak in,' ci un," a ci hi.
Saul' nasemte in David' kiangah hih thute gen uh hi. David in, "Keimah in mizawng hi-in a zahtakhuai lo ka hihna mu napi-in kumpipa' makpa suah ding a thuneu sa na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Saul' nasemte in ama kiangah, "Tua bang tua bangin David in gen hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in, "David kiangah hih bangin na gen ding uh hi, 'Kumpipa in a galte a thukkik theih nadingin Filistiate' vundawn zakhat cih simloh kumpipa in moman deih lo hi,' ci un," a ci hi. Tu-in Saul in Filistiate' khut tawh David sih sak ding ngaihsun hi.
Ama nasemte in David kiangah hih thute a gen ciangin kumpipa' makpa ahih ding David lungkim sak hi. A hun a bei ma-in,
David ding-in ama mite tawh pai a, Filistiate mi zanih that hi; tua ciangin amah kumpipa' makpa a suah theih nadingin kumpipa tungah a cingin a kipia amaute' vundawnte David in hong paipih hi. Saul in a tanu Mikhal ama zi dingin pia hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in David a ompihna leh a tanu Mikhal in David a itna thu Saul in a muh ciangin,
Saul in David kihta semsem hi. Tua ahih ciangin Saul in David' gal hi tawntung hi.
Tua ciangin Filistia mi uliante galdo dingin hong kuankhia uh a, amaute hong kuankhiat simin Saul' nasem dangte khempeuh sangin David in a maa tunzaw hi; tua ahih ciangin nakpi takin ama min kisang ngaihsut semsem hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in David thah ding a ngaihsutna thu a tapa Jonathan leh a nasemte khempeuh kiangah gen hi. Ahih hangin Saul' tapa Jonathan in David diksa mahmah hi.
Jonathan in David kiangah, "Ka pa Saul in nang thah hong sawm hi; tua ahih ciangin zingsang ciangin kidawm in la, mun simtham khatah omin bu in,
kei paikhia-in nangma omna phual nai-ah ka pa kiangah ka ding ding a, nangma thu ka pa kiangah ka gen ding hi; ama tung panin phawk ka neih leh nang kiangah kong gen ding hi," a ci hi.
Jonathan in a pa Saul kiangah David thu a hoihin genin ama kiangah, "Kumpipa a nasempa David tungah khial kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang tungah amah hong khial lo hi; ama nasepnate nang tungah nasep hoih ahi hi;
amah in a nuntakna pia ngamin Filistiapa that a, Topa in Israelte khempeuh adingin gualzawhna lianpi piangsak hi. Nangmah in hih thu na mu a, na lung a dam hi; tua ahih ciangin bang hangin thu om lopi-in David thahna tawh a mawh baang lo mipa tungah khial ding na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Saul in Jonathan' thu mang hi; Saul kiciam a, "Topa in a nungta ahih mah bangin amah kithat lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jonathan in David samin, Jonathan in ama tungah hih thute khempeuh lak hi. Jonathan in Saul kiangah David paipih a, a ni dang-a bangin ama sepna ngei-ah sem hi.
Tua ciangin gal hong omkik hi; David kuankhia-in Filistiate tawh kido a, amaute tampi tak that a, ama mai-ah amaute tai uh hi.
Tua ciangin a khut sungah a teipi tawi-in a inn sungah a tut lai takin Topa kiang panin kha gilo Saul tungah hong tung hi; David in a laiza lasakna tum hi.
Saul in a teipi-in kawm tawh David khawhcip dingin khawh hi; ahih hangin amah in Saul pelh a, amah in kawm tungah a teipi khawh hi. Tua ciangin David tai-in suakta hi.
A zingsang ciangin amah a thah theih nadingin tua zanin Saul in amah a vil dingin David' inn-ah mi sawl hi. Mikhal in ama kiangah, "Tu zanin na nuntakna na suahtak kei leh, zing ciangin nang hong kithat ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Mikhal in kongvangneu-ah David khiasuk hi; amah taikhia-in suakta hi.
Mikhal in milim khat la-in lupna tungah koih a, keelmul lukham khat a lu-ah koihin puan silhsak hi.
Saul in David a man dingin mi a paisak ciangin amah in, "Amah a ci na hi," na ci hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in David en dingin mi sawl a, "Amah ka thah theih nadingin a lupna tawh kei kiangah amah hong pua to un," a ci hi.
A mi sawlte hong tun' ciangin, en in, keel mul lukham a lu san-ah omin lupna tungah a milim na om hi.
Saul in Mikhal kiangah, "Bang hangin tua bangin kei hongkhem a, amah a suahtak nadingin ka galpa khah na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Mikhal in Saul dawngin, "Amah in kei kiangah, 'Hong paisak in; bang hangin nang hong that ding ka hi hiam?' hong ci hi,' a ci hi.
Tu-in David tai-in suakta a, Ramah ah Samuel kiangah pai-in, ama tungah Saul' hihna teng gen hi. Tua ciangin amah leh Samuel pai-in Naioth-ah om uh hi.
Tua ciangin Saul kiangah, "En in, Ramah khua sung Naioth veengah David om hi," kici hi.
Tua ciangin David a man dingin Saul in mi sawl hi; amaute in kamsang honte mailam thu genin omin amaute a makai-in Samuel a ding a muh uh ciangin, Saul' sawltakte tungah Pasian' kha hong tung a, amaute in zong mailam thu gen uh hi.
Hih thu Saul kiangah a kigen ciangin, amah in midang sawl leuleu a, amaute in zong mailam thu mah genin om uh hi. Tua ciangin Saul in mi a thumveina sawl a, amaute in zong mailam thu genin om veve uh hi.
Tua ciangin amahmah Rammah ah pai a, Seku-a om tuikhuk lianpi tung hi; amah in, "Samuel leh David koi-ah om ahi hiam?" ci-in dong hi. Mi khat in, "En in, Ramah khua sung Naioth veengah om uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua lai panin Ramah khua sung Naioth veengah amah pai hi; ama tungah zong Pasian' Kha hong tung a, Ramah khua sung Naioth veeng a tun' mateng a lam pai kawmin amah in mailam thu gen hi.
Amah in zong a puante suahkhia-in, Samuel' mai-ah zong mailam thu genin, tua sun tawntung leh tua zan tawntung a guaktangin om hi. Tua huna kipanin, "Saul zong kamsang suak khin ahi hiam?" kici hi.
Tua ciangin Ramah khua sung Naioth veeng panin David tai-in, Jonathan kiangah hong tungin ama mai-ah, "Bang hih ka hi hiam? Ka mawhna bang ahi hiam? Amah in kei thah dingin hong zon' nadingin na pa mai-ah ka khialhna bang ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in ama kiangah, "Tua bang hi het lo ding! Na si kei ding hi. En in, ka pa in kei kiangah gen loin a lian hita leh a neu hita leh bangmah hih lo hi; bang hangin ka pa in kei tungah hih thu hong iim ding ahi hiam? Tua bang hilo hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin David in dawngin, "Nang nong pahtak lam na pa in tel takin thei hi; tua ahih manin amah in, 'Amah dah kha ding ahih manin hih thu Jonathan theisak kei ning,' ci-in ngaihsun hi. Ahih hangin a taktakin, Topa nungta-in nang na nuntak mah bangin kei ka sih nading themkhat bek in sam hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jonathan in David kiangah, "Na gen peuhpeuh nang adingin kong hih sak ding hi," a ci hi.
David in Jonathan kiangah, "En in, zingciang in kha det ni hi a, kumpipa tawh sabuai-ah pel loin ka tut ding ahi hi; ahih hangin a ni thum ni nitak dongin lo sungah ka buk theih nadingin kei hong paisak in.
Na pa in kei hong kan leh, 'David in ama khuapi Bethlehem-ah a va taipak dingin kei kiangah limtakin hong kingen hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amau innkuan khempeuh adingin kumsim biakpiakna tua lai-ah om hi,' na ci ding hi.
Amah in, 'Pha hi!' a cih leh na nasempa adingin hoih ding hi; ahih hangin amah a heh leh amah in siatna a ngaihsutna thei in.
Tua ahih ciangin thuman itna tawh na nasempa hong bawl in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang tawh a siangtho thuciamna-ah na nasempa na tun'pih hi. Ahih hangin kei sungah mawhna a om leh, nangmah mah in kei hong that in, bang hangin na pa kiangah kei hong paipih ding na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jonathan in, "Nang tungah tua bang hi het kei hen! Ka pa in nang tungah siatna hong tun'sak ding a ngaihsutna thei leng nang kiangah hong gen lo ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in Jonathan kiangah, "Na pa in nang hong ngawh dawn' leh kua in kei kiangah hong gen ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Jonathan in David kiangah, "Hong pai in, lo sungah pai ni," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute gel lo sungah pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jonathan in David kiangah, "Israelte' Pasian, Topa in teci hi ta hen! Zingciang tu bang hun ahi a, a ni thum ni-in ahi zongin, ka pa' ngaihsutna tawng ka kankhiat khit ciangin, en in, David tungah amah a lungsim a hoih leh, nang kiangah mi hong sawlin hong pulak lo ding ka hi hiam?
Ahih hangin nang tungah siatna bawl nadingin ka pa a lungkim sak leh, a muanhuaina-ah nang na pai theih nadingin nang kiangah a thu kong pulak kei a, nang kong sawlkhiat kei taak leh, Topa in keimah Jonathan hong dawm kei ta hen. Amah in ka pa tawh a om mah bangin Topa in nang tawh hong om ta hen.
Kei ka nuntak lai leh ka sih loh nadingin Topa' thuman itna kei tungah hong lak in;
keima innkuan panin na thumanna dokkik ngei kei in. Leitung maitang panin David' galte khempeuh Topa in a phiatkhiat ciangin,
David innkuan panin Jonathan' min phiatkhia kei in. Topa in David' galte tungah phu la ta hen," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jonathan in amah a itna David tungah kiciam pha kik hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ama pumpi a it zahin amah in David it hi.
Tua ciangin Jonathan in ama kiangah, "Zing ciang in kha det ni ahi hi; na tutna awng ding ahih manin nang hong kiphawk ding hi.
A ni thum ni-in nakpi takin nang hong kiphawk kan zawlai ding hi; tua ciangin a thu a kikup ciangin na bukna mun-ah pai in la, suangcian hua lam pangah om in.
Tua ciangin muitum bangin tua lam pangah thaltang thum ka lawn ding hi.
En in, naupang khat sawlin ama kiangah, 'Pai in, thaltangte va zong in,' ka ci ding hi. Naupang kiangah, 'En in, nang ma kiang hih lamah thaltangte om hi, tawm in,' ka cih leh nang a hong pai ding na hi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa a nungta ahih mah bangin nang adingin lungmuanhuai-in launa om lo hi.
Ahih hangin tangvalpa kiangah, 'En in, thaltangte nangma khen'ah om hi.' ka cih leh, nang pai in; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in nang hong sawlkhia hi.
Nang leh kei in i gen thu tawh kisai-in ahih leh, en in, nang leh kei kikalah teci in, Topa om tawntung hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David lo sungah bu hi; kha det ni hong tun' ciangin an ne dingin kumpipa tu hi.
A ni danga bangin kawm gei-a tutna tung, ama tutna-ah kumpipa tu hi; a kigalsai-in Jonathan tu-in, Saul' pangah Abner tu a, ahih hangin David' mun awng hi.
Ahi zongin Saul in tua ni-in bangmah gen lo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, "Ama tungah thu khatpeuh piang hi; amah siang lo hi, siang lo taktak hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a ni nih ni, kha det ni khit a zingsang ciangin David' mun awng lai hi. Tua ciangin Saul in a tapa Jonathan kiangah, "Bang hangin Jessi' tapa zanni hita leh, tuni hita leh an nekna-ah hong pai lo ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Jonathan in Saul dawngin, "Bethlehem ah a pai dingin lim takin kei tungah David hong kingen hi,
amah in, 'Kei hong ciahsak in; ka innkuante un khuapi sungah biakpiakna bawl uh a, ka sanggampa in tua lai-ah ka om ding thu hong pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in nong hehpihna-in hong paisakin ka sanggamte hong musak in,' hong ci hi. Hih thu hangin kumpipa sabuai-ah amah hong pai lo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jonathan tungah Saul heh mahmah a, amah in ama kiangah, "A kihei khial a lehdo numei' tapa aw, nangma maizum nading leh na nu' mindai nadingin Jessi' tapa na pawlpihna thu a thei lo hong sa na hi hiam?
Bang hang hiam cih leh leitungah Jessi' tapa a nuntak lai teng nang na hi a, na kumpi za ahi zongin kip lo ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin mi sawl in la, kei kiangah amah hong paipih in, amah a si taktak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jonathan in a pa Saul dawngin, "Bang hangin amah kithat ding ahi hiam? Amah in bang hih ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Saul in amah a vat kha dingin ama lamah a teipi lawn hi; tua ahih ciangin a pa in David that ding a ngaihsutna Jonathan in thei tel hi.
Tua ciangin heh mahmahna tawh sabuai panin Jonathan ding-in tua pawi a ni nih ni-in an ne lo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a pa in amah minsiasak ahih manin David hangin amah dah hi.
A zingsang ciangin David tawh a kiciamna lo-ah Jonathan pai-in, amah tawh naupangno khat pai hi.
Amah in a naupang kiangah, "Tai in la ka thaltang lotte va tawm in," a ci hi. Naupang a tai laitakin ama khen'ah thaltang khat lawn hi.
Jonathan' thaltang lot a tukna mun-ah naupang a tun' ciangin Jonathan in naupang samin, "Nang khen' hua lamah thaltang om hilo ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jonathan in naupang samin, "Manlang in, hong kinawh in, tua lai-ah om kei in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Jonathan' naupangpa in a thaltangte khawmin a topa kiangah pai hi.
Ahih hangin naupang in bangmah thei lo hi; Jonathan leh David bek in a thu thei uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jonathan in a hiamte a naupangpa kiangah pia-in, ama kiangah, "Pai in la, khuapi sungah pua in," a ci hi.
Naupang a paikhiat khit phetin suangcian pang panin David ding-in lei-ah maipuk a, thumvei kun hi; Jonathan sangin David nakpi takin dahzaw a, amau khat leh khat kinamin, khitui luangin khat leh khat kikah uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jonathan in David kiangah, "Ei tegel Topa' min tawh kiciamin, 'Kei leh nang kikal, leh keima suan-le-khakte leh nangma suan-le-khakte kikalah a tawntungin Topa om ding hi,' i cih mah bangin nuam takin pai in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah ding-in paikhia hi; Jonathan zong khuapi sungah ciah hi.
Tua ciangin David Nob khua-a siampipa Ahimelek kiangah pai hi; Ahimelek a liingsa-in David dawn dingin hong pai a, ama kiangah, "Bang hangin nang guak hong hi a, kuamah tawh hong pai lo na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
David in siampi Ahimelek kiangah, "Kumpipa in na khat hong sawl a, kei kiangah, 'Nang kong sawlna leh nang kong hilh thute khat zong kuamah theisak kei in,' hong ci hi. Tua mun tua mun-ah tangvalte tawh kiciamna khat ka bawl zo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in nang bang na nei hiam? Anlum lum nga ahih kei leh hih lai-a a om peuhpeuh hong pia in," a ci hi.
Siampipa in David dawngin, "Tu takin anlum mawkmawk ka nei kei hi; ahih hangin anlum siangtho om hi; tangvalte numei panin a kikep nak uh leh," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in siampipa dawngin, "A taktakin ci lehang, hih bangin ka paikhiat uh ciangin numeite kiang panin kote ka kikem tawntung uh hi; khualzin mawkmawk ciang nangawnin zong tangvalte siangtho hi; tu ni-in amaute bangzahin siangtho zawkan ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin siampipa in anlum siangtho amah pia hi; bang hang hiam cih leh anlum dang om loin, a kilak khiat ni-in anlum a lum lai tawh a kilaih pah ding, Topa mai panin a kilakhia Ompihna Anlum bek om hi.
Tu-in Topa mai-ah a kikhawlsak, Saul' nasemte mi khat tua ni-in om hi; ama min in Doeg hi a, Saul' gancing makaipipa, Edom mi ahi hi.
Tua ciangin David in Ahimelek kiangah, "Teipi ahi a, namsau ahi zongin hih lai-ah nei lo na hi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa' nasep in nawhtat ding kul ahih manin ka namsau ahi a, ka hiamte ahi zongin kong la man kei hi," a ci hi.
Siampipa in, "Elah kuam-ah na thah Filistia mi Goliath' namsau, en in, puan tawh kitunin hih lai-ah siampi puan nungah om hi; tua na deih leh la in; bang hang hiam cih leh a dang om lo a, tua bek hih lai-ah om hi," a ci hi. David in, "Tua sanga hoihzaw a dang om lo hi; kei hong pia in," a ci hi.
David ding-in tua ni-in Saul kiang panin tai a, Gath kumpipa Akhish kiangah pai hi.
Akhish nasemte in ama kiangah, "Hih David in a gam kumpipa hilo ahi hiam? Amaute khat leh khat in ama thu la-in sa-in lam uh a, 'Saul in a tulin that, David in a tul sawmin that,' ci hilo ahi uh hiam?" a ci uh hi.
David in hih thute a lungsimah ciamteh a, Gath kumpipa Akhish kihta mahmah hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute' mai-ah a gamtat kheelin, amaute' muhna-ah a hai-in kibawl a, kulh kongkhakte tung kuigawpin, a khamul tungah a cilphuan kai suk sak hi.
Tua ciangin Akhish in a nasemte kiangah, "En un, hih mipa a hai lam na mu uh hi; tua ahih ciangin bang hangin kei kiangah amah hong paipih na hi uh hiam?
Ka omna-ah mihai a gamta dingin hih mipa nong paipih nadingun mihai kisam thuah lai ka hi hiam? Hih mipa ka inn sungah hong pai ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
David tua lai panin kihemkhia-in Adullam leihawm-ah tai hi; a sanggamte leh a pa' innkuante khempeuh in a zak uh ciangin ama kiang tua lai mun-ah paisuk uh hi.
Tua ciangin a lungkham mi khempeuh, leh leiba a nei mi khempeuh, leh a lungkim lo mite khempeuh ama kiangah kikhawm uh hi; amah in amaute tungah a ukpa a suak hi. Tua lai-ah amah tawh mihing zali bang om hi.
David tua lai mun panin Moab gam Mizpeh-ah pai hi; amah in Moab kumpipa kiangah, "Pasian in kei adingin hong sepsak ding ka theih hun matengin ka nu leh ka pa na kiangah hong omsak in, ci-in kong thum hi," a ci hi.
Amah in Moab kumpipa kiangah amaute nusia a, munmuanhuaina sungah David a om sung teng amah tawh omkhawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin kamsangpa Gad in David kiangah, "Munmuanhuaina sungah om nawn kei in; kihem in la, Judah gamah pai in." a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin David kihemkhia-in Hereth tulak-ah pai hi.
Tu-in David leh amah tawh a om mite a kimuhna Saul in za hi. A khut sungah a teipi tawi-in, a nasemte khempeuh a kimkotah ding-in Gibeah khua a sangna mun makeng kung nuai-ah Saul tu hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in a kimkot-a a ding a nasemte kiangah, "Tu-in za un, no Benjaminte aw; Jessi' tapa in note khempeuh lote leh leenggui lote hong pia-in, note khempeuh a tul a uk, a za a uk-in hong koih dingin um a,
note khempeuh in kei hong sawmsim na hi uh hiam? Tu ni-a bangin hong pangsim dingin ka tapa in Jessi' tapa tawh thukimna a bawl ciangin kuamah in kei kiangah hong pulak loin, ka tapa in keimah a do dingin ka nasempa a hanthotna-ah note kuamah dah loin, kei kiangah zong nong pulak kei uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Saul' nasemte kiangah a ding, Edom mi Doeg in dawngin, "Ahitub' tapa Ahimelek kiang Nob khua-ah Jessi' tapa a pai ka mu a,
amah in ama adingin Topa thu dot sakin, an-le-tui pia a, Filistia mi Goliath' namsau ama tungah pia hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Ahitub' tapa siampi Ahimelek leh a pa' innkuante ahi Nob-a om siampi khempeuh a sam dingin mi sawl hi; kumpipa kiangah amaute khempeuh hong pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in, "Ahitub' tapa aw, tu-in za in," a ci hi. Amah in dawngin, "Hih lai-ah om ing, topa aw," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in ama kiangah, "Tu ni-a bangin hong pangsimin kei do dingin hong thawh theih nadingin bang hangin nang leh Jessi' tapa in kei hong sawmsim a, ama tungah an leh namsau pia-in, ama adingin Pasian kiangah thu dotsak na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Ahimelek in kumpipa dawngin, "Na nasemte khempeuh lak panin kumpipa' makpa leh nangmah hong cingte a ukpa ahi David bangin kua thumanin, na inn sungah kua kipahtawi ahi hiam?
Ama adingin Pasian thu ka dotsak a masa pen in tu ni ahi hiam? Hilo! Kumpipa in a nasempa ahi a, ka pa' innkuante khempeuh ahi zongin ngawh kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh na nasempa in a tam hita leh a tawm hita leh hih thu khempeuh bangmah thei lo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Ahimelek aw, nang leh na pa' innkuante na si taktak ding uh hi." a ci hi.
Kumpipa in ama kiim-ah a ding a cingte kiangah, "Kihei un la, Topa' siampite that un; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute zong David tawh pang khawm uh hi; amaute in ama tai lam thei napi-in kei kiangah hong pulak lo uh hi," a ci hi. Ahih hangin kumpipa' nasemte in Topa' siampite tung a tu dingin a khut uh taangkhiasak lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Doeg kiangah, "Kihei in la siampite hih in," a ci hi. Edom mi Doeg kihei-in siampite hih a, tua ni-in saiha dial siampi puan a silh mihing sawmgiat leh nga that hi.
Amah in siampite' khuapi Nob khua sunga om nuntakna a nei khempeuh namsau tawh hih hi, numei leh pasal, naupang leh nawine, bawngtalte, late leh tuute, namsau tawh that khin hi.
Ahih hangin Ahitub' tapa Ahimelek' tapate khat Abiathar a kici khat suakta-in David kiangah a tai hi.
Saul in Topa siampite a thah khitna thu Abiathar in David kiangah gen hi.
David in Abiathar kiangah, "Tua ni-in Doeg tua lai-ah om ahih ciangin Saul kiangah gen taktak ding hi, ci-in ka thei hi. Na pa' innkuanpih mite khempeuh' sihna ka piangsak hi.
Kei tawh hong om in, lau kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh kei that dingin hong zongte in nang zong thah dingin hong zong hi; kei tawh nang in lungmuanna sunga om na hi ding hi," a ci hi.
Tu-in amaute in David kiangah, "En in, Filistiate in Keilah sim uh a, a ancilnate uh luh uh hi," ci-in gen uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in Topa thu dongin, "Pai-in Filistiate ka sim ding hiam?" a ci hi. Topa in David kiangah, "Pai-in Filistiate sim in la, Keilah honkhia in," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin David mite in ama kiangah, "En in, Judah gam hih mun-ah eite i lau hi; Filistia galkapte do-in Keilah ah pai lehang bangzahin lauzaw ding i hi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin David in Topa thu dong kik hi. Topa in amah dawngin, "Ding in, Keilah-ah paisuk in; bang hang hiam cih leh na khut sungah Fislistiate kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David leh a mite Keilah ah paisuk uh a, Filistiate tawh kido-in amau' ganhingte ciahpihin amaute tampi tak that uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin David in Keilah-a teng mite honkhia hi.
Ahimelek' tapa Abiathar David kiang Keilah ah a tai lai-in amah in siampipuan khat kengin paisuk hi.
Keilah ah David a tun' khitna thu tu-in Saul kiangah kigen hi. Saul in, "Pasian in ka khut sungah amah hong pia khin hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kulh kongpi leh a kalhna zawl a nei khua sungah lutna tawh amahmah kikhaknelh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in galdo ding, Keilah ah a paisuk ding, David leh a mite a umcih dingin mi khempeuh sam hi.
Saul in ama tungah a sia a sawmna David in thei hi; amah in siampi Abiathar kiangah, "Hih lai-ah siampipuan hong paipih in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in, "Israelte' Pasian, Topa aw, keima hangin khuapi susia dingin Saul in Keilah ah pai a sawmna thu na nasempa in za khin taktak hi.
Keilah mite in ama tungah kei hong ap ding hiam? Na nasempa' zak bangin Saul hong paisuk ding hiam? Israelte' Pasian, Topa aw, kong thum hi, na nasempa tungah hong gen in,' a ci hi. Tua ciangin Topa in, "Amah hong paisuk ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in, "Keilah mite in kei leh ka mite Saul tungah hong ap ding hiam?' a ci hi. Tua ciangin Topa in, "Amaute in note hong ap ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mi zaguk bang a pha, David leh a mite ding-in Keilah panin kihemkhia uh a, amaute a pai theihna peuhpeuh uhah pai uh hi. Keilah panin David a suahtakna thu Saul kiangah a kigen ciangin amah in a vai a khawl phot hi.
Zif gamlak mual tung gam sung, gamlak munmuanhuaina-ah David om hi. Saul in ni simin amah zong a, ahih hangin Pasian in ama tungah David pia lo hi.
Amah a that dingin Saul kuankhia khin ahih manin David lau hi, Zif gamlak Horesh munah David om hi.
Tua ciangin Saul' tapa Jonathan ding-in David kiang Horesh ah pai a, Pasian in hong huh ding hi, ci-in amah hanthawn hi.
Amah in ama kiangah, "Lau kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh ka pa Saul in nang hong su-kha lo ding hi; nangmah in Israelte tungah kumpi na hi ding a, keimah in nangma zom ka hi ding hi; ka pa Saul in zong hih thu thei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute nih in Topa mai-ah thuciamna bawl uh hi; Horesh ah David om lai-in, Jonathan a inn-ah ciah hi.
Tua ciangin Saul kiang Gibeah ah Zif mite paito uh a, "Jeshimon leitaw lam, Hakhilah mual tung, Horesh-a munmuanhuai sung kote lakah David bu hilo ahi hiam?
Tu-in hong paisuk in, kumpipa aw, amah na mat nopna thu thei ka hih manun hong paisuk in; kote' hih ding ahih leh kumpipa tungah amah kong ap ding uh ahi hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in, "Topa in note thupha hong pia ta hen; bang hang hiam cih leh note in kei tungah hehpihna nong nei uh hi.
Pai un, va kician sak lai un; ama bukna mun thei-in va mu un la, tua lai-ah kua in mu hiam hong thei un; bang hang hiam cih leh amah ngiansiam mahmah hi, ci-in kei tungah hong kigen hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah a bukna mun ahi a kiselsimna mun khempeuh hong ciamteh un la, thu a kitel tak tawh kei kiangah hong paikik un. Tua ciangin note tawh kei kong pai ding hi; gam sungah amah a om lai nak leh, Judah gam sung khempeuh zon' ding ahi zongin a tul lak panin amah ka zongkhia teitei ding hi," a ci hi.
Amaute ding-in, Zif-ah pai dingin Saul mai-ah na mapai uh hi. Tu-in David leh a mite Jeshimon leitaw lam Arabah gamsung Maon gamlakah om uh hi.
Saul leh a mite amah zong dingin kuan uh hi. Hih thu David kiangah kigen hi; tua ahih ciangin Moan gamlaka om suangpi-ah amah paisuk hi. Saul in tua thu a zak ciangin amah in Maon gamlakah David delh hi.
A mual pang khatah Saul pai a, David leh a mite a mual pang lang khatah pai uh hi; Saul leh a mite in David leh a mite man dingin hong um ahih manin Saul pelh dingin David a nawhtat lai takin,
Saul kiangah kamtai khat hong tung a, "Hong kinawh in la hong ciah in; bang hang hiam cih leh Filistiate in gam sung hong sim hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David a delhna panin Saul kileh kik a, Filistiate a do-in pai hi; tua ahih ciangin tua mun pen Suahtakna Suangpi kici hi.
Tua lai panin David paito-in En-gedi munmuanhuai-ah om hi.
Filistiate a delhna panin Saul a ciah ciangin, ama kiangah, "En in, En-gedi gamlakah David om hi," ci-in kigen hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in Israelte khempeuh sung pan a kiteel mihing tulthum la-in Sathak Suangpi mai-ah David leh a mite zong dingin pai hi.
Lam gei-a tuu-khawk a omna ah pai hi; tua gei-ah leihawm khat om a, awng hawh dingin tua sungah Saul pai hi. Tu-in David leh a mite leihawm tawngnung sungah na tu uh hi.
Tua ciangin David mite in ama kiangah, "Topa in nang kiangah, 'En in, na khut sungah na galpa kong pia ding a, hoih na sak bangin ama tungah na hih ding hi,' hong cih ni tu ni hita hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin David ding-in Saul' puantualpi mong at khiat simsak hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in Saul' puanmong at khia ahih manin David a lungsim in su hi.
Amah in a mite kiangah, "Amah in Topa' sathau nilhpa hi ci-in thei napi-in, ama tungah ka khut ka ngak ding, Topa' sathau nilhpa ahi ka topa tungah hih bang ka hih ding Topa in hong kham hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in hih thute tawh a mite zol a, amaute Saul hihsak lo hi. Tua ciangin Saul ding khia-in leihawm nusia a, a paina lampi ah pai hi.
Tua khit ciangin David zong leihawm sung panin paikhia-in Saul nung sap a, "Ka to kumpipa!" a ci hi. Saul in a nung a et ciangin, David in lei-ah a mai kunin zahtakna bawl hi.
Tua ciangin David in Saul kiangah, "Bang hangin, 'En in, David in na siat nading zong hi,' a ci mite' thu um na hi hiam?
En in, Topa in tu ni-in leihawm sung ka khut sungah nang hong piakna nangmah mah in tu ni-in na thei khin hi; mi pawlkhat in nang that dingin kei hong sawl a, ahih hangin nang kong hih kei hi. Keimah in, 'Ka topa tungah ka khut ka nga kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Topa' sathau nilhpa ahi hi,' ka ci hi.
En in, ka pa aw, ka khut sunga na puantualpi mong en in; kei tungah khialhna ahi a, kumpi dona ahi zongin a om lohna, na puantualpi mong at khia napi-in nang kong thah lohna thu tawh thei-in na mu ding hi. Kei thah dingin nong zon' hangin nang tungah ka khial kei hi.
Topa in kei leh nang kikalah thu khen hen. Kei' tunga nong khialhnate Topa in kei taangin nang tungah hong thuk hen; ahih hangin keima khut in nang hong hih lo ding hi.
Taang-ate' paunak in, 'A gilote' sung panin gitlohna hong piang,' a cih mah bang ahi hi. Ahih hangin keima khut in nang hong hih lo ding hi.
Israel kumpipa kua do-a kuankhia ahi hiam? Kua delh na hi hiam? Ui si maw! Uili maw!
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in thukhen hong hi-in, kei leh nang kikalah thukhenna hong pia hen la, hih thu thei-in ka thu-ah hong pang hen la, na khutsung panin kei hong honkhia hen," a ci hi.
David in hih thute Saul kiangah a gen a man khit ciangin, Saul in, "Ka tapa David, hih in nang' aw ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ciangin Saul kap hi.
Amah in David kiangah, "Nang in kei sangin na thumanzaw hi; keimah in nang tungah a sia kong piak lai takin nang in kei tungah a pha nong pia hi.
Topa in na khut sungah kei hong koih lai takin nang in kei nong thah lohna-ah kei nong limbawlna tu ni-in na laktel hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khat in a galpa mu leh amah in a suakta-in amah paikhia sak ding ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin tu ni-in kei tungah nong bawlna hangin Topa in a hoih tawh nang thaman hong pia hen.
Tu-in, en in, nangmah in kumpi na hih taktak ding ka thei a, Israel kumpi gam nangma khut sungah a kip ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin keima nung-a ka suan-le-khakte beisak loin, ka pa' innkuan panin ka min na phiat loh nadingin Topa tawh kei tungah hong kiciam in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Saul tungah David kiciam hi. Tua ciangin Saul inn-ah ciah hi; ahih hangin David leh a mite munmuanhuai-ah paito uh hi.
Tu-in Samuel si hi; Israelte kikhawmin ama hangin kap uh a, amaute in Ramah-a om ama innah amah vui uh hi. Tua ciangin David ding-in Paran gamlakah paisuk hi.
Karmel mual-ah nasep a nei mi khat Maon khua-ah om hi. Tua-pa hau mahmah hi; amah in tuu tulthum leh keel tulkhat nei hi. Amah in Karmel ah a tuumul met hi.
Tu-in tua mipa' min in Nabal hi a, a zi' min in Abigail ahi hi, Tua numei in tei leh melhoih a thuah khat hi a, ahih hangin a pasal pen a ki-uk zolo mi leh a gamtat sia khat ahi hi; amah in Kaleb mi ahi hi.
Nabal in a tuumul a metna David in gamlakah za hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in tangval sawm sawl hi; David in tangvalte kiangah, "Karmel ah paito-in Nabal kiangah pai un la, keima min tawh amah hopih un.
Hih bangin amah na hopih ding uh hi: 'Nang tungah nopna om ta hen, na innkuan tungah nopna om ta hen, na neih khempeuh tungah nopna om ta hen,
Ganmul mette na neihna ka za hi; tu-in na tuucingte kote tawh omin amaute tungah siatna ka bawl kei uh a, Karmel ah a om sung teng uh amaute in bangmah man'suah lo uh hi.
Na tangvalte uh dong in, amaute in nang kiangah hong gen ding uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin na mai-ah ka tangvalte maipha musak in; bang hang hiam cih leh pawi ni-in kong pai uh hi. Na khut sungah na neih peuhpeuh na nasemte leh na tapa David tungah pia in,' ci un," a ci hi.
David tangvalte hong tun' ciangin amaute in hih thu khempeuh David minin Nabal kiangah gen uh hi; tua ciangin amaute in ngak uh hi.
Tua ciangin Nabal in David' nasemte dawngin, "David kua ahi hiam? Jessi' tapa kua ahi hiam? Tu lai-in a tote kiang panin a taikhia nasem tampi om hi.
Ka anlum leh ka tui leh ka ganmul mette' adingin ka gawh ka sate la-in koi lai pan-a hong pai cih ka theih loh mite tungah pia ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David' tangvalte kihei a, ciah kikin hih thu khempeuh ama kiangah gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin David in ama mite kiangah, "Mi khempeuh in na namsau uh kuah ciat un!" a ci hi. Amaute khempeuh in a namsau uh kuah uh hi; David in zong a namsau kuah hi; mihing zali bang David nungah paito uh a, mihing zanihte van tawh om uh hi.
Ahih hangin Nabal nasem tangvalte khat in Nabal' zi Abigail kiangah genin, "En in, ka topa uh a hopih dingin gamlak panin David in a kamtaite hong sawlkhia hi; amah in amaute na tai hi.
Ahi zongin kote tungah tua mite hoih mahmahin kote in siatna ka thuak kei uh a, amaute tawh ka pai lai teng uh gamlakah ka om sungun bangmah ka man'suah kei uh hi;
tuute kemin amaute tawh ka om sung khempeuh uh kote adingin sun leh zanin amaute in kulhpi ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hih thu thei in la, na hih ding ngaihsun in; bang hang hiam cih leh ka topa leh a innkuan khempeuh tungah siatna tun'sak ding kingaihsun a, amah a khan'sia ahih manin kuamah in hopih thei lo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Abigail kinawhin, anlum lum zanih, leh leenggahzu savun thawl nih, leh a semsa tuu nga, leh ankan lawh nga, leh leenggahkeu bawk zakhat, leh thei moh zanih la-in late tungah tuate guang hi.
Tua nu in a tangvalte kiangah, "Keima mai-ah na paisuak un; en un, note nungah kei kong pai hi," a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in a pasal Nabal hilh lo hi.
Amah la tungah tuangin mual liah-ah a paisuk lai takin, en in, David leh a mite ama lamah hong paisuk uh hi; amah in amaute dawn hi.
Tu-in David in, "Ama neihsa khempeuh khat zong a mang lo dingin hih mipa neih khempeuh gamlakah a mawkna-in ka cing hi; amah in hih thuhoihte a sia tawh kei tungah hong thuk hi.
Zingsang ciangin ama neihsa khempeuh lakah pasal khat zong ka siit tak leh Pasian in keimah David hong dawm kei ta hen," na ci khin hi.
Abigail in David a muh ciangin kinawh a, la tung panin tuakin David mai-ah maipuk a, lei lakah kun hi.
Ama khe phungah pukin, "Kei tung bekah, ka topa aw, mawhna om ta hen; na kiangah na nasemnu thu hong gensak in la, na nasemnu thugente hong ngai in ci-in kong thum hi.
Ka topa in hih a khan'sia mipa Nabal ngaihsun kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh amin mah bangin amah zong ahi hi; Nabal in ama min hi a, haina in amah vukcip hi; ahih hangin na nasemnu keimah in nangma hong sawl na tangvalte ka mu kha kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, ka topa aw, Topa nungta-in, nangma nuntakna a hin'mah bangin mithah nading pan leh nangma khut tawh thuhkikna na hih loh nadingin Topa in nang hong kho ahih manin, tu-in na galte leh nangma tungah siat nading a zongte in Nabal bang ta hen.
Tu-in na nasemnu keimah in nangmah ka hong puak hih letsong nangma nung hong zui tangvalte hong piasak in.
Na nasemnu khialhna hong maisak in ci-in kong thum hi; bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in Topa' galte do na hih manin Topa in na innkuan kipsak paisuak ding hi; na nuntak lai teng nang sungah siatna kimu lo ding hi.
Nangmah delhin hong that dingin mite hong thawh leh, nangmah in Topa na Pasian kepna sung a hing mite lakah na om ding hi; amah in suang lotna kuang pan lotkhiat bangin na galte lawnkhia ding hi.
Topa in nangmah tawh kisai thu a hoih a gente khempeuh tawh kizui-in hong hihin, Israelte tungah ulian-in nang hong koih khit ciangin,
thu om lopi-in mi thahna ahi a, nangmah mah in phulakna hangin ahi zongin, dah nading thu ahi a, lungsim nat nading thu ahi zongin na nei kei ding hi. Topa in lim takin nang hong bawl ciangin na nasemnu hong phawk in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in Abigail kiangah, "Tu ni-in keimah dawn dingin nang a hong sawl Israelte' Pasian, Topa in thupha ngah ta hen!
Tu ni-in mithahna leh keima khut tawh phulak nading panin keimah hong kem nangma ngaihsutna in thupha ngah ta hen!
Bang hang hiam cih leh nang kong gimsak nading panin hong kho Israelte' Pasian, Topa in a nungta taktak ahih mah bangin, nang hong kinawhin keimah dawn dingin hong pai lo hi lecin, zingsang ciangin Nabal sung pan pasal khat zong om nawn lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in ama tung panin amah a puakte sang hi; amah in tua nu kiangah, "Lung nuamin na inn-ah ciah to ta in; thei in, na thu ka ngai a, nong thuumna kong pia khin hi," a ci hi.
Zingsang ciang, Nabal' zukhamna a ven' ciangin a zi in ama kiangah hih thute gen a, thakhatin a lungtang si-in amah suangtum bang hi.
Tua khit ni sawm bang ciangin Topa in Nabal vat hi; tua ciangin amah si ta hi.
Nabal a sihna thu David in a zak ciangin amah in, "Nabal' khut tung panin ka ngah zahkona hong thuk sakin, siatna panin a nasempa a lenkik Topa in thupha ngah ta hen; Topa in Nabal' gamtat siatna ama lu tung mah ah tung kiksak hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin David in mi sawlin ama zi dingin Abigail helsak hi.
David' nasemte Karmel-a Abigail kiang a tun' uh ciangin amaute in tua nu kiangah, "David in amah zi dingin a la dingin kote nang kiangah hong sawl hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah ding-in lei-ah a mai kun a, "En un, na nasemnu in ka topa' nasemte' khe a silsak ding nasem ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Abigail kinawhin ding-in la tungah tuang a, ama nasem numei nga in amah keem hi; David kamtaite nung zui-in pai a, tua ciangin ama zi suak hi.
David in Jezre-el khuami Ahinoam zong la hi; amau tegel ama zi suak uh hi.
Saul in ama tanu Mikhal, David' zi pen, Gallim khuami Laish tapa Paltiel tungah na pia khin hi.
Tua ciangin Saul kiang Gibeah ah Zif mite hong pai uh a, "Jeshimon nisuahna lam Hakhilah mual tungah David bu hilo ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Saul ding-in Zif gamlakah David zong dingin Israel mi a kiteel mihing tulthum tawh Zif gamlakah paisuk hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in Jeshimon nisuahna lampi gei-a om Hakhilah mual tungah giahphual sat hi. Ahih hangin David gamlakah om lai hi; amah delhin gamlakah Saul a hong paina thu a theih ciangin,
David in thukan simte sawl a, Saul hong pai taktak ahihna thei hi.
Tua ciangin David ding-in Saul in giahphual a satna mun-ah pai hi; David in Saul a galkap mangpa, Ner' tapa Abner tawh a lupna mun mu hi; Saul giahphual laizangah lum a, ama kimkotah galkapte in phual sat uh hi.
Tua ciangin David in Hit mi Ahimelek leh Zeru-iah' tapa, Joab' sanggampa Abishai kiangah, "Saul' giahphual ah kei tawh kua hong paisuk ding na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi. Abishai in, "Kei nang tawh kong paisuk ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David leh Abishai zanin galkapte kiangah pai uh hi; giahphual sungah Saul na ihmu a, a lukhung lei lakah a teipi na kiphut hi; Abner leh galkapte ama kimkotah na lum uh hi.
Tua ciangin Abishai in David kiangah, "Pasian in na galpa tu ni-in na khut sungah hong pia hi; tua ahih ciangin tu-in teipi-in lei tawh khatvei bek hong khawhcip sak in, nihvei khawh ding kisam lo hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin David in Abishai kiangah, "Ama tungah siatna bawl kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa' sathau nilhpa a su peuhpeuh mawhna pan peng ding sa na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
David in, "Topa in a nungta ahih mah bangin Topa in amah vat ding hi; tua ahih kei leh zong a sih hun hong tung ding hi; tua ahih kei leh gal kikapna sungah amah paisukin si ding hi.
Topa sathau nilhpa tungah ka khut ka ngak ding Topa in kei hong kham hi; ahih hangin tu-in a lukhung-a a om a teipi leh a tuithawl la-in pai ni," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in Saul lukhung-a om teipi leh tuithawl la hi; tua ciangin amaute paikhia uh hi. Kuamah in mu lo hi, zong thei lo hi; kuamah khanglo lo hi, amaute khempeuh ihmu uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in amaute ihmut suak mahmah sak hi.
Tua ciangin David a pang khatah pai-in, amaute kikalah saupi a kihalin mual dawn-a gamla-ah ding hi;
David in galkapte leh Ner' tapa Abner samin, "Abner aw, hong dawng lo ding na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ciangin Abner in dawngin, "Kumpipa a sam kua na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
David in Abner kiangah, "Pasal hilo na hi hiam? Israelte sungah nang tawh a kibang kua om ahi hiam? Tua ahih leh bang hangin na to kumpipa vil lo na hi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa na topa susia dingin mi khat hong pai hi.
Hih banga na gamtatna hoih lo hi. Topa in a nungta ahih mah bangin a si dingin na kilawm hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa' sathau nilhpa na topa na vil kei hi. Tu-in a lukhunga a om kumpipa' teipi leh tuithawl koi-ah om ahi hiam thei in," a ci hi.
Saul in David' aw khen thei a, "Ka tapa David, hih in nangmah aw ahi hiam?" a ci hi. David in, "Ka topa, kumpipa aw, keima aw ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Bang hangin ka topa in a nasempa delh ahi hiam? Bang gamta khial ka hi hiam? Ka tungah bang mawhna om ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in ka to kumpipa in a nasempa' thu za in. Keimah do dingin nang hong toksuahpa in Topa ahih leh amah in biakna hong sang ta hen; ahih hangin mihing ahih leh amaute in Topa mai-ah samsiatna ngah ta hen. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in, 'Pai in, pasian dangte' na sem in,' ci-in Topa' gamh ka ngah loh nadingin tuni-in kei hong hawlkhia uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in Topa' omna panin gamdang leitangah kei hong si sak kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh mual tungah vaka a bengpa bangin Israelte kumpipa keimah that dingin nong kuankhia hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in, "Ka gamta khial hi; hong ciahkik in; ka tapa David aw; bang hang hiam cih leh tu ni-in kei hong suaktasak na hih manin nang tungah siatna kong bawl nawn kei ding hi; en in, ka hai gamtat a, nakpi takin ka khial khin hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in dawngin, "Hih lai-ah na teipi om hi, kumpipa! Tangvalte khat hong paisak in la, hong la sak in.
Topa in mi khempeuh a thumanna leh a thutakna hangin thaman pia hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in tuni-in ka khut sungah nang hong pia a, keimah in Topa' sathau nilhpa hih dingin ka khutte ka tangkhiasak kei hi.
En in, tu ni-in nangmah kong suahtaksak mah bangin Topa in zong kei hong suaktasak hen la, haksatna khempeuh panin kei hong honkhia ta hen," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in David kiangah, "Thupha ngah ta in, ka tapa David! Nangmah in na tampi na sem ding a, tuate na zo ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin David ama lampi-ah pai-in, Saul ama omna mun ah ciah hi.
David in a lungsim sungah, "Saul' khut tawh ni khat ni ciangin ka si ding hi; kei adingin Filistiate gamah ka tai ding sangin a hoihzaw om lo hi; tua ciangin Saul in Israel gamgi huam sungah kei hong zon' niloh lungkia ta ding a, keimah in ama khut sung panin ka suakta ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David ding-in, amah leh amah tawh a om mihing zagukte, Gath kumpipa, Maok' tapa Akhish kiangah pai hi.
Tua ciangin David, amah leh a mite a innkuanpih ciat tawh, David zong a zi nihte, Jezre-el khuami Ahinoam leh Nabal' zi meigongnu, Karmel khuami Abigail tawh, Gath-a Akhish kiangah va teeng hi.
Gath ah David tai hi, ci-in Saul kiangah a kigen ciangin amah in David zong nawn lo hi.
Tua ciangin David in Akhish kiangah, "Nangma maipha nong muhsak zawh leh, ka ten' theih nadingin gam sung khuate khatah kei ading mun hong pia in; bang hangin na nasempa nang tawh kumpi khuapi sungah teengkhawm ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.

Topa Pasian aw, leitung leivui zahin a tam mi tungah kumpi-in kei hong koih khin na hih manin ka pa David tungah na thuciamna tu-in hong tung sak in.
Hih mite ka uk theih nadingin tu-in pilna leh theihna hong pia in; bang hang hiam cih leh hih zah-a a tam hih na mite kua in uk zo ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Pasian in Solomon dawngin, "Hih thu na lungsim sungah om a, nangmah in neihsate, hauhna, pahtawina, ahih kei leh nang hong mudahte' nuntakna ngen loin, a tungah kumpi-in nang kong koihna ka mite na uk theih nadingin nang adingin pilna leh theihna hong ngen na hih manin,
pilna leh theihnate nangma tungah hong kipia hi. Nang ma-a kumpite kuamah in a neih ngei loh, nang khit-ate kuamah in zong tua bang a neih loh ding, hauhnate, neihnate, leh pahtawina zong, nangma tungah kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Gibeon-a om mual dawn-a biak piakna mun, kikhopna buk mai panin Jerusalem ah Solomon hong pai hi. Tua ciangin amah in Israel tungah a uk hi.
Solomon in leengte leh sakol tung tuangte kaikhawm hi; amah in leeng tulkhat leh zali leh sakol tung tuang mi tulsawm leh tulnih nei a, leeng khuapite sung leh Jerusalem ah tuate koih hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Jerusalem ah suang bangin ngun leh kham olsak a, taamtaak singte pen Shefelah theiba sing bangin tam sak hi.
Solomon in gamdang panin sakol a laknate in Izipt leh Kue pan hi a, kumpipa' sumbawlte in a man ding pia-in Kue panin tuate ngah uh hi.
Amaute in Izipt panin leeng khat ciangin ngun, shekel za gukin la uh a, sakol khat ciangin za leh sawmnga-in la uh hi; tua mah bangin amaute in zuakkhiat kik dingin Hit kumpite leh Siria kumpite khempeuh tung panin zong sakol leh leeng la uh hi.
Tu-in Solomon in Topa' min dingin biakinn khat leh ama adingin kumpi inn khat lam ding sawm hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in van pua ding mi tul sawmsagih leh mual tung gamah suang to ding mi tul sawmgiat, leh tuate a vaan dingin mi tulthum leh zaguk seh hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in Tai-ar kumpi Huram' kiangah thu puak a: "Teen nading inn khat a lam nadingin ka pa David tungah taamtaak sing na puak mah bangin kei tungah zong hong puak in.
En in, Israelte' adingin a tawntung ading a kikipsaksa bangin, ama mai-ah a namtui nate ahi paknamtui hal nading leh Ompihna Anlum piak tawntung nading, leh sabbath nite leh khadet nite leh Topa i Pasian' adingin a kisehsa pawi nite-in zing leh nitakin meihal biaknate piak nadingin Topa ka Pasian' minin inn khat lamin ama tungah a ap ding ka hi hi.
Kote' Pasian in pasian khempeuh sangin lianzaw ahih manin ka lam ding inn in lian ding hi.
Ahih hangin vantung, a sangpen vantung nangawn in amah huam zo lo ahih manin ama adingin kua in inn lam zo ding ahi hiam? Ama mai-ah paknamtui hal nading cih sim loh ama adingin inn a lamsak dingin kei in kua ka hi hiam?
Tua hi a, tu-in ka pa David in a sehsa, Judah leh Jerusalem ah kei tawh a om nasep siamte tawh a semkhawm dingin kham, ngun, sumngo, leh sik, leh a ausan, a dupsan, puandumte, leh na sepna-ah zong siamna a nei mi khat hong puak in.
Sing nasem sing a phukte' adingin a kisuvui mangbuh beem tul sawmnih, mangbuhham beem tul sawmnih, leenggahzu tambong tul sawmli, leh sathau tambong tul sawmli ka pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Tai-ar kumpi Huram in lai-in thuk-in Solomon kiangah khak a, "Topa in a mite it ahih manin amaute tungah kumpi-in nang hong koih hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a lai sungah gen thuah lai a, "Topa adingin biakinn khat, leh ama adingin kumpi inn khat a lam ding, thu theihna leh thu telna tawh a kidim tapa pil, David tungah pia-in, van leh lei a bawl Israel Topa Pasian in thupha ngah ta hen.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in ka topa in a gensa mangbuh leh mangbuhham, sathau leh leenggahzute, na nasemte tungah puak in;
tua ciangin na kisap sing peuhmah Lebanon panin kong phuk ding uh a, nangmah in Jerusalem ah na puaktoh theih nadingin phong-in tuipi tungah Joppa dong nang kiangah kong paipih ding uh hi," zong ci lai hi.
Tua ciangin a pa David in mi phazah a sim mah bangin, Solomon in Israel gam sunga om gamdang mi khempeuh mi phazah simna bawl hi; mi tulza khat leh tul sawmnga leh tulthum, leh zaguk pha hi.
Amah in van pua dingin amaute tul sawmsagih, mual tung gamah suang to dingin tul sawmgiat, leh mite' nasep a vaan dingin tulthum leh zaguk seh hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in Jerusalem sung Moriah Mual tung a, a pa David tungah Topa a kilahna mun, David in a seh-nasa mun ahi, Jebus mi Ornan ancilna phual-ah Topa' inn lam ding kipan hi.
Amah in ama uk a kum lina a kha nihna ni nih ni-in lam ding kipan hi.
Pasian' inn lam nading Solomon' geelna in: a dung nidanga kizang tong-in, tong sawmguk hi a, a vai tong sawmnih ahi hi.
Inn mai-a innliim in inn vai tawh kikimin tong sawmnih sau hi; tua ciangin a san'na in tong sawmnih ahi hi.
Amah in taaksan tawh a innpi kawm dapin kham hoih tawh zut a, tua tungah nisuh leh khainiang bawl hi.
Amah in suang manpha phutin a inn zeem hi. A kham in Parvaim kham ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in a inn—a innsunte, a sangkilte, a kawmte, leh a kongkhakte, kham tawh zut hi; tua ciangin a kawmte tungah kherubte bawl hi.
Tua ciangin amah in siangthopen mun bawl hi; a dung in inn vai tawh kizui-in tong sawmnih hi a, a vai in tong sawmnih mah ahi hi; amah in kham hoih talen zaguk tawh zut hi.
A kilhnate a gihna in kham shekel sawmnga ahi hi. Tua ciangin amah in a inn dawl tungnungte kham tawh zut hi.
Amah in siangtho pen mun sungah sing kherub nih bawlin kham tawh tuate zut hi.
Tua kherub tegel kha a kizalin tong sawmnih ahi hi; a khat' kha khat in tong nga hi-in inn kawm ban a, tua ciangin a kha lang khat tong nga in a kherub dang khat' kha ban hi.
Tua mah bangin a kherub dang khat' kha lang khat in tong nga hi-in inn kawm lang khat ban a, tong nga mah a sau a kha lang khat in a kherub masa' kha tawh kizom hi.
Hih kherubte' khate in tong sawmnih huam hi; kherubte amau' khe-in ding-in innpi sung lam nga uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a dum leh a ausan leh a dupsan puante leh saihadial tawh a dalna puan bawl a, tua tungah kherubte bawl hi.
Amah in inn mai san-ah tong sawmthum-le-nga a sang, a dawn tuakah tong nga a pha khuamluzepna a nei khuampi nih bawl hi.
Amah in ngawng-a awhte bangin khainiangte bawlin khuampite dawnah koih hi; tua ciangin amah in mangkawlsing zakhat bawlin khainiangte tungah koih hi.
Amah in tua khuamte, khat leitaw lam, a khat leilu lam, biakinn mai-ah phut hi; amah in leitaw lam-a om pen Jakhin phuakin, leilu lam-a om pen Boaz phuak hi.
Amah in sumngo biaknatau, a dung tong sawmnih, a vai tong sawmnih a sang tong sawm a pha khat bawl hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a kisung tuikuangpi bawl hi; tua in a bem hi a, a gei khat pen a gei khat dong tong sawm pha-in, tong nga sang a, a kimkot tong sawmthum pha hi.
Tuikuangpi kimkot a nuai tong sawmthum sungah um gah limte om hi; tua um gahte gual nihin om a, tuikuangpi a kisun'in kisungkhawm pah hi.
Bawngtal sawm-le-nihte tungah tua tuikuangpi kinga a, thum leilu lam nga a, thum nitumna lam nga-in, thum leitaw lam nga a, thum nisuahna lam nga hi; tuate tungah a tuikuangpi kinga a, a nung lam uh a sung lamah om hi.
A sahna in khutpeek mai cia ahi hi; a geivial pen unok pak tawh a kibang hai geivial bangin kibawl hi; tua sungah tui tambong tulguk val ta hi.
Amah in kisil nading tuikuang dang sawm zong bawl a, leitaw lamah nga, leilu lamah nga koih hi. Amaute in meihal biakna a, a zatte uh hihte sungah silsiang ding uh a, tuikuangpi in siampite' kisil nading ahi hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a kigelhsa bangin kham meivakkhuam sawm bawl a, biakinn sung leitaw lamah nga, leilu lamah nga koih hi.
Amah in sabuai sawm zong bawl a, biakinn sung leitaw lam pangah nga, leilu lamah nga koih hi. Tua ciangin amah in kham kuang zakhat bawl hi.
Amah in siampite' inntual, leh inntual lian, leh inntual kongkhakte bawl a, a kongkhakte sumngo tawh zut hi.
Tua ciangin amah in inn khang nisuahna lam kiu-ah tuikuangpi koih hi.
Huram in beelte, kawbiate, leh kuangte zong bawl hi. Tua ahih ciangin Huram in Kumpi Solomon' adingin Pasian' inn a bawl nasep a zawhte in:
Khuampi nihte, kuang-ukte, leh khuampite lu dawnah a om khawmluzepna nihte; leh khuampite lu dawnah a om khuamluzepna kuang-uk nihte a tuam dingin ngen bang-a kibawl nihte,
leh khuampite tungah a om khuamluzepna kuang-uk nihte a tuam dingin ngen banga kibawl khat adingin mangkawlsing gual nih ahi ngen banga kibawl nihte adingin mangkawlsing zalite ahi hi.
Amah in a din'nate, leh din'nate tungah a kikoih tuikuangte,
leh a tuikuangpi khat, leh tua nuai-a om bawngtal sawm-le-nihte zong bawl hi.
Topa' inn dingin Kumpi Solomon' adingin siapa Huram in a kihal sumngo tawh beelte, kawbiate, sikkeukate, leh hihte' adingin nazat khempeuh a bawl hi.
Jordan zanglei sung Sukkoth leh Zeredah kikal beel lei-ah kumpipa in hihte sung hi.
Solomon in hih nate tampi tak bawl a, sumngo a gik zah kithei zo lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Solomon in Pasian' inn sunga om na khempeuh a bawlte in: kham biakna tau, Ompihna Anlum adingin sabuaite,
a kigelhsa bangin biakinn sungnung mai-ah vak dingin kham citak meivakkhuamte leh a meivakte;
kham siangpen tawh a kibawl a pakte, a meivakte, leh a tehte;
kham siangtho tawh a kibawl a taitehte, kuangte, paknamtui adingin pakante, leh vutluahna hi a, siangthopen mun pai nading kongkhak sungnungte' ading leh biakinnpi sung kongkhakte' adingin biakinn kongkhak bilte in kham ahi hi.
Tua bangin Topa' inn ding Solomon in ahih nasep khempeuh kizo hi. Tua ciangin a pa David in a apsa nate Solomon in paipihin, Pasian' inn van manpha koihnate sungah a ngunte, a khamte, leh um-le-beelte khempeuh a seng hi.
Tua ciangin Zion a kici David khuapi sung panin Topa' thuciamna singkuang a paipih to dingin Solomon in Israel upate, minam lutang khempeuh, leh Israel beh makaite, Jerusalem ah kaikhawm hi.
Tua ciangin a kha sagihna-a pawi hun sung kumpipa' mai-ah Israel mi khempeuh kikhawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel upate khempeuh hong pai uh a, Levi mite in thuciamna singkuang la uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in thuciamna singkuang, leh kikhopna buk, leh puanbuk sunga om a siangtho um-le-beel khempeuh pua to uh hi; siampite ahi Levi mite in tuate pua to uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi Solomon leh ama mai-ah a kikhawm Israelte khempeuh thuciamna singkuang mai-ah om uh a, biakna-in tuu leh bawngtal tampi tak pia uh ahih manin a phazah kisim zo lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin siampite in kherubte' kha nuai, siangthopen mun sung, biakinn sungnung sung ama munah Topa' thuciamna singkuang paipih uh hi.
Kherubte in thuciamna singkuang tungah a khate uh zak ahih manin kherubte in thuciamna singkuang leh a zawlte tungah khuhna khat suak uh hi.
A zawlte sau ahih manin siangtho mun panin biakinn sungnung mai-ah a mongte kidawk hi; ahih hangin a pua lam panin kimu thei lo hi; tu ni dongin tua lai-ah tuate om hi.
Amaute Izipt panin hong paikhiat lai-in Topa in Israel mite tawh thuciamna a bawlna mun Horeb-ah Moses in suangpeek nihte a koih sim loh thuciamna singkuang sungah bangmah om lo hi.
Siangtho mun panin siampite hong pusuakin (bang hang hiam cih leh amau' pawlte cih tuam om loin tua lai-a om siampite khempeuh amau mahmah kisian'suah uh hi;
tua ciangin Levi mi lasate Asaf, Heman, leh Jeduthun, amau' tapate leh a behte, saihadial puan tawh kizemin, daltuahte, harp lasaknate, leh laiza lasaknate tawi-in peengkul tum siampite za leh sawmnih tawh biakna tau nisuahna lamah ding khawm uh hi;
aw kikhatin phatin Topa tungah lungdam koh ding pen peengkul tumte leh lasate' nasep ahi hi), peengkulte leh daltuahte leh adang lasaknate tawh, "Topa tungah lungdam koh ding hoih hi, bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi," ci-in Topa phatna-in la a kisak ciangin, Topa' inn in meii tawh kidim a,
meii hangin siampite in na sem zo lo uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa' minthan'na in Pasian' inn sung a dim hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in, "Khuamial sahpi sungah teen ding a teel Topa aw,
a tawntungin na teen nading mun, a lian inn khat, hih lai-ah kong lamsak khin hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in en kawikawi a, Israel mi a kikhawmte khempeuh a din' laitakin amaute khempeuh thupha pia hi.
Tu-in Israel Pasian, Topa' min dingin inn khat lam ding ka pa David' lungsim sungah om hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in ka pa David tungah, 'Na lungsimah keima min dingin inn khat lam ding na ngaihsun a, tua na ngaihsutna hoih mahmah hi;
ahi zongin keima min dingin tua inn a lam dingpa in nangmah hi loin, nangma sung pan hong piang ding na tapa hizaw ding hi,' a ci hi.
Tu-in Topa in a bawlsa thuciamna tungsak khin hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa' thuciam bangin ka pa David' munah hong khangin Israel kumpi tokhom ah kong tu a, Israel Pasian, Topa' min dingin inn ka lam khin hi.
Amah in Israel mite tawh a bawl Topa' thuciamna a kikoihna singkuang tu-in tua lai-ah ka koih khin hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel a kikhawmte khempeuh omna Topa' biaknatau mai-ah Solomon ding-in a khut zan hi.
Solomon in a dung tong nga, a vai tong nga, a sang tong thum a pha sumngo tau khat bawlin inntual ah koih khin hi; tua ciangin tua tungah amah ding hi. Tua ciangin Israel a kikhawmte khempeuh muhin amah khuk din'in van lamah a khut zan hi;
tua ciangin, "Israel Pasian, Topa aw, vantungah ahi a, leitungah ahi zongin thuciamna lenin a lungsim khempeuh uh tawh nangma thu hong mang na nasemte tungah itna kip a lak, nang tawh a kibang Pasian om lo hi;
ama tungah na gensa bangin na nasem ka pa David tungah a tungsakpa na hi hi; hi hi, na kam tawh thu na gen a, na khut tawh tu ni-in na tungsak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in Israel Pasian, Topa aw, ama tungah thuciamin, 'Keima thu nang na man' bangin na suan na khakte in ka thukham zui-in a gamtatna uhah a kidop nak uh leh Israel kumpi tokhom tungah a tu dingin keima mai-ah mi khat beek na kitasam kei ding hi,' na cihsa bangin na nasem ka pa David tawh na thuciamsa kipsak in.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in Israel Pasian, Topa aw, na nasempa David tungah na gensa na kammal kipsak in.
"Ahih hangin Pasian in mite tawh leitungah hong teeng takpi ding ahi hiam? En in, vantung leh a sangpen vantung in nang hong huam zo lo hi; hih keima lamsa inn in hong huam zo lo zawkan ding hi!
Ahi zongin na nasempa' thungetna leh hong thuumna don in; Topa ka Pasian aw, na nasempa in na mai-ah hong kikona leh hong nget thungetna ngai in;
Amaute in hih mun lam nga-in thu hong nget uh ciangin na nasempa leh na mi Israelte' hong thuumnate nangmah in ngai in; hi hi, na teen'na mun vantung panin za in; na zak ciangin maisak in.
"Mi khat a vengte tungah khialin kiciamna kiciamsak a, hong pai-in hih inn sung na biakna tau mai-ah a kiciamna hong kiciam leh,
vantung panin za-in gamta in la, na nasemte thukhenin, a mawh mi a gamtatna ama lu tung mah-ah tusakin thuk in la, a thuman mi a thumanna tawh kizui-in thaman piakna tawh langsak in.
"Na mi Israelte nang tungah hong khialhna hangin a galte uh mai-ah guallelin, amaute hong kihei kikin na min hong phawkin hih inn sung nangma kiangah thungenin thuumna hong bawl ciangin,
vantung panin nangmah in za in la, na mi Israelte' khialhna maisakin amaute leh a pu a pate uh tungah na piak leitungah amaute paipih kik in.
"Amaute nangma tungah hong khialhna hangin vantung kikhakcipin guah a zuk loh hun, amaute na gimsak hun ciangin, amaute in hih mun lam nga-in thu ngen a, na min hong phawkin amau' khialhna panin a kihei uh leh,
amaute a pai nading lampi hoih hih in la, vantung panin za-in na nasemte, na mi Israelte' khialhna maisak in; tua ciangin na mite tungah gamh-in na piak na leitang tungah guah zusak in.
"Gam sungah kialpi tungin, pulnatna ahi a, ankung natna ahi a, ankung zawngkhalna ahi a, kauphe ahi a, lung ahi zongin om a; amau' khuapi khatpeuh peuh ah a galte un umcihin; bang bang gimna, bang bang natna hi taleh;
mi khatpeuh ahi a, na mi Israelte khempeuh in ahi zongin amau' natna leh a dahna ciat uh thei-in hih inn lamah a khut uh hong zanin bangbang thungetna hi taleh bangbang thuumna hi taleh hong bawl leh;
na teenna mun vantung panin za in la, maisakin,amau' gamtatna khempeuh tawh kizui-in a lungsim uh na theih bangin amaute tungah pia ciat in (bang hang hiam cih leh nang, nang bek in mihing' lungsim na thei hi);
tua hi leh ka pu ka pate uh tungah na piak leitang tungah a nuntak hun sung khempeuh uh amaute in nang hong zahtakin nangma thu hong zui ding uh hi.
"Tua mah bangin na mi Israel a hilo gamdang mi khat a lian nangma min hang leh, nangma thahatna hangin a gamlapi gam panin hong pai-in, hih inn lam nga-in thu hong nget leh
na teenna mun vantung panin za in la, gamdang mipa in na tungah hong ngetna khempeuh tawh kizui-in hih in; tua hi leh nangma mi Israelte mah bangin leitung mi khempeuh in na min thei-in nang hong zahtak ding uh a, keima lamsa hih inn in nangma min tawh a kilo ahihna thei ding uh hi.
"A galte uh do dingin na mite kuan khia-in, bangbang lamah amaute sawl hita lecin, nangmah in na teelsa hih khuapi lam nangma tung leh nangma min dingin ka lamsa inn lam nga-in amaute in thu hong nget uh leh,
amau' hong thungetna leh hong thuumnate vantung panin za-in amau' vai huh in.
"Amaute nang tungah hong khialin (a khial lo kua om hiam?) amaute tungah nang heh a, galte tungah amaute pia-in, amaute a gamla gam ahi a, a nai-ah ahi zongin galmatin kipua khia a;
ahi zongin galmatin a kipuakna gamah amaute in a lungsim sung uhah tua thu ngaihsunin kisik kik a, 'Kote khialin lam pialin ka gitloh tat uh hi,' ci-in amaute galmatin a omna gam panin nang tungah hong thuum a;
amaute galmatin a kitutna, galmatin a omna leitangah a ngaihsutna khempeuh uh leh a lungsim khempeuh uh tawh amaute kisik kikin, na teelsa khuapi leh nangma min dingin ka lamsa inn, nangmah in amau' pute pate tungah na piak amau' leitang lam nga-in thu hong nget uh leh,
na teenna vangtung panin amau' thungetna leh thuumnate za in la, amau' vai huhin nang tungah hong khial na mite maisak in.
"Tu-in ding-in Topa Pasian aw, na tawlngakna ding munah, na vangliatna singkuang tawh pai in. Topa Pasian aw, na siampite, gupna tawh zem in la, na hoihna ah na mi siangthote lungdam ta hen.
Topa Pasian aw, na sathau nilhpa nial kei in! Na nasempa David na itna sa hong phawk in," a ci hi.
Solomon a thunget a tawp ciangin, vantung panin meikuang hong pai sukin meihal biakna leh biak piaknate haltum a, tua ciangin Topa' minthan'na in biakinn hong dim hi.
Topa' minthan'na in Topa' inn dim ahih manin Topa' inn sungah siampite lut thei lo uh hi.
Israel mite khempeuh in meikuang hong pai sukin Topa' minthan'na biakinn tungah a om a muh uh ciangin suangphah tungah lei lam maingatin kun uh a, bia-in Topa tungah lungdamna ko-in, "Topa tungah lungdam koh ding hoih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa leh mi khempeuh in Topa' mai-ah biakna pia uh hi.
Kumpi Solomon in biakna-in bawngtal tul sawmnih leh tulnih leh tuutal zakhat leh tul sawmnih pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa leh mi khempeuh in Pasian' inn ap uh hi.
Siampite amau' panmun uhah ding uh hi; Levi mite zong, Kumpi David in Topa tungah lungdam koh nadingin a bawl Topa' tungah la sak nading lasaknate tawh ding uh hi—bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi—David in amau' nasepna tawh phatnate a bawl ciangin tua bangin hih uh hi; amaute tawh a kigalsai-ah siampite in peengkulte tum uh hi; tua ciangin Israel khempeuh ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in Topa' inn mai-ah a om inntual laizang ap hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Solomon in a bawl sumngo biakna tau-ah meihal biakna leh an tawh biakna leh a thaute ta zo lo ahih manin tua lai munah amah in meihal biakna leh thunuam-a biakna thaute pia hi.
Tua hun lai takin Solomon leh amah tawh a om Israel khempeuh mihon tampi in Hamath lutna panin Izipt lui ciang dongah ni sagih sung pawi a kham uh hi.
Tua ciangin a ni giat ni-in amaute in a thukhupna kikhopna khat nei uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in biakna tau apna ni sagih sung pawikham uh hi; pawi dang ni sagih sung kibawl beh lai hi.
A kha sagihna a ni sawmnih leh ni thum ni-in, Topa in David leh Solomon leh ama mi Israel tungah a hoih a bawlna hangin amah in lungdamna leh kipahna tawh a inn uhah mite ciah khia sak hi.
Tua bangin Solomon in Topa' inn leh kumpi inn zo hi; Solomon in Topa' inn leh ama inn sungah hih dinga a geel khempeuh nuam takin zo hi.
Tua ciangin zanin Solomon' tungah Topa kilangin ama kiangah: "Na thungetna ka za khin a, keima adingin biakpiakna inn dingin hih mun ka teel khin hi.
Keimah in vantungte khakcipin guah a zuk loh ciang ahi a, gam sung a netum dingin kauphe thu ka piak ciang ahi a, ka mite lakah natna ka tun'sak ciang ahi zongin,
keima minin a kisam ka mite amau mahmah kiniamkhiatin, thu ngenin ka mai hong zong a, amau' gitlohnate panin a kihei uh leh, tua ciangin keimah in vantung panin ka za ding a, amaute' khialhna maisakin a leitang uh ka hoihsak kik ding hi.
Tu-in ka mitte hakin hih lai munah a kingen thungetna ka bilte in ngai ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a tawntungin ka min a om theih nadingin keimah in hih inn teelin ka ap khin hi; ka mitte leh ka lungsim a tawntungin tua lai-ah om ding hi.
Nang adingin ahih leh, na pa David a gamtat bangin keima mai-ah na gamtat a, nang kong sawl khempeuh bangin semin ka thukhamte leh ka biakna ngeina kipte na zuih leh,
na pa David tawh kiciamin, 'Israel a uk dingin mi khat zong na kitasam kei ding hi,' ka cih bangin na kumpi tokhom ka kipsak ding hi.
"Ahih hangin note kihei-in, na mai uhah ka koihsa ka thukhamte leh ka thupiaknate nusia a, pai-in pasian dangte' na semin tuate na biak uh leh,
note tungah kong piaksa leitang panin note kong botkhia ding hi; tua ciangin ka min dingin ka apsa hih inn ka muhna panin ka lawnkhia ding a, mi khempeuh lakah paunak leh gentehna ka suaksak ding hi.
Tua ciangin a minthangsa hih inn a nawkkha khempeuh in lamdangsa-in, 'Bang hangin hih bangin Topa in hih gam leh hih inn bawl ahi hiam?' ci ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, 'Bang hang hiam cih leh Izipt gam panin amaute a paikhiatpih a pu a pate uh Pasian ahi Topa amaute in nusia uh a, pasian dangte pom uh a, tuate bia-in a na sem uh hi; tua ahih ciangin amah in hih siatna khempeuh amaute tungah tungsak hi,' ci ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Solomon in Topa' inn leh ama inn a lam khit kum sawmnih a cin' ciangin,
Kumpi Huram in ama tungah a piaksa khuapite Solomon in lampha-in tuate sungah Israel mite teeng sak hi.
Tua ciangin Hamathzobah-ah Solomon pai-in tua gam la hi.
Amah in gam sungah Tadmor khua satin Hamath gam sungah vankoihna khuapite khempeuh lam hi.
Amah in khuapi kulh, kongpite, leh zawlte a nei Bethhoron Tungnung leh Bethhoron Nuainung,
leh Baalath, leh Solomon' neih vankoihna khuapite khempeuh, leh a leengte' adingin khuapite khempeuh, leh a sakol tung tuangte' ading khuapite, leh Solomon in Jerusalem, Lebanon sung leh ama ukna gam sung khempeuh ah a lam nop khempeuh zong lam hi.
Israel a hilo Hit mite, Amor mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite, leh Jebus mite sung panin a om lai,
Israel mite in a suksiat nai loh amau nungah a suan leh khak uh tua gam sungah a om laite—Solomon in aana tawh siah a pia dingin bawl a, tua bangin tu ni dongin amaute om uh hi.
Ahih hangin Israel mite ahih leh Solomon in ama na a sem dingin sal-in bawl lo hi; amaute in galkapte, leh ama nuai-ah uliante, a leengte a ukte, leh a sakol tung tuangte ahi uh hi.
Hihte in Kumpi Solomon' ulian ukpite hi a, mite tungah aana a zang mihing zanih leh sawmnga ahi uh hi.
Solomon in David khuapi panin Faro' tanu ama zi paipihin ama adingin a lamsak innah tun'pih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, "Topa' thuciamna singkuang a tun'nasa munte siangtho ahih manin Israel kumpi David' inn sungah ka zi teeng lo ding hi," a ci hi.
A pa David' biakna ngeina kip tawh kizui-in, amau' nasepna dingin siampite a pawlpawlin a kikhennate, leh ni simin nasepna-ah a kisam bangin siampite' mai-ah Levi mite phatna panmunte leh nasepna, leh kongpi tampite' adingin kongcingte amau' pawl kikhenna ciatah amah in seh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua bangin Pasian' mipa David in thu pia hi.
Thu khatpeuh peuh leh van manpha koihnate tawh kisai-in kumpipa in siampite leh Levi mite a thupiakna bang teekteekin amaute in sem uh hi.
Tua bangin Topa' inn bulpi a kiphuh ni-a kipan a kizawh dongin Solomon' nasep khempeuh kimansiang hi. Tua ahih ciangin Topa' inn kizo hi.
Tua ciangin Edom gam sung tuipi gei-a om Ezion-geber leh Eloth khuate-ah Solomon pai hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi Huram in teembawte leh tuipi a thei a nasemte tawh ama nasemte sawl a, Solomon' nasemte tawh Ofir-ah pai khawmin tua lai panin kham talen zali leh sawmnga pua-in kumpi Solomon kiang tun' pih uh hi.
Tu-in Sheba kumpinu in Solomon' minthan'na a zak ciangin thudotna haksate tawh amah a ze-et dingin Jerusalem ah hong pai a, nungzui honpite leh a namtui nate leh kham tampi leh suangmanphate a pua kalaohte hong keng hi. Solomon kiangah amah hong tun' ciangin a lungsim-a om khempeuh ama tungah gen hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in ama dotna khempeuh dawng hi; Solomon in ama tungah a gentel theih loh haksa a sakluat bangmah om lo hi.
Sheba kumpinu in Solomon' pilna, a ma lamsa inn,
a sabuai-ah a an, a uliante' omzia, leh a nasemte' etna zia leh a puansilhte, a anpiate leh a puansilhte, leh Topa' inn ah a piak a meihal biaknate a muh khit ciangin a lungsim bei hi.
Tua ciangin amah in kumpipa kiangah, "Ka gam sung panin nangma thute leh na pilna ka zak a kigen thute man hi;
Na zite mi hampha! Na mai-ah ding tawntungin na pilna a za hih na nasemte mi hampha!
Na tungah lungkimin Topa na Pasian adingin kumpi-in a kumpi tokhom tungah nang hong tusak Topa na Pasian in thupha ngah ta hen! Na Pasian in Israel itin a tawntungin amaute kipsak ding ahih manin, nangmah in thutang leh thuman na sepkhiat theih nadingin amaute tungah kumpi-in nang hong koih hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in kumpipa tungah kham talen zakhat leh sawmnih, leh a namtui nate tampi tak, leh suangmanphate pia hi. Sheba kumpinu in Kumpi Solomon tungah a piak tua bang a namtui nate zahin a hoih om ngei lo hi.
Tua tham loin Ofir panin kham hong pua kumpi Huram' nasemte leh Solomon' nasemte in cingsing leh suangmanphate hong pua uh hi.
