Paul in Areopagas mualno tungah ding-in a gen-inah: "Athen mite aw, note in biakna na hahkat mahmah uh cih ka thei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, lampi-ah ka pai lai takin, na biaknate uh ka et ciangin, 'Kithei-lo Pasian Ading,' ci-a kigelh biakna tau khat ka mu hi. Note in na theih lohpi uh a, na biak uh Pasian' thu kong hilh ding hi.
Leitung akipan leitung sung na khempeuh a piangsak Pasian in, van leh lei uk mangpa ahih ciangin, mi' khut tawh kibawl biakna innah a teeng ahi kei hi.
Amah in hin'na tawh, naksuk naktoh akipan na khempeuh hong pia ahih ciangin na khat peuhmah a deih bangin, mite' khut tawh kivaak ahi kei hi.
Amah in leitung mi khempeuh minam khat bek pan bawl a amaute nuntak nading hun ahi zongin, amau omna atuam atuam ahi zongin a ciamteh zo hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mite in Pasian zongin a muh khak theih nading hang ahi hi. Tua bang i cih hangin Topa Pasian in eite khempeuh panin a gamla om ahi kei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian hangin eite i hing, i tang, i nungta hi. Tua mah bangin note' lai-atpa khat in a gen mah bangin, 'Eite in ama suan i hi hi,' a ci hi.
Pasian' suan i hih ciangin Pasian pen mi lungsim siamna leh khutsiamna tawh a kibawl kham tawh, ngun tawh, suang tawh kibang hi ci-a i up ding a kilawm kei hi.
Pasian in mihingte' theih nai loh hun bang mahin a sim loh hangin tu-in amau mawhna kisik kik nadingun mun khempeuh mite kiangah thu a pia zo hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah in a sehkholhpa tawh leitung mite, thuman tawh thukhen nading ni a genkhol zo hi. Tua pa sihna pan a thawhkik ciangin a kitel zo hi ci-in mi khempeuh a thei sak zo hi," ci-in Paul in a gen hi.
Amaute in misite hin'kikna thu a zak uh ciangin, kimkhat in a kosia uh hi, kimkhat in, "Hih thu tu nung ciangin ka ngaikik nuam uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Paul in amaute kiang pan a paikhia hi.
Mi kimkhat in Paul beelin thu a um uh hi. Tua mite lakah Areopagas mi Dionisias leh Damaris min nei numei khat akipan midangte zong a om uh hi.

A nasepna uh a kibang ahih ciangin Paul in amau' innah teeng a, na a semkhawm uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amaute in puanbuk khuite ahi uh hi.

tua san tak pan paikhia-in, Pasian a bia Titu Justas min nei, mi khat' innah a pai hi. Tua pa' inn in kikhopna inn tawh kinai-in a om hi.
Kikhopna inn ukpa Krispas in ama innkuanpihte tawh Topa a um hi. Korin mi tampite in zong thu ngai uh a, umin a kibaptaiz uh hi.
Zan lai takin Topa in mang sungah Paul kiangah a gen-inah "Lau kei in. Pau loin om kei in, thu na gen ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, nangmah tawh hong omkhawm ka hih manin kuamah in nang hong doin hong liamsuah kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, hih khua sungah keimah in mi tampi ka nei hi," a ci hi.
Paul in tua khua mite kiangah Pasian' thu hilhin kum khat leh kha guk tawntung a om hi.

"Hih pa in ngeina hi lopi-in Pasian biak nading mite a zol hi," a ci uh hi.

Tua ahih kei a, thu ahi zongin, min ahi zongin, nomau biakna thukhamna thu ahi zongin ahih leh, no na vaihawm ding uh hi. Tua thute khen ding ka ut kei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin thukhenna tokhom kiang panin a hawlkhia hi.

Amaute in amaute tawh Paul a om lai nadingin thu a nget uh hangin mang loin,
"Pasian in hong awi leh, khatvei kong paikik ding hi," ci-in amaute tawh kikhenin teembaw tuangin Efesa khua pan a paikhia hi.
Paul in Kaisaria khua a tun' khit ciangin pawlpite tawh kihopih dingin a paitoh khit ciangin Antiok khua-ah a paisuk hi.
Tua khua-ah sawtpi a om khit ciangin paikik a, Galati gam leh Frigia gam pai-in nungzuite khempeuh a kipsak hi.
Alekzandria khua mi Apollos min nei, thuhilh siam, Judah mi khat in Efesa khua-ah a tung hi.

Nangma teci Stefen' si a kibuak lai takin, a kiangah ding-in ka thukim tham loin, a that mite' puan ka cing hi,' ci-in ka gen ciangin,
amah in, 'Paikhia in. Gentailte kiangah gamlapi-ah nang kong sawl ding hi,' hong ci hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Hih thute a gen khit dongin amaute in a ngai uh hi. Tua ciangin, "Hih bang mipa, leitung pan paaikhia mang un'. Amah a hing dingin a kilawm kei hi!" ci-in nakpi-in a kiko uh hi.
Amaute kiko uh a, amau puan suahkhia-in leivui van lamah a lot uh ciangin galkap mangpa in
bang hangin kiko ahi uh hiam cih a theih nadingin, satna tawh Paul thu a kidot nadingin galkap inn sungah tumpih dingin thu a pia hi.
Amaute in Paul savun khau tawh a hen khit uh ciangin Paul in a kiangah a ding bupa kiangah, "Thukhenna thuak loin Rom mi sat ding a kilawm hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Galkap bupa in tua thu a zak ciangin galkap mangpa kiangah pai a, "Bang na cih ding hiam? Hih mi in Rom mi ahi hi," a ci hi.
Galkap mangpa in Paul kiangah pai a, "Nang, Rom mi na hi takpi hiam?" a cih ciangin, "Ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Galkap mangpa in, "Dangka tampi pia-in hih nam min ka ngah hi," a cih ciangin Paul in, "Ka pian'na panin Rom mi ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin thu dong dinga akisa mite in Paul kiang panin a paikhia pah uh hi. Amah Rom mi ahih thei a, amah khau tawh hen zo ahih ciangin galkap mangpa a lau mahmah hi.
A zing ciangin bang hangin Judah mite in Paul a mawhsak uh hiam cih galkap mangpa in tel takpi thei nuamin Paul khahkhia a, siampi liante leh upate a kikhopsak khit ciangin paipihsuk a, amaute mai-ah a koih hi.
Paul in upate a tel takpi-in en a, "Ute naute aw, tuni dongin Pasian mai-ah keimah pumpi ka kimawhsak nading om loin ka om hi," a cih ciangin
siampi mangpa Ananias in, "Ama muk sat un," ci-in a kiangah a dingte thu a pia hi.
Tua ciangin Paul in, "Leikang tawh kizut suangcian' aw, Pasian in nang hong sat ding hi. Nang in Thukham tawh kei tungah thukhen dingin na tu napi-in, Thukham tawh kibang loin hong sat ding thu na pia hiam?" a ci hi.
A kiangah a ding mite in zong, "Nang in Pasian' siampi mangpa zahko na hi hiam?" a cih uh ciangin,
Paul in, "Ute naute aw, amah in Pasian' siampi mangpa ahih lam ka thei kei hi. 'No mipawlte a uk mangpa na kosia kei ding hi,' ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah kigelh zo hi," a ci hi..
Upa kimkhat Farisai-te, kimkhat Saddusi-te ahih uh Paul in a theih ciangin, "Ute naute aw, Farisai mi ka hi hi. Farisai' ta ka hi hi. Mi sisate hong thokik ding hi ci-in ka lamet hangin thu dotna ka thuak hi," ci-in upate kiangah a ko hi.
Paul in tua thu a gen ciangin Farisai-te leh Saddusi-te khat leh khat kiseel uh ahih ciangin a kikhawmte a kikhen uh hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Saddusi-te in, "Hin'kikna ahi zongin, vantungmi ahi zongin, kha ahi zongin a om kei hi," a ci uh hi. Farisai-te in ahih leh, a nihin a om uh hi a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin gamlumna piang a, Farisai-te laka laitheite kimkhat ding-in nakpi-in a nial uh a, "Hih pa tungah bangmah mawhna ka mu kei uh hi. Kha ahi zongin, vantungmi ahi zongin ama kiangah a gen leh, bang phamawh ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Kiseelna a tam ciangin amaute in Paul a sukgawp khak ding uh galkap mangpa lunghimawh ahih ciangin, galkapte paisakin Paul amaute lak pan zawhthawh thu-in la a, galkap innah a paipih dingun a sawl hi.
Zing nitak ciangin Topa in Paul kiangah ding a, "Paul aw, lunghimawh kei in. Keima thu Jerusalem khua-ah na gen zo hi. Tua mah bangin Rom khua-ah zong ka teci thu na pang lai ding hi," a ci hi.
Khua a vak ciangin Judah mite kikhawm uh a, "Paul i thah khit matengin an i ne kei ding hi, tui i dawn kei ding hi," ci-in a kiciam uh hi.
Tua banga a kiciamte a kisim ciangin sawmli val pha hi.
Tua mite in siampi liante leh upate kiangah a pai uh a, "Kote in Paul ka thah khit matengun bangmah ka ne kei ding uh hi ci-in ka kiciam uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in upa vaihawmte tawh Paul thu a pha takpi khen ding bangin a hong paipihsuk nadingun galkap mangpa kiangah na ngen un. Paul in note kiangah hong tun' ma-in lam kalah that dingin ka omkhol ding uh hi," ci-in a gen uh hi.
Paul' sanggamnu' tapa in tuate lampi kiangah pangin a om uh cih a theih ciangin, galkap inn sungah lut a, Paul kiangah a zasak hi.
Paul in galkap khat sam a, "Hih tangval galkap mangpa kiangah va kha in. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, thugen ding khat a nei hi," a ci hi.
Galkap bupa in tangvalpa pen galkap mangpa kiangah paipih a, "A kikhum Paul in kei hong sam a, 'Mangpa kiangah koh nop a nei hih tangvalpa nang kiangah va paipih in,' hong ci hi," a ci hi.
Galkap mangpa in tangvalpa' khut lenin, a kilang lona-ah paipih a, "Bang thu hong ko nuam na hi hiam? ci-in a dong sim hi.
Tangvalpa in, "Zing ciangin upa kikhopna-ah Paul hong paipihsuk a, Judah mite in ama thu tel takin a dong ding bangin, nang kiangah hong ngen dingin a vaihawm zo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amau deihna bangin zui kei in. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, Paul a thah khit matengun an ne lo, tui dawn lo ding ci-in a kiciam mi sawmli val lampi gei-ah a ding uh hi. Tu-in tuate in amau thu na man' ding a ngak uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin galkap mangpa in, "Nang in kei kiangah hih thu nong gen kuamah na gen kei in," ci-in tangvalpa thu pia-in a khah hi.
Tangval a ciah khit ciangin galkap mangpa in galkap bupa sam a, "Tu nitak nai kua ciangin Kaisaria khua pai dingin galkap zanih tawh, sakol tuang galkap sawmsagih tawh, teipi tawi galkap zanih tawh kithawisak in.
Paul tuan' nading sakolte pia in. Mangpipa Feliks kiangah pha takpi-in a paipih ding uh hi," ci-in thu a pia hi.
Amah in hih bangin lai a gelhinah:
"Klaudis Lisias in Mangpipa Feliks kiangah lungdamna lai kong khak hi.
Judah mite in hih pa a man uh a, a that ding a kisak lai takun, amah in Rom mi ahih thu ka theih ciangin galkapte tawh pai-in, amah ka honkhia hi.
Amaute in bang hangin a mawhsak uh hiam cih ka thei nuam a, amaute upa vaihawmte kiangah ka paipihsuk hi.
A kithahna ding ahi zongin, thong sungah a kikhum nading ahi zongin a kilawm a khialhna hang ahi lo, amau thukham thu bek in a mawhsak uh hi cih ka thei hi.
Tua pa bawlsia dingin amaute a hanciam thu hong kizaksak ciangin, thakhatin kong paisak a, amah mawhsakte in nangma kiangah hong ko dingin thu ka pia zo hi," ci-in a gelh hi.
Tua ciangin galkap mangpa' vaikhak bangin galkapte in Paul a la uh a, zan lai takin Antipatris khua-ah a tung uh hi.
A zing ciangin sakol galkapte in Paul paipih uh a, galkapte a ciah uh hi.
Sakol tuang galkapte in Kaisaria khua-ah a tun' uh ciangin, Mangpipa' khut tungah lai a pia uh hi. Paul zong Mangpipa mai-ah a koih uh hi.
Mangpipa in lai a sim ciangin, "Kua gam mi na hi hiam?" ci-in a dot leh, Kilikia gam mi ahih a theih ciangin,
"Nang hong mawhsakte hong tun' uh ciangin, na thu ka ngai ding hi," ci-in Herod' kumpi-inn ah khum dingin thu a pia hi.
Ni nga khit ciangin siampi ukpa Ananias in Tertullas kici thugen siampa leh upa vaihawmte tawh Kaisaria khua-ah hong tungsuk uh a, Paul' thu Mangpipa a ko uh hi.
Paul a sap khit uh ciangin, Tertullas in mawhsakna thu a gen-inah: "Alian Mangpipa Feliks aw, kote in nangma hangin lau loin nuam takin ka om uh ahi zongin, nong kepna leh na thumuhkholhna tawh mipawlte tungah kipuah phatna om ahih ciangin,
gam khempeuh ah apawlpawl na hehpihna phatin ka om uh hi.
Ahih hangin nang kong nokkhak sak loh nadingin, hehpihna tawh komau thu tawm nong ngaih ding kong thuum hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, Nazareth mipawl ukpa ahi, leitung mun khempeuh ah Judah mi khempeuh misuam dingin a hansuah, hih mi gilo kote'n ka mu zo uh hi.
Tua tham loin, amah in biakna innpi a simmawh ciangin ka man uh hi. (Kote Thukham bangin amah thusit ding ka geel zo uh hi;
ahih hangin galkap mangpa Lisias hong pai-in, zawhthawh thu tawh amah ko tung panin hong kaihkhiat sakin, nangma mai-ah ama langte hong pai nading thu a pia hi.)
Ama kiangah thu na dot leh, ka mawhsakna thu uh na thei ding hi," ci-in a ko hi.
Judah mite in zong, "Hih thu ahi takpi hi," ci-in a mawhsak uh hi.
Mangpipa in a khut vanin Paul in a gen dingin thu a piak ciangin Paul in, "Nang in hih pawlte sawtpi sung na uk ka thei ahih ciangin, lungdamin ka mawh kiphelna thu kong gen ding hi.
Keimah in bia dingin Jerusalem khua-ah ka paitoh tuni-in nisawm-le-nih bek pha cih na thei zo hi.
Biakna innpi sungah kuamah tawh ka kinialna hong mu kei uh hi. Kikhopna inn sung ahi zongin, khua sung ahi zongin, mihonpite ka hansuahna amaute in hong mu kei uh hi.
Tua tham loin, kei tungah hong mawhsakna thu a gentel dingin teci hong lak thei kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in biakna pawl tuam a cih uh Lampi thu bangin ka pute ka pate' Pasian ka bia hi ci-in kong pulak hi. Thukham lai leh Pasian' kamsangte' Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh khempeuhte ka um hi.
Midik leh midik lote khempeuh in sihna pan a thokik ding hi ci-in amaute' lamet bangin Pasian suangin ka om hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian tungah ahi zongin, mite tungah ahi zongin, ka lungsim sungah kimawhsakna a om lohna dingin, a tawntungin ka hahkat hi.
Tu-in kum sawtpi khit ciangin keima pawlte hehpihna leh lungdamna letsong pia dingin kong pai hi.
Tua hehpihna ka piak lai takin biakna innpi sungah mi kikhawm lo, gamlum lo, siangtho takin ka bawl Asia gam panin a hong pai Judah mi kimkhatte in hong mu uh hi.
Tua mite in kei tungah mawhsak nading a om leh, na mai-ah hong pai-in hong mawhsak leh a kilawm hi.
Ahih kei leh, upa vaihawmte mai-ah ka om lai takin,
'Misite' thawhkikna thu hangin note mai-ah tuni-in thu dotna ka thuak hi,' cih ka kikona aw kam khat longal, keima tungah mawhna dang bang hong mu ahi uh hiam, tu-in hih mite in hong gen ta uh hen," ci-in a gen hi.
Mangpipa in, "Galkap mangpa Lisias hong paisuk ciangin note ka hong dong ding hi," ci-in tua Lampi thu thei zo ahih ciangin thu khen loin, amaute a khahkhia hi.
"Paul thong sungah khum loin, kicingin om hen. Ama lawmte in ama kiangah pai-in, an a piak nop uh leh, na kham kei un," ci-in galkap bupa kiangah a vaikhak hi.
Tua nung ciang a sawt loin Feliks Mangpipa in Judah mi ahi, a zi Drusilla tawh hong paikhawm a, Paul samin Zeisu Khazih upna thu a ngai uh hi.
Paul in dikna thu, kidekna thu leh hong tung ding Thukhenna Ni thu a hilh ciangin Feliks Mangpa lau a, "Tu-in pai ta in. Tu nung a kilawm hun ciangin kong samkik ding hi," a ci hi.
Paul in amah kisut nading golhguk a piak khak leh ci-in ummawhin tam veipi samin, a hopih hi.
Kum nih a cin' ciangin Porsias Festas in Feliks za a laih hi. Tua Feliks in Judah mite lungdamsak nuamin Paul thong sungah a omsak lai hi.
Festas Mangpa tua gamah a tun' khit ni thum khit ciangin Kaisaria khua panin Jerusalem khua-ah a paito hi.
Tua lai takin siampi liante leh Judah miliante in Paul' thu a ko uh hi.
Lampi-ah bukin thah ding a vaihawm uh a, Jerusalem khua-ah a paisak nadingin a thuum uh hi.
Ahih hangin Festas in zong, "Paul in Kaisaria khua-ah kikhumin a om hi. Tua khua-ah a sawt loin ka pai ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note lakah ahi theite in kei hong zui-in, tuapa tungah mawhna a om leh, na mawhsak ta un," a ci hi.
Festas in amaute lakah ni giat bang, ni sawm bang a taam khit ciangin Kaisaria khua-ah pai a, a zing ciangin thukhen tokhom tungah tu-in Paul a samsak hi.
Paul a tun' ciangin Jerusalem khua pan hong pai Judah mite in amah uumin, teci a lak zo lo, a lian mahmah mawhna tampi tawh Paul a mawhsak uh hi.
Paul in, "Keimah in Judah ngeina Thukham ahi zongin amau biakna innpi tungah ahi zongin, Kaisar Kumpipa tungah ahi zongin ka khial kei hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Festas in, "Jerusalem khua pai a, keimah in hih thu ka hong khensak ding na ut hiam?" ci-in Judah mite lungdamsak nuamin Paul kiangah a dong hi.
Paul in zong, "Kaisar Kumpipa' thukhenna tokhom mai-ah ka ding hi, hih tokhom mai-ah kei' thu nong khensak ding kilawm hi. Nang na theih bangin Judah mite tungah bangmah ka mawh kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi gilo ka hih a, sih nading a, kilawm mawhna ka hih leh, sihna tawh ka kipelh kei ding hi. Ahi zongin tua mite hong mawhsaknate khat beek a man kei leh kuamah in amaute khut tungah hong pia zo kei ding hi. Kaisar Kumpipa kiangah azu ka khan ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Festas Mangpa in upate tawh a vaihawm khit ciangin, "Nang in 'Kaisar Kumpipa kiangah azu ka khan ding hi,' na ci ahih ciangin, Kaisar Kumpipa kiangah na pai ding hi," a ci hi.
Tu nung a sawt loin, Agrippa Kumpipa in ama zi Bernike tawh Kaisar a tun' ciangin Festas a hopih hi.
Sau veipi a om khit ciangin Festas Mangpipa in Paul' thu kumpipa kiangah a gen-inah, "Feliks Mangpipa in thong sungah khumin a nutsiat mi khat a om hi.
Jerusalem khua-ah ka om lai takin siampi liante leh Judah upate in tuapa thu hong ko uh a, hong khensak in ci-in hong thuum uh ciangin,
keimah in zong, 'Mawhsakna a thuak mi in a mawhsak mite tawh kimaituah sak a, a tungah a koih mawhna a phelna thu a gen khit matengin kuamah kiangah piak ding Rom ngeina ahi kei hi,' ci-in ka gen hi.
Tua mite in hih san takah hong kikhop uh ciangin khawl loin, a zing ciangin thukhen tokhom tungah tu-in tuapa ka samsak hi.
Amaute a ding uh a, ama tungah ka upmawh bangin thusia a koih kei uh hi.
Amaute biakna thu leh a sisa mi khat ahi, Zeisu hangah kidongin a mawhsak uh hi. Paul in, 'Tua Zeisu a nungta hi,' a ci hi.
Tua thudotna ka theihtel loh lai takin, 'Jerusalem khua-ah pai a, hih thu tanna na thuak ding hiam?' ci-in amah ka dot leh,
a lian Kumpipa kiangah azukhan nuam a, amah a kikhum lai nading hong ngen ahih ciangin, Karsar Kumpipa kiangah ka paisak mateng dongin ka khumsak hi," a ci hi.
Agrippa in zong, "Tua pa thu ka za nuam hi," a cih ciangin, Festas in, "Zing ciangin ama thu na za ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin zingsang ciangin Agrippa leh Bernike in kithupi bawlna tawh khua sung uliante tawh hong tung uh a, kikhopna inn sungah a tum uh ciangin Festas in thu a piak ciangin Paul a lutsak uh hi.
Festas in, "Kumpipa Agrippa akipan kote tawh a omkhawm mite aw, hih pa na mu uh hi. Jerusalem khua leh hi lai-ah Judah mite khempeuh in ama thu kei hong ko uh a, 'Amah in tomkha nangawn nungta ding a kilawm kei hi,' hong ci uh hi.
Amah in sihna thuak ding akilawm mawhna ahih loh ka thei a, kumpi lianpa kiangah azukhan nuam ahih ciangin, a pai nading thu ka khensat hi.
Ama thu gelh a, Kumpipa kiangah piak ding thu a kitel tak khat beek ka nei kei hi. Tua ahih ciangin note in na dottel khit uh ciangin lai gelh ding ka neih nadingin nomau mai-ah ahi zongin, kumpipa Agrippa kiangah ahi zongin amah kong paipih zo hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a kikhumpa a kimawhsakna lai pia loin paisak leng akilawm kei hi ci-in ka um hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Agrippa in, "Nang in nang ading na gen thei ding hi," a cih ciangin Paul in a khut zanin a gen-inah:
"Agrippa Kumpipa aw, nangma mai-ah Judah mite in hong mawhsakna kiphelna thu, tuni-in gen thei ding ka hih ciangin ka nuam hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nang in Judah ngeina thu leh thu kidotna khempeuh na siam hi. Tua ahih ciangin dam takin ka thu na ngai ta in.
"Jerusalem khua sungah ka mipawlte lakah ka om lai takin, ka neu lai pan akipan ka omzia leh ka hihnate Judah mi khempeuh in a thei uh hi.
Judah ngeina tel takpi a zui pen pawl Farisai mi ka hihna hih mite in teci a pan' nop uh leh, a thei masa bel ahi uh hi.
Tu-in Pasian in i pute i pate kiangah a piak thu kiciamna lametna hanginah thukhenna thuakin ka om hi.
Judah mipawl sawm-le-nihte in sun leh zanin hahkatin Pasian bia-in, thu kiciamna bangin ngah ding a lamen uh hi. Kumpipa aw, hih lametna hangin Judah mite in hong mawhsak uh hi.
Pasian in misite a thokiksak ding hi cih thu up theih ding hilo hi ci-in bang hangin ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?
"Nazareth khua mi Zeisu' min langpanin ahi thei zahzaha sep ding mah hi ci-in ka kizo khin a,
Jerusalem khua-ah tua bangin ka hih zo hi. Siampi liante kiang pan thu ka ngah khit ciangin misiangthote thong sungah ka khia hi. Amaute in sihna a thuak uh ciangin ka thukim hi.
Mite in Pasian tungah a pau khialh nadingin thatang hat thu-in hanciamin, kikhopna inn khat pan khat ah tamveipi ka pai hi. Nakpi-in ka heh maninah gamdangte khua dongin amaute ka bawlsia hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin siampi liante thupiakna leh lai pua-in Damaskas khua lampi ka pai lai takin,
ni sangin a tangzaw, kei leh kei tawh hong paikhawmte kimkot ah hong taang, sun lai takin vantung pan khuavak khat ka mu hi, Kumpipa aw,
Kote khempeuh in lei tungah ka puk lai takun, 'Saul aw, Saul aw, bang hangin hong bawlsia na hi hiam? Ciang hiam na khe tawh peek leteh a haksa hi,' ci-in Hebru kamin a hong ci aw khat ka za hi.
'Topa aw, nang kua na hi hiam?' ci-in ka dot leh, 'Na hong bawlsiat Zeisu ka hi hi.
Ahih hangin tho in ding in, Judah mite leh Gentail mite khut sung pan nang hong gumkhia a, nang in na muhsa thute leh a nung ciangin kei in nang kiangah kong kilatsak ding thute,
hilh a, teci-a pang za-ah nang kong koih nadingin nang kiangah ka hong kilang zo hi.
Tua Gentailte in khuamial sung pan khuavak lamah galkah a, Satan' ukna pan Pasian kiangah kihei ding a, mawhna kimaisakna a ngah ding uh a, kei hong up manunah sian'thosakna a ngahsa mite tawh luahna a ngah khawm nadingun, amau mittang uh na hon'sak dingin, amau kiangah kong paisak ding hi,' ci-in thu hong pia hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Agrippa Kumpipa aw, vantung mangmuhna ngai loin ka om kei hi.
Amaute kisikkik a, kisikkikna tawh kilawm gamtatna bawlin Pasian kiangah a kihei na'ngun Damaskas khua-ah ka gen masak khit ciangin Jerusalem khua akipan Judah gamah a om mi khempeuh kiangah ahi zongin, Gentailte kiangah ahi zongin ka hilh hi.
Tua thu hangin Judah mite in biakna innpi sungah kei hong man uh a, hong thah nading uh a hahkat uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian kiang panin huhna ka ngah khit ciangin tuni dongin ka om a,
Khazih in sihna thuak ding a, sihna pan a thokik masabel ahih ciangin, Judah mipawl leh Gentailte kiangah khuavakna thu a piang ding hi ci-in Moses akipan Pasian' kamsangte' thugenna mah kei in behlap loin milian, mineute kiangah teci-in ka pang hi," a ci hi.
Tua mah bangin Paul in mawhna kiphelhna thu a gen lai takin Festas in, "Paul aw, nang mihai bang na hi hi! Lungpilna tam sinin, mihai na suak zo hi," ci-in nakpi-in a kiko hi.
Paul in, "Mangpa Festas aw, ka hai kei hi. Thuman leh sanhuai thute ka gen hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, kumpipa mai-ah ka gen ngam hih thute kumpipa in a thei hi. Hih thu a thei lo khat beek a om kei hi ci-in ka sin sungah ka um hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, hih thute a kilang lo-na munah kibawl ahi kei hi.
Kumpipa Agrippa aw, nang in kamsangte thu um na hi hiam? Na um cih ka thei hi," a ci hi.
Agrippa in, "Nang in zolna thu tawm tawh kei Christian nong suaksak dektak hi," ci-in Paul kiangah a ci hi.
Paul in, "Nang akipan tuni-in ka thu a za khempeuh in hih sikkol sim lohin, thu tam tawh ahi zongin, thu tawm tawh ahi zongin, kei tawh kibang na suah theih nadingun Pasian kiangah thu ka ngen hi!" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpipa leh Bernike, mangpipa leh amau tawh a tukhawmte a ding uh a,
a paikhiat khit uh ciangin, "Hih mi in sih nading ahi zongin, kikhum nading ahi zongin a bawl kei hi," ci-in khat leh khat a kikum uh hi.
Agrippa in, "Tua pa in, 'Kaisar kumpipa kiangah azu ka khan ding hi,' ci hi kei leh, a khah tuak hi," ci-in Festas kiangah a ci hi.
Italy gam teembaw-ah tuangin ka pai ding uh a kitel khit ciangin, Julias min nei Augustus pawl galkap mangpa' khut tungah Paul leh thong sunga kikhum midangte a pai uh hi.
Asia gam tuipi gei-ah a om khuate ah pai dinga kisa Adramittium teembaw tungah tuangin ka pai uh hi. Makedonia gam Thesalonika khua mi Aristarkhas kote tawh a omkhawm hi.
A zing ciangin Sidon khua ka tun' uh ciangin, ama lawmte kiangah pai-in an vakna a ngah theih nadingin Julias in Paul hehpihin thu a pia hi.

Kote ading Khazih' nasem muanhuai, ka it uh sila ka hih khawmpih uh Epafras in note hong hilh bangin, note in na zak uh Pasian' hehpihna a man taka na theih ni uh pana kipan tua nopna na ngah uh hi.

Ka thungetna un: note in gamtat hoihna apawlpawl ahi gah gahin, Pasian theihna pilna khan' tohna nei-in ahi zongin, lungdamna tawh na khempeuh thuakin lungduai nadingin ama minthan'na, vangliatna bangin,
thahatna tawh dimin ahi zongin Topa tawh a kilawmin gamta-in, na khempeuh ah a hong theihsak nadingin Pasian tawh kipawl theihna leh pilna apawlpawl tawh, ama deihna khempeuh na tel nadingun thu ka ngen uh hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua Tapa hangin Pasian in vantung ahi zongin, leitung ahi zongin-ah a om khempeuh a kimutheite, a kimu thei lote, kumpi tokhomte ahi zongin uknate ahi zongin, a sang belnate ahi zongin, vangliatna ahi zongin, na khempeuh a piangsak hi. Tua Tapa hangah ahi zongin, tua Tapa ading ahi zongin na khempeuh a piangsak hi.
Tapa in na khempeuh a pian' ma-in om a, amah hangin na khempeuh a kip hi.
Amah in pawlpi ahi, pumpi' lutang ahi hi. Na khempeuh ah amahmah a sangbel a suah nadingin a kipahtawi hi a, misite lakpan Ta upa a suak hi.

singlamteh tungah a buak sisan hangin gallemna piangsakin, leitung nate ahi zongin, vantung nate ahi zongin, na khempeuh in Tapa hangah Pasian tawh a kilem theih nading ahi zongin a deih hi.

Khazih hangin mi khempeuh in kicin'na ngahin mi khempeuh tungah pia dingin, kote in mi khempeuh phawksakin pilna apawlpawl tawh tai-in, hilhin Khazih' thu ka hilh uh hi.

Tua Khazih sungah pilna sum, theihna sum a om khempeuh kiseelin om hi.
Kuamah in kheemna kam tawh note hong kheem zawh loh nadingin hih thu ka hong gen hi.
Keima pumpi in note tawh kikhenin ka om hangin, ka lungsim note tawh omkhawm a, note in a ngeina bangin na bawl theihna uh ahi zongin, Khazih sungah upna kipin na om uh ahi zongin ka muh ciangin ka lung a dam hi.
Khazih thu zui lo mite' tangthu leh leitung thungeek zui-in, leitung pilna leh mawkna khempeuh hangin note kuamah in hong sut, hong bawlsiat theih loh nadingin kikem un.

Mawhna-ah ahi zongin, pumpi vunatna ngah lohna-ah ahi zongin si-in a om note, Khazih tawh kibangin hong hingsak a, eite khialhna khempeuh a hong maisak hi.
Eite lang khatah kilem lo-a a om ngeina tawh kipawl kiciamna lai sumangin, singlamteh tungah khen a, eite kikal sung pan a paaimang hi.

Tua ahih ciangin annek tuidawn ahi zongin, pawikham ni, kha det ni, Nipi ni tawh kipawl thute ahi zongin, note kuamah in kidongin thu kikhensak kei un.

Lutang suang loin, pumpi ci-le-sa tawh kipawl ama lungsim tawh kisathei mawkin, ama theih loh a muh loh thute kantelin lungsim kiniamsakna-ah ahi zongin, vantungmi biakna-ah ahi zongin, nuamsa-a a om mi khat nangawn note lungdamna kisutsak kei un.
