"Topa in na galte uh mai-ah note hong lel sak ding hi; amaute do dingin lam khatah na kuan ding uh a, amau mai-ah lam sagih ah na taikeek ding uh hi; leitung kumpi gamte khempeuh muhna ah note in a cikzet-huai na hi ding uh hi.
Note' luang hawmte in huih lak a, leeng vasate khempeuh leh leitunga ganhingte khempeuh' an hi ding hi; amaute a bengkhia ding mihing om lo ding hi.
Topa in note na damkik theih lohna uh Izipt meimatumte, leh meima daite leh meima lip neite leh cithak tawh note hong vatgawp ding hi.
Topa in haina leh mittawtna leh lungsim buaina tawh note hong vatgawp ding hi;
mittaw in khuamial lakah khua a zawt bangin sun-in khua na zawt ding uh a, na hihnate uhah na mavang kei ding uh hi; note hong kinengniamin na nate uh hong kisut niloh ding a, note hong huh ding kuamah om lo ding hi.
Zi dingin lawm khat na dong ding uh a, midang khat in na luppih ding hi; inn na lam ding uh a, tua sungah na teeng kei ding uh hi; leenggui lo na zuan ding uh a, a gah na khawm kei ding uh hi.
Na muh tangpi-un na bawngtal uh kigo ding a, a sa na ne kha kei ding uh hi; note' mai panin na la uh hong kingawh laksak ding a, note kiangah hong kipia kik lo ding hi; na tuute uh na galte uh tungah kipia ding a, note hong huh ding kuamah om lo ding hi.
Na theih nai loh uh minam khat in na leitang panun a gahte leh na nasepsa khempeuh uh netum ding hi; note hong kinengniamin hong kisugawp tawntung lel ding hi;
Topa in note na kidamsak kik theih loh ding uh a nasia meimatumte tawh na khukte leh na khete uh meimasak gawpin, na khenuai panun na luzang dong uhah na thuak ding uh hi.
"Note leh na pu na pate un a theih ngei nai loh minam khat kiangah Topa in note leh note tungah na koih uh na kumpipa hong tun'pih ding hi; tua lai-ah sing leh suang tawh a kibawl pasian dangte' na na sem ding uh hi.
Topa in note hong paikhiatpihna mite lakah a cikzet-huai, paunak, leh ciamnuihna na suak ding uh hi.
Khaici tampi lo-ah na tuh ding uh a, ahi zongin tawmno bek na khawm ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kauphe in nemang ding hi.
Note in leenggah lo zuanin na puah ding uh a, ahih hangin leenggahzu dawn loin, leenggah zong na ne kha kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh lung in tuate ne ding hi.
Na gam sung khempeuh uhah oliv kung na nei ding uh a, ahih hangin a thau tawh note na kizut kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh na oliv gahte uh pulh ding hi.
Tanute leh tapate na nei ding uh a, ahih hangin amaute in nomau' aa hi lo ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute galmat suak ding hi.
Na singte khempeuh uh leh na lei pan uh a, a gahte khempeuh kauphete in tang ding uh hi.
Note lakah a om peemta mite sang semsem ding uh a, note na niam semsem ding uh hi.
Amah in note tungah leitawi hong pia ding a, note in ama tungah leitawi na pia kei ding uh hi; amah a makai hi-in, note a nungzui na hi ding uh hi.
Amah in note hong piak ama thu piaknate leh thukhamte zui loin, Topa na Pasian uh thu mang lo na hih manun, note na siat matengun hih samsiatnate khempeuh note tungah hong tungin, note hong delhin hong pha ding uh hi.
Note leh na suan leh khate uh tungah a tawntungin tuate in lim leh nalamdang hi ding hi.
"Hih a tampi nate khempeuh om napi-in note in lungdamna leh lungsim kipahna tawh Topa note' Pasian nasem lo na hih manun,
Topa in note' langah a hong sawl ding na galte uh' na, gilkialna leh dangtakna, pum guak-a omna, leh na khempeuh kitangsapna tawh, na sem ding uh hi; na galte un note hong suksiat matengin note' ngawng ah sik hakkol hong thuah ding hi.
Topa in a gamlapi leimong panin muvanlai leng banga a manlang, amau' pau na theih loh uh minam, thukhualna a nei lo minam, khangham mite a zahtak lo, khangno mite tungah maipha zong a lak tuan lo minam khat, note' langkhatah hong paipih ding a,
note na siat matengun amaute in na ganhingnote uh leh na leitang panun a piang gahte hong neksak ding uh hi; amaute in note hong beisak matengun note adingin an, leenggahzu, ahih kei leh sathau, na ganhingte uh ahih kei leh na tuuhonnote uh zong hong nusiat lo ding uh hi.
Na gam sung uh a, a om na muan' uh a sang a muan' huai na kulhpite uh a cip khit dong matengin na khuapite khempeuh sungah amaute in note hong umcih ding uh hi; Topa na Pasian un note hong piaksa na gam sung khempeuh uhah a om na khuapite khempeuh sung uhah note hong umcih ding uh hi.
Hong umcihna leh na galte un hong lungkhamsak nading ahi na lungkhamna hun uhah Topa na Pasian un note a hong piaksa na sung panun a piang na tate, na tanute leh na tapate' sate na ne ding uh hi.
Note lakah a ngeksuak, a ci-thei pen mipa in a sanggampa, a it a zi, leh amah tawh a om a tate a nunung pen' tungah an pia nuam lo ding hi;
na khuapite khempeuh sung uhah hong umcihna leh na galte un note hong lungkhamsak nading lungkhamna hun sungah amah in bangmah nei nawn lo ahih manin ama nek a tate' sate kuamah hawm nuam lo ding hi.
Note lakah a om a ngeksuak, a ci-thei pen numei, amah ngek-in a ci neellua ahih manin a khenuai tawh lei sik ding a ngaihsun ngei vet lo nu in, a it a pasal, a tanu leh a tapa adingin, ama sung pana a piang a tate leh ama khe kikal-a a paikhia a nau-nungzuite phal lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh hong umcihna leh na galte un na khuapite uhah note hong lungkhamsak nading lungkhamna sungah bangmah neih lohna hangin amah in tuate nesim ding hi.
"Hih a minthang, zahtakhuai min, Topa na Pasian uh na kihtak theih nadingun hih laibu sunga kigelh hih thute lim takin zuih ding na ngaihsut kei uh leh,
Topa in note leh na suan na khakte uh tungah nasia-in sau vei a om gimna, gimna a tuandiak, leh a nasia, nat saute hong tungsak ding hi.
Amah in note' kihtak Izipt natnate note tungah hong tungsak kik ding hi; note tungah tuate hong belh ding hi.
Note na siat matengun hih thukham laibu sungah a kiciamteh lo natna leh gimna khempeuh zong, Topa in no tungah hong tung sak ding hi.
Note vantung aksite bangin a tam na hihna sung uhah tawmno bek na pha ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian uh thu na mang kei uh hi.
Topa in note tungah a hoih bawlna leh note tampi phasakna ah nuam a sak mah bangin, note tungah siatna tun'sakna leh note suksiatna ah zong Topa in nuamsa ding hi; a luah dingin na lutna uh leitang panin note hong kilakhia ding hi.
Topa in leimong khat panin mong khat, minamte' lakah note hong thehthang ding hi; tua lai-ah note leh na pu na pate un a theih nai loh sing leh suang tawh a kibawl pasian dangte' na na sem ding uh hi.
na nuntakna uh lunghimawh-in na om tawntung ding uh hi; sun leh zanin launa sungah na om ding uh a, nuntak lungmuan'na na nei kei ding uh hi.
Note na zinkik ngei nawn kei ding uh hi, ci-a kong ciam khualzinna, Izipt gamah teembaw tawh Topa in note hong paipih kik ding hi; tua lai-ah sila numei leh sila pasal dingin na galte uh tungah na kizuak ding uh a, ahih hangin kuamah in note hong lei lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Hihte, Horeb ah amaute tawh thuciamna a bawlsa ban-ah, Israel mite tawh Moab gamah thuciamna a bawl dingin Topa in Moses a sawl, a thuciamna kammalte ahi hi.
Kum sawmli sung gamlakah note hong makaih khin hi; note tung panin na puante uh sia nai lo a, na khe panun zong na khedapte uh sia nai lo hi;
Hih mun na tun' uh ciangin Heshbon kumpipa Sihon leh Bashan kumpipa Og, eite a do dingin hong kuankhia uh a, ahih hangin amaute i zo hi;
amaute' leitang i la a, Reuben mite, Gad mite, leh Manasseh minam a langte tungah luah dingin i pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin na hihna khempeuh uhah na daupai theih nadingun hih thuciamna kammalte khempeuh lim takin na zuih ding uh na ngaihsun ding uh hi.
Hih kiciamna note bek tawh a bawl hi lo a,
tu ni-in eite tawh Topa i Pasian' mai-ah a ding mite tawh a bawl mah bangin tu ni-in eite tawh a om nai lo i suan i khakte tawh zong a bawl ahi hi.
"Izipt gam i teen'na leh note in na nawk uh minamte lakah i paina na thei uh hi;
a muhdahhuai amau' na, sing leh suang a kibawl, ngun leh kham a kibawl, amaute lakah a om a milimte uh na mu khin uh hi.
Note lakah numei ahi a, pasal ahi a, innkuan ahi a, minam khat ahi zongin, tua minamte' pasian na a sem dingin Topa i Pasian kiang panin tu ni-in a lungsim a heikhia a om khak ding kidawm un; tua hi kei leh note lakah gu a nei gah kha a gah singkung hong bang ding a, hih kiciamna kammalte za napi-in a lungsim ah amah thupha kipia tawmin, 'Ka lungsim khauhna tawh ka gamta zongin ka suakta veve ding hi,' a ci hong om kha ding hi. Hih in mihoih leh misia, a kibangin phiatkhiatna hong suak sak ding hi.
Topa in amah maisak lo ding a, Topa' hehna tawh hazatna meikhu tua mipa' lang khatah khu zawin, hih laibu sunga kigelh samsiatnate ama tungah tung ding a, Topa in vantung nuai panin ama min phiat ding hi.
Topa in hih thukham laibu sunga a kigelh thuciam samsiatnate khempeuh tawh kizui-in gimna thuak dingin Israel minam khempeuh lak panin amah tengkhia ding hi.
Hong khang lai ding mi, note nungah hong piang na tate uh leh a gamla panin hong pai gamdang mi in tua gam in a gim ngahna leh Topa in a natsakna cinatnate a muh uh ciangin—
a gambup in kaat leh ci, leh nin a kangtum, khai kituh lo, bangmah po lo, lopa zong a po zawh lohna mun Sodom leh Gomorrah, Admah leh Zeboi-im bangin a kilawnthal gawp, a hehna leh a sinsona tawh Topa' lotgawpte tawh kibang hi, ci ding uh hi—
hi hi, minamte khempeuh in bang hangin Topa in hih bangin hih gam bawl ahi hiam? Hih hehna lian in bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?' ci ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin mite in, 'Amah in Izipt gam panin a paikhiatpih lai-in amaute tawh a bawl, a pu a pate uh Pasian ahi Topa' thuciamna amaute in nusia in,
a theih nai loh uh pasiante leh amah in amaute tungah a piak loh pasian dangte, na va semin a biakna hang uh ahi hi;
tua ahih ciangin a mite tungah Topa' hehna kitawh kuang a, hih laibu sunga om samsiatnate khempeuh hih leitang tungah tungsak hi;
Topa in hehna, sinsona, lungham mahmahna tawh a leitang panun amaute zunglot a, tu ni-a i muh bangin amaute gamdangah lawn hi,' ci ding uh hi.
"Topa i Pasian in hong lahkhiat loh thusim om a, ahih hangin hih thukham sunga thute khempeuh i zuih theih nadingin a hong lahkhiat thute, eite leh i suan i khakte' zuih tawntung ding ahi hi.
"Note mai-ah ka koih, na teel ding uh thupha leh samsiatna, hih nate khempeuh note tungah hong tungin, Topa in note hong hawlkhiatna minamte lakah hih thute phawk kikin,
Topa note' Pasian kiangah note leh na suan na khakte uh pai kikin, na lungsim khempeuh uh leh na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh tu ni-a note kong thupiak ahi ama thute na man' uh ciangin,
Topa na Pasian un note na ngei uh hong bangsak kikin, note tungah hehpihna hong nei ding a, Topa na Pasian un note hong thehthangna minamte' lak panin amah in note hong kaikhawm kik ding hi.
A kihawlkhia na mite uh vanmong pekah a om leh zong, Topa na Pasian un tua lai panin note hong khawmin, tua lai panin amah in hong paipih kik ding hi;
note in na neih theih nadingun, na pu na pate uh neih leitangah Topa na Pasian un hong paipih ding hi; na pu na pate uh sangin a ci-thei zaw a tam zaw-in amah in note hong bawl ding hi.
Note in na lungsim khempeuh uh leh na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh Topa na Pasian uh itin na hin' theih nadingun, Topa na Pasian un note leh na suan leh khakte uh tungah thuman' nopna lungsim hong guan ding hi.
Topa na Pasian un hih samsiatnate khempeuh, no hong bawlsia na galte uh leh na langte uh tungah tungsak ding hi.
Note in Topa' thu mang kikin, tu ni-a note kong piak ama thupiaknate khempeuh na zui ding uh hi.
Note in hih thukham laibu sunga kigelh ama thupiaknate leh ama thukhamte zuih ding ahi, Topa na Pasian uh thu na man' uh a, na lungsim khempeuh uh leh na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh Topa na Pasian uh lamah na kihei uh leh, Topa na Pasian un na sepna khempeuh uh, note' suan leh khakte, leh na ganhingte uh panin a piangte, leh na leitang panun a piang khempeuh ah nakpi takin hong daupai sak ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh na pu na pate uh tungah amah a lungkim mah bangin note tungah Topa hong lungkim kik ding a, note hong daupai sak kik ding hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh tu ni-a note kong piak hih thupiakna in note adingin a haksa lua hi lo a, na zuih lah ding uh zong hi lo hi.
Note in, 'Eite in a thu za-in i sep theih nadingin kua in vantungah eite adingin hong paisakin hong laksak ding ahi hiam?' na cih theih nadingun vantunga om hi lo hi.
Note in, 'Eite in a thu za-in i sep theih nadingin kua in tuipi gal khatah hong paisakin hong laksak ding ahi hiam?' na cih theih nadingun tuipi gal-a om zong hi lo hi.
A thu in hong nai mahmah hi; note in na zuih theih nadingun na kam sung uh leh na lungsim sung uhah om hi.
"Mu un, tu ni-in na teel dingun note mai-ah nuntakna leh hauhna, sihna leh siatna ka koih khin zo hi.
Topa na Pasian uh itna, ama lampite totna, ama thupiaknate leh ama thukhamte leh ama ngeina kipte zuihna tawh, tu ni-a no tungah kong piak ahi Topa na Pasian uh thupiaknate na man' uh leh, note nungta-in tampi na pha ding uh a, a luah dingin note na lutna uh leitang tungah Topa na Pasian un note thupha hong pia ding hi.
Ahih hangin na lungsim uh kihei-in, note in zui loin, pasian dangte bia ding leh a na sem dingin note hong kikaihkhiat leh,
tu ni-in note tungah hih thu kong gen hi, note na sia ding uh hi; Jordan kantanin note a lut ding leh a nei dingin na paina uh leitang tungah sau vei na nungta kei ding uh hi.
Tu ni-in note lang khat ah teci a pang dingin vantung leh leitung ka sam a, note mai-ah na teel dingun nuntakna leh sihna, thupha leh samsiatna ka koih hi; tua ahih ciangin note leh na suan leh khakte uh na hin' theih nadingun nuntakna teel un la,
Topa na Pasian uh itin, ama thu mangin, amah beel un; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in na pu na pate uh Abraham, Isaak, leh Jakob tungah piak dingin a kiciamsa leitangah note na teen' theih nadingun tua in note adingin nuntakna leh khan' sauna ahi hi," a ci hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Moses in Israelte khempeuh tungah hih thute a gen zom lai hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, "Tu ni-in kei kum za leh kum sawmnih ka pha hi; note kong mapi zo nawn kei hi. Topa in kei kiangah, 'Hih Jordan gal khatah na pai kei ding hi,' hong ci zo hi.
Topa na Pasian mahmah uh note' mai-ah hong galkah ding hi; note mai-ah hih minamte amah in susia ding a, note in amaute na suankhia ding uh hi; Topa' gensa bangin note' mai-ah Joshua hong galkah ding hi.
Topa in amaute a suksiat lai-a, Amor kumpi Sihon leh Og tung leh amau' leitang tungah a bawl bangin amaute tungah bawl ding hi.
Topa in note tungah amaute hong pia ding a, note kong piak thupiaknate khempeuh tawh kizui-in amaute tungah na bawl ding uh hi.
Thahat un la, hang un, lau kei un la, amaute kihta kei un: bang hang hiam cih leh note tawh hong paipa in Topa na Pasian uh ahi hi; note hong cimawhsak lo ding a, hong nusia lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in Joshua samin, Israelte khempeuh muhin ama kiangah, "Thahat in la, hang in; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute tungah piak dingin Topa in amau pute pate' tungah a ciamsa leitangah hih mite tawh na pai ding hi; nangmah in tua leitang amaute na ngah sak ding hi.
Na mai-ah a paipa in Topa ahi hi; amah in nang tawh hong om ding a, nang hong cimawhsak loin, zong hong nusia lo ding hi; lau kei in la, lungkia kei in," a ci hi.
Moses in hih thukham gelhin, Topa' thuciamna singkuang a pua Levi mi siampite leh Israel upate khempeuh tungah pia hi.
Moses in amaute thupia in, "Kum sagih a cin' sim, a kisehsa suahtak sakna hun, buk pawi hunin,
amah in a teelna mun Topa na Pasian uh mai-ah a kilaak dingin Israelte khempeuh a pai ciangin, amau' zakin Israelte khempeuh mai-ah hih thukham na sim ding uh hi.
Jordan gal khatah a luah dingin na paina gam uhah na nuntak lai tengun amaute in a thu za-in Topa na Pasian uh zahtak ding a theih nading, leh hih thukham thute khempeuh lim takin a sep theih nading, leh hih thu a thei nai lo amau' tate in Topa na Pasian uh zahtak ding a theih nadingun, numei, pasal, leh naupangte, leh na khuapite uh sunga om peemtate, mi khempeuh khawm un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, "En in, na sih ding hun hong nai ta hi; Joshua sam in la, amah ka sawl theih nading kikhopna buk sungah hong om un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Moses leh Joshua pai-in kikhopna buk sungah va om uh hi.
Tua ciangin meii khuam omna puanbuk sungah Topa kilang hi; meii khuam in puanbuk kong gei-ah ding hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, "En in, na pu na pate kiang a zuan ding na hi ta hi; nang' om nawn loh ciangin hih mite in a paina uh mite lakah a gam sung pasiante tawh paktat ding uh a, amaute in kei hong nusia in amaute tawh ka bawl ka thuciamna uh siasak ding uh hi.
Tua hun ciangin amaute tungah ka hehna so-in, amaute nusia-in ka mai ka seel ding a, amaute beimang ding uh hi; tua ni ciangin amaute in, 'Eite lakah i Pasian a om loh manin hih siatnate i tungah hong tung hilo ahi hiam? a cih theih nadingun amaute tungah siatna leh gimna tampi tung ding hi.
Amaute pasian dangte lamah kihei uh ahih manin amau' gamtatnasa siatnate khempeuh hangin tua hun ciangin ka mai ka seel taktak ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hih la gelh in la, Israel mite hilh in; hih la in kei' adingin Israel mite lang khatah teci ahih theih nadingin amaute tungah hih la hilh in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a pu a pate' uh tungah piak dinga ka kiciamna, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luan'na gamah amaute tunpih khinin, amaute in ne-in khamin a thau khit uh ciangin, pasian dangte lamah amaute kihei-in a na semin, kei hong simmawhin ka thuciamna siasak ding uh hi.
Siatna leh haksatnate amaute tungah a tun' ciangin hih la in teci-in amaute lang khatah pang ding hi (bang hang hiam cih leh a suan leh khakte un mangngilh lo ding uh hi); bang hang hiam cih leh piak dingin ka kiciam leitangah amaute ka paipih ma-in, amau' vaihawm kholh a ngimnate uh ka thei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua ni mahin Moses in hih la gelh a, Israel mite hilh hi.
Topa in Nun' tapa Joshua sawlin, "Thahat in la, hang in; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute piak dingin ka kiciam leitang tungah Israel mite na paipih ding hi; nang tawh kong om ding hi," a ci hi.
Moses in a bei dongin hih thukham kammalte laibu sunga gelh a man ciangin,
Moses in Topa' thuciamna singkuang a pua Levi mite thu pia a,
"Hih thukham laibu la un la, note lang khatah teci dingin a om theih nadingin Topa na Pasian uh thuciamna singkuang gei-ah koih un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a lehdo mite leh a lungkhauh mite na hihna uh ka thei hi; en un, note tawh kei a nungta khawm laipi mahin, tu ni-in Topa na lehdo khin uh hi; ka sih khit ciangin bangzah takin lehdo zawlai ding na hi uh hiam!
Hih thute amaute' bil-ah genin, amau' lang khatah teci a pang dingin vantung leh leitung ka sap theih nadingin na minam upate leh na uliante khempeuh uh kei kiangah hong khawm un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka sih khit ciangin note gamtat sia-in, note kong sawlna lampi panin na pial taktak ding lam uh ka thei hi; note' nasepna tawh amah hehsakin, Topa muhna ah a sia gamta ding na hih manun, hong pai ding hunte ah note tungah gimna hong tung ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin hih la malte a bei dongin Israel a kikhawm khempeuhte' zakin Moses in gen hi:
"Vantungte aw, ngai un, thu ka gen ding hi; ka thugente leitung in za hen.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa' min ka phat ding hi. Eite' Pasian a liatna gen un!
"Eite belh Suangpi, a nasepna kicing a, ama sepna khempeuh thumanna ahi hi. Thumanna nei-in, mawhna a nei lo Pasian hi a, amah thutangin thuman hi.
Amaute in ama tungah gamtat sia uh a, amaute' sitban'na hangin amaute in ama tate hi nawn lo uh hi; amaute in a lampial, lungsim kawi khang mite ahi uh hi.
A hai, ngaihsutna nei lo mite aw, tua bangin Topa thuk ding na hi uh hiam? Amah in, note a hong piangsak, note hong bawlin a hong kipsak, na Pa uh hilo ahi hiam?
A beisa hunte phawk un la, khang tampi hunte ngaihsun un; na pa dong in, hong lak ding hi; na upate dong in, hong gen ding uh hi.
Sang Penpa in minam dangte tungah amau' gamh pia a, mihingte a teen' nading mun a seh ciangin, Pasian in a phazah tawh kizui-in mite' gamgi a phut hi.
Ahi zongin Topa' tanh in ama mite hi a, Jakob suante pen a kipia ama luah ahi hi.
A bu a vil, a note tungah a kha a zap, a khate zakin, a note a man, a kha tawh a note a pua muvanlai bangin,
Topa bek mah in amaute makaih a, amaute kiangah gamdang pasian om lo hi.
Amah in leitung a sangna munte tungah amaute tuang sak a, amaute in gamlak pana piangte a ne uh hi; suangpi panin amaute khuaizu hup sakin, meisuang tawh kibang suang panin sathau a ne sak hi.
Bawnghon panin bawngnawi thaukhal, tuuhon panin tuunawi, tuunote leh tuutalte' thau tawh, Bashan bawng honte leh keelte, mangbuh hoihpente tawh leenggah tuisan na dawn uh hi.
"Israel mite thau mahmah uh a, a lehdo thei mi suak uh hi; note thau-in, lianpi pha-in, na zol uh hi; tua ciangin amaute a bawl Pasian amaute in nusia-in, amau' a Honkhiapa thusim lo uh hi.
Amaute in pasian dangte tawh ama hazat theih nadingin gamta uh a, a kihhuai gamtatnate tawh amaute in amah hehsak uh hi.
Amaute in pasian a hilo dawite, amau' theih ngei loh pasiante, hong suak nunung pasian thakte, na pu na pate' theih ngei lohte' tungah biakna pia uh hi.
Note a hong Honkhiapa na phawk kei uh a, note hong suaksak Pasian na mangngilh uh hi.
"Topa in tua thu thei a, a tapate leh a tanute in hehsak ahih manin tua ama tate a nolh hi.
Amah in, 'Amaute kiang panin ka mai ka seel ding a, amaute' tawpna bang hong hi hiam ka en ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in a lampial khang mite hi a, cihtakna a nei lo tate ahi uh hi.
Amaute in pasian a hilote tawh ka hazat nading hong bawl uh a, a milimte uh tawh kei hong hehsak uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin mi-a gentaak lote tawh amaute' hazat theih nading ka bawl ding hi. A hai minam khat tawh amaute ka hehsak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka hehna in mei tawh kuang a, Leinuai thukna mun dong kuang hi, leitung leh a tunga piangte kangtum a, mualte' bulpite' kuangsak hi.
"Amaute tungah siatna ka khol ding a, amaute tungah ka thaltangte ka zang ding hi;
gilkialna tawh amaute bei ding uh a, meikuang sa mahmah leh gu nei natna in amaute ne-tum ding hi; keimah in amaute a pet dingin ha hiam a nei gamsate, amaute a tu dingin gu a nei gulte ka sawl ding hi.
Namsau in amaute gamlakah susia in, inn sungah launa lianpi om ding a, tangval leh nungak, naungek nawi nete sam kangsate tawh susia khawm ding hi.
Keimah in, "Amaute gamlapi ah ka thehthang ding a, mite lakah amaute a kiphawkna ka beisak ding hi," ka ci thei ding hi,
amau' langte in ngaihsun khialin, amaute in, "Eite i gualzo hi, Topa in hihte khempeuh bawl lo hi," hong ci kha ding uh ahih manin galte' hong phin ding ka lau hi,' a ci hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in ngaihsutna a nei lo minam hi a, amaute sungah thu theihtelna om lo hi.
Amaute pil hi leh, hih thu theitel ding uh a, amau' thu tawpna mu ding uh hi!
Amau a Honkhiapa in amaute zuakin, Topa in amaute a piak khiat kei buang leh bangci-in mi khat in mi tulkhat delh mangin, mi nih in mi tulsawm do zo ding ahi hiam?
Bang hang hiam cih leh i galte' suangpi in eite' Suangpi bang hi lo a, i galte thungetna a mawkna ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amau' leenggui in Sodom leenggui pan leh Gomorrah lote panin hong pai ahi hi; amau' leenggahte in gu a nei leenggah hi a, amau' leenggah bawkte a kha hi;
amau' leenggahzu in gulpi gu leh a gu-pha gulgu nei' gu ahi hi.
"Hihte kei kiangah kikholin, ka van koihna sungah kisincip hilo ahi hiam?
Phulakna leh thukkikna kei' aa ahi hi, a hun ciangin amaute puk ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amau' gim ngah hun ding hong nai a, amau' siat nading hong tung pah hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute' vang a beina leh sila leh sila a hilote' a beina a muh ciangin Topa in a mite' dikna kilangsak ding a, ama nasemte tungah hehpihna nei ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, 'Amau' pasiante, a bukna uh suangpi,
amaute' biak piakna thau ne-in, leenggahzu tawh a biakna uh a dawnte koi-ah om ahi hiam? amaute thosakin note kihuh sak un la, amaute na kidalna uh hi sak un!
"Tu-in thei un, Keimah a kicipa in Kei ka hi hi, Kei sim loh pasian dang om lo hi; ka that a, ka nungta sak hi; ka liam sak a, ka dam sak hi; ka khut sung pan a honkhia zo kuamah om lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh vantung lamah ka khutte laamto-in ka kiciam a, Keimah in a nungta tawntung ka hih mah bangin,
a tee ka namsau taatin, thukhen ka kipat ciangin, ka galte tungah phu ka la ding a, kei hong mudahte ka thukkik ding hi.
Ka thaltangte si ka tawksak ding a, ka namsau in mi that ding hi—a kithatte leh a kimante, kei hong langpangte, si ding hi,' a ci hi.
Minamte aw Topa' mite tawh lungdam khawm un! bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a nasemte' phu la a, a langte thukin, ama mite' gam adingin kilemna bawl hi," a ci hi.
Moses hong pai-in, mite' zakin amah leh Nun' tapa Joshua in hih la malte khempeuh sut hi.
Moses in Israelte khempeuh tungah hih thute a gen a man ciangin,
amaute kiangah, "Hih thu khempeuh lim takin a hih theih nadingun na tate uh tungah na hilh theih nadingun, tu ni-a note tungah kong piak thu khempeuh na lungsim uhah koih un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh hih in note adingin a thuneu hi loin, note' nuntakna hi a, a luah dingin Jordan gal khatah na paina gam sung uhah hih thu tawh sau veipi na hing ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ni mahmahin Topa in Moses kiangah,
Jerikho gal lam, Moab sungah a om Nebo Mual, hih Abarim mual tungah kahto in; a neih dingun Israel mite tungah ka piak Kanaan gam en in;
Hor Mual tungah na sanggampa Aaron si-in a mite kiangah a kigawm bangin, na kah tohna mual tungah si in la, na mite kiangah kigawm in;
bang hang hiam cih leh Zin gamlak, Kadesh khua gei-a Meribah tui phual, Israel mite lakah keimah nong upna na siasak hi; Israel mite lakah a siangtho-in kei nong zahtak kei hi.
Tua ahih manin na mai-ah a om gam a gal panin na mu ding hi; ahih hangin Israel mite ka piak gam sungah nang na lut kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Hih in, Pasian mi Moses in ama sih ma-in Israel mite thupha a piakna ahi hi.
Amah in, "Sinai panin Topa hong pai a, Seir panin eite ading hong suakkhia hi; Paran Mual panin hong taangkhia a, a taklam khutah meikuang tawi-in, misiangtho tul sawmte kiang panin hong pai hi.
Hi taktak hi, amah in a mite it a, ama tungah a ki-ap mite khempeuh a khut sungah om hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute in na khephung ah hong kun uh a, nang tung panin lamlahna ngah uh hi.
Jakob mi honte' neih dingin Moses in kote tungah ngeina khat hong pia hi.
Mite' makaite kikhawmin, Israel minamte khempeuh a kikaihkhop ciangin, ama mi Israelte lakah Topa in kumpi suak hi.
"Reuben nungta-in, si kei hen la, ama mite zong mi tawm hi kei ta hen," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Judah thu genin: "Topa aw, Judah' aw ngai in la, a mite kiangah amah paipih in. Na khutte tawh ama ading do in la, a galte dona ah a huhpa hi in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Levi thu genin, "Levi tungah na Thummim pia in la, na mi a dikpa tungah na Urim pia in. Massah ah na ze-et mipa, Meribah tuite ah na kitotpihpa ahi hi;
a nu leh a pa sangin nang hong thupi ngaihsut zaw a, 'Amaute ka thupisim kei hi,' a ci pa ahi hi; amah in a sanggamte paai khia-in, a tate don lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in na thu mangin, na thuciamna zui uh hi.
Amaute in na ngeina kipte Jakob suante hilhin, na thukhamte Israel hilh ding uh hi; amaute in na mai-ah paknamtui hong koihin, na biakna tau tungah meihal biakna bup hong koih ding uh hi.
Topa aw, ama' nate tungah thupha pia in la, a khut tawh a nasepnate saang in; a galte' kawng su-tan in la, a din' kik nawn loh nadingun amah a mudahte sugawp in," a ci hi.
Benjamin thu genin, "Topa in a it mipa, ama kiangah nuam takin om hi; amah in sun tawntung kemin, a liang kikal-ah ama omna bawlsak hi," a ci hi.
Josef thu genin, "Topa in ama leitang tunga om vantung letsong hoih pente, leh nuai-a om a thuknate tawh,
ni hanga gah a hoihpente, leh kha hanga piang a hoihpente tawh,
taanglai mualte tunga piang a hoihpente, leh tawntung mualte' hauhna tawh,
leitung leh a tunga om letsong hoihpente, leh sawlbawk lakah a teengpa' maipha tawh thupha pia hen. Hihte, Josef tungah tung hen la, a sanggamte lakah ulian ahi mipa' lutungah tung hen.
A tacil bawngtal in minliatna nei a, a kite in gamsial kite ahi hi; amah in tuate tawh mite nawt ding a, lei mongdong ah amaute khempeuh phul ding hi; Efraim tul sawmte in tua bang hi a, Manasseh tul tampite in zong tua bang mah ahi hi," a ci hi.
Zebulun thu genin, "Zebulun aw, na paikhiatna ah lungdam in; Issakhar aw, na puanbukte sungah lungdam in.
Amaute in a mual uhah mite sam ding uh a, amaute in tua lai-ah biak piakna mante pia ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in tuipi tamna, leh sehnel sunga na manpha kiseelte ngah uh hi," a ci hi.
Gad thu genin, "Gad a lian-in a bawlpa in thupha ngah hen! Gad in humpinelkai bangin buk a, amah in a baan, leh a luzang balkham hi.
Amah in lei hoihpenna mun ama adingin teel hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a ukpa' tanh kikoihcing sak hi; mi makaite' ngahte mah amah zong kingahsak a, amah in Israel tawh Topa' thupiakna leh thuman khennate a sem hi," a ci hi.
Dan thu genin, "Dan in Bashan panin a diangkhia humpinelkai no ahi hi," a ci hi.
Naftali thu genin, "O Naftali, maipha tawh nuam a sa, Topa' thupha tawh a kidim, bual tui leh leitaw lam a neipa," a ci hi.
Asher thu genin, "Asher in tapa dangte sangin thupha ngahzaw hen; a sanggamte' pahtak hi hen la, a gam sungah oliv thau kidim ta hen.
Na khuapite, sik leh sumngo tawh kidal ding a, na nuntak lai teng na thahatna tua bang hi ding hi, a ci hi.
"Israel aw, nangmah huh dingin vantungah a tuang, a liatna tawh vanpi-ah a om, Pasian tawh a kibang kuamah dang om lo hi.
Tawntung Pasian in nangma omna hi a, nangmah huh dingin tawntung baante a om hi. Amah in na mai-ah galte nawhkhia-in, Susia un, ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin lungmuanna sungah Israel bek teeng hi, Jakob' suante bek, an leh leenggahzu gamah om hi; hi taktak hi, a vantungte in daitui hong khiatsuk hi.
Israel aw, mi nuamsa na hi hi. Nang hong kihuhna lum, leh na gualzawhna namsau ahi Topa in nang banga, a hotkhiat mi kua om ahi hiam? Na galte in hong mai-etin na kiangah hong pai ding uh a, amau' pumpi na tuancil ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses zanglei panin Jerikho gal Nebo Mual, Pisgah dawnah Moses paito hi. Tua ciangin Topa in gam khempeuh, Gilead gam Dan ciang dong,
Naftali gam khempeuh, Efraim leh Manasseh gam, Judah gam khempeuh Ni-tumna Tuipi dong,
Negeb gam, leh Zanglei zong, tua pen nisuh kung khuapi Jerikho kuam ahi, Zoar ciang dong, amah lak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa thugenna bangin Topa' nasem Moses pen Moab gamah si a,
Bethpeor gal khat, Moab gam kuamah amah kiphum hi; ahih hangin tuhun dongin amah a kiphumna mun kuamah in thei lo hi.
Israel mite Moab zanglei-ah ni sawmthum sung Moses hangin kap uh hi; tua khit ciangin Moses hangin kahna leh thuumna veng hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in, ama tungah a khut nga khin ahih manin Nun' tapa Joshua in lungsim pilna tawh kidim hi; tua ahih ciangin Israel mite in ama thu mangin, Topa in Moses a thupiakna bangin gamta uh hi.
Israel sungah Moses bangin Topa in maitang kimu-in a theih kamsang dang kuamah om lo hi.
Izipt gam sungah Faro leh a nasemte leh a gam khempeuh ah a hih dingin Topa in ama tungah a piak limte leh na lamdangte khempeuh,
leh Israelte khempeuh muhna ah Moses in a hih a lian vangliatna leh a lauhuai hihnate khempeuh a nei, amah tawh a kibang kuamah om lo hi.
Jerusalem khua sungah kumpi a sem, David' tapa Thugen Siampa' thugente;
Thugen Siampa in hih bangin ci hi: A mawknapi, a mawknapi, na khempeuh a mawknapi,
Gimpi-a nisa thuak-a nasepna-ah mihing in bang noptuamna ngah ahi hiam?
Khang khat bei-in khang khat hong khang a, ahi zongin leitung kibang bang niloh hi.
Ni hong suakin ni tum a, a suakkik dingin tumzel hi.
Leitaw lam-ah huih nungin, leilu lam-ah nung leuleu a, a zuihna ngei teng mah zui-in, nungnung niloh hi.
Lui khempeuh tuipi-in luangsuk a, ahi zongin tuipi dim nai lo hi; tuinak-ah tuite tung kik zelin, a nak panin hong luangsuk kik zel hi.
A omsa mah bangin hong piang kik ding a, a kisemsa bangin hong kisem kik ding hi. Leitungah a thak na khat beek om lo hi.
Hih in a thak ahi hi, a kici thei ding khat beek om lo hi. Eite' khan' ma-in, a omsa vive ahi hi.
A beisa nate kiphawk kha nawn lo a, hong tung lai ding thute zong a khang kikte in phawk nawn lo ding hi.
Thugen siampa keimah in Jerusalem khua-ah Israel kumpi ka hi ngei hi.
Hih leitungah a kisem na khempeuh en telin a thu kan ding ka ngaihsun hi. Pasian in tua bang nasep ei tungah hong guat pen a nuam het lo nasep khat ahi hi.
Leitungah a kisem khempeuh ka mu khin a, tuate khempeuh a mawknapi na hi a, huihpi nungdelh tawh kibang hi.
A kawisate kimamsak thei lo a, a om lopi a omin kiseh thei lo hi.
"Pilna sangpi ka nei a, keima mai-ah Jerusalem a uk midangte khempeuh sangin ka pilzaw hi; pilna leh theihna a kici khempeuh ka theih loh om lo hi," ka kici hi.
Pilna leh haina, theihna leh mawkna, a kilamdan'na ka zong hi. Ahi zongin tua bang ka hahkatna zong a mawknapi ahih lam ka phawk hi.
Pil semsem lehang kilunghimawh semsem a, tam thei semsem lehang hong gim sak semsem zawsop hi.
Lungdamna zongin, nuam ka sak bang bangin om ning, ci-in ka ngaihsun leuleu hi. Tua zong a mawknapi ahihna ka phawk zel hi.
Nuihna in haina ahihna, leh nopna in bangmah-a a kiman' lohna ka mukhia hi.
Na a lianpi tampi tak mah ka sem zo hi. Keima adingin inn tampi tak ka lam a, leenggui lo tampi tak mah ka nei hi.
Huan bawlin singno cin'na lo zong ka nei a, ka huan sungah nek theih namkim kidim hi.
Tua singnote tui piak nadingin tuikhukpi zong ka bawl hi.
Ka inn-ah a suak silate' ban-ah, sila a nu a pa-in tampi tak ka nei thuah hi; tuuhonte leh bawnghonte zong tampi tak ka nei a, Jerusalem a om ngei dangte khempeuh sangin ka hauzaw hi.
Ka zawhsa kumpite' sumkholna panin keima adingin ngun leh kham zong ka la hi. Ka lungnop nadingin la a sa ding lasiam numei leh pasal tampi ka nei a, zi zong ka deih zahzah ka nei zo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin keima hun ma-in Jerusalem-ah a om ngei mite khempeuh sangin ka lianzaw a, ka pilna zong bei tuan lo hi.
Ka deih khempeuh ka nei a, ka ut bang bangin omin ka gamta hi. Ka sepna khempeuh ah nuam ka sa hi; tua nopsakna in ka nasepna hangin ka phattuamna ahi hi.
Tua ciangin ka sepsa na khempeuh, leh tua banga haksapi-a ka sepnate ka ngaihsut kik ciangin, na khempeuh a mawknapi ahihna leh leitungah bangmah phattuamna a omlohna ka phawk hi.
A hi-in ci lehang, kumpi khat in ama ma-a kumpipa' hihsa teng mah a hih thei bek ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin pilna, haina, mawkna i cih in bang hiam, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.
Tua banga ka ngaihsut ciangin, khuavak in khuamial a zawh bangin, pilna in haina zawhna ahih lam ka mu hi.
Mipilte in a pai nading mun mu thei a, mihaite in a pai nading mun mu thei lo hi. Ahi zongin a pil leh a hai in a kibang khat a tuah tuak ding ka thei hi.
Tua ciangin, "Mihaite tungah a piang thu in kei tungah zong hong piang ding ahih manin, ka pil mahmah manin bang phattuamna ngah ka hi hiam?" ka ci a, "Bangmah ngah kei ing, themkhat zong ngah kei ing," ci-in ka kidawng hi.
Mihaite a kiphawkphawk loh mah bangin, mipilte zong kiphawkphawk tuan lo hi; mai lam hun-ah i vekpi-in hong kimangngilh lel ding hi. A pil a hai-in, i vekin i si ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hih leitunga sepna khempeuh in lungkhamna cih loh hong piak theih ding bangmah om lo ahih manin, hih leitunga hin'na in kei adingin bangmah akiman'na om lo hi. A mawknapi, huih hawm guak bek hi lel hi.
Keimah hong laih dingpa tungah ka neih ka lam khempeuh ka nusiat ding thei ka hih manin, nakpi tak-a sem-a ka gimpih nate in kei' adingin a phattuamna om lo hi.
Amah pil ta leh hai ta leh, ka pilna ka siamna khempeuh zang-a ka sepsa nate luahin a ukpa hi ding hi. Hih in a mawknapi taktak ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hih leitungah nakpi takin ka na sepna ka kisik hi.
Pilna, siamna, theihna siit loin na kisem a, themkhat zong a gimpih het lo mi khat' adingin nusiat ding hi zenzen hi. Hih thu in a man het lo, a mawknapi taktak ahi hi.
Mi khat in hih leitungah lunghimawhna thatang sanin na a sepna-ah bang phattuamna ngah ahi hiam?
Sepna bawlna khempeuh ah lungkhamna leh sinkhamna bekbek hi a, zan nangawnin ihmut mawhpih hi. Hih in a mawknapi taktak ahi hi.
Mihing khat in a nasepna thamanin an ne tui dawnin nuam sa-in a om sangin a hoihzaw bangmah dang om lo hi. Ahi zongin tua nangawn zong, Pasian' hang ahihna ka phawk hi.
Pasian kihel loin kua in an ne-in nuamsa thei ding ahi hiam?
Pasian in amah a lungdamsakte tungah pilna, theihna, leh lungdamna pia a, ahi zongin a hehpihhuai mi mawhte ahih leh a sep bek sisakin, amau' thalawhsa khempeuh, amah a lungdamsakte tungah piaksak hi. Hih in a mawknapi taktak, huihpi nung delh bang bek ahi hi.
Hih leitungah a piang thu khempeuh Pasian in ama pian' hun dinga a sehsa hunin a pian'sak ahi hi.
Suah hun om a, sih hun om hi. Suan hun om a, bawhkhiat hun om hi.
Gawh hun om a, khawi hun om hi. Phel hun om a, lam hun om hi.
Kah hun om a, nuih hun om hi. Dah hun om a, lam hun om hi.
Lupkhop hun om a, tuam lup hun om hi. Kikawi hun om a, kikhahkhiat hun om hi.
Zon' hun om a, mansuah hun om hi. Kep hun om a, paihkhiat hun om hi.
Balkeek hun om a, phop hun om hi. Daih hun om a, pau hun om hi.
It hun om a, muhdah hun om hi. Kido hun om a, kilem hun om hi.
Na a sem mipa in a sepna khempeuh thamanin bang ngah ahi hiam?
Pasian in eite' manlahpih dinga hong piak nasep ka thei hi.
Amah in na khempeuh ama hun tawh a kituak dingin bawl hi. Amah in mai lam thu theih nopna lungsim eite sungah hong guan' a, ahi zongin ama sepnate a cing-a theih zawh nading hong guan lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mihingte in a nuntak lai teng a siam tawp-un gamta-in lungdam-a a om ding a thupi pen ahihna ka phawk hi.
Eite khempeuh in an ne tui dawnin, i sepna thaman tawh lungdamin i om ding kilawm a, tua in Pasian' hong piak letsong ahi hi.
Pasian' sep khempeuh a kip tawntung ding ahihna ka thei hi; i behlap theih ding om lo a, i paihkhiat theih ding zong om lo hi. Amah i zahtak theih nadingin Pasian in tua bang ding mahin a bawl ahi hi.
A piang khat peuhpeuh pen a piang ngeisa mah na hi a, a piang lai ding khat peuhpeuh zong a piang ngeisa mah na hi lel hi. Pasian in ama hun hunin a piang ngeisa mah piang sak kik zelzel hi. Leitungah Thumanlohna
Tua tham loin, hih leitungah gitlohna in thuman thutang a suankhiatna zong ka mu hi.
Pasian in sepna bawlna leh na khempeuh ama hun ding sehkhol khin ahih manin, midikte leh migilote thu khen ding hi.
Mihingte pen ganhing bang lel ahihna uh a lahtel nadingin Pasian in mihingte ze-et hi, ci-in ka lungsimah ka ngaihsun hi.
A tawpna-ah ci lehang, mihingte leh ganhingte in a tuah ding uh kibang a, ganhing mah bangin mihing zong si hi. Mihing leh ganhing in a kibangin nuntakna hu nei a, mihing leh ganhing nuntakna a kiman'na bangmah om lo ahih manin, mihing in ganhing sangin a hoih zawkna bangmah om tuan lo hi.
A nih tuakin mun khatah tungkhawm ding uh a, leivui pan-a piang uh ahih mah bangin leivui mah suakkik ding uh hi.
Mihingte' kha van-ah kahtoin, ganhingte' kha lei-ah lutsuk hi, cih a thei zong kuamah om lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mihing in a sep thaman uh ne-in nuamsa-in a om ding uh a hoih pen ahihna ka phawk hi. Tua lo ahih theih ding uh bangmah dang om lo hi. I sih khit ciangin bang piang ding cih theih theihna om lo hi.
Leitungah thuman lo-a a kigamtatnate khempeuh ka ngaihsun kik leuleu hi. Nenniamna a thuak mite kap uh a, ahi zongin kuamah in amaute hehnem lo hi. A nengniam mite thahat lua uh ahih manin kuamah in thuk ngam lo hi.
A hing lai mite sangin a si khinsa mite hampha ka sa zaw hi.
Mihing-a hong piang nai lo, hih leitung gitlohna teng a mu nai lote hampha zawlai sawnsawn hi.
Mi khat leh khat, hauh nop man-a kidemna hangin nakpi-a na kisem ahihna ka mu hi. Hih zong a mawknapi hi a, huihpi nung delh mah tawh kibang bek hi.
Mihaite in na sem loin a khut zepin om uh a, a tawpna-ah gil kialin sih lawh uh hi.
Nakpi-in na sem a, a mawknapi ahi ding khut nih dim sangin, lungsim nuam-a khut khat dim neihna hoihzaw hi.
Nuntakna sungah a mawknapi ahi thudang khat ka mu leuleu hi.
Mi khat in a tapa ahi a, sanggam ahi zongin nei lo napi-in, a tawntungin nasemin a neihsa tawh lungkim hun nei thei lo hi. Kua adingin gimpi-in na sem a, a ut utin ta hoh lo ahi hiam? Hih in zong a mawknapi mah, a dahhuai nuntakna khat ahi hi.
Mi khat sangin mi nih hoihzaw hi; amau' sepna thaman ngah uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh khat cimawh leh a khat in huh a, mi khat guak pen cimawh zenzen leh a huh ding om lo ahih manin a dahhuai pha mahmah ahi hi.
Khua a dam ciangin mi nih lumkhawm leh khua lum hi; khat guak bangci khua lum thei ding ahi hiam?
Mi khat bek hi leh zawh nop kisa a, nih pha leh kizo zo lo hi. Zang thum-a kiheek khauhual bawhsat hak hi.
Mi' thugen a sang thei nawn lo, teek leh hai a thuah kumpipa sangin, zawng napi-in a pil tangval khat hoihzaw hi.
Mi khat pen thong panin suakta-in kumpi suak thei a, zawng napi-in ama gam sungah kumpi suak thei hi.
Hih leitungah a teeng mi khempeuh' thu ka ngaihsun a, tua mite lak panin kumpipa' za a luah ding khangno pawlkhat a omna ka phawk hi.
Kumpipa' uk mite sim zawh lohin tam a, ahi zongin amah a sih ciangin a nasepna hangin a lungdam khat beek om lo hi. Hih in a mawkna taktak, huihpi nung delh bang bek ahi hi.
Biakinn-ah na pai ciangin lim takin kingaihsun in. Aman leh aman lo a khen thei lo mihaite' biakpiaknate tawh a kibang piakna sangin thungai dingin biakinn-a paina hoihzaw hi.
Thu ngaihsun masa-in pau in la, Pasian' tungah thu mawkciam pak kei in. Vantungah Pasian om a, leitungah nang om na hih manin na pau dinga kilawm zah val pau kei in.
Na lunghimawh semsem leh na mang sia semsem ding a, tam pau semsem lecin na haina kilang semsem ding hi.
Pasian tungah thu na ciam ciangin manlangin tung sak pah in. Amah in mihaite dik sa lo hi. Na thuciamna bangin tung sak in.
Na thuciamna bangin na tunsak loh ding sangin thuciamna neih vet loh ding hoihzaw hi.
Pasian' siampipa' mai-ah ka khial kha hi ci-in na gen ding kisam kha ding ahih manin na kampauna hangin khial kha kei in. Tua bangin gamta kha lecin nangma tungah Pasian heh ding a, na sepsa khempeuh hong suksiatsak ding hi.
Mang tam man leeng a mawkna mah tam a, kam tam pau leeng zong a kituak mahin a mawkna thu mah kibeh laplap hi; bangbang ahi zongin Pasian zahtak lai veve in.
Kumpite in mizawngte gim ngah sakin, thuman thutangin na a kisep kei leh, lamdang sa kei in. Uliante pen amau' tunga uliante in en uh a, tuate tungah a en sawn a lianzaw khat om lai hi.
Gam khat peuhpeuh in a kumpipa in lokhawhna lamsang a lunghimawh kumpi kisam hi.
Sumdeihna lungsim na neih leh lungkim hun cih na nei ngei kei ding hi; na hauh nop hangin na deih khempeuh na ngah ngei kei ding hi; hih in a mawknapi ahi hi.
Hau semsem lecin na vak ding mi tam semsem a, hauzaw ing, ci-a na theih cih bek simloh bangmah phattuamna na ngah kei hi.
Na a sem mipa in a nek ding nei taleh nei takei leh lungnuam takin ihmu thei a, a haute ahih leh lungnuam takin ihmu thei lo uh hi.
A hoih het lo na khat hih leitungah ka mu hi: mite, amau' lunggim nadingin hau uh hi.
Na a sep khialh manin a neihsa teng uh suplawh uh a, a tu a tate' luah ding bangmah om nawn lo hi.
I nute' sung panin bangmah nei loin tangguakin i suah mah bangin tangguak mahin i ciahkik hi. I sepnate, i ciahpih kik theih bangmah om lo hi.
A dahhuai mahmah thu in: i suah hun lai-a mah bang tektekin i ciahkik ding hi; a mawknapi dinga i sepna-ah bang phattuamna ngah i hi hiam?
I nuntak sung teng lungzin'na, dahna, lunghimawhna, natna satna leh hehna bek tawh hun bei lel hi.
Keimah in ka phawk khiat thu in: Pasian in tomkha nuntak hih leitungah hong piak sungin, i sep thaman ne-in dawnin, nuamsa-in i om ding a hoihpen ahi hi. Hih in mihingte' thumong ahi hi.
Pasian in mi khat neih leh lam guan'in, a hauhna nuam takin a nek sak leh, amah lungdamin a sepna thaman ne-in a om ding ahi hi. Tua nopsakna in Pasian' kiang pan ahi hi.
Pasian in lungdamin om sak ahih manin a nuntak tom lam phawkin nei kha lo ding hi.
Hih leitunga mihingte tungah a man het lo-a hong kibawlna ka phawk hi.
Pasian in mi khatpeuh tungah neih leh lam, leh hauhna leh pahtawina pia-in, a deih khempeuh neisak napi-in, tua nate nuam takin zang sak loin, midang khat in nopsak lawh laizang hi. Hih in a mawknapi, a thuman het lo khat ahi hi.
Mi khat in ta zakhat nei-in, kum saupi zong nungta thei kha ding hi; bangzahin sauveipi a nungta ahi zongin leitungah nopsakna ngah loin, lim tak-a vuina a ngah kei leh, a sisa-a suak naungek hoihzaw lai hi.
A sisa-a suak naungek a kiman'na om lo hi; khuamial sungah suakin, khuamial sung mah-ah mangthangin kiphawk nawn lo hi.
Sun khuavak mu kha loin, nuntakna bangci hiam, cih a theih khak loh hangin tawlngakna a ngah hi buang hi.
Nuntakna-ah nopsakna a ngah lo mipa kum tulnih a hing zongin, a tawpna-ah a sisa-a suak naungek mah tawh a tun'na mun kibang lel hi.
Mihingte' nasepna in a nek tawm ding bek a ngaihsutna hi napi-in, a kham khop ngah zo tuan lo hi.
Tua ahih manin mihaipa sangin mipilpa a hamphat zawkna bang om tuan ahi hiam? Mihaipa in nuntak nading zia a theih hangin bang phatuam tuan ahi hiam?
Na dang dang deih thuah ngitngetna sangin i neihsa teng tawh lungkimna hoihzaw hi. Hih zong a mawknapi, huihpi nung delh mah tawh a kibang bek ahi hi.
A piang thu khempeuh, a tuaci ding mahin tangtawng-a kisehsa hi a, mi khat in amah sangin a thahatzaw khat a nial zawh lohna thu i vekpi-in i thei hi.
Sauvei kinial lehang a mawkna hi semsem a, a phattuamna bang om hiam?
Nilim bangin a pai hanhan, a mawknapi hih nuntak tom sungah mihing' ading a hoihpen kua in thei ding ahi hiam? Ama sih khit ciangin leitungah bang piang ding cih kua in gen thei ahi hiam?
A manpha paknamtui sangin minpha hoihzaw a, i suah ni sangin i sih ni hoihzaw hi.
Pawi simna sangin si galna hoihzaw hi; sih ding bek a ngak ahihna mihing khempeuh in a phawk ding kilawm hi.
Nuihna sangin dahna hoihzaw hi; na mai hong gumsak zah in na thu theihna hong khangsak hi.
Mipilte, dahna lakah om tual a, mihaite, nopna lakah om tual hi.
Mihaite in pahtawina la hong sak sangin, mipilte' hong taina hoihzaw hi.
Mihaite' nuihna in meikuang sunga selkeu kikhul a puak zaizai tawh kibang a, khiatna nei lo, a mawknapi ahi hi.
Mipil khat in midangte a khem ciangin, mihai bangin a gamta ahi hi. Sumgolh lakna in a lapa' gamtat hoihna siasak hi.
Na khatpeuh a kipatna sangin a tawpna hoihzaw a, kiphatsakna sangin lungduaina hoihzaw hi.
Heh pahpah kei in, hehna in haihuai hi.
"Bang hangin nidang lai-in hih sangin hoihzaw tham pek hiam?" ci-in dong kei in. Tua in pil thudotna hi lo hi.
Pilna in hauhna zahin hoih a, mihingte' adingin phattuamna ahi hi.
Sum in hong lungmuan'sak bangin pilna in zong hong lungmuang sak hi. Pilna a manphatna in a pilte a nuntaksak theihna ahi hi.
Pasian' sepsate ngaihsun dih in. Pasian in a kawi-a a bawlsate, kua in mamsak kik thei ahi hiam?
Nopna na ngah lai takin lungdam in; haksakna na tuah ciangin hih thu ngaihsun in: Lungdamna leh lungkhamna hong piapa in Pasian hi a, mai lam-ah bang piang ding cih kuamah in thei lo hi.
Ka nuntakna a mawknapi hi a, ahi zongin ka nuntak sungin thu khempeuh ka thei hi. Mi khat hoih napi-in si a, mi khat siahuai napi-in a khan'sau hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hoih lua kei in la, lah sia lua kei in. Bang hangin nang kisiasak tawm ding na hi hiam?
Gilo lua, hai lua kei in. Bang hangin khan'sih laizang ding na hi hiam?
A nih tuakin lenkip in. Pasian na zahtak nak leh, khatpeuhpeuh na zuihna-ah na ma vang ding hi.
Khuapi a uk mihing sawm sangin pilna in mi khat hatsak zaw hi.
A manin a gamta, a khial ngei het lo, leitungah mi khat zong om het lo hi.
Mi' gen khempeuh thudonin nei kei in; na nasempa' hong samsiatna na za kha ding hi.
Nang zong midang na samsiat zelzelna, tel takin na kithei hi.
Hihte khempeuh ka pilna tawh ka ze-et a, pil ding ka hahkat hangin kei' bat zawh ding hi lo hi.
Mihing nuntakna, kua in thei khia zo ding ahi hiam? Eite adingin thuk lua a, tel hak lua hi.
Keimah in, pilna siamna ka theih nading pilna mu-in, thupiangte a hang ka theih nadingin, nakpi takin hanciamin ka lungsim ka pia a, haina a hoihlohna leh a haihuaina ka thei khia hi.
Sihna sangin numei a siahuai zawkna ka theikhia hi. Ama hong piak itna in thang bangin hong tepcip a, ama hong kawina khut in sikkhau bangin hong hencip hi. Pasian' deihna banga gamtate in tua bang numei pel thei a, ahi zongin a mawh nuamte a thang ah awk uh hi.
Thugen siampa in hih bangin ci hi: Thu ka kankan ciangin, aban banin thu ka phawk khia hi.
A thudang ka zon'zon' hangin, bangmah ka mu zo tuan nawn kei hi. Pasal tulkhat sung panin khat bang a pil a om khak theihna, ahi zongin numei lakah a pil cih bang a om lohna, keimah in ka phawkkhia hi.
Keima theihkhiat thu in: Pasian in eite a thuman dingin hong bawl napi-in, eite in paulap tuamtuam zongin, i kikai-awk sak hi.
Mipilte bek in na akhiatna taktak theithei uh hi. Pilna in mipilte maitaisak a, a hehmai bei sak hi.
Kumpipa hong sawl bangin gamta in la, Pasian' tungah thu mawkciam pak kei in.
Kumpipa in a ut peuhpeuh hih thei ahih manin, ama kiang panin paikhia in la, ama lungkim lohna hih teitei kei in.
Kumpipa in aana neihna tawh gamta hi; ama gen bangin gamta in; kuamah in amah nial zo lo hi.
Ama thu a mangte in haksakna tuak kha lo ding hi; mipilte in a gamtat nading zia leh a hun hoih thei uh hi.
Na khatpeuh i hih ding ciangin a kilawm hun, leh a ngeina man om a, ahi zongin eite in bangmah i thei kei hi.
A hong piang ding thu i thei kei a, a hong gen thei zong kuamah om lo hi.
A sih ding a pelh thei, a sih ding hun a phiat thei kuamah om lo hi. Gal a om ciangin gal launa a pelh thei, siatna sungah a lut ciangin a peng thei kuamah om lo hi.
Leitunga gamtatnate ka ngaihsut ciangin, hih thute ka mukhia hi. Mi khat in midang tungah vangliatna nei-in, a uk sung mite a gimsak gawp hun om hi.
Migilote si-in kivui a, a siat gamtatna khua sunga mite mah in han panin a ciah ciangun amah a phat vevena uh ka mu hi.
A mawhte kidaantat pahpah lo ahih manin, mihingte in khialh ding haksa sa lo uh hi.
Mawhnei khat in zavei dong siatna bawl napi-in, a khan' sau veve hi. Ahi zongin, "Pasian a zahtakte adingin, thu khempeuh nuam ding hi.
Migilote' adingin, thu nuam lo ding a, amaute in Pasian zahtak lo uh ahih manin, a nuntak hun uh nilim bangin bei pak ding a, khan'sih ding uh hi," kici hi.
Ahi zongin hih thugenna a mawknapi ahi hi. Leitunga thupiangte ngaihsun dih in: khatveivei midikte' in migilote' daantuah ding teng tuak zawsop a, migilote in midikte' thaman ngah ding teng ngah zawsop uh hi. Hih thu in a hai vai, a mawkna taktak ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mihing in hih leitungah nuam a sak theih ding adang om lo ahih manin, an ne tui dawnin nuamsa-in a om ding bek ahi hi. Pasian in hih leitungah nuntak a piak sung teng, a sep thaman a ngah theih ding hih bek om hi.
Pil ding hahkatin, leitunga thupiangte ka theih ciangin, sun leh zanin ihmu lo liangin i om hangin,
Pasian' nasepna i theih zawh lohna ka phawk hi. Mihingte in bangzahin i hahkat hangin kithei khia zo lo hi. Mipilte in thei a kisak hangun, bangmah thei lo uh hi.
Nakpi takin sauveipi ngaihsun a, ka phawk thu in: mipilte leh midikte' gamtatna khempeuh Pasian in uk a, Pasian' itna hang hizaw hiam, a muhdahna hang hizaw hiam, kuamah in thei lo hi. Amau' mai lam thu khempeuh a mawkna hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khempeuh thumong kibang a, midikte leh migilote, mihoihte leh misiate, misiangte leh mininte, biakna piate leh a pia lote, a thu tawpna a vekpi-in kibang lel hi. Mawhneipa sangin mihoihpa hampha zaw tuan lo a, thuciamna a bawl lopa sangin a bawlpa hampha zaw tuan lo hi.
Mi khempeuh' thumong kibang kim a, hih thu in leitunga thupiang lakah a man het lo khat ahi hi. Mihingte a nuntak lai teng, gitlohna leh a mawkna thu tawh a lungsim uh kidim a, theih kholh lohin mihingte si pak uh hi.
Ahi zongin a hing laite' ading lametna om thei hi; a sisa humpinelkai sangin a hing lai ui hoihzaw hi.
A hing laite in a si ding ahih lam thei thei uh a, a sisate in bangmah thei nawn lo hi. A sisate in thaman bangmah nei nawn lo uh a, amaute kiphawk kha nawn lo hi.
Amau ading itna, muhdahna, hanciamna cihte om nawn lo a, leitunga om nate, khat beek thei kha kik nawn lo ding uh hi.
Na puante siangin paaksak tawntung in la, na sam gumsak ngei kei in.
Pasian in hih leitungah nang a hong piak, tomkha sung na nuntak lai teng, na it na zi tawh a nuam thei thei-in om in. Leitung lungkhamna sungah na lawhtak tua bek mah hi ding hi.
Na mai-ah sep ding a om khempeuh, na tha neihzah tawh sem in. Bang hang hiam cih leh, nangmah in na zuat ding sihna gam sungah, nasepna leh thungaihsutna, pilna leh theihna cihte om lo hi.
Hih leitungah ka phawk thudang khat in: a tai hat mite in tai kidemna-ah zo tawntung lo a, galhang thahatte in gal zo tawntung lo hi. A pilte in an a kham ngah tawntung lo a, a pilte hau tawntung lo hi. Hih theih siamna a neite milian suak tawntung lo hi. Mi khempeuh tungah kamsiatna vive tung hi.
Mihing in ama hun ding thei ngei lo hi. Thang-ah a awk vasate, ngen-ah a awk ngasate tawh i kibang hi. Lam-et loh hun laitak keekin, hun sia sungah mihingte i tung hi.
Thudang khat zong ka mukhia hi: Hih leitungah pilna a hoihna gentehna a hoih khat om hi.
Mi tawmno bek a omna khua khat om a, a vanglian kumpi khat in tua khua sim hi. Amah in tua khua umcihin, a khuasung luhgawp dingin ngaihsun hi.
Tua khua sungah azawng mipil khat om a, ama pilna tawh tua khua hu zo hi. Ahi zongin kuamah in tua mizawngpa phawk kha lo hi.
Thahatna sangin pilna hoihzaw ka ci a, ahi zongin kuamah in mizawngte a pil dingin ngaihsun lo a, mizawngte' thugen kuamah in thudonin nei lo hi.
Mihai hon lakah gam-ukpa in, thu a gen lualua sangin, mipilpa in dam taka a gen hiathiat ngaih huaizaw hi.
Galhiamte sangin pilna hoihzaw a, ahi zongin khialhna khat in a hoih tampi susia thei hi.
A sisa thote in paknamtui bung sunga om paknamtui uih sak thei a, haitatna themno khat in pilna lianpen susia thei hi.
Mipilte a man-a a gamtat ding a ngeina hi a, mihaite a sia-a gamtat ding a ngeina ahi hi.
Mihaite, lampi-ah a pai kawm nangawnin haitat uh a, a haina uh mi khempeuh theisak uh hi.
Nang tungah gam-ukpa a heh leh, na nasepna za taisan pah kei in. Dai tak-a om hithiatna in khialhna lianpi maisak thei hi.
Hih leitungah a thuman lo, gam-ukte' pian'sak ka muhte in:
Mihaite, za lianpi kipia a, mihaute kiniam koih suk hi.
Sakol tungah silate tuang a, miliante sila bangin a khe-un pai uh hi.
Gum a tote, gum sung mah-ah kia ding a, mi' phung a phelsakte, gul in tu ding hi.
Suang tokhiate, suang mah in liam sak ding a, sing-ekte, sing ehna mah-ah liam ding hi.
I hei mawl napi-in i tat kei leh, nakpi takin sat kul a, ngaihsut masak ding pil huaizaw hi.
Gul khiim thei napi-in i khiim kei leh, a kiman'na om tuan lo hi; gul in hong tu veve ding hi.
Mipilte' kampauna in pahtawina ngahsak a, mihaite' kampauna in amau mah siasak hi.
Thugen a kipatun bang tum lo tawh kipan pah malam uh a, gitloh hai vai teng tawh thugen khup lel uh hi.
Mihaite in thu gengenin ciakciak uh hi. Mai lam-a thupiang ding kuamah in thei lo a, i sih khit-a thupiang ding hong gen thei om lo hi.
A inn zuat nading lampi a thei lo mihai luate bek, a innlam zon'na in gim ding uh hi.
Thadah lua-a a inn vang nangawn a hu nuam lopa, a inn keh ding a, a innpi nangawn in puklawh ding hi.

Tui tungah na anlum khia in, ni tampi khit ciangin na mu kik ding hi.
Na neihsate, mun sagih ahi a, mun giat-ah ahi zongin khen kawikawi in. Hih leitungah bang thusia hong piang ding cih na thei khol kei hi.

Huih leh guah ngakin, khuahun hoih dong a ngak mi in, khaici tuh ngei lo ding a, an zong la ngei lo ding hi.

Zingsang-a kipan khaici tuh in la, nitak dong mateng khawl kei in. A vek-a a po kim ding ahi a, khat sia-in, khat a po ding ahi zongin, bangmah na theih kholh om lo hi.
Mi khat sau veipi a nuntak leh a nuntak sung nuam takin om ta hen. Sau veipi tak a hing zongin, a sih khit hun a sau vei zawkna phawk ta hen. Mai lam-ah a lam-ethuai bangmah a om kei hi.
Khangnote aw, na khangno uh nuam sa un la, na khangno lai-un lungdam un. Na hih nop peuhpeuh uh hih un la, na ut bang bangun gamta un. Ahi zongin na gamtatna uh tawh kizui-in, Pasian in thu hong khen ding lamtak phawk gige un.

keen sangte-ah pai ngam nawn loin, lam pai ding a haksat hun, na samte hong kang-in, na khangno thahatna teng bei ta-in, na tha a kiam hun ding ahi hi. Eite in i tawntung inn ding a zuan ding i hi a, khuasung lampi-ah kahna awging kiza ding hi.

Tua Pasian in a it a Tapa hanga eite hong hehpihna vangliatna a phate phat dinginah
Zeisu Khazih hangin ama tapa-za i ngah nadingin hong deih hong hehpihna hangin, amahmah adingin amasa-ah hong koih khol hi.
Pasian in a ngimsa bangin hih a, Khazih hanga a sepsawm a sehsa thuthuk eite hong thei sak hi.
A hun a kicin' cianga a sep ding Pasian' geelna in vantung leh leitungah a om na khempeuh gawmin Khazih uk sak ding ahi hi.
Ama deihna tawh kipawl hanciamna bangin tanglai peka eite hong ciamtehsa bangin eite in tua Khazih sungah luahna na i hi hi.
Tua bang ahihna in Khazih hanga a muang zo eite in a vangliatna phat dingte i suah na'ng hi.
Note in zong note hong gupna thu tawh kipawl Lungdamna Thu ahi thuman thutak ngai-in, tua Khazih na up khit uh ciangin thuciamna tawh kipawl Kha Siangtho-a ciamtehna na ngah zo uh hi.
Pasian' neihsa leh Pasian' vangliatna a phat nading deihna-in tua Kha Siangtho in tatkhiatna hun dong eite luahna maleep ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in Topa Zeisu upna leh misiangtho khempeuhte na itna uh thu ka theih khit ciangin,
note paulamin hehpihna ka phat niloh a, note ading thungenin ka om hi.
Ka thungetna in: eite Topa Zeisu Khazih' Pasian, vangliatna Pa in amah theihtel nadingin pilna ahi zongin, theih baihna lungsim ahi zongin hong piak nadingin,
hong sapna tawh kipawl lametna in bang ci bang lametna hi ahi zongin, misiangthote' neih Topa luahna vangliatna bangzaha lian ahi zongin,
eite tungah hong bawlpha a lian mahmah vangliatna bangzaha lian ahi zongin note in na theih nadingun, na pilna mittang uh a vak nadingin thu ka ngen hi.
Tua vangliatna in Khazih sihna pan a thawh sak kik ciangin Khazih tungah a bawl vangliatna ahi hi.
Na khempeuh a sang belna, ukna, vangliatna leh aana-a kipan tu laitak leitung bek hi lo, nung ciangin a piang ding leitungah a kisam a kiphuak min khempeuh tung, vantungah ama ziat lam a sang mahmah omna-ah a tu sak hi.

tua hun lai takin Khazih tawh kikhenin, Israel mi pawl hi loin, kiciamna a om thuciamna thute tawh kikum loin, lametna om loin, leitungah Pasian nei loin na om uh na ngaihsun ta un.

Hih lai-a kigen thu piangte pen India gam panin Ethiopia gam dong, gamneu za khat sawmnih-le-sagih a uk Ahasu-eras' hun lai-a piang thu ahi hi.
Hih hun lai takin kumpi khua ahi Susa khuapi sunga a kumpi tokhom tungah amah tu hi.
Ama uk a kum thumna kumin ama nuai-a a uliante khempeuh leh a nasemte' adingin pawi khat bawksak hi. Ama khut nuai-a om Persia leh Media galkapmangte leh ama nuai-a uliante leh a ma nuai-ah gam a uk sawnte a om lai takin,
a kumpi gam hauhna leh ama thupi ziazuana ni tampi sung, ni za leh ni sawmgiat sung tak lak hi.
Hih pawi hun a bei khit ciangin kumpi khua Susa khuapi sunga om mi lian mi neu mi khempeuh adingin kumpipa in pawi khat bawl hi; tua pawi pen kumpi inn huang sungah kibawl a, ni sagih kibawl hi.
Tua huang sungah suangkang khuamte kiphut a, khau malneu leh khau dupsan tawh ngun kualte ah kikhihin a kikhai dalna puan pakte kikhungin, suangmanpha a san, a dum, a kang, leh a vom, a nam tuamtuamte kizangin a kizeem suangphah kiphah tungah kham leh ngun kibawl lupnate kikoih hi.
Tua banah Kumpinu Vashti in zong numeite' adingin Kumpipa Ahasu-eras' inn sung mah-ah pawi khat bawl hi.
Ahih hangin Kumpinu Vashti in innsung mangte' thu puak kumpipa' sapna nial hi. Hih a nialna thu ah kumpipa heh mahmah a, a hehna hangin a sin sung so hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in upadi siam a mi pilte thu dong hi; bang hang hiam cih leh upadi leh biakna lam thu theite khempeuh thu dotpen kumpipa' zat ngei khat ahi hi;
ama gei nai pen ah a tu, hun omzia a thei, Persia leh Media gam ulian sagihte ahi Karshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, leh Memukante hi uh a, kumpipa kiangah a hawh thei, kumpi gam sungah ulian pente ahi uh hi.
"Innsung mangte' tung tawnin keimah Kumpi Ahasu-eras' thupiakna bangin gamta lo ahih manin Kumpinu Vashti tungah upadi tawh kizui-in bangci kihih ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa leh uliante' zakin Memukan in dawng a, "Kumpinu Vashti khial hi; kumpipa tung bek hi loin Kumpipa Ahasu-eras' ukna gam sung khempeuh a, om uliante leh mi khempeuh tungah zong a khial ahi hi.
Kumpinu' gamtatna thu numei khempeuh in thei ding uh a, hih thu hangin numeite in a pasalte uh simmawh ding uh hi; amaute in, 'Kumpipa Ahasu-eras in ama kiangah a pai dingin Kumpinu Vashti thu pia napi-in pai lo hi,' ci ding uh hi.
Hih banga kumpinu' gamtatna thu a za Persia leh Media gam numei liante in kumpipa nuai-a uliante tungah tu ni mahmah-in hih thu gen ding uh a, kisimmawhna leh kizahtak lohna tampi piangsak ding hi.
Kumpipa in hoih nasak leh, kumpi thupiakna khat paisak in la, Kumpipa Ahasu-eras' mai-ah Vashti a kilaak kik nawn loh nadingin a kikhel kik ngei nawn lo ding Persia mite leh Media mite' upadi sungah gelhsak in; tua ciangin amah sangin a kilawm zaw numei khat ama za luahsak in.
Tua banga kumpipa' thupiakna thu kumpigam sung khempeuh ah a kizak ciangin numei khempeuh in a neu a lian amau' pasal ciat zahtak ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Kumpipa leh uliante in hih ngaihsutna hoih sa uh a, Memukan' gen bangin kumpipa gamta hi.
Pasal khempeuh in ama innsung ukpa ahih nading leh ama kam a kizuih kim nadingin kumpipa' ukna gam khempeuh ah amau' lai ciat, leh mi khempeuh tungah amau' pau ciatin laikhakte kigelh hi.
Hih thu teng a pian' khit, Kumpipa Ahasu-eras' hehna a dam ciangin, amah in Vashti phawkin, Vashti' gamtatna leh amah tawh kisai-in a thupiakna zong thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa' nasemte in ama kiangah, "Kumpipa' adingin a meel hoih nungak khangnote zongsak in.
Kumpi khua ahi Susa khuapi-a numeite' omna-ah a meel hoih nungak khangno khempeuh hong paipih nadingun na ukna gam tuamtuam khempeuh ah uliante sawl in. Tua numeite pen numeite a uk, kumpipa' innsung mang Hegai' kep dingin ki-ap hen. Tua ciangin tua numeite tungah paknamtui tuamtuamte kiguan hen.
Tua sung panin kumpipa'deih pen nungak in Vashti' tangin kumpinu suak hen," a ci uh hi. Kumpipa in hih ngaihsutna hoih sa a, tua bangin gamta hi.
Tu-in kumpi khua Susa khuapi sungah Benjamin minam Kish, a tapa Shimei, a tapa Jair, a tapa Mordekai a kici Judah mi khat om hi.
Amah pen, Babilon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar in Jerusalem panin Judah kumpipa Jekoniah tawh a lak galmatte lak-a kihelte khat ahi hi.
Amah in a innlak pate khat tanu' a min masa Hadassah, a nung ciangin Esther a kici, khoi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a nu leh a pa om nawn lo hi; tua numei a meel hoih-in a ngaih bang mahmah khat hi a, a nu leh a pa a sih ciangin Mordekai in ama tanu dingin la hi.
Kumpipa' thupiakna kithei kimin, Hegai' kep dingin ap dingin kumpi khua Susa khuapi-ah numei tampi hong kipaipih ciangin, numeite a uk Hegai' tungah ap dingin kumpipa' innah Esther zong kipaipih hi.
Amah in tua nungak hoihsa-in pakta mahmah ahih manin paknamtuite leh a annek ding pia pah a, kumpipa inn sung panin a kiteel nasem numei sagih zong guan a, amah leh a nasem numeite tungah numeite' omna a hoih pen mun pia pah hi.
Mordekai in khaam ahih manin Esther in ama nam leh phung gen khia lo hi.
Esther bangci om a, ama tungah bang piang hiam cih a theih nadingin numeite' omna inntual mai-ah ni simin Mordekai va pai zel hi.
Numeite a kigin' kholh hun a vekpi-in kha sawm-le-nih sung hi a, sathau leh mirrah paknamtui tawh kha guk sung kipuahin, paknamtui tuamtuamte leh kipuahna dangte tawh kha guk sung mah kipuah uh hi.
Kigin' kholhna hun cing a, Kumpipa Ahasu-eras kiangah numeite a pai ciangin numeite' omna panin kumpipa' innah a deih peuhpeuh uh kikengsak hi.
Nitak-in kumpipa kiangah va pai a, a zingsang ciangin numeite' omna a mun dang khatah kiciahsak a, kumpipa' zineute a uk, kumpipa' innsung mang Sha-ashgaz in kem hi. Kumpipa in a deihkik kei leh kumpipa kiangah pai kik nawn lo hi; kumpipa in a deih leh a min-in kisam kik hi.
Mordekai in ama tanu dingin a lak a innlak pa Abihail' tanu Esther pen kumpipa kiangah a pai ding hun a tun ciangin, numeite a uk kumpipa' innsung mangpa Hegai' gen teng lo buang bangmah dang gen lo hi. Tu-in Esther a mu mi peuhmah in hoih sa kim hi.
Ama uk a kum sagihna, kha sawmna a hi Tebeth kha sungin kumpi inn sung Kumpi Ahasu-eras' kiangah Esther a kipaipih ciangin,
kumpipa in ama numei dangte khempeuh sangin it zaw a, a nungak dangte khempeuh sangin lim bawl zaw hi. Tua hi a, kumpi lukhu amah khusakin Vashti' taangin kumpinu suaksak hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Esther pahtawina-in ama uliante leh a nasemte khempeuh' adingin pawi lianpi khat bawl hi. Amah in ama ukna gam khempeuh ah tua ni nasep khawlin zum a khak nading uh zong thu zasak kim a, kumpipa' min tawh a kilawm a kituak letsongte zong hawmkhia hi.
Kumpipa' kongtual-ah Mordekai om hi;
ama hilhna tawh kizui-in Esther in ama minam ahi a, a innkuan ahi zongin pulak lo hi; Mordekai' kep sungin ama thu a man' mah bangin tu-in zong Mordekai' gen bangin gamta hi.
Ni khat, kongtualah Mordekai a om lai takin, kongcing ahi kumpipa' innsung mangte Bigthana leh Teresh heh uh a, Kumpipa Ahasu-eras thah ding sawm uh hi.
Hih thu Mordekai in phawkin Kumpinu Esther kiangah ko a, Esther in Mordekai' hong thupuak ci-in kumpipa kiangah gen sawn hi.
A thu kikanin a manna a kitheih ciangin khuampite tungah tua mi nihte gel kikhai lum hi. Hih thu piangte khempeuh kumpipa' theihin kumpi Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kiciamteh hi.
Hih thute khit ciangin Kumpipa Ahasu-eras in Agag-te beh Hammeda-tha' tapa Haman a za khangsak a, amah tawh a semkhawm ulian dangte khempeuh sangin a lianzaw-in bawl hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpi huang sunga om kumpipa' nasem khempeuh in Haman zahtak bawlin ama mai-ah kun uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua banga a hih ding uh kumpipa in thupia hi. Ahih hangin Mordekai in amah zahtakna limin a mai-ah kun lo hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa huang sunga om kumpipa' nasemte in Mordekai kiangah, "Bang hangin kumpipa' thupiak mang lo na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Ni simin amaute in Mordekai kiangah gengen uh a, ahih hangin amah in mang nuam lo hi; Judah mi ahihna thu amaute kiangah gen khin ahih manin tua banga ama nialna a kimang ding mah ahi hiam cih a theih nadingun Haman' kiangah a thu ko uh hi.
Ama mai-ah Mordekai a kun lohna, amah a zaktak bawl lohna a theih ciangin Haman nak heh mahmah hi.
Amah in Mordekai' mipihte a theih ciangin amah bek suk taak sa lo a, Ahasu-eras' kumpi gamsung khempeuh a, a om Judah mi khempeuh, Mordekai leh a minam buppi-in a suksiat theih nading lampi zong hi.
Kumpi Ahasu-eras' uk a kum sawm-le-nihna, kha masa pen ahi Nisan kha-a kipanin a ni ni a kha kha-in Pur a kici aisanna tawh Haman' muhin ai kisaan a, a kha sawm-le-nihna Adar kha a ni sawm-le-thum ni-in ai pha hi.
Tua ciangin Haman in Kumpipa Ahasu-eras' kiangah, "Na ukna gam tuamtuam sunga mite lakah a om kawikawi, amau a tuam om mi pawl khat om hi. Amau' ngeinate pen midangte' aa tawh kibang lo hi; amaute in nangma thukhamte zui lo uh hi. Tua ahih manin hih mite na hici khahkhong ding kilawm lo hi.
Kumpipa in hoih nasak leh amaute a kisuksiat nading thu pia-in lai-in gelh in; tua hi leh nangma sumkholna sungah koih dingin na khut nuai-a na uliante tungah ngun talen tul sawm ka pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in ama khut tung panin a min thuhna zungbuh suahin Judah mite' gal, Agag-te beh Hammedatha' tapa Haman tungah pia hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Haman kiangah, "Na sum cihte leh na mi cihte nangmah kong pia hi; na ut bangbangin bawl in," a ci hi.
A kha masa a ni sawm-le-thum ni-in kumpipa' lai-atte khempeuh kisam a, Haman' genna tawh kizui-in kumpipa' nuai-ah gam tampi a uk sawnte, gam khat a uk sawnte leh gam uk sawnte' khut nuai-ah a mi tuamtuamte lakah uliante tungah lai kipaisak hi. Gam khempeuh ah amau' lai ciat, mi khempeuh tungah amau' pau ciatin kigelh hi. Hih lai pen Kumpipa Ahasu-eras' min tawh kigelhin kumpipa' min thuhna zungbuh tawh min kithuh hi.
Tua bangin kumpipa' ukna gam khempeuh ah laitaite lai kipiasak a, Adar kha ahi a kha sawm-le-nihna a ni sawm-le-thum ni, ni khat sungin Judah mi a moi a ham, numei naupang, a vekpi-in susia-in, thatin, a beisak mang nading uh, leh a neihsate uh a laksak nadingun thu kipia hi.
Tua a ni seh ni-in amaute a baihsa-in a om theih nadingun hih thupiakna lai pen gam khempeuh ah dal khat ciat kipuakin tua thu pen a gamsung mi khempeuh tungah a kizasak kim ding ahi hi.
Mordekai in hih thu piang teng a theih ciangin a puan balkekin puanhampi silhin vut kibuak a, nakpi takin kap kawmin khua sungah vak kawikawi hi.
Puanhampi silh kawmin kongpi-ah kuamah kilutsak lo ahih manin kumpi inn kongpi panin a kimuhna mun ciangah pai hi.
Kumpipa' thupiakna a tun'na gam Judah mite' omna khempeuh ah nakpi tak-a thuumna leh tauna, an tan'na, kahna, leh dip humna om hi. Mi a tamzaw in puanhampi silhin vut lakah lum uh hi.
Esther' nasem numeite leh a innsung mangte hong pai-in ama kiangah tua thu a gen ciangin kumpinu in lamdangsa mahmah hi. A puanhampi a laih nadingin amah in Mordekai ading puante khak a, ahih hangin Mordekai in tuate na sang lo hi.
Tua ciangin Esther in ama na a sem dingin a kiseh, kumpipa' innsung mangte lak panin Hathak a kici mipa samin hih thu in bang hi a, bang a cih nopna hiam ci-in Mordekai tung panin thu a va kan dingin sawl hi.
Kumpi inn kongpi mai-a om khuapi kongzing tualpi-a om Mordekai kiangah Hathak va pai a,
Mordekai in ama tunga thu piangte khempeuh leh Judah mite sukmang nadingin kumpipa' sumkholna-ah Haman in piak ding a sum ciam zah thute khempeuh ama kiangah na gen hi.
Amaute a kisukmang nadingin Susa khua panin a kihawmkhia lai dal khat zong Mordekai in ama tungah pia a, amah in Esther tungah tua lai na pia-in a thu a na gentel nading leh, kumpipa kiangah Esther na pai-in ama mipihte adingin a na thuumsak ding zong sawl hi.
Hathak zong ciahin Mordekai' thugen teng Esther kiangah va gen hi.
Tua ciangin Esther in Hathak mah sawl kikin Mordekai tungah thu zasak a,
"Numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin sap lohpi-in mi khat peuhpeuh kumpipa' omna inn sungah a va lut leh upadi khat bek om a, tua in: thah ding ahi hi; kumpipa in ama lamah a kham kumpi ciangkhut a na zan leh tua mipa suakta bek ding ahihna thu kumpipa' nasemte leh ama ukna gam mi khempeuh in a theih ciat uh ahi hi. Tu-in kumpipa kiangah a pai dingin hong kisap loh zawh ni sawmthum bang pha ta hi," a ci hi.
Tua hi a, Esther' thugen teng Mordekai tungah gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin Mordekai in Esther a dawn' kikna thu amaute mah puasak a, "Kumpi inn sungah na omna hangin Judah mi khempeuh lak panin nang a suakta tuan dingin kingaihsun kei in.
Hih bang hunin bangmah hih lo-in na om cip leh, Judah mite' suahtak nading leh noptuam nading thu mun dang khat pan hong piang veve ding a, ahi zongin nangmah leh na innkuanpihte i si mang ding uh hi. Hih kumpi inn na tun'na pen hih bang hun-a mah dinga tung na hih mel zong kua'n thei ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Esther in Mordekai a dawn'na amaute puasak a,
"Pai-in Susa khua sunga om Judah mi khempeuh khawm in la, keimah ngaihsutna-in an na tang un; a sun a zan ci loin ni thum sung an ne lo, tui dawn loin na om un. No tan' mah bangin kei leh ka nasem numeite in zong ka na tang ding uh hi. Tua khit ciangin ngeina ahih loh hangin kumpipa kiangah ka va pai ding hi; ka sih leh zong a si ka hi ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Mordekai pai-in Esther' sawl bang teekteekin gamta hi.
A ni thum ni-in Esther in a kumpi puan silhin kumpipa' inntual sung nungah ding-in kumpi inn lam nga hi; kumpi inn sung a kumpi tokhom tungah kumpipa tu-in kongpi lam nga hi.
Inntual ah Kumpinu Esther ding-a om kumpipa in a muh ciangin Esther in kumpipa' maipha ngah a, kumpipa in a khut-a a tawi kham ciangkhut pen Esther' lamah zan hi. Tua ciangin Esther in hong naihin tua ciangkhut dawn va lawng hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Kumpinu Esther aw, bang thu ahi hiam? Kei tungah nong nget peuhpeuh, ka kumpi gam phel khat ciang dong, nang tungah hong kipia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Esther in, "Nong hehpih zawh leh, kumpipa' adinga kong bawlsak nitak an ne dingin tu ni-in Haman tawh hong pai un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Esther' deih bangin i gamtat theih nadingin manlangin Haman va sam un," a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Esther' bawlsa nitak an ne dingin kumpipa leh Haman hong pai uh hi.
Esther in dawngin, "Nang tung panin kong nget nop kong thum nop thu in:
"Topa aw, nong hehpih zawh a, na lung a kim a, kong nget thu nong piak zawh ding leh, note gel' adingin ka na bawl an ne dingin zing ciangin kumpipa leh Haman hong pai un. Zing ciangin nong cih bangin ka deihna kong gen ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin lungdam kipakin tua ni-in Haman ciah hi. Ahih hangin kongpi-a om Mordekai in amah zahtakna limin ama mai-ah ding lo, kun lo-a om a muh ciangin Mordekai tungah nakpi takin heh hi.
Ahi zongin Haman ki-iip tentanin innah ciah hi. Tua ciangin a lawmte leh a zi Zeresh sam a,
ama hauhna teng, a tapa neih teng, kumpipa in amah a pahtak manin a za khan' sakna teng, leh kumpipa' nasemte leh ulian dangte khempeuh sangin a lianzawin amah a koihna thute khempeuh amaute tungah gen in lak hi.
Tua ciangin Haman in, "Hih teng bek hi nai lo lai hi; Kumpinu Esther nangawn in ama bawlsa an kumpipa tawh a ne khawm dingin kei sim loh mi dang kuamah paisak lo hi. Zing ciangin zong kumpipa tawh kei hong sam khawm hi.
Ahi zongin kumpipa' kongpi-a tu Judah mi Mordekai ka muh lai teng hih thute khempeuh a mawkna suak zel hi," ci lai hi.
Tua ciangin a zi Zeresh leh a lawmte khempeuh in ama kiangah, "Pi sawmsagih-le-nga a sang khuam phutsak in la, tua tungah Mordekai a kikhai lup nadingin zing ciangin kumpipa kiangah gen in; tua ciangin nitak an ne dingin lungnuam takin kumpipa tawh pai in," a ci uh hi. Haman in hih ngaihsutna hoih sa a, a khuam phutsak hi.
Tua zan-in kumpipa ihmu thei lo a, nisim thupiang ciamtehna Khang Tangthu Laibu lasak a, ama zakin tua laibu kisim hi.
Tua banga kisim ciangin, kongcingte' sung panin innsung mang Bigthana leh Teresh in Kumpipa Ahasu-eras thah a sawmna thu pen Mordekai in a genna thu a kiciamtehna sim kha uh hi.
Tua thu a zak ciangin kumpipa in, "Hih thu hangin Mordekai' tungah pahtawina ahi a, minliatna ahi zongin bang kipia ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua lai-a a om kumpipa' nasemte in Mordekai tungah bangmah a kipiak lohna thu gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Hih kiim nai-ah kua om hiam?" a ci hi. Tua lai takin Mordekai thah nadingin a phuhsa khuam tungah Mordekai khai lup nading thu kumpipa kiangah a gen dingin kumpi huang sungah Haman hong tum hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa' nasemte in ama kiangah, "Hih lai-ah Haman om hi, inntual ah ding hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Amah hong tumsak un," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Haman hong tum a, kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Kumpipa in a pahtawi nop mipa tungah bang kihih leh hoih na sa hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ciangin Haman in a lungsimah ngaihsun a, "Kumpipa in kei sangin a pahtawi nop zawk ding kua om zenzen ding hiam?" ci-in ngaihsun hi.
Tua ahih manin Haman in kumpipa kiangah, "Kumpipa in a pahtawi nop mipa adingin
kumpipa mahmah in a silh kumpi puante, leh kumpipa a tuan'na sakol a lukhu tawh lasak in.
Tua ciangin kumpipa' ulian pen khat tungah tua kumpi puante leh sakol apsak in. Kumpipa in a pahtawi nop mipa pen amah zeemsak in la, tua ciangin khua sung kongzing lampi-ah sakol tungah a tuangsa-in na ulian penpa kaisak in la, ama mai-ah kiko sakin, 'Kumpipa in a pahtawi nop mipa tungah hih bangin kibawl ding hi,' cisak in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Haman kiangah, "Na cihsa bangin manlangin kumpi puante leh sakol la pah in la, kongpi-a om Judah mi Mordekai tungah hih thute khempeuh hih in. Na gensate khat beek siit kei in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Haman in kumpi puante leh sakol la-in Mordekai zeem a, khuapi sung kongzing lampi-ah amah tuangsakin, "Kumpipa in a pahtawi nop mipa tungah hih bangin kibawl ding hi," ci-in taangko hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa' kongpi-ah Mordekai ciahkik hi. Haman ahih leh kilukhuhsa-in a thuum kawmin a innah ciah pah vingveng hi.
Tua ciangin Haman in a zi Zeresh leh a lawmte khempeuh tungah ama tunga thu piang teng gen hi. Tua ciangin a zi Zeresh leh a lawmte in ama kiangah, "Tu-a na lelhtaak Mordekai in Judah mi ahih leh amah na zo kei ding a, amah in nang hong zo zaw ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua bangin Haman tawh amaute a kiho lai takin kumpipa' innsung mangte hong pai a, Esther' bawlsa nitak an ne dingin amah pai khiatpih pah uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kumpinu Esther tawh an ne dingin kumpipa leh Haman va pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpinu Esther in dawngin, "Kumpipa in nong hehpih zawh a, kumpipa in hoih nasak leh, kong nget kong thum nopna thu in keimah leh ka mite sihna tawh nong kipelhsak nading ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh kei leh ka mite suksiat ding, thah ding, beisak mang dingin hong kizuak hi. Kote, numei pasal a kibangin sal dingin hong kizuak hi leh bangmah ka pau kei ding hi; tua bang lel tawh kumpipa nawngkaisak taak lo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpipa Ahasu-eras in Kumpinu Esther' kiangah, "Hih banga gamtat ding a ngaihsun kua hi a, koi-ah om ahi hiam? a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Esther in, "Hong langpang ka galpa! Hih mi gilo Haman!" a ci hi. Tua lai takin kumpipa leh kumpinu' mai-ah cih nading thei loin Haman om hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa hehsa-in an nekna pan ding khia-in kumpi huan sungah pai hi. Ahi zongin Haman ahih leh tua lai mah-ah omin Kumpinu Esther in a nuntakna a suahtaksak nading thuum hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa in amah thah dingin a ngaihsutna lungsim thei hi.
Kumpi huan panin a annekna mun uhah kumpipa hong paikik ciangin Esther' tutna lamah Haman na awn phei-a om mu a, kumpipa in, "Ka inn sung ka muhna nangawn-ah hih mipa in kumpinu hih ding ahi hiam?" ci hi. Kumpipa in tua thu a cih phetin amaute in Haman' mai puan khuh uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa' na a sem innsung mangte lakah Harbona in, "Ni dangin kumpipa' na hoih takin a sem ngei Mordekai thah nadingin Haman mahmah in a phuhsak, pi sawmsagih-le-nga a sang khuam pen Haman' innah tu mah-in om hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Tua tungah amah khailum un," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Mordekai khailup nadingin a phuh khuam tungah Haman khai lum uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa' hehna dam hi.
Tua ni mahin Kumpipa Ahasu-eras in Judah mite' gal ahi Haman' neihsa khempeuh Kumpinu Esther tungah pia hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa' omna-ah Mordekai hong tung hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah tawh a kinaina zia, kumpipa kiangah Esther in gen hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Haman' tung panin a lakkiksa minthuhna zungbuh pen suahkhia-in Mordekai pia hi. Tua hi a, Haman' neihsa khempeuh a uk dingin Esther in Mordekai koih hi.
Kumpipa' mai-ah Esther khatvei va pai kikin khitui naptui tawh a khe mai-ah va puk a, Agag mi Haman' vaihawm siatna liante leh Judah mite a sawmna thu a kipelh kik theih nadingin va thuum hi.
Kumpipa in Esther lamah a kham ciangkhut na zan a,
tua ciangin Esther tho to-in kumpipa mai-ah ding-in, "Kei nong hehpih zawh a, hih ka ngaihsutna man nasak a, hoih nasak leh, na ukna gamsung khempeuh ah a om Judah mite thah nading a sawmna-in Agag-te beh Hammedatha' tapa Haman in a laigelhte dawhkik nadingin lai khat gelhsak in.
Ka mipihte tungah hih siatna liante a tung ka muh ding bangci thuak zawh ding ka hi hiam? Ahih kei leh ka innkuanpih tungah a tung hih siatna ka muh ding bangci thuak zawh ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpipa Ahasu-eras in Kumpinu Esther leh Judah mi Mordekai tungah, "Haman in Judah mite thah hong sawm ahih manin sing tungah amah kikhai lum khin a, Haman' neihsa khempeuh Esther tungah kong pia khin hi.
Kumpipa' min tawh kigelhin, kumpipa' minthuhna tawh a kithuh khinsa lai pen kidok kik thei nawn lo ahih manin, tu-in Judah mite tawh kisai-in hoih dinga na up bangin kumpipa' min tawh a dang thupiakna khat gelh in la, tua khit ciangin kumpipa' minthuhna zungbuh tawh thuh in," a ci hi.
