Tua ahih ciangin a kha thumna ahi Sivan kha a ni sawmnih-le-thum ni-in kumpipa' lai-atte kisam a, Mordekai' gen bang teekteekin Judah mite tung, leh India panin Ethiopia dong, gam za khat leh sawmnih-le-sagih a uk ahi gam tampi a ukte, gam khat a ukte leh tua gamsunga uliante tungah lai kihawm kik a, amau' lai ciat leh amau' pau ciatin kigelh hi; Judah mite' ading zong amau' lai leh amau pau mah-in kigelh hi.
Tua lai pen Kumpipa Ahasu-eras' minin kigelhin kumpipa' minthuhna zungbuh mah tawh kithuh a, kumpi sakol bukah a kikhawi kumpipa' sakolte tungah laitaite kituangsakin lai kihawmsak hi.
Tua thupiakna lai pen gam khempeuh ah kihawmin mi khempeuh kitheisakin, amau' galte a thukkik nading ahi tua ni tawh kisai-in Judah mite a kigin' kholh ding uh ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa' sakolte' tungah laitaite tuangin kumpipa' thu-kin sawl mah bangin nawh tai uh hi; tua ciangin Susa khuapi sungah zong tua thupiakna lai kihawm hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi puansan leh a kang silhin, kham tawh kibawl kumpi lukhu lianpi khu-in, saihadial puan neel leh puansan silhsa-in kumpipa' omna panin Mordekai paikhia hi; tua ciangin Susa khuapi sunga mi khempeuh lungdamin awng uh hi.
Tua hi a, Judah mite in suahtakna, lungdamna, leh pahtawina ngah uh hi.
Kumpipa' thupiakna a tun'na gam leh khua khempeuh ah Judah mite adingin lungdamna leh kipahna, pawi bawlna leh nasep khawlin zumkhakna om hi. Tua hi a, mite in Judah mite kihta uh ahih manin tua gam-a om mi tampi tak in Judah mi ka hi uh hi, ci uh hi.
A kha sawm-le-nihna ahi Adar kha a ni sawm-le-thum ni-in kumpipa' thupiakna bangin sepkhiat nading hun hong tung hi. Judah mite' galte in gualzo ding a, a ki-up ni teek pen amau a mudah mite' tungah Judah mite a gualzawh ni ding hong hi hi.
Tua ni-in amaute' siat nading a geelte a su dingin Kumpipa Ahasu-eras' ukna gam khempeuh-a amau' khuapite sungah Judah mite kikhawm uh hi. Mi khempeuh in Judah mite kihta uh ahih manin kuamah in Judah mite nang ngam lo uh hi.
Mordekai kihta uh ahih manin gam tampi a ukte leh gam khat a ukte leh gamsunga ulian tuamtuamte leh kumpi ulian khempeuh in Judah mite pan'pih uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh kumpi inn sungah Mordekai ulianpi khat suak a, a vangliatna a khan' semsem mah bangin gam khempeuh ah ama minthan'na kizel hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Judah mite in namsau tawh a galte uh tampi tak that lum uh a, amaute a mudahte a ut ut-un hih gawp uh hi.
Kumpi khua Susa khuapi sung mahmah-ah Judah mite in mi za nga thatin susia uh hi.
Kumpi khua Susa khuapi sunga a kithat zah tua ni mahmahin kumpipa kiangah kizasak hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Kumpinu Esther kiangah, "Kumpi khua Susa khuapi sungah Judah mite in mi za nga that uh a, Haman' tapa sawmte zong that uh hi. Ka ukna gam dangte sungah zong bangzah that ding kithei lo hi. Tu-in bang deih lai na hi hiam? Nong nget peuhpeuh hong kipia lai ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Esther in, "Kumpipa in hoih nasak leh, tu ni-a mah bangin zing ciang zong Susa khuapi sunga om Judah mite tungah hih theihna thupia in la, Haman' tapa sawmte' luanghawm khuam tungah khaisak in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin tua banga a hih nadingin kumpipa in sawl hi; Susa khuapi sungah hih thu suakkhiasak a, khuam tungah Haman' tapa sawmte kikhai hi.
Susa khuapi sunga om Judah mite Adar kha a ni sawm-le-li ni-in kikhawm kikin Susa khua sungah mi za thum that uh hi. Ahi zongin amaute' neihsate suksak lo uh hi.
Tua mah bangin kumpipa' ukna gam tuam tuam-a om Judah mite in zong amaute' galte panin a kihut nadingun kikhawm uh hi. Amau a mudah mihing tul sawmsagih leh tul nga thatin a galte uh tungah phu la uh hi. Ahih hangin a neihsate uh suksak lo uh hi.
Hih banga a hih pen Adar kha a ni sawm-le-thum ni hi a, a ni sawm-le-li ni-in tawlnga uh a, pawi bawlin lungdamin om uh hi.
Ahih hangin Susa khua sunga om Judah mite in ahih leh a ni sawm-le-thum leh sawm-le-li ni-in kikaikhawm uh a, a ni sawm-le-nga ni tawlnga uh a, pawi bawlin lungdamin om uh hi.
Hih thu hangin gam sung khuaneute-a teeng Judah mite in Adar kha a ni sawm-le-li ni pawibawlna leh lungdam ni dingin tawlngak ni-in nei uh a, anlimnono kikholhna ni-in zang uh hi.
Tua ciangin Mordekai in hih thupiangte khempeuh lai-in ciamteh a, a nai a gamla-a om Kumpipa Ahasu-eras' ukna gamsung khempeuh a, om Judah mite tungah lai paisak hi.
A kum kumin Adar kha ni sawm-le-li ni leh sawm-le-nga ni a tan' nadingun thupia hi.
Tua nite pen Judah mite a galte uh tung panin a suahtak ni, dahna leh thuumnate lungdamna leh lungnopna a suah kha ahi hi. Tua ahih manin amaute in pawi bawl ni leh lungdam ni-in nei-in, anlimnono khat leh khat kikholh ni leh mi zawngte tungah letsong piak ni-in a zat dingun thupia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Mordekai' laigelhna tawh kizui-in Judah mite in a patsa uh hih banga a hihnate uh zom uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Judah mi khempeuh' gal ahi, Hammedatha' tapa' Agag-te beh Haman in Judah mite sugawpin a suksiat nadingin Pur kici ai saan-in Judah mite suksiat ding sawm hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in hih thu a theih ciangin, Judah mite suk nadingin Haman in a geelsa thuhoih lopen Haman' lutung mah a lehtuk nading, leh amah leh a tapate khuam tungah a kikhai nading lai-in gelhin thupia hi.
Judah mite amau mahmah, leh a suan a khakte uh, leh amau a pawlpih khempeuh in lai sunga kigelh bangin a kiseh hunin kum simin hih ni nihte peel loin a tan' nading uh kipsak uh a,
a khang khangin innkuan sim, gam sim, khuapi simah hih nite kiphawkin a kitan' nading leh Judah mite lakah hih Purim nite a kitan' ngitnget nading ahi a, a suan-le-khakte un zong hih thu a mangngilh ngei het loh nading uh ahi zongin kho takin len uh hi.
Tua ciangin Abihail' tanu Kumpinu Esther in Purim thu tawh kisai hih laikhak nihna a kipsak nadingin Judah mi Mordekai tungah aana a kicingin a piakna, lai-in gelh hi.
Kumpi Ahasu-eras' ukna gam za leh sawmnih sagih sungah a om Judah mite khempeuh tungah kilemna leh nopna a om nading deihsakna laite kikhak a,
Judah mi Mordekai in a gelhsa bang, a kisehsa bangin hih Purim nite a tan' nadingun thu kipia hi. Tua mah bangin amaute leh a suan-le-khakte uh adingin an tan' nading leh thuumna bawl nading ngeinate gelh uh hi.
Kumpinu Esther' thupiakna in hih Purim bawl nading ngeinate kipsak a, lai thupite sungah hih thu kiciamteh hi.
Kumpipa Ahasu-eras in a ukna gam leitung leh tuikulh tunga teengte tung panin siah kai hi.
Ama vangliatna leh a thahatna tawh a sepnate khempeuh, leh Mordekai tungah a piak minphatnate, Media leh Persia Kumpite' Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Kumpipa Ahasu-eras' zomah Mordekai in a za lianpen nihna ahi hi; Mordekai in ama mite' phattuam nading leh a suan-le-khakte uh a khan'toh nading hanciam ahih manin Judah mite lakah milian khat hi a, a gam mihonpite in it kim uh hi.
Jakob tawh Izipt-ah a hong pai, amau' innkuan ciat tawh ahi, Israel' tapate' minte in:
Reuben, Simeon, Levi, leh Judah,
Issakhar, Zebulun, leh Benjamin,
Dan leh Naftali, Gad leh Asher ahi hi.
Jakob' suan-le-khakte khempeuh mihing sawmsagih ahi hi; Josef pen Izipt-ah na om khin zo hi.
Tua ciangin Josef leh a sanggamte leh tua khang mi khempeuh si uh hi.
Ahih hangin Israel suan-le-khakte pung-in nakpi takin khang uh hi; amaute tampi pha-in nakpi takin a vangliatna uh khang hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute tua gamah dim uh hi.
Tu-in Josef a thei lo kumpi thak khat Izipt gamah hong khang hi.
Amah in a mihingte' kiangah, "En un, Israel mite eite' adingin tam lua-in thahat lua uh hi.
Hong pai un, amaute hong tam kha ding uh ahih manin ngaihsut siamna tawh amaute hih ni, eite' tungah gal hong om leh amaute in i galte pawlin eite hong do-in hih gam panin taikhia kha ding uh hi," ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute nasepna tawh a gimsak dingin amaute' tungah nasem ukte koih uh hi; amaute in Faro' adingin vankoihna Pithom leh Ra-amses khuapite lam uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute a kinenniam ciangin amaute tampi pha zaw-in kizelhthang zaw uh hi. Izipt mite in Israel mite kihta uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Israel mite gim mahmahin nasemsak uh a,
buan leh leiseek tawh a haksa nasepna leh lo sungah nasep namkim khempeuh tawh amau' nuntakna haksasak uh hi; amaute' sepna khempeuhah amaute in gim mahmahin semsak uh hi.
Tua ciangin Izipt kumpipa in khat' min in Shifrah kici-in a dang khat min in Puah a kiciHebru mi naudomte' kiangah,
"Hebru numeite nau domin, nausuahna tutphah tungah a tu na muh uh ciangun, tapa ahih leh a naungek na that ding uh hi; ahih hangin tanu ahih leh na nungtasak ding uh hi," ci hi.
Ahih hangin naudomte in Pasian zahtak uh a, Izipt kumpipa in amaute a thupiak bangin gamta lo uh hi, nau pasalte nungtasak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Izipt kumpipa in naudomte sam in, amaute' kiangah, "Bang hangin hih bangin gamta-in, nau pasalte nungtasak na hi uh hiam?" ci hi.
Naudomte in Faro' kiangah, "Hebru numeite in Izipt numeite tawh a kibat loh hang ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute thadim uh a, amau' kiangah naudomte a tun' ma-in amaute na suak khin pahpah uh hi," ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian in naudomte lim bawl hi; mite khangin a thahatna uh khang hi.
Naudomte in Pasian zahtak ahih manin amah in amaute' tungah suan-le-khak a pia hi.
Tua ciangin Faro in ama' mihing khempeuh thupia a, "Hebru mite sung panin tapa a suak khempeuh Nail gun sungah na khia ding uh a, ahih hangin tanu khempeuh na nungtasak ding uh hi," ci hi.
Tu-in Levi' suan-le-khakte khat in Levi numei khat zi-in la hi.
Numei gai-in tapa khat nei hi; amah in nau hoih khat hi ci-in a muh ciangin, kha thum sung seel hi.
Amah in naungek a seel zawh nawn loh ciangin ama adingin pumpeng tawh kibawl lawh khat phansak a, tua lawh pen buan leh kultal tui tawh zut hi; amah in tua sungah naungek sialin gun gei-a phaikungte' lakah koih hi.
Amah bang a kicih hiam cih a thei dingin a gamla mun khatah a sanggamnu ding hi.
Tu-in Faro' tanu kisil dingin gun-ah hong pai a, a numei-nasemte gun gei-ah pai uh hi; amah in phaikungte' lakah a lawh mu a, tua lawh la dingin a numei-nasem sawl hi.
Amah in a hon' ciangin naungek mu hi; en in, naungek kap hi. Tua nu in amah hehpih a, "Hih in Hebru mite' ta khat ahi hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin a sanggamnu in Faro' tanu' kiangah, "Keimah pai-in Hebru numeite' lak panin nang adingin naupang hong khoisak dingin naucing khat ka va sapsak ding hiam?" ci hi.
Faro' tanu in ama' kiangah, "Pai in," ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin numeino pai-in naupang' nu va sam hi.
Faro' tanu in ama' kiangah, "Hih naupang la in la, kei adingin hong khoisak in, na thaman kong pia ding hi," ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin nupi in naupang la-in khoi hi.
Naupang khang a, amah in Faro' tanu' kiangah paipih a, amah in tua nu' tapa suak hi; amah in a min Moses phuak hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, "Tui sung panin amah ka kaikhia hi," ci hi.
Ni khat, Moses a khan' khit ciangin, ama' mipihte' kiangah pai-in amau' nasep haksatnate mu hi; Izipt mi khat in ama' mipihte khat ahi Hebru mi khat a sat mu hi.
Amah khuadak kawikawi-in, kuamah mu lo ahih manin amah in Izipt mipa thatin sehnel sungah seel hi.
A zing ciangin amah a paikhiat ciangin, en in, Hebru mi nih na kilai uh hi; amah in a gamta khial mipa' kiangah, "Bang hangin na lawm sat na hi hiam?" ci hi.
Amah in dawngin, "Kote' tungah ulian ding leh thukhen dingin kua in nang hong koih ahi hiam? Izipt mipa na thah bangin nang in keimah thah ding hong sawm na hi hiam?" ci hi. Tua ciangin Moses lau a, "A thu kithei taktak hi," ci-in ngaihsun hi.
Faro in tua thu a zak ciangin Moses thah dingin zong hi. Ahih hangin Faro' kiang panin Moses tai-in Midian gamah om hi; amah tuikhuk gei khatah tu hi.
Tua lai takin Midian siampipa in tanu sagih nei hi; amaute hong pai-in tuitawi uh a, a pa uh' tuuhonte tui pia dingin kuangzawn dim uh hi.
Tuucingte hong pai-in amaute hawlkhia hi; ahih hangin Moses dingto-in amaute huh a, a tuuhonte uh tui piaksak hi.
A pa uh Re-u-el kiangah amaute a tun' ciangun amah in, "A bangci-a tu ni-a hong hici ciah baih na hi uh hiam?" ci hi.
Amaute in, "Izipt mi khat in tuucingte khut sung panin kote hong honkhia-a, ko adingin tui nangawn hong tawisakin tuuhonte tui pia hi," ci uh hi.
Amah in a tanute' kiangah, "Amah koi lai-ah om ahi hiam? Bang hangin tua mipa nusia na hi uh hiam? Amah in an hong nek theih nadingin va sam un," ci hi.
Tua mipa tawh a om khop dingMoses lungkim a, amah in Moses' tungah a tanu Zipporah pia hi.
Tua nu in tapa khat nei a, amah in a min Gershom phuak hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, "Gam dangah peemta ka hi hi," ci hi.
Tua ni tampi hun sung kikalin Izipt kumpipa si hi. Israel mite a salsuahna sung uh-ah thumin, huhna ngenin kiko khia uh a, a salsuahna sung uh-ah amau' kikona Pasian' kiang tung hi.
Pasian in amau' thumna za-in, Pasian in Abraham, Isaak leh Jakob tawh a thuciamna phawk hi.
Pasian in Israel mite mu a, Pasian in amaute' omzia lunghimawh hi.
Tu-in Moses in Midian siampi ahi, a sungpa Jethro' tuuhon kem hi; amah in a tuuhon gamlak nisuahna lamah paipih a, Pasian' mual ahi Horeb tung hi.
Sawlbawk meikuang sung panin ama' tungah Topa' vantungmi in kilang hi; amah khuadak a, en in, sawlpang kuang hi, ahih hangin kangtum lo hi.
Moses in, "Bang hangin sawlpang kangtum lo hiam, kei pai-in hih a lamdang ka muh ka va en ding," ci hi.
Tua thu thei dingin amah a paina Topa in a muh ciangin, sawlpang kawm panin Pasian in amah sam a, "Moses, Moses!" ci hi. Amah in, "Hiah om ing," ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "A nai-ah hong pai kei in; na khe panin na khedapte suahkhia in, bang hang hiam cih leh nangma' din'na mun in lei siangtho ahi hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Keimah in na pa' Pasian, Abraham' Pasian, Isaak' Pasian, leh Jakob' Pasian ka hi hi," ci hi. Moses in ama' maitang hum hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian a et ding amah lau hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in, "Izipt-ah a om ka mihingte' gimna mu khinin a uk nasem ukte hangin amau' kikona ka za khin hi; amau' thuaknate ka lunghimawh a,
Izipt mite' khut sung panin amaute khahkhia-in, tua leitang panin amaute lakhia-in a hoih a tanzau leitang, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luan'na leitang, Kanaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite leh Jebus mite' omna-ah amaute paipih dingin kong paisuk hi.
Tu-in, en in, Israel mite' kikona kei' kiang hong tung khin a, Izipt mite in amaute a netniamna ka mu khin hi.
Hong pai in, nang in ka mihingte ahi Israel' tapate Izipt panin na paikhiatpih theih nadingin Faro' kiangah nang kong sawl ding hi," ci hi.
Ahih hangin Moses in Pasian' kiangah, "Faro' kiangah pai-in Izipt panin Israel mite a paikhiatpih dingin kei in kua ka hi hiam?" ci hi.
Amah in, "Nang tawh kong om taktak ding hi; hih in nangma adingin nangmah kong sawlna lim hi ding hi: nangmah in Izipt panin mihingte na paikhiatpih khit ciangin, nang in hih mual tungah Pasian' na na sem ding hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in Pasian' kiangah, "Israel mihingte' kiangah kei va pai-in amaute' kiangah, 'Na pate uh Pasian in note' kiangah kei hong sawl hi,' va ci leng, amaute in, 'Ama' min bang ahi hiam?' ci-in hong dong leh, amaute' tungah bang ci ding ka hi hiam?" ci hi.
Pasian in Moses' kiangah, "KEIMAH ka hi hi," ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Israel mihingte' tungah hih thu gen in, 'KEIMAH a kici pa in note' kiangah kei hong sawl hi,' ci in," ci hi.
Pasian in zong Moses' kiangah, "'Hih thu Israel mihingte' tungah gen in, "Topa, na pate' Pasian, Abraham' Pasian, Isaak' Pasian, leh Jokob' Pasian in note' kiangah kei hong sawl hi," ci in: hih in keima' min hi tawntung a, tua ahih manin keimah in khang tawntunga phawk ding ka hi hi.
Pai in la, Israel upate kaikhawmin amaute' kiangah, ''TOPA, na pate uh' Pasian, Abraham, Isaak leh Jakob' Pasian keima' tungah hong kilang khinin, 'Note leh Izipt gam sungah note' tungah hong kibawlna ka mu khin hi;
Izipt gimna panin note hong lakhia-in Kanaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Pere mite, Hiv mite leh Jebus mite' leitang, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luan'na leitangah note kong paipih ding ka kiciam hi,' ci hi," va ci in.
Amaute in nangma' thu hong ngai ding uh hi; nang leh Israel upate Izipt kumpipa' kiangah pai-in ama' tungah, "Topa ahi Hebru mite' Pasian in kote hong dawntuah zo hi; tu-in kong thuum uh hi, Topa ka Pasian uh tungah biakna ka piak theih nadingun ni thum khualzinna gam lakah kote hong paisak in," va ci un.
Khut vanglian khat in thatang hat thu tawh a hih kei buang leh Izipt kumpipa in note hong paisak loh ding ka thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin keimah in ka khut zan-in tua sunga ka hih ding nalamdangte tawh Izipt ka vat gawp ding hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in note hong paisak ding hi.
Keimah in Izipt mite' muhna-ah hih mihingte maipha ka pia ding hi; note na paikhiat uh ciangin, a hawm guakin na pai kei ding uh hi,
numei peuhmah in a vengte leh ama' inn sunga om pak mite' kiang panin ngun leh kham tawh kibawl kizepnate leh puante ngen ding uh a, na tapate uh leh na tanute uh tungah tuate na koih ding uh hi, tua bangin note in Izipt mite' na na sut ding uh hi,"' ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in dawngin, "Ahih hangin en in, amaute in kei hong um loin ka thu hong ngai lo ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in, 'Nang' tungah Topa hong kilang lo hi,' hong ci ding uh hi," ci hi.
Topa in ama' kiangah, "Na khut sunga om bang ahi hiam?" ci hi. Amah in, "Ciangkhut," ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "lei lakah lawn in," ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in lei lakah lawn a, gulpi khat suak hi; tua gulpi' kiang panin Moses tai hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in Moses' kiangah, "Na khut zan in la, a mei-in man in," ci hi—tua ahih ciangin amah in a khut zanin man a, ama' khut sungah ciangkhut suakkik hi—
"Amaute in a up theih nadingun Topa, amaute' Pasian, Abraham' Pasian, Isaak' Pasian leh Jakob' Pasian in nang' tungah hong kilang khin zo hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in ama' kiangah, "Na khut na ang sungah koih in," ci kik hi. Amah in a khut a ang sungah koih hi; amah in a lakkhiat ciangin, en in, a khut phak a, vuk bangin pak hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian in, "Na khut na ang sungah koih kik in," ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a khut a ang sungah koih kik hi; amah in a lak khiat ciangin, en in, ama' ci-le-sa dangte mah bangin dam kik hi.
Pasian in, "Amaute in nang hong up kei a, lim masa a thudon kei leh zong, amaute in lim nunung um kha ding uh hi.
Amaute in hih lim nihte nangawn um loin na thu hong thudon kei leh, nangmah in Nail gun panin tui pawl khat la-in lei keu tangah na sung ding hi; Nail gun panin na lak ding tui in lei keu tungah sisan suak ding hi," ci hi.
Ahih hangin Moses in Topa' kiangah, "Oh, ka Topa aw, tu-ma-siah hita leh, na nasempa' tungah thu na gen-a kipan hita leh, keimah in thugen ka siam kei hi; ka kam pau ol-in, ka pau awk hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in ama' kiangah, "Kua in mipa' kam bawl ahi hiam? Kua in amah pau thei losak, bilngongsak, musak, mittawsak ahi hiam? Topa ahi keimah hilo ka hi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in pai in, keimah in na thugenna-ah kong huh ding a, na thugen ding nang kong hilh ding hi," ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in, "Oh, ka Topa aw, hong thum ing, mi dang khat sawl zaw in," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses' tungah Topa heh a, amah in, "Levi mi na sanggampa Aaron om hilo ahi hiam? Amah in hoih takin thu a gen theihna ka cian theih hi; en in, nangmah dawn dingin amah hong paikhia a, amah in nang hong muh ciangin a lungsim sungah amah kipak ding hi.
Nangmah in ama' kiangah thu na gen ding a, a thugen dingte ama' kam sungah na koih ding hi; keimah in na thugenna uh-ah kong huh ding a, na hih ding uh kong hilh ding hi.
Amah in nang' tangin mite' tungah thu gen ding hi; amah in nang adingin kam hi ding a, nang in ama' tungah Pasian bang na hi ding hi.
Nangmah in limte na bawl nading ahi hih ciangkhut na khut sungah na tawi ding hi," ci hi.
A sungpa Jethro' kiangah Moses pai-in ama' kiangah, "Hong thum ing, Izipt-ah ka sanggamte' kiangah kei hong ciahkik sakin amaute a nungta lai uh hiam hong musak in," ci hi. Jethro in Moses' kiangah, "Nuam takin pai in," ci hi.
Midian gam sungah Topa in Moses' kiangah, "Izipt-ah paikik in; bang hang hiam cih leh nangma' nuntakna hong that nuam mite khempeuh si khin ta uh hi," ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses in a zi leh a tapate la a, la khat tungah amaute tuangsakin, Izipt gamah paikik hi; Moses in ama' khut sungah Pasian' ciangkhut tawi hi.
Topa in Moses' kiangah, "'Izipt-ah na ciahkik ciangin, nangma' hih theih dingin vangliatna kong piaksa nalamdangte khempeuh Faro' mai-ah na hih ding thei in; ahih hangin keimah in ama' lungsim ka khauhsak ding a, amah in mite paisak lo ding hi.
Nangmah in Faro' kiangah, "Topa in hih bangin ci hi, Israel in ka tapa a suak masa hi a,
nangma' kiangah, 'Amah in kei hong biak theih nadingin ka tapa paisak in,' kong ci hi; amah paisak ding na nial leh, en in, na tapa a suak masa ka that ding hi,' ci in,"'" a ci hi.
Lampi-ah a giahna khatah Topa in Moses dawntuah a, thah dingin amah zong hi.
Tua ciangin Zipporah in meisuang khat la-in a tapa' vun dawn atkhiat sakin, tua tawh Moses' khe nuh a, "Nang in kei' tungah sisan tawh zipipa na hi taktak hi!" ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in amah tuaci omsak hi. Tua ciangin tua nu in, "Vun-atna hangin sisan tawh zipipa na hi hi," ci hi.
Topa in Aaron kiangah, "Moses dawn dingin gam lakah pai in," ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah pai-in, Pasian' mual-ah amah dawnin amah nam hi.
Topa in amah a sawlna thute khempeuh leh ama' sep dinga a sawl limte khempeuh Moses in Aaron' tungah gen hi.
Tua ciangin Moses leh Aaron pai-in Israel mite' upate khempeuh kaikhawm uh hi.
Topa in Moses' kianga a gensa thute khempeuh Aaron in gen a, mite' muhna-ah limte bawl hi.
Mite in um uh hi; Israel mite' kiangah Topa lungnuam loin, amau' thuaknate amah in a muh khitna thu amaute in a zak uh ciangin, amaute in a lu uh kunin bia uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Faro kiangah Moses leh Aaron pai-in, "Israel Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi, 'Amaute in gam lakah kei adingin pawi khat a kham theih nadingun ka mite paisak in,' ci hi," ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Faro in, "Ama' aw ngai-in Israel ka paisak dingin Topa in kua ahi hiam? Topa ka thei kei hi, tua tham loin Israelte ka paisak kei ding hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Hebrute' Pasian in kote hong dawntuah zo hi; hong thum ung, amah in natna ahih kei leh namsau tawh kote hong hih kha ding ahih manin, ni thum paina gam lakah kote hong paisakin Topa ka Pasian uh tungah biakna hong piasak in," ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Izipt kumpipa in amaute' kiangah, "Moses leh Aaron aw, bang hangin amau' nasepna panin mite paikhiasak ding na hi uh hiam? Na nasepnate uh-ah pai un," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Faro in, "En un, tu-in hih gam mite tam a, amau' nasepnate panin amaute natawlngasak uh hi!" ci hi.
Tua ni mahin Faro in nasem ukte leh a nasem mapite thu pia a,
"Tu-ma-siah-a bangin, leiseek bawl nadingin mite' tungah buhtu na pia nawn kei ding uh hi; amaute paisak un la, amau mah buhtu khawm tawmsak un.
Ahih hangin tu-ma-siah-a a leiseek bawl zah uh amaute na bawlsak ding uh hi, bangbang hita leh na khiam kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute thadah uh hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute kiko-in, 'Kote hong paisakin ka Pasian uh tungah biakna hong piasak un,' ci uh hi.
Amaute in na semin zuauthute a don loh nadingin mihingte' tungah nasep haksa zaw suan un," ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin nasem ukte leh nasem mapite paikhia-in mite' tungah, "Faro in hih bangin ci hi, 'Note buhtu kong pia kei ding hi.
Note pai un la, na muhna peuhpeuh uh-ah na buhtu ding uh va zong tawm un; ahih hangin na nasep uh them khat zong hong kikhiam lo ding hi,' ci hi," ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a buhtu dingun buhkung a kaikhawm dingin Izipt gam khempeuhah mite kikhenthang uh hi.
Nasem ukte in kin ngaihsut uh a, "Buhtu a om hun mah bangin na nasep uh ahi na nisim nasep uh zo un," ci uh hi.
Israel mi nasem mapi, Faro' nasem ukte in amaute uk dingin a koih mite kisatin, "Bang hangin tu ciang dong, leiseek bawl ding na nasep khempeuh uh hih khin nai lo na hi uh hiam?" ci-in kidong hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mi nasem mapite hong pai-in Faro' kiangah, "Bang hangin na nasemte hih bangin hong bawl na hi hiam?
Na nasemte' tungah buhtu hong kipia lo hi, ahi zongin amaute in ko tungah, 'Leiseek bawl un!' hong ci hi. En in, na nasemte hong kisat hi; ahih hangin khialhna pen nangma' mite' tung mah-ah om hi," ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin amah in, "Note na thadah uh hi, note na thadah uh hi; tua ahih ciangin note in, 'Hong paisak un la, Topa' tungah biakna hong piasak un,' na ci uh hi.
Tu-in pai un la, nasem un; bang hang hiam cih leh note buhtu hong kipia lo ding hi, ahi zongin leiseek a mal ngeina zah mah na piakhia ding uh hi," ci hi.
Amaute in, "Bangbang hi ta leh ni sim-a leiseek na seek zah uh khiam lo ding," a cih ciangin, amaute thu haksapi sungah om a hih lam uh Israel mi nasem mapite in mu uh hi.
Amaute Faro' kiang panin a paikhiat ciangun, amaute a na ngak Moses leh Aaron tawh kituak uh hi;
amaute in, "Topa in note hong enin thu hong khen hen, bang hang hiam cih leh Faro leh a nasemte' muhna-ah kote a khial nong suaksak uh a, kote thah nadingin amau' khut sungah namsau khat na koih uh hi," amaute tungah ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' lamah Moses kihei kikin, "Topa aw, bang hangin nangmah in hih mite' tungah siatna bawl na hi hiam? Bang hangin kei hong sawl peuhmah na hi hiam?
Bang hang hiam cih leh nangma' min suangin Faro' kiangah thugen dingin ka pai khit-a kipan, amah in hih mite' tungah siatna bawl a, nangmah in na mihingte na honkhia het kei hi," ci hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in Moses kiangah, "Tu-in Faro' tungah ka bawl ding na mu ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a thahat ka khut hangin amah in ut lopipi-in amaute sawlkhia ding hi, hi hi, amah in ut lopipi-in a thahat ka khut hangin ama' leitang panin amaute hawlkhia ding hi," ci hi.
Pasian in Moses' kiangah, "Keimah in Topa ka hi hi.
Abraham, Isaak leh Jakobte' tungah Vanglian Pasian-in ka kilang a, ahih hangin Topa ahi keima' min tawh amaute' tungah kei ka kitheisak kei hi.
Amaute tawl khat sung a teen'na leitang ahi Kanaan gam amaute' tungah pia dingin amaute tawh ka thuciamna zong ka kipsak hi.
Tua tham loin Izipt mite in sal-a a neih Israel mite' thumna ka za zo a, ka thuciamna ka phawk zo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel mite' tungah, 'Keimah in Topa ka hi hi, Izipt mite' na nasepna uh panin note kong paikhiatpih ding hi, amau' sal hih na panin note kong khahkhia ding hi, a kizan khut leh thukhenna nasep lian tawh note kong tanh ding hi,
keima' mi dingin note kong la ding a, keimah in note' Pasian ka hi ding hi; Izipt mite' vangik nuai panin note a hong paikhiatpihpa, Topa na Pasian uh ka hihna note in na thei ding uh hi.
Abraham, Isaak, leh Jakobte' tungah khutlaam a, ka ciam leitangah note kong paipih ding hi; note' tungah tua leitang na neih dingun kong pia ding hi. Keimah Topa ka hi hi,' ci in," a ci hi.
Moses in tua mah bangin Israel mite' tungah gen hi; ahih hangin amau' lungsim kitapzanna leh gitlohna sungah a salsuahna uh hangin amaute in Moses' thu ngai lo uh hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah,
"Pai-in va tum in la, ama leitang panin Israel mite a paikhiatsak nading Izipt kumpipa Faro' kiangah gen in," ci hi.
Ahih hangin Moses in Topa kiangah, "En in, Israel mite in ka thu hong ngai lo uh hi; tua ahih ciangin bangci-in thugen a siam lo keima' thu Faro in hong ngai ding ahi hiam?" ci hi.
Ahih hang in Topa in Moses leh Aaron' tungah thugen a, Izipt gam panin Israel mite a paikhiatpih nadingin Israel mite leh Izipt kumpipa Faro' tungah thu a gen ding hanthawn hi.
Hihte in amau' innkuan lutangte ahi hi; Israel' ta a suak masa Reuben' tapate: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron leh Karmi hihte in Reubente beh ahi hi.
Simeon' tapate: Jamuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakhin, Zohar leh Kanaan numei' tapa Shawl; hihte in Simeonte beh ahi hi.
Hihte in amau khang tawh kizui-in Levi tapate min ahi hi: Gershon, Kohath leh Merari hi a, Levi nuntak kumte in kum za leh sawm-thum-le-sagih ahi hi.
Gershon' tapate: amau' innkuan tawh kizui-in Libni leh Shimei ahi hi.
Kohath' tapate: Amram' Izhar, Hebron leh Uzziel hi a, Kohath' nuntak kumte in kum za leh sawmthum-le-thum ahi hi.
Merari' tapate: Mahli leh Mushi ahi hi. Hihte in amau' khang tawh kizui-in Levite beh ahi hi.
Amram in ama' pa' sanggamnu Jokhebed zi-in la a, tua nu in amah tawh Aaron leh Moses nei hi. Amram' nuntak kumte in kum za leh sawmthum-le-sagih ahi hi.
Izhar' tapate: Korah, Nefeg leh Zikri ahi hi.
Uzziel' tapate: Mishael, Elzafan leh Sithri ahi hi.
Aaron in Amminadab' tanu, Nahshon' sanggam nu ahi Elisheba zi-in la hi; tua nu in amah tawh Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar nei hi.
Korah' tapate: Assir, Elkanah leh Abiasaf; hihte in Korahte beh ahi hi.
Aaron tapa Eleazar in Putiel' tanute khat zi-in la hi; tua nu in amah tawh Finehas nei hi. Hihte in a innkuan kuanin Levi mite' beh lutangte ahi hi.
"Izipt gam panin Israel mite ami' honpi-in paikhiatpih in," Topa in a cihna mite in hih Aaron leh Moseste ahi hi.
Izipt panin Israel mite paikhiatpih nading thu Izipt kumpipa Faro tunga thugente in amaute hi a, hih Moses leh hih Aaron zong ahi hi.
Izipt gamah Moses kiangah Topa in thu a gen ni-in,
Topa in Moses kiangah, "Keimah in Topa ka hi hi; nang' tunga kong gen khempeuh Izipt kumpipa Faro tungah gen in," ci hi.
Ahih hangin Moses in Topa' kiangah, "En in, keimah in thugen a siam lo mi ka hi hi; tua ahih ciangin bangci-in Faro in ka thu hong ngai ding ahi hiam?" ci hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah, "Thei in, Faro' tungah Pasian bangin nang kong bawl hi; na sanggampa Aaron in na kamsangpa hi ding hi.
Nang kong thupiak khempeuh na gen ding hi; ama' leitang panin Israel mite a paikhiatsak nadingin Faro' tungah na sanggampa Aaron in gen ding hi.
Ahih hangin keimah in Faro' lungsim ka khauhsak ding a, Izipt gamah ka limte leh nalamdangte ka tamsak hangin,
Faro in nang' thu hong ngai lo ding hi; tua ciangin keimah in Izipt tungah ka khut ka nga ding a, thukhenna nasepna lianpite tawh Izipt gam panin ka mi honpi, Israel mite ahi ka mihingte ka paikhiatpih ding hi.
Keimah in Izipt' tungah ka khut zan-in amaute' lak panin Israel mite ka paikhiatpih ciangin Izipt mite in keimah in Topa ka hihna thei ding uh hi," ci hi.
Moses leh Aaron in tua mah bangin hih uh hi; Topa in amaute a thupiak bangin amaute in hih uh hi.
Tu-in amaute in Faro' tungah thu a gen lai takun Moses kum sawmgiat pha a, Aaron kum sawmgiat-le-thum pha hi.
Topa in Moses leh Aaron kiangah,
"Faro in note' kiangah, 'Note a thutak na hihna uh nalamdang khat tawh hong lak un,' hong cih ciangin nangmah in Aaron' kiangah, 'Gulpi khat a suah theih nadingin na ciangkhut la in la, Faro' mai-ah khiasuk in,' ci in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Faro kiangah Moses leh Aaron pai-in Topa' thupiak bangin hih uh hi; Aaron in Faro leh a uliante' mai-ah a ciangkhut lawn suk a, gulpi khat suak hi.
Tua ciangin Faro in mi pilte leh aisan siamte sam hi; amau' Izipt mitphial siamte in zong amau' siamna tawh tua bang teek mahin bawl thei uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a milip in a ciangkhut uh khiasuk ciat a, tuate gulpi vive suak hi. Ahih hangin Aaron' ciangkhut in amau' ciangkhutte valh tum hi.
Topa' gensa bangin Faro' lungsim khauh lai a, amah in amaute' thu ngai lo hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, "Faro' lungsim khauh hi, amah in mite paisak nuam lo hi.
Amah gun-ah a pai lai takin zingsangin Faro kiangah pai in; Nail gun gei-ah amah ngak in la, gulpi a suak na ciangkhut pen mah na khut sungah tawi in.
Nangmah in ama' kiangah, 'Topa, Hebrute' Pasian in nangma' kiangah kei hong sawl a, "Gam lakah amaute in keimah hong biak theih nadingun ka mite paisak in; en in, nangmah in na mang nai kei hi," ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in hih bangin ci hi, "Keimah in Topa ka hihna hih tawh na thei ding hi: en in, ka khut sunga om ciangkhut tawh Nail gun sunga om tui ka sat ding a, tua tui in sisan suak ding hi,
Nail gun sunga ngasa si-in, Nail gun uih ding a, Izipt mite in Nail gun panin tui dawn ding kih ding uh hi,' ci hi, ci-in gen in," ci hi.
Topa in Moses' kiangah, "Aaron' kiangah hih bangin gen in, 'Na ciangkhut la in la, sisan a suah theih nadingin Izipt tuite, amau' gunte, amau' luite, amau' bualte' tung leh amau' tuili khempeuhte' tungah na khut zan in; Izipt gam sunga sing beel leh suang beel khempeuh sung nangawnah sisan om ding hi,' ci in," ci hi.
Moses leh Aaron in Topa' thupiak bangin hih uh hi; Faro leh ama uliante' muh-in amah in ciangkhut vik to-in Nail gun sunga om tui sat a, Nail gun sunga om tui khempeuh sisan suak hi.
Nail gun sunga ngasate si hi; Nail gun uih a, Izipt mite in Nail gun panin tui dawn thei lo uh hi; Izipt gamsung khempeuhah sisan om hi.
Ahih hangin Izipt mitphial siamte in amau' siamna tawh tua bangmah bawl thei uh hi; tua ahih ciangin Faro' lungsim a khauh ngei mahin khauh a, Topa' gensa bangin amah in amaute' thu ngai lo hi.
Faro kihei-in a inn sungah pai a, amah in a lungsim nangawnah tua thu ngaihsutin nei nawn lo hi.
Amaute in Nail gun tui dawn thei lo uh ahih manin Izipt mite khempeuh in Nail gun kiim tengah tui dawn ding to uh hi.
Topa in Nail gun a sat zawh ni sagih pha ta hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses' tungah, "Faro kiangah pai in la ama' tungah, 'Topa in hih bangin ci hi, "Amaute in keimah hong biak theih nadingin ka mite paisak in.
Ahih hangin amaute na paisak kei leh, en in, na gam khempeuh uiphukte tawh ka gimsak ding hi;
Nail gun in uiphukte tawh kidim ding a, tuate in na inn sung, na lupna inndei sung, na lupna tung, na nasemte leh na mihingte' innte sung, na meikhukte leh na annel mekna kuang sungte-ah hong pai ding uh hi;
uiphukte in nang' tung leh na mite leh na nasemte khempeuh' tungah hong pai ding hi," ci hi,' ci-in gen in," a ci hi.
Topa in Moses' tungah, "Aaron kiangah hih bangin gen in, 'Gunte, luite, tuilite' tungah na ciangkhut tawh na khut zan in la, Izipt leitang tungah uiphukte paisak in!' ci-in gen in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Aaron in Izipt tuite' tungah a khut zan hi; uiphukte hong pai-in Izipt leitang tuam hi.
Ahih hangin mitphial siamte in amau' siamna tawh tua bangmah bawl thei uh a, Izipt leitang tungah uiphukte omsak uh hi.
Tua ciangin Faro in Moses leh Aaron samin, "Kei leh ka mite' kiang panin uiphukte a lakkhiat nadingin Topa' tungah thum un; Topa' tungah biakna pia dingin mite ka paisak ding hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in Faro' kiangah, "Nail gun sung cih sim loh, nangma' kiang leh na innte panin uiphukte a bei nadingin nang leh na nasemte leh na mite' adingin ka thum theih nadingin a hun khat seh in," a ci hi.
Amah in, "Zingciang," ci hi. Moses in, "Topa ahi kote' Pasian tawh a kibang kuamah om lo hi ci-in na theih nadingin nangma' cih bang hi ta hen.
Nang leh na innte leh na nasemte leh na mite' kiang panin uiphukte paikhia ding uh hi; Nail gun sung bekah om ding uh hi," ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Faro kiang panin Moses leh Aaron paikhia uh hi; Faro' tungah a tun'saksa uiphuk tawh kisai thu Moses in Topa' tungah ko hi.
Topa in Moses' thugen bangin hih hi; innte leh huang sung leh lote panin uiphukte si hi.
Amaute in a lom lomin tuate khawm uh a, gamsung teng uih hi.
Ahih hangin nopna a om kik lam Faro in a muh ciangin, amah in a lungsim khauhsak a, Topa' gensa bangin amau' thu ngai lo hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses' tungah, "Aaron' kiangah hih bangin gen in, 'Izipt gamsung khempeuhah thokang a om dingin na ciangkhut zan in la leivui sat in,' ci in," a ci hi.
Amaute in tua mah bangin hih uh hi; Aaron in a ciangkhut tawh a khut zan-in, leivui sat a, mihing' tung leh ganhing' tungah thokang hong om hi; Izipt gamsung khempeuhah leivui teng thokang suak hi.
Mitphial siamte in amau' siamna tawh thokang pian'sak ding sin uh a, ahih hangin amaute in hih thei lo uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin mihing leh ganhing' tungah thokangte om hi.
Mitphial siamte in Faro' kiangah, "Hih in Pasian' nasepna ahi hi," ci uh hi. Ahih hangin Faro' lungsim khauh a, Topa' gensa bangin amah in amaute' thu ngai lo hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses' kiangah, 'Zingsangin tho baihin amah gun-ah hong pai ding Faro ngak in, ama' kiangah, 'Topa in hih bangin ci hi, "Amaute in keimah a hong biak theih nadingun ka mite paisak in.
Tua bang hi loin, ka mite na paisak kei leh, en in, nang leh na nasemte leh na mite' tung leh na innte' sungah tho honpite kong sawl ding hi; Izipt mite' innte leh tuate' din'na leitang zong tho honpite tawh kidim ding hi.
Ahih hangin tua ni ciangin keimah in hih leitungah Topa ka hihna na theih nadingin tho honpite a om loh nadingin ka mihingte a ten'na Goshen leitang keimah in ka tuam koih ding hi.
Tua bangin keima' mite leh nangma' mite a kilamdan'na khat ka bawl ding hi. Zing ciangin hih lim hong om ding hi," ci hi,' ci-in gen in," a ci hi.
Topa in tua mah bangin hih hi; Faro' innsung leh ama' nasemte' innte sungah tho honpite hong pai a, Izipt gamsung khempeuh thote' hangin leitang kisia hi.
Tua ciangin Faro in Moses leh Aaron sam a, "Pai un, hih gamsungah na Pasian' tung uh-ah biakna pia un," ci hi.
Ahih hangin Moses in, "Tua banga hih ding kituak lo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Izipt mite' adingin a deihhuai lo biaknate kote in Topa ka Pasian uh tungah ka pia ding uh hi. Izipt mite' adingin a deihhuai lo biaknate amau' muhna-ah pia le ung, amaute in kote suang tawh hong deng ding uh hilo ahi hiam?
Kote in ni thum paina gam lakah pai-in ama' hong thupiak ding bangin Topa ka Pasian uh tungah biakna ka va pia ding uh hi," ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Faro in, "Gam lakah Topana Pasian uh tungah biakna pia dingin note kong paisak ding hi; ahih hangin gamlapi-ah na pai kei ding uh hi. Kei adingin hong thumsak in," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in, "En in, nang' kiang panin kei paikhia-in Faro' kiang pan, a nasemte' kiang pan leh a mite' kiang panin tho honpite zingciang a paikhiat theih nadingin Topa' tungah thu ka ngen ding hi; ahi zongin Topa' tungah biakna pia dingin mite paisak lohna tawh Faro hong zuau-tat kik nawn kei in," ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Faro' kiang panin Moses paikhia-a Topa' tungah thungen hi.
Topa in Moses' nget bangin hih a, Faro' kiang, a nasemte' kiang leh a mite' kiang panin tho honpite lakhia hi; khat zong om nawn lo hi.
Ahih hangin Faro in hih hunin zong a lungsim khauhsak lai a, mite paisak lo hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses' tungah, "Faro' kiangah pai in la ama' kiangah, 'Topa, Hebrute' Pasian in hih bangin ci hi, "Amaute in keimah a hong biak theih nadingin ka mite paisak in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nang in amaute paisak ding nialin amaute na let lai leh,
en in, lo sunga om ganhingte ahi, sakolte, late, kalaohte, bawnghonte leh tuuhonte' tungah a nasia mahmah gimna Topa' khut in tungsak ding hi.
Israel mite aa khempeuh khat beek a sih loh nadingin Israel' ganhingte leh Izipt' ganhingte kikalah Topa in a kilamdan'na khat bawl ding hi," ci hi, ci-in gen in," a ci hi.
Topa in a hun khat seh a, "Zing ciangin Topa in gamsungah hih na hong sem ding hi," ci hi.
A zing ciangin Topa in hih na bawl hi; Izipt mite' ganhing khempeuh si a, ahih hangin Israel mite' ganhing khat zong si lo hi.
Faro in a en dingin mi sawl hi, en in, Israel' ganhing khat zong si lo hi. Ahih hangin Faro' lungsim khauh lai a, amah in mite paisak lo hi.
Topa in Moses leh Aaron' kiangah, "Meiphualpi panin khut dimin vut la un la, Faro' muh-in vantung lamah Moses in lawn hen.
Tua in Izipt gam khempeuhah leivui nel suakin, Izipt gamsung khempeuhah mihing leh ganhing tungah meimatum suakin puakkham ding hi," ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in meiphualpi panin vutte la-in, Faro mai-ah ding uh a, Moses in tuate vantung lamah lawnin, tuate in mihing leh ganhing tungah meimatum suakin puakkham hi.
Mitphial siamte in meimatum hangin Moses dem zo nawn lo uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh mitphial siamte leh Izipt mite khempeuh in meimatum vei uh hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in Faro' lungsim khauhsak a, Topa in Moses' tunga a gensa bangin amah in amaute' thu ngai lo hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses' kiangah, "Zingsangin tho baih in la, Faro' mai-ah ding-in ama' kiangah, "Hebru mite' Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi, "Amaute in keimah a hong biak theih nadingin ka mihingte paisak in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh leitung khempeuhah kei tawh a kibang khat beek om lo hi ci-in na theih nadingin hih hunin na sungtawng dong leh na nasemte leh na mihingte' tungah ka gimnate khempeuh kong tungsak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh tu-in keimah in ka khut zanin natna tawh nang leh na mihingte hong vat gawpin, leitung panin note hong kibeisak thei hi;
ahih hangin leitung khempeuhah keima' min a kipulak theih nadingin nang' tungah ka vangliatna lah ding deihna-in nang kong nungtasak hi.
Ka mihingte' tungah nang kiliansak lai-in amaute na paisak kei hi.
En in, zing ciang tu bang hunin Izipt gam a kisat-a kipanin tu hun dongin tua bang a kimu ngei lo a tam mahmah gialpi ka kiasak ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in mi sawl in la, na ganhingte leh gamlak-a na neihte khempeuh a muanhuai bukna-ah koih in; bang hang hiam cih leh gialpi in inn-ah a kipaipih lo, gamlak-a om mihing leh ganhing tungah kia ding a, amaute si ding uh hi," ci hi,' ci-in gen in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Faro' nasemte' lak panin Topa' thu a zahtak mi in ama' silate leh a ganhingte inn-ah taisak hi;
ahih hangin Topa'thu a don lo mi in ama' silate leh a ganhingte gamlakah nusia hi.
Topa in Moses' kiangah, "Izipt gamsung khempeuh a, mihing leh ganhing leh gamlak kungte khempeuh' tungah gialpi a kiat theih nadingin vantung lamah na khut zan in," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in vantung lamah a ciangkhut zan hi; Topa in vanging leh gialpi puak a, leitungah meikuang tai suk hi. Topa in Izipt gamsungah gialpi zusak hi;
Izipt gam minam khat a suah khit-a kipanin tua bang a om ngei lo, a tam mahmah gialpi leh gialpi lakah mei a kuangzalzal tawntung om hi.
Gialpi in Izipt gam sunga a om mihing leh ganhing, na khempeuh deeng gawp hi; gialpi in gamlak kung khempeuh deeng gawp a, gamlak singkung khempeuh deengtan hi.
Israel mite a omna Goshen gam bekah gialpi kia lo hi.
Tua ciangin Faro in mi sawlin Moses leh Aaron samsak a amaute' kiangah, "Tu tungin ka khial hi; Topa man hi, kei leh ka mihingte ka khial uh hi.
Topa' tungah thum in; bang hang hiam cih leh hih vanging leh gialpi kicing zo hi; note kong paisak ding a, note na khawl nawn kei ding uh hi," ci hi.
Moses in ama' kiangah, "Khuapi panin ka paikhiat khit phetin Topa' lamah ka khut ka zan ding hi; leitung in Topa' aa hi ci-in na theih nadingin vanging tawpin gialpi om nawn lo ding hi.
Ahih hangin nang leh na nasemte in ahih leh, Topa Pasian na zahtak nai lohna uh ka thei hi," ci hi.
(Anthul kungte leh mangbuhham kisia hi, bang hang hiam cih leh mangbuhhamte a vuih laitak hi a, anthul kungte a pak laitak ahi hi.
Ahih hangin mangbuh leh mangbuhmante sia lo hi, bang hang hiam cih leh tuate khangham nai lo hi.)
Tua ahih ciangin Faro' kiang pan khuapi pua-ah Moses paikhia a, Topa' lamah a khut zan hi; vanging leh gialpi tawp a, leitungah guah bua nawn lo hi.
Ahih hangin guah leh gialpi leh vanging a khawlna Faro in a muh ciangin amah khial lai a, amah leh a nasemte in a lungsim uh khauhsak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in Moses'tung tawn-a a gensa bangin Faro' lungsim khauh a, amah in Israel mite paisak lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Faro' kiangah Moses leh Aaron pai uh a ama' kiangah, "Hebru mite' Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi, 'Ka mai-ah nang na kiniamkhiat nading bang tan vei nial ding na hi hiam? Amaute in keima' na hong sep theih nadingin ka mite paisak in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka mite paisak ding na nial leh, en in, zing ciangin na gam sungah kauphete kong paipih ding a,
kuamah in leitang a muh theih loh nadingin tuate in lei maitang khempeuh tuam ding uh hi; gialpi khit cianga nang adinga a om laite amaute in ne ding uh hi; amaute in gamlak-a a po nangma singkung khempeuh ne ding uh hi,
nangma innte leh na nasemte khempeuh leh Izipt mite' innte khempeuh-ah dim ding uh hi; na pu na pate uh leitungah a pian uh a, kipan tuni donga tua bang a muh ngei lohte uh hi ding hi,' ci hi," ci-in a gen hi. Tua ciangin amah kihei-in Faro' kiang panin paikhia hi.
Faro' nasemte in ama' kiangah, "Eite' tungah hih mipa bang tan vei thangzak hong hi ding ahi hiam? Amaute in amau' Pasian, Topa a biak theih nadingun mite paisak in; Izipt a siatna thei tel nai lo na hi hiam?" ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Faro' kiangah Moses leh Aaron kipaipih kik hi; amah in amaute' kiangah, "Pai un, Topa, na Pasian uh va bia un; ahih hangin kua teng pai ding na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Moses in, "Ka khangnote uh leh ka khanghamte uh tawh ka paikhawm ding uh hi; ka tapate uh, ka tanute uh, ka tuuhonte uh leh ka bawnghonte uh tawh ka pai ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa' adingin pawi khat ka kham ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Amah in amaute' kiangah, "Note leh na naupangte uh kong paisak taak leh note tawh Topa om ta ve! En un, note in ngimna hoih lo na nei uh hi.
Tua bang hilo ding! Note' lak panin pasalte pai un la, Topa va bia un, bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen nomau' ut ahi hi," a ci hi. Faro' omna panin amaute kihawlkhia hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Mose' kiangah, "Amaute Izipt leitang tungah hong omin, gialpi in a deen' baang kung khempeuh a nek theih nadingin kauphete sapna-in Izipt leitang tungah na khut zan khia in," ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses in Izipt leitang tungah a ciangkhut zan a, Topa in tua sun tawntung leh tua zan tawntung leitang tungah nisuahna huih nungsak hi; zingsang ciangin nisuahna huih in kauphete hong tun' khin hi.
Tua ma-siah kauphe hon tua banga a tam a om ngei lo, cik mah ciangin zong a omkik ngei lo ding, Izipt leitang tung khempeuhah kauphe hong om a, Izipt gam buppi-ah om uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in leitang bup maitang tuam uh a, leitang mial hi, amaute in leitang tunga kung khempeuh leh gialpi' deen' baang sing gah khempeuh ne uh hi; Izipt leitang tung khempeuhah gamlak singkung hita leh kungno hita leh a hing khat beek om lo hi.
Tua ciangin Faro in Moses leh Aaron nawh sap a, "Topana Pasian' tung leh nangma' tungah ka khial khin hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in ka khialhna hong maisak in, tu-a khat vei bek, kong thum hi, keima' tung panin hih sihna a lakkhiat ding Topa na Pasian tungah thum in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Faro' kiang panin amah pai khia-in Topa' tungah thum hi.
Topa in nitumna huihpi hat mahmah khat nungsak a, tua huih in kauphete laamto-in San Tuipi sung den'na hi; Izipt gam sungah kauphe khat zong om nawn lo hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in Faro' lungsim khauhsak a, amah in Israel mite paisak lo hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses' kiangah, "Mite in khuamial sung a zawt nading, Izipt leitang tungah khuamial a om theih nadingin vantung lamah na khut zan in," ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses in vantung lamah a khut zan a, Izipt leitang tung khempeuhah ni thum sung khuamial sahpi om hi;
ni thum sung amaute khat leh khat kimu thei lo uh a, ama' omna panin kuamah tho khia thei lo hi; ahih hangin Israel mite in amau' ten'na-ah khuavak nei uh hi.
Tua ciangin Faro in Moses samin, "Pai in, Topava bia un; na tate uh zong note tawh hong pai thei ding hi; na tuuhonte uh leh na bawnghonte uh omsak lai un," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Moses in, "Topa ka Pasian'tung uh-ah ka piak theih nadingun biak piakna leh meihal biakna kote nong neihsak kul hi.
Ka ganhingte uh zong kote tawh a pai kul hi; ganno khat zong kinusia lo ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Topa ka Pasian uh ka biak nadingun tuate ka paipih ding uh hi, a mun ka tun' matengun bang pen tawh Topa bia ding cih ka thei kei uh hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in Faro' lungsim khauhsak a, amah in amaute paisak lo hi.
Tua ciangin Faro in ama' kiangah, "Kei' kiang panin kihem in; nang kidawm in: ka maitang hong mukik nawn kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh ka maitang nong muh ni-in nang na si ding hi," a ci hi,
Moses in, "Na cih bang hi ta hen! Na maitang kong mukik nawn kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Topa in Moses' kiangah, "Faro leh Izipt tungah gimna khat ka tungsak lai ding hi; tua khit ciangin hih lai mun panin amah in note hong paisak ding hi; amah in note hong paisak ciangin note hong hawlkhia mang khin ding hi.
Pasal peuhmah in a vengte' kiang pan, numei peuhmah in zong a vengte' kiang panin ngun leh kham kizepnate a nget theih nadingun mite' zakin thugen in," a ci hi.
Topa in Izipt mite' muhna-ah mipa maipha pia hi. Tua tham loin, Moses pen Izipt leitang tung, Faro' nasemte' muhna leh mite' muhna-ah lian mahmah hi.
Moses in, "Topa in hih bangin ci hi. Zankim pawl-in Izipt mite' lakah ka pai ding hi;
kumpi tokhom tunga a tu Faro' tacil-a kipanin an gawina nung-a a om numei-nasem' tacil dong leh ganhing tacil khempeuh, Izipt gam sungah tacil khempeuh si ding hi.
Cik mah-a tua bang a om ngei lo, cik mah ciangin zong a omkik ngei lo ding kahna lianpi Izipt leitang tung khempeuhah om ding hi.
Ahih hangin Izipt mite leh Israel mite a kilamdangin Topa in bawl hi ci-in na theih nadingun Israel mite, mihing hita leh ganhing hita leh, ui khat zong tau lo ding hi.
Hih nangma'nasemte khempeuh keima' kiangah hong paisukin, keima' kiangah hong kunsuk ding uh a, 'Nang leh nangmah hong zui mi khempeuh paikhia un,' hong ci ding uh hi. Tua khit ciangin kei ka paikhia ding hi," a ci hi. Faro' kiang panin amah heh mahmahin paikhia hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses' kiangah, "Izipt leitang tungah ka nalamdangte a tam theih nadingin Faro in na thu hong ngai lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Moses leh Aaron in hih nalamdangte khempeuh Faro' mai-ah bawl uh hi; Topa in Faro' lungsim khauhsak a, amah in Israel mite a leitang panin paikhiasak lo hi.
Izipt gam sungah Topa in Moses leh Aaron kiangah,
"Tu kha in note' adingin kum kipatna hi ding hi; note' adingin kum khat sungah a kha masa hi ding hi.
Israel mihon khempeuhte' tungah gen in, tu kha ni sawm ni-in innkuan khat adingin tuuno ahih kei leh keelno khat, amau' innkuan pha zah tawh kituakin amaute in ganno khat ciat la ding uh hi;
ganno khat' adingin innkuan a tawm luat leh mipa khat in ama' inn zom a vengte tawh a mi tawh kituakin la ding hi; a mi tamna leh a nek zah uh tawh kizui-in ganno man pia ding uh hi.
Na ganno uh a sitbang lo hi ding a, kum khat a pha a pa hi ding hi; tua pen tuu ahi a, keel ahi zongin, khat peuhpeuh hi thei ding hi;
tua pen, Israel mihonte khempeuh in a gannote uh a gawh ding hun nitak khuamui, tua kha ni sawm-le-li dong na kem ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in a sisan kimkhat la-in a nekna uh inn kongkhak khuam nihte leh bangtungzawl nuh ding uh hi.
Amaute in tua zanin a sa hangin ne ding uh hi; silngo sawhloh anlum leh a kha mehteh tawh amaute in ne ding uh hi.
A sate mun khat peuhpeuhah a sial ahi a, tui tawh huanin ahi zongin ne loin, a lu leh a khete leh a sungkuate tawh hangin na ne ding uh hi.
Zingsang dong a khing na omsak kei ding uh a, zingsang cianga a khing om lai peuhmah na haltum ding uh hi.
Hih bang zia-in na ne ding uh hi: na kawng uh gakin, na khedapte uh na khe uh-ah bulhin, na ciangkhut uh na khut uh-ah na tawi ding uh hi; na nawh nek ding uh hi. Tua in Topa' Pasian pawi ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in tua zanin Izipt gam ka nawk ding a, Izipt leitang tungah mihing hita leh ganhing hita leh tacil khempeuh ka vat gawp ding hi; Izipt pasiante khempeuh' tungah thu ka khen ding hi; keimah in Topa ka hi hi.
Note' omna inn tunga sisan in note adingin lim hi ding hi; sisan ka muh ciangin note kong paisan ding a, Izipt leitang ka vat gawp ciangin note hong susia ding gimna note' tungah hong tung lo ding hi.
"Hih ni in note adingin phawkna ni hi ding hi, note in Topa' tungah pawi bawlna ni-in na nei ding uh hi; na khang tawntungun note in biakna ngeina kip khatin na nei tawntung ding uh hi.
Note in ni sagih sung silngo sawhloh anlum na ne ding uh hi; a ni masa ni-in note in na inn panun silngo na hemkhia ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh khat peuh in a ni masa ni panin a ni sagih ni dong silngo sawh a nek leh, Israel sung panin tua mipa kikhenkhia ding hi.
A ni masa ni-in note in a siangtho kikhopna khat na nei ding uh a, a ni sagih ni-in zong a siangtho kikhopna khat mah na nei ding uh hi, tua sung tengin na bangmah kisem lo ding hi; ahih hangin na milip-un na huansa bek mah na ne thei ding uh hi.
Note in silngo sawhloh anlum pawi na bawl ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh hih ni teekteekin Izipt leitang panin na mihonte uh ka paikhiatpih hi: tua ahih ciangin note in na khan tawntungun hih ni pen biakna ngeina kip khatin na nei tawntung ding uh hi.
Kha masa, tua kha ni sawm-le-li nitakin note in silngo sawhloh anlum na ne ding uh a, tua kha ni sawmnih-le-khat nitak dong na ne ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ni sagih sung na inn sung uh-ah silngo kimu lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh mi khat peuh, peemta hita leh gam mi hita leh in silngo sawh a nek leh, Israel mi honpi panin tua mipa kikhenkhia ding hi.
Silngo a kisawh peuhmah nane kei ding uh hi; na omna khempeuh uh-ah silngo sawhloh anlum na ne ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in Israel upate khempeuh samin amaute' kiangah, "Nomau' adingin na innkuan uh tawh a kituakin tuunote teel un la, paisan tuuno go un.
Puknah lom khat la un la, kuang sunga a om sisan sungah diahin, kuang sunga a om sisan tawh bangtungzawl leh kongkhak khuam nihte nuh un; zingsang matengin a inn kongkhak pua-ah kuamah paikhia lo ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Izipt mite that dingin Topa in hong nawk ding hi; amah in bangtungzawl leh kongkhak khuam nih tunga sisan a muh ciangin Topa in kongkhak paisan ding a, a susia ding pen note that dingin na inn sung uh-ah tumsak lo ding hi.
Note leh na tapate in hih pen biakna ngeina kip-in na nei tawntung ding uh hi.
Amah in hong ciamsa bangin Topa in note hong piak ding leitang na tun' uh ciangin hih nasep na zui ding uh hi.
Na tate un note' kiangah, 'Hih bang hihna bang a cih nopna ahi hiam?' hong cih ciangin
note in, 'Topa' paisanna biak piakna ahi hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amah in eite' innkuante hong khawi-in Izipt mite a thah lai-in Izipt gam sungah Israel innkuante paisan hi,' na ci ding uh hi," a ci hi. Mite in a lu uh kunin bia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses leh Aaron a thupiak bangin Israel mite gamta uh hi.
Ama' kumpi tokhom tunga a tu Faro' tacil-a kipanin thongmial sunga a om a kiman mite' tacil leh ganhing tacil khempeuh, Izipt gam sunga a om tacil khempeuh, zankim lai takin Topa in vat gawp hi.
Tua zanin Faro leh a nasemte khempeuh leh Izipt mite khempeuh tho uh hi; Izipt gam sungah kahna lianpi om hi, bang hang hiam cih leh khat beek a sih lohna inn khat zong om lo hi.
Amah in Moses leh Aaron zan sap a, "Ding un, keima' mihingte lak panin note leh Israel mite paikhia un; pai un la, na gensa bangun Topa va bia un.
Na gensa bangun na tuuhonte uh leh na bawnghonte uh la un la, pai un; kei zong thupha hong pia un," a ci hi.
Tua gam panin mite manlangin a sawl khiat nading uh-ah Izipt mite nawhtat mahmah uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in, "Eite khempeuh misi i hi hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mite in silngo sawh nai loh a annel lom uh la-in, annel mekna amau' kuangte puan tawh tunin a liangko uh-ah pua uh hi.
Moses in amaute' tunga a gen bangin Israel mite zong gamta uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Izipt mite'tung panin ngun leh kham kizepnate leh puante ngen uh hi;
amau' ngette a piak nadingun Topa in Izipt mite' muhna-ah mite maipha pia hi. Tua bangin amaute in Izipt mite' na sut uh hi.
Israel mite numei leh naupang kisim loin pasal tul za guk Rameses panin Sukkoth-ah khe-in pai uh hi.
Minam dang tampi leh tuuhon leh bawnghon, ganhing tampi zong amau tawh pai uh hi.
Izipt panin a ken' uh annel lom panin amaute in silngo sawhloh moh em uh hi, tuate silngo kisawh lo hi, bang hang hiam cih leh, Izipt panin amaute kisawnkhia a, zia-ol tat thei loin amau' annek ding zong kiging man lo uh hi.
Israel mite Izipt-ah a om uh hun sung in kum za li leh kum sawmthum ahi hi.
Kum za li leh kum sawmthum a cin' ni teekteekin Izipt leitang panin Topa' mihonpite paikhia uh hi.
Amaute Izipt leitang panin a paikhiatpih nadingin hih in Topa' zan vilna ahi hi; tua mah bangin Israel mite khempeuh in amau khang tawntungin Topa' adingin hih zan mah zan vilna-in nei uh hi.
Topa in Moses leh Aaron' kiangah, "Hih in paisan biakna ngeina kip ahi hi; gamdang mi kuamah in ne lo ding hi;
ahih hangin sum tawh a kilei sila peuhmah in a vun na at khit uh ciangin ne thei ding hi.
Peemta hita leh a kicial nasem hita leh in ne thei lo ding hi.
Inn khat sungah kine ding hi; inn pua-ah a sa na paikhiatpih kei ding uh hi; a guh na kuaitan kei ding uh hi.
Israel mihon khempeuhin hih ding uh hi.
Khual mi khat note' kiangah hong peem a, Topa' adingin paisan a bawl leh, ama mipih pasal khempeuh a vun ki-at sak un, tua ciangin amah a nai-ah hong pai-in bawl thei ding hi; amah in gam mi khat tawh kibang ding hi. Ahih hangin vun ki-at lo mi kuamah in ne lo ding hi.
Gam mi leh note' lakah hong peem khual mi' adingin ngeina khat bek om ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua bangin Israel mite khempeuh in hih uh hi; Topa in Moses leh Aaron a thupiak bangin amaute in hih uh hi.
Tua ni teekteekin Topa in Israel mite a honpi-un Izipt gam panin paikhiatpih hi.
Topa in Moses' kiangah,
"Keima' tungah tacil khempeuh hong ap in; Israel mihingte' lakah, mihing hita leh ganhing hita leh, naubu a hong masa pen peuhpeuh in keima aa ahi hi," a ci hi.
Moses in mite' tungah, "Salsuahna gam, Izipt panin na paikhiat uh hih ni phawk un, bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in vangliatna khut tawh hih mun panin note hong paikhiatpih hi; silngo sawh anlum kine lo ding hi.
Abib kha, tu ni-in note a paikhia ding na hi uh hi.
Amah in note' tungah piak dinga na pate' tungah a ciam, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luan'na leitang, Kanaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Hiv mite leh Jebus mite' leitangah Topa in note hong paipih ciangin hih kha sungin hih bangin pawina hih ding uh hi.
Note in silngo sawhloh anlum ni sagih sung na ne ding uh a, a ni sagih ni-in Topa adingin pawi khat om ding hi.
Silngo sawhloh anlum ni sagih sung kine ding hi; note' tungah silngo sawh anlum kimu lo ding hi, note' huang sung khempeuhah note' tung panin silngo kimu lo ding hi.
Tua ni-in na tapa kiangah, 'Izipt panin ka paikhiat lai-in Topa in kei adinga hong hihsakna hang hi,' ci-in na gen ding hi.
Na kam in Topa' thu kham a gen tawntung theihna dingin hih in na khut tungah lim, na mitte kikalah phawkna khat hi ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in a vangliatna khut tawh hih mun panin nang hong paikhiatpih hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in a kiseh hunin kum khat pan kum khat, hih biakna ngeina kip na zui ding uh hi.
"Amah in note leh na pate uh tungah a ciam bangin, Topa in Kanaan leitangah note hong paipih hun ciang leh note' tungah tua gam hong piak ciangin,
note in naubu a hong masa khempeuh Topa' adingin na tuam koih ding uh hi. Na ganhing uh a tacil a pa khempeuh in Topaaa hi ding hi.
La a tacil peuhmah tuuno khat tawh na tanh ding uh hi, tua bang hi loin na tat kei ding uh leh a ngawg na kuaitan ding uh hi. Note' tapate lak panin tacil peuhmah na tanh ding uh hi.
Hong pai ding hunah na tapa in, 'Hih in bang a cih nopna ahi hiam?' ci-in nang hong dot ciangin, nangmah in ama' kiangah, 'Salsuahna, Izipt panin Topa in vangliatna tawh eite hong paikhiatpih hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Faro in eite paisak ding a nial tentan ciangin Izipt gamsunga tacil khempeuh, mihing tacil leh ganhing tacil khempeuh Topa in that hi. Tua ahih ciangin naubu a hong masa a pa khempeuh Topa' tungah biakna-in ka pia uh hi; ahih hangin ka tapate uh sung pan tacil khempeuh ka tanh uh hi,' na ci ding hi,
Tua in na khut tung-a om ciamtehna lim ahih kei leh na mitte kikal-a talsuante bang hi ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in a vangliatna tawh Izipt panin eite hong paikhiatpih hi," a ci hi.
Faro in mite a paisak ciangin, lampi tom pen hita se leh, Pasian in Filistia gam tawnin amaute paipih lo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in, "Amaute in gal a tuah ciangin mite kisikin Izipt-ah ciahkik kha ding hi,' a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian in San Tuipi lam manawhin gamlak lamah mite kot paipih hi. Israel mite galdo dingin kithawisa-in Izipt leitang panin pai to uh hi.
Moses in Josef' guhte paipih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Josef in Israel mite' tungah thupi takin ciam a, "Note' kiangah Pasian hong hawh ding hi; tua ciangin note in hih lai panin keima' guhte na pua ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Sukkoth panin amaute pai lai uh a, gamlak nawl, Etham-ah giahphual sat uh hi.
Amaute in sun hita leh zan hita leh khualzinin a pai theih nadingun sun-in amaute lam a lak dingin meii khuam khat tawh, zan-in amaute khuavak a pia dingin mei khuam khat tawh, amaute' mai-ah Topa pai hi;
sun-a meii khuam leh zan-a mei khuamte in mite' mai panin paikhia lo hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses' kiangah,
"Israel mite kihei kikin Migdol leh tuipi kikal, Pihahiroth-mai, Baalzefon nisuahna lamah giahphual a sat ding gen in; tuipi gei, tua gal khatah giahphual na sat ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Faro in Israel' thu tawh kisai genin, 'Gam sungah amaute tangciak uh hi; gamlak in amaute khuhcip khin hi,' ci ding hi.
Keimah in Faro' lungsim khauhsakin, amah in amaute delh ding a, Faro leh a mi honpite khempeuh ka zawhna hangin minthan'na ka ngah ding hi; keimah in Topa ka hihna thu Izipt mite in thei ding uh hi," a ci hi. Amaute tua mah bangin gamta uh hi.
Mite tai khin zo hi, ci-in Izipt kumpipa kiangah a kigen ciangin, Faro leh ama nasemte' ngaihsutna kikhel a, amaute in, "Eite' na hong sep nading panin Israel i pai khiatsak, hih banga i gamtat bang himawk ahi hiam?" ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in a leeng kithawi sakin ama galkapte la-in,
a kitengkhia leeng za guk leh Izipt leeng khempeuh a ukte tawh kuan khawm hi.
Topa in Izipt kumpipa Faro' lungsim khauhsak a, amaute kithamuanna tawh a paikhiat laitakun amah in Israel mite delh hi.
Izipt mite ahi, Faro' sakolte, leengte, ama sakol tuangte leh a galkapte in amaute delh uh a, amaute giahphual satin tuipi-ah a omna uh, Pihahiroth gei, Baalzefon nisuahna lam munah pha uh hi.
Faro hong nai ciangin Israel mite khuadak to uh hi, en in, amaute' nungah Izipt mite hong kuan hi; amaute lau mahmah uh hi. Topa' tungah Israel mite kiko uh hi;
amaute in Moses' kiangah, "Izipt-ah han a om loh manin gamlakah a si dingin kote hong paikhiatpih na hi hiam? Izipt panin paikhiatpihna tawh kote' tungah bang hong bawl na hi hiam?
'Kote hong hici omsak in la, Izipt mite' na hong semsak in,' ci-in Izipt-ah nang' tungah hong gen hi lo ka hi uh hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh gamlak-a sih sangin Izipt mite' na sep ding pen kote' adingin hoih zaw ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Moses in mite' tungah, "Kihta kei un, kip takin ding un, amah in note adingin tu ni-a hong sep ding Topa' hotkhiatna mu un; bang hang hiam cih leh tu ni-a na muh uh Izipt mite, note in na mukik nawn kei ding uh hi.
Topa in note adingin hong dosak ding a, note ahih leh na om hithiat ding uh hi bek hi," a ci hi.
Topa in Moses' kiangah, "Bang hangin kei' tungah hong kiko na hi hiam? Israel mite mainawt-in a pai ding gen in.
Israel mite in leikeu tung tawnin tuipi a kantan theih nadingin na ciangkhut laamto in la, tuipi tungah na khut zan-in khenkham in.
Amau' nungah amaute hong pai-in, keimah in Faro leh a mi honpite khempeuh, a leengte, a sakol tuangte ka zawhna hangin minthan'na ka ngah nading hi. Keimah in Izipt mite' lungsim ka khauhsak ding a, amaute in hong nungdelh ding uh hi.
Faro leh ama' leengte leh ama' sakol tuangte ka zawhna hangin minthan'na ka ngah khit ciangin keimah in Topa ka hihna thu Izipt mite in thei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel honpite' mai-ah a pai Pasian' vantungmi kikhin-in amaute' nungah pai hi; amaute' mai panin meii khuam kikhinin amaute' nung-ah ding a,
Izipt honpite leh Israel honpite' kikal-ah pai hi. Tua lai-ah meii leh khuamial om hi; zan tawntung khat leh khat kinai kha loin zingsang khua hong vak hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in tuipi tungah a khut zan hi; Topa in zan tawntung nisuahna huihpi hat tawh tuipi leh luan'sakin, tuipi pen leikeu-in bawl a, tuite kikhen hi.
Israel mite tuipi laizang leikeu tungah pai uh a, amau' taklam leh veilam-ah kawm bangin tuite om hi.
Izipt mite ahi, Faro' sakolte khempeuh, ama' leengte, leh ama' sakol tuangte in delh in tuipi laizang amaute' nungah pai uh hi.
Zingsang ciangin Topa in mei leh meii khuam sung panin Izipt mi honpite en sukin, Izipt mi honpite phial gawp a,
amau' leeng peite tumsak ahih manin man bekbak-in hawl uh hi; Izipt mite in, "Israel' mai panin tai ni; bang hang hiam cih leh Izipt mite' lang pangin Topa in amau' adingin do hi," ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses' kiangah, "Izipt mite'tung, amau' leengte' tung, amau' sakol tuangte' tungah tui hong luan' kik theih nadingin tuipi tungah na khut zan in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses in tuipi tungah a khut zan a, a zingsang khuavak ciangin a luan' ngei bangin tuipi luangkik hi; tua sungah Izipt mite tai uh a, Topa in tuipi laizangah Izipt mite tui tumsak hi.
Tui hong luangkikin leengte leh sakol tuangte leh tuipi sungah amaute a delh Faro' mi honpite khempeuh tuum hi; amaute khat zong suakta lo hi.
Ahih hangin tuipi kantanin leikeu tungah Israel mite pai uh a, amau' taklam leh veilam-ah kawm bangin tuite om hi.
Topa in tua bangin Izipt mite' khut sung panin tua ni-in Israelte honkhia hi; tuipi gei-ah Izipt mi a site Israel mite in mu uh hi.
Israelte in Izipt mite' tungah Topa' bawl nasepna lianpi mu uh a, mite in Topa zahtak uh hi; amaute in Topa leh ama' nasem Moses um uh hi.
Tua ciangin Moses leh Israel mite in Topa' tungah hih la sa uh a, "Topa tungah la ka sa ding hi, amah in minthangin zo khin a, amah in sakol leh a tuangpa tuipi sungah lawn hi.
Topa in ka hatna leh ka lungdamna hi a, amah in keima' kihotkhiatna suak khin hi; hih in keima' Pasian hi, amah ka phat ding hi, ka pa' Pasian hi, amah ka liansak ding hi.
Topa in gal hang mi hi a, Topa in ama' min ahi hi.
"Faro' leengte leh a galkap honpite amah in tuipi sungah lawn a, a kitengkhia ama uliante San Tuipi sungah tum hi.
Tui in amaute tuum a, suangtum bangin a thukna sungah amaute kiasuk uh hi.
Topa aw, na taklam khut, vangliatna-ah minthang hi, Topa aw, na taklam khut in galte thehthang hi.
Nangma' vangliatna tawh nangmah in na langte na lawnthal hi; nang in na hehna na khah khia a, tua in amaute buhkung bangin kangtum hi.
Na nak ging tawh tuite kiciangto a, tuite a lom-in kawm bangin ding to hi; tuipi sungah tui thukpi khal hi.
Galte in, 'ka delh dinga, ka pha ding hi. A nate uh ka hawm ding a, ka deih zahzah-in tuate ka tang ding hi. Ka namsau ka dok ding a, ka khut in amaute susia ding hi,' ci hi.
Nang in na huih tawh na mut a, tuipi in amaute tuum hi; a kihtakhuai tui sungah haknaw bangin amaute tum uh hi.
"Topa aw, pasiante' lakah kua in nang tawh kibang ahi hiam? Kua in nang tawh kibangin, siangthona-ah lianin, minthang nasepna-ah kihtakhuai-in, nalamdang sem ahi hiam?
Nang in na taklam khut na zan a, leitung in amaute nawmvalh hi.
"Nangmah in na ciamsa zui-in na tatkhiatsa mite na paipih hi, nangmah in na hatna tawh a siangtho na omna-ah amaute lam na lak hi.
Mite in za khin uh a, amaute liing uh hi; Filistia-ah a teng mite gimna in mancip hi.
Tu-in Edom ukpite lungkia uh a, Moab makaite, liin'na in mancip hi; Kanaan-ah a teeng mite khempeuh tuisuak khin uh hi.
Launa leh kihtakna amau' tungah tung a, nangmah' thahat vangliatna hangin amaute suangtum bangin taang loin om uh a, Topa aw, nangma' mite in a khen' mateng, nangma' leisa mite in a khen' mateng, amaute khikcip uh hi.
Nang in amaute hong paipihin nangma' mual tungah amaute na suan ding a, Topa aw, nangma' om nading mun-a na bawlsa munah, Topa aw, na khutte in a phuhsa na biakinn-ah, na koih ding hi.
Topa in uk tawntung ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Faro' sakolte ama' leengte tawh, a sakol tuangte tuipi sungah a pai ciangin, Topa in tuipi tuite amaute tuumsak kik hi; ahih hangin Israel mite tuipi laizang leikeu tungah pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Aaron' sanggamnu, numei kamsang, Miriam in a khut-ah khuang khat tawi hi; ama' nungah numeite khempeuh lamin khuang tawh zui uh hi.
Miriam in amaute la sak hi: "Topa la sak un, amah in minthangin zo khin, amah in sakol leh a tuangpa tuipi sungah lawn hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in San Tuipi panin Israel mite paipih suak a, amaute Shur gamlakah pai uh hi; gamlak-ah amaute ni thum pai uh a, tui mu lo uh hi.
Amaute Marah a tun' uh ciangin a tui kha ahih manin Marah tui dawn thei lo uh hi; tua ahih manin Marah ci-in min kiphuak hi.
Moses' tungah mite phun uh a, "Bang dawn ding i hi hiam?" ci uh hi.
Topa' tungah amah kiko hi; Topa in singkung khat amah lak a, amah in tui sungah tua sing lawn a, tui lim hong suak pah hi. Topa in tua lai munah amaute adingin thukham khat leh ngeina kip khat bawl a, tua lai mun-ah amah in amaute' tungah ze-et hi. Amah in,
"Note in Topa na Pasian' thu lim takin na ngaih uh a, ama' maiah a man nate hih-in, ama' thupiakte don a, ama' ngeina kipte khempeuh na zuih uh leh, Izipt mite' tungah ka tun'sak natnate khat beek note' tungah kong tungsak kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in Topa, note hong damsakpa ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute ciktui sawm-le-nih leh nisuh kung sawmsagih a omna mun Elim tung uh hi; tui gei tua mun-ah amaute in giahphual sat uh hi.
Amaute Elim panin ding khia uh a, Izipt leitang panin a paikhiat zawh uh a kha nihna ni sawm-le-nga ni-in Elim leh Sinai kikal-a om Sin gamlakah Israel mi honpite khempeuh tung uh hi.
Gamlakah Moses leh Aaron' tungah Israel mihon buppi phun uh a,
amaute' tungah, "Kote sabeel phungah tu-in ka kham takun an ka nek lai-un Izipt leitangah Topa in hong that khin hi zaw ta leh; bang hang hiam cih leh mihon buppi gilkialna tawh a that dingin note in gamlakah nong paikhiatpih uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Mose' kiangah, "En in, note adingin vantung panin an kong zusak ding hi; keima' thu a zuih uh leh a zuih loh uh ka theihtel nadingin mite paikhia-in ni simin ni khat kham khop ding kaikhawm ding uh hi.
A ni guk ni-in mite in amau' ciahpihte a bawl uh ciangin nisim-a a khop ngei zah nih pha ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses leh Aaron in Israel mite' tungah, "Nitak ciangin Izipt leitang panin note hong paikhiatpihpa in Topa a hihna na thei ding uh a,
Topa' tunga na phunna uh amah in za khin ahih manin zingsang ciangin Topa' minthan'na na mu ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh kote' tungah na phun theih nadingun kote in a bang hi mawk ka hi uh hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Moses in, "Ama' tungah na phunnate uh Topa in a zakna hangin, Topa in note' tungah nitakin nek ding sa, zingsangin kham tak-a na nek ding uh an hong piak ciangin—kote in a bang hi mawk ka hi uh hiam? Note' phunnate in kote' tung hi loin Topa' tung ahi hi," a ci hi.
Moses in Aaron' kiangah, "Israel mihon buppi' tungah, 'Amah in note' phunnate za khin ahih manin Topa' mai a nai-ah hong pai un,' ci in," a ci hi.
Israel mihon buppi' tungah Aaron in thu a gen lai takin, amaute in gamlak lam en uh hi, en in, meii sungah Topa' minthan'na hong kilang hi.
"Israel mite' phunnate ka za khin hi; amaute' kiangah, 'Khuamui ciangin note in sa na ne ding uh a, zingsang ciangin an na kham ding uh hi; tua ciangin keimah in Topa na Pasian uh ka hihna na thei ding uh hi,' ci in," a ci hi.
Nitak ciangin vamimte hong tungin giahphual tuam hi; zingsang ciangin giahphual kiim-ah daitui kia hi.
Daitui a kap ciangin gamlak lei maitang tungah a pa dildel a, a khal, vukkhal banga a pa dildel leitungah om hi.
Israel mite in a muh uh ciangin amaute khat leh khat in, "Bang ahi hiam?" kici uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in tua pen bang hiam cih thei lo uh hi. Moses in amaute' kiangah, "Topa in nek dinga note' tungah hong piak an ahi hi.
Topa' thupiak in hih bang hi: 'Note in na milip-un na kham zah ding uh khawm un; note in na puanbuk sung uh-ah a om mi zah tawh kituakin mi khat in lawhta khat ciat na la ding uh hi,' ci hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Tua mah bangin Israel mite gamta uh hi; amaute in kaikhawm uh a, kimkhat in tam, kimkhat in tawm kaikhawm hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in lawhta khat tawh a teh uh ciangin a tam a kaikhawmpa aa dim val lo a, tawm a kaikhawmpa' aa dim lah lo hi; a milip-in a kham zah ding khawm uh hi.
Moses in amaute' kiangah, "Kuamah in zingsang dong koih kei hen," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in Moses' thu ngai lo uh hi; mi pawl khat in zingsang dong koih uh a, than omin ning hi; amaute' tungah Moses heh hi.
Zingsang simin amaute in a kham zah ding ciat uh khawm uh hi; ahih hangin ni a sat ciangin tuisuak hi.
A ni guk ni-in amaute in an a zah nih, lawhta nih ciat, khawm uh hi; mihon makaite khempeuh hong pai-in Moses' kiangah a gen uh ciangin,
amah in amaute' kiangah, "Hih in Topa' hong thupiak ahi hi: 'Zing ciang pen a thupi-a tawlngak ni, Topa' adingin sabbath siangtho ni ahi hi; na em dingte uh em-in, na huan dingte uh huan un la, a om lai teng zingsang ciang dong koih un,' ci hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Moses' sawl bangin zingsang dong koih uh hi; ning lo a, a sungah thante om lo hi.
Moses in , "Tu ni-in ne un, tu ni-in Topa adingin sabbath ahi hi; tu ni-in gamlakah na mu kei ding uh hi;
Note in ni guk sung na khawm ding uh hi; ahih hangin sabbath ni ahi a ni sagih ni-in bang mah om lo ding hi," a ci hi.
A ni sagih ni-in a kaikhawm dingin mi pawl khat kuan khia uh a, amaute in bangmah mu lo uh hi.
Topa in Moses' kiangah, "Ka thupiakte leh ka thute zuih ding bang tan vei nial ding na hi hiam?
Thei in! Topa in nang' tungah sabbath hong pia zo hi, tua ahih ciangin a ni guk ni-in amah in nang' tungah ni nih ading an hong pia hi; note na milip-un nomau' omna ciatah om un, a ni sagih ni-in ama' omna panin kuamah paikhia kei hen," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a ni sagih ni-in mite tawlnga hi.
Tu-in Israel mite in a min manna ci uh hi; tua pen nannan tang tawh kibangin, a meel kang a, a limna pen, khuaizu tawh a kibawl mohpheng tawh kibang hi.
Moses in, "Hih in Topa' thupiaksa ahi hi: 'Izipt leitang panin note kong paikhiatpih lai-in gamlakah note kong vakna an amaute in a muh theih nadingun na khang tawntungun lawhta dim khat kem un,' ci hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Moses in Aaron' kiangah, "Beel khat la in la, tua sungah manna lawhta dim khat koih in la, na khang tawntungun a kikem dingin Topa' mai-ah koih in," a ci hi.
Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin Aaron in kep dingin Tecipan'na mai-ah koih hi.
Amaute' teen' theih nading leitang a tun' mateng, kum sawmli sung Israel mite in manna ne uh hi; amaute Kanaan gamgi a tun' matengun manna ne uh hi.
(Lawhta khat in seu khat seh-sawm-suah-seh-khat ahi hi.)
Topa' thupiak bangin Israel mihon khempeuh Sin gamlak panin giahphual a ban banin sat uh a, Refidim-ah phual sat uh hi; ahih hangin mite' dawn ding tui om lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mite in Moses' mawhna zong uh a, "Tui dawn ding hong pia in," ci uh hi. Moses in amaute' kiangah, "Bang hangin kei tungah mawhna hong zong na hi uh hiam? Bang hangin Topa ze-et na hi uh hiam?" ci hi.
Ahih hangin tua mun-ah tui duhin mite dangtak uh a, Moses tungah mite phun-in, "Kote leh ka tate uh leh ka ganhingte uh dangtakin a si dingin bang hangin Izipt panin kote hong paipih to na hi hiam?" ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa' tungah Moses kiko a, "Hih mite bang cih ding ka hi hiam? Suang tawh kei hong deeng dingin amaute kithawi uh hi," a ci hi.
Topa in Moses' kiangah, "Israel upate pawl khat samin mite mai-ah pai in; Nail na satna ciangkhut na khut-in tawi in la, pai in.
En in, Horeb-a suangpi-ah nangma' mai-ah ka ding ding hi; nang in suangpi na sat ding a, mite in tui a dawn theih nadingin tua suang panin tui hong phul khia ding hi," a ci hi. Isarel upate' muhna-ah tua mah bangin Moses gamta hi.
Israel mite' mawh zon'na leh amaute in Topa ze-etin, "Eite' lakah Topaom hiam om lo hiam?" a cihna hangun, amah in tua mun pen Massah leh Meribah ci-in min phuak hi.
Tua ciangin Amalek mite hong pai-in Israel mite tawh Refidim-ah kido uh hi.
Moses in Joshua' kiangah, "Eite adingin mi teel in la, paikhia-in Amalek mite tawh kido in; zing ciangin ka khut sungah Pasian' ciangkhut tawh mual dawn-ah ka ding ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih bangin Joshua gamta a, Amalekte tawh kido uh hi, Moses, Aaron leh Hurte mual dawn ah paito uh hi.
Moses in a khut a san'sak peuhmah ciangin Israel in neh hi; amah in a khut a niamsak peuhmah ciangin Amalekte in neh hi.
Ahih hangin Moses a khut kham hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute in suangtum khat la-in ama' nuai-ah koih uh a, tua tungah amah tu a, Aaron leh Hur in a pang khat tuak panin ama' khutte len uh hi; tua ahih ciangin nitum mateng ama' khutte kip hi.
Joshua in Amalek leh ama' mite namsau tawh vat maai hi.
Topa in Moses' kiangah, "Keimah in vantung nuai khempeuh panin Amalek mite a kiphawkna ka phiat siangtho nading thu phawk nadingin hih thu laibu sung khatah gelh in la, Joshua' kiangah genkik in," a ci hi.
Moses in biakna tau khat lamin a min dingin Topa in keima' zawhna lim ahi hi, ci-in phuak a,
"Topa' dial len in! Topa in a khang khangin Amalek mite do ding hi," a ci hi.
Moses' sungpa, Midian siampi Jethro in Moses leh ama' mi Israelte' adingin Pasian' bawlsa khempeuh, Topa in Izipt panin Israel mite a paikhiatpihna thu za hi.
Tu-in Moses' sungpa Jethro in, amah in a sawl kik khit-a kipanin Moses' zi Zipporah leh ama' tapa nihte kem a, a khat min in Gershom ahi hi (Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, "Gam dangah peemta ka hi hi," ci hi),
a dang khat' min in Eliezer ahi hi (bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, "Ka pa' Pasian in keimah hong huhpa hi a, Faro' namsau panin kei hong honkhia hi," ci hi.)
Pasian' mual tungah giahphual a satna gamlak Moses' kiangah ama' tapate leh a zi tawh, Moses' sungpa Jethro hong pai hi.
Mi khat in Moses' kiangah, "En in, na zi leh a tapa nihte tawh nang' kiangah na sungpa Jethro hong pai hi," a cih ciangin
a sungpa dawn dingin Moses paikhia a, zahtakna pia-in amah nam hi; amaute khat leh khat omzia kidong tuak uh a, puanbuk sungah pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in a sungpa' kiangah Topa in Israel mite hangin Faro tung leh Izipt mite' tungah a bawlte khempeuh, lampi-ah amau' tungah a tung haksatna khempeuh leh Topa in amaute a hotkhiatna thu gen hi.
Izipt mite' khut sung panin amah in amaute a khahkhiatna, Israel mite' tungah Topa in a hoih a bawlte khempeuh hangin Jethro lungdam hi.
Jethro in, "Izipt mite leh Faro' khut sung panin note hong khahkhia Topa in thupha ngah ta hen.
Topa in pasian khempeuh sangin a liat zawkna tu-in ka thei hi, bang hang hiam cih leh mite' tungah kiphatsakna tawh Izipt mite a gamtat lai takin amah in Iziptte' khut nuai panin mite khahkhia hi," a ci hi.
Moses' sungpa Jethro in Pasian' tungah meihal biakna leh biak piakna bawl hi; Pasian' mai-ah Moses' sungpa tawh an a ne dingin Israel upate khempeuh tawh Aaron hong pai hi.
A zing ciangin mite thukhen dingin Moses tu a, zingsang a kipan nitak dongin Moses' kiim-ah mite ding uh hi.
Mihingte adingin ama' hihte khempeuh Moses' sungpa in a muh ciangin, amah in, "Mihingte' adinga nang' sep hih in bang ahi hiam? Bang hangin nang bek tu a, zingsanga kipan nitak dongin na kiim-ah mite khempeuh ding ahi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Moses in a sungpa' kiangah, "Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian' deihna kan dingin kei' kiangah mite hong pai hi;
amaute in thu a neih uh ciangin kei' kiangah hong pai uh a, mi khat leh a vengpa' kikal-ah thu ka khen a, Pasian' ngeina kipte leh ama' thukhennate amaute ka theisak hi," a ci hi.
Moses' sungpa in ama' kiangah, "Nangma' hih zia hoih lo hi.
Nang leh nangmah tawh a om mite in na zawngkhal lawh ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh tua nasep in nang' ading gik lua hi; nang bek in na sem khin zo kei hi.
Tu-in ka thu hong ngai in; thu kong lak ding hi, Pasian in nang tawh hong om ta hen; Nangmah in Pasian' mai-ah mite' tangin pai-in, amau' thute Pasian' kiangah na gen ding hi;
nangmah in ngeina kipte leh thukhennate amaute na hilh ding a, amau' lam pai nading leh amau' sep dingte amaute na theisak ding hi.
Tua tham loin, mi khempeuh lak panin Pasian a zahtak mi, a muanhuai mi leh sumgolh a mudah mi, misiamte na teelkhia ding hi; tua bang mite pen mi a tul, a za, a sawmnga, a sawmte' tungah a uk dingin na koih ding hi.
Mite' thu amaute khensak tawntung in; amaute in thu lian peuhmah ' kiangah hong puak ding uh hi, ahih hangin thu neute amau mah in khen tawm ding uh hi; tua hi leh nang adingin baih zaw ding hi, amaute in vangik hong puakpih ding uh hi.
Hih bangin hih lecin Pasian in thahatna hong pia ding a, nangmah in na sem paisuak zo ding hi; tua tham loin hih mite khempeuh zong amau' omna-ah lungnuam takin ciah thei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses in a sungpa' thu ngai-in ama' gen khempeuh hih hi.
Israel khempeuh' sung panin Moses in mipil misiamte teel a, mite a tul, a za, a sawmnga, a sawmte' tungah a uk-in mite lutang-in amaute bawl hi.
Amaute in mite' tungah a tawntungin thukhen uh hi; amaute in thuhaksate Moses' tungah puak uh a, ahih hangin thu neute amaute in khen tawm uh hi.
