Bang a cih nopna ahi hiam, ci-in na mipihte in hong dot uh ciangin,
amaute kiangah, Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: Israel ciangkhut la-in Judah ciangkhut tawh ka koihkhawm ding hi. Tua ciangkhut nihte ciangkhut khat-in ka bawl ding a, ka khut sungah ka tawi ding hi, ci hi, ci-in gen in.
Tua na gelh ciangkhut nihte mite' muhin na khut sungah tawi in la,
amaute kiangah, Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Amaute' omna minam dangte lak panin Israel mite la-in ka kaikhawm ding a, amaute' gamah ka paipih kik ding hi.
Israel mual tung gamah, amaute minam khatin ka gawmkik ding hi. Amaute in a uk ding khat nei ding uh a, amaute minam nih-in kikhen nawn lo ding uh a, kumpi nih-in kikhen nawn lo ding uh a, kumpi gam nih-in zong kikhen nawn lo ding uh hi.
Amaute pen a muhdahhuai milimte tawh kininsak nawn lo ding uh a, mawhnate tawh zong kisiasak nawn lo ding uh hi. Amaute' mawhna leh kei hong lehheknate panin ka suakta sak ding hi. Amaute a siangtho mi-in ka bawl ding a, amaute in keima mi hi-in, kei in amaute' Pasian ka hi ding hi.
Ka nasempa David in amaute' kumpi hi ding a, mi khat ukna nuai-ah amaute kigawmin, ka thukhamte hoih takin zui ding uh hi.
A pu a pate uh a ten' nasa ahi ka nasempa Jakob tungah ka piak leitangah amaute teeng ding uh a, amaute bek hi loin a suan a khak dongun teeng suak ding uh hi. Ka nasempa David in amaute uk tawntung ding hi.
Amaute lungmuangin a om tawntung nading uh thuciamna khat ka bawl ding a, amaute thupha pia-in a mi ka pungsak ding hi. Amaute lakah a om tawntung dingin ka biakinnpi ka phut ding hi.
Amaute tawh teeng khawmin, amaute' Pasian ka hi ding a, amaute pen keima mite hi ding hi.
Amaute lakah a om tawntung dingin ka biakinnpi ka koih ciangin, Topa ahi keimah in keima mi dingin Israel mite ka bawl khitna thu, minam dangte khempeuh in thei ding uh hi," hong ci hi.
"Ezekiel aw, Magog gama om Gog kumpipa mawhsakna thu gen in. Amah in Meshek minamte leh Tubal minamte a ukpipa ahi hi. Amah mawhsakna thu gen in la,
Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Meshek leh Tubal minamte a ukpipa Gog aw, kei in nangma langah ka pang hi.
Nang hong lehhei-in, na khaguh ah sikkawi kong bulh ding a, na galkap honpite khempeuh tawh kong kaikhia ding hi. Na galkap honpite pen a sakolte uh leh a sakol tung tuangte tawh tam mahmah a , na galkap khempeuh in lum leh namsau nei kim uh hi.
Persia gam, Kush gam, leh Put gam mite in zong nang hong panpih uh a, amaute in lum leh siklukhu nei kim uh hi.
Leilu lam gam peka om Gomer gama galkapte khempeuh leh Beth-togarmah gama galkapte khempeuh in nang hong pan'pih uh a, minam dang tampite in zong nang hong pawlpih uh hi.
Tua ahih manin tu-in nang leh na pawlte khempeuh a kigalging sa-in om un la, na thupiakna bangin gamtang pah lian dingin na galkapte khempeuh om sak in.
Minam tuamtuamte lak panin kikaikhawm kikin a gam uh a kitut kik zawh gal launa nei loin a om Israel mite' gam a sim dingin kum tampi khit ciangin kong sawl ding hi. Sau veipi sung kinusia-in gamkhing a suak ngei hi napi-in, tu-in a mite khempeuh lungmuang takin a omna Israel mual tung gamte a sim ding na hi hi.
Nang leh na galkap honpite leh nang hong pawlpih minam tampite in khuapi huih bangin na sim gawp ding uh a, meiipi bangin a gam sung khempeuh na tuamcip ding uh hi.
"Topa Pasian ahi keimah in nang Gog tungah kong gen in ah: Tua hun ding hong tun' ciangin na lungsim sungah gitloh gamtat ding ngaihsut na kipan ding hi.
A khuapite in gal nan' nading kulh nei loin, lungmuang takin a om hithiat, a kihu tawm zo lo ding gam khat, simgawp ding na ngaihsun ding hi.
A sia ngeisa khuapite sunga teeng mite luhin a nate uh na sut gawp ding hi. Tua mite pen minam tuamtuamte lak panin a kikaikhawm kik, tu-in ganhing leh neihsa van zong nei kikin, leitung lam lian khempeuh a kituahna lam kabom san-a teeng mite ahi uh hi.
Sheba mite leh Dedan mite' leh Tarshish khuapite-a teeng sumbukte in nang kiangah, 'Ngun leh khamte, ganhingte leh vante na ngahna dingin luh gawpin a sutgawp ding leh gen zawh loh van tampite tawh a ciah khia dingin galsim dingin na galkapte na kaikhawm nai hiam?' ci-in hong dong ding uh hi," ci-in gen in hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa Pasian in kei kiangah, "Ezekiel aw, Gog kiangah hih bangin thu gen in hong ci hi: Keima mi Israelte lungmuang takin a om hun lai takin nangmah na kihanthawn tawm ding a,
leilu lam pek-a na omna gam panin, sakol tung vive-ah a tuang, minam tampite kiang panin na kaihkhop a thahat galkap hon tampite masuanin na kuan khia ding a,
khuapi huih in gam sung teng a nawk gawp bangin keima mi Israelte na sim ding hi. A hun a tun' ciangin, nangmah zangin na ka sepna tawh minamte lakah ka siangthona ka lah theihna dingin keima gam a sim dingin kong sawl ding hi.
Ni khat ni ciangin Israel mite a sim dingin mi khat ka sawl ding hi, ci-in keima nasemte ahi, Israel kamsangte tung tawnin, sawt pek lai-in ka gengen niloh mipa in nang na hi hi. Hih thu Topa Pasian in gen khin zo hi.
Topa Pasian in: Ahi zongin Gog in Israel gam a sim ni ciangin ka heh suak mahmah ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin ka heh luatna tawh Israel gamah nakpi takin ziin' liing hen, ka ci ding hi.
Ngasate leh vasate, ganhing a neu a lian, leh leitunga om mi khempeuh, keimah kihtakna hangin lau-in liing ding uh hi. Mualte pukin, keente cimin, kulh leh phung khempeuh kicim mang ding hi.
Gimna a tuamtuamte tawh Gog ka lausak gawp ding hi. Topa Pasian in hih thu ka gen khin hi. Ama mite khat leh khat namsau tawh kisat gawp ding uh hi.
Pulnatna leh sisan luan'na tawh amah daan ka pia ding hi. Amah leh a galkap honte leh amah a pan'pih minam tampite tungah guahpi, gialpi, meikuang leh kaat kuang, ka zusak ding hi.
Hih bangin hihna tawh keimah in a lian a siangtho ka hihna thu, minam khempeuh tungah ka langsak ding a, tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu amaute in hong thei ding uh hi," hong ci hi.
Topa Pasian in kei kiangah, "Ezekiel aw, Gog mawhsakna thu gen in la, Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi, ci-in gen in: Meshek leh Tubal minamte a ukpipa Gog aw, keimah in nangma lang khatah a pang ka hi hi.
Mundang khatah nang kong pai sak ding a, leilu lam pek gam panin Israel mual tung gamah kong tun'pih ding hi.
Tua lai mun panin na vei lam khutah na tawi na thal hong betkhiatsakin, na tak lam khutah na tawi na thaltangte zong kong betkhiatsak ding hi.
Nang leh na galkap honte leh nang hong pan'pih minam khempeuhte pen Israel mual tung gamah na si mang ding uh a, vasa nam khempeuh leh gamsate in na sa uh ne ding uh hi.
Topa Pasian in hih thu gen khin ka hih manin gamlakah na tuk zeizai ding uh hi.
Kuamah in nawngkaisak loin nuam takin mite a om hithiatna Magog gam sung leh tuipih gei-a gamte ka hal ding a, tua ciangin Topa ka hihna thu mi khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi.
Keima mi Israelte lakah ka min siangtho ka kitheisak ding a, keima min a dai dingin ka om sak nawn kei ding hi. Tua ciangin keimah pen a Siangtho, Israelte' Pasian ahi Topa ka hihna thu minam khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi," hong ci hi.
Topa Pasian in, "Tua ka gengen ni thu hong tung takpi ding hi.
Israel gam khuapite-ah a teeng mite kuankhia-in, tua a kinusia galhiamte sing cih dingin khawm ding uh hi. Tua a kinusia lumte, thal leh, thaltangte, molhtumte, leh teipite, mei-in cih ding uh a, kum sagih sung kikhom ding hi.
Amaute in mei cih dingin a kinusia galhiamte nei uh ahih manin gamlakah sing tom kul lo ding a, tulakah sing phuk ding zong kisam lo ding hi. Amaute in amau' na a sutte' na sutin, a suksiatsakte' na suksiatsak ding uh hi. Topa Pasian in thu ka gen khin hi," hong ci hi.
Topa in, "Hih thu hong pian' ni ciangin Israel gam sung Si Tuipi nisuahna lama om khualzin mite' Kuam a cihna sung teng, a kivui nadingun Gog ka pia ding hi. Gog leh a galkap honpite, tua lai munah kivui ding ahih manin khualzin mite' lampi khaktan ding a, tua mun pen, 'Gog' Galkapte' Kuam,' kici ding hi.
Israel mite in a gam sung uh a sian'sak kik nadingin misi vuina-in kha sagih sung hun bei ding hi.
Gam sunga om mi khempeuh in misi vuina-ah huh ding uh a, tua bangin a huhna hangun ka gualzawh ni-in pahtawina ngah ding uh hi. Topa Pasian keimah in hih thu ka gen khin hi.
Kha sagih a cin' khit ciangin, a gam sung teng uh a siangthosak theih nadingun a kimangngilh kha siluang hawmte zongin a phum dingin gam sung tengah a zong kawikawi ding mi pawlkhat seh ding uh hi.
Gam sung teng a zon' kawikawina uhah misi guh a muh simun, misi vuite in hong tawmin Gog' Galkapte' Kuam-ah a vui hun ma sung teng a kitheih nadingin a gei-ah ciamtehna khat bawl pahpah ding uh hi.
(Tua galkap honpite' min tamin a gei-ah khuapi khat om hi.) Tua bangin gam sung siangsak kik ding uh hi," hong ci hi.
Topa Pasian in kei kiangah, "Ezekiel aw, amaute' adingin ka bawlsak biak piakna sa a ne dingin mun khempeuh panin vasa khempeuh leh ganhing khempeuh hong pai nadingun sam in. Israel mual tung gamah pawi lianpi mahmah khat om ding a, a duh zahzahun sa ne-in si dawn ding uh hi.
Bashan panin tuutalte, tuunote, keelte leh bawngtal thaute a kigawh bangin a kigo ahi galkapte' sate ne-in, leitung gam ukte' site a dawn ding ahi uh hi.
Biak nadinga gawh bangin hih mite ka gawh ciangin vasate leh ganhingte in a nek zawh zahzah uh a thaute ne ding uh a, a kham dongin a si dawn ding uh hi.
Amaute in ka sabuai tungah, sakolte leh a tunga tuangte, galkapte leh galkap mangte' sa, a nek zawh zahzah uh ne ding uh hi. Topa Pasian in hih thu ka gen khin hi," hong ci hi.
Topa in kei kiangah, "Minamte lakah ka minthan'na ka lak ding a, thu a tangin ka khennate ka sep khiat theih nadingin ka vangliatna ka zatna dan amaute tungah ka lak ding hi.
Tua khit-a kipanin amaute' Topa Pasian ka hihna thu, Israel mite in hong thei ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin kei tungah hong khialhna hangin Israel mite sal suak uh a, amaute nungngatin, a galte uh khut sungah pia-in gal sungah a vekun a sisak ka hihna,
leh amaute' nitna leh a gitlohna uh tawh kituakin amaute tungah bawlin, amaute a nungngat ka hihna thu, minam dangte in thei ding uh hi," hong ci hi.
Topa Pasian in kei kiangah, "Tu-in Jakob suan leh khakte saltan'na panin ka pikhia kik ding a, Israelte khempeuh ka hehpih ding a, amaute a cithei-in ka bawl kik ding hi. Keima min siangtho ka hu ta ding hi.
Amaute gam sungah kuamah in su loin lungmuangin a om kik uh hun ciangin, kei hong lehbawlnate uh leh a mindainate uh mangngilh thei ta ding uh hi.
Kei a siangtho ka hihna thu, minam tampite tungah ka lah nadingin a galte uh a omna gamdang khempeuh panin amaute la khia-in ka kaikhawm kik ding hi.
Tua ciangin, minam dangte khut sungah sal-in amaute puakin, tua khit ciangin amaute khat zong siit loin kaikhawm kikin a gam sung uh ka tun'pih kimna hangin amaute Topa Pasian ka hihna thu, keima mite in hong thei ding uh hi.
Israel mite tungah ka kha ka pia ding a, amaute ka nungngat nawn kei ding hi. Topa Pasian in hih thu ka gen khin hi," hong ci hi.
Jerusalem khuapi a kilak zawh a kum sawm leh lina kum, sal-a hong kipaipih zawh a kum sawmnih leh ngana, a kha masa a ni sawm ni-in ka sungah Topa hong om lamtak ka kiphawk a, amah in kei hong paikhiatpih hi.
Ka maang sungah, Pasian in Israel gamah hong paipih a, mual sang khat tungah hong koih hi. Khuapi tawh a kibang inn honpi bang khat ka mai-ah ka mu hi.
Amah in tua khuapi nai-ah hong paipih a, sumngo bangin a tee mi khat ka mu hi. Tua mipa in pikhau khat leh piciang khat tawi a, kongpi gei-ah ding hi.
Ka muh pen biakinn na hi a, a kimkotah kulh om hi. A mipa in tong guk a sau tehna piciang la-in a kulh teh hi. A teh ciangin tong guk sahin, tong guk mah sang hi.
Tua ciangin nisuahna lama om kulh kongpi-ah pai a, a kahlei-ah kahto-in a khung a tun' ciangin kulh kongvang teh a, tong guk mah sang hi.
Tua ban-ah lampi khat om a, a lampi pang tuakah galvilna inndei neu thum tuak om hi. Inndei neute a dung a vai kikim a, tong guk mah ahi hi. Inndei neu khat leh khat kikal tong nga sah hi. Tua galvilna inndei neute banah tong guk mah a sau lampi khat om a, biakinnpi lam a maingat inndei golzaw sung tung hi.
Hih inndei golzaw a teh ciangin tong giat, pha hi.
Hih inndei pen biakinn tun' nading lampi tawpna hi a, a biakinn lam nehpen-a om kawm pen tong nih sah hi.
(Hih lampi pang tuak-a om galvilna inndei neute pen a golna kikim a, a kikal-a kawmte zong a sahna kikim hi.)
Tua ciangin a mipa in a lampi teh a, tong sawm zai-in tong sawm leh thum sau hi.
Tua galvilna inndei neu mai ciatah tong khat sangin tong khat a sah kidalna khat om hi. (Hih galvilna inndei neute pen a dung a vai tong guk tuak ahi hi.)
Tua ciangin inndei neu kawm nung panin lampi kantanin a gal san-a inndei neu kawm nung dong teh a, tong sawmnih leh nga pha hi.
Inndei nunung pen zomah biakinntual om a, tua tual a teh ciangin tong sawmnih pha hi.
Kulhkong pua panin inndei nawlnung kawm pua dong lampi sauna tong sawmnga pha hi.
Hih inndei neute kawm a pua lam pangah khua-etna vangneu om a, inndei kikal-a om kawm tungah zong a vangneu om hi. Lampi omna lam pang, inndei kikal-a kawmte tungah nisuh kung lim kibawl hi.
Tua ciangin a mipa in kongpi tawnin a tualah hong paipih hi. A tual pualam kawm tawh kizomin inndei sawmthum om a, tua inndeite mai-ah suang a kiphah lampi om hi.
Hih suangphah pen a tual kimkotah om a, hih a pua lam-a tual pen a sung lama om tual sangin niamzaw hi.
Tua ciangin a sung lam tual lut nadingin a sang zaw-ah kongpi khat om hi. A mipa in hih kongpi nih kikal a teh ciangin tong za khat pha hi.
Tua ciangin a mipa in a pualam tual paina ahi, leilu lam pangah a om kongpi lampi hong teh hi.
Tua bangin a teh ciangin lampi pang tuaka om galvilna inndei neu thumte, a kikal a, om kawmte leh a inndei golzaw pen, nisuahna kongpi-ate mah bangin a dung a vai kikim ciat hi. Tua kongpi lampi pen tong sawmnga sau a, tong sawmnih leh nga zai hi.
A inndei golzaw, a kong vangneute, leh nisuh kung lim a kibawlte pen nisuahna lam kongpi-a omte mah tawh kibangin kikim hi. Hih lai-ah zong kongpi lampi tun' nadingin kahlei dawl sagih om a, a nawlnung a, om a inndei golzaw pen in a tual lam maingat hi.
Nisuahna lam pang-a om bang teek mahin, leilu lam kongpi pan a, lutna-a a tual gal khatah tual sungnung lutna kongpi lampi khat mah om hi. Tua kongpi nih kikal a teh ciangin tong za khat sau hi.
Tua ciangin a mipa in leitaw lam pangah hong paipih a, tua lai-ah kongpi lampi khat mah na om leuleu hi. A teh ciangin a dangte mah tawh kikim hi.
Kongpi dang-a omte mah bangin hih lai-ah zong inndeite in kongvangneu nei uh hi. A kongpi lampi pen tong sawmnga sau-in tong sawmnih leh nga zai hi.
Tua kongpi lampi tun' nadingin kahlei cial sagih mah om a, a inndei golzaw pen a nawlnung mahah omin a tual lam nga hi. Lampi omna lam pang, kawm sungnungte' tungah nisuh kung lim mah kibawl hi.
Hih lai-ah zong tual sungnung paina kong lampi khat mah om hi. A mipa in kong leh kong kikal a teh ciangin tong za khat pha hi.
Tua ciangin Leitaw lam kongpi tawnin tual sungnungah hong paipih hi. A lampi a teh ciangin a dangte mah tawh kikim hi.
A inndei golzaw pen in tual puanung lam nga hi. Lampi pang tuaka kawmte tungah nisuh kung lim kibawl a, hih kongpi lampi tun' nadingin kahlei cial giat om hi.
Tua ciangin nisuahna lam kongpi tawnin a tual sungnung-ah hong paipih hi. A lampi a teh ciangin a dangte mah tawh kikim hi.
A galvilna inndei neute, a inndei golzaw, leh a kawm sungnungte zong, kongpi dang-ate mah tawh kikim hi. A kimkotah kongvangneute om a , a inndei golzaw ah zong om hi. A lampi tong sawmnga sau a, tong sawmnih leh nga zai hi.
A inndei golzaw pen a tual puanung lam nga hi. Lampi pang tuaka om kawmte tungah nisuh kung lim kibawl a, hih kongpi lampi tun' nadingin kahlei cial giat om hi.
Tua ciangin leilu lam kongpi lampi-ah hong paipih a, a teh ciangin a dangte mah tawh kibang hi.
A dangte mah bangin hih in zong galvilna inndei neute, kawm sung lam tung kizemte, inndei gol zaw pen, leh a kimkotah kongvangneute nei hi. A lampi tong sawmnga sau a, tong sawmnih leh nga zai hi.
Tual puanung sungah lampi tawh a kimatin inndei gol khat om a, a inndei pen a tual lam nga hi. Hih lai munah biakna-in a pum a, a hal ding uh ganhing luangte silsiang uh hi.
Hih inndei gol sungah sabuai li om a, a lang tuakah nih tuakin kikoih hi. Meihal biakna-a piak ding ahi a, mawhna leh khialhna hanga biakna-in piak ding ganhingte ahi zongin, hih sabuaite tungah go uh hi.
Hih inndei pualam, leilu lam kongpi lutna pang tuakah zong sabuai nih tuak, a vekin sabuai li mah om hi.
Tua ahih manin inndei sungah sabuai li, a pua-ah sabuai li, a vekpi-in giat om a, hih sabuaite pen, biakna-in piak ding ganhingte gawhna-a kizang ahi hi.
Meihal biakna-in piak ding ganhingte bawl nadinga kizang sabuai lite pen suang a kiseek ahi hi. Tua sabuaite tong khat sang a, a dung a vai tong khat leh a lang tuak ahi hi. Biakna-in piak ding gangawhna-in a zat uh na khempeuh, hih sabuaite tungah koih uh hi.
Hih sabuaite kimkotah khut peek cia bang a zai geihual kibawl hi. Biakna-in piak ding sa khempeuh hih sabuaite tungah kikoih hi.
Tua ciangin a pualam panin a tual sungnungah hong paipih a, a tual sungnungah inndei nih na om hi. Khat pen leilu lam kongpi lam pangah omin leitaw lam nga a, a khat pen leitaw lam kongpi lam pangah omin leilu lam nga hi.
A mipa in kei kiangah hih bangin hong gen hi: Leitaw lam a nga inndei pen biakinn sungah na a sem siampite' ading hi a,
leilu lam a nga inndei pen biakna tau-ah na a sem siampite' ading ahi hi. Tua siampite khempeuh pen Zadok' suan Levi mite vive ahi uh hi. Ama na a sem dingin Topa' omna-ah amaute bek kipaisak hi, hong ci hi.
A mipa in hih tual sungnung a teh ciangin a dung a vai tong za khat tuak pha hi. A biakinn mai-ah biakna tau khat om hi.
Tua ciangin biakinn sung lutna inndei-ah hong paipih hi. Amah in a sung lutna lampi teh a, tong nga sau-in, tong sawm leh li zai a, a pang tuaka kawmte tong thum tuak sah hi.
Innsung lutna inndei pen tong sawmnih sau a, tong sawm leh nih zai a, tua lai tun' nadingin kahlei cial sawm om hi. Innsung lutna inndei pang tuakah khuampi khat tuak om hi.
Tua ciangin a mipa in a laizanga om inndei-ah hong paipih hi. Tua inndei lutna lampi teh a,
tong sawm zai a, a pang tuaka om kawmte tong nga tuak sah hi. A laizanga om inndei sung a teh ciangin tong sawmli sau a, tong sawmnih zai hi.
Tua ciangin inndei tawngnungah amah pai a, tua sung lutna lampi a teh ciangin tong nih sau-in tong guk zai a, a pang tuaka om kawmte tong sagih tuak sah hi.
Tua inndei tawngnung a teh ciangin a dung a vai tong sawmnih tuak pha hi. Tua ciangin amah in kei kiangah, "Hih lai in Siangthopen Mun ahi hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in biakinn kawm puanung teh a, tong guk tak sah hi. Hih kawm tawh a kimatin biakinn kimkotah inndei neuneu om a, tuate tong li vive zai hi.
Hih inndei neute dawl thum pha a, dawl khat gual paiphei suak-ah inndei neu sawmthum om hi. Tua inndei neute a dawl san'na tawh kizui-in a biakinn kawm pa to tektek a, tua inndei neute a nang dingin khuam a tuamin kul loin a biakinn kawm kimang toto hi.
Tua biakinn kawm pang bel-a kibawl inndei neute sungah kahlei om to a, a dawl nuainung panin a tungnung dongin kizom to hi. A inndei neute a dawl a san'na lamah a biakinn kawm a paat tektek mah bangin a sang lama om inndei neute a sung zai semsem hi.
Biakinn kimkot teng a lei kitawito a, a mun dangte sangin tong gukin sangto zaw hi. Tua mun panin biakinn kawm leh a kimkota inndei neute kipan to pan hi.
Inndei neute a kawm sahna tong nga pha a,
biakinn kimkotah suangphah bangin a kitawito-a kibawl a zaina in tong sawmnih ahi hi.
Biakinn kimkot-a om inndei neute-ah paina ding kongvang, leilu lamah khat omin, leitaw lamah khat om hi. Tua biakinn kimkotah tong nga paisuak a zai cial khat om leuleu hi.
Tua ciangin nitumna lamah biakinn lam a nga inn khat om hi. A inn dung tong sawmkua hi a, a vai tong sawmsagih hi a, a kimkota a kawm tong nga sah hi.
Tua ciangin mipa in biakinnpi teh a, tong za khat pha hi. A kimkota mun awng, a innsung leh a kawm tawh kigawmin tong za khat ahi hi.
Nisuahna lam pang biakinn mai lam a vai lamin a mun awng tawh kigawmin tong za khat mah ahi hi.
Tua ciangin biakinn nitumna lam pangah a om, a tual lam a nga inn a sauna teh a, a kawm tegel tawh kigawmin tong za mah pha hi. Biakinn sung lut nading inndei, leh a inndeipi, leh Siangthopen Mun sungte pen
a sual panin a kongvangneute ciang dong singpeek tawh kidap hi. A kongvangneute pen a pualam a kihui-a kibawl ahi hi.
Biakinn sung lam kawmte pen kongkhak zang ciang dong lim kibawlte tawh kidim a,
nisuh kungte leh kherub limte vive ahi hi. Amasa-in nisuh kung, tua ciangin kherub, nisuh kung, kherub cih bangin a kimkot khempeuh ah kihelh to dimdiam hi. Tua kherubte in maitang nih ciat nei uh hi.
A mihing maitang in a pang khat lama om nisuh kung lam nga a, a humpinelkai maitang in a pang lang khat lama om nisuh kung lam nga hi. A biakinn sung kimkotah hih bangin kibawl a,
sual panin kongkhak zang kikal sung khempeuh ah a dimin om hi.
Biakinn deipi kongkhak khuamte pen a siik kikim vive ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Siangthopen Mun mai-ah sing tawh a kibawl biakna tau tawh a kibang pian khat om hi. Tong thum sang a, a dung a vai tong nih ahi hi. A khete, a kingaknate leh a zawlte sing tawh a kibawl ahi hi. A mipa in kei kiangah, "Hih in Topa' mai-ah a kikoih sabuai ahi hi," hong ci hi.
Inndeipi sung lut nading leh Siangthopen Mun lut nading ah kongkhak om hi.
Tua kongkhakte pen a laizang-a kituah, kongkhak peek nih nei-a kibawl ahi hi.
Biakinn sung kawmte tungah a kibawl mah bangin hih biakinn deipi sung lutna-a kongkhakte tungah nisuh kung leh kherub limte kibawl hi. Kongkhak pualam, innsung lut nading inndei tung san-ah singpeek tawh liimsun khat kibawl hi.
Hih inndeipi sung kawmte tungah a pualam a kihui kongvangneute om a, nisuh kungte tawh zepna zong kibawl hi.
Tua ciangin mipa in a tual puanungah hong paipih a, biakinn nitumna lam mong-a om inn tawh a kigamla lo, biakinn leilu lam-a om inn khat hong tun'pih hi.
Leilu lam pang hih inndung tong za khat hi a, a vai tong sawmnga ahi hi.
Tua inn pang khat in biakinn gei-a mun awng tong sawmnih a zai a omna lam nga a, a pang lang khat in tua puanung a suangphah lam nga hi. Tua inn pen cial thum a pha a kitawito tungah kilam a, a tunga cialte pen a nuai-ate sangin neu to zaw tektek hi.
Hih inn leilu lam pangah tong sawm zai-in, tong za a sau lampi khat tung a, lutna kong zong tua lam mahah om hi.
A cial tungnung-a om inndeite pen a nuai-ate sangin neuzaw hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tuate pen a sangto zaw, a kawcik zaw-ah om uh hi.
Biakinn tual-a inn dangte mah bangin tua inndei dawl thumte pen a cial tungah kinga uh a, a tuamin khuam nei lo uh hi.
Leilu lam pang-a om mah bangin hih inndeite mai-ah zong lampi khat om hi. A sauna, a zaina, a pianzia leh a kongte zong leilu lama om mah tawh kibang hi.
Nisuahna lam pang-a kulh a kipatna mun a inn leitaw lamah kongkhakte om hi.
Tua ciangin a mipa in kei kiangah, "Leilu lama om leh leitaw lama om hih inn nihte pen biakna inn siangtho ahi hi. Topa' omna-ah a lut siampite in biakna-in a kipia a siangthopente, hih innte sungah ne uh hi. Hih inndeite a siangtho ahih manin, a kipia nate an tawh biaknate leh mawhna leh khialhna hangin biakna-in a kipia sate, a sungah koih uh hi.
Siampite in Topa tungah biakna pia-in biakinn sungah a lut khit uh ciangin a pualamah a pusuah nop uh leh, Topa tungah biakna a piak lai takun a silh uh puante suahin hih inndeite sungah koih ding uh hi. Tua lai panin puan dang silhin mihonte omna-ah pai thei pan uh hi," hong ci hi.
A mipa in biakinn sung lam teng a teh a zawh khit ciangin nisuahna lam kongpi tawnin hong pusuahpih a, biakinn pualam teng teh hi.
Amah in tehna piciang la-in nisuahna lam pang teh a, tong za nga pha hi.
Tua ahih manin a umna tua kulh a pang li-in a teh khit ciangin a pang li mah-in kikim a, pang khat ciangin tong za nga vive pha a, tua deina kulh pen biakna-a a siangtho leh a mawkmawkte khenna ahi hi.
Tua khit ciangin a mipa in biakinn nisuahna lama om kongpi-ah hong paipih a,
nisuahna lam panin Israelte' Pasian' minthan'na hong pai ka mu hi. Pasian' awging pen tuipi ging tawh kibang a, ama minthan'na in leitung taangsak lela hi.
Hih ka maang muhna pen, Pasian in Jerusalem khuapi susia dingin a pai lai-a ka muh leh Khebar Gun gei-a ka muh tawh kibang hi. Tua ciangin thakhatin leilak kiden'na-in ka boksuk hi.
Topa' minthan'na in nisuahna lam kongpi tawnin biakinn sungah lut hi.
Tua ciangin Kha in hong la-in a tual sungnungah hong paipih a, tua lai panin, Topa' minthan'na tawh biakinn sung a kidimna ka mu hi.
Tua lai mun panin kei kiangah a mipa a din' lai takin biakinn sung panin Topa in kei hong hopihna ka za a,
"Ezekiel aw, hih lai munah ka kumpi tokhom om hi. Israel mite lak hih lai munah ka teeng ding a, amaute ka uk tawntung ding hi. Israel mite leh a kumpite un pasian dang biakna tawh ahi a, a kumpi sisate uh phawk nading mual bawlna tawh ahi zongin ka min siangtho daisak ngei nawn lo ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a kumpite un a kongkhuam uh leh a kongzawlte uh keima biakinn kongkhuam leh kongzawlte tawh kimatin bawl uh a, ka kikal uh kawm bek in hong hal hi. A muhdahhuai a gamtatnate khempeuh uh tawh ka min siangtho hong daisak uh a, kei zong ka heh manin amaute ka susia mang hi.
Ahi zongin tu-in amaute in pasian dangte bia nawn loin, a kumpi sisate uh phawkna a mual uh a phiat ding uh ahi hi. Tua bangin a gamtat nak uh leh amaute lakah ka teeng paisuak tawntung ding hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in a thugen hong zom lai a, "Ezekiel aw, Israel mite tungah biakinn thu leh a geelna khempeuh a cing takin lak in la, amaute' mawh gamtatna hangin maizum sak in.
Amaute a gamtatnasate uh hang hong maizum theih uh leh, biakinn geelna, a lim, a lutna leh a pusuahna, a buppi lim, a na khempeuh a kigeelna, leh a zat dan ding khempeuh a cing takin amaute tungah lak tel in la, amaute in a kigeelnate thei-in a zat dan ding bangin a zuih theih nadingun amaute' adingin lai-in gelhsak in.
Biakinn tawh kisai ngeina-in: Mual tunga om biakinn kimkot mun khempeuh pen biakna tawh kisai-in a siangtho ahi hi.
"Biakna-tau golna pen hih bang hi ding hi. A teh nadingin biakinn tehna-a kizang ngeite mah hi ding hi. A biaknatau bul kimkot pen tong khat sangin, tong khat zai ding a, a tua kimkotah khap khat a sangin geivial nei ding hi.
A tau bul panun a tau zawl nuainung ciang tong nih hi ding a, a sahna tong khat hi ding hi. Tua ban siah tong li sangto ding a, tong khat sah ding hi.
A tungnung pen, ganhing kihalna mun in tong li sang ding a, a kiu li-ah tong khat a sang ki om ciat ding hi.
A biaknatau dawn zang pen a dung a vai a kikim hi ding a, tong sawm leh nih sau-in tong sawm leh nih zai ding hi.
Biakna tau a paito a laizang san teng pen a dung a vai a kim, tong sawm leh li hi ding a, a nuai dawl sangin khap khat pai-in neuzaw ding hi. Tua a din'na a nuai gual kimkot tong khat pai-in zai ding hi. Biakna tau tung kah nading kahlei pen nisuahna lam pangah om ding hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa Pasian in kei kiangah, "Ezekiel aw, hih biakna tau zat nading ngeinate in hih bang hi ding hi: Biakna tau a kizawh khit ciangin a tungah meihal biakna piakna leh biakna piakna ganhing site thehna tawh apna a bawl ding na hi hi.
Zadok suan leh khak ahi Levi siampite pen keima na a sem dingin ka omna-ah a hong pai dingte ahi uh hi. Topa Pasian keimah in hih thu kong pia hi. Mawhna hangin biakna-a piak dingin amaute tungah bawngtal khat na pia ding hi.
Nangmah in a sisan pawlkhat la-in biaknatau kiu li-a om ki lite, biakna tau paito a laizang kiute, leh a kimkot-a om a geihualte na nuh ding a, hih bangin hihna tawh biakna tau sian' suahin na ap ding hi.
Mawhna hangin biakna-in a kipia bawngtal pen la-in biakinn huang pualam, a mun hong kigenna sanah a hal ding na hi hi.
A zing ciangin pauban'na a om lo keeltal khat la-in mawhna hangin biakna-in na pia ding hi. Bawngtal si tawh na sian' suah mah bangin hih keeltal si tawh zong biakna tau na sian'suah ding hi.
Hih bangin sian'suahna na man khit ciangin, paubanna a om lo bawngtal khat leh tuutal khat na la ding a,
Topa ahi keima kiangah nong paipih ding hi. Siampite in tua ganhingte tungah ci thehin, keimah hong biakna-in tua ganhingte hal ding uh hi.
Mawhna hangin biak piakna-in ni sagih sung nisimin, paubanna a om lo keeltal khat, bawngtal khat, leh tuutal khat a pia ding na hi uh hi.
Siampite in ni sagih sung biakna tau apna bawlin zat theih dingin a baihsa-in omsak ding uh hi.
Hih bangin ni sagih sung a hih khit uh ciangin, a ni giat ni-a kipanin siampite in meihal biakna leh thunuam-a biak piaknate, biakna tau tungah piak ding kipan ding uh hi. Tua ciangin note tungah kei ka lungkim ding hi. Topa Pasian keimah in hih thu ka gen khin hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin a mipa in nisuahna lam biakinn huang kongpi pua-ah hong paipih a, a kongpi na kikhak hi.
Topa in kei kiangah, "Hih kongpi kikhak paisuak ding a, kihong kik ngei lo ding hi. Israelte' Topa Pasian keimah in hih kongpi tawn khin ka hih manin kuamah dang in tawn thei nawn lo ding a, a kikhak den ding ahi hi.
Ahi zongin hih lai-ah gam-uk na a sem laitak ulianpa pen keima omna-ah biakna an siangtho a ne dingin hong pai thei ding hi. Amah hong pai ciangin inndeipi tawnin inndei sungnung kongvangah hong lutin tua lai mahah pusuak ding hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin a mipa in leilu lam kongpi tawnin biakinn mai-ah hong paipih a, ka khuadak leh, Topa' biakinn sung khempeuh, ama minthan'na tawh na kidim hi. Kei zong leilak kiden'na-in ka boksuk hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in kei kiangah, "Ezekiel aw, tu-a na muh ding nate leh na zak ding thute khempeuh hoih takin ciamteh in. Ka biakinn a kizat nading ngeina om khempeuh tu-in a hong gen ding ka hi hi. Biakinn sunga pai thei dingte leh Siangthopen Munah a pai thei lo dingte khempeuh lim takin ciamteh in.
A lehdo thei hih Israel mite' tungah Topa Pasian keimah in ka gen thute, hih bangin gen in. No Israel mite aw, a beisa hun-a a muhdahhuai na gamtatnate khempeuh uh khawl un.
Keimah biakna-in sathaute leh sasite nong piak uh ciangin, keima thu a mang lo, vun a ki-at lo gamdang mite a sungah na lutsak uh a, ka biakinn na ninsak uh hi. Tua bangin a muhdahhuai na gamtatnate uh tawh ka thuciamna na siasak uh hi.
Ka biakinn sungah biakna ngeinate na zui kei uh a, ka biakinn sungah gamdang mite peuh na na semsak uh hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Topa Pasian in tu-in kong genin ah: Vun ki-at lo gamdang mite peuhmah ka biakinn sungah lut lo ding uh a, note lakah a teeng gamdang mite nangawn lut lo ding uh hi.
No Israel midangte tawh kei hong nusia khawmin milim a bia Levi mite in zong daan thuak ding uh hi.
Amaute in biakinn kong cin' leh biakinn sung nasepte sem thei ding uh hi. Meihal biakna-a kipia ganhingte leh mite in biakna-in a piak ganhingte go thei ding uh a, mite' na a sepsak dingin tavuan la ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin amaute in milim biakna lamah Israel mite makaih-in mawhna sungah Israel mite tun'pih uh ahih ciangin, amaute daan ka piak ding, Topa Pasian keimah nakpi takin ka kiciam hi.
Amaute in keima siampi na sem loin, keima biakna na a siangtho nate nai-ah pai thei loin, Siangthopen Munah zong lut thei lo ding uh hi. Hihte pen, a muhdahhuai a gamtatnasate uh hangin a daan uh ahi hi.
Ahi zongin biakinn sunga nasep a kisam dangte a sem dingin amaute ka seh thei ding hi, ci-in gen in," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa Pasian in kei kiangah, "Zadok suan leh khak Levi mi siampite ahih leh, Israel mi adangte in kei hong nusiat lai takun, amaute in citakin biakinn sungah keima na hong sem uh ahih manin, tu-in amaute in keima na hong semin, keimah biakna-in sathaute leh sasite keima kiangah hong pia ding uh hi.
Ka biakinn sungah amaute lutin, ka biakna tau-ah nasemin, biakinn sunga biaknate-ah makai ding uh hi.
A tual sungnung paina kongpi-ah a lut uh ciangin saihadial puan silh ding uh hi. Tual sungnung sung leh biakinn sungah na a sep lai takun samul puan peuhmah silh lo ding uh hi.
Amaute in saihadial puan khimin, saihadial puan tengin, khua-ul a suaksak thei kawnggak gak lo ding uh hi.
Mi dangte a omna biakinntual puanung ah a pusuah ma-un, biakinn sungah na a sep lai takun a zat uh puante suahin inndei siangtho sungah nusia ding uh hi. Tua lai panin amaute in puan dangte silhin pusuak ding uh hi. Tua hi kei leh a biakna puan siangte un mi dangte lawh kha ding hi.
"Amaute in a sam uh mettol lo ding uh a, a sau lua-in zong hawi lo ding uh hi. A kilawm ciang bek khat-in met ding uh hi.
Biakinntual sungnung ah a lut ma-un siampite in leenggahzu ne lo ding uh hi.
Meigong numei ahi a, a kimasa numei ahi zongin zi-in nei lo ding uh a, Israel nungak, ahih kei leh siampite' zi meigongte ten'pih ding uh hi.
"Amaute in ka mite tungah, biakna na a siangtho leh a mawkmawk nate, leh a nin leh a siang nate a kilamdan'na hilh ding uh hi.
Thu nei khatpeuh peuh a om ciangin, keima ngeina omsa tawh kizui-in thu khen ding uh hi. A kiseh pawite a ngeina omsa bangin bawl ding uh a, sabbathte siangthosak ding uh hi.
Siampite pen misi lawn'na tawh kininsak lo ding uh hi. Ahi zongin, a nu uh ahi a, a pa uh ahi a, a sanggam pasal uh ahih kei leh pasal a nei nai lo a sanggam numeite uh hangin kininsak thei ding uh hi.
Amaute a kisian'suah khit uh nipi kal khat khit ciang bekin,
biakinntual sungnung ah pai-in biakinn sungah na a sep kik theih nadingun kisian'suahna biakna pia ding uh hi. Topa Pasian in hih thu ka gen khin hi.
"Israel mite tungah ka piak, khang khat pan khang khatah a kiluah suksuk ding sung panin siampite' tanh in siampi nasepna za ahi hi. Amaute in Israel mite lakah neihsa gamh nei lo ding uh hi. Amaute' kisapna khempeuh ah kei a kicing khin ka hi hi.
An tawh biakna, mawhna leh khialhna hanga biakna, leh Israel mite lak panin keima adingin a kipia khiate khempeuh amaute in ne ding uh hi.
Anpal sung panin a limcipen teng leh kei tungah hong kipia na khempeuh, amaute in tang ding uh hi. Israel mite' inn sungah ka thupha a tun' theihna dingin amaute in anlum a em simun, biakna-in siampite tungah a em masak penpen uh pia ding uh hi.
Siampite in vasa ahi a, ganhing ahi zongin, sa nek baang hita leh ama thu-in a si tawm mawkte hita leh, ne lo ding uh hi.
"Israel minamte tungah piak dingin leitang a kihawm ciangin, Topa tanh dingin seh khat kituam koih ding hi. Tua a kituam koih leitang in a dung tong tul sawmnih leh tul nga hi ding a, a vai tong tul sawmnih hi ding hi. Tua sung khempeuh a siangtho biakna leitang hi ding hi.
Hih leitang sung panin biakinn ding tawh kisai-in a dung tong za nga, a vai tong za nga mah kisehin, tua banah a kimkot tong sawmnga paisuak mun awng tawh hi lai ding hi.
Hih biakna leitang siangtho sung panin siangthopen mun leh biakinn mun dingin a sau lam tong tul sawmnih leh tul nga, a zai lam tong tul sawm kisehkhia ding hi.
Hih a kisehkhia mun sung teng pen biakna leitang siangtho hi ding a, Topa' biakinn sungah na a sem siampite ading hi ding hi. Hih mun sung teng pen siampite' inn lam nading mun leh biakinn lam nading mun siangtho hi ding hi.
Hihte banah, a dung tong tul sawmnih leh tul nga, a vai tong tul sawm a pha seh khat kibawl leuleu ding a, biakinn sungah na a sem Levi mite' ading hi ding hi. Tua sung tengah amaute' ten' nading khua om ding hi.
Khuapi huang sung dingin a dung tong tul sawmnih leh tul nga, a vai tong tul nga a pha leitang khat kiseh khia ding hi. Hih mun pen a siangtho leitang tawh kizom pah ding a, Israel mite khempeuh ading hi ding hi.
"Gam sung a uk uliante' adingin zong leitang kiseh khia ding hi. A siangtho leitang leh khuapi huang panin kipanin nitumna lamah gamgi ciang, nisuahna lamah zong gamgi ciang mah hi ding a, nitumna pan nisuahna lam gamgi pen Israel minamte khat in a ngah zah tanh mah hi ding hi.
Hih mun teng pen Israel gamsung panin a uk uliante' neih hi ding hi. Tua ahih manin amaute in Israel mite bawlsia nawn lo ding uh a, mun a om lai teng khempeuh, a minam zui-in Israel minamte tangsak ding uh hi.
"Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: No Israel a uk uliante aw, na mawh gamtatna uh sau vei lua zo ta hi. Na ngongtatnate uh leh mi na nenniamnate uh khawl un la, thuman thutangin na sem un. Amau leitang panun ka mite notkhia nawn kei un. Topa Pasian keimah in hih thu kong gen hi.
"Mi khempeuh in tawisuang man leh tehna man zang ding uh hi.
An tehna bung leh tui tehna bung kikim ding a, a kizang ding etkakna pen beem hi ding hi. Beem khatah an bung sawm, tui bung sawm mah hi ding hi.
A gik tehna pen, gerah sawmnih ciang shekel khat, shekel sawmguk ciangin mina khat hi ding hi.
"Biakna na piak nading zia uh pen, mangbuh na neih zah uh pan seh sawmguk suah sehkhat, mangbuhham zong seh sawmguk suah sehkhat mah,
sathau na neih sung uh pan seh za-ah khat (bung tawh teh-in bung sawm ciangin beem khat-a seh),
tuu na neih sung uh pan za nih ciangin khat hi ding hi. Hihte pen an tawh biakna, meihal biakna, thunuam-a biak piaknate hi a, na mawhnate uh a mai theih nading ahi hi. Topa Pasian in hih thu kong pia hi.
Israel mi khempeuh in hihte pen biakna-a piak dingin, amau a uk ulianpa tungah puak ding uh hi.
Gam uk ulianpa in meihal biakna-a piak ding ganhingte, an tawh biakna-a zat dingte, leh pawi khempeuh, kha det ni, sabbath nite-in Israel mibuppite' adingin tuiphih biaknate a piak ding ama nasep ahi hi. Israel mite' mawhna a mai theih nadingin mawhna hanga biakna, an tawh biakna, meihal biakna, leh thunuam-a biak piakna-a zat dingte khempeuh amah in a sikh ding ahi hi.
"Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi. Kha khat a, a ni masa ni-in pauban'na a om lo bawngtal khat biakna-in pia-in biakinn a siangsak ding na hi uh hi.
Siampipa in mawhna hanga biak piakna ganhing si pawlkhat la-in biakinn kongkhuamte, biakna tau kiu lite, leh tual sungnung lutna kongkhuamte nuh ding hi.
Tua mah bangin tua kha a ni sagih ni-in zong, tup lohpi leh theih lohna hangin a khial kha mite' adingin sian' suahna a bawl ding na hi uh hi. Tu-a bang danin biakinn na siangthosak ding uh hi.
A kha masa a ni sawm-le-li ni-in Paisan Pawi bawl na kipan ding uh a, mi khempeuh in ni sagih sung silngo sawhloh anlum na ne ding uh hi.
Tua pawi bawl a kipat ni-in gam uk ulianpa in amah leh gamsung mi khempeuh adingin mawhna hanga biak piakna-in bawngtal khat pia ding hi.
Tua pawi ni sagih sung ni simin pauban'na a om lo bawngtal sagih leh tuutal sagih la-in Topa tungah meihal biakna-in pia ding a, tua ban-a mawhna hanga biakna-in nisimin keeltal khat zong a pia ding ahi hi.
Bawngtal leh tuutal a kipia zah tawh kizui-in an tawh biak nadingin an bung khat pai leh sathau bing khat pai tawh piakhawm ding hi.
A kha sagihna a ni sawm-le-nga ni-in nipi kal khat sung a kibawl ding Buk Pawi kipan ding a, mawhna hanga biak piakna, meihal biakna, leh an tawh biakna-a piak dingin an leh sathaute, nisimin a kisam zah, gam uk ulianpa in pia ding hi.
"Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: Nisuahna lama om, tual sungnung kongpi pen nasep ni guk hun sung teng kikhakcip ding a, ahi zongin sabbath ni leh kha det ni-in kihong ding hi.
Siampite in meihal biakna leh thunuam-a biakna a piak lai takun, gam uk ulianpa pen tual puanung lam panin inndei lianpi kongpi-ah pai-in kongpi khuamte gei-ah ding ding a, tua kongpi ah bia-in tua khit ciangin pusuak kik ding hi. Nitak mateng tua kongpi kikhak lo ding hi.
Sabbath ni leh kha det ni simin mi khempeuh in zong tua kongpi mai-ah Topa bia-in kun ding uh hi.
Gam uk ulianpa in sabbath ni-in meihal biak nadingin pauban'na a om lo tuuno guk leh tuutal khat pia ding hi.
Tua ganhingte tawh a piak khawm ding an tawh biak piak nadingin zong, tuutal khat ciangin an bung khat kizuisak ding a, tuunote tawh piak khop ding pen ama piak nop zahzah hi ding hi. An bung khat a piakna-ah sathau bing dim khat tawh kizuisak ding hi.
Kha det ni ciangin pauban'na a om lo bawngtal khat, tuuno guk, leh tuutal khat hi ding hi.
Tuate tawh piakkhop dingin an tawh biak piak nadingin bawngtal, tuutalte khat ciangin an bung khat pai, leh tuunote tawh piakkhop ding pen ama piak nop zahzah hi ding hi. An bung khat a piakna-ah sathau bing dim khat tawh kizuisak ding hi.
Gam uk ulianpa in a kuan lama a tot lampi teng mah, a ciah ciangin tawnin, inndeipi kongpi mah-ah pusuak ding hi.
"A kiseh pawi hunte-ah Topa bia dingin hong pai mite khempeuh pen a lutna kongpi zui-in kileh kik lo ding uh a, tang takin paisuak ding uh hi. Leilu lam kongpi panin a lutte, leitaw lam kongpi-ah ciah ding uh a, leitaw lam kongpi panin a lutte, leilu lam kongpi-ah ciah ding uh hi.
Gam uk ulianpa zong mihonte mah tawh lutin, amaute mah tawh pusuak khawm ding hi.
Pawi nite leh a kiseh pawi hunte-ah an tawh biakna-a piak ding pen, bawngtal ahi a, tuutal ahi zongin khat ciangin an bung khat in zui ding a, tuunote tawh piakkhawm ding pen a mite' piak nop zahzah hi ding hi. An bung khat a kipiak ciangin sathau bing dim khat in zui ding hi.
Gam uk ulianpa in ama ut thu-in biakna pia a,meihal biakna ahi a, thunuam-a biakna ahi zongin khatpeuh peuh a piak ciangin, ama lut nadingin nisuahna lama om tual sungnung kongpi kihon'sak ding hi. Amah in sabbath ni-a biakna piakna a bawl mah bangin pia ding hi. Amah a ciahkik khit ciangin a kongpi kikhak ding hi.
"Gam uk ulianpa in meihal biakna-a piak dingin pauban'na a om lo kum khat a pha tuuno khat, zingsang simin Topa tungah biakna-in pia ding hi. Hih pen nisimin a kipia ding ahi hi.
Mangbuhnel lawh dim khat leh a meek khoppih ding sathau hai khat tawh, an tawh biakna-in zong, ni simin pia ding hi. Hih meihal biakna piakna ngeina in a kip paisuak ding ahi hi.
Tua bangin tuuno, mangbuhnel, leh sathau, zingsang simin Topa tungah meihal biakna a kipia ngitnget ding ahi hi.
"Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: Gam uk ulianpa in ama neihsa leitang mun khatpeuh peuh, a tapate khatpeuh peuh tungah a piak leh, tua leitang ngah a tapa in a luah gamh-in nei paisuak ding hi.
Ahi zongin gam uk ulianpa in ama nasemte khatpeuh tungah leitang a piak leh, suahtakna kum a tun' ciangin tua leitang pen a pia gam uk ulianpa' neihsa suak kik ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua leitang in ama neihsa hi a, amah leh a tapate bek in nei paisuak thei ding uh hi.
Gam uk ulianpa in mi dangte' neihsa leitang laksak ngei lo ding hi. Ama tungah a kipia leitang sung panin a tapate khenkhia bek ding hi. Ka mite' leitang laksakin, bawlsia lo ding hi, ci-in gen in," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin a mipa in biakinn tual sungnung leitaw lama om kongpi gei-a inndeite-ah hong paipih hi. Hih inndeite pen siampite' zat ding a siangtho inndeite ahi hi. Amah in tua inndeite omna nitumna lam pang mong hong kawk a,
"Hih mun pen, siampite in mawhna leh khialhna hangin biakna-in a kipia sate a huanna mun, leh an tawh biak piaknate a em nading mun ahi hi. Hih pen, tual puanung ah biakna sa leh ante paipih kha loin, tua a siangtho nate tawh tual puanung-a om mite a lawhsak khak loh nading uh ahi hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin tual puanung-ah hong pusuahpih a, a tual kiu lite hong lak hi. Tua tual kiu lite munah tualno khat ciat na om hi.
Tua tualnote tong sawmli sau-in tong sawmthum zai a, a vekpi-in a golna kikim hi.
Tua tualno lite a umna kawm dingin suang kiciang ciat a, tua a kawmte belin meikhuk om hi.
A mipa in, "Hihte pen, mite in biakna-in a piaksate, biakinn sung nasemte in a huanna anbuk ahi hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin biakinn lutna kongkhak-ah hong paipih kik hi. Biakinn kongkhak sangkil nuai panin tui luang a, biakinn ngatna nisuahna lamah luang sukin, biaknatau leitaw lam pang tawnsuk hi.
Tua ciangin a mipa in a leilu lam kongpi tawnin hong pusuahpih a, nisuahna lam kongpi pua lamah hong paipih hi. Leitaw lam kulhkongpi-ah a tui hong luangkhia hi.
A mipa in a tehna piciang tawi-in a tui luan'na nisuahna lam tong tul khat ciang dong teh suk a, a tui kei hong ngaptan sak hi. A tui pen siakmit ciang bek thuk hi.
Tua ciangin tong tul khat ciang teh suk leuleu a, tua lai-ah a tui hong ngaptan sak a, khuk ciang tum hi. Tong tul khat ciang teh suk leuleu-in a tui hong ngaptan sak a, ka kawng ciang tum hi.
Tua ciangin tong tul ciang mah teh suk lai leuleu a, a lui tui thuk lua ta ahih manin ka ngap zo kei hi. Thuk lua ahih manin a tui i peek loh buangin a kikantan zo ding hi lo hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Ezekiel aw, hihte khempeuh hoih takin ciamteh in," hong ci hi. Tua ciangin a mipa in tua gungei mahah hong paipih kik a,
tua lai mun ka tun ciangin a gun lang nih tuakah singkung tampi tak a po ka mu hi.
Amah in kei kiangah, "Hih tui pen nisuahna lam manawhin gam sung nawkin Jordan Kuam-ah luang sukin Si Tuipi sung tung hi. Si Tuipi a tun' ciangin hih tui in tuipi tui pen, tuisiang suaksak kik hi.
Hih tui a luan'na mun peuhpeuh ah ganhing namkim leh ngasa tampi om hi. Hih tui in Si Tuipi tui siangsak kikin, a luan'na peuhpeuh ah nuntakna omsak kik ding hi.
En-gedi khua panin En-eglaim khua ciang dong tuipi dungah ngasa bengte omin, tua dungah a ngen uh zalin pho keu ding uh hi. Mediterranean Tuipi sungah ngasa om zah mah bangin ngasa nam tampite om ding hi.
Ahi zongin tuipi dunga om nawng lakte leh bualte-a om tuite siang lo ding a, cikhuk dingin tuaci-in om lai ding uh hi.
Hih gun pang tuakah a gah nek dingin singkung nam khempeuh po ding hi. A tehte pulh ngei lo ding a, a gah tawh zong kilawi ngei lo ding hi. Biakinn panin a luangkhia tui ngah ding uh ahih manin kha simin a gah thak gah tawntung ding uh hi. A singgahte an ding hi ding a, a tehte zatui in kizang ding hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa Pasian in kei kiangah, "Israel minam sawm leh nihte' gamh dingin leitang hawm ding gamgi in hih bang hi ding hi. Josef minamte in a dangte' ngah zah nih ngah ding uh hi.
Hih gam amaute' tanh dingin ka piak nading thu, na pu na pate uh tungah thupi takin ka kiciam khin zo hi. Tua ahih manin tu-in note lakah a kikim dimdiamin hawm un.
"Leilu lam gamgi pen, Mediterranean Tuipi panin kipanin Hethlon khuapi-ah, Hamath khua lutna-ah, Zedad khuapi-ah,
tua panin Berothah leh Sibraim khuapite-ah (hih khuate pen Damaskas kumpi gam leh Hamath kumpi gam kikalah om hi), tua panin Hazerhattikon khuapi (Hauran kumpi gam gamgi gei-a om) hi ding hi.
Leilu lam gamgi pen Mediterranean tuipi-a kipanin nisuahna lam manawhin Damaskas leh Hamath gamgi-a om Hazarenan khuapi ciang hi ding hi.
"Nisuahna lam gamgi pen, Damaskas leh Hauran gamgi kituahna panin hong kipan sukin, Jordan Gun zuisuk a, Jordan Gun nitumna lam pang Israel gam hi-in, nisuahna lam pang Gilead gam hi a, tua panin Si Tuipi kimang sukin Tamar khuapi ciang hi suk ding hi.
"Leitaw lam gamgi pen, Tamar khuapi panin hong kipanin Meribathkadesh bual hong nawk a, tua panin sak nitumna lam manawhin Izipt gamgi zui toin Mediterranean Tuipi sun ding hi.
"Ni tumna lam gamgi pen, Mediterranean Tuipi hi toin Hamath khua lutna tawh a kitang ciang hi to ding hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin hih gam sung teng, no Israel minamte lakah hawm un.
Note adingin na neih kip tawntung ding uh gamh hi ding hi. Hih leitang na hawm uh ciangin note lakah hong teengin ta a nei khinsa minam dangte zong note mah bangin tanh na pia ding uh hi. Amaute pen Israel minam taktakte mah bangin na ngaihsun ding uh a, Israel minam dangte mah bangin leitang hawmna-ah aii sawk thei ding uh hi.
Note' lakah a teeng gamdang mite in amau' ten'na minamte tawh leitang ngah khawm ding uh hi. Topa Pasian in hih thu kong gen khin hi.
"Leilu lam gamgi pen, Mediterranean Tuipi panin kipanin Hethlon khuapi-ah, Hamath khua lutna-ah, tua panin Damaskas leh Hamath gamgi kituahna san a, om Hazarenan khuapi ciang sun ding hi. Minam khat in leitang khen khat ciat ngah ding uh a, a kikal uh gamgite pen gambup nisuahna gamgi panin gambup nitumna gamgi ciang hi ding a, leilu lam panin a hawm uh kipan suk ding uh hi. Leilu lam a khungnungpen ah Dan minamte,
a zomah Asher minamte,
a zomah Naftali minamte,
a zomah Manasseh minamte,
a zomah Efraim minamte in nisuahna pan nitumna dongah Manasseh tawh kigamgi ding uh hi,
a zomah Reuben minamte,
a zomah Judah minamte, hi ding hi.
"Tuate zomah, Pasian' adingin a kipia leitang hi ding a, a zaina pen leilu lam panin a kipan leitaw lam tong tul sawmnih leh tul nga hi ding hi. A dung lam pen gambup nisuahna gamgi panin gambup nitumna gamgi dong, minam dangte' ngah zah tanh mah hi ding a, a laizang sanah biakinn om ding hi.
Topa' adingin a kipia leitang in a sauna tong tul sawmnih leh tul nga hi ding a, a zaina tong tul sawmnih hi ding hi.
Siampite in hih a siangtho leitang sung panin tanh ngah ding uh a, leilu lam pang leh leitaw lam pang tong tul sawmnih leh tul nga tuak hi-in, nisuahna lam leh nitumna lam pang tong tul sawm tuak hi ding hi. Siampite' ngahna sung hih leitang laizangah Topa' biakinn om ding hi.
Hih mun teng pen Zadok' suan leh khak siampite ading ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih mite in Israel midangte a gamtat khialh uh ciangin Levi midangte bangin va zui lo uh a, citakin keima na hong sem uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Levi midangte' zomah hih bangin a mun tuam diak khat nei ding uh a, tua mun in a siangthopen mun khat hi ding hi.
Hih siampite' zomah Levi mite in leitang ngah ding uh a, a sauna tong tul sawmnih leh tul nga hi-in, a zaina tong tul sawm hi ding hi.
Topa tungah a kipia hih leitang siangtho pen, leitang khempeuh panin a hoihpen hi a, hih leitang sung panin mun khatpeuh peuh zuak thei lo, adang tawh zong kheek thei lo, midang tungah zong pia thei lo ding hi. Hih leitang in a siangtho leitang hi a, Topa' aa ahi hi.
"A om lai leitang, a sauna tong tul sawmnih leh tul nga, leh a zaina tong tul nga pen a siangtho leitang hi loin a mawkmawk leitang hi ding a, mite' taang zat ding mun hi ding hi. Ten' nading leh a mun awngthawl hi ding a, a laizang-ah khuapi om ding hi.
A khuapi golna in a dung a vai-in a kikim hi ding a, a pang li-in pang khat ciangin tong tulli leh tong za nga hi ding hi.
Khuapi kimkot pai suak-ah tong za nih leh tong sawmnga paisuak a zai mun awng om ding hi.
Khuapi a kilam khit ciangin a siangtho leitang lamah a awng lai, nisuahna lam tong tul sawm, nitumna lam tong tul sawm a om lai teng pen khuapi sungah a teengmite in a khawh ding leitang hi ding hi.
Khuapi sunga nasem-a om mi peuhmah in Israel minam sung panin kuamah deidanna om loin hih leitang kho thei ding uh hi.
Hih a kisehkhia leitang buppi pen a pang li-in tong tul sawmnih leh tul nga pai hi ding a, hih pen leitang siangtho leh khuapi huam sung kigawm hi ding hi.
"Hih leitang panin leitaw lam pangah, Israel minam a om laite in leitang ngah ding uh a, a kikal uh gamgite pen gambup nisuahna gamgi panin gambup nitumna gamgi ciang hi ding a, leilu lam panin a hawm uh kipan suk ding uh hi. Leilu lam a khungnung penah a ngah ding Benjamin minamte,
a zomah Simeon minamte,
a zomah Issakhar minamte,
a zomah Zebulun minamte,
a zomah Gad minamte, hi ding hi.
Leitaw lam panin Gad minamte a kipia leitang banah gambup gamgi om ding a, Tamar khuapi panin kipanin Meribath-kadesh bual nawk ding a, tua panin sak nitumna lam manawhin Izipt-te tawh gamgi zui ding a, Mediterranean Tuipi-ah tawp ding hi.
Tu-a ka gen bangin Israel minamte in a khang khangin a luah suksuk ding uh leitang dingin amaute tungah a kipia ding leitang ahi hi. Topa Pasian in hih thu kong gen khin hi.
Khuapi kimkot a sauna tong tul sawm leh tul giat pha a, tu-a kipanin hih khuapi min in, 'Hih lai-ah Topa om hi,' (Jehovah Shammah) kici ding hi," hong ci hi.
Persia kumpipa Sairas' kum khatna kumin, Jeremiah' tung tawnin Topa' thugen a tun' theih nadingin, ama gam sung khempeuh ah tangkona khat bawlin lai-in zong a gelh nadingin Persia kumpipa Sairas' lungsim ah Topa in suak sak hi. Amah in hih bangin hih hi:
"Persia kumpipa Sairas in hih bangin ci hi: Vantung Pasian, Topa in leitung kumpi gam khempeuh keima tungah hong piakhin a, Judah gam sung Jerusalem khua ah ama adingin inn khat ka lamsak ding hong sawl hi.
Note' lakah ama mi peuhmah a Pasian in ompih hen la, Judah gam sung Jerusalem khua-ah paito hen la, Israel Pasian, Topa' inn lam kik hen— amah in Jerusalem ah a om Pasian ahi hi;
tua ciangin koi lai koi lai muna om hi taleh Judah mi a om lai khempeuh, a omna mun mite in Jerusalem-a om Pasian' inn adingin ut thu-a piakna a piakte uh banah, ngun leh kham, nate leh ganhingte tawh zong huh uh hen," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Judah leh Benjamin sunga innkuan lutangte, leh siampite leh Levi mite, Jerusalem khua-a a om Topa' inn lamkik dingin a lungsim sung uhah Pasian in a suahsak mite khempeuh kithawi uh hi;
tua ciangin a veng a pamte un thatang tawh a huh uh banah ngun tawh kibawl um-le-beel, kham, van tuamtuamte, ganhingte leh letsong manphate tawh huh thuah uh hi.
Tua tham loin, Nebukhadnezzar in Jerusalem panin puakhia-in ama pasiante' inn sungah a koihsa ahi Topa' inn-a om ngei um-le-beelte zong kumpipa Sairas in pusuah hi.
Persia kumpipa Sairas in hihte pusuahin sumkempa Mithredath' khut sungah ap hi; tuapa in Judah ukpa Sheshbazzar' adingin a mal zah simin sazian bawlsak hi.
Tua nate a phazah in: kham kuang-uk sawmthum, ngun kuang tulkhat, tem nam tuamtuam sawmnih-le-kua,
kham kuang sawmthum, ngun kuang-uk anam tuamtuam zali sawmkhat leh um-le-beel adang tulkhat ahi hi.
Kham leh ngun kibawl um-le-beelte khempeuh a vekpi-in tulnga leh zali pha hi; tua hi a, Babilon panin salte a kiciahpih kik ciangin Sheshbazzar in tua nate khempeuh Jerusalem ah ciahpih hi.
Babilon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar in a zawhna gam panin Babilon ah sal-in a lakte sung panin hih mite Jerusalem leh Judah ah a ciahkikte hi a, amau' khua ciatah a ciah uh hi.
Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Re-elaiah, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum leh Baanahte makai-in tua mite ciahpih uh hi. Israel mi phazahte in:
Parosh suante tulnih zakhat leh sawmsagih-le-nih ahi hi.
Shefatiah suante zathum leh sawmsagih-le-nih ahi hi.
Arah suante zasagih leh sawmsagih-le-nga ahi hi.
Pahathmoabte beh sung panin Jeshua leh Joab suante tulnih zagiat leh sawm-le-nih ahi hi.
Elam suante tulkhat zanih leh sawmnga-le-li ahi hi.
Zattu suante zakua leh sawmnga-le-nga ahi hi.
Zakkai suante zasagih leh sawmguk ahi hi.
Bani suante zaguk leh sawmli-le-nih ahi hi.
Bebai suante zaguk leh sawmnih-le-thum ahi hi.
Azgad suante tulkhat zanih leh sawmnih-le-nih ahi hi.
Adonikam suante zaguk leh sawmguk-le-guk ahi hi.
Bigvai suante tulnih leh sawmnga-le-guk ahi hi.
Adin suante zali leh sawmnga-le-li ahi hi.
Ater a kici Hezekiah suante sawmkua-le-giat ahi hi.
Bezai suante zathum leh sawmnih-le-thum ahi hi.
Jorah suante zakhat leh sawm-le-nih ahi hi.
Hashum suante zanih leh sawmnih-le-thum ahi hi.
Gibbar suante sawmkua-le-nga ahi hi.
Bethlehem khuami zakhat leh sawmnih-le-thum ahi hi.
Netofah khuami sawmnga-le-guk ahi hi.
Anathoth khuami zakhat leh sawmnih-le-giat ahi hi.
Beth-azmaveth khuami sawmli-le-nih ahi hi.
Kiriath-Jearim khua, Khefirah khua, leh Be-eroth khuami zasagih leh sawmli-le-thum ahi hi.
Ramah khua leh Geba khuami zaguk leh sawmnih-le-khat ahi hi.
Mikmas khuami zakhat leh sawmnih-le-nih ahi hi.
Beth-el khua leh Ai khuami zanih leh sawmnih-le-thum ahi hi.
Nebo khuami sawmnga-le-nih ahi hi.
Magbish khuami zakhat leh sawmnga-le-guk ahi hi.
Elam adang khat suante tulkhat zanih leh sawmnga-le-li ahi hi.
Harim suante zathum leh sawmnih ahi hi.
Lod khua, Hadid khua leh Ono khuami zasagih leh sawmnih-le-nga ahi hi.
Jerikho khuami zathum leh sawmli-le-nga ahi hi.
Sena-ah gam mi tulthum zaguk leh sawmthum ahi uh hi.
Siampite sung panin: Jeshua-te beh panin Jedaiah suante zakua leh sawmsagih-le-thum ahi hi.
Immer suante tulkhat leh sawmnga-le-nih ahi hi.
Pashhur suante tulkhat zanih leh sawmli-le-sagih ahi hi.
Harim suante tulkhat leh sawm-le-sagih ahi uh hi.
Levi mite sung panin: Hodaviahte beh panin Jeshua suante leh Kadmiel suante sawmsagih-le-li ahi uh hi.
Lasate sung panin: Asaf suante zakhat leh sawmnih-le-giat ahi uh hi.
Kongcingte nam sung panin: Shallum suante, After suante, Talmon suante, Akkub suante, Hatita suante, leh Shobai suante, a vekpi-in za khat leh sawmthum-le-kua ahi uh hi.
Biakinn nasemte sung panin: Ziha suante, Hasufa suante, Tabbaoth suante,
Keros suante, Siaha suante, Padon suante,
Lebanah suante, Hagabah suante, Akkub suante,
Hagab suante, Shamlai suante, Hanan suante,
Giddel suante, Gahar suante, Reaiah suante,
Rezin suante, Nekoda suante, Gazzan suante,
Uzza suante, Paseah suante, Besai suante,
Asnah suante, Meunim suante, Nefisim suante,
Bakbuk suante, Hakufa suante, Harhur suante,
Bazluth suante, Mehida suante, Harsha suante,
Barkos suante, Sisera suante, Temah suante,
Neziah suante, leh Hatifa suante ahi uh hi.
Solomon' nasemte nam sung panin: Sotai suante, Hassofereth suante, Peruda suante,
Ja-alah suante, Darkon suante, Giddel suante,
Shefatiah suante, Hattil suante, Pokereth-hazzebaim suante, leh Ami suante ahi uh hi.
Biakinn nasemte khempeuh leh Solomon' nasemte' suan-le-khakte khempeuh a vekpi-in zathum leh sawmkua-le-nih pha uh hi.
Telmelah, Telharsha, Kherub, Addan, leh Immer khuate panin a hong ciahkik, Israel mi hi napi-in amau' beh leh phung a kan thei lo mite in:
Delaiah suante, Tobiah suante, leh Nekoda suante, mi zaguk leh sawmnga-le-nih ahi uh hi.
Siampite sung panin zong: Habaiah suante, Hakkoz suante, leh Barzillai suante (amah in Gilead mi Barzillai' tanute khat ten'pihin tua min tawh a kilo pah) ahi uh hi.
Hih mite in khang kiciamtehna ah amau' min a zon' uh hangin amau' min na om lo ahih manin amaute a siang loin seh uh a, siampi nasep sem sak thei lo uh hi;
Urim leh Thummin aisanna tawh ai a san ding siampi khat a om mateng amaute in biakna an siangpente a nek loh nading uh gam ukpa in gen hi.
Mi a vekpi-in tulsawmli leh tulnih leh zathum leh sawmguk pha uh a,
amaute' nasem numei leh pasal mihing tulsagih zathum leh sawmthum-le-sagihte kisim lo hi; amaute in lasa numei leh pasal mihing zanih nei uh hi.
Amau' sakolte zasagih leh sawmthum-le-guk, amau' la-sakol zanih leh sawmli-le-nga,
amau' kalaoh zali leh sawmthum-le-nga, leh a la uh tulguk zasagih leh sawmnih pha hi.
Amaute Jerusalem-a Topa' inn a tun' uh ciangin Pasian' inn ama mun ngei-ah lamkik nadingin innkuan lutangte pawlkhat in Pasian' inn adingin piakna bawl uh hi;
amaute in ahih zawhna zah uh tawh kizui-in tua nasep nadingin vanmanpha koihna ah kham darik tulsawmguk leh tulkhat, ngun mina tulnga, leh siampi puan zakhat pia uh hi.
Siampite, Levi mite, leh mi pawlkhatte Jerusalem leh a kim nai-ah teeng uh hi; lasate, kongcingte, biakinn nasemte, leh Israel khempeuh amau' khuapi ciatah teeng uh hi.
A kha sagihna hong cin' ciangin Israel mite amau' khuapi ciatah teeng khin uh ahih manin, khe khat khai bangin Jerusalem ah amaute hong kituah diam uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jozadak' tapa Jeshua leh a siampi pihte, leh Shealtiel' tapa Zerubbabel leh a behte hong kipan uh a, Pasian' mi Moses' thukham sungah a kigelh bangin meihal biaknate piak nadingin Israel Pasian' biakna tau bawl uh hi.
Amaute in tua gama midang teengte kihta uh ahih manin a mun lui mah-ah biakna tau phut pahin zing leh nitak simin Topa tungah meihal biakna pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in a kikipsaksa bangin buk pawi bawl uh a, ni simin zat dingin a kisehsa zah bangin meihal biakna ni simin pia uh hi;
tua ciangin hihte banah a tawntunga meihal biakna, khadet sim-a biakna leh Topa' pawi a kisehsa hun khempeuh leh Topa' tungah amau' ut thu tawh a pia mite khempeuh' piaknate zong pia uh hi.
Topa' biakinn a bulpi a kiphuh nai loh hangin a kha sagihna a ni masa ni-a kipanin amaute in Topa tungah meihal biaknate piak ding kipan uh hi.
Tua hi a, amaute in suangseekte leh khutsiamte tungah sum pia uh a, Persia kumpipa Sairas' tung panin a thu ngahna bangun Lebanon mualtung gam panin tuipi gei Joppa khua ah taamtaak singte a hong puaksuk ding Sidon khuamite leh Tai-ar khuamite tungah zong annek tuidawn leh sathau a pia uh hi.
Amaute, Jerusalem a, Pasian' innah hong ciahkik uh a kum nihna, tua kum a kha nihna sungin Shealtiel' tapa Zerubbabel leh Jozadak' tapa Jeshua in nasep kipan uh a, ama Israel mipihte, siampite leh Levi mite leh salsuahna panin Jerusalem ah a hong ciahkik mite khempeuh in huh uh hi. Amaute in Levi mite kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah peuhmah Topa' inn sungah biakna nasepte a vaan dingin seh uh hi.
Jeshua a tapate leh a behte tawh, Kadmiel, Binnui, leh Hodaviahte in Henadad' tapate leh Levi mi a tapate uh leh a behte uh tawh Pasian' innah nasemte tungah ukna tavuan la khawm uh hi.
Innlamte in Topa' biakinn a bul a phuh uh ciangin, Israel kumpipa David in a geel kholhsa bangin Topa a phat dingin siampite in a puan uh silhin peengkul tawh, Asaf tapa Levi mite in daltuah tawh a panmun ding uhah hong pang uh hi;
tua ciangin amaute in Topa phatna leh lungdam kohna a kidawngin sa uh a, "Topa tungah lungdam koh ding hoih hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Israelte hong itna kip tawntung hi," a ci uh hi. Topa' inn bulpi kiphut khin ahih manin mi khempeuh in nakpi takin Topa phat uh hi.
Mi dang tampi in a aw neih zah-un lungdamin a kiko uh hangin a inn masa a mu ngeisa siampite leh Levi mite leh innkuan lutang, midang tampite in hih inn bulpi a kiphuh a muh uh ciangin kap-in thuum uh hi.
Mite nakpi takin kiko ahih manin lungdamna awging leh kahna leh thuumna awgingte mite in khen thei lo uh hi; gamlapi pek panin tua awging kiza hi.
Salsuahna panin a hong ciahkik mite in Israel Pasian Topa adingin biakinn khat a lamna thu Judah leh Benjamin mite' galte in a zak uh ciangin,
Zerubbabel leh Jeshua leh innkuan lutangte kiangah va pai uh a, amaute kiangah, "Inn lamna ah ko zong hong kihel sak un; bang hang hiam cih leh note mah bangin ko zong na Pasian uh ka bia uh a, hih lai-ah kote hong koih Assiria kumpipa Esarhaddon' hun lai-a kipanin note' Pasian tungah biakna ka pia uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Zerubbabel, Jeshua leh Israel sunga innkuan lutang a om laite in amaute kiangah, "Kote' Pasian' adingin ka lam uh inn in note hong lunghihmawhpih ding hi lo hi. Persia kumpipa Sairas in kote hong thupiaksa bangin Israel Pasian, Topa adingin ko teng bek mah in ka lam ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua gam a, midang teengte in Judah mite lungkia sakin inn a lam lai ding uh lausak uh hi;
amau' ngimna a tangtun' theih loh nadingin amaute a langpang dingin zum nasemte golhguk pia uh hi. Persia kumpipa Sairas' uk huna kipan kumpi Darias hun dong hih bangin hih ngitnget uh hi.
Ahasu-eras in uk ding hong kipat ciangin Judah gam leh Jerusalem a, teengte' khiatna thu tua gam a, a na teengsate in lai-in gelh uh hi.
Tua ciangin Persia kumpi Artakzaksis hun ciangin Mithredath, Tabeel leh a lawmte uh thukimna tawh kumpipa tungah laigelh uh a, a lai pen Aram lai-in kigelh a, Aram pau mahin kisim khia hi.
Menzipipa Rehum leh lai-atpa Shimshai in Kumpi Artakzaksis tungah Jerusalem tawh kisai thu anuai-a bangin gelh uh hi:
Menzipipa Rehum, lai-at Shimshai, leh a lawmte khempeuh, thukhente, mangpite, thuvante, uliante, Erek khuami leh Babilon khuami, Susa khua-a om Elam mite,
leh a lian a minthang Ashurbanipal in hong puakkhia-in Samaria khuapi ah hong ten'sak mite leh Eufrates gun lang khat a kizawhna gam sunga om mite tung panin lai puak, ci uh hi.
A lai sung thu hih anuai-a bang ahi hi: "Artakzaksis kumpipa tungah, Eufrates Gungal gam-a om na nasemte in hopihna kam kong puak uh hi:
Nangma kiang panin ko kiangah a hong pai Judah mite, Jerusalem ah tu-in tung khin uh a, a gilo, mi lehdo thei ahi khuapi pen amaute in lamkikin, amaute in a khua bulpi vel khinin kulhpi cian' a kipat khitna thu thei in.
Amau' khuapi kilam kikin kulhte kizo leh amaute in siah ahi a, mangmu ahi a, lo sapna ahi zongin hong pia nawn lo ding uh a, a tawpna-ah kumpipa hong sukkhak ding thu thei in.
Hih khuapi kilam kikna a kulhte kizo khin leh Eufrates gungal gam na uk nawn loh nading thu, nangma tungah kong theikhol sak uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in hih bangin a lai uh thuk hi: "Menzipipa Rehum, lai-atpa Shimshai, leh Samaria leh Eufrates gungal gam sunga om na lawmte khempeuh uh tungah hopihna lai kong khak hi.
Keima tungah nong khak uh lai pen a kitel takin keima zakna-ah hong kisim khin hi.
Keimah in hih thu a kikan nading thu ka pia a, tu-in kikan khin ta hi. Tang lai-a kipanin hih khuapi in kumpite langah pangin, hih khua sungah lehdona leh kumpi dona a om ngitngetna thu kimukhia hi.
A vanglian kumpite in Jerusalem ah uk ngei-in, Eufrates Gungal gam bup tungah aana zang uh a, siah leh mangmu leh losapte tua kumpite tungah kipia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hih mite in nasep a khawl nading uh thupia in. Keimah in thu kong piakkik mateng hih khuapi kilamkik lo ding hi.
Hih thu tawh kisai-ah na sep ding don loin ommawk kei in; tua hi kei leh kumpi tungah siatna leh gimna hong khang ding hi," a ci hi.
Menzipipa Rehum, lai-at Shimshai, leh amau' lawmte' zakna ah kumpi Artakzaksis tung panin a kingah lai a kisim ciangin, Jerusalem ah amaute pai pahin Judah mite a nasep uh zawhthawh thu tawh khawlsak uh hi.
Tua huna kipanin Jerusalem a, om Pasian' inn a kisepna khawl hi; Persia kumpi Darias' uk a kum nihna dong tua bangin khawlcip phot hi.
Tu-in kamsangte Haggai leh Iddo' suan Zekhariah in Judah gam leh Jerusalem a, om Judah mite hanthawnin, Israel Pasian' min tawh thu genkhol uh hi.
Tua ciangin Shealtiel' tapa Zerubbabel leh Jozadak' tapa Jeshua in Jerusalem a, Pasian' inn lamkik ding kipan pah uh a, Pasian' kamsangte in amaute ompihin huh uh hi.
Tua lai takin Eufrates Gungal gam sung teng a uk sawn Tattenai, Shetharbozenai, leh amau' lawmte hong pai pahin amaute kiangah, "Note in hih inn lamkikin a nate na bawl nading uh kua in thu hong pia ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Hih inn lam nasepna-ah a sem mite' min zong amaute in dong uh hi.
Ahi zongin Judah upate in Pasian' vilna sungah nasem hi uh a, Darias' kiangah a thu va tungin ama tung panin thu a kingah kik hun dong a nasep zomna uh kikhaktan lo hi.
Eufrates gungal gam a uk sawn Tattenai, Shetharbozenai, leh Eufrates gungal gam sung thu a vaan ama lawmte in kumpi Darias' tungah laikhak uh hi.
Amaute in thuzaksakna lai hih bangin a gelh uh hi: "Kumpi Darias tungah thupha namcin hong tung ta hen.
Judah gam, alian Pasian' innah ka va paina uh kong theisak uh hi. Tua inn pen suang lianpite tawh kilamin a kawmte sing tawh kibawl hi; hih inn lim takin kisemin amau' makaihna tawh a nasep uh telh mahmah uh hi.
Hih inn a lamkik nading leh a nate a zawh nadingin kua in thupia hiam? cih thu hih upate tungah ka dong uh hi.
Nangmah in a makai teng na theih nadingin amaute' min zong ka dong uh hi.
Amaute in hih bangin hong dawng uh hi: 'Kote in vantung leh leitung Pasian' nasemte ka hi uh a, kum tampi lai-a a kilamsa inn a lamkik ka hi uh hi; a lian Israel kumpi khat in lamin a zawhsa ahi hi.
Ahi zongin ka pu ka pate un vantung Pasian hehsak kha uh ahih manin Babilon kumpipa, Khaldea mi Nebukhadnezzar' khut sungah amaute pia hi; tua kumpipa in hih inn susia a, a mite Babilon ah ciahpih hi.
Ahi zongin Babilon kumpipa Sairas' uk a kum khatna kumin hih Pasian' inn a kilamkikna ding amah in thupia hi.
Tua tham loin Jerusalem a, biakinn sung panin Nebukhadnezzar in la-in Babilon biakinn sunga a koih ahi Pasian' inn sunga kham leh ngun tawh kibawl um-le-beelte zong kumpipa Sairas in Babilon biakinn panin la khia-in gam uk a, a hong koih Sheshbazzar min neipa tungah ap hi;
kumpipa in ama tungah, "Hih um-le-beelte paipih in la, Jerusalem a, biakinn ah va koihkik in; tua lai-a Pasian' inn pen a mun ngei mah ah lamkik sak in," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Sheshbazzar hong pai-in Jerusalem a, Pasian' inn a bulpi hong phut hi; tua huna kipanin tu dong inn lamkik kisem suak a, ahi zongin kizo nai lo hi,' a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hoih na sak leh, Jerusalem a, hih Pasian' inn a kilamkik nading thu kumpipa Sairas in thupia taktak hiam, pia taktak lo hiam cih a kitheih nadingin Babilon khua sunga om laibu koihna inn sung zong sak in. Tua khit ciangin kumpipa in na deihna hong zasak in," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpipa Darias in thupia a, Babilon khua sunga lai manphate a kisen'na innte sung kizong hi.
Ahi zongin Babilon khua sungah na om lo a, Media gam sung kumpi khuapi Ekbatana-ah laizial khat kimu a, tua sungah hih anuai-a bangin a kiciamteh kimu hi:
"Kumpi Sairas' kum khatna kumin Jerusalem khua a, Pasian' inn tawh kisai-in kumpipa in hih thu pia hi: Biakna kipia-in meihal biakna a kipaipihna munah inn lamsak kik un; a mai panin a san'na tong sawmguk, a vai tong sawmguk mah hi ding a,
a kawm pen suang thuap thum leh sing thuap khat tawh a kibawl thuap li hi ding hi; hih sum beinate ahih leh kumpi sum panin kipia ding hi.
Nebukhadnezzar in Jerusalem biakinn panin la khia-in Babilon ah a hong tun'pih Pasian' inn sunga om kham leh ngun tawh kibawl um-le-beelte zong kipia kik ding hi; tuate khempeuh Jerusalem biakinn ah kipuak kik ding a, Pasian' inn sunga a omna mun mun ciatah kikoih kik ding hi," ci-in kigelh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi Darias in hih bangin thupia hi: "Tu-in, Eufrates Gungal gam a uk Tattenai, Shetharbozenai, leh Eufrates Gungal gam sung a vaan na lawmte, tua mun panin na kihemkhia ding uh hi;
Judah mi a ukpa leh a upate in hih Pasian' inn a lamkik theih nadingun na tua ci omsak ding uh hi; ama mun ngei mah ah a inn lamsak kik un.
Hih a kigen Pasian' inn a kilam kik theih nadingin hih Judah upate' adingin na hih dingte uh zong thu kong pia hi. Hih nasepna a mawk khawl loh nadingin, Eufrates gungal gam sung panin a kingah siahte ahi kumpi sum sung panin beina khempeuh a cingin kipia ding hi.
Vantung Pasian' tungah meihal biakna-in piak dingin a kisam khempeuh— bawngtalnote, tuutalte, ahih kei leh tuunote na pia ding uh a, Jerusalem-a siampite' hong ngetna bangin mangbuh, ci, leenggahzu, ahih kei leh sathaute, kitasam loin ni simin amaute tungah pia sak un.
Tua hi leh amaute in vantung Pasian' tungah a namtui biaknate pia-in kumpipa leh a tapate' nuntak nading thu hong ngetsak thei ding uh hi.
Tua tham loin, mi khatpeuh in hih thupiakna a siatsak leh ama inn panin a innkam khat kidawh khiatsakin tua tungah amah kihen cipin kisat gawp ding a, tua banah a inn zong a kisuksiat nading thu kong pia thuah lai hi.
Hih ka thupiakna a siasak nuam, Jerusalem a, Pasian' inn a susia nuam kumpi khatpeuh ahi a, mi khatpeuh ahi zongin a om leh, ama min om nading a, tua mun a bawl Pasian in tua mipa lawnthal ta hen. Keimah Darias in thu kong pia hi; ka thupiak bang tektekin sep ding ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi Darias in amaute tungah a thupiak bang tektekin Eufrates gungal gam sung a uk sawn Tattenai, Shetharbozenai, leh a lawmte in sem uh hi.
Tua hi a, kamsang Haggai leh Iddo' suan Zekhariah' thugenkholhna hangin Judah upate in a inn lam uh zom suakin mavang uh hi. Israel Pasian' sawlna leh Persia kumpi Sairas leh Darias leh Artakzaksis-te' thupiakna tawh amaute in a inn lam uh a zo uh hi;
tua hi a, kumpi Darias' kum gukna, Adar kha a ni sawmnih-le-thum ni-in a inn kizo hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite, siampite leh Levi mite leh sal a suaksa hong ciahkik mi khempeuh in lungdamna lianpi tawh Pasian' inn apna bawl uh hi.
Amaute in Pasian' inn apna-in bawngtal zakhat, tuutal zanih, leh tuuno zali go uh a, mawhna hanga biak nadingin Israelte khempeuh adingin a minam phazah tawh kizui-in keeltal sawm-le-nih pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Moses laibu sungah a kigelh bangin Jerusalem a, Pasian' nasep nadingin siampite amau' panmun ngei-ah pangsak uh a, Levi mite amau nasepna ngei-ah sem sak kik uh hi.
A kha masa a ni sawm-le-li ni-in sal a suaksa hong ciahkik mite in Paisan Pawi bawl uh hi.
Siampite leh Levi mite a vekpi-un kisian'suah khin uh a, a vekpi-un zehsiang khin uh hi; tua hi a, amaute in sal suaksa a hong ciahkik khempeuh ading, a siampi pihte uh leh amau mahmah adingin Paisan tuuno go uh hi.
Salsuahna panin a hong ciahkik Israelte leh Israel Pasian, Topa bia dingin tua gam-a midang teengte leh a nitna uh pan amau leh amau a kihemkhia tawm mite khempeuh in tua Paisan Pawi an ne uh hi.
Tua hi a, amaute in lungdamna tawh ni sagih sung silngo sawhloh anlum pawi bawl uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amau' lungdam nading a om theih nadingin Topa in Assiria kumpipa' lungsim amau tungah a nuam dingin bawlsak a, tua ahih manin Israel Pasian ahi Pasian' inn a sepna uhah kumpipa in amaute huh hi.
Hih thu teng khit ciangin Persia kumpipa Artakzaksis uk hun sungin Ezra, a pa Seraiah, a pa Azariah, a pa Hilkiah,
a pa Shallum, a pa Zadok, a pa Ahitub,
a pa Amariah, a pa Azariah, a pa Meraioth,
a pa Zerahiah, a pa Uzzi, a pa Bukki,
a pa Abishua, a pa Finehas, a pa Elazar, a pa, siampi lian Aaron—
hih Ezra pen Babilon panin hong paito hi. Amah pen Israel Pasian, Topa in a piak Moses thukham a siam lai thei mi khat ahi hi; Topa ahi ama Pasian in ompih ahih manin ama nget khempeuh kumpipa in pia hi.
Kumpi Artakzaksis in a uk a kum sagihna kumin Israel mite, siampite, Levi mite, lasate, kongcingte, leh biakinn nasemte pawlkhat zong, Jerusalem ah Ezra tawh paito uh hi.
Kumpipa' uk kum sagih a cin' kum, a kha ngana sungin Jerusalem tung uh hi;
a kha masa a ni khat ni-in Babilon panin dingkhia dingin Ezra in a ni sehkhol a, a kha ngana a ni khat ni-in Jerusalem tung uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in amah ompih hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Ezra in Topa' thukham a sin ding, a zui ding, leh Israel mite a hilh dingin amah kipia hi.
Kumpi Artakzaksis in siampi ahi, lai theipa lah ahi, Israelte' adingin Topa' thupiaknate leh thukhamte a siam Ezra tungah a piak lai in hih bang ahi hi:
"Kumpite' kumpi ahi Artakzaksis kiang panin vantung Pasian' thukham a siam, siampi hi-in lai theipa lah ahi Ezra tungah:
Ka lungsim khentatna in hih bang ahi hi. Ka gam sunga om Israel mi khatpeuh ahi a, a siampite ahi uh a, Levi mite ahi zongin, Jerusalem ah a painuam khempeuh in nang hong zuih theih nadingun thu ka pia hi.
Nang tungah hong kipia ahi na Pasian' thukham tawh kisai-in Judah leh Jerusalem ah thu bangci om hiam cih a va thei dingin kumpipa keimah leh thu hong lamlak mihing sagihte in kong sawl uh hi.
Kumpipa leh a thu lamlakte in lungkim takin Jerusalem ah a teeng Israel Pasian tungah a piak ngun leh khamte zong,
Babilon gam sunga na muh uh ngun leh khamte, leh Jerusalem a, note' Pasian' inn dingin mite leh siampite in lungkim takin a piakkhiat zuahzuahte uh tawh a va puakkhawm ding na hi hi.
Hih ka thupiakna tawh kizui-in hih sumte pen Jerusalem a, note' Pasian inn-a biakna tau tungah piak dingin bawngtalte, tuutalte, tuunote, leh a an tawh biaknate leh a leenggahzu tawh biak nadingte lei nading bekin na zang ding uh hi.
Tua banah ngun leh kham a val a om lai leh, note' Pasian' deihna tawh kituakin hoih na sak bangun na lawmte tawh na zang thei ding uh hi.
Na Pasian' inn ah zat dingin hong kipia um-le-beelte pen Jerusalem Pasian tungah na va pia ding hi.
Na Pasian' inn adingin a kisam, na piak ding a phamawh a om khak zenzen leh kumpipa' sum sung panin na zang thei ding hi.
"Tua hi a, kumpipa keimah Artakzaksis in Eufrates gungal gam sunga kumpi vankemte khempeuh tungah hih bangin thu ka pia hi: Vantung Pasian' thukham a siam lai a thei, siampi Ezra in note tung panin a kisapna hong nget ciangin,
ngun talen zakhat, mangbuh seu zakhat, leenggahzu tambong zanih, sathau tambong zanih ciang, leh ci a deih zahzah na pia ding uh hi.
Vantung Pasian in a deih peuhpeuh, vantung Pasian' inn adingin lim takin hih un; tua hi kei leh kumpipa' tapate leh kumpigam tungah amah hong heh kha ding hi.
Siampite, Levi mite, lasate, kongcingte, biakinn nasemte, ahih kei leh hih Pasian' inn-a nasemte khat peuhpeuh tung panin siah ahi a, mangmu ahi a, lo sap ahi zongin lak nading thu na neih lohna uh zong kong zasak uh hi, ka ci hi.
"Tua hi a, nang Ezra in nang tungah hong kipia na Pasian' pilna tawh kizui-in Eufrates Gungal gam sunga mite thu a khen dingin na Pasian' thukham a thei mite seh in; nang leh amaute in na Pasian' thukham a thei lote na hilh ding uh hi.
Na Pasian' thukham leh kumpipa' thukham a mang lo peuhmah, sihna ahi a, hawlkhiatna ahi a, neihsa matna ahi a, thongkiatna ahi zongin, a ngah ding a kilawm thukhenna tawh khauh takin dan kitat ding hi," a ci hi.
Kumpi Artakzaksis' uk hun sungin Babilon panin kei tawh hong ciahto khawm a behbeh-in a kiciamteh beh lutangte in:
Finehas-te panin Gershom ahi hi. Ithamar-te beh panin Daniel ahi hi. David-te beh panin Shekaniah' tapa Hattush ahi hi.
Parosh-te beh sung panin Zekhariah hi a, amah tawh pasal zakhat leh sawmnga kiciamteh hi.
Pahathmoab-te beh panin Zerahiah' tapa Elieho-enai hi a, pasal zanih tawh ahi hi.
Zattu-te beh panin Zahaziel' tapa Shekaniah hi a, pasal zathum tawh ahi hi.
Adin-te beh panin Jonathan' tapa Ebed hi a, pasal sawmnga tawh ahi hi.
Elam-te beh panin Athaliah' tapa Isaiah hi a, pasal sawmsagih tawh ahi hi.
Shefatiah-te beh panin Mikhael' tapa Zebadiah hi a, pasal sawmgiat tawh ahi hi.
Joab-te beh panin Jehiel' tapa Obadiah hi a, pasal zanih leh sawm-le-giat tawh ahi hi.
Bani-te beh panin Josifiah' tapa Shelomith hi a, pasal zakhat leh sawmguk tawh ahi hi.
Bebai-te beh panin Bebai' tapa Zekhariah hi a, pasal sawmnih-le-giat tawh ahi hi.
Azgad-te beh panin Hakkatan' tapa Johanan hi a, pasal zakhat leh sawmkhat tawh ahi hi.
A nunung penin Adonikam-te beh pan hi a, amaute' min in: Elifelet, Jeiel, leh Shemaiah hi uh a, pasal sawmguk tawh ahi uh hi.
Bigvai-te beh panin Uthai leh Zabbud hi uh a, pasal sawmsagih tawh ahi uh hi.
Ahava gam lamah lui gei khatah amaute ka khawm a, tua lai-ah ni thum ka taam uh hi. Mite leh siampite ka etphat ciangin Levi mite khat zong na om lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a lawmte lakah a makai Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zekhariah, leh Meshullamte, leh thu ngaihsut a siam Jo-i-arib leh Elnathante ka sam a,
Kasifia mun a, a makaipipa Iddo kiangah va pai-in, tua lai-a biakinn nasem amah leh a behte in, eite' Pasian' inn-a na a sem ding mihing hong puak ding uh a ngen dingin ka sawl hi.
Tua hi a, hehpihna a nei eite' Pasian in hong ompih ahih manin Levi mi Mahli-te beh sung panin thu ngaihsut siam mi ahi Sherebiah, a tapate leh a behte tawh pasal sawm-le-giat,
leh Merari-te beh panin Isaiah, a behte leh amau' tapate mi sawmnih leh Hashabiah tawh,
leh Levi mite' na a sem dingin David leh a uliante in a tuamkoih ahi biakinn nasem zanih leh sawmnih hong pia hi. Hih mite khempeuh amau' min ciat tawh a kisam ahi hi.
Tua ciangin eite' Pasian' mai-ah kote kiniamkhiat thei-in kote leh ka naupangte uh leh ka neihsa khempeuh uh nuam takin ka khualzinna uhah ka pai theih nading uh Pasian' tung pan ka nget theih nadingun Ahava lui-ah antan' nading thu ka taangko hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa kiangah, "Ka Pasian un amah a zong mite khempeuh ompihin amau' adingin a hoih na sem a, amah a nusiate khempeuh tungah amah heh hi," ci-in gen khin ka hih manun lampi-ah kote hong kha dingin galkapte leh sakol tung tuangte kumpipa kiangah ka nget ding ka maizum hi.
Tua hi a, kote in an ka tang uh hi; nuamtak-a ka khualzin theih nading uh i Pasian tungah ka ngen uh a, amah in ka thungetna uh hong pia hi.
Tua ciangin siampi liante sung panin, mi sawm-le-nih, leh Sherebiah, Hashabiah, leh amau' behte mi sawm, ka tuam koih hi.
Tua ciangin, i Pasian' inn nasep nadingin kumpipa leh a thulamlakte leh a uliante leh tua lai-a om Israel mi khempeuh in a tuam khenkhiat uh ngun leh kham leh um-le-beelte, amaute tungah ka ap hi.
Amaute tungah ngun talen zaguk leh sawmnga, talen nih a gik ngun tawh kibawl um-le-beel zakhat, kham talen zakhat,
kham darik tulkhat a man tawh kibawl kuang-uk sawmnih, leh kham zah-a a manpha sumsan hoih tawh a kibawl beel nih ka pia hi.
Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, "Topa tungah note hong ki-ap hi; um-le-beelte zong biakna vante ahi hi; ngun leh khamte ahih leh na pu na pate uh Pasian ahi Topa tungah citna tawh a kipia na ahi hi.
Siampi liante leh Levi mite leh Israel mi leh lutangte' muh-in Jerusalem khua a, Topa' inndei sungah na piak dong mateng uh vilin kem un," ka ci hi.
Tua ahih manin siampite leh Levi mite in Jerusalem a, i Pasian' inn ah puak dingin ngun leh kham leh um-le-beelte hong sang uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jerusalem zuan dingin kha masa a ni sawm-le-nih ni-in Ahava lui panin ka dingkhia uh hi; i Pasian in eite hong ompih ahih manin lam kal-ah galte leh pan'simna a tuamtuamte tawh hong kipelhsak hi.
Jerusalem khua ka tun' uh ciangin ni thum sung ka tawlnga uh hi.
A ni li ni-in Uriah' tapa siampi Meremoth' tavuan lakna tawh i Pasian' inn sungah ngun leh kham leh um-le-beelte kiseng hi; Finehas' tapa Eleazar in amah huh a, Levi mi Jeshua' tapa Jozabad leh Binnui' tapa Noadiah in amau tegel huh uh hi.
Vante a ki-ap ciangin lim takin kivel a, a ki-ap na khempeuh ciamtehna lai khat kibawl hi.
