ahi zongin tu ni-in ka pa' innkuan lang khatah note tho-in a tapate mi sawmsagih suang khat tungah na that uh a, ka pa in a nasem numei tawh a neih a tapa Abimelek pen note' tanau ahihna hangin Shekhem khua mite tungah kumpi-in na bawl uh hi—
note in tu ni-in Jerubbaal leh a innkuanpihte tungah lungsim tak leh thuman tak tawh a gamta takpi mah na hih uh leh, Abimelek tungah note lungdam un la, note tungah amah zong lungdam hen;
ahih hangin tua bang ahih takpi kei leh, Abimelek sung panin meikuang hong paikhia hen la, Shekhem leh Bethmillo khua mite kangtum hen; Shekhem khua mite sung pan leh Bethmillo khua mite sung panin meikuang hong pai hen la, Abimelek kangtum hen,' a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a sanggampa Abimelek a kihtakna hangin Jotham taikhia-in Be-er-ah pai-in tua lai-ah teeng hi.
Abimelek in Israelte tungah kum thum sung uk hi.
Pasian in Abimelek leh Shekhem mite kikalah khagilo sawlin kigalneihna omsak hi; tua ciangin Shekhem mite in Abimelek lehdo uh hi;
tua in, Jerubbaal tapa sawmsagihte a kithahna thu tawh kisai-in, amaute a that a sanggampa uh Abimelek, leh a sanggamte thah nadingin a hanthawn Shekhem mite tungah thukkikna hong tun' theih nadingin a kibawl mahmah ahi hi.
Tua hi a, Shekhem mite in amah pangsim dingin mual dawn-ah mi khempeuhte' na nasut uh hi; hih thu Abimelek kiangah kigen hi.
Tua ciangin Ebed' tapa Ga-al a tanaute tawh Shekhem-ah hong kuan hi; Shekhem mite in amah muang uh hi.
Amaute lo-ah kuanin a leenggui lo uh panin leenggah khawmin cil uh a, pawi khamin amaute' pasian' inn-ah pai uh a, anne tuidawnin omin Abimelek zahko uh hi.
Tua ciangin Ebed' tapa Ga-al in, "Abimelek in kua hi a, ama na i sep dingin ei Shekhem mite in kua i hi hiam? Jerubbaal tapa leh ama ulian Zebul in Shekhem mite' pu leh pa Hamor' na sem hilo ahi uh hiam? Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin ama na sem ding i hi hiam?
Hih mite keima khut nuai a, om hi tazen leh Abimelek ka khin khia ding hi. Abimelek kiangah, 'Na galkap behlap in la hong kuan khia in,' ka ci ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua khuapi a uk Zebul in Ebed tapa Ga-al' kammalte a zak ciangin heh mahmah hi.
Amah in Arumah khua-a om Abimelek kiangah kamtaite sawlin, "En in, Ebed tapa Ga-al leh a tanaute Shekhem-ah hong pai-in nang langpangin tua khuapi sosuah uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in nang leh nang tawh a om mite zan-in pai un la gamlakah pangsim un.
Tua ciangin zingsang ciang ni a suah phetin tho baih un la khuapi bawh un; tua ciangin amah leh amah tawh a om mite nang a do dingin hong kuan khiat ciangun a hi thei bangin amaute tungah na bawl ding hi," ci sak hi.
Tua ciangin Abimelek leh amah tawh a om mite khempeuh zan-in tho-in pawl li kisuahin Shekhem sim dingin pangsim uh hi.
Tua ciangin Ebed tapa Ga-al paikhia-in khuapi kulh kongpi lutna-ah ding hi; tua ciang Abimelek leh amah tawh a om mite a pan'simna panun ding to uh hi.
Ga-al in tua mite a muh ciangin amah in Zebul kiangah, "En in, mual dawn panin mite hong paisuk!" a ci hi. Zebul in ama kiangah, "Mual liimte mi bangin a mu na hi hi," a ci hi.
Ga-al pau kikin, "En in, a gam laizang panin mite hong paisuk a, Aisaante' Tawsaw lam panin pawl khat hong pai hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Zebul in ama kiangah, "Tu-in na kam han'na koi-ah om hiam, 'Ama na i sep dingin Abimelek in kua ahi hiam?' a ci pa aw, Hih mite in na simmawhte hilo ahi hiam? Tu-in paikhia in la amaute tawh kido in,"a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Shekhem mite mai-ah Ga-al kuan khia-in Abimelek tawh kido hi.
Abimelek in amah delh a, a mai-ah amah tai hi; kulh kongpi lutna dongah mi tampi liamin tuk hi.
Tua ciangin Arumah-ah Abimelek teeng hi; Zebul in Ga-al leh a tanaute hawlkhia a, amaute Shekhem-ah teeng thei nawn lo uh hi.
A zing ciangin gamlakah Shekhem mite paikhia uh hi. Hih thu Abimelek kiangah kigen hi.
Amah in a mite la-in pawlthum suahin gamlakah pangsim uh hi; tua ciangin amah khuadakin khuapi panin mite a kuankhia mu a, amaute do-in kipan a, amaute that hi.
Abimelek leh amah tawh a om a pawlte in thakhatin mainawt uh a, ama pawl dang nihte in gamlak-a om mite delhin a thah sungin khuapi kulhpi lutna-ah amaute na ding uh hi.
Abimelek in sun tawntung tua khuapi sim hi; amah in tua khuapi la-in a sunga om mite that hi; amah in tua khuapi phiatmai-in ci vawh hi.
Shekhem Tausang mite khempeuh in tua thu a zak uh ciangin Elberith' inn mun muanhuai-ah lut uh hi.
Shekhem Tausang mite khempeuh kikaikhawm uh hi, ci-in Abimelek kiangah kigen hi.
Tua ciangin amah leh amah tawh a om mi khempeuh tawh Zalmon Mual-ah Abimelek paito hi; Abimelek in a khut-in hei khat la-in selkeu lom khat sat a, tuate la to-in a liangko tungah pua hi. Tua ciangin amah tawh a om mite kiangah, "Kei hih nong muhsa bangun kei' hih bangbangin manlangin hih un," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi khempeuh amau' ading selkeu lom satin Abimelek zui-in mun muanhuai sim nadingin koih uh a, amaute in mei tawh mun muanhuai halin Shekhem Tausang mite khempeuh zong, numei leh pasal mi tulkhat bang si hi.
Tua ciangin Thebez-ah Abimelek pai a, Thebez langpangin giahphual sat a, tua khua la hi.
Ahih hangin tua khuapi sungah tausang muanhuai khat om a, tua khua numei leh pasal, tua khuami khempeuh tua tausang-ah tai-in kikhaknelh uh hi; tua ciangin tausang khum-ah amaute pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Abimelek tausangah pai-in sim a, mei tawh a hal dingin tausang kongkhak naih hi.
Numei khat in an gawina suangpeek tungnung Abimelek'lu tungah khiatsukin a lu guh deeng kham hi.
Tua ciangin Abimelek in ama hiam a tawisak tangvalpa nawh sapin ama kiangah, "Na namsau dok in la kei hong that in, tua hi kei leh mite in, 'Numei khat in, amah that hi,' hong ci kha ding uh hi," a ci hi. A tangvalpa in amah sun letin amah si hi.
Israel mite in Abimelek a sihna a muh uh ciangin amau' inn ciatah ciah uh hi.
Ama sanggam sawmsagihte thatin a pa tungah a khialhna hangin tua bangin Pasian in Abimelek' khialhna thuk hi;
Pasian in Shekhem mite khempeuh' gitlohna amau' lu tungah tusak kik hi; tua bangin Jerubbaal' tapa Jotham' samsiatnate amau tungah a tung hi.
Abimelek khit ciangin Israelte a honkhia dingin Issakhar minam Dodo' tapa Puah' tapa Tola hong khang hi; amah Efraim mualtung gam Shamir-ah teeng hi.
Amah in Israelte kum sawmnih leh kum thum sung thu khen hi. Tua ciangin amah si a, Shamir-ah kivui hi.
Ama khit ciangin Israelte kum sawmnih leh kum nih sung thu a khen Gilead mi Jair hong khang hi.
Amah in la sawmthum tungah a tuang tapa sawmthum nei hi; amaute in Gilead gam sunga om tu dongin Havvothjair a kici khuapi sawmthum nei uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jair si-in Kamon-ah kivui hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite in Topa' muhna-ah a sia gamta kik uh a, Siria mite pasiante, Sidon mite pasiante, Moab mite pasiante, Ammon mite pasiante, leh Filistia gam mite' pasiante ahi Baalte leh Ashtaroth' na sem uh hi; amaute in Topa nusia-in ama' na sem lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israelte tungah Topa' hehna so a, amah in Filistia mite tung leh Ammon mite tungah amaute pia a,
amaute in Israel mite tua kum sugawpin nengniam uh hi. Amaute in Jordan galkhat Gilead gam sunga om Amor mite' leitangah a om Israel mite khempeuh kum sawm leh kum giat sung nengniam uh hi.
Ammon mite in Judah leh Benjamin leh Efraim minamte zong a do dingin Jordan galkah uh hi; tua ahih ciangin Israelte nakpi takin lungkham uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite Topa tungah kiko uh a, "Nang tungah ka khial khin uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kote in ka Pasian uh nusia-in Baalte' na ka sem uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Topa in Israel mite kiangah, "Iziptte leh Amor mite, Ammon mite leh Filistia mite kiang panin hong honkhia hilo ka hi hiam?
Sidon mite, Amalek mite leh Maon mite in zong note hong nengniam uh hi; kei tungah note nong kiko uh a, keimah in amaute' khut sung panin note kong honkhia hi.
Tua hi napi-in note in kei hong nusia-in pasian dangte' na na sem uh hi; tua ahih ciangin note kong honkhia nawn kei ding hi.
Pai un la note' teel pasiante tungah ko un;' na lungkham hun-un amaute kihonkhia sak un," a ci hi.
Israel mite in Topa tungah, "Ka khial khin uh hi; hoih na sak bangbangin ko tungah hong hih in; tu ni-in hong honkhia in, kong thuum uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in amau' lak panin gamdang pasiante koih khia-in Topa' na sem uh hi; tua ciangin Israelte' gentheihna-ah amah dah hi.
Tua ciangin Ammon mite galhiam tawi dingin kisam uh a, Gilead-ah giahphual sat uh hi; Israel mite zong kikaikhawmin Mizpah-ah giahphual sat uh hi.
Tua ciangin mite, Gilead makaite khat leh khat in, "Ammon mite do dinga a kipan ngam kua om ahi hiam? Amah in Gilead gam-a teeng mite khempeuh tungah lutang hi ding hi," a kici uh hi.
Tu-in Gilead khua mi Jefthah in a vanglian galhang khat hi a, ahih hangin amah in a paktat numei' tapa ahi hi. Gilead in Jefthah' pa ahi hi.
Gilead' zi in zong amah tawh tapate nei hi; a tapate a khan' ciangun amaute in Jefthah notkhia-in ama kiangah, "Ka pa uh inn sungah gamh na luah kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh nang in numei dang' tapa na hi hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin a sanggamte kiang panin Jefthah tai-in Tob gam sungah teeng hi; bangmah manlo mite in Jefthah pawmin amah tawh mite sugawpin pai uh hi.
Tawlkhat khit ciangin Ammon mite in Israelte do uh hi.
Ammon mite in Israelte a do ciangin, Tob gam panin Jefthah a la dingin Gilead upate va pai uh hi;
amaute in Jefthah kiangah, "Ammon mite i do theih nadingin hong pai in la kote' makai hong hi in," va ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jefthah in Gilead upate kiangah, "Note in kei hong mudahin ka pa' inn pan hong hawlkhia hilo na hi uh hiam? Bang hangin thu haksa na tuah uh ciangin kei kiangah hong pai na hi uh hiam?" a na ci hi.
Tua ciangin Gilead upate in Jefthah kiangah, "Kote tawh nang hong pai-in Ammon mite do-in Gilead gam sunga teeng mi khempeuh tungah lutang nong hih theih nadingin tua thu hang mahin nang lamah hong kihei ka hi uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Jefthah in Gilead upate kiangah, "Note in Ammon mite do dingin inn-ah nong ciahpih uh a, kei tungah Topa in amaute hong piak leh keimah in note' lutang ka hi ding hi," a ci hi.
Gilead upate in Jefthah kiangah, "Topa in eite kikalah teci hi ding hi; na cih bangin ka hi taktak ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Gilead upate tawh Jefthah pai a, mite in amau' tunga lutang leh makai-in amah koih uh hi; Jefthah in hih thute khempeuh Mizpah khua sung Topa mai-ah gen hi.
Tua ciangin Jefthah in Ammon mite kumpipa kiangah kamtaite sawlin, "Ka gam sim dingin kei kiangah nong pai nadingin kei tungah bang thu om ahi hiam?" ci sak hi.
Ammon mite kumpipa in Jefthah' kamtaite dawng a, "Izipt panin Israelte hong pai lai-in Arnon panin Jabbok leh Jordan ciang ka gam hong lak sak hang ahi hi; tua ahih ciangin tu-in thudamin hong pia kik in," a ci hi.
Jefthah in Ammon mite kumpipa kiangah kamtaite sawl kik a,
ama kiangah, "Jefthah in hih bangin ci hi: Israelte in Moab leitang hita leh Ammon mite leitang hita leh la lo hi.
Izipt panin Israelte hong paitoh lai-in gamlak tawnin San Tuipi-ah hong pai-in Kadesh hong tung uh hi.
Israelte in Edom kumpipa kiangah kamtaite sawl a, 'Kong thuum hi, na gam sung hong nawksak in,' ci sak uh hi; ahih hangin Edom kumpipa in a thu ngai lo hi. Tua ciangin Moab kumpipa kiangah zong sawl uh a, ahih hangin amah thukim lo hi. Tua ahih ciangin Kadesh-ah Israelte om phot uh hi.
Tua ciangin gamlak tawnin amaute khualzin uh a, Edom gam leh Moab gam kimkotin pai-in Moab gam nisuahna lam pangah tung uh a, Arnon gal khatah phual sat uh hi; ahih hangin Moab gam sungah amaute lut lo uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Arnon in Moab gamgi ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Israelte in Heshbon kumpi ahi Amor mite kumpi Sihon kiangah kamtaite sawl uh hi; Israelte in ama kiangah, 'Kong thuum uh hi, ka gam uh a zuan dingin na gam hong nawk sak in,' ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Sihon in ama gam nawk dingin Israelte muang lo hi; tua ahih ciangin Sihon in a mite khempeuh kaikhawmin Jahaz-ah giahphual sat a, Israelte do hi.
Topa, Israelte Pasian in Sihon leh a mite khempeuh Israelte' khut sungah pia a, amaute in zo uh hi; tua ahih ciangin tua gam sunga teeng Amor mite' leitang khempeuh Israelte in luah uh hi.
Amaute in Arnon panin Jabbok ciang leh sehnel gam panin Jordan ciang, Amor mite gam khempeuh luah uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa, Israelte' Pasian in ama mi Israelte' mai panin Amor mite paaikhia hi; tu-in nangmah in amaute luah kik ding sawm na hi hiam?
Na Pasian Khemosh in na neih dinga hong piakte tang lo ding na hi hiam? Topa ka Pasian un kote mai-ah a suankhiatte kote in ka tang ding uh hi.
Tu-in nang in Moab kumpipa Zippor' tapa Balak sangin gina zaw na hi hiam? Amah in Israelte to ngei a, amaute do ngei ahi hiam?
Heshbon leh a khua neute, leh Aroer leh a khua neute, leh Arnon gun pang-a om khuapite khempeuh sungah Israelte a teen' kum zathum hun sung tengin bang hangin amaute la kik lo na hi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin nang tungah ka khial kei a, kei nong dona-ah kei tungah nang nong khial hi; Topa, Thukhenpa in Israel mite leh Ammon mite kikal-ah tu ni-in thu khen hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Ammon kumpipa in ama kiangah a puak Jefthah' thu don lo hi.
Tua ciangin Jefthah tungah Topa' Kha hong tung a, amah in Gilead leh Manasseh nawkin Gilead gam Mizpah ah paisuak a, Gilead gam Mizpah panin Ammon mite kiangah paisuak lai hi.
Jefthah in Topa tungah thuciamna bawlin, "Ka khut sungah Ammon mite nong piak leh,
Ammon mite kiang pan gualzo-in ka ciah ciangin keimah dawn dingin ka inn sung pan hong pai peuhpeuh Topa aa hi ding a, meihal biak nadingin kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute do dingin Ammon mite kiangah Jefthah gal kah hi; Topa in amaute ama khut sungah pia hi.
Amah in Aroer panin Minnith kiimnai ciang dong khuapi sawmnih, leh Abelkeramim ciang dong mi tampi tak thatin vatgawp hi. Tua ahih ciangin Israel mite mai-ah Ammon mite guallel hi.
Tua ciangin Mizpah-a ama inn-ah Jefthah hong ciah hi; en in, amah dawn dingin a tanu khuangneute tawh lamsa-in hong paikhia hi; tua nu in ama ta khat neihsun ahi hi; amah simloh tapa ahi a, tanu ahi zongin nei lo hi.
Amah in tua nu a muh ciangin a puan balkeekin, "Ala, ka tanu! kei nong niam koih mahmah hi, kei adingin lungkhamna lianpi nong suak hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa tungah thu ka ciam khin a, ka thuciamna ka dokkik thei kei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua nu in ama kiangah, "Ka pa aw, Topa tungah thu ciam khin na hih leh, na kam panin a paikhia tawh kizui-in kei tungah hong bawl in, tu-in Topa in na gal Ammon mite tungah nang ading hong thuksak khin hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a pa kiangah, "Kei adingin hih bang hong hi sak in; kei pai-in mualte tungah vak kawikawi-in kei leh ka lawmte in nungak-a ka sih nading hangin ka thuum theih nadingun kha nih sung kei guak hong omsak in," a ci hi.
Amah in, "Pai ta in," a ci hi. Amah in kha nih sung amah pai khiasak in; tua ciangin amah leh a lawmte pai khia-in nungak-a a sih nading hangin mualte tungah thuum uh hi.
Kha nih a cin' ciangin a pa kiangah amah ciahkik a, amah in ama bawlsa a thuciamna bangin tua nu tungah hih hi. Tua nu in pasal tawh a lum khawm nailo, nungak-in khan'sih hi. Tua ciangin Israelte sungah ngeina khat suak a,
Israel tanute kum khatin ni li sung kum simin Gilead mi Jefthah' tanu hangin a thuum dingin pai uh hi.
Efraim mite galhiam tawi dingin kisam uh a, amaute Zafon-ah galkah uh a, Jefthah kiangah, "Bang hangin Ammon mite sim dingin galkahin, nang tawh a kuan khawm dingin kote hong zawn lo na hi hiam? Na inn nang tawh kong hal nelh ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jefthah in amaute kiangah, "Kei leh ka mite in Ammon mite tawh buaina lianpi khat ka nei uh hi; note kong sap ciangin amau' khut sung panin kei nong honkhia kei uh hi.
Note in kei nong hotkhiat loh ding uh ka theih ciangin keimah mah hanciam tawmin Ammon mite do dingin ka galkah a, Topa in kei khut sungah amaute hong pia hi; tua ahih ciangin bang hangin tu ni-in kei do dingin hong kuan na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jefthah in Gilead mite khempeuh khawmin Efraim mite tawh kido uh hi; Gilead mite in Efraim mite vatgawp hi, bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in, "No Gilead mite in Efraimte leh Manassehte lakah Efraim galtaite na hi uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Gilead mite in Efraim mite tung panin Jordan ngahmunte la uh hi. Efraim galtaite khat peuhpeuh in, "Hong galkah sak in," a cih ciangin Gilead mite in ama kiangah, "Efraim mi na hi hiam?" ci uh hi. Amah in, "Hi kei ing," a cih ciangin,
amaute in ama kiangah, "Tua ahih leh Shibboleth ci in," ci uh a, tua ciangin amah in, "Sibboleth" ci hi, bang hang hiam cih leh a manin ci thei lo hi; tua ciangin amaute in amah manin Jordan ngahmunte-ah that uh hi. Tua tungin Efraim mite mi tul sawmli leh tulnih si uh hi.
Jefthah in Israelte kum guk sung thu khen hi. Tua ciangin Gilead mi Jefthah si a, Gilead gam ama khuapi sungah kivui hi.
Ama nungah Bethlehem khuami Ibzan in Israelte thu khen hi.
Amah in tapa sawmthum nei hi; ama beh pualam mite tungah tanu sawmthum mokhak a, a pualam panin a tapate adingin tanu sawmthum la hi. Amah in Israelte kum sagih sung thu khen hi.
Tua ciangin Ibzan si a, Bethlehem-ah kivui hi.
Ama nungah Zebulun mi Elon in Israelte thu khen hi; amah in Israelte kum sawm sung thu khen hi.
Tua ciangin Zebulun mi Elon si a, Zebulun gam Aijalon-ah kivui hi.
Ama sungah Pirathon mi Hillel' tapa Abdon in Israelte thu khen hi.
Amah in la sawmsagihte tungah a tuang tapa sawmli leh tupa sawmthum nei hi; amah in Israelte kum giat sung thu khen hi.
Tua ciangin Pirathon mi Hillel tapa Abdon si a, Amalek mite' mualtung gam Efraim leitang tung, Pirathon-ah kivui hi.
Israel mite Topa muhna-ah a sia gamta kik uh hi; Topa in Filistia mite' khut sungah kum sawmli sung amaute pia hi.
Dan minam sung panin Zorah khuami Manoah min nei khat om hi; ama zi in tasel hi a, ta nei lo hi.
Topa' vantungmi numei kiangah kilangin ama kiangah, "En in, na tasel a, ta na nei kei hi; ahih hangin gai-in tapa khat na nei ding hi.
bang hang hiam cih leh nang gai-in tapa khat na nei ding hi. Ama lu tungah mulkiatna kitah lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh naupang in a suah a, kipanin Pasian tungah Nazir mi hi ding hi; amah in Filistia mite' khut sung panin Israelte hotkhiat ding kipan ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua nu pai-in a pasal kiangah gen a, "Pasian' mi khat ka kiangah hong pai a, ama meel in Pasian' vantungmi meel tawh kibangin dipkuat-huai mahmah hi; koi pan-a hong pai cih amah ka dong kei a, amah in ama min hong gen lo hi;
Tua ciangin Manoah in Topa kunh a, "Topa aw, kong thuum hi, na hong sawl Pasian' mipa ko kiangah hong paisak kik in la, a hong suak ding naupang ka bawl nading uh hong hilhsak in," a ci hi.
Pasian in Manoah' aw ngai-in lo lai-ah tua nu tut lai takin Pasian' vantungmi ama kiangah hong pai hi; ahih hangin a pasal Manoah amah tawh om lo hi.
Tua ciangin tua nu nawhsa-in tai-in a pasal kiangah gen a, "En in, zanhal a, kei kiangah hong pai mipa ka kiangah hong kilang hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Manoah ding-in a zi zui a, a mipa kiangah pai-in ama kiangah, "Hih nu kiangah, thu genpa in nang na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in, "Ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Manoah in, "Na thugente a manin hong tun' ciangin naupang' nuntakna zia ding bang hi a, amah in bang hih ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' vantungmi in Manoah kiangah, "Numei kiangah ka gente khempeuh na kidawm hen.
Manoah in Topa' vantungmi kiangah, "Kong thuum hi, tawlkhat khawl in la, nang adingin keelno khat hong bawl nung," a ci hi.
Topa' vantungmi in Manoah kiangah, "Nong khawlsak zongin na an ka ne kei ding hi; ahih hangin meihal biak nading a baihsa-in na bawl leh Topa tungah pia in," a ci hi. (Bang hang hiam cih leh Manoah in amah Topa' vantungmi ahi lam thei lo hi).
Manoah in Topa' vantungmi kiangah, "Na thugente a manin hong tun' ciangin nang kong pahtawi theih nadingun, na min bang ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Topa vantungmi in ama kiangah, "Hih in a lamdang hi, ci-in thei napi-in bang hangin ka min hong dong na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Manoah in an-a biakna tawh a keelno la-in na lamdang a bawl Topa adingin suang tungah pia hi.
Biakna tau panin vantung lamah meikuang a paitoh ciangin, Manoah leh a zi in a et lai takun biakna tau meikuang sungah Topa' vantungmi kahto hi; tua ciangin amaute lei lakah bok uh hi.
Topa' vantungmi Manoah leh a zi tungah kilang nawn lo hi. Tua ciangin Manoah in amah Topa' vantungmi ahih lam thei hi.
Manoah in a zi kiangah, "Pasian mu khin i hih manin i si taktak ding hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a zi in ama kiangah, "Topa in eite thah hong sawm hi leh, i khut panin meihal biakna leh an tawh biakna hong sang lo ding a, hih nate khempeuh hong lak loin, hih bang nate zong eite tungah hong pulak lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua numei in tapa khat nei-in a min Samson phuak hi; naupang khang a, Topa in amah thupha pia hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' Kha in Zorah leh Eshtaol kikal Mahanehdan-ah amah hanthot ding kipan hi.
Samson Timnah-ah paisuk a, Timnah-ah Filistia mi nungak khat mu hi.
Tua ciangin amah paito-in a pa leh a nu kiangah gen a, "Filistia mi nungak khat Timnah-ah ka mu hi; tu in ka zi dingin amah va la un," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a pa leh a nu in ama kiangah "Nang pai-in vun ki-at lo Filistia mite kiang panin zi na lak nadingin na tanaute' lak ahi a, i mite khempeuh lakah ahi zongin numei khat beek om lo ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi. Ahih hangin Samson in a pa kiangah, "Tua nu hong laksak in; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in ka lung hong kimsak mahmah hi," a ci hi.
A nu leh a pa in hih thu pen Topa kiang pan ahih lam thei lo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Filistia mite tungah paulap a zong ahi hi. Tua hun lai takin Filistia mite in Israelte uk hi.
Tua ciangin a nu leh a pa tawh Timnah-ah Samson paisuk a, Timnah leenggui lote-ah amah tung hi. En in, humpinelkai khanglai khat in, amah hawksan hi;
tua ciangin Topa' Kha ama tungah khauh takin hong tung a, mi khat in keelno khat a bal gawp bangin amah in a khut guak tawh humpinelkai balzan hi. Ahih hangin tua bangin a hih thu a nu tung ahi a, a pa tungah ahi zongin gen lo hi.
Tua ciangin amah paisukin a numei tawh kiho hi; tua nu in Samson lungkimsak mahmah hi.
Tawlkhat khit ciangin tua nu la dingin paikik hi; humpinelkai luanghawm en dingin amah lam pial in en in, humpinelkai luanghawm sungah khuai honkhat leh khuaizu om hi.
Amah in a khut tawh tuate sawkin paisuak a, a pai kawmin ne hi; amah a nu leh a pa kiangah tungin tuate pawlkhat pia a, amaute in ne uh hi. Ahih hangin humpinelkai luanghawm sung panin tua khuaizu a lakna thu gen lo hi.
Tua ciangin numei kiangah a pa paisuk a, Samson in tua lai-ah pawi khat kham hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tangvalte' hih ngei ahi hi.
Mite in amah a muh uh ciangin amah a uap dingin tangval sawmthum hong paipih uh hi.
Tua ciangin Samson in amaute kiangah, "Note mai-ah thu-haksa khat hong gensak un; hih pawi ni sagih sungin a thu mu khia-in bang hiam cih nong gen theih uh leh saihadial puan silh sawmthum leh pawipuan silh sawmthum note kong pia ding hi;
ahih hangin bang hang hiam cih nong gen theih kei uh leh saihadial puan silh sawmthum leh pawipuan silh sawmthum kei nong pia ding uh hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in ama kiangah, "Ka zak theih nadingun na thu-haksa hong gen in," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, "A ne-pa sung panin nek ding pawlkhat hong piang hi. A thahatpa sung panin a khum pawlkhat hong piang hi," a ci hi. Ni thum sungin tua thu-haksa bang hiam cih gen thei lo uh hi.
A nili ni-in amaute in Samson' zi kiangah, "A thu—haksa bang hiam cih hong gen nadingin na pasal zol in, tua hi kei leh nang leh na pa' inn mei tawh kong hal ding uh a, na si ding uh hi; Kote hong zawngsak dingin hih lai-ah hong sam na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Samson zi ama mai-ah kapin, "Kei nong mudah hi, kei nong it kei hi; ka gam mite tungah thu-haksa na gen a, bang hiam cih kei kiangah nong gen kei hi," a ci hi. Amah in numei kiangah, "En in, ka nu kiangah hita leh ka pa kiangah hita leh ka gen kei hi; nang kiangah hong gen ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua nu a pawi ni sagih hun sung teng ama mai-ah kap hi; a ni sagih ni-in amah in tua nu kiangah gen hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in nakpi takin kunh hi. Tua ciangin tua nu in a gam mite kiangah tua thu-haksa gen hi.
Tua khuapi mite in a ni sagih ni, ni a tum ma-in ama kiangah gen uh a, "Khuaizu sangin bang khum zaw hiam? Humpinelkai sangin bang hatzaw hiam?" a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, "Ka bawngla tawh lokho khawm lo hi le uh cin, ka thu-haksa na mu khia kei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' Kha khauh takin ama tungah hong tung a, Ashkelon-ah amah paisukin tua khua mite sawmthum that a, amaute' nate la-in a thu-haksa a gen mite tungah a pawi puante pia hi. Hehsa-in a pa' inn-ah ciah san hi.
Tua hi a, Samson' zi pen a moliahpa' zi dingin kipia hi.
Tawlkhat khit, mangbuh lak hunin a zi kiangah a hawh dingin keelno khat tawh Samson pai hi; amah in, "Inndei sung ka zi kiangah ka lum ding hi," a ci hi. Ahih hangin a numei' pa in amah lutsak lo hi.
Numei' pa in, "Amah mudah taktak hi niteh ci-in ka ngaihsun hi; tua ahih ciangin na lawmpa kiangah ka pia hi. A naunu amah sangin hoihzaw hilo ahi hiam? A u' tangin amah la in ci-in kong thuum hi," a ci hi.
Samson in amaute kiangah, "Tu tungin amau tungah siatna ka bawlna-ah Filistia mite tawh kisai-in ka mawh kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Samson pai-in ngia zathum manin meilah zong la hi; amah in a meite leh a meite kimatsakin a meite kikalah meilah khat koih hi.
A meilahte a kuan'sak khit ciangin Filistia mite' ankung ding laite lakah ngiate khah sak a, anphualte leh ankung ding laite, leh oliv lote kangtum hi.
Tua ciangin Filistia mite in, "Kua in hih hiam?" a ci uh hi. Amaute in, "Timnah mite' makpa Samson in hih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a zi lak sakin a lawmte tungah piaksak hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin Filistia mite hong paito-in tua nu leh a pa mei tawh hal lum uh hi.
Samson in amaute kiangah, "Hih in note' hih ahih leh, ka kiciam hi, note kong thuk ding a, tua khit ciangin ka khawl ding hi," a ci hi.
Amah in amaute dawm loin tampi that hi; tua ciangin amah paisukin Etam suanghawm sungah om hi.
Tua ciangin Filistia mite paito-in Judah-ah giahphual sat uh a, Lehi sim uh hi.
Judah mite in, "Bang hangin kote do-in hong paito na hi uh hiam?" a ci uh hi. Amaute in, "Samson a hen ding, ko tungah amah in hong hih bangin ama tungah ahih dingin kong paito uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Judah mite mihing tulthum Etam suanghawm-ah paisuk uh a, Samson kiangah, "Filistia mite in eite hong ukte ahihna thei lo na hi hiam? Kote tungah nang hong bawl bang ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi. Amah in amaute kiangah, "Amaute in kei tungah hong bawl bangin amaute tungah ka bawl hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in ama kiangah, "Filistia mite khut sungah nang kong piak theih nadingun nangmah a hen dingin kong paisuk uh hi," a ci uh hi. Samson in amaute kiangah, "Note mahmah in nong hih loh nading uh kei tungah hong kiciam un," a ci hi.
Amaute in ama kiangah, "Kong hih kei ding uh hi; nang hong hen bekin amaute khut sungah kong pia bek ding uh hi; nang kong that kei ding uh hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in khauhual thak nih tawh amah hen uh a, tua suang panin amah pai khiatpih to uh hi.
Amah Lehi a tun' ciangin amah dawn dingin Filistia mite hong pai-in awng uh hi; tua ciangin ama tungah Topa' Kha khauh takin hong tung a, a baan tunga om khauhualte pen mei in a kat anthul khau tawh kibang a, amah a kikhihnate a khut panin tolhkhia hi.
Tua ciangin amah in la khaguh thak khat mu a, a khut zanin tua khaguh la-in tua tawh mihing tulkhat that hi.
Tua ciangin Samson in, "La khaguh khat tawh, a lom a lomin, La khaguh khat tawh mihing tulkhat ka that hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a thugen a man khit ciangin a la khaguh paai khia hi; tua mun pen Ramathlehi kici hi.
Tua ciangin amah dangtak mahmah a, amah in Topa samin, "Na nasempa' tha tawh hih suahtakna lian na pia zo hi; tu-in dangtakin kei si-in vun at lote' khut sungah puk ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian in Lehi-a om komdep khat hong a, tua sung panin tui hong phul hi; amah in tui a dawn ciangin a lungsim hong dim kikin thakhauh kik hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua mun min Enhakkore kici hi; tu hun dongin Lehi-ah tua tuikhuk om hi.
Amah in Filistia mite' hun sung Israelte kum sawmnih sung thukhen hi.
Samson Gaza-ah pai a, tua lai-ah numei paktat khat mu-in tua nu kiangah a giak dingin amah pai hi.
Gaza mite kiangah "Samson hong pai," ci-in kigen a, amaute in tua mun umcihin khuapi kulh kongpi-ah zan tawntung amah pangsim uh hi. Amaute zan tawntung dai takin om uh a, "Zingsang khuavak mateng ngak ni; tua ciangin amah i that ding hi," ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin zankim ciang dong Samson lum a, zankim ciangin tho-in khuapi kulh kongpi kongkhakte leh a khuam nihte lenin a zawlte leh a na khempeuh bot to a, a liangko tungah tuate koihin Hebron mai-ah a om mual dawnah tuate pua hi.
Hih thu khit ciangin Sorekkuam-ah Delilah a kici numei khat ngai hi.
Tua ciangin Filistia mi uliante tua nu kiangah hong pai-in, "Amah hong zol in la, ama hatna koi lai-ah om hiam cihna leh amah i nuaisiah nadingin amah i hen theih nading, amah i zawh theih nading zia hong thei in; tua ciangin kote in ngun peek tul leh peek zakhat ciat nang kong pia ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Delilah in Samson kiangah, "Na thahatna lian koi lai-ah om a, mi khatpeuh in nang hong theih nadingin bang hong kici hen ding cihna thu, nong hehpihna-in hong gen in," a ci hi.
Samson in tua nu kiangah, "Amaute in a keu nai lo thalkhau thak sagih tawh hong hen leh ka tha neem ding a, midang mah ka bang ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Filistia mi uliante in tua nu kiangah a keu nai lo thalkhau sagih hong paipih uh a, tua nu in tua khaute tawh amah hen hi.
Tu-in tua nu in inndei sungnungah mi bu sak hi. Tua ciangin tua nu in ama kiangah, "Filistia mite in nang hong hih, Samson!" a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in, patkhaute in mei a suk khak ciangin a kitah bangin thalkhaute botsat hi. Tua ahih ciangin ama thahatna thusim kithei zo lo hi.
Tua ciangin Delilah in Samson kiangah, "En in, kei nong simmawh a, zuauthu nong gen hi; nang bang hong kici hen theih ding cih nong hehpihna-in hong gen in," a ci hi.
Amah in tua nu kiangah, "Amaute in a kizang nai lo khauhual thakte tawh kei hong hen leh ka tha neem ding a, midang mah ka bang ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Delilah in khauhual thakte la-in tuate tawh amah hen a, ama kiangah "Filistia mite in nang hong hih, Samson!" a ci hi. A busim mite inndei sungnungah om uh hi. Ahih hangin amah in mimkhau bangin khauhualte botsat ziau hi.
Tua ciangin Delilah in Samson kiangah, "Tu dong kei nong simmawh a, zuauthu nong gen hi; nang bang hong kici hen theih ding cih hong gen in," a ci hi. Amah in tua nu kiangah, "Ka lu tunga ka sam lom sagihte siamkhau tawh ganin ciampek tawh khen bikbek lecin ka tha neem ding a, midang mah ka bang ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah a ihmut lai takin a lu tunga a sam lom sagihte la-in siamin gan hi. Amah in ciampek tawh khen bikbek a, ama kiangah, "Filistia mite in nang hong hih, Samson!" a ci hi. Ahih hangin a ihmutna pan amah khanglo-in a ciampek, a siambu, leh a siam kai khia hi.
Tua ciangin numei in ama kiangah, "Bang hangin na lungsim kei tawh a om lopi, 'Nang kong it hi,' ci thei na hi hiam? Hih thumvei dong kei nong simmawh a, na thahatna a omna mun nong gen kei hi," a ci hi.
A kam tawh ni simin nakpi takin a kut ciangin, sihna dong dingin amah lunggim hi.
Amah in tua nu kiangah a lungsim khempeuh gen a, amah kiangah, "Ka lu tungah mulkiatna kitah ngei lo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka nu gil sunga kipan Pasian' tungah a kipia Nazir mi ka hi hi. Ka sam kimet leh ka hatna in kei hong nusia ding a, ka tha neem ding a, midang mah ka bang ding hi,"a ci hi.
Ama tungah a lungsim khempeuh gen khin hi, ci-in Delilah in a theih ciangin amah in mi sawlin Filistia mi uliante sam a, "Tu-a khatvei hong pai un; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a lungsim khempeuh kei kiangah hong gen khin zo hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Filistia uliante tua nu kiangah hong pai-in sum zong hong pua uh hi.
Tua nu in a khuk tungah amah ihmu sak hi; amah in mi khat samin a lu tunga a sam lom sagihte meet sak hi. Tua ciangin tua nu in amah gimsak ding kipan a, ama thahatna in amah nusia ta hi.
Tua nu in, "Filistia mite in nang hong hih, Samson!" a ci hi. A ihmutna panin amah khanglo-in, "Ni danga mah bangin pai khia-in keimah kisingin suakta ning," a ci hi. Topa in amah a nusiat khit lam amah in thei lo hi.
Tua ciangin Filistia mite in amah manin a mitte khelkhia uh a, Gaza-ah paipihin amah sumngo kol bulh uh hi, amah in thong sung angawina-ah an gawi hi.
Ahih hangin a kimet khit ciangin a lu tunga a samte khang kik dingin hong kipan hi.
Tu-in Filistia uliante a pasian uh Dagon tungah biakna lianpi khat a pia ding leh a gualnuam dingin kikhawm uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in, "I pasian in i khut sungah i galpa Samson hong pia zo hi," a ci hi.
Mite in amah a muh ciangun a pasian uh phat uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in, "I pasian in eite khut sungah i gam a susia-pa, eite tampi hong thatpa hong pia zo hi," a ci uh hi.
A lungsim uh a nop ciangin amaute in, "Eite' adingin a kimawl theih nadingin Samson sam un," a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in, thong panin Samson sam khia-in amau' mai-ah mawlpih uh hi. Khuampite kikalah amah ding sak uh hi;
Samson in ama khut a len tangvalpa kiangah, "Ka kingak theih nadingin innpi a do khuampite hong lawngsak in," a ci hi.
Tu-in a innpi pen numei leh pasal tawh kidim hi; Samson a kimawl lai takin a en Filistia ulian khempeuh leh innkhum zangah numei leh pasal mi tulthum bang om uh hi.
Tua ciangin Samson in Topa samin, "Topa Pasian aw, kei hong phawk in, kong thuum hi, tu-a ka mittang nihte' tang dingin Filistia mite ka thuk theih nadingin hong thahat sak in, tu-a bek kong thuum hi," a ci hi.
Samson in innpi a do khuampi nihte manin, a khut taklam-in khat a khut veilam-in khat lenin ama gihna tawh a khuamte luai hi.
Samson in, "Filistia mite tawh hong si sak in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin a tha neih khempeuh tawh sawn hi; tua ciangin uliante leh a sunga om mi khempeuh tungah innpi cimsuk hi. Tua ahih ciangin a nuntak lai-a a thah sangin a sihna-a a thah a si mi tamzaw hi.
Tua ciangin a sanggam pasalte leh a innkuanpihte khempeuh hong paisukin amah la uh a, amah ciahpih to-in Zorah leh Eshtaol kikal-a om a pa Manoah' han-ah vui uh hi. Amah in Israelte kum sawmnih sung thukhen hi.
Efraim mualtung gam mi Mikah a kici min nei mi khat om hi.
Amah in a nu kiangah, "Ngun peek tul leh peek zakhat nang kiang panin a kigu, tua tawh kisai-in na samsiat, keima zak-in zong na gen pen, en in, a ngun kei kiangah om hi; keimah in ka la hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin a nu in, "Ka tapa aw, Topa in thupha hong pia ta hen," a ci hi.
Amah in ngun peek tul leh zakhatte a nu kiangah piakik hi; a nu in, "A kiseek milim khat leh a kisung milim khat bawl nadingin ka tapa adingin Topa tungah a ngunte ka apsa ahi hi; tua ahih ciangin tu-in nang tungah kong piakik ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in a nu kiangah a sum a piak kik ciangin a nu in zong ngun peek zanih la-in, a kiseek milim khat leh a kisung milim khat-a a bawlsak ngun seekpa kiangah pia hi; tua pen Mikah' inn sungah om hi.
Tua mipa Mikah in biakna phual khat nei a, amah in siampi puan khat leh innsung pasiante bawlin siampi suak dingin a tapate khat koih hi.
Tua hun lai-in Israelte sungah kumpi om lo hi; mi khempeuh amau' hoihsak bang ciatun gamta uh hi.
Tu-in Judah gam Bethlehem khuami, Judah innkuan, Levi tangval khat om hi; amah tua lai-ah peem hi.
Tua mipa a muhna mun peuhah a teeng dingin Judah gam Bethlehem khua panin paikhia hi; tua bangin khualzinin a pai lai takin Efraim mualtung gam sunga Mikah' inn-ah va tung hi.
Mikah in ama kiangah, "Koi panin hong pai na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in ama kiangah, "Judah gam sung Bethlehem khuami Levi mi ka hi a, mun ka muhna peuhah a peem ding ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Mikah in ama kiangah, "Kei tawh hong omin kei adingin pa leh siampi hong hi in, kum khat-in ngun peek sawm, leh puan silh khat, leh annek kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Levi mipa in amah tawh a teeng khawm dingin thukim hi; tangvalpa in ama tungah a tapate khat tawh kibang hi.
Mikah in Levi mipa koihin, tangvalpa ama siampi suak in Mikah' inn-ah om hi.
Tua ciangin Mikah in, "Topa in ka dau hong pai sak ding hi, ci-in tu-in ka thei hi; bang hang hiam cih leh siampi-in Levi mite khat ka nei hi," a ci hi.
Tua hun lai-in Israelte sungah kumpi om lo hi. Tua hun lai-in Dan minamte in a teen' nading uh gamhluah zong uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua hun dong mateng Israel minamte sung panin amau ading gamhluah bangmah kia lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Dan mite in gam ensimin a va zong dingin amau' minam bup khempeuh lak panin misiam nga Zorah pan leh Eshtaol panin sawl uh hi; amaute in amau kiangah, "Pai un la gam va zong un," a ci uh hi. Amaute Efraim mualtung gam, Mikah' inn-ah hong tung uh a, tua lai-ah taam uh hi.
Amaute Mikah inn gei-ah a om uh ciangin Levi tangval' aw khat khen thei uh hi; amaute kihei-in ama kiangah, "Kua in hih lai-ah nang hong paipih ahi hiam? Hih lai munah bang hih na hi hiam? Hih lai-ah na nasep bang ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, "Tua bang tua bangin Mikah in kei hong bawl hi: amah in kei hong cialin kei in ama siampi ka suak hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in ama kiangah, "Kote' kuankhiat khualzinna a tangtung ding hiam cih ka theih nadingun Pasian hong dotsak in, kong thuum uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin siampipa in amaute kiangah, "Lungnuamin pai un. Note paina na khualzinna uh Topa' khut sungah om hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mi ngate pai khia-in Laish tung uh a, tua lai-a om mite, Sidon mite' om bang danin dai takin omin bangmah in a upmawh lohna, leitungah bangmah kisam loin a hauhna, leh amaute Sidonte kiang panin gamla omin kuamah tawh kizopna a neih lohna, lungmuang tak-a a teen'na uh mu uh hi.
Amaute Zorah leh Eshtaol-a a sanggamte uh kiang hong tun' kik uh ciangin, a sanggamte un amaute kiangah, "Bang thu gen ding na nei uh hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Amaute in, "Ding un, amaute do-in paito ni; bang hang hiam cih leh a leitang ka mu khin uh hi, en un, lei hoih mahmah hi. Bangmah hih loin om mawk ding na hi uh hiam? Pai ding zekai kei un, lut-in tua leitang va luah ni.
Na pai uh ciangin bangmah a ummawh lo mite kiangah na tung ding uh hi. Leitang zai mahmah hi; hi hi, Pasian in na khut sung uh ah leitungah bangmah a kisap lohna mun hong piakhin zo hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Dan minamte galhiam a tawi mihing zaguk Zorah leh Eshtaol panin kuankhia uh a,
amaute paito-in Judah gam sung Kiriath-jearim-ah giahphual sat uh hi. Hih thu hangin tu hun dongin tua mun pen Mahanehdan kici hi; en in, tua in Kiriath-jearim nitumna lamah om hi.
Amaute tua lai mun panin Efraim mualtung gamah pai suakin Mikah innah tung uh hi.
Tua ciangin Laish gam a ensim dingin a pai mi ngate in a sanggamte uh kiangah, "Hih innte sungah siampi puan khat, inn sung pasiante, a kiseek milim khat, leh a kisung milim khat a omna na thei uh hiam? Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na hih ding uh ngaihsun un," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute kihei-in Mikah' inn-a Levi tangvalpa omna-ah tung uh a, ama omzia dong uh hi.
Tu-in galhiam a tawi Dan mi zagukte kulh kongpi lutna-ah ding uh hi;
tua ciangin, galhiam a tawi mi zagukte tawh kulh kongpi lutna-ah siampipa a din' lai takin gam ensim dingin a kuankhia mi ngate tumin a kiseek milim, a siampi puan, a inn sung pasiante, leh a kisung milim la uh hi.
Hih mite Mikah' inn sungah tumin a kiseek milim, a siampi puan, a inn sung pasiante, leh a kisung milim a lak uh ciangin siampipa in amaute kiangah, "Bang hih na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Amaute in ama kiangah, "Pau kei in, na khut-in na kam hum in la kote tawh hong pai-in kote adingin pa leh siampi hong hi in. Nang adingin mi khat' inn sungah siampi hih ding hoihzaw ahi hiam, tua ahih kei leh Israelte sungah minam leh beh siampi hih ding hoihzaw ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin siampipa a lungkim hi; amah in a siampi puan, leh a innsung pasiante, leh a kiseek milim la-in mite' laizangah pai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute mai-ah a ta neute leh a ganhingte leh a vante uh om sakin, amaute kihei-in paikhia uh hi.
Amaute Mikah' inn panin a gamla khop khat a tun' uh ciangin Mikah' inn gei-a om innte sunga om mite kisam khia-in amaute in Dan mite delhin pha uh hi.
Amaute in Dan mite otsan uh a, tua ciangin amaute hong kihei-in Mikah kiangah, "Hih bang mihon tawh nong pai nading bang thu om ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Amah in, "Note in keima bawlsa ka pasiante, leh siampipa la-in na paikhia uh hi; keimah in bang nei nawn ka hi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin, 'Bang thu ahi hiam? bang hangin hong ci thei na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Dan mite in ama kiangah, "Kote lakah na aw hong kizasak kei in, tua hi kei leh ka lawmte uh hehin nang hong hih ding uh a, na innkuanpihte tawh na si kha ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Dan mite pai uh hi; Mikah in ama adingin amaute thahat lua uh hi, ci-in a muh ciangin amah kihei-in a innah ciahkik hi.
Dan mite in Mikah' bawlsate leh a siampipa paipihin gam dai-in a om bangmah a ummawh lo mite omna Laish tung uh a, namsau tawh amaute vatin mei tawh a khuapi hal uh hi.
Amaute in Sidon panin gamla uh ahih manin a honkhia ding om lo a, amaute in kuamah tawh kizopna nei lo uh hi. Tua mun pen Bethrehob-te' neihsa kuam sungah om hi. Amaute in khuapi lam kikin a sungah teeng uh hi.
Amaute in tua khuapi min pen Israelte sungah a suak amau' pian'na Dan tamin Dan phuak uh hi; ahih hangin a masa-in tua khuapi min in Laish ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Dan mite in a kiseek milim amau' adingin phut uh hi; Moses' tapa Gershom' tapa Jonathan leh ama tapate in tua gam a kilak hun dongin Dan minamte adingin siampi ahi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Shiloh-ah Pasian' inn a om sung teng Mikah' bawlsa a kiseek milim phut uh hi.
Tua hun, Israel sungah kumpi a om loh lai takin, Levi mite khat Efraim mualtung gammongah peemin Judah gam Bethlehem panin zineu khat la hi.
A zineu ama tungah heh a, ama kiang panin pai khia-in Judah gam Bethlehem khua-a a pa inn-ah ciah a, tua lai-ah kha li sung khawng om hi.
Tua ciangin a pasal ding khia-in kam neem tawh a hopih ding leh a sam kik dingin tua nu kiangah pai hi. Amah in a nasempa leh a la nih tonpih hi. Tua ciangin tua nu' pa inn-ah tung hi; numei' pa in amah a muh ciangin lungdamna tawh a dawn dingin hong pai hi.
Tua ciangin a sungpa, numei'pa in amah taam sak a, amah tawh nithum sung om hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute in an ne, tui dawnin giak khawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin a nili ni-in zingsangin amaute tho baih uh a, kithawi uh hi; ahih hangin numei'pa in a makpa, kiangah, "An tawmkhat ne-in na tha khauhsak in, tua khit ciangin na pai thei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua mi nihte tu-in ne-in dawn khawm uh hi; numei' pa in mipa kiangah, "Tu zan taam ding lungkim in la, na lung nuamsak in," a ci hi.
Pai dingin mipa a din' ciangin a sungpa in a taam kik dong mateng kho hi.
Tua ciangin a ni nga ni-in a ding dingin zingsangin amah tho baih hi; numei' pa in "An ne phot in la, ni a dialh mateng khawl lai in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in an ne uh hi.
Mipa leh a zineu leh a nasempa paikhia dingin a din' ciangin a sungpa, numei'pa in ama kiangah, "En in, tu-in nitak nai-in ni niam ta hi; tu zan taam un. En in, ni tum dektak hi; hih lai-ah giak in la na lung nuamsak in; na lam pai nading uh zing ciang zingsangin tho baihin innah na ciah ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin mipa tua zan taam lo hi; amah ding-in paikhia a, Jebus (Jerusalem a cihna) gal khat tung hi. Amah in tuan'na a kivawh la nih leh a zineu tawh ahi hi.
Amaute Jebus kiang nai a tun' uh ciangin ni niam khin a, nasempa in a Topa kiangah, "Tu-in hong pai-in, Jebus mite' khuapi-ah kihei-in tua lai-ah zan taam ni," a ci hi.
A Topa in ama kiangah, "Israel mite a hilo gamdang mite' khuapi sungah kihei-in i pai kei ding hi; Gibeah-ah i paisuak ding hi,"a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a nasempa kiangah, "Hong pai in, hih munte khatpeuhpeuh va naih-in, Gibeah ahih kei leh Ramah-ah zan taam ni," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in khengin paisuak uh hi; tua ciangin Benjaminte' gam ahi Gibeah khua gei-ah ni tum a,
Gibeah-ah pai in a giak dingin tua lai-ah amaute kihei uh hi. Amah pai-in khuapi sung kongzing laizangah tu hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a zan taam dingin kuamah in a innah amaute sang lo hi.
En in, puteek khat lo-a a nasepna panin nitak ciangin hong ciah hi; tua-pa in Efraim mualtung gam pan hi a, amah in Gibeah-ah a peem ahi hi; tua mun-a mite in Benjamin mite ahi hi.
Amah khuadak a, khualzinpa khuapi kongzingah mu hi; tua ciangin puteekpa in, "Koi-ah pai ding na hi hiam? Koi panin hong pai na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in ama kiangah, "Keima hong pai khiatna Judah gam Bethlehem panin Efraim mualtung gam mongah a pai dingin hong nawk ka hi uh hi. Judah gam Bethlehem-ah ka pai hi; tu-in Topa inn-a ciah ka hi hi; kuamah in a inn-ah hong tungsak lo hi.
Ka late uh adingin buhtu leh gan-an, kei leh na nasemnu leh na nasemte tawh a om tangvalpa' adingin anlum leh leenggahzu ka nei uh hi; a kisam bangmah om lo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin puteekpa in, "Nopna ngah ta in; na kisapna khempeuh ka en ding hi; kongzingah giak kei hamtang in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in a innah ciahpih in late gan-an pia hi; amaute in a khe uh silin, ne-in dawn uh hi.
Amaute in a lung uh nuamsakin a om lai takun, en in, tua khuapi mi, mi gina lote in tua inn kimkotah pangin a kongkhak tum uh hi; amaute in inn neipa puteekpa kiangah, "Ama taw ka luktheih nadingun na innah a hong tung mipa hong paikhiatpih in," a ci uh hi.
Inn neipa, tua mipa, amaute kiangah pusuakin amaute tungah, "Hi lo hi, ka sanggamte aw, tua bangin gitloh gamtat kei un; hih mipa ka innah hong tun' na theih napi-un hih bang a sia gamta kei un.
En un, hih lai-ah ka ta nungak leh zinpa' zineu om hi; amaute hong pai khiatpih sak un. Amaute buanin hoih na sak bangun amaute tungah hih un; ahih hangin hih mipa tungah tua bang a sia gamta kei un," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin mite in ama thu ngai lo uh hi. Tua ciangin mipa in a zineu manin amaute kiangah koih khia hi; tua ciangin amaute in tua nu buan uh a, zingsang mateng zan tawntung tua nu hih uh hi. Zingsang khuavak ding hong kipat ciangin amaute in tua nu ciahsak uh hi.
Zingsang khua hong vak ciangin numei hong ciahin, ama topa a omna mipa' kongkhak ah pukin khuavak dong om hi.
Zingsang ciangin a topa tho a, a khualzin zom dingin inn kongkhak hongin a paikhiat ciangin, en in, inn khongkhakah a zineu lumin sangkil tungah a khutte kinga hi,
Amah in tua nu kiangah, "Tho in, pai ta ni," a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in dawng nawn lo hi. Tua ciangin amah in dom to-in la tungah tua nu koih hi; mipa ding-in a innah ciah hi.
A innah a tun' ciangin amah in tem khat la a, a zineu lenin a phei a liangin seh sawm-le-seh-nih suahin sem a, Israelte gam sung khempeuhah hawm hi.
A mu mite khempeuh in, "Tu ni dongin, Izipt gam panin Israel mite a pai khiat-a kipan hih bang thu piang ngei lo a, zong kimu ngei lo hi; hih thu ngaihsun un, kikum un la gen un," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite khempeuh, Gilead gam zong a kihel, Dan panin Be-ersheba dong hong kuankhia uh a, Topa' kiang Mizpah-ah mihing khat bangin mihonte hong kikhawm uh hi.
Israel minam khempeuh sung pan makai khempeuh, namsau tawi khe galkap mihing tul zali, Pasian' mite kikhopna-ah amau mahmah kipia uh hi.
(Tu-in Israel mite Mizpah-ah a paina thu Benjamin mite in za uh hi.) Israel mite in, "Hih bang tatsiatna hong pian'na thu hong gen in," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin a kithat numei' pasal, Levi mipa in dawngin, "Benjamin-te' gam Gibeah-ah kei leh ka zineu, a zan taam dingin ka tung uh hi.
Tua ciangin Gibeah mite kei langah hong ding uh a, zan-in kote' omna innkiim-ah hong pang uh hi; amaute in kei hong that nuam uh a, ka zineu buan gawpin tu-in amah si hi.
Tua ciangin ka zineu la-in ka semnen a, Israelte' luah gam sung khempeuhah ka hawm hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Israelte lakah kihhuaina leh ut luat khialhna gamta uh hi.
En un, no Israel mihingte, note khempeuh aw, na ngaihsutna uh gen un la, hih lai-ah kikum un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh mihing khat bangin ding-in, "Eite khempeuh khat zong i puanbuk-ah pai loin, eite khat zong i inn-ah i ciah kei ding hi.
Tu-in Gibeah tungah eite' hih ding thu in: tua khua a sim dingin aisaanna tawh i pai ding a,
amaute in Israelte sungah ut luatna tawh a khialhna uh hangin Benjaminte gam Gibeah a thuk theih nadingun mite' adingin annek tuidawn a pua dingin Israel minamte khempeuh sung panin mi zakhat sung pan mihing sawm, tulkhat sung pan zakhat, tulsawm sung pan tulkhat i la ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin khuapi do dingin Israel mite khempeuh kikhawm uh a, kipawlin mi khat bang uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel minamte in Benjamin minamte khempeuh kiangah mi sawl uh a, "Note lakah a piang thu in bangzah tatsiatna ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in kote in amaute thatin Israelte sung panin siatna ka paihkhiat theih nadingun Gibeah khua sunga om a mi gina lote hong piakhia un," a ci uh hi. Ahih hangin Benjaminte in a sanggam uh Israel mite' aw ngai lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite do dingin a kuan khia dingin Gibeah khuapite panin Benjamin mite kituah uh hi.
Benjamin mite in tua ni-in amau' khuapite panin, Gibeah-ah a teeng a kiteng khia mihing zasagih ban-ah namsau a tawi mihing tul sawmnih leh tulguk khawm uh hi.
Hihte khempeuh lakah mi a kiteng khia a veikhoi zasagih om hi; amaute khempeuh in suang tawh samzang kapin a khial lote ahi uh hi.
Israel mite in Benjaminte sim loh, namsau a tawi mihing tul zali khawm uh hi; hih mite khempeuh galsiam mi ahi hi.
Israel mite ding-in Bethel-ah paito uh a, "Benjamin mite a do dingin kua pai masa ding ka hi uh hiam?" ci-in Pasian dong uh hi. Topa in, "Judah paito masa ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite zingsangin tho-in Gibeah khua sim dingin giahphual sat uh hi.
Tua ciangin, Israel mite Benjamin do dingin kuankhia uh hi; Israel mite amaute do dingin Gibeah-ah a gualin va naih uh hi.
Benjamin mite Gibeah pan hong kuan khia-in tua ni-in Israel mite tul sawmnih leh tulnih lei-ah that uh hi.
Ahih hangin Israel mite kihanthawnin a ni masa ni-a a pan'na mun mah uh ah gal pang kik uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite paito-in nitak dong Topa mai-ah kap uh hi; amaute in Topa kiangah thu dongin, "Ka sanggamte uh Benjamin mite do dingin gal phualah ka naih kik ding uh hiam?" a ci uh hi. Topa in, "Amaute do dingin paito un," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel mite a ni nih ni-in Benjamin mite do dingin hong nai uh hi.
Amaute do dingin a ni nih ni-in Gibeah panin, Benjaminte hong kuankhia a, Israel mite tulsawm leh tulgiat that uh hi; hihte khempeuh namsau a tawi mite ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite khempeuh, galkap vekpi paito-in Bethel-ah tungin kap uh hi; tua lai mun Topa' mai-ah amaute tu-in nitak dong tua ni an tang uh a, Topa mai-ah meihal biakna leh thunuam-a biakna pia uh hi.
Israel mite in Topa thu dong uh a, (bang hang hiam cih leh tua hunin Pasian' thuciamna singkuang tua lai-ah om a,
Aaron' tapa Eleazar' tapa Finehas in tua mai-ah tua hunin na sem hi), "Ka sanggamte uh Benjamin mite a do dingin pai kik lai ding ka hi uh hiam, tua ahih kei leh khawl ding ka hi uh hiam?" a ci uh hi. Topa in, "Paito un; bang hang hiam cih leh zing ciangin amaute na khut sung uh ah kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israelte in Gibeah kiim-ah a pangsim dingin mi koih uh hi.
Israel mite a nithum ni-in Benjamin mite do dingin kuanto uh a, ahun dang-ate mah bangin Gibeah lang khatah pang uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute do dingin Benjamin mite kuankhia uh a, khuapi panin amaute kipaikhiasak hi; a hun dang-ate mah bangin amaute in Bethel lamah a paito pen leh Gibeah lamah a pai lam lianpi, leh gam sungah Israel mite sawmthum bang that uh hi.
Tua ciangin Benjamin mite in, "A masa-a bangin i mai-ah amaute tai uh hi," a ci uh hi. Ahih hangin Israel mite in, "Eite tai-in, khuapi panin lam lianpi-ah amaute paikhia sak ni," kici uh hi.
Israel mite khempeuh amau omna mun panin ding-in Baaltamar-ah a gualin pang uh hi; a pangsim Israel mite Geba nitumna lam amau omna panin hong diang khia uh hi.
Gibeah khua a sim dingin Israelte khempeuh sung pan a kiteng khia mi tulsawm hong kuan uh a, a galdo uh haksa mahmah hi; ahih hangin Benjamin mite in amau adingin siatna a naina thu thei lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mai-ah Topa in Benjaminte zo hi; Israel mite in tua ni-in Benjaminte zo hi; Israel mite in tua ni-in Benjaminte mihing tul sawmnih leh tulnga leh zakhat that uh hi; hihte khempeuh namsau a tawi mite ahi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Benjamin mite in a guallelhna uh kimu uh hi. Israel mite in Benjamin mite awn uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Gibeah khua a sim dingin a koih uh a pangsimte muang uh hi.
Tua ciangin a pangsim mite manlangin hong pai-in Gibeah khua bawh uh hi; a pangsim mite hong pai khia-in namsau tawh khuapi mi khempeuh vatgawp uh hi.
Tu-in Israel mite leh a pangsim mite a kiciamna lim in amaute in khuapi sung panin meikhu lianpi a suahsak toh uh ciangin
Israel mite galdo dingin hong tum ding uh hi. Tu-in Benjaminte in Israel mite sawmthum bang vatgawpin thah ding kipan uh hi; amaute in, "A masa-a mah bangin eite mai-ah amaute kivat tuk gawp taktak hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amau' kiciamna lim meikhu khuapi sung panin suakto dingin a kipat ciangin Benjamin mite nunghei uh hi; en in, a khuapi bup a khu in vantungah kahto hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite hong kilehhei uh a, Benjamin mite lungkia uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amau' siat nading a naina thei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel mite mai panin amaute kileh kikin gamlak lam manawh uh hi; ahih hangin gal in amaute pha a, khuapi sung panin hong pai khia mite in amaute kikal-ah amaute susia uh hi.
Amaute in Nohah panin nisuahna lamah Gibeah gal ciang dong Benjamin mite delhin tuancilin vatgawp uh hi.
Benjamin-te sung pan galhang mihing tulsawm leh tulgiat tuk uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute kihei-in sehnel gam lam Rimmon Suangpi-ah tai uh hi; amaute mihing tulnga lam lianpite-ah si uh a, Gidom ciang dong nakpi takin amaute kidelhin tulnih kithat hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua ni-in Benjamin-te a si khempeuh, namsau a tawi galhang mihing tul sawmnih leh tulnga ahi hi.
Ahih hangin mihing zaguk kihei-in gamlak lam Rimmon Suangpi-ah tai uh a, Rimmon suangpi-ah kha li sung om uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite in Benjamin mite do dingin kihei kik uh a, namsau tawh a mi a sa-in a muh khempeuh uh vatgawp uh hi. Amuh uh khuate khempeuh mei tawh hal uh hi.
Tu-in Israel mite Mizpah-ah kiciam uh a, "Benjamin-te tungah kuamah in i tanu mo-in i kha kei ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Bethel-ah mite hong pai in Pasian' mai-ah nitak dong tu uh a, amaute nakpi takin a kap uh hi.
Amaute in, "Israel' Pasian, Topa aw, tu ni-in Israelte sungah minam khat a pelem nading, hih thu bang hangin Israelte tungah hong tung ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
A zing ciangin mite tho baihin tua lai-ah biakna tau khat lam uh a, meihal biakna leh thu-nuam-a biakna pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite in, "Topa ading kikhopna-ah Israel minamte khempeuh sung panin kua teng hong pai lo ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Topa kiangah a pai lo mite tawh kisai-in Mizpah-ah kiciamna lianpi khat bawl uh a, "Kithat ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Israel mite in a sanggam uh Benjamin mite khasiat uh a, "Tu ni-in Israelte sung panin minam khat bei hi.
Eite in i tanute amaute tungah zi dingin pia lo ding hi hang, ci-in Topa tawh kiciam khin i hih ciangin a om lai amaute' zi ding bang cih ding i hi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Topa kiang Mizpah-ah Israel minamte hong pai lo a om hiam?" a ci uh hi. En in, Jabeshgilead panin tua giahphual kikhopna-ah kuamah pai lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh mite a kikhop ciangin, en in, tua lai-ah Jabeshgilead-a teengte khat zong om lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mihonte in a galhangte uh mihing tulsawm leh tulnih tua lai-ah sawl uh a, "Pai un la Jabeshgilead-a teengte namsau tawh va vatgawp un; nupite leh naupang neute zong hih un.
Hih bangin na hih ding uh hi; pasal khempeuh leh pasal tawh a lum khawmsa numei khempeuh na sumai ding uh hi," ci-in thu pia uh hi.
Amaute in Jabeshgilead-a teeng mite lakah lup khopna tawh pasal a thei nai lo nungakno zali mu uh hi; amaute in Kanaan gam-a om Shiloh giahphual-ah tuate hong paipih uh hi.
Tua ciangin mihon buppite in Rimmon Suangpi-a om Benjamin mite kiangah thu puak uh a, amaute kiangah kilemna thu gen uh hi.
Tua hun ciangin Benjaminte hong ciahkik uh hi; tua ciangin amaute in Jabeshgilead numei a hing-a a koihte uh pia uh hi; ahih hangin amau' adingin kicing zo lo hi.
Israel minamte sungah Topa in kitapkhapna omsak ahih manin mite in Benjaminte khasiat uh hi.
Tua ciangin mihonte' upate in, "Benjaminte sung panin numeite kithat khin ahih manin a om lai mite' zi ding bang cih ding i hi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Amaute in, "Israelte sung panin minam khat a bei loh nadingin Benjamin a suakta laite' adingin gamhluah a om ding kisam hi.
Ahi zongin amau' zi dingin i tanute i pia thei kei hi," a ci uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel mite kiciam khinin, "Benjaminte tungah zi a pia mipa in samsiatna ngah ta hen," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in, "En un, Beth-el leilu lam, Beth-el panin Shekhem lamah a paito lam lianpi nisuahna lam, Lebonah leitaw lamah a om Shiloh-ah Topa ading kumsim pawi khamna om hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Benjamin mite thu pia-in, "Pai-in leenggui lote-ah buk un la,
vil un; Shiloh tanute laamna-ah a laam dingin hong pai uh leh, leenggui lote panin note in delhin mi khempeuh in na zi ciat ding uh Shiloh tanute man un la, Benjamin gamah ciahpih un.
Amau' pate ahi a, a sanggampate uh ahi zongin kote kiangah lungkim lohna gen dingin hong pai ciangin kote in amaute kiangah, 'Kote tungah hehpihna tawh amaute hong pia un; bang hang hiam cih leh mi khempeuh zi ding galkap-na sungah ka ngahsak zo kei uh a, note zong na mawh nadingun note in amaute tungah a pia na hi kei uh hi,' ka ci ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Benjamin mite zong tua mah bangin gamta uh a, amau mi a phazah tawh kituakin a laamte lak panin a puak khiatte uh a zi dingun la uh hi; tua ciangin amaute pai-in a gamhluahna uh-ah ciahkik uh a, khuapite lam kikin a sungah teeng uh hi.
Tua hun ciangin Israel mite tua lai panin paikhia uh a, mi khempeuh amau minam leh a innkuanpih ciat, tua lai panin mi khempeuh amau' gamhluahna ciatah ciah uh hi.
Tua hun lai-in Israelte sungah kumpi om lo hi; amau' hoihsak bang ciatun mi khempeuh gamta uh hi.
Benjamin gam Anathoth khua-a siampi khat ahi, Hilkiah' tapa Jeremiah thu gente hih bang ahi hi.
Amon' tapa Josiah, Judah gamah kumpi a suah zawh kum sawm leh kum thum a cin' kum-in Topa in Jeremiah a hopih hi.
Josiah' tapa Jehoiakim kumpi a suah ciangin Topa in Jeremiah a hopih leuleu hi. Tua khit ciangin Josiah' tapa Zedekiah kumpi a suah zawh kum sawm leh kum khat a phak kum, a kha ngana, Jerusalem khua mite sal tang dinga a kipuak khiat dong tam veipi a hopihpih hi.
Topa in kei hong hopih-a,
"Gil sungah kong bawl ma-in nang kong thei khin zo hi; na suah ma-in kong teelkhia khin zo a, minam dangte' tungah kamsang dingin kong koih khin zo hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, "Ah, Topa Pasian aw, en dih in! Thu gen ka siam kei hi; bang hang hiam cih leh naupang khat ka hi lel hi," ka ci hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in, "'Naupang khat ka hi lel hi,' ci kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh kong puakna khempeuhte' kiangah na pai ding a, kong sawl peuhpeuh na gen ding hi.
Amaute kihta kei in, bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah hong dal dingin kong ompih hi, Topa in kong ci hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in a khut tawh hong zam phei-in ka muk hong lawn sak-a hong hopih hi. "En in, ka thute na kam sungah kong koih khin zo hi.
Gam khempeuh leh kumpi khempeuhte' tungah a botkhia ding leh a phelkhia dingin ahi zongin, a susia ding leh a suankhia dingin ahi zongin, a lam ding leh a phut dingin ahi zongin, tu ni-in za, nang kong pia zo hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in kei tungah, "Jeremiah aw, bang na mu hiam?" ci-in hong dong hi. Kei zong, "Ngak a kici almond singhiang khat ka mu hi," ci-in ka dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in, "Na maan hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka thu gente ka tangtun' sak nadingin kei zong ka ngak hi," hong ci hi.
Topa in a nih veina hong hopih leuleu-a, "Bang na mu hiam?" ci-in hong dong hi. Kei zong, "Beel a so khat ka mu-a, a leilu lam panin hong awnsuk hi," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in, "Leilu lam panin hih gam mi khempeuhte' tungah siatna hong sosuk ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh leilu-a om gam khempeuh keimah in ka sam a, amaute hong pai-in Jerusalem khua kongpite-ah ahi zongin, khua kimkot-a kulh kimte-ah ahi zongin, Judah gam khuapi khempeuh kimte-ah ahi zongin a kumpi tokhomte uh hong phut ciat ding uh hi.
Ka mite in kei hong taisan uh ahih manin a mawhna uh hangin amau' tungah thu ka khen ding hi; pasian dangte meihal biakna a pia uh a, a khut uh tawh a bawlsa milimte a bia uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Jeremiah aw, na kawng gak in, Tho in la, kong sawl khempeuh amaute' kiangah va gen in. Amaute kihta kei in; na kihtak leh amau mai-ah kong lau sak zawlai ding hi.
En in, hih gambup langah ding dingin, Judah kumpite, uliante, siampite leh hih gam mi khempeuh langpan' dingin tu ni-in nang, khuapi muanhuai khat bangin ahi zongin, sik khuampi khat bangin ahi zongin, sumngo kulhpi khat bangin ahi zongin kong bawl hi.
Amaute in nang' lang khatah hong do ding uh hi. Ahih hangin a hong zo kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh, Topa in kong cih-inah, nangmah hong dal dingin kong ompih ding hi," hong ci hi.
Topa in kei hong hopih a,
"Pai in la, Jerusalem khua' zak dingin va tangko in: Topa in hong cih-inah, Na khangno lai-a nong kipiakna, na mothak lai-a nong itna, a kikho nai lo gamlak-a kei' nung nong zuih hun lai ka phawk hi.
Israel mite Topa' ading-a a tuam om hi a, ama' an lakna-ah an palte ahi uh hi. Amaute a ne peuhpeuh a mawh suak uh a, gimna a thuak uh hi, Topa in hong ci hi, ci-in va gen in," hong ci hi.
Jokob' suan leh Israel innkuan khempeuhte aw, Topa' kammal ngai dih un.
Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Na pute na pate un kei kiang panin gamlapi paikhia-in, bangmah-a kimang lo milim peuh bia-in, amau mahmah zong bang mah-a kimang lo a suah khit nadingun kei' tungah bang mawhna mu uh ahi hiam?
Amaute in, 'Izipt gam panin eite hong paikhiatpih-a sehnel lak leh dum lak, leikeu lak leh a lauhuai khuamial bekbak lak, kuama' pai ngei lohna mun, kuama' teen' lohna gamlak-ah a hong makaih Topa koi-ah a om hiam?' ci beek lo uh hi.
Singgah leh a hoih nate na nek theih nadingun an tamna munah kong tun'pih hi. Ahih hangin no nong pai uh ciangin ka gam na nin sak uh a, ka neihsa gam a kihhuai mun na suak sak tazen uh hi.
Siampite in, 'Topa koi-ah a om hiam?' ci-in dong lo uh hi. Thukham theite nangawn in kei hong thei lo uh hi. Kumpi uliante kei' tungah hong khial khin uh a, kamsangte in Baal min tawh thu genin, kiman'na nei lo nate' nung a zui uh hi.
"Tua ahih manin Topa in kong cih-inah, note kong mawhsak lai ding a, na tate-uh' tate zong ka mawhsak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh nitumna lamah Saipras tuikulh mong dong kantan un la, va en dih un. Nisuahna lam Kedar gamah mi sawl un la, limtak kan dih un; tua bang na a piang ngei peuhmah hiam, en dih un.
Gam khat in pasian ahi taktak beek lo a pasiante uh nangawn a khek ngei peuhmah uh hiam? Ahih hangin ka mite in a minthan'na uh ahi, keimah pen bangmah-a kimang lo na peuh tawh hong khek tazen uh hi.
Tua thu phawk un la, lau un, vantungte aw, dah mahmah un la, liing un, Topa in kong ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka mite in mawhna nam nih a bawl zo uh hi: nuntakna ciktui ahi keimah a hong taisan zo uh hi; tuikhuk a to tawm uh a, tuikhuk keh-in tui a vung thei kei hi.
"Israel sal ahi hiam? Sila namte ahi zenzen hiam? Hi lo ahih leh bang hangin a galte in luhgawp zo ahi hiam?
Humpite bangin a galte in amah hawk uh a, nakpi takin a hawkgawp uh hi. A gam uh gam simtham a suah uh a, a khuapite cim-in kuamah teeng lo hi.
Tham loin, Memfis leh Tahpanhes mite in zong a luguh a suktap sak zo hi.
Israel aw, Topa na Pasian in lampi-ah hong makaih laitakin amah na nusiat manin hih teng nang' tungah hong tung hilo ahi hiam?
Tu-in Izipt gamah na pai manin bang phattuamna ngah ding na hi hiam? Nail guntui va dawn lel ding na hi hiam? Assiria gamah na pai manin bang phattuamna ngah ding na hi hiam? Eufrates guntui va dawn lel ding na hi hiam?
Na gitlohna mah in nangmah hong thu hilh ding-a, na thu up nawn lohna in nangmah hong mawhsak ding hi. Topa na Pasian nong nusiat ciang, kei nong kihtak nawn loh ciangin, nuam hetlo-a kha keei hi, cih thu thei in la, mu in, a vanglian Topa Pasian in kong ci hi.
"Sawt pek lai-a kipanin ka hakkol kuaitan-in ka ukna nong nial a, hong kihenna khau sutat-in, 'Na na ka sem kei ding hi,' nong ci hi. Hi hi, numei paktat na bang a, mualsang tung teng leh singliim nuai tengah milim na bia kawikawi hi.
A kiteelteel leenggah gui ci hoihte bangin nang kong suan khin zo-a, ahih hangin nang kisia kik-in bang hangin leenggah gui a hoihlote na suak kik tazen hiam?
Vuttui tawh na kisil-a satpiang tampi na zang zongin na mawhna nin ka mu lai veve hi, Topa Pasian in kong ci hi.
Bangci bangin nangmah in, 'Kei ka nin kei hi, Baal pasiante' nung ka zui kei hi,' na ci thei peuhmah ding hiam? Mualkuam zang-a na lampi totte en dih in; na hih sate mu dih in— a leh tai kawikawi kalaoh huk na bang tazen hi.
Gamlak nuam a sa laano hukte na bang zen hi! A huk lai-in kua in khaam zo ding hiam? Amah a zong nuam peuhpeuh in gim kul se loin, a huk hunin a ngah lel ding uh hi.
Na khe guakin lam pai kei in la, na dang taksak kei in, kong cih hangin, nangmah in, 'Bang phamawh hiam? Khual mite ka it a, amau' nung ka zui ding hi,' na ci hi.
"Guta khat a kimat cianga a zum bangin, Israel mite, a kumpite uh, uliante, a siampite uh leh a kamsangte uh zong a zum ding uh hi.
Amaute in singtawng khat kiangah, 'Nang ka pa na hi hi,' peuh a ci uh a, suangtum khat kiangah, 'Ka pian'na ka nu na hi hi,' peuh a ci uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in kei hong nungngat uh a, a hong maingat kei uh hi. Ahih hangin haksatna a tuah uh ciangin, 'Tho in la, hong hon in,' hong ci uh hi.
No ading-a na bawl uh na pasiante uh koiah om ahi hiam? Haksatna na tuah uh ciangin, a hong hot theih leh kihon sak ta ve un; bang hang hiam cih leh Judah gam aw, na khuapi zahzah-ah pasian na nei tazen uh hi.
"Bang hangin kei hong mawh sak khin na hi uh hiam? Na vekpi-un nong langpan' khin uh hi. Topa in kong ci hi.
Na tate uh thu hilh-in ka sat hangin a mawkna suak zo hi, amaute kibawlpha tuan lo uh hi; na namsaute un humpi an zong bangin na kamsangte uh a that khin zo uh hi.
No khangthakte aw, Topa' kammal limtak ngai dih un. Israel mite adingin keimah in gamlak bang hi ngei ka hi hiam? A mial mahmah gam bang hi ngei ka hi hiam? Tua ahih leh bang hangin ka mite in, 'Ko ka suakta uh hi, nang kiangah kong pai nawn kei ding uh hi,' ci uh ahi hiam?
Nungak khat in a kizepnate a mangngilh thei hiam? A kipi mothak nu in a mothak puante a mangngilh thei hiam? Ahih hangin ka mite in sim zawh loh ni tampi a hong mangngilh uh hi.
"Na lawm ngaih ding na zon' siam mahmah a, numei gilote nangawn na lampi na hilh zen hi!
Mawhnei lo mizawngte' sisan na puan tungah a baang hi; amaute in na inn hong luh ngei beek lo uh hi. Tua bang teng hi napi-in,
nangmah in, 'Kei ka mawh kei hi; kei tungah Pasian heh nawnlo taktak hi,' na ci hi. En in, 'Kei ka mawh kei hi,' na cih manin nang' tungah thu kong khen ding hi.
Bang hangin na lungsim khel ziauziau na hi hiam? Assiriate in nang hong maizumsak ngei bangin Iziptte in zong hong maizum sak ding uh hi.
Nangmah in zong tua gam panin maizumna tawh na lu tungah khut koih sa-in nong paikhia ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh na muan' mite Topa in ka nial zo-a, amaute' hangin na zo ngei kei ding hi.
"Mi khat in a zi ma hen la, tua nu in zong amah nusia-in, pasal dang khat' zi suak leh, a pasal masa in tua nu la kik thei ding ahi hiam? Tua gam teng a nin suaksak khin ding hilo ahi hiam? Nang in numei paktat suak-in mi tampi tawh kingai khin zo napi cin tu'n kei' kiang hong zuankik ding na hi hiam? Topa in kong ci hi.
Khuadak in la, mualsang dawnte en dih in! Hong kilup khoppih lohna mun koi lai takah om ahi hiam? Arab mite in a suam dingun gamlakah mi a ngak uh bangin nang in lam geiah tu-in luppih ding mi na ngak hi. Na paktatna leh na gitlohna tawh hih gam na ninsak zo hi.
Tu mahin kei nong sam a, 'Ka pa aw, ka neu lai pek pan-a ka lawm na hi hi—
nang heh tawntung ding na hi hiam, a tawp dongin lungham den ding na hi hiam?' nong ci hi. En in, tua bang na cih hangin, na hih theih siatna khempeuh na hih khin zo hi," a ci hi.
Kumpipa Josiah a maan' laitakin Topa in kei hong hopih a, "A zulhzau Israel, mual sang tung khempeuh-ah pai a, sing liim nuai khempeuh ah numei paktat banga om kawikawina na mu khin zo hiam?
'Hih teng a hih khit ciangin kei' kiangah hong kilehkik ngawn ding hi,' ci-a ka up hangin amah hong kilehkik tuan lo hi; tua pen numei gina lo a sanggam nu Judah in zong a mu hi.
A zulhzau Israel, midang tawh a khialhna hangin kimaakna lai pia-a ka hawlkhiat zong amah in a mu hi. Ahih hangin numei gina lo Judah lau tuanloin pai a, amah zong numei paktat khat mah a va suak veve hi.
Tua bang hih ding amah in baih ngaihsut lel ahih manin suangtum leh singtawng peuh bia-in a khial a, gam a ninsak hi.
Hih bang teng hi napi a sanggamnu, numei gina lo Judah, a lungsim khempeuh tawh hong kilehkik loin, a kilehkik hong kineih bek hi, Topa in kong ci hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in kei hong hopih-a, "A zulhzau Israel in numei gina lo Judah sangin a mawhna tamzaw hi.
Pai in la, leilu lam Israel gamah hih bangin va tangko in: 'Hong kilehkik in, a zulhzau Israel aw, Topa in kong ci hi. Hehna tawh nang kong en kei ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh a hehpih thei pa ka hi hi, Topa in kong ci hi; ka heh tawntung kei ding hi.
Na mawhna na phawk ding bek kisam hi, Topa na Pasian na langpan'na, singliim nuai khempeuh-ah khualmite tawh na khialh kawikawina leh ka thu nong man' lohnate pulak in, Topa in kong ci hi.
Hong kilehkik un, a zulhzau ka tate aw, Topa in kong ci hi; bang hang hiam na cih uh leh keimah in note' Topa ka hi a, khuapi khat panin mi khat ta leh beh khat sung panin nih ta hong la-in, Zion khua-ah kong puak ding hi.
"'Ka lungsim bang tuucing kong pia ding-a, amaute in pilna leh siamna tawh note hong uk ding uh hi.
Tua hun ciangin gam sungah note pungin na tam uh ciangin Topa in kong cih-inah, mite in, "Topa' thuciamna singkuang" ci-in genin a nei nawn kei ding uh hi. Amaute in ngaihsun kha lo ding uh a, phawk kha loin, zong a goih beek kei ding uh hi. Tham loin zong a kibawl kik nawn kei ding hi.
Tua hun ciangin Jerusalem khua pen Topa' kumpi tokhom kici ding a, Jerusalem khua Topa' omna ah Topa' min pahtawi dingin, gam khempeuh hong kikhawm ding uh hi. Amaute in amau' mawh nopna lungsim uh a zui tentan nawn kei ta ding uh hi.
Tua hun ciangin Judah mite in Israel mite hong pawlpih ding uh a, leilu lam gam panin na pute na pate-uh' luah dinga ka piak sa gamah hong paikhawm ding uh hi.
"'Israel aw, ka tapa bangin nang hong bawlin, gam khempeuh lakah a hoihpen luah dingin, gam nopci khat nang hong pia ning, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi. Ka Pa aw, ci-a hong sam ding leh ka nung hong zui den ding kong sa kha hi.
Ahih hangin thuman lo zi in a pasal a nusiat bangin Israel mite aw, Topa in kong cih in ah, no zong kei' tungah nong thuman kei uh hi,' ci-in va tangko in," hong ci hi.
Mual tung pan awging khat kiza hi, Israel mite' kahna leh tauna aw ahi hi. Lam a pialna hang uh leh Topa a Pasian uh a mangngilhna hang uh ahi hi.
Topa in, "Hong kilehkik un, a zulhzau ka tate aw, na zulhzauna uh kong damsak ding hi," a ci hi. Amau in zong, "En in, nang kiangah kong pai uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa kote' Pasian na hi hi.
Mual tungte leh mualsang tung-a gamlum lialuanate zuaupi taktak hi a, Israel mite hotkhiatna ahih leh Topa i Pasian' sung bekah om takpi hi.
"Ahih hangin i neu lai-a kipan a zumhuai Baal pasian i biakna hangin i pute i pate' nasep sa ahi tuute leh bawngte, a tapate le a tanute uh khempeuh i sum khin zo hi.
Tua ahih manin, zumin lum ni: i minsiatna silh ni. Bang hang hiam cih leh i neulai akipan tu ni ciang dong eite leh i pu i pate in Topa i Pasian' tungah i mawh khin zo hi. Topa i Pasian' thu i mang kei khin zo hi," a ci uh hi.
Topa in, "Israel mite aw, na kilehkik uh leh kei' kiangah hong kilehkik un. Na kihhuainate uh kei kiang pan na paihkhiat uh a, na tai kawikawi kei uh leh,
'Topa a nuntak bangin,' ci a, thuman tak, kip tak, thu tang tak-a thu na ciam nak uh leh, gam khempeuh in thupha ka piak ding hong ngen ding uh a, kei sungah amaute a lungdam ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Judah gam mite leh Jerusalem khuamite' tungah Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Na lote uh kal un la, ling lakah vawh kei un.
Judah mite leh Jerusalem khua mite aw, Topa' tungah vun at un la, na lungtang uh vun at un. Na tua cih kei leh na bawl uh mawhnate hangin, ka hehna mei bangin hong kuangkhia ding a, a phelh zo kuamah om lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Judah gamah va gen un la, Jerusalem khua-ah va tangko un. Gam sung khempeuh-ah peengkul mut-in awng un la, va gen un. 'Hong kikhawm un la, khuapi muan' huaite sungah va lut ni!' va ci un.
Zion mual lampi kihilh un la, na suahtak nadingun tai un, zekai kei un! Bang hang hiam cih leh leilu lam panin siatna lianpi kong puaksuk hi.
Humpi khat a bukna sawl kawm lak pan hong kuankhia zo a, gamte susia dingpa hong paikhia khin zo hi. Na gam uh a kisia sak ding leh na khuapite uhah kuamah a teen' loh nadingin a susia dingin ama' omna panin hong kuankhia khin zo hi.
Tua ahih manin ippi puan silh un la, tau-in kap un; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa' hehna lauhuaipi eite' kiang pan kiheikhia nai lo hi.
Topa in, "Tua ni ciangin kumpipa leh kumpi uliante a lungkia ding uh a, siampite lau mahmah-in, kamsangte a dipkua ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, "Aa, Topa Pasian aw, nangmah in hih mite leh Jerusalem khuamite khem cih tak-in na khem khin zo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau' kiangah, 'Nopna hong om ding hi,' ci napi cin, amau a sunlum dingin namsau khat a om gige hi," ka ci hi.
Tua hun ciangin hih mite leh Jerusalem khuamite' kiangah, "A sa mahmah huih sehnel gam a sang mun panin ka mite' tungah hong nung ding a, tua huih pen an vaite zapsiang dinga a nung huih bang hi lo hi.
Ka sawl huih in tua bang dingin hat lua ding hi. Tu-in keimah in amaute' tungah thu khen-in ka gen hi," a kici ding hi.
En un, i galpa meii bangin hong pai a, a sakol leengte pingpei tawh kibangin, a sakolte muvanlaite sangin manlang zaw hi. Gimna i thuak ding hi, bang hang hiam cih leh gallel ding i hi ta hi.
Jerusalem khua aw, nang hong kihotkhiat nadingin, na lungsim sung panin gitlohna sawpkhia in. Na sungah gitlohna lungsim bang tan vei kem cip ding na hi hiam?
Ngai un, Dan gam pan aw khat hong ging a, Efraim Mual pan kisiat nading thu hong kitangko hi!
Minamte' kiangah va gen un la, Jerusalem' kiangah va tangko un. "Gamlapi panin galte hong pai uh a, Judah gam khuapite' lang khatah hong kiko uh hi.
Judah gam in kei hong langpan' ahih manin a galte in lo hongte bangin a kimkot-ah a pang dimdiam uh hi, Topa in kong ci hi.
Na lungsim leh na gamtatnate hangin hih thu nang' tungah hong tung hi. Hih in nangma' gitlohna hang hi a, kha-in na lungtang hong vut hi."
Aw, ka lungtang, ka lungtang! Na ka sa mahmah hi! Ka lungtang kisai vanvan a, ka om hithiat thei kei hi; bang hang hiam cih leh peengkul mutna aw, gal kisimna aw ka za hi.
Siatna khat khit ciang' khat hong tung a, gamsung khempeuh kisia khin hi. Tha khat thu-in ka bukte hong kisuksiat sak a, ka puan khaite hong kek gawp hi.
Bang tan vei gal kisimna ka mu lai ding hiam? Bang tan vei peengkul aw ka za lai ding hiam?
Topa in, "Ka mite hai uh a, kei hong thei lo uh hi; naupang haite bang uh a, bangmah thei lo uh hi. Siatna bawl siam bek uh a, hoihna, bawl thei lo uh hi," a ci hi.
Leitung ka et leh lim-le-mel nei lo a, vantungah lah khuavak om lo hi.
Mualte ka et leh kiliing damdam uh a, mualneute kileh kawikawi uh hi.
Ka khuadak leh mi khat beek ka mu kei a, van-a vasate zong a leeng mang khin uh hi.
Ka et leh, logam leihoih teng sehnel gam suak khin-a, Topa' mai leh a hehna lianpi mai-ah, khuapi khempeuh kisia khin uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in, "Gam buppi gamlak suak ding a, ahih hangin ka susia suak sam kei ding hi.
Tua hangin leitung kap ding a, vantung a mial ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka gensa, ka khensat sa hi-a, ka kisikkik loh bangin ka lungsim zong ka khelkik kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Sakol tunga tuangte leh thal tawite' aw a kizak ciangin mi khempeuh galtai mang uh a, gamlak-ah tai-in, suang lakah a kahto uh hi; khuapi khempeuh kinusia khin a, kuamah teeng nawn lo hi.
A kisia ding nangmah in bang cih ding na hi hiam? Puan san silh-a kham tawh na kizep liatluat hangin, na mitte zemin na golsak hangin, a mawkna-a kizem na hi ta hi. Na lawm ngaihte in nang hong paaikhia uh a, hong that nuam uh hi.
Nau suak ding numei kiko bang khat ka za hi, tacil a suak numei khat' tauna tawh kibang hi. Zion' tanu husam liang-a a kikona aw hi a, a khut tegel zakin, "Gimna ka thuak ding hi! Kei hong that ding uh hi!" a ci hi.
Jerusalem khua sungah kileh kawikawi un. Khuadak un la, en dih un! A thuman gamtat leh thuman a zong mi khat beek na mu uh hiam, zong dih un. Na muh uh leh tua khua a mawhna ka maisak ding hi.
"Topa a nuntak bangin," ci-in a kiciam uh hangin a zuaupi uh ahi hi.
Topa aw, nangmah in thuman en gige hilo na hi hiam? Nangmah in amaute na sat hangin a awlmawh tuan kei uh hi; na sukgawp hangin na thu hilhna a ngai tuan kei uh hi. Amaute' maitang suangtum sangin sakzaw a, a kisik nuam kei uh hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, "Hih mite mihai hi a, a hehpih huai uh hi: Topa' lampi thei lo uh a, amau' Pasian' deihna a thei kei uh hi.
Mi liante'a kiangah pai-in, ka va kiho ding uh hi; amaute in Topa' lampi a thei uh a, amau' Pasian' deihna a thei uh hi," ci-in ka ngaihsun hi. Ahih hangin a vekpi-in ka ukna hong nial khin uh a, ka hakkol kuaitan-in ka henna khaute a sutat khin zo uh hi.
Tua ahih manin tuulak panin humpi khat in amaute that ding a, sehnel gam panin keivom khat in a petgawp ding hi. Kamkei khat in a khuapite uh vil gige a, a pusuak khia peuhpeuh balzan gawp ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute' mawhna uh tamlua a, kei hong taisan mun lua uh hi.
"Na mawhna uh hong koici maisak ding ka hi hiam? Na tate un kei hong nusia zo uh a, pasian ahi lopi peuh tawh kiciam zo uh hi. Amaute a gilvah dong uh an ka vak khit ciangin, ang kawmin numei paktatte' innah a hon om uh hi.
Sakol gilvah a lante bangin a innvengte' zite uh neh-in a tau huthut uh hi.
Hih thute hangin amaute daantat lo ding ka hi hiam? Topa in ka gen-inah, hi ci bang minam' tungah thukkik lo ding ka hi hiam?
"A gual-a a kisuan a leenggah huan sungah pai in la, suksiat sak in; ahi zongin suk maimangsak sam kei in. A hiangte heuh khiatsak in, bang hang hiam cih leh tuate Topa' aa hi lo hi.
Israel minamte leh Judah minamte, Topa in ka cih-inah, kei tungah hong thuman nawn het lo uh hi.
Amaute in Topa hong nial uh a, 'Amah in bangmah hih lo ding hi; i tungah siatna hong tung lo ding a, gal ahi zongin kial ahi zongin i thuak kei ding hi.
Kamsangte lah huih bang hi lel uh a, a sung uhah thu teeng lo hi. Amau' gen bangun amau mah in a thuak ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Topa, a vanglian Pasian in hong gen-inah: "Amaute in tu-a bangin gen uh ahih manin na kam sunga mei banga ka kuan'sak ka thute in sing tawh kibang hih minamte kangtum zaw ding hi.
En un, Israel minamte aw, Topa in kong cih-inah, gamlapi panin note hong sim dingin gam khat kong kuansak ding hi. Tua gam in tanglai peka a om sa, a hat mahmah, amaute' pau na theih loh uh gam khat ahi hi.
Thal tawh a kap uh ciangin sisak lianlian uh a, a vekpi-in gal hang kim uh hi.
Amaute in lo-a na ante leh na an huante uh hong gaihsak ding uh a, na tapate leh na tanute uh hong thahsak ding uh hi. Na tuu honte leh na bawng honte uh hong gaihsak ding uh a, na lenggahte leh na thei gahte uh hong nek mangsak ding uh hi. Na muan' mahmah kulhpi tawh a ki-uum na khuapite uh, namsau tawh hong suksiat sak ding uh hi."
"Ahih hangin tua bang hun ciang nangawnin, Topa in kong cih-inah, note kong su maimang khin sam kei ding hi.
