Bang hangin mai lam thu ding thei lopi-in a mot om ding, a kimkotah Pasian in dai a khaknelh mipa, mi-in piang zenzen ahi hiam?
Bang hang hiam cih leh khuisatna in ka annek suak a, ka tauna in luipi ging bang ahi hi.
Ka kihtaktak ka tungah hong tung a, ka laulau ka tuak ta hi.
Lungnopna ahi a, daitak-a om hithiat theihna ahi zongin ka nei kei hi; lungkhamna in hong nawk niloh a, tawldam hun ka nei kei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Teman khuami Elifaz in thu gen a,
"Mi khatpeuh in thu hong genpih leh na heh ding hiam? Kua in a kam ip zo nawn ding ahi hiam?
Lunghiang mite na hanthotna, khut kha, ban khate na khauhsakna,
a puk mite na thugenna tawh na kipsakna, khuk zaw mite na hatsak ngeite ngaihsun in.
Ahi zongin nang tungah tuate hong tung a, na thuak zo kei hi; tuate in nang hong su a, na lung niam hi.
Na biakna in hong hehnem zo lo ahi hiam? A paubaang lo, na nuntakna in lametna hong pia zo lo ahi hiam?
Tu-in ngaihsun in, midik kimlai kua sia ngei ahi hiam? A thutang mi a kisuksiatna koi-ah na mu ngei hiam?
Mawhna bawlin buaina ahih mi in a gamtatna bangin a gah a atna ka thei hi.
Pasian' husan'na tawh tua bang mite sia a, ama hehna in tua bang mite kangtum hi.
Humpinelkai bangin migilote hawkna dai ta a, Pasian in amau hate suktan sakin gamdai ta uh hi.
An nek ding mu loin a thahat humpinelkai bangin si uh a, a tate uh kithehthang hi.
Tu-in kei kiangah thu khat hong tung khian a, ka bil in tua thu ginghiau a za hi.
Mi a ihsip hun zankim laitak, zan mangmat hun lai takin,
launa leh liin'na kei tungah hong tung a, ka pumpi liin'na in kei hong lausak hi.
Huih in ka mai hong mut a, ka khuasikmul hong suaksak hi.
A meel ka khen theih loh lim khat hong ding a, ka mai-ah mihing lim khat hong om a, tua ciangin aw-uun duadua khat ka za a,
'Pasian mai-ah mi khatpeuh paubaang loin om zo ngei ding ahi hiam? Amah a Bawlpa' mai-ah sitbaang loin om zo ngei ding ahi hiam?
Pasian in ama nasemte mahmah muang zo loin, a sawltakte a mawhna mu ahih leh,
inn umna kawm dingin buan-a kizatna inn sunga teeng mite, a inn bulpi leivui ahi, vasa bu bangin a kimeekcip thei,
zing kal nitak kal-a a kisusia thei sungah a omte, bangzah ta-in kuama don lohin sia cipin,
amau' liatna in taisan pak ding a, pilna ngah ngei loin si pak kan zawn ding ahi hiam?' hong ci hi.
Tu-in na thu ko in; nang hong huh ding om ahi hiam? A siangthote kua pen' lam zuan ding na hi hiam?
Mihaipa in ama hehna sih lawh a, muhdahna in sihna piangsak hi.
Mihaipa in lim takin zung kha ngei napi, ama inn thakhatin kizunglot ka mu ngei hi.
A tapate kuama suahtaksak zawh ding hi nawn lo hi; kulh kongpi gei-ah amaute kisugawp a, amaute a honkhia ding kuamah om lo hi.
Midangte in a neihsate liah tumsak a, amah sangin a hatzawpa in a um a beel sunga omte nangawn laksak a, a neih a lam duhgawh deihgawh hi.
Lei lak panin gimna hong piang tawm lo a, lei sung panin lungkhamna hong pokhia tawm hi lo hi;
mei-ek a tolen' ngei mah bangin mihing in ama lungkham nading mah piangsak hi.
Nang hi leng, ka Pasian tungah ka thuum ding a, ama tungah ka thu ka ap ding hi.
Amah in na liante leh kuama phawk zawh loh thute sem a, genzawh lohin a lamdang na tampi bawl hi.
Amah in leitungah guah zusak a, lo khempeuh tui a buak hi.
Amah in miniamte sang koih a, a dahte lungnuam sak hi.
Amah in migilote' geelna suksiatsak ahih manin amaute in a ngimna uh tangtun thei lo uh hi.
Amah in migilote amau' gitlohna mah-ah awk sak a, ngian a zangte' geelna lumlet sak hi.
Suntangpi-in amaute khuamial sung kiden'na a, suntangpi-in zan bangin mialzawt uh hi.
Ahi zongin amah in amau' kiang panin pa nei lote honkhia a, mi thahatte kiang panin mi cimawhte honkhia hi.
Tua ahih manin mizawngte in lametna nei kik uh a, thuman lote ahih leh kihencip hi.
Pasian in a taii mite minuamsa hizaw ahih manin, Vanglianpa' taiina thupisan' in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a liamsak hangin a liamma tun ding a, ama satna liamma a damsak ding hi.
Lungkhamna guk vei dong na tuahna-ah amah in hong hon ding a, a sagih veina dingah siatna in nang hong su nawn lo ding hi.
Kialpi sungin na sih nading pan hong honkhia ding a, gal sungah namsau panin hong suakta sak ding hi.
Gensiatna pan nang hong kihu ding a, siatna hong tun' ciangin na lau kei ding hi.
Suksiat ding leh puksih dingte na nuihsan lel ding a, leitung gamsate na kihta kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh na lo sungah suang om lo ding a, gamlak gamsate in hong su lo ding hi.
Na inn sung lunghimawh nading om lo hi ci-in na thei ding a, na inn kiim na et ciangin a kitasam bangmah om lo ding hi.
Na suan na khakte tampi pha ding hi, ci-in na thei ding a, na sunga piangte leitung lopa zah pha ding hi, ci-in na thei ding hi.
A hun ciangin ancilna phual-ah buhlom a tun' mah bangin teek sihin han na zuan ding hi.
Hih thu khempeuh ka kantel uh a, a thuman a na hi hi, za in la, nang adingin zang in.
Tua ciangin Job in dawng a,
"Ka lunggimna kitawikhai hen la, ka haksatna khempeuh kitawi teh leh!
Tuipi sehnel khempeuh sangin gikzaw ding ahih manin ka kampaute thakhauh mahmah hi.
Vanglianpa' thaltangte in kei hong kha a, ka sungah a thal gu kidiah hi. Pasian in a kihtakhuai-in kei hong su hi.
Gam late in lopa a nek lai takin ham a, bawngtal in an a nek lai takin ham ahi hiam?
An lim lote, ci sawh loin kine thei a, aktui da kang in limna nei ahi hiam?
Ka kam in tuate ciam nuam lo a, tuate in a luaksuahhuai an tawh kibang hi.
Ka ngetna ngah thei hi leng a, Pasian in ka deihna hong pia ding hi leh,
Pasian in kei hong sucip hen la, a khut zanin kei hong that vet leh!
Tua hi leh keima kihehnepna hi ding a, hih zahta ka thuakna-ah nuamin ka diang ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Siangtho Pa' thu ka nial khat zong om lo hi.
Ka thuak lai nadingin bang hatna nei nawn a, lungduai a ka omna dingin lamet ding bang om nawn ahi hiam?
Ka thahatna in suang bang hi a, ka pumpi in sumngo tha paai ahi hiam?
Kei leh kei' sungah huhna bangci ngah tawm ding ka hi hiam? Kei hong kihuh nading ka nget nading kuamah om lo hi.
"Pasian ka nusia a, ka nusia kei zongin, hih bang lungkham hunin lawm citak ka kisam hi.
No ka lawmte pen, lui tuikhang bang, a mangthang pak luitui let bang,
nin a khaknelh vuk leh tuikhal bangin na zuautat uh hi.
Khua a lum ciangin tua tui mangthang a, ni a sat ciangin a kang hi.
Tua tui zong dingin khualzin mite pai kawikawi a, gamsung tengah kawi pai-in a mangthang uh hi.
Tema khua mi khualzinte in zong tua tui zong uh a, Sheba mite in zong tua tui muan'in a nei uh hi.
Ahi zongin tua a lametna uh ah cimawh uh hi; tua tui zuan uh a, a om loh ciangin cih nading thei loin kam ka uh hi.
Tu-in zong kei adingin note tua mah bang na hi uh hi; ka gimna teng nong mu uh a, na lau uh hi.
No kiangah, 'Na khat peuhpeuh hong pia un, ka suahtak nadingin sum tawh hong huh un,
ka galte' kiang panin hong honkhia un, kei hong nengniamte' khut sung panin hong tan khia un,' hong ci ngei zenzen ka hi hiam?
"Hong hilh thei le uh cin, pau loin ka om pah ding hi: Ka khialhna hong theih telsak dih un.
Lungsim takpi tawh thugennate heh loin kisang thei a, ahi zongin no hong taiina un bang phatuam sak ahi hiam?
Kamging mawkmawk hehtaak sa a, huih letmang cihmawh kamte thupi ngaihsut na hi uh hiam?
Mi cimawh khat suksiat sawm a, na lawm khat uh hih gawp sawm na hi uh hiam?
"Tu-in kong thuum hi; kihei un la kei hong en un, Na maitang uh ah zuau gen dingin kilawm ka hi hiam?
Ngaihsun pha un, a kilawmlopi-in hong hih kei un. Ngaihsun pha un, ka hoihna hong kize-et hi lel hi.
Ahi zongin zuau gen mahin nong ngaihsun lai veve uh a, a sia leh a pha khen thei loin nong seh lai veve uh hi.
"Leitungah mihing in nasep haksa nei a, ama hun in thacial nasempa' aa bang hilo ahi hiam?
Sila nasemte in niliim lunggulhin, a kicial nasempa in a thaman a ngak tawh kibang hilo ahi hiam?
A mawkna-ah kha tampi sung ka om a, zan thapai lungkhamna in keima tanh ahi hi.
Nitak ka lup ciangin, 'Cik ciangin khuavak in ka tho tam,' ka ci hi. Ahi zongin zan sau a, zingsang khuavak mateng ka kigawigawi hi.
Ka pumpi khempeuh than dim a, ka vun tung khempeuh meima in tuamcip hi.
Ka hunte in siamgante' siam ciangtang sangin manlang zaw a, lametna om loin a mong tung pak hi.
Kei hong mu ngeipa in kei hong mu nawn lo ding a, na hong et laitak mahin ka mangthang ding hi.
Meiilum kaite bei-in a man'than' bangin Leinuai-a paisukpa hong ciahkik ngei nawn lo ding hi.
A inn-ah amah hong ciahkik nawn lo ding a, ama omna ngei mun in amah thei nawn lo ding hi.
"Tua ahih manin pau loin ka om kei ding hi; ka lungkham manin kam ka pau ding a, ka gim luat manin ka phun ding hi.
Kei hong cing ding na koih nadingin, kei tuipi ganhing hong sa na hi hiam?
Lum leng nuam ding a, ihmu leng ka phunna phatuam ding hi, ci leng lah,
a lauhuai mang nong man'sak a, a lauhuai mangmuhna tawh nong lau sak hi.
Tua ahih manin gui-awk ding ka ut zaw a, hih bang ka thuak sangin ka si nuam zaw hi.
Ka lungkham a, ka nungta nuam nawn kei hi. Ka nuntakna in husan' bang hi lel ahih manin kei guak hong hici om sak hoh in, kimanna om lo hi.
Nang in hih zahin na thupi ngaihsut dingin na lungsimah na ngaihsut dingin,
zingsang simin daantat dingin ama kiangah pai-in amah na ze-et themthum nadingin mihing in bang hi lel ahi hiam?
Tom kha sung beek hong pelh lo ding a, ka hu beek hong sang sak man lo ding na hi hiam?
Mihingte a encikpa aw, a khial ka hih leh zong, nang tungah bang hong gamta ka hi hiam? Bang hangin kei hong ngim a, bang hangin na muitum suak ka hi hiam?
Bang hangin ka khialhna hong maisak lo a, ka mawhna hong paihkhiat sak lo na hi hiam? Tu-in han sungah ka lum ding a, nong zon' hangin ka na om kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Shuah gammi Bildad in dawng a,
"Tua bang thu bangtan vei gengen ding a, bangtan vei paupau ding na hi hiam?
Pasian in thutang zang lo ahi hiam? Vanglianpa in thuman zang lo ahi hiam?
Na tate ama tungah khial a, amau' mawhna amaute a tuaksak hi.
A hun lai-in Pasian zong in la, Vanglianpa' hehpih ding thuum lecin,
nang dikin thutang kisa na hih leh pel loin amah in nang hong en ding a, na thumanna tawh kizui-in thaman hong pia na ding hi.
Tua hi leh, na zawn' mahmah khit hangin a tawpna-ah na hau kik ding hi.
"Khangluite thu kantel in la, pute pate' tuahsa thute ngaihsun in.
Eite in zan mah mi i hi a, bangmah i thei kei hi; leitunga i nuntaknate in niliim bang hi lel hi.
Amaute in nang hong hilhin, a thu hong genin, amau' phawksa thute hong gen ding hilo ahi hiam?
"Ciknawng om lohna-ah laiphai kungte po thei ahi hiam? Tui om lohna-ah pumpeng kungte pung thei ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin tuate a pak kimlai a phuk hun nai lopi-in lopa dang khempeuhte sangin keu masa zaw hi.
Pasian a mangngilh mi khempeuh tua mah bang ahi hi; Pasian a don lo mite' lametna a bei hi.
Ama kimuan'na maimom khau bang hi lel a, ama ki-upna maimom bu bang hi lel hi.
A inn tungah kingam a, a inn hoi hi, a inn lencip a, ahi zongin kip zo lo hi.
Amah in nitaang sungah a khang kungno, a huan sungah a dawn hilhhelh kungno ahi hi.
Ahi zongin suangtum lakah a zung a kivial, suangtawphah a phukha zung suak hi.
Tua ciangin mi khatpeuh in a phung pan zung bawh a, 'Nang hong thei ngei zenzen kei ing,' ci-in lawnkhia hi.
Hih bang danin ama nuntakna bei a, lei sung panin kung dangte hong po khia hi.
"Thei tel in Pasian in mawhbaang lo mi nil khia lo ding a, gamtatsia mite huh lo ding hi.
Na muk-ah nuihna hong omsak ding a, na kam-ah lungdam-a kikona hong omsak ding hi.
Nang hong mudahte in maizumna ngah ding uh a, migilote' puanbuk maimang ding hi," a ci hi.
"Kuamah in Pasian a zawhzawh lohna a tel takin ka thei ta hi.
Mi khat in Pasian tawh thu kinial ding hi leh tulkhat sungah khatvei nangawn dawng thei lo ding hi.
Ama pilna thukin, ama vangliatna zai hi; kua in khauh takin nial a, nial pai suak zo ahi hiam?
Pasian in mualte liingsak a, tawlnga sak lo hi; a hehna tawh mualte lumlet hi.
Amah in leitung lokgawp a, a khuampite kiliing hi.
Amah in ni a suah loh nadingin thu pia a, aksite sin cip hi.
Amah bek in vanpi zal a, tuipi tuihualte tuancil hi.
Amah in van-a om Khawlei-uikai, Zawlzawng, Seguk, leh Khanglam aksite a bawlpa ahi hi.
Amah in kuama theihkhiat zawh loh na lian tampi bawl a, kuama sim zawh loh na lamdang tampi sem hi.
Ka kiangah amah hong pai a, ke'n amah ka mu thei kei hi; amah gamtangtang a, ahih hangin amah ka thei kei hi.
Amah in la khia nuam leh kua in khaktan zo ding hiam? Bang hih na hi hiam, kua in ci thei ding ahi hiam?
"Pasian in ama hehna dokkik het lo mah ding hi; Rahab' pawlte a khe nuai-ah kun uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ke'n amah bangci dawn thei loh zaw kan ding a, amah ka nial nading kammal bangci muh ding ka hi hiam?
Kei ka dik hangin amah ka dawng thei kei hi; kei hong mawhsakpa tungah hong hehpih ding ka nget kul hi.
Thukhen zumah amah samin hong pai leh zong ka thuumna hong ngai dingin ka um tuan kei hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh thu themno khat hangin nakpi takin kei hong hih a, thu om lopi-in gimna tampi hong thuaksak hi.
Ka hu nangawn hong sang sak man lo a, lungkhamna tawh hong kidimsak hi.
Thatang hat thu ding hi leh, amah hat mahmah a, thutang kituh hi leeng, kua in thukhen zumah amah sam zo ding ahi hiam?
Kei ka dik hangin keima kam mah in hong man ding a, mawhbaang lo ka hih hangin ka kampau hong lehhei sak ding hi.
Paubaan' na ka neih loh hangin kei ka kithupi ngaihsut tuan het kei a, ka nuntakna ka kih hi.
Thu khat bek om hi; tua ahih ciangin, amah in a paubaang lote leh a gilote susia khawm hi, ka ci hi.
Lauhuai lianpi hong tung pakin sihna a om ciangin mawhbaanglote' thuumna nuihsan lel hi.
"Laitaite sangin ka hun nawh tai zaw a, bei pak ahih manin nopna ngah kha lo hi.
Pumpeng gunkuang bangin nawh pai a, muvanlai sa bawh bangin nawh len' hi.
Ka dahnate kimangngilh bawlin, kimaitaisak ning ci ta leng zong,
a dikin nong seh loh ding lam tak thei khin ka hih manin ka thuak dingte' hangin ka lau hi.
Kei a mawh-a hong kiseh ding ahih leh bang hangin a mawkna-in na sem ding ka hi hiam?
Satpiang tawh kei kisilin, vuttui tawh ka khutte sawp ta leng zong,
buan sungah kei nong hencip ding a, ka puante in kei a kihhuai hong suaksak ding hi.
Amah ka dawn' theih nadingin amah in kei bangin mi hi lo a, thukhen zum-a thu kineihpih theih ding hi lo hi.
Ko tegel kikalah thu hong khen ding khat om thei hen la, ko tegel tungah a aana hong zang ding khat om hi leh,
kei hong kisatna ciang hong paih khiatsak ding a, kei tungah lauhuaina lianpite hong om nawn lo ding hi.
Bang bang ahi zongin amah kihta loin ka pau ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kei omzia ding banga ka om loh lamtak ka kithei hi.
"Ka nuntakna ka cimtak ta hi; ka dahna thu ka ut utin ka gen ding a, ka lungkham manin ka paupau ding hi.
Pasian kiangah hih bangin ka ci ding hi: Kei hong mawhsak kei in; kei nong langpan'na thu hong gen in.
Na khut tawh na sepsate simmawh bawlin, migilote' vaihawmna pan'pihin, hih bangin nong netniamna-ah bang phattuam ngah na hi hiam?
Mihingte bang lelin gamta na hi hiam?
Na nuntakna kote' aa tan bang lelin ngaihsun na hi hiam?
Bang hangin ka mawhna khempeuh sulzuih-in, ka khialhna khempeuh kantel na hi hiam?
Ka mawh lohna na thei a, nang kiang panin kei hong hon ding a om lohna na theihsa mah ahi hi.
Nangma khut in kei hong lomin nong piangsak a, tu-in nangma khut mah in kei hong leh suksiat kik hi.
Leivui panin kei nong bawlna phawkkik in; leivui mah-in hong dengvui kik ding na hi hiam?
Kei ka pian' nadingin ka pa tungah thatang na guan' a, ka nu' sungah kei nong khangsak hi.
Guh leh thaguite tawh ka pumpi ding nong bawl a, sazang leh vun tawh tua guhte nong tuamsak hi.
Kei tungah nuntakna hong pia-in nong it tawntung a, nangma hong kepna hangin ka nungta hi.
Ahi zongin a beisa hun sung khempeuh-ah kei adingin thusim khat na na neihna tu-in ka thei hi.
Ka khialh khakna hong ensim niloh na hih manin ka mawhna nong maisak nuam kei hi.
Ka khialh phetin gimna nong pia a, ka gamtat hoih ciangin nong pakta tuan kei hi. Keimah in mindaina leh maizumna tawh ka kidim hi.
Mavan'na khatpeuh neisun leng zong, humpinelkai bangin ka siat nading nong zong a, kei' gim theih nadingin nalamdang nangawn na bawl hi.
Kei a hong langpang dingin teci na nei tawntung a, kei tungah na hehna khang semsemin, kei nong suk nading thu thak na mu tawntung hi.
"Pasian aw, bang hangin ka nu' sung pan hong piangsak peuhmah na hi hiam? Kuama' hong muh ma-in a si hi zaw leng!
Ka nu' sung pan hankhuk zuat pah ding pen, mihing-a pian' loh zah mahin a hoih ahi hi.
Ka nuntakna bei dektak ta hilo ahi hiam? Hong hici om sak hoh in! Ka hun neih lai sun teng nuamtak hong zangsak in.
Kei a pai baih ta ding ka hi a, kong ciahkik ngei kei ding hi, khuamial, lungzin'na gam,
khuavak nangawn khuamial ahihna, khuamial gam, lungzin'na gam, lungkhamna gam a zuan ta ding ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Na-amah gammi Zofar in dawng a,
"Kampau hihzahta hong kidawng lo ding sa a, kam tam pauna hangin thumanin hong kiseh ding sa na hi hiam?
Job aw, na thugente hong dawng thei lo ding hong sa na hi hiam? Na simmawh kampaute hong kidawng mawh ding sa na hi hiam?
Na thugente a man na sa kha a, Pasian' muhna-ah a siangtho-in na kingaihsun kha hi.
Pasian in na thugente hong dawngkik leh ut mahmah ing!
Pilna nam tampi a omna thu, mihingte' theih zawh loh thuthuk a omna thu hong gen ding hi. Na mawhna zahin Pasian in hong daantah lohna thu thei in.
"Pasian' thuthuk thei khin zo ding na hi hiam? Vanglianpa' hih theihna thei khin zo ding na hi hiam?
Pasian in vantung sangin sang zaw a, ahi zongin tua vantung nangawn na ban zo kei hi. Pasian in Leinuai thu thei a, ahi zongin nangmah in tua thu na thei kei hi.
Pasian' liatna in leitung sangin golzaw a, tuipi sangin zaizaw hi.
Pasian in nang manin thu hong sit leh amah a khaktan ding kua om ahi hiam?
Pasian in mi hoihlote thei takpi hi; mawhna a muh ciangin thu don lo ding ahi hiam?
Gam sung late mihing suak ngei ding a mihaite pil ngei ding ahi hiam?
"Job aw, na lungsim a hoihin bawl in la, Pasian' lam kihei in.
Khialhna na bawl khak leh paaikhia in la, na inn-ah gitlohna omsak kei in.
Tua hi leh kisuan'na om loin na khuadak ngam ding a, na lungnuamin launa na nei kei ding hi.
Na lungkhamnate veng ding a, tuikhang pak bangin na phawk kha nawn kei ding hi.
Tua ciangin na nuntakna in sun sangin taangzaw ding a, nuntak lungzin pen hun in phalvak sangin taangzaw ding hi.
Lungnuam tak leh lametna nei-in na om ding a, Pasian in nang hong hu-in tawldamna hong pia ding hi.
Kuamah kihtak nei loin nuam takin na om ding a, mi tampi in nangma maipha hong zong ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin migilote ahih leh cimawhin khuadak ding uh a, suahtak nading lampi mu lo ding uh hi. Amau' ngah ding ahih leh sihna bek ahi hi," a ci hi.
"Note pen theihna kicing na kisa mah uh a, pilna a nei na kisa mah uh hi.
Ahi zongin note zah mahin kei zong thu ka thei a, note sangin themkhat zong ka niamzaw tuan kei hi. Midangte sangin na theih zawk uh bang om tuan ahi hiam?
Ka lawmte nangawn in tu-in kei hong nuihsan uh a, kei dikin paubaang lo napi hong nuihsan uh hi; ahi zongin Pasian in ka thungetna hong piak hun om hi.
Note in lungkhamna na nei kei uh a, ahi zongin kei nong ciamnuih bawl uh hi; a puk dektak mipa na satgawp uh hi.
Guta mite nuam takin om hit-hiat a, Pasian simmawhte nuam takin nungta hi.
"Ahi zongin, gamsate va dong un, hong hilh ding uh hi; vasate va dong un, hong hilh ding uh hi;
lei tunga bokvak ganhingte va dong un, hong hilh ding uh hi; tui sung ngasate zong va dong un, hong hilh ding uh hi.
Pasian' khut in amaute a bawlna thu, a vekpi-in thei kim uh hilo ahi hiam?
Ama pian'saksate' nuntakna a ukpa in Pasian ahi hi; mihing khempeuhte' nuntakna ama khut sungah om hi.
Leii in an a ciap mah bangin, bil in thu ngai tel hilo ahi hiam?
Khanghamte in pilna nei a, nuntak saute in thu thei tel uh hi.
"Pasian in pilna leh vangliatna nei a, amah thukip-in thu theitel hi.
Pasian in phelkeek leh kuamah in lamkik zo lo a, Pasian in thong-ah mi koih leh kuamah in suaktasak zo lo hi.
Pasian in guah a khaktan ciangin leitung keugaw a, tui a khah ciangin tui hong khang hi.
Pasian thahatin gualzo tawntung a, mi khemte leh khemna a thuakte Pasian' ukna nuai-ah om hi.
Amah in mipilte' pilna susia-in, makaite pen mihai bangin gamta sak hi.
Amah in kumpite za kia sak a, thong-ah a khia hi.
Amah in siampite mihai suaksak a, mi vangliante lawnthal hi.
Amah in mi' muante a pau thei loin bawl a, khanghamte' pilna paihkhiatsak hi.
Amah in mi vangliante mindaisak a, mi thupite' kihihsakna beisak hi.
Amah in khuamial sung panin thuthukte kalkhia a, a kithei zolo thute kitelsak hi.
Amah in minamte thahatsakin liansak a, ahi zongin amah in tuate zo gawpin susia hi.
Amah in minam makaite' pilna paihkhiatsak a, lampi om lohna gamlakah a vakvai sak hi.
Khuavak om loin khuamial lakah amaute in mialzawt uh a, zukham bangin amaute hoi-hoi uh hi.
"Na gen thu khempeuh uh ka muhsa hi a, ka bil-in ka zaksa, ka theihsa thu ahi hi.
Note' theih khempeuh, kei zong ka thei hi. Note sangin ka neuzaw tuan kei hi.
Ahi zongin note tawh kam kinial hi loin Pasian tawh kinial ka hi hi. Pasian tawh hih thu ka kinial nuam hi.
Note in na haina uh zuauthu tawh na melh uh a, kuamah a damsak zolo zato siam-a kineite tawh na kibang uh hi.
Pau het loin om hi le-uhcin, mipilpi mah hong kisa zaw ding hi ve'n.
Tu-in ka thugen hong ngai un la, ka gen laitak limtak ngai un.
Pasian' min dingin a man lo genin, ama adingin zuauthu gensak ding na hi uh hiam?
Pasian angvan ding a, ama ading gensak ding na hi uh hiam?
Pasian in lim takin note hong entel leh note sungah hoihna mu ding ahi hiam? Mihingte na khem bangun Pasian khem thei dingin kingaihsun na hi uh hiam?
A simthamin angvanna na zat uh leh amah in note hong taai taktak ding hi.
Ama vangliatna in note hong lausak ding a, note tungah amah kihtakna hong tung ding hilo ahi hiam?
Na thugennate uh vut khu bang hi lel a, na siksante uh leikhal bang hi lel hi.
Pau kei un la, kei thu hong gensak dih un, a piang peuhpeuh a piang hi mai hen.
Keimah in ka nuntakna pia ngamin, ka nuntakna ka ap ngam hi.
Pasian in kei hong that mah taleh zong, ke'n phamawh ka sa kei hi. Ahi zongin ama mai-ah ka thu ka gen veve ding hi.
Pasian' mai-ah migilote' pai ngam lo ahih manin, ka han'na in ka gualzawhna hi ding hi.
Ka thugente limtak ngai un la, ka lahtelnate na za un.
Ka thu a gen dingin a baihsa-in ka om a, thu ka zawh ding ka tel theih hi.
Pasian aw, kei hong mawhsak ding na hi hiam? Nong mawhsak leh, pau loin a si dingin ka kiging hi.
Thu nih kong ngen hi, hong pia in; tua ciangin nang tungah bangmah kong im kei ding hi.
Kei hong daantat nawn kei in la, launa hong thuaksak nawn kei in.
Pasian aw, hong hopih masa in, kong dawng ding hi. Kei, thu hong gensak in la, nang' hong dawng in.
Ka mawhna ka khialhna bangzah pha hiam? Ka mawhna leh ka khialhna teng hong thei sak in.
Bang hangin kei hong peel a, gal bangin hong ngaihsun na hi hiam?
Keimah, lausak ding hanciam na hi hiam? Kei, singteh bang lel hilo ka hi hiam? Anvai themkhat gal-in do ding na hi hiam?
Nangmah in kei tungah thusiapi nong zong a, ka neu lai-a ka gamtatna nangawn tawh nong mawhsak hi.
Nangmah in ka khe sikkol nong bulh a, ka kalsuanna khempeuh leh ka khekhap nangawn na entel hi.
Tua huhau-in singmuat bangin ka puk a, nget in a nek puan bangin ka zangawp hi.
"Mihingte a nuntak hun tom a, lungkhamna tawh kidim hi.
Amaute pakpalh bangin khangin keu pak uh a, niliim bangin pai hanhanin mangthang uh hi.
Pasian aw, tua bang lel mi kei hong en a, thukhenna thuak dingin na mai-ah hong sam na hi hiam?
Mihing banga a ninte sung panin a siang bangmah hong piang lo ding hi.
Ama nuntak tan ding kisehkhol a—a nuntak ding kha phazah kiciangtan khin hi. Nangmah in na ciangtan khin a, kikheel thei lo hi.
Amah en loin tuaci omsak mai in la, a nuntakna haksa mah zomsak hoh in.
"A kiphuksa singkung nangawn in lametna nei a, a bul sel-in nungta kik thei hi.
Lei sungah a zungte a teek zongin, lei sungah a bulsum a si zongin,
guahtui ngahin, singkungno bangin hong sel kik hi.
Ahi zongin, mi si a, amah maimang pah hi; amah a beina tungta a, koi-ah om nawn ahi hiam?
Gun tuite leh tuipi tuite a kan hun om thei ding hi.
Ahi zongin vanpi a om lai tengin, misite tho kik ngei lo ding a, a ihmutna panun khanglo ngei lo, tang ngei lo ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin kei na hong sam ding a, kong dawng ding hi; nangma bawlsa ahi keimah na hong lunggulh ding hi.
Tua ciangin ka kalsuanna khempeuh nong en ding a, ahi zongin ka khialhnate nong sulzuih nawn kei ding hi.
Ka khialhnate hong maisakin, nong paihkhiatsak ding hi; ka mawhna khempeuh nong phiat khiatsak ding hi. Tu-a bangin a piang thei hi leh ka ut mahmah hi.
"Ahi zongin a tak takin ci lehang, mualte a puk ding hun, suangkeente nangawn a cip ding hun hong tung ding hi.
Tui in suangte nawt khia-in, guahtui in lei a nawt khiat bangin, nangmah in mihingte' lametna na beisak hi.
Nangmah in mi khat zo gawpin amah bei hi; A meel kheksak gawpin na hawl mang hi.
A tapate in amah pahtawi dingin hong pai ta leh zong bangmah phawk zo nawn lo a, a tapate mindai ta leh zong bangmah phawk zo nawn lo hi.
A pumpi sunga a natnate leh a lungsim gimna bek phawk in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Teman khua mi Elifaz in dawng a,
"Job aw, mawk paupau kei in! Nang' pau bangin mipilte pau ngei lo a,
bangmah-a kimang lo kam pau lo a, phattuamna om lo dingpi-in thu seel lo uh hi.
Ahi zongin nangmah in Pasian zahtak nading na beisak a, ama mai-ah thu gen nading na khaktan hi.
Tu-in na mawhna thu na kam panin hong gingkhia a, ngian zangin na kampau tawh na mawhna na seel hi.
Na mawhna thu kei' hong gen kisam lo a, na pauna khempeuh in na mawhna hong langsak ta hi.
"Mihing a piang lakah nang a masa pen kisa na hi hiam? Pasian in mualte a bawl lai-in nang a piang khin kisa na hi hiam?
Pasian' vaihawmnate a zasimin kingaihsun na hi hiam? Nang bek in pilna khempeuh a nei-in kingaihsun na hi hiam?
Ko' theih loh thu bang thei tuan na hi hiam? Ko' muh loh nang bang mu tuan na hi hiam?
Na pa' pian' ma-a piang puteek samkangte tung panin kote in ka pilnate uh ka ngah uh hi.
Pasian in nang hong hehnem hi; bang hangin nialnial na hi hiam? Kam khum kam nem tawh Pasian' taangin nang tungah thu kong gen uh hi.
Ahih hangin nang na lung khauhin, kote nong heh et hi.
Pasian' tungah a heh na hi a, amah a simmawh na hi hi, tua bang thu gen kei in.
Mihing-a piang peuhmah paubaang loin siangtho taktak zo ding ahi hiam? Pasian' tungah a thuman zo kua om ding ahi hiam?
Pasian in a siangtho vantungmite nangawn muang lo ahih leh, ei mawhnei mite bang hong ci muan' mah ding ahi hiam?
Mihing in tui i dawn bangin siatna i dawndawn a, mihing pen siahuai-in bangmah i man kei hi.
"Job aw, tu-in ka thutheihte na ngai in.
Mi dang a nengniam migilopa in a khan' tawntungin lungkhamna thuak ding hi.
Lau nading awging a bil-ah za ngitnget ding a, lungmuangin a om lai takin gutate in buluh ding hi.
Lungzin'na pan suahtak nading lametna om lo a, amah that dingin mun khatah namsau in ngak khinkhian a,
amah ne dingin musanete in ngak uh hi. A mai lam thu lungzin'huai ahihna thei hi.
A thahat kumpi khat bangin lungkhamna leh lungzin'na in amah hih gawp dingin a ngak hi.
Pasian langpangin a khuttum a lahsan, Vanglianpa a dem mipa in hih bang thute thuak hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in khauhtakin Pasian langpangin, a lum sahpi tawh lehdo hi.
A thatang muan'huai-in a pumpi a liat hangin,
ama teen'na khuapi sia-in, ama inn kisusia ding a, a sawt loin nin bulomtang suak ding hi.
Amah sauvei hau lo ding a, a neihsate kip lo ding hi. Ama liim nangawn maimang ding a,
khuamial panin suakta lo ding hi. Amah pen, a hiangte mei in a kattumsak, a pakte huih in a letkhiatsak singkung tawh kibang ding hi.
Amah in gitlohna suan'in nei ahih manin, gitlohna bek mah ngah kik ding hi.
A hun a tun' ma-in amah bei ding a, singhiang bangin keu-in hing kik nawn lo ding hi.
A min ma-in a gahte a pulh leenggui bang ding a, a pakte a pulh mangkhin oliv kung bang ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian ngaihsun lote mi cimang suak a, sumgolh tawh kilam innte mei in kangtum hi.
Hih bang mite in siat nading bek ngaihsunin sem uh a, a lungsim uh ah khem ding bekbek ngaihsun uh hi," a ci hi.
"Tua bang thute ka za ngei khin hi; hehnepna in gim nading bek ahi hi.
Khawl hun nei loin gengen lai ding na hi uh hiam? Na gen ding uh omom lai ahi hiam?
Note leh kei kikheek thei hi lehang, note' gen khempeuh kei zong ka gen thei ding hi. Note ka lu hong pei sanin, thu tampi tak mah kong gen thei ding hi.
Ahi zongin, keimah in note hong tua cih loin, thu hoih tawh note hong hehnemin, note hehnep nading thu ka gen ding hi.
"Thu gen leng ka natna nuamtuam lo a, pau kei ta leng zong, phatuam tuan lo hi.
Pasian aw, kei nong paatsak ngiingei a, ka innkuan teng na si sak khin hi.
Kei nong mancip a, ka gal na suak hi. Ka vun guak leh ka guh guak bek-in ka om a, keima mawhna a kilatna-in mite in ngaihsun uh hi.
Pasian in a hehna tawh hong balnen ngiingei a, a ha hong gawi sanin hong heh et hi.
Mite in kei hong zahko uh a, ka paang a beng dingin hong kikhawmtuah uh hi.
Pasian in migilote khut sungah kei hong pia hi.
Kei nuamtakin a om kim lai, Pasian in ka gawl-in hong manin, hong balgawpin hong sugawp hi. Pasian in a muitum dingin kei hong suang a,
ka kimkot panin a thaltangte tawh hong kap hi. Tua thaltangte in kei hong kha-in hong liamsak a, tua bang nangawn ah hong hehpih lo hi.
Amah in kei hong liamsak thuahthuah a, galkap a hehpa bangin hong hih gawp hi.
Kei thuum-in puanhampi ka silh a, guallel-in leivui lakah ka om hi.
Ka kah kahna-in ka mai khempeuh sangawp a, ka mitkhute bawkin hong liahcip hi.
Ahi zongin ngongtatna themkhat zong ka zang kei a, Pasian' tungah ka thungetna in lungsim takpi tawh ahi hi.
"Leitung aw, a man lo-a kei hong kibawlna seelcip kei in! Thuman deih-a ka kikona aw daicip sak kei in.
Kei' adingin a ding ding, kei hong pan'pih ding mi khat a sanglam vantungah om hi.
Keima tang-a sempa in ka lawmpa ahi hi, Pasian in ka khitui luan'na bangin ka thungetna hong za leh ka ut hi.
Mi khat in a lawmpa' ading a thuumsak bangin, mi khatpeuh in Pasian kiangah kei ading hong thuumsak leh ka ut hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka hun nai mahmah ta a, ka lehzuih nawn loh ding lampi zui-in a pai ka hi ta hi.
Ka bei ding naikuan ta hi. Ka hu ka sang zo nawn kei a, kei adingin hankhuk cih loh bangmah dang om nawn lo hi.
Ka heina khempeuh ah mite in hong zahko a, amau' hong phinna in hong lungzingsak hi.
"Pasian aw, kei hong hu in. Ka thugente hong pan'pih ding kuamah dang om lo hi.
Nangmah in amaute thuman a mu lo dingin bawl na hih manin amaute na gualzosak kei ding hi.
Paunak in, sum ngah nop manin mi khat in a lawmte a lehhek leh, a tate in tua gitlohna thaman thuak hi, kici hi.
"Tu-in amaute in kei tungah hih paunak hong bulh uh a, mite in hih thu za-in kei hong cilpih uh hi.
Mi hoih-a kineite in lamdang hong sa uh a, migilo-in kei hong seh uh hi.
Mite' zahtak-a kinei mite in, amau' ngaihsutna man sa semsem uh hi. Thuman sem mite in thahat semsem ding hi.
Ahi zongin amaute khempeuh hong pai-in ka mai-ah hong ding le uh, amaute lakah mipil khat zong ka mu kei ding hi.
Ka hun bei ta hi; ka geelna teng maimang a, ka lametna teng bei ta hi.
Ka lawmte in, zan khuamial pen sun khuavak, ci uh hi; khuavak hong nai ta hi, ci uh a, ahi zongin khuamial sung mah ah kei ka om lai veve hi.
Kei' lamet nading misite' gam bek om lai a, tua khuamial sungah lumin ka ihmu ding hi.
Hankhuk pen ka pa hi, ka ci ding a, kei hong ne thante pen ka nu leh sanggam numeite, ka ci ding hi.
Kei' lamet ding tua lai-ah bang om ahi hiam? Ka lamet ding tua lai-ah kua in nong muhsak uh hiam?
Misite' gam Leinuai-ah ka pai ciangin nopsakna in kei hong zui lo ding hi," a ci hi.
"Job aw, khawl hun nei thei lo ding na hi hiam? Hong khawl phot lecin, ko zong thu kong gen thei ding uh hi.
Bang hangin bawng bang lelin kote hong ngaihsun a, mihaipi-in kote hong seh na hi hiam?
Na hehna tawh nangmah a kigimsak bek na hi hi. Nangma hangin leitung kinusia ding a, mualte kikhin khia ding sa na hi hiam?
"Migilopa' meivak kisumit ding a, cikmah hunin a kuangkik ngei nawn kei ding hi.
A khe kip ngei a, ahi zongin tu-in a khe bai ta hi. Amah in a ngaihsut khialhna puklawh hi.
Thangsiahna ngen sungah bungbu tuk a, gum sungah amah kia hi.
Thang-ah a khetul-in awk a, thangkhau in amah gakcip hi.
Amah siahna-in lei lakah khauzak kitung a, a pai nading lampi-ah thang kisiah hi.
A ciangciang-ah lauhuaina in amah pang a, a kalsuanna khempeuh ah sulzuih hi.
Siatna in amah ngak a, siatna in su dingin amah ngak gige hi.
A kihtakhuai natna in a pum khempeuh tuam a, a khut leh a khete muatsak ta hi.
Lungmuang tak-a a omna inn panin kikaikhia a, Sihna Kumpipa kiangah kitunpih hi.
Ama sihna hangin a inn zatui tawh a kisian'suah khit ciangin a ut peuhpeuh tua inn-ah teeng thei pah ding hi.
Lei sunga ama zungte keu in, a tunga ama hiangte a si ta hi.
Inn leh gam-ah a minthan'na bei ta a, kuamah in amah phawk kha nawn lo hi.
A nungtate' gam panin amah kihawl khia ding a, khuavakna mun panin khuamialna-ah kihawl khia ding hi.
Amah in suan-le-khak nei lo a, a teen'nasa mun-ah ama gui zom ding om lo hi.
Nisuahna pan nitumna dong ama thuakna a za peuhmah kigaih-in launa tawh liing uh hi.
Migilote, Pasian a ngaihsun lote' thu tawpna in hih bang mah ahi hi," a ci hi.
Bangtanvei thu gengenin, kei hong gimsak ding na hi hiam?
Kei nong simmawh niloh a, tua banga na gamtatna ah maizumna mel na nei thei kei hi.
A khial takpi mah hita leng zong, nang' lainat nading bang om ahi hiam?
Keimah sangin a hoih zaw-in nang na kingaihsun a, ka thuaknate pen ka mawhna hang hi, ci-in na ngaihsun hi.
Hih thu hong piangsakpa in Pasian ahih lam mu thei lo na hi hiam? Kei hong mat nadingin amah in thang hong siah hi.
Hong ngong bawlna ka nial hangin kuamah in hong don kei hi. Thuman ka deih hangin hong kipia kei hi.
Pasian in ka lampi khaktan a, ka paisuak zo kei hi. Amah in ka pai nading lampi khua mialcipsak hi.
Amah in ka hauhna khempeuh hong lakkhiatsak a, ka min hoih kimlai hong siasak hi.
Amah in ka pumpi khempeuh hong satgawp hi. Ka nopsakna teng hong zunglot sakin, vul gawpin a si dingin hong nusia hi.
Kei' tungah Pasian' hehna sogawp a, ama gal lian penin kei hong ngaihsun hi.
Amah in keimah sim dingin a galkapte hong sawl a, galkapte in dum to-in ka buk hong umcih uh hi.
"Pasian in ka sanggamte hong taisan sak a, kei hong theisate kiangah mikhualpi ka suak hi.
Ka behte leh ka lawmte bei ta hi.
Ka inn-ah hong tung ngei ka zinte in hong mangngilh ta a, ka na a sem numeite in mikhual bangin hong bawl a, amau' mai-ah midangpi ka suak hi.
Ka nasemte khatpeuh ka sap ciangin hong dawng nuam lo uh a, hong huh nading ka thuum ciang nangawnin hong thudon lo uh hi.
Ka zi in ka gimnam nam zo lo a, ka sanggamte mahmah in zong hong naih nuam lo uh hi.
Naupang melmawl nangawn in kei hong simmawh uh a, kei hong muh uh ciangin hong nuihsan uh hi.
Ka lawm it pente nangawn in kei hong muhdah et uh a, ka it pente nangawn in kei hong lang bawl uh hi.
Ka guh tungah ka vun kol dihdiah-in om a, a nungta liai-liai bekin ka om hi.
Hong hehpih un! Hong hehpih un! Ka lawmte hilo na hi uh hiam? Pasian in kei hong satpaai hi.
Pasian' hong bawlsiat bangin bang hangin no zong hong bawlsia ding na hi uh hiam? Nong gimsakna uh kicing ta hoh hilo ahi hiam?
"Ka thugente mi khatpeuh in ciamteh hen la, laibu khat sungah khum leh ut mahmah ing!
Tua ahih kei leh zong, ka thugente, sikkhu khat tawh suang tungah khen hen la, a mang ngei nawn lo dingin gelh leh ut ing!
Ahi zongin a tawpna-ah kei hong pan'pih ding a nungta tawntung mi khat, vantungah a omna thu ka thei hi.
Natna in ka vun a nektum khit hangin, hih ka pumpi mahmah tawh Pasian ka mu ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh, "Amah bang i ci gimsak thei ding hiam?" na ci uh hi. Kei nong suk theih nadingun paulap khatpeuh na zong uh hi.
Ahi zongin tu-in namsau kihta un—tua namsau in a mawhte tungah Pasian' hehna hong sem ding hi; tua ciangin thu a khen ding khat a om lam na thei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
"Job aw, ka heh nong suaksak a, kei ka ki-iip zo nawn kei hi.
Na thugente khempeuh kei nong simmawhna kam hi a, ahi zongin kong dawn' nading ka thei hi.
Tanglai pek-a kipan, leitungah mihing a om cil-a kipanin,
migilote' nopsak hun a tomna thu, Pasian a thudon lote' lungdam hun a tomna thu thei lo na hi hiam?
Migilopa lianin vantung a banto zongin, lian mahmah in a lutang in meii lak a banto zongin,
leivui them bangin maimang lel ding hi. Amah a thei ngei mite in, 'Amah koi-ah om ta hiam?' ci-in lamdangsa ding uh hi.
Amah pen zan-a mangmat bang leh mumaang bangin maimang ding a, cik mah hunin kimu kik ngei nawn lo ding hi.
Ama teen'na ngei mun panin amah mangthang ding a,
mizawngte' na a suhsakte, a tate in a lohsak kik ding uh hi.
A pumpi moisuahin a thahat hangin, a sawt loin leivui suak pak ding hi.
"Ama kam sungah gitlohna lim sa mahmahin, namtui sa-in a leii tawh lop melmel a,
amah in muam muam nuamin siakhia nuam lo a, lim sa-in a dangtawng den'na-in a neih hangin,
a gil sungah a kha mahmah an suakin, gulgu a khapen zahin kha deidai hi.
Migilopa in a guksa hauhnate luakhia kik a, a gil sung nangawn panin Pasian in a lakkhiatsak hi.
Migilote' nekte in gu tawh kibang a, gulgu neite' tuk bangin amah si sak hi.
Amah in bawngnawi leh khuaizu guntui bangin a luang mu kha lo ding hi.
Amah in a nasepna thaman khempeuh nusia ding a, a hauhna zang kha man lo ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in mizawngte bawlsia-in don lo a, midangte' inn lamsate sutin a tang hi.
"A huaihamna bei ngei lo a, a duh khempeuh siit nei lo hi.
Amah in a nek ciangin a khamval om nawn lo a, tu-in a hauhna teng bei ta hi.
A cihtheih pen hun lai takin, ama tungah lungkhamna lianpen tung ding hi.
Amah in a duh duh ne mai hen! Pasian in hehna tawh daantat ngawn ding hi.
Amah in namsau pelhin a taina-ah sumngo thal in kaptuk ding hi.
Thaltang khat in a pumpi pailet a, a te-dildel thaltang muk-ah si taak keuhkeuh a, ama tungah a kihtak huaipi hong tung hi.

Pasian' hehna hangin, ama hauhna khempeuh kisusia ding hi.
Migilote' ngah ding a Pasian' piak, migilote' ngah in tu-a bang ahi hi," a ci hi.
"Ka thugennate lim takin hong ngai un la, Ka thu nong ngaihna uh nong hehnepna uh hi sak ni.
Thu ka gen theih nading hun hong pia un la, ka gen khit ciangin na ut uh leh hong zahpih un.
Kei' kitotpihpa in mihing hi lo hi. Bang hangin lungtom lo ding ka hi hiam?
Kei hong en dih un. Lamdang na saktaak ding khat uh hilo ka hi hiam?
Keima tunga thu piang ka ngaihsut ciangin, lamdang sa-in lau-in ka liing hi.

annek tuidawn kicingin cidam hi.

Amaute hawkguam sung leh luihawm sung, leihawm leh keenhawm sung peuhah a teen' uh kul hi.
Amaute ganhing bangin gamlakah ham uh a, sawlkawm nuai-ah kilomin omkhawm uh hi.
Bangmah-a kimang lo misia honte, mite omna gam sung panin kihawlkhia hi.
"Tu-in amaute in kei simmawhin hong nuihsan uh a, amau' ciamnuihna bek ka suak ta hi.
Amaute in kei hong kih uh a, kei tawh tehna-in amaute hoih lua kisa uh a, amaute in ka maitang nangawn cil hong phih uh hi.
Pasian in kei hong zawngkhalsak hong cimawhsak ahih manin amaute in a ut utin kei hong bawlsia uh hi.
Hih mihonte in kei hong simgawpin, kei hong taikhia sak uh a, ka sih nadingin ka mai-ah na pang uh hi.
Ka suahtak theih nading lampi khaktan uh a, keimah suksiat ding hanciam uh hi; amaute a kho ding kuamah om lo hi.
Kei ka bukna leihawm-ah hong tuaksuk uh a, kei hong sucip suk uh hi.
Launa tawh ka kidim a, ka thupina teng huih letkhiat bangin beimang a, ka cihtheihna teng meii bangin theng ta hi.
"Tu-in a si ding ka hi ta a, ka gimna pan noptuam ngah nading om nawn lo hi.
Zan thapai-in ka guh sung ka taang sung khempeuh na a, hong pet tawntung natna pen dai ngei lo hi.
Pasian in ka puan ngawng pan hong manin, ka puan tawh hong heekcip hi.
Buannawng sungah kei hong lawn a, nin bulom bang lel ka hi ta hi.
Pasian aw, nang kong sam a, nong dawng ngei kei hi; nang tungah thu kong ngen a, nong don het kei hi.
Kei tungah nong gilo mahmah a, nong hih theih zahin kei nong bawlsia hi.
Kei huih lakah hong lawnin huih nong lensak a, huihpi in kei hong lawnsuk hong lawnto hi.
Mi khempeuh adingin a kisehkholsa ahi, sihna-ah hong paipih na hihna ka thei hi.
"Na hehpih ding a hong thuum cih loh buang, bangmah dang ahih thei nawn lo misiapa, bang hangin sugawp na hi hiam?
A lungkham mite tawh kei kap khawmin, a cimawhte dahpih hilo ka hi hiam?
Lungdamna leh khuavakna ka lamet lai takin, lungkhamna leh khuamialna hong tung zawsop hi.
Lunggimna leh natna in kei hong sugawp a, gimna ka thuk ding cih loh bangmah dang om nawn lo hi.
Lungkham sinkhamin ka om a, mihon lakah ding-in huhna ka ngen hi.
Kei in gamkhing sunga om ngiate leh kalaoh vasate tawh a kipawl, a kikhawl ta ka hi hi.
Ka vun vomin dulh khia a, ka pumtangin ka ci sa gawp hi.
Nidangin lungdamna la kisa ka zakna mun-ah, thuumna leh kahna aw bek ka za ta hi.
"Lunggulhna tawh nungak khatpeuh ka et ngei loh nading, lim takin kiciamna ka bawl khin hi.
Vanglianpen Pasian in eite bang hong cih a, mihing gamtatna bangci thukkik ahi hiam?
A man loin a gamtate tungah siatna leh gimna tungsak hi.
Pasian in ka gamtatna khempeuh thei a, ka kalsuanna khempeuh hong mu hi.
"A giloin ka gamtat ngei het lohna, kuamah ka khem ngei het lohna thute-ah ka kiciam ngam hi.
Pasian in a man tawikhaina-ah hong tawikhai hen, ka pauban' het lohna hong mu ding hi.
Lampi man panin ka pial a, siatna lam ka zuih a, ka khut tungah mawhna a baan' taak leh,
Ka khawhsa ante midangte' nek suak hen la, ka an khempeuh maimang ta hen.
"Ka vengte' zi zawlmit-in, a kong gei-ah ngakin ka buk taak leh,
Ka it ka zi in midang' an suksak hen la, midang' ang-ah lum ta hen.
(Tua bang mawhna in a siahuai hi a, sihna daan a thuak ding ahi hi.
Ka neih khempeuh a kangtum mei husia tawh a kibang ahi hi.)
"Ka nasemte khatpeuh peuh kei tungah a phun ciangin, a thu ngai-in lim takin ka bawl hi.
Tua ci kei leng, Pasian' mai bangci muh ngam ding ka hi hiam? Pasian in keima thu a khen dingin hong pai ciangin bang gen ding ka hi hiam?
Kei hong piangsak Pasian mah in ka nasemte zong a piangsak ahi hi.
"Mizawngte ka huhkhial ngei kei a, meigong numeite ka guaksuaksak ngei kei hi.
Keimah in an ne ne-in, tagahte gilkialin ka koihkhong ngei kei hi.
Ka khang tawnin tua bangte ka en tawntung hi.
Mi a cimawh, puansilh ding a lei zo lo, a zawng lua ka muh ciangin,
Ka tuuhon panin ka ngah tuumul puan kibawl ka pia hi. Amah in a lungsim neih khempeuh tawh kei hong phat hi.
Zum thukhenna-ah zo na ning cih ngaihsutna tawh tagah khatpeuh ka kheem taak leh,
ka khutte buisum hen la, ka liang bul panin kilong khia ta hen.
Pasian' daan piak ding kihta ka hih manin, tua bang peuhmah ka gamta ngei kei ding hi.
"Leitung hauhna muan' leh suan'in ka nei ngei kei a,
ka hauhna zong ka kisaktheihpih ngei kei hi.
A taang mahmah ni ahi a, a hoih mahmah kha ahi zongin, cik mahin ka bia ngei kei hi.
Tua bang hih ding ngaihsutin zong ka nei ngei kei hi.
Tua bang mawhna in sihna daan a thuak ding hi a, tua bang mawhna in Vanglian Pasian nialna ahi hi.
Ka galte in gimna a thuak ciangin ka kipak ngei kei a, haksatna a tuah ciangun ka lungdam ngei kei hi.
A sih nading uh deihna tawh cik mahin ka samsia ngei kei hi.
Zin leh leeng lim takin ka do tawntungna thu, ka na hong sepsak mi khempeuh in thei uh hi.
Ka inn-ah khualzinte ka tungsak a, kongzing lakah ka lumsak ngei kei hi.
Midangte in a mawhna uh iim a, ahih hangin kei aa ka iim ngei kei hi.
Midangte, hong kampau ding kihtakin ka nei ngei kei hi; amau' simmawh ding kihtakna hangin pau loin ka om ngei kei a, ka bucip ngei kei hi.
Ka thugente kuamah in na ngai lo ding ahi hiam? Ka gen khempeuh man hi, ci-in ka kiciam hi. Vanglian Pasian in hong dawng ta hen. Ka langte in kei hong mawhsakna thute ka tawi theih dingin lai sungah kigelh hi leh,
tua mawhsaknate kisialhna tawh ka ngawng-ah ka ok ding a, mi khempeuh in a muh dingin ka sangsak ding hi.
Ka gamtatna khempeuh Pasian kiangah ka gen ding a, ama muhna-ah lungnuamin kihihsakna tawh ka om ding hi.
"Ka khawh leitang ka guk ahih a, a nei taktakpa tung pan ka suh ahih a,
tua leitang-a piang ante ka nek a, tua lo a khote puksi-in ka omsak taak leh,
tua lo-ah mangbuh leh mangbuhham tangin, kiak leh ling po ta hen," a ci hi. Job' thugente bei ta hi.
Job amahmah dik kisa tawntung ahih manin hih mihing thumte in Job' thugente dawn' ding ngaihsun nawn lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Ram minam, Buz-te beh, Barakhel' tapa Elihu a heh hong suak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Job amah kidiksakin Pasian mawhsak zawsop hi.
Job' lawm thumte tungah zong a heh suak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Job a dawn'na ding uh thei lo uh ahih manin Pasian a khial tawh hong kibang hi.
Elihu in amaute lak panin a khangno pen ahih manin a dangte a pau kim khit mateng bangmah pau loin om hi.
Ahi zongin hih mihing thumte in Job a dawn' theih loh a muh ciangin a hehna thuak zo nawn lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Buz-te beh Barekhel' tapa Elihu in thu gen ding hong kipan a, "Kei a khangno hi-in, note a khangham na hih manun, ka ngaihsutna note lakah kong gen ngam kei hi.
No a khanghamzawte in thu a gen ding kilawm hi, ci-in keimah in ka ngaihsun hi.
Ahi zongin mihingte tunga hong tung pilna pen Vanglian Pasian' Kha pan ahi hi.
Khanghamna in mi pilsak lo a, thuman zong theisak tuan lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in ka thugen nong ngaih ding uh ka deih hi; keima ngaihsutna hong gensak dih un.
"Na thugen lai takun lungduai takin kong ngaingai a, thugen ding na zon'zon' lai takun kong ngak hithiat hi.
Lim takin kong ngai a, na cihmawhna uh ka thei hi; Job' thugente a man lohna na gentel thei kei uh hi.
Bangci-in pilna nei-in kigen thei ding na hi uh hiam? Note in lel na hih manun Pasian in Job dawng ding hi.
Job in note tungah thu hong gen a, kei tungah hong gen lo hi; ahi zongin note' dawn' bangin ka dawng ngei kei ding hi.
"Job aw, hih mite in nang hong lel uh a, nang hong dawn' nading thei lo uh hi.
Amaute pau loin a om ciangun kei zong ngak lai ding ka hi hiam? Amaute in gen ding thei nawn loin ommawk uh hi.
Tu-in kei zong kong dawng ding a, ka ngaihsutna kong pulak ding hi.
Ka thugen ding ka ngak lah a, ka kam ka ki-iip zo kei hi.
Thu gen theih nading hun nei lo hi leng, leenggahtui thak a kithun leenggahtui um bangin ka puakkham ding hi.
Ka thuak zo nawn kei a, ka dawng ta hi.
Hih ka thugenna-ah kuamah ka pawlpih kei ding a, kuamah ka phattuam kei ding hi.
Kuamah ka mawk phat thei kei hi; tua ci mawk phat leng Pasian in kei hong sumang pak ding hi.
"Job aw, tu-in ka thugen khempeuh lim takin ngai in.
Ka lungsim sunga om thute, a hong gen ding ka hi hi.
Ka gen khempeuh lungsim takpi tawh ka gen hi a, aman thu a gen ka hi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian' Kha in kei hong bawl a, Vanglianpa in kei tungah nuntakna hu hong pia hi.
Nong dawn' theih leh hong dawng in. Nong sel nading kiging in.
Job aw, nang leh kei, Pasian' muhna-ah a kibang i hi a, ei tegel in leivui pan-a piang tuak i hi hi.
Tua ahih manin kei nong kihtak nading om lo a, nang kong zawhthawh nading om lo hi.
Keima zakin thu na gen khin a, na genna kamgingte ka za khin hi.
Nangmah in, 'Kei ka mawh kei hi; khialhna bangmah ka gamta kei hi. Ka paubaang kei a, mawhna ka sukha kei hi.
Pasian in kei hong suk theih nading thu zong a, gal bangin kei hong bawl hi.
Amah in ka khe kol hong bulh a, ka gamtatna khempeuh hong encik hi,' na cihna ka za hi.
"Ahih hangin, Job aw, nangmah na khial hi. Pasian pen mihing sangin lianzaw hi.
Mihingte' phunna don ngei lo hi, ci-in bang hangin Pasian mawhsak na hi hiam?
Pasian in a lam tuamtuamin thu hong gen napi-in, ama thugen kuamah in don lo hi.
Zan-in mite a ihmut hun ciangin, mang leh mangmuhna sungah Pasian in thugen hi.
Pasian in mite kiangah thu gen a, ama hilhkholhna hangin mite lau mahmah uh hi.
Mite in khialhna a bawl nawn loh nading, mi kiphasakte a suah khak loh nading, a deihna-in Pasian in mite kiangah thu gen hi.
Pasian in mihingte siatna thuaksak lo a, sih nading panin amaute honkhia hi.
"Pasian in ci natsakna tawh mihing thuhilh a, a pum khempeuh natna tawh kidimsak hi.
Cinapa in an ne zo lo a, an a lim pen nangawn a kihtha suak hi.
A ci a sa khempeuh kiam a, a guh guak bekin om hi.
Amah a bei nading a nai hi ta a, misite' gam a zuan ding ahi ta hi.
Mihingte a tavuan uh a phawksak, Pasian' vantungmi tul tampite lak panin vantungmi khat amah huh dingin hong pai kha ding hi.
Vantungmi in amah a hehpihna hangin, 'Amah suaktasak in! Misite' gamah amah pai sak kei in. Amah tatkhiat nading hih lai-ah om hi,' a ci ding hi.
Tua ciangin ama pumpi khangno suak kikin, a thahat pen hun laitak bang kik ding hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian in ama thungetna pia ding a, amah in lungdamna tawh Pasian bia ding a, Pasian in ama adingin thu a hoih lamin heisak kik ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in mihonpite' zakin, 'Kei ka khial khin hi. A manin ka gamta kei a, ahi zongin Pasian in hong suaktasak hi.
Misite' gam ka tun' nading panin amah in kei hong kem a, tu-in kei ka nungta lai hi,' ci ding hi.
"Pasian in hih thute khempeuh mihing tungah, hih kik zelzel a,
sih nading panin honkhia kikin, nuntakna nuam pia kik hi.
Job aw, tu-in ka thugen hong ngai in la, gamdai-in om in la, kei thu hong gensak in.
Ahi zongin gen nop mahmah na neih leh hong gen in; bang hang hiam cih leh midik na hih ding kong deihsak hi.
Ahi zongin gen nop na neih kei leh, keima thugen hong ngai in, mipil na hih theih nading thu kong hilh ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Elihu in,
"No mipilte aw, ka thugente ciamteh un, no thuthei mite aw, ka thugente ngai un.
An na ciap uh ciangin a lim leh a lim lo na thei uh hi; thu kigen na zak uh ciangin pil kampau leh hai kampau na thei ding uh hi.
Thuman bang hiam cih teng khia ni; thuhoih bang hiam cih mu khia ni.
Job in lah, 'Kei ka dik hi, Pasian in kei a thumanin hong seh nuam lo hi,
kei thuman napi thuzuau genin hong seh hi, kei khial lo napi-in gimna thuakin ka cimawh hi,' a ci hi.
Hih Job tawh a kibang mi na mu ngei uh hiam? Amah in Pasian zahtakna lim nei thei lo hi.
Amah in migilote tawh kikholh nuam sa a, mawhneite tawh vak kawikawi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, 'Pasian' deihna i zuih hangin, bangmah phattuamna om lo hi,' a ci hi.
"Ahi zongin no thu ngaihsun theite in ka thugenna hong ngai un. Pasian in gitlohna gamta ngei ding a, Vanglianpa in a man lo sem ngei peuhmah ding ahi hiam?
Pasian in mite a gamtatna tawh kizui-in thaman pia a, a thuak ding uh a kilawm bangin daantat hi.
A taktakin ci lehang, Pasian a man loin gamta ngei lo a, thutang kimlai a khialin heisak lo hi.
Pasian in a vangliatna mi khatpeuh tung pan ngah ahi hiam? Leitung khempeuh a uk dingin mi khatpeuh in a koih ahi hiam?
Pasian in a ngaihsutna kheel hen la, nuntakna hu dok kik hi leh
nuntakna nei khempeuh si pah ding a, mihingte, leivui suakkik ding hi.
"Job aw, mipil-a kinei na hih leh ka thugennate hong ngai in.
Vanglianpa in thutang deih lo dingin ngaihsun na hi hiam? Nang in a thuman Pasian mawhsak na hi hiam?
Kumpite leh uliante bang mahin kimang loin a gitloh uh ciangin, amaute a mawhsak ngampa in Pasian ahi hi.
Pasian pen mi khempeuh a piangsakpa hi a, amah in uliante panpih tuan lo a, mizawngte sangin mihaute thupi ngaihsut zaw tuan lo hi.
Mihingte zan khat thu-in si pak thei hi. Pasian in mite sat pukin si sak thei a, nakpi-in hih kul loin mi thahatte zong that thei hi.
"Pasian in mihingte gamtatna khempeuh hong encik a, i kalsuanna themno dongin hong mu khin hi.
Gamtatsia mite a buk theih nadingun a seel zo ding, khuamial khuazing koi mah-ah om lo hi.
Pasian mai-ah mihingte in thukhenna a thuak ni ding, a kisehkhol hun om tuan lo hi.
Amah in thu kan kul loin mi vangliante sugawp a, amau' tangin mi dangte koih hi.
Amah in amaute'gamtatnate thei ahih manin, zan khat thu-in amaute lumletin susia gawp hi.
Pasian in mi khempeuh' muhna-ah mawhneite daan pia hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in a thu mang nawn lo uh a, a thupiaknate khempeuh don nawn lo uh hi.
Amaute in mizawngte kapsak gawp uh a, mizawngte' huhngetna awging Pasian in za hi.
Pasian in bangmah hih het kei taleh zong, kuamah in Pasian mawhsak zo lo ding hi. Amah in hong maingat het kei leh zong, kuamah in bangmah cih zo tuan lo ding hi.
Migilote hong uksak ta leh zong, tua panin suahtak nading kuamah in vaihawm zo lo ding hi.
"Job aw, Pasian tungah na khialhnate pulakin, na khialh nawn loh nading thu ciam nai na hi hiam?
Pasian in na khialhnate hong lah nading ngenin, na gamtat siat nawn loh nading ut nai na hi hiam?
Nangmah in Pasian nial na hih manin, nangma utna bang hong hihsak ding ahi hiam? Hih thu in kei' ngaihsut ding hi loin, nangma lungsim khentat ding ahi hi. Tu-in na ngaihsutna hong gen in.
Thu ngaihsun theih peuhmahte in man hi, hong cihpih ding uh a, ka thugenna a za mipil peuhmahte in,
"Thu thei lopi-in Job in thugen a, a gen peuhmah a khiatna nei mel om lo hi.
Job' thugente ngaihsun le uh cin, migilo banga kampau ahihna na thei ding uh hi.
Amah in a khialhna khawl nuam lo a, eite khempeuh mai-ah Pasian simmawhin zahpih hi,' ci ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Elihu mah in,
"Job aw, Pasian' muhna-ah ka paubaang kei hi, na cih ding kilawm lo hi.
Pasian kiangah, ka khialh hangin nang bang phamawh sa na hi hiam? Khialhna ka bawl loh manin bangmah phattuamna ka ngah kei hi, na cih ding kilawm lo hi.
Nang leh na lawmte tungah, thu kong gen ding hi.
Vantung en to dih in, Meiite bangzah takin sang ahi hiam?
Mawhna na bawl manin, Pasian bangmah sukha lo hi. Tampi tak khial ta lecin amah sukha tuan ahi hiam?
Na thumanna hangin Pasian in phattuamna ngah ahi hiam? Pasian in nang kiang panin bangmah deih lo hi.
Na khialhna hangin na mipihte bek in thuak a, na gamtat hoihna hangin na mipihte bek in phattuamna ngah hi.
"Mite in gimna a thuak uh ciang tau uh a, amaute a hon dingin midang khatpeuh sam uh hi.
Lungziin' pen hun lai takin thahatna a pia, amau a Piangsakpa Pasian' lam nga lo uh hi.
Eite mipil-in a hong bawl, ganhingte leh vasate sangin a pil zaw-in a hong bawl Pasian' lam nga lo uh hi.
Amaute migilo mi kihisakte ahih manin, huh ding a nget hangun Pasian in pia lo hi.
Ngetnget, gengen a phattuamna bangmah om lo hi. Vanglian Pasian in na mu lo, na ngai lo hi.
Job aw, nang in, Pasian ka mu thei kei a, ahi zongin ka thu ama khut sungah om a, lungduai takin ka ngak niloh hi, na ci hi.
Pasian in kuamah daan pia lo a, khialhna zong thupi ngaihsut lo hi, ci- in na ngaihsun hi.
Tua banga kam na paupau a mawknapi hi a, na gen mel zong a thei lo na hihna kilang hi," a ci hi.
Elihu in a thugen zom lai a,
"Lungduai-in tawmkhat hong ngai lai in: Pasian' tangin ka gen ding pawlkhat om lai hi.
Kei hong Piangsakpa Pasian thuman hi, ci-in kong lah nadingin thu tampi kaikhawmin kong gen ding hi.
Ka thugennate a khial om het lo a, na mai-ah thugenpa in mipil khat ahi hi.
"Pasian thahat mahmah napi-in kuamah simmawh lo hi. Ama theih loh bangmah om lo hi.
Amah in mimawhte daupaisak lo a, a zawng gimna thuakte tungah a manin gamta hi.
Amah in thuman mite hu a, kumpi ukna za pia a, pahtawina ngahsak tawntung hi.
Ahi zongin mite sikkol kibulh a, a gamtatnasate hangin gimna a thuak uh leh,
Pasian in amau' mawhna leh a kiphatsaknate uh a lakkhia ahi hi.
A gamtat siatna panun a khawl nadingun amau' bil-ah thu a gengen ahi hi.
Amaute in Pasian' thu mangin ama na sem leh amaute nuam sa-in a khan' uh sau hi.
Ahi zongin ama thu mang kei le uh, namsau tawh si ding uh a, misite' gam zuan ding uh hi.
"Migilote a heh-in ni tum uh a, gimna a thuak ciang nangawn-un ama huh ding ngen lo uh hi.
Amaute khan'sih uh a, zumhuaipi-in bei uh hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in gimna tawh mite thuhilh a, mite in khua a phawk theih nadingin gimna zang hi.
Pasian in lungkhamna panin nang hong pai khiatpihin, lungnuam takin nang hong om sak a, na sabuai tungah anlim nono kilui venvan hi.
Ahi zongin tu-in na ngah dinga kilawm daan a thuak ta na hi hi.
Sumgolh' khemsa-in ta kei in la, leitung nate' bawlin lam kipialsak kei in.
Huh ding na nget hangin bangmah phattuamna om nawn lo a, na hauhna na liatna in hong huh thei nawn lo hi.
Mihingte a beimang hun ding, zan khuamial hong tun' ding lunggulh kei in.
Siatna lamah na kihei khak loh nadingin kidawm in; na siat khak loh nadingin gimna hong kithuaksak ahi hi.
Pasian'vang bangzah takin lian hiam cih phawk in; Pasian in sia khempeuh lakah a lianpen ahi hi.
Kuamah in Pasian a gamtat nading sawl thei lo a, Pasian gamtat sia hi, ci-in zong kuamah in mawhsak zo lo hi.
"Pasian a nasepna hangin mi khempeuh in a phat tawntung mah bangin, nang zong amah phat zaw in.
Mi khempeuh in Pasian' sepsate mu uh a, thei kim zo loin lamdangsa uh hi.
Pasian' liatna a kicingin i thei zo kei a, ama kum phazah zong i sim zo kei hi.
Amah in tuipi panin tuite la to a, tua tuite guahtui-in a bawl hi.
Amah in meii sung panin guah piangsak a, mihing khempeuh adingin guahzusak hi.
Meiite a pai henhanna thu hita leh, van-ah van a gin'na thu hita leh kuamah in thei zo lo hi.
Amah in van-ah khua phiasak a, ahi zongin tuipi thuk sung mialsak hi.
Amah in hih bang lam tawh mihingte hong vak a, annek ding tampi hong pia hi.
Amah in keek thu pia a, a kap nop pen a kha dingin sawl hi.
Amah a heh ciangin huihpi sam a, vanging pen ama hong pai nading a kitheihna ahi hi.
"Hih huihpi in ka dip hong kuasak a, ka dip van-a khai hong bangsak hi.
Ama kam panin hong gingkhia hih vanging, Pasian' pauna awging ngai un.
Amah in van-ah khua phiasak a, leimong khat pan mongkhat dong taan' hi.
Tua ciangin a vanglian vanging ahi, ama awging hong kiza a, tua sung mahin khua phiaphia hi.
Pasian' sawlna tawh na lamdang pipi piang a, eite' theih zawh loh thute hong piang hi.
Amah in mihingte' nasep khawlsak a, amah a gamtaang ahihna lak hi.
Gamsate in a lupna ngei delh uh a, a kua sungah bucip uh hi.
Pasian' husan'na in tui khalsak a, tui lianpite khalin sik bangin sak sak hi.
Amah in meiipi nomsak a, meiipi-in khua a phiasak hi.
Pasian' deihna zui-in kikhin kawikawi hi. Leitung mun khempeuhah pai- in, Pasian' sawl teng sem uh hi.

"Job aw, tawlkhat khawlin ngai in la, Pasian' bawl na lamdangte ngaihsun in.

Bangmah in len lopi-in vantungah meii a om sak theihna, a lamdang hih ama siamna na thei hiam?

Tua ahih manin mi khempeuh in amah a zahtakna, mipil a kisate amah in a don lohna, lamdang sak ding hilo hi," a ci hi.

Kalai! A hun hong nai ta! Topa' ni hong nai ta a, Vanglianpa' suksiatna hong nai ta hi.

Ama mi honpite tam mahmah uh ahih manin, amaute thu pia-in a mai uh-ah Topa awng a, ama thupiakna banga a semte hat mahmah uh hi. Topa' ni ding nak kihtakhuai mahmah ahih manin, kua in thuak zo peuhmah ding ahi hiam?
Topa in hih bangin ci hi, "Tu mahmah nangawnin, lungsim tak tawh kisik kikin, an tangin, kapin, thuumna tawh kei kiangah hong paikik un.
Na dah taktakna uh lungkhamna tawh langsak un la, na puan uh a balkeek bek hi kei un," hong ci hi. Topa, note' Pasian kiangah ciahkik un. Amah migi-in hehpihna a nei hi a, a lung duai-in hong huh nuam tawntung a, daan hong tat loin hong maisak nuam tawntung hi.
Topa, i Pasian in a lungsim kheelin, an hauhsakna tawh thupha hong pia kha ding hi. Tua hi leh ama tungah an leh leenggahzu tawh biakna i pia thei ding hi.
Zion mual tungah peengkul tumin, antan' nading thu pia un la, biak kikhopna khat nei un.
Mite kaikhawm un la, amaute sian' suah un. A khangham mite sam un la, naupangte zong kaikhawm un la, nawine lai naungekte zong paipih un. A kiteng cil nungak leh tangvalte nangawn in, a omna uh nusia-in hong pai uh hen.
Topa' na a sem siampite, biakinn sung innlim leh biakna tau kikal-ah, kapin thu ngen uh hen la, "Topa aw, na mite hong hehpih in. Minam dangte in, 'Na Pasian uh koi-ah om hiam?' ci-in kote hong simmawhsak kei in la, amaute' nuihsatin hong omsak kei in," ci uh hen.
Tua ciangin Topa in ama leitang donin, ama mite hehpih hi.
Topa in ama mite' thungetna dawng a, "Tu-in note tungah an, leenggahzu leh sathau, ka hong pia a, na kham takun na ne ding uh hi. Minam dangte' simmawhin na om nawn kei ding uh hi.
Leilu lam panin hong pai mite, note kiang panin sehnel gamah ka hawl khia ding a, a madawkte uh nisuahna tuipi sungah khia-in, a nungdalte uh nitumna tuipi sungah ka khia ding a, amaute in note tungah hong bawlna hangin, a luanghawmte uh uih gawp ding hi. Topa in na lianpite bawl taktak zo hi.
"Lote aw, lau nawn kei un la, lungdamin kipakin om un. Topa in note adingin a lianpi hong bawlsak zo hi.
Ganhingte aw, lau nawn kei un; gamsung tengah lo no ta a, singkungte gah ta-in, theigah leh leenggah tampi om hi.
"Zion mite aw, kipak un la, Topa, na Pasian uh tungah lungdam un. Note in an na hauh theih nadingun, ni danga bangin khuapi guah, tuk guah leh phalbi guah, a hoih bek hong zusak hi.
Na ancilna phual uh an tawh kidim ding a, na koihna uh um-le-beel khempeuh, leenggahzu leh sathau tawh kidim ding hi.
Note a hong sim dingin ka hong sawl, kauphe honpi, a tuan kauphe, a susia kauphe, a pettan kauphe hih ka galkap honte' hong neksak kum sunga piang teng taang kong piakik ding hi.
"Tu-in nek ding tampi nei-in na gil uh vah ding a, note' adingin a lamdang nate a hong bawlsak, Topa na Pasian uh na phat ding uh hi. Tua ciangin ka mite hong kisimmawh nawn lo ding hi.
Tua ciangin, no Israel mite lakah kei ka omna thu, leh keimah Topa in note' Pasian ka hihna thu, kei sim loh kuamah dang a om lohna na thei ding uh hi. Ka mite hong kisimmawh kik ngei nawn lo ding hi.
"Tua khit ciangin mi khempeuh tungah ka Kha ka bua ding a, na tanute uh leh na tapate un kamsang ding uh a, na puteekte un mang manin, na tangvalte un maang mu ding uh hi.
Tua hun ciangin nasem numei leh nasem pasalte tung nangawn-ah, ka Kha ka bua ding hi.
"Tua ciangin vantung leh leitungah hilhkholhna lim ahi, sisan kiluan' sakna, meikatna, leh meikhu lompi hong om ding hi.
Topa' ni, tua a lauhuai hun hong tun' ma-in, ni hong mialin, kha, sisan hong bang ding hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' min tawh thu a ngen khempeuh in, gupkhiatna ngah ding uh hi. Topa' gensa mah bangin, Zion Mual leh Jerusalem khua sungah a suakta mi om ding uh hi. Topa in a sap mite suakta ding uh hi.
"Tua hun ciangin Judah leh Jerusalem, a nidang hun uh ka bangsak kik ding hi.
Minam khempeuhte kaikhawmin, Jehoshafat Kuam-ah ka paipih ding hi. Ka mihingte tungah a bawlnasa hangun, tua munah amaute thu ka khen ding hi. Amaute in Israel mite, gamdangah thehthang uh a, ka gamsung teng phelhawm uh hi.
"Tai-ar khua, Sidon khua, leh Filistia gam khempeuh aw, kei bang hong cih nuam-a kinei na hi uh hiam? Bang khat peuh hangin hong thukkik nuam-a kinei na hi uh hiam? Kei a hong thukkik na hih leh, kei zong manlang takin kong thukkik pah ding hi.
Ka ngun, ka kham, leh ka na manpha tampite la-in, na biakinn sung uhah na puak uh hi.
Judah leh Jerusalem mite, amau' gam panin gamlapi-ah paipihin, Grik mite tungah na zuak uh hi.
Tu-in amaute na zuakna uh mun, panin a la khia kik ding ka hi a, amaute tungah na bawl bangun note tungah kong bawl ding hi.
Na tanute uh leh na tapate uh, Judah mite tungah ka kizuaksak ding a, a gamlapi-a om Seba minamte tungah kizuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in gen khin zo hi," a ci hi.
Minamte tungah hih bangin thuzaksakna bawl in: Gal hang mite sam un la, gal do dingin kithawi un la, galkap khempeuh khawmin hong kuan un!
Lo khawhna tuute namsau-in seek un la, singhiang heuhna temkawite teipi-in seek un. A thanemte in "Ka tha a hat hi" ci ta uh hen.
Kiimkot-a om minamte khempeuh aw, manlangin hong kuan un la, tua kuam-ah hong kikaikhawm un. Topa aw, na galhangte hong paipih suk in.
Minamte hong kithawi hen la, Jehoshafat Kuam-ah hong kuansuk uh hen. Kiimkot-a om minam khempeuhte' thu khen dingin, Topa ahi keimah, tua munah ka tu ding hi.
Amaute gilo mahmah uh ahih manin, anlak huna buh at bangin at gawp un la, leenggahtui dawhna dim letin a luang leenggah cilna kuang sunga om leenggah bangin, tuancil gawp un.
Thukhenna Kuam-ah, a tul a thenin om uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh, tua lai munah Topa' ni hong tung baih ding hi.
Ni leh kha mial a, aksite zong taang nawn lo hi.
Zion Mual panin Topa hong hawk suk a, Jerusalem panin hong awngkeek a, vanpi leh leipi liing damdam hi. Ahi zongin Topa in, ama mite' belhpa hi a, Israel mite' munmuanhuai ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Israelte aw, ka mual siangtho Zion tungah a teeng keimah in, Topa, note' Pasian ka hihna na thei ding uh hi. Jerusalem in a siangtho biakna khuapi hi ding a, gamdang mite in zo kik ngei nawn lo ding uh hi.
Tua hun ciangin mual tung gam khempeuh leenggui lo hi ding a, mual neute khempeuh tungah bawng nawi luang ding a, Judah gam sung khempeuhah tui tampi om ding hi. Topa' biakinn panin lui tui khat hong luang khia ding a, Shittim kuam khempeuh kawtsak ding hi.
Amaute in Judah gam simin, mawhnei lo mite that uh ahih manin, Izipt gam in sehnel gam suakin, Edom gam in gamsia suak ding hi.
Topa in Amittai' tapa Jonah tungah,
"Kithawi in la, a lian mahmah Nineveh khuapi-ah va pai-in va thu hilh in; bang hang hiam cih leh amau' gitlohna thu ka za khin zo hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Topa kiangpan Jonah tai khia-in Tarshish khua lamah taisim dingin a kithawi zawsop hi. Joppa khua-ah a paisuk-a Tarshish khua a zuan ding teembaw khat a mu hi. A sap man pia-in a tungah kah a, Topa kiang pan taikhia dingin teembaw hawlte tawh Tarshish khua-ah a pai hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in tuipi tungah huih nakpi-in nung sak-a huihpi hat lua ahih manin teembaw a kisia dekdek hi.
Tua ciangin teembaw hawlte lau uh a, a pasian ciat uh kiangah a kiko ciat uh hi. Teembaw a zan' tuam nadingin a sung-a vante tuipi sungah a paai uh hi. Tua bang hi napi-in Jonah in teembaw sung a tawng lamah na lutsuk a, a na ihmu hithiat hi.
Teembaw ukpa in amah a muh ciangin, "Ihmu pa aw, bang na cihna hiam? Tho in la, na pasian kiangah thu ngen in! I sih loh nadingin amah in eite hong ngaihsun kha thei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin teembaw hawlte in, "Hong pai dih un. Kua' hangin hih gimna ei tungah hong tung hiam, cih i theih nadingin ai san dih ni," ci-in khat-le-khat a kikum uh hi. Ai a san uh leh Jonah tung a tu hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Kua hangin hih gimna ei tungah hong tung hiam, hong gen in. Na nasep bang hiam? Koi lai pan-a hong pai na hi hiam? Na gam bang hiam? Kua minam na hi hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Amah in, "Keimah in Hebru mi ka hi hi; tuipi leh leitung a bawl, vantungte' Pasian ahi Topa ka bia hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua mite a lau mahmah uh a, "Bang hangin hih bangin hih mawk na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa kiangpan amah a taikhia sim ahih lam a gen khit sa ahih manin a thei khin zo uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Ei adingin tuipi a hong daih theih nadingin nang bang kong cih ding uh hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh huihpi a lauhuai semsem hi.
Amah in, "Hong domto un la tuipi sungah hong khia un; tua hi leh no adingin tuipi a hong daai ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh hih huihpi na thuakna uh keima' hang ahi hi, cih ka thei hi," ci-in a dawng kik hi.
Tua bang a cih hangin amaute in teembaw khawl sak dingin hahkatin lei lamah a hot teeiteei uh hi. Ahih hangin a hih zo kei uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh huihpi a hat semsem hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Topa' kiangah kiko-in, "Topa aw, hih mipa ka sihsak manun kote hong sisak kei in la, mi that hi, ci-in hong ngawh kei ta in, ci-in kong thuum uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa aw, nangmah in pha na sak banga na bawl ahi hi," ci-in thu a ngen uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jonah dom to-in tuipi sungah a khiat uh leh tuipi a daai pah hi.
Tua ciangin tua mite in Topa a kihta mahmah uh a, Topa' tungah biakna pia-in thuciamna a bawl uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jonah a nawmvalh dingin Topa in ngapi khat a geelkholh sa hi a, tua ngapi' gil sungah Jonah sun thum leh zan thum sung a om hi.
Tua ciangin Jonah in tua ngapi gil sung panin Topa a Pasian' kiangah thu ngen a,
"Ka cihmawhna panin Topa ka sam a, amah in hong dawng hi; Sihna gam Sheol panin ka kiko-a, nangmah in ka aw nong za hi.
Nang in tuipi thuk sungah nong khia-a, tui in kei hong tumcip hi; na tuihualte khempeuh in kei hong tum hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, 'Na omna panin kei hong kihawl khia hi; na biakinn siangtho hong koici et kik thei ding ka hi hiam?' ka ci hi.
Tui in ka tungah hong tuamcip a, ka kimkot-ah hong umcih hi. Tuipi tunga lopate in ka lu hong vialcip hi.
Mualte' bul tuipi taw dong ka va pai suk a, kongkhak hong kikhak nelh tawntungna mun ka tun' hangin tua lei sung Hawmpi sung panin a nungta-in nong la to veve hi, Topa, ka Pasian aw,
Kei ka lung a kiat ciangin, Topa ka phawk a; ka thungetna, na biakinn siangtho sung, nangma kiang hong tung hi.
Kiman'na nei lo milim a biate in nangmah hong tai san uh hi.
Ahih hangin keimah in ka hih leh lungdamna aw tawh biakna kong pia ding hi; ka ciamsa ka tangtung sak ding hi. Gupkhiatna in Topa' aa ahi hi!" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in tua ngapi sawl a, amah in lei keu tungah Jonah a luakhia hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Jonah tungah a nih veina thu gen a,
"Kithawi in la, a lian mahmah Nineveh khuapi-ah va pai-in kong gen sa thu va tangko in," a ci hi.
Jonah zong kithawi pah-a Topa' cih bangin Nineveh khua-ah a pai hi. Nineveh khua pen khuapi lian mahmah khat hi a, nithum sung tak kikantan hi.
Jonah zong khua sung lam manawh-in kipan-a, nikhat sung lam a pai khit ciangin, "Ni sawmli khit ciangin Nineveh khuapi a kisusia ding hi," ci-in a kiko hi.
Nineveh khuamite in kisik kik-in Pasian a um uh a, antan' nading thu thang sakin, a golpen pana kipan a neupen dongin ippi puan a silh uh hi.
Nineveh khua kumpipa in tua thu a zak ciangin a kumpi tokhom tung pan ding khia-in, a kumpi puan suah khia-a, ippi puan silhin vut lakah a tu hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Nineveh khua sung khempeuh thu thang sak-in a tangko sak a, "Kumpipa leh uliante' thu tawh: Mihing ahi-a ganhing ahi zongin, bawng hon ahi-a tuu hon ahi zongin, bang mah ciam thei lo ding, an ne thei lo ding, tuidawn thei lo ding uh hi.
Mihing leh ganhingte in ippi puan silhin Pasian tungah nakpi-in kiko ta uh hen. Hi hi, mi khempeuh in a khialhnate uh leh a gitlohnate uh panin kihei ta uh hen.
Eite i sih loh nadingin Pasian kisik kik-in a hehna damsak lo ding hi, kua in ci thei na hi uh hiam?" a cisak hi.
Pasian in amau' hihnate mu a, a khialhnate uh panin a kihei uh a muh ciangin kisik kik a, amaute tungah hih dinga a cihsa siatna a tungsak nawn kei hi.
Ahih hangin tua thu hangin Jonah lungkim het loin a heh hi.
Topa' kiangah thungen a, "Kong ngen hi, Topa aw, ka gam sungah ka om lai pekin hi ci mah in teh, ci hilo ka hi hiam? Tarshish khua-ah hanciam-a ka tai simna zong tua hang mah ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in a hehpih thei Pasian, a heh hak, a migi mahmah, siatna tun' sak nading a kisik kik nuam Pasian na hihna kong thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa aw, tu-in ka nuntakna hong la in, ci-in kong thuum hi: bang hang hiam cih leh ka nuntak sangin si leng kei adingin a hoih zaw hi," a ci hi.
Topa in zong, "Na heh ding kilawm na sa hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin khuapi pua lamah Jonah paikhia-a nisuahna lamah tu-in tua lai-ah ama ading bukno khat a lam hi. Tua khuapi bang hong ci ding hiam, cih en dingin a liim nuai-ah tu-in a ngak hi.
Topa Pasian in zong Jonah a liah ding leh a lungkhamna a tawldamsak dingin umgui khat a tungah a zaamsak hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua umgui hangin Jonah a lungdam mahmah hi.
Ahih hangin a zingsang khuavak ciangin Pasian in tua umgui lungno khat nesak-a a keu hi.
Ni hong suah ciangin Pasian in nisuahna lam panin huih a sa mahmah nungsak a, ni in zong Jonah lu zang kapsuk veva ahih manin a gim mahmah hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Ka nuntak sangin si leng kei adingin a hoihzaw hi," ci-in a sih nading thu a ngen hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian in Jonah kiangah, "Tua umgui hangin na heh ding kilawm na sa hiam?" a ci hi. Jonah in, "Ka heh ding kilawm sa tham loin heh lua-in ka si zongin kilawm ka sa veve hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in, "Nang in na gimpih lohpi, na khan' sak lohpi, zan khat thu-a hong piang-a zan khat thu mah a, a si tua umgui pammaih na sa hi.
Tua ahih leh keimah in ganhing tampi thamlo, a taklam khut leh a veilam khut nangawn a khen thei nai lo naupang tulza leh tulsawmnih sanga tam zawte' teen'na, a lian mahmah Nineveh khuapi pammaih sa lo ding ka hi hiam?" ci-in a dawng kik hi.
Topa' nasem Moses a sih khit ciangin Topa in Moses' nasem ahi Nun' tapa Joshua kiangah,
"Ka nasempa Moses si ta hi; tua ahih ciangin tu-in ding in la, nang leh hih mite khempeuh, hih Jordan kantanin Israel mite tungah ka piak gam sungah pai un.
Moses tungah ka ciam bangin na khe in a totna mun khempeuh nang tungah kong pia ding hi.
Gamlak leh hih Lebanon panin gun lianpi ahi Eufrates gun dong, ni tumna lam-a Tuipi lian lam, Hit mite' leitang khempeuh nangma gam hi ding hi.
Na nuntak sung tawntung kuamah in na mai hong khak zo lo ding hi; Moses tawh ka om mah bangin nang tawh zong kong om ding hi; nang kong tamasak kei ding a, kong nusia kei ding hi.
Thahat in la hang in; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute piak dingin a pate uh tungah ka ciam leitang hih mite na luahsak ding hi.
Thahat-in hang in la, ka nasempa Moses in nang hong piak thukhamte khempeuh tawh kizui-in na gamtat ding lim takin ngaihsun in; na paina peuhah hoih takin na lamzan' theihna dingin tak lamah ahi a, vei lamah ahi zongin pial kei in.
Hih thukham laibu na mangngilh ngei kei ding hi. A sunga a kigelh thute khempeuh tawh kizui-in na gamtat theihna dingin sun leh zanin na lungngaingai ding hi; tua hi leh na lampi mavang ding a, na nasep tangtung ding hi.
Thu hong pia khin hilo ka hi hiam? Thahat in la hang in; lau kei in la, lungkia kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh na paina peuhpeuhah Topa na Pasian nang tawh hong om hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Joshua in mite' uliante thu pia-in,
"Giahphual-ah pai un la, mite thu pia-in, 'Na lam-an ding uh kiging khol un; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian un na neih dingun note hong piak leitangah pai-in a luah dingin ni thum sungin hih Jordan a galkah ding na hi uh hi,' ci un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Joshua in Reuben mite, Gad mite, leh Manasseh minam a langte tungah,
"Topa' nasem Moses in note thu hong piakna kammal, 'Topa na Pasian un note tawlngakna mun hong pia-in, hih leitang note hong pia ding hi,' a cihna thu phawk un.
Moses in Jordan gal khata note hong piak leitangah na zite, na taneute, leh na ganhingte uh a na om ding uh hi; ahih hangin note lakah galhang mi khempeuh in hiam tawi-in Jordan kantanin na sanggamte uh mai-ah pai-in,
note hong piak bangin Topa in na sanggamte uh tungah tawlngakna pia-in, Topa na Pasian un amaute a piak leitang amaute in zong a luah mateng na huh ding uh hi; tua ciangin note' neih leitangah ciah kikin, Topa' nasem Moses in Jordan gal ni suahna lamah note hong piak leitang na luah ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Amaute in Joshua dawngin, "Kote nong thupiak khempeuh ka hih ding uh a, nong sawlna peuhpeuhah ka pai ding uh hi.
Na khempeuhah Moses' thu ka man' uh mah bangin nangma thu zong kong mang ding uh hi. Moses a ompih mah bangin Topa na Pasian in nang hong ompih ta hen!
Na thupiakna leh na thute, na thupiak peuhpeuh hong langpangin a mang lo mipa kithat ding hi. Thahat in la hang in," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Nun tapa Joshua in Shittim panin thukanin mi nih sawl sim a, "Pai-in gam va en un la, a diakdiakin Jerikho khua hong en un," a ci hi. Amaute pai uh a, Rahab min nei a paktat numei khat' innah tungin giak uh hi.
Jerikho kumpipa tungah, "En in, gamsung en dingin Israel mi pawlkhat tu nitakin hih lai-ah hong tung zo hi," ci-in kigen hi.
Tua ciangin Jerikho kumpipa in Rahab kiangah mi sawlin, "Na inn sunga hong tum, na kianga hong tung mite hong pai khiatpih in; bang hang hiam cih leh gam khempeuh a en dingin amaute hong pai uh hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin tua numei in mi nihte la-in na seel khin hi; tua ciangin amah in, "Hi mah hi, ka kiangah mi hong pai uh hi; ahih hangin amaute koi pan hong pai hiam cih ka thei kei hi;
kulh kongpi a kikhak ding khuamial ciangin tua mite paikhia uh hi; tua mite koi-ah pai uh hiam ka thei kei hi; manlangin amaute delh un; na pha kha ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in innkhum zangah tua mite paipih to-in innkhum zangah a koih ngei bangin a koihsa anthul kungte lakah amaute seel khin hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mite in Jordan lamah ngahmun dong delh uh hi; a delhte a paikhiat phetin kulh kongpi kikhak hi.
Amaute a lup ma-in innkhumzang amaute kiangah amah paito a,
tua mite kiangah, "Topa in note tungah hih leitang hong piak khitna ka thei a, note hong kikihtakna kote tungah hong tungin, hih gam sunga a teeng mi khempeuh note mai-ah lunggim uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Izipt panin nong paikhiat lai-un Topa in note mai-ah San Tuipi tui a kan'sakna, leh Jordan gal khata om na suksiat mang uh Amor mite' kumpi nihte ahi Sihon leh Og tungah na bawlna uh ka za khin uh hi.
Tua thu ka zak phetun lungsim kitam zanin, ka lungsim uh bei a, note' hangin mite' lungsimah han'na bei hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian un tunga om vantung leh nuai-a om leitungah Pasian ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in note tungah kong dik gamtat bangin note in zong ko' innkuan-ah nong dik gamtat nading uh Topa min tawh kei tungah hong kiciam un la, a man taktak lim khat kei hong pia-in,
ka nu leh ka pa, ka sanggamnute, ka sanggampate, leh amaute tawh a kizomte khempeuh hong hon un la, sihna panin kote hong suakta sak un," a ci hi.
Mite in ama tungah, "Nang' tangin kote ka si ngam uh hi. Hih ko thu na genkhiat kei nak leh Topa in kote tungah hih leitang hong piak ciangin nang tungah dikna leh thumanna tawh kong gamta ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in kongvangneu panin khau khat tawh amaute khaisuk hi, bang hang hiam cih leh khuapi kulh sunglam pangah ama inn kilam a, khuapi kulh sungah amah teeng hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, "Mual tungah pai un, hong delhte tawh na kituak kha ding uh hi; hong delhte hong ciahkik mateng nithum sung tua lai-ah bu un; tua khit ciangin na pai nading uh ah na pai thei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Mite in ama kiangah, "Kote nong kiciam sak thuciamna thu tawh kisai-in ka paubaang kei ding uh hi.
En in, hih leitangah kong pai uh ciangin kote nong khai sukna hih kongvangneu-ah hih khauhual san na khih ding hi; na inn sungah na nu leh na pa, na sanggampate leh na pa innkuanpihte khempeuh na khawm ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh na inn kong panin kongzing lampi-ah a paikhiat leh ama sihna in ama khialhna hang hi ding hi, kote ka siang ding uh hi; ahih hangin inn sungah nang tawh a om mi khatpeuh a kisukkhak leh, ama sihna in kote' khialhna hi ding hi.
Ahih hangin hih ko thute na gen khiat leh, kote nong kiciam sak thuciamna tawh kisai-in kote ka siang ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Na thugen bangun hi ta hen," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in amaute sawl khia a, amaute paikhia uh hi; amah in a khauhual san a kongvangneu-ah khih hi.
Amaute paikhia-in, mual tungah pai uh a, a delhte a ciahkik mateng nithum sung om uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a delhte in lam dung khempeuh zongin bangmah mu lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin mualtung panin mi nihte paisuk kik uh a, galkahin Nun tapa Joshua kiangah tung uh hi; amau tunga thupiang khempeuh ama tungah gen uh hi.
Amaute in Joshua kiangah, "Topa in leitang khempeuh eite khut sungah hong pia taktak hi; tua tham loin tua gam-a teeng mite khempeuh eite hangin lungmang uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Zingsang tungin Joshua tho-in Israel mite khempeuh tawh Shittim panin ding khia uh hi; amaute Jordan gun tung uh a, a galkah ma-un tua munah giak uh hi.
Nithum a cin'ni ciangin giahphualah uliante pai uh a,
mite thu pia-in, "Topa na Pasian uh thuciamna singkuang Levi mi siampite in a puak na muh uh ciangin na omna mun panun ding khia-in na zui ding uh hi,
hih lamah pai ngei lo na hih manun na pai nading uh lampi tu-a bangin na thei ding uh hi. Ahi zongin note leh tua thuciamna singkuang kikalah mun awng, tong tulnih bang kihalna om ding hi; a gei-ah pai kei-un," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Joshua in mite kiangah, "Nomau mah kisiangsak tawm un; bang hang hiam cih leh zing ciangin note lakah Topa in nalamdangte hong bawl ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Joshua in siampite kiangah, "Thuciamna singkuang la un la, mite mai-ah paisuak un," a ci hi. Amaute in thuciamna singkuang la uh a, mite mai-ah pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Joshua kiangah, "Moses tawh ka omkhawm bangin nang tawh kong omkhawm nading thu amaute in a theih nadingun Israel mite khempeuh muhna-ah tu ni-in nang liatsak ding ka kipan ding hi.
Thuciamna singkuang a pua siampite thu na pia ding a, 'Jordan tuite gei na tun' uh ciangin Jordan sungah taang loin na ding ding uh hi,' na ci ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Joshua in Israel mite kiangah, "Hih lai-ah hong pai un la, Topa na Pasian uh thute za un," a ci hi.
