"Na leitang tung panun an na lak uh ciangin, na lo uh a nawl dongin an na la kei ding uh a, an na lak khit uh ciangin a sang zong na khawm kei ding uh hi.
Note in na leenggui lo uh hawk mai loin, a kia leenggahte zong na leenggui lo panun na tawm kei ding uh hi; note in mi zawngte leh peemtate adingin tuate na nusia ding uh hi; keimah in Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi.
"Note na guta kei ding uh hi; khat leh khat na kikhem kei ding uh a, khat leh khat tungah thuzuau na kigen kei ding uh hi.
Note in a man lopi-in keima min tawh na kiciam kei ding uh a, tua bangin na Pasian uh' min na daisak kei ding uh hi: keimah in Topa ka hi hi.
"Note in na vengte uh na nengniam kei ding uh a, a na na sut kei ding uh hi. A kicial nasempa' thaman pen a zingsang dong zan tawntung na kemcip kei ding uh hi.
Note in bil ngongte phuisam loin mittawte mai-ah puk theih nading na koih kei ding uh a, note in na Pasian uh na zaktak ding uh hi: keimah in Topa ka hi hi.
"Note in thukhenna ah thuman lo na hih kei ding uh hi; note in mizawngte langgen loin, a liante thu zui loin, thumanna tawh na vengte thu na khen ding uh hi.
Note in na mihingte lak uhah mi gensia-in vaksuk vakto loin, na vengpa uh a sih nadingin na langpang kei ding uh hi: keimah in Topa ka hi hi.
"Note in na lungsim sung uhah na sanggampa uh mudah loin, na vengte uh tawh na thu kituah lohna uh kikum khawmin na siangsak ding uh hi; tua hi kei leh ama hangin khialhna na pua ding uh hi.
Note in nomau' mipihte tungah phu la loin, amau na lungsim neih kei ding uh a, nomau na ki-it uh bangin na vengte na it ding uh hi: keimah in Topa ka hi hi.
"Note in ka thukhamte na zui ding uh hi. Note in na ganhingte uh a namdang tawh ta na neisak kei ding uh hi; note in na lo uhah khaici nam nih na pawi kei ding uh hi; khau nam nih a kigan puan zong note tungah kibaang lo ding hi.
"Sila ahi numei, midang khat in zuthawl a piaksa, kitankhia nai loin amah suahtakna a kipia nai lo nu, pasal khat in a lup khoppih leh, thukanna kinei ding hi. Amaute kithat lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua nu suakta lo hi;
ahih hangin tua pa in amahmah adingin mawhna hanga biak nadingin tuutal khat, kikhopna buk kong, Topa kiangah hong paipih ding hi.
Siampipa in tuapa a gamtatnasa a khialhna hangin mawhna hanga biakna tuutal tawh Topa mai-ah ama adingin kilemna bawlsak ding hi; amah a gamtatnasa a khialhna kimaisak ding hi.
"Note tua gamah tungin an dingin kung nam khempeuh na suan uh ciangin, note in amau' gahte a kikham-in na seh ding uh hi; note adingin kum thum sung tua gah a kikham hi ding a, kine lo ding hi.
A kum lina ciangin amau' gah khempeuh siangtho-in, Topa tungah phatna biakna hi ding hi.
Ahih hangin a kum ngana ciangin tuate in note adingin hong gah semsem nadingin tuate gah na ne thei ding uh hi: keimah in Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi.
"Note in sa khatpeuh peuh a sunga sisan tawh na ne khawm kei ding uh hi. Note in mai lam thu genkholhna ahih kei leh ai saanna na sem kei ding uh hi.
Note in na baa samte uh met loin na khamul mongte uh zong na tan kei ding uh hi.
Note in a site' hangin na ci tung uh liamsak loin note tungah ciamtehna khatpeuh peuh na sun kei ding uh hi: keimah in Topa ka hi hi.
"Na tanu uh biakinn sunga paktat dinga piakna tawh siasak kei un; tua bang hi leh pasian dangte biakna sungah na tung ding uh a, gam sung khempeuh, mawhna tawh a kidim suak kha ding hi.
Note in ka sabbath-te tangin ka biakinn na zahtak ding uh hi: keimah in Topa ka hi hi.
"Vankahte leh ai saante lamah kihei kei un; amaute tawh a kininsak dingin amaute zong kei un: keimah in Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi.
"Note in sam kangte mai-ah na kun ding uh a, puteekpa' maitang zahtak-in note in na Pasian uh na kihta ding uh hi: keimah in Topa ka hi hi.
"Na gam sung uhah note lakah khualmi khat hong peem leh, note in ama tungah a man loin na gamta kei ding uh hi.
Note lakah a hong peem khual mite tual sung mi mah bangin na ngaihsun ding uh a, nomau mah bangin amah na it ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh note in Izipt gam sungah khualmi na hi ngei uh hi: keimah in Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi.
"Note in thukhenna, asau tehna, agik tehna, atam tehnate ah a man loin na gamta kei ding uh hi.
Note in tawi khaina maan, tawisuang maan, seu maan, bung maan, na nei ding uh hi: keimah in Izipt gam panin a hong paikhiatpih Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi.
Note in ka thukhamte khempeuh leh ka biakna ngeina kipte khempeuh zui-in tuate na kem ding uh hi: keimah in Topa ka hi hi," a ci hi.
"Israel mite kiangah hih bangin gen in: Israel mite khatpeuh peuh hita leh Israel sunga a peem khual mite hita leh, a tate khatpeuh peuh Molek pasian tungah a pia mipa kithat ding hi; gam sung mite in suang tawh amah deenglum ding uh hi.
Keimah mah in tua mipa ka maisiat ding a, ama mite lak panin ka hawlkhia ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a tate Molek tungah pia-in, ka biakinn ninsakin, ka min siangtho daisak hi.
Amah in Molek tungah a tate khat a piak ciangin gam sung mite in tuapa kimuhmawh bawlin amah a thah kei uh leh,
keimah in tua mipa leh ama innkuanpihte maisiatin, amah leh Molek biakna ah amah a zuite khempeuh amau' mite lak panin ka hawlkhia ding hi.
"Mi khat vankahna leh ai saanna lamah kihei-in tuate thu a dot leh, keimah in tua mipa ka maisiat ding a, ama mite lak panin amah ka hawlkhia ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note ki-ap un la, siangtho un; bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi.
Ka thukhamte zui un la, tuate sem un; note hong siangthosak Topa in keimah ka hi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a nu ahih kei leh a pa a samsia mi peuhmah kithat ding hi; amah in a nu ahih kei leh a pa samsia khin a, ama sihna ah amahmah ngawh ding ahi hi.
"Pasal khat in ama vengpa' zi tawh a mawh leh, tua a khialpa leh a khialnu kithat khawm ding hi.
A pa' zi tawh a lumkhawm mipa in a pa a mindaisak suak hi; amau tegel kithat ding hi, amau' sihna amau mah ngawh ding ahi hi.
Pasal khat a monu tawh a lupkhop leh, amau tegel kithat ding hi; amaute si kinai lua mi tawh khialhna bawl uh hi; amau' sihna amau mah ngawh ding ahi hi.
Pasal khat in numei khat tawh lupkhop bangin pasal dang khat tawh a lupkhop leh, amau tegel kihhuaina a gamta khin uh ahi hi; amaute kithat ding hi, amau' sihna amau mah ngawh ding ahi hi.
Pasal khat in zi la-in a zi' nu tawh zong a lak thuah leh, tua in gitlohna ahi hi; note lakah gitlohna a om loh nadingin tuapa leh a nutate, mei tawh kihallum ding hi.
Pasal khat in ganhing khat tawh a mawh leh, amah kithat ding hi; note in a ganhing na that ding uh hi.
Numei khat in ganhing khat naih-in tua tawh a mawh leh, note in a numei leh a ganhing na that ding uh hi; amaute kithat ding hi, amau' sihna amau mah ngawh ding ahi hi.
"Pasal khat in ama sanggamnu, a pa' tanu ahih kei leh a nu' tanu la-in, tua nu tawh mawhin, tua nu in tuapa tawh a mawh leh, tua in a zumhuai hi a, amau' mipihte' omna panin amaute kihawlkhia ding hi; tuapa in ama sanggamnu tawh mawh khin hi, tuapa in ama mawhna pua ding hi.
Pasal khat in nin nei numei khat tawh lumkhawmin, tua nu tawh a mawh leh, amau tegel in sian'tho nading ngeina palsat uh ahih manin, amau' mipihte lak panin kihawlkhia ding hi.
Note in na nu' sanggamnu ahih kei leh na pa' sanggamnu tawh na mawh kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua in a nai behte tawh mawhna ahi hi; amaute in amau' mawhna pua ding hi.
Pasal khat in a pa' sanggampa' zi tawh a lupkhop leh, amah in a pa' sanggampa a mindaisak ahi hi; amaute in amau khialhna thuak ding uh hi; amaute ta nei loin si ding uh hi.
Pasal khat in a sanggampa' zi a lak leh, tua in nitna ahi hi; amah in a sanggampa a mindaisak ahi hi; amaute in ta nei lo ding uh hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin note in ka thukham khempeuh leh ka biakna ngeina kipte khempeuh zui-in, tuate na sem ding uh hi; tua in note na ten' nading uh kong paipih nading leitang in note hong luakkhiat loh nading ahi hi.
Note' mai-ah keimah in ka paihkhiat ding minamte' ngeinate na zui kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in hih nate khempeuh gamta uh ahih ciangin amaute ka kih hi.
Ahih hangin keimah in note tungah, 'Note in amau leitang na luah ding uh hi; bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luan'na leitang, na neih dingun note' tungah kong pia ding hi,' kong ci khin zo hi. Keimah in mite kiang panin note a hong khenkhia Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi.
Tua ciangin note in a siang ganhing leh a nin ganhing, a nin vasa leh a siang khentelna na bawl ding uh hi; note in nin hi ci-in na seh dingun keimah in ka tuam koihsa ahi ganhing hita leh vasa hita leh leitunga a pai thei khatpeuh peuh tawh hita leh note a kihhuai-in na kibawl kei ding uh hi.
Note in keima adingin na siangtho ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa ahi keimah in ka siangtho a, note in keima' aa na hih theih nadingun mite kiang panin note kong tuamkoih zo hi.
"Pasal ahi a, numei ahi zongin van a kah a, ai a saan mi kithat ding hi; suang tawh amaute kidenglum ding hi; amau' sihna amau mah ngawh ding ahi hi," a ci hi.
"Aaron' tapa siampite tungah thu gen in la, amaute lak panin kuamah in ama beh nai pen ahi, a nu, a pa, a tapa, a tanu, a sanggampa,
ahih kei leh nungak ahi a sanggamnu (tua nu in pasal nei nai lo ahih manin amah tawh a kinai ahi hi; tua nu' hangin amah kininsak thei ding hi) longal ama mite lakah misite' hangin kininsak lo ding hi.
Amah in pasal neisa numei khatpeuh hangin ama mite lakah va kininsakin, tua bangin kidaisak lo ding hi.
Amaute in a lu uh mettol loin, amau' khamul nawlhui zong kiat loin, a ci tung uh liamsak lo ding uh hi.
Amaute in amau' Pasian adingin siangtho ding uh a, amau' Pasian min daisak lo ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in amau' Pasian anlum ahi, Topa' tungah meihal biakna pia uh hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute siangtho ding uh hi.
Amaute in numei paktat ahih kei leh a kininsaksa numei ten'pih lo ding uh hi; a pasal in a maksa numei zong ten'pih lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh siampipa in ama Pasian adingin siangtho hi.
Amah in note' Pasian' anlum pia ahih manin note in amah na ap ding uh hi; amah in note' adingin siangtho ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa ahi keimah, note hong siangtho sakpa, ka siangtho hi.
Siampi khatpeuh peuh' tanu in paktatna tawh amah leh amah a kidaisak leh, ama pa a daisak ahi hi; tua nu, mei tawh kihal lum ding hi.
"Ama sanggamte lakah a lianpen, a lu tungah nilh sathau a kisun'napa leh a puante silh dingin a ki-ap khin siampipa in a samte phiahsak loin, a puante zong balkek lo ding hi;
amah in a nu leh a pa luang nangawn ahi zongin si luang khatpeuh peuh kiangah pai loin, amahmah zong kininsak lo ding hi;
biakinn panin zong pai khia loin, ama Pasian' biakinn zong daisak lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ama Pasian' aa ahi ki-apna nilh sathau in ama tungah om hi; keimah in Topa ka hi hi.
Amah in a zi dingin nungak la ding hi.
Meigong numei, a kimasa numei, a kininsaksa numei, numei paktat, amah in hih bangte ten'pih lo ding hi; ahih hangin amah in ama mite lak panin nungak khat zi-in la ding hi;
tua in ama mite lakah a tate a daisak loh nading ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah a siangthosakpa in keimah Topa ka hi hi, ci in," a ci hi.
Topa in Moses tungah,
"Aaron kiangah hih bangin gen in: Na suan leh khakte sung panin a khang a khangin poina a nei mi in ama Pasian' anlum pia dingin hong neh thei lo ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh poina a nei, mittaw, khelbai, mai hem leh khut-leh-khe sau lua,
khut hoih lo, khe hoih lo,
siampi Aaron' suan leh khakte sung panin poina a nei mi khatpeuh in Topa ading meihal biakna a pia dingin a nai-ah hong pai lo ding hi; amah in poina nei ahih manin, ama Pasian' anlum pia dingin a nai-ah hong pai lo ding hi.
Amah in ama Pasian' anlum, a siangtho pen leh a siangtho nate ne thei ding hi;
ahih hangin amah in poina nei ahih manin, ka biakinnte a daisak loh nadingin dalna puan gei ahi a biakna tau nai-ah ahi zongin hong pai lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute a siangthosakpa in keimah Topa ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses in Aaron leh a tapate leh Israel mite khempeuh tungah a gen hi.
"Aaron leh a tapate in keima min siangtho a daisak loh nadingun amaute in keima tungah a hong ap uh ahi, Israel mite' na a siangthote panin a kikep nadingun gen in; keimah in Topa ka hi hi.
Amaute kiangah, 'Na suan leh khakte uh sung panin a khang a khangin khatpeuh in a nit lai takin Israel mite in Topa tungah a ap a siangtho nate a naih leh, keima omna panin tuapa kihawlkhia ding hi: keimah in Topa ka hi hi.
Aaron' gui sung panin meima leh a na tui a paikhia mi peuhmah in amah a sian'tho mateng a siangtho nate ne thei lo ding hi. Misi lawn'na hita leh a na tui a tehpa lawn'na hita leh a nin na khatpeuh peuh a lawngpa,
amah a nit theih nadingin a bokvak ganhing khat hita leh nitna a ngah theih nading mi khat hita leh a lawngpa, ama nitna in bangbang hita leh—
tua bang na a lawng mipa pen a nitak mateng a nin hi ding a, amah in tui sungah a pumpi a sil kei leh a siangtho nate ne lo ding hi.
Ni a tum ciangin amah siang ding hi: tua khit ciangin amah in a siangtho nate ne thei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua bangte pen ama nek ding mah ahi hi.
A mawk sihte hita leh gamsate in a balgawpte hita leh amah in ne-in tua tawh amah kininsak lo ding hi`: keimah in Topa ka hi hi,' ci in.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in ka thuhilhna zui ding uh hi; tua hi kei leh amaute in tua thu a daisak uh ciangin khialhna thuakin sihpih ding uh hi: amaute a siangthosakpa in keimah Topa ka hi hi.
"A pua lam mi in a siangtho na ne lo ding hi. Siampipa' innah a om peemta ahi a kicial nasemte ahi zongin a siangtho na ne lo ding hi;
ahih hangin siampi khat in ama adingin sum tawh sila khat a lei leh, tua a sila in ne thei ding hi; ama inn sunga a suak mite in ama an ne thei ding uh hi.
Siampipa' tanu khat in a pualam mi khat tawh a kiten' leh tua nu in a siangtho biakna nate ne thei lo ding hi.
Ahih hangin siampipa' tanu pen meigong ahi a, a kima ahi zongin, ta nei loin, a nungak lai mah bangin a pa' innah a ciahkik leh, tua nu in a pa' an ne thei ding hi; ahi zongin a pualam mi kuamah in tua an ne thei lo ding hi.
Mi khat in theih lohna hangin a siangtho na khat a nek leh, tua a na man zah sehnga suah sehkhat behlapin, siampipa tungah a siangtho na pia ding hi.
Israel mite in Topa' tungah a piak ahi, amaute' na siangthote pen siampite in ninsak lo ding uh a,
tua bangin amau' na a siangthote nekna tawh mawhna leh khialhna amaute pua sak lo ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in amaute a siangthosak Topa ka hi hi," a ci hi.
"Aaron leh a tapate leh Israel mi khempeuh tungah hih bangin gen in: Israel mite sung panin ahi zongin Israel sungah a peem mite lak pan ahi zongin mi khatpeuh in biakna a piak ciangin, thuciamna a tun'sakna hita leh meihal biakna-in Topa tungah a kipia ut thu-a biakna hita leh,
hong kisan' theih nadingin bawngtal hita leh tuu hita leh keel hita leh, a sitbang lo apa khat na pia ding uh hi.
Note in a sitbang khatpeuh peuh na pia kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh hong kisang zo lo ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh in bawnghon panin ahi zongin a tuu leh keel hon panin ahi zongin thuciamna tun'sak nading hita leh ut thu-a biakna-in hita leh Topa tungah thunuam-a biakna a piak ciangin, a kisan' theih nadingin a ganhing a cidam hi ding hi; ama tungah sitban'na om lo ding hi.
Ganhing a mittaw, a gamtang theilo, ahem, meima nai a nei, cithak ahih kei leh meima a neite pen, note in Topa tungah pia loin, Topa tungah mei tawh kihal biakna-in biakna tau tungah tuate na zang kei ding uh hi.
Bawngtal hita leh tuuno hita leh a na khatpeuh a saulua ahih kei leh a tom luate pen note in ut thu-a biakna-in na pia thei ding uh hi; ahih hangin thuciamna biak nadingin kisang zo lo hi.
A ciltangte a sanim, a kisukham, a kikeek ahih kei leh a ki-at ganhing khatpeuh peuh, note in Topa tungah pia loin, na gam sung uhah biakna-in na zang kei ding uh hi;
gamdang mite khatpeuh peuh tung pana kingah tua ci bang ganhingte zong na Pasian uh' adingin note in na pia kei ding uh hi. Amaute sitbang a, hem ahih manin tuate hong kisang zo lo ding hi," a ci hi.
"Bawng ahih kei leh tuu ahih kei leh keel khat a suah ciangin a pi tawh ni sagih sung omkhawm ding hi; a ni giat ni-a kipanin tua ganno pen Topa' tungah mei tawh kihal biakna-in kisang thei ding hi.
A pi pen bawng hita leh tuu hita leh, note in a pi leh a no ni khat sungin na gokhawm kei ding uh hi.
Note in Topa tungah lungdam koh biakna na piak uh ciangin, note hong kisan' theih nadingin na pia ding uh hi.
A tua ni mahin kine ding a, note in a zingsang dong siit na nei kei ding uh hi: keimah in Topa ka hi hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin note in ka thupiaknate zui-in tuate na sem ding uh hi: keimah in Topa ka hi hi.
Note in keima min siangtho na daisak kei ding uh hi; Israel mite lakah kei hong kisiangthosak ding hi; keimah in note a hong siangthosak Topa,
note' Pasian ahi dingin Izipt gam panin note a hong paikhiatpihpa ka hi hi: keimah in Topa ka hi hi," a ci hi.
"Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Note in a siangtho biak kikhopnate hi ci-a na gen ding uh a kiseh Topa' pawi ahi a kiseh keima pawite in hihte ahi hi.
Ni guk sungin nasep kizo ding hi; ahih hangin a ni sagih ni in a thupi tawlngakna sabbath, a siangtho kikhopna ahi hi; note in tua ni-in na na sem kei ding uh hi; tua in note' ten'na khempeuh ah Topa' adingin sabbath ahi hi.
"Hihte in amaute adingin a kiseh hunin note in na gen ding uh ahi Topa' pawi a kisehte a siangtho biak kikhopnate ahi hi.
A kha masa, tua kha ni sawm-le-li ni ni takin Topa' Paisan Pawi ahi hi.
Tua kha mah a ni sawm-le-nga ni in Topa tungah silngo sawhloh anlum pawi ahi hi; ni sagih sung note in silngo sawh loh anlum na ne ding uh hi.
A ni masa ni-in note in a siangtho kikhopna khat na nei ding uh hi; note in thatang nasep na sem kei ding uh hi;
Ahih hangin note in Topa tungah meihal biakna ni sagih sung na pia ding uh hi; a ni sagih ni in a siangtho kikhopna khat ahi hi; note in thatang nasep na sem kei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
"Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Note tungah ka hong piak leitangah note tungin an na lak uh ciangin, note in na anpal lakte uh lom khat siampipa kiangah na paipih ding uh hi;
note hong kisan'theih nadingin amah in Topa mai-ah anlom veii ding hi; a zing ciang sabbath khit ciangin siampipa in tua anlom veii ding hi.
Note in anlom na veii ni-un, Topa tungah meihal biakna-in a sitbang lo kum khat a pha tuuno a pa khat na pia ding uh hi.
Tua tawh a kipia khawm ding an tawh biakna in sathau tawh a kibawl annel seu seh sawmsuah seh nih hi ding a, a gim namtui dingin Topa tungah meihal biakna-in kipia ding hi; tua tawh a kipiakhawm ding leenggahzu tawh biakna in leenggahzu thawl khat hi ding hi.
Note in na Pasian uh biakna na paipih ma, hih ni matengin anlum hita leh a ki-em an hita leh a sial hita leh na ne kei ding uh hi; tua in note' khang tawntungin na ten'na khempeuh uhah thukham khat hi tawntung hi.
"Note in a zing ciang sabbath khit ciang, veii-a biakna anlom na paipih ni uh a, kipan ni na sim to ding uh hi; nipi kal sagih bit hi ding hi;
a sabbath sagihna khit a zing ciang dong ni sawmnga na sim ding uh hi; tua ciangin note in an thak ahi an tawh biakna Topa tungah na paipih ding uh hi.
Note in na ten'na uh panin veii dingin seu seh sawmsuah seh nih a kibawl anlum lum nih nong paipih ding uh hi; tuate in annel kibawl, silngo sawh a, ki-em, Topa tungah anpal a, a kipia hi ding hi.
Note in anlum tawh a sitbang lo kum khat a pha tuuno sagih, leh bawngtalno khat, leh tuutal nih na pia ding uh hi; tuate Topa tungah a gim namtui mei tawh kihal biak nadingin an tawh biakna leh leenggahzu tawh biaknate tawh Topa tungah meihal biakna hi ding hi.
Note in khialhna hanga biakna-in keel a pa khat leh thunuam-a biakpiakna-in kum khat a pha tuuno a pa nih na pia ding uh hi.
Siampipa in Topa mai-ah veii-a biakna-in anpal anlum leh tuuno nih tawh tuate veii ding hi; tuate in siampipa adingin Topa mai-ah a siangtho hi ding hi.
Note in tua ni mahin genthangna na bawl ding uh hi; note in a siangtho kikhop khat na nei ding uh hi; note in thatang nasep na sem kei ding uh hi; tua in note ten'na khempeuh ah na khang tawntungun thukham khat hi tawntung hi.
"Note in na leitang panun an na lak uh ciangin, na lo nawl dongun la loin, na an lak khit uh ciangin a sangte zong na khawm kei ding uh hi; note in mizawngte leh khualmi adingin tuate na nusia ding uh hi: keimah in Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi," a ci hi.
"Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: A kha sagihna, tua kha a ni masa ni-in note in thupi tawlngakna ni khat, peengkul tumna tawh a kibawl phawkna, a siangtho kikhopna khat na nei ding uh hi.
Note in thatang nasep na sem kei ding uh hi; Note in Topa' tungah meihal biakna na paipih ding uh hi," a ci hi.
"Hih a kha sagihna ni sawm ni in kilemna ni ahi hi; tua in note' adingin a siangtho kikhopna hun hi ding a, note kigawt tawmin Topa' tungah meihal biakna na pia ding uh hi.
Note in tua ni-in na na sem kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua in Topa note Pasian' mai-ah note adingin kilemna bawl nadingin kilemna bawl ni ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh tua ni-in amahmah a kigawt tawm lo peuhmah ama mite kiang panin kihawlkhia ding hi.
Tua ni-in na khatpeuh peuh a sem mi peuhmah keimah in ama mite lak panin ka susia ding hi.
Note in na na sem kei ding uh hi; tua in na khang tawntungun na ten'na khempeuh uhah thukham khat hi tawntung ding hi.
Tua in note adingin thupi tawlngakna sabbath khat hi ding a, nomau mah na kigawt tawm ding uh hi; tua kha ni kua ni a nitak akipan, a nitak panin a nitak kik dong note in na sabbath uh na tang ding uh hi," a ci hi.
"Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Hih kha sagihna a ni sawm-le-nga ni akipan ni sagih sung in Topa ading buk pawi ahi hi.
A ni masa ni-in a siangtho kikhopna khat hi ding hi; note in thatang nasep na sem kei ding uh hi.
Ni sagih sung note in Topa tungah meihal biakna na pia ding uh hi; a ni giat ni-in note in a siangtho kikhopna khat nei-in Topa' tungah meihal biakna na pia ding uh hi; tua in a thupi kikhopna khat ahi hi; note in thatang nasep na sem kei ding uh hi.
"Hihte in Topa tungah mei tawh kihal biakna, meihal biakna leh an tawh biakna, biakpiakna leh leenggahzu tawh biaknate, amau' ni ciatin piak dingin a siangtho kikhopna hunin na gen ding uh, Topa' pawi a kisehte ahi hi;
note in Topa tungah na piak uh Topa' Sabbath-te, note' letsongte, thuciamna na biaknate khempeuh uh leh ut thu-a na biaknate khempeuh uh banah piak ding ahi hi.
"Note in leitanga piangte na kaihkhop khit uh, kha sagihna a ni sawm-le-nga ni akipan ni sagih sung Topa' pawi na bawl ding uh hi; a ni masa ni in a thupi tawlngakna khat hi a, a ni giat ni zong a thupi tawlngakna khat mah hi ding hi.
Note in a ni masa ni-in singkung hoih gahte, nisuh hiangte, a teh tam singhiang paipite, leh lui-a gialhekte na la ding uh hi; Topa na Pasian uh mai-ah ni sagih sung note na lungdam ding uh hi.
Note in tua pen kum simin ni sagih sung pawi-in na nei ding uh hi; tua in note' khang tawntungin thukham khat hi tawntung ding hi; note in kha sagihna sungah na bawl ding uh hi.
Note in ni sagih sung buk sungah na teeng ding uh hi; Israelte lakah tualsung mi khempeuh buk sungah teeng ding hi;
tua pen keimah in Izipt gam panin amaute ka paikhiapih lai-in Israel mite buk sungah ka teen'sakna thu note suan leh khakte in a theih nading ahi hi; keimah in Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua bangin Moses in Israel mite tungah Topa' pawi a kisehte a gen hi.
"Meivak khat a tawntungin a kivak suak theih nadingin meivak adingin oliv gah a kisuzante panin sathau siangtho nang kiangah hong paipih nading uh Israel mite thu pia in.
Kikhopna buk sung, tecipan'na dalna puan pua lamah, Aaron in nitak-a kipanin zingsang dongin Topa mai-ah a tawntungin tua meivak a ngeina bangin koih ding hi; tua in na khang khangun thukham khat hi tawntung ding hi.
Amah in kham citak meivak khuam tungah meivakte a ngeina bangin Topa mai-ah om sak tawntung ding hi.
"Nangmah in annel la in la, tua panin moh sawm-le-nih bawlin em in; moh khat ciangin annel seu seh sawmsuah seh nih hi ding hi.
Nangmah in kham citak sabuai tungah tuate gual nih-in na koih ding a, gual khatah guk om ding hi.
Phawkna-in Topa tungah mei tawh biakna-in piak dingin anlum tawh a paikhawm theih nadingin nangmah in a gual nihte-ah paknamtui siangtho na koih ding hi.
Sabbath ni simin Aaron in a tawntunga thuciamna-in Israel mite tangin Topa mai-ah a ngeina bangin koih tawntung ding hi.
Tua in Topa tungah mei tawh kihal biakna sung panin amah in a tawntunga a ngah ding a siangtho pen ama kaih ahih manin, Aaron leh ama suante ading hi a, amaute in a siangtho mun khatah ne ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tu-in Israel mite khat' tapa, a pa Izipt mi ahi khat, Israel mite lakah paikhia hi; Israel numei' tapa leh Israel mi khat giahphual ah kitawng uh a,
Israel numei' tapa in Min Siangtho gensia-in samsia hi. Amaute in Moses kiangah amah paipih uh hi. Ama nu' min in Shelomith hi a, Dan minam, Dibri' tanu ahi hi.
Topa' deihna amaute tungah a kigen mateng amaute in tua mipa khumcip uh hi.
"A samsia mipa pen giahphual pua lamah paipih in; ama samsiat a za mi khempeuh ama lu tungah amau' khut nga sak in la, mihonte khempeuh amah deng sak in.
Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: ama Pasian a samsia mi peuhmah in ama khialhna thuak ding hi.
Topa' min a gensia mipa kithat ding hi; mihonte khempeuh in amah deng ding uh hi; peemta hita leh tualsung mi hita leh, Min Siangtho a gensiat ciangin kithat ding hi.
Mi a thatpa kithat ding hi.
Ganhing a thatpa in a ganhing mah-in loh ding hi.
Mi khat in a vengte khat a poisak leh, ama hih bangin ama tung mahah kithuk kik ding a,
guh kitan tang ding guh kitan, mittang tang ding mittang, ha tang ding ha kihih ding hi; amah in mi khat a poisak bangin amah kipoisak ding hi.
Ganhing a thatpa in loh ding hi; mi a thatpa kithat ding hi.
Note in peemta leh tualsung mi adingin ngeina a kibang khat na nei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses in Israel mite tungah thu gen hi; amaute in a samsia mipa giahphual pua lamah paipih uh a, suang tawh a deng uh hi. Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin Israel mite in hih uh hi.
Topa in Sinai Mual tungah Moses kiangah,
"Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Note kong piak leitangah na tun' uh ciangin, leitang in Topa adingin sabbatth tang ding hi.
Kum guk sung note in na lo uh na pawi ding uh hi; kum guk sung note in na leenggui lo uh hah-in a gahte na kaikhawm ding uh hi;
ahih hangin a kum sagihna ah, leitang ading a thupi tawlngakna sabbath, Topa ading sabbath om ding hi; note in na lo uh na pawi kei ding uh a, na leenggui lo uh na hah kei ding uh hi.
A li pote note in na kaikhawm kei ding uh hi; a kipuah lo leenggui gahte note in na kaikhawm kei ding uh hi; leitang' adingin a thupi tawlngakna kum hi ding hi.
Leitang sabbath kum-a piang tawmte in note ading, note leh na sila pasal leh numeite ading leh a kicial na nasemte uh ading leh note tawh a teeng a peem mi ading an hong sik ding hi;
a piang khempeuhte in na bawngte uh ading leh na leitang uhah a om ganhingte an ding ahi hi.
"Kum nipi sagih hun in note adingin kum sawm-li-le-kua ahih theih nadingin note in kum nipi sagih, kum sagih mun sagih vei na simto ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin note in kha sagihna a ni sawm ni-in nakpi-in peengkul na tum ding uh hi; kilemna ni-in note in na gam khempeuh uhah peengkul aw na gingkhia sak ding uh hi.
Note in a kum sawmngana siangtho sakin, gam sunga a teeng mi khempeuhte tungah suahtakna na genthang ding uh hi; note in nomau neihsa ciatah pai kikin note in nomau innkuanpihte ciat kiangah na ciahkik uh ciangin note adingin jubili hi ding hi.
Tua a kum sawmngana in note adingin jubili hi ding hi; tua kum sungin note in lo pawi loin, a li pote zong la loin, a kihah lo leengguite panin zong leenggah na khawm kei ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh tua in jubili ahi hi; tua in note adingin siangtho ding hi; note in lo pan-a piangsate na ne ding uh hi.
"Hih Jubili kum sungin note khempeuh in nomau neihsa ciat na ngah kik ding uh hi.
Note in na vengte tungah na zuak uh ahi zongin na vengte kiang panun na lei uh ahi zongin note khat leh khat na kikhem kei ding uh hi.
Jubili khit ciangin a kum pha zah tawh kituakin note in na vengte uh kiang panin lei-in, a an piang ding kum zah tawh kituakin amau in note tungah hong zuak ding uh hi.
A kum a tam leh a man na khangsak ding uh hi; a kum a tawm leh a man na kiamsak ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh no tungah hong zuak pen a tuk tung ding zah ahi hi.
Note khat leh khat kikhem loin na Pasian uh na zahtak ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin note in ka thukhamte hihin, ka biakna ngeina kipte zui-in tuate na sem ding uh hi; tua hi leh note lungmuang takin gam sungah na teeng ding uh hi.
Leitang in gah gahin, note in na kham takun ne-in, tua sungah lungmuang takin na teeng ding uh hi.
Note in, 'Lo lah pawi loin an lah la kei lehang, a kum sagihna ah bang ne ding i hi hiam?' na cih uh leh
keimah in a kum gukna ah note tungah thupha kong pia ding a, kum thum sung ading gah hong gah ding hi.
A kum giatna ah lo na pawi uh ciangin, note in anlui na ne ding uh hi; anthak hong tun' a kum kua mateng note in a lui na ne ding uh hi.
Leitang in keima' aa ahih manin neih suak dingin leitang kizuak lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh note in kei tawh a omkhawm mikhual leh peemtate na hi uh hi.
Note in na neih uh leitang khempeuh na kitanh kik sak thei ding uh hi.
"Na sanggampa zawngin a neihsa leitang khenkhat a zuak leh, tua ciangin amah tawh a kinai a behpa hong pai-in a sanggampa zuaksa tanh ding hi.
Mi khat in tua na a tatsak ding mi a neih kei a, amahmah hong hau kikin a tanh zo dingin a pian' leh,
amah in tua na a zuak zawh a kumte sim hen la, a zuakna mipa tungah a val-a piak dingte pia kik hen; amah in a neihsa ngah kik ding hi.
Ahih hangin amah in ama adingin ngah kik zawh nading lampi a neih kei leh, tua ama zuak na pen jubili kum mateng a leipa' khut sungah om ding hi; jubili ciangin tua na kipia khia-in, amah in a neihsa ngah kik ding hi.
"Mi khat in khuapi kulh sungah ten'na inn khat a zuak leh, a kizuak khit kum khat bit sungin amah in tanh kik thei ding hi; kum khat bit sung amah in tatkik theih nading thu nei ding hi.
Tua pen kum khat khit bit sungin a kitatkik kei leh, khuapi kulh sunga om tua inn pen a leipa in khang tawntungin a neih dingin kibawlsak ding hi; jubili ciangin kipiakik lo ding hi.
Ahih hangin a kimkotah kulh a nei lo khua neu-a innte pen gam sung lote tawh a kibangin kingaihsun ding hi; tuate kitanh kik thei ding hi; jubili ciangin tuate kipiakhia ding hi.
Ahi zongin Levi mite' khuapite, amau neihsa khuapite-a innte ahih leh, Levi mite in khat vei peuh ciangin tanh thei ding uh hi.
Levi mi khatpeuh in ama tat kik theih ding hi napi a tat kei leh, amau neihsa khuapi sunga tua inn pen jubili ciangin kipia khia ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Levi mite' khuapi sunga innte pen Israel mite lakah amau neihsa ahi hi.
Ahih hangin amau khuapi taang gamte kizuak thei lo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua in amau' neih tawntung na ahi hi.
"Na sanggampa uh zawng-in, note bangin amah a kivak zawh kei leh, note in amah na vaak ding uh hi; mikhual leh peemta bangin amah in note tawh om ding hi.
Na sanggampa uh no kiangah hong ten' theih nadingin ama tung panin ameet akhang la kei un la, na Pasian uh zahtak un.
Note in ama tungah a meet-in sum leitawi pia loin, ama tungah a meet-in na an uh zong na pia kei ding uh hi.
Keimah in note' Pasian ahi ding leh, note tungah Kanaan leitang a hong pia dingin Izipt gam panin note a hong paikhiatpih Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi.
"Na gei-a na sanggampa zawngin, nangma tungah amahmah hong kizuak leh, sila bangin na na sem sak kei ding hi:
amah in nang kiangah a kicial nasem leh peemta bangin om ding hi. Amah in jubili kum mateng nang tawh na hong sem ding hi;
tua ciangin nang kiang panin amah leh amah tawh a om a tate paikhia-in, ama innkuan zuan kikin, a pate' neihsa ngah kik ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Izipt gam panin ka paikhiatpih keima nasemte ahi uh hi; a amaute sila-in kizuak lo ding hi.
Note in hih gawpgawpna tawh amah na uk kei ding uh a, na Pasian uh na zahtak ding uh hi.
Note in na neih theih ding uh sila pasal leh sila numeite in: note in na kimkot uh a, om minamte lak panin sila pasal leh sila numei na lei thei ding uh hi.
Note in na gam sung uhah a suak, note lakah a hong peem mi khualte leh note tawh a om amau' innkuante lak panin zong na lei thei ding uh hi; amaute in nomau' aa hi thei ding uh hi.
Note in amaute pen note khit ciangin na tapate uh tungah amau' neih tawntung dingin a luah dingin na pia thei ding uh hi; note in sila-in amaute na nei thei ding uh a, ahih hangin na sanggam uh Israel mite khat leh khat hih gawpgawpna tawh na ki-uk kei ding uh hi.
"Note tawh a om khualmi ahih kei leh peemta khat hong hau a, ama kianga om na sanggampa uh zawngin, no tawh a om khualmipa tung ahi a, peemta-pa tung ahi zongin, tua ahih kei leh khualmipa innkuan khatpeuh peuh tungah amah a kizuak leh,
amah in a kizuak khit ciangin amah kitanh kik thei ding hi; ama sanggamte khatpeuh peuh in amah tanh thei ding hi;
ama innlak pa ahih kei leh a innlak sanggampa in tanh thei ding hi; ama innkuan sunga a kinai pih a beh khatpeuh in amah tanh thei ding hi; tua ahih kei leh zong amah a hauh leh amahmah kitanh kik thei ding hi.
Amah in ama tungah amahmah a kizuak-a kipan jubili kum dong amah a leipa tawh tuat ding a, ama suahtak nading sum pen a kum phazah tawh kituak hi ding hi; a topa tawh a omkhawm hun sung teng pen a kicial nasem khat thaman zah-in seh ding hi.
Kum tampi in a sap lai leh, amah in tuate tawh kituakin ama thaman ding a kipiakna sung panin ama kitatkhiat nadingin pia kik ding hi.
Ahih hangin jubili kum ding kum tawmkhat in a sap leh amah in a topa tawh tuatna khat nei ding hi; ama sepsak ding kum a om lai tawh kituakin ama kitatkhiat nadingin sum pia kik ding hi.
Amah in a topa tungah a kum kum-a kicial nasempa tawh kibang ding hi; a topa in note' muhna ah hih gawpgawpna tawh amah uk lo ding hi.
Hih bang danin amah a kitatkhiat kei leh, jubili kum ciangin amah leh amah tawh a om a tate' kikhahkhia ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel mite in kei adingin nasemte ahi uh hi; amaute pen Izipt gam panin keimah in ka paikhiatpih keima nasemte ahi uh hi: keimah in Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi.
"Note in nomau adingin a mai-ah na kun dingun milim bawl loin, a kiseek milim hita leh khuam hita leh ding sak loin, na gam sung uhah suang milim na phut kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi.
"Note in ka thukham zui-in ka thupiaknate mangin tuate na sep uh leh,
keimah in note guahtui amau' hunin kong pia ding a, leitang in ama gahte hong piangsakin, lo-a kungte in amau' gah gah ding uh hi.
Na cil uh ante lenggah lawh hun dong kimang ding a, leenggah minte in lo pawi hun dong kimang ding hi; note in na kham takun na an uh na ne ding uh a, lungnuam takin na gam sung uhah na teeng ding uh hi.
Keimah in gam sungah nopsakna hong pia-in, note lungdam takin na lum ding uh a, bangmah in note hong lausak lo ding hi; keimah in gam sung panin ganhing gilote ka hawlkhia ding a, gal kidona in na gam uh hong nawk lo ding hi.
Note in na galte uh na delh ding uh a, note mai-ah namsau in amaute puksak ding hi.
Note nga in zakhat zo-in, note zakhat in tulsawm na zo ding uh hi: note' mai-ah namsau in na galte uh puksak ding hi.
Keimah in note ka hong pingaihsut ding a, note hong pung sakin, tampi hong phasakin, note tawh ka thuciamna ka kipsak ding hi.
Note in sau veipi a kikhol a luite ne-in, note in a thak koih nadingin alui na hahsiang masa ding uh hi.
Keimah in note lakah omna ka bawl ding a, keimah in note kong kih kei ding hi.
Keimah in note lakah omin note' Pasian hi-in, note in keima mite na hi ding uh hi.
Note in amau sila na hih loh nadingun Izipt gam panin note a hong paikhiatpih Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi; keimah in note' hakkolte kuaitanin note a dingtangin kong pai sak hi.
"Ahih hangin note in ka thu ngai loin, hih thupiaknate khempeuh na hih kei uh a,
note in ka thukhamte nialin, note in ka biakna ngeina kipte kih a, ka thupiaknate khempeuh sem loin, ka thuciamna na palsat uh leh,
keimah in note tungah hih bangin kong hih ding hi: note tungah hong tung dingin keimah in thakhat thu-a dipkuatna, zawngkhalna, leh mite siasakin nuntakna a kiamsak ding cisa natna kong tung sak ding hi. Note' lo pawi in a mawkna hi ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh na galte un tuate ne ding hi;
Keimah in note kong maisiat ding a, na galte uh mai-ah, lelhna na thuak ding uh hi; note hong mudah mite in note hong uk ding a, kuamah in note hong delh lo napi-in na tai ding uh hi.
Tua bang hi napi-in note in ka thu nong ngaih kei uh leh, keimah in na khialhna hangun a zah sagih vei-in note kong thuhilh kik ding a,
keimah in na kiphatsakpih uh note' vangliatna susia-in, na vantungte uh sik bangin bawlin na leitung uh sumngo bangin ka bawl ding hi;
na leitang un ama gah piangsak loin, na gam sung uh a, kungte in amau gah gah lo ding ahih manin note' thatang a mawkna-a bei hi ding hi.
"Tua ciangin kei tawh kilehngatin pai-in, keima thu na ngaih kei uh leh, keimah in note' khialhna a zah sagih vei-in note tungah gimna kong tung sak ding hi.
Keimah in note lakah gamsate hong khahin, amaute in na tate uh hong neksak ding a, na ganhingte uh susia-in, note mi tawmno khat hong suah ding a, note' lampite in gamkhing suak ding hi.
"Hih banga hihna tawh kei lamah note hong kihei loin, kei tawh kilehngatin na pai lai uh leh,
kei zong note tawh a kilehngatin pai-in, keimahmah in na khialhnate uh hangin a zah sagih vei-in note kong sat ding hi.
Keimah in thuciamna omsa bangin phulakna na a sem ding namsau khat note tungah kong tung sak ding hi; na khuapi sung uhah note na kikhaihkhop uh leh zong keimah in note' lakah natna kong tung sak ding a, galte khut sungah note hong kipia ding hi.
Keimah in note' nuntakna an ka suksiat ciangin, nupi sawm in meibung khat sungah na anlum uh em ding a, na anlum uh a tawi tehin hong pia kik ding hi; note in na ne ding uh a, na kham zo kei ding uh hi.
"Tua bang hi napi-in note in keima thu ngai loin, kei tawh kilehngatin na pai lai uh leh,
note tawh a kilehngatin ka heh ngawh pah ding a, note' khialhna hangin keimahmah in a zah sagih vei-in kong thuhilh ding hi.
Note in na tapate uh a sa na ne ding uh a, na tanute uh sa zong na ne ding uh hi.
Keimah in mual dawn-a na biaknate uh susia-in, na paknamtui biakna taute uh phukin, na milim' siluang hawmte uh tungah na luanghawmte uh ka paii ding hi; keimah in note kong kih ding hi.
Keimah in na khuapite uh siasakin, na biakinnte uh gamkhing ka suaksak ding a, nomau' gim namtuite ka diik kei ding hi.
Keimah in leitang ka siasak ding a, tua tungah a teeng na galte un lamdang sa ding uh hi.
Keimah in minamte lakah note kong thehthang ding a, keimah in namsau a paai panin dokin note kong delh ding hi; na leitang uh gamkhing hi ding a, na khuapite uh a sia hi ding hi.
"Tua ciangin na galte uh leitangah na om tan vei uh, gamkhing-a a om sung teng, leitang in a sabbath-te a ngah hi ding hi; tua ciangin leitang tawlnga-in, a sabbath-te ngah ding hi.
Ama tungah na ten' lai takun a ngah loh tawlngakna ahi na sabbath-te uh, gamkhing a, a om sung teng a tawlnga hi ding hi.
Note sung panin galte leitangah a om lai mite tungah lungsim gimna ka tungsak ding hi; nahthel ging in amaute tai sak ding a, namsau mai-ah mi khat a tai bangin amaute tai ding uh a, kuamah in a delh lohpi-in amaute puk ding uh hi.
Kuamah in delh lo napi-in namsau mai pan a taikhia bangin amaute khat leh khat kiphupai ding uh hi; note in na galte uh nan' zawh nading vangliatna na nei kei ding uh hi.
Minamte lakah note na sia ding uh a, na galte uh leitang in note hong nemang ding hi.
Note sung panin galte' leitangah a om laite amau' mawhna hangin kiam ding uh hi; amau' pute pate' mawhna hangin amau zong amaute mah bangin kiam ding uh hi.
"Ahih hangin kei tungah khemna tawh hong gamtatnasa uh leh kei tawh kilehngatin a paina uh hangin amaute tawh kilehngatin pai-in, amau galte' leitangah amaute ka paipihna thu ahi, amau' mawhna leh, a pu a pate' mawhna pulakin a lungsim uh niamkhiatin, amaute in a mawhna a kipuahphat uh leh;
tua ciangin keimah in Jakob tawh ka thuciamna ka phawk ding a, keimah in Isaak tawh ka thuciamna leh Abraham tawh ka thuciamna ka phawk ding a, keimah in leitang zong ka phawk ding hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in leitang nusia-in, amaute om loin gamkhingin a om sung teng leitang in a sabbath-te na ngah ding hi; amaute in ka biakna ngeina kipte nialin, amaute in ka thukhamte mudah ahih manin, amaute in a mawhna uh thuak ding uh hi.
Bang bang ahi zongin, amaute a galte uh gam sungah a om sung teng uh keimah in amaute nilkhia loin, amaute a susia maimang zah ding leh amaute tawh ka thuciamna a pelh zah dingin amaute ka mudah kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in Topa amau Pasian ka hi hi;
ahih hangin keimah in amaute ka ngaihsutna-in keimah in amau' Pasian ka hih theih nadingin, minamte' muhna ah Izipt gam panin ka paikhiatpih amau' pu leh pate tawh ka thuciamna ka phawk ding hi: keimah in Topa ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Hihte Moses tung tawnin Sinai Mual tungah Topa in amah leh Israel mite kikalah a bawl thukhamte leh biakna ngeina kipte leh thute ahi hi.
"Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Mi khat in a tuam vilvel-in kiciamna a bawl ciangin, tua a kiciamna a bawl ciangin, tua a kiciamna mite pen nangmah in Topa' aa dingin na seh ding hi;
pasal kum sawmnih panin kum sawmguk a phate a man na sehna pen, biakinn shekel tawh kizui-in mi khat ciangin ngun shekel sawmnga hi ding hi.
Tua mi in numei ahih leh, na sehna in shekel sawmthum hi ding hi.
Tua mi in kum nga pan kum sawmnih ciang a pha mi ahih leh, a man na sehna in pasal shekel sawmnih hi ding a, numei shekel sawm hi ding hi.
Tua mi in kha khat pan kum nga ciang a pha mi ahih leh, a man na sehna in pasal ngun shekel nga hi ding a, numei na sehna in ngun shekel thum hi ding hi.
Tua mi in kum sawmguk pan a tungsiah ahih leh, pasal na sehna in shekel sawm leh nga hi ding a, numei shekel sawm hi ding hi.
Mi khat zawng lua-in nangma seh zah a piak zawh kei leh, amah in siampipa kiangah a mi hong paipih ding a, siampipa in ama man seh ding hi; a kiciam mipa a siamna tawh kizui-in siampipa in ama man seh ding hi.
"Mite in Topa tungah biakna-in a piakte in ganhing ahih leh, mi khatpeuh in Topa tungah a piak tua bang ganhingte khempeuh a siangtho ahi hi.
Amah na khatpeuh peuh, ahoihte ahoih lo tawh ahi zongin, ahoih lote ahoih tawh a hi zongin, laih lo, kheek lo ding hi; amah in ganhing khat ganhing adang khat tawh a kheek leh, tua ganhing leh a kheekna ganhing a siangtho hi ding hi.
Tua pen Topa tungah biakna-in kipia thei lo ganhing nin khat ahih leh, mipa in siampipa mai-ah a ganhing paipih ding a,
siampipa in hoih hi ci-in ahi zongin sia hi ci-in ahi zongin a man zah seh ding hi; nang siampipa in a seh bangin hi pah ding hi.
Ahih hangin amah in tua ganhing a tat nop leh, a kisehna banah seh nga suah seh khat behlap ding hi.
"Mi khat in a siangtho dingin Topa tungah a inn a ap ciangin, siampipa in hoih hi ci-in a hi zongin sia hi ci-in ahi zongin a man zah seh ding hi; siampipa in a seh bangin kip ding hi.
A appa in ama inn a tat nop leh, a kisehna banah sehnga suah sehkhat sum tawh behlap ding a, tua inn ama' aa hi ding hi.
"Mi khat in a luah ahi ama leitang phel khat Topa tungah a ap leh, nangma sehna pen khaici tawh kizui hi ding hi; mangbuhham beem khat a pawina leitang pen ngun shekel sawmnga-in kiseh ding hi.
Amah in jubili kum a, kipanin a lo a ap leh, nangma sehna zahzah bit ding hi;
ahih hangin jubili khit ciangin amah in a lo a ap leh, siampipa in jubili kik dong a om lai kumte tawh kizui-in a man zah sum seh ding a, nangma sehna zah panin kikhiam ding hi.
Lo a appa in a tat nop leh, a kisehna banah sehnga suah sehkhat sum tawh behlap ding a, tua in ama' aa hi suak ding hi.
Ahih hangin amah in a lo tanh nuam lo ahi a, amah in midang khat tungah a lo a zuak ahi zongin ahih leh, tua pen amah in tanh kik thei nawn lo ding hi;
a lo pen, jubili huna piak khiat ciangin, a ki-apsa lo mah bangin Topa tungah a siangtho hi ding hi; siampipa in tua lo tang ding hi.
Amah in a luahna tawh a neih a hilo, a leisa lo pen Topa tungah a ap leh,
siampipa in jubili kum ciang dong ding tua mah seh ding a, a mipa in tua ni-in a kiseh zah, Topa tungah a siangtho-in pia ding hi.
Jubili kum ciangin a lo pen a kileina-pa, gamluahna tawh tua leitang a nei mipa tungah pia kik ding hi.
A kisehna peuhmah biakinn shekel tawh kizui hi ding hi: gerah sawmnih ciangin shekel khat hi ding hi.
"Ahih hangin tacil pen Topa' aa ahih mah bangin, kuamah in ganhing tacilte ap thei lo ding hi; bawng hita leh tuu hita leh Topa' aa ahi hi.
Ganhing nin ahih leh, nangma sehna bangin amah in lei kikin, tua banah seh nga suah seh khat behlap ding hi; tua hi lo a, a kitat kei leh, a kisehna bangin kizuak ding hi.
"Ahih hangin mi khat in a neih, Topa tungah a ap, a ki-apsa nate, mi hita leh ganhing hita leh, a luah ama lo hita leh, kizuak lo ding, kitanh lo ding hi; a ki-ap na peuhmah Topa tungah siangthopen hi.
Mite lak panin a kisusia mang ding a, ki-apsa mi peuhmah, kitanh lo ding hi; kithat ding hi.
"Leitung pana piang seh sawmsuah seh khat khempeuh khaici hita leh singgah hita leh, Topa' aa ahi hi; Topa adingin siangtho hi.
Mi khatpeuh in seh sawmsuah seh khat a, a piak na khatpeuh peuh a tat nop leh, amah in tua banah seh nga suah seh khat behlap ding hi.
Bawnghon leh tuu, keelhon seh sawm suah seh khat khempeuh leh a cingpa' ciangkhut nuai-a a pai ganhing khempeuh seh sawmsuah seh khat peuhmah Topa adingin a siangtho hi ding hi.
Mi khat in pha hiam sia hiam ci-in kantel lo ding a, khek lo ding hi; a khek leh, tua leh a khekna pen a siangtho hi ding hi; tua pen kitanh lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Hihte in Sinai Mual tungah Topa in Israel mite ading Moses tungah a piak thupiakte ahi hi.
A lian mahmah Theofilas aw, a cil panin mittang in a muh teci leh Pasian thuhilh na a sem mite in hong gen uh mah bangin,
eite lakah a hong piangsa thu teng, eite hong zaksak a kizomin lai a gelh mi tampi a om hi.
Keimah in zong tua thu khempeuh a cil panin tel takin ka dot ciangin
nangmah hong kihilhsa thute aman takpi hi, cih na theih nadingin a kizomin gelhin zasak ning, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.
Judah gam Herod kumpipa a man' lai-in Abijah pawlte lakah Zekhariah a min nei siampi khat a om hi. Tuapa' zi in Aaron suan hi a, a min Elisabeth ahi hi.
Tua tegel in Pasian' thukham khempeuh leh Pasian' ngeina khempeuh zui uh a, mawhsak na'ng om loin Pasian mai-ah mipha ahi uh hi.
Elisabeth in tasel ahih ciangin, a khan' teek dongin ta a nei kei uh hi.
Paknamtui mei tawh a hal hun lai takin mi khempeuh in inn pua lamah thu ngenin a om uh hi.
Tua lai takin Topa' vangtungmi khat hong kilang a; paknamtui tau taklam ah a ding hi.
Zekhariah in vantungmi a muh ciangin lunghimawhin a lau hi.
Vantungmi in, "Zekhariah aw, lau kei in. Na thungetna hong ngai zo hi. Na zi Elisabeth in tapa khat nang ading a nei ding hi. Tua tapa' min Johan na phuak ding hi.
Nangmah in zong lungdamna leh nuamna na ngah ding a, ama suahna hangin mi tampite zong a lungdam ding uh hi.
Israel mipawl tampi amau Topa Pasian kiangah a kiheisak kik ding hi.
A pate' lungsim un tate kiangah kiheisak nading ahi zongin, thu ngai lo mite in midikte' pilna lampi ah kiheisak nading ahi zongin, Topa ading a kibawlkhol mite a pian' nading ahi zongin amah in Elijah' lungsim leh vangliatna tawh Pasian mai-ah a pai ding hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Zekhariah in, "Tua banga na piang ding bangci-in ke'n ka thei ding hiam? Kei puteek ka hi hi; ka zi zong a khan' sawt zo hi," ci-in a gen ciangin,
vantungmi in, "Keimah in Pasian kiangah a ding Gabriel ka hi hi. Nangmah hopih a, hih lungdamna thu hong zasak dingin hong sawl hi.
Nangmah in a hun a cin' cianga a tung ding ka thu um lo na hih ciangin, hih thu a pian' ni dongin pau thei loin na om ding hi," a ci hi.
Mite in Zekhariah ngak uh a, biakna inn sungah sawtpi a om ciangin lamdang a sa uh hi.
Amah hong paikhiat ciangin, amaute kiangah pau thei lo ahih ciangin, biakna innpi sungah maang mu hi, ci-in a thei khin uh hi. Zekhariah in lim bek lak a, pau loin a om hi.
Siampi nasepna a bei ciangin Zekhariah innah a ciah hi.
Tua nung ciangin, ama zi Elisabeth a gai hi.
"Midangte kiangah ka thuak gensiatna, Topa in hong paihkhiatsak nadingin kei hong en-in, hih bangin keima tungah hong bawl zo hi," ci-in kha nga tawntung inn sungah a bucip hi.
Kha nga khit ciangin, Galile gam Nazareth kici khua khatah,
David' suan Josef min neipa tawh a kingai nungak kiangah, Pasian in a vangtungmi Gabriel a sawl hi. Tua nungak' min in Mari ahi hi.
Gabriel in ama kiang a tun' ciangin, "Thupha a ngah nungak aw, na cidam ta hen. Topa in nang tawh a omkhawm hi," a ci hi.
Mari in tua thugenna hangin lungmang a, "Hih hopihna in bangci bang hopihna ahi ding hiam?" ci-in a ngaihsun hi.
Vantungmi in, "Mari aw, lau kei in. Nang in Pasian maipha na ngah zo hi.
Gai-in tapa na nei ding hi. Tua tapa' min Zeisu na phuak ding hi.
Tua ta in milian hi ding a, Sang Bel Pasian' Tapa kici ding hi. A pa David' tokhom Pasian in pia ding a,
amah in Jakob' suante a tawntungin uk ding a, ama gam in a bei ngei kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Mari in, "Hih thu in bangci piang ding ahi hiam? Pasal ka nei kei hi," a ci hi.
Vantungmi in zong, "Kha Siangtho in nangma tungah hong tung a, Sang Bel Pasian' vangliatna in nang hong liah ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin, tua siangtho a piang ta in Pasian' Tapa a kici ding hi.
Tua longal, tasel kici na beh Elisabeth in zong a teek zawh hangin tapa gai a, tu-in kha guk a pha zo hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, Pasian in sep theih loh a nei kei hi," a ci hi.
Mari in, "Pasian' sila numei ka hi hi, nangma thu bangin kei tungah hong piang ta hen," a cih khit ciangin, vantungmi in ama kiang panin a paikhia hi.
Tua lai takin Mari ding a, khamtungah Judah khuapi khatah manlangin pai a,
Zekhariah' innah lutin Elisabeth va hopih hi.
Mari hopihna thu Elisabeth in a zak ciangin, a gil sunga om naungeek diang a, amah in Kha Siangtho tawh kidim hi.
"Nangmah in numei lakah thupha ngah na hi hi. Na gil sunga om naungeek in thupha a ngah ding hi.
Ka Topa' nu kei kiangah hong pai nadingin bang hangin hehpihna ke'n ka ngah hiam?
Nong hopihna aw ke'n ka zak ciangin ka gil sunga om naungeek in lungdamna tawh a diang hi.
Thu-um numei in thupha a ngah ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, tua numei kiangah Topa' thugente hong tangtung ding hi," ci-in aw lian tawh a gen hi.
Mari in zong, "Keima lungsim in Topa a pahtawi hi.
Keimah hong gum Topa Pasian hangin ka kha a nuam hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, ama sila numei' kiniamsakna hong en zo hi. Tu-a kipanin khang khempeuhte in kei thupha a ngah mi hong ci ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, vangliatna a neipa in keima tungah a lian thute hong hih zo hi. Tua pa min' a siangtho hi.
Amah kihta mite tungah, Khang khat pan khang khat dongin ama hehpihna a om tawntung ding hi.
Ama ban tawh vangliatna a lak zo hi. Amau ngaihsutna lungsim uh a kiphasakte kikhenthang sak zo hi.
Amah in kumpite a kumpi tokhom tung pan kiasak a, mizawngte khangtosak zo hi.
A gilkial mite an pha tawh vak a, Sum haute khut guak tawh a paikhiasak zo hi.
I pu i pate kiangah a gen ngei mah bangin, Abraham akipan ama suan leh khakte tungah,
Hehpihna thupha a tawntungin a ngaihsut theih nadingin, Ama sila Israel kiangah huhna a pia zo hi," a ci hi.
Mari in Elisabeth kiangah kha thum a om khit ciangin, innah a ciahkik hi.
Elizabeth suah hun a cin' khit ciangin, tapa a suak hi.
Topa in a lian hehpihna Elisabeth tungah a bawl, a inn vengte leh a behte in a zak uh ciangin, amah tawh kibangin lungdamin a nuam uh hi.
Ni giat ni khit ciangin, naungeek' vun at dingin amaute hong pai uh a, a pa min zui-in Zekhariah a phuak nuam uh hi.
Ahih hangin a nu in, "Hi lo hi, a min Johan kiphuak ding hi," a cih ciangin,
amaute in, "Hih min in na behte lakah khat beek kiphuak lo hi," a ci uh hi.
A pa kiangah, "Bang phuak nuam na hi hiam?" ci-in lim tawh a dong uh hi.
Zekhariah in lai ngen a, "Ama min in Johan ahi ding hi," ci-in a gelh ciangin amaute khempeuh in lamdang a sa uh hi.
Tua leh, thakhatin Zekhariah kam kihong a, a leii kikhah a, Pasian phatin a pau thei hi.
A inn vengte khempeuh lau uh a, tua thu khempeuh Judah gam khamtung khempeuh ah kizeel hi.
A za khempeuhte in a lungsim sung uh ah ciamteh uh a, "Hih naungeek in bangci bang mi hi ding ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Topa' khut in amah tawh a omkhawm hi.
Tua naungeek'pa Zekhariah in Kha Siangtho tawh kidim a, kamsan'na tawh a gen-inah:
"Israel mipawl' Topa Pasian in thupha ngah ta hen.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, tanglai ama kamsang siangthote' kam tawh a gen kholh mah bangin,
Eite in i galte' khut sung pan i kikhahkhiat khit ciangin, Ama mai-ah i khan' tawntung sian'thona leh thumanna in,
Lau loin ama' na i sep theih nading ahi zongin, i pa Abraham tungah thuciamna leh
A siangtho ama kamciamsa thu a ngaihsut nading ahi zongin, i pu i pate tungah hehpihna thupha hong bawl nading ahi zongin,
Ama mi pawlte hong veh in, a hong tankhia zo hi, Eite in i galte khut sung pan ahi zongin,
A hong mudah khempeuhte khut sung pan ahi zongin, hong gupkhiat nadingin,
Ama sila David' suan lak panin, Eite adingin kii khat ahi alian hong Gumpa a piangsak zo hi.
Ahi hi, naungeek aw, nangmah in Sang Bel Topa' kamsangpa hong kici ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, eite Pasian hong hehpihna thupha hangin ah Ama mi pawlte' khialhna maisakna tawh,
Gupna thu ama mipawlte na theihsak nading ahi zongin, ama lampi na sial nading ahi zongin, Nang in Topa mai-ah na pai ding hi. Tua hehpihna hangin
Khuamial leh sihna lim sungah a tu mite tungah, khuavak hong tan' nading ahi zongin, Nopna lampi ah eite hong kha ding ahi zongin,
A tung panin ni suakin eite kiangah hong tang ding hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Tua naungeek khang a, a lungsim siamna khangto a, Israel mite kiangah a kilah ni matengin gampa lakah a om hi.
Tua lai takin leitung mi khempeuh a kisim nadingin, Kaisar kumpipa Augustas in thu a pia hi.
Kurinias in Siria gam menzi ahih lai takin hih kisimna a masa pen ahi hi.
Mi khempeuhte in kisim dingin amau khua ciatah a pai uh hi.
Josef in zong David' suan ahih ciangin, a kidongsa a lawmnu Mari tawh kisim dingin, Galile gam Nazareth khua panin Judah gam Bethlehem kici David' khua-ah a pai uh hi.
Tua Mari a gai zawh a sawt zo hi.
Amau Bethlehem khua-ah a om lai takun a suah hun tung a;
a ta cil suak a, puanin a tun khit ciangin zin tun'na innah omna ding om lo ahih ciangin, bawng ankuang sungah naungeek a sial hi.
Tua gamah tuucingte in gam lakah giakin amau tuu honte zanin a cing uh hi.
Topa' vantungmi khat in amaute kiangah ding a, a kiimkot ah Pasian' vang tang a, amaute in a kihta mahmah uh hi.
Ahih hangin vantungmi in, "Lau kei un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mi khempeuh ading nakpi nuamna thu note kong zasak ding hi.
Tuni-in, David' khua-ah Topa Khazih ahi hong Gumpa in note adingin a suak zo hi.
Note in, 'Bang limin thei ding ka hi uh hiam?' na cih uh leh naungeek puanin kitun a, bawng an nekna kuang sungah kisialin a om na mu ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin vantungmi tawh vantung galkap tampite in thakhatin hong kikhawm uh a,
"Van a sang belna-ah Pasian minthang ta hen. Leitung a deih mite tungah nopna om ta hen," ci-in Pasian a phat uh hi.
Vantungmite in vantungah a ciah khit uh ciangin tuucingte in, "Eite Bethlehem khua-ah pai-in, Pasian hong lah hih a piangsa thu va en ni," ci-in khat leh khat a kihopih uh hi.
Manlangin pai uh a, Mari, Josef leh bawng an nekna kuang sungah kisial a, om naungeek a mu uh hi.
A muh khit uh ciangin, amau kiangah naungeek thu kigensa thu teng a zasak uh hi.
Tuucingte' thugenna zate khempeuh in lamdang a sa uh hi.
Mari in ahih leh, tua thute khempeuh ciamteh a, a lungsim sungah a lungngai hi.
Tuucingte in amau kiangah a gensa mah bangin, a zaksa a muhsa uh khempeuhte hangin Pasian' min phatna lasa-in a ciah uh hi.
Tua naungeek' vunat nading ni giat a cin' khit ciangin, a gai ma-a vantungmi in a phuah kholh mah bangin a min Zeisu a phuak uh hi.
Tua nung ciangin Moses' Thukham bangin, amau kisian'thosak nading ni a cin' ciangin, amaute in naungeek Jerusalem khuapi ah a paipih uh hi.
"A ta upa pasal khempeuh in Topa ading a siangtho hi, a kici ding hi," ci-in Topa' Thukhamna lai sungah a kigelh bangin,
Topa kiangah a piak khit uh ciangin, "Vakhu nupa kop ahi zongin, kawl vakhu neu ahi zongin," ci-in Topa' Thukhamna lai sungah a kigelh bangin biakna a pia uh hi.
Tua lai takin Simeon kici mi khat Jerusalem khuapi ah a om hi. Tua pa dik a, Pasian zahtak a, Israel mipawlte' nopsak nading a lamen hi. Kha Siangtho in ama tungah a om hi.
"Topa Khazih na muh matengin na si kei ding hi," ci-in Kha Siangtho in a hilh zo hi.
Tua lai takin amah in Kha Siangtho tawh biakna innpi-ah pai a, a nu leh pate in naungeek Zeisu hangah Thukham ngeina bang hih dingin a paipih lai takun,
Simeon in Zeisu a ang-ah pomin Pasian a phat-inah"
"Topa aw, na genkholh mah bangin, Na sal in nopsakna tawh a pai nadingin thu hong pia in.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, na mipawl Israelte' minthan'na ahi zongin Gentailte tungah khuavak nading ahi zongin,
Mipawl khempeuhte mai-ah na bawl gupna,
Ka mitin ka mu zo hi," a ci hi.
A nu leh pate in naungeek a genna thu lamdang a sa uh hi.
Simeon in amaute thupha a piak khit ciangin a nu Mari kiangah, "Hih naungeek in Israel mi tampite kipuk nading ahi zongin, thawh nading ahi zongin, mi tampi a lungngaihna a kilat nading ahi zongin, nialna a thuak nading lim a pian' nading ahi zongin a kikoih hi.
Ahi hi. Namsau in nangma lungsim hong sun ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Asher pawl ahi, Fanuel' tanu Anna min nei numei kamsang khat a om hi. Amah teek a, a nungak lai pan akipanin kum sagih bek pasal tawh a teen' khit ciangin,
kum sawmgiat leh kum li dong meigong a, thungetna leh an tan'na tawh sun tawh zan tawh pelh loin bia-in biakna innpi lawi loin a om hi.
Amah tua lai takin tunga Pasian hehpihna phatin, Jerusalem khuapi suahtak nading a lamen mi khempeuhte kiangah tua naungeek thu teng a gen hi.
Amaute in Topa' Thukhamna bangin na khempeuh a bawl khit uh ciangin, Galile gam amau khua Nazareth-ah a ciah uh hi.
Naupang khangto a, a thahatna khang a, lungpilna tawh a kidim hi. Pasian' hehpihna thupha zong ama tungah a om hi.
A nu leh pate in kum simin Paisan pawikhamna Jerusalem khua ah a pai uh hi.
Zeisu kum sawm leh kum nih a phak ciangin, ngeina bangin Paisan pawikhamna-ah a paito uh hi.
Pawikham ni a cin' khit ciangin, a nu leh pate a ciah lai takin naupang Zeisu in Jerusalem khua-ah a om lai hi.
A nu leh pate in thei loin a lawmte tawh naupang ton hi ci-in um-in ni khat lam a pai uh hi. Tua ciangin a behte a meeltheihte lakah a zong uh a;
a muh loh uh ciangin Jerusalem khua-ah nungkikin a zong uh hi.
Ni thum khit ciangin, naupang biakna innpi sungah thuhilhte lai zangah tu a, amaute thu ngai a, amaute kiangah thu dongin a om a mu uh hi.
Ama thu a za khempeuhte in a pilna leh a dawn' kiknate lamdang a sa uh hi.
A nu leh pate in amah a muh uh ciangin lungmang uh a, a nu in, "Ka ta aw, bang hangin kote tungah hih bangin hong bawl na hi hiam? Na pa leh keimah in dahna lungsim tawh kong zong uh hi," a ci hi.
Naupang in, "Bang hangin kei hong zong na hi uh hiam? Ka Pa innah om ka hih lam thei lo na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Amau kiangah a genna thu amaute in a thei kei uh hi.
Amah in amaute tawh ciahsuk khawm a, Nazareth khua-ah tungin amaute thu mangin a om hi. A nu in hih thu khempeuh a lungsim sungah a ciamteh hi.
Zeisu' lungpilna leh pumpi khang semsem a, Pasian mai leh mite mai-ah maipha a ngah semsem hi.
Kaisar kumpipa Tiberias a man' zawh kum sawm leh kum nga ciangin, Judah gamah Pontias Pilat mangpi hi a, Galile gamah Herod menzi hi a, Iturea gam leh Trakhonis gamah Herod' nau Filip menzi hi a, Abilene gamah Lisanias menzi hi a;
Annas leh Kaiafas in siampi ukte ahih lai takin, khamtung a, om Zekhariah' tapa Johan tungah Pasian thu a tung hi.
Kamsangpa Isaiah' Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin Johan in Jordan gun dungah vak kawikawi a, mawhna maisak nading kisik kikna tawh kituakin baptaizna thu a hilh hi.
Isaiah gelhna in: "Gampa lakah kikopa' aw in, 'Topa paina lam na sial un. Ama lampi na tangsak un.
Mualkuam thuk khempeuh kivuk dim ding a, Mual lian leh mual neu khempeuh kito niam ding a, Lam kawi khempeuh kitangsak ding hi, Lei hamte a kinelsak ding hi;'
Mi khempeuh in Pasian' gupna thu a thei ding uh hi," ci-in a gelh hi.
Tua lai takin Johan in ama khut tungah kibaptaiz dingin hong pai mihonpite kiangah, "No mualtan' suante aw, a hong tung ding hehna pan na taikhiat nadingun kua in hong hilhkhol hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin kisikkikna tawh kilawm gah na gah un. 'Abraham ka pa uh hi,' ci-in na lungsim sung uh ah lungngaih ding na kipan kei un. Ke'n kong cih-inah, Pasian in hih suangte nangawn zong Abraham' tate a suaksak thei hi.
Tu-in zong sing phungah hei a om zo hi. A gah hoih gah lo kung khempeuh phuk pai-in mei sungah kikhul ding hi," a ci hi.
Mihonpite in, "Tua bang ahih leh, kote in bang ci hih ding ka hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dot uh ciangin,
Johan in, "Puan ak nih a neite in puan ak nei lote tawh hawm ta hen. An nek ding a neite in zong tua bangin hih ta hen," a ci hi.
Siahdongte in zong kibaptaiz dingin hong pai uh a, "Sia aw, kote in bang ci hih ding ka hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dot uh ciangin,
Johan in, "Note in thu hong kipia zah khengin dong kei un," a ci hi.
Galkapte in zong, "Kote in zong bang ci hih ding ka hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dot uh ciangin Johan in, "Note in kuama kiangah zawhthawhna tawh la kei un la, midangte zuau thu tawh na mawhsak kei un. Na khasum ngah zah uh tawh lungkim un," ci-in a gen hi.
Mi khempeuh in Johan in Khazih ahi kha ding hiam ci-in, lamenin a lungsim sung uh ah a lungngai uh hi.
Johan in, "Note tui sungah ka hong baptaiz hi. Kei sangin a lian zaw pa khat hong pai ding hi. Ama khedap khau sut dingin zong ka kilawm kei hi. Tua pa in Kha Siangtho leh mei sungah note hong baptaiz ding hi.
Tua bangin Johan in hansuahna tawh Lungdamna Thu mite kiangah a hilh hi.
Ahih hangin, menzipa in a nau' zi Herodias leh ama mawhna teng hangin Johan in taai ahih ciangin,
Herod in ama mawhna khempeuh tungah hih mawhna behlapin, Johan thong sungah a khia hi.
Mi khempeuh a kibaptaiz khit uh a ciangin, Zeisu in zong kibaptaiz a, thu a nget lai takin van kihong a,
Kha Siangtho pum nei-in vakhu bangin ama tungah kumsuk a, "Nangmah in ka lung hong damsak ka it, ka Tapa na hi hi," ci-in vantung panin aw khat a ging hi.

Zeisu in Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin Jordan gun pan a ciah ciangin, Kha Siangtho in gampa lakah paipih a,
ni sawmli tawntung dawimangpa in a kheem hi. Tua hun sung khempeuh Zeisu in an ne lo a, a ni a cin' ciangin a gil kial hi.
Dawimangpa in, "Nang in Pasian' Tapa na hih takpi leh, hih suang khomun suaksak in," a ci hi.
Zeisu in, "Mite in khomun bek tawh nungta lo hi, ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah kigelh hi," a ci hi.
Tua lai takin dawimangpa in Zeisu paipihto a, leitung gam khempeuh neukha sungin a lak hi.
"Hih vangliatnate leh amau minthan'nate kong pia ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, kei hong kipia zo a, ka piak nop mi kiangah ka pia thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, hong bia leteh hihte khempeuh nangma aa ahi ding hi," a ci hi.
Zeisu in zong, "Na Topa Pasian na bia ding hi. Ama na bek na sem ding hi, ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah kigelh hi," a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin, dawimangpa in Zeisu Jerusalem khuapi sungah paipihin, biakna innpi khum zangah a koih khit ciangin, "Nang in Pasian' Tapa na hih takpi leh, na pumpi kikiasuk sak in.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh: 'Amah in ama vantungmite nang ading thu a pia ding hi,' leh
'Na khe in suang tawh a kisuk khak loh nadingin, Amau in khut tawh nang hong dom ding uh hi,' ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah kigelh hi," a ci hi.
Zeisu in, "Na Topa Pasian na ze-et kei in,' a kici hi," a ci hi.
Dawimangpa in kheemna a vekpi-in ahih khit ciangin a kiang panin tomkha sung a paikhia hi.
Zeisu in Kha Siangtho' vangliatna tawh, Galile gamah ciahkik hi. Ama thu a kimkot gam khempeuh ah kizeelin a thang hi.
Amaute kikhopna innah thu hilh a, mi khempeuh in amah a phat uh hi.
A khan'na Nazareth khua-ah Zeisu pai a, ngeina bangin Nipi ni-in kikhopna innah lut a, Lai Siangtho sim dingin a ding hi.
Kamsangpa Isaiah' Lai Siangtho a kipiak ciangin phen a:
"Topa' Kha Siangtho in keima tungah a om hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, mizawngte kiangah Lungdamna Thu zasak dingin hong sawl zo hi. A kiman a kikhum mite a kikhah nading ahi zongin, Mittawte in khua a muh kik theih nading ahi zongin, Bawlsiatna a thuak mite khah nading ahi zongin,
Topa' hehpihna kum ahi, ci-in zaksak nading ahi zongin, Kei hong sawl zo hi," ci-in kigelhna mun a mu hi.
Lai Siangtho zial a, kikhopna inn nasempa a piak khit ciangin a tu hi. Kikhopna inn sungah a om mi khempeuh in tel takpi-in a en uh hi.
Zeisu in, "Tuni-in hih Lai Siangtho thu in note zak dingin tangtung zo hi," a ci hi.
Mi khempeuhte in Zeisu thu mang uh a, ama kam sung pan a paikhia lungsim phawn'sakna thu, lamdang a sa uh a, "Hih pa in Josef tapa hilo ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, "A tel takpi-in note in, 'Zatopa aw, nangmahmah na kidamsak in. Kapernaum khua-ah na bawlna khempeuh kote in ka zak bangun, nangma gamah zong bawl in,' ci-in thugentehna tawh kei kiangah nong ci ding uh hi.
Ke'n aman takpi kong cih-inah, kamsang kuamah peuhmah ama gamah mite in a deih kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin ke'n aman takpi kong cih-inah, Elijah khan' lai-in kum thum leh kha guk tawntung guahtui kang a, gam sung khempeuh ah kial a tun' lai takin, Israel mipawlte lakah meigong tampi a om uh hi.
Tua meigong khat beek kiangah Elijah a sawl kei hi. Sidon gam Zarephat khua a, meigong khat kiang bekah a sawl hi.
Kamsang Elisha a khan' lai takin, Israel mipawlte lakah miphak tampi a om uh hi. Ahih hangin Siriapa Na-aman longal kuamah in damna a ngah kei uh hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Kikhopna innah a om mi khempeuh in tua a zak uh ciangin, a heh mahmah uh hi.
Amaute ding-in Zeisu khua nawlah a hawlkhiat khit uh ciangin, khua omna mual dawn kui-ah bungbu sawnkhiat dingin a paipih uh hi.
Ahih hangin Zeisu in amaute lai zang pan paikhia-in a pai mang hi.

Amaute in ama thuhilhna lamdang a sa uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amah in ukpa bangin thu a hilh hi.
Tua kikhopna inn sungah kihhuai dawi kha a lut mi khat a om hi.
Amah in, "Nazareth mi Zeisu aw, kote in nang tawh bang kikum i hi hiam? Kote susia dingin hong pai na hi hiam? Nang kua mi na hih ke'n kong thei hi. Pasian' misiangtho na hi hi," ci-in aw lianpi tawh a kiko hi.
Zeisu in, "Pau kei in la, ama sung pan paikhia in," ci-in a taai hi. Dawi in amaute lai zangah amah a puksak khit ciangin, natna bawl loin ama sung pan a paikhia hi.
Mi khempeuh in lamdang a sa uh a, "Hih thu in bang thu ahi hiam? Thu tawh, vangliatna tawh, kihhuai dawite thu a piak ciangin amau a paikhia uh hi," ci-in khat leh khat a kikum uh hi.
Ama thu in a kimkot mun khempeuh ah a thang hi.

Khua a vak ciangin Zeisu paikhia a, gampa lakah a pai hi. Mihonpite in zong uh a, a kiang a tun' uh ciangin, amaute kiang pan a paikhiat loh nadingin a kho nuam uh hi.

Zeisu in amaute ngaihsutna a theih ciangin, "Note in bang hangin na lungsim sung uh ah tua bangin ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?
Bang ci leng a baih zaw hiam? 'Na mawhnate kimaisak zo hi,' ci leng a baih zaw hiam? 'Tho in la pai in,' ci leng a baih zaw hiam?
Ahih hangin Mihing Tapa in leitungah mawhna a maisak theih nading thu a neih lam na theih nadingun, 'Tho in, na lupna pua in la, na innah ciah in,'" ci-in khut leh khe sipa kiangah a ci hi.
Amah in amaute mai-ah thakhatin tho a, a lupna pua-in Pasian' min phatin a ciah hi.

Tua lai takin Zeisu in thugentehna thu a hilh-inah, "Kuamah in puan thak bek khat eukhia a, puan lui a thuap ngei kei uh hi. Tua bang a thuap leh, a puan thak keek a, puan thak bek in puan lui tawh a kilem kei ding hi.
Kuamah in savun um lui sungah leenggahtui thak a thun ngei kei hi. Tua bangin a thun leh, leenggah tui in savun tamsak ding a, leenggahtui luangkhia-in, savun zong a kisia gawp ding hi.
Leenggahtui thak savun um thak sungah a kithun ding hi.
Kuamah in leenggahtui lui a dawn khit ciangin, leenggahtui thak a duh kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Leenggahtui lui a pha hi, a ci hi," ci-in Zeisu in a gen hi.
Nipi ni khatvei Zeisu in buhlei ah a vak leh, a nungzuite in buhvui zut uh a, khut tawh nuai-in a ne uh hi.

Zeisu in, "David in ama lawmte tawh a gilkial lai takin,

Mihonpite khempeuh in Zeisu a lawn' nading a zong uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, ama tung pan vangliatna paikhia a, mi khempeuh a damsak hi.
Zeisu in a nungzuite en a, "Mizawng note in thupha na ngah ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian' Gam in note gam ahi ding hi.
Tu lai taka gilkial note in, thupha na ngah ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, gilvahna na ngah ding uh hi. Tu lai taka a kap note in thupha na ngah ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, na nui ding uh hi.
Mite in Mihing Tapa hangin note muhdah uh a, hong hawlkhiat uh a, hong kosiat uh a, na min uh hong siatsak ciangin, thupha na ngah ding uh hi.
Tua lai takin nuam un la, lungdamin na diang un. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, vantungah nop tuamna lian na ngah ding uh hi. A pute a pate un zong kamsangte tua bangin a bawlsia uh hi.
Sumhau note in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, nopna na ngah zo uh hi.
Tu lai takin an kham note in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note na gilkial ding uh hi. Tu lai taka nui note in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in thuumin na kap ding uh hi.
Mi khempeuh in note hong phat ciangin, gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a pute a pate un thuzuau kamsangte tungah tua bangin a bawl uh hi.
Ka kam a za note kiangah kong cih-inah, na galte na it un. Hong mudahte tungah thupha na bawl un.
Hong phuisamte tungah thupha na pia un.
Hong bawlsiate ading thu na ngetsak un. Na pang langkhat hong bengte, pang langkhat zong na bengsak un. Na puanza a late, na puan ak lak ding na khaam kei un.
A hong ngen khempeuhte na pia un. Na sum a late kiangah, na sum na ngen kik kei un.
Note tungah hong kibawl ding na deih bangun, mite tungah zong na bawl un.
Hong itte bek na it uh leh, bang phattuamna na nei uh hiam? Migilote in zong amau a itte a it uh hi.
Note tungah thupha hong bawl mite tung bekah thupha na bawl uh leh, bang phattuamna na nei uh hiam? Migilote in zong tua bangin ahih uh hi.
Midangte sum na leitawisak uh ciangin, hong lohkik ding ci-in, lamenin na tawisak uh leh, bang phattuamna na nei uh hiam? Migilote in zong a piak bang a ngah kik nadingin migilote a leitawisak uh hi.
Note na hih uh leh, na galte na it un, amaute tungah thupha na bawl un. Na khatpeuh ka ngah ding hi ci-in lamen loin na leitawisak un. Tua bang na hih uh leh, na noptuamna uh lian ding a, Sang Bel Pasian' tate na hi ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah in hehpihna a thukkik lo mi leh migilote a hehpih hi.
Na Pa un hehpihna lungsim a neih bangin note in zong hehpihna lungsim na nei un."
"Midangte' thu na tan kei uh leh, thu tanna tawh na kipelh ding uh hi. Midangte na mawhsak kei uh leh, mawhsakna tawh na kipelh ding uh hi. Midangte' mawhna na maisak uh leh, note mawhna a kimaisak ding hi.
Midangte na piak uh leh, note hong kipia ding hi. Seeng a, teh hoih bek tham lo, a kinengcip, a kilok a kitat a dimlet a, om na ang sung uh ah hong kisung ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, midangte na piakna uh seengin, note zong hong kipia kik ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in thugentehna a hilh-inah, "Mittawte in mittawte lam a hilh zo ding hiam? A nih mahin leihawm sungah kia ding hilo ahi uh hiam?
A nungzuite in a siapa sangin lianzaw lo hi. Ahih hangin a kicingsa-a om a nungzui khempeuhte in a siapa mah bangin ahi ding uh hi.
"Gah hoih lo a gah singkung hoih a om kei hi. Gah hoih a gah kung hoih lo a om kei hi.
Kung khempeuh a gahin kithei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, lingkungah mite in thei gah a lo ngei kei uh hi. Thangling kungah leenggah a lo ngei kei uh hi.
Miphate in ama lungsim sung sumkholna hoih sung pan a pha nate a pusuaksak hi. Mipha lote in a hoih lo sumkholna sung pan a pha lo nate a pusuaksak uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua pa' lungsim a dim bangin a kam in a gen hi."

Ka kiangah hong pai a, ka thu za a, a ngaite khempeuh in, kua mi tawh kibang ahih lam kong lak ding hi.
Amah in inn a lam ciangin, thukpi-in to a, suang tungah khuam a phut mi tawh kibang hi. Tui a khan' ciangin hawktui in tua inn a nawt hangin, pha takin kilam ahih ciangin a liingsak zo kei hi.
Ka thu a zak ciangin a zui lo mi in, khuam phut lo lei tungah inn a lam mi tawh kibang hi. Hawktui in tua inn a nawk ciangin thakhatin a puk hi. Tua inn siatna in siatna lian ahi hi," ci-in a gen hi.
