Ahi kei hi, kong ci hi. Note in zong na mawhna uh na kisikkik kei uh leh, tua mah bangin na kisia khin ding uh hi.
Tua tham loin Siloam inn sangpi puk a, a delhlup mi sawm leh giatte in Jerusalem khua sungah a om mi khempeuhte sangin mawhna a hauh zawk uh um na hi uh hiam?
Ahi kei hi, kong ci hi. Note in zong na mawhna na kisikkik kei uh leh, tua mah bangin na kisia khin ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Zeisu in hih thugentehna a gen-inah, "Mi khat in a lo lai-ah theikung khat a suan hi. Theigah zong dingin tua kung kiangah a pai hangin, gah a om kei hi.
"Topa in lo nasempa kiangah, 'En in, kum thum tua theikung' gah zong dingin kong pai hangin ka mu kei hi. Na phuk in. Bang hangin lei a nainawngsak hiam?' ci-in thu a pia hi.
Lo nasempa in, 'Topa aw, tukum hici koih phot dih in. Keimah in a phung kimkot ah tovungin, eklei ka sung ding hi.
Tu nung ciangin gah hong gah leh, a hoih hi. Ahih kei leh na phuk ding hi,' a ci hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Nipi ni khatin Zeisu in kikhopna inn sungah thu a hilh hi.
Tua lai-ah kum sawm leh kum giat a cina numei khat a om hi. Ama nung kulgawp a, a pum neukha beek a kizan thei kei hi.
Zeisu in tua numei a muh ciangin sam a, "Numei aw, nang na cinatna pan hong kikhah ta hi," a cih khit ciangin a tungah a khut a ngak leh,
thakhatin a pumpi tang a, Pasian' min a phat hi.
Zeisu in Nipi ni-in cina a damsak man-inah kikhopna inn ukpa heh a, mihonpite kiangah, "Nasep nadingin ni guk a om hi. Tua nite sungin hong pai un la, cidamna na ngah ding uh hi. Nipi ni-in hong pai kei un," ci-in a gen hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in, "Mi simtatte aw, no na vekpi-un Nipi ni-in na bawng ahi zongin, na la ahi zongin, buk sung pan khahkhia-in tui ne dingin paipih hilo na hi uh hiam?
Kum sawm leh kum giat Satan in a hencip Abraham' tanu hih numei in Nipi ni-in kikhah tuak hilo ahi hiam?" ci-in a gen hi.
Zeisu in hih thu a gen ciangin, a galte a vekpi-un a zum uh hi. Mihonpite khempeuh in ama bawlna pha hangin a nuam uh hi.
Zeisu in, "Pasian' Gam in bang tawh kibang ahi hiam? Bang tawh ka genteh ding hiam?
Mi khat in huanah a cin ankam tang tawh kibang hi. Ankam tang khangin kung suak a, vana vasate in a hiangah a tuang thei uh hi," a ci hi.
Khatvei Zeisu in, "Pasian' Gam in bang tawh ka genteh ding hiam?
Numei khat in buhneel seeng thum a pawm khit mateng a sawh silngo tawh kibang hi," a ci hi.
Zeisu in khuapi leh khuaneu ah pai kawikawi a, thu hilhin Jerusalem khuapi zuanin a zin hi.
Mi khat in, "Topa aw, gupna ngahte tawm ding ahi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Zeisu in, "Kong kawciik ah na lut zawh nadingun hahkat un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tampi in a lut nop ding uh hangin a lut zo kei ding uh hi, kong ci hi.
Inn neipa tho a, kongkhak a khak khit ciangin, inn pua lamah ding-in kong na kiu uh a, 'Topa aw, kong hong hon' in,' na cih uh hangin topa in, 'Note kuami na hi uh hiam ke'n kong thei kei hi,' hong ci ding hi.
Tua lai takin note in, 'Nang tawh an i ne tui i dawn khawm zo hi. Ko khua lamzingte ah thu na hilh ngei hi,' ci-in na gen uh hangin,
topa in, 'Note kuami na hi uh hiam, ke'n kong thei kei hi. Mawhna ahih te aw, kei kiang pan paikhia un kong ci hi,' ci-in hong gen ding hi.
Abraham, Isaak leh Jakob-te akipan, Pasian' kamsangte khempeuh in Pasian' Gam sungah a om na muh uh ciangin, note in hawlkhiatna na thuak ding uh a, kahna leh hagawina om ding hi.
Ni suahna lam leh ni tumna lam pan, khang lam leh sak lam panin amaute hong pai ding uh a, Pasian' Gam sungah a tu ding uh hi.
A nunung kim khatte in a masa ding uh hi." a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Farisaite kimkhat hong pai uh a, "Paikhia in la, tai in. Herod in nang hong that nuam hi," a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, "Pai un la, 'Tuni leh zingsang ciangin dawi ka hawlkhia ding a, cinatna ka damsak ding a, ni thum ni-in ka kikhin ding hi,' ci-in tua ngia kiangah na hilh un.
Ahih hangin tuni, zing ciang leh thai ciangin ka pai ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, kamsangpa in Jeursalem khua sim loh mun dangah a si thei kei ding hi."
"Pasian' kamsangte that a, na kiangah hong kisawlte zong suang tawh a deeng Jerusalem, Jerusalem khuapi aw, akpi in a nongeekte a kha nuai-ah a khop bangin, na tate tamveipi ka khawm nuam zo a; nang na ut kei hi.
En in, na inn in mi om lo gam simthamin kinusia ding hi. Ke'n kong cih-inah: 'Pasian' min tawh hong paipa in thupha ngah ta hen,' na cih matengin kei nong mu kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Nipi ni khatvei Zeisu in Farisaite upa khat' inn sungah an ne dinga a lut ciangin, amaute in amah a en uh hi.
Tuipuak natna vei khat in ama mai-ah a om hi.
Zeisu in, "Nipi ni-in cinatna damsak tuak ahi hiam, damsak tuak lo ahi hiam?" ci-in thukham siate leh Farisaite kiangah a dot ciangin pau loin a om uh hi.
Tua ciangin, Zeisu in tua pa a damsak khit ciangin a paikhiasak hi.
Zeisu in, "Mi khat in la ahi zongin, bawng ahi zongin nei a, Nipi ni-in leihawm sungah kia leh, thakhatin a lakhia lo ding note lakah kua ahi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin,
amau in a dawng kik thei kei uh hi.
A kisamte in tokhom sangbel a teel uh Zeisu in a muh ciangin, amaute kiangah thugentehna a hilh-inah,
"Mi khatpeuh in mo la lawmvakna-ah note hong sap ciangin, tokhom a sang belna-ah na tu kei un. Tua bangin na tut leh, nangmah sangin a lianzaw khat kisam kha a;
hong sampa leh amah hong pai-in, 'Hih pa ading omna na awn in,' hong ci ding hi. Tua ciangin zumna tawh a niampen munah na tu ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh in hong sap ciangin pai in la, omna niam ah na tu in. Nang hong sampa hong pai ciangin, 'Lawm aw, a sangah na tuto in,' hong ci ding hi. Tua lai takin, nang tawh an a ne khawm mi khempeuhte mai-ah minthan'na na ngah ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ama pumpi a phat mi khempeuh in niamkhiatna a ngah ding uh hi. A kiniamkhiat mi in minphatna a ngah ding uh hi," a ci hi.
A sampa kiangah Zeisu in, "Sun an ahi zongin, nitak an ahi zongin na vaak ciangin, na lawmte ahi zongin, na u na nau ahi zongin, na beh na phung ahi zongin, sumhau na inn veengte ahi zongin na sam kei in. Tua bangin na sap leh, amaute in nang hong sam kikin, nang hong thuk ding uh hi.
Pawi na kham ciangin mizawngte, mipoite, khebaite leh mittawte na sam in.
Amaute in nang hong thukkik nading bangmah nei lo uh ahih ciangin, thupha na ngah ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, midikte' thawhkik ni ciangin nang hong kithukkik ding hi," a ci hi.
Zeisu tawh an a nekhawm mi khat in tua thu a zak ciangin, "Pasian' Gam sungah an a nei dingte in thupha ngah ding hi," a cih leh,
Zeisu in, "Mi khat in pawipi kham a, mi tampi a sam hi.
An nek a hun ciangin, 'Hong pai un. Tu-in na khempeuh a baihsa-in om hi,' ci-in a khohsate kiangah gen dingin a nasempa a sawl hi.
Amaute khempeuh in kithutuakin kam a zong uh hi. A masa pen in, 'Lo ciing khat ka lei a, pai-in ka va en ding hi. Kei hong maisak in,' ci-in a ngen hi.
Khat in, 'Ke'n bawng kap nga ka nei zo hi. Tel-et dingin ka va pai ding hi. Kei hong maisak in,' ci-in thu a ngen hi.
Khat leuleu in, 'Ke'n zi ka pi zo hi. Tua ahih ciangin kong hawh man kei ding hi,' a ci hi.
Nasempa ciah a, tua thu khempeuh a topa a zasak hi. Tua lai takin inn teekpa heh a, "Khua sung lamlian ah ahi zongin, lamneu ah ahi zongin pai in la, mizawngte, mipoite, mittawte, khebaite hong tumpih in,' ci-in a nasempa sawl hi.
A nasempa in, 'Topa aw, na cih mah bangin ka sap hangin omna a awng lai hi,' a ci hi.
A topa in, 'Ka inn a dim nadingin lampi leh lo lamah pai in la, amaute zawhthawhna tawh hong tumsak in.
Ke'n kong cih-inah, a kikhosate ahih uh leh, khat beek in ka an a ciam kei ding hi,' ci-in a nasempa thu a pia hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Tua lai takin mihonpite in Zeisu tawh a paikhawm uh hi.
Amah kihei a, "Kei kiangah hong pai nuamte in a nute, a pate, a zite, a tate, a sanggampate, a sanggamnute ahi zongin, tua tham loin ama nuntakna nangawn a muhdah kei leh, keima nungzui a suak zo kei ding hi.
A singlamteh pua a, ka nung hong zui lote in keima nungzui a suak zo kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mi khat in inn sangpi a lam nop leh, a zawhzawh nading dangka a nei hiam ci-in a masa-in tu-in, a sim phot lo note lakah kua om ahi hiam?
Ahih kei leh, a khuam a phuh khit ciangin, inn a zop zawh kei leh, a mu mi khempeuh in
"Hih pa in inn lam ding a kipat khit ciangin a zom zo kei hi,' ci-in amah a ko ding uh hi.
Ahih kei leh, kumpi khat in adang kumpipa tawh kido dingin a paikhiat ciangin, then nih tawh hong kuante then khat tawh nang zo ding hiam ci-in a masa-in tu-a lungngai lo kumpi om ding hiam?
A zawh kei ding leh, adang kumpipa gamla-ah a om lai takin upa sawl a, gal kilem nading thu a ngen ding hi.
Tua mah bangin note lakah mi khatpeuh in a neihsa khempeuh a nusiat kei leh, ka nungzui a suak zo kei ding hi."
"Tua ahih ciangin ci apha hi. Ahih hangin a alna a man' leh, bangci a al kik ding hiam?
Lei ading ahi zongin, eekkholna ading ahi zongin apha kei hi. Mite in pua lamah a paikhia uh hi. Zak nading bil a nei teng in na za ta un!" a ci hi.
Tua lai takin siahdongte leh migilote khempeuh in Zeisu' thu ngai dingin a kiangah a nai uh hi.
Farisaite leh laitheite in , "Hihpa in migilote ngai a, amau tawh an a nekhawm hi,' ci-in a ko uh hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in hih thugentehna a gen-inah,
"Mi khat in tuu zakhat nei a, tuu khat a man'sak leh, tuu sawmkua leh kua gam lakah nusia-in a mang tuu khat a muh matengin a zong lo ding note lakah kua ahi hiam?
A muh kik ciangin lungdamin a liangko ah pua a, inn a tun' ciangin,
a lawmte leh a inn veengte sam a, 'Hong lungdampih ta un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ka man'suahsa tuu ka mukik zo hi,' a ci hi.
Ke'n kong cih-inah, tua bangin vantungah kisikkikna kisam a kisa lo sawmkua leh kuate sangin, mawhna a kisik migilo khat tungah nuamna a lianzaw hi."
"Lam khat panin, numei khat in dangka sawm nei a, khat a man'suah leh' meivak vakin a muh matengin a inn phiatin a zong kawikawi lo ding kua ahi hiam?
A muhkik ciangin a lawmte leh a inn veengte sam a, 'Hong lungdampih ta un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ka man'suahsa dangka ka mukik zo hi,' a ci hi.
Ke'n kong cih-inah, tua mah bangin a kisikkik mawhneipa khat hangin Pasian' vantungmite' omna munah nuamna a om ding hi," a ci hi.
Khatvei Zeisu in, "Mi khat in tapa nih a nei hi.
A taneu in a pa kiangah va pai a, 'Pa aw, ka ngah dinga kilawm luahna sum hong pia in,' ci-in a ngen hi. A pa in a tate tungah a sum hawmsak hi.
Tua nung ciangin sawtvei kihal loin a taneu in ama sum khempeuh khawm a, gamlapi gamah pai-in tua santak ah noptatna lamsang uang lua ahih ciangin, a sum teng a zang khin hi.
A sum khempeuh a beikhit ciangin tua gamah nakpi-in kial tung a, amah in nakpi a zawng hi.
Tua lai takin amah pai-in tua gam mi khat beel a, vok cing dingin a topa in lo lamah a sawl hi.
Amah in vok an nek begapte nangawn duhgawhin a nekpih nuam hi. Ahih hangin kuamah in an a pia kei hi.
A lungngaih kik ciangin, 'Ka pa' inn sungah nasemte khamval bangzah tak a om hiam! Kei ka hih leh hih gamah gilkialin puksi dek takin ka om hi.
Kei thoin ciah ning! Ka pa kiangah, 'Pa aw, Pasian tung leh nangma mai-ah ka khial zo hi.
Tu-a kipanin na ta kicih nadingin ka kilawm kei hi. Nangma nasemte khat mah bangin hong koih in, ka ci ding hi,' a ci hi.
Tua lai takin tho a, a pa kiangah va ciah hi. Ahih hangin inn pan gamlapi-ah a om lai takin a pa in mu a, hehpihhuai sa-in delh meengmeeng a, a ta ngawngkawi-in a nam hi.
A ta in, 'Pa aw, Pasian tung leh nangma mai-ah ka khial zo hi. Tu-a kipanin na ta kicih nadingin ka kilawm kei hi,' a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a pa in, 'Puan hoih bel hong la meengmeeng un la, silhsak un. Ama khut ah zungbuhte hong butsak un.
Khedap zong bulhsak un. Bawngno a thau hong paipihin go un la, an ne-in nuamsa ni.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a sisa ka tapa a nungta kik hi. A mangsa ahih hangin tu-in kimu kik hi,' ci-in a nasemte a sawl hi. Amaute in lungdamin pawi a kham uh hi."
"A tapa lianzaw in lo kuanin a om hi. Amah hong ciah a, inn a naih ciangin lasakna leh laamna hu ging a za hi.
Nasemte khat sam a, 'Hih a ging bang ahi hiam?' ci-in a dong hi.
Nasempa in, 'Na naupa hong ciah zo hi. Cidamin na pa in mu kik ahih ciangin bawngno thau a go zo hi,' ci-in a gen hi.
Ahih hangin amah heh a, inn sungah a lut nuam kei hi. A pa pusuakin a zol hi.
A ta in, 'Hih tanvei, kum sawtpi nangma na ka sem zo hi. Nangma thukham khat beek ka khial kei hi. Ahih hangin ka lawmte tawh nopna ka bawl nadingin keelno khat zong khatvei beek nong pia ngei kei hi.
Ahih hangin numei gilote tawh kikhawla na sum na pai a mangsak, na tapa hong tun' ciangin ama ading bawngno thau na gawhsak hi,' a ci hi.
A pa in, 'Ta aw, keimah tawh na om tawntung a, ka neih ka lam khempeuh nangma neih nangma lam ahi hi.
Ahih hangin, na nau ahih leh tuma-in a si hi, tu-in a nungta kik hi. Tuma-in a mang hi, tu-in a kimu kik ahih man-inah nopna leh lungdamna bawl tuak hi,' ci-in a gen hi," ci-in a hilh hi.
Khatvei Zeisu in a nungzuite kiangah, "Sumhaupa khat in sumkempa khat a nei hi. Tua sumkempa in a topa sum a thangbawl thu midangte in topa kiangah a ko uh hi.
A topa in sumkempa sam a, 'Nang thu ka zak teng bangci thu ahi hiam? Na sumkep ciamtehna lai hong pia in. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, sumkep na nasem nawn kei ding hi,' a ci hi.
Sumkempa in, 'Tu-in ka topa in sumkep za panin hong kiasak zo ahih ciangin, bang ka ci hih ding hiam? Lo laih nading tha ka nei kei hi. Khutdawh ngen dingin ka maizum hi.
Sumkepna za hong kiatsak khit ciangin, midangte in amau innah hong tun'sak nadingun bang ka ci hih ding hiam ka thei ta hi,' ci-in a ngaihsun hi.
Tua khit ciangin a topa' sum bate a vekpi-un sam a, 'Ka topa kiangah leiba bangzah loh ding a om hiam?' ci-in a masa penpa a dong hi.
Amah in, 'Sathau langva phel zakhat ka ba hi,' ci hi. Sumkempa in, 'Na kiciamna lai la in la, tu-in sawmnga at meegmeeng in,' a ci hi.
Midang khat kiangah, 'Nang in bangzah na ba hiam" ci-in a dot ciangin amah in, 'Mangbuh seeng zakhat ka ba hi," a ci hi. Sumkempa in, 'Na kiciamna lai la in la, sawmgiat na at ding hi,' a ci hi.
Thuman lo sumkempa in pilna tawh ahih ciangin a topa in a phat hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, leitung' tate in amau khang lakah khuavak' tate sangin a pil zaw uh hi.
Ke'n kong cih-inah, aman lo sum tawh lawmte na ngah ding uh hi. Tua hi leh, tua sumte a bei ciangin a om tawntung buk sungah amaute in a hong tungsak ding uh hi."
"Thu neute tungah a diktat mi in, thu liante tungah a diktat ding hi. Thu neute tungah a diktat lo mi in thu liante tungah a diktat kei ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin leitunga a naman lo sum tungah na diktat kei uh leh, sum taktak kua in no hong kemsak ding hiam?
Midangte' sum tungah na diktat kei uh leh, kua in note sum hong kemsak ding hiam?
To nih' na a sem khawm zo nasempa a om kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a tote khat mudahin khat a it ding hi. Khat beelin khat a simmawh ding hi. Note in Pasian' na leh leitung sum na nasem khawm zo kei ding uh hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Dangka a deihgawh Farisaite in hih thu khempeuh a zak uh ciangin Zeisu a zahko uh hi.
Zeisu in, "Note in mite mai-ah phatna na lak nuam uh hi. Ahih hangin Pasian in note lungsim uh a thei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mite phatna in Pasian mai-ah kihhuaina ahi hi."
'Johan hong pai dongin Pasian' Thukham leh Pasian' kamsangte thu akipanin Pasian' Gam Lungdamna Thu kihilh a, mi khempeuh in tua gam sungah zawhthawh bawlin a lut nuam uh hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian' Thukham neupen a kipaihkhiat ding sangin, van leh lei a man'than nading a baihzaw ding hi."
"A zi ma-a numei dang tawh a kiteengte in numei tawh a mawh hi. Pasal tawh a kikhensa numei a teen'pihte in numei tawh a mawh hi."
"Nidang lai-inah sumhaupa khat a om hi. Tua pa in puansan leh saihadial puan silhin ni simin nuamin an pha bel ne-in a om hi.
Lazaras kici mizawng khat in a pumtangin meima vei a; sumhaupa' kongbiang kiangah,
a sabuai tung pan an neng kiate a ngen hi. Uite in zong pai a, a meimate a liak uh hi.
Tua nung ciangin mizawngpa si a, vantungmite in Abraham' ang ah a pua uh hi.
Sumhaupa zong si a, a kivui hi. Meikuang sungah gimna nakpi a thuak lai takin a khuadak leh, Abraham leh Abraham' ang ah Lazaras a om gamlapi panin a gal muh hi.
'Pa Abraham aw, kei hong hehpih in, Lazaras in a khutme dawn tui ah diah hen la, ka lei hong votsak nadingin ka kiangah hong sawl in. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, hih meikuang sungah gimna nakpi ka thuak hi,' ci-in a kiko hi.
Abraham in, 'Ka ta aw, nang na nuntak lai-in nopsakna na ngah a, tua mah bangin Lazaras in zong a pha lo nate ngah hi ci-in na ngaihsun kik in. Tu-in ahih leh, amah in nopna a ngah kik hi. Nang na hih leh, gimna na thuak hi.
Tua tham loin nang leh ko kikalah a thuk mahmah guam khat a om hi. Tua ahih ciangin hih santak panin nangma kiangah a galkah nuamte in, a galkah zo kei uh hi. Tua santak pan ko kiangah hong galkah nuamte in zong hong galkah zo kei uh hi,' a ci hi.
Sumhaupa in, 'Pa aw, tua bang ahih leh, keimah in sanggam nga ka nei hi.
Amaute in hih gimna sungah a tun' loh nading thu a hilh dingin ka pa' innah Lazaras nong sawlsak nadingin kong ngen hi,' a ci hi.
Abraham in, 'Amaute in Moses leh Pasian' kamsangte a nei uh hi.
Tuate thu ngai ta hen,' a ci hi. Sumhaupa in, 'Hi kei, pa Abraham aw, mi sisa khat hong thokikin amaute kiangah a pai leh, amaute in mawhna a kisikkik ding uh hi,' a ci hi.
Abraham in, 'Tuate in Moses' thu leh Pasian' kamsangte' thu a ngaih kei uh leh, mi khat in sihna pan a hingkik zongin a taksang kei ding uh hi,' a ci hi," ci-in Zeisu in a gen hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in a nungzuite kiangah, "Puk nading om loh na'ng thu a om kei hi. Ahih hangin a puksakpa in gimna a thuak ding hi.
Hih naupangte khatpeuh a puksakpa in a ngawngah an-gawina suang khihin tuipi thuk sungah tumcip leh, ama ading a hoih zaw ding hi.
Note na kikem un. Na u na nau in a khialh leh, thu hilhin na taai in. A kisik kik leh, a mawhna na maisak in.
Ni khatin na tungah sagih vei hong khialh khit ciangin hong kihei a, sagih vei dongin, 'Ka kisikkik hi,' hong cih leh, ama khialhna na maisak in," a ci hi.
Sawltakte in, "Komau' upna khangsak ta in," ci-in Topa kiangah a gen uh hi.
Topa in, "Note in ankamtang khat cia bang upna nei le-uhteh hih theikung kiangah, 'Zung tawh kibotkhia-in tuipi sungah na po in,' na cih uh leh, na thu uh a mang ding hi."
"Note in nasem khat nei-in, lo kuanin ahi zongin, tuu cingin ahi zongin hong ciah ciangin ama kiangah, 'Thakhatin hong pai in la, an nekna sabuai ah hong tu in,' a ci ding no lakah kua ahi hiam?
'Keima an nek ding hong bawl in; an ka nek tui ka dawn khit matengin kawnggak in la, an hong pia in. Tua nung ciangin nangin an ne-in tui na dawn ding hi,' ci-in nasempa kiangah gen ding hilo ahi hiam?
Nasempa in a topa thupiak bangin a hih maninah a topa in a phat hiam?
Tuamah bangin note in zong thu khempeuh hong piak bang na hih khit uh ciangin, 'Kote in a pha bawl lo nasemte ka hi uh hi. Nasemte ka hih uh ciangin a kituak bek ka hih zo uh hi,' na ci ding uh hi," ci-in a gen hi.

Nang ding in la, pai in. Na thu upna in nang hong damsak zo hi," a ci hi.

Tua mah bangin, Lot a khan' lai takin amaute in an ne tui dawn, sum lei sum zuak, an tuh inn lamin a om uh hi.
