Judah gam kumpi Jotham, Ahaz, leh Hezekiahte' hun laitakin, Moresheth khuami Mikah tungah Topa in hih bangin thupia hi. Samaria leh Jerusalem tawh kisai-in Topa in Mikah tungah hih thute lak hi.
No minam khempeuhte aw, hih thu za un. Leitunga teeng mi khempeuh aw, hih thu ngai un. Note' lang khatah Topa Pasian in teci pang a, a vantung biakinn panin thu hong gen hi.
Ama mun siangtho panin Topa hong pai a, amah in leitung mualsang dawnte hong siksuk ding hi.
Meikhuk sunga khuainun kikoih bangin, ama khe nuai-ah mual liante tuisuak ding a, mual tung panin tui a luan'sak bangin, guam sungah tua mualte luang suk ding hi.
Pasian tungah Israelte' mawhna leh khialhna hangin hih thute khempeuh piang hi. Israelte' khialhna kua ngawh ding i hi hiam? Samaria mite ngawh ding ahi hiam? Judah gam sungah milim bia-a khial kua ahi hiam? Jerusalem mite ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Samaria khuapi, gamlaka ninkholna mun, leenggui suan'na mun lel dingin ka bawl ding hi. A khua sunga suangte zong guam sungah ka nil suk ding a, a khuapi bulpite ka dawksak ding hi.
A milim manphate khempeuh kisuzanin, mei tawh kisusia ding hi. Pasian tungah a thuman lohna hangun mihingte in hih milimte nei uh ahih manun, a paktatna uh tawh kizui-in tu-in thuak kik ding uh hi, ci hi.
Tua ahih manin kei kapin ka thuum ding a, ka dahna thu ka lah nadingin khe guak leh guaktangin ka vak ding hi. Gam-ui bangin ka ham ding a, kalaoh-vasa bangin ka tau ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Samaria' meima kidamsak thei lo a, Judah in zong tua bangmah a thuak ding ahi ta hi. Ka mite' teen'na Jerusalem khua kongpi mahmah, tua siatna in hong ban ta hi.
I guallelhna, Gath khuamite theisak kei un la, na kahna uh amaute musak kei un. Bethle-afrah khua sungah na lungkhamna uh langsakin, leivui lakah kikhuk un.
Shafir khua-a teeng mite aw, guaktangin maizumna tawh salin pai un. Za-anan khua-a teeng mite, a hingin paikhia ngei lo ding hi. Beth-ezel khuamite kahna leh thuumna na zak uh ciangin, tua khua sungah belh ding munmuanhuai a om lohna na thei ding uh hi.
Topa in Jerusalem kulh kongpi ciang dongah, gimna lianpi tungsak ta ahih manin Maroth khuamite in thuhoih lamenin gim uh hi.
Lakhish khua-a teeng mite aw, na sakol galkapte uh a leng bulh pak un. Note in Zion tanute' khialhna teng zui kha na hih manun, Jerusalem zong a khialsakte na hi uh hi.
Tu-in no Judah mite aw, Moreseth-gath khua, mangpha khak un. Israel kumpite tungah Akzib khua in a zuauthei khat ahi hi.
Mareshah khuamite aw, note a hong zo dingpa ka hong paisak ding hi. Topa in ci hi. Adullam leihawm sungah Israel kumpipa bu ding hi.
Judah mite aw, na it mahmah uh na tate uh, sal-in hong kilaksak ding ahih manin, amaute hangin na dahna lim-un na sam uh met un la, musane bangin na lu uh tolsak un.
A lupna tungah lumin gitlohna a geelgeelte in gimna ngah ta hen. Zingsang khua a vak ciangin, a hih theih ding hun a ngah phetun, a ngaihsutsa uh gitlohnate semkhia uh hi.
Lo deih le uh, mi' aa sut uh a, inn deih le uh, mi' aa mah sut uh hi. Mite bawlsia-in, a inn leh a neihsa sut uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Note tungah gimna tun'sak ding ka ngaihsun a, tua gimna tawh na kipelh thei kei ding uh hi. Note' adingin hun hoih lo hi ding ahih manin, na kiphatsak gamtat nawn kei ding uh hi.
Tua bang hun hong tun' ciangin, mite in note' gim ngahna thu gentehna-in zangin, dah la phuakin sa ding uh a, "Eite i sia khin taktak hi. Topa in i gam hong laksak a, ei hong mante tungah hong piaksak hi," ci ding uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa' mite lakah leitang a kihawm ciangin, kuamah in aisaanna tawh leitang na ngah kha kei ding uh hi.

Ahi zongin Topa in hih bangin hong ci hi: Note in ka mite' gal na suak uh a, gal sung panin a hong ciahkik, lungmuanga a om mite' puantualpi ngahte na sut uh hi.
Ka mihingte' numeite amau' inn nuam panin na hawlkhia uh a, a tate un a ngah ding keima thuphate na taan paisuak sak uh hi.
Tu-in ding un la paikhia un. Na khialhna hangun a lauhuai suksiatna tuak ding na hih manun, hih lai mun in note adingin tawlngakna mun hi lo hi.
Ahi zongin no Israel mi a om laite khempeuh pel loin kong kaikhawm kik taktak ding hi. Tuubuk sunga tuu khum bangin, gankhawk sunga tuuhon kaihkhop bangin, note kong kaikhawm kik ding a, na gam sung uh, mi tampite' husa tawh kidim kik ding hi, ci hi.
Pasian in lampi hong hon'sakin, na maiah hong paikhiatpih ding hi, Salsuahna khuapi kulh kongpi panin paikhia-in na suakta ding uh hi. Kumpi ahi Topa mahmah in hong makaih ding hi.
Israel a uk makaite aw, hih thu ngai un. Note in thutang thuman a deih dinga kilawm hi napi-in,
thuhoih deih loin thusia na deih zawsop uh hi. Note in mite vun na hing hawkkhiat uh a, a guh uh na hing kheuh uh hi.
Ka mite' sa na netum uh hi. A vun uh hawkin, a guh uh na satkham uh a, beel-a meh huan ding bangin na satnen gawp uh hi.
Topa tungah huhna ngenin na kiko hun uh hong tung ding a, ahi zongin amah in note hong dawng lo ding hi. Note gamtatsia na hih manun, na ngetna uh hong ngai lo ding hi.
Sum a pia zo mite kiangah thunuam gen a, a pia lo mite kiangah, gal tuah ding a gen, kamsangte in mite lam khialsak uh hi. Topa in tua bang kamsangte kiangah,
"Ka mite lam khialsak na hih manun, mailam thugen theihna maang na mu nawn kei ding uh a, bangmah na genkhol thei nawn kei ding uh hi. Kamsangte aw, note' hun bei ta ding a, ni in hong tumsan ta ding hi," ci hi.
Kamsanngte in maizumna thuak ding uh a, thu-mu theite in zumna thuak ding uh hi; amaute in a muk uh hum ding uh hi, bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian' dawnna om lo hi.
Ahi zongin kei ka hih leh, Israel mite tungah a mawhna uh a gen khia dingin, Topa' Kha vangliatna tawh kidimin, thutang gen ngamna lungsim ka nei hi.
Ngai un! Israel a uk makaite aw, Note in thutang deih loin, thuman kimlai a khialin na hei uh hi.
Mi thahna leh thuman lohna tawh, Pasian' khuapi, Jerusalem na lam uh hi.
Khuapi ukte in sumgolh ngah nading bekin thu khenin, siampite in sum ngah nading bekin thu gen uh a, kamsangte in zong sum ngah theih nading bek mahin, mailam thu genkhol uh hi. Tua bang hi napi-in amaute in Topa, muan'in nei uh a, "Topa in eite hong ompih a, i tungah siatna hong tung lo ding hi," ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin note hangin, lo khawh bangin Zion kikho-in, Jerusalem, nin kipaihna phualpi suak ding a, biakinn omna mual, gamlak suak ding hi.
Mai lam hunah, Topa' biakinn a omna mual, a sang pen mual hong suak ding a, minam tampi in hong zuan ding uh hi.
Minam tampite hong pai-in, "Jakob' Pasian' biakinn, Topa' mualah va paito ni. Tua lai-ah ama deihna hong hilh ding a, ama deihna bangin i gamta ding hi," ci ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Zion panin thuhilhna hong ging khia a, Jerusalem panin Topa' thu hong pai khia hi.
Amah in minam tampite' thu khensak ding a, Israel gam panin a gamla peka om, minam vangliante' thu khensak ding hi. Amaute in a namsaute uh lo khawhna tu-in seek ding uh a, a teipite uh singhiang heuhna temkawi-in seek ding uh hi. Minam khat leh khat kido nawn lo ding uh a, gal kidona thei kha nawn lo ding uh hi.
A kuamah peuh lungnuamin, a leenggui phung leh a theikung nuai-ah ta hithiat ding a, kuamah in patausak nawn lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa' kam mahmah in hih thu gen khin ta hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khempeuh in, amau' pasian ciat bia-in a thu mang ding uh a, ahi zongin eite in i hih leh i Topa Pasian a tawntungin bia-in a thu i mang ding hi.
Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Tua ni ciangin keimah in khebaite kaikhawmin, a kihawlkhiate leh gimna ka thuaksak mite ka kaikhawm ding hi.
Khebaite ka om sak lai ding a, a kipaikhia mite a thahat minamte ka hisak ding hi. Tua hun akipan a tawntungin, Zion Mual panin amaute ka uk paisuak ding hi.
Pasian in a mite a etna Jerusalem khuapi aw, nidang a, na vangliatna ngah kikin, kumpi khuapi na suak kik ding hi.
Bang hangin tu-in nakpi-in kap a, numei nausuak ding bangin na sa na hi hiam? Kumpi nei lo a, na thulamlakte si ahi hiam?
Jerusalem khuamite aw, numei nausuak ding bangin tha saan un. Tu-in khuapi nusia-in, gam sung khua-ah a teeng ding na hi ta uh a, Babilon khuapi a zuan ta ding na hi uh hi. Ahi zongin tua lai-ah note hong kihonkhia-in, na galte uh khut sung panin Topa in hong tankhia ding hi.
Ahi zongin hih minamte in Topa' lungsim tawng thei lo uh a, ancilna phualah anphalte kaihkhop bangin, kaikhawmin a cil gawp ding ahih lam phawk lo uh hi.
Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Jerusalem khuamite aw, kipan un la, na galte uh sugawp un. Sumngo khe leh sik ki a nei bawngtal bangin note kong thahatsak ding hi. Minam tampite' na sugawp zo ding uh a, amau' neihsa teng keima aa na suaksak ding uh a, amau' hauhna teng, leitung khempeuhte' Topa' neihsa na suaksak ding uh hi.
Jerusalem khuamite aw, na kulh sung uhah lut un. Eite hong ki-umcih a, Israel makaipa' biang ciang tawh sat ding uh hi.
Bethlehem Efrathah khua aw, nang in Judah gamah khuaneupen khat na hi a, ahi zongin nang' sung panin Israel a uk ding khat ka piangsak ding hi. Ama gui in nidang lai, taangtawng pek tawh kizom hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, numei naupai nu, a nau a suah khit mateng, amau' galte khut sungah Topa in amaute pia phot hi. Ama hong khan' ciangin, sal-a om a gam mite, a mipihte uh tawh hong kigawm kik ding hi.
Amah in Topa' thahatna tawh a tuute uk ding a, Topa ama Pasian' min vangliatna tawh uk ding hi. Leitung mi khempeuh in ama liatna phawk ding uh ahih manin, ama mite lungmuang takin om thei ding uh hi.
Amah in lungnopna hong omsak ding hi. Assiria mite in i gam hong simin, i gal dalna teng hong suk ciangin amaute a do dingin, i makai hatpen teng i sawl ding hi.
A namsau uh tawh Assiria gam zo-in Nimrod gam zo ding uh a, Assiria mite in i gamgi dong hong sim ciangin amaute' kiang panin eite hong honkhia ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin a om lai Israel mite pen, Topa in minam tampite' adingin a piak, zing daitui, lopate a khangsak guahtui bang ding uh hi. Amaute in mihing muanin nei loin Pasian bek muang ding uh hi.
A om lai Israel mite pen minam dangte lakah, gamlakah sa a beng, tuute a tuah ciangin manin balnen gawp a, a kam sung pan a honkhia zo a om lo, humpinelkai bang ding uh hi.
Israel mite in a galte' tungah a khutte uh lamto-in, a gal khempeuh uh zo gawpin susia mang ding uh hi.
Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Tua hun ciangin na sakolte uh hong paihkhiatsakin, na leengte uh ka susia ding hi.
Na gam sung uh-a khuapite susia-in, na galpan'na munte uh ka phelkhia ding hi.
Na mitphial siamnate uh susia-in, ai saan thei kong omsak nawn kei ding hi.
Note in na biak uh milimte leh na biakna songte ka susia gawp ding a, note' bawlsa nate na bia nawn kei ding uh hi.
Na gam sung uhah a om Asherah biakna songte botkhia-in na milimte uh ka susia ding hi.
Ka thu hong mang lo minamte tungah hehna tawh phu ka la ding hi.
Topa leh Israel a kitotna ngai un. Topa aw, kipan in la, mual liante leh mual neute mai-ah, na thu sung in.
No mual liante leh a kip tawntung leitung bulpite aw, Topa a kinialna thu ngai un. Topa in ama mite tawh thu nei a, Israel tawh thu kisel ding hi.
Topa in hih bangin thu sung a, "Ka mite aw, note bang hong cih kha ka hi hiam? Bang thu-ah note hong lunggimsak ka hi hiam? Tu-in hong dawng dih un!
Bang hang hiam cih leh, Izipt gam panin note kong paikhiatpih a, salsuahna panin note ka hong tankhia hi. Note hong makai dingin, Moses, Aaron, leh Miriam ka hong sawl hi.
Ka mite aw, Moab Kumpi Balak in note suk nading a vaihawmna teng, leh Beor' tapa Balaam in ama nget bangin a sepna teng, limtakin phawk kik un. Note hotkhiat nadingin ka sepna thu na theih nadingun, Shittim leh Gilgal kikal-a thu piangte ngaihsun kik un," a ci hi.
Vantung Pasian ahi Topa mai-ah bang va keng ding ka hi hiam? Amah biakna-in hal dingin kum khat a pha bawngno thaute paipih ding ka hi hiam?
Topa kiangah, tuu a tul tulin va puakin, gun tui bangin sathau va luangsak leng, tuate tawh amah lungdam ding ahi hiam? Ka mawhnate maisak nadingin ka ta upa pen tawh va bia ding ka hi hiam?
Mun khempeuh-a om no mihingte aw, Topa in a hoih nate hong gen khin zo hi. Topa in note tung panin hong kalh nate in: thuman thute sem ding a, itna kip nei tawntungin, kiniamkhiatna tawh Pasian' thu man' ding ahi hi.
Khuapi lamah Topa kiko hi; mipil in ama min a zahtak ding ahi hi: Aw, minamte leh khuapi-a kikhawm mite in za un!
Thuman lopi-in a ngah uh, migilote' inn sunga van omte, leh ka deih loh tawitehna man lo zatnate, mangngilh thei ding ka hi hiam?
Tawi khaina man lo leh tawisuang man lo a zangte, khahkhong ding ka hi hiam?
Na mi haute uh mi zawngte tungah tatsia mahmah in, na khua sung mi khempeuh uh zuau gen vive hi uh a, a kam un khemna thu bekbek gen hi.
Tua ahih ciangin na mawhna hangun, note kong suksiat ding ka kipan ta hi.
An na nek hangun na kham kei ding uh a, na gil uh kial lai veve ding hi. Nate na koihcing uh hangin phatuam lo ding hi. Galte in tua na koihcing uh nate susia veve ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Kumpi Omri' gamtatna teng zui-in, ama tapa Kumpi Ahab' sep khempeuh na sem uh a, amau' gamtat khempeuh na zui uh hi. Tua ahih manin note kong susia ding hi. Minam dangte in note hong nuihsanin, amaute' simmawhna na thuak ding uh hi.
Kei a kamsia hi'ng! Singgah leh leenggah a heu laitak, a gilkial mipa tawh ka kibang hi. Leenggah nek ding om nawn lo a, ka lunggulh theigah beita hi.
Leitungah mihoih teng bei khin ta a, Pasian tungah a thuman mi kuamah om nawn lo hi. Mi khempeuh in mi thah ding bek ngaihsun uh a, a kuamah peuh in a sanggampa ngen tawh beng hi.
A sia lam-a gamtat ding siam mahmah uh a, uliante leh thukhente in sumgolh ngenin, mi liante in amau' deih teng pulak uh a, kipawlin vaihawm khawm uh hi.
Amaute lakah a hoih pen a, kineite lingkung bang hi a, a thutang pen a, kineite, linghiam bang hi lel uh hi. Pasian in amaute a hilhkholh bangin, a daan piak ding hun hong tung ta a, a lungman' ding hun uh hi ta hi.
Na vengte' thu up-in nei kei in la, na lawmte zong muan'in, nei kei in. Na ang-a lum na zi kiang nangawn ah thu na gen ding kidawm in.
Tu hunin tapate in pate hai bawlin, tanute in nute langpan' uh a, mote in a teeknu uh lang neih uh hi. Mi khat adingin ama innkuanpihte mah a gal suak mawk hi.
Ahi zongin kei ka hih leh Topa ka en ding a, kei hong suaktasak Pasian ka ngak ding hi. Ka Pasian in ka thu hong ngai ding hi.
Ka galte aw, kei tungtang ah lungdam kei un. Ka puk hangin ka thokik ding hi. Khuamial sungah ka om hangin Topa in khuavak hong pia ding hi.
Amah in ka thu hong sun'sakin, kei adingin thu hong khensak mateng Topa' hehna ka thuak ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ama' tungah ka mawh khin zo hi. Amah in khuavak ah hong paipih ding a, ama' hotkhiatna ka mu ding hi.
Tua hun ciangin ka galte in hih thu mu ding uh a, "Na Topa Pasian koi-ah om hiam? ci-in hong tawng ka galte maizum ding uh hi. Amaute guallel ding a, kongzing buan bangin a kisik gawp mu-in kei ka nuam ding hi.
Jerusalem khuamite aw, na khuapi kulh uh a kician' kik ding hun hong tung ding a, tua hun ciangin na gamgi uh nakpi takin kikhan' ding hi.
Nisuahna lam Assiria gam pan hita leh, leitaw lam Izipt gam pan hita leh, a gamlapi tuipi khen' pan leh a gamlapi mualte, mun khempeuh panin na mite uh hong ciahkik ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin a tunga teeng mite' gitlohna hangin, leitung in sehnel gamkhing suak ding hi.
Topa aw, nangma tuu ahi na mite na ciangkhut tawh hong cing in. Gamnuam lei hoihna sungah amau guakin om uh hi. Taanglai huna mah bangin, Bashan leh Gileah gam nuamah tasak in.
Izipt gam pan na paikhiat hun lai uh mah bangin, amau' adingin a lamdang nate ka bawl ding hi.
Minam dangte in hih thu mu ding uh a, minam thahat hi napi-in maizum ding uh hi. Lamdang sa-in kam khat zong pau lo ding uh a, hih thu a zakzakna-un a bil uh ngong liang ding hi.
Amaute in gul bangin leivui liakin, a bokvak ganhing bangin hong awmtal ding uh a, a bukna uh mun muanhuaite panin lau-in a lingsa-in hong pusuak ding uh a, Topa Pasian hong kihta ding uh hi.
Topa aw, nang tawh a kibang Pasian dang om lo a, a om lai na gamluah mite' mawhna na maisak hi. Nang na heh paisuak kei a, na itna kip nong lak hi.
Kote nong khasiat kik ding a, ka mawhnate uh hong sawpkhiatsakin, tuipi taw-ah nong paihsak ding hi.
Ka pu ka pate uh tungah nidang lai a, na ciamsa bangin, Abraham' suan-le-khak ahi nangma mite tungah na cihtakna leh nong itna kip nong lak ding hi.
Pasian' Tapa Zeisu Khazih' Lungdamna Thu a kipatna in hih bang hi.
Kamsang Isaiah' Lai Siangtho sungah: "En in, na pai nading lam sial ding, Na mai-ah ka sawltakpa ka paisak ding hi.
Gampa lakah a kikopa' aw in, 'Topa paina lam na sial un, Ama lampi na tangsak un,' a ci hi," ci-in kigelh hi.
Johan hong kilang a, gampa lakah baptaiz a, mawh kimaisak nadingin, mawhna kisik kikna thu leh baptaizna thu a hilh hi.
Jerusalem khuapihte akipan Judah gamah a om mi khempeuhte in ama kiangah va pai uh a, amau mawhna pulakin ama khut tungah, Jordan gun sungah a kibaptaiz uh hi.
Johan in kala-oh mul kigan puan silh a, savun kawnggak in a kawng a gak hi. Kauphe leh gamlak khuaizu-in kivak hi.
Ama thuhilhna in, "Kei sangin a lian zawpa khat in ka nungah hong pai ding hi. Ama khedap khau sut ding nangawn ka kilawm kei hi.
Keimah in note tui sungah kong baptaiz hi. Amah in Kha Siangtho sungah note hong baptaiz ding hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in Galile gam Nazareth khua panin va pai a, Johan khut tungah Jordan gun sungah a kibaptaiz hi.
Thakhat a, tui sung pan a thawhtoh lai takin van kihong a, Kha Siangtho in vakhu bangin ama tungah hong kumsuk a mu hi.
"Nang in ka lung hong damsak ka it ka Tapa na hi hi," ci-in vantung panin aw khat a ging hi.
Tua ciangin, Kha Siangtho in Zeisu gampa lakah a sawl pah hi.
Gampa lakah ni sawmli omin, Satan' khemna thuak a, gampa lak ganhingte tawh omkhawm a; vantungmite in a vak uh hi.
Johan a kimat khit ciangin Zeisu Galile gamah pai a, Pasian' Lungdamna Thu a hilh-inah,
"A hun a kicing zo hi. Pasian Gam a hong nai zo hi. Na mawhna kisikkik un la, Lungdamna Thu na um ta un," a ci hi.
Galile tuili gei lamah a pai lai takin, Simon leh Andru te unau, ngabengte ahih uh ciangin tui sungah ngen paai a om uh a mu hi.
Zeisu in, "Ka nung hong zui un. Mi mante kong suaksak ding hi," a ci hi.
Amaute in thakhatin a ngen uh nusia-in Zeisu nung a zui uh hi.
A tomkha a pai khit ciangin, Zebedi' tate Jakob leh a nau Johan zong gunkuang sungah ngen khui-a om a muh ciangin thakhatin a sap leh,
amaute in gunkuang sungah thacialte tawh a pa Zebedi nusia-in Zeisu nung a zui uh hi.
Amaute Kapernaum khua-ah lut uh a, Nipi ni-in Zeisu kikhopna inn sungah thakhatin lut a, thu a hilh hi.
Amaute in ama thuhilhna lamdang a sa uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amah in laitheite bangin a hilh kei hi, ukpa bangin thu a hilh hi.
Amaute' kikhopna inn sungah thakhatin kihhuai dawi lut mi khat a om hi.
"Nazareth mi Zeisu aw, kote in nang tawh bang kikum i hi hiam? Kote susia dingin hong pai na hi hiam? Nang kua mi na hih ke'n kong thei hi. Pasian' mi siangtho na hi hi," ci-in a kiko hi.
Zeisu in, "Pau kei in la, ama sung pan paikhia in," ci-in a taai hi.
Kihhuai dawi in tua pa a kongkawsak khit ciangin nakpi-in kiko a, ama sung pan a paikhia hi.
Mi khempeuhte in lamdang a sa uh a, "Hih thu in bang thu ahi hiam? Thuhilhna thak ahi hiam? Uk neihna tawh kihhuai dawite thu a piak ciangin amau in a thu a mang uh hi," ci-in khat leh khat a kikum uh hi.
Thakhatin ama thu in Galile gam sung khempeuh kizeel hi.
Kikhopna inn sung pan a paikhiat khit uh ciangin Simon leh Andrute' inn sungah Jakob leh Johan tawh thakhatin a tum uh hi.
Simon' sungnu nattun'a, lumin a om hi. Amau in thakhatin Zeisu a ko uh hi.
Zeisu in va nai a, tua numei khut len a, a phot leh, a nattun' dam a, zinte a vak hi.
Ni tum a, nitak ciangin cinatna a vei khempeuh leh a sungah dawi lutte Zeisu kiangah paipih uh a;
khua zangpi-in kongkhak kiangah a kikhawm uh hi.
Zeisu in cinatna nam tuamtuam a vei tampi damsak a, dawi tampi a hawlkhia hi. Dawite in Zeisu a theih manun ah kamkhat beek gen lo dingin a kham hi.
Zingsang khua a vak ma-in Zeisu tho a, gampa lakah paikhia a, tua san takah thu a ngen hi.
Simon leh amah tawh a omkhawm mite in zui uh a,
Zeisu a muh uh ciangin, "Mi khempeuh in nang hong zong uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Zeisu in, "Thuhilh dingin hih kiim nai khua dangte ah zong pai ni. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua bang deihna-in kei ka hong pai zo hi," ci-in amau kiangah a gen hi.
Amah in Galile gam khempeuh kikhopna inn tengah pai kawikawi a, thu hilhin dawite a hawlkhia hi.
Tua lai takin miphak khat Zeisu kiangah pai a, a mai-ah khukdin'in, "Topa aw, nong hih nop leh, nong damsak zo ding hi," ci-in a thuum hi.
Zeisu in hehpihhuaisa-in a khut zanin lawng a, "Ka hih nuam hi, na dam ta in," a cih leh,
thakhatin phak natna in ama tung pan paikhia a, a dam pah hi.
Zeisu in tua pa thakhatin paisak a,
"Hih thu kuamah kiangah na gen loh nadingin na kikem in. Ahi zongin siampi kiangah pai in la, va kilak in. Amau in a theih nadingun Moses thu piakna bangin biaknate na pia in," ci-in nakpi-in a sawl hi.
Ahih hangin tua pa paikhia a, a thu genthangin a kizeelsak hi. Tua ahih ciangin Zeisu in a nung ciangin a kilangin khua sungah tum thei lo a, khuanawl gampa lakah a om hi. Mun khempeuh panin a kiangah mite a pai uh hi.
Ni tomno khit ciangin Zeisu in Kapernaum khua-ah lut kik a, inn sungah a om thu mite in a za uh hi.
Kongvang gei nangawn ah om nading om lo zah dongin mi tampite a kikhawm uh a, Zeisu in amaute kiangah thu a hilh hi.
Tua lai takin khut-le-khe si mi khat, mi li in hong pua uh a, ama kiangah a paipih uh hi.
Mihonpi om ahih ciangin Zeisu kiangah a nai zo kei uh a, ama omna tungsan innkhum a vuhlet khit uh ciangin lupna tawh cinapa a khaisuk uh hi.
Zeisu in amaute' upna a theih ciangin a khut-le-khe sipa kiangah, "Ka ta aw, na mawhnate kimaisak zo hi," a ci hi.
Tua munah a tu laitheite kimkhat in,
"Hih pa in bang hangin tua bangin a gen hiam? Pasian tungah a pau khial hi. Pasian longal kua in mawhna maisak zo hiam?" ci-in amaute' sinsung uh ah a ngaihsun uh hi.
Zeisu in amaute' lungsim sung uh ah a ngaihsut uh a kha in a theih ciangin, "Note in bang hangin na lungsim sung uh ah hih thu ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?
Khut-le-khe sipa kiangah bang pen ci leng a baih zaw hiam? 'Na mawhna kimaisak zo hi,' ci leng baih zaw hiam? 'Tho in la, pai in,' ci leng a baih zaw hiam?
Ahih hangin Mihing Tapa in leitungah mawhna a maisak theih nading, thu a neih lam na theih nadingun,
"Tho in, na lupna pua in la, na innah na ciah in, kong ci hi," ci-in a khut-le-khe sipa kiangah a gen hi.
Amah thoin thakhatin a lupna pua a, amau khempeuh mai pan a paikhia hi. Tuate khempeuh in lamdang a sa uh a, "Hih bang khatvei beek ka mu ngei kei uh hi," ci-in Pasian a phat uh hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu tuili geiah a pai kik leh, mihonpi khempeuh a kiangah pai uh a, amaute thu a hilh hi.
Amah in lam a pai lai takin Alefas' tapa Levi in siahdon'na buk sungah tu-in a om a mu hi. "Ka nung hong zui in," a cih ciangin ding-in a zui hi.
Zeisu in Levi' inn sungah an a nek lai takin siahdongte leh mawhnei tampite in Zeisu leh a nungzuite tawh a tukhawm uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, mi tampite in a nung a zui uh hi.
Zeisu in mawhneite leh siahdongte tawh an a nek khawm Farisaite leh laitheite in a muh uh ciangin, a nungzuite kiangah, "Amah in siahdongte leh mawhneite tawh bang hangin an nekhawm, tui dawnkhawm ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in a zak ciangin, "Cidamte in zato deih lo uh hi. Cinate bek in a deih uh hi. Miphate sam dingin hong pai ka hi kei hi. Mawhneite sam dingin hong pai ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Khatvei Johan' nungzuite leh Farisaite in an nek a tan' lai takun Zeisu kiangah va pai uh a, "Johan' nungzuite leh Farisaite in an nek a tang zel uh hi. Bang hangin na nungzuite in an nek tang lo ahi uh hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, "Zipipa in a lawmte tawh a omkhawm lai takin tuate in an a tang thei uh hiam? A omkhawm lai teng an nek a tang thei kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin, zipipa in a lawmte tawh a kikhen ni hong tung ding hi. Tua ni ciangin amaute in an nek a tang ding uh hi.
Kuamah in puanlui, puanthak tawh a thuap kei uh hi. Tua banga a thuap leh, a thuapna puanthak in puanlui keeksakin a vang gol thei hi.
Kuamah in savun um lui sungah leenggahtui thak a thun kei uh hi. Tua bangin a thun leh, leenggahtui in savun a puak khamsak ding a, leenggahtui leh savun a kisia gawp ding uh hi. Leenggahtui thak savun thak sungah a thun uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in Nipi ni khatvei buhleiah a vak leh, lam a pai lai takun a nungzuite in buhvuite a zut uh hi.

Zeisu in, "Siampipa Abiathar a khan' lai takin, David in a lawmte tawh a gilkial lai takun,
Pasian biakna inn sungah lut a, siampi longal midang nek dinga kilawm lo khomun siangtho ne a, a lawmte zong a piak thu sim ngeilo na hi uh hiam?
Nipi ni mite ading a piang hi; mite Nipi ni ading a piang kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, Mihing Tapa in Nipi ni nangawn ukpa ahi hi," a ci hi.
Zeisu in kikhopna inn sungah khatvei lut kik a, tua munah khut langkhat sipa khat a om hi.
Nipi ni-in cinatna a damsak ding hiam, damsak lo ding hiam ci-in amaute in Zeisu a mawhsak nop manun a en uh hi.
Zeisu in, "A lai zangah ding in," ci-in khut sipa kiangah a cih khit ciangin,
"Nipi ni-in phatna bawl tuak hiam? Siatna bawl tuak hiam? Nuntakna khatpeuh gup tuak ahi hiam, thah tuak ahi hiam?" ci-in amaute kiangah a dot ciangin mihonpi pau loin a om uh hi.
Tua ciangin Zeisu in hehna tawh a kim en a, amaute lungkhauhna hangin dah a, tua pa kiangah, "Na khut zan in," ci hi, a khut a zan leh, a dam hi.

Amaute in gunkuang sung pan a paikhiat uh ciangin mite khempeuh in Zeisu' meel a thei uh hi.
A kimkot gam khempeuh ah tai-in, koi lai takah a om ci-in a zak uh ciangin tua munah mi cinate lupna tawh a paipih uh hi.
Khuapi, khuaneu, gamlak, a tun'na khempeuh ah cidam lo mite lam kiangah a koih uh a, ama puan mong teep beek a lawn' nadingun a ngen uh hi. Amah a lawng khempeuh in cidamna a ngah uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin, Jerusalem khua panin hong tung Farisaite leh laithei kimkhatte in Zeisu kiangah hong kikhawm uh a,
a nungzui kimkhatte in a nin cihnopna, a kisil lo khut tawh an ne uh a mu uh hi.
(Farisaite akipan Judah mi khempeuh in tanglai upate' ngeina zui-in khut phatakin sil loin an ne lo uh hi.
Sumbuk panin hong ciah uh ciangin zong pumpi kisil loin an ne lo uh hi. Tua lo adang ngeinate in haite, sumngo kuangte, dalkuangte tui tawh sawpna ngeina a zuih uh tampi a om hi).
Farisaite leh laitheite in, "Tanglai upate' ngeina na nungzuite in zui loin, khut nin tawh bang hangin an ne ahi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in, "Isaiah in mi simtat note tungah a kituakin a genkhol zo hi. Tua Lai Siangtho in: 'Hih mipawlte in amau kam uh tawh kei hong zahtak uh hangin, A lungsim uh kei tawh kigam la hi.
Mite thukham ngeina a hilh uh a, A mawkna in kei hong bia uh hi,' a ci hi.
Note in Pasian thukham na paai uh a, mite kiang pan na ngah uh ngeina na zui uh hi."
"Note in na ngeina uh na zuih theih nadingun Pasian' thukham na nial uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Moses in, 'Na nu leh na pa na zahtak in. A nu a pa a gensiate in sihna thuak ta hen,' a ci hi.
Note in na cihna uh ah, keima kiangah na zat theih keima sum, Pasian kipia zo cihnopna ahi, 'Korban' hi ci-in mi khatin a cih leh,
tua mi in a nu a pate tungah neukha beek bawl theih loh na'ng na kham uh a,
na kipiak ngeina uh zui-in Pasian thu na mawk valsak uh hi. Tua bang gamtatna tampi na zui uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in mihonpite sam kik a, "Note khempeuh in ngai un la, na thei ta un.
Mi sungah a pua lam pan a lutsuk na in mi a ninsak zo na khat beek a om kei hi.
Mi sung pan a paikhiate in mi a ninsak thei hi, zak nading bil a nei mi in za ta hen" a ci hi.
Zeisu in mihonpi lak pan kikhen a, inn sungah a lut khit ciangin, a nungzuite in tua thungentehna a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in, "Note in zong lungpilna nei nai lo na hi uh hiam? Mi pua lam pan a sungah a lut khempeuh in, mi a ninsak zo lo thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ama lung sungah lut loin a gilpi sungah tumsuk a, gil sung pan a kithakhia hi," a ci hi. Tua bang a gen ciangin sa khempeuh a siangthosak hi.
Khatvei Zeisu in, "Mi sung pan a paikhiate in mi a ninsak thei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mi sung pan a hoih lo ngaihsutna, numei tawh mawhna,
mi' sum gukna, mi thahna, mi' zi tungah mawhna, huaihamna, gitlohna, mi kheemna, kihhuai deihna, een'na,
mi gensiatna, kiphatsakna, mawktatna, hih gitlohna khempeuh in sung lam pan a paikhia uh a, mi a ninsak uh hi," a ci hi.
Zeisu tua mun pan tho a, Tai-ar leh Sidon khua nai lamah a pai ciangin, inn khatah lut a, kuamah in a theih loh nading a ut hangin bu-in a kiseel zo kei hi.
A tanu sungah dawi lut numei khat in Zeisu a om thu a zak ciangin, thakhatin hong pai a, a khe kiangah bokin,
a tanu' sung pan dawi a hawlkhiat nading thu a ngen hi. Tua numei in Sirofoenisia pawl, Grik numei ahi hi.
Zeisu in, "Amasa-in tate kivak kham ta hen. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, tate an nek ding la a, uite piak ding kilawm lo hi," a cih leh,
numei in, "Ahi mah hi, Topa aw, uite in tate anneng kiate sabuai nuai-ah a ne uh hi," a ci hi.
Zeisu in, "Tua thu hangin nang pai in, na tanu' sung pan dawi a paikhia zo hi," a ci hi.
Numei a innah ciah a, numeino in lupna tungah lum a, dawi a paikhia zo cih a mu hi.
Zeisu in Tai-ar gam pan paikhia a, Sidon gam a paltan khit ciangin, Dekapolis gam paisuakin Galile tuili a tung kik hi.
Tua lai takin bengngong, paumawl mi khat a kiangah a paipih uh a, ama tungah a khut a ngak nadingin a thuum uh hi.
Zeisu in tua pa mihonpi lak pan samkhia a, gam daihna munah a paipih khit ciangin, a khutmete a bil lang nih sungah guangin, a cil phih a, a leii zong a lawng hi.
Vantung ento-in khuisa a, kihong ta hen cihnopna-in "Effatha" a ci hi.
Tua lai takin mipa a bil kihong a, a leii gui kikhah khia-in pha takpi-in kam a pau thei hi.
Tua thu kuamah kiangah a gen loh nadingin amaute a kham hi. A kham semsem hangin, amaute in tua thu a tangko semsem uh hi.
Amaute in a kigen thei lo zah dongin lamdang a sa uh a, "Amah in na khempeuh phatakin a bawl zo hi. Bengngongte khua zasak zo a, pau thei lote a pausak thei zo hi," ci-in a gen uh hi.
Tua lai takin mihonpi tam kik a, an nek ding a neih loh uh ciangin Zeisu in a nungzuite sam a,
"Hih mite hehpihhuai ka sa hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ni thum tawntung kei tawh a omkhawm uh hi. An nek ding a nei kei uh hi.
An ne loin innah ka ciahsak leh, lampi ah a gim ding uh hi.Tuate kimkhat in gamlapi panin hong pai uh hi," a ci hi.
A nungzuite in, "Hih mite an kham ding bang lak pan kingah thei ding hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, "Khomun pum bangzah na nei uh hiam? ci-in a dot ciangin amaute in, "Pum sagih a om hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Zeisu in, "Mihonpi lei tungah tusak un,' ci-in a sawl hi. Tua ciangin khomun sagih la a, hehpihna a phat khit ciangin, khomun balnenin mite mai-ah lui dingin a nungzuite a pia hi. A nungzuite in mihonpi a lui uh hi.
Ngasa tawmkha nei uh ahih ciangin, hehpihna a phat khit ciangin, tuate zong mite lui ding thu a pia hi.
Amaute in a ne uh a, a kham khit uh ciangin, a khamval uh a neng a themte tawm uh a, seeng sagih a ngah uh hi.
Tuate tul li bang a pha uh hi.
Zeisu in amaute a paikhiatsak khit ciangin a nungzuite tawh gunkuang tungah thakhatin tuangin, Dalmanutha gam a tung uh hi.
Tua lai takin Farisaite hong pusuak uh a, Zeisu tawh thu a kinial uh ciangin, ze-et nadingin vantung pan lim a ngen uh hi.
Zeisu in a lungsim sungah khuisa a, "Hih khang mite in bang hangin lim a ngen uh hiam? Ke'n aman takpi kong cih-inah, hih khang mite ading lim a kilak kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Amaute omna pan paikhia a, khatvei gunkuang tungah tuang kikin tui gal khatah a pai hi.
A nungzuite in khomun puak ding a mangngilh uh a, gunkuang tungah khomun pum khat bek a nei uh hi.
Zeisu in, "Farisaite leh Herod' silnngo kikeem un la, tang un," a cih ciangin,
a nungzuite in, "Eite in khomun i nei kei hi," ci-in khat leh khat a kikum uh hi.
Zeisu in a theih ciangin, "Note in khomun na neih loh manun bang hangin khat leh khat na kikum uh hiam? Thei lo lai ngaihsun lo lai na hi uh hiam?
Na lungsim uh khauh khauh lai ahi hiam? Mittang nei napi-in mu lo, bil nei napi-in za lo, phawk lo na hi uh hiam?
Khomun pum nga mi tul nga ading ka balnen ciangin, a neng a them seeng bangzah na tawm uh hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin, "Seeng sawm leh seeng nih," a ci uh hi.
"Khomun sagih tul li ading ka balnen ciangin, a neng a themte seeng bangzah na tawm uh hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin amaute in, "Seeng sagih," a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, "Note in thei nai lo na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Amaute in Bethsaida khua-ah a tun' uh ciangin, mittaw mi khat a kiangah hong paipih uh a, tua pa a lawn' nadingin a thuum uh hi.
Zeisu in mittawpa a khut tawh kai a, khua nawlah a paipih khit ciangin, a mittang cil phih a, a tungah khut a ngak khit ciangin, "Na khatpeuh peuh na mu thei hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Amah a ettoh leh, "Mite ka mu hi; amaute singkung pai bangin ka mu hi," a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in a khut khatvei a mittang ah nga kik a, tua pa in tel takpi a et kik ciangin dam a, na khempeuh tel takin a mu thei hi.
Zeisu in tua pa innah ciahsak a, "Khua sungah na lut kei in," ci-in thu a pia hi.
Zeisu in a nungzuite tawh Kaisaria Filippi gam khua neute-ah a pai uh hi. Lampi-ah a pai lai takun, "Mite in kei kua hi hong ci uh hiam?" ci-in a nungzuite a dong hi.
Amaute in, "Baptaizpa Johan," a ci uh hi. Kimkhat in, 'Elijah,' a ci uh hi. Ahih hangin midang kimkhat in, 'Kamsangpa khatpeuh,' a ci ciat uh hi," ci-in a gen uh hi.
Zeisu in, "Note in kei kua mi hi nong ci uh hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin, Piter in, "Nangmah in Khazih na hi hi," a ci hi.

Zeisu in, "Mihing Tapa in gimna tampi thuak ding a, upate, siampi liante, leh laitheite in nial ding uh a, amah in thahna thuakin ni thum khit ciangin a thokik ding hi," ci-in tua a kipanin a nungzuite a hilh hi.
Tua thu im loin a gen khin hi. Piter in Zeisu samsim a, seel ding a kipat ciangin,
Zeisu kihei a, a nungzuite a muh ciangin, "Satan aw, ka nungah kinkhia in; nang in Pasian thu na ngaihsun kei hi, mite thu bek na ngaihsun hi," ci-in Piter a taai hi.
Tua ciangin Zeisu in a nungzuite leh mihonpite a sap khit ciangin, "Mi khatpeuh in kei hong zuih nop leh, ama pumpi nial a, a singlamteh pua-in hong zui ta hen.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ama nuntakna a gum nuamte in a nuntakna a mangthangsak ding hi. Kei hang ahi zongin, Lungdamna Thu hang ahi zongin nuntakna a mangsakte in a nuntakna a gum ding hi.
Mi khat in leitung khempeuh a ngah hangin, ama nuntakna mangthangsak leh, bang phattuamna ngah ding ahi hiam?
Mi khatpeuh in ama nuntakna bang sum tawh lei kik thei ding ahi hiam?
Mi paktat leh gilo hih khang mite lakah, kei ahi zongin, ka thu ahi zongin a daisak peuhmah Mihing Tapa in zong a Pa minthan'na leh a siangtho vantungmite tawh hong paikhawm uh ciangin, tua mite a daisak ding hi."

Ni guk khit ciangin Zeisu in Piter, Jakob leh Johan-te samin mual sang tungah, gam daihna munah paipih a, amaute mai-ah a meel kilamdang a,
a puan zong leng a, hih leitungah puansawp mi kuamah in a paaksak zawh loh ding zah dongin a paak mahmah hi.

Tua lai takin Piter in, "Topa aw, hih lai takah kote kong om uh a hoih hi. Nang ading buk khat, Moses ading buk khat, Elijah ading buk khat, buk thum kote hong lamsak in," a ci hi.

Tua lai takin meeingo khat in amaute tuam a, "Hih pa in ka it ka Tapa ahi hi. Ama thu na ngai ta un," ci-in meii lakah aw khat a ging hi.

Ahih hangin, ke'n kong cih-inah Elijah hong tung zo hi. Amaute in Lai Siangtho sungah ama thu a kigelh khol mah bangin, ama tungah ahih nop bangun ahih zo uh hi," ci-in a gen hi.
A nungzuite omna-ah a tun' uh ciangin, mi tampite in amaute uum uh a, laitheite in amaute tawh thu kikum kidongin a om uh a mu hi.
Thakhatin mihonpite khempeuh in Zeisu a muh uh ciangin lamdang a sa uh a, a kiangah tai-in amah a hopih uh hi.

Tua dawi in a matna peuhpeuh ah lei tungah puksak a, a kam sung pan cilphuan bua a, a ha gawi a, a kongkaw gawp thei hi. Dawi a hawlkhiat nadingun na nungzuite kiangah ka nget hangin ahih thei kei uh hi," a ci hi.
Zeisu in, "Upna nei lo pawlte aw, kei in no tawh bang tanvei omkhawm ding ka hi hiam? Tua naupang ka kiangah hong paipih un," a ci hi.
Amaute in a hong paipih uh leh, Zeisu a muh ciangin dawi in naupang thakhatin kongkawsak a, lei tungah puk a, cilphuan bua-in a kipeek sawnsawn hi.
Zeisu in, "Hih natna a kipat zawh bang tanvei pha zo ahi hiam?" ci-in naupang' pa a dot ciangin a pa in, "A neu lai pek pan akipan hi.
Naupang a kisiat nadingin tamveipi meikhuk sungah, tamveipi tui sungah a puksak hi. Ahih hangin, na khat peuhmah na bawl theih leh, kote hong hehpih in la, hong huh in," ci-in ngen hi.

Tua lai takin mihonpite kikhawm dingin hong tai uh a, Zeisu in a muh ciangin, "Bengngong leh pauthei lo dawi aw, ama sung pan paikhia in. Tu nung ciangin tum kik nawn kei in, thu kong pia hi," ci-in kihhuai dawi a taai ciangin,
dawi in kiko-in naupang nakpi-in a kongkawsak khit ciangin a paikhia hi. Naupang in misi tawh kibang ahih ciangin mi tampi in, "A si zo hi," a ci uh hi.

"Keima min tawh hih bang naupangno khat a ngai peuhmah in, kei zong hong ngai hi. Kei hong ngai peuhmah in, kei hong sawlpa zong a ngai hi," ci-in a gen hi.

Zeisu in, "Tua pa na kham kei un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, keima min tawh nalamdang bawlin, a hong kosia pah thei mi khat beek a om kei hi.

Khazih' mi na hih manun ah tui hai khatpeuh hong pia mi in, aman takpi kong cih-inah, noptuamna ngah loin a om kei ding hi."

Na khut in hong puksak leh, na sattan in.
Na khe in nang hong puksak leh, na sattan in.
Khe kim nei-in hel khua sungah hong khul sangin, khutbui khebui-in nuntakna sungah na tum leh, nang ading a hoihzaw ding hi.
Na mittang in hong puksak leh, na khelkhia in.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, mi khempeuh mei tawh cisawh bangin a kisawh ding uh hi.
Ci in a hoih hangin a alna mang leh, bangci a al kik thei ding hiam? Note sungah ci omsak un la, khat leh khat kilemin om un," ci-in a gen hi.

Thukhamte na thei hi. Mi na that kei in. Mi' zi tawh na mawh kei in. Mi' sum na gu kei in. Ahi lo teci na pang kei in. A kilawm loin mi' sum na laksak kei in. Na nu leh na pa na zahtak in," a ci hi.
Tua pa in, "Sia aw, tua thu khempeuh ka neu lai akipan ka tang zo hi," a ci hi.
Zeisu in tua pa a et ciangin it a, "Na khat na sam lai hi. Pai in la, na neihsa teng zuakin mizawngte na pia in. Tua ahih leh, vantung gam sungah sum na nei ding hi. Tua khit ciangin ka nung hong zui in," a ci hi.
Tua pa in tua thu hangin a mai khing a, lungkim loin a paikhia hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, sum tampi a nei hi.

A nungzuite in ama thu lamdang a sa uh hi. Khatvei Zeisu in, "Ka tate aw, sum leh pai a suangte in Pasian Gam sungah a tum nading bangzah tak a haksa hiam?

Amaute in lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi. "Tua bang ahih leh, gupna kua in ngah zo ding hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in amaute enin, "Hih thu mite in ahih zo kei uh hi. Ahih hangin Pasian in ahih theih loh a om kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian in na khempeuh ahih thei hi," a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Piter in, "Kote in ka neihsa khempeuh uh nusia-in nangmah kong zui uh hi," ci-in gen ding a kipat ciangin,
Zeisu in, "Ke'n aman takpi kong cih-inah, kei hang ahi zongin, Lungdamna Thu hang ahi zongin a inn, a sanggampa, a sanggamnu, a nu a pa,
a lo a nusiat leh, tu lai takin a zah zakhat innte, sanggampate, sanggamnute, nute, pate, tate, lote, bawlsiatna tawh ngah a, nung ciangin hong piang ding hunah nuntak tawntungna ngah lo ding kuamah a om kei hi.

Tua ahih manin Vanglianpen Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Nineveh khuapi aw, daan kong pia ding hi. Na nik kong hawkkhiatsak ding a, minamte in guak tanga na omna hong mu ding a, na zumhuaina teng mu ding uh hi.
Nang hong huat bawlin, ninbulom tawh kong dimsak ding a, mite in lamdang sakna tawh hong en ding uh hi.
Nang hong mu khempeuh nungkik gaih-in, 'Nineveh khuapi siacip ta hi; kua in khasiat ding hiam?' ci ding uh hi. Ahi zongin nang hong hehnem nuam kuamah om lo ding hi," ci hi.
Nineveh aw, a kimkot ah tui in a umcih a, amah a dal dingin tuipi nei a, a kulh dingin a kimkot ah tui a om, Thebes khuapi sangin gina zaw kisa zenzen na hi hiam?
Nail Gun dung, gam khempeuh uk khin ahih manin, gen zawh lohin a vanglian hi. Put mite leh Libia mite zong ama pawl ahi hi.
Tua bang hi napi-in, Thebes khuamite kipua khia-in sal suak uh hi. Konglak mun citengah a tate uh kisatlum hi. A miliante, sikkol kibulhin kipua khia a, amau a man galte in hawm uh hi.
Nineveh khuapi aw, nang zong zukham bangin khua na phawk kei ding a, na galte kiang panin tai-in bukna na zong ding hi.
Na kulh muan'huaite pen a gah a zun theikung tawh kibang ding a, a kung sing lecin, a gah na kam sung hong tu tawh kibang ding hi.
Na galkapte, numei bang hi lel ding a, na galte a lut zawh lohna dingin, na gamsung kihu zo lo ding hi. Mei in na kulh kongpi zawlte kangtum ding hi.
Hong ki-umcihna na nan' nadingin tui tawi-in, na kulhte cian'beh in la, Leiseek seek dingin buan cilin, leiseekna kuang a baihsa-in nei ta lecin zong,
tua bang na hih laitakin mei in hong kangtumin, galte in hong vatlum ding hi. Kauphe honpite in an a nek tum bangin, nang na beimang ding hi. Kauphe bangin tampitak na pha khin uh hi.
Van-a aksi sangin a tam zaw-in, sum bawl mi na om khin ta uh hi. A kha zalin a leengmang kauphe hon bangin, tu-in amaute om nawn lo uh hi.
Na uliante uh ahih leh, phalbi lai-in kulh tungah a bawm miamua, ni a suah ciangin leeng khia mangin, a omna mel a kithei lo kauphe hon tawh kibang hi.
Assiria kumpipa aw, na gamsung a ukte si ta a, na uliante ihmu paisuak uh hi. Na mite, mualtung tengah kithehthang a, inn-ah a kaikhawm ding kuamah om lo hi.
Na liammate a dam theihna ding om lo a, na meimate a dam thei lo pawl ahi hi. Na thuakna thu a za mi khempeuh in lungdamin a khut uh beng ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh na gitlohna a thuak kha lo kuamah om lo hi.
Hakaliah' tapa Nehemiah' thugen in hih bang ahi hi. A kum sawmnihna Khislev kha sungin kumpi khuapi Susa-ah ka om lai takin,
ka sanggampa Hanani leh midang pawlkhat Judah gam panin hong tung uh hi; tua ciangin keimah in Jerusalem khua thu leh sal-a matna panin a suakta ahi a om suak Judah mite' thu tawh kisai amaute kiangah ka dong hi.
Salsuahna panin a suakta, tua gam-a a om suakte in haksatna lianpi leh maizumna a ngahna uh, leh Jerusalem kulh kicimin kulhkongpite mei in a kattumna thu hong gen uh hi.
Hih thu ka zak ciangin tusukin ka kap niloh a, ni tampi sung an tangin, vantung Pasian kiangah thu ka ngen hi.
Ka thungetna-ah, "Aw vantung Pasian, Topa, nang hong itin na thupiakna a zuite tungah na thuciamna lim takin a zui, a lian a kihtak-huai Pasian aw,
Nangma tungah kong khial khin uh a, na nasempa Moses tungah na piak ahi thupiaknate, thukhamte, leh ngeinate ka zui kei uh hi.
Na nasem Moses tungah, 'Na cihtak kei uh leh mi namdangte lakah kong thehthang ding hi;
ahi zongin kei kiangah hong ciahkikin ka thupiaknate zui-in na sep uh leh leimong dongah a kithehthangsa na mite uh kaikhawmin keima min om nadingin ka telnasa munah amaute ka ciahpih ding hi,' ci-a na thugen hong phawkkik in.
Topa aw, amaute pen na vangliatna leh a thahat na khut tawh hotkhiatsa na nasemte leh nangma mite ahi uh hi.
Keima hong thungetna leh nangma min a zahtak nuam na nasemte' thungetna na bil hong ngat in. Tu ni-in kei tungah mavan'na hong pia in la, kei tungah hih kumpipa hong migit nading lungsim guan in," ka ci hi.
Kei pen kumpipa' anpiapa ka hi hi. Kumpi Artakzaksis' kum sawmnihna Nisan kha sungin khatvei, a leenggahzu a baihsa-in a om khit ciangin la-in kumpipa ka pia a, ama mai-ah ka om lai takin ka mai a khing hi.
Amah in, "Ci na lopi-in bang hangin na mai khing ahi hiam? Na dahna khat om hi ding hi," hong ci hi. Tua ciangin lau mahmahna tawh
kumpipa ka dawng a, "Kumpipa nungta tawntung in. Ka pute ka pate a kivuina khuapi sia gawp a, a kongpite kangtum ahih ciangin maikhing loin bangci om theih ding ka hi hiam?" ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Kei tungah bang hong ngen nuam na hi hiam?" hong ci hi. Kei zong ka lungsim tawngah vantung Pasian kiangah thu ka ngen a,
tua khit ciangin kumpipa dawngin, "Kumpipa na lungkim a, dik nong sak leh, ka puah phatkik theih nadingin Judah gamsung ka pute ka pate a kivuina khuapi-ah nong paisak nading kong thuum hi, topa," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in (kumpinu gei-ah tu kawmin), "Bang tan vei sawt ding a, cik ciangin hong ciahkik ding na hi hiam?" ci-in hong dong hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in ka ngetna hong thukimpih a, kei zong ka ciahkik ding hun ka gen hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah, "Kumpipa na thukim leh, Judah gam ka tun' dong amaute in kei hong paisuak sak theih nadingun Eufrates Gungal gamsung a uksawn mite ka piak ding laikhakte,
leh biakinn hut nading mun muanhuai kongpi ding, leh khuapi kulh ding, leh ka om nading inn lam nadingin sing hong piak theih nadingin kumpipa' tulak a kem Asaf tungah piak ding laikhak zong, kei tungah hong pia in," ka ci hi. A dik ka Pasian in kei hong ompih ahih manin kumpipa in ka ngette hong pia hi.
Tua ciangin Eufrates Gungal gam a uksawn mite kiang ka tung a, kumpipa' laikhakte amaute tungah ka pia hi. Kumpipa in galkap mangte leh sakol galkapte kei hong kha sak hi.
Ahih zongin Israel mite' phattuam nading a sem dingin mi khat hong paina thu Horonaim khuami Sanballat leh Ammon mi sal ahi Tobiah in a zak uh ciangin nakpi takin lungkim lo uh hi.
Jerusalem ka tun' ciangin ni thum sung ka tawlnga hi.
Tua ciangin zan-in vak khia-in mi tawmkhat ka tonpih hi; ahi zongin Jerusalem' adingin ka bawlsak ding ka Pasian in ka lungsim ah hong suahsak thu kuama kiangah ka gen kei hi. Keima tuan'na sim loh ganhing dang ka kizuisak kei hi.
Kuam Kongpi tawnin Gulpi Tuikhuk leh Nin Kongpi lamah ka pai a, a kicimsa Jerusalem kulhpi leh mei in a kattumsa a kongpite ka en hi.
Tua ciangin Tuinak Kongpi leh Kumpipa' Bual-ah ka paisuak hi; ahi zongin ka tuan'na ganhing a paisuak theih nading mun om lo hi.
Tua hi a, a zanpi mahin kuam lamah pai-in khuapi kulh ka vel hi; tua ciangin Kuam Kongpi mah tawnin khuapi sungah ka lut kik hi.
Tua hi a, khua sung upate in ka paina mun ahi a, ka sep ahi zongin thei lo uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh hih nasep tavuan a la ding Judah mite, siampite, uliante, khua sung upate, leh adangte tungah ka gen nai kei hi.
Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, "I lungkhamna thu na thei uh hi. Jerusalem a siasa-in omin, a kongpite mei in kangtum hi. Hong pai un, zahkona i ngah nawn loh nadingin Jerusalem kulh ciang pha ni," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin a dik ka Pasian in kei hong ompihna leh kumpipa in kei tungah hong gen thute zong amaute tungah ka gen hi. Tua ciangin amaute in, "Tu-in nasep kipan ni," hong ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin lawp mahmah leh ngimna hoih tawh nasep kipan uh hi.
Ahi zongin Horonaim khuami Sanballat leh Ammon mi sal ahi Tobiah leh Arab gam-a a sem Geshem in tua thu a zak uh ciangin, kote zahpihna leh simmawhna tawh, "Hih na sep uh bang ahi hiam? Kumpipa lehpan' na hi uh hiam?" hong ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute dawngin, "Vantung Pasian in ka ma uh hong telhsak ding a, ko ama nasemte in nasep a kipan ta ka hi uh hi; note in ahih leh Jerusalem tawh kisai-in na siksan ding uh ahi a, thu ahi zongin, bangmah kimematna na nei kei uh hi," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin siampi lian Eliashib leh a siampi pihte in nasep kipanin Tuu Kongpi bawl uh hi. Amaute in a khuamte leh a zawlte bawlin a kongkhakte bulh uh hi; amaute in Mi Za Khat Tausang ciang banah Hananel Tausang dong sem uh a, tua ciangin Pasian tungah ap uh hi.
Ama zomah Jerikho khuamite in sem uh hi. Amaute' zomah Imri' tapa Zakkur in sem hi.
Tua ciangin Hassena-ah' tapate in Ngasa Kongpi bawl uh hi; amaute in a zawlte khungin a kongkhakte a kalhna tawh bulh uh hi.
Amaute' zomah Hakkoz' tapa Uriah, a tapa Meremoth in ama khawk sung puah hi; tua zomah Meshezabel' tapa Berekhiah, a tapa Meshullam; tua zomah Baana' tapa Zadok in puah hi;
a zom kikah Tekoa khuamite in puah uh a, ahi zongin amau' uliante in nasem makaite nuai-ah na sem nuam lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Paseah' tapa Joiada leh Besodeiah' tapa Meshullam in Jeshanah Kongpi puah uh hi; amaute in a zawlte khungin a kongkhakte a kalhnate tawh bulh uh hi.
Amaute' zomah Gibeon leh Mizpah khuami ahi, Gibeon mi Melatiah leh Meronoth khuami Jadon in Eufrates Gungal gam a uk sawnpa' zum dong puah uh hi.
Tua zomah khamseekpa Harhaiah' tapa Uzziel in puah hi; a zomah paknamtui bawlpa Hananiah in puah hi; amaute in Kulh Zai ciang dong a ngeina bangin Jerusalem bawlkik uh hi.
Amaute' zomah Jerusalem gam phel khat a uk, Hur tapa Refaiah in puah hi.
A zomah Harumaf tapa Jedaiah in ama inn mai san teng puah hi; tua ciangin a zomah Hashabneiah' tapa Hattush in puah hi.
Harim' tapa Malkhijah leh Pahathmoab' tapa Hasshub in Meikhuk Tausang a huam khawk dang khat sung puah uh hi.
Amaute' zomah Jerusalem gam a phel khat a uk Hallohesh' tapa Shallum in a tanute tawh puah uh hi.
Hanun leh Zanoah khua-a teeng mite in Kuam Kongpi puah uh hi; amaute in tua kongpi bawl pha-in a kongkhakte a kalhnate tawh bulh uh a, Nin Kongpi ciang dong tong tul khat sung kulh puah uh hi.
Bethhakkherem gam a uk, Rekhab' tapa Malkhijah in Nin Kongpi puah hi; amah in tua kongpi bawl pha-in a kongkhakte a kalhnate tawh bulh hi.
Mizpah gam a uk, Kolhozeh' tapa Shallum in Tuinak Kongpi puah hi; amah in tua kongpi bawl pha-in a kongkhakte a kalhnate tawh bulh hi; tua ciangin amah in kumpipa' huan gei-a Shelah Bual a kulh ciang a, David Khuapi pan-a hong paisuk kahlei ciang dong sem hi.
Ama zomah Bethzur gam phel khat a uk, Azbuk' tapa Nehemiah in David' han san ciang, a kibawltawm bual leh Galkap Inn ciang dong puah hi.
Ama zomah a puah Levi mite in: Bani' tapa Rehum; ama zomah Keilah gam phel khat a uk Hashabiah in ama gam taangin puah hi.
Ama zomah a puah a behte in: Keilah gam a phel khat a uk, Henadad' tapa Bavvai in puah hi;
a zomah Mizpah gam a uk Jeshua' tapa Ezer in a Kiu-a galvan koihna kahtohna san khawk khat puah hi.
Ama zomah Zabbai' tapa Baruk in a Kiu panin siampi lian Eliashib' inn kongkhak ciang dong khawk khat sung puah hi.
Ama zomah Hakkoz' tapa Uriah, a tapa Meremoth in Eliashib' inn kongkhak panin Eliashib' inn mong ciang dong khawk khat sung puah hi.
Ama zomah Jerusalem kiim nai-a om siampite in puah uh hi.
A zomah Benjamin leh Hasshub in amau' inn mai san puah uh hi. A zomah Ananiah' tapa Ma-aseiah, a tapa Azariah in ama inn gei san teng puah hi.
Ama zomah Henadad' tapa Binnui in Azariah' inn panin a Kiu,
leh kulh kiu ciang khawk khat sung puah hi. Uzai' tapa Palal in a Kiu gal san teng leh kumpipa' inn panin hong dawk khia, zum cingte' omna ahi tausang tungnung teng puah hi.
Amah zomah Parosh' tapa Pedaiah leh Ofel mualtung a teeng biakinn nasemte in nisuahna lam manawhin Tui Kongpi gal san ciang leh tausang dawk puah hi.
Ama zomah Tekoa khuamite in a lian tausang dawk panin Ofel mualbo kulh ciang, khawk dang khat sung puah uh hi.
Sakol Kongpi tung san teng ahih leh siampite in amau' inn mai san ciat puah uh hi.
Amaute' zomah Immer' tapa Zadok in ama inn mai san puah hi. Ama zomah Nisuahna Kongpi a cing, Shekaniah' tapa Shemaiah in puah hi.
Ama zomah Shelemiah' tapa Hananiah leh Zalaf tapa gukna Hanun in khawk dang khat sung puah uh hi. Amau zomah Berekhiah' tapa Meshullam in ama inndei mai san teng puah hi.
Ama zomah khamseekpa Malkhijah in Kikaihkhopna Kongpi mai san-a om biakinn nasemte' inn leh sumbukte' inn ciang, leh a kiu-a inndei tungnung ciang dong puah hi.
Tua ciangin khamseekte leh sumbukte in a kiu-a inndei tungnung leh Tuu Kongpi kikal puah uh hi.
Sanballat in kote' kulh cian'na thu a zak ciangin lungkim loin heh mahmah a, Judah mite hong zahko hi.
Amah in a kikholhpihte leh Samaria galkapte' kiangah, "Hih Judah mi niangnuangte in bang hih dinga kipan ahi uh hiam? Hih mun bawlpha ding a, kingaihsun ahi uh hiam? Biakna pia-in, a nasep uh ni khat sungin zo dingin kilamen ahi uh hiam? Amaute in a kangtumsa nin bulomtang panin suangtum bawl kik thei ding ahi uh hiam?" ci hi.
Ama kiangah a om Ammon mi Tobiah in, "Amaute in bangbang ciang ta leh amau' kulh cian' tungah ngia khat kah leh kicim lel ding hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin keimah Nehemiah in thu ka ngen a, "Hong za in, kote' Pasian aw, kote hong kisimmawh hi; kote hong zahkona amau lu tungah lehtuk sak in la, gamdang khatah sal suakin mi' bawlsiatin amaute omsak in.
Amaute in a lang tangin kulh ciangte mai-ah nang hong kosia uh ahih manin amau' mawhna maisak kei in la, na muhna panin zong a mawhna uh sumit kei in," ka ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kulh ka ciang uh a, nasep a kim ciang bang kizo hi; mite in utna lungsim tawh sem uh hi.
Ahi zongin Sanballat, Tobiah, Arab mite, Ammon mite, leh Ashod mite in Jerusalem kulh cian' nasep kizom suakin, kulh vang teng huk ding a kipat khitna thu a zak uh ciangin heh mahmah uh hi.
Tua hi a, Jerusalem hong simin buaina a piangsak dingin amaute kipawlin vaihawmna khat nei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka Pasian uh tungah thu ka ngen uh a, amaute a en dingin sun leh zanin galvil ka koih uh hi.
Tua ciangin Judah mite in, "Nasemte a tha uh zaw ta a, ahi zongin nin tampi om lai hi; eima tha tawh kulh cian' i zo ngei kei ding hi," hong ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin ka galte un, "Amau' phawk loh kalun amaute lakah pai-in i that ding a, a nasep uh i beisak ding hi," hong ci uh hi.
Amaute lakah a teeng Judah mite khuapi sungah hong pai ciangin, ka galte uh a omna khempeuh ciat panun hong pai-in kote hong sim nading thu, sawm vei tak hong hilhkhol uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kulh nung lam mun niampenna mun awng tengah a namsau uh, a teipi uh, leh a thal uh tawh, a innkuankuan-un ka mite ka pangsak hi.
Mite' launa ka muh ciangin, uliante leh mi ukte leh mikhempeuh tungah, "Amaute kihta kei un. Na sanggamte, na tapate, na tanute, na zite uh leh na inn na lote uh adingin hong dosak, a lian a kihtak-huai Topa phawk un," ka ci hi.
Amau' hong sawmna thu kote in ka phawkna uh leh Pasian in amau' geelna a suksiatna thu ka galte un thei hi; tua ahih ciangin ka nasepna ciat uh kulh tungah ka vekpi-un ka kuankik uh hi.
Tua hun-a kipanin ka khut nuai-a om mite kimkhat in na sem a, a kimkhat in a teipite, a lumte, leh a thalte uh tawi-in sikpuan silhin ding uh hi; uliante in kulh a ciang Judah mite khempeuh uk uh hi.
Kulh-a cian' ding na a nawn mite in khut lang khat in a van puak uh lenin a khut lang khat uhah galhiam tawi uh hi.
Kulh ciangte in na a sep kawmun a kawng ciat uhah a namsau uh kuah uh hi. Peengkul tumpa ahih leh keima kiangah om hi.
Tua ciangin uliante leh mi ukte leh mi khempeuh tungah, "I nasepna lian a, zaipi tak huam hi; eite kulh tungah kikhenin khat leh khat i kigamla hi.
Peengkul kitum na zakna peuhpeuh panun ko kiangah hong kikhawm un. I Pasian in eite adingin hong dosak ding hi," ka ci hi.
Tua hi a, ni simin khuavak-a kipan nitak aksi suah dong, mi kimkhat in teipi tawi-in, mi kimkhat in na ka sem uh hi.
Tua hun mahin mite kiangah, "Zanin galvil, sunin nasemin nong om theih nadingun mi khempeuh na nasemte ciat uh tawh Jerusalem khua sungah hong giak un," ka ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin keimah-a kipan ka behte, ka nasemte, leh kei hong cingte, a kuamah peuh puan suah man om loin, mi khempeuh in ka khut uhah galhiam ka tawi den uh hi.
Tu-in mi nautang numei leh pasalte in a Judah mipihte uh tungah lungkim lohna kam hong gingsak uh hi.
Mi pawlkhatte in an lei nadingin a tanute uh leh a tapate uh a piakna thu gen uh hi.
Pawlkhatte in kial tun' huhau-in an lei nadingin a lote, a leenggah lote, leh a innte uh a piakna hong gen uh hi.
Pawlkhatte in kumpipa tungah siah piak dingin a lote uh leh a leenggui lote uh khamin a piakna uh hong gen uh hi.
Amaute in, "Kote in ka behte uh mah bangin si-le-sa kibang hi-in, ka naupangte uh zong amau' naupangte mah bangin a hoih hi napi-in, ka tanute uh leh ka tapate uh sal suak dingin ka phum uh hi. Ka tanute uh pawlkhat zong sal suak khin a, ka lote uh leh ka leenggui lote uh midangte' aa suak khin ahih manin amaute tat nadingin ka hih zawh uh bangmah om lo hi," hong ci uh hi.
Amaute' kikona leh hih thute ka zak ciangin ka heh mahmah hi.
Kei zong hih thu lim takin ka ngaihsun a, tua ciangin uliante leh thukhente tai-in amaute kiangah, "No leh no lei kibat manin ameet na kila uh hi," ka ci hi. Amaute nakpi takin tai-in,
"Mi namdangte tungah sal-a kizuaksa i Judah mipihte ahi zo zahzahin i tanh kik hi; tua hi napi-in note in na mipihte uh na zuak uh a, tu-in amaute i tat kik ding hi zel hi!" ka ci hi. Amaute pau loin om uh a, a gen ding mel uh thei lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, "Note' gamtatna hoih lo hi. I gal ahi mi namdangte' zahkohna i ngah loh nadingin i Pasian zahtakna tawh na gamtat ding uh kilawm hi.
Kei leh ka behte leh ka nasemte in zong an leh sum leitawi-in ka pia khia uh hi. Leiba ameet kilakna phiat ni.
Tu ni mahmah-in a lote, a leenggui lote, a oliv lote, a innte uh leh a meet-a na lak uh sum, an, leenggahzu, leh sathaute, amaute tungah pia kik un," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Hihte khempeuh ka pia kik ding uh a, amaute tung panin bangmah ka kal nawn kei ding uh hi; na gen bangin ka gamta ding uh hi," hong ci uh hi. Tua ciangin siampite ka sam a, a ciamsa bangun a gamtat nadingun kiciamna ka bawlsak hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong ka puan singin, "Hih thuciamna a tungsak lo peuhmah a inn leh a neihsa panin Pasian in singkhia ta hen. Hih bangin kisingkhia hen la, hawmsuak hen!" ka ci hi. Tua ciangin a kikhawmte khempeuh in, "Amen," ci uh a, Topa phat uh hi. Tua hi a, a ciamsa bangun mite gamta uh hi.
Tua tham loin, Judah gam a uk dingin hong kiseh hun-a kipan, Kumpi Artakzaksis' kum sawmnihna pan a kum sawmthum-le-nihna dong, kum sawm leh kum nih sung, kei leh ka behte in gam ukte' ngah ngei ante ka ne kei uh hi.
Keima hun ma-in a ukte in mite tungah vangikpi suan uh a, amaute tung panin ni simin an leh lenggahzu ngun shekel sawmli man la uh hi. Amau' nasemte nangawn mite tungah kiliansak lai uh hi. Ahi zongin Pasian ka zahtakna hangin tua bangin kei ka gamta kei hi.
Hih kulh cian'na ah tua tangin keimahmah in zong ka sem a, kei adingin leitang bangmah ka la kei hi; keima mite khempeuh nasem ding bekin tua lai-ah kisutuah uh hi.
I kiim i paam-a mi namdangte' kiang pan hong paite banah, ni simin ka sabuai ah an a ne, thukhente leh Judah mi a kihelin leengla za leh sawmnga bang ka nei den hi.
Nisim in innsung annek tawm dinga kibawl bawngtal khat leh tuu limci guk ahi hi; tua mah bangin ak zong kibawl a, ni sawm simin leenggahzu a um tampipi-in kihih hi; tua zahin bei ta se leh gam ukte' ngah theih ahi, an leh tui ka kal kei hi; bang hang hiam cih leh mite genthei lua hi.
Pasian aw, hih mite' adingin ka bawlna khempeuh kei' adingin a hoih lamin hong phawk in.
Kongpite ah kongkhak ka bulh nai loh hangin, kulh ka cian' khitna leh a vang khat zong a om nawn lohna thu, Sanballat, Tobiah, Arab mi Geshem, leh ka gal dangte khempeuh un a zak uh ciangin,
Sanballat leh Geshem in Ono zanglei sunga om Hakkefirim khua-ah pai-in amaute tawh thu kikum dingin hong sam uh hi; hih pen kei hong suksiat nopna uh ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kei zong amaute kiangah kamtaite ka sawl a, "Tu lai takin nasep thupi ka nei hi, kong pai thei kei ding hi. Kei hong pai leng, kong pai sung ka om loh kal teng nasep kitawlnga ding hi," ka ci hi.
Amaute in tu-a mah bangin li vei tak hong sam uh a, kei zong a li vei mahin tu-a bangin ka dawng kik hi.
Tua mah bangin Sanballat in a nga veina hong sam a, tua tung tangin a kamtaipa in laikhak khat hong pia hi.
A laikhak sungah, "Mi namdangte lakah a kigen, Geshem in zong tua a kigen thu man hi, ci-a a gen thu in, nang leh Judah mite in kumpi lehdo ding na sawm uh a, tua thu hangin kulh na ciang uh hi; tua banah nangmahmah zong kumpi na utna kigen lai hi.
Judah in kumpi khat nei ta hi, ci-in, nang kumpi na hihna thu Jerusalem ah a taangko dingin kamsangte pawlkhat a koih-in zong hong kigen hi. Kumpipa in hih thu za pelmawh ding hi.Tua ahih ciangin thakhatin hong pai in la, hih thu kikum ni," ci-in kigelh hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, "Tua na gen bangin bangmah om lo hi; tua thu in nangma phuahtawm ahi hi," ci-in ka thuk hi.
Kote in ka hanciamna uh khiamin nasep a kizawh loh nading deihna tawh amaute in kote hong lausak theih nading uh a hanciam uh ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin ka hahkat semsem zaw hi.
Mehetabel' tapa Delaiah, a tapa Shemaiah a innah omcip ahih manin ni khat ama kiangah ka pai leh amah in, "Pasian' inn sung, siangtho munah kituahin biakinn kong kikhak nelh ni; bang hang hiam cih leh nang hong that dingin amaute hong pai uh a, zanin amaute in nang hong that ding uh hi," hong ci hi.
Ahih hangin keimah in, "Kei bang mite tai ding ahi hiam? Kei tawh kibang mite a suahtak nadingin biakinn sungah lut ding ahi hiam? Ka pai peuhmah kei ding hi," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin a thusim ka phawk khia hi. Pasian in tua bang thu gen dingin amah a sawl hi lo a, Tobiah leh Sanballat in tua bangin thugen dingin golhguk a na pia na hi a, ama thugenna in keimah suksiat nopna ahi hi.
Ama thugen bangin gamta-in mawhna ka bawl theih nadingin keimah hong lausak dingin a kicial ahi hi; tua bangin zui kha leng kei hong minsia sakin hong simmawh ding uh hi.
Ka Pasian aw, amau' sepnate' hangin Tobiah leh Sanballat thei in la, keimah lausak dingin a hanciam kamsangnu Noadiah leh kamsang dang khempeuh zong thei in.
Elul kha ni sawmnih leh ni nga ni-in kulh kizo a, ni sawmnga leh ni nih sung hun bei hi.
Ka galte un hih thu za-in, ka kiim uh-a om mi namdangte in a theih uh ciangin lamdang sa uh a, kote' Pasian' huhna tawh hih nasep kizo ahihna phawk uh hi.
Hih hun sung teng khempeuh Judah uliante in Tobiah kiangah lai tampi khak uh a, Tobiah' laikhakte zong amaute tungah tung hi.
Tobiah pen Arah' tapa Shekaniah' makpa hi a, ama tapa Jehohanan in Berekhiah' tapa Meshullam' tanute khat ten'pih ahih manin Judah gamsunga mi tampi amah tawh kipawl hi.
Amaute in ama hoihnate zong keima zakna ah hong gen uh a, keima sepna teng zong ama kiangah na puak uh hi. Tua hi a, Tobiah in zong ka lau theih nadingin kei tungah lai tampi hong khak hi.
Kulh kiciang khinin, kongkhakte ka bulh khin a, kongcingte, lasate, leh Levi mite a kiseh khit ciangin,
ka sanggampa Hanani leh galdalna inn a uk Hananiah in a et dingin Jerusalem ka pia hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Hananiah in midang tampi sangin a citakzaw, Pasian a zahtakzaw mi khat ahi hi.
Tua hi a, amaute tungah, "Sun mateng Jerusalem kongpite hong sak kei un; tua ciangin ni om lai mahin kongte khak sakin kalh sak un. Jerusalem khua sunga teengte lak panin khuacing dingte seh un la, pawlkhatte galvilna munah, pawlkhatte amau' inn mai ciatah omsak un," ka ci hi.
Khuapi lianin zai a, ahi zongin a sungah mi tawm bek om a, innte a kilam om nai lo hi.
Tua ciangin uliante, thukhente, leh mite a innkuan kuanun ciamteh nading ka lungsimah Pasian in hong suaksak hi. Tua hi a, hong ciahkik masate' khang ciamtehna laibu ka mu hi. Tua sungah ka muh a kigelhte in:
Parosh suante mi tul nih za khat leh sawmsagih-le-nih ahi hi.
Shefatiah' suante mi za thum leh sawmsagih-le-nih ahi hi.
Arah' suante mi za guk leh sawmnga-le-nih ahi hi.
Pahathmoabte' beh sung panin Jeshua leh Joab suante mi tul nih za giat leh sawm-le-giat ahi hi.
Elam' suante mi tul khat za nih leh sawmnga-le-li ahi hi.
Zattu' suante mi za giat leh sawmli-le-nga ahi hi.
Zakkai' suante mi za sagih leh sawmguk ahi hi.
Binnui' suante mi za guk leh sawmli-le-giat ahi hi.
Bebai' suante mi za guk leh sawmnih-le-giat ahi hi.
Azgad' suante mi tul nih za thum leh sawmnih-le-nih ahi hi.
Adonikam' suante mi za guk leh sawmguk-le-sagih ahi hi.
Bigvai' suante mi tul nih leh sawmguk-le-sagih ahi hi.
Adin' suante mi za guk leh sawmnga-le-nga ahi hi.
Ater a kici Hezekiah' suante mi sawmkua-le-giat ahi hi.
Hashum' suante mi za thum leh sawmnih-le-giat ahi hi.
Bezai' suante mi za thum leh sawmnih-le-li ahi hi.
Harif' suante mi za khat leh sawm-le-nih ahi hi.
Gibeon' suante mi sawmkua-le-nga ahi hi.
Bethlehem leh Netofah khuami za khat leh sawmgiat-le-giat ahi hi.
Anathoth khuami za khat leh sawmnih-le-giat ahi hi.
Bethazmaveth khuami sawmli-le-nih ahi hi.
Kiriath-jearim, Khefirah, leh Be-eroth khuami za sagih leh sawmli-le-thum ahi hi.
Ramah leh Geba khuami za guk leh sawmnih-le-khat ahi hi.
Mikmas khuami za khat leh sawmnih-le-nih ahi hi.
Beth-el leh Ai khuami za khat leh sawmnih-le-thum ahi hi.
Elam adang khat suante tul khat za nih leh sawmnga-le-li ahi hi.
Harim khuami za thum leh sawmnih ahi hi.
Jerikho khuami za thum leh sawmli-le-nga ahi hi.
Lod, Hadik, leh Ono khuami za sagih leh sawmnih-le-khat ahi hi.
Sena-ah khuami tul thum za kua leh sawmthum ahi hi.
Siampite sung panin: Jeshua-te beh panin Jadaiah suante mi za kua leh sawmsagih-le-thum ahi hi.
Immer' suante mi tul khat leh sawmnga-le-nih ahi hi.
Pashhur' suante mi tul khat za nih leh sawmli-le-sagih ahi hi.
Harim' suante mi tul khat leh sawm-le-sagih ahi uh hi.
Levi mite sung panin: Hodevah-te beh panin Jeshua' suante leh Kadmiel' suante mi sawmsagih-le-li ahi hi.
Lasate sung panin: Asaf' suante mi za khat leh sawmli-le-giat ahi hi.
Kongcingte nam sung panin: Shallum' suante, Ater' suante, Talmon' suante, Akkub' suante, Hatita' suante leh Shobai' suante mi za khat leh sawmthum-le-giat ahi uh hi.
Biakinn nasemte sung panin: Ziha' suante, Hasufa' suante, Tabbaoth' suante,
Keros' suante, Sia' suante, Padon' suante,
Lebana' suante, Hagaba' suante, Shalmai' suante,
Hanan' suante, Giddel' suante, Gahar' suante,
Reaiah' suante, Rezin' suante, Nikoda' suante,
Gazzam' suante, Uzza' suante, Paseah' suante,
Besai' suante, Meunim' suante, Nefushesim' suante,
Bakbuk' suante, Hakufa' suante, Harhur' suante,
Bazlith' suante, Mehida' suante, Harsha'suante,
Barkos' suante, Sisera' suante, Temah' suante,
Neziah' suante leh Harifa' suante ahi uh hi.
Solomon' nasemte' suan leh khakte sung panin: Sotai' suante, Sofereth' suante, Perida' suante,
Ja-ala' suante, Darkon' suante, Giddel' suante,
Shefatiah' suante, Hattil' suante, Pokhereth-hazzebaim' suante, leh Amon' suante ahi uh hi.
Biakinn nasemte leh Solomon' nasemte' suan leh khakte mi a vekpi-in za thum leh sawmkua-le-nih pha uh hi.
Telmelah, Telharsha, Kherub, Addon, leh Immer khuate panin a hong ciahkik, Israel mi hi napi-in amau' beh leh phung a kan thei lo mite in:
Delaiah' suante, Tobiah' suante, Nekoda' suante, mi za guk leh sawmli-le-nih ahi uh hi.
Siampite' sung panin zong: Hobaiah' suante, Hakkoz' suante, Barzillai' suante (amah in Gilead mi Barzillai' tanute khat ten'pihin tua min tawh a kilo pah) ahi uh hi.
Hih mite in khang ciamtehna sungah a kiciamteh mite lakah amau min a zon' uh hangin mu lo uh ahih manin amaute a siang loin seh uh a, siampi nasep semsak thei lo uh hi;
tua hi a, Urim leh Thummim aisanna tawh aisan ding siampi khat a om matengin amaute in biakna an siangthopente a nek loh nading uh gam ukpa in gen hi.
Mi a vekpi-in tul sawmli leh tul nih leh za thum leh sawmguk pha a,
amaute' nasem numei leh pasal tul sagih leh za thum leh sawmthum-le-sagihte kisim lo lai hi; tua banah amaute in lasa numei leh pasal za nih leh sawmli-le-nga nei uh hi.
Amau' sakol uh za sagih leh sawmthum-le-guk, a la-sakol uh za nih leh sawmli-le-nga,
a kalaoh uh za li leh sawmthum-le-nga, leh a late uh tul guk za sagih leh sawmnih pha hi.
Beh lutang mi pawl khat in nasep nadingin nate pia uh hi. Gam ukpa in vanmanpha koihna ah kham darik tul khat, kuang-uk sawmnga, leh siampipuan za nga leh sawmthum pia hi.
Tua ciangin beh lutang pawl khatte in vanmanpha koihna ah kham darik tul sawmnih leh ngun mina tul nih za nih pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin mi dangte' piakte in kham darik tul sawmnih, ngun mina tul nih, leh siampipuan sawmguk-le-sagih ahi hi.
Tua ciangin siampite, Levi mite, leh mi pawl khatte Jerusalem khua leh a kiim-ah teeng uh a, kongcingte, lasate, biakinn nasemte, leh Israel mi dangte amau' khuapi ciatah teeng uh hi. Kha sagihna hong cin' ciangin Israel mite amau' khuapi ciatah teeng khin uh hi.
Tua ciangin Tui kongpimai tualpi ah mi khempeuh khe khat khai bangin hong kikhawmtuah diam hi; tua ciangin Topa in Israel mite tungah a piak ahi, Moses' thukham laibu pen lai theipa Ezra in hong paipih nadingin gen uh hi.
Tua hi a, a kha sagihna a ni khat ni-in numei pasal, leh thu telthei ding a kikhawm khempeuh' mai-ah siampi Ezra in thukham laibu hong paipih hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Tui Kongpi mai-a om tualpi lam mai ngatin zingsang tung-a kipan sun ciang dong, numei pasal leh thu a telthei ding mite' zakin tua laibu sunga thute sim a, mi khempeuh in tua thukham laibu sunga thu kisimte lim takin ngai uh hi.
Tua ciangin thugen nadinga sing tawh kibawl tau tungah lai theipa Ezra dingto a, ama taklam pangah Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, leh Ma-aseiah ding uh a, a veilam pangah Pedaiah, Mishael, Malkhijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zekhariah leh Meshullam ding uh hi.
Mi khempeuh sangin a sangzaw munah amah ding ahih manin mi khempeuh' muh theih dingin Ezra in a laibu hong hi; a laibu a hon' ciangin mi khempeuh ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Ezra in a lian Pasian, Topa thupha pia a, mi khempeuh in a khut uh laamto-in, "Amen, Amen," ci-in dawng uh hi; tua ciangin a lu uh kunin lei lam mai ngatin Topa bia uh hi.
Mite amau' omna san ciatah a om sungun mite in thukham a teltheih nadingun Levi mi Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Ma-aseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah-te in a khiatna hilh uh hi.
Amaute in Pasian' thukham laibu sung panin a kitel takin sim uh a, a cihnopna a kitelin gen uh a, tua a kisim thute a tel nadingun hilh uh hi.
Tua ciangin gam ukpa Nehemiah, leh lai theipa lah hi-in siampi lah ahi Ezra, leh mite a hilh Levi mite in amaute khempeuh kiangah, "Tu ni in Topa note' Pasian adingin biakna ni siangtho ahi hi; a kap a mau om kei un," a ci uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh thukham kammalte a zak uh ciangin mi khempeuh kap uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, "Tu-in ciah un; an lim tui lim ne-in thadim un la, a nei zo lote zong va kholh un; bang hang hiam cih leh i Topa' adingin tu ni in biakna ni siangtho ni ahi hi; dah kei un, bang hang hiam cih leh Topa sungah lungdamna in note' thahatna ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Levi mite in mite gamdai sak a, "Dai takin om un; bang hang hiam cih leh tu ni in biakna ni siangtho ni ahi hi; dah kei un," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi khempeuh an ne tui dawnin midangte a kholh ding leh lungdam-a om dingin ciah uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute tungah a kigen thute amaute in theitel uh hi.
A ni nih ni-in thukham sin dingin siampite leh Levi mite tawh beh lutang khempeuh lai theipa Ezra kiangah hong kikhawm uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mite kuan khia-in tua singhiangte hong pua-in amau' innkhumzang ciat, a inntual uh, Pasian' inntual, Tui Kongpi tual leh Efraim Kongpi tual-ah sawlbuk lam uh hi.
Tua hi a, salsuahna panin a hong ciahkik a kikhawm mite khempeuh in sawlbuk lamin tuate sungah om uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Nun' tapa Joshua' hun-a kipanin tua ni dongin Israel mite in tua bangin pawikham ngei lo uh hi. Tua hi a, amaute lungdam mahmah uh hi.
Tua hi a, akipat ni-a kipan abei ni dong Ezra in ni simin Pasian' thukham laibu simkhia hi. Amaute in ni sagih sung tua pawikham uh a, a ngeina om bangin a ni giat ni-in pawi khupna a thupi kikhopna khat om hi.
Tua kha mah a ni sawmnih-le-li ni-in an tang dingin Israel mite kikhawm uh a, puanhampi silhin a lu tung uhah lei kibuak uh hi.
Tua hi a, gamdang mi khempeuh panin Israel mite tuam om uh a, amaute in din'sa-in amau' khialhnate leh a pu a pate uh mawhnate pulak uh hi.
Tua ciangin amau' omna mun ciat uhah ding-in Topa amau' Pasian' thukham laibu nai thum sung sim uh a, a dang nai thum sung amaute in mawhna pulakin Topa a Pasian uh zahtakna bawl uh hi.
Levi mite' kahlei tungah Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, leh Khenani ding uh a, Topa amaute' Pasian tungah nakpi-in kiko uh hi.
Tua ciangin Levi mi Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, leh Pathahiah-te in, "Ding un, Topa na Pasian uh phat un la, 'A tawntung pan a tawntung dongin a minthang na min in thupha ngah a, thupha khempeuh leh phatna dang khempeuh sangin sangzaw hi.
Nang bek in Topa na hi hi; nangmah in van sangpen vantung a, aksihonpite tawh, leitung leh a tunga om khempeuh, tuipi leh a sunga om khempeuh na bawl hi. Nangmah in tuate khempeuh na piangsak a, vantungmi honpi in Nang hong bia uh hi.
Nangmah in Abram teelin Khaldea gam Ur khuapi panin paikhiatpihin Abraham min a phuak Pasian, Topa na hi hi.
Nangma tungah amah a cihtakna na mu a, Kanaan mite gam, Hit mite gam Amor mite gam, Perez mite gam, Jebus mite gam, leh Girgash mite gam, amah leh a suan leh khakte tungah piak dingin ama tungah thuciamna khat na bawl hi. Nangmah thuman na hih manin na thuciamna na tungsak hi.
" 'Nangmah in Izipt gamsunga ka pute ka pate uh gimna mu-in huhna ngenin San Tuipi-ah hong kikona uh na za a,
amaute in ka pute ka pate uh kihihsakna tawh a hih gawpna thei na hih manin Faro leh a nasemte leh a gam mi khempeuh langpanin lim leh nalamdang na bawl hi; tua hi a, tu ni dongin a kip min khat nangma adingin na ngah hi.
Amaute' mai-ah tuipi phelkham na hih manin tuipi laizang leikeu tungah amaute paisuak uh a, ahi zongin tuilianpi sunga suang lot bangin tui thukna sungah amau a delhte na lawn hi.
Sunin meii khuam khat tawh amaute lam na lak a, amau' lam paina khua a vaksak dingin zanin mei khuam khat tawh lam na lak hi.
Sinai Mual tungah kumsukin, vantung panin amaute hopihin, amaute tungah a man thukhenna, thukham taktak, a hoih ngeinate leh thupiaknate na pia a,
na nasempa Moses tung tawnin amaute tungah na sabbath siangtho na theisak a, thupiaknate, ngeinate, leh thukhamte na pia hi.
A gilkialna uh a vahsak dingin vantung panin an na pia a, a dangtakna uh a phasak dingin suangpi panin tui na phulsak a, amaute tungah piak dingin na kiciamsa gamah lutin a luah nadingun amaute na sawl hi.
"'Ahi zongin kote' pute pate kihisakin lung khauh uh a, na thupiaknate mang lo uh hi.
Amaute in thu mang nuam lo uh a, amaute lakah na bawl nalamdangte ngaihsun kha lo uh hi; amaute lung khauh niloh uh a, a salsuahna uh Izipt-ah a paipih kik dingin makai khat seh uh hi. Ahi zongin nang in mawhna a maisak nuam, dikin hehpihna a nei, lungduai-in itna kip a nei Pasian na hi a, amaute na nusia tuan kei hi.
Amaute in a kisung bawngno khat amau mah adingin bawlin, "Hih in Izipt panin note hong pai khiatpih na Pasian uh ahi hi," ci-in gendai-mawhna lianpi a bawl uh ciangin zong,
nang in na hehpih mahmah manin amaute gamlakah na nusia kei hi. Sunin lam a lak meii khuam in amaute nusia lo a, zanin a pai nading uh lampi a vaksak mei khuam in zong amaute nusia lo hi.
Amaute a thuhilh dingin a hoih na Kha Siangtho na pia a, na manna an zong amaute kiang panin na la kik kei a, a dangtakna uh a phasak dingin tui na pia hi.
Kum sawmli tawntung gamlakah amaute na vak a, amaute in bangmah tangsapna nei lo uh hi; a puante uh zong sia lo a, a khe uh zong bawk beek lo hi.
Nangmah in amaute tungah kumpi gamte leh mite na pia a, tuate in gal sung van ngah dingin na piak ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Heshbon kumpipa Sihon' gam leh Bashan kumpipa Og' gam luah uh hi.
Nangmah in amau' suan leh khakte van-a aksi zahin sim zawh lohin na tamsak a, a pu a pate un a luah dingin piak dingin na ciamsa gamah amaute na paipih hi.
A suan a khakte uh tua gamah lutin a lak uh ciangin, amau' mai-ah tua gam-a teeng Kanaan mite na nuaisiah a, a ut bang bangun a bawl dingun a kumpite leh a mite amau' khut sungah na pia hi.
Tua hi a, amaute in kulh nei khuapite leh gam hoihte la uh a, na hoih tampi tawh a kidim innte, suang kikhuak tuibeemte, leenggui lote, oliv lote, leh nek theih singgah kung tampi luah uh hi; amaute in tuate ne-in gilvahin thau uh a, nangma hoihna hangin nuamsa mahmah uh hi.
"'Ahi zongin amaute in dem nopna lungsim nei-in nang hong lehdo uh hi; amaute in na thukham nungngat uh a, nangma lamah hong ciahkik nadingun amaute a hilhkhol na kamsangte that uh a, amaute in gendai-mawhna lianpi bawl uh hi.
Hih thu hangin a galte uh khut sungah amaute na ap a, a galte un amaute hih gawpgawp uh hi. Ahi zongin amau a kihih gawpgawp hun ciangin nang tungah hong ko uh a, nangmah in vantung panin na za a, na hehpihna lianpi tawh amau' galte kiang panin a honkhia ding honkhiate na puak hi.
Ahi zongin a tawldam khit uh ciangin nangma muhna ah a sia gamta zel uh a, nangmah in amau' galte khut sungah na nusia a, a galte un amaute ukgawp uh hi. Ahi zongin amaute in nang tungah huhna hong nget uh ciangin vantung panin amau' ngetna za-in na hehpihna tawh amaute tam veipi na honkhia hi.
Tua hi a, na thukham lamah amaute hong kihei kik nading lim takin amaute na hilhkhol a, ahi zongin amaute kihisakin na thupiaknate don lo uh hi; a zuite tungah nuntakna a pia thei ahi na ngeina kip tungah amaute khial uh hi. Lung khauhin phengphi-in amaute kiheikhia uh a, thu mang nuam lo uh hi.
Kum tampi sung lungduaina tawh amaute na thuak a, na kamsangte tung tawnin na Kha Siangtho tawh amaute na hilhkhol hi; ahi zongin amaute in ngai nuam lo uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin gamdang mite khut sungah amaute na pia hi.
Ahi ta zongin na hehpihna lian hangin amaute beisak loin, zong na nusia kei hi; bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in dikna leh hehpihna a nei na hi hi.
"'Tua ahih ciangin tu-in a lian, a vanglian, a kihtakhuai, itna tawh kipawl thuciamna kip takin a len kote' Pasian aw, Assiria kumpite' hun-a kipan tu ni dongin ka kumpite uh, ka uliante uh, ka siampite uh, ka kamsangte uh, ka pu ka pate uh leh ko mi khempeuh tungah hong tung gimnate hong neu ngaihsut sak kei in.
Kote tungah hong tungsa thu khempeuh ah nangmah a thutang na hi a, nang citakin a om na hi a, ko a khial gamtat kha ka hi uh hi.
Ka kumpite uh, ka uliante uh, ka siampite uh leh ka pu ka pate un nangma thukham zui lo uh a, amaute tungah na piak ahi na thupiaknate leh na hilhkholhnate zong don lo uh hi.

"Israel mi honte khempeuh a mi pha zah tawh kizui-in a innkuankuan, a beh beh-in, pasal peuhmah a milip-in sim in;
nang leh Aaron in Israel sungah kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah a pha, galdo dingin a kuan thei ding mi khempeuh a hon a honin na sim ding uh hi.
A minam simin a beh sungah a lutang ahi mi khat ciat nang tawh hong om ding uh hi.
Hihte in no hong huh dingte min ahi hi. Reuben sung panin Shedeur' tapa Elizur;
Simeon sung panin Zurishaddai' tapa Shelumiel;
Judah sung panin Amminadab' tapa Nahshon;
Issakhar' sung panin Zur' tapa Nethanel;
Zebulun, sung panin Helon' tapa Eliab;
Josef tapate, Efraim sung panin Ammihud' tapa Elishama, leh Manasseh sung panin Pedahzur' tapa Gamaliel;
Benjamin sung panin Gideoni' tapa Abidan;
Dan sung panin Ammishaddai' tapa Ahiezer;
Asher' sung panin Okran' tapa Pagiel;
Gad sung panin De-uel' tapa Eliasaf;
Naftali sung panin Enan' tapa Ahira ahi hi," a ci hi.
Hihte in mihon sung panin a kiteel, amau' phung sung panin a makaite, Israel behte' lutangte ahi uh hi.
Israel tacil, Reuben mi, a suan a khakte, kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah a pha pasal peuhmah, a milipin, a min phazah tawh kizui-in a innkuankuan, a beh beh-in, galdo dingin a kuan thei khempeuh:
Reuben minam tul sawmli leh tulguk leh zanga pha hi.
Simeon mi, a suan a khakte, kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah a pha pasal peuhmah, a milipin, tua a kisimte a min phazah tawh kizui-in a innkuankuan, a beh beh-in, galdo dingin a kuan thei khempeuh:
Simeon minam tul sawmnga leh tulkua leh zathum pha hi.
Gad mi, a suan a khakte, kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah a min phazah tawh kizui-in a innkuankuan, a beh beh-in galdo dingin a kuan thei khempeuh:
Gad minam tul sawmli leh tulnga leh zaguk leh sawmnga pha hi.
Judah mi, a suan a khakte, kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah a min pha zah tawh kizui-in a innkuankuan, a beh beh-in, galdo dingin a kuan thei pasal peuhmah:
Judah minam tul sawmsagih leh tulli leh zaguk pha hi.
Issakhar mi, a suan a khakte, kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah a min phazah tawh kizui-in a innkuankuan, a beh beh-in, galdo dingin a kuan thei pasal peuhmah:
Issakhar minam tul sawmnga leh tulli leh zali pha hi.
Zebulun mi, a suan a khakte, kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah a min phazah tawh kizui-in a innkuankuan, a beh beh-in, galdo dingin a kuan thei pasal peuhmah:
Zebulun minam tul sawmnga leh tul sagih leh zali pha hi.
Josef mi, Efraim mi a kicite, a suan a khakte, kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah a min phazah tawh kizui-in a innkuankuan, a beh beh-in, galdo dingin a kuan thei pasal peuhmah:
Efraim minam tul sawmli leh zanga pha hi.
Manasseh mi, a suan a khakte, kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah a min phazah tawh kizui-in a innkuankuan, a beh beh-in, galdo dingin a kuan thei pasal peuhmah:
