Note in galte hangin lau loin, lungsim kha khatah kipin, Lungdamna Thu tawh kipawl upna ading, lungsim kituakin na hahkatna uh, ka hong tun' ciangin note tawh kimu-in ahi zongin, a kikhenin i om ahi zongin ka zak theih nadingin Khazih' Lungdamna Thu tawh akilawm akituakin gamtat ding na hanciam un.
Tua bangin galte hangah lau lohna in amaute' adingin kisiat nading lim ahi hi; note' adingin ahih leh, Pasian' vaihawmna bangin gupna lim ahi hi.
Huaihamna lungsim, a mawkna minthan' deihna lungsim neihna tawh bangmah na hih kei un. Midangte in note sangin a phazaw hi ci-in lungsim niamkhiatna tawh khat leh khat na kingaihsun un.
Nomau noptuamna bek ngaihsun loin, midangte' noptuam nadingin khat leh khat na kingaihsun un.
Khazih Zeisu sungah a om lungsim note sungah om ta hen:
Amah in Pasian' lim leh meel tawh dimin a om napi-in, Pasian tawh kibatnate ka khah kei ding hi ci loin,
Ama minthan'na paai-in, sila lim la-in, Mi tawh kibatna-ah a suak hi.
Tua bang lim tawh dimin kimu a, Sihna a thuak tham loin, singlamteh tungah a sih dongin, Thumang-in ama pumpi a kiniamsak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian in amah pahtawi-in Min khempeuhte sangin min a lianzaw a pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka itte aw, note in thu na man' tawntung uh bangin keimah maitangah tham loin, ka muh lohna-ah zong thungai-in, launa liin'na lungsim tawh, gupna na ngahna uh semkhia un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in ama deihna bangin na sepnop nading uh leh na sep theih nadingun Pasian mahmah in nomau sungah hong sem ding hi.
Note in na hihna khempeuh uh ah thuum lo, tau lo, kinial loin na hih un.
Tua bangin na hih uh leh, mawhsak nading om loin, kuama tungah khialhna om loin, lungkawi-a kisia mi pawlte lakah mawhna neu kha beek a nei lo Pasian' tate na suak ding uh hi. Nuntakna tawh kipawl thu hilhin, vantunga aksite bangin tua mi pawlte lakah na taang ding uh hi.
Tua ahih leh, kei in a mawkna-in tai ka hi kei a, a mawkna-in nasemin hahkat ka hi kei hi ci-in Khazih' Ni ciangin lungdam kisathei-in ka om ding hi.
Tua tham loin, na piak uh biakna, note upna biakna tungah ka pumpi ka piakhia zongin, ka nuam hi; note khempeuh tawh ka lungdam khawm hi.
Tua mah bangin note in zong nuam un la, keimah tawh lungdam khawm un.
Ahih hangin note thu thei-in ka lungnop tuam nadingin, note kiangah Timoti ka hong sawl ding hi ci-in Zeisu sungah ka lamen hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah in note phattuam nading lungsim pha a neih bangin a nei khat beek keima kiangah a om kei hi.
Amaute in Zeisu Khazih' phattuamna zong loin amaute' phattuamna bek a zong uh hi.
Ahih hangin ta in a pa tawh na a sepkhawm mah bangin Timoti in kei tawh Lungdamna Thu khan'sakna-ah na a semkhawm hi ci-in ama teci thu note in na thei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin keima tungah bang thu a piang ka theih khit ciangin, amah note kiangah amanlangin kong sawl ding hi ci-in lamenin ka om hi.
Ahih hangin keimahmah zong note kiangah a sawt loin ka hong pai ding hi, ci-in Topa sungah ka um hi.
Ahih hangin nasepna leh galdona ah keimah hong vaak, hong khoi mi ahi, note sawltak ahi, ka naupa Epafroditas, note kiangah tu-in ka hong sawl ding kilawm ka sa hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a ci natna thu note in na zak uh bangin, amah in note hong ngai-in, nakpi lungzuangin a om hi.
Amah in si dek takin a gim mahmah hi. Ahih hangin Pasian in amah a hehpih hi. Amah bek ahi kei hi, keima dahna a kibehlap sawnsawn loh nadingin kei zong hong hehpih hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in amah na muhkik uh ciangin na lungdam nading uh ahi zongin, keima dahna zong a kiam nading ahi zongin nomau kiangah hahkatin ka hong sawl hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa sungah lungdamna tawh amah na tungsak un la, tua bang mite na zahtak un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in kei nong vaak, nong khoina uh a kicing lote amah in kicingsak dingin Khazih adingin ama nuntakna a sih dektak zah dongin a hanciam zo hi.
A khak bel thu in: ka it ka ute ka naute aw, Topa sungah na lungdam ta un. Hih bangin ka hong gelhkik hangin ka gim kei hi, note ading bitna ahi hi.
Tua uite, gilo-a gamtate na peel un, vun-atna thu ah a kineih mite na peel un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian Kha Siangtho hangin bia a, i pumpi muang loin, Khazih Zeisu hangah lungdamna kisaktheihna bek a nei eite in, vun-atna taktak a ngah mite i hi hi.
Ahih hangin kei ka hih leh, ci-le-sa ah zong suan' ding ka nei hi. Midang khatpeuh in ci-le-sa ah suan' ding ka nei hi ci-in a ki-up leh, keimah in ka nei zaw hi.
Keimah in ni giat ni-in vun-atna ka thuak hi. Israel mi Benjamin' suan ka hi hi. Hebru mi pana piang Hebru mi taktak ka hi hi. Thukham lam pan ci leeng Farisai mi ka hi hi.

Tua tham loin keimah in Khazih Zeisu ka Topa ka theih tel nadingin na khempeuh supna hi ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.

Khazih Zeisu sungah Pasian in tung lam pan hong sapna tawh kipawl lungdamna ngah nadingin, kidemin kung dongin hahkatin ka tai hi.

David' tapa, Israel kumpi Solomon' paunakte:
Mite in pilna leh thuhoihte a phawk theih nading, khiatna thuk a nei kammalte a theih theih nading.
A hoih-in a pil gamtat theih nading, thuman, thutang, a kilawmin a gamtat theih nading.
Thu thei nai lote in a theih nading, khangnote in pilna leh thu ngaihsut theihna a ngah nading.
Mi ciimsate ciimsak semsemin, mipilsate pilsak semsem-in,
paunakte leh thugentehnate thei-in, mipilte' kampau leh a thugente a theih nading.
Topa zahtakna in pilna kipatna hi a, mihaite in pilna leh thuhilhna don lo uh hi.
Ka ta aw, na pa' hong thuhilhna zui in la, na nu' hong thugente ngai in.
Tua hilhnate in na gamtatna hong hoihsak ding a, kizepna lukhu leh kizepna khi bangin hong etlawm sak ding hi.
Ka ta aw, mihoih lote in hong zol ciangin, amau' zolna zui kei in.

ka thugente khempeuh hong thudon loin, kong tainate hong mang nuam lo na hih manun,

Na thatang teng numei tungah beisak kei in la, na sum khempeuh numei tungah zang kei in, numei in kumpipa siasak thei hi.
A si dekdekte, khamtheihzu pia in la, a lungkham mahmahte, leenggahzu pia in.
Amaute ne sak lecin a zawn'na uh mangngilhin, a lungkhamna uh phawk nawn lo ding hi.
Thu a gen thei lo mite' adingin gensak in la, a huh ding om lo mite pan'pih in.
Amau' ading thu genin a tangin thu khen in la, a zawng-a cimawh mite, amau' adinga kilawm hamphatna ngah sak in.
Zi hoih in suangmanpha sangin manpha zawpek a, ahi zongin zi hoih ngah ding haksa mahmah hi.
A pasal in muang mahmah a, a innsung uh ah annek kitasam ngei lo uh hi,
Amah in a khan' tawntungin a pasal tungah thupha bawl a, a pasal tungah thusia tun'ngei lo hi.
Amah in samul leh khau zongin, thanuam takin nasem hi.
Amah in, sumbukte' van pua teembaw bangin, gamlapi panin an hong ciahpih hi.
Phalvak tungin ziingtho a, an nek ding teng lim takin bawlin, a nasem numeite' sep ding teng vaihawmsak hi.
Amah in leitang hoih penpen zong a, a thalawhsa sum tawh a leenggui lo ding lei hi.
A nik sing ten'in a puanban zial a, thalawp takin a na sem hi.
Amah in khau kheek-in, a puan ding gan tawm hi.
A zawng mite tungah amah cingh a, a cimawh mite tungah huhna pia hi.
A innkuan bup-un puanlum guan' zo ahih manin, phalbi tun' ding lunghimawh lo hi.
Amah in a puan ding khui tawm a, saihadial puansan vive silh zo hi.
A pasal, thukhen upate lakah a tut ciangin, mite' lakah kizahtak hi.
Amah in puan khui-in, kawnggakte zong bawl a, sumbukte tungah tuate zuak hi.
Amah a tha hatin, zong kizahtak a, mailam hun-a ding a lung patau lo hi.
Amah in pilna tawh thu gen a, kam khum takin pau hiat-hiat hi.
Amah in a innkuan sung kisapna teng sem a, a tawntungin manlah den hi.
A tate in amah it uh a, a pasal in zong pakta mahmah a,
"Zi hoih tampi a om tei hangin, nang kan-a hoih kuamah om kei," ci-in phat hi.
Ngaihban'na in zuaupi hi thei a, mel hoihna zong maimang thei hi; ahi zongin Topa a zahtak numei in a phat taak khat ahi hi.
A sepna khempeuh hangin amah phat un, mi khempeuh in a zahtak dingin a kilawm ahi hi.
Mi nuamsa i cih in, migilote' thu a zui lo mi, mimawhte' lampi-a ding lo mi, mi a thusim lote' phual-a tu lo mi;
ama nopsakna in Topa' thu sung bek mah hi a, sun leh zanin ama thu a ngaihsunsun mi ahi hi.
Amah in luitui luang gei-a kisuan, ama gah hunin gah a, a teh a vul lo singkung tawh kibang hi. Ahihna khempeuh ah a ma pai hi.
Migilote ahih leh tua bang hi lo a, huih letkhiat ansi tawh kibang uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin migilote in thukhenna nang zo lo ding a, mimawhte in midikte' pawl sungah kihel thei lo ding hi;
bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in midikte' lampi kem a, migilote' lampi ahi leh siamang ding hi.
Bang thu hangin minamte in siat nading ah kithukhat sim a, mite in a mawk nading sawmsim uh hiam?
Leitung kumpite leh gam ukte in, Topa leh ama sathau nilhpa langpangin vaihawm uh a,
"Amau' hong hennate su-tat khia-in, amau khaute ei kiang panin paikhia ni," ci uh hi.
Vantunga tu-pa in nuihsan a, tua Topa in amaute zahko hi.
Tua ciangin hehna tawh amau kiangah thu gen ding a, heh luatna tawh amaute linglawng sakin,
"Ka mual siangtho Zion tungah ka Kumpi ka tusak khin hi," ci hi.
Topa' thukhenna kong gen ding hi; Amah in kei' tungah, "Nang in ka tapa na hi a, tuni in nang kong piang sak khin zo hi.
Keima tungah hong ngen in; nangma luah dingin minamte ka bawl ding a, leimong dongin nangma neihsa ka hisak ding hi.
Siktawn khat tawh amaute na satkham ding a, beelseekpa' beel den'khap bangin amaute lei-ah na dengzan ding hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpite aw, tu-in pil un; leitung gam ukte aw, thu phawk un.
Topa aw, ka galte tam mahmah! Mi tampi in kei hong langpan' nainai hi.
"Pasian in amah huh lo ding," mi tampi in hong ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin, Topa aw, nangmah in ka kidalna lum, ka minthan'na leh ka lu hong phongpa na hi hi.
Nakpi in Topa ka gal sap a, amah in a mual siangtho panin hong dawng hi.
Lum-in ka ihmu a, Topa in hong kem ahih manin ka thokik hi.
Keimah hong galbawl, hong umcih mi tulsawm tampite ka kihta kei hi.
Tho in, Topa! Kei hong hon in, ka Pasian! Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in ka galte khempeuh' paang na satgawp a, migilote' ha na su-tan hi.
Hotkhiatna in Topa, Nangma hang ahi hi; na mite tungah na thupha hong tung ta hen!
Kong sap ciangin hong dawng in, a thuman ka Pasian! Gimna ka thuak ciangin nopsakna nong pia hi. Kei hong hehpih in la ka thungetna hong za in.
Mite aw, ka minphatna in bang tanvei daina thuak ding ahi hiam? Bang tanvei thu mawkna deih-in, zuauthu zong ding na hi uh hiam?
Ahih hangin Topa in miphate ama adingin a koihtuam lam thei ta un; ke'n ka sap ciangin Topa in hong za hi.
Lau-in liing un la, mawhna pel un; na lupna tung uh-ah lungngai phapha un la, om khikhe lel un.
A maan biakna piaknate lui un la, Topa muang un.
Mi tampi in, "Thupha ngah thei leeng ut si hang. Ko tungah na maitang vang hong taangsak in, Topa!" ci uh hi.
Amaute in an leh leenggahtui a hauh cianga a nuam uh sangin nuamna lianzaw ka lung sungah nong guan hi.
Nuam takin lumin ka ihmu ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa aw, nangmah bek in lungmuan'na munah nong om sak hi.
Topa aw, kong paunate hong ngai in la, kong thumnate hong thudon in.
Ka Kumpi leh ka Pasian aw, nangma tungah hong thum ka hih manin ka kikona aw hong ngai in.
Topa aw, zingsangin ka aw nong za hi; zingsangin nangma adingin biakna bawlin kong ngak hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh gitlohna a deih Pasian na hi kei a, siatna in tawlkhat sung zong nang tawh a omkhawm thei kei hi.
Zuauthu a gen mite na susia hi; Topa in, mi thah nopna lungsim leh mi kheem nopna lungsim neite mudah hi.
Kei ahih leh, a kicing na itna kip suangin na inn sungah ka tum ding a, nangmah zahtakna tawh a siangtho na biakinn lam nga-in ka bia ding hi.
Topa aw, ka galte' hangin na thumanna tawh hong makaih in la, ka mai-ah na lampi tangsak in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amau sungah thuman om lo hi; amau lungsim ah siatna bek ngaihsun uh a, amau gawlgui in a kihongsa hankhuk tawh kibang hi. A leii uh tawh mawk phat uh hi.
Pasian aw, a mawhna uh amau thuak sak in la, amau thu mah tawh amau puksak in; amaute in nangmah hong lehdo uh ahih manin amau mawhna tampite hangin amau paaikhia in.
Ahih hangin nang hong belte khempeuh lungdam sak in la, nuamna la sasak tawntung in; na min a deihte, nangma sungah gualzo-a a lungdam theih nadingin amaute na hu hi.
Topa aw, thuman mi thupha na pia hi; lum tawh dal bangin deihsakna tawh na dal hi.
Topa aw, na heh laitak hong tai kei in la, lungso sa-in hong thuhilh kei in.
Topa aw, thanem ka hih manin kei tungah dikna hong zang in; Topa aw, ka guh ka tang na ahih manin hong dam sak in.
Ka hin' gim mahmah hi. Topa— bang tanvei hong sawt lai ding na hi hiam?
Topa aw, hong kihei in la kei hong gum in; itna kip neipa na hih manin keimah hong hon in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh sihna-ah nangmah phawk theihna om lo ahih manin, Leinuai panin kua in nang hong phat thei ding ahi hiam?
Ka tautauna-in ka gim hi; zan sialin ka khitui in ka lupphah tum a, ka kahkahna-in ka lupna kawt dikdek hi.
Siatna bawlte khempeuh aw, ka kiang panin kihemkhia un; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in ka kahna aw a za zo hi.
Topa in ka thumna za zo a, Topa in ka thungetna hong sang hi.
Ka galte khempeuh zahhuai in genthei mahmah ding uh hi; amaute in nungkik-in, maizumna thuak pah ding uh hi.
Topa ka Pasian aw, nang kong bel hi; kei hong delhte khempeuh kiang panin hong gum in la hong hon in.
Hong hon kei lecin, hong hon ding dang om lo ahih manin amaute in humpinelkai bangin hong kaikhia-in hong balgawp ding uh hi.
Topa ka Pasian aw, hih bangin ka gamtat a siat a, ka khut a khialh leh,
thu om lopi-in ka lawmte kheemin, ka galte ka huh tak leh,
galte in delhin hong pha hen la, lei lakah kei hong tuancilsak in la, leilak ah hong sialpai ta hen.
Tho in, Topa, hehsa-in thasaan in la, ka galte' hehna hong dal in; khanglo in, ka Pasian aw, thukhen nading khat na seh khin zo hi.
Mite nangma kim-ah kikhawmsak in la, amau tung a san'na munah tu in.
Topa in mite thukhen hi; Topa aw, ka thumanna leh ka sunga om keima dikna tawh kizui-in thu hong khen in.
Lungsim leh ngaihsutna a en a thuman Pasian aw, migilote' siatna beisak in la, mi thumante kipsak in.
Pasian in kei hong hupa hi a, lungsim thutang mite a hon hi.
Pasian in a tang-a thu khenpa hi a, ni sim-a heh den Pasian ahi hi.
Mi in a kibawl phat kik kei leh, Pasian in a thalkhau suui zo a, a namsau taat ding hi.
Amah in mei thaltang bawl a, sih theihna ama galhiamte a baihsa-in koih zo hi.
Migilo in thusia gai-in suak nuamin na a, zuauthu hing khia hi.
Amah in gum to-in, ama tawhsa gum sung mah ah amah kia hi.
Ama lungngaih hoih lo pen ama lu tungah tungkik a, ama gamtatsia pen ama luzang mah ah tu hi.
Ke'n ahih leh, ama dikna om bangin Topa tungah lungdamna ka lak ding a, a Sangpen Topa min, phatna la ka sak ding hi.
Topa, kote' Topa aw, leitung khempeuhah na min bangzahin lian! Vantungah na min a than'na
naungekte leh naupangte' kam tawh kisa hi; gal na neih manin galte leh langpangte na daihsak nadingin panmun kip na bawl khin hi.
Na khutmete' nasepna, na bawlsa kha leh aksite, na vantungte ka et ciangin,
nangma ngaihsut tham dingin mi in bang hi a, na phawk tham dingin mihing' ta bang hi lel ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin, Pasian sangin a neuzaw deuhin amah na bawl a, minthan'na leh pahtawina na guan hi.
Na khut tawh na bawlsate khempeuh tungah ukna amah na pia hi.
tuu leh bawng khempeuh, gamsa khempeuh zong,
huih lak-a leeng vasate, tui sunga om ngasate, tui' lampi-a tawn khempeuhte, na khempeuh ama khe nuai-ah na koih hi.
Topa, kote' Topa aw, leitung khempeuhah na min bangzahin lian!
Ka lungsim khempeuh tawh Topa tungah lungdamna kong pia ding hi; na bawlna a lamdangte khempeuh ka gen ding hi.
Lungdamin nangma sungah nuamin ka diang ding a, min phatna la ka sa ding hi, Sangpen Pa aw.
Ka galte a nungkik ciangin, nangma mai-ah amaute pukin kisia uh hi.

leitung mite' thu a manin khen a, a kilawm bangin mite' thu khen hi.

Topa aw, kote hong dal in la, tu khang mite kiang panin hong kem in.

ka galte in "Ama tungah gualzo khin ing" ci kha ding hi. Kei ka lin' manin ka galte nuam kha ding hi.

Pasian aw, nangmah hong bel ka hih ciangin keimah hong kem in.

Topa in ka to kumpipa tungah, "Na galte nangma khe ngakna-in ka bawl matengin ka taklam khutah tu in," a ci hi.
Topa in Zion panin na kumpi ciangkhut hong puak hi. Na galte' lakah uk in!
Na mihonte mual siangtho tungah na makaih ciangin, utna lungsim tawh na mite hong kipia ding uh hi. Daitui bangin zingsang ciangin na khangnona nangma tungah hong tung ding hi.
Topa in thuciam zo a, ama ngaihsutna kheel lo ding hi. "Melkhizedek bangin nang in a tawntungin siampi na hi hi," a ci hi.
Topa in nangma taklam-ah om hi; ama heh ni-in amah in kumpite zogawp ding hi.

Topa phat un, lungsim thutangte a omna, mihon kikhopna sungah ka lungsim khempeuh tawh Topa tungah lungdamna ka ko ding hi.
Topa' nasepnate lian a, hoih a sa mi khempeuh in tuate kankan uh hi.
Ama nasepna in pahtawina leh minliatna tawh kidim a, ama thumanna in kip tawntung hi.
Amah in phawk tawntung dingin a lamdang ama sepnate hong bawl a, Topa dikin hehpihna a nei hi.
Amah in amah zahtakte an pia a, ama thuciamna hong phawk tawntung hi.
Amah in ama mite tungah minamte' gamh a piakna tawh ama vangliatna hong lak khin hi.
Ama nasepnate khempeuh ah amah thumanin citak a, ama thupiaknate muan'taak mahmah hi.
A tawntungin tuate kip ngitnget a, thuman leh thutang tawh zuih ding ahi hi.
Amah in a mite hong honkhia a, amah in a tawntunga dingin thupiakna a bawl khin hi. Ama min, siangtho-in kihtak-huai mahmah hi!
Topa zahtakna in pilna kipatna ahi hi; ama thupiak a zuite khempeuh tungah thukhen siamna a pia hi. Amah phat tawntung ding ahi hi.
Topa phat un. Topa zahtak-in ama thupiaknate nuam a sa mahmah mi in thupha ngahpa ahi hi!
Ama suan-le-khakte in leitungah vanglian ding a, lungsim thutang a nei mipa' suan-le-khakte' thupha kipia ding hi.
Hauhna leh nopsaknate ama inn sungah dim ding a, ama thumanna kip tawntung ding hi.

Cingh gamtatin mi tungah leitawi pia a, thutangin a gamta mipa tungah thu hoih hi.
Amah kiliing lo taktak ding a, amah kiphawk tawntung ding hi.

Amah in hawmkhia zuahzuah a, mizawngte tungah pia khin hi; ama migitna kip tawntung a, amah vanglianin, kipahtawi ding hi.

ngana in sardonik suangmanpha, a gukna in sardius suangmanpha, a sagihna in khrisolait suangmanpha, a giatna in beril suangmanpha, a kuana in topaz suangmanpha, a sawmna in khirsoprase suangmanpha, a sawm-le-khatna in jakinth suangmanpha, a sawm-le-nihna in amethist suangmanpha ahi uh hi.
Khuapi kong khak sawm leh nih in, suangmanpha peek sawm leh nih ahi hi. Kongkhak khempeuh in suangmanpha khat tek ahi uh hi. Khuapi sung lampi in a siangtho limlang tawh kibang kham taktak ahi hi.
Tua khuapi sungah biakinnpi ka mu kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Vanglianpen Topa Pasian leh Tuuno in tua khuapi biakinnpi ahi uh hi.

Note in, 'Keima mite na hi kei uh hi,' a cihna munah, 'A nungta Pasian' tapate kicihna a ngah ding uh hi," ci-in a gen bang ahi hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Topa in leitung ah ama thukhenna kipsak a, manlangin a zo ding hi," ci-in a kiko hi.
Isaiah in:, "Vantung Topa in eite ading khaici hong omsak lai hi kei leh, Eite in Sodom leh Gomorrah khuate i bang zo ding hi," ci-in a masa-a a gen bang ahi hi.
Tua bang ahih leh, bang i ci gen ding hiam? Dikna a delh lo Gentailte in tua-upna tawh kipawl dikna a cihnopna ahi dikna a tung uh hi.
Ahih hangin dikna thukhamna a delh uh Israelte in tua dikna thukham ah a tung zo kei uh hi.
Bang hangin tung zo lo ahi uh hiam na cih uh leh, thu-upna tawh a delh kei uh hi, thukham gamtatna tawh a delh uh hi. Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin, amaute in sui-a kipuk na'ng suang a sui kha uh hi.
A kigelhna in: "Ngai un, sui-a kipuk khak na'ng suangpi leh mawhsak na'ng suangpi Zion mual tungah ka koih hi. Tua suangpi a um mi in zumna a thuak kei ding hi," ahi hi.
Ute naute aw, Israel mite in gupna a ngah nadingun ka lungsim in deihin, Pasian kiangah thu ka ngetsak hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amaute in Pasian' dikna thei loin, amau dikna kipsak nading a zong uh ahih ciangin, Pasian' dikna thu a mang kei uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, thu-um mi khempeuh in a dik nadingun thukham' mong in Zeisu ahi hi.

A thuk sungah kua in a kumsuk ding hiam?" ci-in na lung sungah na ngaihsun kei un a ci hi. Tua bang a cihna in, Khazih hong paipihsuk dingin kua in a kahto ding hiam? Khazih sihna pan a thosak dingin a thuk sungah kua in a kumsuk ding hiam? a cihnopna ahi hi.
Bang a ci hiam? Tua thu in nang tawh kinai-in na kam sungah, na lungsim sungah a om hi; ka hilh uh upna thu a cihnopna hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, "Zeisu in Topa ahi hi" ci-in na kam in mang a, Pasian in amah sihna pan a thosak kik zo hi ci-in na lungsim sungah na up leh, gupna na ngah ding hi.
Dikkisakna ngah nadingin lung sungah ki-um hi. Gupna ngah nadingin kam tawh kipulak hi.
"Amah a um mi peuhmah in zumna a thuak kei ding hi," ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Judah mipawl, Grik mipawl teeltuam a nei kei hi. Mi khempeuh a uk Pasian khat bek om a, ama kiangah thu a ngen mi khempeuh in a kicing hehpihna a ngah ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Topa' min tawh thu a ngen mi khempeuh in gupna a ngah ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin a thu-um lo mite in bang a ci thunget ding uh hiam? A thu a zak ngei loh uh Topa bang ci a um thei ding uh hiam? A hilh mi om kei leh, bang ci a za thei ding uh hiam?
A kisawl kei leh, bang ci a hilh thei ding hiam? Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin, "Nopna Lungdamna Thu hong zasak mite' khe in bang zahin kilawm ahi hiam!"
Ahih hangin mite khempeuh in Lungdamna Thu a ngai kei uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, kamsangpa Isaiah in, "Topa aw, kote thuhilhna kua in um ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin upna in thu zakna hangin a piang hi. Zakna in zong Khazih' thu hangin a piang hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in za hilo ahi uh hiam? A mantakpi a za uh hi: "Amaute aw un leitung khempeuh ah a zel zo hi; Amau thu un leimong dongin a tung zo hi."
Khatvei ka cih-inah, Israel mite in hih thu thei lo ahi uh hiam? Moses in: "Mipawl ahi lo mite hangin note in een'na lungsim na neih nadingun ahi zongin, Pilna nei lo mipawlte hangin na heh nadingun ahi zongin ka bawl ding hi," a ci masa hi.
Isaiah in hang takin: "Kei hong zong lo mite in hong mu zo uh hi, Kei thu hong kan lo mite tungah ka kilang zo hi," a ci hi.
Israel mipawlte thu panin, "Thungai lo, thu seel thei mipawlte lamah ni khat tawntung ka khutpeek ka zan hi," a ci hi.
Tua bang ahih leh, Pasian in ama mipawlte a paaikhia hiam? A paaikhia kei hi, ka ci hi. Keimah in zong Abraham' suan, Benjamin' mipawl Israel mi ka hi hi.
Pasian in a theih kholh ama mite a paaikhia kei hi.

Pasian in zong ama kiangah bang ci gen ahi hiam? "Baal mai-ah a khukdin' lo mi tul sagih keimah ading ka om sak zo hi," a ci hi.
Tua mah bangin tu lai takin hehpihna hangah a kiteelsa kimkhat a om lai uh hi.
Hehpihna hangah ahih leh, gamtatna hang ahi kei hi. Tua bang ahih kei leh, hehpihna in hehpihna ahi kei hi.
Tua bang ahih leh, bang ci ahi hiam? Israel mite in a zon' uh hangin a mu kei uh hi. A teelsate bek in a ngah uh hi. A om lai mite in a lung a khauhsak uh hi.
Tua mah bangin Lai Siangtho sungah, "Pasian a mu thei lo mittang ahi zongin, khua a za thei lo bil ahi zongin, a ihmu nuam lungsim tua mite tungah tuni dongin a pia hi," ci-in a kigelh hi.
David in: "Amau' ankuang un amau tungah tehlop ahi zongin, thangzak ahi zongin, kisuih khak a, kipukna ahi zongin, daantatna ahi zongin hi ta hen.
Amaute in a muh zawh loh nadingun amau mittang uh mial ta hen. Amau nung uh a tawntungin na kulsak in," ci-in a gelh hi.
Tua bang ahih leh, amaute a puk dongun a sui kha uh hiam? Tua bang hi zenzen lo hi. Amau sungah een'na om nadingin, amaute a pukna hangin Gentailte in gupna a ngah uh hi.
Amau pukna un leitungmite hauhna hi a, amau tan'na un Gentailte hauhna ahih leh, amaute kicin'na un hauhna tamzaw piang sak ding hilo ahi hiam?
Gentailte ahi note kiangah kong gen hi. Gentailte' sawltak ka hi ahih ciangin,
ka ci ka sa pawlte lung sungah een'na piang sakin lam khatpeuh mah tawh, kimkhat ka gup zawh khak nadingin, ka za ka phat hi.
Tua mite kipaih khiatna un leitung mite' kilem kikna a pian'sak leh, amau kikoihcin'na un sihna pan thawhkikna hilo ahi hiam?
A kipia masa buhneel a sian'tho leh, a lompi in a siangtho ding hi. A zung a sian'tho leh, a hiangte zong a siangtho ding uh hi.
A hiang kimkhat in a kitan khit ciangin gamlak oliv hiang ahi nangmah in, amau pum tungah pehin kibulh a, hiangte tawh kibangin oliv sing thazung tui zomin na neek leh,
a kitankhia hiangte kosia-in na kisathei kei in. Na kisaktheih leh, nangmah in a zung na pua kei hi, zung in nang hong pua zaw hi.
Tua ahih ciangin nang in, "Kei hong peh nadingin hiangte a kitan hi," ci-in nong ci ding hi.
Hi ta hen. Upna lungsim nei lo ahih ciangun amaute a kitan uh a, nangmah in na upna hang bekin na kip hi. Na kisathei kei in, na kihta in.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, Pasian in a hiang taktakte pammaih a sak kei leh, nangmah zong pammaih hong sa ding ahi kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a puk mite tungah a thukhenna ahi zongin, ama hehpihna sungah na kip leh, nangmah tungah Pasian' hehpihna ahi zongin, hih thu nih na ngaihsun in. Ama hehpihna sungah na kip kei leh, phuk tanna na thuak ding hi.
Amaute in zong amau up lohna sungah a om kei uh leh, a kung tungah zom kikin peh kik nading thu a ngah ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian in amaute khatvei a peh kik thei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, gamlak oliv kung taktak panin hong sat tanin, oliv kung hoih tungah ngeina zui loin nang hong kipeh leh, hiang taktakte ahi uh tua mite in amau oliv kungah zomin peh kik nading a ngah zaw ding uh hilo ahi hiam?
Ute naute aw, na kisaktheih loh nadingun Gentailte khempeuh hong lut khit matengin, Israel mite tungah khuamialna tawm a tung hi ci-in hih thuthuk thei loin na om ding uh ka ut kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin Israel mite khempeuh in gupna a ngah ding uh hi. Tua a kigelhna in: "Zion Mual tungah Gumpa hong pai ding a, Pasian zahtak lohna Jakob' suante lak pan a lakhia ding hi.
Amaute mawhna ke'n ka lakkhiat khit ciangin, Amau tungah ka piak thuciamna in, tua thu ahi ding hi" a ci hi.
Amaute in Lungdamna Thu pan note hangin galte ahi uh hi. Teelkhiatna thu panin pute pate hangin a ki-it mi ahi uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian' hehpihna thupha leh hong sapna in a thu a kidok kik ngei kei hi.
Note in nidang lai-inah Pasian' thu na man'loh uh hangin, tu-in amau thuman'lohna hangin hehpihna na ngah uh mah bangin,
note ngahsa hangah amaute in zong hehpihna a ngah nadingun, tu-in thungai loin a om uh hi.
Pasian in mi khempeuh hong hehpih theih nadingin mi khempeuh thungaih lohna sungah a khumcip hi.
Pasian' hauhna leh pilna leh siamna in bang zahin thuk hiam! A thukhennate kuamah in thei zo lo hi! A paina lampi zui-in i zon' hangin i mu zo kei hi!
Topa' lungsim kua in a thei ngei hiam? Amah tawh a vaihawm kua ahi ngei hiam?
A thukkik dingin na khat peuhpeuh kua in Pasian tungah pia ngei hiam?
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, na khempeuh in amah panin ahi zongin, amah hangin ahi zongin, amah adingin ahi zongin a piang uh hi. A tawntungin amah in minthan'na ngah ta hen. Amen.
Tua ahih ciangin ute naute aw, a hing biakna, a siangtho leh Pasian' deihna tawh kituakin, na pumpi uh Pasian kiangah na piak nadingun Pasian' hehpihna tawh kong thuum hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua bang hihna in a kilawm biakna nasepna ahi hi.
Hih leitung mite bangin na om kei un. A hoih, a deihhuai, a kicing ahi Pasian' deihna in bang ahi hiam ci-in na khen theih nadingun na lungsim uh bawl thakin, na lim uh na kilamdangsak un.
Kei tunga hong kipia hehpihna thupha hangin note' kiangah kong gen-inah: No-le-no na kingaihsut ding zah valun kithupi ngaihsut kei un; Pasian in mikim tunga hong hawmsak upna zah tawh kizui-in a man thukhenna tawh nomau ciat kingaihsun un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, pumpi khat sungah na tampi i nei a, tua nate in nasepna-za khat guak a neih loh uh mah bangin,
a tampi ahi eite in Khazih sungah pum khat bek i hi a, i vekpi-in pumpi' nate i hi hi.
Hong piak hehpihna thupha mah bangin eite in nam tampi hehpih phatna i ngah tek a, kamsangpa za i ngah leh, upna zah bangin kamsang na sem ni.
Nasepna za i ngah leh, tua na sem ni. Thuhilh mi in thuhilh na sem ta hen.
Hansuah mi in mi hansuah na sem ta hen. Hehpihna a pia mi in lungkimin pia ta hen. A uk mi in hahkatin uk ta hen. Midang a hehpih mi in hehpihna lungsim tawh pia ta hen.
Simtat loin itna lungsim om ta hen. Gitlohna mudahin gamtat hoih beel un.
Ute naute itna panin, khat leh khat dawmin na ki-it ta un. Minphatna panin midangte na pumpi uh sangin na phat zaw un.
Nasep hahkat un la, thadah kei un. Lungdamna tawh Topa'na na sem un.
Lawpin lungdam un. Gimna hong tun' ciangin thuak un. Thungen tawntung un.
Misiangthote a sapna bangun na hawm un. Zindo na hahkat un.
No hong bawlsiate thupha na pia un. Hamsiat loin thupha na pia un.
Mi lungdamte tawh kibangin na lungdam khawm un. A kapte tawh na kap khawm un.
Khat leh khat na lungsim uh na kituaksak un. Min san'na na lunggulh kei un. Lung kiniamsakna deih un. Kei mipil mi ka hi ci-in kingaihsun kei un.
Midangte in note hong bawlsiat bangin na thuk kei un. Mi khempeuh mai-ah a kilawm gamtatna na hanciam un.
Note in na hih zawh zahun mi khempeuh tawh na kilem un.
Ka itte aw, midangte in note tungah hong khialh leh, a mawhna na thuk kei un. Pasian' hehpihna na pia un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, "Thukkikna in keima aa ahi hi. A mawhna tawh kituakin ka thuk ding hi, Topa in a ci hi," ci-in Lai Siangtho in a gen hi.
Tua tham loin, "Na gal a gil a kial leh, an na vaak in. Tui a duh leh, a dawn ding na pia in. Tua bangin na bawl leh, ama lu tungah mei-amte a koih na hi ding hi.
Gitlohna na lel kei un, gamtatpha tawh gitlohna na zo un.
A hong uk mangte ukna khempeuh na mang un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian in thu a piak kei leh, ukna aana a nei kei ding uh hi. Ukna za a nei khempeuh Pasian piak za ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ukna a nial mi in Pasian' thu a nial ahi hi. Tua bang a nialte in mawhna daan a thuak ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ukna za a neite in, gamtat hoih mite kihtak ding ahi kei uh hi, gamtat hoih lote kihtak ding ahi uh hi. Ukna za a neite na kihtak nop kei leh, ahoihin gamta in. Tua bang na hih leh ukna neite kiangah pahtawina na ngah ding hi.
Amah in nang noptuam nadinga Pasian' na sem ahi hi. A hoih lo a gamta mi na hih leh, na kihta in. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, amah in a valkhong a, namsau tawi ahi kei hi. Gamtat hoih lo ahihte a mawhna daan pia ding Pasian' sawltak ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, daan kihtakna hang bekin a mang na hi kei uh hi; nomau kitheihna lungsim hangin na mang uh hi.
Tua thu hangin phiangsiah na pia uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amaute in Pasian' sawltak ahi uh ciangin, tua nasepna a tawntung a sem uh hi.
Mi khempeuh ngah ding a kilawm bangin na pia un. Phiangsiah ngah ding a kilawmte phiangsiah na pia un. Kihtak ding a kilawmte na kihta un. Zahtak ding a kilawmte na zahtak ta un.
Khat leh khat ki-itna longal bangmah na kibasak kei un. A lawmte a it mi in Thukham a zui khin zo hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, "Mi' zi tawh na mawh kei in, Mi na that kei in, Mi' na na gu kei in, Mi' na na deihgawh kei in, a cihna thukhamte akipan adang thukham khempeuh in, "Na pumpi na it bangin na lawmte na it in," cihna thukham khat sungah a om uh hi.
Itna in lawmte a siasak thei kei hi. Tua ahih ciangin itna in thukham zuihna thu kicin'na ahi hi.
Tua tham loin, eite hong gupna in eite upna ni tawh a nai sangin, tu-in hong naizaw ahih ciangin note in ihmutna pana khan'lawh nading hun hong tung zo hi ci-in na thei un.
Zan a bei dektak hi, sun hong nai zo hi. Tua ahih ciangin khuamial gamtatna paaikhia-in khuavak galnan'na silh ni.
Topa Zeisu Khazih silh un la, na pumpi huaiham na'ng uh note in na ngaihsun kei un.
Upna neu mi na mang un. Ahih hangin up khialh nading thute tua mi tawh na kikum kei un.
Mi khat in an pawl khempeuh neek theih nadingin upna a nei hi. Ahih hangin mi a thaneem mi in gah leh teh bek a ne hi.
An pawl khempeuh a ne mi in a ne lo mi simmawh kei hen. A ne lo mi in a ne mi dongtel kei hen. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian in tua pa a mang zo hi.
Mi dang' sawltak a dongtel nangmah in kua mi na hi hiam? Tua pa in a Topa thu dotna-ah a kip ahi zongin, a kip lo ahi zongin ahi ding hi. Ahih hangin a Topa in tua pa kipsak theihna a nei ahih ciangin a kipsak ding hi.
Mi khat in ni khat sangin ni khat a manpha zaw hi ci-in a ciamteh hi. Mi khat in ni khempeuh a kibang hi ci-in a ciamteh thei hi. Mikim in ama lungsimah pha a sak bang hi ta hen.
Ni a tang mi in Topa hangin a tang hi. An a ne mi in Topa hangin an a ne hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah in Pasian' hehpihna a phat hi. An ne lo mi in Topa hangin ne lo a, Pasian' hehpihna a phat hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite lakah kuamah in ama ading a nungta kei hi; kuamah in ama ading a si kei hi.
Eite i nuntak leh, Topa ading i nungta hi. Eite i sih leh, Topa ading i si hi. Tua ahih ciangin eite i nungta ahi zongin, i si ahi zongin, Topa' aa i hi hi.
Khazih in misite leh mi nungtate' Topa a suah nadingin sihna thuak a, a sih khit ciangin a hing kik hi.
Nang in bang hangin na u na nau dongtelin thu na khen hiam? Na u na nau bang hangin na simmawh hiam? Eite khempeuh in Pasian' thukhenna tokhom mai-ah i ding ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Lai Siangtho sungah: "Ka nuntak bangin ka mai-ah mi khempeuhte a khukdin' ding uh a, Leii khempeuh in Pasian a phat ding uh hi, ci-in Pasian in thu a pia hi," ci-in a kigelh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin eite khempeuh in eima thu tekah Pasian' thudotna i thuak ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin eite in tu-a kipanin khat leh khat thu kisuah loin om ni. Unau khat puk nading ahi zongin, a khialh nading ahi zongin hih loh nadingin na ciamteh zaw un.
Bangmah in a pian'pih tawh a kihhuai kei hi, keimah in Topa Zeisu muangin thei-in ka lungkim hi. Ahih hangin a kihhuai a sa mi khat a om leh, ama tungah a kihhuai hi.
Na u na nau in nang an nekna hangin a dah leh, nang in itna tawh na gamta kei hi. Amah tang ding Khazih a si khin mi khat na an nekna tawh na siasak kei in.
Tua ahih ciangin na hih theihna uh ah gensiat nading omsak kei un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian' Gam in an nekna, tui dawnna-ah a kip kei hi. Kha Siangtho hanga kingah dikna, kilemna leh lungdamna-ah a kip hi.
Tua bang gamta a, Khazih' na a sem mi in Pasian lungdam sak a, mite mai-ah minphathuai ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kilem nading, khat leh khat kikipsak nading tawh kizom nate zui ni.
An nekna hangin Pasian bawlna na susia kei un. An khempeuh a siangtho hangin midangte a puk nading a ne mi in a khial hi.
Sa nekna, leenggahtui dawnna-a kipan na u na nau puk nading na khempeuh tan'huai hi.
Na neihsa na upna, nangmah ading Pasian mai-ah na om sak in. A man'sa thu-ah amah le amah a kimawhsak lote in mi hampha ahi uh hi.
A um khial mi in a nek leh, upna lungsim nei loin ne ahih ciangin amah le amah a kimawhsak ahi hi. Upna lungsim tawh kituak lo gamtatna khempeuh in mawhna ahi hi.
A thahat eite in eite deih bang zui loin thahat lote a thanemna i thuakpih ding hi.
Eite khempeuh in i lawmte noptuam na'ng ngaihsunin, amah i kipsak nading ama deihna zui ni.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Khazih in zong ama deihna zui lo a, Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin, "Nang hong simmawhte a simmawhna kam in keima tungah hong tung hi," a ci hi.
Eite in Lai Siangtho pan i ngah thuakzawhna leh hehnepna hangah lawpna i neih nadingin, Lai Siangtho-ah nidang lai-a a kigelhsa thu in eite hong thu hilhna-in a kigelh hi.
Note in eite Topa Zeisu Khazih' Pa ahi Pasian, lungsim kituakin na kam uh tawh na phat nadingun,
Khazih Zeisu deih bangin khat leh khat kilung tuakin na om nadingun , kithuakzawhna leh hehnepna a pia Pasian in hong hehpih ta hen.
Tua ahih ciangin Khazih in note hong man' mah bangin note in Pasian' minphatna kilangsakin, khat leh khat na kimang un.
Khatvei amah in: "Gentailte aw, note in ama mipawlte tawh na lungdam khawm un," a ci hi.
Khatvei leuleu: "Gentailte khempeuh aw, Topa phat un, mipawl khempeuhte in amah phat ta un," a ci hi.
Kamsangpa Isaiah in: "Jessi bul meeng in Gentailte a uk ding mi ahi ding hi. Gentailte in amah a muang ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Note in Kha Siangtho' vangliatna hangah lametna pha tawh na dim nadingun, upna nei-in lungdamna, noptuamna a pawlpawlte tawh na dim nadingun, muan'na hong pia Pasian in hong pia ta hen.
Ute naute aw, note in lungsim pha tawh dimin, pilna tawh na dim uh a, khat leh khat thu na kihilh thei uh, ci-in ka um hi.
Kha Siangtho in hong sian' thosak deihhuai biakna ahi Gentailte pia dingin,
keimah in Pasian' Lungdamna Thuhilh na semin Gentailte tungah Khazih' nasem ka hih nading, Pasian in kei hong piak hehpihna thupha hanginah ute naute aw, note hong phawksak kikin, lau loin lai ka gelh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian tawh a kituak nate hangah note lamsang ah keimah in Khazih Zeisu suangin ka kisathei hi.
Gentailte in kam tawh ahi zongin, gamtatna tawh ahi zongin, thungaih nading Khazih in
lim leh nalamdang vangliatna leh Kha Siangtho' vangliatna lakin keima tungah a bawl nate bek ka gen ngam hi. Tua ahih ciangin Jerusalem khua panin Ilirikum gam dongin, kimkot mun khempeuh ah, Khazih' Lungdamna Thu a vekpi-in ka hilh khin zo hi.
Ahi hi. Midangte khuamphuhna tungah ka lam loh na'ngin, Khazih' min a kizak ngeilohna munah Lungdamna Thu hilh dingin lungsim takpi tawh ka hahkat hi.
Lai Siangtho sungah: "Tua mi thu, kuamah in a lah ngei loh hangin amaute in a mu ding uh hi. A za ngei lo mite in a thei ding uh hi," ci-in a kigelh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note omna munah kong pai theih loh nading tam veipi hong kikham zo hi.
Tu lai takin hih munte-ah ka hih ding om lo ahih ciangin note omna-ah kong pai ding pen sau veipi-in deihin,
Spain ka pai ciangin lampi-ah note tawh kimu-in, note tawh kikhawl khawmin, deihna teng a kicin' khit ciangin tua gamah note hong khakna thupha ka ngah ding hi ci-in ka lamen hi.
Tu-in ahih leh, misiangthote vaakin Jerusalem khuapi-ah ka pai ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Makedonia gam mite leh Akhaia gam mite in Jerusalem khuapi-ah misiangtho zawngte sum hawm uh a, lungsim takpi tawh a pia zo uh hi.
Ahi hi, lungsim takpi a nei uh ka cih hangin amaute in tuate tungah leiba nei-in a kingaihsun uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Gentailte in Kha Siangtho piak thuphate Judah mite tawh a ngah khawm uh ahih leh, leitung sum pia-in amau zong Judah mite a vaak ding uh a kilawm hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hih na ka sep a, hih na piakna lim takin ka koih khit ciangin, note kiang tawnin Spain gamah ka pai ding hi.
Note omna mun kong tun' ciangin a kicing Khazih' thupha tawh kong pai ding, ke'n ka thei hi.
Nopna hong pia Pasian in note khempeuh tawh omkhawm ta hen. Amen.
Kenkhrea khua-ah a om pawlpi nasem numei ahi, i sanggamnu Foebe note kiangah kong tungsak hi.
Misiangthote in ahih ding a kilawm bangin, Pasian hangah tua numei na tungsak un la, amah huh dinga a kisapnate khempeuh na huh ta un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah in mi tampi ahi zongin, keimah ahi zongin hong huh mi ahi hi.
Kei tawh kibang Khazih Zeisu' nasem khawm Prisilla leh Akuila na hopihsak un.
Amaute in keima nuntakna tang ding amau ngawng a dawh ngamte ahi uh hi. "Amau in hehpihna a nei uh hi," ci-in kei guak hi lo, Gentail pawlpite khempeuh in a phat uh hi.
Amau inn sungah a om pawlpi zong na hopihsak un. Asia gamah Khazih ading a gah masabel ka it Epainetas zong na hopihsak un.
Note nasem a hahkat Mari na hopihsak un.
Kei tawh thongkia khawm, keima behte ahi Andronikas leh Junias zong na hopihsak un. Amaute in sawltak lakah maiphatna a ngah mi ahi uh a, kei mai-ah Khazih' sunga om mite ahi uh hi.
Pasian hangah ke'n ka it Amflias na hopihsak un.
Kote tawh Khazih' nasem khawmpa Urbanas leh ka it Stakhus zong na hopihsak un.
Nungzui taktak ahi Epelles leh Aritobulus' innkuante zong na hopihsak un.
Ka beh Herodion leh Narkissas' innkuante lakah Topa nung a zuite zong na hopihsak un.
Topa' nasemte ahi Trifana leh Trofosa na hopihsak un. Topa' nasem ahi it ding a kilawm numei Persis zong na hopihsak un.
Topa' teelsa Rufas leh a nu ahi, ke'n zong nu ka cih, na hopihsak un.
Asinkritas, Flegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas akipan, amaute tawh a omkhawm sanggamte na hopihsak un.
Filologas, Julia, Nereas leh a sanggamnu leh Olimpas akipan, amaute tawh a omkhawm misiangthote na hopihsak un.
Khat leh khat siangtho kinapna tawh na kihopih un. Khazih' pawlpite khempeuh in note hong hopih uh hi.
Ute naute aw, na san'sa uh thuhilhna tawh kituak lo, kikhenna leh pukna a bawl thei mite ciamteh un la, tang un, ci-in kong thuum hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite Topa Khazih' na sem loin amau gilpi na bek a sem uh a, kamsiam leh kamzol tawh a pha mite a kheem thei uh hi.
Note' thuman'na in mi khempeuhte lakah kithang ahih ciangin, note hangin ka lung a dam hi. Ahih hangin note in thuhoih lamsang ah lungpilna nei-in, gitlohna lamsang ah mawhna a om loh nading ka hong deih hi.
Nopna hong pia Pasian in a sawt loin note khe nuai uh ah Satan a bawlsia ding hi. Eite Topa Zeisu Khazih' hehpihna thupha in note tungah om ta hen.
Kei tawh na a semkhawm Timoti akipan ka behte ahi uh Lukias, Jason leh Sosipater-te in note hong hopih uh hi.
Hih lai a gelh keimah Tertias in Topa hangin kong hopih hi.
Kei ahi zongin, pawlpi khempeuh ahi zongin, zin hong do thei Gaias in note hong hopih hi. Khuapi dangka keem Erastas leh i sanggampa Kuartas-te in note hong hopih uh hi. (
I Topa Zeisu Khazih' hehpihna thu note khempeuh tawh omkhawm ta hen.)
pilna tawh a dim Pasian, Zeisu Khazih hangin a tawntungin minthan'na ngah ta hen! Amen.
Thukhente in a uk hun lai-in tua gam sungah kialpi tung a, Judah gam sunga Bethlehem khuami khat, amah leh a zi leh a tapa nihte tawh Moab gamah a peem dingin pai uh hi.
A mipa min in Elimelek hi a, a zi' min in Naomi hi-in, a tapa nihte' min in Mahlon leh Khilion ahi hi; amaute in Judah gam Bethlehem-a Efrathah mite ahi uh hi. Amaute Moab gamah pai-in tua lai-ah om uh hi.
Ahih hangin Naomi' pasal Elimelek si a, a tapa nihte bek tawh tua nu om hi.
Hih tapate in Moab mite zi-in la uh hi; a khat' min in Orpah hi a, adang khat min in Ruth ahi hi. Tua lai-ah amaute kum sawm bang teeng uh hi;
tua ciangin Mahlon leh Khilion si a, tua nupi a tapa nihte leh a pasal in sihsan hi.
Tua ciangin tua nu a mo tegel tawh Moab gam panin a ciahkik dingin kithawi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in a mite kemin an a piakna thu Moab gam sung panin amah in za hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a omna mun panin a mo tegel tawh tua nu dingkhia a, Judah gamah ciahkik dingin lam pai uh hi.
Ahih hangin Naomi in a mo nihte kiangah, "Pai un, na inn tuak uh ah ciahkik un la, na nute uh tawh om un. A sisate hita leh kei hita leh nong limbawl uh mah bangin Topa in note hong limbawl ta hen.
Topa in na pasal kik uh inn tuakah hong nuamsa sak hen!" a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in amaute namin, amaute a kap uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in ama kiangah, "Hi lo hi, na mite kiangah nang tawh kong ciah ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Naomi in, "Kilehkik un, ka tanute aw, bang hangin hong zui ding na hi uh hiam? Note' pasal hong hi thei dingin ka gil sungah tapa nei lai ka hi hiam?
Kilehkik un, ka tanute aw, na pai nading uh-ah pai un; bang hang hiam cih leh pasal nei dingin ka teek lua hi. Pasal nei dingin kilamen ing ci mah leng zong, tu nitak mahmahin pasal nei-in tapate nei phial ta mah leng zong,
amaute a khan' khit dong ngak zo ding na hi uh hiam? Pasal neih ding khawl ding na hi uh hiam? Hilo hi, ka tanute aw, Topa in kei hong langpan' ahih manin note sangin nakpi takin kei ka lunggim zaw hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute nakpi-in a kap kik uh hi; Orpah in a teeknu namin ciah a, ahih hangin Ruth in a teeknu beel hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "En in, na sanggamnu a mite leh a pasiante kiangah ciahkik khin hi; na sanggamnu' nungah nang zong ciah in," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Ruth in, "Nang kong nusiat nading ahi a, nang zuihna pan ka ciahkik nading ahi zongin hong cici kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh na paina-ah ka pai ding a, na giahna-ah ka giak ding hi; na mite in keima mite hi ding a, na Pasian in keima Pasian hi ding hi;
na sihna-ah ka si ding a, tua munah ka kivui ding hi. Sihna cih loh buang thudang hangin kong nusiat taak leh Topa in kei hong dawm kei ta hen!" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Naomi in amah a zuih ding a lungsim a khentatna a muh ciangin bangmah ci nawn lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Bethlehem a tun' mateng a nih-un paisuak uh hi. Bethlehem a tun' uh ciangin amaute' hangin a khuazangpi-un luum lialua uh hi; "Hih nu Naomi ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, "Naomi hong ci nawn kei un, Mara hong ci un, bang hang hiam cih leh Vanglianpa in nakpi takin kei hong gim sak hi.
A dim-in ka paikhia a, Topa in a hawmin hong ciahpih kik hi. Topa in kei hong gim sakin Vanglianpa in kei tungah gimna hong tungsak ahih ciangin bang hangin Naomi hong ci lai na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-a bangin Moab gam panin Naomi, Moab mi a monu Ruth tawh hong ciahkik hi. Mangbuhham lak kipat lai takin Bethlehem khua hong tung uh hi.
Tu-in Naomi in a pasal' tanaute, Elimelek innkuan sung mi, Boaz min nei a hau mi gina khat nei hi.
Tua ciangin Moab mi Ruth in Naomi kiangah, "Lo-ah hong kuansak in la maipha ka muhna peuhpeuhpa' nungah anvuite lak-ah a sangh hong tawm sak in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in ama kiangah, "Pai in, ka tanu aw," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah kuan khia-in pai a, an late' nung lo sungah ansanghte tawm hi; Elimelekte innkuan Boaz' lo-ah va pai kha hi.
En in, Boaz in Bethlehem panin hong pai hi; amah in an late kiangah, "Topa in note hong ompih ta hen!" a ci hi. Amaute in dawngin, "Topa in nang thupha hong pia ta hen!" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Boaz in an late a uk a nasempa kiangah, "Hih numei kua ta ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin an late a uk nasempa in dawngin, "Moab gam panin Naomi tawh a hong ciahkik Moab numei ahi hi.
Tua numei in, 'Kong thum hi, ansangh hong tawm sakin an late nungah anlomte lakah a kiate hong khawm sak in,' hong ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah hong pai-in tawlkhat zong khawl loin zingsang tunga kipan tu dong sem suak hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Boaz in Ruth kiangah, "Tu-in, ngai in, ka tanu aw, midangte' lo-ah ansang tawm dingin pai kei in la, hih lo zong nusia kei in, ka numeite' nai-ah om cinten in.
Amaute' an lakna lo na mitsuan in la, amaute' nungah zui in. Nang hong bawlsiat loh nading uh tangvalte thu pia khin hilo ka hi hiam? Na dang a tak ciangin pai in la tangvalte' tui tawisa dawn in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a mai-in lei-ah puksuk a, lei lakah kunin ama kiangah, "Kei gamdang mi khat hi napi, hih banga kei nong phawk nadingin bang hangin na mai-ah maipha ngah ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Boaz in tua nu dawngin, "Na pasal a sih khit-a kipan na teeknu' adingin na sepnate khempeuh, leh na nu leh na pa leh na pian'na gam nusia-in nidanga na theih ngei loh mite kiangah na paina thu a kicing takin kei kiangah hong kigen zo hi.
Topa in na gamtatna sate apha tawh hong thuk a, a lim nuai beel dinga na paina Israelte' Pasian, Topa in thaman a cingin hong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin numei in, "Ka topa aw, kei tungah nong dik mahmah hi; bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in na nasem numeite hilo napi-in na nasemnu tungah migitna kam nong pau hi," a ci hi.
An nek hun ciangin Boaz in tua nu kiangah, "Hih lai-ah hong pai in, anlum ne in la, leenggahzu sungah na an diah in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin an late gei-ah amah tu a, tuapa in an kante tua nu khak hi; amah in a kham mateng ne a, a khamval zong pawlkhat om lai hi.
Tua nu ansang tawm dingin a din' ciangin Boaz in a tangvalte hilh a, "Anlomte lak nangawn ah tawm sak un la, amah kosia kei un.
Anlom hente lak panin zong ama adingin pawlkhat dok khia-in ama top dingin nusia un la, amah tai kei un," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in nitak dong lo sungah tawm hi; tua ciangin amah in a topsa teng satkhia a, mangbuhham seu khat bang pha hi.
Tua ciangin amah in pua-in khuapi sungah ciah hi; a an top teng a teeknu lakin, a an khamvalte zong la-in amah pia hi.
Tua ciangin a teeknu in ama kiangah, "Tu ni-in koi-ah tawm na hi hiam? Koi-ah na sem na hi hiam? Nang hong phawk mipa in thupha ngah ta hen," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a teeknu kiangah a naseppihte gen a, "Tu ni-a ka nasepna mipa in Boaz ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Naomi in a monu kiangah, "A dikna in a hingte hita leh, a site hita leh a mangngilh lo Topa in amah thupha pia ta hen!" a ci hi. Naomi in ama kiangah, "Tua mipa in i behte, i tanau naipente khat ahi hi," zong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moab numei Ruth in, "Tu-a ban-ah amah in kei kiangah, "Ka an khempeuh a lak khit matengun ka nasemte kiang nai-ah om in, hong ci hi," a ci hi.
Naomi in a monu Ruth kiangah, "Ka tanu aw, ama numeite tawh na kuankhop hoih mahmah hi; tua hi kei leh lo dangah nang hong kibawlsia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Boaz numeite' nai-ah amah omin mangbuhham lak khit dong ansangh tawm hi; a teeknu tawh amah omkhawm hi.
Tua ciangin a teeknu Naomi in ama kiangah, "Ka tanu aw, nang' adingin a nop nadingin inn na suan' nading kong vaihawmsak ding kilawm hilo ahi hiam?
A numeite tawh na na sepna Boaz in i tanau hilo ahi hiam? Thei in, amah in tu nitakin ancilna-ah mangbuhham haih hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kisilin sathau kinuh in la, na puan hoihpente silhin ancilna-ah paisuk in; ahih hangin a nek a dawn a man mateng a mipa kiangah na pai lam kithei sak kei in.
Ahih hangin amah a lup ciangin a lupna mun encik in; tua ciangin pai in la a khe lam puan leemin lum in; tua ciangin na gamtat nading amah in hong gen ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in dawngin, "Na gen khempeuh ka hih ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ancilna-ah amah paisukin a teeknu in ama kiangah a gensa bang teekteekin gamta hi.
Boaz in a nek a dawn khit ciangin a lungnuam a, anphual nawl-ah lum dingin pai hi. Tua ciangin dam takin numei hong pai-in a khe lam puan leemsakin lumsuk hi.
Zankim ciangin mipa lau-in kihei a, en in, a khe-ah numei khat na lum!
Amah in, "Kua na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua nu in dawngin, "Keimah na nasemnu Ruth ka hi hi; tanaute na hih ciangin na nasemnu na puan hong zawn in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Topa in thupha hong pia ta hen, ka tanu aw; a hau hita leh a zawng hita leh tangvalte nung na zuih lohna-ah a masa sangin a lianzaw a tawpkhak hih dikna na gamta hi.
Tu-in ka tanu aw, lau kei in, na nget khempeuh nang adingin kong hih sak ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka khuapih mite khempeuh in numei gina na hih lam thei uh hi.
Kei pen tanau nai ka hihna man hi; ahih hangin kei sangin a naizaw tanau khat om lai hi.
Tu zan om in, zingsang ciangin amah in nang tungah tanaute' hih ding hong hih leh pha hi; amah hih sak in; ahih hangin nang tungah tanaute sep ding a sep nop kei leh, tua ciangin, Topa in a nungta ahih mah bangin nang tungah tanau nasep kong sem ding hi. Zingsang dong lum in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin zingsang dong a khe kiangah lum a, ahih hangin mi meel khat leh khat a kitheih ma-in amah tho hi; tua ciangin mipa in, "Ancilna-ah numei a paina kithei sak kei in," a ci hi.
Mipa in, "Na puansilh hong paipih in la hong dawh in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin numei in dawh a, amah in mangbuhham lawh guk teh khia-in tua nu guan' hi; tua ciangin khuapi sungah tua nu ciah hi.
A teeknu kiangah a tun' ciangin amah in, "Ka tanu aw, bang na ci hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in mipa in ama adingin a hihna teng genin,
"Hih mangbuhham lawh guk hong guan' hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, 'Na teeknu kiangah khut hawm guakin na ciah kei ding hi,' hong ci hi," a ci hi.
Amah in dawngin, "Ka tanu aw, a thu hong bangci suahkhiat cih na theih mateng ngak in; bang hang hiam cih leh mipa mawk om lo ding a, tu-in a thu siangsak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kulh kongpi-ah Boaz paito-in tua mun-ah tusuk hi; en in, tanaute, Boaz' genpa hong pai hi. Tua ahih ciangin Boaz in, "Hong pai dih in, lawm aw; hih lai-ah tu dih in," a ci hi; tua ciangin amah hong kihei-in hong tusuk hi.
Tua ciangin amah in khua upate mihing sawm sam-in, "Hih lai-ah tu dih un," a ci hi; tua ahih ciangin amaute tusuk uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in tanaupa kiangah, "Moab gam panin a hong ciahkik Naomi in i tanaute Elimelek' neihsa leitang zuak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hih thu nang kiangah kong gen ding ngaihsun in, 'Hih lai-a a tu mite' muhna leh keima mi upate' muhna-ah lei in,' kong ci hi. Na tat ding leh tan in; ahih hangin na tat kei ding leh, a thu ka theih nadingin kei kiangah hong gen in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang sim loh a tan ding kuamah om lo hi; tua ahih manin nang kiangah kong pai hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in "Ka tan ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Boaz in, "Naomi tung panin a lo na lei ni-a kipanin, a site, min a gamhluah ah a tun' kik theih nadingin a sipa' zi Moab numei Ruth zong a lei na hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a tanaupa in, "Keima gamhluah siasak kha ding ka hih manin keima adingin ka tan thei kei ding hi. Keimah in tan thei lo ka hih ciangin keima tat theihna thu nangmah in tang in," a ci hi.
Nidang lai-in Israelte sungah tatna leh kikhekna thu-ah ngeina in hih bang ahi hi; thu vaihawm khat peuhpeuh a kipsak nadingin mipa khat in a khedap suahkhia-in a lawmpa pia hi; hih banga hihna pen Israelte sungah kipsakna ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a tanaupa in Boaz kiangah, "Nang ading lei in," a cih ciangin amah in a khedap suahkhia hi.
Tua ciangin Boaz in upate leh mi khempeuh kiangah, "Tu ni-in note in Naomi' tung panin Elimelek leh Khilion leh Mahlon' neihsa khempeuh ka lei khitna thu teci na hi uh hi.
A site' min ama sanggamte leh a pian'na a khua sung panin a maiman' loh nadingin ama gamhluahna-ah a site min a kizop theih nadingin a si khin Mahlon' zi, Moab numei Ruth zong ka zi dingin ka lei khin hi; note in tu ni-in teci na hi uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kulh kongpi-a om mite khempeuh leh upate in, "Kote in teci ka hi uh hi. Topa in, Israelte' innkuan a lamto khawm Rachel leh Leah bangin na innkuan sunga hong pai numei bawl ta hen. Efrathah-ah na dau pai hen la, Bethlehem ah na minthang ta hen;
Topa in hih a khangno lai numei tawh nang hong piak na tate hangin Judah in Tamar tawh a neih tapa Perez' innkuan tawh kibangin na innkuan piang ta hen," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Boaz in Ruth la-in ama zi suak hi; amah in a zi luppih a, Topa in tua nu gai sakin amah in tapa khat nei hi.
Tua ciangin nupite in Naomi kiangah, "Tanau nei loin tu ni-in hong om sak lo Topa in thupha ngah ta hen; Israelte sungah ama min thang ta hen!
Amah in nang adingin na nuntakna hong pia kik, leh na khanghamna-ah hong vakpa hi ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh, tapa sagih sangin a thupizaw, nangmah hong it na monu' neih ahi hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Naomi in naungeek la-in a angah tawi a, amah cingnu suak hi.
A veng nupite in a min phuak uh a, "Naomi sung pan tapa khat suak," a ci uh hi. Amaute in a min Obed phuak uh hi; amah in Jessi' pa hi a, Jessi in David' pa ahi hi.
Tu-in Perez' suan-le-khakte in: Perez in Hezron' pa,
Hezron in Ram' pa Ram in Amminadab' pa,
Amminadab in Nahshon' pa, Nahshon in Salmon' pa,
Salmon in Boaz' pa, Boaz' in Obed' pa,
Obed in Jessi' pa, Jessi in David' pa ahi hi.
Solomon' la ngaihpente: Nungak:
Na muk tawh nong tawptawp a, nong itna in leenggahzu sangin khumzaw hi.
Na omna khempeuh nam vuauvuau a, na min kizaza a, nang hong ngai lo om lo hi.
Hong kai in la, paikhawm ni. Ka kumpi hong hi in la, na innah hong ciahpih in. Nang tawh om leeng i lung dam a, leenggahzu ne-in nuam sa ni. Nang kong ngaih khak tuahpha ing.
Jerusalem nungakte aw, ka vom hangin ngaih baang ing. Savun puanbuk bangin ka ang hiuhiau a, Solomon' puankhaite ka bang hi.

Na pu na pate uh bang nawn kei un. Nidanga kamsangte in amaute kiangah ka thu gen uh a, gamtatsia gamta loin, a mawh nawn lohna ding uh hilh uh hi. Ahi zongin amaute in ka thu ngai nuam loin, ka thu hong mang lo uh hi.
Tu-in na pu na pate uh koi-ah om ahi hiam? Tua kamsangte nungta lai sa na hi uh hiam?
Ahi zongin ka nasem ahi kamsangte' tung tawnin ka hilhkholhna leh ka thupiaknate in note dongin hong su kha lo ding sa na hi uh hiam? Tua ahih ciangin a tawpna-ah amaute kisik uh a, hih dinga ka lungsimah ka geelsa bangin amau' gamtatna tawh kizui-in daan ka piakna thu phawk uh hi,' ci in," a ci hi.
Darias in a uk a kum nihna kum, kha sawm leh kha khatna ahi Shebat kha ni sawmnih leh ni li ni-in Topa in kei tungah thu hong gen a, zanin mang hong musak hi.
Topa' vantungmi khat, sakol san khat tungah a tuang ka mu hi. Kuam sunga om mui singkungte lakah amah khawl a, ama nungah sakol dang a san, a gial, a kang om hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, "Sia aw, hih sakolte bang a cih nopna ahi hiam?" ci-in ka dong hi. Vantungmi in hong dawng a, "Bang a cih nopna hiam cih kong lak ding hi.
Hih sakol tung tuangte pai kawikawi-in leitung a en dingin Topa in a sawl ahi hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin mui kung lakah a khawl Topa' vantungmite kiangah amaute in, "Leitung khempeuh ka en kawikawi khin uh a, leitung khempeuh khua phawk loin nuam takin om uh hi," ci-in thu zasak uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' vantungmi in, "Vanglianpen Topa aw, Jerusalem khuapi leh Judah gam khuapite tungah kum sawmsagih sung na heh khin ta hi. Amaute hehpih loin bang tan vei om lai ding na hi hiam?" ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in dikna leh hehnepna kam tawh vantungmi dawng a,
Vanglianpen Topa in ama tungah a gensa thute keimah in ka taangko sawn nadingin tua vantungmi in kei hong sawl a, "Ka khuapi siangtho Jerusalem, nakpi takin itin ka lunghimawh hi.
Tua banga nuam taka a om hithiat minamte tungah ka heh mahmah hi. Ka mite tungah ka hehna ki-ip tentanin ka om lai takin, hih minam dangte in ka mite' gimna nasiasak semsem uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Jerusalem khuapi tungah ka hehpihna a lak dingin ka hong paikik hi. Tua khuapi sungah ka biakinn kilam kik ding a, khuapi kulh zong kiciang kik ding hi, Topa in ci hi, ci-in gen in," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin vantungmi in ka taangko nading hong genkik leuleu a, "Ama khuapite nakpi takin cithei kikin, Jerusalem khuapi a hehnep kik nading, leh ama khuapi-in Zion a neihkik nading, Topa in gen hi, ci-in gen in," hong ci hi.
Ka khuadak leh saki li ka mu hi.
Bang a cih nopna ahi hiam, ci-in vantungmi kiangah ka dong hi. Amah in hong dawng a, "Judah mite, Israel mite, leh Jerusalem mite a theihthang gawp leitung vangliatnate saki a cih nopna hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in sek tawi mihing li hong lak hi.
Hih mite a bang hih ding ahi hiam, ci-in ka dong hi. Amah in hong dawng a, "Hih saki lite in Judah mite thehthang gawp a, a lang uhah kuamah pang ngam lo ahih manin, tu-in hih sek tawi lite in Judah gam sugawpin a mite a thehthang gawp minamte lau sakin a lawnthal ding ahi hi," hong ci hi.
Ka muhna dang khat leuleu-ah, a khut sungah tehna khau a tawi mi khat ka mu hi.
"Koi-a pai ding na hi hiam?" ci-in ka dong a, amah in "Jerusalem khuapi a sauna leh a zaina ka theih nadingin a teh dingin a pai ding ka hi hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin vantung mipa hong paikhia a, vantungmi dang khat in amah na dawntuah hi.
Tua ciangin vantungmi a masapa in a dawntuahpa kiangah, "Va tai in la, tehna khau a tawi tangvalpa kiangah hih thu va gen in, Jerusalem khua sungah mihing leh ganhing tam mahmah ding ahih manin Jerusalem kulh huam sungah ta zo lo ding uh hi.
Tua khuapi a hu dingin meikulh bangin Topa mahmah a om nading, leh tua khua sungah a minthan'na tawh a teen' nading thu, Topa in kamciam zo hi, ci-in va gen in," a ci hi.
Topa in ama mite kiangah, "Mun khempeuhah note kong thehthang khin hi. "Hong pai un! Hong pai un! Saklam gam panin taikhia un."
Babilon-ah a om ka mite aw, Zion-ah tai un," ci hi.
Topa mahmah in note hong su ding a, ni danga note' na hong sepsak mite in tu-in note' nate hong lehsuh kik ding uh hi," hong cisak hi. Hih bangin thu hong pian' ciangin Vanglianpen Topa in kei hong sawl lam tak na thei ding uh hi.
Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Jerusalem mite aw, lungdamin la sa un. Note tawh hong omkhawm ta ding ka hi hi," ci hi.
Tua hun ciangin Topa kiangah minam tampi hong pai ding uh a, ama mite suak ding uh hi. Topa in note hong ompih ding a, tua ciangin note kiangah kei a hong sawlna thu na thei ding uh hi.
Judah mite in gam siangtho sungah Topa' neihtuam mite hong suakkik ding a, Jerusalem khua pen a it penpen khuapi hong hi kik ding hi.
Mi khempeuh aw, Topa' mai-ah gamdai-in om un. Bang hang hiam cih leh a siangtho ama omna mun panin amah hong paikhia ta hi.
Topa in mang hong musak a, Topa' vantungmi mai-ah siampi lian Joshua ding-in, a mawhna a zong dingin a kiangah Satan zong a om ka mu hi.
Topa' vantungmi in Satan kiangah, "Satan aw, Topa in nang hong taai hi. Jerusalem a it Topa in nang hong taai hi. Hih Joshua pen, meikhuk sung panin a kiteenkhia singkhuah tawh kibang hi," a ci hi.
Joshua ahih leh vantungmi' mai-ah ding a, puan a nin mahmah silh hi.
Vantungmi in ama sawltak van mi dangte kiangah, "Hih mipa' silh a puan ninte suah khiatsak un," ci-in thu pia hi. Tua ciangin vantungmi in Joshua kiangah, "Na mawhna teng kong paih khiatsak khin a, tu-in na silh dingin puan thak ka hong pia ding hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin a sawltak vanmite thu pia a, Joshua' lu tungah dial siangtho a khipsak ding uh sawl hi. Topa' vantungmi tua munah a din' sung mahin, amaute in zong Joshua, dial siangtho khimsakin, tua khit ciangin puan siangtho zong silhsak uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' vantungmi in Joshua kiangah lim takin thu gen a,
Vanglianpen Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Ka thukhamte zui a, kong sawl thute na sep leh, ka biakinn sung leh biakinn huang sung teng na uk ding a, hih ka kianga om vantungmite' thu ka ngaih bangin nangma thu zong ka ngai ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin siampi lian Joshua aw, ngai in; ama siampi pih ahi no adangte in zong ngai un. Note in mai lam thu hoih nadingin lim na hi uh hi. Sing bangin A Sel ka nasempa khat kong paisak ding hi.
Joshua' omna mai-ah, mittang sagih a nei suang khat ka koih hi; tua suang tungah lai ka gelh ding a, ni khat sungin hih gam mite' mawhna ka paihkhiatsak ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin note khempeuh in leenggui leh theikungte hau-in nuam na sa ding uh a, na veengte ciat un hong nekpihin hong lungdampih nadingun na sam ding uh hi, Vanglianpen Topa in ci hi," a ci hi.
Kei tawh a kiho vantungmi mah hong paikik a, a ihmu kimlai a kiphong bang keekin kei hong khanglosak hi.
Amah in, "Bang na mu hiam?" ci-in hong dong hi. Kei zong, "Kham tawh a kibawl meivakkhuam khat ka mu hi. Tua meivakkhuam in meivak sagih nei a, meivak tui koih nading hai khat zong a khuam dawnah om hi. Tua meivak sagihte in meivakkhau nei ciat uh hi.
Meivakkhuam gei-ah oliv kung nih zong om a, meivakkhuam lang tuakah om uh hi," ci-in ka dawng hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong vantungmi kiangah, "Sia aw; hihte bang a cih nopna ahi hiam?" ci-in ka dot ciangin,
amah in, "A cih nopna thei lo na hi hiam?" ci-in hong dong a, kei zong "Sia aw, ka thei kei hi," ci-in ka dawngkik hi.
Tua ciangin vantungmi in kei kiangah, "Topa in Zerubbabel' tungah hih bangin thu gen hi; Thagum hat hang hi lo, vangliatna hang zong hi lo, keima tung panin na ngah Kha hang bek tawh na ma na tun' zo ding hi.
Thu haksa pente nangawn in na ma hong khaktan zo lo ding hi. Biakinn na lamkik ding a, mite in, 'Hoih mahmah hi,' ci-in a ot ngeii-ngai lai takin a khupna suang na ciang ding hi, hong ci hi," a ci hi.
Topa in kei tungah thu hong gen hi.
Amah in, "Zerubbabel in biakinn bulpi phut khin a, biakinn lam zong zo ding hi. Tua ciangin ka mite in, amaute kiangah nang kong sawlna thu thei ding uh hi.
A ma uh a telh loh manin ka mite lungkia uh a, ahi zongin Zerubbabel in biakinn lam nasep a makaihna a muh uh ciangin a lung uh damkik ding hi," hong ci hi. Vantungmi in, "Meivak sagihte in, leitung khempeuh a etna Topa' mittang sagih ahi hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong ama kiangah, "Meivakkhuam pang tuak-a om oliv kung nihte bang a cih nopna ahi hiam?
Oliv thau a luan' khiatna kham tuizawl nihte' gei-a om oliv hiang nihte bang a cih nopna ahi hiam?" ci-in ka dong hi.
Amah in, "Thei lo na hi hiam?" ci-in hong dong a, kei zong, "Sia aw, thei kei ing," ci-in ka dawng hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Leitung khempeuh' Topa' na a sem dingin Pasian in teelin sathau a nilh mi nihte a cih nopna ahi hi," hong ci hi.
Ka khuadak kik leh huih lakah a leeng laizial khat ka mu hi.
Vantungmi in, "Bang mu na hi hiam?" ci-in hong dong a, kei zong, "Laizial a leeng khat ka mu a, a dung pi sawmthum pha-in, a vai pi sawm leh pi nga pha hi," ci-in ka dawng hi.
Tua ciangin amah kei kiangah, "leitung gam khempeuhah a pai ding hamsiatnate, hih lai tungah kigelh hi. Guta khempeuh, gam sung panin kisiak khia mang ding hi, ci-in laizial dal lang khatah kigelh a, a man lopi-in ka min tawh thuciam mi khempeuh zong kisiak khia mang ding hi, ci-in a lang khatah kigelh hi.
Vanglianpen Topa in hih samsiatna a khahkhiatna ding thu gen a, guta mite khempeuh leh a man loin ka min tawh thuciam mite khempeuh' inn sungah lut ding hi. Tua bang mite' inn sungah a tawntungin hamsiatna omin, amaute-a kipan a sing a suang, a vekpi-in kisumai ding hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin vantungmi hong kilang kikin kei kiangah, "Tu-a hong pai ding en in," hong ci hi.
Kei zong, "Bang ahi hiam?" ci-in ka dong hi. Amah in hong dawng a, "Tua in ciangpi hi a, gamsung khempeuh' mawhna lim ahi hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangpi a sin in haknaw kibawl ahi hi. Tua banga ka et lai takin haknaw kibawl tua ciangpi sin pen kidomto a, tua ciangpi sungah numei khat tu hi.
Tua ciangin vantungmi in, "Hih numei in gitlohna lim ahi hi," hong ci hi. Tua ciangin vantungmi in ciangpi sungah tua numei hensuk kik a, a sin tawh tua ciangpi sinkik hi.
Tua ciangin ka khuadak leh numei nih ka mu a, tui-vapi bangin kha nei-in, keima lamah hong leeng uh hi. Van lamah tua ciangpi leh'pih to uh hi.
Tua ciangin vantungmi kiangah, "Koi lai-ah len'pih ding ahi uh hiam?" ci-in ka dong hi.
Amah in, "Biakinn khat a lamsak dingin Babilon gamah a len'pih ding ahi uh hi. Biakinn a lamsak uh a zawh uh ciangin, biak dingin tua ciangpi kikoih ding hi," ci-in hong dawng hi.
Mang adang khat ka mu leuleu hi. Sumngo mual nih kikal panin sakolleeng li hong paikhia ka mu hi.
A leeng masa pen sakol san in kai a, a nihna, sakol vom in kai a,
a thumna, sakol kang in kai a, a lina, sakol gial in kai hi.
Tua ciangin vantungmi kiangah, "Sia aw, hih sakolleengte bang a cih nopna ahi hiam?" ci-in ka dong hi.
Tua ciangin amah in hong dawng a, "Hihte in vantunga om kha lite a cih nopna hi a, leitung khempeuhte' Topa kiang panin a hong paikhia ahi uh hi," hong ci hi.
Sakol vomte in a kaih leeng pen leilu lam Babilon gamah a pai ding hi a, sakol kangte nitumna lam, sakol gialte leitaw lam, sakol sante nisuahna lam gamah a pai ding ahi hi.
Tua sakolte, pai khia-in leitung teng a et ding uh ngaklah mahmah uh hi. Tua ahih manin vantungmi in, "Pai un la, leitung teng va en un," ci-in thu pia hi. Amaute zong pai-in va en uh hi.
Tua ciangin vantungmi in kei hong otsan a, "Leilu lam Babilon gamah a paite in Topa' hehna damsak hi," hong ci hi.
Amah in, "Babilon gam salsuahna pan a hong ciahkik Heldai, Tobijah, leh Jedaiahte' hong piak letsongte la in la, tua na lak ni mahin, Zefaniah' tapa Josiah' innah paipih in.
Amaute' hong piak ngun leh khamte zangin kumpi lukhu khat bawl in la, Johozadak' tapa, siampi lian a sem Joshua khusak in.
Ama kiangah, 'Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Hih mipa in sing bangin A Sel a kici mipa ahi hi. A omna peuhpeuh-ah amah cithei ding a, Topa' biakinn lamkik ding hi.
Amah in Topa' biakinn a lam dingpa hi a, kumpite' ngah theih minliatna ngahin, ama mite uk ding hi. Ama kumpi tokhom gei-ah siampi khat om ding a, kithutuakin kilemin na semkhawm ding uh hi," ci hi,' va ci in.
Tua kumpi lukhu pen Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, leh Josiahte pahtawi-in phawk nadingin biakinn sungah om ding hi," hong ci hi.
Gamlapi-a teeng mite hong pai-in Topa' inn lam nasep hong huh ding uh hi. Tua biakinn a kilam kik ciangin Vanglianpen Topa in note kiangah kei a hong sawlna thu na thei ding uh hi. Topa na Pasian uh' thupiaknate cing takin na zuih nak uh leh tu-a ka gen bangin hong piang ding hi.
Kumpi Darias in a uk a kum lina, a kha kuana Khislev kha a ni li ni-in Topa in Zekhariah tungah thu gen hi.
Tua ahih manin Topa in kei tungah thu hong gen a,
"Gam sung mi khempeuh leh siampite tungah hih bangin gen in: Amaute in a beisa kum sawmsagih sung kha ngana leh kha sagihna sungin an tangin a kahna uh, kei hong pahtawina uh hi lo hi.
A an nek a tui dawnte uh zong amau' duh man bek hi," hong ci hi.
Jerusalem cithei-in a khua sungah mi tampi omin, leitaw lam gam, nitumna lam gam, a kim a pam khuapite-ah mi tampi teengin a om hun lai takin, tu-a mah bangin Topa in a kamsang masate' tung tawnin a gensa thu ahi hi.
Topa in Zekhariah tungah thu gen a,
"Note in thu a tangin khenin, khat leh khat tungah itna leh hehpihna kilakin,
note lakah a om meigong, tagah, gamdang mite, ahih kei leh mi zawngte gim pia loin, khat leh khat kisiatsak nading na ngaihsut loh nading uh thu ka hong pia zo hi," ci hi.
Ahi zongin amaute in mang nuam het lo uh a, hih thute ngaihsutin zong nei nuam lo uh hi.
Amaute in a lungsim uh suangtum bangin saksak uh a, Vanglianpen Topa in taanglai kamsangte tung tawnin a Kha Siangtho tawh a gen thuhilhnate ngai nuam lo uh hi. Tua ahih manin Topa heh mahmah hi.
Amaute ka hopih ciangin hong ngai nuam lo uh hi; kei zong amaute' hong thungetna ka ngai kei ding hi, Topa in ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Topa in "Huihpi' mut khiat bangin amaute thehthang gawpin, a theih ngei lohna uh gam dangah amaute teeng ding uh hi. Amau' nusiat leitang hoih in zong gamkhing suak ding a, a sungah kuamah om nawn loin daicip ding hi," a ci hi.
Vanglianpen Topa in kei tungah thu hong gen a,
amah in, "Jerusalem mite ka it luatna hangin Jerusalem khuapi ka huh nuam mahmah a, hih ka it luatna in a galte tungah ka heh hong suaksak hi.
Ka khuapi Zion ah ciahkikin Jerusalem ah ka teeng ding hi. Tua ciangin Jerusalem pen a citak khuapi ci-in minthang ding a, Vanglianpen Topa' mual in mual siangtho kici ding hi.
Jerusalem khuapi kongzing leh lamkabomte-ah a tu dingin puteekte omkik ding a, teek lua kisa-in ciangkhut khunin pai ding uh hi.
Kongzing khempeuh ah numei naupang kimawlin phezaizai ding uh hi.
Tu-in a om lai note adingin hih thu a hi thei lo ding tawh a kibat hangin kei adingin ahi mawh ding thu hi lo hi.
Nisuahna leh nitumna gamte panin ka mite ka honkhia ding a,
Jerusalem khua sungah ka tun'pih kik ding hi. Amaute in keima mi hi-in, kei in amau' Pasian ka hi ding a, amau tawh ka thuciamnate uh lim takin ka zui ding uh hi.
"Thakhauhin lungsim hang un. Ka biakinn a kilamkik nading a bul a kiphuh lai takin kamsangte in a gen thute mah a za na hi uh hi.
Tua hun ma-in mi ahi a, ganhing ahi zongin na a sem dingin kuamah in cial zo lo a, galte kihtakna hangin kuamah a ut utin om thei lo hi. Mi khat leh khat ka kidosak hi.
Ahi zongin tu-in a suakta lai hih minamte, ni danga-te ka bangsak kei ding hi.
A beisa hun-ah, Judah gam mite leh Israel gam mite pen, minam dangte in hamsiatna kamin zang uh a, 'Judah leh Israelte thuak bangin thuak un,' kici uh hi. Ahi zongin note kong honkhia ding a, tu-in midangte in, 'Judah leh Israel bangin thupha ngah un,' ci-in thupha piakna-in kinei ding uh hi. Tua ahih manin na lungsim uh hangsak un la lau kei un.
"Na pu na pate un kei hong hehsak ciangin amaute tungah siatna tun'sak ding ka ngaihsun a, ka lungsim ka khiam het kei hi.
Ahi zongin tu-in Jerusalem khuamite leh Judah gam mite tungah thupha piak ding ka ngaihsun hi. Tua ahih ciangin lunghimawh kei un.
Note, hih bangin gamta un: Note khat leh khat tungah thuman thutak kam kipau un. Thukhenna zumah, kilemna a piangsak ding thutang zang un.
Khat leh khat kisiatsak nading vaihawm kei un la, a man lopi-in teci pangin kiciam kei un. Zuauna, thuman lohna, leh kibawlsiatnate ka deih kei hi," hong ci hi.
amah in, "Kha lina, kha ngana, kha sagihna, leh kha sawmna sunga antan'nate pen, Judah gam mite' adingin lungdamin kipakin pawi bawlna hun suak ta ding hi. Tua ahih manin thuman leh kilemna deih pha un," hong ci hi.
Vanglianpen Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Minam liante leh khuapi liante panin Jerusalem ah mi hong pai hun hong tung ding hi.
Khuapi khat-a om mite in khuapi danga om mite kiangah, 'Vanglianpen Topa bia-in ama tung panin thupha ka ngen ding uh hi. Hong zui un,' ci ding uh hi.
A vanglian a thahat minamte in Vanglianpen Topa a bia ding leh ama tung pan thupha a ngen dingin Jerusalem ah hong pai ding uh hi.
Tua hun ciangin minam tuamtuamte sung panin mi sawm, Judah mi khat kiangah hong pai-in, 'Pasian in note hong ompihna thu za ka hih manun na nung hong zuisak in,' ci-in thuum ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Topa' thugenna: Hadrak gamte' daantuah nading Topa in thukhen zo a, Damaskas khuapi in zong tuak ding hi. Israel minam khempeuh, Topa' aa ahih mah bangin, leitung minam khempeuh zong Topa' aa ahi hi.
Hadrak tawh a kigizawng Hamath zong, ama' aa hi a, siamna a nei Tai-ar khuapi leh Sidon khuapite zong, ama' aa mah ahi hi.
Tai-ar khuapi in galnan'na kulh bawl a, leivui zahin ngun leh kham hau a, kongzing nin zahin kiciang venvan hi.
Ahi zongin, Topa in a neih khempeuh laksakin, tuipi sungah paihsak ding a, a khuapi haltum ding hi.
Ashkelon khuapi in hih thu mu-in lau ding a, Gaza khuapi in zong gimlawh ding hi. A lametna teng bei ding ahih manin, Ekron khuapi in zong gimlawh ding hi. Gaza khuapi in a kumpipa taan ding a, Ashkelon khuapi kinusiacip ding hi.
Ashdod khuapi-ah kahbia mite teeng ding a, a kiphasak Filistia mite ka beisak ding hi.
Amaute in sa, a sisan tawh ne nawn lo ding uh a, a kikham ante zong tang ding uh hi. A suakta sun teng, keima mite suak ding uh a, Judah minam lakah beh khat bang ding uh hi. Jebus mite mah bangin Ekron khuamite zong, keima mi suak ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin ka gamsung ka hu ding a, galte ka nawksak kei ding hi. Ka mihingte' thuakna mu khin ka hih manin, mi gilote ka bawlsiasak nawn kei ding hi.
Zion mite aw, nakpi takin lungdam un. Jerusalem mite aw, lungdamin awng un. En un, na kumpipa uh hong pai hi. Amah, dikna leh gupkhiatna tawh hong pai a, ahi zongin kiniamkhiatna tawh hong pai-in sin nai loh lano tungah hong tuang hi.
Gal kidona leengte, Israel gam pan beisakin, sakol galkapte, Judah gam pan ka la khia ding a, galdona-a kizang thalte, kisusia ding hi. Na kumpipa un, minamte lakah kilemna thu gen ding a, amah in, tuipi mong khat pan tuipi mong khat dong, Eufrates gunpi panin leimong dongin uk ding hi.
Sisan tawh a kikipsak, note tawh ka thuciamna hangin, na salsuahna uh keugaw gam panin, note ka hong suaktasak ding hi.
Lametna a om ta, no salte aw, ciahkik un la, a muanhuai na mun ngei uh zuankik un. Note' thuaknasa a zah nihin, thupha ka hong piak nading, tu ni-in note kiangah ka hong gen hi.
Grik mite sim nadingin, Judah thal bangin keek-in, Israel thaltang-in ka zang ding a, Zion mite namsau-in ka zang ding hi.
Ama mite tungah Topa kilang ding a, a thaltang lot khuaphia bang ding hi. Topa Pasian in peengkul tum ding a, leitaw lam pan-a hong nung huihpi tawh va kuankhia ding hi.
Vanglianpen Topa in ama mite hu ding a, ama mite in a galte uh susia ding hi. Galdona sungah, zukham bangin awng gawp ding uh a, a galte uh' sisan luangsak gawp ding uh hi. Biakna site, biakna tau tungah, hai-a sun tawh kibangin luangsak ding uh hi.
Tuucingpa in a tuuhonte, lauhuaina pan a hot bangin, tua ni ciangin Topa, amau' Pasian in a mite honkhia ding hi. Kumpi lukhu tunga suangmanphate bangin, ama gam sungah a mite taang ding uh hi.
Tua thu bangzah takin hoihin nuam ding ahi hiam! Anlim nekna in tangvalte thahatsak ding a, leenggahtui thak dawnna in nungakte thadimsak ding hi.
Singkung lopa a sel hunin, Topa' kiang pan guah ngen un. Meii kaisakin, guah zusak a, ankung khempeuh a dumsakpa in Topa ahi hi.
Mihingte in milim peuh, thudotin nei uh a, a thu ngahte uh, zuauthu leh a mawkna hi lel hi. Mang khia thei-a kineite in lamlak khial uh a, amau' hehnepnate, a mawknapi hi lel hi. Tua ahih manin, tuu bangin mite mangthang uh a, makai a neih loh manun gimna ngah uh hi.
Ka mi a makaite tungah ka heh suak a, amaute daan ka pia ding hi. Judah mite in, Vanglianpen Topa ahi keima aa hi a, amaute lim takin keemin, ka sakol galkap thahatte hi ding uh hi.
Amaute sung panin innkiu suang khetphim galkap mangte, gam ukte, hong khangkhia ding uh hi.
Kongzing buannawng lakah, a galte a tuancil gawp galkapte bangin, amaute gualzo ding uh a, Topa in a ompih manin amaute in galdo ding uh a, a galte' sakol galkapte zo gawp ding uh hi.
Judah mite, ka thahatsak ding a, Josef' innkuan ka honkhia ding hi. Amaute ka khasiat ding a, innah ka ciahpih kik ding hi. Amaute cik mah-a ka nial ngei loh bang keekin, nuam takin om ding uh hi. Keimah in Topa, amau' Pasian ka hi a, amau' thungetnate ka pia ding hi.
Israel mite' galkap hatte bang ding uh a, zukham lungnuam, bang ding uh hi. A suan a khakte un hih gualzawhna phawkin lungdam ding uh a, Topa' bawlna hangin kipak ding uh hi.
Amaute samin, ka kaikhawm ding a, amaute honkhia-in, ni danga zahin mi tampi ka phasak ding hi.
Mi namdangte lakah amaute ka thehthang hangin, a gamlapi gam panin kei hong phawk ding uh hi. Amaute leh a tate uh suakta-in, innah hong ciahkhawm ding uh hi.
Izipt leh Assiria gam panin amaute ka ciahpih kik ding a, amau' gam amau' lei-ah ka teengsak ding hi. Gilead gam leh Lebanon gamah zong ka teengsak ding a, gam khempeuhah mi dim ding hi.
Amaute in, lungkhamna tuipi a phutkhak uh ciangin, keimah in tuipi hualte ka vatmai ding a, Nail gun tuithukte kangcip ding hi. Assiria mite ka niamkhiat ding a, Izipt in a vangliatna taan ding hi.
Ka mite ka thahatsak ding a, amaute in kei hong bia-in ka thu hong mang ding uh hi, Topa in ci hi.
Mei in na taamtaak kungte a kat theih nadingin, na kongpite hong in, Lebanon aw,
Taaksan kungte aw, kapin thuum un; taamtaak kungte pukkhin a, a minthang singkungte kisia ta hi. Bashan tawsaw kungte aw, kapin thuum un; gammang tupi sing teng kiphuk ta hi.
Tuucingte, a minthan'na uh beita ahih manin, dahin kap uh hi. A tulak inn uh kisusia khin ahih manin humpinelkaite' hawkna za un.
Topa ka Pasian in kei tungah thu hong gen a, "Gawh dinga kikoih tuuhonte va cing in.
Tuu neite in a tuute go uh a, ahi zongin daan kipia lo hi. Amaute in a tuusa zuak uh a, 'Topa in thupha ngah ta hen. Tu-in i hau ta hi,' ci uh hi. A tuucingte mahmah in a tuute hehpihna nei lo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hih gam-a a teeng mite ka hehpih nawn kei ding hi. Amaute a ukpa leh a kumpipa' khut nuai-ah mi khempeuh ka koih ding hi. Gam uk mite in gam sung teng susia gawp dinga amau' suksiatna panin kuamah ka honkhia kei ding hi," hong ci hi.
Tua summeet bawlte in kei hong cial uh a, a kigo ding tuute a cingpa ka suak hi. Kei zong ciangkhut nih ka la a, khat pen Hehpihna ci-in min ka phuak a, a khat pen Kipawlna ci-in min ka phuak hi. Tua hi a, kei zong tua tuute a cingin ka om hi.
Kha khat sungin tuucing thumte ka notkhia hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute tungah ka lungduai zo nawn kei a, amaute in kei hong mudah uh hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong tuuhonte kiangah, "Note ka hong cing nawn kei ding hi. A si ding teng si un la, a kisusia ding teng siacip un. A om lai sun teng khat leh khat kisanek un," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin Hehpihna a kici ciangkhut la-in ka kuaitan a, minam khempeuh tawh ka bawl thuciamna ka phiat hi.
Tua ahih manin tua ni-in thuciamna kiphiat hi. Tuu summeet bawlte in hong en giugiau uh a, hih banga ka gamtatna panin Topa' thugen ahih lam phawk uh hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong amaute kiangah, "Hoih na sak uh leh ka tuucin' thaman hong pia un. Hoih na sak kei uh leh lah tang lel un," ka ci hi. Tua ciangin ka thaman dingin ngun shekel sawmthum hong pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in kei kiangah, "Biakinn sum koihna sungah tuate koih in," hong ci hi. Tua ciangin kei zong, kei tawh kituak-a tam a sak mahmah uh tua dangka sawmthum la-in biakinn sumkoihna sungah ka koih hi.
Tua ciangin Kipawlna a kici ciangkhut la-in ka kuaitan leuleu a, Judah leh Israel a kipawlna kiphiat hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in kei kiangah, "Khat vei tuucing nasep semkik in la, tu tungin kiman'na a nei lo tuucing nasep sem in.
Ka tuuhonte a cing dingin tuucing khat ka koih a, ahi zongin ka tuu a sia dingte huh loin, a mangthangte zong loin, a liamte bawl loin, a cidamte zong an vak lo hi. Amah in tuu thau pente' sa ne-in, a khecinte nangawn hawkkhiatsak zawsop hi.
Vanpi zalin, leitung piangsak a, mihingte tungah nuntakna a pia Topa in Israel mite tawh kisai-in thu gen a,
