Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, "Zingsangin tho baih inla, Faro' mai-ah dingin ama kiangah, 'Hebru mite' Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Amaute in keimah hong biak theih nadingun ka mite paisak in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh leitung khempeuhah kei tawh a kibang khat beek om lo hi, ci-in na theih nadingin hih hunin na inn sungtawng dong le na nasemte le na mite' tungah ka gimnate khempeuh kong tungsak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh tu-in keimah in ka khut zanin natna tawh nang le na mite hong vatgawpin, leitung panin note hong kibeisak thei hi.
Ahi zongin leitung khempeuhah keima min a kipulak theih nadingin note tungah ka vangliatna lah ding deihna-in kong nungtasak lai hi.
Ka mite tungah nang kiliansak lai-in amaute na paisak kei hi.
En in, zing ciang tubang hunin Egypt gam a kisat a kipanin tuhun dongin tua bang a kimu ngei lo, a tam mahmah gialpi ka kiasak ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in mi sawl inla, na ganhingte le gamlak a na neihte khempeuh a muanhuai bukna-ah koih in. Bang hang hiam cih leh inn-ah a kipaipih lo, gamlak a om mihing le ganhing tungah gialpi kia ding a, amaute si ding uh hi," ci hi,' ci-in gen in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Faro' nasemte' lak panin Topa' thu a zahtak mi in ama silate le a ganhingte inn-ah taisak hi.
Ahi zongin Topa' thu a don lo mi in ama silate le a ganhingte gamlakah nusia hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah, "Egypt gam sung khempeuh a mihing le ganhing le gamlak kungte khempeuh tungah gialpi a kiat theih nadingin vantung lamah na khut zan in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in vantung lamah a ciangkhut a zan hi. Topa in van gingsakin gialpi kiasak a, leitungah keek kia suk hi. Topa in Egypt gam sungah gialpi zusak hi.
Egypt gam minam khat a suah khit a kipanin tua bang a om ngei lo, a tam mahmah gialpi le gialpi lakah khua phia-in keek ging om tawntung hi.
Gialpi in Egypt gam sunga a om mihing le ganhing, na khempeuh denggawp hi. Gialpi in gamlak kung khempeuh denggawp a, gamlak singkung khempeuh dengtan hi.
Tua ciangin Faro in mi sawlin Moses le Aaron samsakin amaute kiangah, "Tutungin ka khial hi. Topa man hi. Kei le ka mite ka khial uh hi.
Topa' tungah thum un. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih vanging le gialpi kicingzo hi. Note kong paisak ding a, note na khawl nawn kei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Moses in ama kiangah, "Khuapi panin ka paikhiat khit phetin Topa' lamah ka khut ka zan ding hi. Leitung pen Topa a' hi, ci-in na theih nadingin vanging tawpin gialpi om nawn lo ding hi.
Ahih hangin nang le na nasemte in ahihleh, Topa Pasian na zahtak nai lohna uh ka thei hi," a ci hi.
(Anthul kungte le mangbuhham kisia hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mangbuhhamte a vuih laitak hi a, anthul kungte a pak laitak ahi hi.
Ahih hangin mangbuh le mangbuhmante sia lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tuate khangham nai lo hi.)
Tua ahih ciangin Faro' kiang pan khuapi pualamah Moses paikhia a, Topa' lamah a khut zanin thu a ngen hi. Vanging le gialpi tawp pah a, leitungah guah bua nawn lo hi.
Ahih hangin guah le gialpi le vanging a khawlna Faro in a muh ciangin amah khial lai a, amah le a nasemte in a lungsim uh khauhsak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in Moses tungtawnin a gensa bangin Faro' lungsim khauh lai a, amah in Israel mite paisak lo hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses tungah, "Faro' kiangah pai in. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute' lakah hih keima limte ka lah theih nading le keimah in Egypt mite ka mawlpihna le amaute' lakah bang limte bawl khin cihna thu na tate le na tute' zakna-ah na gen theih nading le, Topa ka hihna na theih nadingin ama lungsim le a nasemte' lungsim ka khauhsak hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Faro' kiangah Moses le Aaron pai-in ama kiangah, "Hebru mite' Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: 'Ka mai-ah nang na kiniamkhiat nading bang tanvei nial ding na hi hiam? Amaute in keimah hong biak theih nadingin ka mite paisak in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka mite paisak ding na nial leh, zing ciangin na gam sungah kauphete kong paipih ding a,
kuamah in leitang a muh theih loh nadingin tuate in lei maitang khempeuh tuam ding uh hi. Gialpi khit cianga nang a' dinga a omlai sunte amaute in ne ding uh hi. Tuate in gamlak a a po nangma singkung khempeuh ne ding uh a,
nangma innte le na nasemte khempeuh le Egypt mite' inn khempeuhah dim ding uh hi. Na pu na pate uh leitang tungah a pian' uh a kipan tuni donga tua bang a muh ngei lohte uh hi ding hi,' ci hi," ci-in a gen hi. Tua ciangin amah kihei-in Faro' kiang panin a paikhia hi.
Faro' nasemte in ama kiangah, "Eite tungah hih mipa bang tanvei thangzak hong hi niloh ding ahi hiam? Amaute in amau' Pasian, Topa a biak theih nadingun mite paisak in. Egypt a siatna theitel nai lo na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Faro kiangah Moses le Aaron kipaipih kik hi. Faro in amaute kiangah, "Pai un; Topa , na Pasian uh va bia un. Ahi zongin kua teng pai ding na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Moses in, "Ka khangnote uh le ka khanghamte uh tawh ka paikhawm ding uh hi. Ka tapate uh, ka tanute uh, ka tuuhonte uh, le ka bawnghonte uh tawh ka pai ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa a dingin pawi khat ka kham ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Faro in amaute kiangah, "Note tawh na naupangte uh kong paisak taak leh note tawh Topa hong om ta ve! En un, note in ngimna hoih lo na nei uh hi.
Tua bang hi lo ding! Note' lak panin pasalte pai unla, Topa va bia un. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen nomau' ut ahi hi," a ci hi. Faro' omna panin amaute kihawlkhia hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, "Egypt leitang tungah amaute hong omin, gialpi in a den baang kung khempeuh a ne ding kauphete sapna-in Egypt leitang tungah na khut zan khia in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses in Egypt leitang tungah a ciangkhut zan a, Topa in tua sun tawntung le tua zan tawntung leitang tungah nisuahna huih a nungsak hi. Zingsang ciangin nisuahna huih in kauphete hong tun khin hi.
Tua masiah kauphe hon tua banga a tam a om ngei lo, cikmah ciangin zong a omkik ngei lo ding, Egypt leitang tung khempeuhah kauphe hong om a, Egypt gam buppi-ah a dim uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh tuate in lei maitang khempeuh tuam uh a, leitang mial hi. Tuate in leitang tunga kung khempeuh le gialpi' den baang singkung gah khempeuh ne uh hi. Egypt leitang tung khempeuhah gamlak singkung hitaleh kungno hitaleh a hing khat beek om nawn lo hi.
Tua ciangin Faro in Moses le Aaron nawh sap a, " Topa na Pasian' tung le nangma tungah ka khial khin hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in ka khialhna hong maisak in. Tu-a khatvei bek, kong thum hi; keima tung panin hih sihna a lakkhiat ding Topa na Pasian' tungah thum in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Faro kiang panin amah paikhia-in Topa' tungah a thum hi.
Topa in nitumna huihpi hat mahmah khat nungsak a, tua huih in kauphete laamto-in San Tuipi sung a denna hi. Egypt gam sungah kauphe khat zong om nawn lo hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, "Mite in khuamial sung a zawt nading, Egypt leitang tungah khuamial a om theih nadingin vantung lamah na khut zan in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses in vantung lamah a khut zan a, Egypt leitang tung khempeuh ni thum sung khua mial bikbek hi.
Ni thum sung amau khatlekhat kimu thei lo uh a, ama omna panin kuamah paikhia thei lo hi. Ahih hangin Israel mite in amau' tenna-ah khuavak nei uh hi.
Tua ciangin Faro in Moses samin, "Pai un, Topa va bia un; na tate uh zong note tawh hong pai thei ding hi. Na tuuhonte uh le na bawnghonte uh omsak lai un," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Moses in, " Topa ka Pasian uh tungah ka piak theih nadingun biakpiakna le meihal biakna kote nong neihsak kul hi.
Ka ganhingte uh zong kote tawh a pai kul hi. Ganno khat zong kinusia lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa ka Pasian uh ka biak nadingun tuate ka paipih ding uh hi. A mun ka tun matengun bang pen tawh Topa bia ding cih ka thei kei uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Faro in ama kiangah, "Kei kiang panin kihem in. Nang kidawm in. Ka maitang hong mu kik nawn kei in. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka maitang nong muh ni-in nang na si ding hi," a ci hi.
Moses in, "Na cih bang hita hen! Na maitang kong mu kik nawn kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah, "Faro le Egypt tungah gimna khat ka tungsak lai ding a, tua khit ciangin hih lai mun panin amah in note hong paisak ding hi. Amah in note hong paisak ciangin note hong hawlkhia mang khin ding hi.
Pasal peuhmah in a vengte kiang pan, numei peuhmah in zong a vengte' kiang mah panin ngun le kham kizepnate a nget theih nadingun mite' zakin thu gen in," a ci hi.
Topa in Egypt mite' muhna-ah mite maipha pia hi. Tua tham loin, mipa Moses pen Egypt leitang tung, Faro' nasemte' muhna, le mite' muhna-ah lian mahmah hi.
Moses in Faro' kiangah, " Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Zankim pawlin Egypt mite' lakah ka pai ding hi.
Kumpi tokhom tunga tu Faro' tacil a kipanin an gawina nunga a om nasem numei tacil dong le ganhing tacil khempeuh, Egypt gam sungah tacil khempeuh si ding hi.
Cikmahin tua bang a om ngei lo, cikmah ciangin zong a omkik ngei lo ding kahna lianpi Egypt leitang tung khempeuhah om ding hi.
Ahih hangin Egypt mite le Israel mite a kilamdangin Topa in bawl hi, ci-in na theih nadingun Israel mite, mihing hitaleh ganhing hitaleh, ui khat nangawn zong tau lo ding hi, ci hi" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in Faro' kiangah, "Na uliante khempeuh keima kiangah hong paisukin, keima kiangah hong kun ding uh a, 'Nang le nangmah hong zui khempeuh paikhia un,' hong ci ding uh hi. Tua khit ciangin kei ka paikhia ding hi," ci thuah lai hi. Tua ciangin Faro' kiang panin amah a heh mahmahsa-in a paikhia hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, "Egypt tungah nalamdang tam ka bawl theih nadingin Faro in na thu hong ngai lo lai ding hi," a ci hi.
Moses le Aaron in hih na lamdangte khempeuh Faro' mai-ah a bawl uh hi. Topa in Faro' lungsim khauhsak a, amah in Israel mite a leitang panin paikhiasak lo hi.
Egypt gam sungah Topa in Moses le Aaron kiangah,
"Tu kha pen note a dingin kum kipatna hi ding a, note a dingin kum khat sungah a kha masa hi ding hi.
Israel mihon khempeuhte tungah gen in. Tu kha ni sawm ni-in innkuan khat a dingin tuuno ahih kei leh keelno khat, amau' innkuan phazah tawh kituakin amaute in ganno khat ciat go ding uh hi.
Ganno khat a ne ding innkuanmi a tawmluat leh amau' innzom a vengte tawh a mi tawh kituakin a sa hawm ding uh hi. A mi tamna le a nekzah uh tawh kizui-in ganno man pia ding uh hi.
Na ganno uh a sitbaang lo hi ding a, kum khat a pha a pa hi ding hi. Tua pen tuu ahi a, keel ahi zongin, khat peuhpeuh hi thei ding hi.
Tua gannote pen Israel mihonte khempeuh in a gawh ding hun nitak khuamui, tua kha ni sawm le li dong na kem ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in a si kimkhat la-in a nekna uh inn kongkhak khuam nihte le a bangtungzawl nuh ding uh hi.
Amaute in tua zanin a sa hangkeu-in ne ding uh a, silngo sawh loh anlum le a kha mehteh tawh amaute in ne ding uh hi.
A sate mun khat peuhpeuh a sial ahi a, tui tawh huanin ahi zongin ne loin, a lu le a khete le a sungkuate tawh hangkeu-in, na ne ding uh hi.
Zingsang dong a khing na omsak kei ding uh a, zingsang cianga a khing omlai peuhmah na haltum ding uh hi.
Hih bang zia-in na ne ding uh hi: Na kawng uh gakin, na khedap uh na khe uhah bulhin, na ciangkhut uh na khut uhah na tawi ding uh a, na nawh nek ding uh hi. Tua pen Topa' Paisan Pawi ahi hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in tua zanin Egypt gam ka nawk ding a, Egypt leitang tungah mihing hitaleh ganhing hitaleh tacil khempeuh ka vatlum ding a, Egypt pasian-te khempeuh tungah thu ka khen ding hi. Kei pen Topa ka hi hi.
Note' omna inn tunga sisan pen note a dingin lim hi ding hi. Sisan ka muh ciangin note kong paisan ding a, Egypt leitang ka vatgawp ciangin note hong susia ding gimna note' tungah hong tung lo ding hi.
"Hih pen note a dingin phawkna ni hi ding a, note in Topa' tungah pawi bawlna ni-in na nei ding uh hi. Na khang tawntungun note in biakna ngeina kip khatin na nei tawntung ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Topa in, "Note in ni sagih sung silngo sawh loh anlum na ne ding uh hi. A ni masa ni-in note in na inn panun silngo na hemkhia ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh khatpeuh in a ni masa ni panin a ni sagih ni dong silngo sawh a nek leh, Israel mi-in tua mipa kiseh nawn lo ding hi.
A ni masa ni le a ni sagih ni-in a siangtho biak kikhopna khat na nei ding uh a, tua ni nih sung na bangmah na sem kei ding uh hi. Ahi zongin na milipun an huanin na ne thei ding uh hi.
Note in silngo sawh loh anlum pawi na bawl ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih ni teekteekin Egypt leitang panin na mihonte uh ka paikhiatpih hi. Tua ahih ciangin note in na khan tawntungun hih ni pen biakna ngeina kip khatin na nei tawntung ding uh hi.
Kha masa, tua kha sawm le li nitakin note in silngo sawh loh anlum na ne ding uh a, tua kha ni sawmnih le khat nitak dong na ne ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ni sagih sung na innsung uhah silngo kimu lo ding hi. Mi khatpeuh, peemta hitaleh gammi hitaleh in silngo sawh a nek leh Israel mi-in tua mipa kiseh nawn lo ding hi.
Silngo a kisawh peuhmah na ne kei ding uh hi. Na omna khempeuh uhah silngo sawh loh anlum na ne ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in Israel upate khempeuh samin amaute kiangah, "Nomau a dingin na innkuan uh tawh a kituakin tuunote teel unla, Paisan Pawi bawl nading tuuno go un.
Puknah lomkhat la unla, kuang sunga om sisan sungah diahin, kuang sunga om sisan tawh bangtungzawl le kongkhak khuam nihte nuh un. Zingsang matengin a inn kongkhak pua-ah kuamah paikhia lo ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt mite a that dingin Topa in hong nawk ding hi. Bangtungzawl le kongkhak khuam nih tunga sisan a muh ciangin Topa in kongkhak paisan ding a, a susia dingte pen note that dingin na innsung uhah tumsak lo ding hi.
Note le na tapate un hih pen biakna ngeina kipin na nei tawntung ding uh hi.
Amah in hong ciamsa bangin Topa in note hong piak ding leitang na tun uh ciangin hih ngeina na zui ding uh hi.
Na tate un note kiangah, 'Hih banga hihna pen bang a cih nopna ahi hiam?' hong cih ciangin,
note in, ' Topa' Paisanna hangin biakpiakna ahi hi. Amah in eite' innkuante hong khawi-in Egypt mite a thah lai-in Egypt gam sungah Israel innkuante paisan hi,' na ci ding uh hi," a ci hi. Mite in a lu uh kunin Pasian a bia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses le Aaron a thupiak bangin mite a gamta uh hi.
Ama kumpi tokhom tunga a tu Faro' tacil a kipanin thongmial sunga a om a kiman mite' tacil le ganhing tacil khempeuh, zankim laitakin Topa in vatgawp hi.
Tua zanin Faro le a nasemte khempeuh le Egypt mite khempeuh tho uh a, Egypt gam sungah kahna lianpi a om hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh khat beek a sihlohna inn khat zong om lo hi.
Faro in Moses le Aaron zan sap a, "Ding un; keima mite' lak panin note le Israel mite paikhia unla, na gensa bangun Topa va bia un.
Na gensa bangun na tuuhonte uh le na bawnghonte uh la unla, pai un. Kei zong thupha hong pia un," a ci hi.
Tua gam panin mite manlangin a sawlkhiat nading uhah Egypt mite nawh tat mahmah uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in, "Eite khempeuh i si khin ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mite in silngo sawh nai loh a annel lom uh la-in, annel mekna amau' kuangte puan tawh tunin a liangko uhah pua uh hi.
Moses in amaute tunga a gen bangin Israel mite zong gamta uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Egypt mite' tung panin ngun le kham kizepnate le puante ngen uh hi.
Amau' ngette a piak nadingun Topa in Egypt mite' muhna-ah Israel mite maipha a pia hi. Tua bangin amaute in Egypt mite' na a sut uh hi.
Israel mite numei le naupang kisim loin pasal tul zaguk Rameses panin Sukkoth-ah khe-in pai uh hi.
Minamdang tampi le tuuhon le bawnghon, ganhing tampi zong amau tawh pai uh hi.
Egypt panin a ken uh annel lom panin amaute in silngo sawh loh moh em uh hi. Tuate silngo a kisawh lohna pen Egypt gam panin amaute kinotkhia a, ze-ol tat thei loin amau' annek ding zong kiging man lo uh hi.
Israel mite Egypt-ah kum zali le kum sawmthum sung om uh hi.
Kum zali le kum sawmthum a cin ni teekteekin Egypt leitang panin Topa' mihonpite paikhia uh hi.
Egypt leitang panin amaute a paikhiatpih nadingin hih pen Topa' zan vilna ahi hi. Tua mah bangin Israel mite khempeuh in zong amau' khang tawntungin Topa a dingin hih zan mah zan vilna-in a nei uh hi.
Topa in Moses le Aaron kiangah, "Hih Paisan Pawi pen biakna ngeina kip khat hi ding a, gamdangmi kuamah in ne lo ding hi.
Ahih hangin sum tawh a kilei sila peuhmah in a vun na at khit uh ciangin ne thei ding hi.
Peemta hitaleh a kicial nasem hitaleh in ne thei lo ding hi.
Inn sungah kine ding a, inn pua-ah a sa na paikhiatpih kei ding uh hi. A guh na kuaitan kei ding uh hi.
Israel mihon khempeuh in hih ding uh hi.
Khualmi khat note kiangah hong peem a, Topa a dingin Paisan Pawi a bawl leh, ama mipih pasal khempeuh a vun ki-atsak un. Tua khit ciangin amah a nai-ah hong pai-in bawl thei ding a, amah pen gammi khat tawh kibang ding hi. Ahih hangin vun ki-at lo mi kuamah in ne lo ding hi.
Gammi le note' lakah hong peem khualmi a dingin ngeina khat bek om ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua bangin Israel mite khempeuh gamta uh a, Topa in Moses le Aaron a thupiak bangin amaute in hih uh hi.
Tua ni teekteekin Topa in Israel mite a honpi-un Egypt gam panin a paikhiatpih hi.
"Keima tungah tacil khempeuh hong ap in. Israel mite' lakah, mihing hitaleh ganhing hitaleh, naubu a hong masa pen peuhpeuh keima-a' ahi hi," a ci hi.
Moses in mite tungah, "Salsuahna Egypt gam panin na paikhiat uh hih ni phawk un. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in vangliatna tawh hih mun panin note hong paikhiatpih hi. Silngo sawh anlum kine lo ding hi.
Abib kha, tuni-in note a paikhia na hi uh hi.
Amah in note tungah piak dinga na pate' tungah a ciam, bawngnawi le khuaizu a luanna leitang, Kanaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Hiv mite, le Jebus mite' leitangah Topa in note hong paipih ciangin hih kha sungin hih bangin na hih ding uh hi.
Note in silngo sawh loh anlum ni sagih sung na ne ding uh a, a ni sagih ni-in Topa pahtawina pawi khat om ding hi.
Silngo sawh loh anlum ni sagih sung kine ding hi. Note' tungah silngo sawh anlum kimu lo ding a, note' huang sung khempeuhah silngo kimu lo ding hi.
Tua ni-in na tate uh kiangah, 'Egypt panin ka paikhiat lai-un Topa in ko a' dinga hong hihsakna hang hi,' ci-in na gen ding uh hi.
Na kam un Topa' Thukham a gen tawntung theih nadingin hih pen na khut tung uhah lim, na taltang tung uhah phawkna khat hi ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in a vangliatna tawh hih mun panin note hong paikhiatpih hi.
"Amah in note le na pate uh tungah a ciam bangin, Topa in Kanaan leitangah note hong paipih hun ciang le note tungah tua gam hong piak ciangin,
note in naubu a hong masa khempeuh Topa a dingin na tuam koih ding uh hi. Na ganhing uh a tacil a pa khempeuh zong Topa a' hi ding hi.
La a tacil peuhmah tuuno khat tawh na tanh ding uh hi. Na tat kei ding uhleh a ngawng na kuaitan ding uh hi. Note' tapate' lak panin tacil peuhmah na tanh ding uh hi.
Hong pai ding hunah na tapa in, 'Hih pen bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?' ci-in nang hong dot ciangin, nangmah in ama kiangah, 'Salsuahna, Egypt panin Topa in vangliatna tawh kote hong paikhiatpih hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Faro in kote paisak ding a nial tentan ciangin Egypt gam sunga tacil khempeuh, mihing tacil le ganhing tacil khempeuh Topa in that hi. Tua ahih ciangin naubu a hong masa a pa khempeuh Topa' tungah biakna-in ka pia uh hi. Ahih hangin ka tapate uh sung pan tacil khempeuh ka tanh uh hi,' na ci ding hi.
Tua pen na khut tunga om ciaptehna lim ahih kei leh na mitte' kikal-a talsuante bang hi ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in a vangliatna tawh Egypt panin eite hong paikhiatpih hi," a ci hi.
Faro in mite a paisak ciangin, lampi tom pen hitaseleh, Pasian in Filistia gam tawnin amaute paipih lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in, "Amaute in gal a tuah ciangin mite kisikin Egypt-ah ciahkik kha ding hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian in San Tuipi lam manawhin sehnel gam lamah mite kot paipih hi. Israel mite gal a do dingin a kithawisa-in Egypt leitang panin a paito uh ahi hi.
Moses in Josef' guhte paipih hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ama guhte a puak ding uh Josef in Israel mite thupi takin kiciamna bawlsak khin hi. "Pasian in note hong hotkhiat ciangin note in hih lai panin keima guhte na pua ding uh hi," na ci khin hi.
Sukkoth panin amaute pai lai uh a, sehnel gam nawl, Etham-ah giahphual sat uh hi.
Amaute, sun hitaleh zan hitaleh khualzinin a pai theih nadingun sunin amaute lam a lak dingin meii khuam khat tawh, zanin amaute khuavak a pia dingin mei khuam khat tawh, amaute' mai-ah Topa a pai hi.
Sunin meii khuam le zanin mei khuamte, mite' mai-ah om tawntung hi.
"Israel mite kihei kikin Migdol le tuipi kikal, Pihahiroth mai, Baalzefon nisuahna lamah giahphual a sat ding gen in. Tuipi gei, tua galkhatah giahphual na sat ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Faro in Israel mite' thu tawh kisai genin, 'Sehnel gam sungah amaute tangciak uh hi. Sehnel gam in amaute khuhcip khin hi,' ci ding hi.
Keimah in Faro' lungsim khauhsakin, amah in Israel-te hong delh ding a, Faro le a mihonpite khempeuh ka zawhna hangin minthanna ka ngah ding hi. Kei, Topa ka hihna thu Egypt mite in thei ding uh hi," a ci hi. Amaute zong tua bangmahin gamta uh hi.
Mite tai khinzo hi, ci-in Egypt kumpipa kiangah a kigen ciangin, Faro le ama nasemte' ngaihsutna kikheel a, amaute in, "Eite' na hong sep nading panin Israel mite i paikhiatsak, hih banga i gamtat bang hi mawk ahi hiam?" ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in a leeng kithawisakin ama galkapte la-in,
a kitengkhia leeng zaguk le Egypt leeng khempeuh a ukte tawh kuan khawm hi.
Topa in Egypt kumpipa Faro' lungsim khauhsak a, Israel mite kithamuanna tawh a paikhiat lai takun a delh hi.
Egypt mite ahi, Faro' sakolte, leengte, ama sakol tung tuangte le a galkapte in amaute delh uh a, amaute giahphual satin tuipi gei-a a omna uh, Pihahiroth gei, Baalzefon nisuahna lam munah a pha uh hi.
Faro hong nai ciangin Israel mite khuadak to uh hi. En in, amaute' nungah Egypt mite hong kuan hi. Amaute lau mahmah uh hi. Topa' tungah Israel mite kiko uh hi.
Amaute in Moses kiangah, "Egypt-ah han a om loh manin sehnel gam sungah a si dingin kote hong paikhiatpih na hi hiam? Egypt panin paikhiatpihna tawh kote' tungah bang hong bawl na hi hiam?
'Kote hong hici omsak inla, Egypt mite' na hong semsak in,' ci-in Egypt-ah nang' tungah hong gen hi lo ka hi uh hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh sehnel gamah sih sangin Egypt mite' na sep ding kote a dingin hoihzaw ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Moses in mite tungah, "Lau kei un, kiptakin om un. Note-a' dingin tuni-a hong sep ding Topa' hotkhiatna mu un. Bang hang hiam cih leh tuni-a na muh uh Egypt mite, note in na mukik nawn kei ding uh hi.
Topa in note a dingin hong dosak ding a, note ahihleh na om hithiat ding uh hi bek hi," a ci hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah, "Bang hangin kei' tungah hong kiko na hi uh hiam? Israel mite mai nawtin a pai ding uh gen in.
Israel mite in lei keu tungtawnin tuipi a kantan theih nadingin na ciangkhut laamto inla, tuipi tungah na khut zanin tuipi khenkham in.
Amau' nungah Egypt mite hong pai-in, keimah in Faro le a mihonpite khempeuh, a leengte, le a sakol tung tuangte ka zawhna hangin minthanna ka ngah nadingin keimah in Egypt mite' lungsim ka khauhsak ding hi.
Faro le ama leengte le ama sakol tung tuangte ka zawhna hangin minthanna ka ngah khit ciangin Topa ka hihna thu Egypt mite in hong thei ding uh hi," a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Moses in tuipi tungah a khut zan hi. Topa in zan tawntung nisuahna huihpi hat tawh tuipi mutgawpin, tuipi pen lei keu-in bawl a, tuite a kikhen hi.
Israel mite, tuipi laizang lei keu tungah pai uh a, amau' taklam le veilamah kawm bangin tuite om hi.
Egypt mite ahi, Faro' sakol khempeuh, ama leengte, le ama sakol tung tuangte in delhin tuipi laizang amaute' nungah pai uh hi.
Zingsang ciangin Topa in mei le meii khuam sung panin Egypt mihonpite en sukin, Egypt mihonpite phialgawp a,
amau' leengpeite gumsak ahih manin man bekbakin hawl uh hi. Egypt mite in, "Israel mite' kiang panin tai ni. Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt mite hong langpangin Topa in amau a dingin hong do hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, "Egypt mite' tung, amau' leengte tung, le amau' sakol tung tuangte' tungah tui hong luankik theih nadingin tuipi tungah na khut zan in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses in tuipi tungah a khut zan a, a zingsang khuavak ciangin a luan ngei bangin tuipi hong luangkik hi. Tua tui sung panin Egypt mite taikhiat sawm uh a, ahi zongin Topa in tuipi laizangah Egypt mite zogawp hi.
Tui hong paikikin leengte le sakol tung tuangte le tuipi sungah amaute a delh Faro' mihonpite khempeuh tuum a, amaute khat zong suakta lo hi.
Ahih hangin tuipi kantanin lei keu tungah Israel mite pai uh a, amau' taklam le veilamah kawm bangin tuite a om hi.
Topa in tua bangin Egypt mite' khutsung panin tua ni-in Israel-te honkhia a, tuipi gei-ah Egypt mi a site, Israel mite in mu uh hi.
Israel mite in Egypt mite' tungah Topa' bawl nasepna lianpi mu uh a, mite in Topa a zahtak uh hi. Amaute in Topa le ama nasem Moses a um uh hi.
Tua ciangin Moses le Israel mite in Topa' tungah hih la sa uh a, " Topa phatna la ka sa ding hi. Amah in minthangin zo khin a, amah in sakol le a tuang pa tuipi sungah a lawn hi.
Topa , kei a hong hupa hi a, keimah hong honkhia pa ahi hi. Amah, keima Pasian hi a, amah ka phat ding hi. Ka pa' Pasian hi a, amah ka liansak ding hi.

" Topa aw, na taklam khut, thahatin minthang a, Topa aw, na taklam khut in galte a thehthang hi.
Na vangliatna tawh nangmah in na langte na lawnthal hi. Na hehna na khahkhia a, tua in amaute buhkung bangin a kangtum hi.

Nang in na huih tawh na mut a, tuipi in amaute tuum hi. A kihtakhuai tui sungah haknaw bangin amaute tum uh hi.
" Topa aw, pasian-te' lakah kua, nang tawh kibang ahi hiam? Kua, nang tawh kibangin, sianthona-ah lianin, minthang nasepna-ah kihtakhuai-in, nalamdang sem ahi hiam?
Na taklam khut na zan a, leitung in amaute nawmvalh hi.
Nangmah in na ciamsa zui-in na tatkhiatsa mite na paipih a, na hatna tawh a siangtho na omna-ah amaute lam na lak hi.
Midangte in hih thu za khin uh a, amaute ling uh hi. Filistia-ah a teng mite lau-in lingcip uh hi.

Launa le kihtakna amaute' tungah tung a, a thahat na vangliatna hangin amaute suangtum bangin taang loin om uh hi. Topa aw, nangma mite in a khen' mateng, na leisa mite in a khen' mateng amaute khikcip uh hi.
Nang in amaute hong paipihin nangma mual tungah amaute na suan ding hi. Topa aw, na om nading munin na bawlsa munah, Topa aw, na khutte in a phuhsa na biakinn-ah na koih ding hi.
Faro' sakolte ama leengte tawh, a sakol tung tuangte tuipi sungah a pai ciangin, Topa in tuipi tuite amaute tuumsakkik a, ahi zongin Israel mite tuipi laizang lei keu tungah a pai uh hi.

Topa' tungah amah kiko hi. Topa in singkung khat amah lak a, amah in tui sungah tua sing lawn a, tui lim hong suak pah hi. Topa in tua lai munah amaute a dingin thukham khat le ngeina kip khat bawl a, tua lai munah amah in amaute' tungah laktel a,
"Note in Topa na Pasian uh thu limtakin na ngaih uh a, ama mai-ah a man nate hihin, ama thupiakte don a, ama ngeina kipte khempeuh na zuih uhleh, Egypt mite' tungah ka tunsak natnate khat beek note' tungah kong tungsak kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh kei pen Topa , note hong damsak pa ka hi hi," a ci hi.

Nitak ciangin vamimte hong leengin giahphual hong tuam hi. Zingsang ciangin giahphual kiimah daitui kia hi.

Topa in Moses kiangah, "Keimah in mun khempeuh panin Amalek mite ka phiat siangtho nading thu phawk nadingin hih thu laibu sung khatah gelh inla, Joshua kiangah hih thu gen kik in," a ci hi.
Moses in biakna tau khat lamin a min dingin, " Topa , keima zawhna lim ahi hi," ci-in phuak a,
" Topa' dial sang tawi un! Topa in a khang khangin Amalek mite do ding hi," a ci hi.
Moses' sungpa, Midian siampi Jethro in Moses le ama mi Israel-te a dingin Pasian' sepna, Topa in Egypt panin Israel mite a paikhiatpihna thu khempeuh a za hi.
Tu-in Moses' sungpa Jethro in, Moses a sawl khit a kipanin Moses' zi Zipporah le ama tapa nihte kem a, a khat min Gershom ahi hi. (Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, "Gam dangah peemta ka hi hi," ci hi.)
Adang khat min Eliezer ahi hi. (Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, "Ka pa' Pasian pen keimah hong huhpa hi a, Faro' thah nading panin kei hong honkhia hi," ci hi.)
Pasian' mual tungah giahphual a satna sehnel gam Moses kiangah Jethro in Moses' tapate le a zi hong puak hi.
Mi khat in Moses kiangah, "En in, na zi le a tapa nihte tawh nang kiangah na sungpa Jethro hong pai hi," a cih ciangin
Moses zong a sungpa a dawn dingin paikhia a, zahtakna pia-in amah a nam hi. Amaute khatlekhat omzia kidong tuak uh a, puanbuk sungah a pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in a sungpa kiangah Topa in Israel mite' hangin Faro' tung le Egypt mite' tungah a bawlte khempeuh, lampi-ah amau' tungah a tung haksatna khempeuh le Topa in amaute a hotkhiatna thu a gen hi.
Egypt mite' khutsung panin amah in amaute a khahkhiatna, Israel mite tungah Topa in a hoih a bawlte khempeuh hangin Jethro lungdam hi.
Jethro in, "Egypt mite le Faro' khutsung panin note hong khahkhia Topa in thupha ngah tahen.
Topa pen pasian dang khempeuh sangin a liatzawkna tu-in ka thei hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mite tungah kiphatsakna tawh Egypt mite a gamtat lai takin amah in Egypt mite' khutnuai panin mite khahkhia hi," a ci hi.
Moses' sungpa Jethro in Pasian' tungah meihal biakna le biakpiakna a bawl hi. Pasian' mai-ah Moses' sungpa tawh an a ne khawm dingin Israel upate khempeuh le Aaron hong pai uh hi.
A zing ciangin mite' thu a khen dingin Moses tu a, zingsang a kipan nitak dongin Moses' kiimah mite a ding uh hi.
Mite a dingin ama hihte khempeuh Moses' sungpa in a muh ciangin amah in, "Mite a' dinga nang' sep hih pen a bangci ahi hiam? Bang hangin nang bek tu a, zingsang a kipan nitak dongin na kiimah mite khempeuh ding ahi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Moses in a sungpa kiangah, "Pasian' thu a kan dingin kei' kiangah mite hong pai uh hi.
Amaute in thu a neih uh ciangin kei kiangah hong pai uh a, mi khat le a vengpa' kikalah thu ka khen a, Pasian' ngeina kipte le ama thukhennate amaute ka theisak hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses' sungpa Jethro in ama kiangah, "Nangma hihzia hoih lo hi.
Nang le na kianga om mite in na zawngkhal lawh ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua nasep nang a dingin gik lua hi. Nang bek in na sem khinzo kei hi.
Tu-in ka thu hong ngai in; thu kong lak ding hi. Pasian in nang hong ompih tahen. Nang pen Pasian' mai-ah mite' tangin pai-in, amau' thute Pasian' kiangah na gen ding hi.
Nangmah in ngeina kipte le thukhennate amaute na hilh ding a, amau' lam pai nading le amau' sep dingte amaute na theisak ding hi.
Tua tham loin, mi khempeuh lak panin Pasian a zahtak mi, a muanhuai mi le sumgolh a mudah mi, mi siamte na teelkhia ding hi. Tua bang mite pen a tul, a za, a sawmnga, a sawmte tungah a uk dingin na koih ding hi.
Mite' thu amaute khensak tawntung in. Amaute in thu liante bek nang kiangah hong puak ding uh a, ahi zongin thu neute amau mah in khen tawm ding uh hi. Tua hileh nang a dingin baih zaw ding a, amaute in na vangik hong puakpih ding uh hi.
Hih bangin hih lecin Pasian in thahatna hong pia ding a, nangmah in na sem paisuakzo ding hi. Tua tham loin hih mite khempeuh zong amau' omna-ah lungnuam takin ciah thei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses in a sungpa' thu ngai-in ama gen khempeuh a hih hi.
Israel mi khempeuh sung panin Moses in mipil mi siamte teel a, mite a tul, a za, a sawmnga, a sawmte tungah a ukin mite' lutangin amaute a bawl hi.
Amaute in mite tungah a tawntungin thu khen uh hi. Amaute in thu haksate bek Moses tungah puak uh a, ahi zongin thuneute amaute in khen tawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in a sungpa ciahkhiasak a, Jethro zong ama gamah a ciahkik hi.
Egypt gam panin Israel mite a paikhiat zawh kha thumna a ni masa ni-in amaute Sinai sehnel gam tung uh hi.
Refidim panin amaute ding khia-in Sinai gam a tun uh ciangin, amaute in sehnel gam tua mual mai-ah giahphual a sat uh hi.
Pasian kiangah Moses paito hi. Topa in mual panin amah sam a, "Jakob' suanlekhak Israel mite tungah hih bangin na gen ding hi:
Egypt mite tungah ka bawlna le muvanlai in a kha tawh a note a puak bangin note hong pua-in keima kiangah kong paipihna na mu khin uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in note in ka thu mangin ka thuciamna na zuih uhleh mite khempeuh lak panin note pen keima mi na hi ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh leitung khempeuh keima a' hi a,
note pen keima siampi nasep a sem minam, le minam siangtho na hi ding uh hi. Israel mite tungah hih thute na gen ding ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses hong pai-in upate sam a, Topa in amah a thupiak hih thute khempeuh amaute' mai-ah a sung hi.
Mi khempeuh in, " Topa' gensa khempeuh ka hih ding uh hi," ci-in dawng khawm uh hi. Moses in mite' thugente Topa' tungah a gen hi.
Topa in Moses tungah, "En in, nang kong hopih ciangin mite in a zak theih nading le nang zong hong up theih nadingun meii sahpi sungah nang kiangah kong pai ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Moses in mite' thugente Topa' tungah a gen hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah, "Mite kiangah pai inla, tuni le zingciang sungteng amaute siangthosakin, amau' puante amau mah sawpsakin,
a ni thum ni-in a baihsa-in om un. Bang hang hiam cih leh a ni thum ni-in Sinai Mual tungah mite khempeuh' muhna-ah Topa hong paisuk ding hi.
Nangmah in mite a dingin dalna khat a kimkotah na koih ding a, 'Mualtungah pai loin, a gamgi na lawnkhak loh nadingun kidawm un; mual a lawng peuhpeuh kithat ding hi.
Khut peuhmah in tua mi kithat ding pa lawngkha lo ding a, suang tawh kidenglum ahih kei leh kikaplum ding hi. Ganhing hitaleh mihing hitaleh kihing khawi lo ding hi,' na ci ding hi. Peengkul sauveipi hong kitum ciangin amaute mualtungah hong paito ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mualtung panin mite kiangah Moses paisuk a, mite siangthosak hi. Amaute in a puante uh sawp uh hi.
Amah in mite kiangah, "Ni thum ni ciangin a baihsa-in om un; numei tawh lumkhawm kei un," a ci hi.
A ni thum ni zingsang ciangin van gingin khua phia a, mualtungah meii sahpi kai a, nakpitakin a ging peengkul kitum ahih manin giahphual a om mi khempeuh ling uh hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in giahphual panin Pasian a dawn dingin mite paikhiatpih a, amaute a om nading mual bulah om uh hi.
Meikhu in Sinai Mual tuamcip hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mei sung tua mualtungah Topa a kumsuk hi. A khu, meiphualpi khu bangin kahto a, a mual buppi nakpitakin kiling hi.
Sinai Mual dawnah Topa hong paisuk hi. Topa in tua mual dawnah Moses sam a, Moses zong paito hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah, "Amaute in Topa a en dingin hong kantanin amaute tampi tak si kha ding uh ahih manin paisuk inla, mite hilhkhol in.
Amaute' tungah Topa hehlua kha ding ahih manin, Topa' kiangah hong pai siampite zong amau mah kisiangthosak tawm hen," a ci hi.
Moses in Topa' tungah, "Sinai Mual dongah mite hong pai thei lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmahmah in kote nong thuhilh a, 'Mual kimkotah dalnate bawl inla, siangthosak in,' nong ci hi," a ci hi.
Topa in ama kiangah, "Paisuk inla, Aaron hong paipihto in. Ahih hangin amaute' tungah amah hehlua kha ding ahih manin Topa kiang dongah a pai dingin siampite le mite paisuaksak kei in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mite kiangah Moses paisukin amaute kiangah a gen hi.
"Kei pen salsuahna Egypt gam panin note a hong paikhiatpih Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi.
"Keimah longal pasian dang na bia kei ding uh hi.
"A kiseek milim hitaleh, tunga vantung hitaleh, nuai-a leisung hitaleh, leinuai-a om tui sungah hitaleh a om na khat peuhpeuh a sun khat peuhpeuh note a dingin na bawl kei ding uh hi.
Tuate' mai-ah na kun kei ding uh a, tuate na bia kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah note' Topa Pasian, a aam Pasian ka hi a, kei hong mudahte' tungah pate' mawhna tate' tungah khang thum khang lina dongin thuk-in,
ahih hangin kei hong itin ka thupiakte a zui mi a tul tampite tungah itna kip a lak pa ka hi hi.
" Topa note' Pasian' min a sia lamin na zang kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in ama min a zang khialte gim pia ding hi.
"Sabbath ni a siangtho-a zat ding phawk un.
Ni guk sung nomau' na semin na nasep ding khempeuh uh na hih ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin a ni sagih ni pen Topa note' Pasian' Sabbath ni ahi hi. Tua ni-in note, na tapate, na tanute, na nasempate, na nasemnute, na ganhing uh ahi a, peemtate in ahi zongin na bangmah na sem kei ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a ni guk sung tengin Topa in van le lei, tuipi le tuate sunga om khempeuh bawl a, a ni sagih ni tawlnga hi. Tua ahih ciangin Topa in Sabbath ni thupha pia-in siangthosak hi.
" Topa na Pasian un note hong piak leitang tungah na khan uh a sau theih nadingin na nu le na pa uh zahtak un.
"Mi na that kei ding uh hi.
"Nulepa mawhna na bawl kei ding uh hi.
"Na na gu kei ding uh hi.
"Na vengte uh langkhatah a man loin teci na pang kei ding uh hi.
"Na vengte uh inn na deihgawh kei ding uh hi. Na vengte uh zi hitaleh, ama nasempa hitaleh, ama nasemnu hitaleh, ama bawngtal hitaleh, ama la hitaleh, na vengte a' ahi na khat peuhpeuh na deihgawh kei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tu-in mite khempeuh in vangingte, peengkul aw, le mual meikhu thu a theihtel uh ciangin, lau-in a ling uh hi. Amaute a gamla-ah ding uh a,
Moses kiangah, "Nangmah in kote kiangah thu hong gen in; kote in ka ngai ding uh hi. Ahi zongin kote si kha ding ka hih uh ciangin ko tungah Pasian hong gensak kei in," a ci uh hi.
Moses in mite kiangah, "Lau kei un; bang hang hiam cih leh note khialkha loin amah na kihtak theih nadingun note' tungah a laktel dingin Pasian hong pai ahi hi," a ci hi.
Pasian' omna meii sah nai-ah Moses a pai laitakin mite a gamla-ah a ding uh hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah, "Nangmah in Israel mite tungah hih bangin na gen ding hi: 'Vantung panin note kong hopihna note mahmah in na thei khin uh hi.
Note in kei tawh nong biakkhop dingun ngun pasian-te le kham pasian-te na bawl kei ding uh hi.
Note in keima a dingin lei tawh biakna tau khat bawl unla, tua tungah na meihal biaknate uh le thunuama na biaknate uh, na tuute uh le na bawngtalte uh pia un. Keima min a kiphawk nading munin ka bawlna peuhmahah note kiangah keimah hong pai-in note thupha kong pia ding hi.
Note in keima a dingin suang tawh biakna tau na bawl uhleh, a kiseek suang tawh na bawl kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh na nazatte uh tawh na va suk uhleh a ninsak na hi uh hi.
Tua tungah na seelsim uh a kidawk khak loh nadingin ka biakna tau tung kahtoh nading kahlei a kulin na sang bawl kei ding uh hi,' ci in.
"Tu-in hihte pen amaute' tungah na piak ding biakna ngeina kipte ahi hi.
Hebru mi sila khat na lei uh ciangin, amah in kum guk sung na hong sepsak ding a, a kum sagihna ciangin bangmah hong pia loin a suakta-in paikhia ding hi.
Amah guakin hong pai ahihleh amah guak mahin paikhia ding a, zi neisa-in hong pai ahihleh amah tawh a zi zong paikhia ding hi.
A topa in amah zi guan a, tua nu in amah tawh tapate ahi a, tanute ahi zongin a neih leh, a zi le a tate pen a topa a' hi ding a, amah guakin paikhia ding hi.
Ahih hangin sila in a kitel takin genin, 'Ka topa, ka zi, le ka tate ka it hi; a suakta-in ka paikhia kei ding hi,' a cih leh,
tua ciangin a topa in thukhente kiangah amah paipih ding hi. Amah in kongkhakah ahi a, kongkhak khuam-ah ahi zongin amah paipih ding hi. A topa in phimpi khat tawh ama bil vuhsak ding a, amah in a nuntak tawntung ama na sepsak ding hi.
"Mi khat in a tanu sila-in a zuak ciangin, tua nu pen sila pasalte bangin paikhia lo ding hi.
A topa in ama zi dingin a sehsa tua numei in amah a lungkimsak kei leh, amah in tua nu a pa kiang mahah zuakkik ding hi. Amah, tua nu tungah citakin gamta lo ahih manin, gamdang mi khat tungah tua nu a zuak theih nading thu nei lo ding hi.
Mi khat in a tapa a dingin sila numei a lei leh, amah in tanu bangin tua nu bawl ding hi.
Amah in zi dang khat a lakthuah leh, a zi masa' annek, a puansilh, ahih kei leh lupkhop nading thuneihna khiam lo ding hi.
Amah in hih thu thumte tuanu a dingin a bawl kei leh, sum hong piak kul lo, bangmah a kul loin tua nu paikhia thei ding hi.
"Mi khat satin a sisak mi peuhpeuh kithat ding hi.
Ahih hangin amah in a thah sawm hi lo a, a thah khak ahihleh, amah a tai theih nadingin note a' ding mun khat ka seh ding hi.
Ahih hangin mi khat in midang khat thah ding tumin a thah leh, amah na thah theih nadingun note in ka biakna tau a belhna nangawn panin amah na la teitei ding uh hi.
"Ama pa hitaleh ama nu hitaleh a sat peuhmah kithat ding hi.
"Zuak ding ahi a, sila-in neih ding ahi zongin mi a gu mi peuhmah kithat ding hi.
"Ama pa hitaleh ama nu hitaleh a samsia mi peuhmah kithat ding hi.
"Mite kitawng a, a khat in adang khat suangtum khat tawh ahi a, ama khuttum tawh ahi zongin tumin, mipa a sih loh hangin lupna ngakin,
tua ciangin mipa thozo-in ama ciangkhut tawh a vakkhiatkik zawh nakleh, amah a tum pa siang ding hi. Amah in ama hun bei sungteng tang ding bek ama tungah loh ding a, amah damsiangsak ding hi.
"Mi khat in molhtum khat tawh ama sila ahi pasal hitaleh numei hitaleh satin a phualah a sih pah leh, amah gim kipia ding hi.
Ahih hangin ni khat ahi a, ni nih ahi zongin sila a nuntak leh, amah gim piak ding hi lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh sila pen ama neihsa ahih manin sila a sih ciangin amah a sumh khin ahi hi.
"Mite kitawngin numei naupaii khat liamsak a, tatolhin; ahi zongin siatna in a zuihbeh kei nakleh, tua nu' pasal in ama tunga a cihzah tawh kituakin tua numei a liamsak mi kigam ding a, thukhente' khenna bangin amah liau ding hi.
Siatna khatpeuh in a zuihbeh leh, tua ciangin nuntakna tang ding nuntakna,
meikang tang ding meikang, liamna tang ding liamna, siatna tang ding siatna pia ding hi.
Amah in a sila ahi pasal hitaleh numei hitaleh a ha a tupkhiat leh, amah in tua ha' hangin sila suaktasakin paikhiasak ding hi.
"Bawngtal khat in pasal hitaleh numei hitaleh a ki tawh a piklup ciangin, a bawngtal kidenglum ding a, a sa kine lo ding hi. Ahih hangin bawngtal nei pa siang ding hi.
Ahih hangin a hun beisa-ah bawngtal in mi si thei a, a nei pa kihilh napi-in a khumcip kei a, tua bawngtal in pasal ahi a, numei ahi zongin a thah leh, bawngtal kidenglum ding a, a nei pa zong kithat ding hi.
Ama tung pan tatkhiatna sum a kinget leh, ama nuntakna tatkhiat nadingin ama tungah a kingen zahzah amah in pia ding hi.
Tua bawngtal in mi' tapa ahi a, tanu ahi zongin a ki tawh a pik leh hih ngeina tawh kizui-in kigamta ding hi.
Bawngtal in sila ahi pasal hitaleh numei hitaleh khat peuhpeuh a ki tawh a pik leh, a nei pa in amau' topa' tungah ngun shekel sawmthum pia ding a, bawngtal kidenglum ding hi.
"Mi khat in dum honsa-in a nusia ahi a, mi khat in dum a tawh ciangin siin loin om ahi zongin, bawngtal hitaleh la hitaleh dum sungah a kiat leh,
dum nei pa in loh ding hi. Amah in a nei pa tungah sum pia ding a, ganhing luang pen ama a' hi pah ding hi.
"Mi khat' bawngtal in adang khat' bawngtal liamsakin a sih leh, amaute in a hing pen zuak ding uh a, tua man hawm ding uh hi. A ganhing si pen zong amaute in hawm ding uh hi.
Tua bang hi lo a, bawngtal in mi si ngei hi, ci-in kithei napi a nei pa in a khumcip kei leh, amah in bawngtal tang ding bawngtal pia ding a, a si ganhing pen amah in tang ding hi.
"Mi khat in bawngtal ahi a, tuu ahi zongin gu a, a that a, a zuak zongin, amah in bawngtal khat tang dingin bawngtal nga, tuu khat tang dingin tuu li pia ding hi. Amah in ditkikna bawl ding hi. Amah in bangmah a neih kei leh, ama guktakna hangin amah kizuak ding hi. A kigu ganhing, bawngtal ahi a, la ahi a, tuu ahi zongin a hingin ama khut sungah a kimuh leh, amah in a zah nih pia ding hi. "Guta khat in inn vutlet a, kisatin amah a sih leh, tua sihna hangin mawhna om lo ding hi. Ahih hangin nisuah khit ahihleh tua sihna hangin mawhna om ding hi.
"Mi khat in lo khatah ahi a, leenggui lo-ah ahi zongin gan tasak a, a ganhing khahin midang khat' lo-ah a tat leh, amah in ama lo le ama leenggah lo panin a piangte tawh loh ding hi.
"Mei kuangin gam kang a, a kikhol an ahi a, a ding lai an ahi a, lo ahi zongin a kat leh, mei a kangsak pa in a cing takin loh ding hi.
"Mi khat in a vengte kiangah sum ahi a, van ahi zongin kep ding ap a, tua mipa' inn panin a kiguk leh, a gu pa a kimuh leh amah in a zah nih pia ding hi.
A gu pa a kimuh kei leh a vengpa' vante amah in gu hiam, gu lo hiam cih a kitel nadingin thukhente kiangah inn nei pa in kiciamna bawl ding hi.
"Thu neihna khat peuhpeuh, bawngtal ahi a, la ahi a, tuu ahi a, puansilh ahi zongin, a mang na khat peuhpeuh, mi khat in, 'Hih pen kei a' hi,' a cihna thu-ah, alang nihte' thu pen thukhente' mai-ah tung ding hi. Thukhente in a mawhsak mipa in a vengpa tungah a zah nih pia ding hi.
"Mi khat in ama vengte tungah la ahi a, bawngtal ahi a, tuu ahi zongin, ganhing khat peuhpeuh kep dingin a piak a, kuama muh lohin tua ganhing a si a, a liam a, a kihawlkhia ahi zongin ahihleh,
amah in a veng pa' neihsa a gu kha hiam cih a kitheih nadingin amau tegel' kikalah Topa tawh kiciamna om ding hi. A nei pa in tua kiciamna sang ding a, amah in loh lo ding hi.
Ahih hangin ama tung panin a kigu ahihleh, a nei pa tungah amah in loh ding hi.
Gamsa in a balzan ahihleh, lahtel nadingin tua ganhing paipihsak in. A kibalzan ganhing amah in loh lo ding hi.
"Mi khat in a vengte' gan khat peuhpeuh kawm a, a nei pa om loin a liam a, a si zongin, amah in a kicingin loh ding hi.
A nei pa tawh a omkhawm ahihleh amah in loh lo ding hi. A kikawm ahihleh a kikawm bangin pai ding hi.
"Mi khat in a kidong nai lo nungak khat zolin amah tawh a lupkhop leh, amah in tua nu' man ding moman letsong pia ding a, ama zi suak ding hi.
A numei' pa in ama tungah tua nu a piak nop kei leh zong, tua mipa in nungak moman letsong zah numei' pa' tungah sum pia veve ding hi.
"Numei aisan nu na hingkhawi kei ding uh hi.
" Topa bek simloh pasian dang khat peuhpeuh tungah biakna a pia mi peuhmah kithat ding hi.
"Khualmi khatpeuh na bawlsia kei ding uh a, na nengniam kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note zong Egypt leitangah khual mite na hi ngei uh hi.
Note in amaute na gimsak uh a, amaute keima tungah hong kiko leh, keimah in amau' kikona ka za taktak ding hi.
Ka hehna so-in namsau tawh note kong that ding a, na zite uh meigong suakin, na tate uh tagah suak ding hi.
"Note tawh a om, a zawng keima mite khat peuhpeuh tungah sum leitawi na piak uhleh, ama tungah sum leitawi a piapa bangin na om kei ding uh a, ama tung panin a meet na dok kei ding uh hi.
Khapna ahi na vengpa' puan silh lai na lak ngei khak leh nitum ma-in ama tungah na pia kik ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ama silh ding tua bek hi a, tua pen ama pumpi a dingin a puan neihsun ahi hi. Amah bang dang tawh lum ding ahi hiam? Amah kei tungah hong kiko leh ke'n ka za ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in hehpihna ka nei hi.
"Thukhente na simmawh kei ding uh a, na mite uh a ukpa zong na samsia kei ding uh hi.
"Na anlakna pan uh le sathau le leenggah na suknate uh panin a leetkhiate piak khiat ding na zekai kei ding uh hi. "Na tapa cilte uh keima tungah nong pia ding uh hi.
Na bawngtalte uh le na tuute uh panin zong tua bangmahin nong pia ding uh hi. Ni sagih sung a pi tawh om ding a, a ni giat ni-in kei tungah nong pia ding uh hi.
"Note pen kei' tungah hong ki-ap mite na hi ding uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin gamlakah gamsate in a balzan sa peuhmah note in na ne kei ding uh a, tua bang sate uite na lot ding uh hi.
"Thuman lo na genkhia kei ding uh hi. Elna tawh teci pang dingin migilo pa tawh na kipawl kei ding uh hi.
Siatna a bawl dingin mihon na zui kei ding uh hi. Thutang a hei khia dingin mihonpi nung zui-in thu neihna-ah teci na pang kei ding uh hi.
Ama thu neihna-ah mizawng pa na langneih kei ding uh hi.
"Na langneih mite' bawngtal ahi a, a la ahi zongin a gammang na tuah uhleh ama kiangah na hawlkik ding uh hi.
Nangmah a hong mudah pa' la a van tawh a puk na muh leh a la tawh amah na nusia kei ding a, tua la phot toh ding na huh ding hi.
"Ama thu neihna-ah mizawng pa a thutang kimlai na lelsak kei ding uh hi.
A man lopi a mi mawhsak ding panin kikem unla, a dikpa le thuman pa that kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh a gilo mi ka khah kei ding hi.
"Khualmi na nengniam kei ding uh hi. Khualmi' lungsim na thei uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note zong Egypt gamah khualmi na hi ngei uh hi.
"Note in na leitang uhah kum guk sung khai tuhin a piangte na kaikhawm ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin a kum sagihna ciangin, nomau' mi a zawngte in a nek theih nadingin leitang tawlngasakin, lokhulin na omsak ding uh a, gamlak ganhingte in mizawngte' nek loh teng ne thei ding uh hi. Na leenggui lote uh le na oliv lote uh zong tua bangmahin na hih ding uh hi.
"Ni guk sung na nasep uh na sem ding uh hi. Ahih hangin na bawngtal le na la in tawlngakna a neih theih nading le, na nasem numei' tapa le khual mite in thathak a ngah theih nadingin a ni sagih ni-in na tawlnga ding uh hi.
Note' tunga kong gente khempeuh thudon un; pasian dangte' min genin nei kei unla, na kam sung panun zong tua bangte kizasak kei un.
"Kum khatin thumvei, keima a dingin pawi na bawl ding uh hi.
Silngo sawh loh anlum pawi na bawl ding uh hi. Keimah in note kong thupiak bangin Abib kha sung a kisehsa hun ciangin ni sagih sung silngo sawh loh anlum na ne ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua kha sungin Egypt panin note na paikhia uh hi. Khut hawmguak tawh keima mai-ah kuamah hong kilak lo ding hi.
"Note in lo-a na tuh uh, na nasepna uh a gah masa, anlak pawi na bawl ding uh hi. Note in lo panin na nasepna uh a gah na kaihkhop uh kum bei ciangin an kaihkhopna pawi na bawl ding uh hi.
Topa Pasian ' mai-ah pasal khempeuh kum khatin thumvei kilaak ding uh hi.
"Note in silngo sawh anlum tawh keimah biakpiakna si na pia khawm kei ding uh a, a ganhing thau zong zingsang dong na omsak kei ding uh hi.
"Note in na anpalte uh lakah a tung masa pen Topa na Pasian uh inn-ah na paipih ding uh hi. "Note in a pi' nawizu tawh keelno na huan kei ding uh hi.
"En un, keimah in ka bawlsa munah note hong paipih ding le lamkalah note hong cing dingin note' mai-ah vantungmi khat ka sawl hi.
Amah thudonin ama aw ngai unla, amah lehdo kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in note' thu palsatna hong maisak lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh keima min tawh nasem ahi hi.
"Ahih hangin note in ama aw limtakin ngai-in keima gen bangin na gamtat uhleh na galte uh' tungah gal ka hi ding a, na langte uh' tungah lang ka hi ding hi.
"Note' mai-ah ka vantungmi pai-in Amor mite, Hit mite, Perez mite, Kanaan mite, Hiv mite, le Jebus mite kiangah note hong paipihin, keimah in amaute ka phiat khiat ciangin,
amau' pasian-te' mai-ah note kun loin, tuate bia loin, amau' gamtat bangin na gamta kei ding uh a, note in amaute lawnthal mang kiuhkeuhin amau' milim suang khuampite na satnen gawp ding uh hi.
Note in Topa na Pasian uh nong bia ding uh a, keimah in na an uh le na tui uh thupha ka pia ding hi. Keimah in note' lak panin cinatna ka la khia ding hi.
Note' leitangah kuamah nausia om lo ding a, a ciing zong om lo ding hi. Note kong teeksihsak ding hi.
"Keimah hong kikihtakna note' mai-ah paisakin note' phutkhak ding mi khempeuh ka kitokgawpsak ding a, na galte khempeuh uh lehhei-in note' kiang panin ka taisak ding hi.
Note' mai panin Hiv mite, Kanaan mite, le Hit mite a hawlkhia dingin note' mai-ah tunpi ka sawlkhia ding hi.
Leitung gamkhing suakin gamlak ganhingte note' langkhatah tampi pha kha ding ahih manin note' mai panin kum khat sungin amaute ka hawlkhia kei ding hi.
Keimah in San Tuipi panin Filistia mite' tuipi ciang le sehnel gam panin Eufratis gun ciang dongah na gamgite uh ka phut ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua gam a teng mite note' khut sungah kong pia ding a, note in na mai uh panin amaute na hawlkhia ding uh hi.
Amaute ahi a, amau' pasian-te tawh ahi zongin thuciamna na bawl kei ding uh hi.
Amaute in kei' tungah note hong khialsak kha ding ahih ciangin note' leitang tungah amaute teng lo ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note in amau' pasian-te na biak uhleh note' tungah thangzak khat hong hi taktak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, "Nang le Aaron, Nadab, Abihu le Israel upate sung pan sawmsagih tawh keima kiangah hong paito unla, a gamla panin kunin hong bia un.
Topa' nai-ah Moses bek hong pai ding hi. A dangte a nai-ah hong pai lo ding a, mihonte in mual ciang dong hong neh lo ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Moses hong pai-in Topa' thugente khempeuh le biakna ngeinate khempeuh mite kiangah a gen hi. Mi khempeuh in aw kikhatin dawng uh a, " Topa' gensa thute khempeuh ka hih ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Moses in Topa' thugente khempeuh a gelh hi. Zingsangin amah tho baih a, mual bulah biakna tau khat lamin, Israel minam sawm le nihte tawh kituakin khuam sawm le nih a phut hi.
Amah in Israel mi tangvalte sawlin, tuate in meihal biakna le thunuama biakna bawngtalte Topa' tungah pia uh hi.
Moses in a sisan kimkhat la-in, kuangte sungah koih a, sisan kimkhat biakna tau tungah a theh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in thuciamna laibu la-in, mite' zakin tua laibu a sim hi. Amaute in, " Topa' gensa khempeuh kote in ka hih ding uh a, kote ka thumang ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in sisan la-in mite' tungah theh a, "Hih thute khempeuh tawh kizui-in Topa in note tawh a bawlsa thuciamna sisan en un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses le Aaron, Nadab, Abihu le Israel upate sung pan sawmsagih paito uh a,
amaute in Israel Pasian mu uh hi. Ama khe nuai-ah a sianthona van mel tawh a kibang, sapfaia suangmanpha tawh a kibawl suangphahpek bangpian om hi.
Amah in Israel mi makaite gimna ngahsak lo hi. Amaute in Pasian mu uh a, tua ciangin an ne-in tui dawn uh hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah, "Keima kiang mualtungah hong paito inla, tua lai-ah ngak in. Amaute a kihilh nadingin keima gelhsa, thukham le thupiakna tawh, suangpek nang tungah kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ama nasempa Joshua tawh Moses kithawi uh a, Pasian' mual tungah paito uh hi.
Amah in upate kiangah, "Note' kiangah kong paikik matengun hih lai-ah kote hong ngak un. En un, note tawh Aaron le Hur om hi. Thu nei peuhpeuh amaute' kiangah paisak un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mualtungah Moses paito a, meii in mual a tuam hi.
Topa' minthanna vang pen Sinai Mual tungah kinga a, meii in ni guk sung tua mual a tuam hi. A ni sagih ni-in amah in meii lak panin Moses a sam hi.
Tu-in Topa' vangliatna vang pen Israel mite' muhna-ah mualvum dawn a kangtum meikuang tawh kibang hi.
Meii sungah Moses tum a, mualtungah paito hi. Moses sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung mualtungah a om hi.
"Amaute in kei a dingin biakna hong paipih nadingin Israel mite' kiangah gen in. A pia nuam mi peuhmah tung panin kei a dingin biakna na sang ding hi.
Amaute' tung panin na san ding biakna hih bang ahi hi: Kham, ngun, sumngo,
a dum, a dupsan, a ausan puante le a kopin a kikhuk khau tawh a kigan puan hoih, keelmul,
a kisansak tuutal vunte, keelvunte, singkha sing,
meivakte a' ding sathau, nilh sathau ding le paknamtui dingin a namtui nate,
siampipuan le awmdal a bulh dingin onik suangte ahi hi.
Amaute' lakah kei ka om theih nadingin kei a dingin biakbuk khat amaute bawlsak in.
Biakbuk le a nazatte' lim ding tawh kisai-in nang' tungah kong lahte khempeuh tawh kituakin nangmah in na bawl ding hi.
"Amaute in singkha sing tawh singkuang khat bawl ding uh hi. A dung pi thum le letmat kua, a vai pi nih le letmat thum, a sanna pi nih le letmat thum hi ding hi.
Nangmah in kham citak tawh tua singkuang na zut ding a, a sung le a pua na zut ding hi. A tung kimkotah a geihual kham tawh na bawl ding hi.
Nangmah in tua singkuang a dingin kham kual li sungin a singkuang khe li tungah tuate na bulh ding a, a pang khatah kual nih, a pang langkhatah a kual nih mah na bulh ding hi.
Nangmah in singkha singzawl na sui ding a, tuate kham tawh na zut ding hi.
Singkuang puak nadingin singkuang panga kualte sungah a zawlte na khum ding hi.
Singkuang' kualte sungah a zawlte omsuak ding a, tuate kilakhia lo ding hi.
Nang' tunga kong piak ding thuciamna nangmah in singkuang sungah na koih ding hi.
"Tua ciangin kham citak tawh hehpihna tokhom khat na bawl ding a, a dung pi thum le letmat kua, a vai pi nih le letmat thum hi ding hi.
Nangmah in kham tawh kherub nih na bawl ding a, hehpihna tokhom mong tuakah a kiseek tua kherub-te na omsak ding hi.
Mong khatah kherub khat, a mong langkhatah kherub khat mah bawl in. Hehpihna tokhom tawh a kizomin a mong tuakah kherub na bawl ding hi.
Kherub-te in a khate uh a tungah zal ding uh a, amau' khate tawh hehpihna tokhom liimsunin amaute khatlekhat kimaingat ding uh hi. Hehpihna tokhom lamah kherub-te' mai nga ding uh hi.
Singkuang tungah hehpihna tokhom na koih ding a, singkuang sungah nang kong piak ding thuciamna na koih ding hi.
Hehpihna tokhom tung, thuciamna singkuang tunga om kherub nihte kikal panin nang kong hopih ding a, Israel mite a dingin nang' tungah kong piak ding thute khempeuh nang' tungah kong gen ding hi.
"Nangmah in singkha sing tawh sabuai khat na bawl ding a, a dung pi thum, a vai pi khat le alang, a sanna pi nih le letmat thum hi ding hi.
Kham citak tawh na zut ding a, a kimkotah a geihual kham tawh na bawl ding hi.
Nangmah in khutpeek cia a zai zawl peek khat a kimkotah na bawl ding a, tua zawl peek kimkotah a geihual na bawl ding hi.
Nangmah in tua sabuai a dingin kham kual li na bawl ding a, tuate pen a kiu li, a khe lite-ah na gak ding hi.
Sabuai puak nading zawlte a len dingin a zawl peek gei-ah a kualte om ding hi.
Paknamtui a dingin a kuangdaite le a pakante, tui phih nadingin a thawl gongbakte, le a kuang-ukte na bawl ding hi. Kham citak tawh tuate na bawl ding hi.
Keima mai sabuai tungah Ompihna Anlum na koih tawntung ding hi.
"Kham citak tawh meivakkhuam khat na bawl ding hi. Meivakkhuam bul leh a kungte pen a kiseek nate tawh kibawl ding hi. A haite, a nunte le a paakte, tua tawh sakhat hi khawm ding uh hi.
A pang panin hiang guk meengkhia ding a, a pang khatah meivakkhuam hiang thum meengkhia-in, a pang langkhatah meivakkhuam hiang thum mah meengkhia ding hi.
Hiang khat ciat tungah a nun le a pak a om, almond gah tawh a kibang hai thum le adang hiang khat ciat tungah a nun le a pak a om, almond gah tawh a kibang hai thum mah kibawl ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin hiang gukte meivakkhuam panin meengkhia ding hi.
A meivakkhuam tung mahmahah a nunte le a paakte tawh a om, almond bangin a kibawl hai li omin,
meivakkhuam panin hiang guk a kopte' bulah tua tawh sakhat ahi nun khat om ding hi.
Amau' nunte le a hiangte, sakhat hi ding a, a vekpi-in kham citak a kiseek sakhat hi ding hi.
Nangmah in ama a dingin meivak sagihte na bawl ding a, ama omna mai teng khua a vaksak dingin meivakte kikoih ding hi.
A taitehte le a kuangte kham citak hi ding hi.
Kham citak tawi sawmnih le tawi khat val a gik tawh hih nazatte khempeuh kibawl ding hi.
Mualtungah nang' tunga hong kilak hih nate pen amau' lim ding bangin na bawl ding thei in.
"Tua tham loin a kopin a kikhuk khau hoih tawh a kigan dalna puan sawm le a dum, a dupsan, le a ausan khau a kigan puan tawh biakbuk na bawl ding hi. Hoihtakin a kibawl kherub-te tawh tuate na bawl ding hi.
Dalna puan a dung pi sawmli le pi nih hi ding a, dalna puan a vai pi guk hi ding hi. Dalna puan khempeuh kikim ciat ding hi.
Dalna puan ngate khatlekhat kikhuituah ding hi.
A kikhuituah a masa dalna puan a nawlnung pen' nawl dung sukah khaudum tawh a bilvangte na bawl ding hi. Tua bangmahin a kikhuituah a nihna dalna puan a nawlnung pen' nawl dung suk mahah a bilvangte na bawl ding hi.
Dalna puan khat tungah bilvang sawmnga bawlin, a kikhuituah a nihna dalna puan nawlah bilvang sawmnga mah na bawl ding a, a bilvangte khatlekhat kitang ding uh hi.
Biakbuk pen bup khat a suah theih nadingin nangmah in kham kilhna sawmnga bawlin, tua kilhnate tawh dalna puan khatlekhat na kimatsak ding hi.
"Biakbuk a tung khuh nadingin keelmul tawh puante zong na bawl ding a, puan sawm le khat na bawl ding hi.
Tua puan a dung pi sawmli le nga, a vai pi guk ciat hi ding a, puan sawm le khatte kikim ding hi.
Tua puan ngate amau le amau khuituahin, puan gukte zong amau le amau mah na khuituah ding a, a gukna puan pen puanbuk mai-ah na khep ding hi.
A kikhuituah puan khat nawlah a bilvang sawmnga bawlin, a kikhuituah a nihna puan nawlnung pen nawlah a bilvang sawmnga mah na bawl ding hi.
Tua pen bup khat a suah theih nadingin nangmah in sumngo kilhna sawmnga bawlin, a bilvangte' sungah tua kilhnate guangin, puanbuk na kimatsak ding hi.
Puanbuk puan a val khia, puan alang a val pen, biakbuk nungah kaisuk ding hi.
Puanbuk puan a dunglam, pangkhatah pi khat le alang, a pang langkhatah pi khat le alang a val pen biakbuk a khuh dingin hih lampang le hua lampangte-ah kaisuk ding hi.
"A kisansak tuutal vunte le keelvunte tawh puanbuk khuhna khat na bawl ding hi.
"Biakbuk a dingin a po to ding khuampeekte singkha sing na bawl ding hi.
A khuampeek khat a tun pi sawm le nga hi ding a, a vai pi nih le letmat thum vive hi ding hi.
A bulh nadingin a khuampeek khatah a zang nih ciat om ding hi. Biakbuk khuampeek khempeuh tua bangin na bawl ding hi.
Biakbuk khuampeekte na bawl ding hi: Leitaw lam panga dingin khuampeek sawmnih hi ding hi.
A khuampeek sawmnihte' bulah bullen sawmli ngun tawh na bawl ding a, a zang nihte a dingin khuampeek khat bulah bullen nih, a khuampeek dang khat bulah adang nihte a dingin bullen nih mah hi ding hi.
Biakbuk a pang nihna lam, leilu lam panga a khuampeek sawmnihte le
ngun tawh kibawl a bullen sawmlite a dingin, khuampeek khatah bullen nih, adang khuampeek khat bulah bullen nih mah hi ding hi.
Nitumna lam, biakbuk nung lama dingin khuampeek guk na bawl ding hi.
Biakbuk nunglam kiute a dingin khuampeek nih na bawl ding hi.
Tuate a bul lamah kikak ding a, ahih hangin a kual masa ah a dawn kimat ding hi. A nihin tua bang hi ding a, tuate in a kiu nihte piangsak ding uh hi.
Ngun tawh kibawl amau' bullen sawm le gukte a' ding a khuampeek giat pha ding a, khuampeek khatah bullen nih ciat om ding hi.
"Singkha sing, zawlin na bawl ding hi.
Biakbuk pangkhat a khuampeek a' ding zawl nga, biakbuk a pang langkhat a khuampeek a dingin zawl nga, nitumna lam biakbuk nung lam panga a khuampeekte a dingin zawl nga hi ding hi.
A zawl laita, a khuampeek kimciang a banto pen mong khat pan mong khat paisuak ding hi.
A khuampeekte kham tawh zutin, a zawlte a len dingin amau' kualte kham tawh na bawl ding a, a zawlte kham tawh na zut ding hi.
A lim ding geelna, mualtungah nang tungah hong kilak mah tawh kizui-in biakbuk na lam ding hi.
"A dum, a dupsan, a ausan, a kopin a kikhuk khau hoih kigan tawh dalna puan khat na bawl ding a, hoihtakin a kibawl kherub-te tawh kizem ding hi.
Ngun tawh kibawl bullen lite tungah a om, kham kibawl vankhaina nei-in, kham tawh a kizut singkha khuampi lite tungah na khai ding hi.
A kilhnate-ah dalna puan khai sukin, dalna puan sung tua lai munah thuciamna singkuang na koih ding a, dalna puan in siangtho pen mun panin siangtho mun khen ding hi.
Siangtho pen mun sunga om thuciamna singkuang tungah hehpihna tokhom na koih ding hi.
Dalna puan pualamah sabuai koihin, sabuai tawh a kisan biakbuk leitaw lampangah meivakkhuam na koih ding a, leilu lampangah sabuai na koih ding hi.
"Puanbuk kongkhak dingin a dum, a dupsan, a ausan, a kopin a kikhuk khau hoih tawh a kigan, phim tawh kikhui-in a kizem kongpuankhai khat na bawl ding hi.
Kongpuankhai a dingin singkha khuampi nga bawlin kham tawh na zut ding hi. A vankhainate kham hi ding a, tuate a dingin sumngo bullen nga na bawl ding hi.
"Biakna tau ding singkha sing tawh bawl in. Pi sagih le alang sau-in pi sagih le alang mah na zaisak ding hi. Biakna tau a ning kikim ding a, a tun pi li le alang hi ding hi.
A kiu lite-ah ki na bawl ding hi. A kite pen a biakna tau tawh sakhat hi ding a, sumngo tawh na zut ding hi.
Ama a dingin vut koih nading beelte le kawbiate, kuangte, sikkate le vutluahna peekte na bawl ding a, a nazat khempeuh sumngo tawh na bawl ding hi.
Ama a dingin siklen, a vang simsiam zong sumngo tawh na bawl ding hi. Siklen tung, a kiu lite-ah sumngo kual li na bawl ding hi.
Siklen in biakna tau kimciang a batsuk theih nadingin biakna tau zawl nuai panin na bulh ding hi.
Biakna tau a dingin singkha sing zawlte bawlin sumngo tawh tuate na zut ding hi.
A kipuak ciangin biakna tau pang nihte-ah a zawlte a om theihna dingin a kualte' vang sungah a zawlte kikhum ding hi.
Singpekte tawh kuak nei-in biakna tau na bawl ding a, mualtung a nang tungah hong kilaksa bangin kibawl ding hi.
"Biakbuk tual na bawl ding hi. A tual in leitaw lam pangah pang khat a dingin pi za le sawmnga a sau, a kopin a kikhuk khau hoih tawh a kigan a kikhai suk dalna puan nei ding hi.
A khuam sawmnih le a bullen sawmnih pen sumngo tawh a kibawl hi ding a, ahih hangin khuampi tunga vankhainate le a gaknate pen ngun tawh a kibawl hi ding hi.
Leilu lampang a ding zong a sauna tua bangmah hi-in, a kikhai suk dalna puan pi za le sawmnga sau ding a, a khuam sawmnih le a bullen sawmnih pen sumngo tawh a kibawl hi ding hi. Ahi zongin khuampi tunga vankhainate le a gaknate pen ngun tawh a kibawl hi ding hi.
Nitumna lam pangah buktual a vailam a dingin khuampi sawm le bullen sawmte tawh pi sawmsagih le nga a sau a kikhai suk dalna puan om ding hi.
A mailam, nisuahna lam buktual a vailam pi sawmsagih le nga hi ding hi.
Kongpi pang khat-a ding a kikhaisuk dalna puan pi sawmnih le nih le alang hi ding a, khuampi thum le bullen thumte tawh hi ding hi.
A pang langkhatah a kikhaisuk dalna puan pen pi sawmnih le nih le alang hi ding a, khuampi thum le bullen thumte tawh hi ding hi.
Buktual a kongpi dingin a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khau a kopin a kikhuk khau hoihte tawh a kigan, phim tawh kikhui-in a kizem, pi sawmthum a sau kongpuankhai khat om ding a, tua in khuampi li le bullen li nei ding hi.
Buktual kiima khuampi khempeuh ngun tawh kibawl gakna tawh kigak ding a, a vankhainate ngun hi-in a bullente sumngo hi ding hi.
Buktual a dung pi za le sawmnga, a vai pi sawmsagih le nga, a sanna pi sagih le alang hi-in, a kopin a kikhuk khau hoih tawh a kigan a kikhaisuk dalna puan le sumngo bullente tawh hi ding hi.
Biakbuk nazat ding peuhmahte le a khetphimte khempeuh le buktual a khetphimte khempeuh sumngo tawh a kibawl hi ding hi.
"Meivak a kuangin a om tawntung theih nadingin mei a vak ding oliv gah a kisuzan, sathau siangtho, Israel mite in nang kiangah hong paipih nadingun thu na pia ding hi.
Kikhopna buk sung, thuciamna singkuang mai-a dalna puan pualamah, Aaron le ama tapate in nitak a kipan zingsang dong Topa' mai-ah vil ding uh hi. Tua pen Israel mite in amau' khang tawntungin a zuih ding uh ngeina kip khat hi ding hi.
"Tua ciangin keima tungah siampi na a sem dingin Israel mite lak panin na sanggampa Aaron le a tapate Nadab le Abihu, Eleazar le Ithamar, nangma kiangah la in.
Minthanna le hoihna tawh a kidim nadingin na sanggampa Aaron a' ding biakna puan siangtho na bawl ding hi.
Keima siampi nasepna-ah amah a ap theih nadingun amaute in Aaron' puante a bawl nading, hih theihna lungsim ka guatsa, siamna a nei mite khempeuh tungah gen in.
Amaute' bawl ding puante: Awmdal khat, siampipuan khat, puantualpi khat, sikli nei-a a gial puantungsilh khat, dialpi khat le kawnggak khat ahi hi. Keima tungah siampi na a sem ding na sanggampa Aaron le ama tapate a dingin amaute in biakna puan siangthote bawl ding uh hi.
Amaute in kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le a kopin a kikhuk tawh a kigan puan hoihte sang ding uh hi.
"Amaute in siampipuan pen, kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte tawh bawl ding uh a, hoihtakin a kibawl hi ding hi.
Amah a gak dingin hoihtakin a kigan tua tunga puan om pen, kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute le a kopin a kikhuk puan hoihte tawh kibawlin, a sepna zia le a nate a kibang hi ding hi.
amau' suahna tawh kizui-in amau' min gukte suang khat tungah gelhin, a omlai gukte' min a suang dang khat tungah na gelh ding hi.
Kizepna a bawlpa in min gelhna a bawl bangin Israel tapa sawm le nihte' minte suang nihte tungah na gelh ding hi. Tuate pen kham a zepna tawh na um ding hi.
Israel tapate phawkna suang dingin siampipuan' liangkaih puan tungah tua suang nihte na bulh ding hi. Aaron in ama liangko nihte tungah phawkphawk dingin Topa' mai-ah amaute' min pua ding hi.
Kham tawh kibawl a kiphut kizepna le
khau bangin a kihual, kham citak khainiang nih na bawl ding a, a kihual khainiangte pen a kiphutte' tungah na bulh ding hi.
"Hoihtakin a kibawl thukhenna awmdal khat na bawl ding hi. Siampipuan a kibawl bangmahin na bawl ding hi. Kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute le a kopin a kikhuk puan hoih tawh na bawl ding hi.
A ning kikimin thuap nih hi ding a, a dung letmat kua, a vai letmat kua mah hi ding hi.
Tua sungah suang gual li-in na bulh ding hi. Sardis suang, topaz suang, le karbankal suang gual khat pen a gual masa hi ding hi.
A gual nihna-ah emerald suang, sapfaia suang, le diamond suang hi ding hi.
A gual thumna-ah jakinth suang, agate suang, le amethyst suang hi ding hi.
A gual lina-ah beryl suang, onik suang, le jasper suang hi ding a, kham tawh zepna sungah tuate kibulh ding hi.
Israel tapate' min tawh kituakin amaute' min a omna suang sawm le nih om ding hi. Tuate pen minam sawm le nihte a dingin amau' min ciat kigelhin, min gelhna tawh kibang ding hi.
Awmdal a dingin khau tawh a kibang, a kihual kham citak khainiang na bawl ding hi.
Awmdal a dingin kham kual nih na bawl ding a, awmdal mongah tua kualte na bulh ding hi.
Awmdal mong a kual nihte sungah kham khau nihte na khum ding hi.
Khau mong nihte zepna tawh na zom ding a, siampipuan' liangkaih puan mai lamah tua bangin na zom ding hi.
Kham kual nih na bawl ding a, awmdal mong nih, siampipuan tawh a kizom a sunglamah na bulh ding hi.
Kham kual nih na bawl ding a, siampipuan liangkaih nihte' nuai a mailam, hoihtakin a kigan siampi puankhau a kizopna tung sanah na bulh ding hi.
Hoihtakin a kigan siampipuan' khau tungah a om theih nading le siampipuan tung panin awmdal a kol theih loh nadingin amaute in siampipuan' kualah khaudum khatin a kual tawh gakkhawm ding uh hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Topa' mai-ah phawk tawntung nadingin amaute a paipih dingin siangtho munah amah a pai ciangin, Aaron in ama lungtang tunga om thukhenna awmdal sungah Israel tapate' min pua ding hi.
Thukhenna awmdal sungah Urim le Thummim na koih ding a, Topa' mai-ah a pai ciangin Aaron' lungtang tungah tuate om ding hi. Tua bangin Aaron in ama lungtang tungah Israel mite' thukhenna Topa' mai-ah pua tawntung ding hi.
"Siampi puantualpi, puan dum bek tawh na bawl ding hi.
A mongah a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute tawh a kizem mang kawlsing gah bawlin, a mong kiimah amaute' kikalah kham siklong bawlin,
puantualpi mong kimkotah kham long le mang kawlsing gah, kham long le mang kawlsing gah cih bangin na kihelhsak ding hi.
Aaron in biakna na a sep ciangin tua puan silh ding a, amah a sih khak loh nadingin Topa' mai a siangtho munah a tum ciang le a pusuah ciangin a gingte kiza ding hi.
"Nangmah in kham citak tawh a peek khat na bawl ding a, min gelhna a kibawlte mah bangin tua tungah, ' Topa a' ding siangtho,' ci-in na gelh ding hi.
Tua pen, khaudum khat tawh dialpi tungah na gak ding a, dialpi mai lamah om ding hi.
Tua pen Aaron' taltangah om ding a, Israel mite in letsong siangtho a piakna uh ahi, a siangtho biakpiakna-ah mawhna a om peuhmah Aaron in ama tungah pua ding hi. Topa' mai-ah amaute a kisan' theih nadingin ama taltang tungah tua a peek om tawntung ding hi.
"A puantungsilh ding pen khau hoih tawh siik li nei, a gialin na gan ding hi. Khau hoih tawh dialpi khat na bawl ding a, phim tawh kikhui-in a kizem kawnggak khat na bawl ding hi.
"Aaron' tapate a dingin puantungsilhte, kawnggakte, le lukhute na bawl ding a, minthanna le hoihna tawh a kidim nadingin tuate na bawl ding hi.
Amaute in keima tungah siampi na a sep theih nadingun na sanggampa Aaron le a tapate na silhsak ding a, amaute sathau nilhin, nasem dingin kipsakin, na siangthosak ding hi.
A ci guakin a omna uh a tuam dingin amau a dingin puan hoihte tawh pheituamte na bawlsak ding a, tuate in kawng panin phei ciang ban ding hi.
Kikhopna bukah amaute a pai ciang uh ahi a, siangtho munah nasem dingin biakna tau nai-ah a pai ciang uh ahi zongin, Aaron le ama tapate in tuate a silh ding uh hi. Tua hikeileh amaute in amau tung mahah mawhna a kisuan tawm suakin si ding uh hi. Hih pen amah le ama khit ciangin a suanlekhakte a dingin a om tawntung ngeina kip khat hi ding hi.
"Amaute in keima tungah siampi na a sep theih nadingun amaute na sianthosak nadingin amaute' tungah na hih ding thute: Bawngtalno khat le a sitbaang lo tuutal nih,
le silngo sawh loh anlum, sathau a kihel silngo sawh loh mohte, sathau tawh a kizut silngo sawh loh mohphengte la in. Tuate pen mangbuhnel tawh na bawl ding hi.
Lawh khat sungah tuate koihin tuate a lawhin paipihin, a bawngtal le a tuutal nih zong na paipih ding hi.
"Kikhopna buk kongkhakah Aaron le a tapate na paipih ding a, tui tawh amaute na sil ding hi.
Nangmah in puante la-in, puantungsilh le siampi puantualpi, siampipuan le awmdal, Aaron silhsakin, hoihtakin a kigan siampipuan gakna tawh amah na gak ding hi.
Ama lu tungah dialpi khim sakin, dialpi tungah kumpi lukhu siangtho na khusak ding hi.
Nangmah in nilh sathau la-in, ama lu tungah sungin amah na nilh ding hi.
"Tua ciangin nangmah in ama tapate paipihin, amaute, puantungsilh na silhsak ding a,
kawnggakte tawh amaute gakin, amau' lu tungah a lukhute uh na gak ding hi. Siampi nasepna pen a kip tawntung ngeina ahih manin amau a' hi ding hi. Tua bangin Aaron le a tapate na kipsak ding hi.
"Tua ciangin kikhopna buk mai-ah bawngtal na paipih ding hi. Aaron le a tapate in bawngtal lu tungah amau' khut nga ding uh a,
Topa' mai, kikhopna buk kongkhakah nangmah in a bawngtal na go ding hi.
Bawngtal sisan tawmkhat la-in na khutme tawh biakna tau kite na nuh ding a, si a omlai teng biakna tau bulah na sungkhia ding hi.
A gilpi tuam a thau khempeuh le a sin tunga a utok le a kal nihte le a kal tuam a thau na la ding a, biakna tau tungah tuate na hal ding hi.
Ahih hangin bawngtal sa le a vun le a ekte, giahphual pua lamah mei tawh na hal ding hi. Tua pen khialhna hanga biakna ahi hi.
"Tua ciangin nangmah in tuutalte khat la-in, Aaron le a tapate in tuutal lu tungah amau' khut nga ding uh a,
nangmah in tuutal go-in, a si la-in biakna tau kimkotah na theh ding hi.
Tua ciangin tuutal semnenin, a sungkua le a khete silin, a sabakte le a lu tawh tuate koihin,
biakna tau tungah tuutal a bupin na hal ding hi. Tua pen Topa' tungah meihal biakna hi a, a gim namtui, Topa' tungah mei tawh kihal biakna ahi hi.
"Nangmah in tuutal adang khat na la ding hi. Aaron le a tapate in tua tuutal lu tungah amau' khut nga ding uh a,
nangmah in tuutal go-in, a si tawmkhat la-in Aaron' taklam bil dawn le ama tapate' taklam bil dawnte le amau' taklam khutpi dawnte le amau' taklam khepi dawnte nuhin, si a omlai teng biakna tau kiimah na theh ding hi.
Tua ciangin biakna tau tunga a om si tawmkhat le nilh sathau la-in Aaron le ama puante tung le a tapate le a puante tungah na theh ding hi. Tua ciangin amah le a puante le a tapate le a puante a siangtho hi ding hi.
"Nangmah in tuutal thau, a mei, a gilpi tuam a thau, a sin pan a utok, a kal nihte, a kal tuam a thau, le a taklam phei (bang hang hiam cih leh tuate pen kipsakna tuutal ahi hi)
le Topa' mai-ah a om silngo sawh loh anlum lawh sung panin anlum khat, sathau tawh a kibawl anlum bek khat, le moh pheng khat na la ding hi.
Hihte khempeuh Aaron' khutsung le a tapate' khut sungah na koih ding a, Topa' mai-ah vei-a piak dingin na vei ding hi.
Tua ciangin amau' khutsung panin tuate na la ding a, Topa' mai-ah a gim namtui dingin biakna tau tungah mei tawh kihal biakna banah na hal ding hi. Tua pen Topa' tungah mei tawh kihal biakna ahi hi.
"Nangmah in Aaron a kikipsakna tuutal sa-iik la-in Topa' mai-ah vei-a piak dingin na vei ding hi. Tua pen nangma tanh hi ding hi.
"Kipsakna sa pen Aaron le ama tapate a' ding ahih ciangin, kipsakna tuutal panin a kipia, a kivei siampite' tanh a phei le vei-a piak sa-iikte na siangthosak ding hi.
Tua pen Aaron le ama tapate a dingin Israel mite' tung panin a kaih tawntung ding uh ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh thunuama amau' biakna panin Israel mite in a piak ding siampite' tanh ahi hi. Tua pen Topa' tungah amau' piak ahi hi.
"Aaron' biakna puan siangthote pen ama sih khit ciangin a tapate' tungah kipia ding a, amaute sathau kinilhin a kikipsak nading ahi hi.
Ama za luahin siampi na a sem a tapa in siangtho munah nasem dingin kikhopna bukah a pai ciangin ni sagih sung tuate silh ding hi.
"Nangmah in kipsakna tuutal la-in a siangtho biakna mun khatah a sa na huan ding hi.
Aaron le a tapate in kikhopna buk kongkhakah tuutal sa le lawh sunga om anlum ne ding uh hi.
Amaute in amaute a kikipsak nading le a siangthosak dingin kilemna a kibawlna tua ante ne ding uh a, ahih hangin a pualam mi in tuate ne thei lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tuate pen a siangtho biakna an ahi hi.
Kipsakna sate khat peuhpeuh ahi a, anlum ahi zongin, zingsang ciang dong a omlai leh nangmah in a omlaite mei tawh na hal ding hi. Tuate pen biakna an siangtho ahih manin kine lo ding hi.
"Tua bangin nang kong thupiakte khempeuh tawh kituakin Aaron le ama tapate' tungah na hih ding a, ni sagih sung tawntung amaute ki-apna na bawl ding hi.
Kilem nadingin mawhna hanga biakna-in ni simin bawngtal khat na pia ding hi. Siangthosak nadingin sathau na nilh ciang le kilemna na bawl ciangin biakna tau a dingin khialhna hanga biakna khat zong na pia ding hi.
Biakna tau a dingin ni sagih sung kilemna bawlin na siangthosak ding hi. Tua ciangin biakna tau a siangtho pen suak ding a, tua biakna tau a lawng peuhpeuh a siangtho suak ding hi.
"Tu-in biakna tau tungah na piak tawntung dingte hih bang ahi hi: Nisimin a kizomin kum khat a pha tuuno nihta hi ding hi.
Tuuno khat zingsang lamin na pia ding a, adang tuuno khat nitak lamin na pia ding hi.
Tuuno a masa tawh annel lawh khat le a oliv thau hai khat tawh a kihel leh tuibuah dingin leenggahzu hai khat hi ding hi.
Tuuno adang khat nitakin na pia ding a, zingsang a mah bangin a gim namtui ding, Topa' mai-ah mei tawh kihal biakna-in an tawh biakna le tuibuah tawh na pia khawm ding hi.
Nang tunga thu kong gen nading, nang tawh ka kituah nading mun, Topa' mai kikhopna buk kongkhakah na khang tawntungun a kipia tawntung ding meihal biakna hi ding hi.
Tua lai-ah Israel mite tawh ka kituah ding a, keima vang in tua mun siangthosak ding hi.
Keimah in kikhopna buk le biakna tau ka siangthosak ding a, keima siampi na a sem dingin Aaron le a tapate zong ka siangthosak ding hi.
Israel mite lakah keimah tengin amau' Pasian ka hi ding hi.
Amaute' lakah keimah ka tenna hangin Egypt leitang panin amaute a paikhiatpih Topa amau' Pasian ka hihna amaute in hong thei ding uh hi. Kei pen Topa amau' Pasian ka hi hi.
"Nangmah in paknamtui hal nading biakna tau khat, singkha sing tawh na bawl ding hi.
A dung pi khat le alang, a vai zong pi khat le alang mah hi ding hi. A kikim sikli nei hi ding a, a sanna pi thum hi ding hi. A kite a tak tawh sakhat hi ding hi.
Nangmah in kham citak tawh a tung le a pang kimkot le a kite na zut ding a, a kimkotah kham tawh a geihual na bawl ding hi.
Tua biakna tau a dingin kham kual nih na bawl ding hi. A geihual nuai a kigal sai a pang tuakah tuate na bawl ding a, a puak nading zawlte a khum nading hi ding uh hi.
Nangmah tawh ka kituah nading mun, thuciamna tunga a om hehpihna tokhom mai, thuciamna singkuang kiangah a om dalna puan mai-ah biakna tau na koih ding hi.
Aaron in tua tungah a namtui paknamtui hal ding hi. Amah in zingsang simin meivakte a puah ciangin hal ding hi.
Tua tungah a siangtho lo paknamtui hitaleh, meihal biakna hitaleh, an tawh biakna hitaleh na pia kei ding hi. Tua tungah tuibuah na sung kei ding hi.
Aaron in kilem nadingin khialhna hanga biakna si a kite tungah kum khatin khatvei zut ding hi. Amah in na khang tawntungun kum khatin khatvei kilemna bawl ding hi. Tua pen Topa' tungah a siangtho pen ahi hi," a ci hi.
"Israel mite a phazah na sim ciangin amau' lakah gimna a tun loh nadingin, a milip in a kitatkhiatna uh Topa' tungah pia ding uh hi.
Mi simna-ah a kihel mi peuhmah in biakinn shekel tawh kituakin shekel lang (shekel khatah gerah sawmnih om hi), Topa' tungah biakna-in pia ding hi.
Mi simna-ah a kihel, kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah peuhmah in Topa' tungah biakna pia ding hi.
Note a' ding kilemna bawl nadingin Topa biakna na piak uh ciangin a haute in shekel lang sangin a tamzaw pia lo ding a, a zawngte in a tawmzaw pia lo ding hi.
