Nomau a dingin kilemna bawl nading, Topa' mai-ah Israel mite ka phawkna a hisak dingin Israel mite tung panin kilemna sum na la ding a, kikhopna buk nasep nadingin na zang ding hi," a ci hi.
"Kisil nadingin sumngo kuang khat, le a ngak nading zong sumngo mah tawh bawl in. Nangmah in kikhopna buk le biakna tau kikalah na koih ding a, tua sungah tui na koih ding hi.
Aaron le a tapate in a khut uh le a khe uh tua tui tawh sil ding uh hi.
Kikhopna bukah amaute a pai ciang uh ahi a, Topa' tungah mei tawh kihal biakna hal dingin biakna tau nai-ah a pai ciang uh ahi zongin, amaute a sih loh nadingun amaute tui tawh kisil ding uh hi.
A sih khak loh nadingun a khut uh le a khe uh sil ding uh hi. Tua pen na khang tawntungun amaute tung a kipanin amau' suanlekhakte tungah ngeina kip khat hi ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua tham loin, Topa in Moses kiangah,
"A hoihpen a namtui nate la in. Myrrh paknamtui shekel zanga le a namtui thaksing tuazah lang, shekel zanih le sawmnga a gik, le a khum a namtui paknamtui zanih le sawmnga,
biakinn shekel tawh kituakin thaksing nam khat zanga, le oliv thau bung khat,
nangmah in paknamtui bawlte' bawl mah bangin a siangtho sathau nilh dingin hihte na gawm ding a, tua pen a siangtho sathau nilh hi ding hi.
Nangmah in tua tawh kikhopna buk le thuciamna singkuang,
sabuai le a nazat khempeuh, meivakkhuam le a nazatte le paknamtui biakna tau,
meihal biakna tau a nazat khempeuh tawh, kuang le a ngakna na zut ding hi.
Tuate a siangtho pen ahih theih nadingin na siangthosak ding a, tuate a lawng peuhmah a siangtho suak ding hi.
Amaute in keima tungah siampi na hong sep theih nadingun Aaron le a tapate nangmah in sathau nilhin amaute na siangthosak ding hi.
Nangmah in Israel mite kiangah, 'Hih pen na khang tawntungun a siangtho keima sathau nilh hi ding hi.
Mi mawkmawkte' pumpi tungah tua sathau kisung lo ding a, tua bangin a kigawm sathau dang na bawl kei ding uh hi. Tua pen a siangtho hi a, note a dingin a siangtho hi ding hi.
Tua tawh a kibangin a bawl mi peuhmah ahi a, a pualam mi khatpeuh tuate a nilhsak mi peuhmah ahi zongin ama mite' kiang panin kikhenkhia ding hi, Topa in ci hi,' ci in," a ci hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah, "A namtui nate, stakte, onikha, le galbanum, paknamtui citak tawh a namtui nate (a tamna a kikim ciatin) la inla,
paknamtui bawlte' hih bangin ci sawhin a nin baang lo, biakna paknamtui bawl in.
Nangmah in kimkhat a neu mahmahin na satnen ding a, nang tawh ka kituah nading kikhopna buk sunga thuciamna mai-ah pawlkhat na koih ding hi. Tua pen nangma a dingin a siangtho pen hi ding hi.
A kigawmpih ngei teng tawh na bawl ding paknamtui pen note a dingin na bawl kei ding uh hi. Tua pen note a dingin Topa' tungah a siangtho hi ding hi.
Tua tawh a kibangin paknamtui a bawl mi peuhmah ama mite' kiang panin kikhenkhia ding hi," a ci hi.
"Thei in; Judah minam Hur' tapa ahi Uri' tapa Bezalel a minin ka sam khin hi.
Lim hoihte a geel ding; kham, ngun, sumngo tawh na a bawl ding; siamna nam khempeuhah nasep nading; bulh ding suangte seekna le singzep nasep a sem dingin vangliatna, siamna, pilna, theihna, le khutsiam nasep khempeuh tawh amah ka kidimsak hi.
En in, amah tawh, Dan minam, Ahisamak' tapa Oholiab ka seh khinzo hi. Amaute in nang kong thupiak khempeuh a bawl theih nadingun a hih thei mi khempeuh tungah siamna ka pia khinzo hi.
Amau' sep dingte hih bang ahi hi: Kikhopna buk, le thuciamna singkuang le a tunga om hehpihna tokhom le buk sung na khempeuh,
sabuai le a nazatte le a siangtho meivakkhuam le a nazatte khempeuh, paknamtui biakna tau,
le meihal biakna tau a nazatte khempeuh tawh, kuang le a ngakna,
le amau' siampi nasep nadingin siampi Aaron' puan siangthote le ama tapate' puante ahi, hoihtakin a kigan puante,
le siangtho mun a dingin nilh sathau le a namtui paknamtui ahi hi. Ka thupiakte khempeuh tawh kituakin nangmah in na bawl ding hi," a ci hi.
"Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: 'Keima Sabbath ni-in note na tawlnga ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih pen Topa ahi keimah in note a hong siangthosak ka hihna na theih nadingun na khang tawntungun keimah le note' kikalah lim khat hi ding hi.
Sabbath ni-in note na tawlnga ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note a dingin a siangtho ahi hi. Tua ni-in a tawlnga lo mi peuhmah kithat ding a, tua ni-in na a sem mi peuhmah ama mite' kiang panin kikhenkhia ding hi.
Ni guk sungin nasep kizo ding hi. Ahih hangin a ni sagih ni pen a thupi-a tawlngakna Sabbath ni hi a, Topa' tungah siangtho hi. Sabbath ni-in nasep khat peuhpeuh a sem mi peuhmah kithat ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a tawntung thuciamna-in amau' khang tawntungin Sabbath tangin, Israel mite in Sabbath kem ding uh hi.
Ni guk sung teng Topa in van le lei bawlin, a ni sagih ni-in amah tawlnga a, a tha dimsakkik hi. Keimah le Israel mite' kikalah hih Sabbath ni pen lim khat hi tawntung ding hi, ci hi,' ci in," a ci hi.
Sinai Mual tungah thugenna a man khit ciangin Pasian' khut tawh a kigelh suangpek ahi thuciamna suangpek nihte, amah in Moses a pia hi.
Mualtung panin Moses hong tunsuk hahna mite in a theih uh ciangin, Aaron kiangah mite amau mah kikaikhawm tawmin ama kiangah, "Kithawi in; kote' mai-ah a pai ding pasian hong bawlsak in. Egypt leitang panin eite hong paikhiatpih to Moses ahihleh bang suak khin cih i thei kei hi," a ci uh hi.
Aaron in amaute kiangah, "Na zite, na tapate, le na tanute uh bil tungah a om kham bilbahte sutkhia unla, kei kiangah tuate hong paipih un," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi khempeuh in amau' bil-a om kham bilbahte sutkhia-in Aaron' kiangah tuate a paipih uh hi.
Amah in amaute' tung panin kham saangin, sumtui sunna sungah sungin, a kisung bawngno khat bawlsak a, tua ciangin mite in, "Israel mite aw, hih pen Egypt leitang panin note hong paikhiatpih to na pasian uh!" a ci uh hi.
Aaron in hih thu a muh ciangin, amah in tua mai-ah biakna tau khat lam a, "Zing ciang pen Topa a' ding pawi bawl ni hi ding hi," ci-in zaksakna a bawl hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah, "Paisuk in; bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt leitang panin nangmah in na paikhiatpih toh mite amau kisiasak uh hi.
Ka thupiakna lampi panin amaute kiheikhia pak uh hi. Amau a dingin amaute in a kisung bawngno khat bawlin, tua bia-in a tungah biakna pia uh a, 'Israel mite aw, hih pen Egypt leitang panin note hong paikhiatpih to na pasian uh ahi hi!' ci uh hi," a ci hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah, "Hih mite ka mu zo hi. En in, a lungkhauh mite ahi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in amaute tungah ka sinso-in amaute ka beisak theih nadingin kei guak hong omsak in. Ahi zongin nang ahihleh minam lian khatin kong bawl ding hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Moses in Topa ama Pasian tungah thum a, " Topa aw, na vangliatna le na thahatna tawh Egypt leitang panin na paikhiatpih ahi nangma mite tungah bang hangin sinso ding na hi hiam?
Bang hangin Egypt mite in, 'Mualtungah amaute a that ding le leitung panin amaute a beisak dingin siatna ngaihsutna tawh amah in amaute paikhiatpih hi,' ci ding uh ahi hiam? A kihtakhuai na hehna daisak inla, na lungsim kheelin na mite tungah hih siatna tungsak kei in.
Amaute' tungah nangmahmah kiciamin, 'Na suanlekhakte uh vantung aksi bangin tamsakin, keimah in ka ciamsa hih leitang khempeuh na suanlekhakte uh tungah ka pia ding a, amaute in luah tawntung ding uh hi,' na cihna na nasemte Abraham, Isaac, le Israel phawk in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in a lungsim kheel a, ama mite' tungah a tunsak ding siatna tungsak nawn lo hi.
Tua ciangin Moses kihei-in, a khutsunga om thuciamna suangpek nih, a pang langnih tuakah a kigelh suangpeekte tawh mualtung panin a paisuk hi.
A peekte pen Pasian' bawl hi a, a kigelh thute pen suangpek tungah Pasian' gelh ahi hi.
Joshua in amaute' kiko gamlumna a zak ciangin Moses kiangah, "Giahphual ah kido-a gamlumna om hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Moses in, "Tu-a gamlumna pen zawhna kikona aw ahi a, lelhna kikona aw ahi zongin, tua bang pawl hi lo hi. Ahih hangin tu-a ka zak pen lasakna awging ahi hi," a ci hi.
Giahphual nai-ah amah tungin bawngno le lamna a muh phetin, Moses heh mahmah a, amah in ama khutsung panin suangpeekte lawn a, mual bulah tuate a sukham hi.
Amah in amaute' bawlsa bawngno la-in mei tawh hal a, gawivui-in tui tungah theh a, Israel mite a tui dawnsak hi.
Moses in Aaron kiangah, "Amaute' tungah khialhna lianpi khat na tunpih nadingin hih mite in nang' tungah bang hong gen uh ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Aaron in, "Ka topa aw, heh lua kei in. Mite' lungsim na theihsa ahih mah bangin amaute in siatna ngaihsun uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in keima kiangah, 'Kote' mai-ah a pai ding pasian hong bawlsak in. Egypt leitang panin eite hong paikhiatpih to Moses ahihleh, bang suak khin cih i thei kei hi,' ci uh hi.
Keimah in amaute kiangah, 'Kham a nei peuhpeuh in sutkhia un,' ka ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in kei' tungah hong pia uh a, keimah in mei sungah tuate ka lawn a, hih bawngno hong suak hi," a ci hi.
Mite a tatkhialhna Moses in a muh ciangin (bang hang hiam cih leh Aaron in amau' maizum nadingin amau' galte' lakah amaute takhialsak hi),
giahphual kongpi sungah Moses ding a, " Topa' lamah kua teng om na hi uh hiam? Kei' kiangah hong pai un," a ci hi. Levi mite khempeuh ama kiangah hong kikaikhawm uh hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, "Israel-te' Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: 'A milip in a namsau a pangah tawi-in kongpi khat pan kongpi khat, giahphual khempeuhah pai kawikawi-in, a milip in a sanggampa, a milip in a kikholhpih pa, a milip in a vengpa that hen,' ci hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Moses' thugen bangin Levi mite gamta uh a, tua ni-in mihing tulthum bang si hi.
Moses in, "Note' tungah thupha hong tun theih nadingin ama tapa le a sanggamte ciat supna thuakin Topa' na sep nadingah tuni-in note na kikipsak tawm uh hi," a ci hi.
A zingsang ciangin Moses in mite kiangah, "Note in khialhna lianpi khat na bawl khin uh hi. Tu-in Topa' kiangah kei ka pai ding a, note' khialhna thu-ah kilemna ka va bawl thei kha ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa' kiangah Moses paikikin, "Ala, hih mite in khialhna lianpi khat bawl khin uh a, amaute in amau a dingin kham pasian khat bawl khin uh hi.
Ahih hangin nangmah in tu-in amau' khialhna maisak in. Na maisak kei ding leh, hong thum ing, nangma gelhsa laibu panin keimah hong phiatmai in," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in Moses kiangah, "Kei' tungah hong khial peuhmah, ka laibu panin ka phiat ding hi.
Ahih hangin tu-in pai in; nang' tunga kong gensa munah mite paipih in. En in, na mai-ah ka vantungmi pai ding hi. Ahi zongin ka thukkik ni ciangin amau' khialhna amau' tungah ka thuk ding hi," a ci hi.
Amaute in Aaron' bawlsa bawngno bia uh ahih manin Topa in mite' tungah gimna a tungsak hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah, "Hih mun nusia un; Abraham, Isaac, le Jakob tungah, 'Na suanlekhakte uh tungah ka pia ding hi,' ci-a ka ciam leitangah nangmah le Egypt leitang panin na paikhiatpih toh mite tawh hih lai panin paito un.
Note' mai-ah vantungmi khat ka sawl ding a, Kanaan mite, Amor mite, Hit mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite, le Jebus mite ka hawlkhia ding hi.
Bawngnawi le khuaizu a luanna leitangah paito un. Ahi zongin note hong sisak kha ding ka hih ciangin note' lakah kei kong paito kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note mi lungkhauh na hi uh hi," a ci hi.
Mite in hih thusiate a zak uh ciangin amaute thuum uh a, kuamah kizem lo uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Moses kiangah, "Israel mite' tungah hih bangin gen in: 'Note mi lungkhauh na hi uh hi. Note' lakah tomno khat sung hong paito leng, note kong beisak ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin note kong bawl nading ka theih nadingin note' tung panin na kizepnate uh suahkhia un,' ci in," ci-in gen khinzo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel mite in Horeb Mual pan a kipanin amau' kizepnate suahkhia uh hi.
Israel mite in giahphual a sat simin Moses in puanbuk la-in giahphual panin a gamla pekah lam thei zel hi. Amah in tua pen kikhopna buk, ci hi. Topa' tungah thu a dong nuam mi peuhmah giahphual pualama om kikhopna bukah paikhia uh hi.
Puanbukah Moses a pai peuhpeuh ciangin mi khempeuh ding to-in, a milipin a puanbuk kong ciat uhah ding uh a, puanbuk sungah a tum khit mateng Moses' nung en uh hi.
Puanbukah Moses a tum ciangin meii khuam hong kum sukin puanbuk kongkhakah ding a, Topa in Moses hopih hi.
Puanbuk kongkhakah meii khuam a ding a muh uh ciangin a milipin a puanbuk kong ciat uhah mi khempeuh dingto-in kun uh hi.
Tua bangin, mi khat in a lawmpa a hopih bangin maitang kituahin Topa in Moses hopih zel hi. Giahphual ah Moses a ciahkik ciangin, Nun' tapa, ama nasem tangval Joshua, puanbukah omlai hi.
Moses in Topa' kiangah, "Thei in; nangmah in keima kiangah, 'Hih mite paipihto in,' nong ci hi. Ahih hangin kei tawh nong sawlkhop ding mi kei nong theisak nai kei hi. Ahi zongin nangmah in, 'Na minin nang kong thei a, ka mai-ah maipha zong na mu khin hi,' nong ci khin hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in nang tungah kong thum hi; na muhna-ah maipha ka ngah leh keimah in nang hong thei-in, na muhna-ah maipha ka ngah theih nadingin tu-in nangma geelnate kei hong lak in. Hih minam pen nangma mite ahihna zong ngaihsun in," a ci hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah, "Nang tawh kong pai ding a, lungsim tawlngakna hun nang kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Moses in ama kiangah, "Nang nong paipih kei ding leh, hih lai panin kote hong paikhiatosak kei in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah le nangma mite in nangma muhna-ah maipha ka ngahna uh bang ci-in kithei ding ahi hiam? Leitung a om mi khempeuh tungah keimah le nangma mite ka tungnunna uh pen kote tawh nang nong paikhopna hi lo ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah, "Nangma gensa hih thu mahmah keimah in ka hih ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka muhna-ah nang in maipha na ngahzo a, na minin nang kong thei hi," a ci hi.
Moses in, "Kong thum hi; na vangliatna kei hong lak in," a ci hi.
Amah in, "Keima hoihna khempeuh na mai-ah ka paisak ding a, na mai-ah keima min, ' Topa ' cihna ka pulak ding hi. Ka diknopna mite tungah ka dik ding a, ka hehpihnop mite ka hehpih ding hi.
Ahih hangin nangmah in ka maitang na mu thei kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mi in kei hong mu leh tuami nungta lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua banah Topa in, "En in; suang tungah na din nading keima kiangah mun khat om hi.
Keima minthanna vang a pai laitakin suanghawm sungah nang kong koih ding a, kei ka paikhiat mateng ka khut tawh nang kong hum ding hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in ka khut ka lakhia ding hi. Nangmah in ka nung na mu ding a, ahih hangin ka maitang na mu kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah, "A masa tawh a kibangin suangpek nih sui in. Na sukkhap a masa suangpeekte sunga om thute tuate tungah ka gelh kik ding hi.
Kithawi-in Sinai Mual tungah zingsangin hong paito inla, mual dawn tua munah keima kiangah hong kilak in.
Nang tawh kuamah hong paito khawmsak kei inla, mualtung tengah kuamah omsak kei in. Tua mual mai-ah tuuhon ahi a, bawnghon ahi zongin gamtasak kei in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses in a masa bangin suangpek nih a sui hi. Zingsang ciangin amah tho baihin, Topa in amah a thupiaksa bangin Sinai Mual tungah paito a, a khut sungah suangpek nih a tawi hi.
Meii sungah Topa kum sukin tua lai-ah Moses tawh ding a, Topa in ama min a pulak hi.
Ama mai-ah Topa pai-in, "Topa , Topa , hehpihna nei-in a dik Pasian; lungduai-in itna kip le thutakna tawh a dim;
mi tul tampite a dingin itna kip a nei; mawhna, thu palsatna le khialhna maisakin; ahih hangin bangbang hitaleh mawhna a khahkhong ngei lo; pate' mawhna tate' tung le tute' tung, khang thum khang lina dongin a thukpa," ci-in a pulak hi.
Moses in leilak lamah a lu kunin a bia hi.
Amah in, "Tu-in na muhna-ah maipha ka muh leh, Topa aw, kong thum hi; lungkhauh mite ka hita uh zongin kote' kiangah Topa hong pai in. Kote' mawhna le kote' khialhna hong maisak inla, nangma mi dingin kote hong sang in," a ci hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah, "En in, keimah in thuciamna khat ka bawl hi. Nangma mi khempeuh' muhna-ah, leitung khempeuh hitaleh minam khatpeuh sungah hitaleh cikmahin tua bang a kibawl ngei lo na lamdangte ka bawl ding a, note' lakah a om mite khempeuh in Topa' nasepna mu ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note' tungah kong bawl ding na pen a kihtakhuai thu ahi hi.
"Tuni-a kong thupiak zui in. En in, na mai-ah Amor mite, Kanaan mite, Hit mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite, le Jebus mite ka hawlkhia ding hi.
Na paina leitangah a teng mite tawh thuciamna bawlkha kei inla, tua pen note a dingin thangzak a suahkhak loh nadingin nangmahmah kidawm in.
Nangmah in amau' biakna taute phelin, amau' biakna khuamte kuaitanin, amau' Asherah milimte na phukpai ding hi.
"(Pasian dang na bia kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa , ama min Aam a hi pa pen a aam Pasian ahi hi.)
Nangmah in tua leitangah a teng mite tawh thuciamna bawlkha kei in. Amaute in amau' pasian-te tawh paktatna bawlin amau' pasian-te' tungah biakna pia-in, khatpeuh in note hong sap ciangin, note in ama biakpiakna na ne kha ding uh a,
note in amau' tanute na tapate uh a dingin la-in, amau' pasian-te tawh paktatna a bawl a tanute in amau' pasian-te tawh na tapate uh paktatsak kha ding uh hi.
"A kisung pasian-te note a dingin bawlin na bia kei ding uh hi.
"Silngo sawh loh anlum pawi na bawl ding uh hi. Abib kha, a kisehsa hun sungteng, nang kong thupiak mah bangin ni sagih sung silngo sawh loh anlum na ne ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Abib kha sungin Egypt panin note na paikhia uh hi.
"Mihing le ganhing tacil a pa khempeuh keima-a' ahi hi.
La a tacilte tuuno khat tawh na tanh ding uh hi. Na tat kei uhleh a ngawng na kuaitan ding uh hi. Na tapa cilte khempeuh uh na tanh ding uh hi. Keima mai-ah a guakin kuamah hong kilak lo ding hi.
"Ni guk sung na na sem ding uh a, ahi zongin a ni sagih ni-in na tawlnga ding uh hi. Lokhawh hun le anlak hun sungin zong na tawlnga ding uh hi.
"Nipikalte' pawi, mangbuh a tung masa pawi, le kum bei ciangin an kaihkhop pawi na bawl ding uh hi.
"Pasal khempeuh Israel Pasian, Topa Pasian' mai-ah kum khatin thumvei kilak ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh note' mai-ah minam dangte ka hawlkhia ding a, na gamgite uh nomau a dingin ka keek ding hi. Topa na Pasian uh' mai-ah kum khatin thumvei a kilak dingin na paitoh sungun na leitang uh mi khat peuhpeuh in a hong deihgawh khak ding lunghihmawhna om lo ding hi.
"Note in silngo tawh keimah biakpiakna si na pia khawm kei ding uh a, Paisan Pawi biakpiakna zong zingsang dong na omsak kei ding uh hi.
"Note in na anpalte uh lakah a tung masa pen Topa na Pasian uh' inn-ah na paipih ding uh hi. "Note in keelno a pi' nawizu tawh na huan kei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Topa in Moses kiangah, "Hih thute gelh in. Hih thute tawh kizui-in nang le Israel tawh thuciamna khat ka bawlzo hi," a ci hi.
Tua lai-ah sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung Topa tawh Moses om a, tua hun sungteng anletui a ne kei hi. Amah in suangpek tungah thuciamna kammalte ahi thupiak sawmte a gelh hi.
A khut sungah thuciamna suangpek nih tawh Sinai Mual tung panin Moses hong paisuk ciangin, Pasian tawh amah kiho khin ahih manin a maitang vun a taan lamtak Moses in thei lo hi.
Aaron le Israel mite khempeuh in Moses a muh ciangin, a maitang vun na taang a, ama mai-ah a pai ding uh amaute lau uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute kiangah Moses pai hi. Aaron le mihon makaite khempeuh ama kiangah hong paikik uh a, Moses in amaute hopih hi.
Tua khit ciangin Israel mi khempeuh a nai-ah hong pai uh a, Topa in Sinai Mual-ah ama tunga a gen khempeuh thupiakna-in amaute tungah a pia hi.
Moses in amaute tawh thugen a man khit ciangin, amah in a maitangah kiliahna puan khat a koih hi.
Ahih hangin Topa tawh a kiho dingin ama mai-ah Moses a tum peuhpeuh ciangin, amah a pusuah kik mateng a kiliahna puan la khia hi. Amah hong paikhia-in ama tungah a kipia thute Israel mite kiangah a gen ciangin,
Israel mite in Moses' maitang vun a taang mu uh hi. Amah tawh a kiho dingin a pai matengin Moses in kiliahna puan tawh a maitang a khuh kik hi.
Moses in Israel mihonpi khempeuh khawmin amaute kiangah, "Hihte pen note' hih ding Topa' hong thupiak ahi hi.
Ni guk sungin nasep kiman ding a, ahih hangin a ni sagih ni-in thupi-a tawlngakna Sabbath siangtho Topa' tungah na nei ding uh hi. Tua ni-in na khat peuhpeuh a sem peuhmah kithat ding hi.
Sabbath ni-in na tenna khempeuh uhah mei na cih kei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Moses in Israel mihonpite khempeuh tungah, " Topa' hong thupiak hih bang ahi hi:
Note in Topa' tungah biakna na pia ding uh hi. A pia nuam peuhmah in Topa' tungah biakna paipih un. Tuate in: Kham, ngun le sumngo,
a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le a kopin a kikhuk puan hoihte, keelmul,
a kisansak tuutal vunte le savunte; singkha sing,
meivak a' ding sathau, nilh sathau le a paknamtui dingin a namtui nate,
siampipuan le awmdalah bulh dingin onik suang le suang dangte ahi hi.
"Note' lak panin siamna a nei mi peuhmah hong paisak unla, Topa' thupiaksa khempeuh bawlsak un. Tua a bawl dingte pen biakbuk,
a puanbuk le a khuhna, a vankhainate le a khuampeekte, a zawlte, a khuampite, a bullente;
singkuang a zawlte tawh, hehpihna tokhom le kongkhak dalna puan;
sabuai a zawlte le a nazatte khempeuh tawh, Ompihna Anlum;
khuavak dingin meivakkhuam zong, a nazatte le a meivakte tawh, meivak dingin sathau;
paknamtui biakna tau, a zawlte tawh, nilh sathau le a namtui paknamtui le biakbuk kongah kongkhak a' ding puankhai;
meihal biakna tau, a sumngo siklen, a zawlte, a nazatte khempeuh, kuang le a ngakna tawh;
buktual a a puankhaite, a khuampite le a bullente tawh, tual kongpi a' ding puankhai;
biakbuk khetphimte le huang khetphimte, le a khaute;
siangtho munah zat dingin limtakin a kigan puante, amau' siampi nasep nadingin siampi Aaron a' ding puan siangtho le ama tapate' puante ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mihonpi khempeuh Moses' omna panin paikhia uh hi.
Piak nopna lungsim a nei mi peuhmah hong pai tawm uh a, kikhopna buk le a nasep nading khempeuh le puan siangthote a zat dingin Topa a' ding a piakte uh hong puak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin numei, pasal hong pai uh hi. Piak nopna lungsim a neite khempeuh in tukkilhte, bilbahte, min gelhna zungbuhte, le banbulhte ahi kham tawh a kibawl na namkim hong paipih uh a, a milip in Topa' tungah kham tawh piakna ap uh hi.
A dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute, puan hoih, keelmul, a kisansak tuutal vunte, ahih kei leh savun hoihte ahi zongin a nei mi peuhmah in tuate hong paipih uh hi.
Ngun ahi a, sumngo ahi zongin a pia thei peuhmah in Topa' tungah tua nate paipih uh a, nasep nadinga kimang thei ding singkha sing a nei mi peuhmah in zong hong paipih hi.
A hih thei numei khempeuh in a khut uh tawh khau khuk uh a, amau' khuksa a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le a kopin a kikhuk khaute hong paipih uh hi.
Hih theih siamna a nei numei khempeuh in zong keelmul khuk uh hi.
Makaite in siampipuan le awmdal a bulh dingin onik suang le suang dangte,
meivak ding, nilh sathau ding, le paknamtui dingin a namtui nate le sathau hong paipih uh hi.
Topa in Moses tunga a thupiaksa nasep nadingin na khat peuhpeuh a pia nuam numei pasal Israel mi khempeuh in utthu-a biakna-in Topa' tungah hong paipih uh hi.
Moses in Israel mite kiangah, "Thei un; Topa in a minin Judah minam, Hur' tapa Uri, Uri' tapa Bezalel sam khin hi.
Lim hoihte a geel ding; kham, ngun, sumngo tawh na a bawl ding; siamna nam khempeuh nasep nading, bulh ding suang seekna, le singzep nasep a sem dingin amah in vangliatna, siamna, pilna, theihna, le khutsiam nasep khempeuh tawh amah kidimsak hi.
Topa in amah le Dan minam Ahisamak' tapa Oholiab tungah midangte hilh siamna pia khin hi.
Amah in khutsiam nasep, geelsiam nasep; a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le a kopin a kikhuk puanzep siam nasep; siamgat siamna, le geelsiam nasep ahi zongin nasep namkim a sem dingin amaute tungah siamna a guan hi.
"Bezalel le Oholiab le biakbuk lamna-ah nasep khat peuhpeuh sep nading zia a thei dingin Topa in siamna le pilna a guat mi peuhmah in Topa' thupiaksa khempeuh tawh kituakin sem ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Moses in Bezalel le Oholiab le Topa in nasep siamna a guat mi, nasem a pai dingin a ut mi peuhmah a sam hi.
Israel mite in biakbuk sep nadingin utthu-a a piak uh nate a paipih khempeuh uh amaute in Moses' tung panin a sang uh hi. Amaute in zingsang simin utthu-a piakna ama tungah paipih uh ahih manin,
biakbuk nasep a namkim a sem mi khempeuh amau' nasepna ciat panin hong pai uh a,
Moses kiangah, " Topa in eite' sep dingin a hong sawl nasep nadingin a kicing ding zahval, mite in tampi hong paipih uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses in thu pia-in giahphual khempeuhah thu kizasak a, "Numei hitaleh pasal hitaleh kuamah in biakbuk-a dingin pia thuah nawn kei un," kici hi. Tua ahih ciangin a piak ding uh mite kikho hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amau' piaksa nate pen nasepna khempeuh hih nadingin kicing a, valzaw lai hi.
Nasem mite' lak panin a hih thei mi khempeuh in puan dal sawm tawh biakbuk bawl uh hi. Tuate pen a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoih le a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute tawh kibawlin hoihtakin a kibawl kherub-te tawh zem uh hi.
Tua puan a dung pi sawmli le nih, a vai pi guk ciat hi a, a puan khempeuh kikim hi.
Amaute in puan dal ngate khatlekhat khuituahin, puan adang ngate zong khatlekhat mah khuituah uh hi.
Amaute in a kikhuituah masa puan a nawlnung pen nawl dung sukah khau dum tawh a bilvangte bawl uh a, tua mah bangin a kikhuituah nihna puan a nawlnung pen nawl dung sukah zong tuate mah a bawl uh hi.
Amaute in puan khat tungah bilvang sawmnga bawlin, a kikhuituah a nihna puan nawlah bilvang sawmnga mah bawl uh a, a bilvangte khatlekhat kitang hi.
Amaute in kham kilhna sawmnga bawlin, tua kilhnate tawh a puan khatlekhat kimatsak uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin biakbuk puan bupkhat a suak hi.
Amaute in biakbuk a tung khuh nadingin keelmul tawh puan dal sawm le khat a bawl uh hi.
Tua puante a dung pi sawmli le nga, a vai pi guk ciat hi a, tua puan sawm le khatte kikim hi.
Amaute in puan dal ngate khatlekhat khuituahin, a puan dang gukte zong khatlekhat mah a khuituah uh hi.
Amaute in a kikhuituah puan khat a nawlnung pen nawlah a bilvang sawmnga bawlin, puan dal a zom nawlah a bilvang sawmnga mah a bawl uh hi.
Tuate bup khat a suah theih nading, puanbuk a kimatsak dingin amaute in kilhna sawmnga sumngo tawh a bawl uh hi.
Amaute in puanbuk-a dingin a kisansak tuutal vunte le keel vunte tawh khuhna khat a bawl uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in biakbuk-a dingin singkha sing tawh a po to khawm ding khuampeekte a bawl uh hi.
A khuampeekte khat a tun pi sawm le pi nga hi a, a vai pi nih le letmat thum ciat ahi hi.
A bulh nadingin khuampeek khat in zang nih ciat nei a, amaute in biakbuk khuam khempeuh a dingin a bawl uh hi.
Amaute in biakbuk-a dingin khuampeekte hih bangin bawl uh hi: Leitaw lampang a dingin khuam sawmnih;
a khuampeek sawmnihte' bulah bullen sawmli ngun tawh, a zang nihte a dingin khuampeek khat bulah bullen nih, le a khuampeek dang khat bulah a zang nihte a dingin bullen nih mah a bawl uh hi.
Biakbuk a pang nihna lam, leilu lampang a dingin amaute in khuampeek sawmnih
le ngun tawh kibawl a bullen sawmli, khuampeek khat bulah bullen nih, adang khuampeek khat bulah bullen nih mah a bawl uh hi.
Nitumna lam, biakbuk nung lama dingin amaute in khuampeek guk a bawl uh hi.
Biakbuk nung lam kiute a dingin a khuampeek nih zong a bawl uh hi.
Tuate a bul lamah kikak a, ahih hangin a kual masa ah a dawn kimat hi. A kiu nihte-a dingin tua bangin nih a bawl uh hi.
Ngun tawh kibawl amau' bullente tawh khuampeek giat om hi: Bullen sawm le guk om a, khuampeek khat bulah bullen nih ciat a om hi.
Amaute in singkha singzawl, biakbuk pang khat-a khuampeekte-a' dingin nga,
biakbuk a pang langkhat a khuampeekte a dingin zawl nga, nitumna lam biakbuk nung lampang a khuampeekte a dingin zawl nga mah a bawl uh hi.
A khuampeekte' kimciang takah mong khat panin mong khat dongin a zawl laita paisuaksak uh hi.
Amaute in kham tawh khuampeekte zutin, zawlte a len dingin kham tawh a kualte bawl uh a, kham tawh a zawlte a zut uh hi.
Amaute in a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoih tawh dalna puan a bawl uh hi. Hoihtakin a kibawl kherub-te tawh amaute in tua dalna puan a zem uh hi.
Tua puan a dingin amaute in singkha khuampi li bawl uh a, kham tawh tua khuampite a zut uh hi. A vankhainate pen kham hi a, tua khuamte a dingin ngun bullen li a sung uh hi.
Amaute in puanbuk kongkhak-a dingin a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le phim tawh kikhui-in a kizem, a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoih tawh kongpuankhai khat le,
a khuampi ngate a vankhainate tawh a bawl uh hi. Amaute in tuate' luzepnate kham tawh zutin, a gaknate kham hi a, ahih hangin a bullen ngate pen sumngo ahi hi.
Bezalel in singkha sing tawh singkuang bawl a, a dung pi thum le letmat kua, a vai pi nih le letmat thum, a sanna pi nih le letmat thum mah ahi hi.
Kham citak tawh a sung le a pua zutin, a kimkotah kham geihual khat a bawl hi.
A kiu lite a dingin kham kual li, a pang khatah kual nih, a pang langkhat a dingin kual nih mah a sung hi.
Singkha singzawlte zong bawl a, kham tawh tuate zutin,
singkuang puak nadingin singkuang panga kualte sungah a zawlte a khum hi.
Kham citak tawh hehpihna tokhom khat bawl a, a dung pi thum le letmat kua, a vai pi nih le letmat thum ahi hi.
Amah in sek tawh a kiseek kham tawh kherub nih, hehpihna tokhom mong tuakah a bawl hi.
Kherub khat mong khatah, kherub khat a mong langkhatah om a, a mong nihte-ah hehpihna tokhom tawh sakhatin kherub-te a bawl hi.
Kherub-te in a khate uh tua tokhom tungah zalin, amau' khate tawh hehpihna tokhom liimsun uh a, amaute khatlekhat kimaingat uh hi. Hehpihna tokhom lamah kherub-te' mai a nga hi.
Amah in singkha sing tawh sabuai zong bawl a, a dung pi thum, a vai pi khat le alang, a sanna pi nih le letmat thum ahi hi.
Kham citak tawh zut a, a kimkotah kham tawh a geihual khat a bawl hi.
Khut peek cia a pha zawl khat a kimkotah bawl a, a zawl kimkotah kham geihual khat a bawl hi.
Tua sabuai a dingin kham kual li sungin, a kiu li, a khe lite-ah a kualte a gak hi.
Sabuai puak nadingin singkha singzawlte bawl a, kham tawh tuate a zut hi.
Amah in sabuai tunga om ding beellekuangte, paknamtui a dingin kuangdaite le pakante, tui buah nadingin kuang-ukte le thawl gongbakte, kham citak tawh a bawl hi.
Amah in kham citak tawh meivakkhuam zong a bawl hi. Meivakkhuam a bul le a kungte pen a kiseek nate tawh kibawl hi. A haite, a nunte, le a paakte, meivakkhuam tawh sakhat ahi hi.
A pangte panin hiang guk meengkhia a, a pang khatah meivakkhuam hiang thum omin, a pang langkhatah meivakkhuam hiang thum mah a om hi.
Hiang khat tungah a nun le a pak a om, almond gah tawh a kibang hai thum, le adang hiang khat ciat tungah a nun le a pak a om, almond gah tawh a kibang hai thum mah kibawl hi. Tua ahih ciangin meivakkhuam panin a hiang gukte a meengkhia ahi hi.
A meivakkhuam tung mahmahah a nun le a pak tawh a om, almond gah bangin a kibawl hai li omin,
meivakkhuam panin hiang guk a kopte' bulah tua tawh sakhat ahi nun khat om hi.
Amau' nunte le a hiangte pen tua tawh sakhat hi a, a buppi-in kham citak a kiseek sakhat ahi hi.
A meivak sagihte le a taitehte le a kuangte kham citak a bawl ahi hi.
Amah in kham citak tawi sawmnih le tawi khat a gik tawh tua meivakkhuam le a nazatte khempeuh a bawl hi.
Amah in singkha sing tawh paknamtui biakna tau bawl a, a dung pi khat le alang, a vai pi khat le alang mah ahi hi. Tua pen a ning kikim a, a sanna pi thum hi a, a kite pen tua biakna tau tawh sakhat ahi hi.
Amah in a tungzang, a kimkota a pangte le a kite kham citak tawh a zut hi. A kimkotah kham geihual khat
le a puak nading zawlte a len dingin a pang tuak a geihual nuai takah kham kual nih a bawl hi.
Amah in singkha sing tawh a zawlte bawlin, kham tawh tuate a zut hi.
Amah in paknamtui bawlte' gawm bangin a siangtho nilh sathau le a siangtho a namtui paknamtui zong a bawl hi.
Amah in meihal biakna tau zong singkha sing tawh bawl a, a dung pi sagih le alang, a vai pi sagih le alang mah ahi hi. A ning kikim a, a sanna pi li le alang ahi hi.
Amah in tua tau a dingin a kiu lite-ah a kite a bawl hi. A kite, a tau tawh sakhat hi a, sumngo tawh a zut hi.
Biakna tau nazat khempeuh, beelte, kawbiate, kuangte, sikkate le vutluahna peekte a bawl hi. A nazat khempeuh sumngo tawh a bawl hi.
Biakna tau a dingin a zawl nuai-ah, a kimciang a ban suk, a vang simsiam, sumngo siklen khat a bawl hi.
A zawlte a len dingin sumngo siklen kiu lite' tunga ding a kual li a sung hi.
Singkha sing tawh a zawlte bawl a, sumngo tawh tuate a zut hi.
A puak nadingin biakna tau pangte a om a kualte sungah a zawlte khum a, singpekte tawh biakna tau a kuakin a bawl hi.
Amah in kikhopna buk kongkhakah na a sem numeite' limlangte panin sumngo tawh kisilna kuang le a ngakna a bawl hi.
Amah in buktual a bawl hi. Leitaw lampang buktual a puan kikhaite pen a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoih hi a, pi za le pi sawmnga a sau hi.
A khuampite sawmnih hi a, a bullente zong sawmnih mah ahi hi. Sumngo tawh kibawl a, ahih hangin a vankhainate le a gaknate ngun ahi hi.
Leilu lampang a ding zong tua bangmah ahi hi.
Nitumna lampang a dingin puan kikhai sukte pi sawmsagih le pi nga hi a, a khuampite sawm hi-in, a bullente sawm mah hi a, a vankhainate le a gaknate ngun ahi hi.
A mailam, nisuahna lama dingin pi sawmsagih le pi nga mah ahi hi.
Kongpi pang khat-a ding puan kikhai sukte pen pi sawmnih le nih le alang hi a, khuampi thum le bullen thum tawh ahi hi.
A pang langkhat ading zong tua bangmah ahi hi. Buktual kongpi hih lam le hua lamah khuampi thum le bullen thum tawh a puan khaisukte pi sawmnih le nih le alang ahi hi.
Buktual kimkota puan kikhai sukte khempeuh pen a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoih ahi hi.
Khuampite a' ding a bullente pen sumngo hi a, ahih hangin a vankhainate le a gaknate ngun ahi hi. A khuamluzepnate a kizutna zong ngun hi a, buktual a khuamte khempeuh ngun kibawl gakna tawh kigak hi.
Buktual kongpi puankhai pen a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte phim tawh kikhui-in a kizem ahi hi. Buktual a kikhai sukte tawh kizui-in pi sawmthum sau-in, a vailam pi sagih le alang sang hi.
A khuampite li hi a, a bullen lite sumngo hi a, a vankhainate ngun hi a, a khuamluzepnate le a gaknate a kizutna ngun mah ahi hi.
Biakbuk le buktual kimkota ding khetphimte khempeuh sumngo ahi hi.
Hihte pen siampi Aaron' tapa Ithamar' vaihawmna nuai-ah Levi mite' sep ding Topa' omna ahi biakbuk-a dingin Moses' thupiakna tawh a kisim van malte ahi hi.
Judah minam Hur' tapa ahi Uri' tapa Bezalel in Topa in Moses a thupiak khempeuh a bawl hi.
A khut siam, a geel siam, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte a zem, Dan minam, Ahisamak' tapa Oholiab in zong amah a huh hi.
Nasep nadinga a kizang kham khempeuh, biakbuk lamna-a a kizang, a kipia khamte, biakinn shekel-in talen sawmnih le kua le shekel zasagih sawmthum ahi hi.
Mi simna sungah a kihel mihonte tung panin a kingah ngunte, biakinn shekel-in talen zakhat le shekel tulkhat zasagih sawmsagih le nga ahi hi.
Mi khat ciangin beka khat (biakinn shekel-in shekel lang) pai pia a, a pia mi, kum sawmnih a pha panin a tungsiah mi kisimna a a kisim peuhmah tul zaguk le tulthum le zanga le sawmnga ahi hi.
Ngun talen za khatte pen biakbuk khuam bullente le dalna puan khuam bullente dingin sun' ding ahi hi. Talen za khatte bullen zakhat, bullen khat ciangin talen khat ahi hi.
Amah in shekel tulkhat zasagih sawmsagih le nga pen khuampi tunga vankhai nadingin bawl a, a khuamluzepnate zutin tuate a' ding gakna a bawl hi.
A kipia sumngo khempeuh, talen sawmsagih le shekel tulnih le zali ahi hi.
Amah in tua tawh kikhopna buk kongkhakte a dingin khuam bullente, sumngo biakna tau le a sumngo siklen le biaknatau nazat khempeuh,
buktual kimkota khuam bullente, buktual kongpi khuam bullente, biakbuk khetphimte khempeuh le buktual kimkota khetphim khempeuh a bawl hi.
Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin, siangtho munah nasep nadingin amaute in a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute tawh limtakin a kigan puan a bawl uh hi. Amaute in Aaron a dingin biakna puan siangtho a bawl uh hi.
Amaute in siampipuan pen kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte tawh a bawl uh hi.
Hoihtakin a kigeel, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte-ah zat dingin kham peek kiseekin khau-in kizen hi.
Amaute in siampipuan a dingin liangkaih puan bawl uh a, a mong nih tegel ah zom uh hi.
Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin, amah a gak dingin hoihtakin a kigan tua tunga puan om pen kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte tawh kibawlin, a nate le a sepna zia a kibang ahi hi.
Israel tapate a phazah tawh kizui-in, onik suangte kitat a, kham tawh a kizepna sungah a minte kigelhin, min gelh siamte' gelh bangin kibawl hi.
Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin Israel tapate phawkna suang dingin siampipuan' liangkaih puan tungah a bulh uh hi.
Amaute in kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte tawh, siampipuan a kibawl puan bangin hoihtakin awmdal a bawl uh hi.
Tua awmdal a ning kikim a, thuap nihin kibawl a, a kikhep ciangin a dung letmat kua, a vai letmat kua mah a pha hi.
Amaute in tua sungah suang gual li bulh uh a, Sardis suang, topaz suang, le karbankal suang gual khat pen a gual masa ahi hi.
A gual nihna-ah emerald suang, sapfaia suang, le diamond suang ahi hi.
A gual thumna-ah jakinth suang, agate suang, le amethyst suang ahi hi.
A gual lina-ah beryl suang, onik suang, le jasper suang ahi hi. Kham tawh zepna sungah tua suangte khempeuh kikoih hi.
Israel tapate a phazah tawh kituakin amaute' min a kigelhna suang sawm le nih om hi. Tua min gelhnate pen minam sawm le nih a huamin a kigelh ahi hi.
Amaute in awmdal tungah khau tawh a kibang, a kihual kham citak khainiang a bawl uh hi.
Kham tawh a kibawl zepna nih le kham kual nih bawl uh a, awmdal mong nihte-ah kham kual nihte a koih uh hi.
Amaute in awmdal mongte-ah a om kual nihte pen kham khau nihte tawh a khih uh hi.
Amaute in zepna nihte tungah khau mong nihte zom uh a, tua bangin amaute in siampipuan' liangkaih puan tung a mai lamah a bulh uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in kham kual nih bawl uh a, siampipuan tawh a kizom a sunglam nawl, awmdal mong nihte-ah a bulh uh hi.
Amaute in kham kual nih bawl uh a, siampipuan' liangkaih puan nihte' nuai a mailam, hoihtakin a kigan siampipuante' puankhau a kizopna tung takah a bulh uh hi.
Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin, hoihtakin a kigan siampipuan khau tungah a om theih nading le siampipuan tung panin awmdal a kol theih loh nadingin amaute in siampipuan' kualte-ah khau dum khatin a kualte tawh awmdal a gak uh hi.
Amaute in khau dum bek tawh a kigan siampi puantualpi zong a bawl uh hi.
A kikeek loh nadingin puantualpi ngawng pen puan ngawng vang bangin a ngawng kimkotah a zimna om hi.
Puantualpi mongte-ah amaute in a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoih tawh mang kawlsing gahte a bawl uh hi.
Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin, amaute in kham citak siklongte zong bawl uh a, puantualpi mong kimkot tunga mang kawlsing gahte' kikalah siklongte a koih uh hi.
Biak nasep nadinga puantualpi mong kimkot tungah siklong khat, mang kawlsing gah khat, siklong khat, mang kawlsing gah khat, cih bangin kihelh hi.
Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin, amaute in Aaron le a tapate a dingin khau hoih tawh a kigan puantungsilhte
le khau hoih tawh a kigan dialpi le khau hoih tawh a kigan lukhute, a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte tawh a kibawl pheituam hoihte,
le a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte tawh a kibawl puan kawnggak le phim tawh kikhui-in a kizem a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul puante zong a bawl uh hi.
Amaute in kham citak tawh a siangtho kizepna peek khat bawl uh a, min gelhna a kibawl mah bangin tua tungah thu gelhin, " Topa' tungah siangtho," ci uh hi.
Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin, amaute in a tunga dialpi tungah a gak dingin tua tungah khau dum khat a vawh uh hi.
Tua bangin kikhopna buk ahi biakbuk nasep khempeuh kiman hi. Topa in Moses a thupiaksa khempeuh bangin Israel mite in sem khin uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute man khin uh hi.
Amaute in biakbuk, a puanbuk le a nazat khempeuh, a vankhainate, khuampeekte, a zawlte, a khuampite le a bullente;
a kisansak tuutal vunte le savun dangte tawh a kibawl khuhna le kong puankhai dalna puan;
thuciamna singkuang, a zawlte le hehpihna tokhom tawh;
sabuai le a nazat khempeuhte le Ompihna Anlum;
kham citak meivakkhuam le meivak a kibulhsa tawh a meivakte le a nazatte khempeuh le meivak a ding sathau;
kham biakna tau, nilh sathau le a namtui paknamtui le puanbuk kongkhak-a ding kongpuankhai;
sumngo biakna tau le a sumngo siklen, a zawlte le a nazat khempeuh; kisilna kuang le a ngakna;
buktual a puan kikhaite, a khuampite, a bullente le buktual kongpi-a ding kongpuankhai, a khaute le a khetphimte; le kikhopna buk ahi biakbuk nasepna-ah a nazat khempeuh;
siampi nasep nadingin siangtho mun a zat ding hoihtakin a kibawl puante, siampi Aaron a' ding biakna puan siangthote le ama tapate' puante, Moses kiangah a paipih uh hi.
Moses in nasep khempeuh vel a, amaute in Topa' thupiaksa bangin a bawl khitna a mu hi. Tua ciangin Moses in amaute thupha a pia hi.
Tua buk sungah thuciamna singkuang na koih ding a, dalna puan tawh singkuang na dal ding hi.
Tua ciangin sabuai tumpihin a om ding bangin na koih ding hi. Meivakkhuam zong tumpihin a meivakte na bulh ding hi.
Thuciamna singkuang mai-ah paknamtui hal nadingin kham biakna tau na koih ding a, biakbuk kongkhak dingin kongpuankhai na khai ding hi.
Kikhopna buk ahi biakbuk kongkhak mai-ah meihal biakna tau koihin,
kikhopna buk le biakna tau kikalah kisilna kuang na koih ding a, a sungah tui zong na koih ding hi.
A kimkotah buktual na bawl ding a, buktual kongpi dingin kongpuankhai na khaito ding hi.
"Tua ciangin sathau la-in, biakbuk le a sunga om khempeuh na nuh ding a, biakbuk le a inn sungvan khempeuh na ap ding hi. Tua ciangin a siangtho biakna van a suak ding hi.
Nangmah in meihal biakna tau le a nazat khempeuh zong sathau nuhin biakna tau na ap ding a, tua biakna tau a siangtho pen hi ding hi.
Kisilna kuang le a ngakna zong sathau nuhin na ap ding hi.
"Tua ciangin kikhopna buk kongkhakah Aaron le ama tapate paipihin, tui tawh amaute na sil ding a,
amah in keima tungah siampi na a sep theih nadingin puan siangthote Aaron silhsakin, amah sathau nilhin na ap ding hi.
Tua ciangin ama tapate zong paipihin puantungsilhte na silhsak ding a,
amaute in keima tungah siampi na a sep theih nadingun amaute' pa sathau na nilh bangin amaute zong sathau na nilh ding hi. Amau' sathau kinilhna in amau' khang tawntungin siampi hi paisuaksak ding hi," a ci hi.
Moses in zong Topa in amah a thupiaksa khempeuh tawh kituakin a hih hi.
A kum nihna a kha masa, a ni masa ni-in biakbuk kilam hi.
Moses in biakbuk lam hi. Amah in a bullente koihin, a khuampeekte phut a, a zawlte khumin, a khuampite a phut hi.
Biakbuk tungah a tungkhuhna zal a, Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin puanbuk a tung a khuh hi.
Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin amah in thuciamna suangpek la-in singkuang sungah koih a, singkuang tungah a zawlte koihin, singkuang tung sanah hehpihna tokhom a nga hi.
Biakbuk sungah singkuang paipihin, kongpuankhai dalna puan khai a, thuciamna singkuang a dal hi.
Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin, amah in biakbuk leilu lam pang, dalna puan pualam, kikhopna buk sungah sabuai koih a,
Topa' mai tua sabuai tungah a om ding bangin anlum a koih hi.
Topa' mai-ah meivakte a koih hi.
tua tungah a namtui paknamtui a hal hi.
Amah in biakbuk kongkhak ding kongpuankhai a mun dingah a khai hi.
Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin amah in kikhopna buk ahi biakbuk kongkhakah meihal biakna tau koih a, tua tungah meihal biakna le an tawh biakna a pia hi.
Kikhopna buk le biakna tau kikalah kisilna kuang koih a, tua sungah kisil nading tui zong a koih hi.
Moses le Aaron le a tapate in amau' khut le a khete uh tua tui tawh a sil uh hi.
Topa in Moses a thupiaksa bangin, kikhopna bukah amaute a pai ciang le biakna tau nai-ah a pai uh ciangin amaute kisil uh hi.
Amah in biakbuk le biakna tau kiimah a buktual bawl a, buktual kongpi kongpuankhai a khai hi. Tua ahih ciangin Moses in a nasep a man ta hi.
Tua ciangin meii in kikhopna buk tuam a, biakbuk sungah Topa' minthanna vang a dim hi.
Tua ahih manin kikhopna buk sungah Moses tum thei lo hi.
A khualzin sung tawntung uh biakbuk tung panin meii a kilakkhiat toh peuhpeuh ciangin Israel mite mailam nawtin pai uh a,
Bang hang hiam cih leh a khualzin sung tawntung uh Israel mi khempeuh' muhna-ah biakbuk tungah sunin Topa' meii om a, zanin mei a om hi.
Topa in Moses sam a, kikhopna buk panin amah hopihin hih bangin ci hi:
"Israel mite tungah gen inla, amaute tungah hih bangin ci in: Note khatpeuh in Topa' tungah biakna na paipih uh ciangin, ganhing tawh na biakna pen bawnghon panin hitaleh tuuhon panin hitaleh na paipih ding uh hi.
"Ama biakna pen bawnghon panin meihal biakna ahihleh, amah in a sitbaang lo a pa khat pia ding a, Topa' mai-ah a kisan' theih nadingin kikhopna bukkongah pia ding hi.
Amah in meihal biakna ganhing lu tungah a khut nga ding a, ama a dingin kilemna bawl nadingin kisang ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Topa' mai-ah a bawngtal go ding hi. Aaron' suan siampite in a si hong paipihin, kikhopna buk kong-a biakna tau kimkotah a si theh ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in meihal biakna ganhing a vun hawkin semnen ding a,
Aaron' suan siampite in biakna tau tungah mei koihin, mei tungah a ngeina bangin sing koih ding hi.
Tua ciangin Aaron' suan siampite in a sanente, a lutang le a thaute, biakna tau tunga om mei tunga sing tungah a ngeina bangin koih ding a,
ahih hangin a sungkuate le a khete tui tawh sil ding hi. Tua ciangin siampipa in mei tawh kihal biakna, Topa a dingin a gim namtui, meihal biakna-in biakna tau tungah a vekpi-in hal ding hi.
"Meihal biak nadingin ama letsong pen tuu hitaleh keel hitaleh a hon lak panin ahihleh, amah in a sitbaang lo a pa khat pia ding hi.
Amah in Topa' mai biakna tau tung leilu lampangah go ding a, Aaron' suan siampite in biakna tau tung kimkotah a si theh ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in semnen ding a, biakna tau tunga om mei tunga sing tungah a ngeina bangin siampipa in a lutang le a thau tawh koih khawm ding a,
ahih hangin a sungkuate le a khete amah in tui tawh sil ding hi. Siampipa in a vekpi-in pia-in, biakna tau tungah hal ding hi. Tua pen Topa a dingin a gim namtui, mei tawh kihal biakna, meihal biakpiakna ahi hi.
" Topa' tungah ama biakna pen vasa tawh meihal biakna ahihleh, amah in vakhu tawh ahi zongin, kawl vakhuno tawh ahi zongin, a biakna hong paipih ding hi.
Tua ciangin siampipa in biakna tau-ah paipihin a lu heektat ding a, biakna tau tungah hal ding hi. Biakna tau pangah a si taakkhiasak ding hi.
Amah in a tangkhai le a multe bot khia-in, vut koihna, biakna tau pang nisuahna lamah lawnkhia ding hi.
Amah in a khate-in balkek ding a, ahih hangin baltat lo ding hi. Tua ciangin siampipa in mei tunga om sing tung, biakna tau tungah hal ding hi. Tua pen Topa a dingin a gim namtui, mei tawh kihal biakna, meihal biakna ahi hi.
"Mi khatpeuh in Topa' tungah an tawh biakna hong paipih le, ama biakpiakna pen annel hi ding hi. Amah in tua annel tungah sathau sungin, paknamtui koihin,
tua ciangin Aaron' suan siampite kiangah paipih ding hi. Tua ciangin siampipa in annel khutdim le sathau, a paknamtui khempeuh tawh la ding a, siampipa in hih pen Topa a dingin a gim namtui, mei tawh biakna, phawkna-in biakna tau tungah hal ding hi.
An tawh biakna a valteng pen Aaron le a tapate a' ding hi ding hi. Tua pen Topa' tungah mei tawh biakna sung panin a siangtho pen ahi hi.
"Nangmah in biak nadingin meibung sunga ki-em an tawh biakna na paipih ciangin, silngo sawh loh, sathau tawh a kizut mohpheng hi ding hi.
"Na biakna pen beelpei daii tunga ki-em an tawh biakna ahihleh, sathau tawh a kibawl annel hi ding hi.
Balnenin a tungah sathau na sung ding hi. Tua pen an tawh biakna ahi hi.
"Na biakna pen sikbeel daii sunga kihuan an tawh biakna ahihleh, sathau tawh a kibawl annel hi ding hi.
Nangmah in hih nate tawh a kibawl an tawh biakna, Topa' kiangah na paipih ding a, siampipa kiangah a kipaipih ciangin amah in biakna tau-ah paipih ding hi.
Siampipa in an tawh biakna panin a phawkna biakna teng la-in, Topa' tungah a gim namtui, mei tawh biakna-in biakna tau tungah hal ding hi.
An tawh biakna a valteng pen Aaron le a tapate a' ding hi ding hi. Tua pen Topa' tungah mei tawh biakna sung panin a siangthopen ahi hi.
" Topa' tungah na paipih an tawh biakna pen silngo tawh kibawl lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh silngo hitaleh khuaizu hitaleh khat peuhpeuh Topa' tungah meihal biakna-in na hal kei ding hi.
Anpal tawh biakna ahihleh Topa' kiangah na paipih thei ding hi. Ahih hangin a gim namtui dingin biakna tau tungah kipia lo ding hi.
An tawh na biaknate khempeuh ci na sawh ding hi. An tawh na biakna-ah na Pasian tawh na thuciamna ci sawh loin na om kei ding a, na biakna khempeuh ci na sawh ding hi.
"Anpal tawh Topa' tungah biakna na piak leh, anpal tawh na biak nadingin a vui thak panin kila-in a kigawivui, mei-ah a kihangkeu na pia ding hi.
Nang in a tungah sathau sungin, paknamtui na buak ding hi. Tua pen an tawh biakna ahi hi.
Siampipa in phawk nadingin a kigawivui an pawlkhat le a sathau leh a paknamtui khempeuh hal ding hi. Tua pen Topa' tungah meihal biakna ahi hi.
"Mi khat' biakna pen thunuama biakna ahih a, amah in a nu hitaleh a pa hitaleh bawnghon lak panin a piak leh, amah in Topa' mai-ah a sitbaang lo pia ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a biakna ganhing lu tungah a khut nga-in kikhopna buk kongah go ding a, tua ciangin Aaron' suan siampite in biakna tau kimkot tungah a si theh ding uh hi.
Thunuama biakna panin Topa' tungah mei tawh biakna-in a gilpi tuam a thaute le a sungkuate' tunga a om a thau khempeuh tawh,
a kawnga om a kal nihte a thau le a kalte tawh a lakkhiat khop ding ahi a sintuamte pia ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Aaron' suante in mei tunga om sing tunga meihal biakpiakna tau tung mahah hal ding uh hi. Tua pen Topa a dingin a gim namtui, mei tawh kihal biakna ahi hi.
" Topa' tungah thunuama a piak ding ama biakna pen tuu le keel honte sung panin a nu hitaleh a pa hitaleh ganhing khat ahihleh, amah in a sitbaang lo pia ding hi.
Amah in biak nadingin tuuno khat a piak leh, Topa' mai-ah pia ding a,
a biakna ganhing lu tungah a khut nga-in kikhopna buk mai-ah go ding hi. Tua ciangin Aaron' suante in biakna tau kimkot tungah a si theh ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin thunuama biakna panin Topa' tungah meihal biakna-in a thau, a nungguh ciangah a ki-attan a mei thau buppi le a gilpi tuam a thaute le a sungkuate tunga om a thau khempeuh tawh,
a kawnga om a kal nihte a thau tawh, a kalte tawh a lakkhiat khop ding ahi a sintuamte pia ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin siampipa in Topa' tungah mei tawh kihal an tawh biakna-in biakna tau tungah hal ding hi.
"Ama biakna keel ahihleh, amah in Topa' mai-ah pia ding a,
a lu tungah a khut nga-in kikhopna buk mai-ah go ding hi. Tua ciangin Aaron' suante in biakna tau kimkot tungah a si theh ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' tungah mei tawh kihal biakna-in piak dingin a gilpi tuam a thau le a sungkuate tunga om a thau khempeuh tawh,
Tua ciangin siampipa in a gim namtui dingin mei tawh kihal an tawh biakna-in biakna tau tungah hal ding hi. A thau khempeuh Topa -a' ahi hi.
Tua pen na khang tawntungun na tenna khempeuh uhah note in a thau le sisan na nek loh nadingun a tawntungin ngeina kip hi ding hi," a ci hi.
"Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Hih lo ding ci-in Topa in a thupiakte khat peuhpeuh, mi khatpeuh in theih lohna hangin khial a, tuate khatpeuh a hihkhak leh,
a khial pa pen sathau a kinilh siampipa ahih a, mite tungah tua bangin mawhna hong tut leh, ama gamtatnasa a khialhna hangin a sitbaang lo bawngtalno khat Topa' mai-ah khialhna hanga biakna-in amah piasak un.
Amah in Topa' mai kikhopna buk kongah a bawngtal paipihin, bawngtal lu tungah a khut nga ding a, Topa' mai-ah a bawngtal go ding hi.
Tua ciangin sathau a kinilh siampipa in a bawngtal si tawmkhat la-in, kikhopna bukah paipih ding hi.
Tua ciangin siampipa in a si sungah a khutme diahin, biakbuk dalna puan mai Topa' mai-ah a si kimkhat sagih vei theh ding hi.
Tua ciangin siampipa in kikhopna buk sung Topa' mai-a om paknamtui biakna tau kite a si kimkhat nuhin, kikhopna bukkongah a om meihal biakna tau bulah bawngtal si a omlai teng sungkhia ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in khialhna hanga biakna bawngtal thau khempeuh a gilpi tuam a thau le a sungkuate tunga om a thau khempeuh tawh,
a kawnga om a kal nihte a thau tawh, a kalte tawh a lakkhiat khop ding a sintuamte
(thunuama biakna bawngtal panin hihte a kilak mah bangin) la ding a, siampipa in meihal biakna tau tungah tuate hal ding hi.
Ahih hangin bawngtal vun le a sa khempeuh, a lutang, a khete, a sungkuate, le a ek tawh,
a bawngtal buppi puakhia-in vut kibuakna, giahphual pualam mun siangtho khatah sing a kicih mei tungah amah in hal ding a, vut a kibuakna munah kihal ding hi.
"Israel mihonte khempeuh in theih lohna hangin khialhna khat gamta-in tua pen mihonte in a phawk kei a, hih lo ding, ci-in Topa in a thupiakte khat peuhpeuh amaute in hihin a mawh uhleh,
amau' gamtatnasa khialhna a kitheih ciangin, khialhna hanga biak nadingin mihonte in bawngtalno khat pia-in kikhopna buk mai-ah paipih ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin mihonte' upate in Topa' mai, bawngtal lu tungah amau' khut nga ding uh a, Topa' mai-ah tua bawngtal kigo ding hi.
Tua ciangin sathau a kinilh siampipa in kikhopna bukah bawngtal si kimkhat paipih ding a,
a si sungah a khutme diahin dalna puan mai Topa' mai-ah sagih vei theh ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Topa' mai kikhopna buk sunga om biakna tau kite tungah a si kimkhat zut ding a, kikhopna bukkongah a om biakna tau bulah si a omlai teng sung ding hi.
Tua bangin a bawngtal hih ding hi. Amah in khialhna hanga biakna bawngtal a hihsa mah bangin hih zong hih ding hi. Siampipa in amau a' dingin kilemna bawlsak ding a, amaute kimaisak ding hi.
Amah in giahphual pua-ah bawngtal puakhia ding a, a masa bawngtal a hal mah bangin a hal ding hi. Tua pen mihonpi a dingin khialhna hanga biakna ahi hi.
"Ukpa khat khialin, hih lo ding, ci-in Topa ama Pasian in a thupiakte khempeuh lakah khat peuhpeuh theih lohna hangin hihkha-in a mawh ciangin,
ama gamtatnasa khialhna ama tungah a va kihilh leh, amah in biakna-in a sitbaang lo keel pa khat paipih ding a,
keel lu tungah a khut nga-in, Topa' mai, meihal biakna a kigawh nading munah go ding hi. Tua pen khialhna hanga biakna ahi hi.
Tua ciangin siampipa in a khutme tawh khialhna hanga biakna si tawm la-in meihal biakna tau kite nuhin meihal biakna tau bulah a si omlai teng sung ding hi.
Thunuama biakna sathaute mah bangin amah in biakna tau tungah a thau khempeuh hal ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin siampipa in ama khialhna hangin kilemna bawlsak ding a, amah kimaisak ding hi.
"Hih lo ding, ci-in Topa' thupiakte khat peuhpeuh mi mawkmawk khat in theih lohna hangin hihin a khialh a, a mawh leh,
ama gamtatnasa a khialhna ama tungah a kihilh ciangin amah in a gamtatnasa a khialhna hangin biak nading a sitbaang lo keel a nu khat paipih ding hi.
Amah in a khialhna hanga biakna ganhing lu tungah a khut nga-in, meihal biakna munah khialhna hanga biakna go ding hi.
Siampipa in a khutme tawh si tawm la-in meihal biakna tau kite nuh ding a, biakna tau bulah si a omlai teng sung ding hi.
Thunuama biakna panin a thaute a kilakkhiat mah bangin amah in a thau khempeuh lakhia ding a, Topa a' ding a gim namtui dingin siampipa in biakna tau tungah hal ding hi. Siampipa in ama a dingin kilemna bawlsak ding a, amah kimaisak ding hi.
"Amah in khialhna hanga biakna-in a piak dingin tuuno khat a paipih leh, a sitbaang lo a nu khat hi ding a,
khialhna hanga biakna ganhing lu tungah a khut nga-in, meihal biakna a kigawhna munah khialhna hanga biak nadingin go ding hi.
Tua ciangin siampipa in khialhna hanga biakna si tawmkhat a khutme tawh la-in meihal biakna tau kite nuh ding a, biakna tau bulah a si omlai teng sung ding hi.
Thunuama biakpiakna panin tuuno thau a kilak khiat mah bangin amah in a thau khempeuh lakhia ding a, Topa' tungah mei tawh kihal biakna, biakna tau tungah siampipa in hal ding hi. Siampipa in ama gamtatnasa a khialhna hangin kilemna bawlsak ding a, amah kimaisak ding hi.
"Mi khatpeuh teci pang dingin a kisap ciangin a muhsa a theihsa thute gen loin a ip leh, amah in tua mawhna pua ding hi.
"Tua ahih kei leh mi khatpeuh in gamlak ganhing nin a sisa hitaleh inn ganhing nin a sisa hitaleh a bokvak a nin ganhing a sisa hitaleh, a muh lohin a nin khat peuhpeuh lawngkha-in amah a nin a suah leh, a mawh hi ding hi.
"Tua ahih kei leh amah in mihing nitna hitaleh, mu loin a lawnkhak leh, a theih ciangin a mawh hi ding hi.
"Tua ahih kei leh mi khatpeuh in a sia bawl ding hitaleh a pha bawl ding hitaleh mite a kiciam theih ngei kiciamna nam khat peuhpeuh ama kam tawh a theih lohin a kiciampak khak leh, a theih ciangin hihte khat peuhpeuhah a mawh hi ding hi.
"Hihte khat peuhpeuhah mi khat a mawh ciangin, amah in a gamtatnasa a khialhna pulak ding a,
mawhna hanga biakna-in tuuhon pan ahi a, keelhon pan ahi zongin a nu khat peuhpeuh tuu hitaleh keel hitaleh, a gamtatnasa a khialhna hangin Topa' tungah biakna paipih ding a, siampipa in a khialhna hangin kilemna bawlsak ding hi.
"Ahih hangin amah in tuuno khat a piak zawh kei leh a gamtatnasa a khialhna hangin Topa' tungah biakna-in vakhu nih ahi a, kawl vakhuno nih ahi zongin, khat khialhna hanga biakna, a khat meihal biak nadingin paipih ding hi.
Amah in siampipa tungah tuate paipih ding a, siampipa in khialhna hanga biak nading pen pia masa ding hi. Amah in a ngawng panin a lu heek ding a, ahih hangin heeksat lo ding hi.
Amah in khialhna hanga biakna si tawmkhat biakna tau pangah theh ding a, biakna tau bulah a si omlai teng taaksak ding hi. Tua pen khialhna hanga biakna ahi hi.
Tua ciangin amah in ngeina kip om bangin meihal biak nadingin a khat pia ding hi. Siampipa in a gamtatnasa a khialhna hangin kilemna bawlsak ding a, amah kimaisak ding hi.
"Ahih hangin amah in vakhu nih ahi a, kawl vakhuno nih ahi zongin a piak zawh kei leh, amah in a gamtatnasa a khialhna hangin a biakna-in annel lawh khat, khialhna hanga biak nadingin paipih ding hi. Tua pen khialhna hanga biakna ahih manin amah in tua sungah sathau khah lo ding a, paknamtui zong hel lo ding hi.
Amah in siampipa kiangah paipih ding a, siampipa in phawkna-in khutdim khat la-in Topa' tungah mei tawh kihal biakna, biakna tau tungah hal ding hi. Tua pen khialhna hanga biakna ahi hi.
Tua bangin siampipa in hihte khat peuhpeuh a gamtatnasa a khialhna hangin kilemna bawlsak ding a, amah kimaisak ding hi. An tawh biakna-a mah bangin a omlai teng siampipa a' ding ahi hi," a ci hi.
"Mi khatpeuh in theih lohna hangin thu palsatin Topa' na a siangtho khat peuhpeuhah a khialh leh, a mawhna hanga biakna-in tuuhon sung panin a sitbaang lo tuutal khat, biakinn shekel tawh kizui-in ngun shekel-in nangmah in a man sehin, amah in Topa' kiangah paipih ding hi. Tua pen mawhna hanga biakna ahi hi.
Amah in a siangtho na a hih khialhna-ah lohkikna zong bawl ding a, seh nga-ah khat gawm behin siampipa tungah pia ding hi. Siampipa in mawhna hanga biakna tuutal tawh ama a dingin kilemna bawlsak ding a, amah kimaisak ding hi.
"Hih lo ding, ci-in Topa' thupiakte khat peuhpeuh, mi khatpeuh in hihin a khialh leh, a theih lohna hang hitaleh zong, amah a mawh hi veve-in, ama mawhna mah pua ding hi.
Tuuhon lak pan a sitbaang lo tuutal khat, a manzah ding nangmah in seh inla, amah in mawhna hanga biak nadingin siampipa kiangah paipih ding hi. Theihlohna hanga ama gamtatnasa khialhna hangin siampipa in ama a' ding kilemna bawlsak ding a, amah kimaisak ding hi.
Tua pen Topa' tungah khial ahih manin mawhna hanga biakna ahi hi," a ci hi.
"Mi khatpeuh khialin, Topa' thu palsatin, na kepsakna thu-ah ahi zongin, khapna nate' thu-ah ahi zongin a vengpa khemin, ahih kei leh a na sutin, a vengpa nengniamin,
tua ahih kei leh a mang na khat mu-in tua thu-ah zuau-in a man loin kiciam a, mite a khialh theih ngeina khat peuhpeuhah
khialin a mawh ciangin amah in a suhte hitaleh, a netniamna tawh a ngahte hitaleh, amah a kikemsak na hitaleh, a mang na a muh hitaleh,
a man loin a kiciamnasa na khat peuhpeuh hitaleh loh ding hi. Amah in a cingin lohin seh nga-ah khat piak beh ding a, a mawhna hanga biakna a piak ni-in a nei pa tungah pia ding hi.
Tua ciangin a mawhna hanga a biak nading, tuuhon lak pan a sitbaang lo tuutal khat, Topa' tungah a piak ding, a man ding nangma sehzah, amah in siampipa kiangah paipih ding hi.
Siampipa in Topa' mai-ah ama a' ding kilemna bawlsak ding a, mi khat a mawh theih ngeina khat peuhpeuhte-ah amah kimaisak ding hi," a ci hi.
"Aaron le a tapate thu pia inla, hih bangin ci in: Hih pen meihal biakna ngeina ahi hi. Meihal biakna pen biakna tau tunga meikhuk tungah zingsang mateng zan tawntung om ding a, tua biakna tau tungah mei kikuangsak den ding hi.
Siampipa in a saihadial puan silhin, a saihadial pheituam tengin, biakna tau tungah meihal biakna mei in a kattum vutte la-in biakna tau pangah koih ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a puante suahin puan dang silh ding a, giahphual pualam a siangtho mun khatah a vutte puakhia ding hi.
Biakna tau tunga mei kikuangsak den ding a, kimitsak lo ding hi. Siampipa in zingsang simin a tungah sing cihin, meihal biakna a ngeina bangin a tungah koihin, thunuama biakna thau a tungah hal ding hi.
Biakna tau tungah mei kikuangsak tawntung ding a, kimitsak lo ding hi.
"Tua ciangin an tawh biakna ngeina hih bang ahi hi. Aaron' suante in biakna tau mai, Topa' mai-ah pia ding uh hi.
Mi khat in, biakna tau tungah a om an tawh biakna annel khutdim khat, a sathau le a paknamtui khempeuh tawh la-in, Topa a dingin a gim namtui, phawkna-in biakna tau tungah hal ding hi.
Aaron le a tapate in a omlai teng ne ding uh hi. A siangtho mun khatah silngo sawh loh in ne ding uh a, kikhopna buktual sung mun khat hi ding hi.
Tua pen silngo sawhin a ki-em hi lo ding hi. Meihal biakna hong kipiakna sung panin amau' tanh dingin ka piaksa ahi hi. Tua pen khialhna hanga biakna le mawhna hanga biakna bangin a siangtho pen ahi hi.
Na khang tawntung uha dingin thu hong kipiak mah bangin, Topa' tungah meihal biakna a kipiakna panin Aaron' suante lakah pasal peuhmah in tuate ne thei ding hi. Tuate a lawng peuhmah a siangtho suak ding hi," a ci hi.
"Aaron le a suante sathau a kinilh ni-in Topa' tungah hih bangin biakna kipia ding hi: An tawh biakna ngeina bangin annel lawh khat, alang zingsangin, alang nitakin pia ding hi.
Tua pen beelpei tung khatah sathau tawh kibawl ding hi. An tawh biakna mah bangin limtakin helsa leh balnensa-in na paipih ding a, Topa a' ding a gim namtui dingin na pia ding hi.
Aaron' suante sung panin amah a laih dingin sathau a kinilh siampipa in, thu a kipiaksa mah bangin Topa' tungah pia ding a, a vekpi-in kihal ding hi.
Siampipa in an tawh a biakna peuhmah a vekpi-in kihal ding a, kine lo ding hi," a ci hi.
"Aaron le a tapate tungah hih bangin gen in: Khialhna hanga biakna ngeina hih bang ahi hi. Meihal biakna a kigawhna mun Topa' mai-ah khialhna hanga biakna kigo ding a, tua pen a siangtho pen ahi hi.
Khialhna hanga biakna a pia siampipa in kikhopna buktual sung a siangtho mun khatah ne ding hi.
A sa a lawng peuhmah a siangtho suak ding hi. Puan tungah a si a kithehkhak ciangin, a siangtho mun khatah tua si a kithehkha pen kisawp ding hi.
Tua ciangin a kihuanna leibeel kisukham ding hi. Ahih hangin taaubeelin a kihuan ahihleh a beel kikiatin tui sungah kisawp siang sitset ding hi.
Siampite' lak panin pasal peuhmah in ne thei ding uh hi. Tua in a siangtho pen ahi hi.
Ahih hangin siangtho munah kilemna bawl nadingin kikhopna buk sungah a kipaipih si a kilak khiatna, khialhna hanga biakna sa kine lo ding a, mei tawh kihal ding hi.
"Mawhna hanga biakna ngeina, a siangtho pen hih bang ahi hi.
Amaute in meihal biakna a gawhna mun uhah mawhna hanga biakna go ding uh a, biakna tau kimkotah a si kitheh ding hi.
Tua ciangin a thau khempeuh, a meithau, a gilpi tuam a thau,
a kawnga om a kal nihte a thau tawh, a kalte tawh a lakkhiat khop ding ahi a sin tuamte kipia ding hi.
Topa' tungah meihal biakna-in siampipa in biakna tau tungah hal ding a, tua pen mawhna hanga biakna ahi hi.
Siampite lakah pasal peuhmah in a siangtho mun khatah ne thei ding uh hi; tua in a siangtho pen ahi hi.
"Mawhna hanga biakna pen khialhna hanga biakna tawh kibang a, tuate a' ding a ngeina a kibang hi ding a, kilemna a bawlsak siampipa in tua biakna sa ngah ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh' meihal biakna a piaksak siampipa in ama piaksak tua meihal biakna a vun ngah ding hi.
Mei bung sunga a ki-em an tawh biakna peuhmah leh sikbeel daii ahi a, beelpei tungah ahi zongin a kibawl khempeuhte, a pia siampipa in ngah ding hi.
An tawh biakna khempeuh, sathau a kihel hitaleh a kihel lo hita leh, Aaron' suan khempeuh in a kikimin hawm ding uh hi.
"Mi khatpeuh in Topa' tungah a piak theih ding, thunuama biakna ngeina hih bang ahi hi.
Amah in lungdam kohna-in a piak leh, silngo sawh loh sathau tawh a kihel moh, silngo sawh loh mohpheng sathau tawh a kizut, annel moh sathau limtakin a kihelte, lungdam biakna tawh pia khawm ding hi.
Amah in lungdam koh nadingin thunuama ama biakpiakna tawh silngo kisawh anlum mohte ama biakna-in paipih khawm ding hi.
Amah in Topa biak nadingin tua biakna sung panin moh khat ciat pia ding a, thunuama biakna si a theh siampipa in tua moh ngah ding hi.
Lungdam kohna-in thunuama ama biakpiakna a sa pen a piak ni-in kine ding a, a zingsang dong bangmah kisit lo ding hi.
"Ahih hangin ama biakpiakna pen thuciamna hanga biakpiakna ahi a, utthu-a biakpiakna ahi zongin ahihleh, amah in a biakpiakna a piak ni-in kine ding a, a omlai teng a zing ciangin kine ding hi.
Ahih hangin a ni thum ni-in biakpiakna sa a omlai teng mei tawh kihal ding hi.
A ni thum ni-in thunuama ama biakpiakna sa khat peuhpeuh a kinek leh, tua biakpiakna a piapa kisang lo ding a, tua pen ama a' in zong kiciamteh lo ding hi. Tua sa a nin hi ding a, a ne pa in ama mawhna pua ding hi.
"A nin na khat peuhpeuh tawh a kisawhkha sa kine lo ding a, mei tawh kihal ding hi. Ahi zongin a siang mi khempeuh in a sa ne thei ding uh hi.
A nin hi napi-in thunuama Topa' tungah biakpiakna sa a ne pa ama mipihte' lak panin kihawlkhia ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh in mihing nin hitaleh ganhing nin hitaleh a kihhuai a nin khat peuhpeuh hitaleh lawng a, tua khit ciangin thunuama Topa' tungah biakpiakna sa a nek leh, ama mipihte' lak panin tua mipa kihawlkhia ding hi," a ci hi.
A mawk sih ganhing thau leh gamsate in a balgawp ganhing thaute, nadangin kizang thei ding a, ahih hangin bangbang hileh na ne kei ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa' tungah mei tawh kihal biakna ganhing thau a ne mi peuhmah ama mipihte' lak panin kihawlkhia ding hi.
Tua tham loin note in na tenna uh mun khat peuhpeuhah vasa sisan hitaleh ganhing sisan hitaleh si peuhmah na ne kei ding uh hi.
Si khat peuhpeuh a ne mi peuhmah ama mipihte' lak panin kihawlkhia ding hi," a ci hi.
"Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Topa' tungah thunuama ama biakpiakna a piapa in Topa' kiangah ama biakna paipih ding hi. Thunuama ama biakpiakna panin
amah in Topa' tungah meihal biakna a khutin paipih ding hi. Topa' mai-ah vei-a biak nadingin a iik a kivei theih nadingin amah in a thau a iik tawh paipih ding hi.
Siampipa in biakna tau tungah a thau hal ding a, ahih hangin a iik pen Aaron le a suante a' ding hi ding hi.
Thunuama na biakpiakna panin biakna-in siampipa tungah a taklam phei na pia ding uh hi.
Aaron' suante sung panin thunuama biakna si le a thau a piapa in a taklam phei a ngah ding ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a kivei a iik le a kipia a phei pen keimah in Israel mite' tung panin thunuama amau' biakpiakna sung panin lakhia-in, Israel mite' tung panin a tawntungin a ngah dingun siampi Aaron le a suante' tungah ka pia khinzo hi.
Hih pen, Topa' siampi na a sem dingin amaute a kipiak ni-in, Topa' tungah meihal biakna sung panin amau' tungah a kipia, Aaron leh a suante' tanh ahi hi.
Israel mite in amaute tungah a piak nadingin amaute sathau a kinilh ni-in Topa in hih thu pia a, tua pen a khang tawntungun amau' kaih ahi hi," a ci hi.
Hihte pen amau' biaknate Topa' tungah a piak nadingun amah in Israel mite Sinai sehnel gamah a thupiak ni-in Topa in Sinai Mual tungah Moses a thupiak, meihal biakna, an tawh biakna, khialhna hanga biakna, mawhna hanga biakna, ki-apna le thunuama biakna ngeina ahi hi.
"Aaron le amah tawh a om a tapate, a puante, a nilh sathau, khialhna hanga biakna a bawngtal, a tuutal nihte le silngo sawh loh anlum lawh la inla,
kikhopna bukkongah Israel mihonte khempeuh khawm in," a ci hi.
Topa in amah a thupiak bangin Moses in hih a, kikhopna bukkongah mihonte kikhawm hi.
Moses in mihonte kiangah, "Tu-a ka hih dingte pen Topa in hih dingin a thupiak ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in Aaron le a tapate paipihin tui tawh amaute a sil hi.
Amah in a puantungsilh amah silhsak a, a kawnggak tawh gakin, a puantualpi silhsak a, a siampipuan silhsakin, siampipuan' khau, hoihtakin a kigan tawh gak a, tua tawh ama tungah a khih hi.
Amah in ama tungah a awmdal bulhin, a awmdal sungah Urim le Thummim a koih hi.
Amah in Aaron' lu tungah a dialpi khimsakin, a dialpi tung a mai lamah, Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin amah in kham peek, a siangtho kumpi lukhu a khusak hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in nilh sathau la-in, biakbuk le a sunga om khempeuh nuhin tuate a ap hi.
Amah in biakna tau tungah tuate kimkhat sagihvei thehin, biakna tau le a nazat khempeuh le kuang le a ngaknate, ap dingin sathau a nuh hi.
Amah in nilh sathau kimkhat Aaron' tungah sung a, ap dingin amah a sathau a nilh hi.
Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin, Moses in Aaron' tapate paipih a, puantungsilhte silhsakin, kawnggak tawh amaute gak a, amau' lu tungah lukhute a khih hi.
Tua ciangin amah in khialhna hanga biakna bawngtal paipih a, Aaron le a tapate in tua bawngtal lu tungah amau' khut nga uh hi.
Kilemna bawl nadingin Moses in a bawngtal go a, a si la-in a kiima biakna tau kite a khutme tawh nuhin, biakna tau siangthosak a, biakna tau bulah a site sungkhia-in a ap hi.
A sungkuate tunga om a thau khempeuh le a sintuamte le a kal nihte a thau tawh la-in, biakna tau tungah tuate a hal hi.
Ahih hangin, Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin a omlai a vun, a sa le a ek, amah in giahphual pualamah mei tawh a hal hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in meihal biakna tuutal pia a, Aaron le a tapate in tuutal lu tungah amau' khut nga uh hi.
Moses in tua tuutal go-in, biakna tau tung kimkotah a si theh hi.
Tuutal a kisemnen ciangin, Moses in a lu le a ki-atnente le a thau a hal hi.
Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin, a sungkuate le a khete tui tawh a kisawp khit ciangin, Topa' tungah mei tawh kihal biakna a gim namtui, meihal biakna-in Moses in biakna tau tungah tuutal buppi a hal hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in a tuutal dang, kipsakna tuutal pia a, Aaron leh a tapate in tuutal lu tungah amau' khut nga uh hi.
Moses in tuutal go a, a si tawmkhat la-in Aaron' taklam bilteep leh a taklam khutpi le a taklam khepi nuh hi.
Aaron' tapate hong kipaipih a, Moses in amau' taklam bilteepte le amau' taklam khutpite le amau' taklam khepite a si tawmkhat nuh a, a si a val laite, biakna tau tung kimkotah a theh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a thau, a mei thau le a sungkuate tunga om a thau khempeuh le a sintuamte, a kal nihte le a thau, le a taklam phei a la hi.
Topa' mai-ah a om silngo sawh loh anlum lawh sung panin amah in silngo sawh loh moh khat le sathau sawh anlum moh khat le mohpheng khat la-in, a thau tung le a taklam phei tungah tuate a koih hi.
Amah in hihte khempeuh, Aaron le a tapate' khut sungah koih a, amaute in vei-a biakna-in Topa' mai-ah tuate a vei uh hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in amaute' khutsung panin tuate la-in, Topa' tungah meihal biakpiakna, a gim namtui, kipsakna biakna-in biakna tau tungah meihal biakna tawh tuate a hal khawm hi.
Moses in a iik la-in vei-a biakna-in Topa' mai-ah a vei hi. Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin tua pen kipsakna tuutal panin Moses' tanh ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in nilh sathau kimkhat le biakna tau tunga om a si la-in, Aaron le ama tapate le amau' puante tungah a theh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Moses in Aaron le ama tapate, a puante uh tawh a apkhawm hi.
Moses in Aaron le a tapate kiangah, "Keimah in thu hong pia-in, 'Aaron le a tapate in ne ding uh hi,' ka cih mah bangin, kikhopna buk kongah a sa huan unla, tua lai munah tua sa le kipsakna biakna lawh sungah a om anlum ne unla,
a sa le anlum na khamvalte uh mei tawh na hal ding uh hi.
Note hong kikipsak nading hun ni sagih sung hi ding ahih manin, note hong kikipsakna hun a cin mateng, kikhopna bukkong pua-ah ni sagih sung na paikhia kei ding uh hi.
Tuni-a kibawl bangin, note a dingin kilemna bawl ding, Topa in thu hong pia khin hi.
Kikhopna bukkongah ni sagih sung sun le zan na om ding uh a, Topa' hong sawlte na hih ding uh hi. Tua hikeileh note na si ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua bang dingin keima tungah thu hong kipia hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Aaron le a tapate in zong, Topa in Moses' tungtawnin a thupiakte khempeuh a hih uh hi.
A ni giat ni-in Moses in Aaron le a tapate le Israel upate a sam hi.
Amah in Aaron' kiangah, "Khialhna hanga biak nadingin bawng pano khat le meihal biak nadingin tuutal khat, a nih tuakin a sitbaang lo, la inla, Topa' mai-ah tuate pia in.
Israel mite kiangah, 'Khialhna hanga biak nadingin keel a pa khat, le meihal biak nadingin bawngno khat le tuuno khat, a nih tuakin kum khat pha-in a sitbaang lo,
le thunuama biakna-in Topa' mai-ah piak dingin bawngtal khat le tuutal khat, le sathau tawh a kibawl an tawh biakna la un. Bang hang hiam cih leh tuni-in note tungah Topa hong kilang ding hi,' ci in," a ci hi.
Amaute in zong kikhopna buk mai-ah Moses' thupiak teng hong paipih uh a, mihonpite khempeuh a nai-ah hong pai-in Topa' mai-ah ding uh hi.
Moses in, "Note tungah Topa' minthanna vang hong kilat theih nadingin Topa in hih bangin thu hong pia hi," a cih khit ciangin
Aaron' kiangah, " Topa' thupiaksa bangin biakna tau mai-ah pai-in khialhna hanga biakna le meihal biakna pia inla, nangma a' ding le mite a dingin kilemna bawl in. Mite' biakna paipih inla, amaute a dingin kilemna bawlsak in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Aaron in biakna tau naihin, ama a' mahmah ding ahi khialhna hanga biakna bawngno a go hi.
Aaron' tapate in ama tungah a si pia uh a, amah in a si sungah a khutme diahin biakna tau kite nuh a, biakna tau bulah a si vallai teng a sungkhia hi.
Ahih hangin, Topa in Moses a thupiak bangin khialhna hanga biakna panin a thau le a kalte le a sintuamte biakna tau tungah a hal hi.
A sa le a vunte ahihleh giahphual pualamah mei tawh a hal hi.
Tua ciangin a meihal biakna a go hi. A tapate in ama tungah a si pia uh a, amah in biakna tau tung kimkotah a theh hi.
Amaute in meihal biakna ama tungah a nen nenin a lutang tawh pia uh a, amah in biakna tau tungah tuate a hal hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a sungkuate le a khete sawp a, biakna tau tungah meihal biakna tawh tuate a halkhawm hi.
Tua ciangin a masa-a khialhna hanga biakna mah bangin amah in mite' biakna pia-in, mite a' ding ahi khialhna hanga biakna keel la-in go a, khialhna hanga biak nadingin a pia hi.
Tua ciangin meihal biakna paipihin ngeina kip omsa bangin a pia hi.
Amah in zingsang a meihal biakna banah biakna paipihin, tua sung panin a khutdim la-in, biakna tau tungah a hal hi.
Moses' thupiak bangin amah in mite a dingin thunuama biakna bawngtal le tuutal zong a go hi. A tapate in ama kiangah a si paipih uh a, amah in biakna tau kimkotah theh a,
bawngtal le tuutal thau, a mei thau, a gilpi tuam, a kalte, a sintuamte
le a thau, amaute in a iikte tungah koihin, amah in biakna tau tungah a thau a hal hi.
Ahih hangin Aaron in a iikte le a taklam pheite, Topa' mai-ah vei-a biakna-in a vei hi.
Tua ciangin Aaron in mite' lamah a khutte laamto-in thupha a piak khit ciangin khialhna hanga biakna le meihal biakna le thunuama biakna a piakna panin hong paisuk hi.
Kikhopna buk sungah Moses le Aaron hong tum uh a, hong pusuah khiat ciangun mite thupha pia a, mi khempeuh tungah Topa' minthanna vang hong kilang hi.
Topa' mai panin mei hong piangkhia-in meihal biakna le biakna tau tunga om sathau a kang hi. Mi khempeuh in a muh uh ciangin awng uh a, lei maingatin a kunsuk uh hi.
Tu-in Aaron' tapate Nadab le Abihu in amau' paknamtui beel tuak la-in, a sungah mei koih uh a, a tungah paknamtui koihin, Topa in amau' tungah tua banga thu a piak ngei loh a siang lo mei, Topa' mai-ah a pia uh hi.
Topa' omna mun panin mei hong paikhia-in amaute kang a, Topa' mai-ah a si uh hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in Aaron' kiangah, " Topa in, 'Ka kiang nai-a a omte kiangah keimah a siangtho-in ka kilak ding a, mi khempeuh' mai-ah keimah hong kiminthangsak ding hi,' ci hi," ci-in a gen hi. Aaron pau loin a om hi.
Moses in Aaron' pa' sanggampa Uzziel' tapate Mishael le Elizafan samin amaute kiangah, "Hong pai unla biakbuk panin giahphual pualamah na sanggamte uh puakhia un," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in hong naihin, Moses' sawl bangin giahphual pualamah amau' puantungsilh mah uh tawh amaute a puakhia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in Aaron le a tapate Eleazar le Ithamar kiangah, "Na lu uha na sam uh phiahsak kei unla, na puante uh balkek kei un. Tua bangin na hih uhleh note si-in, mihon khempeuh tungah Topa' hehna hong tung ding hi. Ahih hangin na mipih uh, Israel mihon buppi pen, Topa' mei in a katlup mite' hangin dahin kap thei ding uh hi.
Kikhopna buk kong panin a pualamah paikhia kei un. Na pai uhleh na si ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa' nilh sathau note' tungah om hi," a ci hi. Moses' gen bangin amaute a gamta uh hi.
Note in a siangtho le a mawkmawk, le a nin le a siang na khen ding uh hi.
Topa in Moses tungtawnin amaute' tunga a gensa thukhamte khempeuh note in Israel mite a hilh ding na hi uh hi," a ci hi.
Moses in Aaron le a omlai a tapate Eleazar le Ithamar kiangah, " Topa' tungah meihal biakna sung panin a vallai ahi an tawh biakna la unla, tua pen a siangtho pen ahih manin silngo sawh lohin biakna tau gei-ah ne un.
Tua an pen Topa' tungah meihal biaknate lak panin nang le na tapate' kaih ding ahih manin a siangtho mun khatah na ne ding uh hi. Tua bang ding mahin kei' tungah thu hong kipia hi.
Ahih hangin a kivei a iik le a kipia a pheite pen nang le na tapate le na tanute in a siangtho mun khatpeuhah ne ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen Israel mite in thunuama a biakpiakna panun nang le na tapate' kaih dinga hong kipia ahi hi.
Topa in a thupiaksa bangin a kipia a phei le a kivei a iikte ahihleh Topa' mai-ah vei-a biakna-in vei dingin amaute in meihal biakna sathau tawh hong paipih ding uh a, tua pen nang le na tapate in a tawntungin na kaih ding uh ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tu-in Moses in khialhna hanga biakna keel tawh kisai thu limtakin kan a, na kihal khin mawk hi. Aaron' tapa a omlai Eleazar le Ithamar-te' tungah amah heh a,
"Note in mihonte a dingin Topa' mai-ah kilemna bawlin, amau' mawhna a kilakkhiat theih nadingin note' tungah hong kipiasa a siangtho sa pen khialhna hanga biakna hi napi, bang hangin a siangtho mun khatah ne lo na hi uh hiam?
En un, biakbuk sungah a sisan kipaipih lo hi. Ka thupiaksa bangin note in biakbuk sungah na nek dingun a kilawm ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Aaron in Moses kiangah, "En in, tuni-in amaute in Topa' mai-ah amau' khialhna hanga biakna le amau' meihal biakna pia khinzo uh hi. Tua bang hinapi hih bang thute kei' tungah hong tung veve hi. Khialhna hanga biakna tuni-in a ne hi leng, Topa' muhna-ah sanhuai ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Topa in Moses le Aaron tungah,
"Israel mite kiangah hih bangin gen un: Hihte pen leitung a om ganhing khempeuh lak panin na nek theih ding uh a nungta ganhing ahi hi.
Ahi zongin eknel haite lak pan hitaleh khecin kate lak pan hitaleh, note in na nek theih loh dingte uh: Kalaoh in eknel a hai hangin a khecin ka lo ahih ciangin note a dingin a nin ahi hi.
Sakikh ganhing in eknel a hai hangin a khecin ka lo ahih ciangin note a dingin a nin ahi hi.
Bilpi in eknel a hai hangin a khecin ka lo ahih ciangin note a dingin a nin ahi hi.
Vok pen khecin ka ahih hangin eknel hai lo ahih ciangin note a dingin a nin ahi hi.
Note in tuate' sa na ne kei ding uh a, a sisate zong na lawng kei ding uh hi. Tuate pen note a dingin a nin ahi hi.
