"Tua hunin note thu kong pia a, ' Topa na Pasian un na neih dingun hih leitang hong piazo hi. Na galhang mite khempeuh uh galhiam tawh kithawi-in Israel mi na sanggamte uh mai-ah va kuan ding hi.
Ahih hangin na zite, na taneute, le na ganhingte uh (ganhing tampi na neih uh ka thei hi) note kong piaksa khuapite-ah om ding uh a,
Topa in note hong piak bangin na sanggamte uh tungah lungsim tawlngakna pia-in, Topa na Pasian un Jordan galkhatah amaute a piak leitang amaute in zong a luah matengun na huh ding uh hi. Tua ciangin note kong piaksa ahi na neihsa ciat uhah note khempeuh na ciah ding uh hi,' kong ci hi.
Amaute na kihta kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh nang a' dinga hong dosak pa pen Topa na Pasian ahi hi,' ka ci hi.
"Tua hunin keimah in Topa' tungah ka thum a,
'Topa Pasian aw, na liatna le na thahatnate na nasempa' tungah lah ding a hong kipan pan bek na hi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh vantung hitaleh leitungah hitaleh nangma hih bangin tua bang nasep leh a vanglian gamtatna a hih thei bang pasian om ahi hiam?
Kei hong paisak inla, Jordan galkhat a om gam hoih, tua mualtung gam hoih le Lebanon hong musak in, ci-in kong thum hi,' ka ci hi.
"Ahih hangin note' hangin kei' tungah Topa heh a, ka thunget hong pia lo hi. Topa in kei kiangah, 'Phazo hi; hih thu kei kiangah hong gen nawn kei in.
Ahih hangin Joshua thu pia inla, hanthawnin thakhauhsak in; bang hang hiam cih leh hih mite' mai-ah amah pai ding a, nangmah in na muh ding leitang amaute luahsak ding hi,' hong ci hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Bethpeor gal-a kuam sungah i taam lai hi.
"Tu-in Israel-te aw, note nungta-in, Topa, na pate uh Pasian in note hong piak leitangah va pai-in na luah theih nadingun note kong hilh thukhamte le ngeina kipte don unla zui un.
ahih hangin Topa na Pasian uh a lenkipte khempeuh tuni-in na hinglai uh hi.
"En un, note in a luah dingin na lutna uh gam sungah na zuih dingun Topa ka Pasian in kei hong thupiak bangin thukhamte le ngeina kipte kong hilh khinzo hi.
Tuate zui unla, sem un; bang hang hiam cih leh hih thukhamte khempeuh a zak uh ciangin, 'Hih minam liante pen a pil thuthei taktak hi,' a ci ding uh mite' muhna-ah hih thu pen nomau' pilna le nomau' theihna hi ding hi.

"Mei in mual kangin van laizang dong banto-in, khuamial le meii le khuazing in a tuamcip laitakin note a nai-ah hong pai-in mual bulah na ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin mei sung panin Topa in note' kiangah thu hong gen hi. Note in awging na za uh a, ahih hangin bangmah mu loin, awging bek a om hi.
Thupiak Sawmte ahi note' hih dinga hong thupiak ama thuciamna note' tungah hong gen a, amah in suangpek nih tungah tuate a gelh hi.
Note in na luah ding uh gam sungah na zuih theih nadingun, thukhamte le ngeina kipte note kong hilhna ding tua hun laitakin Topa in kei thu hong pia hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin note hoihtakin kidawm un. Horeb-ah mei sung panin Topa in note' tungah thu hong gen ni-in bangmah mu lo na hih manun,
note a dingin lim khat peuhpeuh, pasal tawh a kibang hitaleh numei tawh a kibang hitaleh,
leitung a om ganhing khat peuhpeuh tawh a kibang hitaleh, huihlaka leeng kha a nei vasa khat peuhpeuh tawh a kibang hitaleh,
leitungah a bokvak khat peuhpeuh tawh a kibang hitaleh, leinuai-ah a om tui sunga ngasa khat peuhpeuh tawh a kibang hitaleh, a kiseek milim bawlna tawh a sia-in na gamtat khak loh nadingun kidawm un.
Ahih hangin Topa in tuni-a bangin sik meikhuk tawh a kibang Egypt panin ama neih mi dingin note hong la-in hong paikhiatpih khin hi.
Tua tham loin note' hangin kei' tungah Topa heh a, keimah in Jordan kantan loin Topa na Pasian un note' gamh dingin hong piak leitang hoihah ka lut loh nadingin a kiciam hi.
Hih gamah kei ka si ding a, Jordan khengin ka pai thei kei ding hi. Ahih hangin note in kantanin tua gam hoih na luah ding uh hi.
Topa na Pasian un note tawh hong bawl thuciamna mangngilhin, Topa na Pasian un note' hih dinga hong kham lim khat peuhpeuh tawh a kibang a kiseek milim na bawlkhak loh nadingun kidawm un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian uh hong kangtum thei mei tawh kibang a, a haza Pasian ahi hi.
"Note in tuleta nei-in gam sungah mi khangham na suah uh ciangin, na khat peuhpeuh tawh a kibang limin a kiseek milim bawlna le Topa na Pasian uh' muhna-ah a sia bawlna tawh amah a heh nadingin na siat gamtat uhleh,
Jordan galkhat luah dingin na paina leitang uhah na siat maimang baih nadingun note' langkhatah teci pang dingin tuni-in van le lei ka sam hi. Tua leitang tungah note sauvei na hing kei ding uh a, na siamaimang ding uh hi.
Topa in mite lakah note hong thehthang ding a, Topa in note hong hawlna minamte lakah mi tawmcik bek na omlai ding uh hi.
Note in tua lai munah mite' khut in a bawl, khua mu thei lo, khua za thei lo, a ne thei lo, a nam thei lo sing le suang pasian-te' na na sem ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin tua lai panin Topa na Pasian uh na zong ding uh a, na lungsim khempeuh uh le na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh na zon uhleh amah na mu ding uh hi.
Note in gimna thuakin, mailam hunah hih nate khempeuh note' tungah hong tun ciangin, Topa na Pasian uh lamah kihei-in ama thu na mang ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian uh hehpihna a nei Pasian ahi hi. Amah in note hong tamasak loin, hong nusia lo ding a, na pate uh tawh a thuciamna mangngilh lo ding hi.
"Pasian in leitungah mi a piansak ni a kipan, note' pian' ma-a hun beisa thu tu-in kan unla, van mong khat pan mong khat kikal thu zong kan un. Hih bang na lian piang ngei-in, a kiza ngei peuhmah hiam?
Note in Pasian' aw za khin napi-in na hin lai uh bangin meikuang sung panin pasian dang khat peuhpeuh' pauna aw mi khat peuhpeuh in za ngei ahi hiam?
Tua ahih kei leh, Topa na Pasian un Egypt gam sungah note a dingin na muhna uhah a bawlte khempeuh tawh a kibangin, ze-etna, lim, nalamdang, gal, a vanglian le a thahatna le a lauhuai mahmah tawh pasian dang khat peuhpeuh in ama mite a dingin minamdang khat sung pan minam khat a va lak ding hanciam ngam ngei ahi hiam?
Topa Pasian hi, ci-in na theih nadingun note' tungah hih thu hong kilak hi a, amah simloh kuamah dang om lo hi.
Amah in note hong khal theih nadingin vantung panin ama aw note hong zasak hi. A mei lianpi leitungah note hong musak a, mei sung panin ama aw na za uh hi.
Amah in na pate uh itin, amau' suanlekhakte hong teel a, amahmah in ama vanglian tawh Egypt panin note hong paikhiatpih a,
note sangin a tamzaw le a vanglian zawte' gamah hong paipihin, note' luah dingin amau' leitang hong piak nadingin note' mai-ah amaute hong hawlkhiatsak ahih manin tuni-in hih bangin na om thei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tunga om vantung hitaleh nuai-a om leitung hitaleh ah Topa pen Pasian ahihna thu tuni-in thei unla, na lungsim uhah ciamteh un; kuamah dang om lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note le note' khita na tate uh tungah thu hong nuamin, Topa na Pasian un a tawntung a hong piak gam sungah na khan uh na sausak theih nadingun tuni-a no kiangah kong gen ahi ama thukhamte le a thupiakte na zui ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin, a beisa hunah amah tawh kilangneihna a om lo, tum lopi-in a vengpa a that, mi that khapa va tai-in, hih khuapite khat peuhpeuhah taina tawh a suahtak theih nadingin Moses in nisuahna lam Jordan galkhatah khuapi thum a tuam koih hi.
Reuben mite a dingin mualzang sehnel gam Beza khua, Gad mite a dingin Gilead gam sung Ramoth khua, le Manasseh mite a dingin Bashan gam sung Golan khua ahi hi.
Moses in Israel mite tungah thu pia hi.
Hihte pen, Egypt gam panin a paikhiat-un Moses le Israel mite in a zawh Heshbon-ah a teng Amor mite' kumpipa Sihon' gam sung, Jordan gal, Bethpeor tawh a kigalsai kuam sungah, Egypt panin Israel mite a paikhiat lai-in Moses in amaute tungah a gen thute ahi hi.
Amaute in, Arnon kuam mong a a om Aroer panin Sirion Mual (Hermon a cihna) dong, Jordan nisuahna lama om Arabah gam khempeuh, Pisgah mualpang nuai Arabah tuipi dong tawh, kumpi Sihon' leitang le Bashan kumpi Og' leitang, Jordan galkhat nisuahna lamah a teng Amor kumpi nihte' leitang a luah uh hi.
Moses in Israel-te khempeuh samin amaute kiangah, "Israel-te aw, tuni-a note' zakin kong gen thukhamte le ngeina kipte ngai unla, note in thei-in limtakin zuih ding na ngaihsun ding uh hi.
Topa i Pasian in eite tawh Horeb-ah thuciamna khat bawl hi.
Topa in i pute i pate bek tawh hih thuciamna a bawl hi loin, tuni-a a hinglai eite khempeuh tawh zong a bawl ahi hi.
Note' tungah Topa' thu a gen dingin Topa le note' kikalah ka din laitakin, mei sung panin tua mualah Topa in kimaituahin note hong hopih a, mei hangin note lau na hih manun mualtungah na paito kei uh hi. Amah in:
"'Kei pen salsuahna Egypt leitang panin note a hong paikhiatpih Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi.
"'Keimah longal pasian dang na nei kei ding uh hi.
"'A kiseek milim hitaleh, tunga vantung hitaleh, nuai-a leitung hitaleh, leinuai-a om tui sung hitaleh ah a om na khat peuhpeuh a sun khat peuhpeuh note a dingin na bawl kei ding uh hi.
Amaute' mai-ah kun loin, amau' na na sem kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh keimah Topa note' Pasian, a aam Pasian ka hi a, kei hong mudahte' tungah a pate' mawhna a tate' tungah khang thum khang lina dongin thuk-in,
ahih hangin kei hong itin ka thupiakte a zui mi a tul tampite' tungah itna kip a lak pa ka hi hi.
" Topa note' Pasian' min a sia lamin na zang kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in ama min a sia lamin a zang mi a mawh lo hi, ci lo ding hi.
"' Topa note' Pasian in hong thupiak bangin na sianthosak nadingun Sabbath ni tang un.
Ni guk sung na semin na nasep ding khempeuh uh na hih ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin a ni sagih ni pen Topa note' Pasian' Sabbath ni ahi hi. Tua ni-in note bangin na nasem numei le na nasem pasalte uh a tawlngak theih nadingin note, na tapate, na tanute, na nasemnute, na nasempate, na bawngtal, na la, na ganhing khat peuhpeuh uh le na huang sung uha om zinte in na khat peuhpeuh sem lo ding uh hi.
Egypt-ah nasem na hihna uh le tua lai panin Topa na Pasian un a vangliatna khut le a thahatna tawh hong paikhiatpihna na phawk ding uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Sabbath ni na tan' ding uh Topa note' Pasian in thu hong pia hi.
"' Topa note' Pasian in hong piak leitang tungah na khan uh sau-in na nopsak theih nadingun Topa note' Pasian in hong thupiak bangin na nu na pa uh zahtak un.
"'Mi na that kei ding uh hi.
"'Nulepa mawhna zong na bawl kei ding uh hi.
"'Na na gu kei ding uh hi.
"'Na vengte uh langkhatah zong a man loin teci na pang kei ding uh hi.
"'Na vengte uh zi zong na deihgawh kei ding uh hi. Na vengte' inn, a lo, a nasempa, a nasemnu, a bawngtal, a la, ahih kei leh na vengte' na khat peuhpeuh na deihgawh kei ding uh hi,' ci hi.
" Topa in mei, meii, le a mial mahmah sung panin awging lianpi tawh mualtung a no a kikhawm khempeuh tungah hih thute hong gen a, amah in bangmah dang genthuah lo hi. Amah in suangpek nih tungah tuate gelhin, tua suangpeekte kei tungah hong pia hi.
"Mei in mual a kat laitakin khuamial sung panin awging na zak uh ciangin minam lutang khempeuh le upate kei kiangah hong pai uh hi.
Note in, 'En in, Topa i Pasian in a minthanna le a liatna eite' tungah hong lak khin a, mei sung panin ama awging i za khin hi. Pasian in mi hopih napi, mi a hinglai veve-in tuni-in i mu hi.
Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin tu-in eite si ding ihi hiam? Hih mei lianpi in eite hong kangtum ding hi. Topa i Pasian' awging za lai lehang eite i si ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a si thei mihing khempeuh sung panin eite' zak bangin mei sung panin a nungta Pasian a paukhiatna awging za-in a nungta lai kua om ahi hiam?
A nai-ah va pai inla, Topa i Pasian in a gen ding khempeuh va za in. Topa i Pasian in nang tungah hong genteng ko' tungah nang hong gensawn in. Kote in hong mangin ka sem ding uh hi,' nong ci uh hi.
"Kei kiangah nong gen uh ciangin Topa in na thu uh a za hi. Topa in kei kiangah, 'Hih mite in nang kiangah hong gen uh thu ka za khin a, a gen khempeuh uh a manin gen uh hi.
Amaute le a suan a khakte uh a nopsak tawntung theih nadingun keimah zahtak ding le ka thupiak khempeuh zuih ding hih bang ngaihsutna nei tawntung le-uh ka deih ahi hi.
Pai inla amaute kiangah, "Na puanbuk uhah ciah un," ci in.
Ahih hangin nang, kei kiang hih lai-ah ding in. Amaute' neih dingin ka piak leitangah amaute in a zuih theih nadingun amaute na hilh ding thupiakna le thukhamte le ngeina kipte khempeuh nang tungah kong gen ding hi,' hong ci hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Topa na Pasian un note hong thupiak bangin na gamtat ding uh na kingaihsun ding uh a, ama thu panin taklam hitaleh veilam hitaleh ah na pial kei ding uh hi.
Note nungta-in, nuamsa-in na luah ding uh leitangah sawtpi na nuntak nadingun Topa na Pasian un note hong thupiakna lampi khempeuh na tawn ding uh hi.
"Tu-in, luah dinga na paina gam uhah na zuih dingun, note le na tapate uh le na suanlekhakte un Topa note' Pasian' thukhamte le a thupiakte na zuihna uh tawh amah na zahtak theih nadingun, Topa na Pasian un na nuntak tawntung uh na zuih dingun kei a hong hilh sawnsak thute pen hih thupiakna, thukhamte, le ngeina kipte ahi hi. Hihte pen na khan uh a sau theih nading ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel-te aw, note nuamsa-in, Topa, na pate uh Pasian in note tungah hong ciamsa bangin bawngnawi le khuaizu a luanna gamah tampi pha-in na khan theih nadingun hih thute za unla, na zuih ding uh ngaihsun un.
"Israel-te aw, za un: Topa i Pasian, Topa khat bek ahi hi.
Topa note' Pasian, na lungsim khempeuh uh, na nuntakna khempeuh uh, le na thahatna khempeuh uh tawh na it ding uh hi.
Tuni-a no kong piak hih thute na lungsim uhah om ding hi.
Na tate uh tungah limtakin na hilh ding uh a, na innsung uhah na tut uh ciang, lampi-ah na pai uh ciang, na lup ciang uh le na thawh ciangun tua thute na gengen ding uh hi.
Na khut tung uhah lim dingin tuate na hen ding uh a, na mitte uh kikalah tuate pen talsuante bang hi ding hi.
Na inn kongkhak khuam tung uh le na kongpi uh tungah tuate na gelh ding uh hi.
" Topa na Pasian un note piak dingin na pate uh Abraham, Isaac, le Jakob tungah a ciam, note' phuh loh a lian a hoih khuapite,
note' khol loh na hoih khempeuh tawh a kidim innte, note' bawl loh tuibeem, note' suan loh leengguite, le oliv kungte a omna leitangah hong paipihin, note in ne-in na kham uh ciangin,
salsuahna Egypt leitang panin hong paikhiatpih Topa na mangngilh khak loh nading uh kidawm un.
Topa na Pasian uh na zahtak ding uh hi. Ama na bek na sem ding uh a, ama min tawh na kiciam ding uh hi.
Note' kiima om mite' pasian-te ahi pasian dangte' nung na zui kei ding uh hi;
bang hang hiam cih leh note' lakah a om Topa na Pasian uh a aam Pasian ahi hi. Tua bang hikeileh note' tungah Topa na Pasian uh hong hehin, lei maitang panin note hong susia ding hi.
"Massah munah amah na ze-et uh bangin Topa na Pasian uh na ze-et nawn kei ding uh hi.
Amah in note hong thupiaksa ahi Topa na Pasian un hong thupiakte khempeuh na zui ding uh hi.
Topa' hong ciamsa bangin note' mai panin na langte khempeuh uh nawhkhiatna tawh na pu na pate uh tungah piak dingin Topa in a ciamsa leitang hoih note in na luah theih nading uh le note na nopsak theih nadingun Topa' muhna-ah a man le a hoih nate na sem ding uh hi.
"Hong tung ding hunah na tapate un, ' Topa i Pasian in note hong piak hih thute, bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?' ci-in hong dot uh ciangin
na tapate uh kiangah, 'Eite pen Egypt gam sungah Faro' silate ihi a, Topa in Egypt panin a vangliatna tawh hong paikhiatpih hi.
Topa in eite' muhna-ah a lian a nasia lim le na lamdangte Egypt mite le Faro le a uliante khempeuh tungah lak hi.
Amah in i pu i pate tungah piak dinga a ciam leitangah hong paipihin, eite hong piak theih nadingin tua lai panin eite hong paikhiatpih hi.
Tuhuna bangin i nuntak theih nadingin amah in eite' hoih tawntung ding a deihna-in, Topa i Pasian zahtakin hih thukhamte khempeuh i zuih ding Topa in thu hong pia hi.
Amah in eite hong thupiak bangin Topa i Pasian' mai-ah hih thupiakte khempeuh limtakin zui lehang eite a dingin thumanna hi ding hi,' na ci ding uh hi.
" Topa na Pasian un luah dinga na tumna uh leitangah hong paipihin, note' mai-ah Hit mite, Girgash mite, Amor mite, Kanaan mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite, le Jebus mite, note sangin lianzaw-in a thahatzaw minam sagihte note' mai panin siangkhiasakin,
Topa na Pasian un note tungah amaute hong pia-in, note in amaute na zawh uh ciangin, note in amaute na susiamang ding uh hi. Amaute tawh thuciamna na bawl kei ding uh a, amaute tungah hehpihna na lak kei ding uh hi.
Amaute tawh kiteng loin, na tanute uh amau' tapate pia loin, a tanute uh na tapate uh a dingin na la kei ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh pasian dangte' na a sem dingin Topa zuihna panin na tapate uh amaute in heikhia ding uh hi. Tua ciangin no tungah Topa hong hehin note hong susia pak ding hi.
Amaute tungah hih bangin note na gamta ding uh hi: A biakna taute uh phelsakin, a biakna songte uh dengzanin, amau' Asherah milimte phuksakin, a kiseek a milimte uh mei tawh na hal ding uh hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh note pen Topa note' Pasian' tungah a siangtho mi na hi uh hi. Leitung a om mite khempeuh sung panin ama mi ahi dingin Topa na Pasian un note hong teelzo hi.
" Topa in note hong itin hong teelna pen midangte sangin na tamzawkna hang uh hi lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khempeuh lakah a tawmpen na hi uh hi.
Topa in salsuahna Egypt kumpipa Faro' khutsung panin note hong honkhia-in a vangliatna tawh hong paikhiatpihna pen Topa in note hong itin, na pate uh tunga a kiciam thuciam a zuihna hang ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa na Pasian uh amah bek ahi Pasian hi a, amah itin a thupiakna a zuite tungah khang tulkhat dongin thuciamna le itna kip lenin a thuman Pasian,
amah a mudah mite, suksiatna tawh a thukpah pa ahihna thei un. Amah a mudah mi tungah zekai loin a maitang mahah thuk ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tuni-a no kong piak thute khempeuh limtakin na zuih ding uh ngaihsun un.
"Note in hih ngeina kipte za-in, kemin tuate na zuihna hangun, Topa na Pasian un na pu na pate uh tungah a ciam thuciamna le itna kip note tungah hong tungsak ding hi.
Amah in note hong itin, tampi hong phasak ding hi. Amah in note tungah piak dingin na pu na pate uh tungah a ciam gam sungah note' suanlekhakte le na gam sung panun a piangte, na an uh le na leenggahzu uh le na sathau uh, le na ganhingte uh pungsakin, na tuulekeelno honte uh zong thupha pia ding hi.
Midangte khempeuh sangin note thupha hong kilim piakzaw ding hi. Note' lak hitaleh na ganhingte uh lak hitaleh ah a nu ahi a, a pa ahi zongin a ciing om lo ding hi.
Topa in note' tung panin natna khempeuh lakhia ding hi. Note in na theihsa uh ahi Egypt gam a natna siate note' tungah khat zong hong tung lo ding a, ahih hangin no hong mudahte khempeuh tungah tuate tungsak ding hi.
Topa na Pasian un note tungah hong piak mi khempeuh na beisak ding uh a, amaute na khasiat kei ding uh hi. Note a dingin thangzak hi ding ahih manin amau' pasian-te zong na bia kei ding uh hi.
"Na lungsim uhah, 'Hih minamte ei sangin tamzaw hi. Amaute bangci suankhiat zawh ding ihi hiam?' na cih khak uhleh,
amaute na kihta kei ding uh hi. Topa na Pasian un Faro le Egypt mite khempeuh tungah a hih,
na mitte un a muhsa a lian ze-etnate, limte, na lamdangte, a vangliatna le Topa na Pasian un hong paikhiatpihna a thahatna na phawk ding uh hi. Topa na Pasian un na kihtak uh mi khempeuh tungah tua bangin hih ding hi.
Tua tham loin, a omlai mite le no kiang panin a bu mite a siat khit dong matengin Topa na Pasian un amaute' lakah tunpi khah ding hi.
Topa na Pasian un note' mai-ah hih minamte tawm tawmin siang khiasak ding hi. Note a dingin gamsate hong tam khanlua kha ding ahih manin thakhatthu-in amaute na beisak kei ding uh hi.
Amah in note' khut sungah amaute' kumpite hong pia ding a, note in mun khempeuh panin amaute' min na maimangsak ding uh hi. Amaute na susiamang khin ding uh a, note' langkhatah mi khat beek hong pang zo lo ding hi.
A kiseek amau' pasian milimte mei tawh na hal ding uh hi. Tua nate-ah na awk khak loh nadingun amaute' tunga a om kham le ngun deihgawh loin, note a dingin na la kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen Topa na Pasian uh tungah a kihhuai ahi hi.
Note' inn sungah a kihhuai nate na tumpih kei ding uh a, tua nate tawh kibangin samsiat a thuak mi na kisuaksak kei ding uh hi. Note in tua nate mudah mahmahin na kih ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua nate a kisamsia na ahi hi.
"Note nungta-in tampi na phak theih nading uh le na pu na pate uh tungah piak dinga Topa a kiciamsa leitangah va pai-in na neih theih nadingun tuni-a note kiangah kong gen thupiakna khempeuh limtakin na zuih ding uh na ngaihsun ding uh hi.
A thupiakte na zui uh hiam, na zui kei uh hiam cih a theih nadingin note hong niamkhiatin, na lungsim uhah bang om hiam cih a theih nadingin Topa na Pasian un sehnel gamah hih kum sawmli sung note hong paipihna lampi khempeuh na ciamteh ding uh hi.
Mite, an bek tawh nungta loin Topa' kamsung panin a pusuak thu khempeuh tawh nungta hi, ci-in note hong theihsak nadingin, amah in note hong niamkhiatin hong gilkialsak a, note hitaleh na pu na pate uh hitaleh in a theih ngei loh manna tawh hong vak hi.
Hih kum sawmli sung note' tunga om na puan uh sia loin, na khe uh zong bawk lo hi.
Tua ahih manin mi khat in a tapa a khal bangin Topa na Pasian un note hong khalna thu na lungsim uhah thei un.
Tua ahih ciangin ama lampi zuihna le amah zahtakna tawh Topa note Pasian' thupiakte na zui ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa note' Pasian in, mual le guamah a luang tuite a omna, ciktui le tuikhuk a omna leitang,
mangbuh le mangbuhham, leenggui le theikung, le mang kawlsing a omna leitang, oliv kungte le khuaizu a omna leitang,
bangmah kisam loin, cilbawl loin an na nek nading uh leitang, a suangte sik ahihna leitang, mualte sung panin sumsan na tawh theihna uh leitang ahi gam hoihah note hong paipih hi.
"Tuni-a no tungah kong gen ahi ama thupiaknate le a ngeina kipte le a thukhamte zuih lohna tawh Topa na Pasian uh mangngilh kha ding na hih manun kidawm un.
Tua hikeileh, an ne-in na kham uh ciang, inn hoihte lamin tuate sungah na ten uh ciang,
na bawnghonte uh le na tuuhonte uh tampi a phak ciang le na khamte uh le na ngunte uh tampi pha-in, na neih khempeuh uh tampi a phak ciangin
na lungsim uh lianin, salsuahna Egypt gam panin note a hong paikhiatpih,
a lian a lauhuai sehnel gamah gul gunei le momai lak le tui om lohna lei keu-ah a hong paipihpa, meisuang tawh a kibang suangpi panin tui a hong piapa,
a tawpna-ah a hoihin na gamtat theih nading uh a deihna-in note hong niamkhiatin a hong ze-et theih nadingin na pu na pate un a theih loh manna tawh sehnel gamah a hong vak Topa na Pasian uh na mangngilh kha ding uh hi.
Na lungsim uhah, 'Ka vangliatna uh le ka thahatna un hih hauhna hong ngahsak hi,' ci kha ding na hih manun kingaihsun un.
Tuni-a mah bangin na pu na pate uh tungah a kiciamna a kipsak theih nadingin, na hauh nadingun vangliatna a hong piapa amah ahih manin Topa na Pasian uh na phawk ding uh hi.
Topa na Pasian uh mangngilhin pasian dangte' nung zui-in tuate' na semin na biak uhleh, na sia taktak ding uh hi, ci-in tuni-in limtakin kong hilhkhol hi.
Topa note' Pasian' aw ngai lo ahih manun, Topa in note' mai-ah a siatsak minamte bangin note na sia ding uh hi.
"Israel-te aw, za un; note sangin tamzaw-in a thahatzaw minamte, lianin van banin kulhpi a kiciangto khuapite, na theihsa uh mi ahi a pum lian a tun sang Anak mite, 'Anak mite, kua in dozo ding ahi hiam?' a kicih na zak ngei mite uh a suankhia dingin Jordan a kantan ta ding na hi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, a kangtum thei mei bangin note' mai-ah a pai pa pen Topa na Pasian uh ahihna thu tuni-in thei un. Amah in note' mai-ah amaute susia-in, amaute zogawp ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin Topa in note tungah hong ciamsa bangin amaute hawlkhia-in manlangin na siamangsak ding uh hi.
" Topa na Pasian un note mai panin amaute a nawhkhiat khit ciangin, na lungsim uhah, 'Hih leitang a luah dingin Topa in hong paipihna pen komau' thumanna hang ahi hi,' ci kha kei un. Topa in na mai uhah amaute a hawlkhiatna pen hih minamte' gitlohna hang hizaw hi.
Na thumanna hang uh ahi a, na lungsim manna hang uh tawh ahi zongin amau' leitang a luah ding na hi kei uh hi. Topa na Pasian un na mai panun amaute a hawlkhiatna pen hih minamte' gitlohna hang le Topa in na pu na pate uh Abraham, Isaac, le Jakob tungah a thuciamna kammal a kipsak theih nading ahi hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin note' thumanna hangin Topa na Pasian un na tan' dingun hih leitang hoih note tungah hong pia ahihlohna thei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh note pen lungsim khauh mi na hi uh hi.
" Topa na Pasian uh sehnel gamah phinin na hehsakna uh phawk unla, mangngilh kei un. Egypt gam panin na paikhiat ni uh a kipan hih lai na tun dongun Topa langpanin na lehdo uh hi.
Horeb mual nangawnah a heh nadingin Topa na phin uh a, note' tungah Topa heh a, amah in note hong susia dektak hi.
Topa in note tawh a bawl thuciamna suangpeekte a sang dingin mualtungah ka paitoh lai-in, mualtungah sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung ka om a, an ne lo, tui dawn loin ka om hi.
Pasian' khut tawh a kigelh suangpek nihte kei tungah Topa in hong pia hi. Kikhop ni-in mei sung panin note tungah Topa in hong gensa kammal khempeuh tua suangpeekte tungah om hi.
Sun sawmli le zan sawmli a cin ni-in kiciamna suangpek nihte Topa in kei hong pia hi.
"Tua ciangin Topa in kei kiangah, 'Kithawi inla, hih lai panin paisuk mengmeng in. Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt panin na paikhiatpih mite a sia-in gamta khin uh hi. Amaute ka thupiakna panin kiheikhia pak uh a, amaute a dingin a kisung milim khat bawl khin uh hi,' hong ci hi.
"Tua tham loin Topa in kei kiangah, 'Hih mite ka mu khin a, a lungsim khauh mite ahi hi.
Amaute susia-in mun khempeuh panin amaute' min ka phiat theihna dingin kei guak hong omsak in. Amaute sangin a vanglianzaw, a tamzaw minamin nang kong bawl ding hi,' hong ci lai hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin kihei-in mualtung panin kong paisuk a, mei in mual kangin na kuang hi. Kiciamna suangpek nihte ka khut nihte sungah om hi.
Tua ciangin ka khuadak leh, Topa na Pasian tung uhah na khial khin takpi uh a, a kisung bawngno milim amaute a dingin na bawl uh hi. Topa in note hong thupiakna panin na kiheikhia pak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin suangpek nihte la-in ka khut nihte' sung panin lawnin note' muhna-ah ka sukham hi.
Tua ciangin a masa-a bangin sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung Topa' mai-ah kunin ka om a, ama heh nadingin phinin, Topa' muhna-ah a sia gamtatna tawh note' khialhnate khempeuh hangin an ne lo, tui dawn loin ka om hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh note' tungah Topa' hehna le a lungkim hetlohna, note susia dingin a kithawina hangin ka lau hi. Ahih hangin tua hunin zong Topa in kei' thu hong ngai hi.
Aaron' tungah Topa heh mahmah a, amah susia dingin kithawi a, tua hun mahin Aaron a' ding zong thu ka ngen hi.
Tua ciangin note' khialhna, na bawlsa uh bawngno, mei tawh halin sukhamin, leivui bangin a neel dongin ka gawizan hi. Tua ciangin mualtung panin a hong luangsuk lui sungah a vuite ka lawn hi.
"Taberah, Massah, le Kibrothhattaavah munte-ah zong Topa phinin na hehsak uh hi.
Topa in Kadeshbarnea panin note hong sawlin, 'Paito unla note kong piak leitang luah un,' hong cih lai-in Topa na Pasian uh hong thupiakna nialin, amah um loin, ama aw na ngai kei uh hi.
Note kong theih ni a kipan Topa na nial uh hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Topa in note ka susia ding ci ahih manin hih sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung Topa' mai-ah kunin ka om hi.
Topa' tungah thu ka ngen a, 'Topa Pasian aw, nangmah in na liatna tawh na hotkhiatsa, na vangliatna tawh Egypt panin na paikhiatpih na mite le na luahte susia kei in.
Na nasem Abraham, Isaac, le Jakob phawk inla, hih mihingte' lungsim khauhna hitaleh a gitlohna uh hitaleh a khialhna uh hitaleh thusim kei in.
Tua bang hikeileh kote nong paikhiatpihna gam mite in, " Topa in amaute tungah a ciamsa leitangah amaute paipih zo loin, amah in amaute mudah ahih manin, sehnel gamah amaute a that dingin paikhiatpih hi," ci kha ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute pen na vangliatna le na thahatna tawh na paikhiatpih na mihingte le na luahte ahi hi,' ka ci hi.
"Tua hun laitakin Topa in kei kiangah, 'A masa-a bangin suangpek nih seekin, mualtung ka kiangah hong pai inla, sing singkuang khat bawl in.
A masa-a suangpek na sukkhapte' tunga thute tua suangpeekte tungah ka gelh ding a, singkuang sungah tuate na koih ding hi,' hong ci hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin singkha sing tawh singkuang khat bawlin, a masa-a bangin suangpek nih ka seek a, ka khut sungah a peek nihte tawi-in mualtungah ka paito hi.
Kikhop ni-in mei sung panin mualtungah Topa in note tungah hong gensa thupiak sawmte, a masa-a a kigelh bangin tua suangpeekte tungah amah in gelh a, tua ciangin Topa in kei tungah tua suangpeekte hong pia hi.
Tua ciangin kihei-in mualtung panin ka paisuk a, ka bawlsa singkuang sungah tua suangpeekte ka koih hi. Topa in kei hong thupiak bangin suangpeekte tua sungah a om hi.
(Beeroth Benejaakan panin Moserah-ah Israel mite zin uh hi. Tua lai-ah Aaron si a, tua lai munah kivui hi. Ama tangin a tapa Eleazar in siampi na sem hi.
Tua lai panin Gudgodah-ah pai uh a, Gudgodah panin lui tuite a omna gam Jotbathah-ah pai uh hi.
Tua hun laitakin Topa in, tuni dongin ama na a sem ding le ama min tawh thupha a pia dingin Topa' mai-ah dingin, Topa' thuciamna singkuang a pua dingin Levi minamte a tuam koih hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a sanggamte uh bangin Levi mite in tanh ahi a, luah ahi zongin nei lo uh a, Topa na Pasian un amau kiangah a gen bangin Topa pen amau' luah ahi hi.)
"A masa-a bangin sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung mualtungah ka om a, Topa in tua hunin zong ka thu hong ngai a, Topa in note hong susia nawn lo hi.
Topa in kei kiangah, 'Amaute tungah piak dingin a pu a pate uh tungah ka kiciam leitangah pai-in a luah theih nadingun ding inla, na khualzin uh zomin mite mai-ah pai in,' hong ci hi.
"Israel-te aw, tu-in, Topa na Pasian uh zahtak ding, ama lampite tot ding, amah it ding, na lungsim khempeuh uh le na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh Topa note' Pasian' na sep ding,
le nomau' hoih nadingin tuni-a kong gen thupiaknate le Topa' thukhamte zuih ding cih simloh, Topa na Pasian un note' tung panin bang dang hong kal ahi hiam?
En un, vantung le vantung a sangpente le leitung le a sunga om khempeuh pen Topa note' Pasian-a' ahi hi.
Tua hi napi-in Topa in na pu na pate uh a itna lian mahmah ahih manin tuni-a mah bangin midangte khempeuh sangin amau' suanlekhakte hong teelzaw hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa' thu mang unla, lungkhauh nawn kei un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian uh a lian, a vanglian, a kihtakhuai Pasian, angvan nei loin, sumgolh a la lo, pasian-te' Pasian, topate' Topa ahi hi.
Amah in pa nei lote le meigong numeite a dingin thutang semin, peemtate itin an le puan a pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin peemtate it un; bang hang hiam cih leh note zong Egypt gamah peemta na hi uh hi.
Topa note' Pasian na zahtak ding uh a, ama na semin, amah beelin, ama min tawh na kiciam ding uh hi.
Amah pen nomau' phat ding ahi hi. Na mitte un a muhsa hih a lian a kihtakhuai nate note a dingin hong bawlsak pa pen na Pasian uh ahi hi.
Na pu na pate uh mihing sawmsagih bek Egypt-ah paisuk uh a, ahi zongin tu-in Topa na Pasian un vantung aksi zahin note hong tamsak hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Topa na Pasian uh itin ama hong thuhilhna, a thukhamte, a ngeina kipte, a thupiakte na zui tawntung ding uh hi.
Tuni-in ngaihsun un (a thei nai lo, a mu nai lo na tate uh tungah a gen hi lo ka hih ciangin), Topa note' Pasian' hong thuhilhna, ama liatna, a vangliatna le a thahatna,
Egypt kumpipa Faro le a leitang tung khempeuhah a hih Egypt gam sunga ama limte le a sepnate;
Egypt galkapte, a sakolte le a leengte tungah a hihte; note hong delh laitakin San Tuipi tawh amaute tuumsakin, tuni dongin Topa in amaute a suksiatna;
hih mun na tun ma sungtengun sehnel gamah amah in note tungah hong hihte;
Reuben' tapa Eliab, a tapa Dathan le Abiram-te tungah a hihte; leitang a kam ka-in Israel khempeuh lakah a innkuanpihte, a puanbukte le amau a zuite khempeuh tawh amaute a nawmvalhna ngaihsun un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa' hihsa a nasepna a liante khempeuh na mitte un mu khin hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin note thahatin, na luah ding uh leitangah va pai-in na luah theih nading uh le, Topa in na pu na pate uh le a suanlekhakte uh tungah piak dingin a kiciam, bawngnawi le khuaizu tui bangin a luanna gamah sauvei na nuntak theih nadingun tuni-a kong gen thupiakna khempeuh na zui ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh luah dinga na lut nading uh leitang pen note' hong paikhiatna, anteh cinna huan banga khaici vawhin tui na buah nadingun nakpitakin na semin tui na lakna uh Egypt leitang tawh kibang lo hi.
Note va pai-in na luah ding uh leitang pen, vantung panin guahtui a ngah mual le guam a omna leitang,
Topa na Pasian un a kep leitang hi a, kum kipat a kipan kum bei dongin Topa note' Pasian in tua leitang en tawntung hi.
" Topa na Pasian uh itin, na lungsim khempeuh uh le na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh ama na na sep nadingun tuni-a kong gen ama thupiaknate na zuih uhleh,
na an uh le na leenggahzu uh le na sathau uh na kaihkhop theih nadingun amah in guah masa le guah nunung, a hunin na leitang uh a dingin hong zusak ding hi.
Amah in na ganhingte uh a dingin na gam sung uhah lopa hong posak ding a, note in zong an ne-in na gil uh vah ding hi.
Midangte' hong khemna hangin note kihei-in pasian dangte' na semin tuate na biakkhak loh nadingun kingaihsun un.
"Tua ahih ciangin hih ka thugente na lungsim uhah ciamtehin na ngaihsun ding uh hi. Na khut tung uhah lim dingin na khih ding uh a, tuate pen na mitte uh kikalah talsuan hi ding hi.
Na tate uh tungah na hilh ding uh a, na innsung uhah na lut laitak, lampi-ah na pai laitak, na lup ciang uhleh na thawh ciangun tuate genin na nei ding uh hi.
Vantungte, leitung' tungah a om laiteng, amaute tungah piak dingin Topa in na pu na pate uh tungah a kiciam gam sungah note le na tate uh khan a sau theih nadingin na inn kongkhak khuam uh le na kongpite uh tungah tuate na gelh ding uh hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian uh itin, ama lampi khempeuh zui-in, amah beelin, nomau zuih dingin kong gen hih thupiakna khempeuh zuih ding na kingaihsut uhleh,
Topa in na mai uhah a om hih minamte khempeuh hawlkhia ding a, note sangin lianzaw-in a thahatzaw minamte na suankhia ding uh hi.
Na khe un a sikna mun khempeuh nomau a' hi ding hi. Na gamgi uh sehnel gam panin Lebanon ciang dong le Eufratis gun panin nitumna tuipi dong hi ding hi.
Na lang uhah kuamah pang zo lo ding hi. No tungah hong ciam bangin Topa na Pasian un na tot ding uh gam khempeuh tungah note hong kizahtakna le note hong kikihtakna tungsak ding hi.
"En un, tuni-in na mai uhah thupha khat le hamsia khat ka koih hi.
Tuni-a kong gen, Topa na Pasian uh thupiaknate na zuih uhleh thupha hi a,
Topa na Pasian uh thupiaknate mang loin, na theih nai loh uh pasian dangte' nungzui dingin tuni-a no kong thupiakna panin na kiheikhiat uh le hamsia ahi hi.
Luah dingin na lutna uh leitangah Topa na Pasian un hong paipih ciangin Gerizim Mual tungah thupha taangko-in, Ebal Mual tungah hamsia na taangko ding uh hi.
(Tua mualte, Jordan gal, lampi panin nitumna lam, Moreh tawsaw gei-a Gilgal galkhat, Arabah-ah a teng Kanaan mite' gam sungah om hi.)
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian un note hong piak leitang a luah dingin Jordan kantanin a pai ding na hi uh hi. Tua leitang luahin a sungah na ten uh ciangin,
tuni-a note kong piak thukhamte le ngeina kipte khempeuh na zuih ding uh limtakin na ngaihsun ding uh hi.
"Hihte pen, leitungah na nuntak laiteng uh Topa, na pu na pate uh Pasian in na neih dingun no hong piaksa gam sungah limtakin na zuih ding uh thukhamte le ngeina kipte ahi hi.
Na suankhiat ding uh minamte in a biakna mun mual sangte tung le mual neute tung le singniim nuai, mun khempeuh na susia taktak ding uh hi.
Amaute' biakna taute phelkhia-in, a biakna songte dengzanin, amaute' Asherah milimte mei tawh na hal ding uh hi. A kiseek amau' pasian-te' limte na phukpai ding uh a, tua mun panin amau' min na maimangsak ding uh hi.
"Ahih hangin Topa na Pasian uh tungah tua bangin na hih kei ding uh hi.
Topa na Pasian un na minam khempeuh uh sung panin ama min koih nadingin teelin, ama omna dinga a bawlna mun na zong ding uh hi.
Tua lai-ah na pai ding uh a, na meihal biaknate uh le na biakpiaknate uh, note in na piak uh sawm-ah-khat le na piak thuahte uh, thuciamna biakpiakna, utthu-a na piakna, na bawnghon tacilte uh le na tuuhon tacilte uh tua lai-ah na paipih ding uh hi.
Topa na Pasian uh mai tua lai munah na ne ding uh a, Topa na Pasian un note thupha hong piakna hangin na hihna khempeuh uhah note le na innkuanpihte na lungdam ding uh hi.
"Tua hun ciangin mi khempeuh in ama hoihsak bangin a gamtat ngei ciat bangin na gamta nawn kei ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian un note hong piak tawlngakna le luahna-ah na tung nai kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jordan galkhatah pai-in, Topa na Pasian un luah dingin note hong piak leitangah tengin, nuamtakin na nuntak theih nadingun na kiim uha na langte khempeuh uh kiang panin tawlngakna hong piak ciangin,
Topa na Pasian un ama min om nading munin a teelna munah note kong sawl khempeuh na paipih ding uh hi. Na meihal biaknate uh le na biakpiaknate uh, note in na piak uh sawm-ah-khat le na piak thuahte uh le Topa' tungah na ciam uh na thuciam piaknate uh na paipih ding uh hi.
Topa na Pasian uh mai-ah note le na tapate uh le na tanute uh, na nasem numeite uh le na nasem pasalte uh, le note' neih bangin tanh ahi a, luah ahi zongin a nei lo na khuasung uha om Levi mite tawh lungdam khawm un.
Na tuahna mun peuh uhah na meihal biaknate uh na piak loh nadingun kingaihsun un.
Na minamte uh sung panin Topa in a teelna mun khatah na meihal biaknate uh pia-in, note kong thupiakte khempeuh tua lai munah na hih ding uh hi.
"Ahi zongin, Topa na Pasian un note tungah hong piak thupha tawh kizui-in na khuapite uh khat peuhpeuh sungah sa na deih zahzah uh go-in na ne thei ding uh hi. Sanang le sakhitalte a kinek mah bangin mi a nin le a siang kideidan loin na ne thei ding uh hi.
A si na ne kei bek ding uh hi; tui bangin leitungah a si na bua ding uh hi.
Na an uh sawm-ah-khat ahi a, na leenggahzu uh ahi a, na sathau uh ahi zongin, na bawnghon uh le na tuuhonte uh sung pan tacilte ahi zongin, na kiciamna uh ahi na thuciam uh biakpiakna khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin, utthu-a na piakte uh ahi zongin, nomau' piak thuahte ahi zongin na khuapite uh sungah na ne thei kei ding uh hi.
Topa na Pasian un a teelna munah note le na tapate le na tanute, na nasem numeite le na nasem pasalte, le na khuapite uh sunga om Levi mite in Topa na Pasian uh mai-ah na ne ding uh hi. Na hihna khempeuh uhah Topa na Pasian uh mai-ah na lungdam ding uh hi.
Na gam sung uhah na ten laiteng uh Levi mite na mangngilh loh nadingun kingaihsun un.
"No tungah hong ciamsa bangin Topa na Pasian un na gamgi uh hong sotsak ciangin, sa na duh manun, 'Sa ka ne ding uh hi,' na cih uhleh, na duh zahzah uh sa na ne thei ding uh hi.
Topa na Pasian un ama min koih nadingin a teelna mun pen note kiang panin a gamla lua ahihleh, note kong thupiaksa bangin Topa in no hong piaksa na bawnghon uh pan ahi a, na tuuhon uh pan ahi zongin khat peuhpeuh na go thei ding uh a, na duh zahzah uh na khuasung uhah na ne thei ding uh hi.
Sanang ahi a, sakhital ahi zongin a kinek mah bangin na ne thei ding uh a, mi a nin le a siang kideidan loin a kibangin na ne thei ding uh hi.
A si na nek loh ding uh theitel un. Bang hang hiam cih leh si pen nuntakna hi a, nuntakna pen sa tawh na ne khawm kei ding uh hi.
Si na ne kei ding uh a, tui bangin leitungah na buakhia ding uh hi.
Topa' muhna-ah a manin na gamtat uh ciangin note le note' khit cianga na tate uh a nopsak theih nadingin si na ne kei ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin na bat uh a siangtho nate le na thuciamna uh na piaknate uh note in la-in Topa in a teelna munah na paipih ding uh a,
Topa na Pasian uh biakna tau tungah na meihal biakna uh, a sa le a si na pia ding uh hi. Na biakpiakna uh site Topa note' Pasian' biakna tau tungah kibuakhia ding a, ahih hangin a sa na ne thei ding uh hi.
Topa na Pasian uh muhna-ah a hoih le a manin na gamtat uh ciangin note le note' khit cianga na tate uh a nopsak theih nadingin note kong thupiak khempeuh na kin ding uh limtakin ngaihsun un.
" Topa na Pasian un na mai panun na suankhiat ding uh minamte beimangsakin, amaute suankhia-in amau' leitangah na ten uh ciangin,
na mai uhah amaute a kisuksiat khit ciangin amaute zui-in na awk khak loh nading uh le, 'Kei zong amau' hih bangin ka hih theih nadingin hih minamte in a pasian-te uh bangci biak ahi uh hiam?' ci-in a pasian-te uh thu na kan loh nadingun kingaihsun un.
Topa na Pasian uh tungah tua bangin na hih kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in a muhdah a kihhuai nam khempeuh amaute in a pasian-te uh a dingin hih uh hi. A pasian-te uh a dingin a tapate uh le a tanute nangawn uh mei sungah a hal uh hi.
"Note kong thupiak khempeuh na hih ding uh na lim ngaihsut ding uh hi. Na behlap kei ding uh a, zong na khiam kei ding uh hi.
"Note lakah kamsang khat ahi a, mangman khat ahi zongin hong khangin, lim ahi a, nalamdang ahi zongin hong lak a,
ama hong gen lim ahi a, nalamdang ahi zongin hong tungin, na theih ngei loh uh, 'Adang pasian-te' nung zui-in amaute va bia ni,' hong cih leh,
tua kamsangpa' thu ahi a, mangman pa' thu ahi zongin na ngai kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa note' Pasian na lungsim khempeuh uh le na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh na it uh hiam cih a kitheih nadingin Topa na Pasian un no hong ze-etna ahi hi.
Topa na Pasian uh nung zui-in, amah na zahtak ding uh a, a thupiaknate zui-in a thu na ngai ding uh a, amah bia-in amah na beel ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin tua kamsangpa ahi a, mangman pa ahi zongin kithat ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian un na pai nadingun a hong thupiak na nusiat theih nading uh le Egypt leitang panin hong paikhiatpihin salsuahna panin hong honkhia Topa na Pasian uh langpangin na lehdo nading uh thu hong hilh ahi hi. Tua bangin note' lak panin siatna na siangkhiasak ding uh hi.
"Na sanggampa ahi a, na tanu ahih kei leh na tapa in ahi a, na ang sunga om na zi ahi a, nangmah banga na ngaihsut na lawm it in ahi zongin nang hong zol simin, leimong khat pan mong khat dong kikalah, nang kiang pan a nai ahi a, a gamla ahi zongin, nang hitaleh na pu na pate hitaleh in a theih ngei loh, na kiima om mite' pasian-te, 'Va pai-in pasian dangte va bia ni,' hong cih leh
ama cih mang loin, a thu ngai loin, amah hehpih loin, amah khahkhong loin, amah na im kei ding hi.
Nangmah in amah na that ding hi. Amah a that dingin nangmah a masa pen na hi ding a, tua khit ciangin midangte khempeuh in hong zui ding uh hi.
Salsuahna ahi Egypt gam panin a hong paikhiatpih Topa na Pasian uh kiang panin note hong paikhiatpih ding ngaihsun ahih manin suang tawh amah na denglum ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel-te khempeuh in za-in lau ding uh a, hih banga gitlohna note lakah bawlkik ngei nawn lo ding uh hi.
" Topa na Pasian un tenna dinga hong piak na khuapite uh khat peuhpeuh sungah,
mi ginalo pawlkhat note lakah hong pai-in, 'Pai-in pasian dangte va bia ni,' ci-in na theih ngei lohte uh lamah khuapi sunga teng mite a paikhiatpihna na zak uhleh,
note in a thu na kan ding uh a, zongin limtakin na dong ding uh hi. Note lakah tua banga a kihhuai-in gamtatna thu a om mah ahih takpi leh,
tua khua sunga mite namsau tawh na that ding uh a, khua sunga om mi khempeuh le a ganhingte, namsau tawh na susiamang ding uh hi.
Note in van kinusiate khempeuh khua laizang mun awngah khawmin, Topa na Pasian uh tungah khuapi le van kinusia khempeuh meihal biakna bupin mei tawh na hal ding uh hi. Tua khuapi pen ninkikholna hi tawntung ding a, kilamkik nawn lo ding hi.
Tuni-a kong gen ama thupiaknate khempeuh zui-in Topa na Pasian uh mai-ah a manin gamtatna tawh Topa na Pasian uh' aw na ngaih uhleh, na pu na pate uh tungah a ciamsa bangin, a kihtakhuai ama hehna panin Topa kihei-in note tungah migitna hong lakin, note tungah hehpihna hong nei-in, note tampi tak hong phaksak theih nadingin a ki-apsa na khat beek zong note a dingin na kem kei ding uh hi.
"Note pen Topa na Pasian uh mite na hi uh hi. Misite hangin note ki-atkeh loin, na sam uh zong na mettol kei ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh note pen Topa na Pasian uh tungah a siangtho mite na hi uh a, leitung a om mite khempeuh sung panin ama neih dingin Topa in note hong teel ahi hi.
"A kihhuai na khat peuhpeuh na ne kei ding uh hi.
Na nek theih ding uh ganhingte: Bawng, tuu, keel,
sakhital, sanang, simsakhi, sathak, saza, zosakhi, le gamtuu ahi hi.
Ganhingte lak panin a khecin a ka, eknel a hai ganhing peuhmah na ne thei ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin eknel a hai a, a khecin a ka ahi zongin na nek theih loh dingte uh: Kalaoh, bilpi, le sakikhte in eknel a hai hangin a khecin ka lo ahih manin note a dingin a nin ahi hi.
Vok pen a khecin a kat hangin eknel hai lo ahih manin note-a' dingin a nin ahi hi. Tuate' sa ne loin, a sisate zong na lawng kei ding uh hi.
"Tui sunga om khempeuh lak panin phe le lip a nei peuhmah na ne thei ding uh hi.
Phe le lip a nei lo peuhmah na ne kei ding uh a, tuate pen no-a' dingin a nin ahi hi.
Ahih hangin na nek loh dingte uh: Muvanlai, musane, luimu,
mupi, mumeika, amau nam ciat;
vasa-kalaoh, pengpelep, vatawt, musi nam khempeuh;
keising le simbu, gam vatawt
le tui vatawt, samuat ne musane le tuimu,
gun vapi, gun vazonei nam khempeuh; huihtun le bak ahi hi.
"Kha a nei insek ganhing khempeuh no a dingin a nin ahi hi; tuate kine lo ding hi.
A leng thei insek ganhing a siangte khempeuh na ne thei ding uh hi.
"Ama thu-a a si tawm ganhing peuhmah na ne kei ding uh hi. A nek dingun na khuasung uha om khualmite tungah na pia thei ding uh a, tua ahih kei leh zong gamdang mite tungah na zuak thei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note pen Topa na Pasian uh tungah a siangtho mi na hi uh hi. "Keelno a pi' nawizu tawh na huan kei ding uh hi.
"A kum kumin na lo uhah a piang, na khaici panun a piang khempeuh sawm-ah-khat na pia ding uh hi.
Topa na Pasian uh na zahtak tawntung nading uh na theih nadingun, ama min a ten nadingin a teelna mun Topa note' Pasian' mai-ah na an uh, na leenggahzu uh, na sathau uh sawm-ah-khat, le na bawnghon uh le na tuuhon tacilte uh na ne ding uh hi.
Topa na Pasian un a min koih nadingin a teelna mun pen, Topa na Pasian un no thupha hong piak ciangin note kiang panin gamla lua a, no a dingin lam a sau luat manin sawm-ah-khat na paipih zawh kei uhleh,
tuate sum na suah ding uh a, a sumte tunin, Topa na Pasian un a teelna munah na pai ding uh a,
na deih peuhpeuh uh bawng ahi a, tuu ahi a, leenggahzu ahi a, khamtheihzu ahi zongin, na duh peuhpeuh uh leina-in a sum na zang ding uh hi. Topa na Pasian uh mai tua lai munah na ne ding uh a, note le na innkuanpihte uh na lungdam ding uh hi.
"Note bangin amaute in tanh le luah nei lo ahih manin na khuasung uha om Levi mite na mangngilh kei ding uh hi.
"Kum thum simin tua kum-a note' anpiang sawm-ah-khat khempeuh hong paikhiatpihin na khuasung uhah na khol ding uh hi.
Topa na Pasian un na sepnate khempeuh uhah thupha hong piak theih nadingin, note tawh kibangin amaute in tanh ahi a, luah ahi zongin nei lo uh ahih manin note' khua sunga om Levi mite, peemtate, pa nei lote, leh meigong numeite hong pai-in tua ante ne-in a gilvah ding uh hi.
"Kum sagih a cin simin leiba maisakna na nei ding uh hi.
Maisak nading zia in: Leitawi a pia mi khempeuh in a vengte tungah leitawi a a piaksate maisak ding hi. Topa' maisakna thu kigen khin ahih manin a vengpa, a sanggampa' tung pan kuamah in leiba siik nawn lo ding hi.
Gamdang mite' tung pan na siik thei ding uh a, ahih hangin na sanggamte uh tung panin no-a' hong bat peuhmah na maisak ding uh hi.
"Ahih hangin tuni-a kong gen hih thupiakna khempeuh zui-in Topa note' Pasian' aw na ngaih nak-uhleh note' lakah a zawng om lo ding hi (bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian un na neih dingun gamhluahin hong piak leitang tungah Topa in note thupha hong pia ding hi).
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian un hong ciamsa bangin note thupha hong pia ding a, minam tampi tungah leitawi na pia ding uh a, ahih hangin note in lei na tawi kei ding uh hi. Minam tampite na uk ding uh a, ahih hangin amaute in note hong uk lo ding uh hi.
" Topa na Pasian un note hong piak gam sunga na khuate uh khat peuhpeuh sungah na sanggam khat uh note lakah a zawng a om leh na lungsim uh khauhsak loin, na sanggam zawng pa uh huh loin na om kei ding uh hi.
Ama tungah na cingh gamtat ding uh a, bangbang hitaleh ama kisap zah na leitawi ding uh hi.
Na lungsim uhah ngaihsutna hoih lo omin, 'Kum sagihna, maisakna kum hong nai hi,' ci-in na sanggampa galmi et-in amah bangmah na piak loh uh ciangin na langkhatah Topa' tungah amah kiko-in, no tungah khialhna a suahkhak ding kingaihsun un.
Citna tawh amah na pia ding uh a, amah na piak uh ciangin lungsim neihna na nei kei ding uh hi. Topa na Pasian un na sepna na hihna khempeuh uhah hih thu hangin note thupha hong pia ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh leitang tungah mizawng bei ngei lo ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin, 'Gam sungah a om na sanggampa, na a kisam mite le mizawngte tungah na cingh mahmah ding uh hi,' ci-in thu kong pia hi.
"Na sanggampa, Hebru pasal khat ahi a, Hebru numei khat ahi zongin nang tungah hong kizuak leh, amah in nangma na kum guk sung hong sem ding a, a kum sagihna ciangin nang kiang panin a suakta-in na paikhiasak ding hi.
Na kiang panin a suakta-in na paikhiatsak ciangin khuthawm guakin na paisak kei ding hi.
Na tuuhon lak, na ancilna le na leenggah sukna panin citna tawh tampi na pia ding a, Topa na Pasian in nang thupha hong piak zahin amah na pia ding hi.
Egypt gamah sila na hihna uh le Topa na Pasian un note hong suahtaksakna na phawk ding uh hi. Tua ahih manin hih thu tuni-in kong pia hi.
"Ahih hangin amah in note nuam hong sa-in, nang le na innkuanpihte hong it ahih manin 'Nang kiang panin ka paikhia kei ding hi,' hong cih leh,
phimpi khat la-in, kongkhak dapphahin a bil na vut ding a, na sila hi tawntung ding hi. Na sila numei zong tua bangmahin na hih ding hi.
Na kiang panin a suakta-in amah na paisak ciangin haksa sa kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh a kicial nasem thaman lang tawh amah in nangma na kum guk sung hong sem khinzo hi. Tua ahih ciangin Topa na Pasian un na hihna khempeuh uhah thupha hong pia ding hi.
"Na bawnghon uh le na tuuhon uh panin tacil a pa khempeuh Topa note' Pasian' tungah na ap ding uh hi. Na bawnghon tacilte uh tawh na na sem kei ding uh a, na tuuhon tacilte uh zong a mul na met kei ding uh hi.
Topa in a teelna munah a kum kumin Topa note' Pasian' mai-ah na innkuanpihte uh tawh na ne ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin poina khatpeuh, a khebai a mittaw, ahih kei leh poina lian khat peuhpeuh a neih leh, Topa note' Pasian' tungah biakna-in na pia kei ding uh hi.
Na khuasung uhah na ne ding uh hi. Sanang ahi a, sakhi ahi zongin a kinek bangin mi nin le mi siangte in a kibangin ne thei ding uh hi.

"Vasabu khat, sing tung ahi a, leilakah ahi zongin, a no ahi a, a tui ahi zongin omin, a pi in a no a ompih ahi a, a op ahi zongin na muh khak zenzen uhleh, a pi pen a no tawh na la khawm kei ding uh hi.

"Na inn tung panun mi khat kia-in mi sihna hanga mawhna na innsung uhah na tunsak khak loh nadingun inn thak na lam uh ciangin na innkhumzang uhah tangban na khung ding uh hi.
"Na leenggui lo uhah khaici nam nih na vawh kei ding uh hi. Vawh le-uh cin na vawh uh an le na leenggui lo uhah a piang khempeuh a nin suak ding hi.
"Bawngtal khat le la khat tawh lo na khokhawm kei ding uh hi.
"Samul le khau a kigankhawm puan na silh kei ding uh hi.
"Na puanza uh kiu lite tungah puanmongteep na bawl ding uh hi.
a zumhuai gamtatna tawh tua nu mawhsakin, 'Keimah in hih numei ka la a, amah tawh ka lupkhop ciangin ama sungah nungakna lim ka mu kei hi,' cihna tawh tua nu tungah minsia a tut leh,
tua numei' nu le a pa in a tanu uh' nungakna lim a kilatna puan lakhia-in upate kiang kongpi-ah paipih ding uh hi.
Numei' pa in upate kiangah, 'Hih mipa tungah a zi dingin ka tanu ka pia a, amah in deih nawn lo a,
"Na tanu' sungah nungakna lim ka mu kei hi," cihna tawh a zumhuai-in amah mawhsak hi. Ahi zongin hihte pen ka tanu' nungakna a kilatna limte ahi hi,' ci-in a puan lak ding hi. Amaute in khua upate mai-ah a puan phah ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua khua upate in tua mipa la-in sat ding uh hi.
Amaute in ngun shekel zakhat liausak ding uh a, a numei' pa' tungah tuate pia ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Israel nungak tungah minsia tun hi. Tua ciangin a numei pen ama zi mah hi ding a, a nuntak laiteng tua nu ma thei lo ding hi.
"Ahih hangin a mawhsakna thumanin, numei sungah nungakna lim a kimuh kei takpi leh,
amaute in a pa' inn kongah a numei paipih ding uh a, ama khuapi pasalte in suang tawh amah denglum ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a pa' inn sungah paktat gamtatna tawh Israel sungah haina tun hi. Tua bangin note' lak panin siatna na siangsak ding uh hi.
"Mi khat, midang khat' zi tawh a lumkhawm a kimuh leh, numei tawh a lum pa le a numei, a nih tuakun kithat ding hi. Tua bangin Israel sung panin siatna na siangsak ding uh hi.
"A kidongsa nungak khat om a, mi khat in khuapi sungah tua nu tuakin amah tawh a lupkhop leh,
tua khuapi kongpi-ah amau tegel na paipih ding uh a, a numei khuapi sungah a om hinapi-in mi' huhna ngen dingin a kiko lohna hang le, tua pasal in a vengpa' zi a va suksakna hangin, suang tawh a nihun na denglum ding uh hi. Tua bangin note' lak panin siatna na siangsak ding uh hi.
"Ahih hangin mi khat in a kidongsa nungak khat gamlakah tuakin, mipa in tua nu buanin a luppih leh, tua numei tawh a lum mipa bek kithat ding hi.
A numei' tungah bangmah na hih kei ding uh hi. Numei' tungah sih nading mawhna om lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih thu pen mi khat in a vengpa do-in a thah tawh kibang hi.
Hih mipa in gamlakah numei hih ahih manin, a kidongsa numei in huhna ngen dingin a kiko hangin amah a hon ding kuamah om lo hi.
"Mi khat in a kidong nai lo nungak khat tuakin, tua numei buanin luppih a, amau tegel a kimuh leh,
numei tawh a lum pa in nungak' pa tungah ngun shekel sawmnga pia ding a, tua numei ama zi hi ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a numei va su khin hi. A nuntak laiteng tua numei ma thei lo ding hi.
"Mi khat in a pa' zidangte tenpih lo ding a, a pa-a' ahi numei tawh mawh lo ding hi.
"A ciltang a kitam ahih kei leh, a pasal na a cing lo mipa Topa a' ding kikhopna sungah lut lo ding hi.
"Zawlta peuhmah, Topa a' ding kikhopna sungah lut lo ding hi. A suan a khak khang sawmna dong nangawnin Topa a' ding kikhopna sungah tua bang mi kuamah lut thei lo ding hi.
"Ammon mite ahi a, Moab mite ahi zongin Topa a' ding kikhopna sungah lut thei lo ding uh hi. A khang sawmna dong nangawnun Topa a' ding kikhopna sungah lut thei ngei peuhmah lo ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt panin na paikhiat lai-un lampi-ah anletui tawh amaute in note hong dawn lo uh a, note hong samsia dingin Mesopotamia gam Pethor khua panin Beor' tapa Balaam cial uh hi.
Ahih hangin Topa na Pasian un Balaam' thu ngai lo hi. Topa na Pasian un note hong it ahih manin, Topa na Pasian un samsiatna pen note a dingin thupha-in hong heisakzaw hi.
Amaute' nopsak nading ahi a, a daupai nading uh ahi zongin na khantawnun na hanciam kei ding uh hi.
"Edom mite khatpeuh na mudah kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute na sanggam uh ahi hi. Egypt mi khatpeuh na mudah kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau' gamah peemta na hi ngei uh hi.
Amaute' sung pana piang a khang thumna mite a kipan Topa a' ding kikhopna sungah lut thei ding uh hi.
"Na galte uh a do dingin kuanin giahphual ah na om uh ciangin, siatna nam khempeuh panin nomau na kikem ding uh hi.
Note lakah, zan sungin ama tungah thupiang hangin a siang lo mi a om leh giahphual pualamah amah paikhia ding a, giahphual sungah hong pai lo ding hi.
Ahih hangin nitak ciangin amahmah tui sungah kisil ding a, ni a tum ciangin giahphual sungah hong paithei ding hi.
"Giahphual pua-ah awnghawh nading mun khat na nei ding uh hi.
Na galhiamte uh banah tulzum khat na nei ding uh a, awng na hawh khit uh ciangin tua tawh lei to-in, na ek uh na vuk ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh note hong hon ding le note' mai-a na galte uh a hong pia dingin Topa na Pasian uh na giahphual laizang uhah hong pai hi. Tua ahih ciangin note lakah a kilawm lo nate a muh loh nading le note kiang panin amah a paikhiat loh nadingin na giahphual uh siangtho ding hi.
"A topa' kiang panin no kiangah a hong tai sila, a topa kiang mahah na apkik kei ding uh hi.
Na khuapite uh lak panin ama teelna mun, ama lungkim penna, note lakah note tawh amah hong teng ding a, amah na nengniam kei ding uh hi.
"Israel ta numeite biakinn sunga a paktat pawlin om lo ding uh a, Israel tapate zong a paktat pawlin om lo ding uh hi.
A paktat nu a kiguaihna sum ahi a, a paktat pa a kiguaihna sum ahi zongin thuciamna khat peuhpeuh piakna-in Topa note' Pasian' inn sungah na paipih kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih tegel pen Topa note' Pasian' tungah a kihhuai ahi hi.
"Na sanggampa tungah sumgum hitaleh, ankhing hitaleh, a meet ngaihsutna-in na khat peuhpeuh leitawi na pia kei ding uh hi.
Gamdang mi tungah a meetin leitawi na pia thei ding uh a, ahih hangin na sanggampa tungah a meetin leitawi na pia kei ding uh hi. Hihte pen a luah dingin na tumna uh gam sungah Topa na Pasian un na sepna khempeuh uhah thupha hong piak theih nading ahi hi.
" Topa note' Pasian' tungah thuciamna na bawl ciangun na ciamna uh tungsak loin na ommawk kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian un hong kal teekteek ding a, note tungah khialhna hong hi ding hi.
Ahih hangin thuciamna bawl ding pan na kikep uhleh note' sungah khialhna om lo ding hi.
Na kam uh tawh na ciamsa uh thu pen Topa note' Pasian' tungah nomau utthu-a na ciam uh ahih manin na kam uh panin a gingkhia peuhmah na tunsak ding uh na ngaihsun ding uh hi.
"Na vengpa' leenggui lo-ah na pai uh ciangin na ut zahzah uh na kham dong uh leenggah na ne thei ding uh a, ahih hangin na van sung uhah na guang kei ding uh hi.
"Mi khat in zi la-in a tenpih ciangin, tua nu tungah kilawm lohna a om manin numei in a pasal' mitah maipha mu lo a, amah in makna lai gelhin ama tungah pia-in ama inn panin sawlkhia a, a pasal' inn panin amah kihem khia-in,
a pasal nunung in amah deih lo leuleu a, makna lai gelhin a numei' khut sungah koih a, a inn panin tua nu sawlkhia-in, tua ahih kei leh zi dinga a la a pasal nunung a sih leh,
tua numei a hawlkhia a pasal masa in, tua nu a kinitsak khit ciangin a zi dingin lakik thei nawn lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen Topa' mai-ah kihhuaina hi a, Topa note' Pasian un luah dingin hong piak leitang tungah mawhna na tunpih kei ding uh hi.
"Mi khat in zi a neih tungin galkapte tawh kuankhia lo ding a, nasep khat peuhpeuh zong kisawl lo ding hi. A laksa a zi tawh a lungdam khawm dingin inn-ah kum khat sung maang ding hi.
"Kuamah in an gawina ahi a, an gawina suangpek a tungnung ahi zongin khapna-in la lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh khapna-in nuntakna a la suak ding hi.
"Mi khat in Israel mi a sanggamte khat gu-in, amah in sila bangin a bawl ahi a, a zuak ahi zongin a kimuh leh, tua guta pa kithat ding hi. Tua bangin note' lak panin siatna na siangsak ding uh hi.
"Phaknatna hong tun ciangin Levi siampite in hong gen bangin na gamtat ding uh ngaihsun un. Amaute ka thupiakna bangin na gamtatna dingun na kingaihsun ding uh hi.
Egypt panin na paikhiat lai-un lampi-ah Topa na Pasian un Miriam' tungah a hihna phawk un.
"Na vengte uh tungah na khat peuhpeuh leitawi na piak uh ciangin ama hong khapna a la dingin a inn-ah pai kei un.
A pualamah na ding ding uh a, leitawi na piakna mipa in nang kiangah a na khap hong paipih ding hi.
Amah mizawng ahihleh ama hong khap puan na zantaamsak kei ding uh a,
ni a tum ciangin, a puanza silhin nang thupha hong piak theihna dingin tua hong na khap ama kiangah na piakik ding uh hi. Tua pen Topa note' Pasian' mai-ah note a dingin thumanna hi ding hi.
"A zawng a cimawh a kicial nasempa, na sanggamte khat ahi a, na gam sung na khuapite sunga om peemta khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin, na nengniam kei ding uh hi.
A sep ni-in ama thaman, nitum ma-in na pia ding uh hi (bang hang hiam cih leh amah zawng a, tua bek a lungsimah om hi). Tua hikeileh Topa' tungah amah in hong khia ding a, note na mawh ding uh hi.
"Tate' tangin pate kithat lo ding a, pate' tangin zong tate kithat lo ding hi. Mi khempeuh ama khialhna hang bekin kithat ding hi.
"Peemta' thu ahi a, pa nei lo mi' thu ahi zongin tuate a' ding thutang na heisak kei ding uh a, meigong numei' puan zong khapna-in na laksak kei ding uh hi.
Egypt-ah sila na hihna uh le Topa note' Pasian in tua lai panin hong hotkhiatna na phawk ding uh hi. Tua ahih manin hih banga na gamtat nading uh thu kong pia hi.
"Na lo-ah an la-in lo lai-ah anlom na mangngilh uh ciangin a tawm dingin na paikik kei ding uh hi. Tuate pen peemta, pa nei lo, le meigong numeite a' ding ahi hi. Hih pen Topa note' Pasian in na khut uh tawh na sepna khempeuh uhah note thupha hong piak theih nading ahi hi.
Na oliv kungte uh na sat uh ciangin a hiangte na sat kikkik kei ding uh hi. Tuate pen peemta, pa nei lo, le meigong numeite a' ding ahi hi.
Na leenggui lo panun leenggah na kaihkhop uh ciangin a sang na nung khop kik kei ding uh hi. Tuate pen peemta, pa nei lo, le meigong numeite a' ding ahi hi.
Egypt gamah sila na hihna uh na phawk ding uh hi. Tua ahih manin hih bangin na gamtat nadingun thu kong pia hi.
"Mite kikalah thu kineihna om a, thukhen zumah amaute pai-in, thukhente in amau' thu khensakin, a dikpa khahin a mawh pa lelsak a,
a mawh pa satna thuak dinga kilawm ahihleh, thukhen pa in amah lumsuksakin a khialhna zahin ama muhin satsak ding hi.
Sat sawmli kipia thei ding a, ahih hangin tua val hi lo ding hi. Tua hikeileh, hih sangin a tamvei zaw mi khat in sat lai leh note' muhna-ah na sanggampa uh a kineubawl suak ding hi.
"Bawng in an a cil laitakin a muk na tuam kei ding uh hi.
"Sanggam pasalte teng khawmin, tuate khat si-in tapa a neih kei le, a sipa' zi pen innkuan pualam khualmi tawh kiteng lo ding hi. A pasal' sanggampa in luppihin a zi dingin amah la ding a, ama tungah pasal' sanggampa' nasep sem ding hi.
Ama min Israel tungah a maiman' loh nadingin tua nu in a neih masak a tapa pen a sisa a pasal' ta-in kiseh ding hi.
Mipa in a sanggampa' zi a laknop kei leh, upate kiang kongpi-ah a sanggampa' zi pai ding a, 'Ka pasal' sanggampa in a sanggampa' min Israel sungah a zop ding ut lo a, pasal' sanggampa' nasep kei tungah hong sem nuam lo hi,' ci ding hi.
Tua ciangin mipa' khuapi upate in amah samin thu genpih ding uh hi. Amah in, 'Tua nu ka la nuam kei hi,' a cih teitei leh,
upate' omin a sanggampa' zi ama kiangah paito-in a khe panin a khedap kaihkhiatsakin a maitang cilphih ding hi. Tua ciangin tua nu in, 'A sanggampa' innkuan a zomto lo mipa hih bangin kibawl ta hen,' cikhia ding hi.
Israel mite lakah ama innkuan pen, 'A khedap a kikaih khiatsak mipa' innkuan,' kici ding hi.
"Mi khatlekhat a kilai ciangin, a satpa' kiang panin a pasal a honkhia dingin a khat pa' zi hong pai a, a khutin a selsimte a matsak leh,
tua nu' khut na sattansak ding uh a, amah na hehpih kei ding uh hi.
"Na ipsung uhah tawisuang nam nih, a lian le a neu, na neikhawm kei ding uh hi.
Na innsung uhah tehna nam nih, a lian le a neu, na neikhawm kei ding uh hi.
Tawisuang a cing a man na nei ding uh a, tehna a cing a man na nei ding uh hi. Topa note' Pasian in hong piak leitangah na khan uh a sau theih nading ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh tua bangin gamta-in, a thuman lote khempeuh, Topa note' Pasian' tungah a kihhuai ahi hi.
"Egypt panin nong paikhiat lai-un lampi-ah Amalek mite in note hong bawlna,
note gimin lungkhamin na om laitakun lampi-ah a hong simna, le note' nungah a nunung khempeuh hong thahna uh phawk un; amaute in Pasian kihta lo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa note' Pasian in note' neih dingin gamh-in hong piak leitang tungah, Topa na Pasian un na kiim uha na galte khempeuh panun tawlngakna hong piak ciangin, mun khempeuh panin Amalek mite a kiphawkna na phiatkhiat ding uh na mangngilh kei ding uh hi.
" Topa na Pasian un luah dingin a hong piak leitangah va pai-in, tua leitang luahin a tungah na ten uh ciangin,
Topa na Pasian un a hong piak leitang pana piang gah khempeuh panin a gah masa pawlkhat la-in lawh khat sungah na koih ding uh a, ama min na omsak nadingun Topa na Pasian un a teelna munah na pai ding uh hi.
Tua hun laitakin na a sem siampipa kiangah pai-in ama kiangah, ' Topa in kote piak dingin ka pu ka pate uh tungah a ciam leitangah ka tun khitna uh tuni-in Topa na Pasian kiangah kong ko uh hi,' na ci ding uh hi.
"Tua ciangin siampipa in note' khut panin a lawh hong saang ding a, Topa note' Pasian biakna tau mai-ah koih ding hi.
" Topa note' Pasian mai-ah note in, 'A vak kawikawi kote' pupi pen Aram mi hi a, amah Egypt-ah paisukin tua munah a peem lai-in mi tawmno ahi hi. Tua lai-ah amah a lian, a thahat, tampi a pha minam khat a suak hi.
Egypt-te in kote hong ngong bawlin hong gimsak a, kote sal bangin hong bawl uh hi.
Tua ciangin ka pu ka pate uh Pasian ahi Topa Pasian' tungah ka kiko uh a, Topa in kote' aw hong za-in, ka gimnate uh, ka sepnate uh le hong netniamnate uh a mu hi.
Topa in a vangliatna le a thahatna, launa lianpi, lim le na lamdangte tawh Egypt panin kote hong paikhiatpih hi.
Amah in hih mun hong tunpihin, bawngnawi le khuaizu tui bangin a luanna gam hih leitang ko tungah hong pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin en in, Topa, nangmah in kote nong piaksa leitang panin a gah a min masa kong paipih uh hi,' na ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin Topa note' Pasian' mai-ah na koihsuk ding uh a, Topa note' Pasian' mai-ah na bia ding uh hi.
Topa note' Pasian in note le na innkuanpihte uh tungah hong piak na a hoih khempeuhte hangin note le Levi mite le note lakah a om peemtate na lungdam khawm ding uh hi.
"Sawm-ah-khat piak kum ahi, a kum thumna kumin, amaute in na khuapite uh sungah an ne-in, gilvahin a om theih nadingun Levi mite, peemtate, pa nei lote, le meigong numeite tungah na piak uh, na khawhsa uh sawm-ah-khat na piak khit uh ciangin,
Topa note' Pasian' mai-ah, 'Ka innsung panin a siangtho dingteng ka tuamkoih khin hi. Tua tham loin kei nong sawlna bangin na thupiaknate khempeuh tawh kizui-in Levi mite, peemtate, pa nei lote, le meigong numeite tungah ka pia khin hi. Hih tungtangah na thupiakna khat zong ka khial kei a, ka mangngilh zong om lo hi.
Dahin ka kah sungin zong sawm-ah-khat ka ne kei a, ka nit sungin zong ka khenkhia kei a, misite tungah zong ka pia kei hi. Topa ka Pasian' thu ka mang a, kei nong thupiakna khempeuh bangin ka hih khin hi.
Vantung, nangma omna a siangtho panin hong ensuk inla, kote' pulepate tungah bawngnawi le khuaizu tui bangin a luanna gam na ciam mah bangin, nangma mi Israel-te le na hong piaksa leitang thupha hong pia in,' na ci ding uh hi.
"Tuni-in Topa na Pasian un hih thukhamte le ngeina kipte na zuih ding uh note tungah thu hong pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin na lungsim khempeuh uh le na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh na hih ding uh limtakin na ngaihsun ding uh hi.
Tuni-in, Topa pen note' Pasian ahihna le note in ama lampite tawnin, ama thukhamte le ama thupiaknate le ama ngeina kipte zui-in, ama thu na man' ding uh na gen khin uh hi.
Tuni-in Topa in note pen amah in note tungah hong ciamsa bangin ama neih ding mi na hihna uh, le note in ama thupiaknate khempeuh na zuih nading uh,
ama bawlsa minam dangte khempeuh sangin phatna le minthanna le pahtawina a lianzaw a ngahin hong koih nading, le ama gensa mah bangin Topa note' Pasian a dingin a siangtho mi na hih nading uh hong gen khin hi," a ci hi.
Tu-in Moses le Israel upate in mite thu pia-in, "Tuni-a kong gen uh thupiakna khempeuh na zui ding uh hi.
Topa na Pasian un note hong piak leitangah pai dingin Jordan na kantan ni-un suangtumpite na phut ding uh a, buan tawh na zut ding uh hi.
Na pu na pate uh Pasian ahi Topa in note tungah hong ciam mah bangin bawngnawi le khuaizu tui bangin a luanna leitang, Topa na Pasian un note hong piakna gamah a lut dingin na galkah uh ciangin tua suangte tungah hih thute na gelh ding uh hi.
Jordan na galkah khit uh ciangin Ebal Mual tungah tuni-a kong thupiakna uh tawh kizui-in hih suangte na phut ding uh a, buan tawh tua suangte na zut ding uh hi.
Tua lai-ah Topa na Pasian uh a dingin suang kibawl biakna tau khat na bawl ding uh a, tuate tungah sik tawh a kibawl nazatte na liik kei ding uh hi.
Topa na Pasian uh a dingin a kiseek lo suangtumte tawh biakna tau na bawl ding uh a, tua biakna tau tungah Topa na Pasian uh a dingin meihal biaknate na pia ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin thunuama biaknate na pia ding uh a, tua lai munah ne-in, Topa na Pasian uh mai-ah na lungdam ding uh hi.
Hih thute khempeuh tua suangte tungah a kitel takin na gelh ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Moses le Levi siampite in Israel-te khempeuh tungah, "Israel-te aw, gamdai unla ngai un: Tuni-in Topa note' Pasian' mi na suak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa note' Pasian' thu mangin, tuni-a kong gen uh ama thupiaknate le ama thukhamte na zui ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Moses in tua ni mahin mite thuhilhin,
"Jordan na galkah khit uh ciangin mite thupha a pia dingin Gerizim Mual tungah a ding ding minamte: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issakhar, Josef, le Benjamin ahi hi.
Ebal Mual tungah hamsia a pia dingin a ding ding minamte: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, le Naftali ahi hi.
Levi mite in awging lianpi tawh Israel mite khempeuh tungah hih bangin ci ding uh hi.
"' Topa a dingin a kihhuai ahi, khutsiampa' khut tawh a kibawl, a kiseek ahi a, a kisung ahi zongin milim bawlin, mun simthamah a koih mipa in gimna ngah ta hen,' ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in dawngin, 'Amen,' ci ding uh hi.
"'A nu ahi a, a pa ahi zongin a zahtak lo mipa in gimna ngah ta hen,' ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, 'Amen,' ci ding uh hi.
"'A vengpa' gisuang a botkhia mipa in gimna ngah ta hen,' ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, 'Amen,' ci ding uh hi.
"'Mittaw pa lam a lakkhial mipa in gimna ngah ta hen,' ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, 'Amen,' ci ding uh hi.
"'Peemta, pa nei lo, le meigong numeite a' ding thutang a heikhiatsak mipa in gimna ngah ta hen,' ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, 'Amen,' ci ding uh hi.
"'Amah in a pa' tungah maizumna tun ahih manin, a pa' zidang tawh a lumkhawm mipa in gimna ngah ta hen,' ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, 'Amen,' ci ding uh hi.
"'Ganhing khat peuhpeuh tawh nulepa mawhna a bawl mipa in gimna ngah ta hen,' ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, 'Amen,' ci ding uh hi.
"'A nu' tanu, a pa' tanu, ahih kei leh a sanggamnu tawh a lumkhawm mipa in gimna ngah ta hen,' ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, 'Amen,' ci ding uh hi.
"'A sungnu tawh a lumkhawm mipa in gimna ngah ta hen,' ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, 'Amen,' ci ding uh hi.
"'Mawhna nei lopa thah nadingin sumgolh a la mipa in gimna ngah ta hen,' ci ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, 'Amen,' ci ding uh hi.
"Note in Topa na Pasian uh thu mangin, tuni-a kong gen ama thupiakna khempeuh limtakin na zuih uhleh Topa na Pasian un leitung minam dangte khempeuh sangin a lianzaw-in note hong bawl ding hi.
Topa na Pasian uh thu na man' uhleh hih thuphate khempeuh note tungah hong tung ding hi.
"Khuapi sungah thupha ngah mi na hi ding uh a, lote-ah zong thupha ngah mi mah na hi ding uh hi.
"Note' sung pana piangte, le na leitang uh pana piangte, le na ganhing uh pana piang, na bawngte uh pungin na tuuhonte uh tungah thupha om ding hi.
"Na seengte uh le na annel mekna kuangte uhah thupha om ding hi.
"Na sepna khempeuh uhah thupha na ngah ding uh hi.
" Topa in, note' langah hong pang na galte uh na mai uhah lelhna thuaksak ding hi. Amaute lampi khat tawnin hong kuan ding uh a, note' mai panin lam sagih tawnin taikeek ding uh hi.
" Topa in note' ansal tung le na hihna khempeuh uhah thupha hong puak ding hi. Topa na Pasian un note hong piakna leitangah amah in note tungah thupha hong pia ding hi.
"Note in Topa na Pasian uh hong thupiaknate zui-in ama lampi na tot uhleh amah in note tungah hong ciamsa bangin ama a dingin a siangtho mi dingin Topa in note hong kipsak ding hi.
Topa in note hong sapna thu midang khempeuh in thei ding uh a, amaute in note hong kihta ding uh hi.
Note piak dingin na pu na pate uh tungah Topa in a ciamsa gam sungah note' sung pana piangte, na gan khawi pan uha piangte, le na leitang pan uha piangte-ah Topa in note nakpitakin hong hausak ding hi.
Note' leitangah ama hunin guah a zusak ding le na sepna khempeuh uh thupha a pia dingin Topa in a na hoih kholna vantung note hong hon ding hi. Note in minam tampite tungah leitawi na pia ding uh a, ahih hangin note in leitawi na la kei ding uh hi.
Note in tuni-a kong thugente limtakin zuihna tawh Topa na Pasian uh thupiaknate mangin, tuni-a no kong thupiakna kammalte panin, pasian dangte' na semin a bia dingin na pial kei nak-uhleh, Topa in a makai-in note hong bawl ding a, mi' nung zui-in hong bawl lo ding hi. Tunglam bekah na kah ding uh a, na nuaikiat ngei kei ding uh hi.
"Ahih hangin note in Topa na Pasian uh thu mang loin, tuni-a kong gen ama thupiaknate le ama thukhamte khempeuh limtakin na zuih kei uhleh, hih samsiatna khempeuh note tungah hong tung ding a, note hong ban ding hi.
"Khuapi sungah hong kisamsia ding a, lo-ah zong hong kisamsia ding hi.
"Na lawhte uh le na annel mekna kuangte un zong samsiatna ngah ding hi.
"Note' sung pana piangte le na leitang uh pana piangte, na bawngte uh le na tuuhon note uh in zong samsiatna ngah ding hi.
"Na sep na bawlna khempeuh uhah hamsia na ngah ding uh hi.
"Note in Topa na nusiat uh a, na gamtatsiat uhleh, note sia-in na sihmang khit matengun Topa in note tungah samsiatna, buaina, cihmawhnate hong tungsak ding hi.
A luah dingin na lutna uh leitang panin note hong beisak matengin note lakah pulnatna a tun nadingin Topa in bawl ding hi.
Topa in pulnatna le cisa natna, meima nasia le a sa mahmah keutumna, huihpi' mutgawpna le a nom tawh note hong vatgawp ding a, note na sih matengun tuate na thuak ding uh hi.
Topa in na gam sung uha guahte tang dingin leivui le sehnel hong zusak ding a, note na sih matengun vantung panin note tungah tuate hong kiasuk ding hi.
" Topa in na galte uh mai-ah note hong guallelsak ding hi. Amaute a do dingin lam khatah na kuan khawm ding uh a, amau' mai-ah lam sagihin na taikeek ding uh hi. Leitung kumpi gamte khempeuh' muhna-ah note a cikzethuai na hi ding uh hi.
Note' luanghawmte pen huih lak a leeng vasate khempeuh le leitung a ganhingte khempeuh' an hi ding a, tuate a bengkhia ding mihing om lo ding hi.
Topa in note na damkik theih loh nading uh Egypt meimatumte le meima daite, meima lipneite le cithak tawh note hong vatgawp ding hi.
Topa in haina, mittawtna, le lungsim buaina tawh note hong vatgawp ding hi.
Mittawte in khuamial lakah khua a zawt bangin sunin khua na zawt ding uh a, na hihnate uhah na maavang kei ding uh hi. Note hong kinengniamin na tate uh hong kisut niloh ding a, note hong huh ding kuamah om lo ding hi.
"Zi dingin lawm khat na dong ding uh a, midang khat in na luppih ding hi. Inn na lam ding uh a, tua sungah na teng kei ding uh hi. Leenggui lo na zuan ding uh a, a gah na ne kha kei ding uh hi.
Na muh tangpi-un na bawngtal uh kigo ding a, a sa na ne kha kei ding uh hi. Note' mai panin na la uh hong kingawh laksak ding a, note kiangah hong kipia kik nawn lo ding hi. Na tuute uh na galte uh tungah kipia ding a, note hong huh ding kuamah om lo ding hi.
Na theih nai loh uh minam khat in na leitang panun a piangte le na nasepsa khempeuh uh ne tum ding a, note hong kinengniamin hong kisugawp tawntung lel ding hi.
Topa in note na kidamsakkik theih loh ding uh a nasia mahmah meimatumte tawh na khukte uh le na khete uh meimasak gawpin, na khenuai panun na luzang dong uhah na thuak ding uh hi.
"Note le na pu na pate un a theih ngei loh minam khat kiangah Topa in note le note tungah na koih uh na kumpipa uh hong tunpih ding a, tua lai-ah singlesuang tawh a kibawl pasian dangte' na na sem ding uh hi.
Topa in note hong paikhiatpihna mite lakah a cikzethuai, paunak, le gentehna na suak ding uh hi.
"Khaici tampi lo-ah na tuh ding uh a, ahi zongin tawmno bek na khawm ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kauphe in nemang ding hi.
Note in leenggah lo zuanin na puah ding uh a, ahih hangin leenggahzu dawn loin, leenggah zong na ne kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh lung in tuate ne ding hi.
Tanute le tapate na nei ding uh a, ahih hangin amaute pen nomau a' hi lo ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute galmat suak ding uh hi.
Na singte khempeuh uh le, na leitang panun a piang khempeuh kauphete in tang ding uh hi.
"Note lakah a om peemtate lian semsem ding uh a, note na neu semsem ding uh hi.
Amaute in note' tungah leitawi hong pia ding uh a, note in amaute tungah leitawi na pia kei ding uh hi. Amaute a makai hi-in, note a nungzui na hi ding uh hi.
"Amah in note hong piak thupiaknate le thukhamte zui loin, Topa na Pasian uh thu mang lo na hih manun, note na sih matengun hih samsiatnate khempeuh note' tungah hong tungin, note hong delhin hong pha ding uh hi.
Note le na suanlekhakte uh tungah a tawntungin tuate pen lim le nalamdang hi ding hi.
Hih a tampi nate khempeuh om napi-in note in lungdamna le lungsim kipahna tawh Topa note' Pasian' na sem lo na hih manun,
Topa in note' langah a hong sawl ding na galte uh' na, gilkialna le dangtakna, pum guakin omna, le na khempeuh kitangsapna tawh, na sem ding uh hi. Na galte un note hong suksiat matengin note' ngawngah sik hakkol hong thuah ding uh hi.
Topa in a gamlapi leimong panin muvanlai leeng bangin a manlang, amau' pau na theih loh uh minam, thukhualna a nei lo minam, khangham mite a zahtak lo, khangno mite tungah maipha zong a lak tuan lo minam khat, note' langkhatah hong paipih ding a,
note na sih matengun amaute in na ganhon note uh le na leitang panun a piang gahte hong neksak ding uh hi. Amaute in note hong beisak matengun note a dingin an, leenggahzu, ahih kei leh sathau, na ganhingte uh ahih kei leh na tuuhon note uh zong hong nusiat lo ding uh hi.
Na gam sung uha a om na muan uh, a sang a muanhuai na kulhpite uh a cip khit dong matengin note' khuapite khempeuh sungah amaute in note hong umcih ding uh hi. Topa na Pasian un note hong piaksa na gam sung khempeuh uhah a om na khuapite khempeuh sung uhah note hong umcih ding uh hi.
"Na galte un hong umcihna le hong lungkhamsak nading ahi na lungkham hun sung uhah Topa na Pasian un note a hong piaksa, na sung panun a piang na tanute uh le na tapate uh' sate na ne ding uh hi.
Note lakah a ngeksuak, a cithei pen mipa in a sanggampa, a it a zi, le amah tawh a om a tate a nunung pen' tungah an pia nuam lo ding hi.
Na khuapite khempeuh sung uhah hong umcihna le na galte un note hong lungkhamsak nading hun sungah bangmah kinei nawn lo ding ahih manin ama nek a tate' sate kuamah in midang hawm nuam lo ding hi.
Note lakah a om a ngeksuak, a cithei pen numei, amah ngekin a ci neel lua ahih manin a khenuai tawh lei sik ding a ngaihsun ngei vet lo nu in a it a pasal, a tanute le a tapate a dingin ama sung panin a piang a tate le ama sung panin a paikhia a nau-nungzuite phal lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hong umcihna le na galte un na khuapite uhah note hong lungkhamsak nading lungkhamna sungah bangmah neih lohna hangin amah in tuate nesim ding hi.
"Hih a minthang, a zahtakhuai min, Topa na Pasian uh na kihtak theih nadingun hih laibu sunga kigelh hih thute limtakin zuih ding na ngaihsut kei uhleh,
Topa in note le na suan na khakte uh tungah nasia-in sauvei a om gimna, gimna a tuan diak, le a nasia, nat saute hong tungsak ding hi.
Amah in note' kihtak Egypt natnate note' tungah hong tungsakkik ding a, note' tungah tuate kilawi lo ding hi.
Note na siat matengun hih thukham laibu sungah a kiciamteh lo natna le gimna khempeuh zong Topa in no tungah hong tungsak ding hi.
Note, vantung aksite zahin a tam na hihna sung uhah tawmno bek na pha ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian uh thu na mang kei uh hi.
Topa in note tungah a hong bawlna le note tampi hong phaksakna-ah nuam a sak mah bangin, note tungah siatna tunsakna le note suksiatna-ah zong Topa in nuamsa ding a, a luah dingin na lutna uh leitang panin note hong kilakhia ding hi.
