Tua ciangin David leilak panin tho-in kisil a, sathau nilhin a puante khek a, Topa' inn-ah pai-in Pasian a bia hi. Tua ciangin ama inn-ah ciah hi. An a nget ciangin amaute in a mai-ah lui uh a, amah in a ne hi.
Tua ciangin a nasemte in ama kiangah, "Hih banga na gamtatna a bangci hiam? Naungek a hin lai-in an tangin na kap hi; ahih hangin naungek a sih ciangin tho-in an na ne zawsop hi," a ci uh hi.
Amah in, "Naungek a hin lai-in an tangin ka kap hi; bang hang hiam cih leh, 'Naungek a hin nadingin Topa in kei hong hehpih ding hiam, hong hehpih lo ding hiam, cih kua in theikhol ahi hiam?' ka ci hi.
Ahih hangin tu-in amah si ta hi; bang hangin an tang nawn ding ka hi hiam? Amah lakik thei ding ka hi hiam? Ama kiangah kei ka pai ding a, ahih hangin kei kiangah amah hong kik lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in a zi Bathsheba hehnem a, ama kiangah pai-in amah tawh a lumkhawm hi. Tua nu in tapa khat nei a, a min Solomon a phuak hi. Topa in tua naupang it ahih manin,
kamsang Nathan' tungah thu puak hi. Topa' itna hangin ama min Jedidiah a phuah ding a gen hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi a omlaiteng kaikhawm inla, khuapi langah phual satin khuapi la in; tua hikeileh keimah in khuapi la-in keima min pua kha ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in mi khempeuh kaikhawmin Rabbah-ah pai a, tua khuapi simin a la hi.
Tua ciangin amah in amau' pasian Molek lu tungah a om lukhu a laksak hi. Tua lukhu kham talen khat gik a, a sungah suangmanpha khat om hi. David' kumpi lukhu tungah tua suangmanpha kikoih hi. Tua ciangin amah in khuapi sunga vankinusiate tampi tak paikhiatpih hi.
Amah in a sunga om mite paikhiatpihin singatnate, tuzumte, le heite tawh na a sem dingin koih a, leiseek seekna-ah amaute na semsak hi. Tua bangin Ammon mite' khuapi khempeuh a hih hi. Tua ciangin David le mi khempeuh Jerusalem-ah a ciah uh hi.
Tu-in David' tapa Absalom in Tamar min nei sanggam numei a melhoih mahmah khat nei hi. Tawlkhat khit ciangin David' tapa Ammon in tua nu ngai hi.
Ammon in ngailua mahmah ahih manin a sanggamnu Tamar hangin cinat lawh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nungak le tangval kituam omsak ahih manin Ammon in tua nu a muhtheih nading omtheih tuaklo hi.
Ahih hangin Ammon in David' sanggampa Shimeah' tapa Jonadab min nei lawmpa khat nei a, Jonadab pen mi tei mahmah khat ahi hi.
Amah in Ammon kiangah, "Kumpipa' tapa aw, bang hangin zingsang khat khit zingsang khat thakiam semsem na hi hiam? Kei kiangah a hang hong gen lo ding na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Ammon in ama kiangah, "Ka sanggampa Absalom' sanggamnu Tamar ka ngai hi," a ci hi.
Jonadab in ama kiangah, "Na lupna tungah lum inla, a cina kineih in. Nangmah a veh dingin na pa hong pai ciangin ama kiangah, 'Keimah in mu-in ama khut panin an ka nek theih nadingin ka sanggamnu Tamar hong paisakin annek ding hong piasak inla, ka muhna-ah an hong bawl sak in,' ci in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Ammon lumin a cina kineih hi. Amah a en dingin kumpipa a pai ciangin Ammon in kumpipa kiangah, "Ama khut panin ka nek theih nadingin ka sanggamnu Tamar hong paisakin mohpheng nih khawng na bawlsak nading kong thum hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in inn-a Tamar kiangah mi sawlin, "Na sanggampa Ammon' inn-ah pai-in ama a' ding an bawlsak in," cisak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a sanggampa Ammon lumin a omna mun a inn-ah Tamar pai hi. Amah in annel lom la-in meek a, ama muhna-ah mohphengte bawlin a em hi.
Tua ciangin amah in sikbeeldai la-in ama mai-ah sungkhia a, ahih hangin amah in ne nuam lo hi. Tua ciangin Ammon in, "Kei kiang panin mi khempeuh sawlkhia masa in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin ama kiang panin mi khempeuh paikhia hi.
Tua ciangin Ammon in Tamar kiangah, "Na khut tung panin ka nek theih nadingin inndei sungah an hong paipih in," a ci hi. Tamar in a bawlsa mohphengte la-in inndei sung a sanggampa Ammon kiangah paipih hi.
Ahih hangin amah in a nek dingin ama kiang nai-ah a paipih ciangin, amah in tua numei lenin ama kiangah, "Hong pai in; kei tawh hong lum in ka sanggamnu aw," a ci hi.
Amah in dawngin, "Hilo hi, ka sanggampa aw, kei hong thatang hih kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh Israel sungah tua bangin kigamta lo hi. Hih bangin hai gamtat lua kei in.
Keimah in ka maizumna koi-ah seelcipzo ding ka hi hiam? Nang zong, Israel-te sungah mihai luate khat bang na hi ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in kong thum hi, kumpipa kiangah gen in; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in nang a dingin kei hong khaktan lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in a thugen ngai lo hi. Amah sangin hatzaw ahih manin thatanghat thu tawh hihin amah luppih hi.
Tua ciangin Ammon in nakpitakin Tamar mudah hi. Amah in a cil-a a itna zah sangin a muhdahna lianzaw hi. Tua ahih ciangin Ammon in ama kiangah, "Ding in, paikhia in," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a numei in ama kiangah, "Hilo hi, ka sanggampa aw; bang hang hiam cih leh kei nong sawlkhiatna pen kei tungah nong hihsa thu sangin lianzaw hi," a ci hi. Ahih hangin a thu ngai lo hi.
Amah in a nasem tangvalpa samin, "Ka omna panin hih numei koihkhia inla, ama nungah kongkhak kalh in," a ci hi.
Tua nu in puantualpi ban nei khat silh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa' tanute in tua bangin puan silh hi. Tua ahih ciangin a nasempa in tua nu koihkhia-in ama nungah kongkhak kalh hi.
Tua ciangin Tamar in a lu tungah vut koihin ama silh puantualpi bansau balkek hi. Tua ciangin a lu tungah a khut koihin paikhia a, a paikawmin a gingin a kap hi.
Tua ciangin a sanggampa Absalom in ama kiangah, "Na sanggampa Ammon in nang hong bawlsia ahi hiam? Bangbang hitaleh kilungnuamsak in, ka sanggamnu aw; amah pen na sanggampa ahi hi; hih thu na lungsimah koih kei in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin a sanggampa Absalom' inn-ah Tamar lungzuang khawngai-in a om hi.
Absalom in Ammon kiangah a pha ahi a, a sia ahi zongin bangmah gen vet lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a sanggamnu Tamar thatanghat thu tawh hih ahih manin Absalom in Ammon mudah lua mahmah hi.
Tua zawh kum nih bit khit ciangin Absalom in Efraim nai-a om Baalhazor-ah tuumul mette khawm a, Absalom in kumpipa' tapate khempeuh sam hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah Absalom hong pai-in, "En in, na nasempa in tuumul mette khawm hi; kumpipa le a nasemte na nasempa tawh nong pai ding kong thum hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in Absalom kiangah, "Hilo hi, ka tapa aw; i vekpi-in pai kei ni; pai lehang kote pen nang a dingin vangik ka hi kha ding uh hi," a ci hi. Amah in ci teitei a, ahih hangin amah pai nuam loin ama thupha a tungah a pia hi.
Tua ciangin Absalom in, "Tua bang hi lo ding ahihleh ka sanggampa Ammon kote tawh nong paisak ding kong thum hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Bang hangin nang tawh amah hong pai ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Absalom in Ammon le kumpipa' tapate khempeuh amah tawh a paisak mateng ci teitei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Absalom' nasemte in ama thupiaksa bangin Ammon hih uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa' tapate khempeuh dingin a la tung ciat uhah tuangin a tai uh hi.
Amaute lamkalah a om laitakin David kiangah thu tung a, "Absalom in kumpipa' tapate khempeuh that a, khat beek siit lo hi," kici hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa ding a, a puante balkekin leilakah a lum hi. A kianga om a nasemte khempeuh in zong a puan uh balkek uh hi.
Ahih hangin David' sanggampa Shimeah' tapa Jonadab in, "Amaute in kumpipa' tapa tangvalte khempeuh that hi, ci-in ka topa in ngaihsun kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh Ammon bek si hi. Amah in a sanggamnu Tamar thatanghat thu tawh a hih ni a kipanin Absalom' thupiakna tawh hih thu a kisehkhol ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa' tapate khempeuh si hi, ci-in ka topa in ngaihsunin na lungsimah koih kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh Ammon bek si hi," a ci hi.
Tua kikal sungin Absalom tai hi. Tua ciangin galvil tangvalpa a khuadak leh, mualpang nai Horonaim lampi panin mihon hong pai a mu hi.
Jonadab in kumpipa kiangah, "En in, kumpipa' tapate hong tungzo hi. Na nasempa' gen bangin hong piang takpi hi," a ci hi.
Amah in a thugen a man khit phetin, kumpipa' tapate hong tungin hong kap uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa zong a nasemte khempeuh tawh nakpitakin a kap uh hi.
Ahih hangin Absalom tai-in Geshur kumpipa Ammihud' tapa Talmai kiangah tung hi. Ni tampi sung David a tapa' hangin a thum hi.
Absalom ahihleh Geshur-ah pai a, tua lai-ah kum thum sung a om hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Absalom ngai-in hong mahmah hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah si hi, ci-in thei khin ahih manin Ammon' thu-ah kihehnem khin hi.
Tu-in kumpipa in Absalom a ngaihna thu Zeruiah' tapa Joab in a phawk hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Joab in Tekoa-ah mi sawlin tua panin numei pil khat la-in ama kiangah, "Dahin a kap kineih inla, dahna lim puante silh in. Sathau nilh kei inla, misi hangin ni tampi a thum khin numei bangin gamta in.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah pai inla, hih bangin ama kiangah thu gen in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Joab in ama gen ding thute a hilh hi.
Kumpipa kiangah Tekoa numei a pai ciangin lei-ah maipukin zahtakna bawl a, "Hong huh in! Aw kumpipa," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Na lungkhamna bang om ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in dawngin, "Kalai, ka pasal si ta a, meigong numei khat ka hi hi.
Na nasemnu in tapa nih nei a, lo sungah amau tegel kitawng uh hi. Amau tegel a khen ding kuamah om lo a, khat in a khat pa satin that hi.
Tu-in ka beh buppi na nasemnu' langah hong pangin amaute in, 'Ama thah a sanggampa' nuntakna tangin amah ka thah theih nadingun a sanggampa a sat mipa hong pia in,' hong ci uh hi. Tua bangin amaute in innluah pa zong susia ding uh hi. Tua bangin amaute in a omlai ka lametna pa beisakin leitungah ka pasal' suanlekhak a suakta omsak lo ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in tua numei kiangah, "Na inn-ah ciah in; nang tawh kisai-in thu ka pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Tekoa numei in kumpipa kiangah, "Ka to kumpipa aw, keima tung le ka innkuan tungah mawhna om ta hen; kumpipa le a tokhom mawhpeng ta hen," a ci hi.
Kumpipa in, "Nang' tungah mi khatpeuh in thu khatpeuh hong gen leh kei kiangah amah hong paipih in; amah in nang hong sukik ngei nawn lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Phulapa in that nawn loin, ka tapa a kisuksiat loh nadingin kumpipa in Topa na Pasian' tungah na kiciam ding kong thum hi," a ci hi. Amah in, " Topa a nungta ahih mah bangin na tapa' samzang khat zong lei-ah kialo ding hi," ci-in a kiciam hi.
Tua ciangin a numei in, "Ka to kumpipa tungah na nasemnu kam khat hong gensak in, ci-in kong thum hi," a ci hi. Amah in, "Gen in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a numei in, "Tua ahihleh bang hangin Pasian' mite' langah tua bang na hih sawm na hi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh hih bang lungsim khentatna na piakna-ah kumpipa in a hawlkhiatna a inn-ah a paipih kik mateng kumpipa amahmah mawh a kipia ahi hi.
Eite khempeuh i si ding a, a kikhawm kik thei lo leilakah a bua tui tawh i kibang hi. Ahih hangin a hawlkhiat pa a kipuasehin a kikoih loh nadingin lampi a zong mipa' nuntakna Pasian in lakhia lo ding hi.
Mite in kei hong lausak ahih manin tu-in ka to kumpipa kiangah hih thu a gen dingin kong pai hi. Na nasemnu in, 'Kumpipa kiangah thu ka gen ding a, kumpipa in a nasemnu' ngetna sem kha ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa in za-in, Pasian' gamh panin kei le ka tapa hong susia khawm ding mipa' khut panin a nasemnu honkhia ding hi,' ci-in ngaihsun hi.
Na nasemnu in, 'Ka to kumpipa' kammal in nopsakna hong pia ding hi,' ci-in ngaihsun hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka to kumpipa pen a pha le a sia a khenthei dingin Pasian' vantungmi tawh kibang hi. Topa na Pasian in nang hong ompih ta hen!" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in a numei dawngin, "Nang kong dot peuhpeuh hong im kei in," a ci hi. A numei in, "Ka to kumpipa in gen hen," a ci hi.
Kumpipa in, "Hih thu khempeuh Joab' vaihawmna tawh hong pai na hi hiam?" a ci hi. A numei in dawngin, "Nang a nungta taktak na hih mah bangin ka to kumpipa aw, ka to kumpipa' gen bang teekteek mah ahi hi. Kei hong sawl pa pen na nasempa Joab hi a, na nasemnu' gen dingin hih thute a hong sawl pa amah ahi hi.
Na thu paizia khek nadingin na nasempa Joab in hih thu hih hi. Ahih hangin ka topa in leitung a om na khempeuh theih nadingin Pasian' vantungmi pilna tawh a kibang pilna na nei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Joab lei-ah maipuksuk a, zahtakna bawlin kumpipa thupha a pia hi. Tua ciangin Joab in, "Kumpipa in a nasempa' ngetna a piakna-ah, tuni-in ka to kumpipa nangma muhna-ah maipha ka muhna na nasempa in ka thei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Joab dingin Geshur-ah pai a, Jerusalem-ah Absalom a ciahpih hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Ama inn-ah amah tuam tensak in; keima omna-ah amah hong pai lo ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Absalom ama inn-ah tuam tenin kumpipa omna-ah pai lo hi.
Tu-in Israel-te khempeuh sungah a melhoihna hangin Absalom zahin tua bangin phat ding kuamah om lo hi. A khenuai a kipan a luzang dongin ama tungah paubaanna om lo hi.
Amah in a sam a met ciangin (kum bei simin amah in met zel hi; a sam a gih ciangin amah in met hi), amah in a sam tawi khai a, kumpipa' gik tehna-in shekel zanih a gik hi.
Absalom' sung pan tapa thum, le a min Tamar ahi ta numei khat a suak hi; tua nu pen a melhoih mahmah khat ahi hi.
Tua hi a, kumpipa' omna-ah pai loin Absalom kum nih bit Jerusalem-ah teng hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah a sawl dingin Absalom in Joab samsak hi. Ahih hangin ama kiangah Joab hong pai lo hi. Amah in a nih veina sawl a, ahih hangin Joab hong pai lo veve hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a nasemte kiangah, "En un, Joab' lo pen keima-a' zom hi a, tua lai-ah amah in mangbuhham nei hi; pai unla mei tawh va hal un," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Absalom' nasemte in a lo mei tawh a hal uh hi.
Tua ciangin Joab dingin Absalom' kiang ama inn-ah pai-in ama kiangah, "Bang hangin na nasemte in mei tawh ka lo hong halsak ahi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Absalom in Joab dawngin, "En in, nang kiangah thu kong puak a, 'Kumpipa kiangah nang hong sawlin, "Bang hangin Geshur panin hong pai ka hi hiam? Tua lai-ah omlai leng kei a dingin hoihzaw ding hi," ci-in a va dong dingin hih lai-ah nong pai nading kong gen hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in kumpipa omna-ah kei hong paisak in; kei tungah mawhna a om leh amah hong thatsak in,' ka ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah Joab pai-in ama kiangah tua thu a gen hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in Absalom sam hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah kumpipa kiangah hong pai a, a mai lei ngatin kumpipa' mai-ah a kun hi; tua ciangin kumpipa in Absalom a nam hi.
Hih hun khit ciangin Absalom in leeng khat le sakolte, le ama mai-ah a tai ding mi sawmnga la hi.
Absalom tho baihin kulhkongpi lam gei-ah tu zel hi. Mi khatpeuh in thu khensak dingin kumpipa' mai-ah pai nading thu a neih ciangin Absalom in amah samin, "Koi khua pan na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in, "Na nasempa, Israel-te sungah tua minam tua khua ka hi hi," a cih ciangin
Tua tham loin Absalom in, "Gam sungah kei thukhen hi leng! Thu ahi a, a hang khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin a nei mi peuhmah kei kiangah hong pai ding a, keimah in ama tungah thu a tangin ka khen ding hi," a ci hi.
Ama tungah zahtakna a bawl dingin mi khatpeuh a nai-ah hong pai ciangin amah in a khut zan a, amah lenin a nam hi.
Tua bangin Absalom in kumpipa kiangah thu a khensak dingin a hong pai Israel-te khempeuh tungah a hih hi. Tua ahih ciangin Absalom in Israel mite' lungsim na zo hi.
Kum li a cin ciangin Absalom in kumpipa kiangah, "Kei hong paisak inla, Topa' tungah ka ciamsa ka thuciam, Hebron-ah hong piasak in, ci-in kong thum hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Aram gam Geshur-ah ka om laitakin na nasempa in thu khat ciam a, ' Topa in Jerusalem-ah kei hong paipih kik taktak leh Topa' tungah biakna ka pia ding hi,' ka ci hi," a ci hi.
Kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Nuamtakin pai in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah dingin Hebron-ah a pai hi.
Ahih hangin Absalom in Israel minam khempeuh kiangah a simthamin kamtaite sawl a, "Peengkul aw na zak phetun, 'Absalom, Hebron-ah kumpi hi!' ci un," a ci hi.
A kisam mi za nihte Jerusalem panin Absalom tawh a pai uh hi. Amaute lungsim hoih tawh a pai hi a, bangmah thei lo uh hi.
Absalom in biakna a piak laitakin David' thulamlak pa, Giloh mi Ahithofel, ama khuapi Gilo panin samsak hi. Tua ciangin sawmsimna hong hat semsem a, Absalom tawh a om mite kibehlaplap hi.
Tua ciangin kamtai khat David kiangah hong pai-in, "Israel mite' lungsim Absalom' lamah pai khin hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Tua ciangin David in Jerusalem-ah amah tawh a om a nasemte khempeuh kiangah, "Ding un, tai ni; tua hikeileh Absalom' kiang panin eite' suahtak nading om lo ding hi. Manlangin pai ni; tua hikeileh amah in eite hong pha pak ding a, eite' tungah siatna hong tungsakin namsau tawh khuapi hong vat ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa' nasemte in ama kiangah, "En in, ka to kumpipa in na khensat peuhpeuh a sem dingin na nasemte kiging hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa paikhia a, ama innkuan le a ulian khempeuh in ama nung a zui uh hi. Kumpipa in inn kem dingin a zineu sawm nusia hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa paikhia a, mi khempeuh in ama nung a zui uh hi. Tua ciangin khuanawl inn tawpna-ah amaute khawl uh hi.
Tua ciangin a nasemte khempeuh in amah nawkin pai uh hi. Khereth mi khempeuh, Peleth mi khempeuh, le Gath panin amah a zui mi za gukte khempeuh, kumpipa' mai nawkin paisuak uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Gath mi Ittai kiangah, "Bang hangin nang zong kote hong zui na hi hiam? Ciahkik inla, kumpipa tawh om in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen gamdang mi na hi a, na inn panin gam dangah a om zong na hi hi.
Nang pen zan mah beka hong pai na hi hi. Koi lai munah kei pai ding cih thei lopi-in kote tawh a kawivak dingin nang hong bawl ding ka hi hiam? Ciahkik in, na sanggamte ciahpih in. Topa in itna kip le thumanna nang' tungah hong lak ta hen," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Ittai in kumpipa dawngin, " Topa nungta-in, ka to kumpipa zong nungta ahih mah bangin, sih nading ahi a, hin nading ahi zongin ka to kumpipa a omna peuhpeuhah na nasempa om ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in Ittai kiangah, "Tua ahihleh pai in, paisuak in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Gath mi Ittai, a mi khempeuh le amah tawh a om a naupang khempeuh tawh a paisuak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi khempeuh a pai laitakin gam sung mi khempeuh a gingin kapkhia uh a, kumpipa in Kidron lui kantanin, mi khempeuh zong gamlak lamah a paisuak uh hi.
Tua ciangin Abiathar hong paito a, Zadok zong Levi mi khempeuh tawh hong pai-in Pasian' Thuciamna Singkuang hong pua uh hi. Mi khempeuh in khuapi a khen' khit mateng amaute in Pasian' Thuciamna Singkuang nga phot uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Zadok kiangah, "Pasian' Thuciamna Singkuang khuapi sungah puakik in. Topa' maipha ka muh nakleh, amah in kei hong paipih kikin Thuciamna Singkuang le a omna mun hong musakkik ding hi.
Ahih hangin amah in, 'Na tungah lungkimna ka nei kei hi,' hong cih leh, en in, hih lai-ah kei ka om hi; amah in hoih a sak bangin kei tungah hong bawl hen," a ci hi.
Kumpipa in siampi Zadok kiangah, "En in, nuamtakin nang le Abiathar, na tapa nihte Ahimaaz le Abiathar' tapa Jonathan tawh khuapi sungah ciahkik un.
Thei in, kei kiangah thu a hong zasak dingin nang' kiang panin thuko mi hong tun mateng gamlak tui ngahmunte-ah ka na ngak ding hi," cithuah lai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Zadok le Abiathar in Pasian' Thuciamna Singkuang Jerusalem-ah puakik uh a, amaute tua lai-ah om uh hi.
Ahih hangin Oliv Mual tung kahtohna-ah David paito a, khe guak le lu tuamsa-in a paikawmin kap hi. Amah tawh a om mi khempeuh zong lu khuhsa-in a paitoh kawmun a kap uh hi.
Tua laitakin David kiangah, "Ahithofel zong mi sawmsimte lakah Absalom tawh om hi," ci-in kigen hi. Tua ahih ciangin David in, " Topa aw, kong thum hi; Ahithofel' thugente haina-in na heisak in," a ci hi.
Pasian a kibiakna mun mual dawnah David a tun ciangin, Arkhi mi Hushai amah a dawn dingin a puantungsilh balkeksa le a lu tungah lei baang tawh hong pai hi.
David in ama kiangah, "Nang hong zuisuak lecin kei a dingin vangik na hi ding hi.
Ahih hangin khuapi sungah nang ciahkikin Absalom kiangah, 'Aw kumpipa, kei, nangma nasem ka hi ding hi. Hun beisa sungah na pa' nasem ka hih mah bangin tu-in nangma nasem ka hi ding hi,' ci lecin, Ahithofel' thugente kei a dingin na zo ding hi.
Siampi Zadok le Abiathar tua lai-ah nang tawh om hi lo ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa' inn pan na zak peuhpeuh siampi Zadok le Abiathar' kiangah gen in.
En in, amau' tapa tegel, Zadok' tapa Ahimaaz le Abiathar' tapa Jonathan, amaute tawh omkhawm hi. Na zak peuhpeuh amaute' tungtawnin kei tungah nong puak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Jerusalem-ah Absalom a lut laitakin David' lawmpa Hushai zong khuapi sungah a pai hi.
David in mual dawn a khen' khit tawmvei ciangin Mefibosheth nasempa Ziba in anlum zanih, leenggah phehkeu bawk zakhat, khuakhal singgah zakhat le leenggahzu savun um khat a pua van a kivawh la nih tawh amah na dawn hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Ziba kiangah, "Bang hangin hihte hong paipih na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Ziba in dawngin, "Late pen kumpipa' innkuante a tuan nading, anlum le khuakhal singgahte pen tangvalte' nek ding, le leenggahzu pen gamlakah a gimte' dawn ding ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Na topa Saul' tupa koi-ah om ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Ziba in kumpipa kiangah, "Amah Jerusalem-ah om hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, 'Tuni-in Israel mite in ka pu Saul' kumpi gam kei hong piakik ding hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Ziba kiangah, "En in, Mefibosheth' neihsa khempeuh tu-in nangma a' ahi hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Ziba in, "Kei, nangma nasempa ka hi hi; ka to kumpipa' muhna-ah maipha hong musak tawntung in," a ci hi.
Bahurim-ah Kumpi David a tun ciangin Saul' innsung innkuan mi, Gera' tapa Shimei min nei mi khat hong paikhia a, a paikawmin David samsia tawntung hi.
Amah in Kumpi David le a nasemte khempeuh suang tawh deng hi. Mi khempeuh le mi thahatte khempeuh David' taklam le veilamah om uh hi.
Shimei in a samsiat kawmin, "Pai mang, pai mang, nang mi that pa, bangmah man lo mipa!
Ama tangin na uk Saul' innkuante na thahna hangin Topa in nangma tungah hong thuk hi. Topa in na tapa Absalom' tungah kumpi gam pia khinta hi. Thei in, na siatna nangma lu tungah hong tu hi; bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen mi that pa na hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a nu Zeruiah ahi Abishai in kumpipa kiangah, "Bang hangin hih uisi a banglel mi khat in ka to kumpipa samsia ding ahi hiam? Hong kuansak inla a lu hong tankhiasak in," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in, "No Zeruiah tapate aw, note tawh bang kisai ahi hiam? Topa in ama kiangah, 'David samsia in,' a cihna hangin hong samsia ahihleh, 'Bang hangin tuaci hih na hi hiam?' kua in ci ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in Abishai le a nasemte khempeuh kiangah, "En un, keima tapa mahmah in kei thah dingin hong zong hi; hih Benjamin mi in bangzahin tu-in hong zongzaw kan ding ahi hiam! Ama thu-in omsak un, amah hong samsiasak un; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in amah a sawl hi kha ding hi.
Topa in ka thuakna hong enin, tuni-a kei hong samsiatna hangin Topa in a hoih tawh kei hong thuk kha ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ama galkhat mualpangah Shimei pai a, a paikawmin samsia-in suang tawh amah dengin leivui a theh laitakin David le a mite lampi-ah pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa le amah tawh a om mi khempeuhte gim mahmahin Jordan tung uh a, tua lai-ah amah kitawldamsak hi.
Tu-in Absalom le Israel mite khempeuh Jerusalem hong tung uh a, Ahithofel amah tawh om hi.
Tua ciangin David lam a lak pa, Arkhi mi Hushai, Absalom kiangah hong tun ciangin Hushai in Absalom' kiangah, "Kumpipa khan sawt ta hen! Kumpipa khan sawt ta hen!" a ci hi.
Absalom in Hushai kiangah, "Hih bang pen na lawmpa tungah thumanna ahi hiam? Bang hangin na lawmpa tawh pai lo na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Hushai in Absalom kiangah, "Hilo hi; Topa le hih mite le Israel mite khempeuh a dingin a kiteel mipa a' ka hi ding a, amah tawh ka om ding hi.
Tua banah, kua' na sem ding ka hi hiam? Ama' tapa hi lo ding ahi hiam? Na pa' na ka sep bangin nangma na ka sem ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Absalom in Ahithofel kiangah, "Na ngaihsutna hong gen in; bang hih ding ihi hiam?" a ci hi.
Ahithofel in Absalom' kiangah, "Inn kem dingin a nusiat na pa' zineute luppih in; tua ciangin nangmah in na pa na muhdah bawlna thu Israel-te khempeuh in za-in nangmah tawh a om mite khempeuh' tha khauhsak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in innkhumzangah Absalom a dingin puanbuk khat lam uh a, Israel-te khempeuh' muhna-ah Absalom in a pa' zineute luppih hi.
Tua hun lai-in Ahithofel' thugente pen Pasian' kammal mahmah bangin kingaihsun hi. Tua bangin David le Absalom in Ahithofel' thugente a thupi ngaihsut uh ahi hi.
Tua zawh a sawt loin Ahithofel in Absalom kiangah, "Mi tul sawm le tulnih hong teelsak in; keimah kuankhia-in tuzanin David ka delh ding hi.
Amah gimin lungkia-in a om laitakin amah ka hih ding a, amah ka amkhamsak ding hi. Tua hileh amah tawh a om mi khempeuh tai ding uh hi. Keimah in kumpipa bek ka satpuk ding a,
mothak in a pasal kiang a zuatkik mah bangin mi khempeuh nang kiangah kong ciahpih kik ding hi. Nangmah in mi khat bek' nuntakna na zong hi; midang khempeuh nuamtakin om ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua thugenna in Absalom le Israel upate khempeuh lungkimsak hi.
Tua ciangin Absalom in, "Arkhi mi Hushai zong sam un; ama thugen ngai phot ni," a ci hi.
Absalom kiangah Hushai hong pai ciangin Absalom in ama kiangah, "Tua bangin Ahithofel in thu gen hi; ama genna bangin i hih ding hiam? Tua ahih kei leh nang gen in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Hushai in Absalom kiangah, "Tutungin Ahithofel' thugen hoih lo hi," a ci hi.
Tua banah Hushai in, "Na pa le a mite mi thahat hi a, gamlakah a note a kilaksak vompi bangin amaute a hehna na thei hi. Tua banah na pa galdona lamsang a siam hi a, mite tawh zanin amah om khawm lo ding hi.
Tu nangawnin amah dum khat sungah ahi a, mundang khatah ahi zongin bu khin ding hi. Kisim cilna-ah mi pawlkhat si leh tua thu a za mi peuhpeuh in, 'Absalom a zui mite lakah a si om khin hi,' ci ding hi.
Tua ciangin a lungtang humpinelkai lungtang a bang galhang mipa nangawn launa tawh lungkia gawp ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Israel-te khempeuh in na pa mi thahat ahihna le amah tawh a om mite mi hang ahihna thei uh hi.
Ahih hangin keima ngaihsutna hih bang ahi hi: Dan panin Beersheba ciang dong, tuipi gei-a sehnel bangin a tam Israel mi khempeuh nang kiangah khawmin galsim dingin nangmahmah na kuan ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah i muhna mun khat peuhpeuhah theihkholh lohin i hihgawp ding hi. Amah le amah tawh a om mi khempeuh khat zong kisiit lo ding hi.
Amah khuapi khat sungah a nungkik le, Israel-te khempeuh in tua khuapi sungah khauhual paipihin tua lai munah suangtang khat nangawn a kimu nawn lo dingin kuam sungah tua khua i kaikhia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Absalom le Israel mite khempeuh in, "Arkhi mi Hushai' thugen pen Ahithofel' thugen sangin hoihzaw hi," a ci uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Absalom' tungah siatna a tunsak theih nadingin Ahithofel' thugen hoih in a lelh ding Topa in a sehsa ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Hushai in siampi Zadok le Abiathar kiangah, "Tua bang tua bangin Ahithofel in Absalom le Israel upate kiangah gen a, tua bang tua bangin keimah in thu ka gen hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in manlang takin mi sawl inla, David kiangah, 'Tuzan gamlak tui ngahmunte-ah giak kei inla, bangbang hitaleh galkah in; tua hikeileh kumpipa le amah tawh a om mi khempeuh hong kivalhtum kha ding hi,' ci-in gen sak in," a ci hi.
Tu-in Jonathan le Ahimaaz in Enrogel-ah ngak uh hi. Nasem numei khat pai-in amaute kiangah gen a, amaute pai-in Kumpi David kiangah gen zel uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute khuapi sungah a lutlam uh a kimu lo ding ahi hi.
Ahih hangin tangval khat in amaute mu-in Absalom kiangah gen hi. Tua ahih ciangin amau tegel manlang takin paikhia uh a, a huang sungah tuikhuk a nei Bahurim-a mi khat' inn-ah tung uh a, tuikhuk sungah amaute tuaksuk uh hi.
Tua ciangin a numei in khuhna khat la-in tuikhuk gong tungah phah a, tua tungah an zalh a, bangmah kithei lo hi.
Absalom' nasemte tua nu' inn-ah hong tun ciangin amaute in, "Ahimaaz le Jonathan koi lai-ah om ahi uh hiam?" a ci uh hi. A numei in amaute kiangah, "Amaute lui galkhatah pai khinzo uh hi," a ci hi. Amaute in zong a muh zawh loh uh ciangin Jerusalem-ah a ciahkik uh hi.
Amaute a paikhiat khit ciangin tuikhuk panin mite hong paikhia uh a, pai-in Kumpi David kiangah a thu gen uh hi. Amaute in David kiangah, "Ding in; tui galkhatah manlang takin pai in; bang hang hiam cih leh tua bang tua bangin nangma langkhatah Ahithofel in thu gen hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin David le amah tawh a om mi khempeuh ding uh hi. Amaute in Jordan kantan uh a, khuavak ciangin Jordan a kantan nai lo khat beek om nawn lo uh hi.
Ahithofel in ama thugen a kizuih loh a muh ciangin a la tutphah vawhin ama khuapi a inn-ah nuak ciah hi. Tua ciangin amah in a innkuan vai hawmsak a, a man ciangin amahmah gui-awk hi. Amah si a, a pa' hanah kivui hi.
Tua ciangin Mahanaim ah David tung hi. Absalom in Israel mite khempeuh tawh Jordan kantan hi.
Tu-in Absalom in Joab tangin galkapte a uk dingin Amasa koih khin hi. Amasa pen Nahash' tanu Abigail a tenpih, Ishmael mi ahi Ithra min nei mi khat' tapa hi a, ama nu Abigail le Joab' nu Zeruiah a unau ahi hi.
Israel-te le Absalom in Gilead gamah giahphual sat uh hi.
Mahanaim ah David a tun ciangin Ammon mite' gam Rabbah khua panin Nahash' tapa Shobi, le Lodebar panin Ammiel' tapa Makhir, le Rogelim panin Gilead mi Barzillai in
lupnate, kuangte, le leibeelte, mangbuh, mangbuhham, an, an kan, bepi le besan,
khuaizu le bawngnawi-thaukhal, le tuu le sathaukhalte, David le amah tawh a om mite' nek dingin hong puak uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in, "Mite gamlakah gilkialin, gimin dangtak uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin David in amah tawh a om mite khawmin a tultul a ukte le a zaza a ukte-in koih hi.
David in galkapte khen thum suah a, khenkhat Joab' ukna nuai-ah, khenkhat Joab' sanggampa Zeruiah' tapa Abishai' ukna nuai-ah, khenkhat Gath mi Ittai' nuai-ah koihin galdo dingin a kuansak hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in mite kiangah, "Note tawh kei zong kong kuankhia ding hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin mite in, "Nang nong kuankhia kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh kote tai le-ung amaute in kote phamawh hong sa lo ding hi. Kote kimkhat si le ung amaute in kote phamawh hong sa lo ding hi. Ahih hangin nang pen kote tul sawm zahin na manpha hi. Tua ahih ciangin khuapi panin kote kiangah huhna hong puak lecin hoihzaw hi," a ci uh hi.
Kumpipa in amaute kiangah, "Note in hoih na sak pen bangun ka gamta ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin galkap khempeuh a zaza le a tultulin a paikhiat laitakun kulhkongpi pangah kumpipa ding hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Joab le Abishai le Ittai thu pia-in, "Keimah nong khualna-un tangvalpa Absalom hong dawm mahmah un," a ci hi. Kumpipa in Absalom' thu galkapmangte tungah a vaikhakna mi khempeuh in za uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel-te a do dingin gamlakah galkapte kuankhia uh a, Efraim tulakah kido uh hi.
David' nasemte in tua lai-ah Israel mite zo uh a, tua ni-a mi kithat tam a, mi tul sawmnih ahi hi.
Tua gam maitang tung khempeuhah galkikapna omkim hi. Tua ni-in namsau' thah sangin thudang hangin tulakah a si mi tamzaw hi.
David' nasemte in Absalom tuakkha uh hi. Absalom a la tungah tuang a, tawsaw lianpi hiang pha nuai khatah a la tai-in, a lutang tawsaw hiang lakah awk a, ama nuai panin a la taisuakin, vanlelei kikalah amah a kikhai-in kinusia hi.
Tua ciangin mi khat in mu-in Joab kiangah gen a, "En in, tawsaw hiang kawm lakah Absalom a kikhai ka mu hi," a ci hi.
Joab in ama kiangah a gen mipa kiangah, "Bang! Nang amah mu maw! Bang hangin leilakah amah satkhiasuk lo na hi hiam? Nang tungah ngun peek sawm le kawnggak khat hong pia ngel ding hi ve ing," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a mipa in Joab kiangah, "Ngun peek tulkhat ka khut sungah hong koih ta lecin zong kumpipa' tapa a hih dingin ka khutmeno khat zong ka zankhia kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kote' zakin kumpipa in nang le Abishai le Ittai thu hong pia-in, 'Keimah nong khualna-un tangvalpa Absalom hong dawm un,' hong ci hi.
Thudang khatah, amah langpangin zuautat leng (Kumpipa tungah a ki-im bangmah om lo hi), nangmahmah kikang koihin nong hu kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Joab in, "Hih bangin nang tawh hun ka beisak kei ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in thaltang thum la-in tawsaw hiang kawmah Absalom a hing lai-in a lungtang sungah tuate a siat hi.
Tua ciangin Joab' galhiam tawite tangval sawm in Absalom umcih a, amah satin that uh hi.
Tua ciangin Joab in peengkul tum a, Israel-te a delhna panun galkapte hong ciahkik uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Joab in amaute kho hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Absalom la-in tulaka dum lianpi khat sungah amah paai uh a, ama tungah suangcian a lian mahmah khat ciang uh hi. Tua ciangin Israel-te khempeuh amau' inn ciatah tai uh hi.
Absalom in ama nuntak lai-in khuampi khat la-in ama a dingin phutin Kumpipa' Kuamah om hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, "Keima min hong zom ding tapa ka nei kei hi," a ci hi. Tua khuampi ama min tamin phuak a, tuni dongin Absalom' Mual, kici hi.
Tua ciangin Zadok' tapa Ahimaaz in, "Kei hong taisak inla, Topa in ama galte' vangliatna panin amah a hotkhiat lungdamna thu kumpipa kiangah hong puaksak in," a ci hi.
Joab in ama kiangah, "Nang in tuni-in lungdamna thu na puak kei ding hi. A nidang ciangin lungdamna thu na puak thei ding a, ahih hangin tuni-in lungdamna thu na puak kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa' tapa si hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Joab in Kush mipa kiangah, "Pai inla na muhsa teng kumpipa kiangah va gen in," a ci hi. Kush mipa zong Joab' mai-ah kunin, tua ciangin a tai hi.
Tua ciangin Zadok' tapa Ahimaaz in Joab kiangah, "Bangbang piang taleh kei zong Kush mipa' nungah hong taisak in," a ci kik hi. Joab in, "Lungdamna thu puakna hangin thaman ngah lo ding cih thei napi-in, ka tapa aw, bang hangin tai ding na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in, "Bangbang piang taleh ka tai ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Joab in ama kiangah, "Tai in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Ahimaaz zanglei lam tawnin tai a, Kush mipa makhelh hi.
Tua laitakin kulhkongpi puanung le a sungnung kikalah David na tu hi. Galvil pa kulhkongpi khumzangah paito a, a khuadak ciangin amah guakin a hong tai mi khat a mu hi.
Galvil pa in kumpipa kiangah a gen hi. Kumpipa in, "Amah guak ahihleh thuhoih ahi hi," a ci hi. Amah hong nawhtai-in hong nai hi.
Tua ciangin galvil pa in midang khat a hong tai mu leuleu hi. Galvil pa in kulhkongpi-ah ko a, "En un, midang khat zong hong tai leuleu!" a ci hi. Kumpipa in, "Amah in zong lungdamna thu hong paipih hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin galvil pa in, "A masa pa' taizia pen Zadok' tapa Ahimaaz' tai tawh kibang hi, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Amah mihoih hi a, lungdamna thuhoih tawh hong pai hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah Ahimaaz hong kiko-in, "Na khempeuh hoih hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa mai-ah lei maingatin amah kun a, "Ka to kumpipa' langkhatah a khut a liik mite nangma khut sungah a hong pia Topa na Pasian in thupha ngah ta hen," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Tangvalpa Absalom a hoihhoih hiam?" a ci hi. Ahimaaz in dawngin, "Joab in na nasempa hong sawl laitakin buaina lianpi khat ka mu a, ahih hangin bang hiam cih ka thei kei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Kiheikhia inla, hih lai-ah ding in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah kiheikhia-in taang loin a ding hi.
Tua ciangin Kush mipa hong tung hi. Kush mipa in, "Ka to kumpipa a dingin lungdam nading thu om hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nangma langah a ding mi khempeuh' vangliatna panin tuni-in Topa in nang hong honkhia hi," a ci hi.
Kumpipa in Kush mipa kiangah, "Tangvalpa Absalom a hoihhoih hiam?" a ci hi. Kush mipa in dawngin, "Ka to kumpipa' galte, le siat nadingin nangma langkhatah a ding khempeuh, tua tangvalpa bang ta hen," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa' lungsim nakpitakin sukha a, kulhkongpi tunga inndei sungah paito-in a kap hi. A paikawmin amah in, "Aw ka tapa Absalom, ka tapa, ka tapa Absalom! Nangma tangin kei sizaw taleng. Aw Absalom, ka tapa, ka tapa!" a ci hi.
Joab kiangah, "En in, Absalom' hangin kumpipa kapin thum hi," ci-in kigen hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua ni-a gualzawhna mi khempeuh a dingin thumna hong suak mawk hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua ni-in mite in, "Kumpipa a tapa' hangin dah hi," ci-in za uh hi.
Tua ciangin galsung pan a tai uh ciangin a maizum mite a geel bangin tua ni-in khuapi sungah mite simlut uh hi.
Kumpipa in a mai khuh a, nakpitakin kapkhia-in, "Aw ka tapa Absalom! Aw Absalom! Ka tapa, ka tapa!" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa' inn sungah Joab hong pai-in, "Tuni-in nangma nuntakna, na tanute le na tapate' nuntakna, na zite le na zineute' nuntakna a hong honkhia na nasemte khempeuh na maizumsak hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in nang hong mudahte itin, nang hong itte na mudah hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a ukte le nasemte nang adingin bangmah ahihlohna tuni-in na kitelsak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Absalom hingin, kote khempeuh tuni-in si le ung na nuam ding ka thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in ding in, paikhia inla na nasemte tungah kamneem pau in; bang hang hiam cih leh na pai kei leh tuzan ciangin mi khat zong nang kiangah hong om nawn lo ding hi, ci-in Topa' min tawh ka kiciam ngam hi. Hih thu pen na tangval a kipan tu ciang dong na tungah hong tungsa siatna khempeuh sangin nang a dingin siazaw ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa dingin kulhkongpi gei-ah a tu hi. Tua ciangin mite kiangah, "En un, kulhkongpi-ah kumpipa tu hi," ci-in kigen a, tua ciangin kumpipa mai-ah mi khempeuh hong pai uh hi. Tu-in Israel mite amau' inn ciatah na tai khin uh hi.
Israel minam khempeuh sungah mi khempeuh thu kisel uh a, "Kumpipa in i galte' khutsung panin hong khahkhia-in Filistia-te' khutsung panin hong honkhia hi. Tu-in Absalom' hangin i gam sung panin amah taikhia hi.
Ahih hangin eite' tungah sathau i nilh Absalom, gal sungah si khin hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in bang hangin kumpipa lakkik ding bangmah gen lo na hi uh hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi David in hih thu, siampi Zadok le Abiathar kiangah puakin, "Judah upate kiangah hih bangin gen un: 'Israel-te khempeuh' thu kumpipa kiangah tung khin hi. Bang hangin note in kumpipa a inn-ah a ciahpih nunung pen hi ding na hi uh hiam?
Note pen ka behnai na hi uh a, note pen keima si keima sa na hi uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin kumpipa a ciahpih nunung pen hi ding na hi uh hiam?' ci un.
Tua ciangin Amasa kiangah, 'Nang pen keima si keima sa hi lo na hi hiam? Tua kipan Joab' munah nang pen ka galkapte a ukpa na hih kei taak leh Pasian in kei hong dawm kei ta hen, ci hi,' ci-in gen un," a ci hi.
David' thugen in Judah mite khempeuh' lungsim thakhatin zo pah hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in kumpipa kiangah thu puakin, "Nang le na nasemte khempeuh hong ciahkik un," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Jordan-ah kumpipa hong paikik hi. Kumpipa a dawn ding le Jordan galah kumpipa a paipih dingin Gilgal-ah Judah mite hong pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Bahurim panin Benjamin mi Gera' tapa Shimei, Kumpi David a dawn dingin Judah mite tawh manlangin paisuk hi.
Benjamin sung panin mi tulkhat amah tawh om hi. Tua ciangin Saul' innsung nasem Ziba, a tapa sawm le nga le a nasem sawmnihte tawh kumpipa' mai Jordan-ah taisuk a,
kumpipa' innkuante a galkahpih ding le ama deih bangin na a sem dingin amaute in ngahmun ngap uh hi. Jordan a galkah ding ciangin Gera' tapa Shimei kumpipa' mai-ah boksukin
kumpipa kiangah, "Ka to kumpipa in Jerusalem na nusiat ni-in na nasempa' gamtat khialhna ka topa in hong mawhsak kei inla, hong ciamteh kei in; kumpipa in ngaihsutin nei kei in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka khialh khitna na nasempa in ka thei hi. Tua ahih ciangin, en in, ka to kumpipa a dawn dingin a hong paisuk dingin Josef minam khempeuh sung panin a masa penin tuni-in kong tung hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a nu Zeruiah ahi Abishai hong paukhia a, "Amah in Topa' sathau nilh pa samsia ahih manin hih thu hangin Shimei thah ding hi lo ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Ahih hangin David in, "Note pen tuni-in kei' lang bangin na om nadingun no Zeruiah' tapate tawh kei bang kisai ihi hiam? Tuni-in Israel sungah mi khatpeuh kithat ding ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh tuni-in Israel-te' tungah kumpi ka hihna thei hi lo ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Shimei kiangah, "Nang na si kei ding hi," a ci hi. Kumpipa in ama tungah kiciamna a bawl hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa a dawn dingin Saul' tupa Mefibosheth hong paisuk hi. Kumpipa a paikhiat ni a kipan lungnuamin hong tunkik ni dong, amah in a khete zem lo, a khamul puah lo, a puante zong sawp lo hi.
Jerusalem panin kumpipa a dawn dingin hong pai ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Mefibosheth aw, bang hangin kei hong zui lo na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in dawngin, "Ka topa! Aw Kumpipa, ka nasempa in kei hong khem hi; bang hang hiam cih leh na nasempa in ama kiangah, 'Kei a tungah tuangin kumpipa ka zuih theih nadingin kei a dingin la khat tutphah vawh in,' ka ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh na nasempa a khe bai hi.
Amah in ka to kumpipa kiangah na nasempa hong gensia hi. Ahih hangin ka to kumpipa pen Pasian' vantungmi tawh kibang hi. Tua ahih ciangin hoih na sak bangin hong hih in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka to kumpipa' mai-ah ka pa' innkuante khempeuh a si zah dong dingin a sia ahi hi. Ahih hangin nangmah in na sabuai-ah a ne mite lakah na nasempa na hong koih hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa tungah ka koh ding thudang bang neithuah nawn ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Bang hangin nangma thu gen lailai na hi hiam? Ka lungsim ka khentatzo hi; nang le Ziba in leitang na hawm ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mefibosheth in kumpipa kiangah, "Aw, ka to kumpipa lungnuamin inn hong tung khin na hih nungsang, a vekin amah lasak in," a ci hi.
Rogelim panin Gilead mi Barzillai zong hong paisuk hi. Jordan galkhatah amah a kha dingin kumpipa tawh Jordan ciang dong amah paisuak hi.
Barzillai pen kum sawmgiat a pha, a khangham mahmah mi khat ahi hi. Mahanaim ah kumpipa a om laitakin amah in an pia hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah mihau mahmah khat ahi hi.
Kumpipa in Barzillai kiangah, "Kei hong zui inla, Jerusalem-ah kei tawh hong om in, nang kong vak ding hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Barzillai in kumpipa kiangah, "Kei, kumpipa tawh Jerusalem-ah a paito dingin ka nuntak ding kum bangzah hun nei nawn ka hi hiam?
Tuni-in kei kum sawmgiat ka pha ta a, a nuam le a nuam lo khentel thei nawn ka hi hiam? Na nasempa in a nek ahi a, a dawn ahi zongin a limna phawk thei nawn ka hi hiam? Lasa numeite le lasa pasalte' aw za thei nawn ka hi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin ka to kumpipa tungah na nasempa vangik kibehlap hong hi ding ka hi hiam?
Na nasempa in Jordan galkhatah tomkha sung kumpipa hong zui ding hi. Kei pen tua bang hamphatna lianpi a ngah dingin zong ka kilawm kei hi.
Keima khuapi sung mah, ka nu le ka pa' han nai-ah ka sih theih nadingin na nasempa hong ciahsakkik in, ci-in kong thum hi. Ahih hangin hih lai-ah ka tapa na nasempa Khimham om hi; ka to kumpipa tawh amah galkah sak in; hoih na sak bangbangin ama a' ding hihsak in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in dawngin, "Khimham in kei hong zui ding a, nangmah in hoih na sak bangbangin ama a' ding ka hihsak ding hi; kei tung panin na deih khempeuh nangma a dingin kong hihsak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh Jordan galah pai uh a, kumpipa zong a pai hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in Barzillai namin thupha pia a, ama inn-ah amah a ciah hi.
Gilgal-ah kumpipa paisuak a, amah tawh Khimham paisuak hi. Judah mi khempeuh, le Israel mi a kimkhatte in zong ama paina dingah kumpipa a kha uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite khempeuh hong pai-in kumpipa kiangah, "Bang hangin ka sanggam uh Judah mite in nang hong gukhia-in, kumpipa le a innkuante, le David' mite amah tawh, Jordan galah paipih ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Judah mite khempeuh in Israel mite dawngin, "Kumpipa pen kote tawh beh kinai ahihna hang ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin hih thu-ah heh na hi uh hiam? Kumpipa' sum bei-in an ne peuhmah ka hi uh hiam? Tua ahih kei leh amah in letsong khat peuhpeuh kote hong pia ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite in Judah mite dawngin, "Kumpipa sungah tanh sawm ka nei uh a, David' sungah note khempeuh sangin tam ka neizaw uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin note in kote hong simmawh na hi uh hiam? Kote pen i kumpipa ciahpih kik ding a gen masate hi lo ka hi uh hiam?" a ci uh hi. Ahih hangin Israel mite' kammal sangin Judah mite' kammal kihtakhuai zaw hi.
Tu-in tua lai-ah Benjamin mi, Bikhri' tapa Sheba min nei, mi ginalo khat hong omkha hi. Amah in peengkul tumin, "David' sungah tanh i nei kei a, Jessi' tapa' sungah gamh i nei kei hi; na inn ciat uhah ciah un, Israel-te aw," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel mi khempeuh David' kiang pan nungkik uh a, Bikhri' tapa Sheba zui uh hi. Ahih hangin Judah mite in Jordan panin Jerusalem ciang dong a kumpipa uh kiptakin zui uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jerusalem-a a inn-ah David tung hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in inn kem dingin a nusiat a zineu sawmte la-in a kivil inn khat sungah amaute koihin amaute a vak hi. Ahih hangin amaute luppih lo hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute a khang laipi-in meigong numei suak uh a, a sih dong uh amaute kikhumcip hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Amasa kiangah, "Ni thum sungin Judah mite kei kiangah khawm inla, nangmahmah zong hih lai-ah hong om in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Judah-te a sam dingin Amasa pai a, ahi zongin ama tungah a kiciam a kisehsa khengin amah zekai hi.
Tua ciangin David in Abishai kiangah, "Tu-in Bikhri' tapa Sheba in Absalom sangin eite tungah siatna tamzaw hong bawl ding hi. Na topa' nasemte la inla, amah delh in. Tua hikeileh amah in ama a dingin khuapi muanhuaite ngahin eite tungah buaina hong piangsak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Abishai' nungah Joab le Khereth mite le Peleth mite, le mi thahat khempeuh pai uh hi. Bikhri' tapa Sheba a delh dingin Jerusalem panin amaute kuankhia uh hi.
Gibeon gam sunga suangtumpi-ah amaute a tun uh ciangin amaute a dawn dingin Amasa hong pai hi. Tu-in Joab in galkap puan silhin, tua tungah, a kawng tungah a kigak a paai sunga namsau tawh a kithuah kawnggak khat om a, a mailam manawhin a pai laitakin a namsau seel hi.
Tua ciangin Joab in Amasa kiangah, "Ka sanggampa aw, bang cici na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ciangin Joab in amah a hopih kawmin a taklam khut tawh a khamul-in Amasa man hi.
Ahih hangin Amasa in Joab' khutsunga om namsau mu lo hi. Tua ahih ciangin Joab in a namsau tawh a pumpi sat a, nihvei sat kul loin a gilpi leilakah buakhia hi; tua ciangin Amasa a si hi. Tua ciangin Joab le a sanggampa Abishai in Bikhri' tapa Sheba delh uh hi.
Tua ciangin Joab' mite khat Amasa' kiangah dingin, "Joab a gum peuhmah, le David-a' ahi mi peuhmah in Joab zui un," a ci hi.
Lam lianpi a ama sisan sungah Amasa kidiahin a om hi. Tua lai-ah a pai mi peuhmah in amah a muh ciangin a khawl uh hi. Mi khempeuh a khawlna tua mipa in a muh ciangin amah in lam lianpi panin gamlakah Amasa puakhia-in ama tungah puan khat a khuh hi.
Lam lianpi panin amah a kilakkhiat khit ciangin Bikhri' tapa Sheba a delh dingin Joab nungah mi khempeuh paisuak hi.
Tua ciangin Israel minamte khempeuh nawkin Abelbethmaakah khua-ah Sheba pai hi. Bikhri mi khempeuh kikhawm uh a, amah zui-in khuapi sungah tum uh hi.
Tua ciangin Joab tawh a om mi khempeuh hong pai-in Abelbethmaakah khua-ah amah umcih uh hi. Amaute in khuapi simna-in suang cianpi khat bawl uh a, kulhpi langkhatah ding uh hi. Tua ciangin kulhpi a puk theih nadingin amaute in kulhpi nuai to uh hi.
Tua ciangin numei pil khat in khuapi panin samin, "Za un! Joab kiangah gen un: 'Nang tungah thu kong gen theih nadingin hih lai-ah hong pai in,' ci un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua nu' mai-ah Joab hong pai hi. Tua numei in, "Nang, Joab na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in dawngin, "Ka hi hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin tua numei in ama kiangah, "Na nasemnu' thugente ngai in," a ci hi. Amah in dawngin, "Ka ngai hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Tanglai-in amaute in, 'Abel-ah thu dong sak un,' ci thei uh a, tua bangin amaute in thu siangsak uh hi.
Kei pen Israel sungah tua bangin kilemna a deih a thuman mi khat ka hi hi. Nang in Israel sungah nu tawh a kibang khuapi khat suksiat ding na hanciam hi. Bang hangin Topa' gamhluah valhtum ding na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Joab in dawngin, "Keimah in ka valhtum ding ahi a, ka suksiat ding ahi zongin keima ngaihsut hi dek lo hi.
Tua thu man lo hi. Ahih hangin Efraim mualtung gammi Bikhri' tapa Sheba a kici mipa in Kumpi David lehdo hi; amah bek hong pia in. Tua hileh khuapi panin ka nungkik ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin tua numei in Joab kiangah, "En in, kulh sung panin nang kiangah ama lutang hong kilawnsuk ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin ama pilna zangin mi khempeuh kiangah tua numei a pai hi. Tua ciangin amaute in Bikhri' tapa Sheba' lu tankhia-in Joab kiangah lawnkhia uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in peengkul tum a, khuapi panin amaute kikhenin a milipin a inn ciat uhah a ciah uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa kiang Jerusalem-ah Joab a ciah hi.
Tua laitakin Joab pen Israel galkap khempeuh a uk ahi hi. Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah pen Khereth mite le Peleth mite a uk ahi hi.
Adoram pen aana tawh na a kisemsakte a uk ahi hi. Ahilud' tapa Jehoshafat pen thu ciamteh pa ahi hi.
Sheva pen lai-at pa ahi hi. Zadok le Abiathar siampite ahi uh hi.
Jair mi Ira zong David' siampi ahi hi.
Tu-in kum khat khit kum khat, David' hun sungin kum thum sung kialpi tung hi. Tua ciangin David in Topa' kiangah thu dong hi. Topa in, "Amah in Gibeon mite that ahih manin Saul le a innkuan tungah mi thahna hanga mawhna om hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in Gibeon mite sam hi. Tu-in Gibeon mite pen Israel-te' sung hi loin Amor mi a omlaite ahi uh hi. Amaute a hingkhawi ding Israel mite kiciam khin napi-in, Israel le Judah mite a' ding a deih luatna-in Saul in amaute thah dingin hanciam hi.
Tua ciangin David in Gibeon mite kiangah, "Note a dingin bang hong hihsak ding ka hi hiam? Note in Topa' mite thupha na piaktheih nadingun bangci bangin kilemna hong bawl ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Gibeon mite in ama kiangah, "Kote le Saul ahi a, a innkuan tawh kikalah ahi zongin kitotna a om pen ngun le kham in maisak zo lo ding hi. Israel-te sungah mi khatpeuh ka thah hangun zong lungkim zawh nading om lo hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Note a' ding kong hihsak ding bang hi, ci na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Amaute in kumpipa kiangah, "Israel gam sungah kote in mun ka neih loh nadingun kote hong netumin suksiat ding Saul in vaihawm hi.
Topa' mualtung, Topa' mai Gibeon-ah amaute ka khai theih nadingun ama tapa sagihte hong pia in," a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Amaute kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in amah le Saul' tapa Jonathan' kikalah a om, Topa tawh kiciamna hangin Jonathan' tapa, Saul' tupa Mefibosheth a siit hi.
Ahi zongin Aiah' tanu Rizpah' tapa nih, Saul tawh a neih Armoni le Mefibosheth; le Saul' tanu Merab in Meholah mi Barzillai' tapa Adriel tawh a neih a tapa ngate a la hi.
Amah in Gibeon mite tungah amaute pia a, amaute in Topa' mai mualtungah amaute khai uh a, amau sagihte sikhawm uh hi. Mangbuhham lak kipat hun, anlak kipat cil lamin amaute kithat hi.
Tua ciangin Aiah' tanu Rizpah in a puanhampi la-in, anlak a kipan van panin amau' luanghawmte tungah guah a zuk dongin ama lup nadingin suangpi tungah a phah hi. Sunin huihlak vasate in ahi a, zanin gamsate in ahi zongin amau' luanghawmte a sukkhak loh nadingun a cing hi.
Saul' zineu, Aiah' tanu Rizpah' gamtatna thu David kiangah a kigen ciangin,
David pai-in Gilboa mualtungah Filistia-te in Saul a thah lai hunin Filistia-te in amaute a khaina mun Bethshan khuasung kongzing lampi laizang panin a luanghawm a guksak Jabeshgilead mite' tung panin Saul' guhte le a tapa Jonathan' guhte a lakik hi.
Amah in tua lai panin Saul' guhte le a tapa Jonathan' guhte paipihto hi. Amaute in a kikhai mi sagihte' guh zong kaikhawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Zela khuasung Benjamin' leitang, a pa Kish' han sungah Saul le a tapa Jonathan' guhte phum uh a, amaute in kumpipa' thupiak khempeuh hih uh hi. Tua khit ciangin tua gam ading thumnate Pasian in a ngai hi.
Filistia-te, Israel-te tawh kidokik uh a, David a nasemte tawh paisuk khawmin Filistia-te a sim uh hi. Tua galkidona-ah David gim mahmah hi.
Mithagolte' suante khat, a teipi sumngo shekel zathum a gik, namsau thak khat a kuah Ishbibenob in David thah ding ngaihsun hi.
Ahih hangin amah a huh dingin Zeruiah' tapa Abishai hong pai a, Filistia-pa simin amah a that hi. Tua ciangin David' mite in amah kunh-in, "Galsim dingin ko tawh nong kuankhia nawn kei ding hi. Hong kuan lecin Israel mite' muan le suanpa kong taan kha ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Hih hun khit ciangin Filistia-te tawh Gob-ah galkidona omkik a, Hushah mi Sibbekai in mithagolte' suante khat ahi Saf a that hi.
Tua ciangin Filistia-te tawh galkidona om leuleu a, Bethlehem mi Jaareoregim' tapa Elhanan in a teipi siamgante' siamlawngpi cia a pha, Gath mi Goliath a that hi.
Tua ciangin, a khut langtuakah khutme guk, le a khe langtuakah kheme guk, a vekpi-in sawmnih le li a nei, mi thalian khat a omna Gath-ah gal om leuleu hi. Amah zong mithagolte' sung panin a piang ahi hi.
Amah in Israel-te a phin ciangin, David' sanggampa Shimei' tapa Jonathan in amah that hi.
Hih mi lite pen Gath-a mithagolte' sung pana piang ahi uh hi. David le a nasemte in amaute a that uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in ama galte khempeuh' khutsung, le Saul' khutsung panin amah a hotkhiat hunin David in hih la kammalte Topa' tungah a gen hi.
Amah in, " Topa, kei hong hupa, ka kulhpi, kei hong honkhia pa,
ka Pasian, ka kihutna, ka bukna pa, lum bangin kei a hong dal, ka munmuanhuai le ka belh, keimah hong honkhia pa hi a, ngong hihna panin hong hon hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh sihna tuihualte in kei hong tum a, siatna tuikhangte in kei hong nawk hi.
Ka lungkhamna-ah Topa ka sam a, ka Pasian ka sam hi. A biakinn panin amah in ka aw hong za a, ka kikona awging ama bil a tung hi.
"Tua ciangin ama hehna hangin leitung kisingin, nakpitakin kilokgawp a, vantung bulpite kilinggawp hi.
A nakvang sung panin meikhu pusuak a, a kamsung panin a kangtum mei pusuak a, ama tung panin mei-am san kuangkhia hi.
Amah in vantungte niamsakin hong paisuk a, ama khenuai-ah khuamial sahpi om hi.
Kherub khat tungah amah tuangin hong leng a, huih khate tungah amah kimu hi.
Amah in ama kimkotah khuamial bawl a, a tung kikhuh nadingin meii sahpi a zang hi.
"Vantung panin Topa hong awngsuk a, Sang Pen pa in a aw hong gingsak hi.
Amah in thaltangte lawnin thehthang gawp a, khuaphialep phiasakin amaute a taisak hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' mawhsakna awging lianpi hangin tuipi tawte kidawk a, lei bulpite a guakin om hi.
"Amah in a sangna mun panin hong banin kei hong la a, tui thukpi panin kei hong kaikhia hi.
A hat ka galte panin kei hong honkhia a, kei hong mudahte panin hong suaktasak hi. Keima a dingin ka galte hatlua uh hi.
Ka kamsiat ni-in kei hong simgawp uh a, ahih hangin Topa in kei hong huh hi.
Amah in mun tanzau khatah kei hong paikhiatpih a, kei tungah lungkim ahih manin kei hong honkhia hi.
"Ka thumanna tawh kizui-in Topa in thaman hong pia a, ka sianthona tawh kizui-in hong dinkik hi.
Ama biakna ngeina kipte hoihtakin ka zui a, ama thukhamte panin kei ka pial kei hi.
Ama mai-ah kawk ka baang kei a, kisuanna dangte panin hoihtakin ka kikem hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in ka thumanna, ama muhna-ah ka sianthona tawh kizui-in kei hong dinkik khin hi.
"Thuman mi tungah nangmah na thuman a, a kawkbaang lo mi tungah a kawkbaang loin na gamta hi.
A siangtho mi tungah a siangtho-in na gamta a, a thukawi mi tungah thupeelin na gamta hi.
Topa aw, nang pen keima meivak na hi hi. Ka Pasian in ka khuamial vaksak hi.
Nangma hangin galkap hon khat ka sugawpzo a, ka Pasian' hangin khuakulh khat ka kanzo hi.
"Hih Pasian a thu kicing a, Topa' kamciamna a manna kilang hi. Amah a beelte khempeuh a dingin kidalna lum ahi hi.
Topa longal Pasian kua hiam? I Pasian simloh, hong hu kua hiam?
Hih Pasian, a muanhuai keima belh hi a, ka lampi khempeuh lungmuanhuaisak hi.
Amah in sakhipite' khe bangin ka khe kipsak a, mun sangna-ah keimah hong koih hi.
Amah in galsimzia kei hong hilh a, sumngo thal khauhpente ka keekzo hi.
"Nangmah in kei hong dalin na hong honkhia a, nangma hong huhna in kei hong liansak hi.
Ka kalsuan nading mun tanzau keima nuai-ah nong pia a, ka khe taal lo hi.
Ka galte delhin ka susia a, amaute a beitum mateng kei ka kileh kei hi.
Amaute ka beisak a, amaute ka sunlet hi; amaute thokik nawn lo uh a, ka khenuai-ah amaute puk uh hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in galdo nadingin tha nong guan a, keimah hong dote ka nuai-ah na nengniam hi.
Nangmah in ka galte, kei hong mudahte, na nungkiksak a, keimah in amaute ka susiagawp hi.
Amaute khuadak uh a, ahih hangin a honkhia ding kuamah om lo hi. Topa' tungah hong ko uh a, ahih hangin amah in amaute dawng lo hi.
"Leivui bangin amaute ka satvui a, kongzing buante bangin amaute tuankhamin ka sikcipsuk hi.
Mite tawh kidona panin nangmah in nong honkhia a, minamte' lutangin kei nong bawl a, ka theih ngei loh mite in keima na hong sem uh hi.
Keimah mai-etin gamdang mite ka kiangah hong pai uh hi. Amaute in ka thu a zak phetun, ka thu hong mang uh hi.
Gamdang mite lungkia uh a, a phualkip panun lingin hong paikhia uh hi.
" Topa hing hi; kei hong hupa in thupha ngah hen la, ka Pasian, kei hong honkhia pa,
hong thuksakin, keima nuai-ah mite a koihsuk Pasian,
ka galte kiang panin kei hong paikhiatpih pa vanglian tahen. Nangmah in ka langte tungah kei nong liansak a, mi ngongtatte kiang panin kei nong honkhia hi.
" Topa aw, hih thu hangin minam khempeuh lakah nang kong phat ding a, na min phatna la ka sa ding hi.
Zawhna lianpi ama kumpipa tungah pia a, a sathau nilh pa David le a suanlekhakte tungah a tawntungin itna kip a lak hi," a ci hi.
Jessi' tapa David, milianpi a suak mipa, Jakob' Pasian' sathau nilh pa, Israel laphuak siampa David' kam nunungte hih bang ahi hi:
" Topa' kha in kei tungtawnin thu hong gen a, ka kam sungah ama thugente om hi.
Israel Pasian kampau khin a, Israel a hupa in kei kiangah hong ci khin hi: Mi khat in mite tungah thutang takin ukin Pasian zahtakna tawh limtakin a uk ciangin
amah pen amaute tungah zingsang khuavak bangin taang ziazua a, meii kaai loh ni zingsang a ni taangkhia, leilak panin lopate a selsak guahtui tawh kibang hi.
Hi hi, ka innkuan zong Pasian tawh tua bangmah hi lo ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in tawntung thuciamna kei tawh hong bawl a, na khempeuh a hoih a kipin hih hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah hong huhin, ka deihna khempeuh tangtungsak ding hi lo ahi hiam?
Ahih hangin mi gilote ahihleh a kilawnkhia lingkungte tawh kibang hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh khut guak tawh amaute kilawng ngam lo a,
amaute a lawng ding mipa pen sik le teipi bul tawh kithawi a, amaute mei tawh kihaltum siang hi," a ci hi.
David' neih mi thahatte' minte: Tahkhemon mi Joshebbasshebeth hi a, amah pen mi thumte a ukpa ahi hi. Amah in a teipi tawh mihing zagiat do-in hun khat sungin thatmang khin hi.
Tua ciangin mi thahat thumte lakah amah a zom pa pen Ahoah mi Dodo' tapa Eleazar ahi hi. Galsim dingin a kikaikhawm Filistia-te to a, Israel mite a nungkik hunin David tawh amah om hi.
Amah dingin a khut a hikcip mateng Filistia-te sattuk a, a namsau a khut sungah omcip hi. Topa in tua ni-in gualzawhna lianpi piangsak a, a kithat mite' na a tawm ding bekin ama nungah mite hong paikik uh hi.
Ama zomah Harar mi Agee' tapa Shammah ahi hi. Besan a dimna mun Lehi-ah Filistia-te kikaikhawm uh a, Filistia-te' kiang panin mite tai uh hi.
Ahih hangin amah in tua munah panmun la-in hu a, Filistia-te that a, Topa in gualzawhna lianpi a piangsak hi.
Ukpa sawmthumte lak panin mi thumte paisukin, Refaim kuamah Filistia mihonte in giahphual satin a om laitakin, Adullam leihawm a David kiangah anlak hun pawlin tung uh hi.
Tua hunin munmuanhuai sungah David om a, Filistia khuacingte Bethlehem-ah om uh hi.
David in lunggulhna tawh, "Kulhkongpi gei-a om Bethlehem tuikhuk panin mi khat in tuidawn ding kei hong pia leh!" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mi thahat thumte in Filistia-te' giahphual phulin kulhkongpi gei-a om Bethlehem tuikhuk panin tui tawikhia uh a, a tui la-in David kiangah paipih uh hi. Ahih hangin David in a tui dawn lo hi. Amah in Topa a dingin a tui sung a,
" Topa aw, hih tui ka dawn het kei ding hi. Amau' nuntakna khamin a pai mite' sisan a dawn tawh ka kibang hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in dawn lo hi. Mi thahat thumte' hanzia tu-a bang ahi hi.
Tu-in Zeruiah' tapa, Joab' sanggampa Abishai, mihing sawmthumte a ukpa ahi hi. Amah in a teipi tawh mihing za thumte do-in amaute that a, mihing sawmthumte' banah minphatna ngahbeh hi.
Mihing sawmthumte sung pan amah a minthang pen hi a, amaute a ukpa a suak hi. Ahih hangin amah in mihing thumte ban nai lo hi.
Jehoiada' tapa, Kabzeel khuami Benaiah pen gal a hang, na lianpite a sempa hi a, amah in Moab galhang mi nih a vat hi. Amah zong paisukin vuk a kiat ni khatin leihawm sunga om humpinelkai khat a that hi.
Amah in a melhoih Egypt mi khat a that hi. Egypt mipa in a khut sungah teipi tawi hi. Ahih hangin Benaiah ciangkhut khat tawh ama kiangah paisuk a, Egypt-pa' khutsung panin a teipi sutkhia-in ama teipi mah tawh amah a that hi.
Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah in hihte hihin, a thahat mi thumte' minphatna zah phial a ngah hi.
Mihing sawmthumte' lakah amah minthang a, ahih hangin amah in mihing thumte ban nai lo hi. David in amah a cingte a ukin a koih hi.
Joab' sanggampa Asahel zong sawmthumte' lakah khat ahi hi. Bethlehem mi Dodo' tapa Elhanan,
Pirathon khuami Benaiah, Gaash gei-a kuam pan Hiddai,
Betharabah khuami Abialbon, Bahurim khuami Azmaveth,
Shaalbon khuami Eliahba, Jashen' tapate, Jonathan,
Maakah khuami Ahasbai' tapa Elifelet, Gilo khuami Ahithofel' tapa Eliam,
Karmel khuami Hezro, Arbi mi Paarai,
Ammon mi Zelek, Zeruiah' tapa galhiam a tawi Beeroth khuami Naharai,
Hit mi Uriah, a vekpi-in sawmthum le sagih ahi uh hi.
Khatvei, Israel-te tungah Topa hong hehkik a, amah in mite' gim nadingin David hanthawnin, "Pai in; Israel le Judah mi a phazah sim in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in Joab le amah tawh a om galkap ukte kiangah, "Mite a phazah ka theih nadingin Dan panin Beersheba ciang dong Israel minamte khempeuh lakah pai unla mi phazah va sim un," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Joab in kumpipa kiangah, "Ka to kumpipa' muhin Topa na Pasian in mite tu-a a omzah za khatin a tamna behlap tahen. Ahih hangin bang hangin ka to kumpipa in hih thu deih na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa' kamgente in Joab le galkap ukte zozaw hi. Tua ahih ciangin Israel mite a phazah a sim dingin kumpipa' omna panin Joab le galkap ukte a paikhia uh hi.
Amaute in Jordan kantanin kuam laizang a om khuapi Aroer panin kipanin Gad lam manawh uh a, Jazer-ah paisuak uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute Gilead tung uh a, tua panin Hit mite' gam Kadesh tung uh hi. Tua lai panin Dan tungin, Dan panin kual pai-in Sidon tung uh hi.
Tua ciangin Taia munmuanhuai le Hiv mite le Kanaan mite' khuapite khempeuh tung uh hi. Tua panin Judah-te' Negeb lam Beersheba-ah pai uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin gam khempeuhah amaute a pai khit uh, kha kua le ni sawmnih a cin khit ciangin Jerusalem-ah hong tungkik uh hi.
Tua ciangin Joab in kumpipa kiangah mite a phazah a gawm a pia hi: Israel sungah namsau a tawi galhang mi tul zagiat om a, Judah mi tul zanga om hi.
Ahih hangin mi a sim khit ciangin David' lungsim in amahmah gimsak hi. Tua ciangin David in Topa' tungah, "Ka gamtatnasa sungah nakpitakin ka khial hi. Ahih hangin, tu-in, Topa aw, nang tungah kong thum hi; na nasempa' mawhna hong maisak in; bang hang hiam cih leh ka hai gamtatkha khin hi," a ci hi.
Zingsangin David a thawh ciangin David' thumu pa ahi kamsang Gad tungah Topa' thu hong tung a,
"Pai inla, David kiangah hih bangin gen in. ' Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Nangma tungah thu thum kong pia hi; nang tungah kong hih theih nadingin tuate khat teel in,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David kiangah Gad hong pai-in ama tungah gen a, "Na gam sungah kum thum sung kialpi hong tung ding hiam? Ahih kei leh na galte in nang hong delh laitakin amaute' mai-ah kha thum sung tai ding na hi hiam? Ahih kei leh na gam sungah ni thum sung pulnatna hong tung ding ahi hiam? Tu-in ngaihsun in; kei hong sawl pa' kiangah bang dawnna puakkik ding ka hi hiam khentat in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in Gad kiangah, "Nakpi takin ka lung a kham hi. Ama hehpihna lian ahih manin Topa' khut sungah tung ni; bangbang ahi zongin mihing khut sungah hong tungsak kei hen," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in zingsang a kipan a kiseh hun dongin Israel-te tungah natna tungsak hi. Dan panin Beersheba dongin mihing tul sawmsagih a si hi.
Vantung mi in Jerusalem khua a susia dingin kithawi-in a khut a zan ciangin tua tatsiatna panin Topa kisik a, mite lakah suksiatna na a sem vantungmi kiangah, "Phazo hi; tu-in khawl ta in," a ci hi. Topa' vantungmi pen Jebus mi Araunah' ancilna gei-ah a om hi.
Tua ciangin mite a vat vantungmi a muh ciangin David in Topa' tungah thu gen a, "En in, ka mawh hi; a khial pa pen kei ka hi hi. Hih mite in bang khialhna nei ahi uh hiam? Kong thum hi; kei le ka innkuante bek gim hong pia in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua ni-in David kiangah Gad pai-in ama kiangah, "Paito in; Jebus mi Araunah' ancilna-ah Topa a' ding biakna tau khat phut in," a ci hi.
Araunah a khuadaksuk ciangin kumpipa le a nasemte ama lamah a hong paito a mu hi. Araunah paikhia-in a mai lei ngatin kumpipa zahtakna a bawl hi.
Tua ciangin Araunah in, "Bang hangin ka to kumpipa a nasempa kiangah hong pai na hi hiam?" a ci hi. "Mite' tung panin gimna a ven' theih nadingin Topa a' ding biakna tau lam nading na ancilna mun a lei ding," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Araunah in David kiangah, "Ka to kumpipa in hoih na sak bangin la inla biakna pia in; meihal biak nadingin bawngtalte, le a sing dingin ancilna peekte le bawngtal kolte hih lai-ah om hi.
Kumpipa aw, keimah Araunah in hihte khempeuh kumpipa tungah kong pia hi," a ci hi. Tua banah Araunah in kumpipa kiangah, " Topa , na Pasian in nang hong sang ta hen," cithuah lai hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in Araunah kiangah, "Hilo hi; nangma tung panin hihte a man tawh kituakin kong lei ding hi. Topa ka Pasian' tungah kei' sum bei loin meihal biaknate ka pia kei ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin David in ngun shekel sawmnga tawh ancilna mun le bawngtalte a lei hi.
Tua ciangin David in Topa a' ding biakna tau khat tua lai-ah lam a, meihal biaknate le thunuama biaknate a pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua gam adingin thumna Topa in ngai a, Israel-te' tung panin gimna a veng hi.
Tu-in Kumpi David teekin kum tam ta hi. Amaute in amah puan a silhsak uh hangin a khua lum thei lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a nasemte in ama kiangah, "Ka to kumpipa a dingin nungakno khat kizong hen la, amah in kumpipa enin amah a kemnu hita hen. Ka to kumpipa a khua a lum theih nadingin na ang sungah tua nu lum hen," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Israel gam sung khempeuhah nungak melhoih khat zong uh a, Shunem mi Abishag mu-in, kumpipa kiangah amah paipih uh hi.
Tua nungak melhoih mahmah a, kumpipa a kemnu suakin ama na a sem hi. A lupkhawm uh hangin kumpipa in amah hih zo lo hi.
Tu-in David in Haggith tawh a neih a tapa Adonijah amahmah kiliansak tawmin, "Keimah, kumpi ka hi ding hi," a ci hi. Amah in ama a dingin leengte le sakol tung tuangte, le ama mai-ah a tai ding mihing sawmnga vaihawm hi.
A pa David in, "Bang hangin tua bang tua bangin gamta na hi hiam?" ci-a dotna tawh khatvei beek amah tai ngei lo hi. Amah pen a melhoih mahmah mi khat zong ahi hi. Amah pen Absalom zom a suak ahi hi.
Amah in Zeruiah' tapa Joab le siampi Abiathar tawh vaihawm hi. Amaute in Adonijah zui-in amah panpih uh hi.
Ahih hangin siampi Zadok, le Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah, le David' mi a thahatte in Adonijah panpih lo uh hi.
Adonijah in Enrogel gei-a om Gulpi' Suangpi kiangah tuute, bawngtalte, le ganno thaute biakna-in pia-in, amah in kumpipa' tapate ahi a sanggamte khempeuh le Judah gam kumpi uliante khempeuh sam a,
Tua ciangin Nathan in Solomon' nu Bathsheba kiangah, "Haggith' tapa Adonijah kumpi suak khinin, David in tua thu a theih lohna thu za nai lo na hi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in hong pai in. Nangma nuntakna le na tapa Solomon' nuntakna na suahtaksak theih nadingin nang tungah ngaihsutna kong pia ding hi.
Thakhatin Kumpi David kiangah pai-in ama tungah, 'Ka to kumpipa in na nasemnu' tungah hong kiciamin, "Na tapa Solomon pen keima nungah maangin, keima kumpi tokhom tungah tu ding hi," ci hi lo na hi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin Adonijah kumpi suak ahi hiam?' ci in.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah thu na gen laitakin kei zong nangma nungah hong pai-in nangma thugen teng kong panpih ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Bathsheba a inndei sung kumpipa kiangah va pai hi (tu-in kumpipa teek mahmah a, Shunem mi Abishag in kumpipa' na sem hi.)
Tua nu in ama kiangah, "Ka topa aw, na nasemnu tungah Topa na Pasian' min tawh kiciamin, 'Na tapa Solomon pen keima nungah maangin, keima kumpi tokhom tungah tu ding hi,' na ci hi.
Tu-in en in, ka to kumpipa in na theih loh hangin, Adonijah kumpi ahi hi.
Amah in biakna-in bawngtalte, ganno thaute, le tuute, tampi tak pia khin a, kumpipa' tapate khempeuh, siampi Abiathar, le galkapte a ukpa Joab sam a, ahih hangin amah in na nasempa Solomon sam lo hi.
Ka to kumpipa aw, tu-in nangma nungah ka to kumpipa' tokhom tungah kua tu ding, ci-a amaute kiangah na gen ding ngakin Israel-te khempeuh in nang hong en uh hi.
Tua bang hikeileh ka to kumpipa na bei ciangin kei le ka tapa Solomon a khialin a hong kiseh hun hong tung ding hi," a ci hi.
Kumpipa tawh tua nu kiho-in a om laitakin kamsangpa Nathan hong tum hi.
Kumpipa kiangah, "Hih lai-ah kamsangpa Nathan om hi," ci-in a kigen hi. Kumpipa mai-ah amah hong pai ciangin a mai leilam ngatin kumpipa' mai-ah a kun hi.
Tua ciangin Nathan in, "Ka to kumpipa aw, 'Keima nungah Adonijah maangin ka kumpi tokhom tungah tu ding hi,' ci na hi hiam?
Bang hang hiam cih leh tuni-in amah paisuk khinin, bawngtalte, ganno thaute, le tuute, tampi tak biakna-in pia a, kumpipa' tapate khempeuh, galkapte a ukpa Joab, le siampi Abiathar sam hi. Amaute in ama a' ding pawi bawl uh a, 'Kumpi Adonijah a khansau hen!' ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin na nasempa keimah, le siampi Zadok, le Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah, le na nasempa Solomon, amah in hong sam lo hi.
Ka to kumpipa in hih thu thukimpihin, nangma khit ciangin ka to kumpipa' tokhom tungah kua tu ding cih thu na nasem kote' kiangah hong im na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi David in dawngin, "Bathsheba ka kiangah hong samkik in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa omna-ah tua nu hong pai-in, kumpipa' mai-ah a ding hi.
Kumpipa kiciamin, "Haksatna khempeuh panin kei a hong honkhia Topa a nungta ahih mah bangin,
nangma tungah Topa , Israel Pasian' min tawh hong kiciamin, 'Keima nungah ka tapa Solomon maang ding a, keima tangin ka kumpi tokhom tungah tu ding hi,' ka cihsa mah bangin, tuni-in zong ka cikik hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Bathsheba in leilam maingatin kunin kumpipa tungah zahtakna bawl a, "Ka to kumpi David nungta tawntung ta hen!" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi David in siampi Zadok, kamsang Nathan, le Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah samsak hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa' mai-ah amaute hong pai uh hi.
Kumpipa in amaute kiangah, "Na topa' nasemte paipih unla, ka tapa Solomon keima la-sakol tungah tuangsakin Gihon-ah paipihsuk un.
Israel-te' tungah kumpi-in tua lai munah siampi Zadok le kamsang Nathan sathau nilhsak un. Tua ciangin peengkul tum unla, 'Kumpi Solomon khansau hen!' ci un.
Tua ciangin ama nungah note nong pai ding uh a, amah hong pai-in ka kumpi tokhom tungah hong tu ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh keima tangin amah kumpi hi ding hi. Israel le Judah a ukpa dingin amah ka seh khinzo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah in dawngin, "Hi ta hen! Topa , ka to kumpipa' Pasian in tua bangin kipsak tahen.
Topa in ka to kumpipa a ompih mah bangin Solomon zong ompih hen la, ka to Kumpi David' tokhom sangin ama tokhom lianzaw sak hen," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Zadok, kamsang Nathan, Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah, le Khereth mite le Peleth mite paisukin Kumpi David' la-sakol tungah Solomon tuangsak uh a, Gihon-ah amah paipih uh hi.
Tua lai-ah siampi Zadok in puanbuk panin sathau biing la-in Solomon a nilh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in peengkul tum uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, "Kumpi Solomon khansau hen!" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh ama nungah pai-in tamngaikop tum uh a, nakpitakin lungdam uh a, amau' gamlumna in lei a thawnkham hi.
Adonijah le amah tawh a om leenglate khempeuh in a pawi bawl a man khit uh ciangin hih thu za uh hi. Joab in peengkul aw a zak ciangin amah in, "Khuapi sungah hih gamlumna bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah a kampau laitakin, siampi Abiathar' tapa Jonathan hong pai hi. Tua ciangin Adonijah in, "Hong tum in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang migina na hi a, thuhoih nong puak hi," a ci hi.
Jonathan in Adonijah dawngin, "Hilo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh i to kumpi David in kumpi-in Solomon bawl khin hi.
Kumpipa in amah tawh siampi Zadok, kamsang Nathan, le Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah, le Khereth mite le Peleth mite sawl khin hi. Amaute in kumpipa' la-sakol tungah amah tuangsak khin uh hi.
Siampi Zadok le kamsang Nathan in Gihon-ah kumpi-in amah sathau nilh khin uh hi. Tua lai panin amaute lungdamin ciahkhin uh ahih manin khuapi sung gamlum hi. Nangma zak pen hih gamlumna ahi hi.
Tu-in Solomon in kumpi tokhom luah khinta hi.
Tua tham loin kumpipa' nasemte i to Kumpi David tungah lungdamna a ko dingin pai uh a, 'Na Pasian in nangma min sangin Solomon' min a thangzaw-in bawl hen la, nangma tokhom sangin ama tokhom a lianzaw-in bawl ta hen,' ci uh hi. A lupna tung panin kumpipa mahmah zong kun hi.
Tua ciangin Adonijah' leenglate khempeuh ling uh a, dingin amau' mun ciatah a ciah uh hi.
Tua ciangin Adonijah in Solomon kihta hi. Amah pai-in biakna tau kite pom hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon kiangah, "Adonijah in Kumpi Solomon hong kihta hi. Amah in biakna tau kite lenin, 'Amah in a nasempa namsau tawh a thahloh nading kei tungah Kumpi Solomon hong kiciam masa hen,' ci hi," kici hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in, "Amah in a kilawm mi ahihna a lahtel theih leh ama samzang khat zong leilakah kialo ding a, ahi zongin ama sungah gitlohna a kimuh leh amah si ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kumpi Solomon in mi sawl a, amaute in zong biakna tau panin amah paikhiatpih uh hi. Amah hong pai-in Kumpi Solomon' tungah zahtakna bawl hi. Tua ciangin Solomon in ama kiangah, "Na inn-ah ciah in," a ci hi.
"Leitung mi khempeuh ngeina bangin a pai ding ka hi ta hi. Thakhauhin pasal na hihna kilangsak in.
Amah in kei tungah a hong gen, 'Na tapate in a lungsim khempeuh uhleh a nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh keima mai-ah thuman takin gamtat ding limtakin a ngaihsut nak-uhleh Israel kumpi tokhom tungah khat beek in nang hong tamasak lo ding hi,' ci-a a thugenna Topa in a kipsak theih nadingin, Moses thukham sungah a kigelh bangin Topa na Pasian' thuhilhna zui-in, ama lampite hoihtakin tawn inla, ama thukhamte, a thupiakte, a biakna ngeina kipte hoihtakin zui in. Tua hileh na heksuk na hektohna khempeuhah na dau hong pai ding hi.
"Tham loin, Zeruiah' tapa Joab in kei hong bawlna, gal sunga a si mite' phu a lakna-in gal kilem hun sungin a thah, Israel galkap ukte ahi mi nih, Ner' tapa Abner le Jether' tapa Amasa tungah a bawlna le, amah in mawhna nei lo mite thatin, tua ama gamtatna hangin ka thuaknate zong na thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin nangma pilna bangin gamta inla, lungnuam takin sih ngeina tawh amah na sihsak loh ding thei in.
Ahih hangin Gilead mi Barzillai' tapate tungah thuman takin gamta inla, na sabuai a an nete bangin amaute omsak in; bang hang hiam cih leh na sanggampa Absalom' kiang panin ka tai lai-in amaute in tua bang thumanna tawh kei hong bawl uh hi.
Mahanaim ah ka pai lai-in a nasia samsiatna tawh kei a hong samsia, Bahurim panin a hong pai Benjamin mi Gera' tapa Shimei zong nang tawh om hi. Ahih hangin Jordan-ah keimah a dawn dingin hong pai ciangin ama tungah Topa tawh kiciamin, 'Namsau tawh nang kong that kei ding hi,' ka ci hi.
Ahi ta zongin tu-in amah a mawhbaang loin ngaihsun kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang mipil na hi hi. Ama tungah na bawl dinga a kilawm na thei ngawn ding hi. Amah thatin a lutang hanah na paipihsuk ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David si a, David khuapi sungah kivui hi.
Israel-te tungah David in kum sawmli sung uk hi. Amah in Hebron-ah kum sagih sung ukin, Jerusalem-ah kum sawmthum le kum thum sung uk hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a pa David' tokhom tungah Solomon tu a, ama kumpi gam kiptakin kiphut hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon' nu Bathsheba kiangah David in Haggith tawh a neih a tapa Adonijah hong pai hi. Tua nu in, "Thunuama hong pai na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in, "Thunuam hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Adonijah in, "Nang tungah gen ding khat ka nei hi," a ci hi. Amah in, "Gen in," a ci hi.
Adonijah in, "Kumpi gam pen keima-a' hi-in, Israel-te khempeuh in keima uk ding a lamet mahmahna uh na thei hi. Ahi zongin kumpi gam kihei-in ka sanggampa-a' suak hi; bang hang hiam cih leh hih thu pen Topa' kiang pan ahi hi.
Amah in, "Kumpi Solomon kiangah nong ngetsak ding kong thum hi. Amah in nang' thu hong nial lo ding hi. Shunem mi Abishag ka zi dingin kei tungah hong piak ding ka ut hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Adonijah tangin ama tungah thu a gen dingin Kumpi Solomon kiangah Bathsheba va pai hi. Tua ciangin tua nu a dawn dingin kumpipa dingin tua nu mai-ah a kun hi. Tua ciangin ama tokhom tungah tu-in kumpipa' nu a dingin tutna khat lasak hi. Tua nu ama taklamah a tu hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Nangma tungah na neuno khat nget ding ka nei hi; kei hong nial kei in," a ci hi. Kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Hong ngen in, nu aw; kong nial kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Amah in, "Shunem mi Abishag ama zi dingin na sanggampa Adonijah tungah kipia hen," a ci hi.
Kumpi Solomon in a nu dawngin, "Bang hangin Adonijah a dingin Shunem mi Abishag hong ngen na hi hiam? Kumpi gam zong ama a dingin ngetsak lai vet in; bang hang hiam cih leh amah ka u hi a, ama lamah siampi Abiathar le Zeruiah' tapa Joab pang hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Solomon zong Topa tawh kiciamin, "Hih thu in Adonijah' nuntakna a lei kei taak leh Pasian in kei hong dawm kei ta hen!
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, kei hong kipsakin ka pa David' tokhom tungah hong koih a, ama ciamsa bangin kei tung le ka suanlekhakte tungah kumpi gam hong pia Topa a nungta ahih mah bangin, tuni-in Adonijah kithat ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kumpi Solomon in Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah sawl hi. Amah in tua pa satpuk sukin, tua ciangin amah a si hi.
Tua ciangin siampi Abiathar' kiangah kumpipa in, "Nangma mun le nangma gam a omna Anathoth ah ciah in; bang hang hiam cih leh na sih ding a kilawm ahi hi. Ahih hangin nangmah in ka pa David' mai-ah Topa Pasian ' Thuciamna Singkuang na puakna le ka pa' gimna-ah na gimkhopna hangin tutungin nang kong that kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Solomon in Topa' siampi hihna panin Abiathar hawlkhia-in, Eli innkuan tawh kisai thu Topa in Shiloh-ah a genna thu tua bangin a tungsak hi.
Hih thu Joab kiang a tun ciangin Topa' puanbukah Joab tai-in biakna tau kite a len hi. (Joab in Absalom pawlpih loin Adonijah a na pawlpihna hang ahi hi.)
Kumpi Solomon kiangah, " Topa' puanbukah Joab tai hi," ci-in a kigen ciangin Solomon in Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah sawlin, "Pai in; amah satpuk in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa' puanbukah Benaiah hong pai-in ama kiangah, "Kumpipa in thu hong pia a, 'Hong paikhia in,' ci hi," a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in, "Hilo hi, hih lai-ah kei ka sizaw ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Benaiah in kumpipa kiangah thu puakin, "Tua bangin Joab in thu gen a, tua bangin amah in kei hong dawng hi," a ci hi.
Kumpipa in amah dawngkikin, "Ama cihsa bangin hih in; amah satlum inla phum in. Joab in thu om lopi-in mi a thahna hangin mawhna pen keima tung le ka suanlekhakte' tung panin tua bangin na siangsak ding hi.
Topa in ama mawhna ama lu tung mahah tungsakkik ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka pa David' theih loh kalin amah in Israel galkapte a uk Ner' tapa Abner le Judah galkapte a uk Jether' tapa Amasa, amah sangin thuman zaw-in a hoihzaw ahi mihing nih do-in namsau tawh a that hi.
