Tua ahih ciangin mi thahna hangin gimna pen Joab' lu tung le ama suanlekhakte' lu tungah a tawntungin hong tungkik ding hi. Ahih hangin David' tung, ama suanlekhakte' tung, ama innkuan tung, le ama kumpi tokhom tungah Topa' kiang panin a tawntung nopna om ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah paito-in amah satpuk sukin that a, gamlak ama inn sungah amah kiphum hi.
Kumpipa in Joab tangin galkapte' tungah Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah koih a, kumpipa in Abiathar' tangin siampi Zadok a koih hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in mi sawlin Shimei samsakin ama kiangah, "Jerusalem-ah inn khat lamin tua lai-ah teng inla, tua lai mun panin mun khat peuhpeuhah paikhia kei in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nang paikhia-in Kidron lui na kantan ni-in na sih ding teltakin thei in; na sih leh nangma khialhna hang hi ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Shimei in kumpipa kiangah, "Na thugen hoih hi; ka to kumpipa' gen bangin na nasempa gamta ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Jerusalem-ah sauveipi sung Shimei om hi.
Ahih hangin kum thum a cin ciangin Gath kumpipa Maakah' tapa Akhish kiangah Shimei' silate nih va tai uh hi. Shimei' kiangah, "En in, na silate Gath-ah om hi," ci-in a kigen ciangin
Shimei dingin la khat a van vawhin a silate a zong dingin Gath-a Akhish kiangah pai a, Gath panin a silate a ciahpih hi.
Jerusalem panin Gath-ah Shimei pai-in a ciahkikna thu Solomon kiangah a kigen ciangin
kumpipa in mi sawlin Shimei samsakin ama kiangah, " Topa tawh hong kiciam sakin, thupi takin nang hong thuhilhin, 'Nang, mun khat peuhpeuhah na paikhiat ni-in na sih ding teltakin thei in,' hong ci hi lo ka hi hiam? Tua ciangin nangmah in, 'Na thugen hoih hi; ka mang hi,' na ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin Topa' tungah na kiciamna le nang hong thuhilhin kong thupiakna zui lo na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua banah kumpipa in Shimei kiangah, "Ka pa David tungah siatna na bawlte khempeuh na lungsimah na thei hi. Tua ahih ciangin Topa in nangma siatna nangma lu tung mahah hong tunkik ding hi.
Ahih hangin Kumpi Solomon thupha kipia-in, a tawntungin Topa' mai-ah a tokhom kikipsak ding hi," zong a ci lai hi.
psap Tua ciangin kumpipa in Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah thu pia hi. Amah paikhia-in Shimei satpuk sukin, tua ciangin amah a si hi. Tua ahih ciangin Solomon' khut sungah kumpi gam kikipsak hi.
Solomon in Egypt kumpipa Faro tawh numei-a kizopna bawl hi. Amah in Faro' tanu la a, ama inn le Topa' biakinn le Jerusalem kimkota kulhpi a lam a zawh mateng David khuapi sungah tua nu paipihin omsak hi.
Ahi zongin Topa a dingin biakinn kilam nai lo ahih manin mite in mualtung a biaknate-ah biakna pia uh hi.
Solomon in Topa itin, a pa David' thukhamte zui hi. Ahi zongin amah in mualtung a biaknate-ah biakna pia-in paknamtui hal hi.
Tua ciangin biakna a pia dingin Gibeon-ah kumpipa pai hi; bang hang hiam cih leh mualtung a biakna mun a lian pen ahi hi. Solomon in tua biakna tau tungah meihal biakna tam veipi tak a piaknasa mun ahi hi.
Gibeon-ah zanin mang sungah Solomon' tungah Topa kilang hi. Pasian in, "Nang kong piak ding hong ngen in," a ci hi.
Solomon in, "Na nasem ka pa David' tungah a lian itna kip na lak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh cihtakna, thumanna tawh nangma mai-ah gamta-in, nangma tungah lungsim thutang hi. Nangmah in ama a dingin hih a lian itna kip koihsakin, tuni-in ama tokhom tungah a tu ding tapa khat na pia hi.
Tu-in, Topa ka Pasian aw, kei pen naupangno khat hinapi-in ka pa David' munah kumpi-in na nasempa nong koih hi. Bangci gamtatin bangci nasep ding cih ka theih khat zong om lo hi.
A lian, a phazah a kisim zo lo, a tamna a kiseh thei lo, nangmah in na teelsa na mite lakah na nasempa om hi.
Tua ahih ciangin keimah in a sia le a pha ka theihtheih nadingin na mite uk nading thu theihtelna lungsim na nasempa hong pia in. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih a lian a tam na mite kua in ukzo ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Solomon' thungetna in Topa lungkimsak hi.
Pasian in ama kiangah, "Nangmah in hih thu hong ngenin, nangma a dingin khansauna ahi a, hauhna ahi a, na galte thahzawh nading ahi zongin hong ngen loin, a man thu na theih nadingin nang a dingin thu theihtelna hong ngen na hih manin,
en in, nangma hong ngetna bangin kong pia ding hi. En in, nangma hun ma-in nang tawh a kibang a om loh nading le nangma khitah zong nang tawh a kibang hong khan loh nadingin pilna le theihna lungsim kong pia ding hi.
Nangma hunsung tawntung kumpi dang nang tawh a kiteh theih lohna dingin nangma hong nget loh hauhna le pahtawina zong nang kong pia ding hi.
Na pa David in a tot bangin nangmah in ka lampite tawnin, ka thukhamte le ka thupiaknate na zuih nakleh na khan ka sausak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon khanglo a, hih pen a mang na hi hi. Tua ciangin Jerusalem-ah amah pai a, Topa' Thuciamna Singkuang mai-ah amah dingin meihal biaknate le thunuama biaknate pia-in, a nasemte khempeuh a dingin pawi khat a kham hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah numei paktat nih hong pai-in a mai-ah ding uh hi.
A numei khat in, "Aw, ka topa aw, hih numei le kei, inn khat sungah ka omkhawm uh hi; amah zong inn-ah a om sungin keimah in ta khat ka nei hi.
Ka ta neih khit ni thum ni ciangin hih numei in zong ta hong nei hi. Ko gel bek a om ka hi uh a, kote tawh inn sungah kuamah dang om lo hi.
Amah in delhphahkha ahih manin zanin hih numei' tapa a si hi.
Tua ciangin zankim laitakin amah tho-in, na nasemnu ka ihmut laitakin ka kiang panin ka tapa la-in ama ang-ah koih a, ama tapa si kei' ang-ah hong koih hi.
Zingsangin ka ta nawi a pia dingin ka thawh ciangin, a sisa na hi hi. Ahih hangin limtakin ka et ciangin, amah pen keima sung pana suak ta na hi lo hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a numei dang khat in, "Hilo hi; a hing naupang keima a' hi a, a si naupang nangma a' ahi hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin a masa nu in, "Hilo hi; a si naupang nangma a' hi a, a hing naupang keima-a' ahi hi," a ci hi. Tua bangin kumpipa' mai-ah amau tegel in thu gen tuak uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Khat in, 'A nungta pen keima tapa hi a, nangma tapa si hi,' ci hi. Tua ciangin adang khat in, 'Hilo hi; nangma tapa si a, keima tapa a hing pen ahi hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Namsau khat hong la un," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa' mai-ah namsau khat hong kipaipih hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "A nungta naupang khen nih suah unla, khat tungah alang pia-in, adang khat tungah alang pia un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a tapa a nungta numei in a lungsimah a tapa khasiat ahih manin kumpipa kiangah, "Aw ka topa aw, a nungta naupang amah piazaw in; bangbang hitaleh amah that kei in," a ci hi. Ahih hangin a khat in, "Hih pen kei ka hi a, amah in ahi zongin tang thei lo ding hi; hong hawmsak un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in dawngin, "A masa numei tungah naupang hing pia un; bangbang hitaleh that kei un; amah pen a nu ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mi khempeuh in kumpipa' piak thukhenna za uh hi. Thutang a sem dingin ama tungah Pasian in pilna pia hi, ci-in phawk uh ahih manin amaute in kumpipa lamdangsa-in a om uh hi.

Solomon a' ding ni khatin annek tuidawn, annel lawh sawmthum, le an lawh sawmguk,
bawngtal a thau sawm, le lonona a kivak bawng sawmnih; tuu zakhat; sakhitalte, le Syria sakhite, sanangte, le a thau vasate a kisim lo hi lai hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Eufratis nitumna lam gam sung khempeuh Tifsah panin Gaza ciang dong, Eufratis nitumna lampang kumpi khempeuh uk a, ama kiim mun khempeuhah galdaihna om hi.
Solomon' hun sung khempeuh Judah le Israel lungmuang takin omin, Dan panin Beersheba ciang dong nangawn mi khempeuh a leenggui le a theikung nuai uhah lungnuamin om uh hi.
Solomon in a leengte a dingin buk a nei ciat sakol tul sawmli le sakol tung tuang mi tul sawm le tulnih zong nei hi.
Tua uliante in Kumpi Solomon le Kumpi Solomon' sabuai-ah a hong pai mite khempeuh a dingin amau ciat sik kha sunga dingin annek tuidawn vaihawm uh a, amaute in bangmah kisamsak lo uh hi.
Amau' nasep ciat tawh kizui-in a kisapna munah sakolte le sakol zaptelte a dingin mangbuhham le buhtu zong paipih uh hi.
Pasian in Solomon' tungah tehzawh lohin a thuk mahmah pilna le theihna, le genzawh loh lungsim zaina pia a,
Solomon' pilna in nisuahna lam mi khempeuh le Egypt pilna khempeuh khumlet hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh midang khempeuh sangin amah pilzaw a, Ezrah mi Ethan, le Mahol' tapa Heman, Kalkol, le Darda sangin pilzaw lai a, a kiima minam khempeuh lakah ama minthanna kizel hi.
Amah in paunak tulthum zong genkhia a, ama laphuah dawng tul le dawng nga ahi hi.
Amah in Lebanon-a om taamtak a kipan phungmai a po puknahte dongin singkung thu a gen hi. Amah in khe li nei ganhingte, vasate, a bokvak ganhingte, le ngasate' thu a gen hi.
Mi khempeuh le leitung kumpi khempeuh sung panin Solomon' pilna thu a ngai dingin ama pilna thu a zasate hong pai uh hi.
Amaute in ama pa' munah kumpi-in amah sathau a nilhna thu a zak ciangin Taia kumpi Hiram in a nasemte Solomon kiangah sawl hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Hiram in David it tawntung hi.
" Topa in ama khenuai-ah amaute a koihsak matengin amah a umcih a galte tawh kidona hangin ka pa David in Topa ama Pasian' min dingin biakinn a lam theih lohna thu na thei hi.
Ahih hangin tu-in Topa ka Pasian in na khempeuhah tawlngakna kei tungah hong pia hi. Hong langpang ahi a, thusia ahi zongin om lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in ka pa David kiangah, 'Nangma tangin na kumpi tokhom tungah ka koih ding na tapa in ka min dingin biakinn lam ding hi,' a cih mah bangin Topa ka Pasian' min dingin biakinn khat lam ka sawm hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Lebanon taamtak singte kei a dingin a kiphukna ding thu pia in; ka nasemte in nangma nasemte seppih ding uh a, nangma seh bangin na nasemte' thaman ding nang tungah kong pia ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Sidon mite bangin sing suih a siam kote lakah khat zong a om lohna na thei hi," a ci hi.
Hiram in Solomon' kam a zak ciangin nakpitakin lungdam a, "Hih a lian a tam mite a uk dingin David' tungah a pil tapa a pia Topa in tuni-in thupha ngah ta hen," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Hiram in Solomon kiangah mi sawlin, "Kei kiangah nong thu-khak ka za hi. Taamtak sing le taaksan sing tawh kisai na deih khempeuh a hih dingin ka kiging hi.
Ka nasemte in Lebanon panin tuipi-ah tuate hong puaksuk ding uh hi. Nangma cihna munah a pai dingin tuipi a tawn dingin keimah in tuate phongin ka bawl ding a, tua lai munah keimah in a singte phelsakin nangmah in na ngah ding hi. Nangmah in ka mite a' ding anpiakna tawh ka deihnate nong kicingsak ding hi," cisak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Hiram in ama deih taamtak le taaksan singte Solomon pia a,
Solomon in Hiram tungah a mite' an dingin mangbuh beem tul sawmnih le oliv thau bungpi tul sawmnih dim a pia hi. Solomon in Hiram' tungah a kum kumin hihte a pia hi.
Ama tungah a ciam bangin Topa in Solomon tungah pilna pia hi. Solomon le Hiram kilem uh a, amau tegel in thuciamna khat a bawl uh hi.
Kumpi Solomon in Israel sung panin aana tawh na a sem mite la hi. A lak mite mihing tul sawmthum pha hi.
Amah in Lebanon-ah tua mite kha khatin tul sawm a kikhelin puak hi. Amaute Lebanon-ah kha khat omin inn-ah kha nih om ding uh hi. Adoniram in hih a kila mite uk hi.
Solomon in vanpua mi tul sawmsagih le mualtung gamah suangseek mi tul sawmgiat zong nei a,
na a sem mite a uk, Solomon' nuai-ah ulian tulthum le zathum, nasep ukte a kihel lo ahi hi.
Suangseeksa tawh biakinn bulpi a phuh theih nadingin kumpipa' thupiakna tawh amaute in a lian, a manpha suangtumte tokhia uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin biakinn lam nadingin Solomon' mi innlamte le Hiram' mi innlamte le Gebal mite in sing phuk le singlesuang nasep a sem uh hi.
Egypt gam panin Israel mite a paikhiat zawh kum zali le kum sawmgiatna, Israel-te tungah Solomon' uk a kum lina, a kha nihna ahi Ziv kha-in amah in Topa' biakinn lam ding kipan hi.
Kumpi Solomon in Topa a dingin a lam biakinn, a sung pi sawmkua sau-in, pi sawmthum zai a, pi sawm le nga sang hi.
Biakinn mai-ah a innliim pen biakinn zaina zahin pi sawmthum sau a, inn mai lamah pi sawm le nga sang hi.
Tua ciangin amah in biakinn a dingin a pualam a kihui tawlette a bawl hi.
Amah in biakinn pang tuak le a nunglam biakinn kawm kimkotin a kawm tungah zong inn lam a, a kimkot a pangah inndei bawl hi.
A dawl nuainung pen pi sagih le alang zai-in, a laita pi kua zai a, a thumna pi sawm le alang zai hi. Kawm sungah innkam a lut loh nadingin amah in inn pualam pang kimkota dingin a nanna singbekte a bawl hi.
Biakinn a kilam ciangin a kitawhna mun panin a kibawlsa suangte tawh kilam hi. Tua ahih manin a kilam laitakin hei ahi a, sek ahi a, sik nazat khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin a gingte biakinn huang sungah kiza lo hi.
A dawl nuainung lut nading pen biakinn leitaw lampangah om hi. A dawl laita-ah kahlei zui-in kipai-in a dawl laita panin a thumna-ah kipai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in biakinn lamin a zo hi. Amah in innkamte khungin taamtak peekte tawh inndap a bawl hi.
Amah in a inn buppi tungah a lambehte zomin, dawl khat ciangin pi sagih le alang sang ciat a, taamtak singte-in a biakinn tawh kizom hi.
Tu-in Topa' thu Solomon' tungah hong tung a,
"Nangmah in na lam hih biakinn tawh kisai-in, ka thukhamte zui-in ka ngeina kipte mang a, ka thupiaknate khempeuh kemin tuate na zuih leh, na pa David tungah ka gen thu nang' tungah kong kipsak ding hi.
Tua ciangin na lam biakinn sung Israel mite lakah ka teng ding a, keima mi Israel-te ka nusia kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Solomon in biakinn lamin a zo hi.
Amah in taamtak peekte tawh biakinn sung kawm dap hi. Sual panin inndap innsunte dongin amah in sing tawh a sunglam tuam hi. Tua ciangin amah in taaksan peekte tawh a sual tuam hi.
Amah in sual panin innsun dong inn nunglam pi sawmthum taamtak peekte tawh lam a, amah in siangtho pen mun, biakinn sungnung dingin a inn sungah a bawl hi.
Biakinn sungnung mai-a innsung, pi sawmguk sau hi.
Inn sunga om taamtak singte tungah umgah le pakpalh lim kigelh hi. A vekpi-in taamtak a kidap hi a, suang kimu lo hi.
Amah in Topa' Thuciamna Singkuang koih nadingin a sungtawng penah biakinn sungnung a bawl hi.
Biakinn sungnung, pi sawmthum sau-in, pi sawmthum mah zai a, pi sawmthum mah sang a, amah in kham citak tawh a zut hi. Amah in taamtak sing biakna tau khat zong a bawl hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in kham citak tawh innsung zut a, biakinn sungnung mai kantanin kham khainiang khung a, kham tawh a zut hi.
Amah in a inn buppi a zawh dongin kham tawh a zut hi. Biakinn sungnung a biakna tau buppi zong amah in kham tawh a zut hi.
Amah in biakinn sungnungah oliv sing tawh kherub nih bawl a, pi sawm le nga tuak a sang hi.
Kherub kha langkhat, pi sagih le alang sau-in, kherub kha lang dang khat, pi sagih le alang mah sau a, a kha langkhat mong panin a mong langkhat dong pi sawm le nga ahi hi.
Kherub adang khat zong pi sawm le nga mah sau a, Kherub tegel a sauna le a pianlim kibang hi.
Kherub khat a sauna pi sawm le nga hi a, a kherub dang khat zong tua zah mah ahi hi.
Amah in biakinn sung tawngnung penah kherub-te a koih hi. Kherub-te' khate kizal a, khat' kha in kawm banin, adang kherub' kha in a kawm langkhat ban hi. Amau' kha langkhat tegel inn laizangah kituah hi.
Amah in kham tawh tua kherub-te a zut hi.
Amah in a sungnung le a puanung inndeite, a kimkotin inn kawm khempeuh tungah kherub-te le nisuh kungte le pakpalhte a bawl hi.
A sungnung le a puanung inndei sung innsualte amah in kham tawh a zut hi.
Biakinn sungnung lut nadingin amah in oliv sing kongkhak peekte a bawl hi; a bangtung zawl le kongkhak khuamte in kiu nga piangsak hi.
Amah in kherub-te, nisuh kungte, le pakpalh lim kibawlte tawh oliv sing kongkhak peek nihte a tuam hi; amah in tuate kham tawh zut a, kherub-te le nisuh kungte tungah kham a theh hi.
Tua bangmahin amah in kiu li nei-in biakinn sung lutna oliv sing kongkhak khuamte,
le taaksan sing kongkhak peek nihte a bawl hi. Kongkhak a peek nihte kikhepin, adang kongkhak a peek nihte zong kikhep hi.
Tuate tungah amah in kherub-te le nisuh kungte le pakpalhte bawl a, tua a bawlte tungah a tukimin kham tawh a zut hi.
Amah in a kiseek suang gual thum le taamtak sing gual khat tawh a tual sungnung a bawl hi.
A kum lina, Ziv kha-in Topa' biakinn a bulpi kipan hi.
A kum sawm le khatna, a kha giatna ahi Bul kha-in a na khempeuh le a kigen khempeuh bangin a kizo hi. Amah in tua a lamna-in kum sagih sung hun a bei hi.
Solomon in ama inn ding zong kum sawm le thum sung lamin a inn buppi a zo hi.
Amah in Lebanon Tulak Inn a kici khat a lam hi. A sauna pi zalesawmnga hi a, a zaina pi sawmsagih le nga hi-in, a sanna pi sawmli le nga hi a, taamtak khuampi gual thum tungah taamtak innkam kikhungin tua tungah a kilam ahi hi.
Gual khatah sawm le nga a om khuampi sawmli le nga tunga kilam inndei tung san teng taamtak sing tawh kituam hi.
A pang kawm tegel tungah tawlet gual thum tuak om a, a tawlet gual thumte khatlekhat kitang hi.
A kongkhakte le a tawlet khempeuhte a pang kikim kiu li nei vive hi a, a gual thumin tawlet khatlekhat kitang dimdiam hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Khuampi Innpi a kici khat lam hi. A sauna pi sawmsagih le nga hi a, a zaina pi sawmli le nga ahi hi. A mai lamah khuampite a nei innliim om a, tua khuampite tungah a tungkhuhna khat om hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a thukhen nading mun Thukhenna Innpi ahi Kumpi Tokhom Innpi a kici khat lam a, a sual panin a innsun ciang dong taamtak sing kizang hi.
Kumpi Tokhom Innpi nung lamah ama ten nading inn zong tua mah bangin a kilam ahi hi. Solomon in zi-a a lak Faro' tanu a dingin hih innpi tawh a kibang inn dang khat zong a lam hi.
Hihte khempeuh, a bulpi nangawn a kipan a khum dong, le Topa' biakinn tual a kipan tual lianpi dongin, limtakin tehin, a kitan, a nung le a mai suangatna tawh a ki-at a manpha suangte tawh a kibawl ahi hi.
A bulpi pen a manpha suang, suang lian, pawlkhat pi sawm le nih, pawlkhat pi sawm le nga a pha suangte ahi hi.
Tuate' tung ate pen limtakin tehin a kitan a manpha suang, le taamtak sing ahi hi.
Tual lianpi in a kimkotah a kiseek suang gual thum simin taamtak sing gual khat nei hi. Tua mah bangin Topa' biakinn tual sungnung le innliim in zong a nei hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Solomon in mi sawlin Taia khua-a om Huram samsak hi.
Amah pen Naftali minam meigongnu' tapa hi a, ama pa pen Taia khuami sumngo seek na a sempa ahi hi. Amah in sumngo tawh na khat peuhpeuh hih nadingin pilna, theihna, siamna a nei ahi hi. Kumpi Solomon kiangah amah hong pai-in ama na khempeuh a sem hi.
Amah in sumngo khuampi nih sung hi. Khuampi khat a sauna pi sawmnih le sagih hi a, a khuam pum kimkot pi sawm le giat pha hi. A sung hawm a, a sahna zung li ahi hi. A khuam nihna zong tua mah tawh kibang hi.
Khuampite tungah a bulh dingin amah in a kisung sumngo khuamluzepna nih zong a bawl hi. Khuamluzepna khat a sauna pi sagih le alang hi a, adang khat khuamluzepna a sauna tua zah mah ahi hi.
Tua ciangin amah in khuampite lu dawna khuamluzepna a dingin khainiang a kihuiheek tawh a kibawl ngen banga kikalh simsiam nih a bawl hi. Ngen khat pen khuamluzepna khat a' ding hi a, a ngen dang khat pen khuamluzepna adang khat a' ding ahi hi.
Tua mah bangin amah in mang kawlsing gahte a bawl hi. Khuampi lu dawna om khuamluzepna tuam nadingin ngen tawh kibangin a bawl tung kimkotah gual nih bawl a, a khuamluzepna dang khat zong tua mah bangin a bawl hi.
Tua ciangin innlim a om khuampi dawnah a om khuamluzepnate pi guk pha a, tuate tungah unok pak a kibawlte om hi.
A khuamluzepnate pen a khuampi nihte tung le ngen tawh kibanga kibawl gei-a a om a bem a dawk tungah om hi. A kimkotah gual nihin mang kawlsing gah zanih om a, a khuamluzepna dang khatah zong tua bangmah ahi hi.
Amah in biakinn innlimah khuampite a phut hi. Leitaw lamah a khuam khat phutin a min Jakhin phuak a, leilu lamah a khuam dang khat phutin a min Boaz a phuak hi.
A khuampite dawnah unok pak a kibawl om hi. Tua bangin khuampite a bawl a man khin hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a kisung tuikuangpi a bawl hi. Tua tuikuang a bem hi a, a gei khat pan a gei khat pi sawm le nga pha-in, pi sagih le alang thuk a, a kimkot pi sawmli le nga a pha hi.
A geivial nuai pi sawmli le nga sung, tuikuangpi kimkotin um gahte kibawl hi. Tua um gahte gual nihin om a, a tuikuangpi a kisunin kisung khawm pah hi.
Bawngtal sawm le nihte tungah tua tuikuangpi kinga a, thum leilu lam nga a, thum nitumna lam nga-in, thum leitaw lam nga a, thum nisuahna lam a nga hi. Tuate tungah a tuikuangpi kikoih a, a nunglam uh a sunglamah om hi.
A tuikuang sahna khutpeekmai cia ahi hi. A geivial pen unok pak tawh a kibang hai geivial bangin kibawl hi. Tua sungah tui tambong tulli bang ta thei hi.
Amah in sumngo kibawl tuikuang a kingakna sawm zong a bawl hi. Tua a bawlte pi guk sau, pi guk zai, pi li le alang sang hi.
Tua a kingaknate hih bangin kibawl hi: Tuate in a khawkte nei-in, tua a khawkte a kungah kibulh a,
tua ciangin a kungah a kibulh a khawkte tungah humpinelkaite, bawngtalte, le kherub-te om hi. Tua kungte tung, humpinelkaite le bawngtalte' tung le nuai-ah a sawi-in a kikalh limliam om hi.
Tua tham loin tua ngaknate in sumngo tawh a kibawl leengpeite le leengpei zawlte nei ciat a, a kiu lite-ah tuikuangpi nannate om hi. Tua nannate a kisung hi a, a pang ciatah pakkual om hi.
A gong pen a kingakna pan pi khat le alang sangto hi. A gong pen kingakna a kibawl bangin bem a, pi nih le letmat thum thuk hi. A gongah lim kigelhte om hi. A khawkte in sikli nei a, bem lo hi.
A leengpei lite pen a khawkte' nuai-ah om hi. Leengpei zawlte a kingakna tawh sakhat mah hi a, leengpei a sanna pi nih le letmat thum ahi hi.
A peite pen sakol leengpei bangin kibawl hi; a pei zawl, a peikual, a peikalhna, le a kalhna bulte khempeuh a kisung ahi hi.
A kingaknate' kiu ciatah a nanna li om ciat a, tua a nannate a ngakna tawh sakhat ahi hi.
Tua ciangin a ngakna dawnah letmat kua a sang vial bem khat om hi. A ngakna dawnah a kipsaknate le a khawkte pen a ngakna tawh sakhat ahi hi.
Tua ciangin a kipsaknate le a khawkte tungah a mun awng zah ciat tawh kizui-in amah in kherub-te, humpinelkaite, le nisuh kungte gelhin a kimkotah pakkual a bawl hi.
Tu-a bangin amah in a kingakna sawm bawl hi. A vekpi-in a kibangin kisungin, a liatna le a pianlim a kibang ahi hi.
Tua ciangin amah in sumngo tuikuang sawm bawl hi. Tuikuang khatah tui tambong sawmgiat bang ta-in, tuikuang vangsung pi guk ciat pha a, a kingakna sawmte a dingin tuikuang khat ciat om hi.
Tua ciangin amah in tua a kingaknate, biakinn leitaw lamah nga, leilu lamah nga a koih hi. Tua ciangin biakinn khang nisuahna lam kiu-ah tuikuangpi a koih hi.
Huram in beelte, kawbiate, le kuangte zong a bawl hi. Tua ahih ciangin Huram in Kumpi Solomon a dingin Topa' biakinn a ding nasep khempeuh a zo hi.
Khuampi nihte, khuampite dawnah a om khuamluzepna kuak nihte, le khuampite dawnah a om khuamluzepna kuak nihte tuam nading ngen tawh a kibanga kibawl nihte;
khuampite tungah a om khuamluzepna nihte a tuam dingin ngen tawh a kibanga kibawl khat a dingin mang kawlsing gah gual nih ahi, ngen tawh a kibanga kibawl nih a dingin mang kawlsing gah za lite;
a kingakna sawmte, le a kingaknate tungah a om tuikuang sawmte;
tuikuangpi khat, le tuikuangpi nuai-ah a om bawngtal sawm le nihte ahi hi.
Tu-in beelte, kawbiate, le kuangte, Huram in Kumpi Solomon a dingin a bawl, Topa' biakinn sungah a om nazatte khempeuh a tee sumngo tawh a kibawl ahi hi.
Jordan zanglei, Sukkoth le Zarethan kikal beel lei-ah kumpipa in tua nate sungsak hi.
Tamlua ahih manin Solomon in hih nate khempeuh tawiteh zo lo hi; sumngo gik zah kithei lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa' biakinn sunga om nazat khempeuh Solomon in bawl hi. Kham biakna tau, Ompihna Anlum a dingin kham sabuai,
biakinn sungnung mai, leitaw lampangah nga omin, leilu lampangah nga a om kham citak meivakkhuamte; kham tawh a kibawl paakte, meivakte, le taitehte;
paknamtui a dingin haite, taitehte, kuangte, pakante, le kham citak vutluahna; le siangtho pen mun biakinn sung tawngnung kongkhakte le biakinn sung kongkhakte a dingin kham bilte ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kumpi Solomon in Topa' biakinn a hih nasep khempeuh kizo hi. Tua ciangin Solomon in a pa David' apsa nate, ngun, kham, le nazatte paipihin Topa' biakinn sung vankoihna-ah tuate a koih hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in Zion a kici David khuapi panin Topa' Thuciamna Singkuang la-in Biakinn sungah a paipih dingin Jerusalem khuasung ama kiangah Israel upate le minam lutang, Israel beh makaite a khawm hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite khempeuh a kha sagihna Ethanim kha sunga pawi hunin Kumpi Solomon kiangah kikhawm uh hi.
Israel upate khempeuh hong pai uh a, siampite in Thuciamna Singkuang la-in Biakinn-ah paipih uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in kikhopna buk, le puanbuk sunga om a siangtho nazatte khempeuh a paipih uh hi. Siampite le Levi mite in tuate paipihto uh hi.
Thuciamna Singkuang mai-ah a kikhawm Kumpi Solomon le Israel mihonte khempeuh in biakna-in tuu le bawngtalte tampi tak pia uh ahih manin tuate a phazah kisim zo lo hi.
Tua ciangin siampite in a kherub-te' kha nuai, siangthopen mun sung, biakinn sungnung lama ama munah Topa' Thuciamna Singkuang paipih uh hi.
Kherub-te in Thuciamna Singkuang omna mun tungah a kha uh zak ahih manin Thuciamna Singkuang le a zawlte tungah kherub-te in khuhna piangsak uh hi.
A zawlte sau mahmah ahih manin biakinn sungnung mai siangtho mun panin a zawl mongte kimu a, ahih hangin a pualam panin kimu thei lo hi. Tuni dongin tua san takah tuate om hi.
Tua Thuciamna Singkuang sungah, Egypt gam panin a paikhiat lai-un Topa in Israel mite tawh thuciamna a bawlna Horeb-ah Moses in suangpek nih a koih simloh bangmah dang om lo hi.
Siangtho mun panin siampite a paikhiat ciangin meii in Topa' biakinn tuam a,
meii hangin siampite nasem dingin om thei lo uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa' minthanna vang in Topa' biakinn a tuam hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in, " Topa in vantungah ni koih khin a, ahih hangin khuamial sahpi sungah amah a ten ding gen khin hi.
Keimah in nangma a dingin a kipahtawi mun khat, na ten tawntung nading biakinn khat ka lam khin hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel a kikhawmte a din laitakin kumpipa in en kawikawi-in Israel a kikhawmte khempeuh thupha a pia hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "'Egypt panin ka mi Israel-te ka paikhiatpih a kipanin keima min a om theih nadingin biakinn khat lamna ding Israel minam khempeuh sungah khuapi khat zong ka teel kei hi. Ahih hangin ka mi Israel-te tungah a uk dingin David ka teel hi,' ci-in ka pa David tungah a kam tawh a ciamsa a tungsak Israel Pasian, Topa in thupha ngah tahen.
Israel Pasian, Topa' min dingin biakinn khat lam ding ka pa David' lungsim sungah om ngei hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in ka pa David kiangah, 'Keima min dingin biakinn khat lam ding na lungsim sungah a omna thu a hoih mahmah ahi hi.
Ahi zongin nangmah in a biakinn na lam kei ding a, nangma sung pan hong suak ding na tapa in ka min dingin biakinn a lam ding hi,' a ci hi.
Tu-in ama bawlsa thuciamna Topa in tungsak khin hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka pa David' munah keimah khangin, Topa' ciamsa bangin Israel kumpi tokhom tungah ka tu a, Israel Pasian, Topa' min dingin a biakinn ka lam khin hi.
Amah in Egypt leitang panin amaute a paikhiatpih lai-in amah in i pu i pate tawh a bawl Topa' thuciamna a omna Thuciamna Singkuang a dingin tua lai-ah mun khat ka bawlsak hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel a kikhawmte khempeuh a omna Topa' mai-ah Solomon ding a, vantung lamah a khutte zak hi.
Amah in, "Israel Pasian, Topa aw, tunga om vantung ahi a, nuai-a om leitungah ahi zongin, nangma mai-ah a lungsim khempeuh uh tawh a gamta na nasemte tungah thuciamna lenin itna kip a lak, nang tawh a kibang pasian om lo hi.
Na nasem ka pa David tungah na gensa thu na kipsak hi. Nangmah in na kam tawh na gen a, tuni-in na tungsak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in Israel Pasian, Topa aw, ama tungah, 'Keima mai-ah nang na gamtat mah bangin na tapate in keima mai-ah gamtat ding a kidop nak-uhleh, Israel kumpi tokhom tungah a tu dingin keima mai-ah mi khat zong na tasam kei ding hi,' ci-in na nasem ka pa David tungah na ciamsa thu lenkip in.
"Ahih hangin leitungah Pasian teng taktak ding ahi hiam? Vantung le vantung a sangpen in nang hong huam zo lo hi. Tua ahih manin keima lamsa hih biakinn in bangzahin nang hong huam zo lo zaw kan ding ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin na nasempa' thungetna le a hong thumna hong don in la, Topa ka Pasian aw, tuni-in nangma mai-ah na nasempa in a hong ngetna, a kikona le a thungetna hong ngai in.
Amaute in hih mun lamah hong nget uh ciangin na mi Israel-te' hong thumna zong ngai in. Na tenna mun vantung panin hong za inla, ka mawhna uh hong maisak in.
"Mi khat a vengpa tungah khialin, amah a kiciamsak a, amah hong pai-in hih biakinn sung nangma biakna tau mai-ah a kiciam leh,
nangmah in vantung panin za-in gamta inla, na nasemte thu khen inla, a mawh pa thuak sakin ama lu tung mahah ama gamtatna tungsak in la, a dikpa a dikna langsakin ama dikna tawh kizui-in thaman pia in.
"Nangma tungah hong khialhna hangin galte mai-ah na mi Israel-te a guallelh ciangin, amaute nang lamah hong kihei kikin nangma min hong phawk a, hih biakinn sungah thu ngenin nang tungah hong thum uhleh,
vantung panin za-in na mi Israel-te' khialhna maisak inla, a pu a pate uh tungah na piak leitangah amaute paipih kik in.
"Nangma tungah hong khialhna hangin vantung kikhakcipin guah a zuk loh ciangin, amaute in hih mun lamah thu ngenin na min hong phawk a, amaute na gimsak ciangin amau' khialhna panin a kihei uhleh,
vantung panin za-in na mi Israel, na nasemte' khialhna maisak in la, amaute' zuih ding lampi hoih hilh inla, na mite tungah gamh-in na piaksa leitang tungah guah zusak in.
"Gam sungah kialpi tungin, pulnatna ahi a, ankung natna ahi a, ankung zawngkhalna ahi a, kauphe ahi a, lung ahi zongin a om a, amau' khuapi khat peuhpeuh a galte un umcihin, bangbang gimna, bangbang natna hitaleh,
mi khatpeuh ahi a, na mi Israel-te khempeuh in ahi zongin amau' lungsim natna thei-in hih biakinn lamah a khutte hong zanin bangbang thungetna hitaleh bangbang thumna hitaleh hong bawl uhleh,
na tenna vantung panin za-in maisak in. Tua ciangin amau' gamtatna khempeuh tawh kizui-in a lungsim uh na theih bangin amaute tungah pia ciat in (bang hang hiam cih leh nang, nang bek in mihing khempeuh lungsim na thei hi).
Tua hileh ka pu ka pate uh tungah na piak leitang tungah a nuntak hun sung khempeuh uh amaute in nang hong zahtak ding uh hi.
"Tua mah bangin na mi Israel a hi lo gamdang mi khat nangma min hangin a gamlapi panin hong pai-in
(bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in a lian nangma minthanna le nangma mite a dingin na sepsak na liante' thu za ding uh hi), hih biakinn lamah thu hong nget ciangin,
na tenna vantung panin za inla, tua gamdang mipa in nang tungah hong ngetna khempeuh tawh kizui-in hih in. Nangma mi Israel-te mah bangin leitung mi khempeuh in na min thei-in nang hong zahtak nading, le hih ka lamsa biakinn pen nangma min tawh a kilo ahihna a theihna ding uh ahi hi.
"A galte uh a do dingin na mite kuankhia-in, bangbang lamah amaute sawl hita lecin, nangmah in na teelsa khuapi lam, Topa' tung le nangma min dingin ka lamsa biakinn lamah thu hong nget uh ciangin,
amau' hong thungetna le hong thumna vantung panin za-in amau' vai huh in.
"Amaute nang tungah hong khialin - bang hang hiam cih leh mi a khial lo kuamah om lo hi - amaute tungah nang heh a, galte tungah amaute pia-in, amaute kimanin a galte' gam a gamla ahi a, a nai-ah ahi zongin kipuakhia a,
ahi zongin amaute a kipuak khiatna leitangah amaute in a lungsim uhah thu ngaihsunin kisik kik a, 'Kote khialin lampialin ka gitloh tat uh hi,' ci-in amaute a mante' leitang panin nang tungah hong thum uh a,
amaute manin a puakhia a galte uh leitangah a ngaihsutna khempeuh uh le a lungsim khempeuh uh tawh amaute kisik kikin, nangmah in na teelsa khuapi, amau' pute pate' tungah na piaksa amau' leitang, le nangma min dingin ka lam biakinn lam nga-in nangma tungah thu hong nget uhleh
vantung na tenna mun panin amau' hong thungetna le hong thumna za-in, amau' vai huh in.
Nang tungah hong khial na mite le nang tunga hong gamtatna uh amau' thupalsatnate khempeuh maisakin, a galte un amaute tungah hehpihna a neih theih nadingun amaute manin a puakhia mite' muhna-ah amaute hehpih in.
(Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute pen Egypt panin na paikhiatpih, sik meiphual sung panin na paikhiatpih nangma mi le nangma luah ahi uh hi.)
Na nasempa' hong thumna le na mi Israel-te' hong thumna-ah maipha tawh hong en tawntung inla, nang hong sap peuhmah uh ciangin amaute na bil na ngat in.
Egypt panin ka pate uh na paikhiatpih lai-in na nasempa Moses tungtawnin na gen bangin nangma luah ahi dingin leitung mi khempeuh lak panin amaute na tengkhia hi, Topa Pasian aw," a ci hi.
Tu-in Solomon in hih thungetna le thumnate khempeuh Topa' tungah a bawl khit ciangin, vantung lamah a khutte a zan sa-in a khukdinna mun Topa' biakna tau mai panin amah dingto hi.
Tua ciangin amah dingin awging pha tawh Israel a kikhawmte khempeuh thupha pia-in,
"Ama hong ciamsa khempeuh tawh kizui-in ama mi Israel-te tungah tawlngakna a pia Topa in thupha ngah ta hen! A nasempa Moses tungtawnin a gensa ama thuciam hoihte khempeuh kam khat zong maimawk lo hi.
I pu i pate a ompih mah bangin Topa i Pasian in eite hong ompih hen la, eite hong nusia kei hen la, hong taisan kei hen.
Amah in i pu i pate a thupiaksa ahi ama lampi khempeuh a zui ding, le ama thupiaknate, a thukhamte, le a ngeina kipte a zui dingin ama lamah i lungsim hong awnsak hen.
Topa' mai-ah ka thumna kammalte sun le zanin Topa i Pasian in hong za hen la, nisimin a kisam bangin a nasempa' vai le ama mi Israel-te' vai hong huh tahen.
Tua hileh mi khempeuh in Topa pen Pasian hi, ci-in thei ding uh a, kuamah dang a om lohna phawk ding uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa i Pasian' tungah na lungsim khempeuh uh tawh thuman unla, tuni-a bangin ama thukhamte zui-in a thupiaknate mang un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa le amah tawh a om Israel mi khempeuh in Topa' mai-ah biakna a pia uh hi.
Solomon in thunuama biakna-in Topa' tungah bawngtal tul sawmnih le tulnih le tuu tul zakhat le tul sawmnih a pia hi. Tua bangin kumpipa le Israel mi khempeuh in Topa' biakinn a ap uh hi.
Tua ni mahin kumpipa in Topa' biakinn mai-a om inntual laizang ap hi; bang hang hiam cih leh meihal biakna le an tawh biakna le thunuama biakna a thaute a tazo dingin Topa' mai-a sumngo biakna tau neulua ahih manin tua lai-ah meihal biakna le an tawh biakna le thunuama biakna thaute a pia hi.
Tua hi a, tua hun lai-in Solomon le amah tawh a om Israel mi khempeuh in Topa i Pasian' mai-ah ni sagih sung, Hamath khua lutna panin Egypt lui dong kikhopna lianpi khat bawlin pawi khat kham uh hi.
A ni giat ni-in amah in mite ciahsak hi. Amaute in kumpipa thupha pia uh a, Topa in a nasempa David le ama mi Israel-te tungah hoihna a lahnate khempeuh hangin lungdamna le lungsim kipahna tawh a inn ciat uhah a ciah uh hi.
Solomon in Topa' biakinn le kumpi inn le a lamnop khempeuh a lam a man khit ciangin,
Gibeon-a ama tungah a kilahsa bangin Solomon tungah Topa a nihveina kilang hi.
Topa in ama kiangah, "Keima mai-ah na hihsa na thungetna le na thumnate ka za khin hi. Na lamsa hih biakinn ka ap khin hi. A tawntungin tua biakinn sungah kei hong kibia ding a, a tawntungin tua biakinn ka hu ding hi.
Nang ahihleh, na pa David a gamtat bangin lungsim thupina le thumanna tawh ka mai-ah gamta-in, nang kong thupiak khempeuh bangin sem a, ka thukhamte le ka ngeina kipte na zuih leh,
na pa David tungah, 'Israel kumpi tokhom tungah mi khat zong na tasam kei ding hi,' ci-in ka ciamsa bangin Israel-te tungah na kumpi tokhom ka kipsak paisuak ding hi.
Ahih hangin nang na hi a, na tate ahi zongin, keimah zuihna panin pialin, note mai-ah ka koih ka thupiaknate le ka thukhamte na zuih kei uh a, pasian dangte' na a sem ding le a bia dingin na pai uhleh,
amaute ka piaksa leitang panin Israel mite ka lakhia ding hi. Tua ciangin ka min dingin ka apsa biakinn pen ka muhna panin ka lawnkhia ding a, Israel-te pen mi khempeuh lakah paunak le thugentehna suak ding hi.
Tua ciangin hih biakinn pen ninbulomtang suak ding a, a nawkkha mi khempeuh in lamdangsa-in, eh! ci ding uh hi. Amaute in, 'Bang hangin Topa in hih leitang le hih biakinn hih bangin hih ahi hiam?' ci ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, 'Egypt panin a pu a pate uh a paikhiatpih Topa a Pasian uh amaute in nusia-in pasian dangte len uh a, tuate bia-in a na a sepna hang uh ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin Topa in hih siatna khempeuh amaute tungah tungsak hi,' ci ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Solomon in inn nihte, Topa' biakinn le kumpi inn a lam kum sawmnih a beina,
Taia kumpi Hiram in Solomon' deih zahzah taamtak sing le taaksan sing le kham a piak khit ciangin, Kumpi Solomon in Galilee gam sunga om khuapi sawmnih, Hiram tungah a pia hi.
Ahih hangin Solomon in amah a piaksa khuapite a en dingin Taia panin Hiram hong pai ciangin, tua khuapite tawh amah lungkim zo lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in, "Ka sanggam aw, kei nong piak hih khuapite a bangci khuapi ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin tuni dongin tuate Kabul gam kici hi.
Hiram in kumpipa kiangah a piak kham talen zakhat le talen sawmnih a pha hi.
Topa' biakinn, ama inn, Jerusalem kulh, le Hazor, Megiddo, le Gezer khuate a lam dingin Kumpi Solomon in aana tawh na a semte a la hi.
(Egypt kumpi Faro paito a, Gezer la-in mei tawh hal a, a khuapi sunga teng Kanaan mite thatin Solomon' zi, a tanu' tungah mokenin a khuapi a piak ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin Solomon in Gezer khua lamkik hi). Tua banah Bethhoron nuainung
le Baalath le Judah gam sung gamlakah Tamar,
le Solomon in a neih vankoihna khuapi khempeuh, le a leengte-a' ding khuapite, le a sakol tung tuangte a' ding khuapite, le Jerusalem sung, Lebanon sung, le ama ukna gam sung khempeuhah zong Solomon in a lamnop khempeuh a lamkik hi.
Israel mi a hi lo Amor mite, Hit mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite, le Jebus mite sung panin a omlai mi khempeuh,
Israel mite in a suksiat khit siang zawh loh, tua gamah amau' nunga a omlai a suanlekhakte uh, Solomon in aana tawh na a sem salin bawl ahih ciangin tuni dongin tua bangmahin amaute om uh hi.
Ahih hangin Solomon in Israel mite salin bawl lo hi. Amaute pen galkapte, ama nuai-ah a uliante, a galkapmangte, a leeng ukte, le a sakol tung tuangte ahi uh hi.
Solomon' innlam nasep a uk ulianpite mi zanga le sawmnga ahi hi.
Faro tanu a dingin Solomon in a lamsak ama inn-ah a om dingin David khuapi panin amah a paikhiat khit ciangin Solomon in Millo a lam hi.
Solomon in Topa a dingin a lam biakna tau tungah meihal biakna le thunuama biakna kum khatin thumvei pia-in Topa' mai-ah paknamtui a hal hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a biakinn a zo hi.
Kumpi Solomon in Edom gam sung San Tuipi gei dunga om Eloth nai-a Eziongeber-ah teembaw honkhat a bawl hi.
Tua ciangin Hiram in tua teembaw honte tawh tuipi tung nasep a thei tuipi mi a nasemte, Solomon' nasemte tawh sawlkhia hi.
Tua ciangin amaute Ofir-ah pai-in tua lai panin kham talen zali le sawmnih hong pua uh a, amaute in Kumpi Solomon kiangah tuate tunpih uh hi.
Tu-in Sheba kumpinu in Topa' min tawh kisai-in Solomon' minthanna a zak ciangin thudotna haksate tawh amah a ze-et dingin hong pai hi.
Amah nungzui honpi, a namtui nate a pua kalaohte, kham tampi, le suangmanpha tampi tawh Jerusalem-ah hong pai a, Solomon' kiangah a tun ciangin amah in a lungsim a om khempeuh Solomon tungah a gen hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in ama dotna khempeuh dawng hi. Kumpipa in ama tungah a gentel theih loh, haksa lua a sak bangmah om lo hi.
a sabuai-ah a an, a uliante' omzia, le a nasemte' etna, a puante uh, a an piate, le Topa' biakinn-ah a piak meihal biaknate khempeuh a muh khit ciangin lamdang a sa mahmah hi.
Tua ciangin amah in kumpipa kiangah, "Ka gam sung panin nangma thu le na pilna ka zak a kigen thute man mahmah hi.
Na zite a hampha mahmah hi a, na mai-ah ding tawntungin na pilna a za hih na nasemte zong hampha mahmah uh hi.
Nang tungah lungdamin Israel kumpi tokhom tungah nang a hong koih Topa na Pasian in thupha ngah ta hen! Topa in Israel it tawntung ahih manin nangmah in thutang le thuman na sepkhiat theih nadingin amah in kumpi-in nang hong bawl hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in kumpipa tungah kham talen za le sawmnih, le a namtui nate tampi tak, le suangmanphate a pia hi. Sheba kumpinu in Kumpi Solomon tungah a piak hih banga a tam a namtui nate hong pai ngei nawn lo hi.
Tua tham loin Ofir panin kham hong pua Hiram' teembaw honte in Ofir panin cingsing le suangmanpha tampi tak hong pua uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in cingsingte Topa' biakinn le kumpipa' innkhuamte, lasate a dingin laiza lasakna le harp lasakna-in bawl hi. Tuni dongin tua bang cingsing hoihte hong tungkik ngei lo, kimu ngei nawn lo hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Solomon in citna tawh ama tungah a piak banah ama deih a nget khempeuh zong Sheba kumpinu tungah a pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah le a nasemte a gam uhah a ciahkik uh hi.
Tu-in sumbawlte le sumbukte, Arabia kumpi khempeuh le gam sung a ukte tung panin a ngahte banah kum khatin Solomon tungah a tung kham a gihna pen talen zaguk le sawmguk le guk ahi hi.
Kumpi Solomon in a kiseek kham tawh kibawl lum lianpi zanih bawl a, lum khatah kham shekel zaguk bei hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a kiseek kham tawh kibawl lum zathum bawl a, lum khat ciangin kham mina thum bei hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in Lebanon Tulak Inn a kici sungah tuate koih hi.
kahlei cial gukte' mong ciatah khat ciat a om humpinelkai sawm le nih ding hi. Kumpi gam sung khat peuhpeuhah tua tawh a kibang kibawl ngei lo hi.
Kumpi Solomon' tuidawnna haite khempeuh kham hi a, Lebanon Tulak Inn sunga om haite khempeuh kham citak hi a, khat zong ngun hi lo hi. Solomon' hun lai-in ngun bangmahin kingaihsun lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa in Hiram' teembaw honte tawh Tarshish teembaw honkhat tuipi-ah a pai nei hi. Tarshish teembaw honte kum thumin khatvei hong pai-in kham, ngun, saiha, zawngmaw, le utongte hong puak zel hi.
Tua bangin Kumpi Solomon in hauhna le pilna tawh leitung kumpi khempeuh khumkhelh hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian in ama lungsim sunga a koih ama pilna a ngai dingin leitung mi buppi in Solomon' omna zong uh hi.
Amaute khempeuh in letsong, ngun le kham tawh kibawl nate, puante, myrrh paknamtui, a namtui nate, sakolte, le la-sakolte, a kumkumin tampi tak hong puak uh hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in leengte le sakol tung tuangte khawm hi. Amah in leeng tul le zali le tuanna sakol tul sawm le tulnih nei a, amah in tuate, leeng khuapite le Jerusalem-ah zattawm dingin a koih hi.
Kumpipa in Jerusalem-ah suang bangin ngun olsak a, amah in Shefelah theithek sing bangin taamtak sing tamsak hi.
Solomon' sakol lakte Egypt le Kue pan hi a, kumpipa' sumbawlte in Kue-ah a man pia-in tuate ngah uh hi.
Egypt panin leeng khat ciangin ngun shekel zaguk, sakol khat ciangin za le sawmnga-in kingah hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa' sumbawlte in Hit kumpite le Syria kumpite khempeuh tungah zuakkhia uh hi.
Tu-in Kumpi Solomon in gamdang numei tampi ngai hi. Faro' tanu, le Moab mi, Ammon mi, Edom mi, Sidon mi, le Hit numeite,
Topa in Israel mite tungah, "Amaute tawh na kiteng kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in amau' pasian' lamah na lungsim uh hong heikhia taktak ding uh hi," a cih minamte' lak pan lawm ngai a, Solomon in hih mite ngai-in pom hi.
Amah in kumpite' tanu vive zi zasagih, le zineu zathum nei hi. A zite in ama lungsim heikhia uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Solomon a teek ciangin a zite in pasian dangte' lamah ama lungsim heikhia uh a, ama pa David' lungsim bangin ama lungsim Topa' tungah thuman bup taktak zo lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Sidon mite' nusian Ashtoreth, le Ammon mite a' ahi a kihhuai Milkom, Solomon in bia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa' muhna-ah Solomon a sia gamta a, a pa David bangin Topa zuibup lo hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in Jerusalem nisuahna lam mualtungah Moab mite a' ahi a kihhuai Khemosh le Ammon mite a' ahi a kihhuai Molek a dingin mualtung a biakna khat a lam hi.
Tua mah bangin amah in paknamtui halin a pasian-te uh tungah biakna a pia a gamdang zite khempeuh a dingin hihsak hi.
Ama tungah nihvei kilak khinin, amah in pasian dangte' nung a zuih loh nading ama tungah thu a pia khin Topa , Israel Pasian panin a lungsim kiheikhia ahih manin Solomon tungah Topa heh hi. Ahih hangin amah in Topa' thupiaksa zui tuan lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in Solomon kiangah, "Hih pen nangma ngaihsutna hi-in, nang kong piaksa ka thuciamna le ka thukhamte zui lo na hih ciangin, keimah in nangma tung panin na kumpi gam balkekin na nasempa tungah ka pia taktak ding hi.
Ahi zongin na pa David' hangin nangma hun sungin ka hih kei ding a, na tapa' khutsung panin ka balkhia ding hi.
Ahi zongin kumpi gam khempeuh ka balkhia kei ding hi. Ka nasempa David hang le ka teelsa Jerusalem hangin na tapa' tungah minam khat ka pia lai ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Solomon a langpang ding Edom mi Hadad khangsak hi. Amah pen Edom kumpi innkuansung mi khat ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Edom-ah David a omlai, a site a vui dingin galkap a ukpa Joab a paitoh lai-in Edom sunga pasal khempeuh amah in that hi.
(Bang hang hiam cih leh Joab in Edom sunga pasal khempeuh a suksiat khit matengin amah le Israel-te khempeuh tua lai-ah kha guk sung om uh hi).
Ahih hangin Hadad naupangno ahih lai-in, a pa' nasem Edom mite pawlkhat tawh Egypt-ah a tai hi.
Amaute Midian panin dingkhia-in Paran tung uh a, Paran panin mi zawnin tonpih a, ama tungah inn khat pia-in, annek ding pia-in, leitang a pia Egypt kumpipa Faro kiang Egypt gam tung uh hi.
Hadad in Faro' mai-ah maipha lianpi mu a, amah in ama zi Tahpenes' sanggamnu tawh kitengsak hi.
Tua ciangin Tahpenes sanggamnu in amah tawh tapa Genubath nei a, Tahpenes in Faro' inn-ah a naupang khoi hi. Faro' inn sungah Faro' tapate tawh Genubath om hi.
Ahih hangin Hadad in David le galkap a ukpa Joab a sihna thu Egypt panin a zak ciangin Faro' kiangah, "Keima gamah ka ciah theih nadingin hong paikhiasak in," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Faro in ama kiangah, "Nangma gamah ciah ding na hanciam nadingin kei tawh na omna-ah bang kitangsapna nei na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Ahi zongin amah in Faro' kiangah, "Hong paisak hoh in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian in ama topa ahi Zobah kumpi Hadadezer kiang panin a tai Eliada tapa Rezon zong Solomon a langpang dingin a khangsak hi.
Amah in ama kiimah mi khawmin mite' na a sut pawl a makai a suak hi. Amaute Damaskas-ah pai-in tua lai munah teng uh a, Damaskas-ah amah kumpi-in bawl uh hi.
Hadad mah bangin Solomon' hun sung khempeuh Israel-te a langpangin amah omin siatna a bawl hi. Amah in Israel mite mudah a, Syria gamah a uk hi.
Solomon' nasem, Zeredah khuasunga om Efraim mi, Nebat' tapa, a nu' min Zeruah hi-in meigong ahi, Jeroboam in zong kumpipa lehdo hi.
Amah in kumpipa a lehdona thu hih bang ahi hi: Solomon in Millo lamin a pa David' khuapi a vangte a hu hi.
Jeroboam pen nasep siam mahmah khat hi a, Solomon in hih a khangno mipa a kizen mi hi, ci-in a theih ciangin Josef minam aana tawh na a semte tungah a ukin a bawl hi.
Tua hun sungin Jerusalem panin Jeroboam a paikhiat ciangin Shiloh khuami kamsang Ahijah in lampi-ah amah na dawn hi. Ahijah in puan thak khat na silhtawm a, amau nih tegel bek gamlakah om uh hi.
Tua ciangin Ahijah in ama tungah a silh a puan thak lenin seh sawm le nih suahin a balkek hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Jeroboam kiangah, "Nang a dingin bek sawm la in; bang hang hiam cih leh Israel Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi, 'En in, Solomon' khut panin kumpi gam a balkhia ding ka hi a, nangma tungah minam sawm kong pia ding hi.
(Ahih hangin ka nasem David le Israel minam khempeuh sung panin ka teelsa khuapi Jerusalem hangin amah in minam khat nei ding hi).
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in kei hong nusia a, Sidon mite' nusian Ashtoreth, Moab pasian Khemosh, le Ammon mite' pasian Milkom bia-in, a pa David bangin keima muhna-ah a manin gamtatna le ka thukhamte le ka ngeina kipte zui loin ka thu hong nial hi.
Ahi zongin ama khutsung panin kumpi gambup ka lakhia kei ding hi. Ka thupiaknate le ka thukhamte a zui, ka teel ka nasem David' hangin a nuntak sung tawntung ukpa-in amah ka bawl ding hi.
Ahih hangin ama tapa' khutsung panin kumpi gam la-in nangma tungah minam sawm kong pia ding hi.
Ahi zongin ka min koih nadingin ka teelsa khuapi Jerusalem-ah ka nasempa David in keima mai-ah suanlekhak a neih tawntung theih nadingin a tapa tungah minam khat ka pia ding hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in nang hong la-in na deih khempeuh tungah na uk ding a, nang pen Israel tungah kumpi na hi ding hi.
Ka nasempa David bangin ka thukhamte zuihna tawh nang kong thupiak khempeuh ngai-in, ka thu hong zui-in, ka muhna-ah a manin na gamtat leh, nang tawh hong omkhawmin, David a dingin ka hih bangin nangma tungah Israel mite ka hong pia ding a, na suanlekhakte in zong uk paisuak ding hi.
Hih thu hangin David' suanlekhakte ka gimsak ding a, ahih hangin a tawntung ding hi lo hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Solomon in Jeroboam thah dingin zong hi. Ahih hangin Jeroboam dingin Egypt kumpipa Shishak kiangah tai a, Solomon' sih mateng Egypt-ah a om hi.
Tu-in Solomon' sep a omlaite, le a hih khempeuh, le a pilna, Solomon' Nasepna Laibu sungah kigelh hi.
Jerusalem panin Israel-te khempeuh tungah Solomon in a uk hun kum sawmli sung ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon si a, a pa David khuapi sungah kivui hi. Tua ciangin ama tangin a tapa Rehoboam in uk hi.
Shekhem-ah Rehoboam pai hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah kumpi a suaksak Israel mi khempeuh Shekhem-ah hong pai uh hi.
Nebat' tapa Jeroboam in tua thu a zak ciangin (bang hang hiam cih leh kumpi Solomon kiang panin a taina Egypt-ah amah omlai hi), Egypt panin hong ciahkik hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in mi sawlin amah sam uh hi. Tua ciangin Jeroboam le a kikhawm khempeuhte hong pai-in Rehoboam kiangah,
"Na pa in kote hong gimbawlin vangikpi hong suan hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na pa' nasep haksate le kote tungah a giklua thuhaksate zangsak in. Tua hileh kote in nangma na kong sem ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, "Ni thum sung va kihem unla, tua ciangin kei kiangah hong paikik un," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin mite paikhia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Rehoboam in a pa Solomon a nuntak lai-in ama mai-ah a ding ngei khangham mite thu dongin, "Hih mite ka dawn nading ngaihsutna hong bangci piak ding na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in ama kiangah, "Nangmah in tuni-in hih mite' deihna bang zui inla, amaute na dawn ciangin kamhoih pau lecin, amaute pen a tawntungin nangma nasemte hi ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin khanghamte in ama tungah ngaihsutna a piakte nusia-in, amah tawh a khangkhawm ama mai-ah a ding khangnote thu dong hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, "'Na pa in kote tungah hong suat vangik zangsak in,' kei tungah hong ci hih mite i dawn nading ngaihsutna hong bangci piak ding na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah tawh a khangkhawm khangnote in ama kiangah, "Nang kiangah, 'Na pa in vangikpi hong puasak ahih manin kote a dingin hong zangsak in,' hong ci hih mite kiangah hih bangin na gen ding hi. Amaute kiangah, 'Ka khutmeno pen ka pa' kawng sangin golzaw hi.
Tu-in ka pa in note tungah vangik hong suat banah kong behlap lai ding hi. Ka pa in ciang tawh note hong thuhilh hi. Ahih hangin keimah in ciang lingnei tawh note kong thuhilh ding hi,' na ci ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in, "Ni thum ni-in ka kiangah hong paikik un," a cih mah bangin Jeroboam le mi khempeuh a ni thum ni-in Rehoboam kiangah hong pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in mite ngawhdawn a, khangham mite in ama tungah ngaihsutna a piakte nusia-in,
khangnote' ngaihsut piakna tawh kizui-in amaute kiangah thu gen a, "Ka pa in note' tungah vangik hong suat banah keimah in ka hong behlap lai ding hi. Ka pa in ciang bek tawh note hong thuhilh hi. Ahih hangin keimah in ciang lingnei tawh note kong thuhilh ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua bangin kumpipa in mite' deihna zui lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Shiloh khuami Ahijah' tungtawnin Nebat' tapa Jeroboam' tungah a gensa thu a tunsak nadingin Topa in a piansak thu kiheina ahi hi.
Kumpipa in amau' thu a ngaih lohna Israel-te khempeuh in a muh uh ciangin mite in kumpipa dawng uh a, "David sungah kote in bang ngah nei ka hi uh hiam? Jessi tapa sungah gamhluah ka nei kei uh hi. Israel-te aw, na inn ciat uhah ciah un. Rehoboam in ama a' ding vaihawmtawm ta hen," a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Israel-te a inn ciat uhah kihem uh hi.
Ahih hangin Rehoboam in Judah khuapite sungah a teng Israel mite a uk hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Rehoboam in aana tawh nasemte a uk Adoram, Israel-te tawh a kimu dingin sawl a, ahi zongin amaute in amah suang tawh na denglum uh hi. Tua ciangin Jerusalem-ah a tai dingin Kumpi Rehoboam a sakol leeng-ah a tuang dingin nawhtai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tuni dongin leilulam Israel-te in David' suante' ukna lehdo uh hi.
Jeroboam hong ciahkik khitna thu Israel-te khempeuh in a zak uh ciangin amaute in mi sawlin kikhopna-ah amah samsak uh a, Israel-te khempeuh tungah kumpi-in amah a bawl uh hi. David' suante a zui kuamah dang om lo a, Judah minam bek in a zui uh hi.
Jerusalem-ah Rehoboam a tun ciangin, a kumpi gam a ngahkikna dingin Israel mite a sim dingin Judah minam khempeuh, le Benjamin minam, a kiteel galhang mi tul zakhat le tul sawmgiat a khawm hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian' mi Shemaiah' tungah Pasian' thu hong tung hi:
"Judah kumpipa, Solomon' tapa Rehoboam tung, le Judah le Benjamin minam khempeuh tung, le a omlai midang khempeuh tungah gen in.
' Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Note na kuanto kei ding uh a, na beh uh ahi Israel-te na do kei ding uh hi. Mi khempeuh a inn ciat uhah ciah hen. Hih thu pen keima vaihawm ahi hi,' ci hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Topa' thu ngai uh a, Topa' thugen bangin inn-ah a ciahkik uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jeroboam in Efraim mualtung gam sungah Shekhem khua phutin tua lai-ah tawlkhat sung a teng hi. Tua ciangin amah paikhia-in Penuel a puah hi.
Tua ciangin Jeroboam in a lungsim sungah, "Tu-in kumpi gam pen David' suante' tungah kiheikik khathei ding hi.
Jerusalem-a Topa' biakinn-ah biakna pia dingin hih mite paito leh, hih mite' lungsim Judah kumpi Rehoboam, a topa uh lamah kiheikik kha ding a, amaute in kei hong thatin Judah kumpi Rehoboam kiangah ciahkik ding uh hi," ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in thu kikupna khat bawl a, tua ciangin kham bawngno nih bawl hi. Tua ciangin amah in mite kiangah, "Jerusalem-ah sauvei khop na pai khinta uh hi. Israel mite aw, Egypt leitang panin note hong paikhiatpih na pasian-te uh en un," a ci hi.
Amah in Bethel-ah khat koihin, Dan-ah adang khat a koih hi.
Hih na pen khialhna khat a suak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mite Bethel-a bia ding le Dan-a bia dingin a gamla pekah va pai uh hi.
Amah in mual dawnte-ah zong biak nading inn lamin mite khempeuh lak panin Levi mi ahi lo mite siampi-in a seh hi.
Tua ciangin Jeroboam in Judah a om pawi tawh a kibangin a kha giatna a ni sawm le nga ni-in pawi khat bawl a, biakna tau tungah biaknate a pia hi. Tua mah bangin amah in Bethel-ah bawlin ama bawlsa bawngno milimte tungah biakna a pia hi. Tua ciangin amah in ama bawlsa mualtung a biakna siampite Bethel-ah a koih hi.
A kha giatna a ni sawm le nga ni, ama deih kha sungin Bethel-a ama bawlsa biakna tau-ah amah paito hi. Amah in Israel mite a dingin pawi khat kipsak a, paknamtui hal dingin biakna tau-ah a paito hi.
Tua laitakin Topa' sawlna tawh Judah panin Pasian' mi khat Bethel-ah hong pai hi. Paknamtui hal dingin biakna tau gei-ah Jeroboam na ding hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' sawlna bangin biakna tau langpangin mipa kiko a, "Biakna tau, biakna tau aw, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: 'En in, Josiah min nei tapa khat David' suan sung pan hong piang ding hi. Amah in nangma tungah paknamtui a hal mualtung a biakna a pia siampite nangma tungah biakna-in pia ding a, nangma tungah mihingte' guhte kihal ding hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua ni mahin amah in lim khat pia a, "Hih pen Topa in thu a gen khitna lim ahi hi: 'En in, biakna tau kitam khamin a tunga om vutte kithehthang ding hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Bethel-a biakna tau langpangin Pasian' mipa' thugenna kumpipa in a zak ciangin biakna tau panin Jeroboam in a khut zan a, "Amah lencip un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah langpangin a zankhiat a khut keucip ahih manin a khut tonsakkik thei nawn lo hi.
Topa' sawlna bangin Pasian' mipa in lim khat a piakna tawh kizui-in biakna tau zong kiphelkhamin biakna tau panin a vutte kithehthang hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Pasian' mipa kiangah, "Tu-in Topa na Pasian' maipha kunh inla, ka khut a ngei a bat nadingin thu hong ngetsak in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Pasian' mipa in Topa' tungah kunh hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa' khut a ngei bangkik a, a nidanga mah hong bang hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Pasian' mipa kiangah, "Inn-ah hong zui in la, tawlnga in. Keimah in nangma tungah thaman kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian' mipa in kumpipa kiangah, "Na inn phel langkhat hong pia ding na hi zongin kong zui kei ding hi. Keimah in hih lai munah an ahi a, tui ahi zongin ka ne ka dawn kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in kei tungah thu hong pia khinzo a, 'An ahi a, tui ahi zongin ne lo dawn loin, na paina lampi tawnin na ciahkik kei ding hi,' hong ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah lampi dangah pai a, Bethel-ah hong paina lampi tawnin ciahkik lo hi.
Tua hun laitakin kamsang khangham khat Bethel-ah a teng hi. Ama tapate hong pai-in tua ni-in Pasian' mipa in Bethel-ah a hih thu teng ama kiangah a gen uh hi. Kumpipa kiangah a gen thute zong, amaute in a pa uh kiangah a gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin a pa un amaute kiangah, "Koi lamah amah pai ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ciangin a tapate in Judah panin hong pai Pasian' mipa a paina lam a hilh uh hi.
Amah in a tapate kiangah, "Kei a dingin la van hong vawhsak un," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in ama a dingin la van vawhsakin a tungah amah a tuang hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian' mipa nungah amah pai a, tawsaw khat nuai-ah tu-in amah mu hi. Tua ciangin amah in Pasian' mipa kiangah, "Nang pen Judah panin a hong pai Pasian' mipa na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in, "Ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Kei tawh inn-ah hong ciahin an ne in," a ci hi.
Amah in, "Nang tawh kong ciahkik kei ding a, nang kong zui thei kei ding hi. Hih munah nang tawh an ahi a, tui ahi zongin ka ne ka dawn kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in kei tungah, 'An ahi a, tui ahi zongin tua lai-ah ne lo dawn loin, na paina lampi tawnin na ciahkik kei ding hi,' hong ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Kei zong nangmah bangin kamsang khat ka hi a, Topa' sawlna bangin vantungmi khat in kei tungah thu hong gen a, 'Amah in anletui ne-in a dawn theih nadingin na inn-ah amah paipih kik in,' hong ci hi," a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in Pasian' mipa tungah zuau genin a phuahtawm ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah zui-in hong ciahkik a, ama inn-ah an ne-in tui a dawn hi.
Amaute sabuai-ah a tut laitakun amah a ciahpih kik kamsang teekpa tungah Topa' thu hong tung hi.
Judah panin hong pai Pasian' mipa tungah amah kiko a, " Topa in hih bangin ci hi: 'Nangmah in ama thu mang loin, Topa na Pasian in hong thupiaksa thupiakna zui loin,
nang hong paikikin, amah in, "An ne kei inla, tui dawn kei in," hong cihna munah an ne-in tui na dawn hi. Tua ahih manin na pate' hanah na luanghawm kivui lo ding hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in an ne-in tui a dawn khit ciangin, amah in a ciahpih kik kamsangpa a dingin la van vawhsak hi.
Amah a paikhiat ciangin humpinelkai khat in lampi-ah na dawntuahin amah that hi. Ama luanghawm lampi-ah kipaai a, a gei-ah a la ding a, a humpinelkai zong a luanghawm gei-ah a ding hi.
Tua laitakin mite in va nawkkha uh a, lampi-ah a luanghawm kipaai-in a luanghawm gei-ah humpinelkai a ding mu uh hi. Amaute hong pai-in kamsang khangham pa a tenna khuapi sungah a gen uh hi.
Lampi panin amah a ciahpih kik kamsangpa in tua thu a zak ciangin amah in, " Topa' thu a mang lo Pasian' mipa ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin Topa in ama tungah a gensa thu tawh kizui-in amah balnenin a that humpinelkai tungah Topa in amah pia hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a tapate kiangah, "Kei a dingin la van hong vawhsak un," a ci hi. Amaute in vawhsak uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah pai a, lampi-ah a luanghawm kipaai-in la leh humpinelkai a luanghawm gei-ah a ding a mu hi. Humpinelkai in a luanghawm ne lo a, a la zong balnen lo hi.
Tua ciangin kamsangpa in Pasian' mipa' luanghawm la-in la tungah koih a, kah ding le vui dingin khuapi sungah a ciahpih hi.
Tua ciangin amah in ama hanah a luanghawm a vui hi. Tua ciangin ama hangin amaute kap uh a, "Ala, ka sanggampa!" a ci uh hi.
Amah a vui khit ciangin a tapate kiangah, "Kei ka sih ciangin Pasian' mipa a kivuina hanah kei hong vui un. Ama guh gei-ah kei' guhte koih un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Bethel-a biakna tau le Samaria khuapite sunga om mualtung a biaknate khempeuh langpangin Topa' sawlna bangin a thugenna hong tung taktak ding hi," a ci hi.
Hih thu khit ciangin zong ama gamtat sia panin Jeroboam kihei tuan lo a, mite khempeuh sung panin mualtung a biaknate-a sem ding siampite bawlkik hi. Amah in a sem nuam peuhpeuh mualtung a biakna siampi dingin a ap hi.
Hih pen lei maitang panin khenkhia-in a susia zah dongin Jeroboam' innkuan tungah khialhna lianpi a suak hi.
Tua hun laitakin Jeroboam' tapa Abijah a ci na hi.
Jeroboam in a zi kiangah, "Ding inla, na mel kiseelin Jeroboam' zi na hihlam kitheisak kei inla, Shiloh-ah va pai in. Hih mite tungah kumpi ka hih nading thu a gen kamsangpa Ahijah tua lai-ah om hi.
Anlum sawm, moh pawlkhat, khuaizu thawl khat keng inla ama kiangah va pai in. Naupang tungah a piang ding thu amah in nang kiangah hong gen ding hi," a ci hi.
Jeroboam' zi tua bangmahin gamta hi. Amah kithawi-in Shiloh-ah pai a, Ahijah' inn va tung hi. A khanghamna hangin a mitte maang ahih manin Ahijah in khua mu thei lo hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Ahijah kiangah, "En in, a tapa tawh kisai nangma kiangah thu a dong dingin Jeroboam' zi hong pai hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a tapa a ci na hi. Tua bang tua bangin tua nu tungah na gen ding hi," a ci hi. Amah hong pai ciangin numei dang khatin kineih hi.
Ahih hangin Ahijah in amah kongkhak hong tun a kheging a zak ciangin, "Hong tum in Jeroboam' zi aw, bang hangin midang khat kineih na hi hiam? Nang a dingin thugik khat kei tungah hong kipia hi.
Pai inla Jeroboam kiangah hih bangin gen in, 'Israel Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Mite lak panin nang hong liansakin ka mi Israel-te tungah makai-in kong bawl a,
David' suante' tung panin kumpi gam balkhia-in nangma tungah kong pia hi. Ahi zongin nang pen ka thupiaknate zui-in, a lungsim khempeuh tawh kei hong zui-in ka muhna-ah a man nate bek a sem ka nasempa David na bang kei a,
nangmah in na mai-a om mite khempeuh sangin siatna bawlzaw-in, pai-in pasian dangte le a kisung milimte nang a dingin bawlin ka hehna dingin nong phin a, na nung lamah kei nong paai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin en in, mi khat in a bei matengin ek a haltum mah bangin Jeroboam innkuan tungah siatna tungsakin, sal le sal ahi lo mi a kibangin pasal khempeuh Jeroboam innkuan panin ka susia ding a, Israel sungah Jeroboam innkuan ka beisiangsak ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Jeroboam' mi, khuapi sunga a si mi peuhpeuh uite in ne ding a, gamlakah a si mi peuhpeuh huihlak vasate in ne ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in gen khin hi," ci hi,' ci-in a gen hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin ding inla na inn-ah ciah in. Na khua na tun ciangin na tapa si ding hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mi khempeuh ama hangin kapin vui ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel Pasian, Topa' tungah a lungkimhuai na khat Jeroboam' innkuan sung panin ama tungah kimu ahih manin Jeroboam sung panin amah bek mah hanah kivui ding hi.
Tua tham loin tuni-in Jeroboam innkuan a beisak ding, Israel-te' tungah kumpi khat Topa in ama a dingin khangsak ding hi. Tua hun a kipan
tui sunga pumpeeng a kilin' mah bangin Topa in Israel mite vatin amau pute pate tungah a piak hih gam hoih panin Israel zunglot ding a, Eufratis gun galkhatah amaute thehthang ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Asherah milimte bawlin Topa a heh nadingin phin uh hi.
Tua ciangin ama khialhna le Israel-te a khialhsakna ahi Jeroboam' khialhna hangin amah in Israel nusia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jeroboam' zi dingin kihemkhia a, Tirzah-ah a ciah hi. Amah inn tungin sangkil a kan laitakin naupang a si hi.
Tua ciangin a nasem kamsang Ahijah tungtawnin Topa' thugenna tawh kizui-in Israel mi khempeuh in amah vui-in ama hangin a kap uh hi.
Tu-in Jeroboam' gamtatna a omlaite, a galsimna le a gam uknate, Israel Kumpite' Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi.
Jeroboam' uk hun sung kum sawmnih le nih ahi hi. Tua ciangin amah si a, ama tangin a tapa Nadab in a uk hi.
Tu-in Solomon' tapa Rehoboam in Judah-ah uk hi. Gam uk dingin a kipatin Rehoboam kum sawmli le khat pha a, a min koih nadingin Topa in Israel minam khempeuh sung panin a teelkhiat khuapi Jerusalem-ah amah in kum sawm le sagih sung uk hi. Ama nu a min Naamah hi a, Ammon mi ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Judah mite, Topa' muhna-ah a sia gamta uh a, a pu a pate khempeuh uh hih sangin a tamzaw-in amau' khialhnate uh tawh ama hazat nading piangsak uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in amau a dingin mualtung a biaknate, biakna songte le mual sang tung khempeuh le singniim nuai khempeuhah Asherah milimte bawl uh a,
biakna phualte-ah numei-pasal paktat pawlte zong om uh hi. Topa in Israel mite' mai-ah a hawlkhiat minam dangte' gamtatna a kihhuai khempeuh bangin amaute gamta uh hi.
Kumpi Rehoboam' kum ngana kumin Jerusalem a sim dingin Egypt kumpi Shishak hong kuanto hi.
Amah in Topa' biakinn-a van manphate le kumpipa' inn-a van manphate lakhia hi. Amah in na khempeuh lakhia hi. Amah in Solomon' bawlsa kham lumte khempeuh zong la hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Rehoboam in tuate' tangin sumngo lumte bawl a, kumpipa' inn kongkhak a cing inncing uliante' khut sungah tuate a ap hi.
Topa' biakinn-ah kumpipa a pai simin inncingte in tuate pua-in, tua ciangin inncinna inndei sungah tuate koihkik zel uh hi.
Tu-in Rehoboam' gamtatna a omlaite, le a sep khempeuh, Judah Kumpite' Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi.
Tua ciangin Rehoboam le Jeroboam' kikalah galkidona om tawntung hi.
Tua ciangin Rehoboam si a, David khuapi sungah a pate tawh kivui hi. Ama nu a min Naamah hi a, Ammon mi ahi hi. Tua ciangin ama tangin a tapa Abijam in a uk hi.
Tu-in Nebat' tapa Kumpi Jeroboam' kum sawm le giatna kumin Abijam in Judah tungah uk ding kipan hi.
Amah in Jerusalem-ah kum thum sung uk hi. Ama nu' min Maakah hi a, Absalom' tanu ahi hi.
Ama mai-a a pa' khialhna khempeuh amah in zui hi. A pusawn David a thuman bangin Topa a Pasian' tungah a lungsim thuman bup lo hi.
Ahi zongin David' hangin Topa a Pasian in Jerusalem-ah amah tapa khat pia a, ama khitah a tapa koihin Jerusalem kipsak hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Hit mi Uriah thu-ah cih simloh ama nuntak sung tawntung Topa' mitah David a manin gamta-in a thupiakte khat peuhpeuh panin amah pial lo hi.
Tu-in Abijam' nuntak sung tawntung amah le Jeroboam' kikalah kidona om hi.
Abijam' gamtatna a omlaite, le a sep khempeuh, Judah Kumpite' Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi. Tua ciangin Abijam le Jeroboam kikalah galkidona om hi.
Tua ciangin Abijam si a, amaute in David khuapi sungah amah vui uh hi. Ama tangin a tapa Asa in uk hi.
amah in Jerusalem-ah kum sawmli le khat sung uk hi. Ama pi' min Maakah hi a, Absalom' tanu ahi hi.
Ama pupi David a gamtat bangin Topa' muhna-ah Asa a manin gamta hi.
Amah in gam sung panin pasal paktat pawlte koihkhia-in a pate' bawlsa milim khempeuh khinkhia hi.
Amah in Asherah milim dingin a kibawl a kihhuai milim khat nei ahih manin kumpinu' nu hihna panin a pi Maakah zong khinkhia hi. Tua hi a, Asa in tua nu' milim phukin Kidron lui-ah a hal hi.
Ahih hangin mualtung a biaknate kilakhia lo hi. Ahi zongin ama hun sung khempeuh Asa' lungsim Topa' tungah thuman bup hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a pa' apsa letsongte le ama apsa letsongte, ngun, kham, le nazatte Topa' biakinn sungah a paipih hi.
Amau' hun sung tawntung Asa le Israel kumpi Baasha kikalah galkidona om hi.
Judah a sim dingin Israel kumpi Baasha kuanto a, Judah kumpi Asa kiang pan kuamah paikhia thei lo, kuamah a tum theih loh nadingin Ramah khua a lam hi.
Tua ciangin Asa in Topa' biakinn sung vankoihna le kumpipa inn vankoihna sungah a omlai ngun le kham khempeuh la-in ama nasemte' khut sungah tuate a pia hi. Tua ciangin kumpi Asa in Damaskas-ah a teng, Syria kumpi, Hezion' tapa Tabrimmon, a tapa Benhadad kiangah tuate puak a,
"Ka pa le na pa mah bangin kei le nang kikalah kipawlna khat omsak ni. Ngun le kham letsong nangma tungah kong puak hi. Keima kiang panin amah a nungkik theih nadingin Israel kumpi Baasha tawh na kipawlna va sutat in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Benhadad in Kumpi Asa' thu mang a, Israel khuapite a sim dingin a galkap a ukte sawlin, Ijon, Dan, Abelbethmaakah, le Khinneroth khempeuh, Naftali gam khempeuh tawh a zo hi.
Baasha in tua thu a zak ciangin Ramah a lam khawlin Tirzah-ah om hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi Asa in Judah gam khempeuhah thu genzakna khat bawl a, kuamah peng loin a milipin Baasha in khua lamna-a a zat Ramah suangte le a singte a puakhia dingin a sawl hi. Tua ciangin kumpi Asa in tuate tawh Benjamin mite' khua Geba le Mizpah khua a lam hi.
Tu-in Asa' gamtatna a omlaite khempeuh, ama thahatna khempeuh, ama sep khempeuh, le ama lam khuapite, Judah Kumpite' Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi. Ahih hangin a teek ciangin a khete-ah natna khat a nei hi.
Tua ciangin Asa si a, a pupi David khuapi sungah a pate tawh kivui hi. Tua ciangin ama tangin a tapa Jehoshafat in a uk hi.
Judah kumpi Asa' kum nihna kumin Jeroboam' tapa Nadab in Israel tungah uk ding kipan a, amah in Israel tungah kum nih sung uk hi.
Topa' muhna-ah amah a sia gamta a, a pa' khekhap mah tawnin, Israel a khialhsakna ama khialhna mah a zui hi.
Issakhar minam Ahijah' tapa Baasha in Nadab sawmsim hi. Baasha in Filistia-te' khua Gibbethon-ah amah sattuk hi. Nadab le Israel khempeuh in Gibbethon umcihin a om laitakun a thah ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Judah kumpi Asa' kum thumna kumin Baasha in Nadab that a, Nadab tangin amah in a uk hi.
Amah kumpi ahih phetin Jeroboam' innkuan khempeuh that hi. Topa in Shiloh khuami a nasempa Ahijah tungtawnin a gensa bangin a vekpi-in a suksiat khit dongin mi khat zong Jeroboam' innkuan-ah nusia lo hi.
Tua pen ama khialhna le Israel a khialhsakna ahi Jeroboam' khialhnate hang le Israel Pasian, Topa a hehsakna hang ahi hi.
Tu-in Nadab' gamtatna a omlaite, le a sep khempeuh, Israel Kumpite' Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi.
Amau' hun sung khempeuh Asa le Israel kumpi Baasha kikalah galkidona a om hi.
Judah kumpi Asa' kum thumna kumin Ahijah' tapa Baasha in Israel khempeuh tungah Tirzah panin uk ding kipan a, kum sawmnih le li sung a uk hi.
Topa' muhna-ah amah a sia gamta a, Jeroboam' khekhap mah tawnin, Israel a khialhsakna ama khialhna mah a zui hi.
Tua ciangin Baasha langpangin Hanani tapa Jehu tungtawnin Topa' thu hong tung a,
"Keimah in leivui lak panin nang hong sangto sakin ka mi Israel-te tungah makai-in nang hong bawl napi-in, nangmah in Jeroboam' khekhap mah tawnin ka mi Israel-te na khialsak a, amaute' khialhna tawh kei hong hehsak na hih manin
en in, keimah in Baasha le a innkuan ka phiatsiang ding a, Nebat' tapa Jeroboam' innkuan bangin na innkuan ka bawl ding hi.
Baasha' mi, khuapi sunga a si peuhpeuh uite in ne ding a, ama mi gamlakah a si peuhpeuh huihlak vasate in ne ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tu-in Baasha' gamtatna a omlaite, a septe, le a thahatna, Israel Kumpite' Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi.
Tua ciangin Baasha si a, Tirzah-ah kivui hi. Ama tangin a tapa Elah in uk hi.
Tua tham loin Jeroboam innkuan bangin ama nasepna tawh hehsakin Topa' muhna-ah a sia a gamtatna khempeuh hang le amah in Jeroboam le a innkuan a suksiatna hangin Hanani' tapa kamsang Jehu' tungtawnin Baasha le a innkuan langpangin Topa' thu hong tung hi.
Judah kumpi Asa' kum sawmnih le gukna kumin Baasha' tapa Elah in Tirzah panin Israel tungah uk ding kipan a, kum nih sung uk hi.
Ahih hangin ama leengte alang a ukpa ama nasem Zimri in amah sawmsim hi. Tirzah-a kumpi innsung a ukpa Arza' inn-ah zukhamin Tirzah-ah a om laitak,
Judah kumpi Asa' kum sawmnih le sagihna kumin Zimri hong pai-in Elah sattukin that a, ama tangin a uk hi.
Amah in uk dinga a kipat, kumpi tokhom tungah a tut khit phetin amah in Baasha' innkuan khempeuh that hi. Ama behte pasal khat beek ahi a, a lawmte ahi zongin khat zong siit lo hi.
Baasha' khialhnate le a khialhsa uh ahi a tapa Elah' khialhnate, le amaute in Israel khialsakin, a milimte uh tawh Israel Pasian, Topa a hehsakna uh hangin, Baasha langpangin kamsang Jehu tungtawnin Topa' thugenna bangin Baasha' innkuan khempeuh tua bangin Zimri in susia hi.
Tu-in Elah' gamtatna a omlaite, le a sep khempeuh, Israel Kumpite' Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi.
Judah kumpi Asa' kum sawmnih le sagihna kumin Zimri in Tirzah-ah ni sagih sung uk hi. Tua laitakin Filistia-te' khua Gibbethon simin Israel galkapte in giahphual sat uh a,
giahphual sat a om galkapte in, "Zimri in sawmsimin kumpipa that khin hi," a kicihna a za uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Israel-te khempeuh in tua ni-in giahphual ah galkap a ukpa Omri kumpi-in a bawl uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Omri le amah tawh a om Israel khempeuh Gibbethon panin paito-in amaute in Tirzah umcih uh hi.
Ama hihsa a khialhna, Topa' muhna-ah a siat gamtatna, Jeroboam' khekhap a totna, le a hihsa a khialhna, Israel a khialhsakna hangin, a khuapi kila khinta hi, ci-in Zimri in a muh ciangin kumpipa' inn muanhuai sungah amah pai a, kumpipa' inn tawh amah mei-in kihalnelhin a si hi.
Tu-in Zimri' gamtatna a omlaite, le ama hihsa a sawmsimna, Israel Kumpite' Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite pawl nihin kikhen uh hi. Mi pawlkhat in kumpi-in a bawl dingin Ginath' tapa Tibni zui uh a, a pawlkhat in Omri zui uh hi.
Ahih hangin Omri a zui mite in Ginath' tapa Tibni a zuite zo uh ahih ciangin Tibni si a, Omri kumpi a suak hi.
Judah kumpi Asa' kum sawmthum le khatna kumin Omri in Israel-te tungah uk ding kipan a, kum sawm le nih sung a uk hi. Amah in kum guk sung Tirzah-ah uk hi.
Amah in Shemer' tung panin ngun talen nihin Samaria mual lei hi. Amah in kulh tawh a mual um a, tua mual a nei pa Shemer' min tamin a lamsa khuapi min Samaria a phuak hi.
Topa' muhna-ah Omri a sia gamta a, ama mai-a om mi khempeuh sangin a sia tamzaw gamta hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Nebat' tapa Jeroboam' gamtat khempeuh, le Israel a khialhsakna khialhnate, a milimte uh tawh Israel Pasian, Topa a hehsakna uh a zui hi.
Tu-in Omri' gamtatna a omlaite, le a thahatna a lahna, Israel Kumpite' Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi.
Tua ciangin Omri si a, Samaria-ah kivui hi. Tua ciangin ama tangin a tapa Ahab in a uk hi.
Judah kumpi Asa' kum sawmthum le giatna kumin Omri' tapa Ahab in Israel tungah uk ding kipan a, amah in Samaria panin Israel-te tungah kum sawmnih le nih sung a uk hi.
Omri' tapa Ahab, ama mai-a mite khempeuh sangin Topa' muhna-ah a sia tamzaw gamta hi.
Nebat' tapa Jeroboam' khialhnate zuih ding ama a dingin a thuzang tawh a kibat mah bangin, amah in Sidon mite' kumpi Ethbaal' tanu Jezebel zi-in la a, pai-in Baal na semin a bia hi.
Amah in Samaria-a a lam Baal inn sungah Baal a dingin biakna tau khat dingsak hi.
Tua ciangin Ahab in Asherah milim khat bawl hi. Ahab in ama mai-a om Israel kumpite khempeuh sangin Israel Pasian, Topa hehsak nading tam hihzaw hi.
Ama hun sungin Bethel mi Hiel in Jerikho a puah hi. Topa in Nun tapa Joshua' tungtawnin a gen bangin amah in a tacil Abiram' luang khamin a bulpi phut a, a tapa neupen Segub' luang khamin a kongpite a phut hi.
Tu-in Gilead gam sung Tishbe khua panin Tishbe mi Elijah in Ahab kiangah, "A mai-ah ka dinna Israel Pasian, Topa a nungta ahih mah bangin keima thu tawh loin daitui ahi a, guah ahi zongin hong tung ding kumte sungah om lo ding hi," a ci hi.
"Hih lai panin kihemin nisuahna lamah kihei inla, Jordan nisuahna lam Kherith lui-ah bu in.
Nangmah in lui panin tui na dawn ding hi. Tua lai-ah nangmah a hong vak dingin va-akte thu ka piazo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah pai-in Topa' thugen bangin gamta a, Jordan nisuahna lam Kherith lui gei-ah a om hi.
Tua ciangin va-akte in ama kiangah zing le nitakin anlum le sa puak a, amah in lui panin tui a dawn hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah kiangah Topa' thu hong tung a,
"Ding inla, Sidon mite' khua Zarefath-ah pai-in tua lai-ah om in. Tua lai-ah nangmah a hong vak dingin meigongnu khat thu ka piazo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah dingin Zarefath-ah a pai hi. Khuapi kulhkongpi a tun ciangin, meigongnu khat in sing na tom hi. Amah in tua nu samin, "Ka dawn theih nadingin beel khat sungah tui tawm hong paipih in," a ci hi.
Tua nu in paipih dingin a kisak laitakin, amah in tua nu samin, "Anlum neu khat hong tawi kawm in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, " Topa na Pasian a nungta ahih mah bangin emsa bangmah ka nei kei a, beel sungah annel khutdim khat le um sungah sathau tawmno khat bek om hi. Tu-in keimah le ka tapa a dingin tuate bawlin kote in ka nek theih nadingun singkang nih khawng a tom ka hi a, tua ciangin a si ta ding ka hi uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah in ama kiangah, "Lunghimawh kei in; pai inla na gensa bangin an hong bawl in. Kei a dingin mohneu khat hong bawlsak masa-in kei kiangah hong paipih inla, tua khit ciangin nang le na tapa a' ding bawl in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: ' Topa in leitungah guah a zuksak ni matengin beel sunga annel bei lo ding a, um sunga sathau zong kiam ngei lo ding hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah pai-in Elijah' gensa bangin hih hi. Tua nu, le amah, le tua nu' innkuan in ni tampi sung ne uh hi.
Elijah' tungtawnin Topa' thugen bangin beel sunga annel bei lo a, um sunga sathau zong kiam ngei lo hi.
Hih thu khit ciangin innsung nupi ahi numei' tapa a ci na hi. A natna nasia mahmah ahih manin gim semsemin a si hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Elijah kiangah, "Pasian' mipa aw, kei' langkhatah bang thu nei na hi hiam? Ka khialhna a pholak ding ka tapa' sihna a piangsak dingin kei kiangah nong pai hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in tua nu kiangah, "Na tapa hong pia in," a ci hi. Amah in tua nu' ang panin amah la-in ama giahna innkhumzangah puato-in ama lupna tungah a sial hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' tungah kiko-in, " Topa ka Pasian aw, ama tapa thahna tawh ka peemna meigongnu' tung nangawnah gimna hong tungsak na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin naupang tungah amah thumvei kikhuangin Topa' tungah kiko a, " Topa ka Pasian aw, hih naupang hingkiksak in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Elijah' aw ngai hi; naupang hong nak kikin a hingkik hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah in naupang la-in innkhumzang panin inn sungah paipihsuk a, a nu kiangah a pia hi. Tua ciangin Elijah in, "En in, na tapa nungta hi," a ci hi.
Numei in Elijah kiangah, "Nang, Pasian' mi na hihna le Topa in nang tungtawnin thu a gen takpi ahihna tu-in ka thei hi," a ci hi.
Ni tampi khit a kum thumna kumin Elijah' tungah Topa' thu hong tung a, "Pai in, Ahab kiangah nangmah kilak in. Tua ciangin keimah in leitungah guah ka zusak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Ahab kiangah amah a kilaktawm dingin Elijah a pai hi. Tu-in Samaria-ah kialpi nasia hi.
Tua ciangin Ahab in kumpi innsung a ukpa Obadiah sam hi. (Obadiah in nakpitakin Topa zahtak hi;
Jezebel in Topa' kamsangte a hon thah lai-in Obadiah in kamsang zakhat la-in sawmnga sawmnga-in leihawm sungah seel a, amaute anletui tawh a vak hi.)
Tua ciangin Ahab in Obadiah kiangah, "Gam sung ciktui omna khempeuh le kuam omna khempeuhah va pai in. Lopa mu-in sakolte le la-sakolte i hinsuahzo kha ding a, ganhingte pawlkhat i sum kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in a et dingun leitang hawm uh hi. Ahab mahmah mun khat lamah pai-in Obadiah mahmah a mun dang khat lamah a pai hi.
Obadiah lamkalah a om laitakin, Elijah in amah na dawntuah hi. Obadiah in amah thei-in a mai lei ngatin puk a, "Ka to Elijah, nang na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in dawngin, "Keimah ka hi hi. Pai-in na topa kiangah, 'Elijah hih lai-ah om hi,' ci in," a ci hi.
Amah in, "Hong thah dingin Ahab' khut sungah na nasempa nong piak nadingin bang thu-ah khial ka hi hiam?
Topa na Pasian a nungta ahih mah bangin nangmah a zong dingin ka topa in a sawl lohna minam ahi a, kumpi gam ahi zongin om lo hi. Amaute in, 'Hih lai-ah amah om lo hi,' a cih uh ciangin, amaute in nang hong muh lohna thu amah in kumpi gam ahi a, minam ahi zongin kiciamsak hi.
Tu-in nangmah in, 'Pai-in na topa kiangah, "Hih lai-ah Elijah om hi," ci in,' nong ci hi.
