Nang kiang panin kei ka paikhiat phetin ka theih lohna munah Topa' kha in nang hong pua ding hi. Kei va pai-in Ahab kiangah genin amah in nang hong muh loh ciangin, ka khangno lai a kipanin keimah na nasempa in Topa a zahtak hinapi-in, amah in kei hong that ding hi.
Jezebel in Topa' kamsangte a thah lai-in Topa' kamsangte mi zakhat, sawmnga sawmnga-in leihawm sungah seelin, amaute anletui tawh ka vakna thu ka topa tungah hong kigen nai lo ahi hiam?
Tu-in nangmah in, 'Pai-in na topa kiangah, "Hih lai-ah Elijah om hi," ci in,' nong ci hi. Tua hileh amah in kei hong that ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah in, "A mai-ah ka dinna Vanglian Topa a nungta ahih mah bangin, tuni-in ama kiangah kei mahmah ka kilak taktak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Ahab tawh a kimu dingin Obadiah pai-in ama kiangah a gen hi. Tua ciangin Elijah tawh a kimu dingin Ahab hong pai hi.
Ahab in Elijah a muh ciangin, "Israel mite a lungkhamsak pa, nang na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in dawngin, "Keimah in Israel mite ka lungkhamsak kei hi. Nang in Topa' thupiaknate nusia-in Baal-te zui na hih manin nang le na pa' innkuan in na lungkhamsak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in mi sawl inla, Karmel Mual kei kiangah Israel-te khempeuh, le Jezebel' sabuai-ah an a ne Baal kamsang zali le sawmnga le Asherah kamsang za lite hong khawm in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Ahab in Israel mite khempeuh kiangah mi sawlin, Karmel Mual-ah Israel mite le kamsangte khawmsak hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh' nai-ah Elijah hong pai-in, "Ngaihsutna kibang lo thu nih kikalah bang tanvei khensat loin om niloh ding na hi uh hiam? Topa pen Pasian ahihleh amah zui un; tua hi loin Baal pen Pasian ahihleh amah zui un," a ci hi. Ahi zongin mite in kam khat beek dawng lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah in mite kiangah, "Kei, kei bekbek, Topa' kamsang sung panin ka omlai a, ahih hangin Baal kamsangte mihing zali le sawmnga om hi.
Kote tungah bawngtal nih hong pia un. Amau a dingin bawngtal khat amaute teelsak unla, semnen sakin sing tungah koihsak unla, ahih hangin a tungah mei koihsak kei un. Tua ciangin keimah in a bawngtal khat bawlin sing tungah koihin, a tungah mei ka koih kei ding hi.
Tua ciangin note in na pasian tung uhah thu ngen unla, keimah in zong Topa' tungah thu ka ngen ding hi. Tua ciangin thungetna mei tawh hong pia pasian pen Pasian taktak ahi hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in dawngin, "Hih na thugen hoih hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah in Baal kamsangte kiangah, "Note tam na hih manun note a dingin bawngtal khat teel unla bawl masa un. Tua ciangin na pasian uh tungah thu ngen unla, ahih hangin a tungah mei koih kei un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in amaute tungah a kipia bawngtal la-in bawl uh a, zingsang a kipan sun dong Baal tungah thu ngenin, "Baal aw, kote hong dawng in," a ci uh hi. Ahih hangin awging om lo a, kuamah in dawng lo hi. Tua ciangin amau' bawlsa biakna tau-ah amaute diang uh hi.
Sun ciangin Elijah in amaute zahpihin, "Amah pen pasian ahih ciangin a gingin kiko un. Amah in thu a lungngaih laitak, ahih kei leh mun dangah paikhia, ahih kei leh khualzin, ahih kei leh amah ihmu-in phot ding kisam hikhathei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute a gingin kiko-in, amau' ngeina bangin namsaute le sikzumte tawh, amaute tungah si a luan dongin ki-atin kisun uh hi.
Sunkim khit ciangin biakpiak hun dong mateng amaute awngsuak uh a, ahih hangin awging om lo hi. Kuamah in dawng lo a, kuamah in don lo hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah in mi khempeuh kiangah, "Ka kiang nai-ah hong pai un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh ama kiang nai-ah hong pai uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in Topa' biakna tau a kisupaisa khat puahkik hi.
"Israel, nangma min hi ding hi," ci-in Topa' thu a tunna Jakob' tapa minam sawm le nihte tawh kizui-in Elijah in suangtum sawm le nih la hi.
Tua ciangin tua suangte tawh Topa' minin biakna tau khat lam hi. Amah in khaici lawh nih a tazo dingin a lian hawklam khat biakna tau kimkotah bawl hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a ngeina bangin a sing koih a, a bawngtal semnenin a sing tungah koih hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Beel li sungah tui dim unla, meihal biakna tau tung le a sing tungah sung un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "A nihveina hih un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in a nihveina hih uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "A thumveina hih un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in a thumveina hih leuleu uh hi.
Biakpiak hun ciangin kamsang Elijah a nai-ah hong pai-in, "Abraham, Isaac, le Israel Pasian, Topa aw, nang pen Israel sungah Pasian na hihna, le kei pen nangma nasem ka hihna, le hih nate khempeuh nangma thu tawh ka hihna thu tuni-in kitheisak in.
Topa aw, nangmah Pasian na hihna le amaute' lungsim na heikikna thu hih mite in a theih nadingin hong dawng in, Topa aw, hong dawng in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' meikuang hong kia a, a meihal biakna, a sing, a suangte, le a leivui kangtumin, hawklam sunga om tui nangawn kangcip hi.
Mi khempeuh in tua thu a muh uh ciangin a mai uh leilam ngatin puk uh hi. Amaute in, " Topa pen Pasian ahi hi; Topa pen Pasian ahi hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah in amaute kiangah, "Baal kamsangte man un; amaute khat zong suaktasak kei un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in man uh hi. Elijah in Kishon lui-ah amaute paipih sukin tua lai-ah amaute a that hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah in Ahab kiangah, "Paito inla, an ne-in tui dawn in; bang hang hiam cih leh guahpi huging om hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin anne tuidawn dingin Ahab paito hi. Karmel Mual dawnah Elijah paito a, amahmah leilakah kun sukin a khukte kikalah a maitang a phum hi.
Tua ciangin a nasempa kiangah, "Tu-in paito in; tuipi lam va en in," a ci hi. Amah paito-in khuadak a, "Bangmah om lo hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Sagihvei paikik in," a ci hi.
A sagihveina ciangin amah in, "Khuttum cia bang meii tawmno khat tuipi panin hong kaito hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Paito-in Ahab kiangah, 'Guah in hong khak kha ding ahih manin na leeng kithawi in la paisuk in,' va ci in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah tungah Topa' vangliatna hong tung hi. Amah in a kawng gakin Jezreel khua lutna dongah Ahab' mai-ah na tai hi.
Ahab in Jezebel kiangah Elijah' hih khempeuh le namsau tawh kamsangte khempeuh a thah khitna thu a gen hi.
Tua ciangin Jezebel in Elijah kiangah kamtai khat sawlin, "Zing ciang tubang hunin amaute na thah bangin nangmah ka hong thah kei taak le pasian-te in kei hong dawm kei ta hen," cisak hi.
Tua ciangin amah lau a, kithawi-in a suahtak nadingin paikhia a, Judah-te' khua Beersheba tungin tua lai-ah a nasempa nusia hi.
Ahih hangin amahmah gamlakah ni khat lam pailai-in poding kung nuai khatah a tu hi. Tua ciangin amah in a sih nading thu ngenin, "Phazo hi; tu-in Topa aw, ka nuntakna hong la ta in; bang hang hiam cih leh ka pate sangin kei ka hoihzaw kei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin poding kung khat nuai-ah amah lumsukin a ihmu hi. Tua laitakin vantungmi khat in amah lawngin ama kiangah, "Tho inla an ne in," a ci hi.
Amah khuadak a, ama lutang gei suang sa tungah a ki-em moh khat le tui hai khat na om hi. Amah in tuate ne-in dawnin lumkik hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' vantungmi a nihveina hong paikikin amah lawng a, "Tho in la an ne in; tua hikeileh nang a dingin khualzinna haksa lua ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah tho a, an ne-in tui dawn a, tua an thahatna tawh Pasian' mual Horeb ciang dong sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung a pai hi.
Tua ciangin leihawm khatah amah tungin tua lai-ah giak hi. Topa in Elijah hopih a, "Elijah, hih lai-ah bang hih na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in, "Vanglian Pasian, Topa a dingin ka huaiham mahmah hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Israel mite in na thuciamna nusia-in, na biakna taute lawnkhia uh a, namsau tawh na kamsangte that hi; kei, kei bekbek ka omlai hi. Amaute in kei nangawn thah dingin hong zong lai uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Paikhia inla, mualtung, Topa' mai-ah ding in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Topa in hong nawk a, a lian a khauh huihpi in mualte semkhamin Topa' mai-ah suangtumte sukham a, ahih hangin huihpi sungah Topa om lo hi. Huihpi nun' a daih khit ciangin zin ling a, ahih hangin zinling sungah Topa om lo hi.
Zinling khit ciangin meikuang om a, ahih hangin meikuang sungah zong Topa om lo hi. Meikuang khit ciangin aw nem neu khat a ging hi.
Elijah in a zak ciangin a puan tawh a mai tuamin paikhia a, leihawm lutna-ah ding hi. Ama kiangah aw khat hong ging a, "Elijah, hih lai-ah bang hih na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in, "Vanglian Pasian, Topa a dingin ka huaiham mahmah hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Israel mite in na thuciamna nusia-in, na biakna taute lawnkhia uh a, namsau tawh na kamsangte that uh hi; kei, kei bekbek ka omlai hi. Amaute in kei nangawn thah dingin hong zong lai uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in ama kiangah, "Pai in, Damaskas gamlak na lampi-ah ciahkik in. Na tun ciangin Syria gam kumpi dingin Hazael sathau na nilh ding hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpi dingin Nimshi' tapa Jehu sathau na nilh ding hi. Tua ciangin nangma munah kamsang dingin Abelmeholah khuami Shafat' tapa Elisha sathau na nilh ding hi.
Jehu in Hazael' namsau panin a suakta peuhpeuh that ding hi. Elisha in Jehu' namsau panin a suakta peuhpeuh that ding hi.
Ahi zongin Baal mai-ah a kun nai lo, amah a nam nai lo mihing tul sagih Israel sungah ka siit ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua lai panin amah paikhia a, ama neihsa a bawngtal kap sawm le nih tawh lo a kho Shafat' tapa Elisha mu a, amah a sawm le nihna tawh a kho ahi hi. Elijah in ama gei nawkin ama tungah a puan lawn hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a bawngtalte nusia-in Elijah' nungah tai a, "Ka nu le ka pa kam vaikhakin hong namsak phot in; tua ciangin nang kong zui ding hi," a ci hi. Amah in Elisha kiangah, "Paikik in; nang hong khaktan ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah a zuihna panin ciahkik a, a bawngtal kolte la-in a bawngtalte go a, a sate bawngtal kolte tawh huanin mite tungah pia a, amaute in a ne uh hi. Tua ciangin amah kithawi-in Elijah' nung zui a, ama na a sem hi.
Syria kumpipa Benhadad in ama galkap khempeuh khawm hi. Amah a huh ding kumpi sawmthum le nih, le sakolte le leengte om hi. Amah paito-in Samaria umcihin simgawp hi.
'Na ngun le na kham keima a' hi a, na zi hoihpente le na tate zong keima-a' mah ahi hi,' ci hi," cisak hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in dawngin, "Na gen mah bangin, ka topa, kumpipa aw, kei le ka neih khempeuh nangma a' ahi hi," a ci hi.
Kamtaite hong paikikin, "Benhadad in hih bangin ci hi: 'Nang kiangah mi hong sawlin, "Kei tungah na ngun le na kham, na zite le na tate hong pia in," kong cisak hi.
Ahi zongin zing ciang tubang hunin nangma kiangah ka nasemte kong sawl ding a, amaute in nangma inn le na nasemte' innsung thawi-in, amau' deih peuhpeuh hong la ding uh hi,' ci hi," cisak hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in gam sung upa khempeuh samin, "Tu-in ciamteh un, hih mipa in buaina a zonna thei un; bang hang hiam cih leh ka zite le ka ngun le ka kham a la dingin mi hong sawl a, ama thu ka nial kei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin upa khempeuh le mi khempeuh in ama kiangah, "Don kei inla, zong thukim kei in," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in Benhadad' kamtaite kiangah, "Ka to kumpipa kiangah hih bangin gen un: 'Na nasempa' tung panin nong kalh masak kong pia ding hi; ahih hangin a nihna kong piazo kei hi, ci hi,' ci un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin kamtaite kihemkhia-in ama tungah thu tunkik uh hi.
Benhadad in ama kiangah mi sawlin, "Samaria leitang pen kei hong zui khempeuh' khutkuak a dimzawh taak leh, pasian-te in kei hong dawm kei ta hen," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in dawngin, "Ama kiangah gen un: 'Gal a zawh khit ciangin galhiam a suahkhia pa bangin galsim dingin galhiam a kuah lai pa kiphasak kei hen,' ci un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpi Ahab kiang nai-ah kamsang khat hong pai-in, " Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Hih mihon tampi khempeuh na mu hiam? En in, tuni-in nangma khut sungah kong pia ding hi. Tua ciangin keimah, Topa ka hihna na thei ding hi, ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Ahab in, "Kua tawh hi ding hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in, " Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Gamte a ukte' nasemte tawh, ci hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Kua in galsim pan ding hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in dawngin, "Nangmah in na pan ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in gamte a ukte' nasemte khawm a, amaute zanih le sawmthum le nih ahi hi. Amaute' khit ciangin amah in Israel mi khempeuh, tulsagih a khawm hi.
Tua ciangin Benhadad, bukte sungah amah a huh kumpi sawmthum le nihte tawh zukhamin a om laitak sun hunin amaute kuankhia uh hi.
Gam a ukte' nasemte kuankhia masa uh hi. Tua ciangin Benhadad in thukante sawlkhia a, amaute in ama kiangah, "Samaria panin mi hong kuankhia uh hi," ci-in zasak uh hi.
Amah in, "Kilemna a bawl dingin hong pai ahihleh a hingin amaute man un. Tua ahih kei a, a hong sim dingin amaute a hong pai ahih le zong amaute a hing mahin man un," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin gamte a ukte' nasemte le amaute a zui galkapte, khuapi panin kuankhia uh hi.
Mi khempeuh in amau' kisikpih ciat that uh hi. Syria-te tai-in Israel mite in amaute delh uh a, ahih hangin Syria kumpipa Benhadad sakol tung tuangte tawh sakol khatin tai hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa paikhia-in sakolte le leengte man a, Syria-te tampi tak a that hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa kiang nai-ah kamsangpa hong pai-in ama kiangah, "Hong pai in, nangmah kithakhauhsak inla, na hih ding thu limtakin ngaihsun in; bang hang hiam cih leh khuakhal ciangin Syria kumpipa nangmah simin hong kuanto kik ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Syria kumpipa' nasemte in ama kiangah, "Amaute' pasian-te pen mualtung pasian-te hi a, tua ahih ciangin eite sangin amaute hatzaw uh hi. Ahih hangin zanglei-ah amaute do lehang amaute sangin eite i hatzaw taktak ding hi.
Hih bangin hih in: Kumpite ama panmun ciat panin khinkhia inla, amaute' munah galkapmangte koih in.
Tua ciangin na taansa galkap tawh a kibang galkap, sakol tangin sakol, leeng tangin leeng khawm in. Tua ciangin zanglei-ah amaute i do ding a, amaute sangin eite i hatzaw taktak ding hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in amau' thu ngai-in a hih hi.
Khuakhal ciangin Benhadad in Syria-te khawmin Israel mite a sim dingin Afek-ah a kuanto hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite kikhawmin, lam-an kiguan' a, amaute a do dingin a kuan uh hi. Israel mite in amaute' mai-ah keelhon neu nih bangin giahphual sat uh a, Syria-te ahihleh gam sung khempeuh dim uh hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian' mi khat a nai-ah hong pai-in Israel kumpipa kiangah, " Topa in hih bangin ci hi: 'Syria-te in, " Topa pen mualtung pasian hi a, amah pen kuamsung pasian hi lo hi," ci uh ahih manin hih a lian mihonpi khempeuh nangma khut sungah kong pia ding a, keimah, Topa ka hihna na thei ding hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Amaute a kimaituahin ni sagih sung giahphual satin om uh hi. A ni sagih ni-in gal kido uh hi. Israel mite in Syria-te ni khat sungin khe galkap tul zakhat vatlum uh hi.
Tua ciangin a omlaite Afek khuapi-ah tai uh a, ahi zongin tuate mi tul sawmnih le tulsagih pen khuapi kulh in cipnelh hi. Benhadad zong tai a, khuapi sunga inndei sungnung khatah a lut hi.
Tua ciangin a nasemte in ama kiangah, "Israel kumpite pen hehpihna a nei kumpite hi, ci-in i za hi. Puanhampi i kawngah tengin i lu tungah khauhual vialin Israel kumpipa kiangah pai ni; amah in na nuntakna hong suaktasak kha ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in a kawng uhah puanhampi tengin a lu uhah khauhual vialin Israel kumpipa kiangah pai uh a, "Na nasempa Benhadad in, 'Kong thum hi, kei hong nungtasak in,' ci hi," a ci uh hi. Amah in, "Amah nungta lai ahi hiam? Amah ka sanggam bang ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tu-in mite in a lim en cikin ama tung panin a theih uh ciangin, "Hi hi, amah nungta lai hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Pai un la amah hong paipih un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin ama kiangah Benhadad hong paikhia hi. Ahab in leeng tung ama kiangah Benhadad kahtosak hi.
Tua ciangin Benhadad in ama kiangah, "Ka pa in na pa' tung panin a lak khuapite kong piakik ding hi. Ka pa in Samaria-ah a bawl mah bangin Damaskas-ah nang a dingin sumbuk na bawl thei ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Ahab in, "Hih na thugente' hangin nang kong suaktasak ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in thuciamna khat amah tawh bawlin a ciahsak hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' thupiakna tawh kamsangte' tapate khat in a lawmte khat kiangah, "Hong sat in, kong thum hi," a ci hi. Ahih hangin a mipa in amah sat nuam lo hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a lawmpa kiangah, "Nangmah in Topa' thu mang lo na hih manin, kei kiang panin na paikhiat khit phetin humpinelkai khat in nang hong that ding hi," a ci hi. Ama kiang panin amah a kihepkhiat khit phetin humpinelkai khat in amah dawntuahin petlum pah hi.
Tua ciangin amah in midang khat mu a, "Hong sat in, kong thum hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin mipa in amah nakpitakin satin amah liamsak hi.
Kumpipa in a nawk laitakin kumpipa tungah amah kiko-in, "Na nasempa gal sungah kuan hi. Galkap khat in kei kiangah gal matsa mi khat hong paipih a, 'Hih mipa kem in; amah na taisuah leh ama nuntakna tangin nangma nuntakna hi ding a, ahih kei leh ngun talen khat na liau ding hi,' hong ci hi.
Na nasempa hih lai hua lai-ah manlahin ka om kalin amah na mang hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Nangma thukhenna bang hi ta hen; nangmahmah in na khentawm hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in ama kiangah, " Topa in hih bangin ci hi: 'Thah dinga ka seh mipa khah na hih ciangin ama nuntakna tangin nangma nuntakna, ama mite' tangin nangma mite pai ding hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa a inn-ah a lungkim lo, maikhingin pai a, Samaria a tung hi.
Tua laitakin Jezreel khuami Naboth in Samaria kumpi Ahab' kumpi inn gei-ah leenggui lo khat nei hi.
Hih thu teng khit ciangin Ahab in Naboth kiangah, "Ka inn tawh kinai ahih manin anteh huan dingin ka neih theih nadingin na leenggui lo hong pia in; keimah in tua tang dingin leenggui lo hoihzaw khat kong pia ding hi; ahih kei leh zong nang a dingin a hoihzawk ding leh a man ding sum kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jezreel khuami Naboth in ama tungah a thugenna hangin hehna le maikhinna tawh Ahab a inn-ah ciah hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, "Ka pu ka pate' gamh nang tungah kong pia kei ding hi," ci hi. Amah a lupna tungah lumin a mai hei a, an ne lo hi.
Ahih hangin a zi Jezebel ama kiangah hong pai-in, "An a ne lo zah dingin bang hangin na lungsim tua zahin heh ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in, "Keimah in Jezreel khuami Naboth kiangah thu genin, 'Sum tawh lei dingin na leenggui lo hong pia in; ahih kei leh zong, na lungkim leh tua tang dingin leenggui lo dang khat kong pia ding hi,' ka ci hi. Amah in hong dawngin, 'Nang tungah ka leenggui lo kong pia kei ding hi,' hong ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a zi Jezebel in, "Tu laitakin Israel mite a ukpa hi lo na hi hiam? Tho-in an ne inla, na lungsim nuamsak in. Keimah in Jezreel khuami Naboth' leenggui lo nangma tungah kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in Ahab' minin laikhakte gelhin ama min gelhna tawh tua laite tungah gelh a, ama khuapi sungah Naboth tawh a teng upate le uliante tungah tua laite a khak hi.
Amah in a laite sungah, "An tan' ding thu zasak unla, mite' lak a sangna munah Naboth koih un.
Ama mai-ah mi ginalo nih koihin ama langkhatah mawhna zong sakin, 'Nang in Pasian le kumpipa na samsia hi,' cisak un. Tua ciangin amah lakhia unla denglum un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin ama khuapi mi, ama khuapi sungah a teng upate le uliante in amaute tungah Jezebel' thupuak bangin hih uh hi. Amaute tungah a khak laite sungah a kigelh mah bangin,
amaute in an tan' ding thu zasak uh a, mite' lak a sangna munah Naboth koih uh hi.
Tua ciangin mi ginalo nihte hong pai-in ama mai-ah tu uh hi. Tua ciangin mi ginalo nihte in mite' omin Naboth' mawhna zong uh a, "Naboth in Pasian le kumpipa samsia hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in khuapi pualamah amah paipih uh a, suang tawh amah denglum uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Jezebel kiangah thu puakin, "Suang tawh Naboth kideng khinzo a, amah sita hi," a ci uh hi.
Jezebel in Naboth suang tawh kidengin a sihna thu a zak phetin Ahab kiangah, "Tho in; sum tawh lei dingin nangma tungah hong piak nop loh, Jezreel khuami Naboth' leenggui lo tang in; bang hang hiam cih le Naboth nungta nawn lo hi; sita hi," a ci hi.
Naboth a sihna thu Ahab in a zakphetin, a luah dingin Jezreel khuami Naboth' leenggui lo-ah a paisuk dingin a tho hi.
"Tho inla, Samaria-ah a om Israel kumpi Ahab a dawntuah dingin paisuk in. Naboth' leenggui lo a la dingin tua lai-ah amah om hi.
Nangmah in ama kiangah, ' Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "That khinin zong luahkhin na hi hiam?" ci hi,' na ci ding hi. Tua ciangin ama kiangah, ' Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Uite in Naboth' sisan a liahna munah uite in nangma sisan liak ding uh hi," ci hi,' ci-in gen in," a ci hi.
Ahab in Elijah a muh ciangin, "Ka gal pa aw, kei hong mu na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in dawngin, " Topa' muhna-ah a sia a gamta dingin nangmah kipiatawm na hih manin nang kong mu hi.
Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Nangma tungah siatna kong tungsak ding hi. Nang kong phiatkhia siang ding a, Israel sungah nangma mi sal le sal ahi lo mi pasal khempeuh ka beisak ding hi.
Kei nong hehsakna hang le Israel na khialhsakna hangin Nebat' tapa Jeroboam' innkuan le Ahijah' tapa Baasha' innkuan bangin nangma innkuan ka bawl ding hi.
Jezebel' thu zong Topa in genin, 'Uite in Jezreel khua sungah Jezebel ne ding uh hi,' ci hi.
Khuapi sungah Ahab' innkuan a si peuhpeuh uite in ne ding uh hi; gamlakah a si nangma innkuan peuhpeuh huihlak vasate in ne ding uh hi, ci hi," a ci hi.
Ama zi Jezebel in a hanthot Ahab bangin Topa' muhna-ah a sia a gamta dingin amahmah a kipiatawm mi kuamah dang om lo hi.
Topa in Israel mite' mai-ah a hawlkhiat Amor mite mah bangin milimte zui-in a kihhuai mahmahin a gamta hi.
Ahab in hih thute a zak ciangin a puante balkek a, a pum tungah puanhampi silhin, an tangin puanhampi tungah lum a, maikhingin a vak kawikawi hi.
"Keima mai-ah bangzahin Ahab a kiniamkhiatna na mu hiam? Keima mai-ah amah kiniamkhiat ahih manin ama hun sungin siatna ka tungsak kei ding hi. Ahih hangin a tapa' hun sungin ama innkuan tungah siatna ka tungsak ding hi," a ci hi.
Kum thum sung Syria le Israel gal kido loin om uh hi.
Ahih hangin a kum thumna kumin Israel kumpi Ahab kiangah Judah kumpi Jehoshafat va paisuk hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in a nasemte kiangah, "Ramothgilead eima a' hi a, eite pau loin omin Syria kumpipa' khutsung panin i lakkhiat lohna thu na thei uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Jehoshafat kiangah, "Ramothgilead-ah galsim dingin kei nong zui ding hiam?" a ci hi. Jehoshafat in Israel kumpipa kiangah, "Kei a kipan ka mite le ka sakolte nangma a' ka hi uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jehoshafat in Israel kumpipa kiangah, " Topa thu dong masa in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in kamsangte mihing zali bang khawmin amaute tungah, "Ramothgilead a sim dingin ka kuan ding hiam, ahih kei le ka thuak ding hiam," a ci hi. Amaute in, "Kuanto in; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in kumpipa' khut sungah hong pia ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in Jehoshafat kiangah, " Topa thu i dot theih nading, Imlah' tapa Mikaiah a kici mi khat omlai hi. Ahih hangin amah in kei' thu a hoih gen ngei loin a sia gen den ahih manin amah ka mudah hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Jehoshafat in, "Kumpipa in tua bangin ci kei in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in ulian khat samin, "Manlangin Imlah' tapa Mikaiah hong paipih in," a ci hi.
Samaria kulhpi lutna ancilna-ah Israel kumpipa le Judah kumpipa Jehoshafat a kumpi tokhom tung uhah tu-in kumpi puan tawh kizemin om uh a, kamsang khempeuh in amau' mai-ah thu gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin Khenaanah' tapa Zedekiah in ama a dingin sik kite bawl a, " Topa in hih bangin ci hi: 'Amaute na zawh matengin hihte tawh Syria mite na nawt ding hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Kamsang khempeuh in zong tua bangmahin genin, "Ramothgilead-ah kuanto inla gualzo in; Topa in kumpipa' khut sungah hong pia ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Mikaiah a sam dingin a pai kamtai pa in ama kiangah, "Thu kikhatin kamsangte' thugen pen kumpipa a dingin a hoihlam ahi hi. Amaute bangin nang zong gen inla, a hoihlamin gen in," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Mikaiah in, " Topa a nungta ahih mah bangin, Topa in kei tungah hong gen thu ka gen ding hi," a ci hi.
Kumpipa kiangah amah a tun ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Mikaiah aw, Ramothgilead-ah galsim dingin i kuan ding hiam, ahih kei le i thuak ding hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in dawngin, "Kuanto inla va gualzo ve. Topa in kumpipa' khut sungah hong pia ding hi ven'," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, " Topa' min tawh thudang gen loin thuman bek kei tungah nong gen nading bangzah vei hong thuhilh ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Tuucing a nei lo tuute bangin mualte tungah Israel mi khempeuh a kithehthang ka mu hi. Topa in, 'Hihte in makai nei lo hi; amaute lungnuam takin a inn ciat uhah ciah hen,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in Jehoshafat kiangah, "Amah in kei' thu a hoih gen loin a sia gen ding hi, nang kiangah hong ci khin hi lo ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mikaiah in, "Tua ahih ciangin Topa' thu ngai in: Topa a kumpi tokhom tungah tu-in, ama taklam le a veilamah vantung mihonpi a ding ka mu hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in, 'Amah kuanto-in Ramothgilead-ah a va sih nadingin kua in Ahab va zol ding hiam?' ci hi. Khat in thu khat genin adang khat in thudang khat gen hi.
Tua ciangin kha khat hong madawkin Topa' mai-ah ding a, 'Keimah in amah ka va zol ding hi,' ci hi.
Topa in ama kiangah, 'Bang lam tawh zol ding na hi hiam?' a ci hi. Amah in, 'Keimah paikhia-in, ama kamsangte khempeuh sungah a zuau kha ka va hi ding hi,' ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, 'Nangmah in amah a va zol ding na hi a, nangmah in na zo ding hi; paikhia inla tua bangin va hih in,' ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in en in, Topa in hih na kamsangte khempeuh' sungah zuaugen kha khat koih khin hi. Topa in nang tawh kisai-in a sia gen khin hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Khenaanah' tapa Zedekiah a nai-ah hong pai-in Mikaiah a paang bengin, "Nang' tungah thu a gen dingin Topa' kha in cikin kei hong nusia-in nang kiang hong tung ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mikaiah in, "En in, nangmah a bu dingin inndei nungah na pai ni ciangin na thei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in, "Mikaiah man unla, khuapisung a ukpa Amon le kumpipa' tapa Joash kiangah paipih kik un.
Tua ciangin, 'Kumpipa in hih bangin ci hi: "Hih mipa thong sungah koih unla, lungnuamin kei kong ciahkik matengin anletui tawmno cik bek tawh vak un," ci hi,' va ci un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mikaiah in, "Lungnuam takin nong ciahkik leh Topa in kei' tungtawnin thu hong gen lo ahi hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "A kuamah peuh in hih ka thugen za un," cithuah lai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel kumpipa le Judah kumpipa Jehoshafat, Ramothgilead-ah kuanto uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in Jehoshafat kiangah, "Kei ka mel seelin gal sungah kong kuan ding a, ahih hangin nangmah in na kumpi puante nong silh ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Israel kumpipa in a mel seelin gal sungah kuan hi.
Tu-in Syria kumpipa in ama leeng a uk mi sawmthum le nihte thu pia-in, "A neu ahi a, a lian tawh ahi zongin kido loin, Israel kumpipa bek tawh na kido ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Leeng a ukte in Jehoshafat a muh uh ciangin amaute in, "Israel kumpipa hi taktak hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah a do dingin amaute kihei uh hi; tua ciangin Jehoshafat awngkhia hi.
Israel kumpipa ahih lohna leeng a ukte in a theih uh ciangin amah a delhna panun amaute nungkik uh hi.
Ahih hangin mi khat in a thal mawk lot a, a galhiam awmdal thep kikalah lutin Israel kumpipa kha hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a leeng hawlpa kiangah, "Kei liam ka hih manin hong kihei inla, gal sung panin hong puakhia in," a ci hi.
Tua ni-in galkidona lian a, nitak a a sih dong Syria-te' lam maingatin a leeng sungah Israel kumpipa kingamin a om hi. A liamma panin a si luangte leeng taw lamah luangkhia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa si a, Samaria-ah kipaipih a, amaute in Samaria-ah kumpipa vui uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Samaria bual gei-ah a leeng sil uh a, Topa in a gensa thu tawh kizui-in uite in a sisan liak tumin numei paktatte tua sungah kisil uh hi.
Tu-in Ahab' gamtatna a omlaite, a hih khempeuh, ama lamsa saiha inn, le ama lam khuapi khempeuh, Israel Kumpite' Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi.
Tua bangin Ahab si a, ama tangin a tapa Ahaziah in uk hi.
Israel kumpi Ahab' kum lina kumin Asa' tapa Jehoshafat in Judah gamah uk ding kipan hi.
Gam uk dingin a kipatin Jehoshafat kum sawmthum le nga pha a, Jerusalem-ah kum sawmnih le nga sung uk hi. Ama nu' min Azubah hi a, Shilhi' tanu ahi hi.
Amah in a pa Asa' khekhap tawn a, tua lampi panin pial loin, Topa' muhna-ah a manin gamta hi. Ahi zongin mualtung a biaknate kilakhia lo a, mite in tuate tungah biakna pia lai-in paknamtui hal uh hi.
Jehoshafat in Israel kumpipa tawh zong kilemna a bawl hi.
Tu-in Jehoshafat' gamtatna a omlaite, amah in a lah a thahatna, le amah in a galdona, Judah Kumpite' Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi.
A pa Asa' hun lai-in a omlai pasal paktat pawlte amah in gam sung panin beisak hi.
Edom-ah kumpi om lo a, Judah kumpipa' khutnuai-a a huhpa khat in uk hi.
Jehoshafat in kham zongin Ofir-ah a pai dingin Tarshish teembawte bawl hi. Ahih hangin Eziongeber-ah teembawte sia ahih manin amaute pai lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Ahab' tapa Ahaziah in Jehoshafat kiangah, "Teembawte sungah nangma nasemte tawh keima nasemte paikhawm sak in," a ci hi. Ahih hangin Jehoshafat ut lo hi.
Tua ciangin Jehoshafat si a, David khuapi Jerusalem-ah a pate tawh kivui hi. Tua ciangin ama tangin a tapa Jehoram in a uk hi.
Judah kumpipa Jehoshafat' kum sawm le sagihna kumin Ahab' tapa Ahaziah in Samaria panin Israel tungah uk ding kipan a, amah in Israel tungah kum nih sung uk hi.
Topa' muhna-ah amah a sia gamta a, ama nu, le ama pa, le Israel a khialsak Jeroboam' khekhap mah tawn hi.
Amah in Baal na semin bia a, a pa mah bangin a hihna khempeuhah Israel Pasian, Topa hehsak hi.
Samaria-a a inndei tungnung innliim panin Ahaziah kia-in a liam hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in kamtaite sawlin amaute kiangah, "Pai un, hih natna panin ka damkikzo ding hiam cih thu Ekron pasian, Baalzebub kiangah va dong un," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Topa' vantungmi in Tishbe mi Elijah kiangah, "Ding in, Samaria kumpipa' kamtaite a dawn dingin paito-in amaute kiangah, 'Ekron pasian, Baalzebub kiangah thu a dong dingin na pai nadingun Israel sungah Pasian om nawn lo ahi hiam?' ci in.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in hih bangin ci hi: 'Nang pen tu-a na liamna panin na damkikzo nawn kei ding a, na si taktak ding hi, ci hi,' ci in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Elijah zong pai-in a gen hi.
Kamtaite zong kumpipa kiangah hong ciahkik uh a, amah in amaute kiangah, "Bang hangin hong ciahkik na hi uh hiam?" na ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in ama kiangah, "Kote a dawn dingin mi khat hong pai-in kote kiangah, 'Note hong sawl kumpipa kiangah paikik unla, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Ekron pasian, Baalzebub kiangah thu a dong dingin mi na sawl nadingin Israel sungah Pasian om nawn lo ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin tu-a na liamna panin na damkikzo nawn kei ding a, na si taktak ding hi,' hong ci hi," a ci uh hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, "Note a dawn dingin hong pai-in hih thute a gen pa a bangci mi ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amaute in amah dawngin, "Amah in samulpuan khat silh a, a kawngah savun kawnggak gak hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Amah pen Tishbe mi Elijah ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah mihing sawmnga a ukpa a mihing sawmnga tawh a sawl hi. Mual dawn khatah a tu Elijah kiangah amah paito-in ama kiangah, "Pasian' mipa aw, kumpipa in, 'Hong paisuk hen,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Elijah in mihing sawmnga a ukpa dawngin, "Kei pen Pasian' mi khat ka hih leh, vantung panin meikuang hong paisuk hen la, nang le na mihing sawmngate hong kangtum hen," a ci hi. Tua ciangin vantung panin meikuang hong paisukin amah le a mihing sawmngate a kangtum hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah mihing sawmnga a uk adang khat a mihing sawmnga mah tawh sawlkik hi. Tua ciangin amah paito-in ama kiangah, "Pasian' mipa aw, kumpipa' thupiakna hih bang ahi hi: 'Manlang takin hong paisuk in,' cihna ahi hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Elijah in amaute dawngin, "Kei pen Pasian' mi khat ka hih leh, vantung panin meikuang hong paisuk hen la, nang le na mihing sawmngate hong kangtum hen," a ci hi. Tua ciangin vantung panin Pasian' meikuang hong paisukin amah le a mihing sawmngate a kangtum leuleu hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in mihing sawmnga a uk a thumna pa a mihing sawmnga mah tawh sawl leuleu hi. Tua ciangin mihing sawmnga a uk a thumna pa paito a, Elijah' mai-ah hong pai-in khukdinin hong puk a, amah kunh-in, "Pasian' mipa aw, nangma tungah kong thum hi, keima nuntakna le nangma nasem hih mihing sawmngate' nuntakna pammaih sa-in hong hehpih in.
En in, vantung panin meikuang hong paisuk a, mihing sawmnga a uk a masa nihte a mi sawmnga tuak uh tawh kangtum hi. Ahih hangin ka nuntakna pammaih sa-in hong hehpih in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' vantungmi in Elijah kiangah, "Amah tawh paisuk in; amah kihta kei in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah dingin kumpipa kiangah amah tawh paisuk a,
tua ciangin ama kiangah, " Topa in hih bangin ci hi: 'Nangmah in Ekron pasian, Baalzebub kiangah thu a dong dingin kamtaite na sawl khin hi. Thudot nading Israel sungah Pasian om nawn lo ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin tu-a na liamna panin nang na damkikzo nawn kei ding a, na si taktak ding hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Elijah' gensa Topa' kammal tawh kizui-in amah si hi. Ahaziah in tapa nei lo ahih manin Judah kumpipa Jehoshafat' tapa Jehoram' kum nihna kumin, a sanggampa Joram ama tangin kumpi a suak hi.
Ahaziah' gamtatna a sepsa a omlaite, Israel Kumpite' Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi.
Topa in pingpei-in vantungah Elijah a lak ding lai-in Elijah le Elisha-te Gilgal panin inn zuanin lamkal a om ahi uh hi.
Elijah in Elisha kiangah, "Hih lai-ah khawl in, kong thum hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Bethel ciang dong kei hong sawl hi," a ci hi. Ahih hangin Elisha in, " Topa nungta a, nangmahmah na nuntak mah bangin, nang kong nusia ngei kei ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute Bethel dongah paisuak uh hi.
Tua ciangin Bethel-ah a om kamsang honkhat Elisha kiangah hong pai-in ama kiangah, " Topa in tuni-in nangma kiang panin na topa a lakkhiat ding na thei hiam?" a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Hi hi, ka thei hi; bangmah gen nawn kei un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah in Elisha kiangah, "Elisha aw, hih lai-ah khawl in, kong thum hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Jerikho-ah kei hong sawl hi," a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in, " Topa nungta a, nangmahmah na nuntak mah bangin, nang kong nusia ngei kei ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Jerikho-ah amaute tung uh hi.
Jerikho-ah a om kamsang honkhat in Elisha hong naihin ama kiangah, " Topa in tuni-in nangma kiang panin na topa a lakkhiat ding na thei hiam?" a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in dawngin, "Hi hi, ka thei hi; bangmah gen nawn kei un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah in ama kiangah, "Hih lai-ah khawl in, kong thum hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Jordan-ah kei hong sawl hi," a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in, " Topa nungta a, nangmahmah na nuntak mah bangin, nang kong nusia ngei kei ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute a nihun pai lai uh hi.
Kamsang mihing sawmnga in zong zui uh a, amau tegel Jordan gei-ah a din laitakun a kiang panun a gamla simah kamsangte a ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah in a puantualpi suahin zial a, tua tawh a tui sat hi. Lei keu tungah amau tegel a pai theih matengun a pang khat le a pang langkhatah a tui kikhen hi.
Amaute a galkah khit uh ciangin Elijah in Elisha kiangah, "Nang kiang panin kei hong kilak khiat ma-in nang a dingin kong hihsak ding na deih hong gen in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Elisha in, "Kong thum hi, kha thu-ah na vangliatna a zah nih hong luahsak in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "A haksa na khat nong ngen hi. Ahi zongin nangma kiang panin kei hong kilak laitakin kei nong muh leh nang a dingin tua thu hong piang ding hi. Ahih hangin kei nong muh kei leh tua bangin hong piang lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute a pai kawmkawm a kiho laitakun, mei leeng khat le mei sakolte in amaute nih a khen hi. Tua ciangin vantungah Elijah pingpei-in paito hi.
Tua ciangin Elisha in tua mu-in amah kiko a, "Ka pa, ka pa! Israel mite a hupipa! Nang pai ta maw!" a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in Elijah mu nawn lo hi. Tua ciangin Elisha in a dah manin a puan balkekin phel nih a suak hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Elijah tung panin a kiakhia puan tawm a, kilehin Jordan gun pangah a ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in ama tung panin a kiakhia Elijah' puan la-in tui sat a, "Elijah' Pasian, Topa koi-ah om na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in tui a sat khit ciangin a pang khat le a pang langkhatah a tui kikhen hi. Tua ciangin Elisha pai-in a galkah hi.
Tu-in Jerikho-ah a om kamsangte in amah a muh uh ciangin amaute in, "Elijah' vangliatna Elisha' tungah om hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amah a dawn dingin amaute hong pai uh a, ama mai leilakah amaute a kun uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in ama kiangah, "Tu-in en in, a thahat na nasem mihing sawmnga ka om uh hi; kong thum uh hi, kote hong paisak inla na topa hong zongsak in. Topa' kha in amah manin mualtung ahih kei leh guam sungah amah khia hi kha ding hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Na zong kei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in amah a maizum dongin a cih teitei uh ciangin amah in, "Pai un," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute mihing sawmnga a pai uh hi. Amaute in ni thum sung amah zong uh a, ahih hangin amah mu zo lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah Jerikho-ah a khawl sungin ama kiangah amaute hong paikik uh a, amah in amaute kiangah, "Note kiangah, 'Pai kei un,' hong ci hi lo ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tu-in khuapi mite in Elisha kiangah, "En in, topa in na muh bangin, hih khuapi omzia nuam hi. Ahih hangin a tui sia a, hih gamah kipung thei lo hi," a ci uh hi.
Amah in, "Hai thak khat hong paipih unla, a sungah ci koih un," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in ama kiangah paipih uh hi.
Tua ciangin tuinakah amah pai-in a sungah ci lawnin, " Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Hih tui a hoihin ka bawl khin hi. Tu-a kipanin sihna ahi a, tatolhna ahi zongin piangsak nawn lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Elisha' kampauna tawh kizui-in tuni dongin a tui hoih hi.
Amah tua lai panin Bethel-ah paito hi. Lampi-ah a paitoh laitakin khuapi panin naupangneu pawlkhat hong paikhia-in amah zahko uh a, "Paito in, nang lukolh pa" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah a kiimah khuadak a, amah in amaute a muh ciangin Topa' min tawh amaute a samsia hi. Tua ciangin gamlak panin vompi nih hong pai-in naupang sawm le nih balnen hi.
Tua lai panin amah Karmel Mual-ah paisuak a, tua ciangin Samaria-ah a ciahkik hi.
Judah kumpi Jehoshafat' kum sawm le giatna kumin Samaria sung Israel tungah Ahab' tapa Joram kumpi suak a, amah in kum sawm le nih sung uk hi.
Ama nu le ama pa zahin a siatloh hangin Topa' muhna-ah amah a sia gamta hi. Amah in a pa' bawlsa Baal biakna song koihkhia tei a,
ahi zongin amah in Israel a khialsak Nebat' tapa Jeroboam' khialhna mah pomlai hi; tua panin amah kihemkhia lo hi.
Moab kumpipa Mesha pen tuu khawi pa ahi hi. Amah in Israel kumpipa tungah kum simin tuuno tul zakhat, le tuutal tul zakhat' mul a piak ding ahi hi.
Ahih hangin Ahab a sih khit ciangin Moab kumpipa in Israel kumpipa lehdo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua laitakin Samaria panin kumpi Joram kuankhia-in Israel mi khempeuh khawm hi.
Tua ciangin amah pai-in Judah kumpi Jehoshafat kiangah thu zasak a, "Moab kumpipa in kei hong lehdo hi; Moab gam a sim dingin kei tawh nong kuan ding hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Kong kuan ding hi; keimah a kipan ka mite le ka sakolte nangma a' ka hi uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Koi lam tawnin kuan ding ihi hiam?" a ci hi. Joram in dawngin, "Edom gam lam tawnin i kuan ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Judah kumpipa le Edom kumpipa tawh Israel kumpipa a kuan hi. Amaute ni sagih sung a kual pai khit uh ciangin galkapte hitaleh amaute a zui ganhingte a' ding hitaleh tui om lo hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in, "Ala! Moab kumpipa' khut sungah a hong piak dingin Topa in ei kumpi thumte hong sam hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jehoshafat in, "Ama tungtawnin Topa' tungah thu i dot theih nadingin hih lai-ah Topa' kamsang om lo ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa' nasemte khat in dawngin, "Elijah a huhpa om a, Shafat' tapa Elisha ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jehoshafat in, "Amah pen Topa' kamsang man taktak ahi hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Israel kumpipa le Jehoshafat le Edom kumpipa ama kiangah paisuk uh hi.
Tua ciangin Elisha in Israel kumpipa kiangah, "Nang tawh bang kisai ka hi hiam? Na nu' kamsangte le na pa' kamsangte' kiangah pai in," a ci hi. Ahih hangin Israel kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Hilo hi; Moab' khut sungah hong piak dingin ko kumpi thumte a hong sampa pen Topa ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Elisha in, "Ama na ka sep Vanglian Topa a nungta ahih mah bangin, Judah kumpipa Jehoshafat thupi ngaihsutna nei lo hi leng nang hong en loin, zong kong mu kei ding hi.
Ahi zongin tu-in lasakna a tumsiam khat hong paipih in," a ci hi. Lasakna a tumsiam pa in a tum ciangin Topa' vangliatna ama tungah hong tung hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, " Topa in hih bangin ci hi: 'Hih a keu lui taw pen tuilite tawh a kidimin ka bawl ding hi,' ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in hih bangin ci hi: 'Huih ahi a, guah ahi zongin na mu kei ding a, ahih hangin nangmah in na dawn ding, na gan hon, le na ganpite in a dawn dingin lui taw pen tui tawh kidim ding hi,' ci hi.
Hih pen Topa' muhna-ah a thuneu khat ahi hi. Amah in Moab mite zong nangma khut sungah hong pia ding a,
nangmah in kulhpi a nei khuapi khempeuh, le khuapi deihhuai khempeuh zo-in, singkung hoih khempeuh phukin, tuinak khempeuh na khakcip ding a, leitang hoih khempeuh suangtum tawh na kidimsak ding hi," a ci hi.
A zingsang ciangin biakpiak hunin, gam sungteng tui tawh a kidim matengin Edom panin tui hong luang hi.
Amaute a sim dingin kumpite a kuantohna thu Moab mite khempeuh in a zak uh ciangin, a moipen panin a hampen dongin galhiam a tawi thei khempeuh kisamkhia uh a, gamgi-ah kikhawm uh hi.
A zing ciang zingsang tungin amaute tho-in, tui tungah ni a taan ciangin, Moab mite in amau' galkhatah a om tuite pen sisan bangin a sanin mu uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in, "Hua pen sisan ahi hi; kumpite khatlekhat kido-in, khatlekhat kithat hi taktak ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, Moab-te aw, vankinusiate va la ni!" a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Israel-te' giahphual ah amaute a tun uh ciangin, amaute' mai-ah a taikhiat matengin Israel mite hong kipanin Moab mite a do uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute mainawtin pai-in a paikawmun Moab mite that uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in khuapite lawnthal uh a, a suang in a khuhcip dongin leitang tung khempeuhah mi khempeuh in suang lawn uh hi. Amaute in tuinak khempeuh khakcip uh a, singkung hoih khempeuh phuk uh hi. Kirhareseth-ah a suangtumte bek a om dongin suanglotna a tawite in umcihin vatgawp uh hi.
Moab kumpipa in a lelhlam a kitheih ciangin, Edom kumpipa' san tak a phukhia dingin namsau tawi mihing zasagih a la hi. Ahih hangin amaute in phukhia zo lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in ama tangin a uk ding a ta upa pen la-in kulh tungah meihal biakna-in a pia hi. Israel mite in tua bangin a gamtatna a muh uh ciangin a lungsim uh sukha mahmah a, amau' kiang panin nungkikin a gamah a ciahkik uh hi.
Tu-in kamsang honte sung pan mi khat' zi Elisha' tungah kiko-in, "Na nasem ka pasal si hi. Na nasempa in Topa a zahtakna na thei hi. Ahih hangin ka tapate nih sila dingin a la dingin a leibatna pa hong pai hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Elisha in tua numei kiangah, "Nang a dingin bang hong hihsak thei ding ka hi hiam? Inn sungah bang nei na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Na nasemnu in sathau biing khat cih simloh inn sungah bangmah dang nei lo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "A pua-ah paikhia inla, beel hawm a tawm lua lo, na vengte khempeuh' beel va kawm in.
Tua ciangin sungtumin, nang le na tapate kong kikhaknelh unla, hih beelte khempeuh sungah sung in. Beel khat a dim simin tuamkoih pahpah in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ama kiang panin tua numei paikhia-in amah le a tapate kong kikhaknelh uh hi. Amah in a sun' laitakin a tapate in ama kiangah a beelte paipih uh hi.
Beelte a dim ciangin amah in a tapa khat kiangah, "Beel dang khat hong paipih in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin a tapa in, "Beel adang om nawn lo hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin sathau a luan a khawl hi.
Tua nu hong pai-in Pasian' mipa kiangah a thu teng gen a, tua ciangin amah in, "Pai in; a sathau zuakin na leibate loh in. Nang le na tapate, a omlaite tawh na nungta ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Ni khat Shunem-ah Elisha paisuak a, tua lai-ah a hau numei khat tengin tua nu in an ne dingin amah a sam hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in tua lam a nawk peuhpeuh ciangin an ne dingin tua lai-ah baang zel hi.
Tua ciangin tua numei in a pasal kiangah, "Tu-in en in, hih lai mun hong nawk tawntungpa pen Pasian' mi siangtho hi, ci-in ka thei hi.
Eite kiangah amah hong pai peuhpeuh ciangin a tuntheih nadingin innkhumzangah kawm a nei inndeineu khat bawlin tua sungah ama a dingin lupna khat, sabuai khat, tutphah khat, le meivak khat koihsak ni," a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Elisha in ama kiangah, "Tu-in tua nu kiangah hih bangin gen in: Thei in, kote a dingin hih haksatna khempeuh na thuak hi. Nang a dingin bang hong kihihsak ding deih na hi hiam? Kumpipa kiang ahih kei leh galkap a ukpa kiangah nang tangin thu khat peuhpeuh hong kigensak ding na deih a om hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in dawngin, "Kei pen ka mipihte lakah teng ka hih manin bangmah ka kisam kei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Tua bang ahihleh tuanu a dingin bang kihihsak thei ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Gehazi in dawngin, "Thu khat bek om hi. Tua nu in tapa nei lo a, a pasal teekta hi," a ci hi.
Amah in, "Tua nu sam in," a ci hi. Amah in tua nu a sap ciangin kongkalai-ah a hong ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "A hun hong tun ciangin tapa khat na tawi ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin tua nu in, "Hilo hi, ka topa, Pasian' mipa aw; na nasemnu tungah zuau kei in," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin tua nu in nau paii a, Elisha in ama tungah a gensa bangin a hun a tun kik ciangin amah in tapa khat a nei hi.
Naupang a gol ciangin ni khat a pa kiang anlate lakah a pai hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a pa kiangah, "Aw, ka lutang, ka lutang!" a ci hi. A pa in a nasempa kiangah, "A nu kiangah va pua in," a ci hi.

Tua ciangin amah inla van vawhin a nasempa kiangah, "Gan nawh in; kong gen kei nakleh kei a dingin a pai khiamsak kei in," a ci hi.

Amah a dawn dingin thakhatin va tai inla ama kiangah, 'Na dam hiam? Na pasal a dam hiam? Naupang a dam hiam?' va ci in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin tua nu in, "Hoih hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian' mipa kiang mualtungah tua nu a tun ciangin tua nu in ama khe len hi. Tua ciangin amah a sawnkhia dingin Gehazi hong pai hi. Ahih hangin Pasian' mipa in, "Amah tuaci omsak in; bang hang hiam cih leh amah nakpitakin lungkham hi. Topa in kei tungah a thu hong im a, kei kiangah hong gen lo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua nu in, "Ka topa' tung pan tapa hong ngen ka hi hiam? Kei hong khem kei in, hong ci hi lo ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in Gehazi kiangah, "Na kawng gak inla na khutah ka ciangkhut tawi-in pai in. Mi khatpeuh in nang hong hopih leh zong dawng kei in. Tua ciangin naupang' mai tungah ka ciangkhut va nga in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin naupang' nu in, " Topa nungta a, nangmahmah na nuntak mah bangin, nang kong nusia kei ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah dingin tua nu a zui hi.
Gehazi na mapai suakin naupang' maitang tungah a ciangkhut nga a, ahih hangin awging ahi a, nuntakna lim ahi zongin om lo hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah a dawn dingin hong kileh kikin ama kiangah, "Naupang khanglo nai lo hi," a ci hi.
Inn sungah Elisha hong tun ciangin amah in a lupna tungah a si-in a lum naupang a mu hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah bek lutin kong a kikhaknelh hi. Tua ciangin Topa' tungah thu ngen hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Gehazi samin, "Shunem numei sam in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in tua nu a sam hi. Tua nu ama kiangah hong pai ciangin amah in, "Na tapa la in," a ci hi.
Tua nu hong pai-in ama khe-ah pukin leilakah a kun hi. Tua ciangin a tapa la-in a paikhia hi.
Tua gam sungah kialpi a tun laitakin Gilgal-ah Elisha hong paikik hi. Kamsangte ama mai-ah tu-in thu a ngaih laitakin amah in a nasemte kiangah, "Beelpi suang unla kamsangte a' ding meh huan un," a ci hi.
Amaute khat meh zong dingin gamlakah pai a, vatak-um gui khat mu-in tua tung panin a ang dimin umgah lo a, tuate bang hiam cih thei lopi-in hong pai-in mehbeel sungah atnen hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in mite' nek dingin hong thukkhia uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute in meh a nek laitakun amaute kiko-in, "Pasian' mipa aw, an sungah gu om!" a ci uh hi. Amaute in ne thei lo uh hi.
Amah in, "Tua ahihleh a an tawm hong la un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in beel sungah tua an lawn a, "Amaute in a nek theih nadingin mite a dingin thukkhia un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin bangmah ci nawn lo hi.
Mi khat Baalshalishah panin hong pai-in Pasian' mipa kiangah anpal anlum, mangbuhham lum sawmnih, le anvui a thak a van sungah hong pua hi. Tua ciangin Elisha in a nasempa kiangah, "Amaute in a nek theih nadingun kamsangte tungah pia in," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a nasempa in, "Mihing za khatte' mai-ah keimah in hih bangci lui theih ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi. Ahi zongin amah in, "Amaute in a nek theih nadingun mite tungah tuate pia in. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in, 'Amaute in ne-in khamval ding uh hi,' ci hi," a ci kik hi.
Tua ciangin amah in amaute mai-ah tua an a lui hi. Tua ciangin amaute in ne uh a, Topa' gensa bangin pawlkhat a vallai hi.
Syria kumpipa' galkap a uk Naaman pen kumpipa' maipha a ngah ulianpi khat ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in ama hangin Syria mite gualzawhna pia hi. Amah a thahat a vanglian khat hi a, ahih hangin amah a phak ahi hi.
Syria mite in a galsimna khat uhah Israel gam panin numeino khat ciahpih uh a, tua nu in Naaman' zi na' a sem hi.
Amah in a tonu kiangah, "Samaria-ah a om kamsangpa tawh ka topa kimu thei leh! Amah in a phakna damsak ding hi," a ci hi.
Naaman in hih thu a zak ciangin sungtumin a topa kiangah, "Tua bang tua bangin Israel gam numeino in thu gen hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Tua ciangin Syria kumpipa in, "Tu-in pai in. Israel kumpipa kiangah lai khat ka khak ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah pai-in ngun talen sawm, kham shekel tulguk, le pawipuan sawm a keng hi.
Amah in Israel kumpipa tungah laikhak keng a, tua sungah, "Hih laikhak na ngah ciangin, ama phakna na damsak theih nadingin ka nasempa Naaman nangma kiangah kong sawlna thu thei in," a ci hi.
Israel kumpipa in a laikhak a sim ciangin amah in a puante balkekin, "Mi khat a phaknatna damsak dingin hih mipa in kei tungah hih thu hong puak nadingin a that ding le a nungtasak dingin kei, Pasian ka hi hiam? Ngaihsun dih un. Kei tawh kitotna ding a zonna thei un," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Israel kumpipa in a puante a balkekna thu Pasian' mipa Elisha in a zak ciangin amah in kumpipa kiangah mi sawlin, "Bang hangin na puante balkek na hi hiam? Israel sungah kamsang khat a omna thu amah in a theih nadingin tu-in kei kiangah amah hong paisak in," cisak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a sakolte le a leengte tawh Naaman hong pai-in Elisha' kongah a khawl hi.
Tua ciangin Elisha in ama kiangah kamtai khat sawlin, "Pai in la, Jordan gun sungah sagihvei va kisil in. Tua ciangin nangma cilesa a ngei hong bangkikin, nang na siang ding hi," cisak hi.
Ahih hangin Naaman hehin paikhia a, "En un, amah kei kiangah hong paikhia-in, ka gei-ah hong dingin, a Pasian a Topa' min loin, a natna mun tungah a khut vanin, kei miphak pa hong damsak taktak ding hi, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.
Israel tuite khempeuh sangin Damaskas gam a om Abana le Farpar gun tuite hoihzaw hi lo ahi hiam? Tuate' sungah kisilin siang thei lo ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah kihei-in paikhia hi.
Ahih hangin a nasemte a nai-ah hong pai-in ama kiangah, "Ka topa aw, kamsangpa in na lian khat a sem dingin hong sawl hileh sem ding hi lo na hi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin amah in nang kiangah, 'Kisil inla siang in,' hong cih ciangin na hih ding bangzah ta-in kilawmzaw hi lo ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian mipa' kamgen bangin amah paisukin Jordan gun sungah sagihvei kidiah hi. Tua ciangin a cilesa naupangno cilesa bangin a ngei bangkikin amah a siang hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian' mipa kiangah amah le a pawlte khempeuh kileh kikin ama mai-ah ding uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "En in, leitung mundang khempeuhah Pasian om loin, Israel sung bekah om hi, ci-in ka thei hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na nasempa tung panin letsong khat hong sang in," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in, "A na ka sep Topa a nungta ahih mah bangin, bangmah kong sang kei ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in a lakna ding kunh teitei a, ahih hangin amah in nial veve hi.
Tua ciangin Naaman in, "Tua ahihleh kong thum hi, na nasempa tungah la-sakol nih puakkhop leitang hong pia in. Bang hang hiam cih leh tu a kipanin na nasempa in meihal biakna ahi a, biakpiakna ahi zongin pasian dangte khat peuhpeuh tungah pia loin Topa' tung bekah pia ding hi.
Ahi zongin hih thu-ah Topa in na nasempa a mawhna hong maisak hen: Rimmon biakinn sungah a bia dingin ka topa a pai ciangin zui ding ka hih manin Rimmon biakinn sungah kei ka kunna thu-ah Topa in a nasempa hong maisak hen," a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Gehazi in Naaman nungdelh hi. Tua ciangin ama nungah mi khat hong taina Naaman in a muh ciangin amah a dawn dingin a leeng panin kum a, "Thu a hoihkim hiam?" a ci hi.

Kote Jordan-ah hong paisakin kote in singluang khat ciat la-in ka tenna ding uh mun khat ko hong bawl sak in," a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in dawngin, "Pai un," a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin amaute tawh amah a kuan hi. Jordan a tun uh ciangin amaute in sing phuk uh hi.

Amah in dawngin, "Amaute na that kei ding hi. Na namsau le na thal tawh loin galmatin na laksate that ding na hi hiam? Amaute in an ne-in tui a dawn khit ciangin a topa uh kiangah a ciahkik theih nadingun amaute' mai-ah anletui lui in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in amaute a dingin pawi lianpi khat bawl hi. Amaute in an ne-in tui a dawn khit uh ciangin amaute sawlkhia a, tua ciangin a topa uh kiangah amaute a ciah uh hi. Tua ciangin Israel gam a sim dingin Syria-te hong pai nawn lo uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Syria kumpipa Benhadad in a galkap buppi khawmin paito a, Samaria a umcih hi.
Amaute in a umcih hun sungteng, la lutang khat ngun shekel sawmgiat, gam lo-uih bul hai khat ngun shekel nga-in a kizuak dongin Samaria-ah kialpi lianpi a tung hi.

Tua ciangin amah in, " Topa in nang hong huh ding ahih kei leh koi lai panin nang hong huh ding ka hi hiam? An ahi a, leenggahzu ahi zongin nei ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in tua nu dongin, "Na lungkhamna bang ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in dawngin, "Hih numei in kei kiangah, 'Tuni-in amah i nek theih nadingin na tapa hong pia in; zing ciangin keima tapa i ne ding hi,' hong ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kote in ka tapa' sa huanin ka ne uh hi. A zing ciangin keimah in ama kiangah, 'Amah i nek theih nadingin na tapa hong pia in,' ka ci hi. Ahih hangin tua nu in a tapa na seel hi," a ci hi.
Kumpipa in tua numei' thugente a zak ciangin ama puante balkek hi. Kulhzangah kumpipa pai kawikawi a, mite khuadakin amah a et uh ciangin amah in a sung lamah puanhampi a silh mu uh hi.
