Levi mite sungah la makai Khenaniah inla uk ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in thei hi.
Berekhiah le Elkanah-te pen Thuciamna Singkuang a dingin kongcingte hi ding uh hi.
Siampite Shebaniah, Joshafat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zekhariah, Benaiah, le Eliezer-te in Pasian' Thuciamna Singkuang mai-ah peengkulte tum ding uh hi. Obededom le Jehiah-te zong Thuciamna Singkuang a dingin kongcingte hi ding uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David le Israel upate, le a tul-a a ukte, Obededom' inn panin lungdamna tawh Topa' Thuciamna Singkuang a paipihto dingin a pai uh hi.
Pasian in Topa' Thuciamna Singkuang a pua Levi mite huh ahih manin amaute in bawngtal sagih le tuutal sagih biakna-in a pia uh hi.
David in saihadial puantualpi silh a, tua mah bangin Thuciamna Singkuang a pua Levi mite khempeuh, le lasate, le lasate a uk Khenaniah-te in zong a silh uh hi. Tua ciangin David in siampipuan khat silh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel mi khempeuh in sakite le peengkulte, le daltuahte' awging tawh kizui-in awng kawmin Topa' Thuciamna Singkuang paipihto uh a, harp lasaknate le laiza lasaknate tawh nakpitakin la a sa uh hi.
David khuapi-ah Topa' Thuciamna Singkuang hong tun laitakin Saul' tanu a zi Mikhal in tawlet panin na en a, Kumpi David lamin a gualnuam-a a om a mu hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a lungsim sungah David a neu-et hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Pasian' Thuciamna Singkuang hong tumpih uh a, David in ama a dingin a lamsak puanbuk sungah koih uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in meihal biaknate le thunuama biaknate Pasian' mai-ah pia uh hi.
David in meihal biaknate le thunuama a biaknate a piak a man khit ciangin amah in Topa' min tawh mite thupha pia a,
Israel mi numei le pasal khempeuhte tungah anlum khat, sa bak khat, le leenggahkeu bek khat ciat a hawm hi.
Tua tham loin amah in Topa' Thuciamna Singkuang mai-ah na semin thu a ngen ding, lungdamna a ko ding, le Israel Pasian, Topa a phat dingin Levi mite pawlkhat a seh hi.
Asaf a ukpi hi a, ama zomah Zekhariah ahi hi. Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obededom, le Jeiel, harp lasaknate le laiza lasaknate a tum dingte ahi uh hi. Asaf in daltuahte a tum ding hi a,
siampite Benaiah le Jahaziel-te in Pasian' Thuciamna Singkuang mai-ah peengkulte a tum paisuak ding uh ahi hi.
Tua ciangin tua ni-in David in Asaf le a Levi mipihte in Topa tungah hih bangin lungdamkohna la a sa dingin a seh masa hi:
Topa' tungah lungdamna ko-in, ama min lo unla, ama septe khempeuh mite' lakah kitheisak un!
Amah la sak un. Phatna la amah sak unla, a lamdang a septe khempeuh mite tungah gen un!
Ama min siangtho hangin nuamin diang unla, Topa a zong mite khempeuh lungdam ta uh hen!
Topa le ama hatna zong unla, ama ompihna zong den un!
A lamdang a nasepte phawk unla, a lamdang ama genkhiat a thukhennate phawk un,
no ama nasem Abraham' suante, Jakob' suante, ama teeltuamte aw!
Amah, eite' Topa Pasian hi a, ama thupiaknate leitung khempeuh a' ding ahi hi.
Amah in a thuciamna phawk tawntung hi. Khang tul khat-a dingin a thupiakna kammal,
Abraham tawh a thuciamna, Isaac tungah a khapna,
Jakob tungah thu ciamin, amah in a kipsak, Israel tungah tawntung thuciamna-in a kipsak,
"Nangma tungah Kanaan gam hong pia-in, gamhluahin na tanh dingin kong pia ding hi," a cihte phawk tawntung hi.
Amaute a mi-in tawmin, gentaak loin peemta hi uh a,
minam khat pan nam khatah vak kawikawi-in, kumpi gam khat pan gamdang khatah a pai lai-un,
amaute kuamah nengniamsak lo hi. Amaute' hangin amah in kumpite taigawp a,
"Ka sathau nilhte lawng kei unla, ka kamsangte tungah siatna hih kei un!" ci hi.
Leitung mi khempeuh aw, Topa la sak un! A ni ni-in ama hotkhiatna thu gengen un.
Minam dangte lakah ama minthanna genkhia unla, a lamdang ama septe mi khempeuh lakah gen un!
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa lian mahmah a, nakpitakin phat ding ahi hi; pasian khempeuh sangin lamdang sakzawk ding ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh minam dangte' pasian-te milim hi lel a, ahih hangin Topa ahihleh vantungte a bawlpa ahi hi.
Pahtawina le minliatna in amah umcih a, thahatna le lungdamna in amah kimkot hi.
Leitung mi khempeuh aw, Topa theitel unla, Topa' minthanna le a thahatna theitel un!
Amah in a ngah ding a kilawm minthanna Topa' tungah pia un. Biakna puak unla, ama mai-ah pai un! Biakna puan silhin Topa bia un.
Leitung mi khempeuh aw, ama mai-ah ling un; hi hi, leitung kip mahmah a, kilok ngei lo ding hi.
Vantung kipak hen la, leitung lungdam ta hen; minam khempeuhte lakah, " Topa maang hi!" amaute in ci ta uh hen.
Tuipi le a sunga om khempeuh awng uh hen la, gamlak le a sunga om khempeuh lungdamin diang ta uh hen!
Tua ciangin gamlak singte in lungdamna tawh Topa' mai-ah la sa ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh leitung thu khen dingin amah hong pai hi.
Amah hoih ahih manin Topa' tungah lungdamna ko un; bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip a tawntungin a kho hi!
"Kote hong khahkhia in, kote hong honkhia Pasian aw, minam dangte lak panin kote hong kaikhawm in. Na min siangtho tungah lungdam kong koh theih nading uh le, nangmah phatna-ah ka minthan nadingun kote hong hon in.
Israel Pasian, Topa in thupha ngah ta hen, a tawntung pan a tawntung dongin!" zong ci lai un, a ci hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, "Amen!" ci-in Topa a phat uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in nisima a kisam bangin Thuciamna Singkuang mai-ah na a sem tawntung dingin Asaf le a Levi mipihte Topa' Thuciamna Singkuang mai-ah nusia a,
Obededom le a behte sawmguk le giatte zong a nusia hi. Jeduthun' tapa Obededom le Hosah-te pen kongpi cing dingte ahi uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Topa' thukham sungah a kigelh ama thupiak khempeuh bangin, zingsang le nitakin meihal biakna tau tungah Topa a dingin meihal biaknate a pia tawntung dingin, Gibeon-a om mual dawna Topa' biakbuk mai-ah siampi Zadok le a sanggam siampite a nusia hi.
Tuate' banah amaute tawh Heman le Jeduthun zong om a, ama itna kip kho tawntung ahih manin Topa' tungah lungdamna a ko dingin a kiteel, a minin a kilokhia midang omlai hi.
Heman le Jeduthun inla aw dingin peengkulte le daltuahte nei uh a, biakna lasak nadingin lasakna nate nei uh hi. Jeduthun' tapate kulhkongpi cing dingin kiseh hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh a inn ciat uhah ciah uh a, David zong a innkuante thupha a pia dingin a inn-ah a ciah hi.
Tu-in David a inn-ah a ten ciangin amah in kamsang Nathan kiangah, "En in, taamtak inn hoih sungah kei ka teng a, ahih hangin puanbuk nuai-ah Topa' Thuciamna Singkuang om lai hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Nathan in David kiangah, "Pasian in nang hong ompih ahih manin na lungsimah a om khempeuh hih in," a ci hi.
"Pai inla ka nasempa David kiangah hih bangin gen in. ' Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Nangmah in keima ten nadingin biakinn na lam kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel-te ka paipihtoh a kipan tuni dongin biakinn sungah ka teng kei a, puanbuk khat pan puanbuk khat, omna khat pan omna khatah ka pai kawikawi hi.
Israel mi khempeuh tawh ka painasa mun khempeuhah, keima mite tuu bangin a cing dingin ka sawl thukhente khat peuhpeuh tungah, "Bang hangin taamtak biakinn khat kei a dingin hong lamsak lo na hi hiam?" ci-in kam khat beek ka gen hiam?' ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in ka nasempa David kiangah hih bangin na ci ding hi. 'Vanglian Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Ka mi Israel-te tungah ulian ahi dingin lonona, tuu na zuihna panin nang kong la hi.
Na paina peuhpeuhah nang tawh kong omkhin a, na mai panin na galte khempeuh ka susia hi. Leitung miliante khat min bangin nang a dingin min khat kong bawlsak ding hi.
Amau' inn ciatah a ten theih nading le a kinawngkaisak nawn loh nadingin ka mi Israel-te a dingin mun khat sehin amaute ka phut ding hi. Ka mi Israel-te tungah thukhente ka seh a kipanin a nidanga bangin mi ngongtatte in amaute beisak nawn lo ding uh hi. Tua ciangin keimah in na galte khempeuh ka nuaisiah ding hi. Tua tham loin Topa keimah in nang a lianin hong bawlin, suanlekhak na neihna ding thu nang tungah kong gen hi.
Amah in kei a dingin biakinn khat hong lamsak ding a, keimah in ama kumpi tokhom ka kipsak paisuak ding hi.
Kei pen ama pa ka hi ding a, amah pen keima tapa hi ding hi. Nangma hun ma-a sem Saul' tung panin ka lakkhiat bangin nangma tung panin ka itna kip ka lakhia kei ding a,
ka mite le ka kumpi gam a kem dingin amah ka koih ding a, ama kumpi tokhom kip paisuak ding hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Hih kammalte khempeuh tawh kizui le hih maangmuhna khempeuh tawh kizui-in Nathan in David kiangah a gen hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi David tumin Topa' mai-ah tu a, " Topa Pasian aw, nangmah in hih ciang dong kei nong tunpihna kei kua hi a, ka innkuanpihte bang ahi hiam?
Hih a beisa thu pen nangma mitah na neu khat ahi hi, Pasian aw. Nangmah in a hong tung ding hunpi khat sung tang ding na nasempa' suanlekhak tawh kisai thu zong na gen khin a, mailam a khang dingte thu kei nong lak khin hi, Topa Pasian!
Na nasempa nong pahtawina-ah David in nang tungah bang gen ding nei nawn ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in na nasempa na thei hi.
Topa aw, na nasempa' hang, le nangma lungsim bangin hih na liante khempeuh na kitheihsakna-ah hih liatna khempeuh na hih hi.
Ka bilun ka zakna uh tawh kizui-in Topa aw, nangmah tawh a kibang kuamah om lo a, nang simloh Pasian dang om lo hi.
Egypt panin na hotkhiat na mite' mai-ah minam dangte hawlkhiatna tawh nang a dingin a lian a lauhuai min khat na bawlna, Pasian pai-in ama mi dingin a hotkhiat Israel-te tawh a kibang mi leitungah minam dang kua om ahi hiam?
Na mi Israel-te a tawntungin nangma mi ahi dingin na bawl hi. Tua ciangin Topa aw, nang pen amaute' Pasian na suak hi.
"Tu-in Topa aw, na nasempa le a suan a khakte tawh kisai-in na gensa thu a tawntungin kip hen la, na gensa bangin hong hih in.
Tua ciangin, 'Israel Pasian, Vanglian Topa pen Israel-te' Pasian hi,' ci-in nangma min a tawntungin kipin kiliansak ding a, na nasempa David' ukna nangma mai-ah kip tawntung ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nang ka Pasian in keima suante kumpi-in nong bawlsakna ding na nasempa tungah nong lak khinzo hi. Tua ahih ciangin na nasempa in na mai-ah thu nget ding hanna lungsim hong nei hi.
Tu-in Topa aw, nang, Pasian na hi a, na nasempa tungah hih na hoih na ciam khin hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in nangma mai-ah a kizop tawntung theih nadingin na nasempa' suanlekhakte thupha na piak ding nang hong lungkim ta in; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa aw, nangmah in thupha na piaksate a tawntungin thupha ngah ahi hi," a ci hi.
Hih thute khit ciangin David in Filistia mite zo-in nuaisiah a, Filistia mite' khutsung panin Gath le a khuaneute a la hi.
Zobah le Hamath gam kumpipa Hadadezer in Eufratis gun kuam gamte ngahkik nuamin hong kuan ahih manin David in amah do-in a zo hi.
Tua ciangin David in ama tung panin leeng galkap tulkhat, sakol tung tuang galkap tulsagih, le khe galkap tul sawmnih la hi. Tua ciangin David in leengkai sakol galkap khempeuh a zagui attatsak a, ahih hangin leeng zakhat a dingin a kicing a siit hi.
Zobah kumpi Hadadezer a huh dingin Damaskas a Syria mite hong pai ciangin David in Syria mite tul sawmnih le tulnih that hi.
Tua ciangin David in Syria gam Damaskas-ah khuacingte koih hi. Tua ciangin Syria mite David' nasem suak uh a, siah a puak uh hi. David a paina peuhpeuhah Topa in gualzosak hi.
Tua ciangin David in Hadadezer' nasemte in a puak kham kibawl lumte la-in Jerusalem-ah a ciahpih hi.
Tua ciangin Hadadezer' khuapite Tibhath le Kun panin David in sumngo tampi tak la hi. Solomon in tuate tawh sumngo tuikuangpi le khuampite le sumngo umlebeelte a bawl hi.
David in Zobah kumpi Hadadezer' galkap buppi a zawhna thu Hamath kumpi Toi in a zak ciangin,
Hadadezer simin a zawhna hangin a hopih ding le a lungdampih dingin Kumpi David kiangah a tapa Joram a sawl hi; bang hang hiam cih le Hadadezer le Toi kido zel ngei hi. Amah in kham, ngun, le sumngo tawh kibawl na namkim khempeuh puak hi.
Kumpi David in hihte zong, Edom, Moab, Ammon mite, Filistia mite, le Amalek, minam khempeuh kiang panin a puakkhiat ngun le kham tawh Topa' tungah a apkhawm hi.
Tua ciangin Zeruiah' tapa Abishai in Ci Kuam-ah Edom mite tul sawm le tulgiat that hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Edom-ah khuacingte koih a, Edom mite khempeuh David' nasem a suak uh hi. Topa in David a paina peuhpeuhah gualzosak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in Israel mi khempeuh uk a, amah in a mite khempeuh tungah thuman le thutang a zang hi.
Zeruiah' tapa Joab pen galkapte a uk hi a, Ahilud' tapa Jehoshafat pen thuciamteh pa ahi hi.
Ahitub' tapa Zadok le Abiathar' tapa Ahimelek siampite hi a, Shavsha lai-at pa ahi hi.
Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah pen Khereth mite le Peleth mite tungah a uk hi a, David' tapate pen kumpipa' nasepna-ah uliante ahi uh hi.
Hih thu khit tawlkhat ciangin Ammon mite' kumpipa Nahash si a, a tapa in ama tangin uk hi.
Tua ciangin David in, "Ama pa kei tungah thuman takin hong gamta ahih manin Nahash' tapa Hanun' tungah thuman takin ka gamta ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin David in a pa' huhau-in amah a hehnem dingin kamtaite a sawl hi. Tua ciangin David' nasemte amah a hehnem dingin Ammon mite' gam Hanun' kiangah hong pai uh hi.
Ahih hangin Ammon mite' uliante in Hanun' kiangah, "David in nang kiangah hehnemte hong sawlna hangin na pa a pahtawi hi, ci-in ngaihsun na hi hiam? Gam sung a pheklek ding le a lumlet ding le gam sung a ensim dingin ama nasemte na kiangah hong pai hi lo ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Hanun in David' nasemte manin a khamul uh metsak a, a kawng ciang uhah a puante uh atkhiatsakna tawh amaute daisakin a sawlkhia hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute kihem uh hi.
Hih mite tawh kisai thu David kiangah a kigen ciangin amaute a dawntuah dingin mi a sawl hi; bang hang hiam cih leh hih mite nakpi takin maizum uh a, ciah ngam lo uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Na khamul uh a khankik mateng Jerikho-ah om unla, tua ciangin hong ciah un," a ci hi.
Ammon mite in David' muhdahin amau mah a kibawl tawmna uh a muh uh ciangin Hanun le Ammon mite in Mesopotamia, Arammaakah, le Zobah panin leeng galkapte le sakol galkapte cial nadingin ngun talen tulkhat a puak uh hi.
Amaute in leeng galkap tul sawmthum le tulnih le Maakah gam kumpipa a galkap tawh cial uh a, amaute hong pai-in Medeba khua kiangah phual a sat uh hi. Tua ciangin a khuapite uh panin Ammon mite kikhawmin galsim dingin hong kuan uh hi.
David in tua thu a zak ciangin Joab le mi thahat galkap khempeuh a sawl hi.
Tua ciangin Ammon mite hong kuankhia-in khuapi lutna-ah galdo dingin hong pang uh a, a hong kuan kumpite in gamlakah panmun a la uh hi.
Gal in a nung le a mai panin a panna Joab in a theih ciangin Israel mi a kitengkhia mi pawlkhat teel a, Syria mite a do dingin pangsak hi.
A omlai a mite amah in a sanggampa Abishai' ukin koih a, Ammon mite a do dingin amaute kipangsak hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Syria mite ka lelhtuak leh nangmah in kei nong huh ding a, ahih hangin Ammon mite nang na lelhtuak leh keimah in nang kong huh ding hi.
Hang in; i mite a' ding le i Pasian' khuapite a dingin pasal tat ni; Topa in ama hoihsak bangin hong hih ta hen," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Joab le amah tawh a om mite in a do dingin Syria mite kiang hong naih uh hi. Tua ciangin ama mai-ah Syria mite tai uh hi.
Syria mite a taina Ammon mite in a muh uh ciangin tua bangmahin amaute zong Joab' sanggampa Abishai' mai-ah tai uh a, khuapi sungah lut uh hi. Tua ciangin Jerusalem-ah Joab hong ciahkik hi.
Ahih hangin Syria mite in Israel-te a lelhlam uh a kitheih uh ciangin, amaute in kamtaite sawlin Eufratis gal khata om Syria galkapte sam uh a, Hadadezer' galkapte a ukpa Shofak a makai-in koih uh hi.
David kiangah hih thu a kigen ciangin, amah in Israel khempeuh khawmin Jordan galkah a, amaute kiangah pai-in amaute a do dingin galkapte khawm hi. David in Syria mite a do dingin gal pangsak a, Syria mite tawh kido uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel-te' mai-ah Syria mite tai uh hi. Tua ciangin David in Syria mite' leeng hawl galkap mihing tulsagih, le khe galkap tul sawmli that a, amau' galkap a ukpa Shofak zong a that hi.
Tua khit ciangin Hadadezer' nasemte in Israel-te a lelhlam uh a kitheih uh ciangin amaute in David tawh kilemna bawl uh a, ama khutnuai mi a suak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Syria mite in Ammon mite huh nuam nawn lo uh hi.
Khuakhal sungin galsimin kumpite kuankhia zel uh hi. Tua bang hunhoih khuakhal hong tun ciangin Joab in galkapte kuan khiatpihin Ammon mite' gam sugawp a, hong pai-in Rabbah khua umcih hi. Ahih hangin Jerusalem-ah David om hi. Tua ciangin Joab in Rabbah khua vatin lumlet hi.
Tua ciangin David in amau' kumpipa' kumpi lukhu ama tung panin lakkhiatsak hi. Tua lukhu kham talen khat gikin a sungah suangmanpha khat a omna amah in thei hi. Tua hi a, David in tua lukhu ama lu tungah khu hi. Tua ciangin amah in tua khuapi van kinusiate tampi tak khat paikhiatpih hi.
Tua ciangin amah in tua sunga om mite paikhiatpihin singatnate le tuzumte le heite tawh na a sem dingin a koih hi. Tua bangin Ammon mite' khuapite khempeuhah David in hih hi. Tua ciangin David le mi khempeuh Jerusalem-ah a ciah uh hi.
Hih thute khit ciangin Gezer-ah Filistia mite tawh kidona hong om a, Hushah khuami Sibbekai in mithagolte' suanlekhakte khat ahi Sippai a that hi. Tua bangin Filistia mite kinuaisiah hi.
Tua ciangin Filistia mite tawh kidona omkik leuleu hi. Tua hi a, Jair' tapa Elhanan in a teipi kung siamlawngpi cia a pha, Gath khuami Goliath' sanggampa Lahmi a that hi.
Tua ciangin a khut langtuakah khutme guk a nei, a khe langtuakah zong kheme guk mah a nei, a vekpi-in sawmnih le li a nei, mi thalian khat a omna Gath-ah gal omkik hi. Tua mipa zong mithagolte' sung pana hong piang ahi hi.
Hih mi thumte pen Gath-a mithagolte sung pana hong piang ahi uh hi. David le a nasemte' khutin amaute puk uh hi.
Satan in Israel mite gimsak nuam ahih manin Israel mi phazah a sim dingin David hanthawn hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in Joab le galkap a ukte kiangah, "Pai un; Beersheba panin Dan ciang dong Israel mi phazah va sim unla, amaute a phazah ka theih nadingin kei kiangah thu hong zasak un," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Joab in, " Topa in a mite a zah za khatin behlap ta hen! Ka to kumpipa aw, amaute khempeuh ka topa' nasemte hi lo ahi uh hiam? Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin ka topa in hih kisam sa na hi hiam? Bang hangin Israel tungah mawhna tun ding na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in Joab thuzawh hi. Tua ciangin Joab kihemkhia-in Israel sung khempeuhah pai a, tua ciangin Jerusalem-ah hong ciahkik hi.
Tua ciangin Joab in David kiangah mite a kigawm khit ciangin a phazah a pia hi. Israel khempeuh sungah gal kap thei ding mihing awn khat le sang khat om a, Judah sungah gal kap thei ding mi tul za le tul sawmsagih om hi.
Ahih hangin Joab in kumpipa' thupiakna hoihsa het lo ahih manin a mi simna-ah Levi minam le Benjamin minamte hel lo hi.
Ahih hangin hih thu-ah Pasian lungkim lo a, amah in Israel-te vatgawp hi.
Tua ciangin David in Pasian kiangah, "Hih ka nasepna-ah nakpitakin ka khial hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in nang tungah kong thum hi; na nasempa' mawhna hong maisak in; bang hang hiam cih leh a haihuai mahmahin ka gamta kha khin hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in David' thumu pa Gad tungah thu gen a,
"Pai inla David kiangah, ' Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Nangma tungah thu thum kong pia hi. Nang tungah kong hih theih nadingin tuate khat teel in, ci hi,' ci-in gen in" a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David kiangah Gad hong pai-in ama tungah, " Topa in hih bangin ci hi, 'Na lak ding khat teel in:
Kialpi kum thum sung, ahih kei leh na galte in nang hong simgawp laitakin na galte mai-ah kha thum sung galtaina, ahih kei leh gam sungah pulnatna le Topa' vantungmi in Israel sung khempeuhah suksiatna ni thum sung a piangsak Topa' namsau,' ci hi. Tu-in kei hong sawl pa kiangah ka ciahpih ding dawnna ding khentel in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in Gad kiangah, "Keimah in lungkhamna lianpi khat ka tuak hi. Ama hehpihna lian mahmah ahih manin Topa' khut sungah hong puksak inla, mihing' khut sungah hong puksak kei in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in Israel tungah pulnatna khat tungsak a, Israel mi tul sawmsagih puk hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian in a susia dingin Jerusalem-ah vantungmi sawl hi. Ahih hangin amah in a suksiat ding laitakin Topa in mu a, tua thusia-ah amah kisik hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a susia vantungmi kiangah, "Phazo hi; tu-in khawl ta in," a ci hi. Jebus mi Ornan' ancilna gei-ah Topa' vantungmi a din laitak ahi hi.
Tua ciangin David khuadak to a, leitung le vantung kikalah Topa' vantungmi dingin, a khut sungah a kidoksa namsau khat omin Jerusalem tungah a zan mu hi. Tua ciangin David le a upate puanhampi silhin maipuk uh hi.
Tua ciangin David in Pasian kiangah, "Mi phazah a sim dingin thu a piapa keimah hi lo ka hi hiam? Khialin a gitloh gamtat mahmah pa keimah ka hi hi. Ahih hangin hih mite in bang gamtat khialhna nei ahi uh hiam? Topa ka Pasian aw, kong thum hi, keimah le ka innkuan gim hong pia in. Ahih hangin na mite tungah gimna tungsak kei in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David paito-in Jebus mi Ornan' ancilna phualah Topa a' ding biakna tau khat a lamna ding a gen dingin Topa' vantungmi in Gad sawl hi.
Ornan le a tapa lite in mangbuh a cilcil laitakin a khuadak uhleh Topa' vantungmi mu uh a, a tapa lite lau-in a bu uh hi.
Ornan kiangah David hong tun ciangin, Ornan khuadak a, David mu-in ancilna panin hong paikhia a, a mai leilam ngatin David tungah zahtakna a bawl hi.
Tua ciangin David in Ornan kiangah, "Mite kiang panin gimna a ven' theih nadingin Topa a' ding biakna tau khat ka lam theih nadingin na ancilna mun hong pia in. A man a cingin piak dingin hong pia in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Ornan in David kiangah, "La in; ko to kumpipa in hoih na sak bangin hih in. Meihal biaknate-a zat dingin bawngtalte, a sing dingin ancilna singte, le an tawh biak nadingin a mangbuhte kong pia hi. A vekpi-in kong pia hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Kumpi David in Ornan kiangah, "Hilo hi, a man a cing tawh kong lei ding hi. Topa a dingin nangma a' ka la kei ding a, keima sum bei loin meihal biaknate zong ka pia kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in Ornan' tungah a mun lei nadingin kham shekel zaguk a gik a pia hi.
Tua ciangin David in tua lai-ah Topa a dingin biakna tau khat lamin meihal biaknate le thunuama biaknate bawlin Topa' tungah thu ngen a, tua ciangin amah in a thungetna a piakna-in a meihal biakna a hal dingin vantung panin meikuang a piasuk hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' thupiakna tawh vantungmi in a namsau a pai sungah a siatkik hi.
Tua hunin, Jebus mi Ornan' ancilna phualah ama nget thu Topa in a piakna David in a muh ciangin amah in tua lai-ah a biakpiaknate a bawl hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Moses in gamlakah a bawl Topa' biakbuk le meihal biakna tau pen tua hunin Gibeon mual dawnah omlai hi.
Ahih hangin amah in Topa' vantungmi' namsau kihta ahih manin Pasian tungah thu a dong dingin tua lai-ah David pai ngam lo hi.
Tua ciangin David in, "Hih lai-ah Topa Pasian' inn om ding a, hih lai-ah Israel mite' meihal biakna tau om ding hi," a ci hi.
Israel gam sunga om gamdang mite a kikaihkhop nadingun David in thu a pia hi. Tua ciangin amah in Pasian' biakinn lam nadingin suangseeksate a bawl dingin suangseekte a koih hi.
David in kongpi kongkhak-a zat dingin siktukkilh le gak nadingin sik tampi koihin, teh zawh lohin sumngo tampi tak zong koih a,
taamtak singte simzawh hi lo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Sidon khuamite le Taia khuamite in David kiangah taamtak tampi tak puak uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh David in, "Ka tapa Solomon khangno-in pumpi tawh sinna om nai lo a, Topa a' ding a kilam biakinn pen gam khempeuhah minthanna le pahtawina-ah a lian mahmah ding ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua biakinn dingin keimah ka kigingkhol ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin David in a sih ma-in na tampi tak koihkhol hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a tapa Solomon sam a, Israel Pasian, Topa a dingin biakinn khat a lam ding a gen hi.
David in Solomon kiangah, "Ka ta aw, Topa ka Pasian' min dingin biakinn khat lam ding ka lungsimah om hi.
Ahih hangin kei' tungah Topa' thu hong tung a, 'Nangmah in gal lianpipi tampi simin mi tampi na that hi. Nangmah in keima mai leitungah sisan tua zahta luangsak na hih manin ka min dingin biakinn na lam kei ding hi.
En in, nangma sung panin tapa khat hong piang ding a, amah pen lungnopna a nei mi hi ding hi. Keimah in a kimkota a galte khempeuh panin ama tungah lungnopna ka pia ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ama min Solomon hi ding a, ama hun sungin Israel tungah lungnopna le daihna ka pia ding hi.
Amah in keima min dingin biakinn khat lam ding hi. Amah ka tapa hi-in, kei, ama pa ka hi ding a, Israel sungah ama kumpi tokhom ka kipsak paisuak ding hi,' hong ci hi.
Tu-in ka ta aw, amah in nangma thu a gensa bangin Topa na Pasian' biakinn na lamna-ah na tangtun theih nadingin Topa in nang hong ompih tahen.
Amah in Israel tungah nang hong uksak ciangin Topa na Pasian' thukham na zuih theih nadingin Topa in ngaihsut pilna le thutelna nang tungah hong pia tahen.
Tua ciangin Israel-te a dingin Topa in Moses a piak thukhamte le biakna ngeina kipte zuih ding na kidop nakleh na maavang ding hi. Thakhauh inla hang in. Lau kei inla lungkia kei in.
Nakpi taka hanciamna le gimna lianpi tawh Topa' biakinn dingin kham talen tul zakhat, ngun talen awn khat, le tehzawh lohin sumngo le sik ka koih khinzo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tam mahmah hi; sing le suang zong ka koihzo hi. Nangmah in hihte na behlap ding hi.
Nangmah in na a sem ding mi tampi na nei hi; suangseekte, leilesuang innlam siamte, khutsiamte, le simzawh lohin siamna nam khempeuh a nei,
kham, ngun, sumngo, le sik sep a siamte na nei ding hi. Kithawi inla sem in! Topa in nang hong ompih ta hen!" a ci hi.
Israel makaite khempeuh in zong a tapa Solomon a huhna ding David in thu pia a,
" Topa na Pasian uh note tawh hong om hi lo ahi hiam? Amah in na kiim khempeuh uhah lungnopna hong pia hi lo ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in gam sunga teng mite keima khut sungah hong pia khin a, Topa le ama mite' mai-ah gam sung khempeuh kinuaisiah hi.
Tu-in Topa na Pasian uh a zong dingin na ngaihsutna uh le na lungsim uh kipsak un. Topa' min dingin a kilam biakinn sungah Topa' Thuciamna Singkuang le Pasian' umlebeel siangthote a kipaipih theih nadingin kithawi unla Topa Pasian' biakinn lam un," a ci hi.
Tu-in David teekin kum tampi pha a, amah in Israel tungah kumpi-in a tapa Solomon a koih hi.
David in Israel makai khempeuh le siampite le Levi mite a khawm hi.
Levi mite kum sawmthum panin a tungsiah teng kisim a, a vekpi-in pasal tul sawmthum le tulgiat pha hi.
David in, "Hihte sung panin tul sawmnih le tulli in Topa' biakinn sungah nasep uk ding a, tulguk pen maangte le thukhente hi ding a,
tulli kongcingte, le tulli in phatna dinga ka bawlsa lasaknate tawh Topa tungah phatna pia ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in Levi mite a behbehin pawl thum suah a, tuate pen: Gershom pawl, Kohath pawl, le Merari pawl ahi uh hi.
Gershom' tapate: Ladan le Shimei ahi uh hi.
Ladan' tapate: A ukpi Jehiel, le Zetham, le Joel, thum pha uh hi.
Shimei' tapate: Shelomoth, Haziel, le Haran, thum pha uh hi. Hihte pen Ladan' beh lutangte ahi uh hi.
Tua ciangin Shimei' tapate: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, le Beriah ahi uh hi. Hih lite pen Shimei' tapate ahi uh hi.
Jahath a ukpi hi-in, Zina a nihna ahi hi. Ahih hangin Jeush le Beriah-te in tapa tampi nei lo uh ahih manin innkuan khat kisuak sakin sim khatin kisim khawm uh hi.
Kohath' tapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, le Uzziel, li pha uh hi.
Amram' tapate: Aaron le Moses ahi uh hi. Amah le a tapate in Topa' mai-ah paknamtui a hal tawntung ding le ama na semin ama min tawh thupha a piak tawntung theih nadingin a siangtho pen nate a ap dingin Aaron kituam koih hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian' mipa Moses' tapate ahihleh Levi minamte lakah kisim hi.
Moses' tapate: Gershom le Eliezer ahi uh hi.
Gershom' tapate lakah Shebuel a ukpi ahi hi.
Eliezer' tapa Rehabiah zong a ukpi ahi hi. Eliezer in tapa dang nei lo a, ahih hangin Rehabiah' tapate tam mahmah hi.
Kohath' tapa nihna Izhar' tapate lakah Shelomoth a ukpi ahi hi.
Kohath' tapa thumna Hebron' tapate lakah: Jeriah a ukpi, Amariah a nihna, Jahaziel a thumna, le Jekameam a lina ahi hi.
Kohath' tapa lina Uzziel' tapate lakah: Mikah a ukpi, le Isshiah a nihna ahi hi.
Merari' tapate: Mahli le Mushi ahi hi. Mahli' tapate: Eleazar le Kish ahi hi.
Eleazar in tapa nei loin si a, tanu bek nei hi. Amau' tanau, Kish tapate in amaute tenpih uh hi.
Mushi' tapate: Mahli, Eder, le Jeremoth, thum pha uh hi.
Hihte pen Topa' biakinn nasepna-ah na a sem ding, kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah, a milipin a minin a mi phazah zui-in a kiciamtehna bangin beh lutangte, a behbehin Levi suante ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh David in, "Israel Pasian, Topa in a mite tungah lungnopna piazo a, Jerusalem-ah amah om tawntung ta hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Levi mite in puanbuk hitaleh tua tawh kisai nasepna ding nate khat peuhpeuh hitaleh a puak ding uh kisam nawn lo hi," a ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh David' thupiakna a nunung pen tawh a kisim hihte pen kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah Levi mi a phazah ahi hi.
"Ahih hangin amaute' nasep ding pen Topa' biakinn nasepna-ah Aaron' suante huhin, biakinn tualte le biakinn deite kemin, biakna na khempeuh a siangtho sak ding, le Pasian' biakinn nasepna-ah hih ding khat peuhpeuh a sem ding uh ahi hi.
Ompihna Anlum, an tawh biak nadingin annel, silngo sawh loh anlum moh, a ki-em piakna, sathau tawh a kihel piakna, le a tam tehna ahih kei leh a lian tehna nasep khempeuh zong a huh ding uh ahi hi.
Tua ciangin amaute zingsang simin ding ding uh a, lungdamna ko-in Topa phatin, nitakin zong tua bangmahin hih ding uh a,
a mal zah a kisam bangin Sabbath nite, Khadet nite, le pawi nite-in Topa tungah meihal biakna a kipiak peuhpeuh ciangin a tawntungin Topa' mai-ah om ding uh hi.
Tua bangin amaute in kikhopna puanbuk le biakinn kemin, Topa' biakinn nasepna-ah amau' behte ahi Aaron' suante huh ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Aaron' suante a kisehkhennate hih bang ahi hi. Aaron' tapate: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, le Ithamar ahi uh hi.
Ahih hangin a pa uh a sih ma-in Nadab le Abihu si-in ta nei lo uh ahih manin Eleazar le Ithamar-te siampi suak uh hi.
Eleazar' suan Zadok, le Ithamar' suan Ahimelek' huhna tawh David in amau' nasepna-ah a kiseh bangin Aaron' suante a koih hi.
Ithamar' suante lak sangin Eleazar' suante lakah ukpi tam omzaw ahih manin, amaute in Eleazar' suante pawl sawm le guk suahin, Ithamar' suante pawl giat suah uh hi.
Eleazar' suante le Ithamar' suante lakah biakinn uliante le Pasian' uliante om tuak uh ahih manin amaute in a kibangin aisanna tawh amaute koih uh hi.
Tua ciangin Levi mi Nethanel' tapa ahi lai-at pa Shemaiah in kumpipa, uliante, siampi Zadok, Abiathar' tapa Ahimelek, siampite, le Levi mi beh lutangte' omna-ah amaute ciamteh hi. Eleazar' suante-a' dingin khat kiteelin, tua ciangin Ithamar' suante a dingin khat kiteel a, kilaihsak niloh uh hi.
Aisanna a masa pen Jehoiarib tung, a nihna Jedaiah tung,
a kuana Jeshua tung, a sawmna Shekaniah tung,
a sawm le khatna Eliashib tung, a sawm le nihna Jakim tung,
a sawm le thumna Huppah tung, a sawm le lina Jeshebeab tung,
a sawm le ngana Bilgah tung, a sawm le gukna Immer tung,
a sawm le sagihna Hezir tung, a sawm le giatna Happizzez tung,
a sawm le kuana Pethahiah tung, a sawmnihna Jehezkel tung,
a sawmnih le khatna Jakhin tung, a sawmnih le nihna Gamul tung,
a sawmnih le thumna Delaiah tung, a sawmnih le lina Maaziah tungah a tu hi.
Hihte in Israel Topa Pasian in amah a thupiak bangin a pupi uh Aaron in amaute-a' dingin a kipsaksa ngeina bangin Topa' biakinn sungah a pai dingin amau' nasep uh ahi a kiseh nasep nei uh hi.
Tua ciangin Levi suante a omlaite lakah: Aram' suante sung panin Shubael' suante Jehdeiah ahi hi.
Isshiah' suante sung panin Zekhariah ahi hi. Mikah' sanggampa pen Isshiah ahi hi.
Merari' suante: Mahli, Mushi, le Jaaziah ahi hi.
Merari' suante Jaaziah sung panin Beno, Shoham, Zakkur, le Ibri ahi hi.
Mahli in tapa nih, Eleazar le Kish nei hi. Eleazar in tapa nei lo a, Kish in Jerahmeel a kici tapa khat nei hi.
Mushi' tapate: Mahli, Eder, le Jerimoth ahi uh hi. Hihte pen a beh tawh kizui-in Levi' suante ahi uh hi.
Hihte in zong a behte uh ahi Aaron' suante mah bangin Kumpi David, Zadok, Ahimelek, siampite, le Levi mi beh lutangte' muhna-ah beh lutangte le a nau pasalte khat ciat in a kibangin aisanna tawh nasep tavuan a la uh hi.
David le nasepna ah a ukpite in zong laiza lasaknate, harp lasaknate, le daltuahte tawh Pasian thu a gen dingin Asaf, Heman, le Jeduthun-te' tapate pawlkhat nasepna-a dingin koihtuam uh hi. Na a semte le amau' nasepte:
Asaf' tapate sung panin: Kumpipa' makaihna nuai-ah Pasian' thu a gen Asaf' makaihna nuai-ah Asaf' tapate Zakkur, Josef, Nethaniah, le Asharelah ahi hi.
Jeduthun' sung panin Jeduthun' tapate: Lungdam kohna le Topa phatna-in laiza lasakna tawh thu a gen, a pa uh Jeduthun' makaihna nuai-ah Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, le Mattithiah, guk pha uh hi.
Heman sung panin Heman' tapate: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamtiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, le Mahazioth ahi hi.
Hihte khempeuh pen Pasian thuciamna bangin amah a pahtawi dingin kumpipa' thumu pa Heman' tapate ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in Heman tungah tapa sawm le li le tanu thum pia hi.
Amaute khempeuh Pasian' biakinn nasep nadingin Topa' biakinn sungah daltuahte, harp lasaknate, le laiza lasaknate tawh la lamsangah a pa uh ukna nuai-ah om uh hi. Asaf, Jeduthun, le Heman-te pen kumpipa' thupiakna nuai-ah om uh hi.
A Levi mipihte uh tawh Topa a' ding lasakna lamah sinna a nei a siam mi a vekpi-in zanih le sawmgiat le giat ahi hi.
Tua ciangin a neu a lian, sia le a sinte a kibangin, amaute in amau' nasep ding uh ai a san uh hi.
Asaf' behte a dingin ai masa Josef tungah tu hi. A nihna Gedaliah, a sanggamte, le a tapate, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A thumna Zakkur, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A lina Izri, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A ngana Nethaniah, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A gukna Bukkiah, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A sagihna Jesharelah, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A giatna Jeshaiah, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A kuana Mattaniah, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A sawmna Shimei, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A sawm le khatna Azarel, a tapate le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A sawm le nihna Hashabiah, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A sawm le thumna Shubael, a tapate le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A sawm le lina Mattithiah, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A sawm le ngana Jeremoth, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A sawm le gukna Hananiah, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A sawm le sagihna Joshbekashah, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A sawm le giatna Hanani, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A sawm lekuana Mallothi, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A sawmnihna Eliathah, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A sawmnih le khatna Hothir, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A sawmnih le nihna Giddalti, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A sawmnih le thumna Mahazioth, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung tu hi.
A sawmnih le lina Romamtiezer, a tapate, le a sanggamte, sawm le nih tung a tu hi.
Kongcingte a kisehkhenna hih bang ahi hi: Korah behte, Asaf' innkuan sung panin Kore' tapa Meshelemiah ahi hi.
Meshelemiah' tapate: Zekhariah a tacil, Jediael a nihna, Zebadiah a thumna, Jathniel a lina,
Elam a ngana, Jehohanan a gukna, Eliehoenai a sagihna ahi hi.
Obededom' tapate: Shemaiah a tacil, Jehozabad a nihna, Joah a thumna, Sakar a lina, Nethanel a ngana,
Ammiel a gukna, Issakhar a sagihna, Peullethai a giatna ahi hi.
Ama tapa upa pen Shemaiah sung panin zong a beh sungah ukte ahi tapate a suak hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute pen siamna lian a nei mite ahi uh hi.
Shemaiah' tapate: Othni, Refael, Obed, le a sanggamte siamna a nei ahi Elzabad, Elihu, le Shemakhiah ahi hi.
Hihte khempeuh pen Obededom' tapate le amau' tapate le a sanggamte uh tawh, nasep nadingin siamna a nei mi kician ahi uh hi. Obededom sung panin sawmguk le nih pha uh hi.
Meshelemiah in siamna a nei tapate le sanggamte, sawm le giat nei hi.
Merari innkuan sung panin Hosah' tapate: Shimri a ukpi (amah tacil ahih loh hangin a pa in a ukpi-in amah bawl hi),
Hilkiah a nihna, Tebaliah a thumna, Zekhariah a lina ahi hi. Hosah' tapate le a sanggamte khempeuh sawm le thum a pha uh hi.
Innkuan pasal lutangte pen kongcingte ahi uh hi. Amaute in a sanggamte uh tawh Topa' biakinn sungah nasep nei uh hi.
Amaute in a neu a lian a kibangin a pate uh innkuankuanin amau' kongpi cin ding ai san uh hi.
Nisuahna lama dingin ai, Shelemiah tungah tu hi. A tapa, a pil thulamlak pa Zekhariah a dingin zong ai san uh a, leilu lama dingin ai pha hi.
Obededom a dingin leitaw lamah hong suak a, a tapa tungah vankoihna inndei kipia hi.
Shuppim le Hosah a dingin lampi a paitohna, Shallekheth kongpi san, nitumna lamah kia hi. Galvil le galvil kimaituah uh hi.
Vankoihna inndei kongah nih nihin a om mah bangin nisimin nisuahna lamah guk omin, nisim mahin leitaw lamah li om hi.
Tua ciangin nitumna lama om lampi inn-a dingin a lampi-ah li omin a inn-ah nih om hi.
Hihte pen Korah mite le Merari' tapate lakah kongcingte a kisehkhenna ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Levi mite sung panin Ahijah in Pasian' biakinn vanmanpha koihnate le a ki-ap letsong koihnate uk hi.
Gershon-te beh sung panin Ladan pen innkuan tampi a piankhiatna mi khat hi a, Jehiel innkuante zong ama sung panin a piang ahi hi.
Jehiel' tapa Zetham le a sanggampa Joel in Topa' biakinn vanmanpha koihnate uk uh hi.
Amram mite, Izhar mite, Hebron mite, le Uzziel mite sung panin:
Moses' tapa Gershom-te beh sung panin Shebuel pen vanmanpha koihna a ukte lakah a ukpi ahi hi.
Gershom' sanggam Eliezer' suan Shelomith tawh zong beh kinai ahi hi. Eliezer' sung panin a tapa Rehabiah, a tapa Jeshaiah, a tapa Joram, a tapa Zikri, a tapa Shelomith ahi hi.
Hih Shelomith le a sanggamte in, Kumpi David, beh lutangte, le a tultul le a zaza-a uk uliante, le galkap a ukte in a ap uh ahi, a ki-ap letsongte a kikoihna khempeuh uk uh hi.
Gal sungah a ngah uh van kinusiate sung panin Topa' biakinn puah nadingin amaute in letsongte ap uh hi.
Thumu pa Samuel, Kish' tapa Saul, Ner' tapa Abner, le Zeruiah' tapa Joab in a apsate khempeuh zong, a ki-ap letsong khempeuh Shelomith le a sanggamte' kepna sungah om hi.
Izhar mite sung panin Khenaniah le a tapate pen Israel a dingin uliante le thukhente-in a pualam nasepna-ah kiseh hi.
Hebron mite sung panin Hashabiah le a sanggamte, siamna a nei mihing tulkhat le zasagih in Jordan nitumna lam Israel tungah Topa' nasepna khempeuh le kumpipa' nasepna-ah uk uh hi.
Hebron mite sung panin Jerijah a ukpi ahi hi. (David' uk a kum sawmlina kumin kikantelna bawl uh a, Gilead gam sung Jazer-ah amaute sung panin siamna lian a nei mihing kimu hi.)
Kumpi David in Jerijah le a sanggamte, siamna a nei mihing tulnih le zasagih, a beh sungah lutang ahite pen Pasian tawh a kisai na khempeuh le kumpipa' vaite-ah, Reuben mite, Gad mite, le Manasseh minam alangte tungah a uk dingin a seh hi.
Tu-in Israel mite, beh lutangte, a tul le a za-a a ukte, le khen khatah mi tul sawmnih le tulli a om, kum tawntung kha khat khit kha khat hong tungin a kuankhia a khente tawh kisai-in na khempeuhah kumpipa' na a sem a uliante:
A kha masa sungin Zabdiel' tapa Jashobeam a khen masa a uk hi a, ama khen sungah mi tul sawmnih le tulli om hi.
Amah pen Perez' suanlekhak hi a, a kha masa sungin galkap a ukte khempeuh a ukpi ahi hi.
A kha nihna sungin Ahoh-te beh Dodai a khen a ukpi hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi.
A kha thumna sungin siampi Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah a ukpi hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi.
Hih pa pen mihing sawmthumte sungah a thahat, mihing sawmthumte a uk Benaiah hi a, ama tapa Ammizabad pen ama khen a ukpa ahi hi.
A kha lina sungin Joab sanggampa Asahel hi a, ama nungah amah a laih dingin a tapa Zebadiah om hi. Ama khen sungah mi tul sawmnih le tulli om hi.
A kha ngana sungin Izrah-te beh Shamhuth hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi.
A kha gukna sungin Tekoa khuami Ikkesh' tapa Ira hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi.
A kha sagihna sungin Efraim suante sung panin Pelon khuami Helez hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi.
A kha giatna sungin Jerah mi sung panin Hushah khuami Sibbekai hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi.
A kha kuana sungin Benjamin mi sung panin Anathoth khuami Abiezer hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi.
A kha sawmna sungin Zerah mi sung panin Netofah khuami Maharai hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi.
A kha sawm le khatna sungin Efraim suante sung panin Pirathon khuami Benaiah hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi.
A kha sawm le nihna sungin Othniel' suante sung panin Netofah khuami Heldai hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih le tulli om hi.
Israel minamte tungah a ukpite: Reuben mite a dingin Zikri' tapa Eliezer ahi hi. Simeon mite a dingin Maakah' tapa Shefatiah ahi hi.
Levi mite a dingin Kemuel' tapa Hashabiah ahi hi. Aaron mite a dingin Zadok ahi hi.
Judah mite a dingin David' sanggamte' sung panin Elihu ahi hi. Issakhar mite a dingin Mikhael' tapa Omri ahi hi.
Zebulun mite a dingin Obadiah' tapa Ishmaiah ahi hi. Naftali mite a dingin Azriel' tapa Jeremoth ahi hi.
Efraim mite a dingin Azariah' tapa Hoshea ahi hi. Manasseh minam a langte a dingin Pedaiah' tapa Joel ahi hi.
Gilead gam sunga Manasseh minam alangte a dingin Zekhariah' tapa Iddo ahi hi. Benjamin mite a dingin Abner' tapa Jaasiel ahi hi.
Dan mite a dingin Jehoram' tapa Azarel ahi hi. Hihte pen Israel minamte' makaite ahi uh hi.
Israel mite vantung aksi zahin a tamin a bawlna ding Topa in thu ciam khin ahih manin David in kum sawmnih le a nuaisiah mite sim lo hi.
Zeruiah' tapa Joab in sim ding kipan a, ahih hangin zo man lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih thu hangin Israel tungah Pasian' hehna hong tung a, Kumpi David' khang tangthu sungah tua a kisimte kikhum lo hi.
Kumpipa' vanmanpha a ukte: Kumpipa' vanmanpha koihnate-ah Adiel' tapa Azmaveth ahi hi. Gam sunga vanmanpha koihnate, khuapi sungate, khuaneute le tausangte sunga omte tungah Uzziah' tapa Jonathan ahi hi.
Lo khawh nasep a sem mite tungah Khelub' tapa Ezri ahi hi.
Leenggui lote tungah Ramah khuami Shimei ahi hi. Leenggui lo panin a piang leenggahzu koihnate tungah Shifmoth khuami Zabdi ahi hi.
Shefelah gam sunga om oliv le theithek kungte tungah Gederah khuami Baalhanan ahi hi. Sathau koihnate tungah Joash ahi hi.
Sharon gam sungah a gamta ganhonte tungah Sharon khuami Shitrai ahi hi. Kuam sunga om ganhonte tungah Adlai' tapa Shafat ahi hi.
Kalaohte tungah Ishmael mi Obil ahi hi. La a nute tungah Meronoth khuami Jehdeiah ahi hi. Tuuhonte tungah Hagri mi Jaziz ahi hi.
Hihte khempeuh pen Kumpi David' neihsa a kemte ahi hi.
David' pano Jonathan pen thuthei mi le laithei mi ahih manin thu lamlak pa ahi hi. Amah le Hakmoni' tapa Jehiel in kumpipa' tapate cing uh hi.
Ahithofel pen kumpipa' thu lamlak pa hi a, Arkhi mi Hushai pen kumpipa' lawmpa ahi hi.
Ahithofel a sih ciangin Benaiah' tapa Jehoiada le Abiathar in laih uh hi. Joab pen kumpipa' galkapte a ukpa ahi hi.
David in Jerusalem-a Israel-te lakah zaneite, minamte sungah zaneite, kumpipa' na a sem a khente sungah uliante, a tultul a a ukte, a zaza-a a ukte, neihsa khempeuh le kumpipa' ganhingte le a tapate a kemte pen, kumpi inn-a zaneite, a thahat mite, le gal a hang tawntungte khempeuh tawh a khawm hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi David a khe-in dingto-in, "Ka sanggamte le ka mite aw, ka thugen hong za un. Topa' Thuciamna Singkuang a' ding le i Pasian' khengak nadingin tawlngakna biakinn khat lam ding ka lungsim sungah om a, a lamna ding ka kiging hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian in kei kiangah, 'Nang pen galhang khat hi-in sisan tampi luangsak na hih manin keima min dingin biakinn na lam thei kei ding hi,' hong ci hi.
Ahi zongin Israel Topa Pasian in Israel tungah kumpi ahi tawntung dingin ka pa' innkuan khempeuh panin kei hong teel hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in makai-in Judah teel a, tua ciangin Judah innkuan panin ka pa' innkuan teel a, tua ciangin ka pa' tate lak panin Israel khempeuh tungah kumpi-in kei hong bawl ding kei tungah amah lungkim hi.
Tua ciangin ka tapate khempeuh lak panin (bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in kei tungah tapa tampi hong pia hi) Israel-te a ukin Topa' kumpi tokhom tungah a tu dingin amah in ka tapa Solomon teel khin hi.
Amah in kei kiangah, 'Ka biakinn le a inntualte a bawl ding pa pen na tapa Solomon ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka tapa dingin amah ka teel khin a, kei pen ama pa ka hi ding hi.
Amah in ka thupiaknate le ka biakna ngeina kipte tuni-a mah bangin zuih ding a ngaihsut paisuak nakleh ama kumpi gam ka kipsak tawntung ding hi,' hong ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in note in hih leitang hoih nei-in note' khit na tate uh tungah gamh-in na nusiat tawntung theih nadingun Topa' mai-ah kikhopna ahi Israel khempeuh' muhna, le i Pasian' zakna-ah Topa na Pasian uh thupiaknate khempeuh zui-in zong un.
"Tu-in nang, ka tapa Solomon aw, na pa' Pasian thei inla, na lungsim khempeuh le utna lungsim tawh ama na sem in; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in lungsim sung zong a, ngimna le ngaihsutna khempeuh thei hi. Nangmah in amah na zon le nangmah in amah na mu ding hi. Ahih hangin amah na nusiat leh amah in nang hong paaikhia paisuak ding hi.
Biakinn dingin inn khat a lam dingin Topa in nang hong teel khin ahih manin tu-in kingaihsun in; thahat inla sem in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in a tapa Solomon tungah biakinn innliim, a innte, a vanmanpha koihnate, a dawl tungnungte, a dei sungnungte, le hehpihna tokhom a dingin inndei a geelna;
le Topa' inn a tualte a dingin a lungsim ah a ngaihsut khempeuh, a kimkot a inndeite khempeuh, Pasian' biakinn sung van manpha koihnate, le a ki-ap letsongte a' ding van manpha koihnate;
siampite le Levi mi a khente, le Topa' biakinn sungah nasepna khempeuh a ding; Topa' biakinn sungah nasepna ding umlebeel khempeuh a' ding,
nasepna-ah zat ding kham tawh kibawl umlebeel khempeuh a gihna, nasepna-ah zat dingin ngun tawh kibawl umlebeelte a gihna,
nasepna-ah meivakkhuam a kizat ciatna bangin kham meivakkhuamte le a meivakte a gihna, a meivakkhuam le meivakte a gihna zah ciat, meivakkhuam khat le a meivakte ngun a gihna,
Ompihna Anlum a dingin sabuai kham a gihna ciat, ngun sabuaite a dingin ngun a gihna,
le sikkeute, kuangte, le haite a dingin kham citak a gihna; kham haipite le a gihna ciat, ngun haipite le a gihna ciat;
a kisiangsaksa kham tawh kibawl paknamtui biakna tau ding le a gihna zah ding a geelna; a khate uh zakin Topa' Thuciamna Singkuang a khuh kherub-te' kham leeng ding a geelna zong a pia hi.
Nasep ding khempeuh geelsa bangin sep dingin hih thu tawh kizui-in Topa' genna bangin lai-in gelhna tawh amah in hihte khempeuh a siangin a hih hi.
Tua ciangin David in a tapa Solomon kiangah, "Thakhauhin hang inla sem in. Lau kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa Pasian, keima Pasian nangawn nang tawh hong om hi. Topa' biakinn sung nasepna khempeuh a kizawh matengin amah in nang hong tamasak lo ding a, hong nusia lo ding hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian' biakinn-ah nasep khempeuh a sem dingin siampite le Levi mi a khente om hi. Nasepna khat peuhpeuhah siamna a nei mite in nasepna khempeuhah nang hong huh ding hi. Uliante le mi khempeuh zong nangma thupiakna bangbangin gamta ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi David in a kikhawm khempeuhte kiangah, "Pasian in amah bek a teelsa ka tapa Solomon pen khangno-in pumpi tawh sinna om nai lo a, nasep ding pen lian mahmah hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih biakinn lianpi pen mihing a' ding hi lo a, Topa Pasian a' ding ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka Pasian' biakinn dingin ka hih theihzah ciang, phuh dingin onik suang, suangpak, mel tuamtuam a nei suang, suangkang, le suangmanpha nam khempeuh tampi takte banah kham zatna ding nate-ah kham, ngun zatna ding nate-ah ngun, sumngo zatna ding nate-ah sumngo, sik zatna ding nate-ah sik, le sing zatna ding nate-ah sing ka koih khinzo hi.
Tua tham loin, a siangtho biakinn a dingin ka koihte khempeuh banah, ngun le kham keima-a' mahmah zong om a, ka Pasian' biakinn ka ngaihsutna hangin ka Pasian' inn-ah ka piakte:
Kawm zut nadingin Ofir gam kham ahi kham talen tulthum, le a kisiangsaksa ngun talen tulsagih,
le siamneelte in a hih ding nasepna khempeuh a dingin kham zatna ding nate-ah kham, le ngun zatna ding nate-ah ngun ahi hi. Kua teng utna lungsim tawh Topa' tungah tuni-in amahmah kipia-in ki-ap ding na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin beh lutangte in utthu-a piakna bawl uh a, minam makaite, a tul tul-a a ukte le a za za-a a ukte, le kumpipa' nasepna-ah a uk uliante in zong hih uh hi.
Amaute in Pasian' biakinn nasep nadingin kham talen tulnga le kham darik tul sawm, ngun talen tul sawm, sumngo talen tul sawm le tulgiat, le sik talen tul zakhat a pia uh hi.
Suangmanpha a nei peuhmah in Gershon mi Jehiel' kepna sung, Topa' biakinn sung vanmanpha koihna-ah a pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin hih mite in utna lungsim tawh pia uh ahih manin mite lungdam uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in a lungsim khempeuh uh tawh Topa' tungah pia ziahziah uh a, kumpi David zong nakpitakin a lungdam hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a kikhawmte khempeuh' omna-ah David in Topa phat hi. David in, "Nang, Topa , ka pu uh Israel Pasian aw, a tawntungin thupha ngah ta in.
Topa aw, liatna, vangliatna, minthanna, gualzawhna, le min liatnate nangma a' ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh vantung le leitungah a om khempeuh zong nangma a' ahi hi. Topa aw, kumpi gam nangma a' hi a, tuate khempeuh tungah nang a lutangin hong kisangsak hi.
Hauhna le minphatna nangma kiang pan hong pai a, nangmah in na khempeuh tungah na uk hi. Na khut sungah vangliatna le minthanna om a, liatsakna ding le thakhauhsakna ding na khut sungah om hi.
"Ahih hangin kote in hih bangin utna tawh kong piak nadingun kei kua hi a, ka mite bang ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh na khempeuh nang kiang pan hong pai hi a, nangma a' mah nang tungah a hong pia ka hi uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka pu ka pate khempeuh uh mah bangin kote pen nangma mai-ah khualmite le pemtate ka hi uh hi. Ka hunte uh leitungah niliim bang hi a, sih ding ka pelh thei kei uh hi.
Topa kote' Pasian aw, na min siangtho pahtawi nadingin nang a' ding biakinn lam nadingin ka piaksa uh hih a tampite zong nangma khutsung panin hong pai hi a, a vekpi-in nangma a' mah ahi hi.
Nangmah in lungsim entelin thumanna-ah na lungkimna ka thei hi, ka Pasian aw. Lungsim thumanna le citna tawh hih nate khempeuh kong pia khin a, tu-in nang tungah citna le lungdamna tawh a hong pia, hih lai-ah a om na mite ka muzo hi.
Ka pute uh Abraham, Isaac, le Israel Pasian, Topa aw, na mite' lungsim sungah tua bang ngimnate le ngaihsutnate omsak tawntung inla, amaute' lungsim nangma lamah kai in.
Amah in a lungsim khempeuh tawh na thupiaknate, na teci pannate, le na thukhamte kemin a vekpi-in sem a, keimah in ka vaihawmsa biakinn lianpi amah in a lam theih nadingin ka tapa Solomon tungah utna lungsim guan in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in a kikhawmte khempeuh tungah, " Topa na Pasian uh phat un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin a kikhawmte khempeuh in a pute a pate uh Pasian Topa phatin a lu uh kun uh a, Topa bia-in kumpipa tungah zahtakna a bawl uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Topa tungah biakpiakna bawl uh a, a zing ciangin Topa tungah meihal biakna bawngtal tulkhat, tuutal tulkhat, le tuuno tulkhat, a leenggahzu tawh a biakna teng tawh, le Israel khempeuh a dingin biakpiakna tampi a pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in tua ni-in lungdamna lianpi tawh Topa' mai-ah pawi khamin a om uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in David' tapa Solomon kumpi-in a nihveina bawl uh a, amaute in Topa a dingin amah kumpi-in sathau nilhin, siampi dingin Zadok sathau a nilh uh hi.
Tua ciangin a pa David tangin Topa' phuhsa kumpi tokhom tungah kumpi-in Solomon a tu hi. Amah a dau pai a, Israel mi khempeuh in ama thu a mang uh hi.
Makaite khempeuh le a thahat mite, le Kumpi David' tapate khempeuh in zong Kumpi Solomon tungah a thuman ding uh thu ciam uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Israel mi khempeuh muhna-ah Solomon tungah minthanna lianpi pia a, Israel sungah ama ma-in kumpi khat peuhpeuh tungah a kipia ngei nai lo kumpi minliatna a guan hi.
Tua hi a, Jessi' tapa David in Israel khempeuh tungah a uk hi.
Israel tungah ama uk hun kum sawmli sung hi a, amah in Hebron-ah kum sagih sung, Jerusalem-ah kum sawmthum le thum sung a uk hi.
Tua ciangin a khangham, a ni cing, hauhna le minthanna tawh a si hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Solomon in ama tangin uk hi.
Tu-in Kumpi David' gamtatna a patna pan a tawpna dongin thumu pa Samuel' Khang Tangthu sung, kamsang Nathan' Khang Tangthu sung, le thumu pa Gad' Khang Tangthu sungah
ama ukna le ama vangliatnate khempeuh le ama tung le Israel tung, gam sung kumpi gamte khempeuh tungah a tung thute a kiciamtehna tawh kigelh khawm hi.
David' tapa Solomon in ama kumpi gam kho takin lenkip hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa ama Pasian in ompih a, a lian mahmahin amah a bawl hi.
Solomon in Israel mi khempeuh tung, a tultul le a zaza-a a ukte tung, thukhente tung, Israel sunga makai khempeuh tung, le beh lutangte tungah thu a gen hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon le amah tawh a om khempeuh, Gibeon-a a om mual dawna biakpiakna munah pai uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa' nasem Moses in gamlakah a bawlsa Pasian' kikhopna buk tua lai-ah om hi.
(Ahih hangin David in Kiriathjearim panin ama a dingin a bawlsak nasa munah Pasian' Thuciamna Singkuang paipihto khin hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Jerusalem-ah ama a dingin puanbuk khat lamsak khin hi.)
Tua tham loin Hur' tapa Uri, a tapa Bezalel in a bawl sumngo biakna tau pen Topa' biakbuk mai tua lai-ah om hi. Tua ciangin Solomon le a kikhawm mite in Topa thu dong uh hi.
Tua ciangin kikhopna bukah a om Topa' mai-a sumngo biakna tau-ah Solomon paito-in tua tungah meihal biakna ganhing tulkhat a pia hi.
Tua zanin Solomon tungah Pasian kilangin ama kiangah, "Nang kong piak ding hong gen in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in Pasian kiangah, "Nangmah in ka pa David tungah a lian le a kip itna na lak khin a, ama tangin kumpi-in keimah nong koih khin hi.
Topa Pasian aw, leitung leivui zahin a tam mite tungah kumpi-in kei hong koih khin na hih manin ka pa David tungah na thuciamna tu-in hong tungsak in.
Hih mite ka uk theih nadingin tu-in pilna le theihna hong pia in; bang hang hiam cih leh hih zahin a tam hih na mite kua in ukzo ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Pasian in Solomon dawngin, "Hih thu na lungsim sungah om a, nangmah in neihsate, hauhna, pahtawina, ahih kei leh nang hong mudahte' nuntakna hong ngen loin, a tungah kumpi-in nang kong koihna ka mite na uk theih nadingin nang a' ding pilna le theihna hong ngen na hih manin,
pilna le theihna nangma tungah hong kipia hi. Nang' ma-a kumpite kuamah in a neih ngei loh, nang' khit-ate kuamah in zong tua bang a neih loh ding hauhnate, neihnate, le pahtawina zong, nangma tungah kong pia thuah ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Gibeon-a om mual dawna biakpiakna mun, kikhopna buk mai panin Jerusalem-ah Solomon hong pai hi. Tua ciangin amah in Israel tungah a uk hi.
Solomon in leengte le sakol tung tuangte kaikhawm hi. Amah in leeng tulkhat le zali le sakol tung tuang mi tul sawm le tulnih nei a, leeng khuapite sung le Jerusalem-ah tuate a koih hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Jerusalem-ah suang bangin ngun le kham olsak a, taamtak singte pen Shefelah theithek sing bangin tamsak hi.
Solomon in gamdang panin sakol a lakna munte pen Egypt le Kue pan hi a, kumpipa' sumbawlte in a man ding pia-in Kue panin tuate ngah uh hi.
Amaute in Egypt panin leeng khat ciangin ngun shekel za guk-in la uh a, sakol khat ciangin za le sawmnga-in la uh hi. Tua bangmahin amaute in zuakkhiat kik dingin Hit kumpite le Syria kumpite khempeuh tung panin zong sakol le leeng a la uh hi.
Tu-in Solomon in Topa' min dingin biakinn khat le ama a dingin kumpi inn khat lam ding sawm hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Solomon in van a pua ding mi tul sawmsagih le mualtung gamah suang a to ding mi tul sawmgiat, le tuate a van dingin mi tulthum le zaguk a seh hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in Taia kumpi Hiram kiangah thu puak a, "Tenna ding inn khat a lam nadingin ka pa David tungah taamtak sing na puak mah bangin kei tungah zong hong puak in.
En in, Israel-te a dingin a tawntung a ding a kikipsaksa bangin, ama mai-ah a namtui nate ahi paknamtui halna ding, le Ompihna Anlum piak tawntungna ding, le Sabbath nite, Khadet nite, le Topa kote' Pasian a dingin a kisehsa pawi nite-in zing le nitakin meihal biaknate piak nadingin Topa ka Pasian' minin biakinn khat lamin ama tungah a ap ding ka hi hi.
Kote' Pasian pen pasian dang khempeuh sangin lianzaw ahih manin ka lam ding biakinn zong lian ding hi.
Ahih hangin vantung, a sang pen vantung nangawn in amah huam zo lo ahih manin ama a dingin kua in biakinn lamzo ding ahi hiam? Ama mai-ah paknamtui halna ding cih simloh ama a dingin biakinn a lamsak dingin kei kua ka hi hiam?
Tua hi a, tu-in ka pa David in a sehsa, Judah le Jerusalem-ah kei tawh a om nasep siamte tawh a semkhawm dingin kham, ngun, sumngo, le sik, le a ausan, a dupsan, puandumte, le nasepna-ah zong siamna a nei mi khat hong puak in.
Taamtak, taaksan, le cingsing zong, Lebanon panin hong puak in; bang hang hiam cih leh na nasemte in Lebanon sing phuk ding zia a theihna ka thei hi. Tua ahih ciangin kei a dingin sing tampi a sem dingin nangma nasemte pen keima nasemte tawh om ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka lam ding biakinn pen lianin lamdang ding hi.
Sing nasem sing a phukte a dingin a kisuvui mangbuh beem tul sawmnih, mangbuhham beem tul sawmnih, leenggahzu tambong tul sawmli, le sathau tambong tul sawmli ka hong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Taia kumpipa Hiram in lai-in thuk-in Solomon kiangah khak a, " Topa in a mite it ahih manin amaute tungah kumpi-in nang hong koih hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a lai sungah genthuah lai a, " Topa a dingin biakinn khat, le ama a dingin kumpi inn khat a lam ding, thutheihna le thutelna tawh a kidim mipil, David tungah a pia, van le lei a bawl Israel Topa Pasian in thupha ngah tahen.
Tu-in Dan minam numei khat' tapa, thutelna tawh a kidim, siamna a nei, siapa Huram kong puak hi. Ama pa pen Taia khuami ahi hi. Amah in kham, ngun, sumngo, sik, le sing, le a ausan, a dum, le a dupsan puante, le saihadial puan, le zepna nam khempeuh a sem ding le ka topa ahi na pa David' mi khutsiamte tawh a semkhawm dingin ama tungah a kipia nasep khat peuhpeuh a sem dingin siamna a neisa ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in ka topa in a gensa mangbuh le mangbuhham, sathau le leenggahzute, na nasemte tungah hong puak in.
Tua ciangin na kisap sing peuhmah Lebanon panin kong phuk ding uh a, nangmah in Jerusalem-ah na puaktoh theih nadingin phongin tuipi tungah Joppa dong nang kiangah kong paipih ding uh hi," zong ci lai hi.
Tua ciangin a pa David in mi phazah a sim mah bangin, Solomon in Israel gam sunga om gamdang mi phazah simna bawl a, mi tul zakhat le tul sawmnga le tulthum le zaguk pha hi.
Amah in van a pua dingin amaute tul sawmsagih, mualtung gamah suang a to dingin tul sawmgiat, le mite' nasep a van dingin tulthum le zaguk a seh hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in Jerusalem sung Moriah Mual tung, a pa David' tungah Topa a kilahna mun, David in a sehnasa mun ahi, Jebus mi Ornan' ancilna phualah Topa' biakinn lam ding kipan hi.
Amah in ama uk a kum lina a kha nihna sungin lam ding kipan hi.
Pasian' biakinn lamna ding Solomon' geelna hih bang ahi hi: A dung pi sawmkua hi a, a vai pi sawmthum ahi hi.
Inn mai-a innliim pen inn vai tawh kikimin pi sawmthum sau a, a sanna zong pi sawmthum mah ahi hi.
Amah in taaksan tawh innpi kawm dapin kham hoih tawh zut a, tua tungah nisuh le khainiang a bawl hi.
Amah in suangmanpha phutin a inn zem hi. A kham zatte Parvaim kham ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in a inn, a innsunte, a sangkilte, a kawmte, le a kongkhakte kham tawh zut a, tua ciangin a kawmte tungah kherub-te a bawl hi.
Tua ciangin amah in siangtho pen mun bawl hi. A dung pen a vai tawh kizui-in pi sawmthum hi a, a vai zong pi sawmthum mah ahi hi. Amah in kham hoih talen zaguk tawh a zut hi.
A kilhnate a gihna kham shekel sawmnga ahi hi. Tua ciangin amah in a inn dawl tungnungte kham tawh a zut hi.
Tua kherub tegel' kha a kizalin pi sawmthum ahi hi. A khat' kha pen pi sagih le alang hi-in inn kawm ban a, tua ciangin alang khat pi sagih le alang in a kherub dang khat' kha ban hi.
Tua mah bangin a kherub dang khat' kha langkhat zong pi sagih le alang hi-in inn kawm langkhat ban a, pi sagih le alang mah a sau a kha langkhat pen a kherub masa' kha tawh kizom hi.
Hih kherub-te' khate in pi sawmthum huam hi. Kherub-te amau' khe-in dingin innpi sunglam nga uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a dum, a ausan, le a dupsan puante, le saihadial puan tawh a dalna puan bawl a, tua tungah kherub-te a bawl hi.
Amah in inn mai sanah pi sawmnga le pi nih le alang a sang, a dawn tuakah pi sagih le alang a pha khuamluzepna a nei khuampi nih bawl hi.
Amah in ngawng a awhte bangin khainiangte bawlin khuampite dawnah khai hi. Tua ciangin amah in mang kawlsing zakhat bawlin khainiangte tungah koih hi.
Amah in tua khuamte, khat leitaw lam, a khat leilu lam, biakinn mai-ah phut hi. Amah in leitaw lama om pen Jakhin phuakin, leilu lama om pen Boaz a phuak hi.
Amah in sumngo biakna tau, a dung pi sawmthum, a vai pi sawmthum, a sang pi sawm le nga a pha khat bawl hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a kisung tuikuangpi khat zong bawl hi. Tua pen a bem hi a, a gei khat pan a gei khat dong pi sawm le nga pha-in, pi sagih le alang sang a, a kimkot pi sawmli le nga a pha hi.
Tuikuangpi pualam kimkot pi sawmlinga sungah umgah limte om hi. Tua um gahte gual nihin om a, tuikuangpi a kisunin kisungkhawm pah hi.
Bawngtal sawm le nihte tungah tua tuikuangpi kinga a, thum leilu lam nga a, thum nitumna lam nga-in, thum leitaw lam nga a, thum nisuahna lam nga hi. Tuate tungah a tuikuangpi kinga a, a nunglam uh a sunglamah om hi.
A sahna pen khutpeek mai cia ahi hi; a geivial pen unok tawh a kibang hai geivial bangin kibawl a, tua sungah tui tambong tulguk val ta hi.
Amah in kisilna ding tuikuang dang sawm zong bawl a, leitaw lamah nga, leilu lamah nga a koih hi. Amaute in meihal biakna-a a zatte uh hihte sungah silsiang ding uh a, tuikuangpi pen siampite' kisilna ding ahi hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a kigelhsa bangin kham meivakkhuam sawm bawl a, biakinn sung leitaw lamah nga, leilu lamah nga a koih hi.
Amah in sabuai sawm zong bawl a, biakinn sung leitaw lampangah nga, leilu lampangah nga koih hi. Tua ciangin amah in kham kuang zakhat bawl hi.
Amah in siampite' inntual, le inntual lian, le inntual kongkhakte bawl a, a kongkhakte sumngo tawh a zut hi.
Huram in beelte, kawbiate, le kuangte zong bawl hi. Tua ahih ciangin Huram in Kumpi Solomon a dingin Pasian' biakinn a bawl nasep a zawhte:
Khuampi nihte, kuang-ukte, le a khuampite lu dawnah a om khuamluzepna nihte, khuampite lu dawnah a om khuamluzepna, kuang-uk nihte a tuam dingin ngen bangin a kibawl nihte,
khuampite tungah a om khuamluzepna kuang-uk nihte a tuam dingin ngen banga kibawl khat a dingin mang kawlsing gual nih ahi ngen banga kibawl nihte a dingin mang kawlsing za lite,
tuikuang a kingaknate le tuate tungah a kikoih tuikuangte,
tuikuangpi khat, le tua nuai-a a om bawngtal sawm le nihte,
Topa' biakinn dingin Kumpi Solomon a dingin siapa Huram in a kihal sumngo tawh a bawl beelte, kawbiate, sikkeukate, le hihte a dingin nazat khempeuh ahi hi.
Jordan zanglei sung Sukkoth le Zeredah kikal beel lei-ah kumpipa in hihte sungsak hi.
Solomon in hih nate tampi tak bawlsak a, sumngo a gikzah kithei zo lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Solomon in Pasian' biakinn sunga na khempeuh a bawl sakte: Kham biakna tau, Ompihna Anlum a dingin sabuaite,
a kigelhsa bangin biakinn sungnung mai-ah vak dingin kham citak meivakkhuamte le a meivakte;
kham hoih pen tawh a kibawl a paakte, a meivakte, le a tehte;
kham citak tawh a kibawl a taitehte, kuangte, paknamtui a dingin pakante, le vutluahna ahi hi. Siangtho pen mun pai nading kongkhak sungnungte a' ding le biakinnpi sung kongkhakte a dingin biakinn kongkhak bilte zong kham tawh a kibawl ahi hi.
Tua bangin Topa' biakinn ding a hih nasep khempeuh kizo hi. Tua ciangin a pa David in a apsa nate Solomon in paipihin, Pasian' biakinn sung vanmanpha koihnate sungah a ngunte, a khamte, le umlebeel khempeuh a seng hi.
Tua ciangin Zion a kici David khuapi sung panin Topa' Thuciamna Singkuang a paipihto dingin Kumpi Solomon in Israel upate, minam lutang khempeuh, le Israel beh makaite, Jerusalem-ah kaikhawm hi.
Tua ciangin a kha sagihna-a pawi hun sungin kumpipa' mai-ah Israel mi khempeuh kikhawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel upate khempeuh hong pai uh a, Levi mite in Thuciamna Singkuang la uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Thuciamna Singkuang, le kikhopna buk, le puanbuk sunga om a siangtho umlebeel khempeuh puato uh a, siampite le Levi mite in tuate puato uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Solomon le ama mai-ah a kikhawm Israel-te khempeuh Thuciamna Singkuang mai-ah om uh a, biakna-in tuu le bawngtal tampi tak pia uh ahih manin a phazah kisim zo lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin siampite in kherub-te' kha nuai, siangtho pen mun sung, biakinn sungnung sung ama munah Topa' Thuciamna Singkuang a paipih uh hi.
Kherub-te in Thuciamna Singkuang tungah a khate uh zak uh ahih manin kherub-te pen Thuciamna Singkuang le a zawlte tungah khuhna khat a suak uh hi.
A zawlte sau ahih manin siangtho mun panin biakinn sungnung mai-ah a mongte kidawk a, ahih hangin a pualam panin kimu thei lo hi; tuni dongin tua lai-ah tuate om hi.
Egypt panin amaute hong paikhiat lai-in Topa in Israel mite tawh thuciamna a bawlna mun Horeb-ah Moses in suangpek nihte a koih simloh Thuciamna Singkuang sungah bangmah dang om lo hi.
Siangtho mun panin siampite hong pusuakin (bang hang hiam cih leh amau' pawlte cihtuam om loin tua lai-a om siampite khempeuh amau mahmah kisiansuah uh hi.
Tua ciangin Levi mi lasate Asaf, Heman, le Jeduthun, amau' tapate le a behte, saihadial puan tawh kizemin, daltuahte, harp lasaknate, le laiza lasaknate tawi-in peengkul tum siampite za le sawmnih tawh biakna tau nisuahna lamah ding khawm uh hi.
Aw kikhatin phatin Topa' tungah lungdam koh ding pen peengkul tumte le lasate' nasep ahi hi) peengkulte le daltuahte le adang lasaknate tawh, " Topa' tungah lungdam koh ding hoih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi," ci-in Topa phatna-in la a kisak ciangin, Topa' biakinn sung meii tawh kidim a,
meii hangin siampite in na sem zo lo uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa' minthanna vangtaang Pasian' biakinn sung a dim hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in, "Khuamial sahpi sungah ten ding a teel Topa aw,
a tawntungin na tenna ding a lian biakinn khat hih lai-ah kong lamsak khin hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in en kawikawi a, Israel mi a kikhawmte khempeuh a din laitakin amaute khempeuh thupha a pia hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, 'Egypt gam panin ka mite ka paikhiatpih ni a kipanin keima min a om nadingin Israel minam khempeuh sungah biakinn khat lamna ding khuapi khat zong ka teel kei a, keima mi Israel tungah kumpi dingin mi khat zong ka teel kei hi. Ahih hangin tu-in ka min a om theih nadingin Jerusalem teelin ka mi Israel-te tungah a uk dingin David ka teel khinta hi,' ci-in genin, ka pa David tungah a kam tawh a thuciamna a khut tawh a tungsak Israel Pasian, Topa in thupha ngah tahen.
"Tu-in Israel Pasian, Topa' min dingin biakinn khat lam ding ka pa David' lungsim sungah om hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in ka pa David tungah, 'Na lungsimah keima min dingin biakinn khat lam ding na ngaihsun a, tua na ngaihsutna hoih mahmah hi.
Ahi zongin keima min dingin tua biakinn a lam ding pa nangmah hi loin, nangma sung pan hong piang ding na tapa hizaw ding hi,' ci hi.
"Tu-in Topa in a bawlsa thuciamna tungsak khin hi; bang hang hiam cih le Topa' thuciam bangin ka pa David munah hong khangin Israel kumpi tokhomah kong tu a, Israel Pasian, Topa' min dingin biakinn ka lam khin hi.
Amah in Israel mite tawh a bawl Topa' thuciamna a kikoihna Thuciamna Singkuang tu-in tua lai-ah ka koih khin hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel a kikhawmte khempeuh' omna Topa' biakna tau mai-ah Solomon dingin a khut zan hi.
Solomon in a dung pi sagih le alang, a vai pi sagih le alang, a sang pi li le alang a pha sumngo tau khat bawlin inntualah a koih khin hi. Tua ciangin tua tungah amah ding hi. Tua ciangin Israel a kikhawmte khempeuh' muhin amah khukdinin van lamah a khut zan hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in thu ngen a, "Israel Pasian, Topa aw, vantungah ahi a, leitungah ahi zongin thuciamna lenin a lungsim khempeuh uh tawh nangma thu hong mang na nasemte tungah itna kip a lak, nang tawh a kibang Pasian dang om lo hi.
Ama tungah na gensa bangin na nasem ka pa David tungah a tungsak pa na hi hi. Na kam tawh thu na gen a, na khut tawh tuni-in na tungsak takpi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in Israel Pasian, Topa aw, ama tungah thu ciamin, 'Keima thu na hong man' bangin na suan na khakte in ka thukham zui-in a gamtatna uhah a kidop nak-uhleh Israel kumpi tokhom tungah a tu dingin keima mai-ah mi khat beek na kitasam kei ding hi,' na cihsa bangin na nasem ka pa David tawh na thuciamsa kipsak in.
"Ahih hangin Pasian pen mite tawh leitungah hong teng takpi ding ahi hiam? En in, vantung le a sangpen vantung in nang hong huam zo lo hi; hih keima lamsa biakinn in hong huam zo lo zaw kan ding!
Ahi zongin na nasempa' thungetna le hong thumna don in, Topa ka Pasian aw, na nasempa na mai-ah hong kikona le a hong nget thungetna hong ngai in.
Na nasempa in hih mun lamah hong thungetna na zak theih nadingin nangmah in na min koih nadingin na ciamsa mun hih biakinn lam sun le zanin hong en in.
Amaute in hih mun lam nga-in thu hong nget uh ciangin na nasempa le na mi Israel-te' hong thumnate nangmah in ngai in. Na tenna mun vantung panin hong za takpi inla, na zak ciangin hong maisak in.
"Mi khat a vengte tungah khialin kiciamna kiciamsak a, hong pai-in hih biakinn sung na biakna tau mai-ah a kiciamna hong kiciam le,
vantung panin za-in gamta inla, na nasemte thu khenin, a mawh mi a gamtatna ama lu tung mahah tusakin thuk inla, a thuman mi a thumanna tawh kizui-in thaman piakna tawh langsak in.
"Na mi Israel-te nang tungah hong khialhna hangin a galte uh mai-ah guallelin, amaute hong kihei kikin na min hong phawkin hih biakinn sung nangma kiangah thu ngenin thumna hong bawl uh ciangin,
vantung panin nangmah in za inla, na mi Israel-te' khialhna maisakin amaute le a pu a pate uh tungah na piak leitangah amaute paipih kik in.
"Amaute nangma tungah hong khialhna hangin vantung kikhak cipin guah a zuk loh hun, amaute na gimsak hun ciangin, amaute in hih mun lam nga-in thu ngen a, na min hong phawkin amau' khialhna panin a kihei uh le,
amaute a pai nading lampi hoih hilh inla, vantung panin za-in na nasem, na mi Israel-te' khialhna maisak in. Tua ciangin na mite tungah gamh-in na piak leitang tungah guah zusak in.
"Gam sungah kialpi tungin, pulnatna ahi a, ankung natna ahi a, ankung zawngkhalna ahi a, kauphe ahi a, lung ahi zongin a om a, amau' khuapi khat peuhpeuhah a galte un umcihin, bangbang gimna, bangbang natna hitaleh,
mi khatpeuh ahi a, na mi Israel-te khempeuh in ahi zongin amau' natna le a dahna ciat uh thei-in hih biakinn lamah a khut uh hong zanin bangbang thungetna hitaleh bangbang thumna hitaleh hong bawl uhleh,
na tenna mun vantung panin za inla, maisakin, amau' gamtatna khempeuh tawh kizui-in a lungsim uh na theih bangin amaute tungah pia ciat in (bang hang hiam cih leh nang, nang bek in mihing' lungsim na thei hi).
Tua hileh ka pu ka pate uh tungah na piak leitang tungah a nuntak hun sung khempeuh uh amaute in nang hong zahtakin nangma thu hong zui ding uh hi.
"Tua mah bangin na mi Israel ahi lo gamdang mi khat a lian nangma min hang, le nangma thahatna hangin a gamlapi gam panin hong pai-in, hih biakinn lam nga-in thu hong nget leh
na tenna mun vantung panin za inla, gamdang mipa in na tungah hong ngetna khempeuh tawh kizui-in hih in. Tua hileh nangma mi Israel-te mah bangin leitung mi khempeuh in na min thei-in nang hong zahtak ding uh a, keima lamsa hih biakinn pen nangma min tawh a kilo ahihna thei ding uh hi.
"A galte uh a do dingin na mite kuankhia-in, bangbang lamah amaute sawl hita lecin, nangmah in na teelsa hih khuapi, nangma tung le nangma min dingin ka lamsa hih biakinn lam nga-in amaute in thu hong nget uhleh,
amau' hong thungetna le hong thumnate vantung panin za-in amau' vai huh in.
"Amaute nang tungah hong khialin (a khial lo kua om ahi hiam?) amaute tungah nang heh a, galte tungah amaute pia-in, amaute a gamla gam ahi a, a nai-ah ahi zongin galmatin kipuakhia a,
ahi zongin galmatin a kipuakna gamah amaute in a lungsim sung uhah tua thu ngaihsunin kisikkik a, 'Kote khialin lampialin ka gitloh tat uh hi,' ci-in amaute galmatin a omna uh gam panin nang tungah hong thum a,
amaute galmatin a kitutna, galmatin a omna uh leitangah a ngaihsutna khempeuh uh le a lungsim khempeuh uh tawh amaute kisikkikin, na teelsa khuapi le nangma min dingin ka lamsa biakinn, nangmah in amau' pute pate tungah na piak amau' leitang lam nga-in thu hong nget uh le,
na tenna vantung panin amau' thungetna le hong thumnate za in la, amau' vai huhin nang tungah hong khial na mite maisak in.
Tu-in ding in, Topa Pasian aw, na tawlngakna ding munah na vangliatna lim Thuciamna Singkuang tawh pai in. Topa Pasian aw, na siampite, thupha pia inla, na hoihna-ah na mi siangthote lungdam tahen.
Topa Pasian aw, na sathau nilh pa nial kei in. Na nasempa David na itnasa hong phawk in," a ci hi.
Solomon a thunget a tawp ciangin, vantung panin meikuang hong paisukin meihal biakna le biakpiaknate kangtum a, tua ciangin Topa' minthanna vang biakinn sung hong dim hi.
Topa' minthanna vang biakinn dim ahih manin Topa' biakinn sungah siampite lut thei lo uh hi.
Israel mite khempeuh in meikuang hong paisukin Topa' minthanna vang biakinn tungah a om a muh uh ciangin suangphah tungah leilam maingatin kun uh a, Pasian bia-in Topa' tungah lungdamna ko-in, " Topa' tungah lungdam koh ding hoih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa le mi khempeuh in Topa' mai-ah biakna pia uh hi.
Kumpi Solomon in biakna-in bawngtal tul sawmnih le tulnih, le tuu tul zakhat le tul sawmnih pia hi. Tua bangin kumpipa le mi khempeuh in Pasian' biakinn a ap uh hi.
Siampite amau panmun uhah ding uh hi. Levi mite zong, Kumpi David in Topa tungah lungdam koh nadingin a bawl Topa' tungah lasakna ding lasaknate tawh ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi. David in amau' nasepna tawh phatnate a bawl ciangin tua bangin hih uh hi. Amaute tawh a kigalsai-ah siampite in peengkulte tum uh a, Israel mi khempeuh zong a ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in Topa' biakinn mai-ah a om inntual laizang ap hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Solomon in a bawl sumngo biakna tau-ah meihal biakna le a thaute ta zo lo ahih manin tua lai munah amah in meihal biakna le thunuama biakna thaute a pia hi.
Tua hun laitakin Solomon le amah tawh a om Israel khempeuh mihon tampi in Hamath lutna panin Egypt lui ciang dongah ni sagih sung pawi a kham uh hi.
Tua ciangin a ni giat ni-in amaute in a thukhupna khat nei uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in biakinn apna ni sagih sung pawi kham uh a, tua pawi ni sagih sung kibawl hi.
A kha sagihna a ni thum ni-in, Topa in David le Solomon, le ama mi Israel tungah a hoih a bawlna hangin amah in lungdamna le kipakna tawh a inn uhah mite a ciahsak hi.
Tua bangin Solomon in Topa' biakinn le kumpi inn zo hi. Solomon in Topa' biakinn le ama inn sungah hih dinga a geel khempeuh nuamtakin zo hi.
Tua ciangin zanin Solomon tungah Topa kilangin ama kiangah, "Na thungetna ka za khin a, keima-a' dingin biakpiakna inn dingin hih mun ka teel khin hi.
Keimah in vantungte khakcipin guah a zuk loh ciang ahi a, gam sung a netum dingin kauphe thu ka piak ciang ahi a, ka mite lakah natna ka tunsak ciang ahi zongin,
keima minin a kisam ka mite amau mahmah kiniamkhiatin, thu ngenin ka mai hong zong a, amau' gitlohnate panin a kihei uhleh, keimah in vantung panin ka za ding a, amaute' khialhna maisakin a leitang uh ka hoihsakkik ding hi.
Nang a dingin ahihleh, na pa David a gamtat bangin keima mai-ah na gamtat a, nang kong sawl khempeuh bangin semin, ka thukhamte le ka biakna ngeina kipte na zuih leh,
Ahih hangin note kihei-in, na mai uhah ka koihsa ka thukhamte leh ka thupiaknate nusia a, pai-in pasian dangte' na semin tuate na biak uhleh,
note' tungah kong piaksa leitang panin note kong botkhia ding hi. Tua ciangin ka min dingin ka apsa hih biakinn ka muhna panin ka lawnkhia ding a, mi khempeuh lakah paunak le gentehna ka suaksak ding hi.
"Tua ciangin a minthangsa hih biakinn a nawkkha khempeuh in lamdangsa-in, 'Bang hangin hih bangin Topa in hih gam le hih biakinn bawl ahi hiam?' ci ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, 'Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt gam panin amaute a paikhiatpih a pu a pate uh Pasian ahi Topa amaute in nusia uh a, pasian dangte pom uh a, tuate bia-in a na sem uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in hih bang siatna khempeuh amaute tungah tungsak hi,' ci ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Solomon in Topa' biakinn le ama inn a lam khit kum sawmnih a cin ciangin,
Kumpi Hiram in ama tungah a piaksa khuapite Solomon in lampha-in tuate sungah Israel mite tengsak hi.
Tua ciangin Hamathzobah-ah Solomon pai-in tua gam a la hi.
Amah in sehnel gam sungah Tadmor khua satin Hamath gam sungah vankoihna khuapite khempeuh a lam hi.
Amah in khuapi kulh, kongpite, le zawlte a nei Bethhoron Tungnung leh Bethhoron Nuainung,
le Baalath, le Solomon' neih vankoihna khuapite khempeuh, a leengte a' ding khuapite khempeuh, a sakol tuangte a' ding khuapite, le Solomon in Jerusalem, Lebanon sung, le ama ukna gam sung khempeuhah a lamnop khempeuh zong a lam hi.
Israel ahi lo Hit mite, Amor mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite, le Jebus mite sung panin a omlai,
Israel mite in a suksiat nai loh amau nungah a suanlekhakte uh tua gam sungah a omlaite, Solomon in aana tawh siah a pia dingin bawl a, tua bangin tuni dongin amaute om uh hi.
Ahih hangin Israel mite ahihleh Solomon in ama na a sem dingin salin bawl lo hi. Amaute pen galkapte, ama nuai-ah uliante, a leengte a ukte, le a sakol tung tuangte ahi uh hi.
Kumpi Solomon' ulian, mite' tungah aana a zang mihing zanih le sawmnga a om uh hi.
Solomon in David khuapi panin Faro' tanu ama zi paipihin ama a' dingin a lamsak inn-ah tunpih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, " Topa' Thuciamna Singkuang a tunnasa munte a siangtho ahih manin Israel kumpi David' inn sungah ka zi teng lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Sabbath nite, Khadet nite, le kum simin a kinei pawi thum - silngo sawh loh anlum pawi, nipikal pawi, le biakbuk pawite a dingin Moses' thupiakna tawh kizui-in nisimin piakna nasep ding a kisam ahih mah bangin innliim mai-a a lam Topa' biakna tau tungah Solomon in meihal biakna Topa tungah a pia hi.
A pa David' biakna ngeina kip tawh kizui-in, nasep nadingin siampite a pawlpawlin a kikhennate, le nisim nasepna-ah a kisam bangin siampite' mai-ah Levi mite phatna lasak panmunte le kongpi tampite-a' dingin kongcingte amau' pawl kikhenna ciatah amah in seh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua bangin Pasian' mipa David in thu pia hi.
Thu khat peuhpeuh le vanmanpha koihnate tawh kisai-in kumpipa in siampite le Levi mite a thupiakna bang teekteekin amaute in a sem uh hi.
Tua bangin Topa' biakinnpi a kiphuh ni a kipan a kizawh dongin Solomon' nasep khempeuh kimansiang hi. Tua ahih ciangin Topa' biakinn kizo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Edom gam sung tuipi gei-a om Eziongeber le Eloth khuate-ah Solomon pai hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Hiram in teembawte le tuipi a thei a nasemte tawh ama nasemte sawl a, Solomon' nasemte tawh Ofir-ah paikhawmin tua lai panin kham talen zali le sawmnga pua-in Kumpi Solomon kiang a tunpih uh hi.
Tu-in Sheba kumpinu in Solomon' minthanna a zak ciangin thudotna haksate tawh a ze-et dingin Jerusalem-ah hong pai a, nungzui honpi le a namtui nate le kham tampi le suangmanphate a pua kalaohte hong keng hi. Solomon kiangah amah hong tun ciangin a lungsim a om khempeuh ama tungah gen hi.
