Tua ciangin Solomon in ama dotna khempeuh dawng hi. Solomon in ama tungah a gentel theih loh haksa lua a sak bangmah om lo hi.
Sheba kumpinu in Solomon' pilna, a lamsa inn,
a sabuai-ah a an, a uliante' omzia, le a nasemte' etna zia le a puansilhte, a anpiate le a puansilhte, le Topa' biakinn-ah a piak a meihal biaknate a muh khit ciangin a lungsim a bei hi.
Tua ciangin amah in kumpipa kiangah, "Ka gam sung panin nangma thute le na pilna ka zak a kigen thute a man hi.
Na zite hampha mahmah hi. Na mai-ah ding tawntungin na pilna a za hih na nasemte hampha mahmah hi.
Na tungah lungkimin Topa na Pasian a dingin kumpi-in a kumpi tokhom tungah nang hong tusak Topa na Pasian in thupha ngah ta hen! Na Pasian in Israel mite itin a tawntungin amaute kipsak ding ahih manin, nangmah in thutang le thuman na sepkhiat theih nadingin amaute tungah kumpi-in nang hong koih hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in kumpipa tungah kham talen zakhat le sawmnih, le a namtui nate tampi tak, le suangmanphate a pia hi. Sheba kumpinu in Kumpi Solomon tungah a piak tua banga a namtui nate zahin a hoih om ngei lo hi.
Tua tham loin Ofir panin kham hong pua Kumpi Hiram' nasemte le Solomon' nasemte in cingsing le suangmanphate hong pua uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Topa' biakinn le kumpi inn-a cingsing kahlei ding le lasate-a' dingin laiza lasaknate le harp lasaknate-in zong a bawl hi. Tua hun ma-in Judah gam sungah tua bang kimu ngei lo hi.
Tua ciangin kumpinu in amah a puakte a thukna-in letsong a piakte banah, a deih khempeuh, a nget khempeuh, Sheba kumpinu tungah Solomon in a pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah kihei-in a nasemte tawh ama gamah a ciahkik hi.
Tu-in kum khat sungin Solomon tungah a tung kham a gihna talen zaguk le sawmguk le guk hi a,
sumbawlte le sumbukte' tutte a kisim lo ahi hi. Arabia kumpite khempeuh le gam sung a ukte in Solomon kiangah kham le ngun puak uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a kiseek kham lum zathum bawl hi; lum khat ciangin kham shekel zathum bei hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in Lebanon Tulak Inn sungah tuate koih hi.
Kumpi tokhom in cial guk le kham a kibawl khengakna khat nei-in, tuate kumpi tokhom tawh kimat a, a tutna pang tuakah ban ngaknate le a ban ngaknate pangah humpinelkai nih ding a,
kahlei cial guk mong ciatah khat ciat, humpinelkai sawm le nih ding hi. Kumpi gam khat peuhpeuhah tua tawh a kibang kibawl ngei lo hi.
Kumpi Solomon' dawnna haite khempeuh kham hi a, Lebanon Tulak Inn sunga umlebeelte khempeuh zong kham citak ahi hi. Solomon' hun lai-in ngun bangmahin kingaihsun lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Kumpi Hiram' nasemte tawh kumpipa' teembawte, Tarshish-ah pai hi. Tarshish teembawte kum thum simin khatvei hong tungin kham, ngun, saiha, zawngmaw, le utong hong puak zel hi.
Tua bangin kumpi Solomon in hauhna le pilna tawh leitung kumpi khempeuh khumkhelh hi.
Amaute khempeuh in a letsong ciat uh, ngun le kham tawh a kibawl nate, puante, myrrh paknamtuite, a namtui nate, sakolte, le la-sakolte, a kum kumin tampi tak hong puak uh hi.
Solomon in sakolte le leengte a dingin buk tulli, le sakol tung tuang mi tul sawm le tulnih nei a, leeng khuapite sungah pawlkhat koih a, Jerusalem khua ama kiangah pawlkhat koih hi.
Amah in Eufratis panin Filistia gam ciang, le Egypt gamgi ciang dong kumpi khempeuh a uk hi.
Kumpipa in Jerusalem-ah suang bangin ngun olsak a, Shefelah theithek sing bangin taamtak sing tamsak hi.
Solomon a dingin Egypt le gam khempeuh panin sakolte kila hi.
Tu-in Solomon' gamtatna a omlaite, a kipatna pan a tawp dong, Kamsang Nathan' Tangthu sung, le Shiloh Khua Mi Ahijah' Thugen Kholhna sung, le Nebat' tapa Jeroboam thu tawh kisai-in Thumu pa Iddo' Maangmuhna sungah kigelh hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon si a, a pa David khuapi sungah kivui hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Rehoboam in ama tangin a uk hi.
Amah kumpi a suaksak dingin Israel khempeuh Shekhem-ah pai ahih manin Shekhem-ah Rehoboam pai hi.
Nebat' tapa Jeroboam in tua thu a zak ciangin (bang hang hiam cih leh Kumpi Solomon kiang panin a taina Egypt-ah amah omlai hi), Egypt panin Jeroboam hong ciahkik hi.
Amaute in mi sawlin amah samkik uh a, tua ciangin Jeroboam le Israel khempeuh hong pai-in Rehoboam kiangah,
"Na pa in hong gimbawlin vangik hong suan hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na pa' nasep haksa le kote' vangik hong zangsak inla, kote in nangma na kong sem ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, "Ni thum sung a hun hong pia unla, tua ciangin hong paikik un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Rehoboam in a pa Solomon a nuntak lai-a a mai-ah a ding khangham mite thu kuppih a, "Hih mite ka dawnna ding ngaihsutna hong bangci piak na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in ama kiangah, "Hih mite tungah nang dik inla, amaute lungkimsakin amaute tungah kam hoih pau lecin, amaute nangma nasem hi tawntung ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin khanghamte in a piak ngaihsutna nusia-in, amah tawh a khangkhawm, ama mai-ah a ding khangnote thu a kuppih hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, "Kei kiangah, 'Na pa in kote tungah hong suat vangik zangsak in,' a hong ci hih mite i dawnna ding bang ngaihsutna hong pia na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah tawh a khangkhawm khangnote in ama kiangah, "Nangma kiangah, 'Na pa in vangik hong suan hi; ahih hangin kote a dingin hong zangsak in,' hong ci hih mite kiangah hih bangin gen in, 'Ka khutmeno pen ka pa' kawng sangin lianzaw hi.
Tu-in ka pa in note tungah vangik hong suatna-ah keimah in na vangik uh ka behlap ding hi. Ka pa in ciang tawh note hong thuhilh hi; ahih hangin keimah in ciang lingnei tawh note kong thuhilh ding hi,' ci in," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in, "Kei kiangah ni thum ni-in hong paikik un," a cih mah bangin Jeroboam le mi khempeuh a ni thum ni-in Rehoboam kiangah hong pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in amaute ngawh dawnin, khangham mite' ngaihsutna nusia a,
"Ka pa in note vangik hong suan hi; ahih hangin keimah in ka hong behlap lai ding hi. Ka pa in ciang tawh note hong thuhilh hi; ahih hangin keimah in ciang lingnei tawh note kong thuhilh ding hi," ci-in khangnote' ngaihsut piakna bangin Kumpi Rehoboam in amaute kiangah a gen hi.

A beh ciat uh tawh kizui-in amaute a phazah hih bang ahi hi. Judah sung pan a tulin a ukte: Adnah a ukpa hi a, a thahat a galhang mi tul zathum tawh ahi hi.
Ama zomah a ukpa Jehohanan hi a, mi tul zanih le tul sawmgiat tawh ahi hi.
Ama zomah Topa' nasep nadingin a kipia Zikri' tapa Amasiah hi a, a thahat a galhang mi tul zanih tawh ahi hi.
Benjamin sung panin: A thahat a galhang Eliada hi a, thal le lum a tawi mi tul zanih tawh ahi hi.
Tua ciangin ama zomah Jehozabad hi a, galdo dingin hiam a tawi mi tul zakhat le tul sawmgiat tawh ahi hi.
Hihte pen kumpipa in Judah gam sung khempeuhah kulh a nei khuapite-ah a koihte banah kumpipa' na a semte ahi hi.
Jehoshafat hau-in hong minthan' ciangin Ahab tawh numei-a kizopna a bawl hi.
Kum tawmkhat khit ciangin Samaria-a Ahab kiangah amah paisuk hi. Tua ciangin Ahab in amah le amah tawh a hong pai mite a dingin tuu tampi le bawngtal tampi go a, Ramothgilead a sim dingin amah a zol hi.
Israel kumpipa Ahab in Judah kumpipa Jehoshafat kiangah, "Ramothgilead-ah kei tawh nong kuan ding hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in dawngin, "Kei pen nangmah bang ka hi a, ka mite zong nangma mite mah bang ahi hi. Kote pen galsimna ah nang tawh kong kuan ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jehoshafat in Israel kumpipa kiangah, " Topa thu dong masa ni," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in kamsangte mihing zali khawmin amaute kiangah, "Ramothgilead a sim dingin kuanto ding ka hi hiam, tua ahih kei leh thuak ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in, "Kuanto in; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in kumpipa' khut sungah hong pia ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jehoshafat in, "Eite in i dot theih ding Topa' kamsang adang hih lai-ah om nawn lo ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in Jehoshafat kiangah, "Eite in Topa thu i dot theih nading Imlah' tapa Mikaiah a kici mi khat omlai hi. Ahih hangin amah in kei tawh kisai a hoih thu gen ngei loin a sia bekbek gen tawntung ahih manin amah ka mudah hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Jehoshafat in, "Tua bangin kumpipa in ci kei in," a ci hi.
Tu-in Israel kumpipa le Judah kumpipa Jehoshafat a kumpi tokhom tung uhah tu-in a puantualpi uh tawh kizem uh hi. Samaria kulhkongpi lutna munah amaute tu uh a, amaute' mai-ah kamsangte khempeuh in thu a gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin Khenaanah' tapa Zedekiah in sik kite bawl tawmin, " Topa in hih bangin ci hi: 'Amaute a siat matengin hihte tawh Syria mite na nawt ding hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kamsang khempeuh in zong tua bangmahin gen uh a, "Ramothgilead-ah kuanto inla, gualzo in. Topa in kumpipa' khut sungah hong pia ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Mikaiah a sam dingin a pai kamtai pa in ama kiangah, "En in, thu kikhatin kamsangte' thugen pen kumpipa a dingin a hoihlam ahi hi. Nang zong amaute' gen bangin gen inla, a hoihlamin gen in," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Mikaiah in, " Topa a nungta ahih mah bangin, ka Pasian' gen thu bek ka gen ding hi," a ci hi.
Kumpipa kiangah amah hong tun ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Mikaiah aw, Ramothgilead-ah galsim dingin kuan ding ka hi hiam, tua ahih kei leh thuak ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in dawngin, "Kuanto inla va gualzo ve! Na khut sungah amaute hong kipia ding hi ve'n," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, " Topa' min tawh thudang gen loin thuman bek kei tungah nong genna ding bangzah vei hong thuhilh ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "A cing nei lo tuute bangin mualte tungah Israel mi khempeuh a kithehthang ka mu hi. Tua ciangin Topa in, 'Hihte in to nei lo hi; nuamtakin a inn ciat uhah ciahsak un,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in Jehoshafat kiangah, "Amah in kei tawh kisai a hoih gen loin a sia bek gen ding hi, ci-in nang kiangah hong gen hi lo ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mikaiah in, " Topa' thugen za in: Topa a kumpi tokhom tungah tu a, a taklam le a veilamah vantung mihon khempeuh a ding ka mu hi.
Tua laitakin Topa in, 'Israel kumpipa Ahab kuanto-in Ramothgilead-ah a pukna dingin kua in amah zol ding ahi hiam?' a ci hi. Tua ciangin khat in thu khat gen a, adang khat in thudang khat a gen hi.
Tua ciangin kha khat hong madawkin Topa' mai-ah ding a, 'Keimah in amah ka va zol ding hi,' a ci hi. Tua ciangin Topa in ama kiangah, 'Bang lam tawh zol ding na hi hiam?' a ci hi.
Amah in, 'Keimah paikhia-in ama kamsangte khempeuh' kam sungah zuau thugen kha khat ka va hi ding hi,' a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, 'Nangmah in amah na va zol ding hi. Pai inla tua bangin va hih in,' a ci hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Topa in hih na kamsangte' kam sungah zuauthu a gen kha khat koih khin ahihna thei in. Topa in nang na siatna ding gen khinzo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Khenaanah' tapa Zedekiah a nai-ah hong pai-in Mikaiah a paang bengin, "Cik hun a kipan Topa' kha in kei hong nusia-in, hih bang na gen nadingin nang tungah hong tung ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mikaiah in, "Nangmah a bu dingin inndei sungnungah na pai ni ciangin na thei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in, "Mikaiah man unla, khuapi ukpa Amon le kumpipa' tapa Joash kiangah paipih kik un.
Tua ciangin, 'Hih bangin kumpipa in ci hi: Hih mipa thong sungah koih unla, lungnuam takin kong ciahkik mateng anletui tawmno bek tawh vak un, ci hi,' ci un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mikaiah in, "Lungnuam takin nong ciahkik leh kei tungtawnin Topa in thu a gen lo ahi hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Mi khempeuh aw, tu-a ka thugen za un!" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa le Judah kumpipa Jehoshafat, Ramothgilead-ah a kuanto uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in Jehoshafat kiangah, "Kei pen mel kiseelin gal sungah kong kuan ding a, ahih hangin nangmah in na puantualpite nong silh ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Israel kumpipa a mel kiseel a, amaute gal sungah a kuan uh hi.
Tu-in Syria kumpipa in a leeng a ukte thu pia khin a, "A neu tawh ahi a, a lian tawh ahi zongin kido loin, Israel kumpipa bek tawh na kido ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Leeng galkap a ukte in Jehoshafat a muh uh ciangin, "Israel kumpipa hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah a hih dingin amaute in naih uh hi. Tua ciangin Jehoshafat kikokhia a, Topa in amah huh hi. Pasian in ama kiang panin amaute kaikhia hi;
Ahih hangin mi khat in a thal mawklot a, Israel kumpipa a galdal thep le a awmdal kikal a kha hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a leenghawl pa kiangah, "Kei liam ka hih manin kileh inla, galphual panin hong puakhia in," a ci hi.
Tua ni-in galkidona nasia mahmah a, nitak dong Syria mite maingatin a leeng sungah Israel kumpipa kingam hi. Tua hi a, nitum laitakin amah a si ta hi.
Judah kumpipa Jehoshafat lungmuang takin Jerusalem-a ama inn-ah ciahkik hi.
Ahih hangin amah a dawn dingin Hanani' tapa, thumu pa Jehu hong paikhia a, Kumpi Jehoshafat kiangah, "Mi gilote huhin Topa a mudahte it ding na hi hiam? Hih thu hangin Topa' hehna nang tungah hong tungzo hi.
Ahi zongin nang na hoihna pawlkhat om hi; bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in gam sung panin Asherah milimte nusia-in Pasian zon ding na lungsimah na ngaihsun hi," a ci hi.
Jerusalem-ah Jehoshafat teng hi. Tua ciangin Beersheba panin Efraim mualtung gam ciang dong mite lakah zin kawikawi a, amau' pute pate' Pasian, Topa kiangah amaute tunpihkik hi.
thukhente tungah, "Note in mi a' ding hi loin Topa a dingin a khen na hih manun na hih dingte uh limtakin ngaihsun un; thukhenna na piak laitakun note kiangah amah hong om hi.
Tu-in note in Topa zahtak unla, na hihnate uhah kingaihsun un. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa i Pasian in thuman heikhiatna, mi deidanna, le sumgolh laknate deih lo hi," a ci hi.
Tua tham loin, Topa a dingin thukhenna a pia ding le thuneite a khensak dingin Levi mite le siampite le Israel mi beh lutangte pawlkhat, Jehoshafat in Jerusalem-ah a seh hi. Amaute in Jerusalem-ah a phual ding uh nei uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in amaute thuhilh a, " Topa zahtakna, cihtakna, le na lungsim khempeuh uh tawh hih bangin na hih ding uh hi:
A khuapi uhah a teng na sanggamte uh tung panin mi kithahna thu, thukham ahih kei leh thupiakna, upadi ahih kei leh biakna ngeina kipte tawh kisai-in thu khat peuhpeuh note tungah hong tun ciangin, amaute in Topa' mai-ah mawhna a piansak loh nading le note le na sanggamte uh tungah hehna hong tun loh nadingin amaute na hilh ding uh hi. Tua bangin na gamta ding uh a, mawhna na piangsak kei ding uh hi.
En un, Topa' thu tawh kisai thute khempeuhah siampi lian Amariah note tungah om hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa tawh kisai khempeuhah Judah mite a ukpa Ishmael' tapa Zebadiah om hi. Tua ciangin Levi mite in note tungah ulian na hong sem ding uh hi. Hang takin gamta un; thuman mite tawh Topa hong om ta hen!" a ci hi.
Hih thu khit ciangin Moab mite le Ammon mite, le Meunim mite pawlkhat, Jehoshafat a sim dingin hong kuan uh hi.
Mi pawlkhat hong pai-in Jehoshafat kiangah, "Tuipi galkhat, Edom gam panin mihon tampi khat nangmah a sim dingin hong kuan uh hi. Amaute Hazazontamar (Engedi a kici)-ah om uh hi," ci-in a gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jehoshafat lau a, amahmah in Topa' lamlahna ding zong a, Judah gam khempeuhah an tan' ding thu a zasak hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' tung pan huhna a ngen dingin Judah mite hong kikhawm uh hi. Judah khuapi khempeuh panin Topa thu a dong dingin amaute hong pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' biakinn huangsung, inntual thak mai, Judah le Jerusalem-te' kikhopna sungah Jehoshafat ding a,
" Topa , ka pu ka pate uh Pasian aw, nang, vantungah Pasian hi lo na hi hiam? Minamte' kumpi gam khempeuh tungah nang a uk hi lo na hi hiam? Na khut sungah vangliatna le thahatna om a, kuamah in nang hong nang zo lo hi.
Kote' Pasian aw, hih gamah a teng mite na mi Israel-te' mai-ah hawlkhia-in, na lawmpa Abraham' suanlekhakte tungah a tawntung dingin pia hi lo na hi hiam?
Hih gamah amaute tengin, nangma min dingin hih lai-ah biakinn khat lam uh a,
'Eite tungah siatna, namsau, thukhenna, ahih kei leh natna, ahih kei leh kialpi hong tun leh, hih biakinn sungah ama min om ahih manin hih biakinn mai-ah dingin i gimna hunah ama tungah i kiko ding a, amah in hong za-in hong hon ding hi,' ci uh hi.
"Tu-in en in, Egypt gam panin Israel-te hong paikhiat lai-in na simsak loh, amaute in a suksiat loh uh Ammon mite le Moab mite le Seir Mual gam mite,
ka luah dingun kote tungah nong piaksa nangma neihsa panin kote a hong hawlkhia dingin hong paina tawh amaute in kote hong lehthuk zawsop uh hi.
Kote' Pasian aw, amaute tungah thu khen lo ding na hi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh kote a sim dingin a hong pai hih mihon tampite a do dingin thahatna ka nei kei uh hi. Ka cih nading uh ka thei kei uh a, nangmah bek kong mitsuan uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua laitakin Topa' mai-ah Judah mi khempeuh a taneute, a zite, le a naupangte uh tawh a ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin a kikhawmte' lak, Levi mi Asaf' suante sung pan Mattaniah, a tapa Jeiel, a tapa Benaiah, a tapa Zekhariah, a tapa Jahaziel tungah Topa' kha hong tung hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Judah gam khempeuh le Jerusalem-a teng khempeuh, le Kumpi Jehoshafat aw, ngai un. Topa in hih bangin note' tungah hong gen hi: 'Kihta kei unla, hih a tam mi honpi hangin lungkia kei un; bang hang hiam cih leh galdona pen note a' hi loin Pasian-a' ahi hi.
Zing ciangin amaute a do-in paisuk un. Ziz kahtohna lampi tawnin amaute hong kuanto ding uh a, Jeruel gamlak nisuahna lam kuam mongah amaute na mu ding uh hi.
Note in hih kidona-ah na do ding uh kisam lo hi. Judah gam mite le Jerusalem khuamite aw, na panmun uh la-in taang loin ding unla, note' tangin Topa' gualzawhna mu un,' ci hi. Kihta kei unla, lungkia kei un. Zing ciangin amaute a do-in pai un. Topa in note hong ompih ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jehoshafat in a maitang leilam ngatin kun a, Judah gam le Jerusalem-a a teng mite khempeuh zong Topa' mai-ah pukin Topa a bia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Levi mite sung pan Kohath mite le Korah mite, awging pha mahmah tawh Israel Pasian, Topa a phat dingin a dingto uh hi.
Tua ciangin zingsangin amaute tho baihin Tekoa gamlakah a paikhia uh hi. Amaute a paikhiat laitakin Jehoshafat dingin, "Judah gam le Jerusalem-a a tengte aw, ka thugen za un! Topa na Pasian uh um un; tua hileh note na kip ding uh hi. Ama kamsangte um un; tua hileh na maavang ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Amah in mite tawh thu kikupna a neih khit ciangin, galkapte mai-ah amaute a paikawmin, " Topa tungah lungdamna ko un; bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi," ci-in biakna puan silhin Topa tungah la sa-in amah a phat dingte a seh hi.
Amaute inla sa-in phat ding a kipat uh ciangin, Judah mite a sim dingin a hong pai Ammon mite, Moab mite, le Seir Mual gam mite a pangsim ding Topa in koih a, amaute kizo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Ammon mite le Moab mite in Seir Mual a, a tengte a do dingin kipanin amaute susia mang uh a, Seir-a a tengte a beisak khit uh ciangin amaute khatlekhat kisusia uh hi.
Gamlak a galvilna tausangah Judah-te hong tun ciangin mihonpite' omna lam en uh hi. Amaute pen leilakah a puk misi luanghawm vive na hi a, a suakta kuamah om lo hi.
Van kinusiate a tawm dingin Jehoshafat le a mite hong pai ciangin bawngte, vante, puante, le na manphate tampi tak mu uh a, a puakzawh nawn loh ciang dong uh amau a dingin a la uh hi. Van kinusiate tam mahmah ahih manin ni thum sung tawm uh hi.
A ni li ni-in Berakah Kuam-ah amaute kikhawm uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in tua lai-ah Topa phat uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin tuni dongin tua lai mun pen Berakah Kuam kici hi.
Tua ciangin Judah mi le Jerusalem mi khempeuh ciah uh a, Jehoshafat makai-in lungdamna tawh Jerusalem-ah a pai uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a galte uh hangin Topa in amaute lungdamsak hi.
Amaute, harp lasaknate le laiza lasaknate tawh Jerusalem-a Topa' biakinn-ah tung uh hi.
Topa in Israel-te' galte a dosakna thu a zak uh ciangin kumpi gamte khempeuh in Topa a kihta uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Jehoshafat' ukna gam sung gamdai hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a Pasian in ama kiimah galdaihna a pia hi.
Tua bangin Jehoshafat in Judah tungah uk hi. Amah in uk ding a kipatin kum sawmthum le nga pha a, Jerusalem-ah kum sawmnih le nga sung uk hi. Ama nu' min Azubah hi a, Shilhi' tanu ahi hi.
Amah in a pa Asa' gamtat bangmahin Topa' muhna-ah a man na sem hi.
Ahi zongin mual dawna biakpiaknate kilakhia lo hi. Mite in a lungsim uhah a pu a pate uh' Pasian ngaihsun nai lo uh hi.
Tu-in Jehoshafat' gamtatna a omlaite, a patna pan a tawp dongin, Israel Kumpite' Tangthu sunga a kiciamteh, Hanani' Tapa Jehu' Khang Tangthu sungah kigelh hi.
Hih thu khit ciangin Judah kumpi Jehoshafat in a gilo a a gamta Israel kumpipa Ahaziah tawh kipawlna a bawl hi.
Tarshish a pai ding teembawte bawlna-ah amah pawl a, amaute in Eziongebar-ah teembawte a bawl uh hi.
Tua ciangin Mareshah khuami Dodavahu' tapa Eliezer in Jehoshafat langpangin thu genin, "Nangmah in Ahaziah tawh kipawlna bawl na hih manin Topa in na bawlsa uh nate susia ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin teembawte kisia a Tarshish-ah pai thei lo hi.
Jehoshafat si a, David khuapi sungah a pate tawh kivui hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Jehoram in ama tangin uk hi.
Jehoshafat' tapa Jehoram' sanggam pasalte: Azariah, Jehiel, Zekhariah, Azariah, Mikhael, le Shefatiah ahi uh hi. Hihte khempeuh, Judah kumpi Jehoshafat' tapate ahi hi.
A pa un amaute tungah letsong lianpite, ngun, kham, le a manpha neihsate, Judah gam sunga kulhnei khuapite tawh a pia hi. Ahih hangin amah ta upa ahih manin Jehoram tungah kumpi gam a pia hi.
A pa' kumpi tokhom tungah Jehoram kahin a kip ciangin namsau tawh a sanggam pasal khempeuh that a, Judah ulian pawlkhat zong a that hi.
Jehoram kumpi a suahin a kum sawmthum le nih pha a, Jerusalem-ah kum giat sung uk hi.
Amah in Ahab innkuan mah bangin Israel kumpi dangte' gamtat a zui hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Ahab' tanu ama zi ahi hi. Topa' muhna-ah amah a sia gamta hi.
Ahi zongin, David tawh a bawlsa a thuciamna, ama tung le a suante tungah ukna za a piak suakna ding a ciam khitna hangin Topa in David' suante susia lo hi.
Ama hun sungin Judah ukna panin Edom lengkhia-in amau' kumpi tuam a koih uh hi.
Tua ciangin ama nuai-a a ukte le a leengte khempeuh tawh Jehoram galkah a, zanin amah kipanin amah le a leeng ukte a umcih Edom mite a vatgawp hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tuni dongin Judah ukna panin Edom mite leengkhia hi. Amah in a pu a pate' Pasian, Topa nusia ahih manin tua hun laitakin Libnah zong ama ukna panin a lengkhia hi.
Tua tham loin amah in Judah mualtung gamah mual dawna biakpiaknate bawl a, Jerusalem-a teng mite citak loin omsak a, Judah mite lampialsak hi.
Tua ciangin kamsang Elijah tung panin ama kiangah laikhak khat hong tung a, "Na pu David' Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: 'Na pa Jehoshafat' gamtat bang leh Judah kumpi Asa' gamtat bangin gamta loin,
Israel kumpi dangte' gamtat bangin gamta-in Ahab innkuan in cihtak lohna-ah Israel a paipih bangin Judah le Jerusalem-a teng mite cihtak lohna-ah na paipih a, na pa' innkuan sung panin nang sangin a hoihzaw na sanggam pasalte zong na that hi.
Tua ahih manin na mite, na tate, na zite, le na neih khempeuh tungah Topa in gimna lianpi khat hong tungsak ding a,
Tua ciangin Topa in Ethiopia mite kiangah a om Filistia mite le Arab mite, Jehoram tungah a heh nadingun tok lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Judah a simin amaute hong kuanto-in luh uh a, kumpipa' inn-ah a om a muh uh na khempeuh, le a tapate le a zite zong puakhia uh a, a tapa neupen Jehoahaz simloh a tapate a kinusia om lo hi.
A hun a cin, kum nih beina ciangin a natna hangin a gil tolhkhia a, nakpitakin na sa-in a si hi. A pate a dingin mei a cih uh bangin a mite in amah zahtakna-in mei cih lo uh hi.
Amah in uk ding a kipatin kum sawmthum le nih a pha hi. Jerusalem-ah kum giat sung uk a, kuama dahpih lohin amah kihemkhia hi. Amaute in David khuapi sungah amah vui uh a, ahih hangin kumpite' han sungah kivui lo hi.
Tua ciangin Jerusalem-ah a tengte in ama tangin a tapa neupen Ahaziah kumpi-in koih uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Arab mite tawh giahphual ah hong pai mite in a tapa golzawte khempeuh that khin uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Judah kumpi Jehoram' tapa Ahaziah in uk hi.
Ahaziah in uk ding a kipatin kum sawmli le nih pha a, Jerusalem-ah kum khat sung uk hi. Ama nu' min Athaliah hi a, Omri' tanu ahi hi.
Ama nu in a sia-a a gamtatna ding lamlak ahih manin amah zong Ahab innkuan dangte' gamtat bangin a gamta hi.
Ahab innkuan dangte mah bangin Topa' muhna-ah a sia gamta hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a pa' sih khit ciangin ama siatna dingah thu lamlakte pen Ahab' innkuante ahi uh hi.
Amah in amaute' thugen nangawn zui a, Ramothgilead-ah Syria kumpi Hazael tawh a kido dingin Israel kumpi Ahab' tapa Joram tawh a kuan hi. Tua ciangin Syria mite in Joram liamsak uh a,
Syria kumpi Hazael a do laitakin gal sungah a ngah a liamnate Jezreel-ah a kidamsak dingin a kileh kik hi. Tua ciangin Jezreel-ah Ahab' tapa Joram a ci na ahih manin amah a en dingin Judah kumpi Jehoram' tapa Ahaziah a hawhsuk hi.
Ahih hangin Joram' kiangah a hawhna tawh Ahaziah' pukna a tunna ding Pasian' sehsa ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua lai-ah amah a hawh sungin Ahab innkuan a susia dingin Topa in sathau a nilhsa, Nimshi' tapa Jehu tawh a kimu dingin Joram tawh paikhia hi.
Jehu in Ahab innkuan tungah Pasian' thukhenna a sepkhiat laitakin Judah uliante le Ahaziah' na a sem, Ahaziah' sanggam pasalte' tapate tuak a, amah in amaute a that hi.
Amah in Ahaziah zong a, Samaria-ah a buk laitakin amah kiman a, tua ciangin Jehu kiangah amah kipaipihin kithat hi. Amaute in amah vui uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in, "Amah pen a lungsim khempeuh tawh Topa a zong Jehoshafat' tupa ahi hi," ci uh hi. Tua ciangin Ahaziah innkuante in kumpi gam a ukzo ding mi khat zong nei nawn lo uh hi.
Tu-in Ahaziah' nu Athaliah in a tapa a sihna a theih ciangin amah kipanin Judah sung pan kumpi innkuan khempeuh thatsak hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa' tanu Jehosheba in Ahaziah' tapa Joash la a, a kithat ding kumpipa' tapate lak panin amah gukhia-in lupna senna inndei sungah amah le a cingnu a koih hi. Amah pen Ahaziah' sanggamnu ahih manin Kumpi Jehoram' tanu ahi, siampi Jehoiada' zi Jehosheba in tua bangin Athaliah' kiang panin amah seel a, tua nu in amah thatkha lo hi.
Tua bangin Athaliah in gam sung a uk laitakin Pasian' biakinn sungah bu-in kum guk sung amaute tawh amah a om hi.
Ahih hangin a kum sagihna kumin Jehoiada amah kihanthawnin a za-a a ukte, Jehoram' tapa Azariah, le Jehohanan' tapa Ishmael, le Obed' tapa Azariah, le Adaiah' tapa Maaseiah, le Zikri' tapa Elishafat-te tawh thukimna khat a bawl hi.
Tua ciangin Judah gam sungah amaute pai kawikawi-in Judah khuapite khempeuh panin Levi mite, le Israel mi beh lutangte khawmin Jerusalem-ah hong pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin a kikhawm khempeuh in Pasian' biakinn sungah kumpipa tapa Joash tawh thuciamna khat bawl uh hi. Tua ciangin Jehoiada in amaute kiangah, "En un, kumpipa' tapa! Topa in David suante tawh kisai-in a gen bangin amah uksak un.
Note in hih bangin na hih ding uh hi: Sabbath ni-in nasep a peng no siampite le Levi mite sung panin seh thum ah seh khat kulhkongpi cingte na hi ding uh a,
seh thum ah seh khat kumpipa' inn-ah omin seh thum ah seh khat Khuabul Kulhkongpi-ah na om ding uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh Topa' biakinn tual sungah na om ding uh hi.
Siampite le na a sem Levi mite simloh, Topa' biakinn sungah kuamah lutsak kei un. Amaute a siangtho ahih manin amaute lut thei ding uh a, ahih hangin mi khempeuh in Topa' sawlna na mang ding uh hi.
Levi mite in a khutsung uhah a galhiam ciat uh tawh kumpipa cing ding uh a, biakinn sungah a lut peuhpeuh kithat ding hi. Hong tum ciang hitaleh a pusuah ciang hitaleh ah kumpipa tawh om un," a ci hi.
Siampi Jehoiada' thupiak khempeuh bangin Levi mite le Judah mi khempeuh gamta uh hi. Amaute in amau' mi ciat Sabbath ni-in na a sem ding mite tawh Sabbath ni-in nasep a peng ding mite hong paipih uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Jehoiada in nasep a peng ding siampite ciahsak lo hi.
Tua ciangin siampi Jehoiada in Topa' biakinn sungah a om, Kumpi David-a' ahi ngei teipite le lum lian le lum neute, a ukte tungah a pia hi.
Tua ciangin amah in mi khempeuh a galhiam ciat uh tawh kumpipa a cingin, biakinn leitaw lampang pan leilu lampang, biakna tau le inn kiimah a koih hi.
Tua ciangin amah in kumpipa' tapa paikhiatpihin ama lu tungah kumpi lukhu khusak a, kumpi za ngahna lai zong a pia hi. Tua ciangin amaute in kumpi-in amah taangko uh a, Jehoiada le a tapate in amah sathau nilhin, "Kumpipa khansau hen!" a ci uh hi.
Mite tai-in kumpipa a phatna uh gamlumna Athaliah in a zak ciangin mite' omna Topa' biakinn-ah a pai hi.
Amah a khuadak ciangin, biakinn lutna-a om a khuampi gei-ah kumpipa a ding, le a ukte le peengkul tumte kumpipa gei-ah a om, le gam sung mi khempeuh lungdamin peengkulte a tum, le lasate a lasakna nate uh tawh tua pawi makai-in a na om uh a mu hi. Tua ciangin Athaliah in a puante balkekin kiko a, "Sawmsimna! Sawmsimna!" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin siampi Jehoiada in galkapte tungah a kikoih a ukte paikhiatpihin amaute tungah, "A gualin a cingte lak panin a pua-ah amah paikhiatpih un. Amah a panpih mi khat peuhpeuh namsau tawh kithat ding hi," a ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh siampipa in, " Topa' biakinn sungah tua nu that kei un," ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in tua nu man uh a, kumpipa omna inn Sakol Kongpi vangah paikhiatpihin tua lai-ah amah a that uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' mi ahihna ding uh Jehoiada in amah le mi khempeuh le kumpipa kikalah thuciamna khat a bawl hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh Baal inn-ah pai-in a inn a laikhia uh hi. Amaute in a biakna taute le a milimte sukham uh a, biakna taute mai-ah Baal siampi Mattan a that uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jehoiada in David' hih ngei bangin, Moses thukham sungah a kigelh bangin lungdamna le lasakna tawh, Topa' tungah meihal biakna a pia ding, Topa' biakinn a en dingin David in a vaihawmsa Levi siampite le Levi mite' ukna nuai-ah Topa' biakinn a vil galvilte a koih hi.
Lam khat peuhpeuhah a nin mi khat peuhpeuh hong lut loh nadingin Topa' biakinn kulhkongpite-ah amah in kulhkongpi cingte a koih hi.
Tua ciangin amah in galkap ukte, mi liante, mi a ukte, le gam sung mi khempeuh a paipih hi. Tua ciangin amaute in Topa' biakinn panin kumpipa' inn kulhkongpi tungnung tawnin kumpipa paipihsuk uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in kumpi tokhom tungah kumpipa tusak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin gam sung mi khempeuh lungdam uh hi. Namsau tawh Athaliah a kithah khit ciangin khuapi sung a nuam pah hi.
Joash in uk ding a kipatin kum sagih pha a, Jerusalem-ah kum sawmli sung uk hi. Ama nu' min Zibiah hi a, Beersheba khuami ahi hi.

Jehoiada in ama a dingin zi nih laksak a, amah in tapate le tanute a nei hi.
Hih hun khit ciangin Joash in Topa' biakinn a ngei batsakkik ding ngaihsun hi.
Amah in siampite le Levi mite khempeuh khawmin amaute kiangah, "Judah khuapite-ah pai unla, Pasian' biakinn a kum kumin puah nadingin Israel khempeuh tung panin sum khawm un; hih thu na nawh hih ding uh thei un," a ci hi. Ahih hangin Levi mite kinawh lo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in amau' ukpi Jehoiada samin ama kiangah, " Topa' nasem Moses in Topa' ompihna puanbuk-a dingin Israel mihonte tung panin a khon mangmu bang hangin Judah le Jerusalem panin Levi mite khawmsak lo na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh tua a gilo numei Athaliah le a pawlte in Pasian' biakinn luh uh a, Topa' biakinn sunga om a ki-ap nate khempeuh zong Baal-te a dingin zang uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in thu pia a, amaute in singkuang khat bawlin Topa' biakinn kulhkongpi pualamah a koih uh hi.
Gamlakah a omlai-un Pasian' nasem Moses in Israel mite a piaksak mangmu Topa a dingin hong puak nadingun Judah le Jerusalem sung khempeuhah thu zaksakna kibawl hi.
Tua ciangin ulian khempeuh le mi khempeuh lungdamin a mangmu uh hong sung uh a, a man khit mateng uh singkuang sungah khia uh hi.
Levi mite in kumpipa' uliante kiangah a singkuang paipih uh a, a sungah sum tampi a omlam a muh peuhpeuh uh ciangin, kumpipa' lai-at pa le siampi lianpen pa' sawltak pa hong pai-in singkuang sunga sum teng bungkhia-in la uh a, tua ciangin a omna ngei-ah a singkuang koihkik uh hi. Tua bangin a ni ni-in amaute in hih uh a, sum tampi a khawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa le Jehoiada in Topa' biakinn nasep a ukte tungah tua sumte pia uh a, amaute in Topa' biakinn a ngei a bangsakkik dingin leilesuang nasep a siamte le khutsiamte, le Topa' biakinn a puahkik dingin sik le sumngo nasep a siamte zong a cial uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua nasepna-ah a kisehte in na semin amau' khut sungah puahkikna nasep in mai nawt a, amaute in a ngei bangin Topa' biakinn bawlkikin kipsak uh hi.
Amaute in a zawh khit uh ciangin, kumpipa le Jehoiada kiangah sum a omlaite hong paipih uh a, amaute in tuate tawh Topa' biakinn-ah nasepna ding le meihal biak nadingin nazatte, le paknamtui a dingin pakante, le kham le ngun beelte a bawl uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Jehoiada' nuntak sung khempeuh a tawntungin Topa' biakinn sungah meihal biaknate a pia uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jehoiada teekin a hun kicing ta a, tua ciangin a si hi. A sihin kum za le kum sawmthum pha hi.
Amah in Israel sung, le Pasian' na le Pasian' biakinn-ah nasep hoih sem ahih manin amaute in David khuapi sung kumpite' lakah amah a vui uh hi.
Jehoiada a sih khit ciangin Judah uliante hong pai-in amau' thu a zuih nadingin kumpipa tungah thu va gen uh a, kumpipa in zong amaute' thu a ngai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in a pu a pate uh Pasian, Topa' biakinn nusia uh a, Asherah milimte le milim dangte' na sem uh hi. Hih amau' mawhna hangin Judah le Jerusalem tungah hehna hong tung hi.
Ahi zongin Topa' lamah amaute a paipih kik dingin amah in amaute lakah kamsangte a puak hi. Hihte in amau' langkhatah teci pang a, ahih hangin amaute in don lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin siampi Jehoiada' tapa Zekhariah' sungah Pasian' kha hong lut hi. Tua ciangin amah dingin mite en sukin mite kiangah, "Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: 'Bang hangin na mavan' theih loh nadingun Topa' thupiaknate palsat na hi uh hiam? Note in Topa nusia na hih manun amah in note hong nusia hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in amah sawmsim uh a, kumpipa' thupiakna tawh amaute in Topa' biakinn tualah suang tawh amah denglum uh hi.
Tua bangin kumpipa Joash in Zekhariah' pa Jehoiada in ama tungah a lah dikna phawk nawn loin ama tapa thahsak mawk hi. Amah in a sih ding ciangin, " Topa in mu hen la thuk ta hen!" a ci hi.
Kum bei ciangin Joash a simin Syria galkapte hong kuanto hi. Judah le Jerusalem-ah amaute hong pai-in mite lak panin ulian khempeuh that uh a, a van ngahte khempeuh uh Damaskas kumpipa kiangah puak uh hi.
Syria galkapte mi tawmno hong pai hi napi-in, amaute in a pu a pate uh Pasian, Topa nusia uh ahih manin Topa in amaute' khut sungah galkap tampi ahi mite a pia hi. Tua bangin amaute in Joash' tungah thukhenna a pia uh hi.
Amah nakpi tak a liamsa-in nusia-in, ama kiang panin Syria mite a kihepkhiat khit uh ciangin, siampi Jehoiada' tapa a thahna hangin a nasemte in amah sawmsim uh a, a lupna tungah amah that uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah si hi. David khuapi sungah amah vui uh a, ahih hangin amaute in kumpite' hanah amah vui lo uh hi.
Amah a sawmsim mite pen Ammon numei Shimeath' tapa Zabad, le Moab numei Shimrith' tapa Jehozabad ahi uh hi.
Ama tapate' thute, le amah a kigensiatna thute, le Pasian' biakinn a kilamkikna thute, Kumpite' Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Amaziah in ama tangin a uk hi.
Amaziah in uk ding a kipatin kum sawmnih le nga pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kum sawmnih le kua sung uk hi. Ama nu' min Jehoaddin hi a, Jerusalem khuami ahi hi.
Topa' mitah a manin amah gamta a, ahi zongin a lungsim a paubaang lo hizo nai sam lo hi.
Ama khut sungah kumpi vangliatna kiptakin a om khit phetin a pa ahi kumpipa a that a nasemte a that hi.
Ahih hangin Moses laibu sungah, "Tate' hangin pate kithat lo ding a, pate' hangin tate kithat lo ding hi," ci-in Topa in a thupiakna thukham sungah a kigelh mah bangin amah in amau' tate that lo hi.
Tua ciangin Amaziah in Judah mite khawm a, a tul-a ukte le a za-a ukte' khutnuai-ah Judah mite le Benjamin mite a behbeh, a pawlpawlin a koih hi. Amah in kum sawmnih le a tungsiah a pha mite khawm a, galsim dingin a hoih, teipi le lum a zang thei, a kitengkhia mihing tul zathum a pha hi.
Amah in Israel sung panin ngun talen zakhat tawh a thahat galhang mi tul zakhat zong a cial hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian' mi khat ama kiangah hong pai-in, "Kumpipa aw, Israel mi ahi hih Efraim mite khempeuh, Topa in ompih lo ahih manin hih Israel galkapte nang tawh kuankhawm sak kei in.
Ahih hangin hih bang lama hihna tawh galdona-ah thahat dingin kingaihsun kha na hih leh, Pasian in galte' mai-ah nang hong paai ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in huhna ding ahi a, paihna ding ahi zongin vangliatna nei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Amaziah in Pasian' mipa kiangah, "Ahi ta zongin Israel galkapte tungah ka piaksa talen zakhat thu bang cih ding ihi hiam?" a ci hi. Pasian' mipa in dawngin, " Topa in hih sangin nakpitakin a tamzaw hong pia thei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Amaziah in Efraim panin hong pai galkapte, inn-ah a ciahkik dingin a paikhiasak hi. Tua ciangin Judah mite tungah amaute heh mahmah uh a, heh mahmahna tawh inn-ah a ciahkik uh hi.
Ahih hangin Amaziah kihanthawnin a mite paikhiatpih a, Ci Kuam-ah pai-in Seir gam mite mihing tul sawm a that hi.
Adang tul sawm hingmat uh a, keen sang dawn khatah amaute paipihin tua keen dawn panin amaute lawnsuk uh a, amaute khempeuh themlen' hi.
Ahih hangin Amaziah in gal sungah amah tawh kuansak loin, inn-ah a sawlkik galkapte in Samaria panin Bethhoron dong Judah khuapite na sim uh a, tuate sungah mi tulthum thatin van tampi a la uh hi.
Seir gamah Edom mite a thahna panin Amaziah hong ciah ciangin amah in Seir gam mite' pasian-te hong ciahpih a, ama pasian dingin tuate koih a, tuate bia-in tuate' tungah biakna a pia hi.
Tua ciangin Amaziah tungah Topa hehin ama kiangah kamsang khat sawl a, tua pa in, "Bang hangin nangma khut panin ama mite a honkhia lo, mi pawlkhatte' pasian-te beel na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in thu a gen laitakin kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Kumpipa tungah ngaihsutna a pia dingin nang hong koih ka hi uh hiam? Khawl in! Bang hangin nang hong kithat ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin kamsangpa khawl a, ahih hangin ama kiangah, "Hih bang gamta-in ka thugenna ngai lo na hih manin Pasian in nang hong suksiat ding a lungsim a khentatna ka thei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Judah kumpi Amaziah in ngaihsutna a lak khit ciangin Israel kumpi, Jehu' tapa Jehoahaz, a tapa Joash kiangah mi sawlin, "Hong pai in; khatlekhat kisi ni," cisak hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpi Joash in Judah kumpi Amaziah kiangah thu puak a, "Lebanon-a thangling kung in Lebanon-a taamtak tungah thu puak a, 'A zi dingin ka tapa' tungah na tanu pia in,' ci hi. Tua ciangin Lebanon gamsa khat hong pai-in thangling kung tuancil hi.
Nangmah in, 'Edom mite ka vat khin hi,' na ci a, na lungsim in nang hong kisathei sak hi. Tu-a na minthanna zah tawh inn-ah om in; bang hangin nangmah le Judah mite na pukkhawm nadingun buaina piangsak ding na hi hiam" a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Amaziah in mang lo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Edom pasian-te bia uh ahih manin, Pasian in amau' galte' khut sungah amaute a piaktheih nadingin tua pen Pasian' vaihawmna ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel kumpipa Joash kuanto a, Judah-te' gam Bethshemesh-ah amah le Judah kumpipa Amaziah khatlekhat gal sungah kisi uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite in Judah mite zo a, mi khempeuh a inn uhah a tai uh hi.

Amaute' ukna nuai-ah galdona-ah kumpipa a huh dingin thahatna tawh gal a do thei ding galkap tul zanga om hi.
