Tua ahih ciangin Topa a Pasian' mai-ah Jotham a hoih tatna tawh kizui-in a vang zong a lian hi.
Tu-in Jotham' gamtatna a omlaite, le a galsimnate, le a omziate, Israel le Judah Kumpite' Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi.
Amah in uk ding a kipatin kum sawmnih le nga pha a, Jerusalem-ah kum sawm le guk sung uk hi.
Tua ciangin Jotham si a, David khuapi sungah amaute in amah a vui uh hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Ahaz in ama tangin a uk hi.
Ahaz in uk ding a kipatin kum sawmnih pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kum sawm le guk sung uk hi. A pu David gamtat hoih bangin Topa' mitah a man gamta lo a,
Israel kumpite' khekhap zuizaw hi. Amah in a kisung milimte nangawn Baal-te a dingin a bawl hi.
Tua ciangin Hinnom' tapa' kuamah paknamtui hal a, Topa in Israel-te' mai-ah a hawlkhiat minamte in a zat uh a kihhuai gamtatnate mah bangin biakna-in a tapate a hal hi.
Tua ciangin amah in mual dawna biakpiaknate, le mual neute, le singniim nuai khempeuhah biakna pia-in paknamtui a hal hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in Syria kumpipa khut sungah amah pia a, amah in zo-in mi tampi salin Damaskas-ah a ciahpih hi. Israel kumpipa' khut sungah zong amah kipia a, amah zo-in a mite tampi tak a that hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in a pu a pate uh Pasian, Topa nusia uh ahih manin Remaliah' tapa Pekah in nikhat thu-in amaute galhang mihing tul zakhat le tul sawmnih, Judah gam sungah a that hi.
Tua ciangin Efraim mi a thahat Zikri in Kumpi Ahaz' tapa Maaseiah le kumpi inn a uk Azrikam le kumpipa zomah aana a nei Elkanah a that hi.
Israel mite in amau' beh Judah mite lak panin numeite, tapate, le tanute, mihing tul zanih salin a man uh hi. Amaute in amau' kiang panin van tampi zong la-in tua vante Samaria-ah a ciahpih uh hi.
Ahih hangin Oded min nei Topa' kamsang khat tua lai-ah om hi. Samaria-ah hong tung galkapte a dawn dingin amah paikhia-in amaute kiangah, "En un, Judah tungah na pu na pate uh Pasian Topa heh ahih manin note' khut sungah amaute hong pia a, ahih hangin note in heh mahmahna tawh amaute na that uh a, tua in vantung dong ban hi.
Tu-in note in Judah mi le Jerusalem mi, numei le pasalte, na sal dingun nuaisiah na sawm uh hi. Topa na Pasian uh tungah nomau mahmah in khialhna nei hi lo na hi uh hiam?
Tu-in ka thugen hong za unla, na behte uh kiang panin na lak uh na galmatte uh puakkik un; bang hang hiam cih leh note tungah Topa' hehna a lauhuai om hi," a ci hi.
Efraim mi ukpite pawkhat, Johanan' tapa Azariah, Meshillemoth' tapa Berekhiah, Shallum' tapa Jehizkiah, le Hadlai' tapa Amasa, galsung panin hong tungte' langkhatah pangin
amaute kiangah, "Tuhuna i khialhnate le i mawhna behlapin Topa' tungah mawhna eite tungah behlap hong sawm na hih manun hih lai-ah galmatte nong tunpih kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh i mawhna lian khinzo a, Israel tungah a lauhuai hehna om hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin galhiam tawi mite in uliante le a kikhawm khempeuh' mai-ah galmatte le a lak uh nate nusia uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua na a sem dingin mite dingin galmatte la uh a, amaute lakah guaktangin a omte, a vanlakte uh sung pan puante silhsak uh hi. Amaute puan silhsak uh a, khedap kaihte pia-in anletui vak uh a, sathau nilh uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute lakah a tha ginalote la tungah pua uh a, nisuh khuapi ahi Jerikho khua amau' behte kiangah paipih uh hi. Tua ciangin Samaria-ah amaute ciahkik uh hi.
Tua hun laitakin Kumpi Ahaz in Assiria kumpipa kiangah huhna a ngen dingin mi a sawl hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Edom mite in Judah simkikin zo uh a, galmatin a mite puakhia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Filistia mite in Shefelah le Judah-te' Negeb gam sung khuapite luh uh a, Bethshemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soko a khuaneute tawh, Timnah a khuaneute tawh, le Gimzo a khuaneute tawh la uh a, amaute tua munah teng uh hi.
Judah Kumpi Ahaz pen Judah mite tungah kihihsakna tawh gamta-in Topa' tungah citak lo ahih manin ama hangin Topa in Judah mite niamkoih hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kumpi Ahaz' ngetna zui-in Assiria kumpipa Tiglathpileser hong kuan hi. Ahi zongin amah thakhauhsakzaw loin gimsakzaw hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Ahaz in Topa' biakinn, kumpipa' inn, le uliante' inn panin vanmanphate la-in Assiria kumpipa tungah siah pia a, ahih hangin hihte khempeuh a kimanna om lo hi.
Hih Kumpi Ahaz mah pen, a lungkham hunin Topa' tungah citak lozaw lai hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah a zo Damaskas-te' pasian-te tungah biakna pia-in, "Syria kumpite' pasian-te in amaute huh ahih manin amaute in kei hong huh theih nadingun amau' tungah biakna ka pia ding hi," ci hi. Ahih hangin tua pasian-te pen amah le a mipihte khempeuh' siatna ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Ahaz in Pasian' biakinn-a umlebeelte khawmin satnen a, tua ciangin Topa' biakinn kongkhakte a kalhcip hi. Tua ciangin ama a dingin Jerusalem kiu khempeuhah biakna tau a bawl hi.
Amah in pasian dangte tungah paknamtui hal nadingin Judah khuapi khempeuhah mual dawna biakpiaknate bawl a, a pu a pate' Pasian, Topa a heh nadingin a phin hi.
Tu-in ama gamtatna a omlaite le a omzia khempeuh, a patna panin a tawpna dong, Judah le Israel Kumpite' Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi.
Tua ciangin Ahaz si a, amaute in Jerusalem khuapi sungah vui uh a, ahi zongin Judah kumpite tawh vuikhawm lo uh hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Hezekiah in ama tangin a uk hi.
Hezekiah in uk ding a kipatin kum sawmnih le nga pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kum sawmnih le kua sung uk hi. Ama nu' min Abijah hi a, Zekhariah' tanu ahi hi.
A pu David' hihnasa khempeuh bangin Topa' mitah a man gamta hi.
Ama uk a kum khatna, a kha masa sungin amah in Topa' biakinn kongkhakte hongin tuate a puah hi.
Amah in siampite le Levi mite paipihin nisuahna lam mun awngah amaute khawmin
amaute kiangah, "Levi mite aw, ka thugen hong za un! Tuni-in nomau kisiansuah unla, na pu na pate uh Pasian, Topa' biakinn siangthosakin a ninsak thei na khempeuh siangtho mun panin nawnkhia un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh i pute i pate citak lo a, Topa i Pasian' muhna-ah a sia gamta uh hi. Amaute in amah nusia-in, Topa i Pasian' muhna-ah a sia gamta uh hi. Amaute in amah nusia-in, Topa' tenna panin a mai uh heikhia uh a, a nung uh ngat uh hi.
Amaute in innliim kongkhakte zong khakin meivakte sumit uh a, siangtho munah paknamtui halna le meihal biaknate Israel Pasian tungah bawl lo uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh en un, hih thu hangin namsau-in i pu i pate puk uh a, i tapate, i tanute, le i zite galmatin om uh hi.
Tu-in a lauhuai a hehna eite tung pan a kiheikhiat theih nadingin Israel Pasian, Topa tawh thuciamna khat bawl ding ka lungsimah om hi.
Ka tate aw, Topa in ama omna-ah a ding ding, ama na a sem ding, le ama nasemte hi-in ama tungah paknamtui a hal dingin note hong teel khin ahih manin tu-in mawk om kei un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Levi mite, Kohath' beh sung panin Amasai' tapa Mahath, le Azariah' tapa Joel; Merari' beh sung panin Abdi' tapa Kish, le Jehallelel' tapa Azariah; Gershon beh sung panin Zimmah' tapa Joah, le Joah' tapa Eden;
Elizafan' beh sung panin Shimri le Jeuel; Asaf' beh sung panin Zekhariah le Mattaniah;
Heman' beh sung panin Jehiel le Shimei; Jeduthun' beh sung panin Shemaiah le Uzziel kipan uh hi.
Amaute in a sanggamte uh khawmin amau kisiansuah uh a, Topa' genna tawh kumpipa' thupiak bangin Topa' biakinn a puahsiang dingin a tum uh hi.
A puahsiang dingin Topa' biakinn sung tawngnungah a siampite lut uh a, Topa' biakinn sunga a muh uh a nin khempeuh Topa' biakinn tualah hong paikhiatpih uh hi. Tua ciangin Levi mite in la-in Kidron lui-ah puakhia uh hi.
Kha masa a ni masa ni-in amaute in siansuah ding kipan uh a, tua kha a ni giat ni-in Topa' innlimah amaute hong pai uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in ni giat sung Topa' biakinn siansuah uh a, a kha masa a ni sawm le guk ni-in zo uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa Hezekiah kiangah amaute tumin, " Topa' biakinn khempeuh, meihal biakna tau le a nazatte khempeuh, le Ompihna Anlum sabuai le a nazatte khempeuh ka puahsiang khin uh hi.
Kumpi Ahaz a cihtak loh laitakin ama uk sungin a paihkhiat nazat khempeuh a baihsa-in bawlin ka siansuah uh hi. Topa' biakna tau mai-ah tu-in tuate om hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa Hezekiah tho baihin khuapi sung zaneite khawmin Topa' biakinn-ah a paito uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in kumpi gam le biakinn le Judah a dingin khialhna hanga biakna-in bawngtal sagih, tuutal sagih, tuuno sagih, le keel sagih hong paipih uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in Topa' biakna tau tungah tuate a pia dingin Aaron' suan siampite a sawl hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in a bawngtalte go uh a, siampite in a sisan la-in biakna tau tungah theh uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in tuutalte go-in a sisan tawh biakna tau theh uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in tuunote go-in a sisan tawh biakna tau theh uh hi.
Tua ciangin khialhna hanga biakna ding keeltal sagihte kumpipa le a kikhawmte kiangah hong kipaipih a, amaute in tuate tungah a khut uh nga hi;
tua ciangin Israel khempeuh a dingin pumkhat suahna bawl nadingin siampite in go-in tuate' sisan tawh biakna tau tungah khialhna hanga biakna a bawl uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel khempeuh a dingin meihal biakna le khialhna hanga biakna a bawl ding uh kumpipa in thu pia hi.
Tua ciangin amah in David le kumpipa' thumu pa Gad le kamsang Nathan' thupiakna bangin Topa' biakinn sungah daltuahte, harp lasaknate, le laiza lasaknate tawh Levi mite a koih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua thupiakna pen kamsangte' tungtawnin Topa' kiang pan a hong pai ahi hi.
Tua ciangin biakna tau tungah meihal biakna a kipiakna ding Hezekiah in thu a pia hi. Meihal biakna a kipat ciangin Topa' tungah lasakna zong kipan a, Israel kumpi David' lasaknate in peengkulte pawm hi.
A kikhawm khempeuh in Pasian bia-in, lasate inla sa uh a, peengkul tumte in peengkul tum uh hi. Meihal biakna a kiman mateng hihte khempeuh hih paisuak uh hi.
Biakpiakna a kiman ciangin kumpipa le amah tawh a om khempeuhte kunin Pasian a bia uh hi.
Tua ciangin David' kammalte le thumu pa Asaf' kammalte zangin Topa' tungah phatna la a sak nadingun kumpipa Hezekiah le uliante in Levi mite thu a pia uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in lungdamna tawh phatna late sa uh a, tua ciangin amaute kunin Pasian a bia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Hezekiah in, "Tu-in Topa' tungah nomau mah na ki-ap khin uh hi. A nai-ah hong pai unla Topa' biakinn-ah biakpiaknate le lungdam piaknate hong paipih un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin a kikhawmte in biakpiaknate le lungdam piaknate hong paipih uh hi. Tua ciangin piaknopna lungsim a nei khempeuh in meihal biaknate hong paipih uh hi.
A kikhawmte in a hong paipih meihal biakna a phazah bawngtal sawmsagih, tuutal zakhat, le tuuno zanih hi a, hihte khempeuh pen Topa' tungah meihal biakna khat ahi hi.
A ki-ap biaknate bawngtal zaguk le tuu tulthum ahi hi.
Ahih hangin siampite a mi tawmlua uh ahih manin meihal biaknate khempeuh a vun hawk khin zo lo uh a, siampi dangte a kisiansuah ma sungteng, a sanggam uh Levi mite in nasep a kizawh mateng amaute huh uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh kisiansuahna thu-ah siampite sangin Levi mite ngentel zaw uh hi.
Meihal biakna a tampite banah thunuama biakna thaute, le meihal biakna a dingin leenggahzu tawh biaknate om hi. Tua bangin Topa' biakinn sungah nasepna ki-omsakkik hi.
Pasian in mite a dingin a bawlsak thute hangin Hezekiah le mi khempeuh lungdam uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua thu thakhatin hong piangvat hi.
Israel Pasian, Topa' Paisan Pawi a bawl dingin Jerusalem-a Topa' biakinn-ah hong pai nadingun Hezekiah in Israel mi khempeuh le Judah mite kiangah mi sawl a, Efraim mite le Manasseh mite tungah zong laikhakte a gelh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa le a uliante le Jerusalem-a a kikhawm khempeuh in Paisan Pawi a kha nihna sungin bawl ding kikum khin uh hi.
Siampite mi a kicingzah ding amau kisiansuah nai lo uh a, mite zong Jerusalem-ah kikhawm nai lo uh ahih manin a hunin bawl thei lo uh hi.
Hih geelna pen kumpipa le a kikhawm khempeuh a dingin hoih leh kilawm hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mite hong pai-in Israel Pasian, Topa a dingin Jerusalem-ah Paisan Pawi a bawl nadingun Beersheba panin Dan ciang dong Israel sung khempeuhah taangkona khat a bawlna ding uh thukhensatna khat bawl uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh bawl dinga a kigen bangin amaute in a lianpi-in bawl ngei lo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa le a uliante kiang pana laikhakte tawh Israel khempeuh le Judah sungah laikhakte tawh pai uh a, kumpipa' thupiakna: "Israel mite aw, Assiria kumpite' khutsung panin a suakta, a omlai note' lamah amah hong kiheikik theih nadingin Abraham, Isaac, le Israel Pasian, Topa' lamah kiheikik un.
Note in na theih uh bangin, amau' pute pate' Topa Pasian' tungah a cihtak lohna uh hangin nakpitakin gim a piak na pute na pate uh le na sanggamte uh bang kei un.
Tu-in na pute na pate uh bangin lungkhauh kei unla, note kiang panin a lauhuai ama hehna a kiheikhiat theih nadingin Topa' lamah kipia unla, amah in a tawntung dingin a sianthosaksa a biakinn-ah Topa na Pasian uh bia un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uhleh Topa' lamah note na kilehkik uhleh, na sanggamte uh le na tate un amau a mante' tung panin hehpihna ngahin hih gamah hong ciahkik ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa na Pasian uh dikna le hehpihna a nei hi a, ama lamah na kiheikik nak-uhleh note kiang panin a maitang heikhia lo ding hi," ci-in a gen uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Efraim le Manasseh gam sung khuapi khat pan khuapi khat, le Zebulun ciang dongah laitaite a pai uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute in na nuihsanin zahpih uh a, na simmawh bawl uh hi.
Asher mi, Manasseh, le Zebulun mi tawmkhat bek kiniamkhiatin Jerusalem-ah hong pai uh hi.
Topa' thupiakna tawh kumpipa le uliante' sawlna a sem dingin Judah mite tungah Pasian in lungsim kikhatna a guan hi.
Tua ciangin a kha nihna sungin silngo sawh loh anlum pawi a bawl dingin Jerusalem-ah mihon tampi tak hong pai uh hi.
Amaute nasem dingin kipanin Jerusalem-a biakna taute hemkhia uh a, paknamtui halna ding biakna taute khempeuh amaute in lakhia-in Kidron kuamah paai uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in a kha nihna a ni sawm le li ni-in Paisan Pawi tuuno go uh hi. Tua ciangin biakna vai-in a siangtho nai lo siampite le Levi mite nakpitakin maizum uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amau mah kisiansuahin Topa' biakinn sungah meihal biaknate hong paipih uh hi.
Pasian' mipa Moses' thukham bangin amaute in amau' panmun ngei hong la uh a, siampite in Levi mite' khut tung panin a ngah uh sisan theh uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a kikhawm lakah amau mah a kisiansuah nai lo tampi om uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Topa' tungah a siangtho-in a kibawl nadingun a nin khempeuh a dingin Levi mite in Paisan Pawi tuuno a gawh ding uh kisam hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh mi tampi tak, Efraim, Manasseh, Issakhar, le Zebulun sung pan, amau mah kisiansuah nai lo uh a, ahi zongin ngeina lopi-in amaute in Paisan Pawi ne uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Hezekiah in amaute a dingin thu ngenin, "Ka pute ka pate uh' Pasian a dik Topa aw,
biakinn sianthona ngeina om bangin lungsim tak tawh nang hong biate khempeuh' mawhna maisak in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Hezekiah' thungetna pia-in mite' mawhna maisak a, gimna ngahsak lo hi.
Tua ciangin Jerusalem-ah a om Israel mite in lungdamna lianpi tawh ni sagih sung silngo sawh loh anlum pawi a bawl uh hi. Tua ciangin Levi mite le siampite in a hatna khempeuh uh tawh Topa la sak uh a, a ni ni-in Topa phat uh hi.
Tua ciangin Hezekiah in Topa' nasepna-ah a siamna hoih uh a lak Levi mite khempeuh tungah hanthotna thu a gen hi. Tua ahih ciangin mite in pawi an ni sagih sung ne uh a, thunuama biakna pia-in a pu a pate uh Pasian, Topa tungah lungdamna a ko uh hi.
Tua ciangin adang ni sagih sung mah tua pawi a bawlthuah lai ding uh a kikhawm khempeuh thukim uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in lungdamna tawh adang ni sagih sung mah bawlthuah uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Judah kumpipa Hezekiah in biakpiak nadingin a kikhawmte tungah bawngtal tulkhat le tuu tulsagih pia a, uliante in a kikhawmte tungah bawngtal tulkhat le tuu tul sawm pia uh hi. Siampite tampi tak amau mah kisiansuah uh hi.
Judah mi a kikhawm khempeuh, le siampite le Levi mite, le Israel panin a hong paikhia a kikhawm khempeuh, le Israel gam panin a hong paikhia peemtate, le Judah gam sungah a teng peemtate, lungdam uh hi.
Israel kumpi David' tapa Solomon hun a kipanin Jerusalem-ah hih bang om ngei lo ahih manin Jerusalem-ah lungdamna lianpi a om hi.
Tua ahih ciangin siampite le Levi mite dingin mite thupha pia uh a, amau' awging kiza-in, amau' thungetna in vantung a a siangtho ama tenna a banto hi.
Tu-in hihte khempeuh a man ciangin, tua lai-a a om Israel khempeuh Judah khuapite-ah pai-in biakna songte sat khamin Asherah milimte phukin, Judah le Benjamin sung, le Efraim le Manasseh sunga mual dawna biakpiaknate le biakna taute a suksiat khit mateng uh phelkek uh hi. Tua ciangin Israel mi khempeuh, a mi kimin amau' inn omna a khuapi ciat uhah a ciah uh hi.
Tua ciangin Hezekiah in siampite le Levi mite amau' nasep ciat tawh kizui-in a khen a khenin seh a, siampite le Levi mite in meihal biaknate le thunuama biaknate pia-in, Topa' biakinn sung phual tuamtuamte-ah na semin lungdamkohna le phatna a bawl ding uh ahi hi.
Kumpipa in ama neihsa sung panin a piakte pen meihal biakna ding ahi hi. Topa' thukham sungah a kigelh mah bangin zing le nitak a meihal biaknate, Sabbath nite, Khadet nite, le a kiseh pawite a dingin meihal biaknate ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' thukham om bangin nasepna-ah siampite le Levi mite a kibuppiak theih nadingun amau' ngah ding a kilawm nate, Jerusalem-a a teng mite in amaute tungah a piak nadingun amah in a sawl hi.
Tua thupiakna a kitheihthang phetin Israel mite in anpalte, leenggahzu, le lo-a piang khempeuh tampi tak hong pia uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in na khempeuh sung pan sawm-ah-khat ahi tampi tak hong paipih uh hi.
Tua ciangin Judah khuapite sungah a teng Israel mite le Judah mite in zong bawng le tuu sawm-ah-khat le Topa a Pasian uh tungah a kipiasa a ki-ap nate hong paipih uh a, a lom a lomin a koih uh hi.
A kha thumna sungin amaute in tua a lomte cian ding kipan uh a, a kha sagihna sungin a mansiang uh hi.
Hezekiah le uliante hong pai-in a lomte a muh uh ciangin amaute in Topa le ama mi Israel-te thupha a pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Hezekiah in a lomte' thu, siampite le Levi mite a dong hi.
Zadok' suan ahi siampi lianpen pa Azariah in amah dawngin, "Amaute in amau' piakte uh Topa' biakinn sungah paipih ding hong kipat uh a kipan kote in an ka ne uh a, a kicing nei-in tampi vallai hi. Topa in ama mite thupha pia ahih manin hih na tampi a omlai i nei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Topa' biakinn sungah inndeite a bawlna ding uh Hezekiah in thu pia a, amaute in zong a deite a bawl uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in a piaknate, sawm-ah-khat le a ki-ap nate cihtakna tawh hong paipih uh hi. Tuate a en ulian pen pa Levi mi Konaniah hi a, a sanggampa Shimei pen amah a huhpa ahi hi.
Kumpipa Hezekiah le Pasian' biakinn ukpa Azariah' sehna tawh Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismakhiah, Mahath, le Benaiah-te in Konaniah le a sanggampa Shimei huhin a ukte ahi uh hi.
Tua ciangin nisuahna lam kulhkongpi cing pa, Levi mi Imnah tapa Kore pen Topa a' ding le siangtho pen biak nadingin koihcing dingin a kipiate a sehkhen dingin, Topa' tungah utthu-a piaknate a ukpa ahi hi.
Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, le Shekaniah-te in siampite' khuapi sungah a moi a ham a kibangin a khen khenin, a ngah ding ciat a sanggamte uh tungah a hawm dingin cihtakna tawh amah huh uh hi.
Khangsimna-a amau' kiciamtehna tawh kisai-in a kipia hi tuan loin, a khen khenin amau' panmun tawh kizui-in nisimin nasepna-ah a kisam bangin Topa' biakinn sungah a lut, kum thum le a tungsiah a pha pasal khempeuh tungah tanh kipia kim hi.
Siampite a beh zui-in nasep kipia hi. Levi mi kum sawmnih le a tungsiahte a khen khenin amau' panmun tawh kizui-in nasep kipia hi.
Siampite a naupangte khempeuh, a zite, a tapate, le a tanute uh tawh a mihon bupin kiciamteh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a siangtho-in a kikepna uhah amaute citak uh hi.
Amau' khuapite-a' ahi taang gam lote-ah a om Aaron' suan siampite a' ding ahihleh, a kiciamteh siampite' lak le Levi mite lakah pasal khempeuh tungah amau' ngah ding ciat a hawmkhia dingin a minin a kiseh mi, khuapi tampite sungah a om hi.
Tua bangin Hezekiah in Judah gam sung khempeuhah hih hi. Amah in Topa a Pasian' mai-ah a hoih le a manin gamta-in cihtakna tawh a sem hi.
Amah in Pasian' biakinn sung nasepna le thukham le thupiaknate tawh kizui-in a hihna-ah ama Pasian zongin, a lungsim khempeuh tawh sem a, a maa a vang hi.
Hih thute khempeuh le citak a hih banga na a kisep khit ciangin Assiria kumpipa Sennakherib hong pai-in Judah simin kulhnei khuapite' langkhatah phual sat a, ama a dingin lak a sawm hi.
amah in a uliante le a mi thahatte tawh khuapi pualamah a luangkhia tuinakte khakcip ding vaihawm a, amaute in amah a huh uh hi.
Mi tampi tak kikhawm uh a, gam sungah a luang tuinak le lui khempeuh khakcipin, "Bang hangin Assiria kumpite hong pai-in tui tampi mu ding ahi uh hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Amah in lungsim khotakin sep ding kipan a, a cimsa kulh khempeuh ciangpha-in tua tungah tausangte koihto a, tua pualamah kulh dang khat a ciang hi. Amah in David khuapi sungah Millo a muanhuai-in a bawlpha hi. Amah in galhiamte le lumte zong tampi bawl hi.
Amah in mite a uk dingin galdona-ah a ukte koih a, khuapi kulhkongpi mun awnna ama kiangah amaute khawmin amaute tungah hanthotna tawh thu genin,
"Thakhauh unla hang un. Assiria kumpipa le amah tawh a om mihon khempeuh mai-ah lau kei unla, zong lungkia kei un; bang hang hiam cih leh amah tawh a omte sangin eite tawh a om pa lianzaw hi.
Amah in mihing thahatna nei a, ahih hangin eite hong huhin i gal hong dosak dingin Topa i Pasian in eite hong ompih hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin mite in Judah kumpipa Hezekiah' kammalte a muang uh hi.
Hih thute khit ciangin a galkap khempeuh tawh Lakhish a umcih, Assiria kumpipa Sennakherib in Judah kumpipa Hezekiah le Jerusalem-ah a om Judah mi khempeuh kiang Jerusalem-ah a nasemte sawlin,
"Assiria kumpipa Sennakherib in hih bangin ci hi: 'Note in Jerusalem umcihna na nanna ding uh bang suang na hi uh hiam?
Hezekiah in note kiangah, "Assiria kumpipa' khut panin Topa i Pasian in eite hong honkhia ding hi," hong cih ciangin, note gilkial dangtakin a hong sisak dingin amah in note hong makai khial hi lo ahi hiam?
Hih Hezekiah mah in mual dawna a biakpiaknate le ama biakna taute lakhia-in Judah le Jerusalem thu pia a, "Biakna tau khat mai-ah note in bia-in tua tungah na biakpiaknate uh na hal ding uh hi," ci hi lo ahi hiam?
Keimah le ka pu ka pate in gamdang mi khempeuh tungah ka hihnasate uh thei lo na hi uh hiam? Tua gam minamte' pasian in keima khutsung panin a gam uh honkhiazo ahi uh hiam?
Na Pasian un keima khutsung panin note hong hotkhiat theih nadingin ka pu ka pate in a suksiatmang tua minamte' pasian khempeuh lakah kua in a mite honkhiazo ngei ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in note, Hezekiah' khemsa-in ta kei unla, hih bangin kimakai khialsak kei un. Amah um kei un; bang hang hiam cih leh minam khatpeuh, kumpi gam khatpeuh' pasian in keima khut pan ahi a, ka pu ka pate' khutsung pan ahi zongin a mite honkhiazo ngei nai lo hi. Keima khutsung pan na Pasian un note hong honkhia zo lo zaw kan ding hi,' ci un," a cisak hi.
Tua ciangin ama nasemte in Topa Pasian le a nasempa Hezekiah langpangin thu tamzaw gen lai uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Israel Pasian, Topa' hehna ding le amah a langpanna-in laikhakte gelh a, "Ka khutsung panin a mite a honkhia zo lo gam sung minam dangte' pasian-te mah bangin ka khutsung panin Hezekiah' Pasian in a mite honkhia zo lo ding hi," ci hi.
Amaute in khuapi a laktheih nadingin khuapi mite lau-in a linglawnsak nadingun kulh tungah a om Jerusalem mite tungah Judah pau tawh nakpitakin kiko uh hi.
Amaute in, mite' khut tawh a kibawl leitung mite' pasian-te a gen bang lelun Jerusalem Pasian a gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa Hezekiah le Amoz' tapa, kamsang Isaiah in hih thu hangin thu ngenin vantung lamah kiko uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Assiria kumpipa' giahphual ah a thahat galhang khempeuh le galkap a ukte le uliante a susia vantungmi khat a sawl hi. Tua ahih ciangin ama gamah maizumna tawh a ciahkik hi. Ama pasian' inn sungah amah a tun ciangin ama tapate pawlkhat in namsau tawh amah satlum uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in Assiria kumpipa Sennakherib' khut le ama galte khempeuh panin Hezekiah le Jerusalem-a a tengte honkhia a, amah in mun khempeuh panin galdaihna amaute tungah a pia hi.
Tua ciangin mi tampi in Jerusalem khua Topa kiangah letsongte hong puakin, Judah kumpi Hezekiah kiangah na manphate hong puak uh a, tua hun a kipanin minam khempeuh' muhna-ah amah kisangtawi hi.
Tua hun lai-in Hezekiah cina-in si dektak a, amah in Topa' tungah thu ngen hi. Topa in a ngetna pia-in ama tungah lim khat a pia hi.
Ahih hangin a lungsim kiphasak ahih manin ama tungah phattuamna a kibawl zahin Topa' tungah Hezekiah in lungdam ko nuam lo hi. Tua ahih manin amah le Judah le Jerusalem tungah Topa' hehna hong tung hi.
Ahi zongin a nung ciangin Hezekiah a lungsim kiphatsakna thu-ah amah le Jerusalem-a teng mite tawh kiniamkhiat uh ahih manin amaute' tungah Topa' hehna hong tung lo hi.
Hezekiah hau mahmahin a min thang mahmah hi. Amah in ngun, kham, suangmanphate, a namtui nate, lumte, a manpha umlebeel khempeuh a dingin vanmanpha koihnate a bawl hi.
An, leenggahzu, le sathau koihna ding vankoihnate zong a bawl hi. Ganhing nam khempeuh a dingin ganbukte, le tuubukte a bawl hi.
Amah in tua bangmahin amahmah a dingin khuapite le tuuhonte le ganhonte tampi a koih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in ama tungah neihsa tampi tak pia hi.
Hih Hezekiah mah in Gihon tui tungnungte khaktanin David khuapi nitumna lampangah luangsak hi. Hezekiah a nasepna khempeuhah a maa vang hi.
Tua ahih ciangin gam sung omzia lim a kan dingin ama kiangah a kisawl Babylon uliante' kamtaite tawh kisai-in, amah a ze-etna ding le ama lungsim sungah bang om hiam cih a vekpi-in a theih nadingin Pasian in ama thu-in amah a omsak hi.
Tu-in Hezekiah' gamtatna a omlaite, le ama nasep hoihte, Judah le Israel Kumpite' Khang Tangthu Laibu sung, le Amoz' Tapa, Kamsang Isaiah' Maangmuhna sungah kigelh hi.
Tua ciangin Hezekiah si a, amaute in David' suante' han paina mualpangah amah vui uh hi. Judah mi khempeuh le Jerusalem-a tengte in a sih lai-in amah zahtakna bawl uh hi. Tua ciangin ama tapa Manasseh in ama tangin a uk hi.
Manasseh in uk ding a kipatin kum sawm le nih pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kum sawmnga le nga sung uk hi.
Topa in Israel minamte' mai-ah a hawlkhiat minamte' zat a kihhuai gamtatnate mah bangin, Topa' muhna-ah amah a sia gamta hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a pa Hezekiah in a suksiatsa mual dawna biakpiaknate amah in lamkikin, Baal-te a dingin biakna taute phut a, Asherah milimte bawlin vantung nate khempeuh bia a, tuate' na sem hi.
Topa in, "Jerusalem-ah ka min om tawntung ding hi," a cihna Topa' biakinn sungah amah in biakna taute a lam hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Topa' biakinn tual nihte sungah vantung nate khempeuh a dingin biakna taute lam hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Hinnom' tapa' kuamah biakna-in a tapate hal a, aisanna le mailam thugenkholhna le khongkhaina zang a, vankah theite le aisante tawh na semkhawm hi. Amah in Topa' muhna-ah siatna tampi bawl a, amah hehsak hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian in David le a tapa Solomon tungah, "Amaute ka thupiak khempeuh, thukham khempeuh, ngeinate, le Moses tungtawnin a kipia biakna ngeina kipte zuih ding a kidop nak-uhleh, Israel minam khempeuh sung panin ka teelkhiat hih biakinn sung le Jerusalem sungah ka min ka koih tawntung ding hi. Tua ciangin na pu na pate uh a dingin ka sehsa gam panin Israel-te ka khinkhia nawn kei ding hi," a cih Pasian' biakinn sungah amah in ama bawlsa milim koih hi.
Manasseh in Judah le Jerusalem-a tengte zol ahih manin, Israel mite' mai-ah Topa in a suksiat minamte sangin amaute a sia tamzaw gamta uh hi.
Topa in Manasseh tung le ama mite tungah thu gen a, ahih hangin amaute in don lo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in Assiria kumpipa' galkap ukte amau' kiangah paipih a, amaute in sikkawite tawh Manasseh manin sumngo khau tawh khihin Babylon-ah a paipih uh hi.
Amah a lungkham ciangin Topa a Pasian kunh-in a pu a pate' Pasian' mai-ah nakpitakin amahmah kiniamkhiat hi.
Amah in ama kiangah thu ngen a, tua ciangin Pasian in ama kutna saangin, a thumna a ngai hi. Amah in Jerusalem-ah amah paipih kikin a kumpi gam a piakik hi. Tua ciangin Topa pen Pasian ahihna Manasseh in a thei hi.
Tua khit ciangin amah in kuam sung, Gihon nitumna lam, David khuapi-ah, Ngasa Kongpi lutna lamah kulh puanung khat ciang a, Ofel kiimah ciang suakin a sang mahmahin ciangto hi. Amah in Judah gam sunga kulhnei khuapi khempeuhah zong galkap a ukte koih hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Topa' biakinn panin gamdang pasian-te le a milim lakhia a, Topa' biakinn mualtung le Jerusalem-a ama lamsa biakna tau khempeuh lakhia-in, khuapi pualamah tuate paai hi.
Amah in Topa' biakna tau zong koihkikin tua tungah thunuama biakna le lungdamkohna a pia hi. Tua ciangin amah in Israel Pasian, Topa' na a sep nadingun Judah-te thu a pia hi.
Ahi zongin mite in mual dawna biakpiaknate ah biakna pia lai uh a, ahih hangin Topa amaute' Pasian' tung bek mahah a piak uh ahi hi.
Tu-in Manasseh' gamtatna a omlaite, le a Pasian' tungah a thungetna, le Israel Pasian, Topa' min tawh ama tungah thu a gen thumute' thugente, Israel Kumpite' Khang Tangthu sungah om hi.
Tua ciangin ama thungetna, le ama kutna Pasian in a sanna, le ama khialhna le a cihtak lohna khempeuh, le amah a kiniamkhiat ma-in mual dawna biakpiaknate bawlin Asherah-te le milim dangte a koihna munte thu, Thumute' Khang Tangthu sungah kigelh hi.
Tua ciangin Manasseh si a, amaute in a inn sungah vui uh hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Amon in ama tangin a uk hi.
Amon in uk ding a kipatin kum sawmnih le nih pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kum nih sung uk hi.
A pa Manasseh' gamtatnasa khempeuh bangin Topa' muhna-ah amah a sia gamta hi. Amon in a pa Manasseh' bawlsa milim khempeuh tungah biakna pia a, tuate' na sem hi.
A pa Manasseh a kiniamkhiat bangin Topa' mai-ah amah kiniamkhiat lo a, hih Amon in mawhna tam piangsak semsem hi.
Ahih hangin tua gam mite in Kumpi Amon a sawmsim khempeuh that leuleu uh hi. Tua ciangin tua gam mite in ama tangin a tapa Josiah kumpi-in a koih uh hi.
Josiah in uk ding a kipatin kum giat pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kum sawmthum le khat sung uk hi.
Topa' mitah a man gamta a, a pu David' khekhap zui-in themkhat zong lampial lo hi.
Ama uk a kum giatna sung, naupang ahi laipi mahin, amah in a pu David' Pasian zon ding kipan hi. A kum sawm le nihna ciangin amah in Judah le Jerusalem panin mual dawna biaknate, Asherah milimte, le a kiseek le a kisung milimte beisiangsak ding kipan hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Baal-te' biakna taute ama muhna-ah supaisak hi. Tua ciangin amah in tuate tungah a om paknamtui biakna taute phuk a, Asherah milimte, le a kiseek le a kisung milimte sukhamin gawivui a, tuate' tungah biakna a pia mite' han tungah tua a vuite a theh hi.
Amah in amau' biakna taute tungah a siampite' guhte zong hal a, Judah le Jerusalem a siangsak hi.
Tua ciangin Manasseh, Efraim, le Simeon, le Naftali khuapi ciang dong, mun awngte le a kiim a pamah,
amah in biakna taute sukhamin Asherah milimte le milim dangte satvui a, Israel gam sung khempeuhah paknamtui biakna taute a satvui hi. Tua ciangin Jerusalem-ah a ciahkik hi.
Tu-in ama uk a kum sawm le giatna, gam sung le biakinn a siansak khit ciangin, Topa a Pasian' biakinn a puah dingin amah in Azariah' tapa Shafan, le khuapi sung ukpa Maaseiah, le thu ciamteh pa ahi, Joahaz' tapa Joah a sawl hi.
Siampi lianpen pa Hilkiah kiangah amaute hong pai uh a, kongcingte ahi Levi mite in Manasseh le Efraim, le Israel a omlaite khempeuh, le Judah le Benjamin khempeuh, le Jerusalem-a a teng mite tung panin a khop uh ahi, Pasian' biakinn-ah a hong kipaipih sumte a pia uh hi.
Amaute in Topa' biakinn a vaan nasemte tungah tua sumte pia uh hi. Tua ciangin Topa' biakinn-ah a sem nasemte in biakinn puahna ding le a ngei batsakkik nadingin pia uh hi.
Amaute in a kito suangte leina ding, le Judah kumpite in a siatsak, tep nadingin singte le biakinn lam nadingin innkamte leina dingin khutsiamte le innlamte tungah a sumte a pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin mite in cihtakna tawh na sem uh hi. Amaute tungah a en dingin Levi mi Merari-te beh sung pan Jahath le Obadiah, le Kohath-te beh sung pan Zekhariah le Meshullam kikoih hi. Levi mi, lasakna nazatte-ah siamna a nei khempeuh,
vangik puate a uk, le nasep namkim a sem khempeuh a makaih uh hi. Tua ciangin Levi mi pawlkhatte pen laigelhte, le za neite, le kulhkongpi cingte ahi hi.
Amaute in Topa' biakinn-ah a kipaipih sumte a lakkhiat laitakun siampi Hilkiah in Moses tungtawnin a kipia thukham laibu a mu hi.
Tua ciangin Hilkiah in lai-at pa Shafan kiangah, " Topa' biakinn sungah thukham laibu ka mu hi," ci hi. Tua ciangin Hilkiah in Shafan tungah a laibu pia hi.
Shafan in kumpipa kiangah a laibu paipihin ama kiangah, "Na nasemte tungah a kipia khempeuh amaute in a sep san laitak uh ahi hi.
Topa' biakinn sungah a kikoih sumte amaute in lakhia-in nasep vaante le nasemte tungah pia uh hi," ci-in gen thuah lai hi.
Tua ciangin lai-at pa Shafan in kumpipa kiangah, "Siampi Hilkiah in kei tungah laibu khat hong pia hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Shafan in kumpipa mai-ah tua laibu a sim hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Hilkiah, Shafan' tapa Ahikam, Mikah' tapa Abdon, lai-at pa Shafan, le kumpipa' nasempa Asaiah thu pia-in,
"Pai unla, a kimu laibu sunga kammalte tawh kisai-in keima a' ding le Israel le Judah-ah a omlai mite a dingin Topa thu va dong un; bang hang hiam cih leh i pu i pate in hih laibu sungah a kigelh khempeuh bangin sep ding Topa' kammal na zui lo uh ahih manin eite tungah Topa' hehna lian hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Hilkiah le kumpipa in a sawl mite, Hasrah, a tapa Tokhath, a tapa Shallum, biakinn puante a kem pa' zi ahi kamsangnu Huldah kiangah pai-in (tu-in tua nu Jerusalem sung a Veng Nihna-ah teng hi) tua thu tawh kisai ama kiangah va gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua nu in amaute kiangah, "Israel Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: 'Kei kiangah note a hong sawl pa kiangah gen un.
Topa in hih bangin ci hi: En un, Judah kumpipa mai-ah a kisim laibu sunga kigelh samsiatnate khempeuh ahi siatna, hih mun le a tungah a teng mi khempeuh tungah ka tungsak ding hi.
Amaute in amau' gamtatna tawh kei hong hehsak theih nadingun amaute in kei hong nusia-in pasian dangte tungah paknamtui hal uh ahih manin hih mun tungah ka hehna kisungin dai lo ding hi.
hih mun le a tunga tengte langpanna ama kammal na zak ciangin na lungsim kisikin Pasian' mai-ah na kiniamkhiat a, keima mai-ah nang kiniamkhiatin na puante balkekin ka mai-ah kap na hih manin, kei zong nang kong za hi, Topa in ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in mi sawlin Judah le Jerusalem upa khempeuh kaikhawm hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa, Judah mite le Jerusalem-a a teng mite, siampite le Levi mite, le mi khempeuh a lian a neu tawh, Topa' biakinn-ah paito uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in Topa' biakinn sungah a kimu thuciamna laibu sunga thute khempeuh amau' zakin a sim hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa ama munah dingin, hih laibu sungah a kigelh thuciamna kammalte a sem dingin a lungsim khempeuh le a nuntakna khempeuh tawh Topa' nung a zuihna ding le ama thupiaknate, ama tecipannate, le a thukhamte a zuihna ding, Topa' mai-ah thuciamna khat a bawl hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Jerusalem le Benjamin sunga a om mi khempeuh hih thu a zuisak hi. Tua ciangin Jerusalem-a teng mite zong amau' pute pate' Pasian ahi Pasian' thuciamna bangin a gamta uh hi.
Tua ciangin Josiah in Israel mite' neihsa gam sung khempeuh panin a kihhuaite khempeuh lakhia a, Israel sunga om mi khempeuh Topa amaute' Pasian' na a semsak hi. Ama nuntak sung khempeuh amau' pute pate' Pasian ahi Topa zuihna panin amaute kiheikhia lo uh hi.
Josiah in Topa a dingin Jerusalem-ah Paisan Pawi bawl hi. Amaute in a kha masa a ni sawm le li ni-in Paisan Pawi tuuno go uh hi.
Amah in siampite amau' panmunte-ah seh a, Topa' biakinn sunga nasepna-ah amaute hanthawn hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Israel khempeuh hilhin Topa' tungah a siangtho Levi mite tungah, "Israel kumpipa, David' tapa Solomon in a lam biakinn sungah Thuciamna Singkuang siangtho koih un. Na liangko tung uhah na puak ding uh kisam nawn lo hi. Tu-in Topa na Pasian uh le ama mi Israel-te' na sem un.
Note a khenkhenin na beh uh tawh kizui-in kithawi unla, Israel kumpipa David' lamlahna le a tapa Solomon' lamlahna zui un.
Tua ciangin mi nautang na sanggamte uh beh kikhenna tawh kizui-in siangtho munah ding uh hen la, Levi minam beh tuamtuamte sung pan kihelkim un.
Tua ciangin Paisan Pawi bawlna ganhing go-in nomau mah kisiansuah unla, Moses' tungtawnin Topa' thugen bangin na sanggamte uh a dingin kithawi un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Josiah in tua lai-a a om mi khempeuhte a dingin Paisan Pawi piakna-in a ganhon panin mi nautangte tungah tuunote le keelnote tul sawmthum ciang dong, le bawngtal tulthum a pia hi. Hihte pen kumpipa' neihsa sung pan a kipia ahi hi.
Tua ciangin ama uliante in zong utna lungsim tawh mite tung, siampite tung, le Levi mite tungah a pia uh hi. Pasian' biakinn-ah ulianpite ahi Hilkiah, Zekhariah, le Jehiel-te in siampite tungah Paisan Pawi bawl nadingin tuuno le keelno tulnih le zaguk, le bawngtal zathum a pia uh hi.
Levi mi ukpite Konaniah, Shemaiah, le a sanggam Nethanel, Hashabiah, Jeiel le Jozabad-te in Paisan Pawi piak nadingin Levi mite tungah tuuno le keelno tulnga, le bawngtal zanga a pia uh hi.
Nasepna ding a kithawi khit uh ciangin, siampite amau' munah ding uh a, kumpipa' thupiakna bangin Levi mite amau' khen sungah om uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Paisan tuuno go uh a, Levi mite in a vun a hawk laitakun siampite in amau' tung panin a ngah uh sisan a theh uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, Moses laibu sungah a kigelh bangin Topa' tungah piak dingin mi nautang sungah a innkuan a pawlpawl tawh kizui-in a hawm theih nadingun meihal biaknate a tuamkoih uh hi. Tua bangin amaute in bawngtalte zong a hih uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in biakna ngeina kip tawh kizui-in Paisan tuuno sa mei-ah a hang uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in beel sung, beelpi sung, le sikbeel daite sungah a siangtho piaknate huan uh a, mi nautang khempeuh kiangah tuate manlang takin a puak uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin amau a' ding le siampite a dingin amau mah in a sa bawl uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Aaron' suan siampite zankim ciang dong meihal biakna pia-in manlah uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Levi mite in amau a' ding le Aaron' suan siampite a dingin a sa bawl uh hi.
David' thupiak bangin Asaf' behte ahi lasate, le Asaf, le Heman, le kumpipa' thumu pa Jeduthun-te amau' munah om uh hi. Kulhkongpi cingte a kulhkongpi ciatah om uh a, amau' sanggam Levi mite in amau a dingin sa bawlsak uh ahih manin amau' nasepna pan amaute a paikhiat ding uh kisam lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kumpi Josiah' thupiakna bangin Paisan Pawi bawlna ding le Topa' biakna tau tungah meihal biaknate piak nadingin tua ni-in Topa' nasepna ding khempeuh a kithawi uh hi.
Tua lai-ah a om Israel mite in tua hunin Paisan Pawi, le Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi ni sagih sung a bawl uh hi.
Kamsang Samuel huna kipan Israel sungah tua bang Paisan Pawi kibawl ngei lo hi. Josiah le siampite le Levi mite, le tua lai-ah a om Judah le Israel mi khempeuh, le Jerusalem-a a teng mite in a bawl Paisan Pawi tawh a kibang, Israel kumpite kuamah in bawl ngei lo hi.
Josiah' uk a kum sawm le giatna kumin hih Paisan Pawi kibawl hi.
Hih thute khempeuh khit, Josiah in biakinn a bawl khit ciangin, Eufratis gun gei Karkhemish-ah galsim dingin Egypt kumpipa Neko hong kuanto a, amah a do dingin Josiah a kuankhia hi.
Ahih hangin Neko in ama kiangah kamtaite sawlin, "Judah kumpipa aw, ei tegel khatlekhat i kihihna ding bang om ahi hiam? Tu-in nang a sim dingin hong kuan ka hi kei a, ka galte a sim dingin a hong kuan ka hi hi. Ka kinawhna ding Pasian in kei tungah thu hong pia khin hi. Kei tawh a omkhawm Pasian na nialna khawl in. Tua hikeileh nang hong susia ding hi," cisak hi.
Ahi zongin ama kiang panin Josiah kiheikhia nuam lo a, amah tawh a kido theih nadingin a mel kiseel hi. Amah in Neko' kam pana Pasian' thugente ngai lo a, Megiddo zanglei-a gal kidona-ah va pawm hi.
Tua ciangin thaltawite in Kumpi Josiah kap hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in a nasemte kiangah, "Nakpi takin liam ka hih manin kei hong paikhiatpih un," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a nasemte in leeng sung panin amah lakhia-in ama leeng nihna sungah amah pua-in Jerusalem-ah a paipih uh hi. Tua ciangin amah si a, a pate' han sungah kivui hi. Judah gam le Jerusalem khuami khempeuh Josiah' hangin kap uh hi.
Jeremiah in zong Josiah' hangin kah la a phuak hi. Numei lasate le pasal lasate khempeuh in tuni dongin amau' kahna-ah Josiah tamlawh uh hi. Amaute in Israel sungah hih thu biakna ngeina kipin a bawl uh hi. Kah la sungah tuate kikhum hi.
Tu-in Josiah' gamtatna a omlaite, le Topa' thukham sungah a kigelh bangin a nasep hoihte,
le ama gamtatna, a masa le a nunungte, Israel le Judah Kumpite' Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi.
Tua gam mite in Josiah' tapa Jehoahaz la-in Jerusalem-ah a pa' tangin kumpi-in a koih uh hi.
Jehoahaz in uk ding a kipatin kum sawmnih le thum pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kha thum sung uk hi.
Tua ciangin Egypt kumpipa in Jerusalem-ah amah zakiasak a, siah ngun talen zakhat le kham talen khat, tua gam kipiasak hi.
Tua ciangin Egypt kumpipa in Judah le Jerusalem tungah a ukin Jehoahaz' sanggampa Eliakim koih a, ama min Jehoiakim-in kheelsak hi. Ahih hangin Neko in a sanggampa Jehoahaz la-in Egypt-ah a paipih hi.
Jehoiakim in uk ding a kipatin kum sawmnih le nga pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kum sawm le khat sung uk hi. Topa a Pasian mai-ah amah a sia gamta hi.
Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar amah a simin hong kuanto a, Babylon-ah a paipih dingin amah kol bulh hi.
Nebukhadnezzar in Topa' biakinn-a umlebeel pawlkhatte zong Babylon-ah pua-in Babylon-a a kumpi inn-ah tuate a koih hi.
Tu-in Jehoiakim' gamtatna a omlaite, le ama hih a kihhuaite, le amah a hoih lohna a kimute, Israel le Judah Kumpite' Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Jehoiakhin in ama tangin a uk hi.
Jehoiakhin in uk ding a kipatin kum sawm le giat pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kha thum le ni sawm sung uk hi. Topa' muhna-ah amah a sia gamta hi.
Tua kum khuakhal sungin Kumpi Nebukhadnezzar in mi sawlin Topa' biakinn-a umlebeel manphate tawh amah Babylon-ah lasak a, Judah le Jerusalem tungah Jehoiakhin' sanggampa Zedekiah kumpi-in a koih hi.
Zedekiah in uk ding a kipatin kum sawmnih le khat pha a, amah in Jerusalem-ah kum sawm le khat sung uk hi.
Topa a Pasian' muhna-ah amah a sia gamta hi. Topa' kammal a gensawn kamsang Jeremiah mai-ah amah kiniamkhiat lo hi.
Pasian tawh amah a kiciamsak kumpi Nebukhadnezzar zong amah in lehdo hi. Israel Pasian, Topa' kiang zuankik nuam lo a, zong kisik nuam loin a lung khauhsak hi.
A makai siampite le mi khempeuh zong tua bangmahin citak lo mahmah uh a, minam dangte' kihhuainate zui uh hi. Amah in Jerusalem-ah a siangtho-in a koih Topa' biakinn amaute in ninsak uh hi.
A mite le ama tenna mun khasiat ahih manin amau' pute pate' Pasian, Topa in a kamtaite amaute kiangah sawl teitei hi.
Ahih hangin a mite tungah Topa a heh ciang dong, a hehna a kidamsak zawh nawn loh ciang dongin amaute in Pasian' kamtaite zahpihin, a thute simmawhin, a kamsangte thusim lo niloh uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in Khaldea mite' kumpipa amaute' langkhatah paipih a, tua kumpipa in amau' Pasian' biakinn sung nangawnah namsau tawh a tangvalte uh that a, numei pasal, a moi a ham, a dam a na, kuamah khasiat lo hi. Pasian in a vekpi-in ama khut sungah a pia hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' biakinn-a umlebeel khempeuh a lian a neu, le Topa' biakinn-a vanmanphate, le kumpipa le a uliante' vanmanphate khempeuh amah in Babylon-ah paipih hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Pasian' biakinn halin Jerusalem khua susia uh a, a kumpi inn khempeuh mei tawh halin umlebeel a manpha khempeuh a susia uh hi.
Amah in namsau panin a suakta mite Babylon-ah salin la a, Persia kumpi in a uk hun mateng amah le a suanlekhakte' nasem a suak uh hi.
Tua sungin Israel leitang in a sabbath-te a kicingin na tang hi. Kamsang Jeremiah tungtawnin Topa' thugen a tun nadingin kum sawmsagih a cin nadingin leitang a kinusiat sung khempeuh leitang in sabbath tawlngakna a nei ahi hi.
Tu-in Persia kumpipa Sairas' kum khatna kumin, Jeremiah' kam pana Topa' thugen a tun theih nadingin, Topa in Persia kumpipa Sairas' lungsim hanthawn a, amah in a kumpi gam sung khempeuhah taangkona khat bawl a, lai-in zong a gelh hi. A lai gelhna-ah,
"Persia kumpipa Sairas in hih bangin ci hi: 'Vantung Pasian, Topa in leitung kumpi gam khempeuh kei hong pia khin a, Judah gam sung Jerusalem khua-ah ama a dingin biakinn khat ka lamsak ding hong sawl hi. Note lakah ama mi ahi khempeuh, Topa a Pasian uh in ompih tahen. Biakinn lam dingin Jerusalem-ah amaute paito sak un,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Persia kumpi Sairas' uk kum khatna kumin, Jeremiah tungtawnin Topa' thugen a tun theih nadingin, ama gam sung khempeuhah taangkona khat bawlin lai-in zong a gelh nadingin Persia kumpi Sairas' lungsimah Topa in a suaksak hi. Amah in hih bangin a hih hi:
"Persia kumpi Sairas in hih bangin ci hi: Vantung Pasian, Topa in leitung kumpi gam khempeuh keima tungah hong pia khin a, Judah gam sung Jerusalem khua-ah ama a dingin biakinn khat ka lamsak ding hong sawl hi.
Note lakah ama mi peuhmah a Pasian in ompih hen la, Judah gam sung Jerusalem khua-ah paito hen la, Israel Pasian, Topa' biakinn lamkik hen. Amah pen Jerusalem-ah a om Pasian ahi hi.
Tua ciangin koilai mun koilai gam a om hitaleh Judah mi a omlai khempeuh, ama omna mun mite in Jerusalem-a om Pasian' biakinn a dingin utthu-a a piakte uh banah, ngun le kham, nate le ganhingte tawh zong huh ciat uh hen," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Judah le Benjamin sunga innkuan lutangte, le siampite le Levi mite, Jerusalem khua-a om Topa' biakinn a lamkik dingin a lungsim sung uhah Pasian in a suahsak mite khempeuh kithawi uh hi.
Tua ciangin a veng a pamte in thatang tawh a huh uh banah ngun tawh kibawl umlebeel, kham, van tuamtuamte, ganhingte, le letsong manphate tawh huh thuah lai uh hi.
Tua tham loin, Nebukhadnezzar in Jerusalem panin puakhia-in ama pasian-te' biakinn sungah a koihsa ahi Topa' biakinn-a om ngei umlebeelte zong kumpipa Sairas in pusuah hi.
Persia kumpi Sairas in hihte pusuahin sumkem pa Mithredath' khut sungah ap hi. Tua pa in Judah ukpa Sheshbazzar a dingin a malzah simin sazian bawlsak hi.
Tua nate a phazah: Kham kuang tulkhat, ngun kuang tulkhat, umlebeel a nam tuamtuam sawmnih le kua,
kham kuang-uk sawmthum, ngun kuang-uk a nam tuamtuam zali sawmkhat, le umlebeel adang tulkhat ahi hi.
Kham le ngun kibawl umlebeelte khempeuh a vekpi-in tulnga zali sawmguk kua pha hi. Tua hi a, Babylon panin salte a kiciahpih kik ciangin Sheshbazzar in tua nate khempeuh Jerusalem-ah a ciahpih hi.
Babylon kumpi Nebukhadnezzar in a zawhna gam panin Babylon-ah salin a lakte sung panin hih mite Jerusalem le Judah-ah a ciahkikte hi a, amau' khua ciatah a ciah uh ahi hi.
Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, le Baanah-te makai-in tua mite a ciahpih uh hi. Israel mi phazahte:
Parosh suante - tulnih zakhat sawmsagih le nih ahi hi.
Shefatiah suante - zathum sawmsagih le nih ahi hi.
Arah suante - zasagih sawmsagih le nga ahi hi.
Pahathmoab beh sung panin Jeshua le Joab suante - tulnih zagiat sawm le nih ahi hi.
Elam suante - tulkhat zanih sawmnga le li ahi hi.
Zattu suante - zakua sawmli le nga ahi hi.
Zakkai suante - zasagih sawmguk ahi hi.
Bani suante - zaguk sawmli le nih ahi hi.
Bebai suante - zaguk sawmnih le thum ahi hi.
Azgad suante - tulkhat zanih sawmnih le nih ahi hi.
Adonikam suante - zaguk sawmguk le guk ahi hi.
Bigvai suante - tulnih sawmnga le guk ahi hi.
Adin suante - zali sawmnga le li ahi hi.
Ater a kici Hezekiah suante - sawmkua le giat ahi hi.
Bezai suante - zathum sawmnih le thum ahi hi.
Jorah suante - zakhat sawmnih le nih ahi hi.
Hashum suante - zanih sawmnih le thum ahi hi.

Kiriathjearim khua, Khefirah khua, le Beeroth khuami - zasagih sawmli le thum ahi hi.

Lod khua, Hadid khua, le Ono khuami - zasagih sawmnih le nga ahi hi.

Senaah gammi - tulthum zaguk sawmthum ahi uh hi.
Siampite sung panin: Jeshua-te beh panin Jedaiah suante - zakua sawmsagih le thum ahi hi.
Immer suante - tulkhat sawmnga le nih ahi hi.
Pashhur suante - tulkhat zanih sawmli le sagih ahi hi.
Harim suante - tulkhat sawm le sagih ahi uh hi.
Levi mite sung panin: Hodaviah-te beh panin Jeshua suante le Kadmiel suante - sawmsagih le li ahi hi.
Lasate sung panin Asaf' suante - zakhat sawmnih le giat ahi hi.
Kongcingte nam sung panin Shallum suante, Ater suante, Talmon suante, Akkub suante, Hatita suante, le Shobai suante, a vekpi-in - zakhat sawmthum le kua ahi hi.
Biakinn nasemte sung panin Ziha suante, Hasufa suante, Tabbaoth suante,
Rezin suante, Nekoda suante, Gazzam suante,
Neziah suante, le Hatifa suante ahi uh hi.
Jaalah suante, Darkon suante, Giddel suante,
Shefatiah suante, Hattil suante, Pokherethhazzebaim suante, le Ami suante ahi uh hi.
Biakinn nasemte khempeuh le Solomon' nasemte' suanlekhak khempeuh a vekpi-in zathum sawmkua le nih a pha uh hi.
Temelah, Teharsha, Kherub, Addan, le Immer khuate panin a hong ciahkik, Israel mi hinapi-in amau' behlephung a kan thei lo mite:
Delaiah suante, Tobiah suante, le Nekoda suante, mi zaguk sawmnga le nih ahi uh hi.
Siampite sung panin zong: Habaiah suante, Hakkoz suante, le Barzillai suante (amah in Gilead mi Barzillai tanute khat tenpihin tua min tawh a kilo pah) ahi uh hi.
Hih mite in khang kiciamtehna-ah amau' min a zon uh hangin amau' min na om lo ahih manin amaute a siang loin seh uh a, siampi nasep semsak thei lo uh hi.
Urim le Thummim aisanna tawh ai a san ding siampi khat a om mateng amaute in biakna an siangpente a nek loh nading uh gam ukpa in a gen hi.
Mi a vekpi - tul sawmli le tulnih le zathum sawmguk pha uh a,
amaute' nasem numei le pasal mihing - tulsagih le zathum sawmthum le sagihte kisim lo hi. Amaute in lasa numei le pasal mihing zanih nei uh hi.
Amau' sakolte - zasagih sawmthum le guk, amau' la-sakol - zanih sawmli le nga,
amau' kalaoh - zali sawmthum le nga, le a la uh - tulguk zasagih le sawmnih pha hi.
Amaute Jerusalem-a Topa' biakinn a tun uh ciangin Pasian' biakinn ama mun ngei-ah lamkik nadingin innkuan lutangte pawlkhat in Pasian' biakinn a dingin piakna bawl uh hi.
Amaute in a hih zawhna zah uh tawh kizui-in tua nasep nadingin vanmanpha koihna-ah kham darik tul sawmguk le tulkhat, ngun mina tulnga, le siampipuan zakhat a pia uh hi.
Siampite, Levi mite, le mi pawlkhatte Jerusalem le a kiim nai-ah teng uh hi. Lasate, kongcingte, biakinn nasemte, le Israel mi khempeuh amau' khuapi ciatah a teng uh hi.
A kha sagihna hong cin ciangin Israel mite amau' khuapi ciatah teng khin uh ahih manin, khekhat khai bangin Jerusalem-ah hong kituah diam uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jozadak' tapa Jeshua le a siampipihte, le Shealtiel' tapa Zerubbabel le a behte hong kipan uh a, Pasian' mi Moses thukham sungah a kigelh bangin meihal biaknate piak nadingin Israel Pasian biakna tau a bawl uh hi.
Amaute in tua gam a midang tengte kihta uh ahih manin a mun lui mahah biakna tau phut pahin zing le nitak simin Topa' tungah meihal biakna a pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in a kikipsaksa bangin buk pawi bawl uh a, nisimin zat dingin a kisehsa zah bangin meihal biakna nisimin a pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin hihte banah a tawntung a meihal biakna, Khadet sima biakna, le Topa' pawi a kisehsa hun khempeuh le Topa' tungah amau' utthu tawh a pia mite khempeuh' biaknate zong a pia uh hi.
Topa' biakinnpi a bul a kiphuh nai loh hangin a kha sagihna a ni masa ni a kipanin amaute in Topa' tungah meihal biaknate piak ding kipan uh hi.
Tua hi a, amaute in suangseekte le khutsiamte tungah sum pia uh a, Persia kumpi Sairas' tung panin a thu ngahna bangun Lebanon mualtung gam panin tuipi gei Joppa khua-ah taamtak singte a hong puaksuk ding Sidon khuamite le Taia khuamite tungah zong annek tuidawn le sathau a pia uh hi.
Amaute, Jerusalem khua-a Pasian' biakinn-ah a hong ciahkik uh a kum nihna, tua kum a kha nihna sungin Shealtiel' tapa Zerubbabel le Jozadak' tapa Jeshua, nasep kipan uh a, a Israel mipihte, siampite, Levi mite, le salsuahna panin Jerusalem-ah a hong ciahkik mite khempeuh in zong a huh uh hi. Amaute in Levi mite kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah peuhmah Topa' biakinn sungah biakna nasepte a vaan dingin a seh uh hi.
Jeshua a tapate le a behte tawh, le Hodaviah-te beh Kadmiel le a tate in Henadad' tapate le Levi mi a tapate uh le a behte uh tawh Pasian' biakinn-ah nasemte tungah ukna tavuan a lakhawm uh hi.
Innlamte in Topa' biakinn a bul a phuh uh ciangin, Israel kumpipa David in a geelkholhsa bangin Topa a phat dingin siampite in a puan uh silhin peengkul tawh, Asaf' tapa Levi mite daltuah tawh a panmun ding uhah hong pang uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Topa phatna le lungdamkohna a kidawngin sa uh a, " Topa hoih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Israel-te hong itna kip tawntung hi," a ci uh hi. Topa' biakinn bulpi kiphut khin ahih manin mi khempeuh in nakpitakin Topa phat uh hi.
Midang tampi lungdamin a aw neih zahun a kiko uh hangin a biakinn masa a mu ngeisa siampite, Levi mite, le innkuan lutang, midang tampite in hih biakinn bulpi a kiphuh a muh uh ciangin kapin a thum uh hi.
Mite nakpitakin kiko ahih manin lungdamna awging, le kahna le thumna awgingte mite in khen thei lo uh hi. Gamlapi pek panin tua awgingte a kiza hi.
Salsuahna panin a hong ciahkik mite in Israel Pasian Topa a dingin biakinn khat a lamna thu Judah le Benjamin mite' galte in a zak uh ciangin
Zerubbabel, Jeshua, le innkuan lutangte kiangah va pai-in amaute kiangah, "Biakinn lamna-ah ko zong hong kihelsak un; bang hang hiam cih leh note mah bangin ko zong na Pasian uh ka bia uh a, hih lai-ah kote hong koih Assiria kumpipa Esarhaddon' hun lai a kipanin note' Pasian' tungah biakna ka pia uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Zerubbabel le Israel sunga innkuan lutang a omlaite in amaute kiangah, "Kote' Pasian a dingin ka lam uh biakinn pen note' hong lunghihmawhpih ding hi lo hi. Persia kumpipa Sairas in kote hong thupiaksa bangin Israel Pasian, Topa a dingin ko teng guak mah in ka lam ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua gam a teng midangte in Judah mite lungkiasakin biakinn a lam zomlai ding uh a lausak uh hi.
Amau' ngimna a tangtun theih loh nadingin amaute in a langpang dingin zum nasemte golhguk pia uh hi. Persia kumpipa Sairas' hun a kipan kumpi Darias hun dong hih bangin hih ngitnget uh hi.
Ahasueras in uk ding hong kipat ciangin Judah gam le Jerusalem-a a tengte a khiatna thu tua gamah a na tengsate in lai-in a gelh uh hi.
Tua ciangin Persia kumpi Artakzaksis hun ciangin Mithredath, Tabeel, le a lawmte uh thukimna tawh kumpipa tungah lai gelh uh a, a lai pen Aram lai-in kigelh a, Aram pau mahin kisimkhia hi.
Menzipipa Rehum le lai-at pa Shimshai in Kumpi Artakzaksis tungah Jerusalem tawh kisai thu a nuai-a bangin gelh uh hi.
Menzipipa Rehum, lai-at Shimshai, le a lawmte khempeuh, thukhente, mangpite, thuvaante, uliante, Erek khuami le Babylon khuami, Susa khua-a om Elam mite,
le a lian a minthang Ashurbanipal in hong puakhia-in Samaria khuapi-ah a hong tensak mite le Eufratis Gun langkhat a kizawhna gam sunga a om mite tung panin lai puak, a ci uh hi.
A lai sung thu hih a nuai-a bang ahi hi: "Artakzaksis Kumpipa tungah, Eufratis Gungal gam a om na nasemte in hopihna kam kong puak uh hi.
"Nangma kiang panin ko kiangah a hong pai Judah mite, tu-in Jerusalem-ah tung khin uh a, a gilo, mi lehdo thei ahi khuapi pen amaute in lamkikin, amaute in a khua bulpi vel khinin, kulhpi cian' a kipat khitna thu thei in.
Amau' khuapi kilam kikin kulhte kizo leh amaute in siah ahi a, mangmu ahi a, losap ahi zongin hong pia nawn lo ding uh a, a tawpna-ah kumpi hong sukkhak ding thu thei in.
Kote in kumpipa tawh thuciamna kip nei khin ka hih manun kumpipa' minsiatna ka muh ding uh kilawm lo hi. Tua ahih manin nangma mai-a a semte' thuciamtehna laibute a ki-etkik theih nadingin kumpipa tungah thu kong zasak uh hi. Thuciamtehna laibu sung en lecin hih khuapi pen a lehdo thei khuapi, kumpipa tung le a ukna gamte tungah siatna a piangsak, kumpi dona a khua sungah a om tawntungna thu na mukhia ding hi. Hih khuapi a kisukcipna zong hih thu hang mah ahi hi.
Hih khuapi kilam kikin a kulhte kizo khin leh Eufratis Gungal gam na uk nawn loh nading thu, nangma tungah kong theikholsak uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in a lai uh hih bangin thuk hi: "Menzipipa Rehum, lai-at pa Shimshai, le Samaria le Eufratis Gungal gam sunga om na lawmte khempeuh uh tungah hopihna lai kong khak hi.
"Keima tungah nong khak uh lai pen a kitel takin keima zakna-ah hong kisim khin hi.
Keimah in hih thu a kikanna ding thu ka pia a, tu-in kikantel khinta hi. Tanglai a kipanin hih khuapi pen kumpi langah pangin, hih khua sungah lehdona le kumpi dona a om ngitngetna thu kimukhia hi.
A vanglian kumpite in Jerusalem-ah uk ngei-in, Eufratis Gungal gambup tungah aana zang uh a, siah, mangmu, le losapte tua kumpite tungah kipia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hih mite a nasep uh a khawlna ding thu pia in. Keimah in thu kong piakkik mateng hih khuapi kilamkik lo ding hi.
Hih thu tawh kisai-in na sep ding don loin ommawk kei in. Tua hi kei leh kumpi tungah siatna le gimna hong khang ding hi," a ci hi.
Menzipipa Rehum, lai-at Shimshai, le amau' lawmte' zakna-ah Kumpi Artakzaksis tung panin a kingah lai a kisim ciangin, Jerusalem-ah amaute pai pahin Judah mite a nasep uh aana tawh a khawlsak uh hi.
Tua hun a kipanin Jerusalem-a om Pasian' biakinn a kisepna a khawl hi. Persia kumpi Darias' uk a kum nihna dong tua bangin a khawlcip phot hi.
Tu-in kamsangte Haggai le Iddo' suan Zekhariah in Judah gam le Jerusalem-ah a om Judah mite hanthawnin, Israel Pasian' min tawh thu a gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin Shealtiel' tapa Zerubbabel le Jozadak' tapa Jeshua, Jerusalem-a Pasian' biakinn lamkik ding kipan pah uh a, Pasian' kamsangte in amaute ompihin huh uh hi.
Tua laitakin Eufratis Gungal gam sung teng a uk sawn Tattenai, Shetharbozenai, le amau' lawmte hong paipahin amaute kiangah, "Note in hih biakinn lamkikin a nate na bawlna ding uh kua in thu hong pia ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Hih biakinn lam nasepna-ah a sem mite' min zong amaute in dong uh hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in Judah upate huh ahih manin Darias kiangah a thu va tungin ama tung pan thu a kingahkik hun dong a nasep zomna uh kikhaktan lo hi.
Eufratis Gungal gam a uk sawn Tattenai, Shetharbozenai, le Eufratis Gungal gam sung thu a vaan ama lawmte in Kumpi Darias tungah lai khak uh hi.
Amaute in thuzaksakna lai hih bangin a gelh uh hi: "Kumpi Darias tungah thupha namcin hong tung tahen.
"Judah gam, a lian Pasian' biakinn-ah ka va paina uh kong theisak uh hi. Tua biakinn pen suang lianpipite tawh kilamin a kawmte sing tawh kibawl hi. Hih biakinn limtakin kisemin amau' makaihna tawh a nasep uh telh mahmah hi.
"Hih biakinn a kilamkikna ding le a nate a zawh nadingin kua in thu pia hiam, cih thu hih upate tungah ka dong uh hi.
"Amaute in hih bangin hong dawng uh hi: 'Kote pen vantung le leitung Pasian' nasemte ka hi uh a, kum tampi lai-in a kilamsa biakinn a lamkik ka hi uh a, a lian Israel kumpi khat in lamin a zawhsa ahi hi.
Ahi zongin ka pu ka pate un vantung Pasian hehsakkha uh ahih manin Babylon kumpipa, Khaldea mi Nebukhadnezzar' khut sungah amaute pia hi. Tua kumpipa in hih biakinn susia a, a mite Babylon-ah ciahpih hi.
Ahi zongin Babylon kumpipa Sairas' uk a kum khatna kumin hih Pasian' biakinn a kilamkikna ding amah in thu pia hi.
Tua tham loin Jerusalem-a biakinn sung panin Nebukhadnezzar in la-in Babylon biakinn sunga a koih ahi Pasian' biakinn sunga om ngeisa kham le ngun kibawl umlebeelte zong kumpi Sairas in Babylon biakinn panin lakhia-in gam ukin a hong koih Sheshbazzar min nei pa tungah ap hi.
Kumpipa in ama tungah, "Hih umlebeelte paipih inla, Jerusalem-a biakinn-ah va koihkik in. Tua lai-a Pasian' biakinn pen a mun ngei mahah lamkik sak in," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Sheshbazzar hong pai-in Jerusalem-a Pasian' biakinn a bulpi hong phut hi. Tua hun a kipanin tu dong lamkik kisem suak a, ahi zongin kizo nai lo hi,' ci uh hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin hoih na sak leh, Jerusalem-a hih Pasian' biakinn a kilamkikna ding thu kumpipa Sairas in thu pia takpi hiam, pia taktak lo hiam cih a kitheih nadingin Babylon khua sunga om laibu koihna innte sung zongsak in. Tua khit ciangin kumpipa in na deihna hong zasakkik in," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Darias in thu pia a, Babylon khua sunga lai manphate a kisenna innte sung kizong hi.
Ahi zongin Babylon khua sungah na om lo a, Media gam sung kumpi khuapi Ekbatana-ah laizial khat kimu a, tua sungah hih a nuai-a bangin a kiciamteh kimu hi:
"Kumpi Sairas' kum khatna kumin Jerusalem khua-a Pasian' biakinn tawh kisai-in kumpipa in thu pia hi: Biakna kipia-in meihal biakna a kipaipihna munah biakinn lamsakkik un. A sanna pi sawmkua, a vai pi sawmkua mah hi ding a,
a kawm pen suang thuap thum le sing thuap khat tawh a kibawl, thuap li hi ding hi. Hih sum beinate ahihleh kumpi sum panin kipia ding hi.
Nebukhadnezzar in Jerusalem biakinn panin lakhia-in Babylon-ah a hong tunpih Pasian' biakinn sunga om kham le ngun tawh kibawl umlebeelte zong kipiakik ding hi. Tuate khempeuh Jerusalem biakinn-ah kipuakik ding a, Pasian' biakinn sunga a omna munmun ciatah kikoihkik ding hi," ci-in kigelh hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Darias in hih bangin thu a pia hi: "Tu-in Eufratis Gungal gam a uk Tattenai, Shetharbozenai, le Eufratis Gungal gam sung a vaan na lawmte, tua mun panin na kihemkhia ding uh hi.
Judah mi a ukpa le a upate in hih Pasian' biakinn a lamkik theih nadingun na tuaci omsak ding uh hi. Ama mun ngei mahah a biakinn lamsakkik un.
Hih a kigen Pasian' biakinn a kilamkik theih nadingin hih Judah upate a dingin na hih dingte uh zong thu kong pia hi. Hih nasepna a mawk khawl loh nadingin, Eufratis Gungal gam sung panin a kingah siahte ahi kumpi sum sung panin beina khempeuh a cingin kipia ding hi.
Vantung Pasian' tungah meihal biakna-in piak dingin a kisam khempeuh - bawngtalnote, tuutalte, ahih kei leh tuunote na pia ding uh a, Jerusalem-a siampite' hong ngetna bangin mangbuh, ci, leenggahzu, ahih kei leh sathaute, kitasam loin nisimin amaute tungah piasak un.
Tua hileh amaute in vantung Pasian' tungah a namtui biaknate pia-in kumpipa le a tapate' nuntakna ding thu hong ngetsak thei ding uh hi.
Tua tham loin, mi khatpeuh in hih thupiakna a siatsak leh ama inn panin a innkam khat kidawhkhiat sakin tua tungah amah kihen cipin kisatgawp ding a, tua banah a inn zong a kisuksiatna ding thu kong pia thuah lai hi.
Hih ka thupiakna a siasak nuam, Jerusalem-a Pasian' biakinn a susia nuam kumpi khatpeuh ahi a, mi khatpeuh ahi zongin a om leh, ama min omna dinga tua mun a bawl Pasian in tua mipa lawnthal tahen. Keimah Darias in thu kong pia hi. Ka thupiak bang teekteekin sep ding ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Darias in amaute tungah a thupiak bang teekteekin Eufratis Gungal gam sung a uksawn Tattenai, Shetharbozenai, le a lawmte in sem uh hi.
Tua hi a, kamsang Haggai le Iddo' suan Zekhariah' thugenna hangin Judah upate in a biakinn lam uh zom suakin maavang uh hi. Israel Pasian' sawlna le Persia kumpi Sairas le Darias le Artakzaksis-te' thupiakna tawh amaute in a biakinn lam uh a zo uh hi.
Tua hi a, Kumpi Darias' kum gukna, Adar kha a ni sawm le thum ni-in a biakinn kizo hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite, siampite, Levi mite, le sal a suaksa a hong ciahkik mi khempeuh in lungdamna lianpi tawh Pasian' biakinn apna a bawl uh hi.
Amaute in Pasian' biakinn apna-in bawngtal zakhat, tuutal zanih, le tuuno zali go uh a, mawhna hanga biak nadingin Israel-te khempeuh a dingin a minam phazah tawh kizui-in keeltal sawm le nih a pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Moses laibu sungah a kigelh bangin Jerusalem-a Pasian' nasep nadingin siampite amau' panmun ngei-ah pangsak uh a, Levi mite amau' nasepna ngei-ah a semsakkik uh hi.
A kha masa a ni sawm le li ni-in sal a suaksa a hong ciahkik mite in Paisan Pawi a bawl uh hi.
Siampite le Levi mite a vekpi-un kisiansuah khin uh a, a vekpi-un zehsiang khin uh hi. Tua hi a, amaute in sal suaksa a hong ciahkik khempeuh a' ding, a siampipihte uh le amau mahmah a dingin Paisan tuuno a go uh hi.
Salsuahna panin a hong ciahkik Israel-te le Israel Pasian, Topa a bia dingin tua gam a midang tengte le a nitna uh pan amau le amau a kihemkhia tawm mite khempeuh in tua Paisan Pawi an a ne uh hi.
Tua hi a, amaute in lungdamna tawh ni sagih sung silngo sawh loh anlum pawi a bawl uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau' lungdamna ding a om theih nadingin Topa in Assiria kumpipa' lungsim amau' tungah a nuam dingin a bawlsak hi. Tua ahih manin Israel Pasian ahi Pasian' biakinn a sepna uhah kumpipa in amaute a huh hi.
Hih thu teng khit ciangin Persia kumpi Artakzaksis uk hun sungin Ezra, a pa Seraiah, a pa Azariah, a pa Hikiah,
a pa Shalum, a pa Zadok, a pa Ahitub,
a pa Abishua, a pa Finehas, a pa Eleazar, a pa siampi lianpen pa Aaron:
hih Ezra pen Babylon panin hong tungto hi. Amah pen Israel Pasian, Topa in a piak Moses thukham a siam laithei mi khat ahi hi. Topa ahi ama Pasian in ompih ahih manin ama nget khempeuh kumpipa in a pia hi.
Kumpi Artakzaksis in a uk a kum sagihna kumin Israel mite, siampite, Levi mite, lasate, kongcingte, le biakinn nasem pawlkhat zong, Jerusalem-ah Ezra tawh tungto uh hi.
Kumpipa' uk kum sagih a cin kum, a kha ngana sungin Jerusalem tung uh hi.
A kha masa a ni khat ni-in Babylon pan a ding khia dingin Ezra in a ni sehkhol a, a kha ngana a ni khat ni-in Jerusalem a tung uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in amah ompih hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Ezra in Topa' thukham sinin zuih ding, le Israel mite a hilh dingin amah kipia hi.
Kumpi Artakzaksis in siampi ahi, laithei pa lah ahi, Israel-te a dingin Topa' thupiaknate le thukhamte a siam Ezra tungah a piak lai pen hih bang ahi hi:
"Kumpite' kumpi ahi Artakzaksis kiang panin vantung Pasian' thukham a siam, siampi hi-in laithei pa lah ahi Ezra tungah:
"Ka lungsim khentatna hih bang ahi hi: Ka gam sunga om Israel mi khatpeuh ahi a, a siampite uh ahi a, Levi mite ahi zongin, Jerusalem-ah a ciahkik nuam khempeuh in nang hong zuih theih nadingun thu ka pia hi.
Nang tungah hong kipia ahi na Pasian' thukham tawh kisai-in Judah le Jerusalem-ah thu bangci om hiam cih a va thei dingin kumpipa keimah le thu hong lamlak mihing sagihte in kong sawl uh hi.
Kumpipa le a thu lamlakte in Jerusalem-ah a teng Israel Pasian tungah lungkim takin a piak ngun le khamte zong,
Babylon gamah na muh uh ngun le khamte, le Jerusalem-a note' Pasian' biakinn dingin mite le siampite in lungkim takin a piak khiat zuazuate uh tawh a va puakkhawm ding na hi uh hi.
"Hih ka thupiakna tawh kizui-in hih sumte pen Jerusalem-a note' Pasian' biakinn-a biakna tau tungah piak dingin bawngtalte, tuutalte, tuunote, le a an tawh biaknate, le a leenggahzu tawh biakna dingte leina ding bekin na zang ding uh hi.
Tua banah ngun le kham a val a omlai leh, note' Pasian' deihna tawh kituakin hoih na sak bangun na lawmte tawh na zang thei ding uh hi.
Na Pasian' biakinn-ah zat dingin hong kipia umlebeelte pen Jerusalem Pasian tungah na va pia ding hi.
Na Pasian' biakinn a dingin a kisam, na piak ding a phamawh a omkhak zenzen leh kumpipa sum sung panin na zang thei ding hi.
"Tua hi a, kumpipa keimah Artakzaksis in Eufratis Gungal gam sunga om kumpi vankemte khempeuh tungah hih bangin thu ka pia hi: Vantung Pasian' thukham a siam lai a thei, siampi Ezra in note tung panin a kisapna hong nget ciangin,
ngun talen zakhat, mangbuh seu zakhat, leenggahzu tambong zanih, sathau tambong zanih ciang, le ci a deih zahzah na pia ding uh hi.
Vantung Pasian in a deih peuhpeuh, vantung Pasian biakinn a dingin limtakin hih un. Tua hikeileh kumpipa tapate le kumpi gam tungah amah hong heh kha ding hi.
Siampite, Levi mite, lasate, kongcingte, biakinn nasemte, ahih kei leh hih Pasian' biakinn-a nasemte khat peuhpeuh tung panin siah ahi a, mangmu ahi a, losap ahi zongin lakna ding thu na neih lohna uh zong kong zasak uh hi, ka ci hi.
"Tua hi a, nang Ezra in nang tungah hong kipia na Pasian' pilna tawh kizui-in Eufratis Gungal gam sunga mite thu a khen dingin na Pasian' thukham a thei mite seh in. Nang le amaute in na Pasian' thukham a thei lote na hilh ding uh hi.
Na Pasian' thukham le kumpipa' thukham a mang lo peuhmah, sihna ahi a, hawlkhiatna ahi a, neihsa matna ahi a, thongkiatna ahi zongin, a ngah ding a kilawm thukhenna tawh khauhtakin gim kipia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Ezra in, "Jerusalem-a om Topa' biakinn tua bangin a minthangsak thuah dingin kumpipa lungsimah suak a, kumpipa le a thu lamlakte le a uliante kei tungah a thunuam dingin a bawl i pu i pate' Pasian ahi Topa in thupha ngah ta hen!" a ci hi. Tua hi a, Topa ka Pasian in kei hong ompihna thei ka hih manin ka lungsim hong hang a, kei hong zui dingin Israel makaite ka khawm hi.
Kumpi Artakzaksis' uk hun sungin Babylon panin kei tawh hong ciahto khawm a behbehin a kiciamteh beh lutangte hih bang ahi hi:
Gershom: Finehas-te beh pan ahi hi. Daniel: Ithamar-te beh pan ahi hi. Hattush: David-te beh panin Shekaniah' tapa ahi hi.
Zekhariah: Parosh-te beh sung pan hi a, amah tawh pasal zakhat le sawmnga kiciamteh hi.
Eliehoenai: Pahathmoab-te beh panin Zerahiah' tapa hi a, pasal zanih tawh ahi hi.
Shekaniah: Zattu-te beh panin Jahaziel' tapa hi a, pasal zathum tawh ahi hi.
Ebed: Adin-te beh panin Jonathan' tapa hi a, pasal sawmnga tawh ahi hi.
Isaiah: Elam-te beh panin Athaliah' tapa hi a, pasal sawmsagih tawh ahi hi.
Zebadiah: Shefatiah-te beh panin Mikhael' tapa hi a, pasal sawmgiat tawh ahi hi.
Obadiah: Joab-te beh panin Jehiel' tapa hi a, pasal zanih le sawm le giat tawh ahi hi.
Shelomith: Bani-te beh panin Josifiah' tapa hi a, pasal za le sawmguk tawh ahi hi.
Zekhariah: Bebai-te beh panin Bebai' tapa hi a, pasal sawmnih le giat tawh ahi hi.
Johanan: Azgad-te beh panin Hakkatan' tapa hi a, pasal za le sawmkhat tawh ahi hi.
Elifelet, Jeiel, le Shemaiah: A hong nungpai Adonikam-te beh zong hi uh a, pasal sawmguk tawh ahi uh hi.
Uthai le Zabbud: Bigvai-te beh pan hi uh a, pasal sawmsagih tawh ahi uh hi.
Ahava gam lamah a luang lui gei khatah amaute ka khawm a, tua lai-ah ni thum sung ka tam uh hi. Mite le siampite ka etphat ciangin Levi mite khat zong na om lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a lawmte lakah a makai, Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zekhariah, le Meshullam-te, le thu ngaihsut siam Joiarib le Elnathan-te ka sam a,
Kasifia mun a a makai pa Iddo kiangah va pai-in, tua lai-a biakinn nasem amah le a behte in, eite' Pasian' biakinn-a na a sem ding mihing hong puak ding uh a ngen dingin ka sawl hi.
Tua hi a, hehpihna a nei eite' Pasian in hong ompih ahih manin Levi mi Mahli-te beh sung panin thu ngaihsutsiam mi ahi Sherebiah, a tapate le a behte tawh pasal sawm le giat,
le Merari-te beh panin Isaiah, a behte le amau' tapate mi sawm le nih le Hashabiah tawh,
Levi mite' na a sem dingin David le a uliante in a tuamkoih ahi biakinn nasem zanih le sawmnih hong pia hi. Hih mite khempeuh amau' min ciat tawh a kisam ahi hi.
Tua ciangin eite' Pasian' mai-ah kote kiniamkhiat thei-in, kote le ka naupangte uh le ka neihsa khempeuh uh nuamtakin ka khualzinna uhah ka pai theih nading uh Pasian' tung pan ka nget theih nadingun Ahava lui-ah an tanna ding thu ka taangko hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa kiangah, "Ka Pasian un amah a zong mite khempeuh ompihin amau a dingin a hoih na sem a, amah a nusiate khempeuh tungah amah heh hi," ci-in gen khin ka hih manun lampi-ah kote hong kha dingin galkapte le sakol tung tuangte kumpipa kiangah ka nget ding ka mai a zum hi.
Tua hi a, kote in an ka tang uh hi. Nuamtakin khual ka zin theih nading uh i Pasian' tungah ka ngen uh a, amah in ka thungetna uh hong pia hi.
Tua ciangin siampi liante sung panin mi sawm le nih - Sherebiah, Hashabiah, le amau' behte mi sawm ka tuamkoih hi.
Tua ciangin i Pasian' biakinn nasep nadingin kumpipa le a thu lamlakte le a uliante le tua lai-a a om Israel mi khempeuh in a tuam khen ciat uh ngun le kham le umlebeelte, amaute tungah ka ap hi.
Amaute tungah ka apte: Ngun talen zaguk sawmnga, talen nih a gik ngun tawh a kibawl umlebeel zakhat, kham talen zakhat,
kham darik tulkhat man tawh a kibawl kuang-uk sawmnih, le kham zahin a manpha sumsan hoih tawh a kibawl beel nih ahi hi.
Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, " Topa tungah note hong ki-ap hi. Umlebeelte zong biakna vante ahi hi. Ngun le khamte ahihleh na pu na pate uh Pasian ahi Topa tungah citna tawh a kipia na ahi hi.
Siampi liante, Levi mite, le Israel mi beh lutangte' muhin Jerusalem khua-ah Topa' biakinn dei sungah na puak dong mateng uh vilin kem un," ka ci hi.
Tua ahih manin siampite le Levi mite in Jerusalem-a i Pasian' biakinn-ah puak dingin ngun, kham, le umlebeelte a hong sang uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jerusalem a zuan dingin kha masa a ni sawm le nih ni-in Ahava lui panin ka ding khia uh hi. I Pasian in kote hong ompih ahih manin lamkalah galte le pansimna a tuamtuamte tawh hong kipelhsak hi.
Jerusalem khua ka tun uh ciangin ni thum sung ka tawlnga uh hi.
A ni li ni-in Uriah' tapa siampi Meremoth' tavuan lakna tawh i Pasian' biakinn sungah ngun, kham, le umlebeelte kiseng hi. Finehas' tapa Eleazar in amah huh a, Levi mi Jeshua' tapa Jozabad le Binnui' tapa Noadiah in amau tegel huh uh hi.
Vante a ki-ap ciangin limtakin kivel a, a ki-ap na khempeuh ciaptehna lai khat kibawl hi.
Tua ciangin salsuahna panin inn hong zuankik mite in Israel-te khempeuh a dingin Israel Pasian tungah meihal biakna-in bawngtal sawm le nih, tuutal sawmkua le guk, tuuno sawmsagih le nih, le mawhna hanga biakna-in keeltal sawm le nih a pia uh hi. Hihte khempeuh pen Topa' tungah meihal biakna ahi hi.
Amaute in Eufratis Gungal gam sung tenga kumpipa' nuai-ah a uksawn a lian pente le uliante tungah kumpipa' thupiaknate zong a va gen uh hi. Tua hi a, amaute in mite le Pasian' biakinn lam nasep a huh uh hi.
Hih thute khempeuh a kisep khit ciangin keima kiangah makaite pawlkhat hong pai-in, "Hih gam a teng gamdang mite' nitna le Kanaan mite, Hit mite, Perez mite, Jebus mite, Ammon mite, Moab mite, Egypt mite, le Amor' mite' gamtat a kihhuaite panin Israel mi, siampite le Levi mite nangawn zong, a siangtho-in tuam om lo uh hi.
Amaute le a tapate un hih gam a teng minam dangte' numeite tenpih uh a, tua thu hangin a siangtho minam pen tu-in gamdang mite tawh a kihel suak ta hi. Tua hi a, hih thu-ah makaite le thukhen uliante pen a khial masa ahi uh hi," hong ci uh hi.
Hih thu ka zak ciangin dah mahmahin ka puante balkekin, ka sam le ka khamul botin, cih nading thei loin ka om hi.
Tua ciangin sal a suak hih mite' cihtak lohna hangin Israel Pasian' gim piak ding lau-in a ling mite khempeuh kei kiangah hong kikhawm uh a, nitak biakpiak hun dong cih nading thei loin ka om hi.
Tua hi a, nitak biakpiak hun ciangin khua phawk kikin ka puankekpi mah silh kawmin khukdinin Topa Pasian' lamah ka khut zakin,
"Ka biak Pasian aw, ka mawhnate un ka lu dawn dong uh hong vuknelhin vantung dong banto ahih manin nangma lam kong et ding maizumin ka mai a san hi, ka Pasian aw.
Ka pu ka pate uh hun a kipanin tuhun dong mawhna lianpi ka nei uh hi. Tua thu hangin ka kumpite uh le ka siampite un gamdang kumpite' khut sungah sihna, salsuahna, neihsa kisuhna, le maizumna thuak uh a, tuhunin zong tua bangmah ka thuak uh hi.
Kote pen sal ka hi takpi uh hi; ahi zongin ka salsuahna uhah ka Pasian un nong nusia kei a, kote' Pasian' biakinn puahkikin ka dinsakkik theih nading uh le Judah le Jerusalem-ah kidalna kulh ka neih theih nadingun kipat thakna na hong piak theih nadingin Persia kumpite ko tungah a thunuam dingin nong bawlsak hi.
"Kote' Pasian aw, hih bang hi khin ahih ciangin kote in bang gen thei nawn ding ka hi uh hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh na nasem kamsangte tungtawnin kote thu hong pia-in, 'Note va lutin na luah ding uh gam pen, tua gam a a na teng gamdang mite in ninsakin a kihhuai a gamtatnate uh tawh mong khat pan mong khat dongin a ninsa gam nin ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin na tanute uh amau' tapate tawh kitengsak kei unla, na tapate uh zi dingin amau' tanute zong la kei un. Amaute' phattuamna ding le a maavanna ding uh hanciam kei un. Tua bang hileh note thahatin tua gam a piangte nuamtakin na ne ding uh a, na tate un a luah tawntung dingun tua gam na piasawn thei ding uh hi,' ci-in nong thupiaknate ka zui kei uh hi.
Tu-in kote' gamtatsiate le a lian ka mawhnate uh hangin hih bang gimna lian ka thuak uh hi; ahi zongin nangmah in kote' tuah dinga kilawmzah gimna hong tuaksak loin, tu-a banga a nungta lai-in nong omsak zaw hi.
Hih banga ka thuak khit uh ciangin kote in na thupiaknate mang lo kikin, a kihhuai-in a gamta mite tawh kitengin kizomkik ding ka hi uh hiam? Tua bang hi kik le-ung, a suakta, a nungta ka om nawn loh dongun kote' tungah na hehna hong tungsak ding hi lo na hi hiam?
Israel Pasian, Topa aw, nang na thutang a, ahi zongin tuni-a a omlai ko teng nong suaktasak veve hi. Na muhna-ah kote a mawhpi mah hita le-ung hong hehpih in; bang hang hiam cih leh mawhna tawh nangma mai-ah kuamah om thei lo hi," ci-in thu ka ngen hi.
Ezra in tu-a bangin thu ngenin mawhna pulakin khitui naptui tawh Pasian' biakinn mai-ah kunin a om laitakin Israel mi numei, pasal, naupang, mi tampi tak ama kiimah hong kikhawmin amaute khempeuh zong nakpitakin a kap uh hi.
Tua ciangin Elam-te beh sung panin Jehiel' tapa Shekaniah hong pau-in Ezra kiangah, "Hih gam a teng gamdang numeite tenpihna tawh i Pasian tungah i khial hi. Ahi ta zongin Israel mite a dingin lametna omlai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, ka topa uh nangma ngaihsutna le i Pasian' thupiakna a kihta mite' ngaihsutna bangin hih i zite le a tate uh i makna ding thu i Pasian' tungah kiciam ni. Tua ciangin thukham sunga om bangin gamta ni.
Kipan in; nangma nasep ding ahi hi; kote in kong huh ding uh hi. Hang inla sem in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Ezra dingin, a kigensa bangin amaute a gamtat nadingun a kiciam dingin siampi makaite, Levi mite, le Israel mi khempeuh sawl a, amaute zong a kiciam pah uh hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian' biakinn panin Ezra paikhia-in Eliashib' tapa Jehohanan' omna inndei-ah pai-in tua lai-ah a giak hi. Salsuahna pan a hong ciahkik mite' khialhna hangin dah ahih manin amah in anletui ne zo lo hi.
Tua ciangin Judah le Jerusalem sunga a om a hong ciahkik salte khempeuh Jerusalem-ah a hong kikhopna ding uh,
le ni thum sungin a hong tung lo a om leh uliante le upate' hoihsakna bangin a neihsa khempeuh uh kimanin, salsuaksa mihonte panin a kihawlkhiat theih nading thu taangkona khat kibawl hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Judah le Benjamin mi khempeuh ni thum sungin Jerusalem-ah hong kikhawm uh a, tua pen a kha kuana a ni sawmnih ni ahi hi. Tua hi a, Pasian' biakinn mai inntualah hih thu hangin mi khempeuh patau-in guah lakah lingin a tu uh hi.
Tua ciangin siampi Ezra dingto-in amaute kiangah, "Note in gamdang numeite zi-in la-in Israel mite' mawhna na behlap uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na pu na pate uh Pasian ahi Topa' tungah na mawhna uh pulak unla, ama deihna bangin gamta-in hih gam a teng gamdang mite le gamdang mi ahi na zite uh tawh kikhenin tuam om un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a kikhawm mi khempeuh in dawngin kiko uh a, "Hi ta hen, na gen bangin ka gamta ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin mi tampi hi hang a, guahzuk laitak zong ahi hi. Hih guah lakah ka omsuak zo kei ding uh hi. Tua tham loin hih thu-ah eite in mawhna lianpi hihkha ihih manin ni khat ni nih sungin hih nasep a kizo thei ding hi lo hi.
A kikhawm mihonpite' tangin i makaite semsak inla, hih thu hangin eite' tungah Pasian' hehna a dam matengin, i khuapite sung khempeuhah gamdang numei a tenpih mi khempeuh amau khuasung upate le thukhente ciat tawh a kiseh hunin i makaite kiangah va kilak uh hen," a ci uh hi.
Asahel' tapa Jonathan le Tikvah' tapa Jahzeiah tegel bek in hih thu nial uh a, Meshullam le Levi mi Shabbethai bek in tua a nialte panpih uh hi.
Tua hi a, thukham omsa bangin, a hong ciahkik salsuakte a gamta uh hi. Siampi Ezra in amau' beh ciat tangin beh lutang pawlkhat tengkhia a, tuate khempeuh a minin a kilokhia ahi hi. A kha sawmna a ni khat ni-in hih mite a thukan ding uh kipan uh a,
a kha masa a ni khat ni-in gamdang numei a tenpih mite' thu a kan uh a zo uh hi.

Amaute in a zite a mak ding uh kiciam uh a, amau' mawhna hangin biakna-in tuuhon panin tuutal khat hong paipih uh hi.
