Hih mite khempeuh in gamdang numei tenpih uh a, amaute in a zite uh a tate uh tawh a makhawm uh hi.
Hakaliah' tapa Nehemiah' thugen hih bang ahi hi. A kum sawmnihna Khislev kha sungin kumpi khuapi Susa-ah ka om laitakin,
ka sanggampa Hanani le midang pawlkhat Judah gam panin hong tung uh hi. Tua ciangin keimah in Jerusalem khua thu le sala matna panin a suakta ahi a omsuak Judah mite' thu tawh kisai amaute kiangah ka dong hi.
Salsuahna panin a suakta, tua gam a omsuakte in haksatna lianpi le maizumna a ngahna uh, le Jerusalem kulh kicimin kulhkongpite mei in a kattumna thu a hong gen uh hi.
Ka thungetna-ah, "Aw vantung Pasian, Topa , nang hong itin na thupiakna a zuite tungah thuciamna limtakin a zui, a lian a kihtakhuai Pasian aw,
Nangma tungah kong khialkhin uh a, na nasempa Moses tungah na piak ahi thupiaknate, thukhamte, le ngeina kipte ka zui kei uh hi.
Na nasem Moses tungah, 'Na cihtak kei uhleh minam dangte lakah kong thehthang ding hi.
Ahi zongin kei kiangah hong ciahkikin ka thupiaknate zui-in na sep uhleh leimong dongah a kithehthangsa na mite uh kaikhawmin keima min om nadingin ka teelnasa munah amaute ka ciahpih ding hi,' ci-a na thugen hong phawkkik in.
Topa aw, amaute pen na vangliatna le a thahat na khut tawh na hotkhiatsa na nasemte le nangma mite ahi uh hi.
Keima hong thungetna le nangma min a zahtak nuam na nasemte' thungetna na bil hong ngat in. Tu-in kei tungah maavanna hong pia inla, kei tungah hih kumpipa hong migitna ding lungsim hong guan in," ka ci hi. Tua hun laitakin kei pen kumpipa' an a piapa ka hi hi.
Kumpi Artakzaksis' kum sawmnihna Nisan kha sungin khatvei, a leenggahzu a baihsa-in a om khit ciangin la-in kumpipa ka pia a, ama mai-ah ka om laitakin ka mai a khing hi.
Amah in, "Cina lopi-in bang hangin na mai khing ahi hiam? Na dahna khat om hi ding hi," hong ci hi. Tua ciangin lau mahmahna tawh
kumpipa ka dawng a, "Kumpipa nungta tawntung in. Ka pute ka pate a kivuina khuapi siagawp a, a kongpite kangtum ahih ciangin maikhing loin bangci om theih ding ka hi hiam?" ka ci hi.
tua khit ciangin kumpipa dawngin, "Kumpipa na lung a kim a, dik na sak leh, ka puahphatkik theih nadingin Judah gam sung ka pute ka pate a kivuina khuapi-ah nong paisakna ding kong thum hi, topa," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in (kumpinu a gei-ah tukawmin), "Bang tanvei sawt ding a, cik ciangin hong ciahkik thei ding na hi hiam?" ci-in hong dong hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in ka ngetna hong thukimpih a, kei zong ka ciahkik ding hun ka gen hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah, "Kumpipa na thukim leh, Judah gam ka tun dong amaute in hong paisuaksak theih nadingun Eufratis Gungal gam sung a uksawn mite ka piak ding laikhakte,
le biakinn hutna ding munmuanhuai kongpi ding, khuapi kulh ding, le ka omna ding inn lam nadingin sing hong piaktheih nadingin kumpipa' tulak a kem Asaf' tungah piak ding laikhak zong, kei tungah hong pia in," ka ci hi. A dik ka Pasian in kei hong ompih ahih manin kumpipa in ka ngette hong pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Eufratis Gungal gam a uksawn mite kiang ka tung a, kumpipa' laikhakte amaute tungah ka pia hi. Kumpipa in galkapmangte le sakol galkapte kei hong khasak hi.
Ahi zongin Israel mite' phattuamna ding a sem dingin mi khat a paina thu Horonaim khuami Sanballat le Ammon mi sal ahi Tobiah in a zak uh ciangin nakpitakin lungkim lo uh hi.
Jerusalem khua ka tun ciangin ni thum sung ka tawlnga hi.
Tua ciangin zanin vakkhia-in mi tawmkhat ka tonpih hi. Ahi zongin Jerusalem a dingin ka bawlsak ding ka Pasian in ka lungsimah hong suahsak thu kuama kiangah ka gen kei hi. Keima tuanna simloh ganhing dang ka kizuisak kei hi.
Kuam Kongpi tawnin Gulpi Tuikhuk le Nin Kongpi lamah ka pai a, a kicimsa Jerusalem kulhpi le mei in a kattumsa a kongpite ka en hi.
Tua ciangin Tuinak Kongpi le Kumpipa' Bual-ah ka paisuak hi. Ahi zongin ka tuanna ganhing a paisuak theih nading mun om lo hi.
Tua hi a, a zanpi mahin kuam lampi-ah pai-in khuapi kulh ka vel hi. Tua ciangin Kuam Kongpi mah tawnin khuapi sungah ka lutkik hi.
Tua hi a, khuasung upate in ka paina mun ahi a, ka sep ahi zongin thei lo uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh hih nasep tavuan a la ding Judah mite, siampite, uliante, khuasung upate, le a dangte tungah ka gen nai kei hi.
Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, "I lungkhamna thu na thei uh hi. Jerusalem a siasa-in omin, a kongpite mei in kangtum hi. Hong pai un, zahkona i ngah nawn loh nadingin Jerusalem kulh ciangpha ni," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin a dik ka Pasian in kei hong ompihna le kumpipa in kei tungah hong gen thute zong amaute tungah ka gen hi. Tua ciangin amaute in, "Tu-in nasep kipan pah ni," hong ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin lawp mahmahna le ngimna hoih tawh nasep a kipan uh hi.
Ahi zongin Horonaim khuami Sanballat, Ammon mi sal ahi Tobiah, le Arab gammi ahi Geshem in tua thu a zak uh ciangin, kote zahpihna le simmawhna tawh, "Hih na sep uh bang ahi hiam? Kumpipa lehpan' na hi uh hiam?" hong ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute dawngin, "Vantung Pasian in ka maa uh hong telhsak ding a, ko ama nasemte in nasep a kipan ta ka hi uh hi; note in ahihleh Jerusalem tawh kisai-in thu na neih theih nadingun bangmah kimematna na nei kei uh hi," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin siampi lianpen pa Eliashib le a siampipihte in nasep kipanin Tuu Kongpi a bawl uh hi. Amaute in a khuamte le a zawlte bawlin a kongkhakte bulh uh hi. Amaute in Za Khat Tausang ciang banah Hananel Tausang dong sem uh a, tua ciangin Pasian' tungah ap uh hi.
A zomah Jerikho khua mite in sem uh hi. Amaute' zomah Imri' tapa Zakkur in sem hi.
Tua ciangin Hassenaah' tapate in Ngasa Kongpi bawl uh hi. Amaute in a zawlte khungin a kongkhakte a kalhna bulh uh hi.
Amaute' zomah Hakkoz' tapa Uriah, a tapa Meremoth in ama khawk sung puah hi. Tua zomah Meshezabel' tapa Berekhiah, a tapa Meshullam hi a, tua zomah Baana' tapa Zadok in puah hi.
A zom kikah Tekoa khua mite in puah uh a, ahi zongin amau' uliante in a tote uh sawl bangin sem nuam lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Paseah' tapa Joiada le Besodeiah' tapa Meshullam in Jeshanah Kongpi puah uh a, a zawlte khungin a kongkhakte a kalhna bulh uh hi.
Amaute' zomah Gibeon le Mizpah khuami ahi, Gibeon mi Melatiah le Meronoth khuami Jadon in Eufratis Gungal gam a uksawn pa' zum dong puah uh hi.
Tua zomah khamseek pa Harhaiah' tapa Uzziel in puah a, a zomah paknamtui bawlpa Hananiah in puah hi. Amaute in Kulh Zai ciang dong a ngeina bangin Jerusalem bawlkik uh hi.
Amaute' zomah Jerusalem gam phelkhat a uk, Hur' tapa Refaiah in puah hi.
A zomah Harumaf' tapa Jedaiah in ama inn mai san teng puah hi. Tua ciangin a zomah Hashabneiah' tapa Hattush in puah hi.
Harim' tapa Malkhijah le Pahathmoab' tapa Hasshub in Meikhuk Tausang a huam khawk dang khat sung puah uh hi.
Amaute' zomah Jerusalem gam a phelkhat a uk, Hallohesh' tapa Shallum in a tanute tawh a puah uh hi.
Hanun le Zanoah khua-a teng mite in Kuam Kongpi puah uh hi. Amaute in tua kongpi bawlpha-in a kongkhakte a kalhna bulh uh a, Nin Kongpi ciang dong pi tul le pi zanga sung kulh a puah uh hi.
Bethhakkherem gam a uk, Rekhab' tapa Malkhijah in Nin Kongpi puah a, tua kongpi bawlpha-in a kongkhakte a kalhna a bulh hi.
Mizpah gam a uk, Kolhozeh' tapa Shallum in Tuinak Kongpi puah a, tua kongpi bawlpha-in a kongkhakte a kalhna bulh hi. Tua ciangin amah in kumpipa' huan gei-a kulh ciang a, David khuapi pana hong paisuk kahlei ciang dong a sem hi.
Ama zomah Bethzur gam phelkhat a uk, Azbuk' tapa Nehemiah in David' han san ciang, a kibawl tawm bual le Galkap Inn ciang dong puah hi.
Ama zomah a puah Levi mite: Bani' tapa Rehum hi a, ama zomah Keilah gam phelkhat a uk Hashabiah in ama gam tangin puah hi.
Ama zomah a puah a behte: Keilah gam phelkhat a uk, Henadad' tapa Bavvai in puah hi.
A zomah Mizpah gam a uk, Jeshua' tapa Ezer in a Kiu-a galvan koihna kahtohna san khawk khat puah hi.
Ama zomah Zabbai' tapa Baruk in a Kiu panin siampi lianpen pa Eliashib' inn kongkhak ciang dong khawk khat sung puah hi.
Ama zomah Hakkoz' tapa Uriah, a tapa Meremoth in Eliashib' inn kongkhak panin Eliashib' innmong ciang dong khawk khat sung puah hi.
Ama zomah Jerusalem kiimnai-a om siampite in puah uh hi.
A zomah Benjamin le Hasshub in amau' inn mai san puah uh hi. A zomah Ananiah' tapa Maaseiah, a tapa Azariah in ama inn gei san teng puah hi.
le kulh kiu ciang khawk khat sung puah hi. Uzai' tapa Palal in a Kiu gal san teng le kumpipa' inn panin hong dawkkhia, zumcingte' omna ahi tausang tungnung teng puah hi.
Ama zomah Parosh' tapa Pedaiah in nisuahna lam manawhin Tui Kongpi gal san ciang le tausang dawk puah hi.
Sakol Kongpi tung san teng ahihleh siampite in amau' inn mai san ciat puah uh hi.
Ama zomah Shemaiah' tapa Hananiah le Zalaf' tapa gukna Hanun in khawk dang khat sung puah uh hi. Amau zomah Berekhiah' tapa Meshullam in ama inndei mai san teng puah hi.
Ama zomah khamseek pa Malkhijah in Kikaihkhopna Kongpi mai sana om biakinn nasemte' inn le sumbukte' inn ciang, le a kiu-a inndei tungnung ciang dong puah hi.
Tua ciangin khamseekte le sumbukte in a kiu-a inndei tungnung le Tuu Kongpi kikal a puah uh hi.
Sanballat in kote' kulh cianna thu a zak ciangin lungkim loin heh mahmah a, ko Jew mite hong zahko hi.
Amah in a kikholhpihte le Samaria galkapte' kiangah, "Hih Jew mi niangnuangte in bang hih ding a kipan ahi uh hiam? Hih mun a bawlpha dinga kingaihsun ahi uh hiam? Biakpiakna hangin a nasep uh ni khat sungin zo dingin kilamen ahi uh hiam? Amaute in a kangtumsa ninbulomtang panin suangtum bawlkik thei ding ahi uh hiam?" ci hi.
Ama kiangah a om Ammon mi Tobiah in, "Amaute in bangbang ciang ta le amau' kulh cian' tungah ngia khat kah leh kicim lel ding hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin keimah Nehemiah in thu ka ngen a, "Hong za in, kote' Pasian aw; kote hong kisimmawh hi. Kote hong zahkona amau' lu tungah lehtuksak inla, gamdang khatah sal suakin mi' bawlsiatin amaute omsak in.
Amaute in a langtangin kulh ciangte' mai-ah nang hong hehsak uh ahih manin amau' mawhna maisak kei inla, na ciaptehna panin zong a mawhna uh sumit kei in," ka ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kulh ka ciang uh a, nasep a kimciang bang kizo hi. Mite in utna lungsim tawh sem uh hi.
Ahi zongin Sanballat, Tobiah, Arab mite, Ammon mite, le Ashdod mite in Jerusalem kulh cian' nasep kizom suakin, kulh vang teng huk ding a kipat khitna thu a zak uh ciangin heh mahmah uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka Pasian uh tungah thu ka ngen uh a, amaute a en dingin sun le zanin galvil ka koih uh hi.
Tua ciangin Judah gam mite in, "Nasemte a tha uh zaw ta a, ahi zong nin tampi omlai hi. Eima tha tawh kulh cian' i zo ngei kei ding hi," hong ci uh hi.
Amaute lakah a teng Jew mite khuapi sungah hong pai ciangin, ka galte uh a omna khempeuh ciat panun hong pai-in kote hong simna ding thu, sawmvei tak hong hilhkhol uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kulh nunglam mun niam penna mun awng tengah a namsau uh, a teipi uh, le a thal uh tawh, a innkuan kuanun ka mite ka pangsak hi.
Mite' launa ka muh ciangin, uliante, mi ukte, le mi khempeuh tungah, "Amaute kihta kei un. Na sanggamte, na tapate, na tanute, na zite uh, le na inn na lote uh a dingin hong dosak, a lian a kihtakhuai Topa phawk un," ka ci hi.
Amau' hong sawmna thu kote in ka phawkna uh le Pasian in amau' geelna a suksiatna thu ka galte un thei uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin ka nasepna ciat uh kulh tungah ka vekpi-un ka kuankik uh hi.
Tua hun a kipanin ka khutnuai-a om mite kimkhat in na sem a, a kimkhat in a teipite, a lumte, le a thalte uh tawi-in sik puan silhin ding uh a, uliante in kulh a ciang Judah mi khempeuh uk uh hi.
Kulh-a cian' ding na a nawn mite in a khut langkhat uh tawh a van puak uh lenin a khut langkhat uhah galhiam tawi uh hi.
Kulh ciangte in na a sep kawmun a kawng ciat uhah a namsau uh kuah uh hi. Peengkul tum pa ahihleh keima kiangah om hi.
Tua ciangin mi liante, mi ukte, le mi khempeuh tungah, "I nasepna lian a, zaipi tak huam hi; eite kulh tungah kikhenin khatlekhat i kigamla hi.
Peengkul kitum na zakna peuhpeuh panun ko kiangah hong kikhawm un. I Pasian in eite a dingin hong dosak ding hi," ka ci hi.
Tua hi a, nisimin khuavak a kipan nitak aksi suah dong, mi kimkhat in teipi tawi-in, mi kimkhat in na ka sem uh hi.
Tua hun mahin mite kiangah, "Zanin galvil, sunin nasemin hong om theih nadingun mi khempeuh na nasemte ciat uh tawh Jerusalem khua sungah hong giak un," ka ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin keimah a kipan ka behte, ka nasemte, le kei hong cingte, a kuamah peuh puan suah man om loin, mi khempeuh in ka khut uhah galhiam ka tawi den uh hi.
Tu-in mi nautang numei le pasalte in a Jew mipihte uh tungah lungkim lohna kam hong gingsak uh hi.
Mi pawlkhatte in an lei nadingin a tanute uh le a tapate uh a piakna thu hong gen uh hi.
Pawlkhatte in kial tun huhau-in an lei nadingin a lote, a leenggah lote, le a innte uh a piakna hong gen uh hi.
Pawlkhatte in kumpipa tungah siah piak dingin a lote uh le a leenggui lote uh khamin a piakna uh hong gen uh hi.
Amaute in, "Kote pen ka behte uh mah bangin cilesa kibang hi-in, ka naupangte uh zong amau' naupangte mah bangin a hoih hinapi-in, ka tanute uh le ka tapate uh sal suak dingin ka phum uh hi. Ka tanute uh pawlkhat zong sal suakkhin a, ka lote uh le ka leenggui lote uh midangte a' suakkhin ahih manin amaute tat nadingin ka hih zawh uh bangmah om lo hi," hong ci uh hi.
Amaute' kikona le hih thute ka zak ciangin ka heh mahmah hi.
Kei zong hih thu limtakin ka ngaihsun a, tua ciangin uliante le thukhente taii-in amaute kiangah, "No le no leiba manin salin na kila uh hi," ka ci hi. Amaute nakpitakin taii-in,
"Minam dangte tungah sala kizuaksa i Jew mipihte ahizo zahzahin i tanhkik hi. Tua hinapi-in note in na mipihte uh na zuak uh a, tu-in amaute i tatkik ding hi zel hi," ka ci hi. Amaute pau loin om uh a, a gen ding mel uh thei lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, "Note' gamtatna hoih lo hi. I gal ahi minam dangte' zahkona i ngah loh nadingin i Pasian zahtakna tawh na gamtat ding uh kilawm hi.
Kei le ka behte le ka nasemte in zong an le sum leitawi-in ka piakhia uh hi. Leiba manin mi kilakna phiat ni.
Tuni mahmahin a lote, a oliv lote, a innte uh le a meetin na lak uh sum, an, leenggahzu, le sathaute, amaute tungah pia kik un," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Hihte khempeuh ka piakik ding uh a, amaute tung panin bangmah ka kal nawn kei ding uh hi. Na gen bangin ka gamta ding uh hi," hong ci uh hi. Tua ciangin siampite ka sam a, a ciamsa bangun a gamtat nadingun siampite' mai-ah kiciamna ka bawlsak hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong ka puan singin, "Hih thuciamna a tungsak lo peuhmah a inn le a neihsa panin Pasian in singkhia tahen. Hih bangin kisingkhia hen la, hawmsuak hen!" ka ci hi. Tua ciangin a kikhawmte khempeuh in, "Hi ta hen," ci uh a, Topa a phat uh hi. Tua hi a, a ciamsa bangun mite a gamta uh hi.
Tua tham loin, Judah gam a uk dingin hong kiseh hun a kipan, Kumpi Artakzaksis' kum sawmnihna pan a kum sawmthum le nihna dong, kum sawm le nih sung, kei le ka behte in gam ukte' ngah ngei ante ka ne kei uh hi.
Keima hun ma-in a ukte in mite tungah van gikpi suan uh a, amaute' tung panin nisimin an le leenggahzu ngun shekel sawmli man a la uh hi. Amau' nasemte nangawn mite tungah kiliansak lai uh hi. Ahi zongin Pasian ka zahtakna hangin tua bangin kei ka gamta kei hi.
Hih kulh cianna-ah kei mahmah in zong ka sem a, kei a dingin leitang bangmah ka la kei hi. Keima mite khempeuh nasem ding bekin tua lai-ah kisutuah uh hi.
Kiim le pama minam dangte' kiang pan hong paite banah, nisimin ka sabuai-ah an a ne, thukhente le Jew mi a kihelin leengla za le sawmnga bang ka nei den hi.
Nisimin innsung annektawm dinga kibawl bawngtal khat le tuu limci guk ahi hi. Tua mah bangin ak zong kibawl a, ni sawm simin leenggahzu a um tampipi-in kihih hi. Tua zahin bei taseleh gam ukte' ngah theih ahi anletui ka kal kei hi; bang hang hiam cih leh mite genthei lua hi.
Pasian aw, hih mite a dingin ka bawlna khempeuh kei a dingin a hoih lamin hong phawk in.
Kongpite-ah kongkhak ka bulh nai loh uh hangin, kulh ka cian' khitna uh le a vang khat zong a om nawn lohna thu, Sanballat, Tobiah, Arab mi Geshem, le ka gal dangte khempeuh un a zak uh ciangin,
Sanballat le Geshem zong Ono zanglei sunga om Hakkofirim khua-ah pai-in amaute tawh thu a kikum dingin hong sam uh hi. Hih pen kei hong suksiat nopna uh ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kei zong amaute kiangah kamtaite ka sawl a, "Tu laitakin nasep thupi ka nei hi; kong pai thei kei ding hi. Kei hong pai leng, kong pai sung ka om loh kalteng nasep kitawlnga ding hi," ka ci hi.
Amaute in tu-a bangmahin livei tak hong sam uh a, kei zong a livei mahin tu-a bangin ka dawngkik hi.
Tua bangmahin Sanballat in a ngaveina hong sam a, tua tungtangin a kamtai pa in laikhak khat hong pia hi.
A laikhak sungah, "Minam dangte lakah a kigen, Geshem in zong tu-a a kigen thu man hi, ci-a a gen thu in: Nang le Jew mite in kumpi lehdo ding na sawm uh a, tua thu hangin kulh na ciang uh hi. Tua banah nangmahmah zong kumpi na utna kigen lai hi.
Judah gam in kumpi khat nei ta hi, ci-in, nang kumpi na hihna thu Jerusalem-ah a taangko dingin kamsangte pawlkhat a koihin zong hong kigen hi. Kumpipa in hih thu za pelmawh ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin thakhatin hong pai inla, hih thu kikum ni," ci-in kigelh hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, "Tu-a na gen bangin bangmah om lo hi. Tua bang thu pen nangma phuahtawm ahi hi," ci-in ka thuk hi.
Kote in ka hanciamna uh khiamin nasep a kizawh loh nading deihna tawh amaute in kote hong lausak theih nading uh a hanciam uh ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin ka hahkat semsem zaw uh hi.
Mehetabel' tapa Delaiah, a tapa Shemaiah a inn-ah omcip ahih manin ni khat ama kiangah ka pai leh amah in, "Pasian' inn sung, siangtho munah kituahin biakinn kong kikhaknelh ni; bang hang hiam cih leh nang hong that dingin amaute hong pai uh a, zanin amaute in nang hong that ding uh hi," hong ci hi.
Ahih hangin keimah in, "Mi kei bangte tai ding ahi hiam? Mi kei bangte a suahtak nadingin biakinn sungah bu ding ahi hiam? Ka pai peuhmah kei ding hi," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin a thusim ka phawkkhia hi. Pasian in tua bang thu a gen dingin amah a sawl hi lo a, Tobiah le Sanballat in tua bangin thugen dingin golhguk a na pia na hi a, ama thugenna pen keimah suksiat nopna ahi hi.
Ama thugen bangin gamta-in mawhna ka bawl theih nadingin keimah hong lausak nadingin a kicial ahi hi. Tua bangin zuikha leng kei hong minsia sakin hong simmawh ding uh hi.
Ka Pasian aw, amau' sepnate' hangin Tobiah le Sanballat thei inla, keimah lausak dingin a hanciam kamsangnu Noadiah le kamsang dang khempeuh zong thei in.
Elul kha ni sawmnih le nga ni-in kulh kizo a, ni sawmnga le nih sung hun bei hi.
Ka galte un hih thu za-in, ka kiim uha om minam dangte in a theih uh ciangin lamdangsa a, kote' Pasian' huhna tawh hih nasep kizo ahihna a phawk uh hi.
Hih hun sungteng khempeuh Jew uliante in Tobiah kiangah lai tampi khak uh a, Tobiah' laikhakte zong amaute' kiangah tung hi.
Tobiah pen Arah' tapa Shekaniah' makpa hi a, ama tapa Jehohanan in Berekhiah' tapa Meshullam' tanute khat tenpih ahih manin Judah gam sunga mi tampi amah tawh kipawl hi.
Amaute in ama hoihnate zong keima zak-ah hong gen uh a, keima sepna teng zong ama kiangah na puak uh hi. Tua hi a, Tobiah in zong ka lau theih nadingin kei tungah lai tampi hong khak hi.
Kulh kiciang khinin, kongkhakte ka bulh khin uh a, kongcingte, lasate, le Levi mite a kiseh khit ciangin,
ka sanggampa Hanani le biakinn a uk Hananiah in a et dingin Jerusalem ka pia hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Hananiah pen midang tampi sangin a citakzaw, Pasian a zahtakzaw khat ahi hi.
Tua hi a, amaute tungah, "Sun mateng Jerusalem kongpite hongsak kei un. Tua ciangin ni omlai mahin kongte khaksakin kalhsak un. Jerusalem khuasunga tengte lak panin khuacing dingte seh unla, pawlkhatte galvilna munah, pawlkhatte amau' omna inn mai ciatah omsak un," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin uliante, thukhente, le mite a innkuan kuanun ciaptehna ding ka lungsim sungah Pasian in hong suaksak hi. Tua hi a, hong ciahkik masate' khang ciaptehna laibu ka mu hi. Tua sungah a kigelh ka muhte:
Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar in a zawhna gam panin salin a lak mite sung panin hih mite pen Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, le Baanah-te' makaihna tawh Jerusalem le Judah gam sung amau khua ciatah a hong ciahkik ahi uh hi. Israel sung panin mi a phazah:
Parosh suante - mi tulnih zakhat sawmsagih le nih ahi hi.
Shefatiah suante - mi zathum sawmsagih le nih ahi hi.
Arah suante - mi zaguk sawmnga le nih ahi hi.
Pahathmoab-te beh sung panin Jeshua le Joab suante - mi tulnih zagiat le sawm le giat ahi hi.
Elam suante - mi tulkhat zanih sawmnga le li ahi hi.
Zattu suante - mi zagiat sawmli le nga ahi hi.
Zakkai suante - mi zasagih sawmguk ahi hi.
Binnui suante - mi zaguk sawmli le giat ahi hi.
Bebai suante - mi zaguk sawmnih le giat ahi hi.
Azgad suante - mi tulnih zathum sawmnih le nih ahi hi.
Adonikam suante - mi zaguk sawmguk le sagih ahi hi.
Bigvai suante - mi tulnih sawmguk le sagih ahi hi.
Adin suante - mi zaguk sawmnga le nga ahi hi.
Ater a kici Hezekiah' suante - mi sawmkua le giat ahi hi.
Hashum suante - mi zathum sawmnih le giat ahi hi.
Bezai suante - mi zathum sawmnih le li ahi hi.
Harif suante - mi zakhat sawm le nih ahi hi.
Gibeon suante - mi sawmkua le nga ahi hi.
Bethlehem le Netofah khuami - zakhat sawmgiat le giat ahi hi.

Ramah le Geba khuami - zaguk sawmnih le khat ahi hi.
Bethel le Ai khuami - zakhat sawmnih le thum ahi hi.
Nebo adang khat khuami - sawmnga le nih ahi hi.
Harim khuami - zathum sawmnih ahi hi.
Lod, Hadid, le Ono khuami - zasagih sawmnih le khat ahi hi.
Senaah khuami - tulthum zakua sawmthum ahi hi.
Immer suante - mi tulkhat sawmnga le nih ahi hi.
Pashhur suante - mi tulkhat zanih sawmli le sagih ahi hi.
Harim suante - mi tulkhat sawm le sagih ahi uh hi.
Levi mite sung panin: Hodevah-te beh panin Jeshua suante le Kadmiel suante - sawmsagih le li ahi hi.
Lasate sung panin Asaf suante - mi zakhat sawmli le giat ahi hi.
Kongcingte nam sung panin Shallum suante, Ater suante, Talmon suante, Akkub suante, Hatita suante, le Shobai suante - mi zakhat sawmthum le giat ahi uh hi.
Biakinn nasemte sung panin a hong ciahkikte: Ziha suante, Hasufa suante, Tabbaoth suante,
Keros suante, Sia suante, Padon suante,
Lebana suante, Hagaba suante, Shamai suante,

Besai suante, Meunim suante, Nefushesim suante,
Bazlith suante, Mehida suante, Harsha suante,
Neziah suante le Hatifa suante ahi uh hi.
Solomon' nasemte' suanlekhakte sung panin: Sotai suante, Sofereth suante, Perida suante,
Jaala suante, Darkon suante, Giddel suante,
Shefatiah suante, Hattil suante, Pokherethhazzebaim suante, le Amon suante ahi uh hi.
Biakinn nasemte le Solomon' nasemte' suanlekhakte mi a vekpi-in zathum sawmkua le nih a pha uh hi.
Temelah, Telharsha, Kherub, Addan, le Immer khuate panin a hong ciahkik, Israel mi hinapi-in amau' behlephung a kan thei lo mite:
Delaiah suante, Tobiah suante, le Nekoda suante, mi zaguk sawmli le nih ahi uh hi.
Siampite' sung panin zong: Hobaiah suante, Hakkoz suante, Barzillai suante (amah in Gilead mi Barzillai' tanute khat tenpihin tua min tawh a kilo pah) ahi uh hi.
Hih mite in khang ciaptehna sungah a kiciamteh mite lakah amau' min a zon uh hangin mu lo uh ahih manin amaute a siang loin seh uh a, siampi nasep semsak thei lo uh hi.
Tua hi a, Urim le Thummim aisanna tawh ai san ding siampi khat a om matengin amaute in biakna an siangtho pente a nek loh nading uh gam ukpa in a gen hi.
Mi a vekpi-in tul sawmli tulnih zathum sawmguk pha a,
amaute' nasem numei le pasal tulsagih zathum sawmthum le sagihte kisim lo lai hi. Tua banah amaute in lasa numei le pasal zanih sawmlinga nei uh hi.
Amau' sakol zasagih sawmthum guk, a la-sakol uh zanih sawmli nga,
a kalaoh uh zali sawmthum nga, le a late uh tulguk zasagih sawmnih a pha hi.
Beh lutang mi pawlkhat in nasep nadingin nate pia uh hi. Gam ukpa in vanmanpha koihna-ah kham darik tulkhat, kuang-uk sawmnga, le siampipuan zanga sawmthum a pia hi.
Tua ciangin beh lutang pawlkhatte in vanmanpha koihna-ah kham darik tul sawmnih le ngun mina tulnih zanih a pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin midangte' piakte pen kham darik tul sawmnih, ngun mina tulnih, le siampipuan sawmguk le sagih ahi hi.
Tua ciangin siampite, Levi mite, le mi pawlkhatte Jerusalem khua le a kiimah teng uh hi; kongcingte, lasate, biakinn nasemte, le Israel midangte amau' khuapi ciatah a teng uh hi.
Kha sagihna hong cin ciangin Israel mite amau' khuapi ciatah teng khin uh hi. Tua ciangin Tui Kongpi mai tualpi-ah mi khempeuh khekhat khai bangin hong kikhawmtuah diam hi. Tua ciangin Topa in Israel mite tungah a piak ahi Moses thukham laibu pen laithei pa Ezra in hong paipih nadingin a gen uh hi.
Tua hi a, a kha sagihna a ni khat ni-in numei pasal, le thu theitel thei ding a kikhawm khempeuh mai-ah siampi Ezra in thukham laibu hong paipih hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Tui Kongpi mai-a om tualpi lam mai ngatin zingsang tung a kipan sun ciang dong, numei pasal le thu a tel thei ding mite' zakin tua laibu sunga thute sim a, mi khempeuh in tua thukham laibu sunga thu kisimte limtakin a ngai uh hi.
Tua ciangin thugenna dinga sing tawh kibawl tau tungah laithei pa Ezra dingto a, ama taklam pangah Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, le Maaseiah ding uh a, a veilam pangah Pedaiah, Mishael, Malkhijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zekhariah, le Meshullam a ding uh hi.
Mi khempeuh sangin a sangzaw munah amah om ahih manin mi khempeuh' muh theih dingin Ezra in a laibu a hong hi. A laibu a hon ciangin mi khempeuh a ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Ezra in a lian Pasian, Topa thupha pia a, mi khempeuh in a khut uh laamto-in, "Hi tahen. Hi ta hen," ci-in a dawng uh hi. Tua ciangin a lu uh kunin leilam maingatin Topa a bia uh hi.
Mite amau' omna san ciatah a om sungun mite in thukham a tel theih nadingun Levi mi Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, le Pelaiah-te in a khiatna a gen uh hi.
Amaute in Pasian' thukham laibu sung panin a kitel takin sim uh a, a cihnopna a kitelin gen uh a, tua a kisim thute a tel nadingun a hilh uh hi.
Tua ciangin a gam ukpa Nehemiah, laithei pa lah hi-in siampi lah ahi Ezra, le mite a hilh Levi mite in amaute khempeuh kiangah, "Tuni pen Topa note' Pasian a dingin biakna ni siangtho ahi hi; a kap a mau om kei un," a ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh thukham kammalte a zak uh ciangin mi khempeuh kap uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, "Tu-in ciah un. Anlim tuilim ne-in thadim unla, a nei zo lote zong va kholh un; bang hang hiam cih leh i Topa a dingin tuni pen biakna ni siangtho ni ahi hi; dah kei un, bang hang hiam cih leh Topa' hong piak lungdamna in note hong thahatsak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Levi mite in mite gamdaisak a, "Daitakin om un; bang hang hiam cih leh tuni pen biakna ni siangtho ni ahi hi; dah kei un," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi khempeuh anne tuidawnin midangte a kholh ding le lungdam a om dingin a ciah uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute tungah a kigen thute amaute in a theitel uh hi.
A ni nih ni-in thukham sin dingin siampite le Levi mite tawh beh lutang khempeuh laithei pa Ezra kiangah hong kikhawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin, a kha sagihna pawi hun sungin sawlbuk sungah Israel mite a omna ding thu, le amaute in a khuapi khempeuh uh le Jerusalem-ah taangko-in, "A kigensa bangin sawlbuk lam nadingin gamlakah pai unla oliv hiangte, gamlak oliv hiangte, mui sing hiangte, le a teh tam singhiang dangte va sat un," ci-in a gen ding uh, Moses tungtawnin Topa in a thupiakna pen thukham sungah a kigelh lam a mu uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mite kuankhia-in tua singhiangte hong pua-in amau' innkhumzang ciat, le a inntual uh le Pasian' biakinn tual, Tui Kongpi tual, le Efraim Kongpi tualah sawlbuk a lam uh hi.
Tua hi a, salsuahna panin a hong ciahkik a kikhawm mite khempeuh in sawlbuk lamin tuate sungah om uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Nun' tapa Joshua' hun a kipanin tua ni dongin Israel mite in tua bangin hih ngei lo uh hi. Tua hi a, amaute lungdam mahmah uh hi.
Tua hi a, a kipat ni a kipan a bei ni dong Ezra in ni simin Pasian' thukham laibu a simkhia hi. Amaute in ni sagih sung tua pawi kham uh a, a ngeina om bangin a ni giat ni-in pawi khupna thupi kikhopna khat a om hi.
Tua kha mah a ni sawmnih le li ni-in an tang dingin Israel mite kikhawm uh a, puanhampi silhin a lu tung uhah lei kibuak uh hi.
Tua hi a, gamdangmi khempeuh panin Israel mite tuam om uh a, amaute in dinsa-in amau' khialhnate le a pu a pate uh mawhnate a pulak uh hi.
Tua ciangin amau' omna mun ciat uhah dingin Topa amau' Pasian' thukham laibu nai thum sung sim uh a, adang nai thum sung amaute in mawhna pulakin Topa a Pasian uh zahtakna a bawl uh hi.
Levi mite' kahlei tungah Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, le Khenani ding uh a, Topa amaute' Pasian' tungah nakpitakin kiko uh hi.
Tua ciangin Levi mi Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, le Pethahiah-te in, "Ding un, Topa na Pasian uh phat unla, 'A tawntung pan a tawntung dongin a minthang na min in thupha ngah a, thupha khempeuh le phatna dang khempeuh sangin a sangzaw hi.
Nang bek Topa na hi hi. Nangmah in a sang pen vantung le vana om khempeuh, leitung le a tunga om khempeuh, le tuipi le a sunga om khempeuh na bawl hi. Nangmah in tuate khempeuh na omsak a, vantung mihonpi in nang hong bia uh hi.
Nang pen Abram teelin Khaldea gam Ur khuapi panin paikhiatpihin Abraham min a phuak Pasian, Topa na hi hi.
Nangma tungah amah a cihtakna na mu a, Kanaan mite gam, Hit mite gam, Amor mite gam, Perez mite gam, le Girgash mite gam, amah le a suanlekhakte tungah piak dingin ama tungah thuciamna khat na bawl hi. Nang thuman na hih manin na thuciamna na tungsak hi.
"'Nangmah in Egypt gam sunga ka pute ka pate uh' gimna mu-in San Tuipi-ah hong kikona uh na za a,
amaute in ka pu ka pate uh kihihsakna tawh a hih gawpna thei na hih manin Faro le a nasemte le a gammi khempeuh langpangin lim le na lamdang na bawl hi. Tua hi a, tuni dongin a kip minphatna khat nangma a' dingin na ngah hi.
Amaute' mai-ah tuipi phelkham na hih manin tuipi laizang lei keu tungah amaute paisuak uh a, ahi zongin tuihual sunga suanglot bangin tui thukna sungah amau a delhte na lawn hi.
Sunin meii khuam khat tawh amaute lam na lak a, amau' lampaina khua a vaksak dingin zanin mei khuam khat tawh lam na lak hi.
Sinai Mual tungah kumsukin, vantung panin amaute hopihin, amaute tungah a man thukhenna, thukham taktak, a hoih ngeinate le thupiaknate na pia a,
na nasempa Moses tungtawnin amaute tungah na Sabbath siangtho na theisak a, thupiaknate, ngeinate, le thukhamte na pia hi.
"'Ahi zongin kote' pute pate kihisakin lungkhauh uh a, na thupiaknate mang lo uh hi.
Amaute in thu mang nuam lo uh a, amaute lakah na bawl na lamdangte ngaihsun kha lo uh hi. Amaute lungkhauh niloh uh a, a salsuahna uh Egypt-ah a paipih kik dingin makai khat seh uh hi. Ahi zongin nang pen mawhna a maisak nuam, dikin hehpihna a nei, lungduai-in itna kip a nei Pasian na hi a, amaute na nusia tuan kei hi.
Amaute in a kisung bawngno khat amau mah a dingin bawlin, "Hih pen Egypt panin note a hong paikhiatpih na pasian uh ahi hi," ci-in gendai mawhna lianpi a bawl uh ciangin zong,
nang in na hehpih mahmah manin amaute gamlakah na nusia kei hi. Sunin lam a lak meii khuam in amaute nusia lo a, zanin a pai nading uh lampi a vaksak dingin mei khuam in zong amaute nusia lo hi.
Amaute hoihtakin thu na hilh a, na manna an zong amaute kiang panin na lakik kei a, a dangtakna uh a phasak dingin tui na pia hi.
Kum sawmli tawntung gamlakah amaute na vak a, amaute in bangmah tangsapna nei lo uh hi. A puante uh zong sialo a, a khe uh zong bawk beek lo hi.
Nangmah in amaute tungah kumpi gamte le mite na pia a, tuate pen galsung van ngah dingin na piak ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Heshbon kumpipa Sihon' gam le Bashan kumpipa Og' gam luah uh hi.
Nangmah in amau' suanlekhakte vana aksi zahin simzawh lohin na tamsak a, a pu a pate un a luah dingin na piak dingin na ciamsa gamah amaute na paipih hi.
A suan a khakte uh tua gamah lutin a lak uh ciangin, amau' mai-ah tua gam a teng Kanaan mite na nuaisiah a, a ut bang bangun a bawl dingun a kumpite le a mite amau' khut sungah na pia hi.
Tua hi a, amaute in kulhnei khuapite le gam hoihte la uh a, na hoih tampi tawh a kidim innte, suang kikhuak tuibemte, leenggui lote, oliv lote, le nek theih singgah kung tampi a luah uh hi. Amaute in tuate ne-in gilvahin thau uh a, nangma hoihna hangin nuamsa mahmah uh hi.
"'Ahi zongin amaute in demnopna lungsim nei-in nang hong lehdo uh hi. Amaute in na thukham nungngat uh a, nangma lamah hong ciahkikna dingun amaute a hilh na kamsangte that uh a, amaute in gendai mawhna lianpi bawl uh hi.
Hih thu hangin a galte uh khut sungah amaute na ap a, a galte un amaute hih gawpgawp uh hi. Ahi zongin amau a kihih gawpgawp hun ciangin nang tungah hong ko uh a, nangmah in vantung panin na za a, na hehpihna lianpi tawh amau' galte' kiang panin amaute a honkhia ding honkhiate na puak hi.
Ahi zongin a tawldam khit uh ciangin nangma muhna-ah a sia gamta zel uh a, nangmah in amau' galte' khut sungah amaute na nusia a, a galte un amaute a ukgawp uh hi. Ahi zongin amaute in nang tungah huhna hong nget uh ciangin vantung panin amau' ngetna za-in na hehpihna tawh amaute tam veipi na honkhia hi.
Tua hi a, na thukham lamah amaute hong kihei kikna ding limtakin na hilh a, ahi zongin amaute kihisakin na thupiaknate don lo uh hi. A zuite tungah nuntakna a pia thei ahi na ngeina kip tungah amaute khial uh hi. Lungkhauhin phengphi-in amaute kiheikhia uh a, thu mang nuam lo uh hi.

Hih lai-a kigelh thupiangte pen India gam panin Ethiopia gam dong, gamneu zakhat sawmnih le sagih a uk Ahasueras' hun lai-a piang thu ahi hi.
Hih hun laitakin kumpi khua ahi Susa khuapi sunga kumpi tokhom tungah amah tu hi.
Ama uk a kum thumna kumin ama nuai-a a uliante khempeuh le a nasemte a dingin pawi khat bawlsak hi. Ama khutnuai-a om Persia le Media galkapmangte le ama nuai-a uliante le ama nuai-ah gam a uksawnte a om laitakin,
a kumpi gam hauhna le ama thupi ziazuana ni tampi sung, ni za le ni sawmgiat sung tak a lak hi.
Hih pawi hun a bei khit ciangin kumpi khua Susa khuapi sunga om milian mineu mi khempeuh a dingin kumpipa in pawi khat a bawl hi. Tua pawi pen kumpi inn huang sungah kibawl a, ni sagih sung kibawl hi.
Tua huang sungah suangkang khuamte kiphut a, khau malneu le khau dupsan tawh ngun kualte-ah kikhihin a kikhai dalna puanpakte kikhungin, suangmanpha a san, a dum, a kang, le a vom, a nam tuamtuamte kizangin a kizem suangphah kiphah tungah kham le ngun kibawl lupnate kikoih hi.
Tua banah Kumpinu Vashti in zong numeite a dingin Kumpipa Ahasueras' innsung mahah pawi khat a bawl hi.
A ni sagih ni, zunekna hangin a lung a nop ciangin kumpipa in ama na a sem innsungmang sagihte Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, le Karkas-te sam a, mite le uliante mai-ah Kumpinu Vashti a melhoihna a lahtheih nadingin a kumpi lukhu khusa-in ama kiangah a paipih nadingun a sawl hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua nu a mel a hoih takpi mah ahi hi.
Ahih hangin Kumpinu Vashti in innsungmangte' thupuak kumpipa' sapna a nial hi. Hih a nialna thu-ah kumpipa heh mahmah a, a hehna hangin a sin so hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in upadi siam a mipilte thu dong hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh upadi le biakna lam thutheite khempeuh thu dot pen kumpipa' zat ngei khat ahi hi.
Ama gei nai penah a tu mite pen Persia le Media gam ulian sagihte ahi Karshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, le Memukan-te hi uh a, kumpipa kiangah a hawh thei, kumpi gam sungah ulian pente ahi uh hi.
"Innsung mangte' tungtawnin keimah kumpi Ahasueras' thupiakna bangin Kumpinu Vashti gamta lo ahih manin Kumpinu Vashti tungah upadi tawh kizui-in bangci kihih ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa le uliante' zakin Memukan in dawng a, "Kumpinu Vashti khial hi; kumpipa tung bek hi loin Kumpipa Ahasueras' ukna gam sung khempeuha om uliante le mi khempeuh tungah zong a khial ahi hi.
Kumpinu' gamtatna thu numei dangte khempeuh in thei ding uh a, hih thu hangin numeite in a pasalte uh simmawh ding uh a, amaute in, 'Kumpipa Ahasueras in ama kiangah a pai dingin Kumpinu Vashti thu pia napi-in pai lo hi,' ci ding uh hi.
Hih banga kumpinu' gamtatna thu a za Persia le Media gam numei liante in kumpipa nuai-a uliante tungah tuni mahmahin hih thu gen ding uh a, kisimmawhna le kizahtak lohna tampi piangsak ding hi.
Kumpipa in hoih na sak leh, kumpi thupiakna khat paisak inla, Kumpipa Ahasueras' mai-ah Vashti a kilakkik nawn loh nadingin a kikhelkik ngei nawn lo ding Persia mite le Media mite' upadi sungah gelhsak in. Tua ciangin amah sangin a kilawmzaw numei khat ama za luahsak in.
Tua banga kumpipa' thupiakna thu kumpi gam sung khempeuhah a kizak ciangin numei khempeuh in a neu a lian amau' pasal ciat zahtak ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Kumpipa le uliante in hih ngaihsutna hoihsa uh a, Memukan' gen bangin kumpipa a gamta hi.
Pasal khempeuh pen ama innsung ukpa ahihna ding le ama kampau a kizuih kim nadingin kumpipa' ukna gam khempeuhah amau' lai ciat, le mi khempeuh tungah amau' pau ciatin laikhakte kigelh hi.
Hih thu teng a pian' khit, Kumpipa Ahasueras' hehna a dam ciangin, amah in Vashti phawkin, Vashti' gamtatna le amah tawh kisai-in a thupiakna zong thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa' nasemte in ama kiangah, "Kumpipa a dingin a melhoih nungak khangnote zongsak in.
Kumpi khua ahi Susa khuapi-a numeite' omna-ah a melhoih nungak khangno khempeuh hong paipih nadingun na ukna gam tuamtuam khempeuhah uliante sawl in. Tua numeite pen numeite a uk, kumpipa' innsungmang Hegai' kep dingin ki-ap hen. Tua ciangin tua numeite tungah paknamtui tuamtuam kiguan' hen.
Tua sung panin kumpipa' deih bel nungak pen Vashti' tangin kumpinu suak hen," a ci uh hi. Kumpipa in hih ngaihsutna hoihsa a, tua bangin a gamta hi.
Tu-in kumpi khua Susa khuapi sungah Benjamin minam Kish, a tapa Shimei, a tapa Jair, a tapa Mordekai a kici Jew mi khat om hi.
Amah pen, Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar in Jerusalem panin Judah kumpipa Jekoniah tawh a lak galmatte lak a kihel khat ahi hi.
Amah in a innlak pate khat' tanu, a min masa Hadassah, a nung ciangin Esther a kici, a khoi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a nu le a pa om nawn lo hi. Tua numei melhoihin a ngaihbaang mahmah khat hi a, a nu le a pa a sih ciangin Mordekai in ama tanu dingin a lak ahi hi.
Kumpipa' thupiakna kithei kimin, Hegai' kep dingin ap dingin kumpi khua Susa khuapi-ah numei tampi hong kipaipih ciangin, numeite a uk Hegai' tungah ap dingin kumpipa' inn-ah Esther zong kipaipih hi.
Amah in tua nungak hoihsa-in pakta mahmah ahih manin paknamtuite le a annek ding pia pah a, kumpipa' innsung panin a kiteel nasem numei sagih zong guan a, amah le a nasem numeite' tungah numeite' omna a hoihpen mun a pia pah hi.
Mordekai in kham ahih manin Esther in ama namlephung genkhia lo hi.
Esther bangci om a, ama tungah bang piang hiam cih a theih nadingin numeite' omna inntual mai-ah nisimin Mordekai va pai zel hi.
Numeite a kigin' hun a vekpi-in kha sawm le nih sung hi a, sathau le myrrh paknamtui tawh kha guk sung kipuahin, paknamtui tuamtuamte le kipuahna dangte tawh kha guk sung mah kipuah uh hi.
Kiginkholhna hun cing a, Kumpipa Ahasueras' kiangah numeite a pai ciangin numeite' omna panin kumpipa' inn-ah a deih peuhpeuh uh kikengsak hi.
Nitakin kumpipa kiangah va pai a, a zingsang ciangin numeite' omna a mun dang khatah kiciahsak a, kumpipa' zineute a uk, kumpipa' innsungmang Shaashgaz in kem hi. Kumpipa in a deihkik kei leh kumpipa kiangah paikik nawn lo a, kumpipa in a deih leh a minin kisamkik hi.
Mordekai in ama tanu dingin a lak a innlak pa Abihail' tanu Esther pen kumpipa kiangah a pai ding hun a tun ciangin, numeite a uk kumpipa' innsung mangpa Hegai' gen teng lobuang kizepna ding puan dang bangmah ngenthuah lo hi. Tu-in Esther a mu mi peuhmah in hoihsa kim uh hi.
Ama uk a kum sagihna, kha sawmna ahi Tebeth kha sungin kumpi innsung Kumpi Ahasueras' kiangah Esther a kipaipih ciangin,
kumpipa in ama numei dangte khempeuh sangin itzaw a, a nungak dangte khempeuh sangin limbawl zaw hi. Tua hi a, kumpi lukhu amah khusakin Vashti' tangin kumpinu a suaksak hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Esther pahtawina-in ama uliante le a nasem khempeuh a dingin pawi lianpi khat a bawl hi. Amah in ama ukna gam khempeuhah tua ni nasep khawlin zum a khakna ding uh zong thu zasak kim a, kumpipa min tawh a kilawm a kituak letsongte zong a hawmkhia hi.
Tua hun sungin Mordekai in kumpi nasep a ngah hi.
Ama hilhna tawh kizui-in Esther in ama minam ahi a, a innkuan ahi zongin pulak lo hi. Mordekai' kep sungin ama thu a man' mah bangin tu-in zong Mordekai' gen bangin gamta hi.
Ni khat, kumpi nasemin Mordekai a om hun sungin kongcing ahi kumpipa' innsungmangte Bigthana le Teresh heh uh a, Kumpipa Ahasueras thah ding a sawm uh hi.
Hih thu Mordekai in phawkin Kumpinu Esther kiangah ko a, Esther in Mordekai' hong thupuak, ci-in kumpipa kiangah a gensawn hi.
A thu kikanin a manna a kitheih ciangin khuampite tungah tua mi nih tegel kikhailum hi. Hih thupiangte khempeuh kumpipa' theihin Kumpi Gam Tangthu Laibu sungah kiciamteh hi.
Hih thute khit ciangin Kumpipa Ahasueras in Agag-te beh Hammedatha' tapa Haman a za khangsak a, amah tawh a semkhawm ulian dangte khempeuh sangin a lianzaw-in a bawl hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpi huang sunga om kumpipa' nasem khempeuh in Haman zahtak bawlin ama mai-ah kun uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua banga a hih ding uh kumpipa in thu pia hi. Ahih hangin Mordekai pen amah zahtakna limin a mai-ah kun lo hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa' huang sunga om kumpipa' nasemte in Mordekai kiangah, "Bang hangin kumpipa' thupiak mang lo na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Nisimin amaute in Mordekai kiangah gengen uh a, ahih hangin amah in mang nuam lo hi. Jew mi ahihna thu amaute kiangah gen khin ahih manin tua banga ama nialna a kimang ding mah ahi hiam cih a theih nadingun Haman kiangah a thu ko uh hi.
Ama mai-ah Mordekai a kun lohna, amah a zahtakbawl lohna a theih ciangin Haman nak heh mahmah hi.
Amah in Mordekai' mipihte a theih ciangin amah bek suktaak sa lo a, Ahasueras' kumpi gam sung khempeuhah a om Jew mi khempeuh, Mordekai le a minam buppi-in a suksiat theih nading lampi a zong hi.
Kumpi Ahasueras' uk a kum sawm le nihna, a kha masa pen ahi Nisan kha a kipanin a ni ni, a kha kha-in Pur a kici aisanna tawh Haman' muhin ai kisan a, a kha sawm le nihna Adar kha a ni sawm le thum ni-in ai a pha hi.
Tua ciangin Haman in Kumpipa Ahasueras' kiangah, "Na ukna gam tuamtuam sunga om mite lakah a om kawikawi, amau a tuam om mi pawlkhat om hi. Amau' ngeinate pen midangte a' tawh kibang lo a, amaute in nangma thukhamte zui lo uh hi. Tua ahih manin hih mite na hici khahkhong ding kilawm lo hi.
Kumpipa in hoih na sak leh amaute a kisuksiatna ding thu pia-in lai-in gelh in. Tua hileh nangma sumkholna sungah koih dingin na khutnuai-a na uliante tungah ngun talen tul sawm ka pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in ama khutsung panin a minthuhna zungbuh suahin Jew mite' gal, Agag-te beh Hammedatha' tapa Haman' tungah a pia hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Haman kiangah, "Na sum cihte nangmah kong piakik hi; na mi cihte zong nangma khut sungah kong pia hi; na ut bangbangin bawl in," a ci hi.
A kha masa a ni sawm le thum ni-in kumpipa' lai-atte khempeuh kisam a, Haman' genna tawh kizui-in kumpipa' nuai-ah gam tampi a uksawnte le gam khat a uksawnte, le gam uksawnte' khutnuai-ah a mi tuamtuamte lakah uliante tungah lai kipaisak hi. Gam khempeuhah amau' lai ciat, mi khempeuh tungah amau pau ciatin kigelh hi. Hih lai pen kumpipa Ahasueras' min tawh kigelhin kumpipa' minthuhna zungbuh tawh min kithuh hi.
Tua bangin kumpipa' ukna gam khempeuhah laitaite kipiasak a, Adar kha ahi a kha sawm le nihna a ni sawm le thum ni, ni khat sungin Jew mi a moi a ham, numei naupang, a vekpi-in susia-in, thatin, a beisakmangna ding uh, le a neihsate uh a laksak nadingun thu kipia hi.
Tua a ni seh ni-in amaute a baihsa-in a om theih nadingun hih thupiakna lai pen gam khempeuhah dal khat ciat kipuakin tua thu pen a gam sung mi khempeuh tungah a kizasak kim ding ahi hi.
Mordekai in hih thupiang teng a theih ciangin a puan balkekin puanhampi silhin vut kibuak a, nakpitakin a kap kawmin khua sungah vak kawikawi hi.
Puanhampi silh kawmpi-in kongpi-ah kuamah kilutsak lo ahih manin kumpi inn kongpi panin a kimuhna mun ciangah pai hi.
Kumpipa' thupiakna a tunna gam Jew mite' omna khempeuhah nakpi taka thumna le tauna, antanna, kahna, le dip-humna om hi. Mi a tamzaw in puanhampi silhin vut lakah lum uh hi.
Esther' nasem numeite le a innsungmangte hong pai-in ama kiangah tua thu a gen ciangun kumpinu in lamdangsa mahmah hi. A puanhampi a laih nadingin amah in Mordekai a' ding puante khak a, ahih hangin Mordekai in tuate na sang lo hi.
Tua ciangin Esther in ama na a sem dingin a kiseh, kumpipa innsungmangte lak panin Hathak a kici mipa samin hih thu pen bang hi a, bang a cihnopna ahi hiam, ci-in Mordekai tung panin thu a va kan dingin a sawl hi.
Kumpi inn kongpi mai-a om khuapi kongzing tualpi a om Mordekai kiangah Hathak va pai a,
Mordekai in ama tunga thupiangte khempeuh le Jew mite sukmang nadingin kumpipa' sumkholna-ah Haman in piak dinga a sum ciamzah thute khempeuh ama kiangah na gen hi.
Amaute a kisukmang nadingin Susa khua panin a kihawmkhia lai dal khat zong Mordekai in ama tungah pia a, amah in Esther tungah tua lai na pia-in a thu a na gentelna ding le, kumpipa kiangah Esther na pai-in ama mipihte a dingin a na thumsak ding zong a sawl hi.
Tua ciangin Esther in Hathak mah sawlkikin Mordekai' tungah thu zasak a,
"Numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin sap lohpi-in mi khat peuhpeuh kumpipa' omna inn sungah a va lut leh upadi khat bek om a, tua pen, thah ding ahi hi; kumpipa in ama lamah a kham kumpi ciangkhut a na zan leh tua mipa suakta bek ding ahihna thu kumpipa' nasemte le ama ukna gam mi khempeuh in a theih ciat uh ahi hi. Tu-in kumpipa kiangah a pai dingin hong kisap loh zawh ni sawmthum bang pha ta hi," a ci hi.
Tua hi a, Esther' thugen teng Mordekai tungah kigen hi.
Tua ciangin Mordekai in Esther a dawnkikna thu amahmah puasakkik a, "Kumpi inn sungah na omna hangin Jew mi khempeuh lak panin nang a suakta tuan dingin kingaihsun kei in.
Hih bang hunin bangmah hih loin na omcip leh, Jew mite' suahtakna ding le noptuamna ding thu mundang khat pan hong piang veve ding a, nangmah le na innkuanpihte na simang ding uh hi. Hih kumpi inn na tunna pen hih bang huna mah dinga a tung na hih mel zong kua in thei ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Esther in Mordekai a dawnna lai amah puasak leuleu a,
"Pai-in Susa khua sunga om Jew mi khempeuh khawm inla, keimah ngaihsutna-in an na tang un. A sun a zan ci loin ni thum sung an ne lo, tui dawn loin na om un. Na tan' uh mah bangin kei le ka nasem numeite in zong ka na tang ding uh hi. Tua khit ciangin ngeina ahihloh hangin kumpipa kiangah ka va pai ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Mordekai pai-in Esther' sawl bang teekteekin a gamta hi.
A ni thum ni-in Esther in a kumpipuan silhin kumpipa' inntual sungnungah dingin kumpi inn lam a nga hi. Kumpi innsung a kumpi tokhom tungah kumpipa tu-in kongpi lam na nga hi.
Inntualah Kumpinu Esther dinga a om kumpipa in a muh ciangin Esther in kumpipa' maipha ngah a, kumpipa in a khuta a tawi kumpi ciangkhut pen Esther' lamah a zan hi. Tua ciangin Esther in hong naihin tua ciangkhut dawn va lawng hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Kumpinu Esther aw, bang thu ahi hiam? Kei tungah nong nget peuhpeuh, ka kumpi gam phelkhat ciang dong, nang tungah hong kipia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Esther in, "Nong hehpih zawh leh, kumpipa a' dinga kong bawlsak nitak an a ne dingin tuni-in Haman tawh hong pai un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Esther' deih bangin i gamtat theih nadingin manlangin Haman va sam un," a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Esther' bawlsak nitak an a ne dingin kumpipa le Haman hong pai uh hi.
Esther in dawngin, "Nang tung panin kong ngetnop kong thumnop thu in:
Topa aw, nong hehpih zawh a, na lung a kim a, kong nget thu nong piakzawh ding le, no tegel a dingin ka na bawl an a ne dingin zing ciangin kumpipa le Haman hong pai un. Zing ciangin nong cih bangin ka deihna kong gen ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin lungdam kipakin tua ni-in Haman a ciah hi. Ahih hangin kongpi-a om Mordekai in amah zahtakna limin a mai-ah ding lo, kun lo-a om a muh ciangin Mordekai tungah nakpitakin a heh hi.
Ahi zongin Haman ki-ip tentanin inn-ah a ciah hi. Tua ciangin a lawmte le a zi Zeresh sam a,
ama hauhna teng, a tapa neih teng, kumpipa in amah a pahtak manin a za a khansakna teng, le kumpipa' nasemte le ulian dangte khempeuh sangin a lianzaw-in amah a koihna thute khempeuh amaute tungah genin a lak hi.
Tua ciangin Haman in, "Tua tengbek hi nai lo lai hi. Kumpinu Esther nangawn in ama bawlsa an kumpipa tawh a nekhawm dingin kei simloh midang kuamah paisak lo hi. Zing ciangin zong kumpipa tawh kei hong samkhawm hi.
Ahi zongin kumpipa' kongpi-a a tu Jew mi Mordekai ka muh laiteng hih thute khempeuh a mawkna suak zel hi," ci lai hi.
Tua ciangin a zi Zeresh le a lawmte khempeuh in ama kiangah, "Pi sawmsagih le nga a sang khuam phutsak inla, tua tungah Mordekai a kikhailup nadingin zingciangin kumpipa kiangah gen in. Tua ciangin nitak an ne dingin lungnuam takin kumpipa tawh pai in," a ci uh hi. Haman in hih ngaihsutna hoihsa a, a khuam a phutsak hi.
Tua zanin kumpipa ihmu thei lo a, nisim thupiang ciaptehna Khang Tangthu Laibu lasak a, ama zakin tua laibu kisim hi.
Tua banga a kisim ciangin, kongcingte sung panin innsungmang Bigthana le Teresh in Kumpipa Ahasueras thah a sawmna thu pen Mordekai in a genna thu a kiciamtehna simkha uh hi.
Tua thu a zak ciangin kumpipa in, "Hih thu hangin Mordekai' tungah pahtawina ahi a, minliatna ahi zongin bang kipia ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua lai-a a om kumpipa' nasemte in Mordekai' tungah bangmah a kipiak lohna thu a gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Hih kiimnai-ah kua om ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua laitakin Mordekai thah nadingin a phuhsa khuam tungah Mordekai khailupna ding thu kumpipa kiangah a ngen dingin kumpi huang sungah Haman hong tum hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa' nasemte in ama kiangah, "Hih lai-ah Haman om hi; inntualah ding hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Amah hong tumsak un," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Haman hong tum a, kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Kumpipa in a pahtawi nop mipa tungah bang kihih leh hoih na sa hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ciangin Haman in a lungsim sungah ngaihsun a, "Kumpipa in kei sangin a pahtawi nopzawk ding kua om zenzen ahi hiam?" ci-in ngaihsun hi.
Tua ahih manin Haman in kumpipa kiangah, "Kumpipa in a pahtawi nop mipa a dingin
kumpipa mahmah in a silh kumpi puante, le kumpipa a tuanna sakol a lukhu tawh la sak in.
Tua ciangin kumpipa' ulianpen khat tungah tua kumpi puante le sakol apsak in. Kumpipa in a pahtawi nop mipa pen amah zemsak inla, tua ciangin khuasung kongzing lampi-ah sakol tungah a tuangsa-in na ulian pen pa kaisak inla, ama mai-ah kiko sakin, 'Kumpipa in a pahtawi nop mipa tungah hih bangin kibawl ding hi,' cisak in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Haman kiangah, "Na cihsa bangin manlangin kumpi puante le sakol la pah inla, kongpi-a om Jew mi Mordekai tungah hih thute khempeuh hih in. Na gensa khat beek siit kei in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Haman in kumpi puante le sakol la-in Mordekai zem a, khuapi sung kongzing lampi-ah amah tuangsakin, "Kumpipa in a pahtawi nop mipa tungah hih bangin kibawl ding hi," ci-in a taangko hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa' kongpi-ah Mordekai ciahkik hi. Haman ahih le kilukhuhsa-in a thum kawmin a inn-ah ciahpah vingveng hi.
Tua ciangin Haman in a zi Zeresh le a lawmte khempeuh tungah ama tunga thupiang teng a gen hi. Tua ciangin a zi Zeresh le a lawmte in ama kiangah, "Tu-a na lelhtak Mordekai pen Jew mi ahi hi; amah na zo kei ding a, amah in nang hong zozaw ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua bangin Haman tawh amaute a kiho laitakin kumpipa' innsungmangte hong pai a, Esther' bawlsa nitak an a ne dingin amah a paikhiatpih pah uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kumpinu Esther tawh an a ne dingin kumpipa le Haman va pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpinu Esther in dawngin, "Kumpipa in nong hehpihzawh a, kumpipa in hoih na sak leh, kong nget kong thumnop thu pen keimah le ka mipihte sihna tawh nong kipelhsakna ding ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh kei le ka mite suksiat ding, thah ding, beisakmang dingin hong kizuak hi. Kote, numei pasal a kibangin sal dingin hong kizuak hileh bangmah ka pau kei ding hi; tua bang lel tawh kumpipa nawngkaisak taak lo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpipa Ahasueras in Kumpinu Esther kiangah, "Hih banga gamtat ding a ngaihsun kua hi a, koi-ah om ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Esther in, "Hong langpang ka gal pa! Hih migilo Haman!" a ci hi. Tua laitakin kumpipa le kumpinu' mai-ah cih nading thei loin Haman a om hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa a hehsa-in annekna pan dingkhia-in kumpi huan sungah a pai hi. Ahi zongin Haman ahihleh tua lai mahah omin Kumpinu Esther in a nuntakna a suahtaksakna ding a thum hi; bang hang hiam cih le kumpipa in amah thah dingin a ngaihsutna a lungsim a thei hi.
Kumpi huan panin a annekna mun uhah kumpipa hong paikik ciangin Esther' tutna lamah Haman na awn phei-in a om mu a, kumpipa in, "Ka innsung ka muhna nangawnah hih mipa in kumpinu hih ding ahi hiam?" ci hi. Kumpipa in tua thu a cih phetin amaute in Haman' mai puan a khuh uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa' na a sem innsungmangte lakah Harbona in, "Nidangin kumpipa' na hoihtakin a sem ngei Mordekai thah nadingin Haman mahmah in a phuhsak, pi sawmsagih le nga a sang khuam pen Haman' inn-ah tumahin om hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Tua tungah amah khailum un," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Mordekai khailup nadingin a phuh khuam tungah Haman a khailum uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa' hehna a dam hi.
Tua ni mahin Kumpipa Ahasueras in Jew mite' gal ahi Haman' neihsa khempeuh Kumpinu Esther tungah pia hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa' omna-ah Mordekai hong tung hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah tawh a kinaina zia, kumpipa kiangah Esther in gen hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Haman' tung panin a lakkiksa minthuhna zungbuh pen suahkhia-in Mordekai a pia hi. Tua hi a, Haman' neihsa khempeuh a uk dingin Esther in Mordekai a koih hi.
Kumpipa' mai-ah Esther khatvei va paikikin khitui naptui tawh a khe mai-ah va puk a, Agag mi Haman' vaihawm siatna lianpi le Jew mite a sawmna thu a kipelhkik theih nadingin va thum hi.
Kumpipa in Esther' lamah a kham ciangkhut na zan a,
tua ciangin Esther thoto-in kumpipa mai-ah dingin, "Kei nong hehpihzawh a, hih ka ngaihsutna man na sak a, hoih na sak le, na ukna gam sung khempeuhah a om Jew mite thahna ding a sawmna-in Agag-te beh Hammedatha' tapa Haman in a laigelhte dawhkik nadingin lai khat gelhsak in.
Ka mipihte tungah hih siatna lianpi a tung ka muh ding bangci thuakzawh ding ka hi hiam? Ahih kei le ka innkuanpih tungah a tung hih siatna ka muh ding bangci thuakzawh ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpipa Ahasueras in Kumpinu Esther le Jew mi Mordekai tungah, "Haman in Jew mite thah hong sawm ahih manin sing tungah amah kikhailum khin a, Haman' neihsa khempeuh Esther' tungah kong pia khin hi.
Kumpipa' min tawh kigelhin, kumpipa' minthuhna tawh a kithuh khinsa lai pen kidokkik thei nawn lo ahih manin, tu-in Jew mite tawh kisai-in hoih dinga na up bangin kumpipa' min tawh gelh inla, tua khit ciangin kumpipa' minthuhna zungbuh tawh thuh in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a kha thumna ahi Sivan kha a ni sawm le thum ni-in kumpipa' lai-atte kisam a, Mordekai' gen bang teekteekin Jew mite tung le India panin Ethiopia dong gam zakhat le sawmnih le sagih a uk ahi gam tampi a ukte, gam khat a ukte le tua gam sunga uliante tungah lai kihawmkik a, amau' lai ciat le amau' pau ciatin kigelh a, Jew mite a' ding zong amau' lai le amau' pau mahin kigelh hi.
Tua lai pen Kumpipa Ahasueras' minin kigelhin kumpipa' min thuhna zungbuh mah tawh kithuh a, kumpi sakol bukah a kikhawi kumpipa' sakolte tungah laitaite kituangsakin lai kihawmsak hi.
Kha sawm le nihna ahi Adar kha a ni sawm le thumna ni khat sungin Kumpi Ahasueras' ukna gam sung khempeuhah Jew mite in amau a sim ding mi ahih kei leh a gamte' hihna ding panin khua khempeuhah amau na kipawlin na kihu-in, tua banga amaute a hih dingte pen a numei a naupangin susia-in, thatin a beisakna ding uh le a neihsate uh a laksak theihna dingun hih banga lai piakna tawh kumpipa in Jew mite tungah hih theihna ding thu a pia hi.
Tua thupiakna lai pen gam khempeuhah kihawmin mi khempeuh kitheisakin, amau' galte a thukkikna ding ahi tua ni tawh kisai-in Jew mite a kiginkholh ding uh ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa' sakolte tungah laitaite tuangin kumpipa' thu-kin sawl mah bangin nawhtai uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpi khua Susa khuapi sungah zong tua thupiakna lai a kihawm hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi puan a san le a kang silhin, kham tawh kibawl kumpi lukhu lianpi khu-in, saihadial puanneel le puansan silhsa-in kumpipa' omna panin Mordekai paikhia hi. Tua ciangin Susa khuapi sung mi khempeuh lungdamin awng uh hi.
Tua hi a, Jew mite in suahtakna, lungdamna, le pahtawina ngah uh hi.
Kumpipa' thupiakna a tunna gam le khua khempeuhah Jew mite a dingin lungdamna le kipahna, pawi bawlna le nasep khawlin zum khakna a om hi. Tua hi a, midangte in Jew mite kihta uh ahih manin tua gam a om mi tampi tak in Jew mi ka hi uh hi, a ci uh hi.
A kha sawm le nihna ahi Adar kha a ni sawm le thum ni-in kumpipa' thupiakna bangin sepkhiatna ding hun hong tung hi. Jew mite' galte in gualzo dinga a ki-up ni teek pen amau a mudah mite' tungah Jew mite a gualzawh ni ding hong hizaw hi.
Tua ni-in amaute' siatna ding a geelte a sugawp dingin Kumpipa Ahasueras' ukna gam khempeuha amau' khuapite sungah Jew mite kikhawm uh hi. Mi khempeuh in Jew mite kihta uh ahih manin kuamah in Jew mite nang ngam lo uh hi.
Mordekai kihta uh ahih manin gam tampi a ukte le gam khat a ukte le gam sunga ulian tuamtuamte le kumpi ulian khempeuh in Jew mite panpih uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh kumpi inn sungah Mordekai ulianpi khat suak a, a vangliatna a khan semsem mah bangin gam khempeuhah ama minthanna kizel hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Jew mite in namsau tawh a galte uh tampi tak thatlum uh a, amau a mudahte a ut utun hihgawp uh hi.
Kumpi khua Susa khuapi sung mahmahah Jew mite in mi zanga thatin susia uh hi.
Tua hi a, amaute in Jew mite' gal ahi Hammedatha' tapa Haman' tapa sawmte Parshandatha, Dalfon, Aspatha, Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha, Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, le Vaizatha-te zong a that uh hi. Ahi zongin amau' neihsate suksak lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Kumpinu Esther kiangah, "Kumpi khua Susa khuapi sungah Jew mite in mi zanga that uh a, Haman' tapa sawmte zong that uh hi. Ka ukna gamdangte sungah zong bangzah that ding kithei lo hi. Tu-in bang deih lai na hi hiam? Nong nget peuhpeuh hong kipia lai ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Esther in, "Kumpipa in hoih na sak leh, tuni-a mah bangin zing ciangin zong Susa khuapi sunga om Jew mite tungah hih theihna thu pia inla, Haman' tapa sawmte' luanghawmte khuam tungah khaisak in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin tua banga a hih nadingin kumpipa in a sawl hi. Susa khuapi sungah hih thu suakkhiasak a, khuam tungah Haman' tapa sawmte kikhai hi.
Susa khuapi sunga om Jew mite Adar kha a ni sawm le li ni-in kikhawm kikin Susa khua sungah mi zathum that uh hi. Ahi zongin amau' neihsate suksak lo uh hi.
Tua mah bangin kumpipa' ukna gam tuamtuama om Jew mite zong amau' kihut nadingin kikhawm uh hi. Amaute in zong amau a mudah mihing tul sawmsagih le tulnga thatin a galte uh tungah phu la uh hi. Ahih hangin a neihsate uh suksak lo uh hi.
Hih banga a hih pen Adar kha a ni sawm le thum ni hi a, a ni sawm le li ni-in tawlnga uh a, pawi bawlin lungdamin om uh hi.
Ahih hangin Susa khua sunga om Jew mite ahihleh a ni sawm le thum le sawm le li ni-in kikaikhawm uh a, a ni sawm le nga ni tawlnga uh a, pawi bawlin lungdamin om uh hi.
Hih thu hangin gam sung khuaneute-a teng Jew mite in Adar kha a ni sawm le li ni pawi bawlna le lungdam ni dingin tawlngak ni-in nei uh a, anlim nono kikholhna ni-in a zang uh hi.
Tua ciangin Mordekai in hih thupiangte khempeuh lai-in ciamteh a, a nai a gamla a om Kumpi Ahasueras' ukna gam sung khempeuha om Jew mite tungah lai paisak hi.
A kumkumin Adar kha ni sawm le li ni le sawm le nga ni a tanna dingun thu a pia hi.
Tua nite pen Jew mite a galte uh tung panin a suahtak ni, dahna le thumnate lungdamna le lungnopna a suah kha ahi hi. Tua ahih manin amaute in pawi bawl ni le lungdam ni-in nei-in, anlim nono khatlekhat kikholh ni le mizawngte tungah letsong piak ni-in a zat dingun thu a pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Mordekai' laigelhna tawh kizui-in Jew mite in a patsa uh hih banga a hihnate uh a zom uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Jew mi khempeuh' gal ahi, Hammedatha' tapa, Agag-te beh Haman in Jew mite sugawpin a suksiat nadingin Pur kici ai sanin Jew mite suksiat ding sawm hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in hih thu a theih ciangin, Jew mite sukna dingin Haman in a geelsa thu hoih lo pen Haman' lu tung mah a lehtukna ding, le amah le a tapate khuam tungah a kikhaina ding lai-in gelhin thu a pia hi.
Jew mite amau mahmah, le a suan a khakte uh, le amau a pawlpih khempeuh in lai sunga kigelh bangin a kiseh hunin kum simin hih ni nihte a pel loin a tan' ding uh kipsak uh a,
a khangkhangin innkuan sim, gam sim, khuapi simah hih nite phawkin a kitanna ding, le Jew mite lakah hih Purim nite a kitan' ngitngetna ding ahi a, a suanlekhakte un zong hih thu a mangngilh hetloh nading uh ahi zongin khotakin a len uh hi.
Tua ciangin Abihail' tanu Kumpinu Esther in Purim thu tawh kisai hih laikhak nihna a kipsak nadingin Jew mi Mordekai tungah aana a kicingin a piakna lai-in a gelh hi.
Kumpi Ahasueras' ukna gam za le sawmnih le sagih sungah a om Jew mite khempeuh tungah kilemna le nopna a omna ding deihsakna laite kikhak a,
Jew mi Mordekai in a gelhsa bangin a kisehsa tawh kizui-in hih Purim nite a tan nadingun thu kipia hi. Tua mah bangin amaute le a suanlekhakte uh a dingin antanna ding le thumna bawlna ding ngeinate a gelh uh hi.
Kumpinu Esther' thupiakna in hih Purim bawlna ding ngeinate kipsak a, lai thupite sungah hih thu kiciamteh hi.
Kumpipa Ahasueras in a ukna gam leitung le tuikulh tunga tengte tung panin siah kai hi.
Ama vangliatna le a sepnate khempeuh, le Mordekai tungah a piak minphatnate, Media le Persia Kumpite' Khang Tangthu Laibu sungah kigelh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Kumpipa Ahasueras' zomah Mordekai a lianpen ahi hi. Mordekai in ama mite' phattuamna ding le a suanlekhakte uh a khantohna ding hanciam ahih manin Jew mite lakah milian khat hi a, a gam mihonpite in a it kim uh hi.
Uz gamah Job kici min nei mi khat a om hi. Tua mipa a paubaang lo, a thutang, Pasian a zahtak mi khat hi a, amah in gamtat hoih lo peuhmah peel hi.
Amah in tapa sagih le tanu thum nei hi.
Amah in tuu tulsagih, kalaoh tulthum, bawngtal kap zanga, lapi zanga le nasem tampi tak a nei hi. Tua ahih manin nisuahna gam sungah Job a haupen khat ahi hi.
Ama tapate in inn khat panin inn khatah a ban banin pawi bawlin pai kawikawi uh a, tua pawi a siim dingin a sanggam numei thumte uh zong a sam kawikawi uh hi.
Tua banga a pawi bawl uh gual khat a kikhit ciangin Job in a tapate samin amaute siansuah a, zingsangin tho baihin a ta phazah tawh kizui-in meihal biakna a pia hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Job in, "Ka tate khialin, a lungsim sung uhah Pasian samsia khathei ding uh hi," a ci hi. Tu-a bangin Job in hih tawntung hi.
Ni khat ni-in Topa' omna-ah vantung mite hong pai uh a, tuate lakah Satan zong hong kihel hi.
Topa in Satan kiangah, "Koi pana hong pai na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Satan in Topa dawngin, "Leitung khempeuh a lu pan a taw dong vak kawikawi-in ka va phehlehna mun panin ka hong pai hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Satan kiangah, "Ka nasem Job na phawkkha hiam? A paubaang lo, a thutang, Pasian zahtakin gamtat hoih lo a peel amah tawh a kibang midang leitungah na mu kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Amah le a innkuan le a neihsate khempeuh na hutna-in a kimkotah daai khan hi lo na hi hiam? Ama hihna khempeuhah thupha na pia a, genzawh lohin ama neihsa pung hi.
Ahi zongin na khut zanin ama neihsa khempeuh suksak lecin na maitang mahmahah nang hong samsia pah ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Satan kiangah, "En in, ama neihsa khempeuh na khut sungah kong ap hi; ahi zongin amah taktak ahihleh na su kei ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Topa' omna panin Satan a paikhia hi.
Kamtai khat Job kiangah hong tungin, "Bawngtalte in lo kho-in, tuate gei-ah late gamta uh hi.
Tua laitakin Seba mite hong pai-in ganhingte hong sut a, namsau tawh gancingte thatkhin uh hi. Hih thu a hong zasak thei dingin kei bek kong suakta hi," a ci hi.
Amah in a thugen a khit ma-in kamtai dang khat hong tungin, "Vantung panin keek hong kia a, tuute le tuucingte kha-in kangtum uh hi. Hih thu nang kiangah a hong ko thei dingin kei bek kong suakta hi," a ci hi.
Tua pa in a thugen a khit ma-in kamtai dang khat hong tung leuleu-in, "Khaldea mite hon thum in kalaohte hong sut a, namsau tawh kalaoh tung tuangte khempeuh that hi. Hih thu nang kiangah a hong ko thei dingin kei bek kong suakta hi," a ci hi.
Tua laitakin sehnel gam panin huihpi pingpei hong nungin a inn mutpai-in na tate denglum hi. Nang kiangah hih thu a hong ko thei dingin kei bek kong suakta hi," a ci hi.
Hih thu a zak ciangin Job dahlua-in a puan balkek a, a sam met khia-in leilakah bok sukin Pasian a bia hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Ka nu sung panin guaktangin ka suak a, guaktang mahin ka ciahkik ding hi. Topa in hong pia a, Topa mah in hong lakik hi. Topa' min kiphat ta hen," a ci hi.
Hih thu khempeuhah Job khial lo a, Pasian zong mawhsak lo hi.
Ni khat ni-in Topa' omna-ah vantung mite hong paikik uh a, Satan zong amaute lakah hong kihelin Topa' omna mahah hong pai hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Satan kiangah, "Koi lai panin hong pai na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Satan in Topa dawngin, "Leitung khempeuh a lu pan a taw dong vak kawikawi-in ka va phehlehna mun panin kong pai hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Satan kiangah, "Ka nasem Job na phawk hiam? A paubaang lo, a thutang, Pasian zahtakin gamtat hoih lo a peel, amah tawh a kibang midang leitungah om lo hi. Thu om lopi-in amah susia dingin kei nong kam pausak a, ahi zongin ama hoihna bangmah hem tuan lo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Satan in Topa dawngin, "Vun bek in vun mah leizo bek, ci-in paunak a om mah bangin mi khat in ama nuntakna a hutna-in a neih khempeuh pia ngam ding hi.
Tu-in na khut zan inla, ama sa le a guh suksak lecin nangma maitang mahah pel loin nang hong samsia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa' omna panin Satan paikhia a, Job a khetul pan a luzang dongin a kihhuai meima a veisak hi.
Tua ciangin Job in beel kitam themkhat la-in tua tawh kikhuatin vut lakah a tu hi.
Tua ciangin a zi in, "Na upna khiam tuan lo ding na hi hiam? Pasian samsia inla sisuk mai in," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in a zi kiangah, "Numei haite' kampau bangin na pau hi. Pasian' tung panin a hoih sang ihih ciangin siatna zong sang lo ding ihi hiam?" a ci hi. Hih thu khempeuhah a kampau nangawnin Job khial lo hi.
Job' lawmte thum, Teman khuami Elifaz, Shuah gammi Bildad, le Naamah gammi Zofar-te in Job in a thuak gimna thu teng a zak uh ciangin a inn ciat panun amah a hehnem ding le a hanthawn dingin kituahin hong paikhawm uh hi.
Amaute in a gamla sim mun panin Job a muh tungun amah thei pah lo uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute a gingin kapkhia uh a, a puan uh balkekin a lu tung uh a tukik dingin leivui lawnto uh hi.
Tua ciangin leilakah sun sagih le zan sagih sung amah tawh tukhawm uh a, ama thuakna a nasiat mahmah lamtak mu uh ahih manin kuamah in kam khat beek a paupih ngam kei uh hi.
Hih bang teng khit ciangin Job in thugen hong kipan a, mihingin a pian' ni a samsia hi.
"Ka suah ni, le 'Pasal naungek khat kipaii hi,' a kicih zan beimang hen!
Tua ni khimzin' ni suak hen! Vana Pasian in phawkin nei kei hen la, tua ni-in khuavak taang kei hen.
Khuaniim, khuamial in khuhcip hen. Tua ni-in meiipi zing hen la, tua ni awk in valhtum hen.
"Tua zan, khuamial sahpi in mancip hen! Kum khat sunga nidangte tawh kisim khawm kei hen la, kha khat sunga nidangte lakah kiseh khawm kei hen.
Tua zanin ta piang kei hen la, lungdam otna awging tua zanin ging nawnkei hen.
Phuisamna tawh awle a khiim thei, a mitphial tawh tuipi ganhing a hencip thei mite in tua zan samsia tahen.
Tua ni zingsang aksite mial hen. A vak ngei lo ding khuavak ngak niloh hen la, zingsang phalvak mu ngeikei hen;
bang hang hiam cih leh kei hong kipaiina naugil na khakcip lo a, kei' muhna panin lungkhamna hong hepkhiatsak lo hi.
"Bang hangin a sisa-in suak hoh lo a, bang hangin ka suah phetin si pah hoh lo ka hi hiam?
Bang hangin ka nu' khuk tungah hong kitawi se a, ka nu' nawi hong kiteepsak se ahi hiam?
Tua hi zenzen kei leh hanah nuamtakin ka lum hithiat khin ding hi. Sihna sungah ihmu-in ka tawlnga khin ding a,
inn hoihnono a lam kumpite le uliante,
ngun le kham tawh a kidim a hau a liante tawh nuamtakin hanah ka tawlnga khinta ding hi.
Bang hangin a hun cing lo-a suakte bang, khuavak a mu man loin a si naungekte bangin hong kiseelcip hoh lo ahi hiam?
Tua lai-ah migilote in hong sukha nawn lo ding a, a gim mite tawlnga hithiat ding hi.
Tua lai-ah galmat salte in nopna ngah ding a, nasem ukpa' awging za nawn lo ding uh hi.
Tua lai munah milian mineu omkhawm a, silate nangawn a topa' kiang pan suakta hi.
"Bang hangin lungkhamna a thuak mipa, a nuntakna haksa a sa mahmah mipa,
sih ding lunggulh ngeungau napi, a si thei lo, sum phum zon sangin sih ding a lim zonzaw,
han sung a tun ciangin a nuam mahmah, hankhuk a tun ciangin nuam lua-in a dianggawp mite, khuavak a mu dingin mi-in piang laizang ahi hiam?
Bang hangin mailam thu ding a thei lopi-in a mot om ding, a kimkotah Pasian in daai a khaknelh mipa, mi-in piang zenzen ahi hiam?
Bang hang hiam cih leh khuisatna, ka annek suak a, ka tauna, luipi ging bang hi.
Ka kihtaktak thu ka tungah hong tung ta a, ka laulau thu, ka tuak ta hi.
Lungnopna, daitakin omna, ka nei kei hi. Lungkhamna in hong nawk niloh a, tawldam hun ka nei kei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Teman khuami Elifaz in thu hong gen a,
"Mi khatpeuh in thu hong genpih leh na heh ding hiam? Kua in a kam ipzo nawn ding ahi hiam?
Lunghiang mite na hanthotna, khut kha ban kha mite na thakhauhsakna,
a puk mite na thugenna tawh na kipsakna, khukzaw mite na hatsak ngeite ngaihsun in.
Ahi zongin nang tungah tuate hong tung a, na thuakzo kei hi. Tuate in nang hong su a, na lungniam hi.
Tu-in ngaihsun in: Midik kimlai kua sia ngei ahi hiam? A thutang mi a kisuksiatna koi-ah mu ngei na hi hiam?
Mawhna bawlin buaina a piangsak mi in a gamtatna bangin a gah a atna ka thei hi.
Pasian' husanna tawh tua bang mite sia a, ama hehna in tua bang mite kangtum hi.
Humpinelkai hawk bangin migilote' hawkna dai ta a, Pasian in amaute' ha suktansak khin ahih manin gamdai ta uh hi.
Annek ding a mu lo a thahat humpinelkai bangin amaute simang khin uh a, a tate uh kithehthang hi.
"Tu-in kei kiangah thu khat hong tung khian a, ka bil in tua thu ginghiau a za hi.
Mi a ihsip hun zankim laitak, zan mangmat hun laitakin
launa le linna kei tungah hong tung a, ka pumpi linna in kei hong lausak hi.
A mel ka khen theih loh lim khat hong ding a, keima mai-ah mihing lim khat hong om a, tua ciangin aw un duadua khat ka za a,
'Pasian' mai-ah mi khatpeuh paubaang loin omzo ngei ding ahi hiam? Amah a Bawlpa' mai-ah sitbaang loin omzo ngei ding ahi hiam?
Pasian in ama nasemte mahmah muangzo loin, ama sawltakte' mawhna mu ahihleh,
inn umna kawmin buan a kizatna inn sunga a teng mite, a inn bulpi leivui ahi,
zing kal nitak kalin, a kisusia thei sungah a omte, bangzah ta-in kuama don lohin si pakin,
amau' liatna in taisan pak ding a, pilna ngah ngei loin si pakzaw ding hi lo ahi hiam?' hong ci hi.
"Tu-in na thu ko in: Nang hong huh ding om ahi hiam? A siangthote kua pen' lam zuan ding na hi hiam?
Mihai pa in a hehna sihlawh a, muhdahna in sihna piangsak hi.
Mihai pa in limtakin zung kha ngei napi, ama inn thakhatin a kizunglot ka mu ngei hi.
A tapate suahtaksak zawh ding hi nawn lo hi. Kulhkongpi gei-ah amaute kisugawp a, amaute a honkhia ding kuamah om lo hi.
Midangte in a neihsate liahtumsak uh a, amah sangin a hatzaw pa in a um a beel sunga a omte nangawn laksak a, a neih a lam duhgawhin a deihgawh hi.
Leilak panin gimna hong piangtawm lo a, lei sung panin lungkhamna hong pokhiatawm lo hi.
Mei-ek a to leen mah bangin mihingte in amau' lungkhamna ding mah a piangsak uh hi.
"Nang hi leng, ka Pasian' tungah ka thum ding a, ama tungah ka thu ka ap ding hi.
Amah in na liante le kuama phawk zawh loh thute sem a, genzawh lohin a lamdang na tampi a bawl hi.
Amah in guah zusak a, lo khempeuh tui a buak hi.
Amah in mi niamte sangkoih a, a dahte lungnuamsak hi.
Amah in migilote amau' gitlohna mahah awksak a, ngian a zangte' geelna zong a lumletsak hi.
Sunthapai-in khuamial sung kidenna a, suntangpi mahin zan bangin mial a zawt uh hi.
Ahi zongin amah in amau' kiang panin pa nei lote honkhia a, mi thahatte kiang panin mi cimawhte a honkhia hi.
Tua ahih manin mizawngte in lametna neikik uh a, thuman lo mite ahihleh kihencip hi.
"Pasian in a taii mite mi nuamsa hizaw ahih manin, Vanglianpa' taiina thupi san in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a liamsak hangin a liamna tunsak ding a, ama satna liamma damsak ding hi.
Lungkhamna gukvei dong na tuahna-ah amah in nang hong hon ding a, a sagihveina dingah siatna in nang hong su nawn lo ding hi.
Kialpi sungin sih nading pan nang hong honkhia ding a, gal sungah namsau panin nang hong suaktasak ding hi.
Gensiatna panin nang hong kihu ding a, siatna hong tun ciangin na lau kei ding hi.
Suksiat ding le puksih dingte na nuihsan lel ding a, leitung gamsate na kihta kei ding hi.
Na inn sungah lunghihmawhna ding om lo hi, ci-in na thei ding a, na inn kiim na et ciangin a kitasam bangmah om lo ding hi.
Na suan na khakte tampi tak pha ding hi, ci-in na thei ding a, na sunga piangte leitung lopa zah pha ding hi, ci-in na thei ding hi.
A hun ciangin ancilna phualah buhlom a tun mah bangin a teek sihin han na zuan ding hi.
Hih thute khempeuh ka kantel uh a, a thuman a na hi hi. Hih thute ka zaksa uh hi a, a manna na thei ding hi," a ci hi.
"Ka lunggimna kitawikhai hen la, ka haksatna khempeuh kitawiteh leh!
Tuipi sehnel khempeuh sangin gikzaw ding ahih manin ka kampaute guhin a kha hi.
Gam late in lopa a nek laitakin ham a, bawngtal in an a nek laitakin ham ahi hiam?
Ka kam in tuate ciam nuam lo a, tuate khempeuh a luaksuahhuai an tawh a kibang lel ahi hi.
"Ka ngetna ngah thei hi leng a, Pasian in ka deihna hong pia ding hileh
Tua hileh keima kihehnepna hi ding a, hih zahta ka thuakna-ah nuamin ka diang ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Siangtho Pa' thu ka nial khat zong om lo hi.
Ka thuak lai nadingin bang hatna nei nawn a, lungduai a ka om nadingin lamet ding bang om nawn ahi hiam?
Ka thahatna suang bang hi a, ka pumpi in sumngo tha paii ahi hiam?
Kei le kei' sung panin huhna bangci ngahtawm theih ding ka hi hiam? Kei hong kihuhna ding ka ngetna ding kuamah om lo hi.
No ka lawmte pen, lui tuikhang bang, a mangthang pak tui let bang,
nin a khalhnelh vuk le tuikhal bangin na zuautat uh hi.
Khua a lum ciangin tuate tui mangthang a, ni a sat ciangin a kang hi.
Tua tui a zong dingin khualzin mite pai kawikawi a, gam sung tengah kawi pai-in a mangthang uh hi.
Tema khuami khualzinte in zong tua tui zong uh a, Sheba mite in zong tua tui muanin a nei uh hi.

Tu-in zong kei a dingin note tua bang lel na hi uh hi. Ka gimna teng nong mu uh a, na lau uh hi.
ka galte' kiang panin hong honkhia un, kei a hong nengniamte' khutsung panin hong tankhia un,' hong ci ngei zenzen ka hi hiam?
"Hong hilh thei le-uhcin, pau loin ka ompah ding hi. Ka khialhna hong theitelsak dih un.

Kamging mawkmawk lelte heh taak sa a, huih' letmang cihmawh kamte thupi ngaihsut na hi uh hiam?
Mi cimawh khat suksiatgawp sawm a, na lawm khat uh hihgawp sawm na hi uh hiam?
Tu-in kong thum hi; kihei unla kei hong en un. Na maitang uhah zuau a gen dingin kilawm ka hi hiam?
Ngaihsun pha un, a kilawm lopi-in kei hong hih kei un. Ngaihsun pha un, ka hoihna teng a hong kize-et hi lel hi.
Ahi zongin zuau gen mahin nong ngaihsun lai veve uh a, a sia le a pha a khenthei loin nong seh lai veve uh hi.
"Leitungah mihing in nasep haksa nei a, ama hun pen nasempa-a' bang hi lo ahi hiam?
Sila nasemte in niliim lunggulhin nasempa in a thaman a ngak tawh kibang hi lo ahi hiam?
A mawkna-in kha tampi sung ka om a, zanthapai-in lungkhamna bek keima tanh ahi hi.
Nitak ka lup ciangin, 'Cik ciangin khua hong vakin zing ka tho tam,' ka ci hi. Ahi zongin zan sau a, zingsang khuavak mateng ka kigawigawi hi.
Ka pumpi tung khempeuhah than bekbek kidim a, ka vun tung khempeuh meima in tuamcip hi.
Ka hunte siamgante' siam ciangtang sangin manlang zaw a, lametna om loin a mong tung pak hi.
Kei hong mu ngei pa in kei hong mukik nawn lo ding a, na hong et laitak mahin ka mangthang ding hi.
Meiilum kaite bei-in a manthan bangin Leinuai a paisuk pa mangthang ding hi.
Ama inn ah hong ciahkik nawn lo ding a, ama omna ngei mun in amah thei nawn lo ding hi.
Tua ahih manin pau loin ka om kei ding hi. Ka lungkham manin kam ka pau ding a, ka gimluat manin ka phun ding hi.
"Kei a hong cing ding na koih nadingin kei, tuipi ganhing hong sa na hi hiam?
Lum leng nuam ding a, ihmu leng phatuam ding hi, ci leng lah,
a lauhuai mang nong mansak a, a lauhuai maangmuhna tawh nong lausak hi.
Tua ahih manin gui-awk ding ka utzaw a, hih bang ka thuak sangin ka si nuamzaw hi.
Ka lungkham a, ka nungta nuam nawn kei hi. Ka nuntakna pen husan' bang hi lel ahih manin hong hici omsak hoh in.
"Nang in hih zahin na thupi ngaihsut dingin na lungsimah na ngaihsut dingin

Mihingte a encik pa aw, a khial ka hih leh zong nangma tungah bang gamta khial ka hi hiam? Bang hangin kei hong ngim a, bang hangin nangma muitum suak zenzen ka hi hiam?

"Tua bang thu bang tanvei gengen ding a, bang tanvei paupau ding na hi hiam?
Pasian in thutang a zanglo sa na hi hiam? Vanglianpa in thuman a zanglo sa na hi hiam?
Na tate ama tungah khial a, amau' mawhnate amaute a tuaksak ahi hi.
A hun lai-in Pasian zong inla, Vanglianpa' hehpihna ding thuum lecin,

Tua hileh, na zawn' mahmah khit hangin a tawpna-ah na hau kik ding hi.
"Khangluite' thu kantel inla, pute pate' tuahsa thute ngaihsun pha in.

Amaute in nang hong hilhin, a thu hong genin, amau' phawksa thute hong gen ding hi lo ahi hiam?
"Ciknawng om lohna-ah laiphai kung po thei ahi hiam? Tui om lohna-ah pumpeeng pung thei ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin tuate a pak kimlai a phuk hun nai lopi-in kungno dang khempeuh sangin keu masa zaw hi.
Pasian a mangngilhte tua bangmah ahi hi. Pasian a don lo mite' lametna a bei ta ahi hi.
Ama kimuanna maimom khau bang hi lel a, ama ki-upna maimom bu bang hi lel hi.
A inn tungah kingam a, a inn hoi hi. A inn lencip a, ahi zongin kip zo lo hi.
"Amah pen nitaang sungah hoihtakin a khang kungno, a huan sungah a dawn hilhhelh kungno ahi hi.

"Kuamah in Pasian a zawhzawh lohna a teltakin ka theita hi.
Mi khatpeuh Pasian tawh thu a kinial ding hileh tulkhat sungah khatvei nangawn dawng thei lo ding hi.
Amah pil mahmah a, vanglian mahmah hi. Kua in khauhtakin nial a, nial paisuakzo ahi hiam?
Pasian in mualte lingsak a, tawlngasak lo hi. Ama hehna tawh mualte a lumlet hi.
Amah in leitung lokgawp a, a khuampite kiling hi.
Amah in ni a suak lo dingin thu pia a, aksite sincip hi.

Amah in kuama theih zawh loh na lian tampi bawl a, kuama simzawh loh nalamdang tampi sem hi.
"Ka kiangah amah hong pai a, ke'n amah ka mu thei kei hi. Amah gam tangtang napi-in, amah ka theithei kei hi.

Kei ka dik hangin amah ka dawng thei kei hi. Kei hong mawhsak pa tungah hong hehpih ding ka nget kul hi.
