Ahi zongin note zah mahin kei zong thu ka thei a, midangte sangin na theihzawk uh bang om tuan ahi hiam?
Ka lawmte nangawn in tu-in kei hong nuihsan uh a, kei dikin paubaang lo napi hong nuihsan uh hi. Ahi zongin Pasian in ka thungetna a hong piak hun om hi.
Note in lungkhamna bangmah na nei kei uh a, kei na hong ciamnuih bawl gawpgawp uh hi. A puk dektak mipa na satgawp uh hi.
Guta mite nuamtakin om hithiat uh a, Pasian a simmawhte nuamtakin nungta uh hi.
"Ahi zongin gamsate va dong un, hong hilh ding uh hi. Vasate va dong un, hong hilh ding uh hi.
Leitung ganhingte va dong un, hong hilh ding uh hi. Tui sung ngasate zong va dong un, hong hilh ding uh hi.
Pasian' khut in amaute a bawlna thu a vekpi-un thei kim uh hi lo ahi hiam?
A piansaksate' nuntakna Pasian mah in a uk ahi hi. Mihing khempeuhte' nuntakna ama khut sungah om hi.
Leii in an a ciap mah bangin, bil in ngai thei hi lo ahi hiam?
"Khanghamte in pilna nei a, nuntak saute in thu theitel uh hi.
Pasian in pilna le vang nei a, amah thukipin thu a theitel hi.
Pasian in phelkek leh kuamah in lamkik zo lo a, Pasian in thongah mi koih leh kuamah in suaktasak zo lo hi.
Pasian in guah khaktan leh leitung keugaw a, tui a khah ciangin tui hong khang hi.
"Pasian thahatin gualzo tawntung a, mi khemte le khemna a thuakte Pasian' ukna nuai-ah a om uh ahi hi.

Amah in kumpite zakiasak a, thongah a khia hi.
Siampite mihai suaksak a, mi vangliante lawnthal hi.
Amah in mi' muante a pau thei loin bawl a, khanghamte' pilna a paihkhiatsak hi.
Amah in mi vangliante mindaisak a, mi thupite' kihihsakna a beisak hi.
Amah in khuamial sung panin thuthukte kalkhia a, a kithei zo lo thute kitelsak hi.
Amah in minamte thahatsakin liansak a, ahi zongin amah in tuate zogawpin susia hi.
Amah in minam makaite a pilna uh paihkhiatsak a, lampi om lohna gamlakah vakvaisak hi.

"Na gen uh thu khempeuh ka muhsa vive hi a, ka bil-in ka zakzaksa, ka theihtheihsa thu ahi hi.

Ahi zongin note tawh kam a kinial hi loin, Pasian tawh a kinial ka hi hi. Pasian tawh hih ka thu ka kinial nuam hi.
Note in na haina uh zuauthu tawh na melh uh a, kuamah a damsak zo lo zato siam-a kinei mite tawh na kibang uh hi.
Pau hetloin om hi le-uhcin, mipil mah hong kisazaw ding hi.
"Tu-in ka thugen hong ngai unla, ka gen laitakin limtak ngai un.
Pasian' min dingin thuman lo genin, ama a dingin zuauthu gensak ding na hi uh hiam?
Pasian angvan ding a, ama a' ding gensak ding na hi uh hiam?
Pasian in limtakin note hong entel leh note' sungah hoihna mu ding ahi hiam? Mihingte na khem bangun Pasian a khem thei dingin kingaihsun na hi uh hiam?
A simthamin angvanna na zat uhleh amah in note hong taii taktak ding hi.
Ama vangliatna in note hong lausak ding a, note tungah amah kihtakna hong tung ding hi lo ahi hiam?
Na thugente uh vutkhu bang hi lel a, na siksante uh leivui bang hi lel hi.
Pau kei unla, kei, thu hong gensak dih un; a piang peuhpeuh a piang hi mai hen.
"Ka nuntakna pia ngamin, ka nuntakna ka ap ngam hi.
Pasian in kei hong that mah taleh zong, phamawh ka sa kei hi. Ahi zongin ama mai-ah ka thu ka gen veve ding hi.
Pasian' mai-ah migilote pai ngam lo uh ahih manin, ka hanna pen ka gualzawhna hi ding hi.
Ka thugente limtak ngai unla, ka lahtelnate na za un.
Ka thu a gen dingin a baihsa-in ka om a, thu ka zawh ding lamtak teltakin ka thei hi.
"Pasian aw, keimah hong mawhsak ding na hi hiam? Nong mawhsak leh pau hetloin a si dingin ka kiging hi.

Van khumzangah Pasian a paikawmin meii pailetin Pasian in hong musuk thei lo ding hi, ci-in na ngaihsun hi.
"Migilote' gamtat ngeite mah gamtat ding ngaihsun na hi hiam?
Hih mite pen Pasian a nial, Pasian in bangmah a cih thei lo dingin a ki-um mite ahi uh hi.
Tua hitaseleh amaute a daupaisak Pasian hi a, migilote' ngaihsutna pen keima ngaihsutna tawh kigamla mahmah hi.
Migilote tungah gim kipia a muh uh ciangin mihoihte nuam a, paubaanna a nei lo mite in a nuihsan uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh migilote' neih khempeuh kisuksiatsak gawp a, a omlai sunte nangawn mei in a kangtum hi.
"Job aw, tu-in Pasian tawh kilem inla, amah galbawl nawn kei in. Tua hileh amah in nang thupha hong pia ding hi.
Ama hong hilhnate zui inla, ama thute ciamteh in.
Lungsim tak tawh Vanglianpa lamah kihei inla, na innsung pan gamtatsia beisak inla,
na kham neihte leivui bang lelin ngaihsunin, na Ofir khamte suang bang lelin ngaihsunin,
Vanglian Pasian pen na kham le na ngun hisak lecin,
Pasian muanin na nei tawntung ding a, na lungdamna bulpi amah ahihlam na thei ding hi.
Thu na nget ciangin na ngetna hong pia ding a, nangma thuciamnate na tungsak ding hi.
Na hih khempeuh na tangtun ding a, na maa hong vang ding hi.
Pasian in mi kiphasakte niamkhiat a, mi niamte a hon hi.
Nang a mawhbaang lo, a gamtat man na hih nakleh nang hong hon ding hi," a ci hi.
"Tu laitakin Pasian' tungah a phun lo, a heh loin ka om thei kei a, thum loin ka om thei kei hi.
Amah ka zon dan ding thei-in, ama kiang ka tunna ding zia a thei hi leng,
a mai-ah ka thu ka gen ding a, kei ka dikna thu a kicingin ka gen ding hi.
Ama hong gen ding thute le kei a hong dawnna ding thute ka thei nuam hi.
Pasian in a thaneih khempeuh tawh keima langkhatah hong pang ding ahi hiam? Hong langpan lo ding a, ka thugen hong ngai ding hi.
Kei a thuman ka hi a, Pasian kiangah ka gen ding hi. Kuama phelzawh nawn loh dingin kei' dikna a genkhia ding hi.
"Ahi zongin Nisuahna lam ka zong a, Pasian ka mu kei hi. Nitumna lam ka zong a, amah ka mu thei tuan kei hi.
Leilu lam ka zon hangin amah ka mu thei kei a, Leitaw lam ka zon hangin zong amah ka mu thei tuan kei hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in ka kalsuanna khempeuh thei a, kei hong ze-et leh ka sianthona a mu ding hi.
Ama hong lamlahna citakin ka zui cinten a, lam ka pial ngei kei hi.
Pasian' thupiakna bangin ka gamta ngitnget a, keima utna zui loin ama deihna ka zui hi.
"Amah kikheel ngei lo a, kuamah in amah nial zo lo hi. Ama hih nopte kuamah in khaktan zo lo hi.
Tua ahih manin kei a dingin a geelsate tungsak ding hi. Amah in hih bangin geelna tampi tak a nei ahi hi.
Vanglian Pasian in ka lungsim hanna hong mangsak hi.
"Pasian in bang hangin a thukhen ni ding seh lo a, ama nasemte thutang ahihna a lah ni ding seh lo ahi hiam?
"Mihingte in leitang zaipi a ngah theih nadingun gisuangte khinsim uh a, tuute gu-in amau' tuuhonte tawh khawi khawm uh hi.
Mi tagahte' la neihsunte guksak uh a, meigong numei in a leiba a loh khit dong a bawngtal a matsak uh hi.
Mizawngte' ngah theih dingte khaktan uh a, mizawngte notkhia ahih manun amaute lau-in a bucip uh hi.
"Tua ahih manin gamlak a om la bangin gam keu sungah a an ding uh zongtawm uh a, a tate uh an ding koimahah mu zo lo uh hi.
Midangte' lo sungah anlak na sem uh a, migilote' leenggui lo-ah leenggah loin a om uh hi.
Zanin puan silhloin lum uh a, khuadampi lakah silh ding nei loin om uh hi.
"Migilote in pa nei nawn lo naupangte sila-in nei uh a, mizawngte' tate leiba tangin a la uh hi.
Tua mizawngte in puan silhloin na sem uh a, gilkialpi mahin anlak na a sem uh hi.
A thau ngah nadingin oliv gahte gawi-in leenggahzu ngah nadingin leenggahte cil napi-in, gilkial dangtakin ki-omsak hi.
Khuapi sungah a liam le a si kuante' kikona kiza napi-in Pasian in amau' thungetnate don lo hi.
A zawng a cimawhte a thatlum dingin khuavak ma-in mi that pa kuankhia a, zan khuamial hun sungin mite' na a guksak hi.
Numei tunga a mawh mipa in khuamial ding ngakin om a, mite' theih loh dingin ama mel a seel hi.
Gutate in sun sungin a ciamtehsa teng zanin a inn luh uh a, sun sung bu-in khuavak a peel uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh zan khuamial pen amaute khempeuh a dingin zing khuavak bang hi a, zan khuamial lauhuai sung nuam a sa uh hi.
"Tua bang migilo peuhpeuh tuikhang in taai a, ama neih leitangte Pasian in samsia a, tua leenggui lote-ah nasemin kikuan nawn lo hi.
Nisat hun le khuakhal hunin vukkhalte a manthan bangin mihingte' gam sung panin mawhnei mi a mangthang hi.
Amah kiphawkkha nawn lo a, ama nu nangawn in zong a mangngilh ta hi. Thante in amah netum a, amah maimang ta hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh tua bang mite, numei taciingte' neihsa tawh a kivak uh hi a, meigongte' phattuamna ding bangmah bawl lo uh hi.
Pasian in a thahatna tawh mi vangliante susia a, amah a gamtat ciangin migilo pa a si pah hi.
Pasian in a lungnuamin amah nungtasak a, ahi zongin Pasian in amah encik tawntung hi.
Migilo pa tomkha sung a liat hangin kiak bangin vulkik pah a, a kisattan ankung bangin a keu pah hi.
Hih thu kua in nialzo ding na hi uh hiam? Ka thugennate man lo hi, ci-in kei langah hong pangin ka thugente hong selzo ding kua om na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
"Pasian vanglian a, mi khempeuh in a zahtak ding ahi hi. Ama vantung kumpi gam, nuamtakin a omsakzo hi.
Ama na a sem vantung mite bangzah pha cih kua in simzo ding ahi hiam? Pasian' khuavak in a bat lohna koi lai mun om ahi hiam?
Pasian' muhna-ah kua dikzo ding a, siangthozo ding ahi hiam?
Ama mitah khapi nangawn taang sa zo lo lai a, aksite nangawn siang sa zo lo lai hi.
Tua ahihleh, lungno, ganhing no ahi lel mihing pen bangci ding ahi hiam? Mihing in Pasian' muhna-ah bang man lel ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
"A hehpihhuai kei nong huhna, a thazawngkhal kei nong hotna, hih bang ahi hiam?
Kei bang mihai tungah thu manpha nong gen a, pilna thu tampi nong pulak hi.
Tua bang thu a gen dingin kua in hong sawl a, kua' lungsim hong pulakkhia na hi hiam?
"Misite' gam kiling a, a sunga a teng mite launa tawh a ling hi.
Pasian' muhna-ah misite' gam kilang sinsen a, a muh theih loh nadingin a liah bangmah om lo hi.
Pasian in mun awng tungah vanpi hong zalkhia a, bangmah in a len lopi-in leitung a khai lingleng hi.
Amah in meiilom lakah tuite khol a, tua a gik mahmah tui meii a puazosak hi.
Amah in muh tawpna-ah git dinden a, khuavak le khuamial a khen hi.
Amah in vanpi a pua khuampite a taii ciangin tua khuampite lau-in a ling uh hi.
Ama thahatna tawh tuipi zo a, ama siamna tawh tui ganhing golpi Rahab thatlum hi.
A hu a san ciangin vantung teng siang pah a, ama khut in a taikhia gulpi thatlum hi.
Hihte pen ama vangliatna themkhat bek hi pan a, i zak thute pen a hemlam bek hi pan hi. Pasian a liatna taktak kua'n theizo ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Job in thu genkik a,
"Keima dikna a hong seelcipsak Pasian, ka lungsim a hong gimsak Vanglian Pasian a nungta ahih mah bangin,
ka sungah nuntakna a omlaiteng, Pasian' hu, ka nakah ka diik laiteng,
ka muk tawh thusia peuhmah ka gen het kei ding a, ka kam tawh zuauthu peuhmah ka gen het kei ding hi, ci-in ka kiciam hi.
Note a thuman hi, kong ci ngei kei ding a, ka nuntak laiteng, kei a thuman hi'ng, ka cihna thu ka khia ngei kei ding hi.
Kei thuman ka kisakna ka khia ngei kei ding hi. Ka lungsimah kisuanna om loin siang mahmah hi.
"Kei a hong langpan', kei a hong dote in migilo le thuman lote bangin gimna thuak ta uh hen.
Pasian in amaute' nuntakna a laksak hun ciangin, migilote a dingin lametna om nawn ahi hiam?
Lungkhamna a thuak uh ciangin Pasian in amau' kikona awging ngai ding ahi hiam?
Pasian' piak ding lungdamna a deih ding uh kilawm ahih manin, ama tungah thu a nget tawntung ding uh a kilawm ahi hi.
"Pasian' vangliatna bangzahin lian mahmah cih hong gensak unla, Vanglian Pasian' geelsa teng hong laktelsak dih un.
Ahi zongin tuate khempeuh na theih khitsa uh ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin mawk pau na hi uh hiam?
"Vanglian Pasian in migilote, mi ngongtatte, gim a piakzia hih bang ahi hi.
Tapa tampi a neih hangun, a vekpi-in gal sungah si mangkhin ding uh hi. A tate uh a tawntungin gilkial niloh ding uh hi.
A nungta laisunte zong pulnatna tawh si ding uh a, meigong numeite in misite kahzo nawn lo ding uh hi.
Migilote in kuama simzawh loh ngun tampi tak nei ding uh a, genzawh lohin nikten' puansilh ciang venvan ding uh hi.
Migilote' lam innte kho lo a, maimom bu, ahih kei leh lo honna buk tawh kibang lel hi.
Amaute a hausa-in lum uh a, ahih hangin a khanlawh uh ciangin a hauhna teng uh na maimang ta hi.
Lauhuaina in tuikhang pak bangin nawkgawp ding a, zan ciangin huihpi in amaute mutkhiamang ding hi.
Nisuahna huihpi in amaute leenkhia-in a inn panun gamlapi-ah leenkhia ding hi.
Amaute a suahtak theih nading a hanciam tantan kimlai mah, hehpih ngaihsut hetloin leenkhiamang ding hi.
Amaute a tai laitakun huih in nawk gawpin, a susiagawp dingin mutkhiagawp ding hi.
"Ngun a kitawh khiatna a khuk om a, kham a kisiansakna a mun mah om hi.
Mihingte in lei sung panin sik tokhia a, suang sung panin sumsan a huantui uh hi.
Mihingte in khuamial thukpen sung zongin, lei sung a thukpi dong hahkatin zong uh a, khuamial thuktawng sung pan suang a tokhia uh hi.
Mihingte' tenna panin a gamlapi mun, kuamah a pai ngei lohna sungah lei sung sumte a tokhia uh hi. Tua lai munah amau guak in na semsem uh a, lei thuk sungah khauhual tawh kiveisuk kiveito uh hi.
I annek dingte leitungah hong pokhia a, ahi zongin leinuai thuk sung mei bangin a sa mahmah hi.
Lei sunga om suangte sungah sapfaia suangmanpha om a, a leivuite sungah kham a om hi.
Simbung in zong tua lampi thei ngei lo a, luimu zong tua lai-ah va leng ngei lo hi.
Humpinelkai ahi a, ganhing dangte ahi zongin cikmah hunin tua lai-ah va pai ngei lo uh hi.
"Mihingte in suang a sakpente to uh a, mualte' bul lei sung panin a tokhia uh hi.
Suangte a tawhvang uh ciangin suangmanphate a mu uh hi.
Ahi zongin koi lai-ah pilna kimu ding ahi hiam? Koi lai-ah thutheihna nak om ahi hiam?
"Mihingte in a kimuhna ding a lampi thei lo uh a, mihingte' gam sungah zong a lampi om lo hi.
A thuk mahmah tuipi liante in, 'Ko' sungah om lo hi,' ci uh a, tuipite in, 'Ko kiangah om lo hi,' a ci uh hi.
Pilna pen kham tawh a kileizo hi lo a, a man ding zah zong ngun tawh sehtheih hi lo hi.
Ofir kham tawh pilna a kileizo hi lo a, suangmanpha pen tawh zong a kileizo hi tuan lo hi.
Pilna a manphatna kham le limlang tawh tehtheih hi lo a, kham hoihpen a kibawl nate tawh zong leizawh hi lo hi.
Pilna a manphatna suangkhi le limlang tawh genteh theih hi lo a, pilna themkhat bek nangawn kep sangin manphazaw lai hi.
Ethiopia gamah a piang topaz suangmanphate tawh tehtheih ding hi lo a, kham citak hoihpen tawh zong kiteh thei tuan lo hi.
"Tua ahihleh koi lai panin pilna hong piang ahi hiam? Thutheihna koi lai-ah om ahi hiam?
Nuntakna a nei sung pan a mu thei kuamah om lo a, a leengthei vasate nangawn in mu thei lo uh hi.
Sihna le siatna nangawn in a thu hemzak bek ung, ci lai uh hi.
"Pasian bek in pilna lampi thei a, amah bek in a omna mun a thei hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in leimong dong mu a, vantung nuai-ah a om na khempeuh a mu thei hi.
Pasian in huih a gik ding zah bawlin, tuipi a liatna ding zah a seh laitak,
guah zukna ding mun thu pia-in, khuaphialep in a zuih ding lampi bawlin a vaihawm laitak nangawnin,
amah in pilna mu-in a manphate entel a, amah in hoihsa ahih manin a kipsak hi.
"Tua ciangin amah in mihingte tungah thu genin, 'Topa zahtakna, pilna hi a, siatna pelhna pen thutheihna hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Job in a thu genkik a,
"Ka nuntakna nidanga bang hi kik hen la, Pasian in kei hong et hun lai bang hong hi kik leh ka ut hi.
Tua hun lai-in Pasian in kei hong ompih tawntung a, khuamial sungah ka pai laitakin khuavak hong pia hi.
Tua hun pen ka cihtheih hun laitak hi a, Pasian in ka innkuan a hong hut laitak hun ahi hi.
Tua hun lai-in Vanglian Pasian in kei hong ompih a, ka kimkotah ka tate a om uh hi.
Ka bawngte le ka keelte in nawi deih zahzah hong pia uh a, suang tam penna nangawnah ka oliv kungte hoih mahmah hi.
Khuasung upate a kikhop uh ciangin a kikhawm dingin kei ka pai ciangin
kei hong muh phetun khangnote in tutna hong awn uh a, kei hong zahtakna limun papite na ding uh hi.
Khuasung uliante a kiho na khawl pah uh a, a khut uh tawh a kam uh na hum uh hi.
Mi a thupi pente nangawn na gamdai pah uh a, kuamah pau loin na om uh hi.
"Ka thugen a za mi peuhmah in a hoihlamin na za uh a, a hong mu mi peuhmah in dik hong sa uh hi.
Mizawng ka theih peuhmah ka huh tawntung a, cih nading thei lo tagahte zong ka huh hi.
A lungkham a cimawhte in kei hong phat uh a, meigong numeite a lungnuamin ka omsak hi.
Thuman, puan bangin ka silh a, thuman in kei hong tuam hi. Thutang, puanpi-in ka silh a, thutang in kei hong tuam hi.
Mittaw mite a dingin mittang ka hi a, khebai mite a dingin khe ka hi hi.
Mizawngte a dingin a pa uh ka hi a, lungkhamna a thuak, ka theih loh mite nangawn ka panpih tawntung hi.
Migilote' gitlohna khempeuh ka susia gawpmang a, amau' sukgawp mi khempeuh ka honkhia hi.
"Ka nuntak kum sehnel zahin a tam dingin ka ngaihsun a, lungnuam takin inn-ah a si dingin ka kilamen hi.
A zung in tui a ngah tawntung singkung tawh ka kibang a, daitui in a hiangte a nomsak singkung tawh ka kibang hi.
Mite in ka thugen ngai-in hong ngak dimdem uh a, kuamah pau hetloin limtakin hong ngai uh hi.
Thu ka gen khit ciangin a genthuah ding uh bangmah thei nawn lo uh a, ka thugente khempeuh hoihtakin na sang pah uh hi.
Lo khote in khuapi guah deih mahmahin a ngak bangin, ka thugente khempeuh hoihtakin na sang uh hi.
Itna tawh ka nuihsat ciangin amaute lungnuam mahmah uh a, ka mai a tai ciangin a maigumna uh a bei hi.
Amaute ukin a vai ding uh ka hawmsak a, kumpipa in a galkapte a makaih bangin ka makai a, a lungkham uh ciangin amaute ka hehnem hi.
"Ahi zongin tu-in, a pate uh kimanna a nei lo ka uite tawh tuu cing dingin a kuan dingin zong ka deih loh, kei sanga a khangnozawte in hong ciamnuih bawlta uh hi.
Amau' hatna khempeuh tu-in bei khinta ahih manin, amau' hatna kei a dingin a kimanna om nawn lo hi.
Amaute in singkungnote botin ne uh a, limna alna a nei lo poding zung nangawn a ne uh hi.
Gutate otkhai-in a kidelh khiat bangin mite lak panin amaute kihawlkhia hi.
Amaute pen hawkguam sung, leihawm sung, luihawm, le keenhawm sungah a ten uh a kul ahi hi.
Ganhing bangin gamlakah amaute ham uh a, sawlkawm nuai-ah kilomin a omkhawm uh hi.
Bangmahin a kimang lo hih bang misia honte, mite omna gam sung panin a kihawlkhia hi.
Tu-in amaute in kei hong simmawh bawlin hong nuihsan uh a, amaute' ciamnuihna bek ka suak khinta hi.
Amaute in kei hong kih uh a, kei tawh tehna-in amaute hoihlua kisa uh a, amaute in ka maitang nangawn cil hong phih vial uh hi.
Pasian in hong zawngkhalsak, hong cimawhsak ahih manin amaute in a ut utun kei hong bawlsia uh hi.
Amaute in hong simgawpin, kei hong taikhiasak uh a, ka sih theih nadingin ka mai-ah na pang uh hi.
Ka suahtak theih nading lampi na khaktan uh a, kei suksiat ding hanciam uh a, amaute a kho ding kuamah om lo hi.
Kei ka bukna leihawmah amaute hong tuaksuk uh a, kei hong sucipsuk uh hi.
Launa tawh ka kidim a, ka cihtheihna khempeuh meii bangin a thengta hi.
"Tu-in a si ding ka hita a, ka gimna panin noptuam ngahna ding bangmah om nawn lo hi.
Zan thapai-in ka guh sung, ka tang sung khempeuh na a, a hong pet tawntung natna dai ngei peuhmah lo hi.
Pasian in ka puan ngawng pan kei hong manin ka puan tawh hong heekcip hi.
Buannawng ciim sungah kei hong lawnkhia a, ninbulom bang lel ka hita hi.
"Pasian aw, nang kong sam a, na hong dawng ngei kei hi. Nang tungah thu kong ngen a, nong don het kei hi.
Kei tungah nong gilo mahmah a, nong hih theih zahin kei na hong bawlsia hi.
Huih lakah na hong lawn a, huih na hong leensak a, huihpi in hong lawnsuk hong lawnto hi.
Mi khempeuh a dingin sehkholhin a kikoihsa sihna-ah a hong paipih na hihna ka thei hi.
Na hehpih ding a hong thum ding cih lohbuang, bangmah dang a hih thei nawn lo misia pa, bang hangin sugawp na hi hiam?
A lungkham mite tawh kei kap khawmin, a cimawh mite dahpih hi lo ka hi hiam?
Lungdamna le khuavakna ka lamet laitakin, lungkhamna le khuamialna hong tung zawsop hi.
Lunggimna le natna in kei hong sugawp a, gimna ka thuak ding cih loh bangmah dang om nawn lo hi.
Lungkham sinkhamin ka om a, mihon lakah dingin huhna ka ngen hi.
Kei pen gamkhing sunga a om ngia le vasa-kalaohte tawh kipawlin a kikhawl ka hita hi.
Ka vun vomin dulhkhia a, ka pumtangin ka ci sa gawp hi.
Nidangin lungdamna la a kisa ka zakna munah tu-in thumna le kahna aw bek ka za ta hi.
"Lunggulhna tawh nungak khatpeuh ka et ngei loh nading, kiciamna ka bawlkhin hi.
Vanglian Pasian in eite bang hong cih a, mihingte' gamtatna bangci thuhkik ahi hiam?
A man loin a gamtate tungah siatna le gimna a tungsak hi.
Pasian in ka gamtatna khempeuh thei a, ka kalsuanna khempeuh a hong mu hi.
"Ka gitloh gamtat ngei lohna, kuamah ka khem ngei hetlohna, ka gamtat hoihna thute-ah ka kiciam ngam hi.
Pasian in tawikhaina manah hong tawikhai hen; ka paubaan hetlohna hong mu ding hi.
Lampi man panin ka pial a, siatna lam ka zuih a, ka khut tungah mawhna a baan taak leh
ka khawhsa ante midangte' nek suak hen la, ka an neih khempeuh maimang tahen.
"Ka vengte' zi zawlmitin, a kong gei-ah ngakin ka buk taak leh
ka it ka zi in midangte' an suksak hen la, midangte' ang-ah lum tahen.
(Tua bang mawhna pen a siahuai hi a, sihna a thuak ding ahi hi.
Ka neih khempeuh a kangtum thei mei husia tawh a kibang ahi hi.)
"Ka nasemte khat peuhpeuh kei tungah hong phun ciangin, ama thu ngai-in limtakin ka bawl hi.
Tuaci kei leng, Pasian' mai mu ngam ding ka hi hiam? Keima thu a khen dingin Pasian hong pai ciangin bang gen mawk ding ka hi hiam?
Kei a hong piangsak Pasian mah in keima nasemte zong a piangsak ahi hi.
"Mizawngte ka huh ding ka mangngilh ngei kei a, meigong numeite ka guaksuaksak ngei kei hi.
Keimah in an ne napi-in, tagahte a gilkialin ka koihkhong ngei kei hi.
Ka khang tawntungin tua bangte ka en tawntung hi.
"Mi a cimawh, puan silh ding a lei zo lo, a zawng lua ka muh ciangin,
ka tuuhon panin ka ngah tuumul puan kibawl ka pia hi. Amah in zong a lungsim neih khempeuh tawh kei a hong phat hi.
"Zum thukhenna-ah zo-na ning cih ngaihsutna tawh tagah khatpeuh ka khem taak leh,
ka khutte buisum hen la, ka liang bul panin kilongkhia tahen.
Pasian' gimpiak ding kihta ka hih manin, tua bang peuhmah ka gamta ngei kei ding hi.
"Leitung hauhna muan le suanin ka nei ngei kei a,
A taang mahmah ni ahi a, a hoih mahmah kha ahi zongin, cikmahin ka bia ngei kei hi.
Tuate pahtawina le zahtakna limin ka khut lapna tawh cikmah hunin ka khial ngei het kei hi.
Tua bang mawhna in sihna a thuak ding hi a, tua bang mawhna pen Vanglian Pasian nialna ahi hi.
"Ka galte'n gim a thuak teh ka kipak ngei kei a, haksatna a tuah uh teh ka lungdam ngei kei hi.
A sih ding uh deihna tawh ka samsia ngei kei hi.
Zin le leengte limtakin ka do tawntungna thu ka na a hong sepsak mi khempeuh in a thei uh hi.
Khualzin mi khempeuh ka inn-ah ka tungsak tawntung a, kongzing lakah amaute ka lumsak ngei kei hi.
Midangte in a mawhnate uh pulak loin imcip uh a, ahih hangin keima mawhna cikmahin ka im ngei kei hi.
Midangte' hong kam pau ding kihtakin ka nei ngei kei hi. Amau' hong simmawh ding ka kihtakna hangin pau loin ka om ngei kei a, ka bucip ngei kei hi.
"Ka thugente kuamah in na ngai lo ding ahi hiam? Ka gen thu khempeuh man hi, ci-in ka kiciam hi. Vanglian Pasian in kei hong dawng tahen. "Ka langte in kei hong mawhsakna thute ka tawi theih dingin lai sungah a kigelh hileh
tua mawhsaknate kisialhna tawh ka ngawngah ka ok ding a, mi khempeuh in a muh dingin ka sangsak ding hi.
Ka gamtatna khempeuh Pasian kiangah ka gen ding a, ama muhna-ah lungdamin kihihsakna tawh ka om ding hi.
"Ka khawh leitang ka guk ahih a, a nei taktak pa' tung pan ka suh ahih a,
tua leitang a piang ante ka nek a, tua lo a khote a puksi-in ka omsak taak leh,
tua lo sungah mangbuh le mangbuh ham tangin kiak le ling po ta hen," a ci hi. Job' thugente beita hi.
Job amahmah dik kisa tawntung ahih manin hih mihing thumte in Job' thugente dawn ding ngaihsun nawn lo uh hi.
Ahi zongin a thu a za, Ram minam, Buz-te beh, Barakhel' tapa Elihu a heh hong suak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Job amah kidiksakin Pasian mawhsak zawsop hi.
Job' lawm thumte tungah zong a heh suak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Job a dawnna ding uh thei lo uh ahih manin Pasian a khial tawh hong kibang hi.
Elihu ahihleh amaute lak panin a khangno pen ahih manin adangte a pau kim khit mateng bangmah pau loin a om hi.
Ahi zongin hih mihing thumte in Job a dawn theih loh a muh ciangin a hehna thuakzo nawn lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Buz-te beh Barakhel' tapa Elihu in thu gen ding hong kipan a, "Kei a khangno lai hi-in, note a khangham na hih manun, ka ngaihsutna note lakah kong gen ngam kei hi.
No a khangham zawte in thu a gen ding kilawm hi, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.
Ahi zongin mihingte tungah a hong tung pilna pen Vanglian Pasian' kha in a hong piak ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in keima thugen dingte nong ngaih ding uh ka deih hi. Keima ngaihsutna hong gensak dih un.
"Thu na gengen laitakun lungduai takin kong ngaingai a, na thugen dingte uh na zonzon laitakun ka hong ngak hithiat hi.
Limtakin kong ngai a, na cihmawhna uh ka thei hi. Job' thugente a man lohna na gentel thei kei uh hi.
Bang hangin pilna a nei-in kigen thei ding na hi uh hiam? Note in lel na hih manun Pasian in Job dawng ding hi.
Job in note tungah thu tampi hong gen a, kei tungah hong gen lo hi. Ahi zongin note' dawn bangin ka dawng ngei kei ding hi.
"Job aw, hih mite in nang hong lel uh a, nang hong dawnna ding bangmah thei lo uh hi.
Amaute pau loin a om ciangun kei zong pau loin ngak lailai ding ka hi hiam? Amaute in a gen ding uh thei nawn loin ommawk uh hi.
Tu petpetin kei zong nang kong dawng ding a, keima ngaihsutnate ka hong pulak ding hi.
Thu a gen dingin kha in kei hong sawl a, tu taktak ciangin ka kam ka ki-ipzo nawn het kei hi.
Thugen theih nading hun a nei lo hi leng, leenggahzu thak a kithun leenggahzu um bangin ka puakkham ding hi.
Ka thuakzo nawnkei a, ka genkhia ta ding hi.
Hih ka thugenna-ah kuamah ka pawlpih kei ding a, kuamah phattuam ka nei kei ding hi.
Kuamah ka mawkphat thei kei hi. Tuaci mawkphat leng Pasian in kei hong sumang pak ding hi.
"Job aw, tu-in ka thugen khempeuh limtakin hong ngai in.
Ka lungsim sunga om thute a hong gen ding ka hi hi.
Ka gen khempeuh lungsim takpi tawh ka gen hi a, a man thu a gen ka hi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian' kha in kei hong sawl a, Vanglianpa in kei tungah nuntakna hu hong pia hi.
"Na hong dawn theih leh limtakin hong dawng in. Na hong seelna ding limtakin kiging in.
Job aw, nang le kei, Pasian' hong muhna-ah a kibang ihi a, i nih tuakin leivui pana piang ihi hi.
Tua ahih manin kei nong kihtakna ding bangmah thu om lo a, nang ka hong zawhthawh bawlgawpna ding zong bangmah thu om tuan lo hi.
"Keima zakin thu na gen khin a, na thugente ka za khin hi.
Nang in, 'Kei ka mawh kei a, ka gamta khial kei hi. Ka paubaang kei a, mawhna ka sukha kei hi.
Pasian in kei hong sukna ding thu zongzong a, gal bangin kei hong bawl hi.
Amah in ka khe kolbulh a, ka gamtatna khempeuh hong encik hi,' na cihna ka za hi.
"Ahih hangin, Job aw, nangmah na khialzaw hi. Pasian pen mihing sangin lianzaw hi.
Pasian in mihingte' phunna thudon ngei lo hi, ci-in thugenna tawh bang hangin Pasian mawhsak na hi hiam?
Pasian in a lam tuamtuamin thu hong gengen napi-in, ama thugente khempeuh kuamah in thudon lo hi.
Zanin mite a ihmut ciangin, mang le maangmuhna sungah Pasian in thu a gen hi.
Pasian in thu hong gen a, ama hilhkholhna hangin mite lau mahmah uh hi.
Mite in khialhna a bawl nawn lohna ding, mi kiphasakte a suahkhak loh nading, Pasian in a deihna hangin mite kiangah thu a gen hi.
Pasian in mihingte siatna thuaksak lo a, sih nading panin amaute a honkhia hi.
Pasian in cinatsakna tawh mihingte thuhilh a, a pumpi khempeuh natna tawh a kidimsak hi.
Cina pa in an ne zo lo a, an limpen nangawn a kih tha a suak hi.
A ci a sa khempeuh kiam a, a guh guak bekin a om hi.
A beina ding a nai hita a, misi gam a zuan ding hita hi.
"Mihingte' tavuan a phawksak, Pasian' vantungmi tul tampite lak panin vantungmi khat amah a huh dingin hong paikhia ding hi.
Vantung mi in amah a hehpihna hangin, 'Amah suaktasak in. Misite gamah paisak kei in. Amah tatkhiatna ding hih lai-ah om hi,' a ci ding hi.
Tua ciangin ama pumpi khangnosuak kikin, a thahat pen hun laitak a bangkik ding hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian in ama thungetna pia ding a, amah in lungdamna tawh Pasian bia ding a, Pasian in ama a dingin thu a hoihlamin a heisakkik ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in mihonpite' zakna-ah, 'Kei ka khial khin hi. A manin ka gamta kei a, ahi zongin Pasian in kei hong suaktasak hi.
Misite' gam sung ka tunna ding panin amah in kei hong kem a, tu-in kei ka nungta lai hi,' a ci ding hi.
Pasian in hih thute khempeuh mihingte tungah hong hihkik zelzel a,
sih nading panin honkhia kik zelin nuntak nuam a pia kik hi.
"Job aw, ka thugente limtakin hong ngai in. Gamdai-in om inla, kei thu hong gensak in.
Ahi zongin gennop mahmah na neih leh hong gen in; bang hang hiam cih leh midik na hih ding ka hong deihsak hi.
Ahi zongin gennop velvel na neih khol kei leh keima thugen hong ngai in. Mipil na hih theih nading thu kong hilh ding hi," a ci hi.
"No a pilin a kinei mite aw, ka thugente ciamteh un. Thu thei a a kinei mite aw, ka thugente ngai un.
An na ciap uh ciangin a lim a lim lo na thei uh hi. Thu kigen na zak uh ciangin pil kampau le hai kampau na khenthei uh hi.
Thuman bang hiam cih tengkhia ni. Thuhoih bang hiam cih mukhia ni.
Job in, 'Kei ka dik hi. Pasian in kei a thumanin hong seh nuam lo hi.
Kei a thuman hinapi zuauthu genin hong seh hi. Kei a khial hi lo napi gim thuakin ka cimawh hi,' a ci hi.
"Hih Job tawh a kibang mi na mu ngei uh hiam? Amah in Pasian zahtakna lim bangmah nei het lo hi.
Amah in migilote tawh kikholh nuam sa mahmah a, mawhnei mite tawh a vak kawikawi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, 'Pasian' deihna i zuih hangin phattuamna bangmah om lo hi,' ci hi.
"Ahi zongin thu ngaihsun thei a kinei note khempeuh in ka thugenna hong ngai un. Pasian a giloin gamta ngei ding a, Vanglianpa in a man loin sem ngei ding ahi hiam?
Pasian in a gamtatna tawh kizui-in mite tungah thaman pia a, a thuak dingun a kilawm bangin gim a pia hi.
Pasian in ama vangliatna mi khatpeuh tung panin a ngah ahi hiam? Leitung khempeuh a uk dingin mi khatpeuh in amah a koih ahi hiam?
Pasian in ama ngaihsutna kheel hen la, nuntakna hu a dokkik hileh
nuntakna a nei khempeuh si pah ding uh a, mihing khempeuh leivui suakkik ding uh hi.
"Job aw, mipil-a kinei na hih leh ka thugente hong ngai in.
Vanglianpa in thutang a deih lo dingin ngaihsun na hi hiam? Nang in a thuman Pasian mawhsak na hi hiam?
Kumpite le uliante bangmahin kimang loin a gitloh uh ciangin, amaute a mawhsak ngam pa Pasian bek ahi hi.
Pasian pen mi khempeuh a hong piangsak pa hi a, amah in uliante panpih tuan nei lo a, mizawngte sangin mihaute thupi ngaihsutzaw tuan lo hi.
Mihingte ahihleh zan khat thu-in sipak thei hi. Pasian in mite satpukin sisak thei a, nakpitakin hih kul loin mi thahat pente zong a that thei hi.
Pasian in mihingte' gamtatna khempeuh hong encik a, i kalsuanna themno dongin hong mu khin hi.
Gamtatsia mite a buk theih nadingun a seelcipzo ding, khuamial khuazing koimahah om lo hi.
Pasian' mai-ah mihingte in thukhenna a thuak ni ding, a kiseh hun omtuam lo hi.
Amah in a thu kan kul loin mi vangliante sugawp a, amaute' tang dingin midangte a koih hi.
Amah in amaute' gamtatnate a vekpi-in thei ahih manin zan khat thu-in amaute lumletin a susiagawp hi.
Pasian in mi khempeuh' muhin mawhneite gim a pia hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in ama thu mang nawn lo uh a, a thupiakte khempeuh don nawn lo uh hi.
Amaute in mizawngte kapsak gawp uh a, mizawngte' huh ngetna awging Pasian in a za hi.
"Pasian in bangmah hih het kei taleh zong, kuamah in Pasian mawhsak thei lo ding hi. Amah in hong maingat hetkei taleh zong, kuamah in bangmah cihthei tuan lo ding hi.
Migilote hong uksak taleh zong, tua panin suahtakna ding kuamah in vaihawm zo lo ding hi.
"Job aw, Pasian' tungah na khialhnate pulakin na khialh nawn loh nading thu ciam nai lo na hi hiam?
Pasian in na khialhnate a hong lahna ding ngenin, na gamtatsiat nawn loh nading ut nai na hi hiam?
Pasian nial na hih manin amah in nangma utna a bang hangin hong hihsak ding ahi hiam? Hih thu pen kei' ngaihsut ding hi loin, nangma khensat ding ahi hi. Tu-in nangma ngaihsutna a kician takin hong gen in.
"Thu a ngaihsun theite in hih thu man hi, hong cihpih ding uh a, ka thugenna a za mipil peuhmahte in,
'Thu a thei lopi-in Job in thu gen a, a thugen peuhmah a khiatna nei om lo hi.
Job' thugente khempeuh ngaihsun le-uhcin, migilo bangin a kampauna na thei ding uh hi.
Amah a khialhna khawl nuam het lo a, eite khempeuh' mai-ah Pasian simmawhin zahpih bawlgawp hi,' hong ci ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Pasian kiangah, ka khialh hangin bang phamawh sa na hi hiam? Khialhna ka gamtat loh manin bangmah phattuamna ka ngah kei hi, na cih ding kilawm lo hi.
Nang le na lawmte tungah thu ka hong gen ding hi.
"Vantung ento dih un. Meiite bangzah takin sang omto ahi hiam?
Mawhna na gamtat manin, Pasian bangmah sukha lo hi. Tampi tak khial talecin zong amah sukha tuan ahi hiam?
"Mite in gim a thuak ciangin tau uh a, amaute a honkhia dingin midang khatpeuh a sam uh hi.
Lungzin' hun laitakin thahatna a pia, amaute a Piangsak Pasian' lam nga lo uh hi.
Eite mipilin a hong bawl, ganhingte le vasate sangin a pilzaw-in a hong bawl Pasian' lam nga lo uh hi.
Amaute migilo mi kihisakte ahih manun, huh ding a nget hangun Pasian in pia lo hi.
Ngetnget, gengen, a phattuamna bangmah om lo hi. Vanglian Pasian in na mu lo, na ngai lo hi.
"Job aw, nangmah in, 'Pasian ka mu thei kei a, ahi zongin ka thu ama khut sungah om a, lungduai takin ka ngak niloh hi,' na ci hi.
Pasian in kuamah gim pia lo a, khialhna zong thupi ngaihsut lo hi, ci-in na ngaihsun hi.
Tua banga kam na paupau a mawknapi hi a, na gen mel zong a thei het lo na hihna thu a hong kilangsak na hi hi," a ci hi.
Elihu in a thugen zomlai a,
"Lungduai takin tawmkhat hong ngailai in. Pasian' tangin ka gen ding thu pawlkhat omlai hi.
Kei a hong Piangsak Pasian thuman hi, ci-in kong lah nadingin thu tampi tak kaikhawmin ka hong gen ding hi.
Ka thugente khempeuh a khial om het lo a, na mai-ah thugenpa pen mipil khat ahi hi.
"Pasian a thahat mahmah hi napi-in, kuamah simmawh lo hi. Amah in a theih loh bangmah om lo hi.
Amah in mimawhte daupaisak lo a, a zawng gimna a thuakte tungah a manin a gamta hi.
Amah in thuman mite hu a, kumpi ukna za zong pia a, pahtawina lianpi a ngahsak tawntung hi.
Ahi zongin mite sikkol kibulh a, a gamtatnasate hangin gimna a thuak uhleh,
Pasian in amau' mawhna le a kiphatsaknate uh a lakkhia ahi hi.
A gamtatsiatna panun a khawl nadingun amau' bil sungah thu a gengen hi.
Amaute in Pasian' thu mangin ama na sem le-uh amaute nuamsa-in a khan uh a sau hi.
Ahi zongin ama thu mang kei le-uh, namsau tawh si ding uh a, misite' gam zuan ding uh hi.
"Migilote a hehin nitum uh a, gimna a thuak ciang nangawnun ama huh ding ngen lo uh hi.
Amaute khansih uh a, a zumhuaipi-in a bei uh hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in gimna tawh mite thuhilh a, khua a phawktheih nadingun gimna a zang ahi hi.
Pasian in lungkhamna panin nang hong paikhiatpihin, lungnuam takin nang hong omsak a, na sabuai tungah anlim nono kilui venvan hi.
Ahi zongin tu-in na ngah dinga kilawm gimna a thuakta na hi hi.
Sumgolh' khemsa-in gamta kei inla, leitung nate' bawlin lam kipialsak kei in.
Huh ding na nget hangin a phattuamna om nawn lo a, na hauhna na liatna in hong huh thei nawn lo hi.
Mihingte a beimang hun ding, zan khuamial hong tun hun ding lunggulh kei in.
Siatna lamah na kihei khak lohna ding limtakin kidawm in. Na siat khak loh nadingin gimna hong kithuaksak ahi hi.
"Pasian a vangliat mahmahna limtakin phawktel in. Pasian pen sia khempeuh lakah sia lianpen ahi hi.
Pasian' gamtatzia ding kuamah in sawl thei lo a, Pasian gamtatsia hi, ci-in kuamah in zong mawhsak zo lo hi.
Pasian a nasepna hangin mi khempeuh in a phat tawntung mah bangin nang zong amah phatzaw in.
Mi khempeuh in Pasian' sepsate mu uh a, theikim zo lo uh ahih manin lamdang a sa uh hi.
Pasian a liatna a kicingin i theizo kei a, ama kum phazah zong i simzo kei hi.
"Amah in tuipi panin tuite lato a, tua a lak tuite guahtui-in a bawl hi.
Amah in meii sung panin guah piangsak a, mihing khempeuh a dingin guah a zusak hi.
Meiite a pai henhanna hitaleh, vanah van a ginna hitaleh kuamah in thei zo lo hi.
Amah in vantungah khua phiasak a, ahi zongin tuipi thuk sung a mialsak hi.
Amah in tu-a bangin mihingte hong vak a, annek ding tampi tak a hong pia ahi hi.
Amah in keek thu pia a, a kap nop penpen a kha dingin a sawl hi.
"Hih huihpi in ka dip hong kuasak a, ka dip vana khai hong bangsak hi.
Ama kam panin a hong gingkhia hih vanging Pasian' pauna awging, limtakin ngai in.
Amah in vanah khua phiasak a, leimong khat pan mong khat dong a taan hi.
Tua ciangin a vanglian vanging, ama awging hong kiza a, tua hun sungteng mahin khua a phiaphia hi.
Pasian' sawlna tawh na lamdangpipi piang a, eite' theih zawh loh thute a hong piang hi.
Amah in leitungah vuk a kia dingin sawl a, guah tampi tak a zusak hi.
Amah in mihingte a nasep uh khawlsak a, amah a gamtang ahihna a kilangsak hi.
Pasian' husanna in tuite khalsak a, tui lianpite khalin sik bangin a sak hi.
Amah in meiipi nomsak a, meiipi in khua a phiasak hi.
Pasian' deihna zui-in a kikhin kawikawi hi. Leitung mun khempeuhah pai-in, Pasian' sawl teng a sem uh hi.
Pasian in mihingte gim a piakna ding ahi a, pahtakna a lahna ding ahi zongin, leitungah tu-a bangin a piangsak hi.
"Job aw, tawlkhat khawlin ngai inla, Pasian' bawlsa na lamdangte ngaihsun dih in.
Pasian in thu pia a, meii lak panin khua a phiatsak theihna na thei hiam?
Bangmah in a len lopi-in vantungah meii a omsak theihna, a lamdang hih ama siamna na thei hiam?
Leitaw lam huihpi nasia takin a nun' laitakin na puan sungah khua-ul kai-in na om hi.
Limlang bangin a sak mahmah van peekpi ama hih bangin zalzo na hi hiam?
Pasian kiangah ka gen ding uh hong hilh in. A hawmpi-in ka om uh a, ka gen ding uh om lo hi.
Pasian tawh kiho theih nading ka ngen kei ding hi. Kei hong suksiat nadingin kei kipia ding ka hi hiam?
"Tawlkhat sung khuavak kimu vet lo a, guah le meii in a liah hi. Tua ciangin huih hong nungin tuate khempeuh a mutsiang hi.
Kham mel khuavak leilu lam pan hong taang a, Pasian' minthanna pen zahtakna tawh kidimsak hi.
Pasian vanglian mahmah a, eite' theihzawh hi lo hi. Amah thuman mahmah a, thutang takin na a sem hi.
Tua ahih manin mi khempeuh in amah a zahtakna, mipil a kisate amah in a don lohna, lamdangsak ding hi lo hi." a ci hi.
Tua ciangin huihpi lak panin Topa in Job tungah thu hong gen a,
"Kei' pilna a nial dingin nang kua na hi hiam? Thu na theih lohlam a kilangsak na hi bek hi.
Kipasalsakin dingto inla, kong thudot dingte hong dawng in.
Leitung ka bawl laitakin nang om na hi hiam? Thei kisa na hih leh tua thu hong gen in.
Bangcia-in golsak ding cih kua in seh ahi hiam? Kua in a golna ding zah khau khai ahi hiam? Hihte khempeuh thei kisa na hi hiam?
Leitung a pua khuampite bang tungah kiphut ahi hiam? Kua in leitung a bulpi phut ahi hiam?
Tua ni-in zingsang aksite in la sa khawm uh a, Pasian' tapate lungdamin a kiko uh hi.
"Lei sung panin tuipi hong suahkhiat laitakin, tua tuipi a khaktan ding kongpi kua in na khak ahi hiam?
Meii tawh tuipi a tuamcip pa, khuamial tawh a vialcip pa keimah ka hi hi.
Tuipi gamgi ding ciamteh sakin, ama huangsung ding bekah ka omsak hi.
Tuipi kiangah, 'Hih ciang bek na pai ding a, hih banah na kin nawn kei ding hi. Na tuihualte hih ciang bek pai ding hi,' ka ci hi.
Job aw, nangmah in, 'Tuni-in khua vak in,' ci-in na nuntak sung tawntung thu pia ngei na hi hiam?
Zing khuavak in leitung a mongin manin, a kawma bu migilote a sinkhiat ding, thu pia thei ngei na hi hiam?
Khuavak in mualleguamte kilangkhia sak a, puan a tonin a kikoih tawh a kibatna a kilangsak hi.
Migilote a dingin sun khuavak taanglua a, siatna a gamtatna ding uh a khamcip hi.
"Tuipi sungtawng tuinakah pai ngei na hi hiam? Tuipi nuai lei tam tungah lam pai ngei na hi hiam?
Misite' gam khuamial kongkhakpi, mi khatpeuh in nang hong lak ngei ahi hiam?
Leitung bangcia lian ding cih na thei hiam? Hih thute thei na hih leh hong dawng in.
"Leitung khuavak hong kipatkhiatna mun ahi a, leitung khuamial hong kipatna mun ahi zongin, thei na hi hiam?
Nangmah in amau' omna mun ciang dong va thei a, tua ciang dongah va kha kik ngei na hi hiam?
Na nuntakna sawtta a, leitung a pianin nang suakkhin na hih teh tua thute khempeuh thei mah ni teh!
"Vuk a kikoihna munah nang va lut ngei a, gial a kikhopna mun va mu ngei na hi hiam?
Tuate, lungkham huna ding, gal om hun cianga dingin ka koihcing ahi hi.
Leitung nitaang a hong suahkhiatna mun ahi a, nisuahna huihpi hong kipatna mun ahi zongin, va tung ngei na hi hiam?
"Kua in guahzukna ding tui lampi bawlsak a, keek' lampi ding sialsak ahi hiam?
Mihing om lohna mun leilakah, kua in guah zusak ahi hiam?
Lopate a po theih nadingin lei keu-in a sak bekbakte kua in tui buak ahi hiam?
Guah in pa nei ahi hiam? Daitui in pa nei ahi hiam?
Kua' sung panin tuikhal hong piangkhia a, kua' sung panin vana vukte hong suak ahi hiam?
"Vana om Seguk henkop thei a, Zawlzawng a kikhihna phel thei na hi hiam?
Ama hun hunin aksite lam lak thei a, Khawlei-uikai a pai nading lampi lak thei na hi hiam?
Vana om nate' zuih ding ngeina bawlsak thei a, lei-a om nate' zuih ding ngeina bawl thei na hi hiam?
"Vana om meiite in guah hong zuksakna ding nangmah in sawl na hi hiam?
'Khua phia in,' ci-in thu pia lecin, 'Nong sawl bangin phia ning,' hong ci ding ahi hiam?
Nail gun a khan ding a thei gun vapite kua in hilh a, guahzuk ding a thei akluite, kua in hilh ahi hiam?
Leivuite khalcipin, leitang a sak ciangin, meiite thu pia-in vana tuibemte a hong dingin kua in pilna nei ahi hiam?
"Humpinelkai le a note leihawm sungah bu-in, a kua sung uhah lumin ngakin a om laitakun, a an ding uh zonsak thei a, a note' gilkialna vahsak thei na hi hiam?
Va-akte a gilkialin leng kawikawi-in, a note in an duhin kei tungah hong nget ciangun, tua va-akte an a piapa kua ahi hiam?
Tuate a ni ciamtehin, a suah hun ding uh thei na hi hiam?
A no suak dingin lei-ah a bawhsuk hun laitak thei na hi hiam?
A note gamlakah khangin, a nute kiang pan paikhia-in ciahkik nawn lo uh hi.
Amau' om nadingin gamlak ka pia a, bangmah a po zawh lohna zanglei-ah ka tengsak hi.
Gamlumna mun khuapite tawh a kigamla-ah om uh a, kuamah in zualsak zo lo a, na semsak zo lo uh hi.
Mualte tungah an zongin vak kawikawi uh a, nektheih ding singkung lopa a hing peuhpeuh zuan kawikawi uh hi.
"Gambawngtal in nangma na hong sem ding ahi hiam? Na ganbukah gambawngtal hong giak nuam ding ahi hiam?
Nangmah in khauhual tawh khihzo ding a, na lo-ah na lokhawhna leeng kaisakzo ding na hi hiam?
Nasem dingin a hat mahmah hangin, nangma na hong sepsak dingin lamen ngam na hi hiam?
Lo a na anpiangte hong kaihkhop sakin, na ancilna-ah an hong khawm dingin um na hi hiam?
"Vasa-kalaohte in a kha uh bangzah takin nawh zap thei ahi hiam! Ahi zongin gun vapi bangin vasa-kalaoh leng thei lo hi.
Vasa-kalaoh in leilakah a tui nusia a, a tuite a luumsak dingin leilak a ap hi.
Mi khatpeuh in a khe tawh a tuite a sikkhap khak ding, gamsa khatpeuh in a sikkhap khak ding, phawk khollo hi.
A tuite ama a' bangin ngaihsun khollo a, ka gimnate a mawkna suakkha ding hi, ci-in lunghimawh lo hi.
Amah a hai-in a bawlpa ama tungah pilna a guan lopa keimah ka hi hi.
Ahi zongin a tai ciangin sakol sangin hatzaw hi.
"Job aw, sakolte a hatsak pa nang na hi hiam? Sakol zaangmul a posak pa nang na hi hiam?
Sakolte kauphe bangin diangsak thei-in, mite' kihtak dingin phitsak thei na hi hiam?
Amaute in lawpna tawh a khe-un lei khuat uh a, a thaneih khempeuh uh tawh gal sungah a diang uh hi.
Amaute in launa mel bangmah thei lo uh a, namsau kihta-in nungkik cih zong om lo hi.
Amaute' tungah a tuang mite' galhiam, lum le teite a tee zalzal hi.
Peengkul a kitum ciangin ham hathat uh a, gal mai a tun ma-un gal gimnam za uh a, galkapmangte' thupiakna awging a za uh hi.
"Simbung in a kha zalin leitaw lamah a leentheihna ding nangma kiang panin hong sin ahi hiam?
Muvanlai in sang leenin mualtungah bu a tomna ding nang' thupiakna hong ngak ahi hiam?
Suangpi dawnah bu bawl a, suangheeng kawmte phualpi-in nei hi.
Tua lai mun panin khuadak kawikawi a, manin a nek ding an a gal et hi.
Gan sihna kimkotah musanete kikhawm uh a, a note in sasi a dawn uh hi," a ci hi.
"Job aw, nangmah in Vanglian Pasian nong dem hi. Tu-in khawl ding na hiam, ahih kei leh keima thugen nong dawng ding hiam?" a ci hi.
" Topa aw, ka haipau kha hi. Hong bangci dawn theih ding ka hi hiam? Tu a kipanin ka pau nawn kei ding hi.
Ka gen dinga kilawm zahval genkha ka hih manin, tu a kipanin ka pau nawn het kei ding hi," a ci hi.

"Kipasalsakin dingto inla, ka thudotnate hong dawng in.

Na ngap nakleh na minthanna ding le na kihihsak theih nadingin tu-in hong kipan inla, minthanna le minliatna ngah ta in.
A kiphasak mite en inla, na hehna tawh amaute niamkhiat gawp in.
Mi kiphasakte en inla, amaute niamkhiat gawp in. Migilote khempeuh a omna mun munah tuancil in.
Amaute khempeuh lei sungah phumcip inla, misite' gam sungah amaute khihcip in.
Tua bangin na hihzawh nakleh nang a hong phat masa pen pa, nang a gualzo pa na hihna thu a hong phawk masa pen pa ka hi ding hi.

ahi zongin ama pum sungah bangzah hatna om a, bangzahta-in a sazang khauh ahi hiam?
Ama mei, taamtak sing bangin khauhin tal po veva a, a khe-a a sazangte hat pha mahmah hi.
Ama guhte sumngo bangin khauh a, ama khete sikzawl bangin a khauh hi.
"Ganhing khempeuh lak pan a lamdang pen hi a, amah a Piangsak pa bek mah in amah a zozo ahi hi.
Gamsate omna mualtung panin ama an ding lopa kipuak hi.
Amah lingkung nuai-ah lum a, nawng sunga pumpeeng lakah a bu hi.
Lingkungte le lui gei-a gialhek kungte in ama a' ding niliim piangsak hi.
Amah in gun tuikhangte kihta het lo a, tuikhang in ama maitang a nawkgawp hangin nuamtakin omthei veve hi.
"Ngasa siahna sikkawi tawh Awle manzo ding a, khauhual khat tawh a leii henzo ding na hi hiam?
A nakpheh-ah khau vawhzo ding a, a khaguh-ah sikkawi bulhzo ding na hiam?
Amah in na khahna ding hong thum ding a, na hehpihna ding hong ngen ding ahi hiam?
Na sila ahi tawntung dingin nangma tungah thu hong ciam ding ahi hiam?
Na nasem numeite na mawlpih bangin mawlpihzo ding a, vasa khawi bangin bawlzo ding na hi hiam?
Ngasa bengte in lei dingin hong deek ding a, sa zuakte in zuak dingin a sa sem ding ahi hiam?
Ngasa khawhna teipi tawh a vun khawhletzo ding a, teipi lingnei tawh a lutang khawhletzo ding na hi hiam?
Khatvei sukhakhin lecin na hihkik nawn kei ding a, tua na sukkhakna thu na mangngilh nawn kei ding hi.
"Awle a mu mi peuhmah lau-in lei-ah a puk uh hi.
Awle a heh ciangin kihtakhuai mahmah a, ama omna mai-ah kuamah om ngam lo hi.
Leitung a om mihingte lakah Awle a suk manin a sihlawh lo kua om ahi hiam?
"Awle khete, a guh a taang, a thahatna ziate gen loin ka om thei kei hi.
Kua in ama puan tungnung hawkkhiatsak zo a, a sik puanpi sunletzo ahi hiam?
A kihtakhuai a hate a kam sungah om ahih manin, kua in ama kam phensak ngam ahi hiam?
A nungzang sukah a lipte lum bangin kithuapsuk cinten a, suang bangin sakin kimatcip bikbek ciat hi.
Tua lipte khatlekhat kithuapcip bikbek ahih manin, khatlekhat kikalah huih nangawn thawl zo lo hi.
Amah a hetchiai ciangin mei-ek bangin taang zaizai a, a mittangte nisuak bangin a taang hi.
A kam panin mei kuangkhia a, mei-ek leengkhia zaizai hi.
A nak panin meikhu suak a, selkeu khu tawh kibang hi.
Ama husanna in mei tawhkuang a, ama kam panin meikuang a suakkhia hi.
A ngawng zong thakhauh mahmah ahih manin, a gim thei het lo thatang a nei ahi hi.
A vun tung khempeuh a nipna mun mahmah om lo a, sik peek bangin a sak kim hi.
A lungsim in suangtum bangin kihtak khat zong nei lo a, an gawina suang bangin sakin do lah nei lo hi.
Amah hong kithawi ciangin mi thahat pente nangawn lau a, kihta mahmah uh ahih manin cih nading thei loin a om uh hi.
Namsau tawh a kisut hangin bunzo vet lo a, teipi le thaltangte in zong bunzo tuan het lo hi.
Ama a dingin sikte, buhkung bangin nip a, sumngote nangawn sing muatsa bang lel hi.
Amah khua a phawksakzo ding, thaltang om lo a, suang tawh a kiden ciangin anvai them tu bang lel hi.
Ama a dingin molhtum pen buhkung bang hi lel a, teipi tawh a kikhawh ciangin a nuihsan lel hi.
A khecinte, beelpei kitamte tawh kibang a, lam a pai ciangin leilak kuikek gawp hi.
Amah in tuipi tokin beel sunga tuiso bangsakzo a, sathau sa sunga tui tu bangin tuipi phuansak zaizai zo hi.
A painasa khempeuhah tuihual om dandan a, tuipi phuansak pheuphau hi.
Amah in a kihtakhuai ganhing a kihisak pente nangawn nuai-et lai a, amah pen gamsa khempeuh' kumpi ahi hi," a ci hi.
" Topa aw, vangliatna khempeuh na neihna, na hihnop khempeuh na hih theihna thu ka thei hi.
Kei bangmah a thei lo kimlai, 'Bang hangin ka pilna hong dem ngam na hi hiam?' na hong ci hi. Keimah in ka tel zawh loh thute, kei a dingin a lamdanglua thu a gengen ka hi hi.
Thu na gen laitakin ka na ngaihna ding, na thugente kong dawn ding, na hong gen hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in ka paunasate khempeuh hangin ka maizum mahmah a, tu-in vutlevai khu-in nakpitakin ka kisik hi," a ci hi.
Topa in hih thute khempeuh Job tungah a gen khit ciangin, Teman khua mi Elifaz kiangah, "Ka nasempa Job bangin, keima thu na gen ding uh a kilawm bangin gen lo na hih manun, nang le na lawm tegel tungah ka heh hi.
Tu-in bawngtal sagih le tuutal sagih la-in Job kiangah paipih un la, note a dingin biakpiakna-in nei un. Job in note a dingin thu hong ngetsak ding a, keimah in ama thungetna ka pia ding hi. Note' haina zahin kong minsiasak kei ding hi. Note in Job' gen bangin keima thu a manin na gen kei uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa' sawl bangin Elifaz, Bildad, le Zofar gamta uh a, Topa in Job' thungetna a pia hi.
Job in a lawm thumte a' ding thu a ngetsak khit ciangin, Topa in Job citheisakkik a, nidanga a neih ngeizah nihin neihsa lamsa a guan hi.
Tua ciangin Job' sanggam pasalte, a sanggam numeite, le a lawm ngeite a inn-ah hong hawh uh a, a inn-ah pawi bawlin lungdamin a omkhawm uh hi. Topa in ama tungah a tunsak gimnate hangin a khasiatpihnate uh genin a hanthawn uh hi. Amaute in sum le kham zungbuh khat ciat tawh va pha uh hi.
Tua tham loin Topa in Job' nuntakna a masa lam sangin a nunung lamah thupha limpiak zaw hi. Job in tuu tul sawm le tulli, kalaoh tulguk, bawngtal kap tulkhat, le la a pi tulkhat a nei hi.
Amah in tapa sagih le tanu thum neikik a,
a tanu upa pen Jemimah phuak a, a nihna Keziah phuak a, a tum pen Kerenhappuk a phuak hi.

Tua khit ciangin a khankhinin a teeksih ta hi.
Mi nuamsa i cihte pen migilote' thu a zui lo mi, mimawhte' gamtat bangin a gamta lo mi, mi a thusim lote tawh a kipawl lo mi ahi hi.
Ama nopsakna pen Topa thu sung bek mah hi a, sun le zanin ama thu a ngaihsunsun mi ahi hi.
Amah pen lui tuiluang gei-a a kisuan ama gah hunin gah a, a teh a vul ngei lo singkung tawh kibang hi. Ama hihna khempeuhah a maa pai mahmah hi.
Migilote ahihleh tua bang hi lo uh a, huih in a letkhiat anvai tawh kibang lel uh hi.

"Ka mual siangtho Zion tungah ka kumpi ka tusak khin hi," ci hi.

Pasian in amah huh lo ding, mi tampi in hong ci uh hi.

Tho in, Topa ! Kei hong hon in, ka Pasian! Bang hang hiam cih leh ka galte khempeuh' paang nangmah in na beenggawp a, migilote' ha na sutan hi.

A thuman ka Pasian aw, ka hong sap ciangin hong dawng in. Gimna ka thuak ciangin nopsakna nong pia hi. Kei hong hehpih inla, ka thungetna hong za in.
Mite aw, ka minphatna in bang tanvei daina thuak ding ahi hiam? Bang tanvei thumawkna deihin zuauthu zong ding na hi uh hiam?

Lau-in ling unla, mawhna peel un. Na lupna tung uhah lungngai phapha unla, om khikhe un.

Amaute, an le leengtui a hauh cianga a nuam uh sangin nuamna lianzaw ka lung sungah nong guan hi.

Topa aw, zingsang simin ka aw nong za a, zingsang simin nangma a dingin biakna bawlin kong ngak hi.

Pasian aw, a mawhna uh amau mah thuaksak inla, amau' thu mah tawh amaute puksak in. Amaute in nangmah hong lehdo uh ahih manin amau' mawhna tampite hangin amaute paaikhia in.

Topa aw, na heh laitak hong taii kei inla, lungso sa-in hong thuhilh kei in.
Topa aw, thaneem ka hih manin kei tungah dikna hong zang in. Topa aw, ka guh ka taang na mahmah ahih manin hong damsak in.
Ka hingim mahmah hi. Topa aw, bang tanvei nang hong zekai lai ding na hi hiam?
Topa aw, hong kihei inla, kei hong hon in. Itna kip a nei pa na hih manin keimah hong hon in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh misite omna gam sungah nangmah phawk theih nading bangmah om lo ahih manin, Leinuai panin kua in nang hong phat thei ding ahi hiam?
Ka tautauna-in ka gim hi. Zan sialin ka khitui in ka lupna tum a, ka kahkahna-in ka lupna kawt dikdek hi.

Ka galte khempeuh zahhuai mahmahin genthei ding uh hi. Amaute nungkikin maizumna thuak pah ding uh hi.
Topa ka Pasian aw, nangmah ka hong bel hi. Kei hong delhte' kiang panin hong dal inla hong hon in.

Topa ka Pasian aw, ka gamtat a siat a, ka khut a khialh leh,
bangmah thu om lopi-in ka lawmte khemin, ka galte ka huh taak leh,
galte in kei hong delhin hong pha uh hen la, leilakah kei hong tuancilsak inla, leilakah kei hong sialpai ta uh hen.
Tho in, Topa, a hehsa-in thasaan inla, ka galte' hehna panin kei hong dal in. Khanglo in, ka Pasian aw, thukhenna ding hun khat na seh khinzo hi.
Nangma omna kiimah mite kikhawmsak inla, amaute' omna tung a sangna munah tu in.
Topa in mite thu a khen hi. Topa aw, ka thumanna le keima sunga om ka dikna tawh kizui-in thu hong khen in.

Pasian, kei hong hupa hi a, lungsim man mite a hon hi.
Pasian, thu a tangin a khen pa hi a, migilote tungah a heh den pa ahi hi.
Mite a kibawlphat kik kei leh, Pasian in a thalkhau sui zo a, a namsau taat ding hi.
Amah in mei thaltang bawl a, sih theihna ama galhiamte a baihsa-in a koihzo hi.
Migilo in thusia paii a, suak nuamin na a, zuauthu a hingkhia hi.
Amah in gum to a, ama tawhsa gum sung mahah amah a kia hi.
Ama lunggulh hoih lo pen ama lu tungah tukik a, ama gamtatsia pen ama luzang mahah tukik hi.
Ke'n ahihleh, ama dikna om bangin Topa' tungah lungdamna ka lak ding a, a Sangpen Topa' min phatna la ka sak ding hi.
Topa kote' Topa aw, leitung khempeuhah na min lian mahmah hi. Nangmah a hong kiphatna awgingte in vantung ban a,
naungekte le naupangte' kam tawh nangmah phatna la kisa hi. Gal na neih manin galte le langpangte na daihsakna dingin panmunkip na bawl khin hi.
Na nasepna, na bawlsa, kha le aksite, le na vantungte ka et ciangin,
na ngaihsut tham dingin mihing bang hi lel a, na phawk tham dingin mihing' ta bang hi lel ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin, vantungmi sangin a neuzaw deuh bekin na bawl a, minthanna le pahtawina nangmah in na guan hi.

huih lak a leng vasate, tui sunga om ngasate, tui, lampi-a a tawn khempeuhte, na khempeuh ama khenuai-ah na koih hi.
Topa, kote' Topa aw, leitung khempeuhah na min lian mahmah hi.
Ka lungsim khempeuh tawh Topa tungah lungdamna kong ko ding a, na bawl a lamdangte khempeuh ka gen ding hi.
Nangma hangin nuamin ka diang ding a, na min phatna ka sa ding hi, Sangpenpa aw.
Bang hang hiam cih leh keima thutanna na hong kipsak a, tokhom tungah tu-in thu a manin na khen hi.
Minamte na taii a, migilote na susia hi. A maimang dingin amau' min na phiat hi.
Siat denna sungah galte beimang hi. A khuate uh na zunglot a, amaute kiphawkkha nawn lo hi.
Topa ahihleh kumpi za-ah tu ngitnget a, thukhen nadingin a tokhom a bawl hi.
Leitung mite' thu a mantakin khen a, a kilawm bangin mite' thu a khen hi.
Topa pen, netniamna a thuakte a' dingin munkip hi a, haksat hun ciangin munmuanhuai ahi hi.
Topa aw, nang a hong zongte nusia lo na hih manin, na min a theite in nang hong muang uh hi.
Zion-ah a om Topa phatna la sa un! Ama nasepnate mite' lakah gen un!

Tate aw, na pa uh' hong hilhnate ngai unla, thu na teltheih nadingun limtakin ngaihsun un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh kong hilh thute thuhoih ahi hi. Kong hilhte khempeuh limtakin ciamteh un.
Kei zong tapa khat neihsun ka hi a, naupangno khat ka hih lai-in
ka pa in thu hong hilh a, "Ka thugente ciamteh inla, mangngilh kei in. Kong gen bangin gamta in; tua hileh na nungta ding hi.
Pilna le thu ngaihsut theihna na neihna ding hahkat in. Kong gen thute mangngilh kei inla, hoihtakin ngaihsun in.
Pilna nusia kei in; tua hileh siatna panin nang hong hu ding hi. Pilna deih in; tua hileh lungmuang takin na om nadingin hong kem ding hi.
Pilna na ngahna ding a thupi masa pen hi a, na neih khempeuh na beilawh zongin na zon ding ahi hi.
Pilna deih in; mi lianin hong bawl ding hi. Limtakin pom in; pahtawina hong ngahsak ding hi.
Pilna in pahtawina le minthanna nangma tungah hong tungsak ding hi," hong ci hi.
Ka ta aw, ka thugente limtakin zui in. Tua hileh na khansau ding hi.
Na pilna ding lampi kong hilhzo a, na gamtatna ding zia kong genzo hi.
Hoihtakin gamta lecin nang hong nawngkaisakzo ding bangmah om lo ding a, na tai hangin zong na pukkha kei ding hi.
Hong kihilhnate lencip inla, khahsuah kei in. Na nuntakna ding ahih manin limtakin zui in.
Migilote tawh kikhawl kei inla, amau' gamtatnate zui kei in.
Amau' gamtat bangin gamta peuhmah ke'n! Gitlohna peel in! Paisan inla, na maban sem in.
Migilote in a sia khatpeuh a sep mateng uh lum thei lo uh a, mi khatpeuh a sukzawh mateng uh ihmu thei lo uh hi.
Gitloh gamtatna, annek bangin nuamsa uh a, ngongtatna, tui dawn bangin a ngaihsun uh hi.
Ahi zongin thuman mite' zuih lampi ahihleh sun dong a taang pha semsem zingsang khuavak tung tawh kibang hi.
Migilote' lampi ahihleh zan khuamial bangin mial a, amaute a tuksak, a suihkhakte nangawn mu thei lo uh hi.
Ka ta aw, ka thugente don inla, ka kammalte ngai in.
Na kiang panin paikhiasak kei inla, na lungsimah ciamteh in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh tua thu a zuite in nuntakna le cidamna-in a nei uh hi.
Na lungsim ngaihsutnate nuntakna nak hi a, na neihsa a manpha pen bangin na kep ding ahi hi.
A man lo thu gen ngei kei inla, zuauthu le a kiza khial thei ding kammalte zang het kei in.
Kisuanna nei hetloin om liuliau inla, maizumin kuncip kei in.
Na khatpeuh na sepna thu theitel in. Tua hileh na nasep peuhpeuh maavang ding hi.
Siatna peelin a manin gamta inla, thuman lampi panin themcik zong pialkha kei in.
Ka ta aw, ka pilna le ka thumuhnate, limtakin ngai-in hong za in.
Tua hileh a kilawmin na gamtatzia ding na thei ding a, na kampaunate in na pil lamtak hong kilangsak ding hi.
Numei paktatte' kampau khuaizu bangin khum mahmahin a thugente uh a neel dakdak hangin,
a tawpna-ah lungkhamna le natna simloh nangma tungah bangmah dang hong guan lo hi.
Amah in sihna gamah nang hong paipih ding a, ama tot lampi pen sihna mun tunna lampi ahi hi.
Tate aw, tu-in ka thugente limtakin hong ngai unla, ka thugente mangngilh kei un.
Tua bang numei tawh kinehkha kei unla, a inn gei nangawnah paikha kei un.
Tua bang na hih kei uhleh na min hoihna teng uh midang tungah tung ding a, hehpihna a nei lo mite' khutlum tawh na khansih ding uh hi.
Khualmite in na neihsa teng uh la ding a, na sepsa khempeuh uh midangte in ngah ding uh hi.
Na sih kuan uh ciangin thumin na tau ding uh a, gawngin na guhguak bekun na om ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin, "Bang hangin thu thei hoh lo a, hong kihilhna mang hoh lo ka hi hiam?
Kei hong hilh siate' thu ka mang nuam kei a, amau' hong hilhnate ka don keikha hi.
Tua ahih manin tu-in ka cimawh vat a, mi' mai-ah ka min a sia hi," na ci ciat ding uh hi.
Na zi' tungah citak inla, amah bek itin nei in.
Pasal dang tawh va vakzau-in kongzing lakah va mawhkha ding hi.
Na zi pen nangma a' ding bek hi a, midangte tawh na neihkhawm ding hi lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin na zi tawh lungkim inla, na tenpih numei tawh lungdam in.
A it-huai a ngaihbaangin ngaihsun tawntung inla, ama ngaihbaanna tawh lungdamin, ama hong itna tawh lungkim in.
Ka ta aw, bang hangin numei dang lunggulh ding a, numei dangte' ngaihbaanna iplah ding na hi hiam?
Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in na gamtatna khempeuh hong mu a, na paina khempeuhah nang hong en kawikawi hi.
Migilo pa' mawhna thangzak bang hi a, ama mawhna thang sung mahah amah a awk hi.
Ama pumpi ki-uk zo lo ahih manin amah in sihlawh a, ama hailuatna in hankhuk sung a tun hi.
Ka ta aw, na lawmte khatpeuh in sum leitawi a lak ciangin a lohzawh kei leh ama tangin a lohsak dingin kam na ciamkha hiam?
Na kampauna hangin nang hong kimanin, na thuciamna hangin na awkkha hiam?
Ka ta aw, tua bang na hih khak leh, tua mipa' khut sungah a om na hi hi. Na suahtak theih nadingin manlangin a kiangah pai inla, hong khah nadingin ama kiangah thum in.
Ihmumu kei inla, om mawkmawk kei in.
Sabeng pa' kiang panin a suahtak nadingin sakhi a tai bangin, thangah a awk vasa a kitom bangin na suahtak nadingin hanciam in.
Thadahpa aw, miksite kiangah pai inla, amau' nuntakzia va en in.

khuakhal sungin a nek ding uh, tuk hun sungin kaikhawm khol uh hi.

Amau' melhoihna iplahkha kei inla, amau' hong zawlmitna khenglahkha kei in.

Na ang sungah meikuang pom lecin na puan kang loin om ding ahi hiam?
Mei-am tungtawnin pai lecin na khe kang loin om ding ahi hiam?
Tua mah bangin mi' zi tawh a mawhte in gimna thuak ding uh a, tua bang a gamta peuhmah in gimna thuak ding uh hi.

Amah in sumlepai sang nuam vet lo a, letsong tampi piakna in a hehna damsak zo lo hi.
Ka ta aw, ka thugente ciamteh inla, kong sawl thute khempeuh mangngilh ngei kei in.

Khatvei, ka omna inn-ah, ka tawlet panin ka khuadak a,

"Tuni-in biakpiakna ka bawl a, nek ding sa tampi ka nei hi.
Ka nekpih dingin nang ka hong zong a, tu-in kong mu petmah hi.
Ka lupna tungah a nop mahmah dingin, Egypt gam puan hoihpente ka phahzo hi.
Myrrh paknamtui, aloes paknamtui, le sinnamon paknamtui tawh, ka lupna tung a namtui dingin ka bawl khinta hi.
Hong pai in; zanthapai-in ki-itna bawlin, ang kikawmin lungnuam ni.

Amah in sum tampi keng a, nipikal nih bang mateng hong tung lo ding hi," a ci hi.

" Topa in kei hong piangsak masa pen a, tangtawnga ama sep lak pan a masa pen ka hi hi.

Mi khat in ta zakhat nei-in kum saupi zong nungta thei kha ding hi. Bangzahin sauveipi a nungta ahi zongin leitungah nopsakna ngah loin, limtak a vuina a ngah kei leh, a sisa-a suak naungek hoihzaw lai hi.

Khuasung cingte tawh ka kikhen khit phetin ka ngaihno tawh ka kimu hi. Amah kawi-in ka lencip a, ka pianna ka nu' inndei sung, ka nu' inn dong ka tunpih mateng ka khah kei hi.

En un, Solomon kumpi luai-in hong kizawng! Israel gam sunga om galkap hoihpen galkap sawmguk in amah cing hi.
A vekpi-in namsau zat a siam vive hi a, galdo a siam vive hi khin uh hi. A vekpi-in namsau kuah kim uh a, mi' hihkhak ding a cing uh hi.
Sing hoihpen tawh a kibawl luai-in Kumpi Solomon hong kizawng hi.
A luai khuamte, ngun tawh kizut a, a tungah kham tawh a kizem puan a kilam hi. A tut nadingin puansan kibawl a, a sungah savun kidap hi.
Jerusalem nungakte aw, hong pai unla, Kumpi Solomon en dih ve un. A zi neih ni, a lungdam ni-a, a nu in amah a khuksak Kumpi lukhu hong khu hi.
Na ha pak singsengte zong a mul a kimet khin phet, a kisawpsiang tuute tawh kibang hi. Na ha khat zong tok lo a, a vekpi-in kituak dimdiam hi.
Na mukte puansan tawh kibang a, na kampau ngaihnop-huai hi. Na lu khuhna puan sung panin na kho hong san lihleh hi.
Na ngawng pen galhangte' zat lum tangzang tulkhat a kikhai zeizaina David' tausang tawh kibang hi.
Na nawite unok pak lakah a ta khawm helhel sanang nih tawh ahi a, a ta khawm hialhial sakhi peeng tawh ahi zongin a kibang hi.
Zingsang huih vot a nun' mateng, zingsang khuavak hong tun mateng, myrrh paknamtui a omna mualtungah omsuakin, saledi paknamtui lakah ka bual ding hi.
Ngaihno aw, na ngaihbaang mahmah a, kawkbaanna ding na nei kei hi.
Ka lawm ngaih aw, Lebanon Mual-ah hong pai inla, Lebanon Mual panin kei hong zui in. Humpinelkaite le kamkeite a tenna, Amana Mual dawn panin hong taisuk inla, Senir Mual le Hermon Mual panin hong paisuk in.
Itluat ka lawm ngaih aw, nang tawh kingaih nuam mahmah hi. Na itna leenggahzu sangin khumzaw a, na paknamtui paknamtui dang khempeuh sangin namtui zaw hi.
Lawm aw, na muk, khuaizu bangin khum a, na leii, bawngnawi le khuaizu bang hi. Na puante Lebanon Mual tunga paknamtui namkim a nam hi.
Tua huan sungah singkungte hoihtakin khang a, mang kawlsing cinna huan tawh kibang hi. Singgah limci pente tua lai-ah gah a, henna leh nard sing namtuite tua lai-ah a po hi.
Nard sing le saffron sing, thalsing le sinnamon kung, a namtui a gah namkim kung po a, myrrh le aloes, a namtui namkim om hi.
Lebanon Mual tung panin tui hong luangsuk a, ciktui luangte, luitui luangte, tua huan sungah a tungsuk hi.
Saklam huih aw, hong nungsuk inla, khanglam huih aw, hong nungto in. Ka huan sungteng hong namtuisak un. Ka ngaihno, ka huanah hong paisak unla, a gah limci pente hong nesak un.
Itluat ka lawmnu aw, ka huansung hong tungzo ing. Ka paknamtuite ka kaikhawm hi. Ka khuaizu le ka khuailuzu ka ne a, ka leenggahzu le ka bawngnawite ka dawn hi. Nungak le tangval aw, na lungkim piikpeek dongun ne-in dawnin nuamsa un.
Ka lup hangin ka lungsim ihmu lo a, ka ngaihno in ka kong hong kiuh ka za hi. Itluat ngaihno ka lungtup aw, kei hong tumsak in. Ka lu tungah daingo kia a, meiizun in ka sam kawtsak hi.
Ka puante suah khinzo ing. Ka puante silhkik ding ka hi hiam? Ka khete sil khinzo ing; ninsakkik ding ka hi hiam?
Ka ngaihno in kongkhak hong len khin napi hong taisan kik hi.
Ka ngaihno tumsak dingin ka kithawi a, ka khutte myrrh paknamtui tawh ka zut a, ka khutmete myrrh paknamtui ka nuh a, kong a hong dingin a honna ka len hi.
Ka ngaihno a lutsak dingin kong ka hon a, amah na taikhia khinta hi. Amah a taikhiat manin ka dah lua a, amah ka zon hangin ka mu kei a, amah ka sap hangin hong dawng lo hi.
Khuasung a cing mite tawh ka kituak a, kei hong satin hong liamsak uh a, kulhzang a a kileh den khuacingte in ka puantungsilh hawkkhia uh hi.
Kong thum hi, Jerusalem nungakte aw, ka ngaihno na muh uhleh lungzuangin ka sih dekna na gensak un.
Nungak lak a a hoihpen aw, na ngaihno a bangci hiam, hong gen dih in. Tua bangin kong gen liang ding uh bangzahtakin lamdang ahi hiam?
Ka ngaihno a melhoih a, a thahat hi. Mi tul sawm lakah tehpih ding dang om lo hi.
A sam sau-in kil thiuhtheuh a, a sam hoihin vom dikdek a, kham sangin zong deihhuai zaw hi.
A mittangte ahihleh tuisiang phuan lakah a kisil siang kiuhkeuh, luitui luang gei-a a om vahuite tawh kibang hi.
A biangte pen paknamtui a dimin a kithun thawl san kiuhkeuh tawh a kibang hi. A mukte pen myrrh paknamtui tawh a kidim unok pak tawh kibang hi.
A khutte etlawmin hi linlian a, suangmanpha a kiphut zungbuhte a bulh hi. A pumpi pen suangmanpha a kiphut dimdiam saiha pak tawh kibang hi.
A khete pen kham citak a kiphuh dimdiamna suangngo khuamte tawh kibang a, ama duang pen Lebanon mual sang, taamtak kung hoih bangin thupi suak mahmah hi.
A kampaute khum zungzung a, a vekin, deih loh ding khat zong om lo hi. Ka ngaihno, hih bang teng hi, Jerusalem nungakte aw.
Nungak lak a hoihpen nu aw, na ngaihno, koi-ah pai hiam? Na ngaihno koi lam pai hiam? Amah hong zonpih nung.
Ka ngaihno, paknamtui kung a pona, a huan sungah pai hi. A huan sungah a tuu cing a, unok paakte a lo hi.
Ka ngaihno kei a' hi a, kei zong ama a' hi'ng. Amah in unok pak lakah a tuute gamtasak hi.
Ngaihno aw, Jerusalem khuapi bangin na etlawm mahmah a, Tirzah khuapi bangin na hoih mahmah a, vantung aksi bangin na deihhuai hi.
Keima lam hong nga kei in. Na mai in hong leng lua hi. Gilead mual tunga keelhon diang leklek bangin na samphekte phe velvel hi.
Na hate zong, a kisil khin phet tuuhon bangin pak singseng hi. A tok khat zong om lo a, a vekpi-in kituak dimdiam hi.
Na lu khuhna puan sung panin na kho hong san lihleh hi.
Kumpi-zi sawmguk, kumpi zineu sawmgiat, simzawh lohin nungak tampi om kha ding a,
ahi zongin khat bek ka ngai a, amah pen vahui bangin it-huai hi. Amah pen a nu' tanu neihsun hi a, a nu' ta it pen khat ahi hi.
Zing khuavak tawh a kibang hih nungak kua ahi hiam? Amah melhoih mahmah a, nitaang, khataang, a bang hi.
Kuam sunga om singkungnote a en ding, leengguite a pak nai hiam a en ding, mang kawlsing a pak nai hiam a en dingin singno huanah ka paisuk hi.
Galdo dingin a kipan sakol hawlpa a lin' bangin nang kong ngaihna hangin ka lingling hi.
Hong ciahkik in, hong ciahkik in, Shulam numei aw. Nang kong muh theih nadingun hong ciahkik in, hong ciahkik in. Shulam nungak, khanglui lai-a a lamte bangin bang hangin hong mu nuam na hi uh hiam?
Kumpi mel a pua a ngaihbaang nungak aw, na khete le na khedap kilawm mahmah! Na phei le na tanzumte sing suih siamte' suih bang hiuhiau!
Na kalkawm pen leenggahzu lim tawh a kilawi lo hai bangin uk kiukeu hi. Na kawng pen unok pak tawh a ki-um buhlom hen tawh kibang hi.
Na nawite pen a takhawm helhel sakhi peeng, a omkhawm hialhial sanang nih tawh kibang hi.
Na ngawng, saiha tausang tawh kibang hi. Na mitte pen Heshbon khuapi kulh gei-a om tuilite tawh kibang hi. Na nak pen Damaskas khuapi lam a nga Lebanon tausang bangin hoih hiuhiau hi.
Itluat aw na ngaihbaang a, na mel kong muh nuam zungzung hi.
Tuum kung bangin na etlawm a, na nawite pen, nisuh gah a bawk pha mahmah tawh a kibang hi.
Tuum kung tungah kahto-in a gah ka lo ding hi. Na nawite kei a dingin leenggah bawk tawh kibang a, na gimnam epel min bangin namtui hi.
Na kam, leenggahzu bangin khum zungzung hi. Ka ngaihno tungah leenggahzu khum luang hen la, a muk a ha tawk kim hen.
Ka ngaihno a' ka hi a, amah in kei hong deih hi.
Ngaihno aw, gamlakah paikhia-in leenggui lo-ah va giak ni.
Zingsangin tho baihin leengguite a sel nai hiam, leengguite a pak nai hiam, mang kawlsing kungte a pak nai hiam, i en ding hi. Tua lai munah kong itna letsong ka hong pia ding hi.
Tua lai-ah zawl-ai kung a namtui gim na za ding a, singgah lim namcin i kong gei-ah a om hi. Ngaihno aw, a gah a lui le a thak nang a dingin na duhduh kong koihsak hi.
Ka nu' sung pana piang ka sanggampa hi lecin kei ka ut hi. Tua hileh, lamkalah hong tuak taleng zong kong tawptawp ding a, kuamah in phamawh sa lo ding hi.
Keima pianna ka nu' inndei sungah nang kong paipih ding a, tua lai-ah nong kawi ding hi. Tua lai-ah leenggahzu lim, mang kawlsing tui, kong tulh ding hi.
A veilam khut hong khamsak a, a taklam khutin hong kawi hi.
Jerusalem nungakte aw, ko' kingaihna nong suknawi loh nadingun kei tungah hong kiciam un.
Gamlak panin a lawmpa tawh khut kilensa-in a hong paikhia kua ahi hiam? Nangmah na pianna mun, na nu in hong neihna mun, epel kung nuai panin nang kong phong hi.
Kei simloh kuamah ngai kei inla, kei simloh kuamah kawi kei in. Itna zong sihna zahin thahat a, ngaihna zong sihna zahin khauh hi. Itna, mei bangin kuangkhia a, meikuang lianpen a suak hi.
Tui tampi nangawn tawh kisumit zo lo a, tui sungah i phumcip hangin mitzo tuan lo hi. Mi khat in a neihsa sum khempeuh tawh itna a lei dingin hong kithawi leh kinuihsan lel ding hi.
Sanggam numeino khat ka nei uh a, a nawite neu mahmah hi. Tangval khat in hong hel zenzen leh ka sanggamnu uh bangci huh ding ka hi uh hiam?
Amah khua umna kulh hileh, ngun kibawl tausang tawh ka hu ding uh a, amah kulhkongpi hileh, taamtak singpekte tawh ka dal ding uh hi.
Kei, khuakulh ka hi a, ka nawite, a tausang ahi hi. Limtakin kei hong kihutna ka ngaihno in thei ding hi.
Baalhamon a kici munah Solomon in leenggui lo khat a nei hi. Amah in tua lo a kho dingin losapte sawl a, a lo-a piangte' man dingin losapte khat in ngun dangka tulkhat ciat a piak ding uh ahi hi.
Keimah in keima aituam leenggui lo khat ka nei hi. Solomon aw, na ngun dangka tulkhat la inla, lokhote' tungah amau' tanh ding a zah nih pia in.
Huan sunga om ka ngaihno aw, ka lawmte in hong ngai dide ahih manin nangma aw zong, hong gingsak dih in.

Judah gam kumpi ahi Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, le Hezekiah-te' hun lai-in Amoz' tapa Isaiah in Judah gam le Jerusalem khua tawh kisai a maangmuhnate:
Vantungte aw, na za un; leitung aw, na ngai in; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in thu hong gen khinzo a, "Ka pattahsa ka tate in kei hong lehdo uh hi.
Bawng in amah a nei pa thei a, la in zong a topa' an piakna mun thei buang hi. Ahih hangin Israel in bangmah thei lo a, keima mite in thei thei lo uh hi," a ci hi.
Ah, a khial minam, mawhna in a nencip mite, siatna a bawlte' suanlekhakte, a gamtatsia tapate! Amaute in Topa nusia khin uh a, amaute in Israel-te' Siangtho Pasian simmawh khin uh hi. Amaute in lam khial khin taktak uh hi.
Bang hangin note hong kisat theih nadingin lehdo teitei na hi uh hiam? Israel aw, na lutang khempeuh liamma dim a, na lungsim le na ngaihsutna gim mahmah hi.
Khenuai a kipan luzang dong nangawnin a cidamna mun om lo a, sanim gawpnate, meimapite, le siluang liammate a om hi. Tuate pen a nai kisal lo, kitun lo, sathau tawh zong kinomsak lo hi.
Na gam uh khing a, na khuapite uh mei tawh kihal hi. Na muh tangpi mahun gamdang mite in na gam uh hong laksakin na khempeuh susia gawp hi.

Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Note' biakpiakna a tampite pen kei' tungah bang hi leltak ahi hiam? Tuutalte le ganhing thaute' sathau tawh meihal biaknate ka kham ta hi. Bawngtalte, tuunote, le keelte' si tawh kei ka lungkim kei hi.
Kei' mai-ah a kilaak dingin na hong pai uh ciangin hih bangin ka huangsung na tuatcil gawpna uh kua'n hong deih ding ahi hiam?
Bangmahin a kimang lo piaknate hong paipih nawn kei un. Paknamtui halna ka kih hi. Khadet ni, Sabbath ni, le thupi takin na kikhopnate uh mawhna tawh kidim ahih manin ke'n ka thuakzo kei hi.
Note' Khadet nite le na pawite uh ka mudah hi. Tuate pen kei a dingin vangikpi khat suakkhin a, tuate khempeuh ka puakna-in ka gim hi.
"Thungenin na khutte uh nong zaak uh ciangin note kong en kei ding a, thu tampi na nget uh hangin ke'n ka ngai tuan kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh sisan tawh note' khut kidim hi.
Note kisil tawm unla, a siangtho-in kibawl un. Keima muhna-ah na gamtat siatnate uh paikhia-in, siatna na bawlte uh khawl un.
Gamtat hoih ding kisin un. Thumanin gamta unla, kinetniamna kheel un. Pa nei lote hu unla, meigong numei panpih un," ci hi.
Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Tu-in hong pai unla, thu kikumkhawm ni. Na mawhnate uh puansan a bat hangin vuk bangin hong ngo ding hi. Na mawhnate uh si bangin a san hangin tuumul bangin hong kang ding hi.
Note in utna lungsim nei-in thu na man' nak-uhleh lei pana piang a gah hoihte na ne ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin note in kei hong nialin na hong lehdo uhleh namsau in note hong vatmai ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in hih thu gen khinzo hi," a ci hi.
A thutak, thutang tawh a kidim ngeisa khuapi, bangci-a a paktat numei tawh kibang ta ahi hiam? Ama sungah thumanna om ngei napi-in tu-in mi thatte bek a om ta hi.
Jerusalem khuapi aw, nguntang na bang ngei a, tu-in ahihleh ngun-ek na suakta hi. Leenggahzu limci na bang ngei a, tu-in ahihleh tui mawkmawk na bangta hi.
Na uliante, mi lehdote hi a, gutate tawh a kikhawlte ahi hi. Mi khempeuh in sumgolh le letsong a deih uh hi. Amaute in pa nei lote panpih lo uh a, meigongnu' thu amaute in sang lo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, Topa, Vanglian Topa , Israel-te' Vanglian Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: "Ah, ka lang ahi note' tungah ka hehna kong khahkhia ding a, ka gal ahi note tungah keimah in kong thuk ding hi.
Note tungah na kong sem ding a, meikhukah haltui bangin na saam-ek teng uh tuikhia sakin, na kihelpih na nin khempeuh uh ka lakhia ding hi.
A masa-a bangin na thukhente, a kipat cil-a bangin na upate ka koihkik ding hi. Tua khit ciangin nang pen thuman khuapi, thutak khuapi, hong kici ding hi," a ci hi.

Milimte khempeuh mangthang khin ding hi.

Topa, Vanglian Topa in Jerusalem khua le Judah gam panin nuntakna le luhinna, nuntakna an khempeuh le nuntakna tui khempeuh;

Migilo in gimna ngah ta hen! Midang tungah a gitloh gamtatna tawh kizui-in ama tungah kithukkik ding ahih manin ama tungah thu sia ding hi.

lukhute, banbulhte, kawngtente, paknamtui bungte, le a kivom aite;
