pawipuante, puanza neute, puanpite le khutkhai ipte;
puanza neu vang siseihte, saihadial puansungsilhte, dialkhipte, le kikhuhna puante lakhia ding hi.
Paknamtui tangin uihna, kawnggak tangin khauhualpi, limtak a kizem sam tangin lu kolhna, puan hoih tangin puanhampi, melhoihna tangin maizumna hun hong tung ding hi.
Na mite, namsau tawh si ding uh a, a vanglian na mite, gal sungah kisia ding uh hi.
Khuapi kongpi tau-in thum ding hi. Khuapi, gamkhing suak ding a, a guaktanga om nupi leilakah a tucip tawh kibang ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin nupi sagih in papi khat neikhawm ding uh a, "Kote in komau' an ciat ne-in, komau' puan ciat mah ka silh ding uh hi. Kote pen, nangma zi cih min bek hong puasak in; ka minsiatna teng uh hong hum in," ci ding uh hi.
Tua ni ciangin Topa ' bulsel pen melhoihin minthang ding a, leitung panin a piang gahte pen, a suakta lai Israel mite' kiphatsakna le minthanna hi ding hi.
Topa in thukhenna le meihalna tawh Zion mite' mawhna teng siangsakin, Jerusalem khuasung panin mi thahna teng a beisak ciangin Zion-ah a omlai mi, Jerusalem-ah khang tawntungin a om dingin a kiciamtehsa mite khempeuh, a siangtho kici ding hi.
Tua ciangin Zion Mual tung, tua lai-a kikhawm mi khempeuh tungah, sunin meii sungah, zanin meikuang khu tawh Topa hong kilang ding a, Topa ' minthanna vang in khuapi hu ding hi.
Tua minthanna vang pen sun ciangin nisa a liah ding le huihpi guahpi panin bukna le belhna zong hi ding hi.
Ka lawm it pa' tangin a leenggui lo a itna la ke'n hong sa ning: Ka lawm it pa in leitang a hoih mahmahna mualtung khatah leenggui lo khat a nei hi.
Amah in lei to-in a suangte paikhia a, leenggui hoihte a suan hi. A laizangah tausang khat lam a, tua lo sungah leenggahsukna khuk khat a to hi. Amah in leenggah hoih a hong gah ding lamen a, ahih hangin gam leenggah hong gah mawk hi.
Tu-in, Jerusalem khua-ah a tengte le Judah mite aw, kei le ka leenggui lo kikalah thu nong khenna ding uh ka hong thum hi.
Ka leenggui lo a dingin ka hih nai loh ka hih ding a kilawm bang omlai ahi hiam? Leenggah hoih gah ding ka lamet laitakin bang hangin gam leenggah hong gah mawk ahi hiam?
Tu-in, ka leenggui lo tungah ka hih ding thu note tungah kong gen ding hi. A daai ka lakhia ding a, kinemang ding hi. A gawl ka susia ding a, kituancil ding hi.
Lokhulin ka bawl ding hi. Kipuah loin, kikho lo ding a, tua lo sungah lingkung le lingte a khang ding hi. Ama tungah meiite in zong guah a zuksak loh nadingin thu ka pia ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Vanglian Topa ' leenggui lo pen Israel mite hi a, Judah mite pen lungdamna tawh a suan kungte ahi hi. Amah in thutang lamen a, ahih hangin sisan luanna om hi. Thumanna lamen a, ahih hangin kahna om hi.
Leitang tungah amau guak a teng ding dong zahin midangte a dingin mun khempeuh a bei matengin inn khatlekhat, lo khatlekhat gawmin a la thuah tawntung mite in gimna ngah tahen.
Vanglian Topa in ka zakna-ah hih bangin kiciam a, "A mantakin inn tampi tak hawmsuak ding a, a lian a hoih innte-ah a teng om lo ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh leenggah lo eka sawm in phelpi khat dim bek gah ding a, khaici beem khat in an seu khat bek piangsak ding hi," ci hi.
Zingsang tungin tho-in, khamtheihzu delhin, leenggahzu in amaute a satsak pialpual matengin nitakin a tutkho mite in gimna ngah ta hen!
Amaute in a pawi sung uhah laiza lasakna le harp lasakna, khuang, tamngai, le leenggahzu, tampi a nei uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute in Topa ' sepnate don lo uh a, a khut tawh a bawlte zong mu lo uh hi.
Tua hi a, thu theih lohna hangin ka mite sal suak uh hi. A miliante uh gilkialin si dek uh a, a mihonte uh dangtakin keu uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Leinuai in a duhna khangsakin bangmah tawh a kiteh thei lo zahin a kam ka beba a, Jerusalem' hoihna teng, a mipite, a mihonte, ama sunga a lungdam mite, a nawmvalh hi.
Mi khempeuh a niamin kikoih suk hi. A kiphasak mite kiniamkhiat suk hi.
Ahih hangin thutang sepna tawh Vanglian Topa in a liatna hong kilangsak a, a Siangtho Pasian in a mite a thukhenna tawh ama sianthona hong kilangsak hi.
Tua ciangin tuunote in amau' tatna gamlak mun bangin tua khua sungah lopa ne ding uh a, a thau ganhingte le keelnote a siasa khuapi sungah gamta ding uh hi.
Amaute in, "I muh theih nadingin amah manlang sakin, ama nasep khawlsak ni. Israel-te' Siangtho Pa' deihna i theih theih nadingin naisakin tungsak ni!" ci-in ganhing kaih bangin khauzen tawh mawhna kai-in, khauhualpi tawh khialhna kai uh ahih manin gimna ngah ta uh hen.
A phate sia ci-in, a siate pha ci a, khuavak dingin khuamial koihin, khuamial dingin khuavak koih a, a khum dingin a kha koihin, a kha dingin a khum a koihte in gimna ngah tahen.
Amau' mitah pil kisa a, amau' muhna-ah siam a kisate in gimna ngah ta hen!
Leenggahzu tampi a dawnte, khamtheih zunek a hatte,
Tua ahih ciangin mei in buhkung keute kangtum a, meikuang sungah lopa keute a kattum bangin amaute' zung pen muatgawp ding a, amaute' pakpalhte leivui bangin vanah leengto ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Vanglian Topa ' thu nialin Israel-te' Siangtho Pa' thu a simmawh uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa ' hehna ama mite tungah hong khangin, a khut zanin amaute vatgawp a, mualte a kiling hi. Amaute' luanghawmte kongzing lampite-ah nin bangin a om hi. Hih bang teng hangin zong a hehna damzo nai loin ama khut kizanlai hi.
Amah in a gamlapi-a om minam khat a sapna-in lim khat lak a, leimong panin hong pai nadingin a sam hi. Manlang takin tua mite hong pai pah hi.
Tua a hong pai mite kuamah gim lo uh a, kuamah tuk lo uh hi. Kuamah lusu lo a, kuamah ihmu lo uh hi. Dialkaih khat zong kol lo a, khedap khau khat zong kitat lo hi.
Amau' thaltangte hiam a, a thal khempeuh uh a kikeeksa ahi hi. Amau' sakolte' khecinte meisuang bangin sak a, a leengpeite uh pingpei bangin manlang hi.
Amaute' kikona pen humpinelkai hawk bang a, humpinelkai khanglaite bangin amaute a hawk uh hi. Amaute humhamin a sa nek ding uh man uh a, amaute in puakhia-in kuamah in honkhia zo lo hi.
Tua ni ciangin amaute in tuipi ging bangin Israel ngik ding uh hi. Mi khatpeuh in hih gam sung en leh khuamial le lungzinna bek om a, meiite in khua a mialsak hi.
Kumpi Uzziah a sih kumin, a sang mahmah, a lian kumpi tokhom tungah Topa a tu ka mu hi. Ama kumpi puanpi pen biakinn sungteng a dim hi.
Ama kiimah serafim van mite a ding uh hi. Tuate in kha guk ciat nei uh hi; nih tawh a mai liahin, nih tawh a khe tuamin, nih tawh a leeng uh hi.
Amaute khatlekhat kisamin: "Vanglian Topa , siangtho, siangtho, siangtho; leitung khempeuh ama minthanna tawh kidim," ci-in awng uh hi.
Tua kikona aw in biakinn kongkhak khuam bulpite kilingsak a, inn sungteng meikhu tawh a kidim hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, "Gim ngah pa hi ta ing! Bang hang hiam cih leh a mawknapi ka hi hi; ka kama ka thugen khempeuh a mawkna vive hi a, a thugen khempeuh uh mawhna le nitna ahi mite lakah ka tengkha hi. Vanglian Topa , Kumpipa ka mukha khinta hi," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin serafim van mite khat, biakna tau panin taiteh tawh a teh mei-am khat a khutah tawi-in keima kiangah hong leeng hi.
Amah in ka muk hong bi a, "En in, hih in na muk sukha zo hi; na mawhna beita a, na khialhna kimaisak zo hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin, "Kua sawl ding a, eite a dingin kua va pai ding ahi hiam?" Topa' cihna aw ka za hi. Tua ciangin ke'n, "Hih lai-ah kei om ing! Kei hong sawl in," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Pai inla, hih mite tungah, 'Zaza napi tel lo; mumu napi thei lo,' va ci in.
Tua ciangin keimah in, " Topa aw, bang tanvei sawt ding ahi hiam?" ka ci hi. Amah in, "Khuapi-ah a teng kuamah om loin hawm suakin, innte-ah kuamah om loin, leitang pen gamkhing suak kiuhkeuhin,
Topa in gamlapi-ah mite khinkhia-in, leitungah a kinusia mun tampi a om dong, hi ding hi.
Mi sawm ah khat bang a omlai tei hangin, taak kung le tawsaw kungte a kiphuk khit ciangin a bulsum a omlaite mei tawh a kihalkik bangin amaute zong kisusia ding hi," hong ci hi. (A bulsum pen Pasian' mite a kipatthakna ding lahna lim ahi hi.)
Uzziah' tapa Jotham, Jotham' tapa Ahaz ahi Judah kumpipa' hun laitakin, Syria kumpipa Rezin le Remaliah' tapa Pekah ahi Israel kumpipa, Jerusalem khuapi a sim dingin kuanto uh a, ahih hangin amaute in zo zo lo uh hi.
"Syria-te pen Efraim mite tawh kikop," ci-in David' innkuante tungah a kigen ciangin, huih in gamlak a singte a mut bangin amah le a mihingte' lungsim kiling hi.
Topa in Isaiah tungah, "Ahaz tawh kimu dingin Puansawppa' nasepna phual zuatna lampi kiangah a om, bual tungnung tuilakna mongah nang le na tapa Shearjashub pai-in
ama tungah, 'Kidawm inla, om khinkhian in. Lau kei in. Syria kumpipa Rezin le Remaliah' tapa' hehna pen, sing tumbang nih a khute tawh kibang lel ahih manin na lung gimsak kei in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Syria kumpi a kipan Remaliah' tapa le Efraim mite in nang hong sawm uh a,
"Judah gam a sim dingin pai-in va sugawp ni; eima a dingin va zo ni; tua gamah kumpi dingin Tabeel' tapa va koih ni," ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: 'Tua thu pen kip lo ding a, hong tung lo ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Syria' lutang, Damaskas khuapi hi a, Damaskas' lutang, Rezin ahi hi. (Kum sawmguk le kum nga sungin minam ahizo nawn lo zah dongin Efraim kitamzan gawp ding hi.)
Efraim' lutang, Samaria hi a, Samaria' lutang, Remaliah' tapa ahi hi. Hih thu upna kho na neih kei leh, nang na kip kei ding hi,' va ci in," ci-in a gen hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Topa mahmah in note tungah lim khat hong pia ding hi. En un, nungak khat gai-in tapa khat nei ding a, ama min Immanuel kici ding hi.

ahi zongin tuate in nawi tampi a piakna hangin amah in bawngnawi thaukhal ne zo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh gam sungah a omlai mi khempeuh in bawngnawi thaukhal le khuaizu ne ding uh hi.

Lingkungte le lingte na kihtakna hangin tupeek tawh a kikho ngei mual neute-ah na pai ngam kei ding hi. Tua munte pen bawng khahna le tuute' gamtatna mun suak ding hi," a ci hi.

Bang hang hiam cih leh naungek in, 'Nu aw, pa aw,' a cih theih ma-in Damaskas khua' hauhna le Samaria khuasunga a om a kisut vante, Assiria kumpipa in la-in masuan ding hi," hong ci hi.

Judah gam dong hong nawtsuk ding a, dimletin paisuakin, ngawng ciang dong tum ding hi," hong ci hi. Ahih hangin Pasian in eite hong ompih a, a kizal ama khate in i gam hong hu ding hi.
No minam dangte aw, thei unla, lungkham un. Gamlapi-ah a om gamte khempeuh aw, ngai un. Kigalging un; ahih hangin lungkiatna na thuak veve ding uh hi.
Note kikhawmin thu na vaihawm uh hangin a mawkna suak ding a, thu khat peuhpeuh na gen uh hangin kip lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh kote tawh Pasian hong omkhawm hi.

"Hih mite' vaihawmna pawlpih kei un. Amau' kihtakte kihta kei unla, lau kei un.
Ahih hangin Vanglian Topa pen a siangtho-in na ngaihsun ding uh hi. Amah pen note' zahtak pa le note' kihtak pa na hisak ding uh hi.
Amah pen, a lamdang mahmahin a siangtho' luatna hangin mite' puktheihna ding suangtum tawh kibang hi. Judah le Israel kumpi gammite le Jerusalem khua-a a teng mite a awkna ding thangzak tawh kibang ding hi.
Mi tampi tak tuk ding uh hi. Amaute tukin kitamzan gawp ding uh a, amaute awkin kiman ding hi," hong ci hi.
Ka nungzuite aw, Pasian in kei tungah hong piak hih thute, limtakin kemin koihcing un.

Tua ciangin note in, " Topa in note hong hilh thute ngai un. Aisante' thu ngai kei un. Amaute' hong gen thute a kimanna om lo hi," ci-in dawng un.
Mite pen gam sungah vak kawikawi-in, nakpitakin lungkhamin gilkial ding uh hi. A gil uh a kial ciangin amaute lungham gawp ding uh a, a kumpipa uh le a Pasian uh hamsiatin vandak ding uh hi.
Amaute in leilak a etsuk hangun, lungkhamna le khuamialna, lungzinga gimna bek om hi. Khuamial ngeungau sungah amaute kihawlkhia ding hi.
Zebulun minamte le Naftali minamte' tenna gamte in mindaina thuak ngei uh a, ahi zongin mai lamah pahtawina ngahkik ding uh hi. Mediterranean tuipi a kipanin nisuahna lam Jordan gun gal, minam dangte' tenna Galilee gam sung minthang kik ding hi.

Nangmah in amaute na pungsak a, a lungdamna uh na khangsak hi. Anlak hun ciangin lungdamna le mite in vankisutte a hawm ciangun a lungdam bangun nangma mai-ah amaute lungdam uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Midian-te a kizawh ni-a bangin nangmah in amau' vangik puakna hakkol le amaute a kisatna ciangkhut na kuaihtansak a, nangma mi a bawlsia minamte na zogawp hi.

Bang hang hiam cih leh eite a dingin naungek khat hong suak a, eite' tungah tapa khat hong kipia hi. Amah pen eite hong ukpa hi ding a, ama min pen "Lamdang Thulak pa, Vanglian Pasian, Tawntung Pa, Nopsakna Kumpi," kici ding hi.

Manasseh in Efraim, Efraim in Manasseh ne-in, tua tegel in Judah langpang khawm uh hi. Hih thute khempeuh hangin ama hehna damzo nai lo a, ama khut kizanlai hi.
A cimawhte' thutang kimlai hei khiatsakin, keima mite sungah a zawngte' thuman sutkhia-in, meigong numeite' neihsa amau a' ding a suahtheihna ding le pa nei lote' neihsa amau' nek dingin a bawl theih nadingun a man lo thukhensatna pia a, nenniamna thu a gelhte in gimna ngah ta uh hen!
Gimpiak ni hun, gamlapi panin huihpi hong nun' ciangin note in bangcih ding na hi uh hiam? Huhna ngenin kua kiangah tai ding a, na neihsa uh koi lai-ah koih ding na hi uh hiam?
Thongkiate' lakah tonbucipin om ding le a kithat mite lakah sih ding bek a om hi. Hih thute khempeuh hangin ama hehna damzo nai lo a, ama khut kizanlai hi.
Assiria-te pen ka hehna mite gimpiak nadingin molhtum le ciangkhutin ka zat ahi hi.
Keima thu a ngaihsun lo minam le kei a hong hehsak mite' neihsa sutin laksakin, amaute pen konglak buannawng bangin a tuancil dingin amaute sawlin thu ka pia hi.
Ahih hangin a kumpipa in tua bang bek sawm lo a, a lungsim in zong tua bang bek ngaihsun lo hi. Ama lungsim sungah minam tampi suksiat nopna thu om hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, "Ka galkapmangte, kumpi vive hikhin hi lo ahi hiam?
Kalno khuapi pen Karkhemish khuapi tawh kibang hi lo ahi hiam? Hamath khuapi pen Arpad khuapi tawh kibang hi lo ahi hiam? Samaria khuapi pen Damaskas khuapi tawh kibang hi lo ahi hiam?

Samaria le a milimte tungah ka bawl bangin Jerusalem le a milimte tungah bawl lo ding ka hi hiam?" ci hi.
Topa in Zion Mual le Jerusalem khua-ah ama nasep dingteng a zawh khit ciangin Assiria kumpipa kiphasakin a kisialhna le a kiphatsakna hangin gim a pia ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, "Keimah in thu theihtelna nei ka hih manin keima thahatna le keima pilna tawh ka hih khin hi. Mihingte' gamgite lakhia-in amau' sumte ka sut khin a, keimah in bawngtal bangin a gammite ka sugawp hi.
Vasa bumek bangin mihingte' hauhna ka la ziau hi. A kinusia vasa tuite mite in a lak bangin leitung khempeuh ka la khin hi. A kha a zap, a kam a ka, a ham khat beek om lo hi," a ci hi.
Amah a likto pa pen molhtumin a zang ding bangkeek, sing ahi lo mipa pen ciangkhut bangin a likto ding bang keekin, phuk nadingin amah a zang pa tungah, hei, kihisak thei ding ahi hiam? Singat tem zong amah a zang pa tungah kiliansak thei ding ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin Topa, Vanglian Topa in ama mi thaute lakah natna lianpi tungsak ding a, tua natna pen amaute sungah mei bangin kuang niloh ding hi.
Israel-te' khuavak pen mei suakin, Israel-te' Siangtho Pa pen meikuang suak ding hi. Ni khat sungin ama lingkungte le lingte kangin beitum ding hi.
Gah tampi a piangsak ama leitang le ama gamlak a minthanna pen nuntakna le pumpi dong takin Topa in susia ding a, mi cina khat a si tawh kibang ding hi.
A omlai gamlak singkungte tawm mahmah ta a, naupang khat nangawn in khat khatin sim khin thei hi.
Tua ni a kipan Israel a omlaite, Jakob innkuan a suakta laite in amau a sugawp pa suang nawn loin, Topa ahi, Israel Siangtho Pa pen thuman tawh suanin nei ding uh hi.
Jakob innkuan a omlaite a vanglian Pasian kiangah ciahkik ding hi.
Na mi Israel-te, tuipi sehnel zah a phak hangin amaute tawmkhat bek hong ciahkik ding hi. Amaute' thuak dingin a kilawm bangin thu a kikhen ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa, Vanglian Topa in a thukhennasa bangin leitung khempeuhah beisiangna a bawl ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa, Vanglian Topa in thu gen a, "Zion-ah a teng ka mihingte aw, Egypt mite' hih bangin amaute in molhtum tawh hong satin a ciangkhut uh hong liik ciangin Assiria mite kihta kei un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a sawt loin note tungah ka thangpaihna bei ding a, ka hehna amaute' tung tu-in, amaute sia ding uh hi.
Vanglian Topa in Oreb suangpi-ah Midian mite a sukgawp bangin, amah in amaute tungah gimpiakna zang ding a, Egypt mite a thuaksak bangin Assiria mite thuaksak ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin na liangko panun ama vangikpi kinkhia ding a, ama hakkol pen na ngawng panun bei ding hi," a ci hi.
Rimmon gam pan galte hong kipanin Aiath khua hong tung uh a, Migron khua kantanin hong pai uh a, Mikmash khua-ah a van uh hong seng uh hi.
Amaute in mualciang kantanin Geba khua-ah zan khat giak uh hi. Rama khuamite lau-in ling uh a, Saul' tenna Gibeah khuamite a tai uh hi.
Gallim khuamite aw, nakpitakin kiko un! Laisah khuamite aw ngai un! Anathoth khuamite aw, amah dawng un!
Madmenah khuamite taikhia a, Gebim khua-a a teng mite a suakta dingin a tai uh hi.
Tuni mahmahin Nob khua-ah galte tungin khawl uh a, Zion Mual ahi Jerusalem khuapi a khuttum uh sinsan uh hi.
En un, Topa, Vanglian Topa in a kihtakhuai vangliatna tawh singhiangte heuh ding hi. A kung sangte kiphuk ding a, a kisangsakte a niamin kikoih ding hi.
Amah in tulak singte hei tawh phuk ding a, Lebanon mual a singkung liante tawh pukkhawm ding hi.
Jessi' phung sung panin a sel khat hong khangkhia ding a, a zungte panin a no khat hong khang ding hi.
Topa ' kha in ama tungah ama mite a ukna ding pilna, thutheihna, le siamna pia ding hi. Amah in Topa ' deihna thei-in Topa zahtak ding hi.
Amah in Topa ' nasep nuamsa ding hi. Amah in a tungtham bek muhna tawh thu khen lo ding a, kam lengsawn bek zakna tawh thu khentat lo ding hi.
Thumanna tawh mizawngte' thu khenin, lungsim nem mite' thu ahi bangin khensak ding hi. Ama kam panin a thupiakna tawh leitung mite gim kipia ding a, a muk panin a thugenna tawh migilote si ding uh hi.
Amah in thuman le thutak tawh ama mite uk ding hi.
Keivom pen tuuno tawh omkhawm ding a, kamkei gialbem pen keelno tawh lumkhawm ding hi. Bawngno le humpinelkai le ganhing thaute omkhawm ding uh a, naupangno khat nangawn in tuate hawlzo ding hi.
Bawngpi le vompi in an nekhawm ding uh a, amau' note lumkhawm ding uh hi. Humpinelkai in bawngtal mah bangin buhkung ne ding hi.
Nawine naungek, gul gilo' kua vangah kimawl ding a, nawine nawn lo naupang in gul gunei' bu a sawk hangin a gul in tu lo ding hi.
Ka mual siangtho buppi tungah amaute khatlekhat kiliamsak lo ding uh a, kisusia lo ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tuite in tuipi omna a tuamcip mah bangin leitungah Topa ' thu theihna kidim ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin Jessi' zung pen mihingte' tungah lim khat hi ding hi. Minamte in amah zong ding uh a, ama omna mun minthang mahmah ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin Topa in Assiria gam, Egypt gam, Pathros gam, Ethiopia gam, Elam gam, Shinar gam, Hamath gam, le tuipi gei-a gamte panin ama mi a omlaite a ngahkik nadingin a vangliatna zang kik ding hi.
Amah in minamte a dingin lim khat koih ding a, Israel mi a kihawlkhiate kaikhawmin, leitung kiu li panin Judah mi a kikhenthangte kaikhawm ding hi.
Efraim in hazatna lungsim a neihnate bei ding a, Judah mi a galbawlte kisusia ding hi. Efraim in Judah haza nawn lo ding a, Judah in zong Efraim galbawl lo ding hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in nitumna lama om Filistia mite simkhawm ding uh a, nisuahna lama om mite luhkhawm ding uh hi. Amaute in Edom mite le Moab mite zogawp ding uh a, Ammon mite in amau' thu mang ding uh hi.
Topa in ama huihsa nungsakin Nail gunpi le Eufratis gunpi tuite kangsak ding a, mi khempeuh in nuamtakin a kantan zawh ding lui neu sagih bek sitlai ding hi.
Egypt gam panin Israel-te hong paitoh ciangin amau a dingin lam lianpi khat a om mah bangin, ama mi a omlaite a dingin Assiria gam panin zong lam lianpi khat om ding hi.
Ni khat ni ciangin mite in, " Topa aw, kei tungah na heh hangin na hehna damta a, kei hong hehnem na hih manin nang tungah lungdamna kong ko ding hi.
En in, Pasian pen kei a hong honkhia pa ahi hi. Amah ka muang ding a, ka lau kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa Pasian in thahatna le vangliatna hong pia a, amah pen kei a hong honkhia pa ahi hi," a cih hun uh hong tung ding hi.
Tui siangtho in a dangtakte a lungdamsak mah bangin, Pasian' hotkhiatna in a mite lungdamsak ding hi.
Ni khat ni ciangin mite in, " Topa ' tungah lungdam ko unla, ama hong huh ding ngen un. Minam khempeuh lakah ama septe kitheisak unla, ama min kiliansak hi, ci-in gen un.
Amah in minthang takin sem khin ahih manin Topa ' tungah phatna la sa unla, leitung khempeuhah hih thu kitheisak un.
Zion-a teng mite aw, nomau' lakah Israel-te' Siangtho Pa lianin om ahih manin lungdamin awng unla, lungdamin la sa un," a cih hun uh hong tung ding hi.
Amoz' tapa Isaiah in Babylon siatna ding tawh kisai a thumuhnate:
Mualkolh tungah lim khat lakto unla, galkapte tungah nakpitakin kiko un. Miliante' kongpi-ah amaute va pai-in a sim nadingun amaute khut vaan un.
Keimah in ka tuamkoihsa mite thu pia khinin, ka hehna thu a semkhia dingin kiphatsakna tawh a lungdam ka mi thahatte ka sam khin hi.
Ngai un, mihonpi lungdam bangin mualtungte ah gamlumna! Ngai un, minamte' kumpi gamte kikhawmin a gamlumna! Vanglian Topa in galdo dingin mihon khat kaikhawm hi.
Leitung buppi a susia dingin Topa le ama hehna galhiamte gamlapi van mong panin hong pai hi.
Topa ' ni hong naita ahih manin nakpitakin kap un. Vanglianpa' kiang panin suksiatna hong tung ta ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin khut khempeuh zaw-in, mi khempeuh' lungsim tuisuak ding a, amaute lungkia ding uh hi.
Amaute in gim mahmahna le nat velvalna thuak ding uh a, numei nausuak ding bangin na sa ding uh hi. Amaute khatlekhat lamdang sakna tawh ki-en ding uh a, a maitangte un gimna mel pua ding hi.
En un, leitung gamkhing suaksakin, leitung mawhneite a susia dingin hehna le sinsona tawh nasia takin Topa ' ni hong tung ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh vantung aksite le amau' aksi honpite in khuavak piakhia lo ding hi. Ni a suahtung a kipan mial ding a, kha in zong khuavak taangkhiasak lo ding hi.
Leitung mite a tatsiatna hangun gim ka pia ding a, migilote a mawhna hangun gim ka thuaksak ding hi. Mi kihisakte' kiphatsakna beisiang sakin, a kisatheite' kiliatsakna ka niamkhiat ding hi.
Mihingte pen kham hoihte sangin a hoihzaw, minam pen Ofir gam khamte sangin a hoihzaw-in ka bawl ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka sinso ni-in Vanglian Topa ka hehna hangin vantung lausakin ka lingsak ding a, ama omna panin leitung kisingkhia ding hi.
A kidelh sanang le a cing om lo tuu bangin mi khempeuh amau' mite' lam ciatah kihei-in, amau' gam ciatah tai ding uh hi.
Amau' muhna mahah a naungekte uh leilak kidengawpna ding hi. Amaute' inn kiluhin, a zite uh kibuansak ding hi.
En un, ngun le khamte tawh a lungkim lo Media mite pen amaute a sim dingin ka hanthawn hi.
Khaldea mite' hoihna, a kiphatsakpih, kumpi gam a minthang bel Babylon khuapi pen Pasian in Sodom le Gomorrah a siatsak lai hun bang ding hi.
Khang tawntungin tua lai-ah kuamah teng lo ding a, tua lai-ah kuamah om ngei nawn lo ding hi. Arabia mite kuamah in tua lai-ah a puanbuk lam lo ding a, tuucingte kuamah in tua lai-ah a tuute lumsak lo ding hi.
Tua munah gamsate lum ding uh a, tua mun a innte pen a hawk ganhingte tawh kidim ding hi. Tua munah vasa-kalaoh golpite tengin, tua munah keeldawite laam ding uh hi.
Mihaute' inn sungah ngiate, kumpi inn nuam sungah se-alte a ham ding uh hi. Babylon khuapi a siat ding hun hong naita a, a ni sawt nawn lo ding hi.
Topa in Jakob hehpihin Israel teelkik ding a, amaute pen a gam uhah koihkik ding hi. Khual mite in amaute pawlin Jakob innkuan bel ding uh hi.
Israel mite in amaute manin amau' gamah ciahpih ding uh a, Topa' gam sungah amaute pen sila numei sila pasal dingin nei ding uh hi. Amaute a man ngei mite pen tu-in amaute in lehmat ding uh a, amaute a nengniam ngei mite tungah tu-in ukna nei ding uh hi.
A haksa nasep hong kisepsakna, gimna le lungkhamna panin Topa in note tungah tawldamna hong piak ciangin,
Babylon kumpipa tungah hih zahkona kam na zang ding uh a, "Kumpi gilo pa pukta a, amah in kuamah nengniamzo nawn lo ding!
Tawlnga loin mihingte satna-in a kizang, hehna tawh minamte ukin nakpitakin a bawlsia, migilote' ciangkhut le gam ukte' kumpi ciangkhut, Topa in kuaitan khinta hi.
Leitung khempeuh tawlnga-in gamdai takin omta uh a, amaute inla sa-in kiko uh hi.
Taksing kungte na tungah lungdamin, Lebanon mual taamtak singkungte in, 'Nang hong kiniam koih khit a kipanin kote a phuk dingin kuamah hong pai nawn kei,' ci uh hi.
"Nang na paisuk ciangin a hong dawntuah dingin Leinuai-a misite kihanthawn a, nangmah a hong hopih dingin leitungah a lian ngei misi uliante kipusuak sak hi. A minamte' kumpite khempeuh amau' kumpi tokhom panin hong ding uh hi.
Amaute in nang hong hopihin, 'Nang zong kote mah bangin na thahat kei hi. Kote mah na bangta hi,' hong ci ding uh hi.
Nangma harp lasakna awte, nangma liatna khempeuh Leinuai-ah kipaipih suk hi. Thante pen nangma delhphah hi a, thante pen nangma silh ahi hi.
"Nang Khuavak' ta, Zingsol, Babylon kumpipa aw, vantung panin nang bangci kiat na hi hiam? Minamte a niam koihpa ahi nangmah leilak dongah hong bangci kiphukpai ahi hiam?
Nang in na lungsim sungah, 'Vantungah ka kahto ding hi. A sangna mun, Pasian' aksite' tung pekah ka kumpi tokhom ka koih ding a, leilu lam peka kikhopna mualtungah ka tu ding hi.
Meiite' tung pekah ka kahto ding a, Sang Pen pa bangin ka kibawl ding hi,' na ci hi.
Ahih hangin nang pen Leinuai thuk penna Leihawm sungah hong kikoih suk ding hi.
"Nangmah hong mu mite in nang hong en gega-in, nangma thu lungngai dedu ding uh a, 'Hih mipa pen leitung a lingsak pa, kumpi gamte a lokgawp pa,
leitung pen sehnel gam suaksakin, khuapite a susiapa, thong sungah a kikhum mite inn-ah a ciahsak lopa hih pa hi lo ahi hiam?' hong ci ding uh hi.
"Minam dangte' kumpite khempeuh amau hankhuk sung ciat uhah a minthangin lum uh hi.
Ahih hangin nang pen namsau tawh a kithat misi a uihte, Suanghawmpi sunga a paisukte, khe tawh a kisikcip si luanghawmte bangin, na hankhuk pualamah hong kilawnkhia hi.
Nangmah in na gam susia-in, nangma mihingte that khin na hih manin, nang pen amaute tawh hong kivui khawm lo ding hi. Siatna a bawlpa' suanlekhakte' min kilo ngei nawn kei ta hen!
Amaute khangto loin leitung a neih loh nading le leitung maitang teng khuapite tawh a kidimsak loh nadingin amau' pate' mawhna hangin a tate' kithahna ding piang ta hen," na ci ding uh hi.
Vanglian Topa in, "Amaute' langkhatah ka pang ding a, Babylon min le a omlai mite' tate le suanlekhakte ka susia ding hi, Topa in ci hi.
Saphulipte' om nadingin tua khuapi bawlin, bualtui ka suaksak ding a, siatna munphiah tawh ka phiatkhia siang ding hi," Vanglian Topa in ci hi.
Vanglian Topa kiciam khin a, "Ka geelsa bangin piang ding a, ka ngimnasa bangin kip ding hi.
Keimah in ka gam sungah Assiria mite ka susia ding a, ka mual tungah ka sikcip ding hi. Ka mite' tung panin Assiria-te' hakkol amaute' liangko panin Assiria-te' vangik kiakhia ding hi," a ci hi.
Hih ngimna pen leitung buppi a dingin a kingim ahi hi. Hih ka khut pen minam khempeuh gimpiak nadingin a kizan ahi hi.
Vanglian Topa in ngim khin ahih manin kua in phiatzo ding ahi hiam? Ama khut kizan khin ahih manin kua in kaiton kikzo ding ahi hiam?
Kumpi Ahaz a sih kumin thu hong tung a,
"Filistia mi khempeuh aw, note hong kisatna ciangkhut a kitan manin lungdam kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh singbul panin a sel a om bangin, gulpi a sih khit ciangin a siahuaizaw gul gunei hong om ding a, tuate pen a leng thei gulpi hong hi ding uh hi.
Mizawngte in keima gankhahna sungah an ne ding uh a, a cimawhte lungnuam takin lum hithiat ding uh hi. Ahih hangin no Filistia mite, kialpi tawh kong that ding a, a suaktakha a omlaite keimah in ka that ding hi.
"Filistia khuapi kongpite aw, nakpitakin kap un; khuapite aw, kiko un. Filistia mi khempeuh aw, lau-in ling un! Bang hang hiam cih leh leilu lam panin galkap honte' hong paina leivui khu hong kitung a, tua galkapte a meidawi khat beek om lo hi," hong ci hi.
Filistia mite in a hong sawl kamtaite mi khatpeuh in bangci dawn ding ahi hiam? " Topa in Zion kipsak khin a, gimna a thuak ama mite in tua sungah bukna mu uh hi," ci-in a dawng ding uh hi.
Moab gam tawh kisai thu: Zan khat thu-in Ar khua kisiasak ahih manin Moab gam a bei hi. Zan khat thu-in Kir khua kisiasak ahih manin Moab gam a beita ahi hi.
A sangna munte-ah a kap dingin Dibon khuamite paito uh hi. Nebo le Medeba khuate' hangin Moab mite nakpitakin kap uh hi. Dahna limin lu khempeuh kimettol a, khamul khempeuh zong kimetmai hi.
Kongzing lakah amaute in puanhampi silh uh hi. Innkhumzang le kongzing lampi kituahnate-ah mi khempeuh nakpi-in kapin khitui tawh a kawt uh hi.
Heshbon khua le Elealeh khua kiko uh a, amau' kahna awging Jahaz khua dongah kiza hi. Tua ahih ciangin Moab mi galhiam tawite lau-in nakpitakin kiko uh a, amaute a ling uh hi.
Moab gam adingin ka lungsim kiko hi. A galtai ama mite Zoar khua le Eglathshelishiah khuate-ah a tai uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Luhith lampi-ah amaute a kapsa-in paito uh hi. Horonaim khua zuatna lampi-ah amaute in siatna a thuakna uh hangin nakpi-in kiko uh hi.
Nimrim luite kang hi. Lopa keu-in a selthak om lo a, lopa hing om nawn lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in a ngahsa uh le a kholsa uh na tampite pua-in Gialhek Lui-ah a paipih uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Moab gam kiim khempeuhah kahna aw a ging hi. Kahna in Eglaim khua ban a, kahna in Beerelim khua zong a ban hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Dibon luituite sisan tawh kidim hi. Ahi zongin Dibon khua in a thuak ding a nasiazaw omlai a, Moab gam panin a suakta mi le gam sungah a omlai mite khempeuh kithat gawp ding hi.
Moab mite in Jerusalem-a om gam ukpa tungah sehnel gam Sela khua panin tuunote a puak uh hi.
A bu a kipaih khiatsak ciangin a cih nading thei loin a leng kawikawi vasate bangin Arnon guntui ngahmunah Moab mite om uh hi.
Amaute in Judah mite kiangah, "Kote tungah thuhoih hong lak unla, thutangin hong gamta un. Sunkim laitak a singliim bangin kote hong liah un. A kihawlkhia kote hong seel unla, galtai kote hong heek kei un.
A kihawlkhia ko Moab mite note lakah hong tengsak unla, kote hong susiate' kiang panin kote' belh hong hi un. A nengniam pa om nawn loin siatna hun beita a, a khe tawh a sik mipa gam sung panin a manthan ciangin,
itna kip tawh kumpi tokhom khat kiphut ding a, thuman sep ding a manlang, thutang zongin thu a khen mipa pen David' buk sunga om tua tokhom tungah thuman tawh tu ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Judah mite in, "Moab' kiphatsakna thu i za khinta hi. Amah kiphasak mahmah hi. A kiliatsakna, a kiphatsakna, a kihihsakna, ama kisialhnate khempeuh a mawkna ahi hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a thuakna uh hangin Moab mite kap hen la, mi khempeuh zong Moab mite' hangin kap ta uh hen. Nakpi takin gimna a thuak laitakun Kirhareseth khua-ah a anlim nekte uh a phawkkhak uh ciangin khasia-in a kap uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a hiang zaai-in tuipi kantan a, Jazer khua banin sehnel gam dongah a zaam ama hiangte, minam dangte' tote in sattan ahih manin Heshbon lolaite le Sibmah leengguite vul ta uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Jazer khua mite a kah bangin Sibmah leengguite' hangin kei ka kap hi. Heshbon le Elealeh khuamite aw, ka khitui tawh note kong kawtsak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh galkidona in note' singgah le ante hong banzo hi.
An tampi a pian' ngeina lolai-ah lungdamna le nuamna om nawn lo hi. Leenggui lote-ah lasakna om lo a, lungdam a kikona om nawn lo hi. Leenggah cilna-ah kuamah in leengtui suk nawn lo a, leenggah lawh cianga kikona aw kidaisak ta hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moab gam hangin laiza lasakna bangin ka lungsim kisat gaihgaih a, Kirhareseth khuapi hangin kei mahmah zong ka kisat gaihgaih hi.
Hih bang thu pen Topa in a beisa hun lai-in Moab tawh kisai-in a gensa thu ahi hi.
Ahih hangin tu-in Topa in, "Nasem dingin a kicial kum hunte sung bangin, kum thum sungin, ama mihon tampite om taseleh Moab' minthanna in simmawhna thuak ding a, a suakta lai mite pen tawm mahmahin, thaneem ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Damaskas tawh kisai thu hih bangin gen hi: En un, Damaskas pen khuapi hi nawn loin ninbulomtang suak ding hi.
Ama khuapite kinusiacip paisuak ding hi. Tuuhonte' omna mun suak ding a, tua tuuhonte lum hithiatin bangmah in lausak lo ding hi.
Efraim gam panin kulhpi bei-in, Damaskas khua panin kumpi gam mangthang ding hi. Syria mi a suakta laite pen Israel mite mah bangin mindai ding uh hi, Vanglian Topa in ci hi.
Tua ni ciangin Jakob' liatna bei ding a, ama hauhna khempeuh mangthang ding hi.
An a la mi in ankung ding laite kaikhawmin ante a kilak khit ciangin leitang a hawm guakin a om tawh kibang ding a, mi khat in Refaim Kuam sungah ansang a kaihkhop khit ciangin lolai a hawm guakin a om tawh zong kibang ding hi.
Oliv kung a kisin' khit ciangin a hiang sangpen dawnah pum nih pum thum singkung hiang dawnah pum li pum nga a omlai tawh kibang lel ding hi, Israel-te' Topa Pasian in ci hi.
Amaute in amau khut tawh a bawlsa uh biakna taute don lo ding uh a, amau' bawlsa Asherah milimte hitaleh paknamtui halna biakna taute hitaleh muanin nei nawn lo ding uh hi.
Tua ni ciangin amau' khuapi muanhuaite pen Hiv mite le Amor mite in Israel mite' hangin a nusiat uh munte tawh kibang ding a, gamkhing a suak ding hi.
Nomau hong honkhia Pasian note in mangngilhin, nomau' belh Suangpi phawk lo na hih manun note in biakna huan bawlin kung hoihte suan a, kung namdangte tawh pehin,
tuate na suan ni mahun thakhatin khang a, na tuh ni uh a zing ciang mahin a hong pak hangin note in a gah na lokha kei ding uh hi. Gimna le lungkhamna hong tun ni-in tuate maimang ding hi.
Tui lianpi a ging bangin minamte awng uh hi. Ahih hangin amah in amaute tai ding a, gamlapi pekah amaute taikhia ding uh hi. Mualtung a huih mai-ah ansi leeng bang leh huihpi mai-a pingpei bangin leengkhia mang ding uh hi.
