"Assiria pen mihing' namsau ahi lo, namsau khat tawh puk ding a, mihing' namsau ahi lo, namsau khat in susia ding hi. Namsau panin tai ding uh a, a tangvalte uh zawhthawh thu tawh nasem dingin kikoih ding hi.
Amau' belh a kumpipa uh a launa hangin tai ding a, buaina hangin a uliante in a dialkhai uh taisan ding uh hi," ama meikuang Zion-ah a om, ama meikhuk Jerusalem khua-ah a om Topa in ci hi.
En un, ni khat ni ciangin thuman takin kumpi khat in hong uk ding a, uliante in thutang tawh hong uk ding uh hi.
Amaute pen huihpi panin belhna, guahpi panin bukna bang ding uh hi. Sehnel gam sungah a luang tui bang ding uh a, nisa gam sungah a om suangpi liim bang ding uh hi.
Amaute lungtomin hi phangphang nawn lo ding uh a, deihsakna lungsim tawh a kitel takin thu gen hiathiat ding uh hi.
Mihaite pen mi thupi kici nawn lo ding a, mi ginalote pen mi zahtakhuai kici nawn lo ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh mihai in haina thu gen a, a hoihin gamtat loh ding, Topa ' thu a hoih lopi-in gen ding, a gilkialte' an duhna a phat loh nading le a dangtakte in tui dawn ding a neih theih loh nadingin, ama lungsim in mawhna bawl ding a sawm hi.
Mi ginalo' ginat lohna siahuai mahmah hi. Zuauna kam tawh mizawngte a siasak ding le mi cimawhte' thu a thuman ciang nangawnin a siasak dingin amah in gitloh nasepna a bawl hi.
Ahih hangin mipi lungsim a nei mi in na a hoihte geel a, thuhoih nate-ah a pang hi.
Nuamtakin a om hithiat numeite aw, tho unla, ka aw za un. Nomau' tumtakin a lungkim tanute aw, ka thugenna na ngai un.
Nomau' tumtakin a lungkim numeite aw, kum khat val zek khit ciangin na linglawng ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh leenggah kum hong sia ding a, singgah lawhna hun hong tung lo ding hi.
Nuamtakin a om hithiat numeite aw, ling un. Nomau tumtakin a lungkimte aw, linglawng un. Na puan uh hawkkhia-in na tangguakun om unla na kawng uhah puanhampi teng un.
A hoih mahmah lote le tampi a gah leengguite a siatna, keima mite' leitangah ling le lingkungte a pona, lungdamna khuapi sungah lungdamna a omna innte a siatna hangin dahin na dip uh hum un.
Kumpi innte kinusia-in, mi tampi a omna kumpi khuapi kilawi ding hi. Mual le tausangte zong kisiagawp ding a, late le tuuhonte in gamtatna munin nei ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in ama kha hong puak ding hi. Leitang siate lei hoih suakkik ding a, lo-a ante hoih mahmahin tulak bang ding hi.
Tua ciangin gam sung mun khempeuhah thutang om ding a, thu a manin kisem ding hi.
Tua ciangin thumanna hangin nopna om ding a, thumanna hangin daihna le lungmuan tawntungna om ding hi.
Ka mihingte pen kilem takin a tenna, lungmuang takin a omna, daitakin a tawlngakna munah om ding uh hi.
(Tua ciangin tulak kolhsiang ding a, a khuapi pen cimzan ding hi.)
Tui tampi a omna-ah khai tuh a, bawngtal le late a ut utna-ah a tasak note pen mi nuamsa na hi uh hi.
Hong kisusia nai lo, mi a susiapa aw, tu-in gimna a ngah ding na hita hi. Kuamah in hong khem nai loh, mi khem pa aw, tu-in gimna a ngah ding na hita hi. Na suksiat nawn loh ciangin nang hong kisusia ding a, na khem nawn loh ciangin nang hong kikhem ding hi.
Topa aw, kote hong hehpih in; nang kong muang uh hi. A tawntungin kote hong hu inla, lungkham hunin hong honkhia in.
Nangma vanging hangin mite tai uh a, nangma thawhtohna hangin minamte kithehthang hi.
Tangngol in na a khop bangin amau van kinusiate kaikhawm a, kauphe honpi bangin van tawmin mite phe zaizai hi.
A sangna munah teng ahih manin Topa kipahtawi hi. Amah in thutang le thuman tawh Jerusalem dimsak ding hi.
Amah pen nangma hunte a kipna, hotkhiatna a kicinna, pilna le theihna hi ding hi. Topa kihtakna pen ama sumgum hi ding hi.
En un, galhangte huhna ngenin kiko uh a, kilemna ding palai semte nakpitakin kap uh hi.
Lam lianpite gambulak suak a, kuamah khualzinin pai ngam nawn lo uh hi. Thuciamnate kipeksatin, thukimnasate kipalsat a, khatlekhat kizahtakna om nawn lo hi.
Leitang kinusiacipin om mawk hi. Lebanon muala tulak singte vulgawp a, Sharon gam lei hoihpen sehnel gam bang ta hi. Bashan le Karmel muala singtehte pulhmang khinta hi.
Topa in minam dangte kiangah, "Tu-in ka gamtang ding a, ka vangliatna ka lak ding hi. Tu-in kei hong kipahtawi ta ding hi.
Na geelnate uh a kimanna om lo a, na nasepnate uh a mawkna ahi hi. No le no a kisusia na hi uh hi.
Leikang ngah nadingin suangkang a kihal bangin na vui suak ding uh a, meikhuk sunga a kihaltum lingkungte na bang ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Gamlapi-a a om mite aw, ka sepna thu za un. A nai-a a om mite aw, ka vangliatna thei un.
Zion-a a om mawhnei mite lau uh a, Pasian' thu a ngaihsun lo mite lau-in lingcip uh hi. Amaute in, "Pasian' thukhenna pen a kuang tawntung mei tawh kibang hi. Tua bang meikuang kua in thuakzo ding ahi hiam?" ci uh hi.
Thumanin gamta-in thutang na gen uhleh na suakta ding uh hi. Na vangliatna uh mizawngte khemna-in zang kei unla, sumgolh deih kei un. Mi thah ding le siatna gamtat ding a vaihawmte tawh kipawl kei un.
Tua hileh na tangtung ding uh a, kulh muanhuai mahmah sungah a om bangin lungnuam takin na om ding uh hi. Annek tuidawn na kitasam kei ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin a thupi mahmah kumpipa na mu ding uh a, a zai mahmah a gam zong na en ding uh hi.
Nidangin na kihtak uh gamdangmi siahdongte, siahkhawmte, thukan mite, na phawk nawn kei ding uh hi.
Na theihtheih loh uh, a kitel lo kampau a zang, na teltheih lohun a pau bualbual, mi kihisakte na mu nawn kei ding uh hi.
Pawite i bawlna khuapi Zion en un! Daitakin a kitenna mun, a khetphimte kidokkhia ngei loin a khaute a tat ngei lo, a kikhin thei het lo puanbuk a bang, Jerusalem khuapi, na mu ding uh hi.
Tua khua sungah Topa in ama minthanna vang hong langsak ding a, a zai gunte le a zai lui geite-ah i teng ding hi. Tua tuite tungah ei hong do ding gal gunkuang hong kihot nawn lo ding a, gal teembaw zong hong pai nawn lo ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa pen eite' thukhen, Topa pen eite hong ukpa, Topa pen eite' kumpi ahi hi. Amah in eite hong honkhia ding hi.
Gal teembaw khaute kol a, ama omna ding mun sanah gunkuang puan khuam lenkip zo lo a, gunkuang puan kizal thei lo hi. Tua ciangin galte' neihsate kihawmkeek ding a, khebaite nangawn in van ngah ding uh hi.
I gamah a teng mite kuamah in, "Ka ci na hi," ci nawn lo ding uh a, mawhna khempeuh kimaisak ding hi.
Minam khempeuhte aw, thu za dingin hong pai un. Mihingte aw, hong ngai un! Leitang le a tungah a om khempeuhte aw, ngai un. Leitung buppi le a tung panin a hong pai mi khempeuh in ngai un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh minam khempeuh tungah Topa lunghamin, amaute khempeuh tungah heh mahmah a, a simang dingin amaute koihin, thah dingin a pia khinta hi.
A kithat amau' mite kilawnkhia ding a, a siluang hawmte uih semsem ding hi. Amau' sisan in mual khempeuh sansak ding hi.
Vantunga a om khempeuh muatmang ding a, laidal bangin vantungte kizial ding hi. Leenggui panin a tehte pulhin, theikung panin a tehte a pulh bangin aksi hon khempeuh pulh ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka namsau in vantungah a sep ding khempeuh a zawh khit ciangin, en un, a siamang dinga ka sehsa Edom mite tungah thu a khen dingin hong kumsuk ding hi.
Topa in namsau khat nei hi. Sisan tawh kidim ding a, biakpiakna tuuno si le keel si, tuutalte' kal thau tawh a kizolsak bang ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Bozrah khua-ah hih biakpiakna nei ding a, Edom gamah hih bang tampi thahna omsak ding hi.
Gamsial talte amaute tawh tukkhawm ding a, bawngtalno gehsate le bawngtal hatte tukkhawm ding hi. Amau' gam pen sisan tawh kidiah ding a, amau' leitang pen sathau in nipsak ding hi.
Topa in Zion a hotkhiat ding, a galte a thuksak ding hun khat a nei hi.
Luitui khempeuh kultaltui suak ding a, leitang pen kaat suak ding hi. Gam sung khempeuh pen a kuang kultaltui a suak ding hi.
Ahih hangin mu le sakuh in gam sung teng luah ding uh a, keising le va-akte om ding uh hi. Tua gam pen gamsimtham suakin, hawmsuak ding hi.
Kumpi om lo Gam, ci-in amaute in min phuak ding uh a, a ulian khempeuhte a mawkna hi ding uh hi.
Kumpi inn liante sungah lingkung po ding a, kulh a nei khua sungah laho le thangling kungte a po ding hi. Ngiate' an zonna mun suakin, vasa-kalaohte' omna mun hi ding hi.
Sangak le ngiate kikhawl ding uh a, keeldawi in a lawmte sam ding hi. Dawi zong hong tuaksukin ama omna ding mun a zong ding hi.
Tua munah keising in bu tomin, tua lai-ah tui-in keuh ding a, ama liimah a note huai ding hi. Musite zong kikhawm tuahin a nupa ciat un om ding uh hi.
Topa ' laibu sung panin zong unla hih thu sim un. Hih ganhingte khempeuh khat beek zong mangthang lo ding a, lawm sam khat zong om lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in thu pia khinzo a, amahmah in amaute kaikhawm ding hi.
Amah in amaute a dingin leitang hawmsak ding a, amau' tanh ding ciat a pia ding hi. Amaute in tua gam nei tawntung ding uh a, khang khat pan khang khat dongin teng paisuak ding uh hi.
Gamlak le lei keuna gam lungdam ding a, sehnel gam lungdamin palhkhia ding hi. Unok pak bangin
tampi takin palhkhia ding a, lungnopna le lasakna tawh lungdam ding hi. Lebanon mual a minthanna, Karmel mual le Sharon mual a minliatna tua leitang in ngah ding hi. Mi khempeuh in Topa ' minthanna, i Pasian' liatna mu ding uh hi.
A zaw khutte khauhsak unla, a no khukte kipsak un.
Lungsim patau-in, a lauthawng mite kiangah, "Thakhauh un, lau kei un! En un, na galte uh tungah phu hong laksak dingin Pasian hong pai ding a, amah in note hong honkhia ding hi," ci un.
Tua ciangin khebai mipa diangin lam ding a, a pau thei lo mipa in lungdamin la sa ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh gamlakah tui hong phulkhia ding a, sehnel gam sungah luitui hong luang ding hi.
A sa mahmah sehnelte bualtui hong suak ding a, a keugaw leitang pen ciktui tawh hong kidim ding hi. Ngiate' omna ngei leitang pen nawngpi suakin, lopa, pumpeeng, le mau, a po ding hi.
Tua lai-ah lam lianpi khat om ding a, Lampi Siangtho kici ding hi. A siang lo mite in tua tung tawn ngei lo ding a, mihaite in tua lam a zui mite khialsak nawn lo ding hi.
Tua lai-ah humpinelkai om lo ding a, sasialne ganhing khat peuhpeuh hong pai lo ding hi. Tua lai-ah ganhing lauhuaite kimu lo ding hi. Topa ' hotkhiatsa mite in tua lampi tawnin hong ciah ding uh hi.
Topa ' hotkhiatsa mite hong ciahkikin, lungdam tawntungna mai pua-in la sa kawmin Jerusalem-ah hong tung ding uh hi. Amaute in lungdamna le kipakna ngah ding uh a, dahna le khuisatna om nawn lo ding hi.
Kumpi Hezekiah in a uk zawh kum sawmli le ngana kumin Assiria kumpipa Sennakherib in Judah gam sunga khuapi muanhuai khempeuh simin a la hi.
Lakhish khua panin Assiria kumpipa in Jerusalem khua-a kumpi Hezekiah a lut ding a gen dingin ama nuai-a ulian khat le galkap honpi a sawl hi. Puansawppa' nasepna phual zuatna lampi-a bual tungnung tui lampi gei-ah a ulianpa a khawl hi.
Tua ciangin amah tawh a kimu dingin Hilkiah' tapa ahi kumpi innsung a saipa Eliakim le lai-at pa Shebna, le Asaf' tapa ahi thuciamteh pa Joah hong paikhia uh hi.
Tua ciangin a ulianpa in amaute kiangah a genna panin, "Hezekiah kiangah, 'Kumpi lian ahi Assiria kumpipa in hih bangin ci hi: Hih na lungmuanna uhah bang siksan na hi uh hiam?
Kampau lel pen galdo nadingin vaihawmna le vangin ngaihsun na hi uh hiam? Kei nong lehdo nadingun kua suang na hi uh hiam?
En un, ama tunga a kingam mipa' khut a sun ding, a kikuaitansa pumpeeng ciangkhut tawh a kibang Egypt na suang uh hi. Amah a muang khempeuhte' tungah Egypt kumpipa Faro, tua pumpeeng bang hi lel hi.
Ahih hangin note in, " Topa ka Pasian uh ka suang uh hi," a ci-a kinei na hih uhleh ama mun sangte le biakna taute Hezekiah in lakhia-in, Judah le Jerusalem tungah, "Hih biakna tau mai-ah na bia ding uh hi," ci hi lo ahi hiam?
Tu-in hong pai unla, ka topa Assiria kumpipa tawh kiciamna khat bawl un. A tungah a tuang ding mi na ngahzawh nak-uhleh sakol tulnih kong pia ding hi.
Egypt mite' leengte le sakol galkapte muanna tawh ka topa' nasemte lak panin a neupen khat ahi galkapmang khat bek nangawn bangci-in notzo ding na hi uh hiam?
Tua tham loin, hih gam a susia dingin Topa ' thu loin hong pai ka hi hiam? Topa in kei kiangah, "Paito-in hih gam sim inla, susia in," hong ci hi,' ci-in gen un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Eliakim, Shebna, le Joah in a ulianpa kiangah, "Kote in thei ngawn ka hih manun na nasemte tungah Aram pau tawh hong gen hoh in. Kulh tunga om mite' zakna-ah Judah pau tawh thu nong gen loh nadingin kong thum hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin a ulianpa in, "Hih thute na topa uh le note' tung bekah gen ding a, amau' ek mah ne-in amau' zun mah dawnin note tawh a siakhawm ding kulh tunga a tu mite tungah a gen lo dingin ka topa in hong sawl sa na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a ulianpa dingto-in, Judah pau-in nakpitakin kiko a, "Assiria kumpi, kumpi lianpa' thu za un!
" Topa in eite hong honkhia taktak ding a, hih khuapi pen Assiria kumpipa khut sungah kipia lo ding hi," ci-in Hezekiah in hong genna tawh na Topa uh muangkha kei un.
Hezekiah' thu ngai kei un; bang hang hiam cih leh Assiria kumpipa in hih bangin ci hi: Kei tawh kilemna hong bawl unla kei kiangah hong pai un. Tua hileh kei hong pai-in, note' gam tawh a kibang gam khat, an le leenggahzu gamah kong koih matengin note khempeuh in nomau' leenggah ciat, nomau' theigah ciat, na tuikhuk panun nomau tui ciat na ne ding uh hi.
Hezekiah in, " Topa in eite hong honkhia ding hi," ci-in lam hong khialsak kha ding ahih ciangin kidawm un. Assiria kumpipa' khutsung panin minam dangte' pasian khatpeuh in ama gam honkhiazo ngei ahi hiam?
Hamath gam le Arpad gam pasian-te koi-ah om ahi hiam? Sefarvaim gam pasian-te koi-ah om ahi hiam? Amaute in ka khutsung panin Samaria honkhiazo ahi hiam?
Topa in ka khutsung panin Jerusalem khua a hotkhiat nadingin, hih gamte khempeuh' pasian lakah kua in ka khutsung panin a gam uh honkhiazo ahi hiam?' ci hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in, "Dawng kei un," ci-in thu piakhol ahih manin amaute daitakin om uh a, kam khat beek dawng lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Hilkiah' tapa ahi kumpi innsung a sai Eliakim, lai-at Shebna le Asaf' tapa ahi thuciamteh pa Joah in a puan uh balkekin Hezekiah kiangah pai uh a, a ulianpa' thugen teng a va gen uh hi.
Kumpi Hezekiah in a zak ciangin dahin ama puante balkek a, Topa ' inn sungah a pai hi.
Tua ciangin amah in innsung saipa Eliakim, lai-at pa Shebna, le siampi khangham teng dahna limin puanhampi silh kawmin Amoz' tapa kamsangpa Isaiah kiangah a sawl hi.
Amaute in Isaiah kiangah, "Hezekiah in, 'Tuni pen lungkham ni, tai ngah ni, mindai ni ahi hi. Naungek a suah hun tung napi-in a hingkhia zo lo nupi tawh i kibang hi.
A nungta Pasian a zahko dingin ama topa, Assiria kumpipa in a sawl a ulianpa' thugente, Topa na Pasian in za hen la, tua bang thu a gente gim pia tahen. Tua ahih ciangin a omlai i mite a dingin thu ngen in,' ci hi," ci-in a gen uh hi.
Kumpi Hezekiah' nasemte Isaiah kiangah a tun uh ciangin
Isaiah in amaute tungah, "Na topa uh kiangah, ' Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Assiria kumpipa' nasemte in keimah a hong simmawhna na zaksa uh thute hangin lau kei un.
En un, amah in kam lengsawn khat za-in ama gamah a ciahkikna ding lungsim ka guan ding a, ama gam sungah namsau tawh amah ka tuksak ding hi,' ci-in gen un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a ulianpa ciahkik a, Assiria kumpipa in Libnah khua a simna-ah a va pai hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa in Lakhish khua a nusiat khitna thu zazo ahih manin tua lai a va zuanpah ahi hi.
Tu-in, Ethiopia kumpi Tirhakah in Assiria gam a sim dingin Egypt galkap honpi tawh a hong kuanna thu Assiria mite in a za uh hi. Hih thu a zak ciangin Assiria kumpipa in Hezekiah kiangah kamtaite sawl a,
"Judah kumpi Hezekiah kiangah hih bangin gen un: 'Assiria kumpipa' khut sungah Jerusalem kipia lo ding hi, ci-a thu hong ciam na suan Pasian' khemsa-in om kei in.
En in, Assiria kumpite in gam khempeuhah a bawlna, a suksiatmang khitna na zazo hi. Nang hong kisuaktasak tuan ding ahi hiam?
Ka pu ka pate un a suksiat minamte, Gozan minam, Haran minam, Rezef minamte, le Telassar khua-a om Eden mite pen amau' pasian-te in honkhiazo ahi hiam?
Hezekiah in kamtaite tung panin a lai puak uh sangin, a lai a sim hi. Topa ' inn-ah Hezekiah paito-in, Topa ' mai-ah a lai a zal hi.
Hezekiah in Topa ' tungah thu ngenin,
"Vanglian Topa , Israel-te' Pasian, Kherub-te tunga a tupa aw, nangmah bek, leitung kumpi gam khempeuhte' Pasian na hi hi. Nangmah in vantung le leitung na bawl khin hi.
Topa aw, Assiria kumpite in mi khempeuh le a gam khempeuh susiamang khin taktak a,
amaute' pasian-te pen meikhuk sungah paihsak khin hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tuate pen pasian hi loin mite' khut tawh a kibawl sing le suangte ahi uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin tuate kisusia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa kote' Pasian aw, nang bek Topa na hihna thu leitung kumpi gam khempeuh in a theih nadingin, tu-in ama khutsung panin kote hong honkhia in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Amoz' tapa Isaiah in Hezekiah tungah thu puak a, "Israel-te' Pasian, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Nang in Assiria kumpipa Sennakherib tawh kisai thu, kei kiangah thu hong ngen khin na hih ciangin,
amah tawh kisai-in Topa ' thugen hih bang ahi hi: 'Sennakherib aw, Jerusalem mite in nang hong simmawhin hong zahko uh hi. Jerusalem mite in na nungah a lu hong peisan lel uh hi.
Nang in kua zahko-in kua a simmawh na hi hiam? Nang in kua' tungah na aw sangsakin kiphasak na hi hiam? Israel-te' Siangtho Pa, kei' tungah a hong tuaci na hi hi.
Nangmah in na nasempa zangin Topa na zahko a, Lebanon mual dong pek, mual sangte tungah ka leeng tampite tawh ka pai khin hi. Taamtak sing a sangpente, taksing hoihpente ka phuk khin hi. A sangpen mun, tulak a thukpenna munah ka pai khin hi.
Tuikhuk to-in tui ka dawn a, Egypt luituite khempeuh ka galkapte' khenuai tawh ka keusak hi, na ci hi.
"'Sawt pek a kipan ka ngaihsutsa ahih lamtak za ngei nai lo na hi hiam? Nang in khuapi muanhuaite susia gawpin ninbulomtang na suahsakna ding, a sunga teng mite a thahatna uh bei-in, lungkia-in a ommawkna ding, amaute pen lolai-a om kungnote le lopa ngeekte, innkhum zangah a po, a khankhit ma-in a keutum lopate tawh a kibatna ding, tu-in ka tunsak ding thute pen tanglai pek panin ka ngaihsutsa thu ahi hi.
"'Na omna mun, na vaksuk na vaktohna le keima tungah na hehna ka thei hi.
Keima tungah nang hehin, na kiphatsakna thu keima tungah a thu hong tung ahih manin, na nakah sikkawi bulhin, na kamah kamkaih hong bulhin, nong kuanna lampi lam mahah nang kong ciahkiksak ding hi,' ci hi.
"Nang Hezekiah a dingin hih in lim hong hi ding hi: Tu kumin anli pote na ne ding uh a, a kum nihna ciangin tua bangmahin a pote na ne leuleu ding uh hi. A kum thumna ciangin khai tuhin an na la ding uh a, leenggui suanin a gah na ne ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin, Judah minam sung panin a suaktalai mite in singkung bangin zung khasuk kikin, gah na gahto kik ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a omlaite, Jerusalem pan ahi zongin a suakta teng, Zion Mual panin ahi zongin paikhia ding uh hi. Vanglian Topa ' deihluatna in hih thu hong tungsak ding hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Assiria kumpipa tawh kisai-in Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Hih khuapi sungah amah hong pai lo ding a, thaltang zong lawn lo ding hi. Lum tawh hong pai lo ding a, galsimna ding panmun zong hong bawl lo ding hi.
Hong kuanna lampi mahah amah ciahkik ding a, hih khuapi sungah hong pai lo ding hi, Topa in ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah le ka nasempa David ka khualna-in hih khuapi a suahtak nadingin ka hu ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa ' vantungmi kuankhia-in Assiria mite' giahphual ah mihing tul za le tul sawmgiat le tulnga a that hi. Zingsangin mite a thawh ciangin hihte khempeuh misi luang bekbek na hi hi.
Tua ciangin Assiria kumpipa Sennakherib taikhia a, a inn-ah ciahin Nineveh khua-ah a teng hi.
Amah in ama pasian Nisrok inn-ah bia-in a om laitakin, ama tate Adrammelek le Sharezer in namsau tawh amah that uh a, Ararat gamah a tai uh hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Esarhaddon in ama tangin a uk hi.
Tua hun laitakin Hezekiah a ci na-in si dektak hi. Amoz' tapa, kamsang Isaiah ama kiangah hong pai-in, " Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Na innsung thu ding vaihawm in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang na damkikzo kei ding a, na si ding hi, hong ci hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Tua ciangin Hezekiah kawm lam nga-in Topa ' tungah thu ngen a,
" Topa aw, ka lungsim khempeuh le thuman tak tawh nangma mai-ah gamta-in, nangma muhna-ah a hoih nate ka sepna thu, tu-in nong phawk nadingin kong thum hi," a ci hi. Hezekiah nakpitakin a kap hi.
Tua ciangin Isaiah tungah Topa ' thu hong tung a,
"Pai inla Hezekiah kiangah gen in. Topa , na pa David' Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: Na thungetna ka za khin a, na khitui ka mu khin hi. Tua ahih ciangin na nuntakna kum sawm le kum nga kong piak beh ding hi.
Assiria kumpipa' khutsung panin nang le khuapi kong honkhia ding a, hih khuapi ka hu ding hi, ci hi," a ci hi.
Isaiah in, "Amah in hong ciamsa thu Topa in hong bawl nadingin, hih pen Topa' tung panin nangma a dingin lim ahi hi:
En in, Ahaz kumpipa' ni-nai tungah nitum kuana liim pen kal sawm ka nungkiksak ding hi, ci hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin a tum khinsa ni pen ni-nai tungah kal sawm a nungkik hi.
Judah kumpipa Hezekiah a ci na-in, a natna panin a damkik khit ciangin la phuakin a gelh lai in:
Ka hat saan laitakin a si ding ka hita a, ka hun omlai khempeuh Leinuai-ah a om dingin hong kiseh hita hi, ka ci hi.
A hingte' gam sungah Topa ka mu nawn kei ding a, leitung a a teng mite' lakah mihing ka en nawn kei ding hi, ka ci hi.
Tuucingpa' puanbuk bangin ka omna inn kibotkhia-in kei kiang panin kilakhia hi. Siamgante in a hial bangin ka nuntakna kihial khin a, amah in siambu panin kei hong atkhia hi. Sun le zan tawntung gimna hong kithuaksak a,
zingsang dong huhna ngenin ka kiko hi. Humpinelkai bangin amah in ka guh khempeuh hong kuaihtansak a, sun le zan tawntung gimna hong kithuaksak hi.
Phialphiah ahi a, gun vapi bangin ahi zongin ka hamham a, vakhu bangin ka tautau hi. Vantung lam kong etetna-in ka mitte a gim hi. Topa aw, kei hong kinengniam hi; keima lungmuanna hong hi ta in!
Ahih hangin keimah in bang gen thei ding ka hi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in kei tungah hong gen khin a, amahmah in hih thu hong bawl hi. Ka lung gim lua a, ka ihmu thei kei hi.
Topa aw, nang a dingin kong nungta ding a, nang a' ding bekbekin kong nungta ding hi. Ka ci hong damsakkik inla, hong nungtasak in!
Gimna lianpi ka thuakna pen keima lungnopna hong suak ding hi. Lauhuaina khempeuh panin kei nong honkhia a, ka mawhna khempeuh na hong maisak hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Leinuai-ah a om mite in nangma tungah lungdamna hong ko thei lo a, a sisa mite in nang hong phat thei lo uh hi. Gum sunga a paisukte in nangma thumanna hong muang thei lo uh hi.
Tuni-in keima hong gamtat bangin a hing mite bek in nang tungah lungdamna hong ko thei hi. Pate in tate tungah nangma thumanna gensawn uh hi.
Topa in kei hong hon ding a, Topa ' inn sungah i nuntak sung tawntung khausai lasakna i tum ding hi.
Tua ciangin Isaiah in Hezekiah kiangah, "Theigah la sak inla, na damkik nadingin na meimate nuhsak in," a ci hi.
Hezekiah in, " Topa' inn-ah ka paitoh zawhna ding a kitheih nadingin bang lim om ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Tua hun laitakin Baladan' tapa, Babylon kumpi ahi Merodak-baladan in Hezekiah a ci na-in a damkikna thu za ahih manin ama kiangah laikhak le letsong tawh tangmite a sawl hi.
Hezekiah in amaute limtakin zin na do hi. Amah in ama dangka inn, ngun, kham, paknamtui, sathau manpha, a galvan koihna inn khempeuh, le a vankoihna sunga a kimu theite khempeuh amaute a na lak hi. Ama innsung hitaleh, ama gam sunga om khempeuh hitaleh Hezekiah in amaute a lah loh bangmah om lo hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Hezekiah kiangah kamsang Isaiah hong pai-in, "Hih mite in bang hong gen ahi uh hiam? Koi lai panin nang kiangah hong pai ahi uh hiam?" a ci hi. Hezekiah in, "Amaute, a gamlapi, Babylon gam panin kei kiangah a hong pai uh ahi hi," a ci hi.
Amah in, "Amaute in na inn sungah bang teng mu ahi uh hiam?" a ci hi. Hezekiah in, "Amaute in ka innsunga a om khempeuh a vekin mu khin uh hi. Ka vankoihna innte sunga nate amau ka lah loh om lo hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Isaiah in Hezekiah kiangah, "Vanglian Topa ' thu ngai in:
En in, na innsunga a omte khempeuh le na pu na pate in tuni donga a kholsate, Babylon-ah a kipuak ding ni hong tung ding hi; bangmah kinusia lo ding hi, Topa in ci hi.
Nang' sung panin a suak, nangma tapate kimkhat kipaikhiatpih ding a, Babylon kumpipa' inn sungah innsungmang nasep kisemsak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Hezekiah in Isaiah kiangah, "Nong gensa Topa ' thu a hoih ahi hi," a ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, "Kei' nuntak hun sungin nopna le lungmuanna om buang ding hi," ci-in a ngaihsun hi.
Dam takin Jerusalem mite hopih un. Amau' gimna hun beita a, amau' mawhna kimaisakin, amau' khialhnate hangin Topa in a kicingin gim pia khinzo ta hi, ci-in amau tungah gen un.
Awging khat in, "Gamlakah Topa ' lampi sial unla, sehnel gam sungah i Pasian a' ding lam lianpi khat a tangin bawl un.
Kuam khempeuh kivuk dim ding a, mual liante le mual neute kitotam ding hi. A tamkim lo munte kitamkim sak ding a, suanghum omna munte kizalhtam ding hi.
Topa ' kam in gen khin ahih manin, Topa ' minthanna vang hong kilang ding a, mi khempeuh in mukhawm ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Awging khat in, "Kiko in!" hong ci hi. Tua ciangin keimah in, "Bang thu kiko ding ka hi hiam?" ka ci hi. "Mi khempeuh, lopa bang hi a, ama hoihnate khempeuh gamlakah a om pak tawh kibang lel hi.
Topa ' hu in a mut ciangin lopa vulin, pak a pulh hi. Mihingte lopa bang lel hi taktak hi.
Lopa vul a, pak a pulh hi. Ahih hangin Pasian' thu kho tawntung ding hi," hong ci hi.
Jerusalem aw, mual sang dawnah kahto-in lungdamna thu kiko in. Zion aw, nakpitakin awng inla, lungdamna thu taangko in. Nakpi takin kiko inla, lau kei in. Judah gam khuapite tungah, "Na Pasian uh hong pai ta hi," ci-in gen ta un.
Topa Pasian hong pai a, vangliatna tawh hong uk ding hi. Ama sep thamante hong pua a, a gualzawhna thamante hong masuan hi.
Amah in tuucingpa bangin ama tuuhonte an vak ding a, ama tuuhonte kaikhawmin a ang sungah pua ding a, no ngeklai a neite dam takin a paipih ding hi.
Kua in ama khutkuak sungah tuite tehin, ama khap tawh vantung teh a, leitung leivui khempeuh lawh khat sungah guangin, pongkhaina tawh mual liante khai a, tawitehna tawh mual neute teh ahi hiam?
Kua in Topa ' sep dingteng gen a, thu lamlak pa bangin kua in amah hilh ahi hiam?
Thu a kicingin a muh nadingin amah in kua dong ngei a, kua in amah lampi man hilhin, ama tungah thutheihna hilh a, thu theihtelna lampi lak ahi hiam?
En un, minamte pen phelkhai khat panin tuimal themkhat a taakkhia tawh kibang a, tawitehna tungah a om leivui nengbaang bangin kingaihsun lel hi. Amah in tuikulhte pen leivui them bangin tawmto lel hi.
Minam khempeuhte, ama mai-ah bangmah tham hi lo a, amaute pen bangmah a om lo le, a hawmguak sangin a tawmzaw-in amah in a ngaihsun hi.
Milim tawh tehtheih ding hi lo hi. Milim a bawlpa in sungin, khamseek pa khat in tua milim kham tawh zut a, tua milim a dingin ngun khainiangte a sunsak hi.
Ngun le kham a nei zo lo mipa in biakna-in a zat dingin a muat lo ding sing teel a, a taang thei lo milim khat ama a dingin a bawlsak dingin khutsiam mi khat a zong hi.
Note in thei nai lo a, za nai lo na hi uh hiam? A kipat cil-in note tungah hong kigen khin hi lo ahi hiam? Leitung a pian a kipan thei khinta hi lo na hi uh hiam?
Leitung a a teng mite kauphe tawh kibang lel hi. Leitung kimkot tungah a tupa, vantungte puan bangin zalin, a sungah a om theih nadingin puanbuk bangin a zal pa,
uliante a mawkna suaksakin, leitung ukte pen bangmah lo a suaksakpa amah ahi hi.
Amaute pen a gina-in kisuan lo a, a gina-in kivawh lo a, amau' kungte in a gina-in lei sungah zung kha lo uh a, amah in a mut ciangin amaute vul a, huihpi in ham bangin amaute a lenkhiatpih hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kei kua tawh hong genteh ding na hi uh hiam, Siangtho Pa in ci hi.
A sangna lam ento unla mu un. Kua in hihte piangsak ahi hiam? Amau' honpite khat khatin piangsakin, a lian ama thahatna tawh amaute khempeuh a minun a sampa ahi hi. Vangliatna-ah thahat ahih manin khat beek pelem lo hi.
" Topa ' kiang panin keima lampi kiliah a, keima Pasian in ka lungkhamna hong thudon lo hi," Jakob aw, bang hangin ci a, Israel aw, bang hangin tuaci pau na hi hiam?
Thei nai lo a, za nai lo na hi hiam? Topa pen tawntung Pasian hi a, leitung mong khempeuh dong a Piangsak pa ahi hi. Amah gim lo a, zong tawl lo hi. Ama thu theihtelna kigen zo lo hi.
Amah in a gim mi tungah vangliatna pia a, thahatna a nei lo mi a thahatna khangsak hi.
Khangnote nangawn gimin tawl ding a, khanglai mite a tha uh bei ding hi.
Ahih hangin Topa a muang mite a tha uh dimkik ding a, muvanlai bangin kha tawh leengto-in, amaute tai napi-un tawl lo ding uh a, amaute lam pai napi-un gim lo ding uh hi.
Tuipi gei-a om gamte aw, gamdai takin ka thu ngai un. Na mite uh a tha uh dimsak unla, amaute a nai-ah hong paisak un. Amaute in thugen theih nading hun ngah ding uh hi. Thukhen zumah kei tawh kisi nu'ng.
A paina peuhah a gualzo, nisuahna panin a hong pai mipa kua in hanthawn ahi hiam? Amah in ama khut sungah minam dangte pia khin ahih manin amah in kumpite tuancil hi. Amah in a namsau tawh amaute leivui bangin bawl a, ama thal tawh buhkung leeng a bangsak hi.
Amah in amaute nawhdelh lua kisa-in, a khe in lei nangawn sik kha lo liang a, nuamtakin a paisuak hi.
A kipat cil a kipanin a khangkhangin mite a sam, hih nasep semin a bawl kua ahi hiam? Keimah Topa in, a masa le a nunung ka hi a, kei pen Topa ka hi hi.
Tuipi gei-a om gamte in mu khinin a lau uh hi. Leimong dongin mite lau-in ling uh a, amaute in hong nai-in hong pai uh hi.
Mi khempeuh in a vengte ciat huh a, a sanggamte ciat kiangah, "Lau kei un," a ci hi.
Khutsiam pa in khamseek pa hanthawnin, sek tawh milim a neel puah pa in sekpi tawh a sat pa hanthawn a, sumtui a luanna uh, "Hoih hi," a ci uh hi. A ling thei nawn lo dingin amaute in tua milim siktukkilh tawh a khenkip uh hi.
Ahih hangin nang ka nasem pa Israel, ka lawm Abraham' suanlekhak, ka hong teelsa Jakob aw,
leimong panin kong lakkhiat, leimong kiu a gamla pen mun panin ka hong sapkhiat, "Nang pen ka nasem pa na hi a, nangmah kong teel khinzo a, nangmah kong nilkhia kei hi," ka hong cih pa aw,
nang hong ompih ka hih manin lau kei in. Na Pasian ka hih manin lungkia kei in. Nang hong thakhauhsakin ka hong huh ding a, nang hong huhin ka hong honkhia ding hi.
Nangma tungah a heh mite khempeuh maizumna kithuaksakin kikoihkhong ding hi. Nangmah hong dem mite a mawkna suakin siatna thuak ding uh hi.
Nangmah hong langpangte na zon hangin amaute na mu nawn kei ding hi. Nangmah hong dote pen bangmah hi het lo ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah Topa na Pasian in na khut taklam ka len hi. "Lau kei in, nangmah kong huh ding hi," nang tungah a hong ci pa keimah ka hi hi.
Lungno bang ahi lel Jakob, no Israel mite aw, lau kei un! Note kong huh ding hi, Topa in ci hi. Note hong honpa pen Israel-te' Siangtho Pa ahi hi.
Note pen, a thak, a hiam, ha a nei buhcilna bangin ka hong bawl ding hi. Note in mual liante cilin na suvui ding uh a, mual neute pen ansi bangin na gawizan ding uh hi.
Amaute na haih ding uh a, huih in amaute mutkhia ding a, huihpi in amaute thehthang ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ' hangin na lungdam ding uh a, Israel-te' Siangtho Pa' hangin na minthang ding uh hi.
Keima mite in tui duhin, tui zongin, a dang uh a taak ciangin amau' hong thungetna ka pia ding a, Israel-te' Pasian keimah in amaute ka nusia kei ding hi.
Bangmah a om lohna a sangna munte panin gunte ka luangsak ding a, kuamte' laizangah tuikhukte ka omsak ding hi. Sehnel gam pen bualtui ka suaksak ding a, lei keuna mun pen ciktui ka suaksak ding hi.
Gamlakah taamtak sing, singkha sing, mui sing le oliv kungte ka posak ding hi. Sehnel gam sungah taaksan sing, hiangpa sing le tak sing ka suan khawm ding hi.
Topa ' khut in hih nate bawl a, Israel-te' Siangtho Pa in hih nate piangsak hi, ci-in mite in mu-in a theih nading, a thu ngaihsunin a tel theih nading uh ahi hi.
Na thu uh sung un, Topa in ci hi. Na lahtel nop teng uh gen un, Jakob' Kumpipa in ci hi.
Amaute in a thu uh hong paipih uh hen la, a piang ding thu hong gen uh hen. Eite in i ngaihsut theih nading, a hong piang ding thu i theih nadingin a beisa huna om nate bang teng hiam hong gen ta uh hen. Tua ahih kei leh zong, a hong piang ding thu eite tungah hong gen ta uh hen.
Note pen pasian-te na hihna uh ka theih nadingun tu khit ciangin a hong piang ding thute kote tungah hong gen un. Kote lungkia-in ka lau nadingun phatna ahi a, siatna ahi zongin khat peuhpeuh hong bawl dih un.
A taktakin note bangmah na hi kei uh a, na nasepnate uh a mawkna ahi hi. Note a hong teelpa a etsathuai ahi hi.
Leilu lam gam panin mi khat ka hanthawn a, amah hong kuan khin hi. Nisuahna lam panin amah in ka min hong lo ding hi. Beelseek pa in buan a cil bang, sum sunga a kisugawp bangin, amah in gam ukte tuancil gawp ding hi.
Eite in i theih nadingin a kipat cil a kipan kua in hong genkhia a, "Amah man hi," i cih theih nadingin a hun ma-in kua in gen ahi hiam? Kuamah in genkhia lo, kuamah in pulak lo a, kuamah in no' thu za lo hi.
Topa ahi keimah in Zion tungah hih thu ka pulak masa a, Jerusalem tungah lungdamna thu ka gen hi.
Ahih hangin tua mun ka et ciangin kuamah om lo hi. Thu ka dot ciangin a hong dawng ding thulamlak amaute lakah om lo hi.
Amaute khempeuh zuaupi vive hi a, amau' nasepnate a mawkna ahi hi. A kisung amau' milimte pen huih hawmpi bang ahi uh hi.
Keimah in ka huh, ka teel, ka lungkimna ka nasempa en un. Ka kha tawh amah ka kidimsak a, amah in minam khempeuh tungah thuman tungsak ding hi.
Amah kiko loin, a aw zong sangsak lo ding a, kongzing lakah zong thu gen zakzak lo ding hi.
Amah in a zawngkhal mite dop bawl ding a, a cimawh mite tungah migi ding hi. Amah in thumanna tawh mi khempeuh tungah thutang thu semkhia ding hi.
Amah in leitungah thutang thu a phuh khit matengin lungsi lo, lungkia lo ding hi. Tuipi gei-a om gamte in ama thu ngak uh hi.
Vantungte piangsakin a zal, leitung phahin, a tung panin a hong paikhia nate a piangsak, leitungah a om mite tungah husanna pia-in, leitungah a paite khempeuh husanna a guan Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi:
"Kei pen Topa ka hi a, thumanna tawh nangmah hong samin, ka khut tawh hong lenin nang ka hong kem hi. Mittawte a vaksak ding, leinuai thong sung panin thongkiate a lakhia ding, thong sung a mialna munah a tu mite a lakhia ding, mite tungah thuciamna ahi ding, minam dangte tungah khuavak ahi dingin nang ka hong koih khin hi.
"Kei pen Topa ka hi a, Topa pen keima min ahi hi. Pasian dang' tungah keima-a' tawh a kibang minthanna ka pia kei a, a kisui milimte zong keimah hong kiphatnate pawl ka ngahsak kei hi.
En un, hun beisa-a nate in hong khengta a, tu-in a thak nate kong gen hi. Tuate a hong piankhiat ma-in note tungah a thute ka hong genkhol hi," a ci hi.
Topa ' tungah la thak sa unla, leimong panin amah phatna sa un! Tuipi le a sunga omte, tuipi gei-a om gamte le a tunga teng mite aw, la sa un.
Sehnel gam le a khuapite, Kedar mite' tenna khuaneute a aw uh sangkhai sak un. Sela gam a teng mite lungdamna tawh la sasak unla, mual dawn panin amaute awngsak un.
Topa ' minthanna gensak unla, tuipi gei-a gamte-ah amah phatna gensak un.
Mi thahatpa bangin Topa kuankhia a, gal a do mipa bangin ama hehna sosak hi. Amah kiko-in nakpitakin awngkhia a, ama hatna a galte tungah a lak hi.
Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: "Sauveipi sung bangmah hih loin ka om a, keimah le keimah kikhamcipin ka om hithiat hi. Tu-in ahihleh numei nausuak ding bangin ka kikokhia ding a, ka kam ka-in ka tungnak ding hi.
Mual liante le mual neute ka susia ding a, a po khempeuh ka keusak ding hi. Gunte pen tuikulh ka suaksak ding a, bualtuite ka kangsak ding hi.
"Amau' theih loh lampi-ah mittawte ka paipih ding a, amau' theih ngei loh sul zuihpihin ka kha ding hi. Amau' mai-ah khuamial pen khuavak suaksakin, a phokna munte a tamin ka bawl ding hi. Hihte pen keima hih ding nate hi a, tuate sem loin ka nusia kei ding hi.
A kisui milimte muangin, a kisung milimte kiangah, 'Note, komau' pasian-te na hi uh hi,' a ci mite kinolh ding a, maizum mahmahin ki-omsak ding hi.
"Bilngongte aw, za un. Mittawte aw, na muh theih nadingun en un!
Israel in na tampi mu a, ahih hangin tuate encian lo hi. Ama bilte vang a, ahih hangin amah in khua za lo hi," a ci hi.
Topa pen a honkhia nuam mahmah Pasian hi a, ama thuhilhnate limtakin a kizuih ding a deih hi.
Ahih hangin ama mite pen a kiluh, a kisut mite hi a, leihawm sungah amaute khempeuh kikhiasuk a, thonginn sungah kiseel hi. Amaute pen a hon ding a om lo, nek dingin a kiman ganhing suakmangkhin uh a, kuamah in, "Hong piakik in," a cih loh vankinusiate a suak khinta uh hi.
Note lakah khat peuhpeuh in hih thu na ngai ding uh hiam? Tu a kipanin limtakin na ngai ding uh hiam?
Kua in a sutgawppa tungah Jakob pia a, a luhgawpte tungah Israel pia ahi hiam? Topa mahmah in a piak hi lo ahi hiam? Ama tungah eite i khial hi. Ama hong deih bangin i nungta kei a, ama hong thuhilhnate i mang kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in ama hehna so leh galkidonate eite tungah hong tungsak hi. Israel mi khempeuh lakah ama hehna mei bangin hong kuang a, ahih hangin eite in bangmah i thei kei hi. Tua bang i thuakna hangin eite in bangmah i phawk thei tuan kei hi.
Ahih hangin Jakob aw, nangmah hong piangsak pa, Israel aw, nangmah hong bawlpa, Topa in tu-in hih bang ci hi: "Hong honkhia khin ka hih manin lau kei in. Na min tawh kong sam khinzo a, nang pen kei-a' na hi hi.
Tuite na kantan ciangin nang kong ompih ding a, gunte na kantan ciangin tui in hong tuum lo ding hi. Mei kantanin na pai ciangin na kang kei ding a, meikuangte in nang hong kangtum lo ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh kei pen Topa na Pasian, Israel-te' Siangtho Pa, nangmah hong honpa ka hi hi. Nangmah tat nadingin Egypt ka pia a, nangmah khek nadingin Ethiopia le Seba ka pia hi.
Nang pen keima mitah manpha-in, pahtakhuai-in, nangmah hong it ka hih manin nangma tangin mite ka pia a, na nuntakna khek nadingin mihingte ka pia hi.
Nang hong ompih ka hih manin lau kei in. "Nisuahna lam panin na suanlekhakte kong paipih ding a, nitumna lam panin na mite kong kaikhawm ding hi.
Keimah in leilu lam kiangah, 'Piakhia in,' leitaw lam kiangah, 'Len nawn kei in; keima piansak ka bawlsa, keima minthan nadingin ka piansak, keima min tawh a kilote khempeuh ahi, ka tapate a gamlapi panin, ka tanute leimong panin hong paipih un,' ka ci ding hi," a ci hi.
Minamte khempeuh kikaikhawmsak unla, mihingte kikhawmsak un. Amaute' lak panin kua in hih thu hong genkhia thei-in, a beisa huna nate kua in laktel thei ahi hiam? Amau' dikna a langsak dingin a tecite uh hong paipihsak unla, amaute a thu zasakin, man mah hi, cisak un.
"Note pen keima teci na hi uh hi," Topa in ci a, "Kei pen Amah ka hihna thu, nangmah in thei-in keimah nong upna ding, nong theihtel nadingin kong teelsa ka nasempa na hi hi. Kei' ma-in pasian om lo a, kei' khitah zong kuamah om lo ding hi.
"Kei, keimah pen Topa ka hi a, kei simloh honpa dang om lo hi.
Note lakah pasian dang a om ma-in honkhia-in, pulakin, ka genkhol hi. Tua ahih ciangin note pen keima teci na hi uh hi," Topa in ci hi.
"Kei pen Pasian ka hi a, a kipat cil a kipanin zong kei pen Amah ka hi hi. Keima khutsung panin a lakhiazo kuamah om lo hi. Keima sepnate, a kua in hong khaktanzo ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Israel-te' Siangtho Pa, note a hong hon Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Note' hangin Babylon-ah galkapte puakin, khua kongpi sikzawl khempeuh ka kuaitan ding a, Khaldea mite' kikona pen tauna awging ka suaksak ding hi.
Kei pen Topa , note' Siangtho Pa, Israel a Piangsak pa, note' Kumpi ka hi hi," ci hi.
Tuipi sungah lampi bawlin, tui lianpi sungah pai nading sul bawl a, leeng le sakolte, galkapte le galhangte Egypt gam pan paikhiatpihin, a tho thei nawn lo dingin amaute a lumcipsak, amaute pen meivak khau kisumit bangin a mitsak Topa in hih bangin ci hi:
"Masa lama nate ciamteh kei unla, a beisa hun nate ngaihsun kei un.
Tu-in a thak na khat ka bawl a, tu-in hong piangkhia hi. Note in thei lo na hi uh hiam? Gamlakah lam lianpi khat ka bawl ding a, sehnel gam sungah gunte ka luangsak ding hi.
Gamsate, ngiate, le vasa-kalaohte in kei hong pahtawi ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh keima a dingin ka piansak mite in keimah hong phatna a genkhiat theih nadingun, keima teel mite' dawn dingin gamlakah tui pia-in, sehnel gam sungah gun ka luangsak hi.
"Ahih hangin Jakob aw, ka min nong lo kei hi. Israel aw, kei nong cimtak hi.
Meihal biak nadingin kei kiangah na tuu nong paipih kei a, biakpiakna tawh kei nong pahtawi kei hi. Piakna tawh nang kong vangiksak nai kei a, paknamtui piakna tawh kong gimsak nai kei hi.
Kei a dingin paknamtui nong leisak nai kei a, nangmah in biakna sa a thaute tawh nong taiisak nai kei hi. Ahih hangin nang in na khialhna tawh kei tungah vangik na hong suan khin a, na mawhna tawh kei nong gimsak khin hi.
Na thupalsatnate hong paihkhiatsak pa pen keimah ka hi a, kei ka hih manin na khialhnate ka ciamteh kei ding hi.
"Thuman na hihna hong laktel inla, thu kikum khawm ni. Na dikna a kilat nadingin na thu hong sungkhia in.
Na pu na pa masate uh na khial uh a, na makaite uh zong kei tungah hong khial uh hi.
Na uliante un ka biakinn mindaisak uh ahih manin Israel tungah siatna ka tungsak a, Jakob ka mindaisak hi," a ci hi.
Topa in, "Ka nasempa Jakob aw, ka teelsa Israel aw, tu-in za in.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh a dangtak leitang tungah tui ka sung ding a, lei keu tungah luitui ka luangsak ding hi. Na suanlekhakte tungah ka kha ka sung ding a, na tu na tate tungah ka thupha ka pia ding hi.
Amaute pen tui sung panin a pokhia, luitui luang gei-ah a om, gialhek kungte bangin pokhia ding uh hi.
"Khat in, 'Kei pen Topa ka hi hi,' ci-in, adang khat in Jakob min tawh ama min lo ding a, adang khat leuleu in, ' Topa -a', ci-in ama khut tungah gelhin, Israel min tawh amahmah kinophuah ding hi," ci hi.
Topa , Israel Kumpipa le amah Tan pa, Vanglian Topa in hih bangin gen a, "Kei pen a masa pen le a nunung pen ka hi hi. Kei simloh pasian dang om lo hi.
Kua pen kei tawh kibang ahi hiam? Amah gensakin pulaksak unla, keima mai-ah gensak un. A hong tung ding nate thu tanglai pek panin kua in thangko ahi hiam? Hong tung ding nate thu amaute gensak dih un.
Lau kei unla, kihta kei un. Tanglai pek panin note kiangah hong genin hong pulak khin hi lo ka hi hiam? Note khempeuh keima teci na hi uh hi. Kei simloh pasian dang om ahi hiam? Suangpi dang om lo hi. Khat beek ka thei kei hi," a ci hi.
Milim a bawl mite khempeuh a mawkna hi a, amau' deih milimte in phattuamna piangsak lo hi. Milim a biate in khua mu thei loin, thu theithei lo a, amaute in maizumna a thuak uh hi.
Bangmahin a kimang lo pasian kua in bawl a, milim kua in sung ahi hiam?
Milim a bia mite khempeuh in maizumna ngah ding uh hi. Milim a bawl khutsiamte pen mi hilel uh hi. Amaute khempeuh kikhawm sakin dingsak un. Amaute nakpitakin kilausak ding a, a vekpi-un maizumin kikoih khawm ding hi.
Sikseekpa in seekin hol tawh na sem hi. Amah in sek tawh seekin a thahat a khut tawh a sat hi. Amah a gil kialin a tha zaw a, dangtakin a gim hi.
Sing nasep khutsiampa in khau khungin laikung tawh a ciamteh hi. Amah in singnawtna tawh nawt a, laikung tawh a kualin a ciamteh hi. Amah in, inn sungah a teng ding mihing melhoih lim khat bangin mihing limin a bawl hi.
Amah in taamtak singkungte a phuk hi. Tua ahih kei leh sesing kung khat ahi a, tawsaw kung khat ahi zongin tengkhia a, gamlak singte lakah khangsakin golsak hi. Amah in taamtak kung khat suan a, guah in khangsak hi.
Tua ciangin tua kung pen mi khat a dingin mei sing a suak hi. Amah in tua sing kimkhat la-in khua lum nadingin mei-in cih a, amah in mei tawhin moh a em hi. Amah in pasian khat zong bawlin bia a, amah in milim khat bawlin tua milim mai-ah a kun hi.
Amah in a sing kimkhat meikhukah cih hi. Adang kimkhat tawh an ne a, amah in sa hangin a gil vah hi. Amah in mei awi-in, "Ah, ka khua lumta, mei mu khin ing," ci hi.
Amah in a vallai teng, ama milim pasian khatin a bawl hi. Tua milim mai-ah kunin a bia hi. Amah in tua milim tungah thu ngen a, "Nang pen keima pasian na hih ciangin kei hong honkhia in," ci hi.
A kimkhat meikhukah cihin, a aam tungah moh zong ka em a, sa hangin ka ne khinzo hi. A omlai teng a kihhuai-in bawl buang ding ka hi hiam? Sing bek khat mai-ah kun buang ding ka hi hiam, a ci ding, thu a ngaihsun, theihna le thumuhna a nei khat beek om lo hi.
Amah pen vut a nete tawh kibang lel hi. A lungsim haina in amah lam pialpih khin a, amah le amah kihonkhia thei loin, "Ka khut sungah ka tawi milim pen a zumhuai hi lo ahi hiam?" cih zong phawk thei lo hi.
Jakob aw, hih thu phawk in. Israel aw, ka nasempa na hi hi. Nang kong bawl a, nang pen keima nasem na hi hi. Israel aw, nang kong mangngilh kei ding hi.
Na thupalsatnate meiipi bangin na khialhnate meiilum bangin ka phiatkhia khinzo hi. Hong honkhia khin ka hih manin kei kiangah hong ciahkik in.
Vantungte aw, Topa in tua thu sem khin ahih manin la sa un. Lei thuknate aw, awng un. Mualte aw, la sa-in awngkhia un. Tulak le a sunga om sing khempeuh aw, awng un. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Jakob honkhia khin a, Israel sungah amah kiminthangsak ding hi.
Gil sung panin nangmah a hong piangsak, nangmah hong Honpa, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Keimah in na khempeuh bawlin, keimah guak in vantungte zalin, kuama seppih lohin leitung ka zal hi.
Zuau thugente' hilhkholhna limte a siasak pa, aisante pen mihai a suaksak pa, mipilte lehhei kikin, amau' thutheihte haina a suaksak pa;
a nasempa' thu kipsakin, a kamtaite' thugente a sem pa, 'Jerusalem khua-ah mi tengin, Judah khuapite kilamkik ding a, a kisia khuate ka lamkik ding hi,' a ci pa;
tui thukpi kiangah, 'Keu in; na gunte ka keusak ding hi,' a ci pa;
'Sairas kumpipa pen ka tuucingpa hi a, ka deihna teng tungsak ding hi,' a ci pa; 'Jerusalem kilamkik ding a,' biakinn pen, 'Na bulpi kiphutkik ding hi,' a ci Topa ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Kulhkongpi sungah a lut theih nadingin ama mai-ah kongkhakte a honsak ding, kumpite' vangliatnate a lakkhiatsak ding, ama mai-ah minam dangte a zawhsak dingin, a taklam khutin a let, a sathau nilh pa Sairas tungah Topa in hih bangin ci hi:
"Nangma min tawh nang a hong sampa pen Israel Pasian, Topa , keimah ka hihna thu na theih nadingin, nangma mai-ah kei pai-in mualte zalhmai-in, sumngo kongkhakte satzanin a sikzawlte ka sattan ding a, a mialna mun sunga om sum kikoihte, mun simthama sum kiseelte, nangma tungah kong pia ding hi.
Ka nasempa Jakob, ka teelsa Israel ka ngaihsutna-in nang pen na minin kong sam a, nong theih loh hangin min thak kong phuak hi.
"Kei pen Topa ka hi hi. Kuamah dang om lo a, keimah simloh Pasian dang om lo hi. Nisuahna lam pan hitaleh, nitumna lam pan hitaleh, kei simloh adang a om lohna thu mite in a theih nadingin, nong theih loh hangin a kisam thahatna nang ka hong guan hi. Kei pen Topa ka hi a, adang kuamah om lo hi.
Keimah in khuavak le khuamial piangsakin, a pha nate le a sia nate ka piangsak a, hih nate khempeuh a bawlpa, keimah Topa ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Vantungte aw, tunglam panin thuman zusak unla, vantungte in thumanna buasuk ta un. Hotkhiatna a pokhiat theih nadingin leitang kihongsak unla, thumanna zong pokhiato sak un. Keimah Topa in hih thu ka bawl khinzo hi.
Amah a Bawlpa tawh a kido mipa, beelseek pa tawh a kilehdo lei beel in gimna ngah ta hen! Tungman in amah a sek pa kiangah, "Nang in bang bawl na hi hiam, na na bawl in khutlet nei lo hi," ci-in a thu sel ngam ahi hiam?
A pa kiangah, "Nangmah in kua piangsak na hi hiam?" a ci pa hitaleh, a nu kiangah, "Nang in nausuak dingin kua gimpih na hi hiam?" a ci pa in gimna ngah ta hen!
Amah a Bawlpa, Israel-te' Siangtho Pa, Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Nang in keima tate' thu hong dongin, ka khut tawh ka bawlsa tawh kisaite-ah thu hong pia ding na hi hiam?
Keimah in leitung ka bawl a, tua tungah mi ka piangsak hi. Keima khut in vantungte zal a, keimah in vantung na honpite khempeuh thu ka pia hi.
Thu a manin a sem dingin amah khua ka phawksak a, keimah in ama lampi khempeuh ka mamsak ding hi. Amah in nasep thaman ahi a, letsong ahi zongin ngaihsun loin keima khuapi lam ding a, salin a om ka mite a khahkhia ding hi," Vanglian Topa in ci hi.
Topa in Israel tungah, "Egypt' hauhna le Ethiopia sumbuk vante le a tun a sang Seba mite nangma kiangah hong pai-in nangma a' hong hi ding uh a, amaute in nang hong zui ding uh hi. Amaute sikkhau kibulhsa-in hong pai ding uh a, nangma kiangah hong kun ding uh hi. Amaute in nangma kiangah thumna hong bawl ding uh a, 'Nangmah bek tawh Pasian omkhawm a, kuamah dang om loin, amah simloh pasian dang om lo hi,' hong ci ding uh hi.
A taktakin, Israel-te' Pasian, Honpa pen, amahmah a bucip Pasian ahi hi.
Milim a bawl mite khempeuh in maizumna thuakin cih nading thei loin om ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in Israel-te honkhia hi. A tawntungin gualzo ding uh a, cikmah hunin maizumna thuak ngei lo ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Vantungte a piangsak pa (amah Pasian!) Leitung piangsakin a bawl pa (a kipsak pa; a awngthawl dingin bawl loin, ten nadingin leitung a piangsak pa!) Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Kei pen Topa ka hi a, kuamah dang om lo hi.
Keimah in mun simtham, khuamialna gam sungah thu ka gen kei hi. Jakob suanlekhakte tungah, 'A awngthawl mun sungah kei hong zong un,' ka ci kei hi. Keimah Topa in thuman ka gen a, a man nate ka pulak hi.
"Minamte sung panin a suaktalai note aw, nomau kikaikhawmin hong pai unla, hong nai un! Sing milim a pua kawikawi mite in theihna nei lo uh a, a honkhia thei lo pasian tungah thu ngenngen uh hi.
Na thu uh sung unla, hong gen un. Na thu uh kikum khawm un! Hih thu sawtpekin kua in gen ahi hiam? Tanglai-in kua in pulak ahi hiam? Keimah Topa hi lo ka hi hiam? Thuman Pasian le Honpa ahi, kei simloh pasian dang om lo a, kei simloh kuamah dang om lo hi.
"Leitung mi khempeuhte aw, kei lamah hong kihei unla hotkhiatna ngah un! Bang hang hiam cih leh kei pen Pasian ka hi a, kuamah dang om lo hi.
Kei mahmah ka kiciam khin a, a kikhelkik ngei nawn lo ding thukip hih bang ahi hi: 'Keima mai-ah mi khempeuh hong khukdin ding a, keima tungah thuman ding hong kiciam ding hi,' cihna, kei' kamsung panin thumanna tawh pusuakkhia khinzo hi.
Topa ' hang bekin gualzawhna le thahatna kingah hi, hong kici ding hi. Kei hong mudahte khempeuh mindai-in maizum ding uh hi.
Israel suanlekhakte khempeuh, Topa ' hangin gualzo-in a kisial ding uh hi.
"Bel pasian puksukin, Nebo pasian kunsuk a, tua milimte pen ganhing le bawngte tungah kipua hi. Note' puak hih nate pen a gim mahmah ganhingte tungah a kisuan vangik bangin note tungah hong gik hi.
"Na suah a kipan kong tawi, gil sung pana kong puak, Jakob innkuan, Israel innkuan a suakta laite khempeuh aw, keima thu hong ngai un.
Na teek dongun kei pen Amah ka hi a, na sam uh a kan' hun dongin note kong kem ding hi. Ka hong bawlkhin a, ka hong don ding hi. Keimah in hong tawi-in ka hong honkhia ding hi.
"Note in kei, kua tawh hong kibangsakin kua tawh hong kikimsak ding a, ka kibatpih dingin a kua tawh hong enteh ding na hi uh hiam?
Sumbawm panin khamte uang zatin tawitehna tawh ngunte a tehkhiate in kham seekpa cial uh a, amah in tua nate pen pasian-in a seeksak hi. Tua ciangin amaute kunin tua milim a bia uh hi.
Amaute in tua pasian pen a liangko tung uhah ngato-in pua uh a, ama omna ding munah a koih uh hi. Tua a koihna-ah a milim om niloh hi. Ama omna panin kinkhia thei lo hi. Mi khatpeuh in amah sam le amah in dawng thei lo a, ama lungkhamna panin zong a honkhia thei kei hi.
"Thu a palsat mite aw, hih thu phawkin ngaihsun unla, lungngai pha un.
Hun lui thute phawk un; bang hang hiam cih leh kei pen Pasian ka hi a, adang om lo hi. Kei pen Pasian ka hi a, kei tawh a kibang adang om lo hi.
A kipat cil-in a tawpna ding thu ka pulak a, tanglai pek panin a piang nai lo nate genin, 'Ka thugen kip ding a, ka ngimna khempeuh ka tungsak ding hi,' ka ci hi.
Nisuahna gam panin sasialne vasa khat samin, keima thu a semkhia dingin gamlapi panin mi khat ka sam hi. Thu ka gen khin a, ka tungsak ding hi. Ka geel khin a, ka sem ding hi.
"Suahtakna ding haksa mahmah ding hi, a ci lungsim khauh mite aw, ka thu ngai un:
Suahtakna ding hun ka hong tungsak ta a, gamla nawn lo hi. Ka hong hotkhiat ding hun zekai nawn lo ding hi. Keima minthanna ahi Israel a dingin Jerusalem ka honkhia ding hi," a ci hi.
Nungak a bang Babylon aw, hong paisuk inla, leivui lakah tu in. Nungak a bang Khaldea aw, tokhom om lohna leilakah hong tusuk in! Bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen a moi milmel, a ngeek dikdek, hong kici nawn lo ding hi.
An gawina suangte hei inla, an gawi in. Na kikhuhna puan lakhia inla, na nik na puan suahin gunte kantan in.
Na seelsim teng kilang ding a, na zumhuaina teng kimu ding hi. Keimah in kong thukkik ding a, kuamah ka zah kei ding hi.
Israel-te' Siangtho Pa in eite hong suaktasak a, ama min pen Vanglian Topa ahi hi.
Babylon aw, gamdai takin tu inla, khuamialna sungah pai in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen kumpi gamte' tonu, hong kici nawn lo ding hi.
Ka mite tungah ka heh a, ka luah gamh ka ninsak hi. Nangma khut sungah amaute kong pia a, nangmah in amaute na hehpih bawl kei hi. A khangham mite nangawn na ngong bawl mahmah hi.
Nangmah in, "Tonu ka hi tawntung ding hi," ci na hih manin hih thute na lungsimah koih loin, a thumongte zong na phawkkha kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, a nuam bek a ut, lungmuang takin a tu hithiat, na lungsimah, "Keimah hi'ng, kei simloh midang om kei; meigongin om ngei kei ning, ta-khuai cih zong sin kei ning," a ci khuapi aw, hih thu za in:
Aisan siamnate le mibum siamna vang lianpi na neih hangin ta khuaisuahna le meigonna, hih thu nihte thakhat thu-in ni khat sungin a kicing takin nangma tungah hong tung veve ding hi.
Na gitlohna-ah nang na lungmuang a, "Kuamah in kei hong mu kei hi," na ci hi. Na pilna le na theihnate in lam hong pialsak a, na lungsim sungah, "Keimah hi'ng, kei simloh midang om kei," na ci hi.
Ahih hangin nangmah in na beisak theih loh lungkhamna na tungah hong tung ding a, nangmah in maisakna na ngah theih loh gimna nang tungah hong tung ding hi. A thu na theih hetloh siatna na tungah hong tungvat ding hi.
Na neulai a kipan na sep na mibumna le na aisannate ah kiptakin om in. Phattuamna na ngah kha ding a, mite na lausakzo kha ding hi.
Nang tungah a hong kilak thu tampite hangin na gim hi. Vantungte a sehin khenin, aksite en a, khadet simin nang tunga thupiang ding a hong genkhol mite tu-in dingsak inla, nangmah kihonsak in.
En in, amaute pen buhkung tawh kibang uh a, mei in amaute kangtum hi. Meikuang' vangliatna panin amau le amau kihontawm thei lo uh hi. Hih pen khua lumna ding mei-am hi lo a, awi ding mei zong hi lo hi.
Nang tawh na a semkhawm, na neu lai a kipan nang tawh na a semkhawmte tungah hih thute hong tung ding hi. Amaute pen amau' tum ciatah zauvak uh a, nang a hong hon ding kuamah om lo hi.
Israel min tawh a kilo, Judah sung panin a piangkhia, Topa ' min tawh thu ciam napi-in, thuman thutak tawh Israel Pasian a pulak lo Jakob innkuan aw, hih thu ngai un.
Note tua bang hinapi-in, khuapi siangtho sungah a teng mite ihi a, Israel Pasian i muang hi. Ama min pen Vanglian Topa ahi hi, ci-in kisaktheihna-in na neizaw lai uh hi.
A masa lama nate thu tanglai-in ka gen a, keima kam panin tuate gingkhia-in ka kitheithangsak hi. Tua ciangin thakhat thu-in keimah in ka sem a, a hong piang hi.
Note pen paupeengin na ngawng uh sik thagui bang hi a, na thatang uh sumngo bangin a sakna thei khin ka hih manin,
note in, "Ka milim un hihte bawl a, a kisui ka milim uh le a kisung ka milim un thu pia hi," na cih theih loh nadingun tanglai a kipanin note tungah hih thute kong gen a, tuate hong pian' ma-in note tungah kong zasakkhol hi.
Ka gensa thu khempeuh hong tungta ahih manin, na gennate a man hi, na hong cih ding uh hita hi. Tu a kipanin na a thakte, na theih ngei loh uh hong tung ding a ki-im nate kong gen ding hi.
Hihte pen tuhunin a piangsak ka hi a, a beisa hunah hih bang piang nai lo hi. A piang khinsa thu hileh, ka theihsa uh thu hi, na ci kha ding uh hi.
Note pen muantheih ding na hihlohna uh, na suah tung uh a kipan mi lehdo thei na hihna uh ka hong thei hi. Tua ahih manin hih thute na za ngei kei uh a, zong na thei ngei kei uh hi.
Note khempeuh kong suksiat khak loh nadingin ka min ka ngaihsutna tawh ka hehna diahin, keimah hong kiphatna ka ngaihsutna-in note tungah ka ki-ip hi.
Meikhuk sungah ngun a kisiansak bangin gimna meikhuk sungah note kong ze-et hi. Ahi zongin note bangmahin a kimang lo na hihna uh hong kimu khin hi.
Keimah ka kikhualna, keimah ka kingaihsutna-in hih bangin kong hih hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka min a siat ding kilawm ahi hiam? Midang khat tungah keima minthanna ka pia kei ding hi.
Jakob aw, ka thu ngai in. Kong sap Israel-te aw, ka thu hong ngai un! Kei pen amah ka hi a, kei pen a masa hi-in, kei pen a nunung zong ka hi hi.
Ka khut in leitung bulpi koih a, ka khut taklam in vantungte zal hi. Amaute ka sap ciangin amaute omkhawm pah uh hi.
Note khempeuh hong kikhawm unla hong za un! Amaute sung panin kua in hih ka sep ding nate genkhol thei ahi hiam? Ka teelsa mipa in Babylon tungah keima ngimna sem ding a, Khaldea mite' langkhatah kei ka pang ding hi.
Kei, keimah in thu genin amah ka sam a, kei in amah ka panpih a, amah a dau pai ding hi.
Kei kiangah hong nai unla, hih thu hong za un. A kipat cil a kipanin a simthamin thu ka gen ngei kei a, tua thu a pian a kipanin kei ka om hi. (Tu-in Topa Pasian in kei tungah a vangliatna hong pia a, kei hong sawl hi.)
Israel-te' Siangtho Pa, nangmah hong hon Topa in: Phattuamna na ngah nadingin nang a hong hilh, na zuih ding a kilawm lampi-ah a hong paipih Topa na Pasian ka hi hi.
Ka thupiakna a ngai hi hoh leteh! Nangma nopsakna gunpi bang ding a, na thumanna, tuihualte tawh kibang ding hi.
Na tu le na tate sehnel zah pha ding a, na suanlekhakte sehnel vui zah pha ding hi. Keima mai-ah amaute' min kiphiatkhia lo ding a, kisusia ngei lo ding hi, a ci hi.
Babylon panin paikhia-in Khaldea gam panin tai inla, lungdamna tawh hih thu genin taangko inla, leimong dongin puak in. " Topa in ama nasem Jakob honkhia khinzo!" ci-in gen kawikawi in.
Amah in sehnel gam kantanin amaute a paipih ciangin a dang uh taak lo hi. Suangpi panin amau a dingin amah in tui a luangsak hi. Amah in suangpi khangkhamsak a, tui a phulkhia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin migilote a dingin nopna om lo hi, Topa in ci hi.
Tuipi gei-a om gamte aw, ka thu ngai un. Gamlapi-a om mihingte aw, ka thu ngai un. Ka suah ma-in Topa in kei hong teel a, ka nu sungah ka om lai-in amah in keima min hong pulak khin hi.
Amah in ka thugente, namsau hiam bangsak a, ama khut tawh keimah hong hu hi. Amah in a kinawtngil thaltang bangin kei hong bawl a, a hiamsa-in zat pah dingin a thallawng sungah kei hong koih hi.
Amah in kei kiangah, "Nang pen keimah hong kiminthansakna ding ka nasempa Israel na hi hi," a hong ci hi.
Ahih hangin keimah in, "Na ka sem a, ahi zongin a kimanna om lo hi. Ka thatang khempeuh ka beisak a, ahi zongin bangmah ka tangtun kei hi. Ahi zongin Topa in a manin na hong sem ding, ci-in ka muang a, ka sep thaman hong pia ding hi, ci-in ka um hi," ka ci hi.
Ama kiangah Jakob kipaipih kikin, ama kiangah Israel-te a kikaihkhop theih nadingin Topa ' mai-ah kei hong kipahtawi a, Pasian pen keima thahatna suakin, ama nasem dingin ka nu sung panin keimah a hong piangsak Topa in tu-in thu hong gen hi.
Amah in, "Jakob minamte a laamto ding le a suaktalai Israel mite a ngei uh a bangsakkik dingin keima nasem na hihna pen a baih lua mahmah nasep ahi hi. Keima hotkhiatna in leimong dong a phak theih nadingin minam dangte tungah khuavak ahi dingin nang kong pia ding hi," hong ci hi.
Israel a honpa le ama Siangtho Pa ahi Topa in nakpitakin simmawhna a thuak, minamte in a muhdah, gam ukte' nasempa tungah: "Nangmah a hong teel Israel-te' Siangtho Pa, a thuman Topa ' hangin mite na hotkhiatna thu kumpite in a muh uh ciangin zahtakna tawh na mai-ah hong ding ding uh a, na mai-ah uliante hong kun ding uh hi," hong ci hi.
Topa in ama mite kiangah, "Note hotkhiat ding hun a hong tun ciangin maipha kong pia ding a, huhna nong ngetna uh ka hong pia ding hi. Note hong kemin ka hong hu ding a, note' tungtawnin mi khempeuh tawh thuciamna ka bawl ding hi. A kinusia na gam sung uhah note kong tengsakkik ding hi.
Thongkia mite tungah, 'Hong paikhia un,' ci-in, khuamial sunga om mite tungah, 'Hong pusuak un,' ka ci ding hi. Amaute pen lam tawntung ah an a ne, mual pawn a sang munte khempeuhah nuamtakin a gamta tuute tawh kibang ding uh hi.
Amaute gilkial loin, dangtak lo ding uh a, huihsa le nisa in amaute sukha lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute a hehpih pa in amaute lamkaih ding a, ciktui kiangah amaute paipih ding hi.
"Keimah in ka mite a dingin mual liante kantanin lampi ka ziksak ding a, ka lam lianpite-ah phung ka ciang ding hi.
Ka mite a gamlapi panin hong pai ding uh a, leilu lam gam le nitumna lam gamte panin amaute hong pai-in, pawlkhatte, leitaw lam Siene gam panin hong ciah ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Vantungte aw, lungdamin la sa un. Leitung aw, lungdamin diang in. Mual liante aw, lungdamin la sa-in awngkhia un! Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in ama mite hehnem ta a, gimna a thuak ama mite hehpih ta ding hi.
Ahih hangin Jerusalem mite in, " Topa in eite hong nusia khin a, hong mangngilh khinta hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in, "Ama sung panin a suak a tapa a hehpih lo ding zahin nupi khat in ama nawi a teep naungek mangngilh thei ding ahi hiam? Hihte nangawn in mangngilhkha thei ding a, ahi zongin keimah in kong mangngilh kei ding hi.
Jerusalem aw, ka khutpeek sungah nang kong gelh khinzo a, nang ka hong mangngilh ngei kei ding hi.
"Nang a hong lam mite in nang a hong susiate nuaisiah khinta uh a, nang hong siasakte nang kiang panin taikhia khinta uh hi.
Na kimkotah khuadakto inla mu in. Na mi khempeuh hong kikhawm uh a, nangma kiangah amaute hong ciah uh hi. Kei pen a nungta Topa ka hih mah bangin, na mite khempeuh hangin nang na kisial ding a, mothak in kizepna-in a zat bangin amaute khempeuh na zang ding hi.
"A kisia, a kinusia khinsa nangma munte le a kisusia nangma gam pen nangma tungah a teng mite a dingin tu-in kawcik lua ta ding a, nang hong valhtum mite, gamlapi-ah om ding uh hi.
Na kikhen hun uh, salin a om sungun a suak mite in nangma kiangah, 'Kote a dingin mun kawcik lua hi; ka omna ding uh mun hong bawlsak in,' hong ci ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin na lungsimah, 'Kua in keima a dingin hih mite hong hinkhiatsak ahi hiam? Kei hong kinusia-in tang-awlin ka om a, salin hong kikoihin hong kipaikhiatpih hi. Hihte kua in hong khoisak ahi hiam? Keimah guakin hong kinusia hi. Tua ahih manin koi lai panin hihte hong piang ahi hiam?' na ci ding hi," a ci hi.
Topa Pasian in, "En in, minamte tungah ka khut ka laamto ding a, mite tungah ka lim ka lakto ding hi. Amaute in a angsung uhah na tapate tawi-in hong paipih ding uh a, a liangko tung uhah na tate hong pua ding uh hi.
Kumpite pen nang hong kem na pate hong hi ding a, kumpinute pen nang hong khoi na nute hong hi ding hi. Amaute in a maitang uh leilak ngatin nang kiangah hong kun ding uh a, na khe-a leivui baangte a liak ding uh hi. Tua ciangin kei pen Topa ka hihna na hong thei ding hi. Kei hong muangte maizum lo ding hi," a ci hi.
A thahatpa' kiang panin nate kilakhia zo ding a, thukhauh pa' mat mite kihonkhia zo ding ahi hiam?
Topa in, "A thahatpa' mat salte kilakhia ding a, a thukhauh pa' na kilakhia ding hi. Nang hong dem mite keimah in ka dem ding a, na tate ka honkhia ding hi.
Nang hong nengniam mite pen amau' satak mah ka nesak ding a, zukham bangin amau' si mah a kham ding uh hi. Tua ciangin kei pen Jakob' Vanglian Pa, nang hong Tankhiapa, nang hong Hon Topa ka hihna mi khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Topa in, "Amah ka ciahsakna, na nu a kimakna lai koi-ah om ahi hiam? Tua ahih kei leh nang kong zuakna ka leibatnate koi pan ahi hiam? Nomau mawhna hangin note hong kizuak a, nomau khialhna hangin na nu uh kipaikhiasak hi.
"Kong pai ciangin bang hangin mi khat zong om lo ahi hiam? Kong sap ciangin bang hangin hong dawng ding khat zong om lo ahi hiam? Hong hon zo lo zah dingin ka khut hat lo lua ahi hiam? Tua ahih kei leh zong note khahkhiatna ding vangliatna nei lo ka hi hiam? Keima taina tawh tuipi ka keusak a, gunte pen sehnel gam ka suaksak hi. Tui om loh manin a ngasate dangtakin si-in a uih gawp hi.
A lunggim mite ka thahatsak theih nadingin Topa Pasian in ka gen ding thu hong hilh khin hi. Ama hong hilhnate a ngai dingin zingsang simin lawpna hong guan hi.
Topa Pasian in thu theihtelna hong guan hi. Amah ka lehdo kei a, zong ka nungngat kei hi.
Hong satte, ka nung ka dawh a, ka khamul-in a hong kai mite, ka paang ka dawh hi. Maizumna le cilphihna panin ka maitang ka hei kei hi.
Topa Pasian in kei hong huh hi. Tua ahih ciangin cih nading thei loin ka om kei hi. Tua ahih manin ka thuak tentan a, hong maizumsak lo ding hi, ci-in ka thei hi.
Ka thumanna a langsak Pasian a nai-ah hong om hi. Keima langkhatah kua hong pangzo ding ahi hiam? Thukhen zumah kikhia nu'ng. Thukhen zumah kua in hong khia nuam ahi hiam? Kei hong langpang dingin hong kuan tahen.
Topa Pasian in kei hong huh hi. Kua in kei mawh hi, ci-in gen thei ding ahi hiam? Amaute khempeuh puan bangin paatkhia ding uh a, nget in amaute netum ding hi.
Topa kihta a, a nasempa' thu a mangte khempeuh khuamial sungah na pai hangun Topa muang unla, Pasian suanin nei un.
Midang suksiat ding a sawm mite aw, note' vaihawm siatna mah in note hong susia ding hi. Topa ' khut tung panin gimna thuakin na lumsuk ding uh hi.
Topa in, "Hotkhiat ding a ut, Topa a zongte aw, ngai un. Note hong ki-eu khiatna suangpi, note hong kitawhkhiatna khuk en un.
Na pa uh Abraham le note' pianna Sarah ngaihsun dih un. Bang hang hiam cih leh khat bek ahih laitakin amah ka samkhia a, amah thupha pia-in tampi ka phasak hi.
"Tu-in Zion ka hehnem ding hi. A kisia ama munte khempeuh puahpha-in, ama gamlakte Eden huansung ka bangsak ding a, ama sehnel gamte Topa ' huan ka bangsak ding hi. Ama sungah lungdamna le kipahna, lungdamkohna le lasakna awging om ding hi.
"Ka mite aw, ka thugen hong ngai un. Minamte tungah thu ka hilh a, keima thukham in amaute tungah khuavak tun ding hi.
Dakto-in vantungte en unla, leitung zong ensuk un. Bang hang hiam cih leh meikhu bangin vantungte mangthang hi. Puan bangin leitung paatkhia ding a, ama tunga tengte pen thokang bangin si ding uh hi. Ahih hangin keima hotkhiatna kip tawntung ding a, keima khahkhiatna bei ngei lo ding hi.
"Thuman a thei, na lungsim sung uhah keima thu a vom mite aw, ka thu ngai un. Mihingte' kosiatna kihta kei unla, amaute' hong simmawhna hangin lungkia kei un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nget in puan a nektum bangin amaute beimang ding a, lungno in samul puan a pehtum bangin amaute maimang ding uh hi. Ahih hangin keima khahkhiatna om tawntung ding a, khang tawntungin ka hotkhiatna kip ding hi," a ci hi.
Khanglo in, khanglo in; thakhauh in, Topa aw. Khang sawtpi, hun lui lai-a bangin na vangliatna zangin hong huh in. Rahab a satzan gawp pa, gulpi a sunpa, nangmah hi lo na hi hiam?
Tuipi, tuithukpite a keusak, a kihonkhia mite' kantan dingin tuithukpite lampi-in a bawlpa nangmah hi lo na hi hiam?
Topa ' mi a kithehthangte hong ciahkik ding a, lasakna tawh Zion-ah hong pai ding uh hi. A tawntungin amaute lungdam ding uh a, amaute in lungdamna le kipakna ngahin, dahna le khuisatna nei nawn lo ding uh hi.
Topa in, "Kei, keimah pen note hong hehnem pa ka hi hi. Lopa sangin sauvei a nungta zaw tuan lo, mihing lellelte, bang hangin kihta na hi uh hiam?
Vantungte zalin, lei bulpite a koih, note a hong bawl Topa hong mangngilh khinta na hi uh hiam? Note susia dingin a kithawi, no a hong nengniamte' hehna, bang hangin kihta-in lau tawntung na hi uh hiam? Amaute' hehna in note hong susiazo het lo ding hi.
Thong sunga kikhum mite kikhah baih ding hi. Amaute sauveipi nungta ding uh a, annek tuidawn kitasam lo ding uh hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh kei pen tuipi tokgawpin tuihualte a hawksak Topa , note' Pasian ka hi hi. Keima min pen Vanglian Topa ahi hi.
Vantungte zalin lei bulpi ka phut a, Zion kiangah, 'Nang pen keima mi na hi hi. Nang tungah thu kong hilh khin a, ka khut tawh nang ka hong hu hi,' ka ci hi," a ci hi.
Topa ' khutsung panin ama gimpiakna hai a dawn khin, hoina haipi a tawdat dongin a dawn khin Jerusalem aw, nangmah kisosuah tawm in. Nangmah kihanthawn tawm inla, dingtangto in.
Na mite khempeuh sung panin nang a hong makaih ding kuamah om lo a, na khoisa tapate khempeuh lak panin na khut a hong len ding kuamah om lo hi.
Nang tungah siatna le maimanna, kialpi le namsau, hih thu nih hong tungzo hi. Kua in nang hong dahpih ding ahi hiam? Kua in nang hong hehnem ding ahi hiam?
Na mite gim khin a, ngenthang sungah a awk sanang bangin lam kiu khempeuhah amaute lum uh hi. Topa ' hehna, na Pasian' taina amaute in a thuak uh hi.
Ama mite a dingin a thumsak Topa , Topa ahi note' Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: "En un, note' khutsung panin hoina hai ka lakhia khin a, ka hehna haipi na dawn nawn kei ding uh hi.
Note kiangah, 'Na tung uhah kong pai theih nadingun kunsuk un,' a hong ci, no a hong bawlsiate' khut sungah tua haipi ka koih ding hi. Note in na nungzang uh leilak bangin bawlin, amaute' pai nadingin kongzing lampi bangin na bawl khin uh hi," a ci hi.
Zion aw, khanglo in; khanglo inla na tha khauhsak in. Khuapi siangtho Jerusalem aw, na puan hoihte silh in. Bang hang hiam cih leh dawibia mite le a nin mite nang sungah hong pai nawn lo ding hi.
A kimancip Jerusalem mite aw, leivui panin kisingkhia unla dingto un. A kiman Zion mite aw, na ngawng panun hong kihenna khaute sutkhia un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in, "Man nei loin note hong kizuak a, sum pia loin note hong kitankhia ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: Egypt gamah peemta dingin ka mite a masa-in pai uh a, tua banah thu om lopi-in Assiria in amaute nengniam uh hi.
Tu-in Babylon-ah tua bangmahin amaute tungah piang leuleu hi. Thu om lopi-in salin om uh hi. Amau a ukte, kihihsakna tawh awng uh a, sunthapai-in keima min kisimmawh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka mite in keima min hong thei ding uh a, thu a gen pa pen keimah ka hihna tua ni ciangin amaute in hong thei ding uh hi. Keimah, hih lai-ah ka om hi," a ci hi.
Thuhoih hong puak, kilemna thu a genzak, thuhoih thupha a hong puak, hotkhiatna thu a genzak, Zion tungah, "Na Pasian in uk hi," ci-in mualte kantanin thu hong gen kamtai pa bangzahin hoih ahi hiam?
Ngai un, na galvilte un a aw uh sangsak a, amaute in lungdamin la sa khawm uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Zion-ah Topa hong paikikna amaute in maitang kituahin a mu uh hi.
A kisia Jerusalem munte aw, la sa-in kiko khawm un. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in ama mite hehnemta a, Jerusalem honkhia khinta hi.
Topa in minam khempeuh mai-ah a vangliatna siangtho zangin ama mite honkhia hi. Leitung mi khempeuh in i Pasian' hotkhiatna mu ding uh hi.
Kihem un, kihem un. Babylon panin paikhia unla, a nin nate lawng kei un. Topa ' beellekuang a puate aw, khuasung panin paikhia unla, nomau kisiansuah tawm un.
Note' mai-ah Topa pai ding a, Israel Pasian pen note' nungah hong cing pa hi ding ahih manin note galtai-in paikhia loin, a kinawhsa-in na paikhia kei ding uh hi.
Topa in, "En un; ka nasempa a dau pai-in, amah a lianin kikoihin kilaamto ding a, sang mahmah ding hi.
Mi tampite in amah lamdang sa uh hi. Mihing a bang nawn lo zah dongin nakpitakin a mai sia a, mihing a sun nawn lo zah dongin a mel a sia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in minam tampite dipkuasak ding a, ama hangin kumpite in a kam uh cih ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute tungah a kigen ngei lo nate mu ding uh a, amaute in a zak ngei loh uh nate theitel ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mite in, "I zak thu kua in um thei ding ahi hiam? Hih bang thu-ah Topa ' vangliatna khut kua in bangci muh theih ding ahi hiam?
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah pen kungno khat ahi a, lei keu sungah a om singzung khat bangin ahi zongin ama mai-ah khangto lel hi. Eite' et dingin amah in lim le deihhuaina mel bangmah nei lo a, eite' deih dingin hoihna nei lo hi.
Amah pen mite in simmawhin nusia a, gimna le natna a thuak ahi hi. Mite in en nuam loin a mai uh a humsan uh mipa bangin amah kisimmawh a, eite in amah i thusim kei hi.
"Amah in eite' natna teng thuakin, eite' gimna teng pua khin taktak hi. Ahi zongin eite in amah pen ama mawhna hangin Pasian in a gimsak, gimna a thuak bangin i ngaihsun hi.
Ahih hangin eite' khialhna hangin amah kiliamsak a, eite' mawhna hangin amah kisatnim hi. Ama gim thuakna hangin nopna i ngah a, ama liamna hangin damna i ngah hi.
Eite khempeuh in tuu bangin lam i khial khin a, eite khempeuh eimau san ciatah i pai khin hi. Topa in eite khempeuh' mawhnate ama tungah a suan hi.
"Amah kinengniamin gimna a kithuaksak hangin amah kam khat beek pau lo hi. Sa gote kiangah a kipaipih tuuno le a mulmette mai-ah a kipaipih tuu a ham loh mah bangin amah kam khat beek pau lo hi.
Nenniamna le thukhenna tawh amah kipaikhiatpih hi. A hingte' gam panin amah kikhenkhia-in, ama mite' khialhna hangin amah in gimna thuak hi, ci-in ama khang mite kua in thei ahi hiam?
Amah in mawhna bawl lo, zuau gen ngei lo napi-in, amaute in migilote tawh sihna a kibang, mihaute tawh hankhuk a kibang a bawlsak uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin amah a kisatnim ding pen Topa ' deihna ahi hi. Amah in natna thuaksak hi. Mawhna hangin ama pumpi a kipiak ciangin amah in a suanlekhakte mu ding a, ama khan a sau ding hi. Topa ' deihna ama khut sungah pung ding hi.
Amah in a gimna thaman mu-in a lungdam ding hi. A mawk thuak ahihlohna thei-in a thuman ka nasempa in mi tampi tak a dik suaksak ding a, amah in amaute' mawhnate pua ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah pen miliante tawh nate ka hawmsak ding a, amah in mihatte tawh nate a hawm ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in sihna dongin a nuntakna piakhia a, khialhna a nei mite tawh a kisim khawm hi. Ahih hangin amah in mi tampi' mawhna pua a, khialhna a neite a dingin a thumsak hi.
Ta a nei lo, a ciing mi aw, lungdamin la sa in. Nausuak natna a thuak ngei lo mi aw, la sa khia inla, a gingin kiko in! Bang hang hiam cih leh a kinusia numei' tate pen a kitenpih numeite' tate sangin tamzaw ding hi, Topa in ci hi.
Na bukmun khan inla, na tenna puanbukte kizalsak in. Cil bawl kei in. Na khaute sausak inla, na khetphimte khenkip in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh taklam le veilamah nangmah kizelin, na suanlekhakte in minam dangte' leitang luah ding uh a, a kinusia khuapite mi tawh dimsak ding uh hi.
Lau kei in, maizumna na thuak kei ding hi. Cihna ding thei loin om kei in; maizumin nang hong kikoih lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh na khangno lai-in na zulhtatna le na meigonna hangin hong kikonate na phawkkha nawn kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah hong Bawlpa pen nang a dingin na pasal bang hi ding a, ama min pen Vanglian Topa ahi hi. Israel-te' Siangtho Pa pen nang hong honkhia pa hi a, amah pen leitung buppi' Pasian a kici hi.
Khangno lai-a zineih a kima, kinusia-in a dah mahmah zi a kisamkik bangin Topa in nang hong samkik hi, na Pasian in ci hi.
Hehluatna hangin tomno sung nang kiang panin ka maitang ka seel a, ahih hangin tawntung itna tawh nang kong hehpih kik ding hi, nangmah a hong honkhia Topa in ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh hih pen kei a dingin Noah' hun mah tawh a kibang hi. Noah tuite leitungah hong pai nawn lo ding, ci-in ka kiciam mah bangin nang tungah heh nawn loin nang a hong tai nawn lo dingin ka kiciam hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh mual liante kihemin, mual neute a kikhin zongin nang kiang panin ka itna kip paikhia ngei lo ding a, na nopsakna ding ka thuciamna kinlo ding hi, nang a hong hehpih Topa in ci hi.
"Gimna a thuak, huihpi' nawkgawp, hehnepna a ngah lo khuapi aw, en in, na suangte, suangvui hoih tawh ka ciang ding a, na bulpite suangmanpha tawh ka hih ding hi.
Na khumdawnte suangmanpha tawh, na kulhkongpite suangsan tawh, na kulh khempeuh a manpha suang tawh ka bawl ding hi.
" Topa in na tapate khempeuh hoihtakin hilh ding a, na tapate daupai mahmah ding uh hi.
Thuman le thutang in nang hong thahatsak ding hi. Nenniamna tawh na kigamla ding a, nang na lau kei ding hi. Kihtakna tawh na kigamla ding a, nangma nai-ah tuate hong pai lo ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh in note tawh kidona a piansak leh tua pen keima kiang pan hi lo hi. Note tawh kidona a piangsak peuhmah note' hangin puk ding uh hi.
"En un, pum zapin ama kizatna ding ciatin a seek dingin hiam a bawl sikseekpa ka piangsak khin hi. A susia dingin a susia gawp thei pa zong ka piangsak khin hi.
Nangmah do nadingin a kibawl hiam peuhmah maavang lo ding a, thukhenna sungah na langah a pang mi khempeuh na nialgawpzo ding hi. Hih thu pen Topa ' nasemte' gamhluah le keima kiang panin amaute' dikna a kilahna ahi hi, Topa in ci hi," a ci hi.
A dangtak mi peuhmah tui phualah hong pai un. An nei lote aw, hong pai unla hong ne un! Hong pai un; a man ding bangmah piak kul loin leenggahzu le bawngnawi na duh zahzah uh hong ne un.
An ahi lo nate lei nadingin bang hangin na sum uh zang a, hong gilvahsak thei lo nate ngah nadingin bang hangin na sem na hi uh hiam? Keima thu limtakin ngai-in a limci an ne unla, anlimte ah nuamsa-in om un.
Ka mite aw, ka thu ngai unla, kei kiangah hong pai un. Na nuntak theih nadingun a thu hong za un. David ka it mah bangin keima itna kip, tawntung thuciamna note tawh ka bawl ding hi.
David pen mite tungah teci ding, mite a makai ding le a ukpa dingin ka koih hi.
Tu-in note in na theih ngei loh uh minam dangte na sam ding uh a, amah in note hong minthangsak zo ahih manin, Topa note' Pasian, Israel-te' Siangtho Pa' hangin note hong thei lo minamte note kiangah hong tai ding uh hi.
A kimuh thei hun lai-in Topa zong unla amah a nai om lai-in thu ngen un.
Migilo in ama gitlohna nusia hen la, thuman lo mi in ama ngaihsutna nusia hen. Amah in a hehpih theih nadingin Topa eite' Pasian' kiangah amah paisak un. Bang hang hiam cih leh a mawhna maisiangsak ding hi.
