Tua ciangin Topa in hih bangin hong musak hi: Khaukhai zangin a kiciang kulh gei khatah, Topa a ding ka mu a, a khut sungah khaukhai khat a tawi hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in kei kiangah, "Amos aw, bang na mu hiam?" hong ci hi. Kei zong dawngin, "Khaukhai khat mu ing," ka ci hi. Tua ciangin Topa in, "En in, ka mi Israel-te a khialhna uh a kitheih nadingin hih khaukhai tawh ka en hi. Amaute gim ka piak ding ka khiakik nawn kei ding hi.
Isaac' suanlekhakte' biakna munte kinusiacipin, Israel mite' siangtho munte kisusia ding a, Kumpi Jeroboam' innkuante a simgawp dingin gal ka kuansak ding hi," a hong ci hi.
Bethel-ah a om siampi nasem Amaziah in Israel Kumpi Jeroboam kiangah thu puak a, "Amos in Israel mite lakah nang hong sawm hi. Ama thugen in i gam sung siasak ding hi.
Amah in hih bangin thu gen a, 'Gal sungah Jeroboam si ding a, Israel mite amau' gam panin salin kipaikhiatpih ding hi,' ci hi," ci-in a khia hi.
Tua ciangin Amaziah in Amos kiangah, "Kamsang kineih pa aw, na Judah gamah ciah inla, tua lai-ah na nuntakna ding na semin, thu va gen in.
Hih lai pen kumpipa' biakinn mun, minam bup biakinn mun ahih manin Bethel-ah thu hong gen nawn kei in," a ci hi.
Amos in Amaziah dawng a, "Kei pen kamsang ka hi kei a, kamsangte' ta zong ka hi beek kei hi. Kei pen tuucing ka hi a, theithek huan puah tawh a thuahkhawm ka hi hi.
Ka tuucinna panin Topa in kei hong samkhia a, ama mi Israel-te tungah thugen dingin a hong sawl hi.
Tu-in Topa' thugen ngai in. Israel mite' langkhatah thu ka gen ding na hong kho a, Isaac' suanlekhakte' langkhatah thu ka gen ding na hong kham hi.
Amaziah aw, tua bangin kampau na hih manin Topa in nang kiangah, 'Na zi pen khua sungah numei paktat suak ding a, gal sungah na tate si ding uh hi. Na gam kiphelkhamin midang tungah kipia ding a, lawkite' gam sungah nang na si ding hi. Israel mite, galmatin kipaipih ding hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Topa in, "Amos aw, bang na mu hiam?" hong ci hi. "Seeng sunga kikoih singgah min ka mu hi," ci-in kei zong ka dawng hi. Tua ciangin Topa in, "Ka mi Israel-te a dingin a bei hun uh tungta hi. Amaute gim ka piak ding ka khawl nawn kei ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin kumpi inn-ah lungdam lasakna awgingte, kahna awging suak ding hi. Mun khempeuhah misi dim ding a, mun citengah kipaithangin gamdai ding hi," Topa in ci hi.
Mi cimawhte tuancil gawpin, gam sung mizawngte a susiagawp mite aw, hih thu ngai un:
Note in na lungsim sung uhah, "I ante i zuak theih nadingin zumkhak hun bei ding i ngaklah hi. I mangbuhte i zuaktheih nadingin cik ciangin Sabbath ni bei ding ahi hiam? I antehna seu neuseekin sum tampi i ngen nuam a, tawikhaina man lo zangin a hong leite i khem nuam hi.
Khedap bu khat man dingin mizawngte sila-in i zuak nuam a, i mangbuh hoih lote sum tampi i khawng nuam hi," na ci uh hi.
Topa, Israel Pasian kiciam a, "Na gamtatsiatnate uh ka mangngilh ngei kei ding hi.
Tua ahih manin zin hong ling ding a, leitung a om mi khempeuh a kap ding uh hi. Nail Gunpi bangin leitung khempeuh khangto-in kiamsuk ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin sunkim laipi mahin ni ka tumsak ding a, sunkim laipi mahin leitung khempeuhah khua ka mialsak ding hi. Topa Pasian ahi keimah in hih thu kong gen khin hi.
Na lungdam pawite uh dahna ka suaksak ding a, na lasaknate uh kahna awging ka suaksak ding hi. Dahna limin puanhampi na silh ding uh a, na sam uh zong na mettol ding uh hi. A tapa khat neihsun a sihsuah nupa na bang ding uh hi. Tua hun pen a tawp dongin nasia semsem ding hi.
"Keimah in leitungah kialpi kong tunsak hun hong tung ding hi. Tua kialpi pen anletui duhna kialpi hi lo ding a, Topa' thu zaknop mahmahna kialpi hi ding hi. Topa Pasian ahi keimah in hih thu kong gen khin hi.
Mihingte, leilu pan leitaw dong, Topa' thu kanin vak kawikawi ding uh a, ahi zongin mu zo lo ding uh hi.
Tua ni ciangin nungakte le tangvalte dangtakin puk ding uh hi.
Samaria milim pasian Ashimah min tawh kiciam a, 'Dan khuapi pasian a nungta ahih mah bangin,' le 'Beersheba khuapi pasian a nungta ahih mah bangin,' a ci mite pukin thokik nawn lo ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Biakna tau gei-ah Topa a ding ka mu a, hih bangin thu hong pia hi: "Biakinn bulpi khempeuh a kilin' theih nadingin biakinn khuampiluzang nakpitakin satgawp in. Tuate satkham inla, mite' luzang tusak in. Tua lai panin a suakta teng gal sungah ka sisak ding hi. A taikhia, a suakta, kuamah om lo ding hi.
Lei tosukin misite' omna Leinuai-ah a va tun uh hangin tua lai-ah amaute ka su ding a, vantungah a kahtoh uh hangin zong, tua lai mahah amaute ka su veve ding hi.
Karmel mual dawnah a buk uh hangin, amaute zongin ka mankhia ding a, keima kiang panin tuipi tawng sungah bu ta le-uh zong, tuipi gulpite in a tukna ding thu ka pia ding hi.
Galte in a sal dingin hingmat ta le-uh zong, namsau tawh a thah nadingun thu ka pia ding hi. Amaute' hoihna ding ngaihsun hetloin, amaute suksiat ding ka sawm hi," a ci hi.
Vanglian Topa Pasian in leitung a lawn' ciangin tuisuak a, leitung a om mi khempeuh a kap uh hi. Nail Gunpi bangin leitung buppi khangto-in kiamsuk ding hi.
Topa in vantungah a inndeite bawl a, van kuumpi tawh leitung a khuhsuk hi. Amah in tuipi panin tuite samkhia a, leitung khempeuhah tua tuite a sung hi. Hih bangin a bawlpa' min pen Topa ahi hi.
Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Israel mite aw, Ethiopia mite tawh a kibangin note ka hong bawl a, Egypt gam panin note kong paikhiatpih bangin, Kaftor gam panin Filistia mite ka paikhiatpih a, Kir gam panin Syria mite ka paikhiatpih hi.
Keimah in hih a khial Israel kumpi gam ka encik a, hih leitung panin amaute ka susia ding hi. Ahi zongin a vekpi-un susiamang loin pawlkhat ka sitlai ding hi.
Keima mite' sung panin, "I tungah siatna hong tung ngei lo ding hi," a ci mawhneite khempeuh, gal sungah si ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin inn tawh kibangin a siasa David ukna gam keimah in ka puahkik ding a, a vang teng hu-in, a sia teng ka puahkik ding a, a nidanga a ngeina lui mah uh ka bangsakkik ding hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite in Edom gam a omlaiteng le keima mi ahi ngei minam khempeuh zo-in ngahkik ding uh hi, Topa in ci hi.
Topa in hih bangin ci hi: An a kihauh luat manin, anlak a kizawh ma-in lo khawhkik hun tungin, leenggahte, leenggahzu a bawl a kizawh ma-in a suankik hun hong tun ding, hun nuam hong tungta ding hi. Mual lian khempeuh panin leenggahzu khum hong taakkhia-in, mual neu khempeuh tungah leenggahzu a luang ding hi.
Ka mi Israel-te, amau' gam ka tunkik ding a, a kisia a khuapite uh hoihtakin lampha kikin a sungah a teng ding uh hi. Amaute in leenggui suanin, huan bawlin, a sunga piangte a ne ding uh hi.
Amaute a dingin ka piak gam sungah amaute ka koihkik ding a, tua ka piaksa gam panin kuamah in amaute lakhia kik nawn lo ding hi, Topa, note' Pasian in ci hi, a ci hi.
Obadiah' genkholhna: Edom gam tawh kisai-in Topa Pasian in hih bangin gen hi: Minamte lakah kamtai khat kisawlzo a, "Kithawi un! Edom mite a simgawp dingin kuankhia ni," a cihna thu ka zazo hi.
En un, minamte lakah note kong neusak ding a, nakpitakin hong kisimmawh ding hi.
Na lungsim kiphatsakna un note a hong khemzo hi. Note in suang kulhpi beelin mual dawnah na ten manun, "Kua in eite hong puksakzo ding ahi hiam?" ci-in na ngaihsun uh hi.
Muvanlai bangin sangpi-ah leengin, aksite lakah bu na bawl hangun no kong khiasuk veve ding hi, Topa in a ci hi.
Zanin na kiangah gutate le misuamte hong pai-in supna tampi na thuak hangin a deihteng bek uh hong guksak ding hi lo ahi hiam? Leenggah late in lolai-ah a sangte nusia laitei hi lo ahi uh hiam?
Ahih hangin Esau kibuluh khinzo a, a sum a pai khempeuh a kilaksak zo hi.
Na pawl teng in nang hong khemzo uh a, gamgi ciang dong hong hawlkhiazo uh a, na pawl teng in a hong zo khinta uh hi. Na ankuang umpihte in na nuai-ah thang hong siah khin uh a, "A pilna koi-ah om ahi hiam?" a hong ci uh hi.
Topa in: "Tua ni ciangin Edom sung pan a mipilte ka susia ding a, Esau' gamah pilna ka beisak ding hi," a ci hi.
Teman khua aw, Esau' gamah mi khempeuh a kithahlup khit nadingin na galhangte a meidawi ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh na sanggampa Jakob bawlsia-in na thahna hangin maizumna in nang hong khuh ding a, na khantawnin na mangthang ding hi.
Namdangte in a neihsateng a puakkhiat ni-in gamdang mite a kongpi sungah a lut ni-in, Jerusalem-a vante hawmna ding ai a san ni-in, nangmah in gal et bek na hih manin nang zong a thukimpih na hi hi.
Na sanggamte uh a tuahsiat ni-in mu nuam dah hoh un. Judah mite a kisiat ni-in lungdamin nuam kei un. A kisiat ni-in lungdam kei un. A cihmawh ni-in nuihsan kei un.
Ka mite in haksatna a tuah ni-in a kongpi sungah tum kei un. A tuahsiat ni-in a thuaknate uh mu nuam kei un. A tuahsiat ni-in a sum a paite uh laksak kei un.
A suakta sunte a khaktan dingin na ding kei ding uh hi. A cihmawh ni-in a hinglai sunteng, a galte' khut sungah na pia kei ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh minam kimte tungah ka thukhenna ding ni a naizo hi. Nang bawl bangin nangma tungah hong kibawl ding hi. Na hih bangin na lu bukah hong tukik ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka mual siangtho tungah na thuak mah bangun, na kiim na pama om minamte khempeuh in zong ka gimpiakna a thuak ding uh hi. Thuak tawntung ding uh a, maimang ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin Zion mualah pawlkhat va tai ding uh a, tua mun pen a siangtho suak ding hi. Jakob innkuante in amau' gam mah luahkik ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jakob innkuante mei bang ding uh a, Josef innkuante meikuang bang ding uh hi. Esau innkuante ninpa bang hi ding uh a, amaute in a hal ding uh hi. Amaute kangtum khin ding uh a, Esau innkuante khat zong a suakta kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in a genzo hi.
Negeb gammite in Esau' gam luah ding uh a, Shefelah mite in Filistia gam luah ding uh hi. Amaute in Efraim gam le Samaria gam luah ding uh a, Benjamin in Gilead gam luah ding hi.
Israel mi salin a omte in Kanaan gam Zarefat ciang dong luah ding uh a, Jerusalem mi, Sardis khua-ah salin a omte in Negeb gam khuapite a la ding uh hi.
A gualzo Jerusalem khuamite in Esau' gam simin uk ding uh a, tua gam pen Topa' gam ahi ding hi.
"Kithawi inla, a lian mahmah Nineveh khuapi-ah va pai-in thu va hilh in; bang hang hiam cih leh amau' gitlohna thu ka za khinzo hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Topa' kiang pan Jonah taikhia-in Tarshish khua lamah a taisim dingin a kithawi zawsop hi. Joppa khua-ah paisuk a, Tarshish khua a zuan ding teembaw khat a mu hi. A sap man ding pia-in a tungah kah a, Topa' kiang pan a taikhia dingin teembaw hawlte tawh Tarshish khua-ah a pai hi.
Ahih hangin Topa in tuipi tungah huih nakpi-in nungsak a, huihpi hatlua ahih manin teembaw a kisia dekdek hi.
Tua ciangin teembaw hawlte lau uh a, a pasian ciat uh' kiangah a kiko ciat uh hi. Teembaw a zantuam nadingin a sunga vante tuipi sungah a paai uh hi. Tua bang hinapi-in teembaw sungtawng lamah Jonah na lutsukin a na ihmu hithiat hi.
Teembaw ukpa in amah a muh ciangin, "Ihmu pa aw, bang na cihna ahi hiam? Tho inla na pasian kiangah thu ngen in. I sih loh nadingin amah in eite hong ngaihsun khathei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin teembaw hawlte in, "Hong pai dih un. Kua' hangin hih bang gimna ei' tungah hong tung ahi hiam, cih i theih nadingin ai san dih ni," ci-in khatlekhat a kikum uh hi. Ai a san uhleh Jonah tung a tu hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Bang hangin hih gimna ei' tungah hong tung ahi hiam, hong gen in. Na nasep bang ahi hiam? Koi lai pana hong pai na hi hiam? Na gam bang ahi hiam? Kua minam na hi hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Amah in, "Kei pen Hebru mi ka hi hi; tuipi le leitang a bawl, vantungte' Pasian ahi Topa ka bia hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua mite lau mahmah uh a, "Bang hangin hih bangin gamta mawk na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa' kiang pan amah a taikhiasim ahihlam a gen khitsa ahih manin a thei khinzo uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Ei a dingin tuipi a hong daihtheih nadingin nang bang kong cih ding uh hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh huihpi lauhuai semsem hi.
Amah in, "Hong domto unla, tuipi sungah hong khia un; tua hileh no a dingin tuipi a hong dai ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh hih huihpi na thuakna uh keima hang ahi hi, cih ka thei hi," ci-in a dawngkik hi.
Tua bang a cih hangin amaute in teembaw a khawlsak dingin hahkatin lei lamah a hot teitei uh hi. Ahih hangin a hihzo kei uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh huihpi a hat semsem hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa' kiangah amaute kiko-in, " Topa aw, hih mipa ka sihsak manun kote hong sisak kei inla, mi that hi, ci-in hong ngawh kei ta in, ci-in kong thum uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Topa aw, nangmah in pha na sak banga na bawl ahi hi," ci-in thu a ngen uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jonah domto-in tuipi sungah a khiat uhleh tuipi a dai pah hi.
Tua ciangin tua mite in Topa kihta mahmah uh a, Topa' tungah biakna pia-in thuciamna a bawl uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jonah a nawmvalh dingin Topa in ngapi khat a geelkholhsa hi a, tua ngapi' gil sungah Jonah sun thum le zan thum sung a om hi.
Tua ciangin Jonah in tua ngapi' gil sung panin Topa a Pasian kiangah thu ngen a,
"Ka cihmawhna panin Topa ka sam a, amah in kei hong dawng hi. Sihna gam Sheol panin kong kiko a, nangmah in ka aw nong za hi.
Tuipi thuk sungah kei nong khia a, tui in kei hong tuumcip hi. Na tuihualte khempeuh in kei hong tum hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, 'Na omna panin kei hong kihawlkhia hi. Na biakinn siangtho hong koici et kik thei ding ka hi hiam?' ka ci hi.
Tui in kei hong tuamcip a, ka kimkotah hong umcih hi. Tuipi tunga lopate in ka lu hong vialcip hi.
Mualte' bul tuipi taw dong ka va paisuk a, kong hong kikhaknelh tawntungna mun ka tun hangin tua Leihawmpi sung panin a nungta-in nong lato veve hi, Topa ka Pasian aw.
Kei ka lung a kiat ciangin Topa kong phawk a, ka thungetna, na biakinn siangtho sung, nangma kiang hong tung hi.
Kimanna a nei lo milim a biate in nangmah hong taisan uh hi.
Ahih hangin ke'n ahihleh lungdamna aw tawh biakna kong pia ding a, ka ciamsa thu ka tangtungsak ding hi. Topa' kiang pan hotkhiatna hong pai hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Jonah tungah a nihveina thu gen a,
"Kithawi inla, a lian mahmah Nineveh khuapi-ah va pai-in kong gensa thu taangko in," a ci hi.
Jonah zong kithawi pah a, Topa' cih bangin Nineveh khua-ah a pai hi. Nineveh khua pen khuapi lian mahmah khat hi a, ni thum sung tak kikantan hi.
Jonah zong khuasung lam manawhin kipan a, ni khat sung lam a pai khit ciangin, "Ni sawmli khit ciangin hih Nineveh khuapi kisusia ding hi," ci-in a kiko hi.
Nineveh khuamite kisikin Pasian um uh a, antan' ding thu thangsakin, a golpen pan a kipan a neupen dongin puanhampi a silh uh hi.
Nineveh khua kumpipa in tua thu a zak ciangin a kumpi tokhom tung pan dingkhia-in a kumpi puan suahkhia a, puanhampi silhin vut lakah a tu hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Nineveh khuasung khempeuhah thu thangsakin taangkosak a, "Kumpipa le uliante' thu tawh: Mihing ahi a, ganhing ahi zongin, bawnghon ahi a, tuuhon ahi zongin, kuamah in bangmah ciam thei lo ding, an ne thei lo ding, tui dawn thei lo ding uh hi.
Mihing le ganhingte in puanhampi silhin Pasian' tungah nakpi-in kiko ta uh hen. Mi khempeuh, a khialhnate uh le a gitlohnate uh panin kihei ta uh hen.
Eite i sih loh nadingin Pasian kisikin a hehna damsak lo ding hi, kua in ci thei na hi uh hiam?" a cisak hi.
Pasian in amau' hihnate mu a, a khialhna uh panin a kihei uh a muh ciangin kisik a, amau tungah hih dingin a cihsa siatna a tungsak nawn kei hi.
Ahih hangin tua thu hangin Jonah lungkim hetloin a heh hi.
Topa' kiangah thu ngen a, "Kong thum hi, Topa aw; ka gam sungah ka omlai pekin hici mah in teh, ci hi lo ka hi hiam? Hanciamin Tarshish khua-ah ka taisimna zong tua hang mah ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen a hehpih thei Pasian, a hehhak, a migi mahmah, siatna tunsak ding a kisiknuam Pasian na hihna kong thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa aw, tu-in ka nuntakna hong la in, ci-in kong thum hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka nuntak sangin sileng kei a dingin a hoihzaw hi," a ci hi.
Topa in zong, "Na heh ding kilawm sa na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin khuapi pualamah Jonah paikhia a, nisuahna lamah ama a' ding bukno khat lamin tua lai-ah a tu hi. Tua khuapi bang hong ci ding hiam, cih a en dingin a buk liim nuai-ah tu-in a ngak hi.
Topa Pasian in zong Jonah a liah ding le a lungkhamna a tawldamsak dingin umgui khat a tungah a zaamsak hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua umgui hangin Jonah lungdam mahmah hi.
Ahih hangin a zingsang khuavak ciangin Pasian in tua umgui lungno khat nesak ahih manin a keu hi.
Ni hong suah ciangin Pasian in nisuahna lam panin huih a sa mahmah nungsak a, ni in zong Jonah' luzang kapsuk veva ahih manin a gim mahmah hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Ka nuntak sangin si leng kei a dingin hoihzaw hi," ci-in a sih nading thu a ngen hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian in Jonah kiangah, "Tua umgui hangin na heh ding kilawm sa na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Jonah in, "Ka heh ding kilawm sa tham loin hehlua-in ka si zongin kilawm ka sa veve hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in, "Nang in na gimpih lohpi, na khansak lohpi, zan khat thu-in hong piangin zan khat thu mahin a si tua umgui pammaih na sa hi.
Tua ahihleh keimah in ganhing tampi tham lo, a taklam khut le a veilam khut nangawn a khenthei nai lo naupang tul za le tul sawmnih sangin a tamzawte' tenna, a lian mahmah Nineveh khuapi pammaih sa lo ding ka hi hiam?" ci-in a dawngkik hi.
Judah gam kumpi Jotham, Ahaz, le Hezekiah-te' hun laitakin, Moresheth khuami Mikah tungah Topa in thu a pia hi. Samaria le Jerusalem tawh kisai-in Topa in Mikah tungah hih thute a lak hi.
No minam khempeuhte aw, hih thu za un: Leitungah a teng mi khempeuhte aw, hih thu ngai un: Note' langkhatah Topa Pasian in teci pang a, a vantung biakinn panin thu hong gen hi.
Meikhuk sungah khuainun a kikoih bangin ama khenuai-ah mualliante tuisuak ding a, mualtung panin tui a luangsuk bangin, guam sungah tua mualte luangsuk ding hi.
Pasian' tungah Israel-te' mawhna le a khialhnate uh hangin hih thute khempeuh a piang ahi hi. Israel-te' khialhna kua ngawh ding ihi hiam? Samaria mite ngawh ding ihi hiam? Judah gam sungah milim bia-in a khial kua ahi hiam? Jerusalem mite ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Samaria khuapi, gamlak a ninkholna mun, leenggui suanna mun lel dingin ka bawl ding hi. A khuasunga suangte zong guam sungah ka nilsuk ding a, a khuapi bulpite ka dawksak ding hi.
A milim manphate khempeuh kisuzan gawp ding a, mei tawh kisusia ding hi. Pasian' tungah a thuman lohna hangun mihingte in hih milimte nei uh ahih manin, a thuman lohna uh tawh kizui-in tu-in thuakkik ding uh hi, ci hi.
Tua ahih manin kei kapin ka thum ding a, ka dahna thu ka lah nadingin khe guak le guaktangin ka vak ding hi. Gam-ui bangin ka ham ding a, vasa-kalaoh bangin ka tau ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Samaria' meima kidamsak thei lo hi; Judah in zong tua bangmah a thuak ding ahi ta hi. Ka mite' tenna Jerusalem khua mahmah, tua siatna in hong ban ta hi.
I guallelhna thu Gath khuamite theisak kei unla, na kahna uh amaute musak kei un. Bethleafrah khua sungah na lungkhamna uh langsakin, leivui lakah kikhuk un.
Shafir khua-ah a teng mite aw, guaktangin maizumna tawh salin pai un. Zanaan khua-a teng mite, a hingin paikhia ngei lo ding hi. Bethezel khuamite' kahna le thumna na zak uh ciangin, tua khua sungah belh ding munmuanhuai a om lohna na thei ding uh hi.
Topa in Jerusalem kulhpi dongah gimna lianpi tungsak ta ahih manin Maroth khuamite nakpitakin patau uh hi.
Lakhish khua-ah a teng mite aw, na sakol galkapte uh a leeng bulh pak un. Note in Israel-te' khialhnateng zuikha na hih manun, Jerusalem zong a khialsakte na hi uh hi.
Tu-in no Judah mite aw, Moresethgath khua, mangpha khak un. Israel kumpite in Akzib khua panin huhna ngah lo ding hi.
Mareshah khuamite aw, note a hong zong ding pa ka hong paisak ding hi, Topa in ci hi. Adullam leihawm sungah Israel kumpipa bu ding hi.
Judah mite aw, na it mahmah na tate uh, sal a suak dingin hong kilaksak ding ahih manin, amaute' hangin na dahna limun na sam uh met unla, musane bangin na lu uh tolsak un.
A lupna tungah lumin gitlohna a geelgeelte in gimna ngah tahen. Zingsang khua a vak ciangin, hihtheih ding hun a ngah phetun, a ngaihsutsa uh gitlohna a semkhia uh hi.
Lo deih le-uh, mi-a' sut uh a, inn deih le-uh, mi-a' mah sut uh hi. Mite bawlsia-in, a inn le a neihsa uh a sut uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Note' tungah gimna tunsak ding ka ngaihsun a, tua gimna tawh na kipelh thei kei ding uh hi. Note a dingin hun hoih lo hi ding ahih manin kiphatsakna tawh na gamta nawn kei ding uh hi.
Tua bang hun hong tun ciangin mite in note' gim ngahna thugentehna-in zangin, dah la phuakin sa ding uh a, "Eite i sia khin taktak hi. Topa in i gam hong laksak a, ei a hong mante tungah hong piaksak hi," ci ding uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa' mite lakah leitang a kihawm ciangin, kuamah in leitang na ngah kei ding uh hi.
Amaute in kei kiangah, "Tua bang thu hong gen kei in. Tua bang thu gen dingin kilawm lo hi. Tua bangin Pasian in hong minsiasak lo ding hi," hong ci uh hi.
Israel mite aw, " Topa a lung tom ta a, hihte khempeuh, ama hong bawl mah ahi hiam?" na cih ding uh kilawm lo hi. Ka thugenna kammalte, a thuman mite a dingin a hoih hi lo ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin Topa in hih bangin hong ci hi: Note pen ka mite' gal na suak uh a, galsung panin a hong ciahkik, lungmuang a a inn-ah a om mite' puantualpi ngahte na sut uh hi.
Ka mihingte' numeite, amau' inn nuam panin na hawlkhia uh a, a tate un a ngah ding keima thuphate na taansak paisuak uh hi.
Tu-in ding unla paikhia un. Na khialhna hangun a lauhuai suksiatna tuak ding na hih manun, hih lai mun pen note a dingin mun nuam hi lo hi.
Zuau genin khemna tawh thu gen kawikawi a, "Note a dingin leenggahzu le khamtheihzu tampi tak hong om ding hi," a hong ci kamsangte pawl, note' deih kamsangte ahi hi.
Ahi zongin no Israel mi a omlaite khempeuh pel hetloin kong kaikhawm kik ding hi. Tuubuk sunga tuu khum bangin, gankhawk sungah tuuhon kaihkhop bangin note kong kaikhawm kik ding a, na gam sung uh, mi tampite' husa tawh kidimkik ding hi, ci hi.
Pasian in note a' ding lampi hong honsakin hong paikhiatpih ding hi. Salsuahna khuapikulh panin paikhia-in na suakta ding uh hi. Kumpi ahi Topa mahmah in note hong makai ding hi.
Israel a uk makaite aw, hih thu ngai un: Note in thutang thuman a deih dingin a kilawm hinapi-in,
thuhoih deih loin thusia na deih zawsop uh hi. Note in mite' vun na hing hawkkhiat uh a, a guh uh na hing kheuh uh hi.
Topa' tungah huhna ngenin na kiko hun uh hong tung ding a, ahi zongin amah in note hong dawng lo ding hi. Note gamtatsia na hih manun, na ngetna uh hong ngai lo ding hi.
Sum a piazo mite kiangah thunuam gen a, a pia lo mite kiangah gal tuah ding a gen kamsangte in mite lam a khialsak uh hi. Topa in tua bang kamsangte kiangah,
"Keima mite lam khialsak na hih manun mailam thu gentheihna maang na mu nawn kei ding uh a, mailam thu peuhmah na gen thei nawn kei ding uh hi. Kamsangte aw, note' hun beita ding a, ni in hong tumsan ta ding hi," ci hi.
Hih bang thugen kamsangte, a thugen kholhna uh Pasian in a tunsak loh manin maizumin mindai ding uh hi.

Tua ciangin Sheatiel' tapa Zerubbabel, Jehozadak' tapa Joshua ahi siampi lianpen pa, le salsuahna panin hong ciahkik mi khempeuh in Topa ahi amau' Pasian' thu mang uh a, Topa Pasian' kamtai ahi kamsang Haggai' gen bangin gamta-in, Topa zahtakin a lau uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' kamtai Haggai in mite tungah Topa' thugente gensawn a, " Topa in note kong ompih hi," ci hi, ci-in a gen hi.
Tua hi a, Topa in Judah gam ukpa Zerubbabel, siampi lianpen pa Joshua, le salsuahna panin a hong ciahkik mi khempeuh' sungah biakinn lamnopna lungsim a guan hi. Vanglian Topa , amau' Pasian' biakinn a lam dingin hong kithawi uh a,
Darias in kumpi a sep a kum nihna kum, a kha gukna a ni sawmnih le ni li ni-in biakinn lam hong kipan uh hi.
Tua kum mah, a kha sagihna, a ni sawmnih le ni khat ni-in kamsang Haggai tungah Topa in thu gen a,
Judah gam ukpa Zerubbabel, siampi lianpen pa Joshua, le mi khempeuh tungah thu a gen dingin sawl a,
"Nidanga biakinn a hoihna dan a ciamteh theilai na om uh hiam? Tu-in bangci na sa uh hiam? Note' muhna-ah a gen taak het lo tawh kibang ding hi.
Tu-in note kuamah lungkia kei un. Note tawh hong omkhawm ka hih manin nasep kipan un.
Egypt gam panin na paikhiat lai-un, note kong ompih tawntungna ding thu kong ciam hi. Tu-in zong note hong ompihlai ka hih manin lau kei un.
"A sawt loin vanpi le leipi, tuipi le leitung ka lokgawp ding hi.
Minam dang khempeuh lokgawp ding ka hih manin a neihsa uh sum le paite, hih munah hong kipuak ding a, biakinn sungah a dimin van hong om ding hi.
Leitung a a om ngun le kham khempeuh keima-a' ahi hi.
Biakinn thak pen a lui sangin hoihzaw-in thupizaw ding hi. Hih biakinn-ah cihtheihna le nopsakna kong pia ding hi," cisak hi.
Gam uk kumpipa Darias in a uk a kum nihna mah, a kha kuana a ni sawmnih le ni li ni-in kamsang Haggai tungah Topa in thu gen leuleu a,
Mi khatpeuh in biakna-a a kipia sa siangtho themkhat, a puantualpi thep kawmah puakha hen la, tua a puantualpi tawh anlum khat peuhpeuh ahi a, a kihuan an khat peuhpeuh ahi a, leenggahzu, ahih kei le oliv thau, ahih kei leh an nam khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin sukha leh, tua a sukkhak an pen biakna an siangtho a suak ding hiam?" ci-in a dongsak hi. Tua bangin a kidot ciangin siampite in, "Tua puantualpi in a sukkhak ante, biakna an siangtho suak tuan lo ding hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua ciangin Haggai in, "Mi khat in, misi tawh a kisukkhak manin mi nin a suah khit ciangin hih ante khat peuhpeuh lawngkha leh tua a lawnkhak ante a nin a suak ding hiam?" ci-in a dong hi. Siampite in, "A nin suak ding hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua ciangin Haggai in thu gen a, " Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Tu-a nong dawnna uh mah bangin hih minam dangte' sepna khempeuhah tua bangin piang ahih manin, biakna tau tungah a piak uh na khempeuh a nin suak hi.
"Note tungah a piangsa thute limtakin ngaihsun un. Topa' biakinn lam ding na kipat ma-un bangci na hi uh hiam?
An seu sawmnih pha ding ci-in ansal-ah na pai uh ciangin seu sawm bek na pha a, leenggahzu thawlpi sawmnga pha ding ci-in leenggahzu kholna beelpi-ah na pai uh ciangin thawlpi sawmnih dim bek a na pha hi.
Na an ciin khempeuh uh cingteek sakin ka kausansak a, tuate nangawn a susia dingin gialpi ka kiatsak hangin note na kisik nuam kei lailai uh hi.
Tu-in, kha kuana a ni sawmnih le ni li ni, biakinn bulpi a kiphuh khit, tuni a kipanin limtakin ngaihsun un.
Na ansal uhah na upmawhzah sangun an na tawmzaw lai ding ahi hiam? Leenggui le theikung, mang kawlsing le oliv kungte gah nai lo lai ding ahi hiam? Tua bang hi nawn lo ding a, tuni a kipanin note thupha kong pia ding hi, ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua kha a ni sawmnih le ni li ni mahin Topa in Haggai tungah a nihveina thu genkik a,
"Vanpi le leipi a lokgawp ding ka hihna thu, Judah gam ukpa Zerubbabel kiangah gen in.
Kumpipa' gam khempeuh lumletin a vangliatna uh a beisak ding ka hi hi. Leengte le leeng hawlte ka lawnthal ding a, sakol leengte le a tung tuangte puk ding uh a, amaute khatlekhat kithatlum ding uh hi.
Ka nasem Zerubbabel aw, tua ni ciangin nang hong la-in ka mite' kumpi dingin kong bawl ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen ka hong teelpa na hi hi, Vanglian Topa in ci hi, ci-in gen in," a ci hi.
Persia gam uk Kumpipa Darias in a uk a kum nihna, a kha giatna sungin Topa in kamsang Zekhariah tungah thu a gen hi. Zekhariah pen Berekhiah' tapa hi a, ama pu Iddo ahi hi.
Topa in Zekhariah kiangah, "Mite tungah hih bangin thu gen in: 'Na pu na pate uh tungah Topa ahi keimah ka heh mahmah hi.
Ahi zongin tu-in kei kiangah hong ciahkik le-uhcin, kei zong note kiangah kong paikik ding hi.
Na pu na pate uh bang nawn kei un. Nidanga kamsangte in amaute kiangah ka thu gen uh a, gamtatsia gamta loin, a mawh nawn loh nading hilh uh hi. Ahi zongin amaute in ka thu ngainuam loin, ka thu hong mang lo uh hi.
Tu-in na pu na pate uh koi-ah om ahi hiam? Tua kamsangte nungtalai sa na hi uh hiam?
Ahi zongin ka nasem ahi kamsangte' tungtawnin ka hilhkholhna le ka thupiaknate in note dongin hong sukhalo ding sa na hi uh hiam, ka ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin a tawpna-ah amaute kisik uh a, hih dinga ka lungsimah ka geelsa bangin amau' gamtatna tawh kizui-in gim a pia ka hihna thu a phawk uh hi,' ci in," a ci hi.
Darias in a uk a kum nihna kum, kha sawm le khatna ahi Shebat kha ni sawmnih le ni li ni-in Topa in kei tungah thu hong gen a, zanin maang hong musak hi.
Topa' vantungmi khat sakol san khat tungah a tuang ka mu hi. Kuam sunga a om mui singkungte lakah amah khawl a, ama nungah sakol dang a san, a gial, a kang om hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, "Sia aw, hih sakolte bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?" ci-in ka dong hi. Amah in hong dawng a, "Bang a cihnopna hiam cih kong lak ding hi.
Tua ciangin mui kung lakah a khawl Topa' vantung mite kiangah amaute in, "Leitung khempeuh ka en kawikawi khin uh a, leitung khempeuh khuaphawk loin nuamtakin om uh hi," ci-in thu a zasak uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' vantungmi in, "Vanglian Topa aw, Jerusalem khuapi le Judah gam khuapite tungah kum sawmsagih sung na heh khinta hi. Amaute hehpih loin bang tanvei omlai ding na hi hiam?" ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in dikna le hehnepna kam tawh vantung mite dawng a,
Vanglian Topa in ama tungah a gensa thute khempeuh keimah in ka taangko sawn nadingin tua vantungmi in kei hong sawl a, "Ka khuapi siangtho Jerusalem, nakpitakin itin ka lunghimawh hi.
Tua bangin nuamtakin a om hithiat minamte tungah ka heh mahmah hi. Ka mite tungah ka hehna ki-ip tentanin ka om laitakin, hih minam dangte in ka mite' gimna nasiasak semsem uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Jerusalem khuapi tungah ka hehpihna a lak dingin ka hong paikik hi. Tua khuapi sungah ka biakinn kilamkik ding a, khuapikulh zong kiciangkik ding hi, Vanglian Topa in ci hi, ci-in gen in," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin vantungmi in ka taangkona ding hong genkik leuleu a, "Ama khuapite nakpitakin cithei kikin, Jerusalem khuapi a hehnep kikna ding, le ama khuapi-in a neihkikna ding, Vanglian Topa in gen hi, ci-in gen in," hong ci hi.
Bang a cihnopna ahi hiam, ci-in vantungmi kiangah ka dong hi. Amah in hong dawng a, "Judah mite le Jerusalem mite a thehthang gawp leitung vangliatnate a cihnopna ahi hi," hong ci hi.
Hih mite, bang hih ding ahi hiam, ci-in ka dong hi. Amah in hong dawng a, "Hih saki lite in Judah mite thehthang gawp a, a lang uhah kuamah pang ngam lo ahih manin, Judah gam sugawpin a mite a thehthang gawp minamte, tu-in hih sek tawi lite in lausakin a lawnthal ding ahi hi," hong ci hi.
Koi-a pai ding na hi hiam, ci-in ka dot ciangin amah in, "Jerusalem khuapi a sauna ka theih nadingin a teh dingin a pai ding ka hi hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin vantung mipa hong paikhia a, vantung midang khat in amah na dawntuah hi.
Tua ciangin vantungmi a masa pa in a dawntuah pa kiangah, "Va tai inla, tehna khau a tawi tangvalpa kiangah hih thu va gen in. Jerusalem khua sungah mihing le ganhing tam mahmah ding ahih manin Jerusalem kulhhuam sungah ta zo lo ding uh hi.
Tua khuapi a hu dingin meikulh bangin Topa mahmah a omna ding, le tua khua sungah a minthanna tawh a tenna ding thu, Topa in kam ciamzo hi, ci-in va gen in," a ci hi.
Topa in ama mite kiangah, "Mun khempeuhah note kong thehthang khin hi. Ahi zongin tu-in Babylon panin taikhia-in Jerusalem-ah ciahkik un.
Babylon-ah a om mite aw, Zion-ah tai un," ci hi.
Topa mahmah in note hong su ding a, nidanga note' na hong sepsak mite in tu-in note' nate hong lehsuh kik ding uh hi, hong cisak hi. Hih bangin thu hong pian' ciangin Vanglian Topa in kei hong sawl ahih lamtak na thei ding uh hi.
Topa in hih bangin hong ci hi: "Jerusalem mite aw, lungdamin la sa un. Note tawh a hong omkhawm ta ding ka hi hi," ci hi.
Tua hun ciangin Topa kiangah minam tampi hong pai ding uh a, ama mite a suak ding uh hi. Topa in note hong ompih ding a, tua ciangin note kiangah kei a hong sawl ahihna thu na thei ding uh hi.
Judah mite pen gam siangtho sungah Topa' neihtuam hong suakkik ding a, Jerusalem khua pen ama it penpen khuapi hong hi kik ding hi.
Topa in maang hong musak a, Topa' vantungmi mai-ah siampi lianpen pa Joshua' mawhna a zong dingin a kiangah Satan zong a om ka mu hi.
Topa' vantungmi in Satan kiangah, "Satan aw, Topa in nang hong mawhsak hi. Jerusalem a it Topa in nang hong mawhsak hi. Hih Joshua pen meikhuk sung panin a kiteenkhia singkhuah tawh kibang hi," a ci hi.
Joshua ahihleh vantungmi mai-ah ding a, puan a nin mahmah a silh hi.
Vantung mi in ama sawltak van midangte kiangah, "Hih mipa' silh a puan ninte suahkhiatsak un," ci-in thu a pia hi. Tua ciangin vantungmi in Joshua kiangah, "Na mawhna teng kong paihkhiatsak khin a, tu-in na silh dingin puan thak ka hong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a sawltak van mite thu pia a, Joshua' lu tungah dial siangtho a khipsak ding uh a sawl hi. Topa' vantungmi tua munah a din sung mahin, amaute in zong Joshua, dial siangtho khimsakin, tua khit ciangin puan siangtho zong a silhsak uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' vantungmi in Joshua kiangah limtakin thu gen a,
Vanglian Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Ka thukhamte zui-in kong sawl thute na sep leh, ka biakinn sung le biakinn huang sungteng na uk ding a, hih ka kianga om vantung mite' thu ka ngaih bangin nangma thu zong ka hong ngai ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin siampi lianpen pa Joshua aw ngai in: Ama siampipih ahi no a dangte in zong ngai un. Note pen mailam thuhoihna ding lim na hi uh hi. Sing bangin A Sel a kici min nei khat kong paisak ding hi.
Joshua' omna mai-ah, mai sagih a nei suang khat ka koih hi; tua suang tungah lai ka gelh ding a, ni khat sungin hih gammite' mawhna ka paihkhiatsak ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin note khempeuh in leenggui le theikungte hau-in nuam na sa ding uh a, na vengte ciat un hong nekpihin hong lungdampihna dingun na sam ding uh hi, Vanglian Topa in ci hi," a ci hi.
Amah in, "Bang na mu hiam?" ci-in hong dong hi. Kei zong, "Kham tawh a kibawl meivakkhuam khat ka mu hi. Tua meivakkhuam in meivak sagih nei a, meivaktui koihna ding hai khat zong a khuam dawnah om hi. Tua meivak sagihte in meivakkhau nei ciat uh hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong vantungmi kiangah, "Sia aw, hihte bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?" ci-in ka dot ciangin
amah in, "A cihnopna thei lo na hi hiam?" ci-in hong dawng a, kei zong, "Sia aw, ka thei kei hi," ci-in ka dawngkik hi.
Tua ciangin vantungmi in kei kiangah, " Topa in Zerubbabel tungah hih bangin thu gen hi: Galkap tam neihna hang hi lo, nangma vangliatna hang zong hi lo, keima tung panin na ngah vangliatna bek tawh na ma na tunzo ding hi.
Thuhaksa pente nangawn in na ma hong khaktan zo lo ding hi. Biakinn na lamkik ding a, mite in, 'Hoih mahmah hi,' ci-in a ot ngeingai laitakin a khupna suang na ciang ding hi, hong ci hi," a ci hi.
Amah in, "Zerubbabel in biakinn bulpi phut khin a, biakinn lam zong a zo ding hi. Tua ciangin ka mite in, amaute kiangah nang kong sawlna thu hong thei ding uh hi.
A maa uh a telh loh manun ka mite lungkia uh a, ahi zongin Zerubbabel in biakinn lam nasep a makaihna a muh uh ciangin a lung uh damkik ding hi," hong ci hi. Vantung mi in, "Meivak sagihte pen, leitung khempeuh a etna Topa' mittang sagih ahi hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong ama kiangah, "Meivakkhuam pang tuak a om oliv kung nihte bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?
Oliv thau a luankhiatna kham tuizawl nihte' gei-a om oliv hiang nihte bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?" ci-in ka dong hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Leitung khempeuh' Topa' na a sem dingin Pasian in teelin sathau a nilh mi nihte a cihnopna ahi hi," hong ci hi.
Ka khuadak kik leh huihlakah a leeng laizial khat ka mu hi.
Vantung mi in, "Bang na mu hiam?" ci-in hong dong a, kei zong, "Laizial a leeng khat ka mu a, a dung pi sawmthum pha-in, a vai pi sawm le pi nga pha hi," ci-in ka dawng hi.
Tua ciangin amah in kei kiangah, "Leitung gam khempeuhah a tung ding hamsiatnate, hih lai tungah kigelh hi. Guta khempeuh, gam sung panin kisiakmang ding hi, ci-in laizial dal lang khatah kigelh a, a man lopi-in ka min tawh thuciam mi khempeuh zong kisiakkhia mang ding hi, ci-in a lang khatah kigelh hi.
Vanglian Topa in hih samsiatna a khahkhiatna ding thu gen a, guta mite khempeuh le a man loin ka min tawh thuciam mite khempeuh' inn sungah lut ding hi. Tua bang mite' inn sungah a tawntungin hamsiatna omin, amaute a kipan a sing a suang, a vekpi-in sumai ding hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin vantungmi hong kilang kikin kei kiangah, "Tu-a a hong pai ding en in," hong ci hi.
Kei zong, "Bang ahi hiam?" ci-in ka dong hi. Amah in hong dawng a, "Tua pen ciangpi hi a, gam sung khempeuh' mawhna lim ahi hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangpi siin pen haknaw tawh a kibawl ahi hi. Tua bangin ka et laitakin haknaw kibawl tua ciangpi siin pen kidomto a, tua ciangpi sungah numei khat a tu hi.
Tua ciangin vantungmi in, "Hih numei pen gitlohna lim ahi hi," hong ci hi. Tua ciangin vantungmi in ciangpi sungah tua numei hensuk kik a, a siin tawh tua ciangpi a siinkik hi.
Tua ciangin ka khuadak leh numei nih ka mu a, gun vapi bangin kha nei-in, keima lamah hong leeng uh hi. Van lamah tua ciangpi a leenpihto uh hi.
Tua ciangin vantungmi kiangah, "Koi lai-ah leenpih ding ahi uh hiam?" ci-in ka dot leh
amah in, "Biakinn khat a lamsak dingin Babylon gamah a leenpih ding ahi uh hi. Biakinn a lamsak uh a zawh uh ciangin, biak dingin tua ciangpi kikoih ding hi," ci-in a hong dawng hi.
Tua ciangin maang adang khat ka mu leuleu hi. Sumngo mual nih kikal panin sakolleeng li hong paikhia ka mu hi.
Tua ciangin vantungmi kiangah, "Sia aw, hih sakolleengte bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?" ci-in ka dong hi.
Tua ciangin amah in hong dawng a, "Hihte pen huihleeng li a cihnopna hi a, leitung khempeuhte' Topa' kiang panin a hong paikhia ahi uh hi," hong ci hi.
Sakol vomte in a kaih leeng pen leilu lam Babylon-ah a pai ding hi a, sakol kangte, nitumna lam, sakol gialte, leitaw lam, sakol sante, nisuahna lam gamah a pai ding ahi hi.
Tua sakolte, paikhia-in leitung teng a et ding uh ngaklah mahmah uh hi. Tua ahih manin vantungmi in, "Pai unla, leitungteng va en un," ci-in thu a pia hi. Amaute zong pai-in va en uh hi.
Tua ciangin vantungmi in kei hong otsan a, "Leilu lam Babylon gamah a paite in Topa' hehna damsak hi," hong ci hi.
Amah in, "Babylon gam salsuahna pan a hong ciahkik Heldai, Tobijah, le Jedaiah te' hong piak leengte la inla, tua na lak ni mahin Zefaniah' tapa Josiah' inn-ah paipih in.
Amaute' hong piak ngun le khamte zangin kumpi lukhu khat bawl in la, Jehozadak' tapa, siampi lianpen a sem Joshua khusak in.
Ama kiangah, 'Vanglian Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Hih mipa pen sing bangin A Sel a kici mipa ahi hi. A omna peuhpeuhah amah cithei ding a, Topa' biakinn lamkik ding hi.
Amah pen Topa' biakinn a lam ding pa hi a, kumpite' ngah theih minliatna ngahin, ama mite uk ding hi. Ama kumpi tokhom gei-ah siampi khat om ding a, kithutuakin, kilemin na semkhawm ding uh hi," ci hi,' va ci in.
Tua kumpi lukhu pen Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, le Josiah-te pahtawi-in phawk nadingin biakinn sungah om ding hi," hong ci hi.
Gamlapi-a a teng mite hong pai-in Topa' innlam nasep hong huh ding uh hi. Tua biakinn a kilamkik ciangin Vanglian Topa in note kiangah kei a hong sawl ahihna thu na thei ding uh hi. Topa na Pasian uh' thupiaknate cingtakin na zuih nak-uhleh tu-a ka gen bangin a hong piang ding ahi hi.
Bethel khuamite in, Topa' tung panin thupha a ngen ding, le Vanglian Topa' biakinn sunga a om siampite le kamsangte tungah, "A beisa kum tampi sung ka hihsa uh mah bangin biakinn siatna hangin kapkap lai-in, kha ngana sungin an na tangtanglai ding ka hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong dingin Sharezer le Regemmelek, le a mite uh na sawl uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in kei tungah thu hong gen a,
"Gam sung mi khempeuh le siampite tungah hih bangin gen in: Amaute in a beisa kum sawmsagih sung kha ngana le kha sagihna sungin an tangin a kahna uh, kei hong pahtawina uh hi lo hi.
A annek a tuidawnte uh zong, amau' duh man bek ahi hi," hong ci hi.
Jerusalem cithei-in a khua sungah mi tampi om a, leitaw lam gam, nitumna lam gam, a kiim a pam khuapite-ah mi tampi tengin a om hun laitakin, tu-a bangmahin Topa in a kamsang masate' tungtawnin a gensa thu ahi hi.
"Note in thu a tangin khenin, khatlekhat tungah itna le hehpihna kilakin,
note lakah a om meigong, tagah, gamdang mite, ahih kei leh mizawngte gim pia loin, khatlekhat kiliatsakna ding na ngaihsut lohna ding uh thu ka hong piazo hi," a ci hi.
Amaute in a lungsim uh suangtum bangin saksak uh a, Vanglian Topa in tanglai kamsangte' tungtawnin a gen thuhilhnate ngai nuam lo uh hi. Tua ahih manin Topa heh mahmah hi.
Amaute ka hopih ciangin hong ngai nuam lo uh hi; kei zong amaute' hong thungetna ka ngai kei ding hi, Vanglian Topa in ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Topa in, "Huihpi' mutkhiat bangin amaute thehthang gawpin, a theihngei nai lohna uh gam dangah amaute teng ding uh hi. Amau' nusiat leitang hoih zong gamkhing suak ding a, a tungah kuamah om nawn loin daicip ding hi," a ci hi.
Vanglian Topa in kei tungah thu hong genin
amah in, "Jerusalem mite ka itluatna hangin Jerusalem khuapi ka huh nuam mahmah a, hih banga ka itluatna in a galte tungah ka heh hong suaksak hi.
Ka khuapi siangtho Jerusalem-ah ciahkikin ka teng ding hi. A citak khuapi, ci-in minthang ding a, Vanglian Topa' mual pen mual siangtho kici ding hi.
Jerusalem khuapi kongzing le lamkabomte-ah a tu dingin puteekte omkik ding a, teeklua kisa-in ciangkhut khunin pai ding uh hi.
Kongzing khempeuhah numei naupang kimawlin phezaizai ding uh hi.
"Tu-a a omlai note a dingin hih thu ahi thei lo ding tawh a kibat hangin kei a dingin ahi mawh ding thu hi lo hi.
Nisuahna le nitumna gamte panin ka mite ka honkhia ding a,
Jerusalem khua sungah ka tunpihkik ding hi. Amaute pen keima mi hi-in, kei zong amau' Pasian ka hi ding a, amau tawh ka thuciamnate limtakin ka zui ding hi.
"Thakhauhin lungsim hang un. Ka biakinn a kilamkikna ding a bul a kiphuh laitakin kamsangte in a gen thute mah a za na hi uh hi.
Tua hun ma-in mi ahi a, ganhing ahi zongin na a sem dingin kuamah in cial zo lo a, galte kihtakna hangin kuamah a ututin om thei lo hi. Mi khatlekhat ka kidosak hi.
Ahi zongin tu-in a suaktalai hih minamte, nidang ate ka bangsak kei ding hi.
A beisa hunah, Judah gammite le Israel gammite pen, minam dangte in kihamsiatna-in zang uh a, 'Judah le Israel-te' thuak bangin thuak un,' kici uh hi. Ahi zongin note kong honkhia ding a, tu-in midangte in, 'Judah le Israel bangin thupha ngah un,' ci-in thupha kipiakna-in zang ding uh hi. Tua ahih manin na lungsim uh hangsak unla lau kei un.
"Na pu na pate un kei hong hehsak ciangin amaute tungah siatna tunsak ding ka ngaihsun a, ka lungsim ka khiam het kei hi.
Ahi zongin tu-in Jerusalem khua mite le Judah gammite tungah thupha piak ding ka ngaihsun hi. Tua ahih ciangin lunghimawh kei un.
Hih bangin note gamta un: Note khatlekhat tungah thuman thutak kam kipau un. Thukhenna zumah, kilemna a piangsak ding thutang zang un.
Khatlekhat kisiatsakna ding vaihawm kei unla, a man lopi-in teci pangin kiciam kei un. Zuauna, thuman lohna, le kibawlsiatnate ka deih kei hi," hong ci hi.
amah in, "Kha lina, kha ngana, kha sagihna, le kha sawmna sunga antannate pen, Judah gammite a dingin lungdamin kipakin pawi bawlna hun suak ta ding hi. Tua ahih manin thuman le kilemna deih pha un," hong ci hi.
Vanglian Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Minam liante le khuapi liante panin Jerusalem-ah mi hong pai hun hong tung ding hi.
Khuapi khat-a om mite in khuapi dang a om mite kiangah, 'Vanglian Topa bia-in ama tung panin thupha ka ngen ding uh hi. Hong zui un,' ci ding uh hi.
A vanglian a thahat minamte zong Vanglian Topa a bia ding le ama tung panin thupha a ngen dingin Jerusalem-ah hong pai ding uh hi.
Tua hun ciangin minam tuamtuamte sung panin mi sawm, Jew mi khat kiangah hong pai-in, 'Pasian in nang hong ompihna thu za ka hih manun na nung hong zuisak in,' ci-in thum ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Topa' thugenna: Hadrak gammite' gimtuahna ding Topa in thu khenzo a, Damaskas khuapi in zong tuak ding hi. Israel minam khempeuh, Topa -a' ahih mah bangin leitung minam khempeuh zong Topa -a' mah ahi hi.
Hadrak tawh a kigizawng Hamath zong, Topa -a' mah hi a, siamna a nei Taia khuapi le Sidon khuapite zong, ama a' mah ahi hi.
Taia khuapi in galnanna kulh bawl a, leivui zahin ngun le kham hau a, kongzing nin zahin kiciang venvan hi.
Ahi zongin Topa in a neih khempeuh laksakin tuipi sungah paihsak ding a, a khuapi a haltumsak ding hi.
Ashkelon khuapi in hih thu mu-in lau ding a, Gaza khuapi in zong gimlawh ding hi. A lametna teng bei ding ahih manin Ekron khuapi in zong gimlawh ding hi. Gaza khuapi in a kumpipa taan ding a, Ashkelon khuapi kinusiacip ding hi.
Ashdod khuapi-ah minam dangte zong teng ding a, a kiphasak Filistia mite ka beisak ding hi.
Amaute in sa, a si tawh ne nawn lo ding uh a, a kikham ante zong tang ding uh hi. A suakta sunteng, keima mite suak ding uh a, Judah mite lakah beh khat bang ding uh hi. Jebus mite mah bangin Ekron khua mite zong keima mi suak ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin ka gam sung ka hu ding a, galte ka nawksak nawn kei ding hi. Ka mihingte' thuakna mu khin ka hih manin migilote, ka bawlsiasak nawn kei ding hi.
Zion mite aw, nakpitakin lungdam un. Jerusalem mite aw, lungdamin awng un. En un, na kumpipa uh hong pai hi. Amah, gualzawhna tawh hong pai hi. Ahi zongin kiniamkhiatna tawh hong pai a, sin nai loh lano tungah hong tuang hi.
Galkidona leengte Israel gam pan beisakin, sakol galkapte, Judah gam pan ka lakhia ding a, galdona a kizang thalte kisusia ding hi. Na kumpipa un minam dangte lakah kilemna thu gen ding a, amah in tuipi mong khat pan tuipi mong khat dong, Eufratis Gunpi panin leimong dongin a uk ding hi.
Sisan tawh a kikipsak, note tawh ka thuciamna hangin na salsuahna uh keugaw gam panin note ka hong suaktasak ding hi.
Lametna a om no salte aw, ciahkik unla, a muanhuai mahmah na mun ngei uh zuankik un. Note' thuaknasa a zah nihin thupha ka hong piakna ding tuni-in note kiangah ka hong gen hi.
Grik mite, sim nadingin Judah, thal bangin keekin, Israel thaltangin ka zang ding a, Zion mite, namsau-in ka zang ding hi.
Ama mite tungah Topa kilang ding a, a thaltang lotte khuaphia bang ding hi. Topa Pasian in peengkul tum ding a, leitaw lam panin a hong pai huihpi tawh a va kuankhia ding hi.
Vanglian Topa in ama mite hu ding a, ama mite in a galte uh susia ding hi. Galdona sungah zukham bangin awng gawp ding uh a, a galte uh' sisan luangsakgawp ding uh hi. Biakna site, biakna tau tungah hai a sun tawh kibangin a luangsak ding uh hi.
Tuucingpa in a tuuhonte lauhuaina panin a hotkhiat bangin, tua ni ciangin Topa, amau' Pasian in a mite a honkhia ding hi. Kumpi lukhu tungah a om suangmanphate bangin ama gam sungah a mite taang ding uh hi.
Tua thu bangzah takin hoihin nuam ding ahi hiam? Anlim nekna in tangvalte thahatsak ding a, zulim nekna in nungakte thadimsak ding hi.
Singkung lopa a sel hunin Topa kiang pan guah ngen un. Meii kaisakin, guah zusak a, ankung khempeuh a dumsak pa, Topa ahi hi.
Mihingte in milim peuh thudotin nei uh a, a thu ngahte uh zuauthu le a mawkna hi lel hi. Mang khiathei-a kineite in lam lakkhial uh a, amau' hehnepnate a mawknapi hi lel hi. Tua ahih manin tuu bangin mite mangthang uh a, makai a neih loh manun gimna a ngah uh hi.
Ka mi a makaite tungah ka heh suak mahmah a, amaute gim ka pia ding hi. Judah mite pen Vanglian Topa ahi keima a' hi a, amaute limtakin kemin, ka sakol galkap thahatte a suak ding uh hi.
Amaute sung pan mi makaite, galkapmangte, gam ukte, hong khangkhia ding uh hi.
Kongzing buannawng lakah a galte uh a tuancilgawp galkapte bangin amaute gualzo ding uh a, Topa in a ompih manin amaute in gal a sim uh ciangin a galte' sakol galkapte zogawp ding uh hi.
Judah mite ka thahatsak ding a, Israel mite ka honkhia ding hi. Amaute ka khasiat ding a, inn-ah ka ciahpih ding hi. Amaute cikmah hunin ka nial ngei loh bang keekin nuamtakin a om ding uh hi. Kei pen Topa, amau' Pasian ka hi a, amau' thungetnate ka pia ding hi.
Israel mite, galkap hatte bang ding uh a, zukham lungnuam, bang ding uh hi. A suan a khakte un hih gualzawhna phawkin lungdam ding uh a, Topa' bawlna hangin kipak ding uh hi.
Amaute samin ka kaikhawm ding a, amaute honkhia-in a nidang zahin mi tampi ka phasak ding hi.
Minam dangte lakah amaute ka thehthang hangin a gamlapi panin kei hong phawk ding uh hi. Amaute le a tate uh suakta-in, a vekpi-un inn zuanin hong ciahkhawm ding uh hi.
Egypt le Assiria gam panin amaute ka ciahpih kik ding a, a gam a lei uhah ka tengsak ding hi. Gilead gam le Lebanon gamah zong ka tengsak ding a, gam khempeuhah mi a dim ding hi.
Amaute in lungkhamna tuipi a phutkhak uh ciangin keimah in tuihualte ka vatmai ding a, Nail gun tuithukte kangcip ding hi. Assiria mite ka niamkhiat ding a, Egypt in a vangliatna taan ding hi.
Lebanon aw, mei in na taamtak kungte a kattheih nadingin na kongpite hong in.
Taaksan kungte aw, kapin thum un. Taamtak kungte puk khin a, a minthang singkungte kisia ta hi. Bashan tawsaw kungte aw, kapin thum un; gammang tupi singteng kiphukmang khinta hi.
Tuucingte a minthanna uh bei khinta ahih manin dahin a kap uh hi. A tuulak inn uh kisusia khin ahih manin humpinelkaite' hawkna za un.
Topa ka Pasian in kei tungah thu hong gen a, "Gawh dingin a kikoih tuuhonte va cing in.
Tuu neite in a tuute go uh a, ahi zongin amaute gim kipia lo hi. Amaute in a tuusa zuak uh a, ' Topa in thupha ngah tahen. Tu-in i hauta hi,' ci uh hi. A tuucingte mahmah in a tuute uh hehpihna nei lo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hih gamah a teng mite ka hehpih nawn kei ding hi. Amaute a ukpa le a kumpipa' khutnuai-ah mi khempeuh ka koih ding hi. Gam uk mite in gam sungteng susiagawp ding a, amau' suksiatna panin kuamah ka honkhia kei ding hi," hong ci hi.
Tuu summeet bawlte in kei hong cial uh a, a kigo ding tuute a cing pa ka suak hi. Kei zong ciangkhut nih la-in khat pen "Hehpihna" ci-in min ka phuak a, a khat pen "Kipawlna" ci-in min ka phuak hi. Tua hi a, tuute a cingin kei ka om hi.
Kha khat sungin tuucing adang thumte ka notkhia hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute tungah ka lungduaizo nawn kei a, amaute in kei hong mudah uh hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong tuuhonte kiangah, "Note ka hong cing nawn kei ding hi. A si dingteng si unla, a kisusia dingteng siacip un. A omlaisun teng khatlekhat kisanek un," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin "Hehpihna" a kici ciangkhut la-in ka kuaitan a, minam khempeuh tawh ka bawl thuciamna ka phiat hi.
Tua ahih manin tua ni-in thuciamna kiphiat hi. Tuu summeet bawlte in hong en giaugiau uh a, hih banga ka gamtatna panin Topa' thugen ahihlam a phawk uh hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong amaute kiangah, "Hoih na sak uhleh ka tuucin thaman hong pia un. Hoih na sak kei uhleh lah tang lel un," ka ci hi. Tua ciangin ka thaman dingin ngun shekel sawmthum hong pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in kei kiangah, "Biakinn sumkoihna sungah tuate koih in," hong ci hi. Tua ciangin kei zong, kei tawh kituakin tam a sak mahmah uh tua dangka sawmthum la-in biakinn sumkoihna sungah ka koih hi.
Tua ciangin "Kipawlna" a kici ciangkhut la-in ka kuaitan leuleu a, Judah le Israel a kipawlna kiphiat hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in kei kiangah, "Khatvei tuucing nasep semkik inla, tutungin kimanna a nei lo tuucing nasep sem in.
Ka tuuhonte a cing dingin tuucing khat ka koih a, ahi zongin ka tuu a sia dingte huh loin, a mangthangte zong loin, a liamte bawl loin, a cidamte zong an vak lo hi. Amah in tua tuu thau pente' sate ne-in a khecinte nangawn hawkkhiatsak zawsop hi.
Vanpi zalin leitung piangsak a, mihingte tungah nuntakna a pia Topa in Israel mite tawh kisai-in thu gen a,
"Leenggahzu bangin Jerusalem khuapi ka bawl ding a, a kiima om minam dangte in a nek ciangin khamin a hoi ding uh hi. Jerusalem khuapi a umcih uh ciangin Judah gam khuapi dangte zong umcih ding uh hi.
Tua hun hong tun ciangin suangtumpi gik mahmah bangin Jerusalem khuapi ka bawl ding a, likkhiat a sawm minam khat peuhpeuh in liamlawh ding hi. Leitung minamdang khempeuh kipawlin Jerusalem a sim ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Judah minamte in, 'Jerusalem-a a teng mite, Vanglian Topa ahi amau' Pasian' hangin thahat uh hi,' ci ding uh hi.
"Tua ni ciangin Judah minamte, tulak kang le buhphual kang ka bangsak ding a, a kiima om minamdangte khempeuh a susia ding uh hi. Ahi zongin Jerusalem mite, a khuapi sungah lungmuangin a om hithiat ding uh hi.
"Tua ciangin Judah galkapte tungah gualzawhna ka pia masa ding a, David' suanlekhakte le Jerusalem khuamite' minthanna pen Judah midangte' minthanna sangin lianzaw tuan lo ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin Topa in Jerusalem-a a teng mite hu ding a, a ginalo pente nangawn David zahin thahat ding hi. David' suanlekhakte in Topa' vantungmi le Pasian mahmah bangin amaute a makai ding uh hi.
Jerusalem sim ding a hanciam minam khempeuh tua ni ciangin ka susia ding hi.
"David' suanlekhakte le Jerusalem khuamite' tungah hehpihna lungsim le thungetna lungsim ka guan ding hi. Amaute in a sutlup uh mipa enin, ta khat neihsun a sihsuah mite bangin kap ding uh a, tacil a khuaisuahte bangin nakpitakin kapin thum ding uh hi.
Tua hun laitakin Jerusalem khua sungah kapin thumna pen Megiddo zanglei-a Hadadrimmon pasian' sihna hangin kahna le thumna zah mahin nasia ding hi.
Gam sung khempeuhah a innkuankuanin dahin kap ding uh hi. David' suanlekhakte sung panin a innkuankuanin kapin, a zite uh zong a tuam mahin kap ding uh hi. Nathan' suanlekhakte zong a innkuankuanin kapin, a zite uh zong a tuam mahin kap ding uh hi.
Levi' suanlekhakte le a zite, Shimei' suanlekhakte le a zite,
le beh dang khempeuhte zong a behbehin, a zite uh tawh a tuam ciatin kapin a thum ding uh hi.
"Tua ni hong tun ciangin David' suanlekhakte le Jerusalem khuamite' mawhna le nitnateng khempeuh a silsiang dingin tuinak khat hong phul ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin gam sung panin milim khempeuh ka phiatsiang ding a, kuamah in a milim min nangawn uh phawkkha nawn lo ding uh hi. Kamsang zuautheite zong phiatin, milim biaknopna lungsim ka beisak ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh kamsang a kineihlai teitei leh, a pianna a nu le a pa mahmah in kho ding uh a, ' Topa' min paulamin zuauthu gen na hih manin na si ding hi,' ci ding uh hi. Tua bangin thu a gen teitei le, a nu le a pa mahmah in tem tawh sunlum ding uh hi.
Tua ni hong tun ciangin kamsangte in a maangmuh theihna uh kisialhpih ngam nawn loin, kamsangte bangin zong puan silh ngam nawn loin, kamsang zong kineih ngam nawn lo ding uh hi.
Kamsang ka hi kei hi; lokho mi ka hi a, ka khan tawnin lokho-in a om ka hi hi, ci zawsop ding uh hi.
Mi khatpeuh in, 'Na awm a na liammate bang ahi hiam?' ci-in a dot ciangin, 'Ka lawmte' inn khatah zukham sulin kitotna-a a liam ka hi hi,' ci-in a dawng ding hi.
"Namsau aw, ka tuucingpa a su dingin kipan inla, kei tawh nasem khawm pa langpang in. Tuucingpa sat in. Tuute kithehthang ding a, ka tuute gim ka pia ding hi.
Leitung khempeuhah, sehthum suah sehnih si ding a, seh khat bek suaktalai ding hi.
Tua a suakta sehkhatte pen meikhukah ngun a kisiansak bangin, meikhukah kham a kize-et bangin, meikhukah ze-etin ka siangsak ding hi. Amaute in kei tungah thu hong ngenin, kei zong amau' thungetna ka pia ding hi. Keima mi ahihna uh amaute tungah ka gen ding a, amaute in kei pen amau' Pasian ka hihna thu a kam uh tawh pulak ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Jerusalem khuapi a sim dingin Topa in minam khempeuh kaikhawm ding hi. A khuapi kila-in, a innte kiluh gawpin, a numeite zong kibuan gawp ding hi. Mi alang bang salin kipaikhiatpih ding a, adangte ahihleh kipaikhiatpih lo ding hi.
Tua ciangin Topa hong kuankhia ding a, a beisa hunah a sim ngei bangin hih minam dangte hong sim ding hi.
Tua ciangin Jerusalem nisuahna lamah a om Oliv Mual tungah Topa a ding ding hi. Tua ciangin nisuahna lam pan nitumna lamah Oliv Mual kitamin phel nih suak ding a, a kikalah kuampi om ding hi. A mual kimkhat leilu lamah kikhinin, kimkhat leitaw lamah kikhin ding hi.
Hinnom kuam sung kivukcip ding a, Judah kumpi Uzzah' hun lai-in zinlinna-a a kivukcip mah bang ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa ka Pasian hong pai ding a, a mi siangthote khempeuh hong tonpih ding hi.
Tua ni hong tun ciangin khuadam, vukkiat cihte om nawn lo ding a,
Tua ni hong tun ciangin Jerusalem khua panin tuicim hong luangkhia ding a, kimkhat, nisuahna lamah a om Si Tuipi-ah luang ding a, kimkhat, nitumna lamah a om Mediterranean Tuipi-ah luang ding hi. Tua tui in kan' hun cih nei loin luang tawntung ding hi.
Leilu lam Geba khua panin leitaw lam Rimmon khua dong, leitung khempeuh, zanglei suak ding hi. Ahi zongin Jerusalem khuapi pen bangmah ci loin a sangpi-in om ding a, Benjamin Kongpi pan a kipan nidanga kongpi a omnasa Kiu Kongpi dong, le Hananel Tausang panin kumpipa' leenggah cilna phual ciang dong a ban ding hi.
Tua khuapi sungah lungmuang takin mi teng ding uh a, lauhuaina tuakkha nawn lo ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jerusalem khuapi a sim minam dang khempeuhte tungah Topa in gimna lianpi tungsak ding hi. A khe-un a ding thei kimlai mahin a sa uh muatmang ding a, a mitkua sung uhah a mittangte uh muatin, a kam sung uhah a leiite uh muat ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin Topa in amaute amkhamsak gawp ding a, mite in a gei-a a matkhak mite manin khatlekhat kilaithang gawp ding uh hi.
Judah mite in Jerusalem khuapi hutna-in galte do ding uh a, minam dang khempeuhte' neihsa kham, ngun, le puante tampi tak a laksak ding uh hi.
Galte' phuala om sakolte, la-sakolte, kalaohte, late, le ganhing om khempeuh tungah gimna lianpi a tung ding hi.
Tua bangin galte a kizawhgawp khit ciangin, galte sung panin a nungtalai mite in Vanglian Topa, kumpi ahihna hangin a bia ding le ama gualzawhna pawi a bawl dingin kumsimin Jerusalem-ah pai tawntung ding uh hi.
Tua gualzawhna pawi a bawl dingin Egypt mite a painop kei leh, tua bangin a pai nuam lo minamte' thuak ding gimnate mah, amau' tungah a tung ding hi.
Gualzawhna pawi a bawl dingin a pai nuam lo Egypt mite le minam dang khempeuhte tungah a tung ding gimna pen tu-a bang ahi hi.
Tua ni ciangin sakol khilongte khempeuh tungah, " Topa -a' dingin A Kipia," ci-in ciaptehna kibawl ding hi. Biakinn sunga a om beelte khempeuh pen biakna tau mai-ah a kikoih kuangte mah bangin a siangtho-in kinei ding hi.
Jerusalem khuasung le Judah gam sungah a om beelte khempeuh, Vanglian Topa biakna-in zat dingin a tuamin kikoih ding hi. Biakna a pia dingin a hong pai mi khempeuh in tua beelte zangin, biakna sa huanna-in a nei ding uh hi. Tua ni hong tun ciangin Vanglian Topa' biakinn-ah sumzuak vanzuak cihte om nawn lo ding hi.
Topa in Malakhi tungtawnin Israel-te tungah thu gen hi.
Topa in, "Note kong it hi," ci hi. Ahi zongin note in, "Kote hong bangci it na hi hiam?" na ci uh hi. Topa in hong dawng a, "Esau le Jakob unau hi a, ahi zongin Jakob le a suan a khakte itin,
Esau le a suan a khakte ka mudah hi. Esau' neih mualtung gamte ka susia a, gamsate tungah ka pia hi," ci hi.
Esau' suanlekhak Edom mite in, "I khuapite a kisiat khit hangin i lamkik ding hi," ci le-uh, Topa in, "A ut uhleh lam uh hen; ahi zongin ka susia kik veve ding hi. Midangte in, 'Gam gilo, Topa' heh tawntungna minamte,' ci-in ko ding uh hi," ci-in a dawng ding hi.
Vanglian Topa in siampite tungah hih bangin hong ci hi: "Tapa in a pa zahtak a, nasempa in a topa kihta hi. Kei pen na pa uh hinapi, bang hangin hong zahtak lo a, na topa uh hinapi, bang hangin hong kihta lo na hi uh hiam? No siampite in kei hong simmawh napi-in, 'Bang hong ci simmawh ka hi uh hiam?' na cilai uh hi.
Note in ka biakna tau tungah keimah biakna-in an ginalopite hong pia hinapi-in, 'Kong zahtak bawl lohna uh bang om ahi hiam?' na ci uh hi. Ka biakna tau simmawhbawl na hih manun hong zahtak bawl lo na hi uh hi.
Ganhing a mittawpite tawh kei nong biak uh ciangin, a hoihmahin kingaihsun na hi uh hiam? A khebai, a cina ganhingte tawh nong biak uh ciangin, a hoihmah kisa na hi uh hiam? Tua bang ganhing khat peuhpeuh, note hong ukpa kiangah va puak dih un. Note tungah nuamin hong pakta ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin no siampite aw, Pasian in eite hong hehpih theih nadingin ama kiangah thum un. Na hih ngeisa bangun na nget uh hangin na ngetnate uh hong pia lo ding hi; tua pen nomau' khialhna ahi hi.
Vanglian Topa in, "Ka biakna tau tungah, bangmah-a kimang lo mei na tawh mawkmawk theih loh nadingun, note khatpeuh in biakinn kongkhakte khak le-uh cin ka ut hi. Note tungah ka lungkim kei a, nong piak uh biakpiaknate kong sang kei ding hi.
Leitung khempeuhah a om minam khempeuh in kei hong zahtak uh a, kei a dingin mun khempeuhah paknamtui halin, a kisangthei ding biakpiakna hong pia uh hi. Mi khempeuh in kei hong zahtak uh hi.
Note in, 'Hihte cimtak khin hang,' ci-in nong nap nitsan lel uh hi. Keimah biak nadingin a kigu ganhing khatpeuh ahi a, a liam a bai, ahih kei leh a cina peuh nong paipih uh hi. Tua bangte, a sang dingin hong ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?
A tuuhon lakah tuutal cidam nei napi-in, a kamciamsa bangin kei tungah hong piak ciangin, a sitbaang ganhing a hong pia mi khempeuh in samsiatna thuak tahen. Bang hang hiam cih leh kei pen a lian mahmah Kumpipa ka hi a, minam khempeuh in kei hong zahtak uh hi," a ci hi.
Vanglian Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Siampite aw, note a dingin hih lai-ah thupiakna khat om hi.
Na gamtatna uh tawh kei nong zahtak ding uh hi. Ka thugente ngai loin, thupi takin na lak kei uhleh note tungah samsiatna ka hong tungsak ding a, siampi hihna tawh na ngah uh thuphate tungah samsiatna ka tungsak ding hi. A taktakin ci lehang, note in ka thupiaknate thupi lak lo na hih manun na thupha ngahte uh tungah samsiatna ka tungsakzo hi.
Na suanlekhakte uh nakpitakin ka thuhilh ding a, note ahihleh, na biakpiakna ganhing uh a ekte tawh na maitang uh hong zut gawpin tuate tawh kong lawnkhia khawm ding hi.
Tua ciangin Levi' suanlekhakte ahi siampite tawh ka thuciamna a kip nawn lo ahihna thu, hih thu kong genna-ah na thei ding uh hi.
"Amaute a nuntakna ding le a nopsakna ding thu ka ciam a, amaute in kei hong zahtak theih nadingun hih ka thuciamte khempeuh ka pia hi. Amaute in kei hong zahtakin hong kihta takpi uh hi.
Amaute in thuman taktakte mah hilhin gen uh a, amaute' kam panin zuauthu gingkhia lo hi. Ka deihna bangin amaute gamta uh a, a khial ding mi tampite, thuman lamah a paisak uh hi.
Siampite' nasep pen Pasian a manin theih nading a hilh ding uh ahi hi. Amaute pen, Vanglian Topa' kamtaite ahih manun, mite in keima deihna a theih nadingun amaute' tungah thu a dot ding uh ahi hi.
"Ahi zongin, no siampite na hih uhleh lampi man panin na pial khin uh hi. Na thuhilhnate un mi tampi tak khialsak hi. Note tawh ka bawl thuciamna na palsat khin uh hi.
Tua ahih manin, note in ka thuhilhna zui loin, keima thu na hilh uh ciangin zong a kibangin hilh loin mi na deidan mah uh bangin, kei zong mi khempeuh mai-ah simmawhna le niamkhiatna kong ngahsak ding hi," a ci hi.
Eite khempeuh in, eite a hong piangsak Pasian ahi Pa khat bek nei hi lo ihi hiam? Tua hinapi-in bang hangin eite khatlekhat tungah citak loin, i pu i pate tawh a bawl, Pasian' thuciamna palsat ihi hiam?
Judah mite citak loin, Pasian tungah a thuciamna uh palsat uh a, Israel mite' lak le Jerusalem khua sungah siatna tampi gamta uh hi. Topa in a it mahmah biakinn ninsak uh hi. Topa ahi lo, pasian dang a bia numeite, zi-in la-in a tenpih uh hi.
Hih bangin a gamta mi peuhmah, a kua a kua hitaleh, Topa in sugawp hen la, Vanglian Topa tungah biakna a paipih ei minamte tawh hong kigawmsak nawn kei hen.
Note' gamtatna adang khat omlai hi. Tua pen, note' paipih biaknate hong sang nawn lo ahih manin Topa' biakna tau, khitui tawh na kawtsak uh a, kapin thumin na om uh hi.
Bang hangin hong sang lo hiam, na ci uh hi. Na khangnolai uha na tenpih na zite uh tungah na cihtak lohna uh amah in hong thei a, na zite uh tungah na cihtak tawntungna ding uh Pasian tungah thu ciamin, na zite uh zong na lawmnu mah uh hinapi-in amaute tawh na thuciamna uh na pelhna hang uh ahi hi.
Pasian in na zite uh tawh pumkhat, lungsim khat ahi dingin hong bawl hi lo ahi hiam? Hih bangin a hong bawlna pen bang a deihna ahi hiam? Pasian' mi taktak ahi ding tate i neih theih nading ahi hi. Tua ahih manin na khangno lai-un na tenpih na zi uh tawh na thuciamna uh na palsatkhak loh nadingun kidawm un.
Vanglian Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Zi makna ka deih kei a, mi khatpeuh in a khangno lai-a a tenpih a zi tungah tua bang gitlohna a gamtatna ka mudah hi. Tua ahih ciangin hoihtakin kidawm unla, a citak dingin na zite uh tungah na thuciamna uh palsat kei un," ci hi, a ci hi.
Thu na gengenna uh tawh Topa na gimsak uh hi. Note in, "Bangci gimsak ka hi uh hiam?" na ci uh hi. " Topa in a sia-in a gamtate a hoihin ngaihsun a, zong itin amaute tungah lungkim takpi hi," na cihna khawng uhleh, "Thutang a gen Pasian koi lai-ah om ahi hiam?" ci-in na dotnate uh tawh na gimsak uh hi.
Hih bangin na thugenna uh tawh kisai-in Vanglian Topa in hong dawng a, "Ka pai nading lampi a bawlkhol dingin ka kamtai pa ka sawl ding hi. Tua ciangin na ngakngak uh Topa a biakinn sungah thakhat thu-in hong pai ding hi. Na muhnop uh kamtai pa hong pai-in ka thuciamna hong taangko ding hi," ci hi.
Ahi zongin ama hong pai ni ciangin kua in thuakzo ding a, amah hong kilaak ciangin kua nungtazo ding ahi hiam? Amah pen, sikte a siangthosak mei, le puante a siangthosak satpiang tawh kibang hi.
A ninte kangtumsakin, ngunte a siangsak pa bangin thukhen dingin hong pai ding hi. Ngun le khamte a kisiansak bangin amah in Levi suanlekhak ahi siampite siangsak ding hi. Tua ciangin Topa' tungah a kilawm biakna a pia ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Judah mite le Jerusalem mite' piak biaknate pen nidang ate mah bangin Topa' mai-ah a lungkimhuai hi ding hi.
Vanglian Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Note tungah thukhen dingin ka hong pai ding hi; ai tawite, numei tawh a mawhte, a man lopi a teci pangte, numeite' thaman piakna-ah khemna a zangte; meigong, tagah, le gamdang mite a zawhthawh bawlte, le kei hong zahtak lo mi khempeuhte' langkhatah thakhatin teci pangin thu ka khen ding hi.
"Kei, Topa ka hi a, lungsim a kheel lo mi ka hi hi. No Jakob suanlekhakte aw, a siacimit na hi nai kei uh hi.
Na pu na pate uh mah bangin ka thukhamte panin note na pialkhia uh a, ka thukhamte na zui kei uh hi. Ahi zongin keima lamah hong kihei kik un; kei zong note lamah kong kihei ding hi. Ahi zongin note in, 'Nang lamah hong bangci kihei ding ka hi uh hiam?' na ci uh hi.
Keimah in note kong dotnop thu pen, mi khatpeuh in Pasian' na guksak ding kilawm ahi hiam? Kilawm lo hinapi-in note in nong guksak uh hi. Ahi zongin note in, 'Bang hong guksak ka hi uh hiam?' na ci uh hi. Sawm-ah-khat piakna le biakpiaknate ah nong guksak uh hi.
Na minam bupun keima neihsa hong guksak na hih manun note khempeuh tungah samsiatna hong tung hi.
Ka biakinn-ah an a om theih nadingin sawm-ah-khat a kimin hong paipih un. Kei hong ze-et un; vantung kongkhakte hongin, note a dingin na hoih tampi kong piakna na mu ding uh hi.
Lo panin a piang na ante uh, kauphe ka nesak nawn kei ding a, na leenggui uh gahpha mahmah ding hi.
Tua ciangin na gam uh, ten nadingin a hoih mahmah leitang hong suak ding ahih manin, minam dang khempeuh in note pen a nuamsa minam hong ci ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Kei tawh kisai-in na kampaunate uh khauh mahmah hi. Note in, 'Bang kam pau ka hi uh hiam?' na ci uh hi.
Note in, 'Pasian' na i sep a mawkna hi. Ama hong sawl bangin i sep hangin bang a kimanna om a, i gamtatnasate hangin i dahna lim, Vanglian Topa' mai-ah i lah hangin bang phattuamna om ahi hiam?
I muhna bang leh, mi kiphasakteng mah in thupha ngahin nuamsa uh hi. Mi gamtatsiate ahihleh citheibek loin, a gamtatsiatnate uh tawh Pasian ze-et napi-un bangmah tuak se lo uh hi,' na ci uh hi," a ci hi.
Topa a zahtak mite khatlekhat tua bangin thu kigen uh a, amaute' thugennate, Topa in ngai-in za hi. Topa in laibu khat nei a, amah zahtakin a thupi ngaihsut mite khempeuh tua sungah kiciamteh hi.
Vanglian Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "Tua a kiciamteh mite pen keima mite hi ding uh hi. Keimah in na ka sep ni ciangin amaute pen keima neihtuam taktak mite hi ding uh hi. Pa in ama thu a mang a tapa a hehpih mah bangin kei zong amaute ka hehpih ding hi.
Tua ciangin midikte le migilote, le keima na hong semte le hong sem lote a kilamdanna na mukik ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Vanglian Topa in hih bangin ci hi: "En un, mi kiphasak khempeuh le migilo khempeuh, a zung a hiang cih om loin buhtu bangin a kattum ding hun hong tung ding hi. Tua ni ciangin khat zong suakta loin a vekpi-in kangtum khin ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin ka thu a hong mang note tungah dikna ni hong taang ding a, tua in nizang bangin note tungah cidamna hong tun ding hi. Bawng khumna panin a kikhah bawngnote bangin suakta-in nuam na sa ding uh hi.
Keimah in na kong sep ni ciangin note in migilote nuaisiahin leivui bangin na tuancil ding uh hi.
"Israel mite khempeuh in a zuih dingin Horeb Mual panin ka nasem Moses tungah ka piak ahi, Moses' thukhamte, ngeinate, le biakna ngeina kipte khempeuh limtakin phawk un.
"Ahi zongin tua a lauhuai lian mahmah Topa' ni hong tun ma-in note kiangah kamsang Elijah kong paisak ding hi.
Amah in pate le tate lemtuahin a kilemsakkik ding hi. Tua bang hikeileh keimah hong pai-in na gam khempeuh uh ka susiagawp ding hi," ci hi, a ci hi.
Abraham' suan David, David' suan Jesuh Khrih' khang ciaptehna hih bang ahi hi.
Abraham ta Isaac, Isaac ta Jakob, Jakob ta Judah, le a sanggamte ahi uh hi.
Judah ta Perez le Zerah hi a, Tamar tawh a neih a ta ahi uh hi. Perez ta Hezron, Hezron ta Ram,
Ram ta Amminadab, Amminadab ta Nahshon, Nahshon ta Salmon,
Salmon ta Boaz, Rahab tawh a neih a ta ahi hi. Boaz ta Obed, Ruth tawh a neih a ta ahi hi. Obed ta Jessi,
Jessi ta kumpi David ahi hi. David ta Solomon, Uriah' zi Bathsheba tawh a neih pen ahi hi.
Solomon ta Rehoboam, Rehoboam ta Abijah, Abijah ta Asa,
Asa ta Jehoshafat, Jehoshafat ta Joram, Joram ta Uzziah,
Uzziah ta Jotham, Jotham ta Ahaz, Ahaz ta Hezekiah,
Hezekiah ta Manasseh, Manasseh ta Amon, Amon ta Josiah,
Josiah ta Jekhoniah le a sanggamte hi a, Babylon gamah Israel mite salin a kipaipih hun pawlin a suak ahi uh hi.
Jekhoniah ta Shealtiel, Shealtiel ta Zerubbabel,
Zerubbabel ta Abiud, Abiud ta Eliakim, Eliakim ta Azor,
Azor ta Zadok, Zadok ta Akhim, Akhim ta Eliud,
Eliud ta Eleazer, Eleazer ta Matthan, Matthan ta Jakob,
Jakob ta Josef hi a, Josef pen Khrih a kici Jesuh' nu Mary' pasal ahi hi.
Hih bang ahih manin Abraham panin David ciang dong khang sawm le li pha a, David panin Babylon gamah salin a kipaikhiatpih dong khang sawm le li mah pha a, Babylon gamah salin a kipaikhiatpih a kipanin Khrih a suah hun ciang dong khang sawm le li mah a pha hi.
Jesuh Khrih a hong suahna zia hih bang ahi hi. Mary pen Josef a dingin zuthawl piaksa hi a, ahi zongin a kiten taktak ma-un Kha Siangtho in amah a gaisakna thu Mary in a thei hi.
A lawmpa Josef pen a manin a gamta nuam mi khat ahih manin a lawmnu maizumsak nuam lo a, kuama theih lohin maksim dingin a ngaihsun hi.
Ahi zongin hih bangin thu a ngaihsut laitakin a mang sungah Topa' vantungmi khat hong kilang a, "David suan Josef aw, Mary sunga nau pen Kha Siangtho in a gaisak ahih manin amah tenpih ngamlah kei in.
Amah in tapa khat hong nei ding a, tua tapa in ama mite a mawhna uh panin honkhia ding ahih manin ama min dingin Jesuh na phuak ding hi," ci-in thu a gen hi.
Topa in kamsangpa tungtawnin a gensa thu a tun theih nadingin hih thute a piang ahi hi. Tua a genna-ah,
"Nungak khat gai-in tapa khat nei ding a, ama min dingin Emmanuel kiphuak ding hi," ci hi. Emmanuel a khiatna in, eite tawh Pasian hong omkhawm hi, a cihna ahi hi.
Josef zong a khanlawh ciangin Topa' vantungmi' sawl bangin a zi a la hi.
Ahi zongin tua tapa a suah hun dongin a zi luppih lo a, a suah ciangin a min dingin Jesuh a phuak hi.
Herod in Judea gamah kumpi a sep hun laitakin tua gam sung Bethlehem khua-ah Jesuh a suak hi. A suah khit phetin aksi thu lamsang a siam mi pawlkhat, nisuahna lam panin Jerusalem-ah hong tung uh a,
"Jew mite' kumpi ding ahi naungek a hong suak pen koi lai-ah om ahi hiam? Nisuahna lam pan ama aksi hong suah ciangin ka mu uh a, amah a bia dingin a hong pai ka hi uh hi," hong ci uh hi.
Kumpi Herod in hih thu a zak ciangin lamdangsa mahmah a, Jerusalem khuami khempeuh in zong lamdang a sa ciat uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Herod in siampi liante le Thukham hilh siate khempeuh kaikhawm a, "Koi lai-ah Khrih suak ding ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Amaute in, "Kamsangpa in a lai gelhna sungah, 'Judah gamah a om Bethlehem khua aw, ka mi Israel-te a uk dingin nangma sung panin ukpa khat hong piang ding ahih manin Judah gam a uk khuate lakah a neu na hi het kei hi,' ci ahih manin Judea gam sung Bethlehem khua-ah suak ding hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua ciangin Herod in tua mipilte samsim a, aksi a kilat hun teltakin a dot khit ciangin,
Bethlehem khua-ah a pai nadingun sawl a, "Tua naungek limtakin va zong unla, kei zong hong pai-in amah ka biak theih nadingin na muh khit uh ciangin kei kiangah thu hong zasak un," ci-in a vaikhak hi.
Amaute in kumpipa' vaikhak thuteng a zak khit uh ciangin paikhia uh a, nisuahna lamah a muh uh aksi mah, lam a pai laitakun mu uh a, naungek omna tung santak a tun matengin amaute mai-ah tua aksi na pai hi.
Tua aksi a muh uh ciangin a lungdamna uh kigen thei lo hi.
Inn sungah amaute lut uh a, naungek le a nu Mary a mu uh hi. Amaute khukdinin tua naungek a biak khit uh ciangin a vanpuakte uh suahkhia uh a, kham, saledi paknamtui, le myrrh paknamtuite, letsongin a pia uh hi.
Herod kiangah a kihilkik loh nadingun a mang sung uhah Pasian in hilh ahih manin, lampi dang tawnin a gam uhah a ciahkik uh hi.
Tua mipilte a ciah khit uh ciangin Josef' mang sungah Topa' vantungmi khat hong kilang a, "Kithawi-in naungek le a nu, Egypt gamah taipih in. Pai khia un, ci-in kong genkik matengin tua gamah va om un. Herod in naungek thah dingin hong zong ding hi," a ci hi.
Josef zong kithawi pah a, Egypt gam a zuan dingin naungek le a nu tawh zanpi mahin ding khia uh a,
Herod a sih hun ciang dong tua gamah a va om uh hi. Kamsangpa tungtawnin Topa in, "Egypt gam panin ka Tapa ka samkhia hi," ci-in a genna thu a tun nadingin hih bangin a piang ahi hi.
Nisuahna lam panin a hong pai mipilte in amah a khem lamtak Herod in a theih ciangin a heh suak mahmah hi. Tua mipilte tung panin aksi a kilat hun a dotna tawh kizui-in, Bethlehem khua le a kiima om naungek kum nih ciang le a nuaisiah khempeuh a that dingin a galkapte a sawl hi.
Hih bangin thu hong pian' ciangin kamsangpa Jeremiah in,
"Nakpi taka kahna awging Ramah gam sungah kiza hi. Rachel in a tate kah a, a tate khempeuh si khin ahih manin a kah a tawp nadingin kikhem zo lo hi," ci-in a genna thu a tun nading ahi hi.
Herod a sih khit ciangin Egypt gam a om Josef kiangah Topa' vantungmi khat hong kilang a,
"Naupang a that nuam mite si khinta ahih ciangin kithawi inla, naupang le a nu tawh Israel gamah ciah un," a ci hi.
Josef zong kithawi-in, naupang le a nu tawh Israel gamah a ciah uh hi.
Ahi zongin Arkhelaus in a pa Herod' za laihin Judea gam uk mahin a omna thu a zak ciangin tua gamah Josef ciah ngam lo hi. Tua ahih manin a mang sung mahah a kihilna bangin Galilee gam sungah lutin,
Nazareth khua-ah a teng uh hi. Kamsangte in, "Amah pen Nazareth khuami kici ding hi," ci-in a genkholhna a tun nadingin hih bangin a piang ahi hi.
Tua hun laitakin tuiphumpa Johan hong pai-in, Judea gam sungah thuhilh hong kipan a,
"Vantung ki-ukna hun hong naita ahih manin na mawhnate uh kisik kik un," a ci hi.
Kamsang Isaiah in, "Gam sungah mi khat kiko a, 'Topa' pai nading lampi bawl unla, a tot ding lampi tangsak un,' ci hi," ci-in a gen ciangin hih Johan' thu a gen ahi hi.
Johan in kalaoh mul kigan puan silhin, savun kawnggak tawh a kawng gak a, kauphe le gamlak khuaizu tawh a kivak hi.
Jerusalem khua, Judea gam sung, le Jordan Gun kiim gam panin mite hong pai uh hi.
Amaute in a mawhnate uh hong pulak uh a, Johan in Jordan Gun sungah amaute a tuiphum hi.
Ahi zongin Farisi mite le Saddusi mite tampi tak tui a kiphum dingin a hong pai a muh ciangin Johan in amaute kiangah, "Gul bangin ngian a zang note aw, a hong tung ding Pasian' hehna panin na suahtak theih nading uh kua in hong hilhkhol ahi hiam?
Na kisik kikna uh a kilangsak ding gamtatna gamta unla,
'Abraham' suante ihi ngawn hi,' cihna lungsim nei mawk kei un. Ke'n kong cihin-ah, Pasian in hih suangte nangawn Abraham' suanlekhakte-in a bawl thei hi lel hi.
Tu mahmahin sing a bulphuk dingin hei tawh kingim zo hi. Tua ahih manin gah hoih a gah lo sing khempeuh kiphukin meikhuk sungah kikhul ding hi.
Na kisikkik khitna uh a kilat nadingin tui sungah note ka hong phum a, ahi zongin kei nungah a hong pai pa in Kha Siangtho le mei sungah note hong phum ding hi. Tua a hong pai ding pa pen kei sangin nakpitakin lianzaw a, ama khedap a tawisak ding nangawnin ka kilawmzo nai kei hi.
Tua laitakin Galilee gam panin Jesuh hong pai a, Johan' khut sungah a kituiphum dingin ama omna Jordan Gun-ah a hong tung hi.
Ahi zongin Johan in na tuiphum nuam lo a, "Nang in kei nong tuiphum dingin a kilawmzaw kimlai, kei' phum dingin nang hong pai zawsop na hi hiam?" a na ci hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in, "Pasian in hih dingin kisam a sak khempeuh i hih ding a kilawm thu ahih manin tu-in hong phum hoh in," a cih ciangin Johan in zong a mang hi.
Jesuh a kituiphum khit phetin tui sung panin a paikhia pah hi. Tua laitakin vantung hong kihong a, vakhu bangin Pasian' Kha Siangtho hong kumsukin ama tungah a khawl a mu hi.
Tua sung mahin vantung panin aw khat hong ging a, "Hih pen ka it mahmah ka Tapa hi a, ama tungah ka lungkim mahmah hi," a hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Dawimangpa' ze-etna a thuak dingin Kha Siangtho in gamlakah Jesuh a paipih hi.
Jesuh in sun sawmli le zan sawmli sung an ne loin omkhin ahih manin a gil a kial hi.
Tua ciangin ama kiangah Dawimangpa hong pai a, "Pasian' Tapa na hih takpi le hih suangte anlum a suah nadingin thu pia in," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in, "Lai Siangtho sungah, 'Anlum bek tawh mite nungta lo a, Pasian genkhiat thute tawh nungta zaw hi,' ci-in kigelh hi lo ahi hiam?" ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Dawimangpa in gamlak panin Jerusalem khua-ah Jesuh paipih a, biakinn khumzang a sangpen munah a kahtohpih khit ciangin,
"Pasian' Tapa taktak na hih le Lai Siangtho sungah, 'Pasian in nang a hong kem dingin a vantung mite hong sawl ding hi. Na khete le suang a kitahkhak loh nadingin vantung mite in a khut uh tawh nang hong dom ding hi,' ci-in kigelh ahih manin, hih lai panin tuaksuk in," a ci hi.
Jesuh in, "Lai Siangtho mahah, 'Na Topa Pasian na ze-et kei in,' ci-in gen hi lo ahi hiam?" ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Dawimangpa in mual sang mahmah khatah Jesuh paipihto a, leitung kumpi gam khempeuh le a hoihna teng a lah khit ciangin,
"Ka mai-ah kunin kei hong bia lecin hihte khempeuh nangma tungah kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in, "Satan aw, taikhia in. Lai Siangtho in, 'Na Topa Pasian bek bia inla, ama na bek sem in,' ci hi lo ahi hiam?" ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Dawimangpa paikhia a, vantung mite hong pai-in Jesuh huhin an a vak uh hi.
Jesuh in Johan a kimatna thu a zak ciangin Galilee gam sungah va kihem hi.
Galilee gam Nazareth khua-ah omsuak loin paikhia leuleu a, Zebulun le Naftali gam sung Galilee Tuili gei-a om Kapernaum khua-ah a va teng hi.
