Khuamial sunga a teng mite in khuavak lianpi mu ding uh hi. Sihna gam khuamial sungah a teng mite tungah khuavak hong taang ding hi," ci hi.
Tua hun a kipan Jesuh in thuhilh ding kipan a, "Vantung ki-ukna hong naita ahih manin kisikin na omzia uh kheel un," ci-in thu a hilh hi.
Galilee Tuili gei-ah Jesuh a pai laitakin ngabeng Peter a kici Simon le a nau Andru, ngen tawh nga khuhin a om a mu hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Kei hong zui un; nga mat bangin pawl tampi a ngah thei mi kong suaksak ding hi," ci hi.
Amau tegel in zong a ngente uh nusia-in Jesuh a zui pah uh hi.
Tua lai panin a paikhiat khit uh ciangin Zebedi tapa James le Johan-te unau, a pa uh tawh gunkuang sungah ngen puahin a om mu leuleu a, amau tegel zong a sam hi.
Amau tegel in zong gunkuang le a pa uh nusia-in Jesuh a zui pah uh hi.
Galilee gam sung khempeuhah Jesuh pai kawikawi a, amau' kikhopna innte-ah thu hilhin, vantung ki-ukna hangin lungdamna thute hilh a, natna tuamtuam a nei cina khempeuh a damsak hi.
Syria gam sung khempeuhah ama thu kizel ahih manin dawivei mi, sibup mi, khutzaw khezaw mi a kipanin natna satna a tuamtuam a nei mi khempeuh ama kiangah hong kipuak a, amah in a vekpi-in a damsak hi.
Galilee gam, Khuapi Sawmte gam, Jerusalem khua, Judea gam le Jordan Gun galkhat gam panin mi tampi tak in Jesuh a zui uh hi.
Jesuh in tua bangin mihon tampi tak a muh ciangin mualtung lamah kahto-in tusuk a, a nungzuite zong ama nai-ah hong tu uh hi.
Tua ciangin a kam ka-in amaute tungah thu hilh ding kipan a,
"Kha thu lamah zawngkhal a kisate sungah vantung ki-ukna thu om ahih manin thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi.
Dahin a thum a tau mite Pasian in amaute hehnem ding ahih manin thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi.
A lungnem mite in Pasian' ciamsa leitang ngah ding uh ahih manin thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi.
Pasian' deihteng sep ding a hanciamte Pasian in lungkimna ngahsak ding ahih manin thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi.
Midang a hehpih mite tungah Pasian in hehpihna pia ding ahih manin thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi.
Lungsim takpi tawh Pasian a zong mite in Pasian mu ding ahih manin thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi.
Kilem nading deihin a hanciam mite in Pasian' tate cihna ngah ding uh ahih manin thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi.
Pasian' deihna bangin a gamtat manin bawlsiatna a thuak mite vantung ki-ukna sungah a omte ahih manin thupha ngah mi ahi uh hi.
"Midangte in keima hangin a man lopi-in hong simmawhin hong bawlsia a, a nam tuamtuamin hong gensiat uh ciangin thupha ngah mi na hi uh hi.
Note a dingin vantungah thaman lianpi hong kikoih kholhsak ahih manin tua bang na tuah uh ciangin nuamin na lungdam un. Note' hun ma-a kamsangte zong tua bangmahin a na kibawlsia ngei ahi hi.
"Note pen leitung mite a dingin ci tawh na kibang uh hi. Ahi zongin ci a alna bei leh i alsakkik theih nading lampi om nawn lo hi. A kizat nading bangmah om nawn lo a, mite' tuatcilgawp dingin kipaai lel hi.

Hoihtakin na phawk ding uh thu panin: Van le lei a bei mateng, hih thukhamte a neupen khat nangawn' deihna tangtung lopi-in mawkmai lo ding hi.

"Tanglai mite tungah, 'Mi that kei un. Mi that peuhmah in sihna thuak ding hi,' ci-in a kigenna thu na zaksa uh ahi hi.
Ahi zongin ke'n note kiangah kong genin-ah: A sanggampa tungah a heh mi in thukhenna thuakkha thei ding hi. A sanggampa kiangah, 'Bangmah a kimang lo,' ci-in a ko bawl mi in uliante mai-ah thusitna thuak thei ding a, a sanggampa kiangah, 'Mi hai,' ci-in a simmawh mi in hell meikuang sungah khulna thuak thei ding hi.

"'A zi a ma mi peuhmah in a zi tungah makna lai pia ta hen,' ci-in a kigenna zong na zak khitsa uh ahi hi.
Ahi zongin ke'n note kiangah kong genin-ah: Mi khat peuhmah in pasal dang tawh a mawhna hang lobuang, a zi a mak peuhmah a, a zi in pasal a neihkik leh mi tawh a mawh dingin a bawl a suak hi. Tua a kima numei a tenpihte, numei tawh a mawh mah ahi hi.
"Tanglai-in mite tungah, 'Pasian tungah na kiciamnate uh pelh kei unla, ama tungah na kiciam bangun tungsak un,' ci-in a kigenna na zaksa uh ahi hi.
Ahi zongin ke'n note kiangah kong genin-ah: Hih ding khat peuhpeuh na neih uh ciangin kiciamna na zang vet kei un. Kiciamna-in vantung na zang kei un - Pasian' tokhom hi veve hi.

Kiciamna-in na lutang zong na zang kei in. Na lu tunga om samzang khat bek nangawn a kangsa vomsak thei loin, a vom pen na kangsak thei kei hi.
Na gen peuhmah ahi ahihleh, 'Hi,' ci inla, ahi lo ahihleh, 'Hilo,' cihna tawh kicingsak in. Tua bang hi loin kiciamna kam na zat ciangin Dawimangpa tawh kizomin thuman lo na hih lamtak hong kilang hi.

Mihonte in hih thu a theih uh ciangin lau mahmah uh a, Pasian in mihingte tungah hih bang vangliatna a piakna hangin ama min a phat uh hi.
Tua lai mun panin Jesuh a paikhiat ciangin siahdongpa Matthai a zumah tu-in a om mu a, "Hong zui in," a cih leh amah zong dingin a zuipah hi.
Jesuh in Matthai' inn-ah nitak an a nek laitakin siahdong dangte le thukham a khial midang tampite in zong Jesuh le a nungzuite tawh an a nekhawm uh hi.
Farisi mite in hih thu a muh uh ciangin Jesuh nungzuite kiangah, "Bang hangin na siapa un siahdongte le thukham khialte tawh an nekhawm ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Jesuh in hih thu a zak ciangin, "Cidamte in siavuan kisam lo uh a, cina mite bek in kisam uh hi.
Lai Siangtho sungah, 'Ganhing tawh biak ding ka deih kei a, migitna ka deihzaw hi,' ci-in a genna pen bang a cihnopna ahi hiam, va kan un. Mite in a zahtak mihoihte a sam dingin a hong pai ka hi kei a, mite in a pampaih mite a sam dingin a hong pai ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh kiangah Tuiphumpa Johan' nungzuite hong pai uh a, "Bang hangin kote le Farisi mite in an tang zelzel napi-in, na nungzuite in tang lo se ahi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Mopina pawi khatah, a zineipa a om sungin a mopawi simte dah dingin um na hi uh hiam? Dah het lo ding uh hi. Ahi zongin amaute kiang panin zineipa a kilakkhiat ding hun hong tung ding a, tua hun ciangin amaute in an a tang ding uh hi.
Kuamah in a ton nai lo puanbek thak tawh puan lui a phop kei hi. Tua bangin phop leh puanbek thak a ton ciangin a lui kaigawmin a vang a gol semsem ding hi.
Kuamah in savun um lui sungah leenggahzu thak thun lo hi. Kithun leh a savun um phukham ding a, a leenggahzu bua-in a savun um zong a sia a suak ding hi. Leenggahzu thak pen savun um thak sungah kithun bek hi. Tua ahih manin a nihin a sia om lo hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua bangin Jesuh in thu genin a om laitakin Jesuh kiangah Jew mi ulian khat hong pai-in ama mai-ah hong khukdin a, "Tu mahmahin ka tanu a si hi. Ahi zongin nang hong pai-in ama tungah na khut hong nga lecin amah hingkik ding hi," ci-in a thum hi.
Jesuh zong dingpah a, a nungzuite tawh tua mipa a zui uh hi.
Tua laitakin kum sawm le nih tawntung a si a luang numei khat Jesuh' nungah hong pai-in a puan mongteep a lawngsim hi.
Tua numei in, "A puan va lawng bek leng zong ka dam ding hi," ci-in a lungsimah ngaihsun hi.
Jesuh zong hong kihei a, tua numei a muh ciangin, "Ka tanu aw, na lung kinuamsak in. Na upna in nang hong damsak khinta hi," a cih khit phetin tua numei a dampah hi.
Jew mi ulianpa' inn-ah Jesuh a tun ciangin tamngai tum mite le mihonpi a gamlum henhan a muh ciangin,
"Na vekpi-un paikhia un. Hih numeino a si hi lo a, a ihmu bek ahi hi," a ci hi. Ahi zongin amaute in Jesuh zahpihin a nuihsan uh hi.
Ahi zongin mihonpite a pualamah a kipaikhiatsak khit ciangin tua numeino omna-ah Jesuh tumin a khut a va let ciangin tua numeino hong tho hi.
Hih thupiang tua gam khempeuhah a kizel hi.
Tua lai panin Jesuh a paikhiat ciangin mittaw mi nih in a nungah hong zui-in nakpitakin kiko uh a, "David' suan Jesuh aw, kote hong hehpih in," ci-in a thum uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in khua mukik uh a, Jesuh in amau tegel kiangah, "Hih thupiang kuamah theisak kei un," ci-in khauh takin a gen hi.
Ahi zongin amaute paikhia uh a, tua gam sung khempeuhah hih thu a zasak uh hi.
Tua mi nihte a paikhiat laitakun mi pawlkhat in dawi a veina hangin a pauthei lo mi khat, Jesuh kiangah a hong paipih uh hi.
Ama sung panin dawi a kihawlkhiat khit phetin tua mipa hong pautheikik pah hi. Mihonpite in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, "Israel gam sungah hih bang thu piang ngei nai lo hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin Farisi mite in, "Dawimang lianpen pa min tawh hih bangin dawi a hawlkhia ahi hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua bangin khuapite le khuaneute-ah Jesuh pai kawikawi a, a kikhopna uh innte-ah thu hilhin, Pasian' ukna hangin a lungdamhuai thute gen a, natna nam khempeuh a damsak hi.
Mihonte a muh ciangin, a cing nei lo tuuhon bangin gimna ngahin lungkhamin om uh ahih manin hehpihhuai a sa hi.
Tua ahih manin a nungzuite kiangah, "Anlak ding tampi om napi-in anlak na a sem ding mi tawmbek a om hi.
Tua ahih manin ama an a la dingin an nei Topa in nasem tampi hong sawl nadingin thu ngen un," a ci hi.
Jesuh in a nungzui sawm le nihte sam a, dawite a hawlkhiat theih nading uh le natna nam khempeuh a damsak theih nadingun amaute tungah vangliatna a pia hi.
Tua sawltak sawm le nihte' min in: A masa-in Simon (Peter zong a kici pa) le a naupa Andru, Zebedi' tapa James le a naupa Johan,
Filip le Bartholomew, Thomas le siahdongpa Matthai, Alfeas' tapa James, Thaddeas,
Simon (gam khual pa), le Jesuh a lehhek Iskariot' tapa Judas ahi uh hi.
Jesuh in hih mi sawm le nihte sawl a, "Gentail mite gam sung ahi a, Samaria mite khua sungah ahi zongin lut kei un.
Tuu bangin a mangthang Israel mite lakah va paizaw un.
Na paina peuh uhah, 'Vantung ki-ukna hong naita hi,' ci-in thu va hilh un.
Cinate damsakin, misite hingsakin, miphakte damsakin, dawite va hawlkhia un. Man piak kul loin hih vangliatna na ngah uh bangin hih vangliatna na zatna uhah zong man va ngen kei un.
Kham ahi a, ngun ahi a, sumngo ahi zongin sum peuhmah na ip sung uhah keng kei un.
Khualzinna-ah an ngenin puak nading ip ahi a, khedap ahi a, ciangkhut ahi zongin keng kei unla, puanak zong a val kengthuah kei un. Nasem mite pen amau sapnateng mite in a piak ding a ngeina ahi hi.
"Khuapi ahi a, khuaneu ahi zongin khua khat peuhpeuh na tun uh ciangin tua khua sungah note zin hong tungsak nuam kua om ahi hiam, ci-in zong unla, na muh uh ciangin tuate' inn-ah tungin, tua khua na nusiat mateng uh tua lai mahah omsuak pah un.
Inn khat peuhpeuhah na lut uh ciangin a mite hopihin thupha na pia un.
Tua na hopihna uh innsunga mite in note hong tunsaknop leh na hopihna thupha uh amaute tungah kip ding a, ahi zongin hong tunsaknop kei uhleh na hopihna thupha uh na dokkik ding uh hi.
Inn khat peuhpeuh in ahi a, khua khat peuhpeuh in ahi zongin note hong tunsaknop kei a, na thugen uh hong ngaihnop kei leh tua lai panin paikhia unla, na khe uha leivui bangte sinkhiat un.
Thukhen ni ciangin tua khuamite' thuakna sangin Sodom khua le Gomorrah khuamite' thuakna olzaw lai ding ahihna thu hoihtakin phawk un.
"Ngiahon lakah tuu a kikhah bangin note hong sawlkhia ka hih manin gul bangin pilvang unla, vakhu bangin migi un.
Mi pawlkhatte in note hong manin zumah hong paipih ding uh a, amaute' kikhopna inn sungah hong satgawp ding uh ahih manin hoihtakin kidawm un.
Keima hangin gam ukte le kumpite mai-ah thu hong kisit ding hi. Hih bang na tuah uh ciangin thu hong sit mite le Gentail mite tungah Lungdamna Thu gentheih nading hunhoih a nei na hi uh hi.
Tua bangin thusitna a thuak dingin hong kipaipih ciangin, bang gen ding ihi hiam, ci-in lunghimawh kei un. A hun a tun ciangin na gen ding teng uh hong kihilh ding hi.
Thu na gen uh ciangin note' gen hi loin, na Pa uh' Kha Siangtho in note tungtawnin thu a gen ding ahi hi.
Unau le unau, pa in a ta, tate in a nu a pate langpangin sihna a thuak dingin khatlekhat kiheek ding uh hi.
Keima hangin Gentail mi khempeuh in note hong mudah ding uh hi. Ahi zongin a tawp dongin a thuakzo mite in hotkhiatna a ngah ding uh hi.
Khua khatah note hong kibawlsiat leh khuadang khatah tai un. Note kiangah kong genin-ah: Israel khua khempeuh na khit ma-un Mihing Tapa hong pai ding hi.
"A siapa sangin a sang naupangte lianzaw ngei lo a, a topa sangin a silate lianzaw ngei lo hi.
Tua ahih manin sang naupangte pen a siapa uh tawh a kibat uhleh a lungkim ding uh hi a, silate pen a tote uh tawh a kibat uhleh a lungkim ding uh ahi hi. Innteek lutang pa pen Beelzebul hong ci uh ahihleh a innkuanpih mite tua sangin min siazaw tawh hong kozaw lai ding uh hi lo ahi hiam?
"Tua ahih manin kuamah kihta kei un. A kiseelte khatvei teitei kimu ding a, thusimte khatvei teitei thulang suak ding hi.
Zan khuamial sunga kong gente, sun khuavak sungah taangko unla, a simthamin kong huau thute, innkhumdawn zangah na taangko un.
Pumpi a thah khit ciangin kha a that thei lote na kihta kei un. Hell khuk sungah pumpi le kha a nihin a susia thei pa na kihtazaw un.
Gitta nih ciangin mat khatin kizuak lel hi lo ahi hiam? Tua hinapi-in na Pa uh' thukim lohin tua gittate khat nangawn lei-ah mawkkiat lo hi.
Note ahihleh na lu tung uha na sammal phazah nangawn uh hong kiciamtehsak hi.
Tua ahih manin lau kei un. Gitta tampi sangin note na manphazaw uh hi.
"Keima mi ahihna thu mite' theihin a genkhia mite, kei zong vantungah ka Pa' mai-ah keima mi ahihna thu ka gen ding hi.
Ahi zongin keima mi ahihna thu mite' theihin a genkhia nuam lote, kei zong vantungah ka Pa' mai-ah keima mi ahihna thu ka genkhia nuam kei ding hi.
"Leitungah kilemna a omsak dingin hong pai hi, ci-in hong ngaihsun kei un. Kilemna a omsak dingin a hong pai ka hi kei a, kido nading namsau a khah dingin a hong pai ka hizaw hi.
Tate le pate a kidosak ding, tanute le nute a kidosak ding, monute le teeknute a kidosak dingin a hong pai ka hi hi.
Mi khat a dingin a gal lian penpen ama innkuanpih mite mah hong hi ding hi.
"Kei sangin a nu a pa a itzawte kei tawh kilawm lo a, kei sangin a tapa a tanu a itzawte kei tawh kilawm lo hi.
Ama singlamteh mah puatawm lopi-in ka nung hong zuite kei tawh kilawm lo hi.
Hih leitung nuntakna a hon nuamte in a nuntakna taktak taanlawh ding a, keima hangin a nuntakna a taanlawhte in a nuntakna taktak a ngah ding uh hi.
"Na thugen uh a hong sangte in kei' thu a hong sang hi a, kei a hong sangte in kei a hong sawl pa zong a sang ahi uh hi.
Pasian' thugen ahihna hangin Pasian' thugen mi a sangte in Pasian' thugente' thaman ngah ding a, mihoih hihna hangin mihoih a sang mite in mihoihte' thaman ngah ding uh hi.
Keima nungzui mi a neupen khat nangawn, keima nungzui ahihna hangin tuivot hai khat bek a suahte nangawn in pel loin thaman a ngah ding lamtak phawk un," ci-in a vaikhak hi.
Jesuh in a nungzui sawm le nihte a vaikhakna a man khit ciangin tua kiimnai-a om khuate-ah thuhilh ding le thugen dingin tua mun panin a paikhia hi.
Tuiphumpa Johan in thong sung panin Jesuh' nasepnate a zak ciangin Jesuh kiangah a nungzuite sawl a,
"Nang pen a hong pai ding pa na hi hiam, tua ahih kei leh adang na lamen lai ding ka hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dongsak hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Va ciahkik unla, tu-a na zakte uh le na muh uh thute va gen un:
Mittawte in khua mukik a, khebaite paithei kikin, miphakte damkik a, bilngongte in khua za kikin, misite hingkik a, mizawngte tungah Lungdamna Thu a kihilhnate va gen un.
Kei hong umte pen a lungdamhuai mahmah ahi hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua thudong mite a ciahkhiat khit ciangin Jesuh in mihonte kiangah Johan' thu gen a, "Gamlakah Johan kiangah na pai uh ciangin bang a mu dingin kilamen na hi uh hiam? Huih in a mut awn diamdiam lopakungte a en ding maw?
Tua hi lo ahihleh bang a mu dingin kilamen na hi uh hiam? Puan hoihnono a silhpa a mu dingin kilamen maw? A taktakin ci lehang, puan hoihnono a silhte pen kumpi inn sungah om uh hi.
Tua ahih kei leh bang a en dingin pai na hi uh hiam? Kamsangpa a en ding maw? Hi hi; kamsangpa a en dingin na pai uh a, tua na muhpa uh kamsang mawkmawk ciang bek hi loin a lianzaw khat ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho in Johan' thu a genna-ah, 'Na pai nading lampi a hongkhol dingin nangma mai-ah ka kamtai pa ka sawl hi,' ci-in Pasian in gen hi, ci-in kigelh hi.
Leitung mi khempeuh sung pan Tuiphumpa Johan a lianpen ahi hi. Ahi zongin vantung ki-ukna sungah a neupen i cihte nangawn Johan sangin lianzaw lai hi.
Tuiphumpa Johan' thuhilh hun a kipan tu ciang dong, mite in vantung ki-ukna thu hong kituhteh gawp uh a, thahatthu hong ciam uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Tuiphumpa Johan thuhilh a kipat hun ciang dong, kamsangte khempeuh le Moses Thukham khempeuh in hih vantung ki-ukna thu gen belin a nei uh hi.
Tua thu kigensa na upnop uhleh, a kigenkhol bangin a hong pai ding Elijah a kici pen Tuiphumpa Johan ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin bil neite in na za ta un.
"Ahi zongin tuhun mite bang tawh genteh ding ka hi hiam cih leh: Mihon omna lamkabomah a tu naupang a kimawlte tawh kibang uh hi. Naupang honkhat in a lawmte kiangah,
'Lam nading khuang kong tumsak uh hangin na lam nuam kei uh a, kah la ka sak uh hangin lah na kap nuam tuan kei uh hi,' a kicite tawh a kibang uh hi.
Mihing Tapa hong pai leuleu a, zune anne-in a om ciangin, 'Zuhai anhai pa; siahdongte le midangte in a kikholhpih nop loh mite tawh a kikhawlpa,' ci leuleu uh hi. Ahi zongin Pasian' pilna a man taktakna thu a gah panin hong kilang hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in nalamdang tampi a bawlna mun khuapi mite kisik nuam lo uh ahih manin taiibawl ding kipan a,
"Khorazin khuapi mite le Bethsaida khuapi mite aw, gimna lianpi na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note khua sungah a hong kilak na lamdangte, Taia le Sidon khua sungah kilak hileh amaute in kisikna limin sawtpekin puanhampi silhin vut kinuh ding uh hi.
Tua ahih manin thukhen ni ciangin note' thuakna sangin, Taia le Sidon khuamite' thuakna baihzaw lai ding ahihna thu phawk ta un.
Kapernaum khuapi mite aw, van a sangna munah hong kipahtawi ding sa na hi uh hiam? Hell khuk sungah hong kilawnsuk ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note' khuasunga hong kibawl na lamdangte, Sodom khua sungah kibawl hileh tuni dongin tua khua kip lai ding hi.
Tua ahih manin thukhen ni ciangin note' thuakna sangin Sodom khuamite' thuakna baihzaw lai ding ahihna thu phawk ta un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Vantung le leitung Topa ahi ka Pa aw, mipilte le misiamte tungah na ip hih thute, bangmah a thei lo hih mite tungah lak na hih manin ka nuam hi.
Pa aw, hih pen nangma deihna le na lungkimna bangin na hih ahi hi.
"Ka Pa in kei tungah na khempeuh hong pia khin hi. Pa simloh Tapa a thei kuamah om lo a, Tapa le Tapa in a theihsaknop mite simloh, pa a thei kuamah om lo hi.
"Na semin vangik pua-in a gim mite khempeuh aw, ka kiangah hong pai ta un. Note tungah lungsim tawldamna ka hong pia ding hi.
Keima hakkol zamin kisuan unla, kei kiangah hong kisin dih un. Kei pen kiniamkhiatin nem hithiat ka hih manin ka kiangah na tawl uh a dam ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh note kong suat ding ka hakkol nuam a, na puak ding uh van zong a zang mah ahi hi," ci-in a genkhia hi.
Tua zawh a sawt loin Sabbath ni khatin mangbuh lo nawkin Jesuh a pai hi. A nungzuite a gil uh kial ahih manin mangbuhvuite zutin a ne uh hi.
Farisi mite in a muh uh ciangin Jesuh kiangah, "En in, Sabbath ni-in i hih dingin a kilawm lo gamtatna na nungzuite gamta uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "David le a kikholhpihte a gilkial laitakun David' gamtatna thu sim ngei lo na hi uh hiam?
Pasian' inn sungah amah lut a, siampite lobuang, amah le a kikholhpihte in a nektheih ding ahi lo Ompihna Anlum la-in amah le a kikholhpihte in a ne uh hi.
Tua ahih kei leh zong siampite in Sabbath sim mahin biakinn sungah Sabbath thukham khial napi-in mawhsakna a ngah tuan lohna thu uh, Moses Thukham sungah sim ngei lo na hi uh hiam?
Note kiangah kong genin-ah: Tua biakinn sangin a lianzaw khat hih lai-ah hong om hi.
Lai Siangtho sungah, 'Ganhing tawh biak ding ka deih kei a, migitna ka deihzaw hi,' a cihnopna thu teltakin thei le-uhcin a mawh lopi kimlai na mawhsak kei ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Mihing Tapa pen Sabbath ni a ukpa ahi hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua lai panin Jesuh paisuakin amau kikhopna inn sungah a lut hi.
Tua lai-ah a khut langkhat a zaw mi khat a na om hi. Jesuh gamta khial hi, ci-in a mawhna a zong nuam mi pawlkhat tua lai-ah om uh ahih manin tua mite in Jesuh kiangah, "Sabbath ni-in cina damsak ding a kilawm mah ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Note khatpeuh in tuu khat nei unla, Sabbath ni-in dum sungah tua tuu kia leh, tua tuu va lenin kaikhiato ding hi lo na hi uh hiam?
Mi pen tuu sangin nakpitakin manphazaw ahih manin Sabbath ni-in a hoih sep ding a kilawm ahi hi," ci-in a dawn khit ciangin
a mipa kiangah, "Na khut zan in," a ci hi. A mipa in zong a khut zanpah a, midangte mah bangin hoihtakin a damkik hi.
Ahi zongin Farisi mite paikhia uh a, Jesuh a thahtheih nading uh vai a hawm uh hi.
Jesuh in amah a kisawmna thu a theih ciangin tua mun panin a paikhia hi. Mi tampi in amah hong zui uh hi. Amah in cina mi khempeuh damsak a,
Pasian in kamsang Isaiah tungtawnin a gen thu a tuntheih nadingin, kuama kiangah ama thu a gen loh nadingun thu a pia hi. Tua a genna-ah,
"Keimah in ka teelsa ka nasempa, ka it mahmah, ka lungkimna pa en un. Keima Kha ama tungah ka pia ding a, Gentail mite tungah upna man a pulak ding hi.
Amah in thu seel loin, a aw sangsak lo ding a, konglakah zong a awging kiza lo ding hi.
Amah in a zawngkhal mite dopbawl ding a, a cimawh mite tungah migi ding hi. Thuman thutang a gualzawhsak mateng khawl ngei lo ding hi.
Gentail mite in amah bek mah lametin nei ding uh hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin mi pawlkhat in Jesuh kiangah mittawt le pau theih loh a thuah dawivei mi khat hong paipih uh hi. Jesuh in amah damsak ahih manin amah hong pauthei-in khua zong hong muthei hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, "Hih pa, i lametet David' suan hi lo ding ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin Farisi mite in hih thu a zak uh ciangin, "Dawimangpa Beelzebul min tawh dawi a hawlkhia hi lel hi," a ci uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute' ngaihsutna thei ahih manin amaute kiangah, "Gam khat peuhpeuh, a gammite kiphelkhamin pawlkhat le pawlkhat kido le-uh tua gam a sia suak ding hi; khua khat ahi a, innkuan khat ahi zongin kiphelkhamin kido le-uh kip lo ding hi.
Tua mah bangin Satan le Satan kihawlkhia le-uh a ukna bangci kip theih ding ahi hiam?
Keimah in Beelzebul vangliatna tawh dawite hawlkhia ka hih leh na mipihte un a kua' vangliatna tawh hawlkhia ahi uh hiam? Na mipihte un na ngaihsut khialhna uh hong kilangsak hi.
Note' ngaihsut bang hi loin, Pasian' Kha in dawi hawlkhiat nading vangliatna kei tungah hong pia ahih manin note lakah Pasian' ukna hun hong kipan khin ahihna hong kilang hi.
Mi khatpeuh in mi thahat khat pa' inn sungah lutin a neihsate a laksak theih nadingin tua inn nei a thahatpa a hencip masak phot ding kisam hi. A hencip zawh khit ciang bekin a inn-ah lutin a neihsate lathei pan hi.
Kei hong pawlpih lo peuhmah keima lang hi uh a, kei hong kaihkhoppih lo peuhmah a thehthang ahi uh hi.
Tua ahih manin note kiangah kong genin-ah: Mihingte' kampau khialhna le gamtat khialhnate kimaisak thei ding a, ahi zongin Kha Siangtho langpangin a gensiate kimaisak lo ding hi.
Mihing Tapa langpangin a gensiate a mawhna uh kimaisak thei ding a, ahi zongin Kha Siangtho langpangin a gensiate pen tuhun a kipan a tawntungin a mawhna uh kimaisak lo ding hi.
"Singgah limci a gahtheih nadingin a kung a cidam phot ding kisam a, a kung gina kei leh a gah limci lo hi. Tua ahih manin singkung khat a pianzia pen a gahin hong kithei hi.
Gul bangin ngian a zang note aw, migilo na hih uh ciangin bangci-in thuhoih genthei mah ding na hi uh hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh lungsim sunga thu om pen kam in a genkhia hi bek hi.
Mihoihte in a hoih a kholteng suahkhia a, migilote in gitlohna a kholteng a suahkhia ahi hi.
Note kiangah kong genin-ah: Thukhen ni ciangin mi khempeuh in phattuamna a om lo a kampaunate uh khempeuh bangin thusitna a thuak ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nomau kampauna tawh kizui-in thu hong kikhen ding a, dik hi, cihna ahi a, mawh hi, cihna ahi zongin na ngah nadingun nomau kampau mah hong kibulphuh ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Thukham hilh siate le Farisi mi pawlkhat in Jesuh kiangah, "Sia aw, nalamdang khat nong lah ding ka deih uh hi," ci-in a ngen uh hi.

Hih thu ka gen ciangin anlum thu a gen ka hihlohlam bangci-in phawk thei lo lawmlawm na hi uh hiam? Farisi-te le Saddusi-te' silngo hoihtakin kidawm un," a ci hi.

amaute in, 'Kuamah in nasem dingin hong cial lo hi,' ci-in a dawng uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, 'No zong leenggah lo-ah va kuan un,' a ci hi.

Ahih hangin a mipa paikhia-in a paina khempeuhah hih thupiang khempeuh gen belin a nei hi. Hih thu nakgen lua-in kitheithang gawp ahih manin, tua hun a kipanin mite' theihin khua sungah Jesuh lut thei nawn lo hi. Tua ahih manin gamdaihna munah amah om a, mun khempeuh panin ama kiangah mite a hong pai uh hi.
Tuazawh ni tawmkhat khit ciangin Kapernaum khua-ah Jesuh hong paikik a, inn-ah a omna thu hong kitheithang hi.
Mi tampi tak hong kikhawm uh ahih manin innsung khempeuh, kongkhak pualam nangawnah mi a dim hi. Jesuh in amaute kiangah Pasian' thu hilhin a om laitakin,
mihing li in Jesuh kiangah khutlekhezaw mi khat a paipih dingin hong pua uh hi.
Ahi zongin mihonpi kinehlua ahih manin Jesuh kiangah paipih thei lo uh hi. Tua ahih manin Jesuh' omna san inn tungkhum hongletin, a lupna pheek tawh a mipa a khaisuk uh hi.
Jesuh in hih mite' up mahmahna thu a muh ciangin khutlekhezaw mipa kiangah, "Ka ta aw, na mawhnate hong kimaisak hi," a ci hi.
Tua lai-ah a om, Thukham hilh siate pawlkhat in a lungsim sung uhah,
"Bang hangin hih mipa, Pasian tawh a kikim bangin kingaihsunin hih bangin pau ngam ahi hiam? Pasian simloh kuamah in mawhna maisak thei lo hi," ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi.
Jesuh in a lungsim sung uha amau ngaihsutna theipah ahih manin amaute kiangah, "Bang hangin tua bangin ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?
Hih khutlekhezaw mipa kiangah, 'Na mawhna hong kimaisak khin hi,' cih ding le, 'Tho-in na lupna pheek la inla pai dih in,' cih ding koi baihzaw ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin Mihing Tapa in leitungah mawhmaisak theih nading thu nei hi, ci-in na theih nadingun kong lak ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih manin khutlekhezaw mipa kiangah,
"Tho-in na lupna pheek la inla, na inn-ah ciah in," a ci hi.
Tua mipa zong amaute khempeuh' muhin tho a, a lupna pheek la-in a paikhia pah hi. Amaute khempeuh in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, Pasian phatin, "Hih bang mahmah i mu ngei nai het kei hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Galilee Tuili gei-ah Jesuh a paikik hi. Ama kiangah mihonpi hong pai uh a, Jesuh in tua mihonte thu a hilh hi.
Tua bangin a paina-ah Alfeas tapa Levi, a siahdonna zumah tu-in a om a mu hi. Jesuh in ama kiangah, "Kei hong zui in," a ci hi. Levi zong dingin Jesuh' nung a zuipah hi.
Tua nung ciangin Jesuh in Levi' inn-ah an a va ne hi. Siahdong mi tampi le thukham a khial mi tampite in Jesuh zui uh a, amaute tampi in Jesuh le a nungzuite tawh an a nekhawm uh hi.
Hih thukham khialte le siahdongte tawh Jesuh in an a nekkhopna Farisi mite sung panin Thukham hilh siate pawlkhat in a muh uh ciangin a nungzuite kiangah, "Bang hangin hih bang mite tawh an nekhawm ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Jesuh in hih thu a zak ciangin amaute kiangah, "Cidamte in siavuan kisam lo uh a, cina mite bek in kisam uh hi. Mite in a zahtak mihoihte a kisik nadingun a sam dingin a hong pai ka hi kei a, mite in a pampaih mite a kisik nadingun a sam dingin a hong pai ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua hun laitakin Tuiphumpa Johan' nungzuite le Farisi mite in an a tang uh hi. Jesuh kiangah mi pawlkhat hong pai-in, "Bang hangin Tuiphumpa Johan' nungzuite le Farisi mite' nungzuite in an tang uh a, nangma nungzuite in tang lo se ahi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Jesuh in, "Mopawi a siim mite in an ne lo dingin um na hi uh hiam? Zineipa tawh a omkhawm sung uh an ne loin om lo ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin amaute kiang panin zineipa a kipaikhiatpih hun hong tung ding a, tua hun a tun ciangin an ne loin a om ding uh hi.
"Kuamah in puantungsilh lui phop nadingin a ton nai lo puanbek a thak zang ngei lo hi. Zang zenzen leh a puanbek thak in a puan lui balkek ding a, a vang gol zawsop ding hi.
Kuamah in savun um lui sungah leenggahzu a thak thun ngei lo hi. Thun zenzen leh leenggahzu in savun um phukham ding a, a leenggahzu le a savun um, a nih tuakin a kisia suak ding hi. Tua ahih manin leenggahzu thak koih nadingin savun um thak kizang hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Khatvei, Sabbath ni khatin Jesuh le a nungzuite, mangbuh lo nawkin a pai uh hi. A paikawmun a nungzuite in mangbuhvui a zut uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Farisi mite in Jesuh kiangah, "Bang hangin Sabbath ni-in gamtat loh dingpi, na nungzuite gamta uh ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Jesuh in, "David in annek ding a kisap laitakin a gamtatna thu sim ngei lo na hi uh hiam? Amah le a mite a gilkial uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian' biakinn sungah lutin Pasian biakna-a a kipia anlumte a ne uh hi. Abiathar in siampi lianpen a sep laitakin hih thu piang hi. I Thukham tawh kizui-in ci lehang, hih anlumte pen siampite bek in a nektheih ding hinapi-in David in ne-in, a mite nangawn a pia lai hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Sabbath ni, mihingte' phattuam nadingin a kibawl hi a, mihing pen Sabbath ni a phattuam nadingin a kibawl hi lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Mihing Tapa pen Sabbath ni nangawn a ukpa ahi hi," ci-in a thugen a khum hi.
Tua ciangin kikhopna inn sungah Jesuh paikik a, tua lai-ah a khut a langkhat a zaw mi khat na om hi.
Jesuh gamtakhial hi, ci-in a mawhsak nuam mi pawlkhat tua lai-ah om uh a, Sabbath ni-in hih mipa a damsakkha hiam, ci-in vil gige uh hi.
Jesuh in khutzaw mipa kiangah, "Hih a mai lamah hong ding in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mite kiangah, "Sabbath ni-in bang i hih ding i Thukham in hong deih ahi hiam? Huh ding maw, gimsak ding; mi khat a nuntakna hot ding maw, thah ding; koi hong deihzaw ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi. Ahih hangin kuamah in dawng lo hi.
Jesuh in hehmai tawh a kiim a pam en kawikawi a, ahi zongin a khialhna uh le a thuphawk theih lohna uh hangin mite khasiathuai a sa zel hi. Tua ciangin a mipa kiangah, "Na khut zan in," a ci hi. Amah in zong a khut zan a, damin a ngeina bangkik hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kikhopna inn panin Farisi mite paikhia-in Herod pawlte kimkhat tawh kikhopna neipah uh a, Jesuh a thahtheih nading uh a vaihawm uh hi.
Tua lai panin Galilee Tuili-ah Jesuh le a nungzuite pai uh a, Galilee gam, Judea gam,
Jerusalem khua, Idumia gam, Jordan galkhat, Taia khuapi kiim le Sidon khuapi kiima om gamte in ama hihsa thute zakhin uh ahih manin, hih gamte panin mihon tampi tak, ama kiangah hong pai uh hi.
Mihonte tamlua mahmah ahih manin amaute in Jesuh a nehcipgawp khak loh nadingin ama om nading gunkuang khat a koih nadingun a nungzuite a sawl hi.
Amah in cina mi tampi damsakkhin ahih manin, Jesuh a lawntheih nadingun cina khempeuh in amah hong naih ciat uh hi.
Tua laitakin mite' sunga lut dawite in Jesuh a muh uh ciangin a mai-ah pukin kiko uh a, "Nang pen Pasian' Tapa na hi hi," a ci uh hi.
Dawite in amah kua mi ahi cihna thu a genkhiat loh nadingun Jesuh in nakpitakin dawite a kham hi.
Tua lai panin a mualtung lamah Jesuh paito a, mi a deihteng ama kiangah a sam hi. Tua a sap mite ama kiangah hong pai uh a,
amah in mi sawm le nih teelin, sawltakte, ci-in min a phuah hi. Jesuh in, "Kei tawh a kikhawl dingin noteng ka hong teel hi. Thu a hilh dingin zong ka hong sawl ding a,
dawi hawlkhiat nading vangliatna na nei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua a teel mi sawm le nihte: Simon (Jesuh in a min thak dingin Peter a phuah pa),
Zebedi' tapa James le a naupa Johan (Jesuh in hih unaute pen "Vanging bang," a cih nopna Boanerges min a phuahte),
Andru, Filip, Bartholomew, Matthai, Thomas, Alfeas' tapa James, Thaddeas, Simon (gam khual pa),
le Jesuh a lehhek Iskariot' tapa Judas ahi uh hi. Tua lai panin inn-ah Jesuh ciah a,
ama kiangah mihonpi hong kikhawmkik zel ahih manin Jesuh le a nungzuite in an nangawn ne thei lo uh hi.
A innkuanpihte in hih thu a zak uh ciangin Jesuh a la dingin hong kuankhia uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh, "Jesuh mihai suakta hi," a kicihna thu a za uh hi.
Jerusalem khua pan a hong pai Thukham hilh siate pawlkhat in, "Hih pa sungah Beelzebul lut hi. Dawimangpa in ama tungah dawi hawlkhiat theih nading vangliatna pia hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Jesuh in ama kiangah mite samin thugentehna tawh thu hilh a, "Satan in Satan bangci hawlkhiat theih ding ahi hiam?
Gam khat peuhpeuh phelnih kisuahin kido le-uh tua gam kip lo ding hi.
Innkuan khat peuhpeuh phelnih kisuahin kido le-uh tua innkuan kipzo lo ding hi.
Satan le Satan kikhenin kido le-uh kipzo lo ding uh a, a bei ding uh hita uh hi.
Mi thahatpa hencip masa lopi-in kuamah in mi thahatpa' innsung pan a neihsate laksak zo lo ding hi. A hencip khit ciang bekin laksakzo pan bek ding hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin hih thu phawk un! Mihingte' mawhna le a kampau siatnate uh kimaisak thei ding hi.
Ahi zongin Kha Siangtho langpangin thu a gente in mawhna kip sukha uh ahih manin a mawhna uh kimaisak ngei lo ding hi," a ci hi.
(Mi pawlkhatte in, "Jesuh in dawi vei hi," ci uh ahih manin hih bangin thu a gen ahi hi.)
Tua laitakin a nu le a naute hong tung uh a, inn pualamah ngakin, Jesuh a sam dingin mi a sawl uh hi.
Ama kiimah a tu mihonpite in, "Na nu le na naute, inn pua-ah om uh a, nang hong sam uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Jesuh in, "Ka nu le ka naute i cih kuate ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Ama kimkotah a tu mite en a, "Hih lai-ah ka nu le ka sanggamte om uh hi.
Pasian' deihna bangin a gamta mi khempeuh ka nu le ka sanggamte ahi uh hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in Galilee Tuili gei-ah thuhilh ding kipankik leuleu hi. Ama kiimah a kikhawm mite tamlua ahih manin gunkuang sungah pai-in a tu hi. A gunkuang pen tui tungah om a, mihonpite ahihleh tuigei leilakah om uh hi.
Amah in thugentehna tawh thu tampi hilh a, a thuhilhna-ah:
"Ngai un! Khaici vawhpa, khaici vawh dingin a kuankhia hi.
Khaici a vawh ciangin pawlkhatte lamdung tu a, vasate hong leengin tawmin a ne uh hi.
Pawlkhatte leihoih a sah lohna mun, suang a kitawphah tung tu a, lei sah lo ahih manin thakhatin popah hi.
Tua ankungnote in zung thuk kha zo lo ahih manin nisa in a kat ciangin a keutumpah uh hi.
Pawlkhatte lingbulsum omna lak tu a, lingte hong selin depgawp ahih manin bangmah gahzo lo hi.
Adangte ahihleh leihoihna mun tu ahih manin hong po-in khang a, a zah sawmthum, a zah sawmguk, a zah zakhat dongin an hong piang hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Zak nading bil a neite in hih thu za ta un," ci-in a thugen a khum hi.
Mihonpite a ven', amah guak a om ciangin nungzui sawm le nihte le ama thugen a za mite in, na thugentehna a khiatna hong gen in, ci-in a ngen uh hi.
Jesuh in, "Pasian' Ukna tawh kisai thusim, Pasian in note tungah hong gen khinzo hi. Ahi zongin a pualama om mite tungah na khempeuh, thugentehna bek tawh kigen hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh, 'En en napi-un a muh nai loh nading, za za napi-un a tel nai loh nading; amaute in mu-in tel le-uh Pasian' lamah kihei ding uh a, Pasian in amaute' mawhna maisak ding hi,'" ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Note in hih thugentehna thei lo na hi uh hiam? Thei lo na hih uhleh, thugentehna khat peuhpeuh bangci theih ngei ding na hi uh hiam?
Khaici vawhpa in khaici vawh bangin Pasian' thu a vawh hi.
Khat veivei lamdung a tu khaici bang a, mite in a thu za napi-in, a zakkhit phetun Satan hong pai-in amaute sunga a kivawh thute lakkhiatsak hi.
Mi pawlkhatte, khaici pawlkhat a tukna suang kitawphah leilak tawh kibang uh hi. Thu a zak phetun lungdam takin sang uh hi.
Ahi zongin amaute sungah thuktum lo ahih manin sauveipi kip lo hi. Tua thu hangin lungkhamna ahi a, bawlsiatna ahi zongin a tun ciangin a pukpah uh hi.
Mi pawlkhatte, khaici pawlkhat a tukna mun lingbulsum a omna leilak tawh kibang uh hi. Hih bang mite in Pasian' thu a zak hangun,
hih leitung lunghihmawhna, hauhnopna, le deihna dang a tuamtuamte in a thu khuhcip ahih manin bangmah suakkhia zo lo hi.
Ahi zongin midangte ahihleh khaici pawlkhat a tukna mun leihoih tawh kibang uh hi. Amaute in Pasian' thu za-in sang uh a, pawlkhatte a dingin a zah sawmthum, pawlkhatte a dingin a zah sawmguk, pawlkhatte a dingin a zah za khatin man a nei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Mi khatpeuh in mei a kivak hong la-in lawh peuh khuh a, ahih kei leh lupna nuai peuhah koih ngei ahi hiam? A kimuh theih nading meivakna kho sang tungah koih hi lo ahi hiam?
Thusimin a kikoih peuhmah khatvei teitei thulang a suak ding, a kiseel peuhmah khatvei teitei a kipholak ding, cih deihna simloh bang dang om ahi hiam?
Zak nading bil a neite in hih thu za ta un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, "Na zak uh thu limtakin ngaihsun un. Midangte tungah na piakna uh tawh kizui-in note tungah Pasian in hong pia ding a, a tamzaw-in hong piathuah ding hi.
A neisa mipa tungah Pasian in piathuah ding a, a nei lo mipa tung panin themkhat a neihsun nangawn laksak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Pasian' Ukna pen mi khat in a lolai-ah a vawh khaici tawh kibang hi.
Khaici vawhpa zanin ihmu a, zingsangin tho-in sunin a nasep ngeiteng a sem hi. Tua kikal sungin a khaici na po-in na khang a, ahi zongin tua a khantheihna zia amah in a thu thei lo hi.
Leitang in ama thu-in na khangsaktawm a, a masa-in a tehno, tua ciangin a kung, tua ciangin a tak a om dongin na khangsak hi.
An a min ciangin anlak ding hun ahih manin amah in a phiaukawi tawh an at ding a kipan hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Pasian' Ukna bang tawh kibang ci ding a, i gentel nadingin bang thugentehna zang ding ihi hiam?
Leitung a om khaici khempeuh lakah a neu penpen ankam tang tawh kibang hi. Mi khat in tua ankam tang lei-ah vawh a,
tawlkhat khit ciangin hong po-in hong khangto a, khaikung khempeuh lakah a golpen pawl hong suak hi. A kung golin a hiangte zaai ahih manin ama liim sung a hiang kawmah vasate in bu a tom uh hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in hih bang thugentehnate zangin mite tungah thu hilh a, amaute' telzawh zah ciangciang thu a gen hi.
Thugentehna lo tawh thu hilh ngei lo hi. A nungzuite guak tawh a omkhawm ciangin a thu khempeuh a gentel zel hi.
Tua ni mah a nitak ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, "Tui kantanin galkhat lamah pai ni," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a nungzuite in mihonpite nusia-in Jesuh a na tuannasa gunkuang tungah kahin a gunkuang tawh a paikhiatpih uh hi. Gunkuang dangte in zong amau a zui uh hi.
Tua laitakin nakpitakin huihpi hong nung a, tuihual hong omin gunkuang sungah tui hong dim dektak hi.
Jesuh pen gunkuang nung lamah lukham khamin ihmu-in a om hi. A nungzuite in amah phongin, "Sia aw, kote sita le ung phamawh hong sa lo na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Jesuh zong tho-in, "Nung nawn kei in," ci-in huihpi thu pia a, tuihualte kiangah, "Kilok nawn kei un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin huihnung khawlin dai khipkhep pah hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, "Bang hangin lau na hi uh hiam? Tu ciang dong upna nei nai lo na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
A nungzuite in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, "Huihpi le tuihualte nangawn, ama sawl bangin a gamta uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh le a nungzuite Galilee Tuili galkhat, Gadara mite' gam sung a tung uh hi.
Gunkuang tung panin Jesuh a kumsuk khit phetin, han lak panin a hong pai mi khat in na dawntuah hi.
Hih mipa dawivei hi a, han lakah a teng hi. Kuamah in hih mipa, sikkhau tawh henzo nawn lo uh hi.
Tamveipi tak, a khut le a khe, sikkhau tawh kihen khin ngei a, ahi zongin a kihen simin a sikkhaute botsatin, a khe-a kibulh kolte a sukham gawp hi. Amah hatlua ahih manin kuamah in hih zo lo hi.
Sun le zanin han lak le mualtung tengah vak kawikawi a, awng gawpin, suang hiamte tawh amah a kikuiliam hi.
Hih mipa in Jesuh a gal muh ciangin hong delhin ama mai-ah khukdin a,
nakpitakin kiko-in, "A Lianpen Pasian' Tapa Jesuh aw, kei bang hong nuammawh na hi hiam? Kei, gim hong pia kei in, ci-in Pasian' min tawh kong thum hi," a ci hi.
(Hih bangin a cihna pen, Jesuh in, "Dawi aw, hih mipa sung panin paikhia in," a cihna hang ahi hi.)
Jesuh in, "Na min bang ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi. Mipa in, "Kote tampi pha ka hih manun ka min pen A Honpi ahi hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua gam panin mundangah dawite a hawlkhiat loh nadingin tua mipa in a thum lailai hi.
Tua laitakin tua nai-a om mualpangah vok hon tampi gamta-in a om hi.
Dawite in, "Hua vokte kiang beekah hong paisak inla, a sungah hong tumsak in," ci-in a thum uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Jesuh in dawite a pai nading uh thu pia a, dawite zong mipa sung panin paikhia-in vokte sungah a lut uh hi. Tua vok honpite a vekpi-in tulnih bang pha hi. Mualtung panin taisuk henhan uh a, tuili sung kidenna-in tuikia mangkhin uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua vokcingte tai-in khuasung le gam sung tengah hih thupiang a gen uh hi. Tua thupiangte a en dingin mite zong hong pai uh hi.
Jesuh kiang a tun uh ciangin dawi tampi a vei ngei mipa zong a mu uh hi. Tua mipa hoihtakin om a, a lungsim pilin, puan silhin a om a muh uh ciangin lamdangsa-in lau mahmah uh hi.
Hih thupiang a mu mi khempeuh in dawivei pa tunga thupiang le vokte thu, mi khempeuh kiangah a gen kawikawi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amau gam panin a paikhiat nadingin mipite in Jesuh a sawlkhia uh hi.
Tua lai panin gunkuang tungah Jesuh a kahtoh kik ciangin dawi a vei ngei mipa in, "Kei zong hong zuisak in," ci-in a thum hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in amah zuisak lo a, "Na innkuanpihte kiangah ciahkik inla, Topa in nang a hong hehpihna le nangma tunga a hong bawlnate va gen in," ci-in a sawlzaw hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a mipa ciah a, tua kiima om Khuapi Sawmte sungah, Jesuh in ama a dingin a sepnate gen a, tua thu a za mi khempeuh in lamdang a sa uh hi.
Jesuh, gunkuang tuangin a galkah khit ciangin, tuili gei ama kiangah mi tampi tak hong kikhawm leuleu uh hi.
Tua laitakin kikhopna inn a uk, Jairas a kici mi khat hong pai a, Jesuh a muh ciangin a khe phungah bokin,
"Ka tanu si dektak ta hi. Amah a cidam kikin a nuntak theih nadingin hong pai inla, ama tungah na khut hong ngaksak in," ci-in a thum hi.
Jesuh zong, tua mipa tawh a paikhia khawm hi. Mi tampi tak in zong zui uh ahih manin Jesuh a nehcip uh hi.
Tuate lakah, kum sawm le nih sung tawntung siluang natna a nei numei khat a om hi.
Siavuan tampi in amah bawl a, a sum neih khempeuh zangkhin napi-in noptuamzaw loin gim semsemzaw hi.
Tua numei in Jesuh' thu za ahih manin mihonte kawmah Jesuh' nung a zui hi.
Tua nu in, "A puan mong nangawn va lawngkha leng, dam ning," ci-in a ngaihsun hi.
A va lawnkhit phetin a siluang khawlpah a, ama sunga a natna a damlam a kiphawk hi.
Jesuh in ama sung panin a vangliatna a paikhiatlam phawkpah ahih manin mihonpite lakah khuadakin, "Kua in ka puan hong lawng na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
A nungzuite in, "Mihonpite in nang hong nehcihlam na thei hi. Bang hangin kua in hong lawng na hi uh hiam, ci mawk na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin amah a lawngte a theih nadingin Jesuh khuadak kawikawi lai hi.
Tua numei in ama tunga thupiang thei ahih manin laukawm lingkawmin hong pai-in a khephungah hong bok a, a thupiang khempeuh ahi bangbangin a hong gen hi.
Jesuh in zong tua nu kiangah, "Ka tanu aw, na upna in nang hong damsakzo hi. Cidamsuak inla, lungnuam takin va ciah in," a ci hi.
Tua laitakin kikhopna inn ukpa' inn panin kamtaite hong tung uh a, "Na tanu si khinta hi. Bang hangin Siapa mawk gimsak nawn ding na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in amau thu kigen don loin kikhopna inn ukpa kiangah, "Lunghimawh kei in; upna nei peuh in," a ci hi.
Tua lai panin Jesuh in Peter le James le a nau Johan longal kuamah dang kizuisak nawn lo hi.
Kikhopna inn ukpa' inn a tun uh ciangin mite' kahna le thumna, a gamlumna uh a mu hi.
Amah sungtumin, "Bang hangin hici gamlum na hi uh hiam? Bang hangin kap na hi uh hiam? Numeino a si hi lo hi; a ihmu hibek hi," a ci hi.
Amaute in Jesuh zahpih bawlin nuihsan uh ahih manin Jesuh in amaute khempeuh pusuaksak a, numeino' pa le a nu, le a nungzui thumte tawh, numeino' lupna inndei-ah a pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin numeino' khut lenin, "Numeino aw, tho in," a cihna, " Talitha kumi ," a ci hi.
Numeino zong thakhatin tho-in lam a paipah hi. (Amah kum sawm le nih pha ta hi.) Tua ciangin amaute in lamdangsa mahmah uh hi.
Hih thu, kuama kiangah a gen loh nadingun Jesuh in nakpitakin amaute kham a, tua ciangin, "Numeino an pia un," ci-in a sawl hi.
Tua lai panin ama pianna khua Nazareth-ah Jesuh pai a, a nungzuite in a zui uh hi.
A Sabbath ni ciangin kikhopna inn-ah thu a hilh hi. Ama thuhilh a za mi tampite in lamdangsa-in, "Hih pa in hih thute koi panin a ngah ahi hiam? Hih pa tungah a kipia pilna a bang pilna ahi hiam? Bangci-in nalamdang hici bawltheih ahi hiam?
Amah khutsiampa hilel a, Mary' tapa hi lo ahi hiam? James, Josef, Judas, le Simon-te' u hi lo ahi hiam? A nau numeite zong hih lai mah a om hi lo ahi uh hiam?" a ci uh hi. Tua hi a, amah sangzo lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Kamsang khat pen, ama khua, ama behte, le ama innsung longal-ah kizahtakin pahtawina a ngah hi," a ci hi.
Tua hi a, cina tawmkhatte tungah khut nga-in a damsak cih simloh, tua lai-ah nalamdang lian bawl thei lo hi.
Amaute in amah a uploh manin lamdang a sa mahmah hi. Tua ciangin tua kiima om khuaneute-ah thuhilhin a pai kawikawi hi.
Jesuh in sawm le nihte sam a, amaute tungah dawi hawlkhiat nading vangliatna pia-in, amaute nih nihin a sawlkhia hi.
Amaute kiangah, "Ciangkhut simloh, na khualzinna uhah bangmah keng kei un. An ahi a, ip ahi a, sum ahi zongin keng kei un.
Khedap bulh unla, ahi zongin puanak nih silhthuah kei un.
A zin dingin a hong deih inn khat peuhpeuhah tung unla, tua khua panin na paikhiat mateng uh tua inn mahah om paisuak un.
Na paina uh khua khatpeuh in note hong sang loin, na thuhilhna uh hong ngaihnop kei uhleh, tua khua nusia-in, na khe uha leivui bangte sinsan un. Tua pen amaute a dingin hilhkholhna ahi hi," ci-in a vaikhak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute kuankhia uh a, mite a mawhna panun a kisik nadingun thu a hilh uh hi.
Dawi tampi hawlkhia uh a, cina mi tampi sathau zutin a damsak uh hi.
Kumpi Herod in Jesuh thu a kigengenna thu a za hi. Mi pawlkhat in, "Tuiphumpa Johan, sihna panin hingkik hi. Tua ahih manin hih vangliatnate nei hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin a dangte in, "Elijah hi," ci uh a, pawlkhat leuleu in, "Tanglai-a kamsangte mah bangin kamsang khat hi," a ci uh hi.
Herod in Jesuh' nasepnate a zak ciangin, "A lutang ka tankhiat sak Johan hong hingkik hi," a ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Herod in a nau Filip' zi Herodias a tenpihna hangin Johan in Herod kiangah, "Na naupa' zi na tenpih ding ngeina hi lo hi," ci-in gen zelzel ahih manin Herodias a heh suak a, galkapte in Johan manin thong sungah a khiat nadingin Herod a vaihawmsak hi.
Tua ahih manin Herodias in Johan mudahin thatnuam a, ahi zongin that zo lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Johan pen a thuman mihoih khat hi, ci-in Herod in ngaihsun ahih manin amah zahtakin siatna a thuak nading panin hu hi. Ama thugente in a lungsim nuam losak hi; ahi zongin a thugen zanuam veve hi.
Ahi zongin a tawpna-ah Herodias in hunhoih ngah hi. Herod a suah ni hun a tun ciangin kumpi uliante, galkapmangte, le Galilee gam sunga om ulian khempeuh a dingin pawi a kham hi.
Tua pawi bawlna sungah Herodias' tanu hong pai-in hong laam a, Herod le a leenglate khempeuh lungdam mahmah uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in, "Bang deih na hiam; na deih peuhpeuh kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Amah in kamciam pia a, "Ka kumpi gam phelkhat ciang dong nangawnin, nong nget peuhpeuh kong piak nading kong kiciam hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua numeino va paikhia-in a nu kiangah, "Bang ngen ding ka hi hiam?" ci-in a va dong hi. A nu in, "Tuiphumpa Johan' lutang ngen in," ci-in a dawng hi.
Numeino zong kumpipa kiangah hong paikik pahin, "Kuangdai khat sungah Tuiphumpa Johan' lutang nong piakpah ding ka deih hi," a va ci hi.
Hih thu a zak ciangin kumpipa dah mahmah hi. Ahi zongin a kiciamnasa hang le a leenglate' maitang a zahtakna hangin nial ngam lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Johan' lutang a hong paipih nadingin galkapte khat a sawlpah hi. Amah zong pai-in thong sungah Johan' lutang tankhia a,
kuangdai khat sungah a lutang hong paipihin numeino tungah a pia hi.
Johan' nungzuite in hih thu a zak uh ciangin hong pai-in a luanghawm la uh a, hanah a vui uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Jesuh kiangah sawltakte hong ciahkik uh a, a sepna khempeuh uh le a thuhilhna khempeuh uh a zasak uh hi.
Mi a ciah leh a kuan kiphamat uh ahih manin Jesuh le a nungzuite in annek nading hun nangawn nei man lo uh hi. Tua ahih manin Jesuh in, "Ei guak i om theih nading mun khatah paikhia ni; tua lai-ah na tawlnga thei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin gunkuang tuangin gamdaihna mun a zuan dingin a pai uh hi.
Ahi zongin a paikhiatlam uh le amaute ahihlam uh, mi tampi in thei uh ahih manin khuapi khempeuh panin a hong pai mite, lei lam tawnin na pai uh a, Jesuh le a nungzuite a tun ma-in a na ma tun uh hi.
Jesuh, tuigei a tun ciangin mi tampi a na omkhin mu a, amaute, a cing om lo tuute tawh kibang sa ahih manin a khasiat mahmah hi. Tua hi a, amaute thu tampi tak a hilh hi.
Nitak lam ciangin a nungzuite in Jesuh kiangah, "Tu-in nitak hita a, hih lai mun lah gamlak ahi hi.
Hih kiima om khuate-ah amaute pai-in a annek ding uh a lei nadingun hih mihonte sawlkhia in," a ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in, "Amaute' nek ding bangkhat peuhpeuh pia un," a ci hi. A nungzuite in, "Ngun peek zanih tawh anlum va lei-in amaute' nek dingin pia ding ka hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Anlum bangzah nei na hi uh hiam, va en dih un," a ci hi. Amaute in, "Anlum nga le ngasa tawn nih om hi," ci-in a hong genkik uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Mihonte a pawl a pawlin khen unla, lopa hing tungah tusak un," a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin mihonte zong pawlkhatah za, pawlkhatah sawmnga, cih bangin a honhonin a gualtut uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a anlum nga le a ngasa tawn nihte la a, vantung lam ento-in Pasian tungah lungdamna a ko hi. A anlumte balnen a, mite tungah a piak dingin nungzuite a pia hi. Tua mah bangin ngasa tawn nihte zong amaute khempeuh a hawmsak hi.
Amaute khempeuh in ne-in a kham uh hi.
Tua ciangin nungzuite in a kikhamval anlum le ngasa khawm uh a, paipel sawm le nih a dim hi.
Tua an a ne mi sung panin pasal cingteng tulnga a pha hi.
Tua khit phetin Jesuh in a nungzuite gunkuangah tuangsakin, a galkhat a om Bethsaida khua-ah mapaisak a, amah in mihonte a khua ciatah a ciah dingin a sawl hi.
Amaute tawh a kikhen khit ciangin thungen dingin mualtungah a kahto hi.
Khuamial ciangin tui laizang dong gunkuang tungta a, Jesuh ahihleh leitungah amah guakin omlai hi.
Huih in a nungzuite lehmut ahih manin gunkuang hot zo loin haksa a sakna thu uh Jesuh in a thei hi. Tua hi a, zingsang lam nai thum pan nai guk kikal khawngin a nungzuite kiang lamah tuitung tawnin Jesuh a pai hi. Amaute a khengsuak ding bangin pai a,
ahi zongin a nungzuite in tuitung a mi pai a muh ciangun, "Sikha hi," ci-in ngaihsun uh ahih manin a awngkek gawp uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah a muh uh ciangin lau mahmah uh hi. Ahih hangin Jesuh in thakhatin amaute hopihpah a, "Lungnuamin om un. Keimah ka hi hi; lau kei un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute omna gunkuang tungah Jesuh kahto a, huihpi zong a daipah hi. Nungzuite in lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh lungsim navak lo uh ahih manin anlum tawh kisai thupiang tel thei lo uh hi.
Tui a kantan khit uh ciangin Gennesaret gam tung uh a, tuigei-ah a gunkuang uh a khih uh hi.
Gunkuang panin a paikhiat khit phetun mite in Jesuh ahihlam a theipah uh hi.
Tua gam sung tengah mite tai kawikawi uh a, Jesuh om hi, ci-in a kigenna mun peuhpeuhah cinate a lupna pheek uh tawh hong pua uh hi.
Khuapi, khuaneu, le khuakehte a a paina khempeuhah, mite in mihon kikhopna munah cinate hong pua uh a, a puanmongteep beek a lawnsak nading deihin Jesuh kiangah a thum uh hi. A puanmongteep a lawngkha mi khempeuh cidam pahpah uh hi.
Tua laitakin Jerusalem panin a hong pai Farisi mite le Thukham hilh siate, Jesuh kiangah hong kikhawm uh hi.
A nungzuite pawlkhat in khanglui ngeina zui loin, khut silloin an a neklam uh a mukha uh hi.
(Farisi mite le Jew mite khempeuh in khanglui ngeina zui-in khut silloin an ne lo uh hi.
Nektheih zuakna panin a kilei nate zong amau teek mah in a sawp kei uhleh ne lo uh hi. Khanglui ngeina a zuih uh, hai khawng, beel khawng, sumngo kibawl beellekuang khawngte sawp ding cih ngeina a zuih uh tampi om hi.)
Tua ahih manin Farisi mite le Thukham hilh siate in Jesuh kiangah, "Bang hangin na nungzuite in, khanglui laipek panin tuni dongin a kizui pulepa ngeinate zui loin, khut silloin an ne ahi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute dawng a, "A tungthama a hoihin a kilangkhem note' thu, Isaiah in a genkholhna man mahmah hi. Ama genna-ah, 'Pasian in hih bangin gen hi: Hih mite in a kampi bek uh tawh kei hong zahtakbawl uh a, a lungsim taktak uh kei tawh kigamla hi.
Mihingte' bawltawm thukhamte, Pasian' thukham zahin mite tungah hilh uh ahih manin, kei hong biak hangun a kimanna om lo hi,' ci hi.
Note in Pasian' thukham nawlkhinin, mihingte' thuhilhna na zui zawsop uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a thugen zomlai a, "Na khanglui ngeina uh na zuihtheih nadingun Pasian' thukhamte a nawlkhinzia na siam mahmah uh hi.
Moses in, 'Na nu le na pa zahtak un. A nu a pa a samsiate kithat hen,' ci hi.
Ahi zongin note in, 'Mi khatpeuh in a nu a pa a piaktheih ding na khat peuhpeuh a neih hangin, hih pen korban (Pasian a' ding) hi, ci peuh leh,
a nu le a pa a huh nading panin suakta thei hi,' ci-in thu na hilh uh hi.
Hih bang danin mite thu na hilhna uh tawh Pasian' thu na pampaih uh hi. Hih bangzia-in na gamtatna uh adang tampi zong omlai hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in mihonpite samin amaute kiangah, "Mi khempeuh aw, ka thugen hong ngai unla, ka thugente theitel un.
A pualam panin mite sungah tumin mi a ninsakthei bangmah om lo hi. Ahi zongin mite sung panin a pusuak khiate in mi ninsakthei hi.
(Zak nading bil a neite in hih thu za ta un," a ci hi.)
Mihonpite nusia-in inn sungah a lut khit ciangin a nungzuite in hih thugentehna thu a dong uh hi.
Jesuh in, "Note in zong bangmah a thei lo himawk hi lo na hi uh hiam? A pualam panin mite sungah a tum nate in mi ninsak thei lo hi.
A lungsimah tum loin a gil sung bekah tum ahih manin tua panin kithakhia lel hi. (Hih bang a gen ciangin an khempeuh nek dingin a siangtho ahi hi, ci-in Jesuh in a gen ahi hi.)
Mihingte sung panin a pusuak khiate in mihing ninsak hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh mihingte' lungsim sung panin nungak-tangval mawhnopna, guktakna, mi thahna, zilepasal neisate tawh mawhnopna,
huaihamna, gitlohna, khemna, gamtat hoih lohna, enna, mi gensiatna, kisialhna, le haitatna a piangsakthei ngaihsutna hoih lote khempeuh,
mihingte sung panin pusuakin mite ninsak ahihlam thei lo na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua lai panin Jesuh dingkhia-in Taia khuakiim gamah a pai hi. Inn khat sungah lut a, kuamah in a theih loh ding a ut hangin a busim thei kei hi.
A tanu dawi a vei nupi khat in Jesuh' thu a zak ciangin hong pai-in ama khe phungah hong bok hi.
Tua nupi pen Grik mi hi a, Syria gam Foenisia khua-a a suak ahi hi. A tanu sung panin dawi a hawlkhiatsak nadingin a hong thum hi.
Ahih hangin Jesuh in, "Naupangte an nesak masa ni. Naupangte' nek ding kimlai ui khawite piak masak ding kilawm lo hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Ahi zongin nupi in, "Hi mah hi, Topa aw; sabuai nuai-a uite in naupangte' khamvalteng ngahbuang hi lo ahi hiam?" a cih ciangin,
Jesuh in nupi kiangah, "Hih banga na kampauna hangin na inn-ah ciah ta in; na tanu sung panin dawi a paikhiazo hi," a ci hi.
Amah zong a inn-ah ciahpah a, a tanu nuamtakin lum hithiatin a om mu ahih manin dawi a paikhiat khitna thu a thei hi.
Tua ciangin Taia khuakiim gam panin Jesuh paikhia a, Sidon khuapi nawkin pai a, Khuapi Sawmte gam lam tawnin Galilee Tuili-ah a tung hi.
Mi pawlkhat in a bilngongin a pau thei lo mi khat, Jesuh kiangah hong paipih uh a, ama tungah a khut a ngaksak nadingin a thum uh hi.
Jesuh in zong mihonte omna panin tua mipa paikhiatpih a, a mipa' bil tegel sungah a khutmete guang a, tua ciangin a khutmete cil nuhin a leii lawnsakin
vantung lam ento a, khuisa-in, "Kihong in," a cihnopna ahi " Effatha" a ci hi.
Thakhatin a mipa' bil kihongin, a leii zong hong kol a, nuamtakin a pauthei hi.
Kuama kiangah hih thute a gen loh nadingun Jesuh in kham a, ahi zongin nakkham le nakgen semsem zawsop uh hi.
Amaute in genzawh loh dongin lamdangsa mahmah uh a, "Hih mipa in septheih loh bangmah nei lo hi. Bilngongte nangawn khua zasak thei a, a pau thei lote nangawn pau theisak hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua khit a sawt loin Jesuh kiangah mihon tampi tak hong kikhawm leuleu uh a, amaute in annek ding nei nawn lo uh ahih manin Jesuh in a nungzuite samin amaute kiangah,
"Hih mite, kei kiangah ni thum bang hong omkhin uh a, tu-in nek ding nei nawn lo uh ahih manin hehpihhuai ka sa hi.
Amaute pawlkhat gamlapi panin a hong pai uh ahih manin gilkialin ciahsak leng, lamkalah cimawh kha ding uh hi," a ci hi.
A nungzuite in, "Hih mite piak ding, hih gamlakah an bangci ngah ding ihi hiam?" a cih uh ciangin
Jesuh in, "Anlum bangzah nei na hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dot leh, "Sagih nei ung," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in leilakah mihonte tusak a, a anlum sagih la-in Pasian tungah lungdamna a kohkhit ciangin balnenin, mihonpite a lui dingin a nungzuite tungah a pia hi. A nungzuite in zong mihonte a lui uh hi.
Ngasa neu tawmkhat zong nei uh ahih manin Pasian tungah lungdamna a kohkhit ciangin hihte zong mipite mai-ah a lui nadingun a nungzuite a sawl hi.
Amaute in ne-in a khamkhit uh ciangin a khamvalte uh khawm uh a, paipel lian sagih a dim hi.
Hih lai-ah mi tulli bang om hi.
Tua ciangin mihonpite ciahkhiasak a, a nungzuite tawh gunkuang tungah tuangpahin Dalmanutha gamah a pai uh hi.
Farisi mite hong pai-in Jesuh tawh thu kinial uh a, amah a mawhsak theih nading uh a deihna-in Pasian tawh kipawl ahihna a lah nadingin lim khat a lah ding a ngen uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh nakpitakin a sung tawngah khuisa-in, "Bang hangin hih mite in lim hong ngen ahi uh hiam? Hih mite tungah lim kilak peuhmah lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute nusia-in gunkuang sungah tuangin a galkhat lamah a pai hi.
A nungzuite in anlum a puakthuah ding uh mangngilh uh ahih manin gunkuang sungah anlum khat bek a nei uh hi.
Jesuh in, "Farisi-te' silngo le Herod pawlte' silngo kidawm un," ci-in a hilhkhol hi.
Anlum i neih loh manin hih thu hong gen hi ding hi, ci-in a nungzuite a kikum uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute thugen thei ahih manin amaute kiangah, "Anlum na neih loh manun bang hangin thu kikum na hi uh hiam? Theithei nai lo, telthei nai lo na hi uh hiam? Na lungsim uh tua zahin navak lo ahi hiam?
Mihing tul ngate' nek dingin anlum nga ka balnen thu mangngilh ta na hi uh hiam? Tua hun lai-in a kikhamval na khop uh paipel bangzah dim ahi hiam?" a cih ciangin, "Sawm le nih," a ci uh hi.
"Mihing tul lite a dingin lum sagih ka balnen lai-in a khamval uh paipel lian bangzah dim khawm na hi uh hiam?" a cih leuleu ciangin, "Sagih," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Theitel nai lo na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Bethsaida khua tung uh hi. Mi pawlkhat in Jesuh kiangah mittaw khat hong paipih uh a, amah a lawn nadingun a thum uh hi.
Jesuh in tua mittaw pa' khut lenin khuanawlah a paipih hi. A mipa' mitah a cil a phih khit ciangin a khut tawh lawng a, "Na khat peuhpeuh na mu thei hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
A mipa zong khuadak a, "Mite ka mu thei hi; ahi zongin singkung a lam pai tawh kibang uh hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Na khua-ah ciahsuakpah inla, hih khua sungah lutkik kei in," ci-in a vaikhak hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh le a nungzuite, Sisaria Filippi gam sung khuaneute-ah a zin dingin a ding khia uh hi. Lam a pai laitakun a nungzuite kiangah, "Mite in kei kua hi, hong ci uh hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Amaute in, "Pawlkhat in, Tuiphumpa Johan hi, hong ci uh hi. Pawlkhat in, Elijah hi, hong ci uh a, pawlkhat in, kamsang khat peuhpeuh hi ding hi, hong ci uh hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
"Tua ahihleh note in kei kua hi, nong ci uh hiam?" ci-in amaute a dot ciangin Peter in, "Nang pen Khrih na hi hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Kua mi ka hi cih thu kuama kiangah gen kei un," ci-in a nungzuite thu a pia hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Mihing Tapa in tampi tak thuak ding hi; upate, siampi liante, le Thukham hilh siate in amah nial ding uh hi. Amah kithat ding a, ni thum khit ciangin hingkik ding hi," ci-in a nungzuite hilh ding a kipan hi.
Hih thu a kitel takin amaute kiangah a gen hi. Peter in Jesuh paikhiatpihin, "Hih bangin thu gen kei in," ci-in a taii hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh kihei-in a nungzuite a etkawmin Peter lehtai a, "Satan aw, ka nungah om in. Nang in Pasian' ngaihsut bangin thu ngaihsun loin, mihing' ngaihsut bangin na ngaihsun hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in mihonpite le a nungzuite ama kiangah sam a, "Mi khatpeuh ka nungzui a suahnop leh ama deihna bangin gamta nawn loin a singlamteh kisuanin hong zui ding hi.
Hih a leitung nuntakna a hu nuamte in a nuntakna bulpi nangawn tawh suplawh ding a, keima hang le lungdamna thu hangin a nuntakna a suplawhte in a nuntakna bulpi huzo ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh in hih leitung khempeuh a ngah hangin a nuntakna bulpi suplawh leh bang phattuamna om ahi hiam?
Ama nuntakna bang tawh leikik thei nawn ding ahi hiam?
Pasian thei loin a gilo hih mite lakah keima hang le ka thuhilhte hangin maizumin kei hong pulak ngam lo mi peuhmah, a Pa' minthanna vang le a siangtho vantung mite tawh a minthangin hong paikik ciangin Mihing Tapa zong ama hangin maizumin pulak ngam lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a thugen zomlai a, "Hih lai-a a om mi pawlkhatte a sih ma-in vanglianpi tawh Pasian' Ukna hong tung taktak ding ahihna thu phawk un," a ci hi.
Tua zawh ni guk khit ciangin Jesuh in Peter, James, le Johan-te samin amauteng guak mualtung khatah a paipihto hi. Amaute' muhtangpi mahin Jesuh a mel hong kikheel a,
leitung a puansawpte kuamah in a paaksak zawh loh dong ding zahin a puante pakin a tee hi.
Tua lai-ah Elijah le Moses hong omin, Jesuh tawh a kiho a mu uh hi.
Peter zong hong pau-in Jesuh kiangah, "Sia aw, hih lai-a i om, nuam mahmah hi. Nang a' ding buk khat, Moses a' ding buk khat, Elijah a' ding buk khat kong lamsak ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Amah le a lawmte naklau mahmah uh ahih manin a cih ding mel a theih loh man ahi hi.
Meii hong kai-in a liim in amaute hong liah a, tua meii sung panin aw khat hong gingin, "Hih pa, ka it ka Tapa ahi hi; ama thu na ngai un," a hong ci hi.
A kiim a pam a khuadak uhleh Jesuh simloh kuamah dang na om nawn lo hi.
