Amaute in zong dangka peek khat hong paipih uh a, tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Hih dangka tunga om kua' lim hi a, kua' min ahi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin, "Rom Kumpipa Sisar' lim le a min ahi hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Tua ahihleh, Sisar' neihsate Sisar' tungah pia unla, Pasian' neihsate Pasian' tungah pia un," a ci hi. Tua ama thudawnna hangin lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi.
Tua ciangin, thawhkikna om lo hi, a ci Saddusi mi pawlkhat hong pai leuleu uh a,
"Sia aw, 'Mi khat in ta nei loin a zi a sihsan leh tua a si mipa' khang a kizop theih nadingin a naupa in tua meigongnu tenpih ding hi,' ci-in Moses in eite a dingin ngeina a koih hi.
Khatvei, unau pasal sagih om uh hi. A u pen in zi nei a, ta nei loin a si hi.
A nau in a upa' zi luah hi; amah zong ta nei loin si leuleu hi. A thumna pa,
le adangte khempeuh, a sagihna dong in tua nu tenpih uh a, ta nei lo vive mahin a si uh hi. A tawpna ciangin tua numei zong a si hi.
Tua ahihleh, hih unau pasal sagihte in hihnu tenpih kim ciat uh ahih manin, mi khempeuh a thawhkik ni ciangin a kua pen' zi hi ding ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Jesuh in, "Na khial mahmah uh hi. Lai Siangtho ahi a, Pasian' vangliatna ahi zongin na theih lohna hang uh ahi hi.
Sihna panin mite a thawhkik ciangin vantungah a om vantung mite mah bangin zinei pasalnei cih om lo ding uh hi.
Thawhkikna thu tawh kisai-in ci lehang, Moses' laigelhna sung sawlpang kuang thu a genna munah Pasian in Moses kiangah, 'Kei pen Abraham' Pasian, Isaac' Pasian, Jakob' Pasian ka hi hi,' a cihna mun sim ngei lo na hi uh hiam?
Tua bang a cih ciangin Pasian pen misite' Pasian hi loin mihingte' Pasian hi, a ci nuam ahi hi. Tua ahih manin na ngaihsun khial mahmah uh hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua thukidotna a za Thukham hilh siate khat in, Saddusi mite' dotnate limtakin Jesuh in a dawntheihna a muh ciangin Jesuh hong neh a, "Thukham khempeuh lakah bang thukham a lianpen ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Jesuh in, "Thukham a lianpen in: Israel mite aw, ngai un: I Topa Pasian bek mah Topa ahi hi.
Na Topa Pasian uh, na lungsim khempeuh, na nuntakna khempeuh, na pilna khempeuh, le na thahatna khempeuh uh tawh na it un, a cihna ahi hi.
A nihna in: Nangma pumpi na it bangin na vengte na it in, cihna ahi hi. Hih tegel sangin thukham a lianzaw a dang om nawn lo hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Thukham hilh siapa in, "Sia aw, na gen mah bangin hi ka sa mahmah hi. Topa bek mah Pasian hi a, amah simloh pasian dang kuamah om lo hi.
Mite in a lungsim khempeuh, a pilna khempeuh, le a hatna khempeuh uh tawh Pasian itin, amau pumpi a it bangin a vengte a it ding uh ahi hi. Pasian biak nadingin biakna tau tunga gan gawhnate le biakna dang khempeuh sangin hih thukham nihte zuih ding thupizaw takpi hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in hih mipa' thugenzia hoihsa ahih manin, "Pasian' Ukna sungah a om dektak mahmah na hi hi," a ci hi. Tua khit a kipanin Jesuh kiangah kuamah in thu dong ngam nawn lo uh hi.
Jesuh in biakinn sungah thu a hilh laitakin, "Bang hangin Thukham hilh siate in Khrih pen David' suan hi lel hi, ci thei uh ahi hiam?
Kha Siangtho' sawlna tawh David mahmah in thu gen a, 'Topa in keima Topa tungah thu gen hi: Na galte, na khe nuai-ah ka koih matengin, ka taklamah na tu in,' ci hi.
David mahmah in Khrih pen 'Topa,' ci hi. Tua ahihleh Khrih pen David' suan hi lel, cih mawkmawk ding hithei ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Mihonte in hih thu a zak uh ciangin a lungdam mahmah uh hi.
Jesuh in a thuhilhna-ah, "Thukham hilh sia pawlkhatte na bat khak loh nadingun na kidawm un. Amaute in puantualpi silhnuam uh a, mite lakah mite in a zahtak hopih ding a deih uh hi.
Kikhopna inn sungah, uliante a dingin a kikoihcing tutphah nuamte tungah tunuam uh a, pawi sungah zong uliante' tutna mun hoihte bekah a tunuam uh hi.
Meigong numeite tungah nuamtaksa-in a neihsate laksakin zangmang uh a, mite in mihoih a saktheih nading uh a deihna hangun thu saupipi a ngen uh hi. Amau' kineihkhemna tawh kizui-in a gimthuak ding uh lianzaw ding hi," a ci hi.
Biakinn sumpi khiatna kuang gei-ah Jesuh tu a, mihonte in sumpi a khiat laitakun a en hi. A haute in tampipi hong khia uh hi.
A zawng meigong numei khat zong hong pai a, sumnen tang nih hong khia hi.
Tua ciangin a nungzuite sam a, "Adangte khempeuh sangin hih mizawng meigongnu in tam khia zaw hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh adangte in a neihval a lamval sung panun a khia uh ahi hi; ahi zongin amah zawng mahmah napi-in ama kivak nading nangawn siit loin a neih khempeuh a khiakhin ahi hi," a ci hi.
Biakinn panin Jesuh a pusuah laitakin a nungzuite khat in, "Sia aw, hih biakinnte bangzah takin lian a, a suangte bangzah takin gol ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Jesuh in, "Hih innte liansa-in thupi na sa mahmah hi. Ahi zongin hih innte lamna-a a kiciang suangte nih bek nangawn a kithuapna a om lo zah dongin a kiphelkek gawp hun hong tung ding hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Biakinn galkhatah a om Oliv Mual tungah Jesuh tu-in a om laitakin Peter, James, Johan, le Andru hong pai-in amauteng guak a om laitakin,
"Hih na thugen cik ciangin hong tung ding a, hih na thugente khempeuh hong tun ding ciangin bang lim hong om ding ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Kuamah in hong khem zawh loh nadingin na kidawm un.
Keima min pua-in mi tampi hong pai ding uh a, 'Keimah, Khrih ka hi hi,' ci-in mi tampi a khemzo ding uh hi.
A gamla a galkidona thute le a nai-a galkidona huging na zak uh ciangin patau kei un. Tuate a piang ding mah hi a, hun beina ding hi nai lo hi.
Minam khat le minam khat, kumpi khat le kumpi khat kido ding uh hi. Mun tuamtuamah zin hong ling ding a, kial zong hong tung ding hi. Hihte khempeuh pen gimna kipatna hi pan hi.
"Limtakin kidawm un. Note hong kimanin thukhen zumah hong kipaipih ding a, kikhopna inn sungah zong hong kisat ding hi. Ukpite le kumpite mai-ah keima thu gen nading hun na ngah ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin hun beina a tun ma-in mi khempeuh tungah Lungdamna Thu kihilh masa phot ding hi.
Note hong kimanin, thusitna a thuak dingin thukhen zumah hong kipaipih ciangin bang gen ding ihi hiam, ci-in ma lunghihmawh kei un. A thugen ding pen note hi loin Kha Siangtho ahih manin a hun tak ciangin na gen dingun a hong kisawl peuhpeuh na gen un.
Unau khatlekhat a sih nadingun kikhia ding uh a, pa in a ta khia-in, ta in a nu le a pate khia-in a thatsak ding uh hi.
Keima hangin Gentail mi khempeuh in note hong mudah ding uh a, ahi zongin a sih dongun a thuakzote in hotkhiatna a ngah ding uh hi.
"Ama om loh nading pi-ah a lipkhaphuai zehphitna a hong om na muh uh ciangin (hih lai a simte in Jesuh' cihnopna thei ta un!) Judea gam a om mite mualtungah tai un.
A innkhum zangah a om laitak ahi khate zong, a kumsuk ciangin a neihsate a taipih dingin a la dingin a inn sungah lut nawn kei hen.
Lolai-ah a om laitak ahi khate zong, a puan la dingin a inn uh zuan nawn kei hen.
Tua laitakin nupi naupaiite le naungek neite a dingin haksa mahmah ding hi.
Phalbi laitakin hih thu hong piankhak loh nadingin thu na ngen un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in leitung a piansak cil a kipanin tuhun dong, cikmahin tua bang haksatna a om ngei lo, nidang ciangin zong a om ngei nawn lo ding, tua hun laitakin hong tung ding hi.
Topa in tua gimna hun a ni khiam lo hileh a suaktazo kuamah om lo ding hi. Ahi zongin ama teel mite a khualna-in a ni a khiam hi.
"Tua laitakin mi khatpeuh in, 'Hih lai-ah Khrih om hi; hua lai-ah Khrih om hi,' ci-in hong gen leh, um kei un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Khrih kineihkhemte le kamsang kineihkhemte hong piang ding a, ahih zawhleh, a teelsa mite nangawn a khem nadingun lim le na lamdangte hong bawl ding uh hi.
Tua ahih manin kidawm un! A hun ma-in kong genkhin hi.
"Tua haksatna hun khit ciangin ni hong mial ding a, kha hong taang nawn lo ding hi.
Van panin aksite hong kia ding a, vantung a om nate a omngei bangin omthei nawn lo ding hi.
Tua ciangin Mihing Tapa, vangliatna le minthanna tawh meii lakah a hong paisuk kimu ding hi.
Tua ciangin leitung mun khempeuhah vantung mite sawl ding a, leimong khat pan mong khat kikalah a om a teel mite khempeuh a kaikhawmsak ding hi.
Thei kung tung pana thupiang panin thu thei un. A hiangte hong meeng a, a teh hong no ciangin khuakhal hun hong naita ding hi, ci-in na thei un.
Tua mah bangin hih thute hong tun ciangin amah hong naita a, hong tung dektak hi, ci-in na thei un.
Hih thu limtakin phawk un. Tu laitakin a nungta mi khempeuh a sihkhit ma-in hih thute hong tung ding hi.
Van le lei mangthang ding a, ahi zongin ka thugente mangthang ngei lo ding hi.
"Ahi zongin tua ni le tua nai hun ding kuamah in thei lo hi. Vantunga om vantung mite ahi a, Tapa ahi keimah in ahi zongin ka thei kei a, ka Pa bek in a thei hi.
Tua hun ding thei lo na hih manun kikemin pilvang un.
Mi khat khualzin dingin paikhia a, a dinkhiat ding ciangin amau' sep ding ciat a nasemte tungah tavuan pia a, kongcing pa in limtakin a cin ding a sawl mipa tawh kibang hi.
Inn nei pa, nitak ahi a, zankim ahi a, zingsang ak khuankuan ahi a, zingsang khuavak khit ahi zongin a bang hunin hong tung ding cih thei lo na hih manun ngakin na pilvang un.
Tua hikeileh amah thakhatin hong tungin na ihmut laitakun hong tuakkha ding hi.
Note tungah kong gen mah bangin mi khempeuh tungah zong, 'Ngakin na pilvang un,' ka ci hi," a ci hi.
Paisan Pawi le Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi a tun ma ni nih ni-in siampi liante le Thukham hilh siate in Jesuh simmatin a thahtheih nading uh lampi a zong uh hi.
Ahi zongin, "Mihonpite hong buai kha ding ahih manin hih pawi hun sungin hih kei ni," a ci uh hi.
Bethany khua-ah, miphak ahi ngei Simon' inn-ah Jesuh in an a nek laitakin, numei khat in a manpha mahmah nard paknamtui citak suangngo thawl dimin a om khat hong tawi a, a suangngo thawl sukhamin Jesuh' lu tungah a paknamtui a sungsuk hi.
Tua lai-a om mi pawlkhat a heh suak a, "Bang hangin hih paknamtui mawk beisak ahi hiam?
Kizuak le ngun peek zathum val kikhawng ding a, a sum mizawngte tungah kipia thei ding hi," ci-in nakpitakin tua numei a mawhsak uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in, "Bangmah cih se kei un! Bang hangin nawngkaisak na hi uh hiam? Amah pen a kilawm a hoihin kei tungah hong gamta hi.
Mizawngte ahihleh note tawh omkhawm tawntung ding a, na huhnop hun peuhpeuhun na huh thei ding uh hi. Ahi zongin kei pen note tawh kong omkhawm tawntung kei ding hi.
Amah in ka luang a kivui nadingin paknamtui a hong ma nuhkhol hi a, a hihtheih zahzah ciang a hih khinta ahi hi.
Hih thu limtakin phawk un! Lungdamna thu a kihilhna leitung mun khempeuhah hihnu' thu kiphawkin kei tungah hong sepnate kigengen ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua laitakin sawm le nihte sungpan Iskariot' tapa Judas in amaute tungah Jesuh a piaktheih nadingin siampi liante kiangah a va pai hi.
Siampi liante in a thu a zak uh ciangin lungdam mahmah uh a, sum tawh kong guai ding uh hi, ci-in thu a ciam uh hi. Tua ahih manin Judas in Jesuh a lehhek theih nading a hunhoih a zong hi.
Paisan Pawi an dingin tuuno a kigawh ni, Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi ni masa ni-in a nungzuite in Jesuh kiangah, "Koi lai-ah pai-in Paisan Pawi an ding hong bawlsak ding ka hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite nih sawlin amaute kiangah, "Jerusalem khua sungah va pai le-uhcin, tuibeel a pua mi khat na mu ding uh hi. Amah zui unla,
ama tumna innteek pa kiangah, 'Siapa in hih bangin ci hi: Ka nungzuite tawh Paisan Pawi an ka nek nading uh zintun nading inndei koilai ahi hiam, ci hi,' va ci un.
Amah in a baihsa-in a na kikoihsa inndei tungnung a zai khat hong lak ding hi. Tua lai-ah na bawl un," a ci hi.
Nungzui tegel zong khua sungah va pai uh a, Jesuh' gen bangin a va mu uh hi. Tua lai-ah Paisan Pawi an ding a bawl uh hi.
A nitak ciangin a nungzui sawm le nihte tawh tua munah Jesuh a om hi.
An a nek laitakun Jesuh in, "Tu laitakin kei tawh an a nekhawm mi khat in kei hong lehhek ding hi," a ci hi.
A nungzuite in lamdangsa uh a, a banbanin, "Kei nong cihna hi kei buangin teh," a ci ciat uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "No sawm le nihte sung, kei tawh an kuang a sawkkhawmte mah sungpan ahi hi.
A kigelhsa mah bangin Mihing Tapa ahihleh si ding a, ahi zongin a lehhek pa' thuakna nasia mahmah ding hi. Tua mipa a piang ngei het lo hileh ama a dingin hoihzaw tham ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua bangin an a nek laitakun Jesuh in anlum la-in lungdamna a kohkhit ciangin balnenin a nungzuite tungah pia a, "Ne un; hih pen keima pumpi ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin hai la a, lungdamna a kohkhit ciangin a nungzuite tungah pia a, tua hai panin a dawnkim uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, "Hih pen mi tampite a dingin a luang, thuciamna thak a kipsak keima sisan ahi hi.
Pasian' Ukna sungah leenggahzu thak ka dawnkik ni matengin leenggahzu a dawn nawn lo ding ka hihna thu limtakin thei un," a ci hi.
Amaute inla khat a sakkhit uh ciangin Oliv Mual-ah a pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "'Tuucingpa ka satlum ding a, tuute a kithehthang ding hi,' ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin note in kei nong taisan ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin hong kithawh kiksak khit ciangin Galilee gam note mai-ah ka pai ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Peter in, "Adang khempeuh in nang hong taisan ahi zongin ke'n kong nusia ngei kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in, "Tuzan mahmahin ak nihvei a khuan' ma-in thumvei tak kei na hong nial ding lamtak phawk in," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Peter in, "Nang tawh sihkhawm nading ciang dong ahi zongin kong nial ngei het kei ding hi," ci-in khauhtakin a gen hi. Tua mah bangin a vekpi-un a ci kim uh hi.
Tua lai panin Gethsemane a kici munah pai-in a tun uh ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, "Thu ka va nget hun sungteng hih lai-ah na om un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Peter, James, le Johan-te paipih lai a, nakpitakin lungkhamin a dahna hong kipan hi.
Amah in, "Ka lungsim dahna lianlua mahmah ahih manin ka si dektak hi. Hih lai-ah om unla na ngak un," a ci hi.
Amah tawmkhat pailai-in leilakah boksuk a, ahi thei ding ahihleh hih thuakna hun tawh a kipelh nadingin thu a ngen hi.
"Pa aw, na khempeuh na hihthei hi. Hih ka thuak ding gimna tawh hong kipelhsak in. Ahi zongin kei' deihna bang hi loin nangma deihna bang hizaw hen," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin hong pai a, a nungzui thumte ihmu-in om a muh ciangin Peter kiangah, "Simon aw, ihmu na hi uh hiam? Nai khat sung nangawn hong ngak zo lo liang na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, "Ze-etna-ah na pukkhak loh nadingun pilvangin thu ngen un. Lungsim in ze-etna nangnuam napi, pumpi in nang zo lo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin paikhia leuleu-in thu a nget ngeiteng mah va ngen leuleu hi.
Hong paikik ciangin a nungzuite na ihmu leuleu uh hi. A ihmut uh suak mahmah hi. Jesuh kiangah a gen ding uh bangmah thei lo uh hi.
A thumveina a hong ciahkik ciangin amaute kiangah, "Ihmu-in na tawlnga hithiat lailai na hi uh hiam? Phazo hi. A hun hong tungta hi. Mihing Tapa mawhnei mite' khut sungah hong kipia khinta hi.
Tho un; pai ta ni. Kei hong lehhek pa hih lai-ah hong tungta hi," a ci hi.
Tua bangin Jesuh in thu a gen laitakin sawm le nihte sung panin Judas hong tung a, siampi liante, Thukham hilh siate, le upate in a sawl mihonte in namsau le molhtum tawi-in hong zui uh hi.
A lehhek pa in mihonte tungah, "Ka nap pa pen Jesuh hi ding hi. Tua pa man unla limtakin cingin paikhiatpih un," ci-in a genkhol hi.
Tua ahih manin hong tun phetin Jesuh kiangah paipah a, "Sia aw," ci-in limnap mahmah hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Jesuh manin limtakin a lencip uh hi.
Tua laitakin a gei-a dingte khat in a namsau dokin siampi lianpen pa' nasempa a sat leh a bil a satkhiatsak hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Guta buluhte a man ding bang keekin, kei a man dingin namsau le molhtum tawh hong kuan na hi uh hiam?
Nisim nisimin biakinn sungah thuhilhin note tawh ka omkhawm a, ahi zongin nong man kei uh hi. Ahi zongin hih thu pen Lai Siangtho sunga a kigelh thu a tun nading ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a nungzuite khempeuh in Jesuh a taisan uh hi.
Puanza kang khat bek a silh tangval khat in zong Jesuh a zui hi. Amaute pawlkhat in amah a mat ciangin,
a puanza kang nusia-in a guaktangin a tai hi.
Mihonte in siampi lianpen pa' inn-ah Jesuh paipih uh a, siampi liante, upate, le Thukham hilh siate hong kikhawm uh hi.
Peter in zong Jesuh' nung galzuih a, siampi lianpen pa' inntual ciangah a om hi. Tua lai-ah palikte tawh mei awi-in a tukhawm hi.
Siampi liante a kipan uliante khempeuh in Jesuh a thahtheih nadingin thu zong uh a, ahi zongin bangmah mu lo uh hi.
Mi tampi in amah a mawhsak nadingun zuauthu gen uh a, ahi zongin a genna uh khatlekhat kituak lo hi.
Tua ciangin mi pawlkhat hong dingin amah a mawhsak nadingun zuauthu hong gen uh a,
"Mihingte' lam hih biakinn ka susia ding a, ni thum khit ciangin mihingte' lam ahi lo adang khat ka lam ding hi," a cihna ka za uh hi, ci-in hong gen uh hi.
Amaute nangawn zong a thugenzia uh kituak lo hi.
Tua ciangin amaute khempeuh mai-ah siampi lianpen pa hong dingin Jesuh thu dong a, "Nangmah mawhsakna-in a gen uh thute na dawn nading om lo ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh pau loin a omcip hi. Tua ciangin siampi lianpen pa in, "Phatna a ngah Pasian' Tapa, Khrih na hi hiam?" ci-in a dongkik leuleu hi.
Jesuh in, "Ka hi hi; Vanglian Pasian' taklamah Mihing Tapa omin meii lakah a hong pai na mu ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin siampi lianpen pa in a puan balkek a, "Thudang kisam nawn lo hi.
Pasian' tungah a paukhialhna na zazo uh hi. Bangci ngaihsut na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi. Hih mipa thah dingin kilawm hi, ci-in amaute khempeuh in thu a khen uh hi.
Tua ciangin mi pawlkhat in cilphih uh a, a mai tunsakin beeng uh a, "Kua in hong beng ahi hiam, gen in," a ci uh hi. Palikte in zong amah paipihin a beeng uh hi.
A nuai-a inntualah Peter a om laitakin siampi lianpen pa' nasem numeite khat hong pai a,
Peter mei awi-in om a muh ciangin limtakin en a, "Nang zong, Nazareth khuami Jesuh tawh na kikhawl ngei hi," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Peter in nial a, "Ka thei kei hi; bang na cihna ahi hiam, cih zong ka tel kei hi," ci-in dawngin tual pualam paina lampi lamah a pai hi. Tua laitakin ak a khuang hi.
Tua numei mah in a omna-ah Peter mu a, a gei-a omte kiangah, "Hih pa, hua mite khat hi takpi hi," a cikik leuleu hi.
Ahi zongin Peter in nial leuleu hi. Tawlkhat khit ciangin a gei-a omte in Peter kiangah, "Nang zong Galilee gammi na hih manin huate khat na hi takpi hi," a ci leuleu uh hi.
Tua ciangin Peter in, "Na gen mipa uh ka theih taak leh Pasian in kei hong dawm kei ta hen," ci-in a kiciam hi.
Tua khit phetin ak nihveina a khuang hi. Tua ciangin, "Ak nihvei a khuan' ma-in kei thumvei na hong nial ding hi," ci-in Jesuh in ama tungah a gensa thu Peter in phawkkik a, dahlua-in a kap hi.
A zingsang ciangin siampi liante in upate, Thukham hilh siate, le ulian dang khempeuh tawh thu kikupna khat nei uh a, Jesuh a henkhit uh ciangin paikhiatpihin Pilat tungah a ap uh hi.
Pilat in, "Nang, Jew mite' Kumpipa na hi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin Jesuh in, "Nang zong tua mah nong ci hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Siampi liante in Jesuh a mawhsakna tampi gen uh ahih manin
Pilat in Jesuh kiangah, "Na dawn nading om lo ahi hiam? Nang hong mawhsakna thute na zazo hi," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in amah a kimawhsaknate kamkhat beek dawng het lo ahih manin Pilat in lamdang a sa mahmah hi.
Paisan Pawi hun simin mite in Pilat tungah a nget peuhpeuh mi khat, thong panin a khah a ngeina ahi hi.
Kumpi a lehdo laitakun mi a that, thong sunga kikhumte lakah Barabbas a kici mi khat zong kihel hi.
Pilat kiangah mihonte hong paito uh a, hih bang hun pawlin a hih ngei bangin mi khat a khah nading a hong ngen uh hi.
Pilat in amaute kiangah, "Jew mite' Kumpipa ka khah ding hong deih na hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh siampite in Jesuh a hazatna hangin hih bangin ama kiangah a paipihna thu teltakin a thei hi.
Ahi zongin Barabbas hong khahsak zaw in, ci-in mihonte in a nget nadingun siampite in mihonte a hanthawn uh hi.
Tua ciangin Pilat in mihonte tungah, "Jew mite' Kumpipa na cih pa uh bangcih ding ka hi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin
amaute in, "Singlamteh tungah that in," ci-in a awng uh hi.
Tua ciangin Pilat in, "Bang hangin tua ci na hi uh hiam? Bang siatna bawl ahi hiam?" a cih ciangin, "Singlamteh tungah that in," ci-in a kinakko zaw semsem uh hi.
Pilat in mihonte lungkimsak nuam ahih manin Barabbas khah a, Jesuh a satsak khit ciangin singlamteh tungah thah dingin galkapte' khut sungah a ap hi.
Tua ciangin galkapte in gam ukpa' inntualah Jesuh paipih uh a, galkap dang khempeuh zong kikhawmsak uh hi.
Jesuh, puansan silhsak uh a, ling lukhu bawlin a lu tungah a khusak uh hi.
A zahtakbawl bang keekin hopih uh a, "Jew mite' Kumpipa aw, na khansau ta hen!" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin pumpeeng tawh a lu satin cilphih uh a, a zahtakbawl kineihin a mai-ah a kun uh hi.
Tua bangin a simmawhbawl khit uh ciangin a puansan suahkhiatsak uh a, ama puan ngeite a silhsakkik uh hi. Tua ciangin singlamteh tungah thah dingin a paikhiatpih uh hi.
Tua bangin a pai laitakun, Alexander le Rufas' pa, Sairin khuami Simon a kici mi khat, gam sung panin khuapi sunga hong pai tawh kituak uh a, Jesuh' singlamteh a pua dingin lammat uh hi.

Jesuh, singlamteh tungah a khai hun pen zingsang nai kua laitak ahi hi.
"Jew mite' Kumpipa," ci-in amah a mawhsakna uh lai kigelh hi.
A taklamah khat, a veilamah khat, mi thatte nih tawh a kikhai khawm hi.
(Hih bangin a hihna uh tawh, "Khialhna a nei mite tawh kisim khawm hi," ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh thu a tung ahi hi.)

Tua ciangin sunkim nai sawm le nih laitak a kipanin nai thum sung leitung khempeuhah khim a zing hi.

Tua ciangin nakpitakin Jesuh kiko-in a laitat hi.

Pilat in a lungsimah, Jesuh a si khin takpi mah hi ding ahi hiam, ci-in ngaihsun ahih manin galkap mangpa samsak a, si khinta ahi hiam, ci-in a dong hi.

Tu-in pai unla, Peter le Jesuh' nungzui dangte kiangah hih thu va gen un. Note tungah hong gensa bangin Galilee gam amaute mai-ah pai hi; tua lai-ah amah na mu ding uh hi, ci hi, ci un," a ci hi.

A lian mahmah Theofilas aw: Eite lakah a piang ngeisa thu a kigente, mi tampi in amau siamna zah ciat tawh lai-in a gelh uh hi.

Amah a muh zawh loh uh ciangin Jerusalem-ah kileh kikin a zong uh hi.
A ciahzawh uh a ni thum ni ciangin biakinn sungah amah mu uh a, siate lakah tu-in a thugen uh ngai-in, thu zong dong zelin a om a mu uh hi.
Amah in pilna tawh thu genin a dawnna a za mite khempeuh in lamdangsa mahmah uh hi.
A nu le a pa in a muh uh ciangin lamdangsa uh a, a nu in, "Ka ta aw, bang hangin hong hici bawl na hi hiam? Na pa tawh lungkham mahmahin nang ka hong zong uh hi," a ci hi.

Mi khempeuh in Pasian' hotkhiatna ngah ding uh hi,'" ci-in a kigelh hi.

"Nazareth khuami Jesuh aw, kote tawh bang kisai ihi hiam? Kote a susia dingin hong pai na hi hiam? Pasian' mi siangtho na hih lamtak ka hong thei uh hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in tua dawi taii a, "Pau kei inla, ama sung panin paikhia in," ci-in thu a pia hi. Dawi in a mipa mihon lakah a puksak khit ciangin ama sung panin paikhia a, ahi zongin liamsak lo hi.
Kikhopna innsunga a om mi khempeuh in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, "Hih a kampaute a bangci kampau ahi hiam? Aana le vang neihna tawh dawi thu pia a, dawite a taikhia uh hi," a ci uh hi.

Jesuh zong pai-in a lupna gei-ah ding a, a cinatna a taii ciangin a nattutna dampah a, amah zong thozo pahin a zinte a dozo pah hi.

A ngen a khuh le ngasa tampi tak awk a, a ngen kikeek dektak hi.
A gunkuang dang khatah a om a lawmte hong pai-in a huh nadingun a khut uh a van uh hi. Amaute zong hong pai uh a, gunkuang tegel sungah ngasa a dimtakin guang uh ahih manin a gunkuang tum dektak hi.

Tua mah bangin Simon' lawmte ahi, Zebedi' tapa James le Johan-te in zong lamdang a sa uh hi. Jesuh in Simon kiangah "Lau kei in. Tu a kipanin ngasa mat bangin mi tampi a huai pa na suak ding hi," a ci hi.

Khatvei, khuasung khatah Jesuh a om laitakin tua khua sungah a pumtangin phaknatna a vei mi khat a om hi. A phakpa in Jesuh a muh ciangin a mai-ah bokin, "Topa aw, hong damsak nuam peuh lecin kei nong damsak thei ding hi," ci-in a thum hi.

Khatvei, Jesuh in thu hilhin a om laitakin Galilee gam, Judea gam, le Jerusalem khua panin a hong pai Farisi mi pawlkhat le Thukham hilh siate pawlkhat hong om hi. Cina damsak theih nading Topa' vangliatna, Jesuh tungah kipia hi.
Mi pawlkhat in khutlekhezaw mi khat a lupna pheek tawh hong pua uh a, inn sungah paipihin Jesuh mai-ah koih ding a hanciam uh hi.
Mihon tamlua ahih manin a lutpih nading uh lampi om lo hi. Tua ahih ciangin innkhum zangah kahpihto-in innkhum hong let uh a, mihonte' lak, Jesuh' omna mai sanah a lupna pheek tawh a khaisuk uh hi.

'Na mawhnate hong kimaisak hi,' cih ding baihzaw ahi hiam, tua ahih kei leh, 'Tho inla, lam pai in,' cih ding baihzaw ahi hiam?
Mihing Tapa in mawhna maisak theih nading leitungah vangliatna nei hi, ci-in na theih nadingun kong lak ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin khutlekhezaw mipa kiangah, "Tho inla na lupna pheek pua-in na inn-ah ciah in," a ci hi.
Thakhat thu-in amaute khempeuh' muhin a mipa zong tho-in a lupna pheek la a, Pasian phatkawmin a inn-ah a ciah hi.
Tua ciangin amaute khempeuh in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, lau mahmah kawmin Pasian phatin, "Tuni-in a lamdang mahmah na khat i mu hi," a ci uh hi.

Levi zong dingpah a, a na khempeuh nusia-in Jesuh a zui hi.
Tua ciangin Levi in ama inn-ah Jesuh vakna annek pawipi bawl a, annekna sabuai-ah siahdong dang tampite le midangte zong tawh a tukhawm uh hi.
Farisi mite le amau sung panin Thukham hilh siate, nungzuite tungah phun uh a, "Bang hangin siahdongte le thukham khial mite tawh an nekhawm na hi uh hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Cidamte in siavuan kisam lo uh a, cina mite bek in kisam uh hi.
Mite in a zahtak mihoihte a kisik nadingun a sam dingin hong pai ka hi kei a, mite in a pampaih mite a kisik nadingun a sam dingin a hong pai ka hi hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin amaute pawlkhat in Jesuh kiangah, "Johan' nungzuite in an tangin thu ngen zelzel uh a, Farisi mite' nungzuite zong tua bangmahin gamta napi-in, bang hangin nangma nungzuite in tang loin om se uh ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Mopawi-ah zineipa le pawisimte a omkhawm laitakin a pawisimte an tangsak thei ding na hi uh hiam?
Amaute kiang panin zineipa a kipaikhiatpih hun hong tung ding a, tua hun ciangin tang ding uh hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in thugentehna dang khat zong gen a, "Mi khat in puan thak khat eukhia-in puan lui thuapna-in nei lo hi. Tua bangin hih leh a puan thak pen a keeksak suak ding a, a puan thak eukhiat zong a puan lui tawh etlawm lo ding hi.
Kuamah in savun um lui sungah leenggahzu a thak thun ngei lo hi. Thun zenzen leh leenggahzu thak in a savun um phukham ding a, a leenggahzu bua-in, a savun um zong kisia ding hi.
Tua ahih manin savun um thak sungah leenggahzu thak a kikoih ding ahi hi.
Kuamah in leenggahzu lui a nek khit ciangin a thak nenuam nawn lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, 'A lui khumzaw hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Sabbath ni khatin mangbuh lo nawkin Jesuh le a nungzuite a pai uh hi. A nungzuite in mangbuhvuite zut uh a, a khutsung uhah nuai-in a ne uh hi.
Amaute lakah a om Farisi mite pawlkhat in, "Sabbath ni-in i hih dingin a kilawm lo gamtatna bang hangin gamta na hi uh hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "David le a kikholhpihte a gilkial laitakun David' gamtatna thu sim ngei lo na hi uh hiam?
Pasian' inn sungah amah lut a, siampite lobuang midangte' nek ding ahi lo Ompihna Anlum la-in ne a, ama kikholhpihte zong a nesak hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Mihing Tapa pen Sabbath ni a Ukpa ahi hi," ci-in a thugen a khum hi.
Sabbath a ni dang khatin kikhopna inn khatah Jesuh pai-in thu a hilh hi. A khut taklam a zaw mi khat tua lai-ah na om hi.
Thukham hilh siate le Farisi mite pawlkhat in Jesuh a mawhsak theih nading uh thu zong nuam uh ahih manin, Sabbath ni-in hih mipa a damsak hiam, ci-in na encik gige uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in amau' ngaihsutna thei ahih manin a khutzaw mipa kiangah, "Ding inla, mihonte mai hih lai munah hong pai in," a ci hi. A mipa zong hong pai-in mihon mai-ah a hong ding hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Note tungah thu khat kong dong nuam hi. Sabbath ni-in a pha bawl ding le a sia bawl ding koi kilawmzaw a, mi khat' nuntakna suahtaksak ding le siatsak ding koi hoihzaw ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amaute khempeuh a et kawikawi khit ciangin a mipa kiangah, "Na khut zan in," a ci hi. Amah in zong a khut zan a, a ngeina bangin a khut hong damkik hi.
Ahi zongin amaute heh mahmah uh a, Jesuh a suktheih nading uh khatlekhat a kikumpah uh hi.
Ni khat, thungen dingin mualtungah Jesuh pai a, zan tawntung Pasian kiangah thu ngenin a om hi.
Khua a vak ciangin a nungzuite sam a, amaute sung panin sawm le nih teelkhia-in sawltakte ci-in min a phuak hi.
Tuate in: Simon (Peter ci-in min a phuah pa) le a naupa Andru, James le a nau Johan, Filip, Bartholomew,
Matthai, Thomas, Alfeas' tapa James, Simon (gam khual pa),
James' tapa Judas, le Jesuh a lehhek pa Iskariot' tapa Judas ahi uh hi.
Tua mualtung panin Jesuh le a nungzui teelte paisuk uh a, a nung a zui midang tampite tawh mun zang khatah a ding hi. Jerusalem khua le Judea gam khempeuh le tuipi gei-a om Taia khua le Sidon khuapite panin a hong pai mihon tampi zong hong om uh hi.
Tua mite pen ama thuhilhna a ngai ding le a natna uh panin damna a ngahnop manun a hong pai uh ahi hi. Dawi a vei mite zong hong pai uh a, damna a ngah uh hi.
Jesuh' tung panin vangliatna paikhia-in mi khempeuh damsak ahih manin mi khempeuh in amah lawn' ding a hanciam uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite en a, "No mizawngte Pasian' Ukna sungah om na hih manun thupha ngah mi na hi uh hi.
Tuhunin a gilkial note nidang ciangin na gil uh a vah ding hi. Tuhunin a dah note nidang ciangin na nuam ding uh hi.
"Mihing Tapa' hangin mite in hong mudahin hong tuamkoih a, hong simmawhin migiloin hong seh ciangin thupha ngah na hi uh hi.
Vantungah na thaman ding uh lian mahmah ahih manin tua bang na tuah uh ciangin nuamin lungdamin na diang un. Bang hang hiam cih leh a pu a pate un zong tua bangmahin kamsangte tungah a bawl uh hi.
"Ahi zongin tuhunin a hau note in nopsakna ngahkhin na hih manun gimna na thuak ding uh hi.
Tuhunin a gilvah note in gilkial gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Tuhunin a lungdam note dahin na kap ding uh hi.
"Mi khempeuh in note hong pahtakbawl ciangin gimna a thuak ding na hi uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a pu a pate un zong tua bangmahin kamsang zuaute a pahtakbawl uh hi.
"Ahi zongin ka thugen a za note kiangah kong cihin-ah: Na galte uh na it unla, no hong mudah mite tungah a pha na bawl un.
No hong phuisamte thupha na pia unla, no hong bawlsiate a' ding thu na ngetsak un.
Na paang langkhat a hong bengte, a langkhat zong na dawhlai un. Na puantungsilh uh a hong sutte tungah, na puansungsilh uh zong na piathuah lai un.
A hong ngente peuhmah na pia unla, na na uh a hong laksakte tung panin lakik kei un.
Note tungah a hong kibawl ding na deih uh bangin midangte tungah na bawl un.
"No hong itte bek it le-uhcin bang hangin thupha ngah ding na hi uh hiam? Mawhnei mite nangawn in amau a itte a it uh hi.
No tungah a hoihin a hong gamtate tung bekah a hoihin gamta le-uh cin bang hangin thupha ngah ding na hi uh hiam? Mawhneite nangawn tua bangmahin gamta uh hi.
Ngahkik ding na lametna uh mite tung bekah leitawi na piak uhleh bang hangin thupha ngah ding na hi uh hiam? Mawhneite nangawn in zong a piakzah mah uh a ngahkik dingin khatlekhat kileitawi uh hi.
Tua bang lelin note na gamta kei ding uh hi. Na galte uh itin amaute tungah thupha bawl unla, lohkik ding lamen loin leitawi pia un. Tua hileh na thaman uh lian ding a, a Lianpen Pasian' tate na hi ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh lungdamna mel a theithei lo mite le a huaiham mite tungah amah migi hi.
Tua ahih manin na Pa un hehpihna a neih bangin note in zong hehpihna lungsim nei ta un.
"Midangte' thu khen kei un. Tua hileh no tungah zong Pasian in thu hong khen lo ding hi. Midangte mawhsak kei un. Tua hileh Pasian in note zong hong mawhsak lo ding hi. Midangte' mawhna maisak un. Tua hi leh Pasian in note' mawhna zong hong maisak ding hi.
Midangte tungah pia un. Tua hileh Pasian in note tungah zong hong pia ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh midangte na piakna uh tawh kizui-in a henhen, a tahtah, a dimletin Pasian in note tungah hong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah thugentehna khat zong gen a, "Mittaw khat in mittaw dang khat lam paipih thei lo hi. Paipih zenzen leh a nih tuakun hawkguamah kiakhawm ding uh hi.
Sang naupang khat a siapa sangin lianzaw ngei lo hi; a sin ding khempeuh a theihkhit ciangin a siapa tawh kikim pan bek ding hi."
"A cidam singkung in gah ginalo gah ngei lo a, a ginalo singkung in gah limci gah ngei lo hi.
Singkung khempeuh a gah tawh kithei thei hi. Sialtalling kung panin theigah kilo ngei lo a, lingvom kung panin leenggah kilo ngei lo hi.
Mihoih pa in a lungsim sunga thuhoih omteng hong suahkhia a, migilo pa in a lungsim sunga a gitlohna teng hong suahkhia hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mite pen amau' lungsim sunga a om bangbang a hong paukhia uh ahi hi.
"Bang hangin, 'Topa aw, Topa aw,' hong ci napi-in ka hong gente zui lo na hi uh hiam?
Ka kiangah hong pai a, ka thuhilhna za-in a zuite khempeuh pen kua tawh kibang hiam cih leh,
suang tungah inn lamin, a khuamkua ding suangsung thukpi tak to-in a phut pa tawh kibang hi. Tui a khan ciangin tui in tua inn a nawk hangin limtakin kilam ahih manin susia zo lo hi.
Ahi zongin ka thuhilhna za napi-in a zui lote pen bulkip a nei lo, leilak mawkmawkah inn a lam pa tawh kibang hi. Tuikhang in tua inn a nawk ciangin thakhat thu-in siagawppah a, tua inn pen naksiat mahmah hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in mite kiangah a thugen dingteng a man khit ciangin Kapernaum khua-ah a pai hi.
Tua khua sungah Rom mi galkapbu khat om a, tua bupa in a it mahmah nasem khat a nei hi. Tua a nasempa a ci na-in a si dektak hi.
Tua bupa in Jesuh' thu a zak ciangin, ama kiangah Jew mi upate pawlkhat sawl a, Jesuh hong pai-in a nasempa a damsak nading a thumsak hi.
Jesuh kiangah Jew mi upate a tun uh ciangin nakpitakin thum uh a, "Amah na huh dingin a kilawm mahmah mi khat ahi hi.
Amah in ei minam hong it mahmah a, kikhop nading inn khat zong hong lamsak hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Jesuh in zong amaute sapna bangin a va zui hi. Jesuh a tun madiakin galkap bupa in Jesuh kiangah a lawmte pawlkhat sawl a, "Topa aw, ka inn-ah nong pai nadingin kei kilawm zo lo ka hih manin hong pai dah hoh in.
Nangmah tawh a kimu dingin zong kilawmzo kisa lo ka hih manin keima pumpi kong pai kei hi. Thu pia peuh lecin ka nasempa dam lel ding hi.
Kei zong uliante' khutnuai-ah hong kikoih mi khat ka hi a, keima khutnuai-ah zong galkapte a om hi. Khat kiangah, 'Pai in,' ci leng a pai hi. Khat kiangah, 'Hong pai in,' ci leng a hong pai hi. Ka nasempa kiangah, 'Hih na sem in,' ci leng zong sem hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in hih thu a zak ciangin lamdangsa mahmah a, amah a zui mihonte lamah kihei-in, "Israel mite lak nangawnah hih bang upna ka mu nai kei hi," a ci hi.
A kamtaite, galkap bupa inn-ah hong tunkik ciangin a nasempa a na damsiang khinta hi.
Tua khit a sawt loin Nain khua-ah Jesuh pai a, a nungzuite le mihonpite in zong a zui uh hi.
Tua khua kulhkongpi a tun laitakun misi vui-a hong pai mihon tawh a kituak uh hi. A misi pen meigong khat' tapa khat neihsun hi a, tua khuasung mihon tampite in tua si vuina-ah meigongnu hong zui uh hi.
Topa in tua meigongnu a muh ciangin a khasiat suak a, "Kap kei in," ci-in a khem hi.
Tua ciangin pai-in a hankuang va len a, si puate zong a khawlpah uh hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Tangval aw, tho in, kong ci hi," a ci hi.
Misi pa zong hong tuto-in hong paupah hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nu kiangah a ap hi.
Amaute khempeuh in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, Pasian min phatin, "Eite lakah kamsang lian khat hong om khinta a, a mite a honkhia dingin Pasian hong pai khinta hi," a ci uh hi.
Hih Jesuh thu pen Judea gam sung le a kiim gam khempeuhah kizel hi.
Johan' nungzuite in hih Jesuh' thu khempeuh Johan kiangah a gen uh hi.
Johan in zong ama nungzuite nih sam a, Topa kiangah amaute paisakin, "Johan in hong pai ding a cih pa mah na hi hiam, tua ahih kei leh adang na lamen lai ding ka hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong dingin a sawl hi.
Jesuh kiangah amaute a tun uh ciangin, "'Hong pai ding ka cih pa mah na hi hiam, tua ahih kei leh adang na lamen lai ding ka hi uh hiam?' ci-in a dong dingin Tuiphumpa Johan in hong sawl hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua hun laitak mahmahin natna a tuamtuamte tampi damsakin, dawivei mite sung panin dawite hawlkhia a, mittaw mi tampi khua a musak hi.
Tua ahih manin Johan' kamtaite kiangah, "Va ciahkik unla, na muhsa uh le na zaksa uh thute khempeuh Johan kiangah va gen un. Mittawte in khua muthei a, khebaite lam paithei a, miphakte damkik a, bilngongte in khua zathei kik a, misite kihingsakkik a, mizawngte tungah Lungdamna Thu kihilh hi.
Johan' kamtaite a ciahkik khit ciangin Jesuh in mihonte tungah Johan' thu gen a, "Johan kiang gamlakah na pai uh ciangin bang a en dingin a pai na hi uh hiam? Huih in a mut awn diamdiam lopa kungte a en ding maw?
Tua ahih kei leh bang a en dingin a pai na hi uh hiam? Puan hoihnono a silh mi khat a en ding maw? A taktakin ci lehang tua bangin puan hoih silh a, nuamtakin a omte pen inn lianpipi sungah teng uh hi.
Tua ahihleh bang a en dingin a pai na hi uh hiam? Kamsangpa khat a en dingin a pai na hi uh hiam? Hi hi, kamsangpa a en dingin na pai uh a, kamsang ciang bek hi loin a lianzaw khat na mu uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho in Johan thu a genna-ah, 'Hih lai-ah ka kamtai pa om hi. Nangma lampi a hong dingin na mai-ah ka mapaisak ding hi, ci-in Pasian in gen hi,' ci-in kigelh hi.
Johan pen leitung mihing sung khempeuh panin a lianpen ahi hi. Ahi zongin Pasian' Ukna sunga a om mi a neupen i cihte nangawn Johan sangin lianzaw lai hi," a ci hi.
Siahdongte le midangte khempeuh in hih thu a zak uh ciangin Pasian' deihna zui-in Johan' khut sungah tui a kiphum uh hi.
Ahi zongin Farisi mite le Thukham hilh siate in Pasian' deihna nialin Johan khut sungah tui kiphum ding ut lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Tuhuna mite bang tawh genteh ding a, bang tawh kibang ci ding ka hi hiam?
Mihon omna lamkabomah a tu naupang a kimawlte tawh kibang uh hi. Naupang honkhat in a lawmte kiangah, 'Lam nading khuang kong tumsak hangun na lam nuam kei uh a, kahna la ka sak hangun lah na kap nuam tuan kei uh hi,' a cihte tawh a kibang uh hi.
Mihing Tapa hong pai leuleu a, zune anne-in a om ciangin, 'Zuhai, anhai pa, siahdongte le midangte in a kikholhpih nop loh mite tawh a kikhawlpa,' ci leuleu uh hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian' pilna a man ahih lamtak, ama thu a zui mite in kilangsak hi," a ci hi.
Farisi mite khat in a inn-ah an ne dingin Jesuh sam a, Jesuh zong pai-in an ne dingin a tu hi.
Tua khua sungah a paktat numei khat om hi. Farisi mipa' inn-ah Jesuh in an ne-in a omna thu a zak ciangin paknamtui suangngo thawl a dim khat hong paipihin,
Jesuh' nungah tu-in kap a, a khitui tawh Jesuh' khete kawtsakin a sam tawh nulsak a, a khete namin a sathau puak a nuh hi.
Jesuh a sam Farisi mipa in a muh ciangin a lungsim sungah, "Hih pa pen kamsang taktak hileh amah a lawng hih numeinu a bangci mi ahi hiam cih thei ding a, ama gamtat hoih lohna teng zong thei ding hi," a ci hi.

Jesuh in, "Lei a ba mi nih om hi. Khat in ngun peek zanga ba a, a khat in sawmnga ba hi.
Amau tegel in a loh zawh loh ciangin a batna pa un a nih tuakun a maisak hi. Hih mi nihte sung panin kua in amah itzaw ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Simon in, "Leiba tam a maisakna pa in itzaw dingin ka um hi," ci-in a dawn ciangin Jesuh in, "Na genna man mahmah hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin numei lamah Jesuh kihei a, Simon kiangah, "Hih numei' gamtatna na mu hiam? Na inn-ah kong pai a, ka khe sil nading tui nong pia kei hi. Ahi zongin amah in a khitui tawh ka khe hong silsak a, a sam tawh hong nulkeusak hi.
Nang in napna tawh leengla na hong do kei a, ahi zongin amah in hih lai-ah kong tun a kipanin tu dongin ka khe a nap khawl nai lo hi.
Nang in ka lu sathau nong nilhsak kei a, ahi zongin amah in ka khe nangawn sathau namtui hong nuhsak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin nang kiangah kong genin-ah, ama mawhna tampi tak a omte kimaisak khin ahih manin amah in a itna nakpitakin a lak hi. Ahi zongin tawmno bek a kimaisakte in a itna uh tawmno bek mahin a lak uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in numei kiangah, "Na mawhnate hong kimaisak khin hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh tawh sabuai-ah an a nekhawm midangte in a lungsim sung uhah, "Mawhna nangawn a maisak hih mipa kua ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in numei kiangah, "Na upna in nang hong damsak khinta hi; lungnuam takin va ciah in," a ci hi.
Tuazawh tawlkhat khit ciangin khuapite le khuaneute-ah a ban banin Jesuh pai a, Pasian' Ukna hangin Lungdamna Thu hilhin a vak kawikawi hi. Tua a vak kawikawina-ah nungzui sawm le nihte,
le a sungpan dawi a hawlkhiatsakte le natna tuamtuam pan a damsak numei pawlkhat in zong a zui uh hi. Tua numeite: A sung panin dawi sagih a kihawlkhiatna Mary (Magdala khuami Mary a kici nu),
Herod' khutnuai-a ulian Khuza' zi Joanna, Susanna, le numei dang tampite hi uh a, amau' neihsa tawh Jesuh le a nungzuite a huh uh hi.
Khua khat khit khua khat panin Jesuh kiangah a hong pai mi hong kibehlaplap a, mi tampi tak hong om ciangin Jesuh in thugentehna khat gen a,
"Khaici vawhpa khaici vawh dingin a kuankhia hi. Khaici a vawh ciangin pawlkhatte lampidung tu a, khe tawh kisik gawpin vasate in a ne hi.
Pawlkhatte, suang kitawphahna leilak tu a, a po tei hangin leisung a nom tam lo ahih manin a vulkik pah hi.
Pawlkhatte, lingbulsum omna leilak tu a, lingte a khan ciangin a deplum hi.
Pawlkhatte, leihoihna lak tu-in khang a, a zah zakhat ciang dong a piang hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh nakpitakin kiko a, "Zak nading bil a neite in hih thu za ta un," ci-in a thugen a khum hi.

Jesuh in, "Pasian' Ukna thu tawh kisai thusim, note tungah hong kigen hi. Ahi zongin midangte in, en en napi-un a muh loh nading za za napi-un a tel loh nadingun amaute tungah thugentehna tawh thu kigen hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Thugentehna a khiatna pen hih bang ahi hi: Khaici pen Pasian' thu hi.
Lamdungah khaici a tukna munte pen Pasian' thu a zate a cihnopna ahi hi. Tuate in Pasian' thu a zak hangun a thu um loin, hotkhiatna a ngah loh nadingun Dawimangpa hong pai-in a lakkhiatsak hi.
Suang kitawphah leilak a tukna munte pen Pasian' thu a zak ciangin lungdam takin a sangte a cihna ahi hi. Ahi zongin amaute sungah thuktum lo ahih manin tawlkhat sung bek um uh a, ze-etna hun a tun ciangin a puk uh hi.
Lingbulsum omna a tukna munte pen Pasian' thu za napi-in a nuntakna sung uhah leitung lunghihmawhna, hauhna, le nopsaknate in depgawp ahih manin bangmah a suakkhia zo lote a cihnopna ahi hi.
Leihoih a tukna munte pen Pasian' thu a zak ciangin lungsimtak tawh a thu mangin kip tawntung uh ahih manin amau a dingin man a neite a cihnopna ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Mei a vak khit ciangin lawh a khuh ahi a, lupna nuai-ah a koih ahi zongin kuamah om lo hi. Innsungah a lut uh ciangin mite in khua a muhtheih nadingin meivak koihna kho sangah koih bek uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh, thusimin a kikoih peuhmah, khatvei teitei thulang a suak lo ding, a kiselcip peuhmah, khatvei teitei a kipholak lo ding, bangmah om lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin thu na ngaih uh ciangin limtakin kingaihsun un. Bang hang hiam cih leh a neisa mipa tungah Pasian in piathuah ding a, a nei lo mipa tung panin themkhat nei-a a kingaihsut nangawn lakkhiatsak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua laitakin Jesuh' nu le a naute hong pai uh a, ahi zongin mihon kinehlua uh ahih manin ama kiangah pai thei lo uh hi.
Tua ahih manin mi khat in Jesuh kiangah, "Na nu le na naute in nang hong munuam uh a, innpua-ah om uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a dawnna-in mihon khempeuh tungah, "Pasian' thu za a, a zuite khempeuh pen ka nu le ka sanggamte ahi hi," a ci hi.

Tua bangin a pai laitakun Jesuh a ihmu hi. Tui tungah nakpitakin huihpi hong nungin gunkuang sungah tui dim dingin hong kipan a, lauhuai mahmah hi.
Nungzuite in Jesuh hong naihin phong uh a, "Topa aw, Topa aw, kote ka si dektak uh hi," a ci uh hi. Jesuh zong tho-in huihpi le tui kilok a daih nadingin thu pia a, a thupiak bangin hong dai dide pah hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, "Na upna uh koi-ah om khinta ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Ahi zongin amaute lau-in lamdangsa uh a, khatlekhat in, "Hih pa kua ahi hiam? Thu a piak ciangin huihpi le tuihualte nangawn in a thu mang uh hi," a kici uh hi.
Tua ciangin Galilee Tuili galkhat, Gadara gam a tung uh hi.
Gunkuang tung panin leilakah Jesuh hong paisuk laitakin tua khuasunga om dawivei mi khat in a na dawn hi. Tua dawivei pa pen sauveipi sung puan silhloin omkhin a, inn-ah zong om loin han lak khawngah om tawntung hi.
Jesuh a muh ciangin nakpitakin awngin a mai-ah khukdin a, "A Lian Pasian' Tapa Jesuh aw, kei bang hong nuammawh na hi hiam? Kei, gim nong piak loh nadingin ka hong thum hi," ci-in nakpitakin a kiko hi.
Hih bangin a cihna pen, ama sung panin dawi a paikhiat nadingin Jesuh in thu a piakna hang ahi hi. Dawi in tua mipa tamveipi tak man a, a khut le a khete sikkhau tawh khihin a kikepcip hangin a sikkhaute peksat a, dawi in gamlakah a paikhiatpih hi.
Jesuh in ama kiangah, "Na min bang ahi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin, ama sungah dawi tampi lut ahih manin, "A Honpi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Leihawm thukpi sungah amaute a khiat loh nadingin Jesuh kiangah a thum uh hi.
Tua laitakin tua kiim mualpang to-ah vok honpi khat gamta-in a om hi. Tua vokte sungah a luttheih nadingun dawite in Jesuh kiangah thum uh a, Jesuh in zong amau' ngetna bangin a pia hi.
Tua ahih manin dawite zong mipa sung panin paikhia-in vokte sungah lut uh a, vokte zong tui gei keen tung khawngah tuaksuk gawpin a vekpi-in tui a kia hi.
Vokcingte in hih thupiang a muh uh ciangin amaute tai-in khuasung le gam sung tengah a zasak uh hi.
Hih thupiang a en dingin mite hong pai uh a, Jesuh kiang a tun uh ciangin dawi a paikhiatna mipa Jesuh kiangah omin, puan silhin, a pilkikna thu a muh uh ciangin a vekpi-un lamdangsa-in a lau uh hi.
Tua thupiang a mu masa mite in dawivei pa a damnazia thute, amaute tungah a na gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin Gadara gam kiima om khempeuh lau mahmah uh ahih manin Jesuh a paikhiat nadingin a sawl uh hi. Jesuh zong gunkuang tungah tuangin a ciah hi.
Dawi a paikhiatna mipa in Jesuh kiangah, "Kei zong hong zuisak in," ci-in a thum hi; ahi zongin Jesuh in,
"Na inn-ah ciah inla, Pasian in nang a dingin bangzah takin na hong sepsak hiam, cihna thu va gen in," ci-in a sawlkhia hi. A mipa zong ciah a, ama a dingin Jesuh' sepsakna thu khempeuh, khuasung tengah a gengen hi.
Tuili galkhatah Jesuh hong ciahkik ciangin, ama hong ciahkik ding ngakin om niloh uh ahih manin mite na nuam mahmah uh hi.
Tua laitakin kikhopna inn ukpi Jairas a kici mi khat hong pai-in Jesuh' khe phungah hong khukdin a, ama inn-ah a pai nadingin a thum hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh kum sawm le nih a pha tanu khat a neihsun pen a ci na-in a si dektak hi. Jesuh zong tua inn zuan dingin a pai laitakin mihonpite in zui-in a nehcip uh hi.
Tua laitakin kum sawm le nih tawntung siluang natna vei-in, a neih khempeuh siavuante cialna-in a zat hangin kuamah in a damsak zawh loh numei khat,
mihonte lak Jesuh nungah hong pai-in Jesuh' puanmongteep lawngsim a, thakhatin a siluang a kangpah hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Kua in hong lawng na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi. Kuamah in, "Hong lawng ing," a cih loh ciangin Peter in, "Topa aw, mi khempeuh in nang hong umcihin hong nehcip uh hi," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in, "Ka sung panin vangliatna a paikhiat lamtak phawk ka hih manin mi khat in hong lawng hi," a ci hi.
Numei in amah a kiphawkna thu a theih ciangin a lingsa-in hong pai-in Jesuh mai-ah hong bok a, Jesuh a lawnna thu le amah a dampahna thuteng, tua lai-a om mi khempeuh' zakin Jesuh kiangah a pulak hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in numei kiangah, "Ka tanu aw, na upna in nang hong damsakzo hi; lungnuam takin na ciah in," a ci hi.
Tua bangin thu a gen laitakin kikhopna inn ukpa' inn panin kamtai khat hong tung a, "Na tanu si khinzo ta hi. Siapa gimsak nawn kei in," a hong ci hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in hih thu a zak ciangin, kikhopna inn ukpa kiangah, "Lunghimawh kei in; upna nei peuh lecin na tanu a hingkik ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua inn-ah Jesuh a tun ciangin Peter, Johan, le James le numeino' nu le pa simloh kuamah dang, inn sungah zuisak lo hi.
Tua lai-a om mi khempeuh, tua numeino' sihna hangin kapin, thumin na om uh hi. Ahi zongin Jesuh in, "Kap nawn kei un, amah a si hi lo hi; a ihmu bek ahi hi," a ci hi.
Amah a sihkhitna thei uh ahih manin Jesuh a nuihsan lel uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in numeino a khutin lenin, "Numeino aw, tho in," a ci hi.
Numeino zong hingkik a, thakhatin a thopah hi. Tua ciangin numeino' nek ding an pia un, ci-in Jesuh in a sawl hi.
Numeino' nu le pa in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, ahi zongin hih thupiangte kuama kiangah a gen loh nadingun Jesuh in a kham hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in nungzui sawm le nihte sam a, dawite a hawlkhiat theih nading uh le cinate a damsak theih nadingun vangliatna le aana a pia hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian' Ukna thu a hilh ding le cinatnate a damsak dingin kuankhia sakin
amaute kiangah, "Tu-a na khualzinna uhah bangmah keng kei un. Ciangkhut ahi a, ip ahi a, an ahi a, sum ahi zongin keng kei unla, puan-ak zong a valin kengthuah kei un.
Khua khatpeuhah na lut uh ciangin tua khua panin na paikhiat matengun a inn-ah hong tungsakte' inn mahah om paisuak un.
A inn uhah a hong tunsak nop lohna khua peuhpeuh panin na paikhiat uh ciangin amaute hilhkholhna-in na khe uha leivui bangte sinsan un," ci-in a vaikhak hi.
Nungzuite zong kuankhia uh a, khua khempeuhah pai-in Lungdamna Thu hilh uh a, a paina khempeuh uhah cinate a damsak uh hi.
Galilee gam sungteng a uk Herod in hih thupiangte a zak ciangin lungmang mahmah hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mi pawlkhat in, "Johan hong hingkik hi," ci uh hi.
Pawlkhat in, "Elijah hong kilangkik hi," ci uh a, pawlkhat in, "Tanglai kamsangte khat hong hingkik hi," a ci uh hi.
Herod in, "Johan a ngawng ka tansak khitsa ahi hi; hih a thu ka zak mipa kua hi ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Jesuh tawh kimuh ding a hanciam hi.
Sawltakte a khualzinna panun a hong tunkik uh ciangin a sepna teng uh Jesuh kiangah a gen uh hi. Jesuh in zong amauteng bek a om theih nadingun amaute samkhia a, Bethsaida khua lamah a paipih hi.
Mihonte in hih thu a theih uh ciangin Jesuh nungdelh uh a, Jesuh in zong amaute na nolh loin, amaute tungah Pasian' Ukna thu na hilh a, natna a neite zong a damsak hi.
Ni a tum kuan ciangin nungzui sawm le nihte in Jesuh kiangah, "Hih lai mun gamlak ahih manin, hih kiima om khuate-ah mite va pai-in annek ding le giah nading a zon nadingun mihonte sawlkhia in," a ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "A nek dingun nektheih khat peuhpeuh pia un," a cih ciangin amaute in, "Kote va pai-in hih mi khempeuhte a dingin an va lei ding ka hih kei buang uhleh, anlum nga le ngasa tawn nih cih simloh bangmah dang om lo hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua lai-ah mi tulnga bang a om hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, "Mite sawmnga, sawmnga-in a pawlpawlin tusak un," ci-in a sawl hi.
A nungzuite in zong tua a sawl mah bangin mite a tusak uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in anlum nga le ngasa tawn nih la-in vantung lam nga a, Pasian tungah lungdamna ko-in balnen a, mite tungah a lui dingin a nungzuite tungah a pia hi.
Mi khempeuh in ne-in a khamkhit uh ciangin, a nungzuite in a kikhamval teng khawm uh a, paipel sawm le nih a dim hi.
Khatvei, Jesuh guak thungenin a om laitakin a nungzuite zong ama kiangah om uh hi. Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, "Mite in kei kua hi, hong ci uh ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Amaute in, "Pawlkhat in, Tuiphumpa Johan hi, hong ci uh hi. Pawlkhat in Elijah hi, hong ci uh a, pawlkhat in, tanglai kamsangte khat peuhpeuh hong hingkik hi ding hi, hong ci uh hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Tua ahihleh note in kei kua hi, hong ci na hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin Peter in, "Nang pen Pasian' Khrih na hi hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Hih thu kuama kiangah gen kei un," ci-in a nungzuite thu a pia hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, "Mihing Tapa in tampi tak thuak ding a, upate, siampi liante, le Thukham hilh siate in amah nial ding uh hi. Amah kithat ding a, a ni thum ni-in kihing kiksak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite le mi khempeuh kiangah, "Mi khatpeuh in kei hong zuihnop leh ama deihna bangin gamta nawn loin nisimin a singlamteh pua-in hong zui ding hi.
Hih leitung nuntakna a hu nuamte in a nuntakna bulpi nangawn tawh suplawh ding a, kei' hangin a nuntakna a suplawhte in a nuntakna bulpi hu zo ding hi.
Mi khat in leitung khempeuh a ngah hangin a nuntakna bulpi suplawh leh bang phattuamna om ding ahi hiam?
Keima hang le ka thuhilhnate hangin a maizum peuhmah, a Pa' minthanna vang le a siangtho vantung mite' minthanna tawh a minthangin hong paikik ciangin Mihing Tapa zong ama hangin a maizum ding hi.
Ke'n kong cihin-ah, hih lai-ah a om mi pawlkhatte in Pasian' Ukna a muh khit uh matengin si lo ding uh ahihna phawk un," a ci hi.
Hih thu a genkhit nipikal khat bang khit ciangin Jesuh in Peter, Johan, le James te sam a, mualtungah thungen dingin a paipihto hi.
Jesuh in thu a nget laitakin a mel hong kikheel a, a puante zong pakin tee mahmah hi.
Thakhat thu-in mihing nih tawh a kiho-in hong omvat hi. Tua mi nihte pen Moses le Elijah hi a,
vantung minthanna vang lim nei uh a, Jerusalem khua-ah pai-in sihna tawh Pasian' deihna a tunsak nading thu a kikumkum uh ahi hi.
Peter le a lawm tegel lusu-in ihmu uh a, ahi zongin amaute hong khanglo-in, Jesuh' minthanna vang le amah tawh a dingkhawm mi nihte a mu uh hi.
A mite, Jesuh kiang panin a paikhiat laitakin Peter in bang gen ka hi hiam, cih mel zong a thei lopi-in Jesuh kiangah, "Topa aw, hih lai-a i om, nuam mahmah hi. Nang a' ding buk khat, Moses a' ding buk khat, Elijah a' ding buk khat, buk thum kong lamsak ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Hih bangin thu a gen laitakin meii hong kai a, a liim in amaute hong liah hi. Meii in a tuamcip ciangin nungzuite a lau uh hi.
Tua ciangin meii lakah aw khat hong ging a, "Hih pa, ka Teelsa ka Tapa ahi hi; ama thu na ngai un," a ci hi.
Tua awging a bei khit ciangin Jesuh guak bek hong om hi. Nungzuite in hih a muhsa uh thu tua hun sawngteng kuama kiangah gen loin a imcip uh hi.
A zing ciangin mualtung panin hong paisuk uh a, mi tampi in Jesuh na dawn uh hi.
Mihon lak panin mi khat hong kiko a, "Sia aw, ka tapa nong etsak nadingin kong thum hi. Amah bek ta a ka neih ahi hi.
Dawi in amah man a, thakhat thu-in kikogawp hi. A cilphuan a buak dongin kongkawcipsak a, gimsak gawp a, nusia nuam lo hi.
Na nungzuite in a dawi hong hawlkhiatsak nading uh ka thum a, ahi zongin hong hawlkhiatsak thei lo uh hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in, "Note in bangzahin upna nei lo a, bangzahin khial na hi uh hiam? Note bang tanvei hong ompih ding a, bang tanvei hong kikholhpih ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ciangin a mipa kiangah, "Na tapa hong paipih in," ci-in a dawng hi.
A naupang hong pai laitakin dawi in leilakah tuksakin a kongkawcipsak hi. Ahi zongin Jesuh in a dawi taii a, naupang damsakin, a pa kiangah a piakik hi.
Hih bangin Pasian a vang a liatna hangin mi khempeuh in lamdang a sa uh hi. Mite in Jesuh' hihnate khempeuh lamdangsa-in a om laitakin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah,
"Mihingte' khut sungah Mihing Tapa kipia ding ahihna thu mangngilh het kei un," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin amaute in a cihnopna thei lo uh hi. Amaute in a theihtel loh nading mahun a kibawl hi a, bang a cihnopna hiam, ci-in Jesuh kiangah lah a dong ngam kei uh hi.
Kua lianpen ding ihi hiam, ci-in nungzuite lakah kiselna khat hong om hi.
Jesuh in amaute' lungsim ngaihsutna a phawk ciangin naupang khat la-in a gei-ah omsak a,
a nungzuite kiangah, "Keima hangin hih naupang a limbawl mi peuhmah in kei hong limbawl hi a, kei hong limbawl mi peuhmah in kei hong sawl pa zong a limbawl ahi hi. Note khempeuh lakah a neupen pa a lianpen pa ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Johan in, "Topa aw, nangma min tawh dawi a hawlkhia mi khat ka mu uh a, amah pen eima pawl sungah a om hi lo ahih manin ka kham uh hi," a hong ci hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in ama kiangah, "No hong langpang lote note' pawl ahih manin kham kei un," a ci hi.
Jesuh vantungah a kilaktoh ding hun a nai kuan ciangin Jerusalem khua manawh dingin a ngaihsun hi. Ama mai-ah nungzui pawlkhat mapaisak a,
Jesuh a dingin a kisam khempeuh a vaihawmsak dingin Samaria khua khatah a lut uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in Jerusalem khua manawh sawm ahih manin tua khuamite in Jesuh na tungsak nuam lo uh hi.
A nungzuite sung pan James le Johan in hih thu a theih uh ciangin Jesuh kiangah, "Topa aw, vantung panin meikuang ngenin amaute kangtumsak le ung nong awi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh kihei-in amaute a taii hi.
Tua ciangin khua dang khatah a paisuak uh hi.
Lampi-ah a pai laitakun mi khat in Jesuh kiangah, "Na paina khempeuhah kong zui ding hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in, "Ngiate in lup nading kua nei uh a, vasate in zong giah nading bu nei uh hi. Ahi zongin Mihing Tapa in a luptheih nading mun koimahah nei lo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in midang khat kiangah, "Kei hong zui in," a ci hi. Ahi zongin amah in, "Topa aw, kei hong ciahsak inla, ka pa hong vuisak masa in," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in, "Misi bang ahi mite in misite na vui tahen. Nang ahihleh va pai inla Pasian' Ukna thu va hilh in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin midang khat in, "Topa aw, nang ka hong zui ding hi. Ahi zongin ka inn-ate, mangpha hong khasak masa in," a ci hi.
Jesuh in ama kiangah, "Bawng lokhawhna lenkawmin a nunglam a en mi pen Pasian' Ukna tawh kituak lo hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua khit ciangin Jesuh in ama pai nading khua le mun khempeuhah nih nihin a na pai dingin mi sawmsagih seh a, ama mai-ah a mapaisak hi.
Amaute kiangah, "Anlak ding tam mahmah a, ahi zongin mi tawm bek in anlak na sem uh hi. Tua ahih manin an nei pa in a ante a la dingin mi hong sawl nadingin thu ngen un.
Note va kuan un. Ngiahon lakah tuuno khah bangin note ka hong sawl hi.
Sum ahi a, ip ahi a, khedap a val ahi zongin keng kei un. Lamkalah mi tawh kimawk hoho kei un.
Inn khat peuhpeuhah na lut uh ciangin, 'Hih inn-ah nopsakna hong tung ta hen,' ci-in hopih masa un.
Tua inn sungah nopsakna a ngahthei ding mi a om leh kip paisuak ding a, a om kei leh na hopihna thupha uh na dokkik ding uh hi.
Nasemte in a thaman a ngah ding a kilawm ahih mah bangin na zintunna inn mah uhah omsuak unla, a hong piak peuhpeuh uh na ne un. Na zintunna inn uh kheel themthum kei un.
Khua khat peuhpeuhah na lut uh ciangin note hong tunsak leh, amaute' hong lui peuhpeuh ne unla,
tua khuasunga cinate damsak un. A khuamite kiangah, 'Pasian' Uk nading hun note a dingin hong naita hi,' ci-in gen un.
Ahi zongin khua khat peuhpeuhah na lut uh ciangin note hong tunsaknop kei leh a khuasung kongzingah pai unla,
'Na khuasung uha leivui, ka khe tung uhah a hong bangte nangawn, note hilhkholhna-in ka nulkhia uh hi. Ahi zongin Pasian' Uk nading hun a hong naina thu thei ta un,' ci-in gen un.
Ke'n kong cihin-ah, Thukhen Ni ciangin Sodom khuamite' thuak ding sangin tua khuamite' thuak ding haksazaw lai ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Khorazin khuapi mite le Bethsaida khuapi mite aw, gimna lianpi na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note khua sungah a hong kilak na lamdangte, Taia le Sidon khua sungah kilak hileh amaute in kisikna limin sawtpekin puanhampi silhin vut kinuh ding uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Thukhen Ni ciangin Taia le Sidon khuapi mite' thuak ding sangin note' thuak ding haksazaw lai ding hi.
No Kapernaum khuapi mite aw, van a sangna munah hong kipahtawi ding sa na hi uh hiam? Hell khuk sungah hong kilawnsuk ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, "Note' thu a hong zuite khempeuh, kei' thu a hong zui hi a, note' thu a hong zui lote khempeuh, kei' thu a hong zui lo ahi uh hi. Kei' thu a hong zui lote khempeuh pen kei a hong sawl pa' thu a zui lo ahi uh hi," a ci hi.
Sawmsagihte lungdam mahmahin hong ciahkik uh a, "Topa aw, nangma min tawh dawite nangawn ka hawlkhiazo uh hi," a hong ci uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Vantung panin keekkia bangin Satan a kiatna ka mu hi.
Tu-in thei un. Gulpi le momaite na sikgawp nading uh le na galte uh na zawh nadingun note tungah vangliatna ka hong piazo a, amaute in note bangmah hong cih zo lo ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin dawite in na thu uh hong manna hangin lungdam kei unla, vantungah na min uh a kigelh manin lungdamzaw un," a ci hi.
Tua laitakin Kha Siangtho in lungdamna tawh Jesuh kidimsak hi. Jesuh in, "Vantung le leitung Topa ahi ka Pa aw, mipilte le misiamte tungah na ip thute, bangmah a thei lo hih mite tungah lak na hih manin ka nuam hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih thu pen nangma deihna bang ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Hih nate khempeuh ka Pa in kei tungah hong ap khinzo hi. Pasian simloh, Tapa a thei kuamah om lo hi. Tapa le Tapa in a theihsaknop mite simloh, Pa a thei kuamah om lo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin nungzuite lamah kihei a, "Tu-a na muh uh nate na muh manun a hampha mahmah na hi uh hi.
Ke'n kong cihin-ah, kamsang tampite le kumpi tampite in tu-a note' muhte a muhnop uh hangin mu ngei lo uh a, a zaknop uh hangin za ngei lo uh hi," ci-in a tuamin a gen hi.
Jesuh a ze-et dingin Thukham hilh siate khat hong ding a, "Sia aw, nuntak tawntungna ka ngahtheih nadingin bang sem ding ka hi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Jesuh in, "Thukham sungah bang kigelh a, bang sim na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in, "Na Topa Pasian na lungsim khempeuh, na nuntakna khempeuh, na hatna khempeuh, le na pilna khempeuh tawh na it inla, nangmah na ki-it bangin na vengte na it in," ci-in kigelh hi, ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Na dawnna man mahmah hi. Tua bangin gamta lecin nuntak tawntungna na ngah ding hi," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Thukham hilh siapa amah kitangsak nuam ahih manin Jesuh kiangah, "Ka vengte i cih kuate ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Jesuh in dawng a, "Jerusalem panin Jerikho khua-ah mi khat paisuk a, lamkalah migilote in na suam a, a neih khempeuh laksakin a satgawp khit uh ciangin nusia uh a, a si dektaksa-in a paisan uh hi.
Tua laitakin siampi khat tua lampi tawnin hong paisuk a, amah a muh ciangin lamnawl lam tawnin a paisan hi.
Tua ciangin Levi mi khat zong tua mah bangin hong pai a, amah a muh ciangin lamnawl lam tawnin a paisan leuleu hi.
Ahi zongin Samaria mi khualzin khat, tua lai mun hong tungin a liam pa a muh ciangin hehpihhuaisa a,
a kiangah va pai-in a liammate sathau le leenggahzu a nuhsak khit ciangin a tunsak hi. Tua ciangin a la tungah tuangsak a, zintun inn khatah paipihin tua lai-ah a khoi hi.
A zingsang ciangin zintun inn nei pa kiangah sum peek nih pia a, 'Hih mipa limtakin na khoi in. Na beina dang khempeuh, kong paikik ciangin kong loh ding hi,' ci hi.
Hih mihing thumte sung panin, a kisuampa a dingin a koi pen a vengpa hi dingin na um hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in, "A hehpih pa hi ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh in ama kiangah, "Nang zong pai inla, tua bangmahin gamta in," a ci hi.
Amaute a pai laitakun khua khatah Jesuh bang a, Martha kici numei khat in a inn-ah na tungsak hi.
Martha in Mary kici nau numei khat nei a, Topa' thugente ngai-in Mary a om hi.
Martha bek in na semin manlah mahmah ahih manin a heh suak a, "Topa aw, ka naunu in kei bek na hong sepsak niloh phamawh sa lo na hi hiam? Kei hong huh nadingin hong sawl in," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Topa in, "Martha, Martha aw, nang na lunghihmawhna tam hi.
Ahi zongin a kisam taktak khat bek om a, Mary in tua a kisam na pen a semsem ahih manin, a nasep kikhawlsak lo ding hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Khat vei, Jesuh in mun khatah thu a ngen hi. A thunget a mankhit ciangin a nungzuite khat in, "Topa aw, Johan in a nungzuite a hilh bangin kote zong thungetzia hong hilh in," a ci hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Hih bangin na ngen ding uh hi: 'Pa aw, na min siangtho kizahtak hen la, na Ukna hun hong tung tahen.
Kote tungah a hong mawhte mawh maisakna ka neih bangun ko' mawhna zong hong maisak in. Ze-etna lian hong thuaksak ke'n,' ci-in na ngen ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, "Note khatpeuh, na lawmte uh khat inn-ah zankim laitakin pai-in, 'Lawm aw, anlum lum thum khawng hong leitawi sak in.
Ka lawmte khat zin hong tung a, ka piak ding ka nei het kei hi,' ci le-uhcin,
amah in a innsung panin, 'Hong nawngkaisak dah in. Kong ka kalhkhin uh a, ka naupangte tawh ka lum khinzo uh hi. Kong thokhia thei kei a, bangmah kong pia thei kei ding hi,' ci-in hong dawng ding hi.
Tua ahihleh ke'n kong cihin-ah, a lawm ahihna hangin amah tho tuan loin bangmah a piak loh hangin, a nget teiteina hangin amah tho-in a kisapna teng a pia ding hi.
Tua ahih manin note kiangah kong cihin-ah: Ngen un; na ngah ding uh hi. Zong un; na mu ding uh hi. Kiu un; kongkhak hong kihon ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a ngente khempeuh in ngah ding a, a zongte khempeuh in mu ding a, a kiute khempeuh a dingin kong kihon ding hi.
Note lakah pa ahi mi khatpeuh in, a tapa in ngasa ngen leh ngasa tangin gul a pia ding,
aktui ngen leh aktui tangin momai a pia ding kua om na hi uh hiam?
Note mihoih lo hinapi-in na tate uh tungah a hoih piak ding theithei na hih uhleh, vantung a om na Pa un a ngente tungah Kha Siangtho piazaw kan ding hi lo ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Jesuh in a pau thei lo mi khat sung panin dawi hawlkhia a, dawi a paikhiat khit ciangin a mipa pauthei a, mite in lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi.
Ahi zongin mi pawlkhat in, "Dawimangpa Beelzebul in dawi hawlkhiat theih nading vangliatna ama tungah a pia ahi hi," a ci uh hi.
Mi pawlkhat leuleu in amah a ze-etna-in, Pasian' thukimpihna a kilat nadingin nalamdang a bawl ding a ngen uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in amaute' ngaihsutna thei ahih manin, "Gam khat peuhpeuh, a gammite kiphelkhamin pawlkhat le pawlkhat kido le-uh tua gam sauvei kip lo ding a, innkuan khat peuhpeuh a mite kiphelkhamin kido le-uh kikhenthang ding uh hi.
Tua mah bangin Satan ukna sunga om mite zong khatlekhat kido le-uh a ukna bangci kip ding ahi hiam? Kei pen, Beelzebul' vangliatna tawh dawi hawlkhia hi, nong ci uh hi.
Ke'n Beelzebul' vangliatna tawh dawi hawlkhia ka hih leh, na mipihte un kua' vangliatna tawh hawlkhia ahi uh hiam? Na ngaihsut khialhna uh amaute in hong langsak ding hi.
Note' ngaihsut bang hi loin, ke'n Pasian' vangliatna tawh dawite hawlkhia ka hih manin, note kiangah Pasian' Ukna hun hong tungta ahihna phawk un.
"Mi thahat khat in a hiam neih khempeuh tawh ama inn a cin ciangin a neihsa khempeuh suakta hi.
Ahi zongin amah sangin a hatzaw mi khat in amah simin a zawhgawp khit ciangin, ama muan a hiam khempeuh laksakin a pawlte tawh a hawm hi.
Kei hong pawlpih lo peuhmah keima lang hi uh a, tuute hong kaihkhoppih lo peuhmah tuute a thehthang gawpte ahi uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Mi khatpeuh sung panin dawi a kihawlkhiat khit ciangin a ten nading mun keuna zongin a vak kawikawi hi. A om nading mun a muh loh ciangin, 'Hong kihawlkhiatna inn mahah lutkik ning,' ci hi.
A hong tunkik ciangin hoihtakin kiphiat siangin a hoih linlianin a mu hi.
Tua ciangin amah paikhia kikin, amah sangin a siazaw dawi sagih hong paipih a, a sungah lutin a teng uh hi. Tua mipa' pianzia pen a masa sangin hong siazaw hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in hih thu a genkhit ciangin mihon lak panin numei khat hong paukhia a, "Nang hong paii numei, a nawi na teep numei, mi hampha mahmah ahi hi," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in, "Pasian' thu za-in a zuite hamphazaw lai hi," ci-in a dawng hi.

Nineveh khua mite a dingin kamsang Jonah pen lim khat ahih mah bangin tuhun mite a dingin Mihing Tapa zong, lim ahi ding hi.
Thukhen Ni ciangin leitaw lam gam pana hong pai Kumpinu hong dingin tuhun mite mawhsakna thu hong gen ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Solomon' pilna thu a za dingin leimong khat panin amah hong pai a, ahi zongin Solomon sangin a lianzaw khat hih lai-ah om hi.
Thukhen Ni ciangin Nineveh khuamite hong dingin note mawhsakna thu hong gen ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Jonah' thuhilhna a zak uh ciangin a mawhnate uh kisik uh a, ahi zongin Jonah sangin a lianzaw khat hih lai-ah a om hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Kuamah in meivak a vakkhit ciangin a munbu ah koih lo a, lawh zong khuhlo hi. Innsungah a lut mi khempeuh in khua a muhtheih nadingin meivak koihna tungah a koihzaw hi.
Tua ahih ciangin na pumpi sung uha om khuavak pen khuamial ahih khak loh nading limtakin kingaihsun un.
Tua bang hi peuh leh, meivak a taan ciangin khua na muh uh mah bangin na pumpi uh a dingin khuamialna mun om loin a vekpi-in a taangkim ding hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in a thugen a mankhit ciangin Farisi mi khat in an nekpih dingin Jesuh a sam hi. Amah zong pai-in an ne dingin a tu hi.

Tua ciangin Topa in ama kiangah, "No Farisi mite in hai leh kuangte a pualam na siangsak uh a, ahi zongin note na lungsim sung uhah huaihamin na gi kei uh hi.
No mihaite aw, a pualam a bawlpa in a sunglam zong bawl hi lo ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin na hai leh na kuang sung uhah a omte pen itna tawh mizawngte tungah pia le-uhcin, note a dingin na khempeuh hong siang ding hi.
"No Farisi mite in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Note in Pasian tungah lengmasel, thuambuak a kipan anteh theipuam dongin sawm-ah-khat pia napi-in, mite tungah thuman ding le Pasian it ding na donkha kei uh hi. Hihte khempeuh na hihkim ding uh hi a, paihkhiat na neih ding uh hi lo hi.
"No Farisi mite in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Kikhopna inn sungah tutphah nuampen ah na tunuam uh a, mihon lakah hong kizahtak hopih ding na ut uh hi.
A kiciamteh lo hankhuk, mite in a theih loh manun a va sikkhakna munte tawh na kibang uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Thukham hilh siate khat in Jesuh kiangah, "Sia aw, hih bang thu na gen ciangin kote zong a hong ko bawl na hi hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in, "No Thukham hilh siate in zong gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Note in a puak hak mahmah ding van, mite tungah na suan uh a, ahi zongin tua van a puakpih dingin na khutmeno khat nangawn uh na tangsak nuam kei uh hi.
Note in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Na pu na pate un a thahsa kamsangte' han a hoihin na bawl uh hi.
Tua ahih manin na pu na pate uh gamtatnate a thukimpih, a tecite na hi uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in kamsangte thatin, note in a han na bawl uh hi.
Tua thu hangin Pasian' Pilna a kici laibu sungah, 'Amaute kiangah kamsangte le sawltakte ka sawl ding a, amaute in tua mite pawlkhat bawlsia-in na that ding uh hi,' ci-in kigelh hi.
Tua ahih manin leitung piancil a kipan kamsang a kithatte khempeuh hangin tuhuna mite gim kipia ding a,
Abel a kithah a kipan biakna tau le siangtho mun kikalah a kithat Zekhariah a sihna ciang dong, tua mi thahna hangin gimna a thuak ding uh hi. Ke'n kong cihin-ah, hih thute khempeuh hangin tuhuna mite gim hong kipia taktak ding hi.
No Thukham hilh siate in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Note in pilna ngah theih nading konghonna tawhtang nei napi-in a sungah note na lut tuan kei uh a, a tum dingin a paite zong lah na khaktan uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua mun panin Jesuh a paikhiat khit a kipanin Thukham hilh siate le Farisi mite in nakpitakin Jesuh mawhzon ding kipanin thu tampi tak dong uh a,
a kampau khialhnate a mattheih nadingun thangsiahin a hanciam uh hi.
Mi a tul tampite hong kikhawmin khatlekhat a kisikkha gawp dongin kinehcipin a om laitakin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah thu gen masa a, "Farisi mite' kineihkhemna ahi, a silngo uh limtakin kidawm un.
A kiseelte khatvei teitei kimu ding a, thusimte khatvei teitei thulang suak ding hi.
Zan khuamial sunga na gente uh sun khuavak sungah kigenkik ding a, innsung tawngah na kihuau simnate uh mi khempeuh in theithang ding uh hi.
"Lawmte aw, note kiangah kong genin-ah, pumpi a thahkhit ciangin a siazaw a hihthei nawn lote na kihta kei un.
Kuate kihta ding na hi uh hiam cih leh, mite in a thah khitsa mipa pen hell khuk sungah a khiathuah theilai Pasian na kihta un.
Gitta nga ciangin hamu-in kizuak lel hi lo ahi hiam? Tua bang hi lel napi-in Pasian in gitta khat beek mangngilh lo hi.
Na lutung uha om na sammal zah ciat nangawn uh Pasian in thei khin hi. Note lunghimawh kei un. Gitta tampi sangin na manphazaw ciat uh hi.
"Note kiangah kong cihin-ah, keima mi ahihna mi' theihin a genkhiate, Mihing Tapa in zong Pasian' vantung mite' mai-ah, keima mi hi, ci-in genkhia ding a,
ahi zongin keima mi ahihna mi' theihin a genkhia nuam lote, Pasian' vantung mite mai-ah zong keima mi hi, ci-in Mihing Tapa in genkhia nuam lo ding hi.
Mihing Tapa a langpangte a mawhna uh kimaisak thei ding a, Kha Siangtho a langpangte a mawhna uh kimaisak lo ding hi.
Thusitna a thuak dingin kikhopna inn-ah ahi a, hausa zumah ahi zongin hong paipih uh ciangin bang gen ding a, bangci kihut ding ka hi hiam, ci-in lunghimawh kei un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a hun a tun ciangin Kha Siangtho in na gen dingteng uh hong hilh ding hi," a ci hi.
