Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute khempeuh kiangah, "Hoihtakin kidawm unla, na huaiham loh nadingun kikem un. Bang hang hiam cih leh bangzahta-in mi khat a hauh hangin a neihsa tawh a nuntakna taktak kicing zo lo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah thugentehna khat gen a, "Mi hau pa khat' lo-ah an tampi a piang hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a lungsim sungah, 'Ka an khempeuh ka koih nading mun kicing lo ahih manin bangcih ding ka hi hiam?
Tua ahih manin hih bangin ka gamta ding hi: Ka ansalte phelin a lianzaw ansalte ka lam ding a, tuate sungah ka ante le ka neih khempeuh ka seng ding hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in ama kiangah, 'Mihai pa aw, tuzan mahmahin na si ding hi. Hih na neihsa teng kua'n zang nawn ding ahi hiam?' ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a thugen a khupna-in, "Tua mah bangin amau a' ding bekin a kholcipte pen Pasian' muhna panin mihau hi lo uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, "Tua ahih ciangin note kiangah kong genin-ah: I nuntak nadingin bang ne ding a, i pumpi tungah bang silh ding ihi hiam, ci-in lunghimawh kei un.
Nuntakna pen an sangin thupizaw a, pumpi pen puan sangin thupizaw hi.
Vasate ngaihsun dih un: Amaute in khai tuh lo uh a, anlak cih zong nei lo uh hi. Amaute in beemlepang zong nei lo napi-in Pasian in annek tasamsak lo hi. Vasate sangin note nakpitakin na manphazaw uh hi.
Note na lunghihmawh manun na nuntak hun uh nai khat sung bek a sotto thei kua om na hi uh hiam?
Tua bang a themno khat nangawn hih thei lo na hih uhleh bang hangin adangte lunghimawh se na hi uh hiam?
Gamlak a paakte ngaihsun dih un. Tuate in a nek ding uh na sem lo uh a, a silh ding uh puan zong gan lo uh hi. Ahi zongin note kiangah kong genin-ah: Bangzahin a hauh hangin Solomon nangawn, hih paakte khat zahin a hoihin kizem zo lo lai hi.
Upna neu mite aw, tuni-in om a, zing ciangin keutumin meikhuk sungah a kikhultum lopa kungte, Pasian in puansilh guan ahihleh note hong guanzaw kan ding hi lo ahi hiam?
Tua ahih manin bang ne ding, bang dawn ding, ci-in lunghimawhin om tawntung kei un.
Gentail mi khempeuh in hih nate lunghihmawh penin nei uh hi. Hih nate na kisap lamtak uh zong na Pa un hong thei hi.
Tua ahih manin Pasian' Ukna ngaihsutin nei masazaw un. Tua hileh hih na kisapna dangte uh zong Pasian in hong piathuah ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Tuuhon tawmnote aw, lau-in lunghimawh kei un. Na Pa un ama Ukna sungah ukna thu a nei dingin a hong sehsa ahi hi.
Na neihsa uh zuak unla, mizawngte tungah tua sumte na pia un. Note a dingin a sia thei lo sumkholna na bawl unla, gutate in a luh zawh lohna, leikha in zong a nek zawh lohna, cikmahin a kiam ngei hetloh nading mun vantungah na sumte uh na khol un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh na sum uh a omna munah na lungsim uh om tawntung ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Na kawng uh gakin, na mei uh vakin a kigingsa-in om unla,
a topa uh mopawi simna panin hong tungin kongkhak a kiuh ciangin thakhatin kong a honpah theih nadingun a topa' ciah ding a ngak nasemte bangin om un.
A topa hong ciah ciangin a kigingsa-in amah ngakin a om uh a muh nasemte pen mi hampha mahmah ahi uh hi. Note kiangah kong genin-ah, a topa zong hong kithawi-in a nasemte an vak dingin tusak ding a, amahmah in a nasemte an thukin na a sem ding hi.
Zankim laitak ahi a, zingsang khuavakkuan lam ahi zongin a hong ciah hun peuhpeuh ciangin amah ngakin a om a muh nasemte pen mi hampha mahmah ahi uh hi.
Ahi zongin na phawk ding uh thu khat om hi. Mi khat in guta pa' hong pai ding hun theikhol leh a inn luhsak lo ding hi.
Tua mah bangin Mihing Tapa zong na upmawh loh uh hun laitakin hong pai ding ahih manin note zong a kigingsa-in om tawntung un," a ci hi.
Peter in, "Topa aw, hih thugentehna ko bek nong cihna ahi hiam, ahih kei leh mi khempeuh a' ding na cihna ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Topa in, "A pil a citak nasempa i cih a bangcite ahi hiam? A naseppih dangte ukin a hun manmanin amaute' nekzah ding ciat a pia dingin a topa in a seh nasempa ahi hi.
A topa hong ciah ciangin hih ama sawl bangin a sem a muh nasempa pen mi hampha mahmah ahi hi.
Ke'n kong cihin-ah, a neihsa khempeuh a uk dingin a topa in tua nasempa koih takpi ding hi.
Ahi zongin tua nasempa in a lungsim sungah, 'Ka topa hong ciahkik hak ding hi,' ci-in ngaihsunin a naseppih numei le pasalte satgawp hen la, zukham ankhamin ommawk leh,
tua nasem pa' topa pen ama upmawh loh ni, a theihkholh loh hunin hong tung ding hi. A topa in nakpitakin amah gim pia ding a, a thumang lo mite tawh a kibangin a thuaksak khawm ding hi.
A topa' deihna thei napi-in a topa' deih bangin a gamta nuam lo nasem pa pen nakpitakin kisat ding hi.
Ahi zongin a topa' deihna a theih lohna hangin satthuak nading a gamtakha nasem pa pen kidamsat zawdeuh ding hi. Tampi a kipiakna pa tung pan tampi kikal ding a, a tamzaw a ki-apna pa tung pan a tamzaw kikal ding hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Leitungah meikuang a khah dingin a hong pai ka hi a, tu mahmahin a meikuang kipan khinta hileh ka ut hi.
Gimna sungah ka kiphum nading khat om a, tua thu a kikhit matengin ka lungsim a nuam thei kei hi.
Leitungah kilemna a omsak dingin a hong pai hong sa na hi uh hiam? Hilo hi. Ke'n kong cihin-ah, kikhenna a omsak dingin a hong pai ka hizaw hi.
Tu a kipanin innkuan sungah mihing nga a phate, a langah thum, a langah nihin kikhenin kido ding uh hi.
A pa in a tapa do-in, a tapa in a pa do ding a, a nu in a tanu do-in, a tanu in a nu do ding a, a teeknu in a monu do-in, a monu in a teeknu do ding hi," a ci hi.
Leitaw lam panin huih hong nun' ciangin, 'Ni hong sa ding hi,' na ci uh a, tua mah bangin ni hong sa takpi hi.
No a kineihkhem mite aw, vanlelei na et uh ciangin a piang ding thu thei na hih uhleh, tuhun thute bang hangin theithei lo na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Bang hangin na gamtat nading uh a manin khen thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Mi khatpeuh in na tungah thu hong bawlin zum-ah hong paipih leh, zuma thukhente mai-ah hong kaigawpin, thukhente in palikte kiangah hong apin, palikte in thong sungah a hong koih loh nadingin, na lang pa uh tawh na thu uh a siantheih nadingin na siam tawpun lamkalah hanciam un.
Ke'n kong cihin-ah, tua bangin gamta kei le-uhcin, na liausum uh na piak khit matengun thong panin na suakta kei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua laitakin tua lai-a om mi pawlkhat in Jesuh kiangah, Galilee mite in Pasian kiangah biakna pia-in a om laitakin Pilat in a thah mite' thu a gen uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Tua bangin hih Galilee mite kithat ahih manin, Galilee midangte khempeuh sangin hih a kithat mite a mawhna uh lianzaw hi, ci-in ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?
Hilo hi. Ke'n kong cihin-ah, na mawhna panun na kisik kei uhleh amaute mah bangin note zong na si ding uh hi.
Tua ahih kei leh, Siloam Tuibeem gei-a tausang a puk lai-in a denlup mi sawm le giatte bangci ngaihsut na hi uh hiam? Hih bangin a sih manun Jerusalem khuasunga a teng midangte sangin a mawhna uh lianzaw hi, ci-in ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?
Hilo hi. Ke'n kong cihin-ah, na mawhna panun na kisikkik kei uh leh note zong amaute mah bangin na si ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah thugentehna khat gen a, "Mi khat in a lolai-ah theikung khat a suansak hi. Theigah a lo dingin a pai ciangin bangmah na gah lo hi.
Tua ahih manin amah in a lokho pa kiangah, 'A beisa kum thum sung theigah lo dingin ka pai zelzel a, ahi zongin gah lo hi. Tua ahih manin phuk in. Bang hangin lo sung mawk nawngkaisak ding ahi hiam?' ci hi.
Tua ciangin lokho pa in, 'Topa aw, tu kum sung zong hih bangmahin omsaklai phot in. A phung kimkot to-in eklei ka sung ding hi.
Kum kik ciangin hong gah leh a hoih hi pah ding hi. Ahi zongin hong gah kei veve leh i phuk ding hi,' ci-in a dawng hi," a ci hi.
Sabbath ni khatin Jesuh in kikhopna inn khat sungah thu hilhin a om hi.
Dawivei numei khat tua lai-ah om a, tua dawi in kum sawm le giat sung tua numei cina sakin a nung kulsak a, dingtang thei hetloin a om hi.
Jesuh in tua numei a muh ciangin a kiangah sam a, "Lawm aw, na natna panin na damta hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin numei tungah a khut nga a, thakhat thu-in amah dingtang thei-in Pasian a phatpah hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in Sabbath ni-in cina a damsakna hangin kikhopna inn ukpa a heh suak a, mite kiangah, "Na a kisep theih nading hun ni guk sung om hi. Tua hun sungin hong pai-in kidamsak unla, ahi zongin Sabbath ni-in hong pai kei un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in amah dawng a, "No a kineihkhem mite aw, note in Sabbath ni mahin zong na bawngte uh ahi a, na late uh ahi zongin a buk panin na khihna khaute uh sutin, tui pia dingin paipih hi lo na hi uh hiam?
Tua mah bangin Satan in Abraham' suante khat ahi hih numei pen kum sawm le giat sung hencip hi. Hih a kihencipna panin Sabbath ni-in hih numei khahkhiat ding kilawm hi lo ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Hih Jesuh' dawnna in alangte khempeuh maizumsak a, Jesuh' sep hih na lamdangte khempeuh hangin midang khempeuh a lungdam mahmah uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Pasian' Ukna bang tawh kibang a, bang tawh genteh ding ka hi hiam cih leh:
Mi khat in a lo-ah a vawh ankam tang khat tawh kibang hi. Tua ankam tang hong khangin kung golpi hong suak a, vasate in a hiang tungah bu a tom thei uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Pasian' Ukna bang tawh genteh leuleu ding ka hi hiam cih leh:
Nupi khat in annel lom sungah a sawh silngo tawh kibang hi. Tua silngo in a annel lom khempeuh a pawmsak hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin khuapite le khuaneute nawkin Jesuh paisuak a, Jerusalem khua manawhin a paikawmin thu a hilh hi.
Tua laitakin mi khat in, "Siapa aw, hotkhiatna a ngah mi tawmno khat bek hi ding ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Kong kawcik tawnin na lut nadingun hanciam un. Note kiangah kong genin-ah, mi tampi tak in lut ding a hanciam uh hangin lut zo lo ding uh hi.
Inn nei pa hong tho-in kong hong khak ciangin, note kong pualamah dingin kongkhak na kiu ding uh a, 'Topa aw, kote zong kong hong hon in,' na ci ding uh hi. Amah in, 'Note koilai panin a hong pai na hi uh hiam kong thei kei hi,' ci-in hong dawng ding hi.
Note in, 'Nangmah tawh anne tuidawn khawmin i om a, ka khuasung uhah thu nong hilh hi,' na ci ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin amah in, 'Note koi panin a hong pai cih kong thei kei hi. A giloin a gamta note khempeuh aw, kei kiang panin paikhia un,' hong ci ding hi.
Pasian' Ukna sungah Abraham, Isaac, Jakob, le kamsangte khempeuh a omna mu napi-in, note a pualamah hong kihawlkhiat ciangin tua huna na kahna uh le na ha gawina uh bangzah takin nasia ding ahi hiam?
Nisuahna le nitumna, leilu le leitaw lam panin mite hong pai-in Pasian' Ukna sung sabuai kiimah tukhawm ding uh hi.
Tua hi a, tuhuna mineute tuahun ciangin milian hi ding a, tuhuna miliante tuahun ciangin mineu hi ding hi," a ci hi.
Tuahun laitakin Farisi mi pawlkhat hong pai-in Jesuh kiangah, "Herod in nang thah hong sawm ahih manin hih lai panin mun dang khatah paikhia in," a ci uh hi.
Jesuh in, "Pai unla, ngia bangin ngian a zang tua Herod kiangah hih bangin va gen un: 'Tuni le zing ciang sung dawi hawlkhia-in cina ka damsak ding a, thai ciangin ka nasep ka man ding hi, ci hi,' va ci un.
Ahi zongin tuni, zing le thai sungteng ka ma nawtsuakin ka pai ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Jerusalem khuasung lobuang mun dangah kamsangpa a kithah ding kilawm lo hi.
"Jerusalem, Jerusalem aw, kamsangte na that a, Pasian' hong sawl kamtaite na denglum hi. Akpi in a kha tawh a note a huai mah bangin na mite ka huainuam tawntung a, ahi zongin na ut kei hi.
Tu-in na innte kinusiacip ding hi. 'Topa min tawh a hong pai mipa, Pasian in thupha pia ta hen,' na cih hun hong tun matengin kei nong mu nawn kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Sabbath ni khatin Farisi mi upa khat' inn-ah an ne dingin Jesuh pai a, mite in amah encik uh hi.
Tua laitakin a khut le a khe a bawk mi khat Jesuh kiangah hong pai a,
Jesuh in zong Thukham hilh siate le Farisi mite kiangah, "Sabbath ni-in cina damsak ding i Thukham in hong hiam, khak hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Ahi zongin kuamah in dawng loin omcip uh hi. Jesuh in zong tua mipa samin a damsak khit ciangin a ciahsak hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Note khatpeuh' tapa ahi a, na bawngtal uh ahi zongin tuikhuk thukpi sungah Sabbath ni-in kia leh, Sabbath ni hinapi-in kaikhia veve ding hi lo na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Ahi zongin kuamah in hih thu dawng thei lo uh hi.
Tua annekna ah a kisam mite pawlkhat, uliante' tut nading munah a tutnopna uh a muh ciangin amaute kiangah thu khat gen a,
"Mopawi khatpeuhah hong kisap ciangin uliante' tut nading munah tu kei un. Tua pawi siim dingin a kisamte lakah note sangin a ulianzaw khat hong omkha thei ding a,
innteek pa in note kiangah, 'Hih lai-ah amah tusakzaw ni,' hong ci ding hi. Tua ciangin minautangte' tutna munah maizumpi in na tusuk ding uh hi.
Note pen tua bangin a hong kisap ciangin minautangte' tutna munah na tuzaw un. Innteek pa hong pai-in, 'Lawm aw, hih tutphah nuamah hong tuzaw in,' hong ci ding hi. Tua bangin leengla dangte khempeuh lakah hong cih ciangin nang a dingin angtanhuai mahmah hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a kiliansakte khempeuh in niamkhiatna thuak ding uh a, a kiniamkhiatte khempeuh a lianin kibawl ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a innteek pa kiangah, "Sun-an nekna-ah ahi a, nitak-an nekna-ah ahi zongin mi na sap ciangin, na lawmte ahi a, na sanggamte ahi a, na behte ahi a, mihau na vengte ahi zongin sam kei in. Amaute in zong an ne ding mahin nang hong samkik ding uh a, hih bangin hong sapna hangin na anvakna thaman a ngahkik na hi ding hi.
Tua bangin anvakna pawi na bawl ciangin mizawngte, khezawte, khebaite, le mittawte sam in.
Amaute in nang hong thukkik zo lo ding uh ahih manin nang a dingin a lungdamhuai hong hi ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh sihna panin mihoihte a thawhkik hun ciangin Pasian in nang tungah hong thukkik ding hi," a ci hi.
An ne-a a tutpih mite khat in hih thu a zak ciangin Jesuh kiangah, "Pasian' Ukna sungah an ne-a a tu mite bangzahin mi hampha ahi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Jesuh in ama kiangah, "Khatvei mi khat in pawi lianpi khat bawlin mi tampi a sam hi.
Annek ding hun ciangin a nasempa sawl a, 'Tu-in na khempeuh a baihsa-in omkhin ahih manin hong paita un,' ci-in a khohsa mite a samsak hi.
Ahih hangin a khohsa mite in a pai theih loh nading uh paulap zong ciat uh hi. A masa pen pa in, 'Lo khat ka lei a, ka va et ding kisam ahih manin kong pai thei kei ding hi,' na ci hi.
Adang khat in, 'Bawngtal kap nga ka lei a, a va sin ding ka hih manin kong pai thei kei ding hi,' na ci hi.
Adang khat leuleu in, 'Ka zi ding a kila khin phet ahih manin kong pai thei kei ding hi,' na ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a nasempa hong ciahin a topa kiangah hih thute hong zasak hi. Tua ciangin innteek pa a heh suak a, a nasempa kiangah, 'Khuasung kongzing khempeuhah va pai inla, mizawng, khezaw, mittaw, le khebai mite hong paipih in,' ci-in a sawl leuleu hi.
Tua khit a sawt loin a nasempa in, 'Topa aw, na cih bangin ka sam khin a, ahi zongin om nading mun omlai hi,' a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a topa in a nasempa kiangah, 'Gam sung lamliante le lamneute-ah va pai inla, ka inn-ah mi a dim theih nadingin mi khempeuh hong paipihmang khin in.
Ke'n kong cihin-ah, ka sap masak mite khat beek in ka an ciamkha lo ding uh hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Mi tampi tak in Jesuh hong zui uh a, Jesuh zong kihei-in amaute kiangah,
"Kei kiangah a hong pai mite peuhmah in a nu le a pa, a zi le a ta, a sanggam numeite le a sanggam pasalte, le ama pumpi mahmah a nial ngam kei leh keima nungzui suak thei lo ding hi.
Ama singlamteh mah puatawmin ka nung hong zui lote, keima nungzui hi thei lo hi.
Mi khatpeuh in inn lianpi khat lamding a sawm le, ka zozo ding hiam cih a theih nadingin a bei dingzah tuat masa hi.
Tua bangin tuat masa kei leh tua inn a khuampite a phuhkhit ciangin zawh lohpi-in khawl ding a, tua inn a kizo lo a mu mite khempeuh in amah nuihsan ding uh hi.
'Hih mipa in inn lamding kipan napi-in zozo lo hi,' ci ding uh hi.
Galkap tul sawm a nei kumpi khat in galkap tul sawmnih tawh a hong kuan kumpi khat do dingin a kithawi leh, tua kumpipa a dozo ding mahin i hat takpi hiam ci-in ngaihsun masa ding hi.
A zozo ding ahih vet kei leh, tua kumpipa a hong tun ma, a gamla-ah a om lai-in, ama kiangah kamtaite sawl ding a, kilem nading thu gensak ding hi.
Tua mah bangin mi khat in a neih khempeuh a piakkhiat ngam kei leh keima nungzui suak thei lo ding hi.
"Ci hoih hi; ahi zongin a alna bei leh i al kiksak theih nading lampi om lo hi.
Lei hoihsak nadingin kizang thei lo a, eklei dingin zong kibawl thei lo ahih manin paihmawk a kul hi. Tua ahih manin zak nading bil a neite in za ta un," a ci hi.
Khatvei, Jesuh' thugen a ngai dingin siahdongte le mawhneite tampi tak a hong pai uh hi.
Farisi mite le Thukham hilh siate phun uh a, "Hih mipa, mawhneite tawh kikhawlin an nangawn nekhawm hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Jesuh in amaute kiangah thugentehna khat gen a,
"Note sung panin khatpeuh in tuu zakhat nei-in, tua sung panin khat mansuah leh bangcih ding ahi hiam? Lopa ne-in a gamta tuu sawmkua le kuate nusia-in, a muh matengin tua a mang tuu khat a zong dingin kuankhia ding hi.
A muh ciangin lungdam mahmahin a liangko-ah pua-in ciahpih ding hi.
Inn a tun ciangin a lawmte le a vengte samin, 'A mangsa ka tuu mukik ka hih manin ka nuam mahmah hi. Lungdamna pawi bawl ni,' a ci ding hi.
Tua mah bangin kisikkik ding a kisam lo mihoih sawmkua le kuate tungah lungdamna sangin mawhnei mi khat a kisikna hangin vantungah lungdamna lianzaw ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in tua ahih kei leh zong, "Numei khat in sum peek sawm a neih sung panin khat mansuah leh bangcih ding ahi hiam? Meivak vakin, a innsung teng phiatin, a muh matengin mun khempeuh limtakin zong ding hi.
A muh ciangin a lawmte le a vengte samin amaute kiangah, 'Ka sum mansuahsa mukik ka hih manin ka nuam mahmah hi. Lungdamna pawi bawl ni,' ci ding hi.
Tua mah bangin mawhnei mi khat a kisikkikna hangin Pasian' vantung mite lungdam mahmah uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in thugentehna khat gen leuleu a, "Mi khat in tapa nih a nei hi.
A nauzawpa in, 'Pa aw, neihsa kei' ngah ding tangteng tu-in hong pia in,' a ci hi. Tua ahih manin a pa in zong, a ta tegel a hawmsak hi.
Ni tawmkhat khit ciangin a nauzawpa in ama neihsateng zuakin a sum tawh inn panin a gamlapi-ah paikhia a, a sumte a phengzat gawp hi.
A sum neih khempeuh a zatmang khit ciangin tua ama omna gamah kialpi tung a, ahi zongin amah in bangmah nei nawn lo hi.
Tua ahih manin tua gammite khat kiangah nasem dingin va pai a, a innteek pa in vokcing dingin ama lo-ah a sawl hi.
Vokte' begap nekte nangawn a duhgawh ciang dongin om a, ahi zongin kuamah in an pia lo hi.
A tawpna-ah thu ngaihsun thei a, 'Ka pa' nasemte khempeuh in gaih zawh lohin an khamval nei uh a, tu-in hih lai-ah gilkialin a puksi ding ka hita hi.
Kei kithawi-in ka pa kiangah ka ciah ding a, "Pa aw, Pasian tung le nangma tungah ka khial khin hi.
Na tapa cih dingin zong kilawm nawn lo ka hih manin na nasemte khat bangin hong bawl lel in," ka ci ding hi,' a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amah kithawi-in a pa kiangah a ciahkik dingin a pai hi. Ahi zongin inn a tun ma-in a pa in na galmuh a, hehpihhuaisa mahmah ahih manin va delhin, a tapa ngawng kawi-in a nam hi.
A tapa in, 'Pa aw, Pasian tung le nangma tungah ka khialkhin hi. Na tapa cih dingin zong ka kilawm nawn kei hi,' a ci hi.
Ahi zongin a pa in a nasemte sam a, 'Hong manlang un. Puan hoihpen hong la unla silhsak un. A khutme-ah zungbuh butsak unla, a khe-ah khedap zong bulhsak un.
Tua ciangin i bawngno limcipen hong go unla, lungdam pawi bawl ni.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka tapa a sisa hong nungta a, ka tapa a mangsa hong tungkik hi,' a ci hi. Tua ahih manin lungdamna pawi bawl a kipan uh hi.
"Tua laitakin a tapa uzaw pen lo kuan hi a, vaiciah inn hong tun kuan ciangin lamna le lasakna gingte a za hi.
Amah in zong nasemte khat sam a, 'Bang thu om ahi hiam?' ci-in a dong hi.
'Na naupa hong tungkik hi. Cidamin hong tungkik ahih manin na pa in i bawngtalno limcipen go hi,' ci-in a nasempa in a dawng hi.
A ta uzaw pen a heh suak mahmah ahih manin inn sungah zong hong tum nuam lo hi. Tua ahih manin a pa va pusuakin, a ta hong sungtumna dingin a zol hi.
A tapa uzaw in, 'Tu a beisa hunsung khempeuh, nasemte khat bangin nangma a dingin na ka sem a, na thu zong kong nial ngei het kei hi. Tua hinapi, kei bang hong pia ngei na hi hiam? Ka lawmte tawh pawi ka bawl nadingin keel khat nangawn nong pia kei hi.
Ahi zongin hih na tapa in na neihsa khempeuh numei paktatte tungah zangmang khin a, hong ciahkik ciangin bawngtalno limcipen na gawh lai hi,' a ci hi.
A pa in, 'Ka ta aw, nang pen hih lai-ah kei tawh a omkhawm tawntung na hi a, keima neih khempeuh nangma a' ahi hi.
Tu-in na naupa a sisa hong hingkik a, a mangsa hong tungkik ahih manin lungdamin pawi i bawl ding ahi hi,' ci-in a pa in a dawng hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, "Sum hau pa khat om a, a neihsateng a uk dingin ama khutnuai-ah mi khat a koih hi. Tua a neihsateng a uk dingin a koih mipa in a topa' sumteng phengzat gawp hi, ci-in kikhia hi.
A topa in zong amah sam a, 'Na gamtatna ka zak a bangci thu ahi hiam? Keima neihsa a uk dingin hong koih thei nawn lo ding ka hih manin a beisa hun sungah ka neihsate na zeekna sazian a kimtakin hong pia in,' a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a nasempa in lungngai a, 'Ka topa in ka nasepna panin hong tawpsak ding ahih manin bangci gamtat ding ka hi hiam? Thatang nasep lah ka ngap kei a, nektawm ding mi kiangah nget ding lah ka maizum hi.
Tu'n ka gamtat nading ka theita hi. Tua ka ngaihsut bangin gamta leng, ka nasepna panin ka tawp ciangin lawm nei-in, amaute in a inn-ah kei hong tungsak ding uh hi,' ci hi.
Tua ahih manin a topa' sum a bate khat khatin sam a, a masa pen pa kiangah, 'Ka topa tungah bangzah ba na hi hiam?' a ci hi.
Amah in, 'Sathau tambong zanih dim ba ing,' ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, 'Na leibatna lai va la in,' ci hi; tua ciangin, 'Na leiba om lai sathau tambong zakhat hi. Tu mahmahin tusuk inla, tambong za khatin ciamteh in,' ci hi.
Tua ciangin adang khat pa kiangah, 'Nang bangzah ba na hi hiam?' ci-in a dot ciangin, 'Mangbuh seu zakhat ba ing,' ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, 'Na leibatna lai va la in,' ci hi; tua ciangin, 'Na leiba om lai seu sawmgiat hi. Seu sawmgiat, ci-in ciamteh in,' ci hi.
A diktat lo nasempa pen ama ngiansiamna hangin a topa in a pakta hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian thu a zui mite sangin leitung mihingte pen a nasepna uhah ngiansiam zaw uh hi.
"Note kiangah kong genin-ah, hih na leitung sum uh a bei ciangin tawntung nuntakna inn-ah hong kilutsak theih nadingin lawm zonna-in hih leitung sumte na zang un.
"A tawmno-ah a diktatte pen a tamah zong diktat uh a, a tawmno-ah a citak lote pen a tamah zong citak lo uh hi.
Hih leitung sumte-ah na cihtak kei uhleh kua in no tungah vantung sum hong ap ngam ding ahi hiam?
Midangte' neihsa tungah na cihtak kei uhleh, kua in no tungah nomau gamhluah ding hong ap ngam ding ahi hiam?
"To nih' na a semkhawmzo nasem kuamah om lo hi. A to khat mudahin khat it ding a, khat beelin khat a simmawh ding hi. Pasian' na le leitung sum na na semkhawmzo kei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Sum a deih phadiak Farisi mite in hih thute a zak uh ciangin Jesuh a nuihsan uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Mite in note a man penin hong ngaihsut theih nadingin na om uh a, ahi zongin Pasian in na lungsimtawng uh a hong thei hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mihingte in a manpha mahmahin a ngaihsutte pen Pasian in bangmahin sim lo hi.
"Tuiphumpa Johan' hun ciang dong Moses Thukham le kamsangte' thugente pen zuih belin kinei a, ahi zongin Pasian' Ukna hangin Lungdamna Thu a kihilh hun a kipanin hih thu-ah mi khempeuh hong kituhteh uh hi.
Ahi zongin Thukham a neupen themno khat nangawn a maiman' ding sangin van le lei a manthan ding olzaw lai hi.
"Pasal khat in a zi ma-in numei dang a tenpih leh tua numei tawh a mawh hi a, a kima numei a tenpih pasal zong numei tawh a mawh mah ahi hi.
"Khatvei, mihau mahmah khat om a, nisimin puan manpha nono silhin, anlim nono ne-in a om hi.
Tua ciangin a pumtangin meima a vei, Lazaras a kici mizawng khat zong, mihau pa' kongbiangah hong kikoih a,
mihau pa' sabuai tung panin a kia annengte nenuamin a ngak hi. Tua bangin a om laitakin uite hong pai-in a meima hong liahliah sak uh hi.
Tua ciangin mizawng pa hong si a, vantung a Abraham kiangah a om dingin vantung mite in a paipih uh hi. Mihau pa zong hong si leuleu-in a kivui hi.
Ahi zongin hell khuk sungah gimna thuakin a om hi. A khuadak leh, gamlapi mun khatah Abraham le Lazaras a omkhawm a galmuh hi.
Tua ahih manin nakpitakin kiko a, 'Pa Abraham aw, kei hong hehpih in. Meiphual sungah omin nakpitakin gimna thuak ka hih manin Lazaras in a khutme dawn tui diahin ka leii hong votsak nadingin hong sawl in,' a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Abraham in, 'Ka ta aw, leitungah na nuntak laitakun nang nopsakna namkim na ngah laitakin Lazaras in haksatna namkim a thuak hi. Ahi zongin tu-in amah in hih lai-ah nopsakna a ngah laitakin nangmah in haksatna a thuak na hi hi.
Tua tham loin, i kikalah kuam thukpi khat om a, hih lai panin nang kiangah hong pai nuamte kuamah pai zo lo a, nangma omna panin hih lai-ah zong kuamah hong pai zo lo hi,' ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin mihau pa in, 'Pa aw, tua bang ahihleh zong, ka inn uhah Lazaras nong sawlsak nadingin ka hong thum hi.
Inn-ah nau pasal nga ka nei lai a, ke'n gim ka thuakna hih lai munah hong tunkhak loh teitei nadingun kei' gamtat bangin a gamtat loh nadingun hong hilhsak hen,' a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Abraham in, 'Na sanggamte a hilh dingin Moses le kamsangte om uh ahih manin tuate' thugen na ngai ta uh hen,' a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mihau pa in, 'Pa Abraham aw, tua nong gen zong a kicing khin hi mah hi. Ahi zongin a sisa mi khat hingkikin amaute kiangah va paikik leh a mawhna panun ka naute kisik hamtang ding uh hi,' a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Abraham in, 'Amaute in Moses le kamsangte' thu a mannop kei uhleh, mi khat hong hingkikin amaute kiangah a va gen hangin umsakzo tuan lo ding hi,' ci-in a dawng hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, "Mite a puktheih nading ze-etna hong piang hamtang ding hi. Ahi zongin tua puk nading a piangsak mipa in gimna ngah ding hi.
Hih naupangno khat a khialh nading a piansak sangin a ngawngah an gawina suang lianpi khat khihin tuipi sungah kikhia leh ama a dingin hoihzaw thampek ding hi.
Note hoihtakin kingaihsun un. Na sanggampa uh no tungah hong khialh leh amah taii unla, a kisik leh a mawhna maisak un.
Nikhat sungin sagihvei ciang dong hong khialh hangin zong, a sagihvei mahin no kiangah hong pai-in, 'Ka kisik hi,' hong cih nakleh na maisak khin ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Nikhat, sawltakte in Topa kiangah, "Ka upna uh hong liansak in," a ci uh hi.
Topa in, "Ankam tang cia a pha upna nei le-uhcin, hih nailung kung kiangah, 'Kizunglot inla tuipi sungah va po in,' ci le-uhcin na cih bangun piangzo ding hi.
"Note khatpeuh in na lo uh hong khawhsak ahi a, na tuu uh a hong cinsak ahi zongin nasem khat nei le-uhcin, inn-ah a hong tun ciangin, 'Hong pai inla na an ne pah in,' na ci uh hiam?
Na ci kei uh hi. Ama kiangah, 'Ka nitak-an ding hong bawl inla, na puan silhin ka annek sungteng hong vil in. Ka man khit ciangin na ne thei ding hi,' na cizaw uh hi.
Tua bangin a sawlteng a sepna hangin a nasempa tungah, 'Ka nuam mahmah hi,' ci tuan lo hi.
Tua mah bangin note in zong hong kisawlteng na sepkhit uh ciangin, 'Nasem mawkmawkte mah ihi a, i tavuanteng bek mah a sem khin ihi hi,' na ci uh hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Jerusalem khua manawhin Jesuh a pai laitakin Samaria le Galilee gam kikal tawnin a pai hi.
Khuaneu khatah a lut dektak laitakin miphak sawm in a dawntuah uh hi. Jesuh tawh a kigamla munah ding uh a,
nakpitakin kiko-in, "Topa Jesuh aw, kote hong hehpih in," a ci uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute a muh ciangin, "Pai unla siampite va kivelsak un," a ci hi. Amaute a va pai uh ciangin lamkalah a dam uh hi.
Amaute sung panin a damlam a kitheih ciangin khat hong lehtai kik a, nakpitakin Pasian a phat hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh' khe mai-ah bokin a lungdamna a ko hi. Hih mipa pen Samaria mi ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh hong paukhia a, "Mihing sawm kidamsak hi lo ahi hiam? Adang kuate koi lai-ah om ahi uh hiam?
Bang hangin hih gamdang mipa bek Pasian' tungah lungdamna a ko dingin hong kileh ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in ama kiangah, "Tho inla ciah in. Na upna in nang hong damsak hi," a ci hi.
Hih lai-ah om hi, hua lai-ah om hi, cih bangin kuama gentheih hi lo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note lakah Pasian' Ukna hong om khinzo hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in nungzuite kiangah, "Nikhat ni ciangin Mihing Tapa nikhat sung bek nangawn na muhnop hun uh hong tung ding a, ahi zongin na mu kei ding uh hi.
Mite in, 'Hih lai-ah om hi,' hong ci ding uh hi. Ahi zongin amau' cihna mun a en dingin paikhia kei un.
Amah hong pai taktak ciangin khuaphialep in van mong khat pan mong khat dong hong taanzaih mah bangin kitheikim ding hi.
Ahi zongin amah in gimna tampi tak thuak masa ding a, ama huna mite in amah nial ding uh hi.
Noah hunin up lohpi-in tuiciin a tun bangin Mihing Tapa zong uploh hun khatin hong tung ding hi.
Teembaw sungah Noah lutin Tuiciin in mi khempeuh a sihsak ni ciang dongin tua huna mite in anne zune-in om uh a, mo kipi mo kikha-in a om uh hi.
Lot huna mah tawh zong hong kibang ding hi. Tua hun lai-in zong anne zune-in om uh a, sumlei sumzuak, lokho, inn lamin a omom laitakun,
Sodom panin Lot a paikhiat ni-in van panin kaat leh meikuang hong kiasuk a, amaute khempeuh a kangtum hi.
Mihing Tapa hong kilat ni ciangin zong tua mah tawh hong kibang ding hi.
"Tuani a hong tun ciangin a innkhum zangah a om mipa in a innsunga a om a neihsate a la dingin kumsuk kei hen. Tua mah bangin lo-ah a om mipa zong a inn-ah ciahkik kei hen.

Jesuh in, "Kidawm unla, mi' khemsa-in ta kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah a kineih mi tampi hong pai ding uh a, 'Keimah, Khrih ka hi hi; a hun hong tungta hi,' hong ci ding uh hi. Tua bang mite' nung zuikha kei un.
Gal thu ahi a, gam kilumlet nading thu ahi zongin na zak uh ciangin lau kei un. Hih bang thute a hong piang masa ding mah hi a, ahi zongin bei nading hong naita hi, a cihnopna hi nai lo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a thugen zomlai a, "Gam khat le gam khat hong kido-in, kumpi khat le kumpi khat hong kido ding hi.
Mun khempeuhah nakpitakin zin hong lingin, kialpi le pulnatna zong hong tung ding hi. A kihtakhuai a tuamtuamte le lim lianpipi vanah hong kilang ding hi.
Ahi zongin hihte khempeuh hong pianma-in keima hangin note hong kimanin hong kibawlsia ding hi. Kikhopna innte-ah thusitna thuakin thongah khiat dingin hong ki-ap ding a, ukpite le kumpite mai-ah hong kipaipih ding hi.
Hih hun sung pen note in Lungdamna Thu na gentheih nading uh hunhoih ahi hi.
Tua hun ciangin eite in bangci gen ding cih lunghihmawhin nei kei un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh tua hun ciangin note' gen ding thu le pilna kong guan ding a, na galte uh khat beek in note' thugen hong nialzo loin, zong hong sel zo lo ding uh hi.
Na nu na pate, na sanggamte, na behte, le na lawmte mahmah un note hong khia ding a, note pawlkhat in thahna na thuak ding uh hi.
Mi khempeuh in keima hangin note hong mudah ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin na samzang khat nangawn uh mangthang lo ding hi.
Hih bangin thuakzo le-uhcin nuntakna taktak ngah ding na hih manun kiptakin om un.
"Galkapte in Jerusalem khuapi a umcihna na muh uh ciangin tua khuapi a siat nading naita hi, ci-in na thei ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Judea gam sunga omte mualtungah tai un. Jerusalem khuasunga omte zong taikhia unla, gam sung khuaneu-a om mite, Jerusalem khua sungah lut nawn kei un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin, 'Gim Piak Ni,' ahi hi.
Tua huna naupaiite le naungek neite a dingin haksa mahmah ding hi. Hih leitungah gimna lianpi hong tung ding a, Pasian in hih mite gim a pia ding hi.
Mi pawlkhat, namsau tawh kithat ding a, pawlkhat, galmatin gam dangah kiciahpih ding hi. Tua ciangin Gentail mite' uk hun a bei matengin Jerusalem khuapi a siacipin om ding hi.
"Ni, kha, le aksite tungah lim hong om ding hi. Tuipi ging le tuihual liante kihtakna hangin leitung mi khempeuh lau-in lunggim ding uh hi.
Leitungah tu-in bang hong piang ding, ci-in a ngaihsut kawmun mite lau-in sibup ding uh hi. Vantunga om nate a pai ngei bangin pai nawn loin lampial mangkhin ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Mihing Tapa hong kilang ding a, minthanna le vangliatna tawh meii lakah hong pai ding hi.
Hih thute a pian ding hong kipat ciangin, note hong kihotkhiat ding hun hong naita ahih manin, dingin nuamna lungsim tawh khuadak un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah thugentehna khat gen a, "Thei kung a kipan singkung khempeuh en dih un.
A teh hong no na muh uh ciangin khuakhal hong naita hi, ci-in na thei uh hi.
Tua mah bangin hih thute hong piang na muh uh ciangin Pasian' Ukna hun hong tungta ding hi, ci-in na thei ding uh hi.
Hih lai-a om mite a sihkhit ma-in hih thute hong piang ding ahihna phawk un.
Van le lei a mangthang zongin ka thugente maimang ngei lo ding hi.

Hih thupiang khempeuh thuakzawh nading thahatna na neih nading uh, le Mihing Tapa mai-ah na dintheih nadingun a tawntungin thu ngenin vil niloh un," a ci hi.

Amaute na nuam mahmah uh a, sum tawh guaih dingin thuciam a na pia uh hi.

Tua ciangin Jesuh' luang la suk a, puankang tawh a tun khit ciangin kuamah a kivui ngei nai lohna suang kikhuak hankhuk sungah a vui hi.

Galilee gam panin a hong zui numeite in zong a kivuina-ah zui uh ahih manin a hanphual le a luang kisialzia khempeuh zong a mu uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute ciah uh a, Jesuh' luang a nuh dingun paknamtui le sathau a bawlkhol uh hi. Thukham zui-in Sabbath ni tawlnga-in a om uh hi.
Nipi ni zingsang tungin numeite in a bawlsa uh paknamtui tawi-in hanah va pai uh hi.
Han phual a tun uh ciangin hankhuk hukna suang a kilikkhia mu uh ahih manin
a sungah tumpah uh a, ahi zongin Topa Jesuh' luang na om lo hi.
Amaute in lamdangsa-in a om laitakun amaute gei-ah puanpak a silh mi nih hong dingvat uh hi.
Numeite lau mahmah uh ahih manin lei lam nga-in kuncip uh hi. Tua mi nihte in, "Bang hangin misite lakah mihing zong na hi uh hiam?
Hih lai-ah om nawn lo hi; kithosak zo hi. Galilee gamah a om lai-in note kiangah thu hong genin,
'Mawhnei mite' khut sungah Mihing Tapa kipia ding a, singlamteh tungah kithatin, a ni thum ni-in hingkik ding hi,' a cih thute phawk un," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Jesuh' thugente phawkkik uh a,
han panin ciahkikin, nungzui sawm le khatte le midangte kiangah hih thute a gen uh hi.
Sawltakte kiangah hih thu a gen numeite pen Magdala khuami Mary, Joanna, James' nu Mary, le numei dangte ahi uh hi.
Ahi zongin hih numeite' thugen pen thu phuahtawm bangin ngaihsun uh a, um lo uh hi.
Ahi zongin Peter dingin hanah va tai a, han sung a etsuk ciangin a kitunna puan bek na om hi. Tua ciangin amah in zong tua thupiang lamdangsa-in inn-ah a ciahkik hi.
Tua ni mahin, Jesuh' thu a zui mi nih, Jerusalem khua panin tai sagih bang a gamla Emmaus kici khua-ah a pai uh hi.
A paikawmun hih thupiangte kikumkum uh hi.
Tua bangin kiho-in thu kikumin a om laitakun Jesuh mahmah in hong naihin amaute tawh hong tonkhawm hi.
Amau tegel in a muh hangun Jesuh ahihlam thei lo uh hi.
Jesuh in, "Na lam paikawmun bang gengen na hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong hi. Amau tegel zong dinkhawl pah uh a, a maisuah uh dahmai mahmah lai hi.
Tua ciangin amau tegel sung panin Kleopas a kici pa in, "Jerusalem-a hawhte lakah tusawng tenga tua lai-a thupiang a thei lo nang bek na hi ding hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Bang thu ahi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin amaute in, "Nazareth khuami Jesuh tunga thupiang ahi hi. Amah pen kamsang khat hi a, Pasian le mite khempeuh in a thugen le a nasepna-ah vang a nei mahmah khatin a ngaihsut uh ahi hi.
Ahi zongin ka siampi liante uh le ka uliante un sihna thukhenna a thuak dingin Pilat tungah ap uh a, singlamteh tungah kithat hi.
Amah pen Israel mite a honkhia ding pa hi, ci-in ka lamet uh ahi hi. Tua bang hinapi-in hih thuteng hong piang a, tu-in a thu pianzawh a ni thumna hita hi.
Ko pawlte' sung panin numei pawlkhat in lamdang ka sak uh thu hong gen uh hi. Amaute, tu zingsang tungin hanah va pai uh a,
ahi zongin ama luang na om nawn lo hi. Tua ciangin amaute hong ciahkik uh a, vantung mite a muhna uh le tua vantung mite in Jesuh a hinkik khitna thu a gennate uh hong gensawn uh hi.
Tua ciangin ka lawmte uh pawlkhat zong hanah va pai uh a, numeite' gen bang teekteekin va mu uh a, ahi zongin Jesuh mu lo uh hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amau tegel kiangah, "Bangzah takin hai a, bang dingin kamsangte' thugen um thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Khrih in minthanna a ngah nadingin hih bangteng a thuak ding kisam hi lo ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in Lai Siangtho sungah ama thu a kigennate khempeuh, Moses laibu a kipanin kamsangte' laibu khempeuh a khiatna a gen hi.
Tua khua a tun uh ciangin Jesuh a paisuak ding bangin hong om a,
ahi zongin amau tegel in kho-in, "Tu-in nitak lam hita a, ni tum dektak ahih manin ko tawh hong tamkhawm in," a ci uh hi. Tua ahih manin Jesuh zong amaute tawh a tam hi.
Amaute tawh an ne dingin a tut ciangin Jesuh in anlum la a, Pasian tungah lungdamna a kohkhit ciangin balnenin amaute a pia hi.
Tua laitakin a haktawm bangin Jesuh ahih lamtak mu-in thei uh a, ahi zongin amau' muhna panin Jesuh a mangpah hi.

"Topa hingkik khin takpi hi. Simon kiangah na kilak khinzo hi," ci-in a kigengen laitak uh a tuak uh hi.

Ahi zongin amaute lau-in linglawng gawp uh a, sikha a mu hi ni, ci-in a ngaihsun uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Bang hangin lungmang a, bang hangin lungka na hi uh hiam?
Ka khut le ka khete en un; kei mahmah ka hi hi. Hong lawng unla hong thei un. Tu-a keima neih bangin sikha in pum le tak nei ahi hiam?" a cih khit ciangin
a khut le a khete a lak hi.

Jesuh in saangin amaute' muhin a ne hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Tu-a thupiang khempeuh pen note tawh kong omkhawm lai-a ka gengen thute mah ahi hi. Moses Thukham laibu sung, kamsangte laibu sung le Late sungah a kigelh thu khempeuh a tung ding ahi hi," a ci hi.

amaute kiangah, "Khrih in sihna thuakin, a ni thum ni-in sihna panin hingkik ding a,
Jerusalem khua a kipan minam khempeuh tungah a mawhna uh kisikin a kimaisak nading thu, ama min tawh kihilh ding hi, ci-in kigelh hi.
Note pen hih thu khempeuh a thei teci na hi uh hi.
Ka Pa' hong ciamsa thu, note tungah ka hong pia ding hi. Ahi zongin vantung panin tua vangliatna na ngah mateng uh hih Jerusalem khuapi-ah na ngak un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jerusalem khuasung panin Bethany khuagei ciang amaute paipih a, tua lai panin a khut laamto-in amaute thupha a pia hi.
Amaute thupha a piak laitakin amaute kiang panin paikhia-in vantungah amah a kilato hi.
Amaute in amah bia uh a, lungdam mahmahin Jerusalem khua-ah a ciahkik uh hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian tungah lungdamna a ko dingin biakinn-ah a pai tawntung uh hi.
A kipat cil-in Thu na om a, tua Thu, Pasian tawh na omkhawm a, tua Thu, Pasian ahi hi.
Tua hi a, a kipat cil a kipanin Thu le Pasian na omkhawm hi.
Pasian in Thu tawh na khempeuh piangsak a, a kipiangsak na khempeuh, Thu tawh loin a kipiangsak khat beek om lo hi.
Nuntakna a nei khempeuh in tua Thu tung panin a nuntakna uh ngah a, tua nuntakna in mi khempeuh tungah khuavak hong tunpih hi.
Tua khuavak pen khuamial lakah taang a, khuamial in tua khuavak a zo kei hi.
Pasian in Johan kici mi khat kamtai dingin hong paisak a,
mi khempeuh in ama thugenna za-in tua khuavak a uptheih nadingun tua khuavak thu a gen dingin a hong pai ahi hi.
Tua Johan mahmah pen khuavak hi lo a, khuavak thu a gen dingin a hong pai ahi hi.
Ama gen khuavak taktak pen zong leitungah hong tung khin a, mi khempeuh a taan khin hi.
Amah, leitungah om a, amah tawh leitung a kibawl hinapi-in leitung mite in amah na thei kha lo uh hi.
A khua le a tui-ah va pai a, ahi zongin a khuapih a tuipihte in ama thugen na ngai lo uh hi.
Tua bang hitaseleh ama thu ngai-in amah a um mite khempeuh tungah Pasian' tate suahtheih nading thu a pia hi.
Tua bangin Pasian' tate suahna pen leitung ngeina nute pate sung panin suahna tawh hi loin Pasian sung panin suahna ahi hi.
Tua Thu mihing hong suakin kote lakah hong om a, itna nei-in citak mahmah ahih manin Pasian' pianzia a neihna ka mu cian uh hi. Hih pianzia pen Pasian' Tapa khat bek hihna tawh a neih pianzia ahi hi.
Johan in ama thu gen a, "Keima nungah hong pai hinapi-in keima suah ma-in amah omkhin ahih manin kei sangin amah lianzaw hi," ci-in ka gen pa pen hih pa ahi hi, ci-in a kiko hi.
A kicing ama hong itna hangin eite khempeuh tungah thupha a banbanin hong pia hi.
Pasian in Moses tungtawnin Thukham hong pia a, ahi zongin Jesuh Khrih hangin itna le cihtakna thu hong pai hi.

Tua ciangin amaute in, "Tua ahihleh kua na hi hiam? Elijah na hi hiam?" a cih uh ciangin, "Ka hi kei hi," na ci hi. Kamsangpa na hi hiam, ci-in a dot uh ciangin, ka hi kei hi, a na ci leuleu hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Tua ahihleh kua na hi hiam? Kote hong sawlte kiangah ka gen ding uh thu hong gen in. Nang, kua kici na hi hiam?" ci-in a dot uh ciangin
Johan in, "Kamsang Isaiah in a na gen mah bangin, 'Topa' tot ding lampi na tangsak un,' ci-in gam sungah a kikopa ka hi hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Hih thu a dong mite pen Farisi mite in a sawl uh ahi hi.

Keima khit ciangin note lakah amah in nasep hong kipan ahih hangin, kei pen ama khedap khau a sutsak ding nangawnin ka kilawmzo nai kei hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Hih bang thu kidotna a pianna mun pen Johan in mite tui phumin a omna, Jordan Gun nisuahna lam gal-a om Bethany khua ahi hi.

Amah a bangci mi hi ding cih thei lo napi-in, Israel mite in amah a theih nadingun tui sungah mite a phum dingin a hong pai ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Johan in hih mipa thu teci na pang a, "Vantung panin vakhu bangin Kha hong paisukin ama tungah a om ka mu hi.

Tua ahih manin hih mipa pen Pasian' Tapa hi, ci-in thei ka hih manin teci ka pang hi," a ci hi.

Jesuh in, "Hong pai unla, ka omna mun hong mu un," a na ci hi. Amau tegel in zong Jesuh va zui uh a, a omna mun a va mu uh hi. Tua hun pen nitak nai li hun pawl ahih manin ama kiangah a giak uh hi.

A zing ciangin Jesuh in Galilee gamah pai ding ngaihsun hi. Filip tawh kituak a, ama kiangah, "Hong zui in," a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Ke'n a mantak kong genin-ah, vantung a kihong na mu ding uh a, Mihing Tapa le vantung kikalah Pasian' vantung mite a kumsuk a kahto na mu ding uh hi," a ci hi.

Jesuh le a nungzuite zong tua pawi-ah a kisam hi.

Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Nu aw, bang hangin na lunghihmawhna hong ko zenzen na hi hiam? Keima hun tung nai lo hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh' nu in nasemte kiangah, "Ama hong gen bangbangin gamta un," a ci hi.
Jew mite in amau biakna ngeina-ah kisilsiang nading ngeina nei uh ahih manin tua lai-ah tui tambong guk tambong sagih bang a ta thei thambelpi guk a om hi.
Jesuh in nasemte kiangah, "Tua thambelpite sungah tui a dimin koih un," ci-in a sawl mah bangin a dim sitsetin tui a koih uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Tu-in tui pawlkhat suak unla, zuphung pa kiangah va paipih un," a ci hi. Amaute in zong tua mah bangin a va paipih uh hi.
Zuphung pa in leenggahzu a suak tui a ciap ciangin, (tui a sung nasemte in a theih hangin) koi panin kingah ahi hiam, ci-in thei lo ahih manin zinei tangvalpa samin,
"Midangte in leenggahzu khumte hawm masakin nei uh a, mite in a khamgawp khit uh ciangin a ngeinate hawm pan uh hi. Ahi zongin nangmah in a khum pen teng tu dong na sitlai hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in nalamdang a bawl masak pen Galilee gam Kana khua-ah hih bangin Pasian' pianzia a neihna kilangsak a, a nungzuite in zong amah a um uh hi.

Amah in zong khauteep bawlin biakinn huangsung panin tuu le bawng a kipan ganhing khempeuh hawlkhia a, sumkhekte' sabuai zong sawnpaih sakin a sum khempeuh a thehthang sak hi.
Tua ciangin kawl vakhu zuakte kiangah, "Na kawl vakhute uh hih lai panin paikhiatpih un. Ka Pa' inn pen sumzuakna inn phualpi-in nei kei un," a ci hi.
Hih bangin a gamtatna hangin, "Nangma inn ka deihluatna in ka lungsim hong uklah sak hi," ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelhna thu, a nungzuite in a phawk uh hi.

Ahi zongin Jesuh in biakinn a cih ciangin ama pumpi a cihna ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin sihna panin amah a kithawhkiksak ciangin a nungzuite in Jesuh' thugen phawkkik uh a, Lai Siangtho le Jesuh' thugente a um uh hi.

Amah in mite' lungsimtawng dong thei ahih manin mite a bangci mi ahi hiam cih thu midangte in ama kiangah a gen ding kisam lo hi.

Khatvei zan khuamial laitakin Jesuh kiangah va pai a, "Sia aw, mi khat peuhpeuh Pasian in ompih lo hileh hih na lamdangte kuamah in bawl thei lo ding ahih manin nang pen Pasian' hong sawl siapa na hihna ka hong thei uh hi," a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Nikodemas in, "Mi khat a teek khit ciangin bangci suahkik thei ding ahi hiam? A nu' sungah lutkikin suakkik thei ding ahi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin
Jesuh in, "A mantakin kong genin-ah, mi khatpeuh tui le Kha Siangtho tawh a suahkik kei leh Pasian' Ukna sungah lut thei lo ding hi.
Mihing sung panin a suakte mihing mah hi bek a, Kha tawh a suakte pen kha mi ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin, 'Na suahkik ding ahi hi,' ka hong cihna hangin lamdangsa kei in.
Huih zong a utna peuhpeuhah nung a, a huging na zaktheih hangin koi lam panin hong nung a, koi lamah nung ahi hiam, cih na mu thei kei hi. Kha tawh a suak mite zong tua mah bang ahi hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Nikodemas in, "Hih thu bangci piantheih mawk ding ahi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin
Jesuh in, "Israel mite' sia hinapi-in hih thu theithei lo na hi hiam?
A mantakin kong genin-ah, kote in ka theihsa uh thu bek genin, ka muhsa uh thu bek teci a pang ka hi uh a, ahi zongin note kuamah in ka thugente uh nong um nuam kei uh hi.
Hih leitung thute tawh a kisai thu kong gen ciangin um lo na hih uhleh vantung thute ka hong gen ciangin bangci up mah ding na hi uh hiam?
Vantung panin a hong paisuk Mihing Tapa keimah simloh vantungah a paito ding kuamah om lo hi," a ci hi.
Moses in gamlak khuam tungah sumngo gul a khai mah bangin Mihing Tapa zong hong kikhai ding a,
amah a um mi khempeuh nungta tawntung ding hi.
Pasian in leitung mite hong it mahmah ahih manin ama Tapa a um mi khempeuh si nawn loin a hin tawntung theih nadingun a Tapa neihsun a hong piak dongin a hong itna a hong lak hi.
Pasian in leitungah a Tapa hong sawlna pen mawhsakna thukhen dingin a hong paisak hi loin, leitung mite a honkhia dingin a hong paisak hizaw hi.
Amah a um mite in mawhsak thukhenna thuak lo ding uh hi. Amah a um lote pen Pasian' Tapa neihsun um lo uh ahih manin mawhsak thukhenna a thuak khinta uh ahi hi.
Tua bangin mawhsak thukhenna a thuakna uh a hang in: Leitungah khuavak hong tungkhin napi-in a gamtatna uh hoih lo ahih manin leitung mite in khuavak sangin khuamial deihzaw uh hi.
A gamtat hoih lo mite in a siatna uh a kilatkhak ding ut lo uh ahih manin khuavak deih lo uh a, khuavakah pai nuam lo uh hi.
Ahi zongin thumanin a gamta mite ahihleh a gamtatnate uh Pasian' deihna tawh kituak hi, ci-in a kilatsak theih nadingun khuavak sungah a pai uh hi.
Hih thute khit ciangin Jesuh le a nungzuite Judea gamah pai uh a, tua gamah a nungzuite tawh omin mite tui a phum hi.
Tuiphumpa Johan zong thong kia nai lo hi. Tua hi a, tui tampi omna Salim khua kiang Ainon kici munah Johan in mite tuiphum a, ama kiangah mite hong pai-in tui a kiphum uh hi.
Tua laitakin biakna vai-in kisian' suahna tawh kizomin Johan' nungzuite le Jew mi pawlkhat thu kiseel uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Johan nungzuite a kiangah hong pai uh a, "Sia aw, Jordan Gun galkhatah na om khawmpih ngei pa, ama thu na genna na phawk lai hiam? Tu-in amah in mi tuiphumphum a, mi khempeuh in amah zuan uh hi," ci-in a gen uhleh
Johan in, "Pasian in hih theih nading thu pia kei leh kuamah in bangmah hih thei lo hi.
Kei pen Khrih ka hi kei a, ama mai-ah a hong kisawlpa ka hi lel hi, ci-in ka genna thu note mahmah in na zaksa uh ahi hi.
Mo pen zinei ding tangvalpa a' ding bek ahi hi. Zineipa kiangah a ding a lawmpa in ama kampau ding bek ngai a, ama awging a zak ciangin nuam mahmah hi. Tua mah bangin tu-in ama hangin ka nuam a, keima lungdamna kicingta hi.
Amah lian semsem ding a, kei ka hih leh ka neu semsem ding hi.
"Vantung pan hong pai pa pen adang khempeuh sangin lianzaw hi. Leitung panin a piang mi pen leitung mi hi a, leitung thute bek mah a gen hi. Tua ahih manin vantung panin a hong pai pa ahihleh adang khempeuh sangin a lianzaw ahi hi.
Amah in a muhsa leh a zaksa thu a gen hinapi-in kuamah in ama thugen um lo uh hi.
Ama thugen a umte pen, Pasian' thugen man hi, ci-in a um ahi uh hi.
Pasian in a sawl mipa tungah ama Kha a kicingin pia ahih manin a sawl mipa in Pasian' thugente mah a gen ahi hi.
Pa in Tapa it ahih manin ama khut sungah na khempeuh a pia hi.
Tua ahih manin Tapa a um mi peuhmah nungta tawntung ding a, Tapa' thu a mang lote in nuntak mu lo ding a, amaute tungah Pasian heh tawntung ding hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in Johan sangin mi tam ngahzaw in a tuiphumna thu Farisi mite in a za uh hi.
(A taktakin Jesuh mahmah in tui phum loin a nungzuite bek in a phum ahi hi.)
Jesuh in tua thu a phawk ciangin Judea gam panin paikhia-in Galilee gamah a paikik hi.
Tua a paina-ah Samaria gam a nawk ding kisam hi.
Tua bangin a nawk ciangin Samaria gam sungah Saikhar a kici khua khat a tung hi. Tua khua gei-ah Jakob in a tapa Josef a piak lo khat om hi.
Tua lo sungah tuikhuk khat om a, a khualzinna-in Jesuh gim ahih manin a tuikhuk gei-ah a tu hi. Tua hun pen sunkim laitak ahi hi.
Tua laitakin Samaria numei khat tuitawi dingin tuikhukah a hong pai hi. Jesuh in tua numei kiangah, "Na tui hong dawnsak in," a ci hi.
Tua laitakin khua sungah an lei dingin Jesuh nungzuite paikhia khin uh hi.
Jew mite in buah tang uh a, Samaria mite' na zatte zanglo uh ahih manin, Samaria numei in Jesuh kiangah, "Bang hangin nang Jew mi in kei Samaria numei kiangah tui hong ngen na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Jesuh in, "Pasian' hong piaktheih dingte le tuidawn ding hong ngen pa theitel hi lecin, ama kiang pan tui a ngen ding na hizaw a, amah in nuntakna tui nang hong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin numei in, "Sia aw, tuikhuk thuk mahmah a, ahi zongin tui khai nading bangmah na nei kei hi. Koi panin tua nuntakna tui ngah thei ding na hi hiam?
Tua tham loin, i pupi Jakob sangin lianzaw ding na hi hiam? Amah a kipan a tate le a ganhingte in a nek hih tui sangin a limcizaw koi-ah ngah ding na hi hiam?" a cih ciangin
Jesuh in, "Hih tui a dawn khempeuh dangtak kik ding uh a,
ahi zongin keima piak ding tui a dawn khempeuh dangtak kik nawn lo ding uh hi. Tua ka piak tui a dawnte sungah nuntakna tuinak piang ding a, a nungtasak paisuak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin numei in, "Sia aw, tua bang ahihleh ka dang a tak nawn loh nading le hih lai-ah tuitawi-in ka pai nawn loh nadingin kei zong tua tui hong pia in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Va ciahin na pasal va sam inla, hih lai-ah hong paikik un," a ci hi.
Numei in, "Pasal ka nei kei hi," a cih ciangin Jesuh in, " 'Pasal ka nei kei hi,' na cih pen man mahmah hi.
Pasal nga na nei khin ngei a, tu-a na ompih zong na pasal hi lo hi. Tua ahih manin na thugen man mahmah hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin numei in, "Sia aw, nang pen kamsang khat na hihna thu ka hong thei hi.
Ko Samaria mite' pupite in hih lai mualtungah Pasian bia uh a, ahi zongin no Jew mite in Pasian biakna mun pen Jerusalem khua ahi hi, na ci uh hi," a cih ciangin
Jesuh in, "Lawm aw, hih ka thugen ding hong um in: Mite in hih mualtung hitaleh Jerusalem hitaleh ah Pa Pasian a biak nawn loh hun hong tung ding hi.
No Samaria mite in na theih taktak lohpi uh na bia uh a, ahi zongin ko Jew mite tungtawnin hotkhiatna thu hong pai ahih manin kote in ka theih uh a bia ka hi uh hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian a bia taktakte in Pasian' Kha' lamlahna le thuman tak tawh a biak hun hong tung ding a, tu-in zong a hong tung khinta ahi hi. Pa Pasian in tu-a bangin amah i biak ding a hong deih ahi hi.
Pasian pen Kha ahi hi; amah a biate in tua Kha' lamlahna le thuman taktak tawh a bia ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin numei in, "Khrih a kici Messiah hong pai nading thu ka thei hi. Amah hong pai ciangin thu khempeuh hong gen ding hi," a cih ciangin
Jesuh in, "Tu-a nang tawh a kiho keimah pen tua na gen pa ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua laitakin Jesuh nungzuite hong tung uh a, ahi zongin kuamah in, "Numei aw, bang deih na hi hiam?" cihna ahi a, "Bang hangin tua numei tawh kiho na hi hiam?" cihna ahi zongin dong ngam lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin numei in a tuibeel nusia-in khua sungah ciah a, a khuapih mite kiangah,
"Hong pai un. Ka gamtatnasa a hong thei pa va en ni. Amah Khrih hi kha ding hi," a va ci hi.
Tua ahih manin a khuapihte zong Jesuh kiangah a va pai uh hi.
Mite a hong tunma hunsung tengin a nungzuite in, "Sia aw, an ne in," ci-in a kun uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in, "Note in na theih loh uh nek ding an ka nei hi," a na ci hi.
Tua ahih manin a nungzuite khatlekhat kiho-in, "Mi khatpeuh in an na puak khin hi ding ahi hiam?" a kici uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Keimah hong sawl pa' deihna bangin na semin, sep dingin hong piak nasep zawhna pen ka nuntakna an ahi hi.
Note in na paunak uhah, 'Khai tuh khit kha li ciangin anlak hun hi,' na ci uh hi. Tu-in note khuadakin lote en un. An khempeuh min khinta a, lak ding bek in sam hi.
Khaituh pa le anla pa a lungdam khawm theih nadingin anla pa thaman a kipiak mah bangin anla pa in zong a nungta tawntung dingin mi a khawm ding hi.
Tua ahih manin, 'Khat in khai tuhin, adang khat in a an la,' ci-in paunak a om pen thuman mahmah hi.
Tua ahih manin note in na khawh loh uh lo-ah an a la dingin ka hong sawl hi. Midang in tua lo na kho a, note in a lak bek a si na hi uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua numei in, "Ka gamtatnasate khempeuh hong thei hi," ci-in a thugenna hangin tua khuasunga om Samaria mi tampi tak in Jesuh a um uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Jesuh kiangah Samaria mite a va tun uh ciangin amaute' khua-ah a taam nadingin kun uh a, Jesuh zong tua khua-ah ni nih a taam hi.
Tua ahih manin tua numei' thugenna hangin Jesuh a um mi tampi tak kibehlap hi.
Tua thu um mite in tua numei kiangah, "Nangma thugenna hangin a um ka hi nawn kei uh a, komau mahmah in a thugen za-in, leitung mite a Honkhia ding pa taktak hi, ci-in thei ka hih manun a um ka hi uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua lai-ah ni nih a taam khit ciangin Galilee gamah a pai hi.
Jesuh mahmah in zong, "Kamsang a kuamah peuh ama gamah kipakta ngei lo hi," ci-in a gen ngei hinapi-in,
Paisan Pawi hun laitakin Jerusalem-ah Galilee mite va pai-in, tua pawi sungah Jesuh' septe khempeuh mu khin uh ahih manin, Jesuh a tun ciangin Galilee mite in na limbawl mahmah uh hi.
Tui, leenggahzu a suahsakna Galilee gam Kana khua-ah Jesuh paikik hi. Tua laitakin Kapernaum khua-ah kumpi nasem ulian khat om a, a tapa a ci a na hi.
A tapa gim mahmahin si dektak ahih manin, Judea gam panin Galilee gamah Jesuh hong paina thu a zak ciangin ama kiangah va pai a, Kapernaum khua-ah Jesuh hong pai-in a tapa a damsak nadingin a va thum hi.
Jesuh in ama kiangah, "Note in lim le nalamdang lian ka bawl na muh kei uhleh Topa ka hihna thu na hong um kei ding uh hi," a cih ciangin
ulianpa in, "Sia aw, ka ta a sih ma-in hong pai ta peuh in," ci-in a thum hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Va ciah in. Na tapa nungta ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ulianpa in Jesuh' thugen um ahih manin a ciah hi.
Lampi-ah a nasemte in na dawntuah uh a, "Na tapa nungta ding hi," ci-in na ko uh hi.
Amah in, "Bang hunin a noptuam hong kipan ahi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin amaute in, "Zan sun nai khat pawlin a cisa hong kiamvat hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Jesuh in, "Na tapa nungta ding hi," a cih hun tawh a kituak lian ahihna thu a pa in thei a, amah a kipan a innkuanpihte khempeuh in Jesuh a um uh hi.
Hih nalamdang pen Judea gam panin Galilee gamah hong pai khit a kipanin Jesuh in nalamdang a bawl a nihna ahi hi.
Tua khit ciangin, Jerusalem khua-ah Jew mite biakna pawi kibawl ahih manin Jesuh zong a pai hi.
Jerusalem khuasung Tuu Kongpi a kici gei-ah Hebru pau-in Bethzatha a kici bual khat om a, tua bual kimkotah talap nga a om hi.
Hih talapte sungah a mittaw, a khebai, khutlekhezaw, cina tampi lum phengphang uh hi. (Amaute in tua bualtui a kilawh ding ngakin a om uh ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa' vantungmi khat in tua bual tui lok thei zel a, tui a kilawh khit ciangin tua lai a tung masa penpen ama natna panin a dam hi.)
Tua talapte sung khatah kum sawmthum le kum giat sung a cina khin mi khat a om hi.
Jesuh in tua cina pa mu a, tua munah sauveipi a lupkhitna a theih ciangin ama kiangah, "Na dam nuam hiam?" ci-in a dot leh
cina pa in, "Sia aw, bualtui a kilawh ciangin kei hong pua ding kuamah om lo ahih manin, kei ka tun ma-in midang khat a bual sung na tungkhin pahpah hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Tho inla, na lupna pheek pua-in pai in," a cih ciangin,
tua cina pa thakhatin dampah a, a lupna pheek la-in a paipah hi. Tua ni pen Sabbath ni hi citciat ahih manin,
Jerusalem khuasunga om Jew mi uliante in cina damkik pa kiangah, "Tuni pen Sabbath ni ahih manin lupna pheek na puak ding ngeina hi lo hi," a cih uh ciangin
amah in, "Kei hong damsak pa in, 'Na lupna pheek la inla pai in,' hong ci hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "'Na lupna pheek la inla pai in,' hong ci kua ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Ahi zongin tua munah mi tampi om a, Jesuh paikhia ziau ahih manin cina damkik pa in amah a damsak kua ahi hiam, cih a thei kei hi.
Tua khit ciangin Jesuh in biakinn sungah tua cina dam pa mukik a, ama kiangah, "Tu-in na dam khinta hi. Mawhna bawl nawn kei in. Tua hikeileh a siazaw khat na thuak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah zong pusuak a, Jerusalem khua-a Jew mi uliante kiangah, "Keimah hong damsak pa pen Jesuh ahi hi," ci-in a va ko hi.
Tua ahih manin Jesuh in Sabbath ni-in cina a damsakna hangin amaute in Jesuh bawlsiat ding a kipan uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Ka Pa in tuni dongin na sem tawntung ahih manin kei zong ka sep ding mah ahi hi," a ci hi.
Hih bangin ama kampauna hangin amaute in Jesuh thatnuam semsem uh hi. Amah in Sabbath thukham a palsat bek hi loin, Pasian nangawn ka Pa ci ahih manin Pasian tawh a kikimin kiseh hi, ci-in a mawhsak uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "A mantakin gen lehang: Tapa in ama thu bek tawh bangmah sem lo a, a Pa in a sep a muhteng bek a sem ahi hi. Tua hi a, a Pa in a septeng mah a Tapa in zong a sem ahi hi.
Pa in a Tapa itin, ama septeng mah lak a, mailam hunah zong hih sangin a lianzaw a sep ding lak lai ding ahih manin lamdang na sa mahmah ding uh hi.
Pa in mi sisate nangawn thosakin a nuntaksak mah bangin Tapa in zong a ut peuhpeuh nungtasak thei hi.
Pa in kuama tungah thukhen nasep sem lo hi. Mi khempeuh in Pa a zahtak mah bangin Tapa a zahtak theih nadingun Pa in thukhen nasep khempeuh a Tapa tungah a pia hi. Tua ahih manin Tapa a zahtak lo mi khempeuh pen Tapa a sawl Pa Pasian zong a zahtak lo ahi uh hi.
"A mantakin kong genin-ah: Ka thugennate za-in kei hong sawl pa a um khempeuh a nungta paisuak ding hita hi. Mawhsak thukhenna ngah nawn loin, sihna panin a hingkik ta ahi hi.
A taktakin ci lehang: A si mite in Pasian' Tapa' aw a zak hun uh hong tung ding hi bek loin tu-in a hun hong tungkhin hita a, ama aw a za mi khempeuh nungta ding uh hi.
Pa in nuntakna a piaktheih mah bangin Tapa in zong a piaktheih nadingin Pa in a bawl hi.
Amah pen Mihing Tapa ahih manin thu khentheih nading aana ama tungah a pia hi.
Hih thu ka hong gen ciangin lamdangsa kei un. Han sungah a om misi khempeuh in ama aw za-in,
han sung panin a hong paikhiat uh hun hong tung ding hi. A gamtat hoih mite pen a nungta tawntung dingin hong thokik ding uh a, a gamtat siate ahihleh mawhsak thukhenna a thuak dingin hong thokik ding uh hi.
"Keima thu guak tawh ka hihtheih bangmah om lo hi. Pasian' hong genna bang bekin thu ka khen hi. Keima ut bangin sem loin kei hong sawl pa' deih bangin sem ka hih manin ka thukhenna thuman hi.
"Keima thu tawh kisai-ah kei mahmah in teci pang leng kuamah in a thumanin sang thei lo ding hi.
Tua ahih manin keima a' ding teci a pang ding mi khat om a, keima thu genin teci a panna thuman hi, ci-in ka thei hi.
Note in Johan kiangah thu a dong dingin mi na sawl uh a, amah in note kiangah a thuman hong genzo hi.
Keimah in mihingte' teci panna a kisam ka hi kei a, note in hotkhiatna na ngahtheih nadingun note a' ding ngaihsutna tawh hih thuteng a hong gen ka hizaw hi.
Johan pen meivak bangin kuangin a taang hi a, ama khuavak sungah tawlkhat nuamsa-in om ding na ut uh hi.
Ahi zongin Johan' teci panna sangin a lianzaw teci khat ka nei a, tua in: Ka Pa in sep dingin a hong piak tu-a ka sep thute in kei a dingin teci a pang hi a, Pa in kei a hong sawl taktak ahihna hong kilangsak hi.
Tua ban panin kei a hong sawl Pasian in zong keima a dingin teci a pang hi. Note in Pasian' sawl pa' thu um lo na hih manun Pasian' aw lah za ngei lo, a maitang lah mu ngei lo, na lungsim uhah zong ama thu a ciing lo na hi uh hi.
Nuntak tawntung ngahtheih nading lametna tawh Lai Siangtho sung na lim sim mahmah uh a, tua na sim uh Lai Siangtho in keima thu mah genin teci pang napi-in,
na nuntak theih nadingun kei kiangah nong painuam kei veve uh hi.
"Hih bangin kong gen ciangin mihingte in hong pahtak ding ka deihna hi lo a,
note' lungsim sungah Pasian itna na neih hetlohna uh ka theihna hang hizaw hi.
Ka Pa' thu tawh kei hong pai napi-in na hong sangnuam kei uh hi. Tua hinapi-in midang khatpeuh ama thu tawh hong paitawm leh na sang ding uh hi.
Pasian' pahtak theih nading hanciam nuam loin, note khatlekhat na kiphat theih nading uh a hanciam mite' thugen, a bang hangin um zawsop na hi uh hiam?
Hih bangin ka hong gen ciangin ka Pa kiangah note a hong mawhsak ding pa hi, ci-in hong ngaihsun kei unla, note in suan belin na neih uh Moses pen a hong mawhsak ding pa ahih zawkna thu thei ta un.
Moses in keima thu gen belin nei ahih manin Moses um taktak hi le-uhcin kei zong na hong um ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin Moses' laigelh thute um lo na hih manun kei hong bangci uptheih mah ding na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin Tiberias zong a kici Galilee Tuili galkhat lamah Jesuh a pai hi.
Jesuh in cinate damsakin nalamdang lianpipi a bawlte mi tampi in mukhin uh ahih manin mi tampi tak in Jesuh nung a zui uh hi.
Jesuh zong a mualtung lamah kahto-in a nungzuite tawh a tukhawm hi.
Jew mite' Paisan Pawi hun nai mahmah ta hi.
Jesuh khuadak a, ama lamah mihonpi hong pai muaimuai a muh ciangin Filip kiangah, "Hih mihonpite' nek ding an koici ngahtheih ding ihi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
(Jesuh in a hih ding thei napi-in Filip a ze-etna-in hih bangin a dong lel ahi hi.)
Filip in, "Ngun peek zanih tawh an i lei hangin tawmno bekin cing pan ding uh hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua laitakin a nungzuite sung panin Simon Peter' nau Andru in Jesuh kiangah,
"Hih lai-ah mangbuhham kibawl anlum nga le ngasa tawn nih sun-an a pua tangval khat om sam hi; tuate lah mihing hi zah lakah cihtaak ding ahi hiam?" ci hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in a nungzuite kiangah, "Mihonte tusak un," a ci hi. (Tua lai-ah lopa tampi om hi.) Tua ahih manin mihonte tu uh a, pasal tulnga bang pha uh hi.
Jesuh in anlum la-in Pasian tungah lungdamna a kohkhit ciangin mihon a tute lakah a hawm hi. Tua mah bangin ngasa zong hih a, mi khempeuh in a duh zahzah uh a ne ciat uh hi.
Mi khempeuh in a khamkhit uh ciangin a nungzuite kiangah, "A kikhamvalte kaikhawm kik un; bangmah mawk valsak kei ni," a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin mihonpi in anlum nga a nekkhit uh ciangin a khamvalte uh kaikhawm uh a, paipel sawm le nih dim a pha hi.
Jesuh' nalamdang bawl a muh uh ciangin tua lai-a om mihonpite in, "Leitungah kamsang hong pai ding a kici pa pen hih pa hi taktak hi," a ci uh hi.
Mihonte in thatanghat thu tawh kumpi-in amah a koih sawmna thu Jesuh in a theih ciangin mualtung lamah amah guak a kihemkhia hi.
A nitak ciangin tui gei-ah a nungzuite paisuk uh a,
gunkuang tungah tuangin Kapernaum khua lam manawhin a pai uh hi. Khua hong mialta a, ahi zongin amaute kiangah Jesuh hong tung nai lo hi.
Huih nakpi-in hong nung ahih manin tui hong kilokgawp hi.
Tuigei panin tai thum tai li bang gunkuang a hawhkhit uh ciangin tuitungah Jesuh hong pai-in gunkuang lam a hong naih a mu uh hi. Amaute na lau mahmah uh ahih manin
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Keimah ka hi hi; lau kei un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute nuam mahmah uh a, gunkuang tungah Jesuh kahto sakin, a sawt loin a pai nading mun uh a tungpah uh hi.
A zing ciangin tui galkhatah a omlai mihonte in tui gei-ah gunkuang khat a omlai mu uh a, a zan nitakin gunkuang tungah a tuan uh ciangin a nungzuite lakah Jesuh a om lohna thu zong thei uh ahih manin a nungzuite bek a pai-in a ngaihsun uh hi.
Ahi zongin Tiberias khua panin gunkuang dang tampi hong pai a, Jesuh in lungdamna a kohkhit ciangin an a nekna uh munah hong tung uh hi.
Tua lai-ah Jesuh le a nungzuite a om nawn lohna thu mihonte in a theih uh ciangin gunkuang tungah tuangin Jesuh a zong dingin Kapernaum khua lamah a pai uh hi.
Tui galkhatah Jesuh a muh uh ciangin, "Sia aw, bang hunin hih lai na tung na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Jesuh in, "A mantakin ci lehang: Ka nalamdang bawlte na muh uh ciangin kei hong umin a hong zong na hi kei uh a, an na khamtakun na nek uh manin a hong zong na hi bek uh hi.
A ningthei ante ngaihsutin nei masa kei unla, nuntak tawntungna an kan masa zaw un. Pa Pasian in tua an a pia dingin kei hong sehsa ahih manin keimah in note tungah nuntak tawntungna an ka hong pia ding hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Tua ahihleh Pasian ka lungkimsak theih nadingun bangci gamtat ding ka hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dot uh ciangin
Jesuh in, "Pasian in a hong sawl pa um le-uhcin Pasian a lungkim nadingin a gamta na hi uh hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Kote in mu-in ka hong uptheih nadingun bang nalamdang hong bawl ding a, bang hong sem ding na hi hiam?
Lai Siangtho sungah, 'Amaute' nek dingin van panin an a pia hi,' ci-in a kigelh mah bangin ka pu ka pate un gam sungah manna an ne uh hi," a cih uh ciangin
Jesuh in, "A mantakin ci lehang: Moses in a piak an pen vantung an hi lo hi. Vantung an taktak pen ka Pa in hong pia hi.
Pasian in a hong piak an pen vantung panin hong pai-in leitung mite a nungtasak pa ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Sia aw, kote tungah tua an hong pia tawntung in," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Kei pen nuntakna an ka hi hi. Ka kiangah hong paite gilkial ngei nawn lo ding a, kei hong umte dangtak ngei nawn lo ding hi.
Ahi zongin note tungah ka hong gennop thu in: Note in kei hong mukhin napi-in na hong um nuam kei uh hi.
Ka Pa in kei tungah a hong piak mi peuhmah ka kiangah hong pai ding a, ka kiangah a hong pai mi peuhmah ka hawlkhia kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh keima ut bangin a sem ding hi loin kei hong sawl pa' deihna bangin a sem dingin vantung panin a hong pai ka hi hi.
Kei hong sawl pa' deihna in: Ka khut sungah a hong piak mi khempeuh khat zong khahsuah loin nitawp ni ciangin ka hinsakkik ding ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin Tapa mu-in a um mi khempeuh in nuntak tawntungna ngahin, nitawp ni ciangin ka hinsak ding, ka Pa in hong deih ahi hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in, "Kei pen vantung panin a hong pai an ka hi hi," a cihna hangin mihonte phun ngeingai uh a,
"Hih Jesuh pen a nu le a pa i theih hi a, Josef' tapa hi lel hi lo ahi hiam? Tua hinapi-in bang hangin, 'Vantung panin ka hong pai,' cithei peuhmah ahi hiam?" ci-in a kiphunsan uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Note khatlekhat kiphunsan kei un.
Kei hong sawl Pa in a kaih loh mite ka kiangah hong pai thei lo ding a, ka kiangah hong pai mite nitawp ni ciangin ka hingsak ding hi.
Kamsangte in a lai gelhna uhah, 'Pasian in mi khempeuh a hilh ding hi,' na ci uh hi. Tua ahih manin Pa kiang panin thu za-in a thei mi khempeuh ka kiangah a hong pai ahi hi.
Hih bang ka cih ciangin Pa tawh a kimu khin ngei om hi, ka cihna hi lo hi. Pasian kiang panin hong pai pa bek in Pa a mu ngei ahi hi.
A mantakin kong genin-ah, kei hong umte bek in nuntak tawntungna ngah hi.
Kei pen nuntakna an ka hi hi.
Na pu na pate un gam sungah manna ne uh a, a vekpi-un si veve uh hi.
Ahi zongin vantung panin a hong pai an a ne mi peuhmah si lo ding hi.
Kei pen vantung panin a hong paisuk nuntakna an ka hi hi. Tua an a ne mi peuhmah nungta tawntung ding hi. Leitung mite a nuntak nadingin ka piak ding an pen keima sa ahi hi," a ci hi.
Hih bangin a thugenna hangin mihonpite khatlekhat kitawng uh a, "Bangci-in hih mipa in nek dingin ama sa hong piathei ding ahi hiam?" a kici uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "A mantakin kong genin-ah, Mihing Tapa' sa na nek kei uh a, a sisan na dawn kei uhleh note sungah nuntakna om lo ding hi.
Ka sa ne-in ka si a dawnte a nungta tawntung hi a, nitawp ni ciangin ka hingsak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka sa, an taktak hi a, ka sisan, dawn ding tui taktak ahi hi.
Ka sa ne-in ka si a dawnte pen kei tawh pumkhat ka hi uh hi.
A nungta Pa Pasian in kei hong sawl ahih manin ama hangin ka nuntak mah bangin keima sa a ne mite zong keima hang mahin nungta ding hi.
Tua ahih manin kei pen vantung panin a hong pai an ka hi a, na pu na pate un ne-in a sih veve-na ante tawh kibang lo hi. Hih kei' hong piak an a nete ahihleh nungta tawntung ding hi," a ci hi.
Hih thute pen Kapernaum khua-a kikhopna innsunga a thuhilhna-ah a gen ahi hi.
A nungzuite nangawn un hih thu a zak ciangun, "Hih thugen haksa lua hi. Kua in zuizo ding ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in hih thu-ah a nungzuite' phunna thei ahih manin, "Hih ka thugenna in note hong lungkiasak ahi hiam?
Mihing Tapa ama omna ngei-ah a ciahto kik a mu hi le-uhcin bang na ci ding uh hiam?
Nuntakna a piathei pen Pasian' Kha hi a, mihingte' hihtheih bangmah om lo hi. Keima hong gen thute pen nuntakna a hong piathei tua Kha thu ahi hi.
Tua hinapi-in note pawlkhat in na um kei uh hi," a ci hi. (Jesuh in a kipat cil pek a kipanin kuateng in ama thu um ding a, kuateng in amah lehpei ding cih thu thei khinzo hi.)
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Ka Pa in ahi thei dingin bawl kei leh ka kiangah kuamah hong pai thei lo ding hi, ka cihna thu pen hih thu hang mah ahi hi," ci-in a genthuah lai hi.
Hih bangin a thugenna hangin a nung a zui a thungai mi tampi kileh kikin Jesuh zui nawn lo uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Jesuh in a nungzui sawm le nihte kiangah, "Note zong na ciahkik nuam mai uh hiam?" a cih ciangin
Simon Peter in, "Topa aw, ciah le ung kua kiang zuan mawk ding ka hi uh hiam? Nangmah in nuntak tawntung nading thu na nei hi.
Tu-in nang ka hong um uh a, Pasian kiang panin a hong pai a Siangtho Pa na hihna thu ka hong thei uh hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Note na sawm le nih mahun ka hong teel hinapi-in khat pen dawi na suakmawk uh hi," a ci hi.
Sawm le nihte sung panin amah a lehpei ding ahih manin Simon Iskariot' tapa Judas thu a genna ahi hi.
Tua khit ciangin Galilee gam sungah Jesuh zin kawikawi hi. Jerusalem khua-a om Jew mi uliante in amah thatnuam uh ahih manin Judea gam sungah zin nuam nawn lo hi.
Jew mite' Buk Pawi hun hong naita ahih manin,
ama sanggamte in Jesuh kiangah, "Na nung hong zui mihonte in na nasepna a muhtheih nadingun hih lai panin paikhia-in Judea gamah va pai in.
Mite' theih ding a ut pa in a simthamin na sem ngei lo hi. Hih bangin na semsem na hih manin na sepna thu mi khempeuh theisak vet in," ci-in zahpihna tawh thu gen uh a,
ama sanggamte mahmah in zong Jesuh um lo uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in, "Kei a dingin pai ding a hunhoih hi nai lo hi; ahi zongin note a dingin a hunhoih hi tawntung hi.
Leitung mite' gamtatnate hoih lo hi, ci-in gen tawntung ka hih manin amaute in kei hong mudah uh hi; ahi zongin note hong mudah lo uh hi.
Tua ahih manin pawisiim dingin note va pai un. Kei a dingin a hunhoih hi nai lo ahih manin kei ka hong pai kei ding hi," ci-in dawng a,
amah pai loin Galilee gam sung mahah a omlai hi.
Ahi zongin a sanggamte a dinkhiat khit ciangin Jesuh zong Jerusalem-ah Buk Pawi siim dingin a nungpai hi. Ahi zongin a kilang lua-in pai loin a simpai ahi hi.
Jerusalem-a om Jew mi uliante in tua pawi lak khawng Jesuh zong uh a, "Koi-ah om ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Ama thu hangin mihonte lakah kam kihona tampi om a, "Amah mi hoih mahmah khat hi," ci uh a, pawlkhat in, "Mi khemin a lam khialhpih ding pa ahih manin mihoih hi het lo hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jerusalem khua-a Jew mi uliante a kihtakna hangun kuamah in Jesuh thu a kilangin gen ngam lo uh hi.
Pawi kham hunsung alang bang a bei khit ciangin biakinn sungah Jesuh lutin thuhilh ding a kipan hi.
Jew mi uliante in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, "Hih mipa cikmah a sang kah ngei lo kimlai bang hangin thu hih zah thei ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Jesuh in, "Ka thugente pen keima thu hi lo a, kei a hong sawl Pasian kiang panin a hong pai thu ahi hi.
Pasian' deihna bangin a gamta nuam mi peuhmah in, ka thugente pen Pasian' kiang panin a hong pai thu a gen ka hihna leh keima thu bek tawh a gen ka hihna khenthei ding uh hi.
Amau' thu bek tawh thu a gente in amau' minthan nading a zong hi a, ahi zongin a hong sawl pa' minthan nading a zong keimah in thuman thutak gen ka hih manin zuauthu kihel lo hi.
Moses in note tungah Thukham hong pia napi-in kuamah in na zui kei uh hi. Tua hinapi, bang hangin thah dingin kei hong sawm na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mihonte in, "Dawivei hi teh! Kua in nang thah hong sawm ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Jesuh in, "Sabbath ni-in cina damsakna nalamdang khat ka bawlna hangin lamdang na sa mahmah uh hi.
Moses in na tapate uh vun na at ding uh thu hong pia a, (a taktakin Moses thupiak mapekin na pu na pate un a palsat thu ahi hi) vun at ni ding le Sabbath ni a kituahkhak ciangin a vun na at veve uh hi.
Moses thupiakna a kipelh loh nadingin Sabbath ni-in vun at na hih uhleh Sabbath ni-in mi khat ka damsak manin bang hangin kei tungah heh na hi uh hiam?
A tungthama kimu nate siksanin thu khen kei unla, thu taktak siksanin thu khenzaw un," a ci hi.
Jerusalem khuami pawlkhat in, "Thah dingin a sawm pa uh hih pa hi lo ahi hiam?
Tua hinapi, mihon lakah thu gengen napi-in kuamah in bangmah cih lo uh hi. Uliante in Khrih hi, ci-in theihtelna nei uh hi ding hiam?
Tua ding lah, hih mipa hong piankhiatna i theih hi a, Khrih hong pai ciangin ama piankhiatna kuamah in a theih ding hi lo hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin biakinn sungah a gen mah bangin mi khempeuh zakin genkhia a, "Kei hong theitel taktak a, ka hong piankhiatna mun a thei takpi mah na hi uh hiam? Keima thu tawh a hong paitawm ka hi kei hi; kei a hong sawl a thuman pa a thei lo na hi uh hi.
Ahi zongin amah in kei hong sawlin, ama kiang panin a hong pai ka hih manin ke'n ka thei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Jesuh mat ding hanciam uh hi; ahi zongin ama hun tung nai lo ahih manin kuamah in va su lo hi.
Ahi zongin mihon lak panin mi tampi mah in amah um uh a, "Khrih hong pai ciangin hih mipa sangin nalamdang tamzaw hong bawl tuan ding ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Hih bangin mihonpite a kihona thu Farisi mite in za uh ahih manin amaute le siampi liante in Jesuh a man dingin biakinncing palikte pawlkhat a sawl uh hi.
Jesuh in tua mite kiangah, "Note lakah tawlkhat ka om lai ding a, tua ciangin kei hong sawl pa kiangah ka pai ding hi.
Keima omna munah note hong pai thei lo ding na hih manun tua hun ciangin kei nong zon uh hangin nong mu kei ding uh hi," a na ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jew mi uliante khatlekhat kiho uh a, "I muh zawh loh dingin hih mipa koi lai-ah paisawm hi ding ahi hiam? Jew mite omna Grik khuapi tuamtuamte-ah pai-in Grik mite kiangah thu hilhsawm hi ding ahi hiam?
'Kei nong zon uh hangin nong muzo kei ding uh hi,' a cihna leh 'Keima omna munah nong pai thei kei ding uh hi,' a cih ciangin bang a cihnopna hi ding ahi hiam?" ci-in a kikum uh hi.
Pawi bei ni ding pen a thupi pen ni hi a, tua ni-in mihon lakah Jesuh dingin nakpitakin kiko a, "A dangtak na om uhleh ka kiangah hong pai unla tui hong dawn un.
Lai Siangtho sungah, 'Kei hong um mite sung panin nuntakna tui luangkhia ding hi,' a cih mah bangin kei hong um mite ka kiangah hong pai-in hong dawn ta un," a ci hi.
Jesuh in hih bang a gen ciangin amah a umte in a ngah ding Kha Siangtho thu a genna hi a, tua hun laitakin Pasian' pianzia nei-in sihna panin Jesuh kithokiksak nai lo ahih manin Kha Siangtho kipiakhia nai lo hi.
Hih thu a zak uh ciangin mihon pawlkhat in, "Hih pa pen Kamsangpa taktak hi," ci uh a,
pawlkhat in, "Hih pa, Khrih ahi hi," a ci uh hi. Ahi zongin pawlkhat in, "Galilee gam panin Khrih hong piang ding ahi hiam?
Khrih i cih pen David' suan hi ding a, David' suahna Bethlehem khua-ah suak ding hi, ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah kigelh hi lo ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Jesuh thu tawh kisai-ah mihonte' lungsim kituak lo hi.

(Tua ciangin mi khempeuh a inn ciat uhah ciah uh a, Jesuh ahih leh Oliv Mual tungah a paito hi.

Hih bang mite pen suang tawh denlup dingin i Thukham sungah Moses in na gen hi. Tu-in nangmah in bangci ngaihsut na hi hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Hih bangin a dot uh ciangin Jesuh a mawhsak theih nadingun a thangsiahna uh ahi hi. Jesuh zong kunsuk a, a khutme tawh leilak a gelh hi.
