numei in, "Topa aw, kuamah in thu hong khen lo hi," ci-in a dawng hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Kei zong nang tungah thu kong khen kei hi. Ciah inla, mawhna bawl nawn kei in," a ci hi.)
Tua khit ciangin Jesuh in mihonte kiangah a thugenna khatah, "Kei pen leitung khuavak ka hi hi. Kei hong zuite in khuavak nuntakna nei ding uh a, khuamial gamtatna nei lo ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Farisi mite in, "Nang le nang a kigentawm na hih manin na thugente a manin kisang thei lo hi," a cih uh ciangin
Jesuh in, "Kei le kei a kigentawm ka hih hangin ka thugente a man mah hi veve hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh koi panin hong pai-in koi lai-ah pai ding cih ka kithei a, note in kei ka hong paikhiatna le ka pai nading a thei lo na hizaw uh hi.
Thu a thei lopi-in kei na hong mawhsak uh hi; ahi zongin ke'n kuamah ka mawhsak kei hi.
Mi mawhsakin thu a khen hita mah leng zong, a thukhen pen kei bek hi loin kei a hong sawl Pa Pasian le keimah in a khenkhawm ka hih manun ka thukhennate a man taktak ahi hi.
Na Thukham sung uhah zong, 'Thu khat peuhpeuhah mi nih in a manna teci pangin a gen leh a genna uh thuman hi,' ci-in na kigelh ahih mah bangin,
keima a' ding teci ka pang a, kei hong sawl Pa Pasian in zong keima a dingin teci a pang hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Na pa koi-ah om ahi hiam?" ci-in dong uh a, Jesuh in, "Kei ka hi a, ka Pa ahi zongin na hong thei kei uh hi. Kei hong thei hi le-uhcin ka Pa zong na thei ding uh hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Jesuh in hih thute pen sumpi khiatna kuang a kikoihna biakinn dei sungah a gen hi a, ahi zongin ama hun tung nai lo ahih manin kuamah in amah man lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Kei ka paikhia ding hi. Note in kei na hong zong ding uh a, ahi zongin na mawhna uh na sihpih ding uh hi. Ka paina-ah note na hong pai thei kei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Jew mi uliante in, "'Ka paina-ah note na hong pai thei kei ding uh hi,' ci ahih manin amahmah kithattawm ding a cihna hi ding hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Note pen nuailam mi na hi uh a, kei pen tunglam mi ka hi hi. Note pen hih leitung mi na hi uh a, kei pen hih leitung mi ka hi kei hi.
Kei pen, 'Kei ka hihlam na hong up kei uhleh na mawhna uh a sihpih ding na hih manun, na mawhna uh na sihpih ding uh hi,' ci-in ka hong genna pen hih thu hang ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Nang kua na hi hiam?" ci-in a dot uh ciangin Jesuh in, "A kipat cil a kipan ka hong gensa mah ka hi hi.
Note' thu genin, note' thu ka khen ding tampi tak om hi. Kei a hong sawl pa a thuman a thutak hi a, ama tung panin ka zaksa thute bek leitung mite tungah a pulak ka hi hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Jesuh in Pa Pasian' thu a gengen ahih lamtak amaute in thei lo uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Jesuh in, "Mihing Tapa na khai khit uh ciangin 'Kei kua ka hi hiam?' cih thu na hong thei ding uh hi. Tua hun ciangin kei' thu bek tawh bangmah hih loin, ka Pa' hong hilhsa teng bek a gen ka hihna thu na thei ding uh hi.
Kei a hong sawl pa' lungkimna bang bekin gamta tawntung ka hih manin amah in kei guak hong nusia loin, hong ompih tawntung hi," a ci hi.
Tua bangin Jesuh in thu a gen ciangin mi tampi in amah a um uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amah a um Jew mite kiangah Jesuh in, "Ka thuhilhnate na zuih paisuak nak-uhleh ka nungzui taktakte na hi ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin thuman na thei ding uh a, tua thuman in note hong suaktasak ding hi," a cih leh
amaute in, "Kote Abraham' suanlekhakte ka hi uh a, cikmahin kuama salin ka om ngei kei uh hi. Tua ahih manin bang hangin, 'Note suakta ding,' hong cithei na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "A mantakin ci lehang mawhna a bawl mi peuhmah mawhna' sila ahi uh hi.
Silate pen innkuan mite tawh omkhawm paisuak lo a, tapa ahihleh om paisuak hi.
Tua ahih manin Tapa in note hong khah le a suakta takpi na hi uh hi.
Note pen Abraham' suanlekhakte na hihna uh ka thei hi. Ahi zongin ka thugente hong um lo na hih manun kei thah dingin nong sawm uh hi.
Tua ahih manin keimah in ahihleh ka Pa' hong lahsa thute bek a gen ka hi a, ahi zongin note ahihleh na pa uh hong sawl bangin a gamta na hi uh hi," a ci hi.
Amaute in, "Kote' pa Abraham ahi hi," ci-in a dawn uh ciangin Jesuh in, "Abraham' tate taktak hi le-uhcin Abraham' gamtat bangin na gamta ding uh hi.
A taktakin ci lehang, ka hihna khempeuh Pasian' kiang panin ka zaksa thuman thu ka hong gen hinapi-in note in kei thah ding na hong sawm uh hi. Hih note' gamtat bangin Abraham gamta lo hi.
Note pen na pa uh gamtat bangin a gamta na hi uh hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in, "Kote pen zawlta ka hi kei uh a, ka Pa uh Pasian ahi hi," a cih uh ciangin
Jesuh in, "Kei pen Pasian kiang panin hong pai-in hih lai-ah hong om ka hih manin, Pasian pen na pa taktak uh hileh kei na hong it ding uh hi. Keima thu-in a hong paitawm ka hi kei a, ama hong sawl ka hi hi.
Bang hangin ka thugente theithei lo na hi uh hiam? Ka thugente na ngaih nop loh man uh ahi hi.
Note pen na pa uh Dawimangpa' tate na hi uh a, na pa uh deihna bangin a gamta nuam na hi uh hi. A kipat a kipanin na pa uh mi that hi a, thuman gen ngei lo ahih manin thuman tawh kipawl thei lo hi. Amah pen zuauna khempeuh a pianna a zuaugen pa ahih manin zuau a gen ciangin ama ngeina hi lel hi.
Tua ahih manin thuman ka hong gen ciangin na hong um thei kei uh hi.
Note lakah kua in ka mawhna na hong lakthei uh hiam? Hong lak thei lo na hih manun thuman ka gen ciangin bang hangin hong um lo na hi uh hiam?
Pasian kiang panin a paite in Pasian' thugen za thei hi. Ahi zongin note pen Pasian kiang pan hi lo na hih manun Pasian' thu na ngai nuam kei uh hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jew mihonte in, "Nang Samaria mi hi-in, dawivei hi teh, ka hong cih uh a man mah hi lo ahi hiam?" a cih uh ciangin
Jesuh in, "Kei dawivei ka hi kei hi. Keimah in ka Pa ka zahtakbawl a, ahi zongin note in kei nong simmawhbawl uh hi.
Kei ka minthan' theih nading ka hanciam kei a, ahi zongin keima minthan nading zongin, kei a hong angvan ding thukhen ding Khat om hi.
A mantakin ci lehang, keima thuhilhna a zui peuhpeuh si nawn lo ding hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin mihonte in, "Dawivei taktak na hihna thu tu-in ka hong thei uh hi. Kamsangte khempeuh le Abraham zong si napi-in, 'Keima thuhilhna a zui peuhpeuh si nawn lo ding,' na ci lailai hi.
Kote' pupi Abraham zong si ahih manin amah sangin a lianzaw dingin ki-um na hi hiam? Tua banah kamsangte khempeuh zong si ahih manin nang a kua-in kingaihsun na hi hiam?" a cih uh ciangin
Jesuh in, "Kei le kei a kipahtawi hi leng ka kipahtawina a mawkna hi ding hi. Ahi zongin kei hong pahtawi pa pen ka Pasian uh ahi hi, na cih uh keima Pa ahi hi.
Note in amah na thei ngei kei uh a, ahi zongin ke'n ka thei hi. Amah ka thei kei hi, a ci hi leng, note mah bangin kei zong a zuau ka hi ding hi. Ahi zongin ke'n amah thei ka hih manin ama thu ka mang hi.
Note' pupi Abraham in keima hun a tun ding lawp mahmah a, amah in tua hun mu-in nuam mahmah hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Nang pen kum sawmnga zong pha nai lo na hih manin Abraham mu ding na hi hiam?" a cih uhleh
Jesuh in, "A taktakin ci lehang, Abraham a pian' ma-in kei ka omkhin hi," ci-in a dawng hi.

Tua ciangin Jesuh nakpitakin kiko a, "Kei hong um khempeuh in kei bek hong um hi loin kei hong sawl pa zong a um ahi hi.
Kei hong mu khempeuh in kei hong sawl pa zong a mu ahi hi.
Kei hong um mi khempeuh, khuamial sungah a om nawn loh nadingun leitung khuavak bangin ka hong pai hi.
Ka thugenna za napi-in a zui lo mite tungah thu ka khen kei ding hi. Leitung mite mawhsakin thukhen dingin a hong pai ka hi kei a, a honkhia dingin a hong pai ka hizaw hi.
Kei hong nialin ka thugen a sang lo mite in thukhen ding khat nei uh hi. Nitawp ni ciangin keima thugente pen amaute' thukhen ding ahi hi.

A Pa in ama khut sungah vangliatna khempeuh a piakna le Pasian in amah a sawl mah bangin tu-in Pasian kiangah a paikik ding ahihna thu zong a thei hi.

Simon Peter' khe silsak dingin a kipat ciangin Peter in, "Topa aw, ka khe hong silsak zenzen ding na hi hiam?" a na ci hi.

Tua ciangin Simon Peter in, "Topa aw, tua bang ahihleh ka khe bek hong silsak kei inla, ka khutte le ka lu zong hong silsak in," a na ci leuleu hi.

Jesuh in amah a lehhek ding pa theikhin ahih manin, "Note sung panin khat simloh na siangkhin uh hi," a ci ahi hi.
Jesuh in amaute' khe a silsak khit ciangin a puan silhkik a, annek sabuai-ah a tutnasa mun hong zuanin, "Tu-a note tungah ka hong gamtatna thu na thei uh hiam?
Note in kei pen Siapa, le Topa, na hong ci uh hi. Na hong cih uh mah bangin a man ka hi hi.
Note' Topa le Siapa in na khe uh hong silsak ka hih leh note khatlekhat na kisilsak kan ding uh kilawm hi.
Note tungah ka hong gamtat bangin note na gamtat theih nadingun a lim a hong lak ka hi hi.
A mantakin ci lehang, sila pen a topa sangin lianzaw ngei lo a, a kisawlpa zong a sawl pa sangin lianzaw ngei lo hi.
Hih thu thei-in na zuih uhleh na lung uh nuam mahmah ding hi.
"Hih bangin ka hong genna in note khempeuh hong huam kim lo hi. Ka teelsa mite ka thei hi. Lai Siangtho in, 'Ka an a ne pa in kei hong langpang hi,' a cihna thu a tun ding kisam hi.
Hih thu hong tun taktak ciangin, 'Kei kua ka hihna,' na hong theih nadingun a hun ma-in a hong ma gen ka hi hi.
A mantakin ci lehang, keima hong sawl mite a sangte in kei zong a hong sang ahi uh a, kei a hong sangte in kei a hong sawl pa zong a sang ahi uh hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in hih thuteng a genkhit ciangin lungkham mahmah ahih manin, "A mantakin ci lehang, note khat in kei nong lehhek ding uh hi," ci-in a kilangin a genkhia hi.

Jesuh in a itdiak a nungzuite khat ama kiangah tu ahih manin,

Ama hangin Pasian in minthanna a ngah mah bangin Pasian in zong ama pianzia amah ngahsak ding a, a sawt loin ngahsak pah ding hi.
Ka tate aw, note tawh sauvei ka hong omkhawm nawn kei ding hi. Note in kei na hong zong ding uh a, ahi zongin Jerusalem khua-a Jew uliante kiangah, 'Ka paina munah na hong pai thei kei ding uh hi,' ci-in ka gen mah bangin note kiangah zong tu-in ka hong gen hi.
Note tungah ka hong piak thak thu in: Note khatlekhat na ki-it ding uh ahi hi. Note ka hong it mah bangin note khatlekhat na ki-it un.
Note khatlekhat ki-it le-uhcin keima nungzuite na hihna uh mi khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi," a ci hi.

Jesuh in, "Filip aw, hih tanvei omkhawm khin napi kei hong thei nai lo lai na hi hiam? Kei a hong mu khinte in Pa a mu khin ahih manin bang hangin, 'Pa hong lak in,' ci thei na hi hiam?
Kei pen Pa tawh pumkhat ka hih lamtak um lo na hi hiam? Note tungah ka hong gen thute keima thu bek tawh a hong gen ka hi kei a, kei tawh a om Pa Pasian in na semin a hong gen ahi hi.
Pa tawh pumkhat ka hihna thu hoihtakin hong um un. Na hong up nai kei uhleh zong ka nalamdang bawlnate hangin hong um beek un.
A mantakin ka hong genin-ah, kei hong umte in keima sep nate mah sem ding hi. Pa kiangah kei ciah ding ka hih manin keima sep sangin zong a lianzaw sem lai ding uh hi.
Tapa' hangin Pasian' pianzia a kilat theih nadingin keima min paulamin na hong nget khempeuh uh ka hong pia ding hi.
Keima min paulamin na hong nget nak-uhleh ka hong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Kei na hong it uhleh ka thupiakte zong na zui ding uh hi.
Keimah in Pa kiangah ka ngen ding a, note tawh a omkhawm tawntung dingin Thuman a hong lak Kha Siangtho, note hong Huhpa ding a hong pia ding hi.
Leitung mite in tua Kha Siangtho mu thei lo, theithei lo uh ahih manin sang thei lo ding uh hi. Ahi zongin note sungah tua Kha Siangtho hong om ding ahih manin note in na thei ding uh hi.
"Note a cimawh dingin ka hong nusia kei ding hi. Note kiangah ka hong paikik ding hi.
Tawlkhat khit ciangin leitung mite in kei hong mu nawn lo ding uh hi. Ahi zongin kei ka nuntak mah bangin note zong nungta ding na hih manun note in kei na hong mu ding uh hi.
Tua hun ciangin Pa sungah kei ka omna thu, le note sungah ka hong om mah bangin keima sungah na omna thu uh na thei ding uh hi.
Keima thupiakte sangin a zuite in keimah hong it ahi uh hi. Kei hong it mite pen ka Pa in zong it ding a, keimah in zong itin amaute tungah ka kilang ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Judas Iskariot ahi lo Judas dang khat in, "Topa aw, leitung mite tungah kilang loin kote tungah bangci-in hong kilangtuam thei ding na hi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin
Jesuh in, "Kei hong itte in ka thu zui ding uh hi. Ka Pa in zong it ding a, ka nihun tua mite kiangah pai-in amaute tawh ka omkhawm ding uh hi.
Kei hong it lote in ka thugente zui lo ding uh hi. Tu-a na zak uh thute pen keima thu hi lo a, kei hong sawl Pa Pasian kiang panin a hong pai thu ahi hi.
"Note tawh ka hong omkhawm hun sungin hih thute a hong gen ka hi hi.
Ahi zongin Pa in keima tangin a hong sawl ding Huhpa Kha Siangtho a hong tun ciangin note tungah thu khempeuh hong hilh ding a, note tungah ka hong gensa thu khempeuh zong hong phawksakkik ding hi.
Note tungah keima neih bang lungnopna ka hong pia ding hi. Tua ka hong piak ding lungnopna pen leitung mite in a piaktheih a kip lo lungnopnate pawl hi lo hi. Tua ahih manin lau kei unla, zong lungkham kei un.
'Ka va paikhia ding a, ahi zongin note kiangah ka hong paikik ding hi,' ka cihna thu na za khin uh hi. Kei sangin a lianzaw Pa Pasian kiangah a va pai ding ka hih manin kei na hong it nak-uhleh ama kiangah ka paina hangin na nuamzaw ding uh hi.
A thu hong pian' taktak ciangin ka thugente na uptheih nadingun a pian' ma-in a hong genkhol ka hi hi.
Tu-in hih leitung a ukpa hong tungta ahih manin note kiangah thu kong gen man nawn kei ding hi. Amah in keima tungah aana nei lo hi.
Ahi zongin leitung mite in Pa Pasian ka itna thu a theih nadingun Pa' vaihawmna bangbangin a gamta ding ka hi hi. Tua ahih manin kithawi un; hih lai mun panin paikhia ta ni," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Kei pen leenggui taktak ka hi a, ka Pa pen leenggui lonei pa ahi hi.
Amah in gah a nei lo ka hiang khempeuh satkhia a, gah a nei hiangte ahihleh a gah semsem theih nadingin a puah hi.
Note tungah ka hong thugennate hangin note a siang na suak khinzo uh hi.
Kei tawh hong kizom paisuak le-uhcin kei zong note tawh a kizom paisuak ka hi ding hi. A hiang pen a gui tawh kizom kei leh gah a gah theih loh mah bangin note zong kei tawh na kizop kei uhleh gah na gah thei kei ding uh hi.
"Kei pen leenggui ka hi a, note pen a hiang na hi uh hi. Note in kei tawh loin bangmah hih thei lo ding na hih manun kei tawh a kizomte in gah tampi na gah ding uh hi.
Kei tawh a kizom lo mite pen leenggui hiang bangin kipaai khia-in keutum hi. Tua bang hiangte meikhuk sungah kilawnin a kangtum hi.
Kei tawh na hong kizop uh a, note sungah ka thu a om nakleh na deih peuhpeuh uh hong ngen le-uhcin hong kipia ding hi.
Gah tampi gah le-uhcin ka Pa' minthanna a kilangsak na hi ding uh a, keima nungzui na hihna uh kilang ding hi.
Ka Pa in kei hong it zahin note hong it ka hih manin keima hong itna sungah om un.
Ka Pa' hong thupiakte zui-in ama itna sungah ka om mah bangin note in zong ka thupiaknate na hong zuih uhleh ka itna sungah a om na hi ding uh hi.
Note hangin kei ka lungdam theih nading le note' lungdamna a cingtaak a suahtheih nadingin hih thute a hong gen ka hi hi.
"Note tungah ka hong piak thu in: Note ka hong it zahin note khatlekhat na ki-it un.
Lawmte' tang ding sih ngamna sangin lawmte itna a lianzaw om nawn lo hi.
Ka hong thupiak bangin na gamtat uhleh ka lawmte na hi uh hi.
Nasemte in a tote' nasepna bangmah thei lo ahih manin note pen nasemte ka hong ci nawn kei ding hi. Ka Pa' tung panin ka zak thu khempeuh note kiangah hong genkhin ka hih manin note, lawm, ka hong ci zaw ding hi.
Note in kei na hong teel kei uh a, ahi zongin keimah in note ka hong teel a, note va pai-in a kimang tawntung ding gah a gah dingin ka hong seh hi. Tua ahih manin keima min suangin Pa kiangah na nget peuhpeuh uh hong pia ding hi.
Tua hi a, note ka hong thupiak in: Khatlekhat na ki-it un, cihna ahi hi.
"Leitung mite in note hong muhdah leh kei a hong mudah masa ahihna thu na thei un.
Hih leitung mite tawh a kipawl hi le-uhcin leitung mite in amau pawlte hong it ding hi. Ahi zongin hih leitung mite lak panin note ka hong teelkhia a, amaute tawh kipawl nawn lo na hih manun a hong mudah ahi uh hi.
'Sila pen a topa sangin lianzaw lo hi,' ci-in ka hong thugenna phawk un. Amaute in kei hong bawlsiat uhleh note zong hong bawlsia ding hi. Ka thugente hong zuih uhleh note' thugente zong hong zui ding hi.
Ahi zongin amaute in kei hong sawl pa thei lo uh ahih manin keima mi na hihna uh hangin amaute in hih bangin hong bawl ding uh ahi hi.
Kei hong pai kei-in amaute tungah thu a gen lo hi leng amaute in mawh pualo ding uh hi. Ahi zongin tu-in ahihleh a mawhna thu uhah kiphel nading a paulap ding uh bangmah om nawn lo hi.
Kei hong mudahte in ka Pa zong a mudah ahi hi.
Kuamah in a bawl ngei loh na lamdangte amaute lakah a bawl lo hi leng amaute in mawh pualo ding uh hi. Ahi zongin amaute in ka nalamdang bawlte mu khin uh ahih manin kei le ka Pa a hong mudah khawm uh ahi hi.
Amaute' Thukham sungah, 'Thu om lopi-in kei hong mudah uh hi,' ci-in a kigelhna thu a tuntheih nadingin a hici mah ding ahi hi.
"Ahi zongin Thuman a hong lak ding Huhpa ahi Kha Siangtho ka Pa kiang panin ka hong sawl ding hi. Amah hong tun ciangin keima thu hong gen ding hi.
A kipat cil a kipanin kei tawh omkhawm na hih manun note in zong keima thu na gen ding uh hi.
"Note na pukkhak loh nadingun hih thute a hong gen ka hi hi.
Amaute in a kikhopna uh innte panin note hong hawlkhia ding uh hi. Note hong that mite pen Pasian' nasemin a kingaihsut ding uh hun hong tung ding hi.
Amaute in ka Pa ahi a, kei ahi zongin hong thei lo uh ahih manin tu-a bangin note a hong bawl ding uh ahi hi.
Hih bangin a hong gamtat hun uh hong tun ciangin ka hong gen thute na phawk theih nadingun a hong genkhol ka hi hi. "Note tawh hong omkhawm ngawn ka hih manin a kipattung lamin hih thute ka hong gen kei hi.
Tu-in ahihleh kei hong sawl pa kiangah a ciahkik ding ka hi hi. Tua hinapi-in, 'Koi-ah pai ding na hi hiam?' ci-in kuamah in na hong dong kei uh hi.
Ahi zongin hih thute ka hong gen ciangin na lungsim uh dah mahmah hi.
A taktakin ci lehang, kei paikhia kei leng note hong Huh ding pa hong pai lo ding a, kei paikhia leng note hong Huh ding pa hong sawl ding ka hih manin kei va paikhia leng note a dingin hoihzaw tham hi.
Amah hong tun ciangin leitung mite tungah mawhna thu, thuman thu leh thukhenna thu laktel ding hi.
Amaute in kei hong uploh manun a mawhna uh lak ding a,
Pa kiangah pai ding ka hih manin kei na hong mu nawn kei ding uh hi, ka cihna thu a manna lak ding a,
hih leitung a ukpa pen thukhenna a thuakkhin ahihna thu zong lak ding hi.
"Ka hong gen ding tampi tak omlai hi; ahi zongin hong gen lai leng note a dingin tamlua ding hi.
Tua ahih manin thuman hong lak ding Kha Siangtho hong tun ciangin thu khempeuh a manin hong hilh ding hi. Ama ngaihsuttawm thu hong gen ding hi lo a, ama tungah a kigen thute le a hong tung ding thute a hong gen ding ahi hi.
Amah in keima gen ding thute note tungah hong gen ding ahih manin Pasian' pianzia ka neihna hong kilangsak ding hi.
Ka Pa' neihsa khempeuh keima-a' suakkhin ahih manin keima gen ding thute le a gen dingin ka sawlteng Kha Siangtho in note kiangah hong gen ding hi," a ci hi.
"Tawlkhat khit ciangin na hong mu nawn kei ding uh a, tawlkhat khit ciangin na hong mukik ding uh hi," a cih ciangin,
a nungzuite pawlkhat kidong uh a, "Tawlkhat khit ciangin kei na hong mu nawn kei ding uh a, tawlkhat khit ciangin na hong mukik ding uh hi, a cihna le Pa kiangah a ciahkik ding ka hi hi, a cihnate bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?" a kici uh hi.
Tawlkhat a cihcih pen bang a cihnopna ahi hiam, i thei kei hi, a kici uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute' theihnop lamtak phawk ahih manin amaute kiangah, "Note khatlekhat na kidot uh, 'Tawlkhat khit ciangin na hong mu nawn kei ding uh a, tawlkhat khit ciangin na hong mukik ding uh hi,' ka cihnopna a kidong na hi uh hiam?
A taktakin ka hong genin-ah, note dahin na kap ding uh a, ahi zongin leitung mite lungdam ding uh hi. Note na dah ding uh a, ahi zongin na dahna uh lungdamna hong suak ding hi.
Numei in a ta a suahhun a tun ciangin na sa ahih manin a dah hi. Ahi zongin a ta a suahkhit ciangin leitungah naungek khat a piangsak khin ahihna hangin lungdamin a natna teng a mangngilh ta hi.
Note zong tua mah tawh na kibang ding uh hi. Note zong tu-in na dah uh hangin note tawh kimukik ding ihih manin na lung uh dam mahmah ding a, tua na lungdamna uh kuamah in hong beisak thei lo ding hi.
"Tua hun ciangin kei kiangah bangmah nong ngen nawn kei ding uh hi. A mantakin kong genin-ah, keima min suangin na nget peuhpeuh uh Pa in hong pia ding hi.
Tuni ciang dong keima min suangin bangmah na ngen nai kei uh hi. Tua ahih manin ngen le-uhcin hong kipia ding ahih manin na lungdamna uh hong cingtaak ding hi.
"Tuhun ciang dong hih thute thugentehna zangin ka hong gen hi. Ahi zongin thugentehna ka hong zat nawn loh hun hong tung ding a, tua hun ciangin a teltakin Pa Pasian' thu ka hong gen ding hi.
Tua hun hong tun ciangin, Pa Pasian kiangah ka hong ngetsak ding hi, ka hong ci nawn kei ding a, nomau mahmah in ka min suangin Pa kiangah na ngenpah ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh note in kei hong itin, Pa kiang panin a hong pai ka hihna thu um na hih manun Pa mahmah in note hong it ahihna hang ahi hi.
Pa kiang panin hong pai-in leitung a hong tung ka hi a, tu-in leitung nusia leuleu-in Pa kiang a zuankik ding ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a nungzuite in, "Tu-in thugentehna zang nawn loin a kitel takin thu na hong gen hi.
Tu-in na khempeuh na theihkhitna thu ka phawk uh a, ka theihnop uh thute kote in ka hong dot ding uh zong kisam nawn lo ahih manin Pa kiang panin a hong pai na hihna thu ka hong um uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Jesuh in, "Tu-in hong umta na hi uh hiam?
Note khempeuh kithehthangin na inn ciat uh zuanin kei bek na hong nusiat ding uh hun a hong tung ding hi bek loin tu-in a hong tung hita hi. Ahi zongin kei guak a hong kinusia hi lo a, Pa in kei hong ompih hi.
Keimah tawh na hong kipawlna uh hangin lungnopna na neihtheihna dingun hih thu a hong gen ka hi hi. Leitung gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Ahi zongin keimah in leitung nate zo khinta ka hih manin lungnuamin om un," a ci hi.
Jesuh in hih thute a genkhit ciangin vantung lam ento-in, "Pa aw, a hun hong tungta ahih manin na Tapa in na pianzia hong kilatsak theih nadingin tu-in na Tapa' pianzia hong kilangsak ta in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Tapa tungah na piak mi khempeuh tungah Tapa in nuntak tawntungna a piaktheih nadingin mi khempeuh tungah ukna aana a neih nadingin Tapa tungah na hong piaksa ahi hi.
Nang bek a man Pasian na hihna thu le nangmah in na hong sawl Jesuh Khrih hong theihna pen amaute a dingin nuntak tawntung ngah nading lampi ahi hi.
Nangmah in sep dingin na hong piak nasep khempeuh sem khinta ka hih manin leitungah na min a thangsak ka hi hi.
Pa aw, leitung a kipiansak ma-in nang tawh i neihkhawm na pianzia mah tu-in nangma omna munah hong pia ta in.
"Leitung mite sung panin keima khut sungah na hong piak mite tungah nangma min ka pulak khinzo ta hi. Tua mite in nangma thu mangin nangma mi hi uh a, ahi zongin keima khut sungah amaute na hong pia hi.
Tu-in amaute in keima neih khempeuh nangma hong piak ahihna thu a thei uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh gen dingin na hong sawl thu khempeuh amaute kiangah ka gen ciangin um uh a, nangma kiang panin a pai ka hihna thu hong thei uh a, nangma hong sawl ka hihna thu zong hong um uh hi.
"Amaute a dingin thu ka hong ngetsak hi. Leitung mite a dingin a hong ngetsak hi loin keima khut sungah na hong piak mite nangma mi ahih manin tua mite a dingin a hong ngetsak ka hi hi.
Keima neih khempeuh nangma a' hi a, nangma neih khempeuh keima-a' ahih manin, tua mite' hangin nangma pianzia ka neihna hong kilang hi.
Tu-in nangma kiangah kei a hong paita ding ka hih manin leitungah ka om nawn kei ding a, ahi zongin amaute a omlai ding uh ahi hi. Tua ahih manin a Siangtho ka Pa aw, nang le kei pumkhat ihih mah bangin amaute zong pumkhat ahih nadingun na vangliatna tawh hoihtakin na kem in.
Amaute tawh ka omkhawm hun lai-in nangma hong piak na min vangliatna tawh amaute ka kem hi. Amaute ka hu a, a maimang ding pa simloh khat zong ka kisamsak kei hi. Tua a maimang pa lah Lai Siangtho sung thu a tun nading ahi hi.
Tu-in nangma kiangah a hong paita ding ka hih manin keimah bangin amaute in lungdamna cingtaak a neihtheih nadingun leitungah ka om lai-in hih thute a gen ka hi hi.
Amaute tungah na thu ka gen khin hi. Ahi zongin keimah bangin amaute zong hih leitung mite tawh kipawl lo uh ahih manin leitung mite in a mudah uh hi.
Leitung panin amaute na lakkhiat ding a hong ngetsak ka hi kei a, a Gilopa' bawlsiat nading panin na kep ding a hong ngen ka hi hi.
Hih leitung tawh kei ka kipawl loh mah bangin amaute zong a kipawl lo uh ahi hi.
Nangma thuman hilhna tawh amaute a siangtho nangma zat dingin na bawl in.
Leitungah kei na hong sawl mah bangin kei zong leitung mahah amaute ka sawl hi.
Nangma tungah thuman takin amaute zong hong ki-ap theih nadingun amaute ka khualna-in nangma tungah kei ka hong ki-ap hi.
"Hih mite a' ding bek thu a hong ngetsak ka hi kei a, amaute' thugenna hangin kei hong um mite a' ding zong a hong ngetsak ka hi hi.
Pa aw, amaute khempeuh pumkhat a suahtheih nadingun ka hong ngetsak hi. Nangmah in kei na hong sawlna thu leitung mite in a uptheih nadingun ei tegel pawlkhat ihih mah bangin amaute zong eite tawh pawlkhat hong hi tahen.
Nang le kei pumkhat ihih mah bangin amaute zong pumkhat a suah theih nadingun keima tungah na hong piak pianzia mah amaute tungah ka pia hi.
Leitung mite in kei na hong sawlna thu a theih nading le kei na hong it mah bangin amaute na itna thu a theihna hangun amaute pumkhat a suah taktak theih nadingun amaute lakah kei ka om a, kei tawh nang na hong omkhawm hi.
Pa aw, leitung a pianma pekin kei na hong itna hangin na hong piak pianzia a mu dingin keimah na hong piak mite zong ka omna-ah a hong pai theih nading ka deihsak hi.
A Thuman ka Pa aw, leitung mite in nang hong thei lo uh hi. Ahi zongin keimah in nang ka hong thei a, kei na hong sawlna thu hih mite in zong a thei uh hi.
Kei na hong itna zah itna mah amaute sungah omin, amaute tawh kei ka omkhawm theih nadingin amaute tungah nangma min ka gen khin a, mai lamah zong ka gen lailai ding hi," ci-in thu a ngen hi.
Jesuh in tu-a bangin thu a nget khit ciangin a nungzuite tawh Kidron lui kantanin a pai hi. Tua lai-ah huan khat om a, tua huan sungah a nungzuite tawh a lut hi.
Jesuh le a nungzuite tua munah pai zelzel uh ahih manin Jesuh a lehhek Judas in zong tua mun a thei hi.
Tua ahih manin Judas zong, siampi liante le Farisi mite in a sawl galkap honkhat le biakinncing palik pawlkhat tawh hiam tawi-in lalcin leh meilah de-in tua huanah a hong pai uh hi.
Jesuh in zong ama tungah a piang ding thu khempeuh theikhin ahih manin hong paikhia-in amaute kiangah, "Kua zong na hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Amaute in, "Nazareth khuami Jesuh a zong ka hi uh hi," a ci hi. Jesuh a lehhek Judas zong tua mihonte tawh hong dingkhawm hi.
Jesuh in, "Keimah ka hi hi," a cih ciangin amaute nungkinin a puk uh hi.
Jesuh in, "Kua zong na hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dotkik ciangin amaute in, "Nazareth khuami Jesuh a zong ka hi uh hi," a ci leuleu uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Keimah ka hi hi, ci-in ka hong gen khinzo hi. Kei hong zong na hih uhleh hih adangte khah lel un," a ci hi.
Hih bang a cihna pen, "Kei na hong piaksate khat zong ka kisamsak kei hi," ci-in a thugenna a tun nading ahi hi.
Simon Peter in namsau kuah ahih manin a namsau dokin siampi lianpen pa' silapa a sat leh a taklam bil a satkhia hi. Tua silapa' min Malkhus ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in Peter kiangah, "Na namsau a paai-ah siat in. Ka Pa in thuak dingin a hong piak thu thuak lo ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin galkapte le a bute le Jew mi palikte in Jesuh manin hen uh a,
tua kumin siampi lianpen a sem Kaiafas' sungpa Annas kiangah a paipih masa uh hi.
Mihonte' tangin mi khat a sih ding kilawm zaw hi, ci-in Jerusalem khua-a Jew mi uliante kiangah thu a gen pa Kaiafas ahi hi.
Simon Peter le a nungzui dang khat in zong Jesuh a zui uh hi. Hih a nungzui dang khat pa le siampi lianpen pa kithei uh ahih manin siampi lianpen pa' inntual dongah Jesuh tawh a lutkhawm hi.
Ahi zongin Peter ahihleh kong pualamah a khawl hi. Tua ahih manin siampi lianpen pa tawh a kithei nungzui dang khat pa zong va pai kikin kongcing numei a hopih khit ciangin Peter zong a tumpih hi.
Kongcing numei in Peter kiangah, "Hih mipa' nungzuite khat hi lo na hi hiam?" a cih leh, "Ka hi kei hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Khua dam mahmah ahih manin nasemte le palikte in meihol cih a, tua mei awi-in a kiimah ding uh ahih manin Peter zong va pai-in mei awi-in amaute tawh a dingkhawm hi.
Siampi lianpen pa Annas in Jesuh kiangah ama nungzuite thu le a thuhilhna tawh kisai thu a dong hi.
Jesuh in, "Mi khempeuh' theihin thu ka gen tawntung hi. Jew mihonpi a kikhopna innte le Biakinn sungah thu ka hilh a, thu ka sim genna om ngei lo hi.
Tua ahih manin bang hangin kei kiangah hong dong se na hi hiam? Ka thugen a za mite kiangah dong lecin ka genteng amaute in hong genthei ding uh hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Hih bangin Jesuh a pau ciangin biakinncing palikte khat in Jesuh beeng a, "Bang hangin hih bangin siampi lianpen pa tungah kampau ngam na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh in, "A man loin kampau khial ka hih leh ka khialhna hong lak in. Ka thugen a man ahih manin bang hangin hong beeng zenzen na hi hiam?" ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Annas in Jesuh a kikhihsa mahin siampi lianpen pa Kaiafas kiangah a puak hi.
Tua bangin mei awi-in Simon Peter a din laitakin a kiima om midangte in, "Nang, hua mipa' nungzuite khat hi lo na hi hiam?" a cih uhleh Peter in, "Ka hi kei hi," ci-in a nial leuleu hi.
Tua ciangin siampi lianpen pa' nasem, Peter in a bil a sat khiatsak pa' behte khat in, "Huan sungah amah tawh na omkhawm lai-un hong mu hi lo ka hi hiam?" a cih ciangin,
Peter in nialkik leuleu a, tua khit phetin ak a khuang hi.
Tua ciangin Kaiafas' inn panin gam ukpa Pilat' omna kumpi inn-ah Jesuh a paipih uh hi. Tua hun pen zingsang tung ahi hi. Jew mite ahihleh Paisan Pawi annekna sungah kihel nuam uh ahih manin biakna vai-in a siang a suahtheih nadingun kumpi inn huang sungah lut lo uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute kiangah Pilat hong pusuakin, "Hih mipa na mawhsakna uh bang ahi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin
amaute in, "Hih mipa a gamtat a sialo hileh nang kiangah ka hong paipih kei ding uh hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua ciangin Pilat in, "Jerusalem khua-a om no Jew mi uliante mah in paikhiatpih unla, nomau Thukham tawh kizui-in ama tungah thu khen un," ci-in a gen ciangin Jew mite in ama kiangah, "Kote in mi thahtheih nading thu ka nei kei uh hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
(Jesuh in ama sihna dingzia a gensa thu a tuntheih nadingin hih bangin a piang ahi hi.)
Tua ciangin kumpi huang sungah Pilat ciahkik a, Jesuh samin, "Nang Jew mite' kumpi na hi hiam?" ci-in a dot leh
Jesuh in, "Nang' lungsimah a piangtawm hong dong na hi hiam, tua ahih kei leh midangte in keima thu hong gen ahi hiam?" ci-in a dawng hi.
Pilat in, "Kei, Jew mi hong sa na hi hiam? Na Jew mipihte le na siampi liante un kei kiangah nang hong ap uh hi. Bang gamta khial na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Keima ukna pen hih leitung gam hi lo hi. Keima ukna hih leitung gam hileh Jerusalem khua-a Jew mi uliante' khut sungah hong kipiak loh nadingin ka nungzuite in a do ding uh hi. Tua ahih manin keima ukna pen hih leitung tawh kizom lo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Pilat in, "Tua ahihleh nang kumpi hi lo na hi hiam?" a cih leh Jesuh in, "Kumpi hi, nangmah in na hong ci hi. Hih thuman a genkhia dingin mi hong suakin leitungah a hong pai ka hi hi. Hih thuman tawh a kizom mi peuhmah in keima thugen hong zui uh hi," a cih ciangin
Pilat in, "Thuman na cih bang ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi. Tua ciangin Jew mihonte kiangah Pilat va paikhia kikin amaute kiangah, "Ama khialhna bangmah ka mu kei hi.
Tua ahih manin na Paisan Pawi hun uh ciangin note a dingin mi khat ka khahkhiat a ngeina ahih manin note a dingin hih Jew kumpipa hong khahkhia leng na ut uh hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin,
amaute awng gawpin, "Hih mipa khah kei in! Barabbas hong khah in!" ci-in a dawng uh hi. (Barabbas pen mi suamin thongkia khat ahi hi.)
Tua ciangin Pilat in ama kiangah Jesuh paipih sakin a satsak hi.
Galkapte in a kumpi lukhu dingin ling vialin Jesuh khusak uh a, a kumpi puan dingin puansan a silhsak khit uh ciangin
ama kiangah nehin, "Jew mite Kumpipa, na khansau ta hen!" ci-in hopihin a khut uh tawh a beeng uh hi.
Pilat zong khatvei hong pusuak kikin mihonte kiangah, "Ama khialhna bangmah a mu lo ka hihna thu na theih nadingun note kiangah Jesuh ka hong paikhia sak hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Jesuh zong ling lukhu khukawm leh puansan silhkawmin hong pusuak a, Pilat in mihonte kiangah, "En un, hih lai-ah na mipa uh om hi," a ci hi.
Siampi liante le biakinncing palikte in a muh uh ciangin "Singlamteh tungah that in, singlamteh tungah that in!" ci-in a kiko uh hi. Pilat in amaute kiangah, "Na ut uhleh paipih unla, singlamteh tungah that un! Ke'n ama khialhna ka mu kei hi," a cih ciangin
Jew mihonte in, "Amah Pasian' Tapa-in kigen ahih manin a kithah theih nading Thukham ka nei uh hi," ci-in a genna uh
Pilat in a zak ciangin a lunghimawh semsem hi.
Tua ahih manin kumpi inn huang sungah lutkikin Jesuh kiangah, "Koi lai panin a hong pai na hi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi. Ahi zongin Jesuh in dawng lo ahih manin,
"Hong dawng lo ding na hi hiam? Nang thahtheih nading le khahtheih nading thu ka neihlam phawk lo na hi hiam?" a cih ciangin
Jesuh in, "Pasian in nang tungah hong pia lo hileh kei tungah thu na nei het kei ding hi. Tua ahih manin nangma khut sungah kei hong apte' mawhna lianzaw hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Pilat in hih thu a zak ciangin Jesuh a khahtheih nading lampi zongin a hanciam hi. Ahi zongin Jew mihonte awngin kiko uh a, "Hih mipa na khah peuhmah leh Rom gam khempeuh a uk Kumpipa tawh a kipawl lo na hi ding hi. Kumpi hi'ng, a ci khempeuh pen gam khempeuh a uk Kumpipa a langpang ahi hi," a ci uh hi.
Pilat in hih bangin mite' kikona a zak ciangin Jesuh paikhiatpih a, Hebru pau-in Gabbatha a kici Suangphahpek tunga thukhenna tokhom tungah a tu hi.
Tua ni pen Paisan Pawi hun ding Kigin' ni hi a, sunkim laitak hun ahi hi. Pilat in Jew mihonte kiangah, "Hih lai-ah na Kumpipa uh om!" a cih ciangin
amaute in, "That in, that in, singlamteh tungah that in," ci-in a kiko uh hi. Pilat in, "Na Kumpipa uh that mawk ding ka hi hiam?" a cih ciangin siampi liante in, "Rom gam khempeuh a uk Kumpipa simloh kumpi dang ka nei kei uh hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin singlamteh tungah thah dingin amaute' khut sungah Jesuh a pia ta hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute in Jesuh la-in paikhiatpih uh a, ama kikhai nading singlamteh mah puasakin Hebru pau-in Golgotha a kici Lutang Guh mualah a paipih uh hi.
Tua lai mun panin singlamteh tungah khai uh a, ama langtuakah zong midang khat tuak mah khai-in a laizangah Jesuh a kikhai hi.
Pilat in lai khat gelhsakin, "Jew mite' Kumpipa, Nazareth khuami Jesuh," cisak a, singlamteh tungah a suangsak hi.
Jesuh a kikhaina mun pen Jerusalem khuapi tawh kinai ahih manin Judea gammi tampi in hih lai kigelh a sim uh hi. Tua lai pen Hebru lai, Latin lai, le Grik lai-in a kigelh hi.
Tua ciangin Jew siampi liante in Pilat kiangah, "'Jew mite' Kumpipa,' ci-in gelh kei inla, 'Hih mipa in Jew mite' kumpi ka hi hi, ci hi,' ci-in gelh in," a cih uhleh
Pilat in, "Ka gelhsa pen ka gelhsa bangbangin kip hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Galkapte in singlamteh tungah Jesuh a khai khit uh ciangin a puante la uh a, khenkhat ciatin a ngah dingun khen li a suah uh hi. Mong a nei lo, a kiphan a puantualpi zong a la uh hi.
Ahi zongin amaute in, "Hih puan balkek kei ni. A ngah ding i theih nadingin ai san ni," a kici uh hi. Lai Siangtho sungah, "Amaute in ka puante hawm uh a, ka puantualpi ngah nadingin ai a san uh hi," ci-in a kigelhna a tun nadingin hih bangin galkapte a gamta ahi uh hi.
Jesuh' singlamteh gei-ah ama nu; ama nuno ahi, Klopas' zi Mary; le Magdala khuami Mary a ding uh hi.
Jesuh in ama nu le a it a nungzui pa a dingkhawm a muh ciangin a nu kiangah, "Nu aw, tua lai-ah na tapa om hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a nungzui pa kiangah, "Na nu tua lai-ah om hi," a ci leuleu hi. Tua ahih manin tua hun a kipanin nungzui pa in ama inn-ah Jesuh' nu Mary a kem hi.
Tua hun ciangin Jesuh in na khempeuh kicingta hi, ci-in thei ahih manin Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh thu a tuntheih nadingin, "Ka dangtak hi," a ci hi.
Tua lai-ah beel khat dimin leenggahzu-hau om ahih manin amaute in tua sungah tuihupna diahin puknah hiang dawnah a koih khit uh ciangin Jesuh' kamah a va tahto uh hi.
Jesuh in tua leenggahzu-hau ciamin, "Man khinta hi," a cih khit ciangin a lu puksukin a si ta hi.
Tua ni pen Kigin' ni hi a, a zing ciang Sabbath ni thupi diak ahih manin tua ni-in singlamteh tungah a luangte a omlai ding deih lo uh ahih ciangin Jerusalem khua-a Jew mi uliante, Pilat kiangah va pai-in a khete uh kuaitanin a luangte a lakkhiat nadingun a ngen uh hi.
Tua ahih manin galkapte hong pai uh a, a tuah masak pa uh a khe a kuaihtansak khit uh ciangin a langkhat a om pa a' zong a kuaihtansak uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh' khe kuaitan dingin a kithawi uh ciangin amah a na sihkhitna thei uh ahih manin a khe a kuaihtansak nawn kei uh hi.
Ahi zongin galkapte khat in a teipi tawh Jesuh' pangpi a sut leh sisan le tui hong leengkhia hi.
(Note in na uptheih nadingun hih thupiang a mu pa in ama muhna bang a hong gen ahi hi. Ama thugente a man thu hi a, a gen pa in a mantaktak a gen ahihna thu zong a thei hi.)
Lai Siangtho sungah, "Ama guhte khat zong kitan lo ding hi," ci-in a genna thu a tuntheih nadingin hih bangin a piang ahi hi.
Tua banah Lai Siangtho mun dang khatah, "Teipi tawh a sut pa uh a en ding uh hi," na kici lai hi.
Tua ciangin Arimathea khuami Josef in Jesuh' luang a lakkhiat theih nadingin Pilat kiangah va pai-in a ngen hi. (Josef i cih pen Jesuh' nung a zui khat hi a, ahi zongin Jerusalem khua-a Jew uliante a kihtakna hangin a simzuih khat ahi hi.) Josef in Jesuh' luang a lakkhiat theih nadingin thu ngah ahih manin va pai-in Jesuh' luang a lakhia hi.
Jesuh kiangah a zan hawh ngei Nikodemas zong hong pai a, Jesuh' luang a siatloh nadingin a bawl nading myrrh le aloes paknamtui kigawm tawi sawmnih bang a gik a hong pua hi.
Tua mi nihte in si a vui uh ciangin a bawl ngeina bangun a paknamtuite nuhin puan tawh a tun uh hi.
Jesuh, singlamteh tungah a kithahna mun tawh kinai-ah huan khat om a, tua huan sungah kuamah a kivui ngei nai lohna hankhuk thak khat a om hi.
Tua ni pen Kigin' ni hi a, Jew mite' Sabbath ni hong naita ahih manin, tua hankhuk a nai ahihna hangin nawhsa thu-in tua lai munah Jesuh a vui uh hi.
Nipi ni zingsang khuavak ma-in Magdala khuami Mary zong hanah va pai-in a et ciangin hankhuk kihukna suangtum a kilikkhia khin a mu hi.
Amah zong tai-in Simon Peter le Jesuh in a it a nungzui pa kiangah, "Amaute in hankhuk panin i Topa lakhia khin uh a, koi lai-ah koih ahi uh hiam, cih ka thei kei uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin nungzui dang khat pa tawh Peter zong paikhia-in han lam a manawh uh hi.
A nih tuakun taikhawm uh a, ahi zongin nungzui dang khat pa in Peter makhelhin hanah a tung masa hi.
Hankhuk sung a etsuk ciangin a kitunna puante a om mu a, ahi zongin lutsuk lo hi.
Ama nungah Simon Peter hong tungin han sungah a lutsukpah hi. A luang tunna puan mu a,
a lu tunna puan pen a luang tunna tawh omkhawm loin a tuamin a kizialin a om a mu hi.
Tua ciangin han a tung masa nungzui dang pa zong lutsukin a thupiangte mu ahih manin a um hi.
(Sihna panin thokik ding hi, ci-in Lai Siangtho in a genna thu a theithei nai lo uh ahi hi.)
Tua ciangin nungzuite a inn uhah a ciah uh hi.
Ahi zongin han pualamah Mary kap a, a kahkawmin hankhuk sung lamah kunin en a,
Jesuh' luang a kisialna a lu lamah khat, a khe lamah khat, puanpak silhin a tu vantungmi nih a mu hi.
Tua vantung mite in Mary kiangah, "Bang hangin kap na hi hiam?" ci-in a dot uh ciangin amah in, "Amaute in ka Topa paikhiatpih uh a, koi lai-ah koih ahi uh hiam, cih ka thei kei hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua khit ciangin a kihei leh Jesuh mu a, ahi zongin Jesuh ahihlam thei lo hi.
Jesuh in, "Numei aw, bang hangin kap na hi hiam? Kua zong na hi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin Mary in huan cing pa sa ahih manin, "Sia aw, amah na puakkhiat leh koi lai-ah koih na hi hiam hong gen in. A luang ka la nuam hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Mary!" a cih leh Mary zong ama lamah kihei a, "Rabboni," ci-in a dawng hi. (Rabboni pen Hebru pau hi a, "Siapa," a cihna ahi hi.)
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Kei hong lenlen nawn kei in. Ka Pa kiangah a paito nai lo ka hi hi. Ka sanggamte kiangah va pai inla, 'Keima Pa le note' Pa, keima Pasian le note' Pasian' kiangah ka pai ding hi,' ci hi, ci-in va gensak zaw in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Magdala khuami Mary zong nungzuite kiangah pai-in Topa a muh khitna thu va gen a, hih a kam vaikhakte zong a zasak hi.
Tua ni pen Nipi ni nitak lam hi a, nungzuite zong a nitakin innsung khatah a kikhop laitakun Jerusalem khua-a Jew mi uliante a kihtakna uh hangin inn a kikalhnelh uh hi. Tua bang hinapi-in amaute lakah Jesuh hong ding a, "Nopna ngah ta un," ci-in a hopih hi.
Tua bangin a hopih khit ciangin a khutte le a pangpi zong a lak hi. Topa a muhna hangun nungzuite a nuam mahmah uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Note in nopna ngah ta un. Pa in kei a hong sawl bangin note zong ka hong sawl hi," ci-in a vaikhak leuleu hi.
Tua khit ciangin amaute lamah a hu sang a, "Kha Siangtho na sang un.
Mite' mawhna na maisak uhleh amaute' mawhna a mai hi ding a, na maisak kei uhleh amaute' mawhna a mai lo hi ding hi," a ci hi.
Nungzuite kiangah Jesuh a kilah laitakin sawm le nihte sung panin Unau Peeng minno a nei Thomas om lo hi.
Tua ahih manin nungzui dangte in ama kiangah, "Topa ka mu uh hi," a cih uhleh amah in, "A khut, siktukkilh tawh a kikilhna mate mu-in, tua a siktukkilh ma vangah ka khutmete ka va khum teek kei a, ama pangpi zong ka khut tawh ka lawn' teek kei leh ka um kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua zawh nipikal khat ciangin nungzuite zong innsung khatah kikhawm leuleu uh a, tua hunin Thomas zong a om hi. Amaute kong kikhaknelh uh hinapi-in Jesuh hong pai-in amaute lakah hong ding a, "Nopna ngah ta un," ci-in a hopih khit ciangin
Thomas kiangah, "Na khutme tawh hong lawng inla ka khutte en in. Na khut zan inla ka pangpi zong lawng in. Umlah nawn kei inla, um taktak in," a ci hi.
Thomas in zong, "Ka Topa, ka Pasian!" ci-in a dawn ciangin
Jesuh in, "Kei na hong muhkhit ciang bekin hong um pan na hi hiam? Kei hong mu lo napi-in hong umte a dingin lungdamhuai mahmah zaw ding hi," a ci hi.
Jesuh in a nungzuite' muhna-ah nalamdang lian tampi bawl a, ahi zongin hih laibu sungah a kigelh lo tampi tak omlai hi.
Hih laibu sungah a kigelh thute pen Jesuh, Pasian' Tapa, Khrih ahihna thu na uptheih nading uh le ama min hangin tua upna tawh nuntakna na ngahtheih nading uh deihna tawh a kigelh ahi hi.
Tua khit ciangin a nungzuite omna Tiberias Tuili gei-ah Jesuh kilang leuleu a, a thu pianzia hih bang ahi hi:
Simon Peter, Unau Peeng minno a nei Thomas, Galilee gam Kana khuami Nethanel, Zebedi' tapate, le nungzui dang nihte mun khatah a omkhawm uh hi.
Simon Peter in a lawmte kiangah, "Kei, ngasa bengin kuan ning," ci-in a gen leh a lawmte in, "Ko zong hong kuan nung," ci uh ahih manin, amaute kuankhia-in gunkuang tungah a tuang uh hi. Ahi zongin tua zanin ngasa khat zong man lo uh hi.
Zingsang khua a vak ciangin tui gei-ah Jesuh ding a, ahi zongin a nungzuite in amah ahihlam thei lo uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Tangvalte aw, ngasa na man uh hiam?" ci-in a dot leh amaute in, "Bangmah ka man kei uh hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Na gunkuang taklam pang uhah na ngen uh paai le-uhcin na man ding uh hi," a ci hi. Amaute in zong a ngen uh paai uh a, ngasa tam awk lua ahih manin a ngen uh a kaizo kei uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in a it nungzui pa in Peter kiangah, "Topa hi!" a ci hi. Simon Peter in Topa ahihna thu a zak ciangin (a nga betna uhah a puante uh suahkhia uh ahih manin) a puan silh buatbuatin tui sungah a leengkhia hi.
Nungzui dangte ahihleh gunkuang mahah tuangin a ngen uh tawh ngasa a dimtakin a hong kai uh hi. Tua lai mun le a tui gei pen pi zathum bang bek kigamla hi.
Tui gei a tun uh ciangin mei-am tungah ngasa le anlum a ki-em a mu uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Tu-a na ngasa matte uh pawlkhat hong paipih un," ci-in a gen ciangin
Simon Peter zong gunkuang tungah va kahin ngasa a dimin a om ngen va kai a, ngasa a vekpi-in za le sawmnga le thum pha-in tam mahmah napi-in a ngen uh themkhat zong kikeek lo hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Hong pai un; zing an ne ni," a ci hi. Amah pen Topa ahih lamtak thei uh ahih manin, "Nang kua na hi hiam?" ci-in a nungzuite khat beek in dong ngam lo uh hi.
Jesuh hong pai-in anlum la-in amaute tungah pia a, tua mah bangin ngasa zong a pia hi.
Hih pen sihna panin Jesuh a kithawhkiksak khitzawh nungzuite tungah a kilah a thum veina hita hi.
An a nekkhit uh ciangin Jesuh in Simon Peter kiangah, "Johan' tapa Simon aw, hih adang khempeuhte' hong it sangin kei na hong nak itzaw hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin amah in, "Topa aw, ka hong itzaw hi. Nang ka hong itna na thei hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Ka tuunote na kem in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh in a nihveina dong leuleu a, "Johan' tapa Simon aw, kei na hong it hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin, "Topa aw, nang ka hong it a, ka hong itna thu na thei hi," a cih ciangin, "Ka tuute na kem in," a ci leuleu hi.
Jesuh in a thumveina dong leuleu a, "Johan' tapa Simon aw, kei na hong it hiam?" a cih ciangin, "Kei na hong it hiam?" ci-in thumvei tak a dotna hangin Peter zong a dah suak hi. Tua ahih manin, "Topa aw, nangmah in na khempeuh na thei a, nangmah ka hong itna thu zong na thei hi," ci-in a dawn ciangin Jesuh in, "Ka tuute na kem in.
A mantakin ci lehang, na khangno lai-in na kawnggak gakin na utna peuhah na pai zialzial thei hi. Ahi zongin na khangham ciangin na khutte na zan ding a, midangte in na khutte hong henin na ut loh napi ah hong paipih ding uh hi," a ci hi.
(Hih bangin a thugenna pen Peter a sih nading zia le Pasian' min a thansak nading thu a gen nopna ahi hi.) Tua ciangin Jesuh in Peter kiangah, "Hong zui un," a ci hi.
Peter a kihei ciangin, nitak an a nek lai-un Jesuh' gei-ah tu-in, "Topa aw, nang kua in hong lehhek ding ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong, Jesuh' it a nungzui pa ama nungah a om a mu hi.
Peter in amah a muh ciangin Jesuh kiangah, "Topa aw, hih mipa bangci ding ahi hiam?" ci-in a dot leh
Jesuh in, "Ka hong paikik mateng amah a nungta dingin ka deih nakleh nang bang phamawh sa na hi hiam? Nangmah in ka nung hong zui peuh in," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ahih manin hih nungzui pa si lo ding hi, ci-in a nungzuite lakah a kigen hi. Ahi zongin Jesuh in, "Amah si lo ding hi," a ci hi loin, "Ka hong paikik mateng amah a nungta dingin ka deih nakleh nang bang phamawh sa na hi hiam?" a ci bek ahi hi.
Jesuh in tua a cih nungzui pa pen hih thute genin lai sungah a gelh pa hi a, ama thugente a mantaktak hi, ci-in ka thei uh hi.
Jesuh in a sep thute tampi tak omlai hi. A sep khempeuh a ban banin laibu sungah a kigelh hileh a laibute pen leitungah ta zo lo ding hi, ci-in ka um hi.
Lawm Theofilas aw, Lai ka hong gelh masakna sungah Jesuh in nasep a kipat tung a kipanin vantungah amah a kilaktoh hun ciang dong, a thuhilhna le a septe khempeuh cingtakin ka gelh hi. Ama sawltak dingin a teelsa mite, Kha Siangtho tungtawnin thu a vaikhak khit ciangin vantungah amah kilato hi.
Ama sih khitzawh ni sawmli sung amaute tungah tam veipi kilang a, amah a nungta taktak ahihna teltakin a kithei ahi hi. Amaute in amah mu uh a, Pasian' Ukna thu amaute tungah a gen hi.
Amaute tawh a omkhawm laitakin amah in amaute kiangah, "Jerusalem khua panin paikhia kei unla, note kiangah ka hong gensa ka Pa' hong kamciam thu na ngak un.
Johan in tui sungah mite phum a, ahi zongin a sawt loin Pasian in Kha Siangtho tawh note hong kidimsak ding hi," ci-in thu a pia hi.
Tua bangin Jesuh tawh a omkhawm laitakun sawltakte in Jesuh kiangah, "Topa aw, tutungin Israel minamte tungah ukna aana na piakik ding hiam?" ci-in a dot uh ciangin
Jesuh in, "Ka Pa in ama thu tawh a sehsa hun le nite, cik ciangin hong tung ding cih thu note' theih ding thu hi lo hi.
Ahi zongin note tungah Kha Siangtho hong tun ciangin vangliatna tawh na kidim ding uh a, Jerusalem khuasung, Judea gam sung, Samaria gam sung, le leimong dongin note in keima thu na gen ding uh hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Hih thu a genkhit ciangin amaute' muhtangpi mahin vanah Jesuh kilato a, meiipi in liah ahih manin amah mu thei nawn lo uh hi.
Tua bangin Jesuh a kilaktoh ciangin amaute in vantung lam enenin a om laitakun amaute kiangah puanpak a silh mi nih hong dingvat a,
"Galilee mite aw, bang hangin vantung lam enin ding niloh na hi uh hiam? Note kiang panin vantungah a kilato hih Jesuh pen, vantungah a paitoh na muh uh bang teekteek mahin khatvei hong paisuk kik ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jerusalem pan tai lang bang a gamla tua Oliv Mual tung panin Jerusalem-ah sawltakte a ciahkik uh hi.
Jerusalem a tun uh ciangin amauteng, Peter, Johan, James le Andru, Filip le Thomas, Bartholomew le Matthai, Alfeas' tapa James, Simon (gam khual pa), le James' tapa Judas a tunna uh inn dei-ah a kahto uh hi.
Numeite, Jesuh' nu Mary, le Jesuh' naute tawh thungen khawm dingin a kikhawm zelzel uh hi.
Tua khit a sawt loin thu um mi zakhat le sawmnih bang a kikhop khawm laitakun Peter hong dingin thu hong gen a,
"Lawmte aw, Jesuh a mante lam a lak Judas thu, Kha Siangtho in David' kam panin a genkholhna Lai Siangtho sung thu a tun ding kisam hi.
Judas pen eite tawh na a semkhawm dingin a kiteelkhia ahih manin eima pawl mi ahi hi.
("Tu-in hih mipa in a gitloh gamtatna thamanin a ngah sum tawh amah in lo khat lei a, tua lo sungah kia-in a si hi. Amah kitamzan a, a sungkua khempeuh kithehkek hi.
Jerusalem khuasunga teng mi khempeuh in hih thu za uh a, amau' pau-in tua lo pen 'Akeldama,' ci uh hi. Akeldama a khiatna in, 'Mi Thahna Lo,' a cihna ahi hi.)
"Bang hang hiam cih leh Late Laibu sungah, 'Ama tenna mun gamdai hen la, tua munah kuamah teng kei hen,' kici a, tua banah, 'Ama nasep midang khat in sem ta hen,' ci-in kigelh hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Topa Jesuh' thawhkikna thu teci pangin a hong genpih dingin Judas tangin mi khat i lak ding kisam hi. Tua mipa pen Johan' tuiphum kipat hun a kipanin Jesuh vanah a kilaktoh hun ciang dong, Jesuh' nasepna khempeuhah eite tawh a omkhawm mi khat ahih ding kisam hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Josef (min dang nih a nei, Barsabbas le Justas zong a kici pa) le Matthias a pulak uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in thu ngen uh a, "Mihing khempeuh' lungsim sung thu a thei Topa aw, ama om nadingin a kilawm munah a om dingin sawltak nasep panin a hong paisan Judas tang dingin, hih mi nih sung panin na teel penpen hong hilh in," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin a teel nadingun lai ai san uh a, Matthias in ngah ahih manin sawltak sawm le khatte tawh a kisim khawm pah hi.
Pentekos ni hong tun ciangin Jesuh a um mi khempeuh mun khatah kikhawm uh hi.
Tua laitakin huihpi nung bangin huging khat hong tungvat a, amaute' kikhopna innsung khempeuh hong dim hi.
Tua ciangin leii tawh a kibang meikuang bang pian amaute lakah hong kithehthang a, tuate in mi khempeuh sukha kim hi.
Amaute khempeuh Kha Siangtho tawh kidim uh a, tua Kha in minam dangte' pau tawh amaute a pau theisak hi.
Tua laitakin biakna pawi siim dingin gam tuamtuam panin a hong pai Jew mi biakna hahkat mi tampi tak, Jerusalem khua sungah a om uh hi.
Hih huging a zak uh ciangin mihon tampi tak hong kikhawm uh a, hih Jesuh a um mite' thugen pen amau' pau ciatin za uh ahih manin lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi.
Amaute in hih thu lamdangsa mahmah uh ahih manin, "Hih thugen mite pen Galilee mi vive hi lo ahi hiam?
Tua hinapi-in bang hangin amaute' thugen pen eima pau ciatin za ihi hiam?
Eite pen Parthia gam, Media gam, Elam gam, Mesopotamia gam, Judea gam, Kappadosia gam, Pontas gam, Asia gam,
Frigia gam, Pamfilia gam, Egypt gam, le Sairin khuapi gei-a om Libya gamte pan ihi a, pawlkhatte Rom gam pan ihi hi.
Jew mite le Gentail mi Jew biakna a zuite ihi a, pawlkhatte pen Krete gam le Arabia gam pan ihi hi. Tua bang hinapi-in, Pasian' sep na lamdang liante a kigenna eima pau ciatin i za hi," a ci uh hi.
Amaute in lamdangsa-in lungmang mahmah uh a, "A bangci thu ahi hiam?" ci-in khatlekhat a kidong uh hi.
Ahi zongin mi pawlkhatte in hih Jesuh a umte simmawhbawl uh a, "Zukham ahi uh hi," ci-in a zahko uh hi.
Tua ciangin sawltak sawm le khatte tawh a omkhawm Peter hong dingto-in, mihonte tungah nakpitakin thu hong gen a, "Ka mipih ahi Jew mite le Jerusalem khuasunga om mi khempeuhte aw, hih thupiang hong gen ding ka hih manin limtakin na ngai un.
Tuhun pen zingsang nai kua hi pan ahih manin, note' ngaihsut bangin hih mite zukham hi lo uh hi.
Hih thupiang pen kamsang Joel in a gensa thu hi a, tua sungah,
'Pasian in hih bangin gen hi: Nitawp ni ciangin, mi khempeuh tungah ka Kha ka sung ding a, na tanute uh le na tapate un keima thu taangko ding uh hi; na tangvalte un maang mu ding uh a, na puteekte un mang man ding uh hi.
Tua ni ciangin ka nasem numeite le ka nasem pasalte' tung nangawnah ka Kha ka sung ding a, amaute in keima thu gen ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin vantung le leitungah hilhkholhna lim le nalamdang ka bawl ding hi. Sisan kiluansakna, meikatna le meikhu sahpi hong om ding hi.
Topa' ni, a lian thupi ni, hong tunma-in ni hong mialin, kha, sisan hong bang ding hi.
Ahi zongin Topa tungah huhna a ngen khempeuh in hotkhiatna ngah ding uh hi,' ci-in a kigelh hi.
"Ka mipih Israel-te aw, hih ka thugen na ngai un: Nazareth khuami Jesuh tungtawnin Pasian in lim le na lamdangte bawlin na hong sem ahih manin, Jesuh pen Pasian' sawl nasem ahihna teltakin na thei uh hi. Hih thu pen note lakah a piang thu ahih manin nomau mahmah in na thei uh hi.
Pasian in thu a ma theihkholhna le ama geelna tawh kizui-in note' khut sungah tua Jesuh a hong piak ding a ngaihsutsa hi a, note in singlamteh tungah khai-in migilote' khut tawh amah na that uh hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in misite lak panin amah hingkiksak a, sihna in amah lencip zo lo ahih manin sihna hanga gimna panin amah a suaktasak hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh David in ama thu a genna-ah, "'Topa ka maingat tawntung a, ka taklamah amah om ahih manin lungkhamna ka thuak kei ding hi.
Tua ahih manin ka lungdam a, kei ka nuam hi. A si thei mihing ka hih lel hangin lungmuang takin ka om ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh misite' gamah kei nong nusiacip kei ding a, na nasem keimah muatna nong thuaksak kei ding hi.
Nangmah in nuntakna lampi na hong lak khin a, nong ompihna tawh kei nong lungdamsak hi,' ci hi.
"Sanggamte aw, note' theih dingin i pupi David' thu a teltakin kong gen ding hi. Amah si-in kivui a, a han zong tu mahmahin eite kiangah omlai hi.
David pen kamsang hi a, ama tunga Pasian' thuciam a thei hi. Ama suante khat, amah bang teek mahin kumpi-in a bawl nading Pasian in thu a ciam hi.
Pasian in a sep ding thu David in mukhol ahih manin, 'Mi site gam sungah amah kinusia lo a, a sa a muat kei hi,' ci-in a gen ciangin, Khrih' thawhkik nading thu a gengen ahi hi.
Pasian in sihna panin hih Jesuh hingkiksak a, kote khempeuh pen hih thu a thei teci vive ka hi uh hi.
Amah in Pasian' taklamah omna dongin liatna ngah a, ama tungah Pasian in a ciamsa Kha Siangtho zong a ngahkhin hi. Tu laitak a na muh na zak uh nate pen kote tungah a hong piak tua Kha Siangtho ahi hi.
David pen vantungah a kahtoh loh hangin amah in, 'Topa in keima Topa kiangah: Na khe nuai-ah na galte kong koihsak matengin ka taklamah na tu in, ci-in gen hi,' ci hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin singlamteh tungah na thah uh hih Jesuh pen Pasian in Topa le Khrih in a bawl khitna thu, Israel mi khempeuh in teltakin thei ta un," a ci hi.
Amaute in hih thu a zak uh ciangin a lungsim uh nakpitakin sukha a, Peter le sawltak dangte kiangah, "Sanggamte aw, bangci gamtat ding ka hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Tua ciangin Peter in amaute kiangah, "Na mawhna uh kisik unla, na mawhna uh hong kimaisak theih nadingin Jesuh Khrih min tawh tui kiphum ciat un. Tua hileh Pasian' piakkhong Kha Siangtho na ngah ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in ama kamciamna pen note tung, na suan na khakte uh tung le gamlapi-a om mi khempeuh, i Topa Pasian in a sap mi khempeuh tungah a hong bawl ahi hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Peter in amaute tungah thu tampi genthuahin hanthawn a, "Hih migilote' gimthuak ding na tuahkhak loh nadingun nomau mah in na suahtak nading uh lampi zong ciat un," a ci hi.
Mi tampi in ama thugen umin tui kiphum uh a, tua ni-in mihing tulthum bang kibehlap uh hi.
Amaute in sawltakte tung panin thu sinin amaute tawh kikhawl uh a, amaute tawh an nekhawmin, thu zong a ngenkhawm uh hi.
Sawltakte in lim le nalamdang tampi bawl uh a, mi khempeuh in lamdang sa mahmah uh hi.
Thu um khempeuh kikhawlin omkhawm uh a, a neihsate uh zong a neikhawm uh hi.
Amaute in a neih a lamteng uh zuak uh a, a sumte pen amau kisapna tawh kizui-in amaute lakah a hawm uh hi.
Nisimin biakinn-ah kikhawm uh a, a innte uhah an nekhawmin, lungdamna le kiniamkhiatna tawh a ne ciat uh hi.
Pasian phat uh a, khatlekhat thupha kideihsakin a om uh hi. Pasian in nisimin hotkhiatna a ngah mi kibehlapsak tawntung hi.
Nikhat, thunget hun nitak nai thum laitakin biakinn-ah Peter le Johan a pai uh hi.
Kongpi Hoih a kici gei-ah a suahtung a kipan a khebai mi khat na om hi. Biakinn-ah a pai mite tung panin sum a ngen dingin nisimin hih kongpi gei-ah amah hong kikoih zel hi.
Peter le Johan, biakinn-ah a hong pai a muh ciangin sum a na ngen hi.
Amau tegel in tua mipa limtakin en uh a, Peter in, "Kote hong en dih in," a ci hi.
Bang khat peuhpeuh ngah ding, ci-in kilamen ahih manin amaute a en hi.
Peter in ama kiangah, "Sum ka nei peuhmah kei hi; ahi zongin ka neih kong pia ding hi. Nazareth khuami Jesuh Khrih min tawh, dingin lam na pai nadingin thu ka hong pia hi," a cih khit ciangin,
a taklam khutin lenin kaito a, thakhat thu-in a khe le a siakmitte hong khauhpah hi.
Tua ciangin amah hong diangin dingto a, lam a pai kawikawi hi. Tua ciangin biakinn-ah amaute zui a, lam paikawm diangkawmin Pasian a phat hi.
Mi khempeuh in amah lam pai-in Pasian a phatna mu uh a,
biakinn Kongpi Hoih gei-ah sum ngenin a tupa hi, ci-in a thei uh hi. Ama tunga thupiang a muh uh ciangin lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi.
Tua mipa in Peter le Johan beel cinten a, mi khempeuh in hih thupiang lamdangsa uh ahih manin amaute' omna Solomon' Talap a kici-ah mite a hong tai uh hi.
Peter in hih mite a muh ciangin amaute kiangah, "Ka mipih Israel mite aw, bang hangin hih thupiang lamdangsa a, bang hangin ko hong hici et na hi uh hiam? Hih mipa lam ka paisak theihna uh, komau' vang le komau' hoihna hang sa na hi uh hiam?
I pupite Abraham, Isaac, le Jakob Pasian in a nasem Jesuh tungah ama vangliatna a pia hi. Note in aana neite khut sungah tua Jesuh na pia uh a, Pilat mangpa in amah khah dingin a ngaihsut khit ciang nangawnin Pilat' maitang mahah amah na nial teitei uh hi.
Amah mi hoih mi siangtho hinapi-in, amah na nial zawsop uh a, mi that khat a khahkhiat nadingin Pilat kiangah na ngen uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mite tungah nuntakna a piapa na that uh a, ahi zongin sihna panin Pasian in amah hingkiksak hi. Ko tegel pen hih thu a thei teci ka hi uh hi.
Hih Jesuh min' vangliatna in hih khebai mipa tungah thahatna a pia ahi hi. Note khempeuh in na theih uh mah bangin hih mipa bangzah takin khebai ahih hangin Jesuh upna le ama min hangin hih mipa in dam sianthona a ngah ahi hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin sanggamte aw, note le na makaite uh hih bangin Jesuh tungah na gamtatna uh na theih lohna hang uh hi, ci-in ka thei hi.
Ama Khrih in a thuak nading thu, Pasian in tanglai pekin kamsangte khempeuh tungtawnin genkhol a, tu-in hih bangin a thugen kholhna a hong tungsak ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin na mawhnate uh hong sawpsiangsak theih nading, Topa kiang panin a hong pai lungsim nopna hun na ngah theih nading uh le note a dingin a sehsa Jesuh Khrih a hong sawltheih nadingin na mawhna uh kisik unla, Pasian kiang zuan un.
Pasian in ama kamsang mi siangthote tungtawnin tanglai-in a genkholhsa bangin, na khempeuh a thakin a kibawl hun dong mateng vantungah Jesuh a om ding ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Moses in, 'Kei a hong sawl mah bangin note sung mah panin note a' ding kamsang khat Topa na Pasian un note kiangah hong sawl ding hi. Ama hong thugen khempeuh na mang ding uh hi.
Tua kamsangpa' thugen a mang lo khempeuh, a Jew mipihte kiang panin kikhen khia-in kisusia ding hi,' ci hi.
Samuel a kipan ama nunga hong piang kamsang khempeuh in tu laitak a thupiangte mah genkhol ciat uh hi.
Pasian in Abraham kiangah, 'Na suan na khakte thupha ka piak bangin leitung mi khempeuh thupha ka pia ding hi,' ci ahih manin, Pasian in ama kamsangte tungtawnin a thuciamte khempeuh eite a' ding hi a, Pasian in i pu i pate tawh a thuciamte, eite in zong a ngah ding ihi hi.
Eite khempeuh i gitlohna panin kikheelin thupha a hong piaktheih nadingin Pasian in a Nasem dingin Jesuh teelin, eite kiangah a hong sawl masa ahi hi," ci-in thu a gen hi.
Peter le Johan omkhawmin, tua bangin Peter in mite kiangah thu a gen laitakin siampite, biakinn upate, le Saddusi mite hong pai uh hi.
Hih sawltak nihte in misite thokik ding hi, cih a lahtel nadingun sihna panin Jesuh thokik hi, ci-in mite kiangah thu hilh uh ahih manin nawngkai a sa uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amau tegel man uh a, ni tum kuanta ahih manin a zing ciang dong thong sungah a khum uh hi.
Ahi zongin amaute' thugen a za mi tampi in um uh a, thu um mi tulnga bang a pha ta uh hi.
A zing ciangin Jew mi makaite, upate, le Thukham hilh siate, Jerusalem-ah hong kikhawm uh hi.
Siampi lianpen a semngei Annas, siampi lianpen a sem Kaiafas, Johan, Alexander, le siampi lianpente beh mi khempeuh tawh kikhopna khat a bawl uh hi.
Amaute' mai-ah sawltak tegel dingsak uh a, "Kua' vangliatna le kua' min tawh hih bangin na sem na hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin Peter in dawng a, "Makaite le upate aw,
hih khebai mipa tungah thuhoih a kibawlna le ama damna thu tawh kisai-in kote thu hong sit na hih uhleh,
note in singlamteh tungah na thah uh, Pasian in sihna panin a thawhkiksak Nazareth khuami Jesuh Khrih min vangliatna tawh hih mipa a ci damin hih lai-ah ding ahihna thu, note le Israel mi khempeuh in na theih dingun a kilawm thu khat ahi hi.
Lai Siangtho in, 'No innlamte in na nilkhiat uh suangtum pen innkiu suang bulpi a suak hi,' ci-in a gen pen hih Jesuh ahi hi.
Ama hang bek tawh hotkhiatna kingah thei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh eite in hotkhiatna i ngahtheih nadingin leitung khempeuhah Pasian in hong piak min dang khat zong om lo hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Uliante in Peter le Johan a han' mahmahna thu le amaute pilna sang a nei lo mi mawkmawk ahihna thu a theih uh ciangin lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh tawh a kikhawl khin ngeite ahihna uh a phawk uh hi.
Ahi zongin a kidamsak mipa pen Peter le Johan-te gei-ah om gige ahih manin a nial nading uh thu mu zo lo uh hi.
Tua ahih manin tua innsung panin amaute pusuaksak phot uh a, tua khit ciangin amaute thu kikumin,
"Hih mite bangcih ding ihi hiam? Jerusalem khuasunga om mi khempeuh in hih mite' bawl a lamdang mahmah nate thei ciat uh a, i nial theih nading bangmah om lo hi.
Ahi zongin mite lakah hih thute a kitheihthang thuah loh nadingin, Jesuh' min tawh kuama kiangah thu a gen ngei nawn loh nadingun taii ni," a kici uh hi.
Tua ciangin sawltakte samkik uh a, Jesuh' min tawh thugen ahi a, thuhilh ahi zongin a hih nawn hetloh nadingun thu a pia uh hi.
Ahi zongin Peter le Johan in, "Note' thu manzawk ding le Pasian' thu manzawk ding, Pasian' muhna panin koi pen manzaw ding cih thu nomau mah in zong ngaihsun ciat un.
Tua ahih manin kote in ka muhsa uh le ka zaksa uh thute gen loin ka om thei kei ding uh hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Ahi zongin uliante in a khauhzaw-in thu a gen khit uh ciangin a khah uh hi. Hih thupiang hangin mi khempeuh in Pasian phat uh ahih manin hih mite gim a piak nading uh a thu mu thei lo uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh hih nalamdang a kibawlna mipa pen a khan kum sawmli val a pha khinsa mi khat ahi hi.
Peter le Johan a kikhahkhiat khit phetin a lawmte uh kiangah pai-in siampi liante le upate in amaute tungah a thugente khempeuh a zasak uh hi.
A lawmte un hih thu a zak uh ciangin a vekpi-un lungsim kikhatin Pasian' kiangah thu ngen uh a, "Van le lei, tuipi tuineu le a sunga om khempeuh a piangsak Topa aw,
kote' pupi, na nasempa David tungah na Kha Siangtho tawh thu na gen a, amah in, 'Bang hangin Gentail mite heh mahmah a, a tangtung lo dingpi vaihawm uh ahi hiam?
Topa le ama Khrih a do dingin leitung kumpite kithawi uh a, gam ukte kikaikhawm uh hi,' ci hi.
A cih mah bangin Herod le Pontias Pilat in hih khuapi sung teek mahah Gentail mite le Israel mite tawh kikupna nei uh a, nangmah in Khrih dingin na bawl, a siangtho na Nasempa Jesuh thah dingin a vaihawm uh hi.
Nangmah in na deihna bangin a piang dingin na vangliatna tawh na khensatsa thu khempeuh a sem dingin amaute kikhawm uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa aw, amaute in kote hong tawnnate thei inla, nangma nasem kote in lungsim han' mahmahna tawh nangma thu ka gentheih nadingun hong huh in.
Cinate damsak theih nading vangliatna hong pia inla, a siangtho na Nasempa Jesuh' min tawh nalamdang kibawl ta hen," a ci uh hi.
Tua bangin thu a nget khit uh ciangin amaute' kikhopna mun hong kilinggawp hi. Amaute khempeuh Kha Siangtho tawh kidim uh a, hang takin Pasian' thu gen ding a kipan uh hi.
Thu um mi khempeuh a lungsim uh le a ngaihsutna uh kikhat uh a, kuamah in ama neihsa kei-a' tuam ci loin, a neih khempeuh uh a neikhawm ciat uh hi.
Topa Jesuh' thawhkikna thu, sawltakte in vangliatna tawh teci pang uh a, Pasian in amaute khempeuh tungah thupha tampi a pia hi.
Inn ahi a, lo ahi zongin a neite in zuak uh a, a sum ngahte uh sawltakte kiangah a ap uh hi. Mi khempeuh tungah a kisapna bang ciat un a sumte hawm uh ahih manin amaute lakah sum kitangsam kuamah om lo uh hi.
Tua hi a, Saipras tuikulh-a suak, Levi mi Josef, sawltakte in Barnabas (Hanthawn Siampa a cihnopna) min a phuah pa in,
ama neih a lo zuak a, a sum hong paipihin sawltakte khut sungah a ap hi.
Ahi zongin Ananias a kici pasal khat le a zi Sapfira a kici, nupa kop khat om uh hi. A neihsa uh pawlkhat zuak uh a,
ahi zongin a zi tawh thukimin a sumte pawlkhat im-in, a dangteng sawltakte kiangah a va ap hi.
Peter in, "Ananias aw, bang hangin Satan' thu-in gamta a, na lo zuak man sumte pawlkhat kem simin, Kha Siangtho khem na hi hiam?
Tua lo na zuakma-in nangma a' hi a, na zuakkhit ciangin a sum zong nangma a' mah ahi hi. Tua hinapi-in bang hangin tua bangin gamtat ding ngaihsun peuhmah na hi hiam? Mite a khem hi loin Pasian a khem na hi hi," a ci hi.
Ananias in hih thu a zak phetin thakhatin si-in puksukpah a, hih thu a za mi khempeuh a lau mahmah uh hi.
Tua ciangin tangvalte hong kipanin puan tawh a luang tun uh a, puakhia-in a va vui uh hi.
Tua khit nai thum bang ding ciangin a zi hong pai a, ahi zongin tua lai-a thupiang bangmah thei lo hi.
Peter in tua nu kiangah, "Nang le na pasal in na lo zuak man uh sum pen a vekpi-in hih zah mah ahi hiam, hong gen dih in," ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, "Hi hi, tua zah mah hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Peter in tua nu kiangah, "Bang dingin na nupa-un Topa' Kha Siangtho ze-et ding thukim khawm na hi uh hiam? En in, na pasal a vuite kongkhak gei mahmahah om uh a, nang zong hong puakhia ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Amah zong thakhat thu-in si-in Peter khe kiangah a puksuk hi. Tua ciangin tangvalte hong lut uh a, a sih khitlam a muh uh ciangin puakhia-in a pasal' gei-ah a phum uh hi.
Pawlpi mi khempeuh le hih thu a za mi khempeuhte nakpitakin a lau uh hi.
Sawltakte in mite lakah lim le nalamdang tampi a bawl uh hi. Thu um mi khempeuh Solomon' Talap-ah kikhawmin a om uh hi.
Midangte in thupi sa-in hoihsa mahmah uh a, ahi zongin amaute pawlpih taktak ngam lo uh hi.
Topa' thu a um numei pasal tampi tak hong kibehlaplap uh hi.
Hih bangin sawltakte' nasepna hangin kongzingah cinate hong kipua a, Peter hong pai ciangin a liim in cinate a liahkhak theih nading deihin a lupna le a lupna pheekte uh tawh lam gei-ah a koih uh hi.
Jerusalem khua kiima om khuapite panin mite hong pai-in, cinate le dawivei mite hong paipih uh a, a vekpi-in damna a ngah uh hi.
Tua ciangin siampi lianpen pa le amah tawh a kipawl tua lai-a Saddusi mite in sawltakte haza-in thangpai uh ahih manin thu bawl ding a ngaihsun uh hi.
Tua ahih manin sawltakte manin thong sungah a khum uh hi.
Ahi zongin tua zanin Topa' vantungmi khat in thong kongkhakte hong a, sawltakte a paikhiatpih khit ciangin amaute kiangah,
"Biakinn-ah pai unla, hih nuntak thakna thu mite kiangah va gen un," ci-in a vaikhak hi.
Ama gen mah bangin sawltakte zong zingsang ciangin biakinn-ah pai-in thuhilh ding a kipan uh hi. Siampi lianpen pa le ama kikholhpihte in ulian kikhopna a cingtaak khat a omtheih nadingin Jew mi upa khempeuh a kikhop nadingun a sam uh hi. Tua khit ciangin thong panin sawltakte va kai-in uliante mai-ah a hong paipih nadingun palikte a sawl uh hi.
Ahi zongin thongah palikte a va tun uh ciangin sawltakte na om lo hi. Tua ahih manin uliante kiangah kileh kikin,
"Thongah ka tun uh ciangin a kongkhakte limtak mahin tawh kikalh a, thongcingte in zong kongpi-ah limtak mahin a na cing ka mu uh hi. Ahi zongin thong kong ka hon uh ciangin a sungah kuamah na om lo hi," ci-in a zasak uh hi.
Biakinn ukpa le siampi liante in hih thu a zak uh ciangin hih sawltakte a bangci thu hi ding hiam, ci-in lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi.
Tua laitakin mi khat hong pai-in amaute kiangah, "Thong sungah na khum uh mite in tu mahmahin biakinn sungah thuhilhin om uh hi," ci-in a hong gen hi.
Tua ciangin biakinn ukpa le a mite va pai-in sawltakte hong paipih kik uh hi. Mihonte in suang tawh amaute a dengawp khak ding lau uh ahih manin sawltakte ngongbawl loin thudam tawh a paipih uh hi.
Tua ciangin uliante mai-ah sawltakte dingsak uh a, siampi lianpen pa in sawltakte kiangah thu genin,
"Hih mipa' min tawh thu na hilh nawn loh nadingun khauhtakin thu kong pia uh hi. Tu-in na gamtatnasate uh thei un. Jerusalem khuasung khempeuhah thu na genthang uh a, ama sihna pen kote nong ngawh nuam uh hi," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Peter le sawltak dangte in, "Mite' thu sangin Pasian' thu ka mangzaw ding uh hi.
Note in singlamteh tungah Jesuh khai-in na thah khit uh ciangin i pu i pate' Pasian in sihna panin amah hingkiksak khinzo hi.
Israel mite kisik kikin Pasian in a mawhna uh a maisak theih nadingin Ukpi le Honpa-in tua Jesuh bawlin ama taklamah a tusak hi.
Hih thute thei-in teci a pangte pen ko sawltakte bek hi loin Kha Siangtho tawh zong ka hi uh a, tua Kha Siangtho pen amah a um mite tungah Pasian in a khongin a piak ahi hi," ci-in a dawngkik uh hi.
Uliante in hih thu a zak uh ciangin heh mahmah uh ahih manin sawltakte thah dingin a ngaihsun uh hi.
Ahi zongin amaute sung panin Farisi mi Gamaliel, Thukham hilh sia khat ahi, mi khempeuh in zong a zahtakbawl mipa khat hong ding a, tawlkhat sung sawltakte a kipusuahpih nadingin thu pia a,
tua khit ciangin a lawm uliante kiangah, "Israel mite aw, hih mite na bawl nading uh tawh kisai-in limtakin kidawm un.
Tuma lam tawlkhat lai-in Thudas a kici mi khat hong khang hi. Mi lian khat ka hi hi, ci-in gen a, mihing zali ding bang in amah pawlpih uh hi. Ahi zongin amah kithatin, a nungzui khempeuh kithehthang a, ama vai beita hi.
Hih thu a pian' khit ciangin, mi bangzah pha hiam, ci-in gam sung mi khempeuh a kisim laitakin Galilee mi Judas a kici mi khat hong khang leuleu a, amah in zong nungzui mihonpi mah a nei hi. Amah zong kithat leuleu a, a nungzuite kithehthangin maimang hi.
Tu-in zong tua bangmahin thu hong piang leuleu hi. Note kiangah kong gennop thu in: Hih mite bangmah cih kei unla, hici omsak lel un. Mihingte' bawltawm vaihawmna ahihleh ama thu-in hong bei lel ding hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian kiang panin a hong pai thu ahihleh na zo zo ngei kei ding uh hi. Pasian tawh a kido na hi ding uh hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Tua ahih manin uliante in Gamaliel' thugen a mang uh hi. Sawltakte samkik sak uh a, a sat khit uh ciangin Jesuh' min tawh thu a hilhkik ngei loh nadingun thu a pia uh hi. Tua khit ciangin sawltakte a khah uh hi.
Uliante omna panin sawltakte paikhia uh a, Jesuh' hangin mindaina a thuak dingin Pasian in kilawm hong sa hi, ci-in ngaihsun uh ahih manin a lungdam mahmah uh hi.
Nisimin biakinn sung le mite inn-ah thu hilh uh a, Jesuh, Khrih hi, cih Lungdamna Thu a gengen uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin thu um mi hong tam tektek a, Jew mite le Grik pau a zang Jew mite kikalah kiphunsanna thu hong om hi. Grik pau a zang Jew mite in, "Annek tuidawn, sumlepai hawmna-ah ka meigong numeite uh hong kipiaksak lo hi," ci-in lungkim lo uh hi.
Tua ahih manin sawltak sawm le nihte in thu um mi khempeuh samin kaikhawm uh a, "Kote in Pasian' thu hilh ding don man lo liangin annek tuidawn sumlepai vai-ah kong manlah ding uh kilawm lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin sanggamte aw, note lak panin pilna le Kha Siangtho a nei mihing sagih hong kitengkhia unla, hih thute a vaihawm dingin i koih ding hi.
Tua hileh kote in ka hun khempeuh uh thungetna le thuhilhna-in kong zang thei ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
A vekpi-un sawltakte' thugente thukimpih uh ahih manin, Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin upna a nei Stefen, Filip, Prokhoras, Nikanor, Timon, Parmenas, le Antiok khua pan Gentail mi ahi Jew biakna a zui Nikolas a teel uh hi.
Amaute in sawltakte kiangah hih mite paipih uh a, sawltakte in a lu tung uhah a khut uh nga-in thu a ngetsak uh hi.
Tua bangin Pasian' thu kizelin hong khang semsem hi. Jerusalem khua sungah thu um mi tampi tak hong kibehlap a, siampi tampi tak in zong Lungdamna Thu a hong um uh hi.
Pasian in Stefen' tungah thupha tampi tak pia-in vangliatna lianpi neisak a, amah in mite lakah lim le nalamdang lianpipi a bawl hi.
Ahi zongin mi pawlkhat in Stefen langpan' uh hi. Tua mite pen mite in, "Sal Suakta Mite," a cihte pawl uh hi a, Sairin khua le Alexandria khua panin a hong pai Jew mite ahi uh hi. Hih Jew mite, Silisia le Asia gam pan a hong pai Jew mite tawh kipawlin Stefen tawh thu kisel dingin hong kipan uh hi.
Ahi zongin Kha Siangtho in Stefen tungah pilna guan ahih manin amaute in thusel zo lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in mi cialin sumgolh pia uh a, "Moses le Pasian langpangin thu a genna ka za uh hi," cisak uh hi.
Amaute in hih bangin zuauna tawh mihonte, upate, le Thukham hilh siate a holhthawh uh hi. Tua ahih manin amaute hong pai-in Stefen man uh a, uliante mai-ah a hong paipih uh hi.
Tua ciangin zuauthu a gen dingin mi pawlkhat hong paipih uh a, "Hih mipa in a siangtho i biakinnpi le Moses Thukham gensia tawntung hi.
Hih Nazareth khuami Jesuh in biakinnpi phelgawpin, Moses tung pek panin a hong kipan ngeina khempeuh khelmang ding hi, ci-in a thuhilhna ka za uh hi," a cisak uh hi.
Ulian kikhopna sunga a kihel mi khempeuh in Stefen en uh a, a maitang pen vantungmi maitang tawh kibang hi, ci-in a mu kim uh hi.
Tua ciangin siampi lianpen pa in Stefen kiangah, "Tu-a amaute' gen bang takpi mah ahi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin
Stefen in, "Ute pate aw, ka thugen hong ngai un. I pupi Abraham, Haran khua-ah a tenma, Mesopotamia gamah a om lai-in, ama kiangah a minthang Pasian kilang a,
'Na gam na lei, na beh na phungte kiang panin paikhia inla, nangma tungah kong lah ding gamah pai in,' ci hi.
Amah zong Khaldea gam panin paikhia-in Haran khua-ah teng hi. A pa a sih khit ciangin Pasian in tu-a na tenna uh hih gamah amah na lalsak leuleu hi.
Pasian in Abraham tungah ama aituam dingin leitang khutpeek cia nangawn pia lo napi-in, amah le a suan a khakte tungah hih gam a piak nading thu a ciam hi. Pasian in tua thuciamna a piak laitakin Abraham in ta nei nai lo hi.
Tua bang hinapi-in, Pasian in Abraham kiangah, 'Na suan na khakte gam dangah tengin salin om ding uh a, kum zali sung nakpitakin gimna thuak ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin sila-in a nei gam mite tungah thu ka khen ding a, na suan na khakte tua gam panin paikhia-in hih lai gamah kei hong bia ding uh hi,' ci hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian in Abraham tungah kiciamna limin vun-atna ngeina na pia hi. Tua ahih manin Abraham in a tapa Isaac a suahzawh nipikal khat khit ciangin a vun at a, Isaac in a tapa Jakob' vun at leuleu a, Jakob in eite' pupite ahi a tapa sawm le nihte' vun na at leuleu hi.
"I pupi dangte in Josef na haza uh a, mi tungah na zuakin, a leite in Egypt gamah sal dingin a na zuaksawn uh hi. Ahi zongin Pasian in i pupi Josef na huh a,
a thuakna khempeuh panin na honkhia hi. Egypt kumpipa Faro' mai-ah Josef a tun ciangin Pasian in ama tungah pilna le a deihhuai gamtat hoih na guan hi. Tua ahih manin Faro in ama khutnuai-ah a gam a uksawn ding le a kumpi innsung khempeuh a van dingin a koih hi.
Tua ciangin Egypt gam le Kanaan gam khempeuhah kialpi tung a, mi khempeuh in haksatna thuak uh ahih manin i pupite in zong annek ding muzo nawn lo uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Egypt gamah an om hi, ci-in Jakob in thu a zak ciangin i pupite ahi a tapate a khatveina na na paisak hi.
A nihveina a pai uh ciangin a sanggamte tungah i pupi Josef na kipulak a, tua hun a kipanin Faro in zong Josef innkuansung thu na thei hi.
Tua ciangin Josef in a pa Jakob kiangah mi sawl a, amah a kipan a innkuan mi khempeuh Egypt-ah a pai nadingun a gensak hi. Tua hun laitakin Jakob innkuan mi sawmsagih le nga pha uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Jakob zong Egypt gamah pai a, amah a kipan i pupite khempeuh tua gamah a si uh hi.
Amau' luanghawmte, Shekhem khua-ah kipua a, Abraham in Hamor-te beh tung panin han dingin sum tawh a lei leitangah kiphum hi.
"Pasian in Abraham tungah a thuciamna a tunsak ding a nai kuan ciangin Egypt gamah ei mite tampi tak na pha ta uh hi.
A tawpna-ah Josef a thei lo kumpi dang khat, Egypt gam sung a uk dingin hong kipan hi.
I mipihte na khemgawpin na khelbawl a, a ta ngeekte uh a sih nadingin inn panin mun dangah a koihkhia sak hi.
Hih hunin naungek melhoih mahmah khat na suak hi. Inn-ah kha thum sung kikem a,
inn panin a kikoihkhiat ciangin Faro' tanu in a ta dingin la a, ama tapa bang teekteek mahin bawlin a khansuah hi.
Egypt gam sunga pilna om khempeuh ama tungah kihilh a, thugenna le nasepna-ah milian mahmah khat a suak hi.
"Amah kum sawmli a phak ciangin Israel' suan a mipihte lakah painopna lungsim a nei hi.
Tua bangin a mipihte lakah a va pai ciangin Egypt mite khat in a Israel mipihte khat a bawlsiatna mu a, a mipih pa a hutna-in Egypt mipa a satlum hi.
Amah pen eite hong honkhia dingin Pasian in a zat ding mipa hi, ci-in a mipihte in a thei ding sa a, ahi zongin a mipihte in na thei lo uh hi.
A zing ciangin Israel mi nih a kilai mu leuleu a, amaute a phelh dingin kipanin, 'Lawmte aw, minam khat hi lo na hi uh hiam? Bang hangin khatlekhat tuaci kibawl na hi uh hiam?' ci hi.
A lawmpa a bawlsia pa in Moses sawnkhia-in, 'Kote a hong uk ding le thu a hong khen dingin kua in nang hong koih ahi hiam?
Zan-a Egypt mipa na thah bangin kei zong a hong thatnuam na hi hiam?' a na ci hi.
Moses in hih thu a zak ciangin Egypt gam panin taikhia-in Midian gamah ten ding kipan a, tua gamah tapa nih a nei hi.
"Tua gamah kum sawmli a ten khit ciangin, Sinai Mual tung gamlakah sawlpang lak a meikuang sungah vantungmi khat ama kiangah hong kilang hi.
Moses in a muh ciangin lamdangsa a, a nai takin a muhtheih nadingin sawlpang kuang kiangah a va pai hi. Ahi zongin Topa' awging za a,
'Kei pen na pu na pate uh ahi Abraham, Isaac, le Jakob-te' Pasian ka hi hi,' a na ci hi. Moses zong lau-in linggawp a, en ngam lo hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, 'Na dinna mun pen a siangtho leitang ahih manin na khedap suah in.
Ka mite in Egypt gamah bawlsiatna a thuaknate teltakin ka mukhin hi. Amaute' tauna awging ka za a, amaute a honkhia dingin a hong paisuk ka hi hi. Hih lai-ah hong pai in; Egypt gamah nang ka hong paisak ding hi,' na ci hi.
"Moses pen Israel mite in deih loin, 'Kote a hong uk ding le thu a hong khen dingin kua in hong koih ahi hiam?' a cih pa uh ahi hi. Ahi zongin Moses pen sawlpang kuang sung pan ama kiangah a kilang vantungmi' huhna tawh ukpa le honkhia pa ahi dingin Pasian in a sawl pa ahi hi.
Amah in Egypt gam le San Tuipi-ah lim le na lamdangte bawlin, Egypt gam panin Israel mite paikhiatpih a, gamlakah kum sawmli sung amaute a makaih hi.
