Hih Moses pen Israel mite tungah, 'Pasian in kei hong sawl mah bangin, i mipihte sung mah panin note a' ding kamsang khat hong sawl ding hi,' a ci pa ahi hi.
Amah pen Israel mite tawh gamlakah a om pa hi a, Sinai Mual tunga ama kiangah thu a gen vantungmi le i pute tawh a kikhawlpa ahi hi. Eite tungah hong gensawn dingin Pasian kiang panin a tul ngei lo thu a ngah ahi hi.
"Ahi zongin i pute in ama thu na mang nuam loin, amah na nawlkhin uh a, Egypt gamah ciahkik nopna lungsim na nei uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute in Aaron kiangah, 'Egypt gam panin eite a hong paikhiatpih tua Moses tungah bang thu piang hiam cih thei lo ihih manin, eite' mai-ah i paisak ding milim pasian pawlkhat hong bawlsak in,' ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute in bawngno tawh a kibang lim khat bawl uh a, ganhing tawh tua milim bia-in, amaute' bawltawm pasian hangin lungdamin pawi a na bawl uh hi.
Tua ahih manin kamsangte laibu sungah, 'Israel mite aw, gamlakah kum sawmli sung, gan go-in biakna na piakte uh kei tunga nong piak uh hi lo hi. Note in na puak uh puanbuk pen Molok pasian milim puanbuk le note' aksi pasian Refan' puanbuk ahi hi. Tuate pen na biak dingun note' bawltawm milim ahih manin Babylon khuapi khen pekah salin ka hong paisak ding hi,' ci-in a kigelh mah bangin Pasian in amaute nungngat a, vana om aksite a bia dingin amaute a sawlkhia hi.
"Gamlakah a omlai-un i pute in Pasian' ompihna puanbuk nei uh a, Pasian in Moses tungah a gensa, a lim ding a lahsa bang teekteekin a kibawl ahi hi.
Tua khit ciangin i pute in amau' pate tung panin a ngah uh tua puanbuk pen amau' ten nading gam a la dingin a kuan uh ciangin na pua uh a, Pasian in amaute' mai-ah tua gam mite hawlkhiatsak ahih manin tua gam a luah uh ciangin a puanbuk zong a na tunpih uh hi. Tua ahih manin David' hun ciang dong tua puanbuk na om hi.
David in Pasian' maipha ngah ahih manin, Jakob Pasian a dingin biakinn khat a vaihawm sak nadingin Pasian kiangah a ngen hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian a dingin biakinn a lamsak pen David hi loin a tapa Solomon ahi hi.
Ahi zongin kamsangpa in, 'Topa in hih bangin ci hi: Vantung pen keima tokhom hi a, leitung zong ka khe ngakna mun ahi hi. Kei a' ding bang biakinn hong lamsak thei ding a, ka om nading koi lai mun hi thei ding ahi hiam? Hih nate khempeuh keima bawlsa hi lo ahi hiam, ci hi,' ci-in a gen mah bangin mihingte' lamsa inn sungah a Lianpen Pasian a teng hi lo hi.
"Na lungsim uh khauh mahmah a, lawki lungsim paii-in, Pasian' thu-ah bilngong na bang uh hi. I pu i pate mah bangin Kha Siangtho thu na mang nuam kei uh hi.
I pu i pate in kamsang a bawlsiat loh khat beek om lo hi. Pasian' deihna bangin a gamta a Nasempa a hong pai nading thu a genkhol Pasian' kamtaite na that uh a, tu-in note in tua nasempa lehhekin na that leuleu uh hi.
Note in vantungmi tungtawnin Pasian' hong piak thukham ngah napi-in na mang nuam kei uh hi," a ci hi.
A kikhawm uliante in Stefen' thugen a zak uh ciangin nakpitakin heh uh a, a ha uh gawisan uh hi.
Ahi zongin Stefen ahihleh Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin vantung lam ento a, Pasian' minthanna vang le Pasian' taklamah Jesuh a ding mu ahih manin,
"En un! Vantung kihong a, Pasian' taklamah Mihing Tapa a ding ka mu hi," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin amaute in a bil uh humsanin nakpitakin kiko-in Stefen bawhhuan uh a,
khua pualamah kaikhia-in suang gol pipi a khiat uh hi. Hih thu-ah teci pangin Stefen a deng mite in a puantungsilh uh suahin Saul a kici tangval khat kiangah lawnin a kemsak uh hi.
Tua bangin suang a khiat thuahthuah laitakun Stefen in thu ngen a, "Topa Jesuh aw, ka kha hong la in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah kunin nakpitakin kiko a, "Topa aw, hih mite' mawhna na maisak in," a cih khit ciangin a si ta hi.
Hih Stefen thahna thu-ah Saul in zong thukimpih hi. Tua ni a kipanin Jerusalem khua-a om pawlpite in nakpitakin bawlsiatna thuak ding kipan uh hi. Sawltakte simloh, thu um midang khempeuh, Judea gam le Samaria gamah kithehthang gawp uh hi.
Thu um mi pawlkhat in Stefen vui uh a, nakpitakin dahin a kap uh hi.
Ahi zongin Saul in pawlpi suksiat ding hanciam a, inn khat pan inn khatah pai kawikawi-in, thu um numei le pasalte kai-in thong sungah a khia hi.
Tua bangin a kithehthang mite pai kawikawi-in thu a hilh uh hi.
Filip zong Samaria gam khuapi-ah pai-in Khrih thu a hilh hi.
Mihonte in Filip' thugen le a nalamdang bawlte a muh uh ciangin a thugen khempeuh limtakin a ngai uh hi.
Mi tampite sung panin dawite nakpitakin kiko-in paikhia uh a, khutzaw khezaw mite zong kidamsak hi.
Tua ahih manin tua khuapi sunga om mite lungdam mahmah uh hi.
Tua khua sungah Simon a kici mi khat om a, amah mitphial bawl siampi hi a, Samaria mite in lamdangsa mahmah uh hi. Amah milian mahmah khatin kigen a,
tua khuasunga om milian mineu a om khempeuh in a thu limtakin ngai-in, "Vang Lianpa," a kici Pasian pen amah ahi hi, a ci uh hi.
Amah in sauveipi sung mitphial bawl a, mite in lamdangsa mahmah uh ahih manin a thu a um uh hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian' Ukna Lungdamna Thu le Jesuh Khrih thu, Filip' gente a up uh ciangin, numei pasal a um khempeuh tui a kiphum uh hi.
Simon mahmah in zong um a, tui a kiphum khit ciangin Filip zui tawntung a, lim le nalamdang lianpipite a bawl a muh ciangin lamdang a sa mahmah hi.
Samaria mite in Pasian' thu a sankhitna uh, Jerusalem-a om sawltakte in a zak uh ciangin amaute kiangah Peter le Johan a paisak uh hi.
Amaute a tun uh ciangin tua lai-a om thu um mite in Kha Siangtho a ngah nadingun thu a ngetsak uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute pen Topa Jesuh min tawh a kituiphum hi pan bek uh a, amaute khat beek in Kha Siangtho ngah nai lo uh hi.
Peter le Johan in amaute lu tungah a khut uh a ngak khit uh ciangin Kha Siangtho a ngah uh hi.
Sawltakte in amaute tungah a khut uh a ngak ciangin Kha Siangtho a ngahna uh mu ahih manin Simon in Peter le Johan kiangah sum pia a,
"Kei zong ka khut ka ngakna mi peuhpeuh in Kha Siangtho a ngahtheih nadingin hih bang vangliatna kei zong hong pia un," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Peter in, "Pasian' piakkhong na pen sum tawh lei theih dingin ngaihsun na hih manin na sumteng tawh sikhawm in.
Pasian in na lungsim man hong sa lo ahih manin kote' nasepna-ah nang nong kihel thei kei ding hi.
Tua ahih manin na ngaihsut hoih lohna panin kisikkik inla, hih bang na ngaihsutna thu-ah na mawhna hong maisak theih nadingin Topa kiangah thu ngen in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in enluatna lungsim nei-in, mawhna in hong valhcip mi khat na hih lamtak ka hong thei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Simon in Peter le Johan kiangah, "Tu-a na thugente uh kei tungah khat beek hong tun loh nadingin thu hong ngetsak un," a ci hi.
Amaute in Jesuh Khrih thu a theihte uh genin Topa' thugente a hilh khit uh ciangin Jerusalem khua-ah a ciahkik uh hi. A ciahkik kawmun Samaria khuaneu lampite-ah Lungdamna Thu a hilh uh hi.
Topa' vantungmi khat in Filip kiangah, "Kithawi inla, Jerusalem khua panin Gaza khua paina lampi zuan dingin leitaw lam manawhin pai in," a ci hi. (Tua lampi tu-in kizang pha nawn lo hi.)
Filip zong kithawi-in a pai hi. Lampi-ah Ethiopia mi mang lian khat tawh kituak hi. Tua mangpa pen Ethiopia kumpinu Kandeis khutnuai-a mang lian khat hi a, kumpinu neihsa khempeuh a ukpa ahi hi. Jerusalem khua-ah Pasian bia dingin a va pai hi a,
inn zuan dingin leeng sungah a tuan kawmin kamsang Isaiah laibu a sim hi.
Tua laitakin Kha Siangtho in Filip kiangah, "Pai inla tua leeng mai-ah va om in," ci-in a sawl hi.
Filip zong ama kiangah va tai a, kamsang Isaiah laibu a simna za ahih manin, "Na laisim a khiatna na thei hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Amah in, "Mi khatpeuh in hong hilhtel lohpi-in bangci theih ding ka hi hiam?" ci-in dawng a, ama leeng tungah Filip a tuang dingin a sam hi.
Tua a sim Lai Siangtho mun pen, "A kigo dingin a kikai tuuno ham lo a, a mul a kimeetsak tuuno a ham loh mah bangin, amah kam khat beek pau lo hi.
Mite in amah simmawhbawl gawp a, amah a huh kuamah om lo hi. Ama nuntakna leitungah bei ahih manin, a suan a khakte' thu, ci-a gen ding om lo hi," ci-in a kigelhna mun ahi hi.
Tua ciangin mangpa in Filip kiangah, "Hih kamsangpa in amah a kicihna ahi hiam, tua ahih kei leh midang khatpeuh a cihna ahi hiam, hong gen dih in," a ci hi.
Filip zong a kam ka-in thugen ding kipan a, tua a Lai Siangtho simna mun a kipanin Jesuh thu ciang dong a gen hi.
Lampi-ah a pai laitakun tui omna mun tung uh a, mangpa in, "Hih lai-ah tui om hi. Tui kiphum nuam peuh leng kua'n hong kham thei ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Filip in, "Na lungsim takpi tawh na up nakleh tui na kiphum thei ding hi," a cih ciangin, "Jesuh Khrih pen Pasian' Tapa hi, ci-in ka um hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin a leeng a khawlsak nadingin mangpa in thu pia a, Filip tawh a nihun tui phualah pai-in Filip in amah a tuiphum hi.
Tui sung panin a paikhiat khit uh ciangin Topa' Kha Siangtho in Filip paikhiatpih hi. Mangpa in Filip mu nawn lo hi; ahi zongin lungdam takin a lampai a zom hi.
Tua ciangin Filip pen Azotas khua-ah a om ahih lamtak amah kiphawk a, tua khua a kipanin Sisaria khua a tun dongin khua khempeuhah Lungdamna Thu a hilh hi.
Tua hun sungteng Saul in Topa' thu a um mite thah dingin a hanciamna zomlai hi. Siampi lianpen pa kiangah pai a,
Topa' thu a zui mi numei pasal a muh peuhpeuh manin Jerusalem khua-ah a ciahpih theih nadingin Damaskas khua-a Jew mi kikhopna inn ukte kiangah a lah dingin lai a ngen hi.
Damaskas khua a zuan dingin pai a, a tun dektak ciangin thakhat thu-in van panin ama kimkotah a hong taangzaih khat a om hi.
Saul, leilakah puksuk a, tua laitakin awging khat in ama kiangah, "Saul, Saul aw, bang hangin kei hong bawlsia na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Saul in, "Topa aw, kua na hi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin, "Nangmah in na hong bawlsiat Jesuh ka hi hi.
Ahi zongin tho-in khuapi sungah lut in; tua lai panin na gamtatna dingteng hong kigen ding hi," a ci hi.
Saul tawh a tonkhawm mite in a awging a zak uh hangin kuamah mu lo uh ahih manin lamdangsa lua-in pau thei lo liangin a om uh hi.
Ni thum sung khua mu thei loin, anletui zong a ne kei hi.
Tua laitakin Damaskas khua-ah Ananias min nei thu um mi khat a om hi. Amah in maang mu a, a maang sungah Topa in, "Ananias aw," ci-in a sam hi. Ananias in, "Topa aw, ka om hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Ananias kiangah, "Kithawi-in Kongzing Tang gei-a Judas inn-ah va pai inla, Tarsas khuami Saul min nei mi khat va kan in. Tua Saul in thu ngen a,
khua a muhkik theih nadingin Ananias min nei mi khat hong pai-in ama lu tungah a khut a ngakna thu, a maang muhna sungah a mu hi," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Ananias in, "Topa aw, hih mipa in Jerusalem khua-a om nangma mite a bawlsiatna thu khempeuh, mi tampi tak in kei tungah hong gen khinzo uh hi.
Tu-in zong nangmah a hong bia mi khempeuh a mattheih nadingin siampi liante tung panin thu a ngahkhit ciangin Damaskas khua-ah a hong tung ahi hi," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Topa in Ananias kiangah, "Gentail mite, kumpite, le Israel mite tungah keima min a kitheisak ding, keima na a sem dingin teelkhin ka hih manin ama kiangah va pai in.
Keima hangin a thuak ding thu khempeuh zong, kei mahmah in ama tungah ka gen ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Ananias zong pai a, inn sungah a lutkhit ciangin Saul lu tungah a khut nga a, "Sanggam Saul aw, hih lai-ah nong pai lai-in nangma tungah a hong kilang Jesuh mahmah in kei hong sawl hi. Nangmah in khua muthei kikin, Kha Siangtho tawh na kidim theih nadingin nangma kiangah a hong paisak ahi hi," a ci hi.
an a nekkhit ciangin a tha hong hatkik hi. Damaskas khua-ah a om thu um mite tawh tawlkhat sung a omkhawm hi.
Kikhopna innte-ah va pai-in, "Jesuh pen Pasian' Tapa ahi hi," ci-in thu hilh ding a kipan hi.
Ama thuhilh a za mi khempeuh in lamdangsa uh a, "Pasian a bia mi peuhpeuh, Jerusalem khua sungah a that pa hi lo ahi hiam? Hih lai-ah zong thu um mite manin siampi liante kiangah a ciahpihkik dingin a hong pai hi lo ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin a thuhilhna-ah Saul hong siam semsem a, Jesuh pen Khrih hi, ci-in teltakin lakthei ahih manin, Damaskas khua-a om Jew mite in a nial nading uh om thei lo hi.
Tuazawh ni tampi khit ciangin Jew mite kikaikhawmin Saul thahsawm uh a,
ahi zongin Saul in amah a kisawm lamtak na phawk hi. Jew mite in Saul a thahtheih nadingun a sun a zanin khua kongpi-ah a pang uh hi.
Ahi zongin Saul' nungzuite in zanin khuakulh tungah kahtohpihin kulh pualamah bawm tawh a khaisuk uh hi.
Jerusalem khua-ah Saul pai a, thu um mite tawh kipawl dingin a vaihawm hi. Ahi zongin amaute in Saul pen thu um dingin na ngaihsun zo lo uh ahih manin na kihta mahmah uh hi.
Tua ciangin Barnabas in Saul hong huh a, sawltakte kiangah Saul a va paipih hi. Lam a pai laitakin Saul in Topa a muhna thu, Topa in Saul kiangah a thugennate, le Damaskas khua-ah Saul in hangtakin Jesuh' min tawh thu a hilhnate khempeuh sawltakte kiangah a gensak hi.
Tua ahih manin Saul zong sawltakte tawh kikhawl a, Jerusalem khua sungah vak kawikawi-in, Topa' min tawh hangtakin thu a hilh hi.
Grik pau a zang Jew mite tawh zong thu genkhawmin kisel uh a, amaute in Saul thah dingin a vaihawm uh hi.
A lawmte in hih thu a phawk uh ciangin Sisaria khua-ah Saul paipihsuk uh a, tua lai panin Tarsas khua-ah a ciahsak uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Judea gam, Galilee gam, le Samaria gam sunga om pawlpite in bawlsiatna thuak nawn loin nuamtakin om uh a, Topa zahtakna tawh gamta uh ahih manin Kha Siangtho huhna tawh a mi khangin a kibehlap uh hi.
Peter khualzinin pai kawikawi a, khatvei Lydda khua-a teng Pasian' mite kiangah a hawh hi.
Tua khua a tun ciangin a khutlekhe a zaw, kum giat sung tawntung lupna ngakin a om, Aineas kici mi khat a mu hi.
Peter in tua pa kiangah, "Aineas aw, Jesuh Khrih in nang hong damsak hi; tho-in na lupna zial in," a ci hi. Amah zong thakhatin thoto pah hi.
Tua khua-a teng mi khempeuh le Sharon zanglei-a teng mi khempeuh in Aineas mu uh ahih manin Topa a um uh hi.
Joppa khua-ah Pasian' thu a um, Tabitha min nei numei khat a om hi. (Tua nu' Grik min pen Dorkas hi a, sakhi a cihnopna ahi hi.) Tua nu a tawntungin a hoihin gamta-in mizawngte a huh hi.
Tua laitakin amah a ci na-in a si hi. Amah a silkhit uh ciangin inndei tungnungah a sial uh hi.
Joppa khua le Lydda khua kigamla lo ahih manin, Joppa khua-a teng thu um mite in Lydda khua-ah Peter om hi, ci-in thu a zak uh ciangin Peter kiangah mi nih sawl uh a, "A manlang theithei-in ko kiangah hong pai in," ci-in a samsak uh hi.
Peter zong kithawi-in a samte tawh paikhawm pah a, tua khua a tun ciangin inndei tungnungah a na paipihto pah uh hi. Tua lai-ah a na om meigong numei khempeuh in Peter na umcih uh a, Dorkas a hin lai-in amaute a dingin a bawlsak puanakte le puantungsilhte, a kahkawmun Peter kiangah a lak uh hi.
Peter in a khut khakin a dingtosak hi. Tua ciangin thu um meigong numeite a kipanin thu um khempeuh samkikin amaute kiangah Dorkas a nungta-in a lak hi.
Joppa khuasung khempeuhah hih thu kitheikim a, mi tampi in Topa a um uh hi.
Joppa khua-ah ni tampi sung Peter tamlai a, savunnim nasepin a nei Simon a kici mipa tawh a omkhawm hi.
Sisaria khua-ah Kornelias a kici mi khat om a, Rom galkap honte sung panin "Italy Galkapte," a kici sungah galkapbu a sem ahi hi.
Amah biakna a hahkat mahmah mi khat hi a, a innkuan bupun Pasian bia uh hi. Amah in Jew mizawngte huh nadingin nakpitakin na sem a, Pasian kiangah thu a ngen tawntung mi khat ahi hi.
Khatvei nitak nai thum pawlin maang mu a, Pasian' vantungmi khat hong pai-in ama kiangah, "Kornelias aw," ci-in a sapna teltakin a thei hi.
Amah in zong laukawmin vantungmi en a, "Topa aw, bang thu ahi hiam?" a cih ciangin, "Pasian in na thungetna hong za a, mizawngte na huhna zong hong thei-in nang hong phawk hi.
Tu-in Joppa khua-ah mi sawl inla, Simon Peter a kici mipa samsak in.
Tua mipa pen, tuipi gei-a teng savunnim nasepin a nei Simon inn-ah zin tungin a om ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua khit ciangin ama kiangah thu a gen vantungmi paikhia a, Kornelias in zong ama innsung nasemte nih le biakna a hahkat mahmah, ama sawltakin a neih galkapte khat sam a,
a thupiang khempeuh amaute kiangah a genkhit ciangin Joppa khua-ah a paisak hi.
A zing ciangin Joppa khua-ah amaute a tun dektak laitakun, thungen dingin sun laitakin innkhumzangah Peter a kahto hi.
Peter a gil kialin an duh mahmah hi. A zinte in an a huanhuan laitakin Peter in maang a mu hi.
Vantung kihong a, sikli a nei a peek deda khat a kiu ciatah khau kivawhin leitungah a hong kikhaisuk a mu hi.
Tua a peek tungah ganhing namkim, a bokvak namkim, le vasa namkim a om hi.
Awging khat in ama kiangah, "Peter aw, tho inla tuate go-in ne in," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Peter in, "Topa aw, tuate go-in ka ne het kei ding hi. A ninin a kingaihsun peuhmah ka ne ngei het kei hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
A awging in ama kiangah, "Pasian in a siangin a gensa khat peuhpeuh a ninin ngaihsun kei in," a ci leuleu hi.
Tu-a bangin a thumveina dong a cihkhit ciangin vantung lamah tua a peek deda a kilato kik hi.
Peter in tua a maangmuhna bang a cihnopna hi ding ahi hiam, ci-in lamdangsa-in a om laitakin, Kornelias in a sawl mite in Simon' inn hong kan kawikawi uh a, a inn hong thei uh ahih manin a kongbiang hong tungta uh hi.
Amaute in, "Simon Peter a kici mi khat, hih lai-ah zin hong tung kha hiam," ci-in a hong dong uh hi.
Tua bangin Peter in a maang muh lungngaingai-in a om laitakin Kha Siangtho in, "En in, mihing thum in nang hong zong uh hi.
Amaute nang kiangah a hong pai dingin ka hong sawl ahih manin kithawi-in kumsuk inla, lunghiang loin amaute zuipah in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Peter zong amaute kiangah paisuk a, "Kei pen na zon pa uh ka hi hi. Bang thu ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Amaute in, "Galkap bupa Kornelias in nang kiangah kote hong sawl hi. Amah pen Pasian a bia mihoih mahmah khat hi a, Jew mi khempeuh in zong a zahtak mahmah khat uh ahi hi. Amah in nangma thugente a zaktheih nadingin a inn-ah nang a hong sap nadingin Pasian in a vantung mite khat ama kiangah gensak hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amah tawh a giakkhawm dingin Peter in amaute a sam hi. A zing ciangin Peter zong kithawi-in amaute tawh paikhawm a, Joppa khua-a om thu um mi pawlkhatte in zong a zui uh hi.
A zing ciangin Sisaria khua a tung uh hi. Kornelias in zong amaute' tun ding lamen ahih manin, a beh a phungte le a lawm itteng a inn-ah a na samkhol hi.
Peter hong tun ciangin Kornelias in na dawn a, a khe kiangah bokin a bia hi.
Ahi zongin Peter in amah kaito a, "Ding in; kei zong mihing mah ka hi lel hi," a ci hi.
Tua bangin a kiho kawmin Peter zong inn sungah tum a, mi tampi tak a na om a muh ciangin
amaute kiangah, "Note mahmah in zong limtakin na theih ciat uh mah bangin Jew mite pen minam dangte kiangah hawhin a kikholh ding a ngeina hi lo hi. Ahi zongin mi khat peuhpeuh a nin hi, ci-in ka ngaihsut loh nadingin Pasian in kei tungah a thu hong lakkhin zo hi.
Tua ahih manin kei nong sap uh ciangin nial loin kong pai hi. Tu-in bang thu-a hong sam na hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Kornelias in, "Tuni tawh sim tuma ni li lai-in tubang hun nitak nai thum laitakin ka inn-ah thungenin ka om hi. Tua bangin thungenin ka om laitakin puanpak mahmah a silh mi khat ka mai-ah hong dingvat a,
'Kornelias aw, Pasian in na thungetnate hong za a, mizawngte na huhnate zong a hong thei hi.
Simon Peter a kici mipa a sam dingin Joppa khua-ah mi sawl in. Amah pen savunnim nasepin nei-in tuipi gei-ah a teng Simon' inn-ah zin tungin a om hi,' hong ci hi.
Tua ahih manin nang kong samsakpah a, midik na hih manin hih lai ciang a hong tung na hi hi. Topa in na gen dingin a hong sawl thu khempeuh na hong gen ding ngakin Pasian' omna hih lai munah a om ka hi uh hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Peter a kam ka-in thu hilh ding kipan a, "Pasian in kuamah angvan' tuam nei loin,
kua mi kua mi hitaleh amah zahtakin a manin a gamta mi khempeuh a sanna thu teltakin ka thei hi.
Mi khempeuh' Topa ahi Jesuh Khrih hangin a kingah Lungdamna Thu, Israel mite tungah Pasian in a puakna thu na thei uh hi.
Johan in tuiphumna thu a hilh khit a kipanin Galilee gam a kipan Judea gam khempeuhah a piang thu lianpite na thei uh hi.
Nazareth khuami Jesuh tungah Pasian in Kha Siangtho le vangliatna pia a, Pasian in a ompihna hangin tua Jesuh in a paina khempeuhah na hoih semin, Dawimangpa in a gimsak mite khempeuh a damsakna thu zong na thei uh hi.
Amah in Jerusalem khua le Jew mite omna mundang khempeuhah a septe khempeuh a thei tecite ka hi uh hi. Jew mite in sing tungah amah khai-in a that uh hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in a ni thum ni-in amah hingkik sakin hong kilangsakkik hi.
Mi khempeuh tungah kilangsak loin, a thei teci dingin Pasian in a hong teelsa kote bek tungah hong kilangsak hi. Sihna panin a hinkik khit ciangin kote in amah tawh an nekhawm tui dawnkhawmin ka om uh hi.
Kote in mite kiangah thu ka hilh nading uh le mihing le misite tungah thu a khen dingin Pasian in amah a sehna thu teci a pang dingin a hong sawl hi.
Amah a um mite khempeuh in ama min hangin a mawhna uh a mai nading thu, kamsangte khempeuh in zong gen belin a neih khat uh ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua bangin Peter in thu a hilh laitakin tua thuhilhna a ngai mite khempeuh tungah Kha Siangtho hong tungsuk hi.
Gentail mite tungah zong Pasian in a Kha Siangtho a piakkhongna thu a muh uh ciangin Joppa khua panin Peter tawh a hong paikhawm Jew mi thu umte in lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in pau lamdang pau-in Pasian' liatna a phatnate uh amau bil mahmah tawh a za uh hi. Tua ciangin Peter in,
"Eite mah bangin hih mite in zong Kha Siangtho ngah uh hi. Tui sungah a kiphum ding uh kua'n kham thei ding ahi hiam?" ci-in a gen khit ciangin,
Jesuh Khrih min tawh amaute tui a kiphum nading uh a sawl hi. Tua ciangin amaute kiangah Peter a tam lai nadingin a thum uh hi.
Gentail mite in zong Pasian' thu a upna uh, Judea gam sunga om sawltakte le thu um mite in a za uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Jerusalem khua-ah Peter a pai ciangin Gentail mite zong vun a ki-at ding uh ahi hi, ci-in a ngaihsun mite in Peter mawhsak uh a,
"Bang hangin vun a ki-at lo Gentail mite' inn-ah tung a, amaute tawh an nangawn nekhawm na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Peter in a thupiang khempeuh a patna panin a ban banin gen a,
"Joppa khua-ah thungenin ka om laitakin maang ka mu hi. A peek deda khat a kiu li-ah khau kivawhin vantung panin hong kikhaisuk ka mu a, keima mai sanah hong khawl hi.
Tua a peek deda tung, limtakin ka et ciangin ganhing, gamsa, a bokvak ganhing le vasate ka mu hi.
Tua ciangin awging khat in kei kiangah, 'Peter aw, tho inla tuate go-in ne in,' hong cihna ka za hi.
Ahi zongin keimah in, 'Topa aw, tuate go-in ka ne het kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a ninin a kingaihsun an peuhmah ka kam ka tun ngei kei hi,' ka ci hi.
Ahi zongin van panin a awging in, 'Pasian in a siangin a gensa khat peuhpeuh a nin na ci kei ding hi,' hong ci kik hi.
Tu-a bangin a thumveina dong hong cih khit ciangin vantungah tua a peek deda kilato kik hi.
Tua laitakin Sisaria khua panin kei kiangah a hong kisawl mihing thumte, ka zintunna inn-ah hong tung uh hi.
Lunghiang loin amaute ka zuihpah nadingin Kha Siangtho in kei tungah hong gen khinzo hi. Joppa khua panin hih i sanggam gukte in zong Sisaria khua-ah hong zui uh a, ka vekpi-un Kornelias inn-ah ka lut uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in vantungmi khat a inn sungah a ding mu-in, tua vantungmi in ama kiangah, 'Simon Peter a kici mipa a sam dingin Joppa khua-ah mi sawl in.
Amah in nang le na innkuan khempeuh un hotkhiatna na ngah nading uh thu hong gen ding hi,' a cihna thu a hong gen hi.
Tua thu gen dingin ka kipat laitakin eite in Kha Siangtho i ngah cil huna mah bangin amaute tungah Kha Siangtho hong tung hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in, 'Johan in tui sungah hong phum a, ahi zongin Pasian in Kha Siangtho tawh note hong kidimsak ding hi,' a cihsa thu ka phawkkik hi.
Eite in Topa Jesuh Khrih i up ciangin eite tungah hong piak mah bangin Pasian in hih Gentail mite tungah zong a kibangin a piakna teltakin kithei ahih manin, hih Pasian' nasepna a khaktanzo dingin kei kua ka hi hiam?" ci-in a gen hi.
Amaute in hih thu a zak uh ciangin mawhsakna thu gen nawn lo uh a, "Gentail mite zong kisikin a nuntak theih nadingun Pasian in hunhoih pia hi," ci-in Pasian a phat uh hi.
Stefen a kithah huna bawlsiatna hangin thu um mite tampi kithehthang uh hi. Mi pawlkhatte Foenisia gam, Saipras gam, le Antiok khua ciang dong tung uh a, Jew mite kiang bekah Pasian' thu a hilh uh hi.
Ahi zongin Saipras gammi le Sairin khuami thu um mi pawlkhatte Antiok khua-ah pai uh a, Topa Jesuh hanga Lungdamna Thu, Gentail mite kiangah zong a gen uh hi.
Topa in nakpitakin amaute huh ahih manin mi tampi in thu umin Topa lamah a kihei uh hi.
Jerusalem-a om pawlpite in hih thu a zak uh ciangin Antiok khua-ah Barnabas a paisak uh hi.
Barnabas a tun ciangin Pasian in amaute thupha a piakna mu-in lungdam mahmah a, amaute citakin a lungsim khempeuh uh tawh Topa tungah a thuman nadingun a hanthawn hi.
Barnabas pen mihoih mahmah, upna nei-in, Kha Siangtho tawh a kidim mi khat ahi hi. Mi tampi in Pasian a um uh hi.
Tua ciangin Saul a zong dingin Barnabas pai a, Tarsas khua-ah a tung hi.
Saul a muh ciangin Antiok khua-ah a paipih hi. Kum khat sung tawntung tua lai-a om pawlpi mite tawh amau tegel omkhawm uh a, mi tampi tak thu a hilh uh hi. Thu um mite pen Khristian ci-in min a kiphuah masakna mun in Antiok khua ahi hi.
Tua hun pawl laitakin Jerusalem khua panin Antiok khua-ah kamsang pawlkhat paisuk uh hi.
Amaute sung panin Agabas a kici kamsangpa hong ding a, leitung khempeuhah kialpi hong tung ding hi, ci-in Kha Siangtho sawlna tawh a genkhol hi. (Tua kialpi pen Klaudias in Gam uk Kumpi a sep laitakin a tung hi.)
Tua lai-a om thu um mite in amau hihzawh zah ciat hanciamin Judea gam a om thu um mite kiangah huhna a puak nading uh a vaihawm uh hi.
Amaute in huh nading sum a kaihkhop khit uh ciangin pawlpi upate tungah a na piak dingun Barnabas le Saul a puasak uh hi.
Hih hun pawl laitakin Herod Kumpipa in pawlpi mite pawlkhat bawlsiat ding kipan hi.
Johan' u James pen namsau tawh thatsak hi.
Hih bangin thahna hangin Jew mite a lungdamna a theih ciangin Peter zong mansak leuleu hi. (Hih pen Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi hunsung ahi hi.)
Peter a kimat khit ciangin thongah kikoih a, galkap li ciat a om galkap pawl lite in a cin dingin ki-ap hi. Herod in Paisan Pawi a ven' ciangin mipi mai-ah Peter thu sit dingin a ngaihsut ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin thong sungah Peter kikhum a, ahi zongin pawlpi mite in lungsim takpi tawh ama a dingin Pasian kiangah thu a ngetsak uh hi.
Herod in Peter thu sit dingin a lakkhiat ding ma a zan sungin, Peter a khut nih tuakin sikkhau kikhihin a langtuakah galkapte in lenin tua galkap nih kikalah kilumsak a, tua banah thongcingte in a kongah cing lai uh hi.
Thakhatthu-in Peter gei-ah Topa' vantungmi khat hong omin thong sung khempeuh khua a vak hi. Vantung mi in Peter' liangko lokin phong a, "Manlangin tho in," a ci hi. Thakhatin Peter' khut panin a sikkhaute kitolkhia hi.
Tua ciangin vantungmi in, "Na kawng hoihtakin gakin na khedap bulh in," ci-in a gen bangin Peter zong a gamta hi. Tua ciangin vantungmi in, "Na puan silh inla hong zui in," a cih mah bangin,
thong sung panin Peter in amah zui-in a paikhia hi. Ahi zongin tua vantungmi' gamtatna pen ahi takpi mah ahi hiam cih thei lo ahih manin maang a mu-in kingaihsun hi.
Thongcingte' vilna mun a khatna le a nihna a khenkhit uh ciangin khuapi sung lut nading sik kibawl thong kongpi a tung uh hi. Tua kongpi pen ama thu-in hong kihongtawm a, amaute a paikhia uh hi. Khuasung lampi-ah a pai laitakun thakhatin vantungmi in Peter guak a nusia hi.
Tua ciangin Peter in khua phawk a, "Maang a mu ka kisak leh a takpi na hi mawk! Topa in a vantungmi kei kiangah hong sawl a, Herod in hong gimsak nading le Jew mite in gimna hong thuaksak nading panin kei hong honkhia hi," a ci hi.
Hih thu a phawk khit ciangin Johan Marka nu Mary' inn-ah a pai hi. Tua lai-ah mi tampi kikhawmin thu a na ngen uh hi.
Peter in inntual kongpi hong kiu a, a en dingin nasem numei Roda va pai hi.
Peter hi, ci-in a aw-in a theih ciangin nuamlua ahih manin inntual kong nangawn hong loin inn sungah va tai a, inntual kongah Peter ding hi, ci-in a va gen hi.
Amaute in, "A hai hi teh!" na cihsan lel uh hi. Ahi zongin amah in, "Peter a om taktak mah hi," a cih teitei ciangin amaute in, "Amah a cing vantungmi hi ding hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua sungtengin Peter in a kong mah hong kiukiu lai a, a tawpna-ah a hon uh ciangin Peter ahihlam thei uh ahih manin lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi.
Amaute a pau nawn loh nadingun Peter in a khut van a, thong sung panin Topa in amah a paikhiatpihna zia teng a gen hi. Tua ciangin, "James le pawlpi midangte kiangah hih thu na gen un," ci-in a vaikhak khit ciangin mundangah a paikhia hi.
Zingsang khua a vak ciangin Peter bangci ahi hiam, ci-in thongcingte lakah buaina lianpi hong om hi.
Peter a zon nadingun Herod in thu pia a, ahi zongin mu zo lo uh hi. Tua ahih manin thongcingte thu kisit a, thah dingin thu a khen nadingun thu a pia hi. Tua ciangin Judea gam panin Sisaria khua-ah Herod paisuk a, tua lai-ah tawlkhat sung a om hi.
Taia khuamite le Sidon khuamite tungah Herod heh mahmah ahih manin Herod tawh a kimu dingin hih khua nih mite hong paikhawm uh hi. A masa-in kumpi innsunga ulian nasem ahi Blastus a pawlmat phot uh hi. Hih khua nihte' annek tuidawn pen hih kumpipa' gam panin a ngah uh ahih manin Blastus makai sakin Herod kiangah va pai-in kilem nading thu a va gen uh hi.
Kumpipa in a thugen hun ding a ciamkholh ni a tun ciangin a kumpi puan silhin a kumpi tokhom tungah tu a, mite tungah thu a gen hi.
Mite in a thugen a zak uh ciangin, "Hih thugen pen mihing hi loin pasian ahi hi," ci-in a awng uh hi.
Herod in mite, Pasian phatsak loin amah phatsak ahih manin thakhatin Topa' vantungmi in Herod cinasak a, a hut in amah netumin a si hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian' thu kizelin a khang semsem hi.
Barnabas le Saul in a nasep a man khit uh ciangin Jerusalem khua panin ciahkik uh a, Johan Marka zong a ciahpih uh hi.
Antiok khua pawlpi sungah kamsang pawlkhat le sia pawlkhat om uh hi. Tuate pen Barnabas, Mi Vom pa zong a kici Simon, Sairin khuami Lusias, gam ukpipa khutnuai-ah gam a uksawn Herod tawh a khangkhawm Manaen, le Saul ahi uh hi.
Amaute in an tangin Pasian bia-in a om laitakun Kha Siangtho in amaute kiangah, "Keima na a sem dingin ka sapsa ahih manin kei a dingin Barnabas le Saul hong piakhia un," a ci hi.
Amaute in zong an tangin, a lu tung uhah a khut uh nga-in thu a ngetsak khit uh ciangin a kuankhia sak uh hi.
Kha Siangtho' sawlna mah bangin Seleusia khua-ah paisuk uh a, tua khua panin teembaw tuangin Saipras tuikulh-ah a pai uh hi.
Saipras tuikulh-a om Salamis khua a tun uh ciangin Jew mite' kikhopna innte-ah Pasian thu a hilh uh hi. Tua a nasepna uhah a huh dingin Johan Marka zong amaute tawh a omkhawm hi.
Tua tuikulh tung khempeuhah zin kawikawi-in Pafos khua a tun uh ciangin mitphial a bawl, kamsang a kineih, Barjesuh min nei Jew mi khat a tuak uh hi.
Tua mipa pen tua tuikulh a uksawn, a pil mahmah Sergius Paulus tawh a kithei mahmah mi khat ahi hi. Tua gam ukpa in Pasian' thu zanuam ahih manin Barnabas le Saul a sam hi.
Ahi zongin tua mitphial siampa Elymas (a Grik min) in Barnabas le Saul na nial a, gam ukpa in Pasian' thu a up theih loh nadingin a na hanciam hi.
Tua ciangin Saul (Paul zong a kici pa) Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin tua mipa limtakin en a,
"Dawimangpa tawh a kibang mipa aw, thuhoih khempeuh nialin, gitlohna ngian tuamtuam na nei a, Topa' thuman pen zuau suahsak ding na hanciam tawntung hi.
Gam ukpa in hih thupiang a muh ciang le Topa thu a kigente a zak ciangin lamdangsa mahmahin Pasian a um hi.
Tua ciangin Pafos khua panin Paul le a lawmte teembaw tuangin Pamfilia gam Perga khua a tung uh hi. Tua khua panin Johan Marka in amaute nusia-in Jerusalem khua-ah a ciahkik hi.
Ahi zongin Perga khua panin amaute paisuak uh a, Pisidia gam Antiok khua a tung uh hi. Sabbath ni-in kikhopna inn-ah pai-in a tu uh hi.
Kikhopna inn ukte in Moses Thukham Laibu sung le kamsangte' laibute a sim khit uh ciangin amaute kiangah, "Sanggamte aw, mihonte tungah hanthotna kam na gennop uhleh thu nong gen ding uh ka deih uh hi," a cisak uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Paul hong ding a, a khut vanin thugen ding hong kipan a, "Israel mipihte le hih lai-ah Pasian a bia Gentail mite aw, ka thugen na ngai un.
Hih Israel mite' biak Pasian in ko Israel mite' pu le pate na na teel a, Egypt gamah peemta-in a om sungun minam lian khatin a na bawl hi. Pasian in ama vangliatna tawh Egypt gam panin amaute na paikhiatpih a,
kum sawmli sung gam sungah amaute na ompih kenkon hi.
Pasian in Kanaan gam sungah mi nam sagih a suksiat khit ciangin kum zali le kum sawmnga sung bang ama mite a luahsak hi.
"Tua khit ciangin kamsang Samuel hun ciang dong amaute' vai a hawm dingin ukpite a pia hi.
Amaute in kumpi ding a nget uh ciangin Pasian in Benjamin minam sung pan Kish' tapa Saul, kum sawmli sung amaute' kumpi dingin a pia hi.
Pasian in kumpi dingin Saul a zat nawn loh ciangin amaute' kumpi dingin David a semsak hi. Pasian in David' thu genin, 'Ka sawl khempeuh a sem ding, ka deih bang mi khat, Jessi' tapa David ka mukhin hi,' a cihsa thu ahi hi.
Pasian in ama ciamsa bangin Israel mite a honkhia dingin hih David' suan sung pan Jesuh a bawl hi.
Jesuh in nasep a kipat ma-in, a mawhna panun kisikin tui a kiphum nadingun Johan in Israel mi khempeuh tungah thu a hilh hi.
Johan in ama nasep a zawh kuan ciangin mite kiangah, 'Kei kua hi hong ci na hi uh hiam? Kei pen note' ngak pa ka hi kei hi. En un, kei nungah na ngak pa uh hong pai a, ama khedap khau a sutsak ding nangawnin ka kilawmzo nai kei hi,' ci hi.
"Abraham' suan ka behte le Pasian a bia Gentail mi khempeuh aw, hih hotkhiatna thu pen eite a dingin Pasian in a hong puak ahi hi.
Jerusalem khua-a a teng mite le a makaite un Jesuh pen Honpa ahih lamtak na thei lo uh a, Sabbath nisimin a kisim niloh kamsangte' thu zong na tel lo uh hi. Amaute in Jesuh na mawhsak uh ahih manin kamsangte' thugente a manin hong tung hi.
Amaute in Jesuh in sihna a thuak nadingin thukhenna a ngah nading thu mu zo lo napi uh, Pilat in thah nading thu a piak nadingin na ngen teitei uh hi.
Lai Siangtho in Jesuh' thu a gen bang teekteekin a bawlkhit uh ciangin singlamteh tung panin lakhia sukin han sungah a koih uh hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in sihna panin amah hingkiksak a,
Galilee gam le Jerusalem khua kikalah amah tawh khual a zinzin khawm ngei mite tungah tam veipi a mun tuamtuamah na kilang hi.
Kote pen note kiangah Lungdamna Thu a puak dingin hih lai-ah a hong om ka hi uh hi. Tua thu in: Pasian in i pu i pate tungah a ciam thu pen Jesuh a hinkik sakna tawh, Israel' suan ahi eite le midang khempeuh a dingin tu-in a hong tungsak ahi hi. Late a lian nihna sungah, 'Nang pen ka Tapa na hi a, tuni-in nangma Pa ka suak hi,' a cihna thu hong tungsak hi.
Muatna a thuakkik ngei nawn lo dingin sihna panin amah a hinkiksakna tawh kisai-in Pasian in a thugenna-ah, 'David tungah ka ciamsa mah bangin note tungah thupha siangtho kong pia takpi ding hi,' ci hi.
Tua mah bangin Late a gelh pa in zong, 'Nang tungah a hong thuman na nasempa muatna na thuaksak kei ding hi,' a ci hi.
David in ama hun lai-in Pasian' deihna bangin na sem a, a sih ciangin a pu a pate gei mahah kisialin muatna a thuak hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in sihna panin a hinkiksak Jesuh in muatna thuak lo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin sanggamte aw, hih Jesuh hangin mawhmaisakna thu note tungah hong kihilh ahihna teltakin na theih ding uh ahi hi.
Tua tham loin Jesuh a um mite khempeuh pen Moses Thukham in a suahtaksak zawh loh mawhna khempeuh panin a suakta ahihna thu na theih ding uh ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin kamsangte in, 'Pasian a thusim lo mite aw, lamdangsa lua-in na si ding uh hi. Na nuntak sungun note lakah ka sepkhiat ding uh thu pen mi khatpeuh in hong gen hileh na up hetloh ding uh thu ahi hi,' ci-in a gen uh thute, note tungah hong pian' khak loh nadingin kidawm un," a ci hi.
Kikhopna inn panin Paul le Barnabas a ciah ding uh ciangin, Sabbath ni kik ciangin hih thute mah hong gen lai un, ci-in mite in a vaikhak uh hi.
Kikhopna inn panin a ciahkhiat uh ciangin Jew mi tampite le Jew biakna a zui Gentail mi tampite in Paul le Barnabas zui uh a, amau tegel in zong tua mite hanthawnin, Pasian' hehpihna suangin kiptakin a om nadingun a gen uh hi.
A Sabbath ni kik ciangin Pasian' thu a ngai dingin a khuazang phialun hong kikhawm uh hi.
Jew mite in mi tampi tak a hong kikhawm a muh uh ciangin Paul le Barnabas haza uh ahih manin Paul' thugente a man lopi hi, ci-in Paul a gensia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Paul le Barnabas in hangtakin thu gen uh a, "No Jew mite tungah Pasian' thu kong gen masak ding mah uh ahi hi. Ahi zongin note in Pasian' thu nialin, nuntak tawntungna a ngah dingin kilawmzo kisa lo na hih manun, note kiang panin paikhia-in Gentail mite kiangah ka pai ding uh hi.

Berea khua-ah zong Paul in Pasian thu a hilhna a zak uh ciangin Thesalonika khua panin Jew mite hong pai-in Berea khua-ah zong mite hong holhthawh gawp uh hi.
Tua ciangin thu um mite in tuipi gei-ah Paul paikhiatpih uh a, ahi zongin Silas le Timoti pen Berea khua-ah a taam lai uh hi.
Tuipi gei-ah Paul a paipih thu um mite in Athen khua ciang dong a va zui uh hi. Athen khua panin Berea khua-ah hong ciahkik uh ciangin, Silas le Timoti in a manlang theithei-in hong delh uh hen, ci-in Paul' kam vaikhak thu a hong pua uh hi.
Paul in Athen khua-ah Silas le Timoti ngakin a om laitakin tua khua sungah milim a dimin a om lamtak mu ahih manin a lungsim ommawk thei lo hi.
Tua ahih manin Pasian a bia Jew mite le Gentail mite tawh kikhopna inn sungah thu kikupna nei uh a, mihon kikhopna munah hong pai mi khempeuh tawh zong nisimin a kikum uh hi.
Epikuras thu ngaihsutzia le Stoik thu ngaihsutzia a um mite pawlkhat, Paul tawh thu kinial uh a, "Hih mi kipilsak thu mawk gengen pa in bang gennuam ahi hiam?" cihsan uh a, pawlkhat in, "Minam dangte' pasian thu a gen tawh kibang hi," a ci uh hi. Paul in Jesuh thu le a thawhkikna thu hilh ahih manin hih bangin a gen uh ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute in Paul samin, Areopagas mualbo-ah paipih uh a, "Tu-a na gengen thuthakte ka theinuam uh hi.
Tu-a na gengen ka zak uh thu pawlkhatte, ko a dingin a lamdangpi khat hi a, a thu a cingin ka theinuam uh hi," a ci uh hi.
(Athen khuamite le tua khua-a om gamdang mite in thu thak la thak ngaihsunin kikup ding simloh thudang ngaihsutin nei lo uh hi.)
Tua ahih manin Paul zong kikhopna mun Areopagas a kici mualbo tungah dingin, "Athen khua mite aw, biakna a hahkat mahmah mite na hihna uh ka thei hi.
Na khuasung uhah ka pai kawmin na biakna munte uh ka et ciangin, 'A Kithei lo Pasian a' ding,' ci-in biakna tau tungah lai a kigelh nangawn ka mu hi. Tu laitakin kei' hong pulak Pasian pen, thei lo napi-in na biakbiak uh Pasian ahi hi.
Tua Pasian pen leitung buppi le a tunga om khempeuh a piangsak Pasian hi a, van le lei a uk Topa ahih manin mihingte' lamsa biakinn sungah teng lo hi.
Amah pen mi khempeuh tungah nuntakna le na khempeuh a piapa ahih manin mihingte in ama a dingin na khat peuhpeuh a sepsak ding a kisam ahi kei hi.
Mihing khat tung panin leitung minam khempeuh hong piangsakin, leitung khempeuhah a omsak hi. Amah in mihingte a piansakma pekin, mihingte' nuntak tanvei ding le a ten nading uh mun a sehsa ahi hi.
Hih bangin a hihna pen mite in amah zongin a muhtheih nading uh a deihna ahi hi. Ahi zongin eite kiang panin Pasian gamla om het lo hi.
Mi khat in, 'Pasian hangin eite piangin, hingin i gamtang hi,' ci-in gen a, note sung panin laphuah siampa khat in zong, 'Eite zong ama tate ihi hi,' na na ci hi.
Eite pen Pasian' tate ihih manin, mihing khutsiamte in bawlin a zep ngunte, khamte, suang milimte tawh a kibang dingin Pasian i ngaihsun kei ding hi.
Pasian in mihingte' theih loh hun lai-a a gamtatnate uh phamawh a sak loh hangin, tu-in mun khempeuha om mi khempeuhte a gamtat siatna panun a kihei nadingun thu a hong pia khinzo hi.
Amah in leitung mi khempeuh thu a mantakin ama teel mipa a hong khensak nading ni a sehkhol khinzo hi. Tua a ngaihsutna a man taktak hi, ci-in mi khempeuh tungah a hong lah nadingin a teel mipa, sihna panin a hingkiksak zo hi," ci-in thu a hilh hi.
Sihna panin thawhkikna thu Paul in a gen a zak uh ciangin mi pawlkhat in zahpihbawl uh a, ahi zongin mi pawlkhat in, "Hih thu khatvei zakik nuam lai ung," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua kikhopna panin Paul a paikhia hi.
Mi pawlkhat in thu umin Paul pawlpih uh a, tuate lakah Areopagas mualbo a thu vaihawm pawl sungah a kihel Dionisias, le Damaris a kici numei khat, le mi pawlkhat ahi uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Athen khua panin Paul paikhia-in Korin khua-ah a tung hi.
Tua lai-ah Pontas gam a suak, Jew mi Aquila a kici mi khat tawh a kimu hi. Gam uk Kumpipa in Jew mi khempeuh Rom khua panin a taikhiat nadingun thu pia ahih manin Aquila le a zi Prisilla pen Italy gam panin Korin khua a hong tun uh a sawt nai lo ahi hi. Tua nupate tawh a kimu dingin Paul zong a inn uhah va hawh a,
tua nupate mah bangin Paul zong puanbuk bawl nasep tawh a nungta ahih manin amaute tawh omkhawmin na a semkhawm uh hi.
Sabbath ni simin kikhopna inn-ah limtakin thu gen a, Jew mi le Grik mite in thu a up nadingun a hanciam hi.
Masedonia gam panin Silas le Timoti hong tun ciangin Paul in a hun neih khempeuh thuhilhna-in zang a, Jesuh pen Khrih ahi hi, ci-in Jew mite kiangah teltakin a gen hi.
Jew mite in ama thuhilhna nialin a gensiat uh ciangin Paul in a puan tunga leivui bangte sinsanin, "Pasian tawh kikhenin siatna na tuah uhleh nomau khialhna hi a, kei nong ngawh nading uh om lo hi. Tu a kipanin Gentail mite kiangah thu ka hilh ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Paul in tua Jew mite nusia-in Pasian a bia Gentail mi Titus Justas' inn-ah a tung hi. Tua mipa' inn pen kikhopna inn gei mahmah ahi hi.
Kikhopna inn ukpa Krispas le a innsunga om mi khempeuh in Topa thu um uh a, Korin khua-a om midang tampite in zong thuhilhna ngai-in um uh a, tui a kiphum uh hi.
Zan khat, Paul in maang mu a, a maang sungah Topa in, "Lau kei in. Lungkia kei inla, na thugen zom in.
Hih khua sungah keima mi tampi om a, nang hong ompih ka hih manin kuamah in nang bangmah hong cih lo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin tua khua-ah kum khat le alang sung omlai-in mite kiangah Pasian thu a hilh hi.
Rom khutnuai-ah Akhaia gam sung a uk dingin Gallio a kikoih ciangin Jew mite hong kikaikhawm uh a, Paul manin zumah a paipih uh hi.
Amaute in, "Hih mipa in ngeina om lopi-in mite in Pasian a biak nadingin zol ding hanciam hi," a ci uh hi.
Paul in a kam ka-in thugen dingin a kipat laitakin Gallio in Jew mite kiangah, "Hih thu pen gamtat khialhna ahi a, gitloh tatna ahi zongin a gamtatna hang hileh no Jew mite' thugente limtakin kong ngaih ding a kilawm mah ahi hi.
Ahi zongin hih thu pen kam zatzia, min le na ngeina uh a kituh na hih manun nomau mah in khentawm un. Tua bang thute keimah in ka hong khen kei ding hi," a cih khit ciangin,
zum panin amaute a hawlkhia hi.
Amaute in kikhopna inn ukpa Sosthenes manin, zum mai-ah satgawp uh a, ahi zongin Gallio in themkhat zong phamawh sa lo hi.
Korin khua-ah ni tampi sung thu um mite tawh Paul omkhawm lai a, tua khit ciangin amaute mangpha khakin Syria gam a zuan dingin Prisilla le Aquila tawh teembaw a tuang uh hi. Paul in Pasian tungah thuciamnasa nei ahih manin teembaw a tuan ma-un Korin khuapi teembaw khawlna Kenkhrea munah a sam a metsak hi.
Tua bangin a pai uh ciangin Efesa khua tung uh a, Paul zong kikhopna inn-ah pai-in Jew mite tawh thu a kisel uh hi. Tua khua-ah Prisilla le Aquila-te nupa a taam lai nading Paul in a gen hi.
Thu um mi pawlkhatte in ni tampi sung Paul a taam nadingin gen uh a, ahi zongin amah taam nuam lo hi;
a dinkhiat ding ciangin, "Pasian deihna ahih nakleh note kiangah ka hong hawhkik ding hi," ci-in vaikhakin, Efesa khua panin teembaw tawh a ding khia hi.
Sisaria khua a tun ciangin Jerusalem khua-ah pai-in pawlpite va hopih a, tua ciangin Antiok khua-ah a pai hi.
Antiok khua-ah tawlkhat a taam khit ciangin Galatia gam le Frigia gam sungah pai-in thu um mi khempeuh a va thakhauhsak hi.
Alexandria khuami Apollos a kici Jew mi khat, Efesa khua-ah hong pai hi. Amah thugen siam mahmah a, Lai Siangtho zong a thei mahmah khat ahi hi.
Amah in Topa' zia thei a, lawp mahmahna tawh Jesuh' thu a mantakin a hilh hi. Ahi zongin amah in Johan' tuiphumna thu bek a thei hi.
Amah in kikhopna inn sungah hangtakin thu hilh ding kipan a, Prisilla le Aquila in ama thuhilhna a zak uh ciangin a omna uh inn-ah Apollos ciahpihin, Pasian' thu paiziate a mantakin a hilhtel uh hi.
Akhaia gamah Apollos pai ding a sawm ciangin, Akhaia gam a om thu um mite in limtakin a na pawlbawl nading uh deihna tawh Efesa khua-a om thu um mite in lai a khak uh hi. Amah a tun ciangin Pasian hehpihna hangin Jesuh thu a um tua lai-a om mite a dingin nuamtuam mahmah hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Lai Siangtho sung siksanin Jesuh pen Khrih ahi hi, ci-in mihon lakah Jew mite tawh thu kiselin a zogawp hi.
Korin khua-ah Apollos a om laitakin Paul khual hong zinin Efesa khua hong tung hi. Tua khua-ah thu um mi pawlkhat tawh kimu a,
"Thu na up uh ciangin Kha Siangtho na ngah uh hiam?" ci-in a dot leh, "Kha Siangtho a omlam nangawn ka za nai kei uh hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua ciangin Paul in, "Tua ahihleh na kituiphumna dan uh bangci bang ahi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin, "Tuiphumpa Johan' thugen bang pawl ahi hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua ciangin Paul in, "Johan' hilh tuiphumna pen mawhna a kisik mite a' ding ahi hi. Amah in Israel mite kiangah, 'Keima nunga hong pai ding pa Jesuh um un,' ci-in gen hi," a ci hi.
Amaute in hih thu a zak uh ciangin Topa Jesuh' minin tui a kiphum uh hi.
Paul in amaute tungah a khut a ngakkhit ciangin amaute tungah Kha Siangtho hong tung hi. Amaute in pau lamdang hong paupah uh a, Pasian' thu zong a gen uh hi.
Tua mite sawm le nih a pha uh hi.
Tua ciangin Paul in kikhopna inn sungah hangtakin kha thum sung thu hilh a, mite in Pasian' Ukna thu a upzawh nadingun nakpitakin a gen hi.
Ahi zongin mi pawlkhat in kin hetloin um nuam lo uh a, mipi' zakin Topa' thu paiziate gensia gawp uh ahih manin Paul in amaute nusia-in thu um mite paikhiatpih a, Tirannas in thugenna-in a neih innpi sungah nisimin thugenna hun a zang hi.
Hih bangin kum nih sung tawntung thu gen niloh ahih manin Asia gam sunga om Jew mi le Gentail mi khempeuh in Topa' thu a za uh hi.
Pasian in Paul' tungtawnin nalamdang lianpipi a bawl hi.
Ama zat mainul ahi a, a puante ahi zongin cinate kiangah a kipaipih ciangin a natnate uh damin, a sunga om dawite zong a taikhia uh hi.
Dawi hawlkhia-in a vak kawikawi Jew mi aitawi pawlkhat in zong Topa Jesuh' min zangin dawi hawlkhiat ding a sawm uh hi. Amaute in dawite kiangah, "Paul in a gengen Jesuh' min tawh thu kong pia uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Siampi lianpen Skeva' tapa sagihte in tu-a bang danin na sem uh hi.
Ahi zongin dawite in amau kiangah, "Jesuh ka thei uh a, Paul zong ka thei uh hi. Note kua na hi uh hiam?" a cihkhit uh ciangin,
dawilutna mipa in amaute buan gawpin zogawp ahih manin, a liam a bai, puan keksa-in tua mipa' inn panin a taikhia uh hi.
Efesa khua-a om Jew mi le Gentail mi khempeuh in hih thu za-in lau mahmah uh a, Topa Jesuh' min nakpitakin a kiphat semsem hi.
Thu a um midang tampi tak zong hong pai uh a, mipi' zakin a gamtatnasate khempeuh uh hong pulak uh hi.
Ai a san ngei mi tampi tak in zong a aisanna laibute uh hong paipih uh a, mi khempeuh' muhin a haltum uh hi. Tua laibu mante a gawm uh ciangin ngun peek then nga man bang ahi hi.
Tu-a bang danin Topa thu nakpitakin hong khangin hong kizel semsem hi.
Hih bang thuteng a piankhit ciangin Masedonia gam le Akhaia gamah Paul zinin Jerusalem-ah paisuak ding a ngaihsun hi. Tua khit ciangin Rom khua-ah zong pai ning, a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amah a huh Timoti le Erastas, Masedonia gamah paisak a, amah in Asia gam sungah tawlkhat hun a zang hi.
Tua hun laitakin Topa' thu hangin Efesa khua-ah buaina lianpi khat a hong piang hi.
Demetrias min nei ngunseek mipa khat in Artemis nusian biakna inn lim ngun tawh bawl a, tua nasepna in amah le a naseppih mite a dingin hauhna lianpi a piangsak hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute' sep bang a sem midang khempeuh kaikhawmin, "Lawmte aw, hih nasepna hangin a hau ihihna thu na thei uh hi.
Nomau mahmah in hih Paul' thugen khempeuh za-in na thei uh hi. Amah in mihingte' bawl pasian-te pen pasian hi het lo hi, ci-in thu hilh a, hih Efesa khua le Asia gam sung khempeuhah mi tampi tak a umsak hi.
Tua ahih manin i nasepna a siatkhak ding lauhuai hi. Tua bek hi loin, Asia gam sung mi le leitung mi khempeuh in a biak Artemis nusian biakna innpi a mawkna hong suahkhak ding, le a liatna teng a maimankhak ding nak lauhuai mahmah hi," a ci hi.
Mihonte in hih thu a zak uh ciangin heh mahmah uh a, "Efesa khuamite' Artemis lianpen hi," ci-in awngkekgawp uh hi.
Khuasung khempeuhah tua buaina hong kizel a, mihonte in Paul tawh a kikhawl Masedonia mi Gaias le Aristarkhas manin mihon kikhopna innpi-ah a kai uh hi.
Paul zong tua innsung mihonte mai-ah thugen dingin painuam a, ahi zongin thu um mite in a pai ding a phal kei uh hi.
Paul' lawm ahi tua gam a ulian pawlkhatte in Paul kiangah kamtai paisak uh a, hih kikhopna munah hong kilak het kei in, ci-in nakpitakin a khosak uh hi.
Tua innpi sungah mihonpi buai ngeingai uh a, mi a tamzaw in a paina thu uh thei lo uh ahih manin, pawlkhat in thu khat genin awnggawp uh a, adang pawlkhat in a thu tuampi khat na awng leuleu uh hi.
Jew mite in mihonpi mai-ah Alexander hong dingsak uh ahih manin, mi pawlkhat in hih thupiang ama hang hi, ci-in ngaihsun uh hi. Alexander in mihonte a gamdaih nadingin a khut hong van a, a mawh lohna uh thu a gen dingin hong kipan hi.
Ahi zongin Jew mi ahih lamtak a theih uh ciangin, "Efesa khuamite' Artemis lianpen hi," ci-in a kituakin nai nih sung a awng uh hi.
A tawpna ciangin khuasung lai-at pa in mihonte a gamdaih nadingin khozo a, "Efesa khuapi mite aw, Efesa khuapi pen, a lian mahmah Artemis biakna innpi le van panin a hong kia biakna suang a kem khuapi ahihna thu mi khempeuh in a theihsa ahi hi.
Hih thu pen kuamah in hong nial thei lo ding hi. Tua ahih manin gamdai takin om unla, a kilawm lo na khat peuhpeuh gamta kei un.
Hih mite in i biakna inn lah bangmah cih lo, i nusian zong bangmah gensiatna nei lo napi-in hih lai-ah na hong paipih uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Demetrias le a pawlte in mi khatpeuh tungah lungkim lohna nei uh ahihleh thu sit ni ding hun om a, thukhen uliante zong om uh ahih manin tuate mai-ah thu kineih ta uh hen.
Ahi zongin hih thu-ah lungkimzo nai lo na hih uhleh zong a ngeina cingin a kikhop uh ciangin gen ding ahi hi.
Tuni-a thupiang hangin eite buaina piangsak, ci-in hong kimawhsak khak ding lauhuai hi. Hih bangin buaina a om nading bangmah a thu om lopi hi a, i siksan ding bangmah thu om het lo hi," a ci hi.
Hih thuteng a genkhit ciangin mihonte a ciahsak hi.
Hih buaina thu a ven' ciangin Paul in thu um mite kaikhawmin, hanthotna kam genin amaute mangpha khak a, Masedonia gam a zuan dingin ding khia hi.
Hih gam sungah khualzinin hanthotna tampi a genkhit ciangin Grik gamah pai a,
tua gamah kha thum sung a tam hi. Syria gam manawh dingin a kithawi laitakin tua gam a om Jew mite in lamkalah amah a thahsawmna thu za ahih manin Masedonia gam tawn kikin khualzin ding a ngaihsun hi.
Berea khuami Pirras' tapa Sopater, Thesalonika khuami Aristarkhas le Sekundus, Derbe khuami Gaias, Timoti, le Asia gam sung panin Tikhikas le Trofimas-te in zong a zui uh hi.
Amaute na mapai uh a, Troas khua-ah kote hong ngak uh hi.
Silngo Sawh loh Anlum Pawi a ven' khit ciangin Filippi khua panin teembaw tawh ka ding uh a, ni nga khit ciangin Troas khua tungin amaute tawh ka kimu uh a, tua lai-ah nipikal khat sung ka taam uh hi.
Sani nitakin an nekhawm dingin ka kikhawm uh a, a zing ciangin a ding khia ding ahih manin Paul in a thuhilh zankim ciang dong a zomsuak hi.
Ka kikhopna uh inn dawl tungnung sungah meivak tampi a kivak hi.
Tawlet gei-ah Eutikhas a kici tangval khat tu a, Paul in a thugen zomzom ahih manin tua tangvalpa a ihmut suakin lusu a, a sawtna ciangin ihmusip kha-in inn dawl thumna panin leilakah a kiasuk hi. Amaute in a va phot uh ciangin amah na si khinta hi.
Paul zong va kumsukin tangvalpa tungah bokin kikhuangin kawi a, "Lunghimawh kei un, hinglai hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin inn dawl tungnungah kahto kikin anlum balnenin thu um mite tawh a nekhawm hi. Zingsang khuavak dong amaute tawh thu kikum uh a, tua ciangin a ding khia hi.
Amaute in tua tangvalpa a inn-ah va kha uh a, a lungsim uh nuamkik mahmah hi.
Tua ciangin Paul in, Assos khua ciang dong khe-in pai ning, ci-in ko kiangah hong gen ahih manin, Troas khua panin teembaw tuangin Assos-ah ka pai uh a, tua khua-ah Paul tawh a kituah ding ka hi uh hi.
Assos khua ka tun uh ciangin Paul in zong teembaw hong man a, Mitylene khua-ah ka paisuak uh hi.
Tua panin ding leuleu-in a zing ciangin Khios tuikulh khengin Samos tuikulh ka tung uh hi. Tua panin a zing ciangin Miletas khua ka tung uh hi.
Paul in Jerusalem khua-ah Pentekos Pawi hun lapnuam ahih manin Asia gam sungah ban man dingin ngaihsun lo a, Efesa khua-ah taam sawm lo hi.
Paul in Miletas khua panin Efesa khua-ah thu puak a, Efesa pawlpi upate in a na dawntuah nadingin a vaikhak hi.
Efesa pawlpi upate hong tun ciangin Paul in amaute kiangah, "Asia gam sung kong tun ni a kipanin note tawh ka om sungteng ka nasepna khempeuh note in na thei uh hi.
Jew mite in kei hong thahsawmna hangin kiniamkhiatna le khitui naptui tawh haksapi-in Topa' na ka sem hi.
Mihon lak ahi a, note' inn sungah ahi zongin ka hong thuhilhna khempeuhah note' phattuam nading a om khempeuh siit nei loin kong gen khin hi.
Jew mi le Gentail mite a mawhna panun Pasian' lamah kihei-in i Topa Jesuh a up nadingun thu ka gen khinzo hi.
Tu-in ahihleh Kha Siangtho' hong sawlna mangin, kei tungah bang thu hong piang ding hiam, cih thei lopi-in Jerusalem khua-ah a pai ding ka hi hi.
Thongkiatna le gimna ka thuak nading thu bekbek, ka omna khua khempeuhah Kha Siangtho in hong gen tawntung hi.
Ahi zongin Topa Jesuh in kei sep dingin a hong piak, Pasian hehpihna hangin Lungdamna Thu, mite kiangah gen ding nasep ka tangtut zawh nakleh kei nuntakna-ah bangbang hong piang taleh a thupi-in ka ngaihsun kei hi.
"A beisa hunah Pasian' Ukna thu a hilhin note lakah kong vak kawikawi a, ahi zongin tu-in kuamah in nong muhkik nawn loh ding uh ka thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tuni mahmahin note tungah limtakin kong gennop thu in: Note khat peuhpeuh Pasian tawh kikhenin siatna na tuah uhleh kei' tavuan hi nawn lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh note tungah Pasian' thu kong gen loh khat zong om nawn lo hi.
Kha Siangtho in note' khut sungah a hong koih pawlpi mite le nomau pumpi mahmah limtakin na kem un. Pasian in a Tapa a sihna tawh a ngah a pawlpi hoihtakin a kemte na hi ta un.
Kei ka om nawn loh ciangin, sa gilote in gannote a phialgawp bangin, mi pawlkhat in thu um mite hong phialgawp ding lamtak ka thei hi.
Note sung mahmah panin zong mi pawlkhat in thu um mite khemin a zolkhiat hun hong tung ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin limtakin kiging unla, kum thum sung tawntung khitui naptui tawh note khempeuh ka hong thuhilhna na ciamteh un.
"Tu-in Pasian' khutsung le ama dikna thu sungah note ka hong ap hi. Amah in note hong khangtosak thei-in, ama mite khempeuh a dingin a koih thuphate note tungah hong pia thei hi.
Kuama neihsa, ngun, kham, le puante en' dingin ka ngaihsun ngei kei hi.
Kei le ka kithuahpihte' kisapna khempeuh ka ngahtheih nadingin keima khut mahmah tawh na ka sepna thu note in na thei uh hi.
Topa Jesuh mahmah in, 'Ngahna sangin piak khiatna-ah lungdamna lianzaw hi,' a cihna phawkkawmin nakpitakin nasepna tawh na khempeuhah a zawngkhalte huh ding hi hang, ci-in note kiangah kong lak khinzo hi," ci-in a vaikhak hi.
Paul in hih bangin a kam vaikhak a man khit ciangin a vekpi-un khukdin uh a, Paul in thu a ngen hi.
Amaute a kikhen dingin mangpha a kikhak uh ciangin khatlekhat kilen kikawi-in a kap uh hi.
Paul in, "Kuamah in nong mukik nawn kei ding uh hi," a cihna hangin a dah mahmah uh hi. Amaute in teembaw tung ciang dong Paul a hong kha uh hi.
Amaute tawh ka kikhen khit uh ciangin teembaw tawh paisuakin Kos tuikulh ka tung uh hi. A zing ciangin Rods tuikulh ka tung uh a, tua lai panin a zing ciangin Patara khua ka tung uh hi.
Tua lai panin Foenisia gamah a pai ding teembaw khat na om ahih manin tua teembaw tuangin ka pai uh hi.
Saipras tuikulh a kigal muhna mun ka tun uh ciangin tua tuikulh leitaw lampang kantanin Syria gam lam manawhin ka paisuak uh a, Taia khua ka tun uh ciangin teembaw in a van puakte suah ahih manin teembaw tung pan ka tuakkhia uh hi.
Tua khua-ah ka kan uhleh thu um mi pawlkhat na om uh a, amaute kiangah nipikal khat sung ka taam uh hi. Jerusalem khua-ah Paul a pai loh nadingin Kha Siangtho' lamlahna tawh amaute in a gen uh hi.
Amaute kiang panin ka ciahkhiat ding uh hun hong tun ciangin ka ding khia uh a, a zite a tate uh tawh a vekpi-un khuanawl ciang hong zui uh hi. Tuipi gei ka tun uh ciangin khukdinin thu ka ngen uh hi.
Tua ciangin khatlekhat mangpha kikhakin teembaw tungah ka tuang uh a, amaute zong a inn uhah a ciah uh hi.
Taia khua panin teembaw tawh pai-in Tolemais khua ka tung uh a, tua lai-ah thu um mite kiangah sun khat kulhin amaute tawh ka kiho uh hi.
A zing ciangin ding leuleu-in Sisaria khua ka tung uh a, Pasian thu a hilh Filip' inn-ah tungin tua lai-ah ka taam uh hi. Tua pa pen Jerusalem khua-a a kiteel mi sagihte sungah a kihel ahi hi.
Amah in Pasian thu a hilh tanu-ngak li nei hi.
Tua lai-ah tawlkhat ka taam khit uh ciangin Judea gam panin Agabas min nei kamsang khat hong tung hi.
Kote' kiangah amah hong pai-in Paul' kawnggak hong laksak a, tua kawnggak tawh ama khut le a khete a gakcip khit ciangin, "Kha Siangtho in, 'Jerusalem khua sungah hih bangin Jew mite in hih kawnggak nei pa hencip ding a, Gentail mite' khut sungah pia ding hi,' ci hi," a hong ci hi.
Hih thu ka zak uh ciangin kote le tua lai-a om thu um mite in Jerusalem-ah Paul a pai loh nadingin ka thum uh hi.
Ahi zongin Paul in, "Bang hangin hih bangin kapin ka lungsim a tapkhap nadingin gamta na hi uh hiam? Jerusalem khua-ah khihcipna a thuak ding bek hi loin, Topa Jesuh hangin a si ding ciang dongin a kithawisa ka hi hi," ci-in a hong dawng hi.
Thu ka genpihpih uh hangin hong mang zo lo ahih manin, ka cih nading uh thei nawn loin, "Topa' deihna bangbang hi ta hen," ci-in ka omta uh hi.
Tua lai-ah tawlkhat ka taam khit uh ciangin ka vante uh kithawi-in Jerusalem khua a zuan dingin ka dinkhiat uh ciangin,
Sisaria khua panin thu um mi pawlkhat in zong hong zui uh a, ka tun nading uh Mnason' inn-ah hong paipih uh hi. Mnason pen Saipras tuikulh gammi hi a, sawt pek a kipanin thu um mi a na hi khinsa ahi hi.
Jerusalem khua ka tun uh ciangin thu um mite in lungdam mahmahin a hong hopih uh hi.
A zing ciangin James kiangah Paul tawh ka hawh uh a, tua lai-ah pawlpi upa khempeuh a na om uh hi.
Paul in amaute hopih a, Pasian in amah Paul tungtawnin Gentail mite lakah na a sepna khempeuh a banbanin a cingtakin a gen hi.
Ama thugen teng a zakkhit uh ciangin a vekpi-un Pasian a phat uh hi. Tua ciangin Paul kiangah, "Sanggam aw, hih lai-ah na theih ding thu khat om hi. Hih lai-ah thu um Jew mi tampi tak om a, amaute in thukham nakzuih mahmah uh hi.
Gentail mite lak a om Jew mi khempeuh tungah na thuhilhna, amaute in Moses thukham zui loin, Jew ngeina zui nawn loin, a tate uh zong vun a at loh nadingun na thugente khempeuh, hih lai-a om Jew mite tungah kigen hi.
Hih lai nong tunkhitna thu amaute in pel loin zakhin ding uh ahih manin bangcih ding ihi hiam?
Tua ahih manin kong gen bangun gamta in. Pasian tungah thuciamna a bawl khinsa mihing li om hi.
Tua mite tawh va kipawl inla, a kisiansuahna uhah nang zong va kihelin, a sum beiteng khempeuh nangmah in sik in. A kisiansuah khit uh ciangin amaute in a sam uh met thei ta ding uh hi. Hih bangin gamta lecin a beisa huna nangma thu a kigente khempeuh a man khat zong om loin, nangmahmah zong Moses Thukham a zui na hihna thu mi khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi.
Thu um Gentail mite tawh kisai-in ahihleh, amaute in milim biakna an khat peuhpeuh, sasi, le a si kiluangkhiasak loin gawlmek a kigo sate a nek loh nading uh, le numei tawh khialhna panin a kikep nading uh hoih hi, ci-in thu khensatin lai ka khak khinzo uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Paul, a zing ciangin tua mi lite tawh va pai khawmin kisiansuahna a va bawl uh hi. Tua ciangin biakinn sungah amah va pai a, a kisiansuah hun sung uh a hun sawt ding tan, tua mi lite a dingin biakna a kipiak ding ni a va zasak hi.
Tua ni sagih hunsung a bei dektak ciangin Asia gam panin a hong pai Jew mite pawlkhat in, biakinn sungah Paul a omna a mu uh hi. Amaute in mihonte sosuahin Paul man uh a,
"Israel mite aw, hong huh un. Mun khempeuhah thu hilh kawikawi-in, Moses Thukham, le hih biakinn langpangin mi khempeuh kiangah Israel mite a hong gensia pa ahi hi. Tu-in Gentail mite nangawn biakinn sungah hong paipihin hih biakinn siangtho a ninsak hi," ci-in a awng uh hi.
(Hih bang a cih theihna uh pen khua sungah Paul le Efesa khuami Trofimas a kikhawl mu uh a, Paul in biakinn sungah tua mipa a lutpih a sa kha uh ahi hi.)
Tua ciangin hih thu in khuasung khempeuh hong zel a, mite hong tai-in hong kikhawmin Paul man uh a, biakinn pualamah kaikhia-in, biakinn kongkhakte a khakpah uh hi.
Mihonte in Paul that dingin a kithawi laitakun Jerusalem khuasung buai mahmah hi, ci-in Rom galkap mangpa kiangah thu na kipuak hi.
Galkap mangpa in zong thakhatin galkapbute le galkapte samin mihonte lak a va kidenna uh hi. Mihonte in galkapte tawh hong pailam a muh uh ciangin Paul a sat nawn kei uh hi.
Paul kiangah galkap mangpa hong pai-in man a, sikkhau nih tawh Paul a khih nadingun thu a pia hi. Tua ciangin, "Hih mipa kua hi a, bang gamta ahi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin,
mihonte sung panin pawlkhat in thu khat genin, pawlkhat in adang khat a gen hi. Mihon kibuai lua a, bang teng taktak hiam, cih theikhia zo lo ahih manin galkap inn-ah a paipih nadingun a mite thu a pia hi.
Galkap huangsung lutna kahlei a tun uh ciangin mihonte in nehcip lua uh ahih manin galkapte in Paul laamto-in a paipih uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh mihonte in hong nungzuihin, "Amah that un," ci-in a awng uh hi.
Amaute in galkap huang sungah Paul a lutpih dektak laitakun Paul in galkap mangpa kiangah, "Nang tung thu tawmkhat kong genthei ding hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin galkap mangpa in, "Grik pau siam hi lo na hi hiam?
Tua ahih manin tuma lamin kumpi lehdo dingin mihing tulli tawh gam sungah a pai Egypt mipa hi buang kei ni teh maw?" a ci hi.
Paul in, "Kei pen Silisia gam Tarsas khua-a suak Jew mi ka hi a, khua thupi sungah a teng mi ka hi hi. Nong hehpihna-in hih mihonte tungah thu hong gensak in," a ci hi.
Galkap mangpa in zong thu a gen ding phal ahih manin kahlei cial tungah Paul ding a, mite a gamdaih nadingin a khut a van hi. Mite a gamdaih khit ciangin Paul in Hebru pau-in mite tungah thu gen a,
"Pate, ute, khangualte aw, hih thu-ah bangmah ka mawh lohna thu kong gen laitakin na ngai un," a ci hi.
Hebru pau-in thu a genna mihonte in a zak uh ciangin amaute gamdaizaw kan uh ahih manin Paul in a thugen zomin,
"Kei pen Silisia gam Tarsas khua-a suak Jew mi ka hi a, ahi zongin hih lai Jerusalem khua-ah Gamaliel' khut sungah sangnaupang hi-in a khangto ka hi hi. I pu i pate' Thukham limtakin hong kihilh a, tu-a note zah mahin Pasian tungah a kipia mi khat ka hi hi.
Hih Thu a zui numei pasal a kuamah peuh manin thong sung ka denna a, sihna ciang dongin amaute ka bawlsia hi.
Hih ka thugente a man ahihna thu, siampi lianpen pa le upa khempeuh in hong genthei ding uh hi. Damaskas khua-a om i Jew mipihte ka lah dingin amaute in lai hong pia uh ahih manin, upate in gim a piaktheih nadingun tua khua-a om thu um mite manin sikkhau khihin Jerusalem khua-ah a ciahpih dingin ka va pai hi.
"Damaskas khua a zuan dingin pai-in ka tun dektak sunkim pawl laitakin, thakhatthu-in van panin ka kimkot hong taangzaih hi.
Leilakah pukin ka om laitakin awging khat ka za a, 'Saul, Saul! Bang hangin kei hong bawlsia na hi hiam?' hong ci hi.
Kei zong, 'Topa aw, kua na hi hiam?' ci-in ka dot ciangin, 'Nangmah in na hong bawlsiat, Nazareth khuami Jesuh ka hi hi,' a hong ci hi.
Ka tonpih mite in a khuavak taang mu uh a, ahi zongin kei' tungah thu hong gen pa' awging za lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong, 'Topa aw, bangci gamtat ding ka hi hiam?' ci-in ka dot ciangin amah in, 'Tho inla, Damaskas khua-ah pai in. Nang' hih dingin Pasian in a sehsa thu khempeuh, tua khua panin hong kigen ding hi,' a hong ci hi.
Tua khuavak taanglua hangin khua muthei nawn lo ka hih manin ka tonpihte in ka khutin hong lenin Damaskas khua-ah a hong paipih uh hi.
"Tua khua-ah Ananias min nei, Thukham limtakin zui-in biakna hahkat mahmah, Damaskas khua-a om Jew mite in a zahtak mahmah mi khat a na om hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, 'I pu i pate' Pasian in ama deihna a thei ding, a thuman a Nasempa a mu ding, le ama kam mahmah tawh a thugen a za dingin nang hong teel khinzo hi.
Tua ahih manin na muhsa le na zaksa thu khempeuh, mi khempeuh tungah genin teci a pang ding na hi hi.
Tu-in bang ngak lai ding na hi hiam? Tho inla, Pasian kiangah thu ngenin kituiphum inla, na mawhnate silsiangsak in,' hong ci hi.
"Tua ciangin Jerusalem khua-ah ka ciahkik a, biakinn sungah thu ngenin ka om laitakin maang ka mu hi.
Tua ka maang sungah Topa in kei kiangah, 'Hih lai-a om mite in keima thu na gennate hong um lo ding uh ahih manin Jerusalem khua panin kuankhia mengmeng in,' hong ci hi.
Kei zong, 'Kikhopna innte-ah pai kawikawi-in nangma thu hong um mite manin ka satgawpna thu amaute mahmah in teltakin hong thei uh hi.
Nangma thu a gen Stefen a kithah laitakin kei mahmah zong ka om a, tua a kithahna thukimpihin a thatte' puante nangawn ka kepsak hi,' ci-in ka dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in kei kiangah, 'Gentail mite omna gamlapi-ah hong sawl ding ka hih manin pai peuh in,' hong ci hi," a ci hi.
Paul in Gentail mite kianga pai nading thu a gen matengin mite in limtakin a ngai uh hi. Ahi zongin tu-a thu a pulak ciangin a aw neihzah uh tawh mite kiko-in, "Leitungah hih bang mi omsak kei un! That un! A hing dingin kilawm lo!" ci-in a awng uh hi.
Mihonte hehlua-in awngkekgawp uh a, a puan uh suahin vanah lawnin, leivui zong van lamah a lawn uh hi.
Tua ciangin Rom galkap mangpa in galkap huang sungah Paul a paipih nadingun thu pia a, bang hangin Jew mite hih bangin ama tungah hehin awngkekgawp uh ahi hiam, ci-in a theih nadingin a satsak hi.
Amaute in sat dingin a hen khit uh ciangin Paul in a gei-a ding galkap bupa kiangah, "Khial hi, ci-in thu nangawn a kisit nai lo Rom mi khat na sat ding uh ngeina ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Galkap bupa in hih thu a zak ciangin galkap mangpa kiangah pai-in, "A bangci na hi hiam? Hua mipa, Rom gammi ahi hi," a cih ciangin,
galkap mangpa zong Paul kiangah va pai-in, "Rom gammi na hi hiam, hong gen dih in," a cih leh Paul in, "Ka hi mah hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin galkap mangpa in, "Hih Rom gammi suah nadingin sum tampi tawh ka lei hi," a ci hi. Paul in, "Kei ka pianin Rom mi-a piang ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Paul thu a dong dingin a gei-a om mite a paikhia uh hi. Sikkhau tawh a khih khit ciangin Paul pen Rom gammi ahihna a phawk ciangin galkap mangpa zong lau-in a lunghimawh hi.
Jew mite in bang hangin Paul mawhsak ahi uh hiam, ci-in teltakin galkap mangpa in theinuam ahih manin a zing ciangin Paul a khihsakna sikkhaute sutsak a, siampi liante le upate thu kikupna a nei dingin a samsak hi. Tua ciangin Paul paikhiatpihin uliante mai-ah a dingsak hi.
Paul in ulian kikhawmte limtakin enin, "Lawmte aw, tuni ciang dong ka nuntak sung tawntung, Pasian mai-ah kisuanna ka nei het kei hi," a cih leh
siampi lianpen pa Ananias in Paul gei-a omte kiangah, "A muk na betsak un," a ci hi.
Paul in, "Leikang tawh a kizut kulh tawh a kibang pa aw, Pasian in nang hong beenggawp taktak ding hi. Keimah thusitna-ah Thukham a zui ding pa hinapi-in Thukham zui loin kei hong kibet nadingin thu na pia hi," a ci hi.
Paul gei-a om mite in, "Pasian' siampi lianpen pa na zahko hi," a cih ciangun
Paul in, "Lawmte aw, siampi lianpen pa ahihlam ka thei kei hi. Lai Siangtho in, 'Na mite uh a ukpa na gensia kei ding uh hi,' ci hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Paul in tua uliante lakah Saddusi mi le Farisi mi a omlam a muh ciangin amaute kiangah, "Lawmte aw, kei pen Farisi mite' suan ahi Farisi mi ka hi hi. Mi site hingkik ding hi, ci-in lamenin upna ka neih manin hih lai-ah thusitna ka thuak hi," a ci hi.
Tua thu a gen khit phetin Saddusi mite le Farisi mite kitawngpah uh a, tua uliante khen nih a pha uh hi.
(Bang hang hiam cih leh Saddusi mite in mi a sih khit ciangin hingkik nawn lo ding hi. Vantung mi ahi a, kha ahi zongin om lo hi, ci uh hi. Ahi zongin Farisi mite in hih thu thumte om hi, ci-in a um uh hi.)
Amau' kitotna awging hupha semsem a, Farisi mite pawlsung a om Thukham hilh siate pawlkhat hong dingin nakpitakin hong pau uh a, "Hih mipa tungah khialhna themkhat zong om lo hi. Vantung mi ahi a, Pasian' sawl khat peuhpeuh in ahi zongin ama tungah thu a gen hi khathei ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Amaute' kitotna hong husia semsem ahih manin amaute in Paul balthanggawp kha ding hi, ci-in galkap mangpa lunghimawh hi. Tua ahih manin galkapte in Paul va kaikhia-in galkap inn-ah a paipih nadingun thu a pia hi.
Tua zanin Paul kiangah Topa hong ding a, "Hang takin om in. Hih Jerusalem khua sungah keima thu genin teci na pan' mah bangin Rom khuapi-ah zong keima thu genin teci na pang ding hi," a ci hi.
A zing ciangin Jew mite pawlkhat kikhawm uh a, Paul i thahkhit ciang bekin anne tuidawn pan ding hi hang, ci-in kiciamna a nei uh hi.
Hih bangin a vaihawm mihing sawmli val bang a pha uh hi.
Siampi liante le upate kiangah pai uh a, "Paul ka thahkhit mateng uh anletui ka nekloh nadingun khauhtakin thuciamna khat ka nei khin uh hi.
Tu-in note le uliante in galkap mangpa tungah thu zasak unla, Paul' thu a cingin a theinuam kineihin, note kiangah Paul hong paipihsak nadingin na ngen un. Hih lai mun hong tunma-in kote in lamkalah ka na that ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin hih a thahsawmna thu uh, Paul sanggamnu' tapa in za ahih manin galkap inn-ah va pai-in Paul kiangah a va gen hi.
Tua ciangin Paul in galkapbute khat samin ama kiangah, "Galkap mangpa kiangah hih tangvalpa va paipih in. Amah in thugen ding khat a nei hi," a ci hi.
Galkap bupa in zong galkap mangpa kiangah va paipih a, "Hih tangvalpa in nang tungah gennop khat hong nei ahih manin nang kiangah kong paipih nadingin thongkia Paul in a hong sawl hi," a ci hi.
Galkap mangpa in zong a khutin tua pa lenin amau gel guak paikhia uh a, "Bang hong gennuam na hi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Tangvalpa in, "Uliante in Paul' thu a cingin a theinuam kineihin, zing ciangin amaute kiangah Paul na paisak nadingin Jew mi aana neite in nget ding a thukim uh hi.
Ahi zongin lamkalah Paul a pangsim dingin mihing sawmli val bang om uh ahih manin amaute' hong ngetna pia kei in. Tua mihing sawmlite in Paul a thahkhit mateng uh anletui a nekloh nadingun kiciamna khat bawlkhin uh hi. Amaute a kithawisa-in om uh a, nangma thupiak ding bek a ngak uh ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin galkap mangpa in tangvalpa kiangah, "Kei kiangah hih thu nong kohna thu kuamah theisak kei in," ci-in a vaikhak khit ciangin a ciahsak hi.
Tua ciangin galkap mangpa in galkapbute nih samin, "Sisaria khua-ah a pai ding galkap zanih sam unla, sakol tung tuang galkap sawmsagih le teitawi galkap zanih tawh zong pai unla, tuzan nai kua hunin ding khia un.
Paul' tuan nading sakol pawlkhat zong keng unla, Menzipa Feliks kiangah hoihtakin va tunpih un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin galkap mangpa in hih a nuai-a bangin lai khat gelh hi:
"A Lian Menzipa aw, Keimah Klaudias Lysias in hopihna lai ka hong gelh hi.
Jew mite in hih mipa manin that dektak uh hi. Rom gammi ahihlam ka theih ciangin ka galkapte tawh pai-in ka va honkhia hi.
Amaute' mawhsakna bang thu ahi hiam, ci-in theinuam ka hih manin thusit dingin amau' uliante kiangah ka paipih hi.
Thong khiat nading le sihna thuak nadingin khialhna a bawlna bangmah ka mu kei hi. A mawhsaknate uh amau' thukham ngeina tawh kisai hi lel hi.
Jew mite pawlkhat in amah a thahsawmna thu hong kikoh ciangin nangma kiangah puak dingin ka ngaihsun hi. Amah a mawhsakte in nangma mai-ah thu a hong gen nadingun amaute kiangah ka gen hi," ci-in a gelh hi.
Galkapte zong a thu ngahna bangun gamta uh a, tua zanin Paul paikhiatpihin Antipatris khua dong a paipih uh hi.
A zing ciangin khe galkapte kilehkik uh a, sakol tung tuang galkapteng bek a kha suaksak uh hi.
Amaute in Sisaria khua-ah Paul tunpih uh a, menzipa kiangah a lai puak uh pia-in, ama tungah Paul a ap uh hi.
Menzipa in tua laikhak sim a, koi lai gammi na hi hiam, ci-in Paul a dong hi. Amah in Sisaria gammi ahihlam a theih ciangin,
"Na langte hong tun ciangin thu kong sit ding hi," ci-in a gen khit ciangin, Herod in a lam inn sungah Paul koihin a cin nadingun thu a pia hi.
Tua khit ni nga ciangin siampi lianpen pa Ananias le upate, amau' thu a gensak ding Tertullas a kici mipa tawh Jerusalem khua panin Sisaria khua-ah hong tung uh a, menzipa Feliks kiangah pai-in Paul a mawhsakna uh thute a va gen uh hi.
Thugen dingin Tertullas a kisawl ciangin hih a nuai-a bangin mawhsakna thu a gen hi: "A Lian Menzipa! Nangma hong makaih siamna hangin hun saupi sung nuamtakin ka omkhin uh a, kote' gam sung a hoih nadingin puahphatna zong tampi tak kibawl khin hi.
Hih thute hangin nang tungah mi khempeuh ka lungdam mahmah uh hi.
Na hun tampi tak hong beisak nuam lo ka hih manun thu a tom theithei a kong gennate uh hehpihna tawh nong ngaih nadingin ka hong thum uh hi.
Hih mipa, buaina a piangsak, a kihtakhuai mi ahihna ka mu uh hi. Mun khempeuha om Jew mite lakah buaina piangsak a, Nazareth mi pawl a kicite a makai pa ahi hi.
Biakinn nangawn thusim loin min siatsak sawm ahih manin amah ka man uh hi. (Komau' thukham tawh kizui-in ama tungah thu khen ka sawm uh hi.
Ahi zongin galkap mangpa Lysias hong pai-in kote kiang panin amah hong kaikhia hi.
Tua ciangin amah a mawhsakte, nangma kiangah hong pai nadingin Lysias in thu a pia hi.) Tu-in hih mipa thu sit lecin, ka mawhsakna uh thu khempeuh nangmah in na thei ding hi," a ci hi.
Jew mite in zong panpih uh a, hih a gen khempeuh a man mah ahi hi, ci-in a gen uh hi.
Paul in thu a gen nadingin menzipa in a khut tawh a lah ciangin Paul in, "Hih minamte tungah thukhenin sauveipi na omkhitna thu ka hong thei hi; kei hong kimawhsaknate nangma mai-ah pheltheih nading hun ngah ka hih manin ka nuam mahmah hi.
Nangmahmah in na theih ding mah bangin, Jerusalem khua-ah Pasian bia dingin ka paina pen ni sawm le ni nih khawng pha pan hi.
Biakinnsung ahi a, kikhopna innsung ahi a, khuasung mun khat peuhpeuhah ahi zongin mi khat peuhpeuh tawh ka kitotna ahi a, mihon in thusia a bawl nadingin ka hanthotna ahi zongin, hih Jew mite in hong mu het lo ding uh hi.
Tu-a kei hong mawhsaknate uh zong a manna thu hong lakthei het lo ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin nangma kiangah kong pulaknop thu in: Amaute in man lo hi, a cih uh tua Thu zui-in kote' pu le pate' Pasian ka bia hi. Moses' Thukham laibu sunga a kigelh thu khempeuh le kamsangte' laibu sunga a kigelhte khempeuh zong ka um hi.
Amaute' up le lamet mah bangin, Pasian in miphate le misiate a kibangin sihna panin hingkiksak khawm ding hi, ci-in umin ka lamen hi.
Tua ahih manin Pasian mai le mite mai-ah lungsim kisuanna a om het lo dingin a tawntungin ka gamta hi.
"Jerusalem panin kum tampi sung ka paikhiat khit ciangin ka mipihte a kihuhna sumte a puak ding le gan go-in Pasian a bia dingin Jerusalem-ah ka pai hi.
Biakinn sungah keimah kisiansuahna ka bawlkhit hun ciangin amaute in kei hong mu uh a, buaina zong bangmah om lo hi.

Tua ahih kei leh zong, uliante mai-ah thusitna thuakin ka om laitakin ka mawhna bang mu uh ahi hiam, cih thu hih mite gensak in.

Bang hangin no Jew mite in Pasian in misite a thawhkik sakna thu um thei lo na hi uh hiam?
