Rom khua-a om ulenaute in kote' thu na za uh ahih manin pawlkhat in, "Appias Sumbuk," ciang dong hong dawn uh a, pawlkhat in "Ansai Thumna," ciang hong ban uh hi. Paul in amaute a muh ciangin Pasian tungah a lungdamna ko a, a lungsim hong nuam mahmah hi.
Rom khua ka tun khit uh ciangin Paul pen ama ututna-ah a om theih nadingin thu kipia a, a taikhak loh nadingin galkap khat bek kicingsak hi.
A tunzawh ni thum khit ciangin Paul in Jew makaite sam a, amaute hong kikhop ciangin amah in, "Ute naute aw, i mipihte tung ahi a, i pu i pate' ngeina tawh kisai-in ahi zongin khialhna bangmah nei lo napi-in Jerusalem khua-ah hong kimanin thongah hong kikoih a, Rom kumpite' khut sungah hong ki-ap hi.
Kei thu hong sit uh ciangin sihna ka thuak nading thu bangmah om lo ahih manin hong khahkhia nuam uh hi.
Israel mite in a lamet uh mipa' hangin sikkhau khihna thuakin thongkia mi ka suak hi. Hih thute khempeuh note kiangah hong gennuam ka hih manin a hong samsak ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Judea gam panin nangma thu tawh kisai-in lai bangmah ka ngah kei uh a, tua gam panin a hong pai i mipihte tung panin zong nang hong kimawhsakna kam ahi zongin bangmah ka za kei uh hi.
Ahi zongin tu-a nangma kipawlna mite' thu pen a koimah peuhah mi khempeuh in gensia uh ahih manin nangma ngaihsutna taktak ka zanuam uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Paul tawh a kimuh nading uh a ni khat seh uh a, tua a kiciam ni-un Paul a zintunna munah Jew mite tampi tak a kikhawm uh hi. Paul in zingsang a kipan nitak dongin amaute tungah Pasian' Ukna thu gentel a, Jesuh' thu man hi, ci-in a uptheih nadingun Moses Thukham le kamsangte' laigelhte siksanin a gen hi.
Pawlkhatte in Paul' thugente um uh a, ahi zongin pawlkhat in um lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Paul in, "Tua ahihleh tu-in Gentail mite tungah Pasian' hotkhiatna thu kigen ta ding hi. Amaute in um ding uh hi. Hih thu hoihtakin thei un," ci-in a thugenna a khum hi.
(Paul in hih thu a gen khit ciangin Jew mite khatlekhat kitawng gawpin a ciah uh hi.)
Paul kum nih sung ama saptawm inn sungah amah bekin om a, ama kiangah a hawh khempeuh tawh thu a kikum hi.
Amah in Pasian' Ukna thu le Topa Jesuh Khrih' thu, hangtakin a ututin genin a hilh hi.
Pasian kiang panin a hong pai Lungdamna Thu a hilh dingin Pasian' teelna tawh sawltak ahi, Jesuh Khrih' sila keimah Paul in lai ka hong khak hi.
Pasian in kamsangte tungtawnin hih Lungdamna Thu a gensa hi a, Lai Siangtho sungah a omsa thu ahi hi.
Tua thu pen eite' Topa Jesuh Khrih ahi ama Tapa' thu ahi hi. Tua Tapa pen leitung silesa lam panin David' suan hi a,
Kha Siangtho thu lamsangah ci lehang misite lak panin vangliatna tawh a thawhsakkikna hangin Pasian' Tapa ahihna thu Pasian in a kilangsak hi.
Minam khempeuh in ama thu umin a zuihtheih nadingun Khrih hangin sawltak nasep sep theih nading hamphatna thu Pasian in Khrih' na sep nadingin kote a hong pia hi.
Pasian' sapna za-in Jesuh Khrih tawh a kipawl Rom khua-a a om note khempeuh zong tua minamte sungah a kihel na hi uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Pasian in hong it a, ama mi dingin a hong sap, no Rom khua-a a om Khristiante khempeuh tungah lai ka hong khak hi. I Pa Pasian le Topa Jesuh Khrih in note tungah dikna le nopsakna thupha hong tungsak tahen.
Jesuh na upna thu uh leitung mi khempeuh in gen belin nei uh ahih manin tua Jesuh hangin Pasian tungah ka lungdamna thu koh belin ka nei hi.
Ama Tapa hangin Lungdamna Thu ka lungsim khempeuh tawh hilhin a na ka sep Pasian in hih ka thugente a man taktak ahihna thu hong thei hi.
Thu ka nget simin note ka hong phawk tawntungna le ama deihna ahih nakleh khatvei teitei ciangin note kiangah ka hong paitheih nading ka utna thu Pasian in a thei hi.
Kha thu-ah note na thahat theih nadingun Pasian in a hong piak thuphate hong genpih nuam ka hih manin note tawh kimuh ding ka ut mahmah hi.
Tua bang ka cih ciangin kei' upna in note hong thakhauh sakin, note' upna in zong kei hong thakhauh sakin, phattuamna i ngah tuak theih nading ka deihna ahi hi.
Khrih sungah sanggamte aw, Gentail midangte lakah thu um mi ka ngah mah bangin note lakah zong ngah ding lametna tawh note kiangah pai ding tam veipi ka geel zel hangin ka hong pai theih lohna thu nong theih ding uh ka ut hi.
Nuntakna sang mite le nuntakna niam mite, mipilte le mihaite, a kuamah peuh ka huh ding ka tavuan ahih manin,
Rom khua-a a om note tungah zong Lungdamna Thu hilh ding ka lawp mahmah hi.
Lungdamna Thu ka muang mahmah hi. Tua thu pen a masa-in Jew mi, tua zomin minam dangte, thu um mi khempeuh a honkhiazo Pasian' vangliatna ahi hi.
Lai Siangtho sungah, "Pasian a upna hangin amah tawh pawlkhat ahi mite nungta ding hi," ci-in a kigelh mah bangin Pasian in amah tawh a kipawl theih nadingin mite a bawlna zia, lungdamna thu in hong kilangsak hi. Tua pen, a patna panin a tawp dongin upna hang bek tawh ahihna thu hong laktel hi.
Mihingte in a mawhna le a gitlohna hangun Pasian' thuman seelcip uh ahih manin van panin a hehna hong kilang sakin a gimpiakna dingzia hong kilangsak hi.
Pasian mahmah in amaute tungah limtakin laktel ahih manin Pasian' thu teltakin a theih khit uh ciangin a gamtatna uh ahih manin Pasian in gim a pia ahi hi.
Pasian in leitung a piansak cil a kipanin a kimu thei lo ama pianzia ahi tawntung vanglianpa le Pasian ahihna thute ama bawlsa nate tung panin teltakin hong kilang hi. Tua ahih manin, "Thei kei ing," ci-in paulap a zontheih nading uh om lo hi.
Amaute in Pasian thei napi-in a zahtak dingun a kilawm bangin zahtak loin, a tungah a lungdam dingun a kilawm bangin lungdam lo uh hi. Amaute in thuhoih ngaihsun nuam lo uh a, a ngaihsutnate uh a mawknapi a suak hi.
Amaute pil a kisak mahmah uh hangin a hai mahmah uh ahi hi.
A hing tawntung Pasian bia loin, mi, vasa, ganhing, ahih kei leh a bokvak ganhingte tawh a kibang limte a bia zawsop uh hi.
Mihingte tua zahta-in hailua uh ahih manin amau ututin a gamtat theih nadingun Pasian in khahkhong vet a, a zumhuai mahmahpi-in a gamta uh hi.
Amaute in a man ahi Pasian' thu um nuam lo uh a, a tawntungin phat dingin a kilawm a Piangsak pa bia loin, Pasian' bawlsa nate bia-in a zui uh hi. Tu-a bangin hi takpi uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amau utna bangin a zumhuaipi-in a gamtat theih nadingun Pasian in a khahkhong hi. A numeite un pasal tawh lupkhop ngeina zang loin a numeipihte mah uh lunggulhin lumkhawm uh a,
a pasalte uh zong numei tawh lumkhawm loin pasalte mah lunggulhin lumkhawm uh a, a zumhuaipi-in a gamta uh hi. Tua ahih manin amaute' gamtatsiatna tawh kituakin Pasian in gim a pia hi.
Mite in a man ahi Pasian' thu ngaihsutin nei nuam lo uh ahih manin amaute' ngaihsut hoih lo bangin a gamtat theih nadingun Pasian in a khahkhia hi. Tua ahih manin a gamtat dingun a kilawm lopipi-in a gamta uh hi.
Siatna nam khempeuh ahi, hoih lohna, huaihamna, khatlekhat kisiatsak nopna, hazatna, mi thahna, kitotna, khemna, a sialam bekbek ngaihsutna, zuau genna,
mi gensiatna, Pasian muhdahna, midangte a heh theih a maizum theih nadingin gamtatna, kiphatsakna, kisialhna, thusia bawlna, nu le pate' thu man lohna,
gamtatsiatna, ciampelna, midangte khual lo, hehpihna nei loin, a sia namkim a gamta uh hi.
Tua bangin a gamtate in sihna thuak ding hi, ci-in Pasian' thukhenna thei napi-in, tua bangin amaute a gamtat uh banah, tua bangin a gamtate pakta-in a awi zawsop lai uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin midangte' thu a khen note pen kuakua hita le-uh cin na suakta tuan kei ding uh hi. Midangte na mawhsakna uh thute mah note zong gamta veve na hih manun, no zong a mawh mah na hi uh hi.
Tua bang mawhna a gamtate, Pasian in gim a piak pen a man mah ahihna i thei ciat hi.
Midangte a mawhna hangin thu khenin, no zong tua amau mawhnate mah na bawl veve uh ciangin Pasian' thukhenna tawh kipelh tuan dingin ki-um peuhmah na hi uh hiam?
Pasian migi-in thu a diah hithiatna pen na kisikkik theih nading uh a deihna ahih lamtak phawkkha loin, a migitna, a lungduaina, a hong thuaknate neu ngaihsutkha na hi uh hiam?
Lungsim khauhin na kisik nop lohna hangun Pasian' hehna le a manin a thukhenna a hong kilat Ni ding ciangin na gimthuak ding uh a nasia semsem dingin a bawl na hi uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in mi khempeuh a gamtatna uh tawh kizui-in thukkik ding hi.
Pahtakna, minthanna, le hin tawntungna deihin a gamtat hoih tawntung mite tungah Pasian in nuntak tawntungna pia ding a,
ahi zongin ama deihna bek zui-in, a gamtat dingin a kilawm bangin gamta loin, a man loin a gamta mite tungah Pasian in ama hehna hangin gimna tungsak ding hi.
Jew mi a kipan Gentail mi dongin a gamtat sia mi khempeuh in gimna le lungkhamna thuak ding uh hi.
Tua mah bangin Jew mi a kipanin Gentail mi dongin a gamtat hoih mi khempeuh in minthanna, pahtawina, le nopsakna ngah ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in kuamah deidan loin mi khempeuh tungah a kibangin thu a khen hi.
Moses Thukham a nei lo Gentail mite a khialh uh ciangin thukham nei lopi mahin siatna thuak uh a, Moses Thukham a nei Jew mite a khialh uh ciangin tua thukham tawh kizui-in amaute tungah thu kikhen hi.
Thukham zakna bek hangin Pasian tawh kipawlna a piang hi lo a, thukham sunga Pasian' genna bangin a gamtate bek Pasian tawh a kipawl thei ahi hi.
Gentail mite in thukham a neih loh uh hangin amau' ngaihsut tawmna tawh thukham' deihna bang a gamtat uh ciangin tua thukham' deihna a zui uh hi a, thukham a neih loh uh hangin a gamtat dingun a kilawm amau mahmah in a thei tawm uh ahi hi.
Amau' lungsim sungah thukham' deihnate omkhin ahihna thu a gamtatna un hong kilangsak hi. Amau mahmah zong khat veivei hoih kisa, khat veivei sia kisa uh ahih manin, amau' lungsim sungah thukham' deihnate theihna omkhin ahihna thu, hih amau' kiphawk tawmna lungsim in nakpitakin hong kitelsak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian in mihingte lungsim sunga a ngaihsutnate uh, Jesuh Khrih thu a khensak Ni ciangin, tu-a ka hong gen bang teekteekin a hong piang ding ahi hi.
Tu-in Jew mi ka hi uh, a ci note in thukham suan belin nei-in Pasian na theihna uh na kisialhpih uh hi.
Thukham thei na hih manun Pasian' deihnate na thei uh a, a man le a man lo na khenthei uh hi.
Mittawte lam a lak ding, khuamial sunga om mite khuavak a musak ding,
mihaite a hilh ding, naupangte a hilh dingte ihi a, thukham sunga om thu khempeuh thei-in i gen khempeuh man mahmah hi, ci-in na kimuang uh hi.
Midangte a hilh note in, nomau mah kihilh lo ding na hi uh hiam? "Guta kei un," ci-in mi hilh napi-in nomau mahmah guta hi lo na hi uh hiam?
"Numei tawh mawh kei un," ci-in mi hilh napi-in nomau mahmah mawh hi lo na hi uh hiam? Milimte mudah napi-in milim biakna inn sunga nate gu hi lo na hi uh hiam?
Note in thukham kisaktheihpih napi-in thukham palsatin Pasian' min na daisak uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Lai Siangtho sungah, "No Jew mite' hangin Gentail mite lakah Pasian kigensia hi," ci-in kigelh hi.
Thukham zui le-uhcin na vun atna uh man nei takpi mah hi. Ahi zongin thukham na zuih kei uhleh na vun atna uh a mawkna a suak ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin vun ki-at lo Gentail mite in thukham a zuih nak-uhleh Pasian in vun at mah bangin ngaihsun ding hi lo ahi hiam?
Tua ahih manin thukham nei-in vun ki-at napi-in tua thukham a zui lo no Jew mite pen vun ki-at lo thukham a zui Gentail mite in thu hong khen ding hi lo ahi uh hiam?
Bang hang hiam cih leh a pualam beka Jew mi hihna le a pualam vun ki-atna lel bek in Jew mi taktak suaksak zo lo hi.
Jew mi taktak i cihte pen, a sunglamah Jew mi ahite ahi hi. A vun ki-atna uh lungsim vun atna hi a, kha thu tawh a kisai ahi hi. Thukham zui-in pumpi tung vun atna pawl hi lo hi. Hih bang mite pen mihingte in phat loin Pasian in phatin a pakta hi.
Tua ahihleh Jew mite in Gentail mite sangin bang hamphatna neizaw a, vun ki-atna in bang phattuamna nei ahi hiam?
Lam tampi-ah a phattuamna a om hi. A masa penin, Pasian in Jew mite tungah ama thute a gen hi.
Ahi zongin Jew mi pawlkhatte in Pasian' thuciamna zui lo uh hi. Hih mi pawlkhatte' thu palsatna hangin Pasian in a thuciamna maimangsak dingin ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?
Tua bang hi het lo hi. Lai Siangtho sungah, "Thu na gen peuhmah ciangin a man na genna thu mite in hong thei ding uh a, mite in nang hong mawhsakna na genkik ciangin na kiphellah ding khat beek om lo ding hi," ci-in a kigelh mah bangin mi khempeuh in zuau a gen zongin Pasian in thuman gen veve ding hi.
Pasian a manin gamta ahihna eite' gamtat khialhna in kilangsak semsem ahih ciangin eite in bang gen ding nei nawn ihi hiam? Pasian in eite gim a hong piak ciangin a thuman lo ahi hiam? (Hih bangin thu ka gen ciangin leitung mihingte' kammal zat ngeite a zang ka hi hi.)
Gim hong piakna-ah a thuman lo hi het lo hi. A thuman lo hi zenzen leh bangci-in leitung mi khempeuh' thu khenthei ding ahi hiam?
Keima zuautatna in Pasian a thumanna kilangsakin a min thangsak semsem ahihleh bang hangin mawhnei-in kei hong kiseh lailai ahi hiam?
Thupha a pian nadingin gamtat sia gamta ni, ci ding ihi hiam? Mi pawlkhatte in tu-a bang teek mahin gen hi, ci-in hong mawhsak uh a, ka heh theihtheih nadingin kam a pau se uh hi. Tua bang mite in amau thuak dingin a kilawm gimna a thuak ding uh hi.
Tua ahihleh Gentail mite sangin ko Jew mite hamphazaw ka hi uh hiam? Bangmah hamphatna nei tuan lo hi ung. Jew mite le Gentail mite a kibangin mawhna khut sungah om uh hi, ci-in ka gen khinzo hi.
Lai Siangtho sungah zong, "Pasian' muhna-ah mi man kuamah om lo a,
a man a thei kuamah om lo a, Pasian tawh kipawl ding a hanciam kuamah om lo hi.
Kuamah in Pasian ngaihsutna nei lo uh a, na-a kimang kuamah om lo a, a hoih gamtat kuamah om lo hi.
A kam uh tawh mi that uh a, a kam uh tawh zuauthu gen uh a, a kampaute uh gulgu tawh kibang hi.
A kam uh tawh mi samsia uh a, gitlohna bek tawh a kidim uh hi.
Mi that pakpak uh a,
a paina khempeuh uhah lungkhamna a piangsak uh hi.

Pasian zahtak ding ngaihsutin nei lo uh hi," ci-in a kigelh hi.
Tua ahih manin kuamah in paulap a zon theih loh nading le mi khempeuh in Pasian' thukhenna a thuak theih nadingin Thukham a nei mite khempeuh in tua Thukham a zuih ding uh ahihna thu i thei hi.
Thukham in mihingte a mawhna kilangsak thei bek ahih manin thukham zuihna hangin kuamah in Pasian tawh kipawl theihna ngah zo lo hi.
Ahi zongin tu-in thukham zuihna hang hi loin thudang khat hangin Pasian tawh kipawl theih nading lampi hong kilangzo a, Thukham le kamsangte in zong hih thu-ah teci a pang uh hi.
Tua thu in: Jew mi le Gentail mi kuamah a kilamdanna om loin Jesuh Khrih upna hangin mi khempeuh in Pasian tawh kipawl theihna a ngah hi.
Mi khempeuh mawh ciat uh a, a hong honkhia Pasian tawh kigamla uh hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in a hong hehpihna hangin Khrih Jesuh tawh hong tatkhiat manin amah tawh i kipawlthei kik hi.
Ama hong sihna hangin mawhna a kimaisak theih nadingin Pasian in Jesuh hong pia a, amah a umte in mawhmaisakna a ngah uh hi. Amah tawh i kipawl theih nading zia hong lahna-in hih bangin Pasian a hong gamta ahi hi. Pasian a lungduaina hangin a beisa hunah i mawhnate hong en khong phot hi.
Ahi zongin tuhun ciangin Jesuh a um mi khempeuh Pasian tawh a kipawl theih nading le amah thuman ahihna a kilatsak nadingin mihingte' mawhna tawh kisai-in na hong sem hi.
Tua ahihleh mihingte in i kisialhpih ding bang om ahi hiam? Bangmah om lo hi. Bang bulphuh ding ihi hiam? Thukham zuihna bulphuh ding ihi hiam? Hi lo hi. I upna a bulphuh ding ihi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khatpeuh Pasian tawh a kipawl theihna pen Thukham zuihzawhna hang hi loin upna hang hi, ci-in i genzo hi.
Pasian, Jew mite' Pasian bek hi a, Gentail mite' Pasian hi lo ahi hiam? Gentail mite' Pasian zong hi veve hi.
Pasian khat bek hi a, a upna uh hangin Jew mite amah tawh a kipawl thei-in a bawl mah bangin Gentail mite zong a upna uh hang mah tawh amah tawh a kipawl thei-in a bawl hi.
Tua ahihleh hih upna thu i gen ciangin Thukham a phiat ihi hiam? Hi lo hi; a kipsak semsem ihi hi.
Tu-in eite' pianna i pupi Abraham' thu ngaihsun ni. Ama tunga thupiang hih bang ahi hi:
Abraham in a sepna hangin amah tawh a kipawl dingin Pasian in sang hileh Abraham in kisialhpih ding thu a nei ahi hi. Ahi zongin Pasian' mai-ah Abraham a kisialh nading bangmah thu om lo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho sungah, "Abraham in Pasian um a, tua a upna hangin Pasian in mihoihin a sang hi," ci-in kigelh hi.
Na a sem mipa a sep thaman kipia hi. Tua a nasepna thaman pen a thalawhsa ahih manin piakkhongin kingaihsutsak lo hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian' maipha ngah nadingin nasepna suang loin upna a suang mipa pen Pasian in mimawh kimlai midik hi, ci-in sang ahih manin, amah tawh a kipawl theih nadingin Pasian in tua mipa' upna thupi san hi.
Tua ahih manin nasepna hang tawh hi loin Pasian in mi khat midikin a sanna hangin David in zong a lungdamna thu na gen a,
