Gen ding tampi ka neihlai hangin lai-in hong gelh lo zaw-in, eite' lungdamna a kicinzawk theih nadingin kei hong pai-in khatlekhat maitang kimu-in thu genkhawm dingin ka kingaihsun hi.
Teeltuam ahi hih lai-a om pawlpi mite in hopihna kam hong khak uh hi.
A khangham bel keimah Johan in Lungsim takpi tawh ka hong it ka lawm Gaias tungah lai ka hong khak hi.
Ka lawm it Gaias aw, nang na ci damin na vai khempeuh zong na maa pai ding hi, ci-in ka lamen hi. Kha thu tawh kisai lamsangah zong bangmah lungkhamna om lo ding hi, ci-in ka thei hi.
Nang a mantakin a gamta na hih takpi mah bangin, i Khristian mipih hih lai-a hong pai peuhpeuh in a mantakin na nuntakna thu hong gen uh ahih manin ka nuam mahmah hi.
Tate bangin ka hong neih mite a mantakin a gamtatna uh ka zakna hangin ka lungdamna sangin adang lungdamna lianzaw bangmah om lo hi.
Ka hong it lawm Gaias aw, na theih ngei loh hinapi-in i Khristian mipihte lungsim takpi tawh na na huh hi.
Amaute na limbawlna thu, hih lai-a pawlpite kiangah hong gen uh hi. I biak Pasian' deihna tawh kituakin a khualzinna uh nuamtakin a zoptheih nadingun na huh in.
Amaute pen Pasian' nasem dingin a khualzin khia uh hi a, thu um lo mite tung panin bangmah huhna ngah lo uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Pasian thuman nasepna-ah nasem khawm mite ihih theih nadingin ei Khristiante in hih bang mite i huh ding ahi hi.
Na pawlpite kiangah lai ka gelh ngei hi. Ahi zongin na pawlpi sungah milian pen a ut Diotrefes in ka thugen hong mang nuam lo hi.
Tua ahih manin kong pai ciangin kote hong gensiatna, zuauthu a genna, le a gamtatna khempeuh ka pholak ding hi. Tua bang mi gensiatna ciang bek hi loin, i Khristian mipihte zin nangawn tungsak nuam lo a, zin a tungsak nuamte nangawn khamin, pawlpi panin hawlkhiat ding hanciam lai hi.
Ka hong it lawm Gaias aw, mi hoih lote' gamtatna zui kei inla, mihoihte' gamtatna zui in. A gamtat hoih mite pen Pasian tawh a kipawl mi hi a, a gamtat hoih lo mite pen Pasian a thei nai lo ahi uh hi.
Mi khempeuh in Demetrias phatkim uh a, a manin ama gamtatna mahmah in hih thu a manna hong kilangsak hi. Kote in zong ama hoihna ka thei uh a, tua ama hoihna ka gennate uh a thuman ahi hi.
Gen ding tampi ka neih hangin lai-in gelhkhiat ding kong sawm kei zaw hi.
Nang tawh kimu baih thei dingin kilamen ka hih manin, tuahun ciangin maitang kimu-in i kiho ding hi.
Nangma tungah nopsakna thupha hong tung tahen. Hih lai-a om i lawmte in hong hopih uh hi. Tua lai-a om i lawmte khempeuh a milipin na hopihsak in.
Jesuh Khrih' sila ka hih banah James' nau keimah Jude in: Pasian' sapna hangin Jesuh Khrih kepna sungah Pasian itna tawh a om mite tungah lai ka hong khak hi.
Note khempeuh tungah hehpihna, le itna thupha tampi tak hong tung tahen.
Ka itte aw, eite in i ngahkhawm hotkhiatna thu, note kiangah gelh nuam mahmahin ka om laitakin Pasian in ama mite tungah a tawntungin a kimang dingin khatvei bek a hong piak upna thu-ah note in na nawksuak nadingun hanthotna gelh ding a kisapna thu ka phawk hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian' thu a ngaihsun lo mi pawlkhat, eite lakah kuama phawk lohin hong lutsim uh a, amaute' mawh gamtat ngamnate a seelna-un Pasian' hehpihna thupha a lehlamin hei-in, eite in khat bek i neih i Mangpa le i Topa ahi Jesuh Khrih a nial uh hi. Hih bang mite' gimthuak ding thu tanglai pekin Lai Siangtho in a gensa thu ahi hi.
Note in na theihsa uh ahi ta zongin ka hong phawksak nop thu in: Topa in Egypt gam panin Israel mite honkhia khin napi-in amah a um lo mite a nung ciangin susiagawp hi.
Amau' aana neih huamsung bekah om loin a omna panun a paikhia vantung mite zong leinuai khuamial sungah sikkol kibulhin amau' thu a kikhen ding Ni lianpi ngakin Pasian in a koihcip hi.
Sodom khua le Gomorrah khua le a kiima om khuapi mite zong tua vantung mite mah bangin gamta uh a, numei tawh mawhnopna bek tham loin pasal le pasal kilunggulhna ciang dong nei uh ahih manin midangte' etteh dingin tawntung meikuang a thuak uh hi.
Tua mite mah bangin hih mite zong thumu-in kinei-in amau pumpi thanghuaisak uh a, Pasian' thu nialin tunglam a om minthanna a neite a simmawhbawl uh hi.
Vantung milian pa Mikhael nangawn tua bangin gamta ngam lo hi. Moses' luanghawm kituhin Dawimangpa tawh a kitot laitakin Mikhael in Dawimangpa zahkona kammal zang ngam loin, "Topa in nang hong taii ta hen," ci bek hi.
Ahi zongin hih mite in a theihtel loh uh thute simmawhbawl uh a, ganhing bangin a pianpih lungsim uh tawh gamta uh ahih manin siatna thuaklawh uh hi.
Hih mite a dingin dahhuai mahmah hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Kain' gamtat bangin gamta-in, sum ngaihsutna-in Balaam' khialh bangin khial uh a, Korah' lehdo bangin lehdo-in siatna thuak uh hi.
Note' annek khopna-ah zumna mel nei loin hong omgawp uh ahih manin hong siatsuah uh a, amau' pumpi bek ngaihsun uh hi. Amaute pen cikmahin guah a zusak ngei lo, huih in a letkhiatmang meiipi, tuk hun laitak nangawnin a gah a gah lo, kizunglotin a keutum singkungte,
a sepna uh tawh amau mah' maizum nading a piangsak tuipi hualte, le Pasian in amaute' om nadingin leisung khuamial thukpi a koihsak tawntung, a lampial aksite tawh kibang bek uh hi.
Tanglai pekin Adam pan khang sagihna Enok in zong hih thu mah na genkhol a, a genna-ah, "En un, Topa, a mi siangtho honpite tawh hong pai ding a,
Pasian' deihna bangin a gamtat lohna hang uh le kam hoih lopipi zangin Pasian a gensiatnate uh hangin Pasian' deihna bangin a gamta lo mite tungah thu khenin mawhsakna pia ding hi," na ci hi.
Hih mite a tawntungin phunin khatlekhat mawhna kizong uh a, amau pumpi deihna bangun gamta-in kiphasak uh a, phattuamna a ngah theih nadingun midangte a phat uh hi.
Ahi zongin ka itte aw, i Topa Jesuh Khrih' sawltakte in note tungah hong gensa thute na phawk un.
Amaute in note kiangah, "Hun nunung lam ciangin Pasian' deihna tawh a kituak lo amau pumpi deihna zui-in note a hong simmawhbawl mi pawlkhat hong piang ding hi," hong ci uh hi.
Hih mite in pawl kikhenna piangsakin, amau pumpi deihna bangin gamta uh a, Kha Siangtho zong nei lo uh hi.
Ahi zongin ka it note ahihleh a siangtho na upna uhah na kip semsem unla, Kha Siangtho vangliatna tawh thu na ngen un.
I Topa Jesuh Khrih in a hong hehpihna tawh nuntak tawntungna hong piak ding na ngakkawmun Pasian' itna sungah na kip un.
A um taktak zo lote hehpih unla,
meiphual sung panin dawhkhiat bangin midangte na honkhia un. Mi pawlkhatte' mawhna-ah note zong na siatkhak loh nadingun kidop kawmna tawh na huh unla, amau' gamtat hoih lo mawhnate na mudah un.
Ama minthanna mai-ah paubaanna om hetloin lungdam takin a hong paipih theih nadingin note na pukkhak nading panun a hong kem,
khat bek ahi eite a hong Hon Pasian in, tuma, tu laitak, le a tawntungin, minthanna, vangliatna, uk zawhna, le aana nei tawntung tahen. Amen.
Hih laibu pen a piang baih ding thute, Pasian' nasemte tungah a lah dingin Pasian in Jesuh tungah a thu pia a, Jesuh in maang sungah a lah thute ahi hi. Khrih in ama vantungmi sawl a, a nasempa Johan kiangah hih thute a kilangsak hi.
Johan in zong a muhsa thu khempeuh na gen leuleu hi. Hih thute pen Johan in Pasian kiang panin hong pai thute le Jesuh Khrih in ama tungah a lahkhiat thuman thutakte a genna thu ahi hi.
Hih laibu a sim mite mi hampha hi a, hih thu kigente ngai-in, hih laibu sungah a kigelh thu a zuite zong mi hampha mah ahi uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih thu kigente a tun ding hun hong naita hi.
Johan in Asia gam sungah a om pawlpi sagihte tungah a khak lai ahi hi. A beisa hun, tuhun, le mailam hunah a om tawntung Pasian kiang pan le ama tokhom mai-ah a om Kha Siangtho sagihte tung pan le,
thuman takin teci a pang, sihna panin a kithokiksak Tapa upa, leitung kumpite tungah ukna aana a nei Jesuh Khrih kiang panin note tungah hehpihna le nopsakna thupha hong tung tahen. Tua Jesuh Khrih in eite hong it a, ama sihna tawh i mawhna panin eite hong suaktasak a,
ama Pa Pasian' na a sem dingin siampi le kumpi za-ah a hong koih hi. Tua Jesuh in minthanna le vangliatna nei tawntung tahen. Amen.
En un, amah hong paita ding a, meiipi tawh hong tonkhawm ding hi. Teipi tawh amah a sunte a kipan mi khempeuh in a mu ding uh hi. Amah a hong pai ciangin leitung mi khempeuh lau-in a kap ding uh hi. Hih ka gen bangin hong piang takpi ding hi. Amen.
A beisa hun, tuhun, le mailam hunah zong a om tawntung ding a Vanglian Topa Pasian in, "Kei pen na khempeuh a Kipatna le a Tawpna ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Note' sanggam keimah Johan in Jesuh tawh kipawlna hangin note mah bangin bawlsiatna thuakin, Pasian' Ukna sungah omin, lungduai takin a thuak mipa ka hi hi. Pasian' thu le Jesuh' hong gen thumante ka genna hangin Patmos a kici tuikulh-ah kei hong kikoih hi.
Topa' ni-in Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin ka om laitakin peengkul bangin a gingpha mahmah khat ka nung lamah ka za a,
"Na muhte khempeuh laibu sungah gelh inla, Efesa pawlpi, Smyrna pawlpi, Pergamum pawlpi, Thiatira pawlpi, Sardis pawlpi, Filadelfia pawlpi, Laodisia pawlpi, hih pawlpi sagihte kiangah khak in," hong ci hi.
Kua in kei hong hopih ahi hiam, ci-in a en dingin ka kihei leh kham kibawl meivakna sagih ka mu hi.
Tua meivakte lakah, puantualpi khat silhin a awm-ah kham kibawl awmgak a gak, mi tawh a kibang khat ka mu hi.
A samte tuumul bangin kangin, khuavak bangin pak a, a mittangte meikuang a bang hi.
A khete, pumbukah a kihalsan sumngo bang a, a awging ahihleh tuipi ging a bang hi.
A taklam khutah aksi sagih tawi-in, a kam sung panin langnih a hiam namsau khat hong pusuak a, a maitang sun nitaang a bang hi.
Amah ka muh ciangin misi bangin ama khe phungah ka puk hi. Ahi zongin amah in ka tungah a taklam khut hong nga a, "Lau kei in; kei pen a kipatna le a tawpna ka hi a,
a nungta mipa zong ka hi hi. Kei ka si ngei hi. Ahi zongin tu-in hong en in, a nungta tawntung ka hi hi. Sihna le misite omna gam keima khutnuai ahi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-a na muh, tu laitakin a om thute le tu nung ciangin a hong piang ding thute, lai sungah gelh in.
Tu-in ka taklam khut sungah na muh aksi sagihte le kham kibawl meivakna sagihte a khiatna in: Aksi sagihte pen pawlpi sagihte' vantung mite a cihna hi a, meivakna sagihte pen pawlpi sagihte a cihna ahi hi.
"Efesa khua-a pawlpi vantungmi kiangah lai gelh inla, a taklam khutah aksi sagih tawi-in, kham kibawl meivakna lakah a pai kawikawi Jesuh' thugenna hih bang ahi hi:
"Note' nasepna, na gimna uh le lungduai takin na thuakna uh, le migilote koihmawk loin, sawltak hi lo napi-in sawltak hi ung, a ci mite dongtelin sawltak ahihlohna uh na muhkhiatnate uh ka thei hi.
Note in lungduai takin thuakin, keima min hangin thuakzo-in, lungkia hetloin na omna uh ka thei hi.
Ahi zongin note ka hong mawhsakna khat om a, tua in: A masa lai-a kei na hong it bangun tu-in na hong it nawn kei uh hi.
Tua ahih manin na lampialna uh phawkin, na mawhna uh panin kihei unla, na gamtat ngeisa bangun gamta kik un. Na mawhna panun kihei-in na kisikkik kei uhleh note kiangah hong pai-in na meivakna uh ka hong lakkhiatsak ding hi.
Ahi zongin note ka hong pahtakna khat om a, tua in: Keima muhdah mah bangin Nikolas pawlte na mudah uh hi.
Tua ahih manin zak nading bil a neite in Kha Siangtho in pawlpite kiangah a gen thute na za un. A gualzo mite tungah, Pasian' Huan sunga om nuntakna singgahte a nektheih nadingun thu ka pia ding hi.
"Smyrna khua pawlpi vantungmi kiangah lai gelh inla, a kipatna le a tawpna, si ngei napi-in a hingkik pa' thugen in:
Na lungkhamnate uh le na zawnnate uh ka thei hi. A taktakin note a hau na hi uh hi. Jew mi hi lo napi-in Jew mi ka hi uh hi, ci-in note a hong gensiatnate uh ka thei hi. Tua bang mite pen Satan' pawlte ahi uh hi.
Na thuak ding uh haksatnate kihta kei un. Dawimangpa in note pawlkhat thong sungah hong khia-in hong ze-et ding hi. Gimna na thuak hun ding uh ni sawm sung bek hi ding hi. Na sih dongun kei tungah hong citak un. Tua hileh nuntakna lukhu ka hong pia ding hi.
Tua ahih manin zak nading bil a neite in Kha Siangtho in pawlpite kiangah a gen thute na za un. A gualzo mite, nihvei sihna in gimsakkha nawn lo ding hi.
"Pergamum khua pawlpi vantungmi kiangah lai gelh inla, a langnihin a hiam mahmah namsau a nei pa' thugen in:
Satan in a kumpi tokhom a phuhna munah a om na hih lamtak uh ka thei hi. Keima thu citakin teci a pang cinten Antipas, Satan' omna munah a kithah hun laitak nangawnin kei na hong upna uh na khahsuah kei uh hi.
Ahi zongin note ka hong mawhsak nading thu tawmkhat a om hi. Milim biakna ante nesakin, nulepa paktatna piangsak a, Israel mite mawhna a gamtasak Balak tungah thu a hilh Balaam' thuhilhnate a um mi pawlkhat note lakah a om hi.
Tua mah bangin Nikolas pawlte' thuhilhna a um mi pawlkhat zong note lak mahah a om hi.
Tua ahih manin na mawhna panun kisikkik un. Na kisik kei uhleh note kiangah kei hong pai baihin, ka kam panin a pusuak namsau tawh amaute ka do ding hi.
Tua ahih manin zak nading bil a neite in Kha Siangtho in pawlpite kiangah a gen thute na za un. A gualzo mi tungah a kiselcip manna an pawlkhat le min thak a kigelhna suangkang khat ka pia ding hi. Tua suangkang pen a ngahte simloh kuamah dang in thei lo ding hi.
"Thiatira khua pawlpi vantungmi kiangah lai gelh inla, meikuang tawh a kibang mittang nei-in sumngo kihalsan tawh a kibang khe a nei Pasian' Tapa' thugen in:
Note' gamtatna, itna na neihna, upna na neihna, na nasepna, lungduai takin na thuakna uh, le a kipatcil lai sangin a nunung lamah na hoihzawknate uh ka thei hi.
Ahi zongin note ka hong mawhsak nading thu khat om hi. Kamsang numei ka hi, ci-in thu a gen Jezebel na nial kei uh hi. Ama thuhilhna hangin ka nasemte in numei-pasal paktatna gamta-in milim biakna ante a ne uh hi.
Tua numei a kisikkik nading hun ka piak hangin a paktatna panin kihei nuam lo hi.
Tua ahih manin tu-in tua numei tawh a paktatna uh panin a kisikkik kei uhleh tua numei le amah tawh a paktat mi khempeuh, lupna ngaksakin nakpitakin gimna ka thuaksak ding hi.
Tua numei' thu a zui mi khempeuh ka that ding hi. Tua hileh, mihingte' ngaihsutna le lungsim a kantel pa ka hihna thu pawlpi khempeuh in thei ding uh hi. Note' gamtatna ciat tawh kizui-in ka hong thukkik ding hi.
Ahi zongin Thiatira khua-a om note pawlkhat in tua numei' thuhilhna hoih lote na zui kei uh a, mite in, 'Satan' thu thukpite hi,' a cih thute na sukha kei uh hi. Note tungah vangik bangmah ka hong suan kei ding hi.
Ka hong pai matengin na neihsateng uh na lenkip ta un.
A gualzo, a tawp dongin keima deihna bangin a gamtazo mite tungah, keimah in ka Pa tung panin ka ngah vangliatnate mah ka pia ding hi. Minam dangte tungah ukna a neih nading uh aana ka pia ding a, leibeel satkhap bangin sik ciangkhut tawh minam dangte satgawp ding uh hi.
Amaute tungah zingsol zong ka pia ding hi.
Tua ahih manin zak nading bil a neite in Kha Siangtho in pawlpite kiangah a gen thute na za un.
"Sardis khua pawlpi vantungmi kiangah lai gelh inla, Pasian Kha Siangtho sagih le aksi sagih a nei pa' thugen in: Note' gamtatnate ka thei a, note a si hinapi-in a hing min na pua uh hi.
Tua ahih manin khua phawk unla, na neihlai sunte uh a beimang ma-in thasanpha kik un. Bang hang hiam cih leh na nasepnate uh Pasian' muhna-ah a cingtaak nai het lo ahihna thu ka thei hi.
Tua ahih manin note a hong kihilh na zaksa uh thute phawkkik unla, tua thute zui-in na mawhna panun kisik kik un. Khua na phawk kei uhleh note kiangah guta bangin ka hong pai ding a, ka hong tunlam nangawn na thei kei ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin Sardis khuasunga om note lakah a puan a ninsak nai lo tawmkhat na om uh hi. Tua bang mite kilawm uh ahih manin kei tawh puanpak silhin ka tonkhawm ding uh hi.
A gualzo mite in tua bangin puanpak silh ding uh a, a nungta mite a kikhumna laibu sung panin amaute' min ka phiat kei ding hi. Ka Pa le ama vantung mite kiangah zong keima mite ahihna uh ka pulak ding hi.
"Filadelfia khua pawlpi vantungmi kiangah lai gelh inla, David' tawhtang kemin, ama honsa kong kuamah in a khak zawh loh, ama khaksa kong kuamah in a hon zawh loh, a thuman a siangthopa' thugen in:
Note' nasepnate ka thei hi. Na tha uh a hat loh hangin ka thu zui-in kei tungah na hong cihtakna uh ka thei hi. Tua ahih manin kuamah in a khak zawh loh ding kong, note' mai-ah honsa-in ka koih hi.
Jew mi hi lo napi-in Jew mi hi ung, ci-in zuau a gen Satan' pawlte, note' mai-ah hong paisakin na khephung uhah ka boksak ding a, note ka hong itna thu amaute ka theisak ding hi.
Note in lungduai takin na thuak nading uh ka hong thupiakna zui na hih manun leitung a a om mi khempeuh ze-et nadingin leitung bupah a hong tung ding lungkhamna panin kei zong note ka hong suaktasak ding hi.
Keimah ka hong pai baih ding hi. Kuamah in, na ngah ding uh gualzawhna lukhu hong tuhkhak loh nadingun na neihsate uh hoihtakin na lenkip un.
A gualzote pen ka Pasian' sutpi-in ka bawl ding a, amaute paikhia ngei nawn lo ding uh hi. Amaute tungah ka Pasian' min le ka Pasian kiang vantung panin a hong paisuk ding Jerusalem khua thak min ka gelh ding a, amaute tungah keima min thak zong ka gelh ding hi.
"Laodisia khua pawlpi vantungmi kiangah lai gelh inla, thuman le citakin teci a pang, Pasian' piansakte khempeuh a kipatna ahi Amen' thugen in:
Note' gamtatnate ka thei a, vot lah vot vet lo, sa lah sa vet loin na omna uh zong ka thei hi. A vot na hih kei uhleh a sa hi vet le-uhcin ka ut hi.
Ahi zongin note pen vot lah vot vet lo, sa lah sa vet loin a laklawhin om na hih manun ka kam sung panin ka hong siakhia ding hi.
Note a zawng, a mittaw, puansilh ding a nei lo, a hehpihhuai, a lungkhamhuai na hih lamtak uh thei loin, kote hau-in ka cithei uh a, bangmah kisapna ka nei kei uh hi, na ci uh hi.
Ka it mite thuhilhin ka taii hi. Tua ahih manin lungsim tak tawh na mawhna panun kisik kik un.
Kongkhakah dingin kong ka hong kiu hi. Ka aw za-in kong hong honte kiangah lutin an ka nekhawm ding uh hi.
Keimah zong gualzo-in ka Pa' tokhomah ka tutkhawm uh mah bangin a gualzote khempeuh zong kei tawh ka tokhom tungah hong tutkhawm theih nadingun thu ka pia ding hi.
Tua ahih manin zak nading bil a neite in Kha Siangtho in pawlpite kiangah a gen thute na za un, ci-in gen in," a hong ci hi.
Hih thuteng khit ciangin ka khuadak leh vantungah kong a kihongsa-in a om ka mu hi. Peengkul awging tawh a kibang, kei kiangah thu a hong gensa awging mah in, "Hih lai-ah hong paito in. Tunung ciangin thupiang dingte ka hong lak ding hi," hong ci hi.
Thakhat thu-in Kha Siangtho tawh ka kidim a, tua vantung a tokhom tungah mi khat a tu ka mu hi.
Tua tokhom tungah a tupa pen Jasper le Karnelian suangmanpha bangin taang ziazua a, a tokhom kimkot pen Emerald suangmanpha bangin suum pempam hi.
Tua tokhom kimkotah tokhom sawmnih le li om a, tuate tungah puanpak silhin kham lukhu a khu upa sawmnih le lite tu uh hi.
Tua tokhom panin khuaphialep hong taangkhia-in, awging le vanging hong kipankhia a, a tokhom mai-ah Pasian' kha ahi meivak sagih a kivak hi.
A ganhing a khatna pen humpinelkai tawh kibang a, a nihna bawngtal tawh kibang a, a thumna in mihing maitang nei a, a lina pen muvanlai a leeng lai tawh kibang hi.
Tua ganhing lite in kha guk ciat nei-in, tua a khate' sunglam le a pualamah mittang a dimtakin om a, a sun a zan tawlnga loin la sa uh a, "A beisa, tuhun, le a tawntungin a om Vanglian Topa Pasian, siangtho hi, siangtho hi, siangtho hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ganhingte in a nungta tawntung, tokhom tungah a tupa tungah a lungdamna uh ko-in pahtawi-in a phat simun
nungta tawntungin tokhom tungah a tupa mai-ah tua upa sawmnih le lite zong bokin amah bia uh a, tua tokhom mai-ah a lukhute uh lawnin la sa uh a,
"Kote' Topa Pasian aw, nangmah in na khempeuh piangsakin, nangma deihna bangin na khempeuh omin, na khempeuh kipiangsak ahih manin, minthanna, pahtawina, le vangliatna na ngah tawntung dingin a kilawm hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin, tokhom tungah a tupa in a taklam khutah a tawi laizial tawn khat ka mu hi. Tua a laidal tung a langnih tuakah lai kigelhin a kizialcip khit ciangin a kiphel theih loh nadingin mun sagih-ah kiciamteh hi.
Tua ciangin a thahat vantungmi khat ka mu a, amah in nakpitakin, "Hih laizial a ciamtehnate lakhia-in a laizial a phel dingin a kilawm kua om ahi hiam?" hong ci hi.
Ahi zongin tua laizial a phel ding mi, vantung, leitung, leinuai-ah kuamah kimu lo hi.
Tua laizial phelin a sung a en dingin a kilawm kuamah kimu lo ahih manin nakpitakin ka kap hi.
Tua laitakin upate khat in kei kiangah, "Kap kei in. Judah minam sung panin Humpinelkai, David suan sung panin a lianpa gualzo khinta a, tua laizial ciaptehna sagihte lakhia-in a laizial phelthei ding hi," a hong ci hi.
Tua upate' huamsung, ganhing lite le kumpi tokhom kikalah Tuuno a ding ka mu hi. Tua Tuuno pen a kigo lumsa tawh kibang a, leitung khempeuhah a kisawlkhia, Pasian' khate' lim ahi ki sagih le mittang sagih a nei hi.
Tua Tuuno va pai a, tokhom tungah a tupa in a taklamah a tawi laizial a va la hi.
Tua laizial a lak khit ciangin ganhing lite le upa sawmnih le lite, Topa' mai-ah a kun uh hi. Amaute in harp lasakna khat ciat le Pasian' mi siangthote in thungetna-in a zat uh paknamtui a dimin a om paknamtui beel khat ciat a tawi uh hi.
Amaute inla thak khat sa uh a, "Nang Tuuno, tua laizial a lakhia ding le a ciamtehnate a lakhia dingin na kilawm hi. Nang hong kigo khin ahih manin mi namkim le pau namkim a pau mite sung panin na sisan tawh Pasian a dingin mite na lei khin a,
Pasian' na a sem dingin siampi za le kumpi za na pia a, amaute in leitung ukin a om ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin ka khuadak leh tokhom le ganhing lite le upate' kimkotah atul-amakin a ding miaimuai vantung mite' awging ka za hi.
Amaute in nakpitakin la sa uh a, "A kigo Tuuno in vangliatna le hauhna, pilna le thahatna, pahtawina, minthanna, le phatna, a ngah dingin kilawm hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin vantung, leitung, leinuai, tuipi sung le mun khempeuhah a om nuntakna a nei khempeuh inla a sakna uh ka za a, amaute in, "Tokhom tungah a tupa le Tuuno in phatna, pahtawina, minthanna le vangliatna, ngah tawntung ta hen," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin ganhing lite in zong, "Amen," na ci uh a, upate in zong khukdinin Pasian a bia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Tuuno in tua ciaptehna sagih sung panin khat a honkhiat ka mu hi. Tua laitakin ganhing lite sung panin khat in vanging bangin nakpitakin, "Hong pai in," a cihna ka za hi.
Ka khuadak leh sakol kang khat hong pai a, a tungah a tuang pa in thal khat a tawi hi. Ama tungah lukhu khat kipia a, a gualzo pa hihna tawh a gualzo dingin a kuankhia hi.
Ciamtehna a nihna a hon ciangin ganhing a nihna in, "Hong pai in," a cihna ka za hi.
Sakol a ausan khat hong pai a, mite khatlekhat a kithah theih nadingun a sakol tung tuang pa in leitungah galkidona a piansak theih nading vangliatna kipia a, ama tungah namsau lian mahmah khat zong kipia lai hi.
Ciamtehna a thumna a hon ciangin ganhing a thumna in, "Hong pai in," a cihna ka za hi. Sakol vom khat hong pai ka mu a, a tungah a tuang pa in a khutah tawitehna a tawi hi.
Tua ganhing lite lak panin awging bang khat ka za a, "Mangbuh lawhta khat in ni khat tha man a, mangbuhham lawhta thum in ni khat tha mah man hi. Ahi zongin oliv huan le leenggui huan susia kei in," a ci hi.
Ciamtehna a lina a hon ciangin ganhing a lina in, "Hong pai in," a cihna ka za hi.
Ka khuadak leh sakol puang khat ka mu a, a tungah a tuang pa' min pen Sihna hi a, a nungah Hell in a zui hi. Amaute in namsau, kialpi, pulnatna, le gamsate tawh leitung mi sehlisuah sehkhat a thahtheih nadingun thu a kipia hi.
Ciamtehna ngana a hon ciangin Pasian' thu a genna hang le Pasian' thu citakin teci a panna uh hangin a kithat mite' kha, biakna tau nuai-ah a om ka mu hi.
Amaute nakpitakin kiko uh a, "A thuman, a siangtho, a Vanglian Topa aw, leitungah a omlai, kote a hong that mite tungah cik ciangin thu khenin, kote hong thahna hangin cik ciangin phu la ding na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute tungah puantualpi a kang khat ciat kipia a, amaute a kithah mah bangin a kithat lai ding a naseppihte uh le a sanggamte uh a kim matengin tawlkhat sung a tawlngak lai nading uh kigen hi.
Ciamtehna gukna a hon ciangin ka khuadak le nakpitakin zin hong ling a, ni pen puanvom bangin hong vomin, kha pen sisan bangin a hong san hi.
Aksite ahihleh huihpi in theipuam a mutkhiat bangin van panin kia zaizai uh hi.
Laidal a kizial bangin vanpi kizialin maimang a, mual le tuikulhte khempeuh a omna uh panin maimangta hi.
Tua ciangin leitung kumpite le miliante, galkapmangte, mihaute le mi vangliante, silate le sila ahi lote a kipanin a kuamah peuh, mualtung a leihawmte sungah bu uh a,
mualte le suangtum lianpite kiangah, "Kote tungah hong kiasuk unla, tokhom tungah a tupa' maitang le Tuuno' hehna panin kote hong liah un.
Amaute' hehna hangin gimna hun hong tungta ahih manin kua in thuakzo ding ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin leitung kiu li-ah vantungmi li, kiu khatah khat ciat dingin leitung, tuipi tung, le singkung khat peuhpeuh a mutkhak loh nadingin leitung huih lite lencipin a om uh ka mu hi.
Tua ciangin a nungta Pasian' ciaptehna a tawi vantungmi khat, nisuahna lam panin hong paito ka mu hi. Leitung le tuipi suksiat theih nading vangliatna a kipia vantungmi lite kiangah amah in nakpitakin gen a,
"I Pasian' nasemte, a taltang uhah ciaptehna i bawl khit matengin leitung, tuipi, le singkungte susia nai kei in," a ci hi.
Israel mite sung panin a nam namin Pasian' ciaptehna tawh a taltang uhah a kiciamteh mi a vekpi-in 144,000 pha hi, ci-in hong kigen hi.
Tuate pen Israel minam sawm le nih sungah nam khatah then khat tulnih ciat hi a, tua minamte pen Judah minam, Reuben minam, Gad minam, Asher minam, Naftali minam, Manasseh minam, Simeon minam, Levi minam, Issakhar minam, Zebulun minam, Josef minam, le Benjamin minam ahi uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin ka khuadak leh mi namkim, pau namkim panin kuama sim zawh loh dingin a tam mahmah mihonpite, tokhom mai le Tuuno mai-ah ding uh a, puanpak silhin a khut uhah nisuh hiang a tawi uh ka mu hi.
Amaute nakpitakin awngin, "Tokhom tungah a tu i Pasian le Tuuno pen eite a hong honkhia ahi uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tokhom, upate, le ganhing lite kimkotah vantungmi khempeuh dingin tokhom mai ngatin kunin Pasian bia uh a,
"Amen! Eite' Pasian in phatna, minthanna, pilna, lungdamkohna, pahtawina, vangliatna, le hatna a tawntungin nei ta hen! Amen," a ci uh hi.
Tua laitakin upate khat in keima kiangah, "Hih puanpak a silh mite kuate hi a, koi lai panin hong pai ahi uh hiam?" ci-in hong dot ciangin,
"Ka thei kei hi, topa aw. Nangmah in na theizaw ding hi," ka ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in keima kiangah, "Hih mite pen bawlsiatna lianpi thuakin a hong suakta mite ahi uh hi. Amaute in a puan uh sawpsiangin Tuuno sisan tawh a paaksak uh ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin Pasian' tokhom mai-ah amaute ding uh a, sun le zanin a biakinn sungah ama na sem uh hi. Tokhom tungah a tupa in amaute ompihin a hu ding hi.
Amaute gilkial cih om nawn lo ding a, a dang uh zong taak nawn lo ding hi. Nisa zong thuakkha nawn lo ding uh a, a sa in zong kangkha nawn lo ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Tokhom laizangah a om Tuuno, amaute a kem pa hi ding a, nuntakna tui omna-ah amaute paipih ding a, Pasian in a khitui khempeuh uh nulsak ding hi," hong ci hi.
Tuuno in ciaptehna sagihna a hon ciangin vantungah nai lang sung bang kidai dide hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian mai-ah a ding vantungmi sagihte ka mu a, amaute tungah peengkul sagih a kipia hi.
Tua ciangin kham kibawl paknamtui kuang a tawi vantungmi adang khat hong pai-in biakna tau mai-ah a ding hi. Pasian' mite in thungetna-in a zat paknamtuite tawh hal beh ding le tokhom mai-ah a om kham kibawl biakna tau tungah piak dingin amaute tungah paknamtui tampi tak a kipia hi.
Pasian' mai-ah a ding vantung mipa' khutsung panin paknamtui khu le Pasian' mite' thungetna van lam manawhin kizialto hi.
Tua ciangin tua vantungmi in paknamtui kuang la a, biakna tau panin mei-am la-in a sungah a koih khit ciangin leitungah lawnsuk a, nakpitakin van gingin zin ling a, khua phia-in keek a kia hi.
Tu-in peengkul sagih a tawi vantungmi sagihte a peengkul uh a tum dingin hong kithawi uh hi.
A masa vantungmi in a peengkul hong tum a, gialpi le mei, sisan tawh kihelin leitungah a kiasuk hi. Leitung sehthumsuah sehkhat, le lopa hing sehthumsuah sehkhat a kangtum hi.
A nihna vantungmi in a peengkul hong tum a, mual lianpi tawh a kibang, mei in kangin a kuang zuazua khat, tuipi sungah kilawnsuk hi.
Tuipi sehthumsuah sehkhat sisan suakin, tuipi sunga om ganhingte sehthumsuah sehkhat si a, teembaw sehthumsuah sehkhat a kisia hi.
A thumna vantungmi in a peengkul hong tum a, vantung panin aksi lian khat meikuang bangin hong kiasukin gunte le tuinakte sehthumsuah sehkhat tungah a tu hi.
Tua aksi a min Gamsai hi a, tui sehthumsuah sehkhat gamsai tui suak a, tua tui khasak ahih manin a dawn mi tampi tak a si uh hi.
A lina vantungmi in a peengkul hong tum a, ni sehthumsuah sehkhat kisatkhia-in, kha zong sehthumsuah sehkhat mah kisatkhia a, aksi zong sehthumsuah sehkhat mah kisatkhia ahih manin a taanna uh sehthumsuah sehkhat ciat a bei hi. Sunin hun sehthumsuah sehkhat tang khua vak lo a, zanin zong hun sehthumsuah sehkhat tang mah kha le aksi taang lo hi.
Tua ciangin ka khuadak leh vankim lai-ah muvanlai khat a leenkawmin nakpi-in ham a, "Vantung mi adang thumte in a hong tum lai ding peengkulte hangin leitungah a teng mi tungah gimna, gimna, gimna lianpi hong tung ding hi," a cihna ka za hi.
Tua ciangin a ngana vantungmi in a peengkul hong tum a, vantung panin leitungah aksi khat a leengsuk ka mu hi. Tua aksi tungah kuahawm thukpi honna tawhtang a kipia hi.
Amah in tua kuahawm thukpi a hon ciangin meiphualpi panin meikhu bangin meikhu tampi hong pusuak a, tua meikhu hangin ni mialin khim a zing hi.
Tua meikhu sung panin kauphete hong pusuakin leitungah pai uh a, momaite' neih bangin a gupha mahmah amaute tungah a kipia hi.
Amaute in lopate, singkungte a kipan a hing khat peuhpeuh bangmah cih loin, a taltang uhah Pasian' ciaptehna a om lo mite bek a gimsak nadingun thu a kipia hi.
Amaute in tua bang mite that loin kha nga sung a bawlsiat nading uh thu kipia a, amaute' bawlsiatna pen momai in mi a deh ciangin a na tawh kibangin a na velval ahi hi.
Tua hun ciangin mite in a sihtheih nading uh a zonzon uh hangin sihtheih nading lampi mu lo ding uh a, sinuam mahmah napi-un sithei het lo ding uh hi.
Tua kauphete' pianzia pen galsim dingin a kithawi sakolte tawh kibang uh hi. A lu tung uhah kham lukhu tawh a kibang khu uh a, a maitang uh mihing maitang tawh a kibang hi.
A sam uh numei sam tawh kibang a, a ha uh humpinelkai ha tawh a kibang hi.
A awm uh, sik-awmdal tawh a kibang pian in tuam a, a khazap uh a gingte pen galkido laitakin sakol in a kaih leeng tampite' gin' tawh a kibang hi.
Momai bangin mei nei-in mi dehthei uh a, tua a mei uh tawh mihingte kha nga sung gimsak theih nading gu a nei uh hi.
Amaute in tua kuahawm thukpi a uk vantungmi pen kumpi-in nei uh a, tua vantungmi a min pen Hebru pau-in Abaddon hi a, Grik pau-in Apollion hi a, "A Susia pa," a cihnopna ahi hi.
Tu-in gimna khatna a beina hita a, ahi zongin gimna nam nih hong tung lai ding a om hi.
Tua ciangin a gukna vantungmi in a peengkul hong tum a, Pasian' mai-ah a om kham kibawl biakna tau kiu lite panin awging khat ka za hi.
Tua awging in peengkul a tawi vantungmi a gukna kiangah, "Eufratis Gun lianpi-ah a kihencip vantungmi lite khahkhia in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin leitung mi khempeuh sehthumsuah sehkhat a thah ding uh a kum, a kha, a ni, a nai hun ngakin a kigingsa-in a om tua vantungmi lite a kikhahkhia hi.
Mi a that ding sakol tung tuang galkap mak sawmnih pha hi, ci-in hong kigen hi.
Ka maang sungah ka muh sakolte le a tungah a tuangte pen hih bang ahi hi: Sakol tung tuangte in mei bangin a san, sapfaia suangmanpha bangin a dum, kat bangin a eng, awmdal a bulh uh hi. A sakol lutangte pen humpinelkai lutang tawh kibang a, a kam uh panin meikuang, meikhu, le kat a pusuak hi.
Hih sakolte' kam panin a hong pusuak meikuang, meikhu, le kat, hih gimna nam thumte in leitung mi sehthumsuah sehkhat a sisak hi.
Hih sakolte in a kam le a mei uhah gu nei uh a, a meite un gul tawh kibangin lutang nei ahih manin a meite uh tawh mi a liamsak uh hi.
Hih gimna tawh a si lo midangte pen amau' gamtatnasa panin kikhelkik nuam lo uh hi. Dawi a biaknate uh, khua a mu thei lo, khua a za thei lo, lam a pai thei lo ngun, kham, sumngo, suang, le sing a kibawl milim a biakte uh khawl tuan lo uh hi.
A mi thahna, a aisanna, a paktatna, le a guktaknate uh zong khawl tuan lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin a thahat vantungmi khat, meiipi in tuamin, a lu tungah sakhituihup khimin, a maitang nitaang tawh kibangin, a khete meikuang khuampi tawh a kibang khat, vantung panin a hong kumsuk ka mu hi.
A khut sungah laizial neu khat phelsa-in a tawi hi. A taklam khe in tuipi sung sikin, a veilam khe in leitung sik a,
nakpitakin kiko ahih manin humpinelkai hawk tawh a kibang hi. Tua bangin a kiko ciangin van sagih a gingte in a dawng hi.
Tua van sagih a gingte' thugen a mankhit phetin tua a thugente lai-ah a gelh dingin ka kithawi hi. Ahi zongin vantung panin awging khat ka za a, "Tua thute lai-ah gelh kei inla, tua van sagih a gingte' thugen imcip in," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin tuipi le leitung kalkakin a ding ka muh vantungmi in vantung lamah a taklam khut laamto-in,
a nungta tawntung, vantung le a sunga om khempeuh, leitung le a sunga om khempeuh, le tuipi le a sunga om khempeuh a bawl Pasian' min tawh kiciam a, "Tu-in zekai nawn het lo ding hi.
A sagihna vantungmi in a peengkul a tum ciangin ama nasem kamsangte tungah a gensa bangin Pasian in ama ip thusim a geelte hong semkhia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin vantung panin awging ka zak in kei kiangah thu hong genkik a, "Tuipi le leitung kalkakin a ding vantungmi' khut sungah a om laizial kiphelsa pen va la in," hong ci hi.
Tua ahih manin vantungmi kiangah va pai-in tua laizial neu a hong piak nadingin ka va gen leh amah in, "La inla, ne in. Na gil sung a tun ciangin thuk mahmah ding a, ahi zongin na kam sungah khuaizu bangin khum mahmah ding hi," hong ci hi.
Kei zong tua vantungmi' khutsung panin a laizial neu la-in ka ne hi. Ka kamah khuaizu bangin khum dekdak a, ahi zongin ka nekkhit ciangin ka gil sung thuk velvalsak hi.
Tua ciangin keima kiangah, "Minam tuamtuam, pau nam tuamtuam a zangte le kumpite tungah a piang ding thu na gen ding kisam lai hi," hong kici hi.
Tua ciangin ciangkhut tawh a kibang teh nading ciang khat kei kiangah hong kipia a, "Pai inla, Pasian' biakinn le biakna tau le tua lai-ah Pasian a bia mite va teh in.
Ahi zongin biakinn pualam tualte teh kei in. Minam dangte' khut sungah kipia khin a, amaute in kha sawmli le nih sung Khuapi Siangtho tuancilgawp ding uh ahih manin tua a tualte teh loin nusia lel in.
Ka teci nihte puanhampi silhin ka paisak ding a, amaute in ni tulkhat zanih sawmguk sung Pasian' thu a gen ding uh hi," hong ci hi.
Tua teci nihte pen leitung Topa mai-ah a om oliv kung nihte le meivakna nihte ahi uh hi.
Mi khatpeuh in amaute suksiat ding hanciam leh amaute' kam panin meikuang pusuakin a galte a kangtum hi. Amaute suksiat ding a hanciam peuhpeuh tua bangin kisusia hi.
Amaute in Pasian' thu genin a teci panna a zawhkhit uh ciangin kuahawm thukpi sung panin a hong paikhia ganhing in tua teci pangte simin zogawpin that ding a,
singlamteh tungah amaute' Topa a kithahna mun Sodom ahih kei leh Egypt minkhem a pua khuapi kongzingah a luanghawm uh kipaidak ding hi.
Mi namkim, pau namkim a zang mi tuamtuamte in ni thum le ni lang sung amaute' luanghawm en ding uh a, a luanghawmte a kivui ding phal lo ding uh hi.
Teci a pang tua kamsang nihte in leitung mite tungah gimna nakpitakin tungsak uh ahih manin hih mi nihte a sihna hangin lungdamin pawi bawl ding uh a, a nuamna uh hangin khatlekhat letsong kipia ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin ni thum le ni lang a cinkhit ciangin amaute sungah Pasian kiang panin nuntakna hu lutin, amaute a khe-un hong ding uh ahih manin a mute khempeuh nakpitakin lau mahmah uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua teci pang nihte in, "Hih lai-ah hong pai un," ci-in vantung panin a kisapna awging a za uh hi. Tua ahih manin a galte uh' muhin vantung meiipi sungah paito uh hi.
Tua hun laitakin nakpitakin zin ling a, a khuapi sehsawmsuah sehkhat tang ding kisiacip a, tua zinling in mi tulsagih a sisak hi. A si lo a hing laite lau mahmah uh a, vantung Pasian a liatna thu a phat uh hi.
Gimna nihna a bei hita a, ahi zongin gimna a thumna hong tung baih ta ding hi.
Tua ciangin a sagihna vantungmi in a peengkul hong tum a, vantungah nakpitakin aw hong ging a, "Leitung uk nading aana neihna pen i Topa Khrih a' hong suakkhin a, amah in a tawntungin uk paisuak ding hi," hong ci hi.
Pasian mai-a a tokhom ciat uhah a tu upa sawmnih le lite zong mai pukin Pasian bia uh a,
"A beisa hun le tu hunah a om tawntung a Vanglian Topa Pasian aw, tu-in na vangliatna zangin uk ding hong kipan khin na hih manin nangma tungah ka nuamna uh ka hong ko uh hi.
Na hehna hong kilat hun hong tungta a, misite thukhen nading hun hong tungta ahih manin minam dangte heh mahmah uh hi. Nangma nasem kamsangte, a lian a neu, nang hong kihta mi khempeuhte thaman na piak ding hun hi ta a, leitung a susia mite na suksiat ding hun hi ta hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin vantungah a om Pasian biakna innpi kihong a, a Thuciamna Singkuang zong biakinn sungah a om a kimu hi. Tua ciangin nakpitakin khua phia-in a ging lianpi om a, van gingin zin ling a, gialpi a kia hi.
Tua ciangin vanah lim lamdang lian khat hong kilang hi. Puan silh bangin ni silhin, a khe nuai-ah kha omin, aksi sawm le nih a kisuanna lukhu, a lu tungah a khu numei khat om hi.
Tua numei naupaii hi a, nausuah natna tungta ahih manin na sa-in a kiko hi.
Tua ciangin lim lamdang adang khat mah vanah hong kilang leuleu hi. Gulpi san a lian mahmah khat om a, lutang sagih le ki sawm nei a, a lutang sagihte-ah lukhu mah nei ciat hi.
A mei tawh vanah a om aksi sehsawmsuah sehkhat vatkhia-in leilak a denna hi. A nau a suah phetin a ne pah dingin nausuak dingin a kithawi tua numei' mai-ah a ding hi.
Tua ciangin tua numei in leitung minam khempeuh sik ciangkhut tawh a uk ding ta pasal khat hong nei hi. Ahi zongin tua naungek pen thakhatin kilakhia-in Pasian a tutna a tokhomah a kipaipih hi.
A numei pen Pasian in ama a dingin a bawl kholhsakna mun gamlakah tai a, tua munah ni tulkhat zanih sawmguk sung kikhoi ding hi.
Tu-in vantungah galkidona hong om a, Mikhael le a vantung mite in gulpi le a vantung mite a do uh hi.
Ahi zongin tua gulpi guallel ahih manin tua gulpi le a vantung mite, vantungah ki-om sak nawn lo hi.
Tua ciangin tua tanglai gulpi, Dawimangpa ahih kei leh Satan a kici, leitung mi khempeuh a khem pa pen a vantung mite tawh leitungah kilawnsuk hi.

Na sungah meivak taang zong kimu nawn lo ding a, a kiteng nungak le tangval a lungdamte' awging kiza nawn lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh na sumbawlte, leitungah a thahat pen hi a, na ai tawh leitung mi khempeuh na khem hi.
Nang Babylon khuapi, hih bangin gim hong kipiakna pen kamsangte le mi siangtho a kithatte' sisan le leitungah a kithat mi khempeuh' sisan nangma sungah a kimuhna hang ahi hi," a ci hi.

A thukhennate thumanin thutang a, a paktatna tawh leitung mi khempeuh a siasak, a paktat nu tungah thu khen khinta a, ama nasemte a thahsakna hangin ama tungah a phu la khinta hi," a ci uh hi.

Puan hoih mahmah, siangin a pak mahmahte, ama silh dingin kipia hi," a ci uh hi. Tua puan hoih pen Pasian' mi siangthote' gamtatna mante ahi hi.

Tua ciangin vantung a kihong ka mu a, sakol kang khat a om hi. A tungah a tuang pa pen a Citak a Thuman pa kici hi. Amah in thumanin thu khenin gal a do hi.
A mittangte meikuang tawh kibang a, lukhu tampi a khu hi. Amah simloh kuamah dang in a theih loh min khat ama tungah a kigelh hi.
Sisan sungah a kidiah puantualpi khat silh a, amah pen, "Pasian' Thu," cihna min tawh a kisam hi.

Minam dangte a zawhgawp nading namsau hiam khat a kam sung panin a pusuak hi. Amah in sik ciangkhut tawh minam dangte ukin, a Vanglian Pasian' heh mahmahna tawh leenggah cilna-ah leengtui a sukkhia ding hi.

Hong pai unla, kumpite' sa, galkapmangte le galkapte' sa, sakolte le a tungah a tuangte' sa, a lian a neu, silate le sila ahi lo mi khempeuhte' sa hong ne un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin sakol tungah a tuang pa le a galkapte a sim dingin ganhing le leitung kumpite a galkapte uh tawh a kikaikhawm ka mu hi.

Hihte in, Joshua leh Israel mite in a zawh Jordan nitumna lam pang, Lebanon kuam sung Baalgad panin Seir lamah a kikhung to Jakah Mual kikala om tua gam kumpite ahi hi (Joshua in mualtung gam, lei niamna gam, Arabah gam, mual pang suk, gamlak, leh Negeb gam sunga om Hit mite, Amor mite, Kanaan mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite, leh Jebus mite, leitangte Israel minamte tungah amau' ngah ding tawh kizui-in a neih dingun pia hi);

Topa' mihonte tungah gimna khat a hong tungsak ahi, eite i kisian'suah nai beek lohna ahi, Peor-a i khialhna hawmthawhin, tu ni-in Topa zuihna panin kihei khia ding na hi uh hiam? Note in tu ni-in Topa na lehdo uh leh zing ciangin Israel mihon buppi tungah amah heh ding hi.
"A Vanglian Pa, Pasian, Topa! A Vanglian Pa, Pasian, Topa! Amah in thei hi, Israel mahmah in zong thei ta hen! Lehdona ahi a, Topa tungah thuman lohna ahi zongin a hih a, Topa zuihna panin pial dingin biakna tau lam ka hih uh leh, tu ni-in kote hong zah kei hen; tua ahih kei leh zong, tua tungah meihal biakna ahi a, an tawh biakna ahi a, thunuam-a biakna ahi zongin piak nadingin a lam ka hih uh leh Topa mahmah in hong thuk ta hen.
Tua ahih ciangin kote in, "Meihal biakna ahi a, biakpiak nading ahi zongin hi loin, ama omna-ah ka meihal biakna uh leh ka biak piaknate uh leh thu-nuam-a ka piaknate uh tawh Topa' na ka sepna uh kote leh note kikal leh ko' khit ciangin suan-le-khakte kikalah teci dingin bawl ni; tua bang hi kei leh hong tung ding hunte-ah na tate un ko' tate tungah, "Topa sungah no' tanh bangmah om lo hi," ci kha ding uh hi,' ka ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note lakah a om lai hih minamte tawh kihel loin, amau' pasiante zong gen loin, tuate tawh zong kiciam loin, amau' na sem loin, amaute mai-ah zong note kun loin, ahih hangin tu ni-a na gamtat bangun Topa na Pasian uh na belh theih nadingun Moses' thukham laibu sunga kigelhte khempeuh zui-in semin, tua panin tak lamah hita leh vei lamah hita leh pial loin na om nadingun khauh takin om un.
Ahih hangin, amah in note hong thupiak ahi Topa na Pasian uh thuciamna palsatin, note in pasian dangte' na semin tuate na biak uh leh, Topa na Pasian un note tawh kisai-a a ciam nahoih khempeuh a tun' mah bangin Topa na Pasian un note hong piaksa hih leitang hoih panin amah in note hong suksiat khit matengin Topa in note tungah siatna khempeuh hong tungsak ding hi. Tua ciangin note tungah Topa' hehna hong so ding a, note tungah a hong piak leitang hoih panin note manlang takin na sia ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Saul' innkuan panin kumpigam khinin, Dan panin Be-ersheba dong Israel leh Judahte tungah David kumpi tokhom phuh ding Topa in ama tungah a ciamsa thu David' adingin ka tun' sak kei taak leh Pasian in keimah Abner hong dawm kei ta hen," a ci hi.
Amaute' in leeng thak khat tungah Pasian' thuciamna singkuang pua uh a, mual tunga om Abinadab' inn panin paikhiatpih uh hi; Abinadab' tapate Uzzah leh Ahio in Pasian' thuciamna singkuang tawh leeng thak hawl uh hi; thuciamna singkuang mai-ah Ahio pai hi.
Kumpi David in hihte zong, a nuaisiah minamte khempeuh Edom, Moab, Ammon mite, Filistiate, Amalek, leh Zobah kumpipa Rehob' tapa Hadadezer' van nusiatte sung panin a ap ngun leh kham tawh Topa tungah ap khawm hi.
amah in kei tungah hong gen, 'Na tapate in a lungsim khempeuh uh leh a nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh keima mai-ah thuman takin pai ding lim takin a ngaihsut uh leh Israel kumpi tokhom tungah khat beek in nang hong tamasak lo ding hi,' ci-a a thugenna Topa in a kipsak theih nading; na hihna khempeuh ah na dau a pai nadingin Moses' thukham sungah a kigelh bangin Topa in na Pasian' thuhilhna zui-in, ama lampite tawn in la, ama thukhamte, a thupiaknate, a biakna ngeina kipte leh a tecipan'nate zui in.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Izipt panin ka mi Israelte ka paikhiatpih huna kipanin keima Min a om theih nadingin inn khat lam nading Israel minam khempeuh sungah khuapi khat zong ka teel kei hi; ahih hangin ka mi Israelte tungah a uk dingin David ka teel hi,' ci-in ka pa David tungah a kam tawh a ciamsa thu a tungsak Israel Pasian, Topa in thupha ngah ta hen.
Tu-in sumbawlte leh sumbukte, leh Arabia kumpi khempeuh leh gamsung a ukte tung panin a ngahte banah kum khatin Solomon tungah a tung kham a gihna in talen zaguk-le-guk ahi hi.
Ama tungah nih vei kilak khinin, amah in pasian dangte' nung a zuih loh nading ama tungah thu a pia khin Topa, Israel Pasian panin a lungsim kiheikhia ahih manin Solomon tungah Topa heh hi; ahih hangin amah in Topa' thupiaksa zui tuan lo hi.
Baasha' khialhnate leh a khialhsa uh ahi a tapa Elah' khialhnate, leh amaute in Israel khialsakin, a milimte uh tawh Israel Pasian, Topa a hehsakna uh hangin, Baasha langpangin kamsang Jehu tung tawnin Topa' thugenna bangin Baasha' innkuan khempeuh tua bangin Zimri in susia hi.
Ama hihsa a khialhna, Topa muhna ah a siat gamtatna, Jeroboam' khekhap a totna, leh a hihsa a khialhna, Israel a khialhsakna hangin, khuapi kila khin hi, ci-in Zimri in a muh ciangin kumpipa' inn muanhuai sungah amah pai a, kumpipa' inn mei tawh amah kihal nelhin si hi.
Israel mite in Jeroboam' khialhna khempeuh hih uh hi; kamsangte ahi a nasemte khempeuh tung tawnin a gensa bangin Topa in ama muhna panin Israel a hepkhiat dongin tuate panin amaute kihem lo uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amau' gam panin Assiria'ah tu ni dongin Israel sal-in om hi.
Hezekiah' thu ngai kei un; bang hang hiam cih leh Assiria kumpipa in hih bangin ci hi: 'kei tawh kilemna hong bawl un la, kei kiangah hong pai un; tua ciangin kei hong pai-in nomau leitang tawh a kibatna mun, an leh leenggahzu a omna, an leh leenggui lo a omna, oliv kungte leh khuaizu a omna gamah, note si loin na nuntak nadingun kong koih dong matengin note khempeuh in nomau leenggui gah ciat ne-in, mi khempeuh in a theigah ciat uh ne ding a, note khempeuh in na tuinak ciat uh panin tui na dawn ding uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in note kiangah, Topa in eite hong honkhia ding hi, ci-in note hong lamlah khialhna-ah Hezekiah thu ngai kei un.
Tua ciangin Topa in David leh a tapa Solomon tungah, "Israel minam khempeuh sung panin ka teelkhiat hih inn sung leh Jerusalem ah ka min ka koih tawntung ding hi; amaute ka thupiaksa khempeuh tawh kizui, leh ka nasempa Moses in amaute a thupiak thukham khempeuh tawh kizui-in gamtat ding a kingaihsut nak uh leh, a pu a pate uh tungah ka piak gam sungah Israelte mi vakvai ka hi sak nawn kei ding hi," a cihna inn sungah amah in ama bawlsa a kiseek Asherah milim koih hi.
Ama gamtatnasate khempeuh tawh kizui-in Manasseh' khialhna hangin ama muhna panin amaute a khinkhiatna ding, leh a diakdiakin, amah in khialhna nei lo mite a thahna hangin Topa' thupiakna tawh Judah tungah hih thu hong tung taktak ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a mawh lo mite' sisan tawh Jerusalem kidimsak a, Topa in amah maisak lo ding hi.
tua ciangin Judah kumpipa Jehoiakhin in Babilon kumpipa tungah amahmah, ama nu, a nasemte, a uliante, leh a kumpi inn-a zaneite kipia hi. Topa in a genkholhsa bangin Babilon kumpipa in ama uk a kum giatna kumin thongkia-in amah la a, Topa' inn a, vanmanpha khempeuh, leh kumpipa' inn a, vanmanpha khempeuh puakhia-in, Israel kumpi Solomon in a bawlsa, Topa' biakinn sunga kham nazat khempeuh la hi.
Hur in a pa zi Efrathah' ta upa pen hi a, ama suan leh khakte in Bethlehem khuapi sat uh hi. Hur' tapa thumte in: Etam, Penuel, leh Ezer ahi uh hi. Etam in tapa thum nei a, tuate in: Jezre-el, Ishma, leh Idbash ahi hi. Tanu khat zong nei a, a min in Hazzelelponi ahi hi. Penuel in Gedor khuapi a satpa hi a, Ezer in Hushah khuapi a satpa ahi hi.
Ezrah' tapa lite in: Jether, Mered, Efer, leh Jalon ahi uh hi. Mered in Faro' tanu Bithiah ten'pih a, tanu Miriam leh tapa Shammai leh Ishbah nei hi. Ishbah in Eshtemoa khuapi satpa ahi hi. Mered in Judah minam numei khat zong ten'pih a, tua tawh tapa thum nei hi. Tuate in: Gedor khuapi a satpa Jered, Soko khuapi a satpa Heber, leh Zanoah khuapi a satpa Jekuthiel ahi hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Topa' thukham sungah a kigelh ama thupiak khempeuh bangin, zingsang leh nitakin meihal biakna tau tungah Topa' adingin meihal biaknate a pia tawntung dingin, Gibeon a, om mual dawn-a Topa' biakbuk mai-ahsiampi Zadok leh a sanggam siampite nusia hi.
Amau' innah amaute a teen' theih nading leh a kinawngkai sak nawn loh nadingin ka mi Israelte' adingin mun khat sehin amaute ka phut ding hi; ka mi Israelte tungah thukhente ka seh-a kipanin a nidanga bangin mi ngongtatte in amaute beisak nawn lo ding uh hi; tua ciangin keimah in na galte khempeuh ka nuaisiah ding hi. Tua tham loin Topa keimah in nang a lianin hong bawlin, suan leh khak na neih nading thu nang tungah kong gen hi.

Tua ciangin kei adingin sing tampi a sem dingin nangma nasemte in keima nasemte tawh om ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka lam ding inn in lianin lamdang ding hi.

Tua ciangin amah in, "'Izipt gam panin ka mite ka paikhiatpih ni-a kipanin keima min a om nadingin Isreal minam khempeuh sungah inn khat lam nading khuapi khat zong ka teel kei a, keima mi Israel tungah kumpi dingin mi khat zong ka teel kei hi; ahih hangin tu-in ka min a om theih nadingin Jerusalem teelin ka mi Israel tungah a uk dingin David ka teel khin ta hi,' ci-in gen in, ka pa David tungah a kam tawh a thuciamna a khut tawh a tungsak Israel Pasian, Topa in thupha ngah ta hen.

Bang hang hiam cih leh Jeroboam leh a tapate in Topa' siampi a sepna panun amaute hawlkhia-in, mual dawn a, biakpiakna munte, dawi gilote, leh ama bawlsa bawngno milimte' adingin ama siampi tuam teel ahih manin Levi mite in amau' taang gam leh amau' neihsate nusia-in Judah leh Jerusalem ah hong pai uh hi.

Kote in kumpipa tawh thuciamna kip a nei khin ka hih manun kumpipa' minsiatna ka muh ding uh kilawm lo ahih manin, nangma mai a, a semte' thuciamtehna laibute a ki-et theih nadingin kumpipa tungah thu kong zasak uh hi. Thuciamtehna laibute sung en lecin hih khuapi in a lehdo thei khuapi, kumpipa tung leh a ukna gamte tungah siatna a piangsak, kumpi dona a khua sungah a om tawntungna thu na mukhia ding hi. Tua ciangin Ezra in, "Jerusalem a, om Topa' inn tua bangin a minthangsak thuah dingin kumpipa lungsim ah suak sak a, kumpipa leh a thulamlakte leh a uliante kei tungah a thunuam dingin a bawl i pu i pate' Pasian ahi Topa in thupha ngah ta hen!" a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin na tanute uh amau' tapate tawh kitengsak kei un la, na tapate uh zi dingin amau' tanute zong la kei un. Amaute' phattuam nading leh mavan' nading hanciam kei un. Tua bang hi leh note tha hatin tua gam-a piangte nuam takin na ne ding uh a, na tate un a luah tawntung dingin tua gam na piasawn thei ding uh hi,' ci-in na thupiaknate ka zui kei uh hi.

Topa ka Pasian aw, nangma tungah lungdamna kong koh tawntung theih nading, ka lungsim in nang hong phat theih nading, a dai om mawk loh nadingin, ka thuumna ka taunate lamna tawh nong heisak a, dahna lim ahi ka puanhampi hong suahsakin nuamna nong guan hi.

Topa in, "Note in sisan sungah na khe uh sil-in, na uite un, galte si a liak theih nadingin Bashan mual panin galte lakhia kikin, tuipi thuk sung panin ka kaikhia kik ding hi," a ci hi.
Leitung kumpi gamte aw, Pasian' tungah la sa un; vantung, tanglai vantung-a tuang Topa phatna la sa un; en un, ama aw, a vanglian ama aw hong gingkhia sak hi.
Vantung panin nangmah in thukhenna na genkhia hi; gimna a thuak leitung mi khempeuh hon dingin Pasian in thu khen ding hong kipat ciangin leitung lau-in taang loin om hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Pasian biakna lamah nuamsa-in, a kilawm gamtatna apawlpawlte bawlin kilemin, nuam takin i om nadingin, kumpi-a kipan ukna a nei mi khempeuh leh mi pawl khempeuhte ading thungenin, thuumin, itna pia-in, hehpihna phatna bawl dingin a masa-in ka hong zol hi.
Tua mah bangin numeite in a kipheek sam tawh ahi zongin, kham tawh ahi zongin, suangmanpha tawh ahi zongin a man pha puan tawh ahi zongin kizeem loin, zumhuaina tawh khuaval tat loin a kilawm puan tawh ahi zongin, Pasian thu a mang numeite' kizep nading a kilawm puan tawh ahi zongin, Pasian a biaksiam numeite' kizep nading a kilawm gamtatna pha tawh ahi zongin a kizep ding uh ka deih hi.
Nangma kiangah a sawt loin ka hong pai ding hi ci-in ka lamet hangin, a sawt veipi ka khawl leh, nangmah in Pasian' innpi sungah mite in bang ci gamtat ding uh hiam cih na theih nadingin, hih bang lai gelhin ka hong pia hi. Tua innpi in a nungta Pasian' pawlpi, thuman thutak khuam leh bulpi ahi hi.

Topa Zeisu Khazih hong kilat dongin nang in a nin baang loin mawhsak nading om loin, thupiakna na zuih nadingin na khempeuh a nungta sak Pasian mai-ah ahi zongin Pontias Pilat maiah pha takpi-a thuman teci a pang Khazih Zeisu mai-ah ahi zongin, keimah in nangma tungah thu kong pia hi.
Sihna tawh kipelh mi khat bek ahi, kuamah in a naih theiloh khuavak sungah om a, kuamah in a muh ngei loh, a muh theih loh, thupha a ngah Topa khat bek ahi kumpite' Kumpipa, topate' Topa in ama ciamtehna hun hong tun' ciangin tua Topa' hong kilat khiatna hong lak ding hi. Tua Pasian in pahtawina, vangliatna ngah tawntung ta hen. Amen.
Hih leitungah sum hau mite in lungsim kiliatsakna tawh kipelhin, a kip tawntung thei lo sum hauhna muang loin, eite lungdam nading na khempeuh a kicingin hong pia Pasian muangin, nuntakna taktak ahi nuntakna ngah nadingin, hong tung ding hun ciangin, amau ading a bulpi pha zong kholin, midangte tungah thupha bawlna, gamtat hoihna kicingin, midang hopnopna lungsim nei-in, khat leh khat kipawl nadingin kilemna thu bawl nading thu na pia in.
Keimah in na khitui luang phawk kikin, ka lungdamna a kicin' nadingin nangmah kong mu nuam a, na pi Lois leh na nu Eunis sungah a masa-in kip-a, a om upna ahi zongin, ka lungkim mah bangin nangma sungah kiphatsakna hi loin a om upna ahi zongin ka phawk a, sun tawh zan tawh thu ka nget ciangin, nangmah hong mangngilh loin hong ngaihsunin, ka pute ka pate in a biak uh bangin ka lungsim kisuan'na om lo siangthona tawh ka biak Pasian' hehpihna ka phat hi.
A kam a nial mite in thuman a theih nadingun Pasian in kisikkikna pia kha ding a, Dawimangpa in ama deihna zui dingin thangsiah-a a awk mite phawkin, tua awkna pan suahtakna a ngah khak theih nadingun lungnemna tawh thuhilh mi ahi ding hi.
Nang na hih leh, na sinsa thu leh na lungsim sunga na san'sa thu-ah ahi zongin, Khazih Zeisu sunga upna tungtawn a, gupkhiatna na ngah nadingin lungpilna a hong pia thei Lai Siangtho, na neu lai-a kipanin na theihsa thu ahi zongin, ciamteh in la, tua na sinsa, na upsa thute-ah kipin om in.
Pasian in ama humopna tawh hong piak Lai Siangtho-a om khempeuh in, Pasian' mi in kicing a, ahoih na apawlpawlte a sep theih nading a, a kigingkhol mi a suah nadingin, thu hilh ding, mawhna lak ding, diktat nading thu hilh ding, leh thuman thutak hilh nadingin thupha a bawl hi.
Zuauthu a gen thei lo Pasian in tanglai hun a tun' ma-in thuciam a, eite Honpa Pasian' thukham bangin kei hong piak thuhilhna tawh a kilawm hunte-ah, Pasian thu a latsakna tawh a kipawl, nuntak tawntungna lamenin, Pasian biakna lamah nopsakna tawh a kipawl thuman thutak theih nading ahi zongin, Pasian' teel mite' up nading ahi zongin, Pasian' sila ahi Zeisu Khazih' sawltak keimah Paul in:
Hih teci thu a man hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Judah mite tangthu ahi zongin, thuman thutak a paaikhia mite' thukhamte ahi zongin thudon loin, upna thu-ah a kip nadingun amaute nakpi-in taai-in na hilh in.
Tua mah bangin numei teekte in zong Pasian' thu tawh kilawm gamtatna a bawl nading, midangte a gendai loh theih nading, kham lua-a leenggahzu' sila ahih loh nading, thu hoih a hilh theih nading tham loin, Pasian' thu in gensiatna a thuak loh nadingin a khangno numeite in a pasal a it ding, a tate a it ding,
Silate in eite Honpa Pasian' thuhilhna khempeuh ah a zep theih nadingun amau tote' ukna mangin, nial loin, na khempeuh a deihhuai mi hih nading leh gu sim loin na khempeuh ah dikna a kilatsak nadingun, hansuahin zol in.

Nangmah in Topa Zeisu umin, misiangthote khempeuh na it ci-in thu ka zak ciangin ka Pasian' hehpihna ka phat tawntunga nang ading thungetsakin ka om hi.
Tua ahih ciangin nang in na bawl dinga kilawmte thu kong piak nadingin keimah in Khazih sungah launa lungsim om loin puteekpa hong kici keimah Paul in, tu-in zong Zeisu Khazih thongkia ka hih maninah, itna tawh nangma kiangah kong thuum zaw hi.
Khazih Zeisu sungah keimah tawh thong a kia khawm Epafros akipan ka naseppih Marka, Aristarkhus, Demas leh Luka-te in nang hong hopih uh hi.
Pasian in tang lai-a kamsangte tungah, i pute pate kiangah atuam atuamin thu a piak kikkik khit ciangin, a nunung bel hih nite-ah ama Tapa tungah eite thu hong pia zo hi. Tua a Tapa na khempeuh luah dingin a koih zo hi; ama tungah zong leitung a piangsak hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, vantungmite tungah thu hong piakna kipin om a, zuih khialhna leh thungaih lohna apawl apawlte in thuak ding a kilawm thukhenna thuak uh ahih leh, a kipat cil a, Topa in hilhin, kam a za mite in a hong kipsak uh a lian mahmah gupna thudon loin om lehang, mawhna daan tawh bang ci kipelh ding i hi hiam?
Tua hi a, tua tate in a si a sa tawh kizom uh ahih ciangin Khazih in zong sihna a thuak ciangin, Dawimangpa ahi sihna a ukpa a suksiat nading ahi zongin, sihna kihta ahih manunah a nungta lai takun a tawntungin a kikhum bangin a omte a suahtak sak nadingin ahi zongin, tua tate bangin si-le-sa a la hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kha Siangtho in a gen mah bangin "Tuni-in ama aw na zak uh leh, na lungsim uh na khuahsak kei un. Keimah hong dong hong ze-etin, Keima hih theih nate, kum sawmli tawntung mu-in, gampa lakah kei tawh kilem lohna bawlin, hong hehsak huna a om bangin om kei un.
Tua ahih ciangin sihna tawh kipawl gamtatnate, kisikkikna, Pasian upna, baptaiznate thuhilhna, khutngakna, misite' thawhkikna, thukhen tawntungnate a bulpi, eite in lamkik loin, Khazih' ngeina a kipatna thute koihin kicin' nadingin kahto ni.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, khatvei khuavakna tungin, vantung hehpihna ciamin, Kha Siangtho tawh a kizom ngei, Pasian' thu hoih ahi zongin, a nung ciangin a tung ding huna vangliatnate ahi zongin a ciap khit ciangin a tawp kikte ahih uh leh, amaute ading Pasian' Tapa singlamteh tungah that kikin a simmawh uh ahih ciangin, a nung ciangin kisikkik ding bawl thakna a tung zo kei uh hi.
Note khempeuh in thadahna nei loin, upna leh thuakna hangin thuciamna a luah ding mite bangin na gamtat zawh nadingun, a tawp dongin upkhialhna nei loin, lametna tawh na dim nadingun, na hahkat nadingun ka deih uh hi.
Zeisu ahih leh, kiciamna om loin a ngah kei hi. "Topa in, 'Nang in a tawntung siampi na hi,' ci-in ciamin a lungsim kikheel nawn lo ding hi," ci-in thu a koihkholh mah bangin Zeisu in kiciamna tawh siampi za ngah a, a phazaw ciamna thu kikhapna a suak hi.
Tua mite Pasian in mawhsak a, thu a piakna in: "Keimah in hih mi pawlte a pute a pate' khut uh kai-in, Izipt gam pan ka paipih ni-in, amau ka piak thuciamna tawh a kilamdang, Thuciamna thak, Israel' innkuante leh, Judah' innkuanpihte tawh ka bawl ding hun hong tung ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ka piak thuciamna-ah a kip kei uh hi. Keimah in zong a mau don loin ka om hi.
Tu-in khut tawh kibawl lo, hih leitung tawh kipawl lo, a lianzaw, a kicing zaw bukah, a nung ciangin a suak ding phattuamnate siampi ahi Khazih in eite ading a tawntung tatkhiatna thupha hong ngahsak khit ciangin, keel' si, bawng' si tawh hi lo, amahmah sisan tawh Siangtho Bel Mun sungah khatvei a tum hi.

Abraham in ze-etna a thuak ciangin upna tawh Isaak biakna-ah a pia hi. "Isaak tung bekah na suan na khak kici ding hi," ci-a thupiak kholhna akipan thuciamnate lungdamin a sang mi hi-in, khat bek a neih tapa a pia hi.
Moses in a khan' a cin' ciangin mawhna tawh kipawl nopsaknate tawlkhat a ngah sangin, Pasian' mite tawh bawlsiatna a thuakkhawm ding deihzaw a, Izipt gam sum khempeuh sangin Khazih tawh kipawl kosiatna a lianzaw-ah lungkimin upna tawh Faro' tanu' tapa kicihna thu a nial hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a nung ciangin a ngah ding thaman a lamen hi.
Tua longal note in khut tawh a kilawng kha thei mei kang mualah ahi zongin, a vom meiipi-ah ahi zongin, khuamial ah ahi zongin, huihpi nungah ahi zongin, peengkul tumna aw-ah ahi zongin, kam awging ah ahi zongin a tung na hi kei uh hi. Tua aw a za mite in thu a piakkik loh nadingin a thuum uh hi.
Note in Zion Mual ah ahi zongin, a nungta Pasian' khua ahi vantung Jerusalem khuapi-ah ahi zongin, a kisim zo lo vantungmi tampi kikhopna-ah ahi zongin, vantung lai sungah a kikhum ta-upa pawl a kikhoppina leh pawlpi-ah ahi zongin, mi khempeuh thu a khen ding Pasian kiangah ahi zongin, kicin'na ah a tung midik mite lungsim khate kiangah ahi zongin, thuciamna thak kikham ahi Zeisu kiangah ahi zongin, Abel' sisan sangin a phazaw a kigen sisan kitheh kiangah ahi zongin, na tung uh hi.
Anungta lametna thu a om nading ahi zongin, a sia thei lo, a kihhuai nitna om lo, a vul thei lo luahna eite in i ngah nading ahi zongin, Zeisu Khazih in sihna pan a thawhkik ciangin hehpihna lianpi tawh kituakin eite hong piang kiksak i Topa Zeisu Khazih' Pa Pasian in thupha ngah ta hen.
Mei tawh a kize-et hangin a kisia thei kham sangin, note upna hong ze-etna un a pha zaw ahih maninah Zeisu Khazih hong kilat ciangin a phat nading, vangliat nading, minthan' nading a suah nadingun, ze-etna apawlpawl thuak nading a om leh, note in tu-in tawlkhat na thuak uh a, na dah uh hangin a tungah ka gelhsa thupha ngaihsunin na lungdam mahmah un.
Tua Topa note in na muh ngeiloh uh hangin na it uh hi. Tu-in zong na muh theih loh uh hangin umin, vangliatna tawh kipawl a kigen thei lo nopna lungsim tawh lungdamin, na kha uh gupkhiatna ahi note upna' tupna mun na ngah uh hi.

Topa ading a lian bel kumpipa ahi zongin, a pha lo gamta mite daan pia ding leh a pha gamta mite pahtawi dingin kumpipa in a koih mangte ahi zongin, mite in a koih ukna nei khempeuh ahi zongin na mang un.
