A teh ding a khawl dong zahin Josef in tuipi gei sehnel zahin antang tampi khol hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh kiteh khin zolo hi.
Josef in a ta masa Manasseh a phuak hi. Amah in, "Pasian in ka haksatna khempeuh leh ka pa' innkuan khempeuh a mangngilhin hong bawl hi," ci hi.
Josef' gensa bangin kum sagih kialpi hong kipan hi. Gamdang khempeuhah kialpi tung a, ahih hangin Egypt gamsung tengah an om hi.
Tua ahih ciangin gam khempeuhah kialpi a tun'kim ciangin Josef in ankholna innte khempeuh hongin, Egypt mite tungah a zuak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt gamah kialpi nasia mahmah hi.
Tua thamloin, leitung khempeuhah kialpi nasia ahih manin, antang lei dingin Josef' kiangah leitung mi khempeuh hong pai uh hi.
Egypt-ah an om hi, ci-in ka za hi. Eite si loin i nuntakna dingin paisuk un la, ei-a' ding an va lei un," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Jakob in Josef' sanggampa Benjamin, a sanggamte tawh paisaklo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ama tungah siatna tung khading, ci-in lau hi.
Josef in a sanggamte thei a, ahih hangin a sanggamte in amah theilo uh hi.
Josef in a mangin amaute a mat khitna a phawk hi. Amah in amaute kiangah, "Note, thukan na hi uh a, hih gam thanemna a en dingin hong pai na hi uh hi," na ci hi.
Amaute in Josef kiangah, "Hilo hi, topa aw; an lei dingin na nasemte a hong pai hi ung.
Kote khempeuh mi khat' ta ka hi uh hi. Kote, a thutak ka hi uh a, na nasemte thukan hilo uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, "Hilo hi, hih gam ginat lohna a en dingin hong pai na hi uh hi," na ci hi.
Amaute in, "Ko, nangma nasemte, sanggam pasal sawmlenih ka hi uh a, Kanaan gam sungah mi khat' ta ka hi uh hi. A moi pen tu laitakin ka pa uh tawh om a, khat pen om nawnlo hi," a ci uh hi.
Note' sungah thuman om hiam, ci-in a kimuhna ding, na thugente uh a kitelna dingin note thong sungah na om laitakun note khat kisawl un la, na sanggampa uh hong paipih sak un. Tua ahih kei leh Faro a nungta ahih mah bangin note, thukan na hi taktak uh hi," a ci hi.
A ni thum ni-in Josef in amaute kiangah, "Keimah in Pasian zahtak ka hih manin hih bangin gamta un. Tua hi leh na nungta ding uh hi.
Note, thuman mi na hih uh leh thong sungah na sanggamte uh khat omsak lai un la, a dangte pai-in na innkuan uh a gilkialte-a' dingin an pua un la,
Tua ciangin amaute khatlekhat in, "A taktakin i sanggampa tawh kisai-in eite i mawh hi. Amah in eite kiangah hong thum napi-in eite in a thu i ngaihloh ciangin amah a lungkhamna i mu hi. Tua thu hangin hih bang lungkhamna eite tungah hong tung hi," kici uh hi.
Reuben in amaute dawng a, "Tangvalpa tungah khial kei un, ci-in note tungah hong gen hilo ka hi hiam? Ahih hangin ka thu nong mang kei uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in ama sihna thaman eite' tungah hong tung ahi hi," a ci hi.
Amaute' kikalah kamphen khat om ahih manin Josef in amau' paute a tellam amaute in theilo uh hi.
Amau' ipte antang tawh dipsakin, a van sung uhah amau' sum ciat koih kikin, lampi-a a nek ding uh an a piakna ding Josef in thu a pia hi. Tua bangmahin amau-a' dingin kihihsak hi.
Amaute khat in a giahna panun a la gan-an pia dingin a van a suah leh, a van gongah a sum mu hi.
Kanaan gamah a pa uh Jakob kiang a tun' uh ciangin, amaute' tunga thupiang khempeuh gen uh a,
Kote pen ka pa uh' tapa, sanggam pasal sawmlenih ka hi uh hi. Khat pen om nawnlo a, tu laitakin a moipen Kanaan gamah ka pa uh tawh om hi,' ka ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua gam topa in kote kiangah, 'Note thuman mi na hihna uh hih tawh ka thei ding hi: Na sanggamte uh khat kei kiangah nusia un la, na innkuan gilkialte-a' dingin antang la un la, ciahkik un.
Na sanggam moi pen uh kei kiangah hong paipih un. Tua hi leh note thukan hiloin thuman mi na hihna uh ka thei ding a, note kiangah na sanggampa uh hong khahin, hih gam sungah omin na na sem thei ding uh hi,' hong ci hi," ci-in a gen uh hi.
Amau' vante a suah ciangun, a milipun a sumte uh a van sung ciat uhah na om hi. Amaute leh a pa un amaute' sum kihente a muh uh ciangin, lungkham uh hi.
A pa uh Jakob in amaute kiangah, "Ka tate tawh kei nong kikhensak zo uh hi: Josef om nawnlo, Simeon om nawnlo, tu-in note in Benjamin na la ding uh hi. Hihte khempeuh kei' tungah hong tung khin hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in, "A sanggampa si a, amah bek om ahih manin ka tapa in note hong zuisuklo ding hi. Note' paina ding na khualzinna uhah ama tungah siatna tung kha zenzen leh, khangham khit nungin dahlua-in ka si ding hi," a ci hi.
Egypt gam panin a puak uh antang amaute in a gaih khit uh ciangin, a pa un amaute kiangah, "Paikik un la, eite-a' ding an tawmkhat va lei un," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Judah in ama kiangah, "Mipa in thupi takin kote hong hilhkhol a, 'Na sanggampa uh tawh nong ton kei uh leh ka mai na mu kei ding uh hi,' hong ci hi.
Ka sanggampa uh hong zuisak lecin kote paisukin nang-a' ding an ka va lei ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin amah nong zuihsak kei leh kote ka paisuk kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mipa in kote kiangah, 'Na sanggampa uh tawh nong ton kei uh leh ka mai na mu kei ding uh hi,' hong ci hi," a ci hi.
Amaute in dawngin, "Mipa in kote' thu leh ka sanggamte uh thu limtakin hong dong a, 'Na pa uh a nungta lai hiam? Sanggam dang na nei uh hiam?' hong ci hi. Hong dotnate ka dawn'na-un ama kiangah a gen ka hi uh hi. 'Na sanggampa uh hong tonpih suk un,' amah in hong cih ding lam kote in bangci theihkholh ding ka hi uh hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Judah in a pa Israel kiangah, "Tangvalpa hong zuisak in; nang leh kote leh i tate siloin i nuntak theihna dingin kote ka va pai ding uh hi.
Kei pen ama-a' dingin a kikham ka hi ding a, kei' khutsung panin amah nong kal ding hi. Keimah in nang kiangah amah hong ciahpihkik loin na mai-ah kong koihkik kei leh, tua mawhna kei hong thuaksak tawntung in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh zekailo hi lehang tu-in nihvei i tungkik khinta ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a pa uh Israel in amaute kiangah, "A tuaci bang ding ahih leh hih bangin gamta un: Gamsunga singgah limci pente pua un la, mipa' tungah letsongin lingsi tawm, khuaizu tawm, singnai, myrrh paknamtui, pistakhio gah, leh almond gahte puak suk un.
Na sum uh a zah nih pua un. Na van gong uhah a kikoihkik sumte puakik un, a kikhial hi khading hi.
Na sanggampa uh zong samin ding un la, mipa kiangah paikik un.
Amah in na sanggampa uh leh Benjamin hong ciahsak kik theihna dingin Vanglian Pasian in mipa' mai-ah note hehpihna hong pia ta hen. Ka tate tawh ka kikhen leh a kikhen ka hi ding hi," a ci hi.
Josef in amaute tawh Benjamin a muh ciangin, amah in a innsung nasempa' kiangah, "Mite inn sungah paipih in la, gan khat go-in bawl in. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih mite in sun ciangin kei tawh an ne ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Josef' inn-ah kipaipih ahih manin lau uh a, amaute in, "Eite sila-in hong bawlin i late a mat theihna ding, eite' tungah thu hong zongin eite hong hih theihna dingin, a masa lai-a i van sunga sum kikoihte' hangin eite hong kipaipih hi," a ci uh hi.
"Aw, topa aw, anlei dingin khatvei kong pai uh hi.
Ka giahna mun uh ka tun' uh ciangin ka vante uh ka hong uh a, ka sumte uh a cingin ka van sung ciat uhah na omkik hi. Tua ahih ciangin kote in tua sumte kong puakik uh a,
an leina dingin sum dang zong kong pua thuah uh hi. Ka van sung uhah kua in sum koih ahi hiam ka thei kei uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Amah in dawng a, "Nuam takin om un la lau kei un. Na Pasian uh, note' pa' Pasian in note-a' dingin na van sung uhah sum koih hi ding hi. Keimah in note' sum a cingin ka ngah khin hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in amaute' kiangah Simeon paikhiatpih hi.
Amah in amau' omzia dong a, "Na gen uh puteek, na pa uh a dam hiam? Amah a nungta lai hiam?" na ci hi.
Amah khuadak to a, a nu' tapa Benjamin mu a, "Hihpa, kei kianga nong gen uh na sanggam moi pen uh ahi hiam? Pasian in nang hong hehpih hen, ka ta!" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a lungsimah a sanggampa ngai lua ahih manin Josef manlangin paikhia a, a kahna ding mun a zong hi. Amah a inndei sungah pai-in tua lai-ah va kap sim hi.
Amaute in Josef amah guakin nesakin, amaute a tuam mahin nesak a, amah tawh a ne Egypt mite in a tuam mahin ne uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt mite in Hebru mite tawh an nekhawm lo uh hi. Tua banga nekkhawm ding pen Egypt mite-a' dingin a kihhuai ahi hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a innsung nasempa thu pia a, "Hih mite' van sungah amau' puakzawh zahzah an guang in la, amau' sum ciat a van gong ciat uhah koih in.
Ka ngun hai pen an leina dinga a sum tawh a moipen' van gongah koihsak in," a ci hi. Amah in Josef' gen bangin a hih hi.
Amaute a pai khit, ahih hangin khuapi panin a nai lai-in, Josef in ama innsung nasempa kiangah, "Kithawi in la, mite va delh in. Amaute na phak ciangin amaute kiangah, 'Bang hangin a hoih pen a sia tawh hong thuk na hi uh hiam? Bang hangin ka topa' ngun hai gu na hi uh hiam?
Ka topa in hih hai sung panin dawnin, hih tawh amah in thu thei hilo ahi hiam? Hih bangin na gamtat manun na khial uh hi,' va ci in," a ci hi.
En in, ka van gong uha ka muh uh sumte, Kanaan gam panin nang kiangah kong puak kik uh hi. Tua ahih teh na topa' inn panin ngun hita leh kham hita leh bangci guk ding ka hi uh hiam?
Amah in, "Na cih bang uh hi ta hen: A kimuhna penpenpa ka sila hi ding a, no a dangteng mawh na baang kei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Judah leh a sanggamte, Josef' inn-ah a tun' ciangin, amah tua lai mahah na omlai hi. Ama mai leilakah amaute kun uh hi.
Josef in amaute kiangah, "Note' gamtatna a bangci gamtat ahi hiam? Kei bang ahi mi in thu ka theihna theilo na hi uh hiam?" na ci hi.
Judah in, "Ka topa tungah hong bangci gen ding ka hi uh hiam? Bang thu gen ding ka hi uh hiam? Tua ahih kei leh ko bangci kiphel theih ding ka hi uh hiam? Pasian in na nasemte' mawhna mukhia hi. En in, kote leh hai a kimuhnapa zong, ka topa' sila ka hi uh hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in, "Tua bangin hi deklo ding hi. Hai a kimuhna mipa bek ka sila hi ding hi. No a dangte ahih leh, na pa' kiang uhah nuamtakin ciah un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin ama kiangah Judah hong paito-in, "Ka topa aw, hong thum ing. Na nasempa, nang tungah kam khat thu hong gensak in la, na nasempa tungah na hehna hong sosak kei in. Bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen Faro mahmah tawh a kibang na hi hi.
Ka topa in a nasemte nong dong a, 'Pa hita leh sanggam pasal dang hita leh na nei uh hiam?' nong ci hi.
Kote in ka topa uh kiangah, 'Kote in a teek pa khat leh a teek zawhin a neih sanggam pasal moilai khat ka nei uh hi. Ama sanggampa si a, a nu' tate sung pan amah bek omlai hi. A pa in amah it mahmah hi,' kong ci uh hi.
Kote in ka topa uh kiangah, 'Tangvalpa in a pa nusia theilo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a pa nusia leh a pa si ding hi,' kong ci uh hi.
Ka pa un, 'Paikikin eite-a' ding an tawm va lei un,' hong cih ciangin
Khat in kei hong nusia khin a, amah kibalzan khin taktak hi, ka ci hi. Tua huna kipan amah ka mu nawn kei hi.
Hih a khat zong kei kiang panin na lak uh a, ama tungah siatna a tun' leh, dahna tawh ka sam kangte Leinuai-ah na paipih suk ding uh hi,' hong ci hi.
kote tawh tangvalpa a ciahlohna a muh ciangin amah si ding hi. Na nasemte in na nasem ka pa uh' sam kangte dahna tawh Leinuai-ah ka paipih ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh na nasem keimah pen tangvalpa-a' dingin ka pa' tungah a kikham ka hi a, 'Nang kiangah amah kong ciahpih kik kei leh tua mawhsakna nangma muhna-ah ka nuntak tawntungin ka thuak ding hi,' ka ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in kong thum hi. Ka topa' sila dingin tangvalpa' tangin na nasempa hong omsak in la, a sanggamte tawh tangvalpa ciahkik sak in.
Tua ciangin ama kianga dingte khempeuh' mai-ah Josef ki-ipzo nawnlo a, "Ka kiang panin mi khempeuh paikhia un," ci-in a kiko hi. Tua ahih manin Josef a sanggamte tungah amah a kipulak ciangin kuamah dang omlo hi.
Josef in a sanggamte kiangah, "Kei, Josef ka hi hi. I pa a nungta lai hiam?" a ci hi. Ahih hangin a sanggamte maizum uh ahih manin amah dawng theilo uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh gam sungah kum nih sung kialpi tungzo hi. Lo khawhloh, an lakloh ding kum nga omlai hi.
Note-a' dingin leitungah a omlai mi a hingsak ding leh note-a' dingin a suakta mi tampi a kem dingin note' mai-ah Pasian in kei hong sawl hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hih lai-ah a hong sawl mi pen note na hi kei uh a, Pasian ahi hi. Amah in Faro' khutnuai-ah a ulian penin kei hong bawlin, ama innsung khempeuh' topa leh Egypt gam khempeuh a ukpa-in kei hong bawlkhin hi.
"Manlangin i pa kiangah va ciahto un la ama kiangah, 'Na tapa Josef in hih bangin ci hi: Pasian in Egypt gam khempeuh' topa-in kei hong bawl khin hi. Ka kiangah hong paisuk hen, zekai kei hen.
Goshen leitangah na teng ding a, nang leh na tate' tate leh na tuuhonte leh na bawnghonte leh na neih khempeuh tawh, nang pen kei tawh a kinai-in na om ding hi.
Hong tung ding kialpi kum nga omlai ahih manin tua lai-ah nang kong vak ding hi. Tua hi kei leh nang leh na innkuanpihte leh na neih khempeuh in zawn'na na ngah ding uh hi, ci hi,' va ci un.
Egypt-ah keima liatna khempeuh leh note' muhsa khempeuh, i pa' kiangah na gen ding uh hi. Manlang un la, hih lai-ah i pa hong paipih suk un," a ci hi.
Faro in Josef kiangah, "Na sanggamte kiangah, 'Hih bangin gamta un: Na ganhingte uh van suan un la, Kanaan gamah ciahkik un.
I pa leh na innkuanpihte uh va la un la, kei kiangah hong pai un. Egypt gam a hoihpen mun note kong pia ding a, note in gam hoih sunga piangte na ne ding uh hi,' ci in.
Amaute zong thu pia in la, 'Hih bangin gamta un: Na tate leh na zite uh-a' dingin Egypt panin leeng la un la, i pa hong paipih un.
Amah in amaute khempeuh tungah puan hoih silh khat ciat a pia hi. Ahih hangin Benjamin' tungah ngun shekel za thum leh puan hoih silh nga a pia hi.
Amah in a pa kiangah a nuai-ate a khak hi: Egypt na hoihte a pua la sawm; antang, anlum, leh lampi-a a pa' nek ding an a pua lapi sawm a puak hi.
Amaute in ama kiangah, "Josef nungta lai a, amah pen Egypt gam khempeuh a ukpa na hi hi," hong ci uh hi. Amah in amaute' thugen umlo ahih ciangin a lung si hi.
Ahih hangin amaute' tunga Josef' gen kammalte ama kiangah a gen ciang leh Josef in amah puakna dinga a khak leengte a muh ciangin, a pa uh Jakob' lungsim hingkik hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel, a neih khempeuh tawh a khuazin kipanin Beersheba tung a, a pa Isaac' Pasian tungah biakpiakna a bawl hi.
Egypt-ah nang tawh kong paisuk ding a, tua ciangin zong keimah in nang kong paipihto kik ding hi. Josef' khutsungah na si ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Beersheba panin Jakob dingkhia hi. Israel' tapate in a pa uh Jakob, a tate uh, leh a zite uh, amah puakna dinga Faro in a khak leeng sungah a pua uh hi.
Amaute in zong Kanaan gam sunga a lam uh a ganhingte uh leh a nate uh la-in, Jakob leh ama suanlekhakte ahi,
Tu-in hihte pen Israel' suanlekhak, Egypt-ah a pai Jakob leh a tate' min ahi hi. Jakob' ta u pen Reuben
leh Reuben' tapate: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron, leh Karmi ahi hi.
Simeon' tapate: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakhin, Zohar, leh Kanaan numei' tapa Shaul ahi hi.
Levi' tapate: Gershon, Kohath, leh Merari ahi hi.
Judah' tapate: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, leh Zerah ahi hi. (Ahih hangin Er leh Onan Kanaan gamah si hi.) Perez' tapate: Hezron leh Hamul ahi hi.
Issakhar' tapate: Tola, Puvah, Job, leh Shimron ahi hi.
Zebulun' tapate: Sered, Elon, leh Jahleel ahi hi.
(Hihte pen Paddanaram-ah Leah tawh a neih Jakob' suante hi a, a tanu Dinah tawh zong ahi hi. Numei leh pasal a vekpi-in sawmthumlethum ahi hi.)
Asher' tapate: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, leh a sanggamnu uh Serah ahi hi. Beriah' tapate: Heber leh Malkhiel ahi hi.
(Hihte pen Laban in a tanu Leah tungah a piak Zilpah' tapate ahi hi. Amah in Jakob tawh hihte nei a, mi sawmleguk ahi hi.)
Josef in Egypt gamah On khua siampipa Potifera' tanu Asenath tawh Manasseh leh Efraim nei hi.
Benjamin' tapate: Bela, Bekher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, leh Ard ahi hi.
(Hihte pen Rachel tawh a neih Jakob' suante hi a, a vekpi-in mi sawmleli ahi hi.)
Naftali' tapate: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, leh Shillem ahi hi.
Egypt gamah a pai Jakob-a' ahi ama suanlekhak, Jakob' tate' zite a kisim loin, a vekpi-in mi sawmgukleguk ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Josef in a leengte kithawi sakin Goshen-ah a pa Israel a dawn dingin a paito hi. A pa a muh phetin ngawng kawi-in tawlkhat sung a kap hi.
Israel in Josef kiangah, "Na maitang mu khinin nang na nuntak lai thei ka hih manin tu-in ka si zongin phamawh nawnlo hi," a ci hi.
Josef in a sanggamte leh a pa' innkuanpihte kiangah, "Kei paito-in Faro' kiangah ka va gen ding a, ama tungah, 'Kanaan gama om ka sanggamte leh ka pa' innkuanpihte kei kiangah hong pai hi.
Amaute pen tuucing ahih manin gan kemte ahi uh hi. Amaute in a tuuhonte uh leh a bawnghonte uh leh a neih khempeuh uh hong paipih uh hi,' ka va ci ding hi.
Goshen leitangah na ten' theihna dingun note in, 'Kote hita leh ka pate uh hita leh ko na nasemte pen ka neu lai uha kipan tuhun dongin gankemte ka hi uh hi,' na ci ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt mite-a' dingin tuucing peuhmah a kihhuai ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Josef pai-in Faro' kiangah, "Ka pa leh ka sanggamte a tuuhon uh leh a bawnghon uh leh a neih khempeuh uh tawh Kanaan gam panin hong pai uh a, amaute tu-in Goshen gamah om uh hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Faro in a sanggamte kiangah, "Na nasep uh bang ahi hiam?" na ci hi. Amaute in Faro' kiangah, "Ka pate uh mah bangin na nasem kote pen gankemte ka hi uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Amaute in Faro kiangah, "Hih gamah tawlkhat a om dingin kong pai uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Kanaan gamah kialpi nasia lua ahih manin tua lai-ah na nasemte' tuuhonte-a' ding lonona om nawnlo hi. Tu-in kong thum uh hi. Goshen gamah na nasemte hong tengsak in," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Faro in Josef kiangah, "Na pa leh na sanggamte na kiangah hong tung khin hi.
Egypt leitang khempeuh nangma thu ahi hi. Na pa leh na sanggamte lei hoihna penah tengsak in. Goshen leitangah amaute tengsak in. Amaute' lakah a hih thei mi na muh leh ka ganhingte a kem dingin koih in," a ci hi.
Faro in Jakob kiangah, "Na nuntak kum bangzah pha ta ahi hiam?" na ci hi.
Jakob in Faro kiangah, "Tawlkhat sung ka nuntak hun pen kum za leh kum sawmthum ahi hi. Ka nuntak hun tom sungah siatna bekbek om a, ka pate tawlkhat a omsung uh a nuntak hunte ban nailo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Faro' thupiaksa bangin Josef in leitang a hoihpen, Rameses leitang, Egypt gam sungah neihsa pia-in a pa leh a sanggamte a tengsak hi.
Josef in a pa, a sanggamte, leh a pa' innkuante khempeuh a ne ding zah tawh kizui-in an a pia hi.
Tu-in kialpi nasia mahmah ahih manin gam khempeuhah an om nawnlo a, kialpi hangin Egypt mite leh Kanaan mite vulgawp uh hi.
Amaute in antang a leina hangin, Egypt gamsung leh Kanaan gamsunga sum khempeuh Josef in ngah khin hi. Josef in Faro' inn-ah tua sumte paipih hi.
Egypt gamsung leh Kanaan gamsunga sum a bei khit ciangin Egypt mite khempeuh Josef kiangah hong pai-in, "Kote an hong pia in. Bang hangin na muhna-ah si ding ka hi uh hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh ka sum uh beita hi," a ci uh hi.
Josef in dawngin, "Na ganhingte uh hong pia un. Na sum uh bei ahih leh na ganhingte uh khekna-in an kong pia ding hi," na ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Josef kiangah a ganhingte uh paipih uh hi. Josef in sakolte, tuuhonte, bawnghonte, leh late a khekna-in amaute an a pia hi. A ganhingte uh khekna-in Josef in tua kum sung amaute an a pia hi.
Tua kum a bei, a kum kik ciangin amaute Josef kiangah hong pai-in, "Ka sum uh a bei khitna ka topa uh tungah kong im kei ding uh hi. Ganhing honte ka topa-a' ahi hi. Ka pumpi uh leh ka leitang uh cih simloh ka topa' muhna-ah bangmah dang om nawnlo hi.
Bang hangin kote si-in ka leitang uh nangma muhna-ah maimawk ding ahi hiam? Kote leh ka leitang uh an tawh hong lei in. Kote, Faro' sila ka hi ding uh a, ka leitang uh zong ama-a' hi ding hi. Leitang mawkval loin, kote si loin ka hin' theihna dingun khaici hong pia in," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Josef in Egypt gam khempeuh Faro-a' dingin a lei hi. Kialpi nasia lua ahih manin Egypt mi khempeuh in a lote uh a zuak uh hi. Leitang khempeuh Faro-a' suak khin hi.
Mihingte ahih leh, Egypt mongkhat panin a mongkhat dongin amah in sila-in bawl hi.
Tua ciangin Josef in mite kiangah, "En un, tuni-in note leh na leitang uh Faro-a' dingin kong lei hi. Tu-in hih lai-ah no-a' dingin khaici om a, note in leitang tungah na vawh ding uh hi.
Anlak ciangin Faro' tungah nga-ah khat na pia ding uh a, nga-ah li pen lo-ah khaici ding, note leh na innkuanpihte uh leh na tate uh' an dingin na tang ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Faro in nga-ah khat nei ding hi cihna, tuni donga a om, Egypt leitang tawh kisai-in Josef in ngeina kip khatin a bawl hi. Siampite' leitang bek Faro-a' suaklo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Egypt gamsung Goshen leitangah Israel-te teng uh hi. Tua lai-ah amaute in neihsa ngah uh a, pungin tampi tak pha uh hi.
Egypt gamah Jakob kum sawmlesagih nungta lai ahih manin ama khan' kum za leh kum sawmlilesagih ahi hi.
Israel a sih ding hun a nai ciangin, amah in a tapa Josef samin ama kiangah, "Tu-in na muhna-ah maipha ka ngah leh, ka phei nuai-ah na khut hong koih in la, thumantak leh citakin kei nong bawl ding thu hong ciam in. Egypt-ah kei hong vui kei in la,
Tua zawh a sawtloin, "Na pa a ci na hi," ci-in Josef kiangah kigen ahih ciangin amah in a tapa nihte Manasseh leh Efraim a paipih hi.
"Tu-in, Egypt-ah nang kiangah kong pai ma-in Egypt gam sungah nang' sung panin a suak na tapa nihte keima-a' ahi hi. Reuben leh Simeon-te mah bangin Efraim leh Manasseh zong keima-a' hi ding hi.
Amaute' khit cianga nang sung panin a suak tate pen nangma-a' hi ding hi. Amau' gamh luahna-ah amau' sanggamte' min tawh amaute kilo khawm ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Paddan panin ka pai lai-in, Efrath tun' ma diak, Kanaan gam lamkalah ka dahna dingin ka zi Rachel hong si hi. Efrath (Bethlehem) paina lampi-ah amah ka vui hi," a ci hi.
Josef in a pa' kiangah, "Pasian in hih lai-ah kei hong piak ka tapate ahi hi," a ci hi. Amah in, "Kong thum hi; amaute thupha ka piak theihna dingin ka kiangah hong paipih in," a ci hi.
Tu-in Israel' mitte a khanghamna hangin maang a, amah in khua mu theilo hi. Tua ahih ciangin Josef in ama kiangah amaute paipih hi. Amah in amaute namin a kawi hi.
Josef in amaute gel la-in, Efraim' taklam khut, Israel' veilam khutah, Manasseh' veilam khut, Israel' taklam khutah a paipih hi.
Israel in a taklam khut zanin a nauzaw Efraim' lu tungah nga a, Manasseh a ta upa ahih manin, a khut kipaihpeh sakin Manasseh' lu tungah a veilam khut a nga hi.
Amah in Josef thupha pia-in, "Ka pate Abraham leh Isaac in a na a sep Pasian, tuni dongin ka nuntak tawntungah lam hong pi Pasian,
siatna khempeuh panin kei hong tankhia vantung mi in hih tangvalte thupha pia hen la, amaute sungah keima min leh ka pa Abraham leh Isaac' min kizomsak hen la, leitungah amaute mi honpi khatin khangsak ta hen!" a ci hi.
A pa in a taklam khut Efraim' lu tungah a koih Josef in a muh ciangin, tua in amah lungkimlo sak hi. Efraim' lu panin Manasseh' lu tungah koih dingin amah in a pa' khut a la hi.
Josef in a pa kiangah, "Hilo hi, pa aw; hih pen a suak masa ahi hi. Na taklam khut ama lu tungah koih in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in tua ni-in amaute thupha pia a, "Note, Israel sungah thupha na hi ding uh a, 'Pasian in Efraim leh Manasseh bangin note hong bawl hen,' kici ding hi," a ci hi. Tua bangin Jakob in Manasseh' mai-ah Efraim a koih hi.
Tua thamloin, ka namsau leh ka thal tawh Amor mite' khut tung panin ka lak mualpang khat, na sanggamte' tung sangin nang' tungah kong piazaw hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jakob in a tapate sam a, "A hong tung ding hunte-ah note' tunga hong tung ding thu kong gen theihna dingin note hong kikhawm un.
"Jakob' tapate aw, hong kikhawmin za un la, na pa Israel' thugen ngai un.
"Reuben, nang pen ka ta upa, ka vangliatna leh ka tacil na hi a, a kiphasak pen, a vanglian pen na hi hi.
Tuihual bangin na kip kei ding a, na tungtuang kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka zi na luppih a, ka lupna na mindai sak hi.
"Simeon leh Levi, unau hi a, a hiam uh ngongtatna dingin a zang uh hi.
Amau' sinsona lauhuai a, amau' hehna kihtakhuai hi. Ciamsiatna ngah ta uh hen! Jakob suante sungah amaute ka khenthang ding a, Israel sungah amaute ka thehthang ding hi.
"Judah aw, na sanggamte in nang hong phat ding hi. Na galte' gawl na mek ding a, na sanggamte na mai-ah hong kun ding uh hi.
"Zebulun, tuipi gei-ah teng ding hi. Amah, teembaw khawlna mun suak ding a, Sidon ciangdongah a gamgi om ding hi.
Dan pen lampi-ah gulpi hi ding a, sul gei-ah gulgu nei hi ding hi. Sakol' khetul petin a tuangpa a nungkiat hi.
"Nong hotkhiat ding ka ngak hi, { Topa }.
"Naftali, a kikhah sakhipi hi a, sakhino suakkhia sak hi.
"Josef, a gah pha hiang ahi hi. Ciktui gei-a om a gah pha hiang hi a, a hiangte kulh tungah zam hi.
Thal tawite in nakpi takin amah simin, amah thal tawh kap uh a, nasia takin gimsak uh hi.
Ahih hangin ama thal liing loin om a, a khutte kizaptel sak hi. Jakob' Vanglian Pa' khut (Israel Suangpi, Tuucingpa' min),
nang hong huh ding na pa' Pasian in tunga om vantung thuphate, nuai-a tuithukna sunga om thuphate, khawilevulh leh tuletate, nangma tungah hong pia hi.
Na pa' thuphate pen tawntung mual liante' thupha, tawntung mual neute sangin vanglian zaw hi. Tua thuphate Josef' lu tungah hong tung hen la, a sanggamte' kiang panin a kituam koihpa' tungah hong tung ta hen.
Hihte khempeuh pen Israel minam sawmlenihte ahi hi. Hih thute pen amau tawh a kituak ciatin a pa in amaute thupha pia-in a gente ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Jakob in a tate thuhilhin amaute kiangah, "Kei, ka mipihte kiangah a kigawm ding ka hita hi. Kivuina ding munin neih dingin Abraham in Hit mi Efron' tung panin a lo tawh a leikhop, Kanaan gam, Mamre nisuahna lamah a om Makpelah lo-a leihawm, Hit mi Efron' lo-a leihawm han sungah ka pate tawh hong vuikhawm un.
Tua lai munah amaute in Abraham leh a zi Sarah vui uh hi. Tua lai munah amaute in Isaac leh a zi Rebekah vui uh hi. Tua lai munah keimah in Leah ka vui hi.
Lo leh tua sunga om leihawm Hit mite' tung panin a kilei ahi hi," a ci hi.
Jakob in a tapate thuhilh a man khit ciangin, a lupna tungah lai-tat a, a nunung pen a hu sang-in ama mipihte kiang a zuan ta hi.
A pa a muatlohna dingin a bawl dingin Josef in a nasem zatui siamte thu pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin zatui siamte in zatui tawh Israel a bawl uh hi.
Ka pa in kei hong kiciamsak a, 'Kei a si ding ka hi ta hi. Kanaan leitangah kei-a' dingin ka khuatsa han sungah kei nong vui ding hi,' hong ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in kei hong paito sak in la, ka pa hong vui sak in, ci-in kong thum hi. Tua ciangin kei kong ciahkik ding hi, ci hi, va cihsak un," a ci hi.
Faro in dawngin, "Paito in la, nang hong kiciamsak bangin na pa va vui in," a ci hi.
Josef' innkuante khempeuh, a sanggamte, a pa' innkuante bangmahin paito uh hi. A tate uh, a tuuhonte uh leh a ganhing honte bek uh Goshen gamah kinusia hi.
Tua lai munah amah tawh leengte leh sakol tuangte zong paikhawm to uh hi. Tua lai-a paite tam mahmah hi.
Amaute Jordan gun galkhat, Atad' buhcilna phual a tun' uh ciangin, nakpi takin dahna tawh a thuum uh hi. Amah in a pa' hangin ni sagih sung dahna hun a bawl hi.
Tua gama teng Kanaan mite in, Atad' buhcilna-ah tua banga kahna a muh ciangin amaute in, "Hih pen Egypt mite-a' dingin a nasia mahmah thuumna ahi hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua mun pen Abelmizraim, kici hi. Tua mun pen Jordan gun galkhat ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in amaute a thupiak bangin ama tapate in ama-a' dingin bawlsak uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ama tapate in Kanaan gamah amah pua-in, kivuina ding muna neih dingin Abraham in Hit mi Efron' tung panin a lo tawh a leikhop, Mamre nisuahna lamah a om, Makpelah mun lo sunga leihawm sungah a vui uh hi.
Josef in a pa a vui khit ciangin, a sanggamte leh a pa a vui dingin amah a zui khempeuhte tawh Egypt-ah a ciahkik hi.
Josef' sanggamte in a pa uh a sih khit ciangin, "Josef in eite hong mudahin ama tunga siatna i bawl khempeuh hong thukkik khading hi," ci uh hi.
'Josef kiangah hih bangin ci un: Na sanggamte' thupalsatna leh a khialhna na maisak in, kong thum hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nang' tungah amaute in siatna hong bawl uh hi,' ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in nang' tungah kong thum uh hi. I pa' Pasian' nasemte' thupalsatna hong maisak in," a ci uh hi. Amaute in ama kiangah tua bangin thu a gen ciangun Josef a kap hi.
Note in ahih leh, kei' tungah a sia dingin na ngaihsun uh hi. Ahih hangin Pasian in tuhuna mah bangin mi tampite a nuntak theihna a pian'na dingin a hoih dingin a ngaihsut ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin lau kei un. Note leh na tate uh-a' dingin an kong pia ding hi," a ci hi. Amah in tua bangin kip gen pha kikin amaute a hehnem hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Josef, amah leh a pa' innkuante tawh Egypt-ah teng uh a, Josef kum za leh kum sawm nungta hi.
Josef in a sanggamte kiangah, "Kei a si ding ka hi ta hi. Ahih hangin Pasian in note hong kem ding a, hih leitang panin amah in Abraham, Isaac, leh Jakob tunga a ciamsa leitangah note hong paikhiatpih to ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kum za leh kum sawm a pha-in Josef a si hi. Amaute in a muatlohna dingin zatui tawh amah bawl uh a, Egypt-ah hankuang sung khatah amah kikoih hi.
Tua ciangin Josef leh a sanggamte leh tua khangmi khempeuh si uh hi.
Ahih hangin Israel' suanlekhakte pungin nakpi takin khang uh hi. Amaute tampi pha-in nakpi takin khang uh ahih manin Egypt gamah dim uh hi.
Tu-in Josef a theilo kumpi thak khat Egypt gamah hong khang hi.
Amah in a mipihte kiangah, "En un, Israel mite eite-a' dingin tam lua-in thahat lua uh hi.
Amaute hong tam khading uh ahih manin ngaihsut siamna tawh amaute hih ni. Eite tungah gal hong om leh amaute in i galte pawlin eite hong do-in hih gam panin taikhia khading uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin nasepna tawh amaute a gimsak dingin amaute tungah nasem ukte koih uh hi. Israel mite in Faro-a' dingin van koihna Pithom leh Rameses khuapite lam uh hi.
buan leh leiseek tawh nasepna leh lo sungah nasep namkim khempeuh tawh amau' nuntakna haksa sak uh hi. Israel mite' sepna khempeuhah amaute in a gim mahmahin semsak uh hi.
"Hebru numeite nau domin, nausuahna tutphah tungah a tut ciangun, tapa ahih leh a naungek na that ding uh a, ahi zongin tanu ahih leh na nungtasak ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin naudomte in Pasian zahtak uh hi. Egypt kumpipa in amaute a thupiak bangin gamtalo uh a, nau pasalte nungtasak uh hi.
Naudomte in Faro' kiangah, "Hebru numeite leh Egypt numeite a kibatlohna hang ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute thadim uh a, amau' kiangah naudomte a tun' ma-in amaute na suak khin pahpah uh hi," na ci uh hi.
Amah in naungek a seel zawh nawnloh ciangin ama-a' dingin pumpeeng tawh kibawl lawh khat phansak a, tua lawh pen buan leh kultal tui tawh a zut hi. Tua sungah naungek sialin gun gei-a phaikungte lakah a koih hi.
Tu-in Faro' tanu a kisil dingin gunah hong pai a, a nasem numeite gun gei-ah a vak lai takun amah in phaikungte lakah a lawh mu a, tua lawh a la dingin a nasem numei khat a sawl hi.
Amah in a hon' ciangin naungek mu hi. Naungek kap ahih manin tuanu in hehpihhuai sa a, "Hih naungek, Hebru mite' ta khat ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a sanggamnu in Faro tanu kiangah, "Keimah pai-in Hebru numeite lak panin nang-a' dingin naupang hong khoisak dingin naucing khat ka va sapsak ding hiam?" va ci hi.
Faro' tanu in ama kiangah, "Va pai in," na ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin numeino pai-in naupang' nu va sam hi.
Faro' tanu in ama kiangah, "Hih naupang la in la, kei-a' dingin hong khoisak in; na thaman kong pia ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin nupi in naupang la-in a khoi hi.
Naupang khang a, amah in Faro tanu' kiangah paipih a, amah pen tuanu' tapa a suak hi. Amah in a min Moses a phuak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, "Tui sung panin amah ka kai khia hi," a ci hi.
Ni khat, Moses a khan' khit ciangin, ama mipihte kiangah pai-in amau' gimnate va mu hi. Egypt mi khat in ama mipih Hebru mi khat a sat zong a mu hi.
Amah khuadak kawikawi a, kuamah mulo ahih manin Egypt mipa thatin sehnel sungah a seel hi.
Amah in dawngin, "Kote' tungah ulian ding leh thukhen dingin kua in nang hong koih ahi hiam? Egypt mipa na thah bangin kei thah ding hong sawm na hi hiam?" na ci hi. Tua ciangin Moses lau a, "A thu hong kithei taktak hi," ci-in ngaihsun hi.
Faro in tua thu a zak ciangin Moses thah dingin a zong hi. Ahih hangin Faro kiang panin Moses tai-in Midian gam a tung hi. Nikhat amah tuikhuk gei khatah tu hi.
A pa uh kiangah amaute a tun' ciangun amah in, "A bangcia tuni-a hong hici ciah baih na hi uh hiam?" na ci hi.
Amaute in, "Egypt mi khat in tuucing dangte' khutsung panin kote hong honkhia a, ko-a' dingin tui nangawn hong tawisakin tuuhonte tui pia hi," ci uh hi.
Amah in a tanute kiangah, "Amah koi lai-ah om ahi hiam? Bang hangin tua mipa nusia na hi uh hiam? Amah in an hong nek theihna dingin va sam un," a ci hi.
Tuanu in tapa khat nei a, amah in a min Gershom a phuak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, "Gam dangah peemta ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Pasian in amau' thumna za hi. Pasian in Abraham, Isaac, leh Jakob tawh a thuciamna a phawk hi.
{ Topa' } vantung mi sawlpang kawm, meikuang sung panin ama tungah hong kilang hi. Amah khuadak a, sawlpang a kuang a mu hi. Ahi zongin kangtumlo hi.
Moses in, "Bang hangin sawlpang kangtumlo hiam, kei pai-in hih a lamdang ka muh va en dih ning," ci hi.
Tua thu a thei dingin amah a paina { Topa } in a muh ciangin, sawlpang kawm panin Pasian in amah sam a, "Moses, Moses!" na ci hi. Amah in, "Hiah om ing," ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "A nai-ah hong pai kei in. Na khe panin na khedapte suahkhia in. Bang hang hiam cih leh nangma din'na mun, leitang siangtho ahi hi," na ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Kei pen na pa' Pasian, Abraham' Pasian, Isaac' Pasian, leh Jakob' Pasian ka hi hi," na ci hi. Tua ciangin Moses in Pasian a muh ding lau ahih manin a maitang a hum hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in, "Egypt-ah a om ka mite' gimna mu khinin, amaute a uk nasem ukte' hangin amau' kikona ka za khin hi. Amau' thuaknate ka thei a,
Egypt mite' khutsung panin amaute khahkhia-in, tua leitang panin amaute la khia-in a hoih a tanzau leitang, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luan'na leitang, Kanaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite, leh Jebus mite' omna-ah amaute a paipih dingin kong paisuk hi.
Hong pai in, nang in Egypt panin ka mi Israel-te na paikhiatpih theihna dingin Faro' kiangah nang kong sawl ding hi," na ci hi.
Amah in, "Nang tawh kong om taktak ding hi. Hih pen nangma-a' dingin nangmah kong sawlna lim hi ding hi: Nangmah in Egypt panin mihingte na paikhiatpih khit ciangin, nang in hih mualtungah Pasian na bia ding hi," a ci hi.
Pasian in Moses kiangah, "{ Keimah } ka hi hi," ci hi. Tua ciangin Pasian in, "Israel mite tungah hih thu genin, '{ Keimah } a kicipa in note kiangah kei hong sawl hi,' ci in," a ci hi.
Pasian in Moses kiangah, "Hih thu Israel mite tungah gen in: '{ Topa, } na pate uh' Pasian, Abraham' Pasian, Isaac' Pasian, leh Jakob' Pasian in note kiangah kei hong sawl hi,' ci in. Hih pen keima min hi tawntung ahih manin kei pen khang tawntungin phawk ding ka hi hi.
Pai in, Israel upate kaikhawmin amaute kiangah, '{ Topa, } na pate uh' Pasian, Abraham, Isaac, leh Jakob' Pasian keima tungah hong kilang khinin, "Note leh Egypt gam sungah note' tungah hong kibawlna ka mu khin hi.
Egypt gam panin note hong lakhia-in Kanaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite, leh Jebus mite' leitang, bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luan'na leitangah note kong paipih ding ka kiciam hi," ci hi,' va ci in.
"Amaute in nangma thu hong ngai ding uh hi. Nang leh Israel upate, Egypt kumpipa kiangah pai-in ama tungah, '{ Topa } ahi Hebru mite' Pasian, kote' kiangah hong kilangzo hi. Tu-in kong thum uh hi, { Topa } ka Pasian uh' tungah biakna ka piak theihna dingun ni thum paina gamlakah kote hong paisak in,' va ci un.
Thatanghat thu tawh a kisawlgawp kei buang leh Egypt kumpipa in note hong paisakloh ding zong ka thei hi.
Numei peuhmah in a vengte leh ama inn sunga ompak mite' kiang panin ngun leh kham tawh kibawl kizepnate leh puante ngen ding uh a, na tapate uh leh na tanute uh tungah tuate na koih ding uh hi. Tua bangin note in Egypt mite' na na sut ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in dawngin, "Ahih hangin amaute in kei hong umloin ka thu hong ngailo ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in, 'Nang tungah { Topa } hong kilanglo hi,' hong ci ding uh hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in ama kiangah, "Na khutsungah bang om ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in, "Ciangkhut," ci hi.
Ahih hangin { Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Na khut zan in la a mei-in man in," ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in a khut zanin man a, ama khutsungah ciangkhut a suakkik hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Amaute in a up theihna dingun { Topa}, amaute' Pasian, Abraham' Pasian, Isaac' Pasian, leh Jakob' Pasian, nang' tungah hong kilang khinzo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in ama kiangah, "Na khut, na ang sungah koih in," ci kik hi. Amah in a khut a ang sungah koih hi. Amah in a lak khiat kik ciangin, a khut phak a, vuk bangin a pak hi.
Pasian in, "Amaute in nang hong up kei a, lim masa a thudon kei uh leh zong, amaute in lim nunung um khading uh hi.
Amaute in hih lim nihte nangawn um loin na thu hong thudon kei leh, nangmah in Nail gun panin tui pawlkhat la-in lei keu tungah na sung ding a, Nail gun panin na lak tui pen lei keu tungah sisan suak ding hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Moses in { Topa } kiangah, "Oh, ka Topa aw, tumasiah hita leh na nasempa tungah thu na gen-a kipan hita leh, kei thugen a siam ka hi kei hi. Ka kam pau ol-in, ka pau awk hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in ama kiangah, "Kua in mipa' kam bawl ahi hiam? Kua in amah pau theilo sak, bilngong sak, mu sak, mittaw sak ahi hiam? { Topa } ahi keimah hilo ka hi hiam?
Tua ciangin Moses tungah { Topa } heh a, amah in, "Levi mi na sanggampa Aaron om hilo ahi hiam? Amah in hoihtakin thu a gen theihna ka cian theih hi. En in, nangmah a dawn dingin amah hong paikhia a, amah in nang hong muh ciangin a lungsim sungah amah kipak ding hi.
Amah in nang' tangin mite tungah thu gen ding hi. Amah in nang-a' dingin thu hong gensak ding a, nang in Pasian bangin na gen ding teng amah na sawl ding hi.
Nangmah in limte na bawlna ding ahi hih ciangkhut na khutsungah na tawi ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a sungpa Jethro' kiangah Moses pai-in ama kiangah, "Hong thum ing; Egypt-ah ka sanggamte kiangah kei hong ciahkik sakin amaute a nungta lai uh hiam hong mu sak in," a ci hi. Jethro in Moses kiangah, "Cidam takin va ciahkik in," a ci hi.
Midian gam sungah { Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Egypt-ah ciahkik in. Bang hang hiam cih leh nang a hong that nuam mi khempeuh si khinta uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses in a zi leh a tapate la a, la khat tungah amaute tuang sakin, Egypt gamah ciah kik hi. Pasian in a tawi dingin a gen ciangkhut, Moses in ama khut sungah a tawi hi.
{ Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Egypt-ah na ciahkik ciangin, nangma hih theih dingin vangliatna kong piaksa na lamdangte khempeuh Faro' mai-ah na hih ding thei in. Ahih hangin keimah in ama lungsim ka khauhsak ding a, amah in mite paisaklo ding hi.
Nangmah in Faro' kiangah, '{ Topa } in hih bangin ci hi: Israel pen ka tapa a suak masa hi a,
nangma kiangah, "Amah in kei hong biak theihna dingin ka tapa paisak in," kong ci hi. Amah paisak ding na nial leh, en in, na tapa a suak masa ka that ding hi, ci hi,' ci in," a ci hi.
Lampi-ah a giahna khatah { Topa } in Moses dawntuahin thah a sawm hi.
Tua ahih ciangin { Topa } in Moses thatlo hi. Tua ciangin tuanu in, vun atna hangin "Sisan tawh ka pasal na hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua laitakin { Topa } in Aaron kiangah, "Moses a dawn dingin sehnel gamah pai in," ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah pai-in, Pasian' mualah Moses dawnin a nam hi.
{ Topa } in amah a sawlna thute khempeuh leh ama sep dinga a sawl limte khempeuh Moses in Aaron' tungah a gen hi.
Tua ciangin Moses leh Aaron pai-in Israel upate khempeuh a kaikhawm uh hi.
{ Topa } in Moses kianga a gensa thute khempeuh Aaron in gen a, Moses in mite' muhna-ah na lamdangte a lak hi.
Mite in um uh hi. Israel mite kiangah { Topa } hawhin, amau' thuaknate amah in a muh khitna thu amaute in a zak uh ciangin, amaute in a lu uh kunin Pasian a bia uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Faro' kiangah Moses leh Aaron pai-in, "Israel Pasian { Topa } in hih bangin ci hi: 'Amaute in sehnel gamah kei-a' dingin pawi khat a kham theihna dingun ka mite paisak in,' ci hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Faro in, "Ama thu mangin Israel mite ka paisakna dingin { Topa } na cih uh kua ahi hiam? { Topa } na cih uh ka thei kei hi. Tua thamloin Israel-te ka paisak kei ding hi," na ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Hebru-te' Pasian ko kiangah hong kilangzo hi. Hong thum ung; amah in natna ahih kei leh namsau tawh kote hong hihkha ding ahih manin, ni thum paina sehnel gamah kote hong paisakin, { Topa } ka Pasian uh' tungah biakna hong piasak in," a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Egypt kumpipa in amaute kiangah, "Moses leh Aaron aw, bang hangin amau' nasepna panin mite paikhiasak ding na hi uh hiam? Na nasepnate uhah pai un," na ci hi.
"Tumasiah-a bangin, leiseek bawlna dingin mite tungah buhtu na pia nawn kei ding uh hi. Amaute paisak un la, amau mah buhtu khawmsak tawm un.
Ahih hangin tumasiah-a a leiseek bawlzah mah uh amaute na bawlsak ding uh hi. Bangbang hita leh na khiam kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute thadah uh hi. Tua ahih manin amaute kiko-in, 'Kote hong paisakin ka Pasian uh tungah biakna hong piasak un' ci uh hi.
Amaute in na semin zuau thute a donlohna dingin mihingte tungah nasep haksa zaw suan un," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin nasem ukte leh nasem mapite paikhia-in mite tungah, "Faro in hih bangin ci hi: 'Note buhtu kong pia kei ding hi.
Note pai un la, na muhna peuhpeuh uhah na buhtu ding uh va zong tawm un. Ahih hangin na nasep ngeizah uh themkhat zong hong kikhiamlo ding hi,' ci hi," a ci uh hi.
Israel mi nasem mapi, Faro' nasem ukte in amaute a uk dingin a koih sawn mite kisatin, "Bang hangin tu ciangdong, leiseek bawl ding na nasep khempeuh uh hih khin nailo na hi uh hiam?" ci-in kidong hi.
Na nasemte tungah buhtu hong kipialo hi. Ahi zongin amaute in ko tungah, 'Leiseek bawl un!' hong ci hi. En in, na nasem kote hong kisat hi. Hih thu-ah nangma mite khialzaw hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin amah in, "Note na thadah uh hi, note na thadah uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin note in, 'Hong paisak un la, { Topa' } tungah biakna hong piasak un,' na ci uh hi.
Tu-in pai un la na sem un. Bang hang hiam cih leh note buhtu hong kipialo ding a, ahi zongin leiseek a mal ngeina zah mah na piakhia ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Amaute in, "Bangbang hita leh nisimin leiseek na seek zah uh khiamlo ding," a cih ciangin, amaute thu haksapi sungah om ahihlam uh Israel mi nasem mapite in mu uh hi.
Amaute Faro kiang panin a paikhiat ciangun, amaute a na ngak Moses leh Aaron tawh kituak uh hi.
Amaute in, "{ Topa } in note hong enin thu hong khen hen. Bang hang hiam cih leh Faro leh a nasemte' muhna-ah kote a khial nong suaksak uh a, kote hong kithah theihna dingin thu a zong na hi uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa' } lamah Moses kihei kikin, "{ Topa } aw, bang hangin nangmah in hih mite tungah siatna bawl na hi hiam? Bang hangin kei hong sawl peuhmah na hi hiam?

Ahih hangin { Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Tu-in Faro' tungah ka bawl ding na mu ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in utlopipi-in amaute sawlkhia ding hi. Amah in utlopipi-in ama leitang panin amaute hawlkhia taktak ding hi," a ci hi.
Pasian in Moses kiangah, "Kei pen { Topa } ka hi hi.
Abraham, Isaac, leh Jakob-te' tungah Vanglian Pasian-in ka kilang a, ahih hangin { Topa } ahi keima min tawh amaute' tungah kei ka kitheisak kei hi.
Amaute tawlkhat sung a ten'na leitang ahi Kanaan gam amaute' tungah piak dingin amaute tawh ka thuciamna zong ka kipsak hi.
Tua thamloin Egypt mite in salin a neih Israel mite' thumna ka zazo a, ka thuciamna ka phawkzo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel mite' tungah, 'Kei pen { Topa } ka hi hi. Egypt mite' na na sepna uh panin note kong paikhiatpih ding hi. Amau' sal hihna panin note kong khahkhia ding a, a thahat ka khut zanin thukhenna nasep lian tawh note kong honkhia ding hi.
Keima mi dingin note kong la ding a, kei pen note' Pasian ka hi ding hi. Egypt mite' sila hihna panin note a hong paikhiatpihpa, { Topa } na Pasian uh ka hihna note in na thei ding uh hi.
Abraham, Isaac, leh Jakob-te' tunga ka ciam leitangah note kong paipih ding hi. Tua leitang na neih dingun note' tungah kong pia ding hi. Kei pen { Topa } ka hi hi, ci hi,' ci in," a ci hi.

Ahih hangin { Topa } in Moses leh Aaron tungah thu gen a, Egypt gam panin Israel mite a paikhiatpih dingin note ka hong sawlna thu, Israel mite leh Egypt kumpipa Faro' tungah va gen un, ci-in a hanthawn hi.
Hihte pen amau' beh lutangte ahi hi: Israel' ta a suak masa Reuben' tapate: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron, leh Karmi ahi hi. Hihte pen Reuben-te beh ahi hi.
Simeon' tapate: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakhin, Zohar, leh Kanaan numei' tapa Shaul ahi hi. Hihte pen Simeon-te beh ahi hi.

Kohath' tapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, leh Uzziel hi a, Kohath kum za leh kum sawmthumlethum nungta hi.
Merari' tapate: Mahli leh Mushi ahi hi. Hihte pen amau' khang tawh kizui-in Levi-te beh ahi hi.

Uzziel' tapate: Mishael, Elzafan, leh Sithri ahi hi.

{ Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Egypt gamsung khempeuh-a mihing leh ganhing leh gamlak kungte khempeuh tungah gialpi a kiat theihna dingin vantung lamah na khut zan in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in vantung lamah a ciangkhut a zan hi. { Topa } in van gingsakin gialpi kiasak a, leitungah keek kia suk hi. { Topa } in Egypt gam sungah gialpi zusak hi.
Egypt gam minam khat a suah khit-a kipanin tua bang a om ngeilo, a tam mahmah gialpi leh gialpi lakah khua phia-in keek ging om tawntung hi.
Gialpi in Egypt gam sunga a om mihing leh ganhing, na khempeuh deenggawp hi. Gialpi in gamlak kung khempeuh deenggawp a, gamlak singkung khempeuh deengtan hi.

Amaute in Moses kiangah, "Egypt-ah han a omloh manin sehnel gam sungah a si dingin kote hong paikhiatpih na hi hiam? Egypt panin paikhiatpihna tawh kote' tungah bang hong bawl na hi hiam?
'Kote hong hici omsak in la, Egypt mite' na hong semsak in,' ci-in Egypt-ah nang' tungah hong gen hilo ka hi uh hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh sehnel gamah sih sangin Egypt mite' na sep ding kote-a' dingin hoihzaw ding hi," a ci uh hi.

{ Topa } in note-a' dingin hong dosak ding a, note ahih leh na om hithiat ding uh hi bek hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Bang hangin kei' tungah hong kiko na hi uh hiam? Israel mite mai nawtin a pai ding uh gen in.

Amau' nungah Egypt mite hong pai-in, keimah in Faro leh a mihonpite khempeuh, a leengte, leh a sakol tung tuangte ka zawhna hangin minthan'na ka ngahna dingin keimah in Egypt mite' lungsim ka khauhsak ding hi.
Faro leh ama leengte leh ama sakol tung tuangte ka zawhna hangin minthan'na ka ngah khit ciangin { Topa } ka hihna thu Egypt mite in hong thei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mihonpite' mai-ah a pai Pasian' vantung mi kikhinin amaute' nungah a pai hi. Amaute' mai panin meii khuam kikhinin amaute' nungah ding a,

Tua ciangin Moses in tuipi tungah a khut zan hi. { Topa } in zan tawntung nisuahna huihpi hat tawh tuipi mutgawpin, tuipi pen lei keu-in bawl a, tuite a kikhen hi.
Israel mite, tuipi laizang lei keu tungah pai uh a, amau' taklam leh veilamah kawm bangin tuite om hi.
Egypt mite ahi, Faro' sakol khempeuh, ama leengte, leh ama sakol tung tuangte in delhin tuipi laizang amaute' nungah pai uh hi.
Zingsang ciangin { Topa } in mei leh meii khuam sung panin Egypt mihonpite en sukin, Egypt mihonpite phialgawp a,
amau' leengpeite gumsak ahih manin man bekbakin hawl uh hi. Egypt mite in, "Israel mite' kiang panin tai ni. Bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt mite hong langpangin { Topa } in amau-a' dingin hong do hi," a ci uh hi.

Nangmah in ama-a' dingin meivak sagihte na bawl ding a, ama omna mai teng khua a vaksak dingin meivakte kikoih ding hi.
Kham citak tawi sawmnih leh tawi khat val a gik tawh hih nazatte khempeuh kibawl ding hi.
"Tua thamloin a kopin a kikhuk khau hoih tawh a kigan dalna puan sawm leh a dum, a dupsan, leh a ausan khau a kigan puan tawh biakbuk na bawl ding hi. Hoihtakin a kibawl kherub-te tawh tuate na bawl ding hi.
Dalna puan a dung pi sawmli leh pi nih hi ding a, dalna puan a vai pi guk hi ding hi. Dalna puan khempeuh kikim ciat ding hi.
Biakbuk pen bup khat a suah theihna dingin nangmah in kham kilhna sawmnga bawlin, tua kilhnate tawh dalna puan khatlekhat na kimatsak ding hi.
"Biakbuk a tung khuhna dingin keelmul tawh puante zong na bawl ding a, puan sawmlekhat na bawl ding hi.
Tua puan a dung pi sawmlilenga, a vai pi guk ciat hi ding a, puan sawmlekhatte kikim ding hi.
Tua pen bup khat a suah theihna dingin nangmah in sumngo kilhna sawmnga bawlin, a bilvangte' sungah tua kilhnate guangin, puanbuk na kimatsak ding hi.
Puanbuk puan a dunglam, pangkhatah pi khat leh alang, a pang langkhatah pi khat leh alang a val pen biakbuk a khuh dingin hih lampang leh hua lampangte-ah kaisuk ding hi.
"A kisansak tuutal vunte leh keelvunte tawh puanbuk khuhna khat na bawl ding hi.
"Biakbuk-a' dingin a po to ding khuampeekte singkha sing na bawl ding hi.
A khuampeek khat a tun' pi sawmlenga hi ding a, a vai pi nih leh letmat thum vive hi ding hi.
A bulhna dingin a khuampeek khatah a zang nih ciat om ding hi. Biakbuk khuampeek khempeuh tua bangin na bawl ding hi.
Biakbuk khuampeekte na bawl ding hi: Leitaw lam pang-a dingin khuampeek sawmnih hi ding hi.
A khuampeek sawmnihte' bulah bullen sawmli ngun tawh na bawl ding a, a zang nihte-a' dingin khuampeek khat bulah bullen nih, a khuampeek dang khat bulah adang nihte-a' dingin bullen nih mah hi ding hi.
Biakbuk a pang nihna lam, leilu lam panga a khuampeek sawmnihte leh
ngun tawh kibawl a bullen sawmlite-a' dingin, khuampeek khatah bullen nih, adang khuampeek khat bulah bullen nih mah hi ding hi.
Nitumna lam, biakbuk nung lam-a dingin khuampeek guk na bawl ding hi.
Biakbuk nunglam kiute-a' dingin khuampeek nih na bawl ding hi.
Tuate a bul lamah kikak ding a, ahih hangin a kual masa-ah a dawn kimat ding hi. A nihin tua bang hi ding a, tuate in a kiu nihte piangsak ding uh hi.
Ngun tawh kibawl amau' bullen sawmlegukte-a' ding a khuampeek giat pha ding a, khuampeek khatah bullen nih ciat om ding hi.
Biakbuk pangkhat-a khuampeek-a' ding zawl nga, biakbuk a pang langkhat-a khuampeek-a' dingin zawl nga, nitumna lam biakbuk nung lam panga a khuampeekte-a' dingin zawl nga hi ding hi.
Kongpuankhai-a' dingin singkha khuampi nga bawlin kham tawh na zut ding hi. A vankhainate kham hi ding a, tuate-a' dingin sumngo bullen nga na bawl ding hi.
"Biakna tau ding singkha sing tawh bawl in. Pi sagih leh alang sau-in pi sagih leh alang mah na zaisak ding hi. Biakna tau a ning kikim ding a, a tun' pi li leh alang hi ding hi.
Ama-a' dingin vut koihna ding beelte leh kawbiate, kuangte, sikkate leh vutluahna peekte na bawl ding a, a nazat khempeuh sumngo tawh na bawl ding hi.
Ama-a' dingin siklen, a vang simsiam zong sumngo tawh na bawl ding hi. Siklen tung, a kiu lite-ah sumngo kual li na bawl ding hi.
Siklen in biakna tau kimciang a batsuk theihna dingin biakna tau zawl nuai panin na bulh ding hi.
Biakna tau-a' dingin singkha sing zawlte bawlin sumngo tawh tuate na zut ding hi.
Singpekte tawh kuak nei-in biakna tau na bawl ding a, mualtunga nang tungah hong kilaksa bangin kibawl ding hi.
"Biakbuk tual na bawl ding hi. A tual in leitaw lam pangah pang khat-a' dingin pi za leh sawmnga a sau, a kopin a kikhuk khau hoih tawh a kigan a kikhai suk dalna puan nei ding hi.
A khuam sawmnih leh a bullen sawmnih pen sumngo tawh a kibawl hi ding a, ahih hangin khuampi tunga vankhainate leh a gaknate pen ngun tawh a kibawl hi ding hi.
Leilu lampanga ding zong a sauna tua bangmah hi-in, a kikhai suk dalna puan pi za leh sawmnga sau ding a, a khuam sawmnih leh a bullen sawmnih pen sumngo tawh a kibawl hi ding hi. Ahi zongin khuampi tunga vankhainate leh a gaknate pen ngun tawh a kibawl hi ding hi.
Nitumna lam pangah buktual a vailam-a' dingin khuampi sawm leh bullen sawmte tawh pi sawmsagih leh nga a sau a kikhai suk dalna puan om ding hi.
A mailam, nisuahna lam buktual a vailam pi sawmsagih leh nga hi ding hi.
Kongpi pang khat-a ding a kikhaisuk dalna puan pi sawmnihlenih leh alang hi ding a, khuampi thum leh bullen thumte tawh hi ding hi.
A pang langkhatah a kikhaisuk dalna puan pen pi sawmnihlenih leh alang hi ding a, khuampi thum leh bullen thumte tawh hi ding hi.
Buktuala kongpi dingin a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khau a kopin a kikhuk khau hoihte tawh a kigan, phim tawh kikhui-in a kizem, pi sawmthum a sau kongpuankhai khat om ding a, tua in khuampi li leh bullen li nei ding hi.
Buktual a dung pi za leh sawmnga, a vai pi sawmsagih leh nga, a san'na pi sagih leh alang hi-in, a kopin a kikhuk khau hoih tawh a kigan a kikhaisuk dalna puan leh sumngo bullente tawh hi ding hi.
Biakbuk nazat ding peuhmahte leh a khetphimte khempeuh leh buktuala khetphimte khempeuh sumngo tawh a kibawl hi ding hi.
"Meivak a kuangin a om tawntung theihna dingin mei-a vak ding oliv gah a kisuzan, sathau siangtho, Israel mite in nang kiangah hong paipihna dingun thu na pia ding hi.
Kikhopna buk sung, thuciamna singkuang mai-a dalna puan pualamah, Aaron leh ama tapate in nitak-a kipan zingsang dong { Topa' } mai-ah vil ding uh hi. Tua pen Israel mite in amau' khang tawntungin a zuih ding uh ngeina kip khat hi ding hi.
"Tua ciangin keima tungah siampi na a sem dingin Israel mite lak panin na sanggampa Aaron leh a tapate Nadab leh Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar, nangma kiangah la in.
Minthan'na leh hoihna tawh a kidimna dingin na sanggampa Aaron-a' ding biakna puan siangtho na bawl ding hi.
Keima siampi nasepna-ah amah a ap theihna dingun amaute in Aaron' puante a bawlna ding, hih theihna lungsim ka guatsa, siamna a nei mite khempeuh tungah gen in.
Amaute' bawl ding puante: Awmdal khat, siampipuan khat, puantualpi khat, sikli nei-a a gial puantungsilh khat, dialpi khat leh kawnggak khat ahi hi. Keima tungah siampi na a sem ding na sanggampa Aaron leh ama tapate-a' dingin amaute in biakna puan siangthote bawl ding uh hi.
Amaute in kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute leh a kopin a kikhuk tawh a kigan puan hoihte sang ding uh hi.
"Amaute in siampipuan pen, kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute leh a kopin a kikhuk a kigan puan hoihte tawh bawl ding uh a, hoihtakin a kibawl hi ding hi.
A kizop khawm theihna dingin a mong nihte-ah a kimat liangkaihna puan nih nei ding hi.
Amah a gak dingin hoihtakin a kigan tua tunga puan om pen, kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute leh a kopin a kikhuk puan hoihte tawh kibawlin, a sepna zia leh a nate a kibang hi ding hi.
Kizepna a bawlpa in min gelhna a bawl bangin Israel tapa sawmlenihte' minte suang nihte tungah na gelh ding hi. Tuate pen kham-a zepna tawh na um ding hi.
Israel tapate phawkna suang dingin siampipuan' liangkaih puan tungah tua suang nihte na bulh ding hi. Aaron in ama liangko nihte tungah phawkphawk dingin { Topa' } mai-ah amaute' min pua ding hi.
"Hoihtakin a kibawl thukhenna awmdal khat na bawl ding hi. Siampipuan a kibawl bangmahin na bawl ding hi. Kham, a dum, a dupsan, a ausan tuumul khaute leh a kopin a kikhuk puan hoih tawh na bawl ding hi.
Tua sungah suang gual li-in na bulh ding hi. Sardis suang, topaz suang, leh karbankal suang gual khat pen a gual masa hi ding hi.
A gual nihna-ah emerald suang, sapfaia suang, leh diamond suang hi ding hi.
A gual thumna-ah jakinth suang, agate suang, leh amethyst suang hi ding hi.
A gual lina-ah beryl suang, onik suang, leh jasper suang hi ding a, kham tawh zepna sungah tuate kibulh ding hi.
Israel tapate' min tawh kituakin amaute' min a omna suang sawmlenih om ding hi. Tuate pen minam sawmlenihte-a' dingin amau' min ciat kigelhin, min gelhna tawh kibang ding hi.
Awmdal-a dingin khau tawh a kibang, a kihual kham citak khainiang na bawl ding hi.
Awmdal-a dingin kham kual nih na bawl ding a, awmdal mongah tua kualte na bulh ding hi.
Awmdal mong-a kual nihte sungah kham khau nihte na khum ding hi.
Khau mong nihte zepna tawh na zom ding a, siampipuan' liangkaih puan mailamah tua bangin na zom ding hi.
Hoihtakin a kigan siampipuan' khau tungah a om theihna ding leh siampipuan tung panin awmdal a kol theihlohna dingin amaute in siampipuan' kualah khaudum khatin a kual tawh gakkhawm ding uh hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin { Topa' } mai-ah phawk tawntungna dingin amaute a paipih dingin siangtho munah amah a pai ciangin, Aaron in ama lungtang tunga om thukhenna awmdal sungah Israel tapate' min pua ding hi.
Thukhenna awmdal sungah Urim leh Thummim na koih ding a, { Topa' } mai-ah a pai ciangin Aaron' lungtang tungah tuate om ding hi. Tua bangin Aaron in ama lungtang tungah Israel mite' thukhenna { Topa' } mai-ah pua tawntung ding hi.
Puan ngawng bangin a kikek lohna dingin a ngawng kimkotah a kigan tawh a kizim, lutang thawl a vang nei ding hi.
puantualpi mong kimkotah kham long leh mang kawlsing gah, kham long leh mang kawlsing gah cih bangin na kihelhsak ding hi.
Aaron in biakna na a sep ciangin tua puan silh ding a, amah a sih khak lohna dingin { Topa' } mai a siangtho munah a tum ciang leh a pusuah ciangin a gingte kiza ding hi.
"Nangmah in kham citak tawh a peek khat na bawl ding a, min gelhna a kibawlte mah bangin tua tungah, '{ Topa}-a' ding siangtho,' ci-in na gelh ding hi.
Tua pen, khaudum khat tawh dialpi tungah na gak ding a, dialpi mailamah om ding hi.
Tua pen Aaron' taltangah om ding a, Israel mite in letsong siangtho a piakna uh ahi, a siangtho biakpiakna-ah mawhna a om peuhmah Aaron in ama tungah pua ding hi. { Topa' } mai-ah amaute a kisan' theihna dingin ama taltang tungah tua a peek om tawntung ding hi.
"A puantungsilh ding pen khau hoih tawh sik li nei, a gialin na gan ding hi. Khau hoih tawh dialpi khat na bawl ding a, phim tawh kikhui-in a kizem kawnggak khat na bawl ding hi.
"Aaron' tapate-a' dingin puantungsilhte, kawnggakte, leh lukhute na bawl ding a, minthan'na leh hoihna tawh a kidimna dingin tuate na bawl ding hi.
Amaute in keima tungah siampi na a sep theihna dingun na sanggampa Aaron leh a tapate na silhsak ding a, amaute sathau nilhin, nasem dingin kipsakin, na siangthosak ding hi.
A ci guakin a omna uh a tuam dingin amau-a' dingin puan hoihte tawh pheituamte na bawlsak ding a, tuate in kawng panin phei ciang ban ding hi.
Kikhopna bukah amaute a pai ciang uh ahi a, siangtho munah nasem dingin biakna tau nai-ah a pai ciang uh ahi zongin, Aaron leh ama tapate in tuate a silh ding uh hi. Tua hi kei leh amaute in amau tung mahah mawhna a kisuan tawm suakin si ding uh hi. Hih pen amah leh ama khit ciangin a suanlekhakte-a' dingin a om tawntung ngeina kip khat hi ding hi.
"Amaute in keima tungah siampi na a sep theihna dingun amaute na sian'thosakna dingin amaute' tungah na hih ding thute: Bawngtalno khat leh a sitbaanglo tuutal nih,
leh silngo sawhloh anlum, sathau a kihel silngo sawhloh mohte, sathau tawh a kizut silngo sawhloh mohphengte la in. Tuate pen mangbuhnel tawh na bawl ding hi.
Lawh khat sungah tuate koihin tuate a lawhin paipihin, a bawngtal leh a tuutal nih zong na paipih ding hi.
"Kikhopna buk kongkhakah Aaron leh a tapate na paipih ding a, tui tawh amaute na sil ding hi.
Nangmah in puante la-in, puantungsilh leh siampi puantualpi, siampipuan leh awmdal, Aaron silhsakin, hoihtakin a kigan siampipuan gakna tawh amah na gak ding hi.
kawnggakte tawh amaute gakin, amau' lu tungah a lukhute uh na gak ding hi. Siampi nasepna pen a kip tawntung ngeina ahih manin amau-a' hi ding hi. Tua bangin Aaron leh a tapate na kipsak ding hi.
{ Topa' } mai, kikhopna buk kongkhakah nangmah in a bawngtal na go ding hi.
A gilpi tuam a thau khempeuh leh a sin tunga a utok leh a kal nihte leh a kal tuam a thau na la ding a, biakna tau tungah tuate na hal ding hi.
Ahih hangin bawngtal sa leh a vun leh a ekte, giahphual pua lamah mei tawh na hal ding hi. Tua pen khialhna hanga biakna ahi hi.
"Tua ciangin nangmah in tuutalte khat la-in, Aaron leh a tapate in tuutal lu tungah amau' khut nga ding uh a,
Tua ciangin tuutal semnen-in, a sungkua leh a khete silin, a sabakte leh a lu tawh tuate koihin,
biakna tau tungah tuutal a bupin na hal ding hi. Tua pen { Topa' } tungah meihal biakna hi a, a gim namtui, { Topa' } tungah mei tawh kihal biakna ahi hi.
"Nangmah in tuutal adang khat na la ding hi. Aaron leh a tapate in tua tuutal lu tungah amau' khut nga ding uh a,
nangmah in tuutal go-in, a si tawmkhat la-in Aaron' taklam bil dawn leh ama tapate' taklam bil dawnte leh amau' taklam khutpi dawnte leh amau' taklam khepi dawnte nuhin, si a omlai teng biakna tau kiimah na theh ding hi.
Tua ciangin biakna tau tunga a om si tawmkhat leh nilh sathau la-in Aaron leh ama puante tung leh a tapate leh a puante tungah na theh ding hi. Tua ciangin amah leh a puante leh a tapate leh a puante a siangtho hi ding hi.
"Nangmah in tuutal thau, a mei, a gilpi tuam a thau, a sin pan a utok, a kal nihte, a kal tuam a thau, leh a taklam phei (bang hang hiam cih leh tuate pen kipsakna tuutal ahi hi)
leh { Topa' } mai-ah a om silngo sawhloh anlum lawh sung panin anlum khat, sathau tawh a kibawl anlum bek khat, leh moh pheng khat na la ding hi.
Hihte khempeuh Aaron' khutsung leh a tapate' khutsungah na koih ding a, { Topa' } mai-ah vei-a piak dingin na vei ding hi.
Tua ciangin amau' khutsung panin tuate na la ding a, { Topa' } mai-ah a gim namtui dingin biakna tau tungah mei tawh kihal biakna banah na hal ding hi. Tua pen { Topa' } tungah mei tawh kihal biakna ahi hi.
"Nangmah in Aaron a kikipsakna tuutal sa-iik la-in { Topa' } mai-ah vei-a piak dingin na vei ding hi. Tua pen nangma tanh hi ding hi.
"Kipsakna sa pen Aaron leh ama tapate-a' ding ahih ciangin, kipsakna tuutal panin a kipia, a kivei siampite' tanh a phei leh vei-a piak sa-iikte na siangthosak ding hi.
Tua pen Aaron leh ama tapate-a' dingin Israel mite' tung panin a kaih tawntung ding uh ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh thunuama amau' biakna panin Israel mite in a piak ding siampite' tanh ahi hi. Tua pen { Topa' } tungah amau' piak ahi hi.
"Aaron' biakna puan siangthote pen ama sih khit ciangin a tapate' tungah kipia ding a, amaute sathau kinilhin a kikipsakna ding ahi hi.
Aaron leh a tapate in kikhopna buk kongkhakah tuutal sa leh lawh sunga om anlum ne ding uh hi.
Amaute in amaute a kikipsakna ding leh a siangthosak dingin kilemna a kibawlna tua ante ne ding uh a, ahih hangin a pualam mi in tuate ne theilo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tuate pen a siangtho biakna an ahi hi.
Kipsakna sate khat peuhpeuh ahi a, anlum ahi zongin, zingsang ciangdong a omlai leh nangmah in a omlaite mei tawh na hal ding hi. Tuate pen biakna an siangtho ahih manin kinelo ding hi.
"Tua bangin nang kong thupiakte khempeuh tawh kituakin Aaron leh ama tapate' tungah na hih ding a, ni sagih sung tawntung amaute ki-apna na bawl ding hi.
Kilemna dingin mawhna hanga biakna-in ni simin bawngtal khat na pia ding hi. Siangtho sakna dingin sathau na nilh ciang leh kilemna na bawl ciangin biakna tau-a' dingin khialhna hanga biakna khat zong na pia ding hi.
Biakna tau-a' dingin ni sagih sung kilemna bawlin na siangthosak ding hi. Tua ciangin biakna tau a siangtho pen suak ding a, tua biakna tau a lawng peuhpeuh a siangtho suak ding hi.
Tuuno a masa tawh annel lawh khat leh a oliv thau hai khat tawh a kihel leh tuibuah dingin leenggahzu hai khat hi ding hi.
Tuuno adang khat nitakin na pia ding a, zingsanga mah bangin a gim namtui ding, { Topa' } mai-ah mei tawh kihal biakna-in an tawh biakna leh tuibuah tawh na pia khawm ding hi.
Nang tunga thu kong genna ding, nang tawh ka kituahna ding mun, { Topa' } mai kikhopna buk kongkhakah na khang tawntungun a kipia tawntung ding meihal biakna hi ding hi.
Keimah in kikhopna buk leh biakna tau ka siangthosak ding a, keima siampi na a sem dingin Aaron leh a tapate zong ka siangthosak ding hi.
Amaute' lakah keimah ka ten'na hangin Egypt leitang panin amaute a paikhiatpih { Topa } amau' Pasian ka hihna amaute in hong thei ding uh hi. Kei pen { Topa } amau' Pasian ka hi hi.
"Nangmah in paknamtui halna ding biakna tau khat, singkha sing tawh na bawl ding hi.
A dung pi khat leh alang, a vai zong pi khat leh alang mah hi ding hi. A kikim sikli nei hi ding a, a san'na pi thum hi ding hi. A kite a tak tawh sakhat hi ding hi.
Nangmah in kham citak tawh a tung leh a pang kimkot leh a kite na zut ding a, a kimkotah kham tawh a geihual na bawl ding hi.
Tua biakna tau-a' dingin kham kual nih na bawl ding hi. A geihual nuai a kigal sai a pang tuakah tuate na bawl ding a, a puakna ding zawlte a khumna ding hi ding uh hi.
Nangmah tawh ka kituahna ding mun, thuciamna tunga a om hehpihna tokhom mai, thuciamna singkuang kiangah a om dalna puan mai-ah biakna tau na koih ding hi.
Aaron in nitakin zong meivakte a koih ciangin tuate hal ding a, na khang tawntungun { Topa' } mai-ah a namtui hi tawntung ding hi.
Tua tungah a siangtholo paknamtui hita leh, meihal biakna hita leh, an tawh biakna hita leh na pia kei ding hi. Tua tungah tuibuah na sung kei ding hi.
Aaron in kilemna dingin khialhna hanga biakna si a kite tungah kum khatin khatvei zut ding hi. Amah in na khang tawntungun kum khatin khatvei kilemna bawl ding hi. Tua pen { Topa' } tungah a siangtho pen ahi hi," a ci hi.
"Israel mite a phazah na sim ciangin amau' lakah gimna a tun' lohna dingin, a milip in a kitatkhiatna uh { Topa' } tungah pia ding uh hi.
Mi simna-ah a kihel mi peuhmah in biakinn shekel tawh kituakin shekel lang (shekel khatah gerah sawmnih om hi), { Topa' } tungah biakna-in pia ding hi.
Mi simna-ah a kihel, kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah peuhmah in { Topa' } tungah biakna pia ding hi.
Note-a' ding kilemna bawlna dingin { Topa } biakna na piak uh ciangin a haute in shekel lang sangin a tamzaw pialo ding a, a zawngte in a tawmzaw pialo ding hi.
Nomau-a' dingin kilemna bawlna ding, { Topa' } mai-ah Israel mite ka phawkna a hisak dingin Israel mite tung panin kilemna sum na la ding a, kikhopna buk nasepna dingin na zang ding hi," a ci hi.
"Kisilna dingin sumngo kuang khat, leh a ngakna ding zong sumngo mah tawh bawl in. Nangmah in kikhopna buk leh biakna tau kikalah na koih ding a, tua sungah tui na koih ding hi.
Kikhopna bukah amaute a pai ciang uh ahi a, { Topa' } tungah mei tawh kihal biakna hal dingin biakna tau nai-ah a pai ciang uh ahi zongin, amaute a sih lohna dingun amaute tui tawh kisil ding uh hi.

"A hoihpen a namtui nate la in. Myrrh paknamtui shekel za nga leh a namtui thaksing tuazah lang, shekel za nih leh sawmnga a gik, leh a khum a namtui paknamtui za nih leh sawmnga,
