Nangmah in tua tawh kikhopna buk leh thuciamna singkuang,
meihal biakna tau a nazat khempeuh tawh, kuang leh a ngakna na zut ding hi.
Tuate a siangtho pen ahih theihna dingin na siangthosak ding a, tuate a lawng peuhmah a siangtho suak ding hi.
Amaute in keima tungah siampi na hong sep theihna dingun Aaron leh a tapate nangmah in sathau nilhin amaute na siangthosak ding hi.
Mi mawkmawkte' pumpi tungah tua sathau kisunglo ding a, tua bangin a kigawm sathau dang na bawl kei ding uh hi. Tua pen a siangtho hi a, note-a' dingin a siangtho hi ding hi.
Tua tawh a kibangin a bawl mi peuhmah ahi a, a pualam mi khatpeuh tuate a nilhsak mi peuhmah ahi zongin ama mite' kiang panin kikhenkhia ding hi, { Topa } in ci hi,' ci in," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in Moses kiangah, "A namtui nate, stakte, onikha, leh galbanum, paknamtui citak tawh a namtui nate (a tamna a kikim ciatin) la in la,
paknamtui bawlte' hih bangin ci sawhin a nin baanglo, biakna paknamtui bawl in.
Nangmah in kimkhat a neu mahmahin na satnen ding a, nang tawh ka kituahna ding kikhopna buk sunga thuciamna mai-ah pawlkhat na koih ding hi. Tua pen nangma-a' dingin a siangtho pen hi ding hi.
A kigawmpih ngei teng tawh na bawl ding paknamtui pen note-a' dingin na bawl kei ding uh hi. Tua pen note-a' dingin { Topa' } tungah a siangtho hi ding hi.
Lim hoihte a geel ding; kham, ngun, sumngo tawh na a bawl ding; siamna nam khempeuhah nasepna ding; bulh ding suangte seekna leh singzep nasep a sem dingin vangliatna, siamna, pilna, theihna, leh khutsiam nasep khempeuh tawh amah ka kidimsak hi.
En in, amah tawh, Dan minam, Ahisamak' tapa Oholiab ka seh khinzo hi. Amaute in nang kong thupiak khempeuh a bawl theihna dingun a hih thei mi khempeuh tungah siamna ka pia khinzo hi.
Amau' sep dingte hih bang ahi hi: Kikhopna buk, leh thuciamna singkuang leh a tunga om hehpihna tokhom leh buksung na khempeuh,
leh amau' siampi nasepna dingin siampi Aaron' puan siangthote leh ama tapate' puante ahi, hoihtakin a kigan puante,
leh siangtho mun-a' dingin nilh sathau leh a namtui paknamtui ahi hi. Ka thupiakte khempeuh tawh kituakin nangmah in na bawl ding hi," a ci hi.
"Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: 'Keima Sabbath ni-in note na tawlnga ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih pen { Topa } ahi keimah in note a hong siangthosak ka hihna na theihna dingun na khang tawntungun keimah leh note' kikalah lim khat hi ding hi.
Sabbath ni-in note na tawlnga ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note-a' dingin a siangtho ahi hi. Tua ni-in a tawlngalo mi peuhmah kithat ding a, tua ni-in na a sem mi peuhmah ama mite' kiang panin kikhenkhia ding hi.
Ni guk sungin nasep kizo ding hi. Ahih hangin a ni sagih ni pen a thupi-a tawlngakna Sabbath ni hi a, { Topa' } tungah siangtho hi. Sabbath ni-in nasep khat peuhpeuh a sem mi peuhmah kithat ding hi.
Ni guk sung teng { Topa } in van leh lei bawlin, a ni sagih ni-in amah tawlnga a, a tha dimsak kik hi. Keimah leh Israel mite' kikalah hih Sabbath ni pen lim khat hi tawntung ding hi, ci hi,' ci in," a ci hi.
Sinai Mual tungah thugenna a man khit ciangin Pasian' khut tawh a kigelh suangpeek ahi thuciamna suangpeek nihte, amah in Moses a pia hi.
Mualtung panin Moses hong tun'suk hahna mite in a theih uh ciangin, Aaron kiangah mite amau mah kikaikhawm tawmin ama kiangah, "Kithawi in; kote' mai-ah a pai ding pasian hong bawlsak in. Egypt leitang panin eite hong paikhiatpih to Moses ahih leh bang suak khin cih i thei kei hi," a ci uh hi.
Aaron in amaute kiangah, "Na zite, na tapate, leh na tanute uh bil tungah a om kham bilbahte sutkhia un la, kei kiangah tuate hong paipih un," a ci hi.
Amah in amaute' tung panin kham saangin, sumtui sun'na sungah sungin, a kisung bawngno khat bawlsak a, tua ciangin mite in, "Israel mite aw, hih pen Egypt leitang panin note hong paikhiatpih to na pasian uh!" a ci uh hi.
Aaron in hih thu a muh ciangin, amah in tua mai-ah biakna tau khat lam a, "Zing ciang pen { Topa}-a' ding pawi bawl ni hi ding hi," ci-in zaksakna a bawl hi.
{ Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Paisuk in; bang hang hiam cih leh Egypt leitang panin nangmah in na paikhiatpih toh mite amau kisiasak uh hi.
Ka thupiakna lampi panin amaute kiheikhia pak uh hi. Amau-a' dingin amaute in a kisung bawngno khat bawlin, tua bia-in a tungah biakna pia uh a, 'Israel mite aw, hih pen Egypt leitang panin note hong paikhiatpih to na pasian uh ahi hi!' ci uh hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Hih mite ka mu zo hi. En in, a lungkhauh mite ahi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in amaute tungah ka sinso-in amaute ka beisak theihna dingin kei guak hong omsak in. Ahi zongin nang ahih leh minam lian khatin kong bawl ding hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Moses in { Topa } ama Pasian tungah thum a, "{ Topa } aw, na vangliatna leh na thahatna tawh Egypt leitang panin na paikhiatpih ahi nangma mite tungah bang hangin sinso ding na hi hiam?
Bang hangin Egypt mite in, 'Mualtungah amaute a that ding leh leitung panin amaute a beisak dingin siatna ngaihsutna tawh amah in amaute paikhiatpih hi,' ci ding uh ahi hiam? A kihtakhuai na hehna daisak in la, na lungsim khelin na mite tungah hih siatna tungsak kei in.
Amaute' tungah nangmahmah kiciamin, 'Na suanlekhakte uh vantung aksi bangin tamsakin, keimah in ka ciamsa hih leitang khempeuh na suanlekhakte uh tungah ka pia ding a, amaute in luah tawntung ding uh hi,' na cihna na nasemte Abraham, Isaac, leh Israel phawk in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in a lungsim khel a, ama mite' tungah a tun'sak ding siatna tungsak nawnlo hi.
Tua ciangin Moses kihei-in, a khutsunga om thuciamna suangpeek nih, a pang langnih tuakah a kigelh suangpeekte tawh mualtung panin a paisuk hi.
A peekte pen Pasian' bawl hi a, a kigelh thute pen suangpeek tungah Pasian' gelh ahi hi.
Joshua in amaute' kiko gamlumna a zak ciangin Moses kiangah, "Giahphualah kido-a gamlumna om hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Moses in, "Tu-a gamlumna pen zawhna kikona aw ahi a, lelhna kikona aw ahi zongin, tua bang pawl hilo hi. Ahih hangin tu-a ka zak pen lasakna awging ahi hi," a ci hi.
Giahphual nai-ah amah tungin bawngno leh lamna a muh phetin, Moses heh mahmah a, amah in ama khutsung panin suangpeekte lawn a, mual bulah tuate a sukham hi.
Moses in Aaron kiangah, "Amaute' tungah khialhna lianpi khat na tun'pihna dingin hih mite in nang' tungah bang hong gen uh ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in keima kiangah, 'Kote' mai-ah a pai ding pasian hong bawlsak in. Egypt leitang panin eite hong paikhiatpih to Moses ahih leh, bang suak khin cih i thei kei hi,' ci uh hi.
Mite a tatkhialhna Moses in a muh ciangin (bang hang hiam cih leh Aaron in amau' maizumna dingin amau' galte' lakah amaute takhial sak hi),
giahphual kongpi sungah Moses ding a, "{ Topa' } lamah kua teng om na hi uh hiam? Kei' kiangah hong pai un," a ci hi. Levi mite khempeuh ama kiangah hong kikaikhawm uh hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, "Israel-te' { Topa } Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: 'A milip in a namsau a pangah tawi-in kongpi khat pan kongpi khat, giahphual khempeuhah pai kawikawi-in, a milip in a sanggampa, a milip in a kikholhpihpa, a milip in a vengpa that hen,' ci hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Moses' thugen bangin Levi mite gamta uh a, tua ni-in mihing tul thum bang si hi.
Moses in, "Note' tungah thupha hong tun' theihna dingin ama tapa leh a sanggamte ciat supna thuakin { Topa' } na sepna dingah tuni-in note na kikipsak tawm uh hi," a ci hi.
A zingsang ciangin Moses in mite kiangah, "Note in khialhna lianpi khat na bawl khin uh hi. Tu-in { Topa' } kiangah kei ka pai ding a, note' khialhna thu-ah kilemna ka va bawl thei khading hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin { Topa' } kiangah Moses paikikin, "Ala, hih mite in khialhna lianpi khat bawl khin uh a, amaute in amau-a' dingin kham pasian khat bawl khin uh hi.
Ahih hangin { Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Kei' tungah hong khial peuhmah, ka laibu panin ka phiat ding hi.
Ahih hangin tu-in pai in; nang' tunga kong gensa munah mite paipih in. En in, na mai-ah ka vantung mi pai ding hi. Ahi zongin ka thukkik ni ciangin amau' khialhna amau' tungah ka thuk ding hi," a ci hi.
Amaute in Aaron' bawlsa bawngno bia uh ahih manin { Topa } in mite' tungah gimna a tungsak hi.
{ Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Hih mun nusia un; Abraham, Isaac, leh Jakob tungah, 'Na suanlekhakte uh tungah ka pia ding hi,' ci-a ka ciam leitangah nangmah leh Egypt leitang panin na paikhiatpih toh mite tawh hih lai panin paito un.
Note' mai-ah vantung mi khat ka sawl ding a, Kanaan mite, Amor mite, Hit mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite, leh Jebus mite ka hawlkhia ding hi.
Bawngnawi leh khuaizu a luan'na leitangah paito un. Ahi zongin note hong sisak khading ka hih ciangin note' lakah kei kong paito kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note mi lungkhauh na hi uh hi," a ci hi.
Mite in hih thusiate a zak uh ciangin amaute thuum uh a, kuamah kizemlo uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Israel mite' tungah hih bangin gen in: 'Note mi lungkhauh na hi uh hi. Note' lakah tomno khat sung hong paito leng, note kong beisak ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin note kong bawlna ding ka theihna dingin note' tung panin na kizepnate uh suahkhia un,' ci in," ci-in gen khinzo hi.
Israel mite in giahphual a sat simin Moses in puanbuk la-in giahphual panin a gamla pekah lam thei zel hi. Amah in tua pen kikhopna buk, ci hi. { Topa' } tungah thu a dong nuam mi peuhmah giahphual pualama om kikhopna bukah paikhia uh hi.
Puanbukah Moses a tum ciangin meii khuam hong kum sukin puanbuk kongkhakah ding a, { Topa } in Moses hopih hi.
Tua bangin, mi khat in a lawmpa a hopih bangin maitang kituahin { Topa } in Moses hopih zel hi. Giahphualah Moses a ciahkik ciangin, Nun' tapa, ama nasem tangval Joshua, puanbukah omlai hi.
Moses in { Topa' } kiangah, "Thei in; nangmah in keima kiangah, 'Hih mite paipihto in,' nong ci hi. Ahih hangin kei tawh nong sawlkhop ding mi kei nong theisak nai kei hi. Ahi zongin nangmah in, 'Na minin nang kong thei a, ka mai-ah maipha zong na mu khin hi,' nong ci khin hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in nang tungah kong thum hi; na muhna-ah maipha ka ngah leh keimah in nang hong thei-in, na muhna-ah maipha ka ngah theihna dingin tu-in nangma geelnate kei hong lak in. Hih minam pen nangma mite ahihna zong ngaihsun in," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Nang tawh kong pai ding a, lungsim tawlngakna hun nang kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Moses in ama kiangah, "Nang nong paipih kei ding leh, hih lai panin kote hong paikhiato sak kei in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh keimah leh nangma mite in nangma muhna-ah maipha ka ngahna uh bang ci-in kithei ding ahi hiam? Leitunga om mi khempeuh tungah keimah leh nangma mite ka tungnun'na uh pen kote tawh nang nong paikhopna hilo ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
{ Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Nangma gensa hih thu mahmah keimah in ka hih ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka muhna-ah nang in maipha na ngahzo a, na minin nang kong thei hi," a ci hi.
Amah in, "Keima hoihna khempeuh na mai-ah ka paisak ding a, na mai-ah keima min, '{ Topa},' cihna ka pulak ding hi. Ka diknopna mite tungah ka dik ding a, ka hehpihnop mite ka hehpih ding hi.
Ahih hangin nangmah in ka maitang na mu thei kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mi in kei hong mu leh tuami nungtalo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua banah { Topa } in, "En in; suang tungah na din'na ding keima kiangah mun khat om hi.
Keima minthan'na vang a pai laitakin suanghawm sungah nang kong koih ding a, kei ka paikhiat mateng ka khut tawh nang kong hum ding hi.
{ Topa } in Moses kiangah, "A masa tawh a kibangin suangpeek nih sui in. Na sukkhap a masa suangpeekte sunga om thute tuate tungah ka gelh kik ding hi.
Kithawi-in Sinai Mual tungah zingsangin hong paito in la, mual dawn tua munah keima kiangah hong kilak in.
Nang tawh kuamah hong paito khawm sak kei in la, mualtung tengah kuamah omsak kei in. Tua mual mai-ah tuuhon ahi a, bawnghon ahi zongin gamta sak kei in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses in a masa bangin suangpeek nih a sui hi. Zingsang ciangin amah tho baihin, { Topa } in amah a thupiaksa bangin Sinai Mual tungah paito a, a khutsungah suangpeek nih a tawi hi.
Meii sungah { Topa } kum sukin tua lai-ah Moses tawh ding a, { Topa } in ama min a pulak hi.
Ama mai-ah { Topa } pai-in, { "Topa}, { Topa}, hehpihna nei-in a dik Pasian; lungduai-in itna kip leh thutakna tawh a dim;
mi tul tampite-a' dingin itna kip a nei; mawhna, thu palsatna leh khialhna maisakin; ahih hangin bangbang hita leh mawhna a khahkhong ngeilo; pate' mawhna tate' tung leh tute' tung, khang thum khang lina dongin a thukpa," ci-in a pulak hi.
Amah in, "Tu-in na muhna-ah maipha ka muh leh, { Topa } aw, kong thum hi; lungkhauh mite ka hita uh zongin kote' kiangah { Topa } hong pai in. Kote' mawhna leh kote' khialhna hong maisak in la, nangma mi dingin kote hong sang in," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in Moses kiangah, "En in, keimah in thuciamna khat ka bawl hi. Nangma mi khempeuh' muhna-ah, leitung khempeuh hita leh minam khatpeuh sungah hita leh cikmahin tua bang a kibawl ngeilo na lamdangte ka bawl ding a, note' lakah a om mite khempeuh in { Topa' } nasepna mu ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note' tungah kong bawl ding na pen a kihtakhuai thu ahi hi.
"Tuni-a kong thupiak zui in. En in, na mai-ah Amor mite, Kanaan mite, Hit mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite, leh Jebus mite ka hawlkhia ding hi.
Na paina leitangah a teng mite tawh thuciamna bawlkha kei in la, tua pen note-a' dingin thangzak a suahkhak lohna dingin nangmahmah kidawm in.
"(Pasian dang na bia kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa}, ama min Aam a hipa pen a aam Pasian ahi hi.)
Nangmah in tua leitangah a teng mite tawh thuciamna bawlkha kei in. Amaute in amau' pasian-te tawh paktatna bawlin amau' pasian-te' tungah biakna pia-in, khatpeuh in note hong sap ciangin, note in ama biakpiakna na ne khading uh a,
note in amau' tanute na tapate uh-a' dingin la-in, amau' pasian-te tawh paktatna a bawl a tanute in amau' pasian-te tawh na tapate uh paktatsak khading uh hi.
"A kisung pasian-te note-a' dingin bawlin na bia kei ding uh hi.
"Silngo sawhloh anlum pawi na bawl ding uh hi. Abib kha, a kisehsa hun sungteng, nang kong thupiak mah bangin ni sagih sung silngo sawhloh anlum na ne ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Abib kha sungin Egypt panin note na paikhia uh hi.
"Mihing leh ganhing tacil a pa khempeuh keima-a' ahi hi.
La a tacilte tuuno khat tawh na tanh ding uh hi. Na tat kei uh leh a ngawng na kuaitan ding uh hi. Na tapa cilte khempeuh uh na tanh ding uh hi. Keima mai-ah a guakin kuamah hong kilaklo ding hi.
"Ni guk sung na na sem ding uh a, ahi zongin a ni sagih ni-in na tawlnga ding uh hi. Lokhawh hun leh anlak hun sungin zong na tawlnga ding uh hi.
"Nipikalte' pawi, mangbuh a tung masa pawi, leh kum bei ciangin an kaihkhop pawi na bawl ding uh hi.
"Pasal khempeuh Israel Pasian, { Topa } Pasian' mai-ah kum khatin thumvei kilak ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh note' mai-ah minam dangte ka hawlkhia ding a, na gamgite uh nomau-a' dingin ka keek ding hi. { Topa } na Pasian uh' mai-ah kum khatin thumvei a kilak dingin na paitoh sungun na leitang uh mi khat peuhpeuh in a hong deihgawh khak ding lunghihmawhna omlo ding hi.
"Note in na anpalte uh lakah a tung masa pen { Topa } na Pasian uh' inn-ah na paipih ding uh hi. "Note in keelno a pi' nawizu tawh na huan kei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Hih thute gelh in. Hih thute tawh kizui-in nang leh Israel tawh thuciamna khat ka bawlzo hi," a ci hi.
Tua lai-ah sun sawmli leh zan sawmli sung { Topa } tawh Moses om a, tua hun sungteng anletui a ne kei hi. Amah in suangpeek tungah thuciamna kammalte ahi thupiak sawmte a gelh hi.
A khutsungah thuciamna suangpeek nih tawh Sinai Mual tung panin Moses hong paisuk ciangin, Pasian tawh amah kiho khin ahih manin a maitang vun a taan' lamtak Moses in theilo hi.
Aaron leh Israel mite khempeuh in Moses a muh ciangin, a maitang vun na taang a, ama mai-ah a pai ding uh amaute lau uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute kiangah Moses pai hi. Aaron leh mihon makaite khempeuh ama kiangah hong paikik uh a, Moses in amaute hopih hi.
Tua khit ciangin Israel mi khempeuh a nai-ah hong pai uh a, { Topa } in Sinai Mual-ah ama tunga a gen khempeuh thupiakna-in amaute tungah a pia hi.
Ahih hangin { Topa } tawh a kiho dingin ama mai-ah Moses a tum peuhpeuh ciangin, amah a pusuah kik mateng a kiliahna puan la khia hi. Amah hong paikhia-in ama tungah a kipia thute Israel mite kiangah a gen ciangin,
Moses in Israel mihonpi khempeuh khawmin amaute kiangah, "Hihte pen note' hih ding { Topa' } hong thupiak ahi hi.
Ni guk sungin nasep kiman ding a, ahih hangin a ni sagih ni-in thupi-a tawlngakna Sabbath siangtho { Topa' } tungah na nei ding uh hi. Tua ni-in na khat peuhpeuh a sem peuhmah kithat ding hi.
Sabbath ni-in na ten'na khempeuh uhah mei na cih kei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Moses in Israel mihonpite khempeuh tungah, "{ Topa' } hong thupiak hih bang ahi hi:
Note in { Topa' } tungah biakna na pia ding uh hi. A pia nuam peuhmah in { Topa' } tungah biakna paipih un. Tuate in: Kham, ngun leh sumngo,
a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute leh a kopin a kikhuk puan hoihte, keelmul,
a kisansak tuutal vunte leh savunte; singkha sing,
meivak-a' ding sathau, nilh sathau leh a paknamtui dingin a namtui nate,
siampipuan leh awmdalah bulh dingin onik suang leh suang dangte ahi hi.
"Note' lak panin siamna a nei mi peuhmah hong paisak un la, { Topa' } thupiaksa khempeuh bawlsak un. Tua a bawl dingte pen biakbuk,
a puanbuk leh a khuhna, a vankhainate leh a khuampeekte, a zawlte, a khuampite, a bullente;
khuavak dingin meivakkhuam zong, a nazatte leh a meivakte tawh, meivak dingin sathau;
paknamtui biakna tau, a zawlte tawh, nilh sathau leh a namtui paknamtui leh biakbuk kongah kongkhak-a' ding puankhai;
buktual-a a puankhaite, a khuampite leh a bullente tawh, tual kongpi-a' ding puankhai;
biakbuk khetphimte leh huang khetphimte, leh a khaute;
siangtho munah zat dingin limtakin a kigan puante, amau' siampi nasepna dingin siampi Aaron-a' ding puan siangtho leh ama tapate' puante ahi hi," a ci hi.
Piak nopna lungsim a nei mi peuhmah hong pai tawm uh a, kikhopna buk leh a nasepna ding khempeuh leh puan siangthote-a zat dingin { Topa}-a' ding a piakte uh hong puak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin numei, pasal hong pai uh hi. Piak nopna lungsim a neite khempeuh in tukkilhte, bilbahte, min gelhna zungbuhte, leh banbulhte ahi kham tawh a kibawl na namkim hong paipih uh a, a milip in { Topa' } tungah kham tawh piakna ap uh hi.
Ngun ahi a, sumngo ahi zongin a pia thei peuhmah in { Topa' } tungah tua nate paipih uh a, nasepna dinga kimang thei ding singkha sing a nei mi peuhmah in zong hong paipih hi.
A hih thei numei khempeuh in a khut uh tawh khau khuk uh a, amau' khuksa a dum, a dupsan, a ausan khaute leh a kopin a kikhuk khaute hong paipih uh hi.
Makaite in siampipuan leh awmdal-a bulh dingin onik suang leh suang dangte,
meivak ding, nilh sathau ding, leh paknamtui dingin a namtui nate leh sathau hong paipih uh hi.
{ Topa } in Moses tunga a thupiaksa nasepna dingin na khat peuhpeuh a pia nuam numei pasal Israel mi khempeuh in utthu-a biakna-in { Topa' } tungah hong paipih uh hi.
Moses in Israel mite kiangah, "Thei un; { Topa } in a minin Judah minam, Hur' tapa Uri, Uri' tapa Bezalel sam khin hi.
Lim hoihte a geel ding; kham, ngun, sumngo tawh na a bawl ding; siamna nam khempeuh nasepna ding, bulh ding suang seekna, leh singzep nasep a sem dingin amah in vangliatna, siamna, pilna, theihna, leh khutsiam nasep khempeuh tawh amah kidimsak hi.
{ Topa } in amah leh Dan minam Ahisamak' tapa Oholiab tungah midangte hilh siamna pia khin hi.

Mi khat a taltang leh a paang panin a sam leh a mul a pulh leh, amah a talkolh hi lel a, amah a siang ahi hi.
Ahih hangin a lutol tung hita leh a talkolh tung hita leh-ah a san kang meima a om leh, tua pen a lutol tung ahih kei leh a talkolh tunga a suakkhia phaknatna ahi hi.
Tua ciangin siampipa in amah vel ding a, a bawk natna pen a lutol tung hita leh a talkolh tung hita leh-ah, pumpi vun tunga phak om tawh kibangin a san kang ahih leh,
"Samul puan hita leh saihadial puan hita leh, puan khat peuhpeuh tungah phaknatna a om ciang,
tua saihadial puan, samul puante, a tung leh a pheite' tung hita leh, savun leh savun tawh a kibawl na khat peuhpeuh tungah a om ciangin,
tua natna pen a hing melin ahi a, a san melin ahi zongin puan tungah a kilat ciang, puan a tung a phei tung hita leh savun leh savun tawh a kibawl na khat peuhpeuh tungah a om ciangin, tua pen phaknatna hi a, siampipa kiangah kilak ding hi.
Siampipa in a natna vel ding a, tua natna a baan'na na pen ni sagih sung koihcip ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a ni sagih ni-in a natna velkik ding hi. A natna pen puan tungah kizelin, puan a tung a phei-ah hita leh, savun leh savun a kizatna na khat peuhpeuh tungah a om leh, tua natna pen a lauhuai phaknatna hi a, a nin ahi hi.
Amah in a puan hal ding hi. Tua natna pen puan a tung a phei-ah hita leh, samul puan saihadial puan hita leh savun tawh a kibawl na khat peuhpeuh tungah a om leh hal ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen a lauhuai phaknatna ahih manin mei sungah kihal ding hi.
"Siampipa in velin, a natna pen puan tung, a tung a phei-ah hita leh, savun tawh a kibawl na khat peuhpeuh tungah a kizelh kei leh,
siampipa in tua natna a ban'na pen amaute in a sawp ding uh thu pia ding a, amah in adang ni sagih sung mah tua na koihcip ding hi.
Siampipa in tua natna a ban'na pen a kisawp khit ciangin vel ding hi. Tua natna a ban'na mun a mel a kikhel kei leh, a natna a kizelh loh hangin tua pen a nin mah ahi hi. Tua natna pen a sunglamah ahi a, a pualamah ahi zongin a baan' leh mei sungah tua puan na hal ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin siampipa in vel a, a kisawp khit ciangin a meima a mualh leh, amah in a puan tung pan hita leh savun tung pan hita leh a puan a tung a phei tung pan hita leh natna a baan'na mun balkhia ding hi.
Tua ciangin a puan tung hita leh puan a tung a phei tungah hita leh savun tawh a kibawl na khat peuhpeuh tungah a kilatkik leh, tua natna a kizel ahih manin natna a baan'na pen mei tawh na hal ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin a puan hita leh puan a tung a phei hita leh savun tawh a kibawl na khat peuhpeuh a kisawp khit ciangin tua natna a paikhiatna na pen, a nih veina kisawp kikin a siang hi ding hi," a ci hi.
Hih pen samul puan hita leh saihadial puan hita leh puan a tung hita leh a phei hita leh, savun tawh a kibawl na khat peuhpeuh tungah a om phaknatna tawh kisai-in siang hiam, nin hiam, ci-in khenna ding ahi hi.
"Hih pen amah a kisian'sak ni-in mi phakpa' zuih ding ngeina hi ding hi. Siampipa kiangah amah kipaipih ding a,
a kisiangsak ding mipa-a' dingin a hing vasa siang nih leh taamtak sing leh a ausan puan leh puknah a la dingin siampipa in amaute sawl ding hi.
Amah in a hing lai vasa pen taamtak sing leh a ausan puan leh puknah tawh la khawmin, tuate leh a hing lai vasa pen tuiluang tunga kithat vasa' si sungah diah ding hi.
Amah in phaknatna panin a kisiangsak dingpa' tungah sagihvei theh ding a, tua ciangin amah siang hi, ci-in gen ding a, a hing vasa pen gamlakah khah ding hi.
A kisiangsak ding mipa in a puante sawpin, a mul khempeuh metkhia-in, tui sungah amahmah kisilin, amah a siang hi ding hi. Tua khit ciangin amah giahphualah hong ciah ding a, ahih hangin ama puanbuk pualamah ni sagih sung om ding hi.
A ni sagih ni-in amah in a sam, a khamul leh a mitkhu mul, leh a pum tungah a om a mul khempeuh metkhia ding hi. Tua ciangin amah in a puante sawpin, tui sungah a pumpi silin, amah a siang hi ding hi.
"A ni giat ni-in amah in a sitbaanglo tuuno a pa nih, leh a sitbaanglo kum khat a pha tuuno a nu khat, leh an tawh biakna ahi sathau tawh annel lawh thum leh sathau biingta khat la ding hi.
Amah a siangsak ding siampipa in a kisiangsak ding mipa leh hih nate, kikhopna bukkonga { Topa' } mai-ah paipih ding hi.
Siampipa in tuuno a pa khat la-in sathau biingta khat tawh mawhna hanga biakna-in pia-in, vei-a biakna-in { Topa' } mai-ah tuate vei ding hi.
Amaute in khialhna hanga biakna leh meihal biakna, siangtho mun sunga a gawhna mun uhah amah in tuuno go ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mawhna hanga biakna pen khialhna hanga biakna mah bangin siampipa-a' hi a, tua pen a siangthopen ahi hi.
Siampipa in mawhna hanga biakna si tawmkhat la-in, tua si pen a kisiangthosak ding mipa' taklam bilteep, a taklam khutpi, leh a taklam khepi nuh ding hi.
Tua ciangin sathau biingta panin kimkhat la-in amahmah' veilam khutsungah sungin,
a veilam khutsunga om sathau sungah a taklam khutme diahin, a khutme tawh a sathau kimkhatte { Topa' } mai-ah sagihvei theh ding hi.
Ama khutsungah a omlai sathau kimkhatte pen siampipa in a kisiangthosak ding mipa' taklam bilteep, a taklam khutpi, leh a taklam khepi nuhin, mawhna hanga biakna si tungah koih ding hi.
Siampipa in a khutsunga sathau omlai teng a kisiangthosak ding mipa' lu nilh ding hi. Tua ciangin siampipa in ama-a' dingin { Topa' } mai-ah kilemna bawlsak ding hi.
"A nitna panin a kisiangthosak ding mipa-a' ding kilemna bawlna dingin siampipa in a khialhna hanga biakna pia ding hi. Tua khit ciangin amah in meihal biakna go ding a,
meihal biakna leh an tawh biaknate, biakna tau tungah pia ding hi. Tua bangin siampipa in ama-a' dingin kilemna bawlsak ding a, amah a siang hi ding hi.
"Ahih hangin amah zawngin tuazah a piakzawh kei leh, ama-a' ding kilemna bawlna dingin a kivei ding, mawhna hanga biakna-in tuuno a pa khat, an tawh biakna dingin sathau tawh a kibawl annel lawh khat leh sathau biingta khat pia ding a,
vakhu nih ahi a, kawl vakhuno nih ahi zongin, a piakzawh bangbang pia ding hi. Khat pen khialhna hanga biakna ding hi a, a khat pen meihal biakna ding ahi hi.
A ni giat ni-in amah in { Topa' } mai, kikhopna bukkong, siampipa kiangah ama kisian'thosakna dingin tuate paipih ding hi.
Siampipa in mawhna hanga biakna tuuno, leh a sathau biingta khat la-in, vei-a biakna-in { Topa' } mai-ah tuate vei ding hi.
Amah in mawhna hanga biakna tuuno go ding hi. Siampipa in mawhna hanga biakna si tawmkhat la-in, a kisiangthosak ding mipa' taklam bilteep, a taklam khutpi, leh a taklam khepi nuh ding hi.
Siampipa in amahmah' veilam khutsungah a sathau kimkhat sung ding a,
a veilam khutsunga a om sathau tawmkhat a taklam khutme tawh { Topa' } mai-ah sagihvei theh ding hi.
Siampipa in ama khutsunga a om sathau tawmkhat a kisiangthosak ding mipa' taklam bilteep, taklam khutpi, leh a taklam khepite, mawhna hanga biakna si a kikoihna munah va nuh ding hi.
Siampipa in a khutsunga a omlai sathau teng a kisiangthosak ding mipa-a' ding { Topa' } mai-ah kilemna bawlna dingin a lu nilhsak ding hi.
Amah in vakhu hita leh kawl vakhuno hita leh, a piakzawh bangbang pia-in,
khat pen khialhna hanga biakna ding, a khat pen meihal biakna dingin an-a biakna tawh pia khawm ding hi. Siampipa in a kisiangthosakpa-a' dingin { Topa' } mai-ah kilemna bawlsak ding hi.
Hih pen phaknatna a vei, a kisiangthosakna dingin biakna a pia zolopa-a' dingin ngeina ahi hi," a ci hi.
"Note-a' dingin kong piak Kanaan gamah na om ciangun note' leitanga inn khat sungah phaknatna kong tun'sak ciangin,
Tua ciangin, inn sunga om na khempeuh a nin hi, a kicih khaklohna dingin a natna a vel dingin siampipa a pai ma-in amaute in tua inn a na hawmsakna ding uh thu pia ding a, tua khit ciangin inn vel dingin siampipa pai ding hi.
natna a baan'na suang lakhia-in khuapi pualam a nin mun khatah a paipihna dingun siampipa in thu pia ding hi.
Amah in tua inn, a sing a suang leh inn a kizutnate khempeuh phel ding a, khuapi pualam a nin mun khatah tuate puakhia ding hi.
Tua thamloin tua inn a kikhakcip sungteng a sungah a lut mipa a nitak dong a nin hi ding hi.
Tua inn sungah a lum mipa leh an a ne mipa in ama puante sawp ding hi.
Tua inn siangthosakna dingin amah in vasa neu nih, taamtak sing leh a ausan khau leh puknah tawh la khawmin,
taamtak sing leh puknah leh a ausan khau pen a vasa hing tawh la khawmin, tua pen a kigo vasa' si leh tuiluang sungah diahin, tua inn sagihvei theh ding hi.
Tua bangin amah in vasa si tawh, tuiluang tawh, a hing vasa tawh, taamtak sing leh puknah leh a ausan khau tawh a inn siangsak ding a,
vasa hing pen khuapi pualam gamlakah khahkhia ding hi. Tua bangin amah in tua inn-a' dingin kilemna bawlsak ding a, tua inn a siang hi ding hi," a ci hi.
puan tung hita leh innsung hita leh-ah a om phaknatna tawh kisai,
a bawk hita leh meima hita leh a tuampian' khat peuhpeuh tawh kisai-in,
bang hunin nin a, bang hunin siang hiam, ci-in lahna ding ahi hi. Hih pen phaknatna tawh kisai ngeina ahi hi.
A natui a paikhia mipa' lupna leh a tutna peuhmah a nin hi ding hi.
A natui a paikhia mipa in a siang mipa' tungah cil a siat leh, tuapa in a puante sawp ding a, amahmah tui sungah kisilin, a nitak mateng a nin hi ding hi.
A natui a paikhia mipa in tui sungah a khut sillopi-in a lawn' mi peuhmah in ama puante sawp ding a, amahmah tui sungah kisilin, a nitak mateng a nin hi ding hi.
A natui a paikhia mipa in a lawn' lei tawh kibawl umlebeelte kisukham ding a, sing tawh kibawl kuanglekeute ahih leh tui sungah kisawp ding hi.
"A natui a paikhia mipa a natui a kan ciangin a kisian'sakna dingin amah in ni sagih sung ngak ding a, tua ciangin a puante sawpin, tuiluang sungah a pumpi sil ding a, a siang hi ding hi.
A ni giat ni-in amah in vakhu nih ahih kei leh kawl vakhuno nih la-in, { Topa' } mai kikhopna bukkongah pai-in, siampipa tungah tuate pia ding hi.
Siampipa in tuate, khat khialhna hanga biakna ding leh adang khat meihal biakna dingin pia ding a, a natui a paikhia mipa-a' dingin siampipa in { Topa' } mai-ah kilemna bawlsak ding hi.
A tungah a natui a tukna puan leh savun peuhmah tui tawh kisawp ding a, a nitak mateng a nin hi ding hi.
Pasal leh numei a lupkhawm khit ciangin, amaute gel tui sungah kisil ding uh a, a nitak mateng a nin hi ding uh hi.
Amah a nit hun sungin a lupna leh a tutna peuhpeuh a nin hi ding hi.
Ama tutna ahi lupna hita leh na khat peuhpeuh hita leh, mi khat in a lawn' ciangin a nitak mateng a nin hi ding hi.
Pasal khat peuhmah tuanu tawh lumin, tuanu' nitna ama tungah a om leh, ni sagih sung tuapa a nin hi ding a, tuapa' lupna peuhmah zong a nin hi ding hi.
"Numei khat in ama nit hun hilo napi-in ni tampi sung a si a suak ahi a, ama nit hun sung khengin nin nei-in ahi zongin a om leh, a ninneih sung khempeuh, ama nit hun sung mah bangin a nin hi ding hi.
Ahih hangin tuanu a nin a bei zawh ni sagih khit ciangin a siang hi ding hi.
A ni giat ni-in tuanu in vakhu nih ahih kei leh kawl vakhuno nih la-in, kikhopna bukkong, siampipa kiangah tuate paipih ding hi.
Siampipa in khialhna hanga biakna dingin khat pia-in, meihal biakna dingin adang khat pia ding hi. Siampipa in ama nitna hangin { Topa' } mai-ah ama-a' ding kilemna bawlsak ding hi.
"Amau' laizanga om ka biakbuk ninsakkha le uh amaute in sihlawh ding uh ahih ciangin, tua bangin note in Israel mite amau' nitna panin siangsakin na kem ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Hih pen a natui a paikhia mipa ahih kei leh a natui tehin, tua tawh mi nin a suakpa-a' dingin ngeina hi a,
nin a neinu-a' ding zong ahi hi. Hihte pen pasal a natui a paikhia mi, ninnei numei leh, a nin neih sungin numei tawh a lumkhawm mipa-a' dingin ngeina ahi hi.
Aaron' tapa nihte in ngeina lopi-in { Topa' } mai-ah mei tawh va pai-in a sihlawh khit uh ciangin { Topa } in Moses kiangah thu a gen hi.
{ Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Thuciamna singkuang tunga om hehpihna tokhom mai, dalna puan sunglam a siangtho munah a hunlopi-in hong pai nawnlohna dingin na sanggampa Aaron kiangah gen in. A hunlopi-in hong pai leh amah si ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua mun pen hehpihna tokhom tunga meii sungah kei ka kilatna mun ahi hi.
Ahih hangin siangtho munah Aaron hong pai ding zia in: Khialhna hanga biakna dingin bawngtalno khat leh meihal biakna dingin tuutal khat hong paipih ding hi.
"Amah in Israel mihonte tung panin khialhna hanga biakna dingin keeltal nih leh meihal biakna dingin tuutal khat la ding hi.
Aaron in amahmah-a' dingin khialhna hanga biakna-in a bawngtal pia-in, amah leh a innkuanpihte-a' dingin kilemna bawl ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in keeltal nih la-in, { Topa' } mai kikhopna bukkongah tuate koih ding hi.
Aaron in tua keel nihte tungah ai saanin, khat pen { Topa}-a' ding, adang khat pen Azazel-a' ding ahi hi.
Aaron in { Topa}-a' ding ai a pha keel paipihin, khialhna hanga biakna-in pia ding hi.
Ahih hangin Azazel-a' dingin ai a pha keel pen gamlakah Azazel' kiangah a kipuak theihna dingin kilemna bawlna dingin a hingin { Topa' } mai-ah kipaipih ding hi.
"Aaron in amahmah-a' dingin khialhna hanga biakna-in a bawngtal pia-in, amah leh a innkuanpihte-a' dingin kilemna bawl ding a, amahmah-a' dingin khialhna hanga biakna-in a bawngtal go ding hi.
Amah in { Topa' } biakna tau panin mei-am a dim paknamtui beel khat leh a kisunen paknamtui khut nih dim la ding hi. Amah in dalna puan sungah paipihin
thuciamna singkuang tungah a om hehpihna tokhom pen paknamtui khu in a tuam theihna dingin { Topa' } mai-ah a om mei tungah a paknamtui koih ding hi. Tua hi kei leh amah si ding hi.
"Tua ciangin amah in mite-a' ding ahi khialhna hanga biakna keel go-in, dalna puan sungah a si paipih ding a, bawngtal si a theh mah bangin a si thehin, hehpihna tokhom tung leh hehpihna tokhom mai-ah theh ding hi.
Amah in tua bangin Israel mite' nitna hang, amau' thu palsatna hang, leh amau' khialhna khempeuh hangin siangtho muna dingin kilemna bawl ding hi. Amah in amau' nitna sungah amau tawh a omkhawm kikhopna buk-a' dingin tua mah bangin a bawl ding hi.
Siangtho munah kilemna bawl dingin amah tumin ama-a' ding, a innkuanpihte-a' ding, leh Israel mihonte khempeuh-a' dingin kilemna a bawl khit hong paikhiat matengin kikhopna buk sungah kuamah omlo ding hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa' } mai-ah a om biakna tau-ah amah va pai-in, biakna tau sian'suahna bawl ding a, bawngtal si leh keel si tawmkhat la-in, biakna tau kimkot-a a kite nuh ding hi.
"Amah in siangtho mun, kikhopna buk, leh biakna tau sian'suahna a bawl khit ciangin, keel hing pen paipih ding hi.
Aaron in keel hing lu tungah a khutte gel nga-in, Israel mite' mawhna, amau' thu palsatna, leh amau' khialhnate khempeuh, keel tungah pulak ding hi. Amah in keel lu tungah tuate suanin, a paikhiatpih dingin a kithawisa mipa tawh sehnel gamah sawlkhia ding hi.
Amah in a siangtho mun khatah, a pumpi tui sungah silin, a puante silh ding a, hong paikhia-in, ama meihal biakna leh mite' meihal biakna pia-in, ama-a' ding leh mite-a' dingin kilemna bawl ding hi.
Azazel' kiangah keel a paisakpa in a puante sawpin, a pumpi tui sungah sil ding a, tua khit ciangin giahphualah hong ciah thei ding hi.
Siangtho munah kilemna bawlna dingin hong kipaipih si a kilakna, khialhna hanga biakna bawngtal leh keel pen giahphual pualamah kipuakhia ding a, a vun, a sa, leh a ekte, mei tawh kihal ding hi.
Tuate a halpa in ama puante sawpin, tui sungah a pumpi sil ding a, tua khit ciangin giahphualah hong ciah thei ding hi.
"Hih pen, a kha sagihna, a ni sawm ni-in note-a' dingin a tawntungin thukham hi ding a, tualsung mi hita leh note lakah a hong peem khualmi hita leh in an tangin, na na sem kei ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh hih ni-in note sian'sakna dingin note-a' ding kilemna kibawl ding a, na khialhna khempeuh panun { Topa' } mai-ah na siang ding uh hi.
Tua pen note-a' dingin a thupi tawlngakna Sabbath hi a, an na tang ding uh hi. Tua pen a tawntunga thukham ahi hi.
Amah in biakbuk sian'suahna bawlin, kikhopna buk leh biakna tau sian'suah ding a, siampite leh mihonte khempeuh-a' dingin kilemna a bawl ding hi.
Hih pen Israel mite-a' dingin amau' khialhnate khempeuh hangin kum khatin khatvei kilemna a kibawlsak theihna dingin note-a' dingin a om tawntung ngeina kip khat hi ding hi," a ci hi. { Topa } in amah a thupiak bangin Moses a gamta hi.

Bang hang hiam cih leh pumpi nuntakna pen si sungah om hi. Note-a' ding kilemna bawlna dingin note-a' dingin biakna tau tungah tua si ka piazo hi. Si pen nuntakna ahih manin kilemna a piangsak na ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin keimah in Israel mite tungah hih bangin ka ci khin hi: Note lakah kuamah in si nelo ding a, note lakah a hong peem khualmi khatpeuh in zong si nelo ding hi.
"Israel mite khatpeuh hita leh, amaute lakah a peem khualmi khatpeuh hita leh in zong, sabetna-ah, a kine thei ding gamsa khatpeuh hita leh vasa hita leh a manpa in a si buakhia-in leivui tawh vuk ding hi.
"A mawk sih hita leh gamsate in a balgawp hita leh a ne mi peuhmah, tualsung mi hita leh peemta hita leh tua mi in a puante sawp ding a, amahmah tui sungah kisilin, a nitak mateng a nin hi ding a, tua khit ciangin amah siang ding hi.
Ahih hangin amah in tuate sawploin ahi zongin, kisil loin ahi zongin a om leh, amah in ama mawhna pua ding hi," a ci hi.
"Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Kei pen { Topa } na Pasian uh ka hi hi.
Note na ten'na uh Egypt gamah amaute a gamtat bangin note na gamta kei ding uh a, note kong paipihna Kanaan gamah zong amaute a gamtat bangin note na gamta kei ding uh hi. Note in amau' gamtatnate na zui kei ding uh hi.
Note in keima biakna ngeina kipte semin ka thukhamte lenin tuate na zui ding uh hi. Kei pen { Topa } na Pasian uh ka hi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in ka thukhamte leh ka biakna ngeina kipte na zui ding uh hi. Tuate a zui mi peuhpeuh nungta ding hi. Kei pen { Topa } ka hi hi.
"Note kuamah in na kinaipih na behte uh mawhpih dingin na naih kei ding uh hi. Kei pen { Topa } ka hi hi.

Nangmah in na pa' zi dangte zong na mawhpih kei ding hi. Tua pen na pa' mindaina ding ahi hi.
Na ni na mawhpih kei ding hi; tuanu pen na pa' sanggam numei ahi hi.
Na pa' sanggampa' tungah mindaina na tun' kei ding hi; tua pen ama zi na naih kei ding hi, cihnopna ahi hi; tuanu pen nangma innlak nu ahi hi.
Na monu na mawhpih kei ding hi; tuanu pen na tapa' zi ahi hi; amah na mawhpih kei ding hi.
Na sanggampa' zi na mawhpih kei ding hi; tua pen na sanggampa' mindaina ding ahi hi.
Na luppih numei khat' tanu na mawhpih kei ding a, tua numei' tapa' tanu hita leh tua numei' tanu' tanu hita leh, luppih dingin na la kei ding hi. Amaute pen nangmah tawh a kinai beh numeite ahi uh hi. Tua bang gamtatna pen a siahuai ahi hi.

Nangmah in Molek tungah meihal biakna-a piak dingin na tate khat peuhpeuh na pia kei ding a, tua bangin na Pasian' min na daisak kei ding hi; keimah pen { Topa } ka hi hi.

tua bang hi kei leh leitang in note' ma-a a om minamte a luakkhiat bangin note in amah na nitsak uh ciangin amah in note hong luakhia ding hi.

"Pasal khatpeuh a vengpa' zi tawh a mawh leh, tua a khialpa leh a khialnu kithat khawm ding hi.

Mi khatpeuh in sawmah khat a piak na khat peuhpeuh a tat nop leh, amah in tua banah nga-ah khat behlap ding hi.
Bawnghon leh tuulekeel hon sawmah khat khempeuh leh a cingpa' ciangkhut nuai-a a pai ganhing khempeuh sawmah khat peuhmah { Topa}-a' dingin a siangtho hi ding hi.
Mi khat in pha hiam sia hiam ci-in kantello ding a, kheklo ding hi. A khek leh, tua leh a khekna pen a siangtho hi khawm ding hi. Tua pen kitanhlo ding hi," a ci hi.
Hihte pen Sinai Mual tungah { Topa } in Israel mite-a' dingin Moses tungah a piak thute ahi hi.
Amaute, Egypt gam panin a paikhiat zawh uh a kum nihna, a kha nihna a ni masa ni-in, Sinai sehnel gam kikhopna puanbuk sungah { Topa } in Moses hopihin hih bangin ci hi:
"Nang leh Aaron in Israel mihonte khempeuh a innkuankuan, a behbehin, pasal peuhmah a milipin a phazah sim un.
No hong huh dingte' min: Reuben : sung panin Shedeur' tapa Elizur;
Simeon : sung panin Zurishaddai' tapa Shelumiel;
Judah : sung panin Amminadab' tapa Nahshon;
Issakhar : sung panin Zuar' tapa Nethanel;
Zebulun : sung panin Helon' tapa Eliab;
Josef tapate, Efraim : sung panin Ammihud' tapa Elishama, leh Manasseh : sung panin Pedahzur' tapa Gamaliel;
Benjamin : sung panin Gideoni' tapa Abidan;
Dan : sung panin Ammishaddai' tapa Ahiezer;
Asher : sung panin Okran' tapa Pagiel;
Gad : sung panin Deuel' tapa Eliasaf;
Naftali : sung panin Enan' tapa Ahira ahi hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in Moses a thupiak bangin Moses leh Aaron in a min kilosa hih mite khawmin, a kha nihna a ni masa ni-in amaute in kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah a pha peuhmah a milipin a innkuankuan, a behbehin amau leh amau a kiciamteh mihon buppite khawm uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in Sinai sehnel gamah amaute a phazah a sim hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in Moses kiangah,
Ahih hangin Levi mite pen thuciamna biakbuk leh a sung nazat khempeuh, leh tua tawh a kisai na khempeuh a uk dingin seh in. Amaute pen biakbuk leh a nazat khempeuh a pua dingte hi a, amaute in a biakbuk semin, a kimkotah phual sat ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin Israel mihonte tungah hehna a omlohna dingin thuciamna biakbuk kiimah Levi mite bek in phual sat ding uh a, Levi mite bek in thuciamna biakbuk kem ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua bangin Israel mite gamta uh a, { Topa } in Moses a thupiak bangin amaute in a sem uh hi.
{ Topa } in Moses leh Aaron kiangah hih bangin gen hi:
Nisuahna lampangah phual a sat dingte pen Judah' giahphual dialkhai a neite hi ding a, a makaite leh a mi phazah a nuai-a bang ahi hi: Judah : mite a makaipa pen Amminadab' tapa Nahshon hi a, ama pawlmi tul sawmsagih leh tul li leh za guk a pha hi. Issakhar : mite a makaipa pen Zuar' tapa Nethanel hi a, ama pawl mitul sawmnga leh tul li leh za li a pha hi. Zebulun : mite a makaipa pen Helon' tapa Eliab hi a, ama pawl mitul sawmnga leh tul sagih leh za li a pha hi. Judah' phualah a pawlpawlin a omte a vekpi-in tul za leh tul sawmgiatleh tul guk leh za li a pha hi. A kipaikhiat ciangin amau masa ding uh hi.
A leitaw lampangah a pawlpawlin Reuben' giahphual dialkhai a neite hi ding a, a makaite leh a mi phazah a nuai-a bang ahi hi. Reuben : mite a makaipa pen Shedeur' tapa Elizur hi a, ama pawl mitul sawmli leh tul guk leh za nga a pha hi. Simeon : mite a makaipa pen Zurishaddai' tapa Shelumiel hi a, amapawl mi tul sawmnga leh tul kua leh za thum a pha hi. Gad : mite a makaipa pen Reuel' tapa Eliasaf hi a, ama pawl mi tulsawmli leh tul nga leh za guk leh sawmnga a pha hi. Reuben' giahphualah a pawlpawlin a omte a vekpi-in tul za leh tulsawmnga leh tul khat leh za li leh sawmnga a pha hi. Amaute a nihna-ah paikhia ding uh hi.
A nitumna lampangah a pawlpawlin Efraim giahphual dialkhai a neite hi ding a, a makaite leh a mi phazah a nuai-a bang ahi hi. Efraim : mite a makaipa pen Ammihud' tapa Elishama hi a, ama pawlmi tul sawmli leh za nga a pha hi. Manasseh : mite a makaipa pen Pedahzur' tapa Gamaliel hi a, amapawl mi tul sawmthum leh tul nih leh za nih a pha hi. Benjamin : mite a makaipa pen Gideoni' tapa Abidan hi a, ama pawlmi tul sawmthum leh tul nga leh za li a pha hi. Efraim giahphualah a pawlpawlin a omte a vekpi-in tul za leh tul giatleh za khat a pha hi. Amaute a thumna-ah paikhia ding uh hi.
A leilu lampangah a pawlpawlin Dan giahphual dialkhai a neite hi ding a, a makaite leh a mi phazah a nuai-a bang ahi hi. Dan : mite a makaipa pen Ammishaddai' tapa Ahiezer hi a, ama pawlmi tul sawmguk leh tul nih leh za sagih a pha hi. Asher : mite a makaipa pen Okran' tapa Pagiel hi a, ama pawl tulsawmli leh tul khat leh za nga a pha hi. Naftali : mite a makaipa pen Enan' tapa Ahira hi a, ama pawl mi tulsawmnga leh tul thum leh za li a pha hi. Dan' giahphuala om mi a vekpi-in tul za leh tul sawmnga leh tul sagihleh za guk a pha hi. Amaute a dialkhai tawh kizui-in a pai nunung ding uh ahi hi.
Hihte pen Israel mite a beh zui-a kisim hi a, a pawlpawlin giahphualah a om mi a vekpi-in tul za guk leh tul thum leh za nga leh sawmnga a pha hi.
Ahih hangin { Topa } in Moses a thupiak bangin Israel mite lakah Levi mite kisimkhawm lo hi.
Tua bangin Israel mite gamta uh hi. { Topa } in Moses a thupiak bangin a beh tawh kizui-in a innkuankuanin amau' dialkhaite' gei-ah giahphual sat uh a, tua bangmahin paikhia uh hi.
Hihte pen Sinai Mual tungah { Topa } in Moses tawh a thugen hun lai-a Aaron leh Moses' huna mite ahi hi.
Aaron' tapate' minte in: A ta upa Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, leh Ithamar hi a,
Ahih hangin Sinai sehnel gam { Topa' } mai-ah mei siangtholo a zat uh ciangin { Topa' } mai-ah Nadab leh Abihu si hi. Amaute in ta neilo uh ahih ciangin Eleazar leh Ithamar in a pa uh Aaron' nuntak sungteng bek siampi na a sem uh ahi hi.
"Levi minamte va paipih in la, amaute in siampi Aaron' na a sep theihna dingun a mai-ah va koih in.
Amaute in biakbukah a sep uh ciangin amah leh mihonpi-a' dingin kikhopna buk mai-ah na sem ding uh hi.
Amaute in kikhopna buk sung nazat khempeuh vaan ding uh a, biakbukah a sep uh ciangin Israel mite-a' dingin na sem ding uh hi.
Nangmah in Aaron leh a tapate' tungah Levi mite na pia ding a, amaute pen Israel mite lak panin keima tungah a kipiate hi ding uh hi.
Nangmah in Aaron leh a tapate na seh ding a, amaute in a siampi nasep uh don ding uh hi. Ahih hangin midang khatpeuh in siampi nasep a sep leh, tua mi kithat ding hi," a ci hi.
"En in, Israel mite lakah tacil khempeuh tangdingin Levi mite ka la khin hi. Levi mite pen keima-a' hi ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh tacil khempeuh keima-a' ahi hi. Egypt gam sungah tacil khempeuh ka thah ni-in, Israel sungah tacil khempeuh, mihing tacil leh ganhing tacil khempeuh, keima-a' dingin ka ap a, amaute pen keima-a' hi ding hi; kei pen { Topa } ka hi hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in Sinai sehnel gam Moses kiangah,
Tua ahih ciangin Moses thu a kipiak bangin amah in { Topa' } thupiakna tawh kizui-in amaute a sim hi.
Kohath' tapate' min in: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, leh Uzziel ahi hi.
Merari' tapate' min in: Mahli leh Mushi ahi hi. Hih mite pen Levi mite beh lutangte ahi uh hi.
Gershon-te beh pen Libni mite leh Shimei mite hi a, hihte pen Gershon-te beh ahi uh hi.
Amaute, kha khat pan a tungsiah a pha pasal peuhmah tul sagih leh za nga ahi hi.
buktuala puan kikhaite, biakbuk kiima om buktuala kongkhak puankhai leh biakna tau, leh a khaute leh hihte tawh a kizom nasep khempeuh ahi hi.
Kohath-te beh pen Amram mite, Izhar mite, Hebron mite, leh Uzziel mite hi a, hihte pen Kohath-te beh ahi hi.
Pasal khempeuh kha khat pan a tungsiah, biakbuk nasep a sem peuhmah tul giat leh za guk ahi hi.
Amau' et dingte pen thuciamna singkuang, a sabuai, a meivakkhuam, a biakna taute, siampite in nasepna-in a zat uh biakbuk nazatte' kidalna puan leh hihte tawh a kizom nasep khempeuh ahi hi.
Merari-te beh pen Mahli mite leh Mushi mite hi a, hihte pen Merari-te beh ahi hi.
Amaute kha khat panin a tungsiah pasal peuhmah tul guk leh za nih ahi hi.
Merari-te beh' et dinga a kisehte pen biakbuk khuampeekte, a zawlte, a khuampite, khuam bullente, a nengneng teng leh hihte tawh a kizom nasep khempeuh ahi hi.
Buktual kimkot-a khuampite leh a bullente tawh, khetphimte leh a khaute zong ahi hi.
Nisuahna lampang biakbuk mai, kikhopna buk mai-ah giahphual a sat ding mite pen Israel mite-a' dingin bang khat peuhpeuh sepna dingin biakbuk sungah thu a nei Moses leh Aaron leh a tapate hi a, midang khatpeuh in biakbuk sungah na a sep leh kithat ding hi.
Moses leh Aaron in { Topa' } thupiakna tawh a innkuankuanun a sim Levi mi pasal kha khat panin a tungsiah peuhmah tul sawmnih leh tul nih a pha hi.
{ Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Israel mite sung pan pasal tacil khempeuh sim in la, kha khat panin a tungsiah peuhmah a min la in.
Israel mite lak panin tacil khempeuh tangdingin Levi mite nong laksak ding a, Israel mite' ganhing tacil khempeuh tangdingin Levi mite' ganhing nong laksak ding hi — kei pen { Topa } ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses in { Topa' } thupiak bangin Israel mite lakah tacil khempeuh a sim hi.
Kha khat panin a tungsiah tacil pasal a kisim peuhmah tul sawmnih leh tul nih leh za nih leh sawmsagih leh thum ahi hi.
"Israel mite lakah tacil khempeuh leh a ganhingte uh tangdingin Levi mite leh a ganhingte uh la in. Levi mite keima-a' hi ding hi; kei pen { Topa } ka hi hi.
Levi mi pasal khempeuh sangin Israel mi tacil khempeuh za nih leh sawmsagih leh thumin tamzaw ahih manin,
tuate tatna dingin shekel khatah gerah sawmnih a pha, biakinn shekel zangin mi khat ciangin shekel nga pai la in la,
biakinn shekel zangin Israel mi tacilte tung panin sum shekel tul khat leh za thum leh sawmguk leh nga a la hi.
Tua ciangin, { Topa } in Moses a thupiak mah bangin { Topa' } thu tawh kizui-in kitatkhiatna sumte Aaron leh a tapate tungah Moses in a pia hi.
"Levi mite lak panin Kohath mite amau' innkuankuan leh a behbehin,
"Giahphual a kisuan ding ciangin Aaron leh a tapate tumin kidalna puan lakhia ding uh a, tua puan tawh thuciamna singkuang tun ding uh hi.
"Ompihna Anlum sabuai tungah amaute in puan a dum phah ding uh a, tua tungah a kuangdaite, paknamtui pakante, kuang-ukte, leh tuibuahna thawl gongbakte koih ding uh a, a kikoih tawntung anlum zong a tungah om ding hi.
"Mei vakna meikhuam pen, a meivakte, a taitehte, a kuangte, leh sathau piakna nazatte khempeuh tawh puan a dum khatin tun ding uh hi.
Amaute in a nazat khempeuh savun-in tunin a puakna ding tal tungah koih ding uh hi.
Amaute in biakbuk sungah a kizang nazat khempeuh la-in puan dum khat tawh tunin, savun tawh tuate tun thuah ding uh a, a puakna ding tal tungah koih ding uh hi.
Tua lai-ah nasepna dinga a kizang, biakna tau nazat khempeuh, a vutluahna peek, a tu-ka, a kawbia, leh a kuang, biakna tau nazat khempeuh, a tungah koihin, tua tungah savun tawh tuam ding uh a, a zawlte bulh ding uh hi.
Aaron leh a tapate in biakbuk leh biakbuk nazat khempeuh a tun khit uh giahphual a kisuan ciangin, tuate a pua dingin Kohath mite hong pai ding uh a, ahih hangin amaute in a siangtho nate lawngkhalo ding uh hi; lawng le-uh si ding uh hi. Hihte pen Kohath mite' puak ding kikhopna buk nate ahi hi.
"Siampi Aaron' tapa Eleazar in meivak tui, a namtui paknamtui, a kikoih tawntung an tawh biakna, nilh sathau, leh biakbuk leh a sunga om khempeuh, leh a nazat khempeuh uk ding hi," a ci hi.
"Levi mite lakah Kohath minamte a sihlohna dingin hih un.
A siangthopen nate nai-ah amaute a pai ciangun siloin a hin'na dingun hih un. Aaron leh a tapate pai-in a nasep ding uh leh a van puak ding ciat uhah amaute seh ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin a siangtho nate tomkhano sung bek nangawn a en dingin amaute tumlo ding uh hi; tum le-uh si ding uh hi," a ci hi.
"Gershon mite zong, amau' innkuankuan leh a behbehin sim in.
Nasep leh van puak ciangin Gershon-te beh' nasep dingte:
Biakbuk dalna puante, kikhopna buk a tuamna tawh, a tungzanga om a khuhna tuuvun, kikhopna buk kongkhaka puankhai,
buktuala puan kikhaite, biakbuk leh biakna tau kimkotah a om buktual kongpi puankhaite, a khaute, leh amau' nasepna dinga nazat khempeuh pua ding uh a, amaute in tuate tawh a kizom nasep kisam khempeuh sem ding uh hi.
Gershon beh pasalte' nasep ding, a puak ding leh a hih dingte khempeuh uh Aaron leh a tapate' thupiakna bang hi ding a, a puak ding khempeuh uh amaute na ap ding uh hi.
"Merari mite zong amau' innkuankuan leh a behbehin,
a kimkot-a om buktuala khuampite a bullente tawh, khetphimte, a khaute, a nazatte khempeuh leh a nengnengte hi a, amaute' puak dingin a kiseh nate a minin na lo ding hi.
{ Topa' } thupiakna bangin Moses leh Aaron leh mihonte' makaite in Levi mite sung panin beh thumte — Kohath-te beh, Gershon-te beh, leh Merari-te beh sunga om pasal mi phazah sim uh hi. Kikhopna buk sungah na a sem thei ding kum sawmthum pan kum sawmnga a pha a behbehin a nuai-a bang ahi hi: Kohath : mi pasal a behtangun tul nih leh za sagih leh sawmnga apha hi. Gershon : mi pasal a behtangun tul nih leh zaguk leh sawmthum a phahi. Merari : mi pasal a behtangun tul thum leh za nih ahi hi. Moses leh Aaron leh Israel makaite in a sim, Levi mi a kisim peuhmah,van puak nasep leh kikhopna buk sungah na a sem thei ding kum sawmthum pan kum sawmnga a pha, a vekpi-in tul giat leh zanga leh sawmgiat a pha hi.
Moses' tung tawnin { Topa' } thupiakna bangin a sep ding a puak ding ciat uh kiseh a, { Topa' } thupiak bangin Moses in amaute a sim hi.
"Amaute in miphakte, ninneite leh misi tawh kisukha-in a ninte khempeuh giahphual pua-ah a omsakna dingun Israel mite thu pia in.
A laizangah keima omna ahi amau' giahphual a nitsak lohna dingun hih bangin a nin numei leh pasal paikhia sakin, giahphual pua-ah na omsak ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua mah bangin Israel mite in hih uh a, giahphual pua-ah amaute hawlkhia uh hi. { Topa } in Moses tungah a gen bangin Israel mite in hih uh hi.
"Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: { Topa' } tungah mite a khialh theihna ahi khialhna khat peuhpeuh, numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin gamta-in a mawh leh,
Ahih hangin a khialhna mi in tua khialhna hanga ditkikna a sang ding tanau a neih kei leh, a khial mi-a' dingin kilemna a bawlsakna ahi kilemna tuutal banah, khialhna hanga tua ditkikna pen siampipa-a' dingin { Topa' } tungah tung ding hi.
Amaute in siampipa tungah a paipih uh biakna peuhmah, Israel mite' na a siangthote khempeuh, ama-a' hi ding hi.
Mi khempeuh' na a siangthote zong ama-a' hi ding a, mi khatpeuh in siampipa tungah a piak peuhmah ama-a' hi ding hi," a ci hi.
pasal khat in tuanu luppihin, a pasal in tua thu a theih kei a, tuanu kininsak napi-in kuamah in phawkloin, a khialh laitakin tuanu kimanlo ahih manin a langah a pang ding teci a omloh hangin,
a pasal in upmawhna lungsim nei-in, a kininsak tawm a zi a upmawh leh; tua ahih kei leh zong, a numei kininsaklo napi-in, a pasal in upmawhna lungsim nei-in, a zi a upmawh leh;
tuapa in siampipa kiangah a zi paipihin, tuanu-a' dingin a kisam biakna, mangbuhham lawh khat paipih ding hi. A tungah sathau sungloin, paknamtui zong koihlo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen upmawhna hanga an tawh biakna, mawhna phawkkikna dinga an tawh biakna ahi hi.
"Siampipa in tuanu va paipihin, { Topa' } mai-ah koih ding hi.
Siampipa in { Topa' } mai-ah tua numei koih ding a, numei' sam phelin, upmawhna hanga an tawh biakna ahi phawkkikna an tawh biakna tua numei tawisak ding hi. Siampipa in ama khutsungah tuisia tawi ding hi.
Tua ciangin siampipa in amah kiciam sakin, 'Na pasal' ukna nuai-ah na om sungin, kuamah in nang hong luppih loin, nitna lamah a kihello na hih leh, hih tuisia panin suakta in.
Ahih hangin na pasal' ukna nuai-ah om napi-in nangmah vakvai a, nang leh nang kininsakin, na pasal a hilo midang khat in nang hong luppih leh,
(siampipa in tua numei kiciamsak ding a, tuanu kiangah) { Topa } in na pheipi teemsakin na pumpi a pawmsak ciangin, na mite lakah hamsia leh kiciamna-a zat dingin { Topa } in nang hong bawlin,
hih tuisia in na gilsung zui hen la, na pumpi pawmsakin na pheipi teemsak hen,' ci ding hi. Tua ciangin numei in, 'Amen, Amen,' ci ding hi.
siampipa in numei' khutsung panin upmawhna hanga an tawh biakna lakhia ding a, { Topa' } mai-ah tua an vei-in biakna tau-ah paipih ding hi.
Siampipa in phawkna dingin an tawh biakna khutdim khat la-in biakna tau tungah hal ding a, tua khit ciangin a tui pen a numei dawnsak ding hi.
Amah in a tui a dawnsak khit ciangin, tuanu amahmah kininsakin a pasal tungah thuman loin gamta ahih leh, tua tuisia pen ama sungah tumin nasak velval ding a, a pumpi pawmin a pheipi teem ding a, tua numei pen mite lakah hamsiatna-in kizang ding hi.
Ahih hangin amahmah a kininsak hiloin a siang ahih leh, tuanu suakta-in ta nei thei ding hi.
ahih kei leh pasal khat in upmawhna lungsim nei-in a zi a upmawh ciangin, upmawhna thute-ah zat ding ngeina tu-a bang ahi hi. Siampipa in { Topa' } mai-ah numei koih ding a, hih ngeina khempeuh numei' tungah zang ding hi.
Hih thu-ah pasal in mawhsakna thuaklo ding a, ahih hangin numei a mawh leh ama mawhna thuak ding hi," a ci hi.
"Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin, { Topa}-a' dingin amahmah a kituam koihna dingin Nazir kiciamna ahi, a tuam mahmah kiciamna a bawl ciangin,
leenggahzu leh khamtheihzu nelo ding hi. Leenggahzu leh khamtheihzu pan a kibawl tuithuk dawnlo ding a, leenggahtui khat peuhpeuh dawnloin, leenggah a hing hita leh a keu hita leh nelo ding hi.
Amah a kituam koih hun sungteng leenggui panin a piang bangmah nelo ding a, a tang ahi a, a hawng nangawn ahi zongin nelo ding hi.
"Tuam om dingin a kiciam hun sungteng ama lu tungah mulkiatna ki-tahlo ding hi. { Topa}-a' dingin a tuam om hun a cin' mateng amah a siangtho hi ding a, a sam a sau-in khawi ding hi.
{ Topa}-a' dingin a tuam om hun sungteng mi siluang kiangah pailo ding hi.
A nu, a pa, a sanggamnu, a sanggampa ahi zongin a sih leh tuate khat peuhpeuh hangin amah kininsaklo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian-a' dingin a tuam omna ama lu tungah om hi.
A tuam om hun sungteng { Topa}-a' dingin a siangtho ahi hi.
"Mi khatpeuh ama gei-ah thakhatin si-in, amah in a ki-ap ama sam a nitsak leh, ni sagih sung ngakin tua ciangin kisian'suahin a sam met ding hi.
siampipa in khialhna hanga biakna dingin khat pia-in, meihal biakna dingin a khat pia ding a, ama-a' dingin kilemna bawlsak ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh misi luang hangin amah khial hi. Amah in tua ni mahin a lutang apphakik ding a,
a tuam om ding hun sungteng { Topa}-a' dingin amah tuam omin, mawhna hanga biakna dingin kum khat a pha tuuno a pa khat paipih ding hi. Ahih hangin ama tuam omna kininsak khin ahih manin a masa hun pen a mawkna hi ding hi.
"A tuam om hun a cin' ciangin zuih ding Nazir ngeinate: Kikhopna buk kongah amah kipaipih ding a,
amah in { Topa' } tungah letsong ahi meihal biakna dingin kum khat a pha a sitbaanglo tuuno a pa khat, khialhna hanga biakna dingin kum khat a pha a sitbaanglo tuuno a nu khat, leh thunuama biakna dingin a sitbaanglo tuutal khat,
leh silngo sawhloh anlum lawh khat, sathau tawh a kibawl annel mohte, leh silngo sawhloh, sathau tawh a kizut mohphengte, leh an tawh a biaknate leh leenggahzu tawh a biaknate paipih ding hi.
"Siampipa in { Topa' } mai-ah tuate paipihin a khialhna hanga biakna leh a meihal biakna pia ding a,

{ Topa } tawh a kiho dingin kikhopna buk sungah Moses a pai ciangin, kherub nihte' kikal, thuciamna singkuang tungah a om hehpihna tokhom tung san teng panin amah a hopih awging khat om a, tua awging in Moses a hopih hi.

{ Topa } in Moses kiangah, "{ Topa' } hih theih ding zah kiciangtan sa na hi hiam? Ka thugen a manin hong tun' leh hong tun'loh tu-in na mu ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses paikhia-in mite' tungah { Topa' } thugente a gensawn hi. Amah in mite a makai mi sawmsagih kaikhawmin, Puanbuk kimkotah amaute omsak hi.
Tua ciangin meii sungah { Topa } hong paisukin amah hopih a, ama sunga om kha pawlkhat la-in upa sawmsagihte' sungah a guang hi. Amaute' sungah tua kha a om ciangin, amaute in kamsangte bangin thu genin a kiko uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute in tua khit zawh hih nawnlo uh hi.
Giahphualah mi nih om uh a, khat Eldad kici-in, a khat Medad kici a, amaute' sungah tua kha a lut hi. Amaute pen a kiciamtehte lakah a kihelte hi uh a, ahih hangin Puanbukah pailoin, giahphualah kamsangte bangin thu genin a kiko uh hi.
Tangval khat va tai-in Moses kiangah, "Eldad leh Medad-te in giahphualah thu a gen uh hi," va ci hi.
Ahih hangin Moses in ama kiangah, "Keima tangin hong hazatsak na hi hiam? { Topa' } mi khempeuh kamsang hi hen la, { Topa } in amau' sungah ama Kha guan' leh ka cih laitak hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses leh Israel upate giahphualah a ciahkik uh hi.
{ Topa' } kiang panin huih nungin, tuipi panin vamimte hong puak a, giahphual kiang hih lampang ni khat paina ciang, hua lampang ni khat paina ciang mah giahphual kimkotah kiasak a, lei maitang tungah pi thum bang a sah hi.
Tua sun tawntung leh a zan tawntung leh a zing ciang tawntung mite dingin vamimte a khawm uh hi. Tawm a khawm pen mipa in beem sawm dim khawm a, amaute in amau-a' dingin giahphual kimkotah tuate a pho uh hi.
Sa a kigaih ma, amau' ha kawmah sa a baang laipi mahin, mite' tungah { Topa } hong heh mahmah a, { Topa } in gimna lianpi khat tawh mite a vatgawp hi.
Moses in Kush numei khat ten'pih ahih manin, ama ten'pih Kush numei' hangin Miriam leh Aaron in amah gensia-in,
"{ Topa } in Moses' tung bek tawnin thu gen ahi hiam? Eite' tung zong tawnin hong gen hilo ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi. { Topa } in tua thu a za hi.
Moses a lungneem mahmah hi a, leitunga om mi khempeuh sangin a lungneemzaw ahi hi.
{ Topa } in thakhatthu-in Moses leh Aaron leh Miriam kiangah, "Kikhopna bukah no mihing thumte hong pai un," a ci hi. Amau thumte a pai uh hi.
Meii khuam sungah { Topa } hong kumsukin, kikhopna bukkongah ding a, Aaron leh Miriam a sam hi. Amaute gel mailam nehin hong pai uh hi.
{ Topa } in, "Ka thu za un: Note' lakah kamsang a om leh { Topa } keimah in ama tungah maangmuhna tawh ka kilak a, amah tawh mang sungah ka kiho hi.
Ka nasempa Moses tawh tua bang hilo hi; ka innsung thu khempeuh amah ki-ap hi.
Amah tawh kam leh kam kiho-in, a kitello kampaute tawh hiloin, a kitel takin thu ka gen uh a, amah in { Topa' } meel a mu hi. Tua bang ahih ciangin bang hangin ka nasem Moses gensiat ding laulo na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Amaute tungah { Topa } heh mahmah a, a hehsapi-in a paikhia hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in { Topa' } tungah, "Amah damsak in, Pasian aw, kong thum hi," ci-in a kiko hi.
Ahih hangin { Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Tua numei' maitang, a pa in cil phih leh tua numei ni sagih sung maizum ding hilo ahi hiam? Giahphual pualamah ni sagih sung kikhumcip sak in; tua khit ciangin amah hong kipaipih kik thei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin giahphual pualamah ni sagih sung Miriam kikhumcip hi. Miriam a kipaipih kik mateng khualzin a zom dingin mite dingkhialo uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Hazeroth panin mite dingkhia uh a, Paran gamlakah giahphual a sat uh hi.
"Israel mite tungah ka piak Kanaan leitang a vaan dingin mi sawl in la, amaute lakah makai ahi, nam khat sung panin mi khat ciat sawl in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses in { Topa' } thupiakna tawh Paran gamlak panin Israel mite' lutang ahi mi khempeuh a sawl hi.
A sawl mite' min hih bang ahi hi: Reuben : minam panin Zakkur' tapa Shammua; Simeon : minam panin Hori' tapa Shafat; Judah : minam panin Jefunneh' tapa Kaleb; Issakhar : minam panin Josef' tapa Igal; Efraim : minam panin Nun' tapa Hoshea; Benjamin : minam panin Rafu' tapa Palti; Zebulun : minam panin Sodi' tapa Gaddiel; Josef minam (Manasseh minam) : panin Susi' tapa Gaddi; Dan : minam panin Gemalli' tapa Ammiel; Asher : minam panin Mikhael' tapa Shethur; Naftali : minam panin Vofsi' tapa Nahbi; Gad : minam panin Makhi' tapa Geuel ahi hi.

amau' ten'na gam pen nuntak olna gam hiam, haksatna gam hiam, amau' ten'na khuapite pen giahphual hiam, munmuan'huai hiam,
a leitang a lei hoih hiam, lei sia hiam, sing om hiam, omlo hiam, va thei un. Na siam tawpun va hih un la, tua leitanga gah pawlkhat hong ciahpih un," a ci hi. Tua hun pen leenggah a palte a min hun ahi hi.
Amaute Negeb lamah paito uh a, Hebron tung uh hi. Anak' suanlekhakte ahi Ahiman mite, Sheshai mite, leh Talmai mite, tua lai-ah na om uh hi. (Hebron pen Egypt gama Zoan a kisat ma kum sagih lai-in kisat hi.)
Amaute Eshkol kuam tung uh a, tua lai panin leenggah bawk khat bek a hiang tawh lo-in, mi nih in zawl khatin a zawng uh hi. Amaute in mang kawlsing leh thei zong tawmkhat a pua uh hi.
Paran gamlak Kadesh muna Moses leh Aaron leh Israel mihonte khempeuh kiangah amaute hong tung uh hi. Amaute leh mihon khempeuh tungah thu puakkik uh a, tua leitanga gahte amaute a lak uh hi.
Amaute in Moses kiangah, "Kote nong sawlna leitangah ka va tung uh hi. Tua lai-ah bawngnawi leh khuaizu tui bangin luang a, hih pen tua gama gah ahi hi.
Ahi zongin tua gama teng mite thahat uh a, a khuapite uh kulh tawh ki-umin lian mahmah hi. Tua banah Anak' suanlekhakte tua lai-ah ka mu uh hi.
Amalek mite Negeb gamah teng uh hi. Hit mite, Jebus mite, leh Amor mite, mualtung gamah teng uh hi. Kanaan mite tuipi gei leh Jordan dungah teng uh hi," ci-in a gen uh hi.

Tua ciangin mihon khempeuh nakpi takin kiko uh a, tua zan sung kap uh hi.

Eite' tungah { Topa } a lungkim leh, bawngnawi leh khuaizu tui bangin a luan'na hih leitangah eite hong paipihin eite tungah tua leitang hong pia ding hi.
{ Topa } phunsan kei hamtang un. Amaute pen zialmang pak ding ihih manin tua gam mite kihta kei un. Amau' kiang panin amau' kidalna kilakhia khin a, eite tawh { Topa } hong om hi; amaute kihta kei un," a ci uh hi.

{ Topa } in Moses kiangah, "Hih mite in bang tanvei kei hong simmawh ding ahi uh hiam? Amaute' lakah ka hihsa limte om napi-in, amaute in bang tanvei hong umlo lailai ding ahi uh hiam?
Ahih hangin Moses in { Topa' } kiangah, "Tua bang hi leh Egypt mite in hih thu za ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute' lak panin na thahatna tawh hih mite na paikhiatpih hi.
Amaute in hih gama teng mite tungah gen ding uh hi. { Topa } aw, hih mite' lakah nang na omna thu hih mite in za khinzo uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } aw, maitang kituahin nang hong kimu a, amaute' tungah nangma meii a ding hi. Amaute' mai-ah sunin meii khuam sungah, zanin mei khuam sungah nang na pai hi.
'Amaute' tungah piak dinga a kiciam leitangah { Topa } in hih mite paipih zolo ahih manin, amah in gamlakah amaute that hi,' ci ding uh hi.
Tu-in, nang tungah hong thum ing. Nangmah in thu ciamin, '{ Topa } heh hak a, a itna kip lianin, mawhna leh thu palsatna maisak a, ahih hangin a mawhte siangsak ngeiloin, pate' mawhna tate tungah, khang thum khang lina dongin thuk hi,' na cih mah bangin { Topa' } vangliatna liansak in.
A lian nangma itna kip tawh a kizui leh Egypt panin tuhun dong hih mite na maisaksa tawh kizui-in hih mite' mawhna maisak in, kong thum hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in, "Nangma gen bangin ka maisak hi.
Ahih hangin a taktakin, ka nuntak laiteng, { Topa' } minthan'na tawh leitung kidim ding ahih mah bangin,

Amaute tungah hih bangin gen in: { Topa } in, 'Kei a nungta ka hih mah bangin ka zakna-ah na gente uh no tungah ka hong hih ding hi.
Jefunneh' tapa Kaleb leh Nun' tapa Joshua simloh, note tengsak dingin ka kiciamna leitangah khat beek na tung kei ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin note ahih leh, na luanghawmte uh hih gamlakah lum ding hi.
Na luanghawmte uh a nunung pen gamlakah a kisial mateng, gamlakah kum sawmli sung na tate uh tuucing hi ding uh a, note' ginatlohna thuak ding uh hi.
Na gam vaan sung uh ni phazah tawh kizui-in, ni sawmli, ni khat ciangin kum khat, note in na mawhna uh kum sawmli sung na thuak ding uh a, keima lungkimlohna na thei ding uh hi,' ci hi.
{ Topa } ahi keimah in thu ka gen hi. Keimah langpangin a kikaikhawm hih a gilo mihonte khempeuh tungah hih thu ka hih taktak ding hi. Hih gamlakah amaute beimang ding uh a, amaute si ding uh hi," a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Korah, Dathan, leh Abiram-te' omna kiim panin amaute a paikhia uh hi. Dathan leh Abiram-te, a zite uh leh a tapate uh leh a taneute uh tawh hong pusuakin a puanbuk kong uhah dingkhawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in, "Hih na khempeuh a sem dingin { Topa } in kei hong sawl hi. Hih nasep pen keima utthu ahih lohna, hih thu tawh na thei ding uh hi.
Mi khempeuh a sih ngei bang danin hih mite si a, tua ahih kei leh mi khempeuh in a tuah ngeite a tuah leh, { Topa } in kei hong sawlloh ahi hi.
Ahih hangin { Topa } in a thak khat hong piangsakin, leitang in a kam ka-in amaute' neih khempeuh tawh hih mite valhtumin, a hingtangin Leinuai-ah a tumsuk uh leh, hih mite in { Topa } a simmawh ahihna thu na thei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Leitang a kam ka-in, Korah tawh a kipawl mi khempeuh leh a innkuanpihte uh leh a neihsa khempeuh uh valhtum hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute leh a neihsa khempeuh uh a hingtangun Leinuai-ah tumsuk uh hi. Leitang in amaute khupnelhin mihonpite' lak panin amaute bei uh hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa' } kiang panin mei hong paikhia a, paknamtui a pia mi za nih leh sawmngate kangtum hi.
"Siampi Aaron' tapa Eleazar in meikuang sung panin paknamtui beelte a lakkhiat ding gen in la, tua ciangin a gamlapi-ah mei thehthang in. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua nate,
amau' nuntakna a beina dongin a khial hih mite' paknamtui beelte a siangtho hi. Tua ahih ciangin biakna tau sitna kuangdai dingin seek un; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in { Topa' } mai-ah tuate pia uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua nate siangtho hi. Israel mite tungah tua bangin hih nate pen lim khat hi ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin siampi Eleazar in mei tawh a kangtum mite' piak paknamtui sumngo beelte la-in biakna tau sitna-in a sek hi.
{ Topa } in Moses tung tawnin Eleazar tungah a gen bangin Korah leh a pawlte tawh a kibang khalo dingin, siampi a hilo, Aaron' suanlekhakte a hilo mi peuhmah, { Topa' } mai-ah paknamtui hal dingin a pailohna ding, Israel mite tungah phawksakna khat ahi hi.
Ahih hangin a zing ciangin Israel mihon khempeuh in Moses leh Aaron phunsan uh a, "{ Topa' } mite na that uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Moses leh Aaron langpangin mihonte a kikhop uh ciangin, kikhopna buk lamah amaute a khuadak uh ciangin, meii in na tuam a, { Topa' } minthan'na vang kilang hi.
Kikhopna buk mailamah Moses leh Aaron pai a,
"Tomno sungin amaute ka siatsak theihna dingin hih mihonte' lak panin paikhia un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute gel zong boksuk uh hi.
Moses in Aaron kiangah, "Na paknamtui beel la-in, biakna tau pana mei a sungah koih in la, a tungah paknamtui koihin, mihonte' lakah paipih mengmeng in la, amaute-a' dingin kilemna bawlsak in. Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa' } kiang panin hehna hong paikhia khin a, gimna kipan khin hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Moses' gen bangin Aaron in paknamtui beel la-in mihonte lakah a tai hi. Mite lakah gimna kipan khin takpi a, amah in paknamtui koihin mite-a' dingin kilemna a bawlsak hi.
A si leh a hingte' kikalah amah ding a, gimna a veng hi.
Tu-in Korah' tungtangah a site simloh, hih gimna tawh a si mi tul sawm leh tul li leh za sagih ahi hi.
"Israel mite tungah thu gen in la, amaute tung panin, beh khat ciangin ciangkhut khat, a beh tawh kizui-in a makaite khempeuh tung panin ciangkhut sawmlenih la in. A ciangkhut tungah amau' min ciat gelh in la,
Moses in zong Israel mite tungah tua thu a gen hi. A makaite khempeuh in a beh tawh kizui-in makai khat ciangin khat pai, ciangkhut sawmlenih ama tungah pia uh a, Aaron' ciangkhut zong amau' ciangkhut lakah a om hi.
Moses in thuciamna puanbuk sung { Topa' } mai-ah tua ciangkhutte a koih hi.
A zing ciangin thuciamna puanbuk sungah Moses a pai leh, Levi-te beh-a' ding Aaron' ciangkhut selin nguumkhia a, paakin, almond min gah a gah hi.

Tua ahih manin { Topa' } sawl bangin Moses in zong a hih hi.
A nai-ah a pai, { Topa' } biakbuk nai-ah a pai peuhmah si ding hi. Kote khempeuh ka beina ding uh hita hilo ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in Aaron kiangah, "Nang leh na tapate leh na behte in biakbuk sung nasepnate tawh kisai-in khialhna a om leh mawhna na puakhawm ding uh hi. Ahi zongin nang leh na tapate in na siampi nasepna uh tawh kisai-in khialhna a om leh no teng bek in mawhna na pua ding uh hi.
Amaute in nang hong pawlin, thuciamna puanbuk mai-ah nang leh na tapate na om laitakun note' na hong sepsak theihna dingin na pate nam ahi Levi minam na sanggamte zong paipih in.
Amaute in note hong huhin puanbuk nasep khempeuh sem ding uh a, ahih hangin note leh amaute si khading na hih ciangun biakbuk nazatte leh biakna tau-ah na hong seppihlo ding uh hi.
Amaute in note hong pawlin, kikhopna buk vaanin puanbuk nasep khempeuh sem ding uh a, note' nasepte midang kuamah in hong seppih theilo ding hi.
Israel mite tungah hehna a om nawnlohna dingin biakbuk nasep leh biakna tau nasep note in na sem ding uh hi.
En un, Israel mite kiang panin na sanggam uh Levi mite ka la khin a, amaute pen kikhopna buk nasep a sem dingin { Topa' } tungah a kipia, note' tungah letsong ahi hi.
Nang leh na tapate in biakna tau tawh kisai nate leh dalna puan sunga om nate khempeuhah na siampi nasep uh na sem ding uh hi. Na siampi nasep uh letsongin kong piak hi a, midangte in hong sep leh kithat ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in Aaron kiangah, "En in, kei tungah hong kipia biakna a kikoih khempeuh, Israel mite in a ap nate khempeuh nang kong pia hi. Nangma tanh ding leh na suanlekhakte' kaih ahi tawntung dingin note tungah kong pia hi.
Mei tawh hal dingte lak panin a kisit, a siangtho pen nangma ngah dingte in: Amaute in kei' tungah hong piak amau' biaknate khempeuh, an tawh amau' biaknate khempeuh, khialhna hanga amau' biaknate khempeuh, leh mawhna hanga amau' biaknate khempeuh pen nang leh na suanlekhakte-a' dingin a siangtho pen hi ding hi.
A siangtho pen mun khatah na ne ding uh hi. Pasal peuhmah in ne thei ding hi; note-a' dingin a siangtho ahi hi.
"Amau' letsong biakna, Israel mite in vei-a a biaknate khempeuh uh zong nomau-a' ahi hi. Nang leh na tapate leh na tanute' kaih tawntung dingin tuate kong pia hi. Na inn sunga om a siangtho mi peuhpeuh in ne thei ding hi.
"Sathau limci pen khempeuh, leh leenggahzu leh an a limci pen khempeuh, { Topa' } tungah amau' piak anpalte, note' tungah kong pia hi.
Amaute in { Topa' } tungah a piak uh, amau' leitangah a min masa gah khempeuh nomau-a' hi ding hi. Na inn sunga om a siangtho mi peuhpeuh in ne thei ding hi.
"Israel-te' sungah a ki-ap na peuhmah nomau-a' hi ding hi.
"Mihing leh ganhing khempeuh sung panin { Topa' } tungah mite in a piak tacil khempeuh, mihing hita leh ganhing hita leh, nomau-a' hi ding hi. Ahi zongin mihing tacil na tankhia ding uh a, ganhing nin tacil zong na tankhia ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin bawng tacil, ahih kei leh tuu tacil, ahih kei leh keel tacilte na tan kei ding uh hi; tuate a siangtho ahi hi. Biakna tau tungah tuate' si na theh ding uh a, { Topa' } tungah a gim namtui, mei tawh kihal biakna-in tuate' thau na hal ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin a kivei sa-iik leh a taklam phei nomau-a' ahih mah bangin, tuate' sate nomau-a' hi ding hi.
"Israel mite in { Topa' } tungah a piak a siangtho biaknate khempeuh, nang leh na tapate leh na tanute tungah kaih tawntung dingin kong pia hi. Tua pen nang leh na suanlekhakte-a' dingin { Topa' } mai-ah a tawntungin a kiphel theilo, ci tawh thuciamna ahi hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in Aaron kiangah, "Nang in amau' gam sungah gamhluah na nei kei ding a, amaute' lakah tanh zong na nei kei ding hi. Kei pen Israel mite' lakah nangma tanh leh nangma luah ka hi hi.
"Kikhopna buk sungah amaute' nasepna thaman dingin Israel sunga sawmah khat khempeuh, Levi mite' tungah gamh-in ka pia hi.
Amaute in khialhna thuakin si khading uh ahih manin, tu-a kipanin kikhopna buk sungah Israel midangte pai-in tua sawmah khat nekpihlo ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin Levi mite in kikhopna buk nasep sem ding uh a, amaute in a tavuan uh pua ding uh hi. Tua pen amau' khang tawntungin ngeina kip hi ding a, amaute in Israel mite' lakah luah neilo ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in biakna-in { Topa' } tungah a piak uh Israel mite' sawmah khat pen Levi mite tungah luah dingin ka pia khin hi. Tua ahih ciangin Israel mite lakah amaute in luah a neihloh ding uh ka gensa ahi hi," a ci hi.
"Levi mite kiangah hih bangin na gen lai ding hi: 'Note' luah dingin amaute' tung panin kong piak sawmah khat, Israel mite' tung panin na lak uh ciangin, tua sung panin { Topa' } tungah biakna, sawmah khat sung pan sawmah khat na pia sawn ding uh hi.
Tua na biaknate uh, ancilna pana an leh leenggah sukna pana kipia mah bangin note-a'-in kiciamteh ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel mite' tung panin na ngah uh sawmah khat khempeuh tung panin { Topa' } tungah biakna na pia ding uh hi. Tua bangin siampi Aaron' tungah { Topa } a kibiakna na pia ding uh hi.
Note tungah hong kipia letsong lakah a limci pen, a siangtho pen paipihin { Topa}-a' ding biakna khempeuh na pia ding uh hi,' ci-in gen in.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute kiangah, 'Tuate sung panin a limci pen teng na piak khit uh ciangin, a omlai teng Levi mite-a' dingin ancilna panin a piangte leh leenggah sukna panin a piangte a kipia mah bangin kiciamteh ding hi.
Nang leh na innkuanpihte in mun khat peuhpeuhah na ne thei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua pen kikhopna buk sungah note' nasepna thaman ahi hi.
Tua sung panin a limci pen na piak nak uh leh tua thu hangin mawhsakna na thuak kei ding uh hi. Israel mite' na a siangthote na ninsak kei ding uh hi. Na nitsak uh leh na si ding uh hi,' ci-in gen in," a ci hi.
Tu-in { Topa } in Moses leh Aaron' kiangah,
"{ Topa' } thupiak thukham leh ngeina hih bang ahi hi: Poina a neilo, sitbaan'na a omlo, a tungah nasepna kol a kivawh ngei nailo, bawngla a san khat nomau kiangah hong paipihna dingun Israel mite kiangah gen un.
Siampi Eleazar in a khutme tawh a si tawmkhat la-in, kikhopna buk mailamah a si sagihvei theh ding hi.
Ama muhna-ah a bawngla kihal ding a, a vun, a sa, leh a si, a ek tawh kihal ding hi.
Siampipa in taamtak sing leh puknah leh a ausan khaute la-in bawngla a kihalna sungah tuate khul ding hi.
Tua ciangin siampipa in ama puante sawpin tui sungah kipumsil ding a, tua khit ciangin giahphualah hong pai ding hi. A nitak mateng siampipa a nin hi ding hi.
Mi a siang khat in bawngla vu khawmin, giahphual pualam a siang mun khatah tuate koih ding a, khialhna maisakna ding, nitna sian'sakna ding tui-ah zat dingin Israel mihonpite-a' dingin tuate kikem ding hi.
Bawngla vute a khawm mipa in ama puante sawpin, a nitak mateng a nin hi ding hi. Hih pen Israel mite leh amaute lakah a peem khualmi tungah tawntung ngeina hi ding hi.
"Misi luang khatpeuh a lawngpa ni sagih sung a nin hi ding hi.
A ni thum ni leh a ni sagih ni-in amahmah tui tawh kisiangsakin, tua khit ciangin a siang hi ding hi. Ahih hangin a ni thum ni leh a ni sagih ni-in amahmah a kisian'sak kei leh, amah a siang suak theilo ding hi.
Misi khatpeuh a lawng mi in amahmah a kisian'sak tawm kei leh amahmah in { Topa' } biakbuk a ninsak hi a, Israel sung panin tua mi kihawlkhia ding hi. Nitna hangin ama tungah tui kibuaklo ahih manin ama tungah nitna baang lai ahih ciangin a nin hi ding hi.
"Mi khat puanbuk sungah a sih ciangin puanbuk sungah a pai mi peuhmah leh puanbuk sungah a om mi peuhmah ni sagih sung a nin hi ding hi.
A kisinciplo a kihong beel peuhmah a nin ahi hi.
"Amaute in a nin mipa-a' dingin a kihal khialhna hanga biakna vute la-in beel sung khatah tui luanglai tawh hel ding uh hi.

A ni thum ni leh a ni sagih ni-in a siang mipa in a nin mipa tungah theh ding a, tua bangin a ni sagih ni-in amah in mi ninpa siangsakin, amah in a puante sawpin, tui sungah kipumsil ding a, a nitak ciangin amah a siang hi ding hi.
"Ahih hangin a nin hi napi-in a kisiangsaklo mipa in { Topa' } biakbuk ninsak ahih manin mihonpi panin tua mipa kihawlkhia ding hi. Nitna hangin ama tungah tui kibuaklo ahih manin amah a nin ahi hi.
Tua pen amaute-a' dingin tawntung ngeina khat hi ding hi. Nitna hangin tui a theh mipa in ama puante sawp ding a, nitna hangin a kizang tui a lawng mipa a nitak mateng a nin hi ding hi.

Ahi zongin { Topa } in Moses leh Aaron kiangah, "Israel mite' mai-ah kei hong umlo, hong siangthosaklo na hih uh ciangin amaute ka piaksa leitangah hih mihonte na tun'pih kei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Hihte pen, Israel mite in { Topa } a phunsanna, amaute lakah amahmah a siangtho-a a kilahna mun, Meribah tui phuala thupiang ahi hi.
Ka pu ka pate uh Egypt-ah na paisukin Egypt-ah sauveipi ka teng uh a, Egypt mite in kote leh ka pu ka pate uh hong gimbawl hi.
{ Topa' } tungah ka kiko uh ciangin amah in ka aw uh hong za a, vantung mi khat hong sawlin, Egypt panin hong paikhiatpih a, tu-in nangma gam nawl Kadesh khuapi-ah ka om uh hi.
Tu-in kote na gam hong kantansak in. Lo ahi a, leenggui lo ahi zongin nawkkha loin, tuikhuk panin zong tui ka dawn kei ding uh hi. Kumpipa' Lamlian dungah ka pai ding uh a, na gamsung ka khen' matengun lam ka pial kei ding uh hi," a ci hi.

Aaron leh ama tapa Eleazar sam in la, Hor Mual-ah amaute paipih in.

'En in, Egypt panin mihon khat hong paikhia a, lei maitang teng dim uh hi. Tu-in hong pai in la, amaute hong samsiatsak in. Tua hi leh amaute do-in ka hawlkhiazo khading hi,' hong ci hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Tua ahih ciangin zingsangin Balaam tho-in Balak' uliante kiangah, "Na gam uhah ciah un; bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in note kong zuih ding hong phallo hi," a ci hi.

bang hang hiam cih leh minphatna lianpi nang kong pia ding a, kei' tunga nong gen peuhpeuh ka hih ding hi. Hong pai in la, hih mite hong samsiatsak in,' ci hi," ci-in a gen uh hi.
