Tu-in kong thum hi; { Topa } in kei tungah bang hong ci lai ding hiam cih ka theihna dingin tuzan zong hih lai-ah giak phot un," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua zanin Balaam kiangah Pasian hong pai-in, "Nangmah a sam dingin mite hong pai ahih leh, tho in la amaute zui in. Ahih hangin nang kong sawl teng bek na hih ding hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah pai ahih manin Pasian heh a, amah a khaktan dingin { Topa' } vantung mi in lampi-ah na pang hi. Tu-in a la tungah amah tuang a, a nasemte nih in zong a zui uh hi.
{ Topa' } vantung mi in a khutsungah namsau dawhsa tawi-in lampi-ah a ding, a la in mu ahih manin lampi panin pialin gamlakah a pai hi. Balaam in lampi-ah a paikikna dingin a la a sat hi.
Tua ciangin leenggui lo kikal, a pang tuakah phung a omna lam kawcikah vantung mi na ding leuleu hi.
La in { Topa' } vantung mi a muh ciangin phung phu a, phungah Balaam' khe nengcip ahih ciangin amah in a la sat kik hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa' } vantung mi na ma pai-in, taklamah ahi a, veilamah ahi zongin kihei theihna ding a omlohna mun kawcik khatah na ding leuleu hi.
La in { Topa' } vantung mi a muh ciangin Balaam' nuai-ah lumsuk hi. Balaam heh mahmah a, a ciangkhut tawh a la a sat hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in la pau theisak a, la in Balaam kiangah, "Thumvei dong nong satna dingin nang bang hong cih ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.

La in Balaam' kiangah, "Na khan'tawnin tuni ciangdong na tuan'na na la hilo ka hi hiam? Hih bangin nang hong hih ngei ka hi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in, "Nong hih ngei kei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in Balaam' mitte hon'sak a, a khutsungah namsau dawhsa tawh { Topa' } vantung mi lampi-ah a ding mu ahih manin a lu kunin a boksuk hi.
{ Topa' } vantung mi in ama kiangah, "Bang hangin na la thumvei dong sat na hi hiam? En in, hih na khualzinna-ah lungkimlo ka hih manin nang hong pang dingin kong kuankhia hi.
La in kei hong mu-in thumvei dong hong pel hi. Hong pel kei leh, tu mahmahin nang hong that khinin na la ka hingsak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Balaam in { Topa' } vantung mi kiangah, "Kei hong pangin lampi-ah na din'lam theilo ka hih manin ka khial hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in ka khualzinna hoihsalo na hih leh ka ciahkik ding hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa' } vantung mi in Balaam kiangah, "Mite zui in; ahih hangin nang kong sawlteng bek na gen ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Balaam in Balak' uliante a zuisuak hi.

Pasian in Balaam na dawn hi. Balaam in ama kiangah, "Biakna tau sagih ka bawl khin a, biakna tau simah bawngtal khat leh tuutal khat ciat ka pia hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in Balaam kiangah thu gen a, "Balak kiangah ciahkikin hih bangin na gen ding hi," a ci hi.
Balak kiangah a ciahkik ciangin amah leh Moab uliante khempeuh ama meihal biakna gei-ah na ding uh hi.
Pasian' samsiat loh mite bangci samsiat ding ka hi hiam? { Topa' } mawhsak loh mite bangci mawhsak ding ka hi hiam?
Leivui zahin a tam Jakob mite, kua in a mal simzo ding a, Israel mi phazah a mal simzo ding ahi hiam? Mi thumanpa' sihna bangin hong sisak in la, ka mailam thu ama-a' bang hisak in,!" a ci hi.

A zuau dingin Pasian pen mihing hilo a, a kisik dingin mihing' tapa hilo hi. Amah in gen khin hi; a gen bangin hihlo ding ahi hiam? Amah in ci khin hi; a cih bangin tungsaklo ding ahi hiam?
Amah in Jakob mite tungah mawhna mulo a, Israel mite tungah gamtatsiatna mulo hi. { Topa } amau' Pasian, amaute tawh om a, kumpipa phatna awging amaute' lakah om hi.

En un, hua mite! Humpinelkai bangin thoto a, humpinelkai bangin kaangto hi. A an a nek mateng, amaute' si a dawn mateng, lumsuklo hi," a ci hi.

Saupi a kiphah kuamte tawh kibang a, gun gei-a om huante tawh kibang hi. { Topa } in a suan aloes paknamtui kungte tawh kibang a, tuipi gei-a om taamtak kungte tawh kibang hi.
Balaam' tungah Balak heh mahmah a, amah in a khut leh a khut a tuum hi. Balak in Balaam kiangah, "Ka galte a samsia dingin nang kong sam hi. En in, nang in amaute thumvei tak thupha na pia khinzo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na omna munah tai in. 'Nang kong min liansak ding hi,' ka hong ci hi. Ahih hangin na min liatna ding panin { Topa } in nang hong khaktan hi," a ci hi.
'Balak in kham leh ngun tawh a kidim ama inn hong pia ding hita leh zong, { Topa' } thu banah keima thu-in a pha bawl ding ahi a, a sia bawl ding ahi zongin bangmah ka hih thei kei hi. { Topa' } gente bek keimah in ka gen ding hi,' ci-in gen khin hilo ka hi hiam?

Kikhopna bukkongah amaute kapin a om laitak, Moses' muhna leh Israel mihon buppi' muhna-ah Israel mite khat hong pai-in, Midian numei khat ama innkuanpihte kiangah hong ciahpih hi.

{ Topa } in Moses a thupiak bangin, "Kum sawmnih pan a tungsiah peuhmah mi sim un," a ci hi. Egypt gam panin a paikhia Israel mite:
Hihte khempeuh pen Reuben minam ahi uh hi; amau mi tul sawmli leh tul thum leh za sagih leh sawmthum pha hi.
Eliab' tapate pen Nemuel, Dathan, leh Abiram ahi uh hi. Hih Dathan leh Abiram pen, mihonte lak panin pawl a kai, amaute in { Topa' } thu a seel lai-in Korah tawh kipawlin Moses leh Aaron' thu a seelte ahi uh hi.
Mei in mihing zanih leh sawmnga a kattum lai-in lei in a kam ka-in Korah tawh amaute valh tumin amau pawl teng si uh a, amaute pen hilhkholhna a suak uh hi.
Ahi zongin Korah' tapate silo uh hi.
Hihte pen Simeon minam hi uh a, mi tul sawmnih leh tul nih leh zanih ahi uh hi.
Hihte pen Gad minamte hi a, mi tul sawmli leh zanga ahi hi.
Judah' tapate pen Er leh Onan hi a, Kanaan gamah Er leh Onan si uh hi.
Hihte pen Judah minamte hi a, mi tul sawmsagih leh tul guk leh zanga ahi uh hi.
Hihte pen Issakhar minamte hi a, mi tul sawmguk leh tul li leh zathum ahi uh hi.
Hihte pen Zebulun minamte hi a, mi tul sawmguk leh zanga ahi uh hi.
Amau' behbehin Josef minamte: Manasseh leh Efraim ahi uh hi.
Tu-in Hefer' tapa Zelofehad in tapa neilo a, ahih hangin tanu nei hi: Zelofehad' tanute' minte in Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah, leh Tirzah ahi hi.
Hihte pen Manasseh minamte hi a, mi tul sawmnga leh tul nih leh za sagih ahi hi.
Hihte pen Efraim minamte hi a, mi tul sawmthum leh tul nih leh zanga ahi hi. Hihte pen amau' behbehin Josef minamte ahi hi.
Bela' tapate pen Ard leh Naaman ahi uh hi: Ard pan Ard behte ahi uh hi; Naaman pan Naaman behte ahi uh hi.
Hihte pen amau' behbehin Benjamin minamte hi a, mi tul sawmli leh tul nga leh zaguk ahi hi.
Dan minam sung pan Shuham behte mi tul sawmguk leh tul li leh za li ahi hi.
Hihte pen Asher minamte hi a, tul sawmnga leh tul thum leh za li ahi hi.
Hihte pen Naftali minamte hi a, mi tul sawmli leh tul nga leh za li ahi hi.
Hihte pen Israel mi vekpi a phazah hi a, mi tul za guk leh tul khat leh za sagih leh sawmthum ahi uh hi.
Ahih hangin leitang pen aisaanna tawh kihawm ding a, amau' beh min tawh kizui-in amaute in luah ding uh hi.
Aisaanna tawh kizui-in a tamte tungah a tam, a tawmte tungah a tawm, a gamh uh kihawmsak ding hi," a ci hi.
Amau' suante: Libni behte, Hebron behte, Mahli behte, Mushi behte, leh Korah behte ahi uh hi. Kohath pen Aram' pa ahi hi.

Ahih hangin Nadab leh Abihu pen amaute in { Topa' } mai-ah mei siangtholo a piak lai-un si uh hi.

Tuuno khat-a' dingin an tawh biakna-in sathau tawh a kibawl annel lawh khat ciat hi ding a, a gim namtui meihal biakna ding ahi hi.

Meihal biakna ding ahi zingsanga meihal biakna banah tatsat lo-a biakna-in hihte na pia ding uh hi.
Tua bangmahin mei tawh kihal an tawh biakna ahi, { Topa' } tungah a gim namtui, ni sagih sung ni simin na pia ding uh hi. Tua pen a kitatsat lo-a meihal biakna leh leenggahzu tawh a biaknate banah kipia ding hi.

Kilemna dingin khialhna hanga biakna leh a kitatsat lo-a meihal biakna leh an tawh a biakna leh leenggahzu tawh a biaknate banah khialhna hanga biakna-in keel a pa khat zong hi ding hi.
"A kha sagihna ni sawm leh ni nga ni-in a siangtho kikhopna khat nei-in tua ni-in leitung nasep na sem kei ding uh a, { Topa}-a' dingin ni sagih sung pawi na kham ding uh hi.

A kitatsat lo-a meihal biakna leh an tawh a biakna leh leenggahzu tawh a biaknate banah khialhna hanga biakna-in keel a pa khat zong hi ding hi.

ngeina kip om bangin bawngtal, tuutal, leh tuunote a phazah tawh kizui-in piakkhawm dingin an tawh a biakna leh leenggahzu tawh a biaknate zong hi ding hi.
"Na thuciam biakpiakna uh leh utthu-a na biakpiaknate uh banah na meihal biaknate, leh an tawh na biaknate, leh leenggahzu tawh na biaknate, leh thunuama na biakna dingun a kiseh na pawi hunte uhah hihte, { Topa' } tungah na pia ding uh hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in Moses a thupiak bangin amah in Israel mite tungah a thu a kimin a gensawn hi.
Moses in Israel minam lutangte tungah, "{ Topa' } thupiak hih bang ahi hi:
Mi khat in { Topa' } tungah thuciamna a ciam ciang ahi a, amah in a zuih dingin kiciamna a bawl ciang ahi zongin, amah ciampello ding a, ama kamsung panin a gingkhiate khempeuh tawh kizui-in gamta ding hi.
"Tua ahih kei leh, numei khat in { Topa' } tungah thuciamna bawlin, a pa' inn sungah nungakin a om sungin kamciamna tawh amah kikhihtawm a,
amah in a zuih dingin thuciamna leh kamciamnate a bawlna a pa in za napi-in ama tungah bangmah a cih kei leh, ama thuciamna khempeuh kip ding a, amah a kikhih tawmna kamciamna khempeuh kip ding hi.
Ahih hangin a pa in a zak ni-in a lungkimlohna a tanu' tungah a gen leh, tuanu' thuciamna, amah a kikhih tawmna kamciamnate khat zong kiplo ding hi. A pa in nial ahih manin { Topa } in tuanu maisak ding hi.
Ahih hangin, a pasal in tua thu a zak ni-in a lungkimlohna a gen leh, amah a kikhih tawmna ahi numei' tunga om kamciamna leh ngaihsun lopi-in a kampaunate amah in phiatsak ding a, { Topa } in tuanu maisak ding hi.
"Ahih hangin meigong numei' thuciamna ahi a, a ki-ma numei' thuciamna ahi zongin, amah a kikhih tawmna peuhmah ama tungah kip ding hi.
a pasal in za a, a zi' tungah bangmah ciloin, a nial kei leh, ama thuciamna khempeuh kip ding a, amah a kikhih tawmna thuciamna khempeuh zong kip ding hi.
Ahih hangin a pasal in tua thute a zak ni-in a phiatsak leh, ama thuciamna tawh kisai-in a kam panin a gingkhia peuhmah ahi a, amahmah a kamciamna tawh kisaite ahi zongin kiplo ding hi. A pasal in tuate phiatsak ahih manin { Topa } in tuanu maisak ding hi.

A kha masa, tua kha ni sawm leh ni nga ni-in Rameses panin amaute dingkhia uh hi. Paisan Pawi masa ni khit a zing ciangin Egypt mite khempeuh' muhna-ah gualzawhna tawh Israel mite paikhia uh a,

Etham panin dingkhia uh a, Baalzefon nisuahna lama om Pihahiroth lamah kihei kik uh a, Migdol mai-ah giahphual sat uh hi.

Marah panin dingkhia uh a, Elim tung uh hi. Elim-ah cik tuikhuk sawmlenih leh nisuh kung sawmsagih om a, amaute in tua lai-ah giahphual sat uh hi.

San Tuipi panin dingkhia uh a, Sin sehnel gamah giahphual sat uh hi.
Sin gam panin dingkhia uh a, Dofkah-ah giahphual sat uh hi.

Sinai gam panin dingkhia uh a, Kibrothhattaavah-ah giahphual sat uh hi.
Kibrothhattaavah panin dingkhia uh a, Hazeroth-ah giahphual sat uh hi.
Hazeroth panin dingkhia uh a, Rithmah-ah giahphual sat uh hi.

Note in na minam uh tawh kizui-in aisaanna tawh leitang na luah ding uh hi. Minam tamte tungah a tam na pia ding uh a, minam tawmte tungah a tawm na pia ding uh hi. Mi khatpeuh-a' ding ai a phatna peuhpeuh ama-a' hi ding a, na pate uh nam tawh kizui-in na luah ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin note' mai panin tua gama teng mite na hawlkhiat kei uh leh, na omsak lai uh mite pen na mittang uh a hong do, na pang uh a hong sun lingte tawh hong kibang ding uh a, na ten'na gam uhah note hong gimsak ding uh hi.

"Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Jordan kantanin Kanaan gamah na tun' uh ciangin,
sawmlopi-in mi khatpeuh a thatkha mi thatte a va tai theihna ding, note-a' dingin bukna khuapi dingin khuapite na teel ding uh hi.
Thu kikhen dingin mihonpi mai-ah a din' ma-in mi thatte a sihlohna dingin tua khuapite pen phulapa' kiang panin note-a' dingin bukna hi ding hi.
Sawmlopi-in mi khatpeuh a thatkhate a tai theihna dingin hih khuapi gukte pen Israel mite, khualmite, leh note' lakah a peemte-a' dingin bukna hi ding hi.
"Ahih hangin mi khat in na-a kizang sik khat tawh midang khat satin a sih leh, amah mi that hi a, tua mi thatpa kithat ding hi.
Amah in mi a sih theihna ding mah ahi a khutsunga om suang khat tawh a suk a, a sih leh, amah mi that hi a, tua mi thatpa kithat ding hi.
Tua ahih kei leh, amah in mi a sih theihna ding ahi a khutsunga om sing a kibawl hiam khat tawh amah a sat a, a sih leh, mi that hi a, tua mi thatpa kithat ding hi.
A kinaipih pen khat in a phu la-in mi thatpa that ding a, amah a tuahna peuhah that ding hi.
tua ahih kei leh galbawlna tawh a khutin tumin a sih leh, tua a tumpa kithat ding hi. Amah mi that hi a, a phulapa in a tuah ciangin tua mipa that ding hi.
ahih kei leh, amah pen ama gal hilo, ama siatna ding a zong hilo napi-in, mi a sih theihna ding suang khat zangin a muh lohpi-in amah in deng kha-in a sih leh,
tua mi thatpa leh a phulapa' kikalah hih ngeina kipte tawh kizui-in mihonpi in khen ding hi.
A phulapa' khutsung panin mihonpi in mi thatpa honkhia-in, mihonpi in amah a va taina, bukna khuapi-ah amah puakkik ding a, sathau siangtho a kinilh siampi lianpenpa a sih matengin tua khua-ah a teng ding hi.
a phulapa in ama bukna khuapi daihual pualamah amah mu-in, a phulapa in mi thatpa a thah leh, tua a thatpa mawhlo ding hi.

"Hihte pen na ten'na khempeuh uhah na khang tawntungun thukham leh ngeina hi ding hi.

Tua thamloin, sihna thuak dingin a kilawm mipa tatna ding sum na sang kei ding uh hi; amah kithat ding hi.
Siampi lianpenpa a sih ma-in bukna khuapi-ah a taisa mipa a gamah a ciahkik theihna dingin ama nuntakna tatna ding sum na sang kei ding uh hi.
Na ten'na uh leitang na ninsak kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh mi thahna in leitang ninsak a, a that mipa a kithah kei buang leh, tua mi kithahna leitang sian'sakna ding thudang om theilo hi.
A laizangah keimah ka ten'na leitang na ninsak kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } keimah, Israel mite' laizangah ka teng hi, ci hi, ci-in gen in," a ci hi.

{ Topa } in Moses a thupiak bangin Zelofehad' tanute gamta uh hi.

Hihte pen Jerikho nai Jordan kiang Moab zanglei-ah Israel mite tungah Moses tung tawnin { Topa } in a piak thupiaknate leh ngeina kipte ahi hi.
Hihte pen Jordan galkhat gamlak, Suf galkhat Arabah gamsung, Paran leh Tofel, Laban, Hazeroth leh Dizahab kikalah Moses in Israel-te khempeuh tungah a gen thute ahi hi.
Heshbon gamah a teng Amor kumpipa Sihon, leh Ashtaroth leh Edrei gamah a teng Bashan kumpipa a zawh khit ciangin, a kum sawmlina, kha sawm leh kha khatna, a ni masa ni-in, amaute' tungah thupiakna-in { Topa } in ama tungah a piak bangbangin Moses in Israel mite tungah a gen hi.
"Horeb gam sungah { Topa } i Pasian in eite' kiangah, 'Hih mualah sauvei na om khinzo uh hi.
Kithawi-in na khualzin uh kipan kik un la, Amor mite' mualtung gam leh Arabah kiim, mualtung gam, lei niamna gam, Negeb gam khempeuh, leh Kanaan mite' gam tuipi gei leh Lebanon, gun golpi ahi Eufratis gun dongin pai un.
En un, note' mai-ah leitang ka koihzo hi. Pai un la, { Topa } in na pate uh Abraham, Isaac, Jakob, leh amau' nunga a suanlekhakte uh tungah piak dingin a ciam leitang luah un,' hong ci hi.
{ Topa } na Pasian un note tampi hong phasakzo hi. En un, note tuhunin vantung aksite zahin tampi na pha uh hi.
{ Topa, } na pate uh Pasian in tu-a zah tulin note hong bawl hen la, note tungah hong ciamsa bangin thupha hong pia ta hen!
Kei guak in note' thu kineihnate sian'sakna ding tavuan lianpi bangci puakzawh ding ka hi hiam?
Na minam uh tawh a kizui-in a pil, thuthei, thuphawksa mite teel un la, note' lutangin amaute ka koih ding hi,' kong ci hi.
Note in, 'Nangma hong gen thu pen kote-a' dingin hoih hi,' ci-in nong dawng uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin na minam lutang uh ahi, a pil thu phawksa mite ka la a, note' tungah lutangin a tul uk, a za uk, a sawmnga uk, a sawm ukte, leh uliante na minam khempeuh sung uhah ka koih hi.
"Tua hun laitakin na thukhente uh ka thuhilh a, 'Na sanggamte uh thu neihte za un la, mi khat leh a sanggampa ahi a, amah tawh a om khualmipa tawh ahi zongin thu a mantakin khen un.
Thukhenna-ah angvan na nei kei ding uh hi. A neu leh a liante a kibangin a thu na ngai ding uh a, maitang zahtak tuam na nei kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh thukhenna pen Pasian-a' ahi hi. Note-a' dingin a haksa lua thute kei kiangah nong paipih ding uh a, keimah in tua thu ka za ding hi,' ka ci hi.
"Tua ciangin Horeb gam panin i dingkhia a, { Topa } i Pasian in hong thupiak bangin Amor mite' mualtung gam zuatna lamkalah note' muhsa a lian a lauhuai sehnel gam i nawk khit ciangin Kadeshbarnea i tung hi.
Tua ciangin note' kiangah, '{ Topa } i Pasian in eite hong piak Amor mite' mualtung gam na tung khin uh hi.
En un, { Topa } na Pasian un note' mai-ah leitang koihzo hi. { Topa, } na pate uh Pasian in note tungah hong gensa bangin paito-in luah un. Lau kei un la, lungkia kei un,' kong ci hi.
"Tua ciangin na vekpi-un ka kiangah nong pai uh a, 'Eite-a' dingin gam va enin, i paitohna ding lampi leh i zuat ding khuapite hong genkik thei ding eite' mai-ah mi sawl ni,' nong ci uh hi.
"Tua thu hoihtuak ka sa a, minam khatah khat, note mi sawmlenih kong la hi.
Amaute in tua gam singgah pawlkhat a khutun hong tawi-in i kiangah hong tun'pihsuk uh a, amaute in eite kiangah thu hong zasak kikin, '{ Topa } i Pasian in eite hong piak gam pen leitang hoih ahi hi,' hong ci uh hi.
"Ahi zongin note paito nuamloin, { Topa } na Pasian un hong thupiak na nial uh hi.
Na puanbukte uh sungah na phun uh a, '{ Topa } in eite hong mudah ahih manin eite a hong susia ding Amor mite' khutsungah hong pia dingin Egypt gam panin eite hong paikhiatpih hi.
Koi lai-ah paito ding ihi hiam? I sanggamte in i lungsim hong siasak khin uh a, "A mite ei sangin lianzaw-in sangzaw uh hi. A khuapite lianin van banin ki-um hi. Tua thamloin Anak mite tua munah ka mu uh hi," hong ci uh hi,' na ci uh hi.
"Tua ciangin note kiangah, 'Lau kei un la, amaute kihta kei un.

"{ Topa } in note' thu hong za a, a heh suakin kiciam a,

amah a mudah mite, suksiatna tawh a thukpahpa ahihna thei un. Amah a mudah mi tungah zekai loin a maitang mahah thuk ding hi.
"Note in hih ngeina kipte za-in, kemin tuate na zuihna hangun, { Topa } na Pasian un na pu na pate uh tungah a ciam thuciamna leh itna kip note tungah hong tungsak ding hi.
Amah in note hong itin, tampi hong phasak ding hi. Amah in note tungah piak dingin na pu na pate uh tungah a ciam gam sungah note' suanlekhakte leh na gamsung panun a piangte, na an uh leh na leenggahzu uh leh na sathau uh, leh na ganhingte uh pungsakin, na tuulekeelno honte uh zong thupha pia ding hi.

{ Topa } in note' tung panin natna khempeuh lakhia ding hi. Note in na theihsa uh ahi Egypt gama natna siate note' tungah khat zong hong tunglo ding a, ahih hangin no hong mudahte khempeuh tungah tuate tungsak ding hi.
{ Topa } na Pasian un note tungah hong piak mi khempeuh na beisak ding uh a, amaute na khasiat kei ding uh hi. Note-a' dingin thangzak hi ding ahih manin amau' pasian-te zong na bia kei ding uh hi.

Tua hi kei leh note lakah gu a nei gah kha a gah singkung hong bang ding a, hih kiciamna kammalte za napi-in a lungsimah amah thupha kipia tawmin, 'Ka lungsim khauhna tawh ka gamta zongin ka suakta veve ding hi,' a ci hong om khading hi. Hih in mihoih leh misia, a kibangin phiatkhiatna hong suaksak ding hi.
{ Topa } in amah maisaklo ding a, { Topa' } hehna leh hazatna meikhu bangin tua mipa' langkhatah khuzaw-in, hih laibu sunga kigelh samsiatnate ama tungah tu ding a, { Topa } in a mun khempeuh panin ama min phiat ding hi.
{ Topa } in hih thukham laibu sunga a kigelh thuciam samsiatnate khempeuh tawh kizui-in gimna a thuak dingin Israel minamte khempeuh lak panin amah tengkhia ding hi.
"Hong khanglai ding, note' nungah hong piang na tate uh, leh a gamla gam panin a hong pai gamdang mite in, tua gam' gimngahna leh { Topa } in a natsak cinatnate a muh uh ciangin,
'A gambup pen kaat leh ci, leh nin a kangtum, khai kituhlo, bangmah polo, lopa zong a po zawhlohna mun Sodom leh Gomorrah, Admah leh Zeboiim bangin a kilawnthal gawp, a hehna leh a sinsona tawh { Topa' } lotgawpte tawh kibang hi,' ci ding uh hi.
Minam khempeuhte in, 'Bang hangin { Topa } in hih bangin hih gam bawl ahi hiam? Hih hehna lian, bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?' ci takpi ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin mite in, 'Amah in Egypt gam panin a paikhiatpih lai-in amaute tawh a bawl, a pu a pate uh Pasian ahi { Topa' } thuciamna amaute in nusia-in,
a theih nailoh uh pasian-te leh amah in amaute tungah a piakloh pasian dangte' na va semin a biakna hang uh ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a mite tungah { Topa } heh mahmah a, hih laibu sunga om samsiatnate khempeuh hih leitungah tungsak hi.
{ Topa } in hehna, sinsona, lungham mahmahna tawh a leitang panun amaute zunglot a, tuni-a i muh bangin amaute gamdangah hawlkhia hi,' ci ding uh hi.
"{ Topa } i Pasian in hong lahkhiat loh thusim om a, ahih hangin hih thukham sunga om thute khempeuh i zuih theihna dingin hong lakkhia a, eite leh i suan i khakte' zuih tawntung ding ahi hi.
"Note' mai-ah ka koih, na teel ding thu thupha leh samsiatna, hih nate khempeuh note tungah hong tungin, { Topa } in note hong hawlkhiatna minamte lakah hih thute phawk kikin,
{ Topa } note' Pasian' kiangah note leh na suan na khakte uh paikikin, na lungsim khempeuh uh leh na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh tuni-a kong gen ama thute na man' uh ciangin,
{ Topa } na Pasian un note na ngei uh hong bangsak kikin, note tungah hehpihna hong nei ding a, { Topa } na Pasian un note hong thehthangna mi khempeuhte lak panin note hong kaikhawm kik ding hi.
A kihawlkhia na mite uh van mong pekah a om leh zong, { Topa } na Pasian un tua lai panin note hong khawmin, tua lai panin amah in hong paipih ding hi.
Note in na neih theihna dingun, na pu na pate uh neih leitangah, { Topa } na Pasian un hong paipih ding a, na pu na pate uh sangin a citheizaw a tamzaw-in note hong bawl ding hi.
Note in na lungsim khempeuh uh leh na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh { Topa } na Pasian uh itin na hin'theihna dingun, { Topa } na Pasian un note leh na suanlekhakte uh tungah thu man' nopna lungsim hong guan' ding hi.
{ Topa } na Pasian un hih samsiatnate khempeuh, no hong bawlsia na galte uh leh na langte uh tungah tungsak ding hi.
Note in { Topa' } thu mangkikin, tuni-a kong gen ama thupiaknate khempeuh na zui ding uh hi.
Note in hih thukham laibu sunga kigelh ama thupiaknate leh ama thukhamte zui-in, { Topa } na Pasian uh thu na man' uh a, na lungsim khempeuh uh leh na nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh { Topa } na Pasian uh lamah na kihei uh leh, { Topa } na Pasian un na sepna khempeuh uh, note' suanlekhakte, na ganhingte uh panin a piangte, leh na leitang panun a piang khempeuhah nakpi takin hong daupaisak ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh na pu na pate uh tungah amah a lungkim mah bangin note tungah { Topa } hong lungkim kik ding a, note hong daupaisak ding hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh tuni-a kong gen hih thupiakna pen note-a' dingin a haksa lua hilo a, na zuihlah ding uh zong hilo hi.
Note in, 'Eite in a thu za-in i sep theihna dingin kua in vantungah eite-a' dingin hong paisakin hong laksak ding ahi hiam?' na cih theihna dingun vantunga om hilo hi.
Note in, 'Eite in a thu za-in i sep theihna dingin kua in tuipi galkhatah hong paisakin hong laksak ding ahi hiam?' na cih theihna dingun tuipi gala om zong hilo hi.
A thu, hong nai mahmah hi. Note in na hih theihna dingun na kamsung uh leh na lungsim sung uhah om hi.
"Tuni-in na teel dingun note' mai-ah nuntakna leh a hoih na, sihna leh siatna ka koih khinzo hi.
{ Topa } na Pasian uh itna, ama lampite totna, ama thupiaknate leh ama thukhamte leh ama ngeina kipte zuihna tawh, tuni-a no tungah kong gen ahi { Topa } na Pasian uh thupiaknate na man' uh leh, note nungta-in tampi na pha ding uh a, a luah dingin note na lutna uh leitang tungah { Topa } na Pasian un note thupha hong pia ding hi.
Ahih hangin na lungsim uh kihei-in, note in amah zuiloin, pasian dangte a bia ding leh a na a sem dingin note na kiheikhiat uh leh,
tuni-in note tungah hih thu kong genkhol hi: Note na si ding uh a, Jordan kantanin note a lut ding leh a nei dingin na paina uh leitang tungah sauvei na nungta kei ding uh hi.
Tuni-in note' langkhatah teci a pang dingin vantung leh leitung ka sam a, note' mai-ah na teel dingun nuntakna leh sihna, thupha leh samsiatna ka koih hi. Tua ahih ciangin note leh na suanlekhakte uh na hin'theihna dingun nuntakna teel un la,
{ Topa } na Pasian uh itin, ama thu mangin, amah beel un; bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in na pu na pate uh Abraham, Isaac, leh Jakob tungah piak dingin a kiciamsa leitangah note na ten'theihna dingun tua pen note-a' dingin nuntakna leh khan'sauna ahi hi," a ci hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, "Tuni-in kei kum za leh kum sawmnih ka pha ta a, keima ut bangin ka gamtangzo nawn kei hi. { Topa } in kei kiangah, 'Hih Jordan galkhatah na pai kei ding hi,' hong cizo hi.
{ Topa } na Pasian mahmah uh note' mai-ah hong galkah ding hi. Note' mai-ah hih minamte amah in susia ding a, note in amaute na suankhia ding uh hi. { Topa' } gensa bangin note' mai-ah Joshua hong galkah ding hi.
{ Topa } in amaute a suksiat lai-in, Amor kumpi Sihon leh Og tung leh amau' leitang tungah a bawl bangin amaute tungah bawl ding hi.
{ Topa } in note tungah amaute hong pia ding a, note kong piak thupiaknate khempeuh tawh kizui-in amaute tungah na bawl ding uh hi.
Thahat un la, hang un. Lau kei un la, amaute kihta kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh note tawh hong paipa pen { Topa } na Pasian uh ahi hi. Note hong cimawhsaklo ding a, hong nusialo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses in Joshua samin, Israel-te khempeuh muhin ama kiangah, "Thahat in la hang in. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute tungah piak dingin { Topa } in amau' pute pate tungah a ciamsa leitangah hih mite tawh na pai ding a, nangmah in tua leitang amaute na ngahsak ding hi.
Na mai-ah a paipa pen { Topa } ahi hi. Amah in nang hong ompih ding a, nang hong cimawhsak loin, zong hong nusialo ding hi. Lau kei in la, lungkia kei in," a ci hi.
Moses in hih Thukham gelhin { Topa' } Thuciamna Singkuang a pua Levi mi siampite leh upate khempeuh tungah a pia hi.
Moses in amaute thu pia-in, "Kum sagih a cin' sim, a kisehsa suahtaksakna hun, buk pawi hunin,
amah in a teelna mun { Topa } na Pasian uh mai-ah a kilak dingin Israel-te khempeuh a pai uh ciangin, amau' zakin Israel-te khempeuh mai-ah hih thukham na sim ding uh hi.
Jordan galkhatah a luah dingin na paina uh gamah na nuntak laitengun amaute in a thu za-in { Topa } na Pasian uh zahtak ding a theihna ding, leh hih thukham thute khempeuh limtakin a sep theihna ding, leh hih thu a thei nailo amau' tate in { Topa } na Pasian uh zahtak ding a theihna dingun, numei, pasal, leh naupangte, leh na khuapite uh sunga om peemtate, mi khempeuh khawm un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in Moses kiangah, "En in, na sih ding hun hong nai ta hi. Joshua sam in la, amah ka sawl theihna dingin kikhopna buk sungah hong om un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Moses leh Joshua pai-in kikhopna buk sungah va om uh hi.
Tua ciangin meii khuam omna puanbuk sungah { Topa } kilang hi. Meii khuam, puanbuk kong gei-ah a ding hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in Moses kiangah, "En in, na pu na pate kiang a zuan ding na hita hi. Nang na om nawnloh ciangin hih mite pen na paina uh mite lakah a gamsung pasian-te uh tawh paktat ding uh a, amaute in kei hong nusia-in amaute tawh ka bawl ka thuciamna uh siasak ding uh hi.
Tua hun ciangin amaute tungah ka sin so-in, amaute nusia-in ka mai ka seel ding a, amaute beimang ding uh hi. Tua ni ciangin amaute in, 'Eite' lakah i Pasian a omloh manin hih siatnate i tungah hong tung hilo ahi hiam?' a cih theihna dingun amaute tungah siatna leh gimna tampi tung ding hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin hih lai gelh in la, Israel mite hilh in. Hih la, kei-a' dingin Israel mite' langkhatah teci a suah theihna dingin amaute tungah hilh in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a pu a pate uh tungah piak dinga ka kiciamna, bawngnawi leh khuaizu tui bangin a luan'na gamah amaute tun'pih khinin, amaute in ne-in khamin a thau khit uh ciangin, pasian dangte a bia dingin kihei-in kei hong simmawhin ka thuciamna siasak ding uh hi.
Siatna leh haksatnate amaute tungah a tun' ciangin hih la, teci-in amaute' langkhatah pang ding hi (bang hang hiam cih leh a suanlekhakte un mangngilhlo ding uh hi); bang hang hiam cih leh piak dingin ka kiciam leitangah amaute ka paipih ma-in, amau' vaihawm kholh a ngimnate uh ka thei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in Nun' tapa Joshua sawlin, "Thahat in la hang in; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute piak dingin ka kiciam leitang tungah Israel mite na paipih ding a, nang tawh kong om ding hi," a ci hi.
Moses in { Topa' } Thuciamna Singkuang a pua Levi mite thu pia a,
"Hih Thukham laibu la un la, note' langkhatah teci dingin a om theihna dingin { Topa } na Pasian uh Thuciamna Singkuang gei-ah koih un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a lehdo mite leh a lungkhauh thei mite na hihna uh ka thei hi. En un, note tawh kei a nungta khawm laipi mahin, tuni-in { Topa } na lehdo khin uh hi. Ka sih khit ciangin bangzah takin lehdozaw lai ding na hi uh hiam!
Hih thute amaute' bilah genin, amau' langkhatah teci a pang dingin vantung leh leitung ka sap theihna dingin na minam upate uh leh na uliante khempeuh uh kei kiangah hong khawm un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka sih khit ciangin note sia gamtatin, note kong sawlna lampi panin na pial taktak ding lam uh ka thei hi. Note' sepna tawh amah hehsakin, { Topa' } muhna-ah a sia gamta ding na hih manun, hong pai ding hunte-ah, note' tungah gimna hong tung ding hi," a ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa' } min ka phat ding hi. Eite' Pasian a liatna gen un!
"Eite' belh { Topa, } a nasepna kicing a, ama sepna khempeuh thumanna ahi hi. Thumanna nei-in, mawhna a neilo Pasian hi a, amah thutangin thuman hi.
Ama tungah amaute gamtat sia uh a, amaute' sitbaan'na hangin ama tate hi nawnlo uh hi. Amaute pen a lampial, a lungsim kawi khang mite ahi uh hi.
A hai, ngaihsutna neilo mite aw, tua bangin { Topa } thuk ding na hi uh hiam? Amah pen, note a hong piangsak, note hong bawlin a hong kipsak, na pa uh hilo ahi hiam?
"A beisa hunte phawk un la, khang tampi hunte ngaihsun un. Na pate uh dong le-uh cin, hong hilh ding uh a, na upate uh dong le-uh cin hong gen ding uh hi.
Sang Penpa in minam dangte tungah amau' gamh pia a, mihingte a ten'na ding mun a seh ciangin vantung mi a phazah tawh a kizui-in mite' gamgi a phut hi.
Ahi zongin { Topa' } tanh pen ama mite hi a, Jakob' suante pen a kipia ama luah ahi hi.
"Amah in sehnel gam, huihpi nun'na gam sungah amaute mu hi. Amah in amaute kawi-in kem a, ama mitnauta bangin amaute kem hi.
{ Topa } bek mah in amaute makaih a, amaute kiangah gamdang pasian omlo hi.
"Amah in leitung a sangna-ah amaute tuangsak a, amaute in gamlak pana piangte a ne uh hi. Suangpi panin amaute khuaizu hup sakin, meisuang tawh a kibang suang panin sathau a nesak hi.
Bawnghon panin bawngnawi thaukhal, tuuhon panin tuunawi, tuunote leh tuutalte' thau tawh, Bashan bawnghonte leh keelte, mangbuh hoihpente tawh leenggahtui san na dawn uh hi.
"Israel mite thau mahmah uh a, a lehdo thei mi suak uh hi. Note thau-in lianpi pha-in, na zol uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute a bawl Pasian amaute in nusia-in, amau a Honkhiapa thusimlo uh hi.
Amaute pen pasian dangte tawh ama hazat theihna dingin gamta uh a, a kihhuai gamtatnate tawh amaute in amah hehsak uh hi.
Amaute in pasian a hilo dawite, amau' theih ngeiloh pasian-te, hong suak nunung pasian thakte, na pu na pate un a theih ngeiloh pasian-te' tungah biakna a pia uh hi.
Note a hong Honkhiapa na phawk kei uh a, note a hong suaksak Pasian na mangngilh uh hi.
"{ Topa } in tua thu thei a, a tapate leh a tanute in amah hehsak uh ahih manin tua ama tate a nolh hi.
Amah in, 'Amaute' kiang panin ka mai ka seel ding a, amaute' thumong bang hong hi hiam, ka en ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute a lampial khang mite hi a, cihtakna a neilo tate ahi uh hi.
Amaute in pasian a hilote tawh ka hazatna ding hong bawl uh a, a milimte uh tawh kei hong hehsak uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin mi-a a gen taaklo mite tawh amaute' hazat theihna ding ka bawl ding a, a hai mahmah minam khat tawh amaute ka hehsak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka hehna in mei tawhkuang a, Leinuaite' gamdong a kuang hi. Leitung leh a tunga piangte kangtum a, mualte' bulpite kuangsak hi.
" 'Amaute' tungah siatna ka khol ding a, amaute' tungah ka thaltangte ka zang ding hi.
Gilkialin amaute si ding uh a, a sa mahmah meikuang leh gunei natna in amaute netum ding hi. Keimah in amaute a pet dingin ha hiam a nei gamsate amaute a tu dingin gu a nei gulte ka sawl ding hi.
Namsau in gamlakah amaute susia-in, inn sungah launa lianpi om ding a, tangval leh nungak, naungek nawi nete, samkangte tawh susia khawm ding hi.
Amau' langte in ngaihsun khialin, amaute in, "Eite i gualzo hi. { Topa } in hihte khempeuh bawllo hi," hong ci khading uh ahih manin galte' hong phin ding ka lau hi,' a ci hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute, ngaihsutna a neilo minam hi a, amaute' sungah thu theihtelna omlo hi.
Amaute a pil hi leh, hih thu theitel ding uh a, amau' thu tawpna mu ding uh!
Amau a Honkhiapa in amaute zuakin, { Topa } in amaute piakhia kei leh bangci-in mi khat in mi tul khat delh mangin, mi nih in mi tul sawm taisakzo ding ahi hiam?
Bang hang hiam cih leh i galte' pasian eite' Pasian bang hilo a, i galte' thungetna a mawkna ahi hi.
Amaute, Sodom leh Gomorrah bangin siahuai uh a, gu nei-in a kha leenggah a gah leenggui tawh kibang uh hi.
Amau' leenggahzu pen gulpi gu leh a gupha gul gunei gu tawh kibang hi.
"Hihte kei kiangah kikholin, ka vankoihna sungah kisincip hilo ahi hiam?
Phulakna leh thukkikna kei-a' hi a, a hun ciangin amaute puk ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau' gimngah hun ding hong naita a, amau' siatna ding hong tung pah hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute' vang a beina leh sila leh sila a hilote a beina a muh ciangin { Topa } in a mite' dikna kilangsak ding a, ama nasemte tungah hehpihna nei ding hi.
amaute' biakpiakna thau ne-in, leenggahzu tawh a biakna uh a dawnte koi-ah om ahi hiam? Amaute thosakin note kihuhsak un la, amaute, na kidalna uh hisak un!
"'Tu-in thei un, keimah a kicipa pen kei ka hi a, kei simloh pasian dang kuamah omlo hi. Ka that a, ka nungtasak hi. Ka liamsak a, ka damsak hi. Ka khutsung pan a honkhiazo kuamah omlo hi.
Ka thaltangte si ka tawksak ding ding a, ka namsau in mi that ding hi — a kithatte leh a kimante, kei hong langpangte, sugawp ding hi,' a ci hi.
"{ Topa' } mite phat un, no minam dangte aw; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a nasemte' phu la a, alangte thuk-in, ama mite' gam-a' dingin kilemna a bawl hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Moses hong pai-in, mite' zakin amah leh Nun' tapa Joshua in hih la malte khempeuh a sut uh hi.
amaute kiangah, "Hih thu khempeuh limtakin zui un la, na tate un a zuih dingin na hilh theihna dingun tuni-a note tungah kong gen thu khempeuh na lungsim uhah koih un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh hih pen note-a' dingin a thuneu hiloin note' nuntakna hi a, a luah dingin Jordan galkhat na paina uh gam sungah hih thu tawh sauveipi na hing ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ni mahmahin { Topa } in Moses kiangah,
Hor Mual tungah na sanggampa Aaron si-in a mite kiangah a kigawm bangin, na kahtohna mualtungah si in la, na mite kiangah pai-in kigawm in.
Amah in, "Sinai panin { Topa } hong pai a, Sinai panin eite-a' ding hong suakkhia hi. Paran Mual panin hong taangkhia a, a taklam khutah meikuang tawi-in, mi siangtho tul sawmte kiang panin a hong pai hi.
Hi taktak hi; amah in a mite it a, ama tungah a ki-ap mi khempeuh a khutsungah om hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in na kalsuanna hong zui uh a, nang tung panin lamlahna ngah uh hi.
Mite' makaite kikhawmin, Israel minamte khempeuh a kikaihkhop ciangin, ama mi Israel-te lakah { Topa, } kumpi a suak hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Judah minamte' thu genin, "{ Topa } aw, Judah' aw ngai in la, a mite kiangah amah paipih in. Na khutte tawh ama-a' ding do in la, a galte' dona-ah a huhpa hi in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Levi minamte' thu genin, "Levi tungah na Thummim pia in la, na midikpa tungah na Urim pia in. Massah-ah na ze-et mipa, Meribah tuite-ah na kitotpihpa ahi hi.
A nu leh a pa sangin nangmah hong thupi ngaihsutzaw uh a, 'Amaute ka thupi sim kei hi,' a cipa ahi hi. Amah in a sanggamte paaikhia-in, a tate donlo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Levi minamte in na thu hong mangin, na thuciamna zui uh hi.
{ Topa } aw, ama nate tungah thupha pia in la, a khut tawh a sepnate saang in. A galte' kawng sutan in la, a ding kikzo nawnlo dingin amah a mudahte sugawp in," a ci hi.
Benjamin minamte' thu genin, "{ Topa } in a it mipa ama kiangah nuam takin om hi. Amah in sun tawntung kemin, amaute lakah om hi," a ci hi.
Josef minamte' thu genin, "{ Topa } in ama leitang, tung lamah a om vantung letsong hoihpente, leh nuai-a om a thuknate tawh,
tanglai mualte tunga piang a hoih a limci pente leh tawntung mualte' hauhna tawh,
leitung leh a tunga om letsong hoihpente leh sawlbawk lakah a tengpa' maipha tawh thupha pia ta hen. Hihte khempeuh, Josef tungah tung hen la, a sanggamte lakah ulian ahi mipa' lu tungah tung ta hen.
Amaute in a mual uhah mite sam ding uh a, amaute in tua lai-ah biakpiakna mante pia ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in tuipi tung leh sehnel sungah na manpha kiseelte ngah uh hi," a ci hi.
Gad minamte' thu genin, "Gad a lianin a bawlpa in thupha ngah ta hen! Gad in humpinelkai bangin buk khikhe a, amah in a baan leh a luzang, a balkham hi.
Amah in lei hoihpenna mun ama-a' dingin teel hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a ukpa' tanh kikoihcingsak hi. Mi makaite' ngahte mah amah zong kingahsak a, amah in Israel-te tawh { Topa' } thupiakna leh thuman khennate a sem hi," a ci hi.
Naftali minamte thu genin, "O Naftali, maipha tawh nuam a sa, { Topa' } thupha tawh a kidim, bualtuite leh leitaw lam a neipa," a ci hi.
Asher minamte thu genin, "Asher in tapa dangte sangin thupha ngahzaw ta hen. A sanggamte' pahtak hi hen la, a gam sungah oliv thau kidim ta hen.

{ Topa } in ama nasem Moses a thupiak bangin Moses in zong Joshua thu pia a, Joshua zong tua bangmahin gamta a, { Topa } in Moses a thupiaknate khempeuh a hihloh omlo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Joshua in gam khempeuh, mualtung gam leh Negeb gam leh Goshen gam khempeuh leh lei niamna gam leh Arabah leh Israel-te' mualtung gam leh a lei niamna gamte,
Seir lamah a kikhungto Halak Mual panin Hermon Mual nuai Lebanon kuama om Baalgad ciangdong a la hi. Amah in amau' kumpite khempeuh la-in amaute vatgawpin a that hi.
Hih kumpite khempeuh leh Joshua sauveipi sung a kido hi.
Gibeon khua-a teng Hiv mite longal, Israel mite tawh kilemna a bawl khuapi khat zong omlo hi. Amaute in tua khua dangte khempeuh simin a lak uh ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in Moses a thupiakna bangin amaute a kisuksiat mangna ding leh hehpihna ngahloin a kibeisak theihna dingin Israel-te a dona dingin a lungsim uh a khauhsakpa pen { Topa } ahi hi.
Tua hun laitakin Joshua hong pai-in mualtung gam, Hebron, Debir, Anab, leh Judah mualtung gam khempeuh, leh Israel mualtung gam khempeuh panin Anak mite nawhkhia siang a, Joshua in a khuapite uh tawh amaute susiamang khawm hi.
Israel mite' leitangah Anak mite khat zong om nawnlo a, Gaza, Gath, leh Ashdod sung bekah pawlkhat omlai hi.
{ Topa } in Moses tungah a gensa bangin Joshua in leitang khempeuh a la hi. Tua ciangin Joshua in amau minam tawh kizui-in a ngah ding bangin Israel mite tungah gamh-in a pia hi. Tua huna kipan galdona panin tua gam a tawlnga hi.
Tu-in nisuahna lam Jordan galkhat, Arnon kuam panin Arabah khempeuh, Hermon Mual ciangdong Israel mite in a leitang uh laksakin a zawh kumpi nihte:
Heshbon-ah a teng Amor kumpi, Arnon kuam gei-a om Aroer pan, leh Gilead kuam laizang panin phellang ahi Ammon mite' gamgi Jabbok gun ciangdong, leh Arabah panin nisuahna lamah Khinneroth Tuipi, leh Bethjeshimoth lamah Pisgah mualpang bul leitaw lama om Ci Tuipi ahi Arabah tuipi ciangdong a uk Sihon;
leh Bashan kumpi, Refaim panin a suaktate lakah khat, Ashtaroth leh Edrei-ah tengin, Hermon Mual leh Salekah leh Bashan gam khempeuh, Geshur mite leh Maakath mite gamgi ciang, leh Gilead langkhat panin Heshbon kumpipa Sihon' gamgi ciangdong a uk Og ahi hi.
{ Topa' } nasem Moses leh Israel mite in amaute gel a zo uh hi. Tua ciangin { Topa' } nasem Moses in Reuben mite leh Gad mite leh Manasseh minam alangte tungah a neih dingun amau' leitang a pia hi.
Hihte pen, Joshua leh Israel mite in a zawh Jordan nitumna lampang, Lebanon kuam sung Baalgad panin Seir lamah a kikhungto Halak Mual kikala om kumpite ahi hi. (Joshua in mualtung gam, lei niamna gam, Arabah gam, mualpang suk, sehnel gam, leh Negeb gam sunga om Hit mite, Amor mite, Kanaan mite, Perez mite, Hiv mite, leh Jebus mite' leitangte Israel minamte' tungah amau' ngah ding tawh kizui-in a neih dingun a pia hi.)
Tirzah kumpi, khat; a vekpi-in kumpi sawmthumlekhat ahi hi.
Tu-in Joshua teekin a kum tampi pha hi. { Topa } in ama kiangah, "Nang teekin na kum tampi pha a, ahi zongin leitang lak ding tampi tak omlai hi.
A omlai leitang: Filistia gamsung khempeuh, leh Geshur gam khempeuh
(Kanaan mite' gam ci-a a kiciamteh, leilu lam Ekron gamgi lam, Egypt nisuahna lama om Shihor pan Filistia gam Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, leh Ekron gamte a uk mi nga om hi), leh Avvim gam,
leitaw lamah, Kanaan mite leitang khempeuh, leh Sidon mite gam ahi Mearah gam Amor mite gamgi ahi Afek ciang,
leh Gebal mite' leitang, leh Lebanon gam khempeuh, nisuahna lamah, Hermon Mual nuai-a Baalgad panin Hamath tumna ciang,
Lebanon leh Misrefothmaim kikalah a teng Sidon mite khempeuh ahi hi. Keimahmah in Israel mite' mai panin amaute ka hawlkhia ding a, nang kong thupiaksa bangin Israel mite tungah a luah dingun leitang hawm in.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in minam kua leh Manasseh minam alangte tungah luah dingin hih leitang hawm in," a ci hi.
Reuben mite leh Gad mite in Manasseh minam alang dang khatte tawh { Topa' } nasem Moses in amaute a piaksa ahih manin nisuahna lam Jordan galkhatah gamh ngah khin uh hi.
Arnon kuam monga om Aroer pan, leh kuam laizanga om khuapi, leh Dibon ciangdong Medeba mualzang khempeuh;
leh Ammon mite' gamgi ciangdong Heshbon-ah a uk Amor kumpi Sihon' khuapi khempeuh;
Gilead, leh Geshur mite leh Maakath mite' gam, leh Hermon Mual khempeuh, leh Salekah dong Bashan gam khempeuh;
Ashtaroth leh Edrei-ah a uk Bashan gam sunga Og kumpi gam khempeuh (Refaim-a a suak tate lakah amah bek om hi); Moses in hihte zo-in a hawlkhia hi.
Ahi zongin Israel mite in Geshur mite ahi a, Maakath mite ahi zongin hawlkhia lo uh a, tuni dongin Geshur mite leh Maakath mite Israel-te lakah a teng uh hi.
Levi minamte tung bekah Moses in gamh pialo hi. { Topa } in Moses kiangah a gensa mah bangin Israel-te' { Topa } Pasian' tungah a kipia mei tawh kihal biaknate pen amau' gamh ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amau' gamh pen Arnon kuam gei-a a om Aroer pan, leh kuam laizanga om khuapi, leh Medeba kianga mualzang khempeuh,
Heshbon tawh, leh mualzang tunga om a khuapite khempeuh; Dibon, Bamothbaal, Bethbaalmeon,
Kiriathaim, Sibmah, leh tua kuam mualtunga om Zereth-shahar,
Bethpeor, Pisgah pang suk, leh Bethjeshimoth hi a,
mualzang khuapite khempeuh, leh Heshbon-ah a uk, Moses in Midian makaite Evi, Reke, Zur, Hur, leh Reba, tua gama teng Sihon' uliante tawh a zawh khop ahi Amor kumpi gam khempeuh a huam ahi hi.
Beor' tapa, aisanpa Balaam zong, Israel mite in adang a thahte lakah namsau tawh thatkhawm uh hi.
Reuben mite' gampi pen Jordan ahi hi. Hihte pen amau' beh tawh kizui-in a khuapite leh a khuaneute tawh Reuben mite' gamhluah ahi hi.
Amau' gam pen Jazer, leh Gilead khuapite khempeuh, leh Rabbah nisuahna lamah a om Aroer ciangdong Ammon mite' leitang kimkhat,
leh Heshbon panin Ramathmizpeh leh Betonim ciang, leh Mahanaim panin Debir gam ciangdong,
leh Bethharam kuam sungah Bethnimrah, Sukkoth, leh Zafon, Jordan galkhat nisuahna lam, Khinnereth Tuipi a niamna lam mong ciang, Jordan gamgi-in a nei, Heshbon kumpipa Sihon' kumpi gam a omlai teng ahi hi.
Hihte pen amau' beh tawh kizui-in a khuapite leh a khuaneute tawh Gad mite' gamhluah ahi hi.
Amau' gam pen Mahanaim pan kipanin Bashan gamsung khempeuh, Bashan kumpipa Og' kumpi gamsung khempeuh, leh Bashan gamsunga om Jair khuapi sawmgukte,
leh Gilead alang, Ashtaroth, leh Edrei, Bashan gama Og' kumpi gam khempeuh ahi hi. Hihte amau' innkuan tawh kizui-in Makhir mi alangte-a' dingin Manasseh' tapa Makhir mite tungah kipia hi.
Ahih hangin Levi minamte tungah Moses in gamh pialo hi. Israel-te' { Topa } Pasian in amaute kiangah a gensa mah bangin amah pen amau' gamh ahi hi.
Hihte pen, siampi Eleazar, Nun tapa Joshua, leh Israel minam sung pan beh lutangte in amaute tungah a piak, Kanaan gamsungah Israel mite' ngah gamhte ahi hi.
Minam kua leh alangte-a' dingin { Topa } in Moses a thupiak bangin amau' gamhte aisanna tawh kipia hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Moses in Jordan galkhatah minam nih leh alangte tungah gamh pia khinzo hi. Ahih hangin amaute lakah Levi mite tungah bangmah pialo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Josef mite minam nihin kikhen a, Manasseh leh Efraim minamte ahi uh hi. Tua gam sungah Levi-te tungah tanh kipialo a, ahih hangin amau' ten'na ding khuapite leh a ganhingte uh-a' dingin a lonona gamte tawh kipia bek hi.
{ Topa } in Moses a thupiak bangin Israel mite gamta uh a, amaute in leitang a hawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin Judah minamte Gilgal-a Joshua kiangah pai uh a, amaute sung panin Kenaz mi Jefunneh tapa Kaleb in ama kiangah, "{ Topa } in Kadeshbarnea-ah Pasian mi Moses tungah nang leh kei' thu tawh kisai a gente na thei hi.
A gamsung thukansim dingin { Topa' } nasem Moses in Kadeshbarnea panin kei hong sawl lai-in kum sawmli ka pha a, ka lungsima om bangin ama kiangah thu ka tun'kik hi.
Ahih hangin kei tawh hong paito khawm ka sanggamte in mite lungkiasak uh a, ahi zongin keimah in lungsim tak tawh { Topa } ka Pasian ka zui hi.
Tua ni-in Moses kiciamin, 'Nangmah in { Topa } ka Pasian, lungsim tak tawh zui na hih manin na khe in a totsa leitang pen nang leh na tate-a' dingin gamh hi tawntung ding hi,' hong ci hi.
Tu-in, a cihsa bangin { Topa } in, Israel mite sehnel gamah a pai sung, { Topa } in hih thu Moses tungah a gen-a kipan hih kum sawmlilenga sung kei hong nungtasak a, tu-in kei kum sawmgiatlenga ka pha hi.
Moses in hong sawl hun lai mah bangin tuni-in kei ka tha hat lai a, galdona ding, leh kuankhiatna leh ciahkikna dingin ka thatang pen tua hun lai-a ka thatang mah bang lai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in tua ni-a { Topa' } gen hih mualtung gam kei hong pia in. Anak mite a muan'huai mahmah khuapi sungah a omna thu tua hun lai-in kong gen uh hi. { Topa } in kei hong ompih ding a, { Topa' } cih mah bangin amaute ka hawlkhiazo khading hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in { Topa}, Israel-te' Pasian, lungsimtak tawh zui ahih manin tuni dongin Hebron pen Kenaz mi Jefunneh' tapa Kaleb' gamh a suak hi.
Leitaw lam Akrabbim kahtohna-ah paikhia-in, Zin dong ban a, Kadeshbarnea leitaw lamah Hezron dung tawnin Addar ciangdong paito-in Karka lamah kihei a,
Azmon ciangdong pai-in Egypt lui-ah suakkhia a, tuipi-ah a mong bei hi. Hih pen amau' leitaw lam gamgi hi ding hi.
Tua ciangin nisuahna lam gamgi pen Jordan tun'na ciangdong Ci Tuipi ahi hi. Leilu lampang gamgi pen Jordan tun'na tuipi dawk panin kipan hi.
Akhor Kuam panin Debir-ah paito a, leilu lam manawhin, tua kuam leitaw lampangah a om, Adummim kahtohna galkhatah a om Gilgal lamah kihei hi. Tua ciangin Enshemesh luidungah gamgi pai-in Enrogel-ah tawp hi.
{ Topa } in Joshua tungah a thupiak bangin Jefunneh tapa Kaleb tungah amah in Judah mite lakah tanh khat Kiriatharba, Hebron a cihna, (Arba pen Anak' pa hi) pia hi.
Tua lai panin Kaleb in Anak' tapa thumte Sheshai, Ahiman, leh Talmai, Anak' suanlekhakte a hawlkhia hi.
Tua ciangin Kaleb' sanggampa Kenaz' tapa Othniel in la a, amah in a zi dingin a tanu Aksah a pia hi.
Tuanu ama kiangah a pai ding ciangin ama pa' tung panin lo khat a nget ding hah gen hi. A la tung panin tuanu a kum ciangin Kaleb in tuanu kiangah, "Bang ut na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in, "Letsong khat hong pia in. Negeb gamah kei hong koih na hih buangin cik tuikhukte zong hong pia in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Kaleb in tuanu tungah ciktui tungnungte leh ciktui nuainungte a pia hi.
Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, leh Rimmon: a vekpi-in khuapi sawmnihlekua, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi.
Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, leh Gederothaim: khuapi sawmleli, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi.
Gederoth, Bethdagon, Naamah, leh Makkedah: khuapi sawmleguk, a khuaneute tawh zong ahi hi.
Keilah, Akzib, leh Mareshah: khuapi kua, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi.
Ekron a khuapite leh a khuaneute tawh ahi hi.
Ekron panin tuipi dong, Ashdod lampanga omte khempeuh a khuaneute tawh ahi hi.
Ashdod, a khuapite leh a khuaneute tawh ahi hi. Gaza, a khuapite leh a khuaneute tawh ahi hi. Egypt lui leh tuipi lian a gei ciangdong tawh ahi hi.
Goshen, Holon, leh Giloh: khuapi sawmlekhat, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi.
Humtah, Kiriatharba (Hebron a cihna), leh Zior: khuapi kua, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi.
Kain, Gibeah, leh Timnah: khuapi sawm, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi.
Maarath, Bethanoth, leh Eltekon: khuapi guk, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi.
Kiriathbaal (Kiriathjearim a cihna), leh Rabbah: khuapi nih, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi.
Nibshan, Ci Khuapi, leh Engedi: khuapi guk, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi.
Ahih hangin Judah mite in Jerusalem-a a teng Jebus mite hawlkhia zolo uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin tuni dongin Jebus mite pen Judah mite tawh Jerusalem-ah a tengkhawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin nitumna lam Jaflet mite' gam lam Bethhoron a niam lam gam ciangdongah paisuk hi. Tua ciangin Gezer-ah pai-in tuipi-ah tawp hi.
Josef' suan Manasseh, leh Efraim mite in amau' gamhluah dingin hih gamte ngah uh hi.
Janoah panin Ataroth leh Naarah-ah paisuk a, Jerikho banin Jordan-ah tawp hi.
Manasseh mite' gamhluah sung panin Efraim mite-a' dingin a kikhenkhia khuapite, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi.
Ahi zongin amaute in Gezer sunga teng Kanaan mite hawlkhialo uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin tuni dongin Kanaan mite pen Efraim mite lakah teng a, ahih hangin aana nasep a sem dingin sal a suak uh hi.
Tua ciangin Josef' tacil ahih manin Manasseh minam tungah tanh kipia hi. Manasseh minam sung panin tacil, Gilead' pa Makhir tungah Gilead gam leh Bashan gam kipia hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah galhang mi ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Manasseh minam a omlaite Abiezer, Halek, Asriel, Shekhem, Hefer, leh Shemida-te tungah a behbehin piakna kinei hi. Hihte pen Josef' tapa Manasseh' ta pasal suanlekhakte a behbeh ahi hi.
Ahih hangin Manasseh' tapa Makhir, a tapa Hefer, a tapa Zelofehad in tapa neiloin tanu bek nei a, a tanute' min in: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah, leh Tirzah ahi hi.
Amaute, siampi Eleazar leh Nun tapa Joshua leh makaite mai-ah pai uh a, "Ka sanggamte uh tawh gamh hong piakna dingin { Topa } in Moses thu pia hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin { Topa' } thupiakna bangin amau pate' sanggamte tawh amah in gamh a pia khawm hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Jordan galkhatah Gilead leh Bashan-te simloh Manasseh tungah tanh sawm kia hi.
Tappuah leitang pen Manasseh-a' ahi hi. Ahih hangin Manasseh gamgi-a om Tappuah khuapi pen Efraim tapate-a' ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Kanah lui-ah a gamgi paisuk hi. Manasseh khuapite lak panin lui leitaw lama om hih lai-a khuapite pen Efraim-a' ahi hi. Tua ciangin lui leilu lampangah Manasseh gamgi paisuakin tuipi-ah tawp hi.
Tua gam leitaw lamteng Efraim-a' hi-in, a leilu lamteng Manasseh-a' hi a, tuipi pen a gamgi hi a, leilu lamah Asher banin nisuahna lamah Issakhar a ban hi.
Issakhar leh Asher gam sungah zong Manasseh in gam ngah a, tuate pen Bethshean leh a khuaneute, Ibleam leh a khuaneute, Dor-a tengte leh a khuaneute, Endor-a tengte leh a khuaneute, Taanak-a tengte leh a khuaneute, leh Megiddo-a tengte leh a khuaneute hi a, a thumna pen Nafath ahi hi.
Ahi zongin Manasseh' tapate in hih khuapite luah zolo uh ahih manin tua gamah Kanaan mite teng teitei uh hi.
Ahih hangin Israel mite tampi pha-in a hat uh ciangin amaute in Kanaan mite nasemin koih uh a, hawlkhiamang khinlo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Josef minam in Joshua kiangah thu genin, "{ Topa } in kote thu hong pia khin a, kote mi tampi hi napi-in bang hangin ngah khat leh tanh khat bek gamh-in hong pia na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Joshua in amaute kiangah, "Note mi tampi pha a, Efraim mualtung gam pen note-a' dingin neulua ahih ciangin Perez leh Refaim gam tulakah pai un la, nomau-a' dingin gam sattawm un," a ci hi.
Josef minam in, "Kote-a' dingin mualtung gam kicing zolo hi. Ahi zongin zang gama teng Kanaan mite khempeuh, Bethshean leh a khuaneute, Jezreel Kuam sunga om mite pen sik leeng neite hi zel uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Joshua in Josef' suan Efraim leh Manasseh mite tungah, "Note mi tampi pha-in vanglian na hih manun tanh khat kia na nei kei ding uh hi.
Mualtung gam pen note-a' hi ding a, tulak ahih hangin note in hah siangin a gamgi mong dong na luah ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in sik leeng nei-in, amaute a thahat hangin Kanaan mite na hawlkhiazo ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Israel mite lakah gamh a kipia nailo minam sagih omlai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Joshua in Israel mite kiangah, "{ Topa}, na pu na pate uh Pasian in note hong piaksa leitangah pai-in na luah ding uh bang tanvei zekai lai ding na hi uh hiam?
Minam khat panin mi thum ciat hong pia un la, amaute va kuan khia-in vaksuk vakto-in, amaute' luah dinga ngaihsutna tawh a leitang omziate hong gelhin, tua ciangin kei kiangah hong ciah dingun amaute ka sawl ding hi.
Note in leitang khen sagihin hong ciamteh un la, na ciamtehna uh hih mun kei kiangah nong paipih ding uh hi. Tua ciangin keimah in { Topa } i Pasian' mai-ah note-a' ding ai ka san ding hi.
Levi mite in note lakah tanh neilo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa' } siampi nasepna pen amau' luah ahi hi. Gad, Reuben, leh Manasseh minam alangte in { Topa' } nasem Moses in amaute tungah a piak ahi Jordan Nisuahna lam galkhatah amau' gamh ngah khinzo uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mite a kuan uh hi. Leitang a ciamtehna a gelhna dingun Joshua in a pai mite thu pia a, "Vaksuk vakto-in leitang ciamtehna hong gelh un la, kei kiangah hong paikik un. Tua ciangin Shiloh mun { Topa' } mai-ah note-a' dingin ai ka san ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mite kuanin gam sungah paisuk paito-in khen sagih suahin tua gam a khuakhua-in a ciamtehna uh laibu khat sungah khum uh a, Shiloh giahphuala Joshua kiangah amaute hong pai uh hi.
Joshua in amaute-a' dingin { Topa' } mai Shiloh-ah ai sansak hi. Tua ciangin Joshua in amau' tanh ding ciat Israel-te tungah leitang a pia hi.
A behbeh tawh kizui-in Benjamin minamte-a' ding aisan hun hong tung a, amau' tungah a kipia gam pen Judah minam leh Josef minamte kikalah hong kia hi.
Tua lai panin gamgi in Luz lam manawhin leitaw lam nawtin Luz (Bethel a kici) liangko-ah pai a, Bethhoron Nuainung leitaw lama om mualtunga Atarothaddar khua-ah paisuk hi.
Tua ciangin mun dang manawhin gamgi pai a, Bethhoron galkhat, leitaw lama om mual panin nitumna lampang leitaw lamah kihei a, Judah minamte-a' ahi Kiriathbaal (Kiriathjearim a cihna)-ah a tawp hi. Hih in a nitumna lampang piangsak hi.
Tua ciangin Refaim kuam leilu lam monga om, Hinnom' tapa' kuam a kimuhna mual a gamgi-ah pai hi. Tua ciangin Jebus mite' gam liangko leitaw lam, Hinnom Kuam-ah paisukin, Enrogel-ah paisuk suak hi.
Tu-in amau' beh tawh kizui--in Benjamin minamte' khuapite in Jerikho, Bethhoglah, Emekkeziz,
Khefarammoni, Ofni, Geba — khuapi sawmlenih, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi.
Zela, Haelef, Jebus (Jerusalem a cihna), Gibeah, leh Kiriathjearim — khuapi sawmleli, a khuaneute tawh zong ahi hi. Hihte pen a beh tawh kizui-in Benjamin minamte' luah ahi hi.
A beh zui-in Simeon minam-a' ding aisan nihna hong tung hi. Amau' gamh in Judah minamte' gamh ngahsa pawkhat huam hi.
Bethlebaoth, leh Sharuhen — khuapi sawmlethum, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Ain, Rimmon, Ether, leh Ashan — khuapi li a khuaneute tawh zong ahi hi.
Negeb gam Ramah-a om Baalathbeer ciangdong hih khuapite' kiima om khuaneute khempeuh zong a huam ahi hi. Hihte pen a beh tawh kizui-in Simeon minamte' luah ahi hi.
Simeon minamte' luah in Judah minamte' gamsung khenkhat hong huam hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Judah minamte' ngah pen amau-a' dingin lianlua a, amau' luah sung panin Simeon minam in gamh ngahsawn uh hi.
A beh tawh kizui-in Zebulun minam-a' dingin aisan thumna hong tung hi. Amau' luah gam in Sarid ciangdong ban hi.
Tua ciangin nitumna lamah a gamgi paito-in Mareal-ah paisuak a, Dabbesheth va su a, tua ciangin Jokneam nisuahna lama om lui a ban hi.
Tua ciangin Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, leh Bethlehem khuate zong huam a, khuapi sawmlenih, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi.
A beh tawh kizui-in Issakhar minamte-a' dingin aisan lina hong tung hi.
Remeth, Engannim, Enhaddah, leh Bethpazzez a huam hi.
A gamgi in Tabor, Shahazumah, leh Bethshemesh zong ban a, Jordan-ah a tawp hi. Khuapi sawmleguk, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi.
A beh tawh kizui-in Asher minamte-a' dingin aisan ngana hong tung hi.
Allammelek, Amad, leh Mishal huam hi. Nitumna lamah Karmel leh Shihorlibnath ban a,
tua ciangin nisuahna lamah kihei-in Bethdagon-ah pai a, leilu lam Bethemek leh Neiel lamah Zebulun leh Iftahel kuam ban hi. Tua ciangin leilu lam Kabul,
Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, Kanah, leh a Lian Sidon ciangdong paito lai hi.
Ummah, Afek, leh Rehob khuapite huam a — khuapi sawmnihlenih, a khuaneute tawh ahi hi.

Tua ciangin Ofrah khua-ah { Topa' } vantung mi hong pai a, Abiezer mi Joash neihsa tawsaw nuai-ah hong tu hi. Tua laitakin Joash' tapa Gideon in Midian mite' muhloh dingin leenggah sukna-ah mangbuh cil simin na om hi.
{ Topa' } vantung mi ama tungah kilangin ama kiangah, "{ Topa } in nang hong ompih hi, a thahat a vanglian mipa aw," a ci hi.
Gideon in ama kiangah, "Kong thum hi, sia aw, { Topa } in kote hong ompih ahih leh, bang hangin hih thu khempeuh ko tungah hong tung ahi hiam? Ka pate un kote tungah hong genin, '{ Topa } in Egypt panin eite hong paipih hilo ahi hiam?' a cih uh a lamdang ama sepnate khempeuh koi-ah om ta ahi hiam? Ahih hangin tu-in { Topa } in kote hong paaikhia-in Midian-te' khutsungah hong pia khin hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin ama lamah { Topa } kihei-in, "Hih nangma thahatna tawh pai in la, Midian-te' khutsung panin Israel-te honkhia in. Nangmah hong sawl khin hilo ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Gideon in ama kiangah, "Kong thum hi, Topa aw, Israel-te bangci hotkhiat zawh ding ka hi hiam? En in, Manasseh minam sungah keima behte a hatlo pen hi a, ka innkuan sung panin kei a neupen ka hi hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in ama kiangah, "Nang kong ompih ding a, nangmah in mihing khat bang lelin Midian-te na vatgawp ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Tu-in nong hehpih zawh leh, kei tawh a kiho mipa pen nang na hihna lim khat hong lak in.
Kong thum hi, letsong puakin nang kiangah hong pai-in nangma mai-ah kong koih mateng hih lai panin na paikhia kei in," a ci hi. Amah in, "Nong tun'kik mateng ka na om ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Gideon a inn-ah pai-in keelno khat, leh annel seu khat silngo sawhloh moh a bawl hi. A sa ciang sung khatah koihin a satui beel sung khatah koih a, tawsaw nuai ama kiangah tuate hong paipihin a pia hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian' vantung mi in ama kiangah, "Sa leh silngo sawhloh moh la-in hih suang tungah koih in la, a tungah satui sung in," a ci hi. Tua bangmahin amah in a hih hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa' } vantung mi in a khutsunga om ciangkhut dawn dawksakin, sa leh silngo sawhloh mohte a su hi. A suang panin mei piangkhia-in, sa leh silngo sawhloh moh a kangtum hi. Tua ciangin ama muhna panin { Topa' } vantung mi a mang hi.
Tua ciangin Gideon in amah pen { Topa' } vantung mi ahihlam a thei hi. Gideon in, "Ala, Topa { Pasian}! { Topa' } vantung mi mai kituahin ka mukha khin hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin { Topa } in ama kiangah, "Nopna na tungah hong om ta hen; lau kei in, na si kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Gideon in { Topa}-a' dingin biakna tau khat tua lai-ah lamin tua pen, "{ Topa } in nopna ahi hi", ci-in min a phuak hi. Tua pen, Abiezer mite' neihsa Ofrah khua-ah tuni dongin a dinglai hi.
Tua zanin { Topa } in ama kiangah, "Na pa' bawng sung pan kum sagih a pha a bawngtal nih la in la, na pa' neih Baal biakna tau phelin, a gei-a om Asherah milim phuk in.
Tua ciangin hih lai munmuan'huai dawnah { Topa } na Pasian-a' dingin biakna tau khat lamin, a suangte a ngeina ding bangin koih in. Tua ciangin a bawngtal nih la-in, na phuk Asherah milim sing tawh meihal biakna-in pia in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Gideon in a nasemte mi sawm paipihin, { Topa } in ama tungah a gen bangin a hih hi. Ahih hangin sunin a hih ding a innkuanpihte leh a khuamite kihta lua ahih manin zanin a hih hi.
Tua khuamite zingsang tungin a thawh uh ciangin, Baal biakna tau kiphelkhia-in a gei-a om Asherah milim kiphuk a, a kilam thak biakna tau tungah bawngtal a nihna a kipia a mu uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua khuamite in Joash kiangah, "Na tapa in Baal biakna tau phelkhia-in a gei-a om Asherah milim phuk ahih manin ka thah theihna dingun amah hong paikhiatpih in," a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Joash in ama langkhatah a pang mite khempeuh tungah, "Baal pan'pih ding a, ama tupna hutpih ding na hi uh hiam? Amah a pan'pih peuhmah zingsang ciangin kithat ding hi. Amah pasian ahih leh amahmah kihu tawm ta hen. Bang hang hiam cih leh ama biakna tau a kiphelsak ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Midian mite, Amalek mite, leh Nisuahna lam mite khempeuh hong paikhawm uh a, amaute in Jordan kantanin Jezreel Kuam-ah giahphual a sat uh hi.
Ahih hangin Gideon' tungah { Topa' } kha hong tung hi. Amah in peengkul gingsak a, amah a zui dingin Abiezer mite kisamkhia hi.
Amah in Manasseh gam khempeuhah kamtaite sawl a, amaute zong amah a zui dingin kisam hi. Amah in Asher, Zebulun, leh Naftali minamte kiangah kamtaite sawl a, amah a pawm dingin amaute zong paito uh hi.
Tua ciangin Gideon in Pasian kiangah, "Kei tungah hong heh kei in, tu-a khatvei bek hong pausak lai in, kong thum hi; tuumul tawh hih khatvei bek hong sinsak lai in, kong thum hi. Tuumul tung bek keusak in la, mun dang leitung khempeuhah daitui omsak in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jerubbaal (Gideon a cihna) leh amah tawh a om mi khempeuh zingsangin tho baihin Harod tuikhuk gei-ah giahphual a sat uh hi. Midian-te' giahphual pen amau' kiang pan leilu lam, Moreh mual kiang, kuam sungah om hi.
{ Topa } in Gideon kiangah, "Amau' khutsungah Midian mite piakna dingin nang tawh a omkhawm mite kei-a' dingin tamlua hi. Tua bangin tamlua leh kei tungah Israel-te kisialin, 'Komau' hatna hangin ka gualzo uh hi,' ci khading uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in mite' zakin taangko in la, 'Lau-in a ling mi peuhmah a inn-ah ciah un,' ci in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Gideon in amaute ze-et hi; tul sawmnih leh tul nih ciahkikin, tul sawm bang bek omlai hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in Gideon kiangah, "Mite tamlua lai ahih manin tui gei-ah amaute paipih in. Nang-a' dingin tua munah amaute kong sinsak ding hi. Nang kiangah, 'Hih mipa nang tawh hong kuan ding hi,' ka cihpa nang tawh hong kuan ding hi. Nang kiangah, 'Hih mipa nang tawh hong kuanlo ding hi,' ka cih peuhpeuhpa kuanlo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in tui phualah mite paipih suk hi. { Topa } in Gideon kiangah, "Ui in a liah bangin a lei tawh tui a liak mi peuhmah na tuamkoih ding hi. Tua mah bangin tui dawn dingin a khukdin' suk peuhmah zong na tuamkoih ding hi," a ci hi.
Tui a liak, a khut uh a kamah a tuah mi za thum ahi hi. Ahih hangin a dangte khempeuh tui dawn dingin khukdin' suk uh hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in Gideon kiangah, "Tui a liak mi za thumte tawh nangmah hong honkhia-in, na khutsungah Midian mite kong pia ding hi. A dangte khempeuh amau' inn ciatah ciahsak in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in Israel midang khempeuh ciahsak a, a beelte leh a peengkulte khempeuh uh a kem mihing za thumte a khawlsak hi. Midian-te' giahphual pen amau' khanglam kuam sungah om hi.
Tua zan mahin { Topa } in ama kiangah, "Tho in, giahphual simin pai in; bang hang hiam cih leh na khutsungah kong piazo hi.
Tua ciangin amaute' thugen na za ding a, giahphual simin a kuansuk dingin na tha hong khauh ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin a nasempa Purah tawh giahphuala om galkapte in a pualamah a galpan'na munah a paisuk uh hi.
Midian mite, Amalek mite, leh Nisuahna lam mite khempeuh kauphe bangin tamin kuam dungah om uh hi. A kalaohte uh simzawh hilo a, a tamna pen tuipi gei-a sehnel omzah bang ahi hi.
Gideon a tun' ciangin, mi khat in a lawmpa kiangah mang khat na gen hi. Amah in, "Ngai in, mang khat ka man hi. Midian-te giahphual sungah mangbuhham tawh a kibawl moh khat hong tuksukin puanbuk hong ban a, puanbuk deng kha-in puanbuk puk a, puanbuk kilumletin leilakah kiphah hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a lawmpa in dawngin, "Hih pen, Israel mi Joash' tapa Gideon' namsau lo adang hilo hi. Pasian in ama khutsungah Midian leh mihon khempeuh pia khin hi," a ci hi.
Gideon in a mang leh a khiatna a kigenna a zak ciangin Pasian bia-in a khukdin' hi. Israel-te' giahphualah ciahkikin, "Tho un, bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in na khutsung uhah Midian honte hong piazo hi," a ci hi.
Amah in mihing za thumte pawl thumin khenin, amaute khempeuh tungah peengkul leh beel sungah meilah a om beel hawmte a pia hi.
Amaute kiangah, "Keimah hong en un la, a giahphual nawl ka tun' ciangin kei' hih bangin hih un.
Kei leh ka ompih khempeuh in peengkul ka tum uh ciangin, giahphual pang khempeuhah zong peengkulte tum un la, '{ Topa}-a' ding leh Gideon-a' ding,' ci-in awng un," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, amaute in galvil a laih khit phet, zankim laitakin, Gideon leh amah tawh a om mi za khatte giahphual nawlah hong pai uh a, amaute in peengkul tumin a khutsung uha om beelte a sukham uh hi.
A pawl thum-un peengkul tumin beelte sukham uh a, a veilam khutun meilah tawi-in, a taklam khutun a tum ding uh peengkul tawi uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute kiko-in, "{ Topa}-a' ding leh Gideon-a' ding namsau khat!" a ci uh hi.
Amaute in peengkul za thumte a tum uh ciangin, { Topa } in a galte khempeuh a namsau uh tawh amau leh amau kisatgawp sak hi. Tua ciangin a galte uh Zererah gei Bethshittah ciang, leh Tabbath kiang Abelmeholah gamgi dong tai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Naftali, Asher, leh Manasseh minamte khempeuh sung panin mite kisamkhia a, amaute in Midian-te a delh uh hi.
Tua ciangin Gideon in Efraim mualtung gam khempeuhah kamtaite sawl a, "Midian mite' langkhatah hong kuansukin Bethbarah ciangdong luite hong la un la, Jordan zong hong la un," cisak hi. Tua ahih ciangin Efraim mite khempeuh kisamkhia a, amaute in Bethbarah ciangdong luite la-in, Jordan zong a la uh hi.
Amaute in Midian ulian nihte Oreb leh Zeeb a man uh hi. Amaute in Midian-te a delh kawmun Oreb Suangpi-ah Oreb that uh a, Zeeb Leenggahsukna-ah Zeeb that uh hi. Amaute in Jordan galkhat Gideon kiangah Oreb leh Zeeb lutangte hong paipih uh hi.
Tua ciangin Efraim mite in Gideon kiangah, "Midian-te a do dingin na kuancil lai-in kote nong saploh, kote hong bangci ngaihsut na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi. Amaute in nakpi takin amah mawhsak uh hi.
Amah in amaute kiangah, "Note tawh teh dingin kote bang hi lel ka hi uh hiam? No Efraim minamte' sep a themno khat pen ko minam bup khempeuhte' sep sangin thupizaw hilo ahi hiam?
Pasian in note' khutsungah Midian uliante Oreb leh Zeeb hong piazo hi. Note tawh teh dingin kote in bang hihzo ka hi uh hiam?" a ci hi. Amah hih bangin kam a pau ciangin ama tunga amau' hehna a bei hi.
Tua ciangin Gideon leh amah tawh a om mi za thumte, Jordan tungin galkah uh a, a gimpi mahin amaute delh lai uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in Sukkoth mite kiangah, "Kong thum hi, kei hong zuite tungah anlum pawlkhat pia un; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute gim uh a, Midian kumpi Zebah leh Zalmunna a delh ka hi uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Sukkoth uliante in, "Na galkapte tungah anlum ka piak dingun Zebah leh Zalmunna na khutsungah omkhin ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Gideon in, "Tua ahih leh pha hi. { Topa } in Zebah leh Zalmunna ka khutsungah hong piak khit ciangin gamlak lingte leh lingkungte tawh na sa uh ka kuikek ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua lai panin Penuel-ah paito a, amaute tungah zong tua mah bangin a gen hi. Penuel mite in Sukkoth mite' dawn' mah bangin amah na dawng uh hi.
Tu-in Zebah leh Zalmunna-te, Nisuahna lam mi galkap khempeuh sung pan a omlaiteng, mihing tul sawm leh tul nga bang bek a pha lai a galkapte uh tawh Karkor-ah om uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh namsau a tawi mi tul za leh tul sawmnih si khin hi.
Tua ciangin Nobah leh Jogbehah nisuahna lam mihonte' tot lampi zui-in Gideon paito-in a galte va bingphawn' hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a galte uh galvil omlo hi.
Tua ciangin Zebah leh Zalmunna tai uh hi. Amah in amaute delhin Midian kumpi nihte Zebah leh Zalmunna manin amau' galkap khempeuh kithehthang sak hi.
Amah in Sukkoth mi tangval khat manin thu dong hi. Tuapa in ama-a' dingin uliante leh upate mihing sawmsagih leh sagih a min gelhsak hi.
Tua ciangin Sukkoth mite kiangah amah tungin, "Kei tungah hong kisialin, 'A gim na mite tungah anlum ka piak dingun Zebah leh Zalmunna na khutsungah omkhin ahi hiam?' na cih uh Zebah leh Zalmunna en un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a khuapi upate sam a, gamlak lingte leh lingkungte zong la-in, tuate tawh Sukkoth mite a thuhilh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Amaute, ka sanggam, ka laigui zoppihte ahi uh hi. { Topa } a nuntak mah bangin, amaute suaktasak hi le-uhcin note kong that kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a ta upa pen Jether kiangah, "Ding in, amaute that in," a ci hi. Ahih hangin tangvalpa in a namsau dok ngamlo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah tangval lai ahih manin a lungsim hang nailo hi.
Tua ciangin Zebah leh Zalmunna in, "Nangmahmah ding in la, kote hong hih in; bang hang hiam cih leh pasal nasep a sem dingin pasal mah kisam hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin Gideon dingin Zebah leh Zalmunna that a, amau' kalaohte' ngawng-a a om khade lim tawh a kibang kizepnate a la hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite in Gideon kiangah, "Nang leh na tapa leh na tupa dong in zong kote hong uk un; bang hang hiam cih leh Midian-te' khutsung panin kote nong honkhia hi," a ci uh hi.
Gideon in amaute kiangah, "Note kong uk kei ding a, ka tapa in zong note hong uklo ding hi. { Topa } in note hong uk ding hi," a ci hi.
Ama nget kham bilbahte a gihna pen kham shekel tul khat leh za sagih ahi hi. Midian kumpite in a zat khade lim tawh a kibang kizepnate, khainiangte, puan dupsante, leh a kalaohte uh ngawng kimkotah a om ngawng-awhte a kisimlo ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Gideon in tuate mi limin bawlin ama khuapi Ofrah khua-ah a koih hi. Israel-te khempeuh in tua lai munah tua milim bia uh a, Gideon leh a innkuanpihte-a' dingin thangzak khat a suak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel mite' mai-ah Midian-te guallel uh a, amaute kihisak zo nawnlo uh hi. Gideon' hun sungin tua gam in kum sawmli sung lungnopna a nei hi.
Tu-in Gideon in tapa sawmsagih, ama-a' mahmah nei hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in zi tampi nei hi.
Israel mite in, mun khempeuh panin amau' galte' khutsung pan a honkhia { Topa } a Pasian uh phawklo uh hi.
Jerubbaal (Gideon a cihna) in Israel-te tungah a bawl thuhoihte khempeuh hangin amaute in Jerubbaal innkuante tungah lungdamna bangmah laklo uh hi.
Tu-in Jerubbaal' tapa Abimelek, Shekhem-a a nu' tanaute kiangah pai-in amaute khempeuh kiangah,
"Shekhem khuami khempeuh huau-in gen un, 'Jerubbaal' tapa sawmsagihte a vekpi in note hong uk ding leh khat in note hong uk ding, note-a' dingin koi hoihzaw ahi hiam?' a ci hi. Kei pen note' guh note' sa ka hihna zong phawk un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Baaberith inn panin ngun pek sawmsagih Abimelek pia uh a, amah in ama nung a zui, bangmaha a kimanglo leh thu ngaihsun theilo mite cialna hi.
Tua ciangin Shekhem khuamite khempeuh leh Bethmilo khuamite khempeuh hong paikhawm uh a, amaute in Shekhem khua-a tawsaw songpi kiangah Abimelek kumpi a suaksak uh hi.
Jotham kiangah tua thu a kigen ciangin amah pai-in Gerizim Mual dawnah ding a, nakpi-in kiko-in amaute kiangah, "No Shekhem mite aw, Pasian in note' thu hong ngaih theihna dingin ka thu hong ngai un.
Ahih hangin oliv kung in amaute kiangah, 'Keimah in pasian-te leh mite a kipahtawina ahi ka thaunate nusia-in singkungte a uk dingin hong pai ding ka hi hiam?' ci hi.
Tua ciangin singkungte in theikung kiangah, 'Hong pai in la, kote hong uk in,' ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin theikung in amaute kiangah, 'Keimah in ka khumna leh ka gah hoihte nusia-in singkungte a uk dingin hong pai ding ka hi hiam?' ci hi.
Tua ciangin singkungte in leenggui kiangah, 'Hong pai in la, kote hong uk in,' ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin leenggui in amaute kiangah, 'Keimah in pasian-te leh mite a lungnuamsak ka leenggahzu nusia-in singkungte a uk dingin hong pai ding ka hi hiam?' ci hi.
Tua ciangin singkung khempeuh in thangling kung kiangah, 'Hong pai in la, kote hong uk in,' ci uh hi.
Thangling kung in singkungte kiangah, 'Note tungah kumpi-in lungsim tak tawh sathau hong nilh na hih uh leh, hong pai un la, ka liimah hong bu un. Ahi zongin ka liim nuai-ah nong buk kei uh leh, thangling kung lak panin meikuang hong paikhia hen la, Lebanon taamtak kungte kangtum hen,' ci hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin tu-in Abimelek kumpi-in na bawl uh ciangin lungsimtak leh thumantak mah tawh a gamta na hi uh hiam? Jerubbaal leh a innkuan tungah thuman takin gamta-in ama sepna tawh a kituakin amah a bawl mah na hi uh hiam?
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka pa in note-a' ding hong dosakin a lauhuaina sungah a nuntakna pia a, Midian-te' khutsung panin note hong honkhia hi.
Note in tuni-in Jerubbaal leh a innkuanpihte tungah lungsimtak leh thumantak tawh a gamta takpi mah na hih uh leh, Abimelek tungah note lungdam un la, note tungah zong amah lungdam ta hen.
Ahih hangin tua bang ahih takpi kei leh, Abimelek sung panin meikuang hong paikhia hen la, Shekhem leh Bethmillo khuamite kangtum hen. Shekhem khuamite sung pan leh Bethmillo khuamite sung panin meikuang hong pai hen la, Abimelek kangtum hen," a ci hi.
Pasian in Abimelek leh Shekhem mite kikalah kigalneihna omsak a, Shekhem mite in Abimelek lehdo uh hi.
Tua pen, Jerubbaal tapa sawmsagihte a kithahna thu tawh kisai-in, amaute a that a sanggampa uh Abimelek, leh a sanggamte thahna dingin a hanthawn Shekhem mite tungah thukkikna hong tun'theihna dingin a kibawl mahmah ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Ebed' tapa Gaal in, "Abimelek, kua hi a, ama na i sepsak dingin ei Shekhem mite kua ihi hiam? Jerubbaal' tapa leh ama ulian Zebul in Shekhem mite' pulepa Hamor' na sem uh hilo ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin ama na sem ding ihi hiam?
Hih mite keima khutnuai hi leh! Abimelek ka khinkhia ding hi. Abimelek kiangah, 'Na galkap behlap in la hong kuankhia in,' ka ci ding hi," a ci hi.
Amah in Arumah khua-a om Abimelek kiangah kamtaite sawlin, "En in, Ebed tapa Gaal leh a tanaute Shekhem-ah hong pai-in nang langpangin tua khuapi sosuah hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na ompih mite tawh zanin pai un la, gamlakah pangsim un.
Tua ciangin zingsang ni a suah phetin tho baih un la, khuapi simgawp un. A ompih mite tawh nang a do dingin hong kuankhiat ciangun ahi thei bangin amaute tungah na bawl ding uh hi," cisak hi.
Tua ciangin Abimelek leh amah tawh a om mite khempeuh zanin tho-in pawl li kisuahin Shekhem a sim dingin pangsim uh hi.
Tua ciangin Ebed tapa Gaal paikhia-in khuapi kulhkongpi lutna-ah ding a, Abimelek leh amah tawh a om mite zong a pan'simna panun dingto uh hi.
Tua ciangin Zebul in ama kiangah, "Tu-in na kamhan'na koiah om ahi hiam? 'Ama na i sep dingin Abimelek kua ahi hiam?' a cipa hilo na hi hiam? Hih mite, na simmawhte hilo ahi hiam? Tu-in paikhia in la amaute tawh kido in," a ci hi.
Abimelek in Gaal delh a, ama mai-ah Gaal a tai hi. Kulhkongpi lutna ciangdong nangawnah mi tampi liamin tuk hi.
Tua ciangin Arumah-ah Abimelek a teng hi. Zebul in Gaal leh a tanaute hawlkhia a, amaute Shekhem-ah teng thei nawnlo uh hi.
Abimelek leh amah tawh a om a pawlte in thakhatin mainawt uh a, ama pawldang nihte in gamlaka om mite delhin a thah sungin khuapikulh lutna-ah amaute na ding uh hi.
Shekhem Tausang mite khempeuh in tua thu a zak uh ciangin Elberith' inn munmuan'huai-ah lut uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi khempeuh in amau-a' ding ciat selkeu tomin Abimelek zui-in munmuan'huai simna dingin koih uh a, amaute in mei tawh munmuan'huai halin Shekhem Tausang mite, numei leh pasal mi tul khat bang a si hi.
Ahih hangin tua khuapi sungah tausang muan'huai om a, tua khua numei leh pasal, tua khuami khempeuh tua tausangah tai-in kikhaknelh uh a, tausang khumah amaute om uh hi.
Numei khat in an gawina suangpeek tungnung, Abimelek' lu tungah lawnin a lu guh dengkham hi.
Tua ciangin amah in ama hiam a tawisak tangvalpa nawh sapin ama kiangah, "Na namsau dok in la kei hong that in. Tua hi kei leh mite in, 'Numei khat in amah that hi,' hong ci khading uh hi," a ci hi. A tangvalpa in amah sunletin amah a si ta hi.
