Tua ciangin Samson in, "La khaguh khat tawh a lom lomin, la khaguh khat tawh mihing tul khat ka that hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah dangtak mahmah ahih manin { Topa } samin, "Na nasempa' tha tawh hih bang suahtakna lian nong piazo hi. Tu-in dangtakin kei si-in dawibia mite' khutsungah puk ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian in Lehi-a om komdep khat hong a, tua sung panin tui hong phul hi. Amah in tua tui a dawn ciangin a tha hong dimkikin thakhauh kik hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua mun min Enhakkore kici a, tuhun dongin Lehi-ah tua tuikhuk omlai hi.
Ni khat, Gaza khua-ah Samson pai a, tua lai-ah numei paktat khat mu-in tuanu kiangah a giak dingin a pai hi.
Ahih hangin zankim ciangdong Samson lum a, zankim ciangin tho-in khuapi kulhkongpi kongkhakte leh a khuam nihte lenin a zawlte leh a na khempeuh botto a, a liangko tungah tuate pua-in Hebron mai-ah a om mual dawnah tuate a tun'pih hi.
Tua ciangin Filistia mi uliante tuanu kiangah hong pai-in, "Amah hong zol in la, ama hatna koi-ah om hiam cihna leh amah i nuaisiah zawhna dingin amah i hen theihna ding, amah i zawh theihna ding zia hong thei in. Na theihzawh leh ngun pek tul leh za khat ciat nang kong pia ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Delilah in Samson kiangah, "Na hatna lian koi-ah om a, mi khatpeuh in nang hong zawhtheihna dingin hong bangci kihen ding cihna thu, nong hehpihna-in hong gen in," a ci hi.
Samson in tuanu kiangah, "Amaute in a keu nailo thalkhau thak sagih tawh hong hen leh ka tha nem ding a, midang mah ka bang ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Filistia mi uliante in tuanu kiangah a keu nailo thalkhau sagih hong paipih uh a, tuanu in tua khaute tawh amah a hen hi.
Tua laitakin tuanu in inndei sungah mi busak hi. Tua ciangin tuanu in ama kiangah, "Filistia mite in nang hong hih, Samson!" a ci hi. Ahih hangin, patkhaute in mei a sukkhak ciangin a kitah bangin amah in thalkhaute botsat ziau hi. Tua ahih ciangin ama thahatna thusim kithei zolo hi.
Amah in tuanu kiangah, "Amaute in a kizang nailo khauhual thakte tawh kei hong hen leh ka tha nem ding a, midang mah ka bang ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Delilah in Samson kiangah, "Tudong kei nong simmawh a, zuauthu nong gen hi. Nang hong bangci kihen theih ding cih hong gen in," a ci hi. Amah in tuanu kiangah, "Ka lu tunga ka sam lom sagihte mimkhau tawh ganin ciampek tawh khen bikbek lecin ka tha nem ding a, midang mah ka bang ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah a ihmut laitakin a lu tunga a sam lom sagihte la-in siamin a gan hi. Amah in ciampek tawh khen bikbek a, "Filistia mite in nang hong hih, Samson!" a ci hi. Ahih hangin a ihmutna pan amah khanglo-in a ciampek, a siambu, leh a siam a kaikhia hi.
Tua ciangin numei in ama kiangah, "Bang hangin na lungsim kei tawh a omlopi, 'Nang kong it hi,' ci thei na hi hiam? Hih thumvei dong kei nong simmawh a, na thahatna a omna mun nong gen kei hi," a ci hi.
Nisimin nakpi takin a kutkut ciangin, sihna dong dingin Samson lunggim hi.
Amah in tuanu kiangah a lungsim khempeuh gen a, "Ka lu tungah mulkiatna kitah ngeilo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka suah tunga kipan Pasian' tungah a kipia Nazir mi ka hi hi. Ka sam kimet leh ka hatna in kei hong nusia ding a, ka tha nem ding a, midang mah ka bang ding hi," a ci hi.
Ama tungah a lungsim khempeuh gen khin hi, ci-in Delilah in a theih ciangin amah in mi sawlin Filistia mi uliante sam a, "Tu-a khatvei hong pai un; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a lungsim khempeuh kei kiangah hong gen khinzo hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Filistia uliante tuanu kiangah hong pai-in sum zong hong pua uh hi.
Tuanu in a phei tungah Samson ihmusak hi. Amah in mi khat samin a lu tunga a sam lom sagihte metsak hi. Tua ciangin tuanu in amah gimsak ding kipan a, ama thahatna in amah nusia ta hi.
Tuanu in, "Filistia mite in nang hong hih, Samson!" a ci hi. A ihmutna panin amah khanglo-in, "Nidanga mah bangin paikhia-in keimah kisingin suakta ning," a ci hi. { Topa } in amah a nusiat khitlam amah in theilo hi.
Tu-in Filistia uliante a pasian uh Dagon tungah biakna lianpi khat a pia ding leh a gualnuam dingin kikhawm uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in, "I pasian in i khutsungah i galpa Samson hong piazo hi," a ci uh hi.
Mite in amah a muh ciangun a pasian uh phat uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in, "I pasian in eite' khutsungah i gam a susiapa, eite tampi hong thatpa hong piazo hi," a ci uh hi.
A lungsim uh a nop ciangin amaute in, "Eite-a' dingin a kimawl theihna dingin Samson sam un," a ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in thong panin Samson samkhia-in amau' mai-ah mawlpih uh hi. Khuampite kikalah amah kidingsak hi.
Samson in ama khut a len tangvalpa kiangah, "Ka kingak theihna dingin innpite a do khuampite hong lawngsak in," a ci hi.
Tua laitakin a innpi pen numei leh pasal tawh kidim hi. Samson a kimawlsak laitakin a en Filistia ulian khempeuh leh innkhum zangah numei leh pasal mi tul thum bang om uh hi.
Tua ciangin Samson in { Topa } samin, "{ Topa } Pasian aw, kei hong phawk in, kong thum hi. Tu-a ka mittang nihte' tangdingin Filistia mite ka thuktheihna dingin hong thahatsak in, tu-a bek kong thum hi," a ci hi.
Samson in, "Filistia mite tawh hong sisak in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin a thaneih khempeuh tawh a awn hi. Tua ciangin uliante leh inn sunga om mi khempeuh tungah a innpi kicimsuk hi. Tua ahih ciangin a nuntak lai-a a thah sangin a sihna-a a thah a si mi tamzaw hi.
Tua ciangin a sanggam pasalte leh a innkuanpihte khempeuh hong paisukin a luanghawm la uh a, ciahpihto-in Zorah leh Eshtaol kikala om a pa Manoah' hanah a vui uh hi. Amah in Israel-te kum sawmnih sung thu a khen hi.
Amah in a nu kiangah, "Ngun pek tul leh za khat hong kiguksak lai-in a gupa na samsiatna thu ka za hi. A ngunte pen keima guk hi a, tu-in hih lai-ah tuate om hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin a nu in, "Ka tapa aw, { Topa } in thupha hong pia ta hen," a ci hi.
Amah in ngun pek tul leh za khatte a nu kiangah piakik hi. A nu in, "A kisek milim khat leh a kisung milim khat bawlna dingin ka tapa-a' dingin { Topa' } tungah a ngunte ka apsa ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in nang tungah kong piakik ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in a nu kiangah a sum a piakkik ciangin a nu in zong ngun pek za nih la-in, a kisek milim khat leh a kisung milim khata a bawlsak ngunsekpa kiangah pia a, tuate pen Mikah' inn sungah om hi.
Tua mipa Mikah in biakna phual khat nei a, amah in siampipuan khat leh innsung pasian-te bawlin siampi a suak dingin a tapate khat a koih hi.
Tua hun lai-in Israel sungah kumpi omlo a, mi khempeuh amau' hoihsak bang ciatin gamta uh hi.
Tua hun laitakin Judah gam Bethlehem khuasungah Levi mi tangval khat om hi.
Tua mipa a muhna mun peuhpeuhah a teng dingin Judah gam Bethlehem khua panin paikhia hi. Tua bangin khualzinin a pai laitakin Efraim mualtung gamsunga Mikah' inn-ah va tung hi.
Mikah in ama kiangah, "Koi panin hong pai na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in, "Judah gamsung Bethlehem khua-a om Levi mi ka hi a, mun ka muhna peuhah a peem ding ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Mikah in ama kiangah, "Kei tawh hong omin kei-a' dingin pa leh siampi hong hi in; kum khatin ngun pek sawm, puan silh khat, leh annek kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mikah in, "{ Topa } in kei hong daupaisak ding hi, ci-in tu-in ka thei hi; bang hang hiam cih leh siampi-in Levi mite khat ka neita hi," a ci hi.
Tua hun lai-in Israel-te sungah kumpi omlo hi. Tua hun lai-in Dan minamte in a ten'na ding uh leitang zong uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua hun dong mateng Israel minamte sung panin amau-a' ding gamhluah bangmah kialo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Dan mite in gam ensimin a va zong dingin amau' minam bup khempeuh lak panin mi siam nga Zorah leh Eshtaol panin a sawl uh hi. Amaute in tua mite kiangah, "Pai un la gam va zong un," a ci uh hi. Amaute Efraim mualtung gam, Mikah' inn-ah hong tung uh a, tua lai-ah a taam uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in ama kiangah, "Kote' kuankhiat khualzinna a tangtung ding hiam cih ka theihna dingun Pasian hong dotsak in, kong thum uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin siampipa in amaute kiangah, "Lung nuamin pai un. Note' khualzinna thu-ah { Topa } in hong pan'pih hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mi ngate paikhia-in Laish tung uh a, tua lai-a om mite, Sidon mite' ombang danin daitakin omin bangmah a upmawh lohna, leitungah bangmah kisam loin a hauhna, leh amaute Sidon-te' kiang panin gamla omin kuamah tawh kizopna a neihlohna, lungmuang taka a ten'na uh a mu uh hi.
Amaute Zorah leh Eshtaol-a a sanggamte uh kiangah hong tun'kik uh ciangin, a sanggamte un amaute kiangah, "Bang thu gen ding nong nei uh hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Amaute in, "Ding un, amaute a sim dingin paito ni. Bang hang hiam cih leh a leitang ka mu khin uh a, a lei hoih mahmah hi. Bangmah hihloin ommawk ding na hi uh hiam? Pai ding zekai kei un; lutin leitang va luah ni.
Na pai uh ciangin bangmah a ummawhlo mite kiang na tung ding uh hi. Leitang zai mahmah hi. Pasian in na khutsung uhah leitungah bangmah a kisap lohna mun hong pia khinzo takpi hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Dan minamte galhiam a tawi mihing za guk Zorah leh Eshtaol panin kuankhia uh a,
amaute paito-in Judah gamsung Kiriathjearim-ah giahphual sat uh hi. Hih thu hangin tuhun dongin tua mun pen Mahanehdan kici hi. Tua pen Kiriathjearim nitumna lamah om hi.
Tua ciangin Laish gam a ensim dingin a pai mi ngate in a sanggamte uh kiangah, "Hih innte khat sungah siampipuan khat, innsung pasian-te, a kisek milim khat, leh a kisung milim khat a omlam theilo na hi uh hiam? Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na hih ding uh ngaihsun un," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin, galhiam a tawi mi za gukte tawh kulhkongpi lutna-ah siampipa a din' khawm laitakin gam ensim dingin a kuankhia mi ngate tumin a kisek milim, a siampipuan, a innsung pasian-te, leh a kisung milim la uh hi.
Hih mite Mikah' inn sungah tumin a kisek milim, a siampipuan, a innsung pasian-te, leh a kisung milim a lak uh ciangin siampipa in amaute kiangah, "Bang hih na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Amaute in ama kiangah, "Pau kei in; na khutin na kam hum in la, kote tawh hong pai-in kote-a' dingin pa leh siampi hong hi in. Nang-a' dingin mi khat' innsungah siampi hih ding hoihzaw ahi hiam, tua ahih kei leh Israel-te' sungah minam leh beh siampi hih ding hoihzaw ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin siampipa a lungkim hi. Amah in a siampipuan, a innsung pasian-te, leh a kisek milim la-in mite' lakah a pai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute' mai-ah a taneute leh a ganhingte leh a vante uh omsakin, amaute paikhia uh hi.
Amaute Mikah' inn panin a gamla khopkhat a tun' uh ciangin Mikah' innvenga om mite kikaikhawm uh a, Dan mite delhin a pha uh hi.
Amaute in Dan mite a otsan uh ciangin Dan mite hong kihei-in Mikah kiangah, "Hih bang mihon tawh nong delhna ding bang thu om ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Amah in, "Note in keima bawlsa ka pasian-te leh ka siampipa la-in na paikhia uh hi. Keimah in bang nei nawn ka hi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin, 'Bang thu ahi hiam?' bang hangin hong ci thei na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Dan mite in ama kiangah, "Kote' lakah na aw hong kizasak kei in; tua hi kei leh ka lawmte uh hehin nang hong hih ding uh a, na innkuanpihte tawh na si khading uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Dan mite pai uh hi. Mikah in ama-a' dingin amaute thahat lua hi, ci-in a muh ciangin amah kihei-in a inn-ah a ciahkik hi.
Dan mite in Mikah' bawlsate leh a siampipa paipihin, gamdai-in a om, bangmah a ummawhlo mite' omna Laish tung uh a, namsau tawh amaute vatin mei tawh a khuapi a hal uh hi.
Amaute pen Sidon panin gamla uh ahih manin a honkhia ding omlo a, amaute in kuamah tawh kizopna neilo uh hi. Tua mun pen Bethrehob-te' neihsa kuam sungah om hi. Amaute in khuapi lamkikin a sungah teng uh hi.
Amaute in tua khuapi min pen Israel' suan amau' pian'na Dan tamin Dan a phuak uh hi. Ahih hangin a masa-in tua khuapi min pen Laish ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Dan mite in a kisek milim amau-a' dingin phut uh a, Moses' tupa, Gershom' tapa Jonathan leh ama tapate pen tua gam a kilak hun dong Dan minamte-a' dingin siampi ahi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Shiloh-ah Pasian' biakbuk a om sungteng Mikah' bawlsa a kisek milim tua lai-ah a om hi.
Israel-te sungah kumpi a omloh hun laitakin, Levi mite khat Efraim mualtung gam mongah peemin, Judah gam Bethlehem panin zineu khat a la hi.
Tua ciangin a pasal dingkhia-in kam neem tawh a hopih ding leh a ciahpih kik dingin tuanu' nungah a pai hi. Amah in a nasempa leh a la nih tonpih hi. A sungpa' inn-ah tung a, a sungpa in amah a muh ciangin lungdamna tawh a dawn dingin hong pai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua mi nihte tukhawmin an ne-in tui dawn uh hi. A sungpa in a makpa kiangah, "Tuzan taam ding lungkim hoh in la, na lung nuamsak in," a ci hi.
A pai dingin mipa a din' ciangin a sungpa in a taamkik dong mateng kho hi.
Tua ciangin a ni nga ni-in a ding dingin zingsangin amah tho baih hi. A sungpa in, "An ne phot in la, ni a dialh mateng khawl lai in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in an ne uh hi.
Mipa leh a zineu leh a nasempa a paikhia dingin a din' uh ciangin a sungpa in, "En in, tu-in nitak nai-in ni niamta hi; tuzan taam un. En in, ni tum dektak hi. Hih lai-ah giak in la, na lung nuamsak in. Zing ciang zingsangin tho baihin inn-ah na ciah ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin mipa tua zan taam nawnlo hi. Amah dingin paikhia a, Jebus (Jerusalem a cihna) galkhat tung hi. Amah pen tuan'na a kivawh la nih leh a zineu tawh ahi hi.
Amaute Jebus kiang nai a tun' uh ciangin ni niam khin a, a nasempa in a topa kiangah, "Hih Jebus mite' khuapi-ah zan taam ni," a ci hi.
A topa in, "Israel mite a hilo, gamdang mite' khuapi sungah i taam kei ding hi. Gibeah-ah i paisuak ding hi," a ci hi.
Gibeah-ah pai-in a giak dingin tua khua a zuan uh hi. Amah pai-in khuapisung kongzing laizangah tu hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a zan taam dingin kuamah in a inn-ah amaute sanglo hi.
Tua laitakin puteek khat lo-a a nasepna panin nitak ciangin hong ciah hi. Tuapa pen Efraim mualtung gam pan hi a, amah Gibeah khua-ah a peem hi a, tua khuamite pen Benjamin mite ahi hi.
Amah khuadak a, khualzinpa, khuapi kongzingah a mu hi. Tua ciangin puteekpa in, "Koi-ah pai ding na hi hiam? Koi panin hong pai na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in, "Keima hong paikhiatna Judah gam Bethlehem khua panin Efraim mualtung gam mongah a pai dingin hong nawk ka hi uh hi. Judah gam Bethlehem-ah ka pai hi. Tu-in ka inn-a a ciah ka hi hi. Kuamah in a inn-ah hong tungsak nuamlo hi.
Ka late uh-a' dingin buhtu leh gan-an, kei leh na nasemnu leh na nasemte tawh a om tangvalpa-a' dingin anlum leh leenggahzu ka nei uh a, a kisam bangmah omlo hi," a ci hi.
Amaute in a lung uh nuamsakin a om laitakun, tua khuapi mi, mi ginalote in tua inn kimkotah pangin a kongkhak tumgawp uh hi. Amaute in inn nei puteekpa kiangah, "Ama taw ka luk theihna dingun na inn-ah a hong tung mipa hong paikhiatpih in," a ci uh hi.
Inn neipa, amaute kiangah pusuakin amaute tungah, "Hilo hi, ka sanggamte aw; tua bangin gitloh gamtat kei un.
En un, hih lai-ah ka ta nungak leh ka zinpa' zineu om hi. Amaute hong paikhiatpih ning. Amaute buanin hoih na sak bangun amaute tungah hih un. Ahih hangin hih mipa tungah tua bang a sia gamta kei un," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin mite in ama thu ngailo uh hi. Tua ciangin Levi mipa in a zineu manin amaute kiangah koihkhia hi. Amaute in tuanu buan uh a, zingsang mateng zan tawntung tuanu hih uh hi. Zingsang khuavak dingin a kipat ciangin amaute in tuanu ciahsak uh hi.
Amah in a zineu kiangah, "Tho in, pai ta ni," a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in dawng nawnlo hi. Tua ciangin amah in domto-in a la tungah tuanu koih a, a inn-ah a ciahpih hi.
A inn-ah a tun' ciangin amah in tem khat la a, a zineu lenin a phei a liangin seh sawmlenih suahin sem a, Israel-te' gamsung khempeuhah a hawm hi.
A mu mite khempeuh in, "Egypt gam panin Israel mite a paikhiata kipan tuni dongin hih bang thu piang ngeilo a, zong kimu ngeilo hi. Hih thu ngaihsun un; kikum un la, gen un," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite khempeuh, Gilead gam zong a kihel, Dan panin Beersheba dong hong kuankhia uh a, { Topa' } kiang Mizpah-ah mihing khat bangin mihon hong kikhawm lian uh hi.
Israel minam khempeuh sung pan makai khempeuh, namsau tawi khe galkap mihing tul za li, Pasian' mite' kikhopna-ah amau mahmah kipia uh hi.
Tua ciangin a kithat numei' pasal, Levi mipa in dawngin, "Benjamin-te' gam Gibeah-ah kei leh ka zineu a taam dingin ka tung uh hi.
Tua ciangin ka zineu la-in ka semnen a, Israel-te' luah gamsung khempeuhah ka hong hawm hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in Israel-te' lakah kihhuaina leh lanluat khialhna gamta uh hi.
En un, no Israel mihingte khempeuh aw, na ngaihsutna uh gen un la, hih lai-ah kikum un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh mihing khat bangin ding lianin, "Eite khempeuh khat zong i puanbukah pailoin, eite khat zong i inn-ah i ciah kei ding hi.
amaute in Israel-te sungah lanluatna tawh a khialhna uh hangin Benjamin-te' gam Gibeah a thuk theihna dingun mite-a' ding annek tuidawn a pua dingin Israel minamte khempeuh sung panin mi za khat sung pan mihing sawm, tul khat sung pan za khat, tul sawm sung pan tul khat i la ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in kote in amaute thatin Israel-te' sung panin siatna ka phiatkhiat theihna dingun Gibeah khuasunga om a mi ginalote hong piakhia un," a ci uh hi. Ahih hangin Benjamin-te in a sanggam uh Israel mite' thu ngailo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite do-in a kuankhia dingin Benjamin gamsung khuapite panin Gibeah khuapi-ah hong kituah uh hi.
Benjamin mite in tua ni-in amau' khuapite panin, Gibeah-ah a teng a kitengkhia mihing za sagih banah, namsau a tawi mihing tul sawmnih leh tul guk a khawm uh hi.
Hihte khempeuh lakah mi a kitengkhia a veikhoi za sagih om a, amaute khempeuh pen suang tawh samzang kapin a khiallote ahi uh hi.
Israel mite in Benjamin-te simloh, namsau a tawi mihing tul za li khawm uh a, hih mite khempeuh galsiam mi ahi uh hi.
Israel mite dingin Bethel-ah paito uh a, "Benjamin mite a sim dingin kua pai masa ding ka hi uh hiam?" ci-in Pasian a dong uh hi. { Topa } in, "Judah minamte paito masa ding hi," a ci hi.
Benjamin mite Gibeah pan hong kuankhia-in tua ni-in Israel mite tul sawmnih leh tul nih lei-ah a tuksak uh hi.
Ahih hangin Israel mite kihanthawnin a ni masa ni-a a pan'na mun mah uhah gal pangkik uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite paito-in nitak dong { Topa' } mai-ah a kap uh hi. Amaute in { Topa' } kiangah thu dongin, "Ka sanggam uh Benjamin mite a sim dingin gal phualah ka naihkik ding uh hiam?" a ci uh hi. { Topa } in, "Amaute a sim dingin kuanto un," a ci hi.
Amaute a sim dingin a ni nih ni-in Gibeah panin Benjamin-te hong kuankhia uh a, Israel mite tul sawm leh tul giat lei-ah tuksak uh hi. Hih a site khempeuh namsau a tawi mite ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite khempeuh, galkap vekpi paito-in Bethel-ah tungin a kap uh hi. Tua lai mun { Topa' } mai-ah amaute tu-in nitak dong tua ni an tang uh a, { Topa' } mai-ah meihal biakna leh thunuama biakna a pia uh hi.
Israel mite in { Topa } thu dong uh a (bang hang hiam cih leh tua hunin Pasian' Thuciamna Singkuang tua lai-ah om a,
Aaron' tapa Eleazar' tapa Finehas in tua lai-ah tua hunin na sem hi), "Ka sanggam uh Benjamin mite a sim dingin kuankik lai ding ka hi uh hiam, tua ahih kei leh khawl ding ka hi uh hiam?" a ci uh hi. { Topa } in, "Paito un; bang hang hiam cih leh zing ciangin amaute na khutsung uhah kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.

Amah in, "Note hong uk ding kumpipa' hih zia dingte in: Amah in na tapate uh la-in a leengte-ah na semin a sakol nasem ding, leh a leengte mai-ah a tai dingin seh ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in ama-a' dingin a tul-a uk leh a sawmnga-a ukte, leh pawlkhatte a lo kho-in a an a la ding, leh a galsung nazatte leh a leeng nate a bawl dingin seh ding hi.
Amah in na tanute uh paknamtui bawl ding, an huan ding, leh an em dingin la ding hi.
Amah in na lote uh, na leenggui lote uh, leh na oliv lote uh sung panin a limcipen teng la-in ama nasemte tungah pia ding hi.
Amah in na an leh na leenggahte uh sawmah khat la-in ama uliante leh ama nasemte tungah pia ding hi.
Amah in na nasem numeite uh, na nasem pasalte uh, na bawngte, uh leh na late uh a gina pen teng la-in ama na a sem dingin koih ding hi.
Amah in na tuuhonte uh sawmah khat la ding a, note pen ama sila na hi ding uh hi.
Tua ni ciangin note-a' dingin na teelsa uh na kumpipa uh hangin note na kiko ding uh a, ahih hangin tua ni ciangin { Topa } in note hong dawnglo ding hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin mite in Samuel' thu ngai nuamlo uh hi. Amaute in, "Hilo! Kote' tungah kumpi khat ka nei ding uh hi.
Kote zong minam dangte khempeuh mah bangin, ka kumpipa un kote hong ukin kote' mai-ah pai-in ka galte uh hong dosak ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Samuel in mite' thugen khempeuh a zak khit ciangin { Topa' } kiangah tua thute a genkik hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in Samuel kiangah, "Amaute' thu ngai in la, amaute-a' dingin kumpi khat koih in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Samuel in Israel mite kiangah, "Mi khempeuh na khuapi ciat uhah ciah un," a ci hi.
Amah in tangval a melhoih, a min Saul ahi tapa khat nei hi. Israel mite lakah amah sangin a melhoihzaw, a thacingzaw khat zong omlo a, midang khempeuh ama liangko ciang bek pha uh hi.
Tua laitakin Saul' pa Kish' late a mang hi. Tua ahih ciangin Kish in a tapa Saul kiangah, "Nasemte khat sam in la, late va zong in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Efraim mualtung gamteng leh Shalisha gam teng nawkin zong uh a, ahih hangin mulo uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in Shaalim gamteng zong uh a, ahih hangin tua gamah na om tuanlo hi. Tua ciangin amaute in Benjamin gamteng zong uh a, ahih hangin mu samlo uh hi.
Zuf gam a tun' uh ciangin Saul in amah tawh a om a nasempa kiangah, "Hong pai in, ciahkik ni. Tua hi kei leh ka pa in late ngaihsun nawnloin eite hong lunghimawh zaw khading hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a nasempa in, "En in, hih khuapi sungah Pasian' mi khat om a, a kizahtak mi khat ahi hi. Ama gen khempeuh a manin tung hi. Tua lai-ah pai ni. Eite' khualzin khiatna thu amah in hong genthei khading hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in a nasempa kiangah, "Ahih hangin pai lehang, tua mipa bang puak ding ihi hiam? I van sunga i anlum beita a, Pasian' mipa kiangah i puak ding letsong omlo hi. Bang nei nawn ihi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a nasempa in Saul dawngkikin, "Hih lai-ah ngun sumnen tang khat ka nei hi. I vai hong genna dingin Pasian' mipa kiangah ka pia ding hi," a ci hi.
(Tua ma lai-in Israel-te sungah mi khat in Pasian kiangah thudong dingin a pai ciangin amah in, "Hong pai in, thumupa kiangah va pai ni," ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tuhuna kamsang i cihte tua ma-in thumupa kici hi.)
Tua ciangin Saul in a nasempa kiangah, "Tua ahih leh hoih hi, va pai ni," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Pasian' mipa a omna khuapi-ah amaute a pai uh hi.
Amaute khuapi omna muatungah a paitoh laitakun khuapi panin tui tawi dingin hong paikhia nungaknote tawh kituak uh ahih manin amaute kiangah, "Thumupa hih lai-ah a om hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Amaute in, "Amah om hi; note' mai diakah pai hi. Kinawh un; khuapi sungah tu mahmahin hong pai hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mite in tuni-in mualtunga biakna-ah biakna pia uh hi.
Khuapi sung na lut phetun mualtunga biakna-ah anne dingin a pai ma-in amah na mu ding uh hi. Amah in biakpiakna thupha pia ding ahih manin ama pai mateng mite in an nelo ding uh hi. Thupha a piak khit ciangin a kisam mite in ne thei pan uh hi. Tu-in paito un; bang hang hiam cih leh amah na tuakpah ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin khuapi-ah amaute paito uh hi. Khuapi sungah amaute a lut laitakun mualtunga biakna lamah Samuel a pai dingin amau' lamah hong paikhia a mu uh hi.
Tu-in Saul hong pai ni a zan ni-in Samuel tungah { Topa } in thu na gen khin hi:
"Zing ciang tubang hunin Benjamin gamsung panin nang kiangah mi khat kong sawl ding a, nangmah in ka mi Israel-te tungah ulian dingin amah sathau na nilh ding hi. Amah in Filistia mite' khutsung panin ka mite honkhia ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute' kikona kei kiang hong tung khin ahih manin ka mite' gimna ka mu khinzo hi," a ci hi.
Samuel in Saul a muh ciangin { Topa } in ama kiangah, "Nang kiangah kong gen mipa hih lai-ah hong paita hi. Amah pen ka mite' tungah a uk dingpa ahi hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in kulhkongpi-ah Samuel va naihin, "Hong gen in; thumupa' inn koilai ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Samuel in Saul dawngin, "Keimah, thumupa ka hi hi; mualtunga biakna-ah keima mai-ah na paito in; bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in tuni-in kei tawh an na ne ding a, zingsang ciangin nang hong ciahsakin na lungsima om khempeuh nang kiangah kong gen ding hi.
Tuma ni thum lai-in a mang na late ahih leh, kimu khinta ahih manin tuate na lungsimah ngaihsun nawn kei in. Israel-te' deihdeihte kua' tungah om ahi hiam? Nang leh na pa' innkuante khempeuh tungah a om hilo ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Saul in dawngin, "Kei pen Israel minamte sung panin a tawmpen Benjamin-te hilo ka hi hiam? Keima innkuan, Benjamin minam innkuan khempeuh sung panin a niampen hilo ahi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin hih bangin kei tungah hong pau na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Samuel in Saul leh a nasempa samin inndei sungah paipih a, mihing sawmthum bang a pha a kisam mite lak tutna bul lamah a tusak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin anhuanpa in a khe leh a kawngsa la-in Saul' mai-ah a lui hi. Tua ciangin Samuel in, "Thei in, a kisit pen nang' mai-ah hong kilui hi. Ne in; bang hang hiam cih leh leenglate tawh na nektheihna dingin a kiseh hun a cin' mateng nang-a' dingin hong kisitsak ahi hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua ni-in Saul in Samuel tawh an ne khawm hi.
Amaute mualtunga biakna panin khuapi sungah a paisuk uh ciangin innkhumzangah Saul-a' dingin lupna khat na kiphah a, a ihmu dingin amah lumsuk hi.
Khua a vak ciangin Samuel in innkhumzanga Saul samin, "Na paina dingah kong sawl theihna dingin tho in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Saul tho-in, amah leh Samuel, khuapi kongzingah a pai uh hi.
Amaute khuapi nawlah a paikawmun Samuel in Saul kiangah, "I mai-ah na nasempa a paisuakna ding gen in la, amah a paisuak khit ciangin nang' tungah Pasian' thute kong theihsak theihna dingin tawlkhat hih lai-ah khawl in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Samuel in sathau thawl khat la a, ama lu tungah buakin amah nam a, "{ Topa } in ama mi Israel-te tungah ulian dingin nang sathau hong nilh khin hilo ahi hiam? Nangmah in { Topa' } mite ukin a kiima om amau' galte' khutsung panin amaute na honkhia ding hi. { Topa } in ama luahte tungah ulian dingin nang sathau hong nilh khitna lim hih bang hi ding hi:
Tuni-in kei kiang panin na paikhiat ciangin Benjamin-te' gam Rachel' han kiang Zelzah-ah mihing nih na tuak ding a, amaute in nang kiangah, 'Pai-a na zon' late kimu khin a, tu-in na pa in late ngaihsun nawnloin nangmah hong lunghimawh a, "Ka tapa bang cih ding ka hi hiam?" ci hi,' hong ci ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua lai panin pai lai-in Tabor tawsaw lak na tung ding hi. Tua lai panin Bethel-a Pasian kiangah a paito, keelno thum a pua mi khat, anlum thum a pua adang khat, leh leenggahzu savun thawl khat a pua mi khat, mi thum in nang hong dawn ding uh hi.
Amaute in nang hong hopihin nangmah in amau' tung panin na san' ding anlum nih nang tungah hong pia ding uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin Filistia khuacingte a omna Gibeath-elohim na tung ding hi. Tua khuapi sung na tun' ciangin amaute mai-ah, harp lasakna, khuangneu, tamngai, leh laia lasakna tawh laamin awng kawmin mualtunga biakna panin hong paisuk kamsang honkhat na tuak ding hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa' } kha in khauhtakin nang hong uk ding a, amaute tawh laamin awng khawmin mi tuamdang khatin na kikhel ding hi.
Tua ciangin keima mai Gilgal-ah na paisuk ding hi. Meihal biaknate leh thunuama biaknate a pia dingin nang kiangah kei zong kong pai ding hi. Nang kiangah kei hong pai-in na hih ding teng kong lah mateng, ni sagih sung na ngak ding hi," a ci hi.
Gibeah-ah amaute a tun' uh ciangin, kamsang honkhat in amah na dawn hi. Pasian' kha in khauhtakin amah hong man takpi a, amah zong amaute' lakah laamin a awng hi.
Tua bangin laamin a otna a man ciangin mualtunga biakna tau omna-ah a pai hi.
Saul' pano in amah leh a nasempa a muh ciangin, "Koi-ah pai na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in, "Late a zong dingin ka pai uh hi. Late kimu zolo ding ci-in ka theih uh ciangin Samuel kiangah ka pai uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in a pano kiangah, "Late a kimuh khitna ko kiangah teltakin hong kigen hi," a ci hi. Ahih hangin Samuel in a gen kumpi suahna ding thu tawh kisai ama tungah bangmah genlo hi.
Tu-in Samuel in Mizpah-a { Topa' } kiangah mite khawm hi.
Amah in Israel mite kiangah, "Israel-te' Pasian, { Topa } in hih bangin ci hi: 'Egypt panin Israel-te ka paikhiatpih a, Egypt-te' khutsung leh note hong nengniam kumpi gamte khempeuh' khutsung panin note kong honkhia hi,' ci hi.
Ahih hangin note in na tuahsiatnate uh leh na lungkhamnate uh panin note a hong honkhia na Pasian uh tuni-in na nial uh a, note in, 'Kote' tungah kumpi khat koih in,' na ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na minam nam uh leh a tul tulin { Topa' } mai-ah kilak un," a ci hi.
Amah in Benjamin minamte a behbehin hong paipih a, aisanna tawh Matri innkuan kila hi. A tawpna-ah amah in Matri innkuan a mi malin hong paipih a, aisanna tawh Kish' tapa Saul kila hi. Ahih hangin amaute in amah a zon' uh ciangin amah kimu zolo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in { Topa } kiangah dongkik uh a, "Tua mipa hih lai-ah hong pai hiam?" ci uh a, { Topa } in, "En un, amahmah van kawm lakah bu hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute tai-in tua lai mun panin amah hong paipih uh hi. Mite' lakah amah a din' ciangin mi khempeuh ama liangko ciang bek pha uh hi.
Tua ciangin Samuel in mi khempeuh tungah, "{ Topa } in a teelsa mipa na mu uh hiam? Mi khempeuh lakah amah tawh a kibang khat zong omlo hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh awngin, "Kumpipa khan'sau hen!" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Samuel in kumpipa' thuneihna leh a nasepte mite kiangah gen a, amah in tuate laibu khat sungah gelhin { Topa' } mai-ah a koih hi. Tua ciangin Samuel in mi khempeuh amau' inn ciatah a ciahsak hi.
Saul zong Gibeah-a ama inn-ah ciah a, Pasian in amau' lungsim a lawn'sak mi thahatte zong amah tawh a pai uh hi.
Ahih hangin bangmah a manlo mi pawlkhat in, "Hih mipa in eite hong bangci hotkhiat zawh ding ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi. Amaute in amah simmawhin ama kiangah letsong puaklo uh hi. Ahih hangin amah in tua mite bangmah cihlo hi.
Tua ciangin Ammon mi Nahash a galkapte tawh paito-in Jabeshgilead umcih hi. Jabesh mite in Nahash kiangah, "Kote tawh kilemna hong bawl in; nangma na kong sem ding uh ahi," a ci uh hi.
Jabesh upate in ama kiangah, "Israel-te' gamsung khempeuhah kamtaite ka sawltheihna dingun ni sagih sung a hun hong sot in. Tua ciangin kote hong honkhia ding kuamah a om kei leh nang tungah kote kong kipia ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Saul' khua Gibeah-ah kamtaite a tun' uh ciangin amaute in mite kiangah a thu gen uh a, tua ciangin mi khempeuh a gingin kapkhia uh hi.
Tu-in Saul a bawngtalte' nung zui-in lo panin hong ciah hi. Saul in, "Amaute a kahna dingin bang in mite nasak ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Jabesh mite' thute ama kiangah a gen uh hi.
Saul in hih thute a zak ciangin Pasian' kha in khauhtakin amah hanthawn a, nakpi takin a sin hong so hi.
Amah in bawng leengkai kap khat la a, tuate go-in semnen a, kamtaite sawlin Israel gam khempeuhah khak a, "Saul leh Samuel nung zui-in a kuankhialo peuhmah a bawngtalte' tungah hih bangin kihih ding hi," ci-in a gen hi. Tua ciangin mite tungah { Topa } kihtakna hong tung a, mihing khat bangin amaute hong kuankhia uh hi.
Amah in Bezek-ah amaute a kaihkhop ciangin Israel mite tul za thum pha a, Judah mite tul sawmthum pha hi.
Amaute in a hong pai kamtaite kiangah, "Jabeshgilead-te tungah hih bangin gen un: 'Zing ciang, sun hun ma-in note hong kihonkhia ding hi,' ci un," a ci hi. Kamtaite hong tungin Jabesh mite kiangah a gen uh ciangin amaute lungdam uh hi.
A zing ciangin Saul in mite pawl thumin a khen hi. Tua ciangin amaute' giahphual laizangah zingsang tungin hong pai uh a, sun nisat dong Ammon-te a satlum uh hi. A suakta mite kithehthang uh a, amaute mi nih nangawn a omkhopna om nawnlo hi.
Tua ciangin mite in Saul kiangah, "'Saul in eite hong uk ding hiam?' a cite kua ahi hiam? Amaute i thah theihna dingin a mite hong paipih in," a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Saul in, "Tuni-in mi khat zong kithatlo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tuni pen { Topa } in Israel-te hong hotkhiat ni ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi khempeuh Gilgal-ah pai uh a, tua lai mun { Topa' } mai Gilgal-ah Saul kumpi-in a koih uh hi. Amaute in tua lai { Topa' } mai-ah thunuama biakna pia uh a, Saul leh Israel mite khempeuh tua lai-ah nakpi takin lungdam khawm uh hi.
Tu-in note' makaipa pen kumpipa ahi hi. Keimah teekin ka sam kang ta a, ahi zongin note tawh ka tapate om hi. Ka neulai-a kipan tuni dong note' makai ka hi hi.
Tua ciangin amah in amaute kiangah, "Note in kei tungah bangmah na muhlohna thu uh { Topa } pen note' langkhatah teci hi a, ama sathau nilhpa zong tuni-in teci ahi hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amaute in, "Hi mah hi; { Topa, } i teci ahi hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Samuel in mite kiangah, "Moses leh Aaron teelin Egypt gam panin na pu na pate uh a paikhiatpih { Topa, } teci ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tuni-in note leh na pu na pate uh-a' dingin { Topa } in hotkhiatna a sepna thu khempeuh { Topa' } mai note' tungah hong genin kong mawhsak theihna dingin ding lai dih un.
Egypt-ah Jakob pai-in Egypt-te in amaute a netniam uh ciangin { Topa' } tungah na pu na pate uh kiko uh a, Egypt panin na pu na pate uh paikhiatpihin hih lai munah amaute a tengsak ahi Moses leh Aaron, { Topa } in a puak hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in { Topa } a Pasian uh mangngilh uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in Hazor kumpipa Jabin' galkapmangpa Sisera' tung leh Filistia-te tung leh Moab kumpipa tungah amaute zuak a, hih mite in amaute sim uh hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } tungah amaute kiko uh a, 'Kote ka khial khin uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } nusia-in Baal-te leh Ashtaroth na ka sem uh hi. Ahih hangin tu-in ka galte uh khutsung panin kote hong honkhia in; nangma na kong sem ding uh hi,' a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in Jerubbaal, Barak, Jefthah, leh Samuel hong sawl a, na kiim khempeuh uha na galte uh khutsung panin note hong honkhia a, note lungmuang takin na om uh hi.
Tua ciangin note a sim dingin Ammon kumpipa Nahash hong kuanna na muh uh ciangin, { Topa } na Pasian uh na kumpi uh hi napi-in note in kei kiangah, 'Kumpi khat in kote hong uk ding hi,' na ci uh hi.
"Tu-in note' teelsa, note' nget kumpipa en un; { Topa } in note' tungah kumpi khat koih khinta hi.
Note in { Topa } zahtakin ama na sem a, ama aw ngai-in { Topa' } thupiakna na langpan' kei uh a, note a hong uk kumpipa leh na Pasian uh na zuih uh leh thu hong nuam ding hi.
Ahih hangin note in { Topa' } aw ngailoin { Topa' } thupiakna na langpan' uh leh { Topa } in note leh na kumpipa uh hong langpan' ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in taangloin ding un la, note' muhna-ah { Topa } in a hih ding hih na lian en un.
Tuhun pen mangbuh lak laitak hilo ahi hiam? Amah in vanging leh guah hong puaktheihna dingin { Topa' } tungah thu ka ngen ding hi. Note-a' dingin kumpi khat na ngetna uh hangin { Topa' } muhna-ah na gamtatnasa na gitlohna uh a liatna thu thei-in na mu ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Samuel in { Topa' } tungah thu ngen a, { Topa } in tua ni-in van gingsakin guah zusak hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in { Topa } leh Samuel nakpi takin a zahtak uh hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in Samuel kiangah, "Kote ka sihlohna dingun na nasemte-a' dingin { Topa' } tungah thu ngen in; bang hang hiam cih leh ka khialhnasate uh banah kote-a' dingin kumpi khat ngenin ka khialhnate uh banah hih siatna ka behlap lailai uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Samuel in mite kiangah, "Lau kei un; hih siatnate khempeuh na gamta khin uh hi. Ahi zongin { Topa } zuihna panin pial kei un la, na lungsim khempeuh uh tawh { Topa' } na sem un.
Meetna hong pia theilo, hong hon theilo, a mawkna milimte biakna lamah pial kei un; bang hang hiam cih leh tuate pen a mawkna ahi hi.
{ Topa } in ama min a khualna-in ama mite paaikhialo ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ama mi-in note hong bawlna dingin { Topa } lungkim khin hi.
Tua thamloin kei zong, note-a' dingin { Topa' } tungah thunget lohna tawh ka na khial het kei ding a, keimah in a hoih a man lampite note kong hilh ding hi.
{ Topa } zahtak un la, na lungsim khempeuh uh tawh citakin ama na sem un; bang hang hiam cih leh note-a' dingin amah in na lian hong bawlsaksate ngaihsun un.
Ahih hangin note na gamtat siat lai uh leh, note leh na kumpipa uh, na nihun hong kiphiatkhia ding hi," a ci hi.
Saul in uk ding a kipatin kum sawmthum pha a, kum sawmnih leh kum nih sung Israel-te a uk hi.
Saul in Israel-te mihing tul thum teel hi. Tul nihte Mikmash leh Bethel mualtung gamah Saul tawh om a, tul khatte Benjamin gamsung Gibeah-ah a tapa Jonathan tawh om uh a, midang a omlaite amau' inn a puanbuk ciat uhah amah in ciahsak hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in Filistia khuacingte a zawhna leh Filistia-te-a' dingin Israel-te a huathuai ahihna zong Israel-te khempeuh in za uh hi. Gilgal-ah Saul a pawm dingin mite kisamkhia hi.
Tua ciangin Israel-te tawh a kido dingin Filistia-te kikhawmin, leeng tul sawmthum, sakol galkap tul guk, leh a galkapte tuipi gei-a sehnel zahin tampi pha uh hi. Amaute hong paito-in Bethaven nisuahna lam Mikmash-ah phual sat uh hi.
A galte in Israel mite neh mahmah ahih manin amaute haksatna sungah a omlam uh a kitheih uh ciangin suanghawm sung, leihawm sung, suang kawmlak, han lak, leh tuikhukte sungah bu uh a,
a dangte in Jordan ngahmun kantanin Gad leh Gilead gamah galkah uh hi. Saul ahih leh Gilgal-ah omlai a, amah tawh a om mi khempeuh zong lau-in ling uh hi.
Amah in Samuel' seh hun, ni sagih sung a ngak hi. Ahih hangin Gilgal-ah Samuel hong pailo a, ama kiang panin mite kithehthang hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Saul in, "Meihal biakna leh thunuama biakna hih lai kei kiangah hong paipih un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in meihal biakna a pia hi.
Meihal biakna a piak a man khit phetin Samuel hong tung a, amah a dawn ding leh a hopih dingin Saul paikhia hi.
Samuel in, "Bang hih na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Saul in, "Kei kiang panin mite kithehthangin, a ni kiseh sungin nang lah hong tunglo a, Mikmash-ah Filistia-te a kikhopna ka muh ciangin
keimah in, 'Tu-in Filistia-te keimah hong hih dingin Gilgal-ah hong paisuk ding uh a, keimah in { Topa' } maipha ka ngen nai kei hi,' ka ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin keimahmah kisawl tawmin meihal biakna ka pia hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Samuel in Saul kiangah, "Na hai gamtat hi; { Topa } na Pasian' hong thupiakna na zui kei hi; bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in Israel-te tungah kumpi dingin nang leh na suanlekhakte a kipsaksuak ding ahi hi.

a tul a ukpa kiangah zong hih sathaukhal sawmte puak in. Na ute' omdan va mu in la, amau' omzia a kitheihna lim pawlkhat hong ciahpih in," a ci hi.
Tua laitakin Filistia-te tawh kido-in Saul leh amaute, leh Israel mite khempeuh, Elah kuamah om uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jessi in a thupiak bangin zingsangin David tho baihin, a kem ding midang khat tawh a tuute nusia a, a ante pua-in a pai hi. Mihonte giahphualah pai-in galdo kikona a ot laitakun amah giahphual va tung hi.
Israel-te leh Filistia-te, galkap leh galkap a kido dingin kinaih uh hi.
David in van cingpa' khutsungah a nate nusia-in galkapte kiangah va tai a, pai-in a ute va hopih hi.
Amaute tawh a kiho laitakin, Gath khuami Filistia-te a makaipi Goliath min neipa, Filistia uliante lak panin hong paikhia-in a masa-a mah bangin kam hong pau hi. David in ama kampau a za hi.
Israel mite khatlekhat kiho-in, "Hih hong paikhia mipa na mu ngei uh hiam? Israel-te a to dingin hong paito takpi hi. Amah a that mipa tungah kumpipa in sum tampi pia-in, ama tanu zong pia ding a, a pa' innkuante, Israel sungah aana nasep leh siah khempeuh kipengsak ding hi," a ci uh hi.
David in ama kianga ding mite kiangah, "Hih Filistia-pa thatin Israel-te' tung panin hih mindaina a beisakpa-a' dingin bang kihih ding ahi hiam? A nungta Pasian' galkapte a to dingin hih dawibia Filistia-pa kua ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
David in mite kiangah thu a gen laitakin ama u a upen Eliab in a za hi. David tungah Eliab heh mahmah ahih manin, "Bang hangin hong paisuk na hi hiam? Tua tuu tawmkhatte gamlakah kua tawh nusia na hi hiam? Na kihaimuan'na leh na lungsim gitlohna ka thei hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh galkidona a en dingin nong paisuk hi," a ci hi.
David in, "Bang hih ka hi hiam? Kam bek hilo ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Saul in David kiangah, "Hih Filistia-pa tawh a kido dingin ama langkhatah na kuanzo kei ding hi. Nang pen tangval na hi pan a, amah pen a tangval-a kipan galkap mi ahi hi," a ci hi.

Tua ciangin amah in a khutah a ciangkhut tawi-in, lui panin suangmai tang nga tengin a tuucin' thungip sungah tuate koih hi. A khutsungah a suanglotna tawi a, Filistia-pa' nai-ah a pai hi.
Filistia-pa in David kiangah, "Ka kiangah hong pai in. Huih lak vasate leh gamlak gamsate tungah na sa ka pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in Filistia-pa kiangah, "Namsau, teipi, leh teikhawh tawh kei kiangah nang nong kuan hi. Ahih hangin kei pen Israel galkapte' Pasian, a Vanglian { Topa, } nangmah in na to mipa' min tawh nang kiangah kong kuan hi.
Tuni-in { Topa } in ka khutsungah nang hong pia ding a, keimah in nang hong sattukin na lu ka tankhia ding hi. Tua ciangin tuni-in huihlak vasate leh leitung ganhingte tungah Filistia mi a site' luanghawmte ka pia ding hi. Israel sungah Pasian khat a omlam leitung mi khempeuh in a theihna ding,

Tua ahih ciangin David in suanglotna khat leh suangtang khat tawh Filistia-pa zo-in a that hi. David' khutsungah namsau omlo hi.

Tua ciangin Israel-te leh Judah-te awngin ding uh a, Gath leh Ekron kulhkongpi ciangdong Filistia-te delh uh ahih manin Shaarim panin Gath leh Ekron ciangdong Filistia mi a liamte puk uh hi.
Filistia-pa do-in David a kuankhiatna Saul in a muh ciangin galkapmangpa Abner kiangah, "Abner aw, hih tangvalpa kua' tapa ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Abner in, "Kumpipa aw, ka thei kei hi," a ci hi.

Jonathan in ama silhlai a puantualpi suahin David pia a, a galkidalna leh a namsau nangawn leh a thal leh a kawnggak zong a pia hi.

Filistia-pa a thahna panin David ciahin, amaute in inn lam a zuat uh ciangin Israel khuapi khempeuh sung panin kumpi Saul a dawn dingin khuangtung leh lasaknate tawi-in numeite a laam kawmin hong kuankhia uh hi.
Saul heh mahmah a, hih thugenna in amah lungkimlo sak hi. Amah in, "Amaute in David tungah a tul sawmin pia-in, kei tungah a tulin hong pia bek uh hi. Kumpi min puak cih simloh bang dang nei nawn ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ni-a kipan Saul in David encik hi.

Saul in David kihta hi; bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in amah ompih a, ahih hangin Saul kiang panin amah kihemkhia khinta hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Saul in a omna panin David lakhia-in mihing tul khat a ukin koih a, mite a makai-in amah kuankhia-in hong ciah hi.
David in a sepna khempeuhah a ma tun' hi; bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in amah ompih hi.
Ahih hangin Israel-te khempeuh leh Judah-te khempeuh in David it uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute makaihin amah kuankhia-in hong ciah hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in David kiangah, "Hih lai-ah ka tanu uzaw Merab om hi. Nang tungah zi dingin kong pia ding hi. Kei-a' dingin hang peuh in la, { Topa' } gal do in," a ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Saul in, "Keima khutsungah amah siloin Filistia-te' khutsungah si hen," ci-in ngaihsun hi.
David in Saul kiangah, "Kei pen kumpipa' makpa ka hihna dingin kei, bang hi a, Israel-te tungah ka tanaute, ka pa' innkuante bang ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Saul in, "Ama-a' dingin ka tanu pen thangzak ahih theihna ding leh Filistia-te' khutsungah a sihtheihna dingin ama tungah ka tanu pia ning," ci-in ngaihsun hi. Tua ahih ciangin Saul in David kiangah a nih veina genin, "Nang pen tu-in ka makpa na hi ding hi," a ci hi.
Saul in a nasemte thu pia a, "David kiangah thu tuam genpih un la, 'En in, nang tungah kumpipa lungkim a, ama nasemte khempeuh in nang hong it hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in kumpipa' makpa suak in,' ci un," a ci hi.
Saul' nasemte in David kiangah hih thute gen uh hi. David in, "Kei pen mizawng hi-in a zahtakhuailo ka hihna mu napi-in kumpipa' makpa suah ding a thuneu sa na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in, "David kiangah hih bangin na gen ding uh hi: 'Kumpipa in a galte a thukkik theihna dingin Filistia-te' zangteep za khat cih simloh kumpipa in moman deihlo hi,' ci un," a ci hi. Tu-in Saul in Filistia-te' khut tawh David sihsak ding ngaihsun hi.
David dingin ama mite tawh pai a, Filistia mi za nih that hi. Tua ciangin amah kumpipa' makpa a suahtheihna dingin kumpipa tungah a cingin a kipia amaute' zangvun teepte David in hong paipih hi. Saul in a tanu Mikhal ama zi dingin a pia hi.

Tua ciangin Filistia mi uliante galsim dingin hong kuankhia uh a, amaute hong kuankhiat simin Saul' nasem dangte khempeuh sangin David in a ma tun'zaw hi. Tua ahih manin mite in David thupi muh semsem hi.
Tua ciangin Saul in David thah ding a ngaihsutna thu a tapa Jonathan leh a nuai-a ulian khempeuh kiangah a gen hi. Ahih hangin Saul' tapa Jonathan in David diksa mahmah hi.

Jonathan in a pa Saul kiangah David' thu a hoihin genin ama kiangah, "Kumpipa, a nasempa David tungah khial kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang tungah amah hong khiallo a, ama nasepnate nang-a' dingin nasep hoih ahi hi.
Amah in a nuntakna pia ngamin Filistia-pa that a, { Topa } in Israel-te khempeuh-a' dingin gualzawhna lianpi piangsak hi. Nangmah in hih thu na mu a, na lung a dam hi. Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin thu omlopi-in David thahna tawh a mawhbaanglo mipa tungah khial ding na hi hiam?" a ci hi.

Tu-in David tai-in suakta a, Ramah-ah Samuel kiangah pai-in, ama tungah Saul' hihna teng a gen hi. Tua ciangin amah leh Samuel pai-in Naioth-ah om uh hi.

Tua lai panin Ramah khuasung Naioth vengah amah pai hi. Ama tungah zong Pasian' kha hong tung a, Ramah khuasung Naioth veng a tun' mateng a paikawmin laamin awng hi.

Ahih hangin nang tungah siatna bawlna ding in ka pa a lungkimsak leh, a muan'huaina-ah nang na pai theihna dingin nang kiangah a thu kong pulak kei a, nang kong sawlkhiat kei taak leh { Topa } in keimah Jonathan hong dawm kei ta hen. { Topa } in ka pa a ompih mah bangin nang zong hong ompih ta hen.

Tua laitakin { Topa' } mai-ah biakna vai-in a om, Saul' nasemte mi khat tua lai-ah na omkha hi. Ama min Doeg hi a, Saul' gancing makaipa hi a, Edom mi ahi hi.
Tua ciangin David in Ahimelek kiangah, "Teipi ahi a, namsau ahi zongin hih lai-ah neilo na hi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa' nasep pen nawhtat ding kul ahih manin ka namsau ahi a, ka hiamte ahi zongin ka la man kei hi," a ci hi.
Siampipa in, "Elah kuamah na thah Filistia mi Goliath' namsau, puan tawh kitunin hih lai-ah siampipuan nungah om hi. Tua na deih leh la in. Bang hang hiam cih leh adang omlo a, tua bek hih lai-ah om hi," a ci hi. David in, "Tua sanga hoihzaw adang omlo hi; kei hong pia in," a ci hi.
Akhish' nasemte in ama kiangah, "Hih David, a gam kumpipa hilo ahi hiam? Amaute khatlekhat in ama thu la-in sa-in laam uh a, 'Saul in a tulin that, David in a tul sawmin that,' ci hilo ahi uh hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Ka omna-ah mihai-a gamta dingin hih mipa nong paipihna dingun mihai kisam thuah lai ka hi hiam? Hih mipa ka inn sungah hong pai ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
David tua lai panin kihemkhia-in Adullam leihawmah tai hi. A sanggamte leh a pa' innkuante khempeuh in a zak uh ciangin ama kiang tua lai munah paisuk uh hi.

Nang leh na tapate leh na nasemte in ama-a' dingin lo na kho ding uh a, na topa' tupa in annek ding a neihtheihna dingin a piangte na tun'pih ding uh hi. Ahih hangin na topa' tupa Mefibosheth in keima sabuai-ah an ne tawntung ding hi," a ci hi. Ziba in tapa sawmlenga leh nasem sawmnih nei hi.

David kiangah tua thu a kigen ciangin amaute a dawn dingin amah in mi sawl hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a mite nakpi takin maizum uh hi. Kumpipa in, "Na khamul uh a saukik mateng Jerikho-ah om un la, tua ciangin hong ciah un," a ci hi.
Ammon mite in amaute David' huat mi a suah khitna uh a muh uh ciangin, Ammon mite in mi sawlin Bethrehob-a Syria mite, Zobah-a Syria mite, khe galkap tul sawmnih, leh Maakah kumpipa' mi tul khat tawh, leh Tob mite tul sawm leh tul nih a cial uh hi.
David in tua thu a zak ciangin amah in Joab leh a thahat mihon khempeuh a sawl hi.
Tua ciangin Ammon mite hong kuankhia-in kulhkongpi lutna-ah galsim dingin pan'mun hong la uh hi. Zobah leh Rehob-a Syria mite, Tob mite, leh Maakah-te, gamlakah amau pawl ciatin om uh hi.
Joab in a nung leh a mai-ah amah a sim dingin gal in a pan'na a muh ciangin, amah in Israel-te' sung pan mi pawlkhat teelkhia a, Syria mite a do dingin a pangsak hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Syria mite kei-a' dingin a hat luat leh kei nong huh ding hi. Ahih hangin Ammon mite nang-a' dingin a hat luat leh kei hong pai-in nang kong huh ding hi.
Kihangsak in; i mite-a' ding leh i Pasian' khuapite-a' dingin kipasalsak ni; { Topa } in hoih a sak bangin hong hih ta hen," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Joab leh amah tawh a om mite in Syria mite a do dingin naih uh a, ama mai-ah amaute tai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Hadadezer in mi sawlin Eufratis galkhata Syria mite samsak hi. Hadadezer' galkapmangpa Shobak makai-in Helam-ah amaute tung uh hi.
Israel-te' mai-ah Syria mite tai uh hi. David in leeng za sagih a hawl Syria mite, leh sakol tung tuang mi tul sawmli thatin, amau' galkapmangpa Shobak liamsak a, tua lai-ah amah a si hi.
Galdo dingin kumpite a kuankhiat hun tua kum phalbi sungin David in Joab, leh amah tawh a om a nasemte, leh Israel-te khempeuh sawl a, amaute in Ammon mite sugawpin Rabbah khua umcih uh hi. Ahih hangin David Jerusalem-ah om hi.
David in mi sawlin tua numei' thu kansak hi. Mi khat in, "Hih nu pen Hit mi Uriah' zi, Eliam' tanu Bathsheba hilo ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in kamtaite sawlin tuanu samsak hi. Tuanu ama kiangah hong pai a, amah in tuanu luppih hi. (Tuanu a khasim nitna panin a kisian'suah tung ahi hi.) Tua ciangin ama inn-ah a ciah hi.
Tua ciangin tua numei gai hi. Amah in mi sawlin David kiangah, "Nau ka paai hi," ci-in gensak hi.
Ama kiangah Uriah a tun' ciangin David in Joab bangci om a, mite bangci uh a, galdona bangci mavan' hiam cih dong hi.
Tua ciangin David in Uriah kiangah, "Na inn-ah ciahsuk in la tawlnga in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa' inn panin Uriah paikhia a, kumpipa kiang panin letsong khat in amah zui hi.
"Uriah a inn-ah ciahsuk lo hi," ci-in amaute in David kiangah a gen uh ciangin David in Uriah kiangah, "Khualzin-a hong tung hilo na hi hiam? Bang hangin na inn-ah ciahsuk lo na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Uriah in David kiangah, "Thuciamna Singkuang, Israel-te, leh Judah mite gal sungah om uh a, ka topa Joab leh ka topa' nasemte gamlakah giak uh hi. Tua ahih manin anne tuidawn ding leh ka zi tawh a lum dingin ka inn-ah ciahsuk ding ka hi hiam? Nangmah na hin' mah bangin, hih bang ka gamta het kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in Uriah kiangah, "Hih lai-ah tuni zong om in la, zing ciangin nang kong paikhiasak ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Uriah zong tua zan leh a zing ciang Jerusalem-ah om hi.
A lai sungah, "Galsim a haksatna penah a madawkin Uriah koih in la, amah kivat tukin a sihtheihna dingin ama kiang panin nungkik un," ci-in a gelh hi.
Amah in kamtaipa thu hilhin, "Galkidona thu khempeuh kumpipa kiangah na gen khit ciangin,
kumpipa a heh suakin amah in nangma kiangah, 'A sim dingin khuapi-ah tua zahin a nai-in pai na hi uh hiam? Kulh tung panin hong kap ding uh theilo na hi uh hiam?
Jerubbesheth' tapa Ahimelek kua in that hiam? Numei khat in angawina suangpeek tungnung kulh tung pan ama tungah khiatsukin Thebez-ah amah si hilo ahi hiam? Bang hangin tua zahin kulh nai-ah pai na hi uh hiam?' hong cih leh nangmah in, 'Hit mi na nasempa Uriah zong si hi,' na ci ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kamtaipa pai a, hong tungin a gen dingin Joab in a sawl thu khempeuh David kiangah a gen hi.
Kamtaipa in David kiangah, "Mite in kote hong zothawhin gamlakah kote a do dingin hong kuankhia uh hi. Ahih hangin kote in kulhkongpi lutna dongah amaute ka notkik uh hi.
David in kamtaipa kiangah, "Joab kiangah hih bangin na gen in: 'Hih thu hangin nangmah kilungkhamsak kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh namsau in koi lai panin hong vat ding cih a kimatheih lo mah ahi hi. Khuapi na simna hanciamin lumlet in,' ci-in Joab hanthawn in," a ci hi.
A kahna a ven' ciangin David in mi sawlin ama inn-ah tuanu lasak a, tuanu ama zi suakin, amah tawh tapa khat a nei hi. Ahih hangin David' gamtatna thu in { Topa } lungkimlo sak hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in David kiangah kamsang Nathan sawl hi. Amah hong pai-in David kiangah, "Khuapi khat sungah mi nih om a, khat hau-in a khat zawng hi.
A haupa in tuuhon leh bawnghon tampi nei hi.
Ahih hangin a zawngpa in bangmah neilo a, a leisa tuuno a nu khat bek nei hi. Amah in tua tuuno khoi a, amah leh a tate tawh khangkhawm hi. Ama an ne-in a hai panin dawn a, ama ang sungah lum a, ama-a' dingin tanu tawh kibang hi.
Tu-in mihaupa' inn-ah zin khat hong tung a, amah in a tuuhon ahi a, a bawnghon pan ahi zongin ama kiangah a tung khualzinpa-a' dingin a gawh ding la nuamloin mizawngpa' tuuno laksak a, ama kianga a tung mipa-a' dingin a gawhsak hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tua mipa' tungah David sinso mahmah hi. Amah in Nathan kiangah, "{ Topa } a nungta ahih mah bangin hih banga a gamta mipa a sih ding kilawm hi.
Amah hih bangin gamta a, amah in hehpihna neilo ahih manin a tuuno a zah li-in loh ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Nathan in David kiangah, "Nang pen tua mipa na hi hi. Israel Pasian, { Topa } in hih bangin ci hi: 'Israel-te tungah kumpi-in nang sathau hong nilhin Saul' khutsung panin nang kong honkhia hi.
Keimah in na topa' inn leh na topa' zite na khutsungah kong pia a, Israel-te leh Judah mite nang kong pia hi. Hihte a tawmlua hi leh tua zah nih a hong pia khin ding ka hi hi.
Ama muhna-ah a sia a gamta dingin bang hangin { Topa' } thu simmawh na hi hiam? Nangmah in Hit mi Uriah namsau tawh vatin, ama zi nangma zi dingin na la a, Ammon mite' namsau tawh amah na that khin hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in nangmah in kei hong simmawhin Hit mi Uriah' zi nangma zi dingin la khin na hih manin na inn sungah namsau tawh kidona veng ngeilo ding hi,' ci hi.
{ Topa } in hih bangin ci hi: 'En in, keimah in nangma innkuan sung panin nangma langah siatna a piangsak ding khat ka khangsak ding hi. Na zite na muhin la-in na vengpa' tungah ka pia ding a, amah in sun nitaang sungah na zite luppih ding hi.
David in hih thu a zak ciangin Nathan kiangah, "{ Topa' } tungah ka khial khin hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Nathan in David kiangah, "{ Topa } in zong na khialhna hong maisak khinzo hi; nang na si kei ding hi.
Ahi zongin, hih bangin gamtatna tawh { Topa } thusim peuhmahlo na hih manin nang' sung panin a hong piang naungek si ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Nathan a inn-ah a ciah hi. Tua ciangin Uriah' zi in David tawh a neih naungek{ Topa } in vat a, a ci hong na hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in naungek-a' dingin Pasian' tungah thum hi. David in an tangin zan tawntung leilakah a lum hi.
Tua ciangin leilak panin a phong dingin a innsung upate ama kiangah ding uh hi. Ahih hangin amah tholo a, amaute tawh an zong ne nuamlo hi.
A ni sagih ni-in naungek si hi. Ama kiangah, naungek si hi, ci-in a gen ding uh David' nasemte lau uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in, "Naungek a hin'lai nangawnin amah i hopih hangin i thu hong ngailo hi. Tua ahih ciangin bangci-in ama kiangah, naungek si, ci ngam ding ihi hiam? Amahmah kisusia khading hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin David leilak panin tho-in kisil a, sathau nilhin a puante khek a, { Topa' } inn-ah pai-in Pasian a bia hi. Tua ciangin ama inn-ah ciah hi. An a nget ciangin amaute in a mai-ah lui uh a, amah in a ne hi.
Tua ciangin a nasemte in ama kiangah, "Hih banga na gamtatna a bangci hiam? Naungek a hin' lai-in an tangin na kap hi; ahih hangin naungek a sih ciangin tho-in an na ne zawsop hi," a ci uh hi.
Amah in, "Naungek a hin' lai-in an tangin ka kap hi; bang hang hiam cih leh, 'Naungek a hin'na dingin { Topa } in kei hong hehpih ding hiam, hong hehpihlo ding hiam, cih kua in theikhol ahi hiam?' ka ci hi.
Ahih hangin tu-in amah si ta hi; bang hangin an tang nawn ding ka hi hiam? Amah lakik thei ding ka hi hiam? Ama kiangah kei ka pai ding a, ahih hangin kei kiangah amah hong kiklo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in a zi Bathsheba hehnem a, ama kiangah pai-in amah tawh a lumkhawm hi. Tuanu in tapa khat nei a, a min Solomon a phuak hi. { Topa } in tua naupang it ahih manin,
kamsang Nathan' tungah thu puak hi. { Topa' } itna hangin ama min Jedidiah a phuah ding a gen hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi a omlaiteng kaikhawm in la, khuapi langah phual satin khuapi la in; tua hi kei leh keimah in khuapi la-in keima min pua khading hi," a ci hi.
Amah in a sunga om mite paikhiatpihin singatnate, tuzumte, leh heite tawh na a sem dingin koih a, leiseek seekna-ah amaute na semsak hi. Tua bangin Ammon mite' khuapi khempeuh a hih hi. Tua ciangin David leh mi khempeuh Jerusalem-ah a ciah uh hi.
Tu-in David' tapa Absalom in Tamar min nei sanggam numei a melhoih mahmah khat nei hi. Tawlkhat khit ciangin David' tapa Ammon in tuanu ngai hi.
Ammon in ngailua mahmah ahih manin a sanggamnu Tamar hangin cinat lawh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nungak leh tangval kituam omsak ahih manin Ammon in tuanu a muhtheihna ding omtheih tuaklo hi.
Amah in Ammon kiangah, "Kumpipa' tapa aw, bang hangin zingsang khat khit zingsang khat thakiam semsem na hi hiam? Kei kiangah a hang hong genlo ding na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Ammon in ama kiangah, "Ka sanggampa Absalom' sanggamnu Tamar ka ngai hi," a ci hi.
Jonadab in ama kiangah, "Na lupna tungah lum in la, a cina kineih in. Nangmah a veh dingin na pa hong pai ciangin ama kiangah, 'Keimah in mu-in ama khut panin an ka nek theihna dingin ka sanggamnu Tamar hong paisakin annek ding hong piasak in la, ka muhna-ah an hong bawl sak in,' ci in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Ammon lumin a cina kineih hi. Amah a en dingin kumpipa a pai ciangin Ammon in kumpipa kiangah, "Ama khut panin ka nek theihna dingin ka sanggamnu Tamar hong paisakin mohpheng nih khawng na bawlsakna ding kong thum hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in inn-a Tamar kiangah mi sawlin, "Na sanggampa Ammon' inn-ah pai-in ama-a' ding an bawlsak in," cisak hi.
Tua ciangin amah in sikbeeldai la-in ama mai-ah sungkhia a, ahih hangin amah in ne nuamlo hi. Tua ciangin Ammon in, "Kei kiang panin mi khempeuh sawlkhia masa in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin ama kiang panin mi khempeuh paikhia hi.
Tua ciangin Ammon in Tamar kiangah, "Na khut tung panin ka nek theihna dingin inndei sungah an hong paipih in," a ci hi. Tamar in a bawlsa mohphengte la-in inndei sung a sanggampa Ammon kiangah paipih hi.
Keimah in ka maizumna koi-ah seelcipzo ding ka hi hiam? Nang zong, Israel-te sungah mihai luate khat bang na hi ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in kong thum hi, kumpipa kiangah gen in; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in nang-a' dingin kei hong khaktanlo ding hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in a thugen ngailo hi. Amah sangin hatzaw ahih manin thatanghat thu tawh hihin amah luppih hi.
Tua ciangin Ammon in nakpi takin Tamar mudah hi. Amah in a cil-a a itna zah sangin a muhdahna lianzaw hi. Tua ahih ciangin Ammon in ama kiangah, "Ding in, paikhia in," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a numei in ama kiangah, "Hilo hi, ka sanggampa aw; bang hang hiam cih leh kei nong sawlkhiatna pen kei tungah nong hihsa thu sangin lianzaw hi," a ci hi. Ahih hangin a thu ngailo hi.
Amah in a nasem tangvalpa samin, "Ka omna panin hih numei koihkhia in la, ama nungah kongkhak kalh in," a ci hi.
Tuanu in puantualpi ban nei khat silh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa' tanute in tua bangin puan silh hi. Tua ahih ciangin a nasempa in tuanu koihkhia-in ama nungah kongkhak kalh hi.
Tua ciangin a sanggampa Absalom in ama kiangah, "Na sanggampa Ammon in nang hong bawlsia ahi hiam? Bangbang hita leh kilungnuamsak in, ka sanggamnu aw; amah pen na sanggampa ahi hi; hih thu na lungsimah koih kei in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin a sanggampa Absalom' inn-ah Tamar lungzuang khawngai-in a om hi.
Absalom in Ammon kiangah a pha ahi a, a sia ahi zongin bangmah gen vetlo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in a sanggamnu Tamar thatanghat thu tawh hih ahih manin Absalom in Ammon mudah lua mahmah hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in Absalom kiangah, "Hilo hi, ka tapa aw; i vekpi-in pai kei ni; pai lehang kote pen nang-a' dingin vangik ka hi khading uh hi," a ci hi. Amah in ci teitei a, ahih hangin amah pai nuamloin ama thupha a tungah a pia hi.
Tua ciangin Absalom in, "Tua bang hilo ding ahih leh ka sanggampa Ammon kote tawh nong paisak ding kong thum hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Bang hangin nang tawh amah hong pai ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Absalom in Ammon leh kumpipa' tapate khempeuh amah tawh a paisak mateng ci teitei hi.
Amaute lamkalah a om laitakin David kiangah thu tung a, "Absalom in kumpipa' tapate khempeuh that a, khat beek sitlo hi," kici hi.
Ahih hangin David' sanggampa Shimeah' tapa Jonadab in, "Amaute in kumpipa' tapa tangvalte khempeuh that hi, ci-in ka topa in ngaihsun kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh Ammon bek si hi. Amah in a sanggamnu Tamar thatanghat thu tawh a hih ni-a kipanin Absalom' thupiakna tawh hih thu a kisehkhol ahi hi.
Amah in a thugen a man khit phetin, kumpipa' tapate hong tungin hong kap uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa zong a nasemte khempeuh tawh nakpi takin a kap uh hi.
Absalom ahih leh Geshur-ah pai a, tua lai-ah kum thum sung a om hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Joab in Tekoa-ah mi sawlin tua panin numei pil khat la-in ama kiangah, "Dahin a kap kineih in la, dahna lim puante silh in. Sathau nilh kei in la, misi hangin ni tampi a thum khin numei bangin gamta in.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah pai in la, hih bangin ama kiangah thu gen in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Joab in ama gen ding thute a hilh hi.
Na nasemnu in tapa nih nei a, lo sungah amaute gel kitawng uh hi. Amaute gel a khen ding kuamah omlo a, khat in a khatpa satin that hi.
Tu-in ka beh buppi na nasemnu' langah hong pangin amaute in, 'Ama thah a sanggampa' nuntakna tangin amah ka thah theihna dingun a sanggampa a sat mipa hong pia in,' hong ci uh hi. Tua bangin amaute in innluahpa zong susia ding uh hi. Tua bangin amaute in a omlai ka lametnapa beisakin leitungah ka pasal' suanlekhak a suakta omsaklo ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Kumpipa in, "Nang' tungah mi khatpeuh in thu khatpeuh hong gen leh kei kiangah amah hong paipih in; amah in nang hong sukik ngei nawnlo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Phulapa in that nawnloin, ka tapa a kisuksiat lohna dingin kumpipa in { Topa } na Pasian' tungah na kiciam ding kong thum hi," a ci hi. Amah in, "{ Topa } a nungta ahih mah bangin na tapa' samzang khat zong lei-ah kialo ding hi," ci-in a kiciam hi.
Tua ciangin a numei in, "Tua ahih leh bang hangin Pasian' mite' langah tua bang na hih sawm na hi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh hih bang lungsim khentatna na piakna-ah kumpipa in a hawlkhiatna a inn-ah a paipih kik mateng kumpipa amahmah mawh a kipia ahi hi.
Eite khempeuh i si ding a, a kikhawm kik theilo leilakah a bua tui tawh i kibang hi. Ahih hangin a hawlkhiatpa a kipuasehin a kikoih lohna dingin lampi a zong mipa' nuntakna Pasian in lakhia lo ding hi.
Mite in kei hong lausak ahih manin tu-in ka to kumpipa kiangah hih thu a gen dingin kong pai hi. Na nasemnu in, 'Kumpipa kiangah thu ka gen ding a, kumpipa in a nasemnu' ngetna sem khading hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa in za-in, Pasian' gamh panin kei leh ka tapa hong susia khawm ding mipa' khut panin a nasemnu honkhia ding hi,' ci-in ngaihsun hi.
Na nasemnu in, 'Ka to kumpipa' kammal in nopsakna hong pia ding hi,' ci-in ngaihsun hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka to kumpipa pen a pha leh a sia a khenthei dingin Pasian' vantung mi tawh kibang hi. { Topa } na Pasian in nang hong ompih ta hen!" a ci hi.
Kumpipa in, "Hih thu khempeuh Joab' vaihawmna tawh hong pai na hi hiam?" a ci hi. A numei in dawngin, "Nang a nungta taktak na hih mah bangin ka to kumpipa aw, ka to kumpipa' gen bang teekteek mah ahi hi. Kei hong sawlpa pen na nasempa Joab hi a, na nasemnu' gen dingin hih thute a hong sawlpa amah ahi hi.
Na thu paizia khekna dingin na nasempa Joab in hih thu hih hi. Ahih hangin ka topa in leitunga om na khempeuh theihna dingin Pasian' vantung mi pilna tawh a kibang pilna na nei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Ama inn-ah amah tuam ten'sak in; keima omna-ah amah hong pailo ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Absalom ama inn-ah tuam ten'in kumpipa omna-ah pailo hi.
Tu-in Israel-te khempeuh sungah a melhoihna hangin Absalom zahin tua bangin phat ding kuamah omlo hi. A khenuai-a kipan a luzang dongin ama tungah paubaan'na omlo hi.
Amah in a sam a met ciangin (kum bei simin amah in met zel hi; a sam a gih ciangin amah in met hi), amah in a sam tawi khai a, kumpipa' gik tehna-in shekel za nih a gik hi.
Absalom' sung pan tapa thum, leh a min Tamar ahi ta numei khat a suak hi; tuanu pen a melhoih mahmah khat ahi hi.
Tua hi a, kumpipa' omna-ah pailoin Absalom kum nih bit Jerusalem-ah teng hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah a sawl dingin Absalom in Joab samsak hi. Ahih hangin ama kiangah Joab hong pailo hi. Amah in a nih veina sawl a, ahih hangin Joab hong pailo veve hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a nasemte kiangah, "En un, Joab' lo pen keima-a' zom hi a, tua lai-ah amah in mangbuhham nei hi; pai un la mei tawh va hal un," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Absalom' nasemte in a lo mei tawh a hal uh hi.
Absalom in Joab dawngin, "En in, nang kiangah thu kong puak a, 'Kumpipa kiangah nang hong sawlin, "Bang hangin Geshur panin hong pai ka hi hiam? Tua lai-ah omlai leng kei-a' dingin hoihzaw ding hi," ci-in a va dong dingin hih lai-ah nong paina ding kong gen hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in kumpipa omna-ah kei hong paisak in; kei tungah mawhna a om leh amah hong thatsak in,' ka ci hi," a ci hi.
Absalom tho baihin kulhkongpi lam gei-ah tu zel hi. Mi khatpeuh in thu khensak dingin kumpipa' mai-ah paina ding thu a neih ciangin Absalom in amah samin, "Koi khua pan na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in, "Na nasempa, Israel-te sungah tua minam tua khua ka hi hi," a cih ciangin
Absalom in ama kiangah, "Thei in, na thugente hoihin man hi; ahih hangin na thu a khen dingin kumpipa in a koih mi omlo hi," a ci hi.
Tua thamloin Absalom in, "Gamsungah kei thukhen hi leng! Thu ahi a, a hang khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin a nei mi peuhmah kei kiangah hong pai ding a, keimah in ama tungah thu a tangin ka khen ding hi," a ci hi.
Kum li a cin' ciangin Absalom in kumpipa kiangah, "Kei hong paisak in la, { Topa' } tungah ka ciamsa ka thuciam, Hebron-ah hong piasak in, ci-in kong thum hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Aram gam Geshur-ah ka om laitakin na nasempa in thu khat ciam a, '{ Topa } in Jerusalem-ah kei hong paipih kik taktak leh { Topa' } tungah biakna ka pia ding hi,' ka ci hi," a ci hi.
A kisam mi za nihte Jerusalem panin Absalom tawh a pai uh hi. Amaute lungsim hoih tawh a pai hi a, bangmah theilo uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa paikhia a, ama innkuan leh a ulian khempeuh in ama nung a zui uh hi. Kumpipa in inn kem dingin a zineu sawm nusia hi.
Tua ciangin a nasemte khempeuh in amah nawkin pai uh hi. Khereth mi khempeuh, Peleth mi khempeuh, leh Gath panin amah a zui mi za gukte khempeuh, kumpipa' mai nawkin paisuak uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Gath mi Ittai kiangah, "Bang hangin nang zong kote hong zui na hi hiam? Ciahkik in la, kumpipa tawh om in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen gamdang mi na hi a, na inn panin gamdangah a om zong na hi hi.
Nang pen zan mah beka hong pai na hi hi. Koi lai munah kei pai ding cih theilopi-in kote tawh a kawivak dingin nang hong bawl ding ka hi hiam? Ciahkik in, na sanggamte ciahpih in. { Topa } in itna kip leh thumanna nang' tungah hong lak ta hen," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Ittai in kumpipa dawngin, "{ Topa } nungta-in, ka to kumpipa zong nungta ahih mah bangin, sihna ding ahi a, hin'na ding ahi zongin ka to kumpipa a omna peuhpeuhah na nasempa om ding hi," a ci hi.

Tua ahih ciangin mi khempeuh a pai laitakin gamsung mi khempeuh a gingin kapkhia uh a, kumpipa in Kidron lui kantanin, mi khempeuh zong gamlak lamah a paisuak uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Zadok kiangah, "Pasian' Thuciamna Singkuang khuapi sungah puakik in. { Topa' } maipha ka muh nak leh, amah in kei hong paipih kikin Thuciamna Singkuang leh a omna mun hong musak kik ding hi.

Thei in, kei kiangah thu a hong zasak dingin nang' kiang panin thuko mi hong tun' mateng gamlak tui ngahmunte-ah ka na ngak ding hi," cithuah lai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Zadok leh Abiathar in Pasian' Thuciamna Singkuang Jerusalem-ah puakik uh a, amaute tua lai-ah om uh hi.
Ahih hangin Oliv Mual tung kahtohna-ah David paito a, khe guak leh lu tuamsa-in a paikawmin kap hi. Amah tawh a om mi khempeuh zong lu khuhsa-in a paitoh kawmun a kap uh hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa in Ziba kiangah, "En in, Mefibosheth' neihsa khempeuh tu-in nangma-a' ahi hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Ziba in, "Kei, nangma nasempa ka hi hi; ka to kumpipa' muhna-ah maipha hong musak tawntung in," a ci hi.
Bahurim-ah Kumpi David a tun' ciangin Saul' innsung innkuan mi, Gera' tapa Shimei min nei mi khat hong paikhia a, a paikawmin David samsia tawntung hi.
Amah in Kumpi David leh a nasemte khempeuh suang tawh deng hi. Mi khempeuh leh mi thahatte khempeuh David' taklam leh veilamah om uh hi.
Shimei in a samsiat kawmin, "Pai mang, pai mang, nang mi thatpa, bangmah manlo mipa!
Ama tangin na uk Saul' innkuante na thahna hangin { Topa } in nangma tungah hong thuk hi. { Topa } in na tapa Absalom' tungah kumpi gam pia khinta hi. Thei in, na siatna nangma lu tungah hong tu hi; bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen mi thatpa na hi hi," a ci hi.

Ahih hangin kumpipa in, "No Zeruiah tapate aw, note tawh bang kisai ahi hiam? { Topa } in ama kiangah, 'David samsia in,' a cihna hangin hong samsia ahih leh, 'Bang hangin tuaci hih na hi hiam?' kua in ci ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.

{ Topa } in ka thuakna hong enin, tuni-a kei hong samsiatna hangin { Topa } in a hoih tawh kei hong thuk khading hi," a ci hi.

Tua ciangin kumpipa leh amah tawh a om mi khempeuhte gim mahmahin Jordan tung uh a, tua lai-ah amah kitawldamsak hi.

Tua ciangin Hushai in Absalom kiangah, "Tutungin Ahithofel' thugen hoihlo hi," a ci hi.

Tua ciangin a lungtang humpinelkai lungtang a bang galhang mipa nangawn launa tawh lungkia gawp ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Israel-te khempeuh in na pa mi thahat ahihna leh amah tawh a om mite mi hang ahihna thei uh hi.
Ahih hangin keima ngaihsutna hih bang ahi hi: Dan panin Beersheba ciangdong, tuipi gei-a sehnel bangin a tam Israel mi khempeuh nang kiangah khawmin galsim dingin nangmahmah na kuan ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah i muhna mun khat peuhpeuhah theihkholh lohin i hihgawp ding hi. Amah leh amah tawh a om mi khempeuh khat zong kisitlo ding hi.
Amah khuapi khat sungah a nungkik leh, Israel-te khempeuh in tua khuapi sungah khauhual paipihin tua lai munah suangtang khat nangawn a kimu nawnlo dingin kuam sungah tua khua i kaikhia ding hi," a ci hi.
