Ahih hangin David in, "Note pen tuni-in kei' lang bangin na omna dingun no Zeruiah' tapate tawh kei bang kisai ihi hiam? Tuni-in Israel sungah mi khatpeuh kithat ding ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh tuni-in Israel-te' tungah kumpi ka hihna thei hilo ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa a dawn dingin Saul' tupa Mefibosheth hong paisuk hi. Kumpipa a paikhiat ni-a kipan lungnuamin hong tun'kik ni dong, amah in a khete zeemlo, a khamul puahlo, a puante zong sawplo hi.
Jerusalem panin kumpipa a dawn dingin hong pai ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Mefibosheth aw, bang hangin kei hong zuilo na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in dawngin, "Ka topa! Aw Kumpipa, ka nasempa in kei hong khem hi; bang hang hiam cih leh na nasempa in ama kiangah, 'Kei a tungah tuangin kumpipa ka zuih theihna dingin kei-a' dingin la khat tutphah vawh in,' ka ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh na nasempa a khe bai hi.
Amah in ka to kumpipa kiangah na nasempa hong gensia hi. Ahih hangin ka to kumpipa pen Pasian' vantung mi tawh kibang hi. Tua ahih ciangin hoih na sak bangin hong hih in.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Bang hangin nangma thu gen lailai na hi hiam? Ka lungsim ka khentatzo hi; nang leh Ziba in leitang na hawm ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Rogelim panin Gilead mi Barzillai zong hong paisuk hi. Jordan galkhatah amah a kha dingin kumpipa tawh Jordan ciangdong amah paisuak hi.
Barzillai pen kum sawmgiat a pha, a khangham mahmah mi khat ahi hi. Mahanaim-ah kumpipa a om laitakin amah in an pia hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah mihau mahmah khat ahi hi.
Kumpipa in Barzillai kiangah, "Kei hong zui in la, Jerusalem-ah kei tawh hong om in, nang kong vak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tuni-in kei kum sawmgiat ka pha ta a, a nuam leh a nuamlo khentel thei nawn ka hi hiam? Na nasempa in a nek ahi a, a dawn ahi zongin a limna phawk thei nawn ka hi hiam? Lasa numeite leh lasa pasalte' aw za thei nawn ka hi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin ka to kumpipa tungah na nasempa vangik kibehlap hong hi ding ka hi hiam?
Keima khuapi sung mah, ka nu leh ka pa' han nai-ah ka sih theihna dingin na nasempa hong ciahsak kik in, ci-in kong thum hi. Ahih hangin hih lai-ah ka tapa na nasempa Khimham om hi; ka to kumpipa tawh amah galkah sak in; hoih na sak bangbangin ama-a' ding hihsak in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in dawngin, "Khimham in kei hong zui ding a, nangmah in hoih na sak bangbangin ama-a' ding ka hihsak ding hi; kei tung panin na deih khempeuh nangma-a' dingin kong hihsak ding hi," a ci hi.
Gilgal-ah kumpipa paisuak a, amah tawh Khimham paisuak hi. Judah mi khempeuh, leh Israel mi a kimkhatte in zong ama paina dingah kumpipa a kha uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite khempeuh hong pai-in kumpipa kiangah, "Bang hangin ka sanggam uh Judah mite in nang hong gukhia-in, kumpipa leh a innkuante, leh David' mite amah tawh, Jordan galah paipih ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite in Judah mite dawngin, "Kumpipa sungah tanh sawm ka nei uh a, David' sungah note khempeuh sangin tam ka neizaw uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin note in kote hong simmawh na hi uh hiam? Kote pen i kumpipa ciahpih kik ding a gen masate hilo ka hi uh hiam?" a ci uh hi. Ahih hangin Israel mite' kammal sangin Judah mite' kammal kihtakhuai zaw hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel mi khempeuh David' kiang pan nungkik uh a, Bikhri' tapa Sheba zui uh hi. Ahih hangin Judah mite in Jordan panin Jerusalem ciangdong a kumpipa uh kiptakin zui uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jerusalem-a a inn-ah David tung hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in inn kem dingin a nusiat a zineu sawmte la-in a kivil inn khat sungah amaute koihin amaute a vak hi. Ahih hangin amaute luppihlo hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute a khang laipi-in meigong numei suak uh a, a sih dong uh amaute kikhumcip hi.
Tua ciangin David in Abishai kiangah, "Tu-in Bikhri' tapa Sheba in Absalom sangin eite tungah siatna tamzaw hong bawl ding hi. Na topa' nasemte la in la, amah delh in. Tua hi kei leh amah in ama-a' dingin khuapi muan'huaite ngahin eite tungah buaina hong piangsak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Abishai' nungah Joab leh Khereth mite leh Peleth mite, leh mi thahat khempeuh pai uh hi. Bikhri' tapa Sheba a delh dingin Jerusalem panin amaute kuankhia uh hi.
Gibeon gamsunga suangtumpi-ah amaute a tun' uh ciangin amaute a dawn dingin Amasa hong pai hi. Tu-in Joab in galkap puan silhin, tua tungah, a kawng tungah a kigak a paai sunga namsau tawh a kithuah kawnggak khat om a, a mailam manawhin a pai laitakin a namsau seel hi.
Tua ciangin Joab in Amasa kiangah, "Ka sanggampa aw, bangcici na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ciangin Joab in amah a hopih kawmin a taklam khut tawh a khamul-in Amasa man hi.
Ahih hangin Amasa in Joab' khutsunga om namsau mulo hi. Tua ahih ciangin Joab in a namsau tawh a pumpi sat a, nihvei sat kulloin a gilpi leilakah buakhia hi; tua ciangin Amasa a si hi. Tua ciangin Joab leh a sanggampa Abishai in Bikhri' tapa Sheba delhuh hi.
Tua ciangin Joab' mite khat Amasa' kiangah dingin, "Joab a gum peuhmah, leh David-a' ahi mi peuhmah in Joab zui un," a ci hi.
Lam lianpi-a ama sisan sungah Amasa kidiahin a om hi. Tua lai-ah a pai mi peuhmah in amah a muh ciangin a khawl uh hi. Mi khempeuh a khawlna tua mipa in a muh ciangin amah in lam lianpi panin gamlakah Amasa puakhia-in ama tungah puan khat a khuh hi.
Tua ciangin Joab tawh a om mi khempeuh hong pai-in Abelbethmaakah khua-ah amah umcih uh hi. Amaute in khuapi simna-in suang cianpi khat bawl uh a, kulhpi langkhatah ding uh hi. Tua ciangin kulhpi a puk theihna dingin amaute in kulhpi nuai to uh hi.
Tua ciangin numei pil khat in khuapi panin samin, "Za un! Joab kiangah gen un: 'Nang tungah thu kong gen theihna dingin hih lai-ah hong pai in,' ci un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tuanu' mai-ah Joab hong pai hi. Tua numei in, "Nang, Joab na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in dawngin, "Ka hi hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin tua numei in ama kiangah, "Na nasemnu' thugente ngai in," a ci hi. Amah in dawngin, "Ka ngai hi," a ci hi.
Kei pen Israel sungah tua bangin kilemna a deih a thuman mi khat ka hi hi. Nang in Israel sungah nu tawh a kibang khuapi khat suksiat ding na hanciam hi. Bang hangin { Topa' } gamhluah valhtum ding na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Joab in dawngin, "Keimah in ka valhtum ding ahi a, ka suksiat ding ahi zongin keima ngaihsut hi deklo hi.
Tua thu manlo hi. Ahih hangin Efraim mualtung gammi Bikhri' tapa Sheba a kici mipa in Kumpi David lehdo hi; amah bek hong pia in. Tua hi leh khuapi panin ka nungkik ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin tua numei in Joab kiangah, "En in, kulhsung panin nang kiangah ama lutang hong kilawnsuk ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua laitakin Joab pen Israel galkap khempeuh a uk ahi hi. Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah pen Khereth mite leh Peleth mite a uk ahi hi.
Adoram pen aana tawh na a kisemsakte a uk ahi hi. Ahilud' tapa Jehoshafat pen thu ciamtehpa ahi hi.
Sheva pen lai-atpa ahi hi. Zadok leh Abiathar siampite ahi uh hi.
Tu-in kum khat khit kum khat, David' hun sungin kum thum sung kialpi tung hi. Tua ciangin David in { Topa' } kiangah thu dong hi. { Topa } in, "Amah in Gibeon mite that ahih manin Saul leh a innkuan tungah mi thahna hanga mawhna om hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in Gibeon mite sam hi. Tu-in Gibeon mite pen Israel-te' sung hiloin Amor mi a omlaite ahi uh hi. Amaute a hingkhawi ding Israel mite kiciam khin napi-in, Israel leh Judah mite-a' ding a deih luatna-in Saul in amaute thah dingin hanciam hi.
Tua ciangin David in Gibeon mite kiangah, "Note-a' dingin bang hong hihsak ding ka hi hiam? Note in { Topa' } mite thupha na piaktheihna dingun bangci bangin kilemna hong bawl ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Gibeon mite in ama kiangah, "Kote leh Saul ahi a, a innkuan tawh kikalah ahi zongin kitotna a om pen ngun leh kham in maisak zolo ding hi. Israel-te sungah mi khatpeuh ka thah hangun zong lungkim zawhna ding omlo hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Note-a' ding kong hihsak ding bang hi, ci na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Amaute in kumpipa kiangah, "Israel gamsungah kote in mun ka neihlohna dingun kote hong netumin suksiat ding Saul in vaihawm hi.
{ Topa' } mualtung, { Topa' } mai Gibeon-ah amaute ka khai theihna dingun ama tapa sagihte hong pia in," a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Amaute kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in amah leh Saul' tapa Jonathan' kikalah a om, { Topa } tawh kiciamna hangin Jonathan' tapa, Saul' tupa Mefibosheth a sit hi.
Ahi zongin Aiah' tanu Rizpah' tapa nih, Saul tawh a neih Armoni leh Mefibosheth; leh Saul' tanu Merab in Meholah mi Barzillai' tapa Adriel tawh a neih a tapa ngate a la hi.
Amah in Gibeon mite tungah amaute pia a, amaute in { Topa' } mai mualtungah amaute khai uh a, amau sagihte sikhawm uh hi. Mangbuhham lak kipat hun, anlak kipat cil lamin amaute kithat hi.
Tua ciangin Aiah' tanu Rizpah in a puanhampi la-in, anlak-a kipan van panin amau' luanghawmte tungah guah a zuk dongin ama lupna dingin suangpi tungah a phah hi. Sunin huihlak vasate in ahi a, zanin gamsate in ahi zongin amau' luanghawmte a sukkhak lohna dingun a cing hi.
David pai-in Gilboa mualtungah Filistia-te in Saul a thah lai hunin Filistia-te in amaute a khaina mun Bethshan khuasung kongzing lampi laizang panin a luanghawm a guksak Jabeshgilead mite' tung panin Saul' guhte leh a tapa Jonathan' guhte a lakik hi.
Amah in tua lai panin Saul' guhte leh a tapa Jonathan' guhte paipihto hi. Amaute in a kikhai mi sagihte' guh zong kaikhawm uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Zela khuasung Benjamin' leitang, a pa Kish' han sungah Saul leh a tapa Jonathan' guhte phum uh a, amaute in kumpipa' thupiak khempeuh hih uh hi. Tua khit ciangin tua gam-a' ding thumnate Pasian in a ngai hi.
Mithagolte' suante khat, a teipi sumngo shekel za thum a gik, namsau thak khat a kuah Ishbibenob in David thah ding ngaihsun hi.
Ahih hangin amah a huh dingin Zeruiah' tapa Abishai hong pai a, Filistia-pa simin amah a that hi. Tua ciangin David' mite in amah kunh-in, "Galsim dingin ko tawh nong kuankhia nawn kei ding hi. Hong kuan lecin Israel mite' muan' leh suan'pa kong taan khading uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin, a khut langtuakah khutme guk, leh a khe langtuakah kheme guk, a vekpi-in sawmnihleli a nei, mi thalian khat a omna Gath-ah gal om leuleu hi. Amah zong mithagolte' sung panin a piang ahi hi.
Hih mi lite pen Gath-a mithagolte' sung pana piang ahi uh hi. David leh a nasemte in amaute a that uh hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in ama galte khempeuh' khutsung, leh Saul' khutsung panin amah a hotkhiat hunin David in hih la kammalte { Topa' } tungah a gen hi.
Amah in, "{ Topa }, kei hong hupa, ka kulhpi, kei hong honkhiapa,
ka Pasian, ka kihutna, ka buknapa, lum bangin kei a hong dal, ka munmuan'huai leh ka belh, keimah hong honkhiapa hi a, ngong hihna panin hong hon hi.
A phat taak { Topa } ka sam a, ka galte kiang panin kei hong kihon hi.
Ka lungkhamna-ah { Topa } ka sam a, ka Pasian ka sam hi. A biakinn panin amah in ka aw hong za a, ka kikona awging ama bil a tung hi.
"Tua ciangin ama hehna hangin leitung kisingin, nakpi takin kilokgawp a, vantung bulpite kilinggawp hi.
Amah in ama kimkotah khuamial bawl a, a tung kikhuhna dingin meii sahpi a zang hi.
"Vantung panin { Topa } hong awngsuk a, Sang Penpa in a aw hong gingsak hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa' } mawhsakna awging lianpi hangin tuipi tawte kidawk a, lei bulpite a guakin om hi.
A hat ka galte panin kei hong honkhia a, kei hong mudahte panin hong suaktasak hi. Keima-a' dingin ka galte hatlua uh hi.
Ka kamsiat ni-in kei hong simgawp uh a, ahih hangin { Topa } in kei hong huh hi.
"Ka thumanna tawh kizui-in { Topa } in thaman hong pia a, ka siangthona tawh kizui-in hong dinkik hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa' } thu ka zui a, ka Pasian ka langpang kei hi.
Ama mai-ah kawk ka baang kei a, kisuan'na dangte panin hoihtakin ka kikem hi.
Tua ahih ciangin { Topa } in ka thumanna, ama muhna-ah ka siangthona tawh kizui-in kei hong dinkik khin hi.
"Thuman mi tungah nangmah na thuman a, a kawkbaanglo mi tungah a kawkbaang loin na gamta hi.
{ Topa } aw, nang pen keima meivak na hi hi. Ka Pasian in ka khuamial vaksak hi.
"Hih Pasian a thu kicing a, { Topa' } kamciamna a manna kilang hi. Amah a beelte khempeuh-a' dingin kidalna lum ahi hi.
{ Topa } longal Pasian kua hiam? I Pasian simloh, hong hu kua hiam?
Hih Pasian, a muan'huai keima belh hi a, ka lampi khempeuh lungmuan'huaisak hi.
Ka kalsuanna ding mun tanzau keima nuai-ah nong pia a, ka khe taallo hi.
Amaute ka beisak a, amaute ka sunlet hi; amaute thokik nawnlo uh a, ka khenuai-ah amaute puk uh hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in galdona dingin tha nong guan' a, keimah hong dote ka nuai-ah na nengniam hi.
Amaute khuadak uh a, ahih hangin a honkhia ding kuamah omlo hi. { Topa' } tungah hong ko uh a, ahih hangin amah in amaute dawnglo hi.
Mite tawh kidona panin nangmah in nong honkhia a, minamte' lutangin kei nong bawl a, ka theih ngeiloh mite in keima na hong sem uh hi.
Gamdang mite lungkia uh a, a phualkip panun liingin hong paikhia uh hi.
"{ Topa } hing hi; kei hong hupa in thupha ngah hen la, ka Pasian, kei hong honkhiapa,
ka galte kiang panin kei hong paikhiatpihpa vanglian ta hen. Nangmah in ka langte tungah kei nong liansak a, mi ngongtatte kiang panin kei nong honkhia hi.
"{ Topa } aw, hih thu hangin minam khempeuh lakah nang kong phat ding a, na min phatna la ka sa ding hi.
Zawhna lianpi ama kumpipa tungah pia a, a sathau nilhpa David leh a suanlekhakte tungah a tawntungin itna kip a lak hi," a ci hi.
Jessi' tapa David, milianpi a suak mipa, Jakob' Pasian' sathau nilhpa, Israel laphuak siampa David' kam nunungte hih bang ahi hi:
"{ Topa' } kha in kei tung tawnin thu hong gen a, ka kam sungah ama thugente om hi.
amah pen amaute tungah zingsang khuavak bangin taang ziazua a, meii kaai loh ni zingsanga ni taangkhia, leilak panin lopate a selsak guahtui tawh kibang hi.
Ahih hangin mi gilote ahih leh a kilawnkhia lingkungte tawh kibang hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh khut guak tawh amaute kilawng ngamlo a,
amaute a lawng ding mipa pen sik leh teipi bul tawh kithawi a, amaute mei tawh kihaltum siang hi," a ci hi.
David' neih mi thahatte' minte: Tahkhemon mi Joshebbasshebeth hi a, amah pen mi thumte a ukpa ahi hi. Amah in a teipi tawh mihing za giat do-in hun khat sungin thatmang khin hi.
Tua ciangin mi thahat thumte lakah amah a zompa pen Ahoah mi Dodo' tapa Eleazar ahi hi. Galsim dingin a kikaikhawm Filistia-te to a, Israel mite a nungkik hunin David tawh amah om hi.
Amah dingin a khut a hikcip mateng Filistia-te sattuk a, a namsau a khutsungah omcip hi. { Topa } in tua ni-in gualzawhna lianpi piangsak a, a kithat mite' na a tawm ding bekin ama nungah mite hong paikik uh hi.
Ahih hangin amah in tua munah pan'mun la-in hu a, Filistia-te that a, { Topa } in gualzawhna lianpi a piangsak hi.
Ukpa sawmthumte lak panin mi thumte paisukin, Refaim kuamah Filistia mihonte in giahphual satin a om laitakin, Adullam leihawm-a David kiangah anlak hun pawlin tung uh hi.

"{ Topa } aw, hih tui ka dawn het kei ding hi. Amau' nuntakna khamin a pai mite' sisan a dawn tawh ka kibang hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in dawnlo hi. Mi thahat thumte' han'zia tu-a bang ahi hi.
Mihing sawmthumte sung pan amah a minthang pen hi a, amaute a ukpa a suak hi. Ahih hangin amah in mihing thumte ban nailo hi.
Amah in a melhoih Egypt mi khat a that hi. Egypt mipa in a khutsungah teipi tawi hi. Ahih hangin Benaiah ciangkhut khat tawh ama kiangah paisuk a, Egypt-pa' khutsung panin a teipi sutkhia-in ama teipi mah tawh amah a that hi.

Tua ciangin tua ni-in David kiangah Gad pai-in ama kiangah, "Paito in; Jebus mi Araunah' ancilna-ah { Topa}-a' ding biakna tau khat phut in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin { Topa' } thupiak bangin Gad' cihna zui-in David paito hi.
Araunah a khuadaksuk ciangin kumpipa leh a nasemte ama lamah a hong paito a mu hi. Araunah paikhia-in a mai lei ngatin kumpipa zahtakna a bawl hi.
Tua ciangin Araunah in, "Bang hangin ka to kumpipa a nasempa kiangah hong pai na hi hiam?" a ci hi. "Mite' tung panin gimna a ven' theihna dingin { Topa}-a' ding biakna tau lamna ding na ancilna mun a lei ding," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Araunah in David kiangah, "Ka to kumpipa in hoih na sak bangin la in la biakna pia in; meihal biakna dingin bawngtalte, leh a sing dingin ancilna peekte leh bawngtal kolte hih lai-ah om hi.
Kumpipa aw, keimah Araunah in hihte khempeuh kumpipa tungah kong pia hi," a ci hi. Tua banah Araunah in kumpipa kiangah, "{ Topa}, na Pasian in nang hong sang ta hen," cithuah lai hi.
Ahih hangin kumpipa in Araunah kiangah, "Hilo hi; nangma tung panin hihte a man tawh kituakin kong lei ding hi. { Topa } ka Pasian' tungah kei' sum beiloin meihal biaknate ka pia kei ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin David in ngun shekel sawmnga tawh ancilna mun leh bawngtalte a lei hi.
Tua ciangin David in { Topa}-a' ding biakna tau khat tua lai-ah lam a, meihal biaknate leh thunuama biaknate a pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua gam-a' dingin thumna { Topa } in ngai a, Israel-te' tung panin gimna a veng hi.
Tu-in Kumpi David teekin kum tam ta hi. Amaute in amah puan a silhsak uh hangin a khua lum theilo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a nasemte in ama kiangah, "Ka to kumpipa-a' dingin nungakno khat kizong hen la, amah in kumpipa enin amah a kemnu hita hen. Ka to kumpipa a khua a lum theihna dingin na ang sungah tuanu lum hen," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Israel gamsung khempeuhah nungak melhoih khat zong uh a, Shunem mi Abishag mu-in, kumpipa kiangah amah paipih uh hi.
Tua nungak melhoih mahmah a, kumpipa a kemnu suakin ama na a sem hi. A lupkhawm uh hangin kumpipa in amah hih zolo hi.
Tu-in David in Haggith tawh a neih a tapa Adonijah amahmah kiliansak tawmin, "Keimah, kumpi ka hi ding hi," a ci hi. Amah in ama-a' dingin leengte leh sakol tung tuangte, leh ama mai-ah a tai ding mihing sawmnga vaihawm hi.
A pa David in, "Bang hangin tua bang tua bangin gamta na hi hiam?" ci-a dotna tawh khatvei beek amah tai ngeilo hi. Amah pen a melhoih mahmah mi khat zong ahi hi. Amah pen Absalom zoma suak ahi hi.
Amah in Zeruiah' tapa Joab leh siampi Abiathar tawh vaihawm hi. Amaute in Adonijah zui-in amah pan'pih uh hi.
Ahih hangin siampi Zadok, leh Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah, leh David' mi a thahatte in Adonijah pan'pihlo uh hi.
Adonijah in Enrogel gei-a om Gulpi' Suangpi kiangah tuute, bawngtalte, leh ganno thaute biakna-in pia-in, amah in kumpipa' tapate ahi a sanggamte khempeuh leh Judah gam kumpi uliante khempeuh sam a,
ahih hangin kamsangpa Nathan ahi a, Benaiah ahi a, mi thahatte ahi a, a sanggampa Solomon ahi zongin samlo hi.
Tua ciangin Nathan in Solomon' nu Bathsheba kiangah, "Haggith' tapa Adonijah kumpi suak khinin, David in tua thu a theihlohna thu za nailo na hi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in hong pai in. Nangma nuntakna leh na tapa Solomon' nuntakna na suahtaksak theihna dingin nang tungah ngaihsutna kong pia ding hi.
Thakhatin Kumpi David kiangah pai-in ama tungah, 'Ka to kumpipa in na nasemnu' tungah hong kiciamin, "Na tapa Solomon pen keima nungah maangin, keima kumpi tokhom tungah tu ding hi," ci hilo na hi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin Adonijah kumpi suak ahi hiam?' ci in.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah thu na gen laitakin kei zong nangma nungah hong pai-in nangma thugen teng kong pan'pih ding hi," a ci hi.
Tuanu in ama kiangah, "Ka topa aw, na nasemnu tungah { Topa } na Pasian' min tawh kiciamin, 'Na tapa Solomon pen keima nungah maangin, keima kumpi tokhom tungah tu ding hi,' na ci hi.
Tu-in en in, ka to kumpipa in na theihloh hangin, Adonijah kumpi ahi hi.
Amah in biakna-in bawngtalte, ganno thaute, leh tuute, tampi tak pia khin a, kumpipa' tapate khempeuh, siampi Abiathar, leh galkapte a ukpa Joab sam a, ahih hangin amah in na nasempa Solomon samlo hi.
Tua bang hi kei leh ka to kumpipa na bei ciangin kei leh ka tapa Solomon a khialin a hong kiseh hun hong tung ding hi," a ci hi.
Kumpipa tawh tuanu kiho-in a om laitakin kamsangpa Nathan hong tum hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh tuni-in amah paisuk khinin, bawngtalte, ganno thaute, leh tuute, tampi tak biakna-in pia a, kumpipa' tapate khempeuh, galkapte a ukpa Joab, leh siampi Abiathar sam hi. Amaute in ama-a' ding pawi bawl uh a, 'Kumpi Adonijah a khan' sau hen!' ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin na nasempa keimah, leh siampi Zadok, leh Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah, leh na nasempa Solomon, amah in hong samlo hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi David in dawngin, "Bathsheba ka kiangah hong samkik in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa omna-ah tuanu hong pai-in, kumpipa' mai-ah a ding hi.
Kumpipa kiciamin, "Haksatna khempeuh panin kei a hong honkhia { Topa } a nungta ahih mah bangin,
nangma tungah { Topa}, Israel Pasian' min tawh hong kiciamin, 'Keima nungah ka tapa Solomon maang ding a, keima tangin ka kumpi tokhom tungah tu ding hi,' ka cihsa mah bangin, tuni-in zong ka cikik hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi David in siampi Zadok, kamsang Nathan, leh Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah samsak hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa' mai-ah amaute hong pai uh hi.
Kumpipa in amaute kiangah, "Na topa' nasemte paipih un la, ka tapa Solomon keima la-sakol tungah tuangsakin Gihon-ah paipihsuk un.
Israel-te' tungah kumpi-in tua lai munah siampi Zadok leh kamsang Nathan sathau nilhsak un. Tua ciangin peengkul tum un la, 'Kumpi Solomon khan'sau hen!' ci un.
Tua ciangin ama nungah note nong pai ding uh a, amah hong pai-in ka kumpi tokhom tungah hong tu ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh keima tangin amah kumpi hi ding hi. Israel leh Judah a ukpa dingin amah ka seh khinzo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah in dawngin, "Hi ta hen! { Topa}, ka to kumpipa' Pasian in tua bangin kipsak ta hen.
{ Topa } in ka to kumpipa a ompih mah bangin Solomon zong ompih hen la, ka to Kumpi David' tokhom sangin ama tokhom lianzaw sak hen," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Zadok, kamsang Nathan, Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah, leh Khereth mite leh Peleth mite paisukin Kumpi David' la-sakol tungah Solomon tuangsak uh a, Gihon-ah amah paipih uh hi.
Tua lai-ah siampi Zadok in puanbuk panin sathau biing la-in Solomon a nilh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in peengkul tum uh hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in, "Kumpi Solomon khan'sau hen!" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh ama nungah pai-in tamngaikop tum uh a, nakpi takin lungdam uh a, amau' gamlumna in lei a thawnkham hi.
Adonijah leh amah tawh a om leenglate khempeuh in a pawi bawl a man khit uh ciangin hih thu za uh hi. Joab in peengkul aw a zak ciangin amah in, "Khuapi sungah hih gamlumna bang a cihnopna ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Kumpipa in amah tawh siampi Zadok, kamsang Nathan, leh Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah, leh Khereth mite leh Peleth mite sawl khin hi. Amaute in kumpipa' la-sakol tungah amah tuangsak khin uh hi.
Siampi Zadok leh kamsang Nathan in Gihon-ah kumpi-in amah sathau nilh khin uh hi. Tua lai panin amaute lungdamin ciahkhin uh ahih manin khuapi sung gamlum hi. Nangma zak pen hih gamlumna ahi hi.
Tua thamloin kumpipa' nasemte i to Kumpi David tungah lungdamna a ko dingin pai uh a, 'Na Pasian in nangma min sangin Solomon' min a thangzaw-in bawl hen la, nangma tokhom sangin ama tokhom a lianzaw-in bawl ta hen,' ci uh hi. A lupna tung panin kumpipa mahmah zong kun hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon kiangah, "Adonijah in Kumpi Solomon hong kihta hi. Amah in biakna tau kite lenin, 'Amah in a nasempa namsau tawh a thahlohna ding kei tungah Kumpi Solomon hong kiciam masa hen,' ci hi," kici hi.
Amah in kei tungah a hong gen, 'Na tapate in a lungsim khempeuh uh leh a nuntakna khempeuh uh tawh keima mai-ah thuman takin gamtat ding limtakin a ngaihsut nak uh leh Israel kumpi tokhom tungah khat beek in nang hong tamasaklo ding hi,' ci-a a thugenna { Topa } in a kipsak theihna dingin, Moses thukham sungah a kigelh bangin { Topa } na Pasian' thuhilhna zui-in, ama lampite hoihtakin tawn in la, ama thukhamte, a thupiakte, a biakna ngeina kipte hoihtakin zui in. Tua hi leh na heksuk na hektohna khempeuhah na dau hong pai ding hi.
"Thamloin, Zeruiah' tapa Joab in kei hong bawlna, gal sunga a si mite' phu a lakna-in gal kilem hun sungin a thah, Israel galkap ukte ahi mi nih, Ner' tapa Abner leh Jether' tapa Amasa tungah a bawlna leh, amah in mawhna neilo mite thatin, tua ama gamtatna hangin ka thuaknate zong na thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin nangma pilna bangin gamta in la, lungnuam takin sih ngeina tawh amah na sihsak loh ding thei in.
Ahih hangin Gilead mi Barzillai' tapate tungah thuman takin gamta in la, na sabuai-a an nete bangin amaute omsak in; bang hang hiam cih leh na sanggampa Absalom' kiang panin ka tai lai-in amaute in tua bang thumanna tawh kei hong bawl uh hi.
Mahanaim-ah ka pai lai-in a nasia samsiatna tawh kei a hong samsia, Bahurim panin a hong pai Benjamin mi Gera' tapa Shimei zong nang tawh om hi. Ahih hangin Jordan-ah keimah a dawn dingin hong pai ciangin ama tungah { Topa } tawh kiciamin, 'Namsau tawh nang kong that kei ding hi,' ka ci hi.
Israel-te tungah David in kum sawmli sung uk hi. Amah in Hebron-ah kum sagih sung ukin, Jerusalem-ah kum sawmthum leh kum thum sung uk hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon' nu Bathsheba kiangah David in Haggith tawh a neih a tapa Adonijah hong pai hi. Tuanu in, "Thunuama hong pai na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in, "Thunuam hi," a ci hi.
Adonijah in, "Kumpi gam pen keima-a' hi-in, Israel-te khempeuh in keima uk ding a lamet mahmahna uh na thei hi. Ahi zongin kumpi gam kihei-in ka sanggampa-a' suak hi; bang hang hiam cih leh hih thu pen { Topa' } kiang pan ahi hi.
Tu-in nangma tung panin kong nget ding khat om hi; kei hong nial kei in," a ci hi. Tuanu in ama kiangah, "Gen in," a ci hi.
Amah in, "Kumpi Solomon kiangah nong ngetsak ding kong thum hi. Amah in nang' thu hong niallo ding hi. Shunem mi Abishag ka zi dingin kei tungah hong piak ding ka ut hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Adonijah tangin ama tungah thu a gen dingin Kumpi Solomon kiangah Bathsheba va pai hi. Tua ciangin tuanu a dawn dingin kumpipa dingin tuanu mai-ah a kun hi. Tua ciangin ama tokhom tungah tu-in kumpipa' nu-a' dingin tutna khat lasak hi. Tuanu ama taklamah a tu hi.
Kumpi Solomon in a nu dawngin, "Bang hangin Adonijah-a' dingin Shunem mi Abishag hong ngen na hi hiam? Kumpi gam zong ama-a' dingin ngetsak lai vet in; bang hang hiam cih leh amah ka u hi a, ama lamah siampi Abiathar leh Zeruiah' tapa Joab pang hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Solomon zong { Topa } tawh kiciamin, "Hih thu in Adonijah' nuntakna a lei kei taak leh Pasian in kei hong dawm kei ta hen!
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, kei hong kipsakin ka pa David' tokhom tungah hong koih a, ama ciamsa bangin kei tung leh ka suanlekhakte tungah kumpi gam hong pia { Topa } a nungta ahih mah bangin, tuni-in Adonijah kithat ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kumpi Solomon in Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah sawl hi. Amah in tuapa satpuk sukin, tua ciangin amah a si hi.
Tua ciangin siampi Abiathar' kiangah kumpipa in, "Nangma mun leh nangma gam a omna Anathoth-ah ciah in; bang hang hiam cih leh na sih ding a kilawm ahi hi. Ahih hangin nangmah in ka pa David' mai-ah Topa { Pasian}' Thuciamna Singkuang na puakna leh ka pa' gimna-ah na gimkhopna hangin tutungin nang kong that kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Solomon in { Topa' } siampi hihna panin Abiathar hawlkhia-in, Eli innkuan tawh kisai thu { Topa } in Shiloh-ah a genna thu tua bangin a tungsak hi.
Hih thu Joab kiang a tun' ciangin { Topa' } puanbukah Joab tai-in biakna tau kite a len hi. (Joab in Absalom pawlpih loin Adonijah a na pawlpihna hang ahi hi.)
Kumpi Solomon kiangah, "{ Topa' } puanbukah Joab tai hi," ci-in a kigen ciangin Solomon in Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah sawlin, "Pai in; amah satpuk in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin { Topa' } puanbukah Benaiah hong pai-in ama kiangah, "Kumpipa in thu hong pia a, 'Hong paikhia in,' ci hi," a ci hi. Ahih hangin amah in, "Hilo hi, hih lai-ah kei ka sizaw ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Benaiah in kumpipa kiangah thu puakin, "Tua bangin Joab in thu gen a, tua bangin amah in kei hong dawng hi," a ci hi.
Kumpipa in amah dawngkikin, "Ama cihsa bangin hih in; amah satlum in la phum in. Joab in thu omlopi-in mi a thahna hangin mawhna pen keima tung leh ka suanlekhakte' tung panin tua bangin na siangsak ding hi.
{ Topa } in ama mawhna ama lu tung mahah tungsak kik ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka pa David' theihloh kalin amah in Israel galkapte a uk Ner' tapa Abner leh Judah galkapte a uk Jether' tapa Amasa, amah sangin thuman zaw-in a hoihzaw ahi mihing nih do-in namsau tawh a that hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi thahna hangin gimna pen Joab' lu tung leh ama suanlekhakte' lu tungah a tawntungin hong tungkik ding hi. Ahih hangin David' tung, ama suanlekhakte' tung, ama innkuan tung, leh ama kumpi tokhom tungah { Topa' } kiang panin a tawntung nopna om ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in mi sawlin Shimei samsakin ama kiangah, "Jerusalem-ah inn khat lamin tua lai-ah teng in la, tua lai mun panin mun khat peuhpeuhah paikhia kei in.
Ahih hangin kum thum a cin' ciangin Gath kumpipa Maakah' tapa Akhish kiangah Shimei' silate nih va tai uh hi. Shimei' kiangah, "En in, na silate Gath-ah om hi," ci-in a kigen ciangin
kumpipa in mi sawlin Shimei samsakin ama kiangah, "{ Topa } tawh hong kiciam sakin, thupi takin nang hong thuhilhin, 'Nang, mun khat peuhpeuhah na paikhiat ni-in na sih ding teltakin thei in,' hong ci hilo ka hi hiam? Tua ciangin nangmah in, 'Na thugen hoih hi; ka mang hi,' na ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin bang hangin { Topa' } tungah na kiciamna leh nang hong thuhilhin kong thupiakna zuilo na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua banah kumpipa in Shimei kiangah, "Ka pa David tungah siatna na bawlte khempeuh na lungsimah na thei hi. Tua ahih ciangin { Topa } in nangma siatna nangma lu tung mahah hong tun'kik ding hi.
Ahih hangin Kumpi Solomon thupha kipia-in, a tawntungin { Topa' } mai-ah a tokhom kikipsak ding hi," zong a ci lai hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah thu pia hi. Amah paikhia-in Shimei satpuk sukin, tua ciangin amah a si hi. Tua ahih ciangin Solomon' khutsungah kumpi gam kikipsak hi.
Solomon in Egypt kumpipa Faro tawh numei-a kizopna bawl hi. Amah in Faro' tanu la a, ama inn leh { Topa' } biakinn leh Jerusalem kimkota kulhpi a lam a zawh mateng David khuapi sungah tuanu paipihin omsak hi.
Ahi zongin { Topa}-a' dingin biakinn kilam nailo ahih manin mite in mualtunga biaknate-ah biakna pia uh hi.
Solomon in { Topa } itin, a pa David' thukhamte zui hi. Ahi zongin amah in mualtunga biaknate-ah biakna pia-in paknamtui hal hi.
Tua ciangin biakna a pia dingin Gibeon-ah kumpipa pai hi; bang hang hiam cih leh mualtunga biakna mun a lian pen ahi hi. Solomon in tua biakna tau tungah meihal biakna tam veipi tak a piaknasa mun ahi hi.
Gibeon-ah zanin mang sungah Solomon' tungah { Topa } kilang hi. Pasian in, "Nang kong piak ding hong gen in," a ci hi.
Solomon in, "Na nasem ka pa David' tungah a lian itna kip na lak hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh cihtakna, thumanna tawh nangma mai-ah gamta-in, nangma tungah lungsim thutang hi. Nangmah in ama-a' dingin hih a lian itna kip koihsakin, tuni-in ama tokhom tungah a tu ding tapa khat na pia hi.
Tu-in, { Topa } ka Pasian aw, kei pen naupangno khat hinapi-in ka pa David' munah kumpi-in na nasempa nong koih hi. Bangci gamtatin bangci nasep ding cih ka theih khat zong omlo hi.
A lian, a phazah a kisim zolo, a tamna a kiseh theilo, nangmah in na teelsa na mite lakah na nasempa om hi.
Tua ahih ciangin keimah in a sia leh a pha ka theihtheihna dingin na mite ukna ding thu theihtelna lungsim na nasempa hong pia in. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih a lian a tam na mite kua in ukzo ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Solomon' thungetna in { Topa } lungkimsak hi.
Pasian in ama kiangah, "Nangmah in hih thu hong ngenin, nangma-a' dingin khan'sauna ahi a, hauhna ahi a, na galte thahzawhna ding ahi zongin hong ngenloin, a man thu na theihna dingin nang-a' dingin thu theihtelna hong ngen na hih manin,
en in, nangma hong ngetna bangin kong pia ding hi. En in, nangma hun ma-in nang tawh a kibang a omlohna ding leh nangma khitah zong nang tawh a kibang hong khan'lohna dingin pilna leh theihna lungsim kong pia ding hi.
Nangma hunsung tawntung kumpi dang nang tawh a kiteh theihlohna dingin nangma hong ngetloh hauhna leh pahtawina zong nang kong pia ding hi.
Na pa David in a tot bangin nangmah in ka lampite tawnin, ka thukhamte leh ka thupiaknate na zuih nak leh na khan' ka sausak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon khanglo a, hih pen a mang na hi hi. Tua ciangin Jerusalem-ah amah pai a, { Topa' } Thuciamna Singkuang mai-ah amah dingin meihal biaknate leh thunuama biaknate pia-in, a nasemte khempeuh-a' dingin pawi khat a kham hi.
A numei khat in, "Aw, ka topa aw, hih numei leh kei, inn khat sungah ka omkhawm uh hi; amah zong inn-ah a om sungin keimah in ta khat ka nei hi.
Ka ta neih khit ni thum ni ciangin hih numei in zong ta hong nei hi. Ko gel bek a om ka hi uh a, kote tawh inn sungah kuamah dang omlo hi.
Zingsangin ka ta nawi a pia dingin ka thawh ciangin, a sisa na hi hi. Ahih hangin limtakin ka et ciangin, amah pen keima sung pana suak ta na hilo hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a numei dang khat in, "Hilo hi; a hing naupang keima-a' hi a, a si naupang nangma-a' ahi hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin a masanu in, "Hilo hi; a si naupang nangma-a' hi a, a hing naupang keima-a' ahi hi," a ci hi. Tua bangin kumpipa' mai-ah amaute gel in thu gen tuak uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "A nungta naupang khen nih suah un la, khat tungah alang pia-in, adang khat tungah alang pia un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a tapa a nungta numei in a lungsimah a tapa khasiat ahih manin kumpipa kiangah, "Aw ka topa aw, a nungta naupang amah piazaw in; bangbang hita leh amah that kei in," a ci hi. Ahih hangin a khat in, "Hih pen kei ka hi a, amah in ahi zongin tang theilo ding hi; hong hawmsak un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in dawngin, "A masa numei tungah naupang hing pia un; bangbang hita leh that kei un; amah pen a nu ahi hi," a ci hi.
ama nuai-ah pan'munte leh a semte hih bang ahi hi: Siampi nasep: Zadok' tapa Azariah ahi hi.
Lai-at nasep: Shisha' tapa Elihoref leh Ahijah ahi uh hi. Thu ciamteh nasep: Ahilud' tapa Jehoshafat ahi hi.
Galkapte a uk nasep: Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah ahi hi. Siampite nasep: Zadok leh Abiathar ahi uh hi.
Solomon in Israel khempeuh tungah ulian sawmlenih nei-in tuate in kumpipa leh a innkuan-a' dingin annek tuidawn vaihawmsak uh hi. Mi khat in kum khatin kha khat sung annek tuidawn vaihawmsak ciat uh hi.

Bendeker: Makaz khua, Shaalbim, Bethshemesh khua, leh Elonbethhanan khuasungah;

Solomon in Eufratis panin Filistia gam leh Egypt gamgi ciangdong kumpi gam khempeuh uk hi. Amaute in siah hong puak uh a, a nuntak sung tawntung uh Solomon' na sem uh hi.
Solomon-a' ding ni khatin annek tuidawn, annel lawh sawmthum, leh an lawh sawmguk,
bawngtal a thau sawm, leh lonona-a kivak bawng sawmnih; tuu za khat; sakhitalte, leh syria sakhite, sanangte, leh a thau vasate a kisimlo hi lai hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Eufratis nitumna lam gamsung khempeuh Tifsah panin Gaza ciangdong, Eufratis nitumna lampang kumpi khempeuh uk a, ama kiim mun khempeuhah galdaihna om hi.
Solomon' hun sung khempeuh Judah leh Israel lungmuang takin omin, Dan panin Beersheba ciangdong nangawn mi khempeuh a leenggui leh a theikung nuai uhah lungnuamin om uh hi.
Solomon in a leengte-a' dingin buk a nei ciat sakol tul sawmli leh sakol tung tuang mi tul sawm leh tul nih zong nei hi.
Tua uliante in Kumpi Solomon leh Kumpi Solomon' sabuai-ah a hong pai mite khempeuh-a' dingin amau ciat sik kha sunga dingin annek tuidawn vaihawm uh a, amaute in bangmah kisamsaklo uh hi.
Amau' nasep ciat tawh kizui-in a kisapna munah sakolte leh sakol zaptelte-a' dingin mangbuhham leh buhtu zong paipih uh hi.

Bang hang hiam cih leh midang khempeuh sangin amah pilzaw a, Ezrah mi Ethan, leh Mahol' tapa Heman, Kalkol, leh Darda sangin pilzaw lai a, a kiima minam khempeuh lakah ama minthan'na kizel hi.
Amah in paunak tul thum zong genkhia a, ama laphuah dawng tul leh dawng nga ahi hi.
Amah in Lebanon-a om taamtak-a kipan phungmai-a po puknahte dongin singkung thu a gen hi. Amah in khe li nei ganhingte, vasate, a bokvak ganhingte, leh ngasate' thu a gen hi.
Mi khempeuh leh leitung kumpi khempeuh sung panin Solomon' pilna thu a ngai dingin ama pilna thu a zasate hong pai uh hi.
"{ Topa } in ama khenuai-ah amaute a koihsak matengin amah a umcih a galte tawh kidona hangin ka pa David in { Topa } ama Pasian' min dingin biakinn a lam theihlohna thu na thei hi.
Ahih hangin tu-in { Topa } ka Pasian in na khempeuhah tawlngakna kei tungah hong pia hi. Hong langpang ahi a, thusia ahi zongin omlo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin { Topa } in ka pa David kiangah, 'Nangma tangin na kumpi tokhom tungah ka koih ding na tapa in ka min dingin biakinn lam ding hi,' a cih mah bangin { Topa } ka Pasian' min dingin biakinn khat lam ka sawm hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Lebanon taamtak singte kei-a' dingin a kiphukna ding thu pia in; ka nasemte in nangma nasemte seppih ding uh a, nangma seh bangin na nasemte' thaman ding nang tungah kong pia ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Sidon mite bangin sing suih a siam kote lakah khat zong a omlohna na thei hi," a ci hi.
Hiram in Solomon' kam a zak ciangin nakpi takin lungdam a, "Hih a lian a tam mite a uk dingin David' tungah a pil tapa a pia { Topa } in tuni-in thupha ngah ta hen," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Hiram in Solomon kiangah mi sawlin, "Kei kiangah nong thu-khak ka za hi. Taamtak sing leh taaksan sing tawh kisai na deih khempeuh a hih dingin ka kiging hi.
Ka nasemte in Lebanon panin tuipi-ah tuate hong puaksuk ding uh hi. Nangma cihna mun-ah a pai dingin tuipi a tawn dingin keimah in tuate phong-in ka bawl ding a, tua lai mun-ah keimah in a singte phelsakin nangmah in na ngah ding hi. Nangmah in ka mite-a' ding anpiakna tawh ka deihnate nong kicingsak ding hi," cisak hi.

Amah in biakinn pang tuak leh a nunglam biakinn kawm kimkotin a kawm tungah zong inn lam a, a kimkot a pangah inndei bawl hi.
A dawl nuainung pen pi sagih leh alang zai-in, a laita pi kua zai a, a thumna pi sawm leh alang zai hi. Kawm sungah innkam a lutlohna dingin amah in inn pualam pang kimkota dingin a nan'na singbekte a bawl hi.
Biakinn a kilam ciangin a kitawhna mun panin a kibawlsa suangte tawh kilam hi. Tua ahih manin a kilam laitakin hei ahi a, sek ahi a, sik nazat khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin a gingte biakinn huang sungah kizalo hi.
A dawl nuainung lutna ding pen biakinn leitaw lampangah om hi. A dawl laita-ah kahlei zui-in kipai-in a dawl laita panin a thumna-ah kipai hi.
Amah in a inn buppi tungah a lambehte zomin, dawl khat ciangin pi sagih leh alang sang ciat a, taamtak singte-in a biakinn tawh kizom hi.

Amah in { Topa' } Thuciamna Singkuang koihna dingin a sungtawng penah biakinn sungnung a bawl hi.
Amah in a inn buppi a zawh dongin kham tawh a zut hi. Biakinn sungnunga biakna tau buppi zong amah in kham tawh a zut hi.
Amah in biakinn sungnungah oliv sing tawh kherub nih bawl a, pi sawmlenga tuak a sang hi.
Kherub kha langkhat, pi sagih leh alang sau-in, kherub kha langdang khat, pi sagih leh alang mah sau a, a kha langkhat mong panin a mong langkhat dong pi sawmlenga ahi hi.
Kherub adang khat zong pi sawmlenga mah sau a, kherub-te gel a sauna leh a pian'lim kibang hi.
Kherub khat a sauna pi sawmlenga hi a, a kherub dang khat zong tua zah mah ahi hi.
Amah in biakinn sung tawngnung penah kherub-te a koih hi. Kherub-te' khate kizal a, khat' kha in kawm banin, adang kherub' kha in a kawm langkhat ban hi. Amau' kha langkhatte gel inn laizangah kituah hi.
Amah in a sungnung leh a puanung inndeite, a kimkotin inn kawm khempeuh tungah kherub-te leh nisuh kungte leh pakpalhte a bawl hi.
A sungnung leh a puanung inndei sung innsualte amah in kham tawh a zut hi.
Biakinn sungnung lutna dingin amah in oliv sing kongkhak peekte a bawl hi; a bangtung zawl leh kongkhak khuamte in kiu nga piangsak hi.
Amah in kherub-te, nisuh kungte, leh pakpalh lim kibawlte tawh oliv sing kongkhak peek nihte a tuam hi; amah in tuate kham tawh zut a, kherub-te leh nisuh kungte tungah kham a theh hi.
leh taaksan sing kongkhak peek nihte a bawl hi. Kongkhak a peek nihte kikhepin, adang kongkhak a peek nihte zong kikhep hi.

Amah in Lebanon Tulak Inn a kici khat a lam hi. A sauna pi zalesawmnga hi a, a zaina pi sawmsagihlenga hi-in, a san'na pi sawmlilenga hi a, taamtak khuampi gual thum tungah taamtak innkam kikhungin tua tungah a kilam ahi hi.
Gual khatah sawmlenga a om khuampi sawmlilenga tunga kilam inndei tung san teng taamtak sing tawh kituam hi.
A pang kawmte gel tungah tawlet gual thum tuak om a, a tawlet gual thumte khatlekhat kitang hi.
A kongkhakte leh a tawlet khempeuhte a pang kikim kiu li nei vive hi a, a gual thumin tawlet khatlekhat kitang dimdiam hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Khuampi Innpi a kici khat lam hi. A sauna pi sawmsagihlenga hi a, a zaina pi sawmlilenga ahi hi. A mailamah khuampite a nei innlim om a, tua khuampite tungah a tungkhuhna khat om hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a thukhenna ding mun Thukhenna Innpi ahi Kumpi Tokhom Innpi a kici khat lam a, a sual panin a innsun ciangdong taamtak sing kizang hi.
Kumpi Tokhom Innpi nunglamah ama ten'na ding inn zong tua mah bangin a kilam ahi hi. Solomon in zi-a a lak Faro' tanu-a' dingin hih innpi tawh a kibang inn dang khat zong a lam hi.
Hihte khempeuh, a bulpi nangawn-a kipan a khum dong, leh { Topa' } biakinn tual-a kipan tual lianpi dongin, limtakin tehin, a kitan, a nung leh a mai suangatna tawh a ki-at a manpha suangte tawh a kibawl ahi hi.
A bulpi pen a manpha suang, suang lian, pawlkhat pi sawmlenih, pawlkhat pi sawmlenga a pha suangte ahi hi.
Tuate' tungate pen limtakin tehin a kitan a manpha suang, leh taamtak sing ahi hi.
Tual lianpi in a kimkotah a kiseek suang gual thum simin taamtak sing gual khat nei hi. Tua mah bangin { Topa' } biakinn tual sungnung leh innlim in zong a nei hi.
Amah pen Naftali minam meigongnu' tapa hi a, ama pa pen Taia khuami sumngo seek na a sempa ahi hi. Amah in sumngo tawh na khat peuhpeuh hihna dingin pilna, theihna, siamna a nei ahi hi. Kumpi Solomon kiangah amah hong pai-in ama na khempeuh a sem hi.
Amah in sumngo khuampi nih sung hi. Khuampi khat a sauna pi sawmnihlesagih hi a, a khuam pum kimkot pi sawmlegiat pha hi. A sung hawm a, a sahna zung li ahi hi. A khuam nihna zong tua mah tawh kibang hi.
Khuampite tungah a bulh dingin amah in a kisung sumngo khuamluzepna nih zong a bawl hi. Khuamluzepna khat a sauna pi sagih leh alang hi a, adang khat khuamluzepna a sauna tua zah mah ahi hi.
Tua ciangin amah in khuampite lu dawna khuamluzepna-a' dingin khainiang a kihuiheek tawh a kibawl ngen banga kikalh simsiam nih a bawl hi. Ngen khat pen khuamluzepna khat-a' ding hi a, a ngen dang khat pen khuamluzepna adang khat-a' ding ahi hi.
Tua mah bangin amah in mang kawlsing gahte a bawl hi. Khuampi lu dawna om khuamluzepna tuamna dingin ngen tawh kibangin a bawl tung kimkotah gual nih bawl a, a khuamluzepna dang khat zong tua mah bangin a bawl hi.
Tua ciangin innlim-a om khuampi dawnah a om khuamluzepnate pi guk pha a, tuate tungah unok pak a kibawlte om hi.
A khuamluzepnate pen a khuampi nihte tung leh ngen tawh kibanga kibawl gei-a a om a bem a dawk tungah om hi. A kimkotah gual nihin mang kawlsing gah za nih om a, a khuamluzepna dang khatah zong tua bangmah ahi hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a kisung tuikuangpi a bawl hi. Tua tuikuang a bem hi a, a gei khat pan a gei khat pi sawmlenga pha-in, pi sagih leh alang thuk a, a kimkot pi sawmlilenga a pha hi.
A geivial nuai pi sawmlilenga sung, tuikuangpi kimkotin um gahte kibawl hi. Tua um gahte gual nihin om a, a tuikuangpi a kisun'in kisung khawm pah hi.
Bawngtal sawmlenihte tungah tua tuikuangpi kinga a, thum leilu lam nga a, thum nitumna lam nga-in, thum leitaw lam nga a, thum nisuahna lam a nga hi. Tuate tungah a tuikuangpi kikoih a, a nunglam uh a sunglamah om hi.
A tuikuang sahna khutpeekmai cia ahi hi. A geivial pen unok pak tawh a kibang hai geivial bangin kibawl hi. Tua sungah tui tambong tul li bang ta thei hi.
Amah in sumngo kibawl tuikuang a kingakna sawm zong a bawl hi. Tua a bawlte pi guk sau, pi guk zai, pi li leh alang sang hi.
tua ciangin a kungah a kibulh a khawkte tungah humpinelkaite, bawngtalte, leh kherub-te om hi. Tua kungte tung, humpinelkaite leh bawngtalte' tung leh nuai-ah a sawi-in a kikalh limliam om hi.
Tua thamloin tua ngaknate in sumngo tawh a kibawl leengpeite leh leengpei zawlte nei ciat a, a kiu lite-ah tuikuangpi nan'nate om hi. Tua nan'nate a kisung hi a, a pang ciatah pakkual om hi.
A gong pen a kingakna pan pi khat leh alang sangto hi. A gong pen kingakna a kibawl bangin bem a, pi nih leh letmat thum thuk hi. A gongah lim kigelhte om hi. A khawkte in sikli nei a, bemlo hi.
A leengpei lite pen a khawkte' nuai-ah om hi. Leengpei zawlte a kingakna tawh sakhat mah hi a, leengpei a san'na pi nih leh letmat thum ahi hi.
A peite pen sakol leengpei bangin kibawl hi; a pei zawl, a peikual, a peikalhna, leh a kalhna bulte khempeuh a kisung ahi hi.
A kingaknate' kiu ciatah a nan'na li om ciat a, tua a nan'nate a ngakna tawh sakhat ahi hi.
Tua ciangin a ngakna dawnah letmat kua a sang vial bem khat om hi. A ngakna dawnah a kipsaknate leh a khawkte pen a ngakna tawh sakhat ahi hi.
Tua ciangin a kipsaknate leh a khawkte tungah a mun awng zah ciat tawh kizui-in amah in kherub-te, humpinelkaite, leh nisuh kungte gelhin a kimkotah pakkual a bawl hi.
Tu-a bangin amah in a kingakna sawm bawl hi. A vekpi-in a kibangin kisungin, a liatna leh a pian'lim a kibang ahi hi.
Tua ciangin amah in sumngo tuikuang sawm bawl hi. Tuikuang khatah tui tambong sawmgiat bang ta-in, tuikuang vangsung pi guk ciat pha a, a kingakna sawmte-a' dingin tuikuang khat ciat om hi.

Tua ahih ciangin tu-in Israel Pasian, { Topa } aw, ama tungah, 'Keima mai-ah nang na gamtat mah bangin na tapate in keima mai-ah gamtat ding a kidop nak uh leh, Israel kumpi tokhom tungah a tu dingin keima mai-ah mi khat zong na tasam kei ding hi,' ci-in na nasem ka pa David tungah na ciamsa thu lenkip in.

Ahi zongin na nasempa' thungetna leh a hong thumna hong don in la, { Topa } ka Pasian aw, tuni-in nangma mai-ah na nasempa in a hong ngetna, a kikona leh a thungetna hong ngai in.

"Ding in la, Sidon mite' khua Zarefath-ah pai-in tua lai-ah om in. Tua lai-ah nangmah a hong vak dingin meigongnu khat thu ka piazo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah dingin Zarefath-ah a pai hi. Khuapi kulhkongpi a tun' ciangin, meigongnu khat in sing na tom hi. Amah in tuanu samin, "Ka dawn theihna dingin beel khat sungah tui tawm hong paipih in," a ci hi.
Tuanu in paipih dingin a kisak laitakin, amah in tuanu samin, "Anlum neu khat hong tawi kawm in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "{ Topa } na Pasian a nungta ahih mah bangin emsa bangmah ka nei kei a, beel sungah annel khutdim khat leh um sungah sathau tawmno khat bek om hi. Tu-in keimah leh ka tapa-a' dingin tuate bawlin kote in ka nek theihna dingun singkang nih khawng a tom ka hi a, tua ciangin a si ta ding ka hi uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah in ama kiangah, "Lunghimawh kei in; pai in la na gensa bangin an hong bawl in. Kei-a' dingin mohneu khat hong bawlsak masa-in kei kiangah hong paipih in la, tua khit ciangin nang leh na tapa-a' ding bawl in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel Pasian, { Topa } in hih bangin ci hi: '{ Topa } in leitungah guah a zuksak ni matengin beel sunga annel beilo ding a, um sunga sathau zong kiam ngeilo ding hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah pai-in Elijah' gensa bangin hih hi. Tuanu, leh amah, leh tuanu' innkuan in ni tampi sung ne uh hi.
Elijah' tung tawnin { Topa' } thugen bangin beel sunga annel beilo a, um sunga sathau zong kiam ngeilo hi.
Tua ciangin amah in tuanu kiangah, "Na tapa hong pia in," a ci hi. Amah in tuanu' ang panin amah la-in ama giahna innkhumzangah puato-in ama lupna tungah a sial hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa' } tungah kiko-in, "{ Topa } ka Pasian aw, ama tapa thahna tawh ka peemna meigongnu' tung nangawnah gimna hong tungsak na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin naupang tungah amah thumvei kikhuangin { Topa' } tungah kiko a, "{ Topa } ka Pasian aw, hih naupang hingkiksak in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in Elijah' aw ngai hi; naupang hong nak kikin a hingkik hi.
Numei in Elijah kiangah, "Nang, Pasian' mi na hihna leh { Topa } in nang tung tawnin thu a gen takpi ahihna tu-in ka thei hi," a ci hi.
Ni tampi khit a kum thumna kumin Elijah' tungah { Topa' } thu hong tung a, "Pai in, Ahab kiangah nangmah kilak in. Tua ciangin keimah in leitungah guah ka zusak ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Ahab in kumpi innsung a ukpa Obadiah sam hi. (Obadiah in nakpi takin { Topa } zahtak hi;
Jezebel in { Topa' } kamsangte a hon thah lai-in Obadiah in kamsang za khat la-in sawmnga sawmnga-in leihawm sungah seel a, amaute an leh tui tawh a vak hi.)
Tua ciangin Ahab in Obadiah kiangah, "Gamsung ciktui omna khempeuh leh kuam omna khempeuhah va pai in. Lopa mu-in sakolte leh la-sakolte i hin'suahzo khading a, ganhingte pawlkhat i sum kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Amah in, "Hong thah dingin Ahab' khutsungah na nasempa nong piakna dingin bang thu-ah khial ka hi hiam?
{ Topa } na Pasian a nungta ahih mah bangin nangmah a zong dingin ka topa in a sawllohna minam ahi a, kumpi gam ahi zongin omlo hi. Amaute in, 'Hih lai-ah amah omlo hi,' a cih uh ciangin, amaute in nang hong muhlohna thu amah in kumpi gam ahi a, minam ahi zongin kiciamsak hi.
Nang kiang panin kei ka paikhiat phetin ka theihlohna munah { Topa' } kha in nang hong pua ding hi. Kei va pai-in Ahab kiangah genin amah in nang hong muhloh ciangin, ka khangno lai-a kipanin keimah na nasempa in { Topa } a zahtak hinapi-in, amah in kei hong that ding hi.
Jezebel in { Topa' } kamsangte a thah lai-in { Topa' } kamsangte mi za khat, sawmnga sawmnga-in leihawm sungah seelin, amaute an leh tui tawh ka vakna thu ka topa tungah hong kigen nailo ahi hiam?
Tu-in nangmah in, 'Pai-in na topa kiangah, "Hih lai-ah Elijah om hi," ci in,' nong ci hi. Tua hi leh amah in kei hong that ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah in, "A mai-ah ka din'na Vanglian { Topa } a nungta ahih mah bangin, tuni-in ama kiangah keimahmah ka kilak taktak ding hi," a ci hi.
Ahab in Elijah a muh ciangin, "Israel mite a lungkhamsakpa, nang na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in dawngin, "Keimah in Israel mite ka lungkhamsak kei hi. Nang in { Topa' } thupiaknate nusia-in Baal-te zui na hih manin nang leh na pa' innkuan in na lungkhamsak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in mi sawl in la, Karmel Mual kei kiangah Israel-te khempeuh, leh Jezebel' sabuai-ah an a ne Baal kamsang za li leh sawmnga leh Asherah kamsang za lite hong khawm in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh' nai-ah Elijah hong pai-in, "Ngaihsutna kibanglo thu nih kikalah bang tanvei khensat loin om niloh ding na hi uh hiam? { Topa } pen Pasian ahih leh amah zui un; tua hiloin Baal pen Pasian ahih leh amah zui un," a ci hi. Ahi zongin mite in kam khat beek dawnglo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah in mite kiangah, "Kei, kei bekbek, { Topa' } kamsang sung panin ka omlai a, ahih hangin Baal kamsangte mihing za li leh sawmnga om hi.
Kote tungah bawngtal nih hong pia un. Amau-a' dingin bawngtal khat amaute teelsak un la, semnen sakin sing tungah koihsak un la, ahih hangin a tungah mei koihsak kei un. Tua ciangin keimah in a bawngtal khat bawlin sing tungah koihin, a tungah mei ka koih kei ding hi.
Tua ciangin note in na pasian tung uhah thu ngen un la, keimah in zong { Topa' } tungah thu ka ngen ding hi. Tua ciangin thungetna mei tawh hong pia pasian pen Pasian taktak ahi hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in dawngin, "Hih na thugen hoih hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah in Baal kamsangte kiangah, "Note tam na hih manun note-a' dingin bawngtal khat teel un la bawl masa un. Tua ciangin na pasian uh tungah thu ngen un la, ahih hangin a tungah mei koih kei un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in amaute tungah a kipia bawngtal la-in bawl uh a, zingsang-a kipan sun dong Baal tungah thu ngenin, "Baal aw, kote hong dawng in," a ci uh hi. Ahih hangin awging omlo a, kuamah in dawnglo hi. Tua ciangin amau' bawlsa biakna tau-ah amaute diang uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute a gingin kiko-in, amau' ngeina bangin namsaute leh sikzumte tawh, amaute tungah si a luan' dongin ki-atin kisun uh hi.
Sunkim khit ciangin biakpiak hun dong mateng amaute awngsuak uh a, ahih hangin awging omlo hi. Kuamah in dawnglo a, kuamah in donlo hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah in mi khempeuh kiangah, "Ka kiang nai-ah hong pai un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin mi khempeuh ama kiang nai-ah hong pai uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in { Topa' } biakna tau a kisupaisa khat puahkik hi.
"Israel, nangma min hi ding hi," ci-in { Topa' } thu a tun'na Jakob' tapa minam sawmlenihte tawh kizui-in Elijah in suangtum sawmlenih la hi.
Tua ciangin tua suangte tawh { Topa' } minin biakna tau khat lam hi. Amah in khaici lawh nih a tazo dingin a lian hawklam khat biakna tau kimkotah bawl hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a ngeina bangin a sing koih a, a bawngtal semnenin a sing tungah koih hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Beel li sungah tui dim un la, meihal biakna tau tung leh a sing tungah sung un," a ci hi.
Biakpiak hun ciangin kamsang Elijah a nai-ah hong pai-in, "Abraham, Isaac, leh Israel Pasian, { Topa } aw, nang pen Israel sungah Pasian na hihna, leh kei pen nangma nasem ka hihna, leh hih nate khempeuh nangma thu tawh ka hihna thu tuni-in kitheisak in.
{ Topa } aw, nangmah Pasian na hihna leh amaute' lungsim na heikikna thu hih mite in a theihna dingin hong dawng in, { Topa } aw, hong dawng in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa' } meikuang hong kia a, a meihal biakna, a sing, a suangte, leh a leivui kangtumin, hawklam sunga om tui nangawn kangcip hi.
Mi khempeuh in tua thu a muh uh ciangin a mai uh leilam ngatin puk uh hi. Amaute in, "{ Topa } pen Pasian ahi hi; { Topa } pen Pasian ahi hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah in Ahab kiangah, "Paito in la, an ne-in tui dawn in; bang hang hiam cih leh guahpi huging om hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a nasempa kiangah, "Tu-in paito in; tuipi lam va en in," a ci hi. Amah paito-in khuadak a, "Bangmah omlo hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Sagihvei paikik in," a ci hi.
A sagihveina ciangin amah in, "Khuttum cia bang meii tawmno khat tuipi panin hong kaito hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Paito-in Ahab kiangah, 'Guah in hong khak khading ahih manin na leeng kithawi in la paisuk in,' va ci in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Elijah tungah { Topa' } vangliatna hong tung hi. Amah in a kawng gakin Jezreel khua lutna dongah Ahab' mai-ah na tai hi.
Ahab in Jezebel kiangah Elijah' hih khempeuh leh namsau tawh kamsangte khempeuh a thah khitna thu a gen hi.
Tua ciangin Jezebel in Elijah kiangah kamtai khat sawlin, "Zing ciang tubang hunin amaute na thah bangin nangmah ka hong thah kei taak leh pasian-te in kei hong dawm kei ta hen," cisak hi.
Tua ciangin amah lau a, kithawi-in a suahtakna dingin paikhia a, Judah-te' khua Beersheba tungin tua lai-ah a nasempa nusia hi.
Ahih hangin amahmah gamlakah ni khat lam pailai-in poding kung nuai khatah a tu hi. Tua ciangin amah in a sihna ding thu ngenin, "Phazo hi; tu-in { Topa } aw, ka nuntakna hong la ta in; bang hang hiam cih leh ka pate sangin kei ka hoihzaw kei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin poding kung khat nuai-ah amah lumsukin a ihmu hi. Tua laitakin vantung mi khat in amah lawngin ama kiangah, "Tho in la an ne in," a ci hi.
Amah khuadak a, ama lutang gei suang sa tungah a ki-em moh khat leh tui hai khat na om hi. Amah in tuate ne-in dawnin lumkik hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa' } vantung mi a nihveina hong paikikin amah lawng a, "Tho in la an ne in; tua hi kei leh nang-a' dingin khualzinna haksa lua ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah tho a, an ne-in tui dawn a, tua an thahatna tawh Pasian' mual Horeb ciangdong sun sawmli leh zan sawmli sung a pai hi.
Tua ciangin leihawm khatah amah tungin tua lai-ah giak hi. { Topa } in Elijah hopih a, "Elijah, hih lai-ah bang hih na hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in, "Vanglian Pasian, { Topa}-a' dingin ka huaiham mahmah hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Israel mite in na thuciamna nusia-in, na biakna taute lawnkhia uh a, namsau tawh na kamsangte that hi; kei, kei bekbek ka omlai hi. Amaute in kei nangawn thah dingin hong zong lai uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Paikhia in la, mualtung, { Topa' } mai-ah ding in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin { Topa } in hong nawk a, a lian a khauh huihpi in mualte semkhamin { Topa' } mai-ah suangtumte sukham a, ahih hangin huihpi sungah { Topa } omlo hi. Huihpi nun' a daih khit ciangin zin ling a, ahih hangin zinling sungah { Topa } omlo hi.
Zinling khit ciangin meikuang om a, ahih hangin meikuang sungah zong { Topa } omlo hi. Meikuang khit ciangin aw neem neu khat a ging hi.
Amah in, "Vanglian Pasian, { Topa}-a' dingin ka huaiham mahmah hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Israel mite in na thuciamna nusia-in, na biakna taute lawnkhia uh a, namsau tawh na kamsangte that uh hi; kei, kei bekbek ka omlai hi. Amaute in kei nangawn thah dingin hong zong lai uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in ama kiangah, "Pai in, Damaskas gamlak na lampi-ah ciahkik in. Na tun' ciangin Syria gam kumpi dingin Hazael sathau na nilh ding hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpi dingin Nimshi' tapa Jehu sathau na nilh ding hi. Tua ciangin nangma mun-ah kamsang dingin Abelmeholah khuami Shafat' tapa Elisha sathau na nilh ding hi.
Ahi zongin Baal mai-ah a kun nailo, amah a nam nailo mihing tul sagih Israel sungah ka sit ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua lai panin amah paikhia a, ama neihsa a bawngtal kap sawmlenih tawh lo a kho Shafat' tapa Elisha mu a, amah a sawmlenihna tawh a kho ahi hi. Elijah in ama gei nawkin ama tungah a puan lawn hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a bawngtalte nusia-in Elijah' nungah tai a, "Ka nu leh ka pa kam vaikhakin hong namsak phot in; tua ciangin nang kong zui ding hi," a ci hi. Amah in Elisha kiangah, "Paikik in; nang hong khaktan ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Syria kumpipa Benhadad in ama galkap khempeuh khawm hi. Amah a huh ding kumpi sawmthumlenih, leh sakolte leh leengte om hi. Amah paito-in Samaria umcihin simgawp hi.
'Na ngun leh na kham keima-a' hi a, na zi hoihpente leh na tate zong keima-a' mah ahi hi,' ci hi," cisak hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in dawngin, "Na gen mah bangin, ka topa, kumpipa aw, kei leh ka neih khempeuh nangma-a' ahi hi," a ci hi.
Kamtaite hong paikikin, "Benhadad in hih bangin ci hi: 'Nang kiangah mi hong sawlin, "Kei tungah na ngun leh na kham, na zite leh na tate hong pia in," kong cisak hi.
Ahi zongin zing ciang tubang hunin nangma kiangah ka nasemte kong sawl ding a, amaute in nangma inn leh na nasemte' innsung thawi-in, amau' deih peuhpeuh hong la ding uh hi,' ci hi," cisak hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in gamsung upa khempeuh samin, "Tu-in ciamteh un, hih mipa in buaina a zon'na thei un; bang hang hiam cih leh ka zite leh ka ngun leh ka kham a la dingin mi hong sawl a, ama thu ka nial kei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in Benhadad' kamtaite kiangah, "Ka to kumpipa kiangah hih bangin gen un: 'Na nasempa' tung panin nong kalh masak kong pia ding hi; ahih hangin a nihna kong piazo kei hi, ci hi,' ci un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin kamtaite kihemkhia-in ama tungah thu tun'kik uh hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in dawngin, "Ama kiangah gen un: 'Gal a zawh khit ciangin galhiam a suahkhiapa bangin galsim dingin galhiam a kuah laipa kiphasak kei hen,' ci un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpi Ahab kiang nai-ah kamsang khat hong pai-in, "{ Topa } in hih bangin ci hi: Hih mihon tampi khempeuh na mu hiam? En in, tuni-in nangma khutsungah kong pia ding hi. Tua ciangin keimah, { Topa } ka hihna na thei ding hi, ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Ahab in, "Kua tawh hi ding hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in, "{ Topa } in hih bangin ci hi: Gamte a ukte' nasemte tawh, ci hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Kua in galsim pan ding hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in dawngin, "Nangmah in na pan ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in gamte a ukte' nasemte khawm a, amaute za nih leh sawmthumlenih ahi hi. Amaute' khit ciangin amah in Israel mi khempeuh, tul sagih a khawm hi.
Tua ciangin Benhadad, bukte sungah amah a huh kumpi sawmthumlenihte tawh zukhamin a om laitak sun hunin amaute kuankhia uh hi.
Amah in, "Kilemna a bawl dingin hong pai ahih leh a hingin amaute man un. Tua ahih kei a, a hong sim dingin amaute a hong pai ahih leh zong amaute a hing mahin man un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa paikhia-in sakolte leh leengte man a, Syria-te tampi tak a that hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa kiang nai-ah kamsangpa hong pai-in ama kiangah, "Hong pai in, nangmah kithakhauhsak in la, na hih ding thu limtakin ngaihsun in; bang hang hiam cih leh khuakhal ciangin Syria kumpipa nangmah simin hong kuanto kik ding hi," a ci hi.
Hih bangin hih in: Kumpite ama pan'mun ciat panin khinkhia in la, amaute' munah galkapmangte koih in.
Tua ciangin Israel mite kikhawmin, lam-an kiguan' a, amaute a do dingin a kuan uh hi. Israel mite in amaute' mai-ah keelhon neu nih bangin giahphual sat uh a, Syria-te ahih leh gamsung khempeuh dim uh hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian' mi khat a nai-ah hong pai-in Israel kumpipa kiangah, "{ Topa } in hih bangin ci hi: 'Syria-te in, "{ Topa } pen mualtung pasian hi a, amah pen kuamsung pasian hilo hi," ci uh ahih manin hih a lian mihonpi khempeuh nangma khutsungah kong pia ding a, keimah, { Topa } ka hihna na thei ding hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Amaute a kimaituahin ni sagih sung giahphual satin om uh hi. A ni sagih ni-in gal kido uh hi. Israel mite in Syria-te ni khat sungin khe galkap tul za khat vatlum uh hi.
Tua ciangin a omlaite Afek khuapi-ah tai uh a, ahi zongin tuate mi tul sawmnih leh tul sagih pen khuapi kulh in cipnelh hi. Benhadad zong tai a, khuapi sunga inndei sungnung khatah a lut hi.
Tua ciangin a nasemte in ama kiangah, "Israel kumpite pen hehpihna a nei kumpite hi, ci-in i za hi. Puanhampi i kawngah tengin i lu tungah khauhual vialin Israel kumpipa kiangah pai ni; amah in na nuntakna hong suaktasak khading hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Benhadad in ama kiangah, "Ka pa in na pa' tung panin a lak khuapite kong piakik ding hi. Ka pa in Samaria-ah a bawl mah bangin Damaskas-ah nang-a' dingin sumbuk na bawl thei ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Ahab in, "Hih na thugente' hangin nang kong suaktasak ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in thuciamna khat amah tawh bawlin a ciahsak hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa' } thupiakna tawh kamsangte' tapate khat in a lawmte khat kiangah, "Hong sat in, kong thum hi," a ci hi. Ahih hangin a mipa in amah sat nuamlo hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a lawmpa kiangah, "Nangmah in { Topa' } thu manglo na hih manin, kei kiang panin na paikhiat khit phetin humpinelkai khat in nang hong that ding hi," a ci hi. Ama kiang panin amah a kihepkhiat khit phetin humpinelkai khat in amah dawntuahin petlum pah hi.
Tua ciangin amah in midang khat mu a, "Hong sat in, kong thum hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin mipa in amah nakpi takin satin amah liamsak hi.
Na nasempa hih lai hua lai-ah manlahin ka om kalin amah na mang hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Nangma thukhenna bang hita hen; nangmahmah in na khentawm hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in ama kiangah, "{ Topa } in hih bangin ci hi: 'Thah dinga ka seh mipa khah na hih ciangin ama nuntakna tangin nangma nuntakna, ama mite' tangin nangma mite pai ding hi,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa a inn-ah a lungkimlo, maikhingin pai a, Samaria a tung hi.
Hih thu teng khit ciangin Ahab in Naboth kiangah, "Ka inn tawh kinai ahih manin anteh huan dingin ka neih theihna dingin na leenggui lo hong pia in; keimah in tua tangdingin leenggui lo hoihzaw khat kong pia ding hi; ahih kei leh zong nang-a' dingin a hoihzawk ding leh a man ding sum kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Naboth in Ahab kiangah, "Ka pu ka pate' gamh nang tungah kong piak ding { Topa } in hong kham hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jezreel khuami Naboth in ama tungah a thugenna hangin hehna leh maikhin'na tawh Ahab a inn-ah ciah hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, "Ka pu ka pate' gamh nang tungah kong pia kei ding hi," ci hi. Amah a lupna tungah lumin a mai hei a, an nelo hi.
Ahih hangin a zi Jezebel ama kiangah hong pai-in, "An a nelo zah dingin bang hangin na lungsim tua zahin heh ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in, "Keimah in Jezreel khuami Naboth kiangah thu genin, 'Sum tawh lei dingin na leenggui lo hong pia in; ahih kei leh zong, na lungkim leh tua tangdingin leenggui lo dang khat kong pia ding hi,' ka ci hi. Amah in hong dawngin, 'Nang tungah ka leenggui lo kong pia kei ding hi,' hong ci hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a zi Jezebel in, "Tu laitakin Israel mite a ukpa hilo na hi hiam? Tho-in an ne in la, na lungsim nuamsak in. Keimah in Jezreel khuami Naboth' leenggui lo nangma tungah kong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in Ahab' minin laikhakte gelhin ama min gelhna tawh tua laite tungah gelh a, ama khuapi sungah Naboth tawh a teng upate leh uliante tungah tua laite a khak hi.
Amah in a laite sungah, "An tan' ding thu zasak un la, mite' lak a sangna mun-ah Naboth koih un.

A zing ciang zingsang tungin amaute tho-in, tui tungah ni a taan' ciangin, Moab mite in amau' galkhatah a om tuite pen sisan bangin a sanin mu uh hi.
Ahih hangin Israel-te' giahphualah amaute a tun' uh ciangin, amaute' mai-ah a taikhiat matengin Israel mite hong kipanin Moab mite a do uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute mainawtin pai-in a paikawmun Moab mite that uh hi.
Moab kumpipa in a lelhlam a kitheih ciangin, Edom kumpipa' san tak a phukhia dingin namsau tawi mihing za sagih a la hi. Ahih hangin amaute in phukhia zolo uh hi.
Tu-in kamsang honte sung pan mi khat' zi Elisha' tungah kiko-in, "Na nasem ka pasal si hi. Na nasempa in { Topa } a zahtakna na thei hi. Ahih hangin ka tapate nih sila dingin a la dingin a leibatnapa hong pai hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Elisha in tua numei kiangah, "Nang-a' dingin bang hong hihsak thei ding ka hi hiam? Inn sungah bang nei na hi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Na nasemnu in sathau biing khat cih simloh inn sungah bangmah dang neilo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "A pua-ah paikhia in la, beel hawm a tawm lualo, na vengte khempeuh' beel va kawm in.
Tua ciangin sungtumin, nang leh na tapate kong kikhaknelh un la, hih beelte khempeuh sungah sung in. Beel khat a dim simin tuamkoih pahpah in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ama kiang panin tua numei paikhia-in amah leh a tapate kong kikhaknelh uh hi. Amah in a sun' laitakin a tapate in ama kiangah a beelte paipih uh hi.
Beelte a dim ciangin amah in a tapa khat kiangah, "Beel dang khat hong paipih in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin a tapa in, "Beel adang om nawnlo hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin sathau a luan' a khawl hi.
Tuanu hong pai-in Pasian' mipa kiangah a thu teng gen a, tua ciangin amah in, "Pai in; a sathau zuakin na leibate loh in. Nang leh na tapate, a omlaite tawh na nungta ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Ni khat Shunem-ah Elisha paisuak a, tua lai-ah a hau numei khat tengin tuanu in anne dingin amah a sam hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in tua lam a nawk peuhpeuh ciangin anne dingin tua lai-ah baang zel hi.
Eite kiangah amah hong pai peuhpeuh ciangin a tun'theihna dingin innkhumzangah kawm a nei inndeineu khat bawlin tua sungah ama-a' dingin lupna khat, sabuai khat, tutphah khat, leh meivak khat koihsak ni," a ci hi.
tua lai-ah tawlnga hi. Tua ciangin amah in a nasempa Gehazi kiangah, "Hih Shunem mi sam in," a ci hi. Amah in tua numei a sap ciangin ama mai-ah tuanu hong ding hi.
Tua ciangin Elisha in ama kiangah, "Tu-in tuanu kiangah hih bangin gen in: Thei in, kote-a' dingin hih haksatna khempeuh na thuak hi. Nang-a' dingin bang hong kihihsak ding deih na hi hiam? Kumpipa kiang ahih kei leh galkap a ukpa kiangah nang tangin thu khat peuhpeuh hong kigensak ding na deih a om hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in dawngin, "Kei pen ka mipihte lakah teng ka hih manin bangmah ka kisam kei hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Tua bang ahih leh tuanu-a' dingin bang kihihsak thei ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Gehazi in dawngin, "Thu khat bek om hi. Tuanu in tapa neilo a, a pasal teekta hi," a ci hi.
Amah in, "Tuanu sam in," a ci hi. Amah in tuanu a sap ciangin kongkalai-ah a hong ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "A hun hong tun' ciangin tapa khat na tawi ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin tuanu in, "Hilo hi, ka topa, Pasian' mipa aw; na nasemnu tungah zuau kei in," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin tuanu in nau paii a, Elisha in ama tungah a gensa bangin a hun a tun' kik ciangin amah in tapa khat a nei hi.
Tua ciangin tuanu paito-in Pasian' mipa lupna tungah amah koih a, amah kong khaknelhin a paikhia hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a pasal samin, "Manlang takin Pasian' mipa kiangah pai-in kong ciahkik theihna dingin nasemte khat leh late khat hong puak in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Bang hangin tuni-in ama kiangah pai ding na hi hiam? Khadet ni ahi a, Sabbath ni ahi zongin hilo hi," a ci hi. Amah in, "Hong hoih na ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in la van vawhin a nasempa kiangah, "Gan nawh in; kong gen kei nak leh kei-a' dingin a pai khiamsak kei in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah dingkhia a, Karmel Mual-a Pasian' mipa kiangah a pai hi. Pasian' mipa in amah hong pai a muh ciangin a nasempa Gehazi kiangah,"En in, galah Shunem nu hong pai hi.
Amah a dawn dingin thakhatin va tai in la ama kiangah, 'Na dam hiam? Na pasal a dam hiam? Naupang a dam hiam?' va ci in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin tuanu in, "Hoih hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian' mipa kiang mualtungah tuanu a tun' ciangin tuanu in ama khe len hi. Tua ciangin amah a sawnkhia dingin Gehazi hong pai hi. Ahih hangin Pasian' mipa in, "Amah tuaci omsak in; bang hang hiam cih leh amah nakpi takin lungkham hi. { Topa } in kei tungah a thu hong im a, kei kiangah hong genlo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin tuanu in, "Ka topa' tung pan tapa hong ngen ka hi hiam? Kei hong khem kei in, hong ci hilo ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in Gehazi kiangah, "Na kawng gak in la na khutah ka ciangkhut tawi-in pai in. Mi khatpeuh in nang hong hopih leh zong dawng kei in. Tua ciangin naupang' mai tungah ka ciangkhut va nga in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin naupang' nu in, "{ Topa } nungta a, nangmahmah na nuntak mah bangin, nang kong nusia kei ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah dingin tuanu a zui hi.
Gehazi na mapai suakin naupang' maitang tungah a ciangkhut nga a, ahih hangin awging ahi a, nuntakna lim ahi zongin omlo hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah a dawn dingin hong kileh kikin ama kiangah, "Naupang khanglo nailo hi," a ci hi.
Inn sungah Elisha hong tun' ciangin amah in a lupna tungah a si-in a lum naupang a mu hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah bek lutin kong a kikhaknelh hi. Tua ciangin { Topa' } tungah thu ngen hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Gehazi samin, "Shunem numei sam in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah in tuanu a sam hi. Tuanu ama kiangah hong pai ciangin amah in, "Na tapa la in," a ci hi.
Tuanu hong pai-in ama khe-ah pukin leilakah a kun hi. Tua ciangin a tapa la-in a paikhia hi.
Tua gam sungah kialpi a tun' laitakin Gilgal-ah Elisha hong paikik hi. Kamsangte ama mai-ah tu-in thu a ngaih laitakin amah in a nasemte kiangah, "Beelpi suang un la kamsangte-a' ding meh huan un," a ci hi.
Amaute khat meh zong dingin gamlakah pai a, vatak-um gui khat mu-in tua tung panin a ang dimin umgah lo a, tuate bang hiam cih theilopi-in hong pai-in mehbeel sungah atnen hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in mite' nek dingin hong thukkhia uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute in meh a nek laitakun amaute kiko-in, "Pasian' mipa aw, an sungah gu om!" a ci uh hi. Amaute in ne theilo uh hi.
Amah in, "Tua ahih leh a an tawm hong la un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in beel sungah tua an lawn a, "Amaute in a nek theihna dingin mite-a' dingin thukkhia un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin bangmah ci nawnlo hi.
Mi khat Baalshalishah panin hong pai-in Pasian' mipa kiangah anpal anlum, mangbuhham lum sawmnih, leh anvui a thak a van sungah hong pua hi. Tua ciangin Elisha in a nasempa kiangah, "Amaute in a nek theihna dingun kamsangte tungah pia in," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin a nasempa in, "Mihing za khatte' mai-ah keimah in hih bangci lui theih ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi. Ahi zongin amah in, "Amaute in a nek theihna dingun mite tungah tuate pia in. Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in, 'Amaute in ne-in khamval ding uh hi,' ci hi," a ci kik hi.
Tua ciangin amah in amaute mai-ah tua an a lui hi. Tua ciangin amaute in ne uh a, { Topa' } gensa bangin pawlkhat a vallai hi.
Syria kumpipa' galkap a uk Naaman pen kumpipa' maipha a ngah ulianpi khat ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in ama hangin Syria mite gualzawhna pia hi. Amah a thahat a vanglian khat hi a, ahih hangin amah a phak ahi hi.
Syria mite in a galsimna khat uhah Israel gam panin numeino khat ciahpih uh a, tuanu in Naaman' zi na' a sem hi.
Tua ciangin Syria kumpipa in, "Tu-in pai in. Israel kumpipa kiangah lai khat ka khak ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah pai-in ngun talen sawm, kham shekel tul guk,leh pawipuan sawm a keng hi.
Amah in Israel kumpipa tungah laikhak keng a, tua sungah, "Hih laikhak na ngah ciangin, ama phakna na damsak theihna dingin ka nasempa Naaman nangma kiangah kong sawlna thu thei in," a ci hi.
Israel kumpipa in a laikhak a sim ciangin amah in a puante balkekin, "Mi khat a phaknatna damsak dingin hih mipa in kei tungah hih thu hong puakna dingin a that ding leh a nungtasak dingin kei, Pasian ka hi hiam? Ngaihsun dih un. Kei tawh kitotna ding a zon'na thei un," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Israel kumpipa in a puante a balkekna thu Pasian' mipa Elisha in a zak ciangin amah in kumpipa kiangah mi sawlin, "Bang hangin na puante balkek na hi hiam? Israel sungah kamsang khat a omna thu amah in a theihna dingin tu-in kei kiangah amah hong paisak in," cisak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a sakolte leh a leengte tawh Naaman hong pai-in Elisha' kongah a khawl hi.
Ahih hangin Naaman hehin paikhia a, "En un, amah kei kiangah hong paikhia-in, ka gei-ah hong dingin, a Pasian a { Topa' } min loin, a natna mun tungah a khut vanin, kei miphakpa hong damsak taktak ding hi, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.
Israel tuite khempeuh sangin Damaskas gama om Abana leh Farpar gun tuite hoihzaw hilo ahi hiam? Tuate' sungah kisilin siang theilo ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amah kihei-in paikhia hi.
Ahih hangin a nasemte a nai-ah hong pai-in ama kiangah, "Ka topa aw, kamsangpa in na lian khat a sem dingin hong sawl hi leh sem ding hilo na hi hiam? Tua ahih ciangin amah in nang kiangah, 'Kisil in la siang in,' hong cih ciangin na hih ding bangzah ta-in kilawmzaw hilo ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian' mipa kiangah amah leh a pawlte khempeuh kileh kikin ama mai-ah ding uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "En in, leitung mundang khempeuhah Pasian omloin, Israel sung bekah om hi, ci-in ka thei hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na nasempa tung panin letsong khat hong sang in," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin amah in, "A na ka sep { Topa } a nungta ahih mah bangin, bangmah kong sang kei ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in a lakna ding kunh teitei a, ahih hangin amah in nial veve hi.
Tua ciangin Naaman in, "Tua ahih leh kong thum hi, na nasempa tungah la-sakol nih puakkhop leitang hong pia in. Bang hang hiam cih leh tu-a kipanin na nasempa in meihal biakna ahi a, biakpiakna ahi zongin pasian dangte khat peuhpeuh tungah pialoin { Topa' } tung bekah pia ding hi.
Ahi zongin hih thu-ah { Topa } in na nasempa a mawhna hong maisak hen: Rimmon biakinn sungah a bia dingin ka topa a pai ciangin zui ding ka hih manin Rimmon biakinn sungah kei ka kunna thu-ah { Topa } in a nasempa hong maisak hen," a ci hi.
Pasian' mipa Elisha' nasem Gehazi in, "Ama hong puak nate sangloin ka topa in Syria mi hih Naaman ciahsak mawk hi. { Topa } a nungta ahih mah bangin, amah nungdelhin ama tung panin na khat peuhpeuh ka ngah ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "A vekpi-in hoih hi. Ka topa in, 'Kamsangte nih Efraim mualtung gam panin kei kiangah tu mahmahin hong tung hi. Kong thum hi, amaute tungah ngun talen khat leh pawipuan nih pia in,' a ci dingin hong sawl hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Naaman in, "Talen nih hong sang nuam hoh in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in a san' ding kunh a, ngun talen nih ip nihin henin pawipuan nih tawh, a nasem nihte tungah a guan' hi. Tua ciangin amaute in Gehazi' mai-ah tuate pua uh hi.
Tua ciangin mualtungah amah a tun' ciangin amah in amaute tung panin tuate la-in inn sungah koih hi. Tua ciangin a mite sawlkhia a, amaute kihem uh hi.

Ahih hangin Elisha in ama kiangah, "Nangmah a dawn dingin a leeng tung panin mipa a kihei laitakin nang tawh ka kha omkhawm hilo ahi hiam? Sum leh puante, oliv huante leh leenggui lote, tuute leh bawngtalte, nasem numeite leh nasem pasalte san' ding hun ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin nangma tung leh na suanlekhakte tungah Naaman' phakna hong belh tawntung ta hen," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin ama omna panin vuk bangin kangin a phakin a paikhia hi.
Ni khat, kamsangte khat in Elisha kiangah, "Thei in, nangma khutnuai-a om kote' ten'na mun kote-a' dingin neulua hi.
Kote Jordan-ah hong paisakin kote in singluang khat ciat la-in ka ten'na ding uh mun khat ko hong bawl sak in," a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin amah in dawngin, "Pai un," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute tawh amah a kuan hi. Jordan a tun' uh ciangin amaute in sing phuk uh hi.
Ahih hangin khat in singluang a tan laitakin a heitang lengin tui sungah kia hi. Amah kiko-in, "Ala, ka topa! A kikawm hi ve'n," a ci hi.
