Ahih hangin Pasian' mipa in Israel kumpipa tungah thu puak a, "Syria-te in hong buksim uh ahih manin hih mun na nawklohna dingin kingaihsun in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Israel kumpipa in Pasian' mipa genna mun kiimah a om mite kiangah mi sawlin hilhkhol sak hi. Tua ahih manin tua bangin amaute suakta zelzel uh hi.
Tua ciangin hih thu hangin Syria kumpipa nakpi takin patau hi. Amah in a nasemte samin amaute kiangah, "Eite sung panin Israel kumpipa lamah a pangsim mipa hong genlo ding na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a nasemte khat in, "Kuamah omlo hi, ka topa, kumpipa aw; ahih hangin Israel sungah kamsang Elisha in na lupna inndei sunga na thugente Israel kumpipa tungah gen hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Keimah in mi sawlin amah ka mattheihna dingin pai in la amah a omna mun va thei in," a ci hi. Tua ciangin ama kiangah, "En in, amah Dothan-ah om hi," ci-in kigen hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in sakolte leh leengte leh galkap hon lianpi khat tua lai-ah a sawl hi. Amaute zanin hong pai-in a khuapi umcih uh hi.
Pasian' mipa' nasempa zingsangin tho baihin a paikhiat ciangin, en in, khuapi kimkotah sakolte leh leengte tawh galkap honpi na om hi. Tua ciangin nasempa in, "Ala, ka topa! Bangcih ding ihi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Elisha in thu ngenin, "{ Topa } aw, kong thum hi; amah in a muh theihna dingin ama mitte hon'sak in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin { Topa } in tangvalpa' mitte hon'sak a, tua ciangin amah in mu hi. En in, Elisha' kimkot mualtung khempeuh sakolte leh mei leengte tawh kidim hi.
Amah a sim dingin Syria-te hong paisuk ciangin Elisha in { Topa } kiangah thu ngenin, "Hih mite mittawtna tawh vatgawp in, kong thum hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin Elisha' thungetna bangin amah in mittawtna tawh amaute vatgawp hi.
Tua ciangin Elisha in amaute kiangah, "Hih pen a lampi hilo a, hih zong a khuapi hilo hi; hong zui un; na zon' uh mipa kiangah note kong paipih ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ciangin amah in Samaria-ah amaute a paipih hi.
Amaute Samaria-ah a lut phetin Elisha in, "{ Topa } aw, amaute in a muh theihna dingun hih mite' mitte hon'sak in," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin { Topa } in amau' mitte hon'sak a, tua ciangin amaute in khua mu uh hi. Samaria khua sungah a om ahihna uh thei uh hi.
Amah in dawngin, "Amaute na that kei ding hi. Na namsau leh na thal tawh loin galmatin na laksate that ding na hi hiam? Amaute in an ne-in tui a dawn khit ciangin a topa uh kiangah a ciahkik theihna dingun amaute' mai-ah an leh tui lui in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in amaute-a' dingin pawi lianpi khat bawl hi. Amaute in an ne-in tui a dawn khit uh ciangin amaute sawlkhia a, tua ciangin a topa uh kiangah amaute a ciah uh hi. Tua ciangin Israel gam a sim dingin Syria-te hong pai nawnlo uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "{ Topa } in nang hong huh ding ahih kei leh koi lai panin nang hong huh ding ka hi hiam? An ahi a, leenggahzu ahi zongin nei ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in tuanu dongin, "Na lungkhamna bang ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Amah in dawngin, "Hih numei in kei kiangah, 'Tuni-in amah i nek theihna dingin na tapa hong pia in; zing ciangin keima tapa i ne ding hi,' hong ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kote in ka tapa' sa huanin ka ne uh hi. A zing ciangin keimah in ama kiangah, 'Amah i nek theihna dingin na tapa hong pia in,' ka ci hi. Ahih hangin tuanu in a tapa na seel hi," a ci hi.
Elisha a inn sungah tu a, upate amah tawh tukhawm uh hi. Tu-in kumpipa in ama omna panin mi khat sawlkhia hi. Ahih hangin kamtaipa a tun' ma-in Elisha in upate kiangah, "Hih mi thatpa in ka lutang a tankhia dingin hong sawlna na mu uh hiam? En un, kamtaipa hong tun' ciangin kong khak un la, ama langkhatah khauhtakin kongkhak lencip un. Ama nungah a topa' kheging hong kiza hilo ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amaute tawh amah a kiho laitakin ama kiangah kumpipa hong paisukin, "Hih lungkhamna { Topa' } pian'sak hilo ahi hiam! Bang hangin { Topa } in bang khat peuhpeuh a sep ding ngaklai ding ka hi hiam?" a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Elisha in, "{ Topa' } thu za in. { Topa } in hih bangin ci hi: Zing ciang tubang hunin Samaria kulhkongpi-ah annel lawh khat shekel khatin kizuak ding a, mangbuhham lawh nih shekel khatin kizuak ding hi, ci hi," a ci hi.
Eite, 'Khuapi sungah lut ni,' ci lehang, khuapi sungah kialpi om a, tua lai-ah i si ding hi. Hih lai-ah tu lehang lah eite i si veve ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in hong pai un. Syria-te' giahphualah va pai ni. Amaute in eite hong hingkhawi leh eite i nungta ding a, ahih hangin amaute in eite hong that leh zong a si veve ding mah ihi lel hi," kici uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute Syria-te' phualah a pai dingin phalvak tungin tho uh hi. Ahih hangin Syria-te' phual a nawl a tun' uh ciangin tua lai-ah kuamah na om nawnlo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in leengte, leh galkap hon lianpite' huging Syria galkapte zasak ahih ciangin amaute khatlekhat in, "En un, Israel kumpipa in eite a hong hih dingin Hit kumpite leh Egypt kumpite cial hi," kici uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute phalvak tungin tai-in a puanbukte, a sakolte, leh a late uh nusia uh a, a phual uh a tuaci bangmahin nusia-in a suahtakna dingun tai uh hi.
Giahphual nawlah hih miphakte hong tun' uh ciangin puanbuk khat sungah amaute lutin an ne-in tui dawn uh a, amaute in ngun leh kham leh puante puakhia-in tuate a seel uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute hong paikikin puanbuk dang khatah lut uh a, tua panin vante puakhia-in seel leuleu uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute khatlekhat in, "A manin i gamta kei hi. Tuni pen thuthak a hoih i theih ni ahi hi. Eite pauloin zingsang khuavak dong ngak lehang gimna i thuak ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin tu-in hong pai un. Eite pai-in kumpipa innkuante kiangah va gen ni," kici uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute hong pai-in kulhkongpi cingte samin amaute kiangah, "Syria-te' phualah ka va tung uh a, tua lai-ah kuamah kimulo, bangmah kizalo, bangmah omlo; ahih hangin sakolte kikhihin, late kikhihin, puanbukte a om bangbangin om hi," ci-in a gen uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute Jordan ciangdong va pai uh hi. Syria-te in nawhsa-in a paihkhiat uh puante leh nate tawh lamdung khempeuh pak zeizai hi. Tua ciangin kamtaite hong kikin kumpipa kiangah a gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin mite paikhia uh a, Syria-te' phual luh uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin { Topa' } gensa bangin annel lawh khat shekel khatin kizuakin, mangbuhham lawh nih shekel khatin kizuak hi.
A khut tungah a kingapnapa, a ukpa pen kulhkongpi a ukin kumpipa in seh hi. Mite in kulhkongpi-ah amah nawkpai-in a tung sikin pai uh a, ama kiangah kumpipa a paisuk laitakin Pasian' mipa gensa bangin amah na si hi.
Mite in kulhkongpi-ah ama tung sikin pai uh hi. Amah si ahih manin ama tung tawnin tua bangin a kipai ahi hi.

Tua ciangin David khuadak to a, leitung leh vantung kikalah { Topa' } vantung mi dingin, a khutsungah a kidoksa namsau khat omin Jerusalem tungah a zan mu hi. Tua ciangin David leh a upate puanhampi silhin maipuk uh hi.
Tua ciangin David in Pasian kiangah, "Mi phazah a sim dingin thu a piapa keimah hilo ka hi hiam? Khialin a gitloh gamtat mahmahpa keimah ka hi hi. Ahih hangin hih mite in bang gamtat khialhna nei ahi uh hiam? { Topa } ka Pasian aw, kong thum hi, keimah leh ka innkuan gim hong pia in. Ahih hangin na mite tungah gimna tungsak kei in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David paito-in Jebus mi Ornan' ancilna phualah { Topa}-a' ding biakna tau khat a lamna ding a gen dingin { Topa' } vantung mi in Gad sawl hi.
Tua ahih ciangin { Topa' } min tawh a gen Gad' kammal bangin David paito hi.
Ornan leh a tapa lite in mangbuh a cilcil laitakin a khuadak uh leh { Topa' } vantung mi mu uh a, a tapa lite lau-in a bu uh hi.
Ornan kiangah David hong tun' ciangin, Ornan khuadak a, David mu-in ancilna panin hong paikhia a, a mai leilam ngatin David tungah zahtakna a bawl hi.
Tua ciangin David in Ornan kiangah, "Mite kiang panin gimna a ven' theihna dingin { Topa}-a' ding biakna tau khat ka lam theihna dingin na ancilna mun hong pia in. A man a cingin piak dingin hong pia in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Ornan in David kiangah, "La in; ko to kumpipa in hoih na sak bangin hih in. Meihal biaknate-a zat dingin bawngtalte, a sing dingin ancilna singte, leh an tawh biakna dingin a mangbuhte kong pia hi. A vekpi-in kong pia hi," a ci hi.
Ahih hangin Kumpi David in Ornan kiangah, "Hilo hi, a man a cing tawh kong lei ding hi. { Topa}-a' dingin nangma-a' ka la kei ding a, keima sum beiloin meihal biaknate zong ka pia kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin David in Ornan' tungah a mun leina dingin kham shekel zaguk a gik a pia hi.
Tua ciangin David in tua lai-ah { Topa}-a' dingin biakna tau khat lamin meihal biaknate leh thunuama biaknate bawlin { Topa' } tungah thu ngen a, tua ciangin amah in a thungetna a piakna-in a meihal biakna a hal dingin vantung panin meikuang a piasuk hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa' } thupiakna tawh vantung mi in a namsau a pai sungah a siatkik hi.
Tua hunin, Jebus mi Ornan' ancilna phualah ama nget thu { Topa } in a piakna David in a muh ciangin amah in tua lai-ah a biakpiaknate a bawl hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Moses in gamlakah a bawl { Topa' } biakbuk leh meihal biakna tau pen tua hunin Gibeon mual dawnah omlai hi.
Ahih hangin amah in { Topa' } vantung mi' namsau kihta ahih manin Pasian tungah thu a dong dingin tua lai-ah David pai ngamlo hi.
Tua ciangin David in, "Hih lai-ah { Topa } Pasian' inn om ding a, hih lai-ah Israel mite' meihal biakna tau om ding hi," a ci hi.
Israel gamsunga om gamdang mite a kikaihkhopna dingun David in thu a pia hi. Tua ciangin amah in Pasian' biakinn lamna dingin suangseeksate a bawl dingin suangseekte a koih hi.
David in kongpi kongkhak-a zat dingin siktukkilh leh gakna dingin sik tampi koihin, teh zawhlohin sumngo tampi tak zong koih a,
taamtak singte simzawh hilo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Sidon khuamite leh Taia khuamite in David kiangah taamtak tampi tak puak uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh David in, "Ka tapa Solomon khangno-in pumpi tawh sinna om nailo a, { Topa}-a' ding a kilam biakinn pen gam khempeuhah minthan'na leh pahtawina-ah a lian mahmah ding ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin tua biakinn dingin keimah ka kigingkhol ding hi," a ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin David in a sih ma-in na tampi tak koihkhol hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a tapa Solomon sam a, Israel Pasian, { Topa}-a' dingin biakinn khat a lam ding a gen hi.
David in Solomon kiangah, "Ka ta aw, { Topa } ka Pasian' min dingin biakinn khat lam ding ka lungsimah om hi.
Ahih hangin kei' tungah { Topa' } thu hong tung a, 'Nangmah in gal lianpipi tampi simin mi tampi na that hi. Nangmah in keima mai leitungah sisan tua zahta luangsak na hih manin ka min dingin biakinn na lam kei ding hi.
En in, nangma sung panin tapa khat hong piang ding a, amah pen lungnopna a nei mi hi ding hi. Keimah in a kimkota a galte khempeuh panin ama tungah lungnopna ka pia ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ama min Solomon hi ding a, ama hun sungin Israel tungah lungnopna leh daihna ka pia ding hi.
Tu-in ka ta aw, amah in nangma thu a gensa bangin { Topa } na Pasian' biakinn na lamna-ah na tangtun' theihna dingin { Topa } in nang hong ompih ta hen.
Amah in Israel tungah nang hong uksak ciangin { Topa } na Pasian' thukham na zuih theihna dingin { Topa } in ngaihsut pilna leh thutelna nang tungah hong pia ta hen.
Tua ciangin Israel-te-a' dingin { Topa } in Moses a piak thukhamte leh biakna ngeina kipte zuih ding na kidop nak leh na mavang ding hi. Thakhauh in la hang in. Lau kei in la lungkia kei in.
Nakpi taka hanciamna leh gimna lianpi tawh { Topa' } biakinn dingin kham talen tul za khat, ngun talen awn khat, leh tehzawh lohin sumngo leh sik ka koih khinzo hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tam mahmah hi; sing leh suang zong ka koihzo hi. Nangmah in hihte na behlap ding hi.
Nangmah in na a sem ding mi tampi na nei hi; suangseekte, leilesuang innlam siamte, khutsiamte, leh simzawh lohin siamna nam khempeuh a nei,
kham, ngun, sumngo, leh sik sep a siamte na nei ding hi. Kithawi in la sem in! { Topa } in nang hong ompih ta hen!" a ci hi.
"{ Topa } na Pasian uh note tawh hong om hilo ahi hiam? Amah in na kiim khempeuh uhah lungnopna hong pia hilo ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in gamsunga teng mite keima khutsungah hong pia khin a, { Topa } leh ama mite' mai-ah gamsung khempeuh kinuaisiah hi.
Tu-in { Topa } na Pasian uh a zong dingin na ngaihsutna uh leh na lungsim uh kipsak un. { Topa' } min dingin a kilam biakinn sungah { Topa' } Thuciamna Singkuang leh Pasian' umlebeel siangthote a kipaipih theihna dingin kithawi un la { Topa } Pasian' biakinn lam un," a ci hi.
David in Israel makai khempeuh leh siampite leh Levi mite a khawm hi.
Levi mite kum sawmthum panin a tungsiah teng kisim a, a vekpi-in pasal tul sawmthum leh tul giat pha hi.
David in, "Hihte sung panin tul sawmnih leh tul li in { Topa' } biakinn sungah nasep uk ding a, tul guk pen maangte leh thukhente hi ding a,
tul li kongcingte, leh tul li in phatna dinga ka bawlsa lasaknate tawh { Topa } tungah phatna pia ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in Levi mite a behbehin pawl thum suah a, tuate pen: Gershom pawl, Kohath pawl, leh Merari pawl ahi uh hi.
Gershom' tapate: Ladan leh Shimei ahi uh hi.
Ladan' tapate: A ukpi Jehiel, leh Zetham, leh Joel, thum pha uh hi.
Shimei' tapate: Shelomoth, Haziel, leh Haran, thum pha uh hi. Hihte pen Ladan' beh lutangte ahi uh hi.
Tua ciangin Shimei' tapate: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, leh Beriah ahi uh hi. Hih lite pen Shimei' tapate ahi uh hi.
Jahath a ukpi hi-in, Zina a nihna ahi hi. Ahih hangin Jeush leh Beriah-te in tapa tampi neilo uh ahih manin innkuan khat kisuak sakin sim khatin kisim khawm uh hi.
Kohath' tapate: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, leh Uzziel, li pha uh hi.
Amram' tapate: Aaron leh Moses ahi uh hi. Amah leh a tapate in { Topa' } mai-ah paknamtui a hal tawntung ding leh ama na semin ama min tawh thupha a piak tawntung theihna dingin a siangtho pen nate a ap dingin Aaron kituam koih hi.
Moses' tapate: Gershom leh Eliezer ahi uh hi.
Eliezer' tapa Rehabiah zong a ukpi ahi hi. Eliezer in tapa dang neilo a, ahih hangin Rehabiah' tapate tam mahmah hi.
Kohath' tapa thumna Hebron' tapate lakah: Jeriah a ukpi, Amariah a nihna, Jahaziel a thumna, leh Jekameam a lina ahi hi.
Kohath' tapa lina Uzziel' tapate lakah: Mikah a ukpi, leh Isshiah a nihna ahi hi.
Merari' tapate: Mahli leh Mushi ahi hi. Mahli' tapate: Eleazar leh Kish ahi hi.
Eleazar in tapa neiloin si a, tanu bek nei hi. Amau' tanau, Kish tapate in amaute ten'pih uh hi.
Mushi' tapate: Mahli, Eder, leh Jeremoth, thum pha uh hi.
Hihte pen { Topa' } biakinn nasepna-ah na a sem ding, kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah, a milipin a minin a mi phazah zui-in a kiciamtehna bangin beh lutangte, a behbehin Levi suante ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh David in, "Israel Pasian, { Topa } in a mite tungah lungnopna piazo a, Jerusalem-ah amah om tawntung ta hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Levi mite in puanbuk hita leh tua tawh kisai nasepna ding nate khat peuhpeuh hita leh a puak ding uh kisam nawnlo hi," a ci hi.
"Ahih hangin amaute' nasep ding pen { Topa' } biakinn nasepna-ah Aaron' suante huhin, biakinn tualte leh biakinn deite kemin, biakna na khempeuh a siangtho sak ding, leh Pasian' biakinn nasepna-ah hih ding khat peuhpeuh a sem ding uh ahi hi.
Ompihna Anlum, an tawh biakna dingin annel, silngo sawhloh anlum moh, a ki-em piakna, sathau tawh a kihel piakna, leh a tam tehna ahih kei leh a lian tehna nasep khempeuh zong a huh ding uh ahi hi.
Tua ciangin amaute zingsang simin ding ding uh a, lungdamna ko-in { Topa } phatin, nitakin zong tua bangmahin hih ding uh a,
a mal zah a kisam bangin Sabbath nite, Khadet nite, leh pawi nite-in { Topa } tungah meihal biakna a kipiak peuhpeuh ciangin a tawntungin { Topa' } mai-ah om ding uh hi.
Tua bangin amaute in kikhopna puanbuk leh biakinn kemin, { Topa' } biakinn nasepna-ah amau' behte ahi Aaron' suante huh ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Aaron' suante a kisehkhennate hih bang ahi hi. Aaron' tapate: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, leh Ithamar ahi uh hi.
Ahih hangin a pa uh a sih ma-in Nadab leh Abihu si-in ta neilo uh ahih manin Eleazar leh Ithamar-te siampi suak uh hi.
Eleazar' suan Zadok, leh Ithamar' suan Ahimelek' huhna tawh David in amau' nasepna-ah a kiseh bangin Aaron' suante a koih hi.
Ithamar' suante lak sangin Eleazar' suante lakah ukpi tam omzaw ahih manin, amaute in Eleazar' suante pawl sawmleguk suahin, Ithamar' suante pawl giat suah uh hi.
Eleazar' suante leh Ithamar' suante lakah biakinn uliante leh Pasian' uliante om tuak uh ahih manin amaute in a kibangin aisanna tawh amaute koih uh hi.
Tua ciangin Levi mi Nethanel' tapa ahi lai-atpa Shemaiah in kumpipa, uliante, siampi Zadok, Abiathar' tapa Ahimelek, siampite, leh Levi mi beh lutangte' omna-ah amaute ciamteh hi. Eleazar' suante-a' dingin khat kiteelin, tua ciangin Ithamar' suante-a' dingin khat kiteel a, kilaihsak niloh uh hi.

Hihte in Israel { Topa } Pasian in amah a thupiak bangin a pupi uh Aaron in amaute-a' dingin a kipsaksa ngeina bangin { Topa' } biakinn sungah a pai dingin amau' nasep uh ahi a kiseh nasep nei uh hi.
Merari' suante: Mahli, Mushi, leh Jaaziah ahi hi.
Merari' suante Jaaziah sung panin Beno, Shoham, Zakkur, leh Ibri ahi hi.
Mahli in tapa nih, Eleazar leh Kish nei hi. Eleazar in tapa neilo a, Kish in Jerahmeel a kici tapa khat nei hi.
Mushi' tapate: Mahli, Eder, leh Jerimoth ahi uh hi. Hihte pen a beh tawh kizui-in Levi' suante ahi uh hi.
Hihte in zong a behte uh ahi Aaron' suante mah bangin Kumpi David, Zadok, Ahimelek, siampite, leh Levi mi beh lutangte' muhna-ah beh lutangte leh a nau pasalte khat ciat in a kibangin aisanna tawh nasep tavuan a la uh hi.
David leh nasepna-ah a ukpite in zong laia lasaknate, harp lasaknate, leh daltuahte tawh Pasian thu a gen dingin Asaf, Heman, leh Jeduthun-te' tapate pawlkhat nasepna-a dingin koihtuam uh hi. Na a semte leh amau' nasepte:
Asaf' tapate sung panin: Kumpipa' makaihna nuai-ah Pasian' thu a gen Asaf' makaihna nuai-ah Asaf' tapate Zakkur, Josef, Nethaniah, leh Asharelah ahi hi.
Jeduthun' sung panin Jeduthun' tapate: Lungdam kohna leh { Topa } phatna-in laia lasakna tawh thu a gen, a pa uh Jeduthun' makaihna nuai-ah Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, leh Mattithiah, guk pha uh hi.
Heman sung panin Heman' tapate: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamtiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, leh Mahazioth ahi hi.
Hihte khempeuh pen Pasian thuciamna bangin amah a pahtawi dingin kumpipa' thumupa Heman' tapate ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in Heman tungah tapa sawmleli leh tanu thum pia hi.
Amaute khempeuh Pasian' biakinn nasepna dingin { Topa' } biakinn sungah daltuahte, harp lasaknate, leh laia lasaknate tawh la lamsangah a pa uh ukna nuai-ah om uh hi. Asaf, Jeduthun, leh Heman-te pen kumpipa' thupiakna nuai-ah om uh hi.
A Levi mipihte uh tawh { Topa}-a' ding lasakna lamah sinna a nei a siam mi a vekpi-in za nih leh sawmgiatlegiat ahi hi.
Tua ciangin a neu a lian, sia leh a sinte a kibangin, amaute in amau' nasep ding uh ai a san uh hi.

Shemaiah' tapate: Othni, Refael, Obed, leh a sanggamte siamna a nei ahi Elzabad, Elihu, leh Shemakhiah ahi hi.
Hihte khempeuh pen Obededom' tapate leh amau' tapate leh a sanggamte uh tawh, nasepna dingin siamna a nei mi kician ahi uh hi. Obededom sung panin sawmguklenih pha uh hi.
Meshelemiah in siamna a nei tapate leh sanggamte, sawmlegiat nei hi.
Hilkiah a nihna, Tebaliah a thumna, Zekhariah a lina ahi hi. Hosah' tapate leh a sanggamte khempeuh sawmlethum a pha uh hi.

Hihte pen Korah mite leh Merari' tapate lakah kongcingte a kisehkhenna ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Levi mite sung panin Ahijah in Pasian' biakinn vanmanpha koihnate leh a ki-ap letsong koihnate uk hi.
Gershon-te beh sung panin Ladan pen innkuan tampi a pian'khiatna mi khat hi a, Jehiel innkuante zong ama sung panin a piang ahi hi.
Jehiel' tapa Zetham leh a sanggampa Joel in { Topa' } biakinn vanmanpha koihnate uk uh hi.
Amram mite, Izhar mite, Hebron mite, leh Uzziel mite sung panin:
Hih Shelomith leh a sanggamte in, Kumpi David, beh lutangte, leh a tultul leh a zaza-a uk uliante, leh galkap a ukte in a ap uh ahi, a ki-ap letsongte a kikoihna khempeuh uk uh hi.
Gal sungah a ngah uh van kinusiate sung panin { Topa' } biakinn puahna dingin amaute in letsongte ap uh hi.
Thumupa Samuel, Kish' tapa Saul, Ner' tapa Abner, leh Zeruiah' tapa Joab in a apsate khempeuh zong, a ki-ap letsong khempeuh Shelomith leh a sanggamte' kepna sungah om hi.
Izhar mite sung panin Khenaniah leh a tapate pen Israel-a' dingin uliante leh thukhente-in a pualam nasepna-ah kiseh hi.
Hebron mite sung panin Hashabiah leh a sanggamte, siamna a nei mihing tul khat leh za sagih in Jordan nitumna lam Israel tungah { Topa' } nasepna khempeuh leh kumpipa' nasepna-ah uk uh hi.
Hebron mite sung panin Jerijah a ukpi ahi hi. (David' uk a kum sawmlina kumin kikantelna bawl uh a, Gilead gamsung Jazer-ah amaute sung panin siamna lian a nei mihing kimu hi.)
Kumpi David in Jerijah leh a sanggamte, siamna a nei mihing tul nih leh za sagih, a beh sungah lutang ahite pen Pasian tawh a kisai na khempeuh leh kumpipa' vaite-ah, Reuben mite, Gad mite, leh Manasseh minam alangte tungah a uk dingin a seh hi.
Tu-in Israel mite, beh lutangte, a tul leh a za-a a ukte, leh khen khatah mi tul sawmnih leh tul li a om, kum tawntung kha khat khit kha khat hong tungin a kuankhia a khente tawh kisai-in na khempeuhah kumpipa' na a sem a uliante:
A kha masa sungin Zabdiel' tapa Jashobeam a khen masa a uk hi a, ama khen sungah mi tul sawmnih leh tul li om hi.
A kha nihna sungin Ahoh-te beh Dodai a khen a ukpi hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tul li om hi.
A kha thumna sungin siampi Jehoiada' tapa Benaiah a ukpi hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tul li om hi.
Hihpa pen mihing sawmthumte sungah a thahat, mihing sawmthumte a uk Benaiah hi a, ama tapa Ammizabad pen ama khen a ukpa ahi hi.
A kha lina sungin Joab sanggampa Asahel hi a, ama nungah amah a laih dingin a tapa Zebadiah om hi. Ama khen sungah mi tul sawmnih leh tul li om hi.
A kha ngana sungin Izrah-te beh Shamhuth hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tul li om hi.
A kha gukna sungin Tekoa khuami Ikkesh' tapa Ira hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tul li om hi.
A kha sagihna sungin Efraim suante sung panin Pelon khuami Helez hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tul li om hi.
A kha giatna sungin Jerah mi sung panin Hushah khuami Sibbekai hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tul li om hi.
A kha kuana sungin Benjamin mi sung panin Anathoth khuami Abiezer hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tul li om hi.
A kha sawmna sungin Zerah mi sung panin Netofah khuami Maharai hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tul li om hi.
A kha sawmlekhatna sungin Efraim suante sung panin Pirathon khuami Benaiah hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tul li om hi.
A kha sawmlenihna sungin Othniel' suante sung panin Netofah khuami Heldai hi a, ama khen sungah tul sawmnih leh tul li om hi.
Israel minamte tungah a ukpite: Reuben mite-a' dingin Zikri' tapa Eliezer ahi hi. Simeon mite-a' dingin Maakah' tapa Shefatiah ahi hi.
Levi mite-a' dingin Kemuel' tapa Hashabiah ahi hi. Aaron mite-a' dingin Zadok ahi hi.
Judah mite-a' dingin David' sanggamte' sung panin Elihu ahi hi. Issakhar mite-a' dingin Mikhael' tapa Omri ahi hi.
Zebulun mite-a' dingin Obadiah' tapa Ishmaiah ahi hi. Naftali mite-a' dingin Azriel' tapa Jeremoth ahi hi.
Efraim mite-a' dingin Azariah' tapa Hoshea ahi hi. Manasseh minam a langte-a' dingin Pedaiah' tapa Joel ahi hi.
Gilead gamsunga Manasseh minam alangte-a' dingin Zekhariah' tapa Iddo ahi hi. Benjamin mite-a' dingin Abner' tapa Jaasiel ahi hi.
Dan mite-a' dingin Jehoram' tapa Azarel ahi hi. Hihte pen Israel minamte' makaite ahi uh hi.
Israel mite vantung aksi zahin a tamin a bawlna ding { Topa } in thu ciam khin ahih manin David in kum sawmnih leh a nuaisiah mite simlo hi.
Zeruiah' tapa Joab in sim ding kipan a, ahih hangin zo manlo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih thu hangin Israel tungah Pasian' hehna hong tung a, Kumpi David' khang tangthu sungah tua a kisimte kikhumlo hi.
Kumpipa' vanmanpha a ukte: Kumpipa' vanmanpha koihnate-ah Adiel' tapa Azmaveth ahi hi. Gamsunga vanmanpha koihnate, khuapi sungate, khuaneute leh tausangte sunga omte tungah Uzziah' tapa Jonathan ahi hi.
Shefelah gamsunga om oliv leh theithek kungte tungah Gederah khuami Baalhanan ahi hi. Sathau koihnate tungah Joash ahi hi.
Sharon gamsungah a gamta ganhonte tungah Sharon khuami Shitrai ahi hi. Kuam sunga om ganhonte tungah Adlai' tapa Shafat ahi hi.
David' pano Jonathan pen thuthei mi leh laithei mi ahih manin thu lamlakpa ahi hi. Amah leh Hakmoni' tapa Jehiel in kumpipa' tapate cing uh hi.
Ahithofel pen kumpipa' thu lamlakpa hi a, Arkhi mi Hushai pen kumpipa' lawmpa ahi hi.
Ahithofel a sih ciangin Benaiah' tapa Jehoiada leh Abiathar in laih uh hi. Joab pen kumpipa' galkapte a ukpa ahi hi.
David in Jerusalem-a Israel-te lakah zaneite, minamte sungah zaneite, kumpipa' na a sem a khente sungah uliante, a tultul-a a ukte, a zaza-a a ukte, neihsa khempeuh leh kumpipa' ganhingte leh a tapate a kemte pen, kumpi inn-a zaneite, a thahat mite, leh gal a hang tawntungte khempeuh tawh a khawm hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi David a khe-in dingto-in, "Ka sanggamte leh ka mite aw, ka thugen hong za un. { Topa' } Thuciamna Singkuang-a' ding leh i Pasian' khengakna dingin tawlngakna biakinn khat lam ding ka lungsim sungah om a, a lamna ding ka kiging hi.
Ahi zongin Israel { Topa } Pasian in Israel tungah kumpi ahi tawntung dingin ka pa' innkuan khempeuh panin kei hong teel hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in makai-in Judah teel a, tua ciangin Judah innkuan panin ka pa' innkuan teel a, tua ciangin ka pa' tate lak panin Israel khempeuh tungah kumpi-in kei hong bawl ding kei tungah amah lungkim hi.
Tua ciangin ka tapate khempeuh lak panin (bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in kei tungah tapa tampi hong pia hi) Israel-te a ukin { Topa' } kumpi tokhom tungah a tu dingin amah in ka tapa Solomon teel khin hi.
Amah in kei kiangah, 'Ka biakinn leh a inntualte a bawl dingpa pen na tapa Solomon ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka tapa dingin amah ka teel khin a, kei pen ama pa ka hi ding hi.
Amah in ka thupiaknate leh ka biakna ngeina kipte tuni-a mah bangin zuih ding a ngaihsut paisuak nak leh ama kumpi gam ka kipsak tawntung ding hi,' hong ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in note in hih leitang hoih nei-in note' khit na tate uh tungah gamh-in na nusiat tawntung theihna dingun { Topa' } mai-ah kikhopna ahi Israel khempeuh' muhna, leh i Pasian' zakna-ah { Topa } na Pasian uh thupiaknate khempeuh zui-in zong un.
"Tu-in nang, ka tapa Solomon aw, na pa' Pasian thei in la, na lungsim khempeuh leh utna lungsim tawh ama na sem in; bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in lungsim sung zong a, ngimna leh ngaihsutna khempeuh thei hi. Nangmah in amah na zon' leh nangmah in amah na mu ding hi. Ahih hangin amah na nusiat leh amah in nang hong paiikhia paisuak ding hi.
Biakinn dingin inn khat a lam dingin { Topa } in nang hong teel khin ahih manin tu-in kingaihsun in; thahat in la sem in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in a tapa Solomon tungah biakinn innlim, a innte, a vanmanpha koihnate, a dawl tungnungte, a dei sungnungte, leh hehpihna tokhom-a' dingin inndei a geelna;
leh { Topa' } inn a tualte-a' dingin a lungsimah a ngaihsut khempeuh, a kimkota inndeite khempeuh, Pasian' biakinn sung vanmanpha koihnate, leh a ki-ap letsongte-a' ding vanmanpha koihnate;
siampite leh Levi mi a khente, leh { Topa' } biakinn sungah nasepna khempeuh-a ding; { Topa' } biakinn sungah nasepna ding umlebeel khempeuh-a' ding,
nasepna-ah meivakkhuam a kizat ciatna bangin kham meivak khuamte leh a meivakte a gihna, a meivakkhuam leh meivakte a gihna zah ciat, meivakkhuam khat leh a meivakte ngun a gihna,
Ompihna Anlum-a' dingin sabuai kham a gihna ciat, ngun sabuaite-a' dingin ngun a gihna,
leh sikkeute, kuangte, leh haite-a' dingin kham citak a gihna; kham haipite leh a gihna ciat, ngun haipite leh a gihna ciat;
a kisiangsaksa kham tawh kibawl paknamtui biakna tau ding leh a gihna zah ding a geelna; a khate uh zakin { Topa' } Thuciamna Singkuang a khuh kherub-te' kham leeng ding a geelna zong a pia hi.
Nasep ding khempeuh geelsa bangin sep dingin hih thu tawh kizui-in { Topa' } genna bangin lai-in gelhna tawh amah in hihte khempeuh a siangin a hih hi.
Tua ciangin David in a tapa Solomon kiangah, "Thakhauhin hang in la sem in. Lau kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } Pasian, keima Pasian nangawn nang tawh hong om hi. { Topa' } biakinn sung nasepna khempeuh a kizawh matengin amah in nang hong tamasaklo ding a, hong nusialo ding hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian' biakinn-ah nasep khempeuh a sem dingin siampite leh Levi mi a khente om hi. Nasepna khat peuhpeuhah siamna a nei mite in nasepna khempeuhah nang hong huh ding hi. Uliante leh mi khempeuh zong nangma thupiakna bangbangin gamta ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi David in a kikhawm khempeuhte kiangah, "Pasian in amah bek a teelsa ka tapa Solomon pen khangno-in pumpi tawh sinna om nailo a, nasep ding pen lian mahmah hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih biakinn lianpi pen mihing-a' ding hilo a, { Topa } Pasian-a' ding ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka Pasian' biakinn dingin ka hih theihzah ciang, phuh dingin onik suang, suangpak, mel tuamtuam a nei suang, suangkang, leh suangmanpha nam khempeuh tampi takte banah kham zatna ding nate-ah kham, ngun zatna ding nate-ah ngun, sumngo zatna ding nate-ah sumngo, sik zatna ding nate-ah sik, leh sing zatna ding nate-ah sing ka koih khinzo hi.
Tua thamloin, a siangtho biakinn-a dingin ka koihte khempeuh banah, ngun leh kham keima-a' mahmah zong om a, ka Pasian' biakinn ka ngaihsutna hangin ka Pasian' inn-ah ka piakte:
Kawm zutna dingin Ofir gam kham ahi kham talen tul thum, leh a kisiangsaksa ngun talen tul sagih,
leh siamneelte in a hih ding nasepna khempeuh-a dingin kham zatna ding nate-ah kham, leh ngun zatna ding nate-ah ngun ahi hi. Kua teng utna lungsim tawh { Topa' } tungah tuni-in amahmah kipia-in ki-ap ding na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin beh lutangte in utthu-a piakna bawl uh a, minam makaite, a tul tula a ukte leh a za za-a a ukte, leh kumpipa' nasepna-ah a uk uliante in zong hih uh hi.
Amaute in Pasian' biakinn nasepna dingin kham talen tul nga leh kham darik tul sawm, ngun talen tul sawm, sumngo talen tul sawm leh tul giat, leh sik talen tul za khat a pia uh hi.
Suangmanpha a nei peuhmah in Gershon mi Jehiel' kepna sung, { Topa' } biakinn sung vanmanpha koihna-ah a pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin hih mite in utna lungsim tawh pia uh ahih manin mite lungdam uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in a lungsim khempeuh uh tawh { Topa' } tungah pia ziahziah uh a, kumpi David zong nakpi takin a lungdam hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a kikhawmte khempeuh' omna-ah David in { Topa } phat hi. David in, "Nang, { Topa}, ka pu uh Israel Pasian aw, a tawntungin thupha ngah ta in.
{ Topa } aw, liatna, vangliatna, minthan'na, guazawhna, leh min liatnate nangma-a' ahi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh vantung leh leitungah a om khempeuh zong nangma-a' ahi hi. { Topa } aw, kumpi gam nangma-a' hi a, tuate khempeuh tungah nang a lutangin hong kisangsak hi.
Hauhna leh minphatna nangma kiang pan hong pai a, nangmah in na khempeuh tungah na uk hi. Na khutsungah vangliatna leh minthan'na om a, liatsakna ding leh thakhauhsakna ding na khutsungah om hi.
"Ahih hangin kote in hih bangin utna tawh kong piakna dingun kei kua hi a, ka mite bang ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh na khempeuh nang kiang pan hong pai hi a, nangma-a' mah nang tungah a hong pia ka hi uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka pu ka pate khempeuh uh mah bangin kote pen nangma mai-ah khualmite leh pemtate ka hi uh hi. Ka hunte uh leitungah nilim bang hi a, sih ding ka pelh thei kei uh hi.
{ Topa } kote' Pasian aw, na min siangtho pahtawina dingin nang-a' ding biakinn lamna dingin ka piaksa uh hih a tampite zong nangma khutsung panin hong pai hi a, a vekpi-in nangma-a' mah ahi hi.
Nangmah in lungsim entelin thumanna-ah na lungkimna ka thei hi, ka Pasian aw. Lungsim thumanna leh citna tawh hih nate khempeuh kong pia khin a, tu-in nang tungah citna leh lungdamna tawh a hong pia, hih lai-ah a om na mite ka muzo hi.
Ka pute uh Abraham, Isaac, leh Israel Pasian, { Topa } aw, na mite' lungsim sungah tua bang ngimnate leh ngaihsutnate omsak tawntung in la, amaute' lungsim nangma lamah kai in.
Amah in a lungsim khempeuh tawh na thupiaknate, na teci pan'nate, leh na thukhamte kemin a vekpi-in sem a, keimah in ka vaihawmsa biakinn lianpi amah in a lam theihna dingin ka tapa Solomon tungah utna lungsim guan' in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin David in a kikhawmte khempeuh tungah, "{ Topa } na Pasian uh phat un," a ci hi. Tua ciangin a kikhawmte khempeuh in a pute a pate uh Pasian { Topa } phatin a lu uh kun uh a, { Topa } bia-in kumpipa tungah zahtakna a bawl uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in { Topa } tungah biakpiakna bawl uh a, a zing ciangin { Topa } tungah meihal biakna bawngtal tul khat, tuutal tul khat, leh tuuno tul khat, a leenggahzu tawh a biakna teng tawh, leh Israel khempeuh-a' dingin biakpiakna tampi a pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in tua ni-in lungdamna lianpi tawh { Topa' } mai-ah pawi khamin a om uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute in David' tapa Solomon kumpi-in a nihveina bawl uha, amaute in { Topa}-a' dingin amah kumpi-in sathau nilhin, siampi dingin Zadok sathau a nilh uh hi.
Tua ciangin a pa David tangin { Topa' } phuhsa kumpi tokhom tungah kumpi-in Solomon a tu hi. Amah a dau pai a, Israel mi khempeuh in ama thu a mang uh hi.
Makaite khempeuh leh a thahat mite, leh Kumpi David' tapate khempeuh in zong Kumpi Solomon tungah a thuman ding uh thu ciam uh hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in Israel mi khempeuh muhna-ah Solomon tungah minthan'na lianpi pia a, Israel sungah ama ma-in kumpi khat peuhpeuh tungah a kipia ngei nailo kumpi minliatna a guan' hi.
Israel tungah ama uk hun kum sawmli sung hi a, amah in Hebron-ah kum sagih sung, Jerusalem-ah kum sawmthumlethum sung a uk hi.
Tua ciangin a khangham, a ni cing, hauhna leh minthan'na tawh a si hi. Tua ciangin a tapa Solomon in ama tangin uk hi.
Tu-in Kumpi David' gamtatna a patna pan a tawpna dongin thumupa Samuel' Khang Tangthu sung, kamsang Nathan' Khang Tangthu sung, leh thumupa Gad' Khang Tangthu sungah
ama ukna leh ama vangliatnate khempeuh leh ama tung leh Israel tung, gamsung kumpi gamte khempeuh tungah a tung thute a kiciamtehna tawh kigelh khawm hi.
David' tapa Solomon in ama kumpi gam kho takin lenkip hi; bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } ama Pasian in ompih a, a lian mahmahin amah a bawl hi.
Solomon in Israel mi khempeuh tung, a tultul leh a zaza-a a ukte tung, thukhente tung, Israel sunga makai khempeuh tung, leh beh lutangte tungah thu a gen hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon leh amah tawh a om khempeuh, Gibeon-a a om mual dawna biakpiakna munah pai uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa' } nasem Moses in gamlakah a bawlsa Pasian' kikhopna buk tua lai-ah om hi.
(Ahih hangin David in Kiriathjearim panin ama-a' dingin a bawlsaknasa munah Pasian' Thuciamna Singkuang paipihto khin hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Jerusalem-ah ama-a' dingin puanbuk khat lamsak khin hi.)
Tua thamloin Hur' tapa Uri, a tapa Bezalel in a bawl sumngo biakna tau pen { Topa' } biakbuk mai tua lai-ah om hi. Tua ciangin Solomon leh a kikhawm mite in { Topa } thu dong uh hi.
Tua ciangin kikhopna bukah a om { Topa' } mai-a sumngo biakna tau-ah Solomon paito-in tua tungah meihal biakna ganhing tul khat a pia hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in Pasian kiangah, "Nangmah in ka pa David tungah a lian leh a kip itna na lak khin a, ama tangin kumpi-in keimah nong koih khin hi.
{ Topa } Pasian aw, leitung leivui zahin a tam mite tungah kumpi-in kei hong koih khin na hih manin ka pa David tungah na thuciamna tu-in hong tungsak in.
Hih mite ka uk theihna dingin tu-in pilna leh theihna hong pia in; bang hang hiam cih leh hih zahin a tam hih na mite kua in ukzo ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Pasian in Solomon dawngin, "Hih thu na lungsim sungah om a, nangmah in neihsate, hauhna, pahtawina, ahih kei leh nang hong mudahte' nuntakna hong ngenloin, a tungah kumpi-in nang kong koihna ka mite na uk theihna dingin nang-a' ding pilna leh theihna hong ngen na hih manin,
pilna leh theihna nangma tungah hong kipia hi. Nang' ma-a kumpite kuamah in a neih ngeiloh, nang' khit-ate kuamah in zong tua bang a neihloh ding hauhnate, neihnate, leh pahtawina zong, nangma tungah kong pia thuah ding hi," a ci hi.
Solomon in leengte leh sakol tung tuangte kaikhawm hi. Amah in leeng tul khat leh za li leh sakol tung tuang mi tul sawm leh tul nih nei a, leeng khuapite sung leh Jerusalem-ah tuate a koih hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Jerusalem-ah suang bangin ngun leh kham olsak a, taamtak singte pen Shefelah theithek sing bangin tamsak hi.
Solomon in gamdang panin sakol a lakna munte pen Egypt leh Kue pan hi a, kumpipa' sumbawlte in a man ding pia-in Kue panin tuate ngah uh hi.
Amaute in Egypt panin leeng khat ciangin ngun shekel za guk-in la uh a, sakol khat ciangin za leh sawmnga-in la uh hi. Tua bangmahin amaute in zuakkhiat kik dingin Hit kumpite leh Syria kumpite khempeuh tung panin zong sakol leh leeng a la uh hi.
Tu-in Solomon in { Topa' } min dingin biakinn khat leh ama-a' dingin kumpi inn khat lam ding sawm hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Solomon in van a pua ding mi tul sawmsagih leh mualtung gamah suang a to ding mi tul sawmgiat, leh tuate a van dingin mi tul thum leh zaguk a seh hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in Taia kumpi Hiram kiangah thu puak a, "Ten'na ding inn khat a lamna dingin ka pa David tungah taamtak sing na puak mah bangin kei tungah zong hong puak in.
En in, Israel-te-a' dingin a tawntunga ding a kikipsaksa bangin, ama mai-ah a namtui nate ahi paknamtui halna ding, leh Ompihna Anlum piak tawntungna ding, leh Sabbath nite, Khadet nite, leh { Topa } kote' Pasian-a' dingin a kisehsa pawi nite-in zing leh nitakin meihal biaknate piakna dingin { Topa } ka Pasian' minin biakinn khat lamin ama tungah a ap ding ka hi hi.
Ahih hangin vantung, a sang pen vantung nangawn in amah huam zolo ahih manin ama-a' dingin kua in biakinn lamzo ding ahi hiam? Ama mai-ah paknamtui halna ding cih simloh ama-a' dingin biakinn a lamsak dingin kei kua ka hi hiam?
Tua hi a, tu-in ka pa David in a sehsa, Judah leh Jerusalem-ah kei tawh a om nasep siamte tawh a semkhawm dingin kham, ngun, sumngo, leh sik, leh a ausan, a dupsan, puandumte, leh nasepna-ah zong siamna a nei mi khat hong puak in.
Taamtak, taaksan, leh cingsing zong, Lebanon panin hong puak in; bang hang hiam cih leh na nasemte in Lebanon sing phuk ding zia a theihna ka thei hi. Tua ahih ciangin kei-a' dingin sing tampi a sem dingin nangma nasemte pen keima nasemte tawh om ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka lam ding biakinn pen lianin lamdang ding hi.
Sing nasem sing a phukte-a' dingin a kisuvui mangbuh beem tul sawmnih, mangbuhham beem tul sawmnih, leenggahzu tambong tul sawmli, leh sathau tambong tul sawmli ka hong pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Taia kumpipa Hiram in lai-in thuk-in Solomon kiangah khak a, "{ Topa } in a mite it ahih manin amaute tungah kumpi-in nang hong koih hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin a lai sungah genthuah lai a, "{ Topa}-a' dingin biakinn khat, leh ama-a' dingin kumpi inn khat a lam ding, thutheihna leh thutelna tawh a kidim mipil, David tungah a pia, van leh lei a bawl Israel { Topa } Pasian in thupha ngah ta hen.
Tu-in Dan minam numei khat' tapa, thutelna tawh a kidim, siamna a nei, siapa Huram kong puak hi. Ama pa pen Taia khuami ahi hi. Amah in kham, ngun, sumngo, sik, leh sing, leh a ausan, a dum, leh a dupsan puante, leh saihadial puan, leh zepna nam khempeuh a sem ding leh ka topa ahi na pa David' mi khutsiamte tawh a semkhawm dingin ama tungah a kipia nasep khat peuhpeuh a sem dingin siamna a neisa ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in ka topa in a gensa mangbuh leh mangbuhham, sathau leh leenggahzute, na nasemte tungah hong puak in.
Tua ciangin na kisap sing peuhmah Lebanon panin kong phuk ding uh a, nangmah in Jerusalem-ah na puaktoh theihna dingin phongin tuipi tungah Joppa dong nang kiangah kong paipih ding uh hi," zong ci lai hi.
Tua ciangin a pa David in mi phazah a sim mah bangin, Solomon in Israel gamsunga om gamdang mi phazah simna bawl a, mi tul za khat leh tul sawmnga leh tul thum leh zaguk pha hi.
Amah in van a pua dingin amaute tul sawmsagih, mualtung gamah suang a to dingin tul sawmgiat, leh mite' nasep a van dingin tul thum leh zaguk a seh hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in Jerusalem sung Moriah Mual tung, a pa David' tungah { Topa } a kilahna mun, David in a sehnasa mun ahi, Jebus mi Ornan' ancilna phualah { Topa' } biakinn lam ding kipan hi.
Inn mai-a innliim pen inn vai tawh kikimin pi sawmthum sau a, a san'na zong pi sawmthum mah ahi hi.
Amah in taaksan tawh innpi kawm dapin kham hoih tawh zut a, tua tungah nisuh leh khainiang a bawl hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in a inn, a innsunte, a sangkilte, a kawmte, leh a kongkhakte kham tawh zut a, tua ciangin a kawmte tungah kherub-te a bawl hi.
Tua kherub-te gel' kha a kizalin pi sawmthum ahi hi. A khat' kha pen pi sagih leh alang hi-in inn kawm ban a, tua ciangin alang khat pi sagih leh alang in a kherub dang khat' kha ban hi.
Tua mah bangin a kherub dang khat' kha langkhat zong pi sagih leh alang hi-in inn kawm langkhat ban a, pi sagih leh alang mah a sau a kha langkhat pen a kherub masa' kha tawh kizom hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a dum, a ausan, leh a dupsan puante, leh saihadial puan tawh a dalna puan bawl a, tua tungah kherub-te a bawl hi.
Amah in inn mai sanah pi sawmnga leh pi nih leh alang a sang, a dawn tuakah pi sagih leh alang a pha khuamluzepna a nei khuampi nih bawl hi.
Amah in ngawnga awhte bangin khainiangte bawlin khuampite dawnah khai hi. Tua ciangin amah in mang kawlsing za khat bawlin khainiangte tungah koih hi.
Amah in sumngo biakna tau, a dung pi sawmthum, a vai pi sawmthum, a sang pi sawmlenga a pha khat bawl hi.
Tua ciangin amah in a kisung tuikuangpi khat zong bawl hi. Tua pen a bem hi a, a gei khat pan a gei khat dong pi sawmlenga pha-in, pi sagih leh alang sang a, a kimkot pi sawmlilenga a pha hi.
Tuikuangpi pualam kimkot pi sawmlinga sungah umgah limte om hi. Tua um gahte gual nihin om a, tuikuangpi a kisun'in kisungkhawm pah hi.
Bawngtal sawmlenihte tungah tua tuikuangpi kinga a, thum leilu lam nga a, thum nitumna lam nga-in, thum leitaw lam nga a, thum nisuahna lam nga hi. Tuate tungah a tuikuangpi kinga a, a nunglam uh a sunglamah om hi.
A sahna pen khutpeek mai cia ahi hi; a geivial pen unok tawh a kibang hai geivial bangin kibawl a, tua sungah tui tambong tul guk val ta hi.
Amah in sabuai sawm zong bawl a, biakinn sung leitaw lampangah nga, leilu lampangah nga koih hi. Tua ciangin amah in kham kuang za khat bawl hi.
Amah in siampite' inntual, leh inntual lian, leh inntual kongkhakte bawl a, a kongkhakte sumngo tawh a zut hi.
Huram in beelte, kawbiate, leh kuangte zong bawl hi. Tua ahih ciangin Huram in Kumpi Solomon-a' dingin Pasian' biakinn a bawl nasep a zawhte:
Khuampi nihte, kuang-ukte, leh a khuampite lu dawnah a om khuamluzepna nihte, khuampite lu dawnah a om khuamluzepna, kuang-uk nihte a tuam dingin ngen bangin a kibawl nihte,
khuampite tungah a om khuamluzepna kuang-uk nihte a tuam dingin ngen banga kibawl khat-a' dingin mang kawlsing gual nih ahi ngen banga kibawl nihte-a' dingin mang kawlsing za lite,
tuikuang a kingaknate leh tuate tungah a kikoih tuikuangte,
tuikuangpi khat, leh tua nuai-a a om bawngtal sawmlenihte,
{ Topa' } biakinn dingin Kumpi Solomon-a' dingin siapa Huram in a kihal sumngo tawh a bawl beelte, kawbiate, sikkeukate, leh hihte-a' dingin nazat khempeuh ahi hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Solomon in Pasian' biakinn sunga na khempeuh a bawl sakte: Kham biakna tau, Ompihna Anlum-a' dingin sabuaite,
kham hoih pen tawh a kibawl a pakte, a meivakte, leh a tehte;
kham citak tawh a kibawl a taitehte, kuangte, paknamtui-a' dingin pakante, leh vutluahna ahi hi. Siangtho pen mun paina ding kongkhak sungnungte-a' ding leh biakinnpi sung kongkhakte-a' dingin biakinn kongkhak bilte zong kham tawh a kibawl ahi hi.
Tua bangin { Topa' } biakinn ding a hih nasep khempeuh kizo hi. Tua ciangin a pa David in a apsa nate Solomon in paipihin, Pasian' biakinn sung vanmanpha koihnate sungah a ngunte, a khamte, leh umlebeel khempeuh a seng hi.
Tua ciangin Zion a kici David khuapi sung panin { Topa' } Thuciamna Singkuang a paipihto dingin Kumpi Solomon in Israel upate, minam lutang khempeuh, leh Israel beh makaite, Jerusalem-ah kaikhawm hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Thuciamna Singkuang, leh kikhopna buk, leh puanbuk sunga om a siangtho umlebeel khempeuh puato uh a, siampite leh Levi mite in tuate puato uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Solomon leh ama mai-ah a kikhawm Israel-te khempeuh Thuciamna Singkuang mai-ah om uh a, biakna-in tuu leh bawngtal tampi tak pia uh ahih manin a phazah kisim zolo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin siampite in kherub-te' kha nuai, siangtho pen mun sung, biakinn sungnung sung ama munah { Topa' } Thuciamna Singkuang a paipih uh hi.
Kherub-te in Thuciamna Singkuang tungah a khate uh zak uh ahih manin kherub-te pen Thuciamna Singkuang leh a zawlte tungah khuhna khat a suak uh hi.
A zawlte sau ahih manin siangtho mun panin biakinn sungnung mai-ah a mongte kidawk a, ahih hangin a pualam panin kimu theilo hi; tuni dongin tua lai-ah tuate om hi.
Egypt panin amaute hong paikhiat lai-in { Topa } in Israel mite tawh thuciamna a bawlna mun Horeb-ah Moses in suangpeek nihte a koih simloh Thuciamna Singkuang sungah bangmah dang omlo hi.
Siangtho mun panin siampite hong pusuakin (bang hang hiam cih leh amau' pawlte cihtuam omloin tua lai-a om siampite khempeuh amau mahmah kisian'suah uh hi.
Tua ciangin Levi mi lasate Asaf, Heman, leh Jeduthun, amau' tapate leh a behte, saihadial puan tawh kizemin, daltuahte, harp lasaknate, leh laia lasaknate tawi-in peengkul tum siampite za leh sawmnih tawh biakna tau nisuahna lamah ding khawm uh hi.
Aw kikhatin phatin { Topa' } tungah lungdam koh ding pen peengkul tumte leh lasate' nasep ahi hi) peengkulte leh daltuahte leh adang lasaknate tawh, "{ Topa' } tungah lungdam koh ding hoih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ama itna kip tawntung hi," ci-in { Topa } phatna-in la a kisak ciangin, { Topa' } biakinn sung meii tawh kidim a,
meii hangin siampite in na sem zolo uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa' } minthan'na vangtaang Pasian' biakinn sung a dim hi.

Ahih hangin tu-in ka min a om theihna dingin Jerusalem teelin ka mi Israel-te tungah a uk dingin David ka teel khinta hi,' ci-in genin, ka pa David tungah a kam tawh a thuciamna a khut tawh a tungsak Israel Pasian, { Topa } in thupha ngah ta hen.

Ahih hangin { Topa } in ka pa David tungah, 'Na lungsimah keima min dingin biakinn khat lam ding na ngaihsun a, tua na ngaihsutna hoih mahmah hi.
Ahi zongin keima min dingin tua biakinn a lam dingpa nangmah hiloin, nangma sung pan hong piang ding na tapa hizaw ding hi,' ci hi.
"Tu-in { Topa } in a bawlsa thuciamna tungsak khin hi; bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa' } thuciam bangin ka pa David munah hong khangin Israel kumpi tokhomah kong tu a, Israel Pasian, { Topa' } min dingin biakinn ka lam khin hi.

Tua ciangin Israel a kikhawmte khempeuh' omna { Topa' } biakna tau mai-ah Solomon dingin a khut zan hi.
Solomon in a dung pi sagih leh alang, a vai pi sagih leh alang, a sang pi li leh alang a pha sumngo tau khat bawlin inntualah a koih khin hi. Tua ciangin tua tungah amah ding hi. Tua ciangin Israel a kikhawmte khempeuh' muhin amah khukdin'in van lamah a khut zan hi.
Tua ciangin Solomon in thu ngen a, "Israel Pasian, { Topa } aw, vantungah ahi a, leitungah ahi zongin thuciamna lenin a lungsim khempeuh uh tawh nangma thu hong mang na nasemte tungah itna kip a lak, nang tawh a kibang Pasian dang omlo hi.
Ama tungah na gensa bangin na nasem ka pa David tungah a tungsakpa na hi hi. Na kam tawh thu na gen a, na khut tawh tuni-in na tungsak takpi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in Israel Pasian, { Topa } aw, ama tungah thu ciamin, 'Keima thu na hong man' bangin na suan na khakte in ka thukham zui-in a gamtatna uhah a kidop nak uh leh Israel kumpi tokhom tungah a tu dingin keima mai-ah mi khat beek na kitasam kei ding hi,' na cihsa bangin na nasem ka pa David tawh na thuciamsa kipsak in.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in Israel Pasian, { Topa } aw, na nasempa David tungah na gensa na kammal kipsak in.
"Ahih hangin Pasian pen mite tawh leitungah hong teng takpi ding ahi hiam? En in, vantung leh a sangpen vantung in nang hong huam zolo hi; hih keima lamsa biakinn in hong huam zolo zaw kan ding!
Ahi zongin na nasempa' thungetna leh hong thumna don in, { Topa } ka Pasian aw, na nasempa na mai-ah hong kikona leh a hong nget thungetna hong ngai in.
Na nasempa in hih mun lamah hong thungetna na zak theihna dingin nangmah in na min koihna dingin na ciamsa mun hih biakinn lam sun leh zanin hong en in.
Amaute in hih mun lam nga-in thu hong nget uh ciangin na nasempa leh na mi Israel-te' hong thumnate nangmah in ngai in. Na ten'na mun vantung panin hong za takpi in la, na zak ciangin hong maisak in.
"Mi khat a vengte tungah khialin kiciamna kiciamsak a, hong pai-in hih biakinn sung na biakna tau mai-ah a kiciamna hong kiciam leh,
vantung panin za-in gamta in la, na nasemte thu khenin, a mawh mi a gamtatna ama lu tung mahah tusakin thuk in la, a thuman mi a thumanna tawh kizui-in thaman piakna tawh langsak in.
vantung panin nangmah in za in la, na mi Israel-te' khialhna maisakin amaute leh a pu a pate uh tungah na piak leitangah amaute paipih kik in.
"Amaute nangma tungah hong khialhna hangin vantung kikhak cipin guah a zukloh hun, amaute na gimsak hun ciangin, amaute in hih mun lam nga-in thu ngen a, na min hong phawkin amau' khialhna panin a kihei uh leh,
amaute a paina ding lampi hoih hilh in la, vantung panin za-in na nasem, na mi Israel-te' khialhna maisak in. Tua ciangin na mite tungah gamh-in na piak leitang tungah guah zusak in.
"Gam sungah kialpi tungin, pulnatna ahi a, ankung natna ahi a, ankung zawngkhalna ahi a, kauphe ahi a, lung ahi zongin a om a, amau' khuapi khat peuhpeuhah a galte un umcihin, bangbang gimna, bangbang natna hita leh,
mi khatpeuh ahi a, na mi Israel-te khempeuh in ahi zongin amau' natna leh a dahna ciat uh thei-in hih biakinn lamah a khut uh hong zanin bangbang thungetna hita leh bangbang thumna hita leh hong bawl uh leh,
na ten'na mun vantung panin za in la, maisakin, amau' gamtatna khempeuh tawh kizui-in a lungsim uh na theih bangin amaute tungah pia ciat in (bang hang hiam cih leh nang, nang bek in mihing' lungsim na thei hi).
Tua hi leh ka pu ka pate uh tungah na piak leitang tungah a nuntak hun sung khempeuh uh amaute in nang hong zahtakin nangma thu hong zui ding uh hi.
"Tua mah bangin na mi Israel a hilo gamdang mi khat a lian nangma min hang, leh nangma thahatna hangin a gamlapi gam panin hong pai-in, hih biakinn lam nga-in thu hong nget leh
na ten'na mun vantung panin za in la, gamdang mipa in na tungah hong ngetna khempeuh tawh kizui-in hih in. Tua hi leh nangma mi Israel-te mah bangin leitung mi khempeuh in na min thei-in nang hong zahtak ding uh a, keima lamsa hih biakinn pen nangma min tawh a kilo ahihna thei ding uh hi.
"A galte uh a do dingin na mite kuankhia-in, bangbang lamah amaute sawl hita lecin, nangmah in na teelsa hih khuapi, nangma tung leh nangma min dingin ka lamsa hih biakinn lam nga-in amaute in thu hong nget uh leh,
amau' hong thungetna leh hong thumnate vantung panin za-in amau' vai huh in.
"Amaute nang tungah hong khialin (a khiallo kua om ahi hiam?) amaute tungah nang heh a, galte tungah amaute pia-in, amaute a gamla gam ahi a, a nai-ah ahi zongin galmatin kipuakhia a,
amaute galmatin a kitutna, galmatin a omna uh leitangah a ngaihsutna khempeuh uh leh a lungsim khempeuh uh tawh amaute kisikkikin, na teelsa khuapi leh nangma min dingin ka lamsa biakinn, nangmah in amau' pute pate tungah na piak amau' leitang lam nga-in thu hong nget uh leh,
na ten'na vantung panin amau' thungetna leh hong thumnate za in la, amau' vai huhin nang tungah hong khial na mite maisak in.

keima minin a kisam ka mite amau mahmah kiniamkhiatin, thu ngenin ka mai hong zong a, amau' gitlohnate panin a kihei uh leh, keimah in vantung panin ka za ding a, amaute' khialhna maisakin a leitang uh ka hoihsak kik ding hi.
Nang-a' dingin ahih leh, na pa David a gamtat bangin keima mai-ah na gamtat a, nang kong sawl khempeuh bangin semin, ka thukhamte leh ka biakna ngeina kipte na zuih leh,
Ahih hangin note kihei-in, na mai uhah ka koihsa ka thukhamte leh ka thupiaknate nusia a, pai-in pasian dangte' na semin tuate na biak uh leh,
note' tungah kong piaksa leitang panin note kong botkhia ding hi. Tua ciangin ka min dingin ka apsa hih biakinn ka muhna panin ka lawnkhia ding a, mi khempeuh lakah paunak leh gentehna ka suaksak ding hi.

Tua ahih ciangin { Topa } in Khaldea mite' kumpipa amaute' langkhatah paipih a, tua kumpipa in amau' Pasian' biakinn sung nangawnah namsau tawh a tangvalte uh that a, numei pasal, a moi a ham, a dam a na, kuamah khasiat lo hi. Pasian in a vekpi-in ama khutsungah a pia hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa' } biakinn-a umlebeel khempeuh a lian a neu, leh { Topa' } biakinn-a vanmanphate, leh kumpipa leh a uliante' vanmanphate khempeuh amah in Babylon-ah paipih hi.
Amah in namsau panin a suakta mite Babylon-ah salin la a, Persia kumpi in a uk hun mateng amah leh a suanlekhakte' nasem a suak uh hi.
Tua sungin Israel leitang in a sabbath-te a kicingin na tang hi. Kamsang Jeremiah tung tawnin { Topa' } thugen a tun'na dingin kum sawmsagih a cin'na dingin leitang a kinusiat sung khempeuh leitang in sabbath tawlngakna a nei ahi hi.
Tu-in Persia kumpipa Sairas' kum khatna kumin, Jeremiah' kam pana { Topa' } thugen a tun' theihna dingin, { Topa } in Persia kumpipa Sairas' lungsim hanthawn a, amah in a kumpi gamsung khempeuhah taangkona khat bawl a, lai-in zong a gelh hi. A lai gelhna-ah,
"Persia kumpipa Sairas in hih bangin ci hi: 'Vantung Pasian, { Topa } in leitung kumpi gam khempeuh kei hong pia khin a, Judah gamsung Jerusalem khua-ah ama-a' dingin biakinn khat ka lamsak ding hong sawl hi. Note lakah ama mi ahi khempeuh, { Topa } a Pasian uh in ompih ta hen. Biakinn lam dingin Jerusalem-ah amaute paito sak un,' ci hi," a ci hi.
Persia kumpi Sairas' uk kum khatna kumin, Jeremiah tung tawnin { Topa' } thugen a tun' theihna dingin, ama gamsung khempeuhah taangkona khat bawlin lai-in zong a gelhna dingin Persia kumpi Sairas' lungsimah { Topa } in a suaksak hi. Amah in hih bangin a hih hi:
"Persia kumpi Sairas in hih bangin ci hi: Vantung Pasian, { Topa } in leitung kumpi gam khempeuh keima tungah hong pia khin a, Judah gamsung Jerusalem khua-ah ama-a' dingin biakinn khat ka lamsak ding hong sawl hi.
Note lakah ama mi peuhmah a Pasian in ompih hen la, Judah gamsung Jerusalem khua-ah paito hen la, Israel Pasian, { Topa' } biakinn lamkik hen. Amah pen Jerusalem-ah a om Pasian ahi hi.
Tua ciangin koilai mun koilai gama om hita leh Judah mi a omlai khempeuh, ama omna mun mite in Jerusalem-a om Pasian' biakinn-a dingin utthu-a a piakte uh banah, ngun leh kham, nate leh ganhingte tawh zong huh ciat uh hen," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Judah leh Benjamin sunga innkuan lutangte, leh siampite leh Levi mite, Jerusalem khua-a om { Topa' } biakinn a lamkik dingin a lungsim sung uhah Pasian in a suahsak mite khempeuh kithawi uh hi.
Tua ciangin a veng a pamte in thatang tawh a huh uh banah ngun tawh kibawl umlebeel, kham, van tuamtuamte, ganhingte, leh letsong manphate tawh huh thuah lai uh hi.
Tua thamloin, Nebukhadnezzar in Jerusalem panin puakhia-in ama pasian-te' biakinn sungah a koihsa ahi { Topa' } biakinn-a om ngei umlebeelte zong kumpipa Sairas in pusuah hi.
Persia kumpi Sairas in hihte pusuahin sumkempa Mithredath' khutsungah ap hi. Tuapa in Judah ukpa Sheshbazzar-a' dingin a malzah simin sazian bawlsak hi.
Tua nate a phazah: Kham kuang tul khat, ngun kuang tul khat, umlebeel a nam tuamtuam sawmnihlekua,
kham kuang-uk sawmthum, ngun kuang-uk a nam tuamtuam za li sawm khat, leh umlebeel adang tul khat ahi hi.
Kham leh ngun kibawl umlebeelte khempeuh a vekpi-in tul nga za li sawmgukkua pha hi. Tua hi a, Babylon panin salte a kiciahpih kik ciangin Sheshbazzar in tua nate khempeuh Jerusalem-ah a ciahpih hi.
Babylon kumpi Nebukhadnezzar in a zawhna gam panin Babylon-ah salin a lakte sung panin hih mite Jerusalem leh Judah-ah a ciahkikte hi a, amau' khua ciatah a ciah uh ahi hi.
Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, leh Baanah-te makai-in tua mite a ciahpih uh hi. Israel mi phazahte:
Parosh suante — tul nih za khat sawmsagihlenih ahi hi.
Shefatiah suante — za thum sawmsagihlenih ahi hi.
Arah suante — za sagih sawmsagihlenga ahi hi.
Pahathmoab beh sung panin Jeshua leh Joab suante — tul nih za giat sawmlenih ahi hi.
Elam suante — tul khat za nih sawmngaleli ahi hi.
Zattu suante — za kua sawmlilenga ahi hi.
Zakkai suante — za sagih sawmguk ahi hi.
Bani suante — za guk sawmlilenih ahi hi.
Bebai suante — za guk sawmnihlethum ahi hi.
Azgad suante — tul khat za nih sawmnihlenih ahi hi.
Adonikam suante — za guk sawmgukleguk ahi hi.
Bigvai suante — tul nih sawmngaleguk ahi hi.
Adin suante — za li sawmngaleli ahi hi.
Ater a kici Hezekiah suante — sawmkualegiat ahi hi.
Bezai suante — za thum sawmnihlethum ahi hi.
Jorah suante — za khat sawmnihlenih ahi hi.
Hashum suante — za nih sawmnihlethum ahi hi.
Gibbar suante — sawmkualenga ahi hi.
Bethlehem khuami — za khat sawmnihlethum ahi hi.
Netofah khuami — sawmngaleguk ahi hi.
Anathoth khuami — za khat sawmnihlegiat ahi hi.
Bethazmaveth khuami — sawmlilenih ahi hi.
Kiriathjearim khua, Khefirah khua, leh Beeroth khuami — za sagih sawmlilethum ahi hi.
Ramah khua leh Geba khuami — za guk sawmnihlekhat ahi hi.
Mikmash khuami — za khat sawmnihlenih ahi hi.
Bethel khua leh Ai khuami — za nih sawmnihlethum ahi hi.
Nebo khuami — sawmngalenih ahi hi.
Magbish khuami — za khat sawmngaleguk ahi hi.
Elam adang khat suante — tul khat za nih sawmngaleli ahi hi.

Lod khua, Hadid khua, leh Ono khuami — za sagih sawmnihlenga ahi hi.

Senaah gammi — tul thum za guk sawmthum ahi uh hi.
Siampite sung panin: Jeshua-te beh panin Jedaiah suante — za kua sawmsagihlethum ahi hi.
Immer suante — tul khat sawmngalenih ahi hi.
Pashhur suante — tul khat za nih sawmlilesagih ahi hi.
Harim suante — tul khat sawmlesagih ahi uh hi.
Levi mite sung panin: Hodaviah-te beh panin Jeshua suante leh Kadmiel suante — sawmsagihleli ahi hi.
Lasate sung panin Asaf' suante — za khat sawmnihlegiat ahi hi.
Kongcingte nam sung panin Shallum suante, Ater suante, Talmon suante, Akkub suante, Hatita suante, leh Shobai suante, a vekpi-in — za khat sawmthumlekua ahi hi.
Shefatiah suante, Hattil suante, Pokherethhazzebaim suante, leh Ami suante ahi uh hi.
Biakinn nasemte khempeuh leh Solomon' nasemte' suanlekhak khempeuh a vekpi-in za thum sawmkualenih a pha uh hi.
Temelah, Teharsha, Kherub, Addan, leh Immer khuate panin a hong ciahkik, Israel mi hinapi-in amau' behlephung a kan theilo mite:
Delaiah suante, Tobiah suante, leh Nekoda suante, mi za guk sawmngalenih ahi uh hi.
Siampite sung panin zong: Habaiah suante, Hakkoz suante, leh Barzilai suante (amah in Gilead mi Barzillai tanute khat ten'pihin tua min tawh a kilo pah) ahi uh hi.
Hih mite in khang kiciamtehna-ah amau' min a zon' uh hangin amau' min na omlo ahih manin amaute a siangloin seh uh a, siampi nasep semsak theilo uh hi.
Urim leh Thummim aisanna tawh ai a san ding siampi khat a om mateng amaute in biakna an siangpente a neklohna ding uh gam ukpa in a gen hi.
Mi a vekpi — tul sawmli leh tul nih leh za thum sawmguk pha uh a,
amaute' nasem numei leh pasal mihing — tul sagih leh za thum sawmthumlesagihte kisimlo hi. Amaute in lasa numei leh pasal mihing za nih nei uh hi.
Amau' sakolte — za sagih sawmthumleguk, amau' la-sakol — za nih sawmlilenga,
amau' kalaoh — za li sawmthumlenga, leh a la uh — tul guk za sagih leh sawmnih pha hi.
Amaute Jerusalem-a { Topa' } biakinn a tun' uh ciangin Pasian' biakinn ama mun ngei-ah lamkikna dingin innkuan lutangte pawlkhat in Pasian' biakinn-a dingin piakna bawl uh hi.
Amaute in a hih zawhna zah uh tawh kizui-in tua nasepna dingin vanmanpha koihna-ah kham darik tul sawmguk leh tul khat, ngun mina tul nga, leh siampipuan za khat a pia uh hi.
Siampite, Levi mite, leh mi pawlkhatte Jerusalem leh a kiim nai-ah teng uh hi. Lasate, kongcingte, biakinn nasemte, leh Israel mi khempeuh amau' khuapi ciatah a teng uh hi.
A kha sagihna hong cin' ciangin Israel mite amau' khuapi ciatah teng khin uh ahih manin, khekhat khai bangin Jerusalem-ah hong kituah diam uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jozadak' tapa Jeshua leh a siampipihte, leh Shealtiel' tapa Zerubbabel leh a behte hong kipan uh a, Pasian' mi Moses thukham sungah a kigelh bangin meihal biaknate piakna dingin Israel Pasian biakna tau a bawl uh hi.
Amaute in tua gama midang tengte kihta uh ahih manin a mun lui mahah biakna tau phut pahin zing leh nitak simin { Topa' } tungah meihal biakna a pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin hihte banah a tawntunga meihal biakna, Khadet sima biakna, leh { Topa' } pawi a kisehsa hun khempeuh leh { Topa' } tungah amau' utthu tawh a pia mite khempeuh' biaknate zong a pia uh hi.
{ Topa' } biakinnpi a bul a kiphuh nailoh hangin a kha sagihna a ni masa ni-a kipanin amaute in { Topa' } tungah meihal biaknate piak ding kipan uh hi.
Tua hi a, amaute in suangseekte leh khutsiamte tungah sum pia uh a, Persia kumpi Sairas' tung panin a thu ngahna bangun Lebanon mualtung gam panin tuipi gei Joppa khua-ah taamtak singte a hong puaksuk ding Sidon khuamite leh Taia khuamite tungah zong annek tuidawn leh sathau a pia uh hi.
Amaute, Jerusalem khua-a Pasian' biakinn-ah a hong ciahkik uh a kum nihna, tua kum a kha nihna sungin Shealtiel' tapa Zerubbabel leh Jozadak' tapa Jeshua, nasep kipan uh a, a Israel mipihte, siampite, Levi mite, leh salsuahna panin Jerusalem-ah a hong ciahkik mite khempeuh in zong a huh uh hi. Amaute in Levi mite kum sawmnih panin a tungsiah peuhmah { Topa' } biakinn sungah biakna nasepte a vaan dingin a seh uh hi.
Jeshua a tapate leh a behte tawh, leh Hodaviah-te beh Kadmiel leh a tate in Henadad' tapate leh Levi mi a tapate uh leh a behte uh tawh Pasian' biakinn-ah nasemte tungah ukna tavuan a lakhawm uh hi.
Innlamte in { Topa' } biakinn a bul a phuh uh ciangin, Israel kumpipa David in a geelkholhsa bangin { Topa } a phat dingin siampite in a puan uh silhin peengkul tawh, Asaf' tapa Levi mite daltuah tawh a pan'mun ding uhah hong pang uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in { Topa } phatna leh lungdam kohna a kidawngin sa uh a, "{ Topa } hoih hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Israel-te hong itna kip tawntung hi," a ci uh hi. { Topa' } biakinn bulpi kiphut khin ahih manin mi khempeuh in nakpi takin { Topa } phat uh hi.
Midang tampi lungdamin a aw neih zahun a kiko uh hangin a biakinn masa a mu ngeisa siampite, Levi mite, leh innkuan lutang, midang tampite in hih biakinn bulpi a kiphuh a muh uh ciangin kapin a thum uh hi.
Mite nakpi takin kiko ahih manin lungdamna awging, leh kahna leh thumna awgingte mite in khen theilo uh hi. Gamlapi pek panin tua awgingte a kiza hi.
Salsuahna panin a hong ciahkik mite in Israel Pasian { Topa}-a' dingin biakinn khat a lamna thu Judah leh Benjamin mite' galte in a zak uh ciangin
Zerubbabel, Jeshua, leh innkuan lutangte kiangah va pai-in amaute kiangah, "Biakinn lamna-ah ko zong hong kihelsak un; bang hang hiam cih leh note mah bangin ko zong na Pasian uh ka bia uh a, hih lai-ah kote hong koih Assiria kumpipa Esarhaddon' hun lai-a kipanin note' Pasian' tungah biakna ka pia uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin Zerubbabel leh Israel sunga innkuan lutang a omlaite in amaute kiangah, "Kote' Pasian-a' dingin ka lam uh biakinn pen note' hong lunghihmawhpih ding hilo hi. Persia kumpipa Sairas in kote hong thupiaksa bangin Israel Pasian, { Topa}-a' dingin ko teng guak mah in ka lam ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua gama teng midangte in Judah mite lungkiasakin biakinn a lam zomlai ding uh a lausak uh hi.
Amau' ngimna a tangtun' theihlohna dingin amaute in a langpang dingin zum nasemte golhguk pia uh hi. Persia kumpipa Sairas' huna kipan kumpi Darias hun dong hih bangin hih ngitnget uh hi.
Ahasueras in uk ding hong kipat ciangin Judah gam leh Jerusalem-a a tengte a khiatna thu tua gamah a na tengsate in lai-in a gelh uh hi.
Tua ciangin Persia kumpi Artakzaksis hun ciangin Mithredath, Tabeel, leh a lawmte uh thukimna tawh kumpipa tungah lai gelh uh a, a lai pen Aram lai-in kigelh a, Aram pau mahin kisimkhia hi.
Menzipipa Rehum leh lai-atpa Shimshai in Kumpi Artakzaksis tungah Jerusalem tawh kisai thu a nuai-a bangin gelh uh hi.
Menzipipa Rehum, lai-at Shimshai, leh a lawmte khempeuh, thukhente, mangpite, thuvaante, uliante, Erek khuami leh Babylon khuami, Susa khua-a om Elam mite,
leh a lian a minthang Ashurbanipal in hong puakhia-in Samaria khuapi-ah a hong ten'sak mite leh Eufratis Gun langkhat a kizawhna gamsunga a om mite tung panin lai puak, a ci uh hi.
A lai sung thu hih a nuai-a bang ahi hi: "Artakzaksis Kumpipa tungah, Eufratis Gungal gama om na nasemte in hopihna kam kong puak uh hi.
"Nangma kiang panin ko kiang-ah a hong pai Judah mite, tu-in Jerusalem-ah tung khin uh a, a gilo, mi lehdo thei ahi khuapi pen amaute in lamkikin, amaute in a khua bulpi vel khinin, kulhpi cian' a kipat khitna thu thei in.
Amau' khuapi kilam kikin kulhte kizo leh amaute in siah ahi a, mangmu ahi a, losap ahi zongin hong pia nawnlo ding uh a, a tawpna-ah kumpi hong sukkhak ding thu thei in.
Kote in kumpipa tawh thuciamna kip nei khin ka hih manun kumpipa' minsiatna ka muh ding uh kilawmlo hi. Tua ahih manin nangma mai-a a semte' thuciamtehna laibute a ki-etkik theihna dingin kumpipa tungah thu kong zasak uh hi. Thuciamtehna laibu sung en lecin hih khuapi pen a lehdo thei khuapi, kumpipa tung leh a ukna gamte tungah siatna a piangsak, kumpi dona a khuasungah a om tawntungna thu na mukhia ding hi. Hih khuapi a kisukcipna zong hih thu hang mah ahi hi.
Hih khuapi kilam kikin a kulhte kizo khin leh Eufratis Gungal gam na uk nawnlohna ding thu, nangma tungah kong theikholsak uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in a lai uh hih bangin thuk hi: "Menzipipa Rehum, lai-atpa Shimshai, leh Samaria leh Eufratis Gungal gamsunga om na lawmte khempeuh uh tungah hopihna lai kong khak hi.
Keimah in hih thu a kikanna ding thu ka pia a, tu-in kikantel khinta hi. Tanglai-a kipanin hih khuapi pen kumpi langah pangin, hih khuasungah lehdona leh kumpi dona a om ngitngetna thu kimukhia hi.
A vanglian kumpite in Jerusalem-ah uk ngei-in, Eufratis Gungal gambup tungah aana zang uh a, siah, mangmu, leh losapte tua kumpite tungah kipia hi.
Hih thu tawh kisai-in na sep ding donloin ommawk kei in. Tua hi kei leh kumpi tungah siatna leh gimna hong khang ding hi," a ci hi.
Menzipipa Rehum, lai-at Shimshai, leh amau' lawmte' zakna-ah Kumpi Artakzaksis tung panin a kingah lai a kisim ciangin, Jerusalem-ah amaute pai pahin Judah mite a nasep uh aana tawh a khawlsak uh hi.
Tua huna kipanin Jerusalem-a om Pasian' biakinn a kisepna a khawl hi. Persia kumpi Darias' uk a kum nihna dong tua bangin a khawlcip phot hi.
Tu-in kamsangte Haggai leh Iddo' suan Zekhariah in Judah gam leh Jerusalem-ah a om Judah mite hanthawnin, Israel Pasian' min tawh thu a gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin Shealtiel' tapa Zerubbabel leh Jozadak' tapa Jeshua, Jerusalem-a Pasian' biakinn lamkik ding kipan pah uh a, Pasian' kamsangte in amaute ompihin huh uh hi.
Tua laitakin Eufratis Gungal gamsung teng a uk sawn Tattenai, Shetharbozenai, leh amau' lawmte hong paipahin amaute kiangah, "Note in hih biakinn lamkikin a nate na bawlna ding uh kua in thu hong pia ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Eufratis Gungal gam a uk sawn Tattenai, Shetharbozenai, leh Eufratis Gungal gamsung thu a vaan ama lawmte in Kumpi Darias tungah lai khak uh hi.
"Hih biakinn a kilamkikna ding leh a nate a zawhna dingin kua in thu pia hiam, cih thu hih upate tungah ka dong uh hi.
Nangmah in a makai teng na theihna dingin amaute' min zong ka dong uh hi.
"Amaute in hih bangin hong dawng uh hi: 'Kote pen vantung leh leitung Pasian' nasemte ka hi uh a, kum tampi lai-in a kilamsa biakinn a lamkik ka hi uh a, a lian Israel kumpi khat in lamin a zawhsa ahi hi.
Ahi zongin ka pu ka pate un vantung Pasian hehsakkha uh ahih manin Babylon kumpipa, Khaldea mi Nebukhadnezzar' khutsungah amaute pia hi. Tua kumpipa in hih biakinn susia a, a mite Babylon-ah ciahpih hi.
Tua thamloin Jerusalem-a biakinn sung panin Nebukhadnezzar in la-in Babylon biakinn sunga a koih ahi Pasian' biakinn sunga om ngeisa kham leh ngun kibawl umlebeelte zong kumpi Sairas in Babylon biakinn panin lakhia-in gam ukin a hong koih Sheshbazzar min neipa tungah ap hi.
Kumpipa in ama tungah, "Hih umlebeelte paipih in la, Jerusalem-a biakinn-ah va koihkik in. Tua lai-a Pasian' biakinn pen a mun ngei mahah lamkik sak in," ci hi.
Tua ciangin Sheshbazzar hong pai-in Jerusalem-a Pasian' biakinn a bulpi hong phut hi. Tua huna kipanin tudong lamkik kisem suak a, ahi zongin kizo nailo hi,' ci uh hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin hoih na sak leh, Jerusalem-a hih Pasian' biakinn a kilamkikna ding thu kumpipa Sairas in thu pia takpi hiam, pia taktak lo hiam cih a kitheihna dingin Babylon khua sunga om laibu koihna innte sung zongsak in. Tua khit ciangin kumpipa in na deihna hong zasak kik in," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Darias in thu pia a, Babylon khua sunga lai manphate a kisen'na innte sung kizong hi.
Ahi zongin Babylon khua sungah na omlo a, Media gamsung kumpi khuapi Ekbatana-ah laizial khat kimu a, tua sungah hih a nuai-a bangin a kiciamteh kimu hi:
"Kumpi Sairas' kum khatna kumin Jerusalem khua-a Pasian' biakinn tawh kisai-in kumpipa in thu pia hi: Biakna kipia-in meihal biakna a kipaipihna munah biakinn lamsak kik un. A san'na pi sawmkua, a vai pi sawmkua mah hi ding a,
a kawm pen suang thuap thum leh sing thuap khat tawh a kibawl, thuap li hi ding hi. Hih sum beinate ahih leh kumpi sum panin kipia ding hi.
Nebukhadnezzar in Jerusalem biakinn panin lakhia-in Babylon-ah a hong tun'pih Pasian' biakinn sunga om kham leh ngun tawh kibawl umlebeelte zong kipiakik ding hi. Tuate khempeuh Jerusalem biakinn-ah kipuakik ding a, Pasian' biakinn sunga a omna mun mun ciatah kikoihkik ding hi," ci-in kigelh hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Darias in hih bangin thu a pia hi: "Tu-in Eufratis Gungal gam a uk Tattenai, Shetharbozenai, leh Eufratis Gungal gamsung a vaan na lawmte, tua mun panin na kihemkhia ding uh hi.
Judah mi a ukpa leh a upate in hih Pasian' biakinn a lamkik theihna dingun na tuaci omsak ding uh hi. Ama mun ngei mahah a biakinn lamsak kik un.
Hih a kigen Pasian' biakinn a kilamkik theihna dingin hih Judah upate-a' dingin na hih dingte uh zong thu kong pia hi. Hih nasepna a mawk khawllohna dingin, Eufratis Gungal gamsung panin a kingah siahte ahi kumpi sum sung panin beina khempeuh a cingin kipia ding hi.
Vantung Pasian' tungah meihal biakna-in piak dingin a kisam khempeuh — bawngtalnote, tuutalte, ahih kei leh tuunote na pia ding uh a, Jerusalem-a siampite' hong ngetna bangin mangbuh, ci, leenggahzu, ahih kei leh sathaute, kitasam loin nisimin amaute tungah piasak un.
Tua hi leh amaute in vantung Pasian' tungah a namtui biaknate pia-in kumpipa leh a tapate' nuntakna ding thu hong ngetsak thei ding uh hi.
Tua thamloin, mi khatpeuh in hih thupiakna a siatsak leh ama inn panin a innkam khat kidawhkhiat sakin tua tungah amah kihen cipin kisatgawp ding a, tua banah a inn zong a kisuksiatna ding thu kong pia thuah lai hi.
Hih ka thupiakna a siasak nuam, Jerusalem-a Pasian' biakinn a susia nuam kumpi khatpeuh ahi a, mi khatpeuh ahi zongin a om leh, ama min omna dinga tua mun a bawl Pasian in tua mipa lawnthal ta hen. Keimah Darias in thu kong pia hi. Ka thupiak bang teekteekin sep ding ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Darias in amaute tungah a thupiak bang teekteekin Eufratis Gungal gamsung a uksawn Tattenai, Shetharbozenai, leh a lawmte in sem uh hi.
Tua hi a, kamsang Haggai leh Iddo' suan Zekhariah' thugenna hangin Judah upate in a biakinn lam uh zom suakin mavang uh hi. Israel Pasian' sawlna leh Persia kumpi Sairas leh Darias leh Artakzaksis-te' thupiakna tawh amaute in a biakinn lam uh a zo uh hi.
Tua hi a, Kumpi Darias' kum gukna, Adar kha a ni sawmlethum ni-in a biakinn kizo hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite, siampite, Levi mite, leh sal a suaksa a hong ciahkik mi khempeuh in lungdamna lianpi tawh Pasian' biakinn apna a bawl uh hi.
Amaute in Pasian' biakinn apna-in bawngtal za khat, tuutal za nih, leh tuuno za li go uh a, mawhna hanga biakna dingin Israel-te khempeuh-a' dingin a minam phazah tawh kizui-in keeltal sawmlenih a pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin Moses laibu sungah a kigelh bangin Jerusalem-a Pasian' nasepna dingin siampite amau' pan'mun ngei-ah pangsak uh a, Levi mite amau' nasepna ngei-ah a semsak kik uh hi.
A kha masa a ni sawmleli ni-in sal a suaksa a hong ciahkik mite in Paisan Pawi a bawl uh hi.
Siampite leh Levi mite a vekpi-un kisian'suah khin uh a, a vekpi-un zehsiang khin uh hi. Tua hi a, amaute in sal suaksa a hong ciahkik khempeuh-a' ding, a siampipihte uh leh amau mahmah-a' dingin Paisan tuuno a go uh hi.
Salsuahna panin a hong ciahkik Israel-te leh Israel Pasian, { Topa } a bia dingin tua gama midang tengte leh a nitna uh pan amau leh amau a kihemkhia tawm mite khempeuh in tua Paisan Pawi an a ne uh hi.
Tua hi a, amaute in lungdamna tawh ni sagih sung silngo sawhloh anlum pawi a bawl uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau' lungdamna ding a om theihna dingin { Topa } in Assiria kumpipa' lungsim amau' tungah a nuam dingin a bawlsak hi. Tua ahih manin Israel Pasian ahi Pasian' biakinn a sepna uhah kumpipa in amaute a huh hi.

hih Ezra pen Babylon panin hong tungto hi. Amah pen Israel Pasian, { Topa } in a piak Moses thukham a siam laithei mi khat ahi hi. { Topa } ahi ama Pasian in ompih ahih manin ama nget khempeuh kumpipa in a pia hi.
Kumpi Artakzaksis in a uk a kum sagihna kumin Israel mite, siampite, Levi mite, lasate, kongcingte, leh biak-inn nasem pawlkhat zong, Jerusalem-ah Ezra tawh tungto uh hi.
Kumpipa' uk kum sagih a cin' kum, a kha ngana sungin Jerusalem tung uh hi.
A kha masa a ni khat ni-in Babylon pan a dingkhia dingin Ezra in a ni sehkhol a, a kha ngana a ni khat ni-in Jerusalem a tung uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in amah ompih hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Ezra in { Topa' } thukham sinin zuih ding, leh Israel mite a hilh dingin amah kipia hi.
Kumpi Artakzaksis in siampi ahi, laitheipa lah ahi, Israel-te-a' dingin { Topa' } thupiaknate leh thukhamte a siam Ezra tungah a piak lai pen hih bang ahi hi:
"Kumpite' kumpi ahi Artakzaksis kiang panin vantung Pasian' thukham a siam, siampi hi-in laitheipa lah ahi Ezra tungah:
"Ka lungsim khentatna hih bang ahi hi: Ka gamsunga om Israel mi khatpeuh ahi a, a siampite uh ahi a, Levi mite ahi zongin, Jerusalem-ah a ciahkik nuam khempeuh in nang hong zuih theihna dingun thu ka pia hi.
Nang tungah hong kipia ahi na Pasian' thukham tawh kisai-in Judah leh Jerusalem-ah thu bangci om hiam cih a va thei dingin kumpipa keimah leh thu hong lamlak mihing sagihte in kong sawl uh hi.
Kumpipa leh a thu lamlakte in Jerusalem-ah a teng Israel Pasian tungah lungkim takin a piak ngun leh khamte zong,
Babylon gamah na muh uh ngun leh khamte, leh Jerusalem-a note' Pasian' biakinn dingin mite leh siampite in lungkim takin a piak khiat zuazuate uh tawh a va puakkhawm ding na hi uh hi.
"Hih ka thupiakna tawh kizui-in hih sumte pen Jerusalem-a note' Pasian' biakinn-a biakna tau tungah piak dingin bawngtalte, tuutalte, tuunote, leh a an tawh biaknate, leh a leenggahzu tawh biakna dingte leina ding bekin na zang ding uh hi.
Tua banah ngun leh kham a val a omlai leh, note' Pasian' deihna tawh kituakin hoih na sak bangun na lawmte tawh na zang thei ding uh hi.
Na Pasian' biakinn-a dingin a kisam, na piak ding a phamawh a omkhak zenzen leh kumpipa sum sung panin na zang thei ding hi.
"Tua hi a, kumpipa keimah Artakzaksis in Eufratis Gungal gamsunga om kumpi vankemte khempeuh tungah hih bangin thu ka pia hi: Vantung Pasian' thukham a siam lai a thei, siampi Ezra in note tung panin a kisapna hong nget ciangin,
ngun talen za khat, mangbuh seu za khat, leenggahzu tambong za nih, sathau tambong za nih ciang, leh ci a deih zahzah na pia ding uh hi.
Vantung Pasian in a deih peuhpeuh, vantung Pasian biakinn-a dingin limtakin hih un. Tua hi kei leh kumpipa tapate leh kumpi gam tungah amah hong heh khading hi.
"Tua hi a, nang Ezra in nang tungah hong kipia na Pasian' pilna tawh kizui-in Eufratis Gungal gamsunga mite thu a khen dingin na Pasian' thukham a thei mite seh in. Nang leh amaute in na Pasian' thukham a theilote na hilh ding uh hi.
Na Pasian' thukham leh kumpipa' thukham a manglo peuhmah, sihna ahi a, hawlkhiatna ahi a, neihsa matna ahi a, thongkiatna ahi zongin, a ngah ding a kilawm thukhenna tawh khauhtakin gim kipia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Ezra in, "Jerusalem-a om { Topa' } biakinn tua bangin a minthangsak thuah dingin kumpipa lungsimah suak a, kumpipa leh a thu lamlakte leh a uliante kei tungah a thunuam dingin a bawl i pu i pate' Pasian ahi { Topa } in thupha ngah ta hen!" a ci hi. Tua hi a,{ Topa } ka Pasian in kei hong ompihna thei ka hih manin ka lungsim hong hang a, kei hong zui dingin Israel makaite ka khawm hi.
Zekhariah: Parosh-te beh sung pan hi a, amah tawh pasal za khat leh sawmnga kiciamteh hi.
Eliehoenai: Pahathmoab-te beh panin Zerahiah' tapa hi a, pasal za nih tawh ahi hi.
Shekaniah: Zattu-te beh panin Jahaziel' tapa hi a, pasal za thum tawh ahi hi.
Obadiah: Joab-te beh panin Jehiel' tapa hi a, pasal za nih leh sawmlegiat tawh ahi hi.
Shelomith: Bani-te beh panin Josifiah' tapa hi a, pasal za leh sawmguk tawh ahi hi.
Zekhariah: Bebai-te beh panin Bebai' tapa hi a, pasal sawmnihlegiat tawh ahi hi.
Johanan: Azgad-te beh panin Hakkatan' tapa hi a, pasal za leh sawm khat tawh ahi hi.
Elifelet, Jeiel, leh Shemaiah: A hong nungpai Adonikam-te beh zong hi uh a, pasal sawmguk tawh ahi uh hi.
Uthai leh Zabbud: Bigvai-te beh pan hi uh a, pasal sawmsagih tawh ahi uh hi.
