Tua ahih ciangin a lawmte lakah a makai, Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zekhariah, leh Meshullam-te, leh thu ngaihsut siam Joiarib leh Elnathan-te ka sam a,
Kasifia muna a makaipa Iddo kiangah va pai-in, tua lai-a biakinn nasem amah leh a behte in, eite' Pasian' biakinn-a na a sem ding mihing hong puak ding uh a ngen dingin ka sawl hi.
Tua hi a, hehpihna a nei eite' Pasian in hong ompih ahih manin Levi mi Mahli-te beh sung panin thu ngaihsutsiam mi ahi Sherebiah, a tapate leh a behte tawh pasal sawmlegiat,
leh Merari-te beh panin Isaiah, a behte leh amau' tapate mi sawmlenih leh Hashabiah tawh,
Levi mite' na a sem dingin David leh a uliante in a tuamkoih ahi biakinn nasem za nih leh sawmnih hong pia hi. Hih mite khempeuh amau' min ciat tawh a kisam ahi hi.
Tua ciangin eite' Pasian' mai-ah kote kiniamkhiat thei-in, kote leh ka naupangte uh leh ka neihsa khempeuh uh nuamtakin ka khualzinna uhah ka pai theihna ding uh Pasian' tung pan ka nget theihna dingun Ahava lui-ah an tan'na ding thu ka taangko hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh kumpipa kiangah, "Ka Pasian un amah a zong mite khempeuh ompihin amau-a' dingin a hoih na sem a, amah a nusiate khempeuh tungah amah heh hi," ci-in gen khin ka hih manun lampi-ah kote hong kha dingin galkapte leh sakol tung tuangte kumpipa kiangah ka nget ding ka mai a zum hi.
Tua hi a, kote in an ka tang uh hi. Nuamtakin khual ka zin theihna ding uh i Pasian' tungah ka ngen uh a, amah in ka thungetna uh hong pia hi.
Tua ciangin siampi liante sung panin mi sawmlenih — Sherebiah, Hashabiah, leh amau' behte mi sawm ka tuamkoih hi.
Tua ciangin i Pasian' biakinn nasepna dingin kumpipa leh a thu lamlakte leh a uliante leh tua lai-a a om Israel mi khempeuh in a tuam khen ciat uh ngun leh kham leh umlebeelte, amaute tungah ka ap hi.
Amaute tungah ka apte: Ngun talen za guk sawmnga, talen nih a gik ngun tawh a kibawl umlebeel za khat, kham talen za khat,
kham darik tul khat man tawh a kibawl kuang-uk sawmnih, leh kham zahin a manpha sumsan hoih tawh a kibawl beel nih ahi hi.
Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, "{ Topa } tungah note hong ki-ap hi. Umlebeelte zong biakna vante ahi hi. Ngun leh khamte ahih leh na pu na pate uh Pasian ahi { Topa } tungah citna tawh a kipia na ahi hi.
Siampi liante, Levi mite, leh Israel mi beh lutangte' muhin Jerusalem khua-ah { Topa' } biakinn dei sungah na puak dong mateng uh vilin kem un," ka ci hi.
Tua ahih manin siampite leh Levi mite in Jerusalem-a i Pasian' biakinn-ah puak dingin ngun, kham, leh umlebeelte a hong sang uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jerusalem a zuan dingin kha masa a ni sawmlenih ni-in Ahava lui panin ka dingkhia uh hi. I Pasian in kote hong ompih ahih manin lamkalah galte leh pan'simna a tuamtuamte tawh hong kipelhsak hi.
A ni li ni-in Uriah' tapa siampi Meremoth' tavuan lakna tawh i Pasian' biakinn sungah ngun, kham, leh umlebeelte kiseng hi. Finehas' tapa Eleazar in amah huh a, Levi mi Jeshua' tapa Jozabad leh Binnui' tapa Noadiah in amaute gel huh uh hi.
Vante a ki-ap ciangin limtakin kivel a, a ki-ap na khempeuh ciamtehna lai khat kibawl hi.
Tua ciangin salsuahna panin inn hong zuankik mite in Israel-te khempeuh-a' dingin Israel Pasian tungah meihal biakna-in bawngtal sawmlenih, tuutal sawmkualeguk, tuuno sawmsagihlenih, leh mawhna hanga biakna-in keeltal sawmlenih a pia uh hi. Hihte khempeuh pen { Topa' } tungah meihal biakna ahi hi.
Amaute in Eufratis Gungal gamsung tenga kumpipa' nuai-ah a uksawn a lian pente leh uliante tungah kumpipa' thupiaknate zong a va gen uh hi. Tua hi a, amaute in mite leh Pasian' biakinn lam nasep a huh uh hi.
Hih thute khempeuh a kisep khit ciangin keima kiangah makaite pawlkhat hong pai-in, "Hih gama teng gamdang mite' nitna leh Kanaan mite, Hit mite, Perez mite, Jebus mite, Ammon mite, Moab mite, Egypt mite, leh Amor' mite' gamtat a kihhuaite panin Israel mi, siampite leh Levi mite nangawn zong, a siangtho-in tuam omlo uh hi.
Amaute leh a tapate un hih gama teng minam dangte' numeite ten'pih uh a, tua thu hangin a siangtho minam pen tu-in gamdang mite tawh a kihel suak ta hi. Tua hi a, hih thu-ah makaite leh thukhen uliante pen a khial masa ahi uh hi," hong ci uh hi.
Hih thu ka zak ciangin dah mahmahin ka puante balkekin, ka sam leh ka khamul botin, cihna ding theiloin ka om hi.
Tua ciangin sal a suak hih mite' cihtaklohna hangin Israel Pasian' gimpiak ding lau-in a ling mite khempeuh kei kiangah hong kikhawm uh a, nitak biakpiak hun dong cihna ding theiloin ka om hi.
Tua hi a, nitak biakpiak hun ciangin khua phawk kikin ka puankekpi mah silh kawmin khukdin'in { Topa } Pasian' lamah ka khut zakin,
Ka pu ka pate uh huna kipanin tuhun dong mawhna lianpi ka nei uh hi. Tua thu hangin ka kumpite uh leh ka siampite un gamdang kumpite' khutsungah sihna, salsuahna, neihsa kisuhna, leh maizumna thuak uh a, tuhunin zong tua bangmah ka thuak uh hi.
Kote pen sal ka hi takpi uh hi; ahi zongin ka salsuahna uhah ka Pasian un nong nusia kei a, kote' Pasian' biakinn puahkikin ka din'sakkik theihna ding uh leh Judah leh Jerusalem-ah kidalna kulh ka neih theihna dingun kipat thakna na hong piak theihna dingin Persia kumpite ko tungah a thunuam dingin nong bawlsak hi.
"Kote' Pasian aw, hih bang hi khin ahih ciangin kote in bang gen thei nawn ding ka hi uh hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh kamsang na nasemte tung tawnin kote thu hong pia-in, 'Note va lutin na luah ding uh gam pen, tua gama a na teng gamdang mite in ninsakin a kihhuai a gamtatnate uh tawh mong khat pan mong khat dongin a ninsa gam nin ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin na tanute uh amau' tapate tawh kitengsak kei un la, na tapate uh zi dingin amau' tanute zong la kei un. Amaute' phattuamna ding leh a mavan'na ding uh hanciam kei un. Tua bang hi leh note thahatin tua gama piangte nuamtakin na ne ding uh a, na tate un a luah tawntung dingun tua gam na piasawn thei ding uh hi,' ci-in nong thupiaknate ka zui kei uh hi.
Tu-in kote' gamtatsiate leh a lian ka mawhnate uh hangin hih bang gimna lian ka thuak uh hi; ahi zongin nangmah in kote' tuah dinga kilawmzah gimna hong tuaksak loin, tu-a banga a nungta lai-in nong omsak zaw hi.
Hih banga ka thuak khit uh ciangin kote in na thupiaknate manglo kikin, a kihhuai-in a gamta mite tawh kitengin kizomkik ding ka hi uh hiam? Tua bang hi kik le-ung, a suakta, a nungta ka om nawnloh dongun kote' tungah na hehna hong tungsak ding hilo na hi hiam?
Israel Pasian, { Topa } aw, nang na thutang a, ahi zongin tuni-a a omlai ko teng nong suaktasak veve hi. Na muhna-ah kote a mawhpi mah hita le-ung hong hehpih in; bang hang hiam cih leh mawhna tawh nangma mai-ah kuamah om theilo hi," ci-in thu ka ngen hi.
Ezra in tu-a bangin thu ngenin mawhna pulakin khitui naptui tawh Pasian' biakinn mai-ah kunin a om laitakin Israel mi numei, pasal, naupang, mi tampi tak ama kiimah hong kikhawmin amaute khempeuh zong nakpi takin a kap uh hi.
Tua ciangin Elam-te beh sung panin Jehiel' tapa Shekaniah hong pau-in Ezra kiangah, "Hih gama teng gamdang numeite ten'pihna tawh i Pasian tungah i khial hi. Ahi ta zongin Israel mite-a' dingin lametna omlai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in, ka topa uh nangma ngaihsutna leh i Pasian' thupiakna a kihta mite' ngaihsutna bangin hih i zite leh a tate uh i makna ding thu i Pasian' tungah kiciam ni. Tua ciangin thukham sunga om bangin gamta ni.
Kipan in; nangma nasep ding ahi hi; kote in kong huh ding uh hi. Hang in la sem in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Ezra dingin, a kigensa bangin amaute a gamtatna dingun a kiciam dingin siampi makaite, Levi mite, leh Israel mi khempeuh sawl a, amaute zong a kiciam pah uh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Judah leh Benjamin mi khempeuh ni thum sungin Jerusalem-ah hong kikhawm uh a, tua pen a kha kuana a ni sawmnih ni ahi hi. Tua hi a, Pasian' biakinn mai inntualah hih thu hangin mi khempeuh patau-in guah lakah lingin a tu uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na pu na pate uh Pasian ahi { Topa' } tungah na mawhna uh pulak un la, ama deihna bangin gamta-in hih gama teng gamdang mite leh gamdang mi ahi na zite uh tawh kikhenin tuam om un," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin mi tampi hi hang a, guahzuk laitak zong ahi hi. Hih guah lakah ka omsuak zo kei ding uh hi. Tua thamloin hih thu-ah eite in mawhna lianpi hihkha ihih manin ni khat ni nih sungin hih nasep a kizo thei ding hilo hi.

Ahi zongin kei kiangah hong ciahkikin ka thupiaknate zui-in na sep uh leh leimong dongah a kithehthangsa na mite uh kaikhawmin keima min omna dingin ka teelnasa munah amaute ka ciahpih ding hi,' ci-a na thugen hong phawkkik in.
{ Topa } aw, amaute pen na vangliatna leh a thahat na khut tawh na hotkhiatsa na nasemte leh nangma mite ahi uh hi.
Keima hong thungetna leh nangma min a zahtak nuam na nasemte' thungetna na bil hong ngat in. Tu-in kei tungah mavan'na hong pia in la, kei tungah hih kumpipa hong migitna ding lungsim hong guan' in," ka ci hi. Tua hun laitakin kei pen kumpipa' an a piapa ka hi hi.
tua khit ciangin kumpipa dawngin, "Kumpipa na lung a kim a, dik na sak leh, ka puahphatkik theihna dingin Judah gamsung ka pute ka pate a kivuina khuapi-ah nong paisakna ding kong thum hi, topa," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah, "Kumpipa na thukim leh, Judah gam ka tun' dong amaute in hong paisuaksak theihna dingun Eufratis Gungal gamsung a uksawn mite ka piak ding laikhakte,
leh biakinn hutna ding munmuan'huai kongpi ding, khuapi kulh ding, leh ka omna ding inn lamna dingin sing hong piaktheihna dingin kumpipa' tulak a kem Asaf' tungah piak ding laikhak zong, kei tungah hong pia in," ka ci hi. A dik ka Pasian in kei hong ompih ahih manin kumpipa in ka ngette hong pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Eufratis Gungal gam a uksawn mite kiang ka tung a, kumpipa' laikhakte amaute tungah ka pia hi. Kumpipa in galkapmangte leh sakol galkapte kei hong khasak hi.
Ahi zongin Israel mite' phattuamna ding a sem dingin mi khat a paina thu Horonaim khuami Sanballat leh Ammon mi sal ahi Tobiah in a zak uh ciangin nakpi takin lungkimlo uh hi.
Jerusalem khua ka tun' ciangin ni thum sung ka tawlnga hi.
Tua ciangin zanin vakkhia-in mi tawmkhat ka tonpih hi. Ahi zongin Jerusalem-a' dingin ka bawlsak ding ka Pasian in ka lungsimah hong suahsak thu kuama kiangah ka gen kei hi. Keima tuan'na simloh ganhing dang ka kizuisak kei hi.
Tua ciangin Tuinak Kongpi leh Kumpipa' Bual-ah ka paisuak hi. Ahi zongin ka tuan'na ganhing a paisuak theihna ding mun omlo hi.
Tua hi a, khuasung upate in ka paina mun ahi a, ka sep ahi zongin theilo uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh hih nasep tavuan a la ding Judah mite, siampite, uliante, khuasung upate, leh a dangte tungah ka gen nai kei hi.
Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, "I lungkhamna thu na thei uh hi. Jerusalem a siasa-in omin, a kongpite mei in kangtum hi. Hong pai un, zahkona i ngah nawnlohna dingin Jerusalem kulh ciangpha ni," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin a dik ka Pasian in kei hong ompihna leh kumpipa in kei tungah hong gen thute zong amaute tungah ka gen hi. Tua ciangin amaute in, "Tu-in nasep kipan pah ni," hong ci uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin lawp mahmahna leh ngimna hoih tawh nasep a kipan uh hi.
Ahi zongin Horonaim khuami Sanballat, Ammon mi sal ahi Tobiah, leh Arab gammi ahi Geshem in tua thu a zak uh ciangin, kote zahpihna leh simmawhna tawh, "Hih na sep uh bang ahi hiam? Kumpipa lehpan' na hi uh hiam?" hong ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute dawngin, "Vantung Pasian in ka ma uh hong telhsak ding a, ko ama nasemte in nasep a kipan ta ka hi uh hi; note in ahih leh Jerusalem tawh kisai-in thu na neih theihna dingun bangmah kimematna na nei kei uh hi," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin siampi lianpenpa Eliashib leh a siampipihte in nasep kipanin Tuu Kongpi a bawl uh hi. Amaute in a khuamte leh a zawlte bawlin a kongkhakte bulh uh hi. Amaute in Za Khat Tausang ciang banah Hananel Tausang dong sem uh a, tua ciangin Pasian' tungah ap uh hi.
A zom kikah Tekoa khua mite in puah uh a, ahi zongin amau' uliante in a tote uh sawl bangin sem nuamlo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Paseah' tapa Joiada leh Besodeiah' tapa Meshullam in Jeshanah Kongpi puah uh a, a zawlte khungin a kongkhakte a kalhna bulh uh hi.
Amaute' zomah Gibeon leh Mizpah khuami ahi, Gibeon mi Melatiah leh Meronoth khuami Jadon in Eufratis Gungal gam a uksawnpa' zum dong puah uh hi.
Tua zomah khamseekpa Harhaiah' tapa Uzziel in puah a, a zomah paknamtui bawlpa Hananiah in puah hi. Amaute in Kulh Zai ciangdong a ngeina bangin Jerusalem bawlkik uh hi.
Hanun leh Zanoah khua-a teng mite in Kuam Kongpi puah uh hi. Amaute in tua kongpi bawlpha-in a kongkhakte a kalhna bulh uh a, Nin Kongpi ciangdong pi tul leh pi za nga sung kulh a puah uh hi.
Mizpah gam a uk, Kolhozeh' tapa Shallum in Tuinak Kongpi puah a, tua kongpi bawlpha-in a kongkhakte a kalhna bulh hi. Tua ciangin amah in kumpipa' huan gei-a kulh ciang a, David khuapi pana hong paisuk kahlei ciangdong a sem hi.
Ama zomah Bethzur gam phelkhat a uk, Azbuk' tapa Nehemiah in David' han san ciang, a kibawl tawm bual leh Galkap Inn ciangdong puah hi.
Ama zomah Zabbai' tapa Baruk in a Kiu panin siampi lianpenpa Eliashib' inn kongkhak ciangdong khawk khat sung puah hi.
Ama zomah Hakkoz' tapa Uriah, a tapa Meremoth in Eliashib' inn kongkhak panin Eliashib' innmong ciangdong khawk khat sung puah hi.
A zomah Benjamin leh Hasshub in amau' inn mai san puah uh hi. A zomah Ananiah' tapa Maaseiah, a tapa Azariah in ama inn gei san teng puah hi.
leh kulh kiu ciang khawk khat sung puah hi. Uzai' tapa Palal in a Kiu gal san teng leh kumpipa' inn panin hong dawkkhia, zumcingte' omna ahi tausang tungnung teng puah hi.
Ama zomah Parosh' tapa Pedaiah in nisuahna lam manawhin Tui Kongpi gal san ciang leh tausang dawk puah hi.
Ama zomah Shemaiah' tapa Hananiah leh Zalaf' tapa gukna Hanun in khawk dang khat sung puah uh hi. Amau zomah Berekhiah' tapa Meshullam in ama inndei mai san teng puah hi.
Ama zomah khamseekpa Malkhijah in Kikaihkhopna Kongpi mai sana om biakinn nasemte' inn leh sumbukte' inn ciang, leh a kiu-a inndei tungnung ciangdong puah hi.
Tua ciangin khamseekte leh sumbukte in a kiu-a inndei tungnung leh Tuu Kongpi kikal a puah uh hi.
Sanballat in kote' kulh cian'na thu a zak ciangin lungkim loin heh mahmah a, ko Jew mite hong zahko hi.
Amah in a kikholhpihte leh Samaria galkapte' kiangah, "Hih Jew mi niangnuangte in bang hih dinga kipan ahi uh hiam? Hih mun a bawlpha dinga kingaihsun ahi uh hiam? Biakpiakna hangin a nasep uh ni khat sungin zo dingin kilamen ahi uh hiam? Amaute in a kangtumsa ninbulomtang panin suangtum bawlkik thei ding ahi uh hiam?" ci hi.
Tua ciangin keimah Nehemiah in thu ka ngen a, "Hong za in, kote' Pasian aw; kote hong kisimmawh hi. Kote hong zahkona amau' lu tungah lehtuksak in la, gamdang khatah sal suakin mi' bawlsiatin amaute omsak in.
Amaute in a langtangin kulh ciangte' mai-ah nang hong hehsak uh ahih manin amau' mawhna maisak kei in la, na ciamtehna panin zong a mawhna uh sumit kei in," ka ci hi.
Ahi zongin Sanballat, Tobiah, Arab mite, Ammon mite, leh Ashdod mite in Jerusalem kulh cian' nasep kizom suakin, kulh vang teng huk ding a kipat khitna thu a zak uh ciangin heh mahmah uh hi.
Tua ciangin ka galte un, "Amau' phawkloh kalun amaute lakah pai-in i that ding a, a nasep uh i beisak ding hi," hong ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kulh nunglam mun niam penna mun awng tengah a namsau uh, a teipi uh, leh a thal uh tawh, a innkuan kuanun ka mite ka pangsak hi.
Mite' launa ka muh ciangin, uliante, mi ukte, leh mi khempeuh tungah, "Amaute kihta kei un. Na sanggamte, na tapate, na tanute, na zite uh, leh na inn na lote uh-a' dingin hong dosak, a lian a kihtakhuai { Topa } phawk un," ka ci hi.
Amau' hong sawmna thu kote in ka phawkna uh leh Pasian in amau' geelna a suksiatna thu ka galte un thei uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin ka nasepna ciat uh kulh tungah ka vekpi-un ka kuankik uh hi.
Tua huna kipanin ka khutnuai-a om mite kimkhat in na sem a, a kimkhat in a teipite, a lumte, leh a thalte uh tawi-in sik puan silhin ding uh a, uliante in kulh a ciang Judah mi khempeuh uk uh hi.
Tua ciangin mi liante, mi ukte, leh mi khempeuh tungah, "I nasepna lian a, zaipi tak huam hi; eite kulh tungah kikhenin khatlekhat i kigamla hi.
Peengkul kitum na zakna peuhpeuh panun ko kiangah hong kikhawm un. I Pasian in eite-a' dingin hong dosak ding hi," ka ci hi.
Tua hi a, nisimin khuavak-a kipan nitak aksi suah dong, mi kimkhat in teipi tawi-in, mi kimkhat in na ka sem uh hi.
Tua hun mahin mite kiangah, "Zanin galvil, sunin nasemin hong om theihna dingun mi khempeuh na nasemte ciat uh tawh Jerusalem khuasungah hong giak un," ka ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin keimah-a kipan ka behte, ka nasemte, leh kei hong cingte, a kuamah peuh puan suah man omloin, mi khempeuh in ka khut uhah galhiam ka tawi den uh hi.
Tu-in mi nautang numei leh pasalte in a Jew mipihte uh tungah lungkimlohna kam hong gingsak uh hi.
Mi pawlkhatte in an leina dingin a tanute uh leh a tapate uh a piakna thu hong gen uh hi.
Pawlkhatte in kial tun' huhau-in an leina dingin a lote, a leenggah lote, leh a innte uh a piakna hong gen uh hi.
Amaute in, "Kote pen ka behte uh mah bangin cilesa kibang hi-in, ka naupangte uh zong amau' naupangte mah bangin a hoih hinapi-in, ka tanute uh leh ka tapate uh sal suak dingin ka phum uh hi. Ka tanute uh pawlkhat zong sal suakkhin a, ka lote uh leh ka leenggui lote uh midangte-a' suakkhin ahih manin amaute tatna dingin ka hih zawh uh bangmah omlo hi," hong ci uh hi.
Kei zong hih thu limtakin ka ngaihsun a, tua ciangin uliante leh thukhente taii-in amaute kiangah, "No leh no leiba manin salin na kila uh hi," ka ci hi. Amaute nakpi takin taii-in,
"Minam dangte tungah sala kizuaksa i Jew mipihte ahizo zahzahin i tanhkik hi. Tua hinapi-in note in na mipihte uh na zuak uh a, tu-in amaute i tatkik ding hi zel hi," ka ci hi. Amaute pauloin om uh a, a gen ding mel uh theilo uh hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, "Note' gamtatna hoihlo hi. I gal ahi minam dangte' zahkona i ngahlohna dingin i Pasian zahtakna tawh na gamtat ding uh kilawm hi.
Kei leh ka behte leh ka nasemte in zong an leh sum leitawi-in ka piakhia uh hi. Leiba manin mi kilakna phiat ni.
Tuni mahmahin a lote, a oliv lote, a innte uh leh a meetin na lak uh sum, an, leenggahzu, leh sathaute, amaute tungah pia kik un," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in, "Hihte khempeuh ka piakik ding uh a, amaute tung panin bangmah ka kal nawn kei ding uh hi. Na gen bangin ka gamta ding uh hi," hong ci uh hi. Tua ciangin siampite ka sam a, a ciamsa bangun a gamtatna dingun siampite' mai-ah kiciamna ka bawlsak hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong ka puan singin, "Hih thuciamna a tungsak lo peuhmah a inn leh a neihsa panin Pasian in singkhia ta hen. Hih bangin kisingkhia hen la, hawmsuak hen!" ka ci hi. Tua ciangin a kikhawmte khempeuh in, "Hi ta hen," ci uh a, { Topa } a phat uh hi. Tua hi a, a ciamsa bangun mite a gamta uh hi.
Tua thamloin, Judah gam a uk dingin hong kiseh huna kipan, Kumpi Artakzaksis' kum sawmnihna pan a kum sawmthumlenihna dong, kum sawmlenih sung, kei leh ka behte in gam ukte' ngah ngei ante ka ne kei uh hi.
Keima hun ma-in a ukte in mite tungah van gikpi suan uh a, amaute' tung panin nisimin an leh leenggahzu ngun shekel sawmli man a la uh hi. Amau' nasemte nangawn mite tungah kiliansak lai uh hi. Ahi zongin Pasian ka zahtakna hangin tua bangin kei ka gamta kei hi.
Hih kulh cian'na-ah keimahmah in zong ka sem a, kei-a' dingin leitang bangmah ka la kei hi. Keima mite khempeuh nasem ding bekin tua lai-ah kisutuah uh hi.
Kiim leh pama minam dangte' kiang pan hong paite banah, nisimin ka sabuai-ah an a ne, thukhente leh Jew mi a kihelin leengla za leh sawmnga bang ka nei den hi.
Nisimin innsung annektawm dinga kibawl bawngtal khat leh tuu limci guk ahi hi. Tua mah bangin ak zong kibawl a, ni sawm simin leenggahzu a um tampipi-in kihih hi. Tua zahin bei ta se leh gam ukte' ngah theih ahi an leh tui ka kal kei hi; bang hang hiam cih leh mite genthei lua hi.
Pasian aw, hih mite-a' dingin ka bawlna khempeuh kei-a' dingin a hoih lamin hong phawk in.
Kongpite-ah kongkhak ka bulh nailoh uh hangin, kulh ka cian' khitna uh leh a vang khat zong a om nawnlohna thu, Sanballat, Tobiah, Arab mi Geshem, leh ka gal dangte khempeuh un a zak uh ciangin,
Sanballat leh Geshem zong Ono zanglei sunga om Hakkofirim khua-ah pai-in amaute tawh thu a kikum dingin hong sam uh hi. Hih pen kei hong suksiat nopna uh ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kei zong amaute kiangah kamtaite ka sawl a, "Tu laitakin nasep thupi ka nei hi; kong pai thei kei ding hi. Kei hong pai leng, kong pai sung ka omloh kalteng nasep kitawlnga ding hi," ka ci hi.
Tua bangmahin Sanballat in a ngaveina hong sam a, tua tungtangin a kamtaipa in laikhak khat hong pia hi.
A laikhak sungah, "Minam dangte lakah a kigen, Geshem in zong tu-a a kigen thu man hi, ci-a a gen thu in: Nang leh Jew mite in kumpi lehdo ding na sawm uh a, tua thu hangin kulh na ciang uh hi. Tua banah nangmahmah zong kumpi na utna kigen lai hi.
Judah gam in kumpi khat nei ta hi, ci-in, nang kumpi na hihna thu Jerusalem-ah a taangko dingin kamsangte pawlkhat a koihin zong hong kigen hi. Kumpipa in hih thu za pelmawh ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin thakhatin hong pai in la, hih thu kikum ni," ci-in kigelh hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, "Tu-a na gen bangin bangmah omlo hi. Tua bang thu pen nangma phuahtawm ahi hi," ci-in ka thuk hi.
Kote in ka hanciamna uh khiamin nasep a kizawhlohna ding deihna tawh amaute in kote hong lausak theihna ding uh a hanciam uh ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin ka hahkat semsem zaw uh hi.
Ahih hangin keimah in, "Mi kei bangte tai ding ahi hiam? Mi kei bangte a suahtakna dingin biakinn sungah bu ding ahi hiam? Ka pai peuhmah kei ding hi," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin a thusim ka phawkkhia hi. Pasian in tua bang thu a gen dingin amah a sawl hilo a, Tobiah leh Sanballat in tua bangin thugen dingin golhguk a na pia na hi a, ama thugenna pen keimah suksiat nopna ahi hi.
Ama thugen bangin gamta-in mawhna ka bawl theihna dingin keimah hong lausakna dingin a kicial ahi hi. Tua bangin zuikha leng kei hong minsia sakin hong simmawh ding uh hi.
Elul kha ni sawmnihlenga ni-in kulh kizo a, ni sawmngalenih sung hun bei hi.
Amaute in ama hoihnate zong keima zakah hong gen uh a, keima sepna teng zong ama kiangah na puak uh hi. Tua hi a, Tobiah in zong ka lau theihna dingin kei tungah lai tampi hong khak hi.
Kulh kiciang khinin, kongkhakte ka bulh khin uh a, kongcingte, lasate, leh Levi mite a kiseh khit ciangin,
ka sanggampa Hanani leh biakinn a uk Hananiah in a et dingin Jerusalem ka pia hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Hananiah pen midang tampi sangin a citakzaw, Pasian a zahtakzaw khat ahi hi.
Tua hi a, amaute tungah, "Sun mateng Jerusalem kongpite hongsak kei un. Tua ciangin ni omlai mahin kongte khaksakin kalhsak un. Jerusalem khuasunga tengte lak panin khuacing dingte seh un la, pawlkhatte galvilna munah, pawlkhatte amau' omna inn mai ciatah omsak un," ka ci hi.
Khuapi lianin zai a, ahi zongin a sungah mi tawm bek om a, innte a kilam om nailo hi.
Tua ciangin uliante, thukhente, leh mite a innkuan kuanun ciamtehna ding ka lungsim sungah Pasian in hong suaksak hi. Tua hi a, hong ciahkik masate' khang ciamtehna laibu ka mu hi. Tua sungah a kigelh ka muhte:
Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar in a zawhna gam panin salin a lak mite sung panin hih mite pen Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, leh Baanah-te' makaihna tawh Jerusalem leh Judah gamsung amau khua ciatah a hong ciahkik ahi uh hi. Israel sung panin mi a phazah:
Parosh suante — mi tul nih za khat sawmsagihlenih ahi hi.
Shefatiah suante — mi za thum sawmsagihlenih ahi hi.
Arah suante — mi za guk sawmnganih ahi hi.
Pahathmoab-te beh sung panin Jeshua leh Joab suante — mi tul nih zagiat leh sawmlegiat ahi hi.
Elam suante — mi tul khat za nih sawmngaleli ahi hi.
Zattu suante — mi za giat sawmlilenga ahi hi.
Zakkai suante — mi za sagih sawmguk ahi hi.
Binnui suante — mi za guk sawmlilegiat ahi hi.
Bebai suante — mi za guk sawmnihlegiat ahi hi.
Azgad suante — mi tul nih za thum sawmnihlenih ahi hi.
Adonikam suante — mi za guk sawmguklesagih ahi hi.
Bigvai suante — mi tul nih sawmguklesagih ahi hi.
Adin suante — mi za guk sawmngalenga ahi hi.
Ater a kici Hezekiah' suante — mi sawmkualegiat ahi hi.
Hashum suante — mi za thum sawmnihlegiat ahi hi.
Bezai suante — mi za thum sawmnihleli ahi hi.
Harif suante — mi za khat sawmlenih ahi hi.
Gibeon suante — mi sawmkualenga ahi hi.
Bethlehem leh Netofah khuami — za khat sawmgiatlegiat ahi hi.
Kiriathjearim, Khefirah, leh Beeroth khuami — za sagih sawmlilethum ahi hi.
Ramah leh Geba khuami — za guk sawmnihlekhat ahi hi.
Bethel leh Ai khuami — za khat sawmnihlethum ahi hi.
Nebo adang khat khuami — sawmngalenih ahi hi.
Harim khuami — za thum sawmnih ahi hi.
Lod, Hadid, leh Ono khuami — za sagih sawmnihlekhat ahi hi.
Senaah khuami — tul thum za kua sawmthum ahi hi.
Immer suante — mi tul khat sawmngalenih ahi hi.
Pashhur suante — mi tul khat za nih sawmlisagih ahi hi.
Harim suante — mi tul khat sawmlesagih ahi uh hi.
Levi mite sung panin: Hodevah-te beh panin Jeshua suante leh Kadmiel suante — sawmsagihli ahi hi.
Lasate sung panin Asaf suante — mi za khat sawmligiat ahi hi.
Kongcingte nam sung panin Shallum suante, Ater suante, Talmon suante, Akkub suante, Hatita suante, leh Shobai suante — mi za khat sawmthumgiat ahi uh hi.
Neziah suante leh Hatifa suante ahi uh hi.
Shefatiah suante, Hattil suante, Pokherethhazzebaim suante, leh Amon suante ahi uh hi.
Biakinn nasemte leh Solomon' nasemte' suanlekhakte mi a vekpi-in za thum sawmkuanih a pha uh hi.
Temelah, Telharsha, Kherub, Addan, leh Immer khuate panin a hong ciahkik, Israel mi hinapi-in amau' behlephung a kan theilo mite:
Delaiah suante, Tobiah suante, leh Nekoda suante, mi za guk sawmlinih ahi uh hi.
Siampite' sung panin zong: Hobaiah suante, Hakkoz suante, Barzilai suante (amah in Gilead mi Barzilai' tanute khat ten'pihin tua min tawh a kilo pah) ahi uh hi.
Hih mite in khang ciamtehna sungah a kiciamteh mite lakah amau' min a zon' uh hangin mulo uh ahih manin amaute a siangloin seh uh a, siampi nasep semsak theilo uh hi.
Tua hi a, Urim leh Thummim aisanna tawh ai san ding siampi khat a om matengin amaute in biakna an siangtho pente a neklohna ding uh gam ukpa in a gen hi.
Mi a vekpi-in tul sawmli tul nih zathum sawmguk pha a,
amaute' nasem numei leh pasal tul sagih zathum sawmthumsagihte kisimlo lai hi. Tua banah amaute in lasa numei leh pasal za nih sawmlinga nei uh hi.
Amau' sakol za sagih sawmthum guk, a la-sakol uh za nih sawmli nga,
a kalaoh uh za li sawmthum nga, leh a late uh tul guk za sagih sawmnih a pha hi.
Beh lutang mi pawlkhat in nasepna dingin nate pia uh hi. Gam ukpa in vanmanpha koihna-ah kham darik tul khat, kuang-uk sawmnga, leh siampipuan za nga sawmthum a pia hi.
Tua ciangin beh lutang pawlkhatte in vanmanpha koihna-ah kham darik tul sawmnih leh ngun mina tul nih za nih a pia uh hi.
Tua ciangin midangte' piakte pen kham darik tul sawmnih, ngun mina tul nih, leh siampipuan sawmguklesagih ahi hi.
Tua ciangin siampite, Levi mite, leh mi pawlkhatte Jerusalem khua leh a kiimah teng uh hi; kongcingte, lasate, biakinn nasemte, leh Israel midangte amau' khuapi ciatah a teng uh hi.
Kha sagihna hong cin' ciangin Israel mite amau' khuapi ciatah teng khin uh hi. Tua ciangin Tui Kongpi mai tualpi-ah mi khempeuh khekhat khai bangin hong kikhawmtuah diam hi. Tua ciangin { Topa } in Israel mite tungah a piak ahi Moses thukham laibu pen laitheipa Ezra in hong paipihna dingin a gen uh hi.
Tua hi a, a kha sagihna a ni khat ni-in numei pasal, leh thu theitel thei ding a kikhawm khempeuh mai-ah siampi Ezra in thukham laibu hong paipih hi.
Tua ciangin amah in Tui Kongpi mai-a om tualpi lam mai ngatin zingsang tunga kipan sun ciangdong, numei pasal leh thu a tel thei ding mite' zakin tua laibu sunga thute sim a, mi khempeuh in tua thukham laibu sunga thu kisimte limtakin a ngai uh hi.
Tua ciangin thugenna dinga sing tawh kibawl tau tungah laitheipa Ezra dingto a, ama taklam pangah Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, leh Maaseiah ding uh a, a veilam pangah Pedaiah, Mishael, Malkhijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zekhariah, leh Meshullam a ding uh hi.

Hih thu-ah lungkim hetlo ka hih manin inndei sung panin Tobiah' van teng ka lawnkhia hi.
Tua ciangin tua inndei a sian'sakna ding uh, leh Pasian' biakinn-a umlebeelte, an tawh biakna leh paknamtui a koihkikna dingun thu ka pia hi.
Levi mite' ngah dingte amau' tungah kipialo ahih manin Levi mite leh lasate in a nasep ngeite uh nusia-in a lote uhah na a sepna uh zong ka phawkkhia hi.
Tua ciangin Judah mite khempeuh in an, leenggahzu, leh sathau sung pan sawmah khat hong paipihin vankoihna innte-ah hong tun' uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua vankoihna innte a kem dingin siampi Shelemiah, laithei Zadok, leh Levi mi Pedaiah, leh amaute a huh dingin Mattaniah' tapa Zakkur, a tapa Hanan ka seh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute mi muan'huai ahi uh hi. Amau' nasep pen a sanggamte uh tungah amau' tahn ciat uh a hawmkhia ding uh ahi hi.
Ka Pasian aw, hih thu tawh kisai-in kei hong phawk in la, ka Pasian' biakinn leh a nasepna dingin ka sepsa gamtat hoihte maimangsak kei in.
Tua hun lai-in Judah gamsungah mite in Sabbath ni-in leenggah sukin, a khawhsate uh khawmin late tungah suanin, leenggah, thei, leh van namkim, Sabbath ni-in Jerusalem-ah hong puakna ka mu hi. Tua ni-in na a zuakna uh hangin ka lungkimlohna amaute tungah ka gen hi.
Jerusalem khuasunga teng Taia khuamite in zong ngasa leh van namkim hong paipihin Judah mite tung leh Jerusalem khuasungah Sabbath ni-in zuak uh hi.
Tua ciangin Judah uliante tungah lungkim loin amaute kiangah, "Bang hangin hih bangin hoihlohna gamta-in Sabbath ni ninsak ngam na hi uh hiam?
Na pu na pate uh tu-a bang teekin a gamtat manin eite tung leh hih khuapi tungah hih bang siatna khempeuh hong tung hilo ahi hiam? Tua hinapi-in note in Sabbath ni nitsakna tawh Israel tungah hehna tamzaw na tungsak uh hi," ka ci hi.
Tua hi a, Sabbath ni ding khuamial ciangin kongpite a kikhakna ding ka sawl a, Sabbath bei khit mateng a kihon'lohna dingin thu ka pia hi. Tua ciangin, Sabbath ni-in khua sungah van hong kilutpih lohna dingin kongpite a cing dingin ka nasemte pawlkhat ka koih hi.
Tua ahih manin sumbukte leh na nam tuamtuam a zuakte, khatvei nihvei khawng Jerusalem khua pualamah giak uh hi.
Ahi zongin amaute hilhkholin amaute kiangah, "Bang hangin kulh gei-ah giak na hi uh hiam? Nong giah kik uh leh note tungah thu kong bawl ding hi," ka ci hi. Tua huna kipanin Sabbath ni-in amaute hong pai nawnlo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Sabbath ni a siangtho-in a omsak theihna dingun amaute kisian'suah tawmin kongpite hong cin'na dingun Levi mite ka sawl hi. Ka Pasian aw, hih thu-ah zong hong phawk in la, na itna tawh kizui-in siatna panin kei hong pengsak in.
Tua hun lai mahin zong Judah mite in Ashdod numei, Ammon numei, leh Moab numeite a ten'pihna,
leh a tate uh kimkhat in Ashdod kampau a zatna, leh Judah kampau zang theiloin, amau pau ciat bek a zat theihna thu ka mukhia hi.
Israel kumpipa Solomon zong tua bang numeite' hangin khial hilo ahi hiam? Minam tampite lakah amah tawh a kibang kumpi khat zong omlo a, ama Pasian in amah itin, Israel khempeuh tungah kumpi-in amah koih hi; ahi ta zongin gamdang numeite in amah nangawn khialsakzo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Solomon aw, nangma gamtatnate hong zui-in, gamdang numeite ten'pihna tawh hih siatna lian khempeuh gamta-in i Pasian tungah hong zuautat ding ka hi uh hiam?" ka cisak hi.
Siampi lianpenpa Eliashib' tapa Jehoiada' tapate khat pen Horonaim khuami Sanbalat' makpa na hi hi. Tua ahih manin keima kiang panin amah ka hawlkhia hi.
Ka Pasian aw, amaute in siampi nasepna leh siampite leh Levi mite' thuciamna siasak uh ahih manin amaute thei ta in.
Tua bangin gamdang tawh a kizom nate khempeuh panin amaute ka siangsak a, siampite leh Levi mite a nasep ngei mah uhah ka semsak kik hi.
Tua ciangin a kiseh hunin zat dingin cih ding sing tawh biakna leh anpal tawh biakna ding ka vaihawmsak hi. Ka Pasian aw, a hoih lamin kei hong phawk in.
Hih lai-a kigelh thupiangte pen India gam panin Ethiopia gam dong, gamneu za khat sawmnihsagih a uk Ahasueras' hun lai-a piang thu ahi hi.
Ama uk a kum thumna kumin ama nuai-a a uliante khempeuh leh a nasemte-a' dingin pawi khat bawlsak hi. Ama khutnuai-a om Persia leh Media galkapmangte leh ama nuai-a uliante leh ama nuai-ah gam a uksawnte a om laitakin,
a kumpi gam hauhna leh ama thupi ziazuana ni tampi sung, ni za leh ni sawmgiat sung tak a lak hi.
Hih pawi hun a bei khit ciangin kumpi khua Susa khuapi sunga om milian mineu mi khempeuh-a' dingin kumpipa in pawi khat a bawl hi. Tua pawi pen kumpi inn huang sungah kibawl a, ni sagih sung kibawl hi.
Tua huang sungah suangkang khuamte kiphut a, khau malneu leh khau dupsan tawh ngun kualte-ah kikhihin a kikhai dalna puanpakte kikhungin, suangmanpha a san, a dum, a kang, leh a vom, a nam tuamtuamte kizangin a kizem suangphah kiphah tungah kham leh ngun kibawl lupnate kikoih hi.
Tua banah Kumpinu Vashti in zong numeite-a' dingin Kumpipa Ahasueras' innsung mahah pawi khat a bawl hi.
A ni sagih ni, zunekna hangin a lung a nop ciangin kumpipa in ama na a sem innsungmang sagihte Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, leh Karkas-te sam a, mite leh uliante mai-ah Kumpinu Vashti a melhoihna a lahtheihna dingin a kumpi lukhu khusa-in ama kiangah a paipihna dingun a sawl hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tuanu a mel a hoih takpi mah ahi hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in upadi siam a mipilte thu dong hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh upadi leh biakna lam thutheite khempeuh thu dot pen kumpipa' zat ngei khat ahi hi.
Ama gei nai penah a tu mite pen Persia leh Media gam ulian sagihte ahi Karshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, leh Memukan-te hi uh a, kumpipa kiangah a hawh thei, kumpi gamsungah ulian pente ahi uh hi.
"Innsungmangte' tung tawnin keimah kumpi Ahasueras' thupiakna bangin Kumpinu Vashti gamtalo ahih manin Kumpinu Vashti tungah upadi tawh kizui-in bangci kihih ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa leh uliante' zakin Memukan in dawng a, "Kumpinu Vashti khial hi; kumpipa tung bek hiloin Kumpipa Ahasueras' ukna gamsung khempeuha om uliante leh mi khempeuh tungah zong a khial ahi hi.
Kumpinu' gamtatna thu numei dangte khempeuh in thei ding uh a, hih thu hangin numeite in a pasalte uh simmawh ding uh a, amaute in, 'Kumpipa Ahasueras in ama kiangah a pai dingin Kumpinu Vashti thu pia napi-in pailo hi,' ci ding uh hi.
Hih banga kumpinu' gamtatna thu a za Persia leh Media gam numei liante in kumpipa nuai-a uliante tungah tuni mahmahin hih thu gen ding uh a, kisimmawhna leh kizahtak lohna tampi piangsak ding hi.
Kumpipa in hoih na sak leh, kumpi thupiakna khat paisak in la, Kumpipa Ahasueras' mai-ah Vashti a kilakkik nawnlohna dingin a kikhelkik ngei nawnlo ding Persia mite leh Media mite' upadi sungah gelhsak in. Tua ciangin amah sangin a kilawmzaw numei khat ama za luahsak in.
Tua banga kumpipa' thupiakna thu kumpi gamsung khempeuhah a kizak ciangin numei khempeuh in a neu a lian amau' pasal ciat zahtak ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Kumpipa leh uliante in hih ngaihsutna hoihsa uh a, Memukan' gen bangin kumpipa a gamta hi.
Pasal khempeuh pen ama innsung ukpa ahihna ding leh ama kampau a kizuih kimna dingin kumpipa' ukna gam khempeuhah amau' lai ciat, leh mi khempeuh tungah amau' pau ciatin laikhakte kigelh hi.
Hih thu teng a pian' khit, Kumpipa Ahasueras' hehna a dam ciangin, amah in Vashti phawkin, Vashti' gamtatna leh amah tawh kisai-in a thupiakna zong thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa' nasemte in ama kiangah, "Kumpipa-a' dingin a melhoih nungak khangnote zongsak in.
Kumpi khua ahi Susa khuapi-a numeite' omna-ah a melhoih nungak khangno khempeuh hong paipihna dingun na ukna gam tuamtuam khempeuhah uliante sawl in. Tua numeite pen numeite a uk, kumpipa' innsungmang Hegai' kep dingin ki-ap hen. Tua ciangin tua numeite tungah paknamtui tuamtuam kiguan' hen.
Amah pen, Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar in Jerusalem panin Judah kumpipa Jekoniah tawh a lak galmatte laka kihel khat ahi hi.
Amah in a innlak pate khat' tanu, a min masa Hadassah, a nung ciangin Esther a kici, a khoi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a nu leh a pa om nawnlo hi. Tua numei melhoihin a ngaihbaang mahmah khat hi a, a nu leh a pa a sih ciangin Mordekai in ama tanu dingin a lak ahi hi.
Amah in tua nungak hoihsa-in pakta mahmah ahih manin paknamtuite leh a annek ding pia pah a, kumpipa' innsung panin a kiteel nasem numei sagih zong guan' a, amah leh a nasem numeite' tungah numeite' omna a hoihpen mun a pia pah hi.
Mordekai in kham ahih manin Esther in ama namlephung genkhialo hi.
Esther bangci om a, ama tungah bang piang hiam cih a theihna dingin numeite' omna inntual mai-ah nisimin Mordekai va pai zel hi.
Numeite a kigin' hun a vekpi-in kha sawmlenih sung hi a, sathau leh myrrh paknamtui tawh kha guk sung kipuahin, paknamtui tuamtuamte leh kipuahna dangte tawh kha guk sung mah kipuah uh hi.
Kigin'kholhna hun cing a, Kumpipa Ahasueras' kiangah numeite a pai ciangin numeite' omna panin kumpipa' inn-ah a deih peuhpeuh uh kikengsak hi.
Nitakin kumpipa kiangah va pai a, a zingsang ciangin numeite' omna a mun dang khatah kiciahsak a, kumpipa' zineute a uk, kumpipa' innsungmang Shaashgaz in kem hi. Kumpipa in a deihkik kei leh kumpipa kiangah paikik nawnlo a, kumpipa in a deih leh a minin kisamkik hi.
Mordekai in ama tanu dingin a lak a innlak pa Abihail' tanu Esther pen kumpipa kiangah a pai ding hun a tun' ciangin, numeite a uk kumpipa' innsungmangpa Hegai' gen teng lobuang kizepna ding puan dang bangmah ngenthuah lo hi. Tu-in Esther a mu mi peuhmah in hoihsa kim uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Esther pahtawina-in ama uliante leh a nasem khempeuh-a' dingin pawi lianpi khat a bawl hi. Amah in ama ukna gam khempeuhah tua ni nasep khawlin zum a khakna ding uh zong thu zasak kim a, kumpipa min tawh a kilawm a kituak letsongte zong a hawmkhia hi.
Ama hilhna tawh kizui-in Esther in ama minam ahi a, a innkuan ahi zongin pulaklo hi. Mordekai' kep sungin ama thu a man' mah bangin tu-in zong Mordekai' gen bangin gamta hi.
Ni khat, kumpi nasemin Mordekai a om hun sungin kongcing ahi kumpipa' innsungmangte Bigthana leh Teresh heh uh a, Kumpipa Ahasueras thah ding a sawm uh hi.
A thu kikanin a manna a kitheih ciangin khuampite tungah tua mi nihte gel kikhailum hi. Hih thupiangte khempeuh kumpipa' theihin Kumpi Gam Tangthu Laibu sungah kiciamteh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpi huang sunga om kumpipa' nasem khempeuh in Haman zahtak bawlin ama mai-ah kun uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua banga a hih ding uh kumpipa in thu pia hi. Ahih hangin Mordekai pen amah zahtakna limin a mai-ah kunlo hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa' huang sunga om kumpipa' nasemte in Mordekai kiangah, "Bang hangin kumpipa' thupiak manglo na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Nisimin amaute in Mordekai kiangah gengen uh a, ahih hangin amah in mang nuamlo hi. Jew mi ahihna thu amaute kiangah gen khin ahih manin tua banga ama nialna a kimang ding mah ahi hiam cih a theihna dingun Haman kiangah a thu ko uh hi.
Ama mai-ah Mordekai a kunlohna, amah a zahtakbawl lohna a theih ciang-in Haman nak heh mahmah hi.
Amah in Mordekai' mipihte a theih ciangin amah bek suktaak salo a, Ahasueras' kumpi gamsung khempeuhah a om Jew mi khempeuh, Mordekai leh a minam buppi-in a suksiat theihna ding lampi a zong hi.
Kumpi Ahasueras' uk a kum sawmlenihna, a kha masa pen ahi Nisan kha-a kipanin a ni ni, a kha kha-in Pur a kici aisanna tawh Haman' muhin ai kisan a, a kha sawmlenihna Adar kha a ni sawmlethum ni-in ai a pha hi.
Tua ciangin Haman in Kumpipa Ahasueras' kiangah, "Na ukna gam tuamtuam sunga om mite lakah a om kawikawi, amau a tuam om mi pawlkhat om hi. Amau' ngeinate pen midangte-a' tawh kibanglo a, amaute in nangma thukhamte zuilo uh hi. Tua ahih manin hih mite na hici khahkhong ding kilawmlo hi.
Kumpipa in hoih na sak leh amaute a kisuksiatna ding thu pia-in lai-in gelh in. Tua hi leh nangma sumkholna sungah koih dingin na khutnuai-a na uliante tungah ngun talen tul sawm ka pia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Haman kiangah, "Na sum cihte nangmah kong piakik hi; na mi cihte zong nangma khutsungah kong pia hi; na ut bangbangin bawl in," a ci hi.
A kha masa a ni sawmlethum ni-in kumpipa' lai-atte khempeuh kisam a, Haman' genna tawh kizui-in kumpipa' nuai-ah gam tampi a uksawnte leh gam khat a uksawnte, leh gam uksawnte' khutnuai-ah a mi tuamtuamte lakah uliante tungah lai kipaisak hi. Gam khempeuhah amau' lai ciat, mi khempeuh tungah amau pau ciatin kigelh hi. Hih lai pen kumpipa Ahasueras' min tawh kigelhin kumpipa' minthuhna zungbuh tawh min kithuh hi.
Tua bangin kumpipa' ukna gam khempeuhah laitaite kipiasak a, Adar kha ahi a kha sawmlenihna a ni sawmlethum ni, ni khat sungin Jew mi a moi a ham, numei naupang, a vekpi-in susia-in, thatin, a beisakmangna ding uh, leh a neihsate uh a laksakna dingun thu kipia hi.
Tua a ni seh ni-in amaute a baihsa-in a om theihna dingun hih thupiakna lai pen gam khempeuhah dal khat ciat kipuakin tua thu pen a gamsung mi khempeuh tungah a kizasak kim ding ahi hi.
Mordekai in hih thupiang teng a theih ciangin a puan balkekin puanhampi silhin vut kibuak a, nakpi takin a kap kawmin khuasungah vak kawikawi hi.
Kumpipa' thupiakna a tun'na gam Jew mite' omna khempeuhah nakpi taka thumna leh tauna, antan'na, kahna, leh dip-humna om hi. Mi a tamzaw in puanhampi silhin vut lakah lum uh hi.
Esther' nasem numeite leh a innsungmangte hong pai-in ama kiang-ah tua thu a gen ciangun kumpinu in lamdangsa mahmah hi. A puanhampi a laihna dingin amah in Mordekai-a' ding puante khak a, ahih hangin Mordekai in tuate na sanglo hi.
Mordekai in ama tunga thupiangte khempeuh leh Jew mite sukmangna dingin kumpipa' sumkholna-ah Haman in piak dinga a sum ciamzah thute khempeuh ama kiangah na gen hi.
Amaute a kisukmangna dingin Susa khua panin a kihawmkhia lai dal khat zong Mordekai in ama tungah pia a, amah in Esther tungah tua lai na pia-in a thu a na gentelna ding leh, kumpipa kiangah Esther na pai-in ama mipihte-a' dingin a na thumsak ding zong a sawl hi.
"Numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin saplohpi-in mi khat peuhpeuh kumpipa' omna inn sungah a va lut leh upadi khat bek om a, tua pen, thah ding ahi hi; kumpipa in ama lamah a kham kumpi ciangkhut a na zan leh tua mipa suakta bek ding ahihna thu kumpipa' nasemte leh ama ukna gam mi khempeuh in a theih ciat uh ahi hi. Tu-in kumpipa kiangah a pai dingin hong kisaploh zawh ni sawmthum bang pha ta hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Mordekai in Esther a dawn'kikna thu amahmah puasak kik a, "Kumpi inn sungah na omna hangin Jew mi khempeuh lak panin nang a suakta tuan dingin kingaihsun kei in.
Hih bang hunin bangmah hihloin na omcip leh, Jew mite' suahtakna ding leh noptuamna ding thu mundang khat pan hong piang veve ding a, nangmah leh na innkuanpihte na simang ding uh hi. Hih kumpi inn na tun'na pen hih bang huna mah dinga a tung na hih mel zong kua'n thei ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Esther in Mordekai a dawn'na lai amah puasak leuleu a,
"Pai-in Susa khua sunga om Jew mi khempeuh khawm in la, keimah ngaihsutna-in an na tang un. A sun a zan ciloin ni thum sung an nelo, tui dawnloin na om un. Na tan' uh mah bangin kei leh ka nasem numeite in zong ka na tang ding uh hi. Tua khit ciangin ngeina ahihloh hangin kumpipa kiangah ka va pai ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in ama kiangah, "Kumpinu Esther aw, bang thu ahi hiam? Kei tungah nong nget peuhpeuh, ka kumpi gam phelkhat ciangdong, nang tungah hong kipia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Esther in, "Nong hehpih zawh leh, kumpipa-a' dinga kong bawlsak nitak an a ne dingin tuni-in Haman tawh hong pai un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Esther' deih bangin i gamtat theihna dingin manlangin Haman va sam un," a ci hi. Tua ahih manin Esther' bawlsak nitak an a ne dingin kumpipa leh Haman hong pai uh hi.
Topa aw, nong hehpih zawh a, na lung a kim a, kong nget thu nong piakzawh ding leh, note gel-a' dingin ka na bawl an a ne dingin zing ciangin kumpipa leh Haman hong pai un. Zing ciangin nong cih bangin ka deihna kong gen ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin lungdam kipakin tua ni-in Haman a ciah hi. Ahih hangin kongpi-a om Mordekai in amah zahtakna limin a mai-ah dinglo, kunlo-a om a muh ciangin Mordekai tungah nakpi takin a heh hi.
Ahi zongin Haman ki-ip tentanin inn-ah a ciah hi. Tua ciangin a lawmte leh a zi Zeresh sam a,
ama hauhna teng, a tapa neih teng, kumpipa in amah a pahtak manin a za a khan'sakna teng, leh kumpipa' nasemte leh ulian dangte khempeuh sangin a lianzaw-in amah a koihna thute khempeuh amaute tungah genin a lak hi.
Tua ciangin Haman in, "Tua tengbek hi nailo lai hi. Kumpinu Esther nangawn in ama bawlsa an kumpipa tawh a nekhawm dingin kei simloh midang kuamah paisaklo hi. Zing ciangin zong kumpipa tawh kei hong samkhawm hi.
Tua ciangin a zi Zeresh leh a lawmte khempeuh in ama kiangah, "Pi sawmsagihnga a sang khuam phutsak in la, tua tungah Mordekai a kikhailupna dingin zingciangin kumpipa kiangah gen in. Tua ciangin nitak an ne dingin lungnuam takin kumpipa tawh pai in," a ci uh hi. Haman in hih ngaihsutna hoihsa a, a khuam a phutsak hi.
Tua zanin kumpipa ihmu theilo a, nisim thupiang ciamtehna Khang Tangthu Laibu lasak a, ama zakin tua laibu kisim hi.
Tua banga a kisim ciangin, kongcingte sung panin innsungmang Bigthana leh Teresh in Kumpipa Ahasueras thah a sawmna thu pen Mordekai in a genna thu a kiciamtehna simkha uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Hih kiimnai-ah kua om ahi hiam?" a ci hi. Tua laitakin Mordekai thahna dingin a phuhsa khuam tungah Mordekai khailupna ding thu kumpipa kiangah a ngen dingin kumpi huang sungah Haman hong tum hi.
Tua ahih manin Haman in kumpipa kiangah, "Kumpipa in a pahtawi nop mipa-a' dingin
kumpipa mahmah in a silh kumpi puante, leh kumpipa a tuan'na sakol a lukhu tawh la sak in.
Tua ciangin kumpipa' ulianpen khat tungah tua kumpi puante leh sakol apsak in. Kumpipa in a pahtawi nop mipa pen amah zemsak in la, tua ciangin khuasung kongzing lampi-ah sakol tungah a tuangsa-in na ulian penpa kaisak in la, ama mai-ah kiko sakin, 'Kumpipa in a pahtawi nop mipa tungah hih bangin kibawl ding hi,' cisak in," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Haman kiangah, "Na cihsa bangin manlangin kumpi puante leh sakol la pah in la, kongpi-a om Jew mi Mordekai tungah hih thute khempeuh hih in. Na gensa khat beek sit kei in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Haman in kumpi puante leh sakol la-in Mordekai zem a, khuapi sung kongzing lampi-ah amah tuangsakin, "Kumpipa in a pahtawi nop mipa tungah hih bangin kibawl ding hi," ci-in a taangko hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa' kongpi-ah Mordekai ciahkik hi. Haman ahih leh kilukhuhsa-in a thum kawmin a inn-ah ciahpah vingveng hi.
Tua ciangin Haman in a zi Zeresh leh a lawmte khempeuh tungah ama tunga thupiang teng a gen hi. Tua ciangin a zi Zeresh leh a lawmte in ama kiangah, "Tu-a na lelhtak Mordekai pen Jew mi ahi hi; amah na zo kei ding a, amah in nang hong zozaw ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Kumpinu Esther tawh an a ne dingin kumpipa leh Haman va pai uh hi.

Bang hang hiam cih leh kei leh ka mite suksiat ding, thah ding, beisakmang dingin hong kizuak hi. Kote, numei pasal a kibangin sal dingin hong kizuak hi leh bangmah ka pau kei ding hi; tua bang lel tawh kumpipa nawngkaisak taaklo hi," a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Kumpipa Ahasueras in Kumpinu Esther leh Jew mi Mordekai tungah, "Haman in Jew mite thah hong sawm ahih manin sing tungah amah kikhailum khin a, Haman' neihsa khempeuh Esther' tungah kong pia khin hi.
Kumpipa' min tawh kigelhin, kumpipa' minthuhna tawh a kithuh khinsa lai pen kidokkik thei nawnlo ahih manin, tu-in Jew mite tawh kisai-in hoih dinga na up bangin kumpipa' min tawh gelh in la, tua khit ciangin kumpipa' minthuhna zungbuh tawh thuh in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a kha thumna ahi Sivan kha a ni sawmlethum ni-in kumpipa' lai-atte kisam a, Mordekai' gen bang teekteekin Jew mite tung leh India panin Ethiopia dong gam za khat leh sawmnihlesagih a uk ahi gam tampi a ukte, gam khat a ukte leh tua gamsunga uliante tungah lai kihawmkik a, amau' lai ciat leh amau' pau ciatin kigelh a, Jew mite-a' ding zong amau' lai leh amau' pau mahin kigelh hi.

Kei hong mu ngeipa in kei hong mukik nawnlo ding a, na hong et laitak mahin ka mangthang ding hi.
Meiilum kaite bei-in a man'than' bangin Leinuai-a paisukpa mangthang ding hi.
Ama inn-ah hong ciahkik nawnlo ding a, ama omna ngei mun in amah thei nawnlo ding hi.

a lauhuai mang nong man'sak a, a lauhuai maangmuhna tawh nong lausak hi.
zingsang simin gim a pia dingin ama kiangah pai-in amah na ze-et themthumna dingin mihing bang hi lel ahi hiam?

A hun lai-in Pasian zong in la, Vanglianpa' hehpihna ding thuum lecin,

A inn tungah kingam a, a inn hoi hi. A inn lencip a, ahi zongin kip zolo hi.
"Theitel in; Pasian in cikmah hunin mawhbaanglo mite nilkhialo ding a, gamtatsia mite huh ngeilo ding hi.

Mi khatpeuh Pasian tawh thu a kinial ding hi leh tul khat sungah khatvei nangawn dawng theilo ding hi.
Amah in ni a suaklo dingin thu pia a, aksite sincip hi.
Amah pen vana a om Khawlei-uikai, Zawlzawng, Seguk, leh Khanglam aksite a bawlpa ahi hi.
Amah in kuama theih zawhloh na lian tampi bawl a, kuama simzawhloh na lamdang tampi sem hi.

Tua ahih ciangin keimah in bangci dawn' theih ding a, amah ka nialna ding kammal bangci muh ding ka hi hiam?
Kei ka dik hangin amah ka dawng thei kei hi. Kei hong mawhsakpa tungah hong hehpih ding ka nget kul hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh thu themno khat hangin nakpi takin kei hong hih a, thu omlopi-in gimna tampi hong thuaksak hi.

Kei ka dik hangin keima kam mah siksanin kei hong man ding a, mawhbaanglo ka hih hangin keima kampau hong lehheisak ding hi.

Amah ka dawn' theihna dingin amah, kei bangin mi hilo a, thukhen zumah thu kineihpih theih hilo hi.

"Pasian a thahat mahmah hi napi-in, kuamah simmawhlo hi. Amah in a theihloh bangmah omlo hi.
A gamtatsiatna panun a khawlna dingun amau' bil sungah thu a gengen hi.
Amaute in Pasian' thu mangin ama na sem le uh amaute nuamsa-in a khan' uh a sau hi.
"Migilote a hehin nitum uh a, gimna a thuak ciang nangawnun ama huh ding ngenlo uh hi.
Amaute khan'sih uh a, a zumhuaipi-in a bei uh hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in gimna tawh mite thuhilh a, khua a phawktheihna dingun gimna a zang ahi hi.
Sumgolh' khemsa-in gamta kei in la, leitung nate' bawlin lam kipialsak kei in.
Huh ding na nget hangin a phattuamna om nawnlo a, na hauhna na liatna in hong huh thei nawnlo hi.
Mihingte a beimang hun ding, zan khuamial hong tun' hun ding lunggulh kei in.
Siatna lamah na kihei khaklohna ding limtakin kidawm in. Na siat khaklohna dingin gimna hong kithuaksak ahi hi.
Pasian' gamtatzia ding kuamah in sawl theilo a, Pasian gamtatsia hi, ci-in kuamah in zong mawhsak zolo hi.
Mi khempeuh in Pasian' sepsate mu uh a, theikim zolo uh ahih manin lamdang a sa uh hi.
Amah in meii sung panin guah piangsak a, mihing khempeuh-a' dingin guah a zusak hi.
Meiite a pai henhanna hita leh, vanah van a gin'na hita leh kuamah in thei zolo hi.
Amah a heh ciangin huihpi sam a, vanging pen ama hong paina ding a kitheihna ahi hi.
Amah in vanah khua phiasak a, leimong khat pan mong khat dong a taan' hi.
Pasian' sawlna tawh na lamdangpipi piang a, eite' theih zawhloh thute a hong piang hi.
Pasian' husan'na in tuite khalsak a, tui lianpite khalin sik bangin a sak hi.
"Job aw, tawlkhat khawlin ngai in la, Pasian' bawlsa na lamdangte ngaihsun dih in.

Pasian tawh kiho theihna ding ka ngen kei ding hi. Kei hong suksiatna dingin kei kipia ding ka hi hiam?
"Tawlkhat sung khuavak kimu vetlo a, guah leh meii in a liah hi. Tua ciangin huih hong nungin tuate khempeuh a mutsiang hi.
Kham meel khuavak leilu lam pan hong taang a, Pasian' minthan'na pen zahtakna tawh kidimsak hi.
Pasian vanglian mahmah a, eite' theihzawh hilo hi. Amah thuman mahmah a, thutang takin na a sem hi.
Tua ahih manin mi khempeuh in amah a zahtakna, mipil a kisate amah in a donlohna, lamdangsak ding hilo hi." a ci hi.

Nuamtakin a om hithiat numeite aw, tho un la, ka aw za un. Nomau' tumtakin a lungkim tanute aw, ka thugenna na ngai un.
Nomau' tumtakin a lungkim numeite aw, kum khat val zek khit ciangin na linglawng ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh leenggah kum hong sia ding a, singgah lawhna hun hong tunglo ding hi.
Nuamtakin a om hithiat numeite aw, ling un. Nomau tumtakin a lungkimte aw, linglawng un. Na puan uh hawkkhia-in na tangguakun om un la na kawng uhah puanhampi teng un.

{ Topa } in namsau khat nei hi. Sisan tawh kidim ding a, biakpiakna tuuno si leh keel si, tuutalte' kal thau tawh a kizolsak bang ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in Bozrah khua-ah hih biakpiakna nei ding a, Edom gamah hih bang tampi thahna omsak ding hi.

'Sairas kumpipa pen ka tuucingpa hi a, ka deihna teng tungsak ding hi,' a cipa; 'Jerusalem kilamkik ding a,' biakinn pen, 'Na bulpi kiphutkik ding hi,' a ci { Topa } ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Kulhkongpi sungah a lut theihna dingin ama mai-ah kongkhakte a hon'sak ding, kumpite' vangliatnate a lakkhiatsak ding, ama mai-ah minam dangte a zawhsak dingin, a taklam khutin a let, a sathau nilhpa Sairas tungah { Topa } in hih bangin ci hi:
"Nangma min tawh nang a hong sampa pen Israel Pasian, { Topa}, keimah ka hihna thu na theihna dingin, nangma mai-ah kei pai-in mualte zalhmai-in, sumngo kongkhakte satzanin a sikzawlte ka sattan ding a, a mialna mun sunga om sum kikoihte, mun simthama sum kiseelte, nangma tungah kong pia ding hi.
Ka nasempa Jakob, ka teelsa Israel ka ngaihsutna-in nang pen na minin kong sam a, nong theihloh hangin min thak kong phuak hi.
"Kei pen { Topa } ka hi hi. Kuamah dang omlo a, keimah simloh Pasian dang omlo hi. Nisuahna lam pan hita leh, nitumna lam pan hita leh, kei simloh adang a omlohna thu mite in a theihna dingin, nong theihloh hangin a kisam thahatna nang ka hong guan hi. Kei pen { Topa } ka hi a, adang kuamah omlo hi.
Keimah in khuavak leh khuamial piangsakin, a pha nate leh a sia nate ka piangsak a, hih nate khempeuh a bawlpa, keimah { Topa } ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Vantungte aw, tunglam panin thuman zusak un la, vantungte in thumanna buasuk ta un. Hotkhiatna a pokhiat theihna dingin leitang kihongsak un la, thumanna zong pokhiato sak un. Keimah { Topa } in hih thu ka bawl khinzo hi.
Amah a Bawlpa tawh a kido mipa, beelsekpa tawh a kilehdo lei beel in gimna ngah ta hen! Tungman in amah a sekpa kiangah, "Nang in bang bawl na hi hiam, na na bawl in khutlet neilo hi," ci-in a thu sel ngam ahi hiam?
A pa kiangah, "Nangmah in kua piangsak na hi hiam?" a cipa hita leh, a nu kiangah, "Nang in nausuak dingin kua gimpih na hi hiam?" a cipa in gimna ngah ta hen!
Amah a Bawlpa, Israel-te' Siangtho Pa, { Topa } in hih bangin ci hi: "Nang in keima tate' thu hong dongin, ka khut tawh ka bawlsa tawh kisaite-ah thu hong pia ding na hi hiam?
Thu a manin a sem dingin amah khua ka phawksak a, keimah in ama lampi khempeuh ka mamsak ding hi. Amah in nasep thaman ahi a, letsong ahi zongin ngaihsun loin keima khuapi lam ding a, salin a om ka mite a khahkhia ding hi," Vanglian { Topa } in ci hi.
{ Topa } in Israel tungah, "Egypt' hauhna leh Ethiopia sumbuk vante leh a tun a sang Seba mite nangma kiangah hong pai-in nangma-a' hong hi ding uh a, amaute in nang hong zui ding uh hi. Amaute sikkhau kibulhsa-in hong pai ding uh a, nangma kiangah hong kun ding uh hi. Amaute in nangma kiangah thumna hong bawl ding uh a, 'Nangmah bek tawh Pasian omkhawm a, kuamah dang omloin, amah simloh pasian dang omlo hi,' hong ci ding uh hi.
Milim a bawl mite khempeuh in maizumna thuakin cihna ding theiloin om ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin { Topa } in Israel-te honkhia hi. A tawntungin gualzo ding uh a, cikmah hunin maizumna thuak ngeilo ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Vantungte a piangsakpa (amah Pasian!) Leitung piangsakin a bawlpa (a kipsakpa; a awngthawl dingin bawlloin, ten'na dingin leitung a piangsakpa!) { Topa } in hih bangin ci hi: "Kei pen { Topa } ka hi a, kuamah dang omlo hi.
Keimah in mun simtham, khuamialna gamsungah thu ka gen kei hi. Jakob suanlekhakte tungah, 'A awngthawl mun sungah kei hong zong un,' ka ci kei hi. Keimah { Topa } in thuman ka gen a, a man nate ka pulak hi.
"Minamte sung panin a suaktalai note aw, nomau kikaikhawmin hong pai un la, hong nai un! Sing milim a pua kawikawi mite in theihna neilo uh a, a honkhia theilo pasian tungah thu ngenngen uh hi.
Na thu uh sung un la, hong gen un. Na thu uh kikum khawm un! Hih thu sawtpekin kua in gen ahi hiam? Tanglai-in kua in pulak ahi hiam? Keimah { Topa } hilo ka hi hiam? Thuman Pasian leh Honpa ahi, kei simloh pasian dang omlo a, kei simloh kuamah dang omlo hi.
"Leitung mi khempeuhte aw, kei lamah hong kihei un la hotkhiatna ngah un! Bang hang hiam cih leh kei pen Pasian ka hi a, kuamah dang omlo hi.
Keimahmah ka kiciam khin a, a kikhelkik ngei nawnlo ding thukip hih bang ahi hi: 'Keima mai-ah mi khempeuh hong khukdin' ding a, keima tungah thuman ding hong kiciam ding hi,' cihna, kei' kamsung panin thumanna tawh pusuakkhia khinzo hi.
{ Topa}' hang bekin gualzawhna leh thahatna kingah hi, hong kici ding hi. Kei hong mudahte khempeuh mindai-in maizum ding uh hi.
Israel suanlekhakte khempeuh, { Topa}' hangin gualzo-in a kisial ding uh hi.
"Bel pasian puksukin, Nebo pasian kunsuk a, tua milimte pen ganhing leh bawngte tungah kipua hi. Note' puak hih nate pen a gim mahmah ganhingte tungah a kisuan vangik bangin note tungah hong gik hi.
Amaute kunin, amaute puksuk khawm uh a, amaute in vangik pengsak theilo uh a, amaute mahmah zong galte' matna sungah tung uh hi.
"Na suaha kipan kong tawi, gilsung pana kong puak, Jakob innkuan, Israel innkuan a suakta laite khempeuh aw, keima thu hong ngai un.
Na tek dongun kei pen Amah ka hi a, na sam uh a kan' hun dongin note kong kem ding hi. Ka hong bawlkhin a, ka hong don ding hi. Keimah in hong tawi-in ka hong honkhia ding hi.
Amaute in tua pasian pen a liangko tung uhah ngato-in pua uh a, ama omna ding munah a koih uh hi. Tua a koihna-ah a milim om niloh hi. Ama omna panin kinkhia theilo hi. Mi khatpeuh in amah sam leh amah in dawng theilo a, ama lungkhamna panin zong a honkhia thei kei hi.
Hun lui thute phawk un; bang hang hiam cih leh kei pen Pasian ka hi a, adang omlo hi. Kei pen Pasian ka hi a, kei tawh a kibang adang omlo hi.
A kipat cilin a tawpna ding thu ka pulak a, tanglai pek panin a piang nailo nate genin, 'Ka thugen kip ding a, ka ngimna khempeuh ka tungsak ding hi,' ka ci hi.
Suahtakna ding hun ka hong tungsak ta a, gamla nawnlo hi. Ka hong hotkhiat ding hun zekai nawnlo ding hi. Keima minthan'na ahi Israel-a' dingin Jerusalem ka honkhia ding hi," a ci hi.
Nungak a bang Babylon aw, hong paisuk in la, leivui lakah tu in. Nungak a bang Khaldea aw, tokhom omlohna leilakah hong tusuk in! Bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen a moi milmel, a ngeek dikdek, hong kici nawnlo ding hi.
An gawina suangte hei in la, an gawi in. Na kikhuhna puan lakhia in la, na nik na puan suahin gunte kantan in.
Na selsim teng kilang ding a, na zumhuaina teng kimu ding hi. Keimah in kong thukkik ding a, kuamah ka zah kei ding hi.
Israel-te' Siangtho Pa in eite hong suaktasak a, ama min pen Vanglian { Topa } ahi hi.
Babylon aw, gamdai takin tu in la, khuamialna sungah pai in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen kumpi gamte' tonu, hong kici nawnlo ding hi.
Ka mite tungah ka heh a, ka luah gamh ka ninsak hi. Nangma khutsungah amaute kong pia a, nangmah in amaute na hehpih bawl kei hi. A khangham mite nangawn na ngong bawl mahmah hi.
Nangmah in, "Tonu ka hi tawntung ding hi," ci na hih manin hih thute na lungsimah koihloin, a thumongte zong na phawkkha kei hi.
Aisan siamnate leh mibum siamna vang lianpi na neih hangin ta khuaisuahna leh meigon'na, hih thu nihte thakhat thu-in ni khat sungin a kicing takin nangma tungah hong tung veve ding hi.
Na gitlohna-ah nang na lungmuang a, "Kuamah in kei hong mu kei hi," na ci hi. Na pilna leh na theihnate in lam hong pialsak a, na lungsim sungah, "Keimah hi'ng, kei simloh midang om kei," na ci hi.
Ahih hangin nangmah in na beisak theihloh lungkhamna na tungah hong tung ding a, nangmah in maisakna na ngah theihloh gimna nang tungah hong tung ding hi. A thu na theih hetloh siatna na tungah hong tungvat ding hi.
Na neulai-a kipan na sep na mibumna leh na aisannate-ah kiptakin om in. Phattuamna na ngah khading a, mite na lausakzo khading hi.
Nang tungah a hong kilak thu tampite hangin na gim hi. Vantungte a sehin khenin, aksite en a, khadet simin nang tunga thupiang ding a hong genkhol mite tu-in dingsak in la, nangmah kihonsak in.
En in, amaute pen buhkung tawh kibang uh a, mei in amaute kangtum hi. Meikuang' vangliatna panin amau leh amau kihontawm theilo uh hi. Hih pen khua lumna ding mei-am hilo a, awi ding mei zong hilo hi.
Nang tawh na a semkhawm, na neu lai-a kipan nang tawh na a semkhawmte tungah hih thute hong tung ding hi. Amaute pen amau' tum ciatah zauvak uh a, nang a hong hon ding kuamah omlo hi.
Israel min tawh a kilo, Judah sung panin a piangkhia, { Topa}' min tawh thu ciam napi-in, thuman thutak tawh Israel Pasian a pulaklo Jakob innkuan aw, hih thu ngai un.
Note tua bang hinapi-in, khuapi siangtho sungah a teng mite ihi a, Israel Pasian i muang hi. Ama min pen Vanglian { Topa } ahi hi, ci-in kisaktheihna-in na neizaw lai uh hi.
Note pen paupengin na ngawng uh sik thagui bang hi a, na thatang uh sumngo bangin a sakna thei khin ka hih manin,
note in, "Ka milim un hihte bawl a, a kisui ka milim uh leh a kisung ka milim un thu pia hi," na cih theihlohna dingun tanglai-a kipanin note tungah hih thute kong gen a, tuate hong pian' ma-in note tungah kong zasakkhol hi.
Ka gensa thu khempeuh hong tungta ahih manin, na gennate a man hi, na hong cih ding uh hita hi. Tu-a kipanin na a thakte, na theih ngeiloh uh hong tung ding a ki-im nate kong gen ding hi.
Hihte pen tuhunin a piangsak ka hi a, a beisa hunah hih bang piang nailo hi. A piang khinsa thu hi leh, ka theihsa uh thu hi, na ci khading uh hi.
Note pen muan'theih ding na hihlohna uh, na suah tung uh-a kipan mi lehdo thei na hihna uh ka hong thei hi. Tua ahih manin hih thute na za ngei kei uh a, zong na thei ngei kei uh hi.
Note khempeuh kong suksiat khaklohna dingin ka min ka ngaihsutna tawh ka hehna diahin, keimah hong kiphatna ka ngaihsutna-in note tungah ka ki-ip hi.
Meikhuk sungah ngun a kisian'sak bangin gimna meikhuk sungah note kong ze-et hi. Ahi zongin note bangmahin a kimanglo na hihna uh hong kimu khin hi.
Keimah ka kikhualna, keimah ka kingaihsutna-in hih bangin kong hih hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka min a siat ding kilawm ahi hiam? Midang khat tungah keima minthan'na ka pia kei ding hi.
Note khempeuh hong kikhawm un la hong za un! Amaute sung panin kua in hih ka sep ding nate genkhol thei ahi hiam? Ka teelsa mipa in Babylon tungah keima ngimna sem ding a, Khaldea mite' langkhatah kei ka pang ding hi.
Kei, keimah in thu genin amah ka sam a, kei in amah ka pan'pih a, amah a dau pai ding hi.
Kei kiangah hong nai un la, hih thu hong za un. A kipat cila kipanin a simthamin thu ka gen ngei kei a, tua thu a pian'-a kipanin kei ka om hi. (Tu-in Topa { Pasian } in kei tungah a vangliatna hong pia a, kei hong sawl hi.)
Israel-te' Siangtho Pa, nangmah hong hon { Topa } in: Phattuamna na ngahna dingin nang a hong hilh, na zuih ding a kilawm lampi-ah a hong paipih { Topa } na Pasian ka hi hi.
Na tu leh na tate sehnel zah pha ding a, na suanlekhakte sehnel vui zah pha ding hi. Keima mai-ah amaute' min kiphiatkhia lo ding a, kisusia ngeilo ding hi, a ci hi.
Babylon panin paikhia-in Khaldea gam panin tai in la, lungdamna tawh hih thu genin taangko in la, leimong dongin puak in. "{ Topa } in ama nasem Jakob honkhia khinzo!" ci-in gen kawikawi in.
Amah in sehnel gam kantanin amaute a paipih ciangin a dang uh taaklo hi. Suangpi panin amau-a' dingin amah in tui a luangsak hi. Amah in suangpi khangkhamsak a, tui a phulkhia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin migilote-a' dingin nopna omlo hi, { Topa } in ci hi.
Tuipi gei-a om gamte aw, ka thu ngai un. Gamlapi-a om mihingte aw, ka thu ngai un. Ka suah ma-in { Topa } in kei hong teel a, ka nu sungah ka om lai-in amah in keima min hong pulak khin hi.
Amah in kei kiangah, "Nang pen keimah hong kiminthan'sakna ding ka nasempa Israel na hi hi," a hong ci hi.
Ahih hangin keimah in, "Na ka sem a, ahi zongin a kiman'na omlo hi. Ka thatang khempeuh ka beisak a, ahi zongin bangmah ka tangtun' kei hi. Ahi zongin { Topa } in a manin na hong sem ding, ci-in ka muang a, ka sep thaman hong pia ding hi, ci-in ka um hi," ka ci hi.
Ama kiangah Jakob kipaipih kikin, ama kiangah Israel-te a kikaihkhop theihna dingin { Topa}' mai-ah kei hong kipahtawi a, Pasian pen keima thahatna suakin, ama nasem dingin ka nu sung panin keimah a hong piangsak { Topa } in tu-in thu hong gen hi.
Amah in, "Jakob minamte a laamto ding leh a suaktalai Israel mite a ngei uh a bangsakkik dingin keima nasem na hihna pen a baih lua mahmah nasep ahi hi. Keima hotkhiatna in leimong dong a phak theihna dingin minam dangte tungah khuavak ahi dingin nang kong pia ding hi," hong ci hi.
Israel a honpa leh ama Siangtho Pa ahi { Topa } in nakpi takin simmawhna a thuak, minamte in a muhdah, gam ukte' nasempa tungah: "Nangmah a hong teel Israel-te' Siangtho Pa, a thuman { Topa}' hangin mite na hotkhiatna thu kumpite in a muh uh ciangin zahtakna tawh na mai-ah hong ding ding uh a, na mai-ah uliante hong kun ding uh hi," hong ci hi.
{ Topa } in ama mite kiangah, "Note hotkhiat ding hun a hong tun' ciangin maipha kong pia ding a, huhna nong ngetna uh ka hong pia ding hi. Note hong kemin ka hong hu ding a, note' tung tawnin mi khempeuh tawh thuciamna ka bawl ding hi. A kinusia na gamsung uhah note kong tengsakkik ding hi.
Thongkia mite tungah, 'Hong paikhia un,' ci-in, khuamial sunga om mite tungah, 'Hong pusuak un,' ka ci ding hi. Amaute pen lam tawntungah an a ne, mual pawn a sang munte khempeuhah nuamtakin a gamta tuute tawh kibang ding uh hi.
Amaute gilkial loin, dangtaklo ding uh a, huihsa leh nisa in amaute sukha lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute a hehpihpa in amaute lamkaih ding a, ciktui kiangah amaute paipih ding hi.
"Keimah in ka mite-a' dingin mual liante kantanin lampi ka ziiksak ding a, ka lam lianpite-ah phung ka ciang ding hi.
Ka mite a gamlapi panin hong pai ding uh a, leilu lam gam leh nitumna lam gamte panin amaute hong pai-in, pawlkhatte, leitaw lam Siene gam panin hong ciah ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Vantungte aw, lungdamin la sa un. Leitung aw, lungdamin diang in. Mual liante aw, lungdamin la sa-in awngkhia un! Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in ama mite hehnem ta a, gimna a thuak ama mite hehpih ta ding hi.
Ahih hangin Jerusalem mite in, "{ Topa } in eite hong nusia khin a, hong mangngilh khinta hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin { Topa } in, "Ama sung panin a suak a tapa a hehpihlo ding zahin nupi khat in ama nawi a teep naungek mangngilh thei ding ahi hiam? Hihte nangawn in mangngilhkha thei ding a, ahi zongin keimah in kong mangngilh kei ding hi.
Na kimkotah khuadakto in la mu in. Na mi khempeuh hong kikhawm uh a, nangma kiangah amaute hong ciah uh hi. Kei pen a nungta { Topa} ka hih mah bangin, na mite khempeuh hangin nang na kisial ding a, mothak in kizepna-in a zat bangin amaute khempeuh na zang ding hi.
"A kisia, a kinusia khinsa nangma munte leh a kisusia nangma gam pen nangma tungah a teng mite-a' dingin tu-in kawcik lua ta ding a, nang hong valhtum mite, gamlapi-ah om ding uh hi.
Na kikhen hun uh, salin a om sungun a suak mite in nangma kiangah, 'Kote-a' dingin mun kawcik lua hi; ka omna ding uh mun hong bawlsak in,' hong ci ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin na lungsimah, 'Kua in keima-a' dingin hih mite hong hin'khiatsak ahi hiam? Kei hong kinusia-in tang-awlin ka om a, salin hong kikoihin hong kipaikhiatpih hi. Hihte kua in hong khoisak ahi hiam? Keimah guakin hong kinusia hi. Tua ahih manin koi lai panin hihte hong piang ahi hiam?' na ci ding hi," a ci hi.
Topa { Pasian } in, "En in, minamte tungah ka khut ka laamto ding a, mite tungah ka lim ka lakto ding hi. Amaute in a angsung uhah na tapate tawi-in hong paipih ding uh a, a liangko tung uhah na tate hong pua ding uh hi.
Kumpite pen nang hong kem na pate hong hi ding a, kumpinute pen nang hong khoi na nute hong hi ding hi. Amaute in a maitang uh leilak ngatin nang kiangah hong kun ding uh a, na khe-a leivui baangte a liak ding uh hi. Tua ciangin kei pen { Topa } ka hihna na hong thei ding hi. Kei hong muangte maizumlo ding hi," a ci hi.
A thahatpa' kiang panin nate kilakhia zo ding a, thukhauhpa' mat mite kihonkhia zo ding ahi hiam?
{ Topa } in, "A thahatpa' mat salte kilakhia ding a, a thukhauhpa' na kilakhia ding hi. Nang hong dem mite keimah in ka dem ding a, na tate ka honkhia ding hi.
Nang hong nengniam mite pen amau' satak mah ka nesak ding a, zukham bangin amau' si mah a kham ding uh hi. Tua ciangin kei pen Jakob' Vanglian Pa, nang hong Tankhiapa, nang hong Hon { Topa } ka hihna mi khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in, "Amah ka ciahsakna, na nu a kimakna lai koi-ah om ahi hiam? Tua ahih kei leh nang kong zuakna ka leibatnate koi pan ahi hiam? Nomau mawhna hangin note hong kizuak a, nomau khialhna hangin na nu uh kipaikhiasak hi.
"Kong pai ciangin bang hangin mi khat zong omlo ahi hiam? Kong sap ciangin bang hangin hong dawng ding khat zong omlo ahi hiam? Hong hon zolo zah dingin ka khut hatlo lua ahi hiam? Tua ahih kei leh zong note khahkhiatna ding vangliatna neilo ka hi hiam? Keima taina tawh tuipi ka keusak a, gunte pen sehnel gam ka suaksak hi. Tui omloh manin a ngasate dangtakin si-in a uih gawp hi.
Vantungte khuamial ka silhsak a, amau' kituamna dingin puanhampi ka bawl hi," a ci hi.
A lunggim mite ka thahatsak theihna dingin Topa { Pasian } in ka gen ding thu hong hilh khin hi. Ama hong hilhnate a ngai dingin zingsang simin lawpna hong guan' hi.
Topa { Pasian } in thu theihtelna hong guan' hi. Amah ka lehdo kei a, zong ka nungngat kei hi.
Hong satte, ka nung ka dawh a, ka khamulin a hong kai mite, ka paang ka dawh hi. Maizumna leh cilphihna panin ka maitang ka hei kei hi.
Topa { Pasian } in kei hong huh hi. Tua ahih ciangin cihna ding theiloin ka om kei hi. Tua ahih manin ka thuak tentan a, hong maizumsak lo ding hi, ci-in ka thei hi.
Ka thumanna a langsak Pasian a nai-ah hong om hi. Keima langkhatah kua hong pangzo ding ahi hiam? Thukhen zumah kikhia nu'ng. Thukhen zumah kua in hong khia nuam ahi hiam? Kei hong langpang dingin hong kuan ta hen.
Topa { Pasian } in kei hong huh hi. Kua in kei mawh hi, ci-in gen thei ding ahi hiam? Amaute khempeuh puan bangin paatkhia ding uh a, nget in amaute netum ding hi.
{ Topa } kihta a, a nasempa' thu a mangte khempeuh khuamial sungah na pai hangun { Topa } muang un la, Pasian suan'in nei un.
Midang suksiat ding a sawm mite aw, note' vaihawm siatna mah in note hong susia ding hi. { Topa}' khut tung panin gimna thuakin na lumsuk ding uh hi.
{ Topa } in, "Hotkhiat ding a ut, { Topa } a zongte aw, ngai un. Note hong ki-eu khiatna suangpi, note hong kitawhkhiatna khuk en un.
Na pa uh Abraham leh note' pian'na Sarah ngaihsun dih un. Bang hang hiam cih leh khat bek ahih laitakin amah ka samkhia a, amah thupha pia-in tampi ka phasak hi.
"Tu-in Zion ka hehnem ding hi. A kisia ama munte khempeuh puahpha-in, ama gamlakte Eden huansung ka bangsak ding a, ama sehnel gamte { Topa}' huan ka bangsak ding hi. Ama sungah lungdamna leh kipahna, lungdam kohna leh lasakna awging om ding hi.
"Ka mite aw, ka thugen hong ngai un. Minamte tungah thu ka hilh a, keima thukham in amaute tungah khuavak tun' ding hi.
Dakto-in vantungte en un la, leitung zong ensuk un. Bang hang hiam cih leh meikhu bangin vantungte mangthang hi. Puan bangin leitung paatkhia ding a, ama tunga tengte pen thokang bangin si ding uh hi. Ahih hangin keima hotkhiatna kip tawntung ding a, keima khahkhiatna bei ngeilo ding hi.
"Thuman a thei, na lungsim sung uhah keima thu a vom mite aw, ka thu ngai un. Mihingte' kosiatna kihta kei un la, amaute' hong simmawhna hangin lungkia kei un.
