Josiah' tapa Jehoiakim kumpi a suah ciangin { Topa } in Jeremiah a hopih leuleu hi. Tua khit ciangin Josiah' tapa Zedekiah kumpi a suahzawh kum sawm leh kum khat a phak kum, a kha ngana, Jerusalem khua mite sal tang dingin a kipuakkhiat dong tam veipi a hopihpih hi.
{ Topa } in kei hong hopih a,
Tua ciangin keimah in, "Ah, Topa { Pasian } aw, kei thugen ka siam kei a, naupang khat ka hi lel hi," ka ci hi.
Ahih hangin { Topa } in, "'Naupang khat ka hi lel hi,' ci kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh kong puakna khempeuhte kiangah na pai ding a, kong sawl peuhpeuh na gen ding hi.
Amaute kihta kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah a hong hu dingin ka hong ompih hi, { Topa } in kong ci hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in a khut tawh hong zam phei-in ka muk hong lawn'sakin hong hopih hi. "En in, ka thute na kamsungah kong koih khinzo hi.
Gam khempeuh leh kumpi khempeuhte' tungah a botkhia ding leh a phelkhia dingin ahi zongin, a susia ding leh a lawnkhia dingin ahi zongin, a lam ding leh a phut dingin ahi zongin, tuni-in za, nang kong piazo hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in kei tungah, "Jeremiah aw, bang mu na hi hiam?" ci-in hong dong hi. Kei zong, "Ngak, a kici almond singhiang khat ka mu hi," ci-in ka dawng hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in, "Na man hi; bang hang hiam cih leh ka thugente ka tangtun'sakna dingin kei zong ka ngak hi," hong ci hi.
{ Topa } in a nihveina hong hopih leuleu a, "Bang na mu hiam?" ci-in hong dong hi. Kei zong, "Beel a so khat ka mu a, leilu lam panin hong awnsuk hi," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in, "Leilu lam panin hih gammi khempeuhte' tungah siatna hong sosuk ding hi.
Tua ahih manin Jeremiah aw, kithawi in. Pai in la kong sawl khempeuh amaute kiangah va gen in. Amaute kihta kei in; na kihtak leh amau' mai-ah kong lausakzaw lai ding hi.
En in, hih gambup langah a ding ding, Judah kumpite, uliante, siampite leh hih gammi khempeuh langah a pang dingin tuni-in nang, khuapi muan'huai khat bang ahi zongin, sikkhuampi khat bangin ahi zongin, sumngo kulhpi khat bangin ahi zongin ka hong bawl hi.
Amaute in nang' langkhatah hong do ding uh hi. Ahih hangin a hong zo kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, nangmah a hong hu dingin ka hong ompih ding hi," a hong ci hi.
"Pai in la, Jerusalem khuamite' zak dingin va taangko in. { Topa } in kong cihin-ah: Na khangno lai-a nong kipiakna, na mothak lai-a nong itna, a kikho nailo gamlakah kei' nung nong zuih lai hun ka phawk hi.
Israel mite pen { Topa}-a' dingin a tuam om hi a, ama anlakna-ah a anpalte ahi uh hi. Amaute a ne peuhpeuh a mawh suak uh a, gimna a thuak uh hi, { Topa } in hong ci hi, ci-in va gen in," hong ci hi.
Jakob suan leh Israel innkuan khempeuhte aw, { Topa' } kammal ngai dih un.
{ Topa } in hih bangin ci hi: "Na pute na pate uh kei kiang panin gamlapi-ah paikhia-in, bangmahin a kimanglo milim peuh bia-in, amau mahmah zong bangmahin a kimanglo a suah khitna dingun kei tungah bang mawhna hong mu uh ahi hiam?
Amaute in, 'Egypt gam panin eite hong paikhiatpihin sehnel lak leh dum lak, lei keu lak leh a lauhuai khuamial bekbak lak, kuama pai ngeilohna mun, kuama ten'lohna gamlakah a hong makaih { Topa } koi-ah om ahi hiam?' ci beeklo uh hi.
Singgah leh a hoih nate na nek theihna dingun an tamna munah kong tun'pih hi. Ahih hangin no nong pai uh ciangin ka gam na ninsak uh a, ka neihsa leitang a kihhuai mun na suaksak tazen uh hi.
Siampite in, '{ Topa } koi-ah om ahi hiam?' ci-in donglo uh hi. Thukham a theite nangawn in kei hong theilo uh hi. Kei tungah kumpi uliante hong khial khin uh a, kamsangte in Baal min tawh thu genin kiman'na a neilo milimte a bia uh hi.
"Tua ahih manin { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, note kong mawhsaklai ding a, na tate uh' tate zong ka mawhsak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nitumna lamah Saipras tuikulh mong dong kantan un la va en dih un. Nisuahna lamah Kedar gamah mi sawl un la limtakin kan dih un; tua bang thu a piang ngei peuhmah hiam, en dih un.
Gam khat peuhpeuh in pasian ahi taktak beeklo a pasian-te uh nangawn a khek ngei peuhmah uh hiam? Ahih hangin ka mite in a minthan'na uh ahi keimah, bangmahin a kimanglo na peuh tawh hong khek tazen uh hi.
Tua thu phawk un la lau un; vantungte aw, dah mahmah un la ling un, { Topa } in kong ci hi.
"Israel sal ahi hiam? Sila namte ahi zenzen hiam? Hilo ahih leh bang hangin a galte in luhgawpzo ahi hiam?
Humpinelkai bangin a galte in amah hawksan uh a, nakpi takin a hawkgawp uh hi. A gam uh gam simtham a suah uh a, a khuapite uh cimin kuamah tenglo hi.
Thamloin, Memfis leh Tahpanhes mite in zong a luguh a suktapsak zo uh hi.
Israel aw, { Topa } na Pasian in lampi-ah hong makaih laitakin amah na nusiat manin nang tungah hih bang teng hong tung hilo ahi hiam?
Na gitlohna mah in nangmah hong thuhilh ding a, kei na hong up nawnlohna in nangmah hong mawhsak ding hi. { Topa } na Pasian nong nusia a, keimah nong kihtak nawnloh ciangin, nuam hetloin kha velval hi, cih thu thei in la mu in, Vanglian Topa { Pasian } in ka hong ci hi.
"Sawtpek lai-a kipanin ka hakkol kuaitanin ka ukna nong nial a, hong kihenna khau sutatin, 'Na na ka sem kei ding hi,' na hong ci hi. Numei paktatte na bang uh a, mual sang tung teng leh sing liim nuai tengah milim na bia kawikawi uh hi.
A kiteelteel leenggui ci hoihte bangin nang kong suankik zo a, ahih hangin nang kisia kikin bang hangin leenggah gui a hoihlote na suakkik na hi hiam?
Vuttui tawh kisilin satpiang tampi na zang zongin na mawhna nin ka mu lai veve hi, Topa { Pasian } in kong ci hi.
Bangci bangin nangmah in, 'Kei ka nin kei hi. Baal pasian-te' nung ka zui kei hi,' bang hangin ci thei ding na hi hiam? Mualkuam zangah a om na lampi totte ento in la, na hihsate mu dih in. A suktai a totai kawikawi kalaoh huk na bang tazen hi.
Na khe guakin lam pai kei in la, na dang taaksak kei in, kong cih hangin, nangmah in, 'Bang phamawh ahi hiam? Gamdang pasian-te ka it a, amau' nung ka zui ding hi,' na ci hi.
"Guta khatpeuh a kimat ciangin a zum bangin, Israel mite, a kumpite, a uliante, a siampite, leh a kamsangte uh zong a maizum ding uh hi.
Amaute in singtawng khat kiangah, 'Nang pen ka pasian na hi hi,' ci uh a, suangtum khat kiangah, 'Ka pian'na ka nu na hi hi,' peuh a ci uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in kei hong nungngatin hong maingatlo uh hi. Ahih hangin haksatna a tuah uh ciangin, 'Tho in la hong hon in,' hong ci uh hi.
"Note-a' dinga na bawl uh na pasian-te uh koi-ah om ahi hiam? Haksatna na tuah uh ciangin a hong hon thei ahih leh kihonsak ta un; bang hang hiam cih leh Judah gam aw, na khuapi zahzah uh pasian na nei tazen uh hi.
Kei na hong mawhsakna uh bang thu teng tawh ahi hiam? Na vekpi-un kei nong langpan' khin uh hi, { Topa } in kong ci hi.
Na tate uh thuhilhin ka sat hangin a mawkna suakzo ta hi. Amaute kibawlpha tuanlo uh hi. Humpinelkai hawk bangin na namsaute un na kamsangte uh a that khinzo uh hi.
No Israel mite aw, { Topa' } kammal limtakin ngai dih un. Israel-te-a' dingin gamlak tawh kibang ngei ka hi hiam? A mial mahmah gam tawh kibang ngei ka hi hiam? Tua ahih leh bang hangin ka mite in, 'Ko ka suakta uh hi; nang kiangah kong pai nawn kei ding uh hi,' ci uh ahi hiam?
Nungak khat in a kizepnate mangngilh thei ahi hiam? A kipi mothak in a mothak puante mangngilh thei ahi hiam? Ahih hangin ka mite in simzawhloh ni tampi sung a hong mangngilh uh hi.
Na lawm ngaih ding na zon' siam mahmah a, numei gilote nangawn a zia na hilh thei zen hi.
Mawhneilo mizawngte' sisan na puan tungah baang hi. Amaute in na inn hong luhngei beeklo uh hi. "Tua bang teng hinapi-in
nang in, 'Kei ka mawh kei hi, kei tungah Pasian heh nawnlo hi,' na ci hi. En in, 'Kei ka mawh kei hi,' na cih manin nang tungah thu kong khen ding hi.
Bang hangin na lungsim khel ziauziau na hi hiam? Assiria in nang hong maizumsak ngei bangin Egypt-te in zong nang hong maizumsak ding uh hi.
Nangmah zong tua gam panin maizumna tawh na lu tungah vut khusa-in nong paikhia ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh keimah { Topa } in na muan' mite ka nialzo hi; amaute' hangin na gualzo ngei kei ding hi.
"Mi khat in a zi ma hen la, tuanu in zong amah nusia-in, midang khat' zi va suak leh, a pasal masa in tuanu lakik thei ding ahi hiam? Tua gamteng a ninsak khin suak ding hilo ahi hiam? Nang pen numei paktat suakin mi tampi tak tawh kingai khinzo napi-in, tu-in kei kiang hong zuankik ding na hi hiam, { Topa } in kong ci hi.
Khuadak in la mualsang dawnte en dih in. Hong kilup khoppih lohna mun koi laitakah om ahi hiam? Arab mite in a suam dingun gamlakah mi a ngak uh bangin lam gei-ah tu-in na luppih ding mi na ngak hi. Na paktatna leh na gitlohna tawh hih gam na ninsakzo hi.
Tua hang mahin guahtui kikangsak a, guah nunung hong zulo hi. Ahi zongin numei paktatte tawh a kibang hinapi-in na maizum thei kei lailai hi.
Kumpi Josiah in a uk laitakin { Topa } in kei hong hopih a, "A zulhzau Israel, mualsang tung khempeuhah pai-in singlim nuai khempeuhah numei paktat bangin a om kawikawina na mu khinzo hiam?
Hih teng a hih khit ciangin kei kiangah hong kileh kik ngawn ding hi, ci-in ka up hangin amah hong kileh kik tuanlo hi. Tua bangin a gamtatna pen numei ginalo a sanggamnu Judah in zong a mu hi.
A zulhzau Israel, midang tawh a khialhna hangin kimakna lai pia-in, ka hawlkhiat zong amah in a mu hi. Ahih hangin numei ginalo Judah lau tuanloin, amah zong numei paktat khat mah a va suak veve hi.
Tua bang hih ding amah in baih ngaihsut lel ahih manin suangtum leh singtawng peuh bia-in khial a, gam a ninsak hi.
Hih bang teng hinapi a sanggamnu, numei ginalo Judah, a lungsim takpi tawh hong kilehkik loin, a kilehkik hong kineihkhem bek hi, { Topa } in kong ci hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in kei hong hopih a, "A zulhzau Israel, numei ginalo Judah sangin a mawhna tamzaw hi.
Pai in la leilu lam Israel gamah hih bangin va taangko in: 'Hong kilehkik in, a zulhzau Israel aw, { Topa } in kong ci hi. Hehna tawh nang kong en kei ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh a hehpih theipa ka hi hi, { Topa } in kong ci hi. Ka heh tawntung kei ding hi.
Na mawhna na phawk ding bek kisam hi. { Topa } na Pasian na langpan'na, singlim nuai khempeuhah gamdang pasian-te tawh na khialh kawikawina leh ka thu nong man'lohnate pulak in, { Topa } in kong ci hi.
Hong kileh kik un, a zulhzau ka tate aw, { Topa } in kong ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note pen keima mite na hi uh a, khuapi khat panin mi khat, beh khat sung panin nih cih bangin hong la-in, Zion khua-ah ka hong puak ding hi.
"'Ka thu a hong mang makaite ka hong pia ding a, amaute in pilna leh siamna tawh note hong uk ding uh hi.
Tua hun ciangin gamsungah note pungin na tam uh ciangin { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, mite in, "{ Topa' } Thuciamna Singkuang," ci-in genin a nei nawn kei ding uh hi. Amaute in ngaihsun khalo ding uh a, phawkkha loin, zong a goih beek kei ding uh hi. Thamloin zong a bawlkik nawn kei ding uh hi.
Tua hun ciangin Jerusalem khua pen { Topa' } kumpi tokhom kici ding a, Jerusalem khua { Topa' } omna-ah gam khempeuh hong kikhawmin, amaute in amau' mawhnopna lungsim uh a zui tentan nawn kei ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin a thumanlo zi in a pasal a nusiat bangin Israel mite aw, { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, no zong kei tungah nong thuman kei uh hi,' ci-in va taangko in," hong ci hi.
Mualtung panin awging khat hong kiza a, Israel mite' kahna leh tauna awging ahi hi. Lam a pialna hang uh leh { Topa } a Pasian uh a mangngilhna hang uh ahi hi.
{ Topa } in, "Hong kileh kik un, a zulhzau ka tate aw, na zulhzauna uh kong damsak ding hi," a ci hi. Amaute in zong, "En in, nang kiang kong pai uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } kote' Pasian na hi hi.
Mualtungte leh mualsangte' tungah gamlum lialuanate zuaupi taktak hi a, Israel mite hotkhiatna ding { Topa } eite' Pasian' kiang bekah om takpi hi.
"Ahih hangin i neu lai-a kipan a zumhuai Baal pasian i biakna hangin i pu i pate' biakna ahi tuulebawngte, a tapate leh a tanute khempeuh uh i sum khinzo hi.
Tua ahih manin maizumin lum ni. I minsiatna silh ni. Bang hang hiam cih leh i neulai-a kipan tuni ciangdong eite leh i pu i pate pen { Topa } i Pasian' tungah i mawh khinzo hi. { Topa } i Pasian' thu i mang kei khinzo hi," a ci uh hi.
{ Topa } in, "Israel mite aw, na kilehkik nop uh leh kei kiangah hong kilehkik un. Na kihhuainate uh kei kiang pan na paihkhiat uh a, na tai kawikawi kei uh a,
'{ Topa } a nuntak bangin,' ci-in, thuman tak, kiptak, thutang takin thu na ciam nak uh leh gam khempeuh in thupha ka piak ding hong ngen ding uh a, kei' sungah amaute a lungdam ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Judah gammite leh Jerusalem khuamite tungah { Topa } in hih bangin ci hi: "Na lote uh kal un la, ling lakah khai vawh kei un.
Judah mite leh Jerusalem khuamite aw, { Topa' } thu zui un la, lungsim takpi tawh zui un. Na tuacih kei uh leh na bawl uh mawhnate hangin ka hehna mei bangin hong kuangkhia ding a, a phelhzo kuamah omlo ding hi," a ci hi.
Judah gamah va gen un la, Jerusalem khua-ah va taangko un. Gamsung khempeuhah peengkul mutin awng un la, va gen un. Hong kikhawm un la khuapi muan'huaite sungah va bu ni, va ci un.
Zion paina lampi kihilh un la, na suahtakna dingun tai un; zekai kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh leilu lam panin siatna lianpi ka hong puaksuk hi.
Humpinelkai khat a bukna sawlkawm panin hong kuankhiazo a, gamte a susia dingpa hong paikhiazo hi. Na gam uh a kisiasak ding leh na khuapite uhah kuamah a ten'lohna dingin a susia dingin ama omna panin hong kuankhia khinzo hi.
Tua ahih manin puanhampi silhin tau-in kap un. Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa' } hehna lauhuaipi eite' kiang panin kiheikhia nailo hi.
{ Topa } in, "Tua ni ciangin kumpipa leh kumpi uliante lungkia ding uh a, siampite lau mahmahin, kamsangte dipkua ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, "Ah, Topa { Pasian } aw, nangmah in hih mite leh Jerusalem khuamite khem cih takin na khem khinzo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau kiangah, 'Nopna hong om ding hi,' ci napi-in, amau a sunlum dingin namsau khat a om gige hi," ka ci hi.
Tua hun ciangin hih mite leh Jerusalem khua mite kiangah, "A sa mahmah huih, sehnel gam a sang mun panin ka mite tungah hong nung ding a, tua huih pen anvaite a zapsiang dingin a nung huih bang hilo hi.
Ka sawl huih pen tua bang dingin hat lua ding hi. Tu-in { Topa } in amaute tungah thu khenin a gen hi," kici ding hi.
En un, meii bangin i galpa hong pai a, a sakol leengte pingpei tawh kibang a, a sakolte muvanlai sangin manlang zaw hi. Gimna i thuak ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh gal lel ding ihi ta hi.
Jerusalem khua aw, nang hong kihotkhiatna dingin na lungsim sung panin gitlohna sawpkhia in. Na sungah gitlohna lungsim bang tanvei kemcip ding na hi hiam?

Na lungsim leh na gamtatnate' hangin nang' tungah hih thu hong tung hi. Hih pen nangma gitlohna hang hi a, na lungtang pailetin hong sun hi," a ci hi.
Siatna khat khit ciangin adang khat hong tung a, gamsung khempeuh kisia khinta hi. Thakhat thu-in ka bukte hong kisuksiatsak a, ka puankhaite kikekgawp hi.
{ Topa } in, "Ka mite hai uh a, kei hong theilo uh hi. Naupang haite bang uh a, bangmah theilo uh hi. A sia bawl ding lamsang siam bek uh hi. A hoih bangmah bawl theilo uh hi," a ci hi.
Leitung ka et leh limlemel neilo a, vantungah zong khuavak omlo hi.
Ka et leh, logam leihoih teng sehnel gam suakkhin a, { Topa' } mai, a hehna lianpi mai-ah, khuapi khempeuh kisia khin uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in, "Gam buppi, gamlak suak ding a, ahih hangin ka susia sam kei ding hi.
Tua thu hangin leitung kap ding a, vantung mial ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka gensa, ka khensatsa hi a, ka kisikloh bangin ka lungsim zong ka khelkik kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Sakol tunga tuangte leh thal tawite' aw a kizak ciangin mi khempeuh galtai mang uh a, gamlakah tai-in suang lakah a kahto uh hi. Khuapi khempeuh kinusia khin a, kuamah teng nawnlo hi.
Nau a suak ding numei a kiko bang khat ka za a, tacil a suak numei' tauna tawh kibang hi. Zion' tanu husam liangin a kikona aw na hi a, a khutte gel zakin, "Gimna ka thuak ding hi. Kei hong that ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Jerusalem khuasungah kileh kawikawi un. Khuadak un la en dih un! A thuman gamtat leh thuman a zong mi khat beek na mu uh hiam, zong dih un. Na muh uh leh tua khua' mawhna ka maisak ding hi.
"{ Topa } a nuntak bangin," ci-in a kiciam uh hangin a zuaupi uh ahi hi.
{ Topa } aw, nangmah in thuman en gige hilo na hi hiam? Nangmah in amaute na sat hangin a awlmawh tuan kei uh hi. Na sukgawp hangin na thuhilhna a ngai tuan kei uh hi. Amaute' maitang suangtum sangin sakzaw a, a kisik nuam kei uh hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, "Hih mite mihai hi a, a hehpihhuai ahi hi. { Topa' } lampi theilo uh a, amau' Pasian' deihna a thei kei uh hi.
Miliante kiangah pai-in ka va kiho ding uh hi. Amaute in { Topa' } lampi thei uh a, amau' Pasian' deihna thei uh hi," ci-in ka ngaihsun hi. Ahih hangin a vekpi-un ka uk ding nial khin uh a, ka hakkol kuaitanin ka henna khaute sutat khinzo uh hi.
Hih thute hangin amaute gim pialo ding ka hi hiam? { Topa } in ka genin-ah, hici bang minam tungah thukkiklo ding ka hi hiam?
A gualin a kisuan a leenggah huan sungah pai in la, suksiat sak in; ahi zongin sukmai mangsak sam kei in. A hiangte heuhkhiatsak in; bang hang hiam cih leh tua a hiangte { Topa}-a' hilo hi.

Kamsangte lah huih bang hi lel uh a, a sung uhah thu tenglo hi. Amau' gen bangun amau mah in a thuak ding uh hi,' ci uh hi," a ci hi.

"En un, Israel minamte aw, { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, gamlapi panin note a hong sim dingin gam khat kong kuansak ding hi. Tua gam pen tanglai pekin a om khinsa, a hat mahmah, amaute' pau na theihloh uh gam khat ahi hi.

Na tuuhon, na bawnghonte uh hong gaihsak ding uh a, na leenggah, na theigahte uh hong nek mangsak ding uh hi. Na muan' mahmah uh kulhpi tawh a ki-um na khuapite uh namsau tawh hong suksiatsak ding uh hi.

Kiman'na a neilo, a haihuaipi hi a, gim a kipiak ni ciangin a kisia ding uh hi.
Jakob' Pasian tua bang hilo a, amah pen na khempeuh a piangsakpa ahi hi. Ama mi dingin Israel mite teel a, ama min, Vanglian { Topa } ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in, "En un, tu-in hih gamsungah a teng mite ka lawnkhia ding a, a theihna dingun a tung uhah lungkhamna ka tungsak ding hi," a ci hi.
Ka puanbuk hong kisuksiat sak a, a kikan'na khau khempeuh kitat mangkhin hi. Ka tate in hong taisan uh a, tu-in om nawnlo uh hi. Ka puanbuk a hong lamsak ding leh ka kongkhak puante a hong khaisak ding kuamah om nawnlo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh makaite hai khin uh a, { Topa' } deihna donglo uh hi. Tua thu hangin amaute mapailo uh a, a mite uh kithehthang mang hi.

tua bang na hih uh leh na pute na pate uh tungah ka ciamsa, tu-a na neih uh bawngnawi leh khuaizu tui bangin a luan'na gam kong pia ding hi, ci-in thu ka pia hi," hong ci hi. Tua ciangin keimah in, "Hi ta hen, { Topa } aw," ci-in ka dawngkik hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in kei kiangah, "Hih thuciamna thute ngai-in a sepna dingun Judah gam khuapite leh Jerusalem khua kongzing lakah va taangko in.

Tua ciangin { Topa } in hong hopih leuleu a, "Judah minamte leh Jerusalem khuamite in kei hong langpang uh hi.
Ka thu a ngai nuamlo a pu a pate uh' mawhna lamah kilehhei khinzo uh a, pasian dangte' na a sem dingin a zui khinzo uh hi. Israel mite leh Judah mite in a pu a pate uh tawh ka bawlsa uh thuciamna a palsat khinzo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, en un, a pelh theihloh uh gimna amau' tungah ka tungsak ding a, kei kiangah a hong kap liang uh zongin ka dawng nawn kei ding hi.
Tua ciangin Judah mite leh Jerusalem khuamite in meihal biakna tawh a biak uh a pasian-te uh' kiangah pai-in a va thum ding uh hi. Ahih hangin hih gimna hong tun' ciangin a honkhia thei tuan kei ding uh hi.
"Tua ahih manin Jeremiah aw, hih mite-a' ding thu ngetsak kei in la, amau' tangin thumsak kei in. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in gim ngahin hong sap uh ciangin ka ngai kei ding hi.

Nidang lai-in { Topa } in note, a hing dikdek a gahpha oliv kung tawh kong genteh ngei hi. Ahih hangin kong hal ding a, na hiangte uh kangtumin ging huhu ding hi.

Ahih hangin { Topa } aw, nangmah in kei nong thei hi. Ka gamtatnate nong mu a, nang ka hong itna thu na hong thei hi. Amaute pen gawh dingin a kikoih tuu bangin kaikhia in la, a kigawh ni hun ding a tun' mateng tuamkoih in.

{ Topa } in, "Jeremiah aw, mite tawh tai kidem a, nangmah hong gimsakzo uh ahih leh, sakol bangci demzawh ding na hiam? A nopna munah tuk lailai na hih leh Jordan gun gei sing kawm lakah bangcih ding na hi hiam?
Bang hang hiam cih leh na sanggamte leh na innkuanpihte nangawn in nang hong zuak uh a, nang a hong do ding mihonpi a kaikhawm uh hi. Kam khum tawh nang a hong zol uh hangin um kei in," ci-in hong dawngkik hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in, "Ka inn ka nusia khin a, ka luahsa mite ka paimangta hi. Ka it mahmah ka mite, a galte uh' khutsungah ka piata hi.
Ka luah dingin ka teelsa mite in gamlaka humpinelkai bangin kei' langkhatah pangin hong hawksan uh ahih manin amaute ka mudah hi.
Ka mite pen, sasialne vasa gial khat, sasialne vasa dangte in a kimkot panin a tuk huan nainai uh tawh a kibang uh hi. Gamsate aw, hong kikhawm un la, pawi hong siim un.
Tuucing dang tampi in ka leenggah lo hong suksiatsak uh a, kei-a' teng hong tuatcilsak uh hi. A hoih mahmah ka leenggah lo pawnlak, gamlak, a suaksak uh hi.
Pawn lak hong suahsak uh a, dahin ka kap hi. Gamsung khempeuh a kisiat khit hangin kuamah in phamawh salo sawnsawn uh hi.
Sehnel gam mualsang panin a susia dingte hong paizo uh hi. Gammong khat panin gammong khat dongah a lungmuang kuamah omlo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa' } namsau in mi khempeuh a vattuk hi.
Amaute in mangbuh tuh uh a, ahi zongin kiak bek a ngah uh hi. Nasep a hahkat mahmah hangun bangmah a ngah kei uh hi. A kihtakhuai { Topa' } hehna hangin anlak hun ciangin a maizum ding uh hi," a ci hi.

Israel mite' lametpa aw, haksat hun ciangin ko a hong honkhiapa na hi hi. Bang hangin ka gamsung uhah khualmi bangin nang omin khualzin zan khat bek a taam bangin hong om na hi hiam?

Hih mite tawh kisai-in { Topa } in thu gen a, "Kei kiang panin amaute vakkhia kawikawi nuam uh a, a kideek kei uh hi. Tua ahih manin { Topa } keimah in amaute ka sang kei a, a khialhnate uh phawkin, a mawhnate uh hangin gim ka pia ding hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in kei kiangah, "Hih mite in thupha a ngahna dingin thu hong ngen nawn kei in.
An a tan' uh hangin amau' thumna ka ngai kei ding a, meihal biakna leh an tawh biaknate hong piak uh hangin ka sang kei ding hi. Amaute namsau tawh ahi zongin, kial tawh ahi zongin, pulnatna tawh ahi zongin ka sisakzaw ding hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in, "Ah, Topa { Pasian } aw, en dih in. Kamsangte in amaute kiangah, 'Note in namsau ahi zongin, kial ahi zongin na mukha ngei kei ding uh a, hih munah Pasian in lungnopna kip hong pia ding hi,' a ci uh hi," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in, "Tua kamsangte in kei' min suangin zuauthu hong gen uh hi. Amaute ka sawl kei a, thu ka pia kei a, zong ka hopih kei hi. Note kiangah hong gen uh thute a manlo maangmuhna, bangmahin a kimanglo aisanna, leh amau' ngaihsuttawm thute ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka sawllohpi, 'Hih gam sungah namsau ahi zongin, kial ahi zongin hong tunglo ding hi,' ci-in keima min suangin thu a gen kamsangte tawh kisai-in { Topa } in ka cihin-ah, namsau leh kial tawh hih kamsangte a si khin ding uh hi.
A hilh uh mite in zong kial leh namsau thuakin amaute-a kipan a zite uh, a tapate uh, leh a tanute uh Jerusalem khua kongzing lakah kipaithang ding a, kuamah in a vui kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau' gitlohna amau' tung mahah ka buaksuk ding hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in kei tungah thu hong gen a, "Jeremiah aw, amaute kiangah, 'Sun leh zanin ka khitui luangluang hen la, kang ngei kei ta hen. Bang hang hiam cih leh keima mite in nakpi takin liamna thuak uh a, nakpi takin a kisat uh hi.

{ Topa } aw, nangmah in Judah gam nialsiang khinzo na hi hiam? Zion khua kihhuai sa na hi hiam? Bang hangin kote liamna hong thuaksak a, hong damsak nawnlo na hi hiam? Lungnopna ka lamen uh a, hoihna bangmah a hong tung kei hi. Damna ding hun ka lamen uh a, lauhuaina bekbek ka mu uh hi.
{ Topa } aw, ka gitlohna uh leh ka pute ka pate uh gitlohnate ka hong pulak uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nangma tungah ka hong mawh khin uh hi.

Tua ciangin { Topa } in kei hong hopih a, "Moses leh Samuel nangawn ka mai-ah hong dingin hong thum uh zongin hih mite ka hehpih tuan kei ding hi. Ka muhna panin hawlkhia un la, paikhia sak un.
Amaute in, 'Koi-ah pai ding ka hi uh hiam?' ci-in hong dot uh leh hih bangin genkik in: '{ Topa } in, "Pulnatna tawh a si dingte pul-in si ding uh a, namsau tawh a si dingte namsau-in si ding uh hi. "Amaute' sihna dingin gimna nam li ka tungsak ding hi. A kithahna ding uh namsau, a keizan gawp dingin ui, a valhtum ding leh a susiagawp dingin huih laka vasate leh leilaka ganhingte ka koih ding hi.
Nangmah in kei nong taisanzo hi, { Topa } in kong ci hi. Kei nong nungngat niloh hi. Tua ahih manin ka khut zanin nang kong susia hi. Ka hehna ka ki-ipzo nawn kei hi.
Na gamsung khua kongpite-ah huihpi' mut bangin note kong mutmang ding hi. Na tate uh ka beisak ding a, ka mite ka susia ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh na gitlohna uh leh na omdan hoihlo panun na kiheikik kei uh hi.
Tuipi-a sehnel omzah sangin nupi meigong ka tamsakzaw ding hi. Na tangvalte uh a khan' laitakin ka that ding a, a nute uh ka lunggimsak ding hi. Note' tungah thakhat thu-in lungkhamna leh launa ka hong tungsak ding hi.
Ta sagih a nei nupi khakham vei-in a sibup hi. Sunkimlai hinapi ama-a' dingin khuamial bang a, maizumna leh mindaina a thuak hi. No a nungta laite na galte un namsau tawh a hong satlup dingun ka hong pia ding hi, { Topa } in kong ci hi," a hong ci hi.
Gimna ka thuak hi; ka nu aw, gamsung khempeuh-a mite tawh a kitawng a kisel dingin kei nong suaksak hi. Ka sumte kuamah lah leitawisak loin kuama-a' lah leitawi lalo napi, a vekpi-un kei hong hamsiat teitei uh hi.
{ Topa } aw, amaute' hoihna dingin nang tungah kong thumsak kei a, gimna leh haksatna hun ciangin ka galte-a' dingin nang' tungah kong ngetsak kei leh tua amau' hong hamsiatnate kei' tungah hong tung ta hen!
Mi khat in sik kuaitan zolo ding ahih leh leilu lama sik leh sumngo kihel khawm kuaitan zozaw ding ahi hiam?
{ Topa } in, "Na gamsung tenga na bawl uh mawhna khempeuhte' hangin na neih na lam uh leh na sum na paite uh man ngahloin na galte uh ka tuahsakmang ding hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in: { Topa } aw, nang na thei hi. Hong phawk in la hong veh in. Kei a hong bawlsiate tungah phu hong laksak in. Ka galte tungah na lungduaina hangin kei' sihna ding piangsak kei in. Nangma hangin minsiatna a thuak ka hihlam hong thei in.
Na thute in kei hong kem a, an bangin ka ne hi. Na thute kei-a' dingin kipahna leh lungdamna ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nangma minin kei hong kilo hi, aw, { Topa, } Vanglian Pasian aw.
Mi gualnuam mawkmawkte tawh ka kikhawl kei a, zong ka lungdam khawm kei hi. Nangma thu kong man'na hangin kei tangkai ka hih manin a hehin ka omden hi.
Bang hangin ka natna dai theilo a, ka liamna dam theilo a, dam nuam hetlo ahi hiam? Tui a kang lui tawh kibangin lungkiatna hong thuaksak ding na hi hiam, ka ci hi.
Tua ahih manin { Topa } in, "Na hong kilehkik leh kong koihna ngei-ah kong koihkik ding a, ka na na sem kik ding hi. Thu manphalo genloin thu manpha bek na gen leh, ka kamsang dingin ka hong zang ding hi. Nang kiangah amaute hong pai ding uh a, nang na hih leh amau' kiangah na pai kei ding hi.
Hih mite tungah sumngo a kibawl khuakulhpi kong bangsak ding a, amaute in a hong sim uh hangin a hong zo kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a hong honkhia ding leh a hong suaktasak dingin nang ka hong ompih hi, { Topa } in ka hong ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh hih muna suak tanu tapate leh a nute uh tawh kisai-in { Topa } in ka cihin-ah:
Natna lian tawh si ding uh a, kuamah in kahloin kuamah in zong a vui kei ding uh hi. Leilaka ek ki-tha a bang lel ding uh hi. Namsau leh kial tawh a si ding uh a, a luanghawmte uh huihlaka a leeng vasate leh leilaka ganhingte in a ne ding uh hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, mi' kahna innsungah lut kei un la, thumin kuamah va kah se kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh lungnopna, itna lianpi, leh ka hehpihna hih mite kiang panin ka lakhia khinzo hi, { Topa } in kong ci hi.
Hih gamah miliante leh mineute si ding uh a, kivui loin, amau' hangin kuamah kaploin, kuamah in a pumpi uh kuiliam loin a sam uh zong a met kei ding uh hi.

Bang hang hiam cih leh Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in hih bangin kong ci hi: En un, hih mun panin note' muh teekteekin, note' theih hunsung mahin gualnopna, lungdamna awte leh zinei thakte, pasalnei thakte' awte ka gingsak nawn kei ding hi.

Tua ciangin nangmah in amaute kiangah, '{ Topa } in, "Na pu na pate un kei hong taisan khin uh a, kei hong nusia-in ka thukham a zui kei uh hi.

"En un, { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, ngabeng tampi ka khah ding a, amaute ka mansak ding hi. Tua khit ciangin sabeng tampi ka khah ding a, amaute in mualtung khempeuh leh suanghawmte lakah amaute a beng ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a omdan khempeuh uh ka mitin ka mu a, kei' kiang panin a kiseel bangmah omlo hi. A khialhna khempeuh uh zong ka mu hi.
Amaute' khialhna leh a mawhnate uh a zah nihin ka thuk ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in a muhthadahhuai siluang hawmte tawh a kibang milimte tawh ka gam a ninsak uh a, kihhuaina tawh ka gamh a dimsak uh hi," hong ci hi.
Aw { Topa, } ka hatna leh ka kulhpi, lungkham hun ciangin ka buknapa aw, leimong panin gamdang mite nangma kiangah hong pai ding uh a, "Ka pu ka pate un zuauthu leh bangmahin a kimanglo milimte longal bangmah dang a luah kei ding uh hi.
Mi in ama pasian ding bawltawm thei ahi hiam? Tuate pasian hilo hi," hong ci ding uh hi.

{ Topa } in a genna-ah, "Judah mite' mawhna sik laikung khat tawh kigelh hi. Suangmanpha mukzum tawh amaute' lungtang peek tung leh biakna tau kite tungah khuakin ki-at hi.

{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah: "Mi bek muangin mi' hatna bek suang a, { Topa } tawh a lungsim a kilehngat mi in hamsiatna a ngah ahi hi.

Keimah { Topa } in mi khempeuh' nuntakzia leh a gamtatna tawh kizui-in a piakhia dingin ngaihsutna ka entel a, lungsim ka sittel hi," a ci hi.

{ Topa } aw, hong damsak lecin ka natna teng bei ding a, hong honkhia lecin kei ka suakta ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen ka hong phatpa na hi hi.

{ Topa } in kei kiangah, "Va pai in la, Judah gam kumpite' lutna leh pusuahna Mite' Kongpi leh Jerusalem khua kongpite khempeuhah va ding in la, hih bangin va gen in:

"'Ahih hangin { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, note in ka thu nong ngaih uh a, Sabbath ni-in hih khua kongpite-ah bangmah hong lutpih loin, Sabbath ni siangthosakin, na na sep kei uh leh,
na kumpite uh leh na uliante un David' neih bang kumpi vangliatna a nei ding uh hi. Amaute in Judah mite leh Jerusalem khuamite tawh sakol leeng leh sakolte tungah tuangin hih khua kongpite-ah hong lut ding uh a, hih khuapi-ah zong mi teng tawntung ding hi.

tua ka gensa minam leh gam a siatna panin a kiheikik leh, ama tungah siatna tun'sak dingin ka sehsa pen ka kisikkik ding a, ka tungsak nawn kei ding hi.

{ Topa } aw, kei nong khem a, khemna ka thuak takpi hi. Kei sangin nang na hatzaw a, keimah nong zo hi. Nisimin mite' nuihsat lel ka suak a, mi khempeuh in kei hong zahko uh hi.
