Tua ciangin, 'A Pasian uh { Topa' } thuciamna taisan uh a, pasian dang peuh bia-in a na a sepsak man uh ahi hi,' ci-in a kidawngkik ding uh hi, va ci in," hong ci hi.
Judah mite aw, misipa Josiah kah kei un la, khasiat kei un. A kipaikhiatpih Shallum hangin nakpi takin kapzaw un. Bang hang hiam cih leh a pian'na gam a mu dingin amah hong kilehkik nawnlo ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Judah kumpipa Josiah' za a luah a tapa, hih mun panin a paikhiapa Shallum thu tawh kisai-in { Topa } in, "Amah hong kilehkik nawnlo ding a,
Thumanlopi-in inn lam a, zuauthu tawh inndei tungnung a lam mi, ama na a mawkna-in a inn vengte a semsak mi, thaman a pialo mi in gimna thuak ta hen.
"Inndei tungnung zapi a awng inn gol khat ka lam ding hi," ci-in tawlet vangte bawl a, taamtak singpeek tawh thuap sawm a, za san a zut mi in gimna thuak ta hen.
Taamtak sing tawh inn na lam manin kumpi kisa na hi hiam? Na pa in an ne tui dawn a, thumanna leh diktatna tawh na a sep manin a maa pai hilo ahi hiam?
Amah in mizawngte leh mi cimawhte thuman tawh thu khen a, na khempeuh a hoih a suak pah hi. Tu-a banga hihna pen kei nong theihna uh hilo ahi hiam, { Topa } in kong ci hi.
Ahih hangin note in thumanlo tawh ngahna ding ahi zongin, mimawh lote' sisan luan'na ding ahi zongin, mi nuaisiahna leh ngongtatna ding ahi zongin, na mitte uh leh na lungsim uh na zang uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Judah kumpipa Josiah' tapa Jehoiakim thu tawh kisai-in { Topa } in hih bangin kong ci hi: "Amaute in, 'Sanggampa aw,' 'Sanggamnu aw,' ci-in a sih ciangun a kikah bangun amah a sih ciangin a kah kei ding uh a, '{ Topa } aw, kumpipa aw,' ci-in zong a kah kei ding uh hi.
Jerusalem khua mite aw, Lebanon Mual tungah kahto-in awng un la, Bashan gamah va kiko un. Abarim mualtungah va kiko un; bang hang hiam cih leh na pawlte un gal lel khin hi.
Na daupai laitakun kong hopih hangin na hong ngai nuam kei uh hi. Na neu tung uha kipan nong tuacih ngitnget uh a, keima thu nong mang ngei kei uh hi.
Lebanon gam panin a kila taamtak inn sungah nuamtakin na teng uh hi. Ahih hangin gimna hong tun' ciangin bangzah takin na tau ding uh hiam? Numei nausuak dingte tawh na kibang ding uh hi.
{ Topa } in Jehoiakim tapa Judah kumpipa Jehoiakhin tungah, "Kei a nungta Pasian ka hih mah bangin, nangmah in ka taklam khutah a om ka letmatthuhna tawh a kibang na hih hangin nang kong lakhia ding a,
na kihtak, nang hong thatnuamte' khutsungah kong pia ding hi. Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar leh Khaldea mite' khutsungah nang kong pia ding hi.
Nangmah leh nang hong paai na nu, na suahna mun uh a hilo gamdangah kong lawnkhia ding a, tua laitakah na si ding uh hi.
Jehoiakhin, kuama deihloh a kipaimang beel kitam tawh kibang ta ahi hiam? Bang hangin amah leh a tate kilawnkhia a, a theihloh uh gamah kipaimang ahi hiam?
Aw ka gam, ka gam aw, { Topa' } kammal ngai dih ve'n!
{ Topa } in hih bangin ci hi: "Hihpa, ta neilopa, a khan' tawntungin a gualzo ngeilopa, ci-in ciamteh un. Ama suanlekhakte khat beek in David' tokhom luahlo ding a, Judah gam a uk kei ding hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in thu gen a, "Ka mite sisakin, a kikhenthangsak gam ukte in gimna ngah ta hen!" a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin ka mipihte a kem gam ukte tawh kisai-in { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in hong genin-ah, "Note in ka mite kikhenthang sakin na hawlkhiamang uh a, amaute na don kei uh hi. En un, { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, na gamtatsiate uh hangin gim kong pia ding hi.
Ka mite a omlai sunteng, ka hawlkhiatna ding gamte panin ka kaikhawmkik ding a, a gam uhah ka ciahsak kik ding hi. Amaute pungin a khang ding uh hi.
Amaute a don ding makaite ka koih ding a, lau nawnlo, lungkham nawnloin khat beek a mangthang nawn kei ding uh hi, { Topa } in kong ci hi.
"En un, { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, keimah in David' suan lak panin kumpi dingin a diktat mi khat ka khan'khiatsak ni hong tung ding hi. Amah gam uk siam mahmah ding a, gamsungah thuman thutang tawh thu hong khen ding hi.
Ama hun hong tun' ciangin Judah mite kihonkhia ding a, Israel mite lungmuang takin a teng ding uh hi. Amah a kilawhna dingin a min, '{ Topa, } Eite' Diktan'na,' ci-in a kiphuak ding hi.
"Tua ahih manin en un, { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, mite in, 'Egypt gam panin Israel mite a hong paikhiatpih { Topa } a nuntak bangin,' ci-in a kiciam nawn kei ding uh a,
'A hawlkhiatna leilu lam gam leh gamdangte khempeuh panin Israel mite' suanlekhakte kaikhawmin a makaih { Topa } a nuntak bangin,' ci-in a kiciamzaw ding uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute amau' gamsung mahah a teng ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh mun khempeuhah angkawmte a dim hi. { Topa' } hamsiatna hangin gamsung tengah kahna dim a, gamlak lonona munte a keu mang hi. Amaute gamtatsia uh a, a vangliatna uh a manlopi-in a zang uh hi.
{ Topa } in a cihin-ah, "Kamsangte leh siampite in Pasian a zahtak kei uh hi. Ka biakinnsung nangawnah amau' gitlohna ka mu hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute' lampi pen khuamial lak lamnal hi ding a, amaute kinawhkhia gawpin a tuk ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute' gimthuak ding hun hong tun' ciangin amaute tungah gimna ka tungsak ding hi, { Topa } in kong ci hi.
Ahih hangin Jerusalem khuasunga om kamsangte' sungah a mulkimhuaizaw na khat ke'n ka mu hi. Angkawmin zuauthu gen uh a, mite a gitlohna uh pan a kikhellohna dingin mi hoihlote a hanthawn zawlai uh hi. A vekpi-un kei' muhna-ah Sodom khuamite tawh kibang khin ka sa a, Gomorrah khuamite tawh zong kilamdanglo uh hi.
"Tua ahih manin tua kamsangte tawh kisai-in Vanglian { Topa } in kong genin-ah: En un, keimah in gamsai teh tawh amaute ka vak ding a, gu kisawh tui amaute ka dawnsak ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Jerusalem khua-a om kamsangte' kiang panin gamsung mun khempeuhah Pasian zahtaklohna hong kizel hi," a ci hi.
Vanglian { Topa } in, "Note kiangah thu hong hilh a, a hong lamen khialsak kamsangte' thugennate na ngai kei un. Amaute in a lungsim uhah a geeltawm uh thu hong gen uh hi a, keima kiang pana hong pai thu ahi kei hi.
Keimah { Topa' } thugennna a hong ngailo mite kiangah, hong hoih na ve, ci-in a gen tawntung uh hi. Amau' lungsim' deihna bang ciat bek a zui tentan mi khempeuhte kiangah zong, gimna hong tung zenzenlo ding hi, ci-in a gen uh hi," a ci hi.
Amaute' lakah kua pen { Topa } tawh thu kikum khawm ngei a, a thugennate va thei ngei, va za ngei ahi uh hiam? Kua in ama kammal va ngai ngei a, va thupi ngaihsut ngei ahi uh hiam?
En un, { Topa' } hehna huihpi hong nung hi. A hehna huihpi hong kinuai nainai-in hong paikhia ta a, migilopa' lutang hong kiden'na ding hi.
A lungsim sunga a tupna teng a tangtun'sak matengin { Topa' } hehna damkiklo ding hi. Hong pai lai ding hunte-ah note in siangtakin na telzaw semsem ding uh hi.
{ Topa } in, "Keimah in sawlkhialo napi-in tua kamsangte kuankhia teitei uh hi. Thu bangmah ka genlohpi, kei' min paulamin thu a gen mawkmawk uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in keima lungsim tawng hong thei uh hi leh keima thugente ka mite tungah taangko ding uh a, a nuntakna uh a hoihlote panin kikhelsakin, a gamtat hoihlote uh panin zong kikhelsak khinzo ding uh hi.
"Kei pen mun khat bekah a om Pasian ka hi hiam? Mun khempeuhah a om Pasian hilo ka hi hiam, { Topa } in kong ci hi.
Mi khat peuhpeuh kei' muhloh dingin busim thei ding ahi hiam, { Topa } in kong ci hi. Leitung, vantung, mun khempeuhah ka om lamtak theilo na hi uh hiam, { Topa } in kong ci hi.
Kamsangpa in mang a mat leh a mang bek mah gen hen la, ahih hangin ka thugenna a za mipa in ka thugente mah mantakin gen ta hen. Buhtu leh buhtang bangci kibat theih ding ahi hiam, { Topa } in kong ci hi.
Ka kammal pen mei tawh ahi a, suangtum a satnenzo sek tawh ahi zongin kibang hilo ahi hiam, { Topa } in kong ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin en un, { Topa } in kong genin-ah, kamsangte in amau khatlekhat tung panin a theih uh thute kei' thugen bangin a genkhiatna uh ka deih kei hi.
En un, { Topa } in kong genin-ah, amau' ngaihsuttawm thu gen napi-in, '{ Topa } in ci hi,' a ci khem kamsangte' langkhatah kei ka pang hi.
En un, { Topa } in kong genin-ah, ka sawllohpi zuau mang manin tua thu hilh a, a zuauthu uh leh a kiphatsakna uh tawh ka mite lam a khialhpih mite' langkhatah kei ka pang hi. Ka mite-a' dingin amaute a kiman'na uh themkha beek omlo hi, { Topa } in kong ci hi.
"Jeremiah aw, ka mite khat peuhpeuh in ahi a, kamsang khat ahih kei leh siampi khat peuhpeuh in ahi zongin, '{ Topa' } thugen bang ahi hiam?' ci-in hong dot leh nangmah in, '{ Topa' } thugen nangmah na hi a, nang pen vangik khat na hi hi. { Topa } in nang, kong paaikhia ding hi, hong ci hi,' ci-in gen in.
Kamsang khat, ahih kei leh siampi khat, ahih kei leh ka mite khat peuhpeuh in, '{ Topa' } thugen pen vangik khat ahi hi,' a cih leh tua mipa leh a innkuanpihte khempeuh gim ka pia ding hi.
Mi khempeuh in a lawmte kiangah ahi a, a sanggamte kiangah ahi zongin, '{ Topa } in bangin hong dawng hiam? { Topa } in bang hong gen hiam?' ci-in na kidongzaw ding uh hi.
'{ Topa' } thugen pen vangik khat ahi hi,' ci-in na gen nawn kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note' thugente, note' vangik ahi zaw hi. Note in eite' Pasian ahi a nungta Pasian, Vanglian { Topa' } thugennate na lumletgawp uh hi.
Kamsangpa kiangah, '{ Topa } in bangin hong dawng hiam? { Topa } in bang hong gen hiam?' ci-in dongzaw un.
Ahih hangin note in, '{ Topa' } thugen pen vangik ahi hi,' na cih peuhmah uh leh { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, note in na cihloh dingun kong hilh pen ci teitei na hih manun
keimah in note leh na pu na pate uh ka piaksa khuapi ka domto ding a, ka omna panin ka lawnkhia taktak ding hi.
A tawntungin simmawhna leh maizumna kong thuaksak ding a, cikmah hunin na mangngilh ngei nawn kei ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Babylon Kumpi Nebukhadnezzar in Jerusalem khua panin Jehoiakim' tapa Judah kumpipa Jehoiakhin leh Judah kumpi uliante, khutsiamte leh sikseek siamte, Babylon khua-ah sal dingin a paikhiatpih khit ciangin { Topa } in hih maang hong musak hi. { Topa' } biakinn mai-ah theigah bawm nih dim ka mu hi.
Bawm khat sunga theigahte, a min masate tawh kibangin limci mahmah hi. Ahih hangin a bawm khat pen sunga theigahte limci hetloin nektheih ding bang hi deklo hi.
{ Topa } in hong hopih a, "Jeremiah aw, bang mu na hi hiam?" ci-in hong dong hi. Kei zong, "Theigah ka mu hi. A limcite limci mahmah a, a limcilote limcilo lua ahih manin nektheih ding bang hilo hi," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in, "{ Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in kong cihin-ah:
Hih mun panin Khaldea mite' gama ka puakkhiat Judah mi saltangte hih theigah hoihte bangin a hoihin ka ngaihsun ding hi.
Keimah { Topa } ka hihlam theihtheihna lungsim ka pia ding hi. A lungsim khempeuh uh tawh kei kiangah hong kileh ding uh ahih manin amaute ka mi ahi ding uh a, kei pen amaute' Pasian ka hi ding hi.
"Ahih hangin { Topa } in kong cihin-ah: Judah kumpipa Zedekiah leh ama gam uk uliante-a kipan hih gamah a omsuak Jerusalem khuasunga a omlai sunteng leh Egypt gamah a tengte limcilo lua ahih manin a kine theilo theigahte bangin ka bawl ding hi.
Amaute ka hawlkhiatna ding mun khempeuhah mite in kihamsiatna-in a zat dingun simmawhna leh zahkonate ka thuaksak ding a, amaute' thuakna hangin leitung gam khempeuh ka lausak ding hi.
Namsau tawh kithahna, kialpi, leh pulnatnate ka tungsak ding a, amaute leh a pu a pate' kiangah ka piaksa gamsungah khat beek ka nungtasak nawn kei ding hi," hong ci hi.
Josiah' tapa Jehoiakim, Judah gamah kumpi a suahzawh kum sawmli a cin' kumin Judah mite tawh kisai-in { Topa } in Jeremiah a hopih hi. (Hih hun pen Babylon-ah Nebukhadnezzar kumpi a suah kum ahi hi.)
Kamsangpa Jeremiah in zong Judah gammi khempeuh leh Jerusalem khuami khempeuhte' tungah hih bangin a gensawn hi:
"Amon' tapa Josiah, Judah gamah kumpi a suahzawh a kum sawm leh thum pan tu ciangdong kum sawmnih leh kum thum sung { Topa } in kei hong hopih a, ke'n zong note kiangah kong gensawn tawntung hangin note in na ngai kei uh hi.
{ Topa } in ama nasem ahi kamsangte khempeuh hong sawl tawntung hinapi-in note in ngailoin na bil uh na ngat kei uh hi.
Amaute in, 'Tu-in na vekpi-un na gitlohna uh leh na gamtat khialhnate uh panin na kihei uh leh { Topa } in note leh tanglai-a na pu na pate uh tungah na neih tawntung dingun a hong piak gamsungah na teng thei ding uh hi.
Pasian dangte' nung delhloin, a na semloin na biak kei uh a, na khut uh tawh na bawl uh milimte peuh bia-in na hehsak kei nak uh leh, note bangmah hong cih kei ding hi,' ci-in hong gen uh hi.
Ahih hangin { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, note in ka thu nong ngai kei uh a, note' gim ngahna ding mahin na khut uh tawh milim bawlin nong hehsak uh hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Vanglian { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, note in ka thu hong manglo na hih uh ciangin
en un, leilu lama om minam khempeuhte leh ka nasempa ahi Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar ka vaikhak ding a, hih gam leh a sunga a teng mi khempeuh leh hih kiima om gam khempeuh a sim dingin ka va la ding hi. Keimah in amaute ka susia mangkhin ding a, amaute a tawntungin siacipin simmawhna ka thuaksak ding hi, ci-in { Topa } in kong gen hi.
Tua thamloin lungdamna leh kipahna awte, zinei thakpa leh mothaknu' awte, leh an gawina suang gingte ka gingsak nawn kei ding a, meivak taangte ka sumit ding hi.
Gamsung khempeuh kisia-in, gam simtham suak ding a, hih mite khempeuh kum sawmsagih sung Babylon kumpipa' salin a om ding uh hi.
Kum sawmsagih a cin' khit ciangin { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, Babylon kumpipa leh a gam amau' mawhna hangin gim ka pia ding a, tua gam a tawntungin gam simtham ka suaksak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh gam tampi leh kumpi liante in amaute salin man ding uh a, amau' gamtatna amau' tungah ka thukkik ding hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in kei hong hopih a, "Ka khuttung panin hehna tawh a kidim hih leenggahzu hai la in la, kong sawlna gamte khempeuh dawnsak in.
Tua ahih manin kei zong { Topa' } khuttung panin tua hai ka la a, { Topa' } hong sawlna gamte khempeuh ka dawnsak hi.
Jerusalem leh Judah gama khuapite, a kumpite uh leh a gam uliante uh ka dawnsak a, tuni dongin gam simtham suakin, mite' simmawhna thuakin, a min uh hamsiatna dingin a kizang hi. Tua hai panin a dawn a dangte:
Egypt kumpipa Faro leh a nasemte, a kumpi uliante;
Egypt mite leh amau' lakah a teng gamdang mite khempeuh; Uz gamsunga kumpite khempeuh leh Filistia gamsunga om Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron khuapite, leh Ashdod khuapi-ah a omlai sunte' kumpite khempeuh;
Edom, Moab, leh Ammon mite;
Arabia kumpite khempeuh; sehnel gamsunga teng minam kigawm khawmte' kumpite khempeuh;
leh a gamla hita leh a nai hita leh leilu lama a om kumpite khempeuh khat khit ciangin khat ka dawnsak hi. Tua ciangin leitunga om gam khempeuh ka dawnsak hi. A tawpna-ahBabylon kumpipa in a dawn ding hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in hong hopih a, "Amaute kiangah, Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in hih bangin ci hi: 'Dawn un. Kham un la lua un. Note kiangah namsau hong paisak ding ka hih manin tuk un la, thozo nawn kei un,' va ci in.
"Amaute in na khuttung panin hai la-in dawn ding uh a, hong nial uh leh amaute kiangah, 'Vanglian { Topa } in hong genin-ah: Na dawn uh kul ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh en un, ka min tawh a kilo khuapi sungah suksiatna ka pan ding hi. Note in bangmah a thuaklo ding kisa na hi uh hiam? Gim thuakloin na om kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh Vanglian { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, leitunga teng mite khempeuh a that dingin namsau khat ka sawl hi,' ci in.
"Tua ahih ciangin nangmah in amaute thu na va hilh ding a, hih bangin na va gen ding hi: 'A sang vantung panin { Topa } hong hawk ding a, a ten'na a siangtho panin hong paukhia ding hi. Ama mite' langkhatah nasia takin hong hawkgawp ding a, leenggah cil mite bangin leitung mi khempeuhte a langpangin hong kiko ding hi.
A awging, leimong dongah kithawn ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh gamte' langkhatah { Topa } pang hi. Amah in mi khempeuh thu sit ding a, namsau tawh migilote a thatlum ding hi, { Topa } in ci hi,' na ci ding hi.
"Vanglian { Topa } in a cihin-ah: En un, gam khat pan gam khatah siatna a paipai hi. Leitung a gamla pen mun panin huihpi hong nung hi.
"Tua ni-a { Topa' } thahlup mite' luanghawmte leimong khat panin mong khat dongah a kithehthang ding uh hi. Amaute kuamah in a kah kei ding uh a, kikaikhawm loin, kiphumlo ding uh ahih manin leilakah ek nusiatin a kinusia ding uh hi.
"No makaite aw, tau un la, kap un; vut lakah kikhuk un, no uliante aw. Bang hang hiam cih leh hong kithahlup ni ding leh na kikhenthang ni ding uh hong tungzo hi; tuutal teelte bangin hong kithatlum ding hi.
Makaite-a' dingin bukna ding omlo ding a, uliante-a' dingin suahtak theihna ding omlo hi.
Ngai dih un, makaite' kahna aw leh uliante' tauna aw kiza hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in a gam uh suksiatsak hi.
A lauhuai mahmah { Topa' } hehna hangin a nop mahmah a gam uh kisia gawp hi.
{ Topa' } namsau hang ahi a, a lauhuai ama hehna hang ahi zongin, amau' gam pen gam simtham suakkhin ahih manin humpinelkai in a kua a nusiat bangin { Topa } in a mite nusiazo hi," a ci hi.
Josiah' tapa Jehoiakim, Judah gam kumpi a suah tungin { Topa } in hih bangin Jeremiah hopih a,
"{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah, { Topa' } biakinnpi huang sungah va ding in la, { Topa' } biakinnpi sungah a bia dinga a hong pai Judah gam khuapite khempeuh kiangah gen dinga kong sawl khempeuh va gen in. Kam khat beek im kei in.
Amaute in na thugen hong ngai-in, a gitlohna uh pan kihei khathei ding uh hi. Tua hi leh amau' gitlohna hanga amaute suksiat dingin ka ngaihsutsa ka khelkik ding hi.
Nangmah in amaute kiangah, '{ Topa } in hih bangin ci hi: Note in ka thu hong ngailoin, note mai-a kong lahsa ka thukham bangin na gamtat kei uh a,
note in a thu na man' ngeiloh uh ahi, kong sawl zelzel ka nasem kamsangte' thu na thupi sim kei uh leh
Siampite, kamsangte leh mi khempeuh in hih thu a gen teng a za uh hi.
Mi khempeuh tungah { Topa } in gen dingin a sawlteng Jeremiah in a gen khit ciangin siampite, kamsangte, leh mi khempeuhte in amah man uh a, "Nang na sih ding kilawm hi.
Bang hangin, 'Hih biakinnpi pen Shiloh tawh kibang ding a, hih khuapi-ah a teng omloin gam simtham suak ding hi,' ci-in { Topa' } minin thu hilh ngam na hi hiam?" ci-in a gen uh hi. { Topa' } biakinnpi sungah a om mi khempeuh in Jeremiah a umcih uh hi.
Judah gam uk uliante in hih thu a zak uh ciangin kumpipa' innsung pan { Topa' } biakinnpi-ah hong paito uh a, { Topa' } biakinnpi lutna Kongpi Thak-ah a tu uh hi.
Tua ciangin siampite leh kamsangte in kumpi uliante leh mi khempeuhte' kiangah, "Note in na bil uh tawh na zak ciat uh mah bangin hihpa in hih Jerusalem khuapi langpangin thu hilh ahih manin thah ding kilawm hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jeremiah in kumpi ulian khempeuhte leh mi khempeuhte' kiangah, "{ Topa } in na zaksa uh ahi hih biakinnpi leh hih khuapi langkhatah ka gen thu khempeuh a gen dingin kei hong sawl hi.
Tua ahih manin tu-in na nuntak dante uh leh na gamtatziate uh khel un la, { Topa } na Pasian uh thu ngai un. Tua hi leh { Topa } in note' kisiatna ding a gensa thu a khelkik ding hi.
Ahih hangin kei ka hih leh, en un, note' khutsungah ka om hi. Note in hoih na sak uh bangin kei tungah hong bawl un.
Kei nong thah uh leh bel, mawh neilo mi khat na thah manun note mahmaha kipan hih khuapi leh a sunga tengte in na thuak ding uh thei ta un. Bang hang hiam cih leh note' bil mahmahin na zak dingun hih thute a gen dingin { Topa' } hong sawl taktak ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi uliante leh mi khempeuhte in siampite leh kamsangte tungah, "Hihpa in eite' { Topa } Pasian' min tawh thu hong gen ahih manin thah ding kilawmlo hi," a ci uh hi.
Gamsung upa pawlkhat in zong, dingin tua a kikhawm mi khempeuhte' kiangah,
"Judah kumpipa Hezekiah in a uk laitakin Moresheth khuami Mikah in Judah mi khempeuhte' kiangah, 'Lo dingin Zion mual a kikho ding hi. Jerusalem khua kisia zan ding a, biakinn mual, gamlak a suak ding hi, ci-in Vanglian { Topa } in gen hi,' ci hi.
"Tua hinapi, Judah kumpipa Hezekiah leh Judah mi khempeuhte in amah that zenzen uh ahi hiam? Kumpipa in { Topa } zahtakin, { Topa' } pahtak ding a nget ciangin { Topa } in zong amau' tungah siatna tun'sak dingin a gensa khelkikzaw hilo ahi hiam? Ahih hangin eite in eite' tungah siatna lianpi khat i tungsak dektak hi," a ci uh hi.
Kiriathjearim khua panin zong { Topa' } min tawh thu a hilh Shemaiah' tapa Uriah a kici midang khat a omlai hi. Jeremiah' gen bangmahin amah in zong hih Jerusalem khuapi leh hih gam langkhatah thu a gen hi.
Kumpi Jehoiakim leh a galkapmang khempeuh leh kumpi ulian khempeuhte in ama thugente a zak uh ciangin kumpipa in thah dingin a zong hi. Ahih hangin Uriah in tua thu a zak ciangin lau-in Egypt gamah a taisim hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi Jehoiakim in Akbor' tapa Elnathan leh midang pawlkhat Egypt gamah sawl a,
amau in zong Egypt gam panin Uriah manin kumpi Jehoiakim kiangah a puak uh hi. Amah in tuapa namsau tawh thatin a luanghawm mi mawkmawkte' kivuina munah a paai hi.
Ahih hangin Shafan' tapa Ahikam in Jeremiah hu ahih manin thah dingin mite' khutsungah kipialo hi.
Josiah' tapa Zedekiah, Judah gamah kumpi a suah tungin { Topa } in kei kiangah thu hong gen hi.
{ Topa } in kei tungah, "Savun khau tawh a kithuah hakkol bawl in la, na ngawngah thuah in.
Edom kumpipa tung, Moab kumpipa tung, Taia kumpipa tung, leh Sidon kumpipa tungah, Judah kumpipa Zedekiah tawh kimu dingin Jerusalem khua-ah a hong pai a kumpi taangmite' tung tawnin thu zasak in.
Amaute in a kumpite uh tungah, Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in hih bangin ci hi, ci-in gen uh hen.
'Keimah in a lian mahmah ka vangliatna tawh ka khut zanin, leitung leh leitunga om mite leh ganhingte ka bawl a, piak tuak ka sakte tungah ka pia hi.
Tu-in hih gamte, ka nasempa ahi Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar' khutsungah ka pia khinzo hi. Gamsate nangawn ama nasem dingin ka pia lai hi.
Ama gam a kisiat hun a tun' mateng gam khempeuh in amaha kipan a tapa leh a tupa' na a sepsak ding uh hi. Tua khit ciangin gam tampi leh kumpi liante in amah salin a lehneih kik ding uh hi.
"'Ahih hangin gam khat peuhpeuh ahih kei leh kumpi khat peuhpeuh in Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar' na semloin, Babylon kumpipa' hakkol a ngawngah a puak kei leh, amah ka ukcipsak mateng namsau tawh, kialpi tawh, pulnatna tawh tua gam gim ka pia ding hi, { Topa } in kong ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Babylon kumpipa' na sem kei un, ci-a note kiangah a hong gen na kamsangte uh, na aisan theite uh, na mang man theite uh, leh na mangsan theite uh' thugennate um kei un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh note' kianga hong gen uh thu pen zuauthu hi a, tua hangin na gam uh panin gamlapi-ah note hong kipai khiatpih ding hi. Keimah in note kong hawlkhia ding a, note na si ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin Babylon kumpipa' hakkol pua a, ama na a sem gam pen, lo kho-in a ten'theihna dingin ama gamsung mahah ka omsak ding hi, ci-in { Topa } in hong gen hi,' ci-in gen uh hen," hong ci hi.
Judah kumpipa Zedekiah kiangah zong tua bangmahin ka gen a, "Na nuntak theihna dingin Babylon kumpipa' hakkol pua in.
Bang hangin namsau tawh, kialpi tawh, pulnatna tawh nang leh na mite si ding uh ahi hiam? Babylon kumpipa' na a semlo gam khat peuhpeuh tuaci sih ding, ci-in { Topa } in a gen hi.
{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah, 'Keimah in amaute ka sawl kei hi. Ahih hangin amaute in kei' min tawh a manlopi-in thu hilh uh a, tua hangin note leh note' kiangah thu hong hilh kamsangte kong sawlkhia khawm ding a, na si ding uh hi,' ci hi," ci-in ka gen hi.
Tua ciangin siampite leh hih mi khempeuhte' kiangah, "{ Topa } in hong genin-ah, 'En un, Babylon khua panin { Topa' } biakinn beelte kila kik baih ta ding hi,' ci-in note' kiangah na kamsangte uh' hong thugente um kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh note kiangah hong gen uh thu pen zuauthu ahi hi.
Amau' thu na mang kei un. Na nuntak theihna dingun Babylon kumpipa' na na semzaw un. Bang hangin hih khuapi gam simtham suak laizang ding ahi hiam?
Amaute kamsang taktak ahih uh a, { Topa } in ka hopih taktak ahih uh leh, { Topa' } biakinnpi sung, Judah kumpipa' innsung, leh Jerusalem khuasungah a kinusia lai beelte Babylon khua-ah a kipuakkhiat nawnlohna dingin Vanglian { Topa } kiangah hong thum uh hen.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh, Jehoiakim' tapa Judah kumpi Jehoiakhin leh, Judah gam leh Jerusalem khua-a kumpi ulian khempeuh Jerusalem khua pan Babylon khua-ah Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar in sal dingin a paikhiat-pih laitakin, a nusiatlai khuampite, tuikuangpite, a kingaknate, leh hih khuapi sungah a kinusia lai beelte tawh kisai-in ahi a,
{ Topa' } biakinnpi sung, Judah kumpipa' innsung, leh Jerusalem khuasungah a kinusia lai beelte tawh kisai-in ahi zongin Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in a genin-ah:
Tuate Babylon khua-ah kipuakhia ding a, ka kankik mateng tua lai-ah a omsuak ding hi. Tua khit ciangin tuate ka lakik ding a, hih munah ka koihkik ding hi, { Topa } in hong ci hi," ci-in ka gen hi.
Tua kum mahin (Judah gamah Zedekiah kumpi a suah zawh kum li leh kha nga a phak kum) Gibeon khua panin a hong pai Azzur' tapa kamsang Hananiah in { Topa' } biakinnpi sungah siampite leh mi khempeuh a omkim laitakin hong hopih a,
"Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in hong genin-ah: Babylon kumpipa' vangliatna ka susia khin hi.
Kum nih sungin Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar in hih mun pan lakhia-in Babylon khua-ah a puak, { Topa' } biakinnpi sunga beelte hih munah ka lakik ding hi.
Jehoiakim' tapa Judah kumpi Jehoiakhin leh Judah gam panin Babylon-ah salin a paite khempeuh zong hih munah ka lakik ding hi, { Topa } in hong ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Babylon kumpipa' vangliatna ka susia ding hi, ci hi," a hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa' } biakinnpi sung-ah dingin a om siampite leh mi khempeuhte a omkim laitakin keimah Jeremiah in Hananiah ka hopih a,
"Amen! { Topa } in tua na gen bangin hong sem ta hen. { Topa } in na thugenkholhna bangin hong tungsak hen la, Babylon khua panin { Topa' } biakinnpi sunga beelte leh salin a kimante khempeuh hih lai munah hong lakik tapeuh hen!
Ahi zongin tu-in nang leh mi khempeuhte' zakin kong gen ding hih thu na ngai ta un.
Nang leh kei' ma-in a om, tanglai-a kamsangte in gam tampi leh gam liante' tungah gal ahi zongin, kial ahi zongin, pulnatna ahi zongin hong tung ding hi, ci-in a genkholzo uh hi.
Ahi zongin, nopna hong tung ding hi, ci-in a gen kamsangpa pen { Topa' } hong sawl kamsangpa hi taktak hiam, cih kamsangpa' gen bang hong tun' ciangin a kithei pan ding ahi hi," ka ci hi.
Hananiah in zong mi khempeuh a om laitakin thu gen a, "{ Topa } in, tu-a bangin Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar' vangliatna kum nih sungin gam khempeuhte' tung panin ka beisak ding hi, ci hi," ci-in a gen hi. Tua ciangin kei ka paikhia hi.
Kamsangpa Hananiah in ka ngawng panin ka hakkol lakhia a, hong kuaihtansak zawh tawlkhat khit ciangin { Topa } in kei hong hopih a,
"Pai in la Hananiah kiangah, '{ Topa } in hih bangin hong ci hi: Nangmah in sing tawh kibawl hakkol na kuaitanzo hi. Ahih hangin keimah in sik tawh kibawl hakkol khat tawh ka laih ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in hong genin-ah: Hih gam khempeuhte' ngawngah sik hakkol ka thuah khinzo a, amaute in Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar' na a sem ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh gamsate nangawn ama tungah ka pia khinzo hi, ci hi,' va ci in," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong kamsang Hananiah' kiangah, "Na ngai in, Hananiah! { Topa } in nang hong sawllohpi, hih mite zuauthu na umsak hi.
Tua ahih manin { Topa } in a hong genin-ah: 'En in, hih leitung panin nangmah hong lakhia ding hi. { Topa } langpan'na thu gen na hih manin tu kum sung mahin na si ding hi,' hong ci hi," ka ci hi.
Jerusalem khua panin Nebukhad- nezzar in Babylon khua-ah salin a paikhiatpih uliante, siampite, kamsangte, leh mi khempeuhte' tungah lai khat ka khak hi.
Tua hunin kumpi Jehoiakhin leh a nu, a kumpi innsungmangte, Judah gam leh Jerusalem khua-a makai upate, khutsiamte leh sikseekte, Jerusalem khua panin kipai khiatpih khinzo hi.
Tua laikhak pen Judah kumpipa Zedekiah in Babylon khua Nebukhadnezzar kumpipa kiang-ah kumpi taangmi dingin a puak Shafan' tapa Elasah leh Hilkiah' tapa Gemariah-te ka puasak hi. Tua sungah:
"Jerusalem panin Babylon-ah a hong kipuakkhia saltang mi khempeuhte' tungah Vanglian { Topa, } Pasian in hih bangin hong ci hi:
Inn lam un la, a sungah teng un. Huan bawl un la, a sungah na cin'te uh ne un.
Zi pi un la tanu tapa nei un. Na tapate-a' ding mo la un la, na tanute uh mo kha un; tua hi leh amau in zong tanu tapa hong nei ding uh hi. Kiam kei un la, pungzaw un.
Note salin kong koihna khuapi' phattuamna ding bawl un la, tua khuapi-a' dingin { Topa' } tungah thu ngetsak un. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua khuapi in phattuamna ngah leh no zong phattuamna a ngah mah na hi uh hi.
Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in kong genin-ah: Note' lakah a om na kamsangte uh leh na aisan theite uh' khemsa-in ta kei un la, a mangmat hong gente uh na ngai kei un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka min tawh no tungah hong gen uh thute zuauthu hi a, ka sawllohpi ahi uh hi, { Topa } in ci hi.
"{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah: Babylon khua-ah kum sawm sagih na om khit uh ciangin, note kong kan kik ding a, kong kamciamnasa hong tangtung sakin hih munah kong lakik ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, mailamah lametna note kong piakkik ding, na siatna ding uh hiloin na phattuamna ding uh geelna ka neihte kei bek in ka thei hi.
{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah, note in nong mu ding uh a, na saltan'na uh hong beisakin, kong hawlkhiatna gam khempeuh leh mun khempeuh panin kong kaikhawm kik ding a, note kong lakkhiatna gam mahah kong tun'pih kik ding hi, { Topa } in kong ci hi.
"Note in, 'Eite-a' dingin { Topa } in Babylon khua-ah kamsang hong koihsak hi,' ci-in gen na hih manun
David kumpi tokhom tunga tu kumpipa leh hih khuapi sunga om, note tawh saltang dingin a paikhawmlo na behte khempeuh uh tawh kisai-in { Topa } in kong genin-ah:
En un, amaute tungah namsau tawh kithahna, kialpi leh pulnatna ka tungsak ding a, amaute, a kine theilo theigah muat ka bangsak ding hi.
Amaute, namsau, kialpi, leh pulnatna tawh ka nungdelh ding a, ka hawlkhiatna ding mun khempeuhah mite in kihamsiatna-in a zat dingun simmawhna leh zahkonate ka thuaksak ding a, amaute' thuakna hangin leitung gam khempeuh ka lausak ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh, { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, ka nasem ka kamsangte' tung tawnin kong puak ngitnget thute amaute in thupisim loin a hong mang kei uh hi.
Jerusalem khua panin Babylon khua-ah kong puakkhiat, no saltangte khempeuh aw, { Topa' } kammal ngai dih un:
"Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in, kei' min tawh note kiangah zuauthu a hong hilh Kolaiah' tapa Ahab leh Maaseiah' tapa Zedekiah-te tawh kisai-in kong genin-ah: En un, keimah in amaute Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar' khutsungah ka pia ding a, amah in note' muhin amaute a thatlum ding hi.
Amaute' hangin Judah gam panin Babylon khua-ah saltang mi khempeuh in, 'Babylon kumpipa in Zedekiah leh Ahab, a hingtangin mei sungah a hal bangin { Topa } in nang hong hal ta hen,' ci-in kihamsiatna-in a zang ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute, Israel gamah hai gamtat uh hi: A innvengte' zite mawhpih uh a, thu ka piaklohpi ka min tawh zuauthu a gen uh hi. Keimah { Topa } in ka mu a, teci ka hi hi, hong ci hi," ci-in ka gelh hi.
Nehelam khuami Shemaiah kiangah thugen dingin Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in kei hong sawl hi. Shemaiah in ama min tawh Jerusalem khua-a om mi khempeuhte' kiang leh siampi Maaseiah' tapa Zefaniah leh siampi khempeuhte kiangah lai na khak hi. Tua a lai sungah Shemaiah in Zefaniah' kiangah,
"{ Topa } in siampi Jehoiada tangin nangmah siampi-in hong koih khinzo a, { Topa' } biakinnpi sungah a ukpi ding na hi ta hi. Tua ahih manin thu a hilh mawkmawk mihaite thong kia sakin kol na bulh ding hi.
Bang hangin note kiangah thu a hong hilh Anathoth khuami Jeremiah tailo na hi hiam?
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Babylon khua-ate lai hong khakin, sawt veipi sal tang ding na hih manun, inn lamin a sungah teng un la, huan bawlin a sunga na cin'te uh ne un, hong ci hi," ci-in a gelh hi. Hih bangin Zefaniah' kiangah a laikhakna thu tawh kisai Shemaiah kiangah a gen dingin Pasian in kei hong sawl hi.
"Saltang mi khempeuhte' kiangah Nehelam khuami Shemaiah tawh kisai-in { Topa' } thugenna hih bangin zasak in: Kong sawl lohpi Shemaiah in note kiangah thu hong gen a, zuauthu hong umsak ahih manin,
{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah: En un, keimah in Nehelam khuami Shemaiah leh a suan a khakte gim ka pia ding hi. Amah in keimah hong langpan'na ding thu gen ahih manin ka mite-a' dingin a hoih ka bawl ding nate, amah leh a suan a khakte khat beek in a mu kei ding uh hi, ci-in gen in," hong ci hi.
{ Topa } in hong hopih a,
"{ Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in kong genin-ah: Kong gensa thute khempeuh laibu khat sungah khum in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, ka mi Israel leh Judah-te a saltan'na uh ka beisakkik ni a hong tung ding hi. A pu a pate uh tungah ka piaksa gamah ka tun'pihkik ding a, amaute in tua gam a tangkik ding uh hi, { Topa } in kong ci hi," hong ci hi.
Israel leh Judah mite tawh kisai-in hih bangin a gen hi:
"{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah: Launa leh patauhna aw ka za a, lungnopna aw ka za kei hi.
Tu-in ngaihsun dih un. Pasalte nau a suak ngei uh hiam? Tua ahih leh bang hangin pasal khempeuh in numei nausuak dingte bangin a tai uh hum ahi uh hiam? Bang hangin a mai uhah si tenglo ahi hiam?
Nu e! Tua ni lianpi hong tung ding a, nidang tawh tehtheih ding hilo hi. Jakob suante' gimhun hi ding a, ahih hangin amaute suakta veve ding uh hi.
"Vanglian { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, tua ni ciangin amau' ngawng panin a hakkolte uh ka kuaihtansak ding a, a khaute ka sutat ding hi. Amaute, gamdang mite' salin a om nawn kei ding uh hi.
{ Topa, } amau' Pasian' na ahi a, amaute' kumpipa-in ka koih ding David' na ahi zongin a semzaw ding uh hi.
"Tua ahih manin { Topa } in kong cihin-ah: Ka nasempa Jakob' suante aw, lau kei un. Israel mite aw, patau kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh gamlapi gam panin no kong honkhia ding a, na suan na khakte uh a saltan'na uh panin ka honkhia ding hi. Jakob' suante hong ciah ding uh a, nuamtakin a tengkik ding uh hi. Kuamah in amaute a lausak nawn kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, a hong honkhia dingin note kong ompih hi. Note ka hong thehthangna gamte khempeuh ka susia ding a, ahih hangin note kong susia kei ding hi. A kilawm zahin kong thuhilh ding a, gim pialoin kong mawk nusiat kei ding hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in kong cihin-ah: Na liamma uh dam theilo a, na meima uh nasia mahmah hi.
Note a hong don ding kuamah omlo a, na liamma uh-a' ding zatui omlo a, note' lungdamna ding bangmah omlo hi.
Na lawm ngaihte un hong mangngilh khin uh a, hong don nawnlo uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh na khialhnate uh lian lua-in, na mawhnate uh nasia lua ahih manin, galte bangin note kong bawl a, nasia takin gim kong thuaksak hi.
Bang hangin na sa-in kapkap na hi uh hiam? Na natna uh a dam thei ding hilo hi. Na khialhnate uh lian lua-in, na mawhnate uh nasia lua ahih manin hih bangin note ka hong thuaksak hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, na galte un note, pampaih mi pawl, hong ci-in, 'Kuama donloh Zion na hi hi,' hong cih uh hangin note kong cidamsak kik ding a, na liammate uh ka damsak ding hi.
"{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah: En un, keimah in Jakob suante' bukte ka lamkik ding a, a ten'na uh ka hehpih ding hi. Khuapi zong a omnasa mualtung mahah kilamkik ding a, kumpipa' inn zong a omnasa mahah omkik ding hi.
Tuate sung panin lungdamna la kisa ding a, gualnopna aw kiza ding hi. Amaute ka pungsak ding a, tawmkha bek hilo ding uh hi. Amaute ka kipahtawisak ding a, ka neusak kei ding hi.
A kumpi ding uh amaute khat mah hi ding a, amaute a uk ding amau' sung mah panin a piang ding hi. Keimah in amah ka kai ding a, kei kiangah amah hong pai ding hi. Tua hi kei leh ama thu-in kei a hong zuan ngam ding kua om ahi hiam, { Topa } in kong ci hi.
En un, { Topa' } huihpi nung! A hehna hong kinuai nainai-in hong paikhia ta a, migilopa' lutang hong kiden'na ding hi.
A lungsim sunga a tupna teng a tangtun'sak matengin, { Topa' } hehna a lauhuaipi kilehkik lo ding hi. Hong pai ding hunte-ah note in na telzaw semsem ding uh hi.
"{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah, tua hun ciangin kei pen Israel mi khempeuhte' Pasian ka hi ding a, amaute pen keima mite ahi ding uh hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in hong genin-ah: "Namsau tawh thahna a thuaklote in gamlakah hehpihna a mu ding uh hi. Israel mite in tawldamna ding a zon' laitakun,
gamlapi pek panin { Topa } ka kilang hi. Keimah in nang kong it tawntung a, tua ahih manin nang' tungah kong thuman tawntung hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Efraim mualtung panin galvilte in, 'Tho un! { Topa } i Pasian kiang Zion khua-ah va pai ni,' ci-in a hong kiko hun uh hong tung ding hi," hong ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, "Jakob-a' dingin lungdamna tawh ngaih takin la sa un la, gam khempeuh lakah gam lian pen-a' dingin kiko-in awng un. '{ Topa } in Israel mi a omlaite, ama mite hong honkhia khinzo hi,' ci-in taangko un la phat un.
En un, keimah in leilu lam gam panin amaute ka la ding a, leitung a gamla pen mun panin ka kaikhawm ding hi. Mittawte leh khebaite zong hong kihel ding uh a, nupi gaite leh nausuak ding numeite-a kipan hih lai munah mihonpi hong ciahkik ding uh hi.
Amaute a kap kawmin hong pai ding uh a, keimah in hehnemin amaute ka pii kik ding hi. Tui omna lui gei-ah amaute ka paipihkik ding a, lam nuamah paipihin a tuk kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel mite' pa ka hi a, Efraim, ka ta upa pen ahi hi.
"Aw, gamdangte aw, { Topa' } kammal ngai un la, gamlapi, tuipi gei-a omte kiangah va gensawn un. 'Israel mite a kithehthang sakpa in kaikhawm kik ding a, tuucingpa in a tuute a kep bangin a kem ding hi,' va ci un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in Jakob ka suaktasak khinzo a, a zawh zawhloh khutte' sung pan ka honkhiazo hi.
Amaute hong pai-in Zion mual tungah ngaihtakin la sa ding uh a, { Topa' } hehpihna ahi, buh, leenggahzu, sathau leh tuuno, bawngnote' hangin amaute a lungdam mahmah ding uh hi. A nuntakna uh, tui a kibuak huan bang ding a, lungkham nawnlo ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin nungakte lamin lungdam ding uh a, tangvalte leh papite zong nuam ding uh hi. Amau' kahnate lungdamna ka suaksak ding a, amaute hehpihin a dahnate uh kipahna ka suaksak ding hi.
An lim pen tawh siampite ka vak ding a, keima hoihna hangin ka mite a lungkim ding uh hi, { Topa } in ka ci hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah: "Ramah khua-ah aw khat kiza a, tauna leh kah ngutngutna awging ahi hi. Rachel, a tate-a' dingin a kap hi. A tate om nawnlo ahih manin kinem zolo hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah: "Kap nawn kei un la, na khitui uh nul un. Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, na nasep thaman uh na ngah uh hi. Amaute galte' gam panin hong ciahkik ding uh hi.
Na mailam uh-a' dingin lametna a om hi, { Topa } in kong ci hi. Na tate uh zong na gam mah uhah hong ciahkik ding uh hi.
Efraim' kahna aw ka zazo a, '{ Topa } aw, bawngtal sinloh bangin kei nong thuhilh khinzo hi. Kong ciahkik theihna dingin hong lakik in; bang hang hiam cih leh nang pen { Topa } ka Pasian na hi hi.
Nangma kiang panin ka paikhiat khit phetin ka kisikkik a, nong thuhilh khit ciangin dahin ka kun hi. Ka neu laitaka ka minsiatna teng pua niloh ka hih manin maizumin ka lung-am hi,' a ci hi.
"Efraim, ka it ka tapa hilo ahi hiam? Amah keima ngaihno hilo ahi hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh ama thu ka gen simin amah ka phawk lailai hi. Tua ahih manin amah ka ngaihsun tawntung a, ka hehpih taktak ding hi, { Topa } in ka ci hi.
Lampi-ah ciamtehnate bawl un la, lamlahnate phut un. Na paikhiatna uh lampi mah limtakin zongkik un. Nungak siangtho tawh a kibang Israel mite aw, hong kilehkik un la, na khuapite uh hong zuankik un.
Bang tanvei lungka ding na hi hiam, a zulhzau ka tanu aw. Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in leitungah na thak khat bawl a, numei in pasal a honzo hi," a ci hi.
Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in hong genin-ah: "Keimah in amaute a gam uhah ka omsak kik ciangin, Judah gam leh a khuapite uhah amaute in, 'Thuman thutak a ten'na mual siangtho aw, { Topa } in thupha hong pia ta hen,' ci-in a genkik leuleu ding uh hi.
Judah gam leh a khuapite sungah lokhote leh tuu cinga a vak kawikawi mite a tengkhawm ding uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin ka khanglo a, ka khuadak hi. Ka khan'lawh nuam ka sa mahmah hi.
{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah, "Israel gam leh Judah gam, mihing leh ganhing tawh ka dimsak hun hong tung ding hi.
Amaute a kibetkhiatna ding leh a kitapzanna ding ahi zongin, a kisuankhiatna ding leh a kisiatna ding ahi zongin ka vaihawm mah bangin, { Topa } in ka cihin-ah, amaute a kilamna ding leh a kiphuhna dingin ka vaihawm ding hi.
"En un, { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, Israel minamte leh Judah minamte tawh thuciamna thak khat ka bawl ni hun hong tung ding hi.
Tua pen, a pu a pate uh, Egypt gam panin ka lakkhiatna dingin a khut uh tawh ka kaihkhiat huna ka bawl uh thuciamna tawh kibanglo ding hi. Tua hun lai-in kei amaute' pasal hinapi-in ka thuciamna a hong palsat uh hi, { Topa } in kong ci hi.
Ahih hangin { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, tua hun hong tun' ciangin Israel minamte tawh hih bangin thuciamna ka bawl ding hi: Amaute' sungah ka thukham ka koih ding a, amaute' lungtang tungah ka gelh ding hi. Kei pen amaute' Pasian ka hi ding a, amaute pen keima mite ahi ding uh hi.
Kuamah in midangte leh a sanggamte uh kiangah, '{ Topa } thei in,' ci-in a kihilh nawn kei ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, amaute in a neupen panin a lianpen dongin, a vekpi-un kei a hong thei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau' khialhnate ka maisak ding a, amaute' mawhnate zong phawkin ka nei nawn kei ding hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in sun-a khuavak dingin ni hong pia a, zan-a khuavak dingin a kikhel ngeilo kha leh aksite hong pia hi. Tuipi a lawh ciangin tuihualte ging zuazua a, ama min pen Vanglian { Topa } kici hi.
Amah in, "{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah, hih a kip mahmah leitung leh vantung ngeinate a kikhel hun ciang bekin, Israel mite' suanlekhakte in gam neiloin a om pan bek ding uh hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in hong genin-ah, "Vantung a kiteh theih ciang leh leinuai-a leitung bulpite a kivel theih ciang bekin Israel-te' suanlekhakte khempeuh a mawhna uh hangin ka lawnkhiamang pan ding hi, { Topa } in kong ci hi," a ci hi.
{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah, "Hananel Tausangpi panin khuakulh Kiu Kongpi dongin khuapi a kibawphat hun hong tung ding hi.
Misi luanghawmte leh vutte a kibuakna kuam buppi leh Kidron lui phak ma-a loteng khempeuh tawh, tua panin nisuahna lama Sakol Kongpi kiu ciangdong, { Topa}-a' dingin mun siangtho a suak ding hi. Cikmah ciangin tua khuapi kisusia nawnlo ding a, a kisuankhia ngei nawn kei ding hi," a ci hi.
Nebukhadnezzar kumpipa in a ukzawh kum sawm leh kum giat a phak kumin, Judah gamah Zedekiah kumpi a suahzawh kum sawm pha ta a, tua kumin { Topa } in Jeremiah a hopih hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Judah kumpipa Zedekiah in ama kiangah, "Bang hangin nangmah in thu genkhol a, '{ Topa } in a cihin-ah: En un, hih khuapi, Babylon kumpipa' khutsungah ka pia ding a, amah in a la ding hi.
Judah kumpipa Zedekiah zong Khaldea mite' khutsung pan a suakta kei ding a, Babylon kumpipa' khutsungah a kipia taktak ding hi. Amah tawh maitang kimu-in a ki-en ding uh a, a kiho ding uh hi.
Amah in Babylon khua-ah Zedekiah la ding a, ama tungah na ka sep mateng tua lai-ah om ding hi. Khaldea mite na do uh hangin na zo kei ding uh hi, { Topa } in hong ci hi,' ci-in bang hangin thu hilh na hi hiam?" ci-in thong sungah a khum hi.
Jeremiah in zong, "{ Topa } in kei hong hopih a,
Tua ciangin { Topa' } hong cihna bangmahin thong sungah ka innlak sanggampa hong pai takpi-in hong hopih a, 'Benjamin gam Anathoth khua-a ka lo hong lei in. Bang hang hiam cih leh, i ngeina bangin a nei ding leh a tankhia ding nangmah na hi hi. Nang-a' dingin lei in,' hong ci hi. Tua ciangin keimah in { Topa' } hong hopihna taktak hi, ci-in ka thei hi.
"Keimah in zong ka innlak sanggampa Hananel' kiang panin Anathoth khua-a lo ka lei a, ama-a' dingin ngun shekel sawmlesagih ka tehkhia hi.
Tua ciangin ka kithukimna teng uh a ki-atna, gip a kikhen lai pen leh gip a kikhenlo lai pen ka la a,
Neriah' tapa ahi, Mahseiah' tupa Baruk kiangah ka pia hi. Tua laite, ka innlak sanggampa Hananel tawh, tua kileina laite tunga a min uh a gelh a hong theihpih mite tawh thong huangsunga a tu Judah mite tawh a omkim laitakun ka pia hi.
'Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in a hong genin-ah: Hih gip a kikhen lai leh a kikhenlo laite gel la in la, sialoin sawtveipi a kikep theihna dingin leibeel khat sungah koih in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in a hong genin-ah: Hih gamah innte, lote, leh leenggah lote, mite in a leikikta ding uh hi,' ci-in ka gen hi.
"Neriah' tapa Baruk kiangah kileina lai ka piak khit ciangin { Topa' } kiangah thu ka ngen a,
'Topa { Pasian}! Nangma vangpi leh na khut tawh vantung leh leitung na bawl khinzo hi. Nang-a' dingin a haksalua khat beek omlo hi.
Nangmah in a kikhel ngeilo itna mi tul tampite' tungah na lak a, ahih hangin pate' mawhnate tate' tungah na thuk hi. Vanglian { Topa } a kici a lian mahmah, a hat mahmah Pasian aw,
na ngimnate lian mahmah a, na sepnate thupi mahmah hi. Mite' nuntak zia khempeuh na mu a, amau' nuntak dan leh a sepna tawh kizui-in mi khempeuh tungah thaman na pia kim hi.
Egypt gamah lim leh na lamdangte na lak a, tu-in zong Israel gam leh minam dangte khempeuh tungah lakin, tu-in mun khempeuhah na min thang mahmah hi.
Na mi Israel-te Egypt gam panin lim leh na lamdang tawh ahi a, a khauh mahmah a kizan na khut tawh ahi a, lauhuaina lianpi tawh ahi zongin na lakhia a,
a pute a pate uh tungah piak dingin na ciamsa, bawngnawi leh khuaizu tui bangin a luan'na hih gam na pia hi.
Amau zong lutin a luahpah uh hi. Ahih hangin amaute in na thu hong mangloin, thukham hong zuilo uh a, hih dinga na thupiakte khat beek a hih kei uh hi. Tua ahih manin amaute tungah hih siatna khempeuh na tungsak hi.
"'En in, khuapi lakna dingin kan a to khinzo uh hi. Namsau tawh kithahna hang, kialpi hang, leh pulnatna hangin amaute a sim Khaldea mite' khutsungah khuapi a kipia ding hi. Nong gensa bangin hong tun'loh phamawh ahih manin en in, nang' na mu ta hi.
Ahih hangin Topa { Pasian } aw, hih khuapi Khaldea mite' khutsung a tung ding hinapi, nangmah in, "A hong theihpih ding mi sam in la, tua lo lei in," ci-in nong sawl teitei hi,' ci-in thu ka ngen hi," a ci hi.
"En in, kei pen { Topa } ka hi a, mi khempeuhte' Pasian zong ka hi hi. Kei-a' dingin a haksa lua bang om ahi hiam?
Tua ahih manin, { Topa } in kong cihin-ah: En in, hih khuapi Khaldea mite' khutsung leh Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar' khutsungah ka pia ding a, amah in a la ding hi.
Hih khuapi a sim Khaldea mite hong pai-in mei tawh khuapi a hal ding uh a, ka hehna dingin innkhum tungah Baal milimte paknamtui halna tawh a biakna innte uh leh pasian dangte' kiangah tuidawn biakna a piakna uh innte zong a haltum ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel mite leh Judah mite in a neulai pek uha kipan ka muhna-ah a sia bekbek a gamta uh hi. Keimah { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, Israel mite in a khut uh tawh milim a bawlna uh hangin kei hong hehsak uh hi.
Hih khuapi in, a kisat cila kipan tuni ciangdong hong hehsakin hong thangpaisak ahih manin ka muhna panin ka hemkhia ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel mite leh Judah mite, a kumpite uh leh a kumpi uliante uh, a siampite uh leh a kamsangte uha kipan Judah mite leh Jerusalem khuamite khempeuh in kei hong hehsakna dingin siatna a bawl uh hi.
Amaute in kei hong nungngatin hong maingatlo uh a, ka hilh tawntung hangin ka hilhna a hong mang kei uh hi.
Hinnom Kuam-ah a tapate leh a tanute uh tawh Molek pasian a biakna dingun Baal-a' ding biakna tau sangte a bawl uh hi. Hih a kihhuai na semin, Judah mite mawhna a bawlsakna dingun amaute ka sawl kei a, zong ka ngaihsunkha ngei beek kei hi.
"Jeremiah aw, nangmah in hih khuapi, namsau tawh thahna, kialpi tun'na leh pulnatna tawh Babylon kumpipa' khutsungah kipia ding hi, na ci hi. Ahi zongin tu-in tua bang na cihna hih khuapi tawh kisai-in { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in kong genin-ah:
En in, ka hehna, ka thangpaihna leh ka lungkimlohna lianpi tawh ka hawlkhiatna gam khempeuh panin amaute ka kaikhawm kik ding a, hih munah tun'pih kikin, lungmuang takin ka omsak ding hi.
Amaute' hoihna ding leh amaute' nunga a tu a tate uh a hoihna dingin a tawntungin kei hong zahtakna dingun a lungsim uh kikhat sakin, a nuntak dan uh zong ka kikhatsak ding hi.
Amaute tungah a tawntungin hoihna ka bawl denna dingin amaute tawh tawntung thuciamna khat ka bawl ding hi. Kei kiang panin a kiheikhiat lohna dingun amaute sungah kei hong zahtakna ding uh lungsim ka guan ding hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, hih siatna khempeuh hih mite tungah ka tun'sak mah bangin, amaute' tunga ka khapsa a hoih khempeuh zong ka tungsak pelmawh ding hi.
Nangmah in, hih gam pen mihing leh ganhing a ten'lohna gam simtham hi ding a, Khaldea mite' khutsungah kipia ding hi, ci-in na gen hangin tu-in hih gamah lo kileikik ta ding hi.
Benjamin gam, Jerusalem khua kimkot leh Judah gam khuapite-a kipan mualtunga khuapite, Shefelah zanglei-a khuapite leh leitaw lam Negeb gama khuapite-ah sum tawh lo kilei ding a, a theihpih mite tawh thukimna min gelhin gip tawh kikhen ding hi; bang hang hiam cih leh keimah in amaute a gam mah uhah ka omsak kik ding hi, { Topa } in kong ci hi," a hong ci hi.
Thong huang sungah Jeremiah a kikhumcip laitak mahin { Topa } in a nihveina hopih a,
"Leitung bawlin a kipsak { Topa, } a min { Topa } a kici { Topa } in kong genin-ah:
Kei nong sap leh kong dawngkik ding a, na theih ngei nailoh a ki-imcip thu lianpite kong gen ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh galte' kan tawhna leh galkidona hangin a kisusiagawp ding hih khuapi sunga innte leh Judah kumpite' innte tawh kisai-in, { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in kong cihin-ah:
Ka hehna leh ka thangpaihna tawh ka thahlup ding misi luangte tawh a kidimsak dingin Khaldea mite in a hong sim ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh khuapi sunga a om mite' gitlohna hangin hih khuapi panin ka mai ka seel hi.
Ahih hangin tu-in, keimah in hih khuapi ka damsak ding a, cidamin ka omsak ding hi. A mite cidamsakin hauhna leh lungmuan'na a kicing ka lak ding hi.
Judah mite leh Israel mite ka hausak kik ding a, a nidanga a om ngei bangun ka omsak kik ding hi.
Kei tungah hong bawl uh mawhna khempeuh panin amaute ka siangsak ding a, kei tungah a hong mawhnate uh leh a hong langpan'na khempeuhte uh ka maisak ding hi.
Jerusalem khuapi pen kei-a' dingin lungdamna, minphatna, leh minthan'na ahi hi. A sunga om mite tungah hoihna leh hauhna ka tun'sakna thu a za minam dangte lau-in a ling ding uh hi.
"{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah, note in, 'Hih munah mihing, ganhing omloin mundai suak hi,' ci-in na gen uh mah bangin Judah gam khuapite leh Jerusalem khua kongzingte awng a, mihing ganhing kuamah a teng kei hi.
Ahih hangin lungdamna aw leh kipahna awte, zinei thakte leh mothakte' awte kiza kik ding hi. { Topa' } biakinn-ah mite hong pai-in lungdam kohna-in: 'Vanglian { Topa' } tungah lungdamna ko un. Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } hoih a, ama itna kip tawntung hi,' ci-in a lasakna awte uh a kiza kik ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, a masa-a mah bangin hih gam ka hausak kik ding hi.
"Vanglian { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, mihing ganhing omloin mun awng ahi mun leh a khuapi khempeuhte-ah tuu-cingte in tuu cingin a ten'theihna ding mun hong om ding hi.
Mualtunga khuapite, Shefelah zanglei-a khuapite leh leitaw lam Negeb gama khuapite, Benjamin gam, Jerusalem khua kimkot leh Judah gam khuapite-ah, { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, tuucingte in a tuute uh a phazah a sim ding uh hi.
"En un, { Topa } in kong cihin-ah: Israel mite leh Judah mite tungah ka khapsa thu ka tangtun'sak hun hong tung ding hi.
Tua ni ciangin Judah mite kihonkhia ding a, Israel mite lungmuang takin a teng ding uh hi. Amah a kisapna dingin a min '{ Topa, } Eite' Diktan'na,' ci-in a kiphuak ding hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in kong cihin-ah: Israel mite' kumpi dingin David' suan sung panin mi kitasam ngeilo ding hi.
Levi minam lak panin zong meihal biaknate, an tawh biakna leh biakpiaknate a pia tawntung dingin ka mai-ah a ding ding siampi kitasam ngeilo ding hi," a ci hi.
"{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah: Sun hun leh zan hun a manmanin a hong tun'loh theihna dingin sun tawh ka thuciamna leh zan tawh ka thuciamna na siatsakzawh ciang bekin,
keimah leh ka nasempa David tawh ka thuciamna kisia pan ding a, amah in a kumpi tokhom luah ding tapa neiloin, ka na a sem ding siampi Levi minamte tawh ka thuciamna zong a kisia hi pan ding hi.
Vana aksite kisim zoloin, tuipi-a sehnelte a kiteh zawhloh bangin keimah in ka nasempa David' suanlekhakte ahi a, siampi Levi minamte ahi zongin ka pungsak den ding hi," hong ci hi.
"Hih mite in, { Topa } in a teelsa Israel leh Judah minamte gel a nusia ta hi, ci-in a gen uh thei khalo na hi hiam? Tua bangin amaute in ka mite simmawh uh a, amau' muhna-ah minam khatin a sim nawn kei uh hi.
{ Topa } in kong genin-ah: Sun leh zan tawh ka thuciamna ahi a, vantung leh leitung ngeina kipte ahi zongin a kipsak khin nailo hi leng
Jakob leh ka nasempa David' suante ka nial ding a, Abraham, Isaac, leh Jakob' suante a uk dingin amaute' lakah mi khat zong a teello ding mah ka hi hi. Ahi zongin tu-in tua bang hiloin amaute ka hausak kik ding a, ka hehpih ding hi," a hong ci hi.
Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar in a galkapte khempeuh, a ukna gam khempeuh leh a mi khempeuh tawh Jerusalem khua leh a kiima khuapite a sim laitakin { Topa } in kei hong hopih a,
"{ Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in kong cihin-ah: Judah kumpipa Zedekiah kiangah pai in la, hih bangin va gen in: '{ Topa } in hong genin-ah: En in, keimah in Babylon kumpipa' khutsungah hih khuapi ka pia ding a, amah in mei tawh a hal ding hi.
Ama khutsung panin na suakta kei ding a, hong kimanin ama khutsungah nang hong kipia taktak ding hi. Nang leh Babylon kumpipa maitang kimu-in na kiho ding uh a, Babylon khua-ah na pai ding hi.
Judah kumpipa Zedekiah aw, { Topa' } kammal ngai lai dih in. { Topa } in nangmah tawh kisai-in a hong genin-ah, nang in namsau tawh thahna na thuak kei ding hi.
Nuamtakin na si ding a, nang' ma-a kumpi a suak na pu na pate-a' dingin paknamtui a kihal mah bangin nang-a' dingin zong paknamtui hong kihal ding a, "Aw, topa aw," ci-in hong kah ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in hong gen khinzo hi,' ci-in va gen in," a hong ci hi.
Tua hun pen Babylon kumpipa' galkapte in Jerusalem khuapi leh Judah gama khuapi muan'huai lakah a omlai Lakhish khua leh Azekah khuate gel zong a sim laitak uh ahi hi.
Zedekiah kumpipa in numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin Hebru mipih silate khahkhia-in, kuamah in a Jew mipihte sila-in khawi theilo ding hi, ci-in suahtakna ding thu zasak a, Jerusalem khua-a mi khempeuh tawh thuciamna a bawl hi.
Mi khempeuh in a silate uh numei ahi a, pasal ahi zongin khahkhia-in sila-in khawikik thei nawnlo ding hi, ci-in thuciamna a nei kumpi uliante-a kipan mi khempeuh in mang uh a, a khahkhia uh hi.
Ahih hangin tua nung ciangin a lungsim uh khelkikin a khahkhiatsa uh numei leh pasal silate lakik uh a, sila mahin a zang kik mawk uh hi.
"{ Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in kong cihin-ah, keimah in na pu na pate uh koltan'na Egypt gam pan ka lakkhiat laitakin amau tawh thuciamna khat ka bawl a,
note kiangah nasem dinga hong kizuak na Hebru mipihte uh in note-a' dingin kum guk, na hong sepsak khit a kum sagihna sungin na khahkhia ding uh a, na na uh na semsak nawn kei ding uh hi, ka ci hi. Ahih hangin na pu na pate un ka thu hong ngailo uh a, hong manglo uh hi.
Ahih hangin na lungsim uh na khelkik leuleu uh a, amau' utna banga na khahkhiatsa uh sila numei leh pasalte na lakik uh a, na na uh sem sakin ka min nong daisak uh hi.
Tua ahih manin { Topa } in kong cihin-ah: Mi khempeuh in na sanggam na mipihte uh khahkhia loin, suahtakna pialoin ka thu hong manglo na hih uh leh, en un, { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, note hong khahkhia-in suahtakna kong pia ta hi. Namsau tawh kithahna, pulnatna leh kialpite tawh na sihna dingun note kong khahkhia a, kong suaktasak hi. Leitung gam khempeuhte' hong lipkhap dingin kong bawl hi.
Mite in kei' mai-ah thuciamna a bawl uh ciangin bawngno phel nih suahin a kikalah a pai uh hi. Judah gam kumpi uliante, kumpi innsungmangte, siampite-a kipan bawngno phel nih kikalah a pai khinsa gamsunga ka mite khempeuh in ka thuciamna hong mangloin, thuciamna sunga om thute a zuih kei uh leh amaute tua bawngno ka bangsak ding hi.
A galte' khutsungah amaute ka pia ding a, a thatnuam mite' khutsungah ka pia ding hi. A luanghawmte uh vana vasate leh leitunga gamsate' an a suak ding uh hi.
Judah kumpipa Zedekiah leh a kumpi uliante, a galte uh' khutsungah pia-in, amaute a that nuam mite leh note' kiang panin a kilehkik khinzo Babylon kumpipa' galkapte' khutsungah ka pia ding hi.
En un, { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, keimah in thu ka pia ding a, hih khuapi-ah hong paikik ding uh hi. Amaute in hih khuapi hong simin, hong la-in mei tawh hong halsak ding uh hi. Judah gam khuapite kuama' ten'lohna mun awng ka suaksak ding hi," a hong ci hi.
Josiah' tapa Jehoiakim, Judah gam kumpi ahih laitakin { Topa } in kei hong hopih a,
"Rekhab behte kiangah pai in la, amau tawh na kiho khit ciangin { Topa' } biakinn-ah hong pai in la, inndei khat sungah tumpihin, tua ciangin a dawn dingin leenggahzu pia in," ci-in a hong sawl hi.
Tua ciangin Habazziniah' tupa ahi Jeremiah dang khat' tapa, Jaazaniah leh a sanggamte, a tate khempeuh leh Rekhab behte khempeuh ka sam hi.
Amaute, { Topa' } biakinnsung, kumpi uliante' inndei gei, Shallum' tapa, kongpi uk biakinn upa lian Maaseiah' inndei tung sanah a om, Igdaliah' tapa, Pasian' mi ahi Hanan' tate' inndei sungah ka lutpih hi.
Tua ciangin Rekhab behte' mai-ah leenggahzu a dimin a kikoih hai leh keute ka pia a, leenggahzu dawn un, ci-in ka sawl hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in, "Kote in leenggahzu ka ne kei ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Rekhab' tapa, ka pu uh Jonadab in thu hong pia a, 'Note-a kipan na ta na tute un leenggahzu na ne ngei peuhmah kei ding uh hi.
Inn na lam kei ding uh a, khai na tuh kei ding uh hi. Singno na suan kei ding uh a, leenggah lo na bawl kei ding uh hi. Ahih hangin na ten'pakna uh gamsungah sawtveipi na ten'theihna dingun na nuntak hun sungteng uh puanbuk sungah na teng ding uh hi,' hong ci hi.
Kote in Rekhab' tapa ka pu uh Jonadab' hong thupiak khempeuh ka mang uh a, ka nuntak hun sungteng uh ko-a kipan ka zite uh, ka tapate uh leh ka tanute uh in leenggahzu dawnloin,
ten'na ding inn ka lam kei uh hi. Leenggah huan, lo leh khaici bangmah ka nei kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar in hih gam hong sim ciangin kote in, 'Hong pai un. Khaldea galkapte leh Syria galkapte kihta ihih manin Jerusalem khua-ah pai ni,' ka kici uh a, tua mah bangin tu-in Jerusalem khua-ah ka teng uh hi," a hong ci uh hi.
"Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in kong cihin-ah: Pai in la Judah mite kiang leh Jerusalem khua-a teng mite' kiangah, { Topa } in: Ka thuhilhna hong sangloin ka thu hong ngailo ding na hi uh hiam?
Rekhab' tapa Jonadab in a suanlekhakte tungah leenggahzu a dawn lohna ding uh a thupiakna amaute in zui uh a, tuni ciangdong bangmah a dawn kei uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in a pu uh' thupiakna a mang uh hi. Keimah in note kong hopih tawntung hangin ka thu nong mang kei uh hi.
Ka nasem ahi kamsangte khempeuh note kiangah hong sawl tawntungin, 'Tu-in note khempeuh na hoihlohna uh panin kihei un la, na gamtat hoihlote uh kipuahpha un. Pasian dangte nung delh loin a na na sep kei nak uh leh note leh na pu na pate uh kiangah ka piak gam sungah na teng ding uh hi,' ci-in note tungah hong gen uh hi. Ahih hangin note in na bil uh nong ngat kei uh a, ka thu nong ngai kei uh hi.
Rekhab' tapa Jonadab' suante in a pu uh thupiakna a man' uh hangin hih mite in ka thu hong manglo uh hi.
Tua ahih manin keimah { Topa } Vanglian Pasian in kong genin-ah: En un, Judah mite leh Jerusalem khua-ah a teng mi khempeuh tungah a tung dingin ka gen khiatsa khempeuh ka tungsak ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau tungah ka gen hangin amaute in ka thu hong ngailo uh a, amaute ka sap hangin hong dawngkiklo uh hi, ci hi, ci-in va gen in," a hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong Rekhab behte kiangah, "Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in hong genin-ah: Na pu uh Jonadab' hong thupiakna mangin, a hong thuhilhna bangin zui-in, a hong sawl khempeuh sem khin na hih manun
Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in hong cihin-ah: Rekhab' tapa Jonadab' suante' lak panin ka mai-a ding ka nasem ding pasal khat beek a kitasam ngei kei ding hi, hong ci hi," ci-in ka gen hi.
Josiah' tapa Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim in a ukzawh kum li a phakna kumin { Topa } in kei hong hopih a,
"Laizial khat la in la, tua sungah Josiah kumpi a suah kum, nang kong hopih masak huna kipan tuni ciangdong Israel gam leh gamdang khempeuhte' langkhatah ka thugente khempeuh gelh in.
Judah mite in amau' tungah tun'sak dingin ka ngaihsut siatna khempeuh za-in, mi khempeuh in a siatna uh panin kiheina-in nei khathei ding uh a, keimah in zong amau' khialhna leh amau' mawhnate ka maisak thei khading hi," a hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong Neriah' tapa Baruk ka sam a, { Topa } in keima tungah a hong gen khitsa thu khempeuh sitin Baruk in laizial khat tungah a gelh hi.
Tua ciangin Baruk ka sawl a, "{ Topa' } biakinn-ah a pai dingin kei hong kiphal nawnlo ahih manin
nang va pai in la, an tan' ni ciangin { Topa' } biakinn sungah a om mi khempeuhte' zak dingin ka hong sit hih laizial sungah na at { Topa' } kammalte na va sim ding hi. Amau' khuapite pana hong paikhia Judah mi khempeuhte' zakin zong na sim ding hi.
{ Topa' } tungah amaute thumin a vekpi-un a hoihlohna uh panin a kihei thei khading uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih mite' tungah { Topa } in tun'sak dingin a gensa a hehna leh a thangpaihna lian mahmah hi," ka ci hi.
{ Topa' } biakinn sungah laizial sunga { Topa' } kammal simkhiat dingin ka sawl bangbangin Neriah' tapa Baruk in zong a hih hi.
Josiah' tapa Judah kumpi Jehoiakim in a ukzawh kum nga a phak kum, a kha kuana kha-in Jerusalem khua-a om mi khempeuh leh Judah gam khuapite panin Jerusalem khua-ah a hong pai mi khempeuh in { Topa' } maipha ngahna dingin an a tang uh hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa' } biakinnsung, a Kongpi Thak tumna gei, a dei tungnunga Shafan' tapa thuvanpipa Gemariah' inndei sungah mi khempeuh' zakin Baruk in laizial sunga ka gelhsak kammalte a simkhia hi.
kumpipa' innsung, thuvanpipa' inndei sungah paisuk a, tua lai munah thuvanpipa Elishama, Shemaiah' tapa Delaiah, Akbor' tapa Elnathan, Shafan' tapa Gemariah, leh Hananiah' tapa Zedekiah-te-a kipan kumpi ulian khempeuh tu-in na om uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi ulian khempeuh in, Kushi' tusawn ahi, Shelemiah' tupa, Nethaniah' tapa Jehudi, Baruk kiangah sawl uh a, "Mite kiangah na sim na laizial hong la in la hong pai in," ci-in a samsak uh hi. Tua ciangin Neriah' tapa Baruk in zong tua laizial la-in amaute kiangah hong paipih hi.
Amaute in, "Tu in la hong sim dih in," ci-in a gen uh hi. Baruk in zong amaute kiangah a sim hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi uliante in Baruk kiangah, "Pai in la, nang leh Jeremiah va bu un. Na omna mun uh kuamah theisak kei un," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in thuvanpipa Elishama' inndei sungah tua laizial koih uh a, kumpipa' omna inndei sungah a lut khit uh ciangin kumpipa kiangah tua thu khempeuh a gen uh hi.
Kumpipa in zong tua laizial a la dingin Jehudi sawl a, amah in thuvanpipa Elishama' inndei sung pan a va lakhia hi. Kumpipa leh kumpipa kiangah a ding ulian khempeuhte' zakin Jehudi in a sim hi.

Elnathan, Delaiah, leh Gemariah in kumpipa in laizial a hallohna ding a khoh uh hangin amah in a mang kei hi.

Tua ahih ciangin Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim' thu tawh kisai-in { Topa } in kong genin-ah, amah in David tokhom tunga tu ding suanlekhak a nei kei ding a, ama luanghawm pen sun laitakin nisa' kap ding leh zan laitakin vukngo' tuam dingin kipaidak ding hi.

Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in ka thu hong ngailo uh hi,' ci-in va gen in," ci-in kei a hong sawl hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong laizial dang khat la leuleu-in Neriah' tapa lai-at Baruk ka pia hi. Amah in zong Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim in meikhuk sungah a khul tumsa laizial sunga thu ki-at khempeuh, keima sit bangbangin a at hi. A thu kibang tampi zong ka gelhbeh sak hi.

"{ Topa } ahi Israel mite' Pasian in kong cihin-ah: Kei' tungah thu a hong dongsak Judah kumpipa kiangah hih bangin na va gen ding hi: 'En in, nang hong huh dingin a hong pai Faro kumpipa' galkapte a gam uhah ciahkik ding uh hi.
{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah, nang leh nang kikhemin, "Babylon-te hong kilehkik nawnlo taktak ding uh hi," cikha kei in. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute hong kilehkik ding uh hi.

kumpi Zedekiah in kei hong samsak hi. Kumpipa in a innsungah, "{ Topa' } hong thugen kam khat beek omlo ahi hiam?" ci-in a hong dongsim hi. Kei zong, "Om mah hi," ka cih khit ciangin, "Babylon kumpipa' khutsungah nang hong kipia taktak ding hi," ci-in ka gen hi.

Mattan' tapa Shefatiah, Pashhur' tapa Gedaliah, Shelemiah' tapa Jehukal, leh Malkhiah' tapa Pashhur-te in mi khempeuh tungah keima thugenna a za uh hi.

Tua ciangin keimah in Zedekiah kiangah, "{ Topa, } Vanglian Pasian, Israel mite' Pasian in hong genin-ah, Babylon kumpipa' uliante na belh leh na nuntakna hong kimap ding a, hih khuapi in zong mei tawh haltumna thuakloin nang leh na innkuanpihte na nungta ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin Babylon kumpipa' uliante na belh kei leh Babylon kumpipa' khutsungah hih khuapi kipia ding a, amau in mei tawh halin amaute' khutsung pan na suakta kei ding hi," ka ci hi.

Kei zong, "Amaute' kiangah nang hong kipialo ding hi. Tu-a kong gen bangin { Topa' } thu mang in. Tua hi leh nang-a' dingin hoih ding a, na nuntakna hong kimap ding hi.

amaute kiangah, 'Kumpipa in kei, Jonathan' inn-ah a si dingin a hong puakkik nawnlohna dingin a thum hi ing,' ci-in dawng in," ci-in a hong gen hi.

Mizpah khua Gedaliah kiangah a pai uh hi. Nethaniah' tapa Ishmael, Kareah' tapa Johanan, Tanhumeth' tapa Seraiah, Netofah khuami Efai' tate, leh Maakath mi Jezaniah-te in a galkapte hong paipih uh hi.
