Tua ciangin Kareah' tapa Johanan leh gamsung khuaneu-a om galkapbute khempeuh Mizpah khua Gedaliah kiangah hong pai uh a,
Tua ciangin Kareah' tapa Johanan in Mizpah khua-a Gedaliah' kiangah, "Nethaniah' tapa Ishmael hong thatsak in. Kuamah in hong theilo ding uh hi. Nang hong kithat leh nang a hong beel Jew mite kikhenthang ding a, Judah gamah mi a omlai sunteng in zong beilawh ding uh ahih manin bang hangin amah in nang hong that laizang ding ahi hiam?" ci-in a hopihsim hi.
Ahih hangin Ahikam' tapa Gedaliah in Kareah' tapa Johanan' kiangah, "Tua bangin hih kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh Ishmael' thu na genna manlo hi," a ci kik hi.
Kha sagih kha hong tun' ciangin Nethaniah' tapa, Elishama' tupa, kumpi nam leh kumpipa' ulian pente khat ahi Ishmael, mi sawm tawh Mizpah khua Ahikam' tapa Gedaliah' kiangah hong hawh uh hi. Mizpah khua-ah amaute in an a nekkhawm laitakun,
Nethaniah' tapa Ishmael leh tua mi sawmte in, Babylon kumpipa in gam uk dingin a koih Ahikam' tapa, Shafan' tupa Gedaliah pen namsau tawh satin a thatlum uh hi.
Ishmael in Mizpah khua-ah Gedaliah tawh a omkhawm Jew mi khempeuh leh tua laitakin a om Babylon galkapte zong a that hi.
Shekhem, Shiloh, leh Samaria khuate panin mi sawmgiat hong pai uh hi. Amaute in a khamul uh metin a puan uh balkekin, a pumpi uh a kikui gawpsa-in { Topa' } biakinn-ah an tawh biakna leh paknamtui tawh biakna a piak ding uh hong tawi khawm uh hi.
Khuapisung a tun' uh ciangin Nethaniah' tapa Ishmael leh a mi sawmte in amaute thatin a luang uh tuikhuksung khatah a paai uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute' lakah mi sawm in Ishmael' kiangah, "Ko hong that kei in. Mangbuh, mangbuhham, sathau leh khuaizu ka selsim uh lolai-ah tampi a om hi," a ci uh hi. Tua ahih manin amah leh a lawmte in amaute a that kei uh hi.
Ishmael in a thahsa misi luanghawm khempeuh a paihna tuikhuk pen a gol khat hi a, kumpipa Asa in Israel kumpipa Baasha a nan'na dingin a bawl ahi hi. Nethaniah' tapa Ishmael in a thahsa misi luanghawmte tua tuikhuk a dimsak hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi cing galkapmang Nebuzaradan in, Ahikam' tapa Gedaliah' uk dingin a piak kumpipa' tanute leh Mizpah khua-a a kinusia mi khempeuh-a kipan Mizpah khua-ah a omlai mi khempeuh Nethaniah' tapa Ishmael in man a, Ammon gam lam zuanin a paikhiatpih hi.
Ahih hangin Kareah' tapa Johanan leh amah tawh a omkhawm galkapmang khempeuh in Nethaniah' tapa Ishmael' tatsiatnate a zak uh ciangin
a galkap khempeuh uh tawh Nethaniah' tapa Ishmael a sim dingin a kuankhia uh hi. Gibeon tuikhukpi a tun' uh ciangin a pha uh hi.
Ishmael' mat mi khempeuh in Kareah' tapa Johanan leh a hong tonpih galkapmangte a muh uh ciangin a nuam uh hi.
Ahih hangin Nethaniah' tapa Ishmael leh mihing giat Johanan' khutsung panin suakta uh a, Ammon gamah a tai uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kareah' tapa Johanan leh a paipih galkapmangte khempeuh in, Nethaniah' tapa Ishmael in Mizpah khua-ah Ahikam' tapa Gedaliah a thah khit ciangin manin a paikhiatpih galkapte, nupite, naupangte, leh kumpi innsungmangte-a kipan a omlai mi khempeuh Gibeon khua panin a ciahpih kik uh hi.
Tua ciangin galkapmangte khempeuh, Kareah' tapa Johanan, Hoshaiah' tapa Azariah, leh a neupen pana kipan a lianpen dongin mi khempeuh hong paikhawmin
kei kiangah, "Kong thumna uh hong ngai in la, a hong kinusia ko teng-a' dingin { Topa } na Pasian kiangah thu hong ngetsak in. Bang hang hiam cih leh khatvei lai-in mi tampi ka hih uh hangin tu-in nong muh bangin mi tawmno khat bek ka hita uh hi.
{ Topa } na Pasian in ka lam paina ding uh ahi a, ka na sepna ding uh ahi zongin a hong lahna dingin thu hong ngetsak in," hong ci uh hi.
Kei zong amaute kiangah, "Nong genna uh ka thei khinzo hi. En un, nong ngetna bangun { Topa } na Pasian uh kiangah thu ka ngen ding a, { Topa' } hong dawn'kikna bangbang ka hong gen ding hi. Bangmah kong im kei ding hi," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in kei kiangah, "{ Topa } na Pasian in kote-a' dingin nang tungah a hong gen bangbang ka zuih kei tak mah uh leh { Topa } in mantakin thei ta hen.
Nang kong sawlna uh { Topa } i Pasian' hong gen bangbang hoih ta leh sia ta leh ka mang ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } i Pasian' thu mang leeng, ei-a' dingin na hong hoih ding hi," a hong ci uh hi.
Tua zawh ni sawm khit ciangin { Topa } in kei a hong hopih hi.
Tua ciangin keimah in Kareah' tapa Johanan, amah tawh a omkhawm galkapmangte khempeuh, leh a neupen-a kipan a lianpen dongin mi khempeuh ka sam a,
"Na deihna uh kong thumsakna dingin nong sawlna uh { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in a hong genin-ah:
Hih gamah note na omsuak uh leh note kong lam ding a, kong phel kei ding hi. Kong phut ding a, kong botkhia kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note' tungah siatna kong tun'sak manin ka dah hi.
Na kihtak uh Babylon kumpipa kihta nawn kei un. { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, lau nawn kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh ama khutsung pan a hong honkhia ding leh a hong lakhia dingin keimah in note kong ompih hi.
Amah in note hong hehpihin na gam mah uhah na ten'suak theihna dingun keimah in note kong hehpih ding hi.
"Ahih hangin note in { Topa } na Pasian uh' thu mangloin, 'Hih gam sungah ka teng nawn kei ding uh hi.
Gal omlohna, peengkul kitum lohna, anduh gilkial lohna Egypt gamah pai-in tua lai-ah ka teng ding uh hi,' na cih uh leh
Judah gamah a omlai mite aw, { Topa' } kammal ngai un. Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in kong cihin-ah: Egypt gamah a teng dingin na pai teitei uh a, na ten' teitei uh leh
Egypt gamah pai-in a teng khempeuh namsau tawh ahi a, kialpi tawh ahi a, pulnatna tawh ahi zongin a si ding uh hi. Amaute' tungah ka tun'sak ding gimna panin kuamah a suakta kei ding uh hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in kong cihin-ah: Jerusalem khua-ah a teng mite' tungah ka hehna leh ka thangpaihna a kibuak bangmahin Egypt gamah na pai uh leh note tungah ka hehna hong kibua ding hi. Mite in note hong lipkhap ding a, kihamsiatna-in hong zangin hong zahko ding uh hi. Note in hih mun na mukik nawn kei ding uh hi, ci-in gen hi," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin Judah gamah a omlai sunte kiangah, "{ Topa } in note kiangah, Egypt gamah pai kei un, hong ci hi. Tuni-in note kong hilhkholhnate teltakin thei un.
Na sihna dingun lam na pial khin uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } na Pasian uh kiangah kei nong paisak uh a, 'Ko-a' dingin { Topa } i Pasian' kiangah thu hong ngetsak in. { Topa } i Pasian in a hong gen peuhpeuh ko kiangah hong gen in. Ko zong ka mang ding uh hi,' na hong ci uh hi.
{ Topa } na Pasian un note' kiangah gen dingin a hong sawl tu-in kong gen khinzo hi. Ahih hangin note in khat beek na mang kei uh hi.
Tua ahih manin na ten'nopna mun uhah namsau tawh thahna, kial leh pulnatna tawh sihna na thuak ding uh hi, ci-in tu-in teltakpi-in thei ta un," ka cithuah lai hi.
{ Topa } Pasian in mi khempeuh kiangah a hong sawl hih thuteng ka gen khit ciangin
Hoshaiah' tapa Azariah leh Kareah' tapa Johanan-a kipan migilo dangte khempeuh in kei kiangah, "Nang in zuau na phuak hi. { Topa } i Pasian in, 'Egypt gamah a teng dingin pai kei un,' ci-in a gen dingin nang hong sawllo hi.
Neriah' tapa Baruk in Babylon mite' khutsungah kote hong pia nuamin, hong kithahna ding ahih kei leh Babylon-ah saltang dingin hong kilak theihna ding deih ahih manin ko a hong langpang dingin nang a hong zang ahi zaw hi," a hong ci uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Kareah' tapa Johanan leh galkapmangte khempeuh-a kipan mi khempeuh in Judah gamah omsuakna ding { Topa' } thugenna a mang kei uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kareah' tapa Johanan leh galkapmangte khempeuh in, a kihawlkhiatna uh gam khempeuh panin a hong ciahkik mite leh Judah gamah a omlaisun teng Egypt gamah a paipih uh hi.
Papi, nupi, naupang, kumpipa' tanute-a kipan kumpi cing galkapmang Nebuzaradan in Ahikam' tapa, Shafan' tupa ahi Gedaliah' kep dingin a nusiat mi khempeuh a paipih uh hi. Neriah' tapa Baruk leh kei zong a hong kipaipih hi.
Amaute in { Topa' } thu manglo uh a, Egypt gamah pai-in Tahpanhes khua dong kitung hi.
Tua ciangin Tahpanhes khua-ah { Topa } in kei hong hopih a,
"Suangtum gol pawlkhat la in la, Tahpanhes khua Faro kumpi inn lutna suangphah nuai-ah phum in. Na phumlam Judah mi khempeuh musak in.
Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, 'Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in hong genin-ah: En un, keimah in ka nasempa ahi Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar ka la ding a, hih ka suang phumte tungah ama kumpi tokhom hong phut ding a, tuate tungah a kumpi puanbuk a lam ding hi.
Amah hong pai-in Egypt gam hong simgawp ding a, pulnatna tawh a si ding mite pulnatna tawh si-in, sala mat dingte salin kimanin, namsau-a si ding mite namsau tawh kithat ding uh hi.
Egypt pasian-te a kibiakna biakinnte hal ding a, a pasian-te uh halin a puakhia ding hi. Tuucingte in a puan tung uha om khahte paai-in a sian'sak uh bangin amah in Egypt gam siangsak ding a, tua khit ciangin ngaihmuang takin a ciahkik ding hi.
Egypt gam Migdol khua, Tahpanhes khua, Memfis khua, leh leitaw lama teng Jew mite tawh kisai-in { Topa } in thu hong gen a,
"Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in kong genin-ah: Note in Jerusalem khua leh Judah gam khuapi khempeuh tungah ka tun'sak gimna na muzo uh hi. En un, tuni-in tua khuate a siasa mahin omlai a, kuamah tenglo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute in ka hehna dingin gitlohna bawl uh a, amaute-a kipan note leh na pu na pate un a theih ngeiloh uh pasian-te' na semin paknamtui halin a bia uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in ka thu hong ngailoin a bil uh hong ngatlo uh a, a gitlohna uh panin kihei loin, pasian dangte kiangah paknamtui hal veve uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Judah gam khuapite sung leh Jerusalem khua kongzing lakah ka hehna leh ka thangpaihna ka bua a, ka kuangsak hi. Tuni-a na muh uh bangin tuate kisia-in gamlak suak khinta hi.
"Tu-in Vanglian { Topa } Pasian, Israel mite' Pasian in kong genin-ah: Bang hangin note in hih bangin note' siatna dingin mawhna lianpi bawl na hi uh hiam? Judah gamsungah papi, nupi, naupang, leh naungek-a kipan a nungtalai kuamah om nawn kei hen, cih na deihna uh ahi hiam?
Note si-in, leitunga minam dang khempeuhte in hamsiatna-in a hong zat ding uh leh hong simmawhna dingun bang hangin na khut uh tawh milim bawlin, na ten'na dingun na zuat uh Egypt gamah pasian dangte' kiangah paknamtui halin kei hong hehsak na hi uh hiam?
Judah gam leh Jerusalem khua kongzing lakah na pute na pate uh' gitlohna, Judah kumpite' gitlohna, a zite uh' gitlohna, note mahmah' gitlohna, leh na zite uh' gitlohnate mangngilh khin na hi uh hiam?
Tuni ciangdong note na kiniamkhiat kei uh a, kei hong zahtak loin, note leh na pute na pate uh tungah kong piak ka thukhamte leh ka ngeinate na zui kei uh hi.
"Tua ahih manin Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in kong genin-ah: En un, note a susia dingin na langkhat uhah kei ka ding a, Judah gam khempeuh ka susia ding hi.
Egypt gamah a teng dingin a lungsim a khensat khin Judah mi a omlaite, a vekpi-un ka sisak khin ding hi. Egypt gamah namsau tawh kithat sakin kial tawh ka puksisak ding hi. A neupen-a kipan a golpen dongin namsau leh kialpi tawh a si ding uh a, mite' lipkhap, mite in kihamsiatna-in a zat leh mite' simmawh ka suaksak ding hi.
Jerusalem khua ka siatsak bangin Egypt gama teng mite namsau tawh, kialpi tawh, pulnatna tawh sihna ka thuaksak ding a,
Egypt gamah pai-in a teng Judah mi a omlaite in a zuatkik nop uh ahi Judah gamah ciahkik thei nawnloin, khat beek suakta loin, zong a nungta suak kei ding uh hi. Galtai pawlkhat longal khat beek a suakta kei ding uh hi," a hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin a zite un pasian dangte kiangah paknamtui a hallam a thei papi khempeuh leh tua lai-ah a ding nupi khempeuh-a kipan Egypt gam leitaw lamah a teng mi khempeuh, a vekpi-in mi tampi tak in kei kiangah,
"{ Topa' } mina nong gen thute kong mang kei ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin ka ciamsa uh bangin kote, ka pute ka pate, ka kumpite uh leh kumpi uliante in Judah gam khuapite leh Jerusalem khua kongzing lakah ka hih ngei uh bangin vantung kumpinu kiangah paknamtui halin tuidawn biakna ka hihzaw ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh ka tuacih uh ciangin an tampi ka nei uh a, hau-in gimna zong ka thuak kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin vantung kumpinu kiangah paknamtui halna leh tuidawn biakna ka hih nawnloh uha kipan bangmah ka nei nawn kei uh a, namsau leh kial in hong thatlum zawsop hi," a hong ci uh hi.
Nupite in zong, "Vantung kumpinu' lim a sun dingin moh bawlin paknamtui halna leh tuidawn biakna ka bawl uh ciangin ka pasalte uh' thukim lohpi-in a bawl ka hi zenzen uh hiam?" a hong ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin tua bangin a hong dawngkik papi, nupi-a kipan mi khempeuhte kiangah,
"Judah gam khuapite leh Jerusalem khua kongzing lakah note, na pute na pate uh, na kumpite uh, leh na kumpi uliante uha kipan gamsung mi khempeuh in paknamtui halna na bawl uh ciangin { Topa } in tua pen a phawklo sa na hi uh hiam? A ngaihsunlo sa na hi uh hiam?
{ Topa } in na hoihlohnate uh leh na bawl uh kihhuainate hangin note hong thuakzo nawnlo hi. Tua ahih manin tuni mahmahin zong na gam uh gamlak suakkhin a, mite' kihamsiatna suakin kuamah teng nawnlo hi.
Note in paknamtui halin, { Topa' } tungah mawh thamloin, { Topa' } thu mangloin ama thukhamte, a ngeinate, leh a hong thupiakte zuilo na hih manun tuni mahmahin zong hih gimna note tungah hong tung ahi hi," ka ci hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuhte kiang leh a diakdiakin nupi khempeuhte kiangah, "{ Topa' } kammal ngai dih un. Egypt gamah a om no Judah mite khempeuh aw,
Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in hong genin-ah: Note leh na zite un na khut bek uh tawh na sep uh hiloin na kam mahmah uh tawh, 'Vantung kumpinu' tungah paknamtui hal ding leh tuidawn biakna piak dingin ka kiciamnasa uh bangin ka sem taktak ding uh hi,' ci-in na gen khinzo uh hi. Tua ahih leh na kiciamna uh kipsak ta un la, na kiciamna uh bangin sem dih un!
Ahih hangin Egypt gamah a om no Judah mite aw, { Topa' } thugenna hong ngai un. En un, { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, Egypt gamah a om Judah mi khat beek in, '{ Topa } a nuntak bangin,' ci-in ka min zangin a kiciam nawnlohna dingun ka min lianpi tawh ka kiciam khinzo hi.
En un, amaute tungah hoihna tungloin siatna a tun'na dingin keimah in ka bawl ding hi. Egypt gamah a om Judah mi khempeuh namsau leh kialpi tawh si ding uh a, khat beek a suakta kei ding uh hi.
Namsau tawh thahna a thuak khalo mi tawmkhate, Egypt gam panin Judah gamah hong ciahkik ding uh a, Egypt gamah a teng dingin a pai a nungtalai sunte in kei' kammal leh amau' kammal koizaw a manin tung, cih a thei ding uh hi.
Note' siatna ding ka gensa thute a hong tung takpi ding ahihna thu na theihna dingun { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, note tungah hih lim kong pia ding a, hih munah note kong thuaksak ding hi:
{ Topa } in kong genin-ah: 'En un, Judah kumpi Zedekiah, a galpa ahi amah a that nuam Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar' khutsungah ka piak mah bangin Egypt kumpipa Faro Hofra, a galte' khutsung, amah a thatnuam mite' khutsungah ka pia ding hi,' hong ci hi," ka cithuah lai hi.
Josiah' tapa Jehoiakim, Judah gamah kumpi a suahzawh kum li a cin' ciangin Neriah' tapa Baruk in laibu khat sungah keima gen bangbang a gelh hi. Tua ahih ciangin Baruk kiangah,
"Baruk aw, { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in nang hong hopih hi.
Nangmah in, 'Gimna thuak ing! Bang hang hiam cih leh { Topa } in ka dahna leh ka natna hong behlap hi. Ka tautauna-in ka gim khinzo a, ka tawlnga thei kei hi,' na ci hi.
"{ Topa } in nang tungah hih bang a gen dingin hong sawl hi: En in, keimah in ka lamsate ka phelkik a, ka phuhsate ka botkhia kik hi. Keimah in leitung buppi tua bangin ka hih ding hi.
Tua sung panin nang a pengthei tuam dingin kingaihsun na hi hiam? Tua bangin kingaihsun kei in; bang hang hiam cih leh en in, { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, mi khempeuh tungah gimna ka tungsak ding hi. Ahih hangin nang pen na paina mun khempeuhah kong suaktasak liailiai ding hi, ci hi," ka ci hi.
Gamdangte' thu tawh kisai-in { Topa } in kei kiangah thu hong gen hi.
"Na lumte uh la un la galsim dingin kuankhia un!
Sakol vante vawh un la, tuang ta un, sakol galkapte aw. Na sik lukhute uh khu un la, na teipite uh tat hiamin, na sik puante uh silh un.
"A bangci mawk ahi hiam? Amaute lungmangin a nungkik ta uh hi. A galkapte uh kilehhawl a, lau-in taikekmang mawk uh hi. Kinungleh hei kiklo uh hi; mun khempeuhah launa vive!
A manlang pente zong paikhia thei tuanlo uh a, galkapte zong suaktalo uh hi. Leilu lam Eufratis gun gei-ah hoi-in a tuk uh hi.
Nail gunpi bangin Egypt gam hong khang a, guntui khang hong bang hi. Amah in, kei ka khang ding a, leitung khempeuh ka tuam ding hi. Khuapite leh a sunga teng mite ka susia ding hi, a ci hi.
Sakolte aw, mai nawt un; sakol leengte aw, hat un! Lum a tawi Ethiopia mite leh Put mite aw, thal tawi a siam Lud mite aw, na galkapte uh kuansak un.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh tuni pen Vanglian Topa { Pasian }' ni hi a, phu a lakkik ni, a galte a thuk ni ahi hi. Namsau in amaute that ding a, a kham mateng a si uh a dawn ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Vanglian Topa { Pasian } in Eufratis gun gei leilu lamah amaute biakna-in a nei hi.
Egypt nungakte aw, Gilead gamah pai un la, damna zatui va la un. Zatui tampi na zat khit uh hangin damna na ngah tuan kei uh hi.
Egypt gam a sim dingin Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar' hong paina tawh kisai-in { Topa } in hih bangin kei kiangah a hong gen hi:
"Egypt gam leh Migdol khua-ah va gen in. Memfis khua leh Tahpanhes khua-ah va taangko in: 'Kigingsa leh kithawisa-in om un; bang hang hiam cih leh namsau tawh note hong kithat khin ding hi,' va ci in.
Bang hangin na bawngtal pasian uh Apis guallelin taimang ahi hiam? { Topa } in amah a vattuk hang ahi hi.
Na mite uh tampi tak hoi-in tuk uh a, amaute in khatlekhat kiangah, 'Kithawi dih un; i mipihte kiang, i suahna gamah va ciahkik ni; tua hi leh hih namsau tawh sihna pan i suakta ding hi,' a kici uh hi.
"Egypt kumpipa Faro, min thak khat pia un la, 'Kam si bekin hun mawk beisakpa,' ci ta un.
Vanglian { Topa } keimah Kumpipa ka hi hi. Taber mual, mual khempeuh sangin sangzaw-in, Karmel mual, tuipi tungah sangpi-in a dawktoh bangin, no hong simpa' thahatna a lian mahmah ding hi.
Egypt gamah a tengte aw, note salin a hong kipaipih cianga ding na puanlomte uh zialkhol un. Bang hang hiam cih leh Memfis khua gamlak suak ding a, kisia gawpin, kuamah tenglo ding hi.
A galkap cialte nangawn amaute' lakah bawngno hatlote a bang lel uh hi. Pangloin, do tentanlo uh a, nungkikin a taikek uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amau' kisiat ding ni, amau' gimthuak ding ni, hong tungzo hi.
Gam pha lua-in a kiphut zawhloh hangin a galte un a singte uh a phukmaisak teitei ding uh hi, { Topa } in a ci hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute kauphe sangin tamzaw uh a, simzawhloh zahin a tam uh hi.
Egypt nungakte a maizum ding uh hi. Leilu lam panin a hong pai mite' khutsungah amaute a kipia ding uh hi," a hong ci hi.
Vanglian { Topa, } Israel mite' Pasian in, "En un: Keimah in Thebes khua-a Amon pasian leh Faro kumpipa-a kipan a pasian-te uh leh a kumpite uh, Egypt kumpipa leh amah a muang mi khempeuh tungah gimna ka tungsak ding hi.
Amaute a that nuam Babylon kumpipa Nebukhadnezzar leh a uliante' khutsungah amaute ka pia ding hi. Ahi zongin { Topa } in kong cihin-ah, nidang lai bangin Egypt gamah mi a tengkik ding hi.
Ahih hangin lau kei un, ka nasempa Jakob' suante aw. Patau kei un, Israel mite aw. Bang hang hiam cih leh gamlapi panin note kong honkhia ding a, na suanlekhakte uh saltan'na gam panin kong honkhia ding hi. Jakob' suante hong ciahkik ding uh a, nuamtakin a om ding uh hi. Kuamah in amaute a lausak nawn kei ding hi.
{ Topa } in kong cihin-ah, ka nasem Jakob' suante aw, lau kei un. Bang hang hiam cih leh note kong ompih hi. Tua banah ka heh semsemna dingin hih bangin gamta uh hi. A siathei tawpin hih bangin kei hong simmawh bawlna hong thei in.
Tua ahih manin amaute in ka heh mahmahna thuak ding uh a, amaute zahloin, zong ka khasiat kei ding hi. Amaute in a thaneih tawpun kei kiangah thu hong nget uh hangin amaute' thungetna ka ngai kei ding hi," a hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian hong kiko a, "Hih khuapi a susia ding no mihingte hong pai un la, na hiam zat ciat ding uh zong hong keng un," ci-in a sam hi.
Tua ciangin ama omnasa kherub-te' tung panin Israel-te' Pasian' minthan'na vang hong pai-in biakinn kongah hong om hi. Tua ciangin amah in saihadial puan a silh, lai gelhna ding a tawipa samin,
"Jerusalem khuasung khempeuhah pai kawikawi in la, hih khuapi sungah a muhdahhuai gamtatnate a kisepna hangin dahin a lungkham mi khempeuhte' taltangah ciamtehna va bawl in," ci-in a sawl hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian in a midangte kiangah, "Khuasung khempeuhah amah va zui un la, mi va that un. Kuamah hin'khawi kei un la, kuamah khasiat kei un.
Puteek, nungak, tangval, numei, naupang dong takin va thatlum un la, ahi zongin a taltangah ciamtehna a nei peuhmah su kei un. Hih ka biakinn mahmah panin kipan pah un," a cihna ka za hi. Tua ahih manin tua biakinn sungah a ding Israel makaite, kipatna-in a nei pah uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute kiangah, "Biakinn ninsak un. A tualtengah misi luanghawm dimsak un. Tu-in kipan un," ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute kuankhia-in khuasungah mi thah ding a kipan uh hi.
Tua bangin mi a kithah laitakin keimah guak ka om hi. Kei zong lei-ah bokin, "Topa { Pasian } aw, Jerusalem tungah na hehna hangin Israel mi a omlaisun khempeuh that mangkhin ding na hi hiam?" ci-in ka kiko hi.
Tua ciangin amah in hong dawng a, "Israel mite leh Judah mite' mawhna nak liat mahmah hi. Gamsung khempeuh mi thahna tawh kidimsak uh a, Jerusalem khuapi, siatna namkim tawh kidimsak uh hi. Amaute in, '{ Topa } in i gam susia khin a, { Topa } in eite hong mulo hi,' ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin saihadial puan silhin lai gelhna a tawi mipa in { Topa }' kiangah thu hong zasak kik a, "Nong sawl bangin ka sem khinzo hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian in saihadial puan a silhpa kiangah, "Na khut dimin mei-am tawi in la, kherub nuai-a om leengpeite kikalah va om in. Tua ciangin khuapi tungah a mei-amte theh in," ci-in a sawl hi. Kei zong ama pai ka en gige hi.
Kherub-te' tung panin { Topa' } minthan'na vang hong paikhia-in biakinn kongah va om hi. Tua ciangin biakinn sungah meiipi hong kai a, biakinn tualah { Topa' } minthan'na vang taang zeizai hi.
Kherub-te' khazap ging pen biakinn tual puanung ciangdongah kiza a, Vanglian Pasian a pau ciangin a awging tawh kibang hi.
Kherub-te' nuai-a om leengpeite' kikal panin mei a la dingin { Topa } in saihadial puan silhpa a sawl ciangin, tua mipa zong va pai-in leengpei khat gei-ah a va ding hi.
Tua ciangin kherub khat in a khut zanin amau' kikala om meikhuk sawkin mei-am pawlkhat la a, saihadial puan a silhpa' khutsungah a koih hi. Saihadial puan a silhpa zong tua mei-amte tawi-in a paikhia hi.
Tua kherub-te a pai ciangin kihei kulloin a utna lam peuhpeuh uhah pai thei uh hi. A paina ding lam a nga a pei paina-ah adangte in zui-in kihei tuanlo uh hi.
A leengpei kualte a pei kan'na khaute leh a pei buppi dimin mittang om hi.
Kherub-te a khawl ciangin leengpeite khawl a, kherub-te a leen' ciangin leengpeite in zong a zui uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tua leengpeite pen kherub-te' khutnuai-ah a om ahi uh hi.
Tua ciangin biakinn kong panin { Topa' } minthan'na vang paikhia-in kherub-te' tung sanah va om hi.
Tua bangin ka et laitakin kherub-te in zong a kha uh zalin leilak panin leengto uh a, leengpeite in zong a zui uh hi. Biakinn nisuahna lam kongpi-ah khawl uh a, amaute' tung sanah Israel Pasian' minthan'na vang zong a khawl hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian' kha in biakinn nisuahna lam kongpi-ah hong paipih hi. Tua kongpi gei-ah mihing sawmnih leh nga na om a, tuate lakah minam makai ahi nihte, Azzur' tapa Jaazaniah leh Benaiah' tapa Pelatiah-te zong na kihel uh hi.
Pasian in kei kiangah, "Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, hih mite pen khuapi sungah thu hoihlo a gen migilote ahi uh hi.
Amaute in, 'Inn lam ding hun nailo hi. Hih khuapi pen an huanna beel tawh kibang hi. Eite pen beel sunga kihuan sa tawh i kibang hi,' ci uh hi.
Ka sungah { Topa' } kha hong lutin mite tungah hih bangin thugen dingin hong sawl hi: "Israel mite aw, na thugente uh leh na ngaihsutnate khempeuh uh ka thei hi.
Hih khuasungah mi tampi tak that na hih manun kongzing khempeuhah si luanghawm kidim hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in note kiangah kong gen thu in: Hih khuapi, an huanna beel tawh kibang hi, na cih uh man hi. Beel sunga om sa pen na thahsa uh misi luanghawmte ahi hi. Ahi zongin note ahih leh khuapi sung panin kong lawnkhia ding hi.
Khuapi sung panin note hong lakhia-in gamdang mite' khutsungah kong pia ding hi. Note a si dingin thu kong khen khin hi.
Na gamsung uhah galin na si ding uh hi. Tua ciangin { Topa } ka hih lamtak mi khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi.
Note, beel sunga a om sa bang na hi kei uh hi. Hih khuapi in note hong hulo ding hi. Israel gamsung na omna peuhpeuh uhah gim kong pia ding hi.
Note' kiima om minam dangte' ngeinate zui-in na om laitakun kei pen { Topa } ka hihna thu, na palsat uh thukhamte keima thukham ahihna, leh na zuihloh uh thupiaknate keima thupiak ahihna na thei ding uh hi, ci-in gen in," a hong ci hi.
Tua bangin thu genin ka om laitakin Benaiah' tapa Pelatiah hong din'sih hi. Kei zong leilakah boksukin ka kiko a, "Topa { Pasian } aw, Israel gamsungah a omlai mi khempeuh thah khit sawm na hi hiam?" ka ci hi.
{ Topa } in kei tungah thu hong gen a,
"Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Jerusalem khuasunga teng mite in nang leh salin a om na mipihte' thu gen uh a, 'Salin a om mite pen { Topa } tawh kigamla om lua khinta uh hi. Amah in eima luah dingin hih gam hong pia khinta hi,' ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin na salpihte kiangah hih bangin keima thugente va gensawn in: A gamlapi gamah a teng dingin puakhia-in, gamdangah a thehthangpa pen keimah ka hi hi. Ahi zongin amaute' omna gamdangah tawlkhat sung bek kei a hong bia dingin ka omsak hi.
"Tua ahih manin { Topa } ahi keimah in amaute kiangah ka gen thu va gen in. Amaute ka thehthangna gam panin khawmkikin, amaute tungah Israel gam ka piakik ding hi.
Amaute hong ciahkik ciangin a nin nate khempeuh leh a muhdahhuai milimte khempeuh a nilkhia ding uh ahi hi.
Amaute tungah lungsim thak leh ngaihsutna thak ka pia ding hi. Amaute' suang lungtang paihkhiat sakin mihing lungtang ka guan' ding hi.
Ahi zongin a nin a muhdahhuai milim a bia nuamte ahih leh gim ka pia ding hi. Amau' gamtatna tawh a kizui-in gim ka pia ding hi, Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in hih thu ka hong gen hi," a hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin a leeng dingin kherub-te in a kha uh zal a, a leengpeite in zong a zui hi. Israel-te' Pasian' minthan'na vang amaute' tung sanah a om hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa' } minthan'na vang zong khuapi sung panin paikhia-in khuapi nisuahna lamah a om mualtungah a om hi.
Tua ciangin ka maang sung mahin Pasian' kha in hong leen'pihin Babylon gamah salin a omte kiang hong tun'pih hi. Tua ciangin ka maangmuhna hong beita a,
{ Topa } in kei hong muhsaksa thute khempeuh, salin a om mite kiangah ka gen hi.
Ezekiel aw, tu-in galtai dingte' gamtat bangin na van puak ding guang in la, suntangpi-in paikhia in. Na omna panin na paikhiatlam mi khempeuh musak in. A lehdo thei mi ahih tei hangun a thu theithei khading uh hi.
Khuavak lai-in mite' muhin salin a pai dingin na van guang in la, nitak ciangin salin a pai ding bangin na paikhiatna mite musak in.
Tua bangin amaute in hong et laitakin na kawm sulet in la, tua vang panin na van lakhia in.
Kei zong { Topa' } hong sawl bangin ka gamta hi. Galtaite' hih ding bang teekin tua sunin ka van guangin, tua nitak khuamial ciangin ka khut tawh kawm ka sulet hi. Amaute' muh mahin ka liangko-ah van kisuanin ka paikhia hi.
A zingsang ciangin { Topa } in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,
Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in amaute kiangah ka gen thu tu-in gen in. Tua thu pen Jerusalem khuasung a uk ulianpa leh Jerusalem khuasungah a teng mi khempeuhte-a' ding ahi hi.
Amaute a uk ulianpa in khuamial lakah a liangko-in ama van pua-in paikhia ding hi. Ama paikhiatna dingin amaute in kulh tawhvang sakin tua panin amah suakta ding hi. Amah in a mai humcip ding ahih manin a paina ding mun mu theilo ding hi.
Ama paina ding munah ka ngenthang ka zak ding a, amah awk ding hi. Tua ciangin Babylon khuapi-ah amah ka paipih ding a, a khuapi a mulopi-in tua lai-ah a si ding hi.
A ulianpihte, a thulamlakte, leh amah a cingte, mun citengah ka thehthang ding a, amaute a that dingin namsau ka nungdelhsak ding hi.
Minam dangte' lak gamdangah amaute ka thehthang ciangin { Topa } ka hihna thu amaute in hong phawk ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin galsung, kialpi, leh natna sung panin tawmkhat ka suaktasak ding a, minam dangte' lakah a omna mun panun a gamtatnasate uh a muhdahhuaina phawkin, kei pen { Topa } ka hihna thu hong thei ding uh hi," a hong ci hi.
Hih bangin na gamtatna pen, amaute' gama omlai ahi Jerusalem khuamite tungah Topa { Pasian' } thugenna ahihna thu va gen in. Amaute in launa lin'na tawh an ne-in tui dawn ding uh hi. Amau' gamsungah a tengte a hoih gamtat khat beek omlo ahih manin, a gamsung uhah a om mi khempeuh kipai khiatpihmang ding hi.
Mihing a dimna khuapite kisusia ding a, gamsung khempeuh gamkhing suak ding hi. Tua ciangin { Topa } ka hihna thu hong thei ding uh hi," a hong ci hi.
"Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, bang hangin, 'Hun beibei a, genkholhnate a tung omlo hi,' cih paunak pen Israel mite' lakah zat belin kinei ahi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in tua thu tawh kisai-in ka thugenna amaute kiangah va gen in. Hih paunak ka beisakta ding a, Israel mite in genin a nei nawn kei ding uh hi. Tu-in a hun a naina leh genkholhnate a manin a tun'na ding thu amaute kiangah va gen in.
Israel mite lakah maangmuhna manlo ahi a, genkholhna manlo ahi zongin om nawnlo ding hi.
{ Topa } ahi keimah in amaute tungah thu ka gen ding a, ka gen bangin tung takpi ding hi. Tu-in zekai nawnlo ding hi. A lehdo thei mihingte aw, hih dingin ka gen bangin nomau' nuntak sung mahmahin ka tungsak ding hi. Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in thu ka gen khinzo hi," a hong ci hi.
{ Topa } in kei tungah thu hong gen leuleu a,
"Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, na maangmuhnate leh na thugen kholhnate pen mailam hun saupi ciangin a hong piang pan dingin Israel mite in ngaihsunkha uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa { Pasian } ahi keima thugenna: 'Zekai cih om nawnlo ding a, ka gensa bangin tung ding hi. Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in ka gen khinzo hi, ci hi,' ci-in gen in," a hong ci hi.
"Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Israel kamsangte mawhsakna gen in. '{ Topa' } thugen ngai in,' ci khemin amau' lungsim bangin thu a gente' tungah gen in.
Topa { Pasian' } thugen hih bang ahi hi: Hih kamsang haite in gimna thuak ding uh hi. Amaute in amau' lungsim bangin thu gentawmin, maangmu kineih uh hi.
Israel mite aw, na kamsangte uh ahih leh innsia lakah a om ngiate tawh kibang uh hi.
Amaute in kulh a kicipna munte cinglo uh a, a kicimte ciangkiklo uh ahih manin { Topa' } ni-in gal hong tun' ciangin Israel-te hu zolo ding uh hi.
Amaute' maangmuhnate zuaupi hi a, a thugen kholhnate uh zong zuauthu ahi hi. Keimah in amaute sawllo napi-in amaute in, '{ Topa } in hih bangin ci hi,' ci khem uh hi. Tua bang hinapi-in amaute' thugente ka tun'sak ding a lamen lai uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute kiangah ka gen thu in: 'Na maangmuhnate uh zuaupi hi a, na thugen kholhnate uh zuauthu ahi hi. Note kiangah keimah in thu hong genlo napi-in keima gen bangin na gen uh hi,' ka ci hi," a hong ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa { Pasian } in amaute kiangah, "Na thugente uh zuaupi hi a, na maangmuhnate uh zuaupi ahi hi. Tua ahih manin note kong langpan' hi.
Zuauthu tawh maangmu kineihin, mite a khialh theihna dingin zuauthu a genkhol no kamsangte gim a hong pia ding ka hita hi. Ka mite a kikhop uh ciangin tuate lakah na kihel kei ding uh a, Israel mite' min a kigelhna lakah note' min kigelhlo ding hi. Na gam uhah na ciahkik ngei nawn kei ding uh hi. Tua ciangin Topa { Pasian } ka hihna thu na hong thei ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh thu hoihlo napi-in hoih hi, ci khemin ka mite lam na kaikhial uh hi. Ka mite in kulh dingin suang a cian uh ciangin no kamsangte in a tungtham buan tawh na zut uh hi.
"Tua ahih manin Topa { Pasian } ahi keima thugen in: Ka hehna tawh huihpi nungsakin, guahpi zusakin, gialpi kiasakin, tua kulhpi ka susia ding hi.
A tungtham na zut uh kulh sukhamin, thehthangin, a bul dawksak ding a sawm ka hi hi. Tua bangin ka suksiat ciangin note a hong denglum ding hi. Tua ciangin { Topa } ka hihna thu mi khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi.
Tua bangin kulh leh tua kulh a zut note in ka hehna na thuak ding uh hi. Tua ciangin keimah in, 'Tu-in kulh maimangta a, tua mah bangin kulh a zut mite —
thu hoihlo napi-in thu hoih hi, ci-in Jerusalem a lungmuan'na dingin thu a gen kamsangte zong bei khinta hi,' ka ci ding hi. Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in hih thu ka gen hi," a hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in, "Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, na mite' lakah a om, a thugen ding uh a phuaktawm numeite en in. Amaute' gamtatna hangin mawhsakna thu gen in la,
Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in amaute tungah ka gen thu hih bangin gen in: No numeite in gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Mi khempeuh in a khutah a bulh ding uh leh a lu tungah a khip ding uh aite na bawl uh a, tua nate in mite' lungsim uk hi. Note' phattuamna dingin sihna ding leh hin'na ding vangliatna thu, ka mihingte tungah na zang nuam uh hi.
Mangbuhham khut khat dim leh anlum them tawmkhat na ngah theihna dingun ka mite' mai-ah kei nong minsiasak uh hi. A si dingin a kilawm lopite na that nuam uh a, a hing dingin a kilawm lopite na hingsak nuam uh hi. Tua bangin ka mite tungah zuauthu genin, amaute in note' thugen hong um uh hi.
"Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in ka gen thu in: Sihna leh hin'na ukna-in na zat uh na aite uh ka deih kei hi. Note' khut panin tuate hong bawhkhiat sakin, ukcip dingin na hanciam uh mite ka khahkhia ding hi.
Na ai khipte uh zong hong hawkkhiat sakin note' khutsung panin ka mite ka suaktasak paisuak ding hi. Tua ciangin { Topa } ka hihna thu na hong thei ding uh hi.
Keima gen hilo napi-in na thuzuau genteng uh tawh mihoihte na lunggimsak uh a, migilote a sihtheihna dingun hong kiheilohna ding lamah na lehhanthot zawsop uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in na zuau maangmuhnate uh leh mi lam a khialsak thei na thugen kholhnate uh beita ding hi. Note' khutsung panin ka mite ka honkhia ta ding a, tua ciangin { Topa } ka hihna thu na hong thei ding uh hi," a hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,
"Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, hih mite in milim bia uh a, milim in mawhna sungah amaute tun'pih hi. Amaute' thu theihnopte a gen dingin hong um uh ahi uh hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in amaute tungah ka gen hih thute gen in: Milim bia-in mawhna sungah milimte kitun'sak a, tua khit ciangin kamsangte tungah thu a dong dingin a hong pai Israel mi peuhmah in keima thudawn'na kam ngah ding uh hi. Tua thudawn'na pen a milim tampite uh in a zak dingun a kilawm dawn'na hi ding hi.
Tua milimte in keima kiang panin Israel mite paikhiatpih uh a, ahi zongin tua bangin ka dawn'na tawh kei lamah ka mite ngahkik dingin ka kilamen hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Topa { Pasian } ahi keima thugen pen Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Hong kihei kik un la, na milimte uh nusia un.
Israel mite khat peuhpeuh ahi a, Israel mite lakah a om gamdang mi khat peuhpeuh ahi zongin, kei kiang panin paikhia-in milim bia a, milim in mawhna sungah a tun'pih khit ciangin kamsangpa tungah thu a dong dingin a pai leh, { Topa } ahi keimah in ama thudotna ka dawng ding hi.
Amah nialin, midangte' etteh dingin ka bawl ding hi. Keima mite lak panin amah ka lakhia ding hi. Tua ciangin { Topa } ka hihna thu na thei ding uh hi.
Kamsang khat peuhpeuh in khemna tawh a manloin thu hong dawn' leh, { Topa } ahi keima khem hi ding hi. Israel mite lak panin tua kamsangpa ka lakhia ding hi.
Kamsangpa leh kamsang thu a dongpa a gim thuakna uh kibang ding hi.
Israel mite in kei hong nusiatlohna ding leh a mawhna uh tawh a kinitsak lohna dingun hih bangin ka hih ding hi. Amaute pen keima mi hi ding uh a, kei pen amaute' Pasian ka hi ding hi. Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in hih thu ka gen hi," a hong ci hi.
Noah, Daniel, leh Job, hih mihing thumte nangawn, amaute' lakah a om hi leh, amaute' hoihna in amau' nuntakna ciat bek mah suahtakzo ding uh hi, Topa { Pasian } in ci hi.
Mite a that dingin gamsa kihtakhuaite khahkhia-in, kuamah khual a zin ngamlo dingin tua gamsung a lauhuai-in om leh,
tua gamsungah hih mihing thumte nangawn a om bang hi leh, amaute' tanute leh tapate nangawn uh suahtak zoloin, amaute' nuntakna ciat bek mah suahtakzo ding uh a, tua gam pen gamkhing suak takpi ding hi, ci-in a nungta Topa { Pasian } ka kiciam hi.
Tua gamsungah gal tungsakin, mihing ganhing a siaksiang dingin a husia galhiamte kizang leh,
tua sungah hih mihing thumte a om hangin amau' pumpi ciat simloh, amau' tate nangawn suahtakzo tuanlo ding hi, ci-in a nungta Topa { Pasian } ka kiciam hi.
tua sungah Noah, Daniel, leh Job-te a om ahi zongin, amaute' hoihna in amau' nuntakna ciat bek a hutzawh cihloh, amaute' tate nangawn huzo tuanlo ding hi, ci-in a nungta Topa { Pasian } ka kiciam hi.
"Topa { Pasian' } thugen hih bang ahi hi: Mihing ganhing a sumai dingin gimna nasia pen li ahi gal, kialpi, a kihtakhuai gamsate, leh natna, Jerusalem-ah ka tungsak ding hi.
Amaute' gitlohna zia na muh ciangin ka hihnate khempeuh a kilawm mah ahihna na phawk ding hi. Topa { Pasian } in thu hong gen khinta hi," a hong ci hi.
A kat ma-in zong bangmahin kimanglo ahih manin, kangin a vom khit ciangin a kiman'na omlo semsem hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Topa { Pasian } in hih bangin ci hi: Tulaka om singte in kiman'na nei hi. Ahi zongin leengguite kila-in a kihaltum mah bangin Jerusalem-a teng mite lakhia-in
gim ka pia ding hi. Mei panin khatvei a suahtak khit hangun tu-in mei in amaute kangtum ding hi. Amaute gim ka piak ciangin { Topa } ka hihna thu na hong thei ding hi.
Kei' tungah amaute hong citaklo uh ahih manin gamsung khempeuh gamkhing ka suaksak ding hi, Topa { Pasian } in ci hi," a hong ci hi.
{ Topa } in kei tungah thu hong genkik a,
Topa { Pasian } in Jerusalem tungah ka gen hih thute gen in: Jerusalem aw, nang pen Kanaan gam panin a piang na hi hi. Na pa pen Amor mite hi a, na nu pen Hit mite ahi hi.
Nang na suah lai-in kuamah in hong donlo hi. Na lai hong kitansaklo a, hong kisillo a, ci tawh zong hong kizutlo a, puan tawh zong hong kitunlo hi.
Hihte khempeuh a hong hih dingin kuamah in nang hehpihna lungsim hong neilo hi. Na suah lai-in kuamah in nang hong itlo ahih manin gamlakah nang hong kipaidak lel hi.
"Tua ciangin na kiangah kong paikha a, sisan naisan lakah na kitomtom kong mu hi. Tua bangin na om laitakin na sihlohna dingin thu kong pia hi.
"Nang kong muhkhak kik ciangin pasal nei thei ding hun na hita hi. Na pum guakin a om kimlai, ka puan tawh kong khuh a, na zumhuainateng hong seelsakin, ten'pih dingin kam kong ciam hi. Kong kamciamna tangtung sakin nang pen keima-a' nong suak hi, Topa { Pasian } in ci hi.
Nakbahte, bilbahte, leh na khuk ding kumpi lukhu hoih kong guan hi.
Tua bangin kham leh ngun kibawl kizepnate tawh na kizem a, saihadial puan, nai puan, leh a kiphan a kizem puante bek na silh tawntung hi. Annel hoihpen pawl a kibawl anlum ne-in, nek ding khuaizu leh oliv thaute na kitasam ngei kei hi. Na hoihna a kigen theilo zahin hong om a, kumpinu na suak hi.

na lawm luite khempeuh — na it hita leh na muhdahte hita leh a vekpi-in ka kaikhawm ding hi. Na kimkotah amaute omsakin, tua ciangin na puanteng kong hawkkhiatsak ding a, na guaktangin na omna ka ensak ding hi.

{ Topa } in, "Jerusalem aw, 'Tanu in a nu sun,' cih paunak pen mite in nang tungah hong zang ding uh hi.

"Kei pen a nungta Topa { Pasian } ka hih takpi mah bangin kong cihin-ah: Nang leh na khuaneute' gamtatsiat zahin na sanggamnu Sodom leh a khuaneute gamtatsia ngei nailo hi.

Amaute kihisakin ka deihloh nate gamta uh ahih manin, na theih mah bangin amaute ka nusia hi.

Topa { Pasian } in, "Israel mite khempeuh aw, na milimte uh biabia un! Ahih hangin tu-a kipanin keima thu nong man' uh kul ding a, na milimte uh letsong piakna tawh ka min siangtho na daisak nawn kei ding uh hi," a hong ci hi.

Tu-in hih khuapi kia ta a, tuikulh khempeuh lau-in ling uh hi. Tua bang siatna hangin tuikulhah a teng mite, lau-in lamdang a sa uh hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in hih bangin ka ci hi. Kuamah a ten'lohna a kisia khuapi bangin a gamkhing khuapi-in kong bawl ding hi. Tuipi tuite kong tumsak ding hi.

Tuipi gei-ah omin tuipi dunga mite tawh sumlei sumzuakna a nei khuapi tungah Topa { Pasian } keimah in ka gen thute hih bangin gen in: "Taia khuapi aw, na melhoihna na kisaktheihpih hi.

Edom mite in zong na van tampi hong lei uh hi. Van leina-in emerald suangmanpha, puansan, a kizem puante, saihadial puan hoihte, suangkhi, leh ruby suangmanphate hong pia uh hi.

"Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Egypt kumpipa Faro leh ama mite' kiangah hih bangin gen in: "Na lian mahmah uh a, kong tehpihtheih ding kuamah omlo hi.
A khangsak ding tui om a, leisung panin an a pia ding tui om hi. Tua sing a pona mun tui kawt a, gamsung sing khempeuh in zong tui a ngah uh hi.
Vasa nam khempeuh in a hiang tungah bu tom uh a, ganhing nam khempeuh in a limnuai, tasuahna-in a nei uh hi. Leitung minam khempeuh in zong a limnuai belhin a nei uh hi.
Pasian' huanah a om taamtak hoihte tawh tehtheih ding hilo a, taksing kung in tua bang hiang hoih nei ngeilo a, hiangpa kung in zong tua bang bang hiang hoih nei ngeilo hi. Pasian' huana singkungte zong tua zahin hoih ngeilo hi.
A melhoihin ka bawl a, a hiang ka zausak hi. Pasian' huan sunga a po singkung khempeuhte' en'in ka bawl hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Topa { Pasian } keimah in hih bangin ka ci hi. Tua sing in meiipi a bat dongin khangto a, ahi zongin a san' semsemna tawh kizui-in kiphasak semsem hi.
Tua ahih manin tua singkung ka deih nawn kei hi. Gamdang kumpi khat' khutsungah ka pia ding a, ama thuak dingin a kilawm bangin tua kumpipa in a bawl ding hi.
Thukhualna a neilo gamdang mite in tua singkung phukin a nusiacip ding uh hi. Mual khempeuh leh guam khempeuhah a hiang kitante a kia ding uh hi. A lim a bel minam khempeuh in taisanta ding uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-a kipanin singkung khat beek, bangzahin tui a ngah hangin tua zahin khangin, a dawn in meiipi banin sangzo ngei nawnlo ding hi. Misite' omna Leinuai khua a zuan ding, a si thei mihingte mah bangin singkung khempeuh a si ding ahi ta hi.
"Topa { Pasian } in ka cihin-ah: Tua singkung in misite' khua Leinuai a zuat ciangin, leinuai-a tuite tuumsakin ka thuumsak ding hi. Guntuite leh luituite ka luangsak nawn kei ding a, Lebanon Mual maikhingin, gamlak sing khempeuh a keutum ding hi.
Misite' omna Leinuai khua-ah tua singkung ka khiatsuk ciangin, a kiatna ging in minam khempeuh lokgawp ding hi. Tua singkung a kiat manin Eden singkung khempeuh, leh a hoihpen, limtakin tui a ngah Lebanon singkungte khempeuh in zong Leinuai-ah nuamtuam na sa ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh a sisate a zuan dingin misite' omna Leinuai-ah amah tawh a paikhawm ding uh hi. Ama limnuai a belte khempeuh, minam dangte' lakah kithehthang khin uh hi.
"Tua singkung pen Egypt kumpipa Faro leh ama mite ahi hi. Eden huana singkungte nangawn tua zahin lianin hoih zolo hi. Ahi zongin, Eden huana singkungte mah bangin, Pasian' thu a ngaihsunlo, gasunga a site' omna a zuan dingin, misite' omna Leinuai a manawh ta ahi hi. Topa { Pasian } in hih thu ka gen khin hi," hong ci hi.
Zedekiah in a uk a kum sawmlenih kum, a kha sawmlenih a ni masa ni-in { Topa } in kei kiangah thu hong gen a,
"Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Egypt kumpipa Faro tamlawh in la, hih bangin ci in: "Minam dangte lakah, humpinelkai bangin na kingaihsun hi. Ahi zongin nang pen gunsung tokgawpin a ninsak, awle tawh na kibangzaw hi.
Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in kong cihin-ah: Minam tampi hong kuansakin, ka ngen kong khuhsak ding a, tui gei-ah kong kaisak ding hi.
Leilakah nang hong kaikhia-in, leilak kong den'na ding a, vasate leh ganhingte, a kham takun kong nesak ding hi.
Vantung khuavak khempeuh ka mialsak ding a, na gam khempeuh khim zing ding hi, ci-in Topa { Pasian } in ka gen khin hi.
"Na theih ngeiloh gamdangte-ah salin kong omsak ciangin minam tampite lunggim ding hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa { Pasian } in hih bangin ka ci hi: Babylon kumpipa' namsau na thuak ding hi.
A tui nekna mun a omna khempeuh uhah, na gan khawite ka that khin ding hi. Tui a siknin ding mihing ganhing khat zong om nawnlo ding hi.
Bangmah in su nawnlo ding ahih manin, tuite cim sitset ding a, gunte zong dum dide ding hi, ci-in Topa { Pasian } in ka gen khin hi.
Egypt gam gamkhing suaksakin, a gamsunga omteng ka suksiat ciangin { Topa } ka hihna thu hong thei ding uh hi.
"Hih pen kah la-in a kisa ding tamlawhna hi a, Egypt leh a mite tamlawhna-in minam dang numeite in nei ding uh hi. Topa { Pasian } in hih thu ka gen khin hi," hong ci hi.
Zedekiah in a uk a kum sawmlenih kum, a kha masa a ni sawmlenga ni-in { Topa } in kei tungah thu hong gen a,
"Midang khempeuh sangin melhoihzaw hilo na hi uh hiam? Ahi zongin pai un la, Pasian a theilo mite' han sungah va lum un, ci-in gen in.
"Galsunga a kithatte tawh si khawm ding uh hi. Egypt gamsunga om mi khempeuh a vatlum dingin namsau khat a baihsa-in om hi.
Egypt mite a pan'pih galhang pente in misite' gam Leinuai panin amaute na dawn ding uh a, 'Pasian a theilo, galsunga si mite hong paisuk uh a, hih lai-ah lumta uh hi,' ci-in kiko ding uh hi.
"Assiria zong, a kimkotah a galkapte' han tawh, tua lai mahah om hi. Amaute khempeuh zong galsungah a si uh hi a,
Leinuai a thukpenna munah amaute' han om hi. A galkap khempeuh galsungah a si hi a, a hante uh ama kimkotah om hi. Ahi zongin amaute pen nidangin minam dangte a linglawngsak zo ngeite ahi uh hi.
"Elam zong, a kimkotah a galkap-te' han tawh, tua lai mahah om hi. Amaute khempeuh galsungah a si uh hi a, misite' gam Leinuai-ah Pasian a theiloin paisuk uh hi. A hin' lai-un mi khempeuh a lausak ngeite hi uh a, ahi zongin tu-in amaute si-in mindai-in a om uh hi.
Galsunga a site lak mahah Elam lum a, ama kimkotah a galkapte' han om hi. Amaute, Pasian a theiloin, galsungah si uh hi. A hin' lai-un mite a lausak ngeite hi uh a, ahi zongin tu-in amaute si-in mindai-in om uh a, galsunga site mah tawh a kibangin gimna a thuak uh hi.
"Meshek leh Tubal zong tua lai mahah om uh a, a kimkot uhah a galkapte uh' han om hi. Amaute khempeuh zong Pasian a theilo, galsunga a si ahi uh hi. Ahi zongin a hin' lai-un midangte a lausakzo ngeite ahi uh hi.
Hih mite pen misite' omna Leinuai-ah a galvanteng uh tawh pai-in, a namsau uh kilukham sakin, a lum uh a awm tung uhah a kikoihsak kawmin limtakin a kivui tanglai galkapte bangin pahtawi-a vuina ngahlo uh hi. Ahi zongin hih mite pen midang a lausakzo dingin a vanglian ngeite ahi uh hi.
Tua mah bangin nang Faro zong Pasian a theilo, galsunga site lakah na om ding hi.
"Edom zong a kumpite leh a gam ukte tawh tua lai mahah om hi. Amaute pen a thahat galkapte hi a, ahi zongin tu-in Pasian a theiloin galsunga a site lak, misite' gam Leinuai-ah a lum uh hi.
"Leilu lam uliante leh Sidon mite zong tua lai mahah om uh hi. Amaute' vangliatna in midangte lausak ngei a, ahi zongin tu-in galsunga si mite tawh mindai-in paisuk uh a, Pasian a theiloin kivui uh hi. Misite' gam Leinuai-a a paisukte tawh a mindaina uh kibang hi.
"Egypt kumpipa Faro in hih mite khempeuh a muh ciangin ama sihna leh a galkapte galsungah a sihna thu tawh kisai-in a lung nuamtuam ding hi, Topa { Pasian } in ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Faro in midangte lausak gawp ahih manin amah leh a galkapte khempeuh kithatin, Pasian a theiloin galsunga a si mite tawh kivui khawm ding hi. Topa { Pasian } keimah in hih thu ka gen khin hi," hong ci hi.
"Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, gam khatpeuhah gal ka tun'sak ciangin a thupiangteng na mipihte tungah gen in. Tua galtun'na ding gammite in amaute lak panin galvil dingin mi khat seh uh hi.
Galvilpa in galte hong pai a muh ciangin mi khempeuh a theihsakna dingin pataukohna peengkul tum hi.
Mi khatpeuh in tua pataukohna za napi-in donloin a ommawk a, a galte hong pai-in tua mipa a thah leh, ama sihna pen amahmah ngawh ding ahi hi.
Amah in pataukohna za napi-in donlo ahih manin, ama sihna pen ama khialhna hang ahi hi. Thudon hi leh amah a suakta ding ahi hi.
Ahi zongin galvilpa in galte hong pai mu napi-in pataukohna peengkul a tum kei a, galte hong pai-in mi a thah leh, tua a site amau' mawhna hangin a si hita se leh galvilpa ka ngawh ding hi.
"Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, tu-in Israel minam khempeuhte' galvilpa dingin nang kong koih hi. Nang tungah kong piak hilhkholhna khempeuh amaute tungah na gensawn ding hi.
Migilopa khat pen si ding hi, ci-in kong gen ciangin amah a nuntak theihna dingin na hilh kei leh, tua mipa pen a mawhnei-in si ding a, ahi zongin ama sihna nang kong ngawh ding hi.
Nangmah in migilopa khat hilhkhol napi-in a mawh gamtatna a khawl kei leh, tua mipa a mawhnei mahin si ding a, ahi zongin nang na suakta ding hi," hong ci hi.
{ Topa } in kei kiangah thu hong gen a, "Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Israel mite tungah hih bangin gen in: Amaute in, 'Ka mawhna uh leh ka khialhnate un hong hencipin ka tha uh beita ahih manin, bangci nuntak zawh ding ka hi uh hiam?' ci uh hi.
Amaute kiangah hih bangin gen in: Kei pen a nungta Topa { Pasian } ka hih mah bangin mawhnei mi khat a si ka muh ciangin nuam ka sa het kei hi. A mawh gamtatna khawlin a nuntak ding ka deih hizaw hi. Israel mite aw, na mawh gamtatnate uh khawl un. Bang hangin si nuam se na hi uh hiam?
"Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, tu-in Israel mite kiangah hih bangin gen in: Midik khat in mawhna a bawl leh, a beisa-a ama hoihna in amah suaktasak theilo hi. Migilo khat a gitlohna khawl leh gim kipialo ding a, midik khat in mawhna bawl leh nungtasuak tuanlo ding hi.
gentehna-in, leitawi lapa in ama tungah a ap khapna vante pia kikin, a guksa nate pia kikin, a mawh bawlnate khawlin, nuntakna a pia thei thukhamte a zuih leh, amah nungta taktak ding a, si hetlo ding hi.
"Ahi zongin na mipihte in, '{ Topa' } hihna zia thutanglo hi,' ci-in ngaihsun uh hi. Tua bang hilozaw a, amau' ngaihsutna zia a manlohna hang hizaw hi.
Salin ka omzawh uh a kum sawmlenih kum, a kha sawmna a ni masa ni-in Jerusalem panin a hong suakta mi khat kei kiangah hong pai-in, "Jerusalem khuapi kila khinta hi," ci-in thu hong ko hi.
Tua ama hong tun' ni ding a zan nitakin { Topa' } vangliatna ka sungah hong omlam ka kiphawk a, tua mipa hong tun' ni zingsangin { Topa } in kei hong pau theisak kik hi.
"Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Israel gam khuapi siate sungah a teng mite in, 'Abraham, mi khat bek hinapi-in gambup kipia hi. Tu-in eite a tampi ihih ciangin hih gam pen eima-a' hi taktak hi,' ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa { Pasian } ahi keima thugen, hih bangin amaute kiangah gen in: Note in sasi, a sa tawh na nekhawm uh a, milim zong na bia uh hi. Mi zong na that lai uh hi. Tua ahih manin bangci-in hih gam pen kote-a' hi, ci thei na hi uh hiam?
Note in namsau suan'in na nei uh a, na gamtatnate uh kihhuai mahmah hi. Mi khempeuh in nulepa mawhna na gamta uh hi. Tua bangpi-in hih gam luah thei ding na hi uh hiam, ci-in gen in.
Amaute kiangah hih bangin gen in: Kei pen a nungta Topa { Pasian } ka hih mah bangin, khuapi siate sungah a teng mite galin si ding uh a, khuaneu-ah a teng mite khempeuh gamsate in ne ding uh hi. Dum muan'huai sung leh leihawm sungah a bute khempeuh zong pulnatna tawh si veve ding uh hi.
Gamsung khempeuh gamkhing ka suaksak ding a, amaute' kisaktheihpih vangliatna teng bei ding hi. Israel mualtungte gamkhing suak ding ahih manin kuamah in kantan ngamlo ding uh hi.
A mawhna hangun a mite gim pia-in, a gam uh gamkhing ka suahsak ciangin { Topa } ka hihna thu hong thei ding uh hi.
"Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, khuapi kulh gei-ah ahi a, a inn kong gei uhah ahi zongin na mipihte a kimuh uh ciangin nangma thu tawh kisai thu gen uh a, 'Pai un, { Topa } in bang thu gen hiam, va ngai ni,' ci-in khatlekhat kizawn uh hi.
Tua ciangin nangma thugen a za dingin ka mite hong kisutuah uh a, ahi zongin nangma gen bangin amaute gamtalo uh hi. Amaute a kamun hoih khem napi-in, a lungsim uhah amau' metna ding bek ngaihsun uh hi.
Amaute-a' dingin nang pen mite' lungnopna dingin zawl la sa-in lasaknate a tum mipa tawh na kibang lel hi. Na thugen khempeuh hong ngai napi uh, khat beek zuilo uh hi.
Ahi zongin a tung takpi ding ahih mah bangin, na thugente a tun' ciangin amaute lakah kamsang khat omngei ahihlam hong thei ding uh hi," hong ci hi.
"Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, keima tuuhon ahi Israel mi a cingte mawhsakna thu gen in. Amaute kiangah thu gen in la, Topa { Pasian } ahi keima thugen, amaute kiangah hih bangin gen in: Israel mi a cing note aw, gimna na thuak ding uh hi. Nomau mahmah na kivak uh a, tuute na don kei uh hi.
Tuu zawngkhalte na khoi kei uh a, a cinate damsak loin, a liamnate na tuamsak kei uh hi. A lampialte na khiang kei uh a, a mangte na zong kei uh hi. Tua bang bek hiloin, ngong bawlin na ukgawp zawsop uh hi.
Tua tuute in a cing ding neilo uh ahih manin kithehthang gawp uh a, gamsate' an a suak lel uh hi.
Tua ahih manin ka tuute kithehthang gawp uh a, mualtungte leh mual sang tung khempeuhah vakmang uh hi. Leitung gam khempeuhah ka tuute kithehthang uh a, kuamah in zon' ding kan dingin ngaihsunlo uh hi.
"Tua ahih manin no tuucingte aw, { Topa } ahi keima thugen ngai un:
Kei pen a nungta Topa { Pasian } ka hih takpi mah bangin, keima thu nong ngaihzawk ding uh hinapi-in, tu-in a cing omlo ahih manin gamsate in ka tuute manin thatin a ne uh hi. Ka tuu a cingte in a tuu uh zonglo uh a, amau pumpi bek mah kivakin ka tuute vaklo uh hi.
Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah, note' lang ka hihna thu tu-in kong pulak hi. Note' khutsung panin ka tuute ka la ding a, tuute donloin note bek a kidon no tuucingte' khutsungah ka tuute ka omsakkik nawn kei ding hi. Note' khutsung panin ka tuute ka honkhia ding a, ka tuute, note' nekin ka omsak nawn kei ding hi.
"Topa { Pasian } keimah in note kiangah kong genin-ah: Keimahmah in ka tuute zongin ka kem ding hi.
Gamdang panin amaute lakhia-in ka kaikhawm ding a, amaute' leitangah ka tun'pihkik ding hi. Israel mualtungte, lui geite, leh mite' ten'na mun khempeuhah amaute ka gamtasak ding hi.
Lungmuang takin Israel mualtung lonona leh guamsung munnuamte leh Israel gam lonona mun khempeuhah ka gamtasak ding hi.
Keimahmah in ka tuute ka cing ding a, nuamtakin a omna ding uh mun ka zon'sak ding hi. Topa { Pasian } keimah in hih thu ka gen khin hi.
"No ka tuuhonte aw, Topa { Pasian } ahi keima thugen ngai un: Note a tuamtuam ciatin thu kong khen ding a, note sung panin a hoih leh a hoihlo hong khenin, tuu leh keel zong kong khen ding hi.
Note pawlkhat, lopa limci na nek bek uh tawh na lungkim kei uh a, na neklohte nangawn uh na tuancilgawp uh hi. Tui a siang na dawn uh a, na dawnlohteng uh na siknin uh hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Topa { Pasian } keimah in ka thugen ngai un: No tuu thaute leh tuu gawngte kong khen ding hi.
Note in a cidamlote na ki uh tawh si gawpin, a hon lak panin na nawtkhia uh hi.
{ Topa } ahi keimah, amaute' Pasian ka hi ding a, ka nasempa David, amaute a ukpa hi ding hi. { Topa } ahi keimah in hih thu ka gen khin hi.
Amaute lungmuang takin a om theihna dingun amaute tawh thuciamna khat ka bawl ding hi. Gamsung panin a lauhuai gamsa khempeuh ka beisak ding a, gamlakah nuamtakin gamta-in a lum thei ding uh hi.
Singkungte tampi tak gahin, lo-ah an tampi piang ding a, mi khempeuh a leitang ciat uhah nuamtakin teng ding uh hi. Sal ahihna panun ka mite suakta sakin, a kikhihna kolte uh ka sutsak khit ciangin, { Topa } ka hihna thu amaute in hong thei ding uh hi.
Gamdang mite in hih gawpgawp nawnlo ding uh a, gamsate in thatin ne nawnlo ding uh hi. Amaute lungmuang takin om ding uh a, kuamah in lausak nawnlo ding uh hi.
Amaute tungah logam hoih pia ding ka hih manin gamsungah gilkial dangtak om nawnlo ding hi. Minam dangte in amaute simmawhbawl nawnlo ding uh hi.
Israel mite ka hutna leh amaute pen keima mi ahihna thu mi khempeuh in thei ding uh hi. Topa { Pasian } in hih thu ka gen khin hi.
"No ka ta ahi tuute aw, an ka hong vak tuuhon ahi keima mite na hi uh a, kei pen note' Pasian ka hi hi. Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in hih thu kong gen khin hi," hong ci hi.
"Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Seir Mual lam nga in la, Edom mite mawhsakna thu gen in.
Topa { Pasian } ahi keima thugen, hih bangin gen in: "Seir Mualtung gam aw, kei, nangma lang ka hi hi. Nang a gamkhingin ka hong bawl ding hi.
Na khuapite ka siasak ding a, na gamsungteng gamkhing ka suaksak ding hi. Tua ciangin { Topa } ka hihna thu na thei ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kei pen a nungta Topa { Pasian } ka hih takpi mah bangin, nangma sihna ding ka bawl ding a, na si takpi ding hi. Nangmah in mi sisak na hih manin nangma tungah sihna hong tung ding hi.
Seir Mualtung gam khempeuh gamkhing ka suaksak ding a, tua gamsunga a vak mi khempeuh ka that ding hi.
Mualtung khempeuh si luanghawm tawh ka kidimsak ding a, mual leh guam khempeuh dimin galsunga a site' luanghawm a om ding hi.
A gamkhingin kong bawl paisuak ding a, na khuapite sungah kuamah tengkik nawnlo ding hi. Tua ciangin { Topa } ka hihna thu na hong thei ding hi.
"Kei pen Israel leh Judah mite' Topa { Pasian } hinapi-in, hih minam nihte nangma-a'-in ngaihsunin a luah dingin na kigen hi.
Tua ahih manin kei pen a nungta Topa { Pasian } ka hih takpi mah bangin, hih ka minam nihte tungah na heh gamtatna, na muhdah bawlna, leh na hazat bawlna tawh kizui-in nangma tungah kong thukkik ding hi. Amaute tungah na gamtatnasa hangin gim hong pia ka hihna thu amaute in thei ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin nangmah in, 'Israel mualtungte gamkhing suak ta a, keima-a' ding hita hi,' ci-in simmawhna tawh na kampaunate, { Topa } ahi keimah in a za ka hihlam na thei ding hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Topa { Pasian } in hih bangin ka ci hi: Leitung buppi a lungdam theihna dingin nang a gamkhingpha mahmahin kong bawl ding a,
keima mi Israel-te a siatgawp manin na lungdamna zah tawh kizui-in nangma tungah kong bawl ding hi. Seir Mualtung gam ahi Edom leitang khempeuh, gamkhing suak ding hi. Tua ciangin { Topa } ka hihna thu mi khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi," hong ci hi.
{ Topa } in kei kiangah, "Mihing ahi Ezekiel aw, Israel mualte tungah thu gen in la, Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in amaute tungah gen ding ka neih thute hih bangin gen in:
Israel-te' galte in, 'Hih tangtawng mualtung gamte tu-in eima-a' hita hi,' ci vial uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mailam thu ding gen in la, Topa { Pasian } ahi keima thugen hih bangin pulak in: Na kimkot uhah a om minam dangte in no Israel mualtung gamte hong la-in na neihsate uh a hong suh uh ciangin, mite khempeuh in no Israel mite hong simmawh bawlin hong ciamnuihbawl lel uh hi.
Tua ahih manin no Israel mualtung gamte aw, Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in mual lian leh mual neute, lui leh guamte, a kisia-in a kinusia munte, leh a kiima minam dangte in luhgawpin a ciamnuihbawl khuapite tungah ka gen thute ngai un.
"Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in a kimkotah a om minam dangte, leh a diakdiakin Edom mite tungah ka hehluatna tawh thu ka gen hi. Amaute in lungdamin nuihna leh simmawhna tawh keima leitang la-in a tang uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel gam tawh kisai-in mailam thu genkhol in la, a kimkotah a om minam dangte in a simmawh bawlna hangun Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in hehna tawh ka thugente, mual lian, mual neu, lui leh guamte tungah gen in.
Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in a kimkotah a om minam dangte ka mindaisak ding khauhtakin ka kiciam hi.
Ahi zongin Israel mualtung gamte-ah no ka mi Israel-te-a' dingin singkungte in teh leh gah hong neikik ding uh a, a sawtloin note, inn-ah a hong ciahkik ding na hi uh hi.
Kei pen note' lamah kong pang ding a, pelloin na gam uh lo-in kikho kikin khaici kituhkik ding hi.
A mihing a ganhingin kong pungsak ding a, a nidang sangin tam na phazaw ding uh hi. Ta tampi tak na nei ding uh hi. Nidangin na om ngei bangun kong omsak kik ding a, a nidang sangin a cithei zaw-in kong bawl ding hi. Tua ciangin { Topa } ka hihna thu na hong thei ding uh hi.
No ka mi Israel-te, na leitang uhah kong gamtangsak kik ding hi. Note' leitang suak ding a, tua leitang in na tate uh gilkialin puksisak nawnlo ding hi.
"Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in kong genin-ah: Israel mualtung gamte, mihing sane hi a, tua mualtung gamte in a gamsung mite' tate laksak hi, ci-in a beisa hunah hong kigennate a man ahi hi.
Ahi zongin tu-a kipanin mihing sa a ne, gamsung mite' tate a laksak gam hi nawnlo ding hi. Topa { Pasian } in hih thu ka gen khin hi.

Topa { Pasian } ahi keimah in hih thu ka gen khin hi.
Note sungah lungtang thak leh lungsim thak kong guan' ding a, na suang lungtang uh hong lakkhiatsakin mihing lungtang kong guan' ding hi.
Note sungah keima kha kong guang ding a, note tungah kong piak ka thukhamte leh ka thupiakte limtakin kong zuisak ding hi.
Na singgah kungte uh leh na lolai ante uh tampi tak ka phasak ding a, minam dangte lakah gilkiala mindaina na thuakkha nawn kei ding uh hi.
Na gamtatnasa uh na gitlohnate uh leh na hoihlohnate uh na phawk kik ding uh a, na mawhna uh leh na khialhnate uh hangin nomau mahmah na kimudahtawm ding uh hi.

Hih inndei golzaw a teh ciangin pi sawmleli pha hi.
Hih inndei pen biakinn tun'na ding lampi tawpna hi a, a biakinn lam neh pena om kawm pen pi li a sah hi.
(Hih lampi pang tuaka om galvilna inndei neute pen a golna kikim a, a kikala kawmte zong a sahna kikim hi.)
Tua ciangin a mipa in a lampi teh a, pi sawmleguk zai-in pi sawmnihlenih a sau hi.
Tua ciangin inndei neu kawm nung panin lampi kantanin a gal sana inndei neu kawm nung dong teh a, pi sawmlenih a pha hi.
Inndei nunung pen zomah biakinn tual om a, tua tual a teh ciangin pi sawmthumleli a pha hi.
Kulhkong pua panin inndei nawlnung kawm pua dong lampi sauna pi sawmgiatli a pha hi.
Hih inndei neute' kawm a pualam pangah tawlet neu om a, inndei kikala om kawm tungah zong a vang neu om hi. Lampi omna lampang, inndei kikala kawmte tungah nisuh kung lim kibawl hi.
Hih suangphah pen a tual kimkotah om a, hih a pualama tual pen a sunglama om tual sangin niamzaw hi.
Tua ciangin a sunglam tual lutna dingin a sangzaw-ah kongpi khat om hi. A mipa in hih kongpi nih kikal a teh ciangin pi za khat sawmgukgiat a pha hi.
Tua bangin a teh ciangin lampi pang tuaka om galvilna inndei neu thumte, a kikala om kawmte, leh a inndei golzaw pen, nisuahna kongpi-ate mah bangin a dung a vai kikim ciat hi. Tua kongpi lampi pen pi sawmgiatli sau a, pi sawmlinih zai hi.
A inndei golzaw, a tawlette, leh nisuh kung lim a kibawlte pen nisuahna lam kongpi-a omte mah tawh kibangin kikim hi. Hih lai-ah zong kongpi lampi tun'na dingin kahlei dawl sagih om a, a nawlnunga om a inndei golzaw pen in a tual lam maingat hi.
Nisuahna lampanga om bang teek mahin, leilu lam kongpi pana lutna-a a tual galkhatah tual sungnung lutna kongpi lampi khat mah a om hi. Tua kongpi nih kikal a teh ciangin pi za leh sawmgukgiat a sau hi.
Kongpi danga omte mah bangin hih lai-ah zong inndeite in tawlet nei uh hi. A kongpi lampi pen pi sawmgiatli sau-in pi sawmlinih zai hi.
Tua kongpi lampi tun'na dingin kahlei cial sagih mah om a, a inndei golzaw pen a nawlnung mahah omin a tual lam a nga hi. Lampi omna lampang, kawm sungnungte' tungah nisuh kung lim mah kibawl hi.
Hih lai-ah zong tual sungnung paina kongpi lampi khat mah om hi. A mipa in konglekong kikal a teh ciangin pi za leh sawmgukgiat a pha hi.
A galvilna inndei neute, a inndei golzaw, leh kawm sungnungte pen, kongpi dangate mah tawh kibang hi. Hih kongpi lama om inndei neute-ah zong tawlet om hi. A lampi pi sawmgiatli sau-in, pi sawmlinih zai hi.
A inndei golzaw pen tual puanung lam a nga hi. Lampi pang tuaka kawmte tungah nisuh kung lim kibawl a, hih kongpi lampi tun'na dingin kahlei cial giat a om hi.
A galvilna inndei neute, a inndei golzaw, leh a kawm sungnungte zong, kongpi dangate mah tawh kikim hi. A kimkotah tawlette om a, a inndei golzaw-ah zong a om hi. A lampi, pi sawmgiatli sau a, pi sawmlinih zai hi.
A inndei golzaw pen a tual puanung lam nga hi. Lampi pang tuakah a om kawmte tungah nisuh kung lim kibawl a, hih kongpi lampi tun'na dingin kahlei cial giat a om hi.
A dangte mah bangin hih in zong galvilna inndei neute, kawmsung lam tung kizemte, inndei golzaw pen, leh a kimkotah tawlette a nei hi. A lampi pi sawmgiatli sau a, pi sawmlinih zai hi.
Meihal biakna-in piak ding ganhingte bawlna dingin a kizang sabuai lite pen suang a kiseek ahi hi. Tua sabuaite letmat sawmnih sang a, a dung a vai letmat sawmthum tuak ahi hi. Biakna-in piak ding gan gawhna-in a zat uh na khempeuh, hih sabuaite tungah koih uh hi.

A mipa in hih tual sungnung a teh ciangin a dung a vai pi za khat sawmgukgiat tuak a pha hi. A biakinn mai-ah biakna tau khat a om hi.
Tua ciangin biakinn sung lutna inndei-ah hong paipih hi. Amah in a sung lutna lampi teh a, pi kua sau-in pi sawmnihli zai a, a pang tuaka kawmte pi nga tuak a sah hi.
Innsung lutna inndei pen pi sawmthumli sau a, pi sawmnih zai a, tua lai tun'na dingin kahlei cial sawm a om hi. Innsung lutna inndei pang tuakah khuampi khat tuak a om hi.

Tua ciangin inndei sungnungah amah pai a, tua sung lutna lampi a teh ciangin pi thum sau-in pi sawm zai a, a pang tuaka om kawmte pi sawmlenih tuak a sah hi.

Tua ciangin nitumna lamah biakinn lam a nga inn khat om hi. A inn dung pi za khat sawmnga hi a, a vai pi za khat sawmleguk hi a, a kimkota a kawm pi kua a sah hi.

Inndeipi sung lutna ding leh Siangtho Pen Mun lutna dingah kongkhak a om hi.
Biakinnsung kawmte tungah a kibawl mah bangin hih biakinn deipi sung lutna-a kongkhakte tungah zong nisuh kung leh kherub mah a kibawl hi. Kongkhak pualam, innsung lutna ding inndei sanah singpeek tawh limsun khat a kibawl hi.

Leilu lampang hih inn dung pi za khat sawmgukgiat hi a, a vai pi sawmgiatli ahi hi.
Tua inn pangkhat pen biakinn gei-a mun awng pi sawmthumli a zai a omna lam nga a, a pang langkhat pen tual puanunga suangphah lam a nga hi. Tua inn pen cial thum a pha a kitawito tungah kilam a, a tunga a cialte pen a nuai-ate sangin neuto zaw tektek hi.
Hih inn leilu lampangah pi sawmleguk zai-in, pi za khat sawmgukgiat a sau lampi khat tung a, a lutna kong zong tua lam mahah a om hi.
Biakinn tuala a inn dangte mah bangin tua inndei dawl thumte pen a cial tung-ah kinga uh a, a tuamin khuam neilo uh hi.

Leilu lampanga om mah bangin hih inndeite mai-ah zong lampi khat a om hi. A sauna, a pian'zia leh a kongte zong leilu lama om mah tawh kibang hi.

Hih inndeite a siangtho ahih manin, a kipia nate an tawh biaknate leh mawhna leh khialhna hangin biakna-in a kipia sate, a sungah koih uh hi.
