"A kha sagihna a ni sawmlenga ni-in nipikal khat sung a kibawl ding Buk Pawi kipan ding a, mawhna hanga biakpiakna, meihal biakna, leh an tawh biakna-in piak dingin an leh sathaute, nisimin a kisamzah, gam uk ulianpa in pia ding hi.
"Topa { Pasian } in hih bangin ci hi: Nisuahna lama om, tual sungnung kongpi pen nasep ni guk sung kikhakcip ding a, ahi zongin Sabbath ni leh Khadet ni-in kihong ding hi.
Siampite in meihal biakna leh thunuama biakna a piak laitakun, gam uk ulianpa pen tual puanung lam panin inndei lianpi kongpi-ah pai-in kongpi khuamte gei-ah ding ding a, tua kongpi-ah bia-in tua khit ciangin pusuak kik ding hi. Nitak mateng tua kongpi kikhaklo ding hi.
Sabbath ni leh Khadet nisimin mi khempeuh in zong tua kongpi mai-ah { Topa } bia-in kun ding uh hi.
Gam uk ulianpa in Sabbath ni-in meihal biakna dingin paubaan'na a omlo tuuno guk leh tuutal khat pia ding hi.
Tua ganhingte tawh a piakkhawm ding an tawh biakpiakna dingin zong, tuutal khat ciangin an bung khat kizuisak ding a, tuunote tawh piakkhop ding pen ama piaknop zahzah hi ding hi. An bung khat a piakna-ah sathau bing dim khat tawh kizuisak ding hi.
Khadet ni ciangin paubaan'na a omlo bawngtal khat, tuuno guk, leh tuutal khat hi ding hi.
Tuate tawh piakkhop dingin an tawh biakpiakna dingin bawngtal leh tuutalte khat ciangin an bung khat pai, leh tuunote tawh piakkhop ding pen ama piaknop zahzah hi ding hi. An bung khat a piakna-ah sathau bing dim khat tawh kizuisak ding hi.
"A kiseh pawi hunte-ah { Topa } a bia dingin a hong pai mite khempeuh pen a hong lutna kongpi zui-in kileh kiklo ding uh a, tangtakin paisuak ding uh hi. Leilu lam kongpi panin a lutte, leitaw lam kongpi-ah ciah ding uh a, leitaw lam kongpi panin a lutte, leilu lam kongpi-ah ciah ding uh hi.
Pawi nite leh a kiseh pawi hunte-ah an tawh biakna-in piak ding pen, bawngtal ahi a, tuutal ahi zongin khat ciangin an bung khat in zui ding a, tuunote tawh piakkhawm ding pen a mite' piaknop zahzah hi ding hi. An bung khat a kipiak ciangin sathau bing dim khat in zui ding hi.
Gam uk ulianpa in ama utthu-in biakpiakna, meihal biakna ahi a, thunuama biakna ahi zongin khat peuhpeuh a piak ciangin, ama lutna dingin nisuahna lama om tual sungnung kongpi kihon'sak ding hi. Amah in Sabbath ni-in biakpiakna a bawl mah bangin pia ding hi. Amah a ciahkik khit ciangin a kongpi kikhak ding hi.
"Gam uk ulianpa in meihal biakna-in piak dingin paubaan'na a omlo kum khat a pha tuuno khat, zingsang simin { Topa }' tungah biakna-in pia ding hi. Hih pen nisimin a kipia ding ahi hi.
Mangbuhnel lawh dim khat leh a meek khoppih ding sathau hai khat tawh, an tawh biakna-in zong, nisimin pia ding hi. Hih meihal biakpiakna ngeina pen a kip paisuak ding ahi hi.
Tua bangin tuuno, mangbuhnel, leh sathau, zingsang simin { Topa } tungah a kipia ngitnget ding ahi hi.
"Topa { Pasian } in hih bangin ci hi: Gam uk ulianpa in ama neihsa leitang mun khat peuhpeuh, a tapate khat peuhpeuh tungah a piak leh, tua leitang a ngah a tapa in a luah gamh-in nei paisuak ding hi.
Ahi zongin gam uk ulianpa in ama nasemte khat peuhpeuh tungah leitang a piak leh, suahtakna kum a tun' ciangin tua leitang pen a pia gam ukpa' neihsa suakkik ding hi. Bang bang hiam cih leh tua leitang pen ama neihsa hi a, amah leh a tapate bek in nei paisuak thei ding uh hi.
Gam uk ulianpa in midangte' neihsa leitang laksak ngeilo ding hi. Ama tungah a kipia leitang sung panin a tapate khenkhia bek ding hi. Ka mite' leitang laksakin, bawlsialo ding hi, ci-in gen in," hong ci hi.
"Hih mun pen, siampite in mawhna leh khialhna hangin biakna-in a kipia sate a huanna mun, leh an tawh biakpiaknate a emna ding mun ahi hi. Hih pen, tual puanungah biakna sa leh ante paipihkha loin, tua a siangtho nate tawh tual puanunga om mite a lawhsakkhak lohna ding uh ahi hi," hong ci hi.
Tua tualnote pi sawmgukgiat sau-in pi sawmligiat zai a, a vekin a golna kikim hi.
A mipa in a tehna piciang tawi-in a tui luan'na nisuahna lam pi tul khat zaguk sawmgiat ciangdong tehsuk a, a tui kei hong ngaptansak hi. A tui pen siakmit ciang bek thuk hi.
Tua ciangin pi tul khat zaguk sawmgiat ciang tehsuk leuleu a, tua lai-ah a tui hong ngaptansak a, khuk ciang tum hi. Tua ciangin pi tul khat zaguk sawmgiat ciang tehsuk leuleu-in a tui hong ngaptansak a, ka kawng ciang tum hi.
Tua ciangin pi tul khat zaguk sawmgiat ciang mah tehsuk lai leuleu a, a tui thuklua ta ahih manin ka ngapzo kei hi. Thuklua ahih manin a tui i peek loh buangin a kikantan zo ding hilo hi.
tua lai mun ka tun' ciangin a gun lang nih tuakah singkung tampi tak a po ka mu hi.
Amah in kei kiangah, "Hih tui pen nisuahna lam manawhin gamsung nawkin Jordan Kuam-ah luangsukin Si Tuipi sungah tung hi. Si Tuipi a tun' ciangin hih tui in tuipi tui pen, tuisiang suaksak kik hi.
Hih tui a luan'na mun peuhpeuhah ganhing namkim leh ngasa tampi om hi. Hih tui in Si Tuipi tui siangsak kikin, a luan'na peuhpeuhah nuntakna omsak kik ding hi.
Engedi khua panin Eneglaim khua ciangdong tuipi dungah ngasa bengte omin, tua dungah a ngen uh zalin phokeu ding uh hi. Mediterranean Tuipi sungah ngasa a omzah mah bangin ngasa nam tampi om ding hi.
Ahi zongin tuipi dunga om nawnglakte leh bualte-a om tuite sianglo ding a, cikhuk dingin a tuaci mahin omlai ding uh hi.
Hih gun pang tuakah a gah nek dingin singkung nam khempeuh po ding hi. A tehte pulh ngeilo ding a, a gah tawh zong kilawi ngeilo ding hi. Biakinn panin a luangkhia tui ngah ding uh ahih manin khasimin a gah thak gah tawntung ding uh hi. A singgahte an ding hi ding a, a tehte zatui-in kizang ding hi," hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin Topa { Pasian } in kei kiangah, "Israel minam sawmlenihte' gamh dingin leitang hawm ding a gamgi ding hih bang hi ding hi. Josef minamte in a dangte' ngahzah nih ngah ding uh hi.
tua panin Berothah leh Sibraim khuapite-ah (hih khuate pen Damaskas kumpi gam leh Hamath kumpi gam kikalah om hi), tua panin Hazerhattikon khuapi (Hauran kumpi gamgi gei-a om) hi ding hi.
Leilu lam gamgi pen Mediterranean Tuipi-a kipanin nisuahna lam manawhin Damaskas leh Hamath gamgi-a om Hazarenan khuapi ciang hi ding hi.
"Nisuahna lam gamgi pen, Damaskas leh Hauran gamgi kituahna panin hong kipan sukin, Jordan Gun zuisuk a, Jordan Gun nitumna lampangteng Israel gam hi-in, nisuahna lampangteng Gilead gam hi a, tua panin Si Tuipi kimang sukin Tamar khuapi ciang hisuk ding hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin hih gamsungteng, no Israel minamte lakah hawm un.
Note-a' dingin na neih kip tawntung ding uh gamh hi ding hi. Hih leitang na hawm uh ciangin note lakah hong tengin ta a nei khinsa minam dangte zong note mah bangin tanh na pia ding uh hi. Amaute pen Israel minam taktakte mah bangin na ngaihsun ding uh a, Israel minam dangte mah bangin leitang hawmna-ah ai sawk thei ding uh hi.
Note' lakah a teng gamdang mite in amau' ten'na minamte tawh leitang ngahkhawm ding uh hi. Topa { Pasian } in hih thu kong gen khin hi.
"Leilu lam gamgi pen, Mediterranean Tuipi panin kipanin Hethlon khuapi-ah, Hamath khua lutna-ah, tua panin Damaskas leh Hamath gamgi kituahna sana om Hazarenan khuapi ciang sun ding hi. Minam khat in leitang khen khat ciat ngah ding uh a, a kikal uh gamgite pen gambup nisuahna gamgi panin gambup nitumna gamgi ciang hi ding a, leilu lam panin a hawm uh kipan suk ding uh hi. Leilu lam a khungnung penah Dan minamte,
"Tuate zomah Pasian-a' dingin a kipia leitang hi ding a, a zaina pen leilu lam panin a kipan leitaw lam tai sawm hi ding hi. A dunglam pen gambup nisuahna gamgi panin gambup nitumna gamgi dong, minam dangte' ngahzah tan mah hi ding a, a laizang sanah biakinn om ding hi.
{ Topa}-a' dingin a kipia leitang a sauna tai sawm hi ding a, a zaina tai giat hi ding hi.
Siampite in hih a siangtho leitang sung panin tanh ngah ding uh a, leilu lampang leh leitaw lampang tai sawm tuak hi-in, nisuahna lam leh nitumna lampang tai li tuak hi ding hi. Siampite' ngahna sung hih leitang laizangah { Topa' } biakinn om ding hi.
Hih munteng pen Zadok' suanlekhak siampite-a' ding ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel midangte a gamtat khialh uh ciangin Levi midangte bangin va zuilo uh a, hih mite in citakin keima na hong sem uh hi.
{ Topa } tungah a kipia hih leitang siangtho pen, leitang khempeuh panin a hoihpen mun hi a, hih leitang sung panin mun khat peuhpeuh, kizuak theilo, adang tawh zong kikhek theilo, midang tungah zong kipia theilo ding hi. Hih leitang pen a siangtho leitang hi a, { Topa}-a' ahi hi.
"A omlai leitang, a sauna tai sawm leh a zaina tai nih pen a siangtho leitang hiloin a mawkmawk leitang hi ding a, mite' taang zat ding mun hi ding hi. Ten'na ding leh a mun awngthawl hi ding a, a laizangah khuapi om ding hi.
A khuapi golna a dung a vai-in a kikim hi ding a, a pang li-in pang khat ciangin pi tul sagih zanga sawmguk hi ding hi.
Khuapi sungah nasemin a om mi peuhmah in Israel minam sung panin kuamah kideidanna omloin hih leitang kho thei ding uh hi.
Hih a kisehkhia leitang buppi pen a pang li-in tai sawm pai hi ding a, hih pen leitang siangtho leh khuapihuam sung kigawm hi ding hi.
"A pang li-in tai sawm paisuak a pha, { Topa}-a' dingin a kipia leitang leh khuapi huamteng a kilakkhiat khit ciangin, a pang tuakah a omlai leitang, nitumna lamah tuipi dong, nisuahna lamah gambup gamgi dong, gam uk uliante-a' ding hi ding hi. Hih leitang a kipia kikal sungah, biakinn, { Topa' } tungah a kipia leitang, Levi mite a kipia leitang, leh khuapihuam leitangte om ding a, gam uk uliante' leitang in hihte laitaak ding hi. Hih gam uk uliante' leitang pen leilu lamah Judah Minamte-a' leh leitaw lamah Benjamin Minamte-a' kikalah om ding hi.
"Hih leitang panin leitaw lampang-ah, Israel minam a omlaite in leitang ngah ding uh a, a kikal uh gamgite pen gambup nisuahna gamgi panin gambup nitumna gamgi ciang hi ding a, leilu lam panin a hawm uh kipan suk ding uh hi. Leilu lam a khungnung penah a ngah ding Benjamin Minamte,
Tu-a ka gen bangin Israel minamte in a khang a khangin a luah suksuk ding uh leitang dingin amaute tungah a kipia ding leitang ahi hi. Topa { Pasian } in hih thu kong gen khin hi.
"A khuapi sungah lutna ding kulhkongpite om hi. A khuapikulh pang lite, pang khat ciangin pi tul sagih zanga sawmguk sau hi. A pang khatah kulhkongpi thum ciat om a, Israel minamte khat ciat tam hi. Leilu lampanga om kulhkongpi thumte in Reuben, Judah, leh Levi tam hi. Nisuahna lampanga omte in Josef, Benjamin, leh Dan tam hi. Leitaw lampanga omte in Simeon, Issakhar, leh Zebulun tam hi. Nitumna lampanga omte in Gad, Asher, leh Naftali tam uh hi.
Khuapi kimkot a sauna pi tul sawmthum zanih sawmli pha a, tu-a kipanin hih khuapi min pen, 'Hih lai-ah { Topa } om hi,' kici ding hi," hong ci hi.
Topa in kumpi Jehoiakim leh biakinnpi na manphate kumpi Nebukhadnezzar a mansak hi. Amah in a mi matte Babylon gam ama pasian biakinn-ah paipih a, na manpha a matte sumkoihna inn-ah a koih hi.
Kumpipa in Israel salte sunga kumpi nam leh milian namte lak pan mi pawlkhat a teelkhia dingin innsungmang lian pen Ashpenaz thu a pia hi.
Tua mite, kumpi innsunga nasem siamte a suahtheihna dingun a melhoih, pumpi tung poina a neilo, a navak, hoihtakin pilna a kisinsak, na a thei baih, a lungsim navak ngentang ding ahi hi. Ashpenaz in amaute Babylon lai leh a pau a hilh ding ahi hi.
Amaute pen kumpi innsunga nasem dangte mah bangin nisimin an leh leenggahzu tawh a vak dingin kumpipa in thu a pia hi. Tua bangin kum thum sung sinna a neih khit uh ciangin kumpipa mai-ah amaute a kilak kik ding uh ahi hi.
Tua bangin a kiteelte, Judah mite vive hi a, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, leh Azariah-te ahi uh hi.
Innsungmang lianpenpa in amaute min thak phuah a, Daniel' min dingin Belteshazzar, Hananiah' min dingin Shadrak, Mishael' min dingin Meshak, Azariah' min dingin Abednego a phuak hi.
Daniel in kumpi innsunga an leh leenggahzu tawh a pumpi a thanghuaisak lohna dingin a lungsim a khensat hi. Amah in innsungmang lianpen Ashpenaz kiangah tua bang an a kipiaklohna dingin a ngen zaw hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian in Daniel tungah Ashpenaz in ngaihsut siamna a neih theihna dingin a bawlsak hi.
Ahih hangin Ashpenaz in Daniel kiangah, "Kumpipa in na annek ding uh leh na dawn ding uh sehsa-in nei khinzo ahih ciangin, khangno dangte banzo kei kha zenzen leteh a hong thah ding ka lau hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Daniel zong Ashpenaz in amah leh adang thumte a cing dingin a koihpa kiangah a pai hi.
Amah in, "Ni sawm sung hong ze-etin, anteh bek hong nesak in la, tui bek hong dawnsak in.
Ni sawm a cin' khit ciangin amaute pen kumpi an nete sangin cidamzaw uh a, a ci a sa uh a hoihzaw hi.
Tua ciangin a cingpa in kumpi an leh leenggahzu pialoin amaute anteh an a pia hi.
Pasian in tua khangno lite laitheih siamna leh pilna thukte a pia hi. Daniel pen maangmuhna leh mangkhiat siamna a pia hi.
Kumpipa' sehsa kum thum a cin' khit ciangin Ashpenaz in khangnote khempeuh kumpipa kiangah a paipih hi.
Kumpipa in amaute khempeuh hopih a, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, leh Azariah-te adangteng khempeuh sangin a hoihzawk tuanlam uh a mu hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpi inn-a vaihawm ulian pawl a suak uh hi.
Kumpipa in bangbang thuhaksa nono a dot hangin, hih mi lite pen ama gamsung khempeuha mitphial siamte leh aisan theite khempeuh sangin a zah sawmin a siamzawklam uh a mu hi.
Tua ahih ciangin bang mang man cih a hilh dingin mitphial siamte, mibum theite, leh khongkhai siamte a samsak hi.
Amaute hong pai-in kumpipa mai-ah a din' uh ciangin kumpipa in, "Mang khat ka man a, tua ka mang pen bang hiam cih theinuam ka hih manin ka lungsim a patau mahmah hi," a ci hi.
Amaute in Aram pau tawh, "Kumpipa aw, na khan' sau hen! Na mang hong gen leteh a khiatna zong kong gen ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Kumpipa in, "Ka mangmat leh a khiatna nong gen theih kei uh leh note kong semnengawp ding a, na inn uh suksiatgawp dingin ka ngaihsun khinzo hi.
Ka mangmat nong gen theih kei uh leh note khempeuh thukhenna khat bek ka hong pia ding hi. Noteng khempeuh in lungsim kikhatin zuauthu gengen leeng a ngaihsutna hong kikheel ding hi, a ci nuam na hi tazen uh hi. Tua ahih ciangin ka mangmat hong gen phot un. Tua hi leh a khiatna zong hong gen thei ding ci-in ka hong muang pan ding hi," a ci hi.
Khongkhai theite in, "Kumpipa aw, na deihna bang a hong gen thei ding hih leitungah mihing khat beek omlo ding hi. Kumpi gen loh milian pen leh mi thupi pen khat beek in, a aisan theite, a mitphial siamte, leh a khongkhai theite tungah tua bang thu a dong ngei kuamah om nailo hi.
Kumpipa' thudotna pen haksa lua mahmah ahih manin, mihing a hilo pasian-te longal a gen thei ding kuamah omlo hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mipilte khempeuh thahlup khitna ding thu kipia a, tua thahlup dingte sungah Daniel leh a lawmte zong a kihel uh ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Daniel zong Babylon gamsunga mipilteng a thatlum dingin a kisawl kumpicing a ukpa Ariok kiangah kampau kidawm takin a va pai hi.
Amah in Ariok kiangah, "Bang dingin kumpipa in hih zahtakin thukhauh suaksak ahi hiam,?" ci-in a dong hi. Ariok in a thupiang khempeuh a gen hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah Daniel pai a, a mangmat a khiatna a hilh theihna dingin hun tawmvei sung a kingak laina dingin phalna a ngen hi.
Tua ciangin Daniel a inn-ah ciah a, a thupiangteng khempeuh a lawmte Hananiah, Mishael, leh Azariah-te kiangah a ko hi.
Amah in, vantung Pasian in eite hong hehpihin, tua thuthukpi genkhia thei-in, Babylon gam sunga mipil dangte tawh thahna i thuakkhawm lohna dingin thu i ngen ding hi, ci-in a gen hi.
Amah in hun leh khuahunte kheel a, kumpite koihin lah a lakhia hi. Amah in mite tungah pilna leh theihna a pia hi.
Amah in thuthukpite leh thusimte a lakkhia hi. Amah in khuamial sunga kiseelte thei a, khuavak in amah a umcih hi.
Nang pen ka pu ka pate' Pasian na hi a, ka hong phat a, ka hong zahtak hi. Nangmah in pilna leh thahatna na hong piazo hi. Ka thungetna nong za a, kumpipa kianga ka gen ding thu nong lakzo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in Babylon mipilte a that dingin a sawlpa Ariok kiangah Daniel pai a, "Babylon gamsunga mipilte that kei in. Kumpipa kiangah hong paipih in; tu-in a mangmat a khiatna ka gen ding hi," a ci hi.
Daniel in, "Kumpipa aw, tua na theihnop thu a hong gen thei ding khongkhai thei, mitphial siam, aisan siam kuamah omlo hi.
Ahih hangin thusim a lak thei vantungah Pasian khat a om hi. Amah in mailamah bang thu hong piang ding cih nangmah Nebukhadnezzar kumpipa tungah a hong hilhzo hi.
Kumpipa na ihmut laitakin mailama hong piang ding mang khat na man a, thuthukpi a lakkhia Pasian in a piang ding thu a hong lakkholzo hi.
Tu-in midangte sangin ka pilzawk manin kei tungah tua thu a hong kilak hiloin, Kumpipa in na mangmat a khiatna leh na ngaihsut thu na theihna dingin a hong kilak ahi zaw hi.
"Kumpipa aw, na mangin a te daldal milim lian mahmah khat na mu a, kihtakhuai mahmahin na mai-ah a ding hi.
Tua milim lutang pen kham hoih mahmah tawh a kibawl ahi hi. A awm leh a bante ngun tawh kibawl a, a gil leh a pheite sumngo tawh kibawl hi.
Tua banga na et laitakin mualtung panin suangtumpi khat kuama khuklohin hong tuk a, sik leh tungman kigawm milim khete dengtanin a kithehthang hi.
Thakhatin sik, tungman, sumngo, ngun leh khamte kitamnen gawp a, khuakhal lai-a ansi zap bangin a lengmang hi. Huih in leen'mang khin ahih manin themkha beek a kimu nawn kei hi. Ahih hangin tua suangtum hong khangkhang a, mual cia hong pha-in leitung khempeuh a dim hi.
Kumpipa aw, kumpi khempeuh lak pan nang a lianpen na hi hi. Vantung Pasian in kumpi-in nang hong koih a, vangliatna, thahatna, leh zahtakna a hong pia hi.
Amah in mi' ten'na leitungteng, ganhingteng leh vasate a uk dingin nang a hong koih hi. Tua kham lutang pen nangmah na hi hi.
A khepek leh a khemete khen khat sik leh khen khat tungman kigawm ahi na mu hi. Tua pen kumpi gam kikhenthang ding hi, cihna ahi hi. Tungman leh sik kigawm ahih mah bangin sik bangin a hoih khopkhat ciang khauhna a nei ding hi.
Sik leh tungman kigawm na muh mah bangin tua kumpi gam ukte in kigawm ding hanciamin zileta-in a kimat ding uh hi. Ahih hangin sik leh tungman a kimat theihloh mah bangin a kigawm thei kei ding uh hi.
Tua kumpite a maan laitakun vantung Pasian in a bei thei ngeilo ding kumpi gam a hong phut ding hi. Tua kumpi gam kuamah in zo zolo ding a, tua gam in gamdang khempeuhte zogawpin a kip tawntung ding hi.
Kuama lawn'lohpi-in mualtung pan hong tuksuk suangtum in sik, sumngo, tungman, ngun, leh kham tawh kibawl milim a den'paih na mu hi. A lian Pasian in mailamah bang hong piang ding cih Kumpipa tungah a hong hilh ahi hi. Na mangmat pen ahi bang teekteekin kong gen a, a khiatna zong a man bangin kong genzo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpi Nebukhadnezzar zong Daniel' mai leilakah kunsukin, Daniel tungah sagawh biakna leh a namtui biakpiakna bawl dingin thu a pia hi.
Kumpipa in Daniel' ngetna mah bangin Shadrak, Meshak, leh Abednego-te Babylon gam khen tuamtuamte a uk dingin koih a, Daniel pen kumpi innsungah a omsak hi.
Kumpi Nebukhadnezzar in a tun pi sawmkua a sang, a vailam pi kua a gol kham milim golpi khat bawlsak a, Babylon gamsung Dura zanglei-ah a koih hi.
Kumpipa in a milian khempeuh, kumpi tapate, gam ukpite, gam ukpi huhte, mangpite, sumkem mangte, thukhen mangte, khuapi uk mangte leh milian dangte khempeuh, kumpipa' milim bawl apna-ah a paikim ciat dingin sapna thu a pia hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tua mangliante khempeuh milim apna dingin milim mai-ah a ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin nakpi takin taangkona khat kibawl a, "Minam tuamtuamte leh paunam tuamtuamte khempeuh aw!
Peengkul ging na za ding uh a, tua khit ciangin tamngaite, laia lasakna gingte, harp lasakna gingte, gawsemte, leh tumtheih a tuamtuamte a hong kitum ciangin Kumpi Nebukhadnezzar' koih kham milim mai-ah kunin na bia ding uh hi.
A kunlo, a bialo peuhmah thakhat thu-in mei phualpi sungah kikhul pah ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua mah bangin minam kimte, minam tuamtuamte leh paunam tuamtuamte khempeuh in tumtheih gingte a zak phetun kunsukin Kumpi Nebukhadnezzar' kham milim koih a bia uh hi.
Amaute in Kumpi Nebukhadnezzar' kiangah, "Kumpipa aw, na khan' sau hen!
Tua milim mai-ah kunloin, a bialo khempeuh mei phualpi sungah a kikhul ding ahi hi.
Babylon gam a khen liante a uk dingin na koih Shadrak, Meshak, leh Abednego a kici Jew mi pawlkhat a om uh hi. Amaute in kumpipa' thupiakna a mang kei uh hi. Amaute in na pasian bia nuamloin, na milim koih mai-ah a kun nuam kei uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Amah in, "Shadrak, Meshak, leh Abednego-te aw, ka pasian bianuam loin, ka kham milim koih mai-ah kun nuamlo na hi uh hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in peengkulte, tamngaite, laia lasakna gingte, harp lasakna gingte, gawsem, leh tumtheih dang a gingte na zak khit phet uh ciangin kunin milim na bia ding uh hi. Na biak kei uh leh thakhatin mei phualpi sungah hong kikhul ding ahih ciangin a hong honkhiazo ding pasian omin um na hi uh hiam?" a ci hi.

Tua ciangin Kumpi Nebukhadnezzar pen Shadrak, Meshak, leh Abednego-te tungah heh mahmah ahih manin a mai a san pempam hi. A sat ngeinazah sangin a zah sagihvei a sazaw mei phualpi a cih dingin a mite thu a pia hi.
Tua ciangin Shadrak, Meshak, leh Abednego-te a hencip ding leh mei phualpi sungah a khul dingin galkap thahat khempeuh thu a pia hi.
Tua ciangin amaute puanak leh puantualpi silhsa leh lukhu khusa-in hencip uh a, mei phualpi sungah a khul uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Shadrak, Meshak, leh Abednego-te hencipsa-in meikuangpi laizangah a kiasuk uh hi.
Tua ciangin Nebukhadnezzar in lamdangsa mahmahin a ding vat hi. Amah in a thudotte kiangah, "Mihing thum hencipsa-in mei phualpi sungah khul hilo ihi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi. Amaute in, "Hi mah hi, Kumpipa aw," ci-in a dawngkik uh hi.
"Tua ahih leh bang hangin meikuang sungah mihing li a kawi paipai mu ka hi hiam? Amaute lah kihenciplo a, liam zong liam tuak beeklo uh hi. A lina penpa hoh pasian-te khat tawh a kibang hi," ci-in a dong hi.
Kumpi tapate, gam ukpite, gam ukpi huhte, leh kumpipa' thudotte khempeuh kikhawm uh a, mei in a katloh mite a en uh hi. A sam uh zang khat beek mei in kanghullo a, a puan uh zong kangloin meikhu gim zong a nam beek kei uh hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Shadrak, Meshak, leh Abednego-te' Pasian phat un. Amah in a vantung mite sawl a, amah a muang ama nasem hih mite a honkhia hi. Amaute in ka thupiakna mangloin, amau' Pasian longal pasian dang' mai-ah kun nuamlo, bia nuamlo uh ahih manin mei phualpi sungah khul ding a utzaw uh ahi hi," a ci hi.
"Tu-in minam kimte, minam tuamtuamte, paunam tuamtuamte, mi khat peuhpeuh in Shadrak, Meshak, leh Abednego-te' Pasian gensiatna kampau a om leh kibanengawp ding a, a inn uh kisuksiatsak ding hi, ci-in thukham ka bawl hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih bangin a hon thei pasian dang om peuhmahlo hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Shadrak, Meshak, leh Abednego-te Babylon gam khen liante-ah a golzaw ukna za a pia hi.
Nebukhadnezzar kumpipa in leitung-a om minam kimte, minam tuamtuamte, paunam tuamtuamte khempeuh tungah a nuai-a thute hih bangin a khak hi: "Note tungah nopna om ta hen!
A Lianpen Pasian in kei tungah lim leh na lamdang a hong lahna thute ka hong gen nuam hi.
"Keimah Nebukhadnezzar lung-nuam takin kumpi inn-ah ka teng a, nuamsa mahmahin ka om hi.
Ka mangmat a khiatna a hong hilh dingin Babylon gam kumpi thudotte khempeuh a hong paina dingun thu ka pia hi.
Tua ciangin Daniel (a min ding Betashazzar, ka pasian' min tamin a kiphuakpa) a hong pai hi. Pasian' kha ama sungah om ahih ciangin ama kiangah ka mangmat ka gen hi.
Ama kiangah, aisan theite laka a lianpen Betashazzar aw, Pasian' kha na sungah om ahih manin thuthuk khempeuh na theih theihlam ka thei hi. Hih ka mang a khiatna hong gen in, ka ci hi.
"Ka maangmuhna ngaihsunin ka om laitakin ka khuadak leh a vil, a patau vantung mi khat vantung pan a hong tuaksuk ka mu hi.
Amah nakpi-in kiko-in, 'A singkung phuk in la, a hiangteng sattan in. A tehteng heuhsiang in la, a gahteng thehthang in. A nuai-a ganhingteng leh a hiang tunga vasateng hawlkhia in.
Ahih hangin a bul leh leisunga a zungte nusia in. Sik leh sumngo kual tawh vial in la, gamlak lopate tawh nusia khawm in. Hih mipa tungah daitui kai hen la, ganhingte leh lopate tawh omkhawm hen.
Amah in mihing lungsim nei nawnloin, kum sagih sung ganhing lungsim a nei ding hi.
Hih pen a vil, a patau vantung mi' thukhenna ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin mun khempeuhah a om mi khempeuhte in, a Lian Pasian in mite' kumpi gamah vai a hawm hi, cih a thei ding uh hi. Amah in a teel peuhpeuh a neupente nangawn kumpi a suaksak thei ding hi,' a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Beltashazzar zong a kici Daniel lungmang lua ahih manin tawmvei sung bangmah gen theiloin a om hi. Kumpipa in, Beltashazzar aw, mang leh a khiatna huhau-in na lung mangsak zenzen kei in, a ci hi. Beltashazzar in, Kumpipa aw, nang mangmat leh a khiatna pen na galte tungah tungzaw hen, a ci hi.
Kumpipa in na et laitakin, vantung mi khat vantung panin hong paisuk a, "A singkung phuk in la susia in; ahih hangin leisungah a bul leh a zungte nusia in. A bulah sik leh sumngo kual vial in la, gamlak lopate tawh nusiakhawm in. A tungah daitui kia hen la, kum sagih sung ganhingte tawh omkhawm ta hen," a ci hi.
Vantung mi in singbul leh a zungte leisungah nusiat dingin thu a pia hi. Tua pen, Pasian in leitung khempeuh uk hi, cih na theih ciangin kumpi na suakkik ding hi, a cihnopna ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa aw, kong thuhilhna hong mang in. Mawhna bawl nawn kei in la, diktakin gamta in. Mizawngte hehpih leteh, tua in a sia-a na gamtatnasate hong puahsak ding a, na nuamsa toto ding hi, a ci hi.
Tua zawh kha sawmlenih khit ciangin kumpipa zong Babylon khua kumpi innkhumzang huan sungah vak a,
Babylon khua bangzah takin lian ahi hiam? Kumpi khuapi ding leh, ka vangliatna ka thahatna a kilatna dingin ka lam ahi hi, a ci hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "A kisehsa hun a cin' ciangin keimah Nebukhadnezzar in vantung lam ka ento a, ka khuatheihna a hong tungkik hi. A nungta tawntung a Lianpen Pasian' min phatin, zahtakna leh minthan'na ka pia hi. "Amah in a tawntungin uk ding a, ama gam kip tawntung ding hi.
Amah in leitung mite bangmahin a sim kei a, vantung mite leh leitung mite ama khutnuai ahi hi. Ama deihna kuamah in nial theilo a, a bawlnate kuamah in a hang a kan thei kei hi.
"Ka khuatheihna a hong tun'kik ciangin ka kumpi za, ka minthan'na, leh ka gam minthan'nate a hong kipia kik hi. Ka miliante leh ka thudot mite in hong muak uh a, nidang sangin a lianzaw minthan'na leh ka kumpi za a hong kipia kik hi.
Thakhat thu-in kumpi innsung meivak a taan' penna lam kawm tungah mihing khut khat hong kilangin lai a hong gelh hi. Tua khut in lai a gelh laitak kumpipa in a mu hi.
Amah in mitphial siamte, aisan siamte, aksi et siamte va sam pak un, ci-in a kiko hi. Tua mite a hong tun' uh ciangin kumpipa in, "Hih lai kigelh a sim thei, a khiatna a hong gen thei peuhmah kumpi puanpi silhsakin, minphatna khamkhi a ngawngah ka oksak ding a, kumpi gamsungah a za lian a thumna-in ka koih ding hi," a ci hi.
Kumpipa' thudot mite hong tung uh a, ahih hangin tua lai a sim thei leh kumpipa tungah a khiatna a gen thei kuamah a om kei uh hi.
Tua tak ciangin kumpi Belshazzar lungkham mahmahin a mel daang semsem a, a miliante in a cihna ding mel a thei kei uh hi.
Kumpipa leh a miliante gamlum ngeingai-in a om laitakun, pawi innsung-ah kumpinu hong lut a, "Kumpipa aw, sauveipi nungta in. Bang hangin lungkham lua-in na mai daangsak zenzen na hi hiam?
Na gamsungah Pasian' kha a nei mi khat a om hi. Na pa kumpi ahih laitakin, tua mipa in pasian-te' pilna tawh a kibang pilna, theihna, leh lungsim navakna a nei hi. Tua hi a, kumpi ahi na pa Nebukhadnezzar in tuapa pen aisan theite, mitphial siamte, khongkhai siamte, leh aksi et siamte' ukpi dingin a koih hi.
Amah in a kanzaw siamna nei a, mangkhiat siamna, thudotna haksa nonote dawn'theihna, leh thuthukpite gentel theihna a nei hi. Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa in Beteshazzar ci-in a min a phuah Daniel samsak in. Tua hi leh amah in a hong gen thei pah ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin thakhatin kumpipa kiangah Daniel a paipih uh hi. Kumpipa in, "Nang Daniel pen kumpi ahi ka pa in Judah gam panin a hong lakkhiat Jew mi salte khat hilo na hi hiam?
Nangma sungah Pasian' kha om ahih manin siamna nei-in, lungpilna leh theihna na neihlam ka thei hi.
Ka thudot mite leh mitphial siamte, hih lai kigelh a sim ding leh a khiatna a gen dingin a hong pai uh hinapi, a khiatna a theizo kei uh hi.
Ahih hangin nangmah in thuthukpi leh kuama theih zawhloh thute gen thei hi, ci-in kong zazo hi. Hih lai kigelh sim thei-in a khiatna nong gen theih leh kumpi puansan kong silhsak ding a, minphatna khamkhi na ngawngah hong oksakin, kumpi gamsungah a za lian thumna-in ka hong koih ding hi," a ci hi.
Daniel in kumpipa kiangah, "Letsong pen kei hong pia kei in la, midang khatpeuh piazaw in. Ahi zongin tua lai kigelh hong simsakin a khiatna kumpipa kong hilh ding hi.
A Lianpen Pasian in na pa Nebukhadnezzar kumpi lianin koih a, zahtakna leh vangliatna a pia hi.
Ahih hangin amah a lung khauhin kiphasak a, gilo lua ahih manin a kumpi tokhom panin kilakhia a, a minthan'na a taan hi.
Mihingte lak panin amah kihawlkhia a, ganhing lungsim a nei hi. Gam sakolte tawh tengkhawmin, bawngtal bangin lopa ne a, daitui dal ding neiloin a pualamah a lum hi. A tawpkhakna-ah a Lianpen Pasian in mihingte' kumpi gamte uk a, a teel peuhpeuh kumpi suak hi, ci-in a phawk thei hi.
Vantung Topa' langah na pang hi. A biakinnpi hai leh kuangte la-in sabuai tungah nangmah tawh, na miliante tawh a zineute leh na zite uh tawh zunekna-in na zang uh hi. Theihna a neilo, a mu theilo, khua a za theilo ngun, kham, sumngo, sik, sing, leh suang tawh a kibawl pasian-te' min na phat uh hi. A khiatna zong hih bang ahi hi: Mene beisak ta hi, cihna ahi hi.

Parsin pen kikhen cihna hi a, na gam kikhen khamin Media leh Persia-te a kipiazo hi, a cihna ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Belshazzar in Daniel pen kumpi puansan a silhsak dingin thu pia pah a, minphatna khamkhi a ngawngah a oksak hi. A gamsungah a za lian thumna dingin a koih hi.
Media mi Darias kumpi a suak hi. (Tua laitakin Darias kum sawmguk leh kum nih a pha hi.)
Darias in gamsung khempeuh a uksawn dingin gam ukpi za leh sawmnih dingin a ngaihsun hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in tua gam ukpite tungah a vaihawmpi ding leh kumpi deih bang a sem dingin Daniel leh adang mi nih a teel hi.
Gam ukpi dangte leh vaihawmpi dangte sangin Daniel nasep siamzaw diak se hi. Tua bangin siamzaw diak se ahih manin kumpipa in gam buppi ukin koih ding a ngaihsun hi.
Tua ahih ciangin vaihawmpi dangte leh gam ukpite in Daniel' nasepna encikin a mawhna zon'ding a hanciam uh hi. Ahih hangin Daniel pen a thuman leh a citak khat ahih manin a mawhna leh a simtatna a muzo kei uh hi.
Tua banga nasep kizenlohna leh a tatkhialhna a muhloh uh ciangin, "Hih Daniel pen a biakna tawh kisai-in thu i muh kei ngal leh mawhsakna ding dang i mu kei ding hi," ci-in a kikum uh hi.
Ngattakin zuih ding thukham khat kumpipa in na bawl ding, gamsung nasem ko vaihawmpite, gam ukpite, gam ukpi huhte, leh kumpipa' thudot mite khempeuh ka thukim uh hi. Tuzawh ni sawmthum sungin nang kumpipa kiang longal, pasian kiang ahi a, midang khat peuhpeuh kiangah ahi zongin thungen om theilo ding hi, ci-in na kham ding hi. Hih na thupiakna a manglo peuhmah humpinelkai kikhumna sungah kikhia ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kumpipa aw, thupiakna lai hawmkhia-in a tungah na min gelh in. Tua hi leh Media-te leh Persia-te upadi pen kikhel theilo ding a, ngattakin a kizuih kul ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua bang thupiakna lai kihawmkhia khinzo ta hi, ci-in Daniel in a theih ciangin a inn-ah a ciah hi. A inn dawl tungnungah Jerusalem lam a nga tawlet thum a om hi. Tua laitakah tawlet hon'sa-in a hih ngei bangin khukdin'in ni khatin thumvei ta Pasian kiangah thu a ngen hi.
Amaute khempeuh kumpipa kiangah Daniel a hek dingin a pai uh hi. Amaute in, "Kumpipa aw, tuzawh ni sawmthum sungin kumpipa kiang longal, pasian kiang ahi a, mi khat peuhpeuh kiangah ahi zongin thungen a om leh humpinelkai kikhumna sungah kikhia ding hi, ci-in thupiakna lai hawmkhia-in na min gelh hilo na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpipa in, "Hi mah hi; Media-te leh Persia-te' upadi bangin a kikhel theilo ding a ngat thupiakna ka bawl hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in kumpipa kiangah, "Judah gam panin a hong pai Jew mi salte khat ahi Daniel in kumpipa hong zahtaklo a, na thupiakna a mang nuam kei hi. Nisimin thumveita thu a ngen tawntung hi," a ci uh hi.
Kumpipa in hih thu a zak ciangin lungmang a, Daniel a suahtak theihna ding lampi hanciamin nitum dong a ngaihsun hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa kiangah tua mite hong paikik uh a, "Kumpipa aw, Media leh Persia-te' upadi bangin kumpipa in a hawmkhiatsa thupiakna kikhelkik theilo hi, cih na thei hi," a ci uh hi.
Amaute in suangtum khat la uh a, humpinelkai kikhumna gong a hu uh hi. Kuamah in Daniel a hotkhiat theihlohna dingin kumpipa in ama ciamtehna leh a miliante' ciamtehna tawh a ciamteh hi.
Humpinelkai kikhumna a tun' dektak laitakin aw ling kawmin, "Daniel, a nungta Pasian' nasempa! Thuman takin na biak tawntung na Pasian in humpinelkai kamsung panin a hong honkhia thei hiam," ci-in a kiko hi.
Pasian in a vantung mi hong sawl a, ka liamlohna dingin humpinelkaite' kam a humcipsak hi. Kumpipa aw, mawhna ka bawllohlam leh, nang tungah zong khialhna ka bawllohna amah in hong thei ahih manin tua bangin a hong bawl hi," a ci hi.
Kumpipa lungdam mahmah a, humpinelkai kikhumna sung pan Daniel kaihkhiat dingin thu a pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin Daniel kaikhiato uh a, liamna themcik zong a neihlohlam a mu uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in Pasian muang hi.
Tua ciangin kumpipa in Daniel a hekteng khempeuh a zi a ta ciat uh tawh humpinelkai kikhumna sungah khiat dingin thu a pia hi. Amaute humpinelkai kikhumna taw a tun' ma-un humpinelkaite in bakkhat suahin a guh a taangin a balzan gawp uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kumpi Darias in leitunga om minam kimte, minam tuamtuamte, leh paunam tuamtuamte khempeuh tungah hih bangin lai a khak hi: "Note tungah nopsakna thupha om ta hen.
Ka gamsunga om mi khempeuh in Daniel' Pasian kihta-in a zahtakna dingun thu ka pia hi. "Bang hang hiam cih leh amah a nungta Pasian hi a, a tawntungin a uk ding hi. Ama gam kisia ngeilo ding a, a vangliatna a bei ngei kei ding hi.
Amah pen a honkhiapa leh a suaktasakpa hi a, vantung leh leitungah lim leh na lamdangte a bawl hi. Humpinelkaite' thahatna panin Daniel a suaktasak hi," a ci hi.
Belshazzar, Babylon kumpi a suahzawh a kum masa kumin keimah Daniel in mang khat ka man a, zanin maang ka mu hi. Ka mangmat lai-in ka gelh a, tua zana ka maangmuhnate ka ciamtehna hih bang ahi hi:
Tua ciangin tuipi sung panin a kibanglo sa golpi li hong pusuakto uh hi.
A masa pen humpinelkai tawh kibang a, ahi zongin muvanlai kha tawh a kibang kha a nei hi. Ka et laitakin a khate gel a hong kibotkhia hi. Leitung panin tua ganhing kidomkaang to-in, mihing bangin a khe nihin kidingsak a, mihing lungsim ama tungah a kipia hi.
Tua kite ka et laitakin tuate' lakah adang ki neu khat hong po a, a omsa sung pan ki thumte a botkhia hi. Tua ki' tungah mihing mittang tawh a kibang mittang leh kam om a, kiphatsakna kam tampi a pau hi.
tua sung panin meikuang a hong lengkhia niloh hi. Ama nasem ding mihing tul za tampi om a, a mai-ah mihing tul za sawm tampi a ding uh hi. Thukhenna ding hun kipan a, laibute a kiphen hi.
Sapi dangte ahih leh a vangliatna uh kilak khiatsak a, ahih hangin a nuntak laina ding uh hun ciangtan khat a kipia hi.
Amah in vangliatna, minthan'na, leh kumpi za ngah ahih manin minam kimte, minam tuamtuamte, paunam tuamtuamte khempeuh in ama na a sem ding uh ahi hi. Amah in a tawntungin uk ding a, a kumpi gam a bei ngei kei ding hi.
Tua ciangin a dangte tawh a kibanglo a kihtakhuai sik-ha leh sumngo khecin a nei sapi lina thu ka thei nuam hi. Amah in nene-in na khempeuh tuancilgawp hi.
Tua ciangin a lu tungah ki sawm leh, a nung ciangin ki khat hong po a, a omsa kite sung pan ki thum a kitanna thu ka thei nuam hi. Amah in mittang leh kiphatsakna kamsia pauna ding kam a nei hi. A dangte sangin nakpi takin kihtakhuai zaw hi.
Tua ciangin a nungta tawntung mipa hong pai a, a Lianpen Pasian' mite-a' ding a hoih thukhenna a hong gen hi. Pasian' mite in kumpi za a ngahna ding uh hun a hong tung hi.
Hih bangin hilhtelna kei a hong kipia hi: "Sapi lina pen leitunga hong om ding kumpi gam lina ding hi a, kumpi gamdangte tawh kilamdang mahmah ding hi. Amah in leitung buppi valhtum ding a, tuancil gawpin a sukham ding hi.
"Ki sawmte pen tua kumpi gamsung panin a hong piang ding kumpi sawmte ahi uh hi. Tua ciangin kumpi dang khat hong piang leuleu ding a, amah in a omsate tawh a kilamdang mahmahin kumpi thum a nuaisiah ding hi.
"Amah in a Lianpen Pasian langpangin thu gen ding a, Pasian' mite a bawlsia ding hi. Amah in amaute' biakna tawh kipawl thukhamte leh pawi bawlna hunte kheelsak ding hanciam ding a, ama khutsungah kum thum leh alang sung Pasian' mite a om ding uh hi.
"Hih leitung kumpi gam, vangliat-na, leh liatna khempeuh a Lianpen Pasian' mite tungah a kipia ding hi. Amau' kumpi za cikmah hunin bei ngeilo ding a, leitung ukna za a nei khempeuhte in a thu uh mangin amaute' na a sem ding uh hi," hong ci hi.
Ka maangmuhna-ah thakhatin Elam gamsunga om Susa khuapi kulh sungah a omin ka kingaihsun a, Ulai gun gei-ah ka ding hi.
Tua tuutal in a ki tawh nitumna lam, saklam, leh khanglam a si kawikawi ka mu hi. Ama ut bangin kiphasakin gamta ahih manin amah a khozo ding leh a thahatna pan a suaktazo ding ganhing khat beek a om kei hi.
A bangci hi ding hiam, ci-in ngaihsun theiloin ka om laitakin nitumna lam panin keeltal khat a hong tai veva hi. Hat lua mahmah ahih manin a khe in lei a sukha kei hi. A mitte gel kikalah a tuampian ki lamdang khat a nei hi.
Hehlua mahmah ahih manin tua tuutal laigawp a, a kite gel a suktansak hi. Tuutal in nang zolo ahih manin lei kiden'na a, a huhzo ding kuamah a om kei hi.
Tua ki lite lak pan khat' tungah ki neu dang khat hong po a, khanglam, nisuahna lam, leh Thuciamna Gam lamah a vangliatna a lak hi.
Amah in vantung galkap kumpipa nangawn do-in, ama tunga kipia tawntung biakpiaknate na-ngawn khawlsakin, biakinnpi biaknate a beisak hi.
Nisim biakpiaknate-ah mawhna dim a, biakna man pen leilakah a kipaikhia hi. A sepna peuhpeuhah tua ki thahat mahmah hi.
Vantung mi khat in adang vantung mi khat kiangah thu a dot ka za a, "Hih maangmuhna bang tanvei sawt ding a, a muhdahhuai mawhna in nisim biakpiakna bang tanvei khaktan ding ahi hiam? Vantung galkapte leh biakinnpi bang tanvei kituancil ding ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Amah in, "Zingsang leh nitak biakpiakna tul nih leh zathum vei a cin' khit ciangin biakinnpi kipuahkik ding hi," a ci hi.
Na muh ki nih a nei tuutal pen Media leh Persia gam kumpite a cihnopna ahi hi.
Ki po masa pen a kitan khit ciangin a nunga hong po ki lite pen tua gam panin kumpi gam li hong piang ding a cihnopna ahi hi. Ahih hangin tua gamte ahih leh a masa pen kumpi gam zahin a thahat kei ding uh hi.
Amah thahat mahmah ding a, ahih hangin ama thahatna ahi kei ding hi. Amah in a dipkuathuai siatna piangsak ding a, a hihna khempeuhah a thahat mahmah ding hi. Amah in mi thahatte leh Pasian' mite a susia ding hi.
A lungsim daplan lua ahih manin zuauphuah siamna tawh a hih khempeuh a tangtun' ding hi. Amah kiliansak lua-in theihkholh lohin mi tampi susia-in, a lianpen kumpite' kumpipa nangawn a langpan' ding hi. Ahih hangin mihing thahatna kizang loin amah a kisusia ding hi.
Hih zingsang leh nitak biakpiakna maangmuhna thu a hong kihilh telna pen a man ahi hi. Tu-in hih maangmuhna thu a hong tun' ding hun sawtpi hi lai ding ahih manin imcip phot in," hong ci hi.
Keimah Daniel, ni tawmvei sung thazaw gawpin ka ci a na hi. Tua ciangin tho-in ka nasep ngei a semkik dingin kumpi inn-ah ka pai hi. Ka maangmuhna thu thei zolo ka hih manin cihna ding mel theiloin daptakin ka om hi.
Amah kumpi a suah a kum masa kumin keimah Daniel in, { Topa } in kamsang Jeremiah tungah Jerusalem kum sawmsagih sung kisia ding hi, ci-in a genna thu ngaihsunin biakna laibute ka sim hi.
{ Topa } ka Pasian' kiangah thu ngenin ka mite' mawhna ka pulak hi. Keimah in, "Topa Pasian aw, nang na lian a, ka hong zahtak uh hi.Nang na thuman a, na thuciamna leh na thupiakna a mangte leh a hong itte a tawntungin na it hi.
"Kote ka hih uh leh ka gilo uh a, mawh khinin ka khial khin uh hi. Na hong sawlna bang ka mang kei uh a, na thupiakna leh na thukhamte ka taisan khin uh hi.
Ka kumpite uh, ko hong ukte, ka pu ka pate uh, leh minam khempeuh tungah na min tawh thu a hong gen na nasem kamsangte' thu ka ngai kei uh hi.
Topa, nang na hih leh na siangtho a, ahih hangin kote ka hih uh leh a zumhuai-in ka gamta uh hi. Judah gam leh Jerusalem khuasunga teng Israel mite khempeuh thumanlo uh ahih manin, a nai a gamla gam tuamtuamah na thehthangzo hi.
Ka kumpite uh, ko hong ukte, leh ka pu ka pate uh a zumhuai-in gamta uh a, a hong uk Topa nangma tungah hong khial khin uh hi.
{ Topa } Pasian aw, na nasem kamsangte tung tawnin kote' zuih ding thukhamte nong piak hangin, tua thu ka mang tuan kei uh hi.
Israel-te khempeuh in na gensa thute leh na thukhamte khempeuh a palsat khinzo uh hi. Na tungah khialhna ka hong bawl manun, na nasem Moses' thukham sunga kigelh bangin kote' tungah samsiatna a hong tung hi.
Na gensa bangin kote tung leh ko hong ukte tungah na hong bawlzo hi. Leitunga om khuapi dang khatpeuh sangin Jerusalem khuapi a nasia zaw-in gim na pia hi.
Moses' thukham sunga kigen gimna khempeuh ka thuak uh hi. { Topa } Pasian aw, tu nangawnin zong nang kong lungdamsakna ding uh hanciam loin, na thuman ka zuih theihna dingun mawhna ka kisik kei uh hi.
{ Topa } Pasian aw, nangmah in kote gim a pia dingin nong kithawi a, na hong pia takpi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh na hihna khempeuh a thuman hi a, kote in na thu ka hong mang kei uh hi.
"Kote' Topa Pasian aw, na mihingte Egypt gam panin na hong lakhia a, na vangliatna tudongin kiphawk lai hi. Ka mawh khin uh a, ka khial khin uh hi.
Nang na siangtho hi. Tua ahih ciangin Jerusalem tungah hong heh nawn peuhmah kei in. Tua pen na khuapi hi a, na mual siangtho ahi hi. Kote leh ka pate uh khialhna leh gitlohna hangin, ka kiim ka pam uha mite khempeuh in Jerusalem leh na mite a hong simmawh uh hi.
Pasian aw, kong thungetna leh kong thumna hong za in. A kisiasa na biakinnpi hong puahkik in. Mi khempeuh in nangmah Pasian na hihlam a theihtheihna dingun hong puahkik in.
Pasian aw, kong thungetnate uh hong ngai in la hong za in. Hong en in la, kote' siatna leh na min a pua khuapi a siatna hong mu in. Kote' gamtatna pha a suang hiloin nangma migitna suangin thu ka hong ngen uh hi.
{ Topa } aw, kong thungetna uh hong za in la, ka mawhna uh hong maisak in. { Topa } aw, hong ngai in la hong sem in! Mi khempeuh in Pasian na hihlam a hong theihna dingun hong zekai kei in. Hih khuapi leh hih mite na neihsa ahi hi," ka ci hi.
Keima mawhna leh ka mipih Israel-te' mawhna pulakin, ka { Topa } Pasian kiangah a biakinn siangtho a hong puahkikna dingin thumin ka ngenngen hi.
Thu ka nget laitakin ka maangmuh masak sunga ka muh mipa Gabriel, ka omna munah a hong lengsuk hi. Tua hun pen nitak lam biakpiak hun laitak ahi hi.
"Na mite leh khuapi siangtho, a mawhna leh a gamtat khialhnate a beina ding hun kum sawmsagih mun sagih sung a kisehzo hi. Tua ciangin mawhna kimaisak ding a, a tawntung thutang thu a hong tung ding hi. Genkholhna leh maangmuhna thu a mantakin hong tangtung ding a, a Siangtho Pen Mun biakinnpi kisian'suah ding hi.
Hih thu ciamteh in la thei in: Jerusalem lamkikna ding thu a kipiak huna kipan sathau kinilhpa hong pai dong kum sagih mun sagih sung hi ding hi. Jerusalem kongzing lampi nei leh kulhpi nei-in kilamkik ding a, kum sawmguklenih mun sagih sung kip ding a, ahih hangin buai hun sung ahi ding hi.
Tua hun a bei khit ciangin sathau kinilhpa thuman lopi-in a kithat ding hi. Galsim dingin a hong pai galkapmang lianpa in khuapi leh biakinnpi a susia ding hi. A beina pen tuiciin tun' bang hi ding a, a tawp dongin galdona leh kisiatna vive ahi dingin Pasian in thu a khenzo hi.
Tua makaipa in mi tampite tawh kum sagih sung thuciamna kip bawl ding uh hi. Gangawh biakna leh biakpiakna, hih hunlang sung a khawlsak ding hi. Biakinn dawn sangpen munah a Lipkhaphuai na kikoih ding hi; ahi zongin Pasian in tua a koihpa' thuak dingin a geelsa thu a koihpa in a thuak hun ciangdong, a Lipkhaphuai na pen a koihna mun mahah omlai phot ding hi," hong ci hi.
Sairas, Persia gam kumpi a suahzawh kum thum a pak laitakin Beteshazzar zong a kici Daniel tungah thu khat a kipia hi. Tua thu pen theihtelhak mahmah ahih manin maangmuhna tawh teltakin a kilak hi.
Tua kum a kha masa, ni sawmnihleli ni-in Tigris gunpi gei-ah ka ding hi.
A pumpi, suangmanpha tawh kibangin a taang hi. A maitang, khuaphialep bangin taang a, a mittangte mei bangin a kuang zalzal hi. A ban leh a khete sumngo zutsiang bangin te daldal hi. A aw, mihonpi kiko tawh kibangin a ging zuazua hi.
Tua laitakin ka khut khatin hong phongto a, ka khut leh ka khukin ka thoto a, ling kankan kawmin ka om hi.
Amah in, "Daniel aw, Pasian in nang hong it hi. Ding in la kong thugente limtakin ciamteh in. Na kiangah thu a gen dingin kei hong kisawlzo hi," a hong ci hi. Amah in hih thuteng a hong gen khit ciangin ling kankan kawmin ka ding hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Daniel aw, lau kei in. Kiniamkhiat dingin na lungsim na khensat masak pen ni-a kipan, tua thu na theihtheihna dingin Pasian in na thungetna a hong zazo hi. Na thungetna bang a hong pia dingin ka hong pai hi.
Persia gam a cing vantung mi in ni sawmnihlekhat sung kei a hong nial hi. Tua ciangin kei a hong huh dingin vantung mi thupite khat ahi Mikhael a hong pai hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Persia gamsungah keimah guak bek ka om hi.
Mailam hunah na mipihte' tunga hong tung ding thu a hilhkhol dingin a hong pai ka hi hi. Hih pen mailama hong piang lai ding maangmuhna ahi hi," a hong ci hi.
Amah in hih thu a hong gen ciangin kei bangmah pau theiloin lei ka ensuk gega mawk hi.
Tua ciangin pasal mel tawh a kibang mi khat thakhatin ka mai-ah hong om a, ka muk a hong lawn'sak hi. Tua ciangin thugen dingin ka kisa hi. Ka mai-a a dingpa kiangah, "Topa aw, ka maangmuhna in ka tha hong zawsak lua ahih manin ka ci-lin' a pha thei kei hi.
Amah in, "Lunghimawh kei in la, lau kei in. Kihangsak in. Pasian in nang hong it hi," a hong ci hi. Tuateng a hong gen khit ciangin ka tha hong khauhzaw a, "Topa aw, na gen ding peuhpeuh hong gen in; tu-in ka ci a hong damzaw diak hi," ka ci hi.
Amah in, "Bang hangin na kiangah hong pai ka hi hiam, cih na thei hiam? Thuman Laibu sungah a kigelh thute a lak dingin a hong pai ka hi hi. Tu-in ciahkikin, Persia gam a cing vantung mi tawh ka kido ding hi. Tua khit ciangin Grik gam a cing vantung mi a hong kilang ding hi. Mikhael longal kei a hong huh ding kuamah a om kei hi.
Israel a cing vantung mi pen kei hong huhpa leh a hong dalpa ahi hi," a hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, "Tu-a na tunga kong gen ding thu, a thuman ahi hi. Kumpi thum in Persia gam uk lai ding a, tua banah a lina hong khang ding hi. Tuapa, a dangteng sangin a hauzaw ding hi. Amah in a hauh penpen laitak leh a thahat pen laitakin Grik kumpi a to ding hi.
Kum sauvei sim khit ciangin Egypt kumpipa in a kipawlkhawm theihna dingin Syria kumpipa leh ama tanu a kitengsak ding hi. Ahih hangin tua kipawlkhawmna kiplo ding a, tua numei leh a tonpih a silate leh a ta leh a pasal a kithatlum ding hi.
"A sawtloin tua numei' behte khat in Syria kumpi sim ding a, a kulhpi sungah tumin amaute a zogawp ding hi.
Amah in amaute' milim pasian-te leh a na manpha ngun leh khamte Egypt gamah a pua ding hi. Kum tawmvei sung bek kilemna a om ding hi.
Syria kumpipa in Egypt gam sim ding a, ahih hangin zo zoloin a nungkik ding hi.
A galhatna hang leh galkap tampi a thahna hangin kisathei mahmah ding a, ahih hangin a gualzo tawntung kei ding hi.
Syria kumpipa khatvei kuankikin a masa sangin galkap a tamzaw a kaikhawm ding hi. A hun kicingta a sak ciangin galkap tampi leh galhiam kicing pikpek tawh a kuankhia ding hi.
"Tua hun ciangin mi tampi tak in Egypt kumpipa a lehdo ding uh hi. Daniel' mipihte ahi, mihoihlo pawlkhat in zong a muhsa uh maangmuhna hangin a lehdo ding uh a, ahih hangin a guallel ding uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Syria kumpipa in kulhpi tawh a kiumcih khuapite luhzo-in a la khin ding hi. Egypt galkapte in gal dosuakzo nawnlo ding uh a, galkap thahat pente a thanem ding uh hi.
Galdozo ding om nawnlo uh ahih manin a galte uh a utut-in a gamta ding uh hi. Thuciam Gamah zong lutin a khutsungah tua gam a om ding hi.
"Syria kumpipa in a galkap neih khempeuh zangin galsim ding a ngaihsun ding hi. Olno takin a gualzawh theihna dingin a tanu leh a galte ten'sak ding a ngaihsun ding hi. Ahih hangin a tangtungzo kei veve ding hi.
Tua khit ciangin tuipi tung tawnin minam dangte sim ding a, tampi tak mah a zo ding hi. Ahih hangin gamdang makai khat in amah zogawp ding a, a minthan'na teng a beisak ding hi.
"Tua ciangin kumpi dang khat in ama nung hong zuikik leuleu ding a, a gamsung khan'tohna dingin phiangsiah tampi a dong dingin mi khat a sawl ding hi. Tawlno khat khit ciangin tua kumpipa kithatlum ding a, ahih hangin galsunga si ahi kei ding hi.
"Ama zomah Syria kumpi ding pen migilo, kumpi dingin a kilawmlo mi khat ahi ding hi. Ahih hangin amah pen thakhat thu-in zuausiamna tawh kumpi a hong suakvat ding hi.
Ama thu a nial galkap honpite leh Pasian' siampi liante khempeuh a mangthangsak ding hi.
Amah in a pu a pate' hih ngeiloh, gam hau, gam kilemte nangawn a sim ding hi. Tua ciangin galsunga a lak vante leh nate a nungzuite tawh a hawm ding uh hi. Amah in galdalna kulhpite khempeuh luh ding hanciam ding a, ahih hangin tawmvei sung bek hun a nei ding hi.
"Egypt gam hangtakin a sim theih-na dingin galkap tampi a kaikhawm ding hi. Egypt-te in zong galkap tampi tawh nasia takin a na do ding uh hi. Ahi zongin Egypt kumpipa in khemna thuak ding ahih manin gal a zo kei ding hi.
Ama muan' pen a thudot mipilte in amah lehbawlin a siasak ding uh hi. A galkapte tampi tak si ding ahih manin gal a lel ding hi.
Tua kumpite gel in sabuai khat tungah tu-in an a nekhawm ding uh hi. Ahih hangin a ngaihsutna uh a hoihzawsang om tuanlo ahih manin a kikhem tuak ding uh hi. A hun tung nailo ahih manin a deih bang uh a ngahzo kei uh hi.
A galkapte pawlkhat in biakinnpi leh biakinnpi huang a ninsak ding uh hi. Amaute in nisim biakpiaknate khawlsak ding uh a, a Lipkhaphuai na a suang ding uh hi.
Kumpipa in tua biakna a nusia mite a thuzawh theihna dingin zuaugen siamna a zang ding hi. Ahih hangin Pasian' nung a zui mite ahih uh leh thahatin a gualzo ding uh hi.
Pilna a nei mite in a pilna uh midang tampite tawh a neikhawm ding uh hi. Ahih hangin tawlkhat sung mi pawlkhat in galsunga sihna leh meikuang sunga thahna a thuak ding uh hi. Mi pawlkhatte in lawkgawpna leh thongkiatna a thuak ding uh hi.
Tua bangin thahna a thuak laitakun, pawlkhat in huhna a ngah ding uh hi. Mi tampi in huhna a piak uh hangin amau' metna ding ngaihsutna bek ahi hi.
Mi pawlkhat in thahna a thuak ding uh hi. Tua bangin a pian'na thu pen beina a tun' mateng sian'thosakna leh mipha leh misia khentelna, Pasian' sehsa hun a tun'na ahi hi.
Kumpipa in a pu a pate' biak pasian leh numeite in a it pasian a thusim kei ding hi. Pasian a kici peuhmah khat beek a thusim kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh tuate sangin amah a lianzaw-in a kingaihsun hi.
Tua pasian-te sangin kulhpi a dal pasian a thupisim zaw ding hi. Amah in kham, ngun, suangmanpha, leh a thupi letsongte, a pu a pate' biak ngeiloh pasian kiangah a pia ding hi.
"Syria kumpipa' hun a bei dektak ciangin, Egypt kumpipa in amah a sim ding hi. Syria kumpipa in a thaneihteng sitloin tuikhang bangin sakol tawh, sakol galkapte tawh, teembaw tampi tawh Egypt a do ding hi.
Amah in Thuciamna Gam zong sim ding a, mi tul tampi tak a that ding hi. Ahih hangin Edom gam, Moab gam, leh Ammon gamsungah a omlai sunteng a suakta ding uh hi.
Amah in Egypt gamsunga kisel ngun leh kham leh a neihsa uh na manphateng khempeuh a la ding hi. Amah in Libya leh Ethiopia gam zong a zo ding hi.
Tua ciangin, nisuahna lam leh saklam panin thupiang in amah patausak ding a, thangpaihna tawh galdoin mi tampi tak a that ding hi.
Amah in a kumpi puanbuk lianpite biakinn din'na mualtung leh tuipi kikalah a lam ding hi. Ahih hangin amah a si ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amah a huh ding kuamah a om kei hi," a hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin saihadial puan a silh vantung mi in, "Na mite a cing, a lian vantung mi Mikhael hong kilang ding hi. Tua ciangin leitungah mihing a pian'zawha kipan a nasia penpen gimna hun hong tung ding hi. Tua hun a hong tun' ciangin Pasian' laibu sungah a min a kigelh na mite khempeuh kihonkhia ding hi.
A sisa mi tampite in nuntakna a ngahkik ding uh hi. Pawlkhatte nungta tawntung ding uh a, pawlkhatte in a tawntung zumna leh minsiatna a ngah ding uh hi.
A pilte ahih uh leh vantung khuavak tawh a taangkhawm ding uh hi. A pha-in gamtat ding mi tampi a hilhte pen aksi bangin a taang tawntung ding uh hi.
Tu-in Daniel aw, beina hun a tun' mateng laibu khupcip in la, a tungah ciamtehna koih in. A kallakah mi tampite in bang thu piang hiam cih theitel nuamin a hanciam ding uh hi," a hong ci hi.
Tua mite khat in puanpak silh a, gungal a gamlazaw deuhin a dingpa kiangah, "Hih na lamdangte a beina ding bang tanvei sawt ding ahi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Puanpak silhpa in a khutte gel vantung lamah lamto-in, Tawntung Pasian' min tawh thuciamna a bawl hi. Amah in, "Kum thum leh alang hi ding hi. Pasian' mite a kibawlsiatna a bei ciangin hih thute khempeuh hong piang ding hi," ci-in a gen ka za hi.
Amah in, "Daniel aw, tu-in ciah in; bang hang hiam cih leh hih thute pen beina hun a tun' mateng selcipin ipcip ding ahi hi.
Mi tampite kisian'suahin a hoih leh a hoihlo a kikhentel ding uh hi. Migilote in bangmah theitel theilo uh ahih manin a gilo semsem ding uh hi. Ahih hangin mipilte in theihtel theihna a nei ding uh hi.
Amaute in nisim biakpiakna a khawlsak, a Lipkhaphuai na a hong pian' ciangin ni tul khat zanih sawmkua sung a sawt ding hi.

Nang Daniel na hih leh a tawpdong muan'huai takin om in. Tua ciangin na si ding a, ahi zongin hun a bei ciangin thaman a sang dingin na hingkik ding hi," a hong ci hi.
Judah kumpite Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, leh Israel kumpi Joash' tapa Jeroboam' hun lai-in Beeri' tapa Hosea tungah { Topa } in thu na gen hi.
{ Topa } in Hosea tung tawnin Israel-te tungah thu a na gencil lai-in, amah in Hosea kiangah, "Hih gammite kei tungah citakloin pasian dangte bia uh ahih manin, nang zong hong tulpihlo ding numei paktat khat ten'pih in la, tuanu tawh ta nei in," a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Hosea in zong Diblaim' tanu Gomer ten'pih a, tuanu hong gai-in tapa khat hong nei hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in Hosea kiangah, "Na tapa' min dingin Jezreel phuak in; bang hang hiam cih leh ama pute Jehu in Jezreel khua-ah a mi thahna hangin Israel kumpipa tungah gim ka pia baih ding a, Israel mite tungah Jehu' suanlekhakte' ukna ka beisak ding hi.
Tua ciangin Gomer gaikikin tanu khat nei hi. { Topa } in zong Hosea kiang-ah, "Na tanu' min dingin hehpihloh, a cihnopna Loruhamah phuak in; bang hang hiam cih leh Israel mite ka hehpih nawn kei ding a, a mawhna uh ka maisak het kei ding hi.
Ahi zongin Judah mite ka hehpih ding a, namsau leh thal, sakol leh sakol tung tuangte, leh galsimna tawh hiloin, amaute' { Topa } Pasian ahi keimahmah in amaute ka honkhia ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin { Topa } in, "Na tapa' min dingin ka mi hilo a cihnopna Loammi phuak in; bang hang hiam cih leh no Israel mite, ka mi na hi nawn kei uh a, kei zong note' Pasian ka hi kei hi," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin, tehzawhloh, sim-zawhloh zah dongin tuipi sehnel bangin Israel mite tampi pha ding uh a, tua hunin, "Note ka mi hilo," a kicih hangin ni khat ni ciangin, "A nungta Pasian' tate," kici ding hi.
Judah mite leh Israel mite kigawmkik ding uh a, amaute a makai dingin mi khat a seh ding uh hi. Amaute khangin citheikik ding uh a, tua Jezreel hun pen a nuam mahmah hun hi ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin na Israel mipihte, "Pasian' mi," ci in la, "{ Topa } in a hehpih mite," zong ci in.
Tate aw, na nu uh zolbawl un. Amah ka zi hi nawnlo a, kei zong ama pasal ka hih nawnloh hangin a paktatna leh midang tawh a mawhnate a khawlna dingin zol un.
A gamtat hoihlohna a khawl kei leh, a nu sung pan a suah laitakin a guaktangin a ommah bangin, a puanteng hawkkhiatsakin a guaktangin ka omsak ding a, a keu, bangmah a po zawhlohna gamlak bangin ka bawl ding a, dangtakin a si ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah a paikhiat zawhlohna dingin ling ka kaihnelh ding a, a kimkotah kulh ka ciang ding hi.
Amah in a pasal dangte delh ding a, ahi zongin amaute kiang tung zolo ding hi. Amah in amaute zong niloh ding a, ahi zongin mu zolo ding hi. Tua ciangin amah in, "Ka pasal masa kiangah ciahkik ning; tu-a bangin ka om sangin ama kiang nuamzaw ding hi," a ci ding hi.
Ama tungah an, leenggahzu, leh oliv thau ka piakna, leh Baal pasian biakna dingin a zat ngun leh kham tampi tak a piapa ka hihlam hong phawkkhalo hi.
Tua ahih manin anlak hun ciangin ama tungah ka piak ngei an leh leenggahzute ka pia nawn kei ding a, a silh dingin ka piak samul puan leh saihadial puante ka pia nawn kei ding hi.
Tua ciangin ama it pasal dangte' muhna-ah a puante hawkkhiatsakin a guaktangin ka omsak ding a, kuamah in kei' khutsung panin honkhia zolo ding hi.
Ka pasal it dangte in thamanin hong piak hi, ci-in a gen a leengguite leh a theikungte ka susia ding a, gamsate in tuate suksiatsakin gamlakpi a suak ding hi.
Kei hong mangngilh tanvei sung, Baal pasian tungah paknamtui a hal tanvei sung, leh a pasal it dangte tawh a kikhawl dingin a manpha kizepna a tuamtuamte tawh a kizep hun tanvei sungzah mah gim ka pia ding hi.

amah in, "Kha lina, kha ngana, kha sagihna, leh kha sawmna sunga antan'nate pen, Judah gammite-a' dingin lungdamin kipakin pawi bawlna hun suak ta ding hi. Tua ahih manin thuman leh kilemna deih pha un," hong ci hi.

Zion mite aw, nakpi takin lungdam un. Jerusalem mite aw, lungdamin awng un. En un, na kumpipa uh hong pai hi. Amah, gualzawhna tawh hong pai hi. Ahi zongin kiniamkhiatna tawh hong pai a, sin nailoh lano tungah hong tuang hi.
Galkidona leengte Israel gam pan beisakin, sakol galkapte, Judah gam pan ka lakhia ding a, galdona-a kizang thalte kisusia ding hi. Na kumpipa un minam dangte lakah kilemna thu gen ding a, amah in tuipi mong khat pan tuipi mong khat dong, Eufratis Gunpi panin leimong dongin a uk ding hi.
Lametna a om no salte aw, ciahkik un la, a muan'huai mahmah na mun ngei uh zuankik un. Note' thuaknasa a zah nihin thupha ka hong piakna ding tuni-in note kiangah ka hong gen hi.
Grik mite, simna dingin Judah, thal bangin keekin, Israel thaltangin ka zang ding a, Zion mite, namsau-in ka zang ding hi.
Ama mite tungah { Topa } kilang ding a, a thaltang lotte khuaphia bang ding hi. Topa { Pasian } in peengkul tum ding a, leitaw lam panin a hong pai huihpi tawh a va kuankhia ding hi.
Vanglian { Topa } in ama mite hu ding a, ama mite in a galte uh susia ding hi. Galdona sungah zukham bangin awng gawp ding uh a, a galte uh' sisan luangsakgawp ding uh hi. Biakna site, biakna tau tungah hai-a sun tawh kibangin a luangsak ding uh hi.
Tuucingpa in a tuuhonte lauhuaina panin a hotkhiat bangin, tua ni ciangin { Topa, } amau' Pasian in a mite a honkhia ding hi. Kumpi lukhu tungah a om suangmanphate bangin ama gamsungah a mite taang ding uh hi.
Singkung lopa a sel hunin { Topa } kiang pan guah ngen un. Meii kaisakin, guah zusak a, ankung khempeuh a dumsakpa, { Topa } ahi hi.
Mihingte in milim peuh thudotin nei uh a, a thu ngahte uh zuauthu leh a mawkna hi lel hi. Mang khiathei-a kineite in lam lakkhial uh a, amau' hehnepnate a mawknapi hi lel hi. Tua ahih manin tuu bangin mite mangthang uh a, makai a neihloh manun gimna a ngah uh hi.
Ka mi a makaite tungah ka heh suak mahmah a, amaute gim ka pia ding hi. Judah mite pen Vanglian { Topa } ahi keima-a' hi a, amaute limtakin kemin, ka sakol galkap thahatte a suak ding uh hi.
Kongzing buannawng lakah a galte uh a tuancilgawp galkapte bangin amaute gualzo ding uh a, { Topa } in a ompih manin amaute in gal a sim uh ciangin a galte' sakol galkapte zogawp ding uh hi.
Judah mite ka thahatsak ding a, Israel mite ka honkhia ding hi. Amaute ka khasiat ding a, inn-ah ka ciahpih ding hi. Amaute cikmah hunin ka nial ngeiloh bang keekin nuamtakin a om ding uh hi. Kei pen { Topa, } amau' Pasian ka hi a, amau' thungetnate ka pia ding hi.
Israel mite, galkap hatte bang ding uh a, zukham lungnuam, bang ding uh hi. A suan a khakte un hih gualzawhna phawkin lungdam ding uh a, { Topa' } bawlna hangin kipak ding uh hi.
Minam dangte lakah amaute ka thehthang hangin a gamlapi panin kei hong phawk ding uh hi. Amaute leh a tate uh suakta-in, a vekpi-un inn zuanin hong ciahkhawm ding uh hi.
Egypt leh Assiria gam panin amaute ka ciahpih kik ding a, a gam a lei uhah ka tengsak ding hi. Gilead gam leh Lebanon gamah zong ka tengsak ding a, gam khempeuhah mi a dim ding hi.
Ka mite ka thahatsak ding a, amaute in kei hong bia-in ka thu hong mang ding uh hi, { Topa } in ci hi.

Tuu summeet bawlte in kei hong cial uh a, a kigo ding tuute a cingpa ka suak hi. Kei zong ciangkhut nih la-in khat pen "Hehpihna" ci-in min ka phuak a, a khat pen "Kipawlna" ci-in min ka phuak hi. Tua hi a, tuute a cingin kei ka om hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong tuuhonte kiangah, "Note ka hong cing nawn kei ding hi. A si dingteng si un la, a kisusia dingteng siacip un. A omlaisun teng khatlekhat kisanek un," ka ci hi.
Tua ahih manin tua ni-in thuciamna kiphiat hi. Tuu summeet bawlte in hong en giaugiau uh a, hih banga ka gamtatna panin { Topa' } thugen ahihlam a phawk uh hi.

Vanpi zalin leitung piangsak a, mihingte tungah nuntakna a pia { Topa } in Israel mite tawh kisai-in thu gen a,

Ahi zongin note in keima biakna tau bangmah a man neiloin genin, tua biakna tau tunga na piak uh ante na thupi ngaihsutloh uh ciangin, keimah a hong simmawh na hi uh hi.

Na gamtatna uh tawh kei nong zahtak ding uh hi.
