Tua ahih ciangin tuni-in hingin, a zing ciang mahin meikhukah a kikhultum lel hih gamlak lopate Pasian in puansilh guan' ahih leh note hong lim guatzaw ding ahih manin na upna uh a neu mahmah ahi hi.
Thudang khempeuh sangin Pasian' ukna leh ama deihna na zuih theihna ding uh thupi ngaihsut masazaw un. Tua hi leh hih na kisapna dangte khempeuh uh zong hong piathuah veve ding hi.
"Tua ahih manin zing ciang huna ding ma lungkham masa kei un. Zing ciang thu ding ama thu-in omsak lel un. Tuni thu pen tuni thu mah tawh beisak un la, lungkham ding behlap se kei un.
"Pasian in note hong mawhsak lohna dingin midangte va mawhsaksak nawn kei un.
"Uite tungah a siangtho nate pia kei un. Pia le uh cin hong pet zawsop ding hi. Vokte mai-ah na suangmanphate uh lot kei un. Lot le uh cin sikcip lel ding uh hi.
"Ngen un; na nget uh leh hong kipia ding hi. Zong un; na zon' uh leh na mu ding uh hi. Kongkhak na kiu un; na kiuh uh leh hong kihon ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh a ngente khempeuh in ngah ding uh a, a zongte khempeuh in mu ding uh a, a kiute khempeuh-a' ding kong kihon ding hi.
Note mihoihlo hinapi-in na tate uh tungah na hoih piakding ngaihsun thei na hih uh leh vantungah a om na Pa un a ngen mite tungah na hoihte hong piazaw mahmah ding hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ahih manin note tungah hong kibawl ding na deih bangun midangte tungah na bawl un. Moses Thukhamte leh kamsangte' thuhilhnate pen hih mah a deihna ahi hi.
"Kong kawcik bek tawnin lut un. Hell khuk tun'na ding kongvang pen lianin a lampi baih a, mi tampi in a zui uh hi.
Ahi zongin nuntak tawntungna tun'na ding kong kawcikin a lampi haksa a, mi tawmno bek in a zuizo uh hi.
Amaute' gamtatna tawh amau' pianzia na thei ding uh hi. Lingvom kung panin leenggah kilo ngeilo a, sialtalling kung panin theigah kilo ngei ahi hiam?
Singkung cidamte in gah ginalo gah ngeilo a, singkung ginalote in gah limci gah ngeilo hi.
Gah limci a gahlo singkungte kiphukin meikhuk sungah kikhul hi.
"Kei kiangah, 'Topa, Topa aw,' hong ci mi khempeuh, vantung ki-ukna sungah lutthei kimlo ding uh a, vantungah a om ka Pa' deihna bangin a gamtateng bek lutthei ding uh hi.
Tua ni ciangin mi tampi in kei kiangah, 'Topa, Topa aw, nangma min tawh thu hilhin, nangma min tawh dawite hawlkhia-in, nangma min tawh na lamdang lian tampi bawl hilo ka hi uh hiam?' hong ci ding uh hi.
"Ka thuhilhna za-in a zui mi khempeuhte pen suang tungah a inn a lam mipilpa tawh kibang ding hi.
Hih ka thugente za napi-in a zui nuamlote pen sehnel tungah a inn a lam mihaipa tawh kibang ding hi.
Amah in Thukham hilh siate bangin thu genloin, aana neite bangin thu a genzaw hi.
Tua laitakin miphak khat hong pai-in ama mai-ah hong khukdin' a, "Topa aw, nong damsaknop nak leh nong damsak thei ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in ama kiangah, "Hih thupiang kuama kiangah gen masa loin siampipa kiangah va paisuak pahin va kivelsak in la, na damkhitna thu mi khempeuh in a theihna dingin Moses thupiakna tawh kizui-in biakna va pia in," ci-in a vaikhak hi.
Kapernaum khua a tun' ciangin Rom mi galkapbu khat ama kiangah hong pai-in,
"Topa aw, ka nasempa cina-in inn-ah lupna ngakin om a, gim mahmahin tangzo hetlo ahih manin hong damsak in," ci-in a thum hi.
Ahi zongin galkapbupa in, "Topa aw, keima inn-ah nangpipi nong pai dingin kilawmlo ka hih manin a damna dingin thu pia lel lecin zong ka nasempa dam ding hi.
Jesuh in hih bupa thugen a zak ciangin lamdangsa a, amah a zui mihonte kiangah, "A mantaka kong genin-ah Israel mite lak nangawnah hih bang upna a nei ka mu nai kei hi.
Nisuahna leh nitumna panin mi tampi tak hong pai-in vantung ki-ukna sungah Abraham, Isaac, leh Jakob-te tawh an ne-in sabuai-ah tukhawm ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin vantung ki-ukna sungah a om dingin a kingaihsun Israel mite ahih leh pualam khuamialna-ah kilawnkhia ding a, tua lai-ah kapin a hagawi ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in galkapbupa kiangah, "Na inn-ah ciah in. Na up bangin hong piang ding hi," a ci hi. Tua hun laitak teek mahin a nasempa a dam hi.
Jesuh in ama khut va lawn'sak hi. A natna dampah a, amah zong tho-in a zinte a dozo pah hi.
Kamsang Isaiah in, "Amah in eite' natna teng thuakin, eite' gimna teng puakhia hi," ci-in a genna thu a tun'na dingin hih bang a piang ahi hi.
Jesuh in, "Ngiate in lupna ding kua nei uh a, vasate in zong giahna ding bu nei uh hi. Ahi zongin Mihing Tapa in a luptheihna ding mun koimahah neilo hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin amah a zui midang khat in, "Topa aw, kei hong ciahsak in la, ka pa hong vuisak masa in," a cih leh
Jesuh in, "Nangmah in kei hong zui in la, misi bang ahi mite in misite a vui dingun nusiat in," ci-in a dawng hi.
Gunkuang tungah Jesuh a tuan' ciangin a nungzuite in zong a zui uh hi.
Jesuh in, "Bang hangin tuaci lau na hi uh hiam? Na upna uh neu mahmah hi," a cih khit ciangin tho-in huihpi leh tuihualte thu pia a, a dai dide pah hi.
A nungzuite in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, "Huihpi leh tuihualte nangawn in ama thu mang ahih manin hih mipa a bangci mi hi ding ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tuili galkhat, Gadara gam a tun' ciangin han panin dawivei mi nih hong paikhia-in Jesuh a na dawn uh hi. Tua mi nihte kihtakhuai mahmah ahih manin amaute omna lam tawnin kuamah pai ngamlo uh hi.
Amaute nakpi takin hong kiko uh a, "Pasian' Tapa aw, kote bang hong nuammawh na hi hiam? A hun tung nailopi-in kote gim a pia dingin hong pai na hi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Tua laitakin tua san panin a gamlalo mun khatah vok honpi gamta-in a om hi.
Tua vokcingte zong tai-in khuasung tuh uh a, tua dawivei mite' thu leh a thupiang khempeuh a gen uh hi.
Tua ciangin khuasung mi khempeuh, Jesuh kiangah hong pai-in amah a muh uh ciangin, amau gam panin a paikhiatna dingin a thum uh hi.
Mi pawlkhat in khutlekhezaw mi khat, a lupna pheek tawh hong pua-in Jesuh kiang a hong tun'pih uh hi. Jesuh in amaute' upna a muh ciangin a cina mipa kiangah, "Ka ta aw, na lungsim kinuamsak in; na mawhna hong kimaisak khinta hi," a ci hi.
'Na mawhna hong kimaisak hi,' cih ding leh, 'Tho in la pai in,' cih ding koi baihzaw ahi hiam? Kampau lel pen baih mahmah hi.
Ahi zongin Mihing Tapa in leitungah mawhmaisak theihna ding thu nei hi, ci-in na theihna dingun kong lak ding hi," a cih khit ciangin khutlekhezaw mipa kiangah, "Tho in; na lupna pheek pua in la na inn-ah ciah in," a ci hi.
Jesuh in Matthai' inn-ah nitak an a nek laitakin siahdong dangte leh thukham a khial midang tampite in zong Jesuh leh a nungzuite tawh an a nekhawm uh hi.
Farisi mite in hih thu a muh uh ciangin Jesuh nungzuite kiangah, "Bang hangin na siapa un siahdongte leh thukham khialte tawh an nekhawm ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.
Jesuh in hih thu a zak ciangin, "Cidamte in siavuan kisamlo uh a, cina mite bek in kisam uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh kiangah Tuiphumpa Johan' nungzuite hong pai uh a, "Bang hangin kote leh Farisi mite in an tang zelzel napi-in, na nungzuite in tanglo se ahi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Mopina pawi khatah, a zineipa a om sungin a mopawi simte dah dingin um na hi uh hiam? Dah hetlo ding uh hi. Ahi zongin amaute kiang panin zineipa a kilakkhiat ding hun hong tung ding a, tua hun ciangin amaute in an a tang ding uh hi.
Kuamah in a ton nailo puanbek thak tawh puan lui a phop kei hi. Tua bangin phop leh puanbek thak a ton ciangin a lui kaigawmin a vang a gol semsem ding hi.
Kuamah in savun um lui sungah leenggahzu thak thunlo hi. Kithun leh a savun um phukham ding a, a leenggahzu bua-in a savun um zong a sia a suak ding hi. Leenggahzu thak pen savun um thak sungah kithun bek hi. Tua ahih manin a nihin a sia omlo hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua bangin Jesuh in thu genin a om laitakin Jesuh kiangah Jew mi ulian khat hong pai-in ama mai-ah hong khukdin' a, "Tu mahmahin ka tanu a si hi. Ahi zongin nang hong pai-in ama tungah na khut hong nga lecin amah hingkik ding hi," ci-in a thum hi.
Tua laitakin kum sawmlenih tawntung a si a luang numei khat Jesuh' nungah hong pai-in a puan mongteep a lawngsim hi.
Jew mi ulianpa' inn-ah Jesuh a tun' ciangin tamngai tum mite leh mihonpi a gamlum henhan a muh ciangin,
"Na vekpi-un paikhia un. Hih numeino a si hilo a, a ihmu bek ahi hi," a ci hi. Ahi zongin amaute in Jesuh zahpihin a nuihsan uh hi.
Tua lai panin Jesuh a paikhiat ciangin mittaw mi nih in a nungah hong zui-in nakpi takin kiko uh a, "David' suan Jesuh aw, kote hong hehpih in," ci-in a thum uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in khua mukik uh a, Jesuh in amaute gel kiangah, "Hih thupiang kuamah theisak kei un," ci-in khauh takin a gen hi.
Ahi zongin amaute paikhia uh a, tua gamsung khempeuhah hih thu a zasak uh hi.
Tua mi nihte a paikhiat laitakun mi pawlkhat in dawi a veina hangin a pautheilo mi khat, Jesuh kiangah a hong paipih uh hi.
Ama sung panin dawi a kihawlkhiat khit phetin tua mipa hong pautheikik pah hi. Mihonpite in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, "Israel gamsungah hih bang thu piang ngei nailo hi," a ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin Farisi mite in, "Dawimang lianpenpa min tawh hih bangin dawi a hawlkhia ahi hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua bangin khuapite leh khuaneute-ah Jesuh pai kawikawi a, a kikhopna uh innte-ah thu hilhin, Pasian' ukna hangin a lungdamhuai thute gen a, natna nam khempeuh a damsak hi.
Mihonte a muh ciangin, a cing neilo tuuhon bangin gimna ngahin lungkhamin om uh ahih manin hehpihhuai a sa hi.
Tua ahih manin ama an a la dingin annei Topa in nasem tampi hong sawlna dingin thu ngen un," a ci hi.
Jesuh in a nungzui sawmlenihte sam a, dawite a hawlkhiat theihna ding uh leh natna nam khempeuh a damsak theihna dingun amaute tungah vangliatna a pia hi.
Tua sawltak sawmlenihte' min in: A masa-in Simon (Peter zong a kicipa) leh a naupa Andru, Zebedi' tapa James leh a naupa Johan,
Filip leh Bartholomew, Thomas leh siahdongpa Matthai, Alfeas' tapa James, Thaddeas,
Simon (gam khualpa), leh Jesuh a lehhek Iskariot' tapa Judas ahi uh hi.
Jesuh in hih mi sawmlenihte sawl a, "Gentail mite gamsung ahi a, Samaria mite khuasungah ahi zongin lut kei un.
Cinate damsakin, misite hingsakin, miphakte damsakin, dawite va hawlkhia un. Man piak kulloin hih vangliatna na ngah uh bangin hih vangliatna na zatna uhah zong man va ngen kei un.
Khualzinna-ah an ngenin puakna ding ip ahi a, khedap ahi a, ciangkhut ahi zongin keng kei un la, puanak zong a val kengthuah kei un. Nasem mite pen amau sapnateng mite in a piak ding a ngeina ahi hi.
"Khuapi ahi a, khuaneu ahi zongin khua khat peuhpeuh na tun' uh ciangin tua khuasungah note zin hong tungsak nuam kua om ahi hiam, ci-in zong un la, na muh uh ciangin tuate' inn-ah tungin, tua khua na nusiat mateng uh tua lai mahah omsuak pah un.
Tua na hopihna uh innsunga mite in note hong tun'saknop leh na hopihna thupha uh amaute tungah kip ding a, ahi zongin hong tun'saknop kei uh leh na hopihna thupha uh na dokkik ding uh hi.
Inn khat peuhpeuh in ahi a, khua khat peuhpeuh in ahi zongin note hong tun'saknop kei a, na thugen uh hong ngaihnop kei leh tua lai panin paikhia un la, na khe uha leivui bangte sin'khiat un.
Thukhen ni ciangin tua khuamite' thuakna sangin Sodom khua leh Gomorrah khuamite' thuakna olzaw lai ding ahihna thu hoihtakin phawk un.
"Ngiahon lakah tuu a kikhah bangin note hong sawlkhia ka hih manin gul bangin pilvang un la, vakhu bangin migi un.
Mi pawlkhatte in note hong manin zumah hong paipih ding uh a, amaute' kikhopna innsungah hong satgawp ding uh ahih manin hoihtakin kidawm un.
Keima hangin gam ukte leh kumpite mai-ah thu hong kisit ding hi. Hih bang na tuah uh ciangin thu hong sit mite leh Gentail mite tungah Lungdamna Thu gentheihna ding hunhoih a nei na hi uh hi.
Tua bangin thusitna a thuak dingin hong kipaipih ciangin, bang gen ding ihi hiam, ci-in lunghimawh kei un. A hun a tun' ciangin na gending teng uh hong kihilh ding hi.
Thu na gen uh ciangin note' gen hiloin, na Pa uh' Kha Siangtho in note tung tawnin thu a gen ding ahi hi.
Unau leh unau, pa in a ta, tate in a nu a pate langpangin sihna a thuak dingin khatlekhat kiheek ding uh hi.
Keima hangin Gentail mi khempeuh in note hong mudah ding uh hi. Ahi zongin a tawpdongin a thuakzo mite in hotkhiatna a ngah ding uh hi.
"A siapa sangin a sang naupangte lianzaw ngeilo a, a topa sangin a silate lianzaw ngeilo hi.
Tua ahih manin sang naupangte pen a siapa uh tawh a kibat uh leh a lungkim ding uh hi a, silate pen a tote uh tawh a kibat uh leh a lungkim ding uh ahi hi. Innteek lutangpa pen Beelzebul hong ci uh ahih leh a innkuanpih mite tua sangin min siazaw tawh hong kozaw lai ding uh hilo ahi hiam?
Zan khuamial sunga kong gente, sun khuavak sungah taangko un la, a simthamin kong huau thute, innkhumdawn zangah na taangko un.
Pumpi a thah khit ciangin kha a that theilote na kihta kei un. Hell khuk sungah pumpi leh kha a nihin a susia theipa na kihtazaw un.
Gitta nih ciangin mat khatin kizuak lel hilo ahi hiam? Tua hinapi-in na Pa uh' thukim lohin tua gittate khat nangawn lei-ah mawkkiatlo hi.
Note ahih leh na lu tung uha na sammal phazah nangawn uh hong kiciamtehsak hi.
Ahi zongin keima mi ahihna thu mite' theihin a genkhia nuamlote, kei zong vantungah ka Pa' mai-ah keima mi ahihna thu ka genkhia nuam kei ding hi.
"Leitungah kilemna a omsak dingin hong pai hi, ci-in hong ngaihsun kei un. Kilemna a omsak dingin a hong pai ka hi kei a, kidona ding namsau a khah dingin a hong pai ka hizaw hi.
Tate leh pate a kidosak ding, tanute leh nute a kidosak ding, monute leh teeknute a kidosak dingin a hong pai ka hi hi.
Mi khat-a' dingin a gal lianpenpen ama innkuanpih mite mah hong hi ding hi.
"Kei sangin a nu a pa a itzawte kei tawh kilawmlo a, kei sangin a tapa a tanu a itzawte kei tawh kilawmlo hi.
Ama singlamteh mah puatawm lopi-in ka nung hong zuite kei tawh kilawmlo hi.
"Na thugen uh a hong sangte in kei' thu a hong sang hi a, kei a hong sangte in kei a hong sawlpa zong a sang ahi uh hi.
Keima nungzui mi a neupen khat nangawn, keima nungzui ahihna hangin tuivot hai khat bek a suahte nangawn in pelloin thaman a ngah ding lamtak phawk un," ci-in a vaikhak hi.
Jesuh in a nungzui sawmlenihte a vaikhakna a man khit ciangin tua kiimnai-a om khuate-ah thuhilh ding leh thugen dingin tua mun panin a paikhia hi.
"Nang pen a hong pai dingpa na hi hiam, tua ahih kei leh adang na lamen lai ding ka hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dongsak hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Va ciahkik un la, tu-a na zakte uh leh na muh uh thute va gen un:
Tua hilo ahih leh bang a mu dingin kilamen na hi uh hiam? Puan hoihnono a silhpa a mu dingin kilamen maw? A taktakin ci lehang, puan hoihnono a silhte pen kumpi innsungah om uh hi.
Tua ahih kei leh bang a en dingin pai na hi uh hiam? Kamsangpa a en ding maw? Hi hi; kamsangpa a en dingin na pai uh a, tua na muhpa uh kamsang mawkmawk ciang bek hiloin a lianzaw khat ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho in Johan' thu a genna-ah, 'Na paina ding lampi a hongkhol dingin nangma mai-ah ka kamtaipa ka sawl hi,' ci-in Pasian in gen hi, ci-in kigelh hi.
Tuiphumpa Johan' thuhilh huna kipan tu ciangdong, mite in vantung ki-ukna thu hong kituhteh gawp uh a, thahatthu hong ciam uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Tuiphumpa Johan thuhilh a kipat hun ciangdong, kamsangte khempeuh leh Moses Thukham khempeuh in hih vantung ki-ukna thu gen belin a nei uh hi.
Tua thu kigensa na upnop uh leh, a kigenkhol bangin a hong pai ding Elijah a kici pen Tuiphumpa Johan ahi hi.
'Lamna ding khuang kong tumsak uh hangin na lam nuam kei uh a, kah la ka sak uh hangin lah na kap nuam tuan kei uh hi,' a kicite tawh a kibang uh hi.
Mihing Tapa hong pai leuleu a, zune anne-in a om ciangin, 'Zuhai anhaipa; siahdongte leh midangte in a kikholhpih noploh mite tawh a kikhawlpa,' ci leuleu uh hi. Ahi zongin Pasian' pilna a man taktakna thu a gah panin hong kilang hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in na lamdang tampi a bawlna mun khuapi mite kisik nuamlo uh ahih manin taiibawl ding kipan a,
"Khorazin khuapi mite leh Bethsaida khuapi mite aw, gimna lianpi na thuak ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note khuasungah a hong kilak na lamdangte, Taia leh Sidon khuasungah kilak hi leh amaute in kisikna limin sawtpekin puanhampi silhin vut kinuh ding uh hi.
Tua ahih manin thukhen ni ciangin note' thuakna sangin, Taia leh Sidon khuamite' thuakna baihzaw lai ding ahihna thu phawk ta un.
Kapernaum khuapi mite aw, van a sangna munah hong kipahtawi ding sa na hi uh hiam? Hell khuk sungah hong kilawnsuk ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh note' khuasunga hong kibawl na lamdangte, Sodom khuasungah kibawl hi leh tuni dongin tua khua kip lai ding hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Vantung leh leitung Topa ahi ka Pa aw, mipilte leh misiamte tungah na ip hih thute, bangmah a theilo hih mite tungah lak na hih manin ka nuam hi.
Pa aw, hih pen nangma deihna leh na lungkimna bangin na hih ahi hi.
"Ka Pa in kei tungah na khempeuh hong pia khin hi. Pa simloh Tapa a thei kuamah omlo a, Tapa leh Tapa in a theihsaknop mite simloh, pa a thei kuamah omlo hi.
Keima hakkol zamin kisuan un la, kei kiangah hong kisin dih un. Kei pen kiniamkhiatin neem hithiat ka hih manin ka kiangah na tawl uh a dam ding hi.
Tua zawh a sawtloin Sabbath ni khatin mangbuh lo nawkin Jesuh a pai hi. A nungzuite a gil uh kial ahih manin mangbuhvuite zutin a ne uh hi.
Farisi mite in a muh uh ciangin Jesuh kiangah, "En in, Sabbath ni-in i hih dingin a kilawmlo gamtatna na nungzuite gamta uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "David leh a kikholhpihte a gilkial laitakun David' gamtatna thu sim ngeilo na hi uh hiam?
Pasian' innsungah amah lut a, siampite lobuang, amah leh a kikholhpihte in a nektheih ding a hilo Ompihna Anlum la-in amah leh a kikholhpihte in a ne uh hi.
Tua ahih kei leh zong siampite in Sabbath sim mahin biakinn sungah Sabbath thukham khial napi-in mawhsakna a ngah tuanlohna thu uh, Moses Thukham sungah sim ngeilo na hi uh hiam?
Lai Siangtho sungah, 'Ganhing tawh biak ding ka deih kei a, migitna ka deihzaw hi,' a cihnopna thu teltakin thei le uh cin a mawhlopi kimlai na mawhsak kei ding uh hi.
Tua lai panin Jesuh paisuakin amau kikhopna innsungah a lut hi.
Jesuh in amaute kiangah, "Note khatpeuh in tuu khat nei un la, Sabbath ni-in dum sungah tua tuu kia leh, tua tuu va lenin kaikhiato ding hilo na hi uh hiam?
Mi pen tuu sangin nakpi takin manphazaw ahih manin Sabbath ni-in a hoih sep ding a kilawm ahi hi," ci-in a dawn' khit ciangin
Ahi zongin Farisi mite paikhia uh a, Jesuh a thahtheihna ding uh vai a hawm uh hi.
Pasian in kamsang Isaiah tung tawnin a gen thu a tun'theihna dingin, kuama kiangah ama thu a genlohna dingun thu a pia hi. Tua a genna-ah,
"Keimah in ka teelsa ka nasempa, ka it mahmah, ka lungkimnapa en un. Keima Kha ama tungah ka pia ding a, Gentail mite tungah upna man a pulak ding hi.
Amah in thu seelloin, a aw sangsaklo ding a, konglakah zong a awging kizalo ding hi.
Amah in a zawngkhal mite dopbawl ding a, a cimawh mite tungah migi ding hi. Thuman thutang a gualzawhsak mateng khawl ngeilo ding hi.
Tua ciangin mi pawlkhat in Jesuh kiangah mittawt leh pau theihloh a thuah dawivei mi khat hong paipih uh hi. Jesuh in amah damsak ahih manin amah hong pauthei-in khua zong hong muthei hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh in lamdangsa mahmah uh a, "Hihpa, i lametet David' suan hilo ding ahi hiam?" a ci uh hi.

Tua mah bangin Satan leh Satan kihawlkhia le uh a ukna bangci kip theih ding ahi hiam?

'Hih mipa in inn lamding kipan napi-in zo zolo hi,' ci ding uh hi.

Kei hong itlote in ka thugente zuilo ding uh hi. Tu-a na zak uh thute pen keima thu hilo a, kei hong sawl Pa Pasian kiang panin a hong pai thu ahi hi.
"Note tawh ka hong omkhawm hunsungin hih thute a hong gen ka hi hi.
Ahi zongin Pa in keima tangin a hong sawl ding Huhpa Kha Siangtho a hong tun' ciangin note tungah thu khempeuh hong hilh ding a, note tungah ka hong gensa thu khempeuh zong hong phawksakkik ding hi.
Note tungah keima neih bang lungnopna ka hong pia ding hi. Tua ka hong piakding lungnopna pen leitung mite in a piaktheih a kiplo lungnopnate pawl hilo hi. Tua ahih manin lau kei un la, zong lungkham kei un.
'Ka va paikhia ding a, ahi zongin note kiangah ka hong paikik ding hi,' ka cihna thu na za khin uh hi. Kei sangin a lianzaw Pa Pasian kiangah a va pai ding ka hih manin kei na hong it nak uh leh ama kiangah ka paina hangin na nuamzaw ding uh hi.

Ahi zongin leitung mite in Pa Pasian ka itna thu a theihna dingun Pa' vaihawmna bangbangin a gamta ding ka hi hi. Tua ahih manin kithawi un; hih lai mun panin paikhia ta ni," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin Jesuh in, "Kei pen leenggui taktak ka hi a, ka Pa pen leenggui loneipa ahi hi.
Amah in gah a neilo ka hiang khempeuh satkhia a, gah a nei hiangte ahih leh a gah semsem theihna dingin a puah hi.
Kei tawh hong kizom paisuak le uh cin kei zong note tawh a kizom paisuak ka hi ding hi. A hiang pen a gui tawh kizom kei leh gah a gah theihloh mah bangin note zong kei tawh na kizop kei uh leh gah na gah thei kei ding uh hi.
"Kei pen leenggui ka hi a, note pen a hiang na hi uh hi. Note in kei tawh loin bangmah hih theilo ding na hih manun kei tawh a kizomte in gah tampi na gah ding uh hi.
Kei tawh a kizomlo mite pen leenggui hiang bangin kipai khia-in keutum hi. Tua bang hiangte meikhuk sungah kilawnin a kangtum hi.
Kei tawh na hong kizop uh a, note sungah ka thu a om nak leh na deih peuhpeuh uh hong ngen le uh cin hong kipia ding hi.
Gah tampi gah le uh cin ka Pa' minthan'na a kilangsak na hi ding uh a, keima nungzui na hihna uh kilang ding hi.
Ka Pa' hong thupiakte zui-in ama itna sungah ka om mah bangin note in zong ka thupiaknate na hong zuih uh leh ka itna sungah a om na hi ding uh hi.
Note hangin kei ka lungdam theihna ding leh note' lungdamna a cingtaak a suahtheihna dingin hih thute a hong gen ka hi hi.
Lawmte' tangding sih ngamna sangin lawmte itna a lianzaw om nawnlo hi.
Ka hong thupiak bangin na gamtat uh leh ka lawmte na hi uh hi.
Nasemte in a tote' nasepna bangmah theilo ahih manin note pen nasemte ka hong ci nawn kei ding hi. Ka Pa' tung panin ka zak thu khempeuh note kiangah hong genkhin ka hih manin note, lawm, ka hong ci zaw ding hi.
Hih leitung mite tawh a kipawl hi le uh cin leitung mite in amau pawlte hong it ding hi. Ahi zongin hih leitung mite lak panin note ka hong teelkhia a, amaute tawh kipawl nawnlo na hih manun a hong mudah ahi uh hi.
'Sila pen a topa sangin lianzaw lo hi,' ci-in ka hong thugenna phawk un. Amaute in kei hong bawlsiat uh leh note zong hong bawlsia ding hi. Ka thugente hong zuih uh leh note' thugente zong hong zui ding hi.
Ahi zongin amaute in kei hong sawlpa theilo uh ahih manin keima mi na hihna uh hangin amaute in hih bangin hong bawl ding uh ahi hi.
Kei hong pai kei-in amaute tungah thu a genlo hi leng amaute in mawh pualo ding uh hi. Ahi zongin tu-in ahih leh a mawhna thu uhah kiphelna ding a paulap ding uh bangmah om nawnlo hi.
Kuamah in a bawl ngeiloh na lamdangte amaute lakah a bawllo hi leng amaute in mawh pualo ding uh hi. Ahi zongin amaute in ka na lamdang bawlte mu khin uh ahih manin kei leh ka pa a hong mudah khawm uh ahi hi.

"Amaute-a' dingin thu ka hong ngetsak hi. Leitung mite-a' dingin a hong ngetsak hiloin keima khutsungah na hong piak mite nangma mi ahih manin tua mite-a' dingin a hong ngetsak ka hi hi.

Tu-in nangma kiangah kei a hong paita ding ka hih manin leitungah ka om nawn kei ding a, ahi zongin amaute a omlai ding uh ahi hi. Tua ahih manin a Siangtho ka Pa aw, nang leh kei pumkhat ihih mah bangin amaute zong pumkhat ahihna dingun na vangliatna tawh hoihtakin na kem in.

Galkapte in singlamteh tungah Jesuh a khai khit uh ciangin a puante la uh a, khenkhat ciatin a ngah dingun khen li a suah uh hi. Mong a neilo, a kiphan a puantualpi zong a la uh hi.

Tua ahih manin galkapte hong pai uh a, a tuah masakpa uh a khe a kuaihtansak khit uh ciangin a langkhata ompa-a' zong a kuaihtansak uh hi.

Lawm Theofilas aw, Lai ka hong gelh masakna sungah Jesuh in nasep a kipat tunga kipanin vantungah amah a kilaktoh hun ciangdong, a thuhilhna leh a septe khempeuh cingtakin ka gelh hi. Ama sawltak dingin a teelsa mite, Kha Siangtho tung tawnin thu a vaikhak khit ciangin vantungah amah kilato hi.

Johan in tui sungah mite phum a, ahi zongin a sawtloin Pasian in Kha Siangtho tawh note hong kidimsak ding hi," ci-in thu a pia hi.

Hih thu a genkhit ciangin amaute' muhtangpi mahin vanah Jesuh kilato a, meiipi in liah ahih manin amah mu thei nawnlo uh hi.
Jerusalem a tun' uh ciangin amauteng, Peter, Johan, James leh Andru, Filip leh Thomas, Bartholomew leh Matthai, Alfeas' tapa James, Simon (gam khualpa), leh James' tapa Judas a tun'na uh inn dei-ah a kahto uh hi.

"Lawmte aw, Jesuh a mante lam a lak Judas thu, Kha Siangtho in David' kam panin a genkholhna Lai Siangtho sung thu a tun'ding kisam hi.
"Bang hang hiam cih leh Late Laibu sungah, 'Ama ten'na mun gamdai hen la, tua munah kuamah teng kei hen,' kici a, tua banah, 'Ama nasep midang khat in sem ta hen,' ci-in kigelh hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin Topa Jesuh' thawhkikna thu teci pangin a hong genpih dingin Judas tangin mi khat i lakding kisam hi. Tua mipa pen Johan' tuiphum kipat huna kipanin Jesuh vanah a kilaktoh hun ciangdong, Jesuh' nasepna khempeuhah eite tawh a omkhawm mi khat ahih ding kisam hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Josef (min dang nih a nei, Barsabbas leh Justas zong a kicipa) leh Matthias a pulak uh hi.

Tua laitakin biakna pawi siim dingin gam tuamtuam panin a hong pai Jew mi biakna hahkat mi tampi tak, Jerusalem khuasungah a om uh hi.

Frigia gam, Pamfilia gam, Egypt gam, leh Sairin khuapi gei-a om Libya gamte pan ihi a, pawlkhatte Rom gam pan ihi hi.
Jew mite leh Gentail mi Jew biakna a zuite ihi a, pawlkhatte pen Krete gam leh Arabia gam pan ihi hi. Tua bang hinapi-in, Pasian' sep na lamdang liante a kigenna eima pau ciatin i za hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin sawltak sawmlekhatte tawh a omkhawm Peter hong dingto-in, mihonte tungah nakpi takin thu hong gen a, "Ka mipih ahi Jew mite leh Jerusalem khuasunga om mi khempeuhte aw, hih thupiang hong gen ding ka hih manin limtakin na ngai un.
Tuhun pen zingsang nai kua hi pan ahih manin, note' ngaihsut bangin hih mite zukham hilo uh hi.
'Pasian in hih bangin gen hi: Nitawp ni ciangin, mi khempeuh tungah ka Kha ka sung ding a, na tanute uh leh na tapate un keima thu taangko ding uh hi; na tangvalte un maang mu ding uh a, na puteekte un mang man ding uh hi.
Tua ni ciangin ka nasem numeite leh ka nasem pasalte' tung nangawnah ka Kha ka sung ding a, amaute in keima thu gen ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin vantung leh leitungah hilhkholhna lim leh na lamdang ka bawl ding hi. Sisan kiluan'sakna, meikatna leh meikhu sahpi hong om ding hi.
Topa' ni, a lian thupi ni, hong tun'ma-in ni hong mialin, kha, sisan hong bang ding hi.
"Ka mipih Israel-te aw, hih ka thugen na ngai un: Nazareth khuami Jesuh tung tawnin Pasian in lim leh na lamdangte bawlin na hong sem ahih manin, Jesuh pen Pasian' sawl nasem ahihna teltakin na thei uh hi. Hih thu pen note lakah a piang thu ahih manin nomau mahmah in na thei uh hi.
Pasian in thu a ma theihkholhna leh ama geelna tawh kizui-in note' khutsungah tua Jesuh a hong piakding a ngaihsutsa hi a, note in singlamteh tungah khai-in migilote' khut tawh amah na that uh hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in misite lak panin amah hingkiksak a, sihna in amah lencip zolo ahih manin sihna hanga gimna panin amah a suaktasak hi.
"Sanggamte aw, note' theihdingin i pupi David' thu a teltakin kong gen ding hi. Amah si-in kivui a, a han zong tu mahmahin eite kiangah omlai hi.
David pen kamsang hi a, ama tunga Pasian' thuciam a thei hi. Ama suante khat, amah bang teek mahin kumpi-in a bawlna ding Pasian in thu a ciam hi.
Pasian in a sep ding thu David in mukhol ahih manin, 'Mi site gamsungah amah kinusia lo a, a sa a muat kei hi,' ci-in a gen ciangin, Khrih' thawhkikna ding thu a gengen ahi hi.
Amah in Pasian' taklamah omna dongin liatna ngah a, ama tungah Pasian in a ciamsa Kha Siangtho zong a ngahkhin hi. Tu laitaka na muh na zak uh nate pen kote tungah a hong piak tua Kha Siangtho ahi hi.
David pen vantungah a kahtohloh hangin amah in, 'Topa in keima Topa kiangah: Na khe nuai-ah na galte kong koihsak matengin ka taklamah na tu in, ci-in gen hi,' ci hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin singlamteh tungah na thah uh hih Jesuh pen Pasian in Topa leh Khrih-in a bawl khitna thu, Israel mi khempeuh in teltakin thei ta un," a ci hi.
Amaute in hih thu a zak uh ciangin a lungsim uh nakpi takin sukha a, Peter leh sawltak dangte kiangah, "Sanggamte aw, bangci gamtat ding ka hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Tua ciangin Peter in amaute kiangah, "Na mawhna uh kisik un la, na mawhna uh hong kimaisak theihna dingin Jesuh Khrih min tawh tui kiphum ciat un. Tua hi leh Pasian' piakkhong Kha Siangtho na ngah ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in ama kamciamna pen note tung, na suan na khakte uh tung leh gamlapi-a om mi khempeuh, i Topa Pasian in a sap mi khempeuh tungah a hong bawl ahi hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Peter in amaute tungah thu tampi genthuahin hanthawn a, "Hih migilote' gimthuak ding na tuahkhak lohna dingun nomau mah in na suahtakna ding uh lampi zong ciat un," a ci hi.
Mi tampi in ama thugen umin tui kiphum uh a, tua ni-in mihing tul thum bang kibehlap uh hi.
Sawltakte in lim leh na lamdang tampi bawl uh a, mi khempeuh in lamdang sa mahmah uh hi.
Nisimin biakinn-ah kikhawm uh a, a innte uhah an nekhawmin, lungdamna leh kiniamkhiatna tawh a ne ciat uh hi.
Nikhat, thunget hun nitak nai thum laitakin biakinn-ah Peter leh Johan a pai uh hi.
Kongpi Hoih a kici gei-ah a suahtunga kipan a khebai mi khat na om hi. Biakinn-ah a pai mite tung panin sum a ngen dingin nisimin hih kongpi gei-ah amah hong kikoih zel hi.
Peter leh Johan, biakinn-ah a hong pai a muh ciangin sum a na ngen hi.
Amaute gel in tua mipa limtakin en uh a, Peter in, "Kote hong en dih in," a ci hi.
Bang khat peuhpeuh ngahding, ci-in kilamen ahih manin amaute a en hi.
Peter in ama kiangah, "Sum ka nei peuhmah kei hi; ahi zongin ka neih kong pia ding hi. Nazareth khuami Jesuh Khrih min tawh, dingin lam na paina dingin thu ka hong pia hi," a cih khit ciangin,
a taklam khutin lenin kaito a, thakhat thu-in a khe leh a siakmitte hong khauhpah hi.
Tua mipa in Peter leh Johan beel cinten a, mi khempeuh in hih thupiang lamdangsa uh ahih manin amaute' omna Solomon' Talap a kici-ah mite a hong tai uh hi.
Peter in hih mite a muh ciangin amaute kiangah, "Ka mipih Israel mite aw, bang hangin hih thupiang lamdangsa a, bang hangin ko hong hici et na hi uh hiam? Hih mipa lam ka paisak theihna uh, komau' vang leh komau' hoihna hang sa na hi uh hiam?
I pupite Abraham, Isaac, leh Jakob Pasian in a nasem Jesuh tungah ama vangliatna a pia hi. Note in aana neite khutsungah tua Jesuh na pia uh a, Pilat mangpa in amah khahdingin a ngaihsut khit ciang nangawnin Pilat' maitang mahah amah na nial teitei uh hi.
Amah mihoih mi siangtho hinapi-in, amah na nial zawsop uh a, mi that khat a khahkhiatna dingin Pilat kiangah na ngen uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mite tungah nuntakna a piapa na that uh a, ahi zongin sihna panin Pasian in amah hingkiksak hi. Kote gel pen hih thu a thei teci ka hi uh hi.
Hih Jesuh min' vangliatna in hih khebai mipa tungah thahatna a pia ahi hi. Note khempeuh in na theih uh mah bangin hih mipa bangzah takin khebai ahih hangin Jesuh upna leh ama min hangin hih mipa in dam siangthona a ngah ahi hi.
"Tua ahih ciangin sanggamte aw, note leh na makaite uh hih bangin Jesuh tungah na gamtatna uh na theihlohna hang uh hi, ci-in ka thei hi.
Ama Khrih in a thuakna ding thu, Pasian in tanglai pekin kamsangte khempeuh tung tawnin genkhol a, tu-in hih bangin a thugen kholhna a hong tungsak ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin na mawhnate uh hong sawpsiangsak theihna ding, Topa kiang panin a hong pai lungsim nopna hun na ngah theihna ding uh leh note-a' dingin a sehsa Jesuh Khrih a hong sawltheihna dingin na mawhna uh kisik un la, Pasian kiang zuan un.
Pasian in ama kamsang mi siangthote tung tawnin tanglai-in a genkholhsa bangin, na khempeuh a thakin a kibawl hundong mateng vantungah Jesuh a om ding ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Moses in, 'Kei a hong sawl mah bangin note sung mah panin note-a' ding kamsang khat Topa na Pasian un note kiangah hong sawl ding hi. Ama hong thugen khempeuh na mang ding uh hi.
Tua kamsangpa' thugen a manglo khempeuh, a Jew mipihte kiang panin kikhen khia-in kisusia ding hi,' ci hi.
Samuel-a kipan ama nunga hong piang kamsang khempeuh in tu laitaka thupiangte mah genkhol ciat uh hi.
Pasian in Abraham kiangah, 'Na suan na khakte thupha ka piak bangin leitung mi khempeuh thupha ka pia ding hi,' ci ahih manin, Pasian in ama kamsangte tung tawnin a thuciamte khempeuh eite-a' ding hi a, Pasian in i pu i pate tawh a thuciamte, eite in zong a ngah ding ihi hi.
Eite khempeuh i gitlohna panin kikheelin thupha a hong piaktheihna dingin Pasian in a Nasem dingin Jesuh teelin, eite kiangah a hong sawl masa ahi hi," ci-in thu a gen hi.
Peter leh Johan omkhawmin, tua bangin Peter in mite kiangah thu a gen laitakin siampite, biakinn upate, leh Saddusi mite hong pai uh hi.
Hih sawltak nihte in misite thokik ding hi, cih a lahtelna dingun sihna panin Jesuh thokik hi, ci-in mite kiangah thu hilh uh ahih manin nawngkai a sa uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute gel man uh a, ni tum kuanta ahih manin a zing ciangdong thong sungah a khum uh hi.
Ahi zongin amaute' thugen a za mi tampi in um uh a, thu um mi tul nga bang a pha ta uh hi.
A zing ciangin Jew mi makaite, upate, leh Thukham hilh siate, Jerusalem-ah hong kikhawm uh hi.
Siampi lianpen a semngei Annas, siampi lianpen a sem Kaiafas, Johan, Alexander, leh siampi lianpente beh mi khempeuh tawh kikhopna khat a bawl uh hi.
Amaute' mai-ah sawltakte gel dingsak uh a, "Kua' vangliatna leh kua' min tawh hih bangin na sem na hi uh hiam?" ci-in a dong uh hi.
Tua ciangin Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin Peter in dawng a, "Makaite leh upate aw,
hih khebai mipa tungah thuhoih a kibawlna leh ama damna thu tawh kisai-in kote thu hong sit na hih uh leh,
note in singlamteh tungah na thah uh, Pasian in sihna panin a thawhkiksak Nazareth khuami Jesuh Khrih min vangliatna tawh hih mipa a ci damin hih lai-ah ding ahihna thu, note leh Israel mi khempeuh in na theih dingun a kilawm thu khat ahi hi.
Ama hang bek tawh hotkhiatna kingah thei ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh eite in hotkhiatna i ngahtheihna dingin leitung khempeuhah Pasian in hong piak min dang khat zong omlo hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Uliante in Peter leh Johan a han' mahmahna thu leh amaute pilna sang a neilo mi mawkmawk ahihna thu a theih uh ciangin lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi. Tua ciangin Jesuh tawh a kikhawl khin ngeite ahihna uh a phawk uh hi.
Ahi zongin a kidamsak mipa pen Peter leh Johan-te gei-ah om gige ahih manin a nialna ding uh thu mu zolo uh hi.
"Hih mite bangcih ding ihi hiam? Jerusalem khuasunga om mi khempeuh in hih mite' bawl a lamdang mahmah nate thei ciat uh a, i nial theihna ding bangmah omlo hi.
Ahi zongin mite lakah hih thute a kitheihthang thuahlohna dingin, Jesuh' min tawh kuama kiangah thu a gen ngei nawnlohna dingun taii ni," a kici uh hi.
Tua ciangin sawltakte samkik uh a, Jesuh' min tawh thugen ahi a, thuhilh ahi zongin a hih nawn hetlohna dingun thu a pia uh hi.
Ahi zongin Peter leh Johan in, "Note' thu man'zawk ding leh Pasian' thu man'zawk ding, Pasian' muhna panin koi pen manzaw ding cih thu nomau mah in zong ngaihsun ciat un.
Tua ahih manin kote in ka muhsa uh leh ka zaksa uh thute genloin ka om thei kei ding uh hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Ahi zongin uliante in a khauhzaw-in thu a gen khit uh ciangin a khah uh hi. Hih thupiang hangin mi khempeuh in Pasian phat uh ahih manin hih mite gim a piakna ding uh a thu mu theilo uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh hih na lamdang a kibawlna mipa pen a khan' kum sawmli val a pha khinsa mi khat ahi hi.
Peter leh Johan a kikhahkhiat khit phetin a lawmte uh kiangah pai-in siampi liante leh upate in amaute tungah a thugente khempeuh a zasak uh hi.
A lawmte un hih thu a zak uh ciangin a vekpi-un lungsim kikhatin Pasian' kiangah thu ngen uh a, "Van leh lei, tuipi tuineu leh a sunga om khempeuh a piangsak Topa aw,
kote' pupi, na nasempa David tungah na Kha Siangtho tawh thu na gen a, amah in, 'Bang hangin Gentail mite heh mahmah a, a tangtunglo dingpi vaihawm uh ahi hiam?
Topa leh ama Khrih a do dingin leitung kumpite kithawi uh a, gam ukte kikaikhawm uh hi,' ci hi.
A cih mah bangin Herod leh Pontias Pilat in hih khuapi sung teek mahah Gentail mite leh Israel mite tawh kikupna nei uh a, nangmah in Khrih dingin na bawl, a siangtho na Nasempa Jesuh thahdingin a vaihawm uh hi.
Nangmah in na deihna bangin a piangdingin na vangliatna tawh na khensatsa thu khempeuh a semdingin amaute kikhawm uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa aw, amaute in kote hong tawn'nate thei in la, nangma nasem kote in lungsim han' mahmahna tawh nangma thu ka gentheihna dingun hong huh in.
Cinate damsak theihna ding vangliatna hong pia in la, a siangtho na Nasempa Jesuh' min tawh na lamdang kibawl ta hen," a ci uh hi.
Thu um mi khempeuh a lungsim uh leh a ngaihsutna uh kikhat uh a, kuamah in ama neihsa kei-a' tuam ciloin, a neih khempeuh uh a neikhawm ciat uh hi.
Inn ahi a, lo ahi zongin a neite in zuak uh a, a sum ngahte uh sawltakte kiangah a ap uh hi. Mi khempeuh tungah a kisapna bang ciatun a sumte hawm uh ahih manin amaute lakah sum kitangsam kuamah omlo uh hi.
Tua hi a, Saipras tuikulh-a suak, Levi mi Josef, sawltakte in Barnabas (Hanthawn Siampa a cihnopna) min a phuahpa in,
ama neih a lo zuak a, a sum hong paipihin sawltakte khutsungah a ap hi.
Ahi zongin Ananias a kici pasal khat leh a zi Sapfira a kici, nupa kop khat om uh hi. A neihsa uh pawlkhat zuak uh a,
Tua lo na zuakma-in nangma-a' hi a, na zuakkhit ciangin a sum zong nangma-a' mah ahi hi. Tua hinapi-in bang hangin tua bangin gamtat ding ngaihsun peuhmah na hi hiam? Mite a khem hiloin Pasian a khem na hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua khit nai thum bang ding ciangin a zi hong pai a, ahi zongin tua lai-a thupiang bangmah theilo hi.
Peter in tuanu kiangah, "Nang leh na pasal in na lo zuak man uh sum pen a vekpi-in hih zah mah ahi hiam, hong gen dih in," ci-in a dong hi. Amah in, "Hi hi, tua zah mah hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin Peter in tuanu kiangah, "Bang dingin na nupa-un Topa' Kha Siangtho ze-et ding thukim khawm na hi uh hiam? En in, na pasal a vuite kongkhak gei mahmahah om uh a, nang zong hong puakhia ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Pawlpi mi khempeuh leh hih thu a za mi khempeuhte nakpi takin a lau uh hi.
Sawltakte in mite lakah lim leh na lamdang tampi a bawl uh hi. Thu um mi khempeuh Solomon' Talap-ah kikhawmin a om uh hi.
Midangte in thupi sa-in hoihsa mahmah uh a, ahi zongin amaute pawlpih taktak ngamlo uh hi.
Hih bangin sawltakte' nasepna hangin kongzingah cinate hong kipua a, Peter hong pai ciangin a liim in cinate a liahkhak theihna ding deihin a lupna leh a lupna pheekte uh tawh lam gei-ah a koih uh hi.
Jerusalem khua kiima om khuapite panin mite hong pai-in, cinate leh dawivei mite hong paipih uh a, a vekpi-in damna a ngah uh hi.
Tua ciangin siampi lianpenpa leh amah tawh a kipawl tua lai-a Saddusi mite in sawltakte haza-in thangpai uh ahih manin thu bawl ding a ngaihsun uh hi.
Ahi zongin tua zanin Topa' vantung mi khat in thong kongkhakte hong a, sawltakte a paikhiatpih khit ciangin amaute kiangah,
"Biakinn-ah pai un la, hih nuntak thakna thu mite kiangah va gen un," ci-in a vaikhak hi.
Ama gen mah bangin sawltakte zong zingsang ciangin biakinn-ah pai-in thuhilh ding a kipan uh hi. Siampi lianpenpa leh ama kikholhpihte in ulian kikhopna a cingtaakkhat a omtheihna dingin Jew mi upa khempeuh a kikhopna dingun a sam uh hi. Tua khit ciangin thong panin sawltakte va kai-in uliante mai-ah a hong paipihna dingun palikte a sawl uh hi.
Ahi zongin thongah palikte a va tun' uh ciangin sawltakte na om lo hi. Tua ahih manin uliante kiangah kileh kikin,
"Thongah ka tun' uh ciangin a kongkhakte limtak mahin tawh kikalh a, thongcingte in zong kongpi-ah limtak mahin a na cing ka mu uh hi. Ahi zongin thong kong ka hon' uh ciangin a sungah kuamah na omlo hi," ci-in a zasak uh hi.
Biakinn ukpa leh siampi liante in hih thu a zak uh ciangin hih sawltakte a bangci thu hi ding hiam, ci-in lamdang a sa mahmah uh hi.
Tua ciangin biakinn ukpa leh a mite va pai-in sawltakte hong paipih kik uh hi. Mihonte in suang tawh amaute a den'gawp khakding lau uh ahih manin sawltakte ngongbawl loin thudam tawh a paipih uh hi.
Tua ciangin uliante mai-ah sawltakte dingsak uh a, siampi lianpenpa in sawltakte kiangah thu genin,
"Hih mipa' min tawh thu na hilh nawnlohna dingun khauhtakin thu kong pia uh hi. Tu-in na gamtatnasate uh thei un. Jerusalem khuasung khempeuhah thu na genthang uh a, ama sihna pen kote nong ngawh nuam uh hi," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Peter leh sawltak dangte in, "Mite' thu sangin Pasian' thu ka mangzaw ding uh hi.
Israel mite kisik kikin Pasian in a mawhna uh a maisak theihna dingin Ukpi leh Honpa-in tua Jesuh bawlin ama taklamah a tusak hi.
Hih thute thei-in teci a pangte pen ko sawltakte bek hiloin Kha Siangtho tawh zong ka hi uh a, tua Kha Siangtho pen amah a um mite tungah Pasian in a khongin a piak ahi hi," ci-in a dawngkik uh hi.
Ahi zongin amaute sung panin Farisi mi Gamaliel, Thukham hilh sia khat ahi, mi khempeuh in zong a zahtakbawl mipa khat hong ding a, tawlkhat sung sawltakte a kipusuahpihna dingin thu pia a,
tua khit ciangin a lawm uliante kiangah, "Israel mite aw, hih mite na bawlna ding uh tawh kisai-in limtakin kidawm un.
Tuma lam tawlkhat lai-in Thudas a kici mi khat hong khang hi. Mi lian khat ka hi hi, ci-in gen a, mihing za li ding bang in amah pawlpih uh hi. Ahi zongin amah kithatin, a nungzui khempeuh kithehthang a, ama vai beita hi.
Hih thu a pian' khit ciangin, mi bangzah pha hiam, ci-in gamsung mi khempeuh a kisim laitakin Galilee mi Judas a kici mi khat hong khang leuleu a, amah in zong nungzui mihonpi mah a nei hi. Amah zong kithat leuleu a, a nungzuite kithehthangin maimang hi.
Tu-in zong tua bangmahin thu hong piang leuleu hi. Note kiangah kong gennop thu in: Hih mite bangmah cih kei un la, hici omsak lel un. Mihingte' bawltawm vaihawmna ahih leh ama thu-in hong bei lel ding hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian kiang panin a hong pai thu ahih leh na zo zo ngei kei ding uh hi. Pasian tawh a kido na hi ding uh hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Tua ahih manin uliante in Gamaliel' thugen a mang uh hi. Sawltakte samkik sak uh a, a sat khit uh ciangin Jesuh' min tawh thu a hilhkik ngeilohna dingun thu a pia uh hi. Tua khit ciangin sawltakte a khah uh hi.
Nisimin biakinn sung leh mite inn-ah thu hilh uh a, Jesuh, Khrih hi, cih Lungdamna Thu a gengen uh hi.
Tua khit ciangin thu um mi hong tam tektek a, Jew mite leh Grik pau a zang Jew mite kikalah kiphunsanna thu hong om hi. Grik pau a zang Jew mite in, "Annek tuidawn, sumlepai hawmna-ah ka meigong numeite uh hong kipiaksak lo hi," ci-in lungkimlo uh hi.
Tua ahih manin sawltak sawmlenihte in thu um mi khempeuh samin kaikhawm uh a, "Kote in Pasian' thu hilh ding don manlo liangin annek tuidawn sumlepai vai-ah kong manlah ding uh kilawmlo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin sanggamte aw, note lak panin pilna leh Kha Siangtho a nei mihing sagih hong kitengkhia un la, hih thute a vaihawm dingin i koih ding hi.
Tua hi leh kote in ka hun khempeuh uh thungetna leh thuhilhna-in kong zang thei ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
A vekpi-un sawltakte' thugente thukimpih uh ahih manin, Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin upna a nei Stefen, Filip, Prokhoras, Nikanor, Timon, Parmenas, leh Antiok khua pan Gentail mi ahi Jew biakna a zui Nikolas a teel uh hi.
Tua bangin Pasian' thu kizelin hong khang semsem hi. Jerusalem khuasungah thu um mi tampi tak hong kibehlap a, siampi tampi tak in zong Lungdamna Thu a hong um uh hi.
Pasian in Stefen' tungah thupha tampi tak pia-in vangliatna lianpi neisak a, amah in mite lakah lim leh na lamdang lianpipi a bawl hi.
Ahi zongin mi pawlkhat in Stefen langpan' uh hi. Tua mite pen mite in, "Sal Suakta Mite," a cihte pawl uh hi a, Sairin khua leh Alexandria khua panin a hong pai Jew mite ahi uh hi. Hih Jew mite, Silisia leh Asia gam pan a hong pai Jew mite tawh kipawlin Stefen tawh thu kisel dingin hong kipan uh hi.
Ahi zongin Kha Siangtho in Stefen tungah pilna guan' ahih manin amaute in thusel zolo uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in mi cialin sumgolh pia uh a, "Moses leh Pasian langpangin thu a genna ka za uh hi," cisak uh hi.
Amaute in hih bangin zuauna tawh mihonte, upate, leh Thukham hilh siate a holhthawh uh hi. Tua ahih manin amaute hong pai-in Stefen man uh a, uliante mai-ah a hong paipih uh hi.
Tua ciangin zuauthu a gen dingin mi pawlkhat hong paipih uh a, "Hih mipa in a siangtho i biakinnpi leh Moses Thukham gensia tawntung hi.
Ulian kikhopna sunga a kihel mi khempeuh in Stefen en uh a, a maitang pen vantung mi maitang tawh kibang hi, ci-in a mu kim uh hi.
Tua ciangin siampi lianpenpa in Stefen kiangah, "Tu-a amaute' gen bang takpi mah ahi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin
Stefen in, "Ute pate aw, ka thugen hong ngai un. I pupi Abraham, Haran khua-ah a ten'ma, Mesopotamia gamah a om lai-in, ama kiangah a minthang Pasian kilang a,
'Na gam na lei, na beh na phungte kiang panin paikhia in la, nangma tungah kong lahding gamah pai in,' ci hi.
Amah zong Khaldea gam panin paikhia-in Haran khua-ah teng hi. A pa a sih khit ciangin Pasian in tu-a na ten'na uh hih gamah amah na lalsak leuleu hi.
Pasian in Abraham tungah ama aituam dingin leitang khutpeek cia nangawn pialo napi-in, amah leh a suan a khakte tungah hih gam a piakna ding thu a ciam hi. Pasian in tua thuciamna a piak laitakin Abraham in ta nei nailo hi.
Tua bang hinapi-in, Pasian in Abraham kiangah, 'Na suan na khakte gamdangah tengin salin om ding uh a, kum za li sung nakpi takin gimna thuak ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Pasian in Abraham tungah kiciamna limin vun-atna ngeina na pia hi. Tua ahih manin Abraham in a tapa Isaac a suahzawh nipikal khat khit ciangin a vun at a, Isaac in a tapa Jakob' vun at leuleu a, Jakob in eite' pupite ahi a tapa sawmlenihte' vun na at leuleu hi.
a thuakna khempeuh panin na honkhia hi. Egypt kumpipa Faro' mai-ah Josef a tun' ciangin Pasian in ama tungah pilna leh a deihhuai gamtat hoih na guan' hi. Tua ahih manin Faro in ama khutnuai-ah a gam a uksawn ding leh a kumpi innsung khempeuh a van dingin a koih hi.
Tua ciangin Egypt gam leh Kanaan gam khempeuhah kialpi tung a, mi khempeuh in haksatna thuak uh ahih manin i pupite in zong annek ding muzo nawnlo uh hi.
A nihveina a pai uh ciangin a sanggamte tungah i pupi Josef na kipulak a, tua huna kipanin Faro in zong Josef innkuansung thu na thei hi.
Tua ciangin Josef in a pa Jakob kiangah mi sawl a, amah-a kipan a innkuan mi khempeuh Egypt-ah a paina dingun a gensak hi. Tua hun laitakin Jakob innkuan mi sawmsagih leh nga pha uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Jakob zong Egypt gamah pai a, amah-a kipan i pupite khempeuh tua gamah a si uh hi.
"Pasian in Abraham tungah a thuciamna a tun'sak ding a nai kuan ciangin Egypt gamah ei mite tampi tak na pha ta uh hi.
A tawpna-ah Josef a theilo kumpi dang khat, Egypt gamsung a uk dingin hong kipan hi.
I mipihte na khemgawpin na khelbawl a, a ta ngekte uh a sihna dingin inn panin mun dangah a koihkhia sak hi.
inn panin a kikoihkhiat ciangin Faro' tanu in a ta dingin la a, ama tapa bang teekteek mahin bawlin a khan'suah hi.
Egypt gamsunga pilna om khempeuh ama tungah kihilh a, thugenna leh nasepna-ah milian mahmah khat a suak hi.
Tua bangin a mipihte lakah a va pai ciangin Egypt mite khat in a Israel mipihte khat a bawlsiatna mu a, a mipihpa a hutna-in Egypt mipa a satlum hi.
Amah pen eite hong honkhia dingin Pasian in a zatding mipa hi, ci-in a mipihte in a thei ding sa a, ahi zongin a mipihte in na theilo uh hi.
A zing ciangin Israel mi nih a kilai mu leuleu a, amaute a phelh dingin kipanin, 'Lawmte aw, minam khat hilo na hi uh hiam? Bang hangin khatlekhat tuaci kibawl na hi uh hiam?' ci hi.
A lawmpa a bawlsiapa in Moses sawnkhia-in, 'Kote a hong uk ding leh thu a hong khen dingin kua in nang hong koih ahi hiam?
Moses in hih thu a zak ciangin Egypt gam panin taikhia-in Midian gamah ten' ding kipan a, tua gamah tapa nih a nei hi.
"Tua gamah kum sawmli a ten' khit ciangin, Sinai Mual tung gamlakah sawlpang laka meikuang sungah vantung mi khat ama kiangah hong kilang hi.
Moses in a muh ciangin lamdangsa a, a nai takin a muhtheihna dingin sawlpang kuang kiangah a va pai hi. Ahi zongin Topa' awging za a,
'Kei pen na pu na pate uh ahi Abraham, Isaac, leh Jakob-te' Pasian ka hi hi,' a na ci hi. Moses zong lau-in linggawp a, en ngamlo hi.
Tua ciangin Topa in Moses kiangah, 'Na din'na mun pen a siangtho leitang ahih manin na khedap suah in.
"Moses pen Israel mite in deihloin, 'Kote a hong uk ding leh thu a hong khen dingin kua in hong koih ahi hiam?' a cihpa uh ahi hi. Ahi zongin Moses pen sawlpang kuang sung pan ama kiangah a kilang vantung mi' huhna tawh ukpa leh honkhiapa ahi dingin Pasian in a sawlpa ahi hi.
Amah in Egypt gam leh San Tuipi-ah lim leh na lamdangte bawlin, Egypt gam panin Israel mite paikhiatpih a, gamlakah kum sawmli sung amaute a makaih hi.
Hih Moses pen Israel mite tungah, 'Pasian in kei hong sawl mah bangin, i mipihte sung mah panin note-a' ding kamsang khat hong sawl ding hi,' a cipa ahi hi.
Amah pen Israel mite tawh gamlakah a ompa hi a, Sinai Mual tunga ama kiangah thu a gen vantung mi leh i pute tawh a kikhawlpa ahi hi. Eite tungah hong gensawn dingin Pasian kiang panin a tul ngeilo thu a ngah ahi hi.
"Ahi zongin i pute in ama thu na mang nuamloin, amah na nawlkhin uh a, Egypt gamah ciahkik nopna lungsim na nei uh hi.
Tua ahih manin amaute in Aaron kiangah, 'Egypt gam panin eite a hong paikhiatpih tua Moses tungah bang thu piang hiam cih theilo ihih manin, eite' mai-ah i paisak ding milim pasian pawlkhat hong bawlsak in,' ci uh hi.

Tua khit ciangin i pute in amau' pate tung panin a ngah uh tua puanbuk pen amau' ten'na ding gam a la dingin a kuan uh ciangin na pua uh a, Pasian in amaute' mai-ah tua gam mite hawlkhiatsak ahih manin tua gam a luah uh ciangin a puanbuk zong a na tun'pih uh hi. Tua ahih manin David' hun ciangdong tua puanbuk na om hi.
