Zankim laitakin Paul leh Silas in Pasian kiangah thu ngenin la sa uh a, thongkia dangte in amau' thungetna leh lasaknate a ngai uh hi.
Thakhatin nakpi takin zin hong ling a, thonginn a bulpi dongin a lokgawp hi. Thakhatthu-in thong kongkhak khempeuh kihong a, thongkiate a kikhihna sikkhau khempeuh a kiphelkhia hi.
Thongcingpa zong khanglo a, thong kongkhakte a kihong a muh ciangin thongkia mi khempeuh taikhia mangkhin hi, ci-in ngaihsun ahih manin a namsau dokin amahmah a kithat dingin a kithawi hi.
Thongcingpa in zong meivak a la dingin mi khat sawl a, thong sungah tai-in laukawm lingkawmin Paul leh Silas khe kiang va kiden'na-in a va boksuk hi.
Tua ciangin amaute pusuahpih a, "Tote aw, hotkhiatna ka ngahna dingin bangci gamtat ding ka hi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Amaute in, "Topa Jesuh um in. Tua hi leh nang leh na innkuanpihte in hotkhiatna na ngah ding uh hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in amah leh a innsunga om mi khempeuh tungah Topa' thu a hilh uh hi.
Tua zankim laitakpi mahin thongcingpa in amaute' liammate sawpsiangsak a, amah leh a innkuanpih mi khempeuh a kituiphum pah uh hi.
Tua ciangin a inn-ah amaute ciahpihin an a pia hi. Tu-in Pasian thu um uh ahih manin amah-a kipan a innkuanpih khempeuh a lungdam mahmah uh hi.
Tua ahih manin thongcingpa in zong Paul kiangah, "Thukhen uliante in nang leh Silas kong khahna ding uh thu hong piakhin ahih manin lungnuam takin na ciahkhia theita ding uh hi," a ci hi.
Ahi zongin Paul in palikbute kiangah, "Kote in khialhna bangmah gamtalo napi-in mihon mai-ah hong kisatgawp hi. Kote pen Rom gammi hi ung! Hong kisat khit ciangin thong sungah hong kikoih lai hi. Tu-in kuama theihlohin kote hong khahsim nuam ahi uh hiam? Tua bang mawk hithei peuhmahlo ding hi. Rom thukhen uliante mahmah hih lai-ah hong pai uh hen la, kote hong khahkhia ta hen," a ci hi.
Palikbute in zong Rom thukhen uliante kiangah hih thu va ko uh hi. Paul leh Silas pen Rom gammi ahih lamtak a phawk uh ciangin lunghimawh uh a,
amau mahmah va pai-in a va thum khit uh ciangin thong sung panin khahkhia uh a, tua khua panin a paikhiatna dingun a thum uh hi.
Paul leh Silas zong thong panin paikhia-in Lydia' inn a zuan uh hi. Tua lai-ah thu um mite tawh kikhawm uh a, hanthotna kam a genkhit uh ciangin tua khua panin a dingkhia uh hi.
Amfipolis khua leh Apollonia khua nawkin amaute zin uh a, Jew mite kikhopna inn a omna Thesalonika khua a tung uh hi.
Mi pawlkhat in a thugen uh man sa uh ahih manin Paul leh Silas pawlpih uh a, tua mah bangin Pasian a bia mi tampi tak leh uliante' zi tampi mah in zong a pawlpih uh hi.
Tua bangin mi tampi in Paul' thugen a up uh ciangin Jew mite thangpai uh a, kongzing lakah a vakvai migilo honkhat kaikhawmin a pawlmat uh hi. Khuasung khempeuh buaisak henhanin, mihonte lakah Paul leh Silas a kaihkhiat theihna dingun Jason' inn a va simgawp uh hi.
Tua inn-ah Paul leh Silas a muhloh uh ciangin a innteekpa Jason leh midang pawlkhat kaikhia-in uliante kiangah paipih uh a, "Hih mite in mun khempeuhah buaina piangsak uh hi. Tu-in i khuasung hong tung uh a,
Hih thu a zak uh ciangin mihonte leh khuasung uliante heh mahmah uh a,
Jason leh a lawmte a kitatna ding uh sum a piaksak khit uh ciangin tua khuasung uliante in amaute a khah pan uh hi.
Tua zan ciangin thu um mite in Berea khua-ah Paul leh Silas a paisak uh hi. Tua khua a tun' uh ciangin Jew mite kikhopna inn-ah a pai uh hi.
Thesalonika khuamite sangin Berea khuamite in mipi lungsim neizaw uh hi. Amaute in lawp mahmahna tawh Paul' thugente ngai uh a, Paul' thugente man taktak hiam ci-in a theihna dingun nisimin Lai Siangtho a sim uh hi.
Mi tampi in Pasian' thu um a, tuate sungah a cithei Grik numei tampi leh Grik mi pasal tampi a kihel uh hi.
Tua ciangin thu um mite in tuipi gei-ah Paul paikhiatpih uh a, ahi zongin Silas leh Timoti pen Berea khua-ah a taam lai uh hi.
Tuipi gei-ah Paul a paipih thu um mite in Athen khua ciangdong a va zui uh hi. Athen khua panin Berea khua-ah hong ciahkik uh ciangin, Silas leh Timoti in a manlang theithei-in hong delh uh hen, ci-in Paul' kam vaikhak thu a hong pua uh hi.
Paul in Athen khua-ah Silas leh Timoti ngakin a om laitakin tua khuasungah milim a dimin a om lamtak mu ahih manin a lungsim ommawk theilo hi.
Tua ahih manin Pasian a bia Jew mite leh Gentail mite tawh kikhopna inn sungah thu kikupna nei uh a, mihon kikhopna munah hong pai mi khempeuh tawh zong nisimin a kikum uh hi.
Epikura thu ngaihsutzia leh Stoik thu ngaihsutzia a um mite pawlkhat, Paul tawh thu kinial uh a, "Hih mi kipilsak thu mawk gengenpa in bang gennuam ahi hiam?" cihsan uh a, pawlkhat in, "Minam dangte' pasian thu a gen tawh kibang hi," a ci uh hi. Paul in Jesuh thu leh a thawhkikna thu hilh ahih manin hih bangin a gen uh ahi hi.
Tu-a na gengen ka zak uh thu pawlkhatte, ko-a' dingin a lamdangpi khat hi a, a thu a cingin ka theinuam uh hi," a ci uh hi.
(Athen khuamite leh tua khua-a om gamdang mite in thu thak la thak ngaihsunin kikup ding simloh thudang ngaihsutin neilo uh hi.)
Na khuasung uhah ka pai kawmin na biakna munte uh ka et ciangin, 'A Kitheilo Pasian-a' ding,' ci-in biakna tau tungah lai a kigelh nangawn ka mu hi. Tu laitakin kei' hong pulak Pasian pen, theilo napi-in na biakbiak uh Pasian ahi hi.
Tua Pasian pen leitung buppi leh a tunga om khempeuh a piangsak Pasian hi a, van leh lei a uk Topa ahih manin mihingte' lamsa biakinn sungah tenglo hi.
Amah pen mi khempeuh tungah nuntakna leh na khempeuh a piapa ahih manin mihingte in ama-a' dingin na khat peuhpeuh a sepsak ding a kisam ahi kei hi.
Mihing khat tung panin leitung minam khempeuh hong piangsakin, leitung khempeuhah a omsak hi. Amah in mihingte a pian'sakma pekin, mihingte' nuntak tanvei ding leh a ten'na ding uh mun a sehsa ahi hi.
Hih bangin a hihna pen mite in amah zongin a muhtheihna ding uh a deihna ahi hi. Ahi zongin eite kiang panin Pasian gamla om hetlo hi.
Pasian in mihingte' theihloh hun lai-a a gamtatnate uh phamawh a sakloh hangin, tu-in mun khempeuha om mi khempeuhte a gamtat siatna panun a kiheina dingun thu a hong pia khinzo hi.
Amah in leitung mi khempeuh thu a mantakin ama teel mipa a hong khensakna ding ni a sehkhol khinzo hi. Tua a ngaihsutna a man taktak hi, ci-in mi khempeuh tungah a hong lahna dingin a teel mipa, sihna panin a hingkiksak zo hi," ci-in thu a hilh hi.
Mi pawlkhat in thu umin Paul pawlpih uh a, tuate lakah Areopagas mualbo-a thu vaihawm pawlsungah a kihel Dionisias, leh Damaris a kici numei khat, leh mi pawlkhat ahi uh hi.
Tua lai-ah Pontas gama suak, Jew mi Aquila a kici mi khat tawh a kimu hi. Gam uk Kumpipa in Jew mi khempeuh Rom khua panin a taikhiatna dingun thu pia ahih manin Aquila leh a zi Prisilla pen Italy gam panin Korin khua a hong tun' uh a sawt nailo ahi hi. Tua nupate tawh a kimu dingin Paul zong a inn uhah va hawh a,
Sabbath ni simin kikhopna inn-ah limtakin thu gen a, Jew mi leh Grik mite in thu a upna dingun a hanciam hi.
Masedonia gam panin Silas leh Timoti hong tun' ciangin Paul in a hun neih khempeuh thuhilhna-in zang a, Jesuh pen Khrih ahi hi, ci-in Jew mite kiangah teltakin a gen hi.
Jew mite in ama thuhilhna nialin a gensiat uh ciangin Paul in a puan tunga leivui bangte sin'sanin, "Pasian tawh kikhenin siatna na tuah uh leh nomau khialhna hi a, kei nong ngawhna ding uh omlo hi. Tu-a kipanin Gentail mite kiangah thu ka hilh ding hi," a ci hi.
Kikhopna inn ukpa Krispas leh a innsunga om mi khempeuh in Topa thu um uh a, Korin khua-a om midang tampite in zong thuhilhna ngai-in um uh a, tui a kiphum uh hi.
Zan khat, Paul in maang mu a, a maang sungah Topa in, "Lau kei in. Lungkia kei in la, na thugen zom in.
Hih khuasungah keima mi tampi om a, nang hong ompih ka hih manin kuamah in nang bangmah hong cihlo ding hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin tua khua-ah kum khat leh alang sung omlai-in mite kiangah Pasian thu a hilh hi.
Rom khutnuai-ah Akhaia gamsung a uk dingin Gallio a kikoih ciangin Jew mite hong kikaikhawm uh a, Paul manin zumah a paipih uh hi.
Amaute in, "Hih mipa in ngeina omlopi-in mite in Pasian a biakna dingin zolding hanciam hi," a ci uh hi.
Paul in a kam ka-in thugen dingin a kipat laitakin Gallio in Jew mite kiangah, "Hih thu pen gamtat khialhna ahi a, gitloh tatna ahi zongin a gamtatna hang hi leh no Jew mite' thugente limtakin kong ngaih ding a kilawm mah ahi hi.
Ahi zongin hih thu pen kam zatzia, min, leh na ngeina uh a kituh na hih manun nomau mah in khentawm un. Tua bang thute keimah in ka hong khen kei ding hi," a cih khit ciangin,
Amaute in kikhopna inn ukpa Sosthenes manin, zum mai-ah satgawp uh a, ahi zongin Gallio in themkhat zong phamawh salo hi.
Korin khua-ah ni tampi sung thu um mite tawh Paul omkhawm lai a, tua khit ciangin amaute mangpha khakin Syria gam a zuan dingin Prisilla leh Aquila tawh teembaw a tuang uh hi. Paul in Pasian tungah thuciamnasa nei ahih manin teembaw a tuan' ma-un Korin khuapi teembaw khawlna Kenkhrea munah a sam a metsak hi.
Tua bangin a pai uh ciangin Efesa khua tung uh a, Paul zong kikhopna inn-ah pai-in Jew mite tawh thu a kisel uh hi. Tua khua-ah Prisilla leh Aquila-te nupa a taam laina ding Paul in a gen hi.
Thu um mi pawlkhatte in ni tampi sung Paul a tamna dingin gen uh a, ahi zongin amah tam nuamlo hi;
a din'khiat ding ciangin, "Pasian deihna ahih nak leh note kiangah ka hong hawhkik ding hi," ci-in vaikhakin, Efesa khua panin teembaw tawh a dingkhia hi.
Sisaria khua a tun' ciangin Jerusalem khua-ah pai-in pawlpite va hopih a, tua ciangin Antiok khua-ah a pai hi.
Antiok khua-ah tawlkhat a taam khit ciangin Galatia gam leh Frigia gamsungah pai-in thu um mi khempeuh a va thakhauhsak hi.
Amah in kikhopna innsungah hangtakin thu hilh ding kipan a, Prisilla leh Aquila in ama thuhilhna a zak uh ciangin a omna uh inn-ah Apollos ciahpihin, Pasian' thu paiziate a mantakin a hilhtel uh hi.
Akhaia gamah Apollos pai ding a sawm ciangin, Akhaia gama om thu um mite in limtakin a na pawlbawlna ding uh deihna tawh Efesa khua-a om thu um mite in lai a khak uh hi. Amah a tun' ciangin Pasian hehpihna hangin Jesuh thu a um tua lai-a om mite-a' dingin nuamtuam mahmah hi.
Tua ciangin Paul in, "Tua ahih leh na kituiphumna dan uh bangci bang ahi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin, "Tuiphumpa Johan' thugen bang pawl ahi hi," ci-in a dawng uh hi.
Tua ciangin Paul in, "Johan' hilh tuiphumna pen mawhna a kisik mite-a' ding ahi hi. Amah in Israel mite kiangah, 'Keima nunga hong pai dingpa Jesuh um un,' ci-in gen hi," a ci hi.
Tua mite sawmlenih a pha uh hi.
Tua ciangin Paul in kikhopna innsungah hangtakin kha thum sung thu hilh a, mite in Pasian' Ukna thu a upzawhna dingun nakpi takin a gen hi.
Ahi zongin mi pawlkhat in kin hetloin um nuamlo uh a, mipi' zakin Topa' thu paiziate gensia gawp uh ahih manin Paul in amaute nusia-in thu um mite paikhiatpih a, Tirannas in thugenna-in a neih innpi sungah nisimin thugenna hun a zang hi.
Hih bangin kum nih sung tawntung thu gen niloh ahih manin Asia gamsunga om Jew mi leh Gentail mi khempeuh in Topa' thu a za uh hi.
Pasian in Paul' tung tawnin na lamdang lianpipi a bawl hi.
Efesa khua-a om Jew mi leh Gentail mi khempeuh in hih thu za-in lau mahmah uh a, Topa Jesuh' min nakpi takin a kiphat semsem hi.
Tu-a bang danin Topa thu nakpi takin hong khangin hong kizel semsem hi.
Hih bang thuteng a pian'khit ciangin Masedonia gam leh Akhaia gamah Paul zinin Jerusalem-ah paisuak ding a ngaihsun hi. Tua khit ciangin Rom khua-ah zong pai ning, a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin amah a huh Timoti leh Erastas, Masedonia gamah paisak a, amah in Asia gamsungah tawlkhat hun a zang hi.
Demetrias min nei ngunseek mipa khat in Artemis nusian biakna inn lim ngun tawh bawl a, tua nasepna in amah leh a naseppih mite-a' dingin hauhna lianpi a piangsak hi.
Nomau mahmah in hih Paul' thugen khempeuh za-in na thei uh hi. Amah in mihingte' bawl pasiante pen pasian hi hetlo hi, ci-in thu hilh a, hih Efesa khua leh Asia gamsung khempeuhah mi tampi tak a umsak hi.
Tua ahih manin i nasepna a siatkhak ding lauhuai hi. Tua bek hiloin, Asia gamsung mi leh leitung mi khempeuh in a biak Artemis nusian biakna innpi a mawkna hong suahkhak ding, leh a liatna teng a maiman'khak ding nak lauhuai mahmah hi," a ci hi.
Khuasung khempeuhah tua buaina hong kizel a, mihonte in Paul tawh a kikhawl Masedonia mi Gaias leh Aristarkhas manin mihon kikhopna innpi-ah a kai uh hi.
Paul' lawm ahi tua gama ulian pawlkhatte in Paul kiangah kamtai paisak uh a, hih kikhopna munah hong kilak het kei in, ci-in nakpi takin a khosak uh hi.
Tua innpi sungah mihonpi buai ngeingai uh a, mi a tamzaw in a paina thu uh theilo uh ahih manin, pawlkhat in thu khat genin awnggawp uh a, adang pawlkhat in a thu tuampi khat na awng leuleu uh hi.
Jew mite in mihonpi mai-ah Alexander hong dingsak uh ahih manin, mi pawlkhat in hih thupiang ama hang hi, ci-in ngaihsun uh hi. Alexander in mihonte a gamdaihna dingin a khut hong van a, a mawhlohna uh thu a gen dingin hong kipan hi.
A tawpna ciangin khuasung lai atpa in mihonte a gamdaihna dingin khozo a, "Efesa khuapi mite aw, Efesa khuapi pen, a lian mahmah Artemis biakna innpi leh van panin a hong kia biakna suang a kem khuapi ahihna thu mi khempeuh in a theihsa ahi hi.
Hih thu pen kuamah in hong nial theilo ding hi. Tua ahih manin gamdai takin om un la, a kilawmlo na khat peuhpeuh gamta kei un.
Hih mite in i biakna inn lah bangmah cihlo, i nusian zong bangmah gensiatna neilo napi-in hih lai-ah na hong paipih uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Demetrias leh a pawlte in mi khatpeuh tungah lungkim lohna nei uh ahih leh thu sit ni ding hun om a, thukhen uliante zong om uh ahih manin tuate mai-ah thu kineih ta uh hen.
Ahi zongin hih thu-ah lungkimzo nailo na hih uh leh zong a ngeina cingin a kikhop uh ciangin gen ding ahi hi.
Tuni-a thupiang hangin eite buaina piangsak, ci-in hong kimawhsak khakding lauhuai hi. Hih bangin buaina a omna ding bangmah a thu omlopi hi a, i siksan ding bangmah thu om hetlo hi," a ci hi.
Hih buaina thu a ven' ciangin Paul in thu um mite kaikhawmin, hanthotna kam genin amaute mangpha khak a, Masedonia gam a zuan dingin dingkhia hi.
Hih gamsungah khualzinin hanthotna tampi a genkhit ciangin Grik gamah pai a,
tua gamah kha thum sung a tam hi. Syria gam manawh dingin a kithawi laitakin tua gama om Jew mite in lamkalah amah a thahsawmna thu za ahih manin Masedonia gam tawn kikin khualzin ding a ngaihsun hi.
Berea khuami Pirras' tapa Sopater, Thesalonika khuami Aristarkhas leh Sekundus, Derbe khuami Gaias, Timoti, leh Asia gamsung panin Tikhikas leh Trofimas-te in zong a zui uh hi.
Silngo Sawhloh Anlum Pawi a ven' khit ciangin Filippi khua panin teembaw tawh ka ding uh a, ni nga khit ciangin Troas khua tungin amaute tawh ka kimu uh a, tua lai-ah nipikal khat sung ka taam uh hi.
Sani nitakin an nekhawm dingin ka kikhawm uh a, a zing ciangin a dingkhia ding ahih manin Paul in a thuhilh zankim ciangdong a zomsuak hi.
Tua ciangin inn dawl tungnungah kahto kikin anlum balnenin thu um mite tawh a nekhawm hi. Zingsang khuavak dong amaute tawh thu kikum uh a, tua ciangin a dingkhia hi.
Tua ciangin Paul in, Assos khua ciangdong khe-in pai ning, ci-in ko kiangah hong gen ahih manin, Troas khua panin teembaw tuangin Assos-ah ka pai uh a, tua khua-ah Paul tawh a kituah ding ka hi uh hi.
Assos khua ka tun' uh ciangin Paul in zong teembaw hong man a, Mitylene khua-ah ka paisuak uh hi.
Paul in Jerusalem khua-ah Pentekos Pawi hun lapnuam ahih manin Asia gamsungah ban man dingin ngaihsunlo a, Efesa khua-ah taam sawmlo hi.
Paul in Miletas khua panin Efesa khua-ah thu puak a, Efesa pawlpi upate in a na dawntuahna dingin a vaikhak hi.
Efesa pawlpi upate hong tun' ciangin Paul in amaute kiangah, "Asia gamsung kong tun' ni-a kipanin note tawh ka om sungteng ka nasepna khempeuh note in na thei uh hi.
Jew mite in kei hong thahsawmna hangin kiniamkhiatna leh khitui naptui tawh haksapi-in Topa' na ka sem hi.
Mihon lak ahi a, note' innsungah ahi zongin ka hong thuhilhna khempeuhah note' phattuamna ding a om khempeuh sit neiloin kong gen khin hi.
Jew mi leh Gentail mite a mawhna panun Pasian' lamah kihei-in i Topa Jesuh a upna dingun thu ka gen khinzo hi.
Tu-in ahih leh Kha Siangtho' hong sawlna mangin, kei tungah bang thu hong piang ding hiam, cih theilopi-in Jerusalem khua-ah a pai ding ka hi hi.
Thongkiatna leh gimna ka thuakna ding thu bekbek, ka omna khua khempeuhah Kha Siangtho in hong gen tawntung hi.
Ahi zongin Topa Jesuh in kei sep dingin a hong piak, Pasian hehpihna hangin Lungdamna Thu, mite kiangah gen ding nasep ka tangtut zawh nak leh kei nuntakna-ah bangbang hong piang ta leh a thupi-in ka ngaihsun kei hi.
"A beisa hunah Pasian' Ukna thu a hilhin note lakah kong vak kawikawi a, ahi zongin tu-in kuamah in nong muhkik nawnloh ding uh ka thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tuni mahmahin note tungah limtakin kong gennop thu in: Note khat peuhpeuh Pasian tawh kikhenin siatna na tuah uh leh kei' tavuan hi nawnlo hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh note tungah Pasian' thu kong genloh khat zong om nawnlo hi.
Kha Siangtho in note' khutsungah a hong koih pawlpi mite leh nomau pumpi mahmah limtakin na kem un. Pasian in a Tapa a sihna tawh a ngah a pawlpi hoihtakin a kemte na hi ta un.
Kei ka om nawnloh ciangin, sa gilote in gannote a phialgawp bangin, mi pawlkhat in thu um mite hong phialgawp ding lamtak ka thei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin limtakin kiging un la, kum thum sung tawntung khitui naptui tawh note khempeuh ka hong thuhilhna na ciamteh un.
"Tu-in Pasian' khutsung leh ama dikna thu sungah note ka hong ap hi. Amah in note hong khangtosak thei-in, ama mite khempeuh-a' dingin a koih thuphate note tungah hong pia thei hi.
Kuama neihsa, ngun, kham, leh puante en' dingin ka ngaihsun ngei kei hi.
Kei leh ka kithuahpihte' kisapna khempeuh ka ngahtheihna dingin keima khut mahmah tawh na ka sepna thu note in na thei uh hi.
Topa Jesuh mahmah in, 'Ngahna sangin piak khiatna-ah lungdamna lianzaw hi,' a cihna phawkkawmin nakpi takin nasepna tawh na khempeuhah a zawngkhalte huh ding hi hang, ci-in note kiangah kong lak khinzo hi," ci-in a vaikhak hi.
Paul in hih bangin a kam vaikhak a man khit ciangin a vekpi-un khukdin' uh a, Paul in thu a ngen hi.
Paul in, "Kuamah in nong mukik nawn kei ding uh hi," a cihna hangin a dah mahmah uh hi. Amaute in teembaw tung ciangdong Paul a hong kha uh hi.
Saipras tuikulh a kigal muhna mun ka tun' uh ciangin tua tuikulh leitaw lampang kantanin Syria gam lam manawhin ka paisuak uh a, Taia khua ka tun' uh ciangin teembaw in a van puakte suah ahih manin teembaw tung pan ka tuakkhia uh hi.
Tua khua-ah ka kan uh leh thu um mi pawlkhat na om uh a, amaute kiangah nipikal khat sung ka taam uh hi. Jerusalem khua-ah Paul a pailohna dingin Kha Siangtho' lamlahna tawh amaute in a gen uh hi.
Amaute kiang panin ka ciahkhiat ding uh hun hong tun' ciangin ka dingkhia uh a, a zite a tate uh tawh a vekpi-un khuanawl ciang hong zui uh hi. Tuipi gei ka tun' uh ciangin khukdin'in thu ka ngen uh hi.
A zing ciangin ding leuleu-in Sisaria khua ka tung uh a, Pasian thu a hilh Filip' inn-ah tungin tua lai-ah ka taam uh hi. Tuapa pen Jerusalem khua-a a kiteel mi sagihte sungah a kihel ahi hi.
Kote' kiangah amah hong pai-in Paul' kawnggak hong laksak a, tua kawnggak tawh ama khut leh a khete a gakcip khit ciangin, "Kha Siangtho in, 'Jerusalem khuasungah hih bangin Jew mite in hih kawnggak neipa hencip ding a, Gentail mite' khutsungah pia ding hi,' ci hi," a hong ci hi.
Hih thu ka zak uh ciangin kote leh tua lai-a om thu um mite in Jerusalem-ah Paul a pailohna dingin ka thum uh hi.
Ahi zongin Paul in, "Bang hangin hih bangin kapin ka lungsim a tapkhapna dingin gamta na hi uh hiam? Jerusalem khua-ah khihcipna a thuakding bek hiloin, Topa Jesuh hangin a si ding ciangdongin a kithawisa ka hi hi," ci-in a hong dawng hi.
Thu ka genpihpih uh hangin hong mang zolo ahih manin, ka cihna ding uh thei nawnloin, "Topa' deihna bangbang hi ta hen," ci-in ka omta uh hi.
Tua lai-ah tawlkhat ka taam khit uh ciangin ka vante uh kithawi-in Jerusalem khua a zuan dingin ka din'khiat uh ciangin,
Sisaria khua panin thu um mi pawlkhat in zong hong zui uh a, ka tun'na ding uh Mnason' inn-ah hong paipih uh hi. Mnason pen Saipras tuikulh gammi hi a, sawt peka kipanin thu um mi a na hi khinsa ahi hi.
Jerusalem khua ka tun' uh ciangin thu um mite in lungdam mahmahin a hong hopih uh hi.
Paul in amaute hopih a, Pasian in amah Paul tung tawnin Gentail mite lakah na a sepna khempeuh a banbanin a cingtakin a gen hi.
Gentail mite laka om Jew mi khempeuh tungah na thuhilhna, amaute in Moses thukham zuiloin, Jew ngeina zui nawnloin, a tate uh zong vun a atlohna dingun na thugente khempeuh, hih lai-a om Jew mite tungah kigen hi.
Hih lai nong tun'khitna thu amaute in pelloin zakhin ding uh ahih manin bangcih ding ihi hiam?
Tua mite tawh va kipawl in la, a kisian'suahna uhah nang zong va kihelin, a sum beiteng khempeuh nangmah in sik in. A kisian'suah khit uh ciangin amaute in a sam uh met thei ta ding uh hi. Hih bangin gamta lecin a beisa huna nangma thu a kigente khempeuh a man khat zong omloin, nangmahmah zong Moses Thukham a zui na hihna thu mi khempeuh in hong thei ding uh hi.
Thu um Gentail mite tawh kisai-in ahih leh, amaute in milim biakna an khat peuhpeuh, sasi, leh a si kiluangkhiasak loin gawlmek-a kigo sate a nek lohna ding uh, leh numei tawh khialhna panin a kikepna ding uh hoih hi, ci-in thu khensatin lai ka khak khinzo uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Paul, a zing ciangin tua mi lite tawh va pai khawmin kisian'suahna a va bawl uh hi. Tua ciangin biakinn sungah amah va pai a, a kisian'suah hun sung uh a hun sawt ding tan, tua mi lite-a' dingin biakna a kipiak ding ni a va zasak hi.
"Israel mite aw, hong huh un. Mun khempeuhah thu hilh kawikawi-in, Moses Thukham, leh hih biakinn langpangin mi khempeuh kiangah Israel mite a hong gensiapa ahi hi. Tu-in Gentail mite nangawn biakinn sungah hong paipihin hih biakinn siangtho a ninsak hi," ci-in a awng uh hi.
(Hih bang a cih theihna uh pen khua sungah Paul leh Efesa khuami Trofimas a kikhawl mu uh a, Paul in biakinn sungah tua mipa a lutpih a sa kha uh ahi hi.)
Mihonte in Paul that dingin a kithawi laitakun Jerusalem khuasung buai mahmah hi, ci-in Rom galkapmangpa kiangah thu na kipuak hi.
Galkapmangpa in zong thakhatin galkapbute leh galkapte samin mihonte lak a va kiden'na uh hi. Mihonte in galkapte tawh hong pailam a muh uh ciangin Paul a sat nawn kei uh hi.
Paul kiangah galkapmangpa hong pai-in man a, sikkhau nih tawh Paul a khihna dingun thu a pia hi. Tua ciangin, "Hih mipa kua hi a, bang gamta ahi hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin,
mihonte sung panin pawlkhat in thu khat genin, pawlkhat in adang khat a gen hi. Mihon kibuai lua a, bang teng taktak hiam, cih theikhia zolo ahih manin galkap inn-ah a paipihna dingun a mite thu a pia hi.
Galkap huangsung lutna kahlei a tun' uh ciangin mihonte in nehcip lua uh ahih manin galkapte in Paul laamto-in a paipih uh hi.
Amaute in galkap huangsungah Paul a lutpih dektak laitakun Paul in galkapmangpa kiangah, "Nang tung thu tawmkhat kong genthei ding hiam?" ci-in a dot ciangin galkapmangpa in, "Grik pau siam hilo na hi hiam?
Tua ahih manin tu-ma lamin kumpi lehdo dingin mihing tul li tawh gamsungah a pai Egypt mipa hi buang kei ni teh maw?" a ci hi.
Galkapmangpa in zong thu a gending phal ahih manin kahlei cial tungah Paul ding a, mite a gamdaihna dingin a khut a van hi. Mite a gamdaih khit ciangin Paul in Hebru pau-in mite tungah thu gen a,
"Pate, ute, khan'gualte aw, hih thu-ah bangmah ka mawhlohna thu kong gen laitakin na ngai un," a ci hi.
"Kei pen Silisia gam Tarsas khua-a suak Jew mi ka hi a, ahi zongin hih lai Jerusalem khua-ah Gamaliel' khutsungah sangnaupang hi-in a khangto ka hi hi. I pu i pate' Thukham limtakin hong kihilh a, tu-a note zah mahin Pasian tungah a kipia mi khat ka hi hi.
Hih Thu a zui numei pasal a kuamah peuh manin thong sung ka den'na a, sihna ciangdongin amaute ka bawlsia hi.
Hih ka thugente a man ahihna thu, siampi lianpenpa leh upa khempeuh in hong genthei ding uh hi. Damaskas khua-a om i Jew mipihte ka lah dingin amaute in lai hong pia uh ahih manin, upate in gim a piaktheihna dingun tua khua-a om thu um mite manin sikkhau khihin Jerusalem khua-ah a ciahpih dingin ka va pai hi.
"Damaskas khua a zuan dingin pai-in ka tun' dektak sunkim pawl laitakin, thakhatthu-in van panin ka kimkot hong tangzaih hi.
Ka tonpih mite in a khuavak taang mu uh a, ahi zongin kei' tungah thu hong genpa' awging zalo uh hi.
Tua ciangin kei zong, 'Topa aw, bangci gamtat ding ka hi hiam?' ci-in ka dot ciangin amah in, 'Tho in la, Damaskas khua-ah pai in. Nang' hih dingin Pasian in a sehsa thu khempeuh, tua khua panin hong kigen ding hi,' a hong ci hi.
Tua khuavak taanglua hangin khua muthei nawnlo ka hih manin ka tonpihte in ka khutin hong lenin Damaskas khua-ah a hong paipih uh hi.
Tua ciangin amah in, 'I pu i pate' Pasian in ama deihna a thei ding, a thuman a Nasempa a mu ding, leh ama kam mahmah tawh a thugen a za dingin nang hong teel khinzo hi.
Tua ahih manin na muhsa leh na zaksa thu khempeuh, mi khempeuh tungah genin teci a pang ding na hi hi.
Tu-in bang ngak lai ding na hi hiam? Tho in la, Pasian kiangah thu ngenin kituiphum in la, na mawhnate silsiangsak in,' hong ci hi.
Tua ka maang sungah Topa in kei kiangah, 'Hih lai-a om mite in keima thu na gennate hong umlo ding uh ahih manin Jerusalem khua panin kuankhia mengmeng in,' hong ci hi.
Nangma thu a gen Stefen a kithah laitakin keimahmah zong ka om a, tua a kithahna thukimpihin a thatte' puante nangawn ka kepsak hi,' ci-in ka dawng hi.
Paul in Gentail mite kianga paina ding thu a gen matengin mite in limtakin a ngai uh hi. Ahi zongin tu-a thu a pulak ciangin a aw neihzah uh tawh mite kiko-in, "Leitungah hih bang mi omsak kei un! That un! A hing dingin kilawm lo!" ci-in a awng uh hi.
Mihonte hehlua-in awngkeekgawp uh a, a puan uh suahin vanah lawnin, leivui zong van lamah a lawn uh hi.
Tua ciangin Rom galkapmangpa in galkap huangsungah Paul a paipihna dingun thu pia a, bang hangin Jew mite hih bangin ama tungah hehin awngkekgawp uh ahi hiam, ci-in a theihna dingin a satsak hi.
Amaute in sat dingin a hen khit uh ciangin Paul in a gei-a ding galkapbupa kiangah, "Khial hi, ci-in thu nangawn a kisit nailo Rom mi khat na sat ding uh ngeina ahi hiam?" a ci hi.
Galkapbupa in hih thu a zak ciangin galkapmangpa kiangah pai-in, "A bangci na hi hiam? Hua mipa, Rom gammi ahi hi," a cih ciangin,
galkapmangpa zong Paul kiangah va pai-in, "Rom gammi na hi hiam, hong gen dih in," a cih leh Paul in, "Ka hi mah hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ciangin galkapmangpa in, "Hih Rom gammi suahna dingin sum tampi tawh ka lei hi," a ci hi. Paul in, "Kei ka pian'in Rom mi-a piang ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Paul thu a dong dingin a gei-a om mite a paikhia uh hi. Sikkhau tawh a khih khit ciangin Paul pen Rom gammi ahihna a phawk ciangin galkapmangpa zong lau-in a lunghimawh hi.
Jew mite in bang hangin Paul mawhsak ahi uh hiam, ci-in teltakin galkapmangpa in theinuam ahih manin a zing ciangin Paul a khihsakna sikkhaute sutsak a, siampi liante leh upate thu kikupna a nei dingin a samsak hi. Tua ciangin Paul paikhiatpihin uliante mai-ah a dingsak hi.
Paul in ulian kikhawmte limtakin enin, "Lawmte aw, tuni ciangdong ka nuntak sung tawntung, Pasian mai-ah kisuan'na ka nei het kei hi," a cih leh
siampi lianpenpa Ananias in Paul gei-a omte kiangah, "A muk na betsak un," a ci hi.
Paul in, "Leikang tawh a kizut kulh tawh a kibangpa aw, Pasian in nang hong benggawp taktak ding hi. Keimah thusitna-ah Thukham a zui dingpa hinapi-in Thukham zuiloin kei hong kibetna dingin thu na pia hi," a ci hi.
Paul gei-a om mite in, "Pasian' siampi lianpenpa na zahko hi," a cih ciangun
Paul in, "Lawmte aw, siampi lianpenpa ahihlam ka thei kei hi. Lai Siangtho in, 'Na mite uh a ukpa na gensia kei ding uh hi,' ci hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Paul in tua uliante lakah Saddusi mi leh Farisi mi a omlam a muh ciangin amaute kiangah, "Lawmte aw, kei pen Farisi mite' suan ahi Farisi mi ka hi hi. Mi site hingkik ding hi, ci-in lamenin upna ka neih manin hih lai-ah thusitna ka thuak hi," a ci hi.
Tua thu a gen khit phetin Saddusi mite leh Farisi mite kitawngpah uh a, tua uliante khen nih a pha uh hi.
(Bang hang hiam cih leh Saddusi mite in mi a sih khit ciangin hingkik nawnlo ding hi. Vantung mi ahi a, kha ahi zongin omlo hi, ci uh hi. Ahi zongin Farisi mite in hih thu thumte om hi, ci-in a um uh hi.)
Amau' kitotna awging hupha semsem a, Farisi mite pawlsunga om Thukham hilh siate pawlkhat hong dingin nakpi takin hong pau uh a, "Hih mipa tungah khialhna themkhat zong omlo hi. Vantung mi ahi a, Pasian' sawl khat peuhpeuh in ahi zongin ama tungah thu a gen hi khathei ding hi," a ci uh hi.
Amaute' kitotna hong husia semsem ahih manin amaute in Paul balthanggawp khading hi, ci-in galkapmangpa lunghimawh hi. Tua ahih manin galkapte in Paul va kaikhia-in galkap inn-ah a paipihna dingun thu a pia hi.
Tua zanin Paul kiangah Topa hong ding a, "Hang takin om in. Hih Jerusalem khuasungah keima thu genin teci na pan' mah bangin Rom khuapi-ah zong keima thu genin teci na pang ding hi," a ci hi.
Siampi liante leh upate kiangah pai uh a, "Paul ka thahkhit mateng uh anletui ka neklohna dingun khauhtakin thuciamna khat ka nei khin uh hi.
Tu-in note leh uliante in galkapmangpa tungah thu zasak un la, Paul' thu a cingin a theinuam kineihin, note kiangah Paul hong paipihsakna dingin na ngen un. Hih lai mun hong tun'ma-in kote in lamkalah ka na that ding uh hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Paul in galkapbute khat samin ama kiangah, "Galkapmangpa kiangah hih tangvalpa va paipih in. Amah in thugen ding khat a nei hi," a ci hi.
Galkapbupa in zong galkapmangpa kiangah va paipih a, "Hih tangvalpa in nang tungah gennop khat hong nei ahih manin nang kiangah kong paipihna dingin thongkia Paul in a hong sawl hi," a ci hi.
Galkapmangpa in zong a khutin tuapa lenin amau gel guak paikhia uh a, "Bang hong gennuam na hi hiam?" ci-in a dong hi.
Tangvalpa in, "Uliante in Paul' thu a cingin a theinuam kineihin, zing ciangin amaute kiangah Paul na paisakna dingin Jew mi aana neite in ngetding a thukim uh hi.
Ahi zongin lamkalah Paul a pangsim dingin mihing sawmli val bang om uh ahih manin amaute' hong ngetna pia kei in. Tua mihing sawmlite in Paul a thahkhit mateng uh anletui a neklohna dingun kiciamna khat bawlkhin uh hi. Amaute a kithawisa-in om uh a, nangma thupiak ding bek a ngak uh ahi hi," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin galkapmangpa in tangvalpa kiangah, "Kei kiangah hih thu nong kohna thu kuamah theisak kei in," ci-in a vaikhak khit ciangin a ciahsak hi.
Tua ciangin galkapmangpa in galkapbute nih samin, "Sisaria khua-ah a pai ding galkap za nih sam un la, sakol tung tuang galkap sawmsagih leh teitawi galkap za nih tawh zong pai un la, tuzan nai kua hunin dingkhia un.
Paul' tuan'na ding sakol pawlkhat zong keng un la, Menzipa Feliks kiangah hoihtakin va tun'pih un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin galkapmangpa in hih a nuai-a bangin lai khat gelh hi:
Thong khiatna ding leh sihna thuakna dingin khialhna a bawlna bangmah ka mu kei hi. A mawhsaknate uh amau' thukham ngeina tawh kisai hi lel hi.
Jew mite pawlkhat in amah a thahsawmna thu hong kikoh ciangin nangma kiangah puak dingin ka ngaihsun hi. Amah a mawhsakte in nangma mai-ah thu a hong genna dingun amaute kiangah ka gen hi," ci-in a gelh hi.
Amaute in Sisaria khua-ah Paul tun'pih uh a, menzipa kiangah a lai puak uh pia-in, ama tungah Paul a ap uh hi.
"Na langte hong tun' ciangin thu kong sit ding hi," ci-in a gen khit ciangin, Herod in a lam innsungah Paul koihin a cin'na dingun thu a pia hi.
Tua khit ni nga ciangin siampi lianpenpa Ananias leh upate, amau' thu a gensak ding Tertullas a kici mipa tawh Jerusalem khua panin Sisaria khua-ah hong tung uh a, menzipa Feliks kiangah pai-in Paul a mawhsakna uh thute a va gen uh hi.
Thugen dingin Tertullas a kisawl ciangin hih a nuai-a bangin mawhsakna thu a gen hi: "A Lian Menzipa! Nangma hong makaih siamna hangin hun saupi sungnuamtakin ka omkhin uh a, kote' gamsung a hoihna dingin puahphatna zong tampi tak kibawl khin hi.
Na hun tampi tak hong beisak nuamlo ka hih manun thu a tom theithei-a kong gennate uh hehpihna tawh nong ngaihna dingin ka hong thum uh hi.
Hih mipa, buaina a piangsak, a kihtakhuai mi ahihna ka mu uh hi. Mun khempeuha om Jew mite lakah buaina piangsak a, Nazareth mi pawl a kicite a makaipa ahi hi.
Ahi zongin galkapmangpa Lysias hong pai-in kote kiang panin amah hong kaikhia hi.
Tua ciangin amah a mawhsakte, nangma kiangah hong paina dingin Lysias in thu a pia hi.) Tu-in hih mipa thu sit lecin, ka mawhsakna uh thu khempeuh nangmah in na thei ding hi," a ci hi.
Jew mite in zong pan'pih uh a, hih a gen khempeuh a man mah ahi hi, ci-in a gen uh hi.
Paul in thu a genna dingin menzipa in a khut tawh a lah ciangin Paul in, "Hih minamte tungah thukhenin sauveipi na omkhitna thu ka hongthei hi; kei hong kimawhsaknate nangma mai-ah pheltheihna ding hun ngah ka hih manin ka nuam mahmah hi.
Nangmahmah in na theihding mah bangin, Jerusalem khua-ah Pasian bia dingin ka paina pen ni sawm leh ni nih khawng pha pan hi.
Biakinnsung ahi a, kikhopna innsung ahi a, khuasung mun khat peuhpeuhah ahi zongin mi khat peuhpeuh tawh ka kitotna ahi a, mihon in thusia a bawlna dingin ka hanthotna ahi zongin, hih Jew mite in hong mu hetlo ding uh hi.
Tu-a kei hong mawhsaknate uh zong a manna thu hong lakthei hetlo ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin nangma kiangah kong pulaknop thu in: Amaute in manlo hi, a cih uh tua Thu zui-in kote' pu leh pate' Pasian ka bia hi. Moses' Thukham laibu sunga a kigelh thu khempeuh leh kamsangte' laibu sunga a kigelhte khempeuh zong ka um hi.
Amaute' up leh lamet mah bangin, Pasian in miphate leh misiate a kibangin sihna panin hingkik sak khawm ding hi, ci-in umin ka lamen hi.
Tua ahih manin Pasian mai leh mite mai-ah lungsim kisuan'na a om hetlo dingin a tawntungin ka gamta hi.
"Jerusalem panin kum tampi sung ka paikhiat khit ciangin ka mipihte a kihuhna sumte a puakding leh gan go-in Pasian a bia dingin Jerusalem-ah ka pai hi.
Biakinn sungah keimah kisian'suahna ka bawlkhit hun ciangin amaute in kei hong mu uh a, buaina zong bangmah omlo hi.
Tua laitakin Asia gam panin a hong pai Jew mite pawlkhat om uh hi. Kei mawhsakna ding thu a neih uh leh amaute mahmah hong pai-in nangma mai-ah hong gen ding uh a kilawm ahi hi.
Amaute' mai-ah, 'Mi site hingkik ding hi, ci-in ka upna hangin kei tungah thu nong khen uh hi,' ci-in ka gen simloh amaute' hehna ding bangmah omlo hi," ci-in thu a gen hi.
Tua ciangin tua Thu paizia teltakin a thei Feliks in a thusitna hialbawl a, "Galkapmangpa Lysias hong tun' ciangin na thu uh kong khensak ding hi," ci-in a genkhit ciangin,
Paul cin'ding tavuan a la bupa kiangah thu pia a, "Paul hoihtakin cingsak in la, ahi zongin a lawmte in a kisapna peuhpeuh a piaktheihna dingun kimuh theihna ding hun pia zel in," ci-in a vaikhak hi.
Tua zawh a sawtloin Feliks leh Jew mi ahi a zi Drusilla, Paul a kikhumna-ah hong pai-in amah samkhiasak uh a, Paul in Jesuh Khrih upna thu a gennate a nupa-un a ngai uh hi.
Ahi zongin Paul in thu gengenin, a hoihin a gamtatna ding, pumpi ki-uk zawhna ding, leh hong tungding Thukhenna Hunte a gen tohtoh ciangin, Feliks hong lau a, "Va paikik phot in. Hun ka ngah ciangin kong samkik ding hi," ci-in a gen hi.
Tua gam a uk dingin Festas hong tun'zawh ni thum ciangin Sisaria khua panin Jerusalem khua-ah a va zin hi.
Tua lai panin siampi liante leh Jew upate in Paul a mawhsakna thu uh ama kiangah na gen uh hi. Amaute in lamkalah Paul thatlum nuam uh ahih manin Jerusalem khua-ah Paul a paisakna dingin Festas kiangah nakpi takin a thum uh hi.
Paul in khialhna khat peuhpeuh gamta kha ahih leh zong ama khialhna thu a gen dingin na makaite un kei hong zui uh hen," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua lai-ah Festas ni giat, ni sawm bang a taam khit ciangin Sisaria khua-ah a ciah hi. A zing ciangin thukhen tokhom tungah tu a, ama mai-ah Paul a kipaipihna dingin thu a pia hi.
Paul hong kipaipih ciangin Jerusalem khua panin a hong pai Jew mite in amah umcih a, thu lianpipi tawh Paul a mawhsakna uh tampi gen uh a, ahi zongin a mawhsaknate uh man hi, ci-in a lahtel theih uh bangmah omlo hi.
Paul in, "Jew mite' Thukham ahi a, Rom gam uk kumpipa tungah ahi zongin ka khialhna bangmah om hetlo hi," ci-in a kisut hi.
Paul in, "Keimah thu hong kisitna ding munin a kilawmna, gam uk kumpipa thukhenna mai-ah ka va ding ding hi. Nangmahmah in zong teltakin na theihding bangmahin Jew mite tungah bangmah siatna ka bawl kei hi.
Tua zawh tawlkhat khit ciangin gam uk kumpipa' khutnuai mahah a uksawn Agrippa leh a sanggamnu Bernis, a hong tung thak Festas kiangah a hawh dingin Sisaria khua-ah a hong pai uh hi.
Jerusalem khua-ah ka va pai ciangin Jew siampi liante leh upate in amah a mawhsakna uh thu tampi gen uh a, amah mawhsakin thu ka khenna ding hong gen uh hi.
Ahi zongin ke'n ka dawn'na-ah, 'Mi khat peuhpeuh in mawhsakna a thuak ciangin, mawhsakna a thuakpa leh a mawhsakte maitang kimu-in thu kisel a, mawhsakna a thuakpa in amah a kiphel theihna ding thugenna hun a ngah matengin, mawhsak thukhenna piakding pen Rom ngeina hilo hi,' ka ci hi.
Ka cih mah bangin hih lai-ah amaute a hong tun' uh a zing ciangin thukhenna tokhom tungah tu pahin, a mipa hong kipaipihna dingin thu ka pia hi.
Alangte hong ding uh a, a mawhna a lianpipi hong gen ding uh hi, ci-in ka up leh, tua bang hong hilo hi.
Amau' thu kituhna pen amau' biakna thu, leh a si khinsa hinapi-in Paul in, 'Hing hi,' a cih Jesuh' thu peuh na hi lel hi.
Hih bang thu ka kankhiatna dingzia theilo ka hih manin Paul kiangah, 'Hih thute tawh kisai-in thu kisit dingin Jerusalem-ah va pai lecin na ut hiam?' ci-in ka dot leh amah utlo hi.
Tua ciangin Agrippa in Festas kiangah, "Keimahmah in hih mipa' thugen zanuam ing," a cih ciangin, "Zing ciangin na za ding hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
Tua ahih manin a zing ciangin a thupi takin lian bawl mahmahna tawh Agrippa leh Bernis hong pai uh a, galkapmangte leh khuasung uliante tawh kikhopna inn lianpi sungah a hong lut uh hi. Tua ciangin Festas in Paul hong kitumpihna dingin thu a pia hi.
Tua ciangin Festas in, "Kumpi Agrippa leh hih lai-a om mi khempeuh aw, hih lai khua hita leh Jerusalem khua-ah hita leh Jew mi khempeuh in kei tungah amah mawhsakna thu hong gen uh hih mipa na mu uh hi. Hih mipa hin'khawi ding kilawm lo hi, ci-in amaute awnggawp uh hi.
Ahi zongin kumpipa tungah bangteng taktak gelh ding cih ka thei kei hi. Tua ahih manin ama thu a kikan khit ciangin ka gelhding thu ka theihna dingin note mai-ah, a diakdiakin kumpipa Agrippa mai-ah amah kong paipih hi.

Jew mi taktak i cihte pen, a sunglamah Jew mi ahite ahi hi. A vun ki-atna uh lungsim vun atna hi a, kha thu tawh a kisai ahi hi. Thukham zui-in pumpi tung vun atna pawl hilo hi. Hih bang mite pen mihingte in phatloin Pasian in phatin a pakta hi.
Tua ahih leh Jew mite in Gentail mite sangin bang hamphatna neizaw a, vun ki-atna in bang phattuamna nei ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin Jew mi pawlkhatte in Pasian' thuciamna zuilo uh hi. Hih mi pawlkhatte' thu palsatna hangin Pasian in a thuciamna maimangsak dingin ngaihsun na hi uh hiam?
Tua bang hi hetlo hi. Lai Siangtho sungah, "Thu na gen peuhmah ciangin a man na genna thu mite in hong thei ding uh a, mite in nang hong mawhsakna na genkik ciangin na kiphellah ding khat beek omlo ding hi," ci-in a kigelh mah bangin mi khempeuh in zuau a gen zongin Pasian in thuman gen veve ding hi.
Pasian a manin gamta ahihna eite' gamtat khialhna in kilangsak semsem ahih ciangin eite in bang gen ding nei nawn ihi hiam? Pasian in eite gim a hong piak ciangin a thumanlo ahi hiam? (Hih bangin thu ka gen ciangin leitung mihingte' kammal zat ngeite a zang ka hi hi.)
Gim hong piakna-ah a thumanlo hi hetlo hi. A thumanlo hi zenzen leh bangci-in leitung mi khempeuh' thu khenthei ding ahi hiam?
Keima zuautatna in Pasian a thumanna kilangsakin a min thangsak semsem ahih leh bang hangin mawhnei-in kei hong kiseh lailai ahi hiam?
Thupha a pian'na dingin gamtat sia gamta ni, ci ding ihi hiam? Mi pawlkhatte in tu-a bang teek mahin gen hi, ci-in hong mawhsak uh a, ka heh theihtheihna dingin kam a pau se uh hi. Tua bang mite in amau thuak dingin a kilawm gimna a thuak ding uh hi.
Tua ahih leh Gentail mite sangin ko Jew mite hamphazaw ka hi uh hiam? Bangmah hamphatna nei tuanlo hi ung. Jew mite leh Gentail mite a kibangin mawhna khutsungah om uh hi, ci-in ka gen khinzo hi.
Lai Siangtho sungah zong, "Pasian' muhna-ah mi man kuamah omlo a,
a man a thei kuamah omlo a, Pasian tawh kipawl ding a hanciam kuamah omlo hi.
Kuamah in Pasian ngaihsutna neilo uh a, na-a kimang kuamah omlo a, a hoih gamtat kuamah omlo hi.
Nopna a pian'na dingin gamta ngeilo uh a,
Pasian zahtak ding ngaihsutin neilo uh hi," ci-in a kigelh hi.
Tua ahih manin kuamah in paulap a zon' theihlohna ding leh mi khempeuh in Pasian' thukhenna a thuak theihna dingin Thukham a nei mite khempeuh in tua Thukham a zuihding uh ahihna thu i thei hi.
Thukham in mihingte a mawhna kilangsak thei bek ahih manin thukham zuihna hangin kuamah in Pasian tawh kipawl theihna ngah zolo hi.
Ahi zongin tu-in thukham zuihna hang hiloin thudang khat hangin Pasian tawh kipawl theihna ding lampi hong kilangzo a, Thukham leh kamsangte in zong hih thu-ah teci a pang uh hi.
Tua thu in: Jew mi leh Gentail mi kuamah a kilamdan'na omloin Jesuh Khrih upna hangin mi khempeuh in Pasian tawh kipawl theihna a ngah hi.
Ama hong sihna hangin mawhna a kimaisak theihna dingin Pasian in Jesuh hong pia a, amah a umte in mawhmaisakna a ngah uh hi. Amah tawh i kipawl theihna ding zia hong lahna-in hih bangin Pasian a hong gamta ahi hi. Pasian a lungduaina hangin a beisa hunah i mawhnate hong en khong phot hi.
Ahi zongin tuhun ciangin Jesuh a um mi khempeuh Pasian tawh a kipawl theihna ding leh amah thuman ahihna a kilatsakna dingin mihingte' mawhna tawh kisai-in na hong sem hi.
Tua ahih leh mihingte in i kisialhpih ding bang om ahi hiam? Bangmah omlo hi. Bang bulphuh ding ihi hiam? Thukham zuihna bulphuh ding ihi hiam? Hilo hi. I upna a bulphuh ding ihi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh mi khatpeuh Pasian tawh a kipawl theihna pen Thukham zuihzawhna hang hiloin upna hang hi, ci-in i genzo hi.
Pasian, Jew mite' Pasian bek hi a, Gentail mite' Pasian hilo ahi hiam? Gentail mite' Pasian zong hi veve hi.
Tua ahih leh hih upna thu i gen ciangin Thukham a phiat ihi hiam? Hilo hi; a kipsak semsem ihi hi.
Tu-in eite' pian'na i pupi Abraham' thu ngaihsun ni. Ama tunga thupiang hih bang ahi hi:
Abraham in a sepna hangin amah tawh a kipawl dingin Pasian in sang hi leh Abraham in kisialhpih ding thu a nei ahi hi. Ahi zongin Pasian' mai-ah Abraham a kisialhna ding bangmah thu omlo hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian' maipha ngahna dingin nasepna suangloin upna a suang mipa pen Pasian in mimawh kimlai midik hi, ci-in sang ahih manin, amah tawh a kipawl theihna dingin Pasian in tua mipa' upna thupi san' hi.
Tua ahih manin nasepna hang tawh hiloin Pasian in mi khat midikin a san'na hangin David in zong a lungdamna thu na gen a,
"Pasian in a mawhnate maisakin a khialhnate a selcipsak mite thupha ngah ahi uh hi.
David in a gen hih thupha pen vun ki-atte bek in ngahthei ahi hiam? Hilo hi; vun ki-atlote in zong ngahthei uh hi. Lai Siangtho in, "Abraham in Pasian um a, tua a upna hangin Pasian in mihoihin a sang hi," ci hi, ci-in i gen khinzo hi.
Hih mihoihin a san' bang hun ahi hiam? Abraham a vun a ki-at ma ahi hiam, a ki-at zawh ahi hiam? A vun a ki-at khit hiloin a ki-at ma ahi hi.
Abraham a vun a ki-at ma-in a upna hangin Pasian in mihoihin a san'na lahtelna dingin a vun a kinung-at ahi hi. Tua ahih manin vun a ki-atloh hangin a upna uh hangin mihoihin a kisang mite khempeuh-a' dingin Abraham pen kha thu lamah pupi ahi hi.
A vun a ki-at ma-in i pupi Abraham a upna hangin a gamtat mah bangin a gamta, a vun a ki-at mite-a' dingin zong Abraham pen pupi mah ahi hi. Tua pen vun ki-at lelna hang hiloin upna hang ahi hi.
Abraham leh a suan a khakte in leitung luah ding hi, ci-in Pasian in thu a ciamna pen Abraham in Thukham a zuihna hang hiloin, a upna hangin Pasian in mihoihin a san'na hang ahi hi.
Thukham zuihna hangin Pasian' thuciamnate a kingah ding hi leh mite' upna pen a kiman'na omloin, Pasian' thuciamnate zong a mawkna suak ding hi.
Thukham in Pasian' hehna ding piangsak hi. Ahi zongin thukham om kei leh thukham zuilo cih zong om theilo hi.
Tua ahih manin Abraham' suanlekhakte khempeuh tungah Pasian' hehpihna piakkhong a suahtheihna dingin Thukham a zuite bek in ngah loin, Abraham' up bangin a umte in zong a ngahtheihna dingun upna bulphuhin thuciamna kipia hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Abraham pen kha thu lamah eite khempeuh' pupi ahi hi.
Lai Siangtho sungah zong, "Minam tampite' pupi dingin ka hong bawl khin hi," ci-in a kigelh hi. Tua hi a, bangmah a om nailopi a thupiakna tawh a omsak thei, a site a hingsak thei, Abraham in a up Pasian' muhna-ah hih thuciamna kipin a kizang ahi hi.
Lai Siangtho sungah, "Na suanlekhakte aksi zahin tam ding hi," ci-in a kigelh mah bangin tua bang a pian'theihna ding lametna a om nailopi mahin Abraham in umin lamen ahih manin minam tampite' pupi a suak hi.
Abraham kum za khat bang pha dektak ta a, a si dektak ta ahihna leh a zi Sarah a ciin'na thute a theih hangin a upna kiam tuanlo hi.
Amah in Pasian' thuciamna muan'lah dingin ngaihsunlo a, a upna khahsuah hetlo hi. A upna hangin thakhauh semsemin Pasian a phat hi.
"A upna pen hoihna-in kisang," ci-in a kigelh ciangin ama-a' ding bekin a kigelh hilo hi.
Sihna panin i Topa Jesuh a hingsakpa a um eite khempeuh zong i upna hangin mihoihin hong kisang ding hi, ci-in eite-a' dingin zong a kigelh ahi hi.
Eite' mawhna hangin a si dingin Jesuh kipia a, Pasian tawh eite i kipawl theihna dingin kihingkik sak hi.
Ama hangin upna tawh tu-a i omna Pasian hehpihna sungah a tung ihi a, Pasian tawh minthan'na ngahkhawm ding, ci-in lamen ihih manin i lung a dam hi.
Pasian in eite tungah a hong piak a Kha Siangtho tawh eite sungah ama itna hong guang ahih manin hih lametna in eite hong lungkiasak ngeilo hi.
Eite cimawhin i om laitakin Pasian' hoihsak hunin ei mi gilote-a' dingin Khrih hong si hi.
Mihoih khat-a' dingin a si ngam a omkha ahi zongin thukham zuizo mipa-a' dingin sih ngamna ding a thu haksa mahmah khat ahi hi.
Ahi zongin eite mawhna nei ihih laitakin eite-a' dingin Khrih hong si ahih manin Pasian in eite hong it mahmahna thu hong lak khin hi.
Pasian tawh eite i kilangneih laitakin ama Tapa' sihna hangin amah tawh hong kilemsak ahih leh tu-in Pasian tawh kipawl khinta ihih manin Khrih nuntakna in eite hong honkhiazo zaw kan ding hilo ahi hiam?
Tuateng bek hilo lai a, Pasian tawh hong kilemsak i Topa Jesuh Khrih hangin Pasian tungah i nuam mahmah hi.
Thukham a omma pekin leitungah mawhna na omkhin a, thukham a omlohna munah Pasian in mawhna a ciamtehna laibu neilo hi.
Ahi zongin Adam huna kipan Moses hun dongin sihna in mite uk a, Adam in Pasian' thupiak a man'loh manin a khialh bangin a khial nailo mite nangawn sihna khutnuai mah hi veve uh hi. Adam pen a hong pai lai ding mipa' lim ahi hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian' hong piak letsong pen Adam' mawhna tawh kibang lo ahih manin tuate gel tehkak theihding hilo hi. Tua mi khat a khialhna hangin mi tampi a sihna pen a man mah ahi hi. Ahi zongin Pasian' hong itna leh hong hehpihna nakpi takin lianzaw lai a, mi khat ahi tua Jesuh Khrih' hehpihna hangin mi tampi tak tungah hong kipia letsong lian mahmah hi.
Pasian' letsong leh mi khat' mawhna a hatna zia kilamdang hi. Khialhna khat a om khit ciangin, "Mawh hi," ci-in thukhenna kipia a, ahi zongin khialhna tampi tak a om khit ciangin a kilawm lopi mahin, "Dik hi," cihna piakkhong thupha a om hi.
Mi khat bek' mawhna hangin sihna in hong uk ahih leh mi khat mah ahi Jesuh Khrih hangin nakpi takin a lian Pasian' hehpihna leh mihoih-a san'na a ngah mite nungta-in thahatzaw kan ding uh hi.
Mi khat in thu a man'loh manin mi tampi mimawh a suahsak mah bangin mi khat in thu a man'na hangin mi tampi in Pasian tawh kipawl theihna a ngah ding uh ahi hi.
Khialhna a tam semsemna dingin thukham hong kipia hi. Ahi zongin khialhna a tamna munah Pasian' hehpihna hong lianzaw zel hi.
Tua ahih manin mawhna thahatin hong sihsak mah bangin, i Topa Jesuh Khrih hangin Pasian' hehpihna thahat zaw lai a, mihoihin hong sangin nuntak tawntungna sung a hong tun'pih hi.
Tua ahih leh Pasian' hehpihna a liattheihna dingin mawhna bawlbawl ding ihi hiam?
Tua bang hi deklo ding hi. Mawhna thu-ah a si eite in bangci-in mawhna bawl thei nawn ding ihi hiam?
Khrih Jesuh tawh i kipawl theihna dingin ama sungah a kiphum eite pen ama sihna mahah zong a sikhawm ihihlam theilo na hi uh hiam?
I Pa' vangliatna tawh sihna panin Khrih a kithawhsak kik mah bangin eite zong nuntakna thak i nuntak theihna dingin tui i kiphum ciangin amah tawh kiphum khawmin a sikhawm ihi hi.
Mawhna khutnuai-ah eite i om nawnlohna dingin mawhnopna lungsim i neihnateng i sucip a, singlamteh tungah Khrih a sih laitak mahin i ngeina luiteng a sisak khawm ihihna thu i thei hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh sihna panin Khrih kihingkik sak khin a, si kik ngei nawnlo ding hi. Ama tungah sihna in vangliatna nei nawnlo hi, ci-in i thei hi.
Ama sihna pen mawhna thu tawh kisai-a sihna hi a, sih kikkik kulloin a kuamah peuh zong khatvei bek a kisi ahi hi. Tu-a a nuntakna pen Pasian' thu tawh kisai-a nuntakna ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin na pumpi uh deihna na zuihlohna dingun na pumpi uh, mawhna na uksak nawn kei ding uh hi.
Mawhna gamtatna dingin na pumpi nate uh khat beek na zang nawn kei ding uh hi. Note pen misi hinapi-in a kihingkik sak mite bang na hih manun, a hoihin a hong zattheihna dingin na pumpi bup uh Pasian' tungah na piazaw ding uh hi.
Note pen thukham' sawlna hangin nasem hiloin Pasian' hong lah thuhoihte' hangin nasem na hih uh manin mawhna' sawlna mangin na gamta nawn kei un.
Eite pen thukham' uk hiloin Pasian' hehpihna in hong uk ahih manin mawhna i gamta kei ding hi.
Mi khatpeuh' thu a mang dingin ama khutsungah na kipiak uh ciangin a thu na mante uh' sila na hi uh hi. Mawhna na bawl uh leh sihna a thuak ding na hi uh a, thumangin na om uh leh Pasian tawh pawlkhat a suak ding na hi uh hi.
Note' theih theihna dingin nisim nuntakna ziate tawh a hong genteh ka hi hi. Nidang lai-in hoihlohna leh gitlohna a gamta dingin na pumpi uh na buppiak uh mah bangin, tu-in a man nate a sem dingin na pumpi uh buppiak un la, nuntakna siangtho nei ta un.
Mawhna khutsungah na om laitakun Pasian' deihna bangin na gamtat ding uh kisamlo hi.
Ahi zongin tu-in mawhna bawlnopna panin suakta-in Pasian' khutsung mi na hita uh hi. Tua thu hangin na ngah uh na pen Pasian-a' dingin a kipia khin nuntakna hi a, a tawntung nuntakna tawh a kizom ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin a pasal a nuntak hun sungin pasal dang tawh a lupkhawm leh mi tawh a mawh kici hi. Ahi zongin a pasal a si hi leh thukham tawh kisai-in a suakta hi a, pasal dang a ten'pih hangin mi tawh a mawh hilo hi.
Sanggamte aw, note zong tua mah tawh a kibang na hi uh hi. Khrih tawh pumkhat na hihna uh hangin thukham tawh kisai thu-ah a sikhin na hi uh a, Pasian' nasepna-ah eite a man nei i suahtheihna dingin sihna panin a kithosak kik Khrih tawh nupa na hi uh hi.
Ahi zongin nidangin a hong lencip thukham panin Pasian in eite hong suaktasak khin ahih manin tua thukham tawh kisai-ah eite a sikhin ihi hi. Lai sungah a kigelh thukham lui sungah nungta nawnloin, Kha Siangtho' hong piak nuntakna thakah a nungta ihi hi.
Tua ahih leh Thukham mahmah pen a siahuai ahi hiam? A sia hilo hi. Mawhna bang hiam cih Thukham in hong theitel sak hi. Thukham in, "Hazatna lungsim nei kei in," ci-in genlo hi leh, haza i cih bang ahi hiam, ci-in ka thei kei ding hi.
Thukham a omna hangin mawhna in nuamtak sa-in hazatna a tuamtuam ka neihtheihna ding hong piangsak hi. Thukham om kei leh mawhna in bangmah sem theilo hi.
Nuntak ngahna dingin a kibawl thukham pen keima-a' dingin sihna hong hi zawsop hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Thukham mahmah hita leh thupiaknate hita leh hoihin man a, siangtho hi.
Tua ahih leh a hoih na khat in kei' sihna ding hong piangsak ahi hiam? Hilo hi. Tua sihna pen mawhna' nasepna hi a, mawhna pianzia bangci bang taktak hiam, cih a kitheihna dingin a hoih na khat zangin kei tungah sihna a hong piangsak ahi hi. Tua ahih manin thukham a om manin mawhna a siahuai mahmah ahihna hong kilangzaw kan lai hi.
Ka hihnopteng hihkha loin ka hih noplohteng keek mah hih zawsop ka hih manin keima gamtatna mahmah zong ka tel thei kei hi.
Ka hih noplohteng ka hih veve ciangin Thukham a deihhuai khat hi, ci-in ka ngaihsutna hong langsak hi.
Tua ahih manin tua bangin a gamta taktak pen kei hiloin ka sunga om mawhna hizaw hi.
Ka leitung pumpi sungah a hoih na khat beek omlo hi, ci-in ka thei hi. Ka sungah a hoih gamtatnopna lungsim a om hangin ka hihzo kei hi.
A hoih ka gamtatnop teng gamta loin, ka hihnoploh siatnate ka gamta zawsop hi.
Ka gamtat noplohteng ka gamtat veve ciangin tua a gamta pen kei hi nawnloin ka sunga om mawhna a gamta ahihna a hong kilang hi.
Ahi zongin kei' deihloh thudang khat in ka lungsimah na hong sem hi. Tua ka sunga na hong sem pen in mawhna thu-ah kei hong mancip hi.
I Topa Jesuh Khrih in hong honkhiazo ding ahih manin Pasian tungah ka lung a dam hi. Kei' omzia taktak ahih leh: Ka lungsim tawh Pasian' thu ka zui a, ka pumpi in mawhna a piangsak thu a zui hi.
Ahi zongin tu-in ahih leh Khrih Jesuh tawh kipawlin a nungta mite pen mawhna thukhenna tawh kipelh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Khrih Jesuh tawh a hong kipawlsak Kha Siangtho in mawhna leh sihna a piangsak thukham panin kei hong suaktasak khinta hi.
Mihingte thahatlo ihih manin Thukham in a hih zawhloh thute Pasian in a hihzo hi. Mawhna a beisak theihna dingin mihingte sunga om mawhna tungah thu a khenna-in ama Tapa hong sawl a, amah pen mihingte' mawhna lungsim mah a nei-in a hong pai hi.
Eite' deihna bangin nungta loin Pasian' Kha Siangtho' deihna bangin a nungta eite sungah Thukham' deihna teng a kicin' theihna dingin Pasian in a Tapa a hong sawl ahi hi.
I ngaihsutna, i pumpi deihna uksak lehang sihna tawh kizom hi; i ngaihsutna, Kha Siangtho uksak lehang nuntakna leh nopsakna tawh a kizom hi.
Mi khatpeuh in ama pumpi deihna a ki-uksak ciangin Pasian' thukhamte zuilo ahih manin Pasian' gal suak a, a zuihnop hangin zong zui theilo hi.
Amau pumpi deihna bangin a gamtate in Pasian lungdamsak theilo uh hi.
Note sungah Pasian' Kha Siangtho hong om nak leh nomau pumpi deihna bangin gamta loin Kha Siangtho deihna bangin na gamta ding uh hi. Khrih lungsim a neilote Khrih tawh kipawllo hi.
Ahi zongin note sungah Khrih hong om leh mawhna hangin na pumpi uh a si veve ding ahi zongin, note pen Pasian tawh kipawlkhin na hih manun note-a' dingin Kha Siangtho pen nuntakna ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin lawmte aw, i pumpi deihna bang zui-in gamtat ding a kiphamawh hilo hi.
Na pumpi uh deihna zui-in na gamtat uh leh na si ding uh a, ahi zongin Kha Siangtho huhna tawh na mawh gamtatnate uh na sihsak uh leh na nungta ding uh hi.
Note tungah Pasian in a hong piak a Kha Siangtho in note na launa dingun sila-in a hong bawl hilo a, Kha Siangtho in Pasian' tate a hong suaksak ahi zaw hi. Tua Kha Siangtho mah in Pasian pen, "Pa aw, Pa aw," hong ci theisak hi.
Eite, Pasian' tate ihihna thu eima lungsim bek in a gen hiloin Pasian' Kha Siangtho in zong hong genpih hi.
Eite pen ama ta ihih manin mite-a' dingin a koih thuphate i ngah banah Khrih-a' dingin a koihte zong i ngahkhawm lai ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Khrih in a thuak mah bangin i thuak nak leh amah a minthan' mah bangin ei zong i minthang ding hi.
Tuhuna i thuaknate pen Pasian in a hong piakding minthan'na tawh ka ngaihsut khawm ciangin, tuhuna i thuaknate gentham ka sa het kei hi.
Pasian' bawlsate, amau utthu tawh hiloin siatna a thuak dingin Pasian mahmah in a ngaihsutsa ahi hi. Ahi zongin lametna omlai hi.
Pasian' bawlsate, nikhat ni ciangin muattheihna ding thu panin suakta-in Pasian' tate tawh a nuam suahtakna a ngahkhawm ding uh hi.
Tuhun ciangdong Pasian' bawlsa khempeuh nupi nausuak ding bangin na sa-in a tauna uh i thei hi.
Pasian' bawlsa nate bek hilo a, Pasian' hong piakkhong Kha Siangtho maleep a ngah eite mahmah nangawn in zong, Pasian in ama tate-in hong bawlin i buppi-in a hong suahtaksak ding i ngakkawmin thumin tau-in i om hi.
Hih bangin lamenin i upna in eite hong honkhia khin hi. Ahi zongin i lamet pen i muh ciangin tua pen lamet hi nawnlo hi. Kua in a muhsa nate lamen nawn ahi hiam?
I muhlohte i lamet ciangin lungduai takin i ngak thei hi.
Tua ahih manin eite bangzahin ginalo hita lehang eite a hong huh dingin Kha Siangtho a hong pai hi. Eite in a kilawm bangin thunget ding nangawn i thei kei a, ahi zongin Kha Siangtho mah in tauna tawh eite-a' dingin a hong thumsak hi.
Kha Siangtho in Pasian' deihna tawh kizui-in Pasian' mite-a' dingin hong thumsak ahih manin mihingte' lungsimtawng thu a thei Pasian in Kha Siangtho' ngaihsutna a thei hi.
Ama deihna bang a sem dingin Pasian in a hong sap, amah a it eite-a' dingin na khempeuh a hoihlamin piangsak hi, ci-in i thei hi.
Pasian' Tapa mi khempeuh lakah a upa pen a suahtheihna dingin Pasian in a teelkholhsa mite, a Tapa tawh a kibang dingin a sehsa ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin ama sap mite a sehsa hi a, a sap mite amah tawh a kipawlin bawl a, amah tawh a kipawlin a bawl mite ama minthan'na zong a hawm hi.
Hihteng bang ahih khit ciangin bang gen ding om nawn ahi hiam? Pasian in eite hong koppih peuh leh kua in eite hong zo zo ding ahi hiam?
Ama Tapa nangawn sitloin eite khempeuh-a' dingin hong piakhia ahih manin, na dang khempeuh zong hong piazaw kan ding hilo ahi hiam?
Pasian in mawhlo hi, ci-in a gen khitsa ahih manin, Pasian' teelsa mite tungah kua in mawhna guan'thei nawnding ahi hiam?
Tua ahih manin kua in amaute tungah thu khenthei nawnding ahi hiam? Eite-a' dingin a hong thumsakpa pen Pasian' taklamah a tu, a sih khit ciangin sihna panin a kihing kiksak Khrih Jesuh hilo ahi hiam?
Tua ahih manin bang in Khrih' itna tawh hong kikhensakzo ding ahi hiam? Haksatna, lungkhamna, bawlsiatna, gilkialna, zawn'na, lauhuaina, sihnate khat peuhpeuh in hong khenzo ding ahi hiam?
Lai Siangtho sungah zong, "Note hangin sunthapai-in siatna ding lauhuaina ka thuak uh a, gawhding tuu bangin a hong kibawl hi," ci-in a kigelh hi.
Eite a hong itpa' hangin hih thu khempeuhah a gualzo pente ihi hi.
Bangmah in ama hong itna tawh hong kikhensakzo hetlo ding hi, ci-in ka thei hi. Sihna, nuntakna, vantung mite, vantung vangliatnate, tuhun nate leh a hong tungding nate,
leitunga om nate, leinuai-a om nate, Pasian' bawlsa nate khat peuhpeuh in i Topa Khrih Jesuh hangin Pasian in eite hong itna tawh hong khenzo hetlo ding hi.
Kei, Khrih tawh kipawl ka hih manin zuauthu ka gen thei kei hi. Kha Siangtho lamlahna tawh, ka lungsim kitheihna-ah zuaugen hetloin a mantakin ka gen thu in:
Leitung silesa-ah ka mipihte-a' dingin nakpi takin dahin ka lunggimna a khang hi.
Hi thei ding hi leh amaute' hoihna dingin keimah in Pasian' samsiatna thuakin Khrih tawh kikhenna ding ciangdong nangawnin amaute ka huhnuam hi.
Amaute pen Pasian' teel Israel mite hi a, Pasian in ama ta-in bawlin a minthan'na a hopte, amaute tungah thuciamna bawlin Thukham a piakte, a man taktakin biaktheihna nei-in thuciamna a ngahte,
leh a thupi pupite' suanlekhakte hi uh a, leitung silesa tawh kisai-in Khrih zong amau minam sung panin a piang ahi hi. Hih thute hangin mi khempeuh in na khempeuh a uk Pasian phat tawntung ta uh hen! Amen.
Ahi zongin Pasian' thuciamnate a mawkna a suak hi samlo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Israel mi khempeuh Pasian' teel mi hi khinlo hi.
Abraham' suanlekhak khempeuh zong Pasian' tate hi kimlo hi. Pasian in Abraham kiangah, "Na ta Isaac' suanlekhakte bek nangma suanlekhakin kisim ding hi," ci hi.
Tua ahih manin leitung ngeina tawh a suak tate pen Pasian' ta hilo a, Pasian' thuciamna tawh kizui-a a suakte bek suanlekhak taktakin a kisim pan hizaw hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in hih bangin thuciamna bawl a, "A hun a tun' ciangin kong paikik ding a, Sarah in tapa khat a nei ding hi," ci hi.
Tua bek zong hilo lai hi. Rebekah in eite' pupi Isaac tawh tapa nih nei hi.
Pasian' teelna pen a teel mite' nasepna hang hiloin Pasian' sapna tawh kisaizaw hi, ci-in a kilatna dingin a tate a sia a pha a gamtat theihma, a suahma pek mahin
Tua bang ahih leh Pasian thutanglo hi, a kici thei ding hiam? Kici theilo ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mite' utna leh sepna tawh kisailo a, Pasian' hehpihna bek tawh kisaizaw hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho sungah Pasian in Faro kiangah, "Ka vangliatna lahna ding leh leitung khempeuhah ka min a kitheihna dingin kong zatnop manin kumpi a hong suaksak ka hi hi," ci hi.
Tua ahih manin Pasian in a hehpih nopte hehpih a, a paupeen'sak nopte paupeengsak hi.
Note in, "Tua bang ahih leh bang hangin Pasian in mi mawhsak thei ahi hiam? Pasian' cihsa kua in kheelzo ding ahi hiam?" na cinuam khading uh hi.
Lawmte aw, ahi zongin kua in Pasian' thu nialngam ding na hi uh hiam? Beel in amah a sekpa kiangah, "Bang hangin tua bangin hong sek na hi hiam?" ci ngeilo hi.
Beelsekpa in tungman lomkhat sung panin hun thupi diakin zatding beel leh zat mawkmawk ding beelin a ututin sektheihna ding thu a nei hi.
Tua mah bangin Pasian in zong a beisa hunah siatna a thuakdingin a kilawm mite susia loin a ki-ipipna mite tungah a hehna leh a vangliatna a lahtheihna ding thu a neih mah bangin,
ama minthan'na a lahtheihna dingin ama minthan'na a ngahdingin a hong sehsa eite tungah zong ama hehpihna a hong piaktheihna ding thu a nei hi.
Tua bangin a hong sap eite pen Jew mite sung bek pan hiloin Gentail mite sung panin zong ahi hi.
Hosea Lai Siangtho sungah, "Keima mi a hilote, 'Keima mi,' ka ci ding a, ka itloh mite, 'Ka itte,' ka ci ding hi.
Hih thu pen Isaiah mah in, "Vanglian Topa in eite' suanlekhak ding hong sitsaklo hi leh Sodom khua leh Gomorrah khuamite i bang ding hi," ci-in a genkholhsa thu ahi hi.
Tua ahih leh Pasian tawh kipawl theihna ding hanciamna a neilo Gentail mite pen upna hangin Pasian tawh kipawlthei a,
Pasian tawh a kipawl theihna dingin thukham zuihna tawh hanciam napi-in a zuih zawhlohna hangun Israel mite kipawl theilo ahih leh a bangci thu ahi hiam?
Amaute in upna suangloin nasepna a suan' hang uh ahi hi. Amaute pen Lai Siangtho in a gen mah bangin, "Pukna ding suang," a kici tungah a pukkha uh ahi hi.
Lai Siangtho in, "En un, keimah in Zion-ah mite a muktuk theihna ding, mite a puktheihna ding suang khat ka koih hi. Ahi zongin amah a muang mite khempeuh tavai cih om ngeilo ding hi," ci hi.
Sanggamte aw, i mipihte in hotkhiatna a ngahna ding deihsakin lungsim takpi tawh Pasian kiangah thu ka ngetsak hi.
Amaute in Pasian a kin mahmah lamtak uh thei-in teci-in ka pang ngam hi. Ahi zongin amaute in a man lampi tawh kin khalo uh hi.
Amaute in Pasian tawh kipawl theihna ding lampi man theiloin amau theihtawmna tawh hanciam kha uh ahih manin amah tawh kipawl theihna dingin lampi a khun' zui khalo uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh upna a nei mi khempeuh Pasian tawh a kipawl theihna dingin Khrih in Thukham a beisak hi.
Moses in a laigelhna sungah, "Thukham deihna bangin a gamtazo mi khempeuh a nungta ding hi," ci-in Thukham zuihna hangin Pasian tawh kipawl theihna ding thu a na gen hi.
Ahi zongin upna hangin Pasian tawh kipawl theihna thu a kigenna-ah, "Vantungah kua va paito ding a," ci kei un la, "Leinuai-ah kua va paisuk ding ahi hiam?" zong ci kei un, ci hi. Tua a cihna pen vantung panin Khrih a lasuk ding leh sihna panin a thosak ding cihna ahi hi.
Tua bang a cih ciangin, "Pasian' thu pen nai mahmahin note kam sung leh na lungsim sung uhah om hi," a cihnopna ahi hi. Tua Pasian' thu pen kote' hilhhilh, "Pasian um un," cihna thu ahi hi.
Jesuh pen Topa hi, ci-in mite kiangah genin, Pasian in sihna panin amah hingkiksak zo hi, ci-in na lungsim sung uhah na up taktak uh leh hotkhiatna na ngah ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh i lungsimah i up taktakna hangin Pasian tawh kipawl theihna kingah a, i kamin i genna hangin hotkhiatna a kingah ahi hi.
Lai Siangtho in, "Amah a um mi peuhmah tavailo ding hi," ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Jew mi leh Gentail mi a kideidanna omlo ahih manin Topa pen mi khempeuh' Topa hi kim a, ama kiangah a ngen khempeuh tungah thupha tampi tak a pia hi.
Ahi zongin a uplohpa uh tungah kua in thu ngen thei ding ahi hiam? Ama thu za ngei kei leh kua in a thu um thei ding ahi hiam? Ama thu kigen kei leh kua in za thei ding ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin Isaiah in, "Topa aw, ka thugente uh kua in um ahi hiam?" a cih mah bangin Lungdamna Thu a za mi khempeuh in um kimlo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin zakna panin upna hong piangthei a, Khrih thu upna ding pen hilhna panin hong piangthei pan hi.
Tua ahih leh amaute in thu zalo uh ahi hiam? Lai Siangtho sungah, "Amau' awgingte leitung khempeuhah kizel a, a thugente uh in mun khempeuh a ban hi," ci-in a kigelh mah bangin amaute in thu za khinzo uh hi.
Tua ahih leh Israel mite in a thei uh hiam? Moses mahmah in Pasian' min tawh thu na gen a, "Keima mi pawl a hilote thupha pia-in, note' hazat dingin ka bawl ding a, tua mihaite' hangin note na hehna dingun ka hong bawl ding hi," a cih mah bangin Israel mite in a thu a theilo uh hilo hi.
Tua banah Isaiah in Pasian' min tawh hangtakin thu na gen a, "Kei hong zonglo mite in kei hong mu uh a, kei hong kanlo mite tungah ka kilak hi," ci-in na gen hi.
Tua ciangin Israel mite tawh kisai-in, "Ka thu a manglo, kei hong langpang mite tawh ka kilemkik theihna dingin a tawntungin ka hanciam hi," ci-in a na gen hi.
Tua ahih leh Pasian in ama mi Israel-te nialin nusia mangkhin ahi hiam? Tua bang hi deklo hi. Keimahmah zong Abraham' suan Israel mite ka hi a, tua sung panin Benjamin' suan ka hi hi.
Pasian in tanglai panin a teelsa mite nusialo hi. Elijah in Israel mite mawhsakin Pasian kiangah nakpi takin thu a genna Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh theilo na hi uh hiam?
Tua sungah, "Topa aw, Israel mite in na kamsangte thatin nangmah biakna taute phelin susiagawp uh a, kei bekbek ka omlai hi. Kei nangawn thah hong sawm lai uh hi," ci-in kigelh hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in, "Baal milim a bia nailo mihing tul sagih ka nei lai hi," ci-in a dawng hi.
A teelna-ah mite' nasepna bulphuhin a teel hiloin ama dikna hangin a teel hizaw hi. Pasian in mihingte' nasepna bulphuhin a teel hi leh Pasian' dikna pen dikna kici theilo ding hi.
A thu omzia taktak hih bang ahi hi. Israel mi a tamzaw in a hanciamciam uh ngahlo uh hi. Pasian' teel mi tawmkhat bek in ngah uh a, adangte in Pasian' sapna thudonlo uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Lai Siangtho sungah, "Pasian in thu a ngaihsun theilo, khua a phawk theiloin amaute bawl a, amaute in tuni dongin khua mu theilo, khua za theiloin a om uh hi," ci-in a kigelh hi.
Jew mite a puk uh ciangin sia paisuak ahi uh hiam? Sia paisuaklo uh hi. Amau' mawhna hangin Gentail mite in hotkhiatna ngah uh hi. Gentail mite in hotkhiatna a ngah pen Jew mite in en'na lungsim a neihtheihna ding uh deihna ahi hi.
Jew mite' mawhna pen leitung khempeuh thupha ngahna suak a, amau' gitnat lohna pen Gentail mite' hamphatna suak ahih leh Jew mi khempeuh in hotkhiatna a ngahkim uh ciangin bangzahin hoihkan ding ahi hiam?
Tu-in no Gentail mite tungah thu ka hong gennuam hi: No Gentail mite-a' dingin sawltak ka sep sungteng ka nasep a thupi mahmahin ka ngaihsun ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka mipihte in note hong en'theihna ding uh piangsak thei-in, tua manin amaute pawlkhat in hotkhiatna a ngahna ding uh piangsakzo kha dingin ka kilamen hi.
Amaute a kinialna hangin Pasian tawh leitung mi khempeuh kipawl theihna piang ahih leh amaute a kisan' hun ciangin a sisate nangawn a hin'kikna hong hita ding hi.
A kicing oliv kung a hiangte kisatkhia-in gamlak oliv hiangte tawh kipeh hi. No Gentailte pen tua gamlak oliv hiangte tawh a kibang na hi uh a, Jew mite' hamphatna teng a ngahkhawm na hi uh hi.
Tua ahih manin oliv hiang a kisatkhia tawh a kibang Jew mite simmawhbawl kha kei un. Note na kiphatsak theihna ding uh a thu omlo hi. Note pen a hiang tawh a kibang lel na hi uh a, note in a zungpi a hingsak hiloin, a zungpi in note a hong hingsak ahi zaw hi.
Note in, "Eite tawh hong kipeh theihna dingin a hiangte a kisatkhia ahi hi," na cinuam ding uh hi.
Tua pen thuman ahi hi. Amaute in a uplohna hangun a kisatkhia hi a, note in na upna hangun amaute' munah a om na hi uh hi. Tua ahih manin kiphatsakna lungsim nei kei un la, lamdang sakna tawh om khikhe zaw un.
Pasian in oliv hiang ngeite dawmlo ahih leh note hong dawm tuanlo ding hi.
Hih thu-ah Pasian a migit mahmahna leh a khauh mahmahna i mu hi. A khial mite tungah khauh mahmah a, ama migitna a kizop paisuak theihna dingin na up paisuak nak uh leh note tungah hong migi mahmah hi. Ahi zongin na zop paisuak kei uh leh note zong hong kisatkhia ding hi.
Tua ciangin Jew mite in zong a lungsim uh kheelin Pasian a up uh leh Pasian in a pehkik theihna ding vangliatna nei ahih manin amaute zong amau' mun ngei mahah pehkik ding hi.
Note pen na pian'ngei uh gamlak oliv kung panin hong kisatkhia-in note' pian'ngei a hilo a kicing oliv kung tungah hong kipehthei ahih leh a kicing oliv kung panin a kisatkhia tawh a kibang Jew mite pen Pasian in amau omna ngei-ah a pehkikding olzaw mahmah lai ding hi.
Sanggamte aw, note in na theih dingun ka deih thusim khat om hi. Thei le uh cin, "A pil mahmah hi hang," na kici nawn kei pah ding uh hi. Tua thu in: Israel mite in a up noplohna pen a tawntung ding thu hilo hi. Pasian kiangah Gentail mite a pai dingzah in Pasian a zuat hun ciangdong ding bek ahi hi.

Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in a teel mite leh thupha a piak mite tawh kisai-in a thu dokkiklo hi.

Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian in mi khempeuh tungah hehpihna a piaktheihna dingin a thuman'lohna hangun mi khempeuh thongkia a bangsak hi.
Tua ahih manin Pasian' hong hehpihna nakliat mahmah a, a pilna leh a thu theihnate nakthuk mahmah hi. Ama thukhennate kua' gentheih ding hilo a, a nasepna ziate kua' telzawh ding hilo hi.
Amah in hong thukkik theihna dingin kuamah in ama tungah thupha va bawl ngeilo hi," na ci hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh na khempeuh ama pian'sak hi a, na khempeuh ama hang leh ama minthan'na ding bekin a om ahi hi. Mi khempeuh in Pasian phat tawntung ta hen! Amen.
Tua ahih ciangin sanggamte aw, Pasian in eite tam veipi tak hong hehpih ahih manin ama lungkimna ding leh ama nasepna dingin nomau mahmah a hingtangin Pasian tungah na kipiakna dingun ka hong thum hi. Tua banga kipiakna pen Pasian biakna man taktak ahi hi.
Leitung mihingte' gamtat bangin gamta kei un la, na lungsim uh kikheelin Pasian kipuahpha sak un. Tua hi leh a hoih nate bang hi a, bangte in amah lungkim sakin, bangte a kicing hiam ci-in thei-in Pasian' deihna na phawk thei ding uh hi.
Pasian in kei tungah hehpihna hong piakkhongna hangin note tungah kong gennop thu in: Note tawh a kituakzah valin kilian ngaihsutzaw kha kei un. Pasian in note tungah upna hong piakzah tawh kizui-in kingaihsun bek zaw un la, a kilawm ciang khat bekin kingaihsun un.
Tua ahih manin Pasian in hehpihna hong piakkhongna tawh kizui-in i siamna a tuamtuamte zang ciat ni. I siamna pen Pasian' thu gentheihna ding siamna ahih leh i upna neihzah tawh kizui-in gen ni.
Nasepna ding siamna a nei ihih leh na sem ni. Hilhna ding siamna a nei ihih leh hilh ni.
Midangte hanthot theihna ding siamna a nei ihih leh midangte hanthawn ni. Midangte hoptheihna ding a nei ihih leh citna taktak tawh hawm ni. Makaih theihna ding siamna a nei ihih leh hoihtakin na sem ni. Midangte hehpih theihna ding a nei ihih leh maitaii takin hih ni.
Na ki-itnate uh lungsim takpi tawh hi sak un la, a siate mudahin a hoihte lenkip un.
Unau ki-itna lungsim nei un la, khatlekhat kizahtak bawl ding lamsang kidem un.
Thadah kei un la, nakpi takin na sem un. Lawp mahmahna lungsim tawh Topa' na sem un.
Lamet na neihna hangun lungdamin om tawntung un la, lungkhamna na thuak uh ciangin lungduai-in thu na ngen tawntung un.
Na Khristianpihte uh a kisapna bangin na neihsate uh na hawm un la, zin leh leengla do a siam mite na hita un.
No a hong bawlsia mite, Pasian in thupha a piakna dingin thu ngetsak un la, tua bang mite samsia loin thupha piazaw un.
A lungdam mite lungdampih un la, a dah mite dahpih un.
Mi deidan loin a kibangin en un. Kiphasak loin mineute tawh kikhawlthei un la, kipilsak se kei un.
Midangte' gitlohnate thukkik kei un la, mi khempeuh in hoih hi, ci-in a ngaihsut ding bangin gamta un.
Ahih theih laiteng mi khempeuh tawh na kilemna dingun hanciam un.
Lawmte aw, na hehna uh kuama tungah thukkik kei un la, Pasian' thukkik dingin koih lel un. Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho sungah, "Keimah in amaute tungah ka thuk ding a, midangte a gimsak bangun ka gimsak ding hi, Topa in ci hi," ci-in kigelh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Lai Siangtho sungah, "Na galte uh a gil a kial leh an na pia un. A dang a taak leh tui na pia un. Tua bangin na gamtat uh leh amaute' maizumna dingin a bawl na hi uh hi," ci-in a kigelh bangin gamtazaw un.
Tua ahih manin gitlohna kizosak kei un la, a pha gamtatna tawh gitlohnate a zo na hi ta un.
A kuamah peuh in hong ukte' thu na mang ciat un. Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian' thukimpih lohin kuamah in ukna thu neilo hi; ukna thu nei i cih mite pen Pasian' koih mite ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin ukna thunei a nialte pen Pasian' koihsa mite a nial suak a, tua bang mite in thukhenna a thuak ding uh ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh gam uk mite pen a gamtat hoih mite' kihtak ding hilo a, mi tatsiate' kihtak ding hi bek hi. Ukna thu a neite kihta loin na omnop uh leh a hoihin gamta un. Tua hi leh amaute in note hong pakta-in hong phat ding uh hi.
Ukna thuneite pen note' hoihna dingin Pasian' nasemte ahi uh hi. Ahi zongin a sia-in na gamtat uh leh gim hong pia taktak ding uh ahih manin na lau ding uh ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh amaute pen Pasian' nasemte hi a, a sia-in a gamta mite tungah Pasian' hehna bangin gim a pia dingte ahi uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Pasian' gimpiak ding kihtakna hang bek hiloin, ahi ding thu mah hi, ci-a theihna tawh ukna thu a neite' thu na man' ding uh ahi hi.
Ukna thu a neite in amau' sep dingteng a kimtakin a sep uh ciangin Pasian-a' dingin na a semte hi uh ahih manin tua thu hang mahin zong mangmu a pia na hi uh hi.
Thukham sungah, "Nulepa mawhna bawl kei in, mi that kei in, guta kei in, hazatna lungsim nei kei in," cihna leh adang khempeuhte pen, "Nang na ki-it bangin na vengte na it in," cihna thu in huam khinmang hi.
Midangte a it mi peuhmah in amaute tungah siatna bawl hetlo ahih manin itna i neih ciangin Thukham buppi a zui khinta ihi hi.

Sun khuavak sunga om mite bangin a kilawmin gamta ni. Gualnopna leh zukhamna, mawhna leh thangtatna, kitotna leh kihazatnate-in i hun beisak kei ni.
Kidalna dingin, Topa Jesuh Khrih' hong piak galhiamte zang un la, na pumpi uh deihna bangin gamtatna ding hun omsak nawn kei un.
Upna neu mite pawlbawl un la, na ngaihsutna uh a kituah kei leh zong mawhsak kei un.
Tua ahih manin a ne mite in a tang mite simmawhbawl kei hen la, a tang mite in zong a ne mite simmawhbawl kei hen. Bang hang hiam cih leh a ne mite zong Pasian in a san' mite mah ahi hi.
Mi khat' nasemte tungah kua in thu khen thei ding na hi uh hiam? A gina leh a ginalo a khen dingpa pen amau' Topa ahi hi. A Topa un hoih hi, a cih leh a kipsak zawhna ding vangliatna nei ahih manin a kip hi lel ding uh hi.
Mi pawlkhatte in ni khat peuh adang sangin thupi zaw hi, ci-in ngaihsun uh a, pawlkhatte in ni khempeuh kibangkim hi, ci-in ngaihsun uh hi. Tua ahih manin a kuamah peuh in amau' hoihsakna thu ciantakin thei ta uh hen.
Ni khatpeuh thupi diak hi, ci-in a tang mite in Topa a pahtawina-in a tang ahi uh hi. An khempeuh a ne mi in zong Pasian' tungah lungdamna ko-in ne uh ahih manin Topa a pahtawina mahin a ne uh ahi hi. Nekdingin kilawmlo hi, ci-in a nelo mite in zong Pasian tungah lungdamna mah ko ahih manin Topa a pahtawina mahin a nelo uh ahi hi.
Ama-a' ding bekin kuamah nungtalo a, ama-a' ding bekin kuamah silo hi.
I nuntak leh Topa-a' dingin a nungta ihi a, i sih leh zong Topa-a' ding mahin a si ihi hi. Tua ahih manin i si a, i hing zongin Topa-a' ihi hi.
Hih thu hangin Khrih pen a site leh a hingte' Topa ahih theihna dingin hong si-in hong nungtakik hi.
