Ahi zongin Topa in hong thukimpih nak leh kei ka hong hawhbaih ding a, tua a kiphatsak pau mawkmawkte in bang ciang taktak a hihzo ngap uh hiam, cih thu keima pumpi tawh ka mu ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian' Ukna thu i cih pen kampi bek tawh genna hilo a, Pasian' vang tawh nungta-in gamtatna ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin note taii-in gim a hong pia dingin ka hong pai ding leh itna leh lungnemna lungsim tawh ka hong pai ding koi deihzaw na hi uh hiam?
Note lakah numei tawh paktatna nasia mahmahin, lawkite nangawn a gamtatlohte na gamtatna uh hong kigen a, mi khat in ama nukik nangawn a luppihna thu ka za hi.
Topa' Ni hong tun' ciangin tua bang mite' kha in hotkhiatna a ngahtheihna dingin Satan in amau pumpi a gimsak dingin na piakhia ta un.
Note lakah hih bang gamtatna om napi-in na kisaktheih uh dahhuai mahmah hi. Silngo themkhat in annel lompi a pawmsak theih lamtak theilo na hi uh hiam?
Note na siangtho theihna dingun mawhna silngo luite na paikhia un. Tua hi leh silngo sawhloh annel lom thak na hi ding uh a, zong ahi takpi mah na hi uh hi. Bang hang hiam ci leh i Paisan Pawi hun hong tungta a, eite' Paisan Tuuno ahi Khrih kigo khinzo ta hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mawhna leh gitlohna ahi silngo lui a kisawh anlum tawh Paisan Pawi bawlloin, silngo a kisawhlo, siangthona leh thutakna tawh bawlzaw ni.
Lai ka hong gelhna sungah, numei tawh a paktat mite tawh na kikholhlohna ding uh ka hong gen hi.
Tua bang ka hong cih ciangin numei tawh a paktat, a huaiham, a guta, milim a bia lawkite tawh na kikhawl kei un, ka cihnopna hilo hi. Tuate tawh kikhawllo ding ci lehang, leitung panin paikhia un, cihna suak ding hi.
Tua bang a pualam mite mawhsakin thu ka khen ding kei' nasep hilo hi. Pasian in amaute' thu khen ngawn ding hi. Ahi zongin note in na pawlpih uh mite tungah thu na khen ding uh ahi hi. Lai Siangtho in, "Note lak panin migilopa na lakhia un," na ci hi.
Note khatlekhat thu na kineih uh ciangin Pasian' mi siangthote khensakzaw loin lawki thukhente' mai na kitun' ngam uh hi.
Pasian' mite in leitung mite' thu a khensakzaw ding ahihlam theilo na hi uh hiam? Note pen leitung mite' thu a khensak ding na hih uh ciangin tua bang thu neute khen theilo lawmlawm na hi uh hiam?
Eite pen vantung mite' thu nangawn a khensak ding ihih lamtak theilo na hi uh hiam? Tua ahih manin hih leitunga no' thu neuneute leltak na khentheih zawk kan ding uh ahi hi.
Tua bang hinapi-in hih bang thu themthem hong pian' ciangin pawlpi sungah bangmahin a kisimlo mite' mai kitun'ding na hi uh hiam?
Note-a' dingin zumhuai mahmah hi. Note khatlekhat na kithu-neihnate uh a khenthei ding note lakah mipil khat beek om buang ding hi.
Tua hinapi, khatlekhat thu kineihin zum na kitun' uh a, lawki thukhente na khensak tazen uh hi.
Note khatlekhat zum na kitut mahmah uh zong a gina hetlo na hihna uh hong kilangsak hi. Bang hangin thuakzaw mailo a, sum ngamzaw mailo na hi uh hiam?
Migilote, Pasian' Ukna sungah a lut hetlohna ding thu na thei uh hi. Note kihaibawl kei un. Numei tawh a paktatte, milim biate, mi zi ahih kei leh mi pasal tawh a mawhte, pasal leh pasal a khialte,
a gutate, a huaihamte, zukhamte, mi gensiate, ahih kei leh mi' na a sutte khat beek, Pasian' Ukna sungah lutthei hetlo ding hi.
Note pawlkhat, tua bangin na gamta uh hi. Ahi zongin note pen i Topa Jesuh Khrih leh i Pasian' Kha Siangtho hangin mawhna panin a hong kisiangsak khinsa, Pasian' tungah a kipiasa, Pasian tawh a kipawlsa mite na hi uh hi.
"Ka ut peuhpeuh ka hihtheihna ding thu om hi," a ci omkha ding hi. Ahi zongin na khempeuh hihding kilawmlo hi. Kei zong ka ut khempeuh ka hih theih hangin tua bang gamtatna khat peuhpeuh' sila ka suak nuam kei hi.
"An pen i gilpi-a' ding hi a, gilpi zong an-a' ding mah hilo ahi hiam?" a ci zong omkha ding hi. Ahi zongin Pasian in tuate gel a beisak hun hong tung ding hi. Pumpi pen paktatna-in zatding hilo a, Topa' na sepna-in zatding hizaw hi. Topa in pumpi-a' ding na hong sem hi.
Pasian in sihna panin Topa thosak kik hi. Tua mah bangin eite zong ama vangliatna tawh hong thosak kik ding hi.
Na pumpi uh, Khrih pumpi nate khat ahih lamtak theilo na hi uh hiam? Khrih pumpi nate khat la-in numei tawh paktatte' pumpi nate khat suaksak ding ihi hiam? Tuacih ngeiding hi peuhmahlo hi.
Numei paktat tawh a pumpi a kizomsakpa pen tua numei tawh pumkhat sakhat a suak ahih lamtak theilo na hi uh hiam? Bang hang hiam cih leh Lai Siangtho in, "Tua mi nihte pumkhat a suak ding uh hi," na ci hi.
Numei tawh mawhna na pelh un. Mi khat in a bawl mawhna tuamtuamte in ama pumpi sukhalo hi, a ci om hi. Ahi zongin numei tawh a mawhte, ama pumpi tungah a khial ahi hi.
Na pumpi uh, Pasian in a hong piak, note' sungah a teng Kha Siangtho' biakinn ahih lamtak theilo na hi uh hiam? Note' pumpi, nomau' neihsa hilo a, Pasian-a' ahi hi.
Note pen Pasian in a hong leisa na hih manun na pumpi uh Pasian' minthan'na dingin na zang un.
Tu-in nong laigelhna uh thu tawh kisai-in: Pasal in zi nei kei leh hoihzaw loding ahi hiam, na ci uh hi.
Zi in ama pumpi a ut bangin zangthei nawnloin a pasal' zat ding hi a, tua mah bangin a pasal in zong ama pumpi a ut bangin zangthei nawnloin a zi' zat ding ahi hi.
Thungetna-in hun na zattheihna dingun tawlkhat sung tuam om ding thukim khawm masa lopi-in lupkhop ding kinialkha kei un. Tua bangin tawlkhat sung na tuam om khit uh ciangin note' pumpi' deihna hangin Satan' ze-etna sungah na pukkhak lohna dingun a ngeina bangin lupkhawm ding kipan kik un.
Hih bangin kong gen ciangin a hoihpen hi, ci-in thugenna hilo a, note' pianzia tawh kizui-in hithei tei hi, cihna lel ahi hi.
Mi khempeuh keimah bangin om ciat le uh hoih ka sa hi. Ahi zongin mi khempeuh in Pasian' piak hihzawhna a tuamtuam nei a, khatlekhat kibanglo hi.
Pasal nei nailote leh meigongte pen keimah bangin tanggawl om paisuak le uh hoih ka sa hi.
Ahi zongin a pumpi uh a ki-ukzawh kei ding uh leh pasal nei le uh hoihzaw hi. Nei nuampipi-a neihloh tentan sangin pasal neih hoihzaw hi.
A neisate tungah, kei' ngaihsutna hilo, Topa' ngaihsutna ka gennop thu in: Zi in a pasal ciahsan kei ta hen.
A ciahsan leh zong pasal neiloin om paisuak hen. A om paisuakzawh kei leh a pasal ngei mah zuankik hen. Pasal in a zi ma kei ta hen.
Adangte tungah, Topa' cih hilo, keima ngaihsutna ka gennop thu in: Mi khatpeuh in thu umlo mi khat zi-in a neih leh, pasal mahin neihding a zi a lungkim ahih nak leh ma kei ta hen.
Numei khat in thu umlo mi khat pasalin a neih leh, zi mahin neihding a pasal a lungkim ahih nak leh ma tuan kei ta hen.
Bang hang hiam cih leh thu umlo pasal pen a zi' hangin thu um mi suakthei ding a, thu umlo zi pen a pasal' hangin thu um mi suakthei ding hi. Tua bang hi leh a tate uh thu um mi suakthei ding uh hi. Ahi zongin tua bang hi kei le uh a tate uh thu um mi suaktheilo ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin thu umlo zi in ahi a, thu umlo pasal in ahi zongin kikhen ding a ut leh kikhen ta uh hen. Tua bang thute-ah thu um zi ahi a, thu um pasal ahi zongin a awkna ding thu omlo hi. Pasian in nuamtakin a nungta dingin a hong sap ahi hi.
Mi khempeuh, Pasian in amau' nuntakna dingin a sehna, leh Pasian in a sap laitakin a omzia bangbangun nungta uh hen. Hih bangzia-in om ding pen pawlpi khempeuhah hilhin ka neih ngeina khat ahi hi.
Vun ki-atsa mi khat Pasian in a sap leh, a vun ki-atna lim phiat tuan kei ta hen.
Bang hang hiam cih leh vun atna leh vun atlohna a thupi hilo a, Pasian' thupiakte zuihding a thupi ahi hi.
Sila ahi mi khat Pasian in a sap leh phamawhlo hi; sila mahin ki-om thei veve hi. Ahi zongin suahtak theihna ding lampi a om leh tua hunhoih hamphatna zang ta hen.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in a sap sila ahi mi pen Topa-a' dingin mi suakta hi a, tua mah bangin Khrih in a sap a suakta mi pen Khrih-a' dingin sila ahi hi.
Tu-in a nungak lai a tangval laite thu tawh kisai-in: Topa kiang panin thu ngahna ka neihloh hangin Topa' hehpihna tawh a muan'taak ahi keima ngaihsutna ka hong gen ding hi.
Ahi zongin zineite in kikhen ding ngaihsutin nei kei ta hen. Nungak lai tangval laite in lawm zong kei ta hen.
Ahi zongin pasal in zi a neih hangin a khial hilo a, numei in zong pasal a neih hangin a khial hilo hi. Ahi zongin zinei, pasalneite in leitung lungkhamna tampi thuak uh ahih manin tuate tawh kipelhzaw le uh hoih ka sa hi.
Sanggamte aw, tua bang ka cih ciangin a kiseh hun hong nai mahmah ta hi, ka cihnopna ahi hi. Tua ahih manin zineite pen zineilo mah bangin kingaihsun uh hen la,
a dahte pen a dahlo mah bangin kingaihsun uh hen la, a lungdamte pen a lungdamlo mah bangin kingaihsun uh hen la, na a leite pen bangmah a neilo mah bangin kingaihsun uh hen la,
leitung na nuamtakin a zangte pen a zanglo mah bangin kingaihsun ta uh hen. Bang hang hiam cih leh hih leitung pen sauveipi kip nawnlo ding hi.
Note, lunghihmawhna tawh na kipelhding uh ka hong deihsak hi. Zi a neilote in Topa a lungdamsak theihna dingun Topa' thu bek kinin nei uh hi.
Ahi zongin zineite in a zi a lungdamsak theihna dingun hih leitung vai kinin nei uh a,
a ngaihsutna uh khen nih pha hi. Pasal a neilo numeite in a lungsim leh a pumpi uh Topa-a' dingin zangnuam uh ahih manin Topa' nasep bek kinin nei uh hi. Ahi zongin pasal a nei numeite in a pasal uh a lungdamsak theihna dingun hih leitung vai kinin nei uh hi.
Hih bangin ka hong gen ciangin note' haksatna ding deihna hiloin note' hoihna ding ka deihna ahi hi. Note a kilawm a kituakin gamta-in, lungsim leh thatang siit neiloin Topa' na na septheihna ding uh ka hong deihsakna ahi hi.
Ten'pih dingin lawm dongkhin napi-in kiten' nawnlohding a ngaihsunte' thu panin: Ten'pih kei leng a numei tungah a thumanlo hi ding cihna ahi a, zi a deihna lungsim a lianlua ahi a, ten'pihding mah hoih hi, ci-in ngaihsutna ahi zongin a neih leh a lungkimna bangun gamta-in ten'pih uh hen. Tua thu-ah bangmah khialhna omlo hi.
Ahi zongin kuama sawl hiloin zi neilo dingin a lungsimah khauhtakin khentatin, a lungsim ki-ukzo taktakin a ngaihsutsa ahih nak leh a neihloh hangin phamawhlo hi.
Tua ahih manin a neite zong hoih a, a neiloin a kikem zote hoihzaw lai hi.
Pasalnei numei pen a pasal a nuntak laiteng suaktalo hi. A pasal a sih leh a deih peuhpeuh tawh kitengthei ding a, ahi zongin thu um mi bek ten'pih ding hi.
Mi khat in thu a thei-in a kingaihsut leh a taktakin a theihdingin a kilawmzah a thei nailo ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin biakna sa tawh kisai thu panin: Milim i cih pen bangmah a omlopi khat lim dingin a kibawl na hi a, Pasian khat bek a om ahihna thu i theih ciat ahi hi.

eite-a' dingin Pasian khat bek, Pa khat bek a om hi. Ama-a' dingin i nuntaknapa, na khempeuh a piangsakpa ahi hi. Eite tungah nuntakna a hong pia, na khempeuh a piangsak Topa Jesuh Khrih khat bek a om hi.
Ahi zongin mi khempeuh in hih thu theikimlo uh hi. Mi pawlkhatte, milim biakna thu-ah kingeinaseh lua khin uh ahih manin tuhun mahmahin zong biakna sate a nek uh ciangin tua milim tawh kisai sa mahin ngaihsunsun lai uh hi. Amaute lungsim thaneem uh ahih manin tua sate a nek uh ciangin a zehphi mahin kingaihsun uh hi.
Ahi zongin tua i nek ante in Pasian tawh i kizopna hong hoihsak tuanlo hi. I nekloh hangin siatna om tuanlo a, i nek hangin zong phatna om tuan samlo hi.
Ahi zongin note' utbangin gamtat theihna ding thu na neihna uh hangin upna a neu laite a puksak na suahkhak lohna dingun hoihtakin kidawm un.
No thuthei-a a kineite, milim biakna inn sungah milim biakna sa na neklam uh, hih thu tawh kisai-ah a lungsim hatzo nailote in hong mukha zenzen leh milim biakna sa nek ding a hanthawn na suakkha ding uh hi.
Tua ahih manin nekna in thu upna sungah ka sanggamte khat a khialsak ding ahih leh, amah a pukkhak lohna dingin milim biakna sa ka ne ngei het kei ding hi.
Kei pen sawltak ka hi a, mihingte' khutnuai-a nasem ka hi kei hi. I Topa Jesuh tawh a kimu mi ka hi a, Topa-a' dingin na ka sepna hangin note pen thu um a suak na hi uh hi.
Midangte in sawltakin hong ngaihsun ta kei le uh, note in sawltakin na hong ngaihsut uh a kul ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa sungah na omna uh pen sawltak ka hihlam a kilatna ahi hi.

Note lakah kha thu tawh kisai khaici hong vawh ka hih manun, note tung panin leitung nate ka ngah uh hangin a lianlua hilo hi.
Midangte in note tung panin ngahtheihna ding thu nei uh ahih leh ko ka nei phazaw lai uh hi. Ahi zongin note tung panin ngahtheihna ding thu a om hangin bangmah ka hong la kei uh a, Khrih hangin Lungdamna Thu a dongtangsak ka suahkhak lohna dingun na khempeuhah ka thuak tentan uh hi.
Biakinn-ah nasem dingin a kicial mite in biakinn mah panin an ngah uh a, biakna tau-ah na a semte in biakna sa mah a ngahna uh theilo na hi uh hiam?

A taktakin ci lehang lungdamna thu adang a om hilo a, mi pawlkhatte in note' lungsim hong toknawi-in, Khrih hanga lungdamna thu hei-in thudang tawh laihnuam uh ahih manin, tua amau' deih thu pen lungdamna thu a cihsak mawkmawk ka hi hi.
Note tungah ka hong hilhsa uh lungdamna thu tawh a kilehngatin, kote-a kipan vantung mi dongin thudang a hong hilh a om leh tua a hong hilh mipa hell khuk sungah tung ta hen!
Ka hong gen ngeisa mah bangin ka hong gen kikin-ah: Note' san'sa lungdamna thu tawh a kilehngatin thudang a hong hilh mi peuhpeuh hell khuksung tung ta hen!
Hih bangin thu ka gen ciangin mite' hong pahtak theihna ding a zong tawh kibang na hong sa uh hiam? Mite' pahtak ding a ut ka hi kei a, Pasian' hong pahtak ding a hanciam ka hi hi. Mihingte' hong pahtak theihna dingin a gamta hi zenzen leng, Khrih' nasem ka hi kei ding hi.
Sanggamte aw, keima hilh lungdamna thu pen mihingte tung panin a hong kipan ahihlohna thu na theihding uh ka deih hi.
Mi khatpeuh tung panin ka ngah hilo a, mi khatpeuh in hong hilh zong hilo hi. Jesuh Khrih in kei tungah a hong lahna hang bekin hih thu a thei ka hi hi.
Jew biakna sungah ka omlai hunin Pasian' pawlpi tuamtuamte bawlsiat ding kin mahmahin, a beimangna ding uh ka hanciamna,
leh ka khan'gualte lakah Jew biakna lamah a makai pen ka hihna thu, leh ka pu ka pate uh tang ngeinate a nakkin mahmah ka hihna-a kipanin ka pianzia ngeisate khempeuh na zaksa na theihsa uh ahi hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in a hong hehpihna tawh ka suahma pekin kei hong teelin ama na a sem dingin hong sam khin hi. Keimah in ama Tapa hanga lungdamna thu, Gentail mite lakah ka hilhtheihna dingin kei tungah a Tapa hong kilatsak hun laitakin kuama kiangah thudongin ka pai kei a,
Hih ka thugente a man vive hi a, zuau gen hetlo ka hih lamtak Pasian in hong thei hi.
Tua lai panin Syria leh Silisia gamah ka pai hi.
Tua hun ciangdong Judea gama om Khrih pawlpi tuamtuamte in ka meelin hong thei nailo uh a,
"Ei a hong bawlsia ngei mipa in a maiman'sak nop Khrih upna thu mah a hilhhilh hi," ci-in a kigenna thu a zak bek uh ahi hi.
Tuazawh kum sawmleli khit ciangin Barnabas tawh Jerusalem khua-ah ka paikik a, Titus zong ka tonpih hi.
Pasian' hong sawlna tawh tua lai-ah a pai ka hi hi. Ka nasepnate a mawkna a suahkhak ding utlo ka hih manin makai liana kineite tawh a tuamin kimuhna khat ka nei a, Gentail mite lakah ka hilh lungdamna thute amaute kiangah gentelna khat ka nei hi.
Kei tawh a kithuah Titus nangawn Grik mi hinapi-in a vun ki-atsak tuanlo hi.
Lungdamna thuman taktak pelem hetloin note-a' dingin a kipsuak theihna dingin amaute' deihna themkhat zong ka zui het kei uh hi.
Jerusalem khua-a om makai liana kinei mite in kei' nasepna tawh kisai thu-ah bangmah genthuah ding neilo uh hi. (Pasian in maitang zahtak tuam nei tuanlo ahih manin hih bangin thu a gen ngam ka hi hi.)
Amaute in genthuah ding a neih genloh, Jew mite tungah lungdamna thu hilh ding nasep, Pasian in Peter tungah a piak mah bangin, Gentail mite tungah lungdamna thu hilhna ding nasep, Pasian in kei tungah a hong piakna thu a muzaw uh hi.
Makai-a kinei James, Peter, leh Johan-te in Gentail mite lakah nasem dingin Pasian in kei hong sehna thu thei uh ahih manin, Pasian sungah nasemkhawm khat ihi hi, cih hong lahna uh limin kei leh Barnabas tawh khut kiletna hong bawl uh hi. Kei leh Barnabas in Gentail mite lakah na semin amaute in Jew mite lakah na a sepna ding uh thukimna ka nei uh hi.
Kote in amaute lakah a om mizawngte ka phawkding uh hong kal bek a, tua lah kei zong ngaihsut penin ka neihsa thu mah ahi hi.
James in a hong sawl mi pawlkhatte, tua khua-ah a hong tun'ma-in Peter in thu um Gentail mite tawh an nekhawm napi-in, Gentail mite vun at ding hi, a ci mite a kihtakna hangin tua mite hong tun' ciangin Gentail mite tawh an nekhawm ngam nawnloin hong kihemkhia hi.
Lungdamna thu tawh kizui-in a mantakin gamtalo uh hi, ci-in ka muh ciangin amaute khempeuh' zakin Peter kiangah, "Nang pen Jew mi hinapi-in Jew mi bangin gamta loin Gentail mite bangin a gamta khinsa na hi hi. Tua bangin a gamta khinsa hinapi-in bang hangin tu-in Gentail mite, Jew mite bangin a gamtatna dingun na gamtatna tawh lakkik na hi hiam?" ka ci hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh Khrih upna hang bek tawh Pasian tawh kipawl theihna kingahin, Thukham zuihna hang tawh kingah ngeilo hi, ci-in ka thei uh hi. Kote mahmah in zong, Khrih hangin Pasian tawh ka kipawl theihna dingun Jesuh Khrih ka um uh a, Thukham deihna ka zuihna hang uh tawh hilo hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Thukham zuihna hang tawh kuamah in Pasian tawh kipawl theihna ngah zolo hi.
Tua ahih leh Khrih ka upna hangun Pasian tawh kipawl theihna ding ka hanciam uh ciangin mimawh mah ka hihna uh ka thei uh hi. Tua ahih leh Khrih pen mawhna a piangsak a suakding hiam? Suak hetlo ding hi.
Thukham zuihna hang hilo hi, ci-in ka phiatsa uh thu tu-in pankik leuleu leng keimahmah Thukham khialpa ka suakkik zel ding hi.
Thukham tawh kisai-in ahih leh Pasian-a' dingin ka nuntak theihna dingin tua Thukham mah in kei hong thatkhin ahih manin Thukham tawh kisai thu-ah misi bang ka hi hi. Singlamteh tungah Khrih a kithah lai-in kei zong amah tawh a sikhawm ka hi hi.
Tua ahih manin tuhuna ka nuntakna zia pen kei hang hi nawnloin ka sungah a hong om Khrih hang ahi hi. Tua hi a, keimah hong itin, keima-a' dingin a nuntakna a hong pia Pasian' Tapa ka muan'na tawh tu laitakin a nungta ka hi hi.
Hih bang ka gen ciangin Pasian' hehpihna thupha ka deihlohna ahi kei a, Thukham zuihzawhna hangin Pasian tawh kipawl theihna om hi leh, singlamteh tungah Khrih sihna a mawkna hi lel ding hi, a cinuam ka hizaw hi.
Note in Thukham na zuihna hangun Pasian in Kha Siangtho hong pia-in na lamdang hong bawl ahi hiam, ahih kei leh lungdamna thu za-in na upna hang uh hizaw ahi hiam?
Tua ahih manin Abraham' suanlekhak a man taktak i cihte pen upna a nei mite ahihna thu na theihding uh ahi hi.
Jew mite mah bangin Gentail mite in zong a upna uh hangin amah tawh a kipawlthei dingin Pasian in a bawlna ding thu, Lai Siangtho in na ma theih hi. Tua ahih manin Lai Siangtho in Abraham tungah Lungdamna Thuthak na ma hilhkhol a, "Pasian in leitung mi khempeuh thupha a piakna dingin nangmah hong zang ding hi," na ci hi.
Tu-in Lai Siangtho in, "Upna hangin Pasian tawh a kipawlthei mite bek nungta ding hi," na ci ahih manin Thukham hangin kuamah in Pasian tawh kipawl theihna a ngahlohna thu teltakin hong kilang hi.
Lai Siangtho in, "Thukham' deih bangin a gamta zote nungta ding hi," na ci ahih manin Thukham zuihna leh upna thu na kimemat khalo hi.
Lai Siangtho in, "Sing tungah a kikhai mi peuhmah Pasian' samsiat mi ahi hi," na ci ahih manin eite-a' dingin Khrih in samsiatna a thuak manin Thukham zuihlahna hangin samsiatna panin eite a hong tankhia ahi hi.
Khrih in eite a hong tatna pen, eite in i upna hangin Pasian in a hong ciam Kha Siangtho ngahin, Pasian in Abraham tungah a ciam thuphate zong, Jesuh Khrih hangin Gentail mite tungah a kipiak theihna ding a deihna ahi hi.
Khrih sungah sanggamte aw, i theihtheih ngei gentehna khat ka hong zang ding hi. Mi nih in thu khatpeuhah thukimna nei-in letmat a thuhkhit uh ciangin kuamah in tua thukimna nungphiat theilo, zong behlap theilo hi.
Tu-in Pasian in Abraham leh ama suanpa tungah thuciamna nei hi. Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelhna-ah, mi tampi a cihnopna ahi, "Na suan leh na khakte," cih kammal na zanglo a, mi khat bek ahi Khrih a cihnopna-in, "Na suanpa," ci-in na gen hi.
Tu-in ka hong gennop thu in: Pasian in Abraham tawh thuciamna bawl a, tua a thuciamna peksat sawmlo hi. Tua ahih manin tua thuciamna a kibawlzawh kum zali leh kum sawmthum khit ciangin a kinung piak Thukham in tua thuciamna peksatin phiat theilo ding hi.
Pasian' hong piakkhong pen Thukham zuihna hang tawh a kingah hi mawk leh piakding hong ciamna hangin a kingah hi nawnlo ding hi. Ahi zongin Pasian in Abraham tungah letsong a piakna pen a thuciamnasa tawh kizui-in a piak ahi hi.
Tua ahih leh Thukham bangin a kimang ding ahi hiam? Khialhna cih bang ahi hiam, cih a kitheihna dingin thuciamna banah hong kipiathuah hi a, thuciam a kipiakna, Abraham' suanpa' hun ciangdong bek a kimang dingin a kingaihsun ahi hi. Mihingte tungah Thukham hong kipiak lai-in vantung mi hong kisawlsawn a, mihing ahi Moses tungah hong kipiasawn hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian in Abraham tungah thuciamna a bawl laitakin kuamah sawlsawn neiloin amah bek in a piak ahi hi.
Tua ahih leh Thukham leh Pasian' thuciamnate a kilehngat ahi uh hiam? Hi hetlo hi. Mihingte tungah hong kipia Thukham in nuntakna taktak hong pia thei hi leh tua Thukham zuihna hangin mi khempeuh in Pasian tawh kipawl theihna ngah ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin Jesuh Khrih a um mite tungah a upna hangun Pasian' thuciam a kipiak theihna dingin Lai Siangtho in, "Mawhna khutnuai-ah leitung mi khempeuh a om hi," na ci hi.
Tua ahih manin upna thu hong tun'ma hun sungteng, upna thu a kilahkhiat ding ngakna-in Thukham in eite a hong hencip phot ahi hi.
Tua hi a, i upna hangin Pasian tawh kipawl theihna i ngahna dingin Khrih a hong pai hun ciangdong, Thukham in eite a hong uk ahi hi.
Tu-in ahih leh upna hun hita ahih manin Thukham in eite hong uk thei nawnlo hi.
Tua ahih manin Jew mi leh Gentail mi, sila leh sila a hilo, numei leh pasal cih bangin kideidanna om nawnlo a, note khempeuh Khrih tawh na kipawlna hangun pawlkhat hi-in, a kibangkim na hi uh hi.
Khrih tawh na kipawl nak uh leh Abraham' suante na hita uh a, Pasian' hong khap thute a ngah ding na hi uh hi.
Ahi zongin gamhluah ding tapa in a pa' neihsa khempeuh a luah ding hinapi-in a neulai hun sungteng silate mah bangin bangmah thu neilo hi.
Ahi zongin a hun a cin ciangin eite khempeuh Pasian' tate i suahtheihna dingin Thukham nuai-ah a om mite a hong tankhia dingin Pasian in a Tapa hong paisak a, tua Tapa pen leitung ngeina bangin numei sung panin hong suakin, Jew Thukham sungah hong nungta hi.
Note pen ama tate na hihna uh a hong lahna dingin Pasian in ama Tapa' Kha Siangtho, eite sungah hong tumsak a, tua Kha Siangtho in Pasian pen, "Pa aw, pa aw," hong cisak hi.
Tua ahih manin note pen sila hi nawnloin Pasian' tate na hih manun Pasian in ama tate-a' dingin a koih khempeuh, note tungah hong pia ding hi.
A beisa hunah Pasian theilo na hih manun Pasian a hilo vangliatna a neite' sila-in na om uh hi.
Ahi zongin note in tu-in Pasian meltheih khinin, tua ahih kei leh Pasian in note hong meltheih khinta ahih manin, a bang hangin bangmah a hih zolo, a ginalo tua bangte lamah kiheikik nuam a, sila va suakkik nuam na hi uh hiam?
Note in nite, khate, hunte, kumte-a kipan pawi tuamtuamte limtakin tan'ding na hah ngaihsut mahmah uh hi.
Tua ahih manin note-a' dingin ka nasepna khempeuh a mawkna a suahkhak ding ka hong lunghihmawhsak mahmah hi.
Ka pumpi cidam lohna pen note-a' dingin thu haksapi hinapi-in kei na hong simmawhbawl tuan kei uh a, zong na hong nolh tuan kei uh hi. Vantung panin a hong pai vantung mi zin do bang, leh Khrih Jesuh mahmah zin a do bangin na hong limbawl uh hi.
Tua hun laitakin lungdam mahmah napi-in tu-in a bangci ta na hi uh hiam? A hithei khat hi leh, tua hunin na mittang nangawn uh khelkhia-in kei a hong pianuamte na hihna uh teltakin ka thei hi.
Tua mi pawlkhatte in note hong engin hong kin mahmah uh hi; ahi zongin amaute' ngimna a hoih hi khollo hi. Amaute' hong kin bangin note in zong amaute kinin na kipawl theihna dingun kei kiang panin note a hong khenkhia nuam ahi lel uh hi.
Ngimna hoih nei ahih nak uh leh note' phattuamna ding kinna pen note tawh ka hong omkhawm sung bek hiloin, a tawntungin kin ding a hoih ahi hi.

Tu-in keimah Paul in ka hong gen ding thu limtakin na ngai un: Note in vun-atna na zat uh leh note-a' dingin Khrih' nasepna a kiman'na a om hetlo ahi hi.
Vun-atna a zang mi khempeuh in Thukham dang khempeuh zong a vekpi-in a zuihding a tavuan ahihna thu teltakin phawk ta uh hen.
Thukham zuihna hangin Pasian tawh kipawl theihna ding a hanciamte pen Khrih tawh a kikhen na hi uh a, Pasian' hehpihna in note hong huam theilo hi.
Kote ahih leh Pasian in amah tawh a kipawlthei dingin hong bawl ding hi, ci-in lamenin, kote' upna hangin Kha Siangtho' vangliatna tawh hong piangding hi, ci-in a om ka hi uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Jesuh Khrih tawh i kipawl ciangin vun-atna leh vun-atlohna a thupi tuan omlo a, Khrih i upna hangin midangte i itna a thupi hi bek hi.
A beisa hunah hoihtakin a gamtate na hi uh hi. Tu-in a manin na gamtatlohna dingun kua in lam hong pialsakin Pasian' thu hong manglosak ahi hiam?
Note a hong sam Pasian in note na pialna dingun hong zolkhia hetlo ding hi.
Eite, Topa tawh a kipawl khawmte ihih manin kei tawh a kilamdangin note in bangmah ngaihsut tuam nei hetlo ding, ci-in ka hong muang a, a kua a kua hita leh note hong nawngkaisakte pen Pasian in gim pia ding hi, ci-in ka um hi.
Sanggamte aw, note ahih leh a suakta mi ahi dingin Pasian in a hong sap ahi hi. Ahi zongin tua suahtakna pen na pumpi uh ut bangbangin gamtat theihna dingin paulam zon'na-in nei kei un la, itna tawh khatlekhat kikhualna-in zangzaw un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Thukham khempeuh thu khatin kigawm thei a, "Nangmah na ki-it bangin na vengte na it in," cihna tawh kilomlak thei hi.
Ahi zongin note pen gamsa bangin khatlekhat kiphuai-in kipetkha le uh cin na vekpi-un na siatlawhkhak ding uh lauhuai ahih manin hoihtakin na kidawm un.
Note kiangah ka hong gen thu in: Kha Siangtho' hong sawlna bangin gamta un la, na pumpi uh utna bangin gamta kei un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ei' pumpi ut bangin gamta lehang Kha Siangtho' deihna tawh na kituaklo a, Kha Siangtho' deihna bangin gamta lehang ei' pumpi deihna tawh na kituaklo zel ahih manin hih nihte gel a kilangpang niloh na hi a, note' ut bangin a gamta theilo na hi uh hi.

Ahi zongin keimah in ahih leh, singlamteh tungah i Topa Jesuh a sihna thu bek ka kisialhpih ding hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh singlamteh tungah ama sihna hangin kei-a' dingin leitung thute misi bang a, kei zong, leitung thu-ah misi mah ka bang hi.

Pasian' sawlna tawh Jesuh Khrih' sawltak ahi keimah Paul in Efesa khua-ah a om thu um mite tungah lai ka hong khakhi.
Eite' Pa Pasian leh Topa Jesuh Khrih in note tungah dikna leh nopsakna thupha hong tungsak ta hen.
Ama mai-ah eite pen paubaan'na a neilo, mi siangthote ahi ding leh Khrih hangin ama mite ahi dingin leitung a pian'ma pek nangawnin Pasian in a hong teelsa ihi hi.
Pasian in Jesuh Khrih hangin ama mite ahi dingin eite a hong bawl ding a sehkholhsa hi a, tua bangin a hong bawlding pen ama tupna leh a utna ahi hi.
Pasian in a pilna leh a thumuhnate zangin ama geelsa bangin hong sem a, Khrih zangin a sepnop thusimteng eite tungah hong kilangsak hi.
Tua a geel thu pen, a hunhoih a tun' ciangin Khrih khutnuai-ah, vantung leh leitungah a om khempeuh gawm ding ahi hi.
Na khempeuh, Pasian' ngaihsutna leh a geelsa bangin a piang hi. A cil peka kipanin a ngaihsutsa thu tawh kizui-in Khrih tawh i kipawlna hangin Pasian' tate ihihna dingin Pasian mah in a hong sehsa ihi hi.
Tua ahih manin Khrih a muang masa eite in Pasian phatin a minthan'na vang kilangsak ni.
Note in zong hotkhiatna a hong ngahsakthei Lungdamna Thu a man za-in Khrih na up uh ciangin, Pasian in a hong ciamsa bangin ama mi na hihna uh a kilatna dingin note tungah Kha Siangtho hong piakna tawh a hong ciamteh hi.
Tua Kha Siangtho pen, Pasian in piakdingin a hong ciamsa thu eite khempeuh in i ngah taktak ding a kician ahihna thu a hong lahna hi a, ama mi ahi taktak eite khempeuh pen a suakta takpi mite ihihna a kilatna ding ahi hi. Tua ahih manin a kuamah peuh in Pasian phat ciat ni.
Note in Topa Jesuh na muan'na thu uh leh thu umte khempeuh na itna thu uh ka zak huna kipanin,
i Topa Jesuh Khrih' Pasian ahi, a minthang Pa Pasian in note tungah Kha Siangtho hong pia-in, tua Kha Siangtho in note tungah lungpilna hong pia-in, note in Pasian na theihna dingun note tungah Pasian hong kilatsakna dingin thu ka hong ngetsak niloh hi.
Vantungah ukna, aana, vangliatna a neite khempeuh tungah Khrih in ukna aana nei lai a, hih leitung bekah hiloin a hong tungding leitungah zong amah a lianpen ahi hi.
Tua pawlpi pen Khrih' pumpi hi a, tua pawlpi-a' dingin amahmah kipia-in, mun khempeuha om pawlpite, thu khempeuhah a cingtaaksak hi.
A beisa hunah na thuman'lohna uh leh na mawhna uh hangin kha thu tawh kisai-ah a si na hi uh hi.
Tuahun lai-in leitung gitloh gamtatnate na zui uh a, Pasian thu a umlo mite sungah tu laitakin na a sem, huihlak a ukte' thu na mang uh hi.
A taktakin eite khempeuh zong amaute mah i bang ngei a, i pian'pih lungsim zui-in nungta-in, i pumpi leh i lungsim deihna bangin i gamta hi. Tua ahih manin eite khempeuh zong Pasian' hehna hangin gim a thuak dingte ihi hi.
Tua bang hinapi-in Pasian' hong hehpihna leh eite hong itna lian mahmah ahih manin,
Khrih Jesuh tawh eite i kipawlna hangin vantungah amah tawh i ukkhawm theihna dingin sihna panin Pasian in a hong thokhawmsak hi.
Khrih Jesuh tung tawnin a hong lah ama hehpihna leh a hong itna bangzah takin lianin lamdang ahi hiam, ci-in a hong tungding hunah a hong lah tawntung theihna dingin hih bangin a hong thokhawmsak ahi hi.
Note' upna hangin Pasian' hong hehpihna tawh hotkhiatna a ngah na hi uh hi. Note' thalawhna hangin a ngah hiloin Pasian' hong piakkhong ahi hi.
Note' hanciamna tawh a ngah hilo na hih manun na kisialhna ding uh a thu omlo hi.
Amau mahmah in amau pumpi tungah a hihna uh tawh vun a ki-at mite ka hi uh a ci Jew mite in, vun a ki-atlo mite a hong cih uh, na pian' na patun Gentail mi ahi note in nidanga na omzia uh phawkkik dih un.
Tuahun lai-in Khrih tawh na kikhen uh a, Pasian' teel Israel minamte hiloin a pualam mite na hi uh hi. Pasian in ama mite tungah piakdingin a ciam thute zong a ngahdingte na hi kei uh a, Pasian a neilo, lamet ding bangmah neiloin leitungah a om na hi uh hi.
Ahi zongin a gamlapi-ah a om ngei hinapi-in tu-in Khrih Jesuh tawh na kipawlna hangun ama sihna in Pasian kiang hong tun'pih hi.
Khrih mahmah in Gentail mite leh Jew mite pawlkhatin hong bawl ahih manin eite tungah nopsakna a hong piapa ahi hi. Hih minam nihte khenin gal a piangsak dalna pen Khrih in ama pumpi tawh a satkham hi.
Amah tawh kipawlna hangin minam nihte pawlkhat a suahtheihna dingin minam a dei Jew Thukham leh a ngeinate khempeuh phiatin, eite pawlkhat hong suahin a hong kilemsak hi.
Singlamteh tungah a sihna tawh Khrih in kilangneihna beisak a, tua singlamteh hangin minam nihte pawlkhat suahin Pasian kiang a tun'pih hi.
Tua hi a, Khrih in Pasian tawh a kigamla no Gentail mite tung leh Pasian tawh a kinai Jew mite tungah kilemna ding Lungdamna Thuhoih a hong hilh hi.
Khrih hangin Jew mi leh Gentail mi ahi eite khempeuh, Kha Siangtho huhna tawh Pa Pasian kiangah i paithei hi.
Note zong, sawltakte leh kamsangte in a phuhsa innkhuam tungah a kilam na hi uh a, tua inn sutpi pen Jesuh mahmah ahi hi.
Tua inn sutpi Khrih pen inn-a a kilam khempeuh a puapi pen hi a, Topa-a' dingin biakinn siangtho a suah dongin tua inn a khangsak hi.
Note zong midangte tawh kigawmin ama tungah na kilam uh a, Kha Siangtho-in Pasian a ten'na ding inn na suak uh hi.
Note' phattuamna dingin Pasian in hong hehpihna tawh hih nasep a sem dingin a hong sawlna thu na theihsa uh ahi hi.
Tua ka laigelh na sim le uh cin Khrih tawh kisai a thusim ka theihna thu na phawk ding uh hi.
A beisa hunah tua thusim pen kuama tungah kigenlo a, ahi zongin Pasian in tu-in a siangtho a sawltakte leh a kamsangte tungah Kha Siangtho a hilhsak hi.
Tua thusim pen: Lungdamna thu a kihilhna hangin Gentail mite in Jew mite tawh Pasian' thupha ngahkhawm thei a, amaute tawh pawlkhat suakin, Pasian in piakdingin a ciam thute, Khrih hangin a ngahkhop theihna uh ahi hi.
Pasian' mi khempeuh lakah kei a neupen hinapi-in, Khrih hangin a kigen zolo thu manpha ahi Lungdamna Thu, Gentail mite lakah a gen ding,
leh Pasian in a geelsim thute a kisep khiatna thu mi khempeuh a musak dingin Pasian in kei tungah hih hamphatna hong pia hi. Tuhun laitakin vantung a uk van mite in pawlpi' hangin Pasian' pilna a nam tuamtuamin a muhtheihna dingun na khempeuh a bawl Pasian in a beisa hunah hih thu khempeuh a imcip hi.
Amah tawh i kipawlna leh amah i muan'na hangin kimuang takin Pasian kiangah paitheihna ding hun i nei hi.
Tua ahih manin note hangin ka thuakna pen note' phattuamna ding ahih manin tua ka thuakna thu hangin lungkiatna-in na nei kei un.
Hih ama geelna teng ka ngaihsut ciangin, vantung a tung khinsa mite leh leitungah a omlai mite khempeuh' pian'na i Pa Pasian' mai-ah ka khukdin' a,
note' lungsim a thahatna dingin Pasian in a kicing ama vangliatna sung panin a Kha Siangtho tawh note hong thakhauh sakin,
na upna hangun note lungsim sungah Khrih hong tengin, itna thu-ah zung thuk khakin bulkip na neihna dingun thu ka ngen hi.
Tua hi leh note in Pasian mi ahi midangte khempeuh tawh Khrih hong itna bangzah takin sau-in zai a, bangzah takin thukin sang ahi hiam, cih na theikhawm ding uh hi.
Khrih hong itna a kicing takin theihkhit zawhloh ding ahi ta zongin note in thei-in, Pasian thu a cingin na theihna dingun thu ka hong ngetsak hi.
Eite-a' dingin na a hong sepsak, eite' ngetzah val, leh i ngaihsut zawhloh zah dongin a vangliatna tawh tampi tak a hong hihsak thei
eite' Pasian pen, pawlpi mite khempeuh leh Khrih Jesuh tawh a kipawl mi khempeuh in a khang khangin a tawntungin phat ciat ta uh hen. Amen.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa' na ka sepna hangin thong a kia keimah in note' nuntakzia dingin a hong deihna tawh a kilawm a kituakin na nuntakna dingun ka hong hanthawn hi.
Tua ahih manin mun khempeuhah a omkim khit theihna dingin a paisuk mipa pen mah vantung a sangpen dawn nangawn khengto-in na paito hi.
Amah in mite tungah siamna a tuamtuam hong pia a, pawlkhatte sawltak nasep a semding, pawlkhatte kamsang nasep a semding, pawlkhatte thuhilh kawikawi nasep a semding, pawlkhatte pawlpi kem nasep a semding, leh pawlkhatte laihilh nasep a semdingin a hong seh hi.
Hih nasep a tuamtuamte khempeuh a semdingin Pasian' mi khempeuh kigingkhol sakin Khrih-a' dingin na semin Khrih pumpi a khan'sak theihna ding deihna ahi hi.
Tua hi leh Pasian' Tapa i theihna leh i thu upna-ah kithukhatin, eite a khangcing suakin, Khrih' cingtaakna ciang i banto ding hi.
Ama ukna mangin pumpi na a tuamtuamte a kituak takin kizom a, amaute limtakin a kizop dimdiamna hangin pumpi pen pumkhat a suak thei hi. Pumpi na a tuamtuamte in amau' sepding ciat hoihtakin a sep uh ciangin itna hangin pumpi khangin a cingtaak a suak thei hi.
Tu-in Topa' min tawh limtakin note kiangah ka hong gennop thu in: Thu umlo dawibiate bangin gamta nawn kei un. Amaute' thu ngaihsutte a kimang bangmah omlo a,
a ngaihsutnate uh khuamial tawh kibang hi. Amaute' lungsim khauhin bangmah thei hetlo uh ahih manin Pasian' hong piak nuntakna neikha hetlo uh hi.
Amaute in maizumna mel thei nawnlo uh a, siatna sung tungin, a ututun a kilawm lopipi-in gamta uh hi.
Tua bang gamtatnate pen Khrih thu panin na theihkhak uh hilo hi.
Zuauna lungsim in a suksiat khitsa, nidangin na nuntakna ngei uh ahi na pian'lui uh paikhia un la,
na lungsim uh leh na ngaihsutna uh thaksuak sak un.
A thutang a siangtho ahihna thu, nuntakna mahmah panin a kilangsak, Pasian' pian'zia tawh kibangin a kibawl na ngeina thak uh bangin na nungta un.
Tua ahih manin zuau gen nawn kei un la, Khrih pumpi nate ihihna hangin pawlkhat ihih manin khatlekhat tungah thuman kigen ni.
Na heh uh ciangin, tua hehna hangin khialkha kei un la, a tawntungin heh paisuak kei un.
Dawimangpa in hong suksiat theihna ding hun omsak kei un.
Guta ngeite in gu nawnloin, ama nuntakna ding thuman takin thalawhin, mizawngte zong a huhtheih laina dingin thatang tawh nasep ding kipan ta uh hen.
Na kiho uh ciangin kamguh zang kei un la, na pauna uh a za mite in phattuamna a ngahtheihna dingin na-in a kimang kam hoihte bek na pau un.
Ni khat ni ciangin Pasian in note hong tatkhiat taktakna ding thu a ciantakin hong lahna leh Pasian' neihsa na hihna uh hong ciamtehna-in Kha Siangtho hong pia ahih manin, tua Pasian' Kha Siangtho na dahsak kei un.
Kimuhdahna, hehna, thangpaihna, kitotna, kikona, kilungsim neihna khempeuh beisak un la,
khatlekhat kihehpihin, lungsim neem tawh na kihozaw un la, Khrih' hangin Pasian in note' mawhna hong maisak mah bangin khatlekhat na mawhna uh na kimaisak ta un.
Note pen Pasian in a hong it a tate na hih manun amah tawh na kibatna dingun hanciam un.
Khrih in eite a hong it manin Pasian in eite' mawhna hong maisak theihna dingin a namtui biakna-in Pasian kiangah a kipiak mah bangin note zong itna tawh na gamta un.
Note pen Pasian' mi na hih manun note lakah nulepa khialhna, a kilawmlo-a gamtatna, huaihamna cihte genin zong na nei vet kei un.
A kilawmlo-a kampauna, leh ciamnuih hoihlo cihte zong na zang kei un la, Pasian tungah lungdam kohna kam na pauzaw un.
Nulepa khialhna a gamta mi, a kilawmlo-a a gamta mi, leh a huaiham (huaihamna zong milim biakna zahin sia hi) mite in Khrih Ukna leh Pasian Ukna sungah bangmah ngah nei hetlo ding ahihna uh teltakin thei ta un.
Hih bang mawhnate i bawl hangin phamawh kei, ci-in a mawk gen mite' khemsa-in ta kei un. Pasian thu mangloin hih bangin a gamta mite in Pasian' hehna a thuak ding uh ahi hi.
Khuamial gamtatna, bangmahin a kimanglo nasepnate su vet kei un la, tua bang gamtatnate a hoihlohna pholak zaw un.
Kuama theihlohin a simthamin a hihte uh gen ding nangawnin zong zumhuai lua hi.
Na khat peuhpeuh khuavakah pusuah lehang a pian'zia man taktak hong kilang hi.
Tua ahih manin la sungah, "A ihmu mi aw, khanglo in la, sihna panin tho in. Tua hi leh Khrih in nang hong taan' ding hi," kici hi.
Tua ahih ciangin hoihtakin kingaihsunin gamta un la, mihaite bang hiloin mipilte bangin gamta un.
Tuhun pen hun hoihlo hun ahih manin na hun neih khempeuh uh a hoih lamin zang un.
Tua ahih manin hai ommawk kei un la, Topa in bang a semdingin hong deih ahi hiam, ci-in kan un.
La a tuamtuamte genin sakna tawh Topa' thu gen belin nei un la, na lungsim khempeuh uh tawh Topa phatna la sa un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Khrih pen ama pumpi ahi pawlpi a honkhiapa hi-in, pawlpi tungah ukna thu a neih mah bangin pasal in a zi tungah ukna thu a nei ahi hi.
Pawlpi pen paubaan'na a om hetlo, a siangtho mahmahin Khrih kiangah a kipiak theihna dingin Pasian thu tawh tui-ah a silsiang khit ciangin Pasian kiangah a aptheihna dingin pawlpi-a' dingin Khrih a kipia ahi hi.
Eite pen ama pumpi nate ihihna hangin Khrih in hong it mah bangin kuamah in ama pumpi mudah ngeilo a, hoihtakin kemin a vakzaw hi.
Tua ahih manin Lai Siangtho in, "Hih thu hangin pasal in a nu leh a pa nusia-in a zi tawh kigawm ding a, amaute gel khat a suak ding uh hi," na ci hi.
Pasalte in amau pumpi zahin a zite uh itin, zite in zong amau pumpi zah mahin a pasalte uh a it ding uh ahih mah bangin, Lai Siangtho in hih bangin a gen ciangin a thukzaw khat, Khrih leh pawlpi a ki-itna a gennopna ahi hi, ci-in ka ngaihsun hi.
Tate aw, na nu na pate uh thu na man'ding uh Khristian ngeina hi a, ahi ding mah ahi hi.
Thupiakna a lian khat in, "Na nu leh na pa zahtak in," cihna hi a, khapna thu tawh kizom pahin, "Zahtak lecin nang-a' dingin thu hong hoihin, leitungah na khan' a sau ding hi," na ci pah hi.
Pate aw, na tate uh a hehtheihna dingin bawl kei un la, Khristiante ngeina tawh kituakin taii-in hilhin pantah un.
Silate aw, launa leh lin'na tawh na leitung tote uh thu mang un la, Khrih' na na sep uh mah bangin lungsim takpi tawh na na sepsak un.
A hong pahtak ding uh deihna tawh amaute' muhsung bekin tuaci gamtat kei un la, Khrih' sila na hihna hangun Pasian' hong deih bangin lungsim takpi tawh na sem un.
Mihingte' na a sem bang lelin kingaihsun loin Topa' na a sem bangin kingaihsun un la, thanopna tawh sem un.
Salte ahi a, sal ahilote ahi zongin na hoih a sem mi khempeuh, Topa in thaman a piakding lamtak na thei un.
Tote aw, silate in note hong bawl mah bangin note in zong amaute limbawl un la, tawn' gawpgawpnate zang nawn kei un. Note leh na silate uh vantung panin To khat khutnuai-ah a om na hihna uh leh tua Topa in kuamah maitang zahtak tuam neiloin a kibangin mi khempeuh thu a khen ahihna thu na phawk ta un.
Tu-a kipanin Topa tawh na kipawlna uh leh ama vangliatna hangin na tha uh khauhsak ta un.
Dawimangpa' hong hihna ding khempeuh na dalzawhna dingun Pasian' galvan namkim na zang un.
Eite' do pen leitung mite hilo a, vantung huihlakah a om ukna, aana a neite, hih leitung khuamial a uk a tuamtuamte ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin hun haksat hun hong tun' ciangin galte' hong suknateng khempeuh nangzo-in, a tawpna-ah a gualzo na hih theihna dingun Pasian' galvan namkim na zang un.
Tua ahih ciangin kawnggak gak bangin thutak zang un la, awmdal bulh bangin thuman zang un la,
kithawi-a khedap bulh bangin Lungdamna Thu a hilhkhia dingin kiging un.
Tua banah, dawimangpa' hong kahna thaltang kuangte na sukmitna dingun lum puak bangin upna na nei tawntung un.
Siklukhu khuk bangin hotkhiatna nei un la, Kha Siangtho in a hong piak Pasian' thu pen namsau zat bangin na zang un.
Kha Siangtho tawh kopin a tawntungin Pasian kiangah na kisapna khempeuh uh ngenin na thum un la, tatsat loin Pasian mi khempeuh-a' dingin thu na ngetsak un.
Thu ka hilhtheih hun ding ciangin lungdamna thusim hangtakin ka hilhkhiat theihna dingin Pasian in ka thugen ding hong hilhna dingin kei-a' dingin zong thu na ngetsak ta un.
Pasian' thu genin tangmi ka sepna hang mahin sikkhau khihna thuakin thongkia ka hih manin ka hilhdingin a kilawm bangin hangtakin ka gen ngamna dingin thu hong ngetsak ta un.
Ka septe leh ka omzia khempeuh na theihna dingun Topa thu sungah i sanggam, thuman takin na a sem Tikhikas in note kiangah thu khempeuh a cingin hong gen ding hi.
Kote' omzia na theihna ding uh leh amah in note' lungsim hong thahatsak theihna dingin amah a hong paisak ka hi hi.
Pa Pasian leh Topa Jesuh Khrih in ulenaute khempeuh tungah nopsakna leh itna, thu upna tawh hong piakhawm ta hen.
Tatsat loin i Topa Jesuh Khrih a it tawntung mi khempeuh tungah hehpihna thupha hong tung ta hen.
Jesuh Khrih' sila keimah Paul leh Timoti in Filippi khua-a om Khrih tawh a kipawl Pasian' mite, siate, leh upate khempeuh tungah lai ka hong khak uh hi.
I Pa Pasian leh Topa Jesuh Khrih in note tungah dikna leh nopsakna thupha hong pia ta hen.
Note in lungdamna thu na zak ni uha kipanin tuni ciangdong, lungdamna thuhilh nasepna-ah kei na hong huhna uh hangin ka nuam mahmah a, note-a' dingin thu ka nget simin lungdam mahmahna tawh ka ngen tawntung hi.
Note sungah hih nasep hoih a hong pankhia Pasian in Jesuh Khrih hong paikik hun ciangdong, mi cingtaak na hihna dingun hong huh ding hi, ci-in teltakin ka thei hi.
Lungdamna thu hangin ka thongkiatna leh lungdamna thu man hi, ci-in pangin ka kipsakna ding hun ka ngahna-ah kei tawh a hong pangkhawm na hih manun ka lungsim sungah note na om tawntung uh a, hih zahta-in note ka hong phawkding a kilawm thu mah ahi hi.
Note-a' ding deihsakna tawh thu ka hong ngetsak thu in: Note' lungsimah itna khang semsemin, a sia leh a pha a mantakin khenthei-in a hoihpen na teeltheihna ding uh ahi hi.
Tua hi leh Khrih hong paikik ni ciangin paubaan'na omloin a siangtho na hi ding uh hi.
Jesuh Khrih in note mihoih a hong suahsak theihna leh mite in Pasian pahtawi-in a phattheihna thu, note' gamtat hoih in midangte tungah kilangsak ding hi.
Sanggamte aw, kei tungah a piang thu in lungdamna thu mai a nawtsakzaw ahihna thu na theihding uh ka deih hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Khrih nasem ka hihna hangin thongkia ka hihna thu, inncing galkapte-a kipanin mi khempeuh in a thei uh hi.
Tua banah keima thongkiatna hangin hih lai-a om Khristiante a tamzaw in Topa muan'na-in nei uh a, lau hetloin Pasian' thu gen ngamna-in neizaw uh hi.
Mi pawlkhatte in ahih leh hong hazatna leh hong langpan' nopna tawh Khrih thu hilh uh a, ahi zongin mi pawlkhatte in lungsim hoihtak mah tawh a hilh uh hi.
Pawlkhatte in ahih leh lungsim hoih tawh hiloin ka thongkiatna-ah na ka sak semsem theihna dingin kei hong demna-in Khrih thu a hilh uh hi.
Ahi zongin phamawh ka sa kei hi. Lungsim hoih tawh a kihilh a, lungsimkhem tawh a kihilh ahi zongin, bangbang hita se leh Khrih' thu gen uh ahih nungsang, kei ka lungdam hi.
Note hong thungetsakna leh Jesuh Khrih Kha Siangtho huhna tawh suakta ding hi ing, ci-in thei ka hih manin ka lungdam hi.
Ka si a, ka hing zongin, a diak diakin tu-a kipanin a tawntungin midangte in Khrih phat theihna ding lungsim han'na a neih theihna dingun ka lungsim leh ka pumpi tawh keima tavuan ka lelh hetlohna ding pen ka deihdeih, ka lametet bulpi ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Khrih-a' ding bekin a nungta ka hi a, si ta leng zong kei-a' dingin hoihzaw semsem lai hi.
Leitung pumpi nungta lai hi leng na a manpha tampi semthei ding ka hih manin, sihding leh hin'ding ka teelsawn ding ka thei kei hi.
Hih thu nih khentat hak ka sa mahmah hi. Kei-a' dingin hoihzaw thampek ahih manin leitung pumpi si-in Khrih tawh omkhawm ding ka ut hi.
Ahi zongin note-a' dingin kei ka hin' lai ding kisam phazaw hi.
Hih thu a hoihpen ding hi, ci-in theitel ka hih manin note' khan'tohna ding leh upna hangin na lungdamna uh a khangsak dingin note ka hong hin'pih lai ding hi.
Tua ahih manin note kiangah ka hong hawhkik ciangin Jesuh Khrih tawh kipawlin na nuntakna uhah kei nong kisialhpihna ding uh thu tampi hong omlai ding hi.
Note tawh a omkhawm dingin ka hong paithei a, ka hong paithei kei zongin note in lungdamna thu tawh kipawl upna thu-ah ngimna kikhatin kiptakin na omna ding uh leh deihna kikhatin na dokhawmna thu uh ka zak theihna dingin Khrih hanga lungdamna thu tawh a kilawm a kituakin na nuntak ding uh a thupi pen ahi hi.
Note a hong gualzosak dingpa pen Pasian ahih manin na galte uh na kihta kei un. Hangtakin om tawntung le uh cin, note a gualzo ding hi-in, na galte uh a guallel ding ahihna thu, na galte un hong thei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Khrih' na sepna ding hunpha zong note tungah a hong kipia hi a, Khrih upna tawh ama na a sem hi bek loin, thuakna tawh zong a sem ding na hi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-in note in na hong muh uh ka galdona leh tu mahmahin ka do lailai na zak uh thute-ah kei na hong dopih thei ding uh hi.
Tua ahih manin kei tawh ngaihsutna kibangin note khatlekhat ki-itin, khatlekhat lungsim kituakin na omna uh tawh keima lungdamna na hong cingtaaksakna dingun ka hong kun hi.

Ei Khristian-te khatlekhat ki-it ihih manin sihna khutsung panin paikhia-in nuntakna khutsungah a lut khinta ihihna thu i thei khinzo hi. Itna lungsim a neilote pen sihna khutsung mahah a omlai uh ahi hi.
A Khristian mipih a mudah mi peuhmah mi that hi a, mi thatte in nuntak tawntungna a neihlohna thu na thei uh hi.
Itna i cih bangci theihding ihi hiam cih leh: Khrih in eite-a' dingin a nuntakna hong pia hi. Ei zong i Khristian mipihte-a' dingin i nuntakna i piak ngam ding ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin tu-a bangin i om leh a thuman Pasian tawh a kipawl ihihna leh ama mai-ah lungmuang takin a omthei ding ihihna i thei ding hi.
Tua ahih manin ka it lawmte aw, i lungsimah kisuan'na i neih hetkei leh Pasian' mai-ah lungmuang takin i om ding hi.
Ama thupiaknate zui-in ama lungkimna dingin gamta ihih manin ama kiang panin i nget peuhpeuh i ngah hi.
Ka it lawmte aw, kha ka nei a ci mi khempeuh' thugen um kei un la, tua thute Pasian kiang pan mah ahi hiam, ci-in kantel un. Bang hang hiam cih leh leitungah kamsang a kineihkhem tampi hong om khinta hi.
Pasian' Kha sawlna tawh thugente leh adangte bangci khentheih ding na hi uh hiam cih leh: Jesuh Khrih pen mihing bangin hong pai hi, ci-in a gente khempeuh Pasian Kha' lamlahna tawh thugen ahi hi.
Ahi zongin hih thu a nial mi peuhmah, Pasian Kha' sawlna tawh thugen hilo uh hi. Hih bang mite pen Khrih' Gal hi a, hong paiding hi, ci-in na zaksa uh mah bangin tu-in leitungah a hong om khinta ahi uh hi.
Ka it tate aw, note, Pasian' mite na hi uh a, tua bang kamsang kineihkhemte a zokhin na hi uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh leitung mite a pan'pih dawimangpa sangin note hong ompih Pasian vanglian zaw hi.
Kamsang a kineihkhemte in leitung thu gen uh a, amaute pen Pasian a theilo hih leitung mite tawh kipawl uh ahih manin leitung mite in amau' thugen a ngai uh hi.
Ahi zongin note pen Pasian' mite na hi uh hi. Pasian a thei mi peuhmah in kote' thugen hong ngai uh a, Pasian' pawl a hilo mi peuhmah in kote' thugen hong ngailo uh hi. Tua ahih manin hih bangin thuman Kha leh zuau kha a kilamdan'na i theithei hi.
Ka it lawmte aw, Pasian pen itna hong pian'khiatna bulpi ahih manin eite khatlekhat ki-it ni. Itna a nei mi peuhmah, Pasian' tate hi a, Pasian a thei uh hi.
Pasian pen ki-itna ahih manin itna a neilo mite in Pasian theilo uh hi.
Pasian in eite hong itna hong bangci lah hiam cih leh: Ama hangin eite in nuntakna i ngahtheihna dingin a Tapa neihsun Pasian in leitungah a hong paisak hi.
Hih ka gen itna pen eite in Pasian i itna thu hilo a, Pasian in eite hong itin, i mawhna a maitheihna dingin a Tapa a hong paisakna thu ahi hi.
Ka it lawmte aw, Pasian in tua zahta-in eite hong it ahih leh eite zong khatlekhat i ki-it ding a kilawm ahi hi.
Kuamah in Pasian mu ngeilo hi. Ahi zongin eite khatlekhat i ki-it leh eite tawh Pasian hong omkhawm a, ama itna eite lakah a cingtaakin a om ahi hi.
Pasian in eite tungah a hong piak Kha Siangtho hangin Pasian leh eite a omkhawm ihihna leh Pasian in eite hong ompih ahihna thu i thei hi.
Thukhen Ni ciangin kisuan'na nei hetloin i omtheihna dingin eite in a cingtaak itna a nei ihi hi. Khrih mah bangin hih leitung i nuntakna-ah nungta-in gamta ihih manin tua bang kisuan'na a neilo ding ihi hi.
Itna nei lehang launa omlo a, itna cingtaak nei peuh lehang launa beimangta hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh launa i cih pen gimthuak ding kihtakna hi a, gimthuak ding a laute pen itna cingtaak a neilote ahi hi.
Mi khatpeuh in, "Pasian ka it hi," ci napi-in a Khristian mipihte a muhdah leh a zuaupi a gen ahi hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a muhtheih a Khristian mipih a itlo mi in a muhtheihloh Pasian it theilo ding hi.
Pasian i it ciangin ama thupiakte a zui ihi hi. Eite-a' dingin ama thupiakte zuihding a haksa lua hilo hi.
Hih Jesuh Khrih pen tui tawh kiphumna leh a sisan luangin sihna tawh a hong pai hi a, tui bek tawh a hong pai hiloin tui leh sisan tawh a hong pai ahi hi. Kha mahmah in hih thu a manna teci a pang hi. Kha pen thuman gen ahi hi.

Mihingte' teci pan'na sangthei ihih leh Pasian' teci pan'na i san'theih ding thupizaw hi. Pasian in ama Tapa' thu tu-a bangin teci hong pang hi.
Tua ahih manin Pasian' Tapa a um mi peuhmah in Pasian' teci pan'na a sang ahi hi. Ahi zongin Pasian' thugen a umlo mi peuhmah in ama Tapa thu teci pangin a gennate a umlo uh ahih manin Pasian pen zuaugen a suaksak ahi uh hi.
Tu-in Pasian' teci pan'na in: Pasian in ama Tapa tung tawnin eite tungah nuntak tawntungna a hong pia hi.
Pasian' Tapa tawh a kipawl peuhmah in nuntak tawntungna nei a, Pasian' Tapa tawh a kipawllote in nuntak tawntungna neilo uh hi, cihna ahi hi.
Pasian' Tapa a um mite in nuntak tawntungna a nei na hih lamtak uh na theihna dingun hih lai a hong gelh ka hi hi.
Eite in ama deihna tawh kituakin i nget nak leh i nget khempeuh Pasian in hong piading hi, ci-in kimuan'na lungsim i nei hi.
Eite' ngetna khempeuh amah in na za hi, ci-in thei ihih manin ama kiang panin i nget khempeuh zong hong piading hi, ci-in i thei hi.
Mi khatpeuh in a Khristian mipihte a sihna ding zah ciang a hilo mawhna a gamta a muh leh ama-a' dingin thu ngetsak ta hen. Ama thungetna bangin Pasian in a nuntakna suksaklo ding hi. Hih pen sihna zah ciang mawhna a hilote ka cihna ahi hi. Ahi zongin sihna ding zah ciang ahi mawhna om a, tuate-a' ding ngetsak un, a ci ka hi kei hi.
Gamtat khialhna khempeuh mawhna hi a, ahi zongin mawhna khempeuh in sihna ciangdong piangsak khinlo hi.
Pasian' tate in mawhna bawbawllo uh hi. Pasian' Tapa in amaute kem a, Dawimangpa in amaute susia zolo hi.
Leitung midang khempeuh Dawimangpa' khutsungah a om ahi zongin eite pen Pasian' mi ihihna thu i thei hi.
Ka itte aw, milim na biakkhak lohna dingun na kidawm un.
A khangham bel keimah Johan in Teeltuam ahi, kong it taktak tonu leh na pawlpi mite kiangah lai ka hong gelh hi. Kei bek in a hong it hiloin thuman a thei taktakte khempeuh in zong hong it uh hi.
Pa Pasian leh a Tapa Jesuh Khrih in dikna, hehpihna, leh nopsakna, eite tungah hong pia hen la, thuman leh itna tawh tua thuphate khempeuh eite-a' hong hi ta hen.
Tua ahih ciangin ka hong it tonu aw, ka hong thum nopna panin: Eite khempeuh khatlekhat ki-it ni, cihna ahi hi. Hih ka hong gen thu pen thuthak hilo a, a kipatcil peka kipanin i neihsa thupiakna ahi hi.
Itna thu ka hong gen ciangin Pasian' thupiakte zuiding cihna ahi hi. A kipat cila kipan na zaksa uh ahi hih thupiakna pen na khan' tawntungun zui-in itna na nei ta un.
Tua ahih ciangin na sepsa uh thuman taankha loin, a kimtakin na ngahtheihna dingun limtakin kidawm un.
Khrih' thuhilhna zuiloin a khengvalin a pai mite pen Pasian tawh a kipawllo ahi hi. Ahi zongin a thuhilhna a zuite pen Pa Pasian leh a Tapa tawh a kipawl ahi uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Khrih' hilh ahi hih thute a hilhlo midang khatpeuh note kiangah a hong pai leh na inn uhah zong na tungsak kei un la, zong na hopih kei un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh tua bang mite-a' ding thupha a deihsak mite pen amau' nasep hoihlohna-ah zong a kipawl ahi uh hi.
Gen ding tampi ka neihlai hangin lai-in hong gelhlo zaw-in, eite' lungdamna a kicin'zawk theihna dingin kei hong pai-in khatlekhat maitang kimu-in thu genkhawm dingin ka kingaihsun hi.
Ka lawm it Gaias aw, nang na ci damin na vai khempeuh zong na ma pai ding hi, ci-in ka lamen hi. Kha thu tawh kisai lamsangah zong bangmah lungkhamna omlo ding hi, ci-in ka thei hi.
Tate bangin ka hong neih mite a mantakin a gamtatna uh ka zakna hangin ka lungdamna sangin adang lungdamna lianzaw bangmah omlo hi.
Ka hong it lawm Gaias aw, na theih ngeiloh hinapi-in i Khristian mipihte lungsim takpi tawh na na huh hi.
Amaute na limbawlna thu, hih lai-a pawlpite kiangah hong gen uh hi. I biak Pasian' deihna tawh kituakin a khualzinna uh nuamtakin a zoptheihna dingun na huh in.
Amaute pen Pasian' nasem dingin a khualzin khia uh hi a, thu umlo mite tung panin bangmah huhna ngahlo uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Pasian thuman nasepna-ah nasem khawm mite ihih theihna dingin ei Khristian-te in hihbang mite i huh ding ahi hi.
Na pawlpite kiangah lai ka gelh ngei hi. Ahi zongin na pawlpi sungah milian pen a ut Diotrefes in ka thugen hong mang nuamlo hi.
Tua ahih manin kong pai ciangin kote hong gensiatna, zuauthu a genna, leh a gamtatna khempeuh ka pholak ding hi. Tua bang mi gensiatna ciang bek hiloin, i Khristian mipihte zin nangawn tungsak nuamlo a, zin a tungsak nuamte nangawn khamin, pawlpi panin hawlkhiat ding hanciam lai hi.
Ka hong it lawm Gaias aw, mi hoihlote' gamtatna zui kei in la, mihoihte' gamtatna zui in. A gamtat hoih mite pen Pasian tawh a kipawl mi hi a, a gamtat hoihlo mite pen Pasian a thei nailo ahi uh hi.
Nang tawh kimu baih thei dingin kilamen ka hih manin, tuahun ciangin maitang kimu-in i kiho ding hi. Nangma tungah nopsakna thupha hong tung ta hen. Hih lai-a om i lawmte in hong hopih uh hi. Tua lai-a om i lawmte khempeuh a milipin na hopihsak in.
Jesuh Khrih' sila ka hih banah James' nau keimah Jude in Pasian' sapna hangin Jesuh Khrih kepna sungah Pasian itna tawh a om mite tungah lai ka hong khak hi.
Note khempeuh tungah hehpihna, leh itna thupha tampi tak hong tung ta hen.
Ka itte aw, eite in i ngahkhawm hotkhiatna thu, note kiangah gelh nuam mahmahin ka om laitakin Pasian in ama mite tungah a tawntungin a kimang dingin khatvei bek a hong piak upna thu-ah note in na nawksuakna dingun hanthotna gelh ding a kisapna thu ka phawk hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Pasian' thu a ngaihsunlo mi pawlkhat, eite lakah kuama phawklohin hong lutsim uh a, amaute' mawh gamtat ngamnate a seelna-un Pasian' hehpihna thupha a lehlamin hei-in, eite in khat bek i neih i Mangpa leh i Topa ahi Jesuh Khrih a nial uh hi. Hihbang mite' gimthuak ding thu tanglai pekin Lai Siangtho in a gensa thu ahi hi.
Note in na theihsa uh ahi ta zongin ka hong phawksak nop thu in: Topa in Egypt gam panin Israel mite honkhia khin napi-in amah a umlo mite a nung ciangin susiagawp hi.
Amau' aana neih huamsung bekah omloin a omna panun a paikhia vantung mite zong leinuai khuamial sungah sikkol kibulhin amau' thu a kikhen ding Ni lianpi ngakin Pasian in a koihcip hi.
Sodom khua leh Gomorrah khua leh a kiima om khuapi mite zong tua vantung mite mah bangin gamta uh a, numei tawh mawhnopna bek thamloin pasal leh pasal kilunggulhna ciangdong nei uh ahih manin midangte' etteh dingin tawntung meikuang a thuak uh hi.
Tua mite mah bangin hih mite zong thumu-in kinei-in amau pumpi thanghuaisak uh a, Pasian' thu nialin tunglama om minthan'na a neite a simmawhbawl uh hi.
Vantung milianpa Mikhael nangawn tua bangin gamta ngamlo hi. Moses' luanghawm kituhin Dawimangpa tawh a kitot laitakin Mikhael in Dawimangpa zahkona kammal zang ngamloin, "Topa in nang hong taii ta hen," ci bek hi.
Ahi zongin hih mite in a theihtel loh uh thute simmawhbawl uh a, ganhing bangin a pian'pih lungsim uh tawh gamta uh ahih manin siatna thuaklawh uh hi.
Hih mite-a' dingin dahhuai mahmah hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh Kain' gamtat bangin gamta-in, sum ngaihsutna-in Balaam' khialh bangin khial uh a, Korah' lehdo bangin lehdo-in siatna thuak uh hi.
Note' annek khopna-ah zumnamel neiloin hong omgawp uh ahih manin hong siatsuah uh a, amau' pumpi bek ngaihsun uh hi. Amaute pen cikmahin guah a zusak ngeilo, huih in a letkhiatmang meiipi, tuk hun laitak nangawnin a gah a gahlo, kizunglotin a keutum singkungte,
a sepna uh tawh amau mah' maizumna ding a piangsak tuipi hualte, leh Pasian in amaute' omna dingin leisung khuamial thukpi a koihsak tawntung, a lampial aksite tawh kibang bek uh hi.
Pasian' deihna bangin a gamtatlohna hang uh leh kam hoihlopipi zangin Pasian a gensiatnate uh hangin Pasian' deihna bangin a gamtalo mite tungah thu khenin mawhsakna pia ding hi," na ci hi.
Hih mite a tawntungin phunin khatlekhat mawhna kizong uh a, amau pumpi deihna bangun gamta-in kiphasak uh a, phattuamna a ngah theihna dingun midangte a phat uh hi.
Amaute in note kiangah, "Hun nunung lam ciangin Pasian' deihna tawh a kituaklo amau pumpi deihna zui-in note a hong simmawhbawl mi pawlkhat hong piang ding hi," hong ci uh hi.
Hih mite in pawl kikhenna piangsakin, amau pumpi deihna bangin gamta uh a, Kha Siangtho zong neilo uh hi.

Johan in Asia gamsungah a om pawlpi sagihte tungah a khak lai ahi hi. A beisa hun, tuhun, leh mailam hunah a om tawntung Pasian kiang pan leh ama tokhom mai-ah a om Kha Siangtho sagihte tung pan leh,

A beisa hun, tuhun, leh mailam hunah zong a om tawntung ding a Vanglian Topa Pasian in, "Kei pen na khempeuh a Kipatna leh a Tawpna ka hi hi," a ci hi.
Note' sanggam keimah Johan in Jesuh tawh kipawlna hangin note mah bangin bawlsiatna thuakin, Pasian' Ukna sungah omin, lungduai takin a thuak mipa ka hi hi. Pasian' thu leh Jesuh' hong gen thumante ka genna hangin Patmos a kici tuikulhah kei hong kikoih hi.
Topa' ni-in Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin ka om laitakin peengkul bangin a gingpha mahmah khat ka nunglamah ka za a,
"Na muhte khempeuh laibu sungah gelh in la, Efesa pawlpi, Smyrna pawlpi, Pergamum pawlpi, Thiatira pawlpi, Sardis pawlpi, Filadelfia pawlpi, Laodisia pawlpi, hih pawlpi sagihte kiangah khak in," hong ci hi.

a nungta mipa zong ka hi hi. Kei ka si ngei hi. Ahi zongin tu-in hong en in, a nungta tawntung ka hi hi. Sihna leh misite omna gam keima khutnuai ahi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin tu-a na muh, tu laitakin a om thute leh tu nung ciangin a hong piangding thute, lai sungah gelh in.
Tu-in ka taklam khutsungah na muh aksi sagihte leh kham kibawl meivakna sagihte a khiatna in: Aksi sagihte pen pawlpi sagihte' vantung mite a cihna hi a, meivakna sagihte pen pawlpi sagihte a cihna ahi hi.
"Efesa khua-a pawlpi vantung mi kiangah lai gelh in la, a taklam khutah aksi sagih tawi-in, kham kibawl meivakna lakah a pai kawikawi Jesuh' thugenna hih bang ahi hi:
"Note' nasepna, na gimna uh leh lungduai takin na thuakna uh, leh migilote koihmawk loin, sawltak hilo napi-in sawltak hi ung, a ci mite dongtelin sawltak ahihlohna uh na muhkhiatnate uh ka thei hi.
Tua ahih manin na lampialna uh phawkin, na mawhna uh panin kihei un la, na gamtat ngeisa bangun gamta kik un. Na mawhna panun kihei-in na kisikkik kei uh leh note kiangah hong pai-in na meivakna uh ka hong lakkhiatsak ding hi.
Tua ahih manin zakna ding bil a neite in Kha Siangtho in pawlpite kiangah a gen thute na za un. A gualzo mite tungah, Pasian' Huan sunga om nuntakna singgahte a nektheihna dingun thu ka pia ding hi.
"Smyrna khua pawlpi vantung mi kiangah lai gelh in la, a kipatna leh a tawpna, si ngei napi-in a hingkikpa' thugen in:
Na lungkhamnate uh leh na zawn'nate uh ka thei hi. A taktakin note a hau na hi uh hi. Jew mi hilo napi-in Jew mi ka hi uh hi, ci-in note a hong gensiatnate uh ka thei hi. Tua bang mite pen Satan' pawlte ahi uh hi.

"Pergamum khua pawlpi vantung mi kiangah lai gelh in la, a langnihin a hiam mahmah namsau a neipa' thugen in:
Ahi zongin note ka hong mawhsakna ding thu tawmkhat a om hi. Milim biakna ante nesakin, nulepa paktatna piangsak a, Israel mite mawhna a gamtasak Balak tungah thu a hilh Balaam' thuhilhnate a um mi pawlkhat note lakah a om hi.
Tua ahih manin na mawhna panun kisikkik un. Na kisik kei uh leh note kiangah kei hong pai baihin, ka kam panin a pusuak namsau tawh amaute ka do ding hi.
Tua ahih manin zakna ding bil a neite in Kha Siangtho in pawlpite kiangah a gen thute na za un. A gualzo mi tungah a kiselcip manna an pawlkhat leh min thak a kigelhna suangkang khat ka pia ding hi. Tua suangkang pen a ngahte simloh kuamah dang in theilo ding hi.
"Thiatira khua pawlpi vantung mi kiangah lai gelh in la, meikuang tawh a kibang mittang nei-in sumngo kihalsan tawh a kibang khe a nei Pasian' Tapa' thugen in:
Note' gamtatna, itna na neihna, upna na neihna, na nasepna, lungduai takin na thuakna uh, leh a kipatcil lai sangin a nunung lamah na hoihzawknate uh ka thei hi.
Ahi zongin note ka hong mawhsakna ding thu khat om hi. Kamsang numei ka hi, ci-in thu a gen Jezebel na nial kei uh hi. Ama thuhilhna hangin ka nasemte in numei-pasal paktatna gamta-in milim biakna ante a ne uh hi.
Tua numei a kisikkikna ding hun ka piak hangin a paktatna panin kihei nuamlo hi.
Tua ahih manin tu-in tua numei tawh a paktatna uh panin a kisikkik kei uh leh tua numei leh amah tawh a paktat mi khempeuh, lupna ngaksakin nakpi takin gimna ka thuaksak ding hi.
Tua numei' thu a zui mi khempeuh ka that ding hi. Tua hi leh, mihingte' ngaihsutna leh lungsim a kantelpa ka hihna thu pawlpi khempeuh in thei ding uh hi. Note' gamtatna ciat tawh kizui-in ka hong thukkik ding hi.
Ahi zongin Thiatira khua-a om note pawlkhat in tua numei' thuhilhna hoihlote na zui kei uh a, mite in, 'Satan' thu thukpite hi,' a cih thute na sukha kei uh hi. Note tungah vangik bangmah ka hong suan kei ding hi.
A gualzo, a tawp dongin keima deihna bangin a gamtazo mite tungah, keimah in ka Pa tung panin ka ngah vangliatnate mah ka pia ding hi. Minam dangte tungah ukna a neihna ding uh aana ka pia ding a, leibeel satkhap bangin sik ciangkhut tawh minam dangte satgawp ding uh hi.

"Sardis khua pawlpi vantung mi kiangah lai gelh in la, Pasian Kha Siangtho sagih leh aksi sagih a neipa' thugen in: Note' gamtatnate ka thei a, note a si hinapi-in a hing min na pua uh hi.
Tua ahih manin khua phawk un la, na neihlai sunte uh a beimang ma-in thasanpha kik un. Bang hang hiam cih leh na nasepnate uh Pasian' muhna-ah a cingtaak nai hetlo ahihna thu ka thei hi.
Tua ahih manin note a hong kihilh na zaksa uh thute phawkkik un la, tua thute zui-in na mawhna panun kisik kik un. Khua na phawk kei uh leh note kiangah guta bangin ka hong pai ding a, ka hong tun'lam nangawn na thei kei ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin Sardis khuasunga om note lakah a puan a ninsak nailo tawmkhat na om uh hi. Tua bang mite kilawm uh ahih manin kei tawh puanpak silhin ka tonkhawm ding uh hi.
A gualzo mite in tua bangin puanpak silh ding uh a, a nungta mite a kikhumna laibu sung panin amaute' min ka phiat kei ding hi. Ka Pa leh ama vantung mite kiangah zong keima mite ahihna uh ka pulak ding hi.

Jew mi hilo napi-in Jew mi hi ung, ci-in zuau a gen Satan' pawlte, note' mai-ah hong paisakin na khephung uhah ka boksak ding a, note ka hong itna thu amaute ka theisak ding hi.
Note in lungduai takin na thuakna ding uh ka hong thupiakna zui na hih manun leitunga a om mi khempeuh ze-etna dingin leitung bupah a hong tungding lungkhamna panin kei zong note ka hong suaktasak ding hi.
Keimah ka hong pai baih ding hi. Kuamah in, na ngahding uh gualzawhna lukhu hong tuhkhak lohna dingun na neihsate uh hoihtakin na lenkip un.
A gualzote pen ka Pasian' sutpi-in ka bawl ding a, amaute paikhia ngei nawnlo ding uh hi. Amaute tungah ka Pasian' min leh ka Pasian kiang vantung panin a hong paisuk ding Jerusalem khua thak min ka gelh ding a, amaute tungah keima min thak zong ka gelh ding hi.

Note' gamtatnate ka thei a, vot lah vot vetlo, sa lah sa vetloin na omna uh zong ka thei hi. A vot na hih kei uh leh a sa hi vet le uh cin ka ut hi.
Ahi zongin note pen vot lah vot vetlo, sa lah sa vetloin a laklawhin om na hih manun ka kam sung panin ka hong siakhia ding hi.
Note a zawng, a mittaw, puansilh ding a neilo, a hehpihhuai, a lungkhamhuai na hih lamtak uh theiloin, kote hau-in ka cithei uh a, bangmah kisapna ka nei kei uh hi, na ci uh hi.

Teci a pang tua kamsang nihte in leitung mite tungah gimna nakpi takin tungsak uh ahih manin hih mi nihte a sihna hangin lungdamin pawi bawl ding uh a, a nuamna uh hangin khatlekhat letsong kipia ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin ni thum leh ni lang a cin'khit ciangin amaute sungah Pasian kiang panin nuntakna hu lutin, amaute a khe-un hong ding uh ahih manin a mute khempeuh nakpi takin lau mahmah uh hi.
Tua hun laitakin nakpi takin zin ling a, a khuapi sehsawmsuah sehkhat tangding kisiacip a, tua zinling in mi tul sagih a sisak hi. A silo a hing laite lau mahmah uh a, vantung Pasian a liatna thu a phat uh hi.
Tua ciangin a sagihna vantung mi in a peengkul hong tum a, vantungah nakpi takin aw hong ging a, "Leitung ukna ding aana neihna pen i Topa Khrih-a' hong suakkhin a, amah in a tawntungin uk paisuak ding hi," hong ci hi.
Pasian mai-a a tokhom ciat uhah a tu upa sawmnihlelite zong mai pukin Pasian bia uh a,
"A beisa hun leh tu hunah a om tawntung a Vanglian Topa Pasian aw, tu-in na vangliatna zangin ukding hong kipan khin na hih manin nangma tungah ka nuamna uh ka hong ko uh hi.
Na hehna hong kilat hun hong tungta a, misite thukhenna ding hun hong tungta ahih manin minam dangte heh mahmah uh hi. Nangma nasem kamsangte, a lian a neu, nang hong kihta mi khempeuhte thaman na piak ding hun hi ta a, leitung a susia mite na suksiat ding hun hi ta hi," a ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin vantungah a om Pasian biakna innpi kihong a, a Thuciamna Singkuang zong biakinn sungah a om a kimu hi. Tua ciangin nakpi takin khua phia-in a ging lianpi om a, van gingin zin ling a, gialpi a kia hi.
Tua ciangin vanah lim lamdang lian khat hong kilang hi. Puan silh bangin ni silhin, a khe nuai-ah kha omin, aksi sawmlenih a kisuan'na lukhu, a lu tungah a khu numei khat om hi.
Tua ciangin lim lamdang adang khat mah vanah hong kilang leuleu hi. Gulpi san a lian mahmah khat om a, lutang sagih leh ki sawm nei a, a lutang sagihte-ah lukhu mah nei ciat hi.
A mei tawh vanah a om aksi sehsawmsuah sehkhat vatkhia-in leilak a den'na hi. A nau a suah phetin a ne pah dingin nausuak dingin a kithawi tua numei' mai-ah a ding hi.
A numei pen Pasian in ama-a' dingin a bawl kholhsakna mun gamlakah tai a, tua munah ni tul khat za nih sawmguk sung kikhoi ding hi.
Tu-in vantungah galkidona hong om a, Mikhael leh a vantung mite in gulpi leh a vantung mite a do uh hi.
Ahi zongin tua gulpi guallel ahih manin tua gulpi leh a vantung mite, vantungah kiom sak nawnlo hi.
Tua ciangin tua tanglai gulpi, Dawimangpa ahih kei leh Satan a kici, leitung mi khempeuh a khempa pen a vantung mite tawh leitungah kilawnsuk hi.
Tua ciangin vantungah nakpi takin awging khat ka za a, "Tu-in Pasian in hong honkhia khinta a, kumpi vangliatna a neihna hong lakkhia khinta a, ama Khrih in aana a neihna thu lakkhia khinta hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh a sun a zanin eite' Pasian' mai-ah dingin i sanggamte mawhsakna a gen tawntungpa, tu-in vantung panin kilawnkhia khinta hi.
I sanggamte in Tuuno sisan leh thuman a genna uh tawh amah na zo uh a, a nuntakna nangawn uh na pia ngam uh hi.
Tua ahih manin vantungte leh tuate sungah a teng mi khempeuh aw, lungdam un! Ahi zongin vantung panin Dawimangpa hong kilawnkhia suk a, hun tomno bek a neilai ahihlam thei ahih manin leitung leh tui tungah a omte-a' dingin lauhuai mahmah ding hi," hong ci hi.
Ahi zongin tua gulpi in a sukkhak theihlohna dingin kum thum leh alang sung gamlakah a kikepna ding munah a leen'theihna dingin muvanlai gol mahmahte' kha tawh a kibang kha nih tua numei a kiguan' hi.
Gulpi in zong tuikhang tawh tua numei a taihsak theihna dingin a kam panin gunpi luang bangin tua numei' nungah tui a luangsak hi.
Tua ciangin tua numei tungah gulpi heh mahmah a, tua numei' suanlekhak dangte ahi, Pasian' thupiakna zui-in, Jesuh thu-ah kiptakin a om mite a sim dingin kuankhia a, tuipi gei-ah dingin a om hi.
Tua laitakin tuipi sung panin ganhing khat a hong pusuak ka mu hi. Tua ganhing in ki sawm leh lutang sagih nei a, a ki sawmte tungah lukhu khat ciat om a, a lutang sagihte tungah min hoihlo khat ciat a kigelh hi.
Tua ka muh ganhing pen kamkei tawh kibang a, a khete vom khe tawh kibang a, a kam pen humpinelkai kam tawh a kibang hi. Gulpi in tua ganhing tungah ama vangliatna, ama tokhom, leh aana lianpi a pia hi.
A lutang khat in sihna ding zahin liamma lianpi nei ngei napi-in damkik a, leitung mi khempeuh in lamdang sa-in tua ganhing a zui ngeingai uh hi.
Tua ganhing, kiphatsakna leh kam khelnono a pautheihna ding leh kha sawmlenih sung aana a zattheihna dingin thu kipia hi.
Tua ahih manin Pasian, ama min, a omna mun, leh vantungah a omte khempeuh samsia-in a ko gawpgawp hi.
Pasian' mite simin a zawhgawp theihna ding zong kiphal hi. Minam tuamtuam, pau nam tuamtuam a zang mite khempeuh tungah uktheihna ding aana a kipia hi.
Tua ahih manin a kigo Tuuno laibu sungah a nungta ding mite' min, leitung pian'ma pekin a kikhumna-ah a kihello leitung mi khempeuh in tua ganhing bia ding uh hi.
"Salin a pai dingin a kisehsa mite sal mahin pai ding a, namsau-in thah dingin a kisehsate namsau mah tawh kithat ding hi. Tua ahih manin Pasian' mite in upna leh thuakzawhna kisam hi," a kicihna thu, zakna ding bil a neite in za ta uh hen.
Tua ganhing masa a omna mahah ganhing masa' aana khempeuh zang a, a liamma a damsa tua ganhing masa pen leitung leh a tunga om mi khempeuh, aana tawh a biasak hi.
Tua ganhing nihna in na lamdang lianpipi bawl a, mi khempeuhte' muhin van panin leitungah meikuang nangawn a kiasak thei hi.
Ganhing masa omna-ah na lamdang bawltheihna ding thu ngah ahih manin a na lamdang bawlna tawh leitungah a om mi khempeuh khem a, namsau tawh a si ding zahin a kisat liamsa hinapi a nungta lai ganhing pahtawina ding milim khat a bawlna dingun a gen hi.
Tua ganhing nihna in ganhing masa lim dingin a kibawl milim sungah a hu a muap ciangin hong pauthei a, tua milim a bialo khempeuh a thahtheihna dingin thu a ngah hi.
Tua ganhing in a lian a neu, a hau a zawng, sila leh sila a hilo, mi khempeuh in a taklam khut tung uh ahih kei leh a taltang uhah ciamtehna a neihna dingun thu a pia hi.
Tua ahih manin tua ganhing min ahih kei leh a min tangin a nambat ciamtehna a tungah a neilo mi peuhmah, vanlei vanzuakin paikhia theilo uh hi.
Tua ciangin ka khuadak leh Zion Mual tungah Tuuno a dingin a om ka mu hi. Amah tawh mi tul za leh tul sawmli leh tul li dingkhawm uh a, tua mite' taltangah Tuuno leh a pa' min kigelh hi.
Tua laitakin tuizeu lianpi leh vanging tawh a kibang a gingpha mahmah aw khat vantung panin a hong ging ka za hi. Tua awging pen harp lasakna a kitum a ging tawh kibang hi.
Tokhom, ganhing lite, leh upate' lam nga-in tua mihonpite in la thak khat a sa uh hi. Tua la pen leitungah a kitankhiasa mi tul za leh tul sawmli leh tul lite simloh kuamah dang in sa theilo uh hi.
Hih mite in numei tawh paktatna gamta ngei nailo uh a, paubaan'na a neilote ahi uh hi. Amaute in Tuuno a paina peuhpeuhah zui uh a, midang khempeuh sung panin a kitankhiasa, Pasian leh Tuuno tungah a kipia masa mite ahi uh hi.
Amaute, paubaan'na om kiuhkeuhlo uh ahih manin zuauthu gen ngei hetlo uh hi.
Tua ciangin leitungah a teng mi namkim, pau namkim a zang mite tungah a tawntungin Lungdamna ding Thu gen ding a nei vantung mi khat vankim lai-ah a leeng ka mu hi.
Amah nakpi takin kiko a, "Amah in mihingte thu a khen ding hun hong tungta ahih manin Pasian kihta un la amah phat un. Van leh lei, tuinak leh tuipite a bawlpa hong bia ta un," a ci hi.
Tua ciangin vantung mi a nihna in hong zui a, "A Lian Babylon khuapi kicim, kicim! Amah a huk a lanna leenggahzu, mi khempeuh tungah pia-in khamsak a, gimna thuaksak hi," a ci hi.

Pasian' leenggahzu zong dawn ding uh hi. Pasian in ama hehna ahi leenggahzu khauh pen ama hehna hai sungah a dimtakin sung khinzo ta hi. Tua bang mite pen a siangtho vantung mite leh Tuuno mai-ah meikuang leh kat khu tawh gimna kipia ding hi.

Tua ciangin vanah na lamdang lian mahmah khat ka mu hi. Gimna nam sagih a hong keng vantung mi sagih om uh a, Pasian' hehna a lah tawpna uh ahih manin a nunung pente ahi uh hi.
Tua ciangin mei tawh a kihel limlang peekpi kiphah tuipi tawh a kibang ka mu hi. Ganhing, a lim, leh a min nambat tawh a kipiasa a zote, Pasian' lasakna harpte tawi-in tuipi tawh a kibang gei-ah a ding uh hi.
Amaute in Pasian' nasem Moses la leh Tuuno la sa uh a, "A Vanglian Topa Pasian aw, na nasepnate lamdangin lian mahmah hi. Khang tawntunga Kumpipa aw, na nasepnate-ah thumanin na thutang hi.

32 # THANG HO LEH LIAN DO TANGTHU.

I pu i pate in kimuh kitheihna bek tawh thu gen uh hi.
Thusim thulang a genpih ngam lawm hoih khat kinei a, 'bawmta' kicihi.
Bawmtate in a lawmte ki-itna kip taktak a sak ciangin a lawm tangvalpa nu le pate tungah limtakin genpihhi.
A nute a pate zong a numei' nu le pate kiangah zuthawl tawh va hawh uh a, a tapa ziding va dotsak uh a, thukho khat peuhpeuh va gen uh hi; tua pen 'zuthawl pia' kicihi.
Zuthawl pen kisang thei kinolh theihi.
A numei' nu le pa a thukim leh zuthawl neksak in, a thukimna gen uh hi.
Kithukim diamna a om khit ciangin mopiding hun seh-in, a niding khaubawk khih-in, ciamteh uh hi.
Mopiding ciangin a kisamding na khempeuh tawh kikuanpahhi.

siam khat peuhpeuh in zong thu sung thei a, 'tamsi' kicihi.
Thusunding teng a mansiang ciangin inntek lamte zong thu kisung teng a dawn kik nading uh kikumin mun khatah tuam paikhiat uh hi.
Tuate in thusapa thusun: Manpi, mankang, angkhen, kanman, puman, minman, zangdawh, saseng pua, moliah le mualkhupman a kipan thu kisungte tawh kisai in amau thukimna mipi mai-ah sungin gatang kai kik uh hi.
Thukim diamna a om khit ciangin mo sapuakding kigohi.
Tua sa kigo pen 'tunsa' kicihi.
Tunsa pen usa nausa-in kihawm a, bawmta pen in sakha tanghi.
Mo khate in seng khat, tu khat hei khat, puanbu khat, sathau bing khat le khivui khat kengsak a tuate 'mo vanken' kicihi.
Monu deih pen ahi zongin a nute deihsak khat, a lawmpa tawh a lupkhawm ni mateng a, a kithuahpihding nungak khat kicial a, 'moliah' ahi hi.
Mo pen kilei pah loin a gai ciang bekin kileihi.
A gai lam a kitheih ciangin mo manding sial tawh va kikuanin innah va kikhum a, inntekte in sa na gawh in, 'sialkhupsa' kicihi.
Tua sa pen usa nausa mahin kihawmhi.
Sakha pen tamsipa'ahi kei leh thusapa in tanghi.
Tua ni-in inntekte in neihsa lamsa a kensak nop bangbang kengsakhi.
Ta nih le thum a neih uh ciangin inn tuamah tuankhia in innkuan tuamin om kulhi.
Tua banga tuankhia, a tangtente 'inntuan' kicihi.
Inntuanding ciangin a inntuanding pen in sa khat go-in, a inntuanna a, inndongtading kiseh pahhi.
Inndongta sehna ah: sanggam, tanu, pu, thusa, sasem, nuphal, zawl cih bangin.
Tua a kisehte in a sa kigo amau tanding ciat tangpah uh hi.
Inntuan ciangin innpite gal-aih, sa-aih, gawh le lup kikeng thei tohi.
Tuate a hih nop leh inntuancilte hanciamna tungtawn in a banbanin hih theihi.
Numei min in zong hih thei a, pasal min in zong hih theihi.
Numei min tawh a kihih bangkua honna pen 'Tanghawmna' kici a, pasal min tawh a kibawl pen 'gal-aihna' kicihi.
Tanghawmna bawl nadingin vokpi khat kigo masahi.
Tua tanghawmna bawlna sungah a huh dingin 'nupasiangtho' khat zubel khatin kicialhi.
Tua nupate in zong nupasiangtho dang cial beh thei laihi.
Nupasiangtho kici pen a kiten ma un kuamah tawh genbangngei to, a pumpi-ah poina a nei lo a kitengte ahi hi.
Tua bang nupate 'kekta' kicihi.
Hih kektate innsungpi ah a tuamin phek kiphahsak a, pawi a ven mateng tua lai-ah kigiaksakhi.
Tua nupate in tulpipa zatdi'anhang leh zutuite-a kipan mipite nekding dawnding teng sepsak uh hi.
Tulpite a lian penhi a, kektate a zom ahi hi.
Numei min tawh tanghawmna a kipan khit ciangin pasal min tawh gal-aihna kipan leuleuhi.
Gal-aihdi'a kipat ni 'pansik ni' kici a, phit kisat in a nitak ciangin phit kilemhi.
Phit la le phit tumzia a tuamtuam kinei ciathi.
Min sialin hanla sa-in thau kilawnhi.
Innka ah nungak tangvalte in gal la, sa la sa-in zanhak uh hi.
Tua ni 'zupi ni' kicihi.
Zupi ni zingciang ni tum ciangin innsung tumna leh pusuahna om kikhi.
Khuangtumpa in tawngnawk silhin dialpak khim a, muvanlai khaveng le sawnkai a forhi.
gal-ai, sa-aisate bek kivak a, 'lawmvakna' kicihi.

Tua nihte a sih ciangun khuang tumin gal la sala sa-in kilam thei panhi.

Hih sa namte ki-ai thei in zong kimualsuah theihi.

Sa man lo napi a ai nuam a om leh zong ki-ai theihi.
Sa man lo-a a ai nuamte in mi matsa a luhawm kawmin ai theihi.
Sa man-a a aite hita leh a man lo-a a aite hita leh a hamphatna uh a kikim ahi hi.
Gal man, sa man, gal-ai, sa-aite a sih uh ciangin a thah zah a mat zah tawh kizui-in akgia sawnkai kibawl thei bekhi.
Akgia-sawm a kibawl ciangin sawntan, sawnkai, vaphual kha, utong mei, vavu-giate tawh kibawlhi.
Sih ciangin sa mat le sa aihsate min zui-in dial kikhai thei bekhi.

**NGIA LE VA-AK THU**.

Neukha hong ham dih in, za nuam mahmah ing," a ci kikhi.

A kam a kat ciangin sa a kiahi.
Ngia in sa tuah in a taihi.

Zomi s time is divided not by hours, but by blocks of time such as time of the first cock s crow ak masa khuan when you are able to see the foot of the tree in early morning singkhe taan , time to go to work vaikuan hun , it would be between 7-8 oc lock in the morning; late time to go to work Vaihamsan hun ; noon time sun hun ; time to gather mithun sialhawl hun ; early home going or returning back from work vai masa ; late time to go back home vai nunung ; time after dinner; when you cannot recognize a persons identi t y though you are able to see him be c ause of the darkness sanggam melmak ; time to go for visitation or dating lengla kuan hun ; time to return back home lengla ciah hun ; midnight zankim , and so on. Zomi have a longitu d i nal view of time, which means that - what you sow you will reap.
